chapters.en: In the beginning God created the heavens and the earth.
chapters.zh: 起初　神创造天地

chapters.en: Now the earth was formless and empty, darkness was over the surface of the deep, and the Spirit of God was hovering over the waters.
chapters.zh: 地是空虚混沌。渊面黑暗。　神的灵运行在水面上

chapters.en: And God said, “Let there be light,” and there was light.
chapters.zh: 神说，要有光，就有了光。

chapters.en: God saw that the light was good, and he separated the light from the darkness.
chapters.zh: 神看光是好的，就把光暗分开了。

chapters.en: God called the light “day,” and the darkness he called “night.” And there was evening, and there was morning—the first day.
chapters.zh: 神称光为昼，称暗为夜。有晚上，有早晨，这是头一日。

chapters.en: And God said, “Let there be a vault between the waters to separate water from water.”
chapters.zh: 神说，诸水之间要有空气，将水分为上下。

chapters.en: So God made the vault and separated the water under the vault from the water above it. And it was so.
chapters.zh: 神就造出空气，将空气以下的水，空气以上的水分开了。事就这样成了。

chapters.en: God called the vault “sky.” And there was evening, and there was morning—the second day.
chapters.zh: 神称空气为天。有晚上，有早晨，是第二日。

chapters.en: And God said, “Let the water under the sky be gathered to one place, and let dry ground appear.” And it was so.
chapters.zh: 神说，天下的水要聚在一处，使旱地露出来。事就这样成了。

chapters.en: God called the dry ground “land,” and the gathered waters he called “seas.” And God saw that it was good.
chapters.zh: 神称旱地为地，称水的聚处为海。　神看着是好的。

chapters.en: Then God said, “Let the land produce vegetation: seed-bearing plants and trees on the land that bear fruit with seed in it, according to their various kinds.” And it was so.
chapters.zh: 神说，地要发生青草，和结种子的菜蔬，并结果子的树木，各从其类，果子都包着核。事就这样成了。

chapters.en: The land produced vegetation: plants bearing seed according to their kinds and trees bearing fruit with seed in it according to their kinds. And God saw that it was good.
chapters.zh: 于是地发生了青草，和结种子的菜蔬，各从其类，并结果子的树木，各从其类，果子都包着核。　神看着是好的。

chapters.en: And there was evening, and there was morning—the third day.
chapters.zh: 有晚上，有早晨，是第三日。

chapters.en: And God said, “Let there be lights in the vault of the sky to separate the day from the night, and let them serve as signs to mark sacred times, and days and years,
chapters.zh: 神说，天上要有光体，可以分昼夜，作记号，定节令，日子，年岁。

chapters.en: and let them be lights in the vault of the sky to give light on the earth.” And it was so.
chapters.zh: 并要发光在天空，普照在地上。事就这样成了。

chapters.en: God made two great lights—the greater light to govern the day and the lesser light to govern the night. He also made the stars.
chapters.zh: 于是　神造了两个大光，大的管昼，小的管夜。又造众星。

chapters.en: God set them in the vault of the sky to give light on the earth,
chapters.zh: 就把这些光摆列在天空，普照在地上。

chapters.en: to govern the day and the night, and to separate light from darkness. And God saw that it was good.
chapters.zh: 管理昼夜，分别明暗。神看着是好的。

chapters.en: And there was evening, and there was morning—the fourth day.
chapters.zh: 有晚上，有早晨，是第四日。

chapters.en: And God said, “Let the water teem with living creatures, and let birds fly above the earth across the vault of the sky.”
chapters.zh: 神说，水要多多滋生有生命的物，要有雀鸟飞在地面以上，天空之中。

chapters.en: So God created the great creatures of the sea and every living thing with which the water teems and that moves about in it, according to their kinds, and every winged bird according to its kind. And God saw that it was good.
chapters.zh: 神就造出大鱼和水中所滋生各样有生命的动物，各从其类。又造出各样飞鸟，各从其类。　神看着是好的。

chapters.en: God blessed them and said, “Be fruitful and increase in number and fill the water in the seas, and let the birds increase on the earth.”
chapters.zh: 神就赐福给这一切，说，滋生繁多，充满海中的水。雀鸟也要多生在地上。

chapters.en: And there was evening, and there was morning—the fifth day.
chapters.zh: 有晚上，有早晨，是第五日。

chapters.en: And God said, “Let the land produce living creatures according to their kinds: the livestock, the creatures that move along the ground, and the wild animals, each according to its kind.” And it was so.
chapters.zh: 神说，地要生出活物来，各从其类。牲畜，昆虫，野兽，各从其类。事就这样成了。

chapters.en: God made the wild animals according to their kinds, the livestock according to their kinds, and all the creatures that move along the ground according to their kinds. And God saw that it was good.
chapters.zh: 于是神造出野兽，各从其类。牲畜，各从其类。地上一切昆虫，各从其类。　神看着是好的。

chapters.en: Then God said, “Let us make mankind in our image, in our likeness, so that they may rule over the fish in the sea and the birds in the sky, over the livestock and all the wild animals, and over all the creatures that move along the ground.”
chapters.zh: 神说，我们要照着我们的形像，按着我们的样式造人，使他们管理海里的鱼，空中的鸟，地上的牲畜，和全地，并地上所爬的一切昆虫。

chapters.en: So God created mankind in his own image, in the image of God he created them; male and female he created them.
chapters.zh: 神就照着自己的形像造人，乃是照着他的形像造男造女。

chapters.en: God blessed them and said to them, “Be fruitful and increase in number; fill the earth and subdue it. Rule over the fish in the sea and the birds in the sky and over every living creature that moves on the ground.”
chapters.zh: 神就赐福给他们，又对他们说，要生养众多，遍满地面，治理这地。也要管理海里的鱼，空中的鸟，和地上各样行动的活物。

chapters.en: Then God said, “I give you every seed-bearing plant on the face of the whole earth and every tree that has fruit with seed in it. They will be yours for food.
chapters.zh: 神说，看哪，我将遍地上一切结种子的菜蔬和一切树上所结有核的果子，全赐给你们作食物。

chapters.en: And to all the beasts of the earth and all the birds in the sky and all the creatures that move along the ground—everything that has the breath of life in it—I give every green plant for food.” And it was so.
chapters.zh: 至于地上的走兽和空中的飞鸟，并各样爬在地上有生命的物，我将青草赐给它们作食物。事就这样成了。

chapters.en: God saw all that he had made, and it was very good. And there was evening, and there was morning—the sixth day.
chapters.zh: 神看着一切所造的都甚好。有晚上，有早晨，是第六日。

chapters.en: Thus the heavens and the earth were completed in all their vast array.
chapters.zh: 天地万物都造齐了。

chapters.en: By the seventh day God had finished the work he had been doing; so on the seventh day he rested from all his work.
chapters.zh: 到第七日，神造物的工已经完毕，就在第七日歇了他一切的工，安息了。

chapters.en: Then God blessed the seventh day and made it holy, because on it he rested from all the work of creating that he had done.
chapters.zh: 神赐福给第七日，定为圣日，因为在这日神歇了他一切创造的工，就安息了。

chapters.en: This is the account of the heavens and the earth when they were created, when the LORD God made the earth and the heavens.
chapters.zh: 创造天地的来历，在耶和华神造天地的日子，乃是这样。

chapters.en: Now no shrub had yet appeared on the earth and no plant had yet sprung up, for the LORD God had not sent rain on the earth and there was no one to work the ground,
chapters.zh: 野地还没有草木，田间的菜蔬还没有长起来，因为耶和华神还没有降雨在地上，也没有人耕地。

chapters.en: but streams came up from the earth and watered the whole surface of the ground.
chapters.zh: 但有雾气从地上腾，滋润遍地。

chapters.en: Then the LORD God formed a man from the dust of the ground and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life, and the man became a living being.
chapters.zh: 耶和华神用地上的尘土造人，将生气吹在他鼻孔里，他就成了有灵的活人，名叫亚当。

chapters.en: Now the LORD God had planted a garden in the east, in Eden; and there he put the man he had formed.
chapters.zh: 耶和华神在东方的伊甸立了一个园子，把所造的人安置在那里。

chapters.en: The LORD God made all kinds of trees grow out of the ground—trees that were pleasing to the eye and good for food. In the middle of the garden were the tree of life and the tree of the knowledge of good and evil.
chapters.zh: 耶和华神使各样的树从地里长出来，可以悦人的眼目，其上的果子好作食物。园子当中又有生命树和分别善恶的树。

chapters.en: A river watering the garden flowed from Eden; from there it was separated into four headwaters.
chapters.zh: 有河从伊甸流出来，滋润那园子，从那里分为四道。

chapters.en: The name of the first is the Pishon; it winds through the entire land of Havilah, where there is gold.
chapters.zh: 第一道名叫比逊，就是环绕哈腓拉全地的。在那里有金子，

chapters.en: (The gold of that land is good; aromatic resin and onyx are also there.)
chapters.zh: 并且那地的金子是好的。在那里又有珍珠和红玛瑙。

chapters.en: The name of the second river is the Gihon; it winds through the entire land of Cush.
chapters.zh: 第二道河名叫基训，就是环绕古实全地的。

chapters.en: The name of the third river is the Tigris; it runs along the east side of Ashur. And the fourth river is the Euphrates.
chapters.zh: 第三道河名叫希底结，流在亚述的东边。第四道河就是伯拉河。

chapters.en: The LORD God took the man and put him in the Garden of Eden to work it and take care of it.
chapters.zh: 耶和华神将那人安置在伊甸园，使他修理看守。

chapters.en: And the LORD God commanded the man, “You are free to eat from any tree in the garden;
chapters.zh: 耶和华神吩咐他说，园中各样树上的果子，你可以随意吃。

chapters.en: but you must not eat from the tree of the knowledge of good and evil, for when you eat from it you will certainly die.”
chapters.zh: 只是分别善恶树上的果子，你不可吃，因为你吃的日子必定死。

chapters.en: The LORD God said, “It is not good for the man to be alone. I will make a helper suitable for him.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华神说，那人独居不好，我要为他造一个配偶帮助他。

chapters.en: Now the LORD God had formed out of the ground all the wild animals and all the birds in the sky. He brought them to the man to see what he would name them; and whatever the man called each living creature, that was its name.
chapters.zh: 耶和华神用土所造成的野地各样走兽和空中各样飞鸟都带到那人面前，看他叫什么。那人怎样叫各样的活物，那就是它的名字。

chapters.en: So the man gave names to all the livestock, the birds in the sky and all the wild animals. But for Adam no suitable helper was found.
chapters.zh: 那人便给一切牲畜和空中飞鸟，野地走兽都起了名。只是那人没有遇见配偶帮助他。

chapters.en: So the LORD God caused the man to fall into a deep sleep; and while he was sleeping, he took one of the man’s ribs and then closed up the place with flesh.
chapters.zh: 耶和华神使他沉睡，他就睡了。于是取下他的一条肋骨，又把肉合起来。

chapters.en: Then the LORD God made a woman from the rib he had taken out of the man, and he brought her to the man.
chapters.zh: 耶和华神就用那人身上所取的肋骨，造成一个女人，领她到那人跟前。

chapters.en: The man said, “This is now bone of my bones and flesh of my flesh; she shall be called ‘woman,’ for she was taken out of man.”
chapters.zh: 那人说，这是我骨中的骨，肉中的肉，可以称她为女人，因为她是从男人身上取出来的。

chapters.en: That is why a man leaves his father and mother and is united to his wife, and they become one flesh.
chapters.zh: 因此，人要离开父母与妻子连合，二人成为一体。

chapters.en: Adam and his wife were both naked, and they felt no shame.
chapters.zh: 当时夫妻二人赤身露体，并不羞耻。

chapters.en: Now the serpent was more crafty than any of the wild animals the LORD God had made. He said to the woman, “Did God really say, ‘You must not eat from any tree in the garden’?”
chapters.zh: 耶和华神所造的，惟有蛇比田野一切的活物更狡猾。蛇对女人说，神岂是真说，不许你们吃园中所有树上的果子吗？

chapters.en: The woman said to the serpent, “We may eat fruit from the trees in the garden,
chapters.zh: 女人对蛇说，园中树上的果子，我们可以吃，

chapters.en: but God did say, ‘You must not eat fruit from the tree that is in the middle of the garden, and you must not touch it, or you will die.’ ”
chapters.zh: 惟有园当中那棵树上的果子，神曾说，你们不可吃，也不可摸，免得你们死。

chapters.en: “You will not certainly die,” the serpent said to the woman.
chapters.zh: 蛇对女人说，你们不一定死，

chapters.en: “For God knows that when you eat from it your eyes will be opened, and you will be like God, knowing good and evil.”
chapters.zh: 因为神知道，你们吃的日子眼睛就明亮了，你们便如神能知道善恶。

chapters.en: When the woman saw that the fruit of the tree was good for food and pleasing to the eye, and also desirable for gaining wisdom, she took some and ate it. She also gave some to her husband, who was with her, and he ate it.
chapters.zh: 于是女人见那棵树的果子好作食物，也悦人的眼目，且是可喜爱的，能使人有智慧，就摘下果子来吃了。又给她丈夫，她丈夫也吃了。

chapters.en: Then the eyes of both of them were opened, and they realized they were naked; so they sewed fig leaves together and made coverings for themselves.
chapters.zh: 他们二人的眼睛就明亮了，才知道自己是赤身露体，便拿无花果树的叶子，为自己编作裙子。

chapters.en: Then the man and his wife heard the sound of the LORD God as he was walking in the garden in the cool of the day, and they hid from the LORD God among the trees of the garden.
chapters.zh: 天起了凉风，耶和华神在园中行走。那人和他妻子听见神的声音，就藏在园里的树木中，躲避耶和华神的面。

chapters.en: But the LORD God called to the man, “Where are you?”
chapters.zh: 耶和华神呼唤那人，对他说，你在哪里。

chapters.en: He answered, “I heard you in the garden, and I was afraid because I was naked; so I hid.”
chapters.zh: 他说，我在园中听见你的声音，我就害怕。因为我赤身露体，我便藏了。

chapters.en: And he said, “Who told you that you were naked? Have you eaten from the tree that I commanded you not to eat from?”
chapters.zh: 耶和华说，谁告诉你赤身露体呢？莫非你吃了我吩咐你不可吃的那树上的果子吗？

chapters.en: The man said, “The woman you put here with me—she gave me some fruit from the tree, and I ate it.”
chapters.zh: 那人说，你所赐给我，与我同居的女人，她把那树上的果子给我，我就吃了。

chapters.en: Then the LORD God said to the woman, “What is this you have done?” The woman said, “The serpent deceived me, and I ate.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华神对女人说，你作的是什么事呢？女人说，那蛇引诱我，我就吃了。

chapters.en: So the LORD God said to the serpent, “Because you have done this, “Cursed are you above all livestock and all wild animals! You will crawl on your belly and you will eat dust all the days of your life.
chapters.zh: 耶和华神对蛇说，你既作了这事，就必受咒诅，比一切的牲畜野兽更甚。你必用肚子行走，终身吃土。

chapters.en: And I will put enmity between you and the woman, and between your offspring and hers; he will crush your head, and you will strike his heel.”
chapters.zh: 我又要叫你和女人彼此为仇。你的后裔和女人的后裔也彼此为仇。女人的后裔要伤你的头，你要伤他的脚跟。

chapters.en: To the woman he said, “I will make your pains in childbearing very severe; with painful labor you will give birth to children. Your desire will be for your husband, and he will rule over you.”
chapters.zh: 又对女人说，我必多多加增你怀胎的苦楚，你生产儿女必多受苦楚。你必恋慕你丈夫，你丈夫必管辖你。

chapters.en: To Adam he said, “Because you listened to your wife and ate fruit from the tree about which I commanded you, ‘You must not eat from it,’ “Cursed is the ground because of you; through painful toil you will eat food from it all the days of your life.
chapters.zh: 又对亚当说，你既听从妻子的话，吃了我所吩咐你不可吃的那树上的果子，地必为你的缘故受咒诅。你必终身劳苦，才能从地里得吃的。

chapters.en: It will produce thorns and thistles for you, and you will eat the plants of the field.
chapters.zh: 地必给你长出荆棘和蒺藜来，你也要吃田间的菜蔬。

chapters.en: By the sweat of your brow you will eat your food until you return to the ground, since from it you were taken; for dust you are and to dust you will return.”
chapters.zh: 你必汗流满面才得糊口，直到你归了土，因为你是从土而出的。你本是尘土，仍要归于尘土。

chapters.en: Adam named his wife Eve, because she would become the mother of all the living.
chapters.zh: 亚当给他妻子起名叫夏娃，因为她是众生之母。

chapters.en: The LORD God made garments of skin for Adam and his wife and clothed them.
chapters.zh: 耶和华神为亚当和他妻子用皮子作衣服给他们穿。

chapters.en: And the LORD God said, “The man has now become like one of us, knowing good and evil. He must not be allowed to reach out his hand and take also from the tree of life and eat, and live forever.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华神说，那人已经与我们相似，能知道善恶。现在恐怕他伸手又摘生命树的果子吃，就永远活着。

chapters.en: So the LORD God banished him from the Garden of Eden to work the ground from which he had been taken.
chapters.zh: 耶和华神便打发他出伊甸园去，耕种他所自出之土。

chapters.en: After he drove the man out, he placed on the east side of the Garden of Eden cherubim and a flaming sword flashing back and forth to guard the way to the tree of life.
chapters.zh: 于是把他赶出去了。又在伊甸园的东边安设基路伯和四面转动发火焰的剑，要把守生命树的道路。

chapters.en: Adam made love to his wife Eve, and she became pregnant and gave birth to Cain. She said, “With the help of the LORD I have brought forth a man.”
chapters.zh: 有一日，那人和他妻子夏娃同房。夏娃就怀孕，生了该隐（就是得的意思），便说，耶和华使我得了一个男子。

chapters.en: Later she gave birth to his brother Abel. Now Abel kept flocks, and Cain worked the soil.
chapters.zh: 又生了该隐的兄弟亚伯。亚伯是牧羊的，该隐是种地的。

chapters.en: In the course of time Cain brought some of the fruits of the soil as an offering to the LORD.
chapters.zh: 有一日，该隐拿地里的出产为供物献给耶和华。

chapters.en: And Abel also brought an offering—fat portions from some of the firstborn of his flock. The LORD looked with favor on Abel and his offering,
chapters.zh: 亚伯也将他羊群中头生的和羊的脂油献上。耶和华看中了亚伯和他的供物，

chapters.en: but on Cain and his offering he did not look with favor. So Cain was very angry, and his face was downcast.
chapters.zh: 只是看不中该隐和他的供物。该隐就大大地发怒，变了脸色。

chapters.en: Then the LORD said to Cain, “Why are you angry? Why is your face downcast?
chapters.zh: 耶和华对该隐说，你为什么发怒呢？你为什么变了脸色呢？

chapters.en: If you do what is right, will you not be accepted? But if you do not do what is right, sin is crouching at your door; it desires to have you, but you must rule over it.”
chapters.zh: 你若行得好，岂不蒙悦纳，你若行得不好，罪就伏在门前。它必恋慕你，你却要制伏它。

chapters.en: Now Cain said to his brother Abel, “Let’s go out to the field.” While they were in the field, Cain attacked his brother Abel and killed him.
chapters.zh: 该隐与他兄弟亚伯说话，二人正在田间。该隐起来打他兄弟亚伯，把他杀了。

chapters.en: Then the LORD said to Cain, “Where is your brother Abel?” “I don’t know,” he replied. “Am I my brother’s keeper?”
chapters.zh: 耶和华对该隐说，你兄弟亚伯在哪里？他说，我不知道，我岂是看守我兄弟的吗？

chapters.en: The LORD said, “What have you done? Listen! Your brother’s blood cries out to me from the ground.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说，你作了什么事呢？你兄弟的血，有声音从地里向我哀告。

chapters.en: Now you are under a curse and driven from the ground, which opened its mouth to receive your brother’s blood from your hand.
chapters.zh: 地开了口，从你手里接受你兄弟的血。现在你必从这地受咒诅。

chapters.en: When you work the ground, it will no longer yield its crops for you. You will be a restless wanderer on the earth.”
chapters.zh: 你种地，地不再给你效力。你必流离飘荡在地上。

chapters.en: Cain said to the LORD, “My punishment is more than I can bear.
chapters.zh: 该隐对耶和华说，我的刑罚太重，过于我所能当的。

chapters.en: Today you are driving me from the land, and I will be hidden from your presence; I will be a restless wanderer on the earth, and whoever finds me will kill me.”
chapters.zh: 你如今赶逐我离开这地，以致不见你面。我必流离飘荡在地上，凡遇见我的必杀我。

chapters.en: But the LORD said to him, “Not so ; anyone who kills Cain will suffer vengeance seven times over.” Then the LORD put a mark on Cain so that no one who found him would kill him.
chapters.zh: 耶和华对他说，凡杀该隐的，必遭报七倍。耶和华就给该隐立一个记号，免得人遇见他就杀他。

chapters.en: So Cain went out from the LORD’s presence and lived in the land of Nod, east of Eden.
chapters.zh: 于是该隐离开耶和华的面，去住在伊甸东边挪得之地。

chapters.en: Cain made love to his wife, and she became pregnant and gave birth to Enoch. Cain was then building a city, and he named it after his son Enoch.
chapters.zh: 该隐与妻子同房，他妻子就怀孕，生了以诺。该隐建造了一座城，就按着他儿子的名，将那城叫作以诺。

chapters.en: To Enoch was born Irad, and Irad was the father of Mehujael, and Mehujael was the father of Methushael, and Methushael was the father of Lamech.
chapters.zh: 以诺生以拿。以拿生米户雅利。米户雅利生玛土撒利。玛土撒利生拉麦。

chapters.en: Lamech married two women, one named Adah and the other Zillah.
chapters.zh: 拉麦娶了两个妻，一个名叫亚大，一个名叫洗拉。

chapters.en: Adah gave birth to Jabal; he was the father of those who live in tents and raise livestock.
chapters.zh: 亚大生雅八。雅八就是住帐棚，牧养牲畜之人的祖师。

chapters.en: His brother’s name was Jubal; he was the father of all who play stringed instruments and pipes.
chapters.zh: 雅八的兄弟名叫犹八。他是一切弹琴吹箫之人的祖师。

chapters.en: Zillah also had a son, Tubal-Cain, who forged all kinds of tools out of bronze and iron. Tubal-Cain’s sister was Naamah.
chapters.zh: 洗拉又生了土八该隐。他是打造各样铜铁利器的（或作是铜匠铁匠的祖师）。土八该隐的妹子是拿玛。

chapters.en: Lamech said to his wives, “Adah and Zillah, listen to me; wives of Lamech, hear my words. I have killed a man for wounding me, a young man for injuring me.
chapters.zh: 拉麦对他两个妻子说，亚大，洗拉，听我的声音。拉麦的妻子，细听我的话语，壮年人伤我，我把他杀了。少年人损我，我把他害了。（或作我杀壮士却伤自己，我害幼童却损本身）

chapters.en: If Cain is avenged seven times, then Lamech seventy-seven times.”
chapters.zh: 若杀该隐，遭报七倍。杀拉麦，必遭报七十七倍。

chapters.en: Adam made love to his wife again, and she gave birth to a son and named him Seth, saying, “God has granted me another child in place of Abel, since Cain killed him.”
chapters.zh: 亚当又与妻子同房，她就生了一个儿子，起名叫塞特，意思说，神另给我立了一个儿子代替亚伯，因为该隐杀了他。

chapters.en: Seth also had a son, and he named him Enosh. At that time people began to call on the name of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 塞特也生了一个儿子，起名叫以挪士。那时候，人才求告耶和华的名。

chapters.en: This is the written account of Adam’s family line. When God created mankind, he made them in the likeness of God.
chapters.zh: 亚当的后代记在下面。当神造人的日子，是照着自己的样式造的。

chapters.en: He created them male and female and blessed them. And he named them “Mankind” when they were created.
chapters.zh: 并且造男造女。在他们被造的日子，神赐福给他们，称他们为人。

chapters.en: When Adam had lived 130 years, he had a son in his own likeness, in his own image; and he named him Seth.
chapters.zh: 亚当活到一百三十岁，生了一个儿子，形像样式和自己相似，就给他起名叫塞特。

chapters.en: After Seth was born, Adam lived 800 years and had other sons and daughters.
chapters.zh: 亚当生塞特之后，又在世八百年，并且生儿养女。

chapters.en: Altogether, Adam lived a total of 930 years, and then he died.
chapters.zh: 亚当共活了九百三十岁就死了。

chapters.en: When Seth had lived 105 years, he became the father of Enosh.
chapters.zh: 塞特活到一百零五岁，生了以挪士。

chapters.en: After he became the father of Enosh, Seth lived 807 years and had other sons and daughters.
chapters.zh: 塞特生以挪士之后，又活了八百零七年，并且生儿养女。

chapters.en: Altogether, Seth lived a total of 912 years, and then he died.
chapters.zh: 塞特共活了九百一十二岁就死了。

chapters.en: When Enosh had lived 90 years, he became the father of Kenan.
chapters.zh: 以挪士活到九十岁，生了该南。

chapters.en: After he became the father of Kenan, Enosh lived 815 years and had other sons and daughters.
chapters.zh: 以挪士生该南之后，又活了八百一十五年，并且生儿养女。

chapters.en: Altogether, Enosh lived a total of 905 years, and then he died.
chapters.zh: 以挪士共活了九百零五岁就死了。

chapters.en: When Kenan had lived 70 years, he became the father of Mahalalel.
chapters.zh: 该南活到七十岁，生了玛勒列。

chapters.en: After he became the father of Mahalalel, Kenan lived 840 years and had other sons and daughters.
chapters.zh: 该南生玛勒列之后，又活了八百四十年，并且生儿养女。

chapters.en: Altogether, Kenan lived a total of 910 years, and then he died.
chapters.zh: 该南共活了九百一十岁就死了。

chapters.en: When Mahalalel had lived 65 years, he became the father of Jared.
chapters.zh: 玛勒列活到六十五岁，生了雅列。

chapters.en: After he became the father of Jared, Mahalalel lived 830 years and had other sons and daughters.
chapters.zh: 玛勒列生雅列之后，又活了八百三十年，并且生儿养女。

chapters.en: Altogether, Mahalalel lived a total of 895 years, and then he died.
chapters.zh: 玛勒列共活了八百九十五岁就死了。

chapters.en: When Jared had lived 162 years, he became the father of Enoch.
chapters.zh: 雅列活到一百六十二岁，生了以诺。

chapters.en: After he became the father of Enoch, Jared lived 800 years and had other sons and daughters.
chapters.zh: 雅列生以诺之后，又活了八百年，并且生儿养女。

chapters.en: Altogether, Jared lived a total of 962 years, and then he died.
chapters.zh: 雅列共活了九百六十二岁就死了。

chapters.en: When Enoch had lived 65 years, he became the father of Methuselah.
chapters.zh: 以诺活到六十五岁，生了玛土撒拉。

chapters.en: After he became the father of Methuselah, Enoch walked faithfully with God 300 years and had other sons and daughters.
chapters.zh: 以诺生玛土撒拉之后，与神同行三百年，并且生儿养女。

chapters.en: Altogether, Enoch lived a total of 365 years.
chapters.zh: 以诺共活了三百六十五岁。

chapters.en: Enoch walked faithfully with God; then he was no more, because God took him away.
chapters.zh: 以诺与神同行，神将他取去，他就不在世了。

chapters.en: When Methuselah had lived 187 years, he became the father of Lamech.
chapters.zh: 玛土撒拉活到一百八十七岁，生了拉麦。

chapters.en: After he became the father of Lamech, Methuselah lived 782 years and had other sons and daughters.
chapters.zh: 玛土撒拉生拉麦之后，又活了七百八十二年，并且生儿养女。

chapters.en: Altogether, Methuselah lived a total of 969 years, and then he died.
chapters.zh: 玛土撒拉共活了九百六十九岁就死了。

chapters.en: When Lamech had lived 182 years, he had a son.
chapters.zh: 拉麦活到一百八十二岁，生了一个儿子，

chapters.en: He named him Noah and said, “He will comfort us in the labor and painful toil of our hands caused by the ground the LORD has cursed.”
chapters.zh: 给他起名叫挪亚，说，这个儿子必为我们的操作和手中的劳苦安慰我们。这操作劳苦是因为耶和华咒诅地。

chapters.en: After Noah was born, Lamech lived 595 years and had other sons and daughters.
chapters.zh: 拉麦生挪亚之后，又活了五百九十五年，并且生儿养女。

chapters.en: Altogether, Lamech lived a total of 777 years, and then he died.
chapters.zh: 拉麦共活了七百七十七岁就死了。

chapters.en: After Noah was 500 years old, he became the father of Shem, Ham and Japheth.
chapters.zh: 挪亚五百岁生了闪，含，雅弗。

chapters.en: When human beings began to increase in number on the earth and daughters were born to them,
chapters.zh: 当人在世上多起来，又生女儿的时候，

chapters.en: the sons of God saw that the daughters of humans were beautiful, and they married any of them they chose.
chapters.zh: 神的儿子们看见人的女子美貌，就随意挑选，娶来为妻。

chapters.en: Then the LORD said, “My Spirit will not contend with humans forever, for they are mortal ; their days will be a hundred and twenty years.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华说，人既属乎血气，我的灵就不永远住在他里面。然而他的日子还可到一百二十年。

chapters.en: The Nephilim were on the earth in those days—and also afterward—when the sons of God went to the daughters of humans and had children by them. They were the heroes of old, men of renown.
chapters.zh: 那时候有伟人在地上，后来神的儿子们和人的女子们交合生子，那就是上古英武有名的人。

chapters.en: The LORD saw how great the wickedness of the human race had become on the earth, and that every inclination of the thoughts of the human heart was only evil all the time.
chapters.zh: 耶和华见人在地上罪恶很大，终日所思想的尽都是恶。

chapters.en: The LORD regretted that he had made human beings on the earth, and his heart was deeply troubled.
chapters.zh: 耶和华就后悔造人在地上，心中忧伤。

chapters.en: So the LORD said, “I will wipe from the face of the earth the human race I have created—and with them the animals, the birds and the creatures that move along the ground—for I regret that I have made them.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华说，我要将所造的人和走兽，并昆虫，以及空中的飞鸟，都从地上除灭，因为我造他们后悔了。

chapters.en: But Noah found favor in the eyes of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 惟有挪亚在耶和华眼前蒙恩。

chapters.en: This is the account of Noah and his family. Noah was a righteous man, blameless among the people of his time, and he walked faithfully with God.
chapters.zh: 挪亚的后代记在下面。挪亚是个义人，在当时的世代是个完全人。挪亚与神同行。

chapters.en: Noah had three sons: Shem, Ham and Japheth.
chapters.zh: 挪亚生了三个儿子，就是闪，含，雅弗。

chapters.en: Now the earth was corrupt in God’s sight and was full of violence.
chapters.zh: 世界在神面前败坏，地上满了强暴。

chapters.en: God saw how corrupt the earth had become, for all the people on earth had corrupted their ways.
chapters.zh: 神观看世界，见是败坏了。凡有血气的人，在地上都败坏了行为。

chapters.en: So God said to Noah, “I am going to put an end to all people, for the earth is filled with violence because of them. I am surely going to destroy both them and the earth.
chapters.zh: 神就对挪亚说，凡有血气的人，他的尽头已经来到我面前。因为地上满了他们的强暴，我要把他们和地一并毁灭。

chapters.en: So make yourself an ark of cypress wood; make rooms in it and coat it with pitch inside and out.
chapters.zh: 你要用歌斐木造一只方舟，分一间一间地造，里外抹上松香。

chapters.en: This is how you are to build it: The ark is to be three hundred cubits long, fifty cubits wide and thirty cubits high.
chapters.zh: 方舟的造法乃是这样，要长三百肘，宽五十肘，高三十肘。

chapters.en: Make a roof for it, leaving below the roof an opening one cubit high all around. Put a door in the side of the ark and make lower, middle and upper decks.
chapters.zh: 方舟上边要留透光处，高一肘。方舟的门要开在旁边。方舟要分上，中，下三层。

chapters.en: I am going to bring floodwaters on the earth to destroy all life under the heavens, every creature that has the breath of life in it. Everything on earth will perish.
chapters.zh: 看哪！我要使洪水泛滥在地上，毁灭天下。凡地上有血肉，有气息的活物，无一不死。

chapters.en: But I will establish my covenant with you, and you will enter the ark—you and your sons and your wife and your sons’ wives with you.
chapters.zh: 我却要与你立约，你同你的妻，与儿子，儿妇，都要进入方舟。

chapters.en: You are to bring into the ark two of all living creatures, male and female, to keep them alive with you.
chapters.zh: 凡有血肉的活物，每样两个，一公一母，你要带进方舟，好在你那里保全生命。

chapters.en: Two of every kind of bird, of every kind of animal and of every kind of creature that moves along the ground will come to you to be kept alive.
chapters.zh: 飞鸟各从其类，牲畜各从其类，地上的昆虫各从其类。每样两个，要到你那里，好保全生命。

chapters.en: You are to take every kind of food that is to be eaten and store it away as food for you and for them.”
chapters.zh: 你要拿各样食物积蓄起来，好作你和它们的食物。

chapters.en: Noah did everything just as God commanded him.
chapters.zh: 挪亚就这样行。凡神所吩咐的，他都照样行了。

chapters.en: The LORD then said to Noah, “Go into the ark, you and your whole family, because I have found you righteous in this generation.
chapters.zh: 耶和华对挪亚说，你和你的全家都要进入方舟，因为在这世代中，我见你在我面前是义人。

chapters.en: Take with you seven pairs of every kind of clean animal, a male and its mate, and one pair of every kind of unclean animal, a male and its mate,
chapters.zh: 凡洁净的畜类，你要带七公七母。不洁净的畜类，你要带一公一母。

chapters.en: and also seven pairs of every kind of bird, male and female, to keep their various kinds alive throughout the earth.
chapters.zh: 空中的飞鸟，也要带七公七母，可以留种，活在全地上。

chapters.en: Seven days from now I will send rain on the earth for forty days and forty nights, and I will wipe from the face of the earth every living creature I have made.”
chapters.zh: 因为再过七天，我要降雨在地上四十昼夜，把我所造的各种活物，都从地上除灭。

chapters.en: And Noah did all that the LORD commanded him.
chapters.zh: 挪亚就遵着耶和华所吩咐的行了。

chapters.en: Noah was six hundred years old when the floodwaters came on the earth.
chapters.zh: 当洪水泛滥在地上的时候，挪亚整六百岁。

chapters.en: And Noah and his sons and his wife and his sons’ wives entered the ark to escape the waters of the flood.
chapters.zh: 挪亚就同他的妻和儿子，儿妇，都进入方舟，躲避洪水。

chapters.en: Pairs of clean and unclean animals, of birds and of all creatures that move along the ground,
chapters.zh: 洁净的畜类和不洁净的畜类，飞鸟并地上一切的昆虫，

chapters.en: male and female, came to Noah and entered the ark, as God had commanded Noah.
chapters.zh: 都是一对一对地，有公有母，到挪亚那里进入方舟，正如神所吩咐挪亚的。

chapters.en: And after the seven days the floodwaters came on the earth.
chapters.zh: 过了那七天，洪水泛滥在地上。

chapters.en: In the six hundredth year of Noah’s life, on the seventeenth day of the second month—on that day all the springs of the great deep burst forth, and the floodgates of the heavens were opened.
chapters.zh: 当挪亚六百岁，二月十七日那一天，大渊的泉源都裂开了，天上的窗户也敞开了。

chapters.en: And rain fell on the earth forty days and forty nights.
chapters.zh: 四十昼夜降大雨在地上。

chapters.en: On that very day Noah and his sons, Shem, Ham and Japheth, together with his wife and the wives of his three sons, entered the ark.
chapters.zh: 正当那日，挪亚和他三个儿子闪，含，雅弗，并挪亚的妻子和三个儿妇，都进入方舟。

chapters.en: They had with them every wild animal according to its kind, all livestock according to their kinds, every creature that moves along the ground according to its kind and every bird according to its kind, everything with wings.
chapters.zh: 他们和百兽，各从其类。一切牲畜，各从其类。爬在地上的昆虫，各从其类。一切禽鸟，各从其类。都进入方舟。

chapters.en: Pairs of all creatures that have the breath of life in them came to Noah and entered the ark.
chapters.zh: 凡有血肉，有气息的活物，都一对一对地到挪亚那里，进入方舟。

chapters.en: The animals going in were male and female of every living thing, as God had commanded Noah. Then the LORD shut him in.
chapters.zh: 凡有血肉进入方舟的，都是有公有母，正如神所吩咐挪亚的。耶和华就把他关在方舟里头。

chapters.en: For forty days the flood kept coming on the earth, and as the waters increased they lifted the ark high above the earth.
chapters.zh: 洪水泛滥在地上四十天，水往上长，把方舟从地上漂起。

chapters.en: The waters rose and increased greatly on the earth, and the ark floated on the surface of the water.
chapters.zh: 水势浩大，在地上大大地往上长，方舟在水面上漂来漂去。

chapters.en: They rose greatly on the earth, and all the high mountains under the entire heavens were covered.
chapters.zh: 水势在地上极其浩大，天下的高山都淹没了。

chapters.en: The waters rose and covered the mountains to a depth of more than fifteen cubits.
chapters.zh: 水势比山高过十五肘，山岭都淹没了。

chapters.en: Every living thing that moved on land perished—birds, livestock, wild animals, all the creatures that swarm over the earth, and all mankind.
chapters.zh: 凡在地上有血肉的动物，就是飞鸟，牲畜，走兽，和爬在地上的昆虫，以及所有的人都死了。

chapters.en: Everything on dry land that had the breath of life in its nostrils died.
chapters.zh: 凡在旱地上，鼻孔有气息的生灵都死了。

chapters.en: Every living thing on the face of the earth was wiped out; people and animals and the creatures that move along the ground and the birds were wiped from the earth. Only Noah was left, and those with him in the ark.
chapters.zh: 凡地上各类的活物，连人带牲畜，昆虫，以及空中的飞鸟，都从地上除灭了，只留下挪亚和那些与他同在方舟里的。

chapters.en: The waters flooded the earth for a hundred and fifty days.
chapters.zh: 水势浩大，在地上共一百五十天。

chapters.en: But God remembered Noah and all the wild animals and the livestock that were with him in the ark, and he sent a wind over the earth, and the waters receded.
chapters.zh: 神记念挪亚和挪亚方舟里的一切走兽牲畜。神叫风吹地，水势渐落。

chapters.en: Now the springs of the deep and the floodgates of the heavens had been closed, and the rain had stopped falling from the sky.
chapters.zh: 渊源和天上的窗户都闭塞了，天上的大雨也止住了。

chapters.en: The water receded steadily from the earth. At the end of the hundred and fifty days the water had gone down,
chapters.zh: 水从地上渐退。过了一百五十天，水就渐消。

chapters.en: and on the seventeenth day of the seventh month the ark came to rest on the mountains of Ararat.
chapters.zh: 七月十七日，方舟停在亚拉腊山上。

chapters.en: The waters continued to recede until the tenth month, and on the first day of the tenth month the tops of the mountains became visible.
chapters.zh: 水又渐消，到十月初一日，山顶都现出来了。

chapters.en: After forty days Noah opened a window he had made in the ark
chapters.zh: 过了四十天，挪亚开了方舟的窗户，

chapters.en: and sent out a raven, and it kept flying back and forth until the water had dried up from the earth.
chapters.zh: 放出一只乌鸦去。那乌鸦飞来飞去，直到地上的水都干了。

chapters.en: Then he sent out a dove to see if the water had receded from the surface of the ground.
chapters.zh: 他又放出一只鸽子去，要看看水从地上退了没有。

chapters.en: But the dove could find nowhere to perch because there was water over all the surface of the earth; so it returned to Noah in the ark. He reached out his hand and took the dove and brought it back to himself in the ark.
chapters.zh: 但遍地上都是水，鸽子找不着落脚之地，就回到方舟挪亚那里，挪亚伸手把鸽子接进方舟来。

chapters.en: He waited seven more days and again sent out the dove from the ark.
chapters.zh: 他又等了七天，再把鸽子从方舟放出去。

chapters.en: When the dove returned to him in the evening, there in its beak was a freshly plucked olive leaf! Then Noah knew that the water had receded from the earth.
chapters.zh: 到了晚上，鸽子回到他那里，嘴里叼着一个新拧下来的橄榄叶子，挪亚就知道地上的水退了。

chapters.en: He waited seven more days and sent the dove out again, but this time it did not return to him.
chapters.zh: 他又等了七天，放出鸽子去，鸽子就不再回来了。

chapters.en: By the first day of the first month of Noah’s six hundred and first year, the water had dried up from the earth. Noah then removed the covering from the ark and saw that the surface of the ground was dry.
chapters.zh: 到挪亚六百零一岁，正月初一日，地上的水都干了。挪亚撤去方舟的盖观看，便见地面上干了。

chapters.en: By the twenty-seventh day of the second month the earth was completely dry.
chapters.zh: 到了二月二十七日，地就都干了。

chapters.en: Then God said to Noah,
chapters.zh: 神对挪亚说，

chapters.en: “Come out of the ark, you and your wife and your sons and their wives.
chapters.zh: 你和你的妻子，儿子，儿妇都可以出方舟。

chapters.en: Bring out every kind of living creature that is with you—the birds, the animals, and all the creatures that move along the ground—so they can multiply on the earth and be fruitful and increase in number on it.”
chapters.zh: 在你那里凡有血肉的活物，就是飞鸟，牲畜，和一切爬在地上的昆虫，都要带出来，叫它在地上多多滋生，大大兴旺。

chapters.en: So Noah came out, together with his sons and his wife and his sons’ wives.
chapters.zh: 于是挪亚和他的妻子，儿子，儿妇，都出来了。

chapters.en: All the animals and all the creatures that move along the ground and all the birds—everything that moves on land—came out of the ark, one kind after another.
chapters.zh: 一切走兽，昆虫，飞鸟，和地上所有的动物，各从其类，也都出了方舟。

chapters.en: Then Noah built an altar to the LORD and, taking some of all the clean animals and clean birds, he sacrificed burnt offerings on it.
chapters.zh: 挪亚为耶和华筑了一座坛，拿各类洁净的牲畜，飞鸟献在坛上为燔祭。

chapters.en: The LORD smelled the pleasing aroma and said in his heart: “Never again will I curse the ground because of humans, even though every inclination of the human heart is evil from childhood. And never again will I destroy all living creatures, as I have done.
chapters.zh: 耶和华闻那馨香之气，就心里说，我不再因人的缘故咒诅地（人从小时心里怀着恶念），也不再按着我才行的，灭各种的活物了。

chapters.en: “As long as the earth endures, seedtime and harvest, cold and heat, summer and winter, day and night will never cease.”
chapters.zh: 地还存留的时候，稼穑，寒暑，冬夏，昼夜就永不停息了。

chapters.en: Then God blessed Noah and his sons, saying to them, “Be fruitful and increase in number and fill the earth.
chapters.zh: 神赐福给挪亚和他的儿子，对他们说，你们要生养众多，遍满了地。

chapters.en: The fear and dread of you will fall on all the beasts of the earth, and on all the birds in the sky, on every creature that moves along the ground, and on all the fish in the sea; they are given into your hands.
chapters.zh: 凡地上的走兽和空中的飞鸟，都必惊恐，惧怕你们。连地上一切的昆虫并海里一切的鱼，都交付你们的手。

chapters.en: Everything that lives and moves about will be food for you. Just as I gave you the green plants, I now give you everything.
chapters.zh: 凡活着的动物，都可以作你们的食物。这一切我都赐给你们，如同菜蔬一样。

chapters.en: “But you must not eat meat that has its lifeblood still in it.
chapters.zh: 惟独肉带着血，那就是它的生命，你们不可吃。

chapters.en: And for your lifeblood I will surely demand an accounting. I will demand an accounting from every animal. And from each human being, too, I will demand an accounting for the life of another human being.
chapters.zh: 流你们血，害你们命的，无论是兽，是人，我必讨他的罪，就是向各人的弟兄也是如此。

chapters.en: “Whoever sheds human blood, by humans shall their blood be shed; for in the image of God has God made mankind.
chapters.zh: 凡流人血的，他的血也必被人所流。因为神造人是照自己的形像造的。

chapters.en: As for you, be fruitful and increase in number; multiply on the earth and increase upon it.”
chapters.zh: 你们要生养众多，在地上昌盛繁茂。

chapters.en: Then God said to Noah and to his sons with him:
chapters.zh: 神晓谕挪亚和他的儿子说，

chapters.en: “I now establish my covenant with you and with your descendants after you
chapters.zh: 我与你们和你们的后裔立约，

chapters.en: and with every living creature that was with you—the birds, the livestock and all the wild animals, all those that came out of the ark with you—every living creature on earth.
chapters.zh: 并与你们这里的一切活物，就是飞鸟，牲畜，走兽，凡从方舟里出来的活物立约。

chapters.en: I establish my covenant with you: Never again will all life be destroyed by the waters of a flood; never again will there be a flood to destroy the earth.”
chapters.zh: 我与你们立约，凡有血肉的，不再被洪水灭绝，也不再有洪水毁坏地了。

chapters.en: And God said, “This is the sign of the covenant I am making between me and you and every living creature with you, a covenant for all generations to come:
chapters.zh: 神说，我与你们并你们这里的各样活物所立的永约，是有记号的。

chapters.en: I have set my rainbow in the clouds, and it will be the sign of the covenant between me and the earth.
chapters.zh: 我把虹放在云彩中，这就可作我与地立约的记号了。

chapters.en: Whenever I bring clouds over the earth and the rainbow appears in the clouds,
chapters.zh: 我使云彩盖地的时候，必有虹现在云彩中，

chapters.en: I will remember my covenant between me and you and all living creatures of every kind. Never again will the waters become a flood to destroy all life.
chapters.zh: 我便记念我与你们和各样有血肉的活物所立的约，水就再不泛滥，毁坏一切有血肉的物了。

chapters.en: Whenever the rainbow appears in the clouds, I will see it and remember the everlasting covenant between God and all living creatures of every kind on the earth.”
chapters.zh: 虹必现在云彩中，我看见，就要记念我与地上各样有血肉的活物所立的永约。

chapters.en: So God said to Noah, “This is the sign of the covenant I have established between me and all life on the earth.”
chapters.zh: 神对挪亚说，这就是我与地上一切有血肉之物立约的记号了。

chapters.en: The sons of Noah who came out of the ark were Shem, Ham and Japheth. (Ham was the father of Canaan.)
chapters.zh: 出方舟挪亚的儿子就是闪，含，雅弗。含是迦南的父亲。

chapters.en: These were the three sons of Noah, and from them came the people who were scattered over the whole earth.
chapters.zh: 这是挪亚的三个儿子，他们的后裔分散在全地。

chapters.en: Noah, a man of the soil, proceeded to plant a vineyard.
chapters.zh: 挪亚作起农夫来，栽了一个葡萄园。

chapters.en: When he drank some of its wine, he became drunk and lay uncovered inside his tent.
chapters.zh: 他喝了园中的酒便醉了，在帐棚里赤着身子。

chapters.en: Ham, the father of Canaan, saw his father naked and told his two brothers outside.
chapters.zh: 迦南的父亲含，看见他父亲赤身，就到外边告诉他两个弟兄。

chapters.en: But Shem and Japheth took a garment and laid it across their shoulders; then they walked in backward and covered their father’s naked body. Their faces were turned the other way so that they would not see their father naked.
chapters.zh: 于是闪和雅弗，拿件衣服搭在肩上，倒退着进去，给他父亲盖上。他们背着脸就看不见父亲的赤身。

chapters.en: When Noah awoke from his wine and found out what his youngest son had done to him,
chapters.zh: 挪亚醒了酒，知道小儿子向他所作的事，

chapters.en: he said, “Cursed be Canaan! The lowest of slaves will he be to his brothers.”
chapters.zh: 就说，迦南当受咒诅，必给他弟兄作奴仆的奴仆。

chapters.en: He also said, “Praise be to the LORD, the God of Shem! May Canaan be the slave of Shem.
chapters.zh: 又说，耶和华闪的神，是应当称颂的，愿迦南作闪的奴仆。

chapters.en: May God extend Japheth’s territory; may Japheth live in the tents of Shem, and may Canaan be the slave of Japheth.”
chapters.zh: 愿神使雅弗扩张，使他住在闪的帐棚里，又愿迦南作他的奴仆。

chapters.en: After the flood Noah lived 350 years.
chapters.zh: 洪水以后，挪亚又活了三百五十年。

chapters.en: Noah lived a total of 950 years, and then he died.
chapters.zh: 挪亚共活了九百五十岁就死了。

chapters.en: This is the account of Shem, Ham and Japheth, Noah’s sons, who themselves had sons after the flood.
chapters.zh: 挪亚的儿子闪，含，雅弗的后代，记在下面。洪水以后，他们都生了儿子。

chapters.en: The sons of Japheth: Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshek and Tiras.
chapters.zh: 雅弗的儿子是歌篾，玛各，玛代，雅完，土巴，米设，提拉。

chapters.en: The sons of Gomer: Ashkenaz, Riphath and Togarmah.
chapters.zh: 歌篾的儿子是亚实基拿，利法，陀迦玛。

chapters.en: The sons of Javan: Elishah, Tarshish, the Kittites and the Rodanites.
chapters.zh: 雅完的儿子是以利沙，他施，基提，多单。

chapters.en: (From these the maritime peoples spread out into their territories by their clans within their nations, each with its own language.)
chapters.zh: 这些人的后裔，将各国的地土，海岛，分开居住，各随各的方言，宗族立国。

chapters.en: The sons of Ham: Cush, Egypt, Put and Canaan.
chapters.zh: 含的儿子是古实，麦西，弗，迦南。

chapters.en: The sons of Cush: Seba, Havilah, Sabtah, Raamah and Sabteka. The sons of Raamah: Sheba and Dedan.
chapters.zh: 古实的儿子是西巴，哈腓拉，撒弗他，拉玛，撒弗提迦。拉玛的儿子是示巴，底但。

chapters.en: Cush was the father of Nimrod, who became a mighty warrior on the earth.
chapters.zh: 古实又生宁录，他为世上英雄之首。

chapters.en: He was a mighty hunter before the LORD; that is why it is said, “Like Nimrod, a mighty hunter before the LORD.”
chapters.zh: 他在耶和华面前是个英勇的猎户，所以俗语说，像宁录在耶和华面前是个英勇的猎户。

chapters.en: The first centers of his kingdom were Babylon, Uruk, Akkad and Kalneh, in Shinar.
chapters.zh: 他国的起头是巴别，以力，亚甲，甲尼，都在示拿地。

chapters.en: From that land he went to Assyria, where he built Nineveh, Rehoboth Ir, Calah
chapters.zh: 他从那地出来往亚述去，建造尼尼微，利河伯，迦拉，

chapters.en: and Resen, which is between Nineveh and Calah—which is the great city.
chapters.zh: 和尼尼微，迦拉中间的利鲜，这就是那大城。

chapters.en: Egypt was the father of the Ludites, Anamites, Lehabites, Naphtuhites,
chapters.zh: 麦西生路低人，亚拿米人，利哈比人，拿弗土希人，

chapters.en: Pathrusites, Kasluhites (from whom the Philistines came) and Caphtorites.
chapters.zh: 帕斯鲁细人，迦斯路希人，迦斐托人。从迦斐托出来的有非利士人。

chapters.en: Canaan was the father of Sidon his firstborn, and of the Hittites,
chapters.zh: 迦南生长子西顿，又生赫

chapters.en: Jebusites, Amorites, Girgashites,
chapters.zh: 和耶布斯人，亚摩利人，革迦撒人，

chapters.en: Hivites, Arkites, Sinites,
chapters.zh: 希未人，亚基人，西尼人，

chapters.en: Arvadites, Zemarites and Hamathites. Later the Canaanite clans scattered
chapters.zh: 亚瓦底人，洗玛利人，哈马人，后来迦南的诸族分散了。

chapters.en: and the borders of Canaan reached from Sidon toward Gerar as far as Gaza, and then toward Sodom, Gomorrah, Admah and Zeboyim, as far as Lasha.
chapters.zh: 迦南的境界是从西顿向基拉耳的路上，直到迦萨，又向所多玛，蛾摩拉，押玛，洗扁的路上，直到拉沙。

chapters.en: These are the sons of Ham by their clans and languages, in their territories and nations.
chapters.zh: 这就是含的后裔，各随他们的宗族，方言，所住的地土，邦国。

chapters.en: Sons were also born to Shem, whose older brother was Japheth; Shem was the ancestor of all the sons of Eber.
chapters.zh: 雅弗的哥哥闪，是希伯子孙之祖，他也生了儿子。

chapters.en: The sons of Shem: Elam, Ashur, Arphaxad, Lud and Aram.
chapters.zh: 闪的儿子是以拦，亚述，亚法撒，路德，亚兰。

chapters.en: The sons of Aram: Uz, Hul, Gether and Meshek.
chapters.zh: 亚兰的儿子是乌斯，户勒，基帖，玛施。

chapters.en: Arphaxad was the father of Shelah, and Shelah the father of Eber.
chapters.zh: 亚法撒生沙拉。沙拉生希伯。

chapters.en: Two sons were born to Eber: One was named Peleg, because in his time the earth was divided; his brother was named Joktan.
chapters.zh: 希伯生了两个儿子，一个名叫法勒（法勒就是分的意思），因为那时人就分地居住。法勒的兄弟名叫约坍。

chapters.en: Joktan was the father of Almodad, Sheleph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah,
chapters.zh: 约坍生亚摩答，沙列，哈萨玛非，耶拉，

chapters.en: Hadoram, Uzal, Diklah,
chapters.zh: 哈多兰，乌萨，德拉，

chapters.en: Obal, Abimael, Sheba,
chapters.zh: 俄巴路，亚比玛利，示巴，

chapters.en: Ophir, Havilah and Jobab. All these were sons of Joktan.
chapters.zh: 阿斐，哈腓拉，约巴，这都是约坍的儿子。

chapters.en: The region where they lived stretched from Mesha toward Sephar, in the eastern hill country.
chapters.zh: 他们所住的地方，是从米沙直到西发东边的山。

chapters.en: These are the sons of Shem by their clans and languages, in their territories and nations.
chapters.zh: 这就是闪的子孙，各随他们的宗族，方言，所住的地土，邦国。

chapters.en: These are the clans of Noah’s sons, according to their lines of descent, within their nations. From these the nations spread out over the earth after the flood.
chapters.zh: 这些都是挪亚三个儿子的宗族，各随他们的支派立国。洪水以后，他们在地上分为邦国。

chapters.en: Now the whole world had one language and a common speech.
chapters.zh: 那时，天下人的口音，言语，都是一样。

chapters.en: As people moved eastward, they found a plain in Shinar and settled there.
chapters.zh: 他们往东边迁移的时候，在示拿地遇见一片平原，就住在那里。

chapters.en: They said to each other, “Come, let’s make bricks and bake them thoroughly.” They used brick instead of stone, and tar for mortar.
chapters.zh: 他们彼此商量说，来吧，我们要作砖，把砖烧透了。他们就拿砖当石头，又拿石漆当灰泥。

chapters.en: Then they said, “Come, let us build ourselves a city, with a tower that reaches to the heavens, so that we may make a name for ourselves; otherwise we will be scattered over the face of the whole earth.”
chapters.zh: 他们说，来吧，我们要建造一座城和一座塔，塔顶通天，为要传扬我们的名，免得我们分散在全地上。

chapters.en: But the LORD came down to see the city and the tower the people were building.
chapters.zh: 耶和华降临，要看看世人所建造的城和塔。

chapters.en: The LORD said, “If as one people speaking the same language they have begun to do this, then nothing they plan to do will be impossible for them.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说，看哪，他们成为一样的人民，都是一样的言语，如今既作起这事来，以后他们所要作的事就没有不成就的了。

chapters.en: Come, let us go down and confuse their language so they will not understand each other.”
chapters.zh: 我们下去，在那里变乱他们的口音，使他们的言语彼此不通。

chapters.en: So the LORD scattered them from there over all the earth, and they stopped building the city.
chapters.zh: 于是，耶和华使他们从那里分散在全地上。他们就停工，不造那城了。

chapters.en: That is why it was called Babel —because there the LORD confused the language of the whole world. From there the LORD scattered them over the face of the whole earth.
chapters.zh: 因为耶和华在那里变乱天下人的言语，使众人分散在全地上，所以那城名叫巴别（就是变乱的意思）。

chapters.en: This is the account of Shem’s family line. Two years after the flood, when Shem was 100 years old, he became the father of Arphaxad.
chapters.zh: 闪的后代记在下面。洪水以后二年，闪一百岁生了亚法撒。

chapters.en: And after he became the father of Arphaxad, Shem lived 500 years and had other sons and daughters.
chapters.zh: 闪生亚法撒之后，又活了五百年，并且生儿养女。

chapters.en: When Arphaxad had lived 35 years, he became the father of Shelah.
chapters.zh: 亚法撒活到三十五岁，生了沙拉。

chapters.en: And after he became the father of Shelah, Arphaxad lived 403 years and had other sons and daughters.
chapters.zh: 亚法撒生沙拉之后，又活了四百零三年，并且生儿养女。

chapters.en: When Shelah had lived 30 years, he became the father of Eber.
chapters.zh: 沙拉活到三十岁，生了希伯。

chapters.en: And after he became the father of Eber, Shelah lived 403 years and had other sons and daughters.
chapters.zh: 沙拉生希伯之后又活了四百零三年，并且生儿养女。

chapters.en: When Eber had lived 34 years, he became the father of Peleg.
chapters.zh: 希伯活到三十四岁，生了法勒。

chapters.en: And after he became the father of Peleg, Eber lived 430 years and had other sons and daughters.
chapters.zh: 希伯生法勒之后，又活了四百三十年，并且生儿养女。

chapters.en: When Peleg had lived 30 years, he became the father of Reu.
chapters.zh: 法勒活到三十岁，生了拉吴。

chapters.en: And after he became the father of Reu, Peleg lived 209 years and had other sons and daughters.
chapters.zh: 法勒生拉吴之后，又活了二百零九年，并且生儿养女。

chapters.en: When Reu had lived 32 years, he became the father of Serug.
chapters.zh: 拉吴活到三十二岁，生了西鹿。

chapters.en: And after he became the father of Serug, Reu lived 207 years and had other sons and daughters.
chapters.zh: 拉吴生西鹿之后，又活了二百零七年，并且生儿养女。

chapters.en: When Serug had lived 30 years, he became the father of Nahor.
chapters.zh: 西鹿活到三十岁，生了拿鹤。

chapters.en: And after he became the father of Nahor, Serug lived 200 years and had other sons and daughters.
chapters.zh: 西鹿生拿鹤之后，又活了二百年，并且生儿养女。

chapters.en: When Nahor had lived 29 years, he became the father of Terah.
chapters.zh: 拿鹤活到二十九岁，生了他拉。

chapters.en: And after he became the father of Terah, Nahor lived 119 years and had other sons and daughters.
chapters.zh: 拿鹤生他拉之后，又活了一百一十九年，并且生儿养女。

chapters.en: After Terah had lived 70 years, he became the father of Abram, Nahor and Haran.
chapters.zh: 他拉活到七十岁，生了亚伯兰，拿鹤，哈兰。

chapters.en: This is the account of Terah’s family line. Terah became the father of Abram, Nahor and Haran. And Haran became the father of Lot.
chapters.zh: 他拉的后代，记在下面，他拉生亚伯兰，拿鹤，哈兰。哈兰生罗得。

chapters.en: While his father Terah was still alive, Haran died in Ur of the Chaldeans, in the land of his birth.
chapters.zh: 哈兰死在他的本地迦勒底的吾珥，在他父亲他拉之先。

chapters.en: Abram and Nahor both married. The name of Abram’s wife was Sarai, and the name of Nahor’s wife was Milkah; she was the daughter of Haran, the father of both Milkah and Iskah.
chapters.zh: 亚伯兰，拿鹤各娶了妻。亚伯兰的妻子名叫撒莱。拿鹤的妻子名叫密迦，是哈兰的女儿。哈兰是密迦和亦迦的父亲。

chapters.en: Now Sarai was childless because she was not able to conceive.
chapters.zh: 撒莱不生育，没有孩子。

chapters.en: Terah took his son Abram, his grandson Lot son of Haran, and his daughter-in-law Sarai, the wife of his son Abram, and together they set out from Ur of the Chaldeans to go to Canaan. But when they came to Harran, they settled there.
chapters.zh: 他拉带着他儿子，亚伯兰和他孙子，哈兰的儿子罗得，并他儿妇亚伯兰的妻子撒莱，出了迦勒底的吾珥，要往迦南地去。他们走到哈兰，就住在那里。

chapters.en: Terah lived 205 years, and he died in Harran.
chapters.zh: 他拉共活了二百零五岁，就死在哈兰。

chapters.en: The LORD had said to Abram, “Go from your country, your people and your father’s household to the land I will show you.
chapters.zh: 耶和华对亚伯兰说，你要离开本地，本族，父家，往我所要指示你的地去。

chapters.en: “I will make you into a great nation, and I will bless you; I will make your name great, and you will be a blessing.
chapters.zh: 我必叫你成为大国，我必赐福给你，叫你的名为大，你也要叫别人得福。

chapters.en: I will bless those who bless you, and whoever curses you I will curse; and all peoples on earth will be blessed through you.”
chapters.zh: 为你祝福的，我必赐福与他。那咒诅你的，我必咒诅他，地上的万族都要因你得福。

chapters.en: So Abram went, as the LORD had told him; and Lot went with him. Abram was seventy-five years old when he set out from Harran.
chapters.zh: 亚伯兰就照着耶和华的吩咐去了。罗得也和他同去。亚伯兰出哈兰的时候，年七十五岁。

chapters.en: He took his wife Sarai, his nephew Lot, all the possessions they had accumulated and the people they had acquired in Harran, and they set out for the land of Canaan, and they arrived there.
chapters.zh: 亚伯兰将他妻子撒莱和侄儿罗得，连他们在哈兰所积蓄的财物，所得的人口，都带往迦南地去。他们就到了迦南地。

chapters.en: Abram traveled through the land as far as the site of the great tree of Moreh at Shechem. At that time the Canaanites were in the land.
chapters.zh: 亚伯兰经过那地，到了示剑地方，摩利橡树那里。那时迦南人住在那地。

chapters.en: The LORD appeared to Abram and said, “To your offspring I will give this land.” So he built an altar there to the LORD, who had appeared to him.
chapters.zh: 耶和华向亚伯兰显现，说，我要把这地赐给你的后裔。亚伯兰就在那里为向他显现的耶和华筑了一座坛。

chapters.en: From there he went on toward the hills east of Bethel and pitched his tent, with Bethel on the west and Ai on the east. There he built an altar to the LORD and called on the name of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 从那里他又迁到伯特利东边的山，支搭帐棚。西边是伯特利，东边是艾。他在那里又为耶和华筑了一座坛，求告耶和华的名。

chapters.en: Then Abram set out and continued toward the Negev.
chapters.zh: 后来亚伯兰又渐渐迁往南地去。

chapters.en: Now there was a famine in the land, and Abram went down to Egypt to live there for a while because the famine was severe.
chapters.zh: 那地遭遇饥荒。因饥荒甚大，亚伯兰就下埃及去，要在那里暂居。

chapters.en: As he was about to enter Egypt, he said to his wife Sarai, “I know what a beautiful woman you are.
chapters.zh: 将近埃及，就对他妻子撒莱说，我知道你是容貌俊美的妇人。

chapters.en: When the Egyptians see you, they will say, ‘This is his wife.’ Then they will kill me but will let you live.
chapters.zh: 埃及人看见你必说，这是他的妻子，他们就要杀我，却叫你存活。

chapters.en: Say you are my sister, so that I will be treated well for your sake and my life will be spared because of you.”
chapters.zh: 求你说，你是我的妹子，使我因你得平安，我的命也因你存活。

chapters.en: When Abram came to Egypt, the Egyptians saw that Sarai was a very beautiful woman.
chapters.zh: 及至亚伯兰到了埃及，埃及人看见那妇人极其美貌。

chapters.en: And when Pharaoh’s officials saw her, they praised her to Pharaoh, and she was taken into his palace.
chapters.zh: 法老的臣宰看见了她，就在法老面前夸奖她。那妇人就被带进法老的宫去。

chapters.en: He treated Abram well for her sake, and Abram acquired sheep and cattle, male and female donkeys, male and female servants, and camels.
chapters.zh: 法老因这妇人就厚待亚伯兰，亚伯兰得了许多牛，羊，骆驼，公驴，母驴，仆婢。

chapters.en: But the LORD inflicted serious diseases on Pharaoh and his household because of Abram’s wife Sarai.
chapters.zh: 耶和华因亚伯兰妻子撒莱的缘故，降大灾与法老和他的全家。

chapters.en: So Pharaoh summoned Abram. “What have you done to me?” he said. “Why didn’t you tell me she was your wife?
chapters.zh: 法老就召了亚伯兰来，说，你这向我作的是什么事呢？为什么没有告诉我她是你的妻子？

chapters.en: Why did you say, ‘She is my sister,’ so that I took her to be my wife? Now then, here is your wife. Take her and go!”
chapters.zh: 为什么说她是你的妹子，以致我把她取来要作我的妻子？现在你的妻子在这里，可以带她走吧。

chapters.en: Then Pharaoh gave orders about Abram to his men, and they sent him on his way, with his wife and everything he had.
chapters.zh: 于是法老吩咐人将亚伯兰和他妻子，并他所有的都送走了。

chapters.en: So Abram went up from Egypt to the Negev, with his wife and everything he had, and Lot went with him.
chapters.zh: 亚伯兰带着他的妻子与罗得，并一切所有的，都从埃及上南地去。

chapters.en: Abram had become very wealthy in livestock and in silver and gold.
chapters.zh: 亚伯兰的金，银，牲畜极多。

chapters.en: From the Negev he went from place to place until he came to Bethel, to the place between Bethel and Ai where his tent had been earlier
chapters.zh: 他从南地渐渐往伯特利去，到了伯特利和艾的中间，就是从前支搭帐棚的地方，

chapters.en: and where he had first built an altar. There Abram called on the name of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 也是他起先筑坛的地方，他又在那里求告耶和华的名。

chapters.en: Now Lot, who was moving about with Abram, also had flocks and herds and tents.
chapters.zh: 与亚伯兰同行的罗得也有牛群，羊群，帐棚。

chapters.en: But the land could not support them while they stayed together, for their possessions were so great that they were not able to stay together.
chapters.zh: 那地容不下他们，因为他们的财物甚多，使他们不能同居。

chapters.en: And quarreling arose between Abram’s herders and Lot’s. The Canaanites and Perizzites were also living in the land at that time.
chapters.zh: 当时，迦南人与比利洗人在那地居住。亚伯兰的牧人和罗得的牧人相争。

chapters.en: So Abram said to Lot, “Let’s not have any quarreling between you and me, or between your herders and mine, for we are close relatives.
chapters.zh: 亚伯兰就对罗得说，你我不可相争，你的牧人和我的牧人也不可相争，因为我们是骨肉（原文作弟兄）。

chapters.en: Is not the whole land before you? Let’s part company. If you go to the left, I’ll go to the right; if you go to the right, I’ll go to the left.”
chapters.zh: 遍地不都在你眼前吗？请你离开我，你向左，我就向右。你向右，我就向左。

chapters.en: Lot looked around and saw that the whole plain of the Jordan toward Zoar was well watered, like the garden of the LORD, like the land of Egypt. (This was before the LORD destroyed Sodom and Gomorrah.)
chapters.zh: 罗得举目看见约旦河的全平原，直到琐珥，都是滋润的，那地在耶和华未灭所多玛，蛾摩拉以先如同耶和华的园子，也像埃及地。

chapters.en: So Lot chose for himself the whole plain of the Jordan and set out toward the east. The two men parted company:
chapters.zh: 于是罗得选择约旦河的全平原，往东迁移。他们就彼此分离了。

chapters.en: Abram lived in the land of Canaan, while Lot lived among the cities of the plain and pitched his tents near Sodom.
chapters.zh: 亚伯兰住在迦南地，罗得住在平原的城邑，渐渐挪移帐棚，直到所多玛。

chapters.en: Now the people of Sodom were wicked and were sinning greatly against the LORD.
chapters.zh: 所多玛人在耶和华面前罪大恶极。

chapters.en: The LORD said to Abram after Lot had parted from him, “Look around from where you are, to the north and south, to the east and west.
chapters.zh: 罗得离别亚伯兰以后，耶和华对亚伯兰说，从你所在的地方，你举目向东西南北观看。

chapters.en: All the land that you see I will give to you and your offspring forever.
chapters.zh: 凡你所看见的一切地，我都要赐给你和你的后裔，直到永远。

chapters.en: I will make your offspring like the dust of the earth, so that if anyone could count the dust, then your offspring could be counted.
chapters.zh: 我也要使你的后裔如同地上的尘沙那样多，人若能数算地上的尘沙才能数算你的后裔。

chapters.en: Go, walk through the length and breadth of the land, for I am giving it to you.”
chapters.zh: 你起来，纵横走遍这地，因为我必把这地赐给你。

chapters.en: So Abram went to live near the great trees of Mamre at Hebron, where he pitched his tents. There he built an altar to the LORD.
chapters.zh: 亚伯兰就搬了帐棚，来到希伯仑幔利的橡树那里居住，在那里为耶和华筑了一座坛。

chapters.en: At the time when Amraphel was king of Shinar, Arioch king of Ellasar, Kedorlaomer king of Elam and Tidal king of Goyim,
chapters.zh: 当暗拉非作示拿王，亚略作以拉撒王，基大老玛作以拦王，提达作戈印王的时候，

chapters.en: these kings went to war against Bera king of Sodom, Birsha king of Gomorrah, Shinab king of Admah, Shemeber king of Zeboyim, and the king of Bela (that is, Zoar).
chapters.zh: 他们都攻打所多玛王比拉，蛾摩拉王比沙，押玛王示纳，洗扁王善以别，和比拉王。比拉就是琐珥。

chapters.en: All these latter kings joined forces in the Valley of Siddim (that is, the Dead Sea Valley).
chapters.zh: 这五王都在西订谷会合。西订谷就是盐海。

chapters.en: For twelve years they had been subject to Kedorlaomer, but in the thirteenth year they rebelled.
chapters.zh: 他们已经事奉基大老玛十二年，到十三年就背叛了。

chapters.en: In the fourteenth year, Kedorlaomer and the kings allied with him went out and defeated the Rephaites in Ashteroth Karnaim, the Zuzites in Ham, the Emites in Shaveh Kiriathaim
chapters.zh: 十四年，基大老玛和同盟的王都来在亚特律加宁，杀败了利乏音人，在哈麦杀败了苏西人，在沙微基列亭杀败了以米人，

chapters.en: and the Horites in the hill country of Seir, as far as El Paran near the desert.
chapters.zh: 在何利人的西珥山杀败了何利人，一直杀到靠近旷野的伊勒巴兰。

chapters.en: Then they turned back and went to En Mishpat (that is, Kadesh), and they conquered the whole territory of the Amalekites, as well as the Amorites who were living in Hazezon Tamar.
chapters.zh: 他们回到安密巴，就是加低斯，杀败了亚玛力全地的人，以及住在哈洗逊他玛的亚摩利人。

chapters.en: Then the king of Sodom, the king of Gomorrah, the king of Admah, the king of Zeboyim and the king of Bela (that is, Zoar) marched out and drew up their battle lines in the Valley of Siddim
chapters.zh: 于是所多玛王，蛾摩拉王，押玛王，洗扁王，和比拉王（比拉就是琐珥）都出来，在西订谷摆阵，与他们交战，

chapters.en: against Kedorlaomer king of Elam, Tidal king of Goyim, Amraphel king of Shinar and Arioch king of Ellasar—four kings against five.
chapters.zh: 就是与以拦王基大老玛，戈印王提达，示拿王暗拉非，以拉撒王亚略交战。乃是四王与五王交战。

chapters.en: Now the Valley of Siddim was full of tar pits, and when the kings of Sodom and Gomorrah fled, some of the men fell into them and the rest fled to the hills.
chapters.zh: 西订谷有许多石漆坑。所多玛王和蛾摩拉王逃跑，有掉在坑里的，其余的人都往山上逃跑。

chapters.en: The four kings seized all the goods of Sodom and Gomorrah and all their food; then they went away.
chapters.zh: 四王就把所多玛和蛾摩拉所有的财物，并一切的粮食都掳掠去了。

chapters.en: They also carried off Abram’s nephew Lot and his possessions, since he was living in Sodom.
chapters.zh: 又把亚伯兰的侄儿罗得和罗得的财物掳掠去了。当时罗得正住在所多玛。

chapters.en: A man who had escaped came and reported this to Abram the Hebrew. Now Abram was living near the great trees of Mamre the Amorite, a brother of Eshkol and Aner, all of whom were allied with Abram.
chapters.zh: 有一个逃出来的人告诉希伯来人亚伯兰。亚伯兰正住在亚摩利人幔利的橡树那里。幔利和以实各并亚乃都是弟兄，曾与亚伯兰联盟。

chapters.en: When Abram heard that his relative had been taken captive, he called out the 318 trained men born in his household and went in pursuit as far as Dan.
chapters.zh: 亚伯兰听见他侄儿（原文作弟兄）被掳去，就率领他家里生养的精练壮丁三百一十八人，直追到但，

chapters.en: During the night Abram divided his men to attack them and he routed them, pursuing them as far as Hobah, north of Damascus.
chapters.zh: 便在夜间，自己同仆人分队杀败敌人，又追到大马色左边的何把，

chapters.en: He recovered all the goods and brought back his relative Lot and his possessions, together with the women and the other people.
chapters.zh: 将被掳掠的一切财物夺回来，连他侄儿罗得和他的财物，以及妇女，人民也都夺回来。

chapters.en: After Abram returned from defeating Kedorlaomer and the kings allied with him, the king of Sodom came out to meet him in the Valley of Shaveh (that is, the King’s Valley).
chapters.zh: 亚伯兰杀败基大老玛和与他同盟的王回来的时候，所多玛王出来，在沙微谷迎接他。沙微谷就是王谷。

chapters.en: Then Melchizedek king of Salem brought out bread and wine. He was priest of God Most High,
chapters.zh: 又有撒冷王麦基洗德带着饼和酒出来迎接。他是至高神的祭司。

chapters.en: and he blessed Abram, saying, “Blessed be Abram by God Most High, Creator of heaven and earth.
chapters.zh: 他为亚伯兰祝福，说，愿天地的主，至高的神赐福与亚伯兰。

chapters.en: And praise be to God Most High, who delivered your enemies into your hand.” Then Abram gave him a tenth of everything.
chapters.zh: 至高的神把敌人交在你手里，是应当称颂的。亚伯兰就把所得的拿出十分之一来，给麦基洗德。

chapters.en: The king of Sodom said to Abram, “Give me the people and keep the goods for yourself.”
chapters.zh: 所多玛王对亚伯兰说，你把人口给我，财物你自己拿去吧。

chapters.en: But Abram said to the king of Sodom, “With raised hand I have sworn an oath to the LORD, God Most High, Creator of heaven and earth,
chapters.zh: 亚伯兰对所多玛王说，我已经向天地的主至高的神耶和华起誓。

chapters.en: that I will accept nothing belonging to you, not even a thread or the strap of a sandal, so that you will never be able to say, ‘I made Abram rich.’
chapters.zh: 凡是你的东西，就是一根线，一根鞋带，我都不拿，免得你说，我使亚伯兰富足。

chapters.en: I will accept nothing but what my men have eaten and the share that belongs to the men who went with me—to Aner, Eshkol and Mamre. Let them have their share.”
chapters.zh: 只有仆人所吃的，并与我同行的亚乃，以实各，幔利所应得的分，可以任凭他们拿去。

chapters.en: After this, the word of the LORD came to Abram in a vision: “Do not be afraid, Abram. I am your shield,your very great reward. ”
chapters.zh: 这事以后，耶和华在异象中有话对亚伯兰说，亚伯兰，你不要惧怕，我是你的盾牌，必大大地赏赐你。

chapters.en: But Abram said, “Sovereign LORD, what can you give me since I remain childless and the one who will inherit my estate is Eliezer of Damascus?”
chapters.zh: 亚伯兰说，主耶和华阿，我既无子，你还赐我什么呢？并且要承受我家业的是大马色人以利以谢。

chapters.en: And Abram said, “You have given me no children; so a servant in my household will be my heir.”
chapters.zh: 亚伯兰又说，你没有给我儿子。那生在我家中的人就是我的后嗣。

chapters.en: Then the word of the LORD came to him: “This man will not be your heir, but a son who is your own flesh and blood will be your heir.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华又有话对他说，这人必不成为你的后嗣。你本身所生的才成为你的后嗣。

chapters.en: He took him outside and said, “Look up at the sky and count the stars—if indeed you can count them.” Then he said to him, “So shall your offspring be.”
chapters.zh: 于是领他走到外边，说，你向天观看，数算众星，能数得过来吗？又对他说，你的后裔将要如此。

chapters.en: Abram believed the LORD, and he credited it to him as righteousness.
chapters.zh: 亚伯兰信耶和华，耶和华就以此为他的义。

chapters.en: He also said to him, “I am the LORD, who brought you out of Ur of the Chaldeans to give you this land to take possession of it.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华又对他说，我是耶和华，曾领你出了迦勒底的吾珥，为要将这地赐你为业。

chapters.en: But Abram said, “Sovereign LORD, how can I know that I will gain possession of it?”
chapters.zh: 亚伯兰说，主耶和华阿，我怎能知道必得这地为业呢？

chapters.en: So the LORD said to him, “Bring me a heifer, a goat and a ram, each three years old, along with a dove and a young pigeon.”
chapters.zh: 他说，你为我取一只三年的母牛，一只三年的母山羊，一只三年的公绵羊，一只斑鸠，一只雏鸽。

chapters.en: Abram brought all these to him, cut them in two and arranged the halves opposite each other; the birds, however, he did not cut in half.
chapters.zh: 亚伯兰就取了这些来，每样劈开，分成两半，一半对着一半地摆列，只有鸟没有劈开。

chapters.en: Then birds of prey came down on the carcasses, but Abram drove them away.
chapters.zh: 有鸷鸟下来，落在那死畜的肉上，亚伯兰就把它吓飞了。

chapters.en: As the sun was setting, Abram fell into a deep sleep, and a thick and dreadful darkness came over him.
chapters.zh: 日头正落的时候，亚伯兰沉沉地睡了。忽然有惊人的大黑暗落在他身上。

chapters.en: Then the LORD said to him, “Know for certain that for four hundred years your descendants will be strangers in a country not their own and that they will be enslaved and mistreated there.
chapters.zh: 耶和华对亚伯兰说，你要的确知道，你的后裔必寄居别人的地，又服事那地的人。那地的人要苦待他们四百年。

chapters.en: But I will punish the nation they serve as slaves, and afterward they will come out with great possessions.
chapters.zh: 并且他们所要服事的那国，我要惩罚，后来他们必带着许多财物从那里出来。

chapters.en: You, however, will go to your ancestors in peace and be buried at a good old age.
chapters.zh: 但你要享大寿数，平平安安地归到你列祖那里，被人埋葬。

chapters.en: In the fourth generation your descendants will come back here, for the sin of the Amorites has not yet reached its full measure.”
chapters.zh: 到了第四代，他们必回到此地，因为亚摩利人的罪孽还没有满盈。

chapters.en: When the sun had set and darkness had fallen, a smoking firepot with a blazing torch appeared and passed between the pieces.
chapters.zh: 日落天黑，不料有冒烟的炉并烧着的火把从那些肉块中经过。

chapters.en: On that day the LORD made a covenant with Abram and said, “To your descendants I give this land, from the Wadi of Egypt to the great river, the Euphrates—
chapters.zh: 当那日，耶和华与亚伯兰立约，说，我已赐给你的后裔，从埃及河直到伯拉大河之地，

chapters.en: the land of the Kenites, Kenizzites, Kadmonites,
chapters.zh: 就是基尼人，基尼洗人，甲摩尼人，

chapters.en: Hittites, Perizzites, Rephaites,
chapters.zh: 赫人，比利洗人，利乏音人，

chapters.en: Amorites, Canaanites, Girgashites and Jebusites.”
chapters.zh: 亚摩利人，迦南人，革迦撒人，耶布斯人之地。

chapters.en: Now Sarai, Abram’s wife, had borne him no children. But she had an Egyptian slave named Hagar;
chapters.zh: 亚伯兰的妻子撒莱不给他生儿女。撒莱有一个使女，名叫夏甲，是埃及人。

chapters.en: so she said to Abram, “The LORD has kept me from having children. Go, sleep with my slave; perhaps I can build a family through her.” Abram agreed to what Sarai said.
chapters.zh: 撒莱对亚伯兰说，耶和华使我不能生育。求你和我的使女同房，或者我可以因她得孩子（得孩子原文作被建立）。亚伯兰听从了撒莱的话。

chapters.en: So after Abram had been living in Canaan ten years, Sarai his wife took her Egyptian slave Hagar and gave her to her husband to be his wife.
chapters.zh: 于是亚伯兰的妻子撒莱将使女埃及人夏甲给了丈夫为妾。那时亚伯兰在迦南已经住了十年。

chapters.en: He slept with Hagar, and she conceived. When she knew she was pregnant, she began to despise her mistress.
chapters.zh: 亚伯兰与夏甲同房，夏甲就怀了孕。她见自己有孕，就小看她的主母。

chapters.en: Then Sarai said to Abram, “You are responsible for the wrong I am suffering. I put my slave in your arms, and now that she knows she is pregnant, she despises me. May the LORD judge between you and me.”
chapters.zh: 撒莱对亚伯兰说，我因你受屈。我将我的使女放在你怀中，她见自己有了孕，就小看我。愿耶和华在你我中间判断。

chapters.en: “Your slave is in your hands,” Abram said. “Do with her whatever you think best.” Then Sarai mistreated Hagar; so she fled from her.
chapters.zh: 亚伯兰对撒莱说，使女在你手下，你可以随意待她。撒莱苦待她，她就从撒莱面前逃走了。

chapters.en: The angel of the LORD found Hagar near a spring in the desert; it was the spring that is beside the road to Shur.
chapters.zh: 耶和华的使者在旷野书珥路上的水泉旁遇见她，

chapters.en: And he said, “Hagar, slave of Sarai, where have you come from, and where are you going?” “I’m running away from my mistress Sarai,” she answered.
chapters.zh: 对她说，撒莱的使女夏甲，你从哪里来，要往哪里去。夏甲说，我从我的主母撒莱面前逃出来。

chapters.en: Then the angel of the LORD told her, “Go back to your mistress and submit to her.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华的使者对她说，你回到你主母那里，服在她手下。

chapters.en: The angel added, “I will increase your descendants so much that they will be too numerous to count.”
chapters.zh: 又说，我必使你的后裔极其繁多，甚至不可胜数。

chapters.en: The angel of the LORD also said to her: “You are now pregnant and you will give birth to a son. You shall name him Ishmael,for the LORD has heard of your misery.
chapters.zh: 并说，你如今怀孕要生一个儿子，可以给他起名叫以实玛利，因为耶和华听见了你的苦情。（以实玛利就是神听见的意思）

chapters.en: He will be a wild donkey of a man; his hand will be against everyone and everyone’s hand against him, and he will live in hostility toward all his brothers.”
chapters.zh: 他为人必像野驴。他的手要攻打人，人的手也要攻打他。他必住在众弟兄的东边。

chapters.en: She gave this name to the LORD who spoke to her: “You are the God who sees me,” for she said, “I have now seen the One who sees me.”
chapters.zh: 夏甲就称那对她说话的耶和华为看顾人的神。因而说，在这里我也看见那看顾我的吗？

chapters.en: That is why the well was called Beer Lahai Roi ; it is still there, between Kadesh and Bered.
chapters.zh: 所以这井名叫庇耳拉海莱。这井正在加低斯和巴列中间。

chapters.en: So Hagar bore Abram a son, and Abram gave the name Ishmael to the son she had borne.
chapters.zh: 后来夏甲给亚伯兰生了一个儿子。亚伯兰给他起名叫以实玛利。

chapters.en: Abram was eighty-six years old when Hagar bore him Ishmael.
chapters.zh: 夏甲给亚伯兰生以实玛利的时候，亚伯兰年八十六岁。

chapters.en: When Abram was ninety-nine years old, the LORD appeared to him and said, “I am God Almighty ; walk before me faithfully and be blameless.
chapters.zh: 亚伯兰年九十九岁的时候，耶和华向他显现，对他说，我是全能的神。你当在我面前作完全人，

chapters.en: Then I will make my covenant between me and you and will greatly increase your numbers.”
chapters.zh: 我就与你立约，使你的后裔极其繁多。

chapters.en: Abram fell facedown, and God said to him,
chapters.zh: 亚伯兰俯伏在地。神又对他说，

chapters.en: “As for me, this is my covenant with you: You will be the father of many nations.
chapters.zh: 我与你立约，你要作多国的父。

chapters.en: No longer will you be called Abram ; your name will be Abraham, for I have made you a father of many nations.
chapters.zh: 从此以后，你的名不再叫亚伯兰，要叫亚伯拉罕，因为我已立你作多国的父。

chapters.en: I will make you very fruitful; I will make nations of you, and kings will come from you.
chapters.zh: 我必使你的后裔极其繁多。国度从你而立，君王从你而出。

chapters.en: I will establish my covenant as an everlasting covenant between me and you and your descendants after you for the generations to come, to be your God and the God of your descendants after you.
chapters.zh: 我要与你并你世世代代的后裔坚立我的约，作永远的约，是要作你和你后裔的神。

chapters.en: The whole land of Canaan, where you now reside as a foreigner, I will give as an everlasting possession to you and your descendants after you; and I will be their God.”
chapters.zh: 我要将你现在寄居的地，就是迦南全地，赐给你和你的后裔永远为业，我也必作他们的神。

chapters.en: Then God said to Abraham, “As for you, you must keep my covenant, you and your descendants after you for the generations to come.
chapters.zh: 神又对亚伯拉罕说，你和你的后裔，必世世代代遵守我的约。

chapters.en: This is my covenant with you and your descendants after you, the covenant you are to keep: Every male among you shall be circumcised.
chapters.zh: 你们所有的男子，都要受割礼。这就是我与你，并你的后裔所立的约，是你们所当遵守的。

chapters.en: You are to undergo circumcision, and it will be the sign of the covenant between me and you.
chapters.zh: 你们都要受割礼（受割礼原文作割阳皮。十四、二十三、二十四、二十五节同），这是我与你们立约的证据。

chapters.en: For the generations to come every male among you who is eight days old must be circumcised, including those born in your household or bought with money from a foreigner—those who are not your offspring.
chapters.zh: 你们世世代代的男子，无论是家里生的，是在你后裔之外用银子从外人买的，生下来第八日，都要受割礼。

chapters.en: Whether born in your household or bought with your money, they must be circumcised. My covenant in your flesh is to be an everlasting covenant.
chapters.zh: 你家里生的和你用银子买的，都必须受割礼。这样，我的约就立在你们肉体上作永远的约。

chapters.en: Any uncircumcised male, who has not been circumcised in the flesh, will be cut off from his people; he has broken my covenant.”
chapters.zh: 但不受割礼的男子，必从民中剪除，因他背了我的约。

chapters.en: God also said to Abraham, “As for Sarai your wife, you are no longer to call her Sarai; her name will be Sarah.
chapters.zh: 神又对亚伯拉罕说，你的妻子撒莱，不可再叫撒莱，她的名要叫撒拉。

chapters.en: I will bless her and will surely give you a son by her. I will bless her so that she will be the mother of nations; kings of peoples will come from her.”
chapters.zh: 我必赐福给她，也要使你从她得一个儿子。我要赐福给她，她也要作多国之母。必有百姓的君王从她而出。

chapters.en: Abraham fell facedown; he laughed and said to himself, “Will a son be born to a man a hundred years old? Will Sarah bear a child at the age of ninety?”
chapters.zh: 亚伯拉罕就俯伏在地喜笑，心里说，一百岁的人还能得孩子吗？撒拉已经九十岁了，还能生养吗？

chapters.en: And Abraham said to God, “If only Ishmael might live under your blessing!”
chapters.zh: 亚伯拉罕对神说，但愿以实玛利活在你面前。

chapters.en: Then God said, “Yes, but your wife Sarah will bear you a son, and you will call him Isaac. I will establish my covenant with him as an everlasting covenant for his descendants after him.
chapters.zh: 神说，不然，你妻子撒拉要给你生一个儿子，你要给他起名叫以撒。我要与他坚定所立的约，作他后裔永远的约。

chapters.en: And as for Ishmael, I have heard you: I will surely bless him; I will make him fruitful and will greatly increase his numbers. He will be the father of twelve rulers, and I will make him into a great nation.
chapters.zh: 至于以实玛利，我也应允你，我必赐福给他，使他昌盛极其繁多，他必生十二个族长，我也要使他成为大国。

chapters.en: But my covenant I will establish with Isaac, whom Sarah will bear to you by this time next year.”
chapters.zh: 到明年这时节，撒拉必给你生以撒，我要与他坚定所立的约。

chapters.en: When he had finished speaking with Abraham, God went up from him.
chapters.zh: 神和亚伯拉罕说完了话，就离开他上升去了。

chapters.en: On that very day Abraham took his son Ishmael and all those born in his household or bought with his money, every male in his household, and circumcised them, as God told him.
chapters.zh: 正当那日，亚伯拉罕遵着神的命，给他的儿子以实玛利和家里的一切男子，无论是在家里生的，是用银子买的，都行了割礼。

chapters.en: Abraham was ninety-nine years old when he was circumcised,
chapters.zh: 亚伯拉罕受割礼的时候，年九十九岁。

chapters.en: and his son Ishmael was thirteen;
chapters.zh: 他儿子以实玛利受割礼的时候，年十三岁。

chapters.en: Abraham and his son Ishmael were both circumcised on that very day.
chapters.zh: 正当那日，亚伯拉罕和他儿子以实玛利，一同受了割礼。

chapters.en: And every male in Abraham’s household, including those born in his household or bought from a foreigner, was circumcised with him.
chapters.zh: 家里所有的人，无论是在家里生的，是用银子从外人买的，也都一同受了割礼。

chapters.en: The LORD appeared to Abraham near the great trees of Mamre while he was sitting at the entrance to his tent in the heat of the day.
chapters.zh: 耶和华在幔利橡树那里，向亚伯拉罕显现出来。那时正热，亚伯拉罕坐在帐棚门口，

chapters.en: Abraham looked up and saw three men standing nearby. When he saw them, he hurried from the entrance of his tent to meet them and bowed low to the ground.
chapters.zh: 举目观看，见有三个人在对面站着。他一见，就从帐棚门口跑去迎接他们，俯伏在地，

chapters.en: He said, “If I have found favor in your eyes, my lord, do not pass your servant by.
chapters.zh: 说，我主，我若在你眼前蒙恩，求你不要离开仆人往前去。

chapters.en: Let a little water be brought, and then you may all wash your feet and rest under this tree.
chapters.zh: 容我拿点水来，你们洗洗脚，在树下歇息歇息。

chapters.en: Let me get you something to eat, so you can be refreshed and then go on your way—now that you have come to your servant.” “Very well,” they answered, “do as you say.”
chapters.zh: 我再拿一点饼来，你们可以加添心力，然后往前去。你们既到仆人这里来，理当如此。他们说，就照你说的行吧。

chapters.en: So Abraham hurried into the tent to Sarah. “Quick,” he said, “get three seahs of the finest flour and knead it and bake some bread.”
chapters.zh: 亚伯拉罕急忙进帐棚见撒拉，说，你速速拿三细亚细面调和作饼。

chapters.en: Then he ran to the herd and selected a choice, tender calf and gave it to a servant, who hurried to prepare it.
chapters.zh: 亚伯拉罕又跑到牛群里，牵了一只又嫩又好的牛犊来，交给仆人，仆人急忙预备好了。

chapters.en: He then brought some curds and milk and the calf that had been prepared, and set these before them. While they ate, he stood near them under a tree.
chapters.zh: 亚伯拉罕又取了奶油和奶，并预备好的牛犊来，摆在他们面前，自己在树下站在旁边，他们就吃了。

chapters.en: “Where is your wife Sarah?” they asked him. “There, in the tent,” he said.
chapters.zh: 他们问亚伯拉罕说，你妻子撒拉在哪里。他说，在帐棚里。

chapters.en: Then one of them said, “I will surely return to you about this time next year, and Sarah your wife will have a son.” Now Sarah was listening at the entrance to the tent, which was behind him.
chapters.zh: 三人中有一位说，到明年这时候，我必要回到你这里。你的妻子撒拉必生一个儿子。撒拉在那人后边的帐棚门口也听见了这话。

chapters.en: Abraham and Sarah were already very old, and Sarah was past the age of childbearing.
chapters.zh: 亚伯拉罕和撒拉年纪老迈，撒拉的月经已断绝了。

chapters.en: So Sarah laughed to herself as she thought, “After I am worn out and my lord is old, will I now have this pleasure?”
chapters.zh: 撒拉心里暗笑，说，我既已衰败，我主也老迈，岂能有这喜事呢？

chapters.en: Then the LORD said to Abraham, “Why did Sarah laugh and say, ‘Will I really have a child, now that I am old?’
chapters.zh: 耶和华对亚伯拉罕说，撒拉为什么暗笑，说，我既已年老，果真能生养吗？

chapters.en: Is anything too hard for the LORD? I will return to you at the appointed time next year, and Sarah will have a son.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华岂有难成的事吗？到了日期，明年这时候，我必回到你这里，撒拉必生一个儿子。

chapters.en: Sarah was afraid, so she lied and said, “I did not laugh.” But he said, “Yes, you did laugh.”
chapters.zh: 撒拉就害怕，不承认，说，我没有笑。那位说，不然，你实在笑了。

chapters.en: When the men got up to leave, they looked down toward Sodom, and Abraham walked along with them to see them on their way.
chapters.zh: 三人就从那里起行，向所多玛观看，亚伯拉罕也与他们同行，要送他们一程。

chapters.en: Then the LORD said, “Shall I hide from Abraham what I am about to do?
chapters.zh: 耶和华说，我所要作的事，岂可瞒着亚伯拉罕呢？

chapters.en: Abraham will surely become a great and powerful nation, and all nations on earth will be blessed through him.
chapters.zh: 亚伯拉罕必要成为强大的国，地上的万国都必因他得福。

chapters.en: For I have chosen him, so that he will direct his children and his household after him to keep the way of the LORD by doing what is right and just, so that the LORD will bring about for Abraham what he has promised him.”
chapters.zh: 我眷顾他，为要叫他吩咐他的众子和他的眷属，遵守我的道，秉公行义，使我所应许亚伯拉罕的话都成就了。

chapters.en: Then the LORD said, “The outcry against Sodom and Gomorrah is so great and their sin so grievous
chapters.zh: 耶和华说，所多玛和蛾摩拉的罪恶甚重，声闻于我。

chapters.en: that I will go down and see if what they have done is as bad as the outcry that has reached me. If not, I will know.”
chapters.zh: 我现在要下去，察看他们所行的，果然尽像那达到我耳中的声音一样吗？若是不然，我也必知道。

chapters.en: The men turned away and went toward Sodom, but Abraham remained standing before the LORD.
chapters.zh: 二人转身离开那里，向所多玛去。但亚伯拉罕仍旧站在耶和华面前。

chapters.en: Then Abraham approached him and said: “Will you sweep away the righteous with the wicked?
chapters.zh: 亚伯拉罕近前来，说，无论善恶，你都要剿灭吗？

chapters.en: What if there are fifty righteous people in the city? Will you really sweep it away and not spare the place for the sake of the fifty righteous people in it?
chapters.zh: 假若那城里有五十个义人，你还剿灭那地方吗？不为城里这五十个义人饶恕其中的人吗？

chapters.en: Far be it from you to do such a thing—to kill the righteous with the wicked, treating the righteous and the wicked alike. Far be it from you! Will not the Judge of all the earth do right?”
chapters.zh: 将义人与恶人同杀，将义人与恶人一样看待，这断不是你所行的。审判全地的主，岂不行公义吗？

chapters.en: The LORD said, “If I find fifty righteous people in the city of Sodom, I will spare the whole place for their sake.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华说，我若在所多玛城里见有五十个义人，我就为他们的缘故饶恕那地方的众人。

chapters.en: Then Abraham spoke up again: “Now that I have been so bold as to speak to the Lord, though I am nothing but dust and ashes,
chapters.zh: 亚伯拉罕说，我虽然是灰尘，还敢对主说话。

chapters.en: what if the number of the righteous is five less than fifty? Will you destroy the whole city for lack of five people?” “If I find forty-five there,” he said, “I will not destroy it.”
chapters.zh: 假若这五十个义人短了五个，你就因为短了五个毁灭全城吗？他说，我在那里若见有四十五个，也不毁灭那城。

chapters.en: Once again he spoke to him, “What if only forty are found there?” He said, “For the sake of forty, I will not do it.”
chapters.zh: 亚伯拉罕又对他说，假若在那里见有四十个怎么样呢？他说，为这四十个的缘故，我也不作这事。

chapters.en: Then he said, “May the Lord not be angry, but let me speak. What if only thirty can be found there?” He answered, “I will not do it if I find thirty there.”
chapters.zh: 亚伯拉罕说，求主不要动怒，容我说。假若在那里见有三十个怎么样呢？他说，我在那里若见有三十个，我也不作这事。

chapters.en: Abraham said, “Now that I have been so bold as to speak to the Lord, what if only twenty can be found there?” He said, “For the sake of twenty, I will not destroy it.”
chapters.zh: 亚伯拉罕说，我还敢对主说话，假若在那里见有二十个怎么样呢？他说，为这二十个的缘故，我也不毁灭那城。

chapters.en: Then he said, “May the Lord not be angry, but let me speak just once more. What if only ten can be found there?” He answered, “For the sake of ten, I will not destroy it.”
chapters.zh: 亚伯拉罕说，求主不要动怒，我再说这一次，假若在那里见有十个呢？他说，为这十个的缘故，我也不毁灭那城。

chapters.en: When the LORD had finished speaking with Abraham, he left, and Abraham returned home.
chapters.zh: 耶和华与亚伯拉罕说完了话就走了。亚伯拉罕也回到自己的地方去了。

chapters.en: The two angels arrived at Sodom in the evening, and Lot was sitting in the gateway of the city. When he saw them, he got up to meet them and bowed down with his face to the ground.
chapters.zh: 那两个天使晚上到了所多玛。罗得正坐在所多玛城门口，看见他们，就起来迎接，脸伏于地下拜，

chapters.en: “My lords,” he said, “please turn aside to your servant’s house. You can wash your feet and spend the night and then go on your way early in the morning.” “No,” they answered, “we will spend the night in the square.”
chapters.zh: 说，我主阿，请你们到仆人家里洗洗脚，住一夜，清早起来再走。他们说，不，我们要在街上过夜。

chapters.en: But he insisted so strongly that they did go with him and entered his house. He prepared a meal for them, baking bread without yeast, and they ate.
chapters.zh: 罗得切切地请他们，他们这才进去，到他屋里。罗得为他们预备筵席，烤无酵饼，他们就吃了。

chapters.en: Before they had gone to bed, all the men from every part of the city of Sodom—both young and old—surrounded the house.
chapters.zh: 他们还没有躺下，所多玛城里各处的人，连老带少，都来围住那房子，

chapters.en: They called to Lot, “Where are the men who came to you tonight? Bring them out to us so that we can have sex with them.”
chapters.zh: 呼叫罗得说，今日晚上到你这里来的人在哪里呢？把他们带出来，任我们所为。

chapters.en: Lot went outside to meet them and shut the door behind him
chapters.zh: 罗得出来，把门关上，到众人那里，

chapters.en: and said, “No, my friends. Don’t do this wicked thing.
chapters.zh: 说，众弟兄，请你们不要作这恶事。
