chapters.en: Look, I have two daughters who have never slept with a man. Let me bring them out to you, and you can do what you like with them. But don’t do anything to these men, for they have come under the protection of my roof.”
chapters.zh: 我有两个女儿，还是处女，容我领出来，任凭你们的心愿而行。只是这两个人既然到我舍下，不要向他们作什么。

chapters.en: “Get out of our way,” they replied. “This fellow came here as a foreigner, and now he wants to play the judge! We’ll treat you worse than them.” They kept bringing pressure on Lot and moved forward to break down the door.
chapters.zh: 众人说，退去吧。又说，这个人来寄居，还想要作官哪。现在我们要害你比害他们更甚。众人就向前拥挤罗得，要攻破房门。

chapters.en: But the men inside reached out and pulled Lot back into the house and shut the door.
chapters.zh: 只是那二人伸出手来，将罗得拉进屋去，把门关上，

chapters.en: Then they struck the men who were at the door of the house, young and old, with blindness so that they could not find the door.
chapters.zh: 并且使门外的人，无论老少，眼都昏迷。他们摸来摸去，总寻不着房门。

chapters.en: The two men said to Lot, “Do you have anyone else here—sons-in-law, sons or daughters, or anyone else in the city who belongs to you? Get them out of here,
chapters.zh: 二人对罗得说，你这里还有什么人吗？无论是女婿是儿女，和这城中一切属你的人，你都要将他们从这地方带出去。

chapters.en: because we are going to destroy this place. The outcry to the LORD against its people is so great that he has sent us to destroy it.”
chapters.zh: 我们要毁灭这地方。因为城内罪恶的声音在耶和华面前甚大，耶和华差我们来，要毁灭这地方。

chapters.en: So Lot went out and spoke to his sons-in-law, who were pledged to marry his daughters. He said, “Hurry and get out of this place, because the LORD is about to destroy the city!” But his sons-in-law thought he was joking.
chapters.zh: 罗得就出去，告诉娶了他女儿的女婿们（娶了或作将要娶）说，你们起来离开这地方，因为耶和华要毁灭这城。他女婿们却以为他说的是戏言。

chapters.en: With the coming of dawn, the angels urged Lot, saying, “Hurry! Take your wife and your two daughters who are here, or you will be swept away when the city is punished.”
chapters.zh: 天明了，天使催逼罗得说，起来，带着你的妻子和你在这里的两个女儿出去，免得你因这城里的罪恶同被剿灭。

chapters.en: When he hesitated, the men grasped his hand and the hands of his wife and of his two daughters and led them safely out of the city, for the LORD was merciful to them.
chapters.zh: 但罗得迟延不走。二人因为耶和华怜恤罗得，就拉着他的手和他妻子的手，并他两个女儿的手，把他们领出来，安置在城外。

chapters.en: As soon as they had brought them out, one of them said, “Flee for your lives! Don’t look back, and don’t stop anywhere in the plain! Flee to the mountains or you will be swept away!”
chapters.zh: 领他们出来以后，就说，逃命吧。不可回头看，也不可在平原站住。要往山上逃跑，免得你被剿灭。

chapters.en: But Lot said to them, “No, my lords, please!
chapters.zh: 罗得对他们说，我主阿，不要如此，

chapters.en: Your servant has found favor in your eyes, and you have shown great kindness to me in sparing my life. But I can’t flee to the mountains; this disaster will overtake me, and I’ll die.
chapters.zh: 你仆人已经在你眼前蒙恩。你又向我显出莫大的慈爱，救我的性命。我不能逃到山上去，恐怕这灾祸临到我，我便死了。

chapters.en: Look, here is a town near enough to run to, and it is small. Let me flee to it—it is very small, isn’t it? Then my life will be spared.”
chapters.zh: 看哪，这座城又小又近，容易逃到，这不是一个小的吗？求你容我逃到那里，我的性命就得存活。

chapters.en: He said to him, “Very well, I will grant this request too; I will not overthrow the town you speak of.
chapters.zh: 天使对他说，这事我也应允你。我不倾覆你所说的这城。

chapters.en: But flee there quickly, because I cannot do anything until you reach it.” (That is why the town was called Zoar. )
chapters.zh: 你要速速地逃到那城。因为你还没有到那里，我不能作什么。因此那城名叫琐珥（琐珥就是小的意思）。

chapters.en: By the time Lot reached Zoar, the sun had risen over the land.
chapters.zh: 罗得到了琐珥，日头已经出来了。

chapters.en: Then the LORD rained down burning sulfur on Sodom and Gomorrah—from the LORD out of the heavens.
chapters.zh: 当时，耶和华将硫磺与火从天上耶和华那里降与所多玛和蛾摩拉，

chapters.en: Thus he overthrew those cities and the entire plain, destroying all those living in the cities—and also the vegetation in the land.
chapters.zh: 把那些城和全平原，并城里所有的居民，连地上生长的，都毁灭了。

chapters.en: But Lot’s wife looked back, and she became a pillar of salt.
chapters.zh: 罗得的妻子在后边回头一看，就变成了一根盐柱。

chapters.en: Early the next morning Abraham got up and returned to the place where he had stood before the LORD.
chapters.zh: 亚伯拉罕清早起来，到了他从前站在耶和华面前的地方，

chapters.en: He looked down toward Sodom and Gomorrah, toward all the land of the plain, and he saw dense smoke rising from the land, like smoke from a furnace.
chapters.zh: 向所多玛和蛾摩拉与平原的全地观看，不料，那地方烟气上腾，如同烧窑一般。

chapters.en: So when God destroyed the cities of the plain, he remembered Abraham, and he brought Lot out of the catastrophe that overthrew the cities where Lot had lived.
chapters.zh: 当神毁灭平原诸城的时候，他记念亚伯拉罕，正在倾覆罗得所住之城的时候，就打发罗得从倾覆之中出来。

chapters.en: Lot and his two daughters left Zoar and settled in the mountains, for he was afraid to stay in Zoar. He and his two daughters lived in a cave.
chapters.zh: 罗得因为怕住在琐珥，就同他两个女儿从琐珥上去，住在山里。他和两个女儿住在一个洞里。

chapters.en: One day the older daughter said to the younger, “Our father is old, and there is no man around here to give us children—as is the custom all over the earth.
chapters.zh: 大女儿对小女儿说，我们的父亲老了，地上又无人按着世上的常规进到我们这里。

chapters.en: Let’s get our father to drink wine and then sleep with him and preserve our family line through our father.”
chapters.zh: 来，我们可以叫父亲喝酒，与他同寝。这样，我们好从他存留后裔。

chapters.en: That night they got their father to drink wine, and the older daughter went in and slept with him. He was not aware of it when she lay down or when she got up.
chapters.zh: 于是，那夜她们叫父亲喝酒，大女儿就进去和她父亲同寝。她几时躺下，几时起来，父亲都不知道。

chapters.en: The next day the older daughter said to the younger, “Last night I slept with my father. Let’s get him to drink wine again tonight, and you go in and sleep with him so we can preserve our family line through our father.”
chapters.zh: 第二天，大女儿对小女儿说，我昨夜与父亲同寝。今夜我们再叫他喝酒，你可以进去与他同寝。这样，我们好从父亲存留后裔。

chapters.en: So they got their father to drink wine that night also, and the younger daughter went in and slept with him. Again he was not aware of it when she lay down or when she got up.
chapters.zh: 于是，那夜她们又叫父亲喝酒，小女儿起来与她父亲同寝。她几时躺下，几时起来，父亲都不知道。

chapters.en: So both of Lot’s daughters became pregnant by their father.
chapters.zh: 这样，罗得的两个女儿都从她父亲怀了孕。

chapters.en: The older daughter had a son, and she named him Moab ; he is the father of the Moabites of today.
chapters.zh: 大女儿生了儿子，给他起名叫摩押，就是现今摩押人的始祖。

chapters.en: The younger daughter also had a son, and she named him Ben-Ammi ; he is the father of the Ammonites of today.
chapters.zh: 小女儿也生了儿子，给他起名叫便亚米，就是现今亚扪人的始祖。

chapters.en: Now Abraham moved on from there into the region of the Negev and lived between Kadesh and Shur. For a while he stayed in Gerar,
chapters.zh: 亚伯拉罕从那里向南地迁去，寄居在加低斯和书珥中间的基拉耳。

chapters.en: and there Abraham said of his wife Sarah, “She is my sister.” Then Abimelek king of Gerar sent for Sarah and took her.
chapters.zh: 亚伯拉罕称他的妻撒拉为妹子，基拉耳王亚比米勒差人把撒拉取了去。

chapters.en: But God came to Abimelek in a dream one night and said to him, “You are as good as dead because of the woman you have taken; she is a married woman.”
chapters.zh: 但夜间神来在梦中对亚比米勒说，你是个死人哪，因为你取了那女人来。她原是别人的妻子。

chapters.en: Now Abimelek had not gone near her, so he said, “Lord, will you destroy an innocent nation?
chapters.zh: 亚比米勒却还没有亲近撒拉。他说，主阿，连有义的国，你也要毁灭吗？

chapters.en: Did he not say to me, ‘She is my sister,’ and didn’t she also say, ‘He is my brother’? I have done this with a clear conscience and clean hands.”
chapters.zh: 那人岂不是自己对我说，她是我的妹子吗？就是女人也自己说，他是我的哥哥。我作这事是心正手洁的。

chapters.en: Then God said to him in the dream, “Yes, I know you did this with a clear conscience, and so I have kept you from sinning against me. That is why I did not let you touch her.
chapters.zh: 神在梦中对他说，我知道你作这事是心中正直。我也拦阻了你，免得你得罪我，所以我不容你沾着她。

chapters.en: Now return the man’s wife, for he is a prophet, and he will pray for you and you will live. But if you do not return her, you may be sure that you and all who belong to you will die.”
chapters.zh: 现在你把这人的妻子归还他。因为他是先知，他要为你祷告，使你存活。你若不归还他，你当知道，你和你所有的人都必要死。

chapters.en: Early the next morning Abimelek summoned all his officials, and when he told them all that had happened, they were very much afraid.
chapters.zh: 亚比米勒清早起来，召了众臣仆来，将这些事都说给他们听，他们都甚惧怕。

chapters.en: Then Abimelek called Abraham in and said, “What have you done to us? How have I wronged you that you have brought such great guilt upon me and my kingdom? You have done things to me that should never be done.”
chapters.zh: 亚比米勒召了亚伯拉罕来，对他说，你怎么向我这样行呢？我在什么事上得罪了你，你竟使我和我国里的人陷在大罪里。你向我行不当行的事了。

chapters.en: And Abimelek asked Abraham, “What was your reason for doing this?”
chapters.zh: 亚比米勒又对亚伯拉罕说，你见了什么才作这事呢？

chapters.en: Abraham replied, “I said to myself, ‘There is surely no fear of God in this place, and they will kill me because of my wife.’
chapters.zh: 亚伯拉罕说，我以为这地方的人总不惧怕神，必为我妻子的缘故杀我。

chapters.en: Besides, she really is my sister, the daughter of my father though not of my mother; and she became my wife.
chapters.zh: 况且她也实在是我的妹子。她与我是同父异母，后来作了我的妻子。

chapters.en: And when God had me wander from my father’s household, I said to her, ‘This is how you can show your love to me: Everywhere we go, say of me, “He is my brother.” ’ ”
chapters.zh: 当神叫我离开父家，飘流在外的时候，我对她说，我们无论走到什么地方，你可以对人说，他是我的哥哥。这就是你待我的恩典了。

chapters.en: Then Abimelek brought sheep and cattle and male and female slaves and gave them to Abraham, and he returned Sarah his wife to him.
chapters.zh: 亚比米勒把牛，羊，仆婢赐给亚伯拉罕，又把他的妻子撒拉归还他。

chapters.en: And Abimelek said, “My land is before you; live wherever you like.”
chapters.zh: 亚比米勒又说，看哪，我的地都在你面前，你可以随意居住。

chapters.en: To Sarah he said, “I am giving your brother a thousand shekels of silver. This is to cover the offense against you before all who are with you; you are completely vindicated.”
chapters.zh: 又对撒拉说，我给你哥哥一千银子，作为你在合家人面前遮羞的（羞原文作眼），你就在众人面前没有不是了。

chapters.en: Then Abraham prayed to God, and God healed Abimelek, his wife and his female slaves so they could have children again,
chapters.zh: 亚伯拉罕祷告神，神就医好了亚比米勒和他的妻子，并他的众女仆，她们便能生育。

chapters.en: for the LORD had kept all the women in Abimelek’s household from conceiving because of Abraham’s wife Sarah.
chapters.zh: 因耶和华为亚伯拉罕的妻子撒拉的缘故，已经使亚比米勒家中的妇人不能生育。

chapters.en: Now the LORD was gracious to Sarah as he had said, and the LORD did for Sarah what he had promised.
chapters.zh: 耶和华按着先前的话眷顾撒拉，便照他所说的给撒拉成就。

chapters.en: Sarah became pregnant and bore a son to Abraham in his old age, at the very time God had promised him.
chapters.zh: 当亚伯拉罕年老的时候，撒拉怀了孕。到神所说的日期，就给亚伯拉罕生了一个儿子。

chapters.en: Abraham gave the name Isaac to the son Sarah bore him.
chapters.zh: 亚伯拉罕给撒拉所生的儿子起名叫以撒。

chapters.en: When his son Isaac was eight days old, Abraham circumcised him, as God commanded him.
chapters.zh: 以撒生下来第八日，亚伯拉罕照着神所吩咐的，给以撒行了割礼。

chapters.en: Abraham was a hundred years old when his son Isaac was born to him.
chapters.zh: 他儿子以撒生的时候，亚伯拉罕年一百岁。

chapters.en: Sarah said, “God has brought me laughter, and everyone who hears about this will laugh with me.”
chapters.zh: 撒拉说，神使我喜笑，凡听见的必与我一同喜笑。

chapters.en: And she added, “Who would have said to Abraham that Sarah would nurse children? Yet I have borne him a son in his old age.”
chapters.zh: 又说，谁能预先对亚伯拉罕说撒拉要乳养婴孩呢？因为在他年老的时候，我给他生了一个儿子。

chapters.en: The child grew and was weaned, and on the day Isaac was weaned Abraham held a great feast.
chapters.zh: 孩子渐长，就断了奶。以撒断奶的日子，亚伯拉罕设摆丰盛的筵席。

chapters.en: But Sarah saw that the son whom Hagar the Egyptian had borne to Abraham was mocking,
chapters.zh: 当时，撒拉看见埃及人夏甲给亚伯拉罕所生的儿子戏笑，

chapters.en: and she said to Abraham, “Get rid of that slave woman and her son, for that woman’s son will never share in the inheritance with my son Isaac.”
chapters.zh: 就对亚伯拉罕说，你把这使女和她儿子赶出去，因为这使女的儿子不可与我的儿子以撒一同承受产业。

chapters.en: The matter distressed Abraham greatly because it concerned his son.
chapters.zh: 亚伯拉罕因他儿子的缘故很忧愁。

chapters.en: But God said to him, “Do not be so distressed about the boy and your slave woman. Listen to whatever Sarah tells you, because it is through Isaac that your offspring will be reckoned.
chapters.zh: 神对亚伯拉罕说，你不必为这童子和你的使女忧愁。凡撒拉对你说的话，你都该听从。因为从以撒生的，才要称为你的后裔。

chapters.en: I will make the son of the slave into a nation also, because he is your offspring.”
chapters.zh: 至于使女的儿子，我也必使他的后裔成立一国，因为他是你所生的。

chapters.en: Early the next morning Abraham took some food and a skin of water and gave them to Hagar. He set them on her shoulders and then sent her off with the boy. She went on her way and wandered in the Desert of Beersheba.
chapters.zh: 亚伯拉罕清早起来，拿饼和一皮袋水，给了夏甲，搭在她的肩上，又把孩子交给她打发她走。夏甲就走了，在别是巴的旷野走迷了路。

chapters.en: When the water in the skin was gone, she put the boy under one of the bushes.
chapters.zh: 皮袋的水用尽了，夏甲就把孩子撇在小树底下，

chapters.en: Then she went off and sat down about a bowshot away, for she thought, “I cannot watch the boy die.” And as she sat there, she began to sob.
chapters.zh: 自己走开约有一箭之远，相对而坐，说，我不忍见孩子死，就相对而坐，放声大哭。

chapters.en: God heard the boy crying, and the angel of God called to Hagar from heaven and said to her, “What is the matter, Hagar? Do not be afraid; God has heard the boy crying as he lies there.
chapters.zh: 神听见童子的声音。神的使者从天上呼叫夏甲说，夏甲，你为何这样呢？不要害怕，神已经听见童子的声音了。

chapters.en: Lift the boy up and take him by the hand, for I will make him into a great nation.”
chapters.zh: 起来，把童子抱在怀中（怀原文作手），我必使他的后裔成为大国。

chapters.en: Then God opened her eyes and she saw a well of water. So she went and filled the skin with water and gave the boy a drink.
chapters.zh: 神使夏甲的眼睛明亮，她就看见一口水井，便去将皮袋盛满了水，给童子喝。

chapters.en: God was with the boy as he grew up. He lived in the desert and became an archer.
chapters.zh: 神保佑童子，他就渐长，住在旷野，成了弓箭手。

chapters.en: While he was living in the Desert of Paran, his mother got a wife for him from Egypt.
chapters.zh: 他住在巴兰的旷野。他母亲从埃及地给他娶了一个妻子。

chapters.en: At that time Abimelek and Phicol the commander of his forces said to Abraham, “God is with you in everything you do.
chapters.zh: 当那时候，亚比米勒同他军长非各对亚伯拉罕说，凡你所行的事都有神的保佑。

chapters.en: Now swear to me here before God that you will not deal falsely with me or my children or my descendants. Show to me and the country where you now reside as a foreigner the same kindness I have shown to you.”
chapters.zh: 我愿你如今在这里指着神对我起誓，不要欺负我与我的儿子，并我的子孙。我怎样厚待了你，你也要照样厚待我与你所寄居这地的民。

chapters.en: Abraham said, “I swear it.”
chapters.zh: 亚伯拉罕说，我情愿起誓。

chapters.en: Then Abraham complained to Abimelek about a well of water that Abimelek’s servants had seized.
chapters.zh: 从前，亚比米勒的仆人霸占了一口水井，亚伯拉罕为这事指责亚比米勒。

chapters.en: But Abimelek said, “I don’t know who has done this. You did not tell me, and I heard about it only today.”
chapters.zh: 亚比米勒说，谁作这事，我不知道，你也没有告诉我，今日我才听见了。

chapters.en: So Abraham brought sheep and cattle and gave them to Abimelek, and the two men made a treaty.
chapters.zh: 亚伯拉罕把羊和牛给了亚比米勒，二人就彼此立约。

chapters.en: Abraham set apart seven ewe lambs from the flock,
chapters.zh: 亚伯拉罕把七只母羊羔另放在一处。

chapters.en: and Abimelek asked Abraham, “What is the meaning of these seven ewe lambs you have set apart by themselves?”
chapters.zh: 亚比米勒问亚伯拉罕说，你把这七只母羊羔另放在一处，是什么意思呢？

chapters.en: He replied, “Accept these seven lambs from my hand as a witness that I dug this well.”
chapters.zh: 他说，你要从我手里受这七只母羊羔，作我挖这口井的证据。

chapters.en: So that place was called Beersheba, because the two men swore an oath there.
chapters.zh: 所以他给那地方起名叫别是巴，因为他们二人在那里起了誓。（别是巴就是盟誓的井）

chapters.en: After the treaty had been made at Beersheba, Abimelek and Phicol the commander of his forces returned to the land of the Philistines.
chapters.zh: 他们在别是巴立了约，亚比米勒就同他军长非各起身回非利士地去了。

chapters.en: Abraham planted a tamarisk tree in Beersheba, and there he called on the name of the LORD, the Eternal God.
chapters.zh: 亚伯拉罕在别是巴栽上一棵垂丝柳树，又在那里求告耶和华永生神的名。

chapters.en: And Abraham stayed in the land of the Philistines for a long time.
chapters.zh: 亚伯拉罕在非利士人的地寄居了多日。

chapters.en: Some time later God tested Abraham. He said to him, “Abraham!” “Here I am,” he replied.
chapters.zh: 这些事以后，神要试验亚伯拉罕，就呼叫他说，亚伯拉罕，他说，我在这里。

chapters.en: Then God said, “Take your son, your only son, whom you love—Isaac—and go to the region of Moriah. Sacrifice him there as a burnt offering on a mountain I will show you.”
chapters.zh: 神说，你带着你的儿子，就是你独生的儿子，你所爱的以撒，往摩利亚地去，在我所要指示你的山上，把他献为燔祭。

chapters.en: Early the next morning Abraham got up and loaded his donkey. He took with him two of his servants and his son Isaac. When he had cut enough wood for the burnt offering, he set out for the place God had told him about.
chapters.zh: 亚伯拉罕清早起来，备上驴，带着两个仆人和他儿子以撒，也劈好了燔祭的柴，就起身往神所指示他的地方去了。

chapters.en: On the third day Abraham looked up and saw the place in the distance.
chapters.zh: 到了第三日，亚伯拉罕举目远远地看见那地方。

chapters.en: He said to his servants, “Stay here with the donkey while I and the boy go over there. We will worship and then we will come back to you.”
chapters.zh: 亚伯拉罕对他的仆人说，你们和驴在此等候，我与童子往那里去拜一拜，就回到你们这里来。

chapters.en: Abraham took the wood for the burnt offering and placed it on his son Isaac, and he himself carried the fire and the knife. As the two of them went on together,
chapters.zh: 亚伯拉罕把燔祭的柴放在他儿子以撒身上，自己手里拿着火与刀。于是二人同行。

chapters.en: Isaac spoke up and said to his father Abraham, “Father?” “Yes, my son?” Abraham replied. “The fire and wood are here,” Isaac said, “but where is the lamb for the burnt offering?”
chapters.zh: 以撒对他父亲亚伯拉罕说，父亲哪，亚伯拉罕说，我儿，我在这里。以撒说，请看，火与柴都有了，但燔祭的羊羔在哪里呢？

chapters.en: Abraham answered, “God himself will provide the lamb for the burnt offering, my son.” And the two of them went on together.
chapters.zh: 亚伯拉罕说，我儿，神必自己预备作燔祭的羊羔。于是二人同行。

chapters.en: When they reached the place God had told him about, Abraham built an altar there and arranged the wood on it. He bound his son Isaac and laid him on the altar, on top of the wood.
chapters.zh: 他们到了神所指示的地方，亚伯拉罕在那里筑坛，把柴摆好，捆绑他的儿子以撒，放在坛的柴上。

chapters.en: Then he reached out his hand and took the knife to slay his son.
chapters.zh: 亚伯拉罕就伸手拿刀，要杀他的儿子。

chapters.en: But the angel of the LORD called out to him from heaven, “Abraham! Abraham!” “Here I am,” he replied.
chapters.zh: 耶和华的使者从天上呼叫他说，亚伯拉罕，亚伯拉罕，他说，我在这里。

chapters.en: “Do not lay a hand on the boy,” he said. “Do not do anything to him. Now I know that you fear God, because you have not withheld from me your son, your only son.”
chapters.zh: 天使说，你不可在这童子身上下手。一点不可害他。现在我知道你是敬畏神的了。因为你没有将你的儿子，就是你独生的儿子，留下不给我。

chapters.en: Abraham looked up and there in a thicket he saw a ram caught by its horns. He went over and took the ram and sacrificed it as a burnt offering instead of his son.
chapters.zh: 亚伯拉罕举目观看，不料，有一只公羊，两角扣在稠密的小树中，亚伯拉罕就取了那只公羊来，献为燔祭，代替他的儿子。

chapters.en: So Abraham called that place The LORD Will Provide. And to this day it is said, “On the mountain of the LORD it will be provided.”
chapters.zh: 亚伯拉罕给那地方起名叫耶和华以勒（意思就是耶和华必预备），直到今日人还说，在耶和华的山上必有预备。

chapters.en: The angel of the LORD called to Abraham from heaven a second time
chapters.zh: 耶和华的使者第二次从天上呼叫亚伯拉罕说，

chapters.en: and said, “I swear by myself, declares the LORD, that because you have done this and have not withheld your son, your only son,
chapters.zh: 耶和华说，你既行了这事，不留下你的儿子，就是你独生的儿子，我便指着自己起誓说，

chapters.en: I will surely bless you and make your descendants as numerous as the stars in the sky and as the sand on the seashore. Your descendants will take possession of the cities of their enemies,
chapters.zh: 论福，我必赐大福给你。论子孙，我必叫你的子孙多起来，如同天上的星，海边的沙。你子孙必得着仇敌的城门，

chapters.en: and through your offspring all nations on earth will be blessed, because you have obeyed me.”
chapters.zh: 并且地上万国都必因你的后裔得福，因为你听从了我的话。

chapters.en: Then Abraham returned to his servants, and they set off together for Beersheba. And Abraham stayed in Beersheba.
chapters.zh: 于是亚伯拉罕回到他仆人那里，他们一同起身往别是巴去，亚伯拉罕就住在别是巴。

chapters.en: Some time later Abraham was told, “Milkah is also a mother; she has borne sons to your brother Nahor:
chapters.zh: 这事以后，有人告诉亚伯拉罕说，密迦给你兄弟拿鹤生了几个儿子，

chapters.en: Uz the firstborn, Buz his brother, Kemuel (the father of Aram),
chapters.zh: 长子是乌斯，他的兄弟是布斯和亚兰的父亲基母利，

chapters.en: Kesed, Hazo, Pildash, Jidlaph and Bethuel.”
chapters.zh: 并基薛，哈琐，必达，益拉，彼土利（彼土利生利百加）。

chapters.en: Bethuel became the father of Rebekah. Milkah bore these eight sons to Abraham’s brother Nahor.
chapters.zh: 这八个人都是密迦给亚伯拉罕的兄弟拿鹤生的。

chapters.en: His concubine, whose name was Reumah, also had sons: Tebah, Gaham, Tahash and Maakah.
chapters.zh: 拿鹤的妾名叫流玛，生了提八，迦含，他辖，和玛迦。

chapters.en: Sarah lived to be a hundred and twenty-seven years old.
chapters.zh: 撒拉享寿一百二十七岁，这是撒拉一生的岁数。

chapters.en: She died at Kiriath Arba (that is, Hebron) in the land of Canaan, and Abraham went to mourn for Sarah and to weep over her.
chapters.zh: 撒拉死在迦南地的基列亚巴，就是希伯仑。亚伯拉罕为她哀恸哭号。

chapters.en: Then Abraham rose from beside his dead wife and spoke to the Hittites. He said,
chapters.zh: 后来亚伯拉罕从死人面前起来，对赫人说，

chapters.en: “I am a foreigner and stranger among you. Sell me some property for a burial site here so I can bury my dead.”
chapters.zh: 我在你们中间是外人，是寄居的。求你们在这里给我一块地，我好埋葬我的死人，使她不在我眼前。

chapters.en: The Hittites replied to Abraham,
chapters.zh: 赫人回答亚伯拉罕说，

chapters.en: “Sir, listen to us. You are a mighty prince among us. Bury your dead in the choicest of our tombs. None of us will refuse you his tomb for burying your dead.”
chapters.zh: 我主请听。你在我们中间是一位尊大的王子，只管在我们最好的坟地里埋葬你的死人。我们没有一人不容你在他的坟地里埋葬你的死人。

chapters.en: Then Abraham rose and bowed down before the people of the land, the Hittites.
chapters.zh: 亚伯拉罕就起来，向那地的赫人下拜，

chapters.en: He said to them, “If you are willing to let me bury my dead, then listen to me and intercede with Ephron son of Zohar on my behalf
chapters.zh: 对他们说，你们若有意叫我埋葬我的死人，使她不在我眼前，就请听我的话，为我求琐辖的儿子以弗仑，

chapters.en: so he will sell me the cave of Machpelah, which belongs to him and is at the end of his field. Ask him to sell it to me for the full price as a burial site among you.”
chapters.zh: 把田头上那麦比拉洞给我。他可以按着足价卖给我，作我在你们中间的坟地。

chapters.en: Ephron the Hittite was sitting among his people and he replied to Abraham in the hearing of all the Hittites who had come to the gate of his city.
chapters.zh: 当时以弗仑正坐在赫人中间。于是，赫人以弗仑在城门出入的赫人面前对亚伯拉罕说，

chapters.en: “No, my lord,” he said. “Listen to me; I give you the field, and I give you the cave that is in it. I give it to you in the presence of my people. Bury your dead.”
chapters.zh: 不然，我主请听。我送给你这块田，连田间的洞也送给你，在我同族的人面前都给你，可以埋葬你的死人。

chapters.en: Again Abraham bowed down before the people of the land
chapters.zh: 亚伯拉罕就在那地的人民面前下拜，

chapters.en: and he said to Ephron in their hearing, “Listen to me, if you will. I will pay the price of the field. Accept it from me so I can bury my dead there.”
chapters.zh: 在他们面前对以弗仑说，你若应允，请听我的话。我要把田价给你，求你收下，我就在那里埋葬我的死人。

chapters.en: Ephron answered Abraham,
chapters.zh: 以弗仑回答亚伯拉罕说，

chapters.en: “Listen to me, my lord; the land is worth four hundred shekels of silver, but what is that between you and me? Bury your dead.”
chapters.zh: 我主请听。值四百舍客勒银子的一块田，在你我中间还算什么呢？只管埋葬你的死人吧。

chapters.en: Abraham agreed to Ephron’s terms and weighed out for him the price he had named in the hearing of the Hittites: four hundred shekels of silver, according to the weight current among the merchants.
chapters.zh: 亚伯拉罕听从了以弗仑，照着他在赫人面前所说的话，把买卖通用的银子平了四百舍客勒给以弗仑。

chapters.en: So Ephron’s field in Machpelah near Mamre—both the field and the cave in it, and all the trees within the borders of the field—was deeded
chapters.zh: 于是，麦比拉，幔利前，以弗仑的那块田和其中的洞，并田间四围的树木，

chapters.en: to Abraham as his property in the presence of all the Hittites who had come to the gate of the city.
chapters.zh: 都定准归与亚伯拉罕，乃是他在赫人面前并城门出入的人面前买妥的。

chapters.en: Afterward Abraham buried his wife Sarah in the cave in the field of Machpelah near Mamre (which is at Hebron) in the land of Canaan.
chapters.zh: 此后，亚伯拉罕把他妻子撒拉埋葬在迦南地幔利前的麦比拉田间的洞里。幔利就是希伯仑。

chapters.en: So the field and the cave in it were deeded to Abraham by the Hittites as a burial site.
chapters.zh: 从此，那块田和田间的洞就借着赫人定准归与亚伯拉罕作坟地。

chapters.en: Abraham was now very old, and the LORD had blessed him in every way.
chapters.zh: 亚伯拉罕年纪老迈，向来在一切事上耶和华都赐福给他。

chapters.en: He said to the senior servant in his household, the one in charge of all that he had, “Put your hand under my thigh.
chapters.zh: 亚伯拉罕对管理他全业最老的仆人说，请你把手放在我大腿底下。

chapters.en: I want you to swear by the LORD, the God of heaven and the God of earth, that you will not get a wife for my son from the daughters of the Canaanites, among whom I am living,
chapters.zh: 我要叫你指着耶和华天地的主起誓，不要为我儿子娶这迦南地中的女子为妻。

chapters.en: but will go to my country and my own relatives and get a wife for my son Isaac.”
chapters.zh: 你要往我本地本族去，为我的儿子以撒娶一个妻子。

chapters.en: The servant asked him, “What if the woman is unwilling to come back with me to this land? Shall I then take your son back to the country you came from?”
chapters.zh: 仆人对他说，倘若女子不肯跟我到这地方来，我必须将你的儿子带回你原出之地吗？

chapters.en: “Make sure that you do not take my son back there,” Abraham said.
chapters.zh: 亚伯拉罕对他说，你要谨慎，不要带我的儿子回那里去。

chapters.en: “The LORD, the God of heaven, who brought me out of my father’s household and my native land and who spoke to me and promised me on oath, saying, ‘To your offspring I will give this land’—he will send his angel before you so that you can get a wife for my son from there.
chapters.zh: 耶和华天上的主曾带领我离开父家和本族的地，对我说话，向我起誓说，我要将这地赐给你的后裔。他必差遣使者在你面前，你就可以从那里为我儿子娶一个妻子。

chapters.en: If the woman is unwilling to come back with you, then you will be released from this oath of mine. Only do not take my son back there.”
chapters.zh: 倘若女子不肯跟你来，我使你起的誓就与你无干了，只是不可带我的儿子回那里去。

chapters.en: So the servant put his hand under the thigh of his master Abraham and swore an oath to him concerning this matter.
chapters.zh: 仆人就把手放在他主人亚伯拉罕的大腿底下，为这事向他起誓。

chapters.en: Then the servant left, taking with him ten of his master’s camels loaded with all kinds of good things from his master. He set out for Aram Naharaim and made his way to the town of Nahor.
chapters.zh: 那仆人从他主人的骆驼里取了十匹骆驼，并带些他主人各样的财物，起身往米所波大米去，到了拿鹤的城。

chapters.en: He had the camels kneel down near the well outside the town; it was toward evening, the time the women go out to draw water.
chapters.zh: 天将晚，众女子出来打水的时候，他便叫骆驼跪在城外的水井那里。

chapters.en: Then he prayed, “LORD, God of my master Abraham, make me successful today, and show kindness to my master Abraham.
chapters.zh: 他说，耶和华我主人亚伯拉罕的神阿，求你施恩给我主人亚伯拉罕，使我今日遇见好机会。

chapters.en: See, I am standing beside this spring, and the daughters of the townspeople are coming out to draw water.
chapters.zh: 我现今站在井旁，城内居民的女子们正出来打水。

chapters.en: May it be that when I say to a young woman, ‘Please let down your jar that I may have a drink,’ and she says, ‘Drink, and I’ll water your camels too’—let her be the one you have chosen for your servant Isaac. By this I will know that you have shown kindness to my master.”
chapters.zh: 我向哪一个女子说，请你拿下水瓶来，给我水喝，她若说，请喝，我也给你的骆驼喝，愿那女子就作你所预定给你仆人以撒的妻。这样，我便知道你施恩给我主人了。

chapters.en: Before he had finished praying, Rebekah came out with her jar on her shoulder. She was the daughter of Bethuel son of Milkah, who was the wife of Abraham’s brother Nahor.
chapters.zh: 话还没有说完，不料，利百加肩头上扛着水瓶出来。利百加是彼土利所生的。彼土利是亚伯拉罕兄弟拿鹤妻子密迦的儿子。

chapters.en: The woman was very beautiful, a virgin; no man had ever slept with her. She went down to the spring, filled her jar and came up again.
chapters.zh: 那女子容貌极其俊美，还是处女，也未曾有人亲近她。她下到井旁，打满了瓶，又上来。

chapters.en: The servant hurried to meet her and said, “Please give me a little water from your jar.”
chapters.zh: 仆人跑上前去迎着她，说，求你将瓶里的水给我一点喝。

chapters.en: “Drink, my lord,” she said, and quickly lowered the jar to her hands and gave him a drink.
chapters.zh: 女子说，我主请喝，就急忙拿下瓶来，托在手上给他喝。

chapters.en: After she had given him a drink, she said, “I’ll draw water for your camels too, until they have had enough to drink.”
chapters.zh: 女子给他喝了，就说，我再为你的骆驼打水，叫骆驼也喝足。

chapters.en: So she quickly emptied her jar into the trough, ran back to the well to draw more water, and drew enough for all his camels.
chapters.zh: 她就急忙把瓶里的水倒在槽里，又跑到井旁打水，就为所有的骆驼打上水来。

chapters.en: Without saying a word, the man watched her closely to learn whether or not the LORD had made his journey successful.
chapters.zh: 那人定睛看她，一句话也不说，要晓得耶和华赐他通达的道路没有。

chapters.en: When the camels had finished drinking, the man took out a gold nose ring weighing a beka and two gold bracelets weighing ten shekels.
chapters.zh: 骆驼喝足了，那人就拿一个金环，重半舍客勒，两个金镯，重十舍客勒，给了那女子，

chapters.en: Then he asked, “Whose daughter are you? Please tell me, is there room in your father’s house for us to spend the night?”
chapters.zh: 说，请告诉我，你是谁的女儿，你父亲家里有我们住宿的地方没有。

chapters.en: She answered him, “I am the daughter of Bethuel, the son that Milkah bore to Nahor.”
chapters.zh: 女子说，我是密迦与拿鹤之子彼土利的女儿。

chapters.en: And she added, “We have plenty of straw and fodder, as well as room for you to spend the night.”
chapters.zh: 又说，我们家里足有粮草，也有住宿的地方。

chapters.en: Then the man bowed down and worshiped the LORD,
chapters.zh: 那人就低头向耶和华下拜，

chapters.en: saying, “Praise be to the LORD, the God of my master Abraham, who has not abandoned his kindness and faithfulness to my master. As for me, the LORD has led me on the journey to the house of my master’s relatives.”
chapters.zh: 说，耶和华我主人亚伯拉罕的神是应当称颂的，因他不断地以慈爱诚实待我主人。至于我，耶和华在路上引领我，直走到我主人的兄弟家里。

chapters.en: The young woman ran and told her mother’s household about these things.
chapters.zh: 女子跑回去，照着这些话告诉她母亲和她家里的人。

chapters.en: Now Rebekah had a brother named Laban, and he hurried out to the man at the spring.
chapters.zh: 利百加有一个哥哥，名叫拉班，看见金环，又看见金镯在他妹子的手上，并听见他妹子利百加的话，说那人对我如此如此说。

chapters.en: As soon as he had seen the nose ring, and the bracelets on his sister’s arms, and had heard Rebekah tell what the man said to her, he went out to the man and found him standing by the camels near the spring.
chapters.zh: 拉班就跑出来往井旁去，到那人跟前，见他仍站在骆驼旁边的井旁那里。

chapters.en: “Come, you who are blessed by the LORD,” he said. “Why are you standing out here? I have prepared the house and a place for the camels.”
chapters.zh: 便对他说，你这蒙耶和华赐福的，请进来，为什么站在外边？我已经收拾了房屋，也为骆驼预备了地方。

chapters.en: So the man went to the house, and the camels were unloaded. Straw and fodder were brought for the camels, and water for him and his men to wash their feet.
chapters.zh: 那人就进了拉班的家。拉班卸了骆驼，用草料喂上，拿水给那人和跟随的人洗脚，

chapters.en: Then food was set before him, but he said, “I will not eat until I have told you what I have to say.” “Then tell us,” Laban said.
chapters.zh: 把饭摆在他面前，叫他吃，他却说，我不吃，等我说明白我的事情再吃。拉班说，请说。

chapters.en: So he said, “I am Abraham’s servant.
chapters.zh: 他说，我是亚伯拉罕的仆人。

chapters.en: The LORD has blessed my master abundantly, and he has become wealthy. He has given him sheep and cattle, silver and gold, male and female servants, and camels and donkeys.
chapters.zh: 耶和华大大地赐福给我主人，使他昌大，又赐给他羊群，牛群，金银，仆婢，骆驼，和驴。

chapters.en: My master’s wife Sarah has borne him a son in her old age, and he has given him everything he owns.
chapters.zh: 我主人的妻子撒拉年老的时候给我主人生了一个儿子。我主人也将一切所有的都给了这个儿子。

chapters.en: And my master made me swear an oath, and said, ‘You must not get a wife for my son from the daughters of the Canaanites, in whose land I live,
chapters.zh: 我主人叫我起誓说，你不要为我儿子娶迦南地的女子为妻。

chapters.en: but go to my father’s family and to my own clan, and get a wife for my son.’
chapters.zh: 你要往我父家，我本族那里去，为我的儿子娶一个妻子。

chapters.en: “Then I asked my master, ‘What if the woman will not come back with me?’
chapters.zh: 我对我主人说，恐怕女子不肯跟我来。

chapters.en: “He replied, ‘The LORD, before whom I have walked faithfully, will send his angel with you and make your journey a success, so that you can get a wife for my son from my own clan and from my father’s family.
chapters.zh: 他就说，我所事奉的耶和华必要差遣他的使者与你同去，叫你的道路通达，你就得以在我父家，我本族那里，给我的儿子娶一个妻子。

chapters.en: You will be released from my oath if, when you go to my clan, they refuse to give her to you—then you will be released from my oath.’
chapters.zh: 只要你到了我本族那里，我使你起的誓就与你无干。他们若不把女子交给你，我使你起的誓也与你无干。

chapters.en: “When I came to the spring today, I said, ‘LORD, God of my master Abraham, if you will, please grant success to the journey on which I have come.
chapters.zh: 我今日到了井旁，便说，耶和华我主人亚伯拉罕的神阿，愿你叫我所行的道路通达。

chapters.en: See, I am standing beside this spring. If a young woman comes out to draw water and I say to her, “Please let me drink a little water from your jar,”
chapters.zh: 我如今站在井旁，对那一个出来打水的女子说，请你把你瓶里的水给我一点喝。

chapters.en: and if she says to me, “Drink, and I’ll draw water for your camels too,” let her be the one the LORD has chosen for my master’s son.’
chapters.zh: 她若说，你只管喝，我也为你的骆驼打水。愿那女子就作耶和华给我主人儿子所预定的妻。

chapters.en: “Before I finished praying in my heart, Rebekah came out, with her jar on her shoulder. She went down to the spring and drew water, and I said to her, ‘Please give me a drink.’
chapters.zh: 我心里的话还没有说完，利百加就出来，肩头上扛着水瓶，下到井旁打水。我便对她说，请你给我水喝。

chapters.en: “She quickly lowered her jar from her shoulder and said, ‘Drink, and I’ll water your camels too.’ So I drank, and she watered the camels also.
chapters.zh: 她就急忙从肩头上拿下瓶来，说，请喝，我也给你的骆驼喝。我便喝了。她又给我的骆驼喝了。

chapters.en: “I asked her, ‘Whose daughter are you?’ “She said, ‘The daughter of Bethuel son of Nahor, whom Milkah bore to him.’ “Then I put the ring in her nose and the bracelets on her arms,
chapters.zh: 我问她说，你是谁的女儿，她说，我是密迦与拿鹤之子彼土利的女儿。我就把环子戴在她鼻子上，把镯子戴在她两手上。

chapters.en: and I bowed down and worshiped the LORD. I praised the LORD, the God of my master Abraham, who had led me on the right road to get the granddaughter of my master’s brother for his son.
chapters.zh: 随后我低头向耶和华下拜，称颂耶和华我主人亚伯拉罕的神。因为他引导我走合式的道路，使我得着我主人兄弟的孙女，给我主人的儿子为妻。

chapters.en: Now if you will show kindness and faithfulness to my master, tell me; and if not, tell me, so I may know which way to turn.”
chapters.zh: 现在你们若愿以慈爱诚实待我主人，就告诉我。若不然，也告诉我，使我可以或向左，或向右。

chapters.en: Laban and Bethuel answered, “This is from the LORD; we can say nothing to you one way or the other.
chapters.zh: 拉班和彼土利回答说，这事乃出于耶和华，我们不能向你说好说歹。

chapters.en: Here is Rebekah; take her and go, and let her become the wife of your master’s son, as the LORD has directed.”
chapters.zh: 看哪，利百加在你面前，可以将她带去，照着耶和华所说的，给你主人的儿子为妻。

chapters.en: When Abraham’s servant heard what they said, he bowed down to the ground before the LORD.
chapters.zh: 亚伯拉罕的仆人听见他们这话，就向耶和华俯伏在地。

chapters.en: Then the servant brought out gold and silver jewelry and articles of clothing and gave them to Rebekah; he also gave costly gifts to her brother and to her mother.
chapters.zh: 当下仆人拿出金器，银器，和衣服送给利百加，又将宝物送给她哥哥和她母亲。

chapters.en: Then he and the men who were with him ate and drank and spent the night there. When they got up the next morning, he said, “Send me on my way to my master.”
chapters.zh: 仆人和跟从他的人吃了喝了，住了一夜。早晨起来，仆人就说，请打发我回我主人那里去吧。

chapters.en: But her brother and her mother replied, “Let the young woman remain with us ten days or so; then you may go.”
chapters.zh: 利百加的哥哥和她母亲说，让女子同我们再住几天，至少十天，然后她可以去。

chapters.en: But he said to them, “Do not detain me, now that the LORD has granted success to my journey. Send me on my way so I may go to my master.”
chapters.zh: 仆人说，耶和华既赐给我通达的道路，你们不要耽误我，请打发我走，回我主人那里去吧。

chapters.en: Then they said, “Let’s call the young woman and ask her about it.”
chapters.zh: 他们说，我们把女子叫来问问她。

chapters.en: So they called Rebekah and asked her, “Will you go with this man?” “I will go,” she said.
chapters.zh: 就叫了利百加来，问她说，你和这人同去吗？利百加说，我去。

chapters.en: So they sent their sister Rebekah on her way, along with her nurse and Abraham’s servant and his men.
chapters.zh: 于是他们打发妹子利百加和她的乳母，同亚伯拉罕的仆人，并跟从仆人的，都走了。

chapters.en: And they blessed Rebekah and said to her, “Our sister, may you increase to thousands upon thousands; may your offspring possess the cities of their enemies.”
chapters.zh: 他们就给利百加祝福说，我们的妹子阿，愿你作千万人的母。愿你的后裔得着仇敌的城门。

chapters.en: Then Rebekah and her attendants got ready and mounted the camels and went back with the man. So the servant took Rebekah and left.
chapters.zh: 利百加和她的使女们起来，骑上骆驼，跟着那仆人，仆人就带着利百加走了。

chapters.en: Now Isaac had come from Beer Lahai Roi, for he was living in the Negev.
chapters.zh: 那时，以撒住在南地，刚从庇耳拉海莱回来。

chapters.en: He went out to the field one evening to meditate, and as he looked up, he saw camels approaching.
chapters.zh: 天将晚，以撒出来在田间默想，举目一看，见来了些骆驼。

chapters.en: Rebekah also looked up and saw Isaac. She got down from her camel
chapters.zh: 利百加举目看见以撒，就急忙下了骆驼，

chapters.en: and asked the servant, “Who is that man in the field coming to meet us?” “He is my master,” the servant answered. So she took her veil and covered herself.
chapters.zh: 问那仆人说，这田间走来迎接我们的是谁。仆人说，是我的主人。利百加就拿帕子蒙上脸。

chapters.en: Then the servant told Isaac all he had done.
chapters.zh: 仆人就将所办的一切事都告诉以撒。

chapters.en: Isaac brought her into the tent of his mother Sarah, and he married Rebekah. So she became his wife, and he loved her; and Isaac was comforted after his mother’s death.
chapters.zh: 以撒便领利百加进了他母亲撒拉的帐棚，娶了她为妻，并且爱她。以撒自从他母亲不在了，这才得了安慰。

chapters.en: Abraham had taken another wife, whose name was Keturah.
chapters.zh: 亚伯拉罕又娶了一妻，名叫基土拉。

chapters.en: She bore him Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak and Shuah.
chapters.zh: 基土拉给他生了心兰，约珊，米但，米甸，伊施巴，和书亚。

chapters.en: Jokshan was the father of Sheba and Dedan; the descendants of Dedan were the Ashurites, the Letushites and the Leummites.
chapters.zh: 约珊生了示巴和底但。底但的子孙是亚书利族，利都是族，和利乌米族。

chapters.en: The sons of Midian were Ephah, Epher, Hanok, Abida and Eldaah. All these were descendants of Keturah.
chapters.zh: 米甸的儿子是以法，以弗，哈诺，亚比大，和以勒大。这都是基土拉的子孙。

chapters.en: Abraham left everything he owned to Isaac.
chapters.zh: 亚伯拉罕将一切所有的都给了以撒。

chapters.en: But while he was still living, he gave gifts to the sons of his concubines and sent them away from his son Isaac to the land of the east.
chapters.zh: 亚伯拉罕把财物分给他庶出的众子，趁着自己还在世的时候打发他们离开他的儿子以撒，往东方去。

chapters.en: Abraham lived a hundred and seventy-five years.
chapters.zh: 亚伯拉罕一生的年日是一百七十五岁。

chapters.en: Then Abraham breathed his last and died at a good old age, an old man and full of years; and he was gathered to his people.
chapters.zh: 亚伯拉罕寿高年迈，气绝而死，归到他列祖（原文作本民）那里。

chapters.en: His sons Isaac and Ishmael buried him in the cave of Machpelah near Mamre, in the field of Ephron son of Zohar the Hittite,
chapters.zh: 他两个儿子以撒，以实玛利把他埋葬在麦比拉洞里。这洞在幔利前，赫人琐辖的儿子以弗仑的田中，

chapters.en: the field Abraham had bought from the Hittites. There Abraham was buried with his wife Sarah.
chapters.zh: 就是亚伯拉罕向赫人买的那块田。亚伯拉罕和他妻子撒拉都葬在那里。

chapters.en: After Abraham’s death, God blessed his son Isaac, who then lived near Beer Lahai Roi.
chapters.zh: 亚伯拉罕死了以后，神赐福给他的儿子以撒。以撒靠近庇耳拉海莱居住。

chapters.en: This is the account of the family line of Abraham’s son Ishmael, whom Sarah’s slave, Hagar the Egyptian, bore to Abraham.
chapters.zh: 撒拉的使女埃及人夏甲给亚伯拉罕所生的儿子是以实玛利。

chapters.en: These are the names of the sons of Ishmael, listed in the order of their birth: Nebaioth the firstborn of Ishmael, Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam,
chapters.zh: 以实玛利儿子们的名字，按着他们的家谱记在下面。以实玛利的长子是尼拜约，又有基达，亚德别，米比衫，

chapters.en: Mishma, Dumah, Massa,
chapters.zh: 米施玛，度玛，玛撒，

chapters.en: Hadad, Tema, Jetur, Naphish and Kedemah.
chapters.zh: 哈大，提玛，伊突，拿非施，基底玛。

chapters.en: These were the sons of Ishmael, and these are the names of the twelve tribal rulers according to their settlements and camps.
chapters.zh: 这是以实玛利众子的名字，照着他们的村庄，营寨，作了十二族的族长。

chapters.en: Ishmael lived a hundred and thirty-seven years. He breathed his last and died, and he was gathered to his people.
chapters.zh: 以实玛利享寿一百三十七岁，气绝而死，归到他列祖（原文作本民）那里。

chapters.en: His descendants settled in the area from Havilah to Shur, near the eastern border of Egypt, as you go toward Ashur. And they lived in hostility toward all the tribes related to them.
chapters.zh: 他子孙的住处在他众弟兄东边，从哈腓拉直到埃及前的书珥，正在亚述的道上。

chapters.en: This is the account of the family line of Abraham’s son Isaac. Abraham became the father of Isaac,
chapters.zh: 亚伯拉罕的儿子以撒的后代记在下面。亚伯拉罕生以撒。

chapters.en: and Isaac was forty years old when he married Rebekah daughter of Bethuel the Aramean from Paddan Aram and sister of Laban the Aramean.
chapters.zh: 以撒娶利百加为妻的时候正四十岁。利百加是巴旦亚兰地的亚兰人彼土利的女儿，是亚兰人拉班的妹子。

chapters.en: Isaac prayed to the LORD on behalf of his wife, because she was childless. The LORD answered his prayer, and his wife Rebekah became pregnant.
chapters.zh: 以撒因他妻子不生育，就为她祈求耶和华。耶和华应允他的祈求，他的妻子利百加就怀了孕。

chapters.en: The babies jostled each other within her, and she said, “Why is this happening to me?” So she went to inquire of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 孩子们在她腹中彼此相争，她就说，若是这样，我为什么活着呢？（或作我为什么如此呢？）。她就去求问耶和华。

chapters.en: The LORD said to her, “Two nations are in your womb, and two peoples from within you will be separated; one people will be stronger than the other, and the older will serve the younger.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华对她说，两国在你腹内。两族要从你身上出来。这族必强于那族。将来大的要服事小的。

chapters.en: When the time came for her to give birth, there were twin boys in her womb.
chapters.zh: 生产的日子到了，腹中果然是双子。

chapters.en: The first to come out was red, and his whole body was like a hairy garment; so they named him Esau.
chapters.zh: 先产的身体发红，浑身有毛，如同皮衣，他们就给他起名叫以扫（以扫就是有毛的意思）。

chapters.en: After this, his brother came out, with his hand grasping Esau’s heel; so he was named Jacob. Isaac was sixty years old when Rebekah gave birth to them.
chapters.zh: 随后又生了以扫的兄弟，手抓住以扫的脚跟，因此给他起名叫雅各（雅各就是抓住的意思）。利百加生下两个儿子的时候，以撒年正六十岁。

chapters.en: The boys grew up, and Esau became a skillful hunter, a man of the open country, while Jacob was content to stay at home among the tents.
chapters.zh: 两个孩子渐渐长大，以扫善于打猎，常在田野。雅各为人安静，常住在帐棚里。

chapters.en: Isaac, who had a taste for wild game, loved Esau, but Rebekah loved Jacob.
chapters.zh: 以撒爱以扫，因为常吃他的野味。利百加却爱雅各。

chapters.en: Once when Jacob was cooking some stew, Esau came in from the open country, famished.
chapters.zh: 有一天，雅各熬汤，以扫从田野回来累昏了。

chapters.en: He said to Jacob, “Quick, let me have some of that red stew! I’m famished!” (That is why he was also called Edom. )
chapters.zh: 以扫对雅各说，我累昏了，求你把这红汤给我喝。因此以扫又叫以东（以东就是红的意思）。

chapters.en: Jacob replied, “First sell me your birthright.”
chapters.zh: 雅各说，你今日把长子的名分卖给我吧。

chapters.en: “Look, I am about to die,” Esau said. “What good is the birthright to me?”
chapters.zh: 以扫说，我将要死，这长子的名分于我有什么益处呢？

chapters.en: But Jacob said, “Swear to me first.” So he swore an oath to him, selling his birthright to Jacob.
chapters.zh: 雅各说，你今日对我起誓吧。以扫就对他起了誓，把长子的名分卖给雅各。

chapters.en: Then Jacob gave Esau some bread and some lentil stew. He ate and drank, and then got up and left. So Esau despised his birthright.
chapters.zh: 于是雅各将饼和红豆汤给了以扫，以扫吃了喝了，便起来走了。这就是以扫轻看了他长子的名分。

chapters.en: Now there was a famine in the land—besides the previous famine in Abraham’s time—and Isaac went to Abimelek king of the Philistines in Gerar.
chapters.zh: 在亚伯拉罕的日子，那地有一次饥荒。这时又有饥荒，以撒就往基拉耳去，到非利士人的王亚比米勒那里。

chapters.en: The LORD appeared to Isaac and said, “Do not go down to Egypt; live in the land where I tell you to live.
chapters.zh: 耶和华向以撒显现，说，你不要下埃及去，要住在我所指示你的地。

chapters.en: Stay in this land for a while, and I will be with you and will bless you. For to you and your descendants I will give all these lands and will confirm the oath I swore to your father Abraham.
chapters.zh: 你寄居在这地，我必与你同在，赐福给你，因为我要将这些地都赐给你和你的后裔。我必坚定我向你父亚伯拉罕所起的誓。

chapters.en: I will make your descendants as numerous as the stars in the sky and will give them all these lands, and through your offspring all nations on earth will be blessed,
chapters.zh: 我要加增你的后裔，像天上的星那样多，又要将这些地都赐给你的后裔。并且地上万国必因你的后裔得福

chapters.en: because Abraham obeyed me and did everything I required of him, keeping my commands, my decrees and my instructions.”
chapters.zh: 都因亚伯拉罕听从我的话，遵守我的吩咐和我的命令，律例，法度。

chapters.en: So Isaac stayed in Gerar.
chapters.zh: 以撒就住在基拉耳。

chapters.en: When the men of that place asked him about his wife, he said, “She is my sister,” because he was afraid to say, “She is my wife.” He thought, “The men of this place might kill me on account of Rebekah, because she is beautiful.”
chapters.zh: 那地方的人问到他的妻子，他便说，那是我的妹子。原来他怕说，是我的妻子。他心里想，恐怕这地方的人为利百加的缘故杀我，因为她容貌俊美。

chapters.en: When Isaac had been there a long time, Abimelek king of the Philistines looked down from a window and saw Isaac caressing his wife Rebekah.
chapters.zh: 他在那里住了许久。有一天，非利士人的王亚比米勒从窗户里往外观看，见以撒和他的妻子利百加戏玩。

chapters.en: So Abimelek summoned Isaac and said, “She is really your wife! Why did you say, ‘She is my sister’?” Isaac answered him, “Because I thought I might lose my life on account of her.”
chapters.zh: 亚比米勒召了以撒来，对他说，她实在是你的妻子，你怎么说她是你的妹子。以撒说，我心里想，恐怕我因她而死。

chapters.en: Then Abimelek said, “What is this you have done to us? One of the men might well have slept with your wife, and you would have brought guilt upon us.”
chapters.zh: 亚比米勒说，你向我们作的是什么事呢？民中险些有人和你的妻同寝，把我们陷在罪里。

chapters.en: So Abimelek gave orders to all the people: “Anyone who harms this man or his wife shall surely be put to death.”
chapters.zh: 于是亚比米勒晓谕众民说，凡沾着这个人，或是他妻子的，定要把他治死。

chapters.en: Isaac planted crops in that land and the same year reaped a hundredfold, because the LORD blessed him.
chapters.zh: 以撒在那地耕种，那一年有百倍的收成。耶和华赐福给他，

chapters.en: The man became rich, and his wealth continued to grow until he became very wealthy.
chapters.zh: 他就昌大，日增月盛，成了大富户。

chapters.en: He had so many flocks and herds and servants that the Philistines envied him.
chapters.zh: 他有羊群牛群，又有许多仆人，非利士人就嫉妒他。

chapters.en: So all the wells that his father’s servants had dug in the time of his father Abraham, the Philistines stopped up, filling them with earth.
chapters.zh: 当他父亲亚伯拉罕在世的日子，他父亲的仆人所挖的井，非利士人全都塞住，填满了土。

chapters.en: Then Abimelek said to Isaac, “Move away from us; you have become too powerful for us.”
chapters.zh: 亚比米勒对以撒说，你离开我们去吧。因为你比我们强盛得多。

chapters.en: So Isaac moved away from there and encamped in the Valley of Gerar, where he settled.
chapters.zh: 以撒就离开那里，在基拉耳谷支搭帐棚，住在那里。

chapters.en: Isaac reopened the wells that had been dug in the time of his father Abraham, which the Philistines had stopped up after Abraham died, and he gave them the same names his father had given them.
chapters.zh: 当他父亲亚伯拉罕在世之日所挖的水井因非利士人在亚伯拉罕死后塞住了，以撒就重新挖出来，仍照他父亲所叫的叫那些井的名字。

chapters.en: Isaac’s servants dug in the valley and discovered a well of fresh water there.
chapters.zh: 以撒的仆人在谷中挖井，便得了一口活水井。

chapters.en: But the herders of Gerar quarreled with those of Isaac and said, “The water is ours!” So he named the well Esek, because they disputed with him.
chapters.zh: 基拉耳的牧人与以撒的牧人争竞，说，这水是我们的。以撒就给那井起名叫埃色，因为他们和他相争（埃色就是相争的意思）。

chapters.en: Then they dug another well, but they quarreled over that one also; so he named it Sitnah.
chapters.zh: 以撒的仆人又挖了一口井，他们又为这井争竞，因此以撒给这井起名叫西提拿（西提拿就是为敌的意思）。

chapters.en: He moved on from there and dug another well, and no one quarreled over it. He named it Rehoboth, saying, “Now the LORD has given us room and we will flourish in the land.”
chapters.zh: 以撒离开那里，又挖了一口井，他们不为这井争竞了，他就给那井起名叫利河伯（就是宽阔的意思）。他说，耶和华现在给我们宽阔之地，我们必在这地昌盛。

chapters.en: From there he went up to Beersheba.
chapters.zh: 以撒从那里上别是巴去。

chapters.en: That night the LORD appeared to him and said, “I am the God of your father Abraham. Do not be afraid, for I am with you; I will bless you and will increase the number of your descendants for the sake of my servant Abraham.”
chapters.zh: 当夜耶和华向他显现，说，我是你父亲亚伯拉罕的神，不要惧怕，因为我与你同在，要赐福给你，并要为我仆人亚伯拉罕的缘故，使你的后裔繁多。

chapters.en: Isaac built an altar there and called on the name of the LORD. There he pitched his tent, and there his servants dug a well.
chapters.zh: 以撒就在那里筑了一座坛，求告耶和华的名，并且支搭帐棚。他的仆人便在那里挖了一口井。

chapters.en: Meanwhile, Abimelek had come to him from Gerar, with Ahuzzath his personal adviser and Phicol the commander of his forces.
chapters.zh: 亚比米勒，同他的朋友亚户撒和他的军长非各，从基拉耳来见以撒。

chapters.en: Isaac asked them, “Why have you come to me, since you were hostile to me and sent me away?”
chapters.zh: 以撒对他们说，你们既然恨我，打发我走了，为什么到我这里来呢？

chapters.en: They answered, “We saw clearly that the LORD was with you; so we said, ‘There ought to be a sworn agreement between us’—between us and you. Let us make a treaty with you
chapters.zh: 他们说，我们明明地看见耶和华与你同在，便说，不如我们两下彼此起誓，彼此立约，

chapters.en: that you will do us no harm, just as we did not harm you but always treated you well and sent you away peacefully. And now you are blessed by the LORD.”
chapters.zh: 使你不害我们，正如我们未曾害你，一味地厚待你，并且打发你平平安安地走。你是蒙耶和华赐福的了。

chapters.en: Isaac then made a feast for them, and they ate and drank.
chapters.zh: 以撒就为他们设摆筵席，他们便吃了喝了。

chapters.en: Early the next morning the men swore an oath to each other. Then Isaac sent them on their way, and they went away peacefully.
chapters.zh: 他们清早起来彼此起誓。以撒打发他们走，他们就平平安安地离开他走了。

chapters.en: That day Isaac’s servants came and told him about the well they had dug. They said, “We’ve found water!”
chapters.zh: 那一天，以撒的仆人来，将挖井的事告诉他说，我们得了水了。

chapters.en: He called it Shibah, and to this day the name of the town has been Beersheba.
chapters.zh: 他就给那井起名叫示巴。因此那城叫作别是巴，直到今日。

chapters.en: When Esau was forty years old, he married Judith daughter of Beeri the Hittite, and also Basemath daughter of Elon the Hittite.
chapters.zh: 以扫四十岁的时候娶了赫人比利的女儿犹滴，与赫人以伦的女儿巴实抹为妻。

chapters.en: They were a source of grief to Isaac and Rebekah.
chapters.zh: 她们常使以撒和利百加心里愁烦。

chapters.en: When Isaac was old and his eyes were so weak that he could no longer see, he called for Esau his older son and said to him, “My son.” “Here I am,” he answered.
chapters.zh: 以撒年老，眼睛昏花，不能看见，就叫了他大儿子以扫来，说，我儿，以扫说，我在这里。

chapters.en: Isaac said, “I am now an old man and don’t know the day of my death.
chapters.zh: 他说，我如今老了，不知道哪一天死。

chapters.en: Now then, get your equipment—your quiver and bow—and go out to the open country to hunt some wild game for me.
chapters.zh: 现在拿你的器械，就是箭囊和弓，往田野去为我打猎，

chapters.en: Prepare me the kind of tasty food I like and bring it to me to eat, so that I may give you my blessing before I die.”
chapters.zh: 照我所爱的作成美味，拿来给我吃，使我在未死之先给你祝福。

chapters.en: Now Rebekah was listening as Isaac spoke to his son Esau. When Esau left for the open country to hunt game and bring it back,
chapters.zh: 以撒对他儿子以扫说话，利百加也听见了。以扫往田野去打猎，要得野味带来。

chapters.en: Rebekah said to her son Jacob, “Look, I overheard your father say to your brother Esau,
chapters.zh: 利百加就对她儿子雅各说，我听见你父亲对你哥哥以扫说，

chapters.en: ‘Bring me some game and prepare me some tasty food to eat, so that I may give you my blessing in the presence of the LORD before I die.’
chapters.zh: 你去把野兽带来，作成美味给我吃，我好在未死之先，在耶和华面前给你祝福。

chapters.en: Now, my son, listen carefully and do what I tell you:
chapters.zh: 现在，我儿，你要照着我所吩咐你的，听从我的话。

chapters.en: Go out to the flock and bring me two choice young goats, so I can prepare some tasty food for your father, just the way he likes it.
chapters.zh: 你到羊群里去，给我拿两只肥山羊羔来，我便照你父亲所爱的给他作成美味。

chapters.en: Then take it to your father to eat, so that he may give you his blessing before he dies.”
chapters.zh: 你拿到你父亲那里给他吃，使他在未死之先给你祝福。

chapters.en: Jacob said to Rebekah his mother, “But my brother Esau is a hairy man while I have smooth skin.
chapters.zh: 雅各对他母亲利百加说，我哥哥以扫浑身是有毛的，我身上是光滑的。

chapters.en: What if my father touches me? I would appear to be tricking him and would bring down a curse on myself rather than a blessing.”
chapters.zh: 倘若我父亲摸着我，必以我为欺哄人的，我就招咒诅，不得祝福。

chapters.en: His mother said to him, “My son, let the curse fall on me. Just do what I say; go and get them for me.”
chapters.zh: 他母亲对他说，我儿，你招的咒诅归到我身上。你只管听我的话，去把羊羔给我拿来。

chapters.en: So he went and got them and brought them to his mother, and she prepared some tasty food, just the way his father liked it.
chapters.zh: 他便去拿来，交给他母亲。他母亲就照他父亲所爱的作成美味。

chapters.en: Then Rebekah took the best clothes of Esau her older son, which she had in the house, and put them on her younger son Jacob.
chapters.zh: 利百加又把家里所存大儿子以扫上好的衣服给他小儿子雅各穿上，

chapters.en: She also covered his hands and the smooth part of his neck with the goatskins.
chapters.zh: 又用山羊羔皮包在雅各的手上和颈项的光滑处，

chapters.en: Then she handed to her son Jacob the tasty food and the bread she had made.
chapters.zh: 就把所作的美味和饼交在他儿子雅各的手里。

chapters.en: He went to his father and said, “My father.” “Yes, my son,” he answered. “Who is it?”
chapters.zh: 雅各到他父亲那里说，我父亲。他说，我在这里。我儿，你是谁。

chapters.en: Jacob said to his father, “I am Esau your firstborn. I have done as you told me. Please sit up and eat some of my game, so that you may give me your blessing.”
chapters.zh: 雅各对他父亲说，我是你的长子以扫。我已照你所吩咐我的行了。请起来坐着，吃我的野味，好给我祝福。

chapters.en: Isaac asked his son, “How did you find it so quickly, my son?” “The LORD your God gave me success,” he replied.
chapters.zh: 以撒对他儿子说，我儿，你如何找得这么快呢？他说，因为耶和华你的神使我遇见好机会得着的。

chapters.en: Then Isaac said to Jacob, “Come near so I can touch you, my son, to know whether you really are my son Esau or not.”
chapters.zh: 以撒对雅各说，我儿，你近前来，我摸摸你，知道你真是我的儿子以扫不是。

chapters.en: Jacob went close to his father Isaac, who touched him and said, “The voice is the voice of Jacob, but the hands are the hands of Esau.”
chapters.zh: 雅各就挨近他父亲以撒。以撒摸着他，说，声音是雅各的声音，手却是以扫的手。

chapters.en: He did not recognize him, for his hands were hairy like those of his brother Esau; so he proceeded to bless him.
chapters.zh: 以撒就辨不出他来。因为他手上有毛，像他哥哥以扫的手一样，就给他祝福。

chapters.en: “Are you really my son Esau?” he asked. “I am,” he replied.
chapters.zh: 又说，你真是我儿子以扫吗？他说，我是。

chapters.en: Then he said, “My son, bring me some of your game to eat, so that I may give you my blessing.” Jacob brought it to him and he ate; and he brought some wine and he drank.
chapters.zh: 以撒说，你递给我，我好吃我儿子的野味，给你祝福。雅各就递给他，他便吃了，又拿酒给他，他也喝了。

chapters.en: Then his father Isaac said to him, “Come here, my son, and kiss me.”
chapters.zh: 他父亲以撒对他说，我儿，你上前来与我亲嘴。

chapters.en: So he went to him and kissed him. When Isaac caught the smell of his clothes, he blessed him and said, “Ah, the smell of my son is like the smell of a field that the LORD has blessed.
chapters.zh: 他就上前与父亲亲嘴。他父亲一闻他衣服上的香气，就给他祝福，说，我儿的香气如同耶和华赐福之田地的香气一样。

chapters.en: May God give you heaven’s dew and earth’s richness— an abundance of grain and new wine.
chapters.zh: 愿神赐你天上的甘露，地上的肥土，并许多五谷新酒。

chapters.en: May nations serve you and peoples bow down to you. Be lord over your brothers, and may the sons of your mother bow down to you. May those who curse you be cursed and those who bless you be blessed.”
chapters.zh: 愿多民事奉你，多国跪拜你。愿你作你弟兄的主。你母亲的儿子向你跪拜。凡咒诅你的，愿他受咒诅。为你祝福的，愿他蒙福。

chapters.en: After Isaac finished blessing him, and Jacob had scarcely left his father’s presence, his brother Esau came in from hunting.
chapters.zh: 以撒为雅各祝福已毕，雅各从他父亲那里才出来，他哥哥以扫正打猎回来，

chapters.en: He too prepared some tasty food and brought it to his father. Then he said to him, “My father, please sit up and eat some of my game, so that you may give me your blessing.”
chapters.zh: 也作了美味，拿来给他父亲，说，请父亲起来，吃你儿子的野味，好给我祝福。

chapters.en: His father Isaac asked him, “Who are you?” “I am your son,” he answered, “your firstborn, Esau.”
chapters.zh: 他父亲以撒对他说，你是谁？他说，我是你的长子以扫。

chapters.en: Isaac trembled violently and said, “Who was it, then, that hunted game and brought it to me? I ate it just before you came and I blessed him—and indeed he will be blessed!”
chapters.zh: 以撒就大大地战兢，说，你未来之先，是谁得了野味拿来给我呢？我已经吃了，为他祝福。他将来也必蒙福。

chapters.en: When Esau heard his father’s words, he burst out with a loud and bitter cry and said to his father, “Bless me—me too, my father!”
chapters.zh: 以扫听了他父亲的话，就放声痛哭，说，我父阿，求你也为我祝福。

chapters.en: But he said, “Your brother came deceitfully and took your blessing.”
chapters.zh: 以撒说，你兄弟已经用诡计来将你的福分夺去了。

chapters.en: Esau said, “Isn’t he rightly named Jacob ? This is the second time he has taken advantage of me: He took my birthright, and now he’s taken my blessing!” Then he asked, “Haven’t you reserved any blessing for me?”
chapters.zh: 以扫说，他名雅各，岂不是正对吗？因为他欺骗了我两次。他从前夺了我长子的名分，你看，他现在又夺了我的福分。以扫又说，你没有留下为我可祝的福吗？

chapters.en: Isaac answered Esau, “I have made him lord over you and have made all his relatives his servants, and I have sustained him with grain and new wine. So what can I possibly do for you, my son?”
chapters.zh: 以撒回答以扫说，我已立他为你的主，使他的弟兄都给他作仆人，并赐他五谷新酒可以养生。我儿，现在我还能为你作什么呢？

chapters.en: Esau said to his father, “Do you have only one blessing, my father? Bless me too, my father!” Then Esau wept aloud.
chapters.zh: 以扫对他父亲说，父阿，你只有一样可祝的福吗？我父阿，求你也为我祝福。以扫就放声而哭。

chapters.en: His father Isaac answered him, “Your dwelling will be away from the earth’s richness, away from the dew of heaven above.
chapters.zh: 他父亲以撒说，地上的肥土必为你所住。天上的甘露必为你所得。

chapters.en: You will live by the sword and you will serve your brother. But when you grow restless, you will throw his yoke from off your neck.”
chapters.zh: 你必倚靠刀剑度日，又必事奉你的兄弟。到你强盛的时候，必从你颈项上挣开他的轭。

chapters.en: Esau held a grudge against Jacob because of the blessing his father had given him. He said to himself, “The days of mourning for my father are near; then I will kill my brother Jacob.”
chapters.zh: 以扫因他父亲给雅各祝的福，就怨恨雅各，心里说，为我父亲居丧的日子近了，到那时候，我要杀我的兄弟雅各。

chapters.en: When Rebekah was told what her older son Esau had said, she sent for her younger son Jacob and said to him, “Your brother Esau is planning to avenge himself by killing you.
chapters.zh: 有人把利百加大儿子以扫的话告诉利百加，她就打发人去，叫了她小儿子雅各来，对他说，你哥哥以扫想要杀你，报仇雪恨。

chapters.en: Now then, my son, do what I say: Flee at once to my brother Laban in Harran.
chapters.zh: 现在，我儿，你要听我的话，起来，逃往哈兰，我哥哥拉班那里去，

chapters.en: Stay with him for a while until your brother’s fury subsides.
chapters.zh: 同他住些日子，直等你哥哥的怒气消了。

chapters.en: When your brother is no longer angry with you and forgets what you did to him, I’ll send word for you to come back from there. Why should I lose both of you in one day?”
chapters.zh: 你哥哥向你消了怒气，忘了你向他所作的事，我便打发人去把你从那里带回来。为什么一日丧你们二人呢？

chapters.en: Then Rebekah said to Isaac, “I’m disgusted with living because of these Hittite women. If Jacob takes a wife from among the women of this land, from Hittite women like these, my life will not be worth living.”
chapters.zh: 利百加对以撒说，我因这赫人的女子连性命都厌烦了。倘若雅各也娶赫人的女子为妻，像这些一样，我活着还有什么益处呢？

chapters.en: So Isaac called for Jacob and blessed him. Then he commanded him: “Do not marry a Canaanite woman.
chapters.zh: 以撒叫了雅各来，给他祝福，并嘱咐他说，你不要娶迦南的女子为妻。

chapters.en: Go at once to Paddan Aram, to the house of your mother’s father Bethuel. Take a wife for yourself there, from among the daughters of Laban, your mother’s brother.
chapters.zh: 你起身往巴旦亚兰去，到你外祖彼土利家里，在你母舅拉班的女儿中娶一女为妻。

chapters.en: May God Almighty bless you and make you fruitful and increase your numbers until you become a community of peoples.
chapters.zh: 愿全能的神赐福给你，使你生养众多，成为多族，

chapters.en: May he give you and your descendants the blessing given to Abraham, so that you may take possession of the land where you now reside as a foreigner, the land God gave to Abraham.”
chapters.zh: 将应许亚伯拉罕的福赐给你和你的后裔，使你承受你所寄居的地为业，就是神赐给亚伯拉罕的地。

chapters.en: Then Isaac sent Jacob on his way, and he went to Paddan Aram, to Laban son of Bethuel the Aramean, the brother of Rebekah, who was the mother of Jacob and Esau.
chapters.zh: 以撒打发雅各走了，他就往巴旦亚兰去，到亚兰人彼土利的儿子拉班那里。拉班是雅各，以扫的母舅。

chapters.en: Now Esau learned that Isaac had blessed Jacob and had sent him to Paddan Aram to take a wife from there, and that when he blessed him he commanded him, “Do not marry a Canaanite woman,”
chapters.zh: 以扫见以撒已经给雅各祝福，而且打发他往巴旦亚兰去，在那里娶妻，并见祝福的时候嘱咐他说，不要娶迦南的女子为妻，

chapters.en: and that Jacob had obeyed his father and mother and had gone to Paddan Aram.
chapters.zh: 又见雅各听从父母的话往巴旦亚兰去了，

chapters.en: Esau then realized how displeasing the Canaanite women were to his father Isaac;
chapters.zh: 以扫就晓得他父亲以撒看不中迦南的女子，

chapters.en: so he went to Ishmael and married Mahalath, the sister of Nebaioth and daughter of Ishmael son of Abraham, in addition to the wives he already had.
chapters.zh: 便往以实玛利那里去，在他二妻之外又娶了玛哈拉为妻。他是亚伯拉罕儿子以实玛利的女儿，尼拜约的妹子。

chapters.en: Jacob left Beersheba and set out for Harran.
chapters.zh: 雅各出了别是巴，向哈兰走去。

chapters.en: When he reached a certain place, he stopped for the night because the sun had set. Taking one of the stones there, he put it under his head and lay down to sleep.
chapters.zh: 到了一个地方，因为太阳落了，就在那里住宿，便拾起那地方的一块石头枕在头下，在那里躺卧睡了，

chapters.en: He had a dream in which he saw a stairway resting on the earth, with its top reaching to heaven, and the angels of God were ascending and descending on it.
chapters.zh: 梦见一个梯子立在地上，梯子的头顶着天，有神的使者在梯子上，上去下来。

chapters.en: There above it stood the LORD, and he said: “I am the LORD, the God of your father Abraham and the God of Isaac. I will give you and your descendants the land on which you are lying.
chapters.zh: 耶和华站在梯子以上（或作站在他旁边），说，我是耶和华你祖亚伯拉罕的神，也是以撒的神。我要将你现在所躺卧之地赐给你和你的后裔。

chapters.en: Your descendants will be like the dust of the earth, and you will spread out to the west and to the east, to the north and to the south. All peoples on earth will be blessed through you and your offspring.
chapters.zh: 你的后裔必像地上的尘沙那样多，必向东西南北开展。地上万族必因你和你的后裔得福。

chapters.en: I am with you and will watch over you wherever you go, and I will bring you back to this land. I will not leave you until I have done what I have promised you.”
chapters.zh: 我也与你同在。你无论往哪里去，我必保佑你，领你归回这地，总不离弃你，直到我成全了向你所应许的。

chapters.en: When Jacob awoke from his sleep, he thought, “Surely the LORD is in this place, and I was not aware of it.”
chapters.zh: 雅各睡醒了，说，耶和华真在这里，我竟不知道。

chapters.en: He was afraid and said, “How awesome is this place! This is none other than the house of God; this is the gate of heaven.”
chapters.zh: 就惧怕，说，这地方何等可畏，这不是别的，乃是神的殿，也是天的门。

chapters.en: Early the next morning Jacob took the stone he had placed under his head and set it up as a pillar and poured oil on top of it.
chapters.zh: 雅各清早起来，把所枕的石头立作柱子，浇油在上面。

chapters.en: He called that place Bethel, though the city used to be called Luz.
chapters.zh: 他就给那地方起名叫伯特利（就是神殿的意思）。但那地方起先名叫路斯。

chapters.en: Then Jacob made a vow, saying, “If God will be with me and will watch over me on this journey I am taking and will give me food to eat and clothes to wear
chapters.zh: 雅各许愿说，神若与我同在，在我所行的路上保佑我，又给我食物吃，衣服穿，

chapters.en: so that I return safely to my father’s household, then the LORD will be my God
chapters.zh: 使我平平安安地回到我父亲的家，我就必以耶和华为我的神。

chapters.en: and this stone that I have set up as a pillar will be God’s house, and of all that you give me I will give you a tenth.”
chapters.zh: 我所立为柱子的石头也必作神的殿，凡你所赐给我的，我必将十分之一献给你。

chapters.en: Then Jacob continued on his journey and came to the land of the eastern peoples.
chapters.zh: 雅各起行，到了东方人之地，

chapters.en: There he saw a well in the open country, with three flocks of sheep lying near it because the flocks were watered from that well. The stone over the mouth of the well was large.
chapters.zh: 看见田间有一口井，有三群羊卧在井旁。因为人饮羊群都是用那井里的水。井口上的石头是大的。

chapters.en: When all the flocks were gathered there, the shepherds would roll the stone away from the well’s mouth and water the sheep. Then they would return the stone to its place over the mouth of the well.
chapters.zh: 常有羊群在那里聚集，牧人把石头转离井口饮羊，随后又把石头放在井口的原处。

chapters.en: Jacob asked the shepherds, “My brothers, where are you from?” “We’re from Harran,” they replied.
chapters.zh: 雅各对牧人说，弟兄们，你们是哪里来的，他们说，我们是哈兰来的。

chapters.en: He said to them, “Do you know Laban, Nahor’s grandson?” “Yes, we know him,” they answered.
chapters.zh: 他问他们说，拿鹤的孙子拉班，你们认识吗？他们说，我们认识。

chapters.en: Then Jacob asked them, “Is he well?” “Yes, he is,” they said, “and here comes his daughter Rachel with the sheep.”
chapters.zh: 雅各说，他平安吗？他们说，平安。看哪，他女儿拉结领着羊来了。

chapters.en: “Look,” he said, “the sun is still high; it is not time for the flocks to be gathered. Water the sheep and take them back to pasture.”
chapters.zh: 雅各说，日头还高，不是羊群聚集的时候，你们不如饮羊，再去放一放。

chapters.en: “We can’t,” they replied, “until all the flocks are gathered and the stone has been rolled away from the mouth of the well. Then we will water the sheep.”
chapters.zh: 他们说，我们不能，必等羊群聚齐，人把石头转离井口才可饮羊。

chapters.en: While he was still talking with them, Rachel came with her father’s sheep, for she was a shepherd.
chapters.zh: 雅各正和他们说话的时候，拉结领着她父亲的羊来了，因为那些羊是她牧放的。

chapters.en: When Jacob saw Rachel daughter of his uncle Laban, and Laban’s sheep, he went over and rolled the stone away from the mouth of the well and watered his uncle’s sheep.
chapters.zh: 雅各看见母舅拉班的女儿拉结和母舅拉班的羊群，就上前把石头转离井口，饮他母舅拉班的羊群。

chapters.en: Then Jacob kissed Rachel and began to weep aloud.
chapters.zh: 雅各与拉结亲嘴，就放声而哭。

chapters.en: He had told Rachel that he was a relative of her father and a son of Rebekah. So she ran and told her father.
chapters.zh: 雅各告诉拉结，自己是她父亲的外甥，是利百加的儿子，拉结就跑去告诉她父亲。

chapters.en: As soon as Laban heard the news about Jacob, his sister’s son, he hurried to meet him. He embraced him and kissed him and brought him to his home, and there Jacob told him all these things.
chapters.zh: 拉班听见外甥雅各的信息，就跑去迎接，抱着他，与他亲嘴，领他到自己的家。雅各将一切的情由告诉拉班。

chapters.en: Then Laban said to him, “You are my own flesh and blood.” After Jacob had stayed with him for a whole month,
chapters.zh: 拉班对他说，你实在是我的骨肉。雅各就和他同住了一个月。

chapters.en: Laban said to him, “Just because you are a relative of mine, should you work for me for nothing? Tell me what your wages should be.”
chapters.zh: 拉班对雅各说，你虽是我的骨肉（原文作弟兄），岂可白白地服事我？请告诉我，你要什么为工价？

chapters.en: Now Laban had two daughters; the name of the older was Leah, and the name of the younger was Rachel.
chapters.zh: 拉班有两个女儿，大的名叫利亚，小的名叫拉结。

chapters.en: Leah had weak eyes, but Rachel had a lovely figure and was beautiful.
chapters.zh: 利亚的眼睛没有神气，拉结却生得美貌俊秀。

chapters.en: Jacob was in love with Rachel and said, “I’ll work for you seven years in return for your younger daughter Rachel.”
chapters.zh: 雅各爱拉结，就说，我愿为你小女儿拉结服事你七年。

chapters.en: Laban said, “It’s better that I give her to you than to some other man. Stay here with me.”
chapters.zh: 拉班说，我把她给你，胜似给别人，你与我同住吧。

chapters.en: So Jacob served seven years to get Rachel, but they seemed like only a few days to him because of his love for her.
chapters.zh: 雅各就为拉结服事了七年。他因为深爱拉结，就看这七年如同几天。

chapters.en: Then Jacob said to Laban, “Give me my wife. My time is completed, and I want to make love to her.”
chapters.zh: 雅各对拉班说，日期已经满了，求你把我的妻子给我，我好与她同房。

chapters.en: So Laban brought together all the people of the place and gave a feast.
chapters.zh: 拉班就摆设筵席，请齐了那地方的众人。

chapters.en: But when evening came, he took his daughter Leah and brought her to Jacob, and Jacob made love to her.
chapters.zh: 到晚上，拉班将女儿利亚送来给雅各，雅各就与她同房。

chapters.en: And Laban gave his servant Zilpah to his daughter as her attendant.
chapters.zh: 拉班又将婢女悉帕给女儿利亚作使女。

chapters.en: When morning came, there was Leah! So Jacob said to Laban, “What is this you have done to me? I served you for Rachel, didn’t I? Why have you deceived me?”
chapters.zh: 到了早晨，雅各一看是利亚，就对拉班说，你向我作的是什么事呢？我服事你，不是为拉结吗？你为什么欺哄我呢？

chapters.en: Laban replied, “It is not our custom here to give the younger daughter in marriage before the older one.
chapters.zh: 拉班说，大女儿还没有给人，先把小女儿给人，在我们这地方没有这规矩。

chapters.en: Finish this daughter’s bridal week; then we will give you the younger one also, in return for another seven years of work.”
chapters.zh: 你为这个满了七日，我就把那个也给你，你再为她服事我七年。

chapters.en: And Jacob did so. He finished the week with Leah, and then Laban gave him his daughter Rachel to be his wife.
chapters.zh: 雅各就如此行。满了利亚的七日，拉班便将女儿拉结给雅各为妻。

chapters.en: Laban gave his servant Bilhah to his daughter Rachel as her attendant.
chapters.zh: 拉班又将婢女辟拉给女儿拉结作使女。

chapters.en: Jacob made love to Rachel also, and his love for Rachel was greater than his love for Leah. And he worked for Laban another seven years.
chapters.zh: 雅各也与拉结同房，并且爱拉结胜似爱利亚，于是又服事了拉班七年。

chapters.en: When the LORD saw that Leah was not loved, he enabled her to conceive, but Rachel remained childless.
chapters.zh: 耶和华见利亚失宠（原文作被恨下同），就使她生育，拉结却不生育。

chapters.en: Leah became pregnant and gave birth to a son. She named him Reuben, for she said, “It is because the LORD has seen my misery. Surely my husband will love me now.”
chapters.zh: 利亚怀孕生子，就给他起名叫流便（就是有儿子的意思），因而说，耶和华看见我的苦情，如今我的丈夫必爱我。

chapters.en: She conceived again, and when she gave birth to a son she said, “Because the LORD heard that I am not loved, he gave me this one too.” So she named him Simeon.
chapters.zh: 她又怀孕生子，就说，耶和华因为听见我失宠，所以又赐给我这个儿子。于是给他起名叫西缅（就是听见的意思）。

chapters.en: Again she conceived, and when she gave birth to a son she said, “Now at last my husband will become attached to me, because I have borne him three sons.” So he was named Levi.
chapters.zh: 她又怀孕生子，起名叫利未（就是联合的意思），说，我给丈夫生了三个儿子，他必与我联合。

chapters.en: She conceived again, and when she gave birth to a son she said, “This time I will praise the LORD.” So she named him Judah. Then she stopped having children.
chapters.zh: 她又怀孕生子，说，这回我要赞美耶和华，因此给他起名叫犹大（就是赞美的意思）。这才停了生育。

chapters.en: When Rachel saw that she was not bearing Jacob any children, she became jealous of her sister. So she said to Jacob, “Give me children, or I’ll die!”
chapters.zh: 拉结见自己不给雅各生子，就嫉妒她姐姐，对雅各说，你给我孩子，不然我就死了。

chapters.en: Jacob became angry with her and said, “Am I in the place of God, who has kept you from having children?”
chapters.zh: 雅各向拉结生气，说，叫你不生育的是神，我岂能代替他作主呢？

chapters.en: Then she said, “Here is Bilhah, my servant. Sleep with her so that she can bear children for me and I too can build a family through her.”
chapters.zh: 拉结说，有我的使女辟拉在这里，你可以与她同房，使她生子在我膝下，我便因她也得孩子（得孩子原文作被建立）。

chapters.en: So she gave him her servant Bilhah as a wife. Jacob slept with her,
chapters.zh: 拉结就把她的使女辟拉给丈夫为妾。雅各便与她同房，

chapters.en: and she became pregnant and bore him a son.
chapters.zh: 辟拉就怀孕，给雅各生了一个儿子。

chapters.en: Then Rachel said, “God has vindicated me; he has listened to my plea and given me a son.” Because of this she named him Dan.
chapters.zh: 拉结说，神伸了我的冤，也听了我的声音，赐我一个儿子，因此给他起名叫但（就是伸冤的意思）。

chapters.en: Rachel’s servant Bilhah conceived again and bore Jacob a second son.
chapters.zh: 拉结的使女辟拉又怀孕，给雅各生了第二个儿子。

chapters.en: Then Rachel said, “I have had a great struggle with my sister, and I have won.” So she named him Naphtali.
chapters.zh: 拉结说，我与我姐姐大大相争，并且得胜，于是给他起名叫拿弗他利（就是相争的意思）。

chapters.en: When Leah saw that she had stopped having children, she took her servant Zilpah and gave her to Jacob as a wife.
chapters.zh: 利亚见自己停了生育，就把使女悉帕给雅各为妾。

chapters.en: Leah’s servant Zilpah bore Jacob a son.
chapters.zh: 利亚的使女悉帕给雅各生了一个儿子。

chapters.en: Then Leah said, “What good fortune!” So she named him Gad.
chapters.zh: 利亚说，万幸，于是给他起名叫迦得（就是万幸的意思）。

chapters.en: Leah’s servant Zilpah bore Jacob a second son.
chapters.zh: 利亚的使女悉帕又给雅各生了第二个儿子。

chapters.en: Then Leah said, “How happy I am! The women will call me happy.” So she named him Asher.
chapters.zh: 利亚说，我有福阿，众女子都要称我是有福的，于是给他起名叫亚设（就是有福的意思）。

chapters.en: During wheat harvest, Reuben went out into the fields and found some mandrake plants, which he brought to his mother Leah. Rachel said to Leah, “Please give me some of your son’s mandrakes.”
chapters.zh: 割麦子的时候，流便往田里去，寻见风茄，拿来给他母亲利亚。拉结对利亚说，请你把你儿子的风茄给我些。

chapters.en: But she said to her, “Wasn’t it enough that you took away my husband? Will you take my son’s mandrakes too?” “Very well,” Rachel said, “he can sleep with you tonight in return for your son’s mandrakes.”
chapters.zh: 利亚说，你夺了我的丈夫还算小事吗？你又要夺我儿子的风茄吗？拉结说，为你儿子的风茄，今夜他可以与你同寝。

chapters.en: So when Jacob came in from the fields that evening, Leah went out to meet him. “You must sleep with me,” she said. “I have hired you with my son’s mandrakes.” So he slept with her that night.
chapters.zh: 到了晚上，雅各从田里回来，利亚出来迎接他，说，你要与我同寝，因为我实在用我儿子的风茄把你雇下了。那一夜，雅各就与她同寝。

chapters.en: God listened to Leah, and she became pregnant and bore Jacob a fifth son.
chapters.zh: 神应允了利亚，她就怀孕，给雅各生了第五个儿子。

chapters.en: Then Leah said, “God has rewarded me for giving my servant to my husband.” So she named him Issachar.
chapters.zh: 利亚说，神给了我价值，因为我把使女给了我丈夫。于是给他起名叫以萨迦（就是价值的意思）。

chapters.en: Leah conceived again and bore Jacob a sixth son.
chapters.zh: 利亚又怀孕，给雅各生了第六个儿子。

chapters.en: Then Leah said, “God has presented me with a precious gift. This time my husband will treat me with honor, because I have borne him six sons.” So she named him Zebulun.
chapters.zh: 利亚说，神赐我厚赏。我丈夫必与我同住，因我给他生了六个儿子。于是给他起名西布伦（就是同住的意思）。

chapters.en: Some time later she gave birth to a daughter and named her Dinah.
chapters.zh: 后来又生了一个女儿，给她起名叫底拿。

chapters.en: Then God remembered Rachel; he listened to her and enabled her to conceive.
chapters.zh: 神顾念拉结，应允了她，使她能生育。

chapters.en: She became pregnant and gave birth to a son and said, “God has taken away my disgrace.”
chapters.zh: 拉结怀孕生子，说，神除去了我的羞耻。

chapters.en: She named him Joseph, and said, “May the LORD add to me another son.”
chapters.zh: 就给他起名叫约瑟（就是增添的意思），意思说，愿耶和华再增添我一个儿子。

chapters.en: After Rachel gave birth to Joseph, Jacob said to Laban, “Send me on my way so I can go back to my own homeland.
chapters.zh: 拉结生约瑟之后，雅各对拉班说，请打发我走，叫我回到我本乡本土去。

chapters.en: Give me my wives and children, for whom I have served you, and I will be on my way. You know how much work I’ve done for you.”
chapters.zh: 请你把我服事你所得的妻子和儿女给我，让我走。我怎样服事你，你都知道。

chapters.en: But Laban said to him, “If I have found favor in your eyes, please stay. I have learned by divination that the LORD has blessed me because of you.”
chapters.zh: 拉班对他说，我若在你眼前蒙恩，请你仍与我同住，因为我已算定，耶和华赐福与我是为你的缘故。

chapters.en: He added, “Name your wages, and I will pay them.”
chapters.zh: 又说，请你定你的工价，我就给你。

chapters.en: Jacob said to him, “You know how I have worked for you and how your livestock has fared under my care.
chapters.zh: 雅各对他说，我怎样服事你，你的牲畜在我手里怎样，是你知道的。

chapters.en: The little you had before I came has increased greatly, and the LORD has blessed you wherever I have been. But now, when may I do something for my own household?”
chapters.zh: 我未来之先，你所有的很少，现今却发大众多，耶和华随我的脚步赐福与你。如今，我什么时候才为自己兴家立业呢？

chapters.en: “What shall I give you?” he asked. “Don’t give me anything,” Jacob replied. “But if you will do this one thing for me, I will go on tending your flocks and watching over them:
chapters.zh: 拉班说，我当给你什么呢？雅各说，什么你也不必给我，只有一件事，你若应承，我便仍旧牧放你的羊群。

chapters.en: Let me go through all your flocks today and remove from them every speckled or spotted sheep, every dark-colored lamb and every spotted or speckled goat. They will be my wages.
chapters.zh: 今天我要走遍你的羊群，把绵羊中凡有点的，有斑的，和黑色的，并山羊中凡有斑的，有点的，都挑出来。将来这一等的就算我的工价。

chapters.en: And my honesty will testify for me in the future, whenever you check on the wages you have paid me. Any goat in my possession that is not speckled or spotted, or any lamb that is not dark-colored, will be considered stolen.”
chapters.zh: 以后你来查看我的工价，凡在我手里的山羊不是有点有斑的，绵羊不是黑色的，那就算是我偷的。这样便可证出我的公义来。

chapters.en: “Agreed,” said Laban. “Let it be as you have said.”
chapters.zh: 拉班说，好啊！我情愿照着你的话行。

chapters.en: That same day he removed all the male goats that were streaked or spotted, and all the speckled or spotted female goats (all that had white on them) and all the dark-colored lambs, and he placed them in the care of his sons.
chapters.zh: 当日，拉班把有纹的，有斑的公山羊，有点的，有斑的，有杂白纹的母山羊，并黑色的绵羊，都挑出来，交在他儿子们的手下，

chapters.en: Then he put a three-day journey between himself and Jacob, while Jacob continued to tend the rest of Laban’s flocks.
chapters.zh: 又使自己和雅各相离三天的路程。雅各就牧养拉班其余的羊。

chapters.en: Jacob, however, took fresh-cut branches from poplar, almond and plane trees and made white stripes on them by peeling the bark and exposing the white inner wood of the branches.
chapters.zh: 雅各拿杨树，杏树，枫树的嫩枝，将皮剥成白纹，使枝子露出白的来，

chapters.en: Then he placed the peeled branches in all the watering troughs, so that they would be directly in front of the flocks when they came to drink. When the flocks were in heat and came to drink,
chapters.zh: 将剥了皮的枝子，对着羊群，插在饮羊的水沟里和水槽里，羊来喝的时候，牝牡配合。

chapters.en: they mated in front of the branches. And they bore young that were streaked or speckled or spotted.
chapters.zh: 羊对着枝子配合，就生下有纹的，有点的，有斑的来。

chapters.en: Jacob set apart the young of the flock by themselves, but made the rest face the streaked and dark-colored animals that belonged to Laban. Thus he made separate flocks for himself and did not put them with Laban’s animals.
chapters.zh: 雅各把羊羔分出来，使拉班的羊与这有纹和黑色的羊相对，把自己的羊另放一处，不叫他和拉班的羊混杂。

chapters.en: Whenever the stronger females were in heat, Jacob would place the branches in the troughs in front of the animals so they would mate near the branches,
chapters.zh: 到羊群肥壮配合的时候，雅各就把枝子插在水沟里，使羊对着枝子配合。

chapters.en: but if the animals were weak, he would not place them there. So the weak animals went to Laban and the strong ones to Jacob.
chapters.zh: 只是到羊瘦弱配合的时候就不插枝子。这样，瘦弱的就归拉班，肥壮的就归雅各。

chapters.en: In this way the man grew exceedingly prosperous and came to own large flocks, and female and male servants, and camels and donkeys.
chapters.zh: 于是雅各极其发大，得了许多的羊群，仆婢，骆驼，和驴。

chapters.en: Jacob heard that Laban’s sons were saying, “Jacob has taken everything our father owned and has gained all this wealth from what belonged to our father.”
chapters.zh: 雅各听见拉班的儿子们有话说，雅各把我们父亲所有的都夺了去，并借着我们父亲的，得了这一切的荣耀（荣耀或作财）。

chapters.en: And Jacob noticed that Laban’s attitude toward him was not what it had been.
chapters.zh: 雅各见拉班的气色向他不如从前了。

chapters.en: Then the LORD said to Jacob, “Go back to the land of your fathers and to your relatives, and I will be with you.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华对雅各说，你要回你祖，你父之地，到你亲族那里去，我必与你同在。

chapters.en: So Jacob sent word to Rachel and Leah to come out to the fields where his flocks were.
chapters.zh: 雅各就打发人，叫拉结和利亚到田野羊群那里来，

chapters.en: He said to them, “I see that your father’s attitude toward me is not what it was before, but the God of my father has been with me.
chapters.zh: 对她们说，我看你们父亲的气色向我不如从前了。但我父亲的神向来与我同在。

chapters.en: You know that I’ve worked for your father with all my strength,
chapters.zh: 你们也知道，我尽了我的力量服事你们的父亲。

chapters.en: yet your father has cheated me by changing my wages ten times. However, God has not allowed him to harm me.
chapters.zh: 你们的父亲欺哄我，十次改了我的工价。然而神不容他害我。

chapters.en: If he said, ‘The speckled ones will be your wages,’ then all the flocks gave birth to speckled young; and if he said, ‘The streaked ones will be your wages,’ then all the flocks bore streaked young.
chapters.zh: 他若说，有点的归你作工价，羊群所生的都有点。他若说，有纹的归你作工价，羊群所生的都有纹。

chapters.en: So God has taken away your father’s livestock and has given them to me.
chapters.zh: 这样，神把你们父亲的牲畜夺来赐给我了。

chapters.en: “In breeding season I once had a dream in which I looked up and saw that the male goats mating with the flock were streaked, speckled or spotted.
chapters.zh: 羊配合的时候，我梦中举目一看，见跳母羊的公羊都是有纹的，有点的，有花斑的。

chapters.en: The angel of God said to me in the dream, ‘Jacob.’ I answered, ‘Here I am.’
chapters.zh: 神的使者在那梦中呼叫我说，雅各，我说，我在这里。

chapters.en: And he said, ‘Look up and see that all the male goats mating with the flock are streaked, speckled or spotted, for I have seen all that Laban has been doing to you.
chapters.zh: 他说，你举目观看，跳母羊的公羊都是有纹的，有点的，有花斑的。凡拉班向你所作的，我都看见了。

chapters.en: I am the God of Bethel, where you anointed a pillar and where you made a vow to me. Now leave this land at once and go back to your native land.’ ”
chapters.zh: 我是伯特利的神。你在那里用油浇过柱子，向我许过愿。现今你起来，离开这地，回你本地去吧。

chapters.en: Then Rachel and Leah replied, “Do we still have any share in the inheritance of our father’s estate?
chapters.zh: 拉结和利亚回答雅各说，在我们父亲的家里还有我们可得的分吗？还有我们的产业吗？

chapters.en: Does he not regard us as foreigners? Not only has he sold us, but he has used up what was paid for us.
chapters.zh: 我们不是被他当作外人吗？因为他卖了我们，吞了我们的价值。

chapters.en: Surely all the wealth that God took away from our father belongs to us and our children. So do whatever God has told you.”
chapters.zh: 神从我们父亲所夺出来的一切财物，那就是我们和我们孩子们的。现今凡神所吩咐你的，你只管去行吧。

chapters.en: Then Jacob put his children and his wives on camels,
chapters.zh: 雅各起来，使他的儿子和妻子都骑上骆驼，

chapters.en: and he drove all his livestock ahead of him, along with all the goods he had accumulated in Paddan Aram, to go to his father Isaac in the land of Canaan.
chapters.zh: 又带着他在巴旦亚兰所得的一切牲畜和财物，往迦南地，他父亲以撒那里去了。

chapters.en: When Laban had gone to shear his sheep, Rachel stole her father’s household gods.
chapters.zh: 当时拉班剪羊毛去了，拉结偷了他父亲家中的神像。

chapters.en: Moreover, Jacob deceived Laban the Aramean by not telling him he was running away.
chapters.zh: 雅各背着亚兰人拉班偷走了，并不告诉他，

chapters.en: So he fled with all he had, crossed the Euphrates River, and headed for the hill country of Gilead.
chapters.zh: 就带着所有的逃跑。他起身过大河，面向基列山行去。

chapters.en: On the third day Laban was told that Jacob had fled.
chapters.zh: 到第三日，有人告诉拉班，雅各逃跑了。

chapters.en: Taking his relatives with him, he pursued Jacob for seven days and caught up with him in the hill country of Gilead.
chapters.zh: 拉班带领他的众弟兄去追赶，追了七日，在基列山就追上了。

chapters.en: Then God came to Laban the Aramean in a dream at night and said to him, “Be careful not to say anything to Jacob, either good or bad.”
chapters.zh: 夜间，神到亚兰人拉班那里，在梦中对他说，你要小心，不可与雅各说好说歹。

chapters.en: Jacob had pitched his tent in the hill country of Gilead when Laban overtook him, and Laban and his relatives camped there too.
chapters.zh: 拉班追上雅各。雅各在山上支搭帐棚。拉班和他的众弟兄也在基列山上支搭帐棚。

chapters.en: Then Laban said to Jacob, “What have you done? You’ve deceived me, and you’ve carried off my daughters like captives in war.
chapters.zh: 拉班对雅各说，你作的是什么事呢？你背着我偷走了，又把我的女儿们带了去，如同用刀剑掳去的一般。
