chapters.en: Why did you run off secretly and deceive me? Why didn’t you tell me, so I could send you away with joy and singing to the music of timbrels and harps?
chapters.zh: 你为什么暗暗地逃跑，偷着走，并不告诉我，叫我可以欢乐，唱歌，击鼓，弹琴地送你回去？

chapters.en: You didn’t even let me kiss my grandchildren and my daughters goodbye. You have done a foolish thing.
chapters.zh: 又不容我与外孙和女儿亲嘴。你所行的真是愚昧。

chapters.en: I have the power to harm you; but last night the God of your father said to me, ‘Be careful not to say anything to Jacob, either good or bad.’
chapters.zh: 我手中原有能力害你，只是你父亲的神昨夜对我说，你要小心，不可与雅各说好说歹。

chapters.en: Now you have gone off because you longed to return to your father’s household. But why did you steal my gods?”
chapters.zh: 现在你虽然想你父家，不得不去，为什么又偷了我的神像呢？

chapters.en: Jacob answered Laban, “I was afraid, because I thought you would take your daughters away from me by force.
chapters.zh: 雅各回答拉班说，恐怕你把你的女儿从我夺去，所以我逃跑。

chapters.en: But if you find anyone who has your gods, that person shall not live. In the presence of our relatives, see for yourself whether there is anything of yours here with me; and if so, take it.” Now Jacob did not know that Rachel had stolen the gods.
chapters.zh: 至于你的神像，你在谁那里搜出来，就不容谁存活。当着我们的众弟兄，你认一认，在我这里有什么东西是你的，就拿去。原来雅各不知道拉结偷了那些神像。

chapters.en: So Laban went into Jacob’s tent and into Leah’s tent and into the tent of the two female servants, but he found nothing. After he came out of Leah’s tent, he entered Rachel’s tent.
chapters.zh: 拉班进了雅各，利亚，并两个使女的帐棚，都没有搜出来，就从利亚的帐棚出来，进了拉结的帐棚。

chapters.en: Now Rachel had taken the household gods and put them inside her camel’s saddle and was sitting on them. Laban searched through everything in the tent but found nothing.
chapters.zh: 拉结已经把神像藏在骆驼的驮篓里，便坐在上头。拉班摸遍了那帐棚，并没有摸着

chapters.en: Rachel said to her father, “Don’t be angry, my lord, that I cannot stand up in your presence; I’m having my period.” So he searched but could not find the household gods.
chapters.zh: 拉结对她父亲说，现在我身上不便，不能在你面前起来，求我主不要生气。这样，拉班搜寻神像，竟没有搜出来。

chapters.en: Jacob was angry and took Laban to task. “What is my crime?” he asked Laban. “How have I wronged you that you hunt me down?
chapters.zh: 雅各就发怒斥责拉班说，我有什么过犯，有什么罪恶，你竟这样火速地追我？

chapters.en: Now that you have searched through all my goods, what have you found that belongs to your household? Put it here in front of your relatives and mine, and let them judge between the two of us.
chapters.zh: 你摸遍了我一切的家具，你搜出什么来呢？可以放在你我弟兄面前，叫他们在你我中间辨别辨别。

chapters.en: “I have been with you for twenty years now. Your sheep and goats have not miscarried, nor have I eaten rams from your flocks.
chapters.zh: 我在你家这二十年，你的母绵羊，母山羊没有掉过胎。你群中的公羊，我没有吃过。

chapters.en: I did not bring you animals torn by wild beasts; I bore the loss myself. And you demanded payment from me for whatever was stolen by day or night.
chapters.zh: 被野兽撕裂的，我没有带来给你，是我自己赔上。无论是白日，是黑夜，被偷去的，你都向我索要。

chapters.en: This was my situation: The heat consumed me in the daytime and the cold at night, and sleep fled from my eyes.
chapters.zh: 我白日受尽干热，黑夜受尽寒霜，不得合眼睡着，我常是这样。

chapters.en: It was like this for the twenty years I was in your household. I worked for you fourteen years for your two daughters and six years for your flocks, and you changed my wages ten times.
chapters.zh: 我这二十年在你家里，为你的两个女儿服事你十四年，为你的羊群服事你六年，你又十次改了我的工价。

chapters.en: If the God of my father, the God of Abraham and the Fear of Isaac, had not been with me, you would surely have sent me away empty-handed. But God has seen my hardship and the toil of my hands, and last night he rebuked you.”
chapters.zh: 若不是我父亲以撒所敬畏的神，就是亚伯拉罕的神与我同在，你如今必定打发我空手而去。神看见我的苦情和我的劳碌，就在昨夜责备你。

chapters.en: Laban answered Jacob, “The women are my daughters, the children are my children, and the flocks are my flocks. All you see is mine. Yet what can I do today about these daughters of mine, or about the children they have borne?
chapters.zh: 拉班回答雅各说，这女儿是我的女儿，这些孩子是我的孩子，这些羊群也是我的羊群。凡在你眼前的都是我的。我的女儿并她们所生的孩子，我今日能向他们作什么呢？

chapters.en: Come now, let’s make a covenant, you and I, and let it serve as a witness between us.”
chapters.zh: 来吧，你我二人可以立约，作你我中间的证据。

chapters.en: So Jacob took a stone and set it up as a pillar.
chapters.zh: 雅各就拿一块石头立作柱子，

chapters.en: He said to his relatives, “Gather some stones.” So they took stones and piled them in a heap, and they ate there by the heap.
chapters.zh: 又对众弟兄说，你们堆聚石头。他们就拿石头来堆成一堆，大家便在旁边吃喝。

chapters.en: Laban called it Jegar Sahadutha, and Jacob called it Galeed.
chapters.zh: 拉班称那石堆为伊迦尔撒哈杜他，雅各却称那石堆为迦累得（都是以石堆为证的意思）。

chapters.en: Laban said, “This heap is a witness between you and me today.” That is why it was called Galeed.
chapters.zh: 拉班说，今日这石堆作你我中间的证据。因此这地方名叫迦累得，

chapters.en: It was also called Mizpah, because he said, “May the LORD keep watch between you and me when we are away from each other.
chapters.zh: 又叫米斯巴，意思说，我们彼此离别以后，愿耶和华在你我中间鉴察。

chapters.en: If you mistreat my daughters or if you take any wives besides my daughters, even though no one is with us, remember that God is a witness between you and me.”
chapters.zh: 你若苦待我的女儿，又在我的女儿以外另娶妻，虽没有人知道，却有神在你我中间作见证。

chapters.en: Laban also said to Jacob, “Here is this heap, and here is this pillar I have set up between you and me.
chapters.zh: 拉班又说，你看我在你我中间所立的这石堆和柱子。

chapters.en: This heap is a witness, and this pillar is a witness, that I will not go past this heap to your side to harm you and that you will not go past this heap and pillar to my side to harm me.
chapters.zh: 这石堆作证据，这柱子也作证据。我必不过这石堆去害你。你也不可过这石堆和柱子来害我。

chapters.en: May the God of Abraham and the God of Nahor, the God of their father, judge between us.” So Jacob took an oath in the name of the Fear of his father Isaac.
chapters.zh: 但愿亚伯拉罕的神和拿鹤的神，就是他们父亲的神，在你我中间判断。雅各就指着他父亲以撒所敬畏的神起誓，

chapters.en: He offered a sacrifice there in the hill country and invited his relatives to a meal. After they had eaten, they spent the night there.
chapters.zh: 又在山上献祭，请众弟兄来吃饭。他们吃了饭，便在山上住宿。

chapters.en: Early the next morning Laban kissed his grandchildren and his daughters and blessed them. Then he left and returned home.
chapters.zh: 拉班清早起来，与他外孙和女儿亲嘴，给他们祝福，回往自己的地方去了。

chapters.en: Jacob also went on his way, and the angels of God met him.
chapters.zh: 雅各仍旧行路，神的使者遇见他。

chapters.en: When Jacob saw them, he said, “This is the camp of God!” So he named that place Mahanaim.
chapters.zh: 雅各看见他们就说，这是神的军兵，于是给那地方起名叫玛哈念（就是二军兵的意思）。

chapters.en: Jacob sent messengers ahead of him to his brother Esau in the land of Seir, the country of Edom.
chapters.zh: 雅各打发人先往西珥地去，就是以东地，见他哥哥以扫，

chapters.en: He instructed them: “This is what you are to say to my lord Esau: ‘Your servant Jacob says, I have been staying with Laban and have remained there till now.
chapters.zh: 吩咐他们说，你们对我主以扫说，你的仆人雅各这样说，我在拉班那里寄居，直到如今。

chapters.en: I have cattle and donkeys, sheep and goats, male and female servants. Now I am sending this message to my lord, that I may find favor in your eyes.’ ”
chapters.zh: 我有牛，驴，羊群，仆婢，现在打发人来报告我主，为要在你眼前蒙恩。

chapters.en: When the messengers returned to Jacob, they said, “We went to your brother Esau, and now he is coming to meet you, and four hundred men are with him.”
chapters.zh: 所打发的人回到雅各那里，说，我们到了你哥哥以扫那里，他带着四百人，正迎着你来。

chapters.en: In great fear and distress Jacob divided the people who were with him into two groups, and the flocks and herds and camels as well.
chapters.zh: 雅各就甚惧怕，而且愁烦，便把那与他同在的人口和羊群，牛群，骆驼分作两队，

chapters.en: He thought, “If Esau comes and attacks one group, the group that is left may escape.”
chapters.zh: 说，以扫若来击杀这一队，剩下的那一队还可以逃避。

chapters.en: Then Jacob prayed, “O God of my father Abraham, God of my father Isaac, LORD, you who said to me, ‘Go back to your country and your relatives, and I will make you prosper,’
chapters.zh: 雅各说，耶和华我祖亚伯拉罕的神，我父亲以撒的神阿，你曾对我说，回你本地本族去，我要厚待你。

chapters.en: I am unworthy of all the kindness and faithfulness you have shown your servant. I had only my staff when I crossed this Jordan, but now I have become two camps.
chapters.zh: 你向仆人所施的一切慈爱和诚实，我一点也不配得。我先前只拿着我的杖过这约旦河，如今我却成了两队了。

chapters.en: Save me, I pray, from the hand of my brother Esau, for I am afraid he will come and attack me, and also the mothers with their children.
chapters.zh: 求你救我脱离我哥哥以扫的手。因为我怕他来杀我，连妻子带儿女一同杀了。

chapters.en: But you have said, ‘I will surely make you prosper and will make your descendants like the sand of the sea, which cannot be counted.’ ”
chapters.zh: 你曾说，我必定厚待你，使你的后裔如同海边的沙，多得不可胜数。

chapters.en: He spent the night there, and from what he had with him he selected a gift for his brother Esau:
chapters.zh: 当夜，雅各在那里住宿，就从他所有的物中拿礼物要送给他哥哥以扫。

chapters.en: two hundred female goats and twenty male goats, two hundred ewes and twenty rams,
chapters.zh: 母山羊二百只，公山羊二十只，母绵羊二百只，公绵羊二十只，

chapters.en: thirty female camels with their young, forty cows and ten bulls, and twenty female donkeys and ten male donkeys.
chapters.zh: 奶崽子的骆驼三十只各带着崽子，母牛四十只，公牛十只，母驴二十匹，驴驹十匹。

chapters.en: He put them in the care of his servants, each herd by itself, and said to his servants, “Go ahead of me, and keep some space between the herds.”
chapters.zh: 每样各分一群，交在仆人手下，就对仆人说，你们要在我前头过去，使群群相离，有空闲的地方。

chapters.en: He instructed the one in the lead: “When my brother Esau meets you and asks, ‘Who do you belong to, and where are you going, and who owns all these animals in front of you?’
chapters.zh: 又吩咐尽先走的说，我哥哥以扫遇见你的时候，问你说，你是哪家的人，要往哪里去，你前头这些是谁的，

chapters.en: then you are to say, ‘They belong to your servant Jacob. They are a gift sent to my lord Esau, and he is coming behind us.’ ”
chapters.zh: 你就说，是你仆人雅各的，是送给我主以扫的礼物。他自己也在我们后边。

chapters.en: He also instructed the second, the third and all the others who followed the herds: “You are to say the same thing to Esau when you meet him.
chapters.zh: 又吩咐第二，第三，和一切赶群畜的人说，你们遇见以扫的时候也要这样对他说。

chapters.en: And be sure to say, ‘Your servant Jacob is coming behind us.’ ” For he thought, “I will pacify him with these gifts I am sending on ahead; later, when I see him, perhaps he will receive me.”
chapters.zh: 并且你们要说，你仆人雅各在我们后边。因雅各心里说，我借着在我前头去的礼物解他的恨，然后再见他的面，或者他容纳我。

chapters.en: So Jacob’s gifts went on ahead of him, but he himself spent the night in the camp.
chapters.zh: 于是礼物先过去了。那夜，雅各在队中住宿。

chapters.en: That night Jacob got up and took his two wives, his two female servants and his eleven sons and crossed the ford of the Jabbok.
chapters.zh: 他夜间起来，带着两个妻子，两个使女，并十一个儿子，都过了雅博渡口，

chapters.en: After he had sent them across the stream, he sent over all his possessions.
chapters.zh: 先打发他们过河，又打发所有的都过去，

chapters.en: So Jacob was left alone, and a man wrestled with him till daybreak.
chapters.zh: 只剩下雅各一人。有一个人来和他摔跤，直到黎明。

chapters.en: When the man saw that he could not overpower him, he touched the socket of Jacob’s hip so that his hip was wrenched as he wrestled with the man.
chapters.zh: 那人见自己胜不过他，就将他的大腿窝摸了一把，雅各的大腿窝正在摔跤的时候就扭了。

chapters.en: Then the man said, “Let me go, for it is daybreak.” But Jacob replied, “I will not let you go unless you bless me.”
chapters.zh: 那人说，天黎明了，容我去吧。雅各说，你不给我祝福，我就不容你去。

chapters.en: The man asked him, “What is your name?” “Jacob,” he answered.
chapters.zh: 那人说，你名叫什么？他说，我名叫雅各。

chapters.en: Then the man said, “Your name will no longer be Jacob, but Israel, because you have struggled with God and with humans and have overcome.”
chapters.zh: 那人说，你的名不要再叫雅各，要叫以色列。因为你与神与人较力，都得了胜。

chapters.en: Jacob said, “Please tell me your name.” But he replied, “Why do you ask my name?” Then he blessed him there.
chapters.zh: 雅各问他说，请将你的名告诉我。那人说，何必问我的名，于是在那里给雅各祝福。

chapters.en: So Jacob called the place Peniel, saying, “It is because I saw God face to face, and yet my life was spared.”
chapters.zh: 雅各便给那地方起名叫毗努伊勒（就是神之面的意思），意思说，我面对面见了神，我的性命仍得保全。

chapters.en: The sun rose above him as he passed Peniel, and he was limping because of his hip.
chapters.zh: 日头刚出来的时候，雅各经过毗努伊勒，他的大腿就瘸了。

chapters.en: Therefore to this day the Israelites do not eat the tendon attached to the socket of the hip, because the socket of Jacob’s hip was touched near the tendon.
chapters.zh: 故此，以色列人不吃大腿窝的筋，直到今日，因为那人摸了雅各大腿窝的筋。

chapters.en: Jacob looked up and there was Esau, coming with his four hundred men; so he divided the children among Leah, Rachel and the two female servants.
chapters.zh: 雅各举目观看，见以扫来了，后头跟着四百人，他就把孩子们分开交给利亚，拉结，和两个使女，

chapters.en: He put the female servants and their children in front, Leah and her children next, and Rachel and Joseph in the rear.
chapters.zh: 并且叫两个使女和她们的孩子在前头，利亚和她的孩子在后头，拉结和约瑟在尽后头。

chapters.en: He himself went on ahead and bowed down to the ground seven times as he approached his brother.
chapters.zh: 他自己在他们前头过去，一连七次俯伏在地才就近他哥哥。

chapters.en: But Esau ran to meet Jacob and embraced him; he threw his arms around his neck and kissed him. And they wept.
chapters.zh: 以扫跑来迎接他，将他抱住，又搂着他的颈项，与他亲嘴，两个人就哭了。

chapters.en: Then Esau looked up and saw the women and children. “Who are these with you?” he asked. Jacob answered, “They are the children God has graciously given your servant.”
chapters.zh: 以扫举目看见妇人孩子，就说，这些和你同行的是谁呢？雅各说，这些孩子是神施恩给你的仆人的。

chapters.en: Then the female servants and their children approached and bowed down.
chapters.zh: 于是两个使女和她们的孩子前来下拜。

chapters.en: Next, Leah and her children came and bowed down. Last of all came Joseph and Rachel, and they too bowed down.
chapters.zh: 利亚和她的孩子也前来下拜。随后约瑟和拉结也前来下拜。

chapters.en: Esau asked, “What’s the meaning of all these flocks and herds I met?” “To find favor in your eyes, my lord,” he said.
chapters.zh: 以扫说，我所遇见的这些群畜是什么意思呢？雅各说，是要在我主面前蒙恩的。

chapters.en: But Esau said, “I already have plenty, my brother. Keep what you have for yourself.”
chapters.zh: 以扫说，兄弟阿，我的已经够了，你的仍归你吧。

chapters.en: “No, please!” said Jacob. “If I have found favor in your eyes, accept this gift from me. For to see your face is like seeing the face of God, now that you have received me favorably.
chapters.zh: 雅各说，不然，我若在你眼前蒙恩，就求你从我手里收下这礼物。因为我见了你的面，如同见了神的面，并且你容纳了我。

chapters.en: Please accept the present that was brought to you, for God has been gracious to me and I have all I need.” And because Jacob insisted, Esau accepted it.
chapters.zh: 求你收下我带来给你的礼物。因为神恩待我，使我充足。雅各再三地求他，他才收下了。

chapters.en: Then Esau said, “Let us be on our way; I’ll accompany you.”
chapters.zh: 以扫说，我们可以起身前往，我在你前头走。

chapters.en: But Jacob said to him, “My lord knows that the children are tender and that I must care for the ewes and cows that are nursing their young. If they are driven hard just one day, all the animals will die.
chapters.zh: 雅各对他说，我主知道孩子们年幼娇嫩，牛羊也正在乳养的时候，若是催赶一天，群畜都必死了。

chapters.en: So let my lord go on ahead of his servant, while I move along slowly at the pace of the flocks and herds before me and the pace of the children, until I come to my lord in Seir.”
chapters.zh: 求我主在仆人前头走，我要量着在我面前群畜和孩子的力量慢慢地前行，直走到西珥我主那里。

chapters.en: Esau said, “Then let me leave some of my men with you.” “But why do that?” Jacob asked. “Just let me find favor in the eyes of my lord.”
chapters.zh: 以扫说，容我把跟随我的人留几个在你这里。雅各说，何必呢？只要在我主眼前蒙恩就是了。

chapters.en: So that day Esau started on his way back to Seir.
chapters.zh: 于是，以扫当日起行，回往西珥去了。

chapters.en: Jacob, however, went to Sukkoth, where he built a place for himself and made shelters for his livestock. That is why the place is called Sukkoth.
chapters.zh: 雅各就往疏割去，在那里为自己盖造房屋，又为牲畜搭棚。因此那地方名叫疏割（就是棚的意思）。

chapters.en: After Jacob came from Paddan Aram, he arrived safely at the city of Shechem in Canaan and camped within sight of the city.
chapters.zh: 雅各从巴旦亚兰回来的时候，平平安安地到了迦南地的示剑城，在城东支搭帐棚，

chapters.en: For a hundred pieces of silver, he bought from the sons of Hamor, the father of Shechem, the plot of ground where he pitched his tent.
chapters.zh: 就用一百块银子向示剑的父亲，哈抹的子孙买了支帐棚的那块地，

chapters.en: There he set up an altar and called it El Elohe Israel.
chapters.zh: 在那里筑了一座坛，起名叫伊利伊罗伊以色列（就是神，以色列神的意思）。

chapters.en: Now Dinah, the daughter Leah had borne to Jacob, went out to visit the women of the land.
chapters.zh: 利亚给雅各所生的女儿底拿出去，要见那地的女子们。

chapters.en: When Shechem son of Hamor the Hivite, the ruler of that area, saw her, he took her and raped her.
chapters.zh: 那地的主希未人，哈抹的儿子示剑看见她，就拉住她，与她行淫，玷辱她。

chapters.en: His heart was drawn to Dinah daughter of Jacob; he loved the young woman and spoke tenderly to her.
chapters.zh: 示剑的心系恋雅各的女儿底拿，喜爱这女子，甜言蜜语地安慰她。

chapters.en: And Shechem said to his father Hamor, “Get me this girl as my wife.”
chapters.zh: 示剑对他父亲哈抹说，求你为我聘这女子为妻。

chapters.en: When Jacob heard that his daughter Dinah had been defiled, his sons were in the fields with his livestock; so he did nothing about it until they came home.
chapters.zh: 雅各听见示剑玷污了他的女儿底拿。那时他的儿子们正和群畜在田野，雅各就闭口不言，等他们回来。

chapters.en: Then Shechem’s father Hamor went out to talk with Jacob.
chapters.zh: 示剑的父亲哈抹出来见雅各，要和他商议。

chapters.en: Meanwhile, Jacob’s sons had come in from the fields as soon as they heard what had happened. They were shocked and furious, because Shechem had done an outrageous thing in Israel by sleeping with Jacob’s daughter—a thing that should not be done.
chapters.zh: 雅各的儿子们听见这事，就从田野回来，人人忿恨，十分恼怒。因示剑在以色列家作了丑事，与雅各的女儿行淫，这本是不该作的事。

chapters.en: But Hamor said to them, “My son Shechem has his heart set on your daughter. Please give her to him as his wife.
chapters.zh: 哈抹和他们商议说，我儿子示剑的心恋慕这女子，求你们将她给我的儿子为妻。

chapters.en: Intermarry with us; give us your daughters and take our daughters for yourselves.
chapters.zh: 你们与我们彼此结亲。你们可以把女儿给我们，也可以娶我们的女儿。

chapters.en: You can settle among us; the land is open to you. Live in it, trade in it, and acquire property in it.”
chapters.zh: 你们与我们同住吧。这地都在你们面前，只管在此居住，作买卖，置产业。

chapters.en: Then Shechem said to Dinah’s father and brothers, “Let me find favor in your eyes, and I will give you whatever you ask.
chapters.zh: 示剑对女儿的父亲和弟兄们说，但愿我在你们眼前蒙恩，你们向我要什么，我必给你们。

chapters.en: Make the price for the bride and the gift I am to bring as great as you like, and I’ll pay whatever you ask me. Only give me the young woman as my wife.”
chapters.zh: 任凭向我要多重的聘金和礼物，我必照你们所说的给你们。只要把女子给我为妻。

chapters.en: Because their sister Dinah had been defiled, Jacob’s sons replied deceitfully as they spoke to Shechem and his father Hamor.
chapters.zh: 雅各的儿子们因为示剑玷污了他们的妹子底拿，就用诡诈的话回答示剑和他父亲哈抹，

chapters.en: They said to them, “We can’t do such a thing; we can’t give our sister to a man who is not circumcised. That would be a disgrace to us.
chapters.zh: 对他们说，我们不能把我们的妹子给没有受割礼的人为妻，因为那是我们的羞辱。

chapters.en: We will enter into an agreement with you on one condition only: that you become like us by circumcising all your males.
chapters.zh: 惟有一件才可以应允，若你们所有的男丁都受割礼，和我们一样，

chapters.en: Then we will give you our daughters and take your daughters for ourselves. We’ll settle among you and become one people with you.
chapters.zh: 我们就把女儿给你们，也娶你们的女儿。我们便与你们同住，两下成为一样的人民。

chapters.en: But if you will not agree to be circumcised, we’ll take our sister and go.”
chapters.zh: 倘若你们不听从我们受割礼，我们就带着妹子走了。

chapters.en: Their proposal seemed good to Hamor and his son Shechem.
chapters.zh: 哈抹和他的儿子示剑喜欢这话。

chapters.en: The young man, who was the most honored of all his father’s family, lost no time in doing what they said, because he was delighted with Jacob’s daughter.
chapters.zh: 那少年人作这事并不迟延，因为他喜爱雅各的女儿。他在他父亲家中也是人最尊重的。

chapters.en: So Hamor and his son Shechem went to the gate of their city to speak to the men of their city.
chapters.zh: 哈抹和他儿子示剑到本城的门口，对本城的人说，

chapters.en: “These men are friendly toward us,” they said. “Let them live in our land and trade in it; the land has plenty of room for them. We can marry their daughters and they can marry ours.
chapters.zh: 这些人与我们和睦，不如许他们在这地居住，作买卖。这地也宽阔，足可容下他们。我们可以娶他们的女儿为妻，也可以把我们的女儿嫁给他们。

chapters.en: But the men will agree to live with us as one people only on the condition that our males be circumcised, as they themselves are.
chapters.zh: 惟有一件事我们必须作，他们才肯应允和我们同住，成为一样的人民，就是我们中间所有的男丁都要受割礼，和他们一样。

chapters.en: Won’t their livestock, their property and all their other animals become ours? So let us agree to their terms, and they will settle among us.”
chapters.zh: 他们的群畜，货财，和一切的牲口岂不都归我们吗？只要依从他们，他们就与我们同住。

chapters.en: All the men who went out of the city gate agreed with Hamor and his son Shechem, and every male in the city was circumcised.
chapters.zh: 凡从城门出入的人就都听从哈抹和他儿子示剑的话。于是凡从城门出入的男丁都受了割礼。

chapters.en: Three days later, while all of them were still in pain, two of Jacob’s sons, Simeon and Levi, Dinah’s brothers, took their swords and attacked the unsuspecting city, killing every male.
chapters.zh: 到第三天，众人正在疼痛的时候，雅各的两个儿子，就是底拿的哥哥西缅和利未，各拿刀剑，趁着众人想不到的时候来到城中，把一切男丁都杀了，

chapters.en: They put Hamor and his son Shechem to the sword and took Dinah from Shechem’s house and left.
chapters.zh: 又用刀杀了哈抹和他儿子示剑，把底拿从示剑家里带出来就走了。

chapters.en: The sons of Jacob came upon the dead bodies and looted the city where their sister had been defiled.
chapters.zh: 雅各的儿子们因为他们的妹子受了玷污，就来到被杀的人那里，掳掠那城，

chapters.en: They seized their flocks and herds and donkeys and everything else of theirs in the city and out in the fields.
chapters.zh: 夺了他们的羊群，牛群，和驴，并城里田间所有的。

chapters.en: They carried off all their wealth and all their women and children, taking as plunder everything in the houses.
chapters.zh: 又把他们一切货财，孩子，妇女，并各房中所有的，都掳掠去了。

chapters.en: Then Jacob said to Simeon and Levi, “You have brought trouble on me by making me obnoxious to the Canaanites and Perizzites, the people living in this land. We are few in number, and if they join forces against me and attack me, I and my household will be destroyed.”
chapters.zh: 雅各对西缅和利未说，你们连累我，使我在这地的居民中，就是在迦南人和比利洗人中，有了臭名。我的人丁既然稀少，他们必聚集来击杀我，我和全家的人都必灭绝。

chapters.en: But they replied, “Should he have treated our sister like a prostitute?”
chapters.zh: 他们说，他岂可待我们的妹子如同妓女吗？

chapters.en: Then God said to Jacob, “Go up to Bethel and settle there, and build an altar there to God, who appeared to you when you were fleeing from your brother Esau.”
chapters.zh: 神对雅各说，起来。上伯特利去，住在那里。要在那里筑一座坛给神，就是你逃避你哥哥以扫的时候向你显现的那位。

chapters.en: So Jacob said to his household and to all who were with him, “Get rid of the foreign gods you have with you, and purify yourselves and change your clothes.
chapters.zh: 雅各就对他家中的人并一切与他同在的人说，你们要除掉你们中间的外邦神，也要自洁，更换衣裳。

chapters.en: Then come, let us go up to Bethel, where I will build an altar to God, who answered me in the day of my distress and who has been with me wherever I have gone.”
chapters.zh: 我们要起来，上伯特利去，在那里我要筑一座坛给神，就是在我遭难的日子应允我的祷告，在我行的路上保佑我的那位。

chapters.en: So they gave Jacob all the foreign gods they had and the rings in their ears, and Jacob buried them under the oak at Shechem.
chapters.zh: 他们就把外邦人的神像和他们耳朵上的环子交给雅各。雅各都藏在示剑那里的橡树底下。

chapters.en: Then they set out, and the terror of God fell on the towns all around them so that no one pursued them.
chapters.zh: 他们便起行前往。神使那周围城邑的人都甚惊惧，就不追赶雅各的众子了。

chapters.en: Jacob and all the people with him came to Luz (that is, Bethel) in the land of Canaan.
chapters.zh: 于是雅各和一切与他同在的人到了迦南地的路斯，就是伯特利。

chapters.en: There he built an altar, and he called the place El Bethel, because it was there that God revealed himself to him when he was fleeing from his brother.
chapters.zh: 他在那里筑了一座坛，就给那地方起名叫伊勒伯特利（就是伯特利之神的意思），因为他逃避他哥哥的时候，神在那里向他显现。

chapters.en: Now Deborah, Rebekah’s nurse, died and was buried under the oak outside Bethel. So it was named Allon Bakuth.
chapters.zh: 利百加的奶母底波拉死了，就葬在伯特利下边橡树底下。那棵树名叫亚伦巴古。

chapters.en: After Jacob returned from Paddan Aram, God appeared to him again and blessed him.
chapters.zh: 雅各从巴旦亚兰回来，神又向他显现，赐福与他，

chapters.en: God said to him, “Your name is Jacob, but you will no longer be called Jacob; your name will be Israel. ” So he named him Israel.
chapters.zh: 且对他说，你的名原是雅各，从今以后不要再叫雅各，要叫以色列。这样，他就改名叫以色列。

chapters.en: And God said to him, “I am God Almighty ; be fruitful and increase in number. A nation and a community of nations will come from you, and kings will be among your descendants.
chapters.zh: 神又对他说，我是全能的神。你要生养众多，将来有一族和多国的民从你而生，又有君王从你而出。

chapters.en: The land I gave to Abraham and Isaac I also give to you, and I will give this land to your descendants after you.”
chapters.zh: 我所赐给亚伯拉罕和以撒的地，我要赐给你与你的后裔。

chapters.en: Then God went up from him at the place where he had talked with him.
chapters.zh: 神就从那与雅各说话的地方升上去了。

chapters.en: Jacob set up a stone pillar at the place where God had talked with him, and he poured out a drink offering on it; he also poured oil on it.
chapters.zh: 雅各便在那里立了一根石柱，在柱子上奠酒，浇油。

chapters.en: Jacob called the place where God had talked with him Bethel.
chapters.zh: 雅各就给那地方起名叫伯特利。

chapters.en: Then they moved on from Bethel. While they were still some distance from Ephrath, Rachel began to give birth and had great difficulty.
chapters.zh: 他们从伯特利起行，离以法他还有一段路程，拉结临产甚是艰难。

chapters.en: And as she was having great difficulty in childbirth, the midwife said to her, “Don’t despair, for you have another son.”
chapters.zh: 正在艰难的时候，收生婆对她说，不要怕，你又要得一个儿子了。

chapters.en: As she breathed her last—for she was dying—she named her son Ben-Oni. But his father named him Benjamin.
chapters.zh: 她将近于死，灵魂要走的时候，就给她儿子起名叫便俄尼。他父亲却给他起名叫便雅悯。

chapters.en: So Rachel died and was buried on the way to Ephrath (that is, Bethlehem).
chapters.zh: 拉结死了，葬在以法他的路旁。以法他就是伯利恒。

chapters.en: Over her tomb Jacob set up a pillar, and to this day that pillar marks Rachel’s tomb.
chapters.zh: 雅各在她的坟上立了一统碑，就是拉结的墓碑，到今日还在。

chapters.en: Israel moved on again and pitched his tent beyond Migdal Eder.
chapters.zh: 以色列起行前往，在以得台那边支搭帐棚。

chapters.en: While Israel was living in that region, Reuben went in and slept with his father’s concubine Bilhah, and Israel heard of it. Jacob had twelve sons:
chapters.zh: 以色列住在那地的时候，流便去与他父亲的妾辟拉同寝，以色列也听见了。雅各共有十二个儿子。

chapters.en: The sons of Leah: Reuben the firstborn of Jacob, Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar and Zebulun.
chapters.zh: 利亚所生的是雅各的长子流便，还有西缅，利未，犹大，以萨迦，西布伦。

chapters.en: The sons of Rachel: Joseph and Benjamin.
chapters.zh: 拉结所生的是约瑟，便雅悯。

chapters.en: The sons of Rachel’s servant Bilhah: Dan and Naphtali.
chapters.zh: 拉结的使女辟拉所生的是但，拿弗他利。

chapters.en: The sons of Leah’s servant Zilpah: Gad and Asher. These were the sons of Jacob, who were born to him in Paddan Aram.
chapters.zh: 利亚的使女悉帕所生的是迦得，亚设。这是雅各在巴旦亚兰所生的儿子。

chapters.en: Jacob came home to his father Isaac in Mamre, near Kiriath Arba (that is, Hebron), where Abraham and Isaac had stayed.
chapters.zh: 雅各来到他父亲以撒那里，到了基列亚巴的幔利，乃是亚伯拉罕和以撒寄居的地方。基列亚巴就是希伯仑。

chapters.en: Isaac lived a hundred and eighty years.
chapters.zh: 以撒共活了一百八十岁。

chapters.en: Then he breathed his last and died and was gathered to his people, old and full of years. And his sons Esau and Jacob buried him.
chapters.zh: 以撒年纪老迈，日子满足，气绝而死，归到他列祖（原文作本民）那里。他两个儿子以扫，雅各把他埋葬了。

chapters.en: This is the account of the family line of Esau (that is, Edom).
chapters.zh: 以扫就是以东，他的后代记在下面。

chapters.en: Esau took his wives from the women of Canaan: Adah daughter of Elon the Hittite, and Oholibamah daughter of Anah and granddaughter of Zibeon the Hivite—
chapters.zh: 以扫娶迦南的女子为妻，就是赫人以伦的女儿亚大和希未人祭便的孙女，亚拿的女儿阿何利巴玛，

chapters.en: also Basemath daughter of Ishmael and sister of Nebaioth.
chapters.zh: 又娶了以实玛利的女儿，尼拜约的妹子巴实抹。

chapters.en: Adah bore Eliphaz to Esau, Basemath bore Reuel,
chapters.zh: 亚大给以扫生了以利法。巴实抹生了流珥。

chapters.en: and Oholibamah bore Jeush, Jalam and Korah. These were the sons of Esau, who were born to him in Canaan.
chapters.zh: 阿何利巴玛生了耶乌施，雅兰，可拉。这都是以扫的儿子，是在迦南地生的。

chapters.en: Esau took his wives and sons and daughters and all the members of his household, as well as his livestock and all his other animals and all the goods he had acquired in Canaan, and moved to a land some distance from his brother Jacob.
chapters.zh: 以扫带着他的妻子，儿女，与家中一切的人口，并他的牛羊，牲畜，和一切货财，就是他在迦南地所得的，往别处去，离了他兄弟雅各。

chapters.en: Their possessions were too great for them to remain together; the land where they were staying could not support them both because of their livestock.
chapters.zh: 因为二人的财物群畜甚多，寄居的地方容不下他们，所以不能同居。

chapters.en: So Esau (that is, Edom) settled in the hill country of Seir.
chapters.zh: 于是以扫住在西珥山里。以扫就是以东。

chapters.en: This is the account of the family line of Esau the father of the Edomites in the hill country of Seir.
chapters.zh: 以扫是西珥山里以东人的始祖，他的后代记在下面。

chapters.en: These are the names of Esau’s sons: Eliphaz, the son of Esau’s wife Adah, and Reuel, the son of Esau’s wife Basemath.
chapters.zh: 以扫众子的名字如下。以扫的妻子亚大生以利法。以扫的妻子巴实抹生流珥。

chapters.en: The sons of Eliphaz: Teman, Omar, Zepho, Gatam and Kenaz.
chapters.zh: 以利法的儿子是提幔，阿抹，洗玻，迦坦，基纳斯。

chapters.en: Esau’s son Eliphaz also had a concubine named Timna, who bore him Amalek. These were grandsons of Esau’s wife Adah.
chapters.zh: 亭纳是以扫儿子以利法的妾。她给以利法生了亚玛力。这是以扫的妻子亚大的子孙。

chapters.en: The sons of Reuel: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah and Mizzah. These were grandsons of Esau’s wife Basemath.
chapters.zh: 流珥的儿子是拿哈，谢拉，沙玛，米撒。这是以扫妻子巴实抹的子孙。

chapters.en: The sons of Esau’s wife Oholibamah daughter of Anah and granddaughter of Zibeon, whom she bore to Esau: Jeush, Jalam and Korah.
chapters.zh: 以扫的妻子阿何利巴玛是祭便的孙女，亚拿的女儿。她给以扫生了耶乌施，雅兰，可拉。

chapters.en: These were the chiefs among Esau’s descendants: The sons of Eliphaz the firstborn of Esau: Chiefs Teman, Omar, Zepho, Kenaz,
chapters.zh: 以扫子孙中作族长的记在下面。以扫的长子以利法的子孙中，有提幔族长，阿抹族长，洗玻族长，基纳斯族长，

chapters.en: Korah, Gatam and Amalek. These were the chiefs descended from Eliphaz in Edom; they were grandsons of Adah.
chapters.zh: 可拉族长，迦坦族长，亚玛力族长。这是在以东地从以利法所出的族长，都是亚大的子孙。

chapters.en: The sons of Esau’s son Reuel: Chiefs Nahath, Zerah, Shammah and Mizzah. These were the chiefs descended from Reuel in Edom; they were grandsons of Esau’s wife Basemath.
chapters.zh: 以扫的儿子流珥的子孙中，有拿哈族长，谢拉族长，沙玛族长，米撒族长。这是在以东地从流珥所出的族长，都是以扫妻子巴实抹的子孙。

chapters.en: The sons of Esau’s wife Oholibamah: Chiefs Jeush, Jalam and Korah. These were the chiefs descended from Esau’s wife Oholibamah daughter of Anah.
chapters.zh: 以扫的妻子阿何利巴玛的子孙中，有耶乌施族长，雅兰族长，可拉族长。这是从以扫妻子，亚拿的女儿，阿何利巴玛子孙中所出的族长。

chapters.en: These were the sons of Esau (that is, Edom), and these were their chiefs.
chapters.zh: 以上的族长都是以扫的子孙。以扫就是以东。

chapters.en: These were the sons of Seir the Horite, who were living in the region: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah,
chapters.zh: 那地原有的居民何利人西珥的子孙记在下面，就是罗坍，朔巴，祭便，亚拿，

chapters.en: Dishon, Ezer and Dishan. These sons of Seir in Edom were Horite chiefs.
chapters.zh: 底顺，以察，底珊。这是从以东地的何利人西珥子孙中所出的族长。

chapters.en: The sons of Lotan: Hori and Homam. Timna was Lotan’s sister.
chapters.zh: 罗坍的儿子是何利，希幔。罗坍的妹子是亭纳。

chapters.en: The sons of Shobal: Alvan, Manahath, Ebal, Shepho and Onam.
chapters.zh: 朔巴的儿子是亚勒文，玛拿辖，以巴录，示玻，阿南。

chapters.en: The sons of Zibeon: Aiah and Anah. This is the Anah who discovered the hot springs in the desert while he was grazing the donkeys of his father Zibeon.
chapters.zh: 祭便的儿子是亚雅，亚拿（当时在旷野放他父亲祭便的驴，遇着温泉的，就是这亚拿）。

chapters.en: The children of Anah: Dishon and Oholibamah daughter of Anah.
chapters.zh: 亚拿的儿子是底顺。亚拿的女儿是阿何利巴玛。

chapters.en: The sons of Dishon : Hemdan, Eshban, Ithran and Keran.
chapters.zh: 底顺的儿子是欣但，伊是班，益兰，基兰。

chapters.en: The sons of Ezer: Bilhan, Zaavan and Akan.
chapters.zh: 以察的儿子是辟罕，撒番，亚干。

chapters.en: The sons of Dishan: Uz and Aran.
chapters.zh: 底珊的儿子是乌斯，亚兰。

chapters.en: These were the Horite chiefs: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah,
chapters.zh: 从何利人所出的族长记在下面，就是罗坍族长，朔巴族长，祭便族长，亚拿族长，

chapters.en: Dishon, Ezer and Dishan. These were the Horite chiefs, according to their divisions, in the land of Seir.
chapters.zh: 底顺族长，以察族长，底珊族长。这是从何利人所出的族长，都在西珥地，按着宗族作族长。

chapters.en: These were the kings who reigned in Edom before any Israelite king reigned:
chapters.zh: 以色列人未有君王治理以先，在以东地作王的记在下面。

chapters.en: Bela son of Beor became king of Edom. His city was named Dinhabah.
chapters.zh: 比珥的儿子比拉在以东作王，他的京城名叫亭哈巴。

chapters.en: When Bela died, Jobab son of Zerah from Bozrah succeeded him as king.
chapters.zh: 比拉死了，波斯拉人谢拉的儿子约巴接续他作王。

chapters.en: When Jobab died, Husham from the land of the Temanites succeeded him as king.
chapters.zh: 约巴死了，提幔地的人户珊接续他作王。

chapters.en: When Husham died, Hadad son of Bedad, who defeated Midian in the country of Moab, succeeded him as king. His city was named Avith.
chapters.zh: 户珊死了，比达的儿子哈达接续他作王。这哈达就是在摩押地杀败米甸人的，他的京城名叫亚未得。

chapters.en: When Hadad died, Samlah from Masrekah succeeded him as king.
chapters.zh: 哈达死了，玛士利加人桑拉接续他作王。

chapters.en: When Samlah died, Shaul from Rehoboth on the river succeeded him as king.
chapters.zh: 桑拉死了，大河边的利河伯人扫罗接续他作王。

chapters.en: When Shaul died, Baal-Hanan son of Akbor succeeded him as king.
chapters.zh: 扫罗死了，亚革波的儿子巴勒哈南接续他作王。

chapters.en: When Baal-Hanan son of Akbor died, Hadad succeeded him as king. His city was named Pau, and his wife’s name was Mehetabel daughter of Matred, the daughter of Me-Zahab.
chapters.zh: 亚革波的儿子巴勒哈南死了，哈达接续他作王，他的京城名叫巴乌。他的妻子名叫米希他别，是米萨合的孙女，玛特列的女儿。

chapters.en: These were the chiefs descended from Esau, by name, according to their clans and regions: Timna, Alvah, Jetheth,
chapters.zh: 从以扫所出的族长，按着他们的宗族，住处，名字记在下面，就是亭纳族长，亚勒瓦族长，耶帖族长，

chapters.en: Oholibamah, Elah, Pinon,
chapters.zh: 阿何利巴玛族长，以拉族长，比嫩族长，

chapters.en: Kenaz, Teman, Mibzar,
chapters.zh: 基纳斯族长，提幔族长，米比萨族长，

chapters.en: Magdiel and Iram. These were the chiefs of Edom, according to their settlements in the land they occupied. This is the family line of Esau, the father of the Edomites.
chapters.zh: 玛基叠族长，以兰族长。这是以东人在所得为业的地上，按着他们的住处，所有的族长都是以东人的始祖以扫的后代。

chapters.en: Jacob lived in the land where his father had stayed, the land of Canaan.
chapters.zh: 雅各住在迦南地，就是他父亲寄居的地。

chapters.en: This is the account of Jacob’s family line. Joseph, a young man of seventeen, was tending the flocks with his brothers, the sons of Bilhah and the sons of Zilpah, his father’s wives, and he brought their father a bad report about them.
chapters.zh: 雅各的记略如下。约瑟十七岁与他哥哥们一同牧羊。他是个童子，与他父亲的妾辟拉，悉帕的儿子们常在一处。约瑟将他哥哥们的恶行报给他们的父亲。

chapters.en: Now Israel loved Joseph more than any of his other sons, because he had been born to him in his old age; and he made an ornate robe for him.
chapters.zh: 以色列原来爱约瑟过于爱他的众子，因为约瑟是他年老生的。他给约瑟作了一件彩衣。

chapters.en: When his brothers saw that their father loved him more than any of them, they hated him and could not speak a kind word to him.
chapters.zh: 约瑟的哥哥们见父亲爱约瑟过于爱他们，就恨约瑟，不与他说和睦的话。

chapters.en: Joseph had a dream, and when he told it to his brothers, they hated him all the more.
chapters.zh: 约瑟作了一梦，告诉他哥哥们，他们就越发恨他。

chapters.en: He said to them, “Listen to this dream I had:
chapters.zh: 约瑟对他们说，请听我所作的梦，

chapters.en: We were binding sheaves of grain out in the field when suddenly my sheaf rose and stood upright, while your sheaves gathered around mine and bowed down to it.”
chapters.zh: 我们在田里捆禾稼，我的捆起来站着，你们的捆来围着我的捆下拜。

chapters.en: His brothers said to him, “Do you intend to reign over us? Will you actually rule us?” And they hated him all the more because of his dream and what he had said.
chapters.zh: 他的哥哥们回答说，难道你真要作我们的王吗？难道你真要管辖我们吗？他们就因为他的梦和他的话越发恨他。

chapters.en: Then he had another dream, and he told it to his brothers. “Listen,” he said, “I had another dream, and this time the sun and moon and eleven stars were bowing down to me.”
chapters.zh: 后来他又作了一梦，也告诉他的哥哥们说，看哪，我又作了一梦，梦见太阳，月亮，与十一个星向我下拜。

chapters.en: When he told his father as well as his brothers, his father rebuked him and said, “What is this dream you had? Will your mother and I and your brothers actually come and bow down to the ground before you?”
chapters.zh: 约瑟将这梦告诉他父亲和他哥哥们，他父亲就责备他说，你作的这是什么梦。难道我和你母亲，你弟兄果然要来俯伏在地，向你下拜吗？

chapters.en: His brothers were jealous of him, but his father kept the matter in mind.
chapters.zh: 他哥哥们都嫉妒他，他父亲却把这话存在心里。

chapters.en: Now his brothers had gone to graze their father’s flocks near Shechem,
chapters.zh: 约瑟的哥哥们往示剑去放他们父亲的羊。

chapters.en: and Israel said to Joseph, “As you know, your brothers are grazing the flocks near Shechem. Come, I am going to send you to them.” “Very well,” he replied.
chapters.zh: 以色列对约瑟说，你哥哥们不是在示剑放羊吗？你来，我要打发你往他们那里去。约瑟说，我在这里。

chapters.en: So he said to him, “Go and see if all is well with your brothers and with the flocks, and bring word back to me.” Then he sent him off from the Valley of Hebron. When Joseph arrived at Shechem,
chapters.zh: 以色列说，你去看看你哥哥们平安不平安，群羊平安不平安，就回来报信给我。于是打发他出希伯仑谷，他就往示剑去了。

chapters.en: a man found him wandering around in the fields and asked him, “What are you looking for?”
chapters.zh: 有人遇见他在田野走迷了路，就问他说，你找什么？

chapters.en: He replied, “I’m looking for my brothers. Can you tell me where they are grazing their flocks?”
chapters.zh: 他说，我找我的哥哥们，求你告诉我，他们在何处放羊。

chapters.en: “They have moved on from here,” the man answered. “I heard them say, ‘Let’s go to Dothan.’ ” So Joseph went after his brothers and found them near Dothan.
chapters.zh: 那人说，他们已经走了，我听见他们说要往多坍去。约瑟就去追赶他哥哥们，遇见他们在多坍。

chapters.en: But they saw him in the distance, and before he reached them, they plotted to kill him.
chapters.zh: 他们远远地看见他，趁他还没有走到跟前，大家就同谋要害死他，

chapters.en: “Here comes that dreamer!” they said to each other.
chapters.zh: 彼此说，你看。那作梦的来了。

chapters.en: “Come now, let’s kill him and throw him into one of these cisterns and say that a ferocious animal devoured him. Then we’ll see what comes of his dreams.”
chapters.zh: 来吧。我们将他杀了，丢在一个坑里，就说有恶兽把他吃了。我们且看他的梦将来怎么样。

chapters.en: When Reuben heard this, he tried to rescue him from their hands. “Let’s not take his life,” he said.
chapters.zh: 流便听见了，要救他脱离他们的手，说，我们不可害他的性命。

chapters.en: “Don’t shed any blood. Throw him into this cistern here in the wilderness, but don’t lay a hand on him.” Reuben said this to rescue him from them and take him back to his father.
chapters.zh: 又说，不可流他的血，可以把他丢在这野地的坑里，不可下手害他。流便的意思是要救他脱离他们的手，把他归还他的父亲。

chapters.en: So when Joseph came to his brothers, they stripped him of his robe—the ornate robe he was wearing—
chapters.zh: 约瑟到了他哥哥们那里，他们就剥了他的外衣，就是他穿的那件彩衣，

chapters.en: and they took him and threw him into the cistern. The cistern was empty; there was no water in it.
chapters.zh: 把他丢在坑里。那坑是空的，里头没有水。

chapters.en: As they sat down to eat their meal, they looked up and saw a caravan of Ishmaelites coming from Gilead. Their camels were loaded with spices, balm and myrrh, and they were on their way to take them down to Egypt.
chapters.zh: 他们坐下吃饭，举目观看，见有一伙米甸的以实玛利人从基列来，用骆驼驮着香料，乳香，没药，要带下埃及去。

chapters.en: Judah said to his brothers, “What will we gain if we kill our brother and cover up his blood?
chapters.zh: 犹大对众弟兄说，我们杀我们的兄弟，藏了他的血有什么益处呢？

chapters.en: Come, let’s sell him to the Ishmaelites and not lay our hands on him; after all, he is our brother, our own flesh and blood.” His brothers agreed.
chapters.zh: 我们不如将他卖给以实玛利人，不可下手害他。因为他是我们的兄弟，我们的骨肉。众弟兄就听从了他。

chapters.en: So when the Midianite merchants came by, his brothers pulled Joseph up out of the cistern and sold him for twenty shekels of silver to the Ishmaelites, who took him to Egypt.
chapters.zh: 有些米甸的商人从那里经过，哥哥们就把约瑟从坑里拉上来，讲定二十舍客勒银子，把约瑟卖给以实玛利人。他们就把约瑟带到埃及去了。

chapters.en: When Reuben returned to the cistern and saw that Joseph was not there, he tore his clothes.
chapters.zh: 流便回到坑边，见约瑟不在坑里，就撕裂衣服，

chapters.en: He went back to his brothers and said, “The boy isn’t there! Where can I turn now?”
chapters.zh: 回到兄弟们那里，说，童子没有了。我往哪里去才好呢？

chapters.en: Then they got Joseph’s robe, slaughtered a goat and dipped the robe in the blood.
chapters.zh: 他们宰了一只公山羊，把约瑟的那件彩衣染了血，

chapters.en: They took the ornate robe back to their father and said, “We found this. Examine it to see whether it is your son’s robe.”
chapters.zh: 打发人送到他们的父亲那里，说，我们捡了这个。请认一认是你儿子的外衣不是，

chapters.en: He recognized it and said, “It is my son’s robe! Some ferocious animal has devoured him. Joseph has surely been torn to pieces.”
chapters.zh: 他认得，就说，这是我儿子的外衣。有恶兽把他吃了，约瑟被撕碎了。撕碎了。

chapters.en: Then Jacob tore his clothes, put on sackcloth and mourned for his son many days.
chapters.zh: 雅各便撕裂衣服，腰间围上麻布，为他儿子悲哀了多日。

chapters.en: All his sons and daughters came to comfort him, but he refused to be comforted. “No,” he said, “I will continue to mourn until I join my son in the grave.” So his father wept for him.
chapters.zh: 他的儿女都起来安慰他，他却不肯受安慰，说，我必悲哀着下阴间，到我儿子那里。约瑟的父亲就为他哀哭。

chapters.en: Meanwhile, the Midianites sold Joseph in Egypt to Potiphar, one of Pharaoh’s officials, the captain of the guard.
chapters.zh: 米甸人带约瑟到埃及，把他卖给法老的内臣护卫长波提乏。

chapters.en: At that time, Judah left his brothers and went down to stay with a man of Adullam named Hirah.
chapters.zh: 那时，犹大离开他弟兄下去，到一个亚杜兰人名叫希拉的家里去。

chapters.en: There Judah met the daughter of a Canaanite man named Shua. He married her and made love to her;
chapters.zh: 犹大在那里看见一个迦南人名叫书亚的女儿，就娶她为妻，与她同房，

chapters.en: she became pregnant and gave birth to a son, who was named Er.
chapters.zh: 她就怀孕生了儿子，犹大给他起名叫珥。

chapters.en: She conceived again and gave birth to a son and named him Onan.
chapters.zh: 她又怀孕生了儿子，母亲给他起名叫俄南。

chapters.en: She gave birth to still another son and named him Shelah. It was at Kezib that she gave birth to him.
chapters.zh: 她复又生了儿子，给他起名叫示拉。她生示拉的时候，犹大正在基悉。

chapters.en: Judah got a wife for Er, his firstborn, and her name was Tamar.
chapters.zh: 犹大为长子珥娶妻，名叫他玛。

chapters.en: But Er, Judah’s firstborn, was wicked in the LORD’s sight; so the LORD put him to death.
chapters.zh: 犹大的长子珥在耶和华眼中看为恶，耶和华就叫他死了。

chapters.en: Then Judah said to Onan, “Sleep with your brother’s wife and fulfill your duty to her as a brother-in-law to raise up offspring for your brother.”
chapters.zh: 犹大对俄南说，你当与你哥哥的妻子同房，向她尽你为弟的本分，为你哥哥生子立后。

chapters.en: But Onan knew that the child would not be his; so whenever he slept with his brother’s wife, he spilled his semen on the ground to keep from providing offspring for his brother.
chapters.zh: 俄南知道生子不归自己，所以同房的时候便遗在地，免得给他哥哥留后。

chapters.en: What he did was wicked in the LORD’s sight; so the LORD put him to death also.
chapters.zh: 俄南所作的在耶和华眼中看为恶，耶和华也就叫他死了。

chapters.en: Judah then said to his daughter-in-law Tamar, “Live as a widow in your father’s household until my son Shelah grows up.” For he thought, “He may die too, just like his brothers.” So Tamar went to live in her father’s household.
chapters.zh: 犹大心里说，恐怕示拉也死，像他两个哥哥一样，就对他儿妇他玛说，你去，在你父亲家里守寡，等我儿子示拉长大。他玛就回去，住在她父亲家里。

chapters.en: After a long time Judah’s wife, the daughter of Shua, died. When Judah had recovered from his grief, he went up to Timnah, to the men who were shearing his sheep, and his friend Hirah the Adullamite went with him.
chapters.zh: 过了许久，犹大的妻子书亚的女儿死了。犹大得了安慰，就和他朋友亚杜兰人希拉上亭拿去，到他剪羊毛的人那里。

chapters.en: When Tamar was told, “Your father-in-law is on his way to Timnah to shear his sheep,”
chapters.zh: 有人告诉他玛说，你的公公上亭拿剪羊毛去了。

chapters.en: she took off her widow’s clothes, covered herself with a veil to disguise herself, and then sat down at the entrance to Enaim, which is on the road to Timnah. For she saw that, though Shelah had now grown up, she had not been given to him as his wife.
chapters.zh: 他玛见示拉已经长大，还没有娶她为妻，就脱了她作寡妇的衣裳，用帕子蒙着脸，又遮住身体，坐在亭拿路上的伊拿印城门口。

chapters.en: When Judah saw her, he thought she was a prostitute, for she had covered her face.
chapters.zh: 犹大看见她，以为是妓女，因为她蒙着脸。

chapters.en: Not realizing that she was his daughter-in-law, he went over to her by the roadside and said, “Come now, let me sleep with you.” “And what will you give me to sleep with you?” she asked.
chapters.zh: 犹大就转到她那里去，说，来吧。让我与你同寝。他原不知道是他的儿妇。他玛说，你要与我同寝，把什么给我呢？

chapters.en: “I’ll send you a young goat from my flock,” he said. “Will you give me something as a pledge until you send it?” she asked.
chapters.zh: 犹大说，我从羊群里取一只山羊羔，打发人送来给你。他玛说，在未送以先，你愿意给我一个当头吗？

chapters.en: He said, “What pledge should I give you?” “Your seal and its cord, and the staff in your hand,” she answered. So he gave them to her and slept with her, and she became pregnant by him.
chapters.zh: 他说，我给你什么当头呢？他玛说，你的印，你的带子，和你手里的杖。犹大就给了她，与她同寝，她就从犹大怀了孕。

chapters.en: After she left, she took off her veil and put on her widow’s clothes again.
chapters.zh: 他玛起来走了，除去帕子，仍旧穿上作寡妇的衣裳。

chapters.en: Meanwhile Judah sent the young goat by his friend the Adullamite in order to get his pledge back from the woman, but he did not find her.
chapters.zh: 犹大托他朋友亚杜兰人送一只山羊羔去，要从那女人手里取回当头来，却找不着她。

chapters.en: He asked the men who lived there, “Where is the shrine prostitute who was beside the road at Enaim?” “There hasn’t been any shrine prostitute here,” they said.
chapters.zh: 就问那地方的人说，伊拿印路旁的妓女在哪里，他们说，这里并没有妓女。

chapters.en: So he went back to Judah and said, “I didn’t find her. Besides, the men who lived there said, ‘There hasn’t been any shrine prostitute here.’ ”
chapters.zh: 他回去见犹大说，我没有找着她，并且那地方的人说，这里没有妓女。

chapters.en: Then Judah said, “Let her keep what she has, or we will become a laughingstock. After all, I did send her this young goat, but you didn’t find her.”
chapters.zh: 犹大说，我把这山羊羔送去了，你竟找不着她。任凭她拿去吧，免得我们被羞辱。

chapters.en: About three months later Judah was told, “Your daughter-in-law Tamar is guilty of prostitution, and as a result she is now pregnant.” Judah said, “Bring her out and have her burned to death!”
chapters.zh: 约过了三个月，有人告诉犹大说，你的儿妇他玛作了妓女，且因行淫有了身孕。犹大说，拉出她来，把她烧了。

chapters.en: As she was being brought out, she sent a message to her father-in-law. “I am pregnant by the man who owns these,” she said. And she added, “See if you recognize whose seal and cord and staff these are.”
chapters.zh: 他玛被拉出来的时候便打发人去见她公公，对他说，这些东西是谁的，我就是从谁怀的孕。请你认一认，这印和带子并杖都是谁的，

chapters.en: Judah recognized them and said, “She is more righteous than I, since I wouldn’t give her to my son Shelah.” And he did not sleep with her again.
chapters.zh: 犹大承认说，她比我更有义，因为我没有将她给我的儿子示拉。从此犹大不再与她同寝了。

chapters.en: When the time came for her to give birth, there were twin boys in her womb.
chapters.zh: 他玛将要生产，不料她腹里是一对双生。

chapters.en: As she was giving birth, one of them put out his hand; so the midwife took a scarlet thread and tied it on his wrist and said, “This one came out first.”
chapters.zh: 到生产的时候，一个孩子伸出一只手来。收生婆拿红线拴在他手上，说，这是头生的。

chapters.en: But when he drew back his hand, his brother came out, and she said, “So this is how you have broken out!” And he was named Perez.
chapters.zh: 随后这孩子把手收回去，他哥哥生出来了。收生婆说，你为什么抢着来呢？因此给他起名叫法勒斯。

chapters.en: Then his brother, who had the scarlet thread on his wrist, came out. And he was named Zerah.
chapters.zh: 后来，他兄弟那手上有红线的也生出来，就给他起名叫谢拉。

chapters.en: Now Joseph had been taken down to Egypt. Potiphar, an Egyptian who was one of Pharaoh’s officials, the captain of the guard, bought him from the Ishmaelites who had taken him there.
chapters.zh: 约瑟被带下埃及去。有一个埃及人，是法老的内臣，护卫长波提乏，从那些带下他来的以实玛利人手下买了他去。

chapters.en: The LORD was with Joseph so that he prospered, and he lived in the house of his Egyptian master.
chapters.zh: 约瑟住在他主人埃及人的家中，耶和华与他同在，他就百事顺利。

chapters.en: When his master saw that the LORD was with him and that the LORD gave him success in everything he did,
chapters.zh: 他主人见耶和华与他同在，又见耶和华使他手里所办的尽都顺利，

chapters.en: Joseph found favor in his eyes and became his attendant. Potiphar put him in charge of his household, and he entrusted to his care everything he owned.
chapters.zh: 约瑟就在主人眼前蒙恩，伺候他主人，并且主人派他管理家务，把一切所有的都交在他手里。

chapters.en: From the time he put him in charge of his household and of all that he owned, the LORD blessed the household of the Egyptian because of Joseph. The blessing of the LORD was on everything Potiphar had, both in the house and in the field.
chapters.zh: 自从主人派约瑟管理家务和他一切所有的，耶和华就因约瑟的缘故赐福与那埃及人的家。凡家里和田间一切所有的都蒙耶和华赐福。

chapters.en: So Potiphar left everything he had in Joseph’s care; with Joseph in charge, he did not concern himself with anything except the food he ate. Now Joseph was well-built and handsome,
chapters.zh: 波提乏将一切所有的都交在约瑟的手中，除了自己所吃的饭，别的事一概不知。约瑟原来秀雅俊美。

chapters.en: and after a while his master’s wife took notice of Joseph and said, “Come to bed with me!”
chapters.zh: 这事以后，约瑟主人的妻以目送情给约瑟，说，你与我同寝吧。

chapters.en: But he refused. “With me in charge,” he told her, “my master does not concern himself with anything in the house; everything he owns he has entrusted to my care.
chapters.zh: 约瑟不从，对他主人的妻说，看哪，一切家务，我主人都不知道。他把所有的都交在我手里。

chapters.en: No one is greater in this house than I am. My master has withheld nothing from me except you, because you are his wife. How then could I do such a wicked thing and sin against God?”
chapters.zh: 在这家里没有比我大的。并且他没有留下一样不交给我，只留下了你，因为你是他的妻子。我怎能作这大恶，得罪神呢？

chapters.en: And though she spoke to Joseph day after day, he refused to go to bed with her or even be with her.
chapters.zh: 后来她天天和约瑟说，约瑟却不听从她，不与她同寝，也不和她在一处。

chapters.en: One day he went into the house to attend to his duties, and none of the household servants was inside.
chapters.zh: 有一天，约瑟进屋里去办事，家中人没有一个在那屋里，

chapters.en: She caught him by his cloak and said, “Come to bed with me!” But he left his cloak in her hand and ran out of the house.
chapters.zh: 妇人就拉住他的衣裳，说，你与我同寝吧。约瑟把衣裳丢在妇人手里，跑到外边去了。

chapters.en: When she saw that he had left his cloak in her hand and had run out of the house,
chapters.zh: 妇人看见约瑟把衣裳丢在她手里跑出去了，

chapters.en: she called her household servants. “Look,” she said to them, “this Hebrew has been brought to us to make sport of us! He came in here to sleep with me, but I screamed.
chapters.zh: 就叫了家里的人来，对他们说，你们看。他带了一个希伯来人进入我们家里，要戏弄我们。他到我这里来，要与我同寝，我就大声喊叫。

chapters.en: When he heard me scream for help, he left his cloak beside me and ran out of the house.”
chapters.zh: 他听见我放声喊起来，就把衣裳丢在我这里，跑到外边去了。

chapters.en: She kept his cloak beside her until his master came home.
chapters.zh: 妇人把约瑟的衣裳放在自己那里，等着他主人回家，

chapters.en: Then she told him this story: “That Hebrew slave you brought us came to me to make sport of me.
chapters.zh: 就对他如此如此说，你所带到我们这里的那希伯来仆人进来要戏弄我，

chapters.en: But as soon as I screamed for help, he left his cloak beside me and ran out of the house.”
chapters.zh: 我放声喊起来，他就把衣裳丢在我这里，跑出去了。

chapters.en: When his master heard the story his wife told him, saying, “This is how your slave treated me,” he burned with anger.
chapters.zh: 约瑟的主人听见他妻子对他所说的话，说，你的仆人如此如此待我，他就生气，

chapters.en: Joseph’s master took him and put him in prison, the place where the king’s prisoners were confined. But while Joseph was there in the prison,
chapters.zh: 把约瑟下在监里，就是王的囚犯被囚的地方。于是约瑟在那里坐监。

chapters.en: the LORD was with him; he showed him kindness and granted him favor in the eyes of the prison warden.
chapters.zh: 但耶和华与约瑟同在，向他施恩，使他在司狱的眼前蒙恩。

chapters.en: So the warden put Joseph in charge of all those held in the prison, and he was made responsible for all that was done there.
chapters.zh: 司狱就把监里所有的囚犯都交在约瑟手下。他们在那里所办的事都是经他的手。

chapters.en: The warden paid no attention to anything under Joseph’s care, because the LORD was with Joseph and gave him success in whatever he did.
chapters.zh: 凡在约瑟手下的事，司狱一概不察，因为耶和华与约瑟同在。耶和华使他所作的尽都顺利。

chapters.en: Some time later, the cupbearer and the baker of the king of Egypt offended their master, the king of Egypt.
chapters.zh: 这事以后，埃及王的酒政和膳长得罪了他们的主埃及王，

chapters.en: Pharaoh was angry with his two officials, the chief cupbearer and the chief baker,
chapters.zh: 法老就恼怒酒政和膳长这二臣，

chapters.en: and put them in custody in the house of the captain of the guard, in the same prison where Joseph was confined.
chapters.zh: 把他们下在护卫长府内的监里，就是约瑟被囚的地方。

chapters.en: The captain of the guard assigned them to Joseph, and he attended them. After they had been in custody for some time,
chapters.zh: 护卫长把他们交给约瑟，约瑟便伺候他们。他们有些日子在监里。

chapters.en: each of the two men—the cupbearer and the baker of the king of Egypt, who were being held in prison—had a dream the same night, and each dream had a meaning of its own.
chapters.zh: 被囚在监之埃及王的酒政和膳长二人同夜各作一梦，各梦都有讲解。

chapters.en: When Joseph came to them the next morning, he saw that they were dejected.
chapters.zh: 到了早晨，约瑟进到他们那里，见他们有愁闷的样子。

chapters.en: So he asked Pharaoh’s officials who were in custody with him in his master’s house, “Why do you look so sad today?”
chapters.zh: 他便问法老的二臣，就是与他同囚在他主人府里的，说，他们今日为什么面带愁容呢？

chapters.en: “We both had dreams,” they answered, “but there is no one to interpret them.” Then Joseph said to them, “Do not interpretations belong to God? Tell me your dreams.”
chapters.zh: 他们对他说，我们各人作了一梦，没有人能解。约瑟说，解梦不是出于神吗？请你们将梦告诉我。

chapters.en: So the chief cupbearer told Joseph his dream. He said to him, “In my dream I saw a vine in front of me,
chapters.zh: 酒政便将他的梦告诉约瑟说，我梦见在我面前有一棵葡萄树，

chapters.en: and on the vine were three branches. As soon as it budded, it blossomed, and its clusters ripened into grapes.
chapters.zh: 树上有三根枝子，好像发了芽，开了花，上头的葡萄都成熟了。

chapters.en: Pharaoh’s cup was in my hand, and I took the grapes, squeezed them into Pharaoh’s cup and put the cup in his hand.”
chapters.zh: 法老的杯在我手中，我就拿葡萄挤在法老的杯里，将杯递在他手中。

chapters.en: “This is what it means,” Joseph said to him. “The three branches are three days.
chapters.zh: 约瑟对他说，他所作的梦是这样解，三根枝子就是三天。

chapters.en: Within three days Pharaoh will lift up your head and restore you to your position, and you will put Pharaoh’s cup in his hand, just as you used to do when you were his cupbearer.
chapters.zh: 三天之内，法老必提你出监，叫你官复原职，你仍要递杯在法老的手中，和先前作他的酒政一样。

chapters.en: But when all goes well with you, remember me and show me kindness; mention me to Pharaoh and get me out of this prison.
chapters.zh: 但你得好处的时候，求你记念我，施恩与我，在法老面前提说我，救我出这监牢。

chapters.en: I was forcibly carried off from the land of the Hebrews, and even here I have done nothing to deserve being put in a dungeon.”
chapters.zh: 我实在是从希伯来人之地被拐来的。我在这里也没有作过什么，叫他们把我下在监里。

chapters.en: When the chief baker saw that Joseph had given a favorable interpretation, he said to Joseph, “I too had a dream: On my head were three baskets of bread.
chapters.zh: 膳长见梦解得好，就对约瑟说，我在梦中见我头上顶着三筐白饼。

chapters.en: In the top basket were all kinds of baked goods for Pharaoh, but the birds were eating them out of the basket on my head.”
chapters.zh: 极上的筐子里有为法老烤的各样食物，有飞鸟来吃我头上筐子里的食物。

chapters.en: “This is what it means,” Joseph said. “The three baskets are three days.
chapters.zh: 约瑟说，你的梦是这样解，三个筐子就是三天。

chapters.en: Within three days Pharaoh will lift off your head and impale your body on a pole. And the birds will eat away your flesh.”
chapters.zh: 三天之内，法老必斩断你的头，把你挂在木头上，必有飞鸟来吃你身上的肉。

chapters.en: Now the third day was Pharaoh’s birthday, and he gave a feast for all his officials. He lifted up the heads of the chief cupbearer and the chief baker in the presence of his officials:
chapters.zh: 到了第三天，是法老的生日，他为众臣仆设摆筵席，把酒政和膳长提出监来，

chapters.en: He restored the chief cupbearer to his position, so that he once again put the cup into Pharaoh’s hand—
chapters.zh: 使酒政官复原职，他仍旧递杯在法老手中。

chapters.en: but he impaled the chief baker, just as Joseph had said to them in his interpretation.
chapters.zh: 但把膳长挂起来，正如约瑟向他们所解的话。

chapters.en: The chief cupbearer, however, did not remember Joseph; he forgot him.
chapters.zh: 酒政却不记念约瑟，竟忘了他。

chapters.en: When two full years had passed, Pharaoh had a dream: He was standing by the Nile,
chapters.zh: 过了两年，法老作梦，梦见自己站在河边，

chapters.en: when out of the river there came up seven cows, sleek and fat, and they grazed among the reeds.
chapters.zh: 有七只母牛从河里上来，又美好又肥壮，在芦荻中吃草。

chapters.en: After them, seven other cows, ugly and gaunt, came up out of the Nile and stood beside those on the riverbank.
chapters.zh: 随后又有七只母牛从河里上来，又丑陋又干瘦，与那七只母牛一同站在河边。

chapters.en: And the cows that were ugly and gaunt ate up the seven sleek, fat cows. Then Pharaoh woke up.
chapters.zh: 这又丑陋又干瘦的七只母牛吃尽了那又美好又肥壮的七只母牛。法老就醒了。

chapters.en: He fell asleep again and had a second dream: Seven heads of grain, healthy and good, were growing on a single stalk.
chapters.zh: 他又睡着，第二回作梦，梦见一棵麦子长了七个穗子，又肥大又佳美，

chapters.en: After them, seven other heads of grain sprouted—thin and scorched by the east wind.
chapters.zh: 随后又长了七个穗子，又细弱又被东风吹焦了。

chapters.en: The thin heads of grain swallowed up the seven healthy, full heads. Then Pharaoh woke up; it had been a dream.
chapters.zh: 这细弱的穗子吞了那七个又肥大又饱满的穗子。法老醒了，不料是个梦。

chapters.en: In the morning his mind was troubled, so he sent for all the magicians and wise men of Egypt. Pharaoh told them his dreams, but no one could interpret them for him.
chapters.zh: 到了早晨，法老心里不安，就差人召了埃及所有的术士和博士来。法老就把所作的梦告诉他们，却没有人能给法老圆解。

chapters.en: Then the chief cupbearer said to Pharaoh, “Today I am reminded of my shortcomings.
chapters.zh: 那时酒政对法老说，我今日想起我的罪来。

chapters.en: Pharaoh was once angry with his servants, and he imprisoned me and the chief baker in the house of the captain of the guard.
chapters.zh: 从前法老恼怒臣仆，把我和膳长下在护卫长府布的监里。

chapters.en: Each of us had a dream the same night, and each dream had a meaning of its own.
chapters.zh: 我们二人同夜各作一梦，各梦都有讲解。

chapters.en: Now a young Hebrew was there with us, a servant of the captain of the guard. We told him our dreams, and he interpreted them for us, giving each man the interpretation of his dream.
chapters.zh: 在那里同着我们有一个希伯来的少年人，是护卫长的仆人，我们告诉他，他就把我们的梦圆解，是按着各人的梦圆解的。

chapters.en: And things turned out exactly as he interpreted them to us: I was restored to my position, and the other man was impaled.”
chapters.zh: 后来正如他给我们圆解的成就了。我官复原职，膳长被挂起来了。

chapters.en: So Pharaoh sent for Joseph, and he was quickly brought from the dungeon. When he had shaved and changed his clothes, he came before Pharaoh.
chapters.zh: 法老遂即差人去召约瑟，他们便急忙带他出监，他就剃头，刮脸，换衣裳，进到法老面前。

chapters.en: Pharaoh said to Joseph, “I had a dream, and no one can interpret it. But I have heard it said of you that when you hear a dream you can interpret it.”
chapters.zh: 法老对约瑟说，我作了一梦，没有人能解。我听见人说，你听了梦就能解。

chapters.en: “I cannot do it,” Joseph replied to Pharaoh, “but God will give Pharaoh the answer he desires.”
chapters.zh: 约瑟回答法老说，这不在乎我，神必将平安的话回答法老。

chapters.en: Then Pharaoh said to Joseph, “In my dream I was standing on the bank of the Nile,
chapters.zh: 法老对约瑟说，我梦见我站在河边，

chapters.en: when out of the river there came up seven cows, fat and sleek, and they grazed among the reeds.
chapters.zh: 有七只母牛从河里上来，又肥壮又美好，在芦荻中吃草。

chapters.en: After them, seven other cows came up—scrawny and very ugly and lean. I had never seen such ugly cows in all the land of Egypt.
chapters.zh: 随后又有七只母牛上来，又软弱又丑陋又干瘦，在埃及遍地，我没有见过这样不好的。

chapters.en: The lean, ugly cows ate up the seven fat cows that came up first.
chapters.zh: 这又干瘦又丑陋的母牛吃尽了那以先的七只肥母牛，

chapters.en: But even after they ate them, no one could tell that they had done so; they looked just as ugly as before. Then I woke up.
chapters.zh: 吃了以后却看不出是吃了，那丑陋的样子仍旧和先前一样。我就醒了。

chapters.en: “In my dream I saw seven heads of grain, full and good, growing on a single stalk.
chapters.zh: 我又梦见一棵麦子，长了七个穗子，又饱满又佳美，

chapters.en: After them, seven other heads sprouted—withered and thin and scorched by the east wind.
chapters.zh: 随后又长了七个穗子，枯槁细弱，被东风吹焦了。

chapters.en: The thin heads of grain swallowed up the seven good heads. I told this to the magicians, but none of them could explain it to me.”
chapters.zh: 这些细弱的穗子吞了那七个佳美的穗子。我将这梦告诉了术士，却没有人能给我解说。

chapters.en: Then Joseph said to Pharaoh, “The dreams of Pharaoh are one and the same. God has revealed to Pharaoh what he is about to do.
chapters.zh: 约瑟对法老说，法老的梦乃是一个。神已将所要作的事指示法老了。

chapters.en: The seven good cows are seven years, and the seven good heads of grain are seven years; it is one and the same dream.
chapters.zh: 七只好母牛是七年，七个好穗子也是七年。这梦乃是一个。

chapters.en: The seven lean, ugly cows that came up afterward are seven years, and so are the seven worthless heads of grain scorched by the east wind: They are seven years of famine.
chapters.zh: 那随后上来的七只又干瘦又丑陋的母牛是七年，那七个虚空，被东风吹焦的穗子也是七年，都是七个荒年。

chapters.en: “It is just as I said to Pharaoh: God has shown Pharaoh what he is about to do.
chapters.zh: 这就是我对法老所说，神已将所要作的事显明给法老了。

chapters.en: Seven years of great abundance are coming throughout the land of Egypt,
chapters.zh: 埃及遍地必来七个大丰年，

chapters.en: but seven years of famine will follow them. Then all the abundance in Egypt will be forgotten, and the famine will ravage the land.
chapters.zh: 随后又要来七个荒年，甚至埃及地都忘了先前的丰收，全地必被饥荒所灭。

chapters.en: The abundance in the land will not be remembered, because the famine that follows it will be so severe.
chapters.zh: 因那以后的饥荒甚大，便不觉得先前的丰收了。

chapters.en: The reason the dream was given to Pharaoh in two forms is that the matter has been firmly decided by God, and God will do it soon.
chapters.zh: 至于法老两回作梦，是因神命定这事，而且必速速成就。

chapters.en: “And now let Pharaoh look for a discerning and wise man and put him in charge of the land of Egypt.
chapters.zh: 所以，法老当拣选一个有聪明有智慧的人，派他治理埃及地。

chapters.en: Let Pharaoh appoint commissioners over the land to take a fifth of the harvest of Egypt during the seven years of abundance.
chapters.zh: 法老当这样行，又派官员管理这地。当七个丰年的时候，征收埃及地的五分之一，

chapters.en: They should collect all the food of these good years that are coming and store up the grain under the authority of Pharaoh, to be kept in the cities for food.
chapters.zh: 叫他们把将来丰年一切的粮食聚敛起来，积蓄五谷，收存在各城里作食物，归于法老的手下。

chapters.en: This food should be held in reserve for the country, to be used during the seven years of famine that will come upon Egypt, so that the country may not be ruined by the famine.”
chapters.zh: 所积蓄的粮食可以防备埃及地将来的七个荒年，免得这地被饥荒所灭。

chapters.en: The plan seemed good to Pharaoh and to all his officials.
chapters.zh: 法老和他一切臣仆都以这事为妙。

chapters.en: So Pharaoh asked them, “Can we find anyone like this man, one in whom is the spirit of God ?”
chapters.zh: 法老对臣仆说，像这样的人，有神的灵在他里头，我们岂能找得着呢？

chapters.en: Then Pharaoh said to Joseph, “Since God has made all this known to you, there is no one so discerning and wise as you.
chapters.zh: 法老对约瑟说，神既将这事都指示你，可见没有人象你这样有聪明有智慧。

chapters.en: You shall be in charge of my palace, and all my people are to submit to your orders. Only with respect to the throne will I be greater than you.”
chapters.zh: 你可以掌管我的家。我的民都必听从你的话。惟独在宝座上我比你大。

chapters.en: So Pharaoh said to Joseph, “I hereby put you in charge of the whole land of Egypt.”
chapters.zh: 法老又对约瑟说，我派你治理埃及全地。

chapters.en: Then Pharaoh took his signet ring from his finger and put it on Joseph’s finger. He dressed him in robes of fine linen and put a gold chain around his neck.
chapters.zh: 法老就摘下手上打印的戒指，戴在约瑟的手上，给他穿上细麻衣，把金链戴在他的颈项上，

chapters.en: He had him ride in a chariot as his second-in-command, and people shouted before him, “Make way !” Thus he put him in charge of the whole land of Egypt.
chapters.zh: 又叫约瑟坐他的副车，喝道的在前呼叫说，跪下。这样，法老派他治理埃及全地。

chapters.en: Then Pharaoh said to Joseph, “I am Pharaoh, but without your word no one will lift hand or foot in all Egypt.”
chapters.zh: 法老对约瑟说，我是法老，在埃及全地，若没有你的命令，不许人擅自办事（原文作动手动脚）。

chapters.en: Pharaoh gave Joseph the name Zaphenath-Paneah and gave him Asenath daughter of Potiphera, priest of On, to be his wife. And Joseph went throughout the land of Egypt.
chapters.zh: 法老赐名给约瑟，叫撒发那忒巴内亚，又将安城的祭司波提非拉的女儿亚西纳给他为妻。约瑟就出去巡行埃及地。

chapters.en: Joseph was thirty years old when he entered the service of Pharaoh king of Egypt. And Joseph went out from Pharaoh’s presence and traveled throughout Egypt.
chapters.zh: 约瑟见埃及王法老的时候年三十岁。他从法老面前出去，遍行埃及全地。

chapters.en: During the seven years of abundance the land produced plentifully.
chapters.zh: 七个丰年之内，地的出产极丰极盛（原文作一把一把的），

chapters.en: Joseph collected all the food produced in those seven years of abundance in Egypt and stored it in the cities. In each city he put the food grown in the fields surrounding it.
chapters.zh: 约瑟聚敛埃及地七个丰年一切的粮食，把粮食积存在各城里。各城周围田地的粮食都积存在本城里。

chapters.en: Joseph stored up huge quantities of grain, like the sand of the sea; it was so much that he stopped keeping records because it was beyond measure.
chapters.zh: 约瑟积蓄五谷甚多，如同海边的沙，无法计算，因为谷不可胜数。

chapters.en: Before the years of famine came, two sons were born to Joseph by Asenath daughter of Potiphera, priest of On.
chapters.zh: 荒年未到以前，安城的祭司波提非拉的女儿亚西纳给约瑟生了两个儿子。

chapters.en: Joseph named his firstborn Manasseh and said, “It is because God has made me forget all my trouble and all my father’s household.”
chapters.zh: 约瑟给长子起名叫玛拿西（就是使之忘了的意思），因为他说，神使我忘了一切的困苦和我父的全家。

chapters.en: The second son he named Ephraim and said, “It is because God has made me fruitful in the land of my suffering.”
chapters.zh: 他给次子起名叫以法莲（就是使之昌盛的意思），因为他说，神使我在受苦的地方昌盛。

chapters.en: The seven years of abundance in Egypt came to an end,
chapters.zh: 埃及地的七个丰年一完，

chapters.en: and the seven years of famine began, just as Joseph had said. There was famine in all the other lands, but in the whole land of Egypt there was food.
chapters.zh: 七个荒年就来了。正如约瑟所说的，各地都有饥荒。惟独埃及全地有粮食。

chapters.en: When all Egypt began to feel the famine, the people cried to Pharaoh for food. Then Pharaoh told all the Egyptians, “Go to Joseph and do what he tells you.”
chapters.zh: 及至埃及全地有了饥荒，众民向法老哀求粮食，法老对他们说，你们往约瑟那里去，凡他所说的，你们都要作。

chapters.en: When the famine had spread over the whole country, Joseph opened all the storehouses and sold grain to the Egyptians, for the famine was severe throughout Egypt.
chapters.zh: 当时饥荒遍满天下，约瑟开了各处的仓，粜粮给埃及人。在埃及地饥荒甚大。

chapters.en: And all the world came to Egypt to buy grain from Joseph, because the famine was severe everywhere.
chapters.zh: 各地的人都往埃及去，到约瑟那里籴粮，因为天下的饥荒甚大。

chapters.en: When Jacob learned that there was grain in Egypt, he said to his sons, “Why do you just keep looking at each other?”
chapters.zh: 雅各见埃及有粮，就对儿子们说，你们为什么彼此观望呢？

chapters.en: He continued, “I have heard that there is grain in Egypt. Go down there and buy some for us, so that we may live and not die.”
chapters.zh: 我听见埃及有粮，你们可以下去，从那里为我们籴些来，使我们可以存活，不至于死。

chapters.en: Then ten of Joseph’s brothers went down to buy grain from Egypt.
chapters.zh: 于是，约瑟的十个哥哥都下埃及籴粮去了。

chapters.en: But Jacob did not send Benjamin, Joseph’s brother, with the others, because he was afraid that harm might come to him.
chapters.zh: 但约瑟的兄弟便雅悯，雅各没有打发他和哥哥们同去，因为雅各说，恐怕他遭害。

chapters.en: So Israel’s sons were among those who went to buy grain, for there was famine in the land of Canaan also.
chapters.zh: 来籴粮的人中有以色列的儿子们，因为迦南地也有饥荒。

chapters.en: Now Joseph was the governor of the land, the person who sold grain to all its people. So when Joseph’s brothers arrived, they bowed down to him with their faces to the ground.
chapters.zh: 当时治理埃及地的是约瑟。粜粮给那地众民的就是他。约瑟的哥哥们来了，脸伏于地，向他下拜。

chapters.en: As soon as Joseph saw his brothers, he recognized them, but he pretended to be a stranger and spoke harshly to them. “Where do you come from?” he asked. “From the land of Canaan,” they replied, “to buy food.”
chapters.zh: 约瑟看见他哥哥们，就认得他们，却装作生人，向他们说些严厉话，问他们说，你们从哪里来。他们说，我们从迦南地来籴粮。

chapters.en: Although Joseph recognized his brothers, they did not recognize him.
chapters.zh: 约瑟认得他哥哥们，他们却不认得他。

chapters.en: Then he remembered his dreams about them and said to them, “You are spies! You have come to see where our land is unprotected.”
chapters.zh: 约瑟想起从前所作的那两个梦，就对他们说，你们是奸细，来窥探这地的虚实。

chapters.en: “No, my lord,” they answered. “Your servants have come to buy food.
chapters.zh: 他们对他说，我主阿，不是的。仆人们是籴粮来的。

chapters.en: We are all the sons of one man. Your servants are honest men, not spies.”
chapters.zh: 我们都是一个人的儿子，是诚实人。仆人们并不是奸细。

chapters.en: “No!” he said to them. “You have come to see where our land is unprotected.”
chapters.zh: 约瑟说，不然，你们必是窥探这地的虚实来的。

chapters.en: But they replied, “Your servants were twelve brothers, the sons of one man, who lives in the land of Canaan. The youngest is now with our father, and one is no more.”
chapters.zh: 他们说，仆人们本是弟兄十二人，是迦南地一个人的儿子，顶小的现今在我们的父亲那里，有一个没有了。

chapters.en: Joseph said to them, “It is just as I told you: You are spies!
chapters.zh: 约瑟说，我才说你们是奸细，这话实在不错。

chapters.en: And this is how you will be tested: As surely as Pharaoh lives, you will not leave this place unless your youngest brother comes here.
chapters.zh: 我指着法老的性命起誓，若是你们的小兄弟不到这里来，你们就不得出这地方，从此就可以把你们证验出来了。

chapters.en: Send one of your number to get your brother; the rest of you will be kept in prison, so that your words may be tested to see if you are telling the truth. If you are not, then as surely as Pharaoh lives, you are spies!”
chapters.zh: 须要打发你们中间一个人去，把你们的兄弟带来。至于你们，都要囚在这里，好证验你们的话真不真，若不真，我指着法老的性命起誓，你们一定是奸细。

chapters.en: And he put them all in custody for three days.
chapters.zh: 于是约瑟把他们都下在监里三天。

chapters.en: On the third day, Joseph said to them, “Do this and you will live, for I fear God:
chapters.zh: 到了第三天，约瑟对他们说，我是敬畏神的。你们照我的话行就可以存活。

chapters.en: If you are honest men, let one of your brothers stay here in prison, while the rest of you go and take grain back for your starving households.
chapters.zh: 你们如果是诚实人，可以留你们中间的一个人囚在监里，但你们可以带着粮食回去，救你们家里的饥荒。

chapters.en: But you must bring your youngest brother to me, so that your words may be verified and that you may not die.” This they proceeded to do.
chapters.zh: 把你们的小兄弟带到我这里来，如此，你们的话便有证据，你们也不至于死。他们就照样而行。

chapters.en: They said to one another, “Surely we are being punished because of our brother. We saw how distressed he was when he pleaded with us for his life, but we would not listen; that’s why this distress has come on us.”
chapters.zh: 他们彼此说，我们在兄弟身上实在有罪。他哀求我们的时候，我们见他心里的愁苦，却不肯听，所以这场苦难临到我们身上。

chapters.en: Reuben replied, “Didn’t I tell you not to sin against the boy? But you wouldn’t listen! Now we must give an accounting for his blood.”
chapters.zh: 流便说，我岂不是对你们说过，不可伤害那孩子吗？只是你们不肯听，所以流他血的罪向我们追讨。

chapters.en: They did not realize that Joseph could understand them, since he was using an interpreter.
chapters.zh: 他们不知道约瑟听得出来，因为在他们中间用通事传话。

chapters.en: He turned away from them and began to weep, but then came back and spoke to them again. He had Simeon taken from them and bound before their eyes.
chapters.zh: 约瑟转身退去，哭了一场，又回来对他们说话，就从他们中间挑出西缅来，在他们眼前把他捆绑。

chapters.en: Joseph gave orders to fill their bags with grain, to put each man’s silver back in his sack, and to give them provisions for their journey. After this was done for them,
chapters.zh: 约瑟吩咐人把粮食装满他们的器具，把各人的银子归还在各人的口袋里，又给他们路上用的食物，人就照他的话办了。

chapters.en: they loaded their grain on their donkeys and left.
chapters.zh: 他们就把粮食驮在驴上，离开那里去了。

chapters.en: At the place where they stopped for the night one of them opened his sack to get feed for his donkey, and he saw his silver in the mouth of his sack.
chapters.zh: 到了住宿的地方，他们中间有一个人打开口袋，要拿料喂驴，才看见自己的银子仍在口袋里，

chapters.en: “My silver has been returned,” he said to his brothers. “Here it is in my sack.” Their hearts sank and they turned to each other trembling and said, “What is this that God has done to us?”
chapters.zh: 就对弟兄们说，我的银子归还了，看哪，仍在我口袋里。他们就提心吊胆，战战兢兢地彼此说，这是神向我们作什么呢？

chapters.en: When they came to their father Jacob in the land of Canaan, they told him all that had happened to them. They said,
chapters.zh: 他们来到迦南地，他们的父亲雅各那里，将所遭遇的事都告诉他，说，

chapters.en: “The man who is lord over the land spoke harshly to us and treated us as though we were spying on the land.
chapters.zh: 那地的主对我们说严厉的话，把我们当作窥探那地的奸细。

chapters.en: But we said to him, ‘We are honest men; we are not spies.
chapters.zh: 我们对他说，我们是诚实人，并不是奸细。

chapters.en: We were twelve brothers, sons of one father. One is no more, and the youngest is now with our father in Canaan.’
chapters.zh: 我们本是弟兄十二人，都是一个父亲的儿子，有一个没有了，顶小的如今同我们的父亲在迦南地。

chapters.en: “Then the man who is lord over the land said to us, ‘This is how I will know whether you are honest men: Leave one of your brothers here with me, and take food for your starving households and go.
chapters.zh: 那地的主对我们说，若要我知道你们是诚实人，可以留下你们中间的一个人在我这里，你们可以带着粮食回去，救你们家里的饥荒。

chapters.en: But bring your youngest brother to me so I will know that you are not spies but honest men. Then I will give your brother back to you, and you can trade in the land.’ ”
chapters.zh: 把你们的小兄弟带到我这里来，我便知道你们不是奸细，乃是诚实人。这样，我就把你们的弟兄交给你们，你们也可以在这地作买卖。

chapters.en: As they were emptying their sacks, there in each man’s sack was his pouch of silver! When they and their father saw the money pouches, they were frightened.
chapters.zh: 后来他们倒口袋，不料，各人的银包都在口袋里。他们和父亲看见银包就都害怕。

chapters.en: Their father Jacob said to them, “You have deprived me of my children. Joseph is no more and Simeon is no more, and now you want to take Benjamin. Everything is against me!”
chapters.zh: 他们的父亲雅各对他们说，你们使我丧失我的儿子，约瑟没有了，西缅也没有了，你们又要将便雅悯带去。这些事都归到我身上了。

chapters.en: Then Reuben said to his father, “You may put both of my sons to death if I do not bring him back to you. Entrust him to my care, and I will bring him back.”
chapters.zh: 流便对他父亲说，我若不带他回来交给你，你可以杀我的两个儿子。只管把他交在我手里，我必带他回来交给你。

chapters.en: But Jacob said, “My son will not go down there with you; his brother is dead and he is the only one left. If harm comes to him on the journey you are taking, you will bring my gray head down to the grave in sorrow.”
chapters.zh: 雅各说，我的儿子不可与你们一同下去。他哥哥死了，只剩下他，他若在你们所行的路上遭害，那便是你们使我白发苍苍，悲悲惨惨地下阴间去了。

chapters.en: Now the famine was still severe in the land.
chapters.zh: 那地的饥荒甚大。

chapters.en: So when they had eaten all the grain they had brought from Egypt, their father said to them, “Go back and buy us a little more food.”
chapters.zh: 他们从埃及带来的粮食吃尽了，他们的父亲就对他们说，你们再去给我籴些粮来。

chapters.en: But Judah said to him, “The man warned us solemnly, ‘You will not see my face again unless your brother is with you.’
chapters.zh: 犹大对他说，那人谆谆地诰诫我们说，你们的兄弟若不与你们同来，你们就不得见我的面。

chapters.en: If you will send our brother along with us, we will go down and buy food for you.
chapters.zh: 你若打发我们的兄弟与我们同去，我们就下去给你籴粮。

chapters.en: But if you will not send him, we will not go down, because the man said to us, ‘You will not see my face again unless your brother is with you.’ ”
chapters.zh: 你若不打发他去，我们就不下去，因为那人对我们说，你们的兄弟若不与你们同来，你们就不得见我的面。

chapters.en: Israel asked, “Why did you bring this trouble on me by telling the man you had another brother?”
chapters.zh: 以色列说，你们为什么这样害我，告诉那人你们还有兄弟呢？

chapters.en: They replied, “The man questioned us closely about ourselves and our family. ‘Is your father still living?’ he asked us. ‘Do you have another brother?’ We simply answered his questions. How were we to know he would say, ‘Bring your brother down here’?”
chapters.zh: 他们回答说，那人详细问到我们和我们的亲属，说，你们的父亲还在吗？你们还有兄弟吗？我们就按着他所问的告诉他，焉能知道他要说，必须把你们的兄弟带下来呢？

chapters.en: Then Judah said to Israel his father, “Send the boy along with me and we will go at once, so that we and you and our children may live and not die.
chapters.zh: 犹大又对他父亲以色列说，你打发童子与我同去，我们就起身下去，好叫我们和你，并我们的妇人孩子，都得存活，不至于死。

chapters.en: I myself will guarantee his safety; you can hold me personally responsible for him. If I do not bring him back to you and set him here before you, I will bear the blame before you all my life.
chapters.zh: 我为他作保。你可以从我手中追讨，我若不带他回来交在你面前，我情愿永远担罪。

chapters.en: As it is, if we had not delayed, we could have gone and returned twice.”
chapters.zh: 我们若没有耽搁，如今第二次都回来了。

chapters.en: Then their father Israel said to them, “If it must be, then do this: Put some of the best products of the land in your bags and take them down to the man as a gift—a little balm and a little honey, some spices and myrrh, some pistachio nuts and almonds.
chapters.zh: 他们的父亲以色列说，若必须如此，你们就当这样行，可以将这地土产中最好的乳香，蜂蜜，香料，没药，榧子，杏仁都取一点，收在器具里，带下去送给那人作礼物，

chapters.en: Take double the amount of silver with you, for you must return the silver that was put back into the mouths of your sacks. Perhaps it was a mistake.
chapters.zh: 又要手里加倍地带银子，并将归还在你们口袋内的银子仍带在手里。那或者是错了。

chapters.en: Take your brother also and go back to the man at once.
chapters.zh: 也带着你们的兄弟，起身去见那人。

chapters.en: And may God Almighty grant you mercy before the man so that he will let your other brother and Benjamin come back with you. As for me, if I am bereaved, I am bereaved.”
chapters.zh: 但愿全能的神使你们在那人面前蒙怜悯，释放你们的那弟兄和便雅悯回来。我若丧了儿子，就丧了吧。

chapters.en: So the men took the gifts and double the amount of silver, and Benjamin also. They hurried down to Egypt and presented themselves to Joseph.
chapters.zh: 于是，他们拿着那礼物，又手里加倍地带银子，并且带着便雅悯，起身下到埃及，站在约瑟面前。

chapters.en: When Joseph saw Benjamin with them, he said to the steward of his house, “Take these men to my house, slaughter an animal and prepare a meal; they are to eat with me at noon.”
chapters.zh: 约瑟见便雅悯和他们同来，就对家宰说，将这些人领到屋里。要宰杀牲畜，预备筵席，因为晌午这些人同我吃饭。

chapters.en: The man did as Joseph told him and took the men to Joseph’s house.
chapters.zh: 家宰就遵着约瑟的命去行，领他们进约瑟的屋里。

chapters.en: Now the men were frightened when they were taken to his house. They thought, “We were brought here because of the silver that was put back into our sacks the first time. He wants to attack us and overpower us and seize us as slaves and take our donkeys.”
chapters.zh: 他们因为被领到约瑟的屋里，就害怕，说，领我们到这里来，必是因为头次归还在我们口袋里的银子，找我们的错缝，下手害我们，强取我们为奴仆，抢夺我们的驴。

chapters.en: So they went up to Joseph’s steward and spoke to him at the entrance to the house.
chapters.zh: 他们就挨进约瑟的家宰，在屋门口和他说话，

chapters.en: “We beg your pardon, our lord,” they said, “we came down here the first time to buy food.
chapters.zh: 说，我主阿，我们头次下来实在是要籴粮。

chapters.en: But at the place where we stopped for the night we opened our sacks and each of us found his silver—the exact weight—in the mouth of his sack. So we have brought it back with us.
chapters.zh: 后来到了住宿的地方，我们打开口袋，不料，各人的银子，分量足数，仍在各人的口袋内，现在我们手里又带回来了。

chapters.en: We have also brought additional silver with us to buy food. We don’t know who put our silver in our sacks.”
chapters.zh: 另外又带下银子来籴粮。不知道先前谁把银子放在我们的口袋里。

chapters.en: “It’s all right,” he said. “Don’t be afraid. Your God, the God of your father, has given you treasure in your sacks; I received your silver.” Then he brought Simeon out to them.
chapters.zh: 家宰说，你们可以放心，不要害怕，是你们的神和你们父亲的神赐给你们财宝在你们的口袋里。你们的银子，我早已收了。他就把西缅带出来，交给他们。

chapters.en: The steward took the men into Joseph’s house, gave them water to wash their feet and provided fodder for their donkeys.
chapters.zh: 家宰就领他们进约瑟的屋里，给他们水洗脚，又给他们草料喂驴。

chapters.en: They prepared their gifts for Joseph’s arrival at noon, because they had heard that they were to eat there.
chapters.zh: 他们就预备那礼物，等候约瑟晌午来，因为他们听见要在那里吃饭。

chapters.en: When Joseph came home, they presented to him the gifts they had brought into the house, and they bowed down before him to the ground.
chapters.zh: 约瑟来到家里，他们就把手中的礼物拿进屋去给他，又俯伏在地，向他下拜。

chapters.en: He asked them how they were, and then he said, “How is your aged father you told me about? Is he still living?”
chapters.zh: 约瑟问他们好，又问，你们的父亲就是你们所说的那老人家平安吗？他还在吗？

chapters.en: They replied, “Your servant our father is still alive and well.” And they bowed down, prostrating themselves before him.
chapters.zh: 他们回答说，你仆人我们的父亲平安。他还在。于是他们低头下拜。

chapters.en: As he looked about and saw his brother Benjamin, his own mother’s son, he asked, “Is this your youngest brother, the one you told me about?” And he said, “God be gracious to you, my son.”
chapters.zh: 约瑟举目看见他同母的兄弟便雅悯，就说，你们向我所说那顶小的兄弟就是这位吗？又说，小儿阿，愿神赐恩给你。

chapters.en: Deeply moved at the sight of his brother, Joseph hurried out and looked for a place to weep. He went into his private room and wept there.
chapters.zh: 约瑟爱弟之情发动，就急忙寻找可哭之地，进入自己的屋里，哭了一场。

chapters.en: After he had washed his face, he came out and, controlling himself, said, “Serve the food.”
chapters.zh: 他洗了脸出来，勉强隐忍，吩咐人摆饭。

chapters.en: They served him by himself, the brothers by themselves, and the Egyptians who ate with him by themselves, because Egyptians could not eat with Hebrews, for that is detestable to Egyptians.
chapters.zh: 他们就为约瑟单摆了一席，为那些人又摆了一席，也为和约瑟同吃饭的埃及人另摆了一席，因为埃及人不可和希伯来人一同吃饭。那原是埃及人所厌恶的。

chapters.en: The men had been seated before him in the order of their ages, from the firstborn to the youngest; and they looked at each other in astonishment.
chapters.zh: 约瑟使众弟兄在他面前排列坐席，都按着长幼的次序，众弟兄就彼此诧异。

chapters.en: When portions were served to them from Joseph’s table, Benjamin’s portion was five times as much as anyone else’s. So they feasted and drank freely with him.
chapters.zh: 约瑟把他面前的食物分出来，送给他们。但便雅悯所得的比别人多五倍。他们就饮酒，和约瑟一同宴乐。

chapters.en: Now Joseph gave these instructions to the steward of his house: “Fill the men’s sacks with as much food as they can carry, and put each man’s silver in the mouth of his sack.
chapters.zh: 约瑟吩咐家宰说，把粮食装满这些人的口袋，尽着他们的驴所能驮的，又把各人的银子放在各人的口袋里，

chapters.en: Then put my cup, the silver one, in the mouth of the youngest one’s sack, along with the silver for his grain.” And he did as Joseph said.
chapters.zh: 并将我的银杯和那少年人籴粮的银子一同装在他的口袋里。家宰就照约瑟所说的话行了。

chapters.en: As morning dawned, the men were sent on their way with their donkeys.
chapters.zh: 天一亮就打发那些人带着驴走了。

chapters.en: They had not gone far from the city when Joseph said to his steward, “Go after those men at once, and when you catch up with them, say to them, ‘Why have you repaid good with evil?
chapters.zh: 他们出城走了不远，约瑟对家宰说，起来，追那些人去，追上了就对他们说，你们为什么以恶报善呢？

chapters.en: Isn’t this the cup my master drinks from and also uses for divination? This is a wicked thing you have done.’ ”
chapters.zh: 这不是我主人饮酒的杯吗？岂不是他占卜用的吗？你们这样行是作恶了。

chapters.en: When he caught up with them, he repeated these words to them.
chapters.zh: 家宰追上他们，将这些话对他们说了。

chapters.en: But they said to him, “Why does my lord say such things? Far be it from your servants to do anything like that!
chapters.zh: 他们回答说，我主为什么说这样的话呢？你仆人断不能作这样的事。

chapters.en: We even brought back to you from the land of Canaan the silver we found inside the mouths of our sacks. So why would we steal silver or gold from your master’s house?
chapters.zh: 你看，我们从前在口袋里所见的银子，尚且从迦南地带来还你，我们怎能从你主人家里偷窃金银呢？
