chapters.en: If any of your servants is found to have it, he will die; and the rest of us will become my lord’s slaves.”
chapters.zh: 你仆人中无论在谁那里搜出来，就叫他死，我们也作我主的奴仆。

chapters.en: “Very well, then,” he said, “let it be as you say. Whoever is found to have it will become my slave; the rest of you will be free from blame.”
chapters.zh: 家宰说，现在就照你们的话行吧。在谁那里搜出来，谁就作我的奴仆。其余的都没有罪。

chapters.en: Each of them quickly lowered his sack to the ground and opened it.
chapters.zh: 于是他们各人急忙把口袋卸在地下，各人打开口袋。

chapters.en: Then the steward proceeded to search, beginning with the oldest and ending with the youngest. And the cup was found in Benjamin’s sack.
chapters.zh: 家宰就搜查，从年长的起到年幼的为止，那杯竟在便雅悯的口袋里搜出来。

chapters.en: At this, they tore their clothes. Then they all loaded their donkeys and returned to the city.
chapters.zh: 他们就撕裂衣服，各人把驮子抬在驴上，回城去了。

chapters.en: Joseph was still in the house when Judah and his brothers came in, and they threw themselves to the ground before him.
chapters.zh: 犹大和他弟兄们来到约瑟的屋中，约瑟还在那里，他们就在他面前俯伏于地。

chapters.en: Joseph said to them, “What is this you have done? Don’t you know that a man like me can find things out by divination?”
chapters.zh: 约瑟对他们说，你们作的是什么事呢？你们岂不知像我这样的人必能占卜吗？

chapters.en: “What can we say to my lord?” Judah replied. “What can we say? How can we prove our innocence? God has uncovered your servants’ guilt. We are now my lord’s slaves—we ourselves and the one who was found to have the cup.”
chapters.zh: 犹大说，我们对我主说什么呢？还有什么话可说呢？我们怎能自己表白出来呢？神已经查出仆人的罪孽了。我们与那在他手中搜出杯来的都是我主的奴仆。

chapters.en: But Joseph said, “Far be it from me to do such a thing! Only the man who was found to have the cup will become my slave. The rest of you, go back to your father in peace.”
chapters.zh: 约瑟说，我断不能这样行。在谁的手中搜出杯来，谁就作我的奴仆。至于你们，可以平平安安地上你们父亲那里去。

chapters.en: Then Judah went up to him and said: “Pardon your servant, my lord, let me speak a word to my lord. Do not be angry with your servant, though you are equal to Pharaoh himself.
chapters.zh: 犹大挨近他，说，我主阿，求你容仆人说一句话给我主听，不要向仆人发烈怒，因为你如同法老一样。

chapters.en: My lord asked his servants, ‘Do you have a father or a brother?’
chapters.zh: 我主曾问仆人们说，你们有父亲有兄弟没有。

chapters.en: And we answered, ‘We have an aged father, and there is a young son born to him in his old age. His brother is dead, and he is the only one of his mother’s sons left, and his father loves him.’
chapters.zh: 我们对我主说，我们有父亲，已经年老，还有他老年所生的一个小孩子。他哥哥死了，他母亲只撇下他一人，他父亲疼爱他。

chapters.en: “Then you said to your servants, ‘Bring him down to me so I can see him for myself.’
chapters.zh: 你对仆人说，把他带到我这里来，叫我亲眼看看他。

chapters.en: And we said to my lord, ‘The boy cannot leave his father; if he leaves him, his father will die.’
chapters.zh: 我们对我主说，童子不能离开他父亲，若是离开，他父亲必死。

chapters.en: But you told your servants, ‘Unless your youngest brother comes down with you, you will not see my face again.’
chapters.zh: 你对仆人说，你们的小兄弟若不与你们一同下来，你们就不得再见我的面。

chapters.en: When we went back to your servant my father, we told him what my lord had said.
chapters.zh: 我们上到你仆人我们父亲那里，就把我主的话告诉了他。

chapters.en: “Then our father said, ‘Go back and buy a little more food.’
chapters.zh: 我们的父亲说，你们再去给我籴些粮来。

chapters.en: But we said, ‘We cannot go down. Only if our youngest brother is with us will we go. We cannot see the man’s face unless our youngest brother is with us.’
chapters.zh: 我们就说，我们不能下去。我们的小兄弟若和我们同往，我们就可以下去。因为，小兄弟若不与我们同往，我们必不得见那人的面。

chapters.en: “Your servant my father said to us, ‘You know that my wife bore me two sons.
chapters.zh: 你仆人我父亲对我们说，你们知道我的妻子给我生了两个儿子。

chapters.en: One of them went away from me, and I said, “He has surely been torn to pieces.” And I have not seen him since.
chapters.zh: 一个离开我出去了。我说他必是被撕碎了，直到如今我也没有见他。

chapters.en: If you take this one from me too and harm comes to him, you will bring my gray head down to the grave in misery.’
chapters.zh: 现在你们又要把这个带去离开我，倘若他遭害，那便是你们使我白发苍苍，悲悲惨惨地下阴间去了。

chapters.en: “So now, if the boy is not with us when I go back to your servant my father, and if my father, whose life is closely bound up with the boy’s life,
chapters.zh: 我父亲的命与这童子的命相连。如今我回到你仆人我父亲那里，若没有童子与我们同在，

chapters.en: sees that the boy isn’t there, he will die. Your servants will bring the gray head of our father down to the grave in sorrow.
chapters.zh: 我们的父亲见没有童子，他就必死。这便是我们使你仆人我们的父亲白发苍苍，悲悲惨惨地下阴间去了。

chapters.en: Your servant guaranteed the boy’s safety to my father. I said, ‘If I do not bring him back to you, I will bear the blame before you, my father, all my life!’
chapters.zh: 因为仆人曾向我父亲为这童子作保，说，我若不带他回来交给父亲，我便在父亲面前永远担罪。

chapters.en: “Now then, please let your servant remain here as my lord’s slave in place of the boy, and let the boy return with his brothers.
chapters.zh: 现在求你容仆人住下，替这童子作我主的奴仆，叫童子和他哥哥们一同上去。

chapters.en: How can I go back to my father if the boy is not with me? No! Do not let me see the misery that would come on my father.”
chapters.zh: 若童子不和我同去，我怎能上去见我父亲呢？恐怕我看见灾祸临到我父亲身上。

chapters.en: Then Joseph could no longer control himself before all his attendants, and he cried out, “Have everyone leave my presence!” So there was no one with Joseph when he made himself known to his brothers.
chapters.zh: 约瑟在左右站着的人面前情不自禁，吩咐一声说，人都要离开我出去。约瑟和弟兄相认的时候并没有一人站在他面前。

chapters.en: And he wept so loudly that the Egyptians heard him, and Pharaoh’s household heard about it.
chapters.zh: 他就放声大哭，埃及人和法老家中的人都听见了。

chapters.en: Joseph said to his brothers, “I am Joseph! Is my father still living?” But his brothers were not able to answer him, because they were terrified at his presence.
chapters.zh: 约瑟对他弟兄们说，我是约瑟。我的父亲还在吗？他弟兄不能回答，因为在他面前都惊惶。

chapters.en: Then Joseph said to his brothers, “Come close to me.” When they had done so, he said, “I am your brother Joseph, the one you sold into Egypt!
chapters.zh: 约瑟又对他弟兄们说，请你们近前来。他们就近前来。他说，我是你们的兄弟约瑟，就是你们所卖到埃及的。

chapters.en: And now, do not be distressed and do not be angry with yourselves for selling me here, because it was to save lives that God sent me ahead of you.
chapters.zh: 现在，不要因为把我卖到这里自忧自恨。这是神差我在你们以先来，为要保全生命。

chapters.en: For two years now there has been famine in the land, and for the next five years there will be no plowing and reaping.
chapters.zh: 现在这地的饥荒已经二年了，还有五年不能耕种，不能收成。

chapters.en: But God sent me ahead of you to preserve for you a remnant on earth and to save your lives by a great deliverance.
chapters.zh: 神差我在你们以先来，为要给你们存留余种在世上，又要大施拯救，保全你们的生命。

chapters.en: “So then, it was not you who sent me here, but God. He made me father to Pharaoh, lord of his entire household and ruler of all Egypt.
chapters.zh: 这样看来，差我到这里来的不是你们，乃是神。他又使我如法老的父，作他全家的主，并埃及全地的宰相。

chapters.en: Now hurry back to my father and say to him, ‘This is what your son Joseph says: God has made me lord of all Egypt. Come down to me; don’t delay.
chapters.zh: 你们要赶紧上到我父亲那里。对他说，你儿子约瑟这样说，神使我作全埃及的主，请你下到我这里来，不要耽延。

chapters.en: You shall live in the region of Goshen and be near me—you, your children and grandchildren, your flocks and herds, and all you have.
chapters.zh: 你和你我儿子孙子，连牛群羊群，并一切所有的，都可以住在歌珊地，与我相近。

chapters.en: I will provide for you there, because five years of famine are still to come. Otherwise you and your household and all who belong to you will become destitute.’
chapters.zh: 我要在那里奉养你。因为还有五年的饥荒，免得你和你的眷属，并一切所有的，都败落了。

chapters.en: “You can see for yourselves, and so can my brother Benjamin, that it is really I who am speaking to you.
chapters.zh: 况且你们的眼和我兄弟便雅悯的眼都看见是我亲口对你们说话。

chapters.en: Tell my father about all the honor accorded me in Egypt and about everything you have seen. And bring my father down here quickly.”
chapters.zh: 你们也要将我在埃及一切的荣耀和你们所看见的事都告诉我父亲，又要赶紧地将我父亲搬到我这里来。

chapters.en: Then he threw his arms around his brother Benjamin and wept, and Benjamin embraced him, weeping.
chapters.zh: 于是约瑟伏在他兄弟便雅悯的颈项上哭，便雅悯也在他的颈项上哭。

chapters.en: And he kissed all his brothers and wept over them. Afterward his brothers talked with him.
chapters.zh: 他又与众弟兄亲嘴，抱着他们哭，随后他弟兄就和他说话。

chapters.en: When the news reached Pharaoh’s palace that Joseph’s brothers had come, Pharaoh and all his officials were pleased.
chapters.zh: 这风声传到法老的宫里，说，约瑟的弟兄们来了。法老和他的臣仆都很喜欢。

chapters.en: Pharaoh said to Joseph, “Tell your brothers, ‘Do this: Load your animals and return to the land of Canaan,
chapters.zh: 法老对约瑟说，你吩咐你的弟兄们说，你们要这样行，把驮子抬在牲口上，起身往迦南地去。

chapters.en: and bring your father and your families back to me. I will give you the best of the land of Egypt and you can enjoy the fat of the land.’
chapters.zh: 将你们的父亲和你们的眷属都搬到我这里来，我要把埃及地的美物赐给你们，你们也要吃这地肥美的出产。

chapters.en: “You are also directed to tell them, ‘Do this: Take some carts from Egypt for your children and your wives, and get your father and come.
chapters.zh: 现在我吩咐你们要这样行，从埃及地带着车辆去，把你们的孩子和妻子，并你们的父亲都搬来。

chapters.en: Never mind about your belongings, because the best of all Egypt will be yours.’ ”
chapters.zh: 你们眼中不要爱惜你们的家具，因为埃及全地的美物都是你们的。

chapters.en: So the sons of Israel did this. Joseph gave them carts, as Pharaoh had commanded, and he also gave them provisions for their journey.
chapters.zh: 以色列的儿子们就如此行。约瑟照着法老的吩咐给他们车辆和路上用的食物，

chapters.en: To each of them he gave new clothing, but to Benjamin he gave three hundred shekels of silver and five sets of clothes.
chapters.zh: 又给他们各人一套衣服，惟独给便雅悯三百银子，五套衣服。

chapters.en: And this is what he sent to his father: ten donkeys loaded with the best things of Egypt, and ten female donkeys loaded with grain and bread and other provisions for his journey.
chapters.zh: 送给他父亲公驴十匹，驮着埃及的美物，母驴十匹，驮着粮食与饼和菜，为他父亲路上用。

chapters.en: Then he sent his brothers away, and as they were leaving he said to them, “Don’t quarrel on the way!”
chapters.zh: 于是约瑟打发他弟兄们回去，又对他们说，你们不要在路上相争。

chapters.en: So they went up out of Egypt and came to their father Jacob in the land of Canaan.
chapters.zh: 他们从埃及上去，来到迦南地，他们的父亲雅各那里，

chapters.en: They told him, “Joseph is still alive! In fact, he is ruler of all Egypt.” Jacob was stunned; he did not believe them.
chapters.zh: 告诉他说，约瑟还在，并且作埃及全地的宰相。雅各心里冰凉，因为不信他们。

chapters.en: But when they told him everything Joseph had said to them, and when he saw the carts Joseph had sent to carry him back, the spirit of their father Jacob revived.
chapters.zh: 他们便将约瑟对他们说的一切话都告诉了他。他们父亲雅各又看见约瑟打发来接他的车辆，心就苏醒了。

chapters.en: And Israel said, “I’m convinced! My son Joseph is still alive. I will go and see him before I die.”
chapters.zh: 以色列说，罢了。罢了。我的儿子约瑟还在，趁我未死以先，我要去见他一面。

chapters.en: So Israel set out with all that was his, and when he reached Beersheba, he offered sacrifices to the God of his father Isaac.
chapters.zh: 以色列带着一切所有的，起身来到别是巴，就献祭给他父亲以撒的神。

chapters.en: And God spoke to Israel in a vision at night and said, “Jacob! Jacob!” “Here I am,” he replied.
chapters.zh: 夜间，神在异象中对以色列说，雅各。雅各。他说，我在这里。

chapters.en: “I am God, the God of your father,” he said. “Do not be afraid to go down to Egypt, for I will make you into a great nation there.
chapters.zh: 神说，我是神，就是你父亲的神。你下埃及去不要害怕，因为我必使你在那里成为大族。

chapters.en: I will go down to Egypt with you, and I will surely bring you back again. And Joseph’s own hand will close your eyes.”
chapters.zh: 我要和你同下埃及去，也必定带你上来。约瑟必给你送终（原文作将手按在你的眼睛上）。

chapters.en: Then Jacob left Beersheba, and Israel’s sons took their father Jacob and their children and their wives in the carts that Pharaoh had sent to transport him.
chapters.zh: 雅各就从别是巴起行。以色列的儿子们使他们的父亲雅各和他们的妻子，儿女都坐在法老为雅各送来的车上。

chapters.en: So Jacob and all his offspring went to Egypt, taking with them their livestock and the possessions they had acquired in Canaan.
chapters.zh: 他们又带着迦南地所得的牲畜，货财来到埃及。雅各和他的一切子孙都一同来了，

chapters.en: Jacob brought with him to Egypt his sons and grandsons and his daughters and granddaughters—all his offspring.
chapters.zh: 雅各把他的儿子，孙子，女儿，孙女，并他的子子孙孙，一同带到埃及。

chapters.en: These are the names of the sons of Israel (Jacob and his descendants) who went to Egypt: Reuben the firstborn of Jacob.
chapters.zh: 来到埃及的以色列人名字记在下面。雅各和他的儿孙，雅各的长子是流便。

chapters.en: The sons of Reuben: Hanok, Pallu, Hezron and Karmi.
chapters.zh: 流便的儿子是哈诺，法路，希斯伦，迦米。

chapters.en: The sons of Simeon: Jemuel, Jamin, Ohad, Jakin, Zohar and Shaul the son of a Canaanite woman.
chapters.zh: 西缅的儿子是耶母利，雅悯，阿辖，雅斤，琐辖，还有迦南女子所生的扫罗。

chapters.en: The sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath and Merari.
chapters.zh: 利未的儿子是革顺，哥辖，米拉利。

chapters.en: The sons of Judah: Er, Onan, Shelah, Perez and Zerah (but Er and Onan had died in the land of Canaan). The sons of Perez: Hezron and Hamul.
chapters.zh: 犹大的儿子是珥，俄南，示拉，法勒斯，谢拉。惟有珥与俄南死在迦南地。法勒斯的儿子是希斯伦，哈母勒。

chapters.en: The sons of Issachar: Tola, Puah, Jashub and Shimron.
chapters.zh: 以萨迦的儿子是陀拉，普瓦，约伯，伸仑。

chapters.en: The sons of Zebulun: Sered, Elon and Jahleel.
chapters.zh: 西布伦的儿子是西烈，以伦，雅利。

chapters.en: These were the sons Leah bore to Jacob in Paddan Aram, besides his daughter Dinah. These sons and daughters of his were thirty-three in all.
chapters.zh: 这是利亚在巴旦亚兰给雅各所生的儿子，还有女儿底拿。儿孙共三十三人。

chapters.en: The sons of Gad: Zephon, Haggi, Shuni, Ezbon, Eri, Arodi and Areli.
chapters.zh: 迦得的儿子是洗非芸，哈基，书尼，以斯本，以利，亚罗底，亚列利。

chapters.en: The sons of Asher: Imnah, Ishvah, Ishvi and Beriah. Their sister was Serah. The sons of Beriah: Heber and Malkiel.
chapters.zh: 亚设的儿子是音拿，亦施瓦，亦施韦，比利亚，还有他们的妹子西拉。比利亚的儿子是希别，玛结。

chapters.en: These were the children born to Jacob by Zilpah, whom Laban had given to his daughter Leah—sixteen in all.
chapters.zh: 这是拉班给他女儿利亚的婢女悉帕从雅各所生的儿孙，共有十六人。

chapters.en: The sons of Jacob’s wife Rachel: Joseph and Benjamin.
chapters.zh: 雅各之妻拉结的儿子是约瑟和便雅悯。

chapters.en: In Egypt, Manasseh and Ephraim were born to Joseph by Asenath daughter of Potiphera, priest of On.
chapters.zh: 约瑟在埃及地生了玛拿西和以法莲，就是安城的祭司波提非拉的女儿亚西纳给约瑟生的。

chapters.en: The sons of Benjamin: Bela, Beker, Ashbel, Gera, Naaman, Ehi, Rosh, Muppim, Huppim and Ard.
chapters.zh: 便雅悯的儿子是比拉，比结，亚实别，基拉，乃幔，以希，罗实，母平，户平，亚勒。

chapters.en: These were the sons of Rachel who were born to Jacob—fourteen in all.
chapters.zh: 这是拉结给雅各所生的儿孙，共有十四人。

chapters.en: The son of Dan: Hushim.
chapters.zh: 但的儿子是户伸。

chapters.en: The sons of Naphtali: Jahziel, Guni, Jezer and Shillem.
chapters.zh: 拿弗他利的儿子是雅薛，沽尼，耶色，示冷。

chapters.en: These were the sons born to Jacob by Bilhah, whom Laban had given to his daughter Rachel—seven in all.
chapters.zh: 这是拉班给他女儿拉结的婢女辟拉从雅各所生的儿孙，共有七人。

chapters.en: All those who went to Egypt with Jacob—those who were his direct descendants, not counting his sons’ wives—numbered sixty-six persons.
chapters.zh: 那与雅各同到埃及的，除了他儿妇之外，凡从他所生的，共有六十六人。

chapters.en: With the two sons who had been born to Joseph in Egypt, the members of Jacob’s family, which went to Egypt, were seventy in all.
chapters.zh: 还有约瑟在埃及所生的两个儿子。雅各家来到埃及的共有七十人。

chapters.en: Now Jacob sent Judah ahead of him to Joseph to get directions to Goshen. When they arrived in the region of Goshen,
chapters.zh: 雅各打发犹大先去见约瑟，请派人引路往歌珊去。于是他们来到歌珊地。

chapters.en: Joseph had his chariot made ready and went to Goshen to meet his father Israel. As soon as Joseph appeared before him, he threw his arms around his father and wept for a long time.
chapters.zh: 约瑟套车往歌珊去，迎接他父亲以色列，及至见了面，就伏在父亲的颈项上，哭了许久。

chapters.en: Israel said to Joseph, “Now I am ready to die, since I have seen for myself that you are still alive.”
chapters.zh: 以色列对约瑟说，我既得见你的面，知道你还在，就是死我也甘心。

chapters.en: Then Joseph said to his brothers and to his father’s household, “I will go up and speak to Pharaoh and will say to him, ‘My brothers and my father’s household, who were living in the land of Canaan, have come to me.
chapters.zh: 约瑟对他的弟兄和他父的全家说，我要上去告诉法老，对他说，我的弟兄和我父的全家从前在迦南地，现今都到我这里来了。

chapters.en: The men are shepherds; they tend livestock, and they have brought along their flocks and herds and everything they own.’
chapters.zh: 他们本是牧羊的人，以养牲畜为业。他们把羊群牛群和一切所有的都带来了。

chapters.en: When Pharaoh calls you in and asks, ‘What is your occupation?’
chapters.zh: 等法老召你们的时候，问你们说，你们以何事为业。

chapters.en: you should answer, ‘Your servants have tended livestock from our boyhood on, just as our fathers did.’ Then you will be allowed to settle in the region of Goshen, for all shepherds are detestable to the Egyptians.”
chapters.zh: 你们要说，你的仆人，从幼年直到如今，都以养牲畜为业，连我们的祖宗也都以此为业。这样，你们可以住在歌珊地，因为凡牧羊的都被埃及人所厌恶。

chapters.en: Joseph went and told Pharaoh, “My father and brothers, with their flocks and herds and everything they own, have come from the land of Canaan and are now in Goshen.”
chapters.zh: 约瑟进去告诉法老说，我的父亲和我的弟兄带着羊群牛群，并一切所有的，从迦南地来了，如今在歌珊地。

chapters.en: He chose five of his brothers and presented them before Pharaoh.
chapters.zh: 约瑟从他弟兄中挑出五个人来，引他们去见法老。

chapters.en: Pharaoh asked the brothers, “What is your occupation?” “Your servants are shepherds,” they replied to Pharaoh, “just as our fathers were.”
chapters.zh: 法老问约瑟的弟兄说，你们以何事为业，他们对法老说，你仆人是牧羊的，连我们的祖宗也是牧羊的。

chapters.en: They also said to him, “We have come to live here for a while, because the famine is severe in Canaan and your servants’ flocks have no pasture. So now, please let your servants settle in Goshen.”
chapters.zh: 他们又对法老说，迦南地的饥荒甚大，仆人的羊群没有草吃，所以我们来到这地寄居。现在求你容仆人住在歌珊地。

chapters.en: Pharaoh said to Joseph, “Your father and your brothers have come to you,
chapters.zh: 法老对约瑟说，你父亲和你弟兄到你这里来了，

chapters.en: and the land of Egypt is before you; settle your father and your brothers in the best part of the land. Let them live in Goshen. And if you know of any among them with special ability, put them in charge of my own livestock.”
chapters.zh: 埃及地都在你面前，只管叫你父亲和你弟兄住在国中最好的地。他们可以住在歌珊地。你若知道他们中间有什么能人，就派他们看管我的牲畜。

chapters.en: Then Joseph brought his father Jacob in and presented him before Pharaoh. After Jacob blessed Pharaoh,
chapters.zh: 约瑟领他父亲雅各进到法老面前，雅各就给法老祝福。

chapters.en: Pharaoh asked him, “How old are you?”
chapters.zh: 法老问雅各说，你平生的年日是多少呢？

chapters.en: And Jacob said to Pharaoh, “The years of my pilgrimage are a hundred and thirty. My years have been few and difficult, and they do not equal the years of the pilgrimage of my fathers.”
chapters.zh: 雅各对法老说，我寄居在世的年日是一百三十岁，我平生的年日又少又苦，不及我列祖早在世寄居的年日。

chapters.en: Then Jacob blessed Pharaoh and went out from his presence.
chapters.zh: 雅各又给法老祝福，就从法老面前出去了。

chapters.en: So Joseph settled his father and his brothers in Egypt and gave them property in the best part of the land, the district of Rameses, as Pharaoh directed.
chapters.zh: 约瑟遵着法老的命，把埃及国最好的地，就是兰塞境内的地，给他父亲和弟兄居住，作为产业。

chapters.en: Joseph also provided his father and his brothers and all his father’s household with food, according to the number of their children.
chapters.zh: 约瑟用粮食奉养他父亲和他弟兄，并他父亲全家的眷属，都是照各家的人口奉养他们。

chapters.en: There was no food, however, in the whole region because the famine was severe; both Egypt and Canaan wasted away because of the famine.
chapters.zh: 饥荒甚大，全地都绝了粮，甚至埃及地和迦南地的人因那饥荒的缘故都饿昏了。

chapters.en: Joseph collected all the money that was to be found in Egypt and Canaan in payment for the grain they were buying, and he brought it to Pharaoh’s palace.
chapters.zh: 约瑟收聚了埃及地和迦南地所有的银子，就是众人籴粮的银子，约瑟就把那银子带到法老的宫里。

chapters.en: When the money of the people of Egypt and Canaan was gone, all Egypt came to Joseph and said, “Give us food. Why should we die before your eyes? Our money is all gone.”
chapters.zh: 埃及地和迦南地的银子都花尽了，埃及众人都来见约瑟，说，我们的银子都用尽了，求你给我们粮食，我们为什么死在你面前呢？

chapters.en: “Then bring your livestock,” said Joseph. “I will sell you food in exchange for your livestock, since your money is gone.”
chapters.zh: 约瑟说，若是银子用尽了，可以把你们的牲畜给我，我就为你们的牲畜给你们粮食。

chapters.en: So they brought their livestock to Joseph, and he gave them food in exchange for their horses, their sheep and goats, their cattle and donkeys. And he brought them through that year with food in exchange for all their livestock.
chapters.zh: 于是他们把牲畜赶到约瑟那里，约瑟就拿粮食换了他们的牛，羊，驴，马。那一年因换他们一切的牲畜，就用粮食养活他们。

chapters.en: When that year was over, they came to him the following year and said, “We cannot hide from our lord the fact that since our money is gone and our livestock belongs to you, there is nothing left for our lord except our bodies and our land.
chapters.zh: 那一年过去，第二年他们又来见约瑟，说，我们不瞒我主，我们的银子都花尽了，牲畜也都归了我主。我们在我主眼前，除了我们的身体和田地之外，一无所剩。

chapters.en: Why should we perish before your eyes—we and our land as well? Buy us and our land in exchange for food, and we with our land will be in bondage to Pharaoh. Give us seed so that we may live and not die, and that the land may not become desolate.”
chapters.zh: 你何忍见我们人死地荒呢？求你用粮食买我们和我们的地，我们和我们的地就要给法老效力。又求你给我们种子，使我们得以存活，不至死亡，地土也不至荒凉。

chapters.en: So Joseph bought all the land in Egypt for Pharaoh. The Egyptians, one and all, sold their fields, because the famine was too severe for them. The land became Pharaoh’s,
chapters.zh: 于是，约瑟为法老买了埃及所有的地，埃及人因被饥荒所迫，各都卖了自己的田地。那地就都归了法老。

chapters.en: and Joseph reduced the people to servitude, from one end of Egypt to the other.
chapters.zh: 至于百姓，约瑟叫他们，从埃及这边直到埃及那边，都各归各城。

chapters.en: However, he did not buy the land of the priests, because they received a regular allotment from Pharaoh and had food enough from the allotment Pharaoh gave them. That is why they did not sell their land.
chapters.zh: 惟有祭司的地，约瑟没有买，因为祭司有从法老所得的常俸。他们吃法老所给的常俸，所以他们不卖自己的地。

chapters.en: Joseph said to the people, “Now that I have bought you and your land today for Pharaoh, here is seed for you so you can plant the ground.
chapters.zh: 约瑟对百姓说，我今日为法老买了你们和你们的地，看哪，这里有种子给你们，你们可以种地。

chapters.en: But when the crop comes in, give a fifth of it to Pharaoh. The other four-fifths you may keep as seed for the fields and as food for yourselves and your households and your children.”
chapters.zh: 后来打粮食的时候，你们要把五分之一纳给法老，四分可以归你们作地里的种子，也作你们和你们家口孩童的食物。

chapters.en: “You have saved our lives,” they said. “May we find favor in the eyes of our lord; we will be in bondage to Pharaoh.”
chapters.zh: 他们说，你救了我们的性命。但愿我们在我主眼前蒙恩，我们就作法老的仆人。

chapters.en: So Joseph established it as a law concerning land in Egypt—still in force today—that a fifth of the produce belongs to Pharaoh. It was only the land of the priests that did not become Pharaoh’s.
chapters.zh: 于是约瑟为埃及地定下常例，直到今日，法老必得五分之一，惟独祭司的地不归法老。

chapters.en: Now the Israelites settled in Egypt in the region of Goshen. They acquired property there and were fruitful and increased greatly in number.
chapters.zh: 以色列人住在埃及的歌珊地。他们在那里置了产业，并且生育甚多。

chapters.en: Jacob lived in Egypt seventeen years, and the years of his life were a hundred and forty-seven.
chapters.zh: 雅各住在埃及地十七年，雅各平生的年日是一百四十七岁。

chapters.en: When the time drew near for Israel to die, he called for his son Joseph and said to him, “If I have found favor in your eyes, put your hand under my thigh and promise that you will show me kindness and faithfulness. Do not bury me in Egypt,
chapters.zh: 以色列的死期临近了，他就叫了他儿子约瑟来，说，我若在你眼前蒙恩，请你把手放在我大腿底下，用慈爱和诚实待我，请你不要将我葬在埃及。

chapters.en: but when I rest with my fathers, carry me out of Egypt and bury me where they are buried.” “I will do as you say,” he said.
chapters.zh: 我与我祖我父同睡的时候，你要将我带出埃及，葬在他们所葬的地方。约瑟说，我必遵着你的命而行。

chapters.en: “Swear to me,” he said. Then Joseph swore to him, and Israel worshiped as he leaned on the top of his staff.
chapters.zh: 雅各说，你要向我起誓。约瑟就向他起了誓，于是以色列在床头上（或作扶着杖头）敬拜神。

chapters.en: Some time later Joseph was told, “Your father is ill.” So he took his two sons Manasseh and Ephraim along with him.
chapters.zh: 这事以后，有人告诉约瑟说，你的父亲病了。他就带着两个儿子玛拿西和以法莲同去。

chapters.en: When Jacob was told, “Your son Joseph has come to you,” Israel rallied his strength and sat up on the bed.
chapters.zh: 有人告诉雅各说，请看，你儿子约瑟到你这里来了。以色列就勉强在床上坐起来。

chapters.en: Jacob said to Joseph, “God Almighty appeared to me at Luz in the land of Canaan, and there he blessed me
chapters.zh: 雅各对约瑟说，全能的神曾在迦南地的路斯向我显现，赐福与我，

chapters.en: and said to me, ‘I am going to make you fruitful and increase your numbers. I will make you a community of peoples, and I will give this land as an everlasting possession to your descendants after you.’
chapters.zh: 对我说，我必使你生养众多，成为多民，又要把这地赐给你的后裔，永远为业。

chapters.en: “Now then, your two sons born to you in Egypt before I came to you here will be reckoned as mine; Ephraim and Manasseh will be mine, just as Reuben and Simeon are mine.
chapters.zh: 我未到埃及见你之先，你在埃及地所生的以法莲和玛拿西这两个儿子是我的，正如流便和西缅是我的一样。

chapters.en: Any children born to you after them will be yours; in the territory they inherit they will be reckoned under the names of their brothers.
chapters.zh: 你在他们以后所生的就是你的，他们可以归于他们弟兄的名下得产业。

chapters.en: As I was returning from Paddan, to my sorrow Rachel died in the land of Canaan while we were still on the way, a little distance from Ephrath. So I buried her there beside the road to Ephrath” (that is, Bethlehem).
chapters.zh: 至于我，我从巴旦来的时候，拉结死在我眼前，在迦南地的路上，离以法他还有一段路程，我就把她葬在以法他的路上。以法他就是伯利恒。

chapters.en: When Israel saw the sons of Joseph, he asked, “Who are these?”
chapters.zh: 以色列看见约瑟的两个儿子，就说，这是谁？

chapters.en: “They are the sons God has given me here,” Joseph said to his father. Then Israel said, “Bring them to me so I may bless them.”
chapters.zh: 约瑟对他父亲说，这是神在这里赐给我的儿子。以色列说，请你领他们到我跟前，我要给他们祝福。

chapters.en: Now Israel’s eyes were failing because of old age, and he could hardly see. So Joseph brought his sons close to him, and his father kissed them and embraced them.
chapters.zh: 以色列年纪老迈，眼睛昏花，不能看见。约瑟领他们到他跟前，他就和他们亲嘴，抱着他们。

chapters.en: Israel said to Joseph, “I never expected to see your face again, and now God has allowed me to see your children too.”
chapters.zh: 以色列对约瑟说，我想不到得见你的面，不料，神又使我得见你的儿子。

chapters.en: Then Joseph removed them from Israel’s knees and bowed down with his face to the ground.
chapters.zh: 约瑟把两个儿子从以色列两膝中领出来，自己就脸伏于地下拜。

chapters.en: And Joseph took both of them, Ephraim on his right toward Israel’s left hand and Manasseh on his left toward Israel’s right hand, and brought them close to him.
chapters.zh: 随后，约瑟又拉着他们两个，以法莲在他的右手里，对着以色列的左手，玛拿西在他的左手里，对着以色列的右手，领他们到以色列的跟前。

chapters.en: But Israel reached out his right hand and put it on Ephraim’s head, though he was the younger, and crossing his arms, he put his left hand on Manasseh’s head, even though Manasseh was the firstborn.
chapters.zh: 以色列伸出右手来，按在以法莲的头上，以法莲乃是次子。又剪搭过左手来，按在玛拿西的头上，玛拿西原是长子。

chapters.en: Then he blessed Joseph and said, “May the God before whom my fathers Abraham and Isaac walked faithfully, the God who has been my shepherd all my life to this day,
chapters.zh: 他就给约瑟祝福说，愿我祖亚伯拉罕和我父以撒所事奉的神，就是一生牧养我直到今日的神，

chapters.en: the Angel who has delivered me from all harm —may he bless these boys. May they be called by my name and the names of my fathers Abraham and Isaac, and may they increase greatly on the earth.”
chapters.zh: 救赎我脱离一切患难的那使者，赐福与这两个童子。愿他们归在我的名下和我祖亚伯拉罕，我父以撒的名下。又愿他们在世界中生养众多。

chapters.en: When Joseph saw his father placing his right hand on Ephraim’s head he was displeased; so he took hold of his father’s hand to move it from Ephraim’s head to Manasseh’s head.
chapters.zh: 约瑟见他父亲把右手按在以法莲的头上，就不喜悦，便提起他父亲的手，要从以法莲的头上挪到玛拿西的头上。

chapters.en: Joseph said to him, “No, my father, this one is the firstborn; put your right hand on his head.”
chapters.zh: 约瑟对他父亲说，我父，不是这样。这本是长子，求你把右手按在他的头上。

chapters.en: But his father refused and said, “I know, my son, I know. He too will become a people, and he too will become great. Nevertheless, his younger brother will be greater than he, and his descendants will become a group of nations.”
chapters.zh: 他父亲不从，说，我知道，我儿，我知道。他也必成为一族，也必昌大。只是他的兄弟将来比他还大。他兄弟的后裔要成为多族。

chapters.en: He blessed them that day and said, “In your name will Israel pronounce this blessing: ‘May God make you like Ephraim and Manasseh.’ ” So he put Ephraim ahead of Manasseh.
chapters.zh: 当日就给他们祝福说，以色列人要指着你们祝福说，愿神使你如以法莲，玛拿西一样。于是立以法莲在玛拿西以上。

chapters.en: Then Israel said to Joseph, “I am about to die, but God will be with you and take you back to the land of your fathers.
chapters.zh: 以色列又对约瑟说，我要死了，但神必与你们同在，领你们回到你们列祖之地。

chapters.en: And to you I give one more ridge of land than to your brothers, the ridge I took from the Amorites with my sword and my bow.”
chapters.zh: 并且我从前用弓用刀从亚摩利人手下夺的那块地，我都赐给你，使你比众弟兄多得一分。

chapters.en: Then Jacob called for his sons and said: “Gather around so I can tell you what will happen to you in days to come.
chapters.zh: 雅各叫了他的儿子们来，说，你们都来聚集，我好把你们日后必遇的事告诉你们。

chapters.en: “Assemble and listen, sons of Jacob; listen to your father Israel.
chapters.zh: 雅各的儿子们，你们要聚集而听，要听你们父亲以色列的话。

chapters.en: “Reuben, you are my firstborn, my might, the first sign of my strength, excelling in honor, excelling in power.
chapters.zh: 流便哪，你是我的长子，是我力量强壮的时候生的，本当大有尊荣，权力超众。

chapters.en: Turbulent as the waters, you will no longer excel, for you went up onto your father’s bed, onto my couch and defiled it.
chapters.zh: 但你放纵情欲，滚沸如水，必不得居首位。因为你上了你父亲的床，污秽了我的榻。

chapters.en: “Simeon and Levi are brothers— their swords are weapons of violence.
chapters.zh: 西缅和利未是弟兄。他们的刀剑是残忍的器具。

chapters.en: Let me not enter their council, let me not join their assembly, for they have killed men in their anger and hamstrung oxen as they pleased.
chapters.zh: 我的灵阿，不要与他们同谋。我的心哪，不要与他们联络。因为他们趁怒杀害人命，任意砍断牛腿大筋。

chapters.en: Cursed be their anger, so fierce, and their fury, so cruel! I will scatter them in Jacob and disperse them in Israel.
chapters.zh: 他们的怒气暴烈可咒。他们的忿恨残忍可诅。我要使他们分居在雅各家里，散住在以色列地中。

chapters.en: “Judah, your brothers will praise you; your hand will be on the neck of your enemies; your father’s sons will bow down to you.
chapters.zh: 犹大阿，你弟兄们必赞美你。你手必掐住仇敌的颈项。你父亲的儿子们必向你下拜。

chapters.en: You are a lion’s cub, Judah; you return from the prey, my son. Like a lion he crouches and lies down, like a lioness—who dares to rouse him?
chapters.zh: 犹大是个小狮子。我儿阿，你抓了食便上去。你屈下身去，卧如公狮，蹲如母狮，谁敢惹你。

chapters.en: The scepter will not depart from Judah, nor the ruler’s staff from between his feet,until he to whom it belongs shall come and the obedience of the nations shall be his.
chapters.zh: 圭必不离犹大，杖必不离他两脚之间，直等细罗（就是赐平安者）来到，万民都必归顺。

chapters.en: He will tether his donkey to a vine, his colt to the choicest branch; he will wash his garments in wine, his robes in the blood of grapes.
chapters.zh: 犹大把小驴拴在葡萄树上，把驴驹拴在美好的葡萄树上。他在葡萄酒中洗了衣服，在葡萄汁中洗了袍褂。

chapters.en: His eyes will be darker than wine, his teeth whiter than milk.
chapters.zh: 他的眼睛必因酒红润。他的牙齿必因奶白亮。

chapters.en: “Zebulun will live by the seashore and become a haven for ships; his border will extend toward Sidon.
chapters.zh: 西布伦必住在海口，必成为停船的海口。他的境界必延到西顿。

chapters.en: “Issachar is a rawboned donkey lying down among the sheep pens.
chapters.zh: 以萨迦是个强壮的驴，卧在羊圈之中。

chapters.en: When he sees how good is his resting place and how pleasant is his land, he will bend his shoulder to the burden and submit to forced labor.
chapters.zh: 他以安静为佳，以肥地为美，便低肩背重，成为服苦的仆人。

chapters.en: “Dan will provide justice for his people as one of the tribes of Israel.
chapters.zh: 但必判断他的民，作以色列支派之一。

chapters.en: Dan will be a snake by the roadside, a viper along the path, that bites the horse’s heels so that its rider tumbles backward.
chapters.zh: 但必作道上的蛇，路中的虺，咬伤马蹄，使骑马的坠落于后。

chapters.en: “I look for your deliverance, LORD.
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，我向来等候你的救恩。

chapters.en: “Gad will be attacked by a band of raiders, but he will attack them at their heels.
chapters.zh: 迦得必被敌军追逼，他却要追逼他们的脚跟。

chapters.en: “Asher’s food will be rich; he will provide delicacies fit for a king.
chapters.zh: 亚设之地必出肥美的粮食，且出君王的美味。

chapters.en: “Naphtali is a doe set free that bears beautiful fawns.
chapters.zh: 拿弗他利是被释放的母鹿。他出嘉美的言语。

chapters.en: “Joseph is a fruitful vine, a fruitful vine near a spring, whose branches climb over a wall.
chapters.zh: 约瑟是多结果子的树枝，是泉旁多结果的枝子。他的枝条探出墙外。

chapters.en: With bitterness archers attacked him; they shot at him with hostility.
chapters.zh: 弓箭手将他苦害，向他射箭，逼迫他。

chapters.en: But his bow remained steady, his strong arms stayed limber, because of the hand of the Mighty One of Jacob, because of the Shepherd, the Rock of Israel,
chapters.zh: 但他的弓仍旧坚硬。他的手健壮敏捷。这是因以色列的牧者，以色列的磐石就是雅各的大能者。

chapters.en: because of your father’s God, who helps you, because of the Almighty, who blesses you with blessings of the skies above, blessings of the deep springs below, blessings of the breast and womb.
chapters.zh: 你父亲的神必帮助你。那全能者必将天上所有的福，地里所藏的福，以及生产乳养的福，都赐给你。

chapters.en: Your father’s blessings are greater than the blessings of the ancient mountains, than the bounty of the age-old hills. Let all these rest on the head of Joseph, on the brow of the prince among his brothers.
chapters.zh: 你父亲所祝的福，胜过我祖先所祝的福，如永世的山岭，至极的边界。这些福必降在约瑟的头上，临列那与弟兄迥别之人的顶上。

chapters.en: “Benjamin is a ravenous wolf; in the morning he devours the prey, in the evening he divides the plunder.”
chapters.zh: 便雅悯是个撕掠的狼，早晨要吃他所抓的，晚上要分他所夺的。

chapters.en: All these are the twelve tribes of Israel, and this is what their father said to them when he blessed them, giving each the blessing appropriate to him.
chapters.zh: 这一切是以色列的十二支派。这也是他们的父亲对他们所说的话，为他们所祝的福，都是按着各人的福分为他们祝福。

chapters.en: Then he gave them these instructions: “I am about to be gathered to my people. Bury me with my fathers in the cave in the field of Ephron the Hittite,
chapters.zh: 他又嘱咐他们说，我将要归到我列祖（原文作本民）那里，你们要将我葬在赫人以弗仑田间的洞里，与我祖我父在一处，

chapters.en: the cave in the field of Machpelah, near Mamre in Canaan, which Abraham bought along with the field as a burial place from Ephron the Hittite.
chapters.zh: 就是在迦南地幔利前，麦比拉田间的洞。那洞和田是亚伯拉罕向赫人以弗仑买来为业，作坟地的。

chapters.en: There Abraham and his wife Sarah were buried, there Isaac and his wife Rebekah were buried, and there I buried Leah.
chapters.zh: 他们在那里葬了亚伯拉罕和他妻子撒拉，又在那里葬了以撒和他妻子利百加。我也在那里葬了利亚。

chapters.en: The field and the cave in it were bought from the Hittites. ”
chapters.zh: 那块田和田间的洞原是向赫人买的。

chapters.en: When Jacob had finished giving instructions to his sons, he drew his feet up into the bed, breathed his last and was gathered to his people.
chapters.zh: 雅各嘱咐众子已毕，就把脚收在床上，气绝而死，归到列祖（原文作本民）那里去了。

chapters.en: Joseph threw himself on his father and wept over him and kissed him.
chapters.zh: 约瑟伏在他父亲的面上哀哭，与他亲嘴。

chapters.en: Then Joseph directed the physicians in his service to embalm his father Israel. So the physicians embalmed him,
chapters.zh: 约瑟吩咐伺候他的医生用香料薰他父亲，医生就用香料薰了以色列。

chapters.en: taking a full forty days, for that was the time required for embalming. And the Egyptians mourned for him seventy days.
chapters.zh: 薰尸的常例是四十天。那四十天满了，埃及人为他哀哭了七十天。

chapters.en: When the days of mourning had passed, Joseph said to Pharaoh’s court, “If I have found favor in your eyes, speak to Pharaoh for me. Tell him,
chapters.zh: 为他哀哭的日子过了，约瑟对法老家中的人说，我若在你们眼前蒙恩，请你们报告法老说，

chapters.en: ‘My father made me swear an oath and said, “I am about to die; bury me in the tomb I dug for myself in the land of Canaan.” Now let me go up and bury my father; then I will return.’ ”
chapters.zh: 我父亲要死的时候叫我起誓说，你要将我葬在迦南地，在我为自己所掘的坟墓里。现在求你让我上去葬我父亲，以后我必回来。

chapters.en: Pharaoh said, “Go up and bury your father, as he made you swear to do.”
chapters.zh: 法老说，你可以上去，照着你父亲叫你起的誓，将他葬埋。

chapters.en: So Joseph went up to bury his father. All Pharaoh’s officials accompanied him—the dignitaries of his court and all the dignitaries of Egypt—
chapters.zh: 于是约瑟上去葬他父亲。与他一同上去的，有法老的臣仆和法老家中的长老，并埃及国的长老，

chapters.en: besides all the members of Joseph’s household and his brothers and those belonging to his father’s household. Only their children and their flocks and herds were left in Goshen.
chapters.zh: 还有约瑟的全家和他的弟兄们，并他父亲的眷属。只有他们的妇人孩子，和羊群牛群，都留在歌珊地。

chapters.en: Chariots and horsemen also went up with him. It was a very large company.
chapters.zh: 又有车辆马兵，和他一同上去。那一帮人甚多。

chapters.en: When they reached the threshing floor of Atad, near the Jordan, they lamented loudly and bitterly; and there Joseph observed a seven-day period of mourning for his father.
chapters.zh: 他们到了约但河外，亚达的禾场，就在那里大大地号啕痛哭。约瑟为他父亲哀哭了七天。

chapters.en: When the Canaanites who lived there saw the mourning at the threshing floor of Atad, they said, “The Egyptians are holding a solemn ceremony of mourning.” That is why that place near the Jordan is called Abel Mizraim.
chapters.zh: 迦南的居民见亚达禾场上的哀哭，就说，这是埃及人一场大的哀哭。因此那地方名叫亚伯麦西，是在约但河东。

chapters.en: So Jacob’s sons did as he had commanded them:
chapters.zh: 雅各的儿子们就遵着他父亲所吩咐的办了，

chapters.en: They carried him to the land of Canaan and buried him in the cave in the field of Machpelah, near Mamre, which Abraham had bought along with the field as a burial place from Ephron the Hittite.
chapters.zh: 把他搬到迦南地，葬在幔利前，麦比拉田间的洞里。那洞和田是亚伯拉罕向赫人以弗仑买来为业，作坟地的。

chapters.en: After burying his father, Joseph returned to Egypt, together with his brothers and all the others who had gone with him to bury his father.
chapters.zh: 约瑟葬了他父亲以后，就和众弟兄，并一切同他上去葬他父亲的人，都回埃及去了。

chapters.en: When Joseph’s brothers saw that their father was dead, they said, “What if Joseph holds a grudge against us and pays us back for all the wrongs we did to him?”
chapters.zh: 约瑟的哥哥们见父亲死了，就说，或者约瑟怀恨我们，照着我们从前待他一切的恶足足地报复我们。

chapters.en: So they sent word to Joseph, saying, “Your father left these instructions before he died:
chapters.zh: 他们就打发人去见约瑟，说，你父亲未死以先吩咐说，

chapters.en: ‘This is what you are to say to Joseph: I ask you to forgive your brothers the sins and the wrongs they committed in treating you so badly.’ Now please forgive the sins of the servants of the God of your father.” When their message came to him, Joseph wept.
chapters.zh: 你们要对约瑟这样说，从前你哥哥们恶待你，求你饶恕他们的过犯和罪恶。如今求你饶恕你父亲神之仆人的过犯。他们对约瑟说这话，约瑟就哭了。

chapters.en: His brothers then came and threw themselves down before him. “We are your slaves,” they said.
chapters.zh: 他的哥哥们又来俯伏在他面前，说，我们是你的仆人。

chapters.en: But Joseph said to them, “Don’t be afraid. Am I in the place of God?
chapters.zh: 约瑟对他们说，不要害怕，我岂能代替神呢？

chapters.en: You intended to harm me, but God intended it for good to accomplish what is now being done, the saving of many lives.
chapters.zh: 从前你们的意思是要害我，但神的意思原是好的，要保全许多人的性命，成就今日的光景。

chapters.en: So then, don’t be afraid. I will provide for you and your children.” And he reassured them and spoke kindly to them.
chapters.zh: 现在你们不要害怕，我必养活你们和你们的妇人孩子。于是约瑟用亲爱的话安慰他们。

chapters.en: Joseph stayed in Egypt, along with all his father’s family. He lived a hundred and ten years
chapters.zh: 约瑟和他父亲的眷属都住在埃及。约瑟活了一百一十岁。

chapters.en: and saw the third generation of Ephraim’s children. Also the children of Makir son of Manasseh were placed at birth on Joseph’s knees.
chapters.zh: 约瑟得见以法莲第三代的子孙。玛拿西的孙子，玛吉的儿子也养在约瑟的膝上。

chapters.en: Then Joseph said to his brothers, “I am about to die. But God will surely come to your aid and take you up out of this land to the land he promised on oath to Abraham, Isaac and Jacob.”
chapters.zh: 约瑟对他弟兄们说，我要死了，但神必定看顾你们，领你们从这地上去，到他起誓所应许给亚伯拉罕，以撒，雅各之地。

chapters.en: And Joseph made the Israelites swear an oath and said, “God will surely come to your aid, and then you must carry my bones up from this place.”
chapters.zh: 约瑟叫以色列的子孙起誓说，神必定看顾你们。你们要把我的骸骨从这里搬上去。

chapters.en: So Joseph died at the age of a hundred and ten. And after they embalmed him, he was placed in a coffin in Egypt.
chapters.zh: 约瑟死了，正一百一十岁。人用香料将他薰了，把他收殓在棺材里，停在埃及。

chapters.en: These are the names of the sons of Israel who went to Egypt with Jacob, each with his family:
chapters.zh: 以色列的众子，各带家眷和雅各一同来到埃及，他们的名字记在下面。

chapters.en: Reuben, Simeon, Levi and Judah;
chapters.zh: 有流便，西缅，利未，犹大，

chapters.en: Issachar, Zebulun and Benjamin;
chapters.zh: 以萨迦，西布伦，便雅悯，

chapters.en: Dan and Naphtali; Gad and Asher.
chapters.zh: 但，拿弗他利，迦得，亚设。

chapters.en: The descendants of Jacob numbered seventy in all; Joseph was already in Egypt.
chapters.zh: 凡从雅各而生的，共有七十人。约瑟已经在埃及。

chapters.en: Now Joseph and all his brothers and all that generation died,
chapters.zh: 约瑟和他的弟兄，并那一代的人都死了。

chapters.en: but the Israelites were exceedingly fruitful; they multiplied greatly, increased in numbers and became so numerous that the land was filled with them.
chapters.zh: 以色列人生养众多，并且繁茂，极其强盛，满了那地。

chapters.en: Then a new king, to whom Joseph meant nothing, came to power in Egypt.
chapters.zh: 有不认识约瑟的新王起来，治理埃及，

chapters.en: “Look,” he said to his people, “the Israelites have become far too numerous for us.
chapters.zh: 对他的百姓说，看哪，这以色列民比我们还多，又比我们强盛。

chapters.en: Come, we must deal shrewdly with them or they will become even more numerous and, if war breaks out, will join our enemies, fight against us and leave the country.”
chapters.zh: 来吧，我们不如用巧计待他们，恐怕他们多起来，日后若遇什么争战的事，就连合我们的仇敌攻击我们，离开这地去了。

chapters.en: So they put slave masters over them to oppress them with forced labor, and they built Pithom and Rameses as store cities for Pharaoh.
chapters.zh: 于是埃及人派督工的辖制他们，加重担苦害他们。他们为法老建造两座积货城，就是比东和兰塞。

chapters.en: But the more they were oppressed, the more they multiplied and spread; so the Egyptians came to dread the Israelites
chapters.zh: 只是越发苦害他们，他们越发多起来，越发蔓延，埃及人就因以色列人愁烦。

chapters.en: and worked them ruthlessly.
chapters.zh: 埃及人严严地使以色列人作工，

chapters.en: They made their lives bitter with harsh labor in brick and mortar and with all kinds of work in the fields; in all their harsh labor the Egyptians worked them ruthlessly.
chapters.zh: 使他们因作苦工觉得命苦，无论是和泥，是做砖，是作田间各样的工，在一切的工上都严严地待他们。

chapters.en: The king of Egypt said to the Hebrew midwives, whose names were Shiphrah and Puah,
chapters.zh: 有希伯来的两个收生婆，一名施弗拉，一名普阿，埃及王对她们说，

chapters.en: “When you are helping the Hebrew women during childbirth on the delivery stool, if you see that the baby is a boy, kill him; but if it is a girl, let her live.”
chapters.zh: 你们为希伯来妇人收生，看她们临盆的时候，若是男孩，就把他杀了，若是女孩，就留她存活。

chapters.en: The midwives, however, feared God and did not do what the king of Egypt had told them to do; they let the boys live.
chapters.zh: 但是收生婆敬畏神，不照埃及王的吩咐行，竟存留男孩的性命。

chapters.en: Then the king of Egypt summoned the midwives and asked them, “Why have you done this? Why have you let the boys live?”
chapters.zh: 埃及王召了收生婆来，说，你们为什么作这事，存留男孩的性命呢？

chapters.en: The midwives answered Pharaoh, “Hebrew women are not like Egyptian women; they are vigorous and give birth before the midwives arrive.”
chapters.zh: 收生婆对法老说，因为希伯来妇人与埃及妇人不同，希伯来妇人本是健壮的（原文作活泼的），收生婆还没有到，她们已经生产了。

chapters.en: So God was kind to the midwives and the people increased and became even more numerous.
chapters.zh: 神厚待收生婆。以色列人多起来，极其强盛。

chapters.en: And because the midwives feared God, he gave them families of their own.
chapters.zh: 收生婆因为敬畏神，神便叫她们成立家室。

chapters.en: Then Pharaoh gave this order to all his people: “Every Hebrew boy that is born you must throw into the Nile, but let every girl live.”
chapters.zh: 法老吩咐他的众民说，以色列人所生的男孩，你们都要丢在河里，一切的女孩，你们要存留她的性命。

chapters.en: Now a man of the tribe of Levi married a Levite woman,
chapters.zh: 有一个利未家的人娶了一个利未女子为妻。

chapters.en: and she became pregnant and gave birth to a son. When she saw that he was a fine child, she hid him for three months.
chapters.zh: 那女人怀孕，生一个儿子，见他俊美，就藏了他三个月，

chapters.en: But when she could hide him no longer, she got a papyrus basket for him and coated it with tar and pitch. Then she placed the child in it and put it among the reeds along the bank of the Nile.
chapters.zh: 后来不能再藏，就取了一个蒲草箱，抹上石漆和石油，将孩子放在里头，把箱子搁在河边的芦荻中。

chapters.en: His sister stood at a distance to see what would happen to him.
chapters.zh: 孩子的姐姐远远站着，要知道他究竟怎么样。

chapters.en: Then Pharaoh’s daughter went down to the Nile to bathe, and her attendants were walking along the riverbank. She saw the basket among the reeds and sent her female slave to get it.
chapters.zh: 法老的女儿来到河边洗澡，她的使女们在河边行走。她看见箱子在芦荻中，就打发一个婢女拿来。

chapters.en: She opened it and saw the baby. He was crying, and she felt sorry for him. “This is one of the Hebrew babies,” she said.
chapters.zh: 她打开箱子，看见那孩子。孩子哭了，她就可怜他，说，这是希伯来人的一个孩子。

chapters.en: Then his sister asked Pharaoh’s daughter, “Shall I go and get one of the Hebrew women to nurse the baby for you?”
chapters.zh: 孩子的姐姐对法老的女儿说，我去在希伯来妇人中叫一个奶妈来，为你奶这孩子，可以不可以。

chapters.en: “Yes, go,” she answered. So the girl went and got the baby’s mother.
chapters.zh: 法老的女儿说，可以。童女就去叫了孩子的母亲来。

chapters.en: Pharaoh’s daughter said to her, “Take this baby and nurse him for me, and I will pay you.” So the woman took the baby and nursed him.
chapters.zh: 法老的女儿对她说，你把这孩子抱去，为我奶他，我必给你工价。妇人就抱了孩子去奶他。

chapters.en: When the child grew older, she took him to Pharaoh’s daughter and he became her son. She named him Moses, saying, “I drew him out of the water.”
chapters.zh: 孩子渐长，妇人把他带到法老的女儿那里，就作了她的儿子。她给孩子起名叫摩西，意思说，因我把他从水里拉出来。

chapters.en: One day, after Moses had grown up, he went out to where his own people were and watched them at their hard labor. He saw an Egyptian beating a Hebrew, one of his own people.
chapters.zh: 后来，摩西长大，他出去到他弟兄那里，看他们的重担，见一个埃及人打希伯来人的一个弟兄。

chapters.en: Looking this way and that and seeing no one, he killed the Egyptian and hid him in the sand.
chapters.zh: 他左右观看，见没有人，就把埃及人打死了，藏在沙土里。

chapters.en: The next day he went out and saw two Hebrews fighting. He asked the one in the wrong, “Why are you hitting your fellow Hebrew?”
chapters.zh: 第二天他出去，见有两个希伯来人争斗，就对那欺负人的说，你为什么打你同族的人呢？

chapters.en: The man said, “Who made you ruler and judge over us? Are you thinking of killing me as you killed the Egyptian?” Then Moses was afraid and thought, “What I did must have become known.”
chapters.zh: 那人说，谁立你作我们的首领和审判官呢？难道你要杀我，像杀那埃及人吗？摩西便惧怕，说，这事必是被人知道了。

chapters.en: When Pharaoh heard of this, he tried to kill Moses, but Moses fled from Pharaoh and went to live in Midian, where he sat down by a well.
chapters.zh: 法老听见这事，就想杀摩西，但摩西躲避法老，逃往米甸地居住。

chapters.en: Now a priest of Midian had seven daughters, and they came to draw water and fill the troughs to water their father’s flock.
chapters.zh: 一日，他在井旁坐下。米甸的祭司有七个女儿，她们来打水，打满了槽，要饮父亲的群羊。

chapters.en: Some shepherds came along and drove them away, but Moses got up and came to their rescue and watered their flock.
chapters.zh: 有牧羊的人来，把她们赶走了，摩西却起来帮助她们，又饮了她们的群羊。

chapters.en: When the girls returned to Reuel their father, he asked them, “Why have you returned so early today?”
chapters.zh: 她们来到父亲流珥那里，他说，今日你们为何来得这么快呢？

chapters.en: They answered, “An Egyptian rescued us from the shepherds. He even drew water for us and watered the flock.”
chapters.zh: 她们说，有一个埃及人救我们脱离牧羊人的手，并且为我们打水饮了群羊。

chapters.en: “And where is he?” Reuel asked his daughters. “Why did you leave him? Invite him to have something to eat.”
chapters.zh: 他对女儿们说，那个人在哪里，你们为什么撇下他呢？你们去请他来吃饭。

chapters.en: Moses agreed to stay with the man, who gave his daughter Zipporah to Moses in marriage.
chapters.zh: 摩西甘心和那人同住，那人把他的女儿西坡拉给摩西为妻。

chapters.en: Zipporah gave birth to a son, and Moses named him Gershom, saying, “I have become a foreigner in a foreign land.”
chapters.zh: 西坡拉生了一个儿子，摩西给他起名叫革舜，意思说，因我在外邦作了寄居的。

chapters.en: During that long period, the king of Egypt died. The Israelites groaned in their slavery and cried out, and their cry for help because of their slavery went up to God.
chapters.zh: 过了多年，埃及王死了。以色列人因作苦工，就叹息哀求，他们的哀声达于神。

chapters.en: God heard their groaning and he remembered his covenant with Abraham, with Isaac and with Jacob.
chapters.zh: 神听见他们的哀声，就记念他与亚伯拉罕，以撒，雅各所立的约。

chapters.en: So God looked on the Israelites and was concerned about them.
chapters.zh: 神看顾以色列人，也知道他们的苦情。

chapters.en: Now Moses was tending the flock of Jethro his father-in-law, the priest of Midian, and he led the flock to the far side of the wilderness and came to Horeb, the mountain of God.
chapters.zh: 摩西牧养他岳父米甸祭司叶忒罗的羊群，一日领羊群往野外去，到了神的山，就是何烈山。

chapters.en: There the angel of the LORD appeared to him in flames of fire from within a bush. Moses saw that though the bush was on fire it did not burn up.
chapters.zh: 耶和华的使者从荆棘里火焰中向摩西显现。摩西观看，不料，荆棘被火烧着，却没有烧毁。

chapters.en: So Moses thought, “I will go over and see this strange sight—why the bush does not burn up.”
chapters.zh: 摩西说，我要过去看这大异象，这荆棘为何没有烧坏呢？

chapters.en: When the LORD saw that he had gone over to look, God called to him from within the bush, “Moses! Moses!” And Moses said, “Here I am.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华神见他过去要看，就从荆棘里呼叫说，摩西，摩西。他说，我在这里。

chapters.en: “Do not come any closer,” God said. “Take off your sandals, for the place where you are standing is holy ground.”
chapters.zh: 神说，不要近前来。当把你脚上的鞋脱下来，因为你所站之地是圣地。

chapters.en: Then he said, “I am the God of your father, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac and the God of Jacob.” At this, Moses hid his face, because he was afraid to look at God.
chapters.zh: 又说，我是你父亲的神，是亚伯拉罕的神，以撒的神，雅各的神。摩西蒙上脸，因为怕看神。

chapters.en: The LORD said, “I have indeed seen the misery of my people in Egypt. I have heard them crying out because of their slave drivers, and I am concerned about their suffering.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说，我的百姓在埃及所受的困苦，我实在看见了，他们因受督工的辖制所发的哀声，我也听见了。我原知道他们的痛苦，

chapters.en: So I have come down to rescue them from the hand of the Egyptians and to bring them up out of that land into a good and spacious land, a land flowing with milk and honey—the home of the Canaanites, Hittites, Amorites, Perizzites, Hivites and Jebusites.
chapters.zh: 我下来是要救他们脱离埃及人的手，领他们出了那地，到美好，宽阔，流奶与蜜之地，就是到迦南人，赫人，亚摩利人，比利洗人，希未人，耶布斯人之地。

chapters.en: And now the cry of the Israelites has reached me, and I have seen the way the Egyptians are oppressing them.
chapters.zh: 现在以色列人的哀声达到我耳中，我也看见埃及人怎样欺压他们。

chapters.en: So now, go. I am sending you to Pharaoh to bring my people the Israelites out of Egypt.”
chapters.zh: 故此，我要打发你去见法老，使你可以将我的百姓以色列人从埃及领出来。

chapters.en: But Moses said to God, “Who am I that I should go to Pharaoh and bring the Israelites out of Egypt?”
chapters.zh: 摩西对神说，我是什么人，竟能去见法老，将以色列人从埃及领出来呢？

chapters.en: And God said, “I will be with you. And this will be the sign to you that it is I who have sent you: When you have brought the people out of Egypt, you will worship God on this mountain.”
chapters.zh: 神说，我必与你同在。你将百姓从埃及领出来之后，你们必在这山上事奉我，这就是我打发你去的证据。

chapters.en: Moses said to God, “Suppose I go to the Israelites and say to them, ‘The God of your fathers has sent me to you,’ and they ask me, ‘What is his name?’ Then what shall I tell them?”
chapters.zh: 摩西对神说，我到以色列人那里，对他们说，你们祖宗的神打发我到你们这里来。他们若问我说，他叫什么名字？我要对他们说什么呢？

chapters.en: God said to Moses, “I AM WHO I AM. This is what you are to say to the Israelites: ‘I AM has sent me to you.’ ”
chapters.zh: 神对摩西说，我是自有永有的。又说，你要对以色列人这样说，那自有的打发我到你们这里来。

chapters.en: God also said to Moses, “Say to the Israelites, ‘The LORD, the God of your fathers—the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac and the God of Jacob—has sent me to you.’ “This is my name forever, the name you shall call me from generation to generation.
chapters.zh: 神又对摩西说，你要对以色列人这样说，耶和华你们祖宗的神，就是亚伯拉罕的神，以撒的神，雅各的神，打发我到你们这里来。耶和华是我的名，直到永远，这也是我的纪念，直到万代。

chapters.en: “Go, assemble the elders of Israel and say to them, ‘The LORD, the God of your fathers—the God of Abraham, Isaac and Jacob—appeared to me and said: I have watched over you and have seen what has been done to you in Egypt.
chapters.zh: 你去招聚以色列的长老，对他们说，耶和华你们祖宗的神，就是亚伯拉罕的神，以撒的神，雅各的神，向我显现，说，我实在眷顾了你们，我也看见埃及人怎样待你们。

chapters.en: And I have promised to bring you up out of your misery in Egypt into the land of the Canaanites, Hittites, Amorites, Perizzites, Hivites and Jebusites—a land flowing with milk and honey.’
chapters.zh: 我也说，要将你们从埃及的困苦中领出来，往迦南人，赫人，亚摩利人，比利洗人，希未人，耶布斯人的地去，就是到流奶与蜜之地。

chapters.en: “The elders of Israel will listen to you. Then you and the elders are to go to the king of Egypt and say to him, ‘The LORD, the God of the Hebrews, has met with us. Let us take a three-day journey into the wilderness to offer sacrifices to the LORD our God.’
chapters.zh: 他们必听你的话。你和以色列的长老要去见埃及王，对他说，耶和华希伯来人的神遇见了我们，现在求你容我们往旷野去，走三天的路程，为要祭祀耶和华我们的神。

chapters.en: But I know that the king of Egypt will not let you go unless a mighty hand compels him.
chapters.zh: 我知道虽用大能的手，埃及王也不容你们去。

chapters.en: So I will stretch out my hand and strike the Egyptians with all the wonders that I will perform among them. After that, he will let you go.
chapters.zh: 我必伸手在埃及中间施行我一切的奇事，攻击那地，然后他才容你们去。

chapters.en: “And I will make the Egyptians favorably disposed toward this people, so that when you leave you will not go empty-handed.
chapters.zh: 我必叫你们在埃及人眼前蒙恩，你们去的时候就不至于空手而去。

chapters.en: Every woman is to ask her neighbor and any woman living in her house for articles of silver and gold and for clothing, which you will put on your sons and daughters. And so you will plunder the Egyptians.”
chapters.zh: 但各妇女必向她的邻舍，并居住在她家里的女人，要金器银器和衣裳，好给你们的儿女穿戴。这样你们就把埃及人的财物夺去了。

chapters.en: Moses answered, “What if they do not believe me or listen to me and say, ‘The LORD did not appear to you’?”
chapters.zh: 摩西回答说，他们必不信我，也不听我的话，必说，耶和华并没有向你显现。

chapters.en: Then the LORD said to him, “What is that in your hand?” “A staff,” he replied.
chapters.zh: 耶和华对摩西说，你手里是什么？他说，是杖。

chapters.en: The LORD said, “Throw it on the ground.” Moses threw it on the ground and it became a snake, and he ran from it.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说，丢在地上。他一丢下去，就变作蛇，摩西便跑开。

chapters.en: Then the LORD said to him, “Reach out your hand and take it by the tail.” So Moses reached out and took hold of the snake and it turned back into a staff in his hand.
chapters.zh: 耶和华对摩西说，伸出手来，拿住它的尾巴，它必在你手中仍变为杖，

chapters.en: “This,” said the LORD, “is so that they may believe that the LORD, the God of their fathers—the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac and the God of Jacob—has appeared to you.”
chapters.zh: 如此好叫他们信耶和华他们祖宗的神，就是亚伯拉罕的神，以撒的神，雅各的神，是向你显现了。

chapters.en: Then the LORD said, “Put your hand inside your cloak.” So Moses put his hand into his cloak, and when he took it out, the skin was leprous —it had become as white as snow.
chapters.zh: 耶和华又对他说，把手放在怀里。他就把手放在怀里，及至抽出来，不料，手长了大麻疯，有雪那样白。

chapters.en: “Now put it back into your cloak,” he said. So Moses put his hand back into his cloak, and when he took it out, it was restored, like the rest of his flesh.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说，再把手放在怀里。他就再把手放在怀里，及至从怀里抽出来，不料，手已经复原，与周身的肉一样，

chapters.en: Then the LORD said, “If they do not believe you or pay attention to the first sign, they may believe the second.
chapters.zh: 又说，倘或他们不听你的话，也不信头一个神迹，他们必信第二个神迹。

chapters.en: But if they do not believe these two signs or listen to you, take some water from the Nile and pour it on the dry ground. The water you take from the river will become blood on the ground.”
chapters.zh: 这两个神迹若都不信，也不听你的话，你就从河里取些水，倒在旱地上，你从河里取的水必在旱地上变作血。

chapters.en: Moses said to the LORD, “Pardon your servant, Lord. I have never been eloquent, neither in the past nor since you have spoken to your servant. I am slow of speech and tongue.”
chapters.zh: 摩西对耶和华说，主阿，我素日不是能言的人，就是从你对仆人说话以后，也是这样。我本是拙口笨舌的。

chapters.en: The LORD said to him, “Who gave human beings their mouths? Who makes them deaf or mute? Who gives them sight or makes them blind? Is it not I, the LORD?
chapters.zh: 耶和华对他说，谁造人的口呢？谁使人口哑，耳聋，目明，眼瞎呢？岂不是我耶和华吗？

chapters.en: Now go; I will help you speak and will teach you what to say.”
chapters.zh: 现在去吧，我必赐你口才，指教你所当说的话。

chapters.en: But Moses said, “Pardon your servant, Lord. Please send someone else.”
chapters.zh: 摩西说，主阿，你愿意打发谁，就打发谁去吧。

chapters.en: Then the LORD’s anger burned against Moses and he said, “What about your brother, Aaron the Levite? I know he can speak well. He is already on his way to meet you, and he will be glad to see you.
chapters.zh: 耶和华向摩西发怒说，不是有你的哥哥利未人亚伦吗？我知道他是能言的，现在他出来迎接你，他一见你，心里就欢喜。

chapters.en: You shall speak to him and put words in his mouth; I will help both of you speak and will teach you what to do.
chapters.zh: 你要将当说的话传给他，我也要赐你和他口才，又要指教你们所当行的事。

chapters.en: He will speak to the people for you, and it will be as if he were your mouth and as if you were God to him.
chapters.zh: 他要替你对百姓说话，你要以他当作口，他要以你当作神。

chapters.en: But take this staff in your hand so you can perform the signs with it.”
chapters.zh: 你手里要拿这杖，好行神迹。

chapters.en: Then Moses went back to Jethro his father-in-law and said to him, “Let me return to my own people in Egypt to see if any of them are still alive.” Jethro said, “Go, and I wish you well.”
chapters.zh: 于是，摩西回到他岳父叶忒罗那里，对他说，求你容我回去见我在埃及的弟兄，看他们还在不在。叶忒罗对摩西说，你可以平平安安地去吧。

chapters.en: Now the LORD had said to Moses in Midian, “Go back to Egypt, for all those who wanted to kill you are dead.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华在米甸对摩西说，你要回埃及去，因为寻索你命的人都死了。

chapters.en: So Moses took his wife and sons, put them on a donkey and started back to Egypt. And he took the staff of God in his hand.
chapters.zh: 摩西就带着妻子和两个儿子，叫他们骑上驴，回埃及地去。摩西手里拿着神的杖。

chapters.en: The LORD said to Moses, “When you return to Egypt, see that you perform before Pharaoh all the wonders I have given you the power to do. But I will harden his heart so that he will not let the people go.
chapters.zh: 耶和华对摩西说，你回到埃及的时候，要留意将我指示你的一切奇事行在法老面前。但我要使（或作任凭下同）他的心刚硬，他必不容百姓去。

chapters.en: Then say to Pharaoh, ‘This is what the LORD says: Israel is my firstborn son,
chapters.zh: 你要对法老说，耶和华这样说，以色列是我的儿子，我的长子。

chapters.en: and I told you, “Let my son go, so he may worship me.” But you refused to let him go; so I will kill your firstborn son.’ ”
chapters.zh: 我对你说过，容我的儿子去，好事奉我。你还是不肯容他去。看哪，我要杀你的长子。

chapters.en: At a lodging place on the way, the LORD met Moses and was about to kill him.
chapters.zh: 摩西在路上住宿的地方，耶和华遇见他，想要杀他。

chapters.en: But Zipporah took a flint knife, cut off her son’s foreskin and touched Moses’ feet with it. “Surely you are a bridegroom of blood to me,” she said.
chapters.zh: 西坡拉就拿一块火石，割下他儿子的阳皮，丢在摩西脚前，说，你真是我的血郎了。

chapters.en: So the LORD let him alone. (At that time she said “bridegroom of blood,” referring to circumcision.)
chapters.zh: 这样，耶和华才放了他。西坡拉说，你因割礼就是血郎了。

chapters.en: The LORD said to Aaron, “Go into the wilderness to meet Moses.” So he met Moses at the mountain of God and kissed him.
chapters.zh: 耶和华对亚伦说，你往旷野去迎接摩西。他就去，在神的山遇见摩西，和他亲嘴。

chapters.en: Then Moses told Aaron everything the LORD had sent him to say, and also about all the signs he had commanded him to perform.
chapters.zh: 摩西将耶和华打发他所说的言语和嘱咐他所行的神迹都告诉了亚伦。

chapters.en: Moses and Aaron brought together all the elders of the Israelites,
chapters.zh: 摩西，亚伦就去招聚以色列的众长老。

chapters.en: and Aaron told them everything the LORD had said to Moses. He also performed the signs before the people,
chapters.zh: 亚伦将耶和华对摩西所说的一切话述说了一遍，又在百姓眼前行了那些神迹，

chapters.en: and they believed. And when they heard that the LORD was concerned about them and had seen their misery, they bowed down and worshiped.
chapters.zh: 百姓就信了。以色列人听见耶和华眷顾他们，鉴察他们的困苦，就低头下拜。

chapters.en: Afterward Moses and Aaron went to Pharaoh and said, “This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: ‘Let my people go, so that they may hold a festival to me in the wilderness.’ ”
chapters.zh: 后来摩西，亚伦去对法老说，耶和华以色列的神这样说，容我的百姓去，在旷野向我守节。

chapters.en: Pharaoh said, “Who is the LORD, that I should obey him and let Israel go? I do not know the LORD and I will not let Israel go.”
chapters.zh: 法老说，耶和华是谁，使我听他的话，容以色列人去呢？我不认识耶和华，也不容以色列人去。

chapters.en: Then they said, “The God of the Hebrews has met with us. Now let us take a three-day journey into the wilderness to offer sacrifices to the LORD our God, or he may strike us with plagues or with the sword.”
chapters.zh: 他们说，希伯来人的神遇见了我们。求你容我们往旷野去，走三天的路程，祭祀耶和华我们的神，免得他用瘟疫，刀兵攻击我们。

chapters.en: But the king of Egypt said, “Moses and Aaron, why are you taking the people away from their labor? Get back to your work!”
chapters.zh: 埃及王对他们说，摩西，亚伦，你们为什么叫百姓旷工呢？你们去担你们的担子吧。

chapters.en: Then Pharaoh said, “Look, the people of the land are now numerous, and you are stopping them from working.”
chapters.zh: 又说，看哪，这地的以色列人如今众多，你们竟叫他们歇下担子。

chapters.en: That same day Pharaoh gave this order to the slave drivers and overseers in charge of the people:
chapters.zh: 当天，法老吩咐督工的和官长说，

chapters.en: “You are no longer to supply the people with straw for making bricks; let them go and gather their own straw.
chapters.zh: 你们不可照常把草给百姓作砖，叫他们自己去捡草。

chapters.en: But require them to make the same number of bricks as before; don’t reduce the quota. They are lazy; that is why they are crying out, ‘Let us go and sacrifice to our God.’
chapters.zh: 他们素常作砖的数目，你们仍旧向他们要，一点不可减少，因为他们是懒惰的，所以呼求说，容我们去祭祀我们的神。

chapters.en: Make the work harder for the people so that they keep working and pay no attention to lies.”
chapters.zh: 你们要把更重的工夫加在这些人身上，叫他们劳碌，不听虚谎的言语。

chapters.en: Then the slave drivers and the overseers went out and said to the people, “This is what Pharaoh says: ‘I will not give you any more straw.
chapters.zh: 督工的和官长出来对百姓说，法老这样说，我不给你们草。

chapters.en: Go and get your own straw wherever you can find it, but your work will not be reduced at all.’ ”
chapters.zh: 你们自己在哪里能找草，就往哪里去找吧，但你们的工一点不可减少。

chapters.en: So the people scattered all over Egypt to gather stubble to use for straw.
chapters.zh: 于是百姓散在埃及遍地，捡碎秸当作草。

chapters.en: The slave drivers kept pressing them, saying, “Complete the work required of you for each day, just as when you had straw.”
chapters.zh: 督工的催着说，你们一天当完一天的工，与先前有草一样。

chapters.en: And Pharaoh’s slave drivers beat the Israelite overseers they had appointed, demanding, “Why haven’t you met your quota of bricks yesterday or today, as before?”
chapters.zh: 法老督工的，责打他所派以色列人的官长，说，你们昨天今天为什么没有照向来的数目作砖，完你们的工作呢？

chapters.en: Then the Israelite overseers went and appealed to Pharaoh: “Why have you treated your servants this way?
chapters.zh: 以色列人的官长就来哀求法老说，为什么这样待你的仆人？

chapters.en: Your servants are given no straw, yet we are told, ‘Make bricks!’ Your servants are being beaten, but the fault is with your own people.”
chapters.zh: 督工的不把草给仆人，并且对我们说，作砖吧。看哪，你仆人挨了打，其实是你百姓的错。

chapters.en: Pharaoh said, “Lazy, that’s what you are—lazy! That is why you keep saying, ‘Let us go and sacrifice to the LORD.’
chapters.zh: 但法老说，你们是懒惰的，你们是懒惰的，所以说，容我们去祭祀耶和华。

chapters.en: Now get to work. You will not be given any straw, yet you must produce your full quota of bricks.”
chapters.zh: 现在你们去作工吧，草是不给你们的，砖却要如数交纳。

chapters.en: The Israelite overseers realized they were in trouble when they were told, “You are not to reduce the number of bricks required of you for each day.”
chapters.zh: 以色列人的官长听说，你们每天作砖的工作一点不可减少，就知道是遭遇祸患了。

chapters.en: When they left Pharaoh, they found Moses and Aaron waiting to meet them,
chapters.zh: 他们离了法老出来，正遇见摩西，亚伦站在对面，

chapters.en: and they said, “May the LORD look on you and judge you! You have made us obnoxious to Pharaoh and his officials and have put a sword in their hand to kill us.”
chapters.zh: 就向他们说，愿耶和华鉴察你们，施行判断，因你们使我们在法老和他臣仆面前有了臭名，把刀递在他们手中杀我们。

chapters.en: Moses returned to the LORD and said, “Why, Lord, why have you brought trouble on this people? Is this why you sent me?
chapters.zh: 摩西回到耶和华那里，说，主阿，你为什么苦待这百姓呢？为什么打发我去呢？

chapters.en: Ever since I went to Pharaoh to speak in your name, he has brought trouble on this people, and you have not rescued your people at all.”
chapters.zh: 自从我去见法老，奉你的名说话，他就苦待这百姓，你一点也没有拯救他们。

chapters.en: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Now you will see what I will do to Pharaoh: Because of my mighty hand he will let them go; because of my mighty hand he will drive them out of his country.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华对摩西说，现在你必看见我向法老所行的事，使他因我大能的手容以色列人去，且把他们赶出他的地。

chapters.en: God also said to Moses, “I am the LORD.
chapters.zh: 神晓谕摩西说，我是耶和华。

chapters.en: I appeared to Abraham, to Isaac and to Jacob as God Almighty, but by my name the LORD I did not make myself fully known to them.
chapters.zh: 我从前向亚伯拉罕，以撒，雅各显现为全能的神，至于我名耶和华，他们未曾知道。

chapters.en: I also established my covenant with them to give them the land of Canaan, where they resided as foreigners.
chapters.zh: 我与他们坚定所立的约，要把他们寄居的迦南地赐给他们。

chapters.en: Moreover, I have heard the groaning of the Israelites, whom the Egyptians are enslaving, and I have remembered my covenant.
chapters.zh: 我也听见以色列人被埃及人苦待的哀声，我也记念我的约。

chapters.en: “Therefore, say to the Israelites: ‘I am the LORD, and I will bring you out from under the yoke of the Egyptians. I will free you from being slaves to them, and I will redeem you with an outstretched arm and with mighty acts of judgment.
chapters.zh: 所以你要对以色列人说，我是耶和华，我要用伸出来的膀臂重重地刑罚埃及人，救赎你们脱离他们的重担，不作他们的苦工。

chapters.en: I will take you as my own people, and I will be your God. Then you will know that I am the LORD your God, who brought you out from under the yoke of the Egyptians.
chapters.zh: 我要以你们为我的百姓，我也要作你们的神。你们要知道我是耶和华你们的神，是救你们脱离埃及人之重担的。

chapters.en: And I will bring you to the land I swore with uplifted hand to give to Abraham, to Isaac and to Jacob. I will give it to you as a possession. I am the LORD.’ ”
chapters.zh: 我起誓应许给亚伯拉罕，以撒，雅各的那地，我要把你们领进去，将那地赐给你们为业。我是耶和华。

chapters.en: Moses reported this to the Israelites, but they did not listen to him because of their discouragement and harsh labor.
chapters.zh: 摩西将这话告诉以色列人，只是他们因苦工愁烦，不肯听他的话。

chapters.en: Then the LORD said to Moses,
chapters.zh: 耶和华晓谕摩西说，

chapters.en: “Go, tell Pharaoh king of Egypt to let the Israelites go out of his country.”
chapters.zh: 你进去对埃及王法老说，要容以色列人出他的地。

chapters.en: But Moses said to the LORD, “If the Israelites will not listen to me, why would Pharaoh listen to me, since I speak with faltering lips ?”
chapters.zh: 摩西在耶和华面前说，以色列人尚且不听我的话，法老怎肯听我这拙口笨舌的人呢？

chapters.en: Now the LORD spoke to Moses and Aaron about the Israelites and Pharaoh king of Egypt, and he commanded them to bring the Israelites out of Egypt.
chapters.zh: 耶和华吩咐摩西，亚伦往以色列人和埃及王法老那里去，把以色列人从埃及地领出来。

chapters.en: These were the heads of their families : The sons of Reuben the firstborn son of Israel were Hanok and Pallu, Hezron and Karmi. These were the clans of Reuben.
chapters.zh: 以色列人家长的名字记在下面。以色列长子流便的儿子是哈诺，法路，希斯仑，迦米，这是流便的各家。

chapters.en: The sons of Simeon were Jemuel, Jamin, Ohad, Jakin, Zohar and Shaul the son of a Canaanite woman. These were the clans of Simeon.
chapters.zh: 西缅的儿子是耶母利，雅悯，阿辖，雅斤，琐辖，和迦南女子的儿子扫罗，这是西缅的各家。

chapters.en: These were the names of the sons of Levi according to their records: Gershon, Kohath and Merari. Levi lived 137 years.
chapters.zh: 利未众子的名字按着他们的后代记在下面，就是革顺，哥辖，米拉利。利未一生的岁数是一百三十七岁。

chapters.en: The sons of Gershon, by clans, were Libni and Shimei.
chapters.zh: 革顺的儿子按着家室是立尼，示每。

chapters.en: The sons of Kohath were Amram, Izhar, Hebron and Uzziel. Kohath lived 133 years.
chapters.zh: 哥辖的儿子是暗兰，以斯哈，希伯伦，乌薛。哥辖一生的岁数是一百三十三岁。

chapters.en: The sons of Merari were Mahli and Mushi. These were the clans of Levi according to their records.
chapters.zh: 米拉利的儿子是抹利和母示，这是利未的家，都按着他们的后代。

chapters.en: Amram married his father’s sister Jochebed, who bore him Aaron and Moses. Amram lived 137 years.
chapters.zh: 暗兰娶了他父亲的妹妹约基别为妻，她给他生了亚伦和摩西。暗兰一生的岁数是一百三十七岁。

chapters.en: The sons of Izhar were Korah, Nepheg and Zikri.
chapters.zh: 以斯哈的儿子是可拉，尼斐，细基利。

chapters.en: The sons of Uzziel were Mishael, Elzaphan and Sithri.
chapters.zh: 乌薛的儿子是米沙利，以利撒反，西提利。

chapters.en: Aaron married Elisheba, daughter of Amminadab and sister of Nahshon, and she bore him Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.
chapters.zh: 亚伦娶了亚米拿达的女儿，拿顺的妹妹，以利沙巴为妻，她给他生了拿答，亚比户，以利亚撒，以他玛。

chapters.en: The sons of Korah were Assir, Elkanah and Abiasaph. These were the Korahite clans.
chapters.zh: 可拉的儿子是亚惜，以利加拿，亚比亚撒，这是可拉的各家。

chapters.en: Eleazar son of Aaron married one of the daughters of Putiel, and she bore him Phinehas. These were the heads of the Levite families, clan by clan.
chapters.zh: 亚伦的儿子以利亚撒娶了普铁的一个女儿为妻，她给他生了非尼哈。这是利未人的家长，都按着他们的家。

chapters.en: It was this Aaron and Moses to whom the LORD said, “Bring the Israelites out of Egypt by their divisions.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华说，将以色列人按着他们的军队从埃及地领出来。这是对那亚伦，摩西说的。

chapters.en: They were the ones who spoke to Pharaoh king of Egypt about bringing the Israelites out of Egypt—this same Moses and Aaron.
chapters.zh: 对埃及王法老说要将以色列人从埃及领出来的，就是这摩西，亚伦。

chapters.en: Now when the LORD spoke to Moses in Egypt,
chapters.zh: 当耶和华在埃及地对摩西说话的日子，

chapters.en: he said to him, “I am the LORD. Tell Pharaoh king of Egypt everything I tell you.”
chapters.zh: 他向摩西说，我是耶和华，我对你说的一切话，你都要告诉埃及王法老。

chapters.en: But Moses said to the LORD, “Since I speak with faltering lips, why would Pharaoh listen to me?”
chapters.zh: 摩西在耶和华面前说，看哪，我是拙口笨舌的人，法老怎肯听我呢？

chapters.en: Then the LORD said to Moses, “See, I have made you like God to Pharaoh, and your brother Aaron will be your prophet.
chapters.zh: 耶和华对摩西说，我使你在法老面前代替神，你的哥哥亚伦是替你说话的。

chapters.en: You are to say everything I command you, and your brother Aaron is to tell Pharaoh to let the Israelites go out of his country.
chapters.zh: 凡我所吩咐你的，你都要说。你的哥哥亚伦要对法老说，容以色列人出他的地。

chapters.en: But I will harden Pharaoh’s heart, and though I multiply my signs and wonders in Egypt,
chapters.zh: 我要使法老的心刚硬，也要在埃及地多行神迹奇事。

chapters.en: he will not listen to you. Then I will lay my hand on Egypt and with mighty acts of judgment I will bring out my divisions, my people the Israelites.
chapters.zh: 但法老必不听你们，我要伸手重重地刑罚埃及，将我的军队以色列民从埃及地领出来。

chapters.en: And the Egyptians will know that I am the LORD when I stretch out my hand against Egypt and bring the Israelites out of it.”
chapters.zh: 我伸手攻击埃及，将以色列人从他们中间领出来的时候，埃及人就要知道我是耶和华。

chapters.en: Moses and Aaron did just as the LORD commanded them.
chapters.zh: 摩西，亚伦这样行，耶和华怎样吩咐他们，他们就照样行了。

chapters.en: Moses was eighty years old and Aaron eighty-three when they spoke to Pharaoh.
chapters.zh: 摩西，亚伦与法老说话的时候，摩西八十岁，亚伦八十三岁。

chapters.en: The LORD said to Moses and Aaron,
chapters.zh: 耶和华晓谕摩西，亚伦说，

chapters.en: “When Pharaoh says to you, ‘Perform a miracle,’ then say to Aaron, ‘Take your staff and throw it down before Pharaoh,’ and it will become a snake.”
chapters.zh: 法老若对你们说，你们行件奇事吧。你就吩咐亚伦说，把杖丢在法老面前，使杖变作蛇。

chapters.en: So Moses and Aaron went to Pharaoh and did just as the LORD commanded. Aaron threw his staff down in front of Pharaoh and his officials, and it became a snake.
chapters.zh: 摩西，亚伦进去见法老，就照耶和华所吩咐的行。亚伦把杖丢在法老和臣仆面前，杖就变作蛇。

chapters.en: Pharaoh then summoned wise men and sorcerers, and the Egyptian magicians also did the same things by their secret arts:
chapters.zh: 于是法老召了博士和术士来，他们是埃及行法术的，也用邪术照样而行。

chapters.en: Each one threw down his staff and it became a snake. But Aaron’s staff swallowed up their staffs.
chapters.zh: 他们各人丢下自己的杖，杖就变作蛇，但亚伦的杖吞了他们的杖。

chapters.en: Yet Pharaoh’s heart became hard and he would not listen to them, just as the LORD had said.
chapters.zh: 法老心里刚硬，不肯听从摩西，亚伦，正如耶和华所说的。

chapters.en: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Pharaoh’s heart is unyielding; he refuses to let the people go.
chapters.zh: 耶和华对摩西说，法老心里固执，不肯容百姓去。

chapters.en: Go to Pharaoh in the morning as he goes out to the river. Confront him on the bank of the Nile, and take in your hand the staff that was changed into a snake.
chapters.zh: 明日早晨，他出来往水边去，你要往河边迎接他，手里要拿着那变过蛇的杖，

chapters.en: Then say to him, ‘The LORD, the God of the Hebrews, has sent me to say to you: Let my people go, so that they may worship me in the wilderness. But until now you have not listened.
chapters.zh: 对他说，耶和华希伯来人的神打发我来见你，说，容我的百姓去，好在旷野事奉我。到如今你还是不听。

chapters.en: This is what the LORD says: By this you will know that I am the LORD: With the staff that is in my hand I will strike the water of the Nile, and it will be changed into blood.
chapters.zh: 耶和华这样说，我要用我手里的杖击打河中的水，水就变作血，因此，你必知道我是耶和华。

chapters.en: The fish in the Nile will die, and the river will stink; the Egyptians will not be able to drink its water.’ ”
chapters.zh: 河里的鱼必死，河也要腥臭，埃及人就要厌恶吃这河里的水。

chapters.en: The LORD said to Moses, “Tell Aaron, ‘Take your staff and stretch out your hand over the waters of Egypt—over the streams and canals, over the ponds and all the reservoirs—and they will turn to blood.’ Blood will be everywhere in Egypt, even in vessels of wood and stone.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华晓谕摩西说，你对亚伦说，把你的杖伸在埃及所有的水以上，就是在他们的江，河，池，塘以上，叫水都变作血。在埃及遍地，无论在木器中，石器中，都必有血。

chapters.en: Moses and Aaron did just as the LORD had commanded. He raised his staff in the presence of Pharaoh and his officials and struck the water of the Nile, and all the water was changed into blood.
chapters.zh: 摩西，亚伦就照耶和华所吩咐的行。亚伦在法老和臣仆眼前举杖击打河里的水，河里的水都变作血了。

chapters.en: The fish in the Nile died, and the river smelled so bad that the Egyptians could not drink its water. Blood was everywhere in Egypt.
chapters.zh: 河里的鱼死了，河也腥臭了，埃及人就不能吃这河里的水，埃及遍地都有了血。

chapters.en: But the Egyptian magicians did the same things by their secret arts, and Pharaoh’s heart became hard; he would not listen to Moses and Aaron, just as the LORD had said.
chapters.zh: 埃及行法术的，也用邪术照样而行。法老心里刚硬，不肯听摩西，亚伦，正如耶和华所说的。

chapters.en: Instead, he turned and went into his palace, and did not take even this to heart.
chapters.zh: 法老转身进宫，也不把这事放在心上。

chapters.en: And all the Egyptians dug along the Nile to get drinking water, because they could not drink the water of the river.
chapters.zh: 埃及人都在河的两边挖地，要得水喝，因为他们不能喝这河里的水。

chapters.en: Seven days passed after the LORD struck the Nile.
chapters.zh: 耶和华击打河以后满了七天。

chapters.en: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Go to Pharaoh and say to him, ‘This is what the LORD says: Let my people go, so that they may worship me.
chapters.zh: 耶和华吩咐摩西说，你进去见法老，对他说，耶和华这样说，容我的百姓去，好事奉我。

chapters.en: If you refuse to let them go, I will send a plague of frogs on your whole country.
chapters.zh: 你若不肯容他们去，我必使青蛙糟蹋你的四境。

chapters.en: The Nile will teem with frogs. They will come up into your palace and your bedroom and onto your bed, into the houses of your officials and on your people, and into your ovens and kneading troughs.
chapters.zh: 河里要滋生青蛙，这青蛙要上来进你的宫殿和你的卧房，上你的床榻，进你臣仆的房屋，上你百姓的身上，进你的炉灶和你的抟面盆，

chapters.en: The frogs will come up on you and your people and all your officials.’ ”
chapters.zh: 又要上你和你百姓并你众臣仆的身上。

chapters.en: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Tell Aaron, ‘Stretch out your hand with your staff over the streams and canals and ponds, and make frogs come up on the land of Egypt.’ ”
chapters.zh: 耶和华晓谕摩西说，你对亚伦说，把你的杖伸在江，河，池以上，使青蛙到埃及地上来。

chapters.en: So Aaron stretched out his hand over the waters of Egypt, and the frogs came up and covered the land.
chapters.zh: 亚伦便伸杖在埃及的诸水以上，青蛙就上来，遮满了埃及地。

chapters.en: But the magicians did the same things by their secret arts; they also made frogs come up on the land of Egypt.
chapters.zh: 行法术的也用他们的邪术照样而行，叫青蛙上了埃及地。

chapters.en: Pharaoh summoned Moses and Aaron and said, “Pray to the LORD to take the frogs away from me and my people, and I will let your people go to offer sacrifices to the LORD.”
chapters.zh: 法老召了摩西，亚伦来，说，请你们求耶和华使这青蛙离开我和我的民，我就容百姓去祭祀耶和华。

chapters.en: Moses said to Pharaoh, “I leave to you the honor of setting the time for me to pray for you and your officials and your people that you and your houses may be rid of the frogs, except for those that remain in the Nile.”
chapters.zh: 摩西对法老说，任凭你吧，我要何时为你和你的臣仆并你的百姓祈求，除灭青蛙离开你和你的宫殿只留在河里呢？

chapters.en: “Tomorrow,” Pharaoh said. Moses replied, “It will be as you say, so that you may know there is no one like the LORD our God.
chapters.zh: 他说，明天。摩西说，可以照你的话吧，好叫你知道没有像耶和华我们神的。

chapters.en: The frogs will leave you and your houses, your officials and your people; they will remain only in the Nile.”
chapters.zh: 青蛙要离开你和你的宫殿，并你的臣仆与你的百姓，只留在河里。

chapters.en: After Moses and Aaron left Pharaoh, Moses cried out to the LORD about the frogs he had brought on Pharaoh.
chapters.zh: 于是摩西，亚伦离开法老出去。摩西为扰害法老的青蛙呼求耶和华。

chapters.en: And the LORD did what Moses asked. The frogs died in the houses, in the courtyards and in the fields.
chapters.zh: 耶和华就照摩西的话行。凡在房里，院中，田间的青蛙都死了。

chapters.en: They were piled into heaps, and the land reeked of them.
chapters.zh: 众人把青蛙聚拢成堆，遍地就都腥臭。

chapters.en: But when Pharaoh saw that there was relief, he hardened his heart and would not listen to Moses and Aaron, just as the LORD had said.
chapters.zh: 但法老见灾祸松缓，就硬着心，不肯听他们，正如耶和华所说的。

chapters.en: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Tell Aaron, ‘Stretch out your staff and strike the dust of the ground,’ and throughout the land of Egypt the dust will become gnats.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华吩咐摩西说，你对亚伦说，伸出你的杖击打地上的尘土，使尘土在埃及遍地变作虱子（或作虼蚤下同）。

chapters.en: They did this, and when Aaron stretched out his hand with the staff and struck the dust of the ground, gnats came on people and animals. All the dust throughout the land of Egypt became gnats.
chapters.zh: 他们就这样行。亚伦伸杖击打地上的尘土，就在人身上和牲畜身上有了虱子，埃及遍地的尘土都变成虱子了。

chapters.en: But when the magicians tried to produce gnats by their secret arts, they could not. Since the gnats were on people and animals everywhere,
chapters.zh: 行法术的也用邪术要生出虱子来，却是不能。于是在人身上和牲畜身上都有了虱子。

chapters.en: the magicians said to Pharaoh, “This is the finger of God.” But Pharaoh’s heart was hard and he would not listen, just as the LORD had said.
chapters.zh: 行法术的就对法老说，这是神的手段。法老心里刚硬，不肯听摩西，亚伦，正如耶和华所说的。

chapters.en: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Get up early in the morning and confront Pharaoh as he goes to the river and say to him, ‘This is what the LORD says: Let my people go, so that they may worship me.
chapters.zh: 耶和华对摩西说，你清早起来，法老来到水边，你站在他面前，对他说，耶和华这样说，容我的百姓去，好事奉我。

chapters.en: If you do not let my people go, I will send swarms of flies on you and your officials, on your people and into your houses. The houses of the Egyptians will be full of flies; even the ground will be covered with them.
chapters.zh: 你若不容我的百姓去，我要叫成群的苍蝇到你和你臣仆并你百姓的身上，进你的房屋，并且埃及人的房屋和他们所住的地都要满了成群的苍蝇。

chapters.en: “ ‘But on that day I will deal differently with the land of Goshen, where my people live; no swarms of flies will be there, so that you will know that I, the LORD, am in this land.
chapters.zh: 当那日，我必分别我百姓所住的歌珊地，使那里没有成群的苍蝇，好叫你知道我是天下的耶和华。

chapters.en: I will make a distinction between my people and your people. This sign will occur tomorrow.’ ”
chapters.zh: 我要将我的百姓和你的百姓分别出来。明天必有这神迹。

chapters.en: And the LORD did this. Dense swarms of flies poured into Pharaoh’s palace and into the houses of his officials; throughout Egypt the land was ruined by the flies.
chapters.zh: 耶和华就这样行。苍蝇成了大群，进入法老的宫殿，和他臣仆的房屋，埃及遍地就因这成群的苍蝇败坏了。

chapters.en: Then Pharaoh summoned Moses and Aaron and said, “Go, sacrifice to your God here in the land.”
chapters.zh: 法老召了摩西，亚伦来，说，你们去，在这地祭祀你们的神吧。

chapters.en: But Moses said, “That would not be right. The sacrifices we offer the LORD our God would be detestable to the Egyptians. And if we offer sacrifices that are detestable in their eyes, will they not stone us?
chapters.zh: 摩西说，这样行本不相宜，因为我们要把埃及人所厌恶的祭祀耶和华我们的神，若把埃及人所厌恶的在他们眼前献为祭，他们岂不拿石头打死我们吗？

chapters.en: We must take a three-day journey into the wilderness to offer sacrifices to the LORD our God, as he commands us.”
chapters.zh: 我们要往旷野去，走三天的路程，照着耶和华我们神所要吩咐我们的祭祀他。

chapters.en: Pharaoh said, “I will let you go to offer sacrifices to the LORD your God in the wilderness, but you must not go very far. Now pray for me.”
chapters.zh: 法老说，我容你们去，在旷野祭祀耶和华你们的神，只是不要走得很远。求你们为我祈祷。

chapters.en: Moses answered, “As soon as I leave you, I will pray to the LORD, and tomorrow the flies will leave Pharaoh and his officials and his people. Only let Pharaoh be sure that he does not act deceitfully again by not letting the people go to offer sacrifices to the LORD.”
chapters.zh: 摩西说，我要出去求耶和华，使成群的苍蝇明天离开法老和法老的臣仆并法老的百姓，法老却不可再行诡诈，不容百姓去祭祀耶和华。

chapters.en: Then Moses left Pharaoh and prayed to the LORD,
chapters.zh: 于是摩西离开法老去求耶和华。

chapters.en: and the LORD did what Moses asked. The flies left Pharaoh and his officials and his people; not a fly remained.
chapters.zh: 耶和华就照摩西的话行，叫成群的苍蝇离开法老和他的臣仆并他的百姓，一个也没有留下。

chapters.en: But this time also Pharaoh hardened his heart and would not let the people go.
chapters.zh: 这一次法老又硬着心，不容百姓去。

chapters.en: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Go to Pharaoh and say to him, ‘This is what the LORD, the God of the Hebrews, says: “Let my people go, so that they may worship me.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华吩咐摩西说，你进去见法老，对他说，耶和华希伯来人的神这样说，容我的百姓去，好事奉我。

chapters.en: If you refuse to let them go and continue to hold them back,
chapters.zh: 你若不肯容他们去，仍旧强留他们，

chapters.en: the hand of the LORD will bring a terrible plague on your livestock in the field—on your horses, donkeys and camels and on your cattle, sheep and goats.
chapters.zh: 耶和华的手加在你田间的牲畜上，就是在马，驴，骆驼，牛群，羊群上，必有重重的瘟疫。

chapters.en: But the LORD will make a distinction between the livestock of Israel and that of Egypt, so that no animal belonging to the Israelites will die.’ ”
chapters.zh: 耶和华要分别以色列的牲畜和埃及的牲畜，凡属以色列人的，一样都不死。

chapters.en: The LORD set a time and said, “Tomorrow the LORD will do this in the land.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华就定了时候，说，明天耶和华必在此地行这事。

chapters.en: And the next day the LORD did it: All the livestock of the Egyptians died, but not one animal belonging to the Israelites died.
chapters.zh: 第二天，耶和华就行这事。埃及的牲畜几乎都死了，只是以色列人的牲畜一个都没有死。

chapters.en: Pharaoh investigated and found that not even one of the animals of the Israelites had died. Yet his heart was unyielding and he would not let the people go.
chapters.zh: 法老打发人去看，谁知以色列人的牲畜连一个都没有死。法老的心却是固执，不容百姓去。

chapters.en: Then the LORD said to Moses and Aaron, “Take handfuls of soot from a furnace and have Moses toss it into the air in the presence of Pharaoh.
chapters.zh: 耶和华吩咐摩西，亚伦说，你们取几捧炉灰，摩西要在法老面前向天扬起来。

chapters.en: It will become fine dust over the whole land of Egypt, and festering boils will break out on people and animals throughout the land.”
chapters.zh: 这灰要在埃及全地变作尘土，在人身上和牲畜身上成了起泡的疮。

chapters.en: So they took soot from a furnace and stood before Pharaoh. Moses tossed it into the air, and festering boils broke out on people and animals.
chapters.zh: 摩西，亚伦取了炉灰，站在法老面前。摩西向天扬起来，就在人身上和牲畜身上成了起泡的疮。

chapters.en: The magicians could not stand before Moses because of the boils that were on them and on all the Egyptians.
