chapters.zh: 我的使者要在你前面行，领你到亚摩利人，赫人，比利洗人，迦南人，希未人，耶布斯人那里去，我必将他们剪除。

chapters.en: Do not bow down before their gods or worship them or follow their practices. You must demolish them and break their sacred stones to pieces.
chapters.zh: 你不可跪拜他们的神，不可事奉他，也不可效法他们的行为，却要把神像尽行拆毁，打碎他们的柱像。

chapters.en: Worship the LORD your God, and his blessing will be on your food and water. I will take away sickness from among you,
chapters.zh: 你们要事奉耶和华你们的神，他必赐福与你的粮与你的水，也必从你们中间除去疾病。

chapters.en: and none will miscarry or be barren in your land. I will give you a full life span.
chapters.zh: 你境内必没有坠胎的，不生产的。我要使你满了你年日的数目。

chapters.en: “I will send my terror ahead of you and throw into confusion every nation you encounter. I will make all your enemies turn their backs and run.
chapters.zh: 凡你所到的地方，我要使那里的众民在你面前惊骇，扰乱，又要使你一切仇敌转背逃跑。

chapters.en: I will send the hornet ahead of you to drive the Hivites, Canaanites and Hittites out of your way.
chapters.zh: 我要打发黄蜂飞在你前面，把希未人，迦南人，赫人撵出去。

chapters.en: But I will not drive them out in a single year, because the land would become desolate and the wild animals too numerous for you.
chapters.zh: 我不在一年之内将他们从你面前撵出去，恐怕地成为荒凉，野地的兽多起来害你。

chapters.en: Little by little I will drive them out before you, until you have increased enough to take possession of the land.
chapters.zh: 我要渐渐地将他们从你面前撵出去，等到你的人数加多，承受那地为业。

chapters.en: “I will establish your borders from the Red Sea to the Mediterranean Sea, and from the desert to the Euphrates River. I will give into your hands the people who live in the land, and you will drive them out before you.
chapters.zh: 我要定你的境界，从红海直到非利士海，又从旷野直到大河。我要将那地的居民交在你手中，你要将他们从你面前撵出去。

chapters.en: Do not make a covenant with them or with their gods.
chapters.zh: 不可和他们并他们的神立约。

chapters.en: Do not let them live in your land or they will cause you to sin against me, because the worship of their gods will certainly be a snare to you.”
chapters.zh: 他们不可住在你的地上，恐怕他们使你得罪我。你若事奉他们的神，这必成为你的网罗。

chapters.en: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Come up to the LORD, you and Aaron, Nadab and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel. You are to worship at a distance,
chapters.zh: 耶和华对摩西说，你和亚伦，拿答，亚比户，并以色列长老中的七十人，都要上到我这里来，远远地下拜。

chapters.en: but Moses alone is to approach the LORD; the others must not come near. And the people may not come up with him.”
chapters.zh: 惟独你可以亲近耶和华，他们却不可亲近，百姓也不可和你一同上来。

chapters.en: When Moses went and told the people all the LORD’s words and laws, they responded with one voice, “Everything the LORD has said we will do.”
chapters.zh: 摩西下山，将耶和华的命令典章都述说与百姓听。众百姓齐声说，耶和华所吩咐的，我们都必遵行。

chapters.en: Moses then wrote down everything the LORD had said. He got up early the next morning and built an altar at the foot of the mountain and set up twelve stone pillars representing the twelve tribes of Israel.
chapters.zh: 摩西将耶和华的命令都写上。清早起来，在山下筑一座坛，按以色列十二支派立十二根柱子，

chapters.en: Then he sent young Israelite men, and they offered burnt offerings and sacrificed young bulls as fellowship offerings to the LORD.
chapters.zh: 又打发以色列人中的少年人去献燔祭，又向耶和华献牛为平安祭。

chapters.en: Moses took half of the blood and put it in bowls, and the other half he splashed against the altar.
chapters.zh: 摩西将血一半盛在盆中，一半洒在坛上，

chapters.en: Then he took the Book of the Covenant and read it to the people. They responded, “We will do everything the LORD has said; we will obey.”
chapters.zh: 又将约书念给百姓听。他们说，耶和华所吩咐的，我们都必遵行。

chapters.en: Moses then took the blood, sprinkled it on the people and said, “This is the blood of the covenant that the LORD has made with you in accordance with all these words.”
chapters.zh: 摩西将血洒在百姓身上，说，你看，这是立约的血，是耶和华按这一切话与你们立约的凭据。

chapters.en: Moses and Aaron, Nadab and Abihu, and the seventy elders of Israel went up
chapters.zh: 摩西，亚伦，拿答，亚比户，并以色列长老中的七十人，都上了山。

chapters.en: and saw the God of Israel. Under his feet was something like a pavement made of lapis lazuli, as bright blue as the sky.
chapters.zh: 他们看见以色列的神，他脚下仿佛有平铺的蓝宝石，如同天色明净。

chapters.en: But God did not raise his hand against these leaders of the Israelites; they saw God, and they ate and drank.
chapters.zh: 他的手不加害在以色列的尊者身上。他们观看神，他们又吃又喝。

chapters.en: The LORD said to Moses, “Come up to me on the mountain and stay here, and I will give you the tablets of stone with the law and commandments I have written for their instruction.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华对摩西说，你上山到我这里来，住在这里，我要将石版并我所写的律法和诫命赐给你，使你可以教训百姓。

chapters.en: Then Moses set out with Joshua his aide, and Moses went up on the mountain of God.
chapters.zh: 摩西和他的帮手约书亚起来，上了神的山。

chapters.en: He said to the elders, “Wait here for us until we come back to you. Aaron and Hur are with you, and anyone involved in a dispute can go to them.”
chapters.zh: 摩西对长老说，你们在这里等着，等到我们再回来，有亚伦，户珥与你们同在。凡有争讼的，都可以就近他们去。

chapters.en: When Moses went up on the mountain, the cloud covered it,
chapters.zh: 摩西上山，有云彩把山遮盖。

chapters.en: and the glory of the LORD settled on Mount Sinai. For six days the cloud covered the mountain, and on the seventh day the LORD called to Moses from within the cloud.
chapters.zh: 耶和华的荣耀停于西乃山，云彩遮盖山六天，第七天他从云中召摩西。

chapters.en: To the Israelites the glory of the LORD looked like a consuming fire on top of the mountain.
chapters.zh: 耶和华的荣耀在山顶上，在以色列人眼前，形状如烈火。

chapters.en: Then Moses entered the cloud as he went on up the mountain. And he stayed on the mountain forty days and forty nights.
chapters.zh: 摩西进入云中上山，在山上四十昼夜。

chapters.en: The LORD said to Moses,
chapters.zh: 耶和华晓谕摩西说，

chapters.en: “Tell the Israelites to bring me an offering. You are to receive the offering for me from everyone whose heart prompts them to give.
chapters.zh: 你告诉以色列人当为我送礼物来，凡甘心乐意的，你们就可以收下归我。

chapters.en: These are the offerings you are to receive from them: gold, silver and bronze;
chapters.zh: 所要收的礼物，就是金，银，铜，

chapters.en: blue, purple and scarlet yarn and fine linen; goat hair;
chapters.zh: 蓝色，紫色，朱红色线，细麻，山羊毛，

chapters.en: ram skins dyed red and another type of durable leather ; acacia wood;
chapters.zh: 染红的公羊皮，海狗皮，皂荚木，

chapters.en: olive oil for the light; spices for the anointing oil and for the fragrant incense;
chapters.zh: 点灯的油并作膏油和香的香料，

chapters.en: and onyx stones and other gems to be mounted on the ephod and breastpiece.
chapters.zh: 红玛瑙与别样的宝石，可以镶嵌在以弗得和胸牌上。

chapters.en: “Then have them make a sanctuary for me, and I will dwell among them.
chapters.zh: 又当为我造圣所，使我可以住在他们中间。

chapters.en: Make this tabernacle and all its furnishings exactly like the pattern I will show you.
chapters.zh: 制造帐幕和其中的一切器具都要照我所指示你的样式。

chapters.en: “Have them make an ark of acacia wood—two and a half cubits long, a cubit and a half wide, and a cubit and a half high.
chapters.zh: 要用皂荚木作一柜，长二肘半，宽一肘半，高一肘半。

chapters.en: Overlay it with pure gold, both inside and out, and make a gold molding around it.
chapters.zh: 要里外包上精金，四围镶上金牙边。

chapters.en: Cast four gold rings for it and fasten them to its four feet, with two rings on one side and two rings on the other.
chapters.zh: 也要铸四个金环，安在柜的四脚上，这边两环，那边两环。

chapters.en: Then make poles of acacia wood and overlay them with gold.
chapters.zh: 要用皂荚木作两根杠，用金包裹。

chapters.en: Insert the poles into the rings on the sides of the ark to carry it.
chapters.zh: 要把杠穿在柜旁的环内，以便抬柜。

chapters.en: The poles are to remain in the rings of this ark; they are not to be removed.
chapters.zh: 这杠要常在柜的环内，不可抽出来。

chapters.en: Then put in the ark the tablets of the covenant law, which I will give you.
chapters.zh: 必将我所要赐给你的法版放在柜里。

chapters.en: “Make an atonement cover of pure gold—two and a half cubits long and a cubit and a half wide.
chapters.zh: 要用精金作施恩座（施恩或作蔽罪下同），长二肘半，宽一肘半。

chapters.en: And make two cherubim out of hammered gold at the ends of the cover.
chapters.zh: 要用金子锤出两个基路伯来，安在施恩座的两头。

chapters.en: Make one cherub on one end and the second cherub on the other; make the cherubim of one piece with the cover, at the two ends.
chapters.zh: 这头作一个基路伯，那头作一个基路伯，二基路伯要接连一块，在施恩座的两头。

chapters.en: The cherubim are to have their wings spread upward, overshadowing the cover with them. The cherubim are to face each other, looking toward the cover.
chapters.zh: 二基路伯要高张翅膀，遮掩施恩座。基路伯要脸对脸，朝着施恩座。

chapters.en: Place the cover on top of the ark and put in the ark the tablets of the covenant law that I will give you.
chapters.zh: 要将施恩座安在柜的上边，又将我所要赐给你的法版放在柜里。

chapters.en: There, above the cover between the two cherubim that are over the ark of the covenant law, I will meet with you and give you all my commands for the Israelites.
chapters.zh: 我要在那里与你相会，又要从法柜施恩座上二基路伯中间，和你说我所要吩咐你传给以色列人的一切事。

chapters.en: “Make a table of acacia wood—two cubits long, a cubit wide and a cubit and a half high.
chapters.zh: 要用皂荚木作一张桌子，长二肘，宽一肘，高一肘半。

chapters.en: Overlay it with pure gold and make a gold molding around it.
chapters.zh: 要包上精金，四围镶上金牙边。

chapters.en: Also make around it a rim a handbreadth wide and put a gold molding on the rim.
chapters.zh: 桌子的四围各作一掌宽的横梁，横梁上镶着金牙边。

chapters.en: Make four gold rings for the table and fasten them to the four corners, where the four legs are.
chapters.zh: 要作四个金环，安在桌子的四角上，就是桌子四脚上的四角。

chapters.en: The rings are to be close to the rim to hold the poles used in carrying the table.
chapters.zh: 安环子的地方要挨近横梁，可以穿杠抬桌子。

chapters.en: Make the poles of acacia wood, overlay them with gold and carry the table with them.
chapters.zh: 要用皂荚木作两根杠，用金包裹，以便抬桌子。

chapters.en: And make its plates and dishes of pure gold, as well as its pitchers and bowls for the pouring out of offerings.
chapters.zh: 要作桌子上的盘子，调羹，并奠酒的爵和瓶，这都要用精金制作。

chapters.en: Put the bread of the Presence on this table to be before me at all times.
chapters.zh: 又要在桌子上，在我面前，常摆陈设饼。

chapters.en: “Make a lampstand of pure gold. Hammer out its base and shaft, and make its flowerlike cups, buds and blossoms of one piece with them.
chapters.zh: 要用精金作一个灯台。灯台的座和干与杯，球，花，都要接连一块锤出来。

chapters.en: Six branches are to extend from the sides of the lampstand—three on one side and three on the other.
chapters.zh: 灯台两旁要杈出六个枝子，这旁三个，那旁三个。

chapters.en: Three cups shaped like almond flowers with buds and blossoms are to be on one branch, three on the next branch, and the same for all six branches extending from the lampstand.
chapters.zh: 这旁每枝上有三个杯，形状像杏花，有球，有花，那旁每枝上也有三个杯，形状像杏花，有球，有花。从灯台杈出来的六个枝子都是如此。

chapters.en: And on the lampstand there are to be four cups shaped like almond flowers with buds and blossoms.
chapters.zh: 灯台上有四个杯，形状像杏花，有球，有花。

chapters.en: One bud shall be under the first pair of branches extending from the lampstand, a second bud under the second pair, and a third bud under the third pair—six branches in all.
chapters.zh: 灯台每两个枝子以下有球与枝子接连一块。灯台出的六个枝子都是如此。

chapters.en: The buds and branches shall all be of one piece with the lampstand, hammered out of pure gold.
chapters.zh: 球和枝子要接连一块，都是一块精金锤出来的。

chapters.en: “Then make its seven lamps and set them up on it so that they light the space in front of it.
chapters.zh: 要作灯台的七个灯盏。祭司要点这灯，使灯光对照。

chapters.en: Its wick trimmers and trays are to be of pure gold.
chapters.zh: 灯台的蜡剪和蜡花盘也是要精金的。

chapters.en: A talent of pure gold is to be used for the lampstand and all these accessories.
chapters.zh: 作灯台和这一切的器具要用精金一他连得。

chapters.en: See that you make them according to the pattern shown you on the mountain.
chapters.zh: 要谨慎作这些物件，都要照着在山上指示你的样式。

chapters.en: “Make the tabernacle with ten curtains of finely twisted linen and blue, purple and scarlet yarn, with cherubim woven into them by a skilled worker.
chapters.zh: 你要用十幅幔子作帐幕。这些幔子要用捻的细麻和蓝色，紫色，朱红色线制造，并用巧匠的手工绣上基路伯。

chapters.en: All the curtains are to be the same size—twenty-eight cubits long and four cubits wide.
chapters.zh: 每幅幔子要长二十八肘，宽四肘，幔子都要一样的尺寸。

chapters.en: Join five of the curtains together, and do the same with the other five.
chapters.zh: 这五幅幔子要幅幅相连，那五幅幔子也要幅幅相连。

chapters.en: Make loops of blue material along the edge of the end curtain in one set, and do the same with the end curtain in the other set.
chapters.zh: 在这相连的幔子末幅边上要作蓝色的钮扣，在那相连的幔子末幅边上也要照样作。

chapters.en: Make fifty loops on one curtain and fifty loops on the end curtain of the other set, with the loops opposite each other.
chapters.zh: 要在这相连的幔子上作五十个钮扣，在那相连的幔子上也作五十个钮扣，都要两两相对。

chapters.en: Then make fifty gold clasps and use them to fasten the curtains together so that the tabernacle is a unit.
chapters.zh: 又要作五十个金钩，用钩使幔子相连，这才成了一个帐幕。

chapters.en: “Make curtains of goat hair for the tent over the tabernacle—eleven altogether.
chapters.zh: 你要用山羊毛织十一幅幔子，作为帐幕以上的罩棚。

chapters.en: All eleven curtains are to be the same size—thirty cubits long and four cubits wide.
chapters.zh: 每幅幔子要长三十肘，宽四肘，十一幅幔子都要一样的尺寸。

chapters.en: Join five of the curtains together into one set and the other six into another set. Fold the sixth curtain double at the front of the tent.
chapters.zh: 要把五幅幔子连成一幅，又把六幅幔子连成一幅，这第六幅幔子要在罩棚的前面摺上去。

chapters.en: Make fifty loops along the edge of the end curtain in one set and also along the edge of the end curtain in the other set.
chapters.zh: 在这相连的幔子末幅边上要作五十个钮扣，在那相连的幔子末幅边上也作五十个钮扣。

chapters.en: Then make fifty bronze clasps and put them in the loops to fasten the tent together as a unit.
chapters.zh: 又要作五十个铜钩，钩在钮扣中，使罩棚连成一个。

chapters.en: As for the additional length of the tent curtains, the half curtain that is left over is to hang down at the rear of the tabernacle.
chapters.zh: 罩棚的幔子所余那垂下来的半幅幔子，要垂在帐幕的后头。

chapters.en: The tent curtains will be a cubit longer on both sides; what is left will hang over the sides of the tabernacle so as to cover it.
chapters.zh: 罩棚的幔子所余长的，这边一肘，那边一肘，要垂在帐幕的两旁，遮盖帐幕。

chapters.en: Make for the tent a covering of ram skins dyed red, and over that a covering of the other durable leather.
chapters.zh: 又要用染红的公羊皮作罩棚的盖，再用海狗皮作一层罩棚上的顶盖。

chapters.en: “Make upright frames of acacia wood for the tabernacle.
chapters.zh: 你要用皂荚木作帐幕的竖板。

chapters.en: Each frame is to be ten cubits long and a cubit and a half wide,
chapters.zh: 每块要长十肘，宽一肘半，

chapters.en: with two projections set parallel to each other. Make all the frames of the tabernacle in this way.
chapters.zh: 每块必有两榫相对。帐幕一切的板都要这样作。

chapters.en: Make twenty frames for the south side of the tabernacle
chapters.zh: 帐幕的南面要作板二十块。

chapters.en: and make forty silver bases to go under them—two bases for each frame, one under each projection.
chapters.zh: 在这二十块板底下要作四十个带卯的银座，两卯接这块板上的两榫，两卯接那块板上的两榫。

chapters.en: For the other side, the north side of the tabernacle, make twenty frames
chapters.zh: 帐幕第二面，就是北面，也要作板二十块

chapters.en: and forty silver bases—two under each frame.
chapters.zh: 和带卯的银座四十个，这板底下有两卯，那板底下也有两卯。

chapters.en: Make six frames for the far end, that is, the west end of the tabernacle,
chapters.zh: 帐幕的后面，就是西面，要作板六块。

chapters.en: and make two frames for the corners at the far end.
chapters.zh: 帐幕后面的拐角要作板两块。

chapters.en: At these two corners they must be double from the bottom all the way to the top and fitted into a single ring; both shall be like that.
chapters.zh: 板的下半截要双的，上半截要整的，直顶到第一个环子，两块都要这样作两个拐角。

chapters.en: So there will be eight frames and sixteen silver bases—two under each frame.
chapters.zh: 必有八块板和十六个带卯的银座，这板底下有两卯，那板底下也有两卯。

chapters.en: “Also make crossbars of acacia wood: five for the frames on one side of the tabernacle,
chapters.zh: 你要用皂荚木作闩，为帐幕这面的板作五闩，

chapters.en: five for those on the other side, and five for the frames on the west, at the far end of the tabernacle.
chapters.zh: 为帐幕那面的板作五闩，又为帐幕后面的板作五闩。

chapters.en: The center crossbar is to extend from end to end at the middle of the frames.
chapters.zh: 板腰间的中闩要从这一头通到那一头。

chapters.en: Overlay the frames with gold and make gold rings to hold the crossbars. Also overlay the crossbars with gold.
chapters.zh: 板要用金子包裹，又要作板上的金环套闩，闩也要用金子包裹。

chapters.en: “Set up the tabernacle according to the plan shown you on the mountain.
chapters.zh: 要照着在山上指示你的样式立起帐幕。

chapters.en: “Make a curtain of blue, purple and scarlet yarn and finely twisted linen, with cherubim woven into it by a skilled worker.
chapters.zh: 你要用蓝色，紫色，朱红色线，和捻的细麻织幔子，以巧匠的手工绣上基路伯。

chapters.en: Hang it with gold hooks on four posts of acacia wood overlaid with gold and standing on four silver bases.
chapters.zh: 要把幔子挂在四根包金的皂荚木柱子上，柱子上当有金钩，柱子安在四个带卯的银座上。

chapters.en: Hang the curtain from the clasps and place the ark of the covenant law behind the curtain. The curtain will separate the Holy Place from the Most Holy Place.
chapters.zh: 要使幔子垂在钩子下，把法柜抬进幔子内，这幔子要将圣所和至圣所隔开。

chapters.en: Put the atonement cover on the ark of the covenant law in the Most Holy Place.
chapters.zh: 又要把施恩座安在至圣所内的法柜上，

chapters.en: Place the table outside the curtain on the north side of the tabernacle and put the lampstand opposite it on the south side.
chapters.zh: 把桌子安在幔子外帐幕的北面，把灯台安在帐幕的南面，彼此相对。

chapters.en: “For the entrance to the tent make a curtain of blue, purple and scarlet yarn and finely twisted linen—the work of an embroiderer.
chapters.zh: 你要拿蓝色，紫色，朱红色线，和捻的细麻，用绣花的手工织帐幕的门帘。

chapters.en: Make gold hooks for this curtain and five posts of acacia wood overlaid with gold. And cast five bronze bases for them.
chapters.zh: 要用皂荚木为帘子作五根柱子，用金子包裹。柱子上当有金钩，又要为柱子用铜铸造五个带卯的座。

chapters.en: “Build an altar of acacia wood, three cubits high; it is to be square, five cubits long and five cubits wide.
chapters.zh: 你要用皂荚木作坛。这坛要四方的，长五肘，宽五肘，高三肘。

chapters.en: Make a horn at each of the four corners, so that the horns and the altar are of one piece, and overlay the altar with bronze.
chapters.zh: 要在坛的四拐角上作四个角，与坛接连一块，用铜把坛包裹。

chapters.en: Make all its utensils of bronze—its pots to remove the ashes, and its shovels, sprinkling bowls, meat forks and firepans.
chapters.zh: 要作盆，收去坛上的灰，又作铲子，盘子，肉锸子，火鼎，坛上一切的器具都用铜作。

chapters.en: Make a grating for it, a bronze network, and make a bronze ring at each of the four corners of the network.
chapters.zh: 要为坛作一个铜网，在网的四角上作四个铜环，

chapters.en: Put it under the ledge of the altar so that it is halfway up the altar.
chapters.zh: 把网安在坛四面的围腰板以下，使网从下达到坛的半腰。

chapters.en: Make poles of acacia wood for the altar and overlay them with bronze.
chapters.zh: 又要用皂荚木为坛作杠，用铜包裹。

chapters.en: The poles are to be inserted into the rings so they will be on two sides of the altar when it is carried.
chapters.zh: 这杠要穿在坛两旁的环子内，用以抬坛。

chapters.en: Make the altar hollow, out of boards. It is to be made just as you were shown on the mountain.
chapters.zh: 要用板作坛，坛是空的，都照着在山上指示你的样式作。

chapters.en: “Make a courtyard for the tabernacle. The south side shall be a hundred cubits long and is to have curtains of finely twisted linen,
chapters.zh: 你要作帐幕的院子。院子的南面要用捻的细麻作帷子，长一百肘。

chapters.en: with twenty posts and twenty bronze bases and with silver hooks and bands on the posts.
chapters.zh: 帷子的柱子要二十根，带卯的铜座二十个。柱子上的钩子和杆子都要用银子作。

chapters.en: The north side shall also be a hundred cubits long and is to have curtains, with twenty posts and twenty bronze bases and with silver hooks and bands on the posts.
chapters.zh: 北面也当有帷子，长一百肘，帷子的柱子二十根，带卯的铜座二十个。柱子上的钩子和杆子都要用银子作。

chapters.en: “The west end of the courtyard shall be fifty cubits wide and have curtains, with ten posts and ten bases.
chapters.zh: 院子的西面当有帷子，宽五十肘，帷子的柱子十根，带卯的座十个。

chapters.en: On the east end, toward the sunrise, the courtyard shall also be fifty cubits wide.
chapters.zh: 院子的东面要宽五十肘。

chapters.en: Curtains fifteen cubits long are to be on one side of the entrance, with three posts and three bases,
chapters.zh: 门这边的帷子要十五肘，帷子的柱子三根，带卯的座三个。

chapters.en: and curtains fifteen cubits long are to be on the other side, with three posts and three bases.
chapters.zh: 门那边的帷子也要十五肘，帷子的柱子三根，带卯的座三个。

chapters.en: “For the entrance to the courtyard, provide a curtain twenty cubits long, of blue, purple and scarlet yarn and finely twisted linen—the work of an embroiderer—with four posts and four bases.
chapters.zh: 院子的门当有帘子，长二十肘，要拿蓝色，紫色，朱红色线，和捻的细麻，用绣花的手工织成，柱子四根，带卯的座四个。

chapters.en: All the posts around the courtyard are to have silver bands and hooks, and bronze bases.
chapters.zh: 院子四围一切的柱子都要用银杆连络，柱子上的钩子要用银作，带卯的座要用铜作。

chapters.en: The courtyard shall be a hundred cubits long and fifty cubits wide, with curtains of finely twisted linen five cubits high, and with bronze bases.
chapters.zh: 院子要长一百肘，宽五十肘，高五肘，帷子要用捻的细麻作，带卯的座要用铜作。

chapters.en: All the other articles used in the service of the tabernacle, whatever their function, including all the tent pegs for it and those for the courtyard, are to be of bronze.
chapters.zh: 帐幕各样用处的器具，并帐幕一切的橛子，和院子里一切的橛子，都要用铜作。

chapters.en: “Command the Israelites to bring you clear oil of pressed olives for the light so that the lamps may be kept burning.
chapters.zh: 你要吩咐以色列人，把那为点灯捣成的清橄榄油拿来给你，使灯常常点着。

chapters.en: In the tent of meeting, outside the curtain that shields the ark of the covenant law, Aaron and his sons are to keep the lamps burning before the LORD from evening till morning. This is to be a lasting ordinance among the Israelites for the generations to come.
chapters.zh: 在会幕中法柜前的幔外，亚伦和他的儿子，从晚上到早晨，要在耶和华面前经理这灯。这要作以色列人世世代代永远的定例。

chapters.en: “Have Aaron your brother brought to you from among the Israelites, along with his sons Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar, so they may serve me as priests.
chapters.zh: 你要从以色列人中，使你的哥哥亚伦和他的儿子拿答，亚比户，以利亚撒，以他玛一同就近你，给我供祭司的职分。

chapters.en: Make sacred garments for your brother Aaron to give him dignity and honor.
chapters.zh: 你要给你哥哥亚伦作圣衣为荣耀，为华美。

chapters.en: Tell all the skilled workers to whom I have given wisdom in such matters that they are to make garments for Aaron, for his consecration, so he may serve me as priest.
chapters.zh: 又要吩咐一切心中有智慧的，就是我用智慧的灵所充满的，给亚伦作衣服，使他分别为圣，可以给我供祭司的职分。

chapters.en: These are the garments they are to make: a breastpiece, an ephod, a robe, a woven tunic, a turban and a sash. They are to make these sacred garments for your brother Aaron and his sons, so they may serve me as priests.
chapters.zh: 所要作的就是胸牌，以弗得，外袍，杂色的内袍，冠冕，腰带，使你哥哥亚伦和他儿子穿这圣服，可以给我供祭司的职分。

chapters.en: Have them use gold, and blue, purple and scarlet yarn, and fine linen.
chapters.zh: 要用金线和蓝色，紫色，朱红色线，并细麻去作。

chapters.en: “Make the ephod of gold, and of blue, purple and scarlet yarn, and of finely twisted linen—the work of skilled hands.
chapters.zh: 他们要拿金线和蓝色，紫色，朱红色线，并捻的细麻，用巧匠的手工作以弗得。

chapters.en: It is to have two shoulder pieces attached to two of its corners, so it can be fastened.
chapters.zh: 以弗得当有两条肩带，接上两头，使它相连。

chapters.en: Its skillfully woven waistband is to be like it—of one piece with the ephod and made with gold, and with blue, purple and scarlet yarn, and with finely twisted linen.
chapters.zh: 其上巧工织的带子，要和以弗得一样的作法，用以束上，与以弗得接连一块，要用金线和蓝色，紫色，朱红色线，并捻的细麻作成。

chapters.en: “Take two onyx stones and engrave on them the names of the sons of Israel
chapters.zh: 要取两块红玛瑙，在上面刻以色列儿子的名字，

chapters.en: in the order of their birth—six names on one stone and the remaining six on the other.
chapters.zh: 六个名字在这块宝石上，六个名字在那块宝石上，都照他们生来的次序。

chapters.en: Engrave the names of the sons of Israel on the two stones the way a gem cutter engraves a seal. Then mount the stones in gold filigree settings
chapters.zh: 要用刻宝石的手工，仿佛刻图书，按着以色列儿子的名字，刻这两块宝石，要镶在金槽上。

chapters.en: and fasten them on the shoulder pieces of the ephod as memorial stones for the sons of Israel. Aaron is to bear the names on his shoulders as a memorial before the LORD.
chapters.zh: 要将这两块宝石安在以弗得的两条肩带上，为以色列人作纪念石。亚伦要在两肩上担他们的名字，在耶和华面前作为纪念。

chapters.en: Make gold filigree settings
chapters.zh: 要用金子作二槽，

chapters.en: and two braided chains of pure gold, like a rope, and attach the chains to the settings.
chapters.zh: 又拿精金，用拧工仿佛拧绳子，作两条链子，把这拧成的链子搭在二槽上。

chapters.en: “Fashion a breastpiece for making decisions—the work of skilled hands. Make it like the ephod: of gold, and of blue, purple and scarlet yarn, and of finely twisted linen.
chapters.zh: 你要用巧匠的手工作一个决断的胸牌。要和以弗得一样的作法，用金线和蓝色，紫色，朱红色线，并捻的细麻作成。

chapters.en: It is to be square—a span long and a span wide—and folded double.
chapters.zh: 这胸牌要四方的，叠为两层，长一虎口，宽一虎口。

chapters.en: Then mount four rows of precious stones on it. The first row shall be carnelian, chrysolite and beryl;
chapters.zh: 要在上面镶宝石四行，第一行是红宝石，红璧玺，红玉，

chapters.en: the second row shall be turquoise, lapis lazuli and emerald;
chapters.zh: 第二行是绿宝石，蓝宝石，金钢石，

chapters.en: the third row shall be jacinth, agate and amethyst;
chapters.zh: 第三行是紫玛瑙，白玛瑙，紫晶，

chapters.en: the fourth row shall be topaz, onyx and jasper. Mount them in gold filigree settings.
chapters.zh: 第四行是水苍玉，红玛瑙，碧玉。这都要镶在金槽中。

chapters.en: There are to be twelve stones, one for each of the names of the sons of Israel, each engraved like a seal with the name of one of the twelve tribes.
chapters.zh: 这些宝石都要按着以色列十二个儿子的名字，仿佛刻图书，刻十二个支派的名字。

chapters.en: “For the breastpiece make braided chains of pure gold, like a rope.
chapters.zh: 要在胸牌上用精金拧成如绳的链子。

chapters.en: Make two gold rings for it and fasten them to two corners of the breastpiece.
chapters.zh: 在胸牌上也要作两个金环，安在胸牌的两头。

chapters.en: Fasten the two gold chains to the rings at the corners of the breastpiece,
chapters.zh: 要把那两条拧成的金链子，穿过胸牌两头的环子。

chapters.en: and the other ends of the chains to the two settings, attaching them to the shoulder pieces of the ephod at the front.
chapters.zh: 又要把链子的那两头接在两槽上，安在以弗得前面肩带上。

chapters.en: Make two gold rings and attach them to the other two corners of the breastpiece on the inside edge next to the ephod.
chapters.zh: 要作两个金环，安在胸牌的两头，在以弗得里面的边上。

chapters.en: Make two more gold rings and attach them to the bottom of the shoulder pieces on the front of the ephod, close to the seam just above the waistband of the ephod.
chapters.zh: 又要作两个金环，安在以弗得前面两条肩带的下边，挨近相接之处，在以弗得巧工织的带子以上。

chapters.en: The rings of the breastpiece are to be tied to the rings of the ephod with blue cord, connecting it to the waistband, so that the breastpiece will not swing out from the ephod.
chapters.zh: 要用蓝细带子把胸牌的环子与以弗得的环子系住，使胸牌贴在以弗得巧工织的带子上，不可与以弗得离缝。

chapters.en: “Whenever Aaron enters the Holy Place, he will bear the names of the sons of Israel over his heart on the breastpiece of decision as a continuing memorial before the LORD.
chapters.zh: 亚伦进圣所的时候，要将决断胸牌，就是刻着以色列儿子名字的，带在胸前，在耶和华面前常作纪念。

chapters.en: Also put the Urim and the Thummim in the breastpiece, so they may be over Aaron’s heart whenever he enters the presence of the LORD. Thus Aaron will always bear the means of making decisions for the Israelites over his heart before the LORD.
chapters.zh: 又要将乌陵和土明放在决断的胸牌里，亚伦进到耶和华面前的时候，要带在胸前，在耶和华面前常将以色列人的决断牌带在胸前。

chapters.en: “Make the robe of the ephod entirely of blue cloth,
chapters.zh: 你要作以弗得的外袍，颜色全是蓝的。

chapters.en: with an opening for the head in its center. There shall be a woven edge like a collar around this opening, so that it will not tear.
chapters.zh: 袍上要为头留一领口，口的周围织出领边来，仿佛铠甲的领口，免得破裂。

chapters.en: Make pomegranates of blue, purple and scarlet yarn around the hem of the robe, with gold bells between them.
chapters.zh: 袍子周围底边上要用蓝色，紫色，朱红色线作石榴。在袍子周围的石榴中间要有金铃铛，

chapters.en: The gold bells and the pomegranates are to alternate around the hem of the robe.
chapters.zh: 一个金铃铛一个石榴，一个金铃铛一个石榴，在袍子周围的底边上。

chapters.en: Aaron must wear it when he ministers. The sound of the bells will be heard when he enters the Holy Place before the LORD and when he comes out, so that he will not die.
chapters.zh: 亚伦供职的时候要穿这袍子。他进圣所到耶和华面前，以及出来的时候，袍上的响声必被听见，使他不至于死亡。

chapters.en: “Make a plate of pure gold and engrave on it as on a seal: HOLY TO THE LORD.
chapters.zh: 你要用精金作一面牌，在上面按刻图书之法刻着‘归耶和华为圣’。

chapters.en: Fasten a blue cord to it to attach it to the turban; it is to be on the front of the turban.
chapters.zh: 要用一条蓝细带子将牌系在冠冕的前面。

chapters.en: It will be on Aaron’s forehead, and he will bear the guilt involved in the sacred gifts the Israelites consecrate, whatever their gifts may be. It will be on Aaron’s forehead continually so that they will be acceptable to the LORD.
chapters.zh: 这牌必在亚伦的额上，亚伦要担当干犯圣物条例的罪孽，这圣物是以色列人在一切的圣礼物上所分别为圣的。这牌要常在他的额上，使他们可以在耶和华面前蒙悦纳。

chapters.en: “Weave the tunic of fine linen and make the turban of fine linen. The sash is to be the work of an embroiderer.
chapters.zh: 要用杂色细麻线织内袍，用细麻布作冠冕，又用绣花的手工作腰带。

chapters.en: Make tunics, sashes and caps for Aaron’s sons to give them dignity and honor.
chapters.zh: 你要为亚伦的儿子作内袍，腰带，裹头巾，为荣耀，为华美。

chapters.en: After you put these clothes on your brother Aaron and his sons, anoint and ordain them. Consecrate them so they may serve me as priests.
chapters.zh: 要把这些给你的哥哥亚伦和他的儿子穿戴，又要膏他们，将他们分别为圣，好给我供祭司的职分。

chapters.en: “Make linen undergarments as a covering for the body, reaching from the waist to the thigh.
chapters.zh: 要给他们作细麻布裤子，遮掩下体，裤子当从腰达到大腿。

chapters.en: Aaron and his sons must wear them whenever they enter the tent of meeting or approach the altar to minister in the Holy Place, so that they will not incur guilt and die. “This is to be a lasting ordinance for Aaron and his descendants.
chapters.zh: 亚伦和他儿子进入会幕，或就近坛，在圣所供职的时候必穿上，免得担罪而死。这要为亚伦和他的后裔作永远的定例。

chapters.en: “This is what you are to do to consecrate them, so they may serve me as priests: Take a young bull and two rams without defect.
chapters.zh: 你使亚伦和他儿子成圣，给我供祭司的职分，要如此行，取一只公牛犊，两只无残疾的公绵羊，

chapters.en: And from the finest wheat flour make round loaves without yeast, thick loaves without yeast and with olive oil mixed in, and thin loaves without yeast and brushed with olive oil.
chapters.zh: 无酵饼和调油的无酵饼，与抹油的无酵薄饼，这都要用细麦面作成。

chapters.en: Put them in a basket and present them along with the bull and the two rams.
chapters.zh: 这饼要装在一个筐子里，连筐子带来，又把公牛和两只公绵羊牵来。

chapters.en: Then bring Aaron and his sons to the entrance to the tent of meeting and wash them with water.
chapters.zh: 要使亚伦和他儿子到会幕门口来，用水洗身。

chapters.en: Take the garments and dress Aaron with the tunic, the robe of the ephod, the ephod itself and the breastpiece. Fasten the ephod on him by its skillfully woven waistband.
chapters.zh: 要给亚伦穿上内袍和以弗得的外袍，并以弗得，又带上胸牌，束上以弗得巧工织的带子。

chapters.en: Put the turban on his head and attach the sacred emblem to the turban.
chapters.zh: 把冠冕戴在他头上，将圣冠加在冠冕上，

chapters.en: Take the anointing oil and anoint him by pouring it on his head.
chapters.zh: 就把膏油倒在他头上膏他。

chapters.en: Bring his sons and dress them in tunics
chapters.zh: 要叫他的儿子来，给他们穿上内袍。

chapters.en: and fasten caps on them. Then tie sashes on Aaron and his sons. The priesthood is theirs by a lasting ordinance. “Then you shall ordain Aaron and his sons.
chapters.zh: 给亚伦和他儿子束上腰带，包上裹头巾，他们就凭永远的定例得了祭司的职任。又要将亚伦和他儿子分别为圣。

chapters.en: “Bring the bull to the front of the tent of meeting, and Aaron and his sons shall lay their hands on its head.
chapters.zh: 你要把公牛牵到会幕前，亚伦和他儿子要按手在公牛的头上。

chapters.en: Slaughter it in the LORD’s presence at the entrance to the tent of meeting.
chapters.zh: 你要在耶和华面前，在会幕门口，宰这公牛。

chapters.en: Take some of the bull’s blood and put it on the horns of the altar with your finger, and pour out the rest of it at the base of the altar.
chapters.zh: 要取些公牛的血，用指头抹在坛的四角上，把血都倒在坛脚那里。

chapters.en: Then take all the fat on the internal organs, the long lobe of the liver, and both kidneys with the fat on them, and burn them on the altar.
chapters.zh: 要把一切盖脏的脂油与肝上的网子，并两个腰子和腰子上的脂油，都烧在坛上。

chapters.en: But burn the bull’s flesh and its hide and its intestines outside the camp. It is a sin offering.
chapters.zh: 只是公牛的皮，肉，粪都要用火烧在营外。这牛是赎罪祭。

chapters.en: “Take one of the rams, and Aaron and his sons shall lay their hands on its head.
chapters.zh: 你要牵一只公绵羊来，亚伦和他儿子要按手在这羊的头上。

chapters.en: Slaughter it and take the blood and splash it against the sides of the altar.
chapters.zh: 要宰这羊，把血洒在坛的周围。

chapters.en: Cut the ram into pieces and wash the internal organs and the legs, putting them with the head and the other pieces.
chapters.zh: 要把羊切成块子，洗净五脏和腿，连块子带头，都放在一处。

chapters.en: Then burn the entire ram on the altar. It is a burnt offering to the LORD, a pleasing aroma, a food offering presented to the LORD.
chapters.zh: 要把全羊烧在坛上，是给耶和华献的燔祭，是献给耶和华为馨香的火祭。

chapters.en: “Take the other ram, and Aaron and his sons shall lay their hands on its head.
chapters.zh: 你要将那一只公绵羊牵来，亚伦和他儿子要按手在羊的头上。

chapters.en: Slaughter it, take some of its blood and put it on the lobes of the right ears of Aaron and his sons, on the thumbs of their right hands, and on the big toes of their right feet. Then splash blood against the sides of the altar.
chapters.zh: 你要宰这羊，取点血抹在亚伦的右耳垂上和他儿子的右耳垂上，又抹在他们右手的大拇指上和右脚的大拇指上，并要把血洒在坛的四围。

chapters.en: And take some blood from the altar and some of the anointing oil and sprinkle it on Aaron and his garments and on his sons and their garments. Then he and his sons and their garments will be consecrated.
chapters.zh: 你要取点膏油和坛上的血，弹在亚伦和他的衣服上，并他儿子和他儿子的衣服上，他们和他们的衣服就一同成圣。

chapters.en: “Take from this ram the fat, the fat tail, the fat on the internal organs, the long lobe of the liver, both kidneys with the fat on them, and the right thigh. (This is the ram for the ordination.)
chapters.zh: 你要取这羊的脂油和肥尾巴，并盖脏的脂油与肝上的网子，两个腰子和腰子上的脂油并右腿（这是承接圣职所献的羊）。

chapters.en: From the basket of bread made without yeast, which is before the LORD, take one round loaf, one thick loaf with olive oil mixed in, and one thin loaf.
chapters.zh: 再从耶和华面前装无酵饼的筐子中取一个饼，一个调油的饼和一个薄饼，

chapters.en: Put all these in the hands of Aaron and his sons and have them wave them before the LORD as a wave offering.
chapters.zh: 都放在亚伦的手上和他儿子的手上，作为摇祭，在耶和华面前摇一摇。

chapters.en: Then take them from their hands and burn them on the altar along with the burnt offering for a pleasing aroma to the LORD, a food offering presented to the LORD.
chapters.zh: 要从他们手中接过来，烧在耶和华面前坛上的燔祭上，是献给耶和华为馨香的火祭。

chapters.en: After you take the breast of the ram for Aaron’s ordination, wave it before the LORD as a wave offering, and it will be your share.
chapters.zh: 你要取亚伦承接圣职所献公羊的胸，作为摇祭，在耶和华面前摇一摇，这就可以作你的分。

chapters.en: “Consecrate those parts of the ordination ram that belong to Aaron and his sons: the breast that was waved and the thigh that was presented.
chapters.zh: 那摇祭的胸和举祭的腿，就是承接圣职所摇的，所举的，是归亚伦和他儿子的。这些你都要成为圣，

chapters.en: This is always to be the perpetual share from the Israelites for Aaron and his sons. It is the contribution the Israelites are to make to the LORD from their fellowship offerings.
chapters.zh: 作亚伦和他子孙从以色列人中永远所得的分，因为是举祭。这要从以色列人的平安祭中，作为献给耶和华的举祭。

chapters.en: “Aaron’s sacred garments will belong to his descendants so that they can be anointed and ordained in them.
chapters.zh: 亚伦的圣衣要留给他的子孙，可以穿着受膏，又穿着承接圣职。

chapters.en: The son who succeeds him as priest and comes to the tent of meeting to minister in the Holy Place is to wear them seven days.
chapters.zh: 他的子孙接续他当祭司的，每逢进会幕在圣所供职的时候，要穿七天。

chapters.en: “Take the ram for the ordination and cook the meat in a sacred place.
chapters.zh: 你要将承接圣职所献公羊的肉煮在圣处。

chapters.en: At the entrance to the tent of meeting, Aaron and his sons are to eat the meat of the ram and the bread that is in the basket.
chapters.zh: 亚伦和他儿子要在会幕门口吃这羊的肉和筐内的饼。

chapters.en: They are to eat these offerings by which atonement was made for their ordination and consecration. But no one else may eat them, because they are sacred.
chapters.zh: 他们吃那些赎罪之物，好承接圣职，使他们成圣，只是外人不可吃，因为这是圣物。

chapters.en: And if any of the meat of the ordination ram or any bread is left over till morning, burn it up. It must not be eaten, because it is sacred.
chapters.zh: 那承接圣职所献的肉或饼，若有一点留到早晨，就要用火烧了，不可吃这物，因为是圣物。

chapters.en: “Do for Aaron and his sons everything I have commanded you, taking seven days to ordain them.
chapters.zh: 你要这样照我一切所吩咐的，向亚伦和他儿子行承接圣职的礼七天。

chapters.en: Sacrifice a bull each day as a sin offering to make atonement. Purify the altar by making atonement for it, and anoint it to consecrate it.
chapters.zh: 每天要献公牛一只为赎罪祭。你洁净坛的时候，坛就洁净了，且要用膏抹坛，使坛成圣。

chapters.en: For seven days make atonement for the altar and consecrate it. Then the altar will be most holy, and whatever touches it will be holy.
chapters.zh: 要洁净坛七天，使坛成圣，坛就成为至圣。凡挨着坛的都成为圣。

chapters.en: “This is what you are to offer on the altar regularly each day: two lambs a year old.
chapters.zh: 你每天所要献在坛上的就是两只一岁的羊羔，

chapters.en: Offer one in the morning and the other at twilight.
chapters.zh: 早晨要献这一只，黄昏的时候要献那一只。

chapters.en: With the first lamb offer a tenth of an ephah of the finest flour mixed with a quarter of a hin of oil from pressed olives, and a quarter of a hin of wine as a drink offering.
chapters.zh: 和这一只羊羔同献的，要用细面伊法十分之一与捣成的油一欣四分之一调和，又用酒一欣四分之一作为奠祭。

chapters.en: Sacrifice the other lamb at twilight with the same grain offering and its drink offering as in the morning—a pleasing aroma, a food offering presented to the LORD.
chapters.zh: 那一只羊羔要在黄昏的时候献上，照着早晨的素祭和奠祭的礼办理，作为献给耶和华馨香的火祭。

chapters.en: “For the generations to come this burnt offering is to be made regularly at the entrance to the tent of meeting, before the LORD. There I will meet you and speak to you;
chapters.zh: 这要在耶和华面前，会幕门口，作你们世世代代常献的燔祭。我要在那里与你们相会，和你们说话。

chapters.en: there also I will meet with the Israelites, and the place will be consecrated by my glory.
chapters.zh: 我要在那里与以色列人相会，会幕就要因我的荣耀成为圣。

chapters.en: “So I will consecrate the tent of meeting and the altar and will consecrate Aaron and his sons to serve me as priests.
chapters.zh: 我要使会幕和坛成圣，也要使亚伦和他的儿子成圣，给我供祭司的职分。

chapters.en: Then I will dwell among the Israelites and be their God.
chapters.zh: 我要住在以色列人中间，作他们的神。

chapters.en: They will know that I am the LORD their God, who brought them out of Egypt so that I might dwell among them. I am the LORD their God.
chapters.zh: 他们必知道我是耶和华他们的神，是将他们从埃及地领出来的，为要住在他们中间。我是耶和华他们的神。

chapters.en: “Make an altar of acacia wood for burning incense.
chapters.zh: 你要用皂荚木作一座烧香的坛。

chapters.en: It is to be square, a cubit long and a cubit wide, and two cubits high —its horns of one piece with it.
chapters.zh: 这坛要四方的，长一肘，宽一肘，高二肘，坛的四角要与坛接连一块。

chapters.en: Overlay the top and all the sides and the horns with pure gold, and make a gold molding around it.
chapters.zh: 要用精金把坛的上面与坛的四围，并坛的四角，包裹，又要在坛的四围镶上金牙边。

chapters.en: Make two gold rings for the altar below the molding—two on each of the opposite sides—to hold the poles used to carry it.
chapters.zh: 要作两个金环安在牙子边以下，在坛的两旁，两根横撑上，作为穿杠的用处，以便抬坛。

chapters.en: Make the poles of acacia wood and overlay them with gold.
chapters.zh: 要用皂荚木作杠，用金包裹。

chapters.en: Put the altar in front of the curtain that shields the ark of the covenant law—before the atonement cover that is over the tablets of the covenant law—where I will meet with you.
chapters.zh: 要把坛放在法柜前的幔子外，对着法柜上的施恩座，就是我要与你相会的地方。

chapters.en: “Aaron must burn fragrant incense on the altar every morning when he tends the lamps.
chapters.zh: 亚伦在坛上要烧馨香料作的香，每早晨他收拾灯的时候，要烧这香。

chapters.en: He must burn incense again when he lights the lamps at twilight so incense will burn regularly before the LORD for the generations to come.
chapters.zh: 黄昏点灯的时候，他要在耶和华面前烧这香，作为世世代代常烧的香。

chapters.en: Do not offer on this altar any other incense or any burnt offering or grain offering, and do not pour a drink offering on it.
chapters.zh: 在这坛上不可奉上异样的香，不可献燔祭，素祭，也不可浇上奠祭。

chapters.en: Once a year Aaron shall make atonement on its horns. This annual atonement must be made with the blood of the atoning sin offering for the generations to come. It is most holy to the LORD.”
chapters.zh: 亚伦一年一次要在坛的角上行赎罪之礼。他一年一次要用赎罪祭牲的血在坛上行赎罪之礼，作为世世代代的定例。这坛在耶和华面前为至圣。

chapters.en: Then the LORD said to Moses,
chapters.zh: 耶和华晓谕摩西说，

chapters.en: “When you take a census of the Israelites to count them, each one must pay the LORD a ransom for his life at the time he is counted. Then no plague will come on them when you number them.
chapters.zh: 你要按以色列人被数的，计算总数，你数的时候，他们各人要为自己的生命把赎价奉给耶和华，免得数的时候在他们中间有灾殃。

chapters.en: Each one who crosses over to those already counted is to give a half shekel, according to the sanctuary shekel, which weighs twenty gerahs. This half shekel is an offering to the LORD.
chapters.zh: 凡过去归那些被数之人的，每人要按圣所的平，拿银子半舍客勒，这半舍客勒是奉给耶和华的礼物，一舍客勒是二十季拉。

chapters.en: All who cross over, those twenty years old or more, are to give an offering to the LORD.
chapters.zh: 凡过去归那些被数的人，从二十岁以外的，要将这礼物奉给耶和华。

chapters.en: The rich are not to give more than a half shekel and the poor are not to give less when you make the offering to the LORD to atone for your lives.
chapters.zh: 他们为赎生命将礼物奉给耶和华，富足的不可多出，贫穷的也不可少出，各人要出半舍客勒。

chapters.en: Receive the atonement money from the Israelites and use it for the service of the tent of meeting. It will be a memorial for the Israelites before the LORD, making atonement for your lives.”
chapters.zh: 你要从以色列人收这赎罪银，作为会幕的使用，可以在耶和华面前为以色列人作纪念，赎生命。

chapters.en: Then the LORD said to Moses,
chapters.zh: 耶和华晓谕摩西说，

chapters.en: “Make a bronze basin, with its bronze stand, for washing. Place it between the tent of meeting and the altar, and put water in it.
chapters.zh: 你要用铜作洗濯盆和盆座，以便洗濯。要将盆放在会幕和坛的中间，在盆里盛水。

chapters.en: Aaron and his sons are to wash their hands and feet with water from it.
chapters.zh: 亚伦和他的儿子要在这盆里洗手洗脚。

chapters.en: Whenever they enter the tent of meeting, they shall wash with water so that they will not die. Also, when they approach the altar to minister by presenting a food offering to the LORD,
chapters.zh: 他们进会幕，或是就近坛前供职给耶和华献火祭的时候，必用水洗濯，免得死亡。

chapters.en: they shall wash their hands and feet so that they will not die. This is to be a lasting ordinance for Aaron and his descendants for the generations to come.”
chapters.zh: 他们洗手洗脚就免得死亡。这要作亚伦和他后裔世世代代永远的定例。

chapters.en: Then the LORD said to Moses,
chapters.zh: 耶和华晓谕摩西说，

chapters.en: “Take the following fine spices: 500 shekels of liquid myrrh, half as much (that is, 250 shekels) of fragrant cinnamon, 250 shekels of fragrant calamus,
chapters.zh: 你要取上品的香料，就是流质的没药五百舍客勒，香肉桂一半，就是二百五十舍客勒，菖蒲二百五十舍客勒，

chapters.en: 500 shekels of cassia—all according to the sanctuary shekel—and a hin of olive oil.
chapters.zh: 桂皮五百舍客勒，都按着圣所的平，又取橄榄油一欣，

chapters.en: Make these into a sacred anointing oil, a fragrant blend, the work of a perfumer. It will be the sacred anointing oil.
chapters.zh: 按作香之法调和作成圣膏油。

chapters.en: Then use it to anoint the tent of meeting, the ark of the covenant law,
chapters.zh: 要用这膏油抹会幕和法柜，

chapters.en: the table and all its articles, the lampstand and its accessories, the altar of incense,
chapters.zh: 桌子与桌子的一切器具，灯台和灯台的器具，并香坛，

chapters.en: the altar of burnt offering and all its utensils, and the basin with its stand.
chapters.zh: 燔祭坛，和坛的一切器具，洗濯盆和盆座。

chapters.en: You shall consecrate them so they will be most holy, and whatever touches them will be holy.
chapters.zh: 要使这些物成为圣，好成为至圣，凡挨着的都成为圣。

chapters.en: “Anoint Aaron and his sons and consecrate them so they may serve me as priests.
chapters.zh: 要膏亚伦和他的儿子，使他们成为圣，可以给我供祭司的职分。

chapters.en: Say to the Israelites, ‘This is to be my sacred anointing oil for the generations to come.
chapters.zh: 你要对以色列人说，这油，我要世世代代以为圣膏油。

chapters.en: Do not pour it on anyone else’s body and do not make any other oil using the same formula. It is sacred, and you are to consider it sacred.
chapters.zh: 不可倒在别人的身上，也不可按这调和之法作与此相似的。这膏油是圣的，你们也要以为圣。

chapters.en: Whoever makes perfume like it and puts it on anyone other than a priest must be cut off from their people.’ ”
chapters.zh: 凡调和与此相似的，或将这膏膏在别人身上的，这人要从民中剪除。

chapters.en: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Take fragrant spices—gum resin, onycha and galbanum—and pure frankincense, all in equal amounts,
chapters.zh: 耶和华吩咐摩西说，你要取馨香的香料，就是拿他弗，施喜列，喜利比拿，这馨香的香料和净乳香各样要一般大的分量。

chapters.en: and make a fragrant blend of incense, the work of a perfumer. It is to be salted and pure and sacred.
chapters.zh: 你要用这些加上盐，按作香之法作成清净圣洁的香。

chapters.en: Grind some of it to powder and place it in front of the ark of the covenant law in the tent of meeting, where I will meet with you. It shall be most holy to you.
chapters.zh: 这香要取点捣得极细，放在会幕内，法柜前，我要在那里与你相会。你们要以这香为至圣。

chapters.en: Do not make any incense with this formula for yourselves; consider it holy to the LORD.
chapters.zh: 你们不可按这调和之法为自己作香，要以这香为圣，归耶和华。

chapters.en: Whoever makes incense like it to enjoy its fragrance must be cut off from their people.”
chapters.zh: 凡作香和这香一样，为要闻香味的，这人要从民中剪除。

chapters.en: Then the LORD said to Moses,
chapters.zh: 耶和华晓谕摩西说，

chapters.en: “See, I have chosen Bezalel son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah,
chapters.zh: 看哪，犹大支派中，户珥的孙子，乌利的儿子比撒列，我已经提他的名召他。

chapters.en: and I have filled him with the Spirit of God, with wisdom, with understanding, with knowledge and with all kinds of skills—
chapters.zh: 我也以我的灵充满了他，使他有智慧，有聪明，有知识，能作各样的工，

chapters.en: to make artistic designs for work in gold, silver and bronze,
chapters.zh: 能想出巧工，用金，银，铜制造各物，

chapters.en: to cut and set stones, to work in wood, and to engage in all kinds of crafts.
chapters.zh: 又能刻宝石，可以镶嵌，能雕刻木头，能作各样的工。

chapters.en: Moreover, I have appointed Oholiab son of Ahisamak, of the tribe of Dan, to help him. Also I have given ability to all the skilled workers to make everything I have commanded you:
chapters.zh: 我分派但支派中，亚希撒抹的儿子亚何利亚伯与他同工。凡心里有智慧的，我更使他们有智慧，能作我一切所吩咐的，

chapters.en: the tent of meeting, the ark of the covenant law with the atonement cover on it, and all the other furnishings of the tent—
chapters.zh: 就是会幕和法柜，并其上的施恩座，与会幕中一切的器具，

chapters.en: the table and its articles, the pure gold lampstand and all its accessories, the altar of incense,
chapters.zh: 桌子和桌子的器具，精金的灯台和灯台的一切器具并香坛，

chapters.en: the altar of burnt offering and all its utensils, the basin with its stand—
chapters.zh: 燔祭坛和坛的一切器具，并洗濯盆与盆座，

chapters.en: and also the woven garments, both the sacred garments for Aaron the priest and the garments for his sons when they serve as priests,
chapters.zh: 精工作的礼服，和祭司亚伦并他儿子用以供祭司职分的圣衣，

chapters.en: and the anointing oil and fragrant incense for the Holy Place. They are to make them just as I commanded you.”
chapters.zh: 膏油和为圣所用馨香的香料。他们都要照我一切所吩咐的去作。

chapters.en: Then the LORD said to Moses,
chapters.zh: 耶和华晓谕摩西说，

chapters.en: “Say to the Israelites, ‘You must observe my Sabbaths. This will be a sign between me and you for the generations to come, so you may know that I am the LORD, who makes you holy.
chapters.zh: 你要吩咐以色列人说，你们务要守我的安息日，因为这是你我之间世世代代的证据，使你们知道我耶和华是叫你们成为圣的。

chapters.en: “ ‘Observe the Sabbath, because it is holy to you. Anyone who desecrates it is to be put to death; those who do any work on that day must be cut off from their people.
chapters.zh: 所以你们要守安息日，以为圣日。凡干犯这日的，必要把他治死，凡在这日作工的，必从民中剪除。

chapters.en: For six days work is to be done, but the seventh day is a day of sabbath rest, holy to the LORD. Whoever does any work on the Sabbath day is to be put to death.
chapters.zh: 六日要作工，但第七日是安息圣日，是向耶和华守为圣的。凡在安息日作工的，必要把他治死。

chapters.en: The Israelites are to observe the Sabbath, celebrating it for the generations to come as a lasting covenant.
chapters.zh: 故此，以色列人要世世代代守安息日为永远的约。

chapters.en: It will be a sign between me and the Israelites forever, for in six days the LORD made the heavens and the earth, and on the seventh day he rested and was refreshed.’ ”
chapters.zh: 这是我和以色列人永远的证据，因为六日之内耶和华造天地，第七日便安息舒畅。

chapters.en: When the LORD finished speaking to Moses on Mount Sinai, he gave him the two tablets of the covenant law, the tablets of stone inscribed by the finger of God.
chapters.zh: 耶和华在西乃山和摩西说完了话，就把两块法版交给他，是神用指头写的石版。

chapters.en: When the people saw that Moses was so long in coming down from the mountain, they gathered around Aaron and said, “Come, make us gods who will go before us. As for this fellow Moses who brought us up out of Egypt, we don’t know what has happened to him.”
chapters.zh: 百姓见摩西迟延不下山，就大家聚集到亚伦那里，对他说，起来，为我们作神像，可以在我们前面引路，因为领我们出埃及地的那个摩西，我们不知道他遭了什么事。

chapters.en: Aaron answered them, “Take off the gold earrings that your wives, your sons and your daughters are wearing, and bring them to me.”
chapters.zh: 亚伦对他们说，你们去摘下你们妻子，儿女耳上的金环，拿来给我。

chapters.en: So all the people took off their earrings and brought them to Aaron.
chapters.zh: 百姓就都摘下他们耳上的金环，拿来给亚伦。

chapters.en: He took what they handed him and made it into an idol cast in the shape of a calf, fashioning it with a tool. Then they said, “These are your gods, Israel, who brought you up out of Egypt.”
chapters.zh: 亚伦从他们手里接过来，铸了一只牛犊，用雕刻的器具作成。他们就说，以色列阿，这是领你出埃及地的神。

chapters.en: When Aaron saw this, he built an altar in front of the calf and announced, “Tomorrow there will be a festival to the LORD.”
chapters.zh: 亚伦看见，就在牛犊面前筑坛，且宣告说，明日要向耶和华守节。

chapters.en: So the next day the people rose early and sacrificed burnt offerings and presented fellowship offerings. Afterward they sat down to eat and drink and got up to indulge in revelry.
chapters.zh: 次日清早，百姓起来献燔祭和平安祭，就坐下吃喝，起来玩耍。

chapters.en: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Go down, because your people, whom you brought up out of Egypt, have become corrupt.
chapters.zh: 耶和华吩咐摩西说，下去吧，因为你的百姓，就是你从埃及地领出来的，已经败坏了。

chapters.en: They have been quick to turn away from what I commanded them and have made themselves an idol cast in the shape of a calf. They have bowed down to it and sacrificed to it and have said, ‘These are your gods, Israel, who brought you up out of Egypt.’
chapters.zh: 他们快快偏离了我所吩咐的道，为自己铸了一只牛犊，向它下拜献祭，说，以色列阿，这就是领你出埃及地的神。

chapters.en: “I have seen these people,” the LORD said to Moses, “and they are a stiff-necked people.
chapters.zh: 耶和华对摩西说，我看这百姓真是硬着颈项的百姓。

chapters.en: Now leave me alone so that my anger may burn against them and that I may destroy them. Then I will make you into a great nation.”
chapters.zh: 你且由着我，我要向他们发烈怒，将他们灭绝，使你的后裔成为大国。

chapters.en: But Moses sought the favor of the LORD his God. “LORD,” he said, “why should your anger burn against your people, whom you brought out of Egypt with great power and a mighty hand?
chapters.zh: 摩西便恳求耶和华他的神说，耶和华阿，你为什么向你的百姓发烈怒呢？这百姓是你用大力和大能的手从埃及地领出来的。

chapters.en: Why should the Egyptians say, ‘It was with evil intent that he brought them out, to kill them in the mountains and to wipe them off the face of the earth’? Turn from your fierce anger; relent and do not bring disaster on your people.
chapters.zh: 为什么使埃及人议论说，他领他们出去，是要降祸与他们，把他们杀在山中，将他们从地上除灭。求你转意，不发你的烈怒，后悔，不降祸与你的百姓。

chapters.en: Remember your servants Abraham, Isaac and Israel, to whom you swore by your own self: ‘I will make your descendants as numerous as the stars in the sky and I will give your descendants all this land I promised them, and it will be their inheritance forever.’ ”
chapters.zh: 求你记念你的仆人亚伯拉罕，以撒，以色列。你曾指着自己起誓说，我必使你们的后裔像天上的星那样多，并且我所应许的这全地，必给你们的后裔，他们要永远承受为业。

chapters.en: Then the LORD relented and did not bring on his people the disaster he had threatened.
chapters.zh: 于是耶和华后悔，不把所说的祸降与他的百姓。

chapters.en: Moses turned and went down the mountain with the two tablets of the covenant law in his hands. They were inscribed on both sides, front and back.
chapters.zh: 摩西转身下山，手里拿着两块法版。这版是两面写的，这面那面都有字，

chapters.en: The tablets were the work of God; the writing was the writing of God, engraved on the tablets.
chapters.zh: 是神的工作，字是神写的，刻在版上。

chapters.en: When Joshua heard the noise of the people shouting, he said to Moses, “There is the sound of war in the camp.”
chapters.zh: 约书亚一听见百姓呼喊的声音，就对摩西说，在营里有争战的声音。

chapters.en: Moses replied: “It is not the sound of victory, it is not the sound of defeat; it is the sound of singing that I hear.”
chapters.zh: 摩西说，这不是人打胜仗的声音，也不是人打败仗的声音，我所听见的乃是人歌唱的声音。

chapters.en: When Moses approached the camp and saw the calf and the dancing, his anger burned and he threw the tablets out of his hands, breaking them to pieces at the foot of the mountain.
chapters.zh: 摩西挨近营前就看见牛犊，又看见人跳舞，便发烈怒，把两块版扔在山下摔碎了，

chapters.en: And he took the calf the people had made and burned it in the fire; then he ground it to powder, scattered it on the water and made the Israelites drink it.
chapters.zh: 又将他们所铸的牛犊用火焚烧，磨得粉碎，撒在水面上，叫以色列人喝。

chapters.en: He said to Aaron, “What did these people do to you, that you led them into such great sin?”
chapters.zh: 摩西对亚伦说，这百姓向你作了什么？你竟使他们陷在大罪里。

chapters.en: “Do not be angry, my lord,” Aaron answered. “You know how prone these people are to evil.
chapters.zh: 亚伦说，求我主不要发烈怒。这百姓专于作恶，是你知道的。

chapters.en: They said to me, ‘Make us gods who will go before us. As for this fellow Moses who brought us up out of Egypt, we don’t know what has happened to him.’
chapters.zh: 他们对我说，你为我们作神像，可以在我们前面引路，因为领我们出埃及地的那个摩西，我们不知道他遭了什么事。

chapters.en: So I told them, ‘Whoever has any gold jewelry, take it off.’ Then they gave me the gold, and I threw it into the fire, and out came this calf!”
chapters.zh: 我对他们说，凡有金环的可以摘下来，他们就给了我。我把金环扔在火中，这牛犊便出来了。

chapters.en: Moses saw that the people were running wild and that Aaron had let them get out of control and so become a laughingstock to their enemies.
chapters.zh: 摩西见百姓放肆（亚伦纵容他们，使他们在仇敌中间被讥刺），

chapters.en: So he stood at the entrance to the camp and said, “Whoever is for the LORD, come to me.” And all the Levites rallied to him.
chapters.zh: 就站在营门中，说，凡属耶和华的，都要到我这里来。于是利未的子孙都到他那里聚集。

chapters.en: Then he said to them, “This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: ‘Each man strap a sword to his side. Go back and forth through the camp from one end to the other, each killing his brother and friend and neighbor.’ ”
chapters.zh: 他对他们说，耶和华以色列的神这样说，你们各人把刀跨在腰间，在营中往来，从这门到那门，各人杀他的弟兄与同伴并邻舍。

chapters.en: The Levites did as Moses commanded, and that day about three thousand of the people died.
chapters.zh: 利未的子孙照摩西的话行了。那一天百姓中被杀的约有三千。

chapters.en: Then Moses said, “You have been set apart to the LORD today, for you were against your own sons and brothers, and he has blessed you this day.”
chapters.zh: 摩西说，今天你们要自洁，归耶和华为圣，各人攻击他的儿子和弟兄，使耶和华赐福与你们。

chapters.en: The next day Moses said to the people, “You have committed a great sin. But now I will go up to the LORD; perhaps I can make atonement for your sin.”
chapters.zh: 到了第二天，摩西对百姓说，你们犯了大罪。我如今要上耶和华那里去，或者可以为你们赎罪。

chapters.en: So Moses went back to the LORD and said, “Oh, what a great sin these people have committed! They have made themselves gods of gold.
chapters.zh: 摩西回到耶和华那里，说，唉，这百姓犯了大罪，为自己作了金像。

chapters.en: But now, please forgive their sin—but if not, then blot me out of the book you have written.”
chapters.zh: 倘或你肯赦免他们的罪，……不然，求你从你所写的册上涂抹我的名。

chapters.en: The LORD replied to Moses, “Whoever has sinned against me I will blot out of my book.
chapters.zh: 耶和华对摩西说，谁得罪我，我就从我的册上涂抹谁的名。

chapters.en: Now go, lead the people to the place I spoke of, and my angel will go before you. However, when the time comes for me to punish, I will punish them for their sin.”
chapters.zh: 现在你去领这百姓，往我所告诉你的地方去，我的使者必在你前面引路，只是到我追讨的日子，我必追讨他们的罪。

chapters.en: And the LORD struck the people with a plague because of what they did with the calf Aaron had made.
chapters.zh: 耶和华杀百姓的缘故是因他们同亚伦作了牛犊。

chapters.en: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Leave this place, you and the people you brought up out of Egypt, and go up to the land I promised on oath to Abraham, Isaac and Jacob, saying, ‘I will give it to your descendants.’
chapters.zh: 耶和华吩咐摩西说，我曾起誓应许亚伯拉罕，以撒，雅各说，要将迦南地赐给你的后裔。现在你和你从埃及地所领出来的百姓，要从这里往那地去。

chapters.en: I will send an angel before you and drive out the Canaanites, Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites, Hivites and Jebusites.
chapters.zh: 我要差遣使者在你前面，撵出迦南人，亚摩利人，赫人，比利洗人，希未人，耶布斯人，

chapters.en: Go up to the land flowing with milk and honey. But I will not go with you, because you are a stiff-necked people and I might destroy you on the way.”
chapters.zh: 领你到那流奶与蜜之地。我自己不同你们上去，因为你们是硬着颈项的百姓，恐怕我在路上把你们灭绝。

chapters.en: When the people heard these distressing words, they began to mourn and no one put on any ornaments.
chapters.zh: 百姓听见这凶信就悲哀，也没有人佩戴妆饰。

chapters.en: For the LORD had said to Moses, “Tell the Israelites, ‘You are a stiff-necked people. If I were to go with you even for a moment, I might destroy you. Now take off your ornaments and I will decide what to do with you.’ ”
chapters.zh: 耶和华对摩西说，你告诉以色列人说，耶和华说，你们是硬着颈项的百姓，我若一霎时临到你们中间，必灭绝你们。现在你们要把身上的妆饰摘下来，使我可以知道怎样待你们。

chapters.en: So the Israelites stripped off their ornaments at Mount Horeb.
chapters.zh: 以色列人从住何烈山以后，就把身上的妆饰摘得干净。

chapters.en: Now Moses used to take a tent and pitch it outside the camp some distance away, calling it the “tent of meeting.” Anyone inquiring of the LORD would go to the tent of meeting outside the camp.
chapters.zh: 摩西素常将帐棚支搭在营外，离营却远，他称这帐棚为会幕。凡求问耶和华的，就到营外的会幕那里去。

chapters.en: And whenever Moses went out to the tent, all the people rose and stood at the entrances to their tents, watching Moses until he entered the tent.
chapters.zh: 当摩西出营到会幕去的时候，百姓就都起来，各人站在自己帐棚的门口，望着摩西，直等到他进了会幕。

chapters.en: As Moses went into the tent, the pillar of cloud would come down and stay at the entrance, while the LORD spoke with Moses.
chapters.zh: 摩西进会幕的时候，云柱降下来，立在会幕的门前，耶和华便与摩西说话。

chapters.en: Whenever the people saw the pillar of cloud standing at the entrance to the tent, they all stood and worshiped, each at the entrance to their tent.
chapters.zh: 众百姓看见云柱立在会幕门前，就都起来，各人在自己帐棚的门口下拜。

chapters.en: The LORD would speak to Moses face to face, as one speaks to a friend. Then Moses would return to the camp, but his young aide Joshua son of Nun did not leave the tent.
chapters.zh: 耶和华与摩西面对面说话，好像人与朋友说话一般。摩西转到营里去，惟有他的帮手，一个少年人嫩的儿子约书亚，不离开会幕。

chapters.en: Moses said to the LORD, “You have been telling me, ‘Lead these people,’ but you have not let me know whom you will send with me. You have said, ‘I know you by name and you have found favor with me.’
chapters.zh: 摩西对耶和华说，你吩咐我说，将这百姓领上去，却没有叫我知道你要打发谁与我同去，只说，我按你的名认识你，你在我眼前也蒙了恩。

chapters.en: If you are pleased with me, teach me your ways so I may know you and continue to find favor with you. Remember that this nation is your people.”
chapters.zh: 我如今若在你眼前蒙恩，求你将你的道指示我，使我可以认识你，好在你眼前蒙恩。求你想到这民是你的民。

chapters.en: The LORD replied, “My Presence will go with you, and I will give you rest.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华说，我必亲自和你同去，使你得安息。

chapters.en: Then Moses said to him, “If your Presence does not go with us, do not send us up from here.
chapters.zh: 摩西说，你若不亲自和我同去，就不要把我们从这里领上去。

chapters.en: How will anyone know that you are pleased with me and with your people unless you go with us? What else will distinguish me and your people from all the other people on the face of the earth?”
chapters.zh: 人在何事上得以知道我和你的百姓在你眼前蒙恩呢？岂不是因你与我们同去，使我和你的百姓与地上的万民有分别吗？

chapters.en: And the LORD said to Moses, “I will do the very thing you have asked, because I am pleased with you and I know you by name.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华对摩西说，你这所求的我也要行，因为你在我眼前蒙了恩，并且我按你的名认识你。

chapters.en: Then Moses said, “Now show me your glory.”
chapters.zh: 摩西说，求你显出你的荣耀给我看。

chapters.en: And the LORD said, “I will cause all my goodness to pass in front of you, and I will proclaim my name, the LORD, in your presence. I will have mercy on whom I will have mercy, and I will have compassion on whom I will have compassion.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说，我要显我一切的恩慈，在你面前经过，宣告我的名。我要恩待谁就恩待谁，要怜悯谁就怜悯谁，

chapters.en: But,” he said, “you cannot see my face, for no one may see me and live.”
chapters.zh: 又说，你不能看见我的面，因为人见我的面不能存活。

chapters.en: Then the LORD said, “There is a place near me where you may stand on a rock.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说，看哪，在我这里有地方，你要站在磐石上。

chapters.en: When my glory passes by, I will put you in a cleft in the rock and cover you with my hand until I have passed by.
chapters.zh: 我的荣耀经过的时候，我必将你放在磐石穴中，用我的手遮掩你，等我过去，

chapters.en: Then I will remove my hand and you will see my back; but my face must not be seen.”
chapters.zh: 然后我要将我的手收回，你就得见我的背，却不得见我的面。

chapters.en: The LORD said to Moses, “Chisel out two stone tablets like the first ones, and I will write on them the words that were on the first tablets, which you broke.
chapters.zh: 耶和华吩咐摩西说，你要凿出两块石版，和先前你摔碎的那版一样，其上的字我要写在这版上。

chapters.en: Be ready in the morning, and then come up on Mount Sinai. Present yourself to me there on top of the mountain.
chapters.zh: 明日早晨，你要预备好了，上西乃山，在山顶上站在我面前。

chapters.en: No one is to come with you or be seen anywhere on the mountain; not even the flocks and herds may graze in front of the mountain.”
chapters.zh: 谁也不可和你一同上去，遍山都不可有人，在山根也不可叫羊群牛群吃草。

chapters.en: So Moses chiseled out two stone tablets like the first ones and went up Mount Sinai early in the morning, as the LORD had commanded him; and he carried the two stone tablets in his hands.
chapters.zh: 摩西就凿出两块石版，和先前的一样。清晨起来，照耶和华所吩咐的上西乃山去，手里拿着两块石版。

chapters.en: Then the LORD came down in the cloud and stood there with him and proclaimed his name, the LORD.
chapters.zh: 耶和华在云中降临，和摩西一同站在那里，宣告耶和华的名。

chapters.en: And he passed in front of Moses, proclaiming, “The LORD, the LORD, the compassionate and gracious God, slow to anger, abounding in love and faithfulness,
chapters.zh: 耶和华在他面前宣告说，耶和华，耶和华，是有怜悯有恩典的神，不轻易发怒，并有丰盛的慈爱和诚实。

chapters.en: maintaining love to thousands, and forgiving wickedness, rebellion and sin. Yet he does not leave the guilty unpunished; he punishes the children and their children for the sin of the parents to the third and fourth generation.”
chapters.zh: 为千万人存留慈爱，赦免罪孽，过犯，和罪恶，万不以有罪的为无罪，必追讨他的罪，自父及子，直到三，四代。

chapters.en: Moses bowed to the ground at once and worshiped.
chapters.zh: 摩西急忙伏地下拜，

chapters.en: “Lord,” he said, “if I have found favor in your eyes, then let the Lord go with us. Although this is a stiff-necked people, forgive our wickedness and our sin, and take us as your inheritance.”
chapters.zh: 说，主阿，我若在你眼前蒙恩，求你在我们中间同行，因为这是硬着颈项的百姓。又求你赦免我们的罪孽和罪恶，以我们为你的产业。

chapters.en: Then the LORD said: “I am making a covenant with you. Before all your people I will do wonders never before done in any nation in all the world. The people you live among will see how awesome is the work that I, the LORD, will do for you.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说，我要立约，要在百姓面前行奇妙的事，是在遍地万国中所未曾行的。在你四围的外邦人就要看见耶和华的作为，因我向你所行的是可畏惧的事。

chapters.en: Obey what I command you today. I will drive out before you the Amorites, Canaanites, Hittites, Perizzites, Hivites and Jebusites.
chapters.zh: 我今天所吩咐你的，你要谨守。我要从你面前撵出亚摩利人，迦南人，赫人，比利洗人，希未人，耶布斯人。

chapters.en: Be careful not to make a treaty with those who live in the land where you are going, or they will be a snare among you.
chapters.zh: 你要谨慎，不可与你所去那地的居民立约，恐怕成为你们中间的网罗，

chapters.en: Break down their altars, smash their sacred stones and cut down their Asherah poles.
chapters.zh: 却要拆毁他们的祭坛，打碎他们的柱像，砍下他们的木偶。

chapters.en: Do not worship any other god, for the LORD, whose name is Jealous, is a jealous God.
chapters.zh: 不可敬拜别神，因为耶和华是忌邪的神，名为忌邪者。

chapters.en: “Be careful not to make a treaty with those who live in the land; for when they prostitute themselves to their gods and sacrifice to them, they will invite you and you will eat their sacrifices.
chapters.zh: 只怕你与那地的居民立约，百姓随从他们的神，就行邪淫，祭祀他们的神，有人叫你，你便吃他的祭物，

chapters.en: And when you choose some of their daughters as wives for your sons and those daughters prostitute themselves to their gods, they will lead your sons to do the same.
chapters.zh: 又为你的儿子娶他们的女儿为妻，他们的女儿随从他们的神，就行邪淫，使你的儿子也随从他们的神行邪淫。

chapters.en: “Do not make any idols.
chapters.zh: 不可为自己铸造神像。

chapters.en: “Celebrate the Festival of Unleavened Bread. For seven days eat bread made without yeast, as I commanded you. Do this at the appointed time in the month of Aviv, for in that month you came out of Egypt.
chapters.zh: 你要守除酵节，照我所吩咐你的，在亚笔月内所定的日期吃无酵饼七天，因为你是这亚笔月内出了埃及。

chapters.en: “The first offspring of every womb belongs to me, including all the firstborn males of your livestock, whether from herd or flock.
chapters.zh: 凡头生的都是我的，一切牲畜头生的，无论是牛是羊，公的都是我的。

chapters.en: Redeem the firstborn donkey with a lamb, but if you do not redeem it, break its neck. Redeem all your firstborn sons. “No one is to appear before me empty-handed.
chapters.zh: 头生的驴要用羊羔代赎，若不代赎就要打折它的颈项。凡头生的儿子都要赎出来。谁也不可空手朝见我。

chapters.en: “Six days you shall labor, but on the seventh day you shall rest; even during the plowing season and harvest you must rest.
chapters.zh: 你六日要作工，第七日要安息，虽在耕种收割的时候也要安息。

chapters.en: “Celebrate the Festival of Weeks with the firstfruits of the wheat harvest, and the Festival of Ingathering at the turn of the year.
chapters.zh: 在收割初熟麦子的时候要守七七节，又在年底要守收藏节。

chapters.en: Three times a year all your men are to appear before the Sovereign LORD, the God of Israel.
chapters.zh: 你们一切男丁要一年三次朝见主耶和华以色列的神。

chapters.en: I will drive out nations before you and enlarge your territory, and no one will covet your land when you go up three times each year to appear before the LORD your God.
chapters.zh: 我要从你面前赶出外邦人，扩张你的境界。你一年三次上去朝见耶和华你神的时候，必没有人贪慕你的地土。

chapters.en: “Do not offer the blood of a sacrifice to me along with anything containing yeast, and do not let any of the sacrifice from the Passover Festival remain until morning.
chapters.zh: 你不可将我祭物的血和有酵的饼一同献上。逾越节的祭物也不可留到早晨。

chapters.en: “Bring the best of the firstfruits of your soil to the house of the LORD your God. “Do not cook a young goat in its mother’s milk.”
chapters.zh: 地里首先初熟之物要送到耶和华你神的殿。不可用山羊羔母的奶煮山羊羔。

chapters.en: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Write down these words, for in accordance with these words I have made a covenant with you and with Israel.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华吩咐摩西说，你要将这些话写上，因为我是按这话与你和以色列人立约。

chapters.en: Moses was there with the LORD forty days and forty nights without eating bread or drinking water. And he wrote on the tablets the words of the covenant—the Ten Commandments.
chapters.zh: 摩西在耶和华那里四十昼夜，也不吃饭也不喝水。耶和华将这约的话，就是十条诫，写在两块版上。

chapters.en: When Moses came down from Mount Sinai with the two tablets of the covenant law in his hands, he was not aware that his face was radiant because he had spoken with the LORD.
chapters.zh: 摩西手里拿着两块法版下西乃山的时候，不知道自己的面皮因耶和华和他说话就发了光。

chapters.en: When Aaron and all the Israelites saw Moses, his face was radiant, and they were afraid to come near him.
chapters.zh: 亚伦和以色列众人看见摩西的面皮发光就怕挨近他。

chapters.en: But Moses called to them; so Aaron and all the leaders of the community came back to him, and he spoke to them.
chapters.zh: 摩西叫他们来，于是亚伦和会众的官长都到他那里去，摩西就与他们说话。

chapters.en: Afterward all the Israelites came near him, and he gave them all the commands the LORD had given him on Mount Sinai.
chapters.zh: 随后以色列众人都近前来，他就把耶和华在西乃山与他所说的一切话都吩咐他们。

chapters.en: When Moses finished speaking to them, he put a veil over his face.
chapters.zh: 摩西与他们说完了话就用帕子蒙上脸。

chapters.en: But whenever he entered the LORD’s presence to speak with him, he removed the veil until he came out. And when he came out and told the Israelites what he had been commanded,
chapters.zh: 但摩西进到耶和华面前与他说话就揭去帕子，及至出来的时候便将耶和华所吩咐的告诉以色列人。

chapters.en: they saw that his face was radiant. Then Moses would put the veil back over his face until he went in to speak with the LORD.
chapters.zh: 以色列人看见摩西的面皮发光。摩西又用帕子蒙上脸，等到他进去与耶和华说话，就揭去帕子。

chapters.en: Moses assembled the whole Israelite community and said to them, “These are the things the LORD has commanded you to do:
chapters.zh: 摩西招聚以色列全会众，对他们说，这是耶和华所吩咐的话，叫你们照着行，

chapters.en: For six days, work is to be done, but the seventh day shall be your holy day, a day of sabbath rest to the LORD. Whoever does any work on it is to be put to death.
chapters.zh: 六日要作工，第七日乃为圣日，当向耶和华守为安息圣日。凡这日之内作工的，必把他治死。

chapters.en: Do not light a fire in any of your dwellings on the Sabbath day.”
chapters.zh: 当安息日，不可在你们一切的住处生火。

chapters.en: Moses said to the whole Israelite community, “This is what the LORD has commanded:
chapters.zh: 摩西对以色列全会众说，耶和华所吩咐的是这样，

chapters.en: From what you have, take an offering for the LORD. Everyone who is willing is to bring to the LORD an offering of gold, silver and bronze;
chapters.zh: 你们中间要拿礼物献给耶和华，凡乐意献的可以拿耶和华的礼物来，就是金，银，铜，

chapters.en: blue, purple and scarlet yarn and fine linen; goat hair;
chapters.zh: 蓝色，紫色，朱红色线，细麻，山羊毛，

chapters.en: ram skins dyed red and another type of durable leather ; acacia wood;
chapters.zh: 染红的公羊皮，海狗皮，皂荚木，

chapters.en: olive oil for the light; spices for the anointing oil and for the fragrant incense;
chapters.zh: 点灯的油，并作膏油和香的香料，

chapters.en: and onyx stones and other gems to be mounted on the ephod and breastpiece.
chapters.zh: 红玛瑙与别样的宝石，可以镶嵌在以弗得和胸牌上。

chapters.en: “All who are skilled among you are to come and make everything the LORD has commanded:
chapters.zh: 你们中间凡心里有智慧的都要来作耶和华一切所吩咐的，

chapters.en: the tabernacle with its tent and its covering, clasps, frames, crossbars, posts and bases;
chapters.zh: 就是帐幕和帐幕的罩棚，并帐幕的盖，钩子，板，闩，柱子，带卯的座，

chapters.en: the ark with its poles and the atonement cover and the curtain that shields it;
chapters.zh: 柜和柜的杠，施恩座和遮掩柜的幔子，

chapters.en: the table with its poles and all its articles and the bread of the Presence;
chapters.zh: 桌子和桌子的杠与桌子的一切器具，并陈设饼，

chapters.en: the lampstand that is for light with its accessories, lamps and oil for the light;
chapters.zh: 灯台和灯台的器具，灯盏并点灯的油，

chapters.en: the altar of incense with its poles, the anointing oil and the fragrant incense; the curtain for the doorway at the entrance to the tabernacle;
chapters.zh: 香坛和坛的杠，膏油和馨香的香料，并帐幕门口的帘子，

chapters.en: the altar of burnt offering with its bronze grating, its poles and all its utensils; the bronze basin with its stand;
chapters.zh: 燔祭坛和坛的铜网，坛的杠并坛的一切器具，洗濯盆和盆座，

chapters.en: the curtains of the courtyard with its posts and bases, and the curtain for the entrance to the courtyard;
chapters.zh: 院子的帷子和帷子的柱子，带卯的座和院子的门帘，

chapters.en: the tent pegs for the tabernacle and for the courtyard, and their ropes;
chapters.zh: 帐幕的橛子并院子的橛子，和这两处的绳子，

chapters.en: the woven garments worn for ministering in the sanctuary—both the sacred garments for Aaron the priest and the garments for his sons when they serve as priests.”
chapters.zh: 精工作的礼服和祭司亚伦并他儿子在圣所用以供祭司职分的圣衣。

chapters.en: Then the whole Israelite community withdrew from Moses’ presence,
chapters.zh: 以色列全会众从摩西面前退去。

chapters.en: and everyone who was willing and whose heart moved them came and brought an offering to the LORD for the work on the tent of meeting, for all its service, and for the sacred garments.
chapters.zh: 凡心里受感和甘心乐意的都拿耶和华的礼物来，用以作会幕和其中一切的使用，又用以作圣衣。

chapters.en: All who were willing, men and women alike, came and brought gold jewelry of all kinds: brooches, earrings, rings and ornaments. They all presented their gold as a wave offering to the LORD.
chapters.zh: 凡心里乐意献礼物的，连男带女，各将金器，就是胸前针，耳环（或作鼻环），打印的戒指，和手钏带来献给耶和华。

chapters.en: Everyone who had blue, purple or scarlet yarn or fine linen, or goat hair, ram skins dyed red or the other durable leather brought them.
chapters.zh: 凡有蓝色，紫色，朱红色线，细麻，山羊毛，染红的公羊皮，海狗皮的，都拿了来，

chapters.en: Those presenting an offering of silver or bronze brought it as an offering to the LORD, and everyone who had acacia wood for any part of the work brought it.
chapters.zh: 凡献银子和铜给耶和华为礼物的都拿了来，凡有皂荚木可作什么使用的也拿了来。

chapters.en: Every skilled woman spun with her hands and brought what she had spun—blue, purple or scarlet yarn or fine linen.
chapters.zh: 凡心中有智慧的妇女亲手纺线，把所纺的蓝色，紫色，朱红色线，和细麻都拿了来。

chapters.en: And all the women who were willing and had the skill spun the goat hair.
chapters.zh: 凡有智慧，心里受感的妇女就纺山羊毛。

chapters.en: The leaders brought onyx stones and other gems to be mounted on the ephod and breastpiece.
chapters.zh: 众官长把红玛瑙和别样的宝石，可以镶嵌在以弗得与胸牌上的，都拿了来，

chapters.en: They also brought spices and olive oil for the light and for the anointing oil and for the fragrant incense.
chapters.zh: 又拿香料作香，拿油点灯，作膏油。

chapters.en: All the Israelite men and women who were willing brought to the LORD freewill offerings for all the work the LORD through Moses had commanded them to do.
chapters.zh: 以色列人，无论男女，凡甘心乐意献礼物给耶和华的，都将礼物拿来，作耶和华借摩西所吩咐的一切工。

chapters.en: Then Moses said to the Israelites, “See, the LORD has chosen Bezalel son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah,
chapters.zh: 摩西对以色列人说，犹大支派中，户珥的孙子，乌利的儿子比撒列，耶和华已经提他的名召他，

chapters.en: and he has filled him with the Spirit of God, with wisdom, with understanding, with knowledge and with all kinds of skills—
chapters.zh: 又以神的灵充满了他，使他有智慧，聪明，知识，能作各样的工，

chapters.en: to make artistic designs for work in gold, silver and bronze,
chapters.zh: 能想出巧工，用金，银，铜制造各物，

chapters.en: to cut and set stones, to work in wood and to engage in all kinds of artistic crafts.
chapters.zh: 又能刻宝石，可以镶嵌，能雕刻木头，能作各样的巧工。

chapters.en: And he has given both him and Oholiab son of Ahisamak, of the tribe of Dan, the ability to teach others.
chapters.zh: 耶和华又使他，和但支派中亚希撒抹的儿子亚何利亚伯，心里灵明，能教导人。

chapters.en: He has filled them with skill to do all kinds of work as engravers, designers, embroiderers in blue, purple and scarlet yarn and fine linen, and weavers—all of them skilled workers and designers.
chapters.zh: 耶和华使他们的心满有智慧，能作各样的工，无论是雕刻的工，巧匠的工，用蓝色，紫色，朱红色线，和细麻，绣花的工，并机匠的工，他们都能作，也能想出奇巧的工。

chapters.en: So Bezalel, Oholiab and every skilled person to whom the LORD has given skill and ability to know how to carry out all the work of constructing the sanctuary are to do the work just as the LORD has commanded.”
chapters.zh: 比撒列和亚何利亚伯，并一切心里有智慧的，就是蒙耶和华赐智慧聪明，叫他知道作圣所各样使用之工的，都要照耶和华所吩咐的作工。

chapters.en: Then Moses summoned Bezalel and Oholiab and every skilled person to whom the LORD had given ability and who was willing to come and do the work.
chapters.zh: 凡耶和华赐他心里有智慧，而且受感前来作这工的，摩西把他们和比撒列并亚何利亚伯一同召来。

chapters.en: They received from Moses all the offerings the Israelites had brought to carry out the work of constructing the sanctuary. And the people continued to bring freewill offerings morning after morning.
chapters.zh: 这些人就从摩西收了以色列人为作圣所并圣所使用之工所拿来的礼物。百姓每早晨还把甘心献的礼物拿来。

chapters.en: So all the skilled workers who were doing all the work on the sanctuary left what they were doing
chapters.zh: 凡作圣所一切工的智慧人各都离开他所作的工，

chapters.en: and said to Moses, “The people are bringing more than enough for doing the work the LORD commanded to be done.”
chapters.zh: 来对摩西说，百姓为耶和华吩咐使用之工所拿来的，富富有余。

chapters.en: Then Moses gave an order and they sent this word throughout the camp: “No man or woman is to make anything else as an offering for the sanctuary.” And so the people were restrained from bringing more,
chapters.zh: 摩西传命，他们就在全营中宣告说，无论男女，不必再为圣所拿什么礼物来。这样才拦住百姓不再拿礼物来。

chapters.en: because what they already had was more than enough to do all the work.
chapters.zh: 因为他们所有的材料够作一切当作的物，而且有余。

chapters.en: All those who were skilled among the workers made the tabernacle with ten curtains of finely twisted linen and blue, purple and scarlet yarn, with cherubim woven into them by expert hands.
chapters.zh: 他们中间，凡心里有智慧作工的，用十幅幔子作帐幕。这幔子是比撒列用捻的细麻和蓝色，紫色，朱红色线制造的，并用巧匠的手工绣上基路伯。

chapters.en: All the curtains were the same size—twenty-eight cubits long and four cubits wide.
chapters.zh: 每幅幔子长二十八肘，宽四肘，都是一样的尺寸。

chapters.en: They joined five of the curtains together and did the same with the other five.
chapters.zh: 他使这五幅幔子幅幅相连，又使那五幅幔子幅幅相连，

chapters.en: Then they made loops of blue material along the edge of the end curtain in one set, and the same was done with the end curtain in the other set.
chapters.zh: 在这相连的幔子末幅边上作蓝色的钮扣，在那相连的幔子末幅边上也照样作，

chapters.en: They also made fifty loops on one curtain and fifty loops on the end curtain of the other set, with the loops opposite each other.
chapters.zh: 在这相连的幔子上作五十个钮扣，在那相连的幔子上也作五十个钮扣，都是两两相对，

chapters.en: Then they made fifty gold clasps and used them to fasten the two sets of curtains together so that the tabernacle was a unit.
chapters.zh: 又作五十个金钩，使幔子相连。这才成了一个帐幕。

chapters.en: They made curtains of goat hair for the tent over the tabernacle—eleven altogether.
chapters.zh: 他用山羊毛织十一幅幔子，作为帐幕以上的罩棚。

chapters.en: All eleven curtains were the same size—thirty cubits long and four cubits wide.
chapters.zh: 每幅幔子长三十肘，宽四肘，十一幅幔子都是一样的尺寸。

chapters.en: They joined five of the curtains into one set and the other six into another set.
chapters.zh: 他把五幅幔子连成一幅，又把六幅幔子连成一幅，

chapters.en: Then they made fifty loops along the edge of the end curtain in one set and also along the edge of the end curtain in the other set.
chapters.zh: 在这相连的幔子末幅边上作五十个钮扣，在那相连的幔子末幅边上也作五十个钮扣，

chapters.en: They made fifty bronze clasps to fasten the tent together as a unit.
chapters.zh: 又作五十个铜钩，使罩棚连成一个，

chapters.en: Then they made for the tent a covering of ram skins dyed red, and over that a covering of the other durable leather.
chapters.zh: 并用染红的公羊皮作罩棚的盖，再用海狗皮作一层罩棚上的顶盖。

chapters.en: They made upright frames of acacia wood for the tabernacle.
chapters.zh: 他用皂荚木作帐幕的竖板。

chapters.en: Each frame was ten cubits long and a cubit and a half wide,
chapters.zh: 每块长十肘，宽一肘半，

chapters.en: with two projections set parallel to each other. They made all the frames of the tabernacle in this way.
chapters.zh: 每块有两榫相对。帐幕一切的板都是这样作。

chapters.en: They made twenty frames for the south side of the tabernacle
chapters.zh: 帐幕的南面作板二十块。

chapters.en: and made forty silver bases to go under them—two bases for each frame, one under each projection.
chapters.zh: 在这二十块板底下又作四十个带卯的银座，两卯接这块板上的两榫，两卯接那块板上的两榫。

chapters.en: For the other side, the north side of the tabernacle, they made twenty frames
chapters.zh: 帐幕的第二面，就是北面，也作板二十块

chapters.en: and forty silver bases—two under each frame.
chapters.zh: 和带卯的银座四十个，这板底下有两卯，那板底下也有两卯。

chapters.en: They made six frames for the far end, that is, the west end of the tabernacle,
chapters.zh: 帐幕的后面，就是西面，作板六块。

chapters.en: and two frames were made for the corners of the tabernacle at the far end.
chapters.zh: 帐幕后面的拐角作板两块。

chapters.en: At these two corners the frames were double from the bottom all the way to the top and fitted into a single ring; both were made alike.
chapters.zh: 板的下半截是双的，上半截是整的，直到第一个环子，在帐幕的两个拐角上都是这样作。

chapters.en: So there were eight frames and sixteen silver bases—two under each frame.
chapters.zh: 有八块板和十六个带卯的银座，每块板底下有两卯。

chapters.en: They also made crossbars of acacia wood: five for the frames on one side of the tabernacle,
chapters.zh: 他用皂荚木作闩，为帐幕这面的板作五闩，

chapters.en: five for those on the other side, and five for the frames on the west, at the far end of the tabernacle.
chapters.zh: 为帐幕那面的板作五闩，又为帐幕后面的板作五闩，

chapters.en: They made the center crossbar so that it extended from end to end at the middle of the frames.
chapters.zh: 使板腰间的中闩从这一头通到那一头。

chapters.en: They overlaid the frames with gold and made gold rings to hold the crossbars. They also overlaid the crossbars with gold.
chapters.zh: 用金子将板包裹，又作板上的金环套闩，闩也用金子包裹。

chapters.en: They made the curtain of blue, purple and scarlet yarn and finely twisted linen, with cherubim woven into it by a skilled worker.
chapters.zh: 他用蓝色，紫色，朱红色线，和捻的细麻织幔子，以巧匠的手工绣上基路伯。

chapters.en: They made four posts of acacia wood for it and overlaid them with gold. They made gold hooks for them and cast their four silver bases.
chapters.zh: 为幔子作四根皂荚木柱子，用金包裹，柱子上有金钩，又为柱子铸了四个带卯的银座。

chapters.en: For the entrance to the tent they made a curtain of blue, purple and scarlet yarn and finely twisted linen—the work of an embroiderer;
chapters.zh: 拿蓝色，紫色，朱红色线，和捻的细麻，用绣花的手工织帐幕的门帘，

chapters.en: and they made five posts with hooks for them. They overlaid the tops of the posts and their bands with gold and made their five bases of bronze.
chapters.zh: 又为帘子作五根柱子和柱子上的钩子，用金子把柱顶和柱子上的杆子包裹。柱子有五个带卯的座，是铜的。

chapters.en: Bezalel made the ark of acacia wood—two and a half cubits long, a cubit and a half wide, and a cubit and a half high.
chapters.zh: 比撒列用皂荚木作柜，长二肘半，宽一肘半，高一肘半。

chapters.en: He overlaid it with pure gold, both inside and out, and made a gold molding around it.
chapters.zh: 里外包上精金，四围镶上金牙边，

chapters.en: He cast four gold rings for it and fastened them to its four feet, with two rings on one side and two rings on the other.
chapters.zh: 又铸四个金环，安在柜的四脚上，这边两环，那边两环。

chapters.en: Then he made poles of acacia wood and overlaid them with gold.
chapters.zh: 用皂荚木作两根杠，用金包裹。

chapters.en: And he inserted the poles into the rings on the sides of the ark to carry it.
chapters.zh: 把杠穿在柜旁的环内，以便抬柜。

chapters.en: He made the atonement cover of pure gold—two and a half cubits long and a cubit and a half wide.
chapters.zh: 用精金作施恩座，长二肘半，宽一肘半。

chapters.en: Then he made two cherubim out of hammered gold at the ends of the cover.
chapters.zh: 用金子锤出两个基路伯来，安在施恩座的两头，

chapters.en: He made one cherub on one end and the second cherub on the other; at the two ends he made them of one piece with the cover.
chapters.zh: 这头作一个基路伯，那头作一个基路伯，二基路伯接连一块，在施恩座的两头。

chapters.en: The cherubim had their wings spread upward, overshadowing the cover with them. The cherubim faced each other, looking toward the cover.
chapters.zh: 二基路伯高张翅膀，遮掩施恩座，基路伯是脸对脸，朝着施恩座。

chapters.en: They made the table of acacia wood—two cubits long, a cubit wide and a cubit and a half high.
chapters.zh: 他用皂荚木作一张桌子，长二肘，宽一肘，高一肘半，

chapters.en: Then they overlaid it with pure gold and made a gold molding around it.
chapters.zh: 又包上精金，四围镶上金牙边。

chapters.en: They also made around it a rim a handbreadth wide and put a gold molding on the rim.
chapters.zh: 桌子的四围各作一掌宽的横梁，横梁上镶着金牙边，

chapters.en: They cast four gold rings for the table and fastened them to the four corners, where the four legs were.
chapters.zh: 又铸了四个金环，安在桌子四脚的四角上。

chapters.en: The rings were put close to the rim to hold the poles used in carrying the table.
chapters.zh: 安环子的地方是挨近横梁，可以穿杠抬桌子。

chapters.en: The poles for carrying the table were made of acacia wood and were overlaid with gold.
chapters.zh: 他用皂荚木作两根杠，用金包裹，以便抬桌子，
