chapters.zh: 摩西，亚伦，并以色列全会众便向利未人如此行。凡耶和华指着利未人所吩咐摩西的，以色列人就向他们这样行。

chapters.en: The Levites purified themselves and washed their clothes. Then Aaron presented them as a wave offering before the LORD and made atonement for them to purify them.
chapters.zh: 于是利未人洁净自己，除了罪，洗了衣服。亚伦将他们当作摇祭奉到耶和华面前，又为他们赎罪，洁净他们。

chapters.en: After that, the Levites came to do their work at the tent of meeting under the supervision of Aaron and his sons. They did with the Levites just as the LORD commanded Moses.
chapters.zh: 然后利未人进去，在亚伦和他儿子面前，在会幕中办事。耶和华指着利未人怎样吩咐摩西，以色列人就怎样向他们行了。

chapters.en: The LORD said to Moses,
chapters.zh: 耶和华晓谕摩西说，

chapters.en: “This applies to the Levites: Men twenty-five years old or more shall come to take part in the work at the tent of meeting,
chapters.zh: 利未人是这样，从二十五岁以外，他们要前来任职，办会幕的事。

chapters.en: but at the age of fifty, they must retire from their regular service and work no longer.
chapters.zh: 到了五十岁要停工退任，不再办事，

chapters.en: They may assist their brothers in performing their duties at the tent of meeting, but they themselves must not do the work. This, then, is how you are to assign the responsibilities of the Levites.”
chapters.zh: 只要在会幕里，和他们的弟兄一同伺候，谨守所吩咐的，不再办事了。至于所吩咐利未人的，你要这样向他们行。

chapters.en: The LORD spoke to Moses in the Desert of Sinai in the first month of the second year after they came out of Egypt. He said,
chapters.zh: 以色列人出埃及地以后，第二年正月，耶和华在西乃的旷野吩咐摩西说，

chapters.en: “Have the Israelites celebrate the Passover at the appointed time.
chapters.zh: 以色列人应当在所定的日期守逾越节，

chapters.en: Celebrate it at the appointed time, at twilight on the fourteenth day of this month, in accordance with all its rules and regulations.”
chapters.zh: 就是本月十四日黄昏的时候，你们要在所定的日期守这节，要按这节的律例典章而守。

chapters.en: So Moses told the Israelites to celebrate the Passover,
chapters.zh: 于是摩西吩咐以色列人守逾越节。

chapters.en: and they did so in the Desert of Sinai at twilight on the fourteenth day of the first month. The Israelites did everything just as the LORD commanded Moses.
chapters.zh: 他们就在西乃的旷野，正月十四日黄昏的时候，守逾越节。凡耶和华所吩咐摩西的，以色列人都照样行了。

chapters.en: But some of them could not celebrate the Passover on that day because they were ceremonially unclean on account of a dead body. So they came to Moses and Aaron that same day
chapters.zh: 有几个人因死尸而不洁净，不能在那日守逾越节。当日他们到摩西，亚伦面前，

chapters.en: and said to Moses, “We have become unclean because of a dead body, but why should we be kept from presenting the LORD’s offering with the other Israelites at the appointed time?”
chapters.zh: 说，我们虽因死尸而不洁净，为何被阻止，不得同以色列人在所定的日期献耶和华的供物呢？

chapters.en: Moses answered them, “Wait until I find out what the LORD commands concerning you.”
chapters.zh: 摩西对他们说，你们暂且等候，我可以去听耶和华指着你们是怎样吩咐的。

chapters.en: Then the LORD said to Moses,
chapters.zh: 耶和华对摩西说，

chapters.en: “Tell the Israelites: ‘When any of you or your descendants are unclean because of a dead body or are away on a journey, they are still to celebrate the LORD’s Passover,
chapters.zh: 你晓谕以色列人说，你们和你们后代中，若有人因死尸而不洁净，或在远方行路，还要向耶和华守逾越节。

chapters.en: but they are to do it on the fourteenth day of the second month at twilight. They are to eat the lamb, together with unleavened bread and bitter herbs.
chapters.zh: 他们要在二月十四日黄昏的时候，守逾越节。要用无酵饼与苦菜，和逾越节的羊羔同吃。

chapters.en: They must not leave any of it till morning or break any of its bones. When they celebrate the Passover, they must follow all the regulations.
chapters.zh: 一点不可留到早晨。羊羔的骨头一根也不可折断。他们要照逾越节的一切律例而守。

chapters.en: But if anyone who is ceremonially clean and not on a journey fails to celebrate the Passover, they must be cut off from their people for not presenting the LORD’s offering at the appointed time. They will bear the consequences of their sin.
chapters.zh: 那洁净而不行路的人若推辞不守逾越节，那人要从民中剪除。因为他在所定的日期不献耶和华的供物，应该担当他的罪。

chapters.en: “ ‘A foreigner residing among you is also to celebrate the LORD’s Passover in accordance with its rules and regulations. You must have the same regulations for both the foreigner and the native-born.’ ”
chapters.zh: 若有外人寄居在你们中间，愿意向耶和华守逾越节，他要照逾越节的律例典章行，不管是寄居的是本地人，同归一例。

chapters.en: On the day the tabernacle, the tent of the covenant law, was set up, the cloud covered it. From evening till morning the cloud above the tabernacle looked like fire.
chapters.zh: 立起帐幕的那日，有云彩遮盖帐幕，就是法柜的帐幕。从晚上到早晨，云彩在其上，形状如火。

chapters.en: That is how it continued to be; the cloud covered it, and at night it looked like fire.
chapters.zh: 常是这样，云彩遮盖帐幕，夜间形状如火。

chapters.en: Whenever the cloud lifted from above the tent, the Israelites set out; wherever the cloud settled, the Israelites encamped.
chapters.zh: 云彩几时从帐幕收上去，以色列人就几时起行。云彩在哪里停住，以色列人就在那里安营。

chapters.en: At the LORD’s command the Israelites set out, and at his command they encamped. As long as the cloud stayed over the tabernacle, they remained in camp.
chapters.zh: 以色列人遵耶和华的吩咐起行，也遵耶和华的吩咐安营。云彩在帐幕上停住几时，他们就住营几时。

chapters.en: When the cloud remained over the tabernacle a long time, the Israelites obeyed the LORD’s order and did not set out.
chapters.zh: 云彩在帐幕上停留许多日子，以色列人就守耶和华所吩咐的不起行。

chapters.en: Sometimes the cloud was over the tabernacle only a few days; at the LORD’s command they would encamp, and then at his command they would set out.
chapters.zh: 有时云彩在帐幕上几天，他们就照耶和华的吩咐住营，也照耶和华的吩咐起行。

chapters.en: Sometimes the cloud stayed only from evening till morning, and when it lifted in the morning, they set out. Whether by day or by night, whenever the cloud lifted, they set out.
chapters.zh: 有时从晚上到早晨，有这云彩在帐幕上。早晨云彩收上去，他们就起行。有时昼夜云彩停在帐幕上，收上去的时候，他们就起行。

chapters.en: Whether the cloud stayed over the tabernacle for two days or a month or a year, the Israelites would remain in camp and not set out; but when it lifted, they would set out.
chapters.zh: 云彩停留在帐幕上，无论是两天，是一月，是一年，以色列人就住营不起行。但云彩收上去，他们就起行。

chapters.en: At the LORD’s command they encamped, and at the LORD’s command they set out. They obeyed the LORD’s order, in accordance with his command through Moses.
chapters.zh: 他们遵耶和华的吩咐安营，也遵耶和华的吩咐起行。他们守耶和华所吩咐的，都是凭耶和华吩咐摩西的。

chapters.en: The LORD said to Moses:
chapters.zh: 耶和华晓谕摩西说，

chapters.en: “Make two trumpets of hammered silver, and use them for calling the community together and for having the camps set out.
chapters.zh: 你要用银子作两枝号，都要锤出来的，用以招聚会众，并叫众营起行。

chapters.en: When both are sounded, the whole community is to assemble before you at the entrance to the tent of meeting.
chapters.zh: 吹这号的时候，全会众要到你那里，聚集在会幕门口。

chapters.en: If only one is sounded, the leaders—the heads of the clans of Israel—are to assemble before you.
chapters.zh: 若单吹一枝，众首领，就是以色列军中的统领，要聚集到你那里。

chapters.en: When a trumpet blast is sounded, the tribes camping on the east are to set out.
chapters.zh: 吹出大声的时候，东边安的营都要起行。

chapters.en: At the sounding of a second blast, the camps on the south are to set out. The blast will be the signal for setting out.
chapters.zh: 二次吹出大声的时候，南边安的营都要起行。他们将起行，必吹出大声。

chapters.en: To gather the assembly, blow the trumpets, but not with the signal for setting out.
chapters.zh: 但招聚会众的时候，你们要吹号，却不要吹出大声。

chapters.en: “The sons of Aaron, the priests, are to blow the trumpets. This is to be a lasting ordinance for you and the generations to come.
chapters.zh: 亚伦子孙作祭司的要吹这号。这要作你们世世代代永远的定例。

chapters.en: When you go into battle in your own land against an enemy who is oppressing you, sound a blast on the trumpets. Then you will be remembered by the LORD your God and rescued from your enemies.
chapters.zh: 你们在自己的地，与欺压你们的敌人打仗，就要用号吹出大声，便在耶和华你们的神面前得蒙纪念，也蒙拯救脱离仇敌。

chapters.en: Also at your times of rejoicing—your appointed festivals and New Moon feasts—you are to sound the trumpets over your burnt offerings and fellowship offerings, and they will be a memorial for you before your God. I am the LORD your God.”
chapters.zh: 在你们快乐的日子和节期，并月朔，献燔祭和平安祭，也要吹号，这都要在你们的神面前作为纪念。我是耶和华你们的神。

chapters.en: On the twentieth day of the second month of the second year, the cloud lifted from above the tabernacle of the covenant law.
chapters.zh: 第二年二月二十日，云彩从法柜的帐幕收上去。

chapters.en: Then the Israelites set out from the Desert of Sinai and traveled from place to place until the cloud came to rest in the Desert of Paran.
chapters.zh: 以色列人就按站往前行，离开西乃的旷野，云彩停住在巴兰的旷野。

chapters.en: They set out, this first time, at the LORD’s command through Moses.
chapters.zh: 这是他们照耶和华借摩西所吩咐的，初次往前行。

chapters.en: The divisions of the camp of Judah went first, under their standard. Nahshon son of Amminadab was in command.
chapters.zh: 按着军队首先往前行的是犹大营的纛。统领军队的是亚米拿达的儿子拿顺。

chapters.en: Nethanel son of Zuar was over the division of the tribe of Issachar,
chapters.zh: 统领以萨迦支派军队的是苏押的儿子拿坦业。

chapters.en: and Eliab son of Helon was over the division of the tribe of Zebulun.
chapters.zh: 统领西布伦支派军队的是希伦的儿子以利押。

chapters.en: Then the tabernacle was taken down, and the Gershonites and Merarites, who carried it, set out.
chapters.zh: 帐幕拆卸，革顺的子孙和米拉利的子孙就抬着帐幕先往前行。

chapters.en: The divisions of the camp of Reuben went next, under their standard. Elizur son of Shedeur was in command.
chapters.zh: 按着军队往前行的是流便营的纛。统领军队的是示丢珥的儿子以利蓿。

chapters.en: Shelumiel son of Zurishaddai was over the division of the tribe of Simeon,
chapters.zh: 统领西缅支派军队的是苏利沙代的儿子示路蔑。

chapters.en: and Eliasaph son of Deuel was over the division of the tribe of Gad.
chapters.zh: 统领迦得支派军队的是丢珥的儿子以利雅萨。

chapters.en: Then the Kohathites set out, carrying the holy things. The tabernacle was to be set up before they arrived.
chapters.zh: 哥辖人抬着圣物先往前行。他们未到以前，抬帐幕的已经把帐幕支好。

chapters.en: The divisions of the camp of Ephraim went next, under their standard. Elishama son of Ammihud was in command.
chapters.zh: 按着军队往前行的是以法莲营的纛，统领军队的是亚米忽的儿子以利沙玛。

chapters.en: Gamaliel son of Pedahzur was over the division of the tribe of Manasseh,
chapters.zh: 统领玛拿西支派军队的是比大蓿的儿子迦玛列。

chapters.en: and Abidan son of Gideoni was over the division of the tribe of Benjamin.
chapters.zh: 统领便雅悯支派军队的是基多尼的儿子亚比但。

chapters.en: Finally, as the rear guard for all the units, the divisions of the camp of Dan set out under their standard. Ahiezer son of Ammishaddai was in command.
chapters.zh: 在诸营末后的是但营的纛，按着军队往前行。统领军队的是亚米沙代的儿子亚希以谢。

chapters.en: Pagiel son of Okran was over the division of the tribe of Asher,
chapters.zh: 统领亚设支派军队的是俄兰的儿子帕结。

chapters.en: and Ahira son of Enan was over the division of the tribe of Naphtali.
chapters.zh: 统领拿弗他利支派军队的是以南的儿子亚希拉。

chapters.en: This was the order of march for the Israelite divisions as they set out.
chapters.zh: 以色列人按着军队往前行，就是这样。

chapters.en: Now Moses said to Hobab son of Reuel the Midianite, Moses’ father-in-law, “We are setting out for the place about which the LORD said, ‘I will give it to you.’ Come with us and we will treat you well, for the LORD has promised good things to Israel.”
chapters.zh: 摩西对他岳父（或作内兄）米甸人流珥的儿子何巴说，我们要行路，往耶和华所应许之地去。他曾说，我要将这地赐给你们。现在求你和我们同去，我们必厚待你，因为耶和华指着以色列人已经应许给好处。

chapters.en: He answered, “No, I will not go; I am going back to my own land and my own people.”
chapters.zh: 何巴回答说，我不去。我要回本地本族那里去。

chapters.en: But Moses said, “Please do not leave us. You know where we should camp in the wilderness, and you can be our eyes.
chapters.zh: 摩西说，求你不要离开我们。因为你知道我们要在旷野安营，你可以当作我们的眼目。

chapters.en: If you come with us, we will share with you whatever good things the LORD gives us.”
chapters.zh: 你若和我们同去，将来耶和华有什么好处待我们，我们也必以什么好处待你。

chapters.en: So they set out from the mountain of the LORD and traveled for three days. The ark of the covenant of the LORD went before them during those three days to find them a place to rest.
chapters.zh: 以色列人离开耶和华的山，往前行了三天的路程。耶和华的约柜在前头行了三天的路程，为他们寻找安歇的地方。

chapters.en: The cloud of the LORD was over them by day when they set out from the camp.
chapters.zh: 他们拔营往前行，日间有耶和华的云彩在他们以上。

chapters.en: Whenever the ark set out, Moses said, “Rise up, LORD! May your enemies be scattered; may your foes flee before you.”
chapters.zh: 约柜往前行的时候，摩西就说，耶和华阿，求你兴起。愿你的仇敌四散。愿恨你的人从你面前逃跑。

chapters.en: Whenever it came to rest, he said, “Return, LORD, to the countless thousands of Israel.”
chapters.zh: 约柜停住的时候，他就说，耶和华阿，求你回到以色列的千万人中。

chapters.en: Now the people complained about their hardships in the hearing of the LORD, and when he heard them his anger was aroused. Then fire from the LORD burned among them and consumed some of the outskirts of the camp.
chapters.zh: 众百姓发怨言，他们的恶语达到耶和华的耳中。耶和华听见了就怒气发作，使火在他们中间焚烧，直烧到营的边界。

chapters.en: When the people cried out to Moses, he prayed to the LORD and the fire died down.
chapters.zh: 百姓向摩西哀求，摩西祈求耶和华，火就熄了。

chapters.en: So that place was called Taberah, because fire from the LORD had burned among them.
chapters.zh: 那地方便叫作他备拉，因为耶和华的火烧在他们中间。

chapters.en: The rabble with them began to crave other food, and again the Israelites started wailing and said, “If only we had meat to eat!
chapters.zh: 他们中间的闲杂人大起贪欲的心。以色列人又哭号说，谁给我们肉吃呢？

chapters.en: We remember the fish we ate in Egypt at no cost—also the cucumbers, melons, leeks, onions and garlic.
chapters.zh: 我们记得，在埃及的时候不花钱就吃鱼，也记得有黄瓜，西瓜，韭菜，葱，蒜。

chapters.en: But now we have lost our appetite; we never see anything but this manna!”
chapters.zh: 现在我们的心血枯竭了，除这吗哪以外，在我们眼前并没有别的东西。

chapters.en: The manna was like coriander seed and looked like resin.
chapters.zh: 这吗哪仿佛芫荽子，又好像珍珠。

chapters.en: The people went around gathering it, and then ground it in a hand mill or crushed it in a mortar. They cooked it in a pot or made it into loaves. And it tasted like something made with olive oil.
chapters.zh: 百姓周围行走，把吗哪收起来，或用磨推，或用臼捣，煮在锅中，又作成饼，滋味好像新油。

chapters.en: When the dew settled on the camp at night, the manna also came down.
chapters.zh: 夜间露水降在营中，吗哪也随着降下。

chapters.en: Moses heard the people of every family wailing at the entrance to their tents. The LORD became exceedingly angry, and Moses was troubled.
chapters.zh: 摩西听见百姓各在各家的帐棚门口哭号。耶和华的怒气便大发作，摩西就不喜悦。

chapters.en: He asked the LORD, “Why have you brought this trouble on your servant? What have I done to displease you that you put the burden of all these people on me?
chapters.zh: 摩西对耶和华说，你为何苦待仆人，我为何不在你眼前蒙恩，竟把这管理百姓的重任加在我身上呢？

chapters.en: Did I conceive all these people? Did I give them birth? Why do you tell me to carry them in my arms, as a nurse carries an infant, to the land you promised on oath to their ancestors?
chapters.zh: 这百姓岂是我怀的胎，岂是我生下来的呢？你竟对我说，把他们抱在怀里，如养育之父抱吃奶的孩子，直抱到你起誓应许给他们祖宗的地去。

chapters.en: Where can I get meat for all these people? They keep wailing to me, ‘Give us meat to eat!’
chapters.zh: 我从哪里得肉给这百姓吃呢？他们都向我哭号说，你给我们肉吃吧。

chapters.en: I cannot carry all these people by myself; the burden is too heavy for me.
chapters.zh: 管理这百姓的责任太重了，我独自担当不起。

chapters.en: If this is how you are going to treat me, please go ahead and kill me—if I have found favor in your eyes—and do not let me face my own ruin.”
chapters.zh: 你这样待我，我若在你眼前蒙恩，求你立时将我杀了，不叫我见自己的苦情。

chapters.en: The LORD said to Moses: “Bring me seventy of Israel’s elders who are known to you as leaders and officials among the people. Have them come to the tent of meeting, that they may stand there with you.
chapters.zh: 耶和华对摩西说，你从以色列的长老中招聚七十个人，就是你所知道作百姓的长老和官长的，到我这里来，领他们到会幕前，使他们和你一同站立。

chapters.en: I will come down and speak with you there, and I will take some of the power of the Spirit that is on you and put it on them. They will share the burden of the people with you so that you will not have to carry it alone.
chapters.zh: 我要在那里降临，与你说话，也要把降于你身上的灵分赐他们，他们就和你同当这管百姓的重任，免得你独自担当。

chapters.en: “Tell the people: ‘Consecrate yourselves in preparation for tomorrow, when you will eat meat. The LORD heard you when you wailed, “If only we had meat to eat! We were better off in Egypt!” Now the LORD will give you meat, and you will eat it.
chapters.zh: 又要对百姓说，你们应当自洁，预备明天吃肉，因为你们哭号说，谁给我们肉吃。我们在埃及很好。这声音达到了耶和华的耳中，所以他必给你们肉吃。

chapters.en: You will not eat it for just one day, or two days, or five, ten or twenty days,
chapters.zh: 你们不止吃一天，两天，五天，十天，二十天，

chapters.en: but for a whole month—until it comes out of your nostrils and you loathe it—because you have rejected the LORD, who is among you, and have wailed before him, saying, “Why did we ever leave Egypt?” ’ ”
chapters.zh: 要吃一个整月，甚至肉从你们鼻孔里喷出来，使你们厌恶了，因为你们厌弃住在你们中间的耶和华，在他面前哭号说，我们为何出了埃及呢？

chapters.en: But Moses said, “Here I am among six hundred thousand men on foot, and you say, ‘I will give them meat to eat for a whole month!’
chapters.zh: 摩西对耶和华说，这与我同住的百姓，步行的男人有六十万，你还说，我要把肉给他们，使他们可以吃一个整月。

chapters.en: Would they have enough if flocks and herds were slaughtered for them? Would they have enough if all the fish in the sea were caught for them?”
chapters.zh: 难道给他们宰了羊群牛群，或是把海中所有的鱼都聚了来，就够他们吃吗？

chapters.en: The LORD answered Moses, “Is the LORD’s arm too short? Now you will see whether or not what I say will come true for you.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华对摩西说，耶和华的膀臂岂是缩短了吗？现在要看我的话向你应验不应验。

chapters.en: So Moses went out and told the people what the LORD had said. He brought together seventy of their elders and had them stand around the tent.
chapters.zh: 摩西出去，将耶和华的话告诉百姓，又招聚百姓的长老中七十个人来，使他们站在会幕的四围。

chapters.en: Then the LORD came down in the cloud and spoke with him, and he took some of the power of the Spirit that was on him and put it on the seventy elders. When the Spirit rested on them, they prophesied—but did not do so again.
chapters.zh: 耶和华在云中降临，对摩西说话，把降与他身上的灵分赐那七十个长老。灵停在他们身上的时候，他们就受感说话，以后却没有再说。

chapters.en: However, two men, whose names were Eldad and Medad, had remained in the camp. They were listed among the elders, but did not go out to the tent. Yet the Spirit also rested on them, and they prophesied in the camp.
chapters.zh: 但有两个人仍在营里，一个名叫伊利达，一个名叫米达。他们本是在那些被录的人中，却没有到会幕那里去。灵停在他们身上，他们就在营里说预言。

chapters.en: A young man ran and told Moses, “Eldad and Medad are prophesying in the camp.”
chapters.zh: 有个少年人跑来告诉摩西说，伊利达，米达在营里说预言。

chapters.en: Joshua son of Nun, who had been Moses’ aide since youth, spoke up and said, “Moses, my lord, stop them!”
chapters.zh: 摩西的帮手，嫩的儿子约书亚，就是摩西所拣选的一个人，说，请我主摩西禁止他们。

chapters.en: But Moses replied, “Are you jealous for my sake? I wish that all the LORD’s people were prophets and that the LORD would put his Spirit on them!”
chapters.zh: 摩西对他说，你为我的缘故嫉妒人吗？惟愿耶和华的百姓都受感说话。愿耶和华把他的灵降在他们身上。

chapters.en: Then Moses and the elders of Israel returned to the camp.
chapters.zh: 于是，摩西和以色列的长老都回到营里去。

chapters.en: Now a wind went out from the LORD and drove quail in from the sea. It scattered them up to two cubits deep all around the camp, as far as a day’s walk in any direction.
chapters.zh: 有风从耶和华那里刮起，把鹌鹑由海面刮来，飞散在营边和营的四围。这边约有一天的路程，那边约有一天的路程，离地面约有二肘。

chapters.en: All that day and night and all the next day the people went out and gathered quail. No one gathered less than ten homers. Then they spread them out all around the camp.
chapters.zh: 百姓起来，终日终夜，并次日一整天，捕取鹌鹑。至少的也取了十贺梅珥，为自己摆列在营的四围。

chapters.en: But while the meat was still between their teeth and before it could be consumed, the anger of the LORD burned against the people, and he struck them with a severe plague.
chapters.zh: 肉在他们牙齿之间尚未嚼烂，耶和华的怒气就向他们发作，用最重的灾殃击杀了他们。

chapters.en: Therefore the place was named Kibroth Hattaavah, because there they buried the people who had craved other food.
chapters.zh: 那地方便叫作基博罗哈他瓦（就是贪欲之人的坟墓），因为他们在那里葬埋那起贪欲之心的人。

chapters.en: From Kibroth Hattaavah the people traveled to Hazeroth and stayed there.
chapters.zh: 百姓从基博罗哈他瓦走到哈洗录，就住在哈洗录。

chapters.en: Miriam and Aaron began to talk against Moses because of his Cushite wife, for he had married a Cushite.
chapters.zh: 摩西娶了古实女子为妻。米利暗和亚伦因他所娶的古实女子就毁谤他，

chapters.en: “Has the LORD spoken only through Moses?” they asked. “Hasn’t he also spoken through us?” And the LORD heard this.
chapters.zh: 说，难道耶和华单与摩西说话，不也与我们说话吗？这话耶和华听见了。

chapters.en: (Now Moses was a very humble man, more humble than anyone else on the face of the earth.)
chapters.zh: 摩西为人极其谦和，胜过世上的众人。

chapters.en: At once the LORD said to Moses, Aaron and Miriam, “Come out to the tent of meeting, all three of you.” So the three of them went out.
chapters.zh: 耶和华忽然对摩西，亚伦，米利暗说，你们三个人都出来，到会幕这里。他们三个人就出来了。

chapters.en: Then the LORD came down in a pillar of cloud; he stood at the entrance to the tent and summoned Aaron and Miriam. When the two of them stepped forward,
chapters.zh: 耶和华在云柱中降临，站在会幕门口，召亚伦和米利暗，二人就出来了。

chapters.en: he said, “Listen to my words: “When there is a prophet among you, I, the LORD, reveal myself to them in visions, I speak to them in dreams.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说，你们且听我的话，你们中间若有先知，我耶和华必在异象中向他显现，在梦中与他说话。

chapters.en: But this is not true of my servant Moses; he is faithful in all my house.
chapters.zh: 我的仆人摩西不是这样。他是在我全家尽忠的。

chapters.en: With him I speak face to face, clearly and not in riddles; he sees the form of the LORD. Why then were you not afraid to speak against my servant Moses?”
chapters.zh: 我要与他面对面说话，乃是明说，不用谜语，并且他必见我的形像。你们毁谤我的仆人摩西，为何不惧怕呢？

chapters.en: The anger of the LORD burned against them, and he left them.
chapters.zh: 耶和华就向他们二人发怒而去。

chapters.en: When the cloud lifted from above the tent, Miriam’s skin was leprous —it became as white as snow. Aaron turned toward her and saw that she had a defiling skin disease,
chapters.zh: 云彩从会幕上挪开了，不料，米利暗长了大麻疯，有雪那样白。亚伦一看米利暗长了大麻疯，

chapters.en: and he said to Moses, “Please, my lord, I ask you not to hold against us the sin we have so foolishly committed.
chapters.zh: 就对摩西说，我主阿，求你不要因我们愚昧犯罪，便将这罪加在我们身上。

chapters.en: Do not let her be like a stillborn infant coming from its mother’s womb with its flesh half eaten away.”
chapters.zh: 求你不要使她像那出母腹，肉已半烂的死胎。

chapters.en: So Moses cried out to the LORD, “Please, God, heal her!”
chapters.zh: 于是摩西哀求耶和华说，神阿，求你医治她。

chapters.en: The LORD replied to Moses, “If her father had spit in her face, would she not have been in disgrace for seven days? Confine her outside the camp for seven days; after that she can be brought back.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华对摩西说，她父亲若吐唾沫在她脸上，她岂不蒙羞七天吗？现在要把她在营外关锁七天，然后才可以领她进来。

chapters.en: So Miriam was confined outside the camp for seven days, and the people did not move on till she was brought back.
chapters.zh: 于是米利暗关锁在营外七天。百姓没有行路，直等到把米利暗领进来。

chapters.en: After that, the people left Hazeroth and encamped in the Desert of Paran.
chapters.zh: 以后百姓从哈洗录起行，在巴兰的旷野安营。

chapters.en: The LORD said to Moses,
chapters.zh: 耶和华晓谕摩西说，

chapters.en: “Send some men to explore the land of Canaan, which I am giving to the Israelites. From each ancestral tribe send one of its leaders.”
chapters.zh: 你打发人去窥探我所赐给以色列人的迦南地，他们每支派中要打发一个人，都要作首领的。

chapters.en: So at the LORD’s command Moses sent them out from the Desert of Paran. All of them were leaders of the Israelites.
chapters.zh: 摩西就照耶和华的吩咐从巴兰的旷野打发他们去。他们都是以色列人的族长。

chapters.en: These are their names: from the tribe of Reuben, Shammua son of Zakkur;
chapters.zh: 他们的名字，属流便支派的有撒刻的的儿子沙母亚。

chapters.en: from the tribe of Simeon, Shaphat son of Hori;
chapters.zh: 属西缅支派的有何利的儿子的沙法。

chapters.en: from the tribe of Judah, Caleb son of Jephunneh;
chapters.zh: 属犹大支派的有耶孚尼的儿子迦勒。

chapters.en: from the tribe of Issachar, Igal son of Joseph;
chapters.zh: 属以萨迦支派的有约色的儿子以迦。

chapters.en: from the tribe of Ephraim, Hoshea son of Nun;
chapters.zh: 属以法莲支派的有嫩的儿子何希阿。

chapters.en: from the tribe of Benjamin, Palti son of Raphu;
chapters.zh: 属便雅悯支派的有拉孚的儿子帕提。

chapters.en: from the tribe of Zebulun, Gaddiel son of Sodi;
chapters.zh: 属西布伦支派的有梭底的儿子迦叠。

chapters.en: from the tribe of Manasseh (a tribe of Joseph), Gaddi son of Susi;
chapters.zh: 约瑟的子孙，属玛拿西支派的有稣西的儿子迦底。

chapters.en: from the tribe of Dan, Ammiel son of Gemalli;
chapters.zh: 属但支派的有基玛利的儿子亚米利。

chapters.en: from the tribe of Asher, Sethur son of Michael;
chapters.zh: 属亚设支派的有米迦勒的儿子西帖。

chapters.en: from the tribe of Naphtali, Nahbi son of Vophsi;
chapters.zh: 属拿弗他利支派的有缚西的儿子拿比。

chapters.en: from the tribe of Gad, Geuel son of Maki.
chapters.zh: 属迦得支派的有玛基的儿子臼利。

chapters.en: These are the names of the men Moses sent to explore the land. (Moses gave Hoshea son of Nun the name Joshua.)
chapters.zh: 这就是摩西所打发，窥探那地之人的名字。摩西就称嫩的儿子何西阿为约书亚。

chapters.en: When Moses sent them to explore Canaan, he said, “Go up through the Negev and on into the hill country.
chapters.zh: 摩西打发他们去窥探迦南地，说，你们从南地上山地去，

chapters.en: See what the land is like and whether the people who live there are strong or weak, few or many.
chapters.zh: 看那地如何，其中所住的民是强是弱，是多是少，

chapters.en: What kind of land do they live in? Is it good or bad? What kind of towns do they live in? Are they unwalled or fortified?
chapters.zh: 所住之地是好是歹，所住之处是营盘是坚城。

chapters.en: How is the soil? Is it fertile or poor? Are there trees in it or not? Do your best to bring back some of the fruit of the land.” (It was the season for the first ripe grapes.)
chapters.zh: 又看那地土是肥美是瘠薄，其中有树木没有。你们要放开胆量，把那地的果子带些来。（那时正是葡萄初熟的时候。）

chapters.en: So they went up and explored the land from the Desert of Zin as far as Rehob, toward Lebo Hamath.
chapters.zh: 他们上去窥探那地，从寻的旷野到利合，直到哈马口。

chapters.en: They went up through the Negev and came to Hebron, where Ahiman, Sheshai and Talmai, the descendants of Anak, lived. (Hebron had been built seven years before Zoan in Egypt.)
chapters.zh: 他们从南地上去，到了希伯仑。在那里有亚衲族人亚希幔，示筛，挞买。（原来希伯仑城被建造比埃及的锁安城早七年。）

chapters.en: When they reached the Valley of Eshkol, they cut off a branch bearing a single cluster of grapes. Two of them carried it on a pole between them, along with some pomegranates and figs.
chapters.zh: 他们到了以实各谷，从那里砍了葡萄树的一枝，上头有一挂葡萄，两个人用杠抬着，又带了些石榴和无花果来。

chapters.en: That place was called the Valley of Eshkol because of the cluster of grapes the Israelites cut off there.
chapters.zh: （因为以色列人从那里砍来的那挂葡萄，所以那地方叫作以实各谷。）

chapters.en: At the end of forty days they returned from exploring the land.
chapters.zh: 过了四十天，他们窥探那地才回来，

chapters.en: They came back to Moses and Aaron and the whole Israelite community at Kadesh in the Desert of Paran. There they reported to them and to the whole assembly and showed them the fruit of the land.
chapters.zh: 到了巴兰旷野的加低斯，见摩西，亚伦，并以色列的全会众，回报摩西，亚伦，并全会众，又把那地的果子给他们看。

chapters.en: They gave Moses this account: “We went into the land to which you sent us, and it does flow with milk and honey! Here is its fruit.
chapters.zh: 又告诉摩西说，我们到了你所打发我们去的那地，果然是流奶与蜜之地。这就是那地的果子。

chapters.en: But the people who live there are powerful, and the cities are fortified and very large. We even saw descendants of Anak there.
chapters.zh: 然而住那地的民强壮，城邑也坚固宽大，并且我们在那里看见了亚衲族的人。

chapters.en: The Amalekites live in the Negev; the Hittites, Jebusites and Amorites live in the hill country; and the Canaanites live near the sea and along the Jordan.”
chapters.zh: 亚玛力人住在南地。赫人，耶布斯人，亚摩利人住在山地。迦南人住在海边并约旦河旁。

chapters.en: Then Caleb silenced the people before Moses and said, “We should go up and take possession of the land, for we can certainly do it.”
chapters.zh: 迦勒在摩西面前安抚百姓，说，我们立刻上去得那地吧。我们足能得胜。

chapters.en: But the men who had gone up with him said, “We can’t attack those people; they are stronger than we are.”
chapters.zh: 但那些和他同去的人说，我们不能上去攻击那民，因为他们比我们强壮。

chapters.en: And they spread among the Israelites a bad report about the land they had explored. They said, “The land we explored devours those living in it. All the people we saw there are of great size.
chapters.zh: 探子中有人论到所窥探之地，向以色列人报恶信，说，我们所窥探，经过之地是吞吃居民之地，我们在那里所看见的人民都身量高大。

chapters.en: We saw the Nephilim there (the descendants of Anak come from the Nephilim). We seemed like grasshoppers in our own eyes, and we looked the same to them.”
chapters.zh: 我们在那里看见亚衲族人，就是伟人。他们是伟人的后裔。据我们看，自己就如蚱蜢一样。据他们看，我们也是如此。

chapters.en: That night all the members of the community raised their voices and wept aloud.
chapters.zh: 当下，全会众大声喧嚷。那夜百姓都哭号。

chapters.en: All the Israelites grumbled against Moses and Aaron, and the whole assembly said to them, “If only we had died in Egypt! Or in this wilderness!
chapters.zh: 以色列众人向摩西，亚伦发怨言。全会众对他们说，巴不得我们早死在埃及地，或是死在这旷野。

chapters.en: Why is the LORD bringing us to this land only to let us fall by the sword? Our wives and children will be taken as plunder. Wouldn’t it be better for us to go back to Egypt?”
chapters.zh: 耶和华为什么把我们领到那地，使我们倒在刀下呢？我们的妻子和孩子必被掳掠。我们回埃及去岂不好吗？

chapters.en: And they said to each other, “We should choose a leader and go back to Egypt.”
chapters.zh: 众人彼此说，我们不如立一个首领回埃及去吧。

chapters.en: Then Moses and Aaron fell facedown in front of the whole Israelite assembly gathered there.
chapters.zh: 摩西，亚伦就俯伏在以色列全会众面前。

chapters.en: Joshua son of Nun and Caleb son of Jephunneh, who were among those who had explored the land, tore their clothes
chapters.zh: 窥探地的人中，嫩的儿子约书亚和耶孚尼的儿子迦勒撕裂衣服，

chapters.en: and said to the entire Israelite assembly, “The land we passed through and explored is exceedingly good.
chapters.zh: 对以色列全会众说，我们所窥探，经过之地是极美之地。

chapters.en: If the LORD is pleased with us, he will lead us into that land, a land flowing with milk and honey, and will give it to us.
chapters.zh: 耶和华若喜悦我们，就必将我们领进那地，把地赐给我们。那地原是流奶与蜜之地。

chapters.en: Only do not rebel against the LORD. And do not be afraid of the people of the land, because we will devour them. Their protection is gone, but the LORD is with us. Do not be afraid of them.”
chapters.zh: 但你们不可背叛耶和华，也不要怕那地的居民。因为他们是我们的食物，并且荫庇他们的已经离开他们。有耶和华与我们同在，不要怕他们。

chapters.en: But the whole assembly talked about stoning them. Then the glory of the LORD appeared at the tent of meeting to all the Israelites.
chapters.zh: 但全会众说，拿石头打死他们二人。忽然，耶和华的荣光在会幕中向以色列众人显现。

chapters.en: The LORD said to Moses, “How long will these people treat me with contempt? How long will they refuse to believe in me, in spite of all the signs I have performed among them?
chapters.zh: 耶和华对摩西说，这百姓藐视我要到几时呢？我在他们中间行了这一切神迹，他们还不信我要到几时呢？

chapters.en: I will strike them down with a plague and destroy them, but I will make you into a nation greater and stronger than they.”
chapters.zh: 我要用瘟疫击杀他们，使他们不得承受那地，叫你的后裔成为大国，比他们强胜。

chapters.en: Moses said to the LORD, “Then the Egyptians will hear about it! By your power you brought these people up from among them.
chapters.zh: 摩西对耶和华说，埃及人必听见这事。因为你曾施展大能，将这百姓从他们中间领上来。

chapters.en: And they will tell the inhabitants of this land about it. They have already heard that you, LORD, are with these people and that you, LORD, have been seen face to face, that your cloud stays over them, and that you go before them in a pillar of cloud by day and a pillar of fire by night.
chapters.zh: 埃及人要将这事传给迦南地的居民。那民已经听见你耶和华是在这百姓中间。因为你面对面被人看见，有你的云彩停在他们以上。你日间在云柱中，夜间在火柱中，在他们前面行。

chapters.en: If you put all these people to death, leaving none alive, the nations who have heard this report about you will say,
chapters.zh: 如今你若把这百姓杀了，如杀一人，那些听见你名声的列邦必议论说，

chapters.en: ‘The LORD was not able to bring these people into the land he promised them on oath, so he slaughtered them in the wilderness.’
chapters.zh: 耶和华因为不能把这百姓领进他向他们起誓应许之地，所以在旷野把他们杀了。

chapters.en: “Now may the Lord’s strength be displayed, just as you have declared:
chapters.zh: 现在求主大显能力，照你所说过的话说，

chapters.en: ‘The LORD is slow to anger, abounding in love and forgiving sin and rebellion. Yet he does not leave the guilty unpunished; he punishes the children for the sin of the parents to the third and fourth generation.’
chapters.zh: 耶和华不轻易发怒，并有丰盛的慈爱，赦免罪孽和过犯。万不以有罪的为无罪，必追讨他的罪，自父及子，直到三，四代。

chapters.en: In accordance with your great love, forgive the sin of these people, just as you have pardoned them from the time they left Egypt until now.”
chapters.zh: 求你照你的大慈爱赦免这百姓的罪孽，好象你从埃及到如今常赦免他们一样。

chapters.en: The LORD replied, “I have forgiven them, as you asked.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说，我照着你的话赦免了他们。

chapters.en: Nevertheless, as surely as I live and as surely as the glory of the LORD fills the whole earth,
chapters.zh: 然我指着我的永生起誓，遍地要被我的荣耀充满。

chapters.en: not one of those who saw my glory and the signs I performed in Egypt and in the wilderness but who disobeyed me and tested me ten times—
chapters.zh: 这些人虽看见我的荣耀和我在埃及与旷野所行的神迹，仍然试探我这十次，不听从我的话，

chapters.en: not one of them will ever see the land I promised on oath to their ancestors. No one who has treated me with contempt will ever see it.
chapters.zh: 他们断不得看见我向他们的祖宗所起誓应许之地。凡藐视我的，一个也不得看见。

chapters.en: But because my servant Caleb has a different spirit and follows me wholeheartedly, I will bring him into the land he went to, and his descendants will inherit it.
chapters.zh: 惟独我的仆人迦勒，因他另有一个心志，专一跟从我，我就把他领进他所去过的那地。他的后裔也必得那地为业。

chapters.en: Since the Amalekites and the Canaanites are living in the valleys, turn back tomorrow and set out toward the desert along the route to the Red Sea. ”
chapters.zh: 亚玛力人和迦南人住在谷中，明天你们要转回，从红海的路往旷野去。

chapters.en: The LORD said to Moses and Aaron:
chapters.zh: 耶和华对摩西，亚伦说，

chapters.en: “How long will this wicked community grumble against me? I have heard the complaints of these grumbling Israelites.
chapters.zh: 这恶会众向我发怨言，我忍耐他们要到几时呢？以色列人向我所发的怨言，我都听见了。

chapters.en: So tell them, ‘As surely as I live, declares the LORD, I will do to you the very thing I heard you say:
chapters.zh: 你们告诉他们，耶和华说，我指着我的永生起誓，我必要照你们达到我耳中的话待你们。

chapters.en: In this wilderness your bodies will fall—every one of you twenty years old or more who was counted in the census and who has grumbled against me.
chapters.zh: 你们的尸首必倒在这旷野，并且你们中间凡被数点，从二十岁以外，向我发怨言的，

chapters.en: Not one of you will enter the land I swore with uplifted hand to make your home, except Caleb son of Jephunneh and Joshua son of Nun.
chapters.zh: 必不得进我起誓应许叫你们住的那地。惟有耶孚尼的儿子迦勒和嫩的儿子约书亚才能进去。

chapters.en: As for your children that you said would be taken as plunder, I will bring them in to enjoy the land you have rejected.
chapters.zh: 但你们的妇人孩子，就是你们所说，要被掳掠的，我必把他们领进去，他们就得知你们所厌弃的那地。

chapters.en: But as for you, your bodies will fall in this wilderness.
chapters.zh: 至于你们，你们的尸首必倒在这旷野。

chapters.en: Your children will be shepherds here for forty years, suffering for your unfaithfulness, until the last of your bodies lies in the wilderness.
chapters.zh: 你们的儿女必在旷野飘流四十年，担当你们淫行的罪，直到你们的尸首在旷野消灭。

chapters.en: For forty years—one year for each of the forty days you explored the land—you will suffer for your sins and know what it is like to have me against you.’
chapters.zh: 按你们窥探那地的四十日，一年顶一日，你们要担当罪孽四十年，就知道我与你们疏远了，

chapters.en: I, the LORD, have spoken, and I will surely do these things to this whole wicked community, which has banded together against me. They will meet their end in this wilderness; here they will die.”
chapters.zh: 我耶和华说过，我总要这样待这一切聚集敌我的恶会众。他们必在这旷野消灭，在这里死亡。

chapters.en: So the men Moses had sent to explore the land, who returned and made the whole community grumble against him by spreading a bad report about it—
chapters.zh: 摩西所打发，窥探那地的人回来，报那地的恶信，叫全会众向摩西发怨言，

chapters.en: these men who were responsible for spreading the bad report about the land were struck down and died of a plague before the LORD.
chapters.zh: 这些报恶信的人都遭瘟疫，死在耶和华面前。

chapters.en: Of the men who went to explore the land, only Joshua son of Nun and Caleb son of Jephunneh survived.
chapters.zh: 其中惟有嫩的儿子约书亚和耶孚尼的儿子迦勒仍然存活。

chapters.en: When Moses reported this to all the Israelites, they mourned bitterly.
chapters.zh: 摩西将这些话告诉以色列众人，他们就甚悲哀。

chapters.en: Early the next morning they set out for the highest point in the hill country, saying, “Now we are ready to go up to the land the LORD promised. Surely we have sinned!”
chapters.zh: 清早起来，上山顶去，说，我们在这里，我们有罪了。情愿上耶和华所应许的地方去。

chapters.en: But Moses said, “Why are you disobeying the LORD’s command? This will not succeed!
chapters.zh: 摩西说，你们为何违背耶和华的命令呢？这事不能顺利了。

chapters.en: Do not go up, because the LORD is not with you. You will be defeated by your enemies,
chapters.zh: 不要上去。因为耶和华不在你们中间，恐怕你们被仇敌杀败了。

chapters.en: for the Amalekites and the Canaanites will face you there. Because you have turned away from the LORD, he will not be with you and you will fall by the sword.”
chapters.zh: 亚玛力人和迦南人都在你们面前，你们必倒在刀下。因你们退回不跟从耶和华，所以他必不与你们同在。

chapters.en: Nevertheless, in their presumption they went up toward the highest point in the hill country, though neither Moses nor the ark of the LORD’s covenant moved from the camp.
chapters.zh: 他们却擅敢上山顶去，然而耶和华的约柜和摩西没有出营。

chapters.en: Then the Amalekites and the Canaanites who lived in that hill country came down and attacked them and beat them down all the way to Hormah.
chapters.zh: 于是亚玛力人和住在那山上的迦南人都下来击打他们，把他们杀退了，直到何珥玛。

chapters.en: The LORD said to Moses,
chapters.zh: 耶和华对摩西说，

chapters.en: “Speak to the Israelites and say to them: ‘After you enter the land I am giving you as a home
chapters.zh: 你晓谕以色列人说，你们到了我所赐给你们居住的地，

chapters.en: and you present to the LORD food offerings from the herd or the flock, as an aroma pleasing to the LORD—whether burnt offerings or sacrifices, for special vows or freewill offerings or festival offerings—
chapters.zh: 若愿意从牛群羊群中取牛羊作火祭，献给耶和华，无论是燔祭是平安祭，为要还特许的愿，或是作甘心祭，或是逢你们节期献的，都要奉给耶和华为馨香之祭。

chapters.en: then the person who brings an offering shall present to the LORD a grain offering of a tenth of an ephah of the finest flour mixed with a quarter of a hin of olive oil.
chapters.zh: 那献供物的就要将细面伊法十分之一，并油一欣四分之一，调和作素祭，献给耶和华。

chapters.en: With each lamb for the burnt offering or the sacrifice, prepare a quarter of a hin of wine as a drink offering.
chapters.zh: 无论是燔祭是平安祭，你要为每只绵羊羔，一同预备奠祭的酒一欣四分之一。

chapters.en: “ ‘With a ram prepare a grain offering of two-tenths of an ephah of the finest flour mixed with a third of a hin of olive oil,
chapters.zh: 为公绵羊预备细面伊法十分之二，并油一欣三分之一，调和作素祭，

chapters.en: and a third of a hin of wine as a drink offering. Offer it as an aroma pleasing to the LORD.
chapters.zh: 又用酒一欣三分之一作奠祭，献给耶和华为馨香之祭。

chapters.en: “ ‘When you prepare a young bull as a burnt offering or sacrifice, for a special vow or a fellowship offering to the LORD,
chapters.zh: 你预备公牛作燔祭，或是作平安祭，为要还特许的愿，或是作平安祭，献给耶和华，

chapters.en: bring with the bull a grain offering of three-tenths of an ephah of the finest flour mixed with half a hin of olive oil,
chapters.zh: 就要把细面伊法十分之三，并油半欣，调和作素祭，和公牛一同献上，

chapters.en: and also bring half a hin of wine as a drink offering. This will be a food offering, an aroma pleasing to the LORD.
chapters.zh: 又用酒半欣作奠祭，献给耶和华为馨香的火祭。

chapters.en: Each bull or ram, each lamb or young goat, is to be prepared in this manner.
chapters.zh: 献公牛，公绵羊，绵羊羔，山羊羔，每只都要这样办理。

chapters.en: Do this for each one, for as many as you prepare.
chapters.zh: 照你们所预备的数目，按着只数都要这样办理。

chapters.en: “ ‘Everyone who is native-born must do these things in this way when they present a food offering as an aroma pleasing to the LORD.
chapters.zh: 凡本地人将馨香的火祭献给耶和华，都要这样办理。

chapters.en: For the generations to come, whenever a foreigner or anyone else living among you presents a food offering as an aroma pleasing to the LORD, they must do exactly as you do.
chapters.zh: 若有外人和你们同居，或有人世世代代住在你们中间，愿意将馨香的火祭献给耶和华，你们怎样办理，他也要照样办理。

chapters.en: The community is to have the same rules for you and for the foreigner residing among you; this is a lasting ordinance for the generations to come. You and the foreigner shall be the same before the LORD:
chapters.zh: 至于会众，你们和同居的外人都归一例，作为你们世世代代永远的定例，在耶和华面前，你们怎样，寄居的也要怎样。

chapters.en: The same laws and regulations will apply both to you and to the foreigner residing among you.’ ”
chapters.zh: 你们并与你们同居的外人当有一样的条例，一样的典章。

chapters.en: The LORD said to Moses,
chapters.zh: 耶和华对摩西说，

chapters.en: “Speak to the Israelites and say to them: ‘When you enter the land to which I am taking you
chapters.zh: 你晓谕以色列人说，你们到了我所领你们进去的那地，

chapters.en: and you eat the food of the land, present a portion as an offering to the LORD.
chapters.zh: 吃那地的粮食，就要把举祭献给耶和华。

chapters.en: Present a loaf from the first of your ground meal and present it as an offering from the threshing floor.
chapters.zh: 你们要用初熟的麦子磨面，作饼当举祭奉献。你们举上，好像举禾场的举祭一样，

chapters.en: Throughout the generations to come you are to give this offering to the LORD from the first of your ground meal.
chapters.zh: 你们世世代代要用初熟的麦子磨面，当举祭献给耶和华。

chapters.en: “ ‘Now if you as a community unintentionally fail to keep any of these commands the LORD gave Moses—
chapters.zh: 你们有错误的时候，不守耶和华所晓谕摩西的这一切命令，

chapters.en: any of the LORD’s commands to you through him, from the day the LORD gave them and continuing through the generations to come—
chapters.zh: 就是耶和华借摩西一切所吩咐你们的，自那日以至你们的世世代代，

chapters.en: and if this is done unintentionally without the community being aware of it, then the whole community is to offer a young bull for a burnt offering as an aroma pleasing to the LORD, along with its prescribed grain offering and drink offering, and a male goat for a sin offering.
chapters.zh: 若有误行，是会众所不知道的，后来全会众就要将一只公牛犊作燔祭，并照典章把素祭和奠祭一同献给耶和华为馨香之祭，又献一只公山羊作赎罪祭。

chapters.en: The priest is to make atonement for the whole Israelite community, and they will be forgiven, for it was not intentional and they have presented to the LORD for their wrong a food offering and a sin offering.
chapters.zh: 祭司要为以色列全会众赎罪，他们就必蒙赦免，因为这是错误。他们又因自己的错误，把供物，就是向耶和华献的火祭和赎罪祭，一并奉到耶和华面前。

chapters.en: The whole Israelite community and the foreigners residing among them will be forgiven, because all the people were involved in the unintentional wrong.
chapters.zh: 以色列全会众和寄居在他们中间的外人就必蒙赦免，因为这罪是百姓误犯的。

chapters.en: “ ‘But if just one person sins unintentionally, that person must bring a year-old female goat for a sin offering.
chapters.zh: 若有一个人误犯了罪，他就要献一岁的母山羊作赎罪祭。

chapters.en: The priest is to make atonement before the LORD for the one who erred by sinning unintentionally, and when atonement has been made, that person will be forgiven.
chapters.zh: 那误行的人犯罪的时候，祭司要在耶和华面前为他赎罪，他就必蒙赦免。

chapters.en: One and the same law applies to everyone who sins unintentionally, whether a native-born Israelite or a foreigner residing among you.
chapters.zh: 以色列中的本地人和寄居在他们中间的外人，若误行了什么事，必归一样的条例。

chapters.en: “ ‘But anyone who sins defiantly, whether native-born or foreigner, blasphemes the LORD and must be cut off from the people of Israel.
chapters.zh: 但那擅敢行事的，无论是本地人是寄居的，他亵渎了耶和华，必从民中剪除。

chapters.en: Because they have despised the LORD’s word and broken his commands, they must surely be cut off; their guilt remains on them.’ ”
chapters.zh: 因他藐视耶和华的言语，违背耶和华的命令，那人总要剪除。他的罪孽要归到他身上。

chapters.en: While the Israelites were in the wilderness, a man was found gathering wood on the Sabbath day.
chapters.zh: 以色列人在旷野的时候，遇见一个人在安息日捡柴。

chapters.en: Those who found him gathering wood brought him to Moses and Aaron and the whole assembly,
chapters.zh: 遇见他捡柴的人，就把他带到摩西，亚伦并全会众那里，

chapters.en: and they kept him in custody, because it was not clear what should be done to him.
chapters.zh: 将他收在监内。因为当怎样办他，还没有指明。

chapters.en: Then the LORD said to Moses, “The man must die. The whole assembly must stone him outside the camp.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华吩咐摩西说，总要把那人治死。全会众要在营外用石头把他打死。

chapters.en: So the assembly took him outside the camp and stoned him to death, as the LORD commanded Moses.
chapters.zh: 于是全会众将他带到营外，用石头打死他，是照耶和华所吩咐摩西的。

chapters.en: The LORD said to Moses,
chapters.zh: 耶和华晓谕摩西说，

chapters.en: “Speak to the Israelites and say to them: ‘Throughout the generations to come you are to make tassels on the corners of your garments, with a blue cord on each tassel.
chapters.zh: 你吩咐以色列人，叫他们世世代代在衣服边上作繸子，又在底边的繸子上钉一根蓝细带子。

chapters.en: You will have these tassels to look at and so you will remember all the commands of the LORD, that you may obey them and not prostitute yourselves by chasing after the lusts of your own hearts and eyes.
chapters.zh: 你们佩带这繸子，好叫你们看见就记念遵行耶和华一切的命令，不随从自己的心意，眼目行邪淫，象你们素常一样。

chapters.en: Then you will remember to obey all my commands and will be consecrated to your God.
chapters.zh: 使你们记念遵行我一切的命令，成为圣洁，归与你们的神。

chapters.en: I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of Egypt to be your God. I am the LORD your God.’ ”
chapters.zh: 我是耶和华你们的神，曾把你们从埃及地领出来，要作你们的神。我是耶和华你们的神。

chapters.en: Korah son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, and certain Reubenites—Dathan and Abiram, sons of Eliab, and On son of Peleth—became insolent
chapters.zh: 利未的曾孙，哥辖的孙子，以斯哈的儿子可拉，和流便子孙中以利押的儿子大坍，亚比兰，与比勒的儿子安，

chapters.en: and rose up against Moses. With them were 250 Israelite men, well-known community leaders who had been appointed members of the council.
chapters.zh: 并以色列会中的二百五十个首领，就是有名望选入会中的人，在摩西面前一同起来，

chapters.en: They came as a group to oppose Moses and Aaron and said to them, “You have gone too far! The whole community is holy, every one of them, and the LORD is with them. Why then do you set yourselves above the LORD’s assembly?”
chapters.zh: 聚集攻击摩西，亚伦，说，你们擅自专权。全会众个个既是圣洁，耶和华也在他们中间，你们为什么自高，超过耶和华的会众呢？

chapters.en: When Moses heard this, he fell facedown.
chapters.zh: 摩西听见这话就俯伏在地，

chapters.en: Then he said to Korah and all his followers: “In the morning the LORD will show who belongs to him and who is holy, and he will have that person come near him. The man he chooses he will cause to come near him.
chapters.zh: 对可拉和他一党的人说，到了早晨，耶和华必指示谁是属他的，谁是圣洁的，就叫谁亲近他。他所拣选的是谁，必叫谁亲近他。

chapters.en: You, Korah, and all your followers are to do this: Take censers
chapters.zh: 可拉阿，你们要这样行，你和你的一党要拿香炉来。

chapters.en: and tomorrow put burning coals and incense in them before the LORD. The man the LORD chooses will be the one who is holy. You Levites have gone too far!”
chapters.zh: 明日，在耶和华面前，把火盛在炉中，把香放在其上。耶和华拣选谁，谁就为圣洁。你们这利未的子孙擅自专权了。

chapters.en: Moses also said to Korah, “Now listen, you Levites!
chapters.zh: 摩西又对可拉说，利未的子孙哪，你们听我说。

chapters.en: Isn’t it enough for you that the God of Israel has separated you from the rest of the Israelite community and brought you near himself to do the work at the LORD’s tabernacle and to stand before the community and minister to them?
chapters.zh: 以色列的神从以色列会中将你们分别出来，使你们亲近他，办耶和华帐幕的事，并站在会众面前替他们当差。

chapters.en: He has brought you and all your fellow Levites near himself, but now you are trying to get the priesthood too.
chapters.zh: 耶和华又使你，和你一切弟兄利未的子孙，一同亲近他，这岂为小事，你们还要求祭司的职任吗？

chapters.en: It is against the LORD that you and all your followers have banded together. Who is Aaron that you should grumble against him?”
chapters.zh: 你和你一党的人聚集是要攻击耶和华。亚伦算什么，你们竟向他发怨言呢？

chapters.en: Then Moses summoned Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab. But they said, “We will not come!
chapters.zh: 摩西打发人去召以利押的儿子大坍，亚比兰。他们说，我们不上去。

chapters.en: Isn’t it enough that you have brought us up out of a land flowing with milk and honey to kill us in the wilderness? And now you also want to lord it over us!
chapters.zh: 你将我们从流奶与蜜之地领上来，要在旷野杀我们，这岂为小事，你还要自立为王辖管我们吗？

chapters.en: Moreover, you haven’t brought us into a land flowing with milk and honey or given us an inheritance of fields and vineyards. Do you want to treat these men like slaves ? No, we will not come!”
chapters.zh: 并且你没有将我们领到流奶与蜜之地，也没有把田地和葡萄园给我们为业。难道你要剜这些人的眼睛吗？我们不上去。

chapters.en: Then Moses became very angry and said to the LORD, “Do not accept their offering. I have not taken so much as a donkey from them, nor have I wronged any of them.”
chapters.zh: 摩西就甚发怒，对耶和华说，求你不要享受他们的供物。我并没有夺过他们一匹驴，也没有害过他们一个人。

chapters.en: Moses said to Korah, “You and all your followers are to appear before the LORD tomorrow—you and they and Aaron.
chapters.zh: 摩西对可拉说，明天，你和你一党的人，并亚伦，都要站在耶和华面前。

chapters.en: Each man is to take his censer and put incense in it—250 censers in all—and present it before the LORD. You and Aaron are to present your censers also.”
chapters.zh: 各人要拿一个香炉，共二百五十个，把香放在上面，到耶和华面前。你和亚伦也各拿自己的香炉。

chapters.en: So each of them took his censer, put burning coals and incense in it, and stood with Moses and Aaron at the entrance to the tent of meeting.
chapters.zh: 于是他们各人拿一个香炉，盛上火，加上香，同摩西，亚伦站在会幕门前。

chapters.en: When Korah had gathered all his followers in opposition to them at the entrance to the tent of meeting, the glory of the LORD appeared to the entire assembly.
chapters.zh: 可拉招聚全会众到会幕门前，要攻击摩西，亚伦。耶和华的荣光就向全会众显现。

chapters.en: The LORD said to Moses and Aaron,
chapters.zh: 耶和华晓谕摩西，亚伦说，

chapters.en: “Separate yourselves from this assembly so I can put an end to them at once.”
chapters.zh: 你们离开这会众，我好在转眼之间把他们灭绝。

chapters.en: But Moses and Aaron fell facedown and cried out, “O God, the God who gives breath to all living things, will you be angry with the entire assembly when only one man sins?”
chapters.zh: 摩西，亚伦就俯伏在地，说，神，万人之灵的神阿，一人犯罪，你就要向全会众发怒吗？

chapters.en: Then the LORD said to Moses,
chapters.zh: 耶和华晓谕摩西说，

chapters.en: “Say to the assembly, ‘Move away from the tents of Korah, Dathan and Abiram.’ ”
chapters.zh: 你吩咐会众说，你们离开可拉，大坍，亚比兰帐棚的四围。

chapters.en: Moses got up and went to Dathan and Abiram, and the elders of Israel followed him.
chapters.zh: 摩西起来，往大坍，亚比兰那里去。以色列的长老也随着他去。

chapters.en: He warned the assembly, “Move back from the tents of these wicked men! Do not touch anything belonging to them, or you will be swept away because of all their sins.”
chapters.zh: 他吩咐会众说，你们离开这恶人的帐棚吧，他们的物件，什么都不可摸，恐怕你们陷在他们的罪中，与他们一同消灭。

chapters.en: So they moved away from the tents of Korah, Dathan and Abiram. Dathan and Abiram had come out and were standing with their wives, children and little ones at the entrances to their tents.
chapters.zh: 于是众人离开可拉，大坍，亚比兰帐棚的四围。大坍，亚比兰带着妻子，儿女，小孩子，都出来，站在自己的帐棚门口。

chapters.en: Then Moses said, “This is how you will know that the LORD has sent me to do all these things and that it was not my idea:
chapters.zh: 摩西说，我行的这一切事本不是凭我自己心意行的，乃是耶和华打发我行的，必有证据使你们知道。

chapters.en: If these men die a natural death and suffer the fate of all mankind, then the LORD has not sent me.
chapters.zh: 这些人死若与世人无异，或是他们所遭的与世人相同，就不是耶和华打发我来的。

chapters.en: But if the LORD brings about something totally new, and the earth opens its mouth and swallows them, with everything that belongs to them, and they go down alive into the realm of the dead, then you will know that these men have treated the LORD with contempt.”
chapters.zh: 倘若耶和华创作一件新事，使地开口，把他们和一切属他们的都吞下去，叫他们活活地坠落阴间，你们就明白这些人是藐视耶和华了。

chapters.en: As soon as he finished saying all this, the ground under them split apart
chapters.zh: 摩西刚说完了这一切话，他们脚下的地就开了口，

chapters.en: and the earth opened its mouth and swallowed them and their households, and all those associated with Korah, together with their possessions.
chapters.zh: 把他们和他们的家眷，并一切属可拉的人丁，财物，都吞下去。

chapters.en: They went down alive into the realm of the dead, with everything they owned; the earth closed over them, and they perished and were gone from the community.
chapters.zh: 这样，他们和一切属他们的，都活活地坠落阴间。地口在他们上头照旧合闭，他们就从会中灭亡。

chapters.en: At their cries, all the Israelites around them fled, shouting, “The earth is going to swallow us too!”
chapters.zh: 在他们四围的以色列众人听他们呼号，就都逃跑，说，恐怕地也把我们吞下去。

chapters.en: And fire came out from the LORD and consumed the 250 men who were offering the incense.
chapters.zh: 又有火从耶和华那里出来，烧灭了那献香的二百五十个人。

chapters.en: The LORD said to Moses,
chapters.zh: 耶和华晓谕摩西说，

chapters.en: “Tell Eleazar son of Aaron, the priest, to remove the censers from the charred remains and scatter the coals some distance away, for the censers are holy—
chapters.zh: 你吩咐祭司亚伦的儿子以利亚撒从火中捡起那些香炉来，把火撒在别处，因为那些香炉是圣的。

chapters.en: the censers of the men who sinned at the cost of their lives. Hammer the censers into sheets to overlay the altar, for they were presented before the LORD and have become holy. Let them be a sign to the Israelites.”
chapters.zh: 把那些犯罪，自害己命之人的香炉，叫人锤成片子，用以包坛。那些香炉本是他们在耶和华面前献过的，所以是圣的，并且可以给以色列人作记号。

chapters.en: So Eleazar the priest collected the bronze censers brought by those who had been burned to death, and he had them hammered out to overlay the altar,
chapters.zh: 于是祭司以利亚撒将被烧之人所献的铜香炉拿来，人就锤出来，用以包坛，

chapters.en: as the LORD directed him through Moses. This was to remind the Israelites that no one except a descendant of Aaron should come to burn incense before the LORD, or he would become like Korah and his followers.
chapters.zh: 给以色列人作纪念，使亚伦后裔之外的人不得近前来在耶和华面前烧香，免得他遭可拉和他一党所遭的。这乃是照耶和华借着摩西所吩咐的。

chapters.en: The next day the whole Israelite community grumbled against Moses and Aaron. “You have killed the LORD’s people,” they said.
chapters.zh: 第二天，以色列全会众都向摩西，亚伦发怨言说，你们杀了耶和华的百姓了。

chapters.en: But when the assembly gathered in opposition to Moses and Aaron and turned toward the tent of meeting, suddenly the cloud covered it and the glory of the LORD appeared.
chapters.zh: 会众聚集攻击摩西，亚伦的时候，向会幕观看，不料，有云彩遮盖了，耶和华的荣光显现。

chapters.en: Then Moses and Aaron went to the front of the tent of meeting,
chapters.zh: 摩西，亚伦就来到会幕前。

chapters.en: and the LORD said to Moses,
chapters.zh: 耶和华吩咐摩西说，

chapters.en: “Get away from this assembly so I can put an end to them at once.” And they fell facedown.
chapters.zh: 你们离开这会众，我好在转眼之间把他们灭绝。他们二人就俯伏于地。

chapters.en: Then Moses said to Aaron, “Take your censer and put incense in it, along with burning coals from the altar, and hurry to the assembly to make atonement for them. Wrath has come out from the LORD; the plague has started.”
chapters.zh: 摩西对亚伦说，拿你的香炉，把坛上的火盛在其中，又加上香，快快带到会众那里，为他们赎罪。因为有忿怒从耶和华那里出来，瘟疫已经发作了。

chapters.en: So Aaron did as Moses said, and ran into the midst of the assembly. The plague had already started among the people, but Aaron offered the incense and made atonement for them.
chapters.zh: 亚伦照着摩西所说的拿来，跑到会中，不料，瘟疫在百姓中已经发作了。他就加上香，为百姓赎罪。

chapters.en: He stood between the living and the dead, and the plague stopped.
chapters.zh: 他站在活人死人中间，瘟疫就止住了。

chapters.en: But 14,700 people died from the plague, in addition to those who had died because of Korah.
chapters.zh: 除了因可拉事情死的以外，遭瘟疫死的，共有一万四千七百人。

chapters.en: Then Aaron returned to Moses at the entrance to the tent of meeting, for the plague had stopped.
chapters.zh: 亚伦回到会幕门口，到摩西那里，瘟疫已经止住了。

chapters.en: The LORD said to Moses,
chapters.zh: 耶和华对摩西说，

chapters.en: “Speak to the Israelites and get twelve staffs from them, one from the leader of each of their ancestral tribes. Write the name of each man on his staff.
chapters.zh: 你晓谕以色列人，从他们手下取杖，每支派一根。从他们所有的首领，按着支派，共取十二根。你要将各人的名字写在各人的杖上，

chapters.en: On the staff of Levi write Aaron’s name, for there must be one staff for the head of each ancestral tribe.
chapters.zh: 并要将亚伦的名字写在利未的杖上，因为各族长必有一根杖。

chapters.en: Place them in the tent of meeting in front of the ark of the covenant law, where I meet with you.
chapters.zh: 你要把这些杖存在会幕内法柜前，就是我与你们相会之处。

chapters.en: The staff belonging to the man I choose will sprout, and I will rid myself of this constant grumbling against you by the Israelites.”
chapters.zh: 后来我所拣选的那人，他的杖必发芽。这样，我必使以色列人向你们所发的怨言止息，不再达到我耳中。

chapters.en: So Moses spoke to the Israelites, and their leaders gave him twelve staffs, one for the leader of each of their ancestral tribes, and Aaron’s staff was among them.
chapters.zh: 于是摩西晓谕以色列人，他们的首领就把杖交给他，按着支派，每首领一根，共有十二根。亚伦的杖也在其中。

chapters.en: Moses placed the staffs before the LORD in the tent of the covenant law.
chapters.zh: 摩西就把杖存在法柜的帐幕内，在耶和华面前。

chapters.en: The next day Moses entered the tent and saw that Aaron’s staff, which represented the tribe of Levi, had not only sprouted but had budded, blossomed and produced almonds.
chapters.zh: 第二天，摩西进法柜的帐幕去。谁知利未族亚伦的杖已经发了芽，生了花苞，开了花，结了熟杏。

chapters.en: Then Moses brought out all the staffs from the LORD’s presence to all the Israelites. They looked at them, and each of the leaders took his own staff.
chapters.zh: 摩西就把所有的杖从耶和华面前拿出来，给以色列众人看。他们看见了，各首领就把自己的杖拿去。

chapters.en: The LORD said to Moses, “Put back Aaron’s staff in front of the ark of the covenant law, to be kept as a sign to the rebellious. This will put an end to their grumbling against me, so that they will not die.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华吩咐摩西说，把亚伦的杖还放在法柜前，给这些背叛之子留作记号。这样，你就使他们向我发的怨言止息，免得他们死亡。

chapters.en: Moses did just as the LORD commanded him.
chapters.zh: 摩西就这样行。耶和华怎样吩咐他，他就怎样行了。

chapters.en: The Israelites said to Moses, “We will die! We are lost, we are all lost!
chapters.zh: 以色列人对摩西说，我们死啦。我们灭亡啦。都灭亡啦。

chapters.en: Anyone who even comes near the tabernacle of the LORD will die. Are we all going to die?”
chapters.zh: 凡挨近耶和华帐幕的是必死的。我们都要死亡吗？

chapters.en: The LORD said to Aaron, “You, your sons and your family are to bear the responsibility for offenses connected with the sanctuary, and you and your sons alone are to bear the responsibility for offenses connected with the priesthood.
chapters.zh: 耶和华对亚伦说，你和你的儿子，并你本族的人，要一同担当干犯圣所的罪孽。你和你的儿子也要一同担当干犯祭司职任的罪孽。

chapters.en: Bring your fellow Levites from your ancestral tribe to join you and assist you when you and your sons minister before the tent of the covenant law.
chapters.zh: 你要带你弟兄利未人，就是你祖宗支派的人前来，使他们与你联合，服事你，只是你和你的儿子，要一同在法柜的帐幕前供职。

chapters.en: They are to be responsible to you and are to perform all the duties of the tent, but they must not go near the furnishings of the sanctuary or the altar. Otherwise both they and you will die.
chapters.zh: 他们要守所吩咐你的，并守全帐幕，只是不可挨近圣所的器具和坛，免得他们和你们都死亡。

chapters.en: They are to join you and be responsible for the care of the tent of meeting—all the work at the tent—and no one else may come near where you are.
chapters.zh: 他们要与你联合，也要看守会幕，办理帐幕一切的事，只是外人不可挨近你们。

chapters.en: “You are to be responsible for the care of the sanctuary and the altar, so that my wrath will not fall on the Israelites again.
chapters.zh: 你们要看守圣所和坛，免得忿怒再临到以色列人。

chapters.en: I myself have selected your fellow Levites from among the Israelites as a gift to you, dedicated to the LORD to do the work at the tent of meeting.
chapters.zh: 我已将你们的弟兄利未人从以色列人中拣选出来归耶和华，是给你们为赏赐的，为要办理会幕的事。

chapters.en: But only you and your sons may serve as priests in connection with everything at the altar and inside the curtain. I am giving you the service of the priesthood as a gift. Anyone else who comes near the sanctuary is to be put to death.”
chapters.zh: 你和你的儿子要为一切属坛和幔子内的事一同守祭司的职任。你们要这样供职。我将祭司的职任给你们当作赏赐事奉我。凡挨近的外人必被治死。

chapters.en: Then the LORD said to Aaron, “I myself have put you in charge of the offerings presented to me; all the holy offerings the Israelites give me I give to you and your sons as your portion, your perpetual share.
chapters.zh: 耶和华晓谕亚伦说，我已将归我的举祭，就是以色列人一切分别为圣的物，交给你经管。因你受过膏，把这些都赐给你和你的子孙，当作永得的分。

chapters.en: You are to have the part of the most holy offerings that is kept from the fire. From all the gifts they bring me as most holy offerings, whether grain or sin or guilt offerings, that part belongs to you and your sons.
chapters.zh: 以色列人归给我至圣的供物，就是一切的素祭，赎罪祭，赎愆祭，其中所有存留不经火的，都为至圣之物，要归给你和你的子孙。

chapters.en: Eat it as something most holy; every male shall eat it. You must regard it as holy.
chapters.zh: 你要拿这些当至圣物吃。凡男丁都可以吃。你当以此物为圣。

chapters.en: “This also is yours: whatever is set aside from the gifts of all the wave offerings of the Israelites. I give this to you and your sons and daughters as your perpetual share. Everyone in your household who is ceremonially clean may eat it.
chapters.zh: 以色列人所献的举祭并摇祭都是你的。我已赐给你和你的儿女，当作永得的分。凡在你家中的洁净人都可以吃。

chapters.en: “I give you all the finest olive oil and all the finest new wine and grain they give the LORD as the firstfruits of their harvest.
chapters.zh: 凡油中，新酒中，五谷中至好的，就是以色列人所献给耶和华初熟之物，我都赐给你。

chapters.en: All the land’s firstfruits that they bring to the LORD will be yours. Everyone in your household who is ceremonially clean may eat it.
chapters.zh: 凡从他们地上所带来给耶和华初熟之物也都要归与你。你家中的洁净人都可以吃。

chapters.en: “Everything in Israel that is devoted to the LORD is yours.
chapters.zh: 以色列中一切永献的都必归与你。

chapters.en: The first offspring of every womb, both human and animal, that is offered to the LORD is yours. But you must redeem every firstborn son and every firstborn male of unclean animals.
chapters.zh: 他们所有奉给耶和华的，连人带牲畜，凡头生的，都要归给你。只是人头生的，总要赎出来。不洁净牲畜头生的，也要赎出来。

chapters.en: When they are a month old, you must redeem them at the redemption price set at five shekels of silver, according to the sanctuary shekel, which weighs twenty gerahs.
chapters.zh: 其中在一月之外所当赎的，要照你所估定的价，按圣所的平，用银子五舍客勒赎出来（一舍客勒是二十季拉）。

chapters.en: “But you must not redeem the firstborn of a cow, a sheep or a goat; they are holy. Splash their blood against the altar and burn their fat as a food offering, an aroma pleasing to the LORD.
chapters.zh: 只是头生的牛，或是头生的绵羊和山羊，必不可赎，都是圣的，要把它的血洒在坛上，把它的脂油焚烧，当作馨香的火祭献给耶和华。

chapters.en: Their meat is to be yours, just as the breast of the wave offering and the right thigh are yours.
chapters.zh: 它的肉必归你，像被摇的胸，被举的右腿归你一样。

chapters.en: Whatever is set aside from the holy offerings the Israelites present to the LORD I give to you and your sons and daughters as your perpetual share. It is an everlasting covenant of salt before the LORD for both you and your offspring.”
chapters.zh: 凡以色列人所献给耶和华圣物中的举祭，我都赐给你和你的儿女，当作永得的分。这是给你和你的后裔，在耶和华面前作为永远的盐约（盐即不废坏的意思）。

chapters.en: The LORD said to Aaron, “You will have no inheritance in their land, nor will you have any share among them; I am your share and your inheritance among the Israelites.
chapters.zh: 耶和华对亚伦说，你在以色列人的境内不可有产业，在他们中间也不可有分。我就是你的分，是你的产业。

chapters.en: “I give to the Levites all the tithes in Israel as their inheritance in return for the work they do while serving at the tent of meeting.
chapters.zh: 凡以色列中出产的十分之一，我已赐给利未的子孙为业。因他们所办的是会幕的事，所以赐给他们为酬他们的劳。

chapters.en: From now on the Israelites must not go near the tent of meeting, or they will bear the consequences of their sin and will die.
chapters.zh: 从今以后，以色列人不可挨近会幕，免得他们担罪而死。

chapters.en: It is the Levites who are to do the work at the tent of meeting and bear the responsibility for any offenses they commit against it. This is a lasting ordinance for the generations to come. They will receive no inheritance among the Israelites.
chapters.zh: 惟独利未人要办会幕的事，担当罪孽。这要作你们世世代代永远的定例。他们在以色列人中不可有产业。

chapters.en: Instead, I give to the Levites as their inheritance the tithes that the Israelites present as an offering to the LORD. That is why I said concerning them: ‘They will have no inheritance among the Israelites.’ ”
chapters.zh: 因为以色列人中出产的十分之一，就是献给耶和华为举祭的，我已赐给利未人为业。所以我对他们说，在以色列人中不可有产业。

chapters.en: The LORD said to Moses,
chapters.zh: 耶和华吩咐摩西说，

chapters.en: “Speak to the Levites and say to them: ‘When you receive from the Israelites the tithe I give you as your inheritance, you must present a tenth of that tithe as the LORD’s offering.
chapters.zh: 你晓谕利未人说，你们从以色列人中所取的十分之一，就是我给你们为业的，要再从那十分之一中取十分之一作为举祭献给耶和华，

chapters.en: Your offering will be reckoned to you as grain from the threshing floor or juice from the winepress.
chapters.zh: 这举祭要算为你们场上的谷，又如满酒榨的酒。

chapters.en: In this way you also will present an offering to the LORD from all the tithes you receive from the Israelites. From these tithes you must give the LORD’s portion to Aaron the priest.
chapters.zh: 这样，你们从以色列人中所得的十分之一也要作举祭献给耶和华，从这十分之一中，将所献给耶和华的举祭归给祭司亚伦。

chapters.en: You must present as the LORD’s portion the best and holiest part of everything given to you.’
chapters.zh: 奉给你们的一切礼物，要从其中将至好的，就是分别为圣的，献给耶和华为举祭。

chapters.en: “Say to the Levites: ‘When you present the best part, it will be reckoned to you as the product of the threshing floor or the winepress.
chapters.zh: 所以你要对利未人说，你们从其中将至好的举起，这就算为你们场上的粮，又如酒榨的酒。

chapters.en: You and your households may eat the rest of it anywhere, for it is your wages for your work at the tent of meeting.
chapters.zh: 你们和你们家属随处可以吃。这原是你们的赏赐，是酬你们在会幕里办事的劳。

chapters.en: By presenting the best part of it you will not be guilty in this matter; then you will not defile the holy offerings of the Israelites, and you will not die.’ ”
chapters.zh: 你们从其中将至好的举起，就不至因这物担罪。你们不可亵渎以色列人的圣物，免得死亡。

chapters.en: The LORD said to Moses and Aaron:
chapters.zh: 耶和华晓谕摩西，亚伦说，

chapters.en: “This is a requirement of the law that the LORD has commanded: Tell the Israelites to bring you a red heifer without defect or blemish and that has never been under a yoke.
chapters.zh: 耶和华命定律法中的一条律例乃是这样说，你要吩咐以色列人，把一只没有残疾，未曾负轭，纯红的母牛牵到你这里来，

chapters.en: Give it to Eleazar the priest; it is to be taken outside the camp and slaughtered in his presence.
chapters.zh: 交给祭司以利亚撒。他必牵到营外，人就把牛宰在他面前。

chapters.en: Then Eleazar the priest is to take some of its blood on his finger and sprinkle it seven times toward the front of the tent of meeting.
chapters.zh: 祭司以利亚撒要用指头蘸这牛的血，向会幕前面弹七次。

chapters.en: While he watches, the heifer is to be burned—its hide, flesh, blood and intestines.
chapters.zh: 人要在他眼前把这母牛焚烧。牛的皮，肉，血，粪都要焚烧。

chapters.en: The priest is to take some cedar wood, hyssop and scarlet wool and throw them onto the burning heifer.
chapters.zh: 祭司要把香柏木，牛膝草，朱红色线都丢在烧牛的火中。

chapters.en: After that, the priest must wash his clothes and bathe himself with water. He may then come into the camp, but he will be ceremonially unclean till evening.
chapters.zh: 祭司必不洁净到晚上，要洗衣服，用水洗身，然后可以进营。

chapters.en: The man who burns it must also wash his clothes and bathe with water, and he too will be unclean till evening.
chapters.zh: 烧牛的人必不洁净到晚上，也要洗衣服，用水洗身。

chapters.en: “A man who is clean shall gather up the ashes of the heifer and put them in a ceremonially clean place outside the camp. They are to be kept by the Israelite community for use in the water of cleansing; it is for purification from sin.
chapters.zh: 必有一个洁净的人收起母牛的灰，存在营外洁净的地方，为以色列会众调作除污秽的水。这本是除罪的。

chapters.en: The man who gathers up the ashes of the heifer must also wash his clothes, and he too will be unclean till evening. This will be a lasting ordinance both for the Israelites and for the foreigners residing among them.
chapters.zh: 收起母牛灰的人必不洁净到晚上，要洗衣服。这要给以色列人和寄居在他们中间的外人作为永远的定例。

chapters.en: “Whoever touches a human corpse will be unclean for seven days.
chapters.zh: 摸了人死尸的，就必七天不洁净。

chapters.en: They must purify themselves with the water on the third day and on the seventh day; then they will be clean. But if they do not purify themselves on the third and seventh days, they will not be clean.
chapters.zh: 那人到第三天要用这除污秽的水洁净自己，第七天就洁净了。他若在第三天不洁净自己，第七天就不洁净了。

chapters.en: If they fail to purify themselves after touching a human corpse, they defile the LORD’s tabernacle. They must be cut off from Israel. Because the water of cleansing has not been sprinkled on them, they are unclean; their uncleanness remains on them.
chapters.zh: 凡摸了人死尸，不洁净自己的，就玷污了耶和华的帐幕，这人必从以色列中剪除。因为那除污秽的水没有洒在他身上，他就为不洁净，污秽还在他身上。

chapters.en: “This is the law that applies when a person dies in a tent: Anyone who enters the tent and anyone who is in it will be unclean for seven days,
chapters.zh: 人死在帐棚里的条例乃是这样，凡进那帐棚的，和一切在帐棚里的，都必七天不洁净。

chapters.en: and every open container without a lid fastened on it will be unclean.
chapters.zh: 凡敞口的器皿，就是没有扎上盖的，也是不洁净。

chapters.en: “Anyone out in the open who touches someone who has been killed with a sword or someone who has died a natural death, or anyone who touches a human bone or a grave, will be unclean for seven days.
chapters.zh: 无论何人在田野里摸了被刀杀的，或是尸首，或是人的骨头，或是坟墓，就要七天不洁净。

chapters.en: “For the unclean person, put some ashes from the burned purification offering into a jar and pour fresh water over them.
chapters.zh: 要为这不洁净的人拿些烧成的除罪灰放在器皿里，倒上活水。

chapters.en: Then a man who is ceremonially clean is to take some hyssop, dip it in the water and sprinkle the tent and all the furnishings and the people who were there. He must also sprinkle anyone who has touched a human bone or a grave or anyone who has been killed or anyone who has died a natural death.
chapters.zh: 必当有一个洁净的人拿牛膝草蘸在这水中，把水洒在帐棚上，和一切器皿并帐棚内的众人身上，又洒在摸了骨头，或摸了被杀的，或摸了自死的，或摸了坟墓的那人身上。

chapters.en: The man who is clean is to sprinkle those who are unclean on the third and seventh days, and on the seventh day he is to purify them. Those who are being cleansed must wash their clothes and bathe with water, and that evening they will be clean.
chapters.zh: 第三天和第七天，洁净的人要洒水在不洁净的人身上，第七天就使他成为洁净。那人要洗衣服，用水洗澡，到晚上就洁净了。

chapters.en: But if those who are unclean do not purify themselves, they must be cut off from the community, because they have defiled the sanctuary of the LORD. The water of cleansing has not been sprinkled on them, and they are unclean.
chapters.zh: 但那污秽而不洁净自己的，要将他从会中剪除，因为他玷污了耶和华的圣所。除污秽的水没有洒在他身上，他是不洁净的。

chapters.en: This is a lasting ordinance for them. “The man who sprinkles the water of cleansing must also wash his clothes, and anyone who touches the water of cleansing will be unclean till evening.
chapters.zh: 这要给你们作为永远的定例。并且那洒除污秽水的人要洗衣服。凡摸除污秽水的，必不洁净到晚上。

chapters.en: Anything that an unclean person touches becomes unclean, and anyone who touches it becomes unclean till evening.”
chapters.zh: 不洁净人所摸的一切物就不洁净。摸了这物的人必不洁净到晚上。

chapters.en: In the first month the whole Israelite community arrived at the Desert of Zin, and they stayed at Kadesh. There Miriam died and was buried.
chapters.zh: 正月间，以色列全会众到了寻的旷野，就住在加低斯。米利暗死在那里，就葬在那里。

chapters.en: Now there was no water for the community, and the people gathered in opposition to Moses and Aaron.
chapters.zh: 会众没有水喝，就聚集攻击摩西，亚伦。

chapters.en: They quarreled with Moses and said, “If only we had died when our brothers fell dead before the LORD!
chapters.zh: 百姓向摩西争闹说，我们的弟兄曾死在耶和华面前，我们恨不得与他们同死。

chapters.en: Why did you bring the LORD’s community into this wilderness, that we and our livestock should die here?
chapters.zh: 你们为何把耶和华的会众领到这旷野，使我们和牲畜都死在这里呢？

chapters.en: Why did you bring us up out of Egypt to this terrible place? It has no grain or figs, grapevines or pomegranates. And there is no water to drink!”
chapters.zh: 你们为何逼着我们出埃及，领我们到这坏地方呢？这地方不好撒种，也没有无花果树，葡萄树，石榴树，又没有水喝。

chapters.en: Moses and Aaron went from the assembly to the entrance to the tent of meeting and fell facedown, and the glory of the LORD appeared to them.
chapters.zh: 摩西，亚伦离开会众，到会幕门口，俯伏在地。耶和华的荣光向他们显现。

chapters.en: The LORD said to Moses,
chapters.zh: 耶和华晓谕摩西说，

chapters.en: “Take the staff, and you and your brother Aaron gather the assembly together. Speak to that rock before their eyes and it will pour out its water. You will bring water out of the rock for the community so they and their livestock can drink.”
chapters.zh: 你拿着杖去，和你的哥哥亚伦招聚会众，在他们眼前吩咐磐石发出水来，水就从磐石流出，给会众和他们的牲畜喝。

chapters.en: So Moses took the staff from the LORD’s presence, just as he commanded him.
chapters.zh: 于是摩西照耶和华所吩咐的，从耶和华面前取了杖去。

chapters.en: He and Aaron gathered the assembly together in front of the rock and Moses said to them, “Listen, you rebels, must we bring you water out of this rock?”
chapters.zh: 摩西，亚伦就招聚会众到磐石前。摩西说，你们这些背叛的人听我说，我为你们使水从这磐石中流出来吗？

chapters.en: Then Moses raised his arm and struck the rock twice with his staff. Water gushed out, and the community and their livestock drank.
chapters.zh: 摩西举手，用杖击打磐石两下，就有许多水流出来，会众和他们的牲畜都喝了。

chapters.en: But the LORD said to Moses and Aaron, “Because you did not trust in me enough to honor me as holy in the sight of the Israelites, you will not bring this community into the land I give them.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华对摩西，亚伦说，因为你们不信我，不在以色列人眼前尊我为圣，所以你们必不得领这会众进我所赐给他们的地去。

chapters.en: These were the waters of Meribah, where the Israelites quarreled with the LORD and where he was proved holy among them.
chapters.zh: 这水名叫米利巴水（米利巴就是争闹的意思），是因以色列人向耶和华争闹，耶和华就在他们面前显为圣。

chapters.en: Moses sent messengers from Kadesh to the king of Edom, saying: “This is what your brother Israel says: You know about all the hardships that have come on us.
chapters.zh: 摩西从加低斯差遣使者去见以东王，说，你的弟兄以色列人这样说，我们所遭遇的一切艰难，

chapters.en: Our ancestors went down into Egypt, and we lived there many years. The Egyptians mistreated us and our ancestors,
chapters.zh: 就是我们的列祖下到埃及，我们在埃及久住。埃及人恶待我们的列祖和我们，

chapters.en: but when we cried out to the LORD, he heard our cry and sent an angel and brought us out of Egypt. “Now we are here at Kadesh, a town on the edge of your territory.
chapters.zh: 我们哀求耶和华的时候，他听了我们的声音，差遣使者把我们从埃及领出来。这事你都知道。如今，我们在你边界上的城加低斯。

chapters.en: Please let us pass through your country. We will not go through any field or vineyard, or drink water from any well. We will travel along the King’s Highway and not turn to the right or to the left until we have passed through your territory.”
chapters.zh: 求你容我们从你的地经过。我们不走田间和葡萄园，也不喝井里的水，只走大道（原文作王道），不偏左右，直到过了你的境界。

chapters.en: But Edom answered: “You may not pass through here; if you try, we will march out and attack you with the sword.”
chapters.zh: 以东王说，你不可从我的地经过，免得我带刀出去攻击你。

chapters.en: The Israelites replied: “We will go along the main road, and if we or our livestock drink any of your water, we will pay for it. We only want to pass through on foot—nothing else.”
chapters.zh: 以色列人说，我们要走大道上去。我们和牲畜若喝你的水，必给你价值。不求别的，只求你容我们步行过去。

chapters.en: Again they answered: “You may not pass through.” Then Edom came out against them with a large and powerful army.
chapters.zh: 以东王说，你们不可经过。就率领许多人出来，要用强硬的手攻击以色列人。

chapters.en: Since Edom refused to let them go through their territory, Israel turned away from them.
chapters.zh: 这样，以东王不肯容以色列人从他的境界过去。于是他们转去，离开他。

chapters.en: The whole Israelite community set out from Kadesh and came to Mount Hor.
chapters.zh: 以色列全会众从加低斯起行，到了何珥山。

chapters.en: At Mount Hor, near the border of Edom, the LORD said to Moses and Aaron,
chapters.zh: 耶和华在附近以东边界的何珥山上晓谕摩西，亚伦说，

chapters.en: “Aaron will be gathered to his people. He will not enter the land I give the Israelites, because both of you rebelled against my command at the waters of Meribah.
chapters.zh: 亚伦要归到他列祖（原文作本民）那里。他必不得入我所赐给以色列人的地。因为在米利巴水，你们违背了我的命。

chapters.en: Get Aaron and his son Eleazar and take them up Mount Hor.
chapters.zh: 你带亚伦和他的儿子以利亚撒上何珥山，

chapters.en: Remove Aaron’s garments and put them on his son Eleazar, for Aaron will be gathered to his people; he will die there.”
chapters.zh: 把亚伦的圣衣脱下来，给他的儿子以利亚撒穿上。亚伦必死在那里，归他列祖。

chapters.en: Moses did as the LORD commanded: They went up Mount Hor in the sight of the whole community.
chapters.zh: 摩西就照耶和华所吩咐的行。三人当着会众的眼前上了何珥山。

chapters.en: Moses removed Aaron’s garments and put them on his son Eleazar. And Aaron died there on top of the mountain. Then Moses and Eleazar came down from the mountain,
chapters.zh: 摩西把亚伦的圣衣脱下来，给他的儿子以利亚撒穿上，亚伦就死在山顶那里。于是摩西和以利亚撒下了山。

chapters.en: and when the whole community learned that Aaron had died, all the Israelites mourned for him thirty days.
chapters.zh: 全会众，就是以色列全家，见亚伦已经死了，便都为亚伦哀哭了三十天。

chapters.en: When the Canaanite king of Arad, who lived in the Negev, heard that Israel was coming along the road to Atharim, he attacked the Israelites and captured some of them.
chapters.zh: 住南地的迦南人亚拉得王，听说以色列人从亚他林路来，就和以色列人争战，掳了他们几个人。

chapters.en: Then Israel made this vow to the LORD: “If you will deliver these people into our hands, we will totally destroy their cities.”
chapters.zh: 以色列人向耶和华发愿说，你若将这民交付我手，我就把他们的城邑尽行毁灭。

chapters.en: The LORD listened to Israel’s plea and gave the Canaanites over to them. They completely destroyed them and their towns; so the place was named Hormah.
chapters.zh: 耶和华应允了以色列人，把迦南人交付他们，他们就把迦南人和迦南人的城邑尽行毁灭。那地方的名便叫何珥玛（何珥玛就是毁灭的意思）。

chapters.en: They traveled from Mount Hor along the route to the Red Sea, to go around Edom. But the people grew impatient on the way;
chapters.zh: 他们从何珥山起行，往红海那条路走，要绕过以东地。百姓因这路难行，心中甚是烦躁，

chapters.en: they spoke against God and against Moses, and said, “Why have you brought us up out of Egypt to die in the wilderness? There is no bread! There is no water! And we detest this miserable food!”
chapters.zh: 就怨神和摩西说，你们为什么把我们从埃及领出来，使我们死在旷野呢？这里没有粮，没有水，我们的心厌恶这淡薄的食物。

chapters.en: Then the LORD sent venomous snakes among them; they bit the people and many Israelites died.
chapters.zh: 于是耶和华使火蛇进入百姓中间，蛇就咬他们。以色列人中死了许多。

chapters.en: The people came to Moses and said, “We sinned when we spoke against the LORD and against you. Pray that the LORD will take the snakes away from us.” So Moses prayed for the people.
chapters.zh: 百姓到摩西那里，说，我们怨耶和华和你，有罪了。求你祷告耶和华，叫这些蛇离开我们。于是摩西为百姓祷告。

chapters.en: The LORD said to Moses, “Make a snake and put it up on a pole; anyone who is bitten can look at it and live.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华对摩西说，你制造一条火蛇，挂在杆子上。凡被咬的，一望这蛇，就必得活。

chapters.en: So Moses made a bronze snake and put it up on a pole. Then when anyone was bitten by a snake and looked at the bronze snake, they lived.
chapters.zh: 摩西便制造一条铜蛇，挂在杆子上。凡被蛇咬的，一望这铜蛇就活了。

chapters.en: The Israelites moved on and camped at Oboth.
chapters.zh: 以色列人起行，安营在阿伯。

chapters.en: Then they set out from Oboth and camped in Iye Abarim, in the wilderness that faces Moab toward the sunrise.
chapters.zh: 又从阿伯起行，安营在以耶亚巴琳，与摩押相对的旷野，向日出之地。

chapters.en: From there they moved on and camped in the Zered Valley.
chapters.zh: 从那里起行，安营在撒烈谷。

chapters.en: They set out from there and camped alongside the Arnon, which is in the wilderness extending into Amorite territory. The Arnon is the border of Moab, between Moab and the Amorites.
chapters.zh: 从那里起行，安营在亚嫩河那边。这亚嫩河是在旷野，从亚摩利的境界流出来的。原来亚嫩河是摩押的边界，在摩押和亚摩利人搭界的地方。

chapters.en: That is why the Book of the Wars of the LORD says: “. . . Zahab in Suphah and the ravines, the Arnon
chapters.zh: 所以耶和华的战记上说，苏法的哇哈伯与亚嫩河的谷，

chapters.en: and the slopes of the ravines that lead to the settlement of Ar and lie along the border of Moab.”
chapters.zh: 并向亚珥城众谷的下坡，是靠近摩押的境界。

chapters.en: From there they continued on to Beer, the well where the LORD said to Moses, “Gather the people together and I will give them water.”
chapters.zh: 以色列人从那里起行，到了比珥（比珥就是井的意思）。从前耶和华吩咐摩西说，招聚百姓，我好给他们水喝，说的就是这井。

chapters.en: Then Israel sang this song: “Spring up, O well! Sing about it,
chapters.zh: 当时，以色列人唱歌说，井阿，涌上水来。你们要向这井歌唱。

chapters.en: about the well that the princes dug, that the nobles of the people sank— the nobles with scepters and staffs.” Then they went from the wilderness to Mattanah,
chapters.zh: 这井是首领和民中的尊贵人用圭用杖所挖所掘的。以色列人从旷野往玛他拿去，

chapters.en: from Mattanah to Nahaliel, from Nahaliel to Bamoth,
chapters.zh: 从玛他拿到拿哈列，从拿哈列到巴末，

chapters.en: and from Bamoth to the valley in Moab where the top of Pisgah overlooks the wasteland.
chapters.zh: 从巴末到摩押地的谷，又到那下望旷野之毗斯迦的山顶。

chapters.en: Israel sent messengers to say to Sihon king of the Amorites:
chapters.zh: 以色列人差遣使者去见亚摩利人的王西宏，说，

chapters.en: “Let us pass through your country. We will not turn aside into any field or vineyard, or drink water from any well. We will travel along the King’s Highway until we have passed through your territory.”
chapters.zh: 求你容我们从你的地经过。我们不偏入田间和葡萄园，也不喝井里的水，只走大道（原文作王道），直到过了你的境界。

chapters.en: But Sihon would not let Israel pass through his territory. He mustered his entire army and marched out into the wilderness against Israel. When he reached Jahaz, he fought with Israel.
chapters.zh: 西宏不容以色列人从他的境界经过，就招聚他的众民出到旷野，要攻击以色列人，到了雅杂与以色列人争战。

chapters.en: Israel, however, put him to the sword and took over his land from the Arnon to the Jabbok, but only as far as the Ammonites, because their border was fortified.
chapters.zh: 以色列人用刀杀了他，得了他的地，从亚嫩河到雅博河，直到亚扪人的境界，因为亚扪人的境界多有坚垒。

chapters.en: Israel captured all the cities of the Amorites and occupied them, including Heshbon and all its surrounding settlements.
chapters.zh: 以色列人夺取这一切的城邑，也住亚摩利人的城邑，就是希实本与希实本的一切乡村。

chapters.en: Heshbon was the city of Sihon king of the Amorites, who had fought against the former king of Moab and had taken from him all his land as far as the Arnon.
chapters.zh: 这希实本是亚摩利王西宏的京城。西宏曾与摩押的先王争战，从他手中夺取了全地，直到亚嫩河。

chapters.en: That is why the poets say: “Come to Heshbon and let it be rebuilt; let Sihon’s city be restored.
chapters.zh: 所以那些作诗歌的说，你们来到希实本。愿西宏的城被修造，被建立。

chapters.en: “Fire went out from Heshbon, a blaze from the city of Sihon. It consumed Ar of Moab, the citizens of Arnon’s heights.
chapters.zh: 因为有火从希实本发出，有火焰出于西宏的城，烧尽摩押的亚珥和亚嫩河丘坛的祭司（祭司原文作主）。

chapters.en: Woe to you, Moab! You are destroyed, people of Chemosh! He has given up his sons as fugitives and his daughters as captives to Sihon king of the Amorites.
chapters.zh: 摩押阿，你有祸了。基抹的民哪，你们灭亡了。基抹的男子逃奔，女子被掳，交付亚摩利的王西宏。

chapters.en: “But we have overthrown them; Heshbon’s dominion has been destroyed all the way to Dibon. We have demolished them as far as Nophah, which extends to Medeba.”
chapters.zh: 我们射了他们。希实本直到底本尽皆毁灭。我们使地变成荒场，直到挪法。这挪法直延到米底巴。

chapters.en: So Israel settled in the land of the Amorites.
chapters.zh: 这样，以色列人就住在亚摩利人之地。

chapters.en: After Moses had sent spies to Jazer, the Israelites captured its surrounding settlements and drove out the Amorites who were there.
chapters.zh: 摩西打发人去窥探雅谢，以色列人就占了雅谢的镇市，赶出那里的亚摩利人。

chapters.en: Then they turned and went up along the road toward Bashan, and Og king of Bashan and his whole army marched out to meet them in battle at Edrei.
chapters.zh: 以色列人转回，向巴珊去。巴珊王噩和他的众民都出来，在以得来与他们交战。

chapters.en: The LORD said to Moses, “Do not be afraid of him, for I have delivered him into your hands, along with his whole army and his land. Do to him what you did to Sihon king of the Amorites, who reigned in Heshbon.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华对摩西说，不要怕他。因我已将他和他的众民，并他的地，都交在你手中。你要待他像从前待住希实本的亚摩利王西宏一般。

chapters.en: So they struck him down, together with his sons and his whole army, leaving them no survivors. And they took possession of his land.
chapters.zh: 于是他们杀了他和他的众子，并他的众民，没有留下一个，就得了他的地。

chapters.en: Then the Israelites traveled to the plains of Moab and camped along the Jordan across from Jericho.
chapters.zh: 以色列人起行，在摩押平原，约旦河东，对着耶利哥安营。

chapters.en: Now Balak son of Zippor saw all that Israel had done to the Amorites,
chapters.zh: 以色列人向亚摩利人所行的一切事，西拨的儿子巴勒都看见了。

chapters.en: and Moab was terrified because there were so many people. Indeed, Moab was filled with dread because of the Israelites.
chapters.zh: 摩押人因以色列民甚多，就大大惧怕，心内忧急，
