chapters.en: The Moabites said to the elders of Midian, “This horde is going to lick up everything around us, as an ox licks up the grass of the field.” So Balak son of Zippor, who was king of Moab at that time,
chapters.zh: 对米甸的长老说，现在这众人要把我们四围所有的一概舔尽，就如牛舔尽田间的草一般。那时西拨的儿子巴勒作摩押王。

chapters.en: sent messengers to summon Balaam son of Beor, who was at Pethor, near the Euphrates River, in his native land. Balak said: “A people has come out of Egypt; they cover the face of the land and have settled next to me.
chapters.zh: 他差遣使者往大河边的毗夺去，到比珥的儿子巴兰本乡那里，召巴兰来，说，有一宗民从埃及出来，遮满地面，与我对居。

chapters.en: Now come and put a curse on these people, because they are too powerful for me. Perhaps then I will be able to defeat them and drive them out of the land. For I know that whoever you bless is blessed, and whoever you curse is cursed.”
chapters.zh: 这民比我强盛，现在求你来为我咒诅他们，或者我能得胜，攻打他们，赶出此地。因为我知道，你为谁祝福，谁就得福。你咒诅谁，谁就受咒诅。

chapters.en: The elders of Moab and Midian left, taking with them the fee for divination. When they came to Balaam, they told him what Balak had said.
chapters.zh: 摩押的长老和米甸的长老手里拿着卦金，到了巴兰那里，将巴勒的话都告诉了他。

chapters.en: “Spend the night here,” Balaam said to them, “and I will report back to you with the answer the LORD gives me.” So the Moabite officials stayed with him.
chapters.zh: 巴兰说，你们今夜在这里住宿，我必照耶和华所晓谕我的回报你们。摩押的使臣就在巴兰那里住下了。

chapters.en: God came to Balaam and asked, “Who are these men with you?”
chapters.zh: 神临到巴兰那里，说，在你这里的人都是谁？

chapters.en: Balaam said to God, “Balak son of Zippor, king of Moab, sent me this message:
chapters.zh: 巴兰回答说，是摩押王西拨的儿子巴勒打发人到我这里来，说，

chapters.en: ‘A people that has come out of Egypt covers the face of the land. Now come and put a curse on them for me. Perhaps then I will be able to fight them and drive them away.’ ”
chapters.zh: 从埃及出来的民遮满地面，你来为我咒诅他们，或者我能与他们争战，把他们赶出去。

chapters.en: But God said to Balaam, “Do not go with them. You must not put a curse on those people, because they are blessed.”
chapters.zh: 神对巴兰说，你不可同他们去，也不可咒诅那民，因为那民是蒙福的。

chapters.en: The next morning Balaam got up and said to Balak’s officials, “Go back to your own country, for the LORD has refused to let me go with you.”
chapters.zh: 巴兰早晨起来，对巴勒的使臣说，你们回本地去吧，因为耶和华不容我和你们同去。

chapters.en: So the Moabite officials returned to Balak and said, “Balaam refused to come with us.”
chapters.zh: 摩押的使臣就起来，回巴勒那里去，说，巴兰不肯和我们同来。

chapters.en: Then Balak sent other officials, more numerous and more distinguished than the first.
chapters.zh: 巴勒又差遣使臣，比先前的又多又尊贵。

chapters.en: They came to Balaam and said: “This is what Balak son of Zippor says: Do not let anything keep you from coming to me,
chapters.zh: 他们到了巴兰那里，对他说，西拨的儿子巴勒这样说，求你不容什么事拦阻你不到我这里来，

chapters.en: because I will reward you handsomely and do whatever you say. Come and put a curse on these people for me.”
chapters.zh: 因为我必使你得极大的尊荣。你向我要什么，我就给你什么。只求你来为我咒诅这民。

chapters.en: But Balaam answered them, “Even if Balak gave me all the silver and gold in his palace, I could not do anything great or small to go beyond the command of the LORD my God.
chapters.zh: 巴兰回答巴勒的臣仆说，巴勒就是将他满屋的金银给我，我行大事小事也不得越过耶和华我神的命。

chapters.en: Now spend the night here so that I can find out what else the LORD will tell me.”
chapters.zh: 现在我请你们今夜在这里住宿，等我得知耶和华还要对我说什么。

chapters.en: That night God came to Balaam and said, “Since these men have come to summon you, go with them, but do only what I tell you.”
chapters.zh: 当夜，神临到巴兰那里，说，这些人若来召你，你就起来同他们去，你只要遵行我对你所说的话。

chapters.en: Balaam got up in the morning, saddled his donkey and went with the Moabite officials.
chapters.zh: 巴兰早晨起来，备上驴，和摩押的使臣一同去了。

chapters.en: But God was very angry when he went, and the angel of the LORD stood in the road to oppose him. Balaam was riding on his donkey, and his two servants were with him.
chapters.zh: 神因他去就发了怒。耶和华的使者站在路上敌挡他。他骑着驴，有两个仆人跟随他。

chapters.en: When the donkey saw the angel of the LORD standing in the road with a drawn sword in his hand, it turned off the road into a field. Balaam beat it to get it back on the road.
chapters.zh: 驴看见耶和华的使者站在路上，手里有拔出来的刀，就从路上跨进田间，巴兰便打驴，要叫它回转上路。

chapters.en: Then the angel of the LORD stood in a narrow path through the vineyards, with walls on both sides.
chapters.zh: 耶和华的使者就站在葡萄园的窄路上。这边有墙，那边也有墙。

chapters.en: When the donkey saw the angel of the LORD, it pressed close to the wall, crushing Balaam’s foot against it. So he beat the donkey again.
chapters.zh: 驴看见耶和华的使者，就贴靠墙，将巴兰的脚挤伤了。巴兰又打驴。

chapters.en: Then the angel of the LORD moved on ahead and stood in a narrow place where there was no room to turn, either to the right or to the left.
chapters.zh: 耶和华的使者又往前去，站在狭窄之处，左右都没有转折的地方。

chapters.en: When the donkey saw the angel of the LORD, it lay down under Balaam, and he was angry and beat it with his staff.
chapters.zh: 驴看见耶和华的使者，就卧在巴兰底下，巴兰发怒，用杖打驴。

chapters.en: Then the LORD opened the donkey’s mouth, and it said to Balaam, “What have I done to you to make you beat me these three times?”
chapters.zh: 耶和华叫驴开口，对巴兰说，我向你行了什么，你竟打我这三次呢？

chapters.en: Balaam answered the donkey, “You have made a fool of me! If only I had a sword in my hand, I would kill you right now.”
chapters.zh: 巴兰对驴说，因为你戏弄我，我恨不能手中有刀，把你杀了。

chapters.en: The donkey said to Balaam, “Am I not your own donkey, which you have always ridden, to this day? Have I been in the habit of doing this to you?” “No,” he said.
chapters.zh: 驴对巴兰说，我不是你从小时直到今日所骑的驴吗？我素常向你这样行过吗？巴兰说，没有。

chapters.en: Then the LORD opened Balaam’s eyes, and he saw the angel of the LORD standing in the road with his sword drawn. So he bowed low and fell facedown.
chapters.zh: 当时，耶和华使巴兰的眼目明亮，他就看见耶和华的使者站在路上，手里有拔出来的刀，巴兰便低头俯伏在地。

chapters.en: The angel of the LORD asked him, “Why have you beaten your donkey these three times? I have come here to oppose you because your path is a reckless one before me.
chapters.zh: 耶和华的使者对他说，你为何这三次打你的驴呢？我出来敌挡你，因你所行的，在我面前偏僻。

chapters.en: The donkey saw me and turned away from me these three times. If it had not turned away, I would certainly have killed you by now, but I would have spared it.”
chapters.zh: 驴看见我就三次从我面前偏过去。驴若没有偏过去，我早把你杀了，留它存活。

chapters.en: Balaam said to the angel of the LORD, “I have sinned. I did not realize you were standing in the road to oppose me. Now if you are displeased, I will go back.”
chapters.zh: 巴兰对耶和华的使者说，我有罪了。我不知道你站在路上阻挡我。你若不喜欢我去，我就转回。

chapters.en: The angel of the LORD said to Balaam, “Go with the men, but speak only what I tell you.” So Balaam went with Balak’s officials.
chapters.zh: 耶和华的使者对巴兰说，你同这些人去吧。你只要说我对你说的话。于是巴兰同着巴勒的使臣去了。

chapters.en: When Balak heard that Balaam was coming, he went out to meet him at the Moabite town on the Arnon border, at the edge of his territory.
chapters.zh: 巴勒听见巴兰来了，就往摩押京城去迎接他。这城是在边界上，在亚嫩河旁。

chapters.en: Balak said to Balaam, “Did I not send you an urgent summons? Why didn’t you come to me? Am I really not able to reward you?”
chapters.zh: 巴勒对巴兰说，我不是急急地打发人到你那里去召你吗？你为何不到我这里来呢？我岂不能使你得尊荣吗？

chapters.en: “Well, I have come to you now,” Balaam replied. “But I can’t say whatever I please. I must speak only what God puts in my mouth.”
chapters.zh: 巴兰说，我已经到你这里来了。现在我岂能擅自说什么呢？神将什么话传给我，我就说什么。

chapters.en: Then Balaam went with Balak to Kiriath Huzoth.
chapters.zh: 巴兰和巴勒同行，来到基列胡琐。

chapters.en: Balak sacrificed cattle and sheep, and gave some to Balaam and the officials who were with him.
chapters.zh: 巴勒宰了（原文作献）牛羊，送给巴兰和陪伴的使臣。

chapters.en: The next morning Balak took Balaam up to Bamoth Baal, and from there he could see the outskirts of the Israelite camp.
chapters.zh: 到了早晨，巴勒领巴兰到巴力的高处。巴兰从那里观看以色列营的边界。

chapters.en: Balaam said, “Build me seven altars here, and prepare seven bulls and seven rams for me.”
chapters.zh: 巴兰对巴勒说，你在这里给我筑七座坛，为我预备七只公牛，七只公羊。

chapters.en: Balak did as Balaam said, and the two of them offered a bull and a ram on each altar.
chapters.zh: 巴勒照巴兰的话行了。巴勒和巴兰在每座坛上献一只公牛，一只公羊。

chapters.en: Then Balaam said to Balak, “Stay here beside your offering while I go aside. Perhaps the LORD will come to meet with me. Whatever he reveals to me I will tell you.” Then he went off to a barren height.
chapters.zh: 巴兰对巴勒说，你站在你的燔祭旁边，我且往前去，或者耶和华来迎见我。他指示我什么，我必告诉你。于是巴兰上一净光的高处。

chapters.en: God met with him, and Balaam said, “I have prepared seven altars, and on each altar I have offered a bull and a ram.”
chapters.zh: 神迎见巴兰。巴兰说，我预备了七座坛，在每座坛上献了一只公牛，一只公羊。

chapters.en: The LORD put a word in Balaam’s mouth and said, “Go back to Balak and give him this word.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华将话传给巴兰，又说，你回到巴勒那里，要如此如此说。

chapters.en: So he went back to him and found him standing beside his offering, with all the Moabite officials.
chapters.zh: 他就回到巴勒那里，见他同摩押的使臣都站在燔祭旁边。

chapters.en: Then Balaam spoke his message: “Balak brought me from Aram, the king of Moab from the eastern mountains. ‘Come,’ he said, ‘curse Jacob for me; come, denounce Israel.’
chapters.zh: 巴兰便题起诗歌说，巴勒引我出亚兰，摩押王引我出东山，说，来阿，为我咒诅雅各。来阿，怒骂以色列。

chapters.en: How can I curse those whom God has not cursed? How can I denounce those whom the LORD has not denounced?
chapters.zh: 神没有咒诅的，我焉能咒诅，耶和华没有怒骂的，我焉能怒骂，

chapters.en: From the rocky peaks I see them, from the heights I view them. I see a people who live apart and do not consider themselves one of the nations.
chapters.zh: 我从高峰看他，从小山望他。这是独居的民，不列在万民中。

chapters.en: Who can count the dust of Jacob or number even a fourth of Israel? Let me die the death of the righteous, and may my final end be like theirs!”
chapters.zh: 谁能数点雅各的尘土，谁能计算以色列的四分之一，我愿如义人之死而死。我愿如义人之终而终。

chapters.en: Balak said to Balaam, “What have you done to me? I brought you to curse my enemies, but you have done nothing but bless them!”
chapters.zh: 巴勒对巴兰说，你向我作的是什么事呢？我领你来咒诅我的仇敌，不料，你竟为他们祝福。

chapters.en: He answered, “Must I not speak what the LORD puts in my mouth?”
chapters.zh: 他回答说，耶和华传给我的话，我能不谨慎传说吗？

chapters.en: Then Balak said to him, “Come with me to another place where you can see them; you will not see them all but only the outskirts of their camp. And from there, curse them for me.”
chapters.zh: 巴勒说，求你同我往别处去，在那里可以看见他们。你不能全看见，只能看见他们边界上的人。在那里要为我咒诅他们。

chapters.en: So he took him to the field of Zophim on the top of Pisgah, and there he built seven altars and offered a bull and a ram on each altar.
chapters.zh: 于是领巴兰到了琐腓田，上了毗斯迦山顶，筑了七座坛。每座坛上献一只公牛，一只公羊。

chapters.en: Balaam said to Balak, “Stay here beside your offering while I meet with him over there.”
chapters.zh: 巴兰对巴勒说，你站在这燔祭旁边，等我往那边去迎见耶和华。

chapters.en: The LORD met with Balaam and put a word in his mouth and said, “Go back to Balak and give him this word.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华临到巴兰那里，将话传给他。又说，你回到巴勒那里，要如此如此说。

chapters.en: So he went to him and found him standing beside his offering, with the Moabite officials. Balak asked him, “What did the LORD say?”
chapters.zh: 他就回到巴勒那里，见他站在燔祭旁边。摩押的使臣也和他在一处。巴勒问他说，耶和华说了什么话呢？

chapters.en: Then he spoke his message: “Arise, Balak, and listen; hear me, son of Zippor.
chapters.zh: 巴兰就题诗歌说，巴勒，你起来听。西拨的儿子，你听我言。

chapters.en: God is not human, that he should lie, not a human being, that he should change his mind. Does he speak and then not act? Does he promise and not fulfill?
chapters.zh: 神非人，必不致说谎，也非人子，必不致后悔。他说话岂不照着行呢？他发言岂不要成就呢？

chapters.en: I have received a command to bless; he has blessed, and I cannot change it.
chapters.zh: 我奉命祝福。神也曾赐福，此事我不能翻转。

chapters.en: “No misfortune is seen in Jacob, no misery observed in Israel. The LORD their God is with them; the shout of the King is among them.
chapters.zh: 他未见雅各中有罪孽，也未见以色列中有奸恶。耶和华他的神和他同在。有欢呼王的声音在他们中间。

chapters.en: God brought them out of Egypt; they have the strength of a wild ox.
chapters.zh: 神领他们出埃及。他们似乎有野牛之力。

chapters.en: There is no divination against Jacob, no evil omens against Israel. It will now be said of Jacob and of Israel, ‘See what God has done!’
chapters.zh: 断没有法术可以害雅各，也没有占卜可以害以色列。现在必有人论及雅各，就是论及以色列说，神为他行了何等的大事。

chapters.en: The people rise like a lioness; they rouse themselves like a lion that does not rest till it devours its prey and drinks the blood of its victims.”
chapters.zh: 这民起来，仿佛母狮，挺身，好像公狮，未曾吃野食，未曾喝被伤者之血，决不躺卧。

chapters.en: Then Balak said to Balaam, “Neither curse them at all nor bless them at all!”
chapters.zh: 巴勒对巴兰说，你一点不要咒诅他们，也不要为他们祝福。

chapters.en: Balaam answered, “Did I not tell you I must do whatever the LORD says?”
chapters.zh: 巴兰回答巴勒说，我岂不是告诉你说凡耶和华所说的，我必须遵行吗？

chapters.en: Then Balak said to Balaam, “Come, let me take you to another place. Perhaps it will please God to let you curse them for me from there.”
chapters.zh: 巴勒对巴兰说，来吧，我领你往别处去，或者神喜欢你在那里为我咒诅他们。

chapters.en: And Balak took Balaam to the top of Peor, overlooking the wasteland.
chapters.zh: 巴勒就领巴兰到那下望旷野的毗珥山顶上。

chapters.en: Balaam said, “Build me seven altars here, and prepare seven bulls and seven rams for me.”
chapters.zh: 巴兰对巴勒说，你在这里为我筑七座坛，又在这里为我预备七只公牛，七只公羊。

chapters.en: Balak did as Balaam had said, and offered a bull and a ram on each altar.
chapters.zh: 巴勒就照巴兰的话行，在每座坛上献一只公牛，一只公羊。

chapters.en: Now when Balaam saw that it pleased the LORD to bless Israel, he did not resort to divination as at other times, but turned his face toward the wilderness.
chapters.zh: 巴兰见耶和华喜欢赐福与以色列，就不像前两次去求法术，却面向旷野。

chapters.en: When Balaam looked out and saw Israel encamped tribe by tribe, the Spirit of God came on him
chapters.zh: 巴兰举目，看见以色列人照着支派居住。神的灵就临到他身上，

chapters.en: and he spoke his message: “The prophecy of Balaam son of Beor, the prophecy of one whose eye sees clearly,
chapters.zh: 他便题起诗歌说，比珥的儿子巴兰说，眼目闭住（闭住或作睁开）的人说，

chapters.en: the prophecy of one who hears the words of God, who sees a vision from the Almighty,who falls prostrate, and whose eyes are opened:
chapters.zh: 得听神的言语，得见全能者的异象，眼目睁开而仆倒的人说，

chapters.en: “How beautiful are your tents, Jacob, your dwelling places, Israel!
chapters.zh: 雅各阿，你的帐棚何等华美。以色列阿，你的帐幕何其华丽。

chapters.en: “Like valleys they spread out, like gardens beside a river, like aloes planted by the LORD, like cedars beside the waters.
chapters.zh: 如接连的山谷，如河旁的园子，如耶和华所栽的沉香树，如水边的香柏木。

chapters.en: Water will flow from their buckets; their seed will have abundant water. “Their king will be greater than Agag; their kingdom will be exalted.
chapters.zh: 水要从他的桶里流出。种子要撒在多水之处。他的王必超过亚甲。他的国必要振兴。

chapters.en: “God brought them out of Egypt; they have the strength of a wild ox. They devour hostile nations and break their bones in pieces; with their arrows they pierce them.
chapters.zh: 神领他出埃及。他似乎有野牛之力。他要吞吃敌国，折断他们的骨头，用箭射透他们。

chapters.en: Like a lion they crouch and lie down, like a lioness—who dares to rouse them? “May those who bless you be blessed and those who curse you be cursed!”
chapters.zh: 他蹲如公狮，卧如母狮，谁敢惹他，凡给你祝福的，愿他蒙福。凡咒诅你的，愿他受咒诅。

chapters.en: Then Balak’s anger burned against Balaam. He struck his hands together and said to him, “I summoned you to curse my enemies, but you have blessed them these three times.
chapters.zh: 巴勒向巴兰生气，就拍起手来，对巴兰说，我召你来为我咒诅仇敌，不料，你这三次竟为他们祝福。

chapters.en: Now leave at once and go home! I said I would reward you handsomely, but the LORD has kept you from being rewarded.”
chapters.zh: 如今你快回本地去吧。我想使你得大尊荣，耶和华却阻止你不得尊荣。

chapters.en: Balaam answered Balak, “Did I not tell the messengers you sent me,
chapters.zh: 巴兰对巴勒说，我岂不是对你所差遣到我那里的使者说，

chapters.en: ‘Even if Balak gave me all the silver and gold in his palace, I could not do anything of my own accord, good or bad, to go beyond the command of the LORD—and I must say only what the LORD says’?
chapters.zh: 巴勒就是将他满屋的金银给我，我也不得越过耶和华的命，凭自己的心意行好行歹。耶和华说什么，我就要说什么，

chapters.en: Now I am going back to my people, but come, let me warn you of what this people will do to your people in days to come.”
chapters.zh: 现在我要回本族去。你来，我告诉你这民日后要怎样待你的民。

chapters.en: Then he spoke his message: “The prophecy of Balaam son of Beor, the prophecy of one whose eye sees clearly,
chapters.zh: 他就题起诗歌说，比珥的儿子巴兰说，眼目闭住（闭住或作睁开）的人说，

chapters.en: the prophecy of one who hears the words of God, who has knowledge from the Most High, who sees a vision from the Almighty, who falls prostrate, and whose eyes are opened:
chapters.zh: 得听神的言语，明白至高者的意旨，看见全能者的异象，眼目睁开而仆倒的人说，

chapters.en: “I see him, but not now; I behold him, but not near. A star will come out of Jacob; a scepter will rise out of Israel. He will crush the foreheads of Moab, the skulls of all the people of Sheth.
chapters.zh: 我看他却不在现时。我望他却不在近日。有星要出于雅各，有杖要兴于以色列，必打破摩押的四角，毁坏扰乱之子。

chapters.en: Edom will be conquered; Seir, his enemy, will be conquered, but Israel will grow strong.
chapters.zh: 他必得以东为基业，又得仇敌之地西珥为产业。以色列必行事勇敢。

chapters.en: A ruler will come out of Jacob and destroy the survivors of the city.”
chapters.zh: 有一位出于雅各的，必掌大权。他要除灭城中的余民。

chapters.en: Then Balaam saw Amalek and spoke his message: “Amalek was first among the nations, but their end will be utter destruction.”
chapters.zh: 巴兰观看亚玛力，就题起诗歌说，亚玛力原为诸国之首，但他终必沉沦。

chapters.en: Then he saw the Kenites and spoke his message: “Your dwelling place is secure, your nest is set in a rock;
chapters.zh: 巴兰观看基尼人，就题起诗歌说，你的住处本是坚固。你的窝巢作在岩穴中。

chapters.en: yet you Kenites will be destroyed when Ashur takes you captive.”
chapters.zh: 然而基尼必至衰微，直到亚述把你掳去。

chapters.en: Then he spoke his message: “Alas! Who can live when God does this?
chapters.zh: 巴兰又题起诗歌说，哀哉。神行这事，谁能得活，

chapters.en: Ships will come from the shores of Cyprus; they will subdue Ashur and Eber, but they too will come to ruin.”
chapters.zh: 必有人乘船从基提界而来，苦害亚述，苦害希伯。他也必至沉沦。

chapters.en: Then Balaam got up and returned home, and Balak went his own way.
chapters.zh: 于是巴兰起来，回他本地去。巴勒也回去了。

chapters.en: While Israel was staying in Shittim, the men began to indulge in sexual immorality with Moabite women,
chapters.zh: 以色列人住在什亭，百姓与摩押女子行起淫乱。

chapters.en: who invited them to the sacrifices to their gods. The people ate the sacrificial meal and bowed down before these gods.
chapters.zh: 因为这女子叫百姓来，一同给她们的神献祭，百姓就吃她们的祭物，跪拜她们的神。

chapters.en: So Israel yoked themselves to the Baal of Peor. And the LORD’s anger burned against them.
chapters.zh: 以色列人与巴力毗珥连合，耶和华的怒气就向以色列人发作。

chapters.en: The LORD said to Moses, “Take all the leaders of these people, kill them and expose them in broad daylight before the LORD, so that the LORD’s fierce anger may turn away from Israel.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华吩咐摩西说，将百姓中所有的族长在我面前对着日头悬挂，使我向以色列人所发的怒气可以消了。

chapters.en: So Moses said to Israel’s judges, “Each of you must put to death those of your people who have yoked themselves to the Baal of Peor.”
chapters.zh: 于是摩西吩咐以色列的审判官说，凡属你们的人，有与巴力毗珥连合的，你们各人要把他们杀了。

chapters.en: Then an Israelite man brought into the camp a Midianite woman right before the eyes of Moses and the whole assembly of Israel while they were weeping at the entrance to the tent of meeting.
chapters.zh: 摩西和以色列全会众正在会幕门前哭泣的时候，谁知，有以色列中的一个人，当他们眼前，带着一个米甸女人到他弟兄那里去。

chapters.en: When Phinehas son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron, the priest, saw this, he left the assembly, took a spear in his hand
chapters.zh: 祭司亚伦的孙子，以利亚撒的儿子非尼哈看见了，就从会中起来，手里拿着枪，

chapters.en: and followed the Israelite into the tent. He drove the spear into both of them, right through the Israelite man and into the woman’s stomach. Then the plague against the Israelites was stopped;
chapters.zh: 跟随那以色列人进亭子里去，便将以色列人和那女人由腹中刺透。这样，在以色列人中瘟疫就止息了。

chapters.en: but those who died in the plague numbered 24,000.
chapters.zh: 那时遭瘟疫死的，有二万四千人。

chapters.en: The LORD said to Moses,
chapters.zh: 耶和华晓谕摩西说，

chapters.en: “Phinehas son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron, the priest, has turned my anger away from the Israelites. Since he was as zealous for my honor among them as I am, I did not put an end to them in my zeal.
chapters.zh: 祭司亚伦的孙子，以利亚撒的儿子非尼哈，使我向以色列人所发的怒消了。因他在他们中间，以我的忌邪为心，使我不在忌邪中把他们除灭。

chapters.en: Therefore tell him I am making my covenant of peace with him.
chapters.zh: 因此，你要说，我将我平安的约赐给他。

chapters.en: He and his descendants will have a covenant of a lasting priesthood, because he was zealous for the honor of his God and made atonement for the Israelites.”
chapters.zh: 这约要给他和他的后裔，作为永远当祭司职任的约。因他为神，有忌邪的心，为以色列人赎罪。

chapters.en: The name of the Israelite who was killed with the Midianite woman was Zimri son of Salu, the leader of a Simeonite family.
chapters.zh: 那与米甸女人一同被杀的以色列人，名叫心利，是撒路的儿子，是西缅一个宗族的首领。

chapters.en: And the name of the Midianite woman who was put to death was Kozbi daughter of Zur, a tribal chief of a Midianite family.
chapters.zh: 那被杀的米甸女人，名叫哥斯比，是苏珥的女儿。这苏珥是米甸一个宗族的首领。

chapters.en: The LORD said to Moses,
chapters.zh: 耶和华晓谕摩西说，

chapters.en: “Treat the Midianites as enemies and kill them.
chapters.zh: 你要扰害米甸人，击杀他们。

chapters.en: They treated you as enemies when they deceived you in the Peor incident involving their sister Kozbi, the daughter of a Midianite leader, the woman who was killed when the plague came as a result of that incident.”
chapters.zh: 因为他们用诡计扰害你们，在毗珥的事上和他们的姊妹，米甸首领的女儿哥斯比的事上，用这诡计诱惑了你们。这哥斯比，当瘟疫流行的日子，因毗珥的事被杀了。

chapters.en: After the plague the LORD said to Moses and Eleazar son of Aaron, the priest,
chapters.zh: 瘟疫之后，耶和华晓谕摩西和祭司亚伦的儿子以利亚撒说，

chapters.en: “Take a census of the whole Israelite community by families—all those twenty years old or more who are able to serve in the army of Israel.”
chapters.zh: 你们要将以色列全会众，按他们的宗族，凡以色列中从二十岁以外，能出去打仗的，计算总数。

chapters.en: So on the plains of Moab by the Jordan across from Jericho, Moses and Eleazar the priest spoke with them and said,
chapters.zh: 摩西和祭司以利亚撒在摩押平原与耶利哥相对的约旦河边向以色列人说，

chapters.en: “Take a census of the men twenty years old or more, as the LORD commanded Moses.” These were the Israelites who came out of Egypt:
chapters.zh: 将你们中间从二十岁以外的计算总数。是照耶和华吩咐出埃及地的摩西和以色列人的话。

chapters.en: The descendants of Reuben, the firstborn son of Israel, were: through Hanok, the Hanokite clan; through Pallu, the Palluite clan;
chapters.zh: 以色列的长子是流便。流便的众子，属哈诺的，有哈诺族。属法路的，有法路族。

chapters.en: through Hezron, the Hezronite clan; through Karmi, the Karmite clan.
chapters.zh: 属希斯伦的，有希斯伦族。属迦米的，有迦米族。

chapters.en: These were the clans of Reuben; those numbered were 43,730.
chapters.zh: 这就是流便的各族。其中被数的，共有四万三千七百三十名。

chapters.en: The son of Pallu was Eliab,
chapters.zh: 法路的儿子是以利押。

chapters.en: and the sons of Eliab were Nemuel, Dathan and Abiram. The same Dathan and Abiram were the community officials who rebelled against Moses and Aaron and were among Korah’s followers when they rebelled against the LORD.
chapters.zh: 以利押的众子是尼母利，大坍，亚比兰。这大坍，亚比兰，就是从会中选召的，与可拉一党同向耶和华争闹的时候也向摩西，亚伦争闹。

chapters.en: The earth opened its mouth and swallowed them along with Korah, whose followers died when the fire devoured the 250 men. And they served as a warning sign.
chapters.zh: 地便开口吞了他们，和可拉，可拉的党类一同死亡。那时火烧灭了二百五十个人。他们就作了警戒。

chapters.en: The line of Korah, however, did not die out.
chapters.zh: 然而可拉的众子没有死亡。

chapters.en: The descendants of Simeon by their clans were: through Nemuel, the Nemuelite clan; through Jamin, the Jaminite clan; through Jakin, the Jakinite clan;
chapters.zh: 按着家族，西缅的众子，属尼母利的，有尼母利族。属雅悯的，有雅悯族。属雅斤的，有雅斤族。

chapters.en: through Zerah, the Zerahite clan; through Shaul, the Shaulite clan.
chapters.zh: 属谢拉的，有谢拉族。属扫罗的，有扫罗族。

chapters.en: These were the clans of Simeon; those numbered were 22,200.
chapters.zh: 这就是西缅的各族，共有二万二千二百名。

chapters.en: The descendants of Gad by their clans were: through Zephon, the Zephonite clan; through Haggi, the Haggite clan; through Shuni, the Shunite clan;
chapters.zh: 按着家族，迦得的众子，属洗分的，有洗分族。属哈基的，有哈基族。属书尼的，有书尼族。

chapters.en: through Ozni, the Oznite clan; through Eri, the Erite clan;
chapters.zh: 属阿斯尼的，有阿斯尼族。属以利的，有以利族。

chapters.en: through Arodi, the Arodite clan; through Areli, the Arelite clan.
chapters.zh: 属亚律的，有亚律族。属亚列利的，有亚列利族。

chapters.en: These were the clans of Gad; those numbered were 40,500.
chapters.zh: 这就是迦得子孙的各族，照他们中间被数的，共有四万零五百名。

chapters.en: Er and Onan were sons of Judah, but they died in Canaan.
chapters.zh: 犹大的儿子是珥和俄南。这珥和俄南死在迦南地。

chapters.en: The descendants of Judah by their clans were: through Shelah, the Shelanite clan; through Perez, the Perezite clan; through Zerah, the Zerahite clan.
chapters.zh: 按着家族，犹大其余的众子，属示拉的，有示拉族。属法勒斯的，有法勒斯族。属谢拉的有谢拉族。

chapters.en: The descendants of Perez were: through Hezron, the Hezronite clan; through Hamul, the Hamulite clan.
chapters.zh: 法勒斯的儿子，属希斯伦的，有希斯伦族。属哈母勒的，有哈母勒族。

chapters.en: These were the clans of Judah; those numbered were 76,500.
chapters.zh: 这就是犹大的各族，照他们中间被数的，共有七万六千五百名。

chapters.en: The descendants of Issachar by their clans were: through Tola, the Tolaite clan; through Puah, the Puite clan;
chapters.zh: 按着家族，以萨迦的众子，属陀拉的，有陀拉族。属普瓦的，有普瓦族。

chapters.en: through Jashub, the Jashubite clan; through Shimron, the Shimronite clan.
chapters.zh: 属雅述的，有雅述族。属伸仑的，有伸仑族。

chapters.en: These were the clans of Issachar; those numbered were 64,300.
chapters.zh: 这就是以萨迦的各族，照他们中间被数的，共有六万四千三百名。

chapters.en: The descendants of Zebulun by their clans were: through Sered, the Seredite clan; through Elon, the Elonite clan; through Jahleel, the Jahleelite clan.
chapters.zh: 按着家族，西布伦的众子，属西烈的，有西烈族。属以伦的，有以伦族。属雅利的，有雅利族。

chapters.en: These were the clans of Zebulun; those numbered were 60,500.
chapters.zh: 这就是西布伦的各族，照他们中间被数的，共有六万零五百名。

chapters.en: The descendants of Joseph by their clans through Manasseh and Ephraim were:
chapters.zh: 按着家族，约瑟的儿子有玛拿西，以法莲。

chapters.en: The descendants of Manasseh: through Makir, the Makirite clan (Makir was the father of Gilead); through Gilead, the Gileadite clan.
chapters.zh: 玛拿西的众子，属玛吉的，有玛吉族。玛吉生基列。属基列的，有基列族。

chapters.en: These were the descendants of Gilead: through Iezer, the Iezerite clan; through Helek, the Helekite clan;
chapters.zh: 基列的众子，属伊以谢的，有伊以谢族。属希勒的，有希勒族。

chapters.en: through Asriel, the Asrielite clan; through Shechem, the Shechemite clan;
chapters.zh: 属亚斯烈的，有亚斯烈族。属示剑的，有示剑族。

chapters.en: through Shemida, the Shemidaite clan; through Hepher, the Hepherite clan.
chapters.zh: 属示米大的，有示米大族。属希弗的，有希弗族。

chapters.en: (Zelophehad son of Hepher had no sons; he had only daughters, whose names were Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milkah and Tirzah.)
chapters.zh: 希弗的儿子，西罗非哈没儿子，只有女儿。西罗非哈女儿的名字就是玛拉，挪阿，曷拉，密迦，得撒。

chapters.en: These were the clans of Manasseh; those numbered were 52,700.
chapters.zh: 这就是玛拿西的各族。他们中间被数的，共有五万二千七百名。

chapters.en: These were the descendants of Ephraim by their clans: through Shuthelah, the Shuthelahite clan; through Beker, the Bekerite clan; through Tahan, the Tahanite clan.
chapters.zh: 按着家族，以法莲的众子，属书提拉的，有书提拉族。属比结的，有比结族。属他罕的，有他罕族。

chapters.en: These were the descendants of Shuthelah: through Eran, the Eranite clan.
chapters.zh: 书提拉的众子，属以兰的，有以兰族。

chapters.en: These were the clans of Ephraim; those numbered were 32,500. These were the descendants of Joseph by their clans.
chapters.zh: 这就是以法莲子孙的各族，照他们中间被数的，共有三万二千五百名。按着家族，这都是约瑟的子孙。

chapters.en: The descendants of Benjamin by their clans were: through Bela, the Belaite clan; through Ashbel, the Ashbelite clan; through Ahiram, the Ahiramite clan;
chapters.zh: 按着家族，便雅悯的众子，属比拉的，有比拉族。属亚实别的，有亚实别族。属亚希兰的，有亚希兰族。

chapters.en: through Shupham, the Shuphamite clan; through Hupham, the Huphamite clan.
chapters.zh: 属书反的，有书反族。属户反的，有户反族。

chapters.en: The descendants of Bela through Ard and Naaman were: through Ard, the Ardite clan; through Naaman, the Naamite clan.
chapters.zh: 比拉的众子是亚勒，乃幔。属亚勒的，有亚勒族。属乃幔的，有乃幔族。

chapters.en: These were the clans of Benjamin; those numbered were 45,600.
chapters.zh: 按着家族，这就是便雅悯的子孙，其中被数的，共有四万五千六百名。

chapters.en: These were the descendants of Dan by their clans: through Shuham, the Shuhamite clan. These were the clans of Dan:
chapters.zh: 按着家族，但的众子，属书含的，有书含族。按着家族，这就是但的各族。

chapters.en: All of them were Shuhamite clans; and those numbered were 64,400.
chapters.zh: 照其中被数的，书含所有的各族，共有六万四千四百名。

chapters.en: The descendants of Asher by their clans were: through Imnah, the Imnite clan; through Ishvi, the Ishvite clan; through Beriah, the Beriite clan;
chapters.zh: 按着家族，亚设的众子，属音拿的，有音拿族。属亦施韦的，有亦施韦族。属比利亚的，有比利亚族。

chapters.en: and through the descendants of Beriah: through Heber, the Heberite clan; through Malkiel, the Malkielite clan.
chapters.zh: 比利亚的众子，属希别的，有希别族。属玛结的，有玛结族。

chapters.en: (Asher had a daughter named Serah.)
chapters.zh: 亚设的女儿名叫西拉。

chapters.en: These were the clans of Asher; those numbered were 53,400.
chapters.zh: 这就是亚设子孙的各族，照他们中间被数的，共有五万三千四百名。

chapters.en: The descendants of Naphtali by their clans were: through Jahzeel, the Jahzeelite clan; through Guni, the Gunite clan;
chapters.zh: 按着家族，拿弗他利的众子，属雅薛的，有雅薛族。属沽尼的，有沽尼族。

chapters.en: through Jezer, the Jezerite clan; through Shillem, the Shillemite clan.
chapters.zh: 属耶色的，有耶色族。属示冷的，有示冷族。

chapters.en: These were the clans of Naphtali; those numbered were 45,400.
chapters.zh: 按着家族，这就是拿弗他利的各族。他们中间被数的，共有四万五千四百名。

chapters.en: The total number of the men of Israel was 601,730.
chapters.zh: 以色列人中被数的，共有六十万零一千七百三十名。

chapters.en: The LORD said to Moses,
chapters.zh: 耶和华晓谕摩西说，

chapters.en: “The land is to be allotted to them as an inheritance based on the number of names.
chapters.zh: 你要按着人名的数目将地分给这些人为业。

chapters.en: To a larger group give a larger inheritance, and to a smaller group a smaller one; each is to receive its inheritance according to the number of those listed.
chapters.zh: 人多的，你要把产业多分给他们。人少的，你要把产业少分给他们。要照被数的人数，把产业分给各人。

chapters.en: Be sure that the land is distributed by lot. What each group inherits will be according to the names for its ancestral tribe.
chapters.zh: 虽是这样，还要拈阄分地。他们要按着祖宗各支派的名字承受为业。

chapters.en: Each inheritance is to be distributed by lot among the larger and smaller groups.”
chapters.zh: 要按着所拈的阄，看人数多，人数少，把产业分给他们。

chapters.en: These were the Levites who were counted by their clans: through Gershon, the Gershonite clan; through Kohath, the Kohathite clan; through Merari, the Merarite clan.
chapters.zh: 利未人，按着他们的各族被数的，属革顺的，有革顺族。属哥辖的，有哥辖族。属米拉利的，有米拉利族。

chapters.en: These also were Levite clans: the Libnite clan, the Hebronite clan, the Mahlite clan, the Mushite clan, the Korahite clan. (Kohath was the forefather of Amram;
chapters.zh: 利未的各族有立尼族，希伯伦族，玛利族，母示族，可拉族。哥辖生暗兰。

chapters.en: the name of Amram’s wife was Jochebed, a descendant of Levi, who was born to the Levites in Egypt. To Amram she bore Aaron, Moses and their sister Miriam.
chapters.zh: 暗兰的妻名叫约基别，是利未女子，生在埃及。她给暗兰生了亚伦，摩西，并他们的姐姐米利暗。

chapters.en: Aaron was the father of Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.
chapters.zh: 亚伦生拿答，亚比户，以利亚撒，以他玛。

chapters.en: But Nadab and Abihu died when they made an offering before the LORD with unauthorized fire.)
chapters.zh: 拿答，亚比户在耶和华面前献凡火的时候就死了。

chapters.en: All the male Levites a month old or more numbered 23,000. They were not counted along with the other Israelites because they received no inheritance among them.
chapters.zh: 利未人中，凡一个月以外，被数的男丁，共有二万三千。他们本来没有数在以色列人中。因为在以色列人中，没有分给他们产业。

chapters.en: These are the ones counted by Moses and Eleazar the priest when they counted the Israelites on the plains of Moab by the Jordan across from Jericho.
chapters.zh: 这些就是被摩西和祭司以利亚撒所数的。他们在摩押平原与耶利哥相对的约旦河边数点以色列人。

chapters.en: Not one of them was among those counted by Moses and Aaron the priest when they counted the Israelites in the Desert of Sinai.
chapters.zh: 但被数的人中，没有一个是摩西和祭司亚伦从前在西乃的旷野所数的以色列人，

chapters.en: For the LORD had told those Israelites they would surely die in the wilderness, and not one of them was left except Caleb son of Jephunneh and Joshua son of Nun.
chapters.zh: 因为耶和华论到他们说，他们必要死在旷野。所以，除了耶孚尼的儿子迦勒和嫩的儿子约书亚以外，连一个人也没有存留。

chapters.en: The daughters of Zelophehad son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Makir, the son of Manasseh, belonged to the clans of Manasseh son of Joseph. The names of the daughters were Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milkah and Tirzah. They came forward
chapters.zh: 属约瑟的儿子玛拿西的各族，有玛拿西的玄孙，玛吉的曾孙，基列的孙子，希弗的儿子西罗非哈的女儿，名叫玛拉，挪阿，曷拉，密迦，得撒。她们前来，

chapters.en: and stood before Moses, Eleazar the priest, the leaders and the whole assembly at the entrance to the tent of meeting and said,
chapters.zh: 站在会幕门口，在摩西和祭司以利亚撒，并众首领与全会众面前，说，

chapters.en: “Our father died in the wilderness. He was not among Korah’s followers, who banded together against the LORD, but he died for his own sin and left no sons.
chapters.zh: 我们的父亲死在旷野。他不与可拉同党聚集攻击耶和华，是在自己罪中死的。他也没有儿子。

chapters.en: Why should our father’s name disappear from his clan because he had no son? Give us property among our father’s relatives.”
chapters.zh: 为什么因我们的父亲没有儿子就把他的名从他族中除掉呢？求你们在我们父亲的弟兄中分给我们产业。

chapters.en: So Moses brought their case before the LORD,
chapters.zh: 于是，摩西将她们的案件呈到耶和华面前。

chapters.en: and the LORD said to him,
chapters.zh: 耶和华晓谕摩西说，

chapters.en: “What Zelophehad’s daughters are saying is right. You must certainly give them property as an inheritance among their father’s relatives and give their father’s inheritance to them.
chapters.zh: 西罗非哈的女儿说得有理。你定要在她们父亲的弟兄中，把地分给她们为业。要将她们父亲的产业归给她们。

chapters.en: “Say to the Israelites, ‘If a man dies and leaves no son, give his inheritance to his daughter.
chapters.zh: 你也要晓谕以色列人说，人若死了没有儿子，就要把他的产业归给他的女儿。

chapters.en: If he has no daughter, give his inheritance to his brothers.
chapters.zh: 他若没有女儿，就要把他的产业给他的弟兄。

chapters.en: If he has no brothers, give his inheritance to his father’s brothers.
chapters.zh: 他若没有弟兄，就要把他的产业给他父亲的弟兄。

chapters.en: If his father had no brothers, give his inheritance to the nearest relative in his clan, that he may possess it. This is to have the force of law for the Israelites, as the LORD commanded Moses.’ ”
chapters.zh: 他父亲若没有弟兄，就要把他的产业给他族中最近的亲属，他便要得为业。这要作以色列人的律例典章，是照耶和华吩咐摩西的。

chapters.en: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Go up this mountain in the Abarim Range and see the land I have given the Israelites.
chapters.zh: 耶和华对摩西说，你上这亚巴琳山，观看我所赐给以色列人的地。

chapters.en: After you have seen it, you too will be gathered to your people, as your brother Aaron was,
chapters.zh: 看了以后，你也必归到你列祖（原文作本民）那里，象你哥哥亚伦一样。

chapters.en: for when the community rebelled at the waters in the Desert of Zin, both of you disobeyed my command to honor me as holy before their eyes.” (These were the waters of Meribah Kadesh, in the Desert of Zin.)
chapters.zh: 因为你们在寻的旷野，当会众争闹的时候，违背了我的命，没有在涌水之地，会众眼前尊我为圣。（这水就是寻的旷野加低斯米利巴水。）

chapters.en: Moses said to the LORD,
chapters.zh: 摩西对耶和华说，

chapters.en: “May the LORD, the God who gives breath to all living things, appoint someone over this community
chapters.zh: 愿耶和华万人之灵的神，立一个人治理会众，

chapters.en: to go out and come in before them, one who will lead them out and bring them in, so the LORD’s people will not be like sheep without a shepherd.”
chapters.zh: 可以在他们面前出入，也可以引导他们，免得耶和华的会众如同没有牧人的羊群一般。

chapters.en: So the LORD said to Moses, “Take Joshua son of Nun, a man in whom is the spirit of leadership, and lay your hand on him.
chapters.zh: 耶和华对摩西说，嫩的儿子约书亚，是心中有圣灵的，你将他领来按手在他头上，

chapters.en: Have him stand before Eleazar the priest and the entire assembly and commission him in their presence.
chapters.zh: 使他站在祭司以利亚撒和全会众面前，嘱咐他，

chapters.en: Give him some of your authority so the whole Israelite community will obey him.
chapters.zh: 又将你的尊荣给他几分，使以色列全会众都听从他。

chapters.en: He is to stand before Eleazar the priest, who will obtain decisions for him by inquiring of the Urim before the LORD. At his command he and the entire community of the Israelites will go out, and at his command they will come in.”
chapters.zh: 他要站在祭司以利亚撒面前。以利亚撒要凭乌陵的判断，在耶和华面前为他求问。他和以色列全会众都要遵以利亚撒的命出入。

chapters.en: Moses did as the LORD commanded him. He took Joshua and had him stand before Eleazar the priest and the whole assembly.
chapters.zh: 于是摩西照耶和华所吩咐的将约书亚领来，使他站在祭司以利亚撒和全会众面前。

chapters.en: Then he laid his hands on him and commissioned him, as the LORD instructed through Moses.
chapters.zh: 按手在他头上，嘱咐他，是照耶和华借摩西所说的话。

chapters.en: The LORD said to Moses,
chapters.zh: 耶和华晓谕摩西说，

chapters.en: “Give this command to the Israelites and say to them: ‘Make sure that you present to me at the appointed time my food offerings, as an aroma pleasing to me.’
chapters.zh: 你要吩咐以色列人说，献给我的供物，就是献给我作馨香火祭的食物，你们要按日期献给我。

chapters.en: Say to them: ‘This is the food offering you are to present to the LORD: two lambs a year old without defect, as a regular burnt offering each day.
chapters.zh: 又要对他们说，你们要献给耶和华的火祭，就是没有残疾，一岁的公羊羔，每日两只，作为常献的燔祭。

chapters.en: Offer one lamb in the morning and the other at twilight,
chapters.zh: 早晨要献一只，黄昏的时候要献一只。

chapters.en: together with a grain offering of a tenth of an ephah of the finest flour mixed with a quarter of a hin of oil from pressed olives.
chapters.zh: 又用细面伊法十分之一，并捣成的油一欣四分之一，调和作为素祭。

chapters.en: This is the regular burnt offering instituted at Mount Sinai as a pleasing aroma, a food offering presented to the LORD.
chapters.zh: 这是西乃山所命定为常献的燔祭，是献给耶和华为馨香的火祭。

chapters.en: The accompanying drink offering is to be a quarter of a hin of fermented drink with each lamb. Pour out the drink offering to the LORD at the sanctuary.
chapters.zh: 为这一只羊羔，要同献奠祭的酒一欣四分之一。在圣所中，你要将醇酒奉给耶和华为奠祭。

chapters.en: Offer the second lamb at twilight, along with the same kind of grain offering and drink offering that you offer in the morning. This is a food offering, an aroma pleasing to the LORD.
chapters.zh: 晚上，你要献那一只羊羔，必照早晨的素祭和同献的奠祭献上，作为馨香的火祭，献给耶和华。

chapters.en: “ ‘On the Sabbath day, make an offering of two lambs a year old without defect, together with its drink offering and a grain offering of two-tenths of an ephah of the finest flour mixed with olive oil.
chapters.zh: 当安息日，要献两只没有残疾，一岁的公羊羔，并用调油的细面伊法十分之二为素祭，又将同献的奠祭献上。

chapters.en: This is the burnt offering for every Sabbath, in addition to the regular burnt offering and its drink offering.
chapters.zh: 这是每安息日献的燔祭。那常献的燔祭和同献的奠祭在外。

chapters.en: “ ‘On the first of every month, present to the LORD a burnt offering of two young bulls, one ram and seven male lambs a year old, all without defect.
chapters.zh: 每月朔，你们要将两只公牛犊，一只公绵羊，七只没有残疾，一岁的公羊羔，献给耶和华为燔祭。

chapters.en: With each bull there is to be a grain offering of three-tenths of an ephah of the finest flour mixed with oil; with the ram, a grain offering of two-tenths of an ephah of the finest flour mixed with oil;
chapters.zh: 每只公牛要用调油的细面伊法十分之三作为素祭。那只公羊也用调油的细面伊法十分之二作为素祭。

chapters.en: and with each lamb, a grain offering of a tenth of an ephah of the finest flour mixed with oil. This is for a burnt offering, a pleasing aroma, a food offering presented to the LORD.
chapters.zh: 每只羊羔要用调油的细面伊法十分之一作为素祭和馨香的燔祭，是献给耶和华的火祭。

chapters.en: With each bull there is to be a drink offering of half a hin of wine; with the ram, a third of a hin ; and with each lamb, a quarter of a hin. This is the monthly burnt offering to be made at each new moon during the year.
chapters.zh: 一只公牛要奠酒半欣，一只公羊要奠酒一欣三分之一，一只羊羔也奠酒一欣四分之一。这是每月的燔祭，一年之中要月月如此。

chapters.en: Besides the regular burnt offering with its drink offering, one male goat is to be presented to the LORD as a sin offering.
chapters.zh: 又要将一只公山羊为赎罪祭，献给耶和华。要献在常献的燔祭和同献的奠祭以外。

chapters.en: “ ‘On the fourteenth day of the first month the LORD’s Passover is to be held.
chapters.zh: 正月十四日是耶和华的逾越节。

chapters.en: On the fifteenth day of this month there is to be a festival; for seven days eat bread made without yeast.
chapters.zh: 这月十五日是节期，要吃无酵饼七日。

chapters.en: On the first day hold a sacred assembly and do no regular work.
chapters.zh: 第一日当有圣会。什么劳碌的工都不可作。

chapters.en: Present to the LORD a food offering consisting of a burnt offering of two young bulls, one ram and seven male lambs a year old, all without defect.
chapters.zh: 当将公牛犊两只，公绵羊一只，一岁的公羊羔七只，都要没有残疾的，用火献给耶和华为燔祭。

chapters.en: With each bull offer a grain offering of three-tenths of an ephah of the finest flour mixed with oil; with the ram, two-tenths;
chapters.zh: 同献的素祭用调油的细面。为一只公牛要献伊法十分之三。为一只公羊要献伊法十分之二。

chapters.en: and with each of the seven lambs, one-tenth.
chapters.zh: 为那七只羊羔，每只要献伊法十分之一。

chapters.en: Include one male goat as a sin offering to make atonement for you.
chapters.zh: 并献一只公山羊作赎罪祭，为你们赎罪。

chapters.en: Offer these in addition to the regular morning burnt offering.
chapters.zh: 你们献这些，要在早晨常献的燔祭以外。

chapters.en: In this way present the food offering every day for seven days as an aroma pleasing to the LORD; it is to be offered in addition to the regular burnt offering and its drink offering.
chapters.zh: 一连七日，每日要照这例把馨香火祭的食物献给耶和华，是在常献的燔祭和同献的奠祭以外。

chapters.en: On the seventh day hold a sacred assembly and do no regular work.
chapters.zh: 第七日当有圣会，什么劳碌的工都不可作。

chapters.en: “ ‘On the day of firstfruits, when you present to the LORD an offering of new grain during the Festival of Weeks, hold a sacred assembly and do no regular work.
chapters.zh: 七七节庄稼初熟，你们献新素祭给耶和华的日子，当有圣会。什么劳碌的工都不可作。

chapters.en: Present a burnt offering of two young bulls, one ram and seven male lambs a year old as an aroma pleasing to the LORD.
chapters.zh: 只要将公牛犊两只，公绵羊一只，一岁的公羊羔七只，作为馨香的燔祭献给耶和华。

chapters.en: With each bull there is to be a grain offering of three-tenths of an ephah of the finest flour mixed with oil; with the ram, two-tenths;
chapters.zh: 同献的素祭用调油的细面。为每只公牛要献伊法十分之三。为一只公羊要献伊法十分之二。

chapters.en: and with each of the seven lambs, one-tenth.
chapters.zh: 为那七只羊羔，每只要献伊法十分之一。

chapters.en: Include one male goat to make atonement for you.
chapters.zh: 并献一只公山羊为你们赎罪。

chapters.en: Offer these together with their drink offerings, in addition to the regular burnt offering and its grain offering. Be sure the animals are without defect.
chapters.zh: 这些，你们要献在常献的燔祭和同献的素祭并同献的奠祭以外，都要没有残疾的。

chapters.en: “ ‘On the first day of the seventh month hold a sacred assembly and do no regular work. It is a day for you to sound the trumpets.
chapters.zh: 七月初一日，你们当有圣会。什么劳碌的工都不可作，是你们当守为吹角的日子。

chapters.en: As an aroma pleasing to the LORD, offer a burnt offering of one young bull, one ram and seven male lambs a year old, all without defect.
chapters.zh: 你们要将公牛犊一只，公绵羊一只，没有残疾，一岁的公羊羔七只，作为馨香的燔祭献给耶和华。

chapters.en: With the bull offer a grain offering of three-tenths of an ephah of the finest flour mixed with olive oil; with the ram, two-tenths ;
chapters.zh: 同献的素祭用调油的细面。为一只公牛要献伊法十分之三。为一只公羊要献伊法十分之二。

chapters.en: and with each of the seven lambs, one-tenth.
chapters.zh: 为那七只羊羔，每只要献伊法十分之一。

chapters.en: Include one male goat as a sin offering to make atonement for you.
chapters.zh: 又献一只公山羊作赎罪祭，为你们赎罪。

chapters.en: These are in addition to the monthly and daily burnt offerings with their grain offerings and drink offerings as specified. They are food offerings presented to the LORD, a pleasing aroma.
chapters.zh: 这些是在月朔的燔祭和同献的素祭，并常献的燔祭与同献的素祭，以及照例同献的奠祭以外，都作为馨香的火祭献给耶和华。

chapters.en: “ ‘On the tenth day of this seventh month hold a sacred assembly. You must deny yourselves and do no work.
chapters.zh: 七月初十日，你们当有圣会。要刻苦己心，什么工都不可作。

chapters.en: Present as an aroma pleasing to the LORD a burnt offering of one young bull, one ram and seven male lambs a year old, all without defect.
chapters.zh: 只要将公牛犊一只，公绵羊一只，一岁的公羊羔七只，都要没有残疾的，作为馨香的燔祭献给耶和华。

chapters.en: With the bull offer a grain offering of three-tenths of an ephah of the finest flour mixed with oil; with the ram, two-tenths;
chapters.zh: 同献的素祭用调油的细面，为一只公牛要献伊法十分之三。为一只公羊要献伊法十分之二。

chapters.en: and with each of the seven lambs, one-tenth.
chapters.zh: 为那七只羊羔，每只要献伊法十分之一。

chapters.en: Include one male goat as a sin offering, in addition to the sin offering for atonement and the regular burnt offering with its grain offering, and their drink offerings.
chapters.zh: 又献一只公山羊为赎罪祭。这是在赎罪祭和常献的燔祭，与同献的素祭并同献的奠祭以外。

chapters.en: “ ‘On the fifteenth day of the seventh month, hold a sacred assembly and do no regular work. Celebrate a festival to the LORD for seven days.
chapters.zh: 七月十五日，你们当有圣会。什么劳碌的工都不可作，要向耶和华守节七日。

chapters.en: Present as an aroma pleasing to the LORD a food offering consisting of a burnt offering of thirteen young bulls, two rams and fourteen male lambs a year old, all without defect.
chapters.zh: 又要将公牛犊十三只，公绵羊两只，一岁的公羊羔十四只，都要没有残疾的，用火献给耶和华为馨香的燔祭。

chapters.en: With each of the thirteen bulls offer a grain offering of three-tenths of an ephah of the finest flour mixed with oil; with each of the two rams, two-tenths;
chapters.zh: 同献的素祭用调油的细面。为那十三只公牛，每只要献伊法十分之三。为那两只公羊，每只要献伊法十分之二。

chapters.en: and with each of the fourteen lambs, one-tenth.
chapters.zh: 为那十四只羊羔，每只要献伊法十分之一。

chapters.en: Include one male goat as a sin offering, in addition to the regular burnt offering with its grain offering and drink offering.
chapters.zh: 并献一只公山羊为赎罪祭，这是在常献的燔祭和同献的素祭并同献的奠祭以外。

chapters.en: “ ‘On the second day offer twelve young bulls, two rams and fourteen male lambs a year old, all without defect.
chapters.zh: 第二日要献公牛犊十二只，公绵羊两只，没有残疾，一岁的公羊羔十四只。

chapters.en: With the bulls, rams and lambs, offer their grain offerings and drink offerings according to the number specified.
chapters.zh: 并为公牛，公羊，和羊羔，按数照例，献同献的素祭和同献的奠祭。

chapters.en: Include one male goat as a sin offering, in addition to the regular burnt offering with its grain offering, and their drink offerings.
chapters.zh: 又要献一只公山羊为赎罪祭。这是在常献的燔祭和同献的素祭并同献的奠祭以外。

chapters.en: “ ‘On the third day offer eleven bulls, two rams and fourteen male lambs a year old, all without defect.
chapters.zh: 第三日要献公牛十一只，公羊两只，没有残疾，一岁的公羊羔十四只。

chapters.en: With the bulls, rams and lambs, offer their grain offerings and drink offerings according to the number specified.
chapters.zh: 并为公牛，公羊，和羊羔，按数照例，献同献的素祭和同献的奠祭。

chapters.en: Include one male goat as a sin offering, in addition to the regular burnt offering with its grain offering and drink offering.
chapters.zh: 又要献一只公山羊为赎罪祭。这是在常献的燔祭和同献的素祭并同献的奠祭以外。

chapters.en: “ ‘On the fourth day offer ten bulls, two rams and fourteen male lambs a year old, all without defect.
chapters.zh: 第四日要献公牛十只，公羊两只，没有残疾，一岁的公羊羔十四只。

chapters.en: With the bulls, rams and lambs, offer their grain offerings and drink offerings according to the number specified.
chapters.zh: 并为公牛，公羊，和羊羔，按数照例，献同献的素祭和同献的奠祭。

chapters.en: Include one male goat as a sin offering, in addition to the regular burnt offering with its grain offering and drink offering.
chapters.zh: 又要献一只公山羊为赎罪祭。这是在常献的燔祭和同献的素祭并同献的奠祭以外。

chapters.en: “ ‘On the fifth day offer nine bulls, two rams and fourteen male lambs a year old, all without defect.
chapters.zh: 第五日要献公牛九只，公羊两只，没有残疾，一岁的公羊羔十四只。

chapters.en: With the bulls, rams and lambs, offer their grain offerings and drink offerings according to the number specified.
chapters.zh: 并为公牛，公羊，和羊羔，按数照例，献同献的素祭和同献的奠祭。

chapters.en: Include one male goat as a sin offering, in addition to the regular burnt offering with its grain offering and drink offering.
chapters.zh: 又要献一只公山羊为赎罪祭。这是在常献的燔祭和同献的素祭并同献的奠祭以外。

chapters.en: “ ‘On the sixth day offer eight bulls, two rams and fourteen male lambs a year old, all without defect.
chapters.zh: 第六日要献公牛八只，公羊两只，没有残疾，一岁的公羊羔十四只。

chapters.en: With the bulls, rams and lambs, offer their grain offerings and drink offerings according to the number specified.
chapters.zh: 并为公牛，公羊，和羊羔，按数照例，献同献的素祭和同献的奠祭。

chapters.en: Include one male goat as a sin offering, in addition to the regular burnt offering with its grain offering and drink offering.
chapters.zh: 又要献一只公山羊为赎罪祭。这是在常献的燔祭和同献的素祭并同献的奠祭以外。

chapters.en: “ ‘On the seventh day offer seven bulls, two rams and fourteen male lambs a year old, all without defect.
chapters.zh: 第七日要献公牛七只，公羊两只，没有残疾，一岁的公羊羔十四只。

chapters.en: With the bulls, rams and lambs, offer their grain offerings and drink offerings according to the number specified.
chapters.zh: 并为公牛，公羊，和羊羔，按数照例，献同献的素祭和同献的奠祭。

chapters.en: Include one male goat as a sin offering, in addition to the regular burnt offering with its grain offering and drink offering.
chapters.zh: 又要献一只公山羊为赎罪祭。这是在常献的燔祭和同献的素祭并同献的奠祭以外。

chapters.en: “ ‘On the eighth day hold a closing special assembly and do no regular work.
chapters.zh: 第八日你们当有严肃会。什么劳碌的工都不可作。

chapters.en: Present as an aroma pleasing to the LORD a food offering consisting of a burnt offering of one bull, one ram and seven male lambs a year old, all without defect.
chapters.zh: 只要将公牛一只，公羊一只，没有残疾，一岁的公羊羔七只作火祭，献给耶和华为馨香的燔祭。

chapters.en: With the bull, the ram and the lambs, offer their grain offerings and drink offerings according to the number specified.
chapters.zh: 并为公牛，公羊，和羊羔，按数照例，献同献的素祭和同献的奠祭。

chapters.en: Include one male goat as a sin offering, in addition to the regular burnt offering with its grain offering and drink offering.
chapters.zh: 又要献一只公山羊为赎罪祭。这是在常献的燔祭和同献的素祭并同献的奠祭以外。

chapters.en: “ ‘In addition to what you vow and your freewill offerings, offer these to the LORD at your appointed festivals: your burnt offerings, grain offerings, drink offerings and fellowship offerings.’ ”
chapters.zh: 这些祭要在你们的节期献给耶和华，都在所许的愿并甘心所献的以外，作为你们的燔祭，素祭，奠祭，和平安祭。

chapters.en: Moses told the Israelites all that the LORD commanded him.
chapters.zh: 于是，摩西照耶和华所吩咐他的一切话告诉以色列人。

chapters.en: Moses said to the heads of the tribes of Israel: “This is what the LORD commands:
chapters.zh: 摩西晓谕以色列各支派的首领说，耶和华所吩咐的乃是这样，

chapters.en: When a man makes a vow to the LORD or takes an oath to obligate himself by a pledge, he must not break his word but must do everything he said.
chapters.zh: 人若向耶和华许愿或起誓，要约束自己，就不可食言，必要按口中所出的一切话行。

chapters.en: “When a young woman still living in her father’s household makes a vow to the LORD or obligates herself by a pledge
chapters.zh: 女子年幼，还在父家的时候，若向耶和华许愿，要约束自己，

chapters.en: and her father hears about her vow or pledge but says nothing to her, then all her vows and every pledge by which she obligated herself will stand.
chapters.zh: 她父亲也听见她所许的愿并约束自己的话，却向她默默不言，她所许的愿并约束自己的话就都要为定。

chapters.en: But if her father forbids her when he hears about it, none of her vows or the pledges by which she obligated herself will stand; the LORD will release her because her father has forbidden her.
chapters.zh: 但她父亲听见的日子若不应承她所许的愿和约束自己的话，就都不得为定。耶和华也必赦免她，因为她父亲不应承。

chapters.en: “If she marries after she makes a vow or after her lips utter a rash promise by which she obligates herself
chapters.zh: 她若出了嫁，有愿在身，或是口中出了约束自己的冒失话，

chapters.en: and her husband hears about it but says nothing to her, then her vows or the pledges by which she obligated herself will stand.
chapters.zh: 她丈夫听见的日子，却向她默默不言，她所许的愿并约束自己的话就都要为定。

chapters.en: But if her husband forbids her when he hears about it, he nullifies the vow that obligates her or the rash promise by which she obligates herself, and the LORD will release her.
chapters.zh: 但她丈夫听见的日子，若不应承，就算废了她所许的愿和她出口约束自己的冒失话。耶和华也必赦免她。

chapters.en: “Any vow or obligation taken by a widow or divorced woman will be binding on her.
chapters.zh: 寡妇或是被休的妇人所许的愿，就是她约束自己的话，都要为定。

chapters.en: “If a woman living with her husband makes a vow or obligates herself by a pledge under oath
chapters.zh: 她若在丈夫家里许了愿或起了誓，约束自己，

chapters.en: and her husband hears about it but says nothing to her and does not forbid her, then all her vows or the pledges by which she obligated herself will stand.
chapters.zh: 丈夫听见，却向她默默不言，也没有不应承，她所许的愿并约束自己的话就都要为定。

chapters.en: But if her husband nullifies them when he hears about them, then none of the vows or pledges that came from her lips will stand. Her husband has nullified them, and the LORD will release her.
chapters.zh: 丈夫听见的日子，若把这两样全废了，妇人口中所许的愿或是约束自己的话就都不得为定，因她丈夫已经把这两样废了。耶和华也必赦免她。

chapters.en: Her husband may confirm or nullify any vow she makes or any sworn pledge to deny herself.
chapters.zh: 凡她所许的愿和刻苦约束自己所起的誓，她丈夫可以坚定，也可以废去。

chapters.en: But if her husband says nothing to her about it from day to day, then he confirms all her vows or the pledges binding on her. He confirms them by saying nothing to her when he hears about them.
chapters.zh: 倘若她丈夫天天向她默默不言，就算是坚定她所许的愿和约束自己的话。因丈夫听见的日子向她默默不言，就使这两样坚定。

chapters.en: If, however, he nullifies them some time after he hears about them, then he must bear the consequences of her wrongdoing.”
chapters.zh: 但她丈夫听见以后，若使这两样全废了，就要担当妇人的罪孽。

chapters.en: These are the regulations the LORD gave Moses concerning relationships between a man and his wife, and between a father and his young daughter still living at home.
chapters.zh: 这是丈夫待妻子，父亲待女儿，女儿年幼，还在父家，耶和华所吩咐摩西的律例。

chapters.en: The LORD said to Moses,
chapters.zh: 耶和华吩咐摩西说，

chapters.en: “Take vengeance on the Midianites for the Israelites. After that, you will be gathered to your people.”
chapters.zh: 你要在米甸人身上报以色列人的仇，后来要归到你列祖（原文作本民）那里。

chapters.en: So Moses said to the people, “Arm some of your men to go to war against the Midianites so that they may carry out the LORD’s vengeance on them.
chapters.zh: 摩西吩咐百姓说，要从你们中间叫人带兵器出去攻击米甸，好在米甸人身上为耶和华报仇。

chapters.en: Send into battle a thousand men from each of the tribes of Israel.”
chapters.zh: 从以色列众支派中，每支派要打发一千人去打仗。

chapters.en: So twelve thousand men armed for battle, a thousand from each tribe, were supplied from the clans of Israel.
chapters.zh: 于是从以色列千万人中，每支派交出一千人，共一万二千人，带着兵器预备打仗。

chapters.en: Moses sent them into battle, a thousand from each tribe, along with Phinehas son of Eleazar, the priest, who took with him articles from the sanctuary and the trumpets for signaling.
chapters.zh: 摩西就打发每支派的一千人去打仗，并打发祭司以利亚撒的儿子非尼哈同去。非尼哈手里拿着圣所的器皿和吹大声的号筒。

chapters.en: They fought against Midian, as the LORD commanded Moses, and killed every man.
chapters.zh: 他们就照耶和华所吩咐摩西的，与米甸人打仗，杀了所有的男丁。

chapters.en: Among their victims were Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur and Reba—the five kings of Midian. They also killed Balaam son of Beor with the sword.
chapters.zh: 在所杀的人中，杀了米甸的五王，就是以未，利金，苏珥，户珥，利巴，又用刀杀了比珥的儿子巴兰。

chapters.en: The Israelites captured the Midianite women and children and took all the Midianite herds, flocks and goods as plunder.
chapters.zh: 以色列人掳了米甸人的妇女孩子，并将他们的牲畜，羊群，和所有的财物都夺了来，当作掳物，

chapters.en: They burned all the towns where the Midianites had settled, as well as all their camps.
chapters.zh: 又用火焚烧他们所住的城邑和所有的营寨，

chapters.en: They took all the plunder and spoils, including the people and animals,
chapters.zh: 把一切所夺的，所掳的，连人带牲畜都带了去，

chapters.en: and brought the captives, spoils and plunder to Moses and Eleazar the priest and the Israelite assembly at their camp on the plains of Moab, by the Jordan across from Jericho.
chapters.zh: 将所掳的人，所夺的牲畜，财物，都带到摩押平原，在约旦河边与耶利哥相对的营盘，交给摩西和祭司以利亚撒，并以色列的会众。

chapters.en: Moses, Eleazar the priest and all the leaders of the community went to meet them outside the camp.
chapters.zh: 摩西和祭司以利亚撒，并会众一切的首领，都出到营外迎接他们。

chapters.en: Moses was angry with the officers of the army—the commanders of thousands and commanders of hundreds—who returned from the battle.
chapters.zh: 摩西向打仗回来的军长，就是千夫长，百夫长，发怒，

chapters.en: “Have you allowed all the women to live?” he asked them.
chapters.zh: 对他们说，你们要存留这一切妇女的活命吗？

chapters.en: “They were the ones who followed Balaam’s advice and enticed the Israelites to be unfaithful to the LORD in the Peor incident, so that a plague struck the LORD’s people.
chapters.zh: 这些妇女因巴兰的计谋，叫以色列人在毗珥的事上得罪耶和华，以致耶和华的会众遭遇瘟疫。

chapters.en: Now kill all the boys. And kill every woman who has slept with a man,
chapters.zh: 所以，你们要把一切的男孩和所有已嫁的女子都杀了。

chapters.en: but save for yourselves every girl who has never slept with a man.
chapters.zh: 但女孩子中，凡没有出嫁的，你们都可以存留她的活命。

chapters.en: “Anyone who has killed someone or touched someone who was killed must stay outside the camp seven days. On the third and seventh days you must purify yourselves and your captives.
chapters.zh: 你们要在营外驻扎七日。凡杀了人的，和一切摸了被杀的，并你们所掳来的人口，第三日，第七日，都要洁净自己，

chapters.en: Purify every garment as well as everything made of leather, goat hair or wood.”
chapters.zh: 也要因一切的衣服，皮物，山羊毛织的物，和各样的木器，洁净自己。

chapters.en: Then Eleazar the priest said to the soldiers who had gone into battle, “This is what is required by the law that the LORD gave Moses:
chapters.zh: 祭司以利亚撒对打仗回来的兵丁说，耶和华所吩咐摩西律法中的条例乃是这样，

chapters.en: Gold, silver, bronze, iron, tin, lead
chapters.zh: 金，银，铜，铁，锡，铅，

chapters.en: and anything else that can withstand fire must be put through the fire, and then it will be clean. But it must also be purified with the water of cleansing. And whatever cannot withstand fire must be put through that water.
chapters.zh: 凡能见火的，你们要叫它经火就为洁净，然而还要用除污秽的水洁净它。凡不能见火的，你们要叫它过水。

chapters.en: On the seventh day wash your clothes and you will be clean. Then you may come into the camp.”
chapters.zh: 第七日，你们要洗衣服，就为洁净，然后可以进营。

chapters.en: The LORD said to Moses,
chapters.zh: 耶和华晓谕摩西说，

chapters.en: “You and Eleazar the priest and the family heads of the community are to count all the people and animals that were captured.
chapters.zh: 你和祭司以利亚撒，并会众的各族长，要计算所掳来的人口和牲畜的总数。

chapters.en: Divide the spoils equally between the soldiers who took part in the battle and the rest of the community.
chapters.zh: 把所掳来的分作两半，一半归与出去打仗的精兵，一半归与全会众。

chapters.en: From the soldiers who fought in the battle, set apart as tribute for the LORD one out of every five hundred, whether people, cattle, donkeys or sheep.
chapters.zh: 又要从出去打仗所得的人口，牛，驴，羊群中，每五百取一，作为贡物奉给耶和华。

chapters.en: Take this tribute from their half share and give it to Eleazar the priest as the LORD’s part.
chapters.zh: 从他们一半之中，要取出来交给祭司以利亚撒，作为耶和华的举祭。

chapters.en: From the Israelites’ half, select one out of every fifty, whether people, cattle, donkeys, sheep or other animals. Give them to the Levites, who are responsible for the care of the LORD’s tabernacle.”
chapters.zh: 从以色列人的一半之中，就是从人口，牛，驴，羊群，各样牲畜中，每五十取一，交给看守耶和华帐幕的利未人。

chapters.en: So Moses and Eleazar the priest did as the LORD commanded Moses.
chapters.zh: 于是摩西和祭司以利亚撒照耶和华所吩咐摩西的行了。

chapters.en: The plunder remaining from the spoils that the soldiers took was 675,000 sheep,
chapters.zh: 除了兵丁所夺的财物以外，所掳来的，羊六十七万五千只。

chapters.en: 72,000 cattle,
chapters.zh: 牛七万二千只。

chapters.en: 61,000 donkeys
chapters.zh: 驴六万一千匹。

chapters.en: and 32,000 women who had never slept with a man.
chapters.zh: 女人共三万二千口，都是没有出嫁的。

chapters.en: The half share of those who fought in the battle was: 337,500 sheep,
chapters.zh: 出去打仗之人的分，就是他们所得的那一半，共计羊三十三万七千五百只，

chapters.en: of which the tribute for the LORD was 675;
chapters.zh: 从其中归耶和华为贡物的，有六百七十五只。

chapters.en: 36,000 cattle, of which the tribute for the LORD was 72;
chapters.zh: 牛三万六千只，从其中归耶和华为贡物的，有七十二只。

chapters.en: 30,500 donkeys, of which the tribute for the LORD was 61;
chapters.zh: 驴三万零五百匹，从其中归耶和华为贡物的，有六十一匹。

chapters.en: 16,000 people, of whom the tribute for the LORD was 32.
chapters.zh: 人一万六千口，从其中归耶和华的，有三十二口。

chapters.en: Moses gave the tribute to Eleazar the priest as the LORD’s part, as the LORD commanded Moses.
chapters.zh: 摩西把贡物，就是归与耶和华的举祭，交给祭司以利亚撒，是照耶和华所吩咐摩西的。

chapters.en: The half belonging to the Israelites, which Moses set apart from that of the fighting men—
chapters.zh: 以色列人所得的那一半，就是摩西从打仗的人取来分给他们的。

chapters.en: the community’s half—was 337,500 sheep,
chapters.zh: （会众的那一半有，羊三十三万七千五百只。

chapters.en: 36,000 cattle,
chapters.zh: 牛三万六千只。

chapters.en: 30,500 donkeys
chapters.zh: 驴三万零五百匹。

chapters.en: and 16,000 people.
chapters.zh: 人一万六千口。）

chapters.en: From the Israelites’ half, Moses selected one out of every fifty people and animals, as the LORD commanded him, and gave them to the Levites, who were responsible for the care of the LORD’s tabernacle.
chapters.zh: 无论是人口是牲畜，摩西每五十取一，交给看守耶和华帐幕的利未人，是照耶和华所吩咐摩西的。

chapters.en: Then the officers who were over the units of the army—the commanders of thousands and commanders of hundreds—went to Moses
chapters.zh: 带领千军的各军长，就是千夫长，百夫长，都近前来见摩西，

chapters.en: and said to him, “Your servants have counted the soldiers under our command, and not one is missing.
chapters.zh: 对他说，仆人权下的兵已经计算总数，并不短少一人。

chapters.en: So we have brought as an offering to the LORD the gold articles each of us acquired—armlets, bracelets, signet rings, earrings and necklaces—to make atonement for ourselves before the LORD.”
chapters.zh: 如今我们将各人所得的金器，就是脚链子，镯子，打印的戒指，耳环，手钏，都送来为耶和华的供物，好在耶和华面前为我们的生命赎罪。

chapters.en: Moses and Eleazar the priest accepted from them the gold—all the crafted articles.
chapters.zh: 摩西和祭司以利亚撒就收了他们的金子，都是打成的器皿。

chapters.en: All the gold from the commanders of thousands and commanders of hundreds that Moses and Eleazar presented as a gift to the LORD weighed 16,750 shekels.
chapters.zh: 千夫长，百夫长所献给耶和华为举祭的金子共有一万六千七百五十舍客勒。

chapters.en: Each soldier had taken plunder for himself.
chapters.zh: 各兵丁都为自己夺了财物。

chapters.en: Moses and Eleazar the priest accepted the gold from the commanders of thousands and commanders of hundreds and brought it into the tent of meeting as a memorial for the Israelites before the LORD.
chapters.zh: 摩西和祭司以利亚撒收了千夫长，百夫长的金子，就带进会幕，在耶和华面前作为以色列人的纪念。

chapters.en: The Reubenites and Gadites, who had very large herds and flocks, saw that the lands of Jazer and Gilead were suitable for livestock.
chapters.zh: 流便子孙和迦得子孙的牲畜极其众多。他们看见雅谢地和基列地是可牧放牲畜之地，

chapters.en: So they came to Moses and Eleazar the priest and to the leaders of the community, and said,
chapters.zh: 就来见摩西和祭司以利亚撒，并会众的首领，说，

chapters.en: “Ataroth, Dibon, Jazer, Nimrah, Heshbon, Elealeh, Sebam, Nebo and Beon—
chapters.zh: 亚大录，底本，雅谢，宁拉，希实本，以利亚利，示班，尼波，比稳，

chapters.en: the land the LORD subdued before the people of Israel—are suitable for livestock, and your servants have livestock.
chapters.zh: 就是耶和华在以色列会众前面所攻取之地，是可牧放牲畜之地，你仆人也有牲畜。

chapters.en: If we have found favor in your eyes,” they said, “let this land be given to your servants as our possession. Do not make us cross the Jordan.”
chapters.zh: 又说，我们若在你眼前蒙恩，求你把这地给我们为业，不要领我们过约旦河。

chapters.en: Moses said to the Gadites and Reubenites, “Should your fellow Israelites go to war while you sit here?
chapters.zh: 摩西对迦得子孙和流便子孙说，难道你们的弟兄去打仗，你们竟坐在这里吗？

chapters.en: Why do you discourage the Israelites from crossing over into the land the LORD has given them?
chapters.zh: 你们为何使以色列人灰心丧胆，不过去进入耶和华所赐给他们的那地呢？

chapters.en: This is what your fathers did when I sent them from Kadesh Barnea to look over the land.
chapters.zh: 我先前从加低斯巴尼亚打发你们先祖去窥探那地，他们也是这样行。

chapters.en: After they went up to the Valley of Eshkol and viewed the land, they discouraged the Israelites from entering the land the LORD had given them.
chapters.zh: 他们上以实各谷，去窥探那地回来的时候，使以色列人灰心丧胆，不进入耶和华所赐给他们的地。

chapters.en: The LORD’s anger was aroused that day and he swore this oath:
chapters.zh: 当日，耶和华的怒气发作，就起誓说，

chapters.en: ‘Because they have not followed me wholeheartedly, not one of those who were twenty years old or more when they came up out of Egypt will see the land I promised on oath to Abraham, Isaac and Jacob—
chapters.zh: 凡从埃及上来，二十岁以外的人断不得看见我对亚伯拉罕，以撒，雅各起誓应许之地，因为他们没有专心跟从我。

chapters.en: not one except Caleb son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite and Joshua son of Nun, for they followed the LORD wholeheartedly.’
chapters.zh: 惟有基尼洗族耶孚尼的儿子迦勒和嫩的儿子约书亚可以看见，因为他们专心跟从我。

chapters.en: The LORD’s anger burned against Israel and he made them wander in the wilderness forty years, until the whole generation of those who had done evil in his sight was gone.
chapters.zh: 耶和华的怒气向以色列人发作，使他们在旷野飘流四十年，等到在耶和华眼前行恶的那一代人都消灭了。

chapters.en: “And here you are, a brood of sinners, standing in the place of your fathers and making the LORD even more angry with Israel.
chapters.zh: 谁知，你们起来接续先祖，增添罪人的数目，使耶和华向以色列大发烈怒。

chapters.en: If you turn away from following him, he will again leave all this people in the wilderness, and you will be the cause of their destruction.”
chapters.zh: 你们若退后不跟从他，他还要把以色列人撇在旷野，便是你们使这众民灭亡。

chapters.en: Then they came up to him and said, “We would like to build pens here for our livestock and cities for our women and children.
chapters.zh: 两支派的人挨近摩西，说，我们要在这里为牲畜垒圈，为妇人孩子造城。

chapters.en: But we will arm ourselves for battle and go ahead of the Israelites until we have brought them to their place. Meanwhile our women and children will live in fortified cities, for protection from the inhabitants of the land.
chapters.zh: 我们自己要带兵器行在以色列人的前头，好把他们领到他们的地方。但我们的妇人孩子，因这地居民的缘故，要住在坚固的城内。

chapters.en: We will not return to our homes until each of the Israelites has received their inheritance.
chapters.zh: 我们不回家，直等到以色列人各承受自己的产业。

chapters.en: We will not receive any inheritance with them on the other side of the Jordan, because our inheritance has come to us on the east side of the Jordan.”
chapters.zh: 我们不和他们在约旦河那边一带之地同受产业，因为我们的产业是坐落在约旦河东边这里。

chapters.en: Then Moses said to them, “If you will do this—if you will arm yourselves before the LORD for battle
chapters.zh: 摩西对他们说，你们若这样行，在耶和华面前带着兵器出去打仗，

chapters.en: and if all of you who are armed cross over the Jordan before the LORD until he has driven his enemies out before him—
chapters.zh: 所有带兵器的人都要在耶和华面前过约旦河，等他赶出他的仇敌，

chapters.en: then when the land is subdued before the LORD, you may return and be free from your obligation to the LORD and to Israel. And this land will be your possession before the LORD.
chapters.zh: 那地被耶和华制伏了，然后你们可以回来，向耶和华和以色列才为无罪，这地也必在耶和华面前归你们为业。

chapters.en: “But if you fail to do this, you will be sinning against the LORD; and you may be sure that your sin will find you out.
chapters.zh: 倘若你们不这样行，就得罪耶和华，要知道你们的罪必追上你们。

chapters.en: Build cities for your women and children, and pens for your flocks, but do what you have promised.”
chapters.zh: 如今你们口中所出的，只管去行，为你们的妇人孩子造城，为你们的羊群垒圈。

chapters.en: The Gadites and Reubenites said to Moses, “We your servants will do as our lord commands.
chapters.zh: 迦得子孙和流便子孙对摩西说，仆人要照我主所吩咐的去行。

chapters.en: Our children and wives, our flocks and herds will remain here in the cities of Gilead.
chapters.zh: 我们的妻子，孩子，羊群，和所有的牲畜都要留在基列的各城。

chapters.en: But your servants, every man who is armed for battle, will cross over to fight before the LORD, just as our lord says.”
chapters.zh: 但你的仆人，凡带兵器的，都要照我主所说的话，在耶和华面前过去打仗。

chapters.en: Then Moses gave orders about them to Eleazar the priest and Joshua son of Nun and to the family heads of the Israelite tribes.
chapters.zh: 于是，摩西为他们嘱咐祭司以利亚撒和嫩的儿子约书亚，并以色列众支派的族长，

chapters.en: He said to them, “If the Gadites and Reubenites, every man armed for battle, cross over the Jordan with you before the LORD, then when the land is subdued before you, you must give them the land of Gilead as their possession.
chapters.zh: 说，迦得子孙和流便子孙，凡带兵器在耶和华面前去打仗的，若与你们一同过约旦河，那地被你们制伏了，你们就要把基列地给他们为业。

chapters.en: But if they do not cross over with you armed, they must accept their possession with you in Canaan.”
chapters.zh: 倘若他们不带兵器和你们一同过去，就要在迦南地你们中间得产业。

chapters.en: The Gadites and Reubenites answered, “Your servants will do what the LORD has said.
chapters.zh: 迦得子孙和流便子孙回答说，耶和华怎样吩咐仆人，仆人就怎样行。

chapters.en: We will cross over before the LORD into Canaan armed, but the property we inherit will be on this side of the Jordan.”
chapters.zh: 我们要带兵器，在耶和华面前过去，进入迦南地，只是约旦河这边，我们所得为业之地仍归我们。

chapters.en: Then Moses gave to the Gadites, the Reubenites and the half-tribe of Manasseh son of Joseph the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites and the kingdom of Og king of Bashan—the whole land with its cities and the territory around them.
chapters.zh: 摩西将亚摩利王西宏的国和巴珊王噩的国，连那地和周围的城邑，都给了迦得子孙和流便子孙，并约瑟的儿子玛拿西半个支派。

chapters.en: The Gadites built up Dibon, Ataroth, Aroer,
chapters.zh: 迦得子孙建造底本，亚他录，亚罗珥，

chapters.en: Atroth Shophan, Jazer, Jogbehah,
chapters.zh: 亚他录朔反，雅谢，约比哈，

chapters.en: Beth Nimrah and Beth Haran as fortified cities, and built pens for their flocks.
chapters.zh: 伯宁拉，伯哈兰，都是坚固城。他们又垒羊圈。

chapters.en: And the Reubenites rebuilt Heshbon, Elealeh and Kiriathaim,
chapters.zh: 流便子孙建造希实本，以利亚利，基列亭，

chapters.en: as well as Nebo and Baal Meon (these names were changed) and Sibmah. They gave names to the cities they rebuilt.
chapters.zh: 尼波，巴力免，西比玛（尼波，巴力免，名字是改了的），又给他们所建造的城另起别名。

chapters.en: The descendants of Makir son of Manasseh went to Gilead, captured it and drove out the Amorites who were there.
chapters.zh: 玛拿西的儿子玛吉，他的子孙往基列去，占了那地，赶出那里的亚摩利人。

chapters.en: So Moses gave Gilead to the Makirites, the descendants of Manasseh, and they settled there.
chapters.zh: 摩西将基列赐给玛拿西的儿子玛吉，他子孙就住在那里。

chapters.en: Jair, a descendant of Manasseh, captured their settlements and called them Havvoth Jair.
chapters.zh: 玛拿西的子孙睚珥去占了基列的村庄，就称这些村庄为哈倭特睚珥。

chapters.en: And Nobah captured Kenath and its surrounding settlements and called it Nobah after himself.
chapters.zh: 挪巴去占了基纳和基纳的乡村，就按自己的名称基纳为挪巴。

chapters.en: Here are the stages in the journey of the Israelites when they came out of Egypt by divisions under the leadership of Moses and Aaron.
chapters.zh: 以色列人按着军队，在摩西，亚伦的手下出埃及地所行的路程（或作站口下同）记在下面。

chapters.en: At the LORD’s command Moses recorded the stages in their journey. This is their journey by stages:
chapters.zh: 摩西遵着耶和华的吩咐记载他们所行的路程，其路程乃是这样，

chapters.en: The Israelites set out from Rameses on the fifteenth day of the first month, the day after the Passover. They marched out defiantly in full view of all the Egyptians,
chapters.zh: 正月十五日，就是逾越节的次日，以色列人从兰塞起行，在一切埃及人眼前昂然无惧地出去。

chapters.en: who were burying all their firstborn, whom the LORD had struck down among them; for the LORD had brought judgment on their gods.
chapters.zh: 那时，埃及人正葬埋他们的长子，就是耶和华在他们中间所击杀的。耶和华也败坏他们的神。

chapters.en: The Israelites left Rameses and camped at Sukkoth.
chapters.zh: 以色列人从兰塞起行，安营在疏割。

chapters.en: They left Sukkoth and camped at Etham, on the edge of the desert.
chapters.zh: 从疏割起行，安营在旷野边的以倘。

chapters.en: They left Etham, turned back to Pi Hahiroth, to the east of Baal Zephon, and camped near Migdol.
chapters.zh: 从以倘起行，转到比哈希录，是在巴力洗分对面，就在密夺安营。

chapters.en: They left Pi Hahiroth and passed through the sea into the desert, and when they had traveled for three days in the Desert of Etham, they camped at Marah.
chapters.zh: 从比哈希录对面起行，经过海中到了书珥旷野，又在伊坦的旷野走了三天的路程，就安营在玛拉。

chapters.en: They left Marah and went to Elim, where there were twelve springs and seventy palm trees, and they camped there.
chapters.zh: 从玛拉起行，来到以琳（以琳有十二股水泉，七十棵棕树），就在那里安营。

chapters.en: They left Elim and camped by the Red Sea.
chapters.zh: 从以琳起行，安营在红海边。

chapters.en: They left the Red Sea and camped in the Desert of Sin.
chapters.zh: 从红海边起行，安营在汛的旷野。

chapters.en: They left the Desert of Sin and camped at Dophkah.
chapters.zh: 从汛的旷野起行，安营在脱加。

chapters.en: They left Dophkah and camped at Alush.
chapters.zh: 从脱加起行，安营在亚录。

chapters.en: They left Alush and camped at Rephidim, where there was no water for the people to drink.
chapters.zh: 从亚录起行，安营在利非订。在那里，百姓没有水喝。

chapters.en: They left Rephidim and camped in the Desert of Sinai.
chapters.zh: 从利非订起行，安营在西乃的旷野。

chapters.en: They left the Desert of Sinai and camped at Kibroth Hattaavah.
chapters.zh: 从西乃的旷野起行，安营在基博罗哈他瓦。

chapters.en: They left Kibroth Hattaavah and camped at Hazeroth.
chapters.zh: 从基博罗哈他瓦起行，安营在哈洗录。

chapters.en: They left Hazeroth and camped at Rithmah.
chapters.zh: 从哈洗录起行，安营在利提玛。

chapters.en: They left Rithmah and camped at Rimmon Perez.
chapters.zh: 从利提玛起行，安营在临门帕烈。

chapters.en: They left Rimmon Perez and camped at Libnah.
chapters.zh: 从临门帕烈起行，安营在立拿。

chapters.en: They left Libnah and camped at Rissah.
chapters.zh: 从立拿起行，安营在勒撒。

chapters.en: They left Rissah and camped at Kehelathah.
chapters.zh: 从勒撒起行，安营在基希拉他。

chapters.en: They left Kehelathah and camped at Mount Shepher.
chapters.zh: 从基希拉他起行，安营在沙斐山。

chapters.en: They left Mount Shepher and camped at Haradah.
chapters.zh: 从沙斐山起行，安营在哈拉大。

chapters.en: They left Haradah and camped at Makheloth.
chapters.zh: 从哈拉大起行，安营在玛吉希录。

chapters.en: They left Makheloth and camped at Tahath.
chapters.zh: 从玛吉希录起行，安营在他哈。

chapters.en: They left Tahath and camped at Terah.
chapters.zh: 从他哈起行，安营在他拉。

chapters.en: They left Terah and camped at Mithkah.
chapters.zh: 从他拉起行，安营在密加。

chapters.en: They left Mithkah and camped at Hashmonah.
chapters.zh: 从密加起行，安营在哈摩拿。

chapters.en: They left Hashmonah and camped at Moseroth.
chapters.zh: 从哈摩拿起行，安营在摩西录。

chapters.en: They left Moseroth and camped at Bene Jaakan.
chapters.zh: 从摩西录起行，安营在比尼亚干。

chapters.en: They left Bene Jaakan and camped at Hor Haggidgad.
chapters.zh: 从比尼亚干起行，安营在曷哈及甲。

chapters.en: They left Hor Haggidgad and camped at Jotbathah.
chapters.zh: 从曷哈及甲起行，安营在约巴他。

chapters.en: They left Jotbathah and camped at Abronah.
chapters.zh: 从约巴他起行，安营在阿博拿。

chapters.en: They left Abronah and camped at Ezion Geber.
chapters.zh: 从阿博拿起行，安营在以旬迦别。

chapters.en: They left Ezion Geber and camped at Kadesh, in the Desert of Zin.
chapters.zh: 从以旬迦别起行，安营在寻的旷野，就是加低斯。

chapters.en: They left Kadesh and camped at Mount Hor, on the border of Edom.
chapters.zh: 从加低斯起行，安营在何珥山，以东地的边界。

chapters.en: At the LORD’s command Aaron the priest went up Mount Hor, where he died on the first day of the fifth month of the fortieth year after the Israelites came out of Egypt.
chapters.zh: 以色列人出了埃及地后四十年，五月初一日，祭司亚伦遵着耶和华的吩咐上何珥山，就死在那里。

chapters.en: Aaron was a hundred and twenty-three years old when he died on Mount Hor.
chapters.zh: 亚伦死在何珥山的时候年一百二十三岁。

chapters.en: The Canaanite king of Arad, who lived in the Negev of Canaan, heard that the Israelites were coming.
chapters.zh: 住在迦南南地的迦南人亚拉得王听说以色列人来了。

chapters.en: They left Mount Hor and camped at Zalmonah.
chapters.zh: 以色列人从何珥山起行，安营在撒摩拿。

chapters.en: They left Zalmonah and camped at Punon.
chapters.zh: 从撒摩拿起行，安营在普嫩。

chapters.en: They left Punon and camped at Oboth.
chapters.zh: 从普嫩起行，安营在阿伯。

chapters.en: They left Oboth and camped at Iye Abarim, on the border of Moab.
chapters.zh: 从阿伯起行，安营在以耶亚巴琳，摩押的边界。

chapters.en: They left Iye Abarim and camped at Dibon Gad.
chapters.zh: 从以耶亚巴琳起行，安营在底本迦得。

chapters.en: They left Dibon Gad and camped at Almon Diblathaim.
chapters.zh: 从底本迦得起行，安营在亚门低比拉太音。

chapters.en: They left Almon Diblathaim and camped in the mountains of Abarim, near Nebo.
chapters.zh: 从亚门低比拉太音起行，安营在尼波对面的亚巴琳山里。

chapters.en: They left the mountains of Abarim and camped on the plains of Moab by the Jordan across from Jericho.
chapters.zh: 从亚巴琳山起行，安营在摩押平原约旦河边，耶利哥对面。

chapters.en: There on the plains of Moab they camped along the Jordan from Beth Jeshimoth to Abel Shittim.
chapters.zh: 他们在摩押平原沿约旦河边安营，从伯耶施末直到亚伯什亭。

chapters.en: On the plains of Moab by the Jordan across from Jericho the LORD said to Moses,
chapters.zh: 耶和华在摩押平原约旦河边，耶利哥对面晓谕摩西说，

chapters.en: “Speak to the Israelites and say to them: ‘When you cross the Jordan into Canaan,
chapters.zh: 你吩咐以色列人说，你们过约旦河进迦南地的时候，

chapters.en: drive out all the inhabitants of the land before you. Destroy all their carved images and their cast idols, and demolish all their high places.
chapters.zh: 就要从你们面前赶出那里所有的居民，毁灭他们一切錾成的石像和他们一切铸成的偶像，又拆毁他们一切的丘坛。

chapters.en: Take possession of the land and settle in it, for I have given you the land to possess.
chapters.zh: 你们要夺那地，住在其中，因我把那地赐给你们为业。

chapters.en: Distribute the land by lot, according to your clans. To a larger group give a larger inheritance, and to a smaller group a smaller one. Whatever falls to them by lot will be theirs. Distribute it according to your ancestral tribes.
chapters.zh: 你们要按家室拈阄，承受那地。人多的，要把产业多分给他们。人少的，要把产业少分给他们。拈出何地给何人，就要归何人。你们要按宗族的支派承受。

chapters.en: “ ‘But if you do not drive out the inhabitants of the land, those you allow to remain will become barbs in your eyes and thorns in your sides. They will give you trouble in the land where you will live.
chapters.zh: 倘若你们不赶出那地的居民，所容留的居民就必作你们眼中的刺，肋下的荆棘，也必在你们所住的地上扰害你们。

chapters.en: And then I will do to you what I plan to do to them.’ ”
chapters.zh: 而且我素常有意怎样待他们，也必照样待你们。

chapters.en: The LORD said to Moses,
chapters.zh: 耶和华晓谕摩西说，

chapters.en: “Command the Israelites and say to them: ‘When you enter Canaan, the land that will be allotted to you as an inheritance is to have these boundaries:
chapters.zh: 你吩咐以色列人说，你们到了迦南地，就是归你们为业的迦南四境之地，

chapters.en: “ ‘Your southern side will include some of the Desert of Zin along the border of Edom. Your southern boundary will start in the east from the southern end of the Dead Sea,
chapters.zh: 南角要从寻的旷野，贴着以东的边界。南界要从盐海东头起，

chapters.en: cross south of Scorpion Pass, continue on to Zin and go south of Kadesh Barnea. Then it will go to Hazar Addar and over to Azmon,
chapters.zh: 绕到亚克拉滨坡的南边，接连到寻，直通到加低斯巴尼亚的南边，又通到哈萨亚达，接连到押们，

chapters.en: where it will turn, join the Wadi of Egypt and end at the Mediterranean Sea.
chapters.zh: 从押们转到埃及小河，直通到海为止。

chapters.en: “ ‘Your western boundary will be the coast of the Mediterranean Sea. This will be your boundary on the west.
chapters.zh: 西边要以大海为界。这就是你们的西界。

chapters.en: “ ‘For your northern boundary, run a line from the Mediterranean Sea to Mount Hor
chapters.zh: 北界要从大海起，划到何珥山，

chapters.en: and from Mount Hor to Lebo Hamath. Then the boundary will go to Zedad,
chapters.zh: 从何珥山划到哈马口，通到西达达，

chapters.en: continue to Ziphron and end at Hazar Enan. This will be your boundary on the north.
chapters.zh: 又通到西斐仑，直到哈萨以难。这要作你们的北界。

chapters.en: “ ‘For your eastern boundary, run a line from Hazar Enan to Shepham.
chapters.zh: 你们要从哈萨以难划到示番为东界。

chapters.en: The boundary will go down from Shepham to Riblah on the east side of Ain and continue along the slopes east of the Sea of Galilee.
chapters.zh: 这界要从示番下到亚延东边的利比拉，又要达到基尼烈湖的东边。

chapters.en: Then the boundary will go down along the Jordan and end at the Dead Sea. “ ‘This will be your land, with its boundaries on every side.’ ”
chapters.zh: 这界要下到约旦河，通到盐海为止。这四围的边界以内，要作你们的地。

chapters.en: Moses commanded the Israelites: “Assign this land by lot as an inheritance. The LORD has ordered that it be given to the nine-and-a-half tribes,
chapters.zh: 摩西吩咐以色列人说，这地就是耶和华吩咐拈阄给九个半支派承受为业的。

chapters.en: because the families of the tribe of Reuben, the tribe of Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh have received their inheritance.
chapters.zh: 因为流便支派和迦得支派按着宗族受了产业，玛拿西半个支派也受了产业。

chapters.en: These two-and-a-half tribes have received their inheritance east of the Jordan across from Jericho, toward the sunrise.”
chapters.zh: 这两个半支派已经在耶利哥对面，约旦河东，向日出之地受了产业。

chapters.en: The LORD said to Moses,
chapters.zh: 耶和华晓谕摩西说，

chapters.en: “These are the names of the men who are to assign the land for you as an inheritance: Eleazar the priest and Joshua son of Nun.
chapters.zh: 要给你们分地为业之人的名字是祭司以利亚撒和嫩的儿子约书亚。

chapters.en: And appoint one leader from each tribe to help assign the land.
chapters.zh: 又要从每支派中选一个首领帮助他们。

chapters.en: These are their names: Caleb son of Jephunneh, from the tribe of Judah;
chapters.zh: 这些人的名字，犹大支派有耶孚尼的儿子迦勒。

chapters.en: Shemuel son of Ammihud, from the tribe of Simeon;
chapters.zh: 西缅支派有亚米忽的儿子示母利。

chapters.en: Elidad son of Kislon, from the tribe of Benjamin;
chapters.zh: 便雅悯支派有基斯伦的儿子以利达。

chapters.en: Bukki son of Jogli, the leader from the tribe of Dan;
chapters.zh: 但支派有一个首领，约利的儿子布基。

chapters.en: Hanniel son of Ephod, the leader from the tribe of Manasseh son of Joseph;
chapters.zh: 约瑟的子孙玛拿西支派有一个首领，以弗的儿子汉聂。

chapters.en: Kemuel son of Shiphtan, the leader from the tribe of Ephraim son of Joseph;
chapters.zh: 以法莲支派有一个首领，拾弗但的儿子基母利。

chapters.en: Elizaphan son of Parnak, the leader from the tribe of Zebulun;
chapters.zh: 西布伦支派有一个首领，帕纳的儿子以利撒番。

chapters.en: Paltiel son of Azzan, the leader from the tribe of Issachar;
chapters.zh: 以萨迦支派有一个首领，阿散的儿子帕铁。

chapters.en: Ahihud son of Shelomi, the leader from the tribe of Asher;
chapters.zh: 亚设支派有一个首领，示罗米的儿子亚希忽。

chapters.en: Pedahel son of Ammihud, the leader from the tribe of Naphtali.”
chapters.zh: 拿弗他利支派有一个首领，亚米忽的儿子比大黑。

chapters.en: These are the men the LORD commanded to assign the inheritance to the Israelites in the land of Canaan.
chapters.zh: 这些人就是耶和华所吩咐，在迦南地把产业分给以色列人的。

chapters.en: On the plains of Moab by the Jordan across from Jericho, the LORD said to Moses,
chapters.zh: 耶和华在摩押平原约旦河边，耶利哥对面晓谕摩西说，

chapters.en: “Command the Israelites to give the Levites towns to live in from the inheritance the Israelites will possess. And give them pasturelands around the towns.
chapters.zh: 你吩咐以色列人，要从所得为业的地中把些城给利未人居住，也要把这城四围的郊野给利未人。

chapters.en: Then they will have towns to live in and pasturelands for the cattle they own and all their other animals.
chapters.zh: 这城邑要归他们居住，城邑的郊野可以牧养他们的牛羊和各样的牲畜，又可以安置他们的财物。

chapters.en: “The pasturelands around the towns that you give the Levites will extend a thousand cubits from the town wall.
chapters.zh: 你们给利未人的郊野，要从城根起，四围往外量一千肘。

chapters.en: Outside the town, measure two thousand cubits on the east side, two thousand on the south side, two thousand on the west and two thousand on the north, with the town in the center. They will have this area as pastureland for the towns.
chapters.zh: 另外东量二千肘，南量二千肘，西量二千肘，北量二千肘，为边界，城在当中。这要归他们作城邑的郊野。

chapters.en: “Six of the towns you give the Levites will be cities of refuge, to which a person who has killed someone may flee. In addition, give them forty-two other towns.
chapters.zh: 你们给利未人的城邑，其中当有六座逃城，使误杀人的可以逃到那里。此外还要给他们四十二座城。

chapters.en: In all you must give the Levites forty-eight towns, together with their pasturelands.
chapters.zh: 你们要给利未人的城，共有四十八座，连城带郊野都要给他们。

chapters.en: The towns you give the Levites from the land the Israelites possess are to be given in proportion to the inheritance of each tribe: Take many towns from a tribe that has many, but few from one that has few.”
chapters.zh: 以色列人所得的地业从中要把些城邑给利未人。人多的就多给，人少的就少给。各支派要按所承受为业之地把城邑给利未人。

chapters.en: Then the LORD said to Moses:
chapters.zh: 耶和华晓谕摩西说，

chapters.en: “Speak to the Israelites and say to them: ‘When you cross the Jordan into Canaan,
chapters.zh: 你吩咐以色列人说，你们过约旦河，进了迦南地，

chapters.en: select some towns to be your cities of refuge, to which a person who has killed someone accidentally may flee.
chapters.zh: 就要分出几座城，为你们作逃城，使误杀人的可以逃到那里。
