chapters.en: But you will cross the Jordan and settle in the land the LORD your God is giving you as an inheritance, and he will give you rest from all your enemies around you so that you will live in safety.
chapters.zh: 但你们过了约旦河，得以住在耶和华你们神使你们承受为业之地，又使你们太平，不被四围的一切仇敌扰乱，安然居住。

chapters.en: Then to the place the LORD your God will choose as a dwelling for his Name—there you are to bring everything I command you: your burnt offerings and sacrifices, your tithes and special gifts, and all the choice possessions you have vowed to the LORD.
chapters.zh: 那时要将我所吩咐你们的燔祭，平安祭，十分取一之物，和手中的举祭，并向耶和华许愿献的一切美祭，都奉到耶和华你们神所选择要立为他名的居所。

chapters.en: And there rejoice before the LORD your God—you, your sons and daughters, your male and female servants, and the Levites from your towns who have no allotment or inheritance of their own.
chapters.zh: 你们和儿女，仆婢，并住在你们城里无分无业的利未人，都要在耶和华你们的神面前欢乐。

chapters.en: Be careful not to sacrifice your burnt offerings anywhere you please.
chapters.zh: 你要谨慎，不可在你所看中的各处献燔祭。

chapters.en: Offer them only at the place the LORD will choose in one of your tribes, and there observe everything I command you.
chapters.zh: 惟独耶和华从你那一支派中所选择的地方，你就要在那里献燔祭，行我一切所吩咐你的。

chapters.en: Nevertheless, you may slaughter your animals in any of your towns and eat as much of the meat as you want, as if it were gazelle or deer, according to the blessing the LORD your God gives you. Both the ceremonially unclean and the clean may eat it.
chapters.zh: 然而，在你各城里都可以照耶和华你神所赐你的福分，随心所欲宰牲吃肉。无论洁净人不洁净人都可以吃，就如吃羚羊与鹿一般。

chapters.en: But you must not eat the blood; pour it out on the ground like water.
chapters.zh: 只是不可吃血，要倒在地上，如同倒水一样。

chapters.en: You must not eat in your own towns the tithe of your grain and new wine and olive oil, or the firstborn of your herds and flocks, or whatever you have vowed to give, or your freewill offerings or special gifts.
chapters.zh: 你的五谷，新酒，和油的十分之一，或是牛群羊群中头生的，或是你许愿献的，甘心献的，或是手中的举祭，都不可在你城里吃。

chapters.en: Instead, you are to eat them in the presence of the LORD your God at the place the LORD your God will choose—you, your sons and daughters, your male and female servants, and the Levites from your towns—and you are to rejoice before the LORD your God in everything you put your hand to.
chapters.zh: 但要在耶和华你的神面前吃，在耶和华你神所耀选择的地方，你和儿女，仆婢，并住在你城里的利未人，都可以吃。也要因你手所办的，在耶和华你神面前欢乐。

chapters.en: Be careful not to neglect the Levites as long as you live in your land.
chapters.zh: 你要谨慎，在你所住的地方永不可丢弃利未人。

chapters.en: When the LORD your God has enlarged your territory as he promised you, and you crave meat and say, “I would like some meat,” then you may eat as much of it as you want.
chapters.zh: 耶和华你的神照他所应许扩张你境界的时候，你心里想要吃肉，说，我要吃肉，就可以随心所欲地吃肉。

chapters.en: If the place where the LORD your God chooses to put his Name is too far away from you, you may slaughter animals from the herds and flocks the LORD has given you, as I have commanded you, and in your own towns you may eat as much of them as you want.
chapters.zh: 耶和华你神所选择要立他名的地方若离你太远，就可以照我所吩咐的，将耶和华赐给你的牛羊取些宰了，可以随心所欲在你城里吃。

chapters.en: Eat them as you would gazelle or deer. Both the ceremonially unclean and the clean may eat.
chapters.zh: 你吃那肉，要像吃羚羊与鹿一般。无论洁净人不洁净人都可以吃。

chapters.en: But be sure you do not eat the blood, because the blood is the life, and you must not eat the life with the meat.
chapters.zh: 只是你要心意坚定，不可吃血，因为血是生命。不可将血（原文作生命）与肉同吃。

chapters.en: You must not eat the blood; pour it out on the ground like water.
chapters.zh: 不可吃血，要倒在地上，如同倒水一样。

chapters.en: Do not eat it, so that it may go well with you and your children after you, because you will be doing what is right in the eyes of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 不可吃血。这样，你行耶和华眼中看为正的事，你和你的子孙就可以得福。

chapters.en: But take your consecrated things and whatever you have vowed to give, and go to the place the LORD will choose.
chapters.zh: 只是你分别为圣的物和你的还愿祭要奉到耶和华所选择的地方去。

chapters.en: Present your burnt offerings on the altar of the LORD your God, both the meat and the blood. The blood of your sacrifices must be poured beside the altar of the LORD your God, but you may eat the meat.
chapters.zh: 你的燔祭，连肉带血，都要献在耶和华你神的坛上。平安祭的血要倒在耶和华你神的坛上。平安祭的肉，你自己可以吃。

chapters.en: Be careful to obey all these regulations I am giving you, so that it may always go well with you and your children after you, because you will be doing what is good and right in the eyes of the LORD your God.
chapters.zh: 你要谨守听从我所吩咐的一切话，行耶和华你神眼中看为善，看为正的事。这样，你和你的子孙就可以永远享福。

chapters.en: The LORD your God will cut off before you the nations you are about to invade and dispossess. But when you have driven them out and settled in their land,
chapters.zh: 耶和华你神将你要去赶出的国民从你面前剪除，你得了他们的地居住，

chapters.en: and after they have been destroyed before you, be careful not to be ensnared by inquiring about their gods, saying, “How do these nations serve their gods? We will do the same.”
chapters.zh: 那时就要谨慎，不可在他们除灭之后随从他们的恶俗，陷入网罗，也不可访问他们的神说，这些国民怎样事奉他们的神，我也要照样行。

chapters.en: You must not worship the LORD your God in their way, because in worshiping their gods, they do all kinds of detestable things the LORD hates. They even burn their sons and daughters in the fire as sacrifices to their gods.
chapters.zh: 你不可向耶和华你的神这样行，因为他们向他们的神行了耶和华所憎嫌所恨恶的一切事，甚至将自己的儿女用火焚烧，献与他们的神。

chapters.en: See that you do all I command you; do not add to it or take away from it.
chapters.zh: 凡我所吩咐的，你们都要谨守遵行，不可加添，也不可删减。

chapters.en: If a prophet, or one who foretells by dreams, appears among you and announces to you a sign or wonder,
chapters.zh: 你们中间若有先知或是作梦的起来，向你显个神迹奇事，

chapters.en: and if the sign or wonder spoken of takes place, and the prophet says, “Let us follow other gods” (gods you have not known) “and let us worship them,”
chapters.zh: 对你说，我们去随从你素来所不认识的别神，事奉它吧。他所显的神迹奇事虽有应验，

chapters.en: you must not listen to the words of that prophet or dreamer. The LORD your God is testing you to find out whether you love him with all your heart and with all your soul.
chapters.zh: 你也不可听那先知或是那作梦之人的话。因为这是耶和华你们的神试验你们，要知道你们是尽心尽性爱耶和华你们的神不是。

chapters.en: It is the LORD your God you must follow, and him you must revere. Keep his commands and obey him; serve him and hold fast to him.
chapters.zh: 你们要顺从耶和华你们的神，敬畏他，谨守他的诫命，听从他的话，事奉他，专靠他。

chapters.en: That prophet or dreamer must be put to death for inciting rebellion against the LORD your God, who brought you out of Egypt and redeemed you from the land of slavery. That prophet or dreamer tried to turn you from the way the LORD your God commanded you to follow. You must purge the evil from among you.
chapters.zh: 那先知或是那作梦的既用言语叛逆那领你们出埃及地，救赎你脱离为奴之家的耶和华你们的神，要勾引你离开耶和华你神所吩咐你行的道，你便要将他治死。这样，就把那恶从你们中间除掉。

chapters.en: If your very own brother, or your son or daughter, or the wife you love, or your closest friend secretly entices you, saying, “Let us go and worship other gods” (gods that neither you nor your ancestors have known,
chapters.zh: 你的同胞弟兄，或是你的儿女，或是你怀中的妻，或是如同你性命的朋友，若暗中引诱你，说，我们不如去事奉你和你列祖素来所不认识的别神

chapters.en: gods of the peoples around you, whether near or far, from one end of the land to the other),
chapters.zh: 是你四围列国的神。无论是离你近，离你远，从地这边到地那边的神，

chapters.en: do not yield to them or listen to them. Show them no pity. Do not spare them or shield them.
chapters.zh: 你不可依从他，也不可听从他，眼不可顾惜他。你不可怜恤他，也不可遮庇他，

chapters.en: You must certainly put them to death. Your hand must be the first in putting them to death, and then the hands of all the people.
chapters.zh: 总要杀他。你先下手，然后众民也下手，将他治死。

chapters.en: Stone them to death, because they tried to turn you away from the LORD your God, who brought you out of Egypt, out of the land of slavery.
chapters.zh: 要用石头打死他，因为他想要勾引你离开那领你出埃及地为奴之家的耶和华你的神。

chapters.en: Then all Israel will hear and be afraid, and no one among you will do such an evil thing again.
chapters.zh: 以色列众人都要听见害怕，就不敢在你们中间再行这样的恶了。

chapters.en: If you hear it said about one of the towns the LORD your God is giving you to live in
chapters.zh: 在耶和华你神所赐你居住的各城中，你若听人说，有些匪类从你们中间的一座城出来勾引本城的居民，说，我们不如去事奉你们素来所不认识的别神。

chapters.en: that troublemakers have arisen among you and have led the people of their town astray, saying, “Let us go and worship other gods” (gods you have not known),
chapters.zh: （见上节

chapters.en: then you must inquire, probe and investigate it thoroughly. And if it is true and it has been proved that this detestable thing has been done among you,
chapters.zh: 你就要探听，查究，细细地访问，果然是真，准有这可憎恶的事行在你们中间，

chapters.en: you must certainly put to the sword all who live in that town. You must destroy it completely, both its people and its livestock.
chapters.zh: 你必要用刀杀那城里的居民，把城里所有的，连牲畜，都用刀杀尽。

chapters.en: You are to gather all the plunder of the town into the middle of the public square and completely burn the town and all its plunder as a whole burnt offering to the LORD your God. That town is to remain a ruin forever, never to be rebuilt,
chapters.zh: 你从那城里所夺的财物都要堆积在街市上，用火将城和其内所夺的财物都在耶和华你神面前烧尽。那城就永为荒堆，不可再建造。

chapters.en: and none of the condemned things are to be found in your hands. Then the LORD will turn from his fierce anger, will show you mercy, and will have compassion on you. He will increase your numbers, as he promised on oath to your ancestors—
chapters.zh: 那当毁灭的物连一点都不可粘你的手。你要听从耶和华你神的话，遵守我今日所吩咐你的一切诫命，行耶和华你神眼中看为正的事，耶和华就必转意，不发烈怒，恩待你，怜恤你，照他向你列祖所起的誓使你人数增多。

chapters.en: because you obey the LORD your God by keeping all his commands that I am giving you today and doing what is right in his eyes.
chapters.zh: （见上节

chapters.en: You are the children of the LORD your God. Do not cut yourselves or shave the front of your heads for the dead,
chapters.zh: 你们是耶和华你们神的儿女。不可为死人用刀划身，也不可将额上剃光。

chapters.en: for you are a people holy to the LORD your God. Out of all the peoples on the face of the earth, the LORD has chosen you to be his treasured possession.
chapters.zh: 因为你归耶和华你神为圣洁的民，耶和华从地上的万民中拣选你特作自己的子民。

chapters.en: Do not eat any detestable thing.
chapters.zh: 凡可憎的物都不可吃。

chapters.en: These are the animals you may eat: the ox, the sheep, the goat,
chapters.zh: 可吃的牲畜就是牛，绵羊，山羊，

chapters.en: the deer, the gazelle, the roe deer, the wild goat, the ibex, the antelope and the mountain sheep.
chapters.zh: 鹿，羚羊，狍子，野山羊，麋鹿，黄羊，青羊。

chapters.en: You may eat any animal that has a divided hoof and that chews the cud.
chapters.zh: 凡分蹄成为两瓣又倒嚼的走兽，你们都可以吃。

chapters.en: However, of those that chew the cud or that have a divided hoof you may not eat the camel, the rabbit or the hyrax. Although they chew the cud, they do not have a divided hoof; they are ceremonially unclean for you.
chapters.zh: 但那些倒嚼或是分蹄之中不可吃的乃是骆驼，兔子，沙番因为是倒嚼不分蹄，就与你们不洁净。

chapters.en: The pig is also unclean; although it has a divided hoof, it does not chew the cud. You are not to eat their meat or touch their carcasses.
chapters.zh: 猪因为是分蹄却不倒嚼，就与你们不洁净。这些兽的肉，你们不可吃，死的也不可摸。

chapters.en: Of all the creatures living in the water, you may eat any that has fins and scales.
chapters.zh: 水中可吃的乃是这些，凡有翅有鳞的都可以吃。

chapters.en: But anything that does not have fins and scales you may not eat; for you it is unclean.
chapters.zh: 凡无翅无鳞的都不可吃，是与你们不洁净。

chapters.en: You may eat any clean bird.
chapters.zh: 凡洁净的鸟，你们都可以吃。

chapters.en: But these you may not eat: the eagle, the vulture, the black vulture,
chapters.zh: 不可吃的乃是雕，狗头雕，红头雕，

chapters.en: the red kite, the black kite, any kind of falcon,
chapters.zh: 鹯，小鹰，鹞鹰与其类，

chapters.en: any kind of raven,
chapters.zh: 乌鸦与其类，

chapters.en: the horned owl, the screech owl, the gull, any kind of hawk,
chapters.zh: 鸵鸟，夜鹰，鱼鹰，鹰与其类，

chapters.en: the little owl, the great owl, the white owl,
chapters.zh: 鸮鸟，猫头鹰，角鸱，

chapters.en: the desert owl, the osprey, the cormorant,
chapters.zh: 鹈鹕，秃雕，鸬鹚，

chapters.en: the stork, any kind of heron, the hoopoe and the bat.
chapters.zh: 鹳，鹭鸶与其类，戴鵀与蝙蝠。

chapters.en: All flying insects are unclean to you; do not eat them.
chapters.zh: 凡有翅膀爬行的物是与你们不洁净，都不可吃。

chapters.en: But any winged creature that is clean you may eat.
chapters.zh: 凡洁净的鸟，你们都可以吃。

chapters.en: Do not eat anything you find already dead. You may give it to the foreigner residing in any of your towns, and they may eat it, or you may sell it to any other foreigner. But you are a people holy to the LORD your God. Do not cook a young goat in its mother’s milk.
chapters.zh: 凡自死的，你们都不可吃，可以给你城里寄居的吃，或卖与外人吃，因为你是归耶和华你神为圣洁的民。不可用山羊羔母的奶煮山羊羔。

chapters.en: Be sure to set aside a tenth of all that your fields produce each year.
chapters.zh: 你要把你撒种所产的，就是你田地每年所出的，十分取一分。

chapters.en: Eat the tithe of your grain, new wine and olive oil, and the firstborn of your herds and flocks in the presence of the LORD your God at the place he will choose as a dwelling for his Name, so that you may learn to revere the LORD your God always.
chapters.zh: 又要把你的五谷，新酒，和油的十分之一，并牛群羊群中头生的，吃在耶和华你神面前，就是他所选择要立为他名的居所。这样，你可以学习时常敬畏耶和华你的神。

chapters.en: But if that place is too distant and you have been blessed by the LORD your God and cannot carry your tithe (because the place where the LORD will choose to put his Name is so far away),
chapters.zh: 当耶和华你神赐福与你的时候，耶和华你神所选择要立为他名的地方若离你太远，那路也太长，使你不能把这物带到那里去，

chapters.en: then exchange your tithe for silver, and take the silver with you and go to the place the LORD your God will choose.
chapters.zh: 你就可以换成银子，将银子包起来，拿在手中，往耶和华你神所要选择的地方去。

chapters.en: Use the silver to buy whatever you like: cattle, sheep, wine or other fermented drink, or anything you wish. Then you and your household shall eat there in the presence of the LORD your God and rejoice.
chapters.zh: 你用这银子，随心所欲，或买牛羊，或买清酒浓酒，凡你心所想的都可以买。你和你的家属在耶和华你神的面前吃喝快乐。

chapters.en: And do not neglect the Levites living in your towns, for they have no allotment or inheritance of their own.
chapters.zh: 住在你城里的利未人，你不可丢弃他，因为他在你们中间无分无业。

chapters.en: At the end of every three years, bring all the tithes of that year’s produce and store it in your towns,
chapters.zh: 每逢三年的末一年，你要将本年的土产十分之一都取出来，积存在你的城中。

chapters.en: so that the Levites (who have no allotment or inheritance of their own) and the foreigners, the fatherless and the widows who live in your towns may come and eat and be satisfied, and so that the LORD your God may bless you in all the work of your hands.
chapters.zh: 在你城里无分无业的利未人，和你城里寄居的，并孤儿寡妇，都可以来，吃得饱足。这样，耶和华你的神必在你手里所办的一切事上赐福与你。

chapters.en: At the end of every seven years you must cancel debts.
chapters.zh: 每逢七年末一年，你要施行豁免。

chapters.en: This is how it is to be done: Every creditor shall cancel any loan they have made to a fellow Israelite. They shall not require payment from anyone among their own people, because the LORD’s time for canceling debts has been proclaimed.
chapters.zh: 豁免的定例乃是这样，凡债主要把所借给邻舍的豁免了。不可向邻舍和弟兄追讨，因为耶和华的豁免年已经宣告了。

chapters.en: You may require payment from a foreigner, but you must cancel any debt your fellow Israelite owes you.
chapters.zh: 若借给外邦人，你可以向他追讨。但借给你弟兄，无论是什么，你要松手豁免了。

chapters.en: However, there need be no poor people among you, for in the land the LORD your God is giving you to possess as your inheritance, he will richly bless you,
chapters.zh: 你若留意听从耶和华你神的话，谨守遵行我今日所吩咐你这一切的命令，就必在你们中间没有穷人了（在耶和华你神所赐你为业的地上，耶和华必大大赐福与你）。

chapters.en: if only you fully obey the LORD your God and are careful to follow all these commands I am giving you today.
For the LORD your God will bless you as he has promised, and you will lend to many nations but will borrow from none. You will rule over many nations but none will rule over you.
chapters.zh: 因为耶和华你的神必照他所应许你的赐福与你。你必借给许多国民，却不至向他们借贷。你必管辖许多国民，他们却不能管辖你。

chapters.en: If anyone is poor among your fellow Israelites in any of the towns of the land the LORD your God is giving you, do not be hardhearted or tightfisted toward them.
chapters.zh: 在耶和华你神所赐你的地上，无论哪一座城里，你弟兄中若有一个穷人，你不可忍着心，袖手不帮助你穷乏的弟兄。

chapters.en: Rather, be openhanded and freely lend them whatever they need.
chapters.zh: 总要向他松开手，照他所缺乏的借给他，补他的不足。

chapters.en: Be careful not to harbor this wicked thought: “The seventh year, the year for canceling debts, is near,” so that you do not show ill will toward the needy among your fellow Israelites and give them nothing. They may then appeal to the LORD against you, and you will be found guilty of sin.
chapters.zh: 你要谨慎，不可心里起恶念，说，第七年的豁免年快到了，你便恶眼看你穷乏的弟兄，什么都不给他，以致他因你求告耶和华，罪便归于你了。

chapters.en: Give generously to them and do so without a grudging heart; then because of this the LORD your God will bless you in all your work and in everything you put your hand to.
chapters.zh: 你总要给他，给他的时候心里不可愁烦。因耶和华你的神必在你这一切所行的，并你手里所办的事上，赐福与你。

chapters.en: There will always be poor people in the land. Therefore I command you to be openhanded toward your fellow Israelites who are poor and needy in your land.
chapters.zh: 原来那地上的穷人永不断绝。所以我吩咐你说，总要向你地上困苦穷乏的弟兄松开手。

chapters.en: If any of your people—Hebrew men or women—sell themselves to you and serve you six years, in the seventh year you must let them go free.
chapters.zh: 你弟兄中，若有一个希伯来男人或希伯来女人被卖给你，服事你六年，到第七年就要任他自由出去。

chapters.en: And when you release them, do not send them away empty-handed.
chapters.zh: 你任他自由的时候，不可使他空手而去，

chapters.en: Supply them liberally from your flock, your threshing floor and your winepress. Give to them as the LORD your God has blessed you.
chapters.zh: 要从你羊群，禾场，酒榨之中多多地给他。耶和华你的神怎样赐福与你，你也要照样给他。

chapters.en: Remember that you were slaves in Egypt and the LORD your God redeemed you. That is why I give you this command today.
chapters.zh: 要记念你在埃及地作过奴仆，耶和华你的神将你救赎。因此，我今日吩咐你这件事。

chapters.en: But if your servant says to you, “I do not want to leave you,” because he loves you and your family and is well off with you,
chapters.zh: 他若对你说，我不愿意离开你，是因他爱你和你的家，且因在你那里很好，

chapters.en: then take an awl and push it through his earlobe into the door, and he will become your servant for life. Do the same for your female servant.
chapters.zh: 你就要拿锥子将他的耳朵在门上刺透，他便永为你的奴仆了。你待婢女也要这样。

chapters.en: Do not consider it a hardship to set your servant free, because their service to you these six years has been worth twice as much as that of a hired hand. And the LORD your God will bless you in everything you do.
chapters.zh: 你任他自由的时候，不可以为难事，因他服事你六年，较比雇工的工价多加一倍了。耶和华你的神就必在你所作的一切事上赐福与你。

chapters.en: Set apart for the LORD your God every firstborn male of your herds and flocks. Do not put the firstborn of your cows to work, and do not shear the firstborn of your sheep.
chapters.zh: 你牛群羊群中头生的，凡是公的，都要分别为圣，归耶和华你的神。牛群中头生的，不可用它耕地。羊群中头生的，不可剪毛。

chapters.en: Each year you and your family are to eat them in the presence of the LORD your God at the place he will choose.
chapters.zh: 这头生的，你和你的家属，每年要在耶和华所选择的地方，在耶和华你神面前吃。

chapters.en: If an animal has a defect, is lame or blind, or has any serious flaw, you must not sacrifice it to the LORD your God.
chapters.zh: 这头生的若有什么残疾，就如瘸腿的，瞎眼的，无论有什么恶残疾，都不可献给耶和华你的神。

chapters.en: You are to eat it in your own towns. Both the ceremonially unclean and the clean may eat it, as if it were gazelle or deer.
chapters.zh: 可以在你城里吃。洁净人与不洁净人都可以吃，就如吃羚羊与鹿一般。

chapters.en: But you must not eat the blood; pour it out on the ground like water.
chapters.zh: 只是不可吃它的血。要倒在地上，如同倒水一样。

chapters.en: Observe the month of Aviv and celebrate the Passover of the LORD your God, because in the month of Aviv he brought you out of Egypt by night.
chapters.zh: 你要注意亚笔月，向耶和华你的神守逾越节，因为耶和华你的神在亚笔月夜间领你出埃及。

chapters.en: Sacrifice as the Passover to the LORD your God an animal from your flock or herd at the place the LORD will choose as a dwelling for his Name.
chapters.zh: 你当在耶和华所选择要立为他名的居所，从牛群羊群中，将逾越节的祭牲献给耶和华你的神。

chapters.en: Do not eat it with bread made with yeast, but for seven days eat unleavened bread, the bread of affliction, because you left Egypt in haste—so that all the days of your life you may remember the time of your departure from Egypt.
chapters.zh: 你吃这祭牲，不可吃有酵的饼。七日之内要吃无酵饼，就是困苦饼。（你本是急忙出了埃及地）要叫你一生一世记念你从埃及地出来的日子。

chapters.en: Let no yeast be found in your possession in all your land for seven days. Do not let any of the meat you sacrifice on the evening of the first day remain until morning.
chapters.zh: 在你四境之内，七日不可见面酵，头一日晚上所献的肉，一点不可留到早晨。

chapters.en: You must not sacrifice the Passover in any town the LORD your God gives you
chapters.zh: 在耶和华你神所赐的各城中，你不可献逾越节的祭。

chapters.en: except in the place he will choose as a dwelling for his Name. There you must sacrifice the Passover in the evening, when the sun goes down, on the anniversary of your departure from Egypt.
chapters.zh: 只当在耶和华你神所选择要立为他名的居所，晚上日落的时候，乃是你出埃及的时候，献逾越节的祭。

chapters.en: Roast it and eat it at the place the LORD your God will choose. Then in the morning return to your tents.
chapters.zh: 当在耶和华你神所选择的地方把肉烤了吃（烤或作煮），次日早晨就回到你的帐棚去。

chapters.en: For six days eat unleavened bread and on the seventh day hold an assembly to the LORD your God and do no work.
chapters.zh: 你要吃无酵饼六日，第七日要向耶和华你的神守严肃会，不可作工。

chapters.en: Count off seven weeks from the time you begin to put the sickle to the standing grain.
chapters.zh: 你要计算七七日，从你开镰收割禾稼时算起，共计七七日。

chapters.en: Then celebrate the Festival of Weeks to the LORD your God by giving a freewill offering in proportion to the blessings the LORD your God has given you.
chapters.zh: 你要照耶和华你神所赐你的福，手里拿着甘心祭，献在耶和华你的神面前，守七七节。

chapters.en: And rejoice before the LORD your God at the place he will choose as a dwelling for his Name—you, your sons and daughters, your male and female servants, the Levites in your towns, and the foreigners, the fatherless and the widows living among you.
chapters.zh: 你和你儿女，仆婢，并住在你城里的利未人，以及在你们中间寄居的与孤儿寡妇，都要在耶和华你神所选择立为他名的居所，在耶和华你的神面前欢乐。

chapters.en: Remember that you were slaves in Egypt, and follow carefully these decrees.
chapters.zh: 你也要记念你在埃及作过奴仆。你要谨守遵行这些律例。

chapters.en: Celebrate the Festival of Tabernacles for seven days after you have gathered the produce of your threshing floor and your winepress.
chapters.zh: 你把禾场的谷，酒榨的酒收藏以后，就要守住棚节七日。

chapters.en: Be joyful at your festival—you, your sons and daughters, your male and female servants, and the Levites, the foreigners, the fatherless and the widows who live in your towns.
chapters.zh: 守节的时候，你和你儿女，仆婢，并住在你城里的利未人，以及寄居的与孤儿寡妇，都要欢乐。

chapters.en: For seven days celebrate the festival to the LORD your God at the place the LORD will choose. For the LORD your God will bless you in all your harvest and in all the work of your hands, and your joy will be complete.
chapters.zh: 在耶和华所选择的地方，你当向耶和华你的神守节七日。因为耶和华你神在你一切的土产上和你手里所办的事上要赐福与你，你就非常地欢乐。

chapters.en: Three times a year all your men must appear before the LORD your God at the place he will choose: at the Festival of Unleavened Bread, the Festival of Weeks and the Festival of Tabernacles. No one should appear before the LORD empty-handed:
chapters.zh: 你一切的男丁要在除酵节，七七节，住棚节，一年三次，在耶和华你神所选择的地方朝见他，却不可空手朝见。

chapters.en: Each of you must bring a gift in proportion to the way the LORD your God has blessed you.
chapters.zh: 各人要按自己的力量，照耶和华你神所赐的福分，奉献礼物。

chapters.en: Appoint judges and officials for each of your tribes in every town the LORD your God is giving you, and they shall judge the people fairly.
chapters.zh: 你要在耶和华你神所赐的各城里，按着各支派设立审判官和官长。他们必按公义的审判判断百姓。

chapters.en: Do not pervert justice or show partiality. Do not accept a bribe, for a bribe blinds the eyes of the wise and twists the words of the innocent.
chapters.zh: 不可屈枉正直。不可看人的外貌。也不可受贿赂。因为贿赂能叫智慧人的眼变瞎了，又能颠倒义人的话。

chapters.en: Follow justice and justice alone, so that you may live and possess the land the LORD your God is giving you.
chapters.zh: 你要追求至公至义，好叫你存活，承受耶和华你神所赐你的地。

chapters.en: Do not set up any wooden Asherah pole beside the altar you build to the LORD your God,
chapters.zh: 你为耶和华你的神筑坛，不可在坛旁栽什么树木作为木偶。

chapters.en: and do not erect a sacred stone, for these the LORD your God hates.
chapters.zh: 也不可为自己设立柱像。这是耶和华你神所恨恶的。

chapters.en: Do not sacrifice to the LORD your God an ox or a sheep that has any defect or flaw in it, for that would be detestable to him.
chapters.zh: 凡有残疾，或有什么恶病的牛羊，你都不可献给耶和华你的神，因为这是耶和华你神所憎恶的。

chapters.en: If a man or woman living among you in one of the towns the LORD gives you is found doing evil in the eyes of the LORD your God in violation of his covenant,
chapters.zh: 在你们中间，在耶和华你神所赐你的诸城中，无论哪座城里，若有人，或男或女，行耶和华你神眼中看为恶的事，违背了他的约，

chapters.en: and contrary to my command has worshiped other gods, bowing down to them or to the sun or the moon or the stars in the sky,
chapters.zh: 去事奉敬拜别神，或拜日头，或拜月亮，或拜天象，是主不曾吩咐的。

chapters.en: and this has been brought to your attention, then you must investigate it thoroughly. If it is true and it has been proved that this detestable thing has been done in Israel,
chapters.zh: 有人告诉你，你也听见了，就要细细地探听，果然是真，准有这可憎恶的事行在以色列中，

chapters.en: take the man or woman who has done this evil deed to your city gate and stone that person to death.
chapters.zh: 你就要将行这恶事的男人或女人拉到城门外，用石头将他打死。

chapters.en: On the testimony of two or three witnesses a person is to be put to death, but no one is to be put to death on the testimony of only one witness.
chapters.zh: 要凭两三个人的口作见证将那当死的人治死。不可凭一个人的口作见证将他治死。

chapters.en: The hands of the witnesses must be the first in putting that person to death, and then the hands of all the people. You must purge the evil from among you.
chapters.zh: 见证人要先下手，然后众民也下手将他治死。这样，就把那恶从你们中间除掉。

chapters.en: If cases come before your courts that are too difficult for you to judge—whether bloodshed, lawsuits or assaults—take them to the place the LORD your God will choose.
chapters.zh: 你城中若起了争讼的事，或因流血，或因争竞，或因殴打，是你难断的案件，你就当起来，往耶和华你神所选择的地方

chapters.en: Go to the Levitical priests and to the judge who is in office at that time. Inquire of them and they will give you the verdict.
chapters.zh: 去见祭司利未人，并当时的审判官，求问他们，他们必将判语指示你。

chapters.en: You must act according to the decisions they give you at the place the LORD will choose. Be careful to do everything they instruct you to do.
chapters.zh: 他们在耶和华所选择的地方指示你的判语，你必照着他们所指教你的一切话谨守遵行。

chapters.en: Act according to whatever they teach you and the decisions they give you. Do not turn aside from what they tell you, to the right or to the left.
chapters.zh: 要按他们所指教你的律法，照他们所断定的去行。他们所指示你的判语，你不可偏离左右。

chapters.en: Anyone who shows contempt for the judge or for the priest who stands ministering there to the LORD your God is to be put to death. You must purge the evil from Israel.
chapters.zh: 若有人擅敢不听从那侍立在耶和华你神面前的祭司，或不听从审判官，那人就必治死。这样，便将那恶从以色列中除掉。

chapters.en: All the people will hear and be afraid, and will not be contemptuous again.
chapters.zh: 众百姓都要听见害怕，不再擅敢行事。

chapters.en: When you enter the land the LORD your God is giving you and have taken possession of it and settled in it, and you say, “Let us set a king over us like all the nations around us,”
chapters.zh: 到了耶和华你神所赐你的地，得了那地居住的时候，若说，我要立王治理我，像四围的国一样。

chapters.en: be sure to appoint over you a king the LORD your God chooses. He must be from among your fellow Israelites. Do not place a foreigner over you, one who is not an Israelite.
chapters.zh: 你总要立耶和华你神所拣选的人为王。必从你弟兄中立一人。不可立你弟兄以外的人为王。

chapters.en: The king, moreover, must not acquire great numbers of horses for himself or make the people return to Egypt to get more of them, for the LORD has told you, “You are not to go back that way again.”
chapters.zh: 只是王不可为自己加添马匹，也不可使百姓回埃及去，为要加添他的马匹，因耶和华曾吩咐你们说，不可再回那条路去。

chapters.en: He must not take many wives, or his heart will be led astray. He must not accumulate large amounts of silver and gold.
chapters.zh: 他也不可为自己多立妃嫔，恐怕他的心偏邪。也不可为自己多积金银。

chapters.en: When he takes the throne of his kingdom, he is to write for himself on a scroll a copy of this law, taken from that of the Levitical priests.
chapters.zh: 他登了国位，就要将祭司利未人面前的这律法书，为自己抄录一本，

chapters.en: It is to be with him, and he is to read it all the days of his life so that he may learn to revere the LORD his God and follow carefully all the words of this law and these decrees
chapters.zh: 存在他那里，要平生诵读，好学习敬畏耶和华他的神，谨守遵行这律法书上的一切言语和这些律例，

chapters.en: and not consider himself better than his fellow Israelites and turn from the law to the right or to the left. Then he and his descendants will reign a long time over his kingdom in Israel.
chapters.zh: 免得他向弟兄心高气傲，偏左偏右，离了这诫命。这样，他和他的子孙便可在以色列中，在国位上年长日久。

chapters.en: The Levitical priests—indeed, the whole tribe of Levi—are to have no allotment or inheritance with Israel. They shall live on the food offerings presented to the LORD, for that is their inheritance.
chapters.zh: 祭司利未人和利未全支派必在以色列中无分无业。他们所吃用的就是献给耶和华的火祭和一切所捐的。

chapters.en: They shall have no inheritance among their fellow Israelites; the LORD is their inheritance, as he promised them.
chapters.zh: 他们在弟兄中必没有产业。耶和华是他们的产业，正如耶和华所应许他们的。

chapters.en: This is the share due the priests from the people who sacrifice a bull or a sheep: the shoulder, the internal organs and the meat from the head.
chapters.zh: 祭司从百姓所当得的分乃是这样，凡献牛或羊为祭的，要把前腿和两腮并脾胃给祭司。

chapters.en: You are to give them the firstfruits of your grain, new wine and olive oil, and the first wool from the shearing of your sheep,
chapters.zh: 初收的五谷，新酒和油，并初剪的羊毛，也要给他。

chapters.en: for the LORD your God has chosen them and their descendants out of all your tribes to stand and minister in the LORD’s name always.
chapters.zh: 因为耶和华你的神从你各支派中将他拣选出来，使他和他子孙永远奉耶和华的名侍立，事奉。

chapters.en: If a Levite moves from one of your towns anywhere in Israel where he is living, and comes in all earnestness to the place the LORD will choose,
chapters.zh: 利未人无论寄居在以色列中的哪一座城，若从那里出来，一心愿意到耶和华所选择的地方，

chapters.en: he may minister in the name of the LORD his God like all his fellow Levites who serve there in the presence of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 就要奉耶和华他神的名事奉，像他众弟兄利未人侍立在耶和华面前事奉一样。

chapters.en: He is to share equally in their benefits, even though he has received money from the sale of family possessions.
chapters.zh: 除了他卖祖父产业所得的以外，还要得一分祭物与他们同吃。

chapters.en: When you enter the land the LORD your God is giving you, do not learn to imitate the detestable ways of the nations there.
chapters.zh: 你到了耶和华你神所赐之地，那些国民所行可憎恶的事，你不可学着行。

chapters.en: Let no one be found among you who sacrifices their son or daughter in the fire, who practices divination or sorcery, interprets omens, engages in witchcraft,
chapters.zh: 你们中间不可有人使儿女经火，也不可有占卜的，观兆的，用法术的，行邪术的，

chapters.en: or casts spells, or who is a medium or spiritist or who consults the dead.
chapters.zh: 用迷术的，交鬼的，行巫术的，过阴的。

chapters.en: Anyone who does these things is detestable to the LORD; because of these same detestable practices the LORD your God will drive out those nations before you.
chapters.zh: 凡行这些事的都为耶和华所憎恶。因那些国民行这可憎恶的事，所以耶和华你的神将他们从你面前赶出。

chapters.en: You must be blameless before the LORD your God.
chapters.zh: 你要在耶和华你的神面前作完全人。

chapters.en: The nations you will dispossess listen to those who practice sorcery or divination. But as for you, the LORD your God has not permitted you to do so.
chapters.zh: 因你所要赶出的那些国民都听信观兆的和占卜的，至于你，耶和华你的神从来不许你这样行。

chapters.en: The LORD your God will raise up for you a prophet like me from among you, from your fellow Israelites. You must listen to him.
chapters.zh: 耶和华你的神要从你们弟兄中间给你兴起一位先知，像我，你们要听从他。

chapters.en: For this is what you asked of the LORD your God at Horeb on the day of the assembly when you said, “Let us not hear the voice of the LORD our God nor see this great fire anymore, or we will die.”
chapters.zh: 正如你在何烈山大会的日子求耶和华你神一切的话，说，求你不再叫我听见耶和华我神的声音，也不再叫我看见这大火，免得我死亡。

chapters.en: The LORD said to me: “What they say is good.
chapters.zh: 耶和华就对我说，他们所说的是。

chapters.en: I will raise up for them a prophet like you from among their fellow Israelites, and I will put my words in his mouth. He will tell them everything I command him.
chapters.zh: 我必在他们弟兄中间，给他们兴起一位先知象你。我要将当说的话传给他。他要将我一切所吩咐的都传给他们。

chapters.en: I myself will call to account anyone who does not listen to my words that the prophet speaks in my name.
chapters.zh: 谁不听他奉我名所说的话，我必讨谁的罪。

chapters.en: But a prophet who presumes to speak in my name anything I have not commanded, or a prophet who speaks in the name of other gods, is to be put to death.”
chapters.zh: 若有先知擅敢托我的名说我所未曾吩咐他说的话，或是奉别神的名说话，那先知就必治死。

chapters.en: You may say to yourselves, “How can we know when a message has not been spoken by the LORD?”
chapters.zh: 你心里若说，耶和华所未曾吩咐的话，我们怎能知道呢？

chapters.en: If what a prophet proclaims in the name of the LORD does not take place or come true, that is a message the LORD has not spoken. That prophet has spoken presumptuously, so do not be alarmed.
chapters.zh: 先知托耶和华的名说话，所说的若不成就，也无效验，这就是耶和华所未曾吩咐的，是那先知擅自说的，你不要怕他。

chapters.en: When the LORD your God has destroyed the nations whose land he is giving you, and when you have driven them out and settled in their towns and houses,
chapters.zh: 耶和华你神将列国之民剪除的时候，耶和华你神也将他们的地赐给你，你接着住他们的城邑并他们的房屋，

chapters.en: then set aside for yourselves three cities in the land the LORD your God is giving you to possess.
chapters.zh: 就要在耶和华你神所赐你为业的地上分定三座城。

chapters.en: Determine the distances involved and divide into three parts the land the LORD your God is giving you as an inheritance, so that a person who kills someone may flee for refuge to one of these cities.
chapters.zh: 要将耶和华你神使你承受为业的地分为三段。又要预备道路，使误杀人的，都可以逃到那里去。

chapters.en: This is the rule concerning anyone who kills a person and flees there for safety—anyone who kills a neighbor unintentionally, without malice aforethought.
chapters.zh: 误杀人的逃到那里可以存活，定例乃是这样，凡素无仇恨，无心杀了人的，

chapters.en: For instance, a man may go into the forest with his neighbor to cut wood, and as he swings his ax to fell a tree, the head may fly off and hit his neighbor and kill him. That man may flee to one of these cities and save his life.
chapters.zh: 就如人与邻舍同入树林砍伐树木，手拿斧子一砍，本想砍下树木，不料，斧头脱了把，飞落在邻舍身上，以致于死，这人逃到那些城的一座城，就可以存活，

chapters.en: Otherwise, the avenger of blood might pursue him in a rage, overtake him if the distance is too great, and kill him even though he is not deserving of death, since he did it to his neighbor without malice aforethought.
chapters.zh: 免得报血仇的，心中火热追赶他，因路远就追上，将他杀死。其实他不该死，因为他与被杀的素无仇恨。

chapters.en: This is why I command you to set aside for yourselves three cities.
chapters.zh: 所以我吩咐你说，要分定三座城。

chapters.en: If the LORD your God enlarges your territory, as he promised on oath to your ancestors, and gives you the whole land he promised them,
chapters.zh: 耶和华你神若照他向你列祖所起的誓扩张你的境界，将所应许赐你列祖的地全然给你，

chapters.en: because you carefully follow all these laws I command you today—to love the LORD your God and to walk always in obedience to him—then you are to set aside three more cities.
chapters.zh: 你若谨守遵行我今日所吩咐的这一切诫命，爱耶和华你的神，常常遵行他的道，就要在这三座城之外，再添三座城，

chapters.en: Do this so that innocent blood will not be shed in your land, which the LORD your God is giving you as your inheritance, and so that you will not be guilty of bloodshed.
chapters.zh: 免得无辜之人的血流在耶和华你神所赐你为业的地上，流血的罪就归于你。

chapters.en: But if out of hate someone lies in wait, assaults and kills a neighbor, and then flees to one of these cities,
chapters.zh: 若有人恨他的邻舍，埋伏着起来击杀他，以致于死，便逃到这些城的一座城，

chapters.en: the killer shall be sent for by the town elders, be brought back from the city, and be handed over to the avenger of blood to die.
chapters.zh: 本城的长老就要打发人去，从那里带出他来，交在报血仇的手中，将他治死。

chapters.en: Show no pity. You must purge from Israel the guilt of shedding innocent blood, so that it may go well with you.
chapters.zh: 你眼不可顾惜他，却要从以色列中除掉流无辜血的罪，使你可以得福。

chapters.en: Do not move your neighbor’s boundary stone set up by your predecessors in the inheritance you receive in the land the LORD your God is giving you to possess.
chapters.zh: 在耶和华你神所赐你承受为业之地，不可挪移你邻舍的地界，那是先人所定的。

chapters.en: One witness is not enough to convict anyone accused of any crime or offense they may have committed. A matter must be established by the testimony of two or three witnesses.
chapters.zh: 人无论犯什么罪，作什么恶，不可凭一个人的口作见证，总要凭两三个人的口作见证才可定案。

chapters.en: If a malicious witness takes the stand to accuse someone of a crime,
chapters.zh: 若有凶恶的见证人起来，见证某人作恶，

chapters.en: the two people involved in the dispute must stand in the presence of the LORD before the priests and the judges who are in office at the time.
chapters.zh: 这两个争讼的人就要站在耶和华面前，和当时的祭司，并审判官面前，

chapters.en: The judges must make a thorough investigation, and if the witness proves to be a liar, giving false testimony against a fellow Israelite,
chapters.zh: 审判官要细细地查究，若见证人果然是作假见证的，以假见证陷害弟兄，

chapters.en: then do to the false witness as that witness intended to do to the other party. You must purge the evil from among you.
chapters.zh: 你们就要待他如同他想要待的弟兄。这样，就把那恶从你们中间除掉。

chapters.en: The rest of the people will hear of this and be afraid, and never again will such an evil thing be done among you.
chapters.zh: 别人听见都要害怕，就不敢在你们中间再行这样的恶了。

chapters.en: Show no pity: life for life, eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot.
chapters.zh: 你眼不可顾惜，要以命偿命，以眼还眼，以牙还牙，以手还手，以脚还脚。

chapters.en: When you go to war against your enemies and see horses and chariots and an army greater than yours, do not be afraid of them, because the LORD your God, who brought you up out of Egypt, will be with you.
chapters.zh: 你出去与仇敌争战的时候，看见马匹，车辆，并有比你多的人民，不要怕他们，因为领你出埃及地的耶和华你神与你同在。

chapters.en: When you are about to go into battle, the priest shall come forward and address the army.
chapters.zh: 你们将要上阵的时候，祭司要到百姓面前宣告，

chapters.en: He shall say: “Hear, Israel: Today you are going into battle against your enemies. Do not be fainthearted or afraid; do not panic or be terrified by them.
chapters.zh: 说，以色列人哪，你们当听，你们今日将要与仇敌争战，不要胆怯，不要惧怕战兢，也不要因他们惊恐。

chapters.en: For the LORD your God is the one who goes with you to fight for you against your enemies to give you victory.”
chapters.zh: 因为耶和华你们的神与你们同去，要为你们与仇敌争战，拯救你们。

chapters.en: The officers shall say to the army: “Has anyone built a new house and not yet begun to live in it? Let him go home, or he may die in battle and someone else may begin to live in it.
chapters.zh: 官长也要对百姓宣告说，谁建造房屋，尚未奉献，他可以回家去，恐怕他阵亡，别人去奉献。

chapters.en: Has anyone planted a vineyard and not begun to enjoy it? Let him go home, or he may die in battle and someone else enjoy it.
chapters.zh: 谁种葡萄园，尚未用所结的果子，他可以回家去，恐怕他阵亡，别人去用。

chapters.en: Has anyone become pledged to a woman and not married her? Let him go home, or he may die in battle and someone else marry her.”
chapters.zh: 谁聘定了妻，尚未迎娶，他可以回家去，恐怕他阵亡，别人去娶。

chapters.en: Then the officers shall add, “Is anyone afraid or fainthearted? Let him go home so that his fellow soldiers will not become disheartened too.”
chapters.zh: 官长又要对百姓宣告说，谁惧怕胆怯，他可以回家去，恐怕他弟兄的心消化，和他一样。

chapters.en: When the officers have finished speaking to the army, they shall appoint commanders over it.
chapters.zh: 官长对百姓宣告完了，就当派军长率领他们。

chapters.en: When you march up to attack a city, make its people an offer of peace.
chapters.zh: 你临近一座城，要攻打的时候，先要对城里的民宣告和睦的话。

chapters.en: If they accept and open their gates, all the people in it shall be subject to forced labor and shall work for you.
chapters.zh: 他们若以和睦的话回答你，给你开了城，城里所有的人都要给你效劳，服事你。

chapters.en: If they refuse to make peace and they engage you in battle, lay siege to that city.
chapters.zh: 若不肯与你和好，反要与你打仗，你就要围困那城。

chapters.en: When the LORD your God delivers it into your hand, put to the sword all the men in it.
chapters.zh: 耶和华你的神把城交付你手，你就要用刀杀尽这城的男丁。

chapters.en: As for the women, the children, the livestock and everything else in the city, you may take these as plunder for yourselves. And you may use the plunder the LORD your God gives you from your enemies.
chapters.zh: 惟有妇女，孩子，牲畜，和城内一切的财物，你可以取为自己的掠物。耶和华你神把你仇敌的财物赐给你，你可以吃用。

chapters.en: This is how you are to treat all the cities that are at a distance from you and do not belong to the nations nearby.
chapters.zh: 离你甚远的各城，不是这些国民的城，你都要这样待他。

chapters.en: However, in the cities of the nations the LORD your God is giving you as an inheritance, do not leave alive anything that breathes.
chapters.zh: 但这些国民的城，耶和华你神既赐你为业，其中凡有气息的，一个不可存留。

chapters.en: Completely destroy them—the Hittites, Amorites, Canaanites, Perizzites, Hivites and Jebusites—as the LORD your God has commanded you.
chapters.zh: 只要照耶和华你神所吩咐的将这赫人，亚摩利人，迦南人，比利洗人，希未人，耶布斯人都灭绝净尽，

chapters.en: Otherwise, they will teach you to follow all the detestable things they do in worshiping their gods, and you will sin against the LORD your God.
chapters.zh: 免得他们教导你们学习一切可憎恶的事，就是他们向自己神所行的，以致你们得罪耶和华你们的神。

chapters.en: When you lay siege to a city for a long time, fighting against it to capture it, do not destroy its trees by putting an ax to them, because you can eat their fruit. Do not cut them down. Are the trees people, that you should besiege them?
chapters.zh: 你若许久围困，攻打所要取的一座城，就不可举斧子砍坏树木。因为你可以吃那树上的果子，不可砍伐。田间的树木岂是人，叫你糟蹋吗？

chapters.en: However, you may cut down trees that you know are not fruit trees and use them to build siege works until the city at war with you falls.
chapters.zh: 惟独你所知道不是结果子的树木可以毁坏，砍伐，用以修筑营垒，攻击那与你打仗的城，直到攻塌了。

chapters.en: If someone is found slain, lying in a field in the land the LORD your God is giving you to possess, and it is not known who the killer was,
chapters.zh: 在耶和华你神所赐你为业的地上，若遇见被杀的人倒在田野，不知道是谁杀的，

chapters.en: your elders and judges shall go out and measure the distance from the body to the neighboring towns.
chapters.zh: 长老和审判官就要出去，从被杀的人那里量起，直量到四围的城邑，

chapters.en: Then the elders of the town nearest the body shall take a heifer that has never been worked and has never worn a yoke
chapters.zh: 看哪城离被杀的人最近，那城的长老就要从牛群中取一只未曾耕地，未曾负轭的母牛犊，

chapters.en: and lead it down to a valley that has not been plowed or planted and where there is a flowing stream. There in the valley they are to break the heifer’s neck.
chapters.zh: 把母牛犊牵到流水，未曾耕种的山谷去，在谷中打折母牛犊的颈项。

chapters.en: The Levitical priests shall step forward, for the LORD your God has chosen them to minister and to pronounce blessings in the name of the LORD and to decide all cases of dispute and assault.
chapters.zh: 祭司利未的子孙要近前来。因为耶和华你的神拣选了他们事奉他，奉耶和华的名祝福，所有争讼殴打的事都要凭他们判断。

chapters.en: Then all the elders of the town nearest the body shall wash their hands over the heifer whose neck was broken in the valley,
chapters.zh: 那城的众长老，就是离被杀的人最近的，要在那山谷中，在所打折颈项的母牛犊以上洗手，

chapters.en: and they shall declare: “Our hands did not shed this blood, nor did our eyes see it done.
chapters.zh: 祷告（原文作回答）说，我们的手未曾流这人的血。我们的眼也未曾看见这事。

chapters.en: Accept this atonement for your people Israel, whom you have redeemed, LORD, and do not hold your people guilty of the blood of an innocent person.” Then the bloodshed will be atoned for,
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，求你赦免你所救赎的以色列民，不要使流无辜血的罪归在你的百姓以色列中间。这样，流血的罪必得赦免。

chapters.en: and you will have purged from yourselves the guilt of shedding innocent blood, since you have done what is right in the eyes of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 你行耶和华眼中看为正的事，就可以从你们中间除掉流无辜血的罪。

chapters.en: When you go to war against your enemies and the LORD your God delivers them into your hands and you take captives,
chapters.zh: 你出去与仇敌争战的时候，耶和华你的神将他们交在你手中，你就掳了他们去，

chapters.en: if you notice among the captives a beautiful woman and are attracted to her, you may take her as your wife.
chapters.zh: 若在被掳的人中见有美貌的女子，恋慕她，要娶她为妻，

chapters.en: Bring her into your home and have her shave her head, trim her nails
chapters.zh: 就可以领她到你家里去。她便要剃头发，修指甲，

chapters.en: and put aside the clothes she was wearing when captured. After she has lived in your house and mourned her father and mother for a full month, then you may go to her and be her husband and she shall be your wife.
chapters.zh: 脱去被掳时所穿的衣服，住在你家里哀哭父母一个整月，然后可以与她同房。你作她的丈夫，她作你的妻子。

chapters.en: If you are not pleased with her, let her go wherever she wishes. You must not sell her or treat her as a slave, since you have dishonored her.
chapters.zh: 后来你若不喜悦她，就要由她随意出去，决不可为钱卖她，也不可当婢女待她，因为你玷污了她。

chapters.en: If a man has two wives, and he loves one but not the other, and both bear him sons but the firstborn is the son of the wife he does not love,
chapters.zh: 人若有二妻，一为所爱，一为所恶，所爱的，所恶的都给他生了儿子，但长子是所恶之妻生的。

chapters.en: when he wills his property to his sons, he must not give the rights of the firstborn to the son of the wife he loves in preference to his actual firstborn, the son of the wife he does not love.
chapters.zh: 到了把产业分给儿子承受的时候，不可将所爱之妻生的儿子立为长子，在所恶之妻生的儿子以上，

chapters.en: He must acknowledge the son of his unloved wife as the firstborn by giving him a double share of all he has. That son is the first sign of his father’s strength. The right of the firstborn belongs to him.
chapters.zh: 却要认所恶之妻生的儿子为长子，将产业多加一分给他。因这儿子是他力量强壮的时候生的，长子的名分本当归他。

chapters.en: If someone has a stubborn and rebellious son who does not obey his father and mother and will not listen to them when they discipline him,
chapters.zh: 人若有顽梗悖逆的儿子，不听从父母的话，他们虽惩治他，他仍不听从，

chapters.en: his father and mother shall take hold of him and bring him to the elders at the gate of his town.
chapters.zh: 父母就要抓住他，将他带到本地的城门，本城的长老那里，

chapters.en: They shall say to the elders, “This son of ours is stubborn and rebellious. He will not obey us. He is a glutton and a drunkard.”
chapters.zh: 对长老说，我们这儿子顽梗悖逆，不听从我们的话，是贪食好酒的人。

chapters.en: Then all the men of his town are to stone him to death. You must purge the evil from among you. All Israel will hear of it and be afraid.
chapters.zh: 本城的众人就要用石头将他打死。这样，就把那恶从你们中间除掉，以色列众人都要听见害怕。

chapters.en: If someone guilty of a capital offense is put to death and their body is exposed on a pole,
chapters.zh: 人若犯该死的罪，被治死了，你将他挂在木头上，

chapters.en: you must not leave the body hanging on the pole overnight. Be sure to bury it that same day, because anyone who is hung on a pole is under God’s curse. You must not desecrate the land the LORD your God is giving you as an inheritance.
chapters.zh: 他的尸首不可留在木头上过夜，必要当日将他葬埋，免得玷污了耶和华你神所赐你为业之地。因为被挂的人是在神面前受咒诅的。

chapters.en: If you see your fellow Israelite’s ox or sheep straying, do not ignore it but be sure to take it back to its owner.
chapters.zh: 你若看见弟兄的牛或羊失迷了路，不可佯为不见，总要把它牵回来交给你的弟兄。

chapters.en: If they do not live near you or if you do not know who owns it, take it home with you and keep it until they come looking for it. Then give it back.
chapters.zh: 你弟兄若离你远，或是你不认识他，就要牵到你家去，留在你那里，等你弟兄来寻找就还给他。

chapters.en: Do the same if you find their donkey or cloak or anything else they have lost. Do not ignore it.
chapters.zh: 你的弟兄无论失落什么，或是驴，或是衣服，你若遇见，都要这样行，不可佯为不见。

chapters.en: If you see your fellow Israelite’s donkey or ox fallen on the road, do not ignore it. Help the owner get it to its feet.
chapters.zh: 你若看见弟兄的牛或驴跌倒在路上，不可佯为不见，总要帮助他拉起来。

chapters.en: A woman must not wear men’s clothing, nor a man wear women’s clothing, for the LORD your God detests anyone who does this.
chapters.zh: 妇女不可穿戴男子所穿戴的，男子也不可穿妇女的衣服，因为这样行都是耶和华你神所憎恶的。

chapters.en: If you come across a bird’s nest beside the road, either in a tree or on the ground, and the mother is sitting on the young or on the eggs, do not take the mother with the young.
chapters.zh: 你若路上遇见鸟窝，或在树上或在地上，里头有雏或有蛋，母鸟伏在雏上或在蛋上，你不可连母带雏一并取去。

chapters.en: You may take the young, but be sure to let the mother go, so that it may go well with you and you may have a long life.
chapters.zh: 总要放母，只可取雏，这样你就可以享福，日子得以长久。

chapters.en: When you build a new house, make a parapet around your roof so that you may not bring the guilt of bloodshed on your house if someone falls from the roof.
chapters.zh: 你若建造房屋，要在房上的四围安栏杆，免得有人从房上掉下来，流血的罪就归于你家。

chapters.en: Do not plant two kinds of seed in your vineyard; if you do, not only the crops you plant but also the fruit of the vineyard will be defiled.
chapters.zh: 不可把两样种子种在你的葡萄园里，免得你撒种所结的和葡萄园的果子都要充公。

chapters.en: Do not plow with an ox and a donkey yoked together.
chapters.zh: 不可并用牛，驴耕地。

chapters.en: Do not wear clothes of wool and linen woven together.
chapters.zh: 不可穿羊毛，细麻两样搀杂料作的衣服。

chapters.en: Make tassels on the four corners of the cloak you wear.
chapters.zh: 你要在所披的外衣上四围作繸子。

chapters.en: If a man takes a wife and, after sleeping with her, dislikes her
chapters.zh: 人若娶妻，与她同房之后恨恶她，

chapters.en: and slanders her and gives her a bad name, saying, “I married this woman, but when I approached her, I did not find proof of her virginity,”
chapters.zh: 信口说她，将丑名加在她身上，说，我娶了这女子，与她同房，见她没有贞洁的凭据。

chapters.en: then the young woman’s father and mother shall bring to the town elders at the gate proof that she was a virgin.
chapters.zh: 女子的父母就要把女子贞洁的凭据拿出来，带到本城门长老那里。

chapters.en: Her father will say to the elders, “I gave my daughter in marriage to this man, but he dislikes her.
chapters.zh: 女子的父亲要对长老说，我将我的女儿给这人为妻，他恨恶她，

chapters.en: Now he has slandered her and said, ‘I did not find your daughter to be a virgin.’ But here is the proof of my daughter’s virginity.” Then her parents shall display the cloth before the elders of the town,
chapters.zh: 信口说她，说，我见你的女儿没有贞洁的凭据。其实这就是我女儿贞洁的凭据。父母就把那布铺在本城的长老面前。

chapters.en: and the elders shall take the man and punish him.
chapters.zh: 本城的长老要拿住那人，惩治他，

chapters.en: They shall fine him a hundred shekels of silver and give them to the young woman’s father, because this man has given an Israelite virgin a bad name. She shall continue to be his wife; he must not divorce her as long as he lives.
chapters.zh: 并要罚他一百舍客勒银子，给女子的父亲，因为他将丑名加在以色列的一个处女身上。女子仍作他的妻，终身不可休她。

chapters.en: If, however, the charge is true and no proof of the young woman’s virginity can be found,
chapters.zh: 但这事若是真的，女子没有贞洁的凭据，

chapters.en: she shall be brought to the door of her father’s house and there the men of her town shall stone her to death. She has done an outrageous thing in Israel by being promiscuous while still in her father’s house. You must purge the evil from among you.
chapters.zh: 就要将女子带到她父家的门口，本城的人要用石头将她打死。因为她在父家行了淫乱，在以色列中作了丑事。这样，就把那恶从你们中间除掉。

chapters.en: If a man is found sleeping with another man’s wife, both the man who slept with her and the woman must die. You must purge the evil from Israel.
chapters.zh: 若遇见人与有丈夫的妇人行淫，就要将奸夫淫妇一并治死。这样，就把那恶从以色列中除掉。

chapters.en: If a man happens to meet in a town a virgin pledged to be married and he sleeps with her,
chapters.zh: 若有处女已经许配丈夫，有人在城里遇见她，与她行淫，

chapters.en: you shall take both of them to the gate of that town and stone them to death—the young woman because she was in a town and did not scream for help, and the man because he violated another man’s wife. You must purge the evil from among you.
chapters.zh: 你们就要把这二人带到本城门，用石头打死女子是因为虽在城里却没有喊叫。男子是因为玷污别人的妻。这样，就把那恶从你们中间除掉。

chapters.en: But if out in the country a man happens to meet a young woman pledged to be married and rapes her, only the man who has done this shall die.
chapters.zh: 若有男子在田野遇见已经许配人的女子，强与她行淫，只要将那男子治死。

chapters.en: Do nothing to the woman; she has committed no sin deserving death. This case is like that of someone who attacks and murders a neighbor,
chapters.zh: 但不可办女子。她本没有该死的罪，这事就类乎人起来攻击邻舍，将他杀了一样。

chapters.en: for the man found the young woman out in the country, and though the betrothed woman screamed, there was no one to rescue her.
chapters.zh: 因为男子是在田野遇见那已经许配人的女子，女子喊叫，并无人救她。

chapters.en: If a man happens to meet a virgin who is not pledged to be married and rapes her and they are discovered,
chapters.zh: 若有男子遇见没有许配人的处女，抓住她，与她行淫，被人看见，

chapters.en: he shall pay her father fifty shekels of silver. He must marry the young woman, for he has violated her. He can never divorce her as long as he lives.
chapters.zh: 这男子就要拿五十舍客勒银子给女子的父亲。因他玷污了这女子，就要娶她为妻，终身不可休她。

chapters.en: A man is not to marry his father’s wife; he must not dishonor his father’s bed.
chapters.zh: 人不可娶继母为妻。不可掀开他父亲的衣襟。

chapters.en: No one who has been emasculated by crushing or cutting may enter the assembly of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 凡外肾受伤的，或被阉割的，不可入耶和华的会。

chapters.en: No one born of a forbidden marriage nor any of their descendants may enter the assembly of the LORD, not even in the tenth generation.
chapters.zh: 私生子不可入耶和华的会。他的子孙，直到十代，也不可入耶和华的会。

chapters.en: No Ammonite or Moabite or any of their descendants may enter the assembly of the LORD, not even in the tenth generation.
chapters.zh: 亚扪人或是摩押人不可入耶和华的会。他们的子孙，虽过十代，也永不可入耶和华的会。

chapters.en: For they did not come to meet you with bread and water on your way when you came out of Egypt, and they hired Balaam son of Beor from Pethor in Aram Naharaim to pronounce a curse on you.
chapters.zh: 因为你们出埃及的时候，他们没有拿食物和水在路上迎接你们，又因他们雇了米所波大米的毗夺人比珥的儿子巴兰来咒诅你们。

chapters.en: However, the LORD your God would not listen to Balaam but turned the curse into a blessing for you, because the LORD your God loves you.
chapters.zh: 然而耶和华你的神不肯听从巴兰，却使那咒诅的言语变为祝福的话，因为耶和华你的神爱你。

chapters.en: Do not seek a treaty of friendship with them as long as you live.
chapters.zh: 你一生一世永不可求他们的平安和他们的利益。

chapters.en: Do not despise an Edomite, for the Edomites are related to you. Do not despise an Egyptian, because you resided as foreigners in their country.
chapters.zh: 不可憎恶以东人，因为他是你的弟兄。不可憎恶埃及人，因为你在他的地上作过寄居的。

chapters.en: The third generation of children born to them may enter the assembly of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 他们第三代子孙可以入耶和华的会。

chapters.en: When you are encamped against your enemies, keep away from everything impure.
chapters.zh: 你出兵攻打仇敌，就要远避诸恶。

chapters.en: If one of your men is unclean because of a nocturnal emission, he is to go outside the camp and stay there.
chapters.zh: 你们中间，若有人夜间偶然梦遗，不洁净，就要出到营外，不可入营。

chapters.en: But as evening approaches he is to wash himself, and at sunset he may return to the camp.
chapters.zh: 到傍晚的时候，他要用水洗澡，及至日落了才可以入营。

chapters.en: Designate a place outside the camp where you can go to relieve yourself.
chapters.zh: 你在营外也该定出一个地方作为便所。

chapters.en: As part of your equipment have something to dig with, and when you relieve yourself, dig a hole and cover up your excrement.
chapters.zh: 在你器械之中当预备一把锹，你出营外便溺以后，用以铲土，转身掩盖。

chapters.en: For the LORD your God moves about in your camp to protect you and to deliver your enemies to you. Your camp must be holy, so that he will not see among you anything indecent and turn away from you.
chapters.zh: 因为耶和华你的神常在你营中行走，要救护你，将仇敌交给你，所以你的营理当圣洁，免得他见你那里有污秽，就离开你。

chapters.en: If a slave has taken refuge with you, do not hand them over to their master.
chapters.zh: 若有奴仆脱了主人的手，逃到你那里，你不可将他交付他的主人。

chapters.en: Let them live among you wherever they like and in whatever town they choose. Do not oppress them.
chapters.zh: 他必在你那里与你同住，在你的城邑中，要由他选择一个所喜悦的地方居住。你不可欺负他。

chapters.en: No Israelite man or woman is to become a shrine prostitute.
chapters.zh: 以色列的女子中不可有妓女。以色列的男子中不可有娈童。

chapters.en: You must not bring the earnings of a female prostitute or of a male prostitute into the house of the LORD your God to pay any vow, because the LORD your God detests them both.
chapters.zh: 娼妓所得的钱，或娈童（原文作狗）所得的价，你不可带入耶和华你神的殿还愿，因为这两样都是耶和华你神所憎恶的。

chapters.en: Do not charge a fellow Israelite interest, whether on money or food or anything else that may earn interest.
chapters.zh: 你借给你弟兄的，或是钱财或是粮食，无论什么可生利的物，都不可取利。

chapters.en: You may charge a foreigner interest, but not a fellow Israelite, so that the LORD your God may bless you in everything you put your hand to in the land you are entering to possess.
chapters.zh: 借给外邦人可以取利，只是借给你弟兄不可取利。这样，耶和华你神必在你所去得为业的地上和你手里所办的一切事上赐福与你。

chapters.en: If you make a vow to the LORD your God, do not be slow to pay it, for the LORD your God will certainly demand it of you and you will be guilty of sin.
chapters.zh: 你向耶和华你的神许愿，偿还不可迟延。因为耶和华你的神必定向你追讨，你不偿还就有罪。

chapters.en: But if you refrain from making a vow, you will not be guilty.
chapters.zh: 你若不许愿，倒无罪。

chapters.en: Whatever your lips utter you must be sure to do, because you made your vow freely to the LORD your God with your own mouth.
chapters.zh: 你嘴里所出的，就是你口中应许甘心所献的，要照你向耶和华你神所许的愿谨守遵行。

chapters.en: If you enter your neighbor’s vineyard, you may eat all the grapes you want, but do not put any in your basket.
chapters.zh: 你进了邻舍的葡萄园，可以随意吃饱了葡萄，只是不可装在器皿中。

chapters.en: If you enter your neighbor’s grainfield, you may pick kernels with your hands, but you must not put a sickle to their standing grain.
chapters.zh: 你进了邻舍站着的禾稼，可以用手摘穗子，只是不可用镰刀割取禾稼。

chapters.en: If a man marries a woman who becomes displeasing to him because he finds something indecent about her, and he writes her a certificate of divorce, gives it to her and sends her from his house,
chapters.zh: 人若娶妻以后，见她有什么不合理的事，不喜悦她，就可以写休书交在她手中，打发她离开夫家。

chapters.en: and if after she leaves his house she becomes the wife of another man,
chapters.zh: 妇人离开夫家以后，可以去嫁别人。

chapters.en: and her second husband dislikes her and writes her a certificate of divorce, gives it to her and sends her from his house, or if he dies,
chapters.zh: 后夫若恨恶她，写休书交在她手中，打发她离开夫家，或是娶她为妻的后夫死了，

chapters.en: then her first husband, who divorced her, is not allowed to marry her again after she has been defiled. That would be detestable in the eyes of the LORD. Do not bring sin upon the land the LORD your God is giving you as an inheritance.
chapters.zh: 打发她去的前夫不可在妇人玷污之后再娶她为妻，因为这是耶和华所憎恶的。不可使耶和华你神所赐为业之地被玷污了。

chapters.en: If a man has recently married, he must not be sent to war or have any other duty laid on him. For one year he is to be free to stay at home and bring happiness to the wife he has married.
chapters.zh: 新娶妻之人不可从军出征，也不可托他办理什么公事，可以在家清闲一年，使他所娶的妻快活。

chapters.en: Do not take a pair of millstones—not even the upper one—as security for a debt, because that would be taking a person’s livelihood as security.
chapters.zh: 不可拿人的全盘磨石或是上磨石作当头，因为这是拿人的命作当头。

chapters.en: If someone is caught kidnapping a fellow Israelite and treating or selling them as a slave, the kidnapper must die. You must purge the evil from among you.
chapters.zh: 若遇见人拐带以色列中的一个弟兄，当奴才待他，或是卖了他，那拐带人的就必治死。这样，便将那恶从你们中间除掉。

chapters.en: In cases of defiling skin diseases, be very careful to do exactly as the Levitical priests instruct you. You must follow carefully what I have commanded them.
chapters.zh: 在大麻疯的灾病上，你们要谨慎，照祭司利未人一切所指教你们的留意遵行。我怎样吩咐他们，你们要怎样遵行。

chapters.en: Remember what the LORD your God did to Miriam along the way after you came out of Egypt.
chapters.zh: 当记念出埃及后，在路上，耶和华你神向米利暗所行的事。

chapters.en: When you make a loan of any kind to your neighbor, do not go into their house to get what is offered to you as a pledge.
chapters.zh: 你借给邻舍，不拘是什么，不可进他家拿他的当头。

chapters.en: Stay outside and let the neighbor to whom you are making the loan bring the pledge out to you.
chapters.zh: 要站在外面，等那向你借贷的人把当头拿出来交给你。

chapters.en: If the neighbor is poor, do not go to sleep with their pledge in your possession.
chapters.zh: 他若是穷人，你不可留他的当头过夜。

chapters.en: Return their cloak by sunset so that your neighbor may sleep in it. Then they will thank you, and it will be regarded as a righteous act in the sight of the LORD your God.
chapters.zh: 日落的时候，总要把当头还他，使他用那件衣服盖着睡觉，他就为你祝福。这在耶和华你神面前就是你的义了。

chapters.en: Do not take advantage of a hired worker who is poor and needy, whether that worker is a fellow Israelite or a foreigner residing in one of your towns.
chapters.zh: 困苦穷乏的雇工，无论是你的弟兄或是在你城里寄居的，你不可欺负他。

chapters.en: Pay them their wages each day before sunset, because they are poor and are counting on it. Otherwise they may cry to the LORD against you, and you will be guilty of sin.
chapters.zh: 要当日给他工价，不可等到日落。因为他穷苦，把心放在工价上，恐怕他因你求告耶和华，罪便归你了。

chapters.en: Parents are not to be put to death for their children, nor children put to death for their parents; each will die for their own sin.
chapters.zh: 不可因子杀父，也不可因父杀子。凡被杀的都为本身的罪。

chapters.en: Do not deprive the foreigner or the fatherless of justice, or take the cloak of the widow as a pledge.
chapters.zh: 你不可向寄居的和孤儿屈枉正直，也不可拿寡妇的衣裳作当头。

chapters.en: Remember that you were slaves in Egypt and the LORD your God redeemed you from there. That is why I command you to do this.
chapters.zh: 要记念你在埃及作过奴仆。耶和华你的神从那里将你救赎，所以我吩咐你这样行。

chapters.en: When you are harvesting in your field and you overlook a sheaf, do not go back to get it. Leave it for the foreigner, the fatherless and the widow, so that the LORD your God may bless you in all the work of your hands.
chapters.zh: 你在田间收割庄稼，若忘下一捆，不可回去再取，要留给寄居的与孤儿寡妇。这样，耶和华你神必在你手里所办的一切事上赐福与你。

chapters.en: When you beat the olives from your trees, do not go over the branches a second time. Leave what remains for the foreigner, the fatherless and the widow.
chapters.zh: 你打橄榄树，枝上剩下的，不可再打。要留给寄居的与孤儿寡妇。

chapters.en: When you harvest the grapes in your vineyard, do not go over the vines again. Leave what remains for the foreigner, the fatherless and the widow.
chapters.zh: 你摘葡萄园的葡萄，所剩下的，不可再摘。要留给寄居的与孤儿寡妇。

chapters.en: Remember that you were slaves in Egypt. That is why I command you to do this.
chapters.zh: 你也要记念你在埃及地作过奴仆，所以我吩咐你这样行。

chapters.en: When people have a dispute, they are to take it to court and the judges will decide the case, acquitting the innocent and condemning the guilty.
chapters.zh: 人若有争讼，来听审判，审判官就要定义人有理，定恶人有罪。

chapters.en: If the guilty person deserves to be beaten, the judge shall make them lie down and have them flogged in his presence with the number of lashes the crime deserves,
chapters.zh: 恶人若该受责打，审判官就要叫他当面伏在地上，按着他的罪照数责打。

chapters.en: but the judge must not impose more than forty lashes. If the guilty party is flogged more than that, your fellow Israelite will be degraded in your eyes.
chapters.zh: 只可打他四十下，不可过数。若过数，便是轻贱你的弟兄了。

chapters.en: Do not muzzle an ox while it is treading out the grain.
chapters.zh: 牛在场上踹谷的时候，不可笼住它的嘴。

chapters.en: If brothers are living together and one of them dies without a son, his widow must not marry outside the family. Her husband’s brother shall take her and marry her and fulfill the duty of a brother-in-law to her.
chapters.zh: 弟兄同居，若死了一个，没有儿子，死人的妻不可出嫁外人，她丈夫的兄弟当尽弟兄的本分，娶她为妻，与她同房。

chapters.en: The first son she bears shall carry on the name of the dead brother so that his name will not be blotted out from Israel.
chapters.zh: 妇人生的长子必归死兄的名下，免得他的名在以色列中涂抹了。

chapters.en: However, if a man does not want to marry his brother’s wife, she shall go to the elders at the town gate and say, “My husband’s brother refuses to carry on his brother’s name in Israel. He will not fulfill the duty of a brother-in-law to me.”
chapters.zh: 那人若不愿意娶他哥哥的妻，他哥哥的妻就要到城门长老那里，说，我丈夫的兄弟不肯在以色列中兴起他哥哥的名字，不给我尽弟兄的本分。

chapters.en: Then the elders of his town shall summon him and talk to him. If he persists in saying, “I do not want to marry her,”
chapters.zh: 本城的长老就要召那人来问他，他若执意说，我不愿意娶她，

chapters.en: his brother’s widow shall go up to him in the presence of the elders, take off one of his sandals, spit in his face and say, “This is what is done to the man who will not build up his brother’s family line.”
chapters.zh: 他哥哥的妻就要当着长老到那人的跟前，脱了他的鞋，吐唾沫在他脸上，说，凡不为哥哥建立家室的都要这样待他。

chapters.en: That man’s line shall be known in Israel as The Family of the Unsandaled.
chapters.zh: 在以色列中，他的名必称为脱鞋之家。

chapters.en: If two men are fighting and the wife of one of them comes to rescue her husband from his assailant, and she reaches out and seizes him by his private parts,
chapters.zh: 若有二人争斗，这人的妻近前来，要救她丈夫脱离那打她丈夫之人的手，抓住那人的下体，

chapters.en: you shall cut off her hand. Show her no pity.
chapters.zh: 就要砍断妇人的手，眼不可顾惜她。

chapters.en: Do not have two differing weights in your bag—one heavy, one light.
chapters.zh: 你囊中不可有一大一小两样的法码。

chapters.en: Do not have two differing measures in your house—one large, one small.
chapters.zh: 你家里不可有一大一小两样的升斗。

chapters.en: You must have accurate and honest weights and measures, so that you may live long in the land the LORD your God is giving you.
chapters.zh: 当用对准公平的法码，公平的升斗。这样，在耶和华你神所赐你的地上，你的日子就可以长久。

chapters.en: For the LORD your God detests anyone who does these things, anyone who deals dishonestly.
chapters.zh: 因为行非义之事的人都是耶和华你神所憎恶的。

chapters.en: Remember what the Amalekites did to you along the way when you came out of Egypt.
chapters.zh: 你要记念你们出埃及的时候，亚玛力人在路上怎样待你。

chapters.en: When you were weary and worn out, they met you on your journey and attacked all who were lagging behind; they had no fear of God.
chapters.zh: 他们在路上遇见你，趁你疲乏困倦击杀你尽后边软弱的人，并不敬畏神。

chapters.en: When the LORD your God gives you rest from all the enemies around you in the land he is giving you to possess as an inheritance, you shall blot out the name of Amalek from under heaven. Do not forget!
chapters.zh: 所以耶和华你神使你不被四围一切的仇敌扰乱，在耶和华你神赐你为业的地上得享平安。那时，你要将亚玛力的名号从天下涂抹了，不可忘记。

chapters.en: When you have entered the land the LORD your God is giving you as an inheritance and have taken possession of it and settled in it,
chapters.zh: 你进去得了耶和华你神所赐你为业之地居住，

chapters.en: take some of the firstfruits of all that you produce from the soil of the land the LORD your God is giving you and put them in a basket. Then go to the place the LORD your God will choose as a dwelling for his Name
chapters.zh: 就要从耶和华你神赐你的地上将所收的各种初熟的土产取些来，盛在筐子里，往耶和华你神所选择要立为他名的居所去，

chapters.en: and say to the priest in office at the time, “I declare today to the LORD your God that I have come to the land the LORD swore to our ancestors to give us.”
chapters.zh: 见当时作祭司的，对他说，我今日向耶和华你神明认，我已来到耶和华向我们列祖起誓应许赐给我们的地。

chapters.en: The priest shall take the basket from your hands and set it down in front of the altar of the LORD your God.
chapters.zh: 祭司就从你手里取过筐子来，放在耶和华你神的坛前。

chapters.en: Then you shall declare before the LORD your God: “My father was a wandering Aramean, and he went down into Egypt with a few people and lived there and became a great nation, powerful and numerous.
chapters.zh: 你要在耶和华你神面前说，我祖原是一个将亡的亚兰人，下到埃及寄居。他人口稀少，在那里却成了又大又强，人数很多的国民。

chapters.en: But the Egyptians mistreated us and made us suffer, subjecting us to harsh labor.
chapters.zh: 埃及人恶待我们，苦害我们，将苦工加在我们身上。

chapters.en: Then we cried out to the LORD, the God of our ancestors, and the LORD heard our voice and saw our misery, toil and oppression.
chapters.zh: 于是我们哀求耶和华我们列祖的神，耶和华听见我们的声音，看见我们所受的困苦，劳碌，欺压，

chapters.en: So the LORD brought us out of Egypt with a mighty hand and an outstretched arm, with great terror and with signs and wonders.
chapters.zh: 他就用大能的手和伸出来的膀臂，并大可畏的事与神迹奇事，领我们出了埃及，

chapters.en: He brought us to this place and gave us this land, a land flowing with milk and honey;
chapters.zh: 将我们领进这地方，把这流奶与蜜之地赐给我们。

chapters.en: and now I bring the firstfruits of the soil that you, LORD, have given me.” Place the basket before the LORD your God and bow down before him.
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，现在我把你所赐给我地上初熟的土产奉了来。随后你要把筐子放在耶和华你神面前，向耶和华你的神下拜。

chapters.en: Then you and the Levites and the foreigners residing among you shall rejoice in all the good things the LORD your God has given to you and your household.
chapters.zh: 你和利未人，并在你们中间寄居的，要因耶和华你神所赐你和你家的一切福分欢乐。

chapters.en: When you have finished setting aside a tenth of all your produce in the third year, the year of the tithe, you shall give it to the Levite, the foreigner, the fatherless and the widow, so that they may eat in your towns and be satisfied.
chapters.zh: 每逢三年，就是十分取一之年，你取完了一切土产的十分之一，要分给利未人和寄居的，与孤儿寡妇，使他们在你城中可以吃得饱足。

chapters.en: Then say to the LORD your God: “I have removed from my house the sacred portion and have given it to the Levite, the foreigner, the fatherless and the widow, according to all you commanded. I have not turned aside from your commands nor have I forgotten any of them.
chapters.zh: 你又要在耶和华你神面前说，我已将圣物从我家里拿出来，给了利未人和寄居的，与孤儿寡妇，是照你所吩咐我的一切命令。你的命令我都没有违背，也没有忘记。

chapters.en: I have not eaten any of the sacred portion while I was in mourning, nor have I removed any of it while I was unclean, nor have I offered any of it to the dead. I have obeyed the LORD my God; I have done everything you commanded me.
chapters.zh: 我守丧的时候，没有吃这圣物。不洁净的时候，也没有拿出来，又没有为死人送去。我听从了耶和华我神的话，都照你所吩咐的行了。

chapters.en: Look down from heaven, your holy dwelling place, and bless your people Israel and the land you have given us as you promised on oath to our ancestors, a land flowing with milk and honey.”
chapters.zh: 求你从天上，你的圣所垂看，赐福给你的百姓以色列与你所赐给我们的地，就是你向我们列祖起誓赐我们流奶与蜜之地。

chapters.en: The LORD your God commands you this day to follow these decrees and laws; carefully observe them with all your heart and with all your soul.
chapters.zh: 耶和华你的神今日吩咐你行这些律例典章，所以你要尽心尽性谨守遵行。

chapters.en: You have declared this day that the LORD is your God and that you will walk in obedience to him, that you will keep his decrees, commands and laws—that you will listen to him.
chapters.zh: 你今日认耶和华为你的神，应许遵行他的道，谨守他的律例，诫命，典章，听从他的话。

chapters.en: And the LORD has declared this day that you are his people, his treasured possession as he promised, and that you are to keep all his commands.
chapters.zh: 耶和华今日照他所应许你的，也认你为他的子民，使你谨守他的一切诫命，

chapters.en: He has declared that he will set you in praise, fame and honor high above all the nations he has made and that you will be a people holy to the LORD your God, as he promised.
chapters.zh: 又使你得称赞，美名，尊荣，超乎他所造的万民之上，并照他所应许的使你归耶和华你神为圣洁的民。

chapters.en: Moses and the elders of Israel commanded the people: “Keep all these commands that I give you today.
chapters.zh: 摩西和以色列的众长老吩咐百姓说，你们要遵守我今日所吩咐的一切诫命。

chapters.en: When you have crossed the Jordan into the land the LORD your God is giving you, set up some large stones and coat them with plaster.
chapters.zh: 你们过约旦河，到了耶和华你神所赐给你的地，当天要立起几块大石头，墁上石灰，

chapters.en: Write on them all the words of this law when you have crossed over to enter the land the LORD your God is giving you, a land flowing with milk and honey, just as the LORD, the God of your ancestors, promised you.
chapters.zh: 把这律法的一切话写在石头上。你过了河，可以进入耶和华你神所赐你流奶与蜜之地，正如耶和华你列祖之神所应许你的。

chapters.en: And when you have crossed the Jordan, set up these stones on Mount Ebal, as I command you today, and coat them with plaster.
chapters.zh: 你们过了约旦河，就要在以巴路山上照我今日所吩咐的，将这些石头立起来，墁上石灰。

chapters.en: Build there an altar to the LORD your God, an altar of stones. Do not use any iron tool on them.
chapters.zh: 在那里要为耶和华你的神筑一座石坛。在石头上不可动铁器。

chapters.en: Build the altar of the LORD your God with fieldstones and offer burnt offerings on it to the LORD your God.
chapters.zh: 要用没有凿过的石头筑耶和华你神的坛，在坛上要将燔祭献给耶和华你的神。

chapters.en: Sacrifice fellowship offerings there, eating them and rejoicing in the presence of the LORD your God.
chapters.zh: 又要献平安祭，且在那里吃，在耶和华你的神面前欢乐。

chapters.en: And you shall write very clearly all the words of this law on these stones you have set up.”
chapters.zh: 你要将这律法的一切话明明地写在石头上。

chapters.en: Then Moses and the Levitical priests said to all Israel, “Be silent, Israel, and listen! You have now become the people of the LORD your God.
chapters.zh: 摩西和祭司利未人晓谕以色列众人说，以色列阿，要默默静听。你今日成为耶和华你神的百姓了。

chapters.en: Obey the LORD your God and follow his commands and decrees that I give you today.”
chapters.zh: 所以要听从耶和华你神的话，遵行他的诫命律例，就是我今日所吩咐你的。

chapters.en: On the same day Moses commanded the people:
chapters.zh: 当日，摩西嘱咐百姓说，

chapters.en: When you have crossed the Jordan, these tribes shall stand on Mount Gerizim to bless the people: Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Joseph and Benjamin.
chapters.zh: 你们过了约旦河，西缅，利未，犹大，以萨迦，约瑟，便雅悯六个支派的人都要站在基利心山上为百姓祝福。

chapters.en: And these tribes shall stand on Mount Ebal to pronounce curses: Reuben, Gad, Asher, Zebulun, Dan and Naphtali.
chapters.zh: 流便，迦得，亚设，西布伦，但，拿弗他利六个支派的人都要站在以巴路山上宣布咒诅。

chapters.en: The Levites shall recite to all the people of Israel in a loud voice:
chapters.zh: 利未人要向以色列众人高声说，

chapters.en: “Cursed is anyone who makes an idol—a thing detestable to the LORD, the work of skilled hands—and sets it up in secret.” Then all the people shall say, “Amen!”
chapters.zh: 有人制造耶和华所憎恶的偶像，或雕刻，或铸造，就是工匠手所作的，在暗中设立，那人必受咒诅。百姓都要答应说，阿们。

chapters.en: “Cursed is anyone who dishonors their father or mother.” Then all the people shall say, “Amen!”
chapters.zh: 轻慢父母的，必受咒诅。百姓都要说，阿们。

chapters.en: “Cursed is anyone who moves their neighbor’s boundary stone.” Then all the people shall say, “Amen!”
chapters.zh: 挪移邻舍地界的，必受咒诅。百姓都要说，阿们。

chapters.en: “Cursed is anyone who leads the blind astray on the road.” Then all the people shall say, “Amen!”
chapters.zh: 使瞎子走差路的，必受咒诅。百姓都要说，阿们。

chapters.en: “Cursed is anyone who withholds justice from the foreigner, the fatherless or the widow.” Then all the people shall say, “Amen!”
chapters.zh: 向寄居的和孤儿寡妇屈枉正直的，必受咒诅。百姓都要说，阿们。

chapters.en: “Cursed is anyone who sleeps with his father’s wife, for he dishonors his father’s bed.” Then all the people shall say, “Amen!”
chapters.zh: 与继母行淫的，必受咒诅。因为掀开他父亲的衣襟。百姓都要说，阿们。

chapters.en: “Cursed is anyone who has sexual relations with any animal.” Then all the people shall say, “Amen!”
chapters.zh: 与兽淫合的，必受咒诅。百姓都要说，阿们。

chapters.en: “Cursed is anyone who sleeps with his sister, the daughter of his father or the daughter of his mother.” Then all the people shall say, “Amen!”
chapters.zh: 与异母同父，或异父同母的姐妹行淫的，必受咒诅。百姓都要说，阿们。

chapters.en: “Cursed is anyone who sleeps with his mother-in-law.” Then all the people shall say, “Amen!”
chapters.zh: 与岳母行淫的，必受咒诅。百姓都要说，阿们。

chapters.en: “Cursed is anyone who kills their neighbor secretly.” Then all the people shall say, “Amen!”
chapters.zh: 暗中杀人的，必受咒诅。百姓都要说，阿们。

chapters.en: “Cursed is anyone who accepts a bribe to kill an innocent person.” Then all the people shall say, “Amen!”
chapters.zh: 受贿赂害死无辜之人的，必受咒诅。百姓都要说，阿们。

chapters.en: “Cursed is anyone who does not uphold the words of this law by carrying them out.” Then all the people shall say, “Amen!”
chapters.zh: 不坚守遵行这律法言语的，必受咒诅。百姓都要说，阿们。

chapters.en: If you fully obey the LORD your God and carefully follow all his commands I give you today, the LORD your God will set you high above all the nations on earth.
chapters.zh: 你若留意听从耶和华你神的话，谨守遵行他的一切诫命，就是我今日所吩咐你的，他必使你超乎天下万民之上。

chapters.en: All these blessings will come on you and accompany you if you obey the LORD your God:
chapters.zh: 你若听从耶和华你神的话，这以下的福必追随你，临到你身上，

chapters.en: You will be blessed in the city and blessed in the country.
chapters.zh: 你在城里必蒙福，在田间也必蒙福。

chapters.en: The fruit of your womb will be blessed, and the crops of your land and the young of your livestock—the calves of your herds and the lambs of your flocks.
chapters.zh: 你身所生的，地所产的，牲畜所下的，以及牛犊，羊羔，都必蒙福。

chapters.en: Your basket and your kneading trough will be blessed.
chapters.zh: 你的筐子和你的抟面盆都必蒙福。

chapters.en: You will be blessed when you come in and blessed when you go out.
chapters.zh: 你出也蒙福，入也蒙福。

chapters.en: The LORD will grant that the enemies who rise up against you will be defeated before you. They will come at you from one direction but flee from you in seven.
chapters.zh: 仇敌起来攻击你，耶和华必使他们在你面前被你杀败。他们从一条路来攻击你，必从七条路逃跑。

chapters.en: The LORD will send a blessing on your barns and on everything you put your hand to. The LORD your God will bless you in the land he is giving you.
chapters.zh: 在你仓房里，并你手所办的一切事上，耶和华所命的福必临到你。耶和华你神也要在所给你的地上赐福与你。

chapters.en: The LORD will establish you as his holy people, as he promised you on oath, if you keep the commands of the LORD your God and walk in obedience to him.
chapters.zh: 你若谨守耶和华你神的诫命，遵行他的道，他必照着向你所起的誓立你作为自己的圣民。

chapters.en: Then all the peoples on earth will see that you are called by the name of the LORD, and they will fear you.
chapters.zh: 天下万民见你归在耶和华的名下，就要惧怕你。

chapters.en: The LORD will grant you abundant prosperity—in the fruit of your womb, the young of your livestock and the crops of your ground—in the land he swore to your ancestors to give you.
chapters.zh: 你在耶和华向你列祖起誓应许赐你的地上，他必使你身所生的，牲畜所下的，地所产的，都绰绰有余。

chapters.en: The LORD will open the heavens, the storehouse of his bounty, to send rain on your land in season and to bless all the work of your hands. You will lend to many nations but will borrow from none.
chapters.zh: 耶和华必为你开天上的府库，按时降雨在你的地上。在你手里所办的一切事上赐福与你。你必借给许多国民，却不至向他们借贷。

chapters.en: The LORD will make you the head, not the tail. If you pay attention to the commands of the LORD your God that I give you this day and carefully follow them, you will always be at the top, never at the bottom.
chapters.zh: 你若听从耶和华你神的诫命，就是我今日所吩咐你的，谨守遵行，不偏左右，也不随从事奉别神，耶和华就必使你作首不作尾，但居上不居下。

chapters.en: Do not turn aside from any of the commands I give you today, to the right or to the left, following other gods and serving them.
However, if you do not obey the LORD your God and do not carefully follow all his commands and decrees I am giving you today, all these curses will come on you and overtake you:
chapters.zh: 你若不听从耶和华你神的话，不谨守遵行他的一切诫命律例，就是我今日所吩咐你的，这以下的咒诅都必追随你，临到你身上，

chapters.en: You will be cursed in the city and cursed in the country.
chapters.zh: 你在城里必受咒诅，在田间也必受咒诅。

chapters.en: Your basket and your kneading trough will be cursed.
chapters.zh: 你的筐子和你的抟面盆都必受咒诅。

chapters.en: The fruit of your womb will be cursed, and the crops of your land, and the calves of your herds and the lambs of your flocks.
chapters.zh: 你身所生的，地所产的，以及牛犊，羊羔，都必受咒诅。

chapters.en: You will be cursed when you come in and cursed when you go out.
chapters.zh: 你出也受咒诅，入也受咒诅。

chapters.en: The LORD will send on you curses, confusion and rebuke in everything you put your hand to, until you are destroyed and come to sudden ruin because of the evil you have done in forsaking him.
chapters.zh: 耶和华因你行恶离弃他，必在你手里所办的一切事上，使咒诅，扰乱，责罚临到你，直到你被毁灭，速速地灭亡。

chapters.en: The LORD will plague you with diseases until he has destroyed you from the land you are entering to possess.
chapters.zh: 耶和华必使瘟疫贴在你身上，直到他将你从所进去得为业的地上灭绝。

chapters.en: The LORD will strike you with wasting disease, with fever and inflammation, with scorching heat and drought, with blight and mildew, which will plague you until you perish.
chapters.zh: 耶和华要用痨病，热病，火症，疟疾，刀剑，旱风（或作干旱），霉烂攻击你。这都要追赶你，直到你灭亡。

chapters.en: The sky over your head will be bronze, the ground beneath you iron.
chapters.zh: 你头上的天要变为铜，脚下的地要变为铁。

chapters.en: The LORD will turn the rain of your country into dust and powder; it will come down from the skies until you are destroyed.
chapters.zh: 耶和华要使那降在你地上的雨变为尘沙，从天临在你身上，直到你灭亡。

chapters.en: The LORD will cause you to be defeated before your enemies. You will come at them from one direction but flee from them in seven, and you will become a thing of horror to all the kingdoms on earth.
chapters.zh: 耶和华必使你败在仇敌面前，你从一条路去攻击他们，必从七条路逃跑。你必在天下万国中抛来抛去。

chapters.en: Your carcasses will be food for all the birds and the wild animals, and there will be no one to frighten them away.
chapters.zh: 你的尸首必给空中的飞鸟和地上的走兽作食物，并无人哄赶。

chapters.en: The LORD will afflict you with the boils of Egypt and with tumors, festering sores and the itch, from which you cannot be cured.
chapters.zh: 耶和华必用埃及人的疮并痔疮，牛皮癣与疥攻击你，使你不能医治。

chapters.en: The LORD will afflict you with madness, blindness and confusion of mind.
chapters.zh: 耶和华必用癫狂，眼瞎，心惊攻击你。

chapters.en: At midday you will grope about like a blind person in the dark. You will be unsuccessful in everything you do; day after day you will be oppressed and robbed, with no one to rescue you.
chapters.zh: 你必在午间摸索，好像瞎子在暗中摸索一样。你所行的必不亨通，时常遭遇欺压，抢夺，无人搭救。

chapters.en: You will be pledged to be married to a woman, but another will take her and rape her. You will build a house, but you will not live in it. You will plant a vineyard, but you will not even begin to enjoy its fruit.
chapters.zh: 你聘定了妻，别人必与她同房。你建造房屋，不得住在其内。你栽种葡萄园，也不得用其中的果子。

chapters.en: Your ox will be slaughtered before your eyes, but you will eat none of it. Your donkey will be forcibly taken from you and will not be returned. Your sheep will be given to your enemies, and no one will rescue them.
chapters.zh: 你的牛在你眼前宰了，你必不得吃它的肉。你的驴在你眼前被抢夺，不得归还。你的羊归了仇敌，无人搭救。

chapters.en: Your sons and daughters will be given to another nation, and you will wear out your eyes watching for them day after day, powerless to lift a hand.
chapters.zh: 你的儿女必归与别国的民。你的眼目终日切望，甚至失明，你手中无力拯救。

chapters.en: A people that you do not know will eat what your land and labor produce, and you will have nothing but cruel oppression all your days.
chapters.zh: 你的土产和你劳碌得来的，必被你所不认识的国民吃尽。你时常被欺负，受压制，

chapters.en: The sights you see will drive you mad.
chapters.zh: 甚至你因眼中所看见的，必致疯狂。

chapters.en: The LORD will afflict your knees and legs with painful boils that cannot be cured, spreading from the soles of your feet to the top of your head.
chapters.zh: 耶和华必攻击你，使你膝上腿上，从脚掌到头顶，长毒疮无法医治。

chapters.en: The LORD will drive you and the king you set over you to a nation unknown to you or your ancestors. There you will worship other gods, gods of wood and stone.
chapters.zh: 耶和华必将你和你所立的王领到你和你列祖素不认识的国去。在那里你必事奉木头石头的神。

chapters.en: You will become a thing of horror, a byword and an object of ridicule among all the peoples where the LORD will drive you.
chapters.zh: 你在耶和华领你到的各国中，要令人惊骇，笑谈，讥诮。

chapters.en: You will sow much seed in the field but you will harvest little, because locusts will devour it.
chapters.zh: 你带到田间的种子虽多，收进来的却少，因为被蝗虫吃了。

chapters.en: You will plant vineyards and cultivate them but you will not drink the wine or gather the grapes, because worms will eat them.
chapters.zh: 你栽种，修理葡萄园，却不得收葡萄，也不得喝葡萄酒，因为被虫子吃了。

chapters.en: You will have olive trees throughout your country but you will not use the oil, because the olives will drop off.
chapters.zh: 你全境有橄榄树，却不得其油抹身，因为树上的橄榄不熟自落了。

chapters.en: You will have sons and daughters but you will not keep them, because they will go into captivity.
chapters.zh: 你生儿养女，却不算是你的，因为必被掳去。

chapters.en: Swarms of locusts will take over all your trees and the crops of your land.
