chapters.zh: 你所有的树木和你地里的出产必被蝗虫所吃。

chapters.en: The foreigners who reside among you will rise above you higher and higher, but you will sink lower and lower.
chapters.zh: 在你中间寄居的，必渐渐上升，比你高而又高。你必渐渐下降，低而又低。

chapters.en: They will lend to you, but you will not lend to them. They will be the head, but you will be the tail.
chapters.zh: 他必借给你，你却不能借给他。他必作首，你必作尾。

chapters.en: All these curses will come on you. They will pursue you and overtake you until you are destroyed, because you did not obey the LORD your God and observe the commands and decrees he gave you.
chapters.zh: 这一切咒诅必追随你，赶上你，直到你灭亡。因为你不听从耶和华你神的话，不遵守他所吩咐的诫命律例。

chapters.en: They will be a sign and a wonder to you and your descendants forever.
chapters.zh: 这些咒诅必在你和你后裔的身上成为异迹奇事，直到永远。

chapters.en: Because you did not serve the LORD your God joyfully and gladly in the time of prosperity,
chapters.zh: 因为你富有的时候，不欢心乐意地事奉耶和华你的神，

chapters.en: therefore in hunger and thirst, in nakedness and dire poverty, you will serve the enemies the LORD sends against you. He will put an iron yoke on your neck until he has destroyed you.
chapters.zh: 所以你必在饥饿，干渴，赤露，缺乏之中事奉耶和华所打发来攻击你的仇敌。他必把铁轭加在你的颈项上，直到将你灭绝。

chapters.en: The LORD will bring a nation against you from far away, from the ends of the earth, like an eagle swooping down, a nation whose language you will not understand,
chapters.zh: 耶和华要从远方，地极带一国的民，如鹰飞来攻击你。这民的言语，你不懂得。

chapters.en: a fierce-looking nation without respect for the old or pity for the young.
chapters.zh: 这民的面貌凶恶，不顾恤年老的，也不恩待年少的。

chapters.en: They will devour the young of your livestock and the crops of your land until you are destroyed. They will leave you no grain, new wine or olive oil, nor any calves of your herds or lambs of your flocks until you are ruined.
chapters.zh: 他们必吃你牲畜所下的和你地土所产的，直到你灭亡。你的五谷，新酒，和油，以及牛犊，羊羔，都不给你留下，直到将你灭绝。

chapters.en: They will lay siege to all the cities throughout your land until the high fortified walls in which you trust fall down. They will besiege all the cities throughout the land the LORD your God is giving you.
chapters.zh: 他们必将你困在你各城里，直到你所倚靠，高大坚固的城墙都被攻塌。他们必将你困在耶和华你神所赐你遍地的各城里。

chapters.en: Because of the suffering your enemy will inflict on you during the siege, you will eat the fruit of the womb, the flesh of the sons and daughters the LORD your God has given you.
chapters.zh: 你在仇敌围困窘迫之中，必吃你本身所生的，就是耶和华你神所赐给你的儿女之肉。

chapters.en: Even the most gentle and sensitive man among you will have no compassion on his own brother or the wife he loves or his surviving children,
chapters.zh: 你们中间，柔弱娇嫩的人必恶眼看他弟兄和他怀中的妻，并他余剩的儿女。

chapters.en: and he will not give to one of them any of the flesh of his children that he is eating. It will be all he has left because of the suffering your enemy will inflict on you during the siege of all your cities.
chapters.zh: 甚至在你受仇敌围困窘迫的城中，他要吃儿女的肉，不肯分一点给他的亲人，因为他一无所剩。

chapters.en: The most gentle and sensitive woman among you—so sensitive and gentle that she would not venture to touch the ground with the sole of her foot—will begrudge the husband she loves and her own son or daughter
chapters.zh: 你们中间，柔弱娇嫩的妇人，是因娇嫩柔弱不肯把脚踏地的，必恶眼看她怀中的丈夫和她的儿女。

chapters.en: the afterbirth from her womb and the children she bears. For in her dire need she intends to eat them secretly because of the suffering your enemy will inflict on you during the siege of your cities.
chapters.zh: 她两腿中间出来的婴孩与她所要生的儿女，她因缺乏一切就要在你受仇敌围困窘迫的城中将他们暗暗地吃了。

chapters.en: If you do not carefully follow all the words of this law, which are written in this book, and do not revere this glorious and awesome name—the LORD your God—
chapters.zh: 这书上所写律法的一切话是叫你敬畏耶和华你神可荣可畏的名。你若不谨守遵行，耶和华就必将奇灾，就是至大至长的灾，至重至久的病，加在你和你后裔的身上，

chapters.en: the LORD will send fearful plagues on you and your descendants, harsh and prolonged disasters, and severe and lingering illnesses.
He will bring on you all the diseases of Egypt that you dreaded, and they will cling to you.
chapters.zh: 也必使你所惧怕，埃及人的病都临到你，贴在你身上，

chapters.en: The LORD will also bring on you every kind of sickness and disaster not recorded in this Book of the Law, until you are destroyed.
chapters.zh: 又必将没有写在这律法书上的各样疾病，灾殃降在你身上，直到你灭亡。

chapters.en: You who were as numerous as the stars in the sky will be left but few in number, because you did not obey the LORD your God.
chapters.zh: 你们先前虽然像天上的星那样多，却因不听从耶和华你神的话，所剩的人数就稀少了。

chapters.en: Just as it pleased the LORD to make you prosper and increase in number, so it will please him to ruin and destroy you. You will be uprooted from the land you are entering to possess.
chapters.zh: 先前耶和华怎样喜悦善待你们，使你们众多，也要照样喜悦毁灭你们，使你们灭亡。并且你们从所要进去得的地上必被拔除。

chapters.en: Then the LORD will scatter you among all nations, from one end of the earth to the other. There you will worship other gods—gods of wood and stone, which neither you nor your ancestors have known.
chapters.zh: 耶和华必使你们分散在万民中，从地这边到地那边，你必在那里事奉你和你列祖素不认识，木头石头的神。

chapters.en: Among those nations you will find no repose, no resting place for the sole of your foot. There the LORD will give you an anxious mind, eyes weary with longing, and a despairing heart.
chapters.zh: 在那些国中，你必不得安逸，也不得落脚之地。耶和华却使你在那里心中跳动，眼目失明，精神消耗。

chapters.en: You will live in constant suspense, filled with dread both night and day, never sure of your life.
chapters.zh: 你的性命必悬悬无定。你昼夜恐惧，自料性命难保。

chapters.en: In the morning you will say, “If only it were evening!” and in the evening, “If only it were morning!”—because of the terror that will fill your hearts and the sights that your eyes will see.
chapters.zh: 你因心里所恐惧的，眼中所看见的，早晨必说，巴不得到晚上才好。晚上必说，巴不得到早晨才好。

chapters.en: The LORD will send you back in ships to Egypt on a journey I said you should never make again. There you will offer yourselves for sale to your enemies as male and female slaves, but no one will buy you.
chapters.zh: 耶和华必使你坐船回埃及去，走我曾告诉你不得再见的路。在那里你必卖己身与仇敌作奴婢，却无人买。

chapters.en: These are the terms of the covenant the LORD commanded Moses to make with the Israelites in Moab, in addition to the covenant he had made with them at Horeb.
chapters.zh: 这是耶和华在摩押地吩咐摩西与以色列人立约的话，是在他和他们于何烈山所立的约之外。

chapters.en: Moses summoned all the Israelites and said to them: Your eyes have seen all that the LORD did in Egypt to Pharaoh, to all his officials and to all his land.
chapters.zh: 摩西召了以色列众人来，对他们说，耶和华在埃及地，在你们眼前向法老和他众臣仆，并他全地所行的一切事，你们都看见了，

chapters.en: With your own eyes you saw those great trials, those signs and great wonders.
chapters.zh: 就是你亲眼看见的大试验和神迹，并那些大奇事。

chapters.en: But to this day the LORD has not given you a mind that understands or eyes that see or ears that hear.
chapters.zh: 但耶和华到今日没有使你们心能明白，眼能看见，耳能听见。

chapters.en: Yet the LORD says, “During the forty years that I led you through the wilderness, your clothes did not wear out, nor did the sandals on your feet.
chapters.zh: 我领你们在旷野四十年，你们身上的衣服并没有穿破，脚上的鞋也没有穿坏。

chapters.en: You ate no bread and drank no wine or other fermented drink. I did this so that you might know that I am the LORD your God.”
chapters.zh: 你们没有吃饼，也没有喝清酒浓酒。这要使你们知道，耶和华是你们的神。

chapters.en: When you reached this place, Sihon king of Heshbon and Og king of Bashan came out to fight against us, but we defeated them.
chapters.zh: 你们来到这地方，希实本王西宏，巴珊王噩都出来与我们交战，我们就击杀了他们，

chapters.en: We took their land and gave it as an inheritance to the Reubenites, the Gadites and the half-tribe of Manasseh.
chapters.zh: 取了他们的地给流便支派，迦得支派，和玛拿西半支派为业。

chapters.en: Carefully follow the terms of this covenant, so that you may prosper in everything you do.
chapters.zh: 所以你们要谨守遵行这约的话，好叫你们在一切所行的事上亨通。

chapters.en: All of you are standing today in the presence of the LORD your God—your leaders and chief men, your elders and officials, and all the other men of Israel,
chapters.zh: 今日你们的首领，族长（原文作支派），长老，官长，以色列的男丁，你们的妻子，儿女和营中寄居的，以及为你们劈柴挑水的人，都站在耶和华你们的神面前，

chapters.en: together with your children and your wives, and the foreigners living in your camps who chop your wood and carry your water.
You are standing here in order to enter into a covenant with the LORD your God, a covenant the LORD is making with you this day and sealing with an oath,
chapters.zh: 为要你顺从耶和华你神今日与你所立的约，向你所起的誓。

chapters.en: to confirm you this day as his people, that he may be your God as he promised you and as he swore to your fathers, Abraham, Isaac and Jacob.
chapters.zh: 这样，他要照他向你所应许的话，又向你列祖亚伯拉罕，以撒，雅各所起的誓，今日立你作他的子民，他作你的神。

chapters.en: I am making this covenant, with its oath, not only with you
chapters.zh: 我不但与你们立这约，起这誓，

chapters.en: who are standing here with us today in the presence of the LORD our God but also with those who are not here today.
chapters.zh: 凡与我们一同站在耶和华我们神面前的，并今日不在我们这里的人，我也与他们立这约，起这誓。

chapters.en: You yourselves know how we lived in Egypt and how we passed through the countries on the way here.
chapters.zh: （我们曾住过埃及地，也从列国经过。这是你们知道的。

chapters.en: You saw among them their detestable images and idols of wood and stone, of silver and gold.
chapters.zh: 你们也看见他们中间可憎之物，并他们木，石，金，银的偶像。）

chapters.en: Make sure there is no man or woman, clan or tribe among you today whose heart turns away from the LORD our God to go and worship the gods of those nations; make sure there is no root among you that produces such bitter poison.
chapters.zh: 惟恐你们中间，或男或女，或族长或支派长，今日心里偏离耶和华我们的神，去事奉那些国的神。又怕你们中间有恶根生出苦菜和茵陈来，

chapters.en: When such a person hears the words of this oath and they invoke a blessing on themselves, thinking, “I will be safe, even though I persist in going my own way,” they will bring disaster on the watered land as well as the dry.
chapters.zh: 听见这咒诅的话，心里仍是自夸说，我虽然行事心里顽梗，连累众人，却还是平安。

chapters.en: The LORD will never be willing to forgive them; his wrath and zeal will burn against them. All the curses written in this book will fall on them, and the LORD will blot out their names from under heaven.
chapters.zh: 耶和华必不饶恕他。耶和华的怒气与愤恨要向他发作，如烟冒出，将这书上所写的一切咒诅都加在他身上。耶和华又要从天下涂抹他的名，

chapters.en: The LORD will single them out from all the tribes of Israel for disaster, according to all the curses of the covenant written in this Book of the Law.
chapters.zh: 也必照着写在律法书上，约中的一切咒诅将他从以色列众支派中分别出来，使他受祸。

chapters.en: Your children who follow you in later generations and foreigners who come from distant lands will see the calamities that have fallen on the land and the diseases with which the LORD has afflicted it.
chapters.zh: 你们的后代，就是以后兴起来的子孙，和远方来的外人，看见这地的灾殃，并耶和华所降与这地的疾病，

chapters.en: The whole land will be a burning waste of salt and sulfur—nothing planted, nothing sprouting, no vegetation growing on it. It will be like the destruction of Sodom and Gomorrah, Admah and Zeboyim, which the LORD overthrew in fierce anger.
chapters.zh: 又看见遍地有硫磺，有盐卤，有火迹，没有耕种，没有出产，连草都不生长，好像耶和华在忿怒中所倾覆的所多玛，蛾摩拉，押玛，洗扁一样。

chapters.en: All the nations will ask: “Why has the LORD done this to this land? Why this fierce, burning anger?”
chapters.zh: 所看见的人，连万国人，都必问说，耶和华为何向此地这样行呢？这样大发烈怒是什么意思呢？

chapters.en: And the answer will be: “It is because this people abandoned the covenant of the LORD, the God of their ancestors, the covenant he made with them when he brought them out of Egypt.
chapters.zh: 人必回答说，是因这地的人离弃了耶和华他们列祖的神，领他们出埃及地的时候与他们所立的约，

chapters.en: They went off and worshiped other gods and bowed down to them, gods they did not know, gods he had not given them.
chapters.zh: 去事奉敬拜素不认识的别神，是耶和华所未曾给他们安排的。

chapters.en: Therefore the LORD’s anger burned against this land, so that he brought on it all the curses written in this book.
chapters.zh: 所以耶和华的怒气向这地发作，将这书上所写的一切咒诅都降在这地上。

chapters.en: In furious anger and in great wrath the LORD uprooted them from their land and thrust them into another land, as it is now.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华在怒气，忿怒，大恼恨中将他们从本地拔出来，扔在别的地上，像今日一样。

chapters.en: The secret things belong to the LORD our God, but the things revealed belong to us and to our children forever, that we may follow all the words of this law.
chapters.zh: 隐秘的事是属耶和华我们神的。惟有明显的事是永远属我们和我们子孙的，好叫我们遵行这律法上的一切话。

chapters.en: When all these blessings and curses I have set before you come on you and you take them to heart wherever the LORD your God disperses you among the nations,
chapters.zh: 我所陈明在你面前的这一切咒诅都临到你身上。你在耶和华你神追赶你到的万国中必心里追念祝福的话。

chapters.en: and when you and your children return to the LORD your God and obey him with all your heart and with all your soul according to everything I command you today,
chapters.zh: 你和你的子孙若尽心尽性归向耶和华你的神，照着我今日一切所吩咐的听从他的话。

chapters.en: then the LORD your God will restore your fortunes and have compassion on you and gather you again from all the nations where he scattered you.
chapters.zh: 那时，耶和华你的神必怜恤你，救回你这被掳的子民。耶和华你的神要回转过来，从分散你到的万民中将你招聚回来。

chapters.en: Even if you have been banished to the most distant land under the heavens, from there the LORD your God will gather you and bring you back.
chapters.zh: 你被赶散的人，就是在天涯的，耶和华你的神也必从那里将你招聚回来。

chapters.en: He will bring you to the land that belonged to your ancestors, and you will take possession of it. He will make you more prosperous and numerous than your ancestors.
chapters.zh: 耶和华你的神必领你进入你列祖所得的地，使你可以得着。又必善待你，使你的人数比你列祖众多。

chapters.en: The LORD your God will circumcise your hearts and the hearts of your descendants, so that you may love him with all your heart and with all your soul, and live.
chapters.zh: 耶和华你神必将你心里和你后裔心里的污秽除掉，好叫你尽心尽性爱耶和华你的神，使你可以存活。

chapters.en: The LORD your God will put all these curses on your enemies who hate and persecute you.
chapters.zh: 耶和华你的神必将这一切咒诅加在你仇敌和恨恶你，逼迫你的人身上。

chapters.en: You will again obey the LORD and follow all his commands I am giving you today.
chapters.zh: 你必归回，听从耶和华的话，遵行他的一切诫命，就是我今日所吩咐你的。

chapters.en: Then the LORD your God will make you most prosperous in all the work of your hands and in the fruit of your womb, the young of your livestock and the crops of your land. The LORD will again delight in you and make you prosperous, just as he delighted in your ancestors,
chapters.zh: 你若听从耶和华你神的话，谨守这律法书上所写的诫命，律例，又尽心尽性归向耶和华你的神，他必使你手里所办的一切事，并你身所生的，牲畜所下的，地土所产的，都绰绰有余，因为耶和华必在喜悦你，降福与你，象从前喜悦你列祖一样。

chapters.en: if you obey the LORD your God and keep his commands and decrees that are written in this Book of the Law and turn to the LORD your God with all your heart and with all your soul.
Now what I am commanding you today is not too difficult for you or beyond your reach.
chapters.zh: 我今日所吩咐你的诫命不是你难行的，也不是离你远的。

chapters.en: It is not up in heaven, so that you have to ask, “Who will ascend into heaven to get it and proclaim it to us so we may obey it?”
chapters.zh: 不是在天上，使你说，谁替我们上天取下来，使我们听见可以遵行呢？

chapters.en: Nor is it beyond the sea, so that you have to ask, “Who will cross the sea to get it and proclaim it to us so we may obey it?”
chapters.zh: 也不是在海外，使你说，谁替我们过海取了来，使我们听见可以遵行呢？

chapters.en: No, the word is very near you; it is in your mouth and in your heart so you may obey it.
chapters.zh: 这话却离你甚近，就在你口中，在你心里，使你可以遵行。

chapters.en: See, I set before you today life and prosperity, death and destruction.
chapters.zh: 看哪，我今日将生与福，死与祸，陈明在你面前。

chapters.en: For I command you today to love the LORD your God, to walk in obedience to him, and to keep his commands, decrees and laws; then you will live and increase, and the LORD your God will bless you in the land you are entering to possess.
chapters.zh: 吩咐你爱耶和华你的神，遵行他的道，谨守他的诫命，律例，典章，使你可以存活，人数增多，耶和华你神就必在你所要进去得为业的地上赐福与你。

chapters.en: But if your heart turns away and you are not obedient, and if you are drawn away to bow down to other gods and worship them,
chapters.zh: 倘若你心里偏离，不肯听从，却被勾引去敬拜事奉别神，

chapters.en: I declare to you this day that you will certainly be destroyed. You will not live long in the land you are crossing the Jordan to enter and possess.
chapters.zh: 我今日明明告诉你们，你们必要灭亡。在你过约旦河，进去得为业的地上，你的日子必不长久。

chapters.en: This day I call the heavens and the earth as witnesses against you that I have set before you life and death, blessings and curses. Now choose life, so that you and your children may live
chapters.zh: 我今日呼天唤地向你作见证。我将生死祸福陈明在你面前，所以你要拣选生命，使你和你的后裔都得存活。

chapters.en: and that you may love the LORD your God, listen to his voice, and hold fast to him. For the LORD is your life, and he will give you many years in the land he swore to give to your fathers, Abraham, Isaac and Jacob.
chapters.zh: 且爱耶和华你的神，听从他的话，专靠他。因为他是你的生命，你的日子长久也在乎他。这样，你就可以在耶和华向你列祖亚伯拉罕，以撒，雅各起誓应许所赐的地上居住。

chapters.en: Then Moses went out and spoke these words to all Israel:
chapters.zh: 摩西去告诉以色列众人

chapters.en: “I am now a hundred and twenty years old and I am no longer able to lead you. The LORD has said to me, ‘You shall not cross the Jordan.’
chapters.zh: 说，我现在一百二十岁了，不能照常出入。耶和华也曾对我说，你必不得过这约旦河。

chapters.en: The LORD your God himself will cross over ahead of you. He will destroy these nations before you, and you will take possession of their land. Joshua also will cross over ahead of you, as the LORD said.
chapters.zh: 耶和华你们的神必引导你们过去，将这些国民在你们面前灭绝，你们就得他们的地。约书亚必引导你们过去，正如耶和华所说的。

chapters.en: And the LORD will do to them what he did to Sihon and Og, the kings of the Amorites, whom he destroyed along with their land.
chapters.zh: 耶和华必待他们，如同从前待他所灭绝的亚摩利二王西宏与噩以及他们的国一样。

chapters.en: The LORD will deliver them to you, and you must do to them all that I have commanded you.
chapters.zh: 耶和华必将他们交给你们。你们要照我所吩咐的一切命令待他们。

chapters.en: Be strong and courageous. Do not be afraid or terrified because of them, for the LORD your God goes with you; he will never leave you nor forsake you.”
chapters.zh: 你们当刚强壮胆，不要害怕，也不要畏惧他们，因为耶和华你的神和你同去。他必不撇下你，也不丢弃你。

chapters.en: Then Moses summoned Joshua and said to him in the presence of all Israel, “Be strong and courageous, for you must go with this people into the land that the LORD swore to their ancestors to give them, and you must divide it among them as their inheritance.
chapters.zh: 摩西召了约书亚来，在以色列众人眼前对他说，你当刚强壮胆。因为，你要和这百姓一同进入耶和华向他们列祖起誓应许所赐之地。你也要使他们承受那地为业。

chapters.en: The LORD himself goes before you and will be with you; he will never leave you nor forsake you. Do not be afraid; do not be discouraged.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华必在你前面行。他必与你同在，必不撇下你，也不丢弃你。不要惧怕，也不要惊惶。

chapters.en: So Moses wrote down this law and gave it to the Levitical priests, who carried the ark of the covenant of the LORD, and to all the elders of Israel.
chapters.zh: 摩西将这律法写出来，交给抬耶和华约柜的祭司利未子孙和以色列的众长老。

chapters.en: Then Moses commanded them: “At the end of every seven years, in the year for canceling debts, during the Festival of Tabernacles,
chapters.zh: 摩西吩咐他们说，每逢七年的末一年，就在豁免年的定期住棚节的时候，

chapters.en: when all Israel comes to appear before the LORD your God at the place he will choose, you shall read this law before them in their hearing.
chapters.zh: 以色列众人来到耶和华你神所选择的地方朝见他。那时，你要在以色列众人面前将这律法念给他们听。

chapters.en: Assemble the people—men, women and children, and the foreigners residing in your towns—so they can listen and learn to fear the LORD your God and follow carefully all the words of this law.
chapters.zh: 要招聚他们男，女，孩子，并城里寄居的，使他们听，使他们学习，好敬畏耶和华你们的神，谨守，遵行这律法的一切话，

chapters.en: Their children, who do not know this law, must hear it and learn to fear the LORD your God as long as you live in the land you are crossing the Jordan to possess.”
chapters.zh: 也使他们未曾晓得这律法的儿女得以听见，学习敬畏耶和华你们的神，在你们过约旦河要得为业之地，存活的日子，常常这样行。

chapters.en: The LORD said to Moses, “Now the day of your death is near. Call Joshua and present yourselves at the tent of meeting, where I will commission him.” So Moses and Joshua came and presented themselves at the tent of meeting.
chapters.zh: 耶和华对摩西说，你的死期临近了。要召约书亚来，你们二人站在会幕里，我好嘱咐他。于是摩西和约书亚去站在会幕里。

chapters.en: Then the LORD appeared at the tent in a pillar of cloud, and the cloud stood over the entrance to the tent.
chapters.zh: 耶和华在会幕里云柱中显现，云柱停在会幕门以上。

chapters.en: And the LORD said to Moses: “You are going to rest with your ancestors, and these people will soon prostitute themselves to the foreign gods of the land they are entering. They will forsake me and break the covenant I made with them.
chapters.zh: 耶和华又对摩西说，你必和你列祖同睡。这百姓要起来，在他们所要去的地上，在那地的人中，随从外邦神行邪淫，离弃我，违背我与他们所立的约。

chapters.en: And in that day I will become angry with them and forsake them; I will hide my face from them, and they will be destroyed. Many disasters and calamities will come on them, and in that day they will ask, ‘Have not these disasters come on us because our God is not with us?’
chapters.zh: 那时，我的怒气必向他们发作。我也必离弃他们，掩面不顾他们，以致他们被吞灭，并有许多的祸患灾难临到他们。那日他们必说，这些祸患临到我们，岂不是因我们的神不在我们中间吗？

chapters.en: And I will certainly hide my face in that day because of all their wickedness in turning to other gods.
chapters.zh: 那时，因他们偏向别神所行的一切恶，我必定掩面不顾他们。

chapters.en: “Now write down this song and teach it to the Israelites and have them sing it, so that it may be a witness for me against them.
chapters.zh: 现在你要写一篇歌，教导以色列人，传给他们，使这歌见证他们的不是。

chapters.en: When I have brought them into the land flowing with milk and honey, the land I promised on oath to their ancestors, and when they eat their fill and thrive, they will turn to other gods and worship them, rejecting me and breaking my covenant.
chapters.zh: 因为我将他们领进我向他们列祖起誓应许那流奶与蜜之地，他们在那里吃得饱足，身体肥胖，就必偏向别神，事奉他们，藐视我，背弃我的约。

chapters.en: And when many disasters and calamities come on them, this song will testify against them, because it will not be forgotten by their descendants. I know what they are disposed to do, even before I bring them into the land I promised them on oath.”
chapters.zh: 那时，有许多祸患灾难临到他们，这歌必在他们面前作见证，他们后裔的口中必念诵不忘。我未领他们到我所起誓应许之地以先，他们所怀的意念我都知道了。

chapters.en: So Moses wrote down this song that day and taught it to the Israelites.
chapters.zh: 当日摩西就写了一篇歌，教导以色列人。

chapters.en: The LORD gave this command to Joshua son of Nun: “Be strong and courageous, for you will bring the Israelites into the land I promised them on oath, and I myself will be with you.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华嘱咐嫩的儿子约书亚说，你当刚强壮胆，因为你必领以色列人进我所起誓应许他们的地。我必与你同在。

chapters.en: After Moses finished writing in a book the words of this law from beginning to end,
chapters.zh: 摩西将这律法的话写在书上，及至写完了，

chapters.en: he gave this command to the Levites who carried the ark of the covenant of the LORD:
chapters.zh: 就吩咐抬耶和华约柜的利未人说，

chapters.en: “Take this Book of the Law and place it beside the ark of the covenant of the LORD your God. There it will remain as a witness against you.
chapters.zh: 将这律法书放在耶和华你们神的约柜旁，可以在那里见证以色列人的不是。

chapters.en: For I know how rebellious and stiff-necked you are. If you have been rebellious against the LORD while I am still alive and with you, how much more will you rebel after I die!
chapters.zh: 因为我知道你们是悖逆的，是硬着颈项的。我今日还活着与你们同在，你们尚且悖逆耶和华，何况我死后呢？

chapters.en: Assemble before me all the elders of your tribes and all your officials, so that I can speak these words in their hearing and call the heavens and the earth to testify against them.
chapters.zh: 你们要将你们支派的众长老和官长都招聚了来，我好将这些话说与他们听，并呼天唤地见证他们的不是。

chapters.en: For I know that after my death you are sure to become utterly corrupt and to turn from the way I have commanded you. In days to come, disaster will fall on you because you will do evil in the sight of the LORD and arouse his anger by what your hands have made.”
chapters.zh: 我知道我死后，你们必全然败坏，偏离我所吩咐你们的道，行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，以手所作的惹他发怒。日后必有祸患临到你们。

chapters.en: And Moses recited the words of this song from beginning to end in the hearing of the whole assembly of Israel:
chapters.zh: 摩西将这一篇歌的话都说与以色列全会众听。

chapters.en: Listen, you heavens, and I will speak; hear, you earth, the words of my mouth.
chapters.zh: 诸天哪，侧耳，我要说话。愿地也听我口中的言语。

chapters.en: Let my teaching fall like rain and my words descend like dew, like showers on new grass, like abundant rain on tender plants.
chapters.zh: 我的教训要淋漓如雨。我的言语要滴落如露，如细雨降在嫩草上，如甘霖降在菜蔬中。

chapters.en: I will proclaim the name of the LORD. Oh, praise the greatness of our God!
chapters.zh: 我要宣告耶和华的名。你们要将大德归与我们的神。

chapters.en: He is the Rock, his works are perfect, and all his ways are just. A faithful God who does no wrong, upright and just is he.
chapters.zh: 他是磐石，他的作为完全，他所行的无不公平，是诚实无伪的神。又公义，又正直。

chapters.en: They are corrupt and not his children; to their shame they are a warped and crooked generation.
chapters.zh: 这乖僻弯曲的世代向他行事邪僻。有这弊病就不是他的儿女。

chapters.en: Is this the way you repay the LORD, you foolish and unwise people? Is he not your Father, your Creator,who made you and formed you?
chapters.zh: 愚昧无知的民哪，你们这样报答耶和华吗？他岂不是你的父，将你买来的吗？他是制造你，建立你的。

chapters.en: Remember the days of old; consider the generations long past. Ask your father and he will tell you, your elders, and they will explain to you.
chapters.zh: 你当追想上古之日，思念历代之年。问你的父亲，他必指示你。问你的长者，他必告诉你。

chapters.en: When the Most High gave the nations their inheritance, when he divided all mankind, he set up boundaries for the peoples according to the number of the sons of Israel.
chapters.zh: 至高者将地业赐给列邦，将世人分开，就照以色列人的数目立定万民的疆界。

chapters.en: For the LORD’s portion is his people, Jacob his allotted inheritance.
chapters.zh: 耶和华的分本是他的百姓。他的产业本是雅各。

chapters.en: In a desert land he found him, in a barren and howling waste. He shielded him and cared for him; he guarded him as the apple of his eye,
chapters.zh: 耶和华遇见他在旷野荒凉野兽吼叫之地，就环绕他，看顾他，保护他，如同保护眼中的瞳人。

chapters.en: like an eagle that stirs up its nest and hovers over its young, that spreads its wings to catch them and carries them aloft.
chapters.zh: 又如鹰搅动巢窝，在雏鹰以上两翅扇展，接取雏鹰，背在两翼之上。

chapters.en: The LORD alone led him; no foreign god was with him.
chapters.zh: 这样，耶和华独自引导他，并无外邦神与他同在。

chapters.en: He made him ride on the heights of the land and fed him with the fruit of the fields. He nourished him with honey from the rock, and with oil from the flinty crag,
chapters.zh: 耶和华使他乘驾地的高处，得吃田间的土产。又使他从磐石中咂蜜，从坚石中吸油。

chapters.en: with curds and milk from herd and flock and with fattened lambs and goats, with choice rams of Bashan and the finest kernels of wheat. You drank the foaming blood of the grape.
chapters.zh: 也吃牛的奶油，羊的奶，羊羔的脂油，巴珊所出的公绵羊和山羊，与上好的麦子，也喝葡萄汁酿的酒。

chapters.en: Jeshurun grew fat and kicked; filled with food, they became heavy and sleek. They abandoned the God who made them and rejected the Rock their Savior.
chapters.zh: 但耶书仑渐渐肥胖，粗壮，光润，踢跳奔跑，便离弃造他的神，轻看救他的磐石。

chapters.en: They made him jealous with their foreign gods and angered him with their detestable idols.
chapters.zh: 敬拜别神，触动神的愤恨，行可憎恶的事，惹了他的怒气。

chapters.en: They sacrificed to false gods, which are not God— gods they had not known, gods that recently appeared, gods your ancestors did not fear.
chapters.zh: 所祭祀的鬼魔并非真神，乃是素不认识的神，是近来新兴的，是你列祖所不畏惧的

chapters.en: You deserted the Rock, who fathered you; you forgot the God who gave you birth.
chapters.zh: 你轻忽生你的磐石，忘记产你的神。

chapters.en: The LORD saw this and rejected them because he was angered by his sons and daughters.
chapters.zh: 耶和华看见他的儿女惹动他，就厌恶他们，

chapters.en: “I will hide my face from them,” he said, “and see what their end will be; for they are a perverse generation, children who are unfaithful.
chapters.zh: 说，我要向他们掩面，看他们的结局如何。他们本是极乖僻的族类，心中无诚实的儿女。

chapters.en: They made me jealous by what is no god and angered me with their worthless idols. I will make them envious by those who are not a people; I will make them angry by a nation that has no understanding.
chapters.zh: 他们以那不算为神的触动我的愤恨，以虚无的神惹了我的怒气。我也要以那不成子民的触动他们的愤恨，以愚昧的国民惹了他们的怒气。

chapters.en: For a fire will be kindled by my wrath, one that burns down to the realm of the dead below. It will devour the earth and its harvests and set afire the foundations of the mountains.
chapters.zh: 因为在我怒中有火烧起，直烧到极深的阴间，把地和地的出产尽都焚烧，山的根基也烧着了。

chapters.en: “I will heap calamities on them and spend my arrows against them.
chapters.zh: 我要将祸患堆在他们身上，把我的箭向他们射尽。

chapters.en: I will send wasting famine against them, consuming pestilence and deadly plague; I will send against them the fangs of wild beasts, the venom of vipers that glide in the dust.
chapters.zh: 他们必因饥饿消瘦，被炎热苦毒吞灭。我要打发野兽用牙齿咬他们，并土中腹行的，用毒气害他们。

chapters.en: In the street the sword will make them childless; in their homes terror will reign. The young men and young women will perish, the infants and those with gray hair.
chapters.zh: 外头有刀剑，内室有惊恐，使人丧亡，使少男，童女，吃奶的，白发的，尽都灭绝。

chapters.en: I said I would scatter them and erase their name from human memory,
chapters.zh: 我说，我必将他们分散远方，使他们的名号从人间除灭。

chapters.en: but I dreaded the taunt of the enemy, lest the adversary misunderstand and say, ‘Our hand has triumphed; the LORD has not done all this.’ ”
chapters.zh: 惟恐仇敌惹动我，只怕敌人错看，说，是我们手的能力，并非耶和华所行的。

chapters.en: They are a nation without sense, there is no discernment in them.
chapters.zh: 因为以色列民毫无计谋，心中没有聪明。

chapters.en: If only they were wise and would understand this and discern what their end will be!
chapters.zh: 惟愿他们有智慧，能明白这事，肯思念他们的结局。

chapters.en: How could one man chase a thousand, or two put ten thousand to flight, unless their Rock had sold them, unless the LORD had given them up?
chapters.zh: 若不是他们的磐石卖了他们，若不是耶和华交出他们，一人焉能追赶他们千人，二人焉能使万人逃跑呢？

chapters.en: For their rock is not like our Rock, as even our enemies concede.
chapters.zh: 据我们的仇敌自己断定，他们的磐石不如我们的磐石。

chapters.en: Their vine comes from the vine of Sodom and from the fields of Gomorrah. Their grapes are filled with poison, and their clusters with bitterness.
chapters.zh: 他们的葡萄树是所多玛的葡萄树，蛾摩拉田园所生的。他们的葡萄是毒葡萄，全挂都是苦的。

chapters.en: Their wine is the venom of serpents, the deadly poison of cobras.
chapters.zh: 他们的酒是大蛇的毒气，是虺蛇残害的恶毒。

chapters.en: “Have I not kept this in reserve and sealed it in my vaults?
chapters.zh: 这不都是积蓄在我这里，封锁在我府库中吗？

chapters.en: It is mine to avenge; I will repay. In due time their foot will slip; their day of disaster is near and their doom rushes upon them.”
chapters.zh: 他们失脚的时候，伸冤报应在我。因他们遭灾的日子近了。那要临在他们身上的必速速来到。

chapters.en: The LORD will vindicate his people and relent concerning his servants when he sees their strength is gone and no one is left, slave or free.
chapters.zh: 耶和华见他百姓毫无能力，无论困住的，自由的都没有剩下，就必为他们伸冤，为他的仆人后悔。

chapters.en: He will say: “Now where are their gods, the rock they took refuge in,
chapters.zh: 他必说，他们的神，他们所投靠的磐石，

chapters.en: the gods who ate the fat of their sacrifices and drank the wine of their drink offerings? Let them rise up to help you! Let them give you shelter!
chapters.zh: 就是向来吃他们祭牲的脂油，喝他们奠祭之酒的，在哪里呢？他可以兴起帮助你们，护卫你们。

chapters.en: “See now that I myself am he! There is no god besides me. I put to death and I bring to life, I have wounded and I will heal, and no one can deliver out of my hand.
chapters.zh: 你们如今要知道，我，惟有我是神。在我以外并无别神。我使人死，我使人活。我损伤，我也医治，并无人能从我手中救出来。

chapters.en: I lift my hand to heaven and solemnly swear: As surely as I live forever,
chapters.zh: 我向天举手说，我凭我的永生起誓，

chapters.en: when I sharpen my flashing sword and my hand grasps it in judgment, I will take vengeance on my adversaries and repay those who hate me.
chapters.zh: 我若磨我闪亮的刀，手掌审判之权，就必报复我的敌人，报应恨我的人。

chapters.en: I will make my arrows drunk with blood, while my sword devours flesh: the blood of the slain and the captives, the heads of the enemy leaders.”
chapters.zh: 我要使我的箭饮血饮醉，就是被杀被掳之人的血。我的刀要吃肉，乃是仇敌中首领之头的肉。

chapters.en: Rejoice, you nations, with his people,for he will avenge the blood of his servants; he will take vengeance on his enemies and make atonement for his land and people.
chapters.zh: 你们外邦人当与主的百姓一同欢呼。因他要伸他仆人流血的冤，报应他的敌人，洁净他的地，救赎他的百姓。

chapters.en: Moses came with Joshua son of Nun and spoke all the words of this song in the hearing of the people.
chapters.zh: 摩西和嫩的儿子约书亚去将这歌的一切话说给百姓听。

chapters.en: When Moses finished reciting all these words to all Israel,
chapters.zh: 摩西向以色列众人说完了这一切的话，

chapters.en: he said to them, “Take to heart all the words I have solemnly declared to you this day, so that you may command your children to obey carefully all the words of this law.
chapters.zh: 又说，我今日所警教你们的，你们都要放在心上。要吩咐你们的子孙谨守遵行这律法上的话。

chapters.en: They are not just idle words for you—they are your life. By them you will live long in the land you are crossing the Jordan to possess.”
chapters.zh: 因为这不是虚空，与你们无关的事，乃是你们的生命。在你们过约旦河要得为业的地上必因这事日子得以长久。

chapters.en: On that same day the LORD told Moses,
chapters.zh: 当日，耶和华吩咐摩西说，

chapters.en: “Go up into the Abarim Range to Mount Nebo in Moab, across from Jericho, and view Canaan, the land I am giving the Israelites as their own possession.
chapters.zh: 你上这亚巴琳山中的尼波山去，在摩押地与耶利哥相对，观看我所要赐给以色列人为业的迦南地。

chapters.en: There on the mountain that you have climbed you will die and be gathered to your people, just as your brother Aaron died on Mount Hor and was gathered to his people.
chapters.zh: 你必死在你所登的山上，归你列祖（原文作本民）去，象你哥哥亚伦死在何珥山上，归他的列祖一样。

chapters.en: This is because both of you broke faith with me in the presence of the Israelites at the waters of Meribah Kadesh in the Desert of Zin and because you did not uphold my holiness among the Israelites.
chapters.zh: 因为你们在寻的旷野，加低斯的米利巴水，在以色列人中没有尊我为圣，得罪了我。

chapters.en: Therefore, you will see the land only from a distance; you will not enter the land I am giving to the people of Israel.”
chapters.zh: 我所赐给以色列人的地，你可以远远地观看，却不得进去。

chapters.en: This is the blessing that Moses the man of God pronounced on the Israelites before his death.
chapters.zh: 以下是神人摩西在未死之先为以色列人所祝的福，

chapters.en: He said: “The LORD came from Sinai and dawned over them from Seir; he shone forth from Mount Paran. He came with myriads of holy ones from the south, from his mountain slopes.
chapters.zh: 他说，耶和华从西乃而来，从西珥向他们显现，从巴兰山发出光辉，从万万圣者中来临，从他右手为百姓传出烈火的律法。

chapters.en: Surely it is you who love the people; all the holy ones are in your hand. At your feet they all bow down, and from you receive instruction,
chapters.zh: 他疼爱百姓。众圣徒都在他手中。他们坐在他的脚下，领受他的言语。

chapters.en: the law that Moses gave us, the possession of the assembly of Jacob.
chapters.zh: 摩西将律法传给我们，作为雅各会众的产业。

chapters.en: He was king over Jeshurun when the leaders of the people assembled, along with the tribes of Israel.
chapters.zh: 百姓的众首领，以色列的各支派，一同聚会的时候，耶和华（原文作他）在耶书仑中为王。

chapters.en: “Let Reuben live and not die, nor his people be few.”
chapters.zh: 愿流便存活，不至死亡。愿他人数不至稀少。

chapters.en: And this he said about Judah: “Hear, LORD, the cry of Judah; bring him to his people. With his own hands he defends his cause. Oh, be his help against his foes!”
chapters.zh: 为犹大祝福说，求耶和华俯听犹大的声音，引导他归于本族。他曾用手为自己争战，你必帮助他攻击敌人。

chapters.en: About Levi he said: “Your Thummim and Urim belong to your faithful servant. You tested him at Massah; you contended with him at the waters of Meribah.
chapters.zh: 论利未说，耶和华阿，你的土明和乌陵都在你的虔诚人那里。你在玛撒曾试验他，在米利巴水与他争论。

chapters.en: He said of his father and mother, ‘I have no regard for them.’ He did not recognize his brothers or acknowledge his own children, but he watched over your word and guarded your covenant.
chapters.zh: 他论自己的父母说，我未曾看见。他也不承认弟兄，也不认识自己的儿女。这是因利未人遵行你的话，谨守你的约。

chapters.en: He teaches your precepts to Jacob and your law to Israel. He offers incense before you and whole burnt offerings on your altar.
chapters.zh: 他们要将你的典章教训雅各，将你的律法教训以色列。他们要把香焚在你面前，把全牲的燔祭献在你的坛上。

chapters.en: Bless all his skills, LORD, and be pleased with the work of his hands. Strike down those who rise against him, his foes till they rise no more.”
chapters.zh: 求耶和华降福在他的财物上，悦纳他手里所办的事。那些起来攻击他和恨恶他的人，愿你刺透他们的腰，使他们不得再起来。

chapters.en: About Benjamin he said: “Let the beloved of the LORD rest secure in him, for he shields him all day long, and the one the LORD loves rests between his shoulders.”
chapters.zh: 论便雅悯说，耶和华所亲爱的必同耶和华安然居住。耶和华终日遮蔽他，也住在他两肩之中。

chapters.en: About Joseph he said: “May the LORD bless his land with the precious dew from heaven above and with the deep waters that lie below;
chapters.zh: 论约瑟说，愿他的地蒙耶和华赐福，得天上的宝物，甘露，以及地里所藏的泉水。

chapters.en: with the best the sun brings forth and the finest the moon can yield;
chapters.zh: 得太阳所晒熟的美果，月亮所养成的宝物。

chapters.en: with the choicest gifts of the ancient mountains and the fruitfulness of the everlasting hills;
chapters.zh: 得上古之山的至宝，永世之岭的宝物。

chapters.en: with the best gifts of the earth and its fullness and the favor of him who dwelt in the burning bush. Let all these rest on the head of Joseph, on the brow of the prince among his brothers.
chapters.zh: 得地和其中所充满的宝物，并住荆棘中上主的喜悦。愿这些福都归于约瑟的头上，归于那与弟兄迥别之人的顶上。

chapters.en: In majesty he is like a firstborn bull; his horns are the horns of a wild ox. With them he will gore the nations, even those at the ends of the earth. Such are the ten thousands of Ephraim; such are the thousands of Manasseh.”
chapters.zh: 他为牛群中头生的，有威严。他的角是野牛的角，用以抵触万邦，直到地极。这角是以法莲的万万，玛拿西的千千。

chapters.en: About Zebulun he said: “Rejoice, Zebulun, in your going out, and you, Issachar, in your tents.
chapters.zh: 论西布伦说，西布伦哪，你出外可以欢喜。以萨迦阿，在你帐棚里可以快乐。

chapters.en: They will summon peoples to the mountain and there offer the sacrifices of the righteous; they will feast on the abundance of the seas, on the treasures hidden in the sand.”
chapters.zh: 他们要将列邦召到山上，在那里献公义的祭。因为他们要吸取海里的丰富，并沙中所藏的珍宝。

chapters.en: About Gad he said: “Blessed is he who enlarges Gad’s domain! Gad lives there like a lion, tearing at arm or head.
chapters.zh: 论迦得说，使迦得扩张的应当称颂。迦得住如母狮。他撕裂膀臂，连头顶也撕裂。

chapters.en: He chose the best land for himself; the leader’s portion was kept for him. When the heads of the people assembled, he carried out the LORD’s righteous will, and his judgments concerning Israel.”
chapters.zh: 他为自己选择头一段地，因在那里有设立律法者的分存留。他与百姓的首领同来。他施行耶和华的公义和耶和华与以色列所立的典章。

chapters.en: About Dan he said: “Dan is a lion’s cub, springing out of Bashan.”
chapters.zh: 论但说，但为小狮子，从巴珊跳出来。

chapters.en: About Naphtali he said: “Naphtali is abounding with the favor of the LORD and is full of his blessing; he will inherit southward to the lake.”
chapters.zh: 论拿弗他利说，拿弗他利阿，你足沾恩惠，满得耶和华的福，可以得西方和南方为业。

chapters.en: About Asher he said: “Most blessed of sons is Asher; let him be favored by his brothers, and let him bathe his feet in oil.
chapters.zh: 论亚设说，愿亚设享受多子的福乐，得他弟兄的喜悦，可以把脚蘸在油中。

chapters.en: The bolts of your gates will be iron and bronze, and your strength will equal your days.
chapters.zh: 你的门闩（门闩或作鞋）是铜的，铁的。你的日子如何，你的力量也必如何。

chapters.en: “There is no one like the God of Jeshurun, who rides across the heavens to help you and on the clouds in his majesty.
chapters.zh: 耶书仑哪，没有能比神的。他为帮助你，乘在天空，显其威荣，驾行穹苍。

chapters.en: The eternal God is your refuge, and underneath are the everlasting arms. He will drive out your enemies before you, saying, ‘Destroy them!’
chapters.zh: 永生的神是你的居所。他永久的膀臂在你以下。他在你前面撵出仇敌，说，毁灭吧。

chapters.en: So Israel will live in safety; Jacob will dwell secure in a land of grain and new wine, where the heavens drop dew.
chapters.zh: 以色列安然居住。雅各的本源独居五谷新酒之地。他的天也滴甘露。

chapters.en: Blessed are you, Israel! Who is like you, a people saved by the LORD? He is your shield and helper and your glorious sword. Your enemies will cower before you, and you will tread on their heights.”
chapters.zh: 以色列阿，你是有福的。谁象你这蒙耶和华所拯救的百姓呢？他是你的盾牌，帮助你，是你威荣的刀剑。你的仇敌必投降你。你必踏在他们的高处。

chapters.en: Then Moses climbed Mount Nebo from the plains of Moab to the top of Pisgah, across from Jericho. There the LORD showed him the whole land—from Gilead to Dan,
chapters.zh: 摩西从摩押平原登尼波山，上了那与耶利哥相对的毗斯迦山顶。耶和华把基列全地直到但，

chapters.en: all of Naphtali, the territory of Ephraim and Manasseh, all the land of Judah as far as the Mediterranean Sea,
chapters.zh: 拿弗他利全地，以法莲，玛拿西的地，犹大全地直到西海，

chapters.en: the Negev and the whole region from the Valley of Jericho, the City of Palms, as far as Zoar.
chapters.zh: 南地和棕树城耶利哥的平原，直到琐珥，都指给他看。

chapters.en: Then the LORD said to him, “This is the land I promised on oath to Abraham, Isaac and Jacob when I said, ‘I will give it to your descendants.’ I have let you see it with your eyes, but you will not cross over into it.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华对他说，这就是我向亚伯拉罕，以撒，雅各起誓应许之地。说，我必将这地赐给你的后裔。现在我使你眼睛看见了，你却不得过到那里去。

chapters.en: And Moses the servant of the LORD died there in Moab, as the LORD had said.
chapters.zh: 于是，耶和华的仆人摩西死在摩押地，正如耶和华所说的。

chapters.en: He buried him in Moab, in the valley opposite Beth Peor, but to this day no one knows where his grave is.
chapters.zh: 耶和华将他埋葬在摩押地，伯毗珥对面的谷中，只是到今日没有人知道他的坟墓。

chapters.en: Moses was a hundred and twenty years old when he died, yet his eyes were not weak nor his strength gone.
chapters.zh: 摩西死的时候年一百二十岁。眼目没有昏花，精神没有衰败。

chapters.en: The Israelites grieved for Moses in the plains of Moab thirty days, until the time of weeping and mourning was over.
chapters.zh: 以色列人在摩押平原为摩西哀哭了三十日，为摩西居丧哀哭的日子就满了。

chapters.en: Now Joshua son of Nun was filled with the spirit of wisdom because Moses had laid his hands on him. So the Israelites listened to him and did what the LORD had commanded Moses.
chapters.zh: 嫩的儿子约书亚。因为摩西曾按手在他头上，就被智慧的灵充满，以色列人便听从他，照着耶和华吩咐摩西的行了。

chapters.en: Since then, no prophet has risen in Israel like Moses, whom the LORD knew face to face,
chapters.zh: 以后以色列中再没有兴起先知像摩西的。他是耶和华面对面所认识的。

chapters.en: who did all those signs and wonders the LORD sent him to do in Egypt—to Pharaoh and to all his officials and to his whole land.
chapters.zh: 耶和华打发他在埃及地向法老和他的一切臣仆，并他的全地，行各样神迹奇事，

chapters.en: For no one has ever shown the mighty power or performed the awesome deeds that Moses did in the sight of all Israel.
chapters.zh: 又在以色列众人眼前显大能的手，行一切大而可畏的事。

chapters.en: After the death of Moses the servant of the LORD, the LORD said to Joshua son of Nun, Moses’ aide:
chapters.zh: 耶和华的仆人摩西死了以后，耶和华晓谕摩西的帮手，嫩的儿子约书亚，说，

chapters.en: “Moses my servant is dead. Now then, you and all these people, get ready to cross the Jordan River into the land I am about to give to them—to the Israelites.
chapters.zh: 我的仆人摩西死了。现在你要起来，和众百姓过这约旦河，往我所要赐给以色列人的地去。

chapters.en: I will give you every place where you set your foot, as I promised Moses.
chapters.zh: 凡你们脚掌所踏之地，我都照着我所应许摩西的话赐给你们了。

chapters.en: Your territory will extend from the desert to Lebanon, and from the great river, the Euphrates—all the Hittite country—to the Mediterranean Sea in the west.
chapters.zh: 从旷野，和这利巴嫩，直到伯拉大河。赫人的全地。又到大海日落之处。都要作你们的境界。

chapters.en: No one will be able to stand against you all the days of your life. As I was with Moses, so I will be with you; I will never leave you nor forsake you.
chapters.zh: 你平生的日子，必无一人能在你面前站立得住。我怎样与摩西同在，也必照样与你同在。我必不撇下你，也不丢弃你。

chapters.en: Be strong and courageous, because you will lead these people to inherit the land I swore to their ancestors to give them.
chapters.zh: 你当刚强壮胆。因为你必使这百姓承受那地为业，就是我向他们列祖起誓应许赐给他们的地。

chapters.en: “Be strong and very courageous. Be careful to obey all the law my servant Moses gave you; do not turn from it to the right or to the left, that you may be successful wherever you go.
chapters.zh: 只要刚强，大大壮胆，谨守遵行我仆人摩西所吩咐你的一切律法，不可偏离左右，使你无论往哪里去，都可以顺利。

chapters.en: Keep this Book of the Law always on your lips; meditate on it day and night, so that you may be careful to do everything written in it. Then you will be prosperous and successful.
chapters.zh: 这律法书不可离开你的口，总要昼夜思想，好使你谨守遵行这书上所写的一切话。如此，你的道路就可以亨通，凡事顺利。

chapters.en: Have I not commanded you? Be strong and courageous. Do not be afraid; do not be discouraged, for the LORD your God will be with you wherever you go.”
chapters.zh: 我岂没有吩咐你吗？你当刚强壮胆。不要惧怕，也不要惊惶。因为你无论往哪里去，耶和华你的神必与你同在。

chapters.en: So Joshua ordered the officers of the people:
chapters.zh: 于是，约书亚吩咐百姓的官长说，

chapters.en: “Go through the camp and tell the people, ‘Get your provisions ready. Three days from now you will cross the Jordan here to go in and take possession of the land the LORD your God is giving you for your own.’ ”
chapters.zh: 你们要走遍营中，吩咐百姓说，当预备食物。因为三日之内你们要过这约旦河，进去得耶和华你们神赐你们为业之地。

chapters.en: But to the Reubenites, the Gadites and the half-tribe of Manasseh, Joshua said,
chapters.zh: 约书亚对流便人，迦得人，和玛拿西半支派的人说，

chapters.en: “Remember the command that Moses the servant of the LORD gave you after he said, ‘The LORD your God will give you rest by giving you this land.’
chapters.zh: 你们要追念耶和华的仆人摩西所吩咐你们的话说，耶和华你们的神使你们得享平安，也必将这地赐给你们。

chapters.en: Your wives, your children and your livestock may stay in the land that Moses gave you east of the Jordan, but all your fighting men, ready for battle, must cross over ahead of your fellow Israelites. You are to help them
chapters.zh: 你们的妻子，孩子，和牲畜都可以留在约旦河东，摩西所给你们的地。但你们中间一切大能的勇士都要带着兵器在你们的弟兄前面过去，帮助他们，

chapters.en: until the LORD gives them rest, as he has done for you, and until they too have taken possession of the land the LORD your God is giving them. After that, you may go back and occupy your own land, which Moses the servant of the LORD gave you east of the Jordan toward the sunrise.”
chapters.zh: 等到耶和华使你们的弟兄象你们一样得享平安，并且得着耶和华你们神所赐他们为业之地，那时才可以回你们所得之地，承受为业，就是耶和华的仆人摩西在约旦河东，向日出之地所给你们的。

chapters.en: Then they answered Joshua, “Whatever you have commanded us we will do, and wherever you send us we will go.
chapters.zh: 他们回答约书亚说，你所吩咐我们行的，我们都必行。你所差遣我们去的，我们都必去。

chapters.en: Just as we fully obeyed Moses, so we will obey you. Only may the LORD your God be with you as he was with Moses.
chapters.zh: 我们从前在一切事上怎样听从摩西，现在也必照样听从你。惟愿耶和华你的神与你同在，像与摩西同在一样。

chapters.en: Whoever rebels against your word and does not obey it, whatever you may command them, will be put to death. Only be strong and courageous!”
chapters.zh: 无论什么人违背你的命令，不听从你所吩咐他的一切话，就必治死他。你只要刚强壮胆。

chapters.en: Then Joshua son of Nun secretly sent two spies from Shittim. “Go, look over the land,” he said, “especially Jericho.” So they went and entered the house of a prostitute named Rahab and stayed there.
chapters.zh: 当下，嫩的儿子约书亚从什亭暗暗打发两个人作探子，吩咐说，你们去窥探那地和耶利哥。于是二人去了，来到一个妓女名叫喇合的家里，就在那里躺卧。

chapters.en: The king of Jericho was told, “Look, some of the Israelites have come here tonight to spy out the land.”
chapters.zh: 有人告诉耶利哥王说，今夜有以色列人来到这里窥探此地。

chapters.en: So the king of Jericho sent this message to Rahab: “Bring out the men who came to you and entered your house, because they have come to spy out the whole land.”
chapters.zh: 耶利哥王打发人去见喇合说，那来到你这里，进了你家的人要交出来，因为他们来窥探全地。

chapters.en: But the woman had taken the two men and hidden them. She said, “Yes, the men came to me, but I did not know where they had come from.
chapters.zh: 女人将二人隐藏，就回答说，那人果然到我这里来。他们是哪里来的我却不知道。

chapters.en: At dusk, when it was time to close the city gate, they left. I don’t know which way they went. Go after them quickly. You may catch up with them.”
chapters.zh: 天黑，要关城门的时候，他们出去了，往哪里去我却不知道。你们快快地去追赶，就必追上。

chapters.en: (But she had taken them up to the roof and hidden them under the stalks of flax she had laid out on the roof.)
chapters.zh: （先是女人领二人上了房顶，将他们藏在那里所摆的麻秸中。）

chapters.en: So the men set out in pursuit of the spies on the road that leads to the fords of the Jordan, and as soon as the pursuers had gone out, the gate was shut.
chapters.zh: 那些人就往约旦河的渡口追赶他们去了。追赶他们的人一出去，城门就关了。

chapters.en: Before the spies lay down for the night, she went up on the roof
chapters.zh: 二人还没有躺卧，女人就上房顶，到他们那里，

chapters.en: and said to them, “I know that the LORD has given you this land and that a great fear of you has fallen on us, so that all who live in this country are melting in fear because of you.
chapters.zh: 对他们说，我知道耶和华已经把这地赐给你们，并且因你们的缘故我们都惊慌了。这地的一切居民在你们面前心都消化了。

chapters.en: We have heard how the LORD dried up the water of the Red Sea for you when you came out of Egypt, and what you did to Sihon and Og, the two kings of the Amorites east of the Jordan, whom you completely destroyed.
chapters.zh: 因为我们听见你们出埃及的时候，耶和华怎样在你们前面使红海的水干了，并且你们怎样待约旦河东的两个亚摩利王西宏和噩，将他们尽行毁灭。

chapters.en: When we heard of it, our hearts melted in fear and everyone’s courage failed because of you, for the LORD your God is God in heaven above and on the earth below.
chapters.zh: 我们一听见这些事，心就消化了。因你们的缘故，并无一人有胆气。耶和华你们的神本是上天下地的神。

chapters.en: “Now then, please swear to me by the LORD that you will show kindness to my family, because I have shown kindness to you. Give me a sure sign
chapters.zh: 现在我既是恩待你们，求你们指着耶和华向我起誓，也要恩待我父家，并给我一个实在的证据，

chapters.en: that you will spare the lives of my father and mother, my brothers and sisters, and all who belong to them—and that you will save us from death.”
chapters.zh: 要救活我的父母，弟兄，姐妹，和一切属他们的，拯救我们性命不死。

chapters.en: “Our lives for your lives!” the men assured her. “If you don’t tell what we are doing, we will treat you kindly and faithfully when the LORD gives us the land.”
chapters.zh: 二人对她说，你若不泄漏我们这件事，我们情愿替你们死。耶和华将这地赐给我们的时候，我们必以慈爱诚实待你。

chapters.en: So she let them down by a rope through the window, for the house she lived in was part of the city wall.
chapters.zh: 于是女人用绳子将二人从窗户里缒下去。因她的房子是在城墙边上，她也住在城墙上。

chapters.en: She said to them, “Go to the hills so the pursuers will not find you. Hide yourselves there three days until they return, and then go on your way.”
chapters.zh: 她对他们说，你们且往山上去，恐怕追赶的人碰见你们。要在那里隐藏三天，等追赶的人回来，然后才可以走你们的路。

chapters.en: Now the men had said to her, “This oath you made us swear will not be binding on us
chapters.zh: 二人对她说，你要这样行。不然，你叫我们所起的誓就与我们无干了。

chapters.en: unless, when we enter the land, you have tied this scarlet cord in the window through which you let us down, and unless you have brought your father and mother, your brothers and all your family into your house.
chapters.zh: 我们来到这地的时候，你要把这条朱红线绳系在缒我们下去的窗户上，并要使你的父母，弟兄，和你父的全家都聚集在你家中。

chapters.en: If any of them go outside your house into the street, their blood will be on their own heads; we will not be responsible. As for those who are in the house with you, their blood will be on our head if a hand is laid on them.
chapters.zh: 凡出了你家门往街上去的，他的罪必归到自己的头上（罪原文作血），与我们无干了。凡在你家里的，若有人下手害他，流他血的罪就归到我们的头上。

chapters.en: But if you tell what we are doing, we will be released from the oath you made us swear.”
chapters.zh: 你若泄漏我们这件事，你叫我们所起的誓就与我们无干了。

chapters.en: “Agreed,” she replied. “Let it be as you say.” So she sent them away, and they departed. And she tied the scarlet cord in the window.
chapters.zh: 女人说，照你们的话行吧。于是打发他们去了，又把朱红线绳系在窗户上。

chapters.en: When they left, they went into the hills and stayed there three days, until the pursuers had searched all along the road and returned without finding them.
chapters.zh: 二人到山上，在那里住了三天，等着追赶的人回去了。追赶的人一路找他们，却找不着。

chapters.en: Then the two men started back. They went down out of the hills, forded the river and came to Joshua son of Nun and told him everything that had happened to them.
chapters.zh: 二人就下山回来，过了河，到嫩的儿子约书亚那里，向他述说所遭遇的一切事。

chapters.en: They said to Joshua, “The LORD has surely given the whole land into our hands; all the people are melting in fear because of us.”
chapters.zh: 又对约书亚说，耶和华果然将那全地交在我们手中。那地的一切居民在我们面前心都消化了。

chapters.en: Early in the morning Joshua and all the Israelites set out from Shittim and went to the Jordan, where they camped before crossing over.
chapters.zh: 约书亚清早起来，和以色列众人都离开什亭，来到约旦河，就住在那里，等候过河。

chapters.en: After three days the officers went throughout the camp,
chapters.zh: 过了三天，官长走遍营中，

chapters.en: giving orders to the people: “When you see the ark of the covenant of the LORD your God, and the Levitical priests carrying it, you are to move out from your positions and follow it.
chapters.zh: 吩咐百姓说，你们看见耶和华你们神的约柜，又见祭司利未人抬着，就要离开所住的地方，跟着约柜去。

chapters.en: Then you will know which way to go, since you have never been this way before. But keep a distance of about two thousand cubits between you and the ark; do not go near it.”
chapters.zh: 只是你们和约柜相离要量二千肘，不可与约柜相近，使你们知道所当走的路，因为这条路你们向来没有走过。

chapters.en: Joshua told the people, “Consecrate yourselves, for tomorrow the LORD will do amazing things among you.”
chapters.zh: 约书亚吩咐百姓说，你们要自洁，因为明天耶和华必在你们中间行奇事。

chapters.en: Joshua said to the priests, “Take up the ark of the covenant and pass on ahead of the people.” So they took it up and went ahead of them.
chapters.zh: 约书亚又吩咐祭司说，你们抬起约柜，在百姓前头过去。于是他们抬起约柜，在百姓前头走。

chapters.en: And the LORD said to Joshua, “Today I will begin to exalt you in the eyes of all Israel, so they may know that I am with you as I was with Moses.
chapters.zh: 耶和华对约书亚说，从今日起，我必使你在以色列众人眼前尊大，使他们知道我怎样与摩西同在，也必照样与你同在。

chapters.en: Tell the priests who carry the ark of the covenant: ‘When you reach the edge of the Jordan’s waters, go and stand in the river.’ ”
chapters.zh: 你要吩咐抬约柜的祭司说，你们到了约旦河的水边上，就要在约旦河水里站住。

chapters.en: Joshua said to the Israelites, “Come here and listen to the words of the LORD your God.
chapters.zh: 约书亚对以色列人说，你们近前来，听耶和华你们神的话。

chapters.en: This is how you will know that the living God is among you and that he will certainly drive out before you the Canaanites, Hittites, Hivites, Perizzites, Girgashites, Amorites and Jebusites.
chapters.zh: 约书亚说，看哪，普天下主的约柜必在你们前头过去，到约旦河里，因此你们就知道在你们中间有永生神。并且他必在你们面前赶出迦南人，赫人，希未人，比利洗人，革迦撒人，亚摩利人，耶布斯人。

chapters.en: See, the ark of the covenant of the Lord of all the earth will go into the Jordan ahead of you.
Now then, choose twelve men from the tribes of Israel, one from each tribe.
chapters.zh: 你们现在要从以色列支派中拣选十二个人，每支派一人，

chapters.en: And as soon as the priests who carry the ark of the LORD—the Lord of all the earth—set foot in the Jordan, its waters flowing downstream will be cut off and stand up in a heap.”
chapters.zh: 等到抬普天下主耶和华约柜的祭司把脚站在约旦河水里，约旦河的水，就是从上往下流的水，必然断绝，立起成垒。

chapters.en: So when the people broke camp to cross the Jordan, the priests carrying the ark of the covenant went ahead of them.
chapters.zh: 百姓离开帐棚要过约旦河的时候，抬约柜的祭司乃在百姓的前头。

chapters.en: Now the Jordan is at flood stage all during harvest. Yet as soon as the priests who carried the ark reached the Jordan and their feet touched the water’s edge,
chapters.zh: 他们到了约旦河，脚一入水（原来约旦河水在收割的日子涨过两岸），

chapters.en: the water from upstream stopped flowing. It piled up in a heap a great distance away, at a town called Adam in the vicinity of Zarethan, while the water flowing down to the Sea of the Arabah (that is, the Dead Sea) was completely cut off. So the people crossed over opposite Jericho.
chapters.zh: 那从上往下流的水便在极远之地，撒拉但旁的亚当城那里停住，立起成垒。那往亚拉巴的海，就是盐海，下流的水全然断绝。于是百姓在耶利哥的对面过去了。

chapters.en: The priests who carried the ark of the covenant of the LORD stopped in the middle of the Jordan and stood on dry ground, while all Israel passed by until the whole nation had completed the crossing on dry ground.
chapters.zh: 抬耶和华约柜的祭司在约旦河中的干地上站定，以色列众人都从干地上过去，直到国民尽都过了约旦河。

chapters.en: When the whole nation had finished crossing the Jordan, the LORD said to Joshua,
chapters.zh: 国民尽都过了约旦河，耶和华就对约书亚说，

chapters.en: “Choose twelve men from among the people, one from each tribe,
chapters.zh: 你从民中要拣选十二个人，每支派一人，

chapters.en: and tell them to take up twelve stones from the middle of the Jordan, from right where the priests are standing, and carry them over with you and put them down at the place where you stay tonight.”
chapters.zh: 吩咐他们说，你们从这里，从约旦河中，祭司脚站定的地方，取十二块石头带过去，放在你们今夜要住宿的地方。

chapters.en: So Joshua called together the twelve men he had appointed from the Israelites, one from each tribe,
chapters.zh: 于是，约书亚将他从以色列人中所预备的那十二个人，每支派一人，都召了来。

chapters.en: and said to them, “Go over before the ark of the LORD your God into the middle of the Jordan. Each of you is to take up a stone on his shoulder, according to the number of the tribes of the Israelites,
chapters.zh: 对他们说，你们下约旦河中，过到耶和华你们神的约柜前头，按着以色列人十二支派的数目，每人取一块石头扛在肩上。

chapters.en: to serve as a sign among you. In the future, when your children ask you, ‘What do these stones mean?’
chapters.zh: 这些石头在你们中间可以作为证据。日后，你们的子孙问你们说，这些石头是什么意思。

chapters.en: tell them that the flow of the Jordan was cut off before the ark of the covenant of the LORD. When it crossed the Jordan, the waters of the Jordan were cut off. These stones are to be a memorial to the people of Israel forever.”
chapters.zh: 你们就对他们说，这是因为约旦河的水在耶和华的约柜前断绝。约柜过约旦河的时候，约旦河的水就断绝了。这些石头要作以色列人永远的纪念。

chapters.en: So the Israelites did as Joshua commanded them. They took twelve stones from the middle of the Jordan, according to the number of the tribes of the Israelites, as the LORD had told Joshua; and they carried them over with them to their camp, where they put them down.
chapters.zh: 以色列人就照约书亚所吩咐的，按着以色列人支派的数目，从约旦河中取了十二块石头，都遵耶和华所吩咐约书亚的行了。他们把石头带过去，到他们所住宿的地方，就放在那里。

chapters.en: Joshua set up the twelve stones that had been in the middle of the Jordan at the spot where the priests who carried the ark of the covenant had stood. And they are there to this day.
chapters.zh: 约书亚另把十二块石头立在约旦河中，在抬约柜的祭司脚站立的地方。直到今日，那石头还在那里。

chapters.en: Now the priests who carried the ark remained standing in the middle of the Jordan until everything the LORD had commanded Joshua was done by the people, just as Moses had directed Joshua. The people hurried over,
chapters.zh: 抬约柜的祭司站在约旦河中，等到耶和华晓谕约书亚吩咐百姓的事办完了，是照摩西所吩咐约书亚的一切话。于是百姓急速过去了。

chapters.en: and as soon as all of them had crossed, the ark of the LORD and the priests came to the other side while the people watched.
chapters.zh: 众百姓尽都过了河，耶和华的约柜和祭司就在百姓面前过去。

chapters.en: The men of Reuben, Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh crossed over, ready for battle, in front of the Israelites, as Moses had directed them.
chapters.zh: 流便人，迦得人，玛拿西半支派的人都照摩西所吩咐他们的，带着兵器在以色列人前头过去。

chapters.en: About forty thousand armed for battle crossed over before the LORD to the plains of Jericho for war.
chapters.zh: 约有四万人都准备打仗，在耶和华面前过去，到耶利哥的平原，等候上阵。

chapters.en: That day the LORD exalted Joshua in the sight of all Israel; and they stood in awe of him all the days of his life, just as they had stood in awe of Moses.
chapters.zh: 当那日，耶和华使约书亚在以色列众人眼前尊大。在他平生的日子，百姓敬畏他，像从前敬畏摩西一样。

chapters.en: Then the LORD said to Joshua,
chapters.zh: 耶和华晓谕约书亚说，

chapters.en: “Command the priests carrying the ark of the covenant law to come up out of the Jordan.”
chapters.zh: 你吩咐抬法柜的祭司从约旦河里上来。

chapters.en: So Joshua commanded the priests, “Come up out of the Jordan.”
chapters.zh: 约书亚就吩咐祭司说，你们从约旦河里上来。

chapters.en: And the priests came up out of the river carrying the ark of the covenant of the LORD. No sooner had they set their feet on the dry ground than the waters of the Jordan returned to their place and ran at flood stage as before.
chapters.zh: 抬耶和华约柜的祭司从约旦河里上来，脚掌刚落旱地，约旦河的水就流到原处，仍旧涨过两岸。

chapters.en: On the tenth day of the first month the people went up from the Jordan and camped at Gilgal on the eastern border of Jericho.
chapters.zh: 正月初十日，百姓从约旦河里上来，就在吉甲，在耶利哥的东边安营。

chapters.en: And Joshua set up at Gilgal the twelve stones they had taken out of the Jordan.
chapters.zh: 他们从约旦河中取来的那十二块石头，约书亚就立在吉甲，

chapters.en: He said to the Israelites, “In the future when your descendants ask their parents, ‘What do these stones mean?’
chapters.zh: 对以色列人说，日后你们的子孙问他们的父亲说，这些石头是什么意思。

chapters.en: tell them, ‘Israel crossed the Jordan on dry ground.’
chapters.zh: 你们就告诉他们说，以色列人曾走干地过这约旦河。

chapters.en: For the LORD your God dried up the Jordan before you until you had crossed over. The LORD your God did to the Jordan what he had done to the Red Sea when he dried it up before us until we had crossed over.
chapters.zh: 因为耶和华你们的神在你们前面使约旦河的水干了，等着你们过来，就如耶和华你们的神从前在我们前面使红海干了，等着我们过来一样，

chapters.en: He did this so that all the peoples of the earth might know that the hand of the LORD is powerful and so that you might always fear the LORD your God.”
chapters.zh: 要使地上万民都知道，耶和华的手大有能力，也要使你们永远敬畏耶和华你们的神。

chapters.en: Now when all the Amorite kings west of the Jordan and all the Canaanite kings along the coast heard how the LORD had dried up the Jordan before the Israelites until they had crossed over, their hearts melted in fear and they no longer had the courage to face the Israelites.
chapters.zh: 约旦河西亚摩利人的诸王和靠海迦南人的诸王，听见耶和华在以色列人前面使约旦河的水干了，等到我们过去，他们的心因以色列人的缘故就消化了，不再有胆气。

chapters.en: At that time the LORD said to Joshua, “Make flint knives and circumcise the Israelites again.”
chapters.zh: 那时，耶和华吩咐约书亚说，你制造火石刀，第二次给以色列人行割礼。

chapters.en: So Joshua made flint knives and circumcised the Israelites at Gibeath Haaraloth.
chapters.zh: 约书亚就制造了火石刀，在除皮山那里给以色列人行割礼。

chapters.en: Now this is why he did so: All those who came out of Egypt—all the men of military age—died in the wilderness on the way after leaving Egypt.
chapters.zh: 约书亚行割礼的缘故，是因为从埃及出来的众民，就是一切能打仗的男丁，出了埃及以后，都死在旷野的路上。

chapters.en: All the people that came out had been circumcised, but all the people born in the wilderness during the journey from Egypt had not.
chapters.zh: 因为出来的众民都受过割礼。惟独出埃及以后，在旷野的路上所生的众民都没有受过割礼。

chapters.en: The Israelites had moved about in the wilderness forty years until all the men who were of military age when they left Egypt had died, since they had not obeyed the LORD. For the LORD had sworn to them that they would not see the land he had solemnly promised their ancestors to give us, a land flowing with milk and honey.
chapters.zh: 以色列人在旷野走了四十年，等到国民，就是出埃及的兵丁，都消灭了，因为他们没有听从耶和华的话。耶和华曾向他们起誓，必不容他们看见耶和华向他们列祖起誓，应许赐给我们的地，就是流奶与蜜之地。

chapters.en: So he raised up their sons in their place, and these were the ones Joshua circumcised. They were still uncircumcised because they had not been circumcised on the way.
chapters.zh: 他们的子孙，就是耶和华所兴起来接续他们的，都没有受过割礼。因为在路上没有给他们行割礼，约书亚这才给他们行了。

chapters.en: And after the whole nation had been circumcised, they remained where they were in camp until they were healed.
chapters.zh: 国民都受完了割礼，就住在营中自己的地方，等到痊愈了。

chapters.en: Then the LORD said to Joshua, “Today I have rolled away the reproach of Egypt from you.” So the place has been called Gilgal to this day.
chapters.zh: 耶和华对约书亚说，我今日将埃及的羞辱从你们身上滚去了。因此，那地方名叫吉甲，直到今日（吉甲就是滚的意思）。

chapters.en: On the evening of the fourteenth day of the month, while camped at Gilgal on the plains of Jericho, the Israelites celebrated the Passover.
chapters.zh: 以色列人在吉甲安营。正月十四日晚上，在耶利哥的平原守逾越节。

chapters.en: The day after the Passover, that very day, they ate some of the produce of the land: unleavened bread and roasted grain.
chapters.zh: 逾越节的次日，他们就吃了那地的出产。正当那日吃无酵饼和烘的谷。

chapters.en: The manna stopped the day after they ate this food from the land; there was no longer any manna for the Israelites, but that year they ate the produce of Canaan.
chapters.zh: 他们吃了那地的出产，第二日吗哪就止住了，以色列人也不再有吗哪了。那一年，他们却吃迦南地的出产。

chapters.en: Now when Joshua was near Jericho, he looked up and saw a man standing in front of him with a drawn sword in his hand. Joshua went up to him and asked, “Are you for us or for our enemies?”
chapters.zh: 约书亚靠近耶利哥的时候，举目观看，不料，有一个人手里有拔出来的刀，对面站立。约书亚到他那里，问他说，你是帮助我们呢？是帮助我们敌人呢？

chapters.en: “Neither,” he replied, “but as commander of the army of the LORD I have now come.” Then Joshua fell facedown to the ground in reverence, and asked him, “What message does my Lord have for his servant?”
chapters.zh: 他回答说，不是的，我来是要作耶和华军队的元帅。约书亚就俯伏在地下拜，说，我主有什么话吩咐仆人。

chapters.en: The commander of the LORD’s army replied, “Take off your sandals, for the place where you are standing is holy.” And Joshua did so.
chapters.zh: 耶和华军队的元帅对约书亚说，把你脚上的鞋脱下来，因为你所站的地方是圣的。约书亚就照着行了。

chapters.en: Now the gates of Jericho were securely barred because of the Israelites. No one went out and no one came in.
chapters.zh: 耶利哥的城门因以色列人就关得严紧，无人出入。

chapters.en: Then the LORD said to Joshua, “See, I have delivered Jericho into your hands, along with its king and its fighting men.
chapters.zh: 耶和华晓谕约书亚说，看哪，我已经把耶利哥和耶利哥的王，并大能的勇士，都交在你手中。

chapters.en: March around the city once with all the armed men. Do this for six days.
chapters.zh: 你们的一切兵丁要围绕这城，一日围绕一次，六日都要这样行。

chapters.en: Have seven priests carry trumpets of rams’ horns in front of the ark. On the seventh day, march around the city seven times, with the priests blowing the trumpets.
chapters.zh: 七个祭司要拿七个羊角走在约柜前。到第七日，你们要绕城七次，祭司也要吹角。

chapters.en: When you hear them sound a long blast on the trumpets, have the whole army give a loud shout; then the wall of the city will collapse and the army will go up, everyone straight in.”
chapters.zh: 他们吹的角声拖长，你们听见角声，众百姓要大声呼喊，城墙就必塌陷，各人都要往前直上。

chapters.en: So Joshua son of Nun called the priests and said to them, “Take up the ark of the covenant of the LORD and have seven priests carry trumpets in front of it.”
chapters.zh: 嫩的儿子约书亚召了祭司来，吩咐他们说，你们抬起约柜来，要有七个祭司拿七个羊角走在耶和华的约柜前。

chapters.en: And he ordered the army, “Advance! March around the city, with an armed guard going ahead of the ark of the LORD.”
chapters.zh: 又对百姓说，你们前去绕城，带兵器的要走在耶和华的约柜前。

chapters.en: When Joshua had spoken to the people, the seven priests carrying the seven trumpets before the LORD went forward, blowing their trumpets, and the ark of the LORD’s covenant followed them.
chapters.zh: 约书亚对百姓说完了话，七个祭司拿七个羊角走在耶和华面前吹角。耶和华的约柜在他们后面跟随。

chapters.en: The armed guard marched ahead of the priests who blew the trumpets, and the rear guard followed the ark. All this time the trumpets were sounding.
chapters.zh: 带兵器的走在吹角的祭司前面，后队随着约柜行。祭司一面走一面吹。

chapters.en: But Joshua had commanded the army, “Do not give a war cry, do not raise your voices, do not say a word until the day I tell you to shout. Then shout!”
chapters.zh: 约书亚吩咐百姓说，你们不可呼喊，不可出声，连一句话也不可出你们的口，等到我吩咐你们呼喊的日子，那时才可以呼喊。

chapters.en: So he had the ark of the LORD carried around the city, circling it once. Then the army returned to camp and spent the night there.
chapters.zh: 这样，他使耶和华的约柜绕城，把城绕了一次。众人回到营里，就在营里住宿。

chapters.en: Joshua got up early the next morning and the priests took up the ark of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 约书亚清早起来，祭司又抬起耶和华的约柜。

chapters.en: The seven priests carrying the seven trumpets went forward, marching before the ark of the LORD and blowing the trumpets. The armed men went ahead of them and the rear guard followed the ark of the LORD, while the trumpets kept sounding.
chapters.zh: 七个祭司拿七个羊角在耶和华的约柜前，时常行走吹角。带兵器的在他们前面走，后队随着耶和华的约柜行。祭司一面走一面吹。

chapters.en: So on the second day they marched around the city once and returned to the camp. They did this for six days.
chapters.zh: 第二日，众人把城绕了一次，就回营里去。六日都是这样行。

chapters.en: On the seventh day, they got up at daybreak and marched around the city seven times in the same manner, except that on that day they circled the city seven times.
chapters.zh: 第七日清早，黎明的时候，他们起来，照样绕城七次。惟独这日把城绕了七次。

chapters.en: The seventh time around, when the priests sounded the trumpet blast, Joshua commanded the army, “Shout! For the LORD has given you the city!
chapters.zh: 到了第七次，祭司吹角的时候，约书亚吩咐百姓说，呼喊吧，因为耶和华已经把城交给你们了。

chapters.en: The city and all that is in it are to be devoted to the LORD. Only Rahab the prostitute and all who are with her in her house shall be spared, because she hid the spies we sent.
chapters.zh: 这城和其中所有的都要在耶和华面前毁灭。只有妓女喇合与她家中所有的可以存活，因为她隐藏了我们所打发的使者。

chapters.en: But keep away from the devoted things, so that you will not bring about your own destruction by taking any of them. Otherwise you will make the camp of Israel liable to destruction and bring trouble on it.
chapters.zh: 至于你们，务要谨慎，不可取那当灭的物，恐怕你们取了那当灭的物就连累以色列的全营，使全营受咒诅。

chapters.en: All the silver and gold and the articles of bronze and iron are sacred to the LORD and must go into his treasury.”
chapters.zh: 惟有金子，银子，和铜铁的器皿都要归耶和华为圣，必入耶和华的库中。

chapters.en: When the trumpets sounded, the army shouted, and at the sound of the trumpet, when the men gave a loud shout, the wall collapsed; so everyone charged straight in, and they took the city.
chapters.zh: 于是百姓呼喊，祭司也吹角。百姓听见角声，便大声呼喊，城墙就塌陷，百姓便上去进城，各人往前直上，将城夺取。

chapters.en: They devoted the city to the LORD and destroyed with the sword every living thing in it—men and women, young and old, cattle, sheep and donkeys.
chapters.zh: 又将城中所有的，不拘男女老少，牛羊和驴，都用刀杀尽。

chapters.en: Joshua said to the two men who had spied out the land, “Go into the prostitute’s house and bring her out and all who belong to her, in accordance with your oath to her.”
chapters.zh: 约书亚吩咐窥探地的两个人说，你们进那妓女的家，照着你们向她所起的誓，将那女人和她所有的都从那里带出来。

chapters.en: So the young men who had done the spying went in and brought out Rahab, her father and mother, her brothers and sisters and all who belonged to her. They brought out her entire family and put them in a place outside the camp of Israel.
chapters.zh: 当探子的两个少年人就进去，将喇合与她的父母，弟兄，和她所有的，并她一切的亲眷，都带出来，安置在以色列的营外。

chapters.en: Then they burned the whole city and everything in it, but they put the silver and gold and the articles of bronze and iron into the treasury of the LORD’s house.
chapters.zh: 众人就用火将城和其中所有的焚烧了。惟有金子，银子，和铜铁的器皿都放在耶和华殿的库中。

chapters.en: But Joshua spared Rahab the prostitute, with her family and all who belonged to her, because she hid the men Joshua had sent as spies to Jericho—and she lives among the Israelites to this day.
chapters.zh: 约书亚却把妓女喇合与她父家，并她所有的，都救活了。因为她隐藏了约书亚所打发窥探耶利哥的使者，她就住在以色列中，直到今日。

chapters.en: At that time Joshua pronounced this solemn oath: “Cursed before the LORD is the one who undertakes to rebuild this city, Jericho: “At the cost of his firstborn son he will lay its foundations; at the cost of his youngest he will set up its gates.”
chapters.zh: 当时，约书亚叫众人起誓说，有兴起重修这耶利哥城的人，当在耶和华面前受咒诅。他立根基的时候，必丧长子，安门的时候，必丧幼子。

chapters.en: So the LORD was with Joshua, and his fame spread throughout the land.
chapters.zh: 耶和华与约书亚同在，约书亚的声名传扬遍地。

chapters.en: But the Israelites were unfaithful in regard to the devoted things ; Achan son of Karmi, the son of Zimri, the son of Zerah, of the tribe of Judah, took some of them. So the LORD’s anger burned against Israel.
chapters.zh: 以色列人在当灭的物上犯了罪。因为犹大支派中，谢拉的曾孙，撒底的孙子，迦米的儿子亚干取了当灭的物。耶和华的怒气就向以色列人发作。

chapters.en: Now Joshua sent men from Jericho to Ai, which is near Beth Aven to the east of Bethel, and told them, “Go up and spy out the region.” So the men went up and spied out Ai.
chapters.zh: 当下，约书亚从耶利哥打发人往伯特利东边，靠近伯亚文的艾城去，吩咐他们说，你们上去窥探那地。他们就上去窥探艾城。

chapters.en: When they returned to Joshua, they said, “Not all the army will have to go up against Ai. Send two or three thousand men to take it and do not weary the whole army, for only a few people live there.”
chapters.zh: 他们回到约书亚那里，对他说，众民不必都上去，只要二三千人上去就能攻取艾城。不必劳累众民都去，因为那里的人少。

chapters.en: So about three thousand went up; but they were routed by the men of Ai,
chapters.zh: 于是民中约有三千人上那里去，竟在艾城人面前逃跑了。

chapters.en: who killed about thirty-six of them. They chased the Israelites from the city gate as far as the stone quarries and struck them down on the slopes. At this the hearts of the people melted in fear and became like water.
chapters.zh: 艾城的人击杀了他们三十六人，从城门前追赶他们，直到示巴琳，在下坡杀败他们。众民的心就消化如水。

chapters.en: Then Joshua tore his clothes and fell facedown to the ground before the ark of the LORD, remaining there till evening. The elders of Israel did the same, and sprinkled dust on their heads.
chapters.zh: 约书亚便撕裂衣服。他和以色列的长老把灰撒在头上，在耶和华的约柜前俯伏在地，直到晚上。

chapters.en: And Joshua said, “Alas, Sovereign LORD, why did you ever bring this people across the Jordan to deliver us into the hands of the Amorites to destroy us? If only we had been content to stay on the other side of the Jordan!
chapters.zh: 约书亚说，哀哉。主耶和华阿，你为什么竟领这百姓过约旦河，将我们交在亚摩利人的手中，使我们灭亡呢？我们不如住在约旦河那边倒好。

chapters.en: Pardon your servant, Lord. What can I say, now that Israel has been routed by its enemies?
chapters.zh: 主阿，以色列人既在仇敌面前转背逃跑，我还有什么可说的呢？

chapters.en: The Canaanites and the other people of the country will hear about this and they will surround us and wipe out our name from the earth. What then will you do for your own great name?”
chapters.zh: 迦南人和这地一切的居民听见了就必围困我们，将我们的名从地上除灭。那时你为你的大名要怎样行呢？

chapters.en: The LORD said to Joshua, “Stand up! What are you doing down on your face?
chapters.zh: 耶和华吩咐约书亚说，起来。你为何这样俯伏在地呢？

chapters.en: Israel has sinned; they have violated my covenant, which I commanded them to keep. They have taken some of the devoted things; they have stolen, they have lied, they have put them with their own possessions.
chapters.zh: 以色列人犯了罪，违背了我所吩咐他们的约，取了当灭的物。又偷窃，又行诡诈，又把那当灭的放在他们的家具里。

chapters.en: That is why the Israelites cannot stand against their enemies; they turn their backs and run because they have been made liable to destruction. I will not be with you anymore unless you destroy whatever among you is devoted to destruction.
chapters.zh: 因此，以色列人在仇敌面前站立不住。他们在仇敌面前转背逃跑，是因成了被咒诅的。你们若不把当灭的物从你们中间除掉，我就不再与你们同在了。

chapters.en: “Go, consecrate the people. Tell them, ‘Consecrate yourselves in preparation for tomorrow; for this is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: There are devoted things among you, Israel. You cannot stand against your enemies until you remove them.
chapters.zh: 你起来，叫百姓自洁，对他们说，你们要自洁，预备明天，因为耶和华以色列的神这样说，以色列阿，你们中间有当灭的物，你们若不除掉，在仇敌面前必站立不住。

chapters.en: “ ‘In the morning, present yourselves tribe by tribe. The tribe the LORD chooses shall come forward clan by clan; the clan the LORD chooses shall come forward family by family; and the family the LORD chooses shall come forward man by man.
chapters.zh: 到了早晨，你们要按着支派近前来。耶和华所取的支派，要按着宗族近前来。耶和华所取的宗族，要按着家室近前来。耶和华所取的家室，要按着人丁，一个一个地近前来。

chapters.en: Whoever is caught with the devoted things shall be destroyed by fire, along with all that belongs to him. He has violated the covenant of the LORD and has done an outrageous thing in Israel!’ ”
chapters.zh: 被取的人有当灭的物在他那里，他和他所有的必被火焚烧。因他违背了耶和华的约，又因他在以色列中行了愚妄的事。

chapters.en: Early the next morning Joshua had Israel come forward by tribes, and Judah was chosen.
chapters.zh: 于是，约书亚清早起来，使以色列人按着支派近前来，取出来的是犹大支派。

chapters.en: The clans of Judah came forward, and the Zerahites were chosen. He had the clan of the Zerahites come forward by families, and Zimri was chosen.
chapters.zh: 使犹大支派（原文作宗族）近前来，就取了谢拉的宗族。使谢拉的宗族，按着家室人丁，一个一个地近前来，取出来的是撒底。

chapters.en: Joshua had his family come forward man by man, and Achan son of Karmi, the son of Zimri, the son of Zerah, of the tribe of Judah, was chosen.
chapters.zh: 使撒底的家室，按着人丁，一个一个地近前来，就取出犹大支派的人谢拉的曾孙，撒底的孙子，迦米的儿子亚干。

chapters.en: Then Joshua said to Achan, “My son, give glory to the LORD, the God of Israel, and honor him. Tell me what you have done; do not hide it from me.”
chapters.zh: 约书亚对亚干说，我儿，我劝你将荣耀归给耶和华以色列的神，在他面前认罪，将你所作的事告诉我，不要向我隐瞒。

chapters.en: Achan replied, “It is true! I have sinned against the LORD, the God of Israel. This is what I have done:
chapters.zh: 亚干回答约书亚说，我实在得罪了耶和华以色列的神。我所作的事如此如此，

chapters.en: When I saw in the plunder a beautiful robe from Babylonia, two hundred shekels of silver and a bar of gold weighing fifty shekels, I coveted them and took them. They are hidden in the ground inside my tent, with the silver underneath.”
chapters.zh: 我在所夺的财物中看见一件美好的示拿衣服，二百舍客勒银子，一条金子重五十舍客勒，我就贪爱这些物件，便拿去了。现今藏在我帐棚内的地里，银子在衣服底下。

chapters.en: So Joshua sent messengers, and they ran to the tent, and there it was, hidden in his tent, with the silver underneath.
chapters.zh: 约书亚就打发人跑到亚干的帐棚里。那件衣服果然藏在他帐棚内，银子在底下。

chapters.en: They took the things from the tent, brought them to Joshua and all the Israelites and spread them out before the LORD.
chapters.zh: 他们就从帐棚里取出来，拿到约书亚和以色列众人那里，放在耶和华面前。

chapters.en: Then Joshua, together with all Israel, took Achan son of Zerah, the silver, the robe, the gold bar, his sons and daughters, his cattle, donkeys and sheep, his tent and all that he had, to the Valley of Achor.
chapters.zh: 约书亚和以色列众人把谢拉的曾孙亚干和那银子，那件衣服，那条金子，并亚干的儿女，牛，驴，羊，帐棚，以及他所有的，都带到亚割谷去。

chapters.en: Joshua said, “Why have you brought this trouble on us? The LORD will bring trouble on you today.” Then all Israel stoned him, and after they had stoned the rest, they burned them.
chapters.zh: 约书亚说，你为什么连累我们呢？今日耶和华必叫你受连累。于是以色列众人用石头打死他，将石头扔在其上，又用火焚烧他所有的（他所有的原文作他们）。

chapters.en: Over Achan they heaped up a large pile of rocks, which remains to this day. Then the LORD turned from his fierce anger. Therefore that place has been called the Valley of Achor ever since.
chapters.zh: 众人在亚干身上堆成一大堆石头，直存到今日。于是耶和华转意，不发他的烈怒。因此那地方名叫亚割谷，直到今日（亚割就是连累的意思）。

chapters.en: Then the LORD said to Joshua, “Do not be afraid; do not be discouraged. Take the whole army with you, and go up and attack Ai. For I have delivered into your hands the king of Ai, his people, his city and his land.
chapters.zh: 耶和华对约书亚说，不要惧怕，也不要惊惶。你起来，率领一切兵丁上艾城去，我已经把艾城的王和他的民，他的城，并他的地，都交在你手里。

chapters.en: You shall do to Ai and its king as you did to Jericho and its king, except that you may carry off their plunder and livestock for yourselves. Set an ambush behind the city.”
chapters.zh: 你怎样待耶利哥和耶利哥的王，也当照样待艾城和艾城的王。只是城内所夺的财物和牲畜，你们可以取为自己的掠物。你要在城后设下伏兵。

chapters.en: So Joshua and the whole army moved out to attack Ai. He chose thirty thousand of his best fighting men and sent them out at night
chapters.zh: 于是，约书亚和一切兵丁都起来，要上艾城去。约书亚选了三万大能的勇士，夜间打发他们前往，

chapters.en: with these orders: “Listen carefully. You are to set an ambush behind the city. Don’t go very far from it. All of you be on the alert.
chapters.zh: 吩咐他们说，你们要在城后埋伏，不可离城太远，都要各自准备。

chapters.en: I and all those with me will advance on the city, and when the men come out against us, as they did before, we will flee from them.
chapters.zh: 我与我所带领的众民要向城前往。城里的人像初次出来攻击我们的时候，我们就在他们面前逃跑，

chapters.en: They will pursue us until we have lured them away from the city, for they will say, ‘They are running away from us as they did before.’ So when we flee from them,
chapters.zh: 他们必出来追赶我们，直到我们引诱他们离开城。因为他们必说，这些人像初次在我们面前逃跑。所以我们要在他们面前逃跑，

chapters.en: you are to rise up from ambush and take the city. The LORD your God will give it into your hand.
chapters.zh: 你们就从埋伏的地方起来，夺取那城。因为耶和华你们的神，必把城交在你们手里。

chapters.en: When you have taken the city, set it on fire. Do what the LORD has commanded. See to it; you have my orders.”
chapters.zh: 你们夺了城以后，就放火烧城，要照耶和华的话行。这是我吩咐你们的。

chapters.en: Then Joshua sent them off, and they went to the place of ambush and lay in wait between Bethel and Ai, to the west of Ai—but Joshua spent that night with the people.
chapters.zh: 约书亚打发他们前往，他们就上埋伏的地方去，住在伯特利和艾城的中间，就是在艾城的西边。这夜约书亚却在民中住宿。

chapters.en: Early the next morning Joshua mustered his army, and he and the leaders of Israel marched before them to Ai.
chapters.zh: 约书亚清早起来，点齐百姓，他和以色列的长老在百姓前面上艾城去。

chapters.en: The entire force that was with him marched up and approached the city and arrived in front of it. They set up camp north of Ai, with the valley between them and the city.
chapters.zh: 众民，就是他所带领的兵丁，都上去，向前直往，来到城前，在艾城北边安营。在约书亚和艾城中间有一山谷。

chapters.en: Joshua had taken about five thousand men and set them in ambush between Bethel and Ai, to the west of the city.
chapters.zh: 他挑了约有五千人，使他们埋伏在伯特利和艾城的中间，就是在艾城的西边，

chapters.en: So the soldiers took up their positions—with the main camp to the north of the city and the ambush to the west of it. That night Joshua went into the valley.
chapters.zh: 于是安置了百姓，就是城北的全军和城西的伏兵。这夜约书亚进入山谷之中。

chapters.en: When the king of Ai saw this, he and all the men of the city hurried out early in the morning to meet Israel in battle at a certain place overlooking the Arabah. But he did not know that an ambush had been set against him behind the city.
chapters.zh: 艾城的王看见这景况，就和全城的人，清早急忙起来，按所定的时候，出到亚拉巴前，要与以色列人交战。王却不知道在城后有伏兵。

chapters.en: Joshua and all Israel let themselves be driven back before them, and they fled toward the wilderness.
chapters.zh: 约书亚和以色列众人在他们面前装败，往那通旷野的路逃跑。

chapters.en: All the men of Ai were called to pursue them, and they pursued Joshua and were lured away from the city.
chapters.zh: 城内的众民都被招聚，追赶他们。艾城人追赶的时候，就被引诱离开城。

chapters.en: Not a man remained in Ai or Bethel who did not go after Israel. They left the city open and went in pursuit of Israel.
chapters.zh: 艾城和伯特利城没有一人不出来追赶以色列人的，撇了敞开的城门，去追赶以色列人。

chapters.en: Then the LORD said to Joshua, “Hold out toward Ai the javelin that is in your hand, for into your hand I will deliver the city.” So Joshua held out toward the city the javelin that was in his hand.
chapters.zh: 耶和华吩咐约书亚说，你向艾城伸出手里的短枪，因为我要将城交在你手里。约书亚就向城伸出手里的短枪。

chapters.en: As soon as he did this, the men in the ambush rose quickly from their position and rushed forward. They entered the city and captured it and quickly set it on fire.
chapters.zh: 他一伸手，伏兵就从埋伏的地方急忙起来，夺了城，跑进城去，放火焚烧。

chapters.en: The men of Ai looked back and saw the smoke of the city rising up into the sky, but they had no chance to escape in any direction; the Israelites who had been fleeing toward the wilderness had turned back against their pursuers.
chapters.zh: 艾城的人回头一看，不料，城中烟气冲天，他们就无力向左向右逃跑。那往旷野逃跑的百姓便转身攻击追赶他们的人。

chapters.en: For when Joshua and all Israel saw that the ambush had taken the city and that smoke was going up from it, they turned around and attacked the men of Ai.
chapters.zh: 约书亚和以色列众人见伏兵已经夺了城，城中烟气飞腾，就转身回去，击杀艾城的人。

chapters.en: Those in the ambush also came out of the city against them, so that they were caught in the middle, with Israelites on both sides. Israel cut them down, leaving them neither survivors nor fugitives.
chapters.zh: 伏兵也出城迎击艾城人，艾城人就困在以色列人中间，前后都是以色列人。于是以色列人击杀他们，没有留下一个，也没有一个逃脱的，

chapters.en: But they took the king of Ai alive and brought him to Joshua.
chapters.zh: 生擒了艾城的王，将他解到约书亚那里。

chapters.en: When Israel had finished killing all the men of Ai in the fields and in the wilderness where they had chased them, and when every one of them had been put to the sword, all the Israelites returned to Ai and killed those who were in it.
chapters.zh: 以色列人在田间和旷野杀尽所追赶一切艾城的居民。艾城人倒在刀下，直到灭尽。以色列众人就回到艾城，用刀杀了城中的人。

chapters.en: Twelve thousand men and women fell that day—all the people of Ai.
chapters.zh: 当日杀毙的人，连男带女共有一万二千，就是艾城所有的人。

chapters.en: For Joshua did not draw back the hand that held out his javelin until he had destroyed all who lived in Ai.
chapters.zh: 约书亚没有收回手里所伸出来的短枪，直到把艾城的一切居民尽行杀灭。

chapters.en: But Israel did carry off for themselves the livestock and plunder of this city, as the LORD had instructed Joshua.
chapters.zh: 惟独城中的牲畜和财物，以色列人都取为自己的掠物，是照耶和华所吩咐约书亚的话。
