chapters.en: So Joshua burned Ai and made it a permanent heap of ruins, a desolate place to this day.
chapters.zh: 约书亚将艾城焚烧，使城永为高堆，荒场，直到今日。

chapters.en: He impaled the body of the king of Ai on a pole and left it there until evening. At sunset, Joshua ordered them to take the body from the pole and throw it down at the entrance of the city gate. And they raised a large pile of rocks over it, which remains to this day.
chapters.zh: 又将艾城王挂在树上，直到晚上。日落的时候，约书亚吩咐人把尸首从树上取下来，丢在城门口，在尸首上堆成一大堆石头，直存到今日。

chapters.en: Then Joshua built on Mount Ebal an altar to the LORD, the God of Israel,
chapters.zh: 那时，约书亚在以巴路山上为耶和华以色列的神筑一座坛，

chapters.en: as Moses the servant of the LORD had commanded the Israelites. He built it according to what is written in the Book of the Law of Moses—an altar of uncut stones, on which no iron tool had been used. On it they offered to the LORD burnt offerings and sacrificed fellowship offerings.
chapters.zh: 是用没有动过铁器的整石头筑的，照着耶和华仆人摩西所吩咐以色列人的话，正如摩西律法书上所写的。众人在这坛上给耶和华奉献燔祭和平安祭。

chapters.en: There, in the presence of the Israelites, Joshua wrote on stones a copy of the law of Moses.
chapters.zh: 约书亚在那里，当着以色列人面前，将摩西所写的律法抄写在石头上。

chapters.en: All the Israelites, with their elders, officials and judges, were standing on both sides of the ark of the covenant of the LORD, facing the Levitical priests who carried it. Both the foreigners living among them and the native-born were there. Half of the people stood in front of Mount Gerizim and half of them in front of Mount Ebal, as Moses the servant of the LORD had formerly commanded when he gave instructions to bless the people of Israel.
chapters.zh: 以色列众人，无论是本地人，是寄居的，和长老，官长，并审判官，都站在约柜两旁，在抬耶和华约柜的祭司利未人面前，一半对着基利心山，一半对着以巴路山，为以色列民祝福，正如耶和华仆人摩西先前所吩咐的。

chapters.en: Afterward, Joshua read all the words of the law—the blessings and the curses—just as it is written in the Book of the Law.
chapters.zh: 随后，约书亚将律法上祝福，咒诅的话，照着律法书上一切所写的，都宣读了一遍。

chapters.en: There was not a word of all that Moses had commanded that Joshua did not read to the whole assembly of Israel, including the women and children, and the foreigners who lived among them.
chapters.zh: 摩西所吩咐的一切话，约书亚在以色列全会众和妇女，孩子，并他们中间寄居的外人面前，没有一句不宣读的。

chapters.en: Now when all the kings west of the Jordan heard about these things—the kings in the hill country, in the western foothills, and along the entire coast of the Mediterranean Sea as far as Lebanon (the kings of the Hittites, Amorites, Canaanites, Perizzites, Hivites and Jebusites)—
chapters.zh: 约旦河西，住山地，高原，并对着利巴嫩山沿大海一带的诸王，就是赫人，亚摩利人，迦南人，比利洗人，希未人，耶布斯人的诸王，听见这事，

chapters.en: they came together to wage war against Joshua and Israel.
chapters.zh: 就都聚集，同心合意地要与约书亚和以色列人争战。

chapters.en: However, when the people of Gibeon heard what Joshua had done to Jericho and Ai,
chapters.zh: 基遍的居民听见约书亚向耶利哥和艾城所行的事，

chapters.en: they resorted to a ruse: They went as a delegation whose donkeys were loaded with worn-out sacks and old wineskins, cracked and mended.
chapters.zh: 就设诡计，假充使者，拿旧口袋和破裂缝补的旧皮酒袋驮在驴上，

chapters.en: They put worn and patched sandals on their feet and wore old clothes. All the bread of their food supply was dry and moldy.
chapters.zh: 将补过的旧鞋穿在脚上，把旧衣服穿在身上。他们所带的饼都是干的，长了霉了。

chapters.en: Then they went to Joshua in the camp at Gilgal and said to him and the Israelites, “We have come from a distant country; make a treaty with us.”
chapters.zh: 他们到吉甲营中见约书亚，对他和以色列人说，我们是从远方来的，现在求你与我们立约。

chapters.en: The Israelites said to the Hivites, “But perhaps you live near us, so how can we make a treaty with you?”
chapters.zh: 以色列人对这些希未人说，只怕你们是住在我们中间的。若是这样，怎能和你们立约呢？

chapters.en: “We are your servants,” they said to Joshua. But Joshua asked, “Who are you and where do you come from?”
chapters.zh: 他们对约书亚说，我们是你的仆人。约书亚问他们说，你们是什么人。是从哪里来的。

chapters.en: They answered: “Your servants have come from a very distant country because of the fame of the LORD your God. For we have heard reports of him: all that he did in Egypt,
chapters.zh: 他们回答说，仆人从极远之地而来，是因听见耶和华你神的名声和他在埃及所行的一切事，

chapters.en: and all that he did to the two kings of the Amorites east of the Jordan—Sihon king of Heshbon, and Og king of Bashan, who reigned in Ashtaroth.
chapters.zh: 并他向约旦河东的两个亚摩利王，就是希实本王西宏和在亚斯他录的巴珊王噩一切所行的事。

chapters.en: And our elders and all those living in our country said to us, ‘Take provisions for your journey; go and meet them and say to them, “We are your servants; make a treaty with us.” ’
chapters.zh: 我们的长老和我们那地的一切居民对我们说，你们手里要带着路上用的食物去迎接以色列人，对他们说，我们是你们的仆人。现在求你们与我们立约。

chapters.en: This bread of ours was warm when we packed it at home on the day we left to come to you. But now see how dry and moldy it is.
chapters.zh: 我们出来要往你们这里来的日子，从家里带出来的这饼还是热的。看哪，现在都干了，长了霉了。

chapters.en: And these wineskins that we filled were new, but see how cracked they are. And our clothes and sandals are worn out by the very long journey.”
chapters.zh: 这皮酒袋，我们盛酒的时候还是新的。看哪，现在已经破裂。我们这衣服和鞋，因为道路甚远，也都穿旧了。

chapters.en: The Israelites sampled their provisions but did not inquire of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 以色列人受了他们些食物，并没有求问耶和华。

chapters.en: Then Joshua made a treaty of peace with them to let them live, and the leaders of the assembly ratified it by oath.
chapters.zh: 于是约书亚与他们讲和，与他们立约，容他们活着。会众的首领也向他们起誓。

chapters.en: Three days after they made the treaty with the Gibeonites, the Israelites heard that they were neighbors, living near them.
chapters.zh: 以色列人与他们立约之后，过了三天才听见他们是近邻，住在以色列人中间的。

chapters.en: So the Israelites set out and on the third day came to their cities: Gibeon, Kephirah, Beeroth and Kiriath Jearim.
chapters.zh: 以色列人起行，第三天到了他们的城邑，就是基遍，基非拉，比录，基列耶琳。

chapters.en: But the Israelites did not attack them, because the leaders of the assembly had sworn an oath to them by the LORD, the God of Israel. The whole assembly grumbled against the leaders,
chapters.zh: 因为会众的首领已经指着耶和华以色列的神向他们起誓，所以以色列人不击杀他们。全会众就向首领发怨言。

chapters.en: but all the leaders answered, “We have given them our oath by the LORD, the God of Israel, and we cannot touch them now.
chapters.zh: 众首领对全会众说，我们已经指着耶和华以色列的神向他们起誓，现在我们不能害他们。

chapters.en: This is what we will do to them: We will let them live, so that God’s wrath will not fall on us for breaking the oath we swore to them.”
chapters.zh: 我们要如此待他们，容他们活着，免得有忿怒因我们所起的誓临到我们身上。

chapters.en: They continued, “Let them live, but let them be woodcutters and water carriers in the service of the whole assembly.” So the leaders’ promise to them was kept.
chapters.zh: 首领又对会众说，要容他们活着。于是他们为全会众作了劈柴挑水的人，正如首领对他们所说的话。

chapters.en: Then Joshua summoned the Gibeonites and said, “Why did you deceive us by saying, ‘We live a long way from you,’ while actually you live near us?
chapters.zh: 约书亚召了他们来，对他们说，为什么欺哄我们说我们离你们甚远呢？其实你们是住在我们中间。

chapters.en: You are now under a curse: You will never be released from service as woodcutters and water carriers for the house of my God.”
chapters.zh: 现在你们是被咒诅的。你们中间的人必断不了作奴仆，为我神的殿作劈柴挑水的人。

chapters.en: They answered Joshua, “Your servants were clearly told how the LORD your God had commanded his servant Moses to give you the whole land and to wipe out all its inhabitants from before you. So we feared for our lives because of you, and that is why we did this.
chapters.zh: 他们回答约书亚说，因为有人实在告诉你的仆人，耶和华你的神曾吩咐他的仆人摩西，把这全地赐给你们，并在你们面前灭绝这地的一切居民，所以我们为你们的缘故甚怕丧命，就行了这事。

chapters.en: We are now in your hands. Do to us whatever seems good and right to you.”
chapters.zh: 现在我们在你手中，你以怎样待我们为善为正，就怎样做吧。

chapters.en: So Joshua saved them from the Israelites, and they did not kill them.
chapters.zh: 于是约书亚这样待他们，救他们脱离以色列人的手，以色列人就没有杀他们。

chapters.en: That day he made the Gibeonites woodcutters and water carriers for the assembly, to provide for the needs of the altar of the LORD at the place the LORD would choose. And that is what they are to this day.
chapters.zh: 当日约书亚使他们在耶和华所要选择的地方，为会众和耶和华的坛作劈柴挑水的人，直到今日。

chapters.en: Now Adoni-Zedek king of Jerusalem heard that Joshua had taken Ai and totally destroyed it, doing to Ai and its king as he had done to Jericho and its king, and that the people of Gibeon had made a treaty of peace with Israel and had become their allies.
chapters.zh: 耶路撒冷王亚多尼洗德听见约书亚夺了艾城，尽行毁灭，怎样待耶利哥和耶利哥的王，也照样待艾城和艾城的王，又听见基遍的居民与以色列人立了和约，住在他们中间，

chapters.en: He and his people were very much alarmed at this, because Gibeon was an important city, like one of the royal cities; it was larger than Ai, and all its men were good fighters.
chapters.zh: 就甚惧怕。因为基遍是一座大城，如都城一般，比艾城更大，并且城内的人都是勇士。

chapters.en: So Adoni-Zedek king of Jerusalem appealed to Hoham king of Hebron, Piram king of Jarmuth, Japhia king of Lachish and Debir king of Eglon.
chapters.zh: 所以耶路撒冷王亚多尼洗德打发人去见希伯仑王何咸，耶末王毗兰，拉吉王雅非亚，和伊矶伦王底璧，说，

chapters.en: “Come up and help me attack Gibeon,” he said, “because it has made peace with Joshua and the Israelites.”
chapters.zh: 求你们上来帮助我，我们好攻打基遍，因为他们与约书亚和以色列人立了和约。

chapters.en: Then the five kings of the Amorites—the kings of Jerusalem, Hebron, Jarmuth, Lachish and Eglon—joined forces. They moved up with all their troops and took up positions against Gibeon and attacked it.
chapters.zh: 于是五个亚摩利王，就是耶路撒冷王，希伯仑王，耶末王，拉吉王，伊矶伦王，大家聚集，率领他们的众军上去，对着基遍安营，攻打基遍。

chapters.en: The Gibeonites then sent word to Joshua in the camp at Gilgal: “Do not abandon your servants. Come up to us quickly and save us! Help us, because all the Amorite kings from the hill country have joined forces against us.”
chapters.zh: 基遍人就打发人往吉甲的营中去见约书亚，说，你不要袖手不顾你的仆人，求你速速上来拯救我们，帮助我们，因为住山地亚摩利人的诸王都聚集攻击我们。

chapters.en: So Joshua marched up from Gilgal with his entire army, including all the best fighting men.
chapters.zh: 于是约书亚和他一切兵丁，并大能的勇士，都从吉甲上去。

chapters.en: The LORD said to Joshua, “Do not be afraid of them; I have given them into your hand. Not one of them will be able to withstand you.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华对约书亚说，不要怕他们。因为我已将他们交在你手里，他们无一人能在你面前站立得住。

chapters.en: After an all-night march from Gilgal, Joshua took them by surprise.
chapters.zh: 约书亚就终夜从吉甲上去，猛然临到他们那里。

chapters.en: The LORD threw them into confusion before Israel, so Joshua and the Israelites defeated them completely at Gibeon. Israel pursued them along the road going up to Beth Horon and cut them down all the way to Azekah and Makkedah.
chapters.zh: 耶和华使他们在以色列人面前溃乱。约书亚在基遍大大地杀败他们，追赶他们，在伯和仑的上坡路击杀他们，直到亚西加和玛基大。

chapters.en: As they fled before Israel on the road down from Beth Horon to Azekah, the LORD hurled large hailstones down on them, and more of them died from the hail than were killed by the swords of the Israelites.
chapters.zh: 他们在以色列人面前逃跑，正在伯和仑下坡的时候，耶和华从天上降大冰雹在他们身上（冰雹原文作石头），直降到亚西加，打死他们。被冰雹打死的，比以色列人用刀杀死的还多。

chapters.en: On the day the LORD gave the Amorites over to Israel, Joshua said to the LORD in the presence of Israel: “Sun, stand still over Gibeon, and you, moon, over the Valley of Aijalon.”
chapters.zh: 当耶和华将亚摩利人交付以色列人的日子，约书亚就祷告耶和华，在以色列人眼前说，日头阿，你要停在基遍。月亮阿，你要止在亚雅仑谷。

chapters.en: So the sun stood still, and the moon stopped, till the nation avenged itself on its enemies, as it is written in the Book of Jashar. The sun stopped in the middle of the sky and delayed going down about a full day.
chapters.zh: 于是日头停留，月亮止住，直等国民向敌人报仇。这事岂不是写在雅煞珥书上吗？日头在天当中停住，不急速下落，约有一日之久。

chapters.en: There has never been a day like it before or since, a day when the LORD listened to a human being. Surely the LORD was fighting for Israel!
chapters.zh: 在这日以前，这日以后，耶和华听人的祷告，没有像这日的，是因耶和华为以色列争战。

chapters.en: Then Joshua returned with all Israel to the camp at Gilgal.
chapters.zh: 约书亚和以色列众人回到吉甲的营中。

chapters.en: Now the five kings had fled and hidden in the cave at Makkedah.
chapters.zh: 那五王逃跑，藏在玛基大洞里。

chapters.en: When Joshua was told that the five kings had been found hiding in the cave at Makkedah,
chapters.zh: 有人告诉约书亚说，那五王已经找到了，都藏在玛基大洞里。

chapters.en: he said, “Roll large rocks up to the mouth of the cave, and post some men there to guard it.
chapters.zh: 约书亚说，你们把几块大石头滚到洞口，派人看守，

chapters.en: But don’t stop; pursue your enemies! Attack them from the rear and don’t let them reach their cities, for the LORD your God has given them into your hand.”
chapters.zh: 你们却不可耽延，要追赶你们的仇敌，击杀他们尽后边的人，不容他们进自己的城邑，因为耶和华你们的神已经把他们交在你们手里。

chapters.en: So Joshua and the Israelites defeated them completely, but a few survivors managed to reach their fortified cities.
chapters.zh: 约书亚和以色列人大大杀败他们，直到将他们灭尽。其中剩下的人都进了坚固的城。

chapters.en: The whole army then returned safely to Joshua in the camp at Makkedah, and no one uttered a word against the Israelites.
chapters.zh: 众百姓就安然回玛基大营中，到约书亚那里。没有一人敢向以色列人饶舌。

chapters.en: Joshua said, “Open the mouth of the cave and bring those five kings out to me.”
chapters.zh: 约书亚说，打开洞口，将那五王从洞里带出来，领到我面前。

chapters.en: So they brought the five kings out of the cave—the kings of Jerusalem, Hebron, Jarmuth, Lachish and Eglon.
chapters.zh: 众人就这样行，将那五王，就是耶路撒冷王，希伯仑王，耶末王，拉吉王，伊矶伦王，从洞里带出来，领到约书亚面前。

chapters.en: When they had brought these kings to Joshua, he summoned all the men of Israel and said to the army commanders who had come with him, “Come here and put your feet on the necks of these kings.” So they came forward and placed their feet on their necks.
chapters.zh: 带出那五王到约书亚面前的时候，约书亚就召了以色列众人来，对那些和他同去的军长说，你们近前来，把脚踏在这些王的颈项上。他们就近前来，把脚踏在这些王的颈项上。

chapters.en: Joshua said to them, “Do not be afraid; do not be discouraged. Be strong and courageous. This is what the LORD will do to all the enemies you are going to fight.”
chapters.zh: 约书亚对他们说，你们不要惧怕，也不要惊惶。应当刚强壮胆，因为耶和华必这样待你们所要攻打的一切仇敌。

chapters.en: Then Joshua put the kings to death and exposed their bodies on five poles, and they were left hanging on the poles until evening.
chapters.zh: 随后约书亚将这五王杀死，挂在五棵树上。他们就在树上直挂到晚上。

chapters.en: At sunset Joshua gave the order and they took them down from the poles and threw them into the cave where they had been hiding. At the mouth of the cave they placed large rocks, which are there to this day.
chapters.zh: 日头要落的时候，约书亚一吩咐，人就把尸首从树上取下来，丢在他们藏过的洞里，把几块大石头放在洞口，直存到今日。

chapters.en: That day Joshua took Makkedah. He put the city and its king to the sword and totally destroyed everyone in it. He left no survivors. And he did to the king of Makkedah as he had done to the king of Jericho.
chapters.zh: 当日，约书亚夺了玛基大，用刀击杀城中的人和王。将其中一切人口尽行杀灭，没有留下一个。他待玛基大王，像从前待耶利哥王一样。

chapters.en: Then Joshua and all Israel with him moved on from Makkedah to Libnah and attacked it.
chapters.zh: 约书亚和以色列众人从玛基大往立拿去，攻打立拿。

chapters.en: The LORD also gave that city and its king into Israel’s hand. The city and everyone in it Joshua put to the sword. He left no survivors there. And he did to its king as he had done to the king of Jericho.
chapters.zh: 耶和华将立拿和立拿的王也交在以色列人手里。约书亚攻打这城，用刀击杀了城中的一切人口，没有留下一个。他待立拿王，像从前待耶利哥王一样。

chapters.en: Then Joshua and all Israel with him moved on from Libnah to Lachish; he took up positions against it and attacked it.
chapters.zh: 约书亚和以色列众人从立拿往拉吉去，对着拉吉安营，攻打这城。

chapters.en: The LORD gave Lachish into Israel’s hands, and Joshua took it on the second day. The city and everyone in it he put to the sword, just as he had done to Libnah.
chapters.zh: 耶和华将拉吉交在以色列人的手里。第二天约书亚就夺了拉吉，用刀击杀了城中的一切人口，是照他向立拿一切所行的。

chapters.en: Meanwhile, Horam king of Gezer had come up to help Lachish, but Joshua defeated him and his army—until no survivors were left.
chapters.zh: 那时基色王荷兰上来帮助拉吉，约书亚就把他和他的民都击杀了，没有留下一个。

chapters.en: Then Joshua and all Israel with him moved on from Lachish to Eglon; they took up positions against it and attacked it.
chapters.zh: 约书亚和以色列众人从拉吉往伊矶伦去，对着伊矶伦安营，攻打这城。

chapters.en: They captured it that same day and put it to the sword and totally destroyed everyone in it, just as they had done to Lachish.
chapters.zh: 当日就夺了城，用刀击杀了城中的人。那日，约书亚将城中的一切人口尽行杀灭，是照他向拉吉一切所行的。

chapters.en: Then Joshua and all Israel with him went up from Eglon to Hebron and attacked it.
chapters.zh: 约书亚和以色列众人从伊矶伦上希伯仑去，攻打这城，

chapters.en: They took the city and put it to the sword, together with its king, its villages and everyone in it. They left no survivors. Just as at Eglon, they totally destroyed it and everyone in it.
chapters.zh: 就夺了希伯仑和属希伯仑的诸城邑，用刀将城中的人与王，并那些城邑中的人口，都击杀了，没有留下一个，是照他向伊矶伦所行的，把城中的一切人口尽行杀灭。

chapters.en: Then Joshua and all Israel with him turned around and attacked Debir.
chapters.zh: 约书亚和以色列众人回到底璧，攻打这城，

chapters.en: They took the city, its king and its villages, and put them to the sword. Everyone in it they totally destroyed. They left no survivors. They did to Debir and its king as they had done to Libnah and its king and to Hebron.
chapters.zh: 就夺了底璧和属底璧的城邑，又擒获底璧的王，用刀将这些城中的人口尽行杀灭，没有留下一个。他待底璧和底璧王，像从前待希伯仑和立拿与立拿王一样。

chapters.en: So Joshua subdued the whole region, including the hill country, the Negev, the western foothills and the mountain slopes, together with all their kings. He left no survivors. He totally destroyed all who breathed, just as the LORD, the God of Israel, had commanded.
chapters.zh: 这样，约书亚击杀全地的人，就是山地，南地，高原，山坡的人，和那些地的诸王，没有留下一个。将凡有气息的尽行杀灭，正如耶和华以色列的神所吩咐的。

chapters.en: Joshua subdued them from Kadesh Barnea to Gaza and from the whole region of Goshen to Gibeon.
chapters.zh: 约书亚从加低斯巴尼亚攻击到迦萨，又攻击歌珊全地，直到基遍。

chapters.en: All these kings and their lands Joshua conquered in one campaign, because the LORD, the God of Israel, fought for Israel.
chapters.zh: 约书亚一时杀败了这些王，并夺了他们的地，因为耶和华以色列的神为以色列争战。

chapters.en: Then Joshua returned with all Israel to the camp at Gilgal.
chapters.zh: 于是约书亚和以色列众人回到吉甲的营中。

chapters.en: When Jabin king of Hazor heard of this, he sent word to Jobab king of Madon, to the kings of Shimron and Akshaph,
chapters.zh: 夏琐王耶宾听见这事，就打发人去见玛顿王约巴，伸仑王，押煞王，

chapters.en: and to the northern kings who were in the mountains, in the Arabah south of Kinnereth, in the western foothills and in Naphoth Dor on the west;
chapters.zh: 与北方山地，基尼烈南边的亚拉巴高原，并西边多珥山冈的诸王。

chapters.en: to the Canaanites in the east and west; to the Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites and Jebusites in the hill country; and to the Hivites below Hermon in the region of Mizpah.
chapters.zh: 又去见东方和西方的迦南人，与山地的亚摩利人，赫人，比利洗人，耶布斯人，并黑门山根米斯巴地的希未人。

chapters.en: They came out with all their troops and a large number of horses and chariots—a huge army, as numerous as the sand on the seashore.
chapters.zh: 这些王和他们的众军都出来，人数多如海边的沙，并有许多马匹车辆。

chapters.en: All these kings joined forces and made camp together at the Waters of Merom to fight against Israel.
chapters.zh: 这诸王会合，来到米伦水边，一同安营，要与以色列人争战。

chapters.en: The LORD said to Joshua, “Do not be afraid of them, because by this time tomorrow I will hand all of them, slain, over to Israel. You are to hamstring their horses and burn their chariots.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华对约书亚说，你不要因他们惧怕。明日这时，我必将他们交付以色列人全然杀了。你要砍断他们马的蹄筋，用火焚烧他们的车辆。

chapters.en: So Joshua and his whole army came against them suddenly at the Waters of Merom and attacked them,
chapters.zh: 于是约书亚率领一切兵丁，在米伦水边突然向前攻打他们。

chapters.en: and the LORD gave them into the hand of Israel. They defeated them and pursued them all the way to Greater Sidon, to Misrephoth Maim, and to the Valley of Mizpah on the east, until no survivors were left.
chapters.zh: 耶和华将他们交在以色列人手里，以色列人就击杀他们，追赶他们到西顿大城，到米斯利弗玛音，直到东边米斯巴的平原，将他们击杀，没有留下一个。

chapters.en: Joshua did to them as the LORD had directed: He hamstrung their horses and burned their chariots.
chapters.zh: 约书亚就照耶和华所吩咐他的去行，砍断他们马的蹄筋，用火焚烧他们的车辆。

chapters.en: At that time Joshua turned back and captured Hazor and put its king to the sword. (Hazor had been the head of all these kingdoms.)
chapters.zh: 当时，约书亚转回夺了夏琐，用刀击杀夏琐王。素来夏琐在这诸国中是为首的。

chapters.en: Everyone in it they put to the sword. They totally destroyed them, not sparing anyone that breathed, and he burned Hazor itself.
chapters.zh: 以色列人用刀击杀城中的人口，将他们尽行杀灭。凡有气息的没有留下一个。约书亚又用火焚烧夏琐。

chapters.en: Joshua took all these royal cities and their kings and put them to the sword. He totally destroyed them, as Moses the servant of the LORD had commanded.
chapters.zh: 约书亚夺了这些王的一切城邑，擒获其中的诸王，用刀击杀他们，将他们尽行杀灭，正如耶和华仆人摩西所吩咐的。

chapters.en: Yet Israel did not burn any of the cities built on their mounds—except Hazor, which Joshua burned.
chapters.zh: 至于造在山冈上的城，除了夏琐以外，以色列人都没有焚烧。约书亚只将夏琐焚烧了。

chapters.en: The Israelites carried off for themselves all the plunder and livestock of these cities, but all the people they put to the sword until they completely destroyed them, not sparing anyone that breathed.
chapters.zh: 那些城邑所有的财物和牲畜，以色列人都取为自己的掠物。惟有一切人口都用刀击杀，直到杀尽。凡有气息的没有留下一个。

chapters.en: As the LORD commanded his servant Moses, so Moses commanded Joshua, and Joshua did it; he left nothing undone of all that the LORD commanded Moses.
chapters.zh: 耶和华怎样吩咐他仆人摩西，摩西就照样吩咐约书亚，约书亚也照样行。凡耶和华所吩咐摩西的，约书亚没有一件懈怠不行的。

chapters.en: So Joshua took this entire land: the hill country, all the Negev, the whole region of Goshen, the western foothills, the Arabah and the mountains of Israel with their foothills,
chapters.zh: 约书亚夺了那全地，就是山地，一带南地，歌珊全地，高原，亚拉巴，以色列的山地，和山下的高原。

chapters.en: from Mount Halak, which rises toward Seir, to Baal Gad in the Valley of Lebanon below Mount Hermon. He captured all their kings and put them to death.
chapters.zh: 从上西珥的哈拉山，直到黑门山下利巴嫩平原的巴力迦得，并且擒获那些地的诸王，将他们杀死。

chapters.en: Joshua waged war against all these kings for a long time.
chapters.zh: 约书亚和这诸王争战了许多年日。

chapters.en: Except for the Hivites living in Gibeon, not one city made a treaty of peace with the Israelites, who took them all in battle.
chapters.zh: 除了基遍的希未人之外，没有一城与以色列人讲和的，都是以色列人争战夺来的。

chapters.en: For it was the LORD himself who hardened their hearts to wage war against Israel, so that he might destroy them totally, exterminating them without mercy, as the LORD had commanded Moses.
chapters.zh: 因为耶和华的意思是要使他们心里刚硬，来与以色列人争战，好叫他们尽被杀灭，不蒙怜悯，正如耶和华所吩咐摩西的。

chapters.en: At that time Joshua went and destroyed the Anakites from the hill country: from Hebron, Debir and Anab, from all the hill country of Judah, and from all the hill country of Israel. Joshua totally destroyed them and their towns.
chapters.zh: 当时约书亚来到，将住山地，希伯仑，底璧，亚拿伯，犹大山地，以色列山地所有的亚衲族人剪除了。约书亚将他们和他们的城邑尽都毁灭。

chapters.en: No Anakites were left in Israelite territory; only in Gaza, Gath and Ashdod did any survive.
chapters.zh: 在以色列人的地没有留下一个亚衲族人，只在迦萨，迦特，和亚实突有留下的。

chapters.en: So Joshua took the entire land, just as the LORD had directed Moses, and he gave it as an inheritance to Israel according to their tribal divisions. Then the land had rest from war.
chapters.zh: 这样，约书亚照着耶和华所吩咐摩西的一切话夺了那全地，就按着以色列支派的宗族将地分给他们为业。于是国中太平，没有争战了。

chapters.en: These are the kings of the land whom the Israelites had defeated and whose territory they took over east of the Jordan, from the Arnon Gorge to Mount Hermon, including all the eastern side of the Arabah:
chapters.zh: 以色列人在约旦河外向日出之地击杀二王，得他们的地，就是从亚嫩谷直到黑门山，并东边的全亚拉巴之地。

chapters.en: Sihon king of the Amorites, who reigned in Heshbon. He ruled from Aroer on the rim of the Arnon Gorge—from the middle of the gorge—to the Jabbok River, which is the border of the Ammonites. This included half of Gilead.
chapters.zh: 这二王，有住希实本，亚摩利人的王西宏。他所管之地是从亚嫩谷边的亚罗珥和谷中的城，并基列一半，直到亚扪人的境界，雅博河

chapters.en: He also ruled over the eastern Arabah from the Sea of Galilee to the Sea of the Arabah (that is, the Dead Sea), to Beth Jeshimoth, and then southward below the slopes of Pisgah.
chapters.zh: 与约旦河东边的亚拉巴，直到基尼烈海，又到亚拉巴的海，就是盐海，通伯耶西末的路，以及南方，直到毗斯迦的山根。

chapters.en: And the territory of Og king of Bashan, one of the last of the Rephaites, who reigned in Ashtaroth and Edrei.
chapters.zh: 又有巴珊王噩。他是利乏音人所剩下的，住在亚斯他录和以得来。

chapters.en: He ruled over Mount Hermon, Salekah, all of Bashan to the border of the people of Geshur and Maakah, and half of Gilead to the border of Sihon king of Heshbon.
chapters.zh: 他所管之地是黑门山，撒迦，巴珊全地，直到基述人和玛迦人的境界，并基列一半，直到希实本王西宏的境界。

chapters.en: Moses, the servant of the LORD, and the Israelites conquered them. And Moses the servant of the LORD gave their land to the Reubenites, the Gadites and the half-tribe of Manasseh to be their possession.
chapters.zh: 这二王是耶和华仆人摩西和以色列人所击杀的。耶和华仆人摩西将他们的地赐给流便人，迦得人，和玛拿西半支派的人为业。

chapters.en: Here is a list of the kings of the land that Joshua and the Israelites conquered on the west side of the Jordan, from Baal Gad in the Valley of Lebanon to Mount Halak, which rises toward Seir. Joshua gave their lands as an inheritance to the tribes of Israel according to their tribal divisions.
chapters.zh: 约书亚和以色列人在约旦河西击杀了诸王。他们的地是从利巴嫩平原的巴力迦得，直到上西珥的哈拉山。约书亚就将那地按着以色列支派的宗族分给他们为业，

chapters.en: The lands included the hill country, the western foothills, the Arabah, the mountain slopes, the wilderness and the Negev. These were the lands of the Hittites, Amorites, Canaanites, Perizzites, Hivites and Jebusites. These were the kings:
chapters.zh: 就是赫人，亚摩利人，迦南人，比利洗人，希未人，耶布斯人的山地，高原亚拉巴，山坡，旷野，和南地。

chapters.en: the king of Jericho: one; the king of Ai(near Bethel): one;
chapters.zh: 他们的王，一个是耶利哥王，一个是靠近伯特利的艾城王，

chapters.en: the king of Jerusalem: one; the king of Hebron: one;
chapters.zh: 一个是耶路撒冷王，一个是希伯仑王，

chapters.en: the king of Jarmuth: one; the king of Lachish: one;
chapters.zh: 一个是耶末王，一个是拉吉王，

chapters.en: the king of Eglon, one; the king of Gezer, one;
chapters.zh: 一个是伊矶伦王，一个是基色王，

chapters.en: the king of Debir, one; the king of Geder, one;
chapters.zh: 一个是底璧王，一个是基德王，

chapters.en: the king of Hormah, one; the king of Arad, one;
chapters.zh: 一个是何珥玛王，一个是亚拉得王，

chapters.en: the king of Libnah, one; the king of Adullam, one;
chapters.zh: 一个是立拿王，一个是亚杜兰王，

chapters.en: the king of Makkedah, one; the king of Bethel, one;
chapters.zh: 一个是玛基大王，一个是伯特利王，

chapters.en: the king of Tappuah, one; the king of Hepher, one;
chapters.zh: 一个是他普亚王，一个是希弗王，

chapters.en: the king of Aphek, one; the king of Lasharon, one;
chapters.zh: 一个是亚弗王，一个是拉沙仑王，

chapters.en: the king of Madon, one; the king of Hazor, one;
chapters.zh: 一个是玛顿王，一个是夏琐王，

chapters.en: the king of Shimron Meron, one; the king of Akshaph, one;
chapters.zh: 一个是伸仑米仑王，一个是押煞王，

chapters.en: the king of Taanach, one; the king of Megiddo, one;
chapters.zh: 一个是他纳王，一个是米吉多王，

chapters.en: the king of Kedesh, one; the king of Jokneam in Carmel, one;
chapters.zh: 一个是基低斯王，一个是靠近迦密的约念王，

chapters.en: the king of Dor (in Naphoth Dor), one; the king of Goyim in Gilgal, one;
chapters.zh: 一个是多珥山冈的多珥王，一个是吉甲的戈印王，

chapters.en: the king of Tirzah, one; thirty-one kings in all.
chapters.zh: 一个是得撒王。共计三十一个王。

chapters.en: When Joshua had grown old, the LORD said to him, “You are now very old, and there are still very large areas of land to be taken over.
chapters.zh: 约书亚年纪老迈，耶和华对他说，你年纪老迈了，还有许多未得之地，

chapters.en: “This is the land that remains: all the regions of the Philistines and Geshurites,
chapters.zh: 就是非利士人的全境和基述人的全地。

chapters.en: from the Shihor River on the east of Egypt to the territory of Ekron on the north, all of it counted as Canaanite though held by the five Philistine rulers in Gaza, Ashdod, Ashkelon, Gath and Ekron; the territory of the Avvites
chapters.zh: 从埃及前的西曷河往北，直到以革伦的境界，就算属迦南人之地。有非利士人五个首领所管的迦萨人，亚实突人，亚实基伦人，迦特人，以革伦人之地，并有南方亚卫人之地。

chapters.en: on the south; all the land of the Canaanites, from Arah of the Sidonians as far as Aphek and the border of the Amorites;
chapters.zh: 又有迦南人的全地，并属西顿人的米亚拉到亚弗，直到亚摩利人的境界。

chapters.en: the area of Byblos; and all Lebanon to the east, from Baal Gad below Mount Hermon to Lebo Hamath.
chapters.zh: 还有迦巴勒人之地，并向日出的全利巴嫩，就是从黑门山根的巴力迦得，直到哈马口。

chapters.en: “As for all the inhabitants of the mountain regions from Lebanon to Misrephoth Maim, that is, all the Sidonians, I myself will drive them out before the Israelites. Be sure to allocate this land to Israel for an inheritance, as I have instructed you,
chapters.zh: 山地的一切居民，从利巴嫩直到米斯利弗玛音，就是所有的西顿人，我必在以色列人面前赶出他们去。你只管照我所吩咐的，将这地拈阄分给以色列人为业。

chapters.en: and divide it as an inheritance among the nine tribes and half of the tribe of Manasseh.”
chapters.zh: 现在你要把这地分给九个支派和玛拿西半个支派为业。

chapters.en: The other half of Manasseh, the Reubenites and the Gadites had received the inheritance that Moses had given them east of the Jordan, as he, the servant of the LORD, had assigned it to them.
chapters.zh: 玛拿西那半支派和流便，迦得二支派已经受了产业，就是耶和华的仆人摩西在约旦河东所赐给他们的，

chapters.en: It extended from Aroer on the rim of the Arnon Gorge, and from the town in the middle of the gorge, and included the whole plateau of Medeba as far as Dibon,
chapters.zh: 是从亚嫩谷边的亚罗珥和谷中的城，并米底巴的全平原，直到底本，

chapters.en: and all the towns of Sihon king of the Amorites, who ruled in Heshbon, out to the border of the Ammonites.
chapters.zh: 和在希实本作王亚摩利王西宏的诸城，直到亚扪人的境界。

chapters.en: It also included Gilead, the territory of the people of Geshur and Maakah, all of Mount Hermon and all Bashan as far as Salekah—
chapters.zh: 又有基列地，基述人，玛迦人的地界，并黑门全山，巴珊全地，直到撒迦。

chapters.en: that is, the whole kingdom of Og in Bashan, who had reigned in Ashtaroth and Edrei. (He was the last of the Rephaites.) Moses had defeated them and taken over their land.
chapters.zh: 又有巴珊王噩的全国。他在亚斯他录和以得来作王（利乏音人所存留的只剩下他）。这些地的人都是摩西所击杀，所赶逐的。

chapters.en: But the Israelites did not drive out the people of Geshur and Maakah, so they continue to live among the Israelites to this day.
chapters.zh: 以色列人却没有赶逐基述人，玛迦人。这些人仍住在以色列中，直到今日。

chapters.en: But to the tribe of Levi he gave no inheritance, since the food offerings presented to the LORD, the God of Israel, are their inheritance, as he promised them.
chapters.zh: 只是利未支派，摩西（原文作他）没有把产业分给他们。他们的产业乃是献与耶和华以色列神的火祭，正如耶和华所应许他们的。

chapters.en: This is what Moses had given to the tribe of Reuben, according to its clans:
chapters.zh: 摩西按着流便支派的宗族分给他们产业。

chapters.en: The territory from Aroer on the rim of the Arnon Gorge, and from the town in the middle of the gorge, and the whole plateau past Medeba
chapters.zh: 他们的境界是亚嫩谷边的亚罗珥和谷中的城，靠近米底巴的全平原。

chapters.en: to Heshbon and all its towns on the plateau, including Dibon, Bamoth Baal, Beth Baal Meon,
chapters.zh: 希实本并属希实本平原的各城，底本，巴末巴力，伯巴力勉，

chapters.en: Jahaz, Kedemoth, Mephaath,
chapters.zh: 雅杂，基底莫，米法押，

chapters.en: Kiriathaim, Sibmah, Zereth Shahar on the hill in the valley,
chapters.zh: 基列亭，西比玛，谷中山的细列哈沙辖，

chapters.en: Beth Peor, the slopes of Pisgah, and Beth Jeshimoth—
chapters.zh: 伯毗珥，毗斯迦山坡，伯耶西末。

chapters.en: all the towns on the plateau and the entire realm of Sihon king of the Amorites, who ruled at Heshbon. Moses had defeated him and the Midianite chiefs, Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur and Reba—princes allied with Sihon—who lived in that country.
chapters.zh: 平原的各城，并亚摩利王西宏的全国。这西宏曾在希实本作王，摩西把他和米甸的族长以未，利金，苏珥，户珥，利巴击杀了。这都是住那地属西宏为首领的。

chapters.en: In addition to those slain in battle, the Israelites had put to the sword Balaam son of Beor, who practiced divination.
chapters.zh: 那时以色列人在所杀的人中，也用刀杀了比珥的儿子术士巴兰。

chapters.en: The boundary of the Reubenites was the bank of the Jordan. These towns and their villages were the inheritance of the Reubenites, according to their clans.
chapters.zh: 流便人的境界就是约旦河与靠近约旦河的地。以上是流便人按着宗族所得为业的诸城，并属城的村庄。

chapters.en: This is what Moses had given to the tribe of Gad, according to its clans:
chapters.zh: 摩西按着迦得支派的宗族分给他们产业。

chapters.en: The territory of Jazer, all the towns of Gilead and half the Ammonite country as far as Aroer, near Rabbah;
chapters.zh: 他们的境界是雅谢和基列的各城，并亚扪人的一半地，直到拉巴前的亚罗珥。

chapters.en: and from Heshbon to Ramath Mizpah and Betonim, and from Mahanaim to the territory of Debir;
chapters.zh: 从希实本到拉抹米斯巴和比多宁，又从玛哈念到底璧的境界，

chapters.en: and in the valley, Beth Haram, Beth Nimrah, Sukkoth and Zaphon with the rest of the realm of Sihon king of Heshbon (the east side of the Jordan, the territory up to the end of the Sea of Galilee ).
chapters.zh: 并谷中的伯亚兰，伯宁拉，疏割，撒分，就是希实本王西宏国中的余地，以及约旦河与靠近约旦河的地，直到基尼烈海的极边，都在约旦河东。

chapters.en: These towns and their villages were the inheritance of the Gadites, according to their clans.
chapters.zh: 以上是迦得人按着宗族所得为业的诸城，并属城的村庄。

chapters.en: This is what Moses had given to the half-tribe of Manasseh, that is, to half the family of the descendants of Manasseh, according to its clans:
chapters.zh: 摩西把产业分给玛拿西半支派，是按着玛拿西半支派的宗族所分的。

chapters.en: The territory extending from Mahanaim and including all of Bashan, the entire realm of Og king of Bashan—all the settlements of Jair in Bashan, sixty towns,
chapters.zh: 他们的境界是从玛哈念起，包括巴珊全地，就是巴珊王噩的全国，并在巴珊，睚珥的一切城邑，共六十个。

chapters.en: half of Gilead, and Ashtaroth and Edrei (the royal cities of Og in Bashan). This was for the descendants of Makir son of Manasseh—for half of the sons of Makir, according to their clans.
chapters.zh: 基列的一半，并亚斯他录，以得来，就是属巴珊王噩国的二城，是按着宗族给玛拿西的儿子玛吉的一半子孙。

chapters.en: This is the inheritance Moses had given when he was in the plains of Moab across the Jordan east of Jericho.
chapters.zh: 以上是摩西在约旦河东对着耶利哥的摩押平原所分给他们的产业。

chapters.en: But to the tribe of Levi, Moses had given no inheritance; the LORD, the God of Israel, is their inheritance, as he promised them.
chapters.zh: 只是利未支派，摩西没有把产业分给他们。耶和华以色列的神是他们的产业，正如耶和华所应许他们的。

chapters.en: Now these are the areas the Israelites received as an inheritance in the land of Canaan, which Eleazar the priest, Joshua son of Nun and the heads of the tribal clans of Israel allotted to them.
chapters.zh: 以色列人在迦南地所得的产业，就是祭司以利亚撒和嫩的儿子约书亚，并以色列各支派的族长所分给他们的，都记在下面，

chapters.en: Their inheritances were assigned by lot to the nine-and-a-half tribes, as the LORD had commanded through Moses.
chapters.zh: 是照耶和华借摩西所吩咐的，把产业拈阄分给九个半支派。

chapters.en: Moses had granted the two-and-a-half tribes their inheritance east of the Jordan but had not granted the Levites an inheritance among the rest,
chapters.zh: 原来，摩西在约旦河东已经把产业分给那两个半支派，只是在他们中间没有把产业分给利未人。

chapters.en: for Joseph’s descendants had become two tribes—Manasseh and Ephraim. The Levites received no share of the land but only towns to live in, with pasturelands for their flocks and herds.
chapters.zh: 因为约瑟的子孙是两个支派，就是玛拿西和以法莲，所以没有把地分给利未人，但给他们城邑居住，并城邑的郊野，可以牧养他们的牲畜，安置他们的财物。

chapters.en: So the Israelites divided the land, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
chapters.zh: 耶和华怎样吩咐摩西，以色列人就照样行，把地分了。

chapters.en: Now the people of Judah approached Joshua at Gilgal, and Caleb son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite said to him, “You know what the LORD said to Moses the man of God at Kadesh Barnea about you and me.
chapters.zh: 那时，犹大人来到吉甲见约书亚，有基尼洗族耶孚尼的儿子迦勒对约书亚说，耶和华在加低斯巴尼亚指着我与你对神人摩西所说的话，你都知道了。

chapters.en: I was forty years old when Moses the servant of the LORD sent me from Kadesh Barnea to explore the land. And I brought him back a report according to my convictions,
chapters.zh: 耶和华的仆人摩西从加低斯巴尼亚打发我窥探这地，那时我正四十岁。我按着心意回报他。

chapters.en: but my fellow Israelites who went up with me made the hearts of the people melt in fear. I, however, followed the LORD my God wholeheartedly.
chapters.zh: 然而，同我上去的众弟兄使百姓的心消化。但我专心跟从耶和华我的神。

chapters.en: So on that day Moses swore to me, ‘The land on which your feet have walked will be your inheritance and that of your children forever, because you have followed the LORD my God wholeheartedly.’
chapters.zh: 当日摩西起誓说，你脚所踏之地定要归你和你的子孙永远为业，因为你专心跟从耶和华我的神。

chapters.en: “Now then, just as the LORD promised, he has kept me alive for forty-five years since the time he said this to Moses, while Israel moved about in the wilderness. So here I am today, eighty-five years old!
chapters.zh: 自从耶和华对摩西说这话的时候，耶和华照他所应许的使我存活这四十五年。其间以色列人在旷野行走。看哪，现今我八十五岁了，

chapters.en: I am still as strong today as the day Moses sent me out; I’m just as vigorous to go out to battle now as I was then.
chapters.zh: 我还是强壮，像摩西打发我去的那天一样。无论是争战，是出入，我的力量那时如何，现在还是如何。

chapters.en: Now give me this hill country that the LORD promised me that day. You yourself heard then that the Anakites were there and their cities were large and fortified, but, the LORD helping me, I will drive them out just as he said.”
chapters.zh: 求你将耶和华那日应许我的这山地给我。那里有亚衲族人，并宽大坚固的城，你也曾听见了。或者耶和华照他所应许的与我同在，我就把他们赶出去。

chapters.en: Then Joshua blessed Caleb son of Jephunneh and gave him Hebron as his inheritance.
chapters.zh: 于是约书亚为耶孚尼的儿子迦勒祝福，将希伯仑给他为业。

chapters.en: So Hebron has belonged to Caleb son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite ever since, because he followed the LORD, the God of Israel, wholeheartedly.
chapters.zh: 所以希伯仑作了基尼洗族耶孚尼的儿子迦勒的产业，直到今日，因为他专心跟从耶和华以色列的神。

chapters.en: (Hebron used to be called Kiriath Arba after Arba, who was the greatest man among the Anakites.) Then the land had rest from war.
chapters.zh: 希伯仑从前名叫基列亚巴。亚巴是亚衲族中最尊大的人。于是国中太平，没有争战了。

chapters.en: The allotment for the tribe of Judah, according to its clans, extended down to the territory of Edom, to the Desert of Zin in the extreme south.
chapters.zh: 犹大支派按着宗族拈阄所得之地是在尽南边，到以东的交界，向南直到寻的旷野。

chapters.en: Their southern boundary started from the bay at the southern end of the Dead Sea,
chapters.zh: 他们的南界是从盐海的尽边，就是从朝南的海汊起，

chapters.en: crossed south of Scorpion Pass, continued on to Zin and went over to the south of Kadesh Barnea. Then it ran past Hezron up to Addar and curved around to Karka.
chapters.zh: 通到亚克拉滨坡的南边，接连到寻，上到加低斯巴尼亚的南边，又过希斯仑，上到亚达珥，绕到甲加，

chapters.en: It then passed along to Azmon and joined the Wadi of Egypt, ending at the Mediterranean Sea. This is their southern boundary.
chapters.zh: 接连到押们，通到埃及小河，直通到海为止。这就是他们的南界。

chapters.en: The eastern boundary is the Dead Sea as far as the mouth of the Jordan. The northern boundary started from the bay of the sea at the mouth of the Jordan,
chapters.zh: 东界是从盐海南边到约旦河口。北界是从约旦河口的海汊起，

chapters.en: went up to Beth Hoglah and continued north of Beth Arabah to the Stone of Bohan son of Reuben.
chapters.zh: 上到伯曷拉，过伯亚拉巴的北边，上到流便之子波罕的磐石。

chapters.en: The boundary then went up to Debir from the Valley of Achor and turned north to Gilgal, which faces the Pass of Adummim south of the gorge. It continued along to the waters of En Shemesh and came out at En Rogel.
chapters.zh: 从亚割谷往北，上到底璧，直向河南亚都冥坡对面的吉甲。又接连到隐示麦泉，直通到隐罗结，

chapters.en: Then it ran up the Valley of Ben Hinnom along the southern slope of the Jebusite city (that is, Jerusalem). From there it climbed to the top of the hill west of the Hinnom Valley at the northern end of the Valley of Rephaim.
chapters.zh: 上到欣嫩子谷，贴近耶布斯的南界（耶布斯就是耶路撒冷）。又上到欣嫩谷西边的山顶，就是在利乏音谷极北的边界。

chapters.en: From the hilltop the boundary headed toward the spring of the waters of Nephtoah, came out at the towns of Mount Ephron and went down toward Baalah (that is, Kiriath Jearim).
chapters.zh: 又从山顶延到尼弗多亚的水源，通到以弗仑山的城邑，又延到巴拉（巴拉就是基列耶琳）。

chapters.en: Then it curved westward from Baalah to Mount Seir, ran along the northern slope of Mount Jearim (that is, Kesalon), continued down to Beth Shemesh and crossed to Timnah.
chapters.zh: 又从巴拉往西绕到西珥山，接连到耶琳山的北边（耶琳就是基撒仑）。又下到伯示麦过亭纳，

chapters.en: It went to the northern slope of Ekron, turned toward Shikkeron, passed along to Mount Baalah and reached Jabneel. The boundary ended at the sea.
chapters.zh: 通到以革伦北边，延到施基仑，接连到巴拉山。又通到雅比聂，直通到海为止。

chapters.en: The western boundary is the coastline of the Mediterranean Sea. These are the boundaries around the people of Judah by their clans.
chapters.zh: 西界就是大海和靠近大海之地。这是犹大人按着宗族所得之地四围的交界。

chapters.en: In accordance with the LORD’s command to him, Joshua gave to Caleb son of Jephunneh a portion in Judah—Kiriath Arba, that is, Hebron. (Arba was the forefather of Anak.)
chapters.zh: 约书亚照耶和华所吩咐的，将犹大人中的一段地，就是基列亚巴，分给耶孚尼的儿子迦勒。亚巴是亚衲族的始祖（基列亚巴就是希伯仑）。

chapters.en: From Hebron Caleb drove out the three Anakites—Sheshai, Ahiman and Talmai, the sons of Anak.
chapters.zh: 迦勒就从那里赶出亚衲族的三个族长，就是示筛，亚希幔，挞买。

chapters.en: From there he marched against the people living in Debir (formerly called Kiriath Sepher).
chapters.zh: 又从那里上去，攻击底璧的居民，这底璧从前名叫基列西弗。

chapters.en: And Caleb said, “I will give my daughter Aksah in marriage to the man who attacks and captures Kiriath Sepher.”
chapters.zh: 迦勒说，谁能攻打基列西弗将城夺取，我就把我女儿押撒给他为妻。

chapters.en: Othniel son of Kenaz, Caleb’s brother, took it; so Caleb gave his daughter Aksah to him in marriage.
chapters.zh: 迦勒兄弟基纳斯的儿子俄陀聂夺取了那城，迦勒就把女儿押撒给他为妻。

chapters.en: One day when she came to Othniel, she urged him to ask her father for a field. When she got off her donkey, Caleb asked her, “What can I do for you?”
chapters.zh: 押撒过门的时候，劝丈夫向她父亲求一块田，押撒一下驴，迦勒问她说，你要什么。

chapters.en: She replied, “Do me a special favor. Since you have given me land in the Negev, give me also springs of water.” So Caleb gave her the upper and lower springs.
chapters.zh: 她说，求你赐福给我，你既将我安置在南地，求你也给我水泉。她父亲就把上泉下泉赐给她。

chapters.en: This is the inheritance of the tribe of Judah, according to its clans:
chapters.zh: 以下是犹大支派按着宗族所得的产业。

chapters.en: The southernmost towns of the tribe of Judah in the Negev toward the boundary of Edom were: Kabzeel, Eder, Jagur,
chapters.zh: 犹大支派尽南边的城邑，与以东交界相近的，就是甲薛，以得，雅姑珥，

chapters.en: Kinah, Dimonah, Adadah,
chapters.zh: 基拿，底摩拿，亚大达，

chapters.en: Kedesh, Hazor, Ithnan,
chapters.zh: 基低斯，夏琐，以提楠，

chapters.en: Ziph, Telem, Bealoth,
chapters.zh: 西弗，提链，比亚绿，

chapters.en: Hazor Hadattah, Kerioth Hezron (that is, Hazor),
chapters.zh: 夏琐哈大他，加略希斯仑（加略希斯仑就是夏琐），

chapters.en: Amam, Shema, Moladah,
chapters.zh: 亚曼，示玛，摩拉大，

chapters.en: Hazar Gaddah, Heshmon, Beth Pelet,
chapters.zh: 哈萨迦大，黑实门，伯帕列，

chapters.en: Hazar Shual, Beersheba, Biziothiah,
chapters.zh: 哈萨书亚，别是巴，比斯约他，

chapters.en: Baalah, Iyim, Ezem,
chapters.zh: 巴拉，以因，以森，

chapters.en: Eltolad, Kesil, Hormah,
chapters.zh: 伊勒多腊，基失，何珥玛，

chapters.en: Ziklag, Madmannah, Sansannah,
chapters.zh: 洗革拉，麦玛拿，三撒拿，

chapters.en: Lebaoth, Shilhim, Ain and Rimmon—a total of twenty-nine towns and their villages.
chapters.zh: 利巴勿，实忻，亚因，临门，共二十九座城，还有属城的村庄。

chapters.en: In the western foothills: Eshtaol, Zorah, Ashnah,
chapters.zh: 在高原有以实陶，琐拉，亚实拿，

chapters.en: Zanoah, En Gannim, Tappuah, Enam,
chapters.zh: 撒挪亚，隐干宁，他普亚，以楠，

chapters.en: Jarmuth, Adullam, Sokoh, Azekah,
chapters.zh: 耶末，亚杜兰，梭哥，亚西加，

chapters.en: Shaaraim, Adithaim and Gederah (or Gederothaim) —fourteen towns and their villages.
chapters.zh: 沙拉音，亚底他音，基底拉，基底罗他音，共十四座城，还有属城的村庄。

chapters.en: Zenan, Hadashah, Migdal Gad,
chapters.zh: 又有洗楠，哈大沙，麦大迦得，

chapters.en: Dilean, Mizpah, Joktheel,
chapters.zh: 底连，米斯巴，约帖，

chapters.en: Lachish, Bozkath, Eglon,
chapters.zh: 拉吉，波斯加，伊矶伦，

chapters.en: Kabbon, Lahmas, Kitlish,
chapters.zh: 迦本，拉幔，基提利，

chapters.en: Gederoth, Beth Dagon, Naamah and Makkedah—sixteen towns and their villages.
chapters.zh: 基低罗，伯大衮，拿玛，玛基大，共十六座城，还有属城的村庄。

chapters.en: Libnah, Ether, Ashan,
chapters.zh: 又有立拿，以帖，亚珊，

chapters.en: Iphtah, Ashnah, Nezib,
chapters.zh: 益弗他，亚实拿，尼悉，

chapters.en: Keilah, Akzib and Mareshah—nine towns and their villages.
chapters.zh: 基伊拉，亚革悉，玛利沙，共九座城，还有属城的村庄。

chapters.en: Ekron, with its surrounding settlements and villages;
chapters.zh: 又有以革伦和属以革伦的镇市村庄。

chapters.en: west of Ekron, all that were in the vicinity of Ashdod, together with their villages;
chapters.zh: 从以革伦直到海，一切靠近亚实突之地，并属其地的村庄。

chapters.en: Ashdod, its surrounding settlements and villages; and Gaza, its settlements and villages, as far as the Wadi of Egypt and the coastline of the Mediterranean Sea.
chapters.zh: 亚实突和属亚实突的镇市村庄。迦萨和属迦萨的镇市村庄。直到埃及小河，并大海和靠近大海之地。

chapters.en: In the hill country: Shamir, Jattir, Sokoh,
chapters.zh: 在山地有沙密，雅提珥，梭哥，

chapters.en: Dannah, Kiriath Sannah (that is, Debir),
chapters.zh: 大拿，基列萨拿（基列萨拿就是底璧），

chapters.en: Anab, Eshtemoh, Anim,
chapters.zh: 亚拿伯，以实提莫，亚念，

chapters.en: Goshen, Holon and Giloh—eleven towns and their villages.
chapters.zh: 歌珊，何伦，基罗，共十一座城，还有属城的村庄。

chapters.en: Arab, Dumah, Eshan,
chapters.zh: 又有亚拉，度玛，以珊，

chapters.en: Janim, Beth Tappuah, Aphekah,
chapters.zh: 雅农，伯他普亚，亚非加，

chapters.en: Humtah, Kiriath Arba (that is, Hebron) and Zior—nine towns and their villages.
chapters.zh: 宏他，基列亚巴（基列亚巴就是希伯仑），洗珥，共九座城，还有属城的村庄。

chapters.en: Maon, Carmel, Ziph, Juttah,
chapters.zh: 又有玛云，迦密，西弗，淤他，

chapters.en: Jezreel, Jokdeam, Zanoah,
chapters.zh: 耶斯列，约甸，撒挪亚，

chapters.en: Kain, Gibeah and Timnah—ten towns and their villages.
chapters.zh: 该隐，基比亚，亭纳，共十座城，还有属城的村庄。

chapters.en: Halhul, Beth Zur, Gedor,
chapters.zh: 又有哈忽，伯夙，基突，

chapters.en: Maarath, Beth Anoth and Eltekon—six towns and their villages.
chapters.zh: 玛腊，伯亚诺，伊勒提君，共六座城，还有属城的村庄。

chapters.en: Kiriath Baal (that is, Kiriath Jearim) and Rabbah—two towns and their villages.
chapters.zh: 又有基列巴力（基列巴力就是基列耶琳），拉巴，共两座城，还有属城的村庄。

chapters.en: In the wilderness: Beth Arabah, Middin, Sekakah,
chapters.zh: 在旷野有伯亚拉巴，密丁，西迦迦，

chapters.en: Nibshan, the City of Salt and En Gedi—six towns and their villages.
chapters.zh: 匿珊，盐城，隐基底，共六座城，还有属城的村庄。

chapters.en: Judah could not dislodge the Jebusites, who were living in Jerusalem; to this day the Jebusites live there with the people of Judah.
chapters.zh: 至于住耶路撒冷的耶布斯人，犹大人不能把他们赶出去，耶布斯人却在耶路撒冷与犹大人同住，直到今日。

chapters.en: The allotment for Joseph began at the Jordan, east of the springs of Jericho, and went up from there through the desert into the hill country of Bethel.
chapters.zh: 约瑟的子孙拈阄所得之地是从靠近耶利哥的约旦河起，以耶利哥东边的水为界，从耶利哥上去，通过山地的旷野，到伯特利。

chapters.en: It went on from Bethel (that is, Luz), crossed over to the territory of the Arkites in Ataroth,
chapters.zh: 又从伯特利到路斯，接连到亚基人的境界，至亚他绿。

chapters.en: descended westward to the territory of the Japhletites as far as the region of Lower Beth Horon and on to Gezer, ending at the Mediterranean Sea.
chapters.zh: 又往西下到押利提人的境界，到下伯和仑的境界，直到基色，通到海为止。

chapters.en: So Manasseh and Ephraim, the descendants of Joseph, received their inheritance.
chapters.zh: 约瑟的儿子玛拿西，以法莲就得了他们的地业。

chapters.en: This was the territory of Ephraim, according to its clans: The boundary of their inheritance went from Ataroth Addar in the east to Upper Beth Horon
chapters.zh: 以法莲子孙的境界，按着宗族所得的，记在下面，他们地业的东界是亚他绿亚达到上伯和仑。

chapters.en: and continued to the Mediterranean Sea. From Mikmethath on the north it curved eastward to Taanath Shiloh, passing by it to Janoah on the east.
chapters.zh: 往西通到北边的密米他，又向东绕到他纳示罗，又接连到雅挪哈的东边。

chapters.en: Then it went down from Janoah to Ataroth and Naarah, touched Jericho and came out at the Jordan.
chapters.zh: 从雅挪哈下到亚他绿，又到拿拉，达到耶利哥，通到约旦河为止。

chapters.en: From Tappuah the border went west to the Kanah Ravine and ended at the Mediterranean Sea. This was the inheritance of the tribe of the Ephraimites, according to its clans.
chapters.zh: 从他普亚往西，到加拿河，直通到海为止。这就是以法莲支派按着宗族所得的地业。

chapters.en: It also included all the towns and their villages that were set aside for the Ephraimites within the inheritance of the Manassites.
chapters.zh: 另外在玛拿西人地业中得了些城邑和属城的村庄。这都是分给以法莲子孙的。

chapters.en: They did not dislodge the Canaanites living in Gezer; to this day the Canaanites live among the people of Ephraim but are required to do forced labor.
chapters.zh: 他们没有赶出住基色的迦南人。迦南人却住在以法莲人中间，成为作苦工的仆人，直到今日。

chapters.en: This was the allotment for the tribe of Manasseh as Joseph’s firstborn, that is, for Makir, Manasseh’s firstborn. Makir was the ancestor of the Gileadites, who had received Gilead and Bashan because the Makirites were great soldiers.
chapters.zh: 玛拿西是约瑟的长子，他的支派拈阄所得之地记在下面。至于玛拿西的长子基列之父（父或作主）玛吉，因为是勇士就得了基列和巴珊。

chapters.en: So this allotment was for the rest of the people of Manasseh—the clans of Abiezer, Helek, Asriel, Shechem, Hepher and Shemida. These are the other male descendants of Manasseh son of Joseph by their clans.
chapters.zh: 玛拿西其余的子孙，按着宗族拈阄分地，就是亚比以谢子孙，希勒子孙，亚斯列子孙，示剑子孙，希弗子孙，示米大子孙。这些按着宗族，都是约瑟儿子玛拿西子孙的男丁。

chapters.en: Now Zelophehad son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Makir, the son of Manasseh, had no sons but only daughters, whose names were Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milkah and Tirzah.
chapters.zh: 玛拿西的玄孙，玛吉的曾孙，基列的孙子，希弗的儿子西罗非哈没有儿子，只有女儿。他的女儿名叫玛拉，挪阿，曷拉，密迦，得撒。

chapters.en: They went to Eleazar the priest, Joshua son of Nun, and the leaders and said, “The LORD commanded Moses to give us an inheritance among our relatives.” So Joshua gave them an inheritance along with the brothers of their father, according to the LORD’s command.
chapters.zh: 她们来到祭司以利亚撒和嫩的儿子约书亚并众首领面前，说，耶和华曾吩咐摩西在我们弟兄中分给我们产业。于是约书亚照耶和华所吩咐的，在她们伯叔中，把产业分给她们。

chapters.en: Manasseh’s share consisted of ten tracts of land besides Gilead and Bashan east of the Jordan,
chapters.zh: 除了约旦河东的基列和巴珊地之外，还有十分地归玛拿西，

chapters.en: because the daughters of the tribe of Manasseh received an inheritance among the sons. The land of Gilead belonged to the rest of the descendants of Manasseh.
chapters.zh: 因为玛拿西的孙女们在玛拿西的孙子中得了产业。基列地是属玛拿西其余的子孙。

chapters.en: The territory of Manasseh extended from Asher to Mikmethath east of Shechem. The boundary ran southward from there to include the people living at En Tappuah.
chapters.zh: 玛拿西的境界，从亚设起，到示剑前的密米他，往北到隐他普亚居民之地。

chapters.en: (Manasseh had the land of Tappuah, but Tappuah itself, on the boundary of Manasseh, belonged to the Ephraimites.)
chapters.zh: 他普亚地归玛拿西，只是玛拿西境界上的他普亚城归以法莲子孙。

chapters.en: Then the boundary continued south to the Kanah Ravine. There were towns belonging to Ephraim lying among the towns of Manasseh, but the boundary of Manasseh was the northern side of the ravine and ended at the Mediterranean Sea.
chapters.zh: 其界下到加拿河的南边。在玛拿西城邑中的这些城邑都归以法莲。玛拿西的地界是在河北直通到海为止。

chapters.en: On the south the land belonged to Ephraim, on the north to Manasseh. The territory of Manasseh reached the Mediterranean Sea and bordered Asher on the north and Issachar on the east.
chapters.zh: 南归以法莲，北归玛拿西，以海为界。北边到亚设，东边到以萨迦。

chapters.en: Within Issachar and Asher, Manasseh also had Beth Shan, Ibleam and the people of Dor, Endor, Taanach and Megiddo, together with their surrounding settlements (the third in the list is Naphoth ).
chapters.zh: 玛拿西在以萨迦和亚设境内，有伯善和属伯善的镇市，以伯莲和属以伯莲的镇市，多珥的居民和属多珥的镇市。又有三处山冈，就是隐多珥和属隐多珥的镇市。他纳的居民和属他纳的镇市，米吉多的居民和属米吉多的镇市。

chapters.en: Yet the Manassites were not able to occupy these towns, for the Canaanites were determined to live in that region.
chapters.zh: 只是玛拿西子孙不能赶出这些城的居民，迦南人偏要住在那地。

chapters.en: However, when the Israelites grew stronger, they subjected the Canaanites to forced labor but did not drive them out completely.
chapters.zh: 及至以色列人强盛了，就使迦南人作苦工，没有把他们全然赶出。

chapters.en: The people of Joseph said to Joshua, “Why have you given us only one allotment and one portion for an inheritance? We are a numerous people, and the LORD has blessed us abundantly.”
chapters.zh: 约瑟的子孙对约书亚说，耶和华到如今既然赐福与我们，我们也族大人多，你为什么仅将一阄一段之地分给我们为业呢？

chapters.en: “If you are so numerous,” Joshua answered, “and if the hill country of Ephraim is too small for you, go up into the forest and clear land for yourselves there in the land of the Perizzites and Rephaites.”
chapters.zh: 约书亚说，你们如果族大人多，嫌以法莲山地窄小，就可以上比利洗人，利乏音人之地，在树林中砍伐树木。

chapters.en: The people of Joseph replied, “The hill country is not enough for us, and all the Canaanites who live in the plain have chariots fitted with iron, both those in Beth Shan and its settlements and those in the Valley of Jezreel.”
chapters.zh: 约瑟的子孙说，那山地容不下我们，并且住平原的迦南人，就是住伯善和属伯善的镇市，并住耶斯列平原的人，都有铁车。

chapters.en: But Joshua said to the tribes of Joseph—to Ephraim and Manasseh—“You are numerous and very powerful. You will have not only one allotment
chapters.zh: 约书亚对约瑟家，就是以法莲和玛拿西人，说，你是族大人多，并且强盛，不可仅有一阄之地，

chapters.en: but the forested hill country as well. Clear it, and its farthest limits will be yours; though the Canaanites have chariots fitted with iron and though they are strong, you can drive them out.”
chapters.zh: 山地也要归你，虽是树林，你也可以砍伐。靠近之地必归你。迦南人虽有铁车，虽是强盛，你也能把他们赶出去。

chapters.en: The whole assembly of the Israelites gathered at Shiloh and set up the tent of meeting there. The country was brought under their control,
chapters.zh: 以色列的全会众都聚集在示罗，把会幕设立在那里，那地已经被他们制伏了。

chapters.en: but there were still seven Israelite tribes who had not yet received their inheritance.
chapters.zh: 以色列人中其余的七个支派还没有分给他们地业。

chapters.en: So Joshua said to the Israelites: “How long will you wait before you begin to take possession of the land that the LORD, the God of your ancestors, has given you?
chapters.zh: 约书亚对以色列人说，耶和华你们列祖的神所赐给你们的地，你们耽延不去得，要到几时呢？

chapters.en: Appoint three men from each tribe. I will send them out to make a survey of the land and to write a description of it, according to the inheritance of each. Then they will return to me.
chapters.zh: 你们每支派当选举三个人，我要打发他们去，他们就要起身走遍那地，按着各支派应得的地业写明（或作画图），就回到我这里来。

chapters.en: You are to divide the land into seven parts. Judah is to remain in its territory on the south and the tribes of Joseph in their territory on the north.
chapters.zh: 他们要将地分作七分。犹大仍在南方，住在他的境内。约瑟家仍在北方，住在他的境内。

chapters.en: After you have written descriptions of the seven parts of the land, bring them here to me and I will cast lots for you in the presence of the LORD our God.
chapters.zh: 你们要将地分作七分，写明了拿到我这里来。我要在耶和华我们神面前，为你们拈阄。

chapters.en: The Levites, however, do not get a portion among you, because the priestly service of the LORD is their inheritance. And Gad, Reuben and the half-tribe of Manasseh have already received their inheritance on the east side of the Jordan. Moses the servant of the LORD gave it to them.”
chapters.zh: 利未人在你们中间没有分，因为供耶和华祭司的职任就是他们的产业。迦得支派，流便支派，和玛拿西半支派已经在约旦河东得了地业，就是耶和华仆人摩西所给他们的。

chapters.en: As the men started on their way to map out the land, Joshua instructed them, “Go and make a survey of the land and write a description of it. Then return to me, and I will cast lots for you here at Shiloh in the presence of the LORD.”
chapters.zh: 划地势的人起身去的时候，约书亚嘱咐他们说，你们去走遍那地，划明地势，就回到我这里来。我要在示罗这里，耶和华面前，为你们拈阄。

chapters.en: So the men left and went through the land. They wrote its description on a scroll, town by town, in seven parts, and returned to Joshua in the camp at Shiloh.
chapters.zh: 他们就去了，走遍那地，按着城邑分作七分，写在册子上，回到示罗营中见约书亚。

chapters.en: Joshua then cast lots for them in Shiloh in the presence of the LORD, and there he distributed the land to the Israelites according to their tribal divisions.
chapters.zh: 约书亚就在示罗，耶和华面前，为他们拈阄。约书亚在那里，按着以色列人的支派，将地分给他们。

chapters.en: The first lot came up for the tribe of Benjamin according to its clans. Their allotted territory lay between the tribes of Judah and Joseph:
chapters.zh: 便雅悯支派，按着宗族拈阄所得之地，是在犹大，约瑟子孙中间。

chapters.en: On the north side their boundary began at the Jordan, passed the northern slope of Jericho and headed west into the hill country, coming out at the wilderness of Beth Aven.
chapters.zh: 他们的北界是从约旦河起，往上贴近耶利哥的北边。又往西通过山地，直到伯亚文的旷野。

chapters.en: From there it crossed to the south slope of Luz (that is, Bethel) and went down to Ataroth Addar on the hill south of Lower Beth Horon.
chapters.zh: 从那里往南接连到路斯，贴近路斯（路斯就是伯特利），又下到亚他绿亚达，靠近下伯和仑南边的山。

chapters.en: From the hill facing Beth Horon on the south the boundary turned south along the western side and came out at Kiriath Baal (that is, Kiriath Jearim), a town of the people of Judah. This was the western side.
chapters.zh: 从那里往西，又转向南，从伯和仑南对面的山，直达到犹大人的城基列巴力（基列巴力就是基列耶琳）。这是西界。

chapters.en: The southern side began at the outskirts of Kiriath Jearim on the west, and the boundary came out at the spring of the waters of Nephtoah.
chapters.zh: 南界是从基列耶琳的尽边起，往西达到尼弗多亚的水源。

chapters.en: The boundary went down to the foot of the hill facing the Valley of Ben Hinnom, north of the Valley of Rephaim. It continued down the Hinnom Valley along the southern slope of the Jebusite city and so to En Rogel.
chapters.zh: 又下到欣嫩子谷对面山的尽边，就是利乏音谷北边的山。又下到欣嫩谷，贴近耶布斯的南边。又下到隐罗结。

chapters.en: It then curved north, went to En Shemesh, continued to Geliloth, which faces the Pass of Adummim, and ran down to the Stone of Bohan son of Reuben.
chapters.zh: 又往北通到隐示麦，达到亚都冥坡对面的基利绿。又下到流便之子波罕的磐石。

chapters.en: It continued to the northern slope of Beth Arabah and on down into the Arabah.
chapters.zh: 又接连到亚拉巴对面，往北下到亚拉巴。

chapters.en: It then went to the northern slope of Beth Hoglah and came out at the northern bay of the Dead Sea, at the mouth of the Jordan in the south. This was the southern boundary.
chapters.zh: 又接连到伯曷拉的北边，直通到盐海的北汊，就是约旦河的南头。这是南界。

chapters.en: The Jordan formed the boundary on the eastern side. These were the boundaries that marked out the inheritance of the clans of Benjamin on all sides.
chapters.zh: 东界是约旦河。这是便雅悯人按着宗族，照他们四围的交界所得的地业。

chapters.en: The tribe of Benjamin, according to its clans, had the following towns: Jericho, Beth Hoglah, Emek Keziz,
chapters.zh: 便雅悯支派按着宗族所得的城邑就是，耶利哥，伯曷拉，伊麦基悉，

chapters.en: Beth Arabah, Zemaraim, Bethel,
chapters.zh: 伯亚拉巴，洗玛脸，伯特利，

chapters.en: Avvim, Parah, Ophrah,
chapters.zh: 亚文，巴拉，俄弗拉，

chapters.en: Kephar Ammoni, Ophni and Geba—twelve towns and their villages.
chapters.zh: 基法阿摩尼，俄弗尼，迦巴，共十二座城，还有属城的村庄。

chapters.en: Gibeon, Ramah, Beeroth,
chapters.zh: 又有基遍，拉玛，比录，

chapters.en: Mizpah, Kephirah, Mozah,
chapters.zh: 米斯巴，基非拉，摩撒，

chapters.en: Rekem, Irpeel, Taralah,
chapters.zh: 利坚，伊利毗勒，他拉拉，

chapters.en: Zelah, Haeleph, the Jebusite city (that is, Jerusalem), Gibeah and Kiriath—fourteen towns and their villages. This was the inheritance of Benjamin for its clans.
chapters.zh: 洗拉，以利弗，耶布斯（耶布斯就是耶路撒冷），基比亚，基列，共十四座城，还有属城的村庄。这是便雅悯人按着宗族所得的地业。

chapters.en: The second lot came out for the tribe of Simeon according to its clans. Their inheritance lay within the territory of Judah.
chapters.zh: 为西缅支派的人，按着宗族，拈出第二阄。他们所得的地业是在犹大人地业中间。

chapters.en: It included: Beersheba (or Sheba), Moladah,
chapters.zh: 他们所得为业之地就是，别是巴（或名示巴），摩拉大，

chapters.en: Hazar Shual, Balah, Ezem,
chapters.zh: 哈萨书亚，巴拉，以森，

chapters.en: Eltolad, Bethul, Hormah,
chapters.zh: 伊利多拉，比土力，何珥玛，

chapters.en: Ziklag, Beth Markaboth, Hazar Susah,
chapters.zh: 洗革拉，伯玛加博，哈萨苏撒，

chapters.en: Beth Lebaoth and Sharuhen—thirteen towns and their villages;
chapters.zh: 伯利巴勿，沙鲁险，共十三座城，还有属城的村庄。

chapters.en: Ain, Rimmon, Ether and Ashan—four towns and their villages—
chapters.zh: 又有亚因，利门，以帖，亚珊，共四座城，还有属城的村庄。

chapters.en: and all the villages around these towns as far as Baalath Beer (Ramah in the Negev). This was the inheritance of the tribe of the Simeonites, according to its clans.
chapters.zh: 并有这些城邑四围一切的村庄，直到巴拉比珥，就是南地的拉玛。这是西缅支派按着宗族所得的地业。

chapters.en: The inheritance of the Simeonites was taken from the share of Judah, because Judah’s portion was more than they needed. So the Simeonites received their inheritance within the territory of Judah.
chapters.zh: 西缅人的地业是从犹大人地业中得来的。因为犹大人的分过多，所以西缅人在他们的地业中得了地业。

chapters.en: The third lot came up for Zebulun according to its clans: The boundary of their inheritance went as far as Sarid.
chapters.zh: 为西布伦人，按着宗族，拈出第三阄。他们地业的境界是到撒立。

chapters.en: Going west it ran to Maralah, touched Dabbesheth, and extended to the ravine near Jokneam.
chapters.zh: 往西上到玛拉拉，达到大巴设，又达到约念前的河。

chapters.en: It turned east from Sarid toward the sunrise to the territory of Kisloth Tabor and went on to Daberath and up to Japhia.
chapters.zh: 又从撒立往东转向日出之地，到吉斯绿他泊的境界，又通到大比拉，上到雅非亚。

chapters.en: Then it continued eastward to Gath Hepher and Eth Kazin; it came out at Rimmon and turned toward Neah.
chapters.zh: 从那里往东，接连到迦特希弗，至以特加汛，通到临门，临门延到尼亚。

chapters.en: There the boundary went around on the north to Hannathon and ended at the Valley of Iphtah El.
chapters.zh: 又绕过尼亚的北边，转到哈拿顿，通到伊弗他伊勒谷。

chapters.en: Included were Kattath, Nahalal, Shimron, Idalah and Bethlehem. There were twelve towns and their villages.
chapters.zh: 还有加他，拿哈拉，伸仑，以大拉，伯利恒，共十二座城，还有属城的村庄。

chapters.en: These towns and their villages were the inheritance of Zebulun, according to its clans.
chapters.zh: 这些城并属城的村庄就是西布伦人按着宗族所得的地业。

chapters.en: The fourth lot came out for Issachar according to its clans.
chapters.zh: 为以萨迦人，按着宗族，拈出第四阄。

chapters.en: Their territory included: Jezreel, Kesulloth, Shunem,
chapters.zh: 他们的境界是到耶斯列，基苏律，书念，

chapters.en: Hapharaim, Shion, Anaharath,
chapters.zh: 哈弗连，示按，亚拿哈拉，

chapters.en: Rabbith, Kishion, Ebez,
chapters.zh: 拉璧，基善，亚别，

chapters.en: Remeth, En Gannim, En Haddah and Beth Pazzez.
chapters.zh: 利篾，隐干宁，隐哈大，伯帕薛。

chapters.en: The boundary touched Tabor, Shahazumah and Beth Shemesh, and ended at the Jordan. There were sixteen towns and their villages.
chapters.zh: 又达到他泊，沙哈洗玛，伯示麦，直通到约旦河为止，共十六座城，还有属城的村庄。

chapters.en: These towns and their villages were the inheritance of the tribe of Issachar, according to its clans.
chapters.zh: 这些城并属城的村庄就是以萨迦支派按着宗族所得的地业。

chapters.en: The fifth lot came out for the tribe of Asher according to its clans.
chapters.zh: 为亚设支派，按着宗族，拈出第五阄。

chapters.en: Their territory included: Helkath, Hali, Beten, Akshaph,
chapters.zh: 他们的境界是黑甲，哈利，比田，押煞，

chapters.en: Allammelek, Amad and Mishal. On the west the boundary touched Carmel and Shihor Libnath.
chapters.zh: 亚拉米勒，亚末，米沙勒。往西达到迦密，又到希曷立纳，

chapters.en: It then turned east toward Beth Dagon, touched Zebulun and the Valley of Iphtah El, and went north to Beth Emek and Neiel, passing Kabul on the left.
chapters.zh: 转向日出之地，到伯大衮，达到细步纶往北到伊弗他伊勒谷，到伯以墨和尼业，也通到迦步勒的左边。

chapters.en: It went to Abdon, Rehob, Hammon and Kanah, as far as Greater Sidon.
chapters.zh: 又到义伯仑，利合，哈们，加拿，直到西顿大城。

chapters.en: The boundary then turned back toward Ramah and went to the fortified city of Tyre, turned toward Hosah and came out at the Mediterranean Sea in the region of Akzib,
chapters.zh: 转到拉玛和坚固城推罗。又转到何萨，靠近亚革悉一带地方，直通到海。

chapters.en: Ummah, Aphek and Rehob. There were twenty-two towns and their villages.
chapters.zh: 又有乌玛，亚弗，利合，共二十二座城，还有属城的村庄。

chapters.en: These towns and their villages were the inheritance of the tribe of Asher, according to its clans.
chapters.zh: 这些城并属城的村庄就是亚设支派按着宗族所得的地业。

chapters.en: The sixth lot came out for Naphtali according to its clans:
chapters.zh: 为拿弗他利人，按着宗族，拈出第六阄。

chapters.en: Their boundary went from Heleph and the large tree in Zaanannim, passing Adami Nekeb and Jabneel to Lakkum and ending at the Jordan.
chapters.zh: 他们的境界是从希利弗从撒拿音的橡树，从亚大米尼吉和雅比聂，直到拉共，通到约旦河。

chapters.en: The boundary ran west through Aznoth Tabor and came out at Hukkok. It touched Zebulun on the south, Asher on the west and the Jordan on the east.
chapters.zh: 又转向西到亚斯纳他泊，从那里通到户割，南边到西布伦，西边到亚设，又向日出之地，达到约旦河那里的犹大。

chapters.en: The fortified towns were Ziddim, Zer, Hammath, Rakkath, Kinnereth,
chapters.zh: 坚固的城就是，西丁，侧耳，哈末，拉甲，基尼烈，

chapters.en: Adamah, Ramah, Hazor,
chapters.zh: 亚大玛，拉玛，夏琐，

chapters.en: Kedesh, Edrei, En Hazor,
chapters.zh: 基低斯，以得来，隐夏琐，

chapters.en: Iron, Migdal El, Horem, Beth Anath and Beth Shemesh. There were nineteen towns and their villages.
chapters.zh: 以利稳，密大伊勒，和琏，伯亚纳，伯示麦，共十九座城，还有属城的村庄。

chapters.en: These towns and their villages were the inheritance of the tribe of Naphtali, according to its clans.
chapters.zh: 这些城并属城的村庄就是拿弗他利支派按着宗族所得的地业。

chapters.en: The seventh lot came out for the tribe of Dan according to its clans.
chapters.zh: 为但支派，按着宗族，拈出第七阄。

chapters.en: The territory of their inheritance included: Zorah, Eshtaol, Ir Shemesh,
chapters.zh: 他们地业的境界是琐拉，以实陶，伊珥示麦，

chapters.en: Shaalabbin, Aijalon, Ithlah,
chapters.zh: 沙拉宾，亚雅仑，伊提拉，

chapters.en: Elon, Timnah, Ekron,
chapters.zh: 以伦，亭拿他，以革伦，

chapters.en: Eltekeh, Gibbethon, Baalath,
chapters.zh: 伊利提基，基比顿，巴拉，

chapters.en: Jehud, Bene Berak, Gath Rimmon,
chapters.zh: 伊胡得，比尼比拉，迦特临门，

chapters.en: Me Jarkon and Rakkon, with the area facing Joppa.
chapters.zh: 美耶昆，拉昆，并约帕对面的地界。

chapters.en: (When the territory of the Danites was lost to them, they went up and attacked Leshem, took it, put it to the sword and occupied it. They settled in Leshem and named it Dan after their ancestor.)
chapters.zh: 但人的地界越过原得的地界。因为但人上去攻取利善，用刀击杀城中的人，得了那城，住在其中，以他们先祖但的名将利善改名为但。

chapters.en: These towns and their villages were the inheritance of the tribe of Dan, according to its clans.
chapters.zh: 这些城并属城的村庄就是但支派按着宗族所得的地业。

chapters.en: When they had finished dividing the land into its allotted portions, the Israelites gave Joshua son of Nun an inheritance among them,
chapters.zh: 以色列人按着境界分完了地业，就在他们中间将地给嫩的儿子约书亚为业，

chapters.en: as the LORD had commanded. They gave him the town he asked for—Timnath Serah in the hill country of Ephraim. And he built up the town and settled there.
chapters.zh: 是照耶和华的吩咐，将约书亚所求的城，就是以法莲山地的亭拿西拉城，给了他。他就修那城，住在其中。

chapters.en: These are the territories that Eleazar the priest, Joshua son of Nun and the heads of the tribal clans of Israel assigned by lot at Shiloh in the presence of the LORD at the entrance to the tent of meeting. And so they finished dividing the land.
chapters.zh: 这就是祭司以利亚撒和嫩的儿子约书亚，并以色列各支派的族长，在示罗会幕门口，耶和华面前，拈阄所分的地业。这样，他们把地分完了。

chapters.en: Then the LORD said to Joshua:
chapters.zh: 耶和华晓谕约书亚说，

chapters.en: “Tell the Israelites to designate the cities of refuge, as I instructed you through Moses,
chapters.zh: 你吩咐以色列人说，你们要照着我借摩西所晓谕你们的，为自己设立逃城，

chapters.en: so that anyone who kills a person accidentally and unintentionally may flee there and find protection from the avenger of blood.
chapters.zh: 使那无心而误杀人的，可以逃到那里。这些城可以作你们逃避报血仇人的地方。

chapters.en: When they flee to one of these cities, they are to stand in the entrance of the city gate and state their case before the elders of that city. Then the elders are to admit the fugitive into their city and provide a place to live among them.
chapters.zh: 那杀人的要逃到这些城中的一座城，站在城门口，将他的事情说给城内的长老们听。他们就把他收进城里，给他地方，使他住在他们中间。

chapters.en: If the avenger of blood comes in pursuit, the elders must not surrender the fugitive, because the fugitive killed their neighbor unintentionally and without malice aforethought.
chapters.zh: 若是报血仇的追了他来，长老不可将他交在报血仇的手里。因为他是素无仇恨，无心杀了人的。

chapters.en: They are to stay in that city until they have stood trial before the assembly and until the death of the high priest who is serving at that time. Then they may go back to their own home in the town from which they fled.”
chapters.zh: 他要住在那城里，站在会众面前听审判，等到那时的大祭司死了，杀人的才可以回到本城本家，就是他所逃出来的那城。

chapters.en: So they set apart Kedesh in Galilee in the hill country of Naphtali, Shechem in the hill country of Ephraim, and Kiriath Arba (that is, Hebron) in the hill country of Judah.
chapters.zh: 于是，以色列人在拿弗他利山地分定加利利的基低斯。在以法莲山地分定示剑。在犹大山地分定基列亚巴（基列亚巴就是希伯仑）。

chapters.en: East of the Jordan (on the other side from Jericho) they designated Bezer in the wilderness on the plateau in the tribe of Reuben, Ramoth in Gilead in the tribe of Gad, and Golan in Bashan in the tribe of Manasseh.
chapters.zh: 又在约旦河外耶利哥东，从流便支派中，在旷野的平原，设立比悉。从迦得支派中设立基列的拉末。从玛拿西支派中设立巴珊的哥兰。

chapters.en: Any of the Israelites or any foreigner residing among them who killed someone accidentally could flee to these designated cities and not be killed by the avenger of blood prior to standing trial before the assembly.
chapters.zh: 这都是为以色列众人和在他们中间寄居的外人所分定的地邑，使误杀人的都可以逃到那里，不死在报血仇人的手中，等他站在会众面前听审判。

chapters.en: Now the family heads of the Levites approached Eleazar the priest, Joshua son of Nun, and the heads of the other tribal families of Israel
chapters.zh: 那时，利未人的众族长来到祭司以利亚撒和嫩的儿子约书亚，并以色列各支派的族长面前，

chapters.en: at Shiloh in Canaan and said to them, “The LORD commanded through Moses that you give us towns to live in, with pasturelands for our livestock.”
chapters.zh: 在迦南地的示罗对他们说，从前耶和华借着摩西吩咐给我们城邑居住，并城邑的郊野可以牧养我们的牲畜。

chapters.en: So, as the LORD had commanded, the Israelites gave the Levites the following towns and pasturelands out of their own inheritance:
chapters.zh: 于是以色列人照耶和华所吩咐的，从自己的地业中，将以下所记的城邑和城邑的郊野给了利未人。

chapters.en: The first lot came out for the Kohathites, according to their clans. The Levites who were descendants of Aaron the priest were allotted thirteen towns from the tribes of Judah, Simeon and Benjamin.
chapters.zh: 为哥辖族拈阄，利未人的祭司，亚伦的子孙，从犹大支派，西缅支派，便雅悯支派的地业中，按阄得了十三座城。

chapters.en: The rest of Kohath’s descendants were allotted ten towns from the clans of the tribes of Ephraim, Dan and half of Manasseh.
chapters.zh: 哥辖其余的子孙，从以法莲支派，但支派，玛拿西半支派的地业中，按阄得了十座城。

chapters.en: The descendants of Gershon were allotted thirteen towns from the clans of the tribes of Issachar, Asher, Naphtali and the half-tribe of Manasseh in Bashan.
chapters.zh: 革顺的子孙，从以萨迦支派，亚设支派，拿弗他利支派，住巴珊的玛拿西半支派的地业中，按阄得了十三座城。

chapters.en: The descendants of Merari, according to their clans, received twelve towns from the tribes of Reuben, Gad and Zebulun.
chapters.zh: 米拉利的子孙，按着宗族，从流便支派，迦得支派，西布伦支派的地业中，按阄得了十二座城。

chapters.en: So the Israelites allotted to the Levites these towns and their pasturelands, as the LORD had commanded through Moses.
chapters.zh: 以色列人照着耶和华借摩西所吩咐的，将这些城邑和城邑的郊野，按阄分给利未人。

chapters.en: From the tribes of Judah and Simeon they allotted the following towns by name
chapters.zh: 从犹大支派，西缅支派的地业中，将以下所记的城给了利未支派哥辖宗族亚伦的子孙。因为给他们拈出头一阄，

chapters.en: (these towns were assigned to the descendants of Aaron who were from the Kohathite clans of the Levites, because the first lot fell to them):
They gave them Kiriath Arba (that is, Hebron), with its surrounding pastureland, in the hill country of Judah. (Arba was the forefather of Anak.)
chapters.zh: 将犹大山地的基列亚巴和四围的郊野给了他们。亚巴是亚衲族的始祖。（基列亚巴就是希伯仑）。

chapters.en: But the fields and villages around the city they had given to Caleb son of Jephunneh as his possession.
chapters.zh: 惟将属城的田地和村庄给了耶孚尼的儿子迦勒为业。

chapters.en: So to the descendants of Aaron the priest they gave Hebron (a city of refuge for one accused of murder), Libnah,
chapters.zh: 以色列人将希伯仑，就是误杀人的逃城和属城的郊野，给了祭司亚伦的子孙。又给他们立拿和属城的郊野，

chapters.en: Jattir, Eshtemoa,
chapters.zh: 雅提珥和属城的郊野，以实提莫和属城的郊野，

chapters.en: Holon, Debir,
chapters.zh: 何仑和属城的郊野，底璧和属城的郊野，

chapters.en: Ain, Juttah and Beth Shemesh, together with their pasturelands—nine towns from these two tribes.
chapters.zh: 亚因和属城的郊野，淤他和属城的郊野，伯示麦和属城的郊野，共九座城，都是从这二支派中分出来的。

chapters.en: And from the tribe of Benjamin they gave them Gibeon, Geba,
chapters.zh: 又从便雅悯支派的地业中给了他们基遍和属城的郊野，迦巴和属城的郊野，

chapters.en: Anathoth and Almon, together with their pasturelands—four towns.
chapters.zh: 亚拿突和属城的郊野，亚勒们和属城的郊野，共四座城。

chapters.en: The total number of towns for the priests, the descendants of Aaron, came to thirteen, together with their pasturelands.
chapters.zh: 亚伦子孙作祭司的共有十三座城，还有属城的郊野。

chapters.en: The rest of the Kohathite clans of the Levites were allotted towns from the tribe of Ephraim:
chapters.zh: 利未支派中哥辖的宗族，就是哥辖其余的子孙，拈阄所得的城有从以法莲支派中分出来的。

chapters.en: In the hill country of Ephraim they were given Shechem (a city of refuge for one accused of murder) and Gezer,
chapters.zh: 以色列人将以法莲山地的示剑，就是误杀人的逃城和属城的郊野，给了他们。又给他们基色和属城的郊野，

chapters.en: Kibzaim and Beth Horon, together with their pasturelands—four towns.
chapters.zh: 基伯先和属城的郊野，伯和仑和属城的郊野，共四座城。

chapters.en: Also from the tribe of Dan they received Eltekeh, Gibbethon,
chapters.zh: 又从但支派的地业中给了他们伊利提基和属城的郊野，基比顿和属城的郊野，

chapters.en: Aijalon and Gath Rimmon, together with their pasturelands—four towns.
chapters.zh: 亚雅仑和属城的郊野，迦特临门和属城的郊野，共四座城。

chapters.en: From half the tribe of Manasseh they received Taanach and Gath Rimmon, together with their pasturelands—two towns.
chapters.zh: 又从玛拿西半支派的地业中给了他们他纳和属城的郊野，迦特临门和属城的郊野，共两座城。

chapters.en: All these ten towns and their pasturelands were given to the rest of the Kohathite clans.
chapters.zh: 哥辖其余的子孙共有十座城，还有属城的郊野。

chapters.en: The Levite clans of the Gershonites were given: from the half-tribe of Manasseh, Golan in Bashan (a city of refuge for one accused of murder) and Be Eshterah, together with their pasturelands—two towns;
chapters.zh: 以色列人又从玛拿西半支派的地业中将巴珊的哥兰，就是误杀人的逃城和属城的郊野，给了利未支派革顺的子孙。又给他们比施提拉和属城的郊野，共两座城。

chapters.en: from the tribe of Issachar, Kishion, Daberath,
chapters.zh: 又从以萨迦支派的地业中给了他们基善和属城的郊野，大比拉和属城的郊野，

chapters.en: Jarmuth and En Gannim, together with their pasturelands—four towns;
chapters.zh: 耶末和属城的郊野，隐干宁和属城的郊野，共四座城。

chapters.en: from the tribe of Asher, Mishal, Abdon,
chapters.zh: 又从亚设支派的地业中给了他们米沙勒和属城的郊野，押顿和属城的郊野，

chapters.en: Helkath and Rehob, together with their pasturelands—four towns;
chapters.zh: 黑甲和属城的郊野，利合和属城的郊野，共四座城。

chapters.en: from the tribe of Naphtali, Kedesh in Galilee (a city of refuge for one accused of murder), Hammoth Dor and Kartan, together with their pasturelands—three towns.
chapters.zh: 又从拿弗他利支派的地业中将加利利的基低斯，就是误杀人的逃城和属城的郊野，给了他们。又给他们哈末多珥和属城的郊野，加珥坦和属城的郊野，共三座城。

chapters.en: The total number of towns of the Gershonite clans came to thirteen, together with their pasturelands.
chapters.zh: 革顺人按着宗族所得的城，共十三座，还有属城的郊野。

chapters.en: The Merarite clans (the rest of the Levites) were given: from the tribe of Zebulun, Jokneam, Kartah,
chapters.zh: 其余利未支派米拉利子孙，从西布伦支派的地业中所得的，就是约念和属城的郊野，加珥他和属城的郊野，

chapters.en: Dimnah and Nahalal, together with their pasturelands—four towns;
chapters.zh: 丁拿和属城的郊野，拿哈拉和属城的郊野，共四座城。

chapters.en: from the tribe of Reuben, Bezer, Jahaz,
chapters.zh: 又从流便支派的地业中给了他们比悉和属城的郊野，雅杂和属城的郊野，

chapters.en: Kedemoth and Mephaath, together with their pasturelands—four towns;
chapters.zh: 基底莫和属城的郊野，米法押和属城的郊野，共四座城。

chapters.en: from the tribe of Gad, Ramoth in Gilead (a city of refuge for one accused of murder), Mahanaim,
chapters.zh: 又从迦得支派的地业中，将基列的拉末，就是误杀人的逃城和属城的郊野，给了他们。又给他们玛哈念和属城的郊野，

chapters.en: Heshbon and Jazer, together with their pasturelands—four towns in all.
chapters.zh: 希实本和属城的郊野，雅谢和属城的郊野，共四座城。

chapters.en: The total number of towns allotted to the Merarite clans, who were the rest of the Levites, came to twelve.
chapters.zh: 其余利未支派的人，就是米拉利的子孙，按着宗族拈阄所得的，共十二座城。

chapters.en: The towns of the Levites in the territory held by the Israelites were forty-eight in all, together with their pasturelands.
chapters.zh: 利未人在以色列人的地业中所得的城，共四十八座，并有属城的郊野。

chapters.en: Each of these towns had pasturelands surrounding it; this was true for all these towns.
chapters.zh: 这些城四围都有属城的郊野，城城都是如此。

chapters.en: So the LORD gave Israel all the land he had sworn to give their ancestors, and they took possession of it and settled there.
chapters.zh: 这样，耶和华将从前向他们列祖起誓所应许的全地赐给以色列人，他们就得了为业，住在其中。

chapters.en: The LORD gave them rest on every side, just as he had sworn to their ancestors. Not one of their enemies withstood them; the LORD gave all their enemies into their hands.
chapters.zh: 耶和华照着向他们列祖起誓所应许的一切话，使他们四境平安。他们一切仇敌中，没有一人在他们面前站立得住。耶和华把一切仇敌都交在他们手中。

chapters.en: Not one of all the LORD’s good promises to Israel failed; every one was fulfilled.
chapters.zh: 耶和华应许赐福给以色列家的话一句也没有落空，都应验了。

chapters.en: Then Joshua summoned the Reubenites, the Gadites and the half-tribe of Manasseh
chapters.zh: 当时，约书亚召了流便人，迦得人，和玛拿西半支派的人来，

chapters.en: and said to them, “You have done all that Moses the servant of the LORD commanded, and you have obeyed me in everything I commanded.
chapters.zh: 对他们说，耶和华仆人摩西所吩咐你们的，你们都遵守了。我所吩咐你们的，你们也都听从了。

chapters.en: For a long time now—to this very day—you have not deserted your fellow Israelites but have carried out the mission the LORD your God gave you.
chapters.zh: 你们这许多日子，总没有撇离你们的弟兄，直到今日，并守了耶和华你们神所吩咐你们当守的。

chapters.en: Now that the LORD your God has given them rest as he promised, return to your homes in the land that Moses the servant of the LORD gave you on the other side of the Jordan.
chapters.zh: 如今耶和华你们神照着他所应许的，使你们弟兄得享平安，现在可以转回你们的帐棚，到耶和华的仆人摩西在约旦河东所赐你们为业之地。

chapters.en: But be very careful to keep the commandment and the law that Moses the servant of the LORD gave you: to love the LORD your God, to walk in obedience to him, to keep his commands, to hold fast to him and to serve him with all your heart and with all your soul.”
chapters.zh: 只要切切地谨慎遵行耶和华仆人摩西所吩咐你们的诫命律法，爱耶和华你们的神，行他一切的道，守他的诫命，专靠他，尽心尽性事奉他。

chapters.en: Then Joshua blessed them and sent them away, and they went to their homes.
chapters.zh: 于是约书亚为他们祝福，打发他们去，他们就回自己的帐棚去了。

chapters.en: (To the half-tribe of Manasseh Moses had given land in Bashan, and to the other half of the tribe Joshua gave land on the west side of the Jordan along with their fellow Israelites.) When Joshua sent them home, he blessed them,
chapters.zh: 玛拿西那半支派，摩西早已在巴珊分给他们地业。这半支派，约书亚在约旦河西，在他们弟兄中，分给他们地业。约书亚打发他们回帐棚的时候为他们祝福，

chapters.en: saying, “Return to your homes with your great wealth—with large herds of livestock, with silver, gold, bronze and iron, and a great quantity of clothing—and divide the plunder from your enemies with your fellow Israelites.”
chapters.zh: 对他们说，你们带许多财物，许多牲畜和金，银，铜，铁，并许多衣服，回你们的帐棚去，要将你们从仇敌夺来的物，与你们众弟兄同分。

chapters.en: So the Reubenites, the Gadites and the half-tribe of Manasseh left the Israelites at Shiloh in Canaan to return to Gilead, their own land, which they had acquired in accordance with the command of the LORD through Moses.
chapters.zh: 于是流便人，迦得人，玛拿西半支派的人从迦南地的示罗起行，离开以色列人，回往他们得为业的基列地，就是照耶和华借摩西所吩咐的得了为业之地。

chapters.en: When they came to Geliloth near the Jordan in the land of Canaan, the Reubenites, the Gadites and the half-tribe of Manasseh built an imposing altar there by the Jordan.
chapters.zh: 流便人，迦得人，和玛拿西半支派的人到了靠近约旦河的一带迦南地，就在约旦河那里筑了一座坛。那坛看着高大。

chapters.en: And when the Israelites heard that they had built the altar on the border of Canaan at Geliloth near the Jordan on the Israelite side,
chapters.zh: 以色列人听说流便人，迦得人，玛拿西半支派的人靠近约旦河边，在迦南地属以色列人的那边筑了一座坛。

chapters.en: the whole assembly of Israel gathered at Shiloh to go to war against them.
chapters.zh: 全会众一听见，就聚集在示罗，要上去攻打他们。

chapters.en: So the Israelites sent Phinehas son of Eleazar, the priest, to the land of Gilead—to Reuben, Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh.
chapters.zh: 以色列人打发祭司以利亚撒的儿子非尼哈，往基列地去见流便人，迦得人，玛拿西半支派的人。

chapters.en: With him they sent ten of the chief men, one from each of the tribes of Israel, each the head of a family division among the Israelite clans.
chapters.zh: 又打发十个首领与非尼哈同去，就是以色列每支派的一个首领，都是以色列军中的统领。

chapters.en: When they went to Gilead—to Reuben, Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh—they said to them:
chapters.zh: 他们到了基列地，见流便人，迦得人，和玛拿西半支派的人，对他们说，

chapters.en: “The whole assembly of the LORD says: ‘How could you break faith with the God of Israel like this? How could you turn away from the LORD and build yourselves an altar in rebellion against him now?
chapters.zh: 耶和华全会众这样说，你们今日转去不跟从耶和华，干犯以色列的神，为自己筑一座坛，悖逆了耶和华，这犯的是什么罪呢？

chapters.en: Was not the sin of Peor enough for us? Up to this very day we have not cleansed ourselves from that sin, even though a plague fell on the community of the LORD!
chapters.zh: 从前拜毗珥的罪孽还算小吗？虽然瘟疫临到耶和华的会众，到今日我们还没有洗净这罪。

chapters.en: And are you now turning away from the LORD? “ ‘If you rebel against the LORD today, tomorrow he will be angry with the whole community of Israel.
chapters.zh: 你们今日竟转去不跟从耶和华吗？你们今日既悖逆耶和华，明日他必向以色列全会众发怒。

chapters.en: If the land you possess is defiled, come over to the LORD’s land, where the LORD’s tabernacle stands, and share the land with us. But do not rebel against the LORD or against us by building an altar for yourselves, other than the altar of the LORD our God.
chapters.zh: 你们所得为业之地，若嫌不洁净，就可以过到耶和华之地，就是耶和华的帐幕所住之地，在我们中间得地业。只是不可悖逆耶和华，也不可得罪我们，在耶和华我们神的坛以外为自己筑坛。

chapters.en: When Achan son of Zerah was unfaithful in regard to the devoted things, did not wrath come on the whole community of Israel? He was not the only one who died for his sin.’ ”
chapters.zh: 从前谢拉的曾孙亚干岂不是在那当灭的物上犯了罪，就有忿怒临到以色列全会众吗？那人在所犯的罪中不独一人死亡。

chapters.en: Then Reuben, Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh replied to the heads of the clans of Israel:
chapters.zh: 于是流便人，迦得人，玛拿西半支派的人回答以色列军中的统领说，

chapters.en: “The Mighty One, God, the LORD! The Mighty One, God, the LORD! He knows! And let Israel know! If this has been in rebellion or disobedience to the LORD, do not spare us this day.
chapters.zh: 大能者神耶和华。大能者神耶和华。他是知道的。以色列人也必知道。我们若有悖逆的意思，或是干犯耶和华（愿你今日不保佑我们），

chapters.en: If we have built our own altar to turn away from the LORD and to offer burnt offerings and grain offerings, or to sacrifice fellowship offerings on it, may the LORD himself call us to account.
chapters.zh: 为自己筑坛，要转去不跟从耶和华，或是要将燔祭，素祭，平安祭献在坛上，愿耶和华亲自讨我们的罪。

chapters.en: “No! We did it for fear that some day your descendants might say to ours, ‘What do you have to do with the LORD, the God of Israel?
chapters.zh: 我们行这事并非无故，是特意作的，说，恐怕日后你们的子孙对我们的子孙说，你们与耶和华以色列的神有何关涉呢？

chapters.en: The LORD has made the Jordan a boundary between us and you—you Reubenites and Gadites! You have no share in the LORD.’ So your descendants might cause ours to stop fearing the LORD.
chapters.zh: 因为耶和华把约旦河定为我们和你们这流便人，迦得人的交界，你们与耶和华无分了。这样，你们的子孙就使我们的子孙不再敬畏耶和华了。

chapters.en: “That is why we said, ‘Let us get ready and build an altar—but not for burnt offerings or sacrifices.’
chapters.zh: 因此我们说，不如为自己筑一座坛，不是为献燔祭，也不是为献别的祭，

chapters.en: On the contrary, it is to be a witness between us and you and the generations that follow, that we will worship the LORD at his sanctuary with our burnt offerings, sacrifices and fellowship offerings. Then in the future your descendants will not be able to say to ours, ‘You have no share in the LORD.’
chapters.zh: 乃是为你我中间和你我后人中间作证据，好叫我们也在耶和华面前献燔祭，平安祭，和别的祭事奉他，免得你们的子孙日后对我们的子孙说，你们与耶和华无分了。

chapters.en: “And we said, ‘If they ever say this to us, or to our descendants, we will answer: Look at the replica of the LORD’s altar, which our ancestors built, not for burnt offerings and sacrifices, but as a witness between us and you.’
chapters.zh: 所以我们说，日后你们对我们，或对我们的后人这样说，我们就可以回答说，你们看我们列祖所筑的坛是耶和华坛的样式。这并不是为献燔祭，也不是为献别的祭，乃是为作你我中间的证据。

chapters.en: “Far be it from us to rebel against the LORD and turn away from him today by building an altar for burnt offerings, grain offerings and sacrifices, other than the altar of the LORD our God that stands before his tabernacle.”
chapters.zh: 我们在耶和华我们神帐幕前的坛以外，另筑一座坛，为献燔祭，素祭，和别的祭，悖逆耶和华，今日转去不跟从他，我们断没有这个意思。

chapters.en: When Phinehas the priest and the leaders of the community—the heads of the clans of the Israelites—heard what Reuben, Gad and Manasseh had to say, they were pleased.
chapters.zh: 祭司非尼哈与会中的首领，就是与他同来以色列军中的统领，听见流便人，迦得人，玛拿西人所说的话，就都以为美。
