chapters.en: And Phinehas son of Eleazar, the priest, said to Reuben, Gad and Manasseh, “Today we know that the LORD is with us, because you have not been unfaithful to the LORD in this matter. Now you have rescued the Israelites from the LORD’s hand.”
chapters.zh: 祭司以利亚撒的儿子非尼哈对流便人，迦得人，玛拿西人说，今日我们知道耶和华在我们中间，因为你们没有向他犯了这罪。现在你们救以色列人脱离耶和华的手了。

chapters.en: Then Phinehas son of Eleazar, the priest, and the leaders returned to Canaan from their meeting with the Reubenites and Gadites in Gilead and reported to the Israelites.
chapters.zh: 祭司以利亚撒的儿子非尼哈与众首领离了流便人，迦得人，从基列地回往迦南地，到了以色列人那里，便将这事回报他们。

chapters.en: They were glad to hear the report and praised God. And they talked no more about going to war against them to devastate the country where the Reubenites and the Gadites lived.
chapters.zh: 以色列人以这事为美，就称颂神，不再提上去攻打流便人，迦得人，毁坏他们所住的地了。

chapters.en: And the Reubenites and the Gadites gave the altar this name: A Witness Between Us—that the LORD is God.
chapters.zh: 流便人，迦得人给坛起名叫证坛，意思说，这坛在我们中间证明耶和华是神。

chapters.en: After a long time had passed and the LORD had given Israel rest from all their enemies around them, Joshua, by then a very old man,
chapters.zh: 耶和华使以色列人安静，不与四围的一切仇敌争战，已经多日。约书亚年纪老迈，

chapters.en: summoned all Israel—their elders, leaders, judges and officials—and said to them: “I am very old.
chapters.zh: 就把以色列众人的长老，族长，审判官，并官长都召了来，对他们说，我年纪已经老迈。

chapters.en: You yourselves have seen everything the LORD your God has done to all these nations for your sake; it was the LORD your God who fought for you.
chapters.zh: 耶和华你们的神因你们的缘故向那些国所行的一切事，你们亲眼看见了，因那为你们争战的是耶和华你们的神。

chapters.en: Remember how I have allotted as an inheritance for your tribes all the land of the nations that remain—the nations I conquered—between the Jordan and the Mediterranean Sea in the west.
chapters.zh: 我所剪除和所剩下的各国，从约旦河起到日落之处的大海，我已经拈阄分给你们各支派为业。

chapters.en: The LORD your God himself will push them out for your sake. He will drive them out before you, and you will take possession of their land, as the LORD your God promised you.
chapters.zh: 耶和华你们的神必将他们从你们面前赶出去，使他们离开你们，你们就必得他们的地为业，正如耶和华你们的神所应许的。

chapters.en: “Be very strong; be careful to obey all that is written in the Book of the Law of Moses, without turning aside to the right or to the left.
chapters.zh: 所以，你们要大大壮胆，谨守遵行写在摩西律法书上的一切话，不可偏离左右。

chapters.en: Do not associate with these nations that remain among you; do not invoke the names of their gods or swear by them. You must not serve them or bow down to them.
chapters.zh: 不可与你们中间所剩下的这些国民搀杂。他们的神，你们不可提他的名，不可指着他起誓，也不可事奉，叩拜。

chapters.en: But you are to hold fast to the LORD your God, as you have until now.
chapters.zh: 只要照着你们到今日所行的，专靠耶和华你们的神。

chapters.en: “The LORD has driven out before you great and powerful nations; to this day no one has been able to withstand you.
chapters.zh: 因为耶和华已经把又大又强的国民从你们面前赶出。直到今日，没有一人在你们面前站立得住。

chapters.en: One of you routs a thousand, because the LORD your God fights for you, just as he promised.
chapters.zh: 你们一人必追赶千人，因耶和华你们的神照他所应许的，为你们争战。

chapters.en: So be very careful to love the LORD your God.
chapters.zh: 你们要分外谨慎，爱耶和华你们的神。

chapters.en: “But if you turn away and ally yourselves with the survivors of these nations that remain among you and if you intermarry with them and associate with them,
chapters.zh: 你们若稍微转去，与你们中间所剩下的这些国民联络，彼此结亲，互相往来，

chapters.en: then you may be sure that the LORD your God will no longer drive out these nations before you. Instead, they will become snares and traps for you, whips on your backs and thorns in your eyes, until you perish from this good land, which the LORD your God has given you.
chapters.zh: 你们要确实知道，耶和华你们的神必不再将他们从你们眼前赶出。他们却要成为你们的网罗，机槛，肋上的鞭，眼中的刺，直到你们在耶和华你们神所赐的这美地上灭亡。

chapters.en: “Now I am about to go the way of all the earth. You know with all your heart and soul that not one of all the good promises the LORD your God gave you has failed. Every promise has been fulfilled; not one has failed.
chapters.zh: 我现在要走世人必走的路。你们是一心一意地知道，耶和华你们神所应许赐福与你们的话没有一句落空，都应验在你们身上了。

chapters.en: But just as all the good things the LORD your God has promised you have come to you, so he will bring on you all the evil things he has threatened, until the LORD your God has destroyed you from this good land he has given you.
chapters.zh: 耶和华你们神所应许的一切福气怎样临到你们身上，耶和华也必照样使各样祸患临到你们身上，直到把你们从耶和华你们神所赐的这美地上除灭。

chapters.en: If you violate the covenant of the LORD your God, which he commanded you, and go and serve other gods and bow down to them, the LORD’s anger will burn against you, and you will quickly perish from the good land he has given you.”
chapters.zh: 你们若违背耶和华你们神吩咐你们所守的约，去事奉别神，叩拜他，耶和华的怒气必向你们发作，使你们在他所赐的美地上速速灭亡。

chapters.en: Then Joshua assembled all the tribes of Israel at Shechem. He summoned the elders, leaders, judges and officials of Israel, and they presented themselves before God.
chapters.zh: 约书亚将以色列的众支派聚集在示剑，召了以色列的长老，族长，审判官，并官长来，他们就站在神面前。

chapters.en: Joshua said to all the people, “This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: ‘Long ago your ancestors, including Terah the father of Abraham and Nahor, lived beyond the Euphrates River and worshiped other gods.
chapters.zh: 约书亚对众民说，耶和华以色列的神如此说，古时你们的列祖，就是亚伯拉罕和拿鹤的父亲他拉，住在大河那边事奉别神，

chapters.en: But I took your father Abraham from the land beyond the Euphrates and led him throughout Canaan and gave him many descendants. I gave him Isaac,
chapters.zh: 我将你们的祖宗亚伯拉罕从大河那边带来，领他走遍迦南全地，又使他的子孙众多，把以撒赐给他。

chapters.en: and to Isaac I gave Jacob and Esau. I assigned the hill country of Seir to Esau, but Jacob and his family went down to Egypt.
chapters.zh: 又把雅各和以扫赐给以撒，将西珥山赐给以扫为业。后来雅各和他的子孙下到埃及去了。

chapters.en: “ ‘Then I sent Moses and Aaron, and I afflicted the Egyptians by what I did there, and I brought you out.
chapters.zh: 我差遣摩西，亚伦，并照我在埃及中所行的降灾与埃及，然后把你们领出来。

chapters.en: When I brought your people out of Egypt, you came to the sea, and the Egyptians pursued them with chariots and horsemen as far as the Red Sea.
chapters.zh: 我领你们列祖出埃及，他们就到了红海。埃及人带领车辆马兵追赶你们列祖到红海。

chapters.en: But they cried to the LORD for help, and he put darkness between you and the Egyptians; he brought the sea over them and covered them. You saw with your own eyes what I did to the Egyptians. Then you lived in the wilderness for a long time.
chapters.zh: 你们列祖哀求耶和华，他就使你们和埃及人中间黑暗了，又使海水淹没埃及人。我在埃及所行的事，你们亲眼见过。你们在旷野也住了许多年日。

chapters.en: “ ‘I brought you to the land of the Amorites who lived east of the Jordan. They fought against you, but I gave them into your hands. I destroyed them from before you, and you took possession of their land.
chapters.zh: 我领你们到约旦河东亚摩利人所住之地。他们与你们争战，我将他们交在你们手中，你们便得了他们的地为业。我也在你们面前将他们灭绝。

chapters.en: When Balak son of Zippor, the king of Moab, prepared to fight against Israel, he sent for Balaam son of Beor to put a curse on you.
chapters.zh: 那时，摩押王西拨的儿子巴勒起来攻击以色列人，打发人召了比珥的儿子巴兰来咒诅你们。

chapters.en: But I would not listen to Balaam, so he blessed you again and again, and I delivered you out of his hand.
chapters.zh: 我不肯听巴兰的话，所以他倒为你们连连祝福。这样，我便救你们脱离巴勒的手。

chapters.en: “ ‘Then you crossed the Jordan and came to Jericho. The citizens of Jericho fought against you, as did also the Amorites, Perizzites, Canaanites, Hittites, Girgashites, Hivites and Jebusites, but I gave them into your hands.
chapters.zh: 你们过了约旦河，到了耶利哥。耶利哥人，亚摩利人，比利洗人，迦南人，赫人，革迦撒人，希未人，耶布斯人都与你们争战。我把他们交在你们手里。

chapters.en: I sent the hornet ahead of you, which drove them out before you—also the two Amorite kings. You did not do it with your own sword and bow.
chapters.zh: 我打发黄蜂飞在你们前面，将亚摩利人的二王从你们面前撵出，并不是用你的刀，也不是用你的弓。

chapters.en: So I gave you a land on which you did not toil and cities you did not build; and you live in them and eat from vineyards and olive groves that you did not plant.’
chapters.zh: 我赐给你们地土，非你们所修治的。我赐给你们城邑，非你们所建造的。你们就住在其中，又得吃非你们所栽种的葡萄园，橄榄园的果子。

chapters.en: “Now fear the LORD and serve him with all faithfulness. Throw away the gods your ancestors worshiped beyond the Euphrates River and in Egypt, and serve the LORD.
chapters.zh: 现在你们要敬畏耶和华，诚心实意地事奉他，将你们列祖在大河那边和在埃及所事奉的神除掉，去事奉耶和华。

chapters.en: But if serving the LORD seems undesirable to you, then choose for yourselves this day whom you will serve, whether the gods your ancestors served beyond the Euphrates, or the gods of the Amorites, in whose land you are living. But as for me and my household, we will serve the LORD.”
chapters.zh: 若是你们以事奉耶和华为不好，今日就可以选择所要事奉的，是你们列祖在大河那边所事奉的神呢？是你们所住这地的亚摩利人的神呢？至于我和我家，我们必定事奉耶和华。

chapters.en: Then the people answered, “Far be it from us to forsake the LORD to serve other gods!
chapters.zh: 百姓回答说，我们断不敢离弃耶和华去事奉别神。

chapters.en: It was the LORD our God himself who brought us and our parents up out of Egypt, from that land of slavery, and performed those great signs before our eyes. He protected us on our entire journey and among all the nations through which we traveled.
chapters.zh: 因耶和华我们的神曾将我们和我们列祖从埃及地的为奴之家领出来，在我们眼前行了那些大神迹，在我们所行的道上，所经过的诸国，都保护了我们。

chapters.en: And the LORD drove out before us all the nations, including the Amorites, who lived in the land. We too will serve the LORD, because he is our God.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华又把住此地的亚摩利人都从我们面前赶出去。所以，我们必事奉耶和华，因为他是我们的神。

chapters.en: Joshua said to the people, “You are not able to serve the LORD. He is a holy God; he is a jealous God. He will not forgive your rebellion and your sins.
chapters.zh: 约书亚对百姓说，你们不能事奉耶和华。因为他是圣洁的神，是忌邪的神，必不赦免你们的过犯罪恶。

chapters.en: If you forsake the LORD and serve foreign gods, he will turn and bring disaster on you and make an end of you, after he has been good to you.”
chapters.zh: 你们若离弃耶和华去事奉外邦神，耶和华在降福之后，必转而降祸与你们，把你们灭绝。

chapters.en: But the people said to Joshua, “No! We will serve the LORD.”
chapters.zh: 百姓回答约书亚说，不然，我们定要事奉耶和华。

chapters.en: Then Joshua said, “You are witnesses against yourselves that you have chosen to serve the LORD.” “Yes, we are witnesses,” they replied.
chapters.zh: 约书亚对百姓说，你们选定耶和华，要事奉他，你们自己作见证吧。他们说，我们愿意作见证。

chapters.en: “Now then,” said Joshua, “throw away the foreign gods that are among you and yield your hearts to the LORD, the God of Israel.”
chapters.zh: 约书亚说，你们现在要除掉你们中间的外邦神，专心归向耶和华以色列的神。

chapters.en: And the people said to Joshua, “We will serve the LORD our God and obey him.”
chapters.zh: 百姓回答约书亚说，我们必事奉耶和华我们的神，听从他的话。

chapters.en: On that day Joshua made a covenant for the people, and there at Shechem he reaffirmed for them decrees and laws.
chapters.zh: 当日，约书亚就与百姓立约，在示剑为他们立定律例典章。

chapters.en: And Joshua recorded these things in the Book of the Law of God. Then he took a large stone and set it up there under the oak near the holy place of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 约书亚将这些话都写在神的律法书上，又将一块大石头立在橡树下耶和华的圣所旁边。

chapters.en: “See!” he said to all the people. “This stone will be a witness against us. It has heard all the words the LORD has said to us. It will be a witness against you if you are untrue to your God.”
chapters.zh: 约书亚对百姓说，看哪，这石头可以向我们作见证。因为是听见了耶和华所吩咐我们的一切话，倘或你们背弃你们的神，这石头就可以向你们作见证（倘或云云或作所以要向你们作见证，免得你们背弃耶和华你们的神）。

chapters.en: Then Joshua dismissed the people, each to their own inheritance.
chapters.zh: 于是约书亚打发百姓各归自己的地业去了。

chapters.en: After these things, Joshua son of Nun, the servant of the LORD, died at the age of a hundred and ten.
chapters.zh: 这些事以后，耶和华的仆人嫩的儿子约书亚，正一百一十岁，就死了。

chapters.en: And they buried him in the land of his inheritance, at Timnath Serah in the hill country of Ephraim, north of Mount Gaash.
chapters.zh: 以色列人将他葬在他地业的境内，就是在以法莲山地的亭拿西拉，在迦实山的北边。

chapters.en: Israel served the LORD throughout the lifetime of Joshua and of the elders who outlived him and who had experienced everything the LORD had done for Israel.
chapters.zh: 约书亚在世和约书亚死后，那些知道耶和华为以色列人所行诸事的长老还在的时候，以色列人事奉耶和华。

chapters.en: And Joseph’s bones, which the Israelites had brought up from Egypt, were buried at Shechem in the tract of land that Jacob bought for a hundred pieces of silver from the sons of Hamor, the father of Shechem. This became the inheritance of Joseph’s descendants.
chapters.zh: 以色列人从埃及所带来约瑟的骸骨，葬埋在示剑，就是在雅各从前用一百块银子向示剑的父亲，哈抹的子孙所买的那块地里。这就作了约瑟子孙的产业。

chapters.en: And Eleazar son of Aaron died and was buried at Gibeah, which had been allotted to his son Phinehas in the hill country of Ephraim.
chapters.zh: 亚伦的儿子以利亚撒也死了，就把他葬在他儿子非尼哈，以法莲山地所得的小山上。

chapters.en: After the death of Joshua, the Israelites asked the LORD, “Who of us is to go up first to fight against the Canaanites?”
chapters.zh: 约书亚死后，以色列人求问耶和华说，我们中间谁当首先上去攻击迦南人，与他们争战。

chapters.en: The LORD answered, “Judah shall go up; I have given the land into their hands.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华说，犹大当先上去，我已将那地交在他手中。

chapters.en: The men of Judah then said to the Simeonites their fellow Israelites, “Come up with us into the territory allotted to us, to fight against the Canaanites. We in turn will go with you into yours.” So the Simeonites went with them.
chapters.zh: 犹大对他哥哥西缅说，请你同我到拈阄所得之地去，好与迦南人争战。以后我也同你到你拈阄所得之地去。于是西缅与他同去。

chapters.en: When Judah attacked, the LORD gave the Canaanites and Perizzites into their hands, and they struck down ten thousand men at Bezek.
chapters.zh: 犹大就上去，耶和华将迦南人和比利洗人交在他们手中。他们在比色击杀了一万人。

chapters.en: It was there that they found Adoni-Bezek and fought against him, putting to rout the Canaanites and Perizzites.
chapters.zh: 又在那里遇见亚多尼比色，与他争战，杀败迦南人和比利洗人。

chapters.en: Adoni-Bezek fled, but they chased him and caught him, and cut off his thumbs and big toes.
chapters.zh: 亚多尼比色逃跑。他们追赶，拿住他，砍断他手脚的大姆指。

chapters.en: Then Adoni-Bezek said, “Seventy kings with their thumbs and big toes cut off have picked up scraps under my table. Now God has paid me back for what I did to them.” They brought him to Jerusalem, and he died there.
chapters.zh: 亚多尼比色说，从前有七十个王，手脚的大姆指都被我砍断，在我桌子底下拾取零碎食物。现在神按着我所行的报应我了。于是他们将亚多尼比色带到耶路撒冷，他就死在那里。

chapters.en: The men of Judah attacked Jerusalem also and took it. They put the city to the sword and set it on fire.
chapters.zh: 犹大人攻打耶路撒冷，将城攻取，用刀杀了城内的人，并且放火烧城。

chapters.en: After that, Judah went down to fight against the Canaanites living in the hill country, the Negev and the western foothills.
chapters.zh: 后来犹大人下去，与住山地，南地，和高原的迦南人争战。

chapters.en: They advanced against the Canaanites living in Hebron (formerly called Kiriath Arba) and defeated Sheshai, Ahiman and Talmai.
chapters.zh: 犹大人去攻击住希伯仑的迦南人，杀了示筛，亚希幔，挞买。希伯仑从前名叫基列亚巴。

chapters.en: From there they advanced against the people living in Debir (formerly called Kiriath Sepher).
chapters.zh: 他们从那里去攻击底璧的居民。底璧从前名叫基列西弗。

chapters.en: And Caleb said, “I will give my daughter Aksah in marriage to the man who attacks and captures Kiriath Sepher.”
chapters.zh: 迦勒说，谁能攻打基列西弗，将城夺取，我就把我女儿押撒给他为妻。

chapters.en: Othniel son of Kenaz, Caleb’s younger brother, took it; so Caleb gave his daughter Aksah to him in marriage.
chapters.zh: 迦勒兄弟基纳斯的儿子俄陀聂夺取了那城，迦勒就把女儿押撒给他为妻。

chapters.en: One day when she came to Othniel, she urged him to ask her father for a field. When she got off her donkey, Caleb asked her, “What can I do for you?”
chapters.zh: 押撒过门的时候，劝丈夫向她父亲求一块田。押撒一下驴，迦勒问她说，你要什么。

chapters.en: She replied, “Do me a special favor. Since you have given me land in the Negev, give me also springs of water.” So Caleb gave her the upper and lower springs.
chapters.zh: 她说，求你赐福给我，你既将我安置在南地，求你也给我水泉。迦勒就把上泉下泉赐给她。

chapters.en: The descendants of Moses’ father-in-law, the Kenite, went up from the City of Palms with the people of Judah to live among the inhabitants of the Desert of Judah in the Negev near Arad.
chapters.zh: 摩西的内兄（或作岳父）是基尼人，他的子孙与犹大人一同离了棕树城，往亚拉得以南的犹大旷野去，就住在民中。

chapters.en: Then the men of Judah went with the Simeonites their fellow Israelites and attacked the Canaanites living in Zephath, and they totally destroyed the city. Therefore it was called Hormah.
chapters.zh: 犹大和他哥哥西缅同去，击杀了住洗法的迦南人，将城尽行毁灭，那城的名便叫何珥玛。

chapters.en: Judah also took Gaza, Ashkelon and Ekron—each city with its territory.
chapters.zh: 犹大又取了迦萨和迦萨的四境，亚实基伦和亚实基伦的四境，以革伦和以革伦的四境。

chapters.en: The LORD was with the men of Judah. They took possession of the hill country, but they were unable to drive the people from the plains, because they had chariots fitted with iron.
chapters.zh: 耶和华与犹大同在，犹大就赶出山地的居民，只是不能赶出平原的居民，因为他们有铁车。

chapters.en: As Moses had promised, Hebron was given to Caleb, who drove from it the three sons of Anak.
chapters.zh: 以色列人照摩西所说的，将希伯仑给了迦勒。迦勒就从那里赶出亚衲族的三个族长。

chapters.en: The Benjamites, however, did not drive out the Jebusites, who were living in Jerusalem; to this day the Jebusites live there with the Benjamites.
chapters.zh: 便雅悯人没有赶出住耶路撒冷的耶布斯人。耶布斯人仍在耶路撒冷与便雅悯人同住，直到今日。

chapters.en: Now the tribes of Joseph attacked Bethel, and the LORD was with them.
chapters.zh: 约瑟家也上去攻打伯特利。耶和华与他们同在。

chapters.en: When they sent men to spy out Bethel (formerly called Luz),
chapters.zh: 约瑟家打发人去窥探伯特利。那城起先名叫路斯。

chapters.en: the spies saw a man coming out of the city and they said to him, “Show us how to get into the city and we will see that you are treated well.”
chapters.zh: 窥探的人看见一个人从城里出来，就对他说，求你将进城的路指示我们，我们必恩待你。

chapters.en: So he showed them, and they put the city to the sword but spared the man and his whole family.
chapters.zh: 那人将进城的路指示他们，他们就用刀击杀了城中的居民，但将那人和他全家放去。

chapters.en: He then went to the land of the Hittites, where he built a city and called it Luz, which is its name to this day.
chapters.zh: 那人往赫人之地去，筑了一座城，起名叫路斯。那城到如今还叫这名。

chapters.en: But Manasseh did not drive out the people of Beth Shan or Taanach or Dor or Ibleam or Megiddo and their surrounding settlements, for the Canaanites were determined to live in that land.
chapters.zh: 玛拿西没有赶出伯善和属伯善乡村的居民，他纳和属他纳乡村的居民，多珥和属多珥乡村的居民，以伯莲和属以伯莲乡村的居民，米吉多和属米吉多乡村的居民。迦南人却执意住在那些地方。

chapters.en: When Israel became strong, they pressed the Canaanites into forced labor but never drove them out completely.
chapters.zh: 及至以色列强盛了，就使迦南人作苦工，没有把他们全然赶出。

chapters.en: Nor did Ephraim drive out the Canaanites living in Gezer, but the Canaanites continued to live there among them.
chapters.zh: 以法莲没有赶出住基色的迦南人。于是迦南人仍住在基色，在以法莲中间。

chapters.en: Neither did Zebulun drive out the Canaanites living in Kitron or Nahalol, so these Canaanites lived among them, but Zebulun did subject them to forced labor.
chapters.zh: 西布伦没有赶出基伦的居民和拿哈拉的居民。于是迦南人仍住在西布伦中间，成了服苦的人。

chapters.en: Nor did Asher drive out those living in Akko or Sidon or Ahlab or Akzib or Helbah or Aphek or Rehob.
chapters.zh: 亚设没有赶出亚柯和西顿的居民，亚黑拉和亚革悉的居民，黑巴，亚弗革与利合的居民。

chapters.en: The Asherites lived among the Canaanite inhabitants of the land because they did not drive them out.
chapters.zh: 于是，亚设因为没有赶出那地的迦南人，就住在他们中间。

chapters.en: Neither did Naphtali drive out those living in Beth Shemesh or Beth Anath; but the Naphtalites too lived among the Canaanite inhabitants of the land, and those living in Beth Shemesh and Beth Anath became forced laborers for them.
chapters.zh: 拿弗他利没有赶出伯示麦和伯亚纳的居民，于是拿弗他利就住在那地的迦南人中间。然而伯示麦和伯亚纳的居民成了服苦的人。

chapters.en: The Amorites confined the Danites to the hill country, not allowing them to come down into the plain.
chapters.zh: 亚摩利人强逼但人住在山地，不容他们下到平原。

chapters.en: And the Amorites were determined also to hold out in Mount Heres, Aijalon and Shaalbim, but when the power of the tribes of Joseph increased, they too were pressed into forced labor.
chapters.zh: 亚摩利人却执意住在希烈山和亚雅伦并沙宾。然而约瑟家胜了他们，使他们成了服苦的人。

chapters.en: The boundary of the Amorites was from Scorpion Pass to Sela and beyond.
chapters.zh: 亚摩利人的境界，是从亚克拉滨坡，从西拉而上。

chapters.en: The angel of the LORD went up from Gilgal to Bokim and said, “I brought you up out of Egypt and led you into the land I swore to give to your ancestors. I said, ‘I will never break my covenant with you,
chapters.zh: 耶和华的使者从吉甲上到波金，对以色列人说，我使你们从埃及上来，领你们到我向你们列祖起誓应许之地。我又说，我永不废弃与你们所立的约。

chapters.en: and you shall not make a covenant with the people of this land, but you shall break down their altars.’ Yet you have disobeyed me. Why have you done this?
chapters.zh: 你们也不可与这地的居民立约，要拆毁他们的祭坛。你们竟没有听从我的话。为何这样行呢？

chapters.en: And I have also said, ‘I will not drive them out before you; they will become traps for you, and their gods will become snares to you.’ ”
chapters.zh: 因此我又说，我必不将他们从你们面前赶出。他们必作你们肋下的荆棘。他们的神必作你们的网罗。

chapters.en: When the angel of the LORD had spoken these things to all the Israelites, the people wept aloud,
chapters.zh: 耶和华的使者向以色列众人说这话的时候，百姓就放声而哭。

chapters.en: and they called that place Bokim. There they offered sacrifices to the LORD.
chapters.zh: 于是给那地方起名叫波金（就是哭的意思）。众人在那里向耶和华献祭。

chapters.en: After Joshua had dismissed the Israelites, they went to take possession of the land, each to their own inheritance.
chapters.zh: 从前约书亚打发以色列百姓去的时候，他们各归自己的地业，占据地土。

chapters.en: The people served the LORD throughout the lifetime of Joshua and of the elders who outlived him and who had seen all the great things the LORD had done for Israel.
chapters.zh: 约书亚在世和约书亚死后，那些见耶和华为以色列人所行大事的长老还在的时候，百姓都事奉耶和华。

chapters.en: Joshua son of Nun, the servant of the LORD, died at the age of a hundred and ten.
chapters.zh: 耶和华的仆人，嫩的儿子约书亚，正一百一十岁就死了。

chapters.en: And they buried him in the land of his inheritance, at Timnath Heres in the hill country of Ephraim, north of Mount Gaash.
chapters.zh: 以色列人将他葬在他地业的境内，就是在以法莲山地的亭拿希烈，在迦实山的北边。

chapters.en: After that whole generation had been gathered to their ancestors, another generation grew up who knew neither the LORD nor what he had done for Israel.
chapters.zh: 那世代的人也都归了自己的列祖。后来有别的世代兴起，不知道耶和华，也不知道耶和华为以色列人所行的事。

chapters.en: Then the Israelites did evil in the eyes of the LORD and served the Baals.
chapters.zh: 以色列人行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，去事奉诸巴力，

chapters.en: They forsook the LORD, the God of their ancestors, who had brought them out of Egypt. They followed and worshiped various gods of the peoples around them. They aroused the LORD’s anger
chapters.zh: 离弃了领他们出埃及地的耶和华他们列祖的神，去叩拜别神，就是四围列国的神，惹耶和华发怒。

chapters.en: because they forsook him and served Baal and the Ashtoreths.
chapters.zh: 并离弃耶和华，去事奉巴力和亚斯他录。

chapters.en: In his anger against Israel the LORD gave them into the hands of raiders who plundered them. He sold them into the hands of their enemies all around, whom they were no longer able to resist.
chapters.zh: 耶和华的怒气向以色列人发作，就把他们交在抢夺他们的人手中，又将他们付与四围仇敌的手中，甚至他们在仇敌面前再不能站立得住。

chapters.en: Whenever Israel went out to fight, the hand of the LORD was against them to defeat them, just as he had sworn to them. They were in great distress.
chapters.zh: 他们无论往何处去，耶和华都以灾祸攻击他们，正如耶和华所说的话，又如耶和华向他们所起的誓。他们便极其困苦。

chapters.en: Then the LORD raised up judges, who saved them out of the hands of these raiders.
chapters.zh: 耶和华兴起士师，士师就拯救他们脱离抢夺他们人的手。

chapters.en: Yet they would not listen to their judges but prostituted themselves to other gods and worshiped them. They quickly turned from the ways of their ancestors, who had been obedient to the LORD’s commands.
chapters.zh: 他们却不听从士师，竟随从叩拜别神，行了邪淫，速速地偏离他们列祖所行的道，不如他们列祖顺从耶和华的命令。

chapters.en: Whenever the LORD raised up a judge for them, he was with the judge and saved them out of the hands of their enemies as long as the judge lived; for the LORD relented because of their groaning under those who oppressed and afflicted them.
chapters.zh: 耶和华为他们兴起士师，就与那士师同在。士师在世的一切日子，耶和华拯救他们脱离仇敌的手。他们因受欺压扰害，就哀声叹气，所以耶和华后悔了。

chapters.en: But when the judge died, the people returned to ways even more corrupt than those of their ancestors, following other gods and serving and worshiping them. They refused to give up their evil practices and stubborn ways.
chapters.zh: 及至士师死后，他们就转去行恶，比他们列祖更甚，去事奉叩拜别神，总不断绝顽梗的恶行。

chapters.en: Therefore the LORD was very angry with Israel and said, “Because this nation has violated the covenant I ordained for their ancestors and has not listened to me,
chapters.zh: 于是耶和华的怒气向以色列人发作。他说，因这民违背我吩咐他们列祖所守的约，不听从我的话，

chapters.en: I will no longer drive out before them any of the nations Joshua left when he died.
chapters.zh: 所以约书亚死的时候所剩下的各族，我必不再从他们面前赶出，

chapters.en: I will use them to test Israel and see whether they will keep the way of the LORD and walk in it as their ancestors did.”
chapters.zh: 为要借此试验以色列人，看他们肯照他们列祖谨守遵行我的道不肯。

chapters.en: The LORD had allowed those nations to remain; he did not drive them out at once by giving them into the hands of Joshua.
chapters.zh: 这样耶和华留下各族，不将他们速速赶出，也没有交付约书亚的手。

chapters.en: These are the nations the LORD left to test all those Israelites who had not experienced any of the wars in Canaan
chapters.zh: 耶和华留下这几族，为要试验那不曾知道与迦南争战之事的以色列人，

chapters.en: (he did this only to teach warfare to the descendants of the Israelites who had not had previous battle experience):
chapters.zh: 好叫以色列的后代又知道又学习未曾晓得的战事。

chapters.en: the five rulers of the Philistines, all the Canaanites, the Sidonians, and the Hivites living in the Lebanon mountains from Mount Baal Hermon to Lebo Hamath.
chapters.zh: 所留下的就是非利士的五个首领和一切迦南人，西顿人，并住利巴嫩山的希未人，从巴力黑们山直到哈马口。

chapters.en: They were left to test the Israelites to see whether they would obey the LORD’s commands, which he had given their ancestors through Moses.
chapters.zh: 留下这几族，为要试验以色列人，知道他们肯听从耶和华借摩西吩咐他们列祖的诫命不肯。

chapters.en: The Israelites lived among the Canaanites, Hittites, Amorites, Perizzites, Hivites and Jebusites.
chapters.zh: 以色列人竟住在迦南人，赫人，亚摩利人，比利洗人，希未人，耶布斯人中间，

chapters.en: They took their daughters in marriage and gave their own daughters to their sons, and served their gods.
chapters.zh: 娶他们的女儿为妻，将自己的女儿嫁给他们的儿子，并事奉他们的神。

chapters.en: The Israelites did evil in the eyes of the LORD; they forgot the LORD their God and served the Baals and the Asherahs.
chapters.zh: 以色列人行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，忘记耶和华他们的神，去事奉诸巴力和亚舍拉，

chapters.en: The anger of the LORD burned against Israel so that he sold them into the hands of Cushan-Rishathaim king of Aram Naharaim, to whom the Israelites were subject for eight years.
chapters.zh: 所以耶和华的怒气向以色列人发作，就把他们交在米所波大米王古珊利萨田的手中。以色列人服事古珊利萨田八年。

chapters.en: But when they cried out to the LORD, he raised up for them a deliverer, Othniel son of Kenaz, Caleb’s younger brother, who saved them.
chapters.zh: 以色列人呼求耶和华的时候，耶和华就为他们兴起一位拯救者救他们，就是迦勒兄弟基纳斯的儿子俄陀聂。

chapters.en: The Spirit of the LORD came on him, so that he became Israel’s judge and went to war. The LORD gave Cushan-Rishathaim king of Aram into the hands of Othniel, who overpowered him.
chapters.zh: 耶和华的灵降在他身上，他就作了以色列的士师，出去争战。耶和华将米所波大米王古珊利萨田交在他手中，他便胜了古珊利萨田。

chapters.en: So the land had peace for forty years, until Othniel son of Kenaz died.
chapters.zh: 于是国中太平四十年。基纳斯的儿子俄陀聂死了。

chapters.en: Again the Israelites did evil in the eyes of the LORD, and because they did this evil the LORD gave Eglon king of Moab power over Israel.
chapters.zh: 以色列人又行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，耶和华就使摩押王伊矶伦强盛，攻击以色列人。

chapters.en: Getting the Ammonites and Amalekites to join him, Eglon came and attacked Israel, and they took possession of the City of Palms.
chapters.zh: 伊矶伦招聚亚扪人和亚玛力人，去攻打以色列人，占据棕树城。

chapters.en: The Israelites were subject to Eglon king of Moab for eighteen years.
chapters.zh: 于是以色列人服事摩押王伊矶伦十八年。

chapters.en: Again the Israelites cried out to the LORD, and he gave them a deliverer—Ehud, a left-handed man, the son of Gera the Benjamite. The Israelites sent him with tribute to Eglon king of Moab.
chapters.zh: 以色列人呼求耶和华的时候，耶和华就为他们兴起一位拯救者，就是便雅悯人基拉的儿子以笏。他是左手便利的。以色列人托他送礼物给摩押王伊矶伦。

chapters.en: Now Ehud had made a double-edged sword about a cubit long, which he strapped to his right thigh under his clothing.
chapters.zh: 以笏打了一把两刃的剑，长一肘，带在右腿上衣服里面。

chapters.en: He presented the tribute to Eglon king of Moab, who was a very fat man.
chapters.zh: 他将礼物献给摩押王伊矶伦，原来伊矶伦极其肥胖。

chapters.en: After Ehud had presented the tribute, he sent on their way those who had carried it.
chapters.zh: 以笏献完礼物，便将抬礼物的人打发走了，

chapters.en: But on reaching the stone images near Gilgal he himself went back to Eglon and said, “Your Majesty, I have a secret message for you.” The king said to his attendants, “Leave us!” And they all left.
chapters.zh: 自己却从靠近吉甲凿石之地回来，说，王阿，我有一件机密事奏告你。王说，回避吧。于是左右侍立的人都退去了。

chapters.en: Ehud then approached him while he was sitting alone in the upper room of his palace and said, “I have a message from God for you.” As the king rose from his seat,
chapters.zh: 以笏来到王面前。王独自一人坐在凉楼上。以笏说，我奉神的命报告你一件事。王就从座位上站起来。

chapters.en: Ehud reached with his left hand, drew the sword from his right thigh and plunged it into the king’s belly.
chapters.zh: 以笏便伸左手，从右腿上拔出剑来，刺入王的肚腹，

chapters.en: Even the handle sank in after the blade, and his bowels discharged. Ehud did not pull the sword out, and the fat closed in over it.
chapters.zh: 连剑把都刺进去了。剑被肥肉夹住，他没有从王的肚腹拔出来，且穿通了后身。

chapters.en: Then Ehud went out to the porch ; he shut the doors of the upper room behind him and locked them.
chapters.zh: 以笏就出到游廊，将楼门尽都关锁。

chapters.en: After he had gone, the servants came and found the doors of the upper room locked. They said, “He must be relieving himself in the inner room of the palace.”
chapters.zh: 以笏出来之后，王的仆人到了，看见楼门关锁，就说，他必是在楼上大解。

chapters.en: They waited to the point of embarrassment, but when he did not open the doors of the room, they took a key and unlocked them. There they saw their lord fallen to the floor, dead.
chapters.zh: 他们等烦了，见仍不开楼门，就拿钥匙开了，不料，他们的主人已死，倒在地上。

chapters.en: While they waited, Ehud got away. He passed by the stone images and escaped to Seirah.
chapters.zh: 他们耽延的时候，以笏就逃跑了，经过凿石之地，逃到西伊拉。

chapters.en: When he arrived there, he blew a trumpet in the hill country of Ephraim, and the Israelites went down with him from the hills, with him leading them.
chapters.zh: 到了，就在以法莲山地吹角。以色列人随着他下了山地，他在前头引路，

chapters.en: “Follow me,” he ordered, “for the LORD has given Moab, your enemy, into your hands.” So they followed him down and took possession of the fords of the Jordan that led to Moab; they allowed no one to cross over.
chapters.zh: 对他们说，你们随我来，因为耶和华已经把你们的仇敌摩押人交在你们手中。于是他们跟着他下去，把守约旦河的渡口，不容摩押一人过去。

chapters.en: At that time they struck down about ten thousand Moabites, all vigorous and strong; not one escaped.
chapters.zh: 那时击杀了摩押人约有一万，都是强壮的勇士，没有一人逃脱。

chapters.en: That day Moab was made subject to Israel, and the land had peace for eighty years.
chapters.zh: 这样，摩押就被以色列人制伏了。国中太平八十年。

chapters.en: After Ehud came Shamgar son of Anath, who struck down six hundred Philistines with an oxgoad. He too saved Israel.
chapters.zh: 以笏之后，有亚拿的儿子珊迦，他用赶牛的棍子打死六百非利士人。他也救了以色列人。

chapters.en: Again the Israelites did evil in the eyes of the LORD, now that Ehud was dead.
chapters.zh: 以笏死后，以色列人又行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，

chapters.en: So the LORD sold them into the hands of Jabin king of Canaan, who reigned in Hazor. Sisera, the commander of his army, was based in Harosheth Haggoyim.
chapters.zh: 耶和华就把他们付与在夏琐作王的迦南王耶宾手中。他的将军是西西拉，住在外邦人的夏罗设。

chapters.en: Because he had nine hundred chariots fitted with iron and had cruelly oppressed the Israelites for twenty years, they cried to the LORD for help.
chapters.zh: 耶宾王有铁车九百辆。他大大欺压以色列人二十年，以色列人就呼求耶和华。

chapters.en: Now Deborah, a prophet, the wife of Lappidoth, was leading Israel at that time.
chapters.zh: 有一位女先知名叫底波拉，是拉比多的妻，当时作以色列的士师。

chapters.en: She held court under the Palm of Deborah between Ramah and Bethel in the hill country of Ephraim, and the Israelites went up to her to have their disputes decided.
chapters.zh: 她住在以法莲山地拉玛和伯特利中间，在底波拉的棕树下。以色列人都上她那里去听判断。

chapters.en: She sent for Barak son of Abinoam from Kedesh in Naphtali and said to him, “The LORD, the God of Israel, commands you: ‘Go, take with you ten thousand men of Naphtali and Zebulun and lead them up to Mount Tabor.
chapters.zh: 她打发人从拿弗他利的基低斯将亚比挪庵的儿子巴拉召了来，对他说，耶和华以色列的神吩咐你说，你率领一万拿弗他利和西布伦人上他泊山去。

chapters.en: I will lead Sisera, the commander of Jabin’s army, with his chariots and his troops to the Kishon River and give him into your hands.’ ”
chapters.zh: 我必使耶宾的将军西西拉率领他的车辆和全军往基顺河，到你那里去。我必将他交在你手中。

chapters.en: Barak said to her, “If you go with me, I will go; but if you don’t go with me, I won’t go.”
chapters.zh: 巴拉说，你若同我去，我就去。你若不同我去，我就不去。

chapters.en: “Certainly I will go with you,” said Deborah. “But because of the course you are taking, the honor will not be yours, for the LORD will deliver Sisera into the hands of a woman.” So Deborah went with Barak to Kedesh.
chapters.zh: 底波拉说，我必与你同去，只是你在所行的路上得不着荣耀，因为耶和华要将西西拉交在一个妇人手里。于是底波拉起来，与巴拉一同往基低斯去了。

chapters.en: There Barak summoned Zebulun and Naphtali, and ten thousand men went up under his command. Deborah also went up with him.
chapters.zh: 巴拉就招聚西布伦人和拿弗他利人到基低斯，跟他上去的有一万人。底波拉也同他上去。

chapters.en: Now Heber the Kenite had left the other Kenites, the descendants of Hobab, Moses’ brother-in-law, and pitched his tent by the great tree in Zaanannim near Kedesh.
chapters.zh: 摩西岳父（或作内兄）何巴的后裔，基尼人希百曾离开基尼族，到靠近基低斯撒拿音的橡树旁支搭帐棚。

chapters.en: When they told Sisera that Barak son of Abinoam had gone up to Mount Tabor,
chapters.zh: 有人告诉西西拉说，亚比挪庵的儿子巴拉已经上他泊山了。

chapters.en: Sisera summoned from Harosheth Haggoyim to the Kishon River all his men and his nine hundred chariots fitted with iron.
chapters.zh: 西西拉就聚集所有的铁车九百辆和跟随他的全军，从外邦人的夏罗设出来，到了基顺河。

chapters.en: Then Deborah said to Barak, “Go! This is the day the LORD has given Sisera into your hands. Has not the LORD gone ahead of you?” So Barak went down Mount Tabor, with ten thousand men following him.
chapters.zh: 底波拉对巴拉说，你起来，今日就是耶和华将西西拉交在你手的日子。耶和华岂不在你前头行吗？于是巴拉下了他泊山，跟随他有一万人。

chapters.en: At Barak’s advance, the LORD routed Sisera and all his chariots and army by the sword, and Sisera got down from his chariot and fled on foot.
chapters.zh: 耶和华使西西拉和他一切车辆全军溃乱，在巴拉面前被刀杀败。西西拉下车步行逃跑。

chapters.en: Barak pursued the chariots and army as far as Harosheth Haggoyim, and all Sisera’s troops fell by the sword; not a man was left.
chapters.zh: 巴拉追赶车辆，军队，直到外邦人的夏罗设。西西拉的全军都倒在刀下，没有留下一人。

chapters.en: Sisera, meanwhile, fled on foot to the tent of Jael, the wife of Heber the Kenite, because there was an alliance between Jabin king of Hazor and the family of Heber the Kenite.
chapters.zh: 只有西西拉步行逃跑，到了基尼人希百之妻雅亿的帐棚，因为夏琐王耶宾与基尼人希百家和好。

chapters.en: Jael went out to meet Sisera and said to him, “Come, my lord, come right in. Don’t be afraid.” So he entered her tent, and she covered him with a blanket.
chapters.zh: 雅亿出来迎接西西拉，对他说，请我主进来，不要惧怕。西西拉就进了她的帐棚。雅亿用被将他遮盖。

chapters.en: “I’m thirsty,” he said. “Please give me some water.” She opened a skin of milk, gave him a drink, and covered him up.
chapters.zh: 西西拉对雅亿说，我渴了，求你给我一点水喝。雅亿就打开皮袋，给他奶子喝，仍旧把他遮盖。

chapters.en: “Stand in the doorway of the tent,” he told her. “If someone comes by and asks you, ‘Is anyone in there?’ say ‘No.’ ”
chapters.zh: 西西拉又对雅亿说，请你站在帐棚门口，若有人来问你说，有人在这里没有。你就说，没有。

chapters.en: But Jael, Heber’s wife, picked up a tent peg and a hammer and went quietly to him while he lay fast asleep, exhausted. She drove the peg through his temple into the ground, and he died.
chapters.zh: 西西拉疲乏沉睡。希百的妻雅亿取了帐棚的橛子，手里拿着锤子，轻悄悄地到他旁边，将橛子从他鬓边钉进去，钉入地里。西西拉就死了。

chapters.en: Just then Barak came by in pursuit of Sisera, and Jael went out to meet him. “Come,” she said, “I will show you the man you’re looking for.” So he went in with her, and there lay Sisera with the tent peg through his temple—dead.
chapters.zh: 巴拉追赶西西拉的时候，雅亿出来迎接他说，来吧，我将你所寻找的人给你看。他就进入帐棚，看见西西拉已经死了，倒在地上，橛子还在他鬓中。

chapters.en: On that day God subdued Jabin king of Canaan before the Israelites.
chapters.zh: 这样，神使迦南王耶宾被以色列人制伏了。

chapters.en: And the hand of the Israelites pressed harder and harder against Jabin king of Canaan until they destroyed him.
chapters.zh: 从此以色列人的手越发有力，胜了迦南王耶宾，直到将他灭绝了。

chapters.en: On that day Deborah and Barak son of Abinoam sang this song:
chapters.zh: 那时，底波拉和亚比挪庵的儿子巴拉作歌，说，

chapters.en: “When the princes in Israel take the lead, when the people willingly offer themselves— praise the LORD!
chapters.zh: 因为以色列中有军长率领，百姓也甘心牺牲自己，你们应当颂赞耶和华。

chapters.en: “Hear this, you kings! Listen, you rulers! I, even I, will sing to the LORD; I will praise the LORD, the God of Israel, in song.
chapters.zh: 君王阿，要听。王子阿，要侧耳而听。我要向耶和华歌唱，我要歌颂耶和华以色列的神。

chapters.en: “When you, LORD, went out from Seir, when you marched from the land of Edom, the earth shook, the heavens poured, the clouds poured down water.
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，你从西珥出来，由以东地行走。那时地震天漏，云也落雨。

chapters.en: The mountains quaked before the LORD, the One of Sinai, before the LORD, the God of Israel.
chapters.zh: 山见耶和华的面就震动，西乃山见耶和华以色列神的面也是如此。

chapters.en: “In the days of Shamgar son of Anath, in the days of Jael, the highways were abandoned; travelers took to winding paths.
chapters.zh: 在亚拿之子珊迦的时候，又在雅亿的日子，大道无人行走，都是绕道而行。

chapters.en: Villagers in Israel would not fight; they held back until I, Deborah, arose, until I arose, a mother in Israel.
chapters.zh: 以色列中的官长停职，直到我底波拉兴起，等我兴起作以色列的母。

chapters.en: God chose new leaders when war came to the city gates, but not a shield or spear was seen among forty thousand in Israel.
chapters.zh: 以色列人选择新神，争战的事就临到城门。那时，以色列四万人中岂能见藤牌枪矛呢？

chapters.en: My heart is with Israel’s princes, with the willing volunteers among the people. Praise the LORD!
chapters.zh: 我心倾向以色列的首领，他们在民中甘心牺牲自己。你们应当颂赞耶和华。

chapters.en: “You who ride on white donkeys, sitting on your saddle blankets, and you who walk along the road, consider
chapters.zh: 骑白驴的，坐绣花毯子的，行路的，你们都当传扬。

chapters.en: the voice of the singers at the watering places. They recite the victories of the LORD, the victories of his villagers in Israel. “Then the people of the LORD went down to the city gates.
chapters.zh: 在远离弓箭响声打水之处，人必述说耶和华公义的作为，就是他治理以色列公义的作为。那时耶和华的民下到城门。

chapters.en: ‘Wake up, wake up, Deborah! Wake up, wake up, break out in song! Arise, Barak! Take captive your captives, son of Abinoam.’
chapters.zh: 底波拉阿，兴起。兴起。你当兴起，兴起，唱歌。亚比挪庵的儿子巴拉阿，你当奋兴，掳掠你的敌人。

chapters.en: “The remnant of the nobles came down; the people of the LORD came down to me against the mighty.
chapters.zh: 那时有余剩的贵胄和百姓一同下来。耶和华降临，为我攻击勇士。

chapters.en: Some came from Ephraim, whose roots were in Amalek; Benjamin was with the people who followed you. From Makir captains came down, from Zebulun those who bear a commander’s staff.
chapters.zh: 有根本在亚玛力人的地，从以法莲下来的。便雅悯在民中跟随你。有掌权的从玛吉下来。有持杖检点民数的从西布伦下来。

chapters.en: The princes of Issachar were with Deborah; yes, Issachar was with Barak, sent under his command into the valley. In the districts of Reuben there was much searching of heart.
chapters.zh: 以萨迦的首领与底波拉同来。以萨迦怎样，巴拉也怎样。众人都跟随巴拉冲下平原。在流便的溪水旁有心中定大志的。

chapters.en: Why did you stay among the sheep pens to hear the whistling for the flocks? In the districts of Reuben there was much searching of heart.
chapters.zh: 你为何坐在羊圈内听群中吹笛的声音呢？在流便的溪水旁有心中设大谋的。

chapters.en: Gilead stayed beyond the Jordan. And Dan, why did he linger by the ships? Asher remained on the coast and stayed in his coves.
chapters.zh: 基列人安居在约旦河外。但人为何等在船上。亚设人在海口静坐，在港口安居。

chapters.en: The people of Zebulun risked their very lives; so did Naphtali on the terraced fields.
chapters.zh: 西布伦人是拚命敢死的。拿弗他利人在田野的高处也是如此。

chapters.en: “Kings came, they fought, the kings of Canaan fought. At Taanach, by the waters of Megiddo, they took no plunder of silver.
chapters.zh: 君王都来争战。那时迦南诸王在米吉多水旁的他纳争战，却未得掳掠银钱。

chapters.en: From the heavens the stars fought, from their courses they fought against Sisera.
chapters.zh: 星宿从天上争战，从其轨道攻击西西拉。

chapters.en: The river Kishon swept them away, the age-old river, the river Kishon. March on, my soul; be strong!
chapters.zh: 基顺古河把敌人冲没。我的灵阿，应当努力前行。

chapters.en: Then thundered the horses’ hooves— galloping, galloping go his mighty steeds.
chapters.zh: 那时壮马驰驱，踢跳，奔腾。

chapters.en: ‘Curse Meroz,’ said the angel of the LORD. ‘Curse its people bitterly, because they did not come to help the LORD, to help the LORD against the mighty.’
chapters.zh: 耶和华的使者说，应当咒诅米罗斯，大大咒诅其中的居民。因为他们不来帮助耶和华，不来帮助耶和华攻击勇士。

chapters.en: “Most blessed of women be Jael, the wife of Heber the Kenite, most blessed of tent-dwelling women.
chapters.zh: 愿基尼人希百的妻雅亿比众妇人多得福气，比住帐棚的妇人更蒙福祉。

chapters.en: He asked for water, and she gave him milk; in a bowl fit for nobles she brought him curdled milk.
chapters.zh: 西西拉求水，雅亿给他奶子，用宝贵的盘子给他奶油。

chapters.en: Her hand reached for the tent peg, her right hand for the workman’s hammer. She struck Sisera, she crushed his head, she shattered and pierced his temple.
chapters.zh: 雅亿左手拿着帐棚的橛子，右手拿着匠人的锤子，击打西西拉，打伤他的头，把他的鬓角打破穿通。

chapters.en: At her feet he sank, he fell; there he lay. At her feet he sank, he fell; where he sank, there he fell—dead.
chapters.zh: 西西拉在她脚前曲身仆倒，在她脚前曲身倒卧。在哪里曲身，就在哪里死亡。

chapters.en: “Through the window peered Sisera’s mother; behind the lattice she cried out, ‘Why is his chariot so long in coming? Why is the clatter of his chariots delayed?’
chapters.zh: 西西拉的母亲从窗户里往外观看，从窗棂中呼叫说，他的战车为何耽延不来呢？他的车轮为何行得慢呢？

chapters.en: The wisest of her ladies answer her; indeed, she keeps saying to herself,
chapters.zh: 聪明的宫女安慰她（原文作回答她），她也自言自语地说，

chapters.en: ‘Are they not finding and dividing the spoils: a woman or two for each man, colorful garments as plunder for Sisera, colorful garments embroidered, highly embroidered garments for my neck— all this as plunder?’
chapters.zh: 他们莫非得财而分。每人得了一两个女子。西西拉得了彩衣为掳物，得绣花的彩衣为掠物。这彩衣两面绣花，乃是披在被掳之人颈项上的。

chapters.en: “So may all your enemies perish, LORD! But may all who love you be like the sun when it rises in its strength.” Then the land had peace forty years.
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，愿你的仇敌都这样灭亡。愿爱你的人如日头出现，光辉烈烈。这样，国中太平四十年。

chapters.en: The Israelites did evil in the eyes of the LORD, and for seven years he gave them into the hands of the Midianites.
chapters.zh: 以色列人又行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，耶和华就把他们交在米甸人手里七年。

chapters.en: Because the power of Midian was so oppressive, the Israelites prepared shelters for themselves in mountain clefts, caves and strongholds.
chapters.zh: 米甸人压制以色列人。以色列人因为米甸人，就在山中挖穴，挖洞，建造营寨。

chapters.en: Whenever the Israelites planted their crops, the Midianites, Amalekites and other eastern peoples invaded the country.
chapters.zh: 以色列人每逢撒种之后，米甸人，亚玛力人，和东方人都上来攻打他们，

chapters.en: They camped on the land and ruined the crops all the way to Gaza and did not spare a living thing for Israel, neither sheep nor cattle nor donkeys.
chapters.zh: 对着他们安营，毁坏土产，直到迦萨，没有给以色列人留下食物，牛，羊，驴也没有留下。

chapters.en: They came up with their livestock and their tents like swarms of locusts. It was impossible to count them or their camels; they invaded the land to ravage it.
chapters.zh: 因为那些人带着牲畜帐棚来，像蝗虫那样多，人和骆驼无数，都进入国内，毁坏全地。

chapters.en: Midian so impoverished the Israelites that they cried out to the LORD for help.
chapters.zh: 以色列人因米甸人的缘故，极其穷乏，就呼求耶和华。

chapters.en: When the Israelites cried out to the LORD because of Midian,
chapters.zh: 以色列人因米甸人的缘故，呼求耶和华，

chapters.en: he sent them a prophet, who said, “This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: I brought you up out of Egypt, out of the land of slavery.
chapters.zh: 耶和华就差遣先知到以色列人那里，对他们说，耶和华以色列的神如此说，我曾领你们从埃及上来，出了为奴之家，

chapters.en: I rescued you from the hand of the Egyptians. And I delivered you from the hand of all your oppressors; I drove them out before you and gave you their land.
chapters.zh: 救你们脱离埃及人的手，并脱离一切欺压你们之人的手，把他们从你们面前赶出，将他们的地赐给你们。

chapters.en: I said to you, ‘I am the LORD your God; do not worship the gods of the Amorites, in whose land you live.’ But you have not listened to me.”
chapters.zh: 又对你们说，我是耶和华你们的神。你们住在亚摩利人的地，不可敬畏他们的神。你们竟不听从我的话。

chapters.en: The angel of the LORD came and sat down under the oak in Ophrah that belonged to Joash the Abiezrite, where his son Gideon was threshing wheat in a winepress to keep it from the Midianites.
chapters.zh: 耶和华的使者到了俄弗拉，坐在亚比以谢族人约阿施的橡树下。约阿施的儿子基甸正在酒榨那里打麦子，为要防备米甸人。

chapters.en: When the angel of the LORD appeared to Gideon, he said, “The LORD is with you, mighty warrior.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华的使者向基甸显现，对他说，大能的勇士阿，耶和华与你同在。

chapters.en: “Pardon me, my lord,” Gideon replied, “but if the LORD is with us, why has all this happened to us? Where are all his wonders that our ancestors told us about when they said, ‘Did not the LORD bring us up out of Egypt?’ But now the LORD has abandoned us and given us into the hand of Midian.”
chapters.zh: 基甸说，主阿，耶和华若与我们同在，我们何至遭遇这一切事呢？我们的列祖不是向我们说耶和华领我们从埃及上来吗？他那样奇妙的作为在哪里呢？现在他却丢弃我们，将我们交在米甸人手里。

chapters.en: The LORD turned to him and said, “Go in the strength you have and save Israel out of Midian’s hand. Am I not sending you?”
chapters.zh: 耶和华观看基甸，说，你靠着你这能力去从米甸人手里拯救以色列人，不是我差遣你去的吗？

chapters.en: “Pardon me, my lord,” Gideon replied, “but how can I save Israel? My clan is the weakest in Manasseh, and I am the least in my family.”
chapters.zh: 基甸说，主阿，我有何能拯救以色列人呢？我家在玛拿西支派中是至贫穷的。我在我父家是至微小的。

chapters.en: The LORD answered, “I will be with you, and you will strike down all the Midianites, leaving none alive.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华对他说，我与你同在，你就必击打米甸人，如击打一人一样。

chapters.en: Gideon replied, “If now I have found favor in your eyes, give me a sign that it is really you talking to me.
chapters.zh: 基甸说，我若在你眼前蒙恩，求你给我一个证据，使我知道与我说话的就是主。

chapters.en: Please do not go away until I come back and bring my offering and set it before you.” And the LORD said, “I will wait until you return.”
chapters.zh: 求你不要离开这里，等我归回将礼物带来供在你面前。主说，我必等你回来。

chapters.en: Gideon went inside, prepared a young goat, and from an ephah of flour he made bread without yeast. Putting the meat in a basket and its broth in a pot, he brought them out and offered them to him under the oak.
chapters.zh: 基甸去预备了一只山羊羔，用一伊法细面作了无酵饼，将肉放在筐内，把汤盛在壶中，带到橡树下，献在使者面前。

chapters.en: The angel of God said to him, “Take the meat and the unleavened bread, place them on this rock, and pour out the broth.” And Gideon did so.
chapters.zh: 神的使者吩咐基甸说，将肉和无酵饼放在这磐石上，把汤倒出来。他就这样行了。

chapters.en: Then the angel of the LORD touched the meat and the unleavened bread with the tip of the staff that was in his hand. Fire flared from the rock, consuming the meat and the bread. And the angel of the LORD disappeared.
chapters.zh: 耶和华的使者伸出手内的杖，杖头挨了肉和无酵饼，就有火从磐石中出来，烧尽了肉和无酵饼。耶和华的使者也就不见了。

chapters.en: When Gideon realized that it was the angel of the LORD, he exclaimed, “Alas, Sovereign LORD! I have seen the angel of the LORD face to face!”
chapters.zh: 基甸见他是耶和华的使者，就说，哀哉。主耶和华阿，我不好了，因为我觌面看见耶和华的使者。

chapters.en: But the LORD said to him, “Peace! Do not be afraid. You are not going to die.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华对他说，你放心，不要惧怕，你必不至死。

chapters.en: So Gideon built an altar to the LORD there and called it The LORD Is Peace. To this day it stands in Ophrah of the Abiezrites.
chapters.zh: 于是基甸在那里为耶和华筑了一座坛，起名叫耶和华沙龙（就是耶和华赐平安的意思）。这坛在亚比以谢族的俄弗拉直到如今。

chapters.en: That same night the LORD said to him, “Take the second bull from your father’s herd, the one seven years old. Tear down your father’s altar to Baal and cut down the Asherah pole beside it.
chapters.zh: 当那夜，耶和华吩咐基甸说，你取你父亲的牛来，就是（或作和）那七岁的第二只牛，并拆毁你父亲为巴力所筑的坛，砍下坛旁的木偶，

chapters.en: Then build a proper kind of altar to the LORD your God on the top of this height. Using the wood of the Asherah pole that you cut down, offer the second bull as a burnt offering.”
chapters.zh: 在这磐石（原文作保障）上整整齐齐地为耶和华你的神筑一座坛，将第二只牛献为燔祭，用你所砍下的木偶作柴。

chapters.en: So Gideon took ten of his servants and did as the LORD told him. But because he was afraid of his family and the townspeople, he did it at night rather than in the daytime.
chapters.zh: 基甸就从他仆人中挑了十个人，照着耶和华吩咐他的行了。他因怕父家和本城的人，不敢在白昼行这事，就在夜间行了。

chapters.en: In the morning when the people of the town got up, there was Baal’s altar, demolished, with the Asherah pole beside it cut down and the second bull sacrificed on the newly built altar!
chapters.zh: 城里的人清早起来，见巴力的坛拆毁，坛旁的木偶砍下，第二只牛献在新筑的坛上，

chapters.en: They asked each other, “Who did this?” When they carefully investigated, they were told, “Gideon son of Joash did it.”
chapters.zh: 就彼此说，这事是谁作的呢？他们访查之后，就说，这是约阿施的儿子基甸作的。

chapters.en: The people of the town demanded of Joash, “Bring out your son. He must die, because he has broken down Baal’s altar and cut down the Asherah pole beside it.”
chapters.zh: 城里的人对约阿施说，将你儿子交出来，好治死他。因为他拆毁了巴力的坛，砍下坛旁的木偶。

chapters.en: But Joash replied to the hostile crowd around him, “Are you going to plead Baal’s cause? Are you trying to save him? Whoever fights for him shall be put to death by morning! If Baal really is a god, he can defend himself when someone breaks down his altar.”
chapters.zh: 约阿施回答站着攻击他的众人说，你们是为巴力争论吗？你们要救他吗？谁为他争论，趁早将谁治死。巴力若果是神，有人拆毁他的坛，让他为自己争论吧。

chapters.en: So because Gideon broke down Baal’s altar, they gave him the name Jerub-Baal that day, saying, “Let Baal contend with him.”
chapters.zh: 所以当日人称基甸为耶路巴力，意思说，他拆毁巴力的坛，让巴力与他争论。

chapters.en: Now all the Midianites, Amalekites and other eastern peoples joined forces and crossed over the Jordan and camped in the Valley of Jezreel.
chapters.zh: 那时，米甸人，亚玛力人，和东方人都聚集过河，在耶斯列平原安营。

chapters.en: Then the Spirit of the LORD came on Gideon, and he blew a trumpet, summoning the Abiezrites to follow him.
chapters.zh: 耶和华的灵降在基甸身上，他就吹角。亚比以谢族都聚集跟随他。

chapters.en: He sent messengers throughout Manasseh, calling them to arms, and also into Asher, Zebulun and Naphtali, so that they too went up to meet them.
chapters.zh: 他打发人走遍玛拿西地，玛拿西人也聚集跟随他。又打发人去见亚设人，西布伦人，拿弗他利人，他们也都出来与他们会合。

chapters.en: Gideon said to God, “If you will save Israel by my hand as you have promised—
chapters.zh: 基甸对神说，你若果照着所说的话，借我手拯救以色列人，

chapters.en: look, I will place a wool fleece on the threshing floor. If there is dew only on the fleece and all the ground is dry, then I will know that you will save Israel by my hand, as you said.”
chapters.zh: 我就把一团羊毛放在禾场上，若单是羊毛上有露水，别的地方都是干的，我就知道你必照着所说的话，借我手拯救以色列人。

chapters.en: And that is what happened. Gideon rose early the next day; he squeezed the fleece and wrung out the dew—a bowlful of water.
chapters.zh: 次日早晨基甸起来，见果然是这样。将羊毛挤一挤，从羊毛中拧出满盆的露水来。

chapters.en: Then Gideon said to God, “Do not be angry with me. Let me make just one more request. Allow me one more test with the fleece, but this time make the fleece dry and let the ground be covered with dew.”
chapters.zh: 基甸又对神说，求你不要向我发怒，我再说这一次，让我将羊毛再试一次。但愿羊毛是干的，别的地方都有露水。

chapters.en: That night God did so. Only the fleece was dry; all the ground was covered with dew.
chapters.zh: 这夜神也如此行，独羊毛上是干的，别的地方都有露水。

chapters.en: Early in the morning, Jerub-Baal (that is, Gideon) and all his men camped at the spring of Harod. The camp of Midian was north of them in the valley near the hill of Moreh.
chapters.zh: 耶路巴力就是基甸，他和一切跟随的人早晨起来，在哈律泉旁安营。米甸营在他们北边的平原，靠近摩利冈。

chapters.en: The LORD said to Gideon, “You have too many men. I cannot deliver Midian into their hands, or Israel would boast against me, ‘My own strength has saved me.’
chapters.zh: 耶和华对基甸说，跟随你的人过多，我不能将米甸人交在他们手中，免得以色列人向我夸大，说，是我们自己的手救了我们。

chapters.en: Now announce to the army, ‘Anyone who trembles with fear may turn back and leave Mount Gilead.’ ” So twenty-two thousand men left, while ten thousand remained.
chapters.zh: 现在你要向这些人宣告说，凡惧怕胆怯的，可以离开基列山回去。于是有二万二千人回去，只剩下一万。

chapters.en: But the LORD said to Gideon, “There are still too many men. Take them down to the water, and I will thin them out for you there. If I say, ‘This one shall go with you,’ he shall go; but if I say, ‘This one shall not go with you,’ he shall not go.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华对基甸说，人还是过多。你要带他们下到水旁，我好在那里为你试试他们。我指点谁说，这人可以同你去，他就可以同你去。我指点谁说，这人不可同你去，他就不可同你去。

chapters.en: So Gideon took the men down to the water. There the LORD told him, “Separate those who lap the water with their tongues as a dog laps from those who kneel down to drink.”
chapters.zh: 基甸就带他们下到水旁。耶和华对基甸说，凡用舌头舔水，像狗舔的，要使他单站在一处。凡跪下喝水的，也要使他单站在一处。

chapters.en: Three hundred of them drank from cupped hands, lapping like dogs. All the rest got down on their knees to drink.
chapters.zh: 于是用手捧着舔水的有三百人，其余的都跪下喝水。

chapters.en: The LORD said to Gideon, “With the three hundred men that lapped I will save you and give the Midianites into your hands. Let all the others go home.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华对基甸说，我要用这舔水的三百人拯救你们，将米甸人交在你手中。其余的人都可以各归各处去。

chapters.en: So Gideon sent the rest of the Israelites home but kept the three hundred, who took over the provisions and trumpets of the others. Now the camp of Midian lay below him in the valley.
chapters.zh: 这三百人就带着食物和角。其余的以色列人，基甸都打发他们各归各的帐棚，只留下这三百人。米甸营在他下边的平原里。

chapters.en: During that night the LORD said to Gideon, “Get up, go down against the camp, because I am going to give it into your hands.
chapters.zh: 当那夜，耶和华吩咐基甸说，起来，下到米甸营里去，因我已将他们交在你手中。

chapters.en: If you are afraid to attack, go down to the camp with your servant Purah
chapters.zh: 倘若你怕下去，就带你的仆人普拉下到那营里去。

chapters.en: and listen to what they are saying. Afterward, you will be encouraged to attack the camp.” So he and Purah his servant went down to the outposts of the camp.
chapters.zh: 你必听见他们所说的，然后你就有胆量下去攻营。于是基甸带着仆人普拉下到营旁。

chapters.en: The Midianites, the Amalekites and all the other eastern peoples had settled in the valley, thick as locusts. Their camels could no more be counted than the sand on the seashore.
chapters.zh: 米甸人，亚玛力人，和一切东方人都布散在平原，如同蝗虫那样多。他们的骆驼无数，多如海边的沙。

chapters.en: Gideon arrived just as a man was telling a friend his dream. “I had a dream,” he was saying. “A round loaf of barley bread came tumbling into the Midianite camp. It struck the tent with such force that the tent overturned and collapsed.”
chapters.zh: 基甸到了，就听见一人将梦告诉同伴说，我作了一梦，梦见一个大麦饼滚入米甸营中，到了帐幕，将帐幕撞倒，帐幕就翻转倾覆了。

chapters.en: His friend responded, “This can be nothing other than the sword of Gideon son of Joash, the Israelite. God has given the Midianites and the whole camp into his hands.”
chapters.zh: 那同伴说，这不是别的，乃是以色列人约阿施的儿子基甸的刀。神已将米甸和全军都交在他的手中。

chapters.en: When Gideon heard the dream and its interpretation, he bowed down and worshiped. He returned to the camp of Israel and called out, “Get up! The LORD has given the Midianite camp into your hands.”
chapters.zh: 基甸听见这梦和梦的讲解，就敬拜神，回到以色列营中，说，起来吧。耶和华已将米甸的军队交在你们手中了。

chapters.en: Dividing the three hundred men into three companies, he placed trumpets and empty jars in the hands of all of them, with torches inside.
chapters.zh: 于是基甸将三百人分作三队，把角和空瓶交在各人手里，瓶内都藏着火把，

chapters.en: “Watch me,” he told them. “Follow my lead. When I get to the edge of the camp, do exactly as I do.
chapters.zh: 吩咐他们说，你们要看我行事，我到了营的旁边怎样行，你们也要怎样行。

chapters.en: When I and all who are with me blow our trumpets, then from all around the camp blow yours and shout, ‘For the LORD and for Gideon.’ ”
chapters.zh: 我和一切跟随我的人吹角的时候，你们也要在营的四围吹角，喊叫说，耶和华和基甸的刀。

chapters.en: Gideon and the hundred men with him reached the edge of the camp at the beginning of the middle watch, just after they had changed the guard. They blew their trumpets and broke the jars that were in their hands.
chapters.zh: 基甸和跟随他的一百人，在三更之初才换更的时候，来到营旁，就吹角，打破手中的瓶。

chapters.en: The three companies blew the trumpets and smashed the jars. Grasping the torches in their left hands and holding in their right hands the trumpets they were to blow, they shouted, “A sword for the LORD and for Gideon!”
chapters.zh: 三队的人就都吹角，打破瓶子，左手拿着火把，右手拿着角，喊叫说，耶和华和基甸的刀。

chapters.en: While each man held his position around the camp, all the Midianites ran, crying out as they fled.
chapters.zh: 他们在营的四围各站各的地方。全营的人都乱窜。三百人呐喊，使他们逃跑。

chapters.en: When the three hundred trumpets sounded, the LORD caused the men throughout the camp to turn on each other with their swords. The army fled to Beth Shittah toward Zererah as far as the border of Abel Meholah near Tabbath.
chapters.zh: 三百人就吹角，耶和华使全营的人用刀互相击杀，逃到西利拉的伯哈示他，直逃到靠近他巴的亚伯米何拉。

chapters.en: Israelites from Naphtali, Asher and all Manasseh were called out, and they pursued the Midianites.
chapters.zh: 以色列人就从拿弗他利，亚设，和玛拿西全地聚集来追赶米甸人。

chapters.en: Gideon sent messengers throughout the hill country of Ephraim, saying, “Come down against the Midianites and seize the waters of the Jordan ahead of them as far as Beth Barah.” So all the men of Ephraim were called out and they seized the waters of the Jordan as far as Beth Barah.
chapters.zh: 基甸打发人走遍以法莲山地，说，你们下来攻击米甸人，争先把守约旦河的渡口，直到伯巴拉。于是以法莲的众人聚集，把守约旦河的渡口，直到伯巴拉，

chapters.en: They also captured two of the Midianite leaders, Oreb and Zeeb. They killed Oreb at the rock of Oreb, and Zeeb at the winepress of Zeeb. They pursued the Midianites and brought the heads of Oreb and Zeeb to Gideon, who was by the Jordan.
chapters.zh: 捉住了米甸人的两个首领，一名俄立，一名西伊伯。将俄立杀在俄立磐石上，将西伊伯杀在西伊伯酒榨那里。又追赶米甸人，将俄立和西伊伯的首级带过约旦河，到基甸那里。

chapters.en: Now the Ephraimites asked Gideon, “Why have you treated us like this? Why didn’t you call us when you went to fight Midian?” And they challenged him vigorously.
chapters.zh: 以法莲人对基甸说，你去与米甸人争战，没有招我们同去，为什么这样待我们呢？他们就与基甸大大地争吵。

chapters.en: But he answered them, “What have I accomplished compared to you? Aren’t the gleanings of Ephraim’s grapes better than the full grape harvest of Abiezer?
chapters.zh: 基甸对他们说，我所行的岂能比你们所行的呢？以法莲拾取剩下的葡萄不强过亚比以谢所摘的葡萄吗？

chapters.en: God gave Oreb and Zeeb, the Midianite leaders, into your hands. What was I able to do compared to you?” At this, their resentment against him subsided.
chapters.zh: 神已将米甸人的两个首领俄立和西伊伯交在你们手中。我所行的岂能比你们所行的呢？基甸说了这话，以法莲人的怒气就消了。

chapters.en: Gideon and his three hundred men, exhausted yet keeping up the pursuit, came to the Jordan and crossed it.
chapters.zh: 基甸和跟随他的三百人到约旦河过渡，虽然疲乏，还是追赶。

chapters.en: He said to the men of Sukkoth, “Give my troops some bread; they are worn out, and I am still pursuing Zebah and Zalmunna, the kings of Midian.”
chapters.zh: 基甸对疏割人说，求你们拿饼来给跟随我的人吃，因为他们疲乏了。我们追赶米甸人的两个王西巴和撒慕拿。

chapters.en: But the officials of Sukkoth said, “Do you already have the hands of Zebah and Zalmunna in your possession? Why should we give bread to your troops?”
chapters.zh: 疏割人的首领回答说，西巴和撒慕拿已经在你手里，你使我们将饼给你的军兵吗？

chapters.en: Then Gideon replied, “Just for that, when the LORD has given Zebah and Zalmunna into my hand, I will tear your flesh with desert thorns and briers.”
chapters.zh: 基甸说，耶和华将西巴和撒慕拿交在我手之后，我就用野地的荆条和枳棘打伤你们。

chapters.en: From there he went up to Peniel and made the same request of them, but they answered as the men of Sukkoth had.
chapters.zh: 基甸从那里上到毗努伊勒，对那里的人也是这样说。毗努伊勒人也与疏割人回答他的话一样。

chapters.en: So he said to the men of Peniel, “When I return in triumph, I will tear down this tower.”
chapters.zh: 他向毗努伊勒人说，我平平安安回来的时候，我必拆毁这楼。

chapters.en: Now Zebah and Zalmunna were in Karkor with a force of about fifteen thousand men, all that were left of the armies of the eastern peoples; a hundred and twenty thousand swordsmen had fallen.
chapters.zh: 那时西巴和撒慕拿，并跟随他们的军队都在加各，约有一万五千人，就是东方人全军所剩下的。已经被杀约有十二万拿刀的。

chapters.en: Gideon went up by the route of the nomads east of Nobah and Jogbehah and attacked the unsuspecting army.
chapters.zh: 基甸就由挪巴和约比哈东边，从住帐棚人的路上去，杀败了米甸人的军兵，因为他们坦然无惧。

chapters.en: Zebah and Zalmunna, the two kings of Midian, fled, but he pursued them and captured them, routing their entire army.
chapters.zh: 西巴和撒慕拿逃跑。基甸追赶他们，捉住米甸的二王西巴和撒慕拿，惊散全军。

chapters.en: Gideon son of Joash then returned from the battle by the Pass of Heres.
chapters.zh: 约阿施的儿子基甸由希列斯坡从阵上回来，

chapters.en: He caught a young man of Sukkoth and questioned him, and the young man wrote down for him the names of the seventy-seven officials of Sukkoth, the elders of the town.
chapters.zh: 捉住疏割的一个少年人，问他，疏割的首领长老是谁。他就将首领长老七十七个人的名字写出来。

chapters.en: Then Gideon came and said to the men of Sukkoth, “Here are Zebah and Zalmunna, about whom you taunted me by saying, ‘Do you already have the hands of Zebah and Zalmunna in your possession? Why should we give bread to your exhausted men?’ ”
chapters.zh: 基甸到了疏割，对那里的人说，你们从前讥诮我说，西巴和撒慕拿已经在你手里，你使我们将饼给跟随你的疲乏人吗？现在西巴和撒慕拿在这里。

chapters.en: He took the elders of the town and taught the men of Sukkoth a lesson by punishing them with desert thorns and briers.
chapters.zh: 于是捉住那城内的长老，用野地的荆条和枳棘责打（原文作指教）疏割人。

chapters.en: He also pulled down the tower of Peniel and killed the men of the town.
chapters.zh: 又拆了毗努伊勒的楼，杀了那城里的人。

chapters.en: Then he asked Zebah and Zalmunna, “What kind of men did you kill at Tabor?” “Men like you,” they answered, “each one with the bearing of a prince.”
chapters.zh: 基甸问西巴和撒慕拿说，你们在他泊山所杀的人是什么样式。回答说，他们好象你，各人都有王子的样式。

chapters.en: Gideon replied, “Those were my brothers, the sons of my own mother. As surely as the LORD lives, if you had spared their lives, I would not kill you.”
chapters.zh: 基甸说，他们是我同母的弟兄，我指着永生的耶和华起誓，你们从前若存留他们的性命，我如今就不杀你们了。

chapters.en: Turning to Jether, his oldest son, he said, “Kill them!” But Jether did not draw his sword, because he was only a boy and was afraid.
chapters.zh: 于是对他的长子益帖说，你起来杀他们。但益帖因为是童子，害怕，不敢拔刀。

chapters.en: Zebah and Zalmunna said, “Come, do it yourself. ‘As is the man, so is his strength.’ ” So Gideon stepped forward and killed them, and took the ornaments off their camels’ necks.
chapters.zh: 西巴和撒慕拿说，你自己起来杀我们吧。因为人如何，力量也是如何。基甸就起来，杀了西巴和撒慕拿，夺获他们骆驼项上戴的月牙圈。

chapters.en: The Israelites said to Gideon, “Rule over us—you, your son and your grandson—because you have saved us from the hand of Midian.”
chapters.zh: 以色列人对基甸说，你既救我们脱离米甸人的手，愿你和你的儿孙管理我们。

chapters.en: But Gideon told them, “I will not rule over you, nor will my son rule over you. The LORD will rule over you.”
chapters.zh: 基甸说，我不管理你们，我的儿子也不管理你们，惟有耶和华管理你们。

chapters.en: And he said, “I do have one request, that each of you give me an earring from your share of the plunder.” (It was the custom of the Ishmaelites to wear gold earrings.)
chapters.zh: 基甸又对他们说，我有一件事求你们，请你们各人将所夺的耳环给我。（原来仇敌是以实玛利人，都是戴金耳环的。）

chapters.en: They answered, “We’ll be glad to give them.” So they spread out a garment, and each of them threw a ring from his plunder onto it.
chapters.zh: 他们说，我们情愿给你。就铺开一件外衣，各人将所夺的耳环丢在其上。

chapters.en: The weight of the gold rings he asked for came to seventeen hundred shekels, not counting the ornaments, the pendants and the purple garments worn by the kings of Midian or the chains that were on their camels’ necks.
chapters.zh: 基甸所要出来的金耳环重一千七百舍客勒金子。此外还有米甸王所戴的月环，耳坠，和所穿的紫色衣服，并骆驼项上的金链子。

chapters.en: Gideon made the gold into an ephod, which he placed in Ophrah, his town. All Israel prostituted themselves by worshiping it there, and it became a snare to Gideon and his family.
chapters.zh: 基甸以此制造了一个以弗得，设立在本城俄弗拉。后来以色列人拜那以弗得行了邪淫。这就作了基甸和他全家的网罗。

chapters.en: Thus Midian was subdued before the Israelites and did not raise its head again. During Gideon’s lifetime, the land had peace forty years.
chapters.zh: 这样，米甸人被以色列人制伏了，不敢再抬头。基甸还在的日子，国中太平四十年。

chapters.en: Jerub-Baal son of Joash went back home to live.
chapters.zh: 约阿施的儿子耶路巴力回去，住在自己家里。

chapters.en: He had seventy sons of his own, for he had many wives.
chapters.zh: 基甸有七十个亲生的儿子，因为他有许多的妻。

chapters.en: His concubine, who lived in Shechem, also bore him a son, whom he named Abimelek.
chapters.zh: 他的妾住在示剑，也给他生了一个儿子。基甸与他起名叫亚比米勒。

chapters.en: Gideon son of Joash died at a good old age and was buried in the tomb of his father Joash in Ophrah of the Abiezrites.
chapters.zh: 约阿施的儿子基甸，年纪老迈而死，葬在亚比以谢族的俄弗拉，在他父亲约阿施的坟墓里。

chapters.en: No sooner had Gideon died than the Israelites again prostituted themselves to the Baals. They set up Baal-Berith as their god
chapters.zh: 基甸死后，以色列人又去随从诸巴力行邪淫，以巴力比利土为他们的神。

chapters.en: and did not remember the LORD their God, who had rescued them from the hands of all their enemies on every side.
chapters.zh: 以色列人不记念耶和华他们的神，就是拯救他们脱离四围仇敌之手的，

chapters.en: They also failed to show any loyalty to the family of Jerub-Baal (that is, Gideon) in spite of all the good things he had done for them.
chapters.zh: 也不照着耶路巴力，就是基甸向他们所施的恩惠厚待他的家。

chapters.en: Abimelek son of Jerub-Baal went to his mother’s brothers in Shechem and said to them and to all his mother’s clan,
chapters.zh: 耶路巴力的儿子亚比米勒到了示剑见他的众母舅，对他们和他外祖全家的人说，

chapters.en: “Ask all the citizens of Shechem, ‘Which is better for you: to have all seventy of Jerub-Baal’s sons rule over you, or just one man?’ Remember, I am your flesh and blood.”
chapters.zh: 请你们问示剑的众人说，是耶路巴力的众子七十人都管理你们好呢？还是一人管理你们好呢？你们又要记念我是你们的骨肉。

chapters.en: When the brothers repeated all this to the citizens of Shechem, they were inclined to follow Abimelek, for they said, “He is related to us.”
chapters.zh: 他的众母舅便将这一切话为他说给示剑人听，示剑人的心就归向亚比米勒。他们说，他原是我们的弟兄。

chapters.en: They gave him seventy shekels of silver from the temple of Baal-Berith, and Abimelek used it to hire reckless scoundrels, who became his followers.
chapters.zh: 就从巴力比利土的庙中取了七十舍客勒银子给亚比米勒。亚比米勒用以雇了些匪徒跟随他。

chapters.en: He went to his father’s home in Ophrah and on one stone murdered his seventy brothers, the sons of Jerub-Baal. But Jotham, the youngest son of Jerub-Baal, escaped by hiding.
chapters.zh: 他往俄弗拉到他父亲的家，将他弟兄，耶路巴力的众子七十人都杀在一块磐石上。只剩下耶路巴力的小儿子约坦，因为他躲藏了。

chapters.en: Then all the citizens of Shechem and Beth Millo gathered beside the great tree at the pillar in Shechem to crown Abimelek king.
chapters.zh: 示剑人和米罗人都一同聚集，往示剑橡树旁的柱子那里，立亚比米勒为王。

chapters.en: When Jotham was told about this, he climbed up on the top of Mount Gerizim and shouted to them, “Listen to me, citizens of Shechem, so that God may listen to you.
chapters.zh: 有人将这事告诉约坦，他就去站在基利心山顶上，向众人大声喊叫说，示剑人哪，你们要听我的话，神也就听你们的话。

chapters.en: One day the trees went out to anoint a king for themselves. They said to the olive tree, ‘Be our king.’
chapters.zh: 有一时树木要膏一树为王，管理他们，就去对橄榄树说，请你作我们的王。

chapters.en: “But the olive tree answered, ‘Should I give up my oil, by which both gods and humans are honored, to hold sway over the trees?’
chapters.zh: 橄榄树回答说，我岂肯止住供奉神和尊重人的油，飘摇在众树之上呢？

chapters.en: “Next, the trees said to the fig tree, ‘Come and be our king.’
chapters.zh: 树木对无花果树说，请你来作我们的王。

chapters.en: “But the fig tree replied, ‘Should I give up my fruit, so good and sweet, to hold sway over the trees?’
chapters.zh: 无花果树回答说，我岂肯止住所结甜美的果子，飘摇在众树之上呢？

chapters.en: “Then the trees said to the vine, ‘Come and be our king.’
chapters.zh: 树木对葡萄树说，请你来作我们的王。

chapters.en: “But the vine answered, ‘Should I give up my wine, which cheers both gods and humans, to hold sway over the trees?’
chapters.zh: 葡萄树回答说，我岂肯止住使神和人喜乐的新酒，飘摇在众树之上呢？

chapters.en: “Finally all the trees said to the thornbush, ‘Come and be our king.’
chapters.zh: 众树对荆棘说，请你来作我们的王。

chapters.en: “The thornbush said to the trees, ‘If you really want to anoint me king over you, come and take refuge in my shade; but if not, then let fire come out of the thornbush and consume the cedars of Lebanon!’
chapters.zh: 荆棘回答说，你们若诚诚实实地膏我为王，就要投在我的荫下。不然，愿火从荆棘里出来，烧灭利巴嫩的香柏树。

chapters.en: “Have you acted honorably and in good faith by making Abimelek king? Have you been fair to Jerub-Baal and his family? Have you treated him as he deserves?
chapters.zh: 现在你们立亚比米勒为王，若按诚实正直善待耶路巴力和他的全家，这就是酬他的劳。

chapters.en: Remember that my father fought for you and risked his life to rescue you from the hand of Midian.
chapters.zh: 从前我父冒死为你们争战，救了你们脱离米甸人的手。

chapters.en: But today you have revolted against my father’s family. You have murdered his seventy sons on a single stone and have made Abimelek, the son of his female slave, king over the citizens of Shechem because he is related to you.
chapters.zh: 你们如今起来攻击我的父家，将他众子七十人杀在一块磐石上，又立他婢女所生的儿子亚比米勒为示剑人的王。他原是你们的弟兄。

chapters.en: So have you acted honorably and in good faith toward Jerub-Baal and his family today? If you have, may Abimelek be your joy, and may you be his, too!
chapters.zh: 你们如今若按诚实正直待耶路巴力和他的家，就可因亚比米勒得欢乐，他也可因你们得欢乐。

chapters.en: But if you have not, let fire come out from Abimelek and consume you, the citizens of Shechem and Beth Millo, and let fire come out from you, the citizens of Shechem and Beth Millo, and consume Abimelek!”
chapters.zh: 不然，愿火从亚比米勒发出，烧灭示剑人和米罗众人，又愿火从示剑人和米罗人中出来，烧灭亚比米勒。

chapters.en: Then Jotham fled, escaping to Beer, and he lived there because he was afraid of his brother Abimelek.
chapters.zh: 约坦因怕他弟兄亚比米勒，就逃跑，来到比珥，住在那里。

chapters.en: After Abimelek had governed Israel three years,
chapters.zh: 亚比米勒管理以色列人三年。

chapters.en: God stirred up animosity between Abimelek and the citizens of Shechem so that they acted treacherously against Abimelek.
chapters.zh: 神使恶魔降在亚比米勒和示剑人中间，示剑人就以诡诈待亚比米勒。

chapters.en: God did this in order that the crime against Jerub-Baal’s seventy sons, the shedding of their blood, might be avenged on their brother Abimelek and on the citizens of Shechem, who had helped him murder his brothers.
chapters.zh: 这是要叫耶路巴力七十个儿子所受的残害归与他们的哥哥亚比米勒，又叫那流他们血的罪归与帮助他杀弟兄的示剑人。

chapters.en: In opposition to him these citizens of Shechem set men on the hilltops to ambush and rob everyone who passed by, and this was reported to Abimelek.
chapters.zh: 示剑人在山顶上设埋伏，等候亚比米勒。凡从他们那里经过的人，他们就抢夺。有人将这事告诉亚比米勒。

chapters.en: Now Gaal son of Ebed moved with his clan into Shechem, and its citizens put their confidence in him.
chapters.zh: 以别的儿子迦勒和他的弟兄来到示剑，示剑人都信靠他。

chapters.en: After they had gone out into the fields and gathered the grapes and trodden them, they held a festival in the temple of their god. While they were eating and drinking, they cursed Abimelek.
chapters.zh: 示剑人出城到田间去，摘下葡萄，踹酒，设摆筵宴，进他们神的庙中吃喝，咒诅亚比米勒。

chapters.en: Then Gaal son of Ebed said, “Who is Abimelek, and why should we Shechemites be subject to him? Isn’t he Jerub-Baal’s son, and isn’t Zebul his deputy? Serve the family of Hamor, Shechem’s father! Why should we serve Abimelek?
chapters.zh: 以别的儿子迦勒说，亚比米勒是谁。示剑是谁。使我们服事他呢？他不是耶路巴力的儿子吗？他的帮手不是西布勒吗？你们可以服事示剑的父亲哈抹的后裔。我们为何服事亚比米勒呢？

chapters.en: If only this people were under my command! Then I would get rid of him. I would say to Abimelek, ‘Call out your whole army!’ ”
chapters.zh: 惟愿这民归我的手下，我就除掉亚比米勒。迦勒又对亚比米勒说，增添你的军兵出来吧。

chapters.en: When Zebul the governor of the city heard what Gaal son of Ebed said, he was very angry.
chapters.zh: 邑宰西布勒听见以别的儿子迦勒的话，就发怒，

chapters.en: Under cover he sent messengers to Abimelek, saying, “Gaal son of Ebed and his clan have come to Shechem and are stirring up the city against you.
chapters.zh: 悄悄地打发人去见亚比米勒，说，以别的儿子迦勒和他的弟兄到了示剑，煽惑城中的民攻击你。

chapters.en: Now then, during the night you and your men should come and lie in wait in the fields.
chapters.zh: 现在你和跟随你的人今夜起来，在田间埋伏。

chapters.en: In the morning at sunrise, advance against the city. When Gaal and his men come out against you, seize the opportunity to attack them.”
chapters.zh: 到早晨太阳一出，你就起来闯城。迦勒和跟随他的人出来攻击你的时候，你便向他们见机而作。

chapters.en: So Abimelek and all his troops set out by night and took up concealed positions near Shechem in four companies.
chapters.zh: 于是，亚比米勒和跟随他的众人夜间起来，分作四队，埋伏等候示剑人。

chapters.en: Now Gaal son of Ebed had gone out and was standing at the entrance of the city gate just as Abimelek and his troops came out from their hiding place.
chapters.zh: 以别的儿子迦勒出去，站在城门口。亚比米勒和跟随他的人从埋伏之处起来。

chapters.en: When Gaal saw them, he said to Zebul, “Look, people are coming down from the tops of the mountains!” Zebul replied, “You mistake the shadows of the mountains for men.”
chapters.zh: 迦勒看见那些人，就对西布勒说，看哪，有人从山顶上下来了。西布勒说，你看见山的影子，以为是人。

chapters.en: But Gaal spoke up again: “Look, people are coming down from the central hill, and a company is coming from the direction of the diviners’ tree.”
chapters.zh: 迦勒又说，看哪，有人从高处下来，又有一队从米恶尼尼橡树的路上而来。

chapters.en: Then Zebul said to him, “Where is your big talk now, you who said, ‘Who is Abimelek that we should be subject to him?’ Aren’t these the men you ridiculed? Go out and fight them!”
chapters.zh: 西布勒对他说，你曾说，亚比米勒是谁，叫我们服事他？你所夸的口在哪里呢？这不是你所藐视的民吗？你现在出去，与他们交战吧。

chapters.en: So Gaal led out the citizens of Shechem and fought Abimelek.
chapters.zh: 于是迦勒率领示剑人出去，与亚比米勒交战。

chapters.en: Abimelek chased him all the way to the entrance of the gate, and many were killed as they fled.
chapters.zh: 亚比米勒追赶迦勒。迦勒在他面前逃跑，有许多受伤仆倒的，直到城门。

chapters.en: Then Abimelek stayed in Arumah, and Zebul drove Gaal and his clan out of Shechem.
chapters.zh: 亚比米勒住在亚鲁玛。西布勒赶出迦勒和他弟兄，不准他们住在示剑。

chapters.en: The next day the people of Shechem went out to the fields, and this was reported to Abimelek.
chapters.zh: 次日，民出到田间，有人告诉亚比米勒。

chapters.en: So he took his men, divided them into three companies and set an ambush in the fields. When he saw the people coming out of the city, he rose to attack them.
chapters.zh: 他就把他的人分作三队，埋伏在田间，看见示剑人从城里出来，就起来击杀他们。

chapters.en: Abimelek and the companies with him rushed forward to a position at the entrance of the city gate. Then two companies attacked those in the fields and struck them down.
chapters.zh: 亚比米勒和跟随他的一队向前闯去，站在城门口。那两队直闯到田间，击杀了众人。

chapters.en: All that day Abimelek pressed his attack against the city until he had captured it and killed its people. Then he destroyed the city and scattered salt over it.
chapters.zh: 亚比米勒整天攻打城，将城夺取，杀了其中的居民，将城拆毁，撒上了盐。

chapters.en: On hearing this, the citizens in the tower of Shechem went into the stronghold of the temple of El-Berith.
chapters.zh: 示剑楼的人听见了，就躲入巴力比利土庙的卫所。

chapters.en: When Abimelek heard that they had assembled there,
chapters.zh: 有人告诉亚比米勒说，示剑楼的人都聚在一处。

chapters.en: he and all his men went up Mount Zalmon. He took an ax and cut off some branches, which he lifted to his shoulders. He ordered the men with him, “Quick! Do what you have seen me do!”
chapters.zh: 亚比米勒和跟随他的人就都上撒们山。亚比米勒手拿斧子，砍下一根树枝，扛在肩上，对跟随他的人说，你们看我所行的，也当赶紧照样行。

chapters.en: So all the men cut branches and followed Abimelek. They piled them against the stronghold and set it on fire with the people still inside. So all the people in the tower of Shechem, about a thousand men and women, also died.
chapters.zh: 众人就各砍一枝，跟随亚比米勒，把树枝堆在卫所的四围，放火烧了卫所，以致示剑楼的人都死了，男女约有一千。

chapters.en: Next Abimelek went to Thebez and besieged it and captured it.
chapters.zh: 亚比米勒到提备斯，向提备斯安营，就攻取了那城。

chapters.en: Inside the city, however, was a strong tower, to which all the men and women—all the people of the city—had fled. They had locked themselves in and climbed up on the tower roof.
chapters.zh: 城中有一座坚固的楼。城里的众人，无论男女，都逃进楼去，关上门，上了楼顶。

chapters.en: Abimelek went to the tower and attacked it. But as he approached the entrance to the tower to set it on fire,
chapters.zh: 亚比米勒到了楼前攻打，挨近楼门，要用火焚烧。

chapters.en: a woman dropped an upper millstone on his head and cracked his skull.
chapters.zh: 有一个妇人把一块上磨石抛在亚比米勒的头上，打破了他的脑骨。

chapters.en: Hurriedly he called to his armor-bearer, “Draw your sword and kill me, so that they can’t say, ‘A woman killed him.’ ” So his servant ran him through, and he died.
chapters.zh: 他就急忙喊叫拿他兵器的少年人，对他说，拔出你的刀来，杀了我吧。免得人议论我说，他为一个妇人所杀。于是少年人把他刺透，他就死了。

chapters.en: When the Israelites saw that Abimelek was dead, they went home.
chapters.zh: 以色列人见亚比米勒死了，便各回自己的地方去了。

chapters.en: Thus God repaid the wickedness that Abimelek had done to his father by murdering his seventy brothers.
chapters.zh: 这样，神报应亚比米勒向他父亲所行的恶，就是杀了弟兄七十个人的恶。

chapters.en: God also made the people of Shechem pay for all their wickedness. The curse of Jotham son of Jerub-Baal came on them.
chapters.zh: 示剑人的一切恶，神也都报应在他们头上。耶路巴力的儿子约坦的咒诅归到他们身上了。

chapters.en: After the time of Abimelek, a man of Issachar named Tola son of Puah, the son of Dodo, rose to save Israel. He lived in Shamir, in the hill country of Ephraim.
chapters.zh: 亚比米勒以后，有以萨迦人朵多的孙子，普瓦的儿子陀拉兴起，拯救以色列人。他住在以法莲山地的沙密。

chapters.en: He led Israel twenty-three years; then he died, and was buried in Shamir.
chapters.zh: 陀拉作以色列的士师二十三年，就死了，葬在沙密。

chapters.en: He was followed by Jair of Gilead, who led Israel twenty-two years.
chapters.zh: 在他以后有基列人睚珥兴起，作以色列的士师二十二年。

chapters.en: He had thirty sons, who rode thirty donkeys. They controlled thirty towns in Gilead, which to this day are called Havvoth Jair.
chapters.zh: 他有三十个儿子，骑着三十匹驴驹。他们有三十座城邑，叫作哈倭特睚珥，直到如今，都是在基列地。

chapters.en: When Jair died, he was buried in Kamon.
chapters.zh: 睚珥死了，就葬在加们。

chapters.en: Again the Israelites did evil in the eyes of the LORD. They served the Baals and the Ashtoreths, and the gods of Aram, the gods of Sidon, the gods of Moab, the gods of the Ammonites and the gods of the Philistines. And because the Israelites forsook the LORD and no longer served him,
chapters.zh: 以色列人又行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，去事奉诸巴力和亚斯他录，并亚兰的神，西顿的神，摩押的神，亚扪人的神，非利士人的神，离弃耶和华，不事奉他

chapters.en: he became angry with them. He sold them into the hands of the Philistines and the Ammonites,
chapters.zh: 耶和华的怒气向以色列人发作，就把他们交在非利士人和亚扪人的手中。

chapters.en: who that year shattered and crushed them. For eighteen years they oppressed all the Israelites on the east side of the Jordan in Gilead, the land of the Amorites.
chapters.zh: 从那年起，他们扰害欺压约旦河那边，住亚摩利人之基列地的以色列人，共有十八年。

chapters.en: The Ammonites also crossed the Jordan to fight against Judah, Benjamin and Ephraim; Israel was in great distress.
chapters.zh: 亚扪人又渡过约旦河去攻打犹大和便雅悯，并以法莲族。以色列人就甚觉窘迫。

chapters.en: Then the Israelites cried out to the LORD, “We have sinned against you, forsaking our God and serving the Baals.”
chapters.zh: 以色列人哀求耶和华说，我们得罪了你。因为离弃了我们神，去事奉诸巴力。

chapters.en: The LORD replied, “When the Egyptians, the Amorites, the Ammonites, the Philistines,
chapters.zh: 耶和华对以色列人说，我岂没有救过你们脱离埃及人，亚摩利人，亚扪人，和非利士人吗？

chapters.en: the Sidonians, the Amalekites and the Maonites oppressed you and you cried to me for help, did I not save you from their hands?
chapters.zh: 西顿人，亚玛力人，马云人也都欺压你们。你们哀求我，我也拯救你们脱离他们的手。

chapters.en: But you have forsaken me and served other gods, so I will no longer save you.
chapters.zh: 你们竟离弃我，事奉别神。所以我不再救你们了。

chapters.en: Go and cry out to the gods you have chosen. Let them save you when you are in trouble!”
chapters.zh: 你们去哀求所选择的神。你们遭遇急难的时候，让他救你们吧。

chapters.en: But the Israelites said to the LORD, “We have sinned. Do with us whatever you think best, but please rescue us now.”
chapters.zh: 以色列人对耶和华说，我们犯罪了，任凭你随意待我们吧。只求你今日拯救我们。

chapters.en: Then they got rid of the foreign gods among them and served the LORD. And he could bear Israel’s misery no longer.
chapters.zh: 以色列人就除掉他们中间的外邦神，事奉耶和华。耶和华因以色列人受的苦难，就心中担忧。

chapters.en: When the Ammonites were called to arms and camped in Gilead, the Israelites assembled and camped at Mizpah.
chapters.zh: 当时亚扪人聚集，安营在基列。以色列人也聚集，安营在米斯巴。

chapters.en: The leaders of the people of Gilead said to each other, “Whoever will take the lead in attacking the Ammonites will be head over all who live in Gilead.”
chapters.zh: 基列的民和众首领彼此商议说，谁能先去攻打亚扪人，谁必作基列一切居民的领袖。

chapters.en: Jephthah the Gileadite was a mighty warrior. His father was Gilead; his mother was a prostitute.
chapters.zh: 基列人耶弗他是个大能的勇士，是妓女的儿子。耶弗他是基列所生的。

chapters.en: Gilead’s wife also bore him sons, and when they were grown up, they drove Jephthah away. “You are not going to get any inheritance in our family,” they said, “because you are the son of another woman.”
chapters.zh: 基列的妻也生了几个儿子，他妻所生的儿子长大了，就赶逐耶弗他，说，你不可在我们父家承受产业，因为你是妓女的儿子。

chapters.en: So Jephthah fled from his brothers and settled in the land of Tob, where a gang of scoundrels gathered around him and followed him.
chapters.zh: 耶弗他就逃避他的弟兄，去住在陀伯地，有些匪徒到他那里聚集，与他一同出入。

chapters.en: Some time later, when the Ammonites were fighting against Israel,
chapters.zh: 过了些日子，亚扪人攻打以色列。

chapters.en: the elders of Gilead went to get Jephthah from the land of Tob.
chapters.zh: 亚扪人攻打以色列的时候，基列的长老到陀伯地去，要叫耶弗他回来。

chapters.en: “Come,” they said, “be our commander, so we can fight the Ammonites.”
chapters.zh: 对耶弗他说，请你来作我们的元帅，我们好与亚扪人争战。

chapters.en: Jephthah said to them, “Didn’t you hate me and drive me from my father’s house? Why do you come to me now, when you’re in trouble?”
chapters.zh: 耶弗他回答基列的长老说，从前你们不是恨我，赶逐我出离父家吗？现在你们遭遇急难为何到我这里来呢？

chapters.en: The elders of Gilead said to him, “Nevertheless, we are turning to you now; come with us to fight the Ammonites, and you will be head over all of us who live in Gilead.”
chapters.zh: 基列的长老回答耶弗他说，现在我们到你这里来，是要你同我们去，与亚扪人争战。你可以作基列一切居民的领袖。

chapters.en: Jephthah answered, “Suppose you take me back to fight the Ammonites and the LORD gives them to me—will I really be your head?”
chapters.zh: 耶弗他对基列的长老说，你们叫我回去，与亚扪人争战，耶和华把他交给我，我可以作你们的领袖吗？

chapters.en: The elders of Gilead replied, “The LORD is our witness; we will certainly do as you say.”
chapters.zh: 基列的长老回答耶弗他说，有耶和华在你我中间作见证，我们必定照你的话行。

chapters.en: So Jephthah went with the elders of Gilead, and the people made him head and commander over them. And he repeated all his words before the LORD in Mizpah.
chapters.zh: 于是耶弗他同基列的长老回去，百姓就立耶弗他作领袖，作元帅。耶弗他在米斯巴将自己的一切话陈明在耶和华面前。

chapters.en: Then Jephthah sent messengers to the Ammonite king with the question: “What do you have against me that you have attacked my country?”
chapters.zh: 耶弗他打发使者去见亚扪人的王，说，你与我有什么相干，竟来到我国中攻打我呢？

chapters.en: The king of the Ammonites answered Jephthah’s messengers, “When Israel came up out of Egypt, they took away my land from the Arnon to the Jabbok, all the way to the Jordan. Now give it back peaceably.”
chapters.zh: 亚扪人的王回答耶弗他的使者说，因为以色列人从埃及上来的时候占据我的地，从亚嫩河到雅博河，直到约旦河。现在你要好好地将这地归还吧。

chapters.en: Jephthah sent back messengers to the Ammonite king,
chapters.zh: 耶弗他又打发使者去见亚扪人的王，

chapters.en: saying: “This is what Jephthah says: Israel did not take the land of Moab or the land of the Ammonites.
chapters.zh: 对他说，耶弗他如此说，以色列人并没有占据摩押地和亚扪人的地。

chapters.en: But when they came up out of Egypt, Israel went through the wilderness to the Red Sea and on to Kadesh.
chapters.zh: 以色列人从埃及上来乃是经过旷野到红海，来到加低斯，

chapters.en: Then Israel sent messengers to the king of Edom, saying, ‘Give us permission to go through your country,’ but the king of Edom would not listen. They sent also to the king of Moab, and he refused. So Israel stayed at Kadesh.
chapters.zh: 就打发使者去见以东王，说，求你容我从你的地经过。以东王却不应允。又照样打发使者去见摩押王，他也不允准。以色列人就住在加低斯。
