chapters.en: Once when they had finished eating and drinking in Shiloh, Hannah stood up. Now Eli the priest was sitting on his chair by the doorpost of the LORD’s house.
chapters.zh: 他们在示罗吃喝完了，哈拿就站起来。祭司以利在耶和华殿的门框旁边，坐在自己的位上。

chapters.en: In her deep anguish Hannah prayed to the LORD, weeping bitterly.
chapters.zh: 哈拿心里愁苦，就痛痛哭泣，祈祷耶和华，

chapters.en: And she made a vow, saying, “LORD Almighty, if you will only look on your servant’s misery and remember me, and not forget your servant but give her a son, then I will give him to the LORD for all the days of his life, and no razor will ever be used on his head.”
chapters.zh: 许愿说，万军之耶和华阿，你若垂顾婢女的苦情，眷念不忘婢女，赐我一个儿子，我必使他终身归与耶和华，不用剃头刀剃他的头。

chapters.en: As she kept on praying to the LORD, Eli observed her mouth.
chapters.zh: 哈拿在耶和华面前不住地祈祷，以利定睛看她的嘴。

chapters.en: Hannah was praying in her heart, and her lips were moving but her voice was not heard. Eli thought she was drunk
chapters.zh: 原来哈拿心中默祷，只动嘴唇，不出声音，因此以利以为她喝醉了。

chapters.en: and said to her, “How long are you going to stay drunk? Put away your wine.”
chapters.zh: 以利对她说，你要醉到几时呢？你不应该喝酒。

chapters.en: “Not so, my lord,” Hannah replied, “I am a woman who is deeply troubled. I have not been drinking wine or beer; I was pouring out my soul to the LORD.
chapters.zh: 哈拿回答说，主阿，不是这样。我是心里愁苦的妇人，清酒浓酒都没有喝，但在耶和华面前倾心吐意。

chapters.en: Do not take your servant for a wicked woman; I have been praying here out of my great anguish and grief.”
chapters.zh: 不要将婢女看作不正经的女子。我因被人激动，愁苦太多，所以祈求到如今。

chapters.en: Eli answered, “Go in peace, and may the God of Israel grant you what you have asked of him.”
chapters.zh: 以利说，你可以平平安安地回去。愿以色列的神允准你向他所求的。

chapters.en: She said, “May your servant find favor in your eyes.” Then she went her way and ate something, and her face was no longer downcast.
chapters.zh: 哈拿说，愿婢女在你眼前蒙恩。于是妇人走去吃饭，面上再不带愁容了。

chapters.en: Early the next morning they arose and worshiped before the LORD and then went back to their home at Ramah. Elkanah made love to his wife Hannah, and the LORD remembered her.
chapters.zh: 次日清早，他们起来，在耶和华面前敬拜，就回拉玛。到了家里，以利加拿和妻哈拿同房，耶和华顾念哈拿，

chapters.en: So in the course of time Hannah became pregnant and gave birth to a son. She named him Samuel, saying, “Because I asked the LORD for him.”
chapters.zh: 哈拿就怀孕。日期满足，生了一个儿子，给他起名叫撒母耳，说，这是我从耶和华那里求来的。

chapters.en: When her husband Elkanah went up with all his family to offer the annual sacrifice to the LORD and to fulfill his vow,
chapters.zh: 以利加拿和他全家都上示罗去，要向耶和华献年祭，并还所许的愿。

chapters.en: Hannah did not go. She said to her husband, “After the boy is weaned, I will take him and present him before the LORD, and he will live there always.”
chapters.zh: 哈拿却没有上去，对丈夫说，等孩子断了奶，我便带他上去朝见耶和华，使他永远住在那里。

chapters.en: “Do what seems best to you,” her husband Elkanah told her. “Stay here until you have weaned him; only may the LORD make good his word.” So the woman stayed at home and nursed her son until she had weaned him.
chapters.zh: 她丈夫以利加拿说，就随你的意行吧。可以等儿子断了奶。但愿耶和华应验他的话。于是妇人在家里乳养儿子，直到断了奶。

chapters.en: After he was weaned, she took the boy with her, young as he was, along with a three-year-old bull, an ephah of flour and a skin of wine, and brought him to the house of the LORD at Shiloh.
chapters.zh: 既断了奶，就把孩子带上示罗，到了耶和华的殿。又带了三只公牛，一伊法细面，一皮袋酒。那时孩子还小。

chapters.en: When the bull had been sacrificed, they brought the boy to Eli,
chapters.zh: 宰了一只公牛，就领孩子到以利面前。

chapters.en: and she said to him, “Pardon me, my lord. As surely as you live, I am the woman who stood here beside you praying to the LORD.
chapters.zh: 妇人说，主阿，我敢在你面前起誓，从前在你这里站着祈求耶和华的那妇人，就是我。

chapters.en: I prayed for this child, and the LORD has granted me what I asked of him.
chapters.zh: 我祈求为要得这孩子。耶和华已将我所求的赐给我了。

chapters.en: So now I give him to the LORD. For his whole life he will be given over to the LORD.” And he worshiped the LORD there.
chapters.zh: 所以，我将这孩子归与耶和华，使他终身归与耶和华。于是在那里敬拜耶和华。

chapters.en: Then Hannah prayed and said: “My heart rejoices in the LORD; in the LORD my horn is lifted high. My mouth boasts over my enemies, for I delight in your deliverance.
chapters.zh: 哈拿祷告说，我的心因耶和华快乐。我的角因耶和华高举。我的口向仇敌张开。我因耶和华的救恩欢欣。

chapters.en: “There is no one holy like the LORD; there is no one besides you; there is no Rock like our God.
chapters.zh: 只有耶和华为圣。除他以外没有可比的，也没有磐石像我们的神。

chapters.en: “Do not keep talking so proudly or let your mouth speak such arrogance, for the LORD is a God who knows, and by him deeds are weighed.
chapters.zh: 人不要夸口说骄傲的话，也不要出狂妄的言语。因耶和华是大有智识的神，人的行为被他衡量。

chapters.en: “The bows of the warriors are broken, but those who stumbled are armed with strength.
chapters.zh: 勇士的弓都已折断。跌倒的人以力量束腰。

chapters.en: Those who were full hire themselves out for food, but those who were hungry are hungry no more. She who was barren has borne seven children, but she who has had many sons pines away.
chapters.zh: 素来饱足的，反作佣人求食。饥饿的，再不饥饿。不生育的，生了七个儿子。多有儿女的，反倒衰微。

chapters.en: “The LORD brings death and makes alive; he brings down to the grave and raises up.
chapters.zh: 耶和华使人死，也使人活，使人下阴间，也使人往上升。

chapters.en: The LORD sends poverty and wealth; he humbles and he exalts.
chapters.zh: 他使人贫穷，也使人富足，使人卑微，也使人高贵。

chapters.en: He raises the poor from the dust and lifts the needy from the ash heap; he seats them with princes and has them inherit a throne of honor. “For the foundations of the earth are the LORD’s; on them he has set the world.
chapters.zh: 他从灰尘里抬举贫寒人，从粪堆中提拔穷乏人，使他们与王子同坐，得着荣耀的座位。地的柱子属于耶和华。他将世界立在其上。

chapters.en: He will guard the feet of his faithful servants, but the wicked will be silenced in the place of darkness. “It is not by strength that one prevails;
chapters.zh: 他必保护圣民的脚步，使恶人在黑暗中寂然不动。人都不能靠力量得胜。

chapters.en: those who oppose the LORD will be broken. The Most High will thunder from heaven; the LORD will judge the ends of the earth. “He will give strength to his king and exalt the horn of his anointed.”
chapters.zh: 与耶和华争竞的，必被打碎。耶和华必从天上以雷攻击他，必审判地极的人，将力量赐与所立的王，高举受膏者的角。

chapters.en: Then Elkanah went home to Ramah, but the boy ministered before the LORD under Eli the priest.
chapters.zh: 以利加拿往拉玛回家去了。那孩子在祭司以利面前事奉耶和华。

chapters.en: Eli’s sons were scoundrels; they had no regard for the LORD.
chapters.zh: 以利的两个儿子是恶人，不认识耶和华。

chapters.en: Now it was the practice of the priests that, whenever any of the people offered a sacrifice, the priest’s servant would come with a three-pronged fork in his hand while the meat was being boiled
chapters.zh: 这二祭司待百姓是这样的规矩，凡有人献祭，正煮肉的时候，祭司的仆人就来，手拿三齿的叉子，

chapters.en: and would plunge the fork into the pan or kettle or caldron or pot. Whatever the fork brought up the priest would take for himself. This is how they treated all the Israelites who came to Shiloh.
chapters.zh: 将叉子往罐里，或鼎里，或釜里，或锅里一插，插上来的肉，祭司都取了去。凡上到示罗的以色列人，他们都是这样看待。

chapters.en: But even before the fat was burned, the priest’s servant would come and say to the person who was sacrificing, “Give the priest some meat to roast; he won’t accept boiled meat from you, but only raw.”
chapters.zh: 又在未烧脂油以前，祭司的仆人就来对献祭的人说，将肉给祭司，叫他烤吧。他不要煮过的，要生的。

chapters.en: If the person said to him, “Let the fat be burned first, and then take whatever you want,” the servant would answer, “No, hand it over now; if you don’t, I’ll take it by force.”
chapters.zh: 献祭的人若说，必须先烧脂油，然后你可以随意取肉。仆人就说，你立时给我，不然我便抢去。

chapters.en: This sin of the young men was very great in the LORD’s sight, for they were treating the LORD’s offering with contempt.
chapters.zh: 如此，这二少年人的罪在耶和华面前甚重了，因为他们藐视耶和华的祭物（或作他们使人厌弃给耶和华献祭）。

chapters.en: But Samuel was ministering before the LORD—a boy wearing a linen ephod.
chapters.zh: 那时，撒母耳还是孩子，穿着细麻布的以弗得，侍立在耶和华面前。

chapters.en: Each year his mother made him a little robe and took it to him when she went up with her husband to offer the annual sacrifice.
chapters.zh: 他母亲每年为他作一件小外袍，同着丈夫上来献年祭的时候带来给他。

chapters.en: Eli would bless Elkanah and his wife, saying, “May the LORD give you children by this woman to take the place of the one she prayed for and gave to the LORD.” Then they would go home.
chapters.zh: 以利为以利加拿和他的妻祝福，说，愿耶和华由这妇人再赐你后裔，代替你从耶和华求来的孩子。他们就回本乡去了。

chapters.en: And the LORD was gracious to Hannah; she gave birth to three sons and two daughters. Meanwhile, the boy Samuel grew up in the presence of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 耶和华眷顾哈拿，她就怀孕生了三个儿子，两个女儿。那孩子撒母耳在耶和华面前渐渐长大。

chapters.en: Now Eli, who was very old, heard about everything his sons were doing to all Israel and how they slept with the women who served at the entrance to the tent of meeting.
chapters.zh: 以利年甚老迈，听见他两个儿子待以色列众人的事，又听见他们与会幕门前伺候的妇人苟合，

chapters.en: So he said to them, “Why do you do such things? I hear from all the people about these wicked deeds of yours.
chapters.zh: 他就对他们说，你们为何行这样的事呢？我从这众百姓听见你们的恶行。

chapters.en: No, my sons; the report I hear spreading among the LORD’s people is not good.
chapters.zh: 我儿阿，不可这样。我听见你们的风声不好，你们使耶和华的百姓犯了罪。

chapters.en: If one person sins against another, God may mediate for the offender; but if anyone sins against the LORD, who will intercede for them?” His sons, however, did not listen to their father’s rebuke, for it was the LORD’s will to put them to death.
chapters.zh: 人若得罪人，有士师审判他。人若得罪耶和华，谁能为他祈求呢？然而他们还是不听父亲的话，因为耶和华想要杀他们。

chapters.en: And the boy Samuel continued to grow in stature and in favor with the LORD and with people.
chapters.zh: 孩子撒母耳渐渐长大，耶和华与人越发喜爱他。

chapters.en: Now a man of God came to Eli and said to him, “This is what the LORD says: ‘Did I not clearly reveal myself to your ancestor’s family when they were in Egypt under Pharaoh?
chapters.zh: 有神人来见以利，对他说，耶和华如此说，你祖父在埃及法老家作奴仆的时候，我不是向他们显现吗？

chapters.en: I chose your ancestor out of all the tribes of Israel to be my priest, to go up to my altar, to burn incense, and to wear an ephod in my presence. I also gave your ancestor’s family all the food offerings presented by the Israelites.
chapters.zh: 在以色列众支派中，我不是拣选人作我的祭司，使他烧香，在我坛上献祭，在我面前穿以弗得，又将以色列人所献的火祭都赐给你父家吗？

chapters.en: Why do you scorn my sacrifice and offering that I prescribed for my dwelling? Why do you honor your sons more than me by fattening yourselves on the choice parts of every offering made by my people Israel?’
chapters.zh: 我所吩咐献在我居所的祭物，你们为何践踏。尊重你的儿子过于尊重我，将我民以色列所献美好的祭物肥己呢？

chapters.en: “Therefore the LORD, the God of Israel, declares: ‘I promised that members of your family would minister before me forever.’ But now the LORD declares: ‘Far be it from me! Those who honor me I will honor, but those who despise me will be disdained.
chapters.zh: 因此，耶和华以色列的神说，我曾说，你和你父家必永远行在我面前。现在我却说，决不容你们这样行。因为尊重我的，我必重看他。藐视我的，他必被轻视。

chapters.en: The time is coming when I will cut short your strength and the strength of your priestly house, so that no one in it will reach old age,
chapters.zh: 日子必到，我要折断你的膀臂和你父家的膀臂，使你家中没有一个老年人。

chapters.en: and you will see distress in my dwelling. Although good will be done to Israel, no one in your family line will ever reach old age.
chapters.zh: 在神使以色列人享福的时候，你必看见我居所的败落。在你家中必永远没有一个老年人。

chapters.en: Every one of you that I do not cut off from serving at my altar I will spare only to destroy your sight and sap your strength, and all your descendants will die in the prime of life.
chapters.zh: 我必不从我坛前灭尽你家中的人。那未灭的必使你眼目干瘪，心中忧伤。你家中所生的人都必死在中年。

chapters.en: “ ‘And what happens to your two sons, Hophni and Phinehas, will be a sign to you—they will both die on the same day.
chapters.zh: 你的两个儿子何弗尼，非尼哈所遭遇的事可作你的证据，他们二人必一日同死。

chapters.en: I will raise up for myself a faithful priest, who will do according to what is in my heart and mind. I will firmly establish his priestly house, and they will minister before my anointed one always.
chapters.zh: 我要为自己立一个忠心的祭司。他必照我的心意而行。我要为他建立坚固的家。他必永远行在我的受膏者面前。

chapters.en: Then everyone left in your family line will come and bow down before him for a piece of silver and a loaf of bread and plead, “Appoint me to some priestly office so I can have food to eat.” ’ ”
chapters.zh: 你家所剩下的人都必来叩拜他，求块银子，求个饼，说，求你赐我祭司的职分，好叫我得点饼吃。

chapters.en: The boy Samuel ministered before the LORD under Eli. In those days the word of the LORD was rare; there were not many visions.
chapters.zh: 童子撒母耳在以利面前事奉耶和华。当那些日子，耶和华的言语稀少，不常有默示。

chapters.en: One night Eli, whose eyes were becoming so weak that he could barely see, was lying down in his usual place.
chapters.zh: 一日，以利睡卧在自己的地方。他眼目昏花，看不分明。

chapters.en: The lamp of God had not yet gone out, and Samuel was lying down in the house of the LORD, where the ark of God was.
chapters.zh: 神的灯在神耶和华殿内约柜那里，还没有熄灭，撒母耳已经睡了。

chapters.en: Then the LORD called Samuel. Samuel answered, “Here I am.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华呼唤撒母耳。撒母耳说，我在这里。

chapters.en: And he ran to Eli and said, “Here I am; you called me.” But Eli said, “I did not call; go back and lie down.” So he went and lay down.
chapters.zh: 就跑到以利那里，说，你呼唤我。我在这里。以利回答说，我没有呼唤你，你去睡吧。他就去睡了。

chapters.en: Again the LORD called, “Samuel!” And Samuel got up and went to Eli and said, “Here I am; you called me.” “My son,” Eli said, “I did not call; go back and lie down.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华又呼唤撒母耳。撒母耳起来，到以利那里，说，你呼唤我。我在这里。以利回答说，我的儿，我没有呼唤你，你去睡吧。

chapters.en: Now Samuel did not yet know the LORD: The word of the LORD had not yet been revealed to him.
chapters.zh: 那时撒母耳还未认识耶和华，也未得耶和华的默示。

chapters.en: A third time the LORD called, “Samuel!” And Samuel got up and went to Eli and said, “Here I am; you called me.” Then Eli realized that the LORD was calling the boy.
chapters.zh: 耶和华第三次呼唤撒母耳。撒母耳起来，到以利那里，说，你又呼唤我。我在这里。以利才明白是耶和华呼唤童子。

chapters.en: So Eli told Samuel, “Go and lie down, and if he calls you, say, ‘Speak, LORD, for your servant is listening.’ ” So Samuel went and lay down in his place.
chapters.zh: 因此以利对撒母耳说，你仍去睡吧。若再呼唤你，你就说，耶和华阿，请说，仆人敬听。撒母耳就去，仍睡在原处。

chapters.en: The LORD came and stood there, calling as at the other times, “Samuel! Samuel!” Then Samuel said, “Speak, for your servant is listening.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华又来站着，像前三次呼唤说，撒母耳阿。撒母耳阿。撒母耳回答说，请说，仆人敬听。

chapters.en: And the LORD said to Samuel: “See, I am about to do something in Israel that will make the ears of everyone who hears about it tingle.
chapters.zh: 耶和华对撒母耳说，我在以色列中必行一件事，叫听见的人都必耳鸣。

chapters.en: At that time I will carry out against Eli everything I spoke against his family—from beginning to end.
chapters.zh: 我指着以利家所说的话，到了时候，我必始终应验在以利身上。

chapters.en: For I told him that I would judge his family forever because of the sin he knew about; his sons blasphemed God, and he failed to restrain them.
chapters.zh: 我曾告诉他必永远降罚与他的家，因他知道儿子作孽，自招咒诅，却不禁止他们。

chapters.en: Therefore I swore to the house of Eli, ‘The guilt of Eli’s house will never be atoned for by sacrifice or offering.’ ”
chapters.zh: 所以我向以利家起誓说，以利家的罪孽，虽献祭奉礼物，永不能得赎去。

chapters.en: Samuel lay down until morning and then opened the doors of the house of the LORD. He was afraid to tell Eli the vision,
chapters.zh: 撒母耳睡到天亮，就开了耶和华的殿门，不敢将默示告诉以利。

chapters.en: but Eli called him and said, “Samuel, my son.” Samuel answered, “Here I am.”
chapters.zh: 以利呼唤撒母耳说，我儿撒母耳阿。撒母耳回答说，我在这里。

chapters.en: “What was it he said to you?” Eli asked. “Do not hide it from me. May God deal with you, be it ever so severely, if you hide from me anything he told you.”
chapters.zh: 以利说，耶和华对你说什么，你不要向我隐瞒。你若将神对你所说的隐瞒一句，愿他重重地降罚与你。

chapters.en: So Samuel told him everything, hiding nothing from him. Then Eli said, “He is the LORD; let him do what is good in his eyes.”
chapters.zh: 撒母耳就把一切话都告诉了以利，并没有隐瞒。以利说，这是出于耶和华，愿他凭自己的意旨而行。

chapters.en: The LORD was with Samuel as he grew up, and he let none of Samuel’s words fall to the ground.
chapters.zh: 撒母耳长大了，耶和华与他同在，使他所说的话一句都不落空。

chapters.en: And all Israel from Dan to Beersheba recognized that Samuel was attested as a prophet of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 从但到别是巴所有的以色列人，都知道耶和华立撒母耳为先知。

chapters.en: The LORD continued to appear at Shiloh, and there he revealed himself to Samuel through his word.
chapters.zh: 耶和华又在示罗显现。因为耶和华将自己的话默示撒母耳，撒母耳就把这话传遍以色列地。

chapters.en: And Samuel’s word came to all Israel. Now the Israelites went out to fight against the Philistines. The Israelites camped at Ebenezer, and the Philistines at Aphek.
chapters.zh: 以色列人出去与非利士人打仗，安营在以便以谢。非利士人安营在亚弗。

chapters.en: The Philistines deployed their forces to meet Israel, and as the battle spread, Israel was defeated by the Philistines, who killed about four thousand of them on the battlefield.
chapters.zh: 非利士人向以色列人摆阵。两军交战的时候，以色列人败在非利士人面前。非利士人在战场上杀了他们的军兵约有四千人。

chapters.en: When the soldiers returned to camp, the elders of Israel asked, “Why did the LORD bring defeat on us today before the Philistines? Let us bring the ark of the LORD’s covenant from Shiloh, so that he may go with us and save us from the hand of our enemies.”
chapters.zh: 百姓回到营里，以色列的长老说，耶和华今日为何使我们败在非利士人面前呢？我们不如将耶和华的约柜从示罗抬到我们这里来，好在我们中间救我们脱离敌人的手。

chapters.en: So the people sent men to Shiloh, and they brought back the ark of the covenant of the LORD Almighty, who is enthroned between the cherubim. And Eli’s two sons, Hophni and Phinehas, were there with the ark of the covenant of God.
chapters.zh: 于是百姓打发人到示罗，从那里将坐在二基路伯上万军之耶和华的约柜抬来。以利的两个儿子何弗尼，非尼哈与神的约柜同来。

chapters.en: When the ark of the LORD’s covenant came into the camp, all Israel raised such a great shout that the ground shook.
chapters.zh: 耶和华的约柜到了营中，以色列众人就大声欢呼，地便震动。

chapters.en: Hearing the uproar, the Philistines asked, “What’s all this shouting in the Hebrew camp?” When they learned that the ark of the LORD had come into the camp,
chapters.zh: 非利士人听见欢呼的声音，就说，在希伯来人营里大声欢呼，是什么缘故呢？随后就知道耶和华的约柜到了营中。

chapters.en: the Philistines were afraid. “A god has come into the camp,” they said. “Oh no! Nothing like this has happened before.
chapters.zh: 非利士人就惧怕起来，说，有神到了他们营中。又说，我们有祸了。向来不曾有这样的事。

chapters.en: We’re doomed! Who will deliver us from the hand of these mighty gods? They are the gods who struck the Egyptians with all kinds of plagues in the wilderness.
chapters.zh: 我们有祸了。谁能救我们脱离这些大能之神的手呢？从前在旷野用各样灾殃击打埃及人的，就是这些神。

chapters.en: Be strong, Philistines! Be men, or you will be subject to the Hebrews, as they have been to you. Be men, and fight!”
chapters.zh: 非利士人哪，你们要刚强，要作大丈夫，免得作希伯来人的奴仆，如同他们作你们的奴仆一样。你们要作大丈夫，与他们争战。

chapters.en: So the Philistines fought, and the Israelites were defeated and every man fled to his tent. The slaughter was very great; Israel lost thirty thousand foot soldiers.
chapters.zh: 非利士人和以色列人打仗，以色列人败了，各向各家奔逃，被杀的人甚多，以色列的步兵仆倒了三万。

chapters.en: The ark of God was captured, and Eli’s two sons, Hophni and Phinehas, died.
chapters.zh: 神的约柜被掳去，以利的两个儿子何弗尼，非尼哈也都被杀了。

chapters.en: That same day a Benjamite ran from the battle line and went to Shiloh with his clothes torn and dust on his head.
chapters.zh: 当日，有一个便雅悯人从阵上逃跑，衣服撕裂，头蒙灰尘，来到示罗。

chapters.en: When he arrived, there was Eli sitting on his chair by the side of the road, watching, because his heart feared for the ark of God. When the man entered the town and told what had happened, the whole town sent up a cry.
chapters.zh: 到了的时候，以利正在道旁坐在自己的位上观望，为神的约柜心里担忧。那人进城报信，合城的人就都呼喊起来。

chapters.en: Eli heard the outcry and asked, “What is the meaning of this uproar?” The man hurried over to Eli,
chapters.zh: 以利听见呼喊的声音就问说，这喧嚷是什么缘故呢？那人急忙来报信给以利。

chapters.en: who was ninety-eight years old and whose eyes had failed so that he could not see.
chapters.zh: 那时以利九十八岁了，眼目发直，不能看见。

chapters.en: He told Eli, “I have just come from the battle line; I fled from it this very day.” Eli asked, “What happened, my son?”
chapters.zh: 那人对以利说，我是从阵上来的，今日我从阵上逃回。以利说，我儿，事情怎样。

chapters.en: The man who brought the news replied, “Israel fled before the Philistines, and the army has suffered heavy losses. Also your two sons, Hophni and Phinehas, are dead, and the ark of God has been captured.”
chapters.zh: 报信的回答说，以色列人在非利士人面前逃跑，民中被杀的甚多。你的两个儿子何弗尼，非尼哈也都死了，并且神的约柜被掳去。

chapters.en: When he mentioned the ark of God, Eli fell backward off his chair by the side of the gate. His neck was broken and he died, for he was an old man, and he was heavy. He had led Israel forty years.
chapters.zh: 他一提神的约柜，以利就从他的位上往后跌倒，在门旁折断颈项而死。因为他年纪老迈，身体沉重。以利作以色列的士师四十年。

chapters.en: His daughter-in-law, the wife of Phinehas, was pregnant and near the time of delivery. When she heard the news that the ark of God had been captured and that her father-in-law and her husband were dead, she went into labor and gave birth, but was overcome by her labor pains.
chapters.zh: 以利的儿妇，非尼哈的妻怀孕将到产期，她听见神的约柜被掳去，公公和丈夫都死了，就猛然疼痛，曲身生产。

chapters.en: As she was dying, the women attending her said, “Don’t despair; you have given birth to a son.” But she did not respond or pay any attention.
chapters.zh: 将要死的时候，旁边站着的妇人们对她说，不要怕。你生了男孩子了。她却不回答，也不放在心上。

chapters.en: She named the boy Ichabod, saying, “The Glory has departed from Israel”—because of the capture of the ark of God and the deaths of her father-in-law and her husband.
chapters.zh: 她给孩子起名叫以迦博，说，荣耀离开以色列了。这是因神的约柜被掳去，又因她公公和丈夫都死了。

chapters.en: She said, “The Glory has departed from Israel, for the ark of God has been captured.”
chapters.zh: 她又说，荣耀离开以色列，因为神的约柜被掳去了。

chapters.en: After the Philistines had captured the ark of God, they took it from Ebenezer to Ashdod.
chapters.zh: 非利士人将神的约柜从以便以谢抬到亚实突。

chapters.en: Then they carried the ark into Dagon’s temple and set it beside Dagon.
chapters.zh: 非利士人将神的约柜抬进大衮庙，放在大衮的旁边。

chapters.en: When the people of Ashdod rose early the next day, there was Dagon, fallen on his face on the ground before the ark of the LORD! They took Dagon and put him back in his place.
chapters.zh: 次日清早，亚实突人起来，见大衮仆倒在耶和华的约柜前，脸伏于地，就把大衮仍立在原处。

chapters.en: But the following morning when they rose, there was Dagon, fallen on his face on the ground before the ark of the LORD! His head and hands had been broken off and were lying on the threshold; only his body remained.
chapters.zh: 又次日清早起来，见大衮仆倒在耶和华的约柜前，脸伏于地，并且大衮的头和两手都在门槛上折断，只剩下大衮的残体。

chapters.en: That is why to this day neither the priests of Dagon nor any others who enter Dagon’s temple at Ashdod step on the threshold.
chapters.zh: 因此，大衮的祭司和一切进亚实突，大衮庙的人都不踏大衮庙的门槛，直到今日。

chapters.en: The LORD’s hand was heavy on the people of Ashdod and its vicinity; he brought devastation on them and afflicted them with tumors.
chapters.zh: 耶和华的手重重加在亚实突人身上，败坏他们，使他们生痔疮。亚实突和亚实突的四境都是如此。

chapters.en: When the people of Ashdod saw what was happening, they said, “The ark of the god of Israel must not stay here with us, because his hand is heavy on us and on Dagon our god.”
chapters.zh: 亚实突人见这光景，就说，以色列神的约柜不可留在我们这里，因为他的手重重加在我们和我们神大衮的身上。

chapters.en: So they called together all the rulers of the Philistines and asked them, “What shall we do with the ark of the god of Israel?” They answered, “Have the ark of the god of Israel moved to Gath.” So they moved the ark of the God of Israel.
chapters.zh: 就打发人去请非利士的众首领来聚集，问他们说，我们向以色列神的约柜应当怎样行呢？他们回答说，可以将以色列神的约柜运到迦特去。于是将以色列神的约柜运到那里去。

chapters.en: But after they had moved it, the LORD’s hand was against that city, throwing it into a great panic. He afflicted the people of the city, both young and old, with an outbreak of tumors.
chapters.zh: 运到之后，耶和华的手攻击那城，使那城的人大大惊慌，无论大小都生痔疮。

chapters.en: So they sent the ark of God to Ekron. As the ark of God was entering Ekron, the people of Ekron cried out, “They have brought the ark of the god of Israel around to us to kill us and our people.”
chapters.zh: 他们就把神的约柜送到以革伦。神的约柜到了，以革伦人就喊嚷起来说，他们将以色列神的约柜运到我们这里，要害我们和我们的众民。

chapters.en: So they called together all the rulers of the Philistines and said, “Send the ark of the god of Israel away; let it go back to its own place, or it will kill us and our people.” For death had filled the city with panic; God’s hand was very heavy on it.
chapters.zh: 于是打发人去请非利士的众首领来，说，愿你们将以色列神的约柜送回原处，免得害了我们和我们的众民。原来神的手重重攻击那城，城中的人有因惊慌而死的。

chapters.en: Those who did not die were afflicted with tumors, and the outcry of the city went up to heaven.
chapters.zh: 未曾死的人都生了痔疮。合城呼号，声音上达于天。

chapters.en: When the ark of the LORD had been in Philistine territory seven months,
chapters.zh: 耶和华的约柜在非利士人之地七个月。

chapters.en: the Philistines called for the priests and the diviners and said, “What shall we do with the ark of the LORD? Tell us how we should send it back to its place.”
chapters.zh: 非利士人将祭司和占卜的聚了来，问他们说，我们向耶和华的约柜应当怎样行。请指示我们用何法将约柜送回原处。

chapters.en: They answered, “If you return the ark of the god of Israel, do not send it back to him without a gift; by all means send a guilt offering to him. Then you will be healed, and you will know why his hand has not been lifted from you.”
chapters.zh: 他们说，若要将以色列神的约柜送回去，不可空空地送去，必要给他献赔罪的礼物，然后你们可得痊愈，并知道他的手为何不离开你们。

chapters.en: The Philistines asked, “What guilt offering should we send to him?” They replied, “Five gold tumors and five gold rats, according to the number of the Philistine rulers, because the same plague has struck both you and your rulers.
chapters.zh: 非利士人说，应当用什么献为赔罪的礼物呢？他们回答说，当照非利士首领的数目，用五个金痔疮，五个金老鼠，因为在你们众人和你们首领的身上都是一样的灾。

chapters.en: Make models of the tumors and of the rats that are destroying the country, and give glory to Israel’s god. Perhaps he will lift his hand from you and your gods and your land.
chapters.zh: 所以当制造你们痔疮的像和毁坏你们田地老鼠的像，并要归荣耀给以色列的神，或者他向你们和你们的神，并你们的田地，把手放轻些。

chapters.en: Why do you harden your hearts as the Egyptians and Pharaoh did? When Israel’s god dealt harshly with them, did they not send the Israelites out so they could go on their way?
chapters.zh: 你们为何硬着心像埃及人和法老一样呢？神在埃及人中间行奇事，埃及人岂不释放以色列人，他们就去了吗？

chapters.en: “Now then, get a new cart ready, with two cows that have calved and have never been yoked. Hitch the cows to the cart, but take their calves away and pen them up.
chapters.zh: 现在你们应当造一辆新车，将两只未曾负轭有乳的母牛套在车上，使牛犊回家去，离开母牛。

chapters.en: Take the ark of the LORD and put it on the cart, and in a chest beside it put the gold objects you are sending back to him as a guilt offering. Send it on its way,
chapters.zh: 把耶和华的约柜放在车上，将所献赔罪的金物装在匣子里，放在柜旁，将柜送去。

chapters.en: but keep watching it. If it goes up to its own territory, toward Beth Shemesh, then the LORD has brought this great disaster on us. But if it does not, then we will know that it was not his hand that struck us but that it happened to us by chance.”
chapters.zh: 你们要看看，车若直行以色列的境界到伯示麦去，这大灾就是耶和华降在我们身上的。若不然，便可以知道不是他的手击打我们，是我们偶然遇见的。

chapters.en: So they did this. They took two such cows and hitched them to the cart and penned up their calves.
chapters.zh: 非利士人就这样行，将两只有乳的母牛套在车上，将牛犊关在家里，

chapters.en: They placed the ark of the LORD on the cart and along with it the chest containing the gold rats and the models of the tumors.
chapters.zh: 把耶和华的约柜和装金老鼠并金痔疮像的匣子都放在车上。

chapters.en: Then the cows went straight up toward Beth Shemesh, keeping on the road and lowing all the way; they did not turn to the right or to the left. The rulers of the Philistines followed them as far as the border of Beth Shemesh.
chapters.zh: 牛直行大道，往伯示麦去，一面走一面叫，不偏左右。非利士的首领跟在后面，直到伯示麦的境界。

chapters.en: Now the people of Beth Shemesh were harvesting their wheat in the valley, and when they looked up and saw the ark, they rejoiced at the sight.
chapters.zh: 伯示麦人正在平原收割麦子，举目看见约柜，就欢喜了。

chapters.en: The cart came to the field of Joshua of Beth Shemesh, and there it stopped beside a large rock. The people chopped up the wood of the cart and sacrificed the cows as a burnt offering to the LORD.
chapters.zh: 车到了伯示麦人约书亚的田间，就站住了。在那里有一块大磐石，他们把车劈了，将两只母牛献给耶和华为燔祭。

chapters.en: The Levites took down the ark of the LORD, together with the chest containing the gold objects, and placed them on the large rock. On that day the people of Beth Shemesh offered burnt offerings and made sacrifices to the LORD.
chapters.zh: 利未人将耶和华的约柜和装金物的匣子拿下来，放在大磐石上。当日伯示麦人将燔祭和平安祭献给耶和华。

chapters.en: The five rulers of the Philistines saw all this and then returned that same day to Ekron.
chapters.zh: 非利士人的五个首领看见，当日就回以革伦去了。

chapters.en: These are the gold tumors the Philistines sent as a guilt offering to the LORD—one each for Ashdod, Gaza, Ashkelon, Gath and Ekron.
chapters.zh: 非利士人献给耶和华作赔罪的金痔疮像，就是这些，一个是为亚实突，一个是为迦萨，一个是为亚实基伦，一个是为迦特，一个是为以革伦。

chapters.en: And the number of the gold rats was according to the number of Philistine towns belonging to the five rulers—the fortified towns with their country villages. The large rock on which the Levites set the ark of the LORD is a witness to this day in the field of Joshua of Beth Shemesh.
chapters.zh: 金老鼠的数目是照非利士五个首领的城邑，就是坚固的城邑和乡村，以及大磐石。这磐石是放耶和华约柜的，到今日还在伯示麦人约书亚的田间。

chapters.en: But God struck down some of the inhabitants of Beth Shemesh, putting seventy of them to death because they looked into the ark of the LORD. The people mourned because of the heavy blow the LORD had dealt them.
chapters.zh: 耶和华因伯示麦人擅观他的约柜，就击杀了他们七十人。那时有五万人在那里（原文作七十人加五万人）。百姓因耶和华大大击杀他们，就哀哭了。

chapters.en: And the people of Beth Shemesh asked, “Who can stand in the presence of the LORD, this holy God? To whom will the ark go up from here?”
chapters.zh: 伯示麦人说，谁能在耶和华这圣洁的神面前侍立呢？这约柜可以从我们这里送到谁那里去呢？

chapters.en: Then they sent messengers to the people of Kiriath Jearim, saying, “The Philistines have returned the ark of the LORD. Come down and take it up to your town.”
chapters.zh: 于是打发人去见基列耶琳的居民，说，非利士人将耶和华的约柜送回来了，你们下来将约柜接到你们那里去吧。

chapters.en: So the men of Kiriath Jearim came and took up the ark of the LORD. They brought it to Abinadab’s house on the hill and consecrated Eleazar his son to guard the ark of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 基列耶琳人就下来，将耶和华的约柜接上去，放在山上亚比拿达的家中，分派他儿子以利亚撒看守耶和华的约柜。

chapters.en: The ark remained at Kiriath Jearim a long time—twenty years in all. Then all the people of Israel turned back to the LORD.
chapters.zh: 约柜在基列耶琳许久。过了二十年，以色列全家都倾向耶和华。

chapters.en: So Samuel said to all the Israelites, “If you are returning to the LORD with all your hearts, then rid yourselves of the foreign gods and the Ashtoreths and commit yourselves to the LORD and serve him only, and he will deliver you out of the hand of the Philistines.”
chapters.zh: 撒母耳对以色列全家说，你们若一心归顺耶和华，就要把外邦的神和亚斯他录从你们中间除掉，专心归向耶和华，单单地事奉他。他必救你们脱离非利士人的手。

chapters.en: So the Israelites put away their Baals and Ashtoreths, and served the LORD only.
chapters.zh: 以色列人就除掉诸巴力和亚斯他录，单单地事奉耶和华。

chapters.en: Then Samuel said, “Assemble all Israel at Mizpah, and I will intercede with the LORD for you.”
chapters.zh: 撒母耳说，要使以色列众人聚集在米斯巴，我好为你们祷告耶和华。

chapters.en: When they had assembled at Mizpah, they drew water and poured it out before the LORD. On that day they fasted and there they confessed, “We have sinned against the LORD.” Now Samuel was serving as leader of Israel at Mizpah.
chapters.zh: 他们就聚集在米斯巴，打水浇在耶和华面前，当日禁食，说，我们得罪了耶和华。于是撒母耳在米斯巴审判以色列人。

chapters.en: When the Philistines heard that Israel had assembled at Mizpah, the rulers of the Philistines came up to attack them. When the Israelites heard of it, they were afraid because of the Philistines.
chapters.zh: 非利士人听见以色列人聚集在米斯巴，非利士的首领就上来要攻击以色列人。以色列人听见，就惧怕非利士人。

chapters.en: They said to Samuel, “Do not stop crying out to the LORD our God for us, that he may rescue us from the hand of the Philistines.”
chapters.zh: 以色列人对撒母耳说，愿你不住地为我们呼求耶和华我们的神，救我们脱离非利士人的手。

chapters.en: Then Samuel took a suckling lamb and sacrificed it as a whole burnt offering to the LORD. He cried out to the LORD on Israel’s behalf, and the LORD answered him.
chapters.zh: 撒母耳就把一只吃奶的羊羔献与耶和华作全牲的燔祭，为以色列人呼求耶和华。耶和华就应允他。

chapters.en: While Samuel was sacrificing the burnt offering, the Philistines drew near to engage Israel in battle. But that day the LORD thundered with loud thunder against the Philistines and threw them into such a panic that they were routed before the Israelites.
chapters.zh: 撒母耳正献燔祭的时候，非利士人前来要与以色列人争战。当日，耶和华大发雷声，惊乱非利士人，他们就败在以色列人面前。

chapters.en: The men of Israel rushed out of Mizpah and pursued the Philistines, slaughtering them along the way to a point below Beth Kar.
chapters.zh: 以色列人从米斯巴出来，追赶非利士人，击杀他们，直到伯甲的下边。

chapters.en: Then Samuel took a stone and set it up between Mizpah and Shen. He named it Ebenezer, saying, “Thus far the LORD has helped us.”
chapters.zh: 撒母耳将一块石头立在米斯巴和善的中间，给石头起名叫以便以谢，说，到如今耶和华都帮助我们。

chapters.en: So the Philistines were subdued and they stopped invading Israel’s territory. Throughout Samuel’s lifetime, the hand of the LORD was against the Philistines.
chapters.zh: 从此，非利士人就被制伏，不敢再入以色列人的境内。撒母耳作士师的时候，耶和华的手攻击非利士人。

chapters.en: The towns from Ekron to Gath that the Philistines had captured from Israel were restored to Israel, and Israel delivered the neighboring territory from the hands of the Philistines. And there was peace between Israel and the Amorites.
chapters.zh: 非利士人所取以色列人的城邑，从以革伦直到迦特，都归以色列人了。属这些城的四境，以色列人也从非利士人手下收回。那时以色列人与亚摩利人和好。

chapters.en: Samuel continued as Israel’s leader all the days of his life.
chapters.zh: 撒母耳平生作以色列的士师。

chapters.en: From year to year he went on a circuit from Bethel to Gilgal to Mizpah, judging Israel in all those places.
chapters.zh: 他每年巡行到伯特利，吉甲，米斯巴，在这几处审判以色列人。

chapters.en: But he always went back to Ramah, where his home was, and there he also held court for Israel. And he built an altar there to the LORD.
chapters.zh: 随后回到拉玛，因为他的家在那里。也在那里审判以色列人，且为耶和华筑了一座坛。

chapters.en: When Samuel grew old, he appointed his sons as Israel’s leaders.
chapters.zh: 撒母耳年纪老迈，就立他儿子作以色列的士师。

chapters.en: The name of his firstborn was Joel and the name of his second was Abijah, and they served at Beersheba.
chapters.zh: 长子名叫约珥，次子名叫亚比亚。他们在别是巴作士师。

chapters.en: But his sons did not follow his ways. They turned aside after dishonest gain and accepted bribes and perverted justice.
chapters.zh: 他儿子不行他的道，贪图财利，收受贿赂，屈枉正直。

chapters.en: So all the elders of Israel gathered together and came to Samuel at Ramah.
chapters.zh: 以色列的长老都聚集，来到拉玛见撒母耳，

chapters.en: They said to him, “You are old, and your sons do not follow your ways; now appoint a king to lead us, such as all the other nations have.”
chapters.zh: 对他说，你年纪老迈了，你儿子不行你的道。现在求你为我们立一个王治理我们，像列国一样。

chapters.en: But when they said, “Give us a king to lead us,” this displeased Samuel; so he prayed to the LORD.
chapters.zh: 撒母耳不喜悦他们说立一个王治理我们，他就祷告耶和华。

chapters.en: And the LORD told him: “Listen to all that the people are saying to you; it is not you they have rejected, but they have rejected me as their king.
chapters.zh: 耶和华对撒母耳说，百姓向你说的一切话，你只管依从。因为他们不是厌弃你，乃是厌弃我，不要我作他们的王。

chapters.en: As they have done from the day I brought them up out of Egypt until this day, forsaking me and serving other gods, so they are doing to you.
chapters.zh: 自从我领他们出埃及到如今，他们常常离弃我，事奉别神。现在他们向你所行的，是照他们素来所行的。

chapters.en: Now listen to them; but warn them solemnly and let them know what the king who will reign over them will claim as his rights.”
chapters.zh: 故此你要依从他们的话，只是当警戒他们，告诉他们将来那王怎样管辖他们。

chapters.en: Samuel told all the words of the LORD to the people who were asking him for a king.
chapters.zh: 撒母耳将耶和华的话都传给求他立王的百姓，说，

chapters.en: He said, “This is what the king who will reign over you will claim as his rights: He will take your sons and make them serve with his chariots and horses, and they will run in front of his chariots.
chapters.zh: 管辖你们的王必这样行，他必派你们的儿子为他赶车，跟马，奔走在车前。

chapters.en: Some he will assign to be commanders of thousands and commanders of fifties, and others to plow his ground and reap his harvest, and still others to make weapons of war and equipment for his chariots.
chapters.zh: 又派他们作千夫长，五十夫长，为他耕种田地，收割庄稼，打造军器和车上的器械。

chapters.en: He will take your daughters to be perfumers and cooks and bakers.
chapters.zh: 必取你们的女儿为他制造香膏，作饭烤饼。

chapters.en: He will take the best of your fields and vineyards and olive groves and give them to his attendants.
chapters.zh: 也必取你们最好的田地，葡萄园，橄榄园赐给他的臣仆。

chapters.en: He will take a tenth of your grain and of your vintage and give it to his officials and attendants.
chapters.zh: 你们的粮食和葡萄园所出的，他必取十分之一给他的太监和臣仆。

chapters.en: Your male and female servants and the best of your cattle and donkeys he will take for his own use.
chapters.zh: 又必取你们的仆人婢女，健壮的少年人和你们的驴，供他的差役。

chapters.en: He will take a tenth of your flocks, and you yourselves will become his slaves.
chapters.zh: 你们的羊群，他必取十分之一，你们也必作他的仆人。

chapters.en: When that day comes, you will cry out for relief from the king you have chosen, but the LORD will not answer you in that day.”
chapters.zh: 那时你们必因所选的王哀求耶和华，耶和华却不应允你们。

chapters.en: But the people refused to listen to Samuel. “No!” they said. “We want a king over us.
chapters.zh: 百姓竟不肯听撒母耳的话，说，不然。我们定要一个王治理我们，

chapters.en: Then we will be like all the other nations, with a king to lead us and to go out before us and fight our battles.”
chapters.zh: 使我们像列国一样，有王治理我们，统领我们，为我们争战。

chapters.en: When Samuel heard all that the people said, he repeated it before the LORD.
chapters.zh: 撒母耳听见百姓这一切话，就将这话陈明在耶和华面前。

chapters.en: The LORD answered, “Listen to them and give them a king.” Then Samuel said to the Israelites, “Everyone go back to your own town.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华对撒母耳说，你只管依从他们的话，为他们立王。撒母耳对以色列人说，你们各归各城去吧。

chapters.en: There was a Benjamite, a man of standing, whose name was Kish son of Abiel, the son of Zeror, the son of Bekorath, the son of Aphiah of Benjamin.
chapters.zh: 有一个便雅悯人，名叫基士，是便雅悯人亚斐亚的玄孙，比歌拉的曾孙，洗罗的孙子，亚别的儿子，是个大能的勇士（或作大财主）。

chapters.en: Kish had a son named Saul, as handsome a young man as could be found anywhere in Israel, and he was a head taller than anyone else.
chapters.zh: 他有一个儿子，名叫扫罗，又健壮，又俊美，在以色列人中没有一个能比他的。身体比众民高过一头。

chapters.en: Now the donkeys belonging to Saul’s father Kish were lost, and Kish said to his son Saul, “Take one of the servants with you and go and look for the donkeys.”
chapters.zh: 扫罗的父亲基士丢了几头驴，他就吩咐儿子扫罗说，你带一个仆人去寻找驴。

chapters.en: So he passed through the hill country of Ephraim and through the area around Shalisha, but they did not find them. They went on into the district of Shaalim, but the donkeys were not there. Then he passed through the territory of Benjamin, but they did not find them.
chapters.zh: 扫罗就走过以法莲山地，又过沙利沙地，都没有找着。又过沙琳地，驴也不在那里。又过便雅悯地，还没有找着。

chapters.en: When they reached the district of Zuph, Saul said to the servant who was with him, “Come, let’s go back, or my father will stop thinking about the donkeys and start worrying about us.”
chapters.zh: 到了苏弗地，扫罗对跟随他的仆人说，我们不如回去，恐怕我父亲不为驴挂心，反为我们担忧。

chapters.en: But the servant replied, “Look, in this town there is a man of God; he is highly respected, and everything he says comes true. Let’s go there now. Perhaps he will tell us what way to take.”
chapters.zh: 仆人说，这城里有一位神人，是众人所尊重的，凡他所说的全都应验。我们不如往他那里去，或者他能将我们当走的路指示我们。

chapters.en: Saul said to his servant, “If we go, what can we give the man? The food in our sacks is gone. We have no gift to take to the man of God. What do we have?”
chapters.zh: 扫罗对仆人说，我们若去，有什么可以送那人呢？我们囊中的食物都吃尽了，也没有礼物可以送那神人，我们还有什么没有。

chapters.en: The servant answered him again. “Look,” he said, “I have a quarter of a shekel of silver. I will give it to the man of God so that he will tell us what way to take.”
chapters.zh: 仆人回答扫罗说，我手里有银子一舍客勒的四分之一，可以送那神人，请他指示我们当走的路。

chapters.en: (Formerly in Israel, if someone went to inquire of God, they would say, “Come, let us go to the seer,” because the prophet of today used to be called a seer.)
chapters.zh: （从前以色列中，若有人去问神，就说，我们问先见去吧。现在称为先知的，从前称为先见。）

chapters.en: “Good,” Saul said to his servant. “Come, let’s go.” So they set out for the town where the man of God was.
chapters.zh: 扫罗对仆人说，你说的是，我们可以去。于是他们往神人所住的城里去了。

chapters.en: As they were going up the hill to the town, they met some young women coming out to draw water, and they asked them, “Is the seer here?”
chapters.zh: 他们上坡要进城，就遇见几个少年女子出来打水，问她们说，先见在这里没有。

chapters.en: “He is,” they answered. “He’s ahead of you. Hurry now; he has just come to our town today, for the people have a sacrifice at the high place.
chapters.zh: 女子回答说，在这里，他在你们前面。快去吧。他今日正到城里，因为今日百姓要在丘坛献祭。

chapters.en: As soon as you enter the town, you will find him before he goes up to the high place to eat. The people will not begin eating until he comes, because he must bless the sacrifice; afterward, those who are invited will eat. Go up now; you should find him about this time.”
chapters.zh: 在他还没有上丘坛吃祭物之先，你们一进城必遇见他。因他未到，百姓不能吃，必等他先祝祭，然后请的客才吃。现在你们上去，这时候必遇见他。

chapters.en: They went up to the town, and as they were entering it, there was Samuel, coming toward them on his way up to the high place.
chapters.zh: 二人就上去。将进城的时候，撒母耳正迎着他们来，要上丘坛去。

chapters.en: Now the day before Saul came, the LORD had revealed this to Samuel:
chapters.zh: 扫罗未到的前一日，耶和华已经指示撒母耳说，

chapters.en: “About this time tomorrow I will send you a man from the land of Benjamin. Anoint him ruler over my people Israel; he will deliver them from the hand of the Philistines. I have looked on my people, for their cry has reached me.”
chapters.zh: 明日这时候，我必使一个人从便雅悯地到你这里来，你要膏他作我民以色列的君。他必救我民脱离非利士人的手。因我民的哀声上达于我，我就眷顾他们。

chapters.en: When Samuel caught sight of Saul, the LORD said to him, “This is the man I spoke to you about; he will govern my people.”
chapters.zh: 撒母耳看见扫罗的时候，耶和华对他说，看哪，这人就是我对你所说的，他必治理我的民。

chapters.en: Saul approached Samuel in the gateway and asked, “Would you please tell me where the seer’s house is?”
chapters.zh: 扫罗在城门里走到撒母耳跟前，说，请告诉我，先见的寓所在哪里。

chapters.en: “I am the seer,” Samuel replied. “Go up ahead of me to the high place, for today you are to eat with me, and in the morning I will send you on your way and will tell you all that is in your heart.
chapters.zh: 撒母耳回答说，我就是先见。你在我前面上丘坛去，因为你们今日必与我同席。明日早晨我送你去，将你心里的事都告诉你。

chapters.en: As for the donkeys you lost three days ago, do not worry about them; they have been found. And to whom is all the desire of Israel turned, if not to you and your whole family line?”
chapters.zh: 至于你前三日所丢的那几头驴，你心里不必挂念，已经找着了。以色列众人所仰慕的是谁呢？不是仰慕你和你父的全家吗？

chapters.en: Saul answered, “But am I not a Benjamite, from the smallest tribe of Israel, and is not my clan the least of all the clans of the tribe of Benjamin? Why do you say such a thing to me?”
chapters.zh: 扫罗说，我不是以色列支派中至小的便雅悯人吗？我家不是便雅悯支派中至小的家吗？你为何对我说这样的话呢？

chapters.en: Then Samuel brought Saul and his servant into the hall and seated them at the head of those who were invited—about thirty in number.
chapters.zh: 撒母耳领扫罗和他仆人进了客堂，使他们在请来的客中坐首位。客约有三十个人。

chapters.en: Samuel said to the cook, “Bring the piece of meat I gave you, the one I told you to lay aside.”
chapters.zh: 撒母耳对厨役说，我交给你收存的那一分祭肉现在可以拿来。

chapters.en: So the cook took up the thigh with what was on it and set it in front of Saul. Samuel said, “Here is what has been kept for you. Eat, because it was set aside for you for this occasion from the time I said, ‘I have invited guests.’ ” And Saul dined with Samuel that day.
chapters.zh: 厨役就把收存的腿拿来，摆在扫罗面前，撒母耳说，这是所留下的，放在你面前。吃吧。因我请百姓的时候，特意为你存留这肉到此时。当日，扫罗就与撒母耳同席。

chapters.en: After they came down from the high place to the town, Samuel talked with Saul on the roof of his house.
chapters.zh: 众人从丘坛下来进城，撒母耳和扫罗在房顶上说话。

chapters.en: They rose about daybreak, and Samuel called to Saul on the roof, “Get ready, and I will send you on your way.” When Saul got ready, he and Samuel went outside together.
chapters.zh: 次日清早起来，黎明的时候，扫罗在房顶上。撒母耳呼叫他说，起来吧，我好送你回去。扫罗就起来，和撒母耳一同出去。

chapters.en: As they were going down to the edge of the town, Samuel said to Saul, “Tell the servant to go on ahead of us”—and the servant did so—“but you stay here for a while, so that I may give you a message from God.”
chapters.zh: 二人下到城角，撒母耳对扫罗说，要吩咐仆人先走（仆人就先走了）。你且站在这里，等我将神的话传与你听。

chapters.en: Then Samuel took a flask of olive oil and poured it on Saul’s head and kissed him, saying, “Has not the LORD anointed you ruler over his inheritance?
chapters.zh: 撒母耳拿瓶膏油倒在扫罗的头上，与他亲嘴，说，这不是耶和华膏你作他产业的君吗？

chapters.en: When you leave me today, you will meet two men near Rachel’s tomb, at Zelzah on the border of Benjamin. They will say to you, ‘The donkeys you set out to look for have been found. And now your father has stopped thinking about them and is worried about you. He is asking, “What shall I do about my son?” ’
chapters.zh: 你今日与我离别之后，在便雅悯境内的泄撒，靠近拉结的坟墓，要遇见两个人。他们必对你说，你去找的那几头驴已经找着了。现在你父亲不为驴挂心，反为你担忧，说，我为儿子怎么才好呢？

chapters.en: “Then you will go on from there until you reach the great tree of Tabor. Three men going up to worship God at Bethel will meet you there. One will be carrying three young goats, another three loaves of bread, and another a skin of wine.
chapters.zh: 你从那里往前行，到了他泊的橡树那里，必遇见三个往伯特利去拜神的人，一个带着三只山羊羔，一个带着三个饼，一个带着一皮袋酒。

chapters.en: They will greet you and offer you two loaves of bread, which you will accept from them.
chapters.zh: 他们必问你安，给你两个饼，你就从他们手中接过来。

chapters.en: “After that you will go to Gibeah of God, where there is a Philistine outpost. As you approach the town, you will meet a procession of prophets coming down from the high place with lyres, timbrels, pipes and harps being played before them, and they will be prophesying.
chapters.zh: 此后你到神的山，在那里有非利士人的防兵。你到了城的时候，必遇见一班先知从丘坛下来，前面有鼓瑟的，击鼓的，吹笛的，弹琴的，他们都受感说话。

chapters.en: The Spirit of the LORD will come powerfully upon you, and you will prophesy with them; and you will be changed into a different person.
chapters.zh: 耶和华的灵必大大感动你，你就与他们一同受感说话。你要变为新人。

chapters.en: Once these signs are fulfilled, do whatever your hand finds to do, for God is with you.
chapters.zh: 这兆头临到你，你就可以趁时而作，因为神与你同在。

chapters.en: “Go down ahead of me to Gilgal. I will surely come down to you to sacrifice burnt offerings and fellowship offerings, but you must wait seven days until I come to you and tell you what you are to do.”
chapters.zh: 你当在我以先下到吉甲，我也必下到那里献燔祭和平安祭。你要等候七日，等我到了那里，指示你当行的事。

chapters.en: As Saul turned to leave Samuel, God changed Saul’s heart, and all these signs were fulfilled that day.
chapters.zh: 扫罗转身离别撒母耳，神就赐他一个新心。当日这一切兆头都应验了。

chapters.en: When he and his servant arrived at Gibeah, a procession of prophets met him; the Spirit of God came powerfully upon him, and he joined in their prophesying.
chapters.zh: 扫罗到了那山，有一班先知遇见他，神的灵大大感动他，他就在先知中受感说话。

chapters.en: When all those who had formerly known him saw him prophesying with the prophets, they asked each other, “What is this that has happened to the son of Kish? Is Saul also among the prophets?”
chapters.zh: 素来认识扫罗的，看见他和先知一同受感说话，就彼此说，基士的儿子遇见什么了。扫罗也列在先知中吗？

chapters.en: A man who lived there answered, “And who is their father?” So it became a saying: “Is Saul also among the prophets?”
chapters.zh: 那地方有一个人说，这些人的父亲是谁呢？此后有句俗语说，扫罗也列在先知中吗？

chapters.en: After Saul stopped prophesying, he went to the high place.
chapters.zh: 扫罗受感说话已毕，就上丘坛去了。

chapters.en: Now Saul’s uncle asked him and his servant, “Where have you been?” “Looking for the donkeys,” he said. “But when we saw they were not to be found, we went to Samuel.”
chapters.zh: 扫罗的叔叔问扫罗和他仆人说，你们往哪里去了。回答说，找驴去了。我们见没有驴，就到了撒母耳那里。

chapters.en: Saul’s uncle said, “Tell me what Samuel said to you.”
chapters.zh: 扫罗的叔叔说，请将撒母耳向你们所说的话告诉我。

chapters.en: Saul replied, “He assured us that the donkeys had been found.” But he did not tell his uncle what Samuel had said about the kingship.
chapters.zh: 扫罗对他叔叔说，他明明地告诉我们驴已经找着了。至于撒母耳所说的国事，扫罗却没有告诉叔叔。

chapters.en: Samuel summoned the people of Israel to the LORD at Mizpah
chapters.zh: 撒母耳将百姓招聚到米斯巴耶和华那里，

chapters.en: and said to them, “This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: ‘I brought Israel up out of Egypt, and I delivered you from the power of Egypt and all the kingdoms that oppressed you.’
chapters.zh: 对他们说，耶和华以色列的神如此说，我领你们以色列人出埃及，救你们脱离埃及人的手，又救你们脱离欺压你们各国之人的手。

chapters.en: But you have now rejected your God, who saves you out of all your disasters and calamities. And you have said, ‘No, appoint a king over us.’ So now present yourselves before the LORD by your tribes and clans.”
chapters.zh: 你们今日却厌弃了救你们脱离一切灾难的神，说，求你立一个王治理我们。现在你们应当按着支派，宗族都站在耶和华面前。

chapters.en: When Samuel had all Israel come forward by tribes, the tribe of Benjamin was taken by lot.
chapters.zh: 于是，撒母耳使以色列众支派近前来掣签，就掣出便雅悯支派来。

chapters.en: Then he brought forward the tribe of Benjamin, clan by clan, and Matri’s clan was taken. Finally Saul son of Kish was taken. But when they looked for him, he was not to be found.
chapters.zh: 又使便雅悯支派按着宗族近前来，就掣出玛特利族，从其中又掣出基士的儿子扫罗。众人寻找他却寻不着，

chapters.en: So they inquired further of the LORD, “Has the man come here yet?” And the LORD said, “Yes, he has hidden himself among the supplies.”
chapters.zh: 就问耶和华说，那人到这里来了没有。耶和华说，他藏在器具中了。

chapters.en: They ran and brought him out, and as he stood among the people he was a head taller than any of the others.
chapters.zh: 众人就跑去从那里领出他来。他站在百姓中间，身体比众民高过一头。

chapters.en: Samuel said to all the people, “Do you see the man the LORD has chosen? There is no one like him among all the people.” Then the people shouted, “Long live the king!”
chapters.zh: 撒母耳对众民说，你们看耶和华所拣选的人，众民中有可比他的吗？众民就大声欢呼说，愿王万岁。

chapters.en: Samuel explained to the people the rights and duties of kingship. He wrote them down on a scroll and deposited it before the LORD. Then Samuel dismissed the people to go to their own homes.
chapters.zh: 撒母耳将国法对百姓说明，又记在书上，放在耶和华面前，然后遣散众民，各回各家去了。

chapters.en: Saul also went to his home in Gibeah, accompanied by valiant men whose hearts God had touched.
chapters.zh: 扫罗往基比亚回家去，有神感动的一群人跟随他。

chapters.en: But some scoundrels said, “How can this fellow save us?” They despised him and brought him no gifts. But Saul kept silent.
chapters.zh: 但有些匪徒说，这人怎能救我们呢？就藐视他，没有送他礼物。扫罗却不理会。

chapters.en: Nahash the Ammonite went up and besieged Jabesh Gilead. And all the men of Jabesh said to him, “Make a treaty with us, and we will be subject to you.”
chapters.zh: 亚扪人的王拿辖上来，对着基列雅比安营。雅比众人对拿辖说，你与我们立约，我们就服事你。

chapters.en: But Nahash the Ammonite replied, “I will make a treaty with you only on the condition that I gouge out the right eye of every one of you and so bring disgrace on all Israel.”
chapters.zh: 亚扪人拿辖说，你们若由我剜出你们各人的右眼，以此凌辱以色列众人，我就与你们立约。

chapters.en: The elders of Jabesh said to him, “Give us seven days so we can send messengers throughout Israel; if no one comes to rescue us, we will surrender to you.”
chapters.zh: 雅比的长老对他说，求你宽容我们七日，等我们打发人往以色列的全境去。若没有人救我们，我们就出来归顺你。

chapters.en: When the messengers came to Gibeah of Saul and reported these terms to the people, they all wept aloud.
chapters.zh: 使者到了扫罗住的基比亚，将这话说给百姓听，百姓就都放声而哭。

chapters.en: Just then Saul was returning from the fields, behind his oxen, and he asked, “What is wrong with everyone? Why are they weeping?” Then they repeated to him what the men of Jabesh had said.
chapters.zh: 扫罗正从田间赶牛回来，问说，百姓为什么哭呢？众人将雅比人的话告诉他。

chapters.en: When Saul heard their words, the Spirit of God came powerfully upon him, and he burned with anger.
chapters.zh: 扫罗听见这话，就被神的灵大大感动，甚是发怒。

chapters.en: He took a pair of oxen, cut them into pieces, and sent the pieces by messengers throughout Israel, proclaiming, “This is what will be done to the oxen of anyone who does not follow Saul and Samuel.” Then the terror of the LORD fell on the people, and they came out together as one.
chapters.zh: 他将一对牛切成块子，托付使者传送以色列的全境，说，凡不出来跟随扫罗和撒母耳的，也必这样切开他的牛。于是耶和华使百姓惧怕，他们就都出来，如同一人。

chapters.en: When Saul mustered them at Bezek, the men of Israel numbered three hundred thousand and those of Judah thirty thousand.
chapters.zh: 扫罗在比色数点他们，以色列人有三十万，犹大人有三万。

chapters.en: They told the messengers who had come, “Say to the men of Jabesh Gilead, ‘By the time the sun is hot tomorrow, you will be rescued.’ ” When the messengers went and reported this to the men of Jabesh, they were elated.
chapters.zh: 众人对那使者说，你们要回覆基列雅比人说，明日太阳近午的时候，你们必得解救。使者回去告诉雅比人，他们就欢喜了。

chapters.en: They said to the Ammonites, “Tomorrow we will surrender to you, and you can do to us whatever you like.”
chapters.zh: 于是雅比人对亚扪人说，明日我们出来归顺你们，你们可以随意待我们。

chapters.en: The next day Saul separated his men into three divisions; during the last watch of the night they broke into the camp of the Ammonites and slaughtered them until the heat of the day. Those who survived were scattered, so that no two of them were left together.
chapters.zh: 第二日，扫罗将百姓分为三队，在晨更的时候入了亚扪人的营，击杀他们直到太阳近午，剩下的人都逃散，没有二人同在一处的。

chapters.en: The people then said to Samuel, “Who was it that asked, ‘Shall Saul reign over us?’ Turn these men over to us so that we may put them to death.”
chapters.zh: 百姓对撒母耳说，那说扫罗岂能管理我们的是谁呢？可以将他交出来，我们好杀死他。

chapters.en: But Saul said, “No one will be put to death today, for this day the LORD has rescued Israel.”
chapters.zh: 扫罗说，今日耶和华在以色列中施行拯救，所以不可杀人。

chapters.en: Then Samuel said to the people, “Come, let us go to Gilgal and there renew the kingship.”
chapters.zh: 撒母耳对百姓说，我们要往吉甲去，在那里立国。

chapters.en: So all the people went to Gilgal and made Saul king in the presence of the LORD. There they sacrificed fellowship offerings before the LORD, and Saul and all the Israelites held a great celebration.
chapters.zh: 众百姓就到了吉甲那里，在耶和华面前立扫罗为王，又在耶和华面前献平安祭。扫罗和以色列众人大大欢喜。

chapters.en: Samuel said to all Israel, “I have listened to everything you said to me and have set a king over you.
chapters.zh: 撒母耳对以色列众人说，你们向我所求的，我已应允了，为你们立了一个王。

chapters.en: Now you have a king as your leader. As for me, I am old and gray, and my sons are here with you. I have been your leader from my youth until this day.
chapters.zh: 现在有这王在你们前面行。我已年老发白，我的儿子都在你们这里。我从幼年直到今日都在你们前面行。

chapters.en: Here I stand. Testify against me in the presence of the LORD and his anointed. Whose ox have I taken? Whose donkey have I taken? Whom have I cheated? Whom have I oppressed? From whose hand have I accepted a bribe to make me shut my eyes? If I have done any of these things, I will make it right.”
chapters.zh: 我在这里，你们要在耶和华和他的受膏者面前给我作见证。我夺过谁的牛，抢过谁的驴，欺负过谁，虐待过谁，从谁手里受过贿赂因而眼瞎呢？若有，我必偿还。

chapters.en: “You have not cheated or oppressed us,” they replied. “You have not taken anything from anyone’s hand.”
chapters.zh: 众人说，你未曾欺负我们，虐待我们，也未曾从谁手里受过什么。

chapters.en: Samuel said to them, “The LORD is witness against you, and also his anointed is witness this day, that you have not found anything in my hand.” “He is witness,” they said.
chapters.zh: 撒母耳对他们说，你们在我手里没有找着什么，有耶和华和他的受膏者今日为证。他们说，愿他为证。

chapters.en: Then Samuel said to the people, “It is the LORD who appointed Moses and Aaron and brought your ancestors up out of Egypt.
chapters.zh: 撒母耳对百姓说，从前立摩西，亚伦，又领你们列祖出埃及地的是耶和华。

chapters.en: Now then, stand here, because I am going to confront you with evidence before the LORD as to all the righteous acts performed by the LORD for you and your ancestors.
chapters.zh: 现在你们要站住，等我在耶和华面前对你们讲论耶和华向你们和你们列祖所行一切公义的事。

chapters.en: “After Jacob entered Egypt, they cried to the LORD for help, and the LORD sent Moses and Aaron, who brought your ancestors out of Egypt and settled them in this place.
chapters.zh: 从前雅各到了埃及，后来你们列祖呼求耶和华，耶和华就差遣摩西，亚伦领你们列祖出埃及，使他们在这地方居住。

chapters.en: “But they forgot the LORD their God; so he sold them into the hand of Sisera, the commander of the army of Hazor, and into the hands of the Philistines and the king of Moab, who fought against them.
chapters.zh: 他们却忘记耶和华他们的神，他就把他们付与夏琐将军西西拉的手里，和非利士人并摩押王的手里。于是这些人常来攻击他们。

chapters.en: They cried out to the LORD and said, ‘We have sinned; we have forsaken the LORD and served the Baals and the Ashtoreths. But now deliver us from the hands of our enemies, and we will serve you.’
chapters.zh: 他们就呼求耶和华说，我们离弃耶和华，事奉巴力和亚斯他录，是有罪了。现在求你救我们脱离仇敌的手，我们必事奉你。

chapters.en: Then the LORD sent Jerub-Baal, Barak, Jephthah and Samuel, and he delivered you from the hands of your enemies all around you, so that you lived in safety.
chapters.zh: 耶和华就差遣耶路巴力，比但，耶弗他，撒母耳救你们脱离四围仇敌的手，你们才安然居住。

chapters.en: “But when you saw that Nahash king of the Ammonites was moving against you, you said to me, ‘No, we want a king to rule over us’—even though the LORD your God was your king.
chapters.zh: 你们见亚扪人的王拿辖来攻击你们，就对我说，我们定要一个王治理我们。其实耶和华你们的神是你们的王。

chapters.en: Now here is the king you have chosen, the one you asked for; see, the LORD has set a king over you.
chapters.zh: 现在，你们所求所选的王在这里。看哪，耶和华已经为你们立王了。

chapters.en: If you fear the LORD and serve and obey him and do not rebel against his commands, and if both you and the king who reigns over you follow the LORD your God—good!
chapters.zh: 你们若敬畏耶和华，事奉他，听从他的话，不违背他的命令，你们和治理你们的王也都顺从耶和华你们的神就好了。

chapters.en: But if you do not obey the LORD, and if you rebel against his commands, his hand will be against you, as it was against your ancestors.
chapters.zh: 倘若不听从耶和华的话，违背他的命令，耶和华的手必攻击你们，像从前攻击你们列祖一样。

chapters.en: “Now then, stand still and see this great thing the LORD is about to do before your eyes!
chapters.zh: 现在你们要站住，看耶和华在你们眼前要行一件大事。

chapters.en: Is it not wheat harvest now? I will call on the LORD to send thunder and rain. And you will realize what an evil thing you did in the eyes of the LORD when you asked for a king.”
chapters.zh: 这不是割麦子的时候吗？我求告耶和华，他必打雷降雨，使你们又知道又看出，你们求立王的事是在耶和华面前犯大罪了。

chapters.en: Then Samuel called on the LORD, and that same day the LORD sent thunder and rain. So all the people stood in awe of the LORD and of Samuel.
chapters.zh: 于是撒母耳求告耶和华，耶和华就在这日打雷降雨，众民便甚惧怕耶和华和撒母耳。

chapters.en: The people all said to Samuel, “Pray to the LORD your God for your servants so that we will not die, for we have added to all our other sins the evil of asking for a king.”
chapters.zh: 众民对撒母耳说，求你为仆人们祷告耶和华你的神，免得我们死亡，因为我们求立王的事正是罪上加罪了。

chapters.en: “Do not be afraid,” Samuel replied. “You have done all this evil; yet do not turn away from the LORD, but serve the LORD with all your heart.
chapters.zh: 撒母耳对百姓说，不要惧怕。你们虽然行了这恶，却不要偏离耶和华，只要尽心事奉他。

chapters.en: Do not turn away after useless idols. They can do you no good, nor can they rescue you, because they are useless.
chapters.zh: 若偏离耶和华去顺从那不能救人的虚神是无益的。

chapters.en: For the sake of his great name the LORD will not reject his people, because the LORD was pleased to make you his own.
chapters.zh: 耶和华既喜悦选你们作他的子民，就必因他的大名不撇弃你们。

chapters.en: As for me, far be it from me that I should sin against the LORD by failing to pray for you. And I will teach you the way that is good and right.
chapters.zh: 至于我，断不停止为你们祷告，以致得罪耶和华。我必以善道正路指教你们。

chapters.en: But be sure to fear the LORD and serve him faithfully with all your heart; consider what great things he has done for you.
chapters.zh: 只要你们敬畏耶和华，诚诚实实地尽心事奉他，想念他向你们所行的事何等大。

chapters.en: Yet if you persist in doing evil, both you and your king will perish.”
chapters.zh: 你们若仍然作恶，你们和你们的王必一同灭亡。

chapters.en: Saul was thirty years old when he became king, and he reigned over Israel forty- two years.
chapters.zh: 扫罗登基年四十岁。作以色列王二年的时候，

chapters.en: Saul chose three thousand men from Israel; two thousand were with him at Mikmash and in the hill country of Bethel, and a thousand were with Jonathan at Gibeah in Benjamin. The rest of the men he sent back to their homes.
chapters.zh: 就从以色列中拣选了三千人，二千跟随扫罗在密抹和伯特利山，一千跟随约拿单在便雅悯的基比亚。其余的人扫罗都打发各回各家去了。

chapters.en: Jonathan attacked the Philistine outpost at Geba, and the Philistines heard about it. Then Saul had the trumpet blown throughout the land and said, “Let the Hebrews hear!”
chapters.zh: 约拿单攻击迦巴，非利士人的防营，非利士人听见了。扫罗就在遍地吹角，意思说，要使希伯来人听见。

chapters.en: So all Israel heard the news: “Saul has attacked the Philistine outpost, and now Israel has become obnoxious to the Philistines.” And the people were summoned to join Saul at Gilgal.
chapters.zh: 以色列众人听见扫罗攻击非利士人的防营，又听见以色列人为非利士人所憎恶，就跟随扫罗聚集在吉甲。

chapters.en: The Philistines assembled to fight Israel, with three thousand chariots, six thousand charioteers, and soldiers as numerous as the sand on the seashore. They went up and camped at Mikmash, east of Beth Aven.
chapters.zh: 非利士人聚集，要与以色列人争战，有车三万辆，马兵六千，步兵像海边的沙那样多，就上来在伯亚文东边的密抹安营。

chapters.en: When the Israelites saw that their situation was critical and that their army was hard pressed, they hid in caves and thickets, among the rocks, and in pits and cisterns.
chapters.zh: 以色列百姓见自己危急窘迫，就藏在山洞，丛林，石穴，隐密处，和坑中。

chapters.en: Some Hebrews even crossed the Jordan to the land of Gad and Gilead. Saul remained at Gilgal, and all the troops with him were quaking with fear.
chapters.zh: 有些希伯来人过了约旦河，逃到迦得和基列地。扫罗还是在吉甲，百姓都战战兢兢地跟随他。

chapters.en: He waited seven days, the time set by Samuel; but Samuel did not come to Gilgal, and Saul’s men began to scatter.
chapters.zh: 扫罗照着撒母耳所定的日期等了七日。撒母耳还没有来到吉甲，百姓也离开扫罗散去了。

chapters.en: So he said, “Bring me the burnt offering and the fellowship offerings.” And Saul offered up the burnt offering.
chapters.zh: 扫罗说，把燔祭和平安祭带到我这里来。扫罗就献上燔祭。

chapters.en: Just as he finished making the offering, Samuel arrived, and Saul went out to greet him.
chapters.zh: 刚献完燔祭，撒母耳就到了。扫罗出去迎接他，要问他好。

chapters.en: “What have you done?” asked Samuel. Saul replied, “When I saw that the men were scattering, and that you did not come at the set time, and that the Philistines were assembling at Mikmash,
chapters.zh: 撒母耳说，你作的是什么事呢？扫罗说，因为我见百姓离开我散去，你也不照所定的日期来到，而且非利士人聚集在密抹。

chapters.en: I thought, ‘Now the Philistines will come down against me at Gilgal, and I have not sought the LORD’s favor.’ So I felt compelled to offer the burnt offering.”
chapters.zh: 所以我心里说，恐怕我没有祷告耶和华。非利士人下到吉甲攻击我，我就勉强献上燔祭。

chapters.en: “You have done a foolish thing,” Samuel said. “You have not kept the command the LORD your God gave you; if you had, he would have established your kingdom over Israel for all time.
chapters.zh: 撒母耳对扫罗说，你作了糊涂事了，没有遵守耶和华你神所吩咐你的命令。若遵守，耶和华必在以色列中坚立你的王位，直到永远。

chapters.en: But now your kingdom will not endure; the LORD has sought out a man after his own heart and appointed him ruler of his people, because you have not kept the LORD’s command.”
chapters.zh: 现在你的王位必不长久。耶和华已经寻着一个合他心意的人，立他作百姓的君，因为你没有遵守耶和华所吩咐你的。

chapters.en: Then Samuel left Gilgal and went up to Gibeah in Benjamin, and Saul counted the men who were with him. They numbered about six hundred.
chapters.zh: 撒母耳就起来，从吉甲上到便雅悯的基比亚。扫罗数点跟随他的，约有六百人。

chapters.en: Saul and his son Jonathan and the men with them were staying in Gibeah in Benjamin, while the Philistines camped at Mikmash.
chapters.zh: 扫罗和他儿子约拿单，并跟随他们的人，都住在便雅悯的迦巴。但非利士人安营在密抹。

chapters.en: Raiding parties went out from the Philistine camp in three detachments. One turned toward Ophrah in the vicinity of Shual,
chapters.zh: 有掠兵从非利士营中出来，分为三队，一队往俄弗拉向书亚地去，

chapters.en: another toward Beth Horon, and the third toward the borderland overlooking the Valley of Zeboyim facing the wilderness.
chapters.zh: 一队往伯和仑去，一队往洗波音谷对面的地境向旷野去。

chapters.en: Not a blacksmith could be found in the whole land of Israel, because the Philistines had said, “Otherwise the Hebrews will make swords or spears!”
chapters.zh: 那时，以色列全地没有一个铁匠。因为非利士人说，恐怕希伯来人制造刀枪。

chapters.en: So all Israel went down to the Philistines to have their plow points, mattocks, axes and sickles sharpened.
chapters.zh: 以色列人要磨锄，犁，斧，铲，就下到非利士人那里去磨。

chapters.en: The price was two-thirds of a shekel for sharpening plow points and mattocks, and a third of a shekel for sharpening forks and axes and for repointing goads.
chapters.zh: 但有锉可以锉铲，犁，三齿叉，斧子，并赶牛锥。

chapters.en: So on the day of the battle not a soldier with Saul and Jonathan had a sword or spear in his hand; only Saul and his son Jonathan had them.
chapters.zh: 所以到了争战的日子，跟随扫罗和约拿单的人没有一个手里有刀有枪的，惟独扫罗和他儿子约拿单有。

chapters.en: Now a detachment of Philistines had gone out to the pass at Mikmash.
chapters.zh: 非利士人的一队防兵到了密抹的隘口。

chapters.en: One day Jonathan son of Saul said to his young armor-bearer, “Come, let’s go over to the Philistine outpost on the other side.” But he did not tell his father.
chapters.zh: 有一日，扫罗的儿子约拿单对拿他兵器的少年人说，我们不如过到那边，到非利士人的防营那里去。但他没有告诉父亲。

chapters.en: Saul was staying on the outskirts of Gibeah under a pomegranate tree in Migron. With him were about six hundred men,
chapters.zh: 扫罗在基比亚的尽边，坐在米矶仑的石榴树下，跟随他的约有六百人。

chapters.en: among whom was Ahijah, who was wearing an ephod. He was a son of Ichabod’s brother Ahitub son of Phinehas, the son of Eli, the LORD’s priest in Shiloh. No one was aware that Jonathan had left.
chapters.zh: 在那里有亚希突的儿子亚希亚，穿着以弗得。亚希突是以迦博的哥哥，非尼哈的儿子，以利的孙子。以利从前在示罗作耶和华的祭司。约拿单去了，百姓却不知道。

chapters.en: On each side of the pass that Jonathan intended to cross to reach the Philistine outpost was a cliff; one was called Bozez and the other Seneh.
chapters.zh: 约拿单要从隘口过到非利士防营那里去。这隘口两边各有一个山峰，一名播薛，一名西尼。

chapters.en: One cliff stood to the north toward Mikmash, the other to the south toward Geba.
chapters.zh: 一峰向北，与密抹相对，一峰向南，与迦巴相对。

chapters.en: Jonathan said to his young armor-bearer, “Come, let’s go over to the outpost of those uncircumcised men. Perhaps the LORD will act in our behalf. Nothing can hinder the LORD from saving, whether by many or by few.”
chapters.zh: 约拿单对拿兵器的少年人说，我们不如过到未受割礼人的防营那里去，或者耶和华为我们施展能力。因为耶和华使人得胜，不在乎人多人少。

chapters.en: “Do all that you have in mind,” his armor-bearer said. “Go ahead; I am with you heart and soul.”
chapters.zh: 拿兵器的对他说，随你的心意行吧。你可以上去，我必跟随你，与你同心。

chapters.en: Jonathan said, “Come on, then; we will cross over toward them and let them see us.
chapters.zh: 约拿单说，我们要过到那些人那里去，使他们看见我们。

chapters.en: If they say to us, ‘Wait there until we come to you,’ we will stay where we are and not go up to them.
chapters.zh: 他们若对我们说，你们站住，等我们到你们那里去，我们就站住，不上他们那里去。

chapters.en: But if they say, ‘Come up to us,’ we will climb up, because that will be our sign that the LORD has given them into our hands.”
chapters.zh: 他们若说，你们上到我们这里来，这话就是我们的证据。我们便上去，因为耶和华将他们交在我们手里了。

chapters.en: So both of them showed themselves to the Philistine outpost. “Look!” said the Philistines. “The Hebrews are crawling out of the holes they were hiding in.”
chapters.zh: 二人就使非利士的防兵看见。非利士人说，希伯来人从所藏的洞穴里出来了。

chapters.en: The men of the outpost shouted to Jonathan and his armor-bearer, “Come up to us and we’ll teach you a lesson.” So Jonathan said to his armor-bearer, “Climb up after me; the LORD has given them into the hand of Israel.”
chapters.zh: 防兵对约拿单和拿兵器的人说，你们上到这里来，我们有一件事指示你们。约拿单就对拿兵器的人说，你跟随我上去，因为耶和华将他们交在以色列人手里了。

chapters.en: Jonathan climbed up, using his hands and feet, with his armor-bearer right behind him. The Philistines fell before Jonathan, and his armor-bearer followed and killed behind him.
chapters.zh: 约拿单就爬上去，拿兵器的人跟随他。约拿单杀倒非利士人，拿兵器的人也随着杀他们。

chapters.en: In that first attack Jonathan and his armor-bearer killed some twenty men in an area of about half an acre.
chapters.zh: 约拿单和拿兵器的人起头所杀的约有二十人，都在一亩地的半犁沟之内。

chapters.en: Then panic struck the whole army—those in the camp and field, and those in the outposts and raiding parties—and the ground shook. It was a panic sent by God.
chapters.zh: 于是在营中，在田野，在众民内都有战兢，防兵和掠兵也都战兢，地也震动，战兢之势甚大。

chapters.en: Saul’s lookouts at Gibeah in Benjamin saw the army melting away in all directions.
chapters.zh: 在便雅悯的基比亚，扫罗的守望兵看见非利士的军众溃散，四围乱窜。

chapters.en: Then Saul said to the men who were with him, “Muster the forces and see who has left us.” When they did, it was Jonathan and his armor-bearer who were not there.
chapters.zh: 扫罗就对跟随他的民说，你们查点查点，看从我们这里出去的是谁。他们一查点，就知道约拿单和拿兵器的人没有在这里。

chapters.en: Saul said to Ahijah, “Bring the ark of God.” (At that time it was with the Israelites.)
chapters.zh: 那时神的约柜在以色列人那里。扫罗对亚希亚说，你将神的约柜运了来。

chapters.en: While Saul was talking to the priest, the tumult in the Philistine camp increased more and more. So Saul said to the priest, “Withdraw your hand.”
chapters.zh: 扫罗正与祭司说话的时候，非利士营中的喧嚷越发大了。扫罗就对祭司说，停手吧。

chapters.en: Then Saul and all his men assembled and went to the battle. They found the Philistines in total confusion, striking each other with their swords.
chapters.zh: 扫罗和跟随他的人都聚集，来到战场，看见非利士人用刀互相击杀，大大惶乱。

chapters.en: Those Hebrews who had previously been with the Philistines and had gone up with them to their camp went over to the Israelites who were with Saul and Jonathan.
chapters.zh: 从前由四方来跟随非利士军的希伯来人现在也转过来，帮助跟随扫罗和约拿单的以色列人了。

chapters.en: When all the Israelites who had hidden in the hill country of Ephraim heard that the Philistines were on the run, they joined the battle in hot pursuit.
chapters.zh: 那藏在以法莲山地的以色列人听说非利士人逃跑，就出来紧紧地追杀他们。

chapters.en: So on that day the LORD saved Israel, and the battle moved on beyond Beth Aven.
chapters.zh: 那日，耶和华使以色列人得胜，一直战到伯亚文。

chapters.en: Now the Israelites were in distress that day, because Saul had bound the people under an oath, saying, “Cursed be anyone who eats food before evening comes, before I have avenged myself on my enemies!” So none of the troops tasted food.
chapters.zh: 扫罗叫百姓起誓说，凡不等到晚上向敌人报完了仇吃什么的，必受咒诅。因此这日百姓没有吃什么，就极其困惫。

chapters.en: The entire army entered the woods, and there was honey on the ground.
chapters.zh: 众民进入树林，见有蜜在地上。

chapters.en: When they went into the woods, they saw the honey oozing out; yet no one put his hand to his mouth, because they feared the oath.
chapters.zh: 他们进了树林，见有蜜流下来，却没有人敢用手取蜜入口，因为他们怕那誓言。

chapters.en: But Jonathan had not heard that his father had bound the people with the oath, so he reached out the end of the staff that was in his hand and dipped it into the honeycomb. He raised his hand to his mouth, and his eyes brightened.
chapters.zh: 约拿单没有听见他父亲叫百姓起誓，所以伸手中的杖，用杖头蘸在蜂房里，转手送入口内，眼睛就明亮了。

chapters.en: Then one of the soldiers told him, “Your father bound the army under a strict oath, saying, ‘Cursed be anyone who eats food today!’ That is why the men are faint.”
chapters.zh: 百姓中有一人对他说，你父亲曾叫百姓严严地起誓说，今日吃什么的，必受咒诅。因此百姓就疲乏了。

chapters.en: Jonathan said, “My father has made trouble for the country. See how my eyes brightened when I tasted a little of this honey.
chapters.zh: 约拿单说，我父亲连累你们了。你看，我尝了这一点蜜，眼睛就明亮了。

chapters.en: How much better it would have been if the men had eaten today some of the plunder they took from their enemies. Would not the slaughter of the Philistines have been even greater?”
chapters.zh: 今日百姓若任意吃了从仇敌所夺的物，击杀的非利士人岂不更多吗？

chapters.en: That day, after the Israelites had struck down the Philistines from Mikmash to Aijalon, they were exhausted.
chapters.zh: 这日，以色列人击杀非利士人，从密抹直到亚雅仑。百姓甚是疲乏，

chapters.en: They pounced on the plunder and, taking sheep, cattle and calves, they butchered them on the ground and ate them, together with the blood.
chapters.zh: 就急忙将所夺的牛羊和牛犊宰于地上，肉还带血就吃了。

chapters.en: Then someone said to Saul, “Look, the men are sinning against the LORD by eating meat that has blood in it.” “You have broken faith,” he said. “Roll a large stone over here at once.”
chapters.zh: 有人告诉扫罗说，百姓吃带血的肉，得罪耶和华了。扫罗说，你们有罪了，今日要将大石头滚到我这里来。

chapters.en: Then he said, “Go out among the men and tell them, ‘Each of you bring me your cattle and sheep, and slaughter them here and eat them. Do not sin against the LORD by eating meat with blood still in it.’ ” So everyone brought his ox that night and slaughtered it there.
chapters.zh: 扫罗又说，你们散在百姓中，对他们说，你们各人将牛羊牵到我这里来宰了吃，不可吃带血的肉得罪耶和华。这夜，百姓就把牛羊牵到那里宰了。

chapters.en: Then Saul built an altar to the LORD; it was the first time he had done this.
chapters.zh: 扫罗为耶和华筑了一座坛，这是他初次为耶和华筑的坛。

chapters.en: Saul said, “Let us go down and pursue the Philistines by night and plunder them till dawn, and let us not leave one of them alive.” “Do whatever seems best to you,” they replied. But the priest said, “Let us inquire of God here.”
chapters.zh: 扫罗说，我们不如夜里下去追赶非利士人，抢掠他们，直到天亮，不留他们一人。众民说，你看怎样好就去行吧。祭司说，我们先当亲近神。

chapters.en: So Saul asked God, “Shall I go down and pursue the Philistines? Will you give them into Israel’s hand?” But God did not answer him that day.
chapters.zh: 扫罗求问神说，我下去追赶非利士人可以不可以。你将他们交在以色列人手里不交。这日神没有回答他。

chapters.en: Saul therefore said, “Come here, all you who are leaders of the army, and let us find out what sin has been committed today.
chapters.zh: 扫罗说，你们百姓中的长老都上这里来，查明今日是谁犯了罪。

chapters.en: As surely as the LORD who rescues Israel lives, even if the guilt lies with my son Jonathan, he must die.” But not one of them said a word.
chapters.zh: 我指着救以色列永生的耶和华起誓，就是我儿子约拿单犯了罪，他也必死。但百姓中无一人回答他。

chapters.en: Saul then said to all the Israelites, “You stand over there; I and Jonathan my son will stand over here.” “Do what seems best to you,” they replied.
chapters.zh: 扫罗就对以色列众人说，你们站在一边，我与我儿子约拿单也站在一边。百姓对扫罗说，你看怎样好就去行吧。

chapters.en: Then Saul prayed to the LORD, the God of Israel, “Why have you not answered your servant today? If the fault is in me or my son Jonathan, respond with Urim, but if the men of Israel are at fault, respond with Thummim.” Jonathan and Saul were taken by lot, and the men were cleared.
chapters.zh: 扫罗祷告耶和华以色列的神说，求你指示实情。于是掣签掣出扫罗和约拿单来。百姓尽都无事。

chapters.en: Saul said, “Cast the lot between me and Jonathan my son.” And Jonathan was taken.
chapters.zh: 扫罗说，你们再掣签，看是我，是我儿子约拿单，就掣出约拿单来。

chapters.en: Then Saul said to Jonathan, “Tell me what you have done.” So Jonathan told him, “I tasted a little honey with the end of my staff. And now I must die!”
chapters.zh: 扫罗对约拿单说，你告诉我，你作了什么事。约拿单说，我实在以手里的杖，用杖头蘸了一点蜜尝了一尝。这样我就死吗（吗或作吧）。

chapters.en: Saul said, “May God deal with me, be it ever so severely, if you do not die, Jonathan.”
chapters.zh: 扫罗说，约拿单哪，你定要死。若不然，愿神重重地降罚与我。

chapters.en: But the men said to Saul, “Should Jonathan die—he who has brought about this great deliverance in Israel? Never! As surely as the LORD lives, not a hair of his head will fall to the ground, for he did this today with God’s help.” So the men rescued Jonathan, and he was not put to death.
chapters.zh: 百姓对扫罗说，约拿单在以色列人中这样大行拯救，岂可使他死呢？断乎不可。我们指着永生的耶和华起誓，连他的一根头发也不可落地，因为他今日与神一同作事。于是百姓救约拿单免了死亡。

chapters.en: Then Saul stopped pursuing the Philistines, and they withdrew to their own land.
chapters.zh: 扫罗回去，不追赶非利士人。非利士人也回本地去了。

chapters.en: After Saul had assumed rule over Israel, he fought against their enemies on every side: Moab, the Ammonites, Edom, the kings of Zobah, and the Philistines. Wherever he turned, he inflicted punishment on them.
chapters.zh: 扫罗执掌以色列的国权，常常攻击他四围的一切仇敌，就是摩押人，亚扪人，以东人，和琐巴诸王，并非利士人。他无论往何处去，都打败仇敌。

chapters.en: He fought valiantly and defeated the Amalekites, delivering Israel from the hands of those who had plundered them.
chapters.zh: 扫罗奋勇攻击亚玛力人，救了以色列人脱离抢掠他们之人的手。

chapters.en: Saul’s sons were Jonathan, Ishvi and Malki-Shua. The name of his older daughter was Merab, and that of the younger was Michal.
chapters.zh: 扫罗的儿子是约拿单，亦施韦，麦基舒亚。他的两个女儿，长女名米拉，次女名米甲。

chapters.en: His wife’s name was Ahinoam daughter of Ahimaaz. The name of the commander of Saul’s army was Abner son of Ner, and Ner was Saul’s uncle.
chapters.zh: 扫罗的妻名叫亚希暖，是亚希玛斯的女儿。扫罗的元帅名叫押尼珥，是尼珥的儿子。尼珥是扫罗的叔叔。

chapters.en: Saul’s father Kish and Abner’s father Ner were sons of Abiel.
chapters.zh: 扫罗的父亲基士，押尼珥的父亲尼珥，都是亚别的儿子。

chapters.en: All the days of Saul there was bitter war with the Philistines, and whenever Saul saw a mighty or brave man, he took him into his service.
chapters.zh: 扫罗平生常与非利士人大大争战。扫罗遇见有能力的人或勇士，都招募了来跟随他。

chapters.en: Samuel said to Saul, “I am the one the LORD sent to anoint you king over his people Israel; so listen now to the message from the LORD.
chapters.zh: 撒母耳对扫罗说，耶和华差遣我膏你为王，治理他的百姓以色列。所以你当听从耶和华的话。

chapters.en: This is what the LORD Almighty says: ‘I will punish the Amalekites for what they did to Israel when they waylaid them as they came up from Egypt.
chapters.zh: 万军之耶和华如此说，以色列人出埃及的时候，在路上亚玛力人怎样待他们，怎样抵挡他们，我都没忘。

chapters.en: Now go, attack the Amalekites and totally destroy all that belongs to them. Do not spare them; put to death men and women, children and infants, cattle and sheep, camels and donkeys.’ ”
chapters.zh: 现在你要去击打亚玛力人，灭尽他们所有的，不可怜惜他们，将男女，孩童，吃奶的，并牛，羊，骆驼，和驴尽行杀死。

chapters.en: So Saul summoned the men and mustered them at Telaim—two hundred thousand foot soldiers and ten thousand from Judah.
chapters.zh: 于是扫罗招聚百姓在提拉因，数点他们，共有步兵二十万，另有犹大人一万。

chapters.en: Saul went to the city of Amalek and set an ambush in the ravine.
chapters.zh: 扫罗到了亚玛力的京城，在谷中设下埋伏。

chapters.en: Then he said to the Kenites, “Go away, leave the Amalekites so that I do not destroy you along with them; for you showed kindness to all the Israelites when they came up out of Egypt.” So the Kenites moved away from the Amalekites.
chapters.zh: 扫罗对基尼人说，你们离开亚玛力人下去吧，恐怕我将你们和亚玛力人一同杀灭。因为以色列人出埃及的时候，你们曾恩待他们。于是基尼人离开亚玛力人去了。

chapters.en: Then Saul attacked the Amalekites all the way from Havilah to Shur, near the eastern border of Egypt.
chapters.zh: 扫罗击打亚玛力人，从哈腓拉直到埃及前的书珥，

chapters.en: He took Agag king of the Amalekites alive, and all his people he totally destroyed with the sword.
chapters.zh: 生擒了亚玛力王亚甲，用刀杀尽亚玛力的众民。

chapters.en: But Saul and the army spared Agag and the best of the sheep and cattle, the fat calves and lambs—everything that was good. These they were unwilling to destroy completely, but everything that was despised and weak they totally destroyed.
chapters.zh: 扫罗和百姓却怜惜亚甲，也爱惜上好的牛，羊，牛犊，羊羔，并一切美物，不肯灭绝。凡下贱瘦弱的，尽都杀了。

chapters.en: Then the word of the LORD came to Samuel:
chapters.zh: 耶和华的话临到撒母耳说，

chapters.en: “I regret that I have made Saul king, because he has turned away from me and has not carried out my instructions.” Samuel was angry, and he cried out to the LORD all that night.
chapters.zh: 我立扫罗为王，我后悔了。因为他转去不跟从我，不遵守我的命令。撒母耳便甚忧愁，终夜哀求耶和华。

chapters.en: Early in the morning Samuel got up and went to meet Saul, but he was told, “Saul has gone to Carmel. There he has set up a monument in his own honor and has turned and gone on down to Gilgal.”
chapters.zh: 撒母耳清早起来，迎接扫罗。有人告诉撒母耳说，扫罗到了迦密，在那里立了记念碑，又转身下到吉甲。

chapters.en: When Samuel reached him, Saul said, “The LORD bless you! I have carried out the LORD’s instructions.”
chapters.zh: 撒母耳到了扫罗那里，扫罗对他说，愿耶和华赐福与你，耶和华的命令我已遵守了。

chapters.en: But Samuel said, “What then is this bleating of sheep in my ears? What is this lowing of cattle that I hear?”
chapters.zh: 撒母耳说，我耳中听见有羊叫，牛鸣，是从哪里来的呢？

chapters.en: Saul answered, “The soldiers brought them from the Amalekites; they spared the best of the sheep and cattle to sacrifice to the LORD your God, but we totally destroyed the rest.”
chapters.zh: 扫罗说，这是百姓从亚玛力人那里带来的。因为他们爱惜上好的牛羊，要献与耶和华你的神。其余的，我们都灭尽了。

chapters.en: “Enough!” Samuel said to Saul. “Let me tell you what the LORD said to me last night.” “Tell me,” Saul replied.
chapters.zh: 撒母耳对扫罗说，你住口吧。等我将耶和华昨夜向我所说的话告诉你。扫罗说，请讲。

chapters.en: Samuel said, “Although you were once small in your own eyes, did you not become the head of the tribes of Israel? The LORD anointed you king over Israel.
chapters.zh: 撒母耳对扫罗说，从前你虽然以自己为小，岂不是被立为以色列支派的元首吗？耶和华膏你作以色列的王。

chapters.en: And he sent you on a mission, saying, ‘Go and completely destroy those wicked people, the Amalekites; wage war against them until you have wiped them out.’
chapters.zh: 耶和华差遣你，吩咐你说，你去击打那些犯罪的亚玛力人，将他们灭绝净尽。

chapters.en: Why did you not obey the LORD? Why did you pounce on the plunder and do evil in the eyes of the LORD?”
chapters.zh: 你为何没有听从耶和华的命令，急忙掳掠财物，行耶和华眼中看为恶的事呢？

chapters.en: “But I did obey the LORD,” Saul said. “I went on the mission the LORD assigned me. I completely destroyed the Amalekites and brought back Agag their king.
chapters.zh: 扫罗对撒母耳说，我实在听从了耶和华的命令，行了耶和华所差遣我行的路，擒了亚玛力王亚甲来，灭尽了亚玛力人。

chapters.en: The soldiers took sheep and cattle from the plunder, the best of what was devoted to God, in order to sacrifice them to the LORD your God at Gilgal.”
chapters.zh: 百姓却在所当灭的物中取了最好的牛羊，要在吉甲献与耶和华你的神。

chapters.en: But Samuel replied: “Does the LORD delight in burnt offerings and sacrifices as much as in obeying the LORD? To obey is better than sacrifice, and to heed is better than the fat of rams.
chapters.zh: 撒母耳说，耶和华喜悦燔祭和平安祭，岂如喜悦人听从他的话呢？听命胜于献祭。顺从胜于公羊的脂油。

chapters.en: For rebellion is like the sin of divination, and arrogance like the evil of idolatry. Because you have rejected the word of the LORD, he has rejected you as king.”
chapters.zh: 悖逆的罪与行邪术的罪相等。顽梗的罪与拜虚神和偶像的罪相同。你既厌弃耶和华的命令，耶和华也厌弃你作王。

chapters.en: Then Saul said to Samuel, “I have sinned. I violated the LORD’s command and your instructions. I was afraid of the men and so I gave in to them.
chapters.zh: 扫罗对撒母耳说，我有罪了，我因惧怕百姓，听从他们的话，就违背了耶和华的命令和你的言语。

chapters.en: Now I beg you, forgive my sin and come back with me, so that I may worship the LORD.”
chapters.zh: 现在求你赦免我的罪，同我回去，我好敬拜耶和华。

chapters.en: But Samuel said to him, “I will not go back with you. You have rejected the word of the LORD, and the LORD has rejected you as king over Israel!”
chapters.zh: 撒母耳对扫罗说，我不同你回去。因为你厌弃耶和华的命令，耶和华也厌弃你作以色列的王。

chapters.en: As Samuel turned to leave, Saul caught hold of the hem of his robe, and it tore.
chapters.zh: 撒母耳转身要走，扫罗就扯住他外袍的衣襟，衣襟就撕断了。

chapters.en: Samuel said to him, “The LORD has torn the kingdom of Israel from you today and has given it to one of your neighbors—to one better than you.
chapters.zh: 撒母耳对他说，如此，今日耶和华使以色列国与你断绝，将这国赐与比你更好的人。

chapters.en: He who is the Glory of Israel does not lie or change his mind; for he is not a human being, that he should change his mind.”
chapters.zh: 以色列的大能者必不至说谎，也不至后悔。因为他迥非世人，决不后悔。

chapters.en: Saul replied, “I have sinned. But please honor me before the elders of my people and before Israel; come back with me, so that I may worship the LORD your God.”
chapters.zh: 扫罗说，我有罪了，虽然如此，求你在我百姓的长老和以色列人面前抬举我，同我回去，我好敬拜耶和华你的神。

chapters.en: So Samuel went back with Saul, and Saul worshiped the LORD.
chapters.zh: 于是撒母耳转身跟随扫罗回去，扫罗就敬拜耶和华。

chapters.en: Then Samuel said, “Bring me Agag king of the Amalekites.” Agag came to him in chains. And he thought, “Surely the bitterness of death is past.”
chapters.zh: 撒母耳说，要把亚玛力王亚甲带到我这里来。亚甲就欢欢喜喜地来到他面前，心里说，死亡的苦难必定过去了。
