chapters.en: “But what have I done?” asked David. “What have you found against your servant from the day I came to you until now? Why can’t I go and fight against the enemies of my lord the king?”
chapters.zh: 大卫对亚吉说，我作了什么呢？自从仆人到你面前，直到今日，你查出我有什么过错，使我不去攻击主我王的仇敌呢？

chapters.en: Achish answered, “I know that you have been as pleasing in my eyes as an angel of God; nevertheless, the Philistine commanders have said, ‘He must not go up with us into battle.’
chapters.zh: 亚吉说，我知道你在我眼前是好人，如同神的使者一般。只是非利士人的首领说，这人不可同我们出战。

chapters.en: Now get up early, along with your master’s servants who have come with you, and leave in the morning as soon as it is light.”
chapters.zh: 故此你和跟随你的人，就是你本主的仆人，要明日早晨起来，等到天亮回去吧。

chapters.en: So David and his men got up early in the morning to go back to the land of the Philistines, and the Philistines went up to Jezreel.
chapters.zh: 于是大卫和跟随他的人早晨起来，回往非利士地去。非利士人也上耶斯列去了。

chapters.en: David and his men reached Ziklag on the third day. Now the Amalekites had raided the Negev and Ziklag. They had attacked Ziklag and burned it,
chapters.zh: 第三日，大卫和跟随他的人到了洗革拉。亚玛力人已经侵夺南地，攻破洗革拉，用火焚烧，

chapters.en: and had taken captive the women and everyone else in it, both young and old. They killed none of them, but carried them off as they went on their way.
chapters.zh: 掳了城内的妇女和其中的大小人口，却没有杀一个，都带着走了。

chapters.en: When David and his men reached Ziklag, they found it destroyed by fire and their wives and sons and daughters taken captive.
chapters.zh: 大卫和跟随他的人到了那城，不料，城已烧毁，他们的妻子儿女都被掳去了。

chapters.en: So David and his men wept aloud until they had no strength left to weep.
chapters.zh: 大卫和跟随他的人就放声大哭，直哭得没有气力。

chapters.en: David’s two wives had been captured—Ahinoam of Jezreel and Abigail, the widow of Nabal of Carmel.
chapters.zh: 大卫的两个妻耶斯列人亚希暖和作过拿八妻的迦密人亚比该，也被掳去了。

chapters.en: David was greatly distressed because the men were talking of stoning him; each one was bitter in spirit because of his sons and daughters. But David found strength in the LORD his God.
chapters.zh: 大卫甚是焦急，因众人为自己的儿女苦恼，说，要用石头打死他。大卫却倚靠耶和华他的神，心里坚固。

chapters.en: Then David said to Abiathar the priest, the son of Ahimelek, “Bring me the ephod.” Abiathar brought it to him,
chapters.zh: 大卫对亚希米勒的儿子祭司亚比亚他说，请你将以弗得拿过来。亚比亚他就将以弗得拿到大卫面前。

chapters.en: and David inquired of the LORD, “Shall I pursue this raiding party? Will I overtake them?” “Pursue them,” he answered. “You will certainly overtake them and succeed in the rescue.”
chapters.zh: 大卫求问耶和华说，我追赶敌军，追得上追不上呢？耶和华说，你可以追，必追得上，都救得回来。

chapters.en: David and the six hundred men with him came to the Besor Valley, where some stayed behind.
chapters.zh: 于是，大卫和跟随他的六百人来到比梭溪。有不能前去的就留在那里。

chapters.en: Two hundred of them were too exhausted to cross the valley, but David and the other four hundred continued the pursuit.
chapters.zh: 大卫却带着四百人往前追赶，有二百人疲乏，不能过比梭溪，所以留在那里。

chapters.en: They found an Egyptian in a field and brought him to David. They gave him water to drink and food to eat—
chapters.zh: 这四百人在田野遇见一个埃及人，就带他到大卫面前，给他饼吃，给他水喝，

chapters.en: part of a cake of pressed figs and two cakes of raisins. He ate and was revived, for he had not eaten any food or drunk any water for three days and three nights.
chapters.zh: 又给他一块无花果饼，两个葡萄饼。他吃了，就精神复原。因为他三日三夜没有吃饼，没有喝水。

chapters.en: David asked him, “Who do you belong to? Where do you come from?” He said, “I am an Egyptian, the slave of an Amalekite. My master abandoned me when I became ill three days ago.
chapters.zh: 大卫问他说，你是属谁的。你是哪里的人。他回答说，我是埃及的少年人，是亚玛力人的奴仆。因我三日前患病，我主人就把我撇弃了。

chapters.en: We raided the Negev of the Kerethites, some territory belonging to Judah and the Negev of Caleb. And we burned Ziklag.”
chapters.zh: 我们侵夺了基利提的南方和属犹大的地，并迦勒地的南方，又用火烧了洗革拉。

chapters.en: David asked him, “Can you lead me down to this raiding party?” He answered, “Swear to me before God that you will not kill me or hand me over to my master, and I will take you down to them.”
chapters.zh: 大卫问他说，你肯领我们到敌军那里不肯。他回答说，你要向我指着神起誓，不杀我，也不将我交在我主人手里，我就领你上到敌军那里。

chapters.en: He led David down, and there they were, scattered over the countryside, eating, drinking and reveling because of the great amount of plunder they had taken from the land of the Philistines and from Judah.
chapters.zh: 那人领大卫下去，见他们散在地上，吃喝跳舞，因为从非利士地和犹大地所掳来的财物甚多。

chapters.en: David fought them from dusk until the evening of the next day, and none of them got away, except four hundred young men who rode off on camels and fled.
chapters.zh: 大卫从黎明直到次日晚上，击杀他们，除了四百骑骆驼的少年人之外，没有一个逃脱的。

chapters.en: David recovered everything the Amalekites had taken, including his two wives.
chapters.zh: 亚玛力人所掳去的财物，大卫全都夺回，并救回他的两个妻来。

chapters.en: Nothing was missing: young or old, boy or girl, plunder or anything else they had taken. David brought everything back.
chapters.zh: 凡亚玛力人所掳去的，无论大小，儿女，财物，大卫都夺回来，没有失落一个。

chapters.en: He took all the flocks and herds, and his men drove them ahead of the other livestock, saying, “This is David’s plunder.”
chapters.zh: 大卫所夺来的牛群羊群，跟随他的人赶在原有的群畜前边，说，这是大卫的掠物。

chapters.en: Then David came to the two hundred men who had been too exhausted to follow him and who were left behind at the Besor Valley. They came out to meet David and the men with him. As David and his men approached, he asked them how they were.
chapters.zh: 大卫到了那疲乏不能跟随，留在比梭溪的二百人那里。他们出来迎接大卫并跟随的人。大卫前来问他们安。

chapters.en: But all the evil men and troublemakers among David’s followers said, “Because they did not go out with us, we will not share with them the plunder we recovered. However, each man may take his wife and children and go.”
chapters.zh: 跟随大卫人中的恶人和匪类说，这些人既然没有和我们同去，我们所夺的财物就不分给他们，只将他们各人的妻子儿女给他们，使他们带去就是了。

chapters.en: David replied, “No, my brothers, you must not do that with what the LORD has given us. He has protected us and delivered into our hands the raiding party that came against us.
chapters.zh: 大卫说，弟兄们，耶和华所赐给我们的，不可不分给他们。因为他保佑我们，将那攻击我们的敌军交在我们手里。

chapters.en: Who will listen to what you say? The share of the man who stayed with the supplies is to be the same as that of him who went down to the battle. All will share alike.”
chapters.zh: 这事谁肯依从你们呢？上阵的得多少，看守器具的也得多少。应当大家平分。

chapters.en: David made this a statute and ordinance for Israel from that day to this.
chapters.zh: 大卫定此为以色列的律例典章，从那日直到今日。

chapters.en: When David reached Ziklag, he sent some of the plunder to the elders of Judah, who were his friends, saying, “Here is a gift for you from the plunder of the LORD’s enemies.”
chapters.zh: 大卫到了洗革拉，从掠物中取些送给他朋友犹大的长老，说，这是从耶和华仇敌那里夺来的，送你们为礼物。

chapters.en: David sent it to those who were in Bethel, Ramoth Negev and Jattir;
chapters.zh: 他送礼物给住伯特利的，南地拉末的，雅提珥的。

chapters.en: to those in Aroer, Siphmoth, Eshtemoa
chapters.zh: 住亚罗珥的，息末的，以实提莫的。

chapters.en: and Rakal; to those in the towns of the Jerahmeelites and the Kenites;
chapters.zh: 住拉哈勒的，耶拉篾各城的，基尼各城的。

chapters.en: to those in Hormah, Bor Ashan, Athak
chapters.zh: 住何珥玛的，歌拉珊的，亚挞的。

chapters.en: and Hebron; and to those in all the other places where he and his men had roamed.
chapters.zh: 住希伯仑的，并大卫和跟随他的人素来所到之处的人。

chapters.en: Now the Philistines fought against Israel; the Israelites fled before them, and many fell dead on Mount Gilboa.
chapters.zh: 非利士人与以色列人争战。以色列人在非利士人面前逃跑，在基利波有被杀仆倒的。

chapters.en: The Philistines were in hot pursuit of Saul and his sons, and they killed his sons Jonathan, Abinadab and Malki-Shua.
chapters.zh: 非利士人紧追扫罗和他儿子们，就杀了扫罗的儿子约拿单，亚比拿达，麦基舒亚。

chapters.en: The fighting grew fierce around Saul, and when the archers overtook him, they wounded him critically.
chapters.zh: 势派甚大，扫罗被弓箭手追上，射伤甚重，

chapters.en: Saul said to his armor-bearer, “Draw your sword and run me through, or these uncircumcised fellows will come and run me through and abuse me.” But his armor-bearer was terrified and would not do it; so Saul took his own sword and fell on it.
chapters.zh: 就吩咐拿他兵器的人说，你拔出刀来，将我刺死，免得那些未受割礼的人来刺我，凌辱我。但拿兵器的人甚惧怕，不肯刺他。扫罗就自己伏在刀上死了。

chapters.en: When the armor-bearer saw that Saul was dead, he too fell on his sword and died with him.
chapters.zh: 拿兵器的人见扫罗已死，也伏在刀上死了。

chapters.en: So Saul and his three sons and his armor-bearer and all his men died together that same day.
chapters.zh: 这样，扫罗和他三个儿子，与拿他兵器的人，以及跟随他的人，都一同死亡。

chapters.en: When the Israelites along the valley and those across the Jordan saw that the Israelite army had fled and that Saul and his sons had died, they abandoned their towns and fled. And the Philistines came and occupied them.
chapters.zh: 住平原那边并约旦河西的以色列人，见以色列军兵逃跑，扫罗和他儿子都死了，也就弃城逃跑。非利士人便来住在其中。

chapters.en: The next day, when the Philistines came to strip the dead, they found Saul and his three sons fallen on Mount Gilboa.
chapters.zh: 次日，非利士人来剥那被杀之人的衣服，看见扫罗和他三个儿子仆倒在基利波山，

chapters.en: They cut off his head and stripped off his armor, and they sent messengers throughout the land of the Philistines to proclaim the news in the temple of their idols and among their people.
chapters.zh: 就割下他的首级，剥了他的军装，打发人到非利士地的四境（到或作送到），报信与他们庙里的偶像和众民。

chapters.en: They put his armor in the temple of the Ashtoreths and fastened his body to the wall of Beth Shan.
chapters.zh: 又将扫罗的军装放在亚斯他录庙里，将他的尸身钉在伯珊的城墙上。

chapters.en: When the people of Jabesh Gilead heard what the Philistines had done to Saul,
chapters.zh: 基列雅比的居民听见非利士人向扫罗所行的事，

chapters.en: all their valiant men marched through the night to Beth Shan. They took down the bodies of Saul and his sons from the wall of Beth Shan and went to Jabesh, where they burned them.
chapters.zh: 他们中间所有的勇士就起身，走了一夜，将扫罗和他儿子的尸身从伯珊城墙上取下来，送到雅比那里，用火烧了。

chapters.en: Then they took their bones and buried them under a tamarisk tree at Jabesh, and they fasted seven days.
chapters.zh: 将他们骸骨葬在雅比的垂丝柳树下，就禁食七日。

chapters.en: After the death of Saul, David returned from striking down the Amalekites and stayed in Ziklag two days.
chapters.zh: 扫罗死后，大卫击杀亚玛力人回来，在洗革拉住了两天。

chapters.en: On the third day a man arrived from Saul’s camp with his clothes torn and dust on his head. When he came to David, he fell to the ground to pay him honor.
chapters.zh: 第三天，有一人从扫罗的营里出来，衣服撕裂，头蒙灰尘，到大卫面前伏地叩拜。

chapters.en: “Where have you come from?” David asked him. He answered, “I have escaped from the Israelite camp.”
chapters.zh: 大卫问他说，你从哪里来。他说，我从以色列的营里逃来。

chapters.en: “What happened?” David asked. “Tell me.” “The men fled from the battle,” he replied. “Many of them fell and died. And Saul and his son Jonathan are dead.”
chapters.zh: 大卫又问他说，事情怎样。请你告诉我。他回答说，百姓从阵上逃跑，也有许多人仆倒死亡。扫罗和他儿子约拿单也死了。

chapters.en: Then David said to the young man who brought him the report, “How do you know that Saul and his son Jonathan are dead?”
chapters.zh: 大卫问报信的少年人说，你怎么知道扫罗和他儿子约拿单死了呢？

chapters.en: “I happened to be on Mount Gilboa,” the young man said, “and there was Saul, leaning on his spear, with the chariots and their drivers in hot pursuit.
chapters.zh: 报信的少年人说，我偶然到基利波山，看见扫罗伏在自己枪上，有战车，马兵紧紧地追他。

chapters.en: When he turned around and saw me, he called out to me, and I said, ‘What can I do?’
chapters.zh: 他回头看见我，就呼叫我。我说，我在这里。

chapters.en: “He asked me, ‘Who are you?’ “ ‘An Amalekite,’ I answered.
chapters.zh: 他问我说，你是什么人。我说，我是亚玛力人。

chapters.en: “Then he said to me, ‘Stand here by me and kill me! I’m in the throes of death, but I’m still alive.’
chapters.zh: 他说，请你来，将我杀死。因为痛苦抓住我，我的生命尚存。

chapters.en: “So I stood beside him and killed him, because I knew that after he had fallen he could not survive. And I took the crown that was on his head and the band on his arm and have brought them here to my lord.”
chapters.zh: 我准知他仆倒必不能活，就去将他杀死，把他头上的冠冕，臂上的镯子拿到我主这里。

chapters.en: Then David and all the men with him took hold of their clothes and tore them.
chapters.zh: 大卫就撕裂衣服，跟随他的人也是如此，

chapters.en: They mourned and wept and fasted till evening for Saul and his son Jonathan, and for the army of the LORD and for the nation of Israel, because they had fallen by the sword.
chapters.zh: 而且悲哀哭号，禁食到晚上，是因扫罗和他儿子约拿单，并耶和华的民以色列家的人，倒在刀下。

chapters.en: David said to the young man who brought him the report, “Where are you from?” “I am the son of a foreigner, an Amalekite,” he answered.
chapters.zh: 大卫问报信的少年人说，你是哪里的人。他说，我是亚玛力客人的儿子。

chapters.en: David asked him, “Why weren’t you afraid to lift your hand to destroy the LORD’s anointed?”
chapters.zh: 大卫说，你伸手杀害耶和华的受膏者，怎么不畏惧呢？

chapters.en: Then David called one of his men and said, “Go, strike him down!” So he struck him down, and he died.
chapters.zh: 大卫叫了一个少年人来，说，你去杀他吧。

chapters.en: For David had said to him, “Your blood be on your own head. Your own mouth testified against you when you said, ‘I killed the LORD’s anointed.’ ”
chapters.zh: 大卫对他说，你流人血的罪归到自己的头上，因为你亲口作见证说，我杀了耶和华的受膏者。少年人就把他杀了。

chapters.en: David took up this lament concerning Saul and his son Jonathan,
chapters.zh: 大卫作哀歌，吊扫罗和他儿子约拿单，

chapters.en: and he ordered that the people of Judah be taught this lament of the bow (it is written in the Book of Jashar):
chapters.zh: 且吩咐将这歌教导犹大人。这歌名叫弓歌，写在雅煞珥书上。

chapters.en: “A gazelle lies slain on your heights, Israel. How the mighty have fallen!
chapters.zh: 歌中说，以色列阿，你尊荣者在山上被杀。大英雄何竟死亡。

chapters.en: “Tell it not in Gath, proclaim it not in the streets of Ashkelon, lest the daughters of the Philistines be glad, lest the daughters of the uncircumcised rejoice.
chapters.zh: 不要在迦特报告。不要在亚实基伦街上传扬。免得非利士的女子欢乐。免得未受割礼之人的女子矜夸。

chapters.en: “Mountains of Gilboa, may you have neither dew nor rain, may no showers fall on your terraced fields.For there the shield of the mighty was despised, the shield of Saul—no longer rubbed with oil.
chapters.zh: 基利波山哪，愿你那里没有雨露。愿你田地无土产可作供物。因为英雄的盾牌在那里被污丢弃。扫罗的盾牌仿佛未曾抹油。

chapters.en: “From the blood of the slain, from the flesh of the mighty, the bow of Jonathan did not turn back, the sword of Saul did not return unsatisfied.
chapters.zh: 约拿单的弓箭非流敌人的血不退缩。扫罗的刀剑非剖勇士的油不收回。

chapters.en: Saul and Jonathan— in life they were loved and admired, and in death they were not parted. They were swifter than eagles, they were stronger than lions.
chapters.zh: 扫罗和约拿单，活时相悦相爱，死时也不分离。他们比鹰更快，比狮子还强。

chapters.en: “Daughters of Israel, weep for Saul, who clothed you in scarlet and finery, who adorned your garments with ornaments of gold.
chapters.zh: 以色列的女子阿，当为扫罗哭号。他曾使你们穿朱红色的美衣，使你们衣服有黄金的妆饰。

chapters.en: “How the mighty have fallen in battle! Jonathan lies slain on your heights.
chapters.zh: 英雄何竟在阵上仆倒。约拿单何竟在山上被杀。

chapters.en: I grieve for you, Jonathan my brother; you were very dear to me. Your love for me was wonderful, more wonderful than that of women.
chapters.zh: 我兄约拿单哪，我为你悲伤。我甚喜悦你。你向我发的爱情奇妙非常，过于妇女的爱情。

chapters.en: “How the mighty have fallen! The weapons of war have perished!”
chapters.zh: 英雄何竟仆倒。战具何竟灭没。

chapters.en: In the course of time, David inquired of the LORD. “Shall I go up to one of the towns of Judah?” he asked. The LORD said, “Go up.” David asked, “Where shall I go?” “To Hebron,” the LORD answered.
chapters.zh: 此后，大卫问耶和华说，我上犹大的一个城去可以吗？耶和华说，可以。大卫说，我上哪一个城去呢？耶和华说，上希伯仑去。

chapters.en: So David went up there with his two wives, Ahinoam of Jezreel and Abigail, the widow of Nabal of Carmel.
chapters.zh: 于是大卫和他的两个妻，一个是耶斯列人亚希暖，一个是作过迦密人拿八妻的亚比该，都上那里去了。

chapters.en: David also took the men who were with him, each with his family, and they settled in Hebron and its towns.
chapters.zh: 大卫也将跟随他的人和他们各人的眷属一同带上去，住在希伯仑的城邑中。

chapters.en: Then the men of Judah came to Hebron, and there they anointed David king over the tribe of Judah. When David was told that it was the men from Jabesh Gilead who had buried Saul,
chapters.zh: 犹大人来到希伯仑，在那里膏大卫作犹大家的王。有人告诉大卫说，葬埋扫罗的是基列雅比人。

chapters.en: he sent messengers to them to say to them, “The LORD bless you for showing this kindness to Saul your master by burying him.
chapters.zh: 大卫就差人去见基列雅比人，对他们说，你们厚待你们的主扫罗，将他葬埋。愿耶和华赐福与你们。

chapters.en: May the LORD now show you kindness and faithfulness, and I too will show you the same favor because you have done this.
chapters.zh: 你们既行了这事，愿耶和华以慈爱诚实待你们，我也要为此厚待你们。

chapters.en: Now then, be strong and brave, for Saul your master is dead, and the people of Judah have anointed me king over them.”
chapters.zh: 现在你们的主扫罗死了，犹大家已经膏我作他们的王，所以你们要刚强奋勇。

chapters.en: Meanwhile, Abner son of Ner, the commander of Saul’s army, had taken Ish-Bosheth son of Saul and brought him over to Mahanaim.
chapters.zh: 扫罗的元帅尼珥的儿子押尼珥，曾将扫罗的儿子伊施波设带过河，到玛哈念，

chapters.en: He made him king over Gilead, Ashuri and Jezreel, and also over Ephraim, Benjamin and all Israel.
chapters.zh: 立他作王，治理基列，亚书利，耶斯列，以法莲，便雅悯，和以色列众人。

chapters.en: Ish-Bosheth son of Saul was forty years old when he became king over Israel, and he reigned two years. The tribe of Judah, however, remained loyal to David.
chapters.zh: 扫罗的儿子伊施波设登基的时候年四十岁，作以色列王二年。惟独犹大家归从大卫。

chapters.en: The length of time David was king in Hebron over Judah was seven years and six months.
chapters.zh: 大卫在希伯仑作犹大家的王，共七年零六个月。

chapters.en: Abner son of Ner, together with the men of Ish-Bosheth son of Saul, left Mahanaim and went to Gibeon.
chapters.zh: 尼珥的儿子押尼珥和扫罗的儿子伊施波设的仆人从玛哈念出来，往基遍去。

chapters.en: Joab son of Zeruiah and David’s men went out and met them at the pool of Gibeon. One group sat down on one side of the pool and one group on the other side.
chapters.zh: 洗鲁雅的儿子约押和大卫的仆人也出来，在基遍池旁与他们相遇。一班坐在池这边，一班坐在池那边。

chapters.en: Then Abner said to Joab, “Let’s have some of the young men get up and fight hand to hand in front of us.” “All right, let them do it,” Joab said.
chapters.zh: 押尼珥对约押说，让少年人起来，在我们面前戏耍吧。约押说，可以。

chapters.en: So they stood up and were counted off—twelve men for Benjamin and Ish-Bosheth son of Saul, and twelve for David.
chapters.zh: 就按着定数起来，属扫罗儿子伊施波设的便雅悯人过去十二名，大卫的仆人也过去十二名，

chapters.en: Then each man grabbed his opponent by the head and thrust his dagger into his opponent’s side, and they fell down together. So that place in Gibeon was called Helkath Hazzurim.
chapters.zh: 彼此揪头，用刀刺肋，一同仆倒。所以，那地叫作希利甲哈素林，就在基遍。

chapters.en: The battle that day was very fierce, and Abner and the Israelites were defeated by David’s men.
chapters.zh: 那日的战事凶猛，押尼珥和以色列人败在大卫的仆人面前。

chapters.en: The three sons of Zeruiah were there: Joab, Abishai and Asahel. Now Asahel was as fleet-footed as a wild gazelle.
chapters.zh: 在那里有洗鲁雅的三个儿子，约押，亚比筛，亚撒黑。亚撒黑脚快如野鹿一般。

chapters.en: He chased Abner, turning neither to the right nor to the left as he pursued him.
chapters.zh: 亚撒黑追赶押尼珥，直追赶他不偏左右。

chapters.en: Abner looked behind him and asked, “Is that you, Asahel?” “It is,” he answered.
chapters.zh: 押尼珥回头说，你是亚撒黑吗？回答说，是。

chapters.en: Then Abner said to him, “Turn aside to the right or to the left; take on one of the young men and strip him of his weapons.” But Asahel would not stop chasing him.
chapters.zh: 押尼珥对他说，你或转向左转向右，拿住一个少年人，剥去他的战衣。亚撒黑却不肯转开不追赶他。

chapters.en: Again Abner warned Asahel, “Stop chasing me! Why should I strike you down? How could I look your brother Joab in the face?”
chapters.zh: 押尼珥又对亚撒黑说，你转开不追赶我吧。我何必杀你呢？若杀你，有什么脸见你哥哥约押呢？

chapters.en: But Asahel refused to give up the pursuit; so Abner thrust the butt of his spear into Asahel’s stomach, and the spear came out through his back. He fell there and died on the spot. And every man stopped when he came to the place where Asahel had fallen and died.
chapters.zh: 亚撒黑仍不肯转开。故此，押尼珥就用枪刺入他的肚腹，甚至枪从背后透出，亚撒黑就在那里仆倒而死。众人赶到亚撒黑仆倒而死的地方，就都站住。

chapters.en: But Joab and Abishai pursued Abner, and as the sun was setting, they came to the hill of Ammah, near Giah on the way to the wasteland of Gibeon.
chapters.zh: 约押和亚比筛追赶押尼珥，日落的时候，到了通基遍旷野的路旁，基亚对面的亚玛山。

chapters.en: Then the men of Benjamin rallied behind Abner. They formed themselves into a group and took their stand on top of a hill.
chapters.zh: 便雅悯人聚集，跟随押尼珥站在一个山顶上。

chapters.en: Abner called out to Joab, “Must the sword devour forever? Don’t you realize that this will end in bitterness? How long before you order your men to stop pursuing their fellow Israelites?”
chapters.zh: 押尼珥呼叫约押说，刀剑岂可永远杀人吗？你岂不知终久必有苦楚吗？你要等何时才叫百姓回去，不追赶弟兄呢？

chapters.en: Joab answered, “As surely as God lives, if you had not spoken, the men would have continued pursuing them until morning.”
chapters.zh: 约押说，我指着永生的神起誓，你若不说戏耍的那句话，今日早晨百姓就回去，不追赶弟兄了。

chapters.en: So Joab blew the trumpet, and all the troops came to a halt; they no longer pursued Israel, nor did they fight anymore.
chapters.zh: 于是约押吹角，众民就站住，不再追赶以色列人，也不再打仗了。

chapters.en: All that night Abner and his men marched through the Arabah. They crossed the Jordan, continued through the morning hours and came to Mahanaim.
chapters.zh: 押尼珥和跟随他的人整夜经过亚拉巴，过约旦河，走过毕伦，到了玛哈念。

chapters.en: Then Joab stopped pursuing Abner and assembled the whole army. Besides Asahel, nineteen of David’s men were found missing.
chapters.zh: 约押追赶押尼珥回来，聚集众民，见大卫的仆人中缺少了十九个人和亚撒黑。

chapters.en: But David’s men had killed three hundred and sixty Benjamites who were with Abner.
chapters.zh: 但大卫的仆人杀了便雅悯人和跟随押尼珥的人，共三百六十名。

chapters.en: They took Asahel and buried him in his father’s tomb at Bethlehem. Then Joab and his men marched all night and arrived at Hebron by daybreak.
chapters.zh: 众人将亚撒黑送到伯利恒，葬在他父亲的坟墓里。约押和跟随他的人走了一夜，天亮的时候到了希伯仑。

chapters.en: The war between the house of Saul and the house of David lasted a long time. David grew stronger and stronger, while the house of Saul grew weaker and weaker.
chapters.zh: 扫罗家和大卫家争战许久。大卫家日见强盛。扫罗家日见衰弱。

chapters.en: Sons were born to David in Hebron: His firstborn was Amnon the son of Ahinoam of Jezreel;
chapters.zh: 大卫在希伯仑得了几个儿子，长子暗嫩是耶斯列人亚希暖所生的。

chapters.en: his second, Kileab the son of Abigail the widow of Nabal of Carmel; the third, Absalom the son of Maakah daughter of Talmai king of Geshur;
chapters.zh: 次子基利押（基利押历代上三章一节作但以利）是作过迦密人拿八的妻亚比该所生的。三子押沙龙是基述王达买的女儿玛迦所生的。

chapters.en: the fourth, Adonijah the son of Haggith; the fifth, Shephatiah the son of Abital;
chapters.zh: 四子亚多尼雅是哈及所生的。五子示法提雅是亚比他所生的。

chapters.en: and the sixth, Ithream the son of David’s wife Eglah. These were born to David in Hebron.
chapters.zh: 六子以特念是大卫的妻以格拉所生的。大卫这六个儿子都是在希伯仑生的。

chapters.en: During the war between the house of Saul and the house of David, Abner had been strengthening his own position in the house of Saul.
chapters.zh: 扫罗家和大卫家争战的时候，押尼珥在扫罗家大有权势。

chapters.en: Now Saul had had a concubine named Rizpah daughter of Aiah. And Ish-Bosheth said to Abner, “Why did you sleep with my father’s concubine?”
chapters.zh: 扫罗有一妃嫔，名叫利斯巴，是爱亚的女儿。一日，伊施波设对押尼珥说，你为什么与我父的妃嫔同房呢？

chapters.en: Abner was very angry because of what Ish-Bosheth said. So he answered, “Am I a dog’s head—on Judah’s side? This very day I am loyal to the house of your father Saul and to his family and friends. I haven’t handed you over to David. Yet now you accuse me of an offense involving this woman!
chapters.zh: 押尼珥因伊施波设的话就甚发怒，说，我岂是犹大的狗头呢？我恩待你父扫罗的家和他的弟兄，朋友，不将你交在大卫手里，今日你竟为这妇人责备我吗？

chapters.en: May God deal with Abner, be it ever so severely, if I do not do for David what the LORD promised him on oath
chapters.zh: 我若不照着耶和华起誓应许大卫的话行，废去扫罗的位，建立大卫的位，使他治理以色列和犹大，从但直到别是巴，愿神重重地降罚与我。

chapters.en: and transfer the kingdom from the house of Saul and establish David’s throne over Israel and Judah from Dan to Beersheba.”
Ish-Bosheth did not dare to say another word to Abner, because he was afraid of him.
chapters.zh: 伊施波设惧怕押尼珥，不敢回答一句。

chapters.en: Then Abner sent messengers on his behalf to say to David, “Whose land is it? Make an agreement with me, and I will help you bring all Israel over to you.”
chapters.zh: 押尼珥打发人去见大卫，替他说，这国归谁呢？又说，你与我立约，我必帮助你，使以色列人都归服你。

chapters.en: “Good,” said David. “I will make an agreement with you. But I demand one thing of you: Do not come into my presence unless you bring Michal daughter of Saul when you come to see me.”
chapters.zh: 大卫说，好。我与你立约。但有一件，你来见我面的时候，若不将扫罗的女儿米甲带来，必不得见我的面。

chapters.en: Then David sent messengers to Ish-Bosheth son of Saul, demanding, “Give me my wife Michal, whom I betrothed to myself for the price of a hundred Philistine foreskins.”
chapters.zh: 大卫就打发人去见扫罗的儿子伊施波设，说，你要将我的妻米甲归还我。她是我从前用一百非利士人的阳皮所聘定的。

chapters.en: So Ish-Bosheth gave orders and had her taken away from her husband Paltiel son of Laish.
chapters.zh: 伊施波设就打发人去，将米甲从拉亿的儿子，她丈夫帕铁那里接回来。

chapters.en: Her husband, however, went with her, weeping behind her all the way to Bahurim. Then Abner said to him, “Go back home!” So he went back.
chapters.zh: 米甲的丈夫跟着她，一面走一面哭，直跟到巴户琳。押尼珥说，你回去吧。帕铁就回去了。

chapters.en: Abner conferred with the elders of Israel and said, “For some time you have wanted to make David your king.
chapters.zh: 押尼珥对以色列长老说，从前你们愿意大卫作王治理你们，

chapters.en: Now do it! For the LORD promised David, ‘By my servant David I will rescue my people Israel from the hand of the Philistines and from the hand of all their enemies.’ ”
chapters.zh: 现在你们可以照心愿而行。因为耶和华曾论到大卫说，我必借我仆人大卫的手，救我民以色列脱离非利士人和众仇敌的手。

chapters.en: Abner also spoke to the Benjamites in person. Then he went to Hebron to tell David everything that Israel and the whole tribe of Benjamin wanted to do.
chapters.zh: 押尼珥也用这话说给便雅悯人听，又到希伯仑，将以色列人和便雅悯全家一切所喜悦的事说给大卫听。

chapters.en: When Abner, who had twenty men with him, came to David at Hebron, David prepared a feast for him and his men.
chapters.zh: 押尼珥带着二十个人来到希伯仑见大卫，大卫就为押尼珥和他带来的人设摆筵席。

chapters.en: Then Abner said to David, “Let me go at once and assemble all Israel for my lord the king, so that they may make a covenant with you, and that you may rule over all that your heart desires.” So David sent Abner away, and he went in peace.
chapters.zh: 押尼珥对大卫说，我要起身去招聚以色列众人来见我主我王，与你立约，你就可以照着心愿作王。于是大卫送押尼珥去，押尼珥就平平安安地去了。

chapters.en: Just then David’s men and Joab returned from a raid and brought with them a great deal of plunder. But Abner was no longer with David in Hebron, because David had sent him away, and he had gone in peace.
chapters.zh: 约押和大卫的仆人攻击敌军，带回许多的掠物。那时押尼珥不在希伯仑大卫那里，因大卫已经送他去，他也平平安安地去了。

chapters.en: When Joab and all the soldiers with him arrived, he was told that Abner son of Ner had come to the king and that the king had sent him away and that he had gone in peace.
chapters.zh: 约押和跟随他的全军到了，就有人告诉约押说，尼珥的儿子押尼珥来见王，王送他去，他也平平安安地去了。

chapters.en: So Joab went to the king and said, “What have you done? Look, Abner came to you. Why did you let him go? Now he is gone!
chapters.zh: 约押去见王说，你这是作什么呢？押尼珥来见你，你为何送他去，他就踪影不见了呢？

chapters.en: You know Abner son of Ner; he came to deceive you and observe your movements and find out everything you are doing.”
chapters.zh: 你当晓得，尼珥的儿子押尼珥来是要诓哄你，要知道你的出入和你一切所行的事。

chapters.en: Joab then left David and sent messengers after Abner, and they brought him back from the cistern at Sirah. But David did not know it.
chapters.zh: 约押从大卫那里出来，就打发人去追赶押尼珥，在西拉井追上他，将他带回来，大卫却不知道。

chapters.en: Now when Abner returned to Hebron, Joab took him aside into an inner chamber, as if to speak with him privately. And there, to avenge the blood of his brother Asahel, Joab stabbed him in the stomach, and he died.
chapters.zh: 押尼珥回到希伯仑，约押领他到城门的瓮洞，假作要与他说机密话，就在那里刺透他的肚腹，他便死了。这是报杀他兄弟亚撒黑的仇。

chapters.en: Later, when David heard about this, he said, “I and my kingdom are forever innocent before the LORD concerning the blood of Abner son of Ner.
chapters.zh: 大卫听见了，就说，流尼珥的儿子押尼珥的血，这罪在耶和华面前必永不归我和我的国。

chapters.en: May his blood fall on the head of Joab and on his whole family! May Joab’s family never be without someone who has a running sore or leprosy or who leans on a crutch or who falls by the sword or who lacks food.”
chapters.zh: 愿流他血的罪归到约押头上和他父的全家。又愿约押家不断有患漏症的，长大麻疯的，架拐而行的，被刀杀死的，缺乏饮食的。

chapters.en: (Joab and his brother Abishai murdered Abner because he had killed their brother Asahel in the battle at Gibeon.)
chapters.zh: 约押和他兄弟亚比筛杀了押尼珥，是因押尼珥在基遍争战的时候杀了他们的兄弟亚撒黑。

chapters.en: Then David said to Joab and all the people with him, “Tear your clothes and put on sackcloth and walk in mourning in front of Abner.” King David himself walked behind the bier.
chapters.zh: 大卫吩咐约押和跟随他的众人说，你们当撕裂衣服，腰束麻布，在押尼珥棺前哀哭。大卫王也跟在棺后。

chapters.en: They buried Abner in Hebron, and the king wept aloud at Abner’s tomb. All the people wept also.
chapters.zh: 他们将押尼珥葬在希伯仑。王在押尼珥的墓旁放声而哭，众民也都哭了。

chapters.en: The king sang this lament for Abner: “Should Abner have died as the lawless die?
chapters.zh: 王为押尼珥举哀，说，押尼珥何竟像愚顽人死呢？

chapters.en: Your hands were not bound, your feet were not fettered. You fell as one falls before the wicked.” And all the people wept over him again.
chapters.zh: 你手未曾捆绑，脚未曾锁住。你死，如人死在罪孽之辈手下一样。于是众民又为押尼珥哀哭。

chapters.en: Then they all came and urged David to eat something while it was still day; but David took an oath, saying, “May God deal with me, be it ever so severely, if I taste bread or anything else before the sun sets!”
chapters.zh: 日头未落的时候，众民来劝大卫吃饭，但大卫起誓说，我若在日头未落以前吃饭，或吃别物，愿神重重地降罚与我。

chapters.en: All the people took note and were pleased; indeed, everything the king did pleased them.
chapters.zh: 众民知道了就都喜悦。凡王所行的，众民无不喜悦。

chapters.en: So on that day all the people there and all Israel knew that the king had no part in the murder of Abner son of Ner.
chapters.zh: 那日，以色列众民才知道杀尼珥的儿子押尼珥并非出于王意。

chapters.en: Then the king said to his men, “Do you not realize that a commander and a great man has fallen in Israel this day?
chapters.zh: 王对臣仆说，你们岂不知今日以色列人中死了一个作元帅的大丈夫吗？

chapters.en: And today, though I am the anointed king, I am weak, and these sons of Zeruiah are too strong for me. May the LORD repay the evildoer according to his evil deeds!”
chapters.zh: 我虽然受膏为王，今日还是软弱。这洗鲁雅的两个儿子比我刚强。愿耶和华照着恶人所行的恶报应他。

chapters.en: When Ish-Bosheth son of Saul heard that Abner had died in Hebron, he lost courage, and all Israel became alarmed.
chapters.zh: 扫罗的儿子伊施波设听见押尼珥死在希伯仑，手就发软。以色列众人也都惊惶。

chapters.en: Now Saul’s son had two men who were leaders of raiding bands. One was named Baanah and the other Rekab; they were sons of Rimmon the Beerothite from the tribe of Benjamin—Beeroth is considered part of Benjamin,
chapters.zh: 扫罗的儿子伊施波设有两个军长，一名巴拿，一名利甲，是便雅悯支派，比录人临门的儿子。比录也属便雅悯。

chapters.en: because the people of Beeroth fled to Gittaim and have resided there as foreigners to this day.
chapters.zh: 比录人早先逃到基他音，在那里寄居，直到今日。

chapters.en: (Jonathan son of Saul had a son who was lame in both feet. He was five years old when the news about Saul and Jonathan came from Jezreel. His nurse picked him up and fled, but as she hurried to leave, he fell and became disabled. His name was Mephibosheth.)
chapters.zh: 扫罗的儿子约拿单有一个儿子名叫米非波设，是瘸腿的。扫罗和约拿单死亡的消息从耶斯列传到的时候，他才五岁。他乳母抱着他逃跑。因为跑得太急，孩子掉在地上，腿就瘸了。

chapters.en: Now Rekab and Baanah, the sons of Rimmon the Beerothite, set out for the house of Ish-Bosheth, and they arrived there in the heat of the day while he was taking his noonday rest.
chapters.zh: 一日，比录人临门的两个儿子利甲和巴拿出去，约在午热的时候到了伊施波设的家。伊施波设正睡午觉。

chapters.en: They went into the inner part of the house as if to get some wheat, and they stabbed him in the stomach. Then Rekab and his brother Baanah slipped away.
chapters.zh: 他们进了房子，假作要取麦子，就刺透伊施波设的肚腹，逃跑了。

chapters.en: They had gone into the house while he was lying on the bed in his bedroom. After they stabbed and killed him, they cut off his head. Taking it with them, they traveled all night by way of the Arabah.
chapters.zh: 他们进房子的时候，伊施波设正在卧房里躺在床上，他们将他杀死，割了他的首级，拿着首级在亚拉巴走了一夜，

chapters.en: They brought the head of Ish-Bosheth to David at Hebron and said to the king, “Here is the head of Ish-Bosheth son of Saul, your enemy, who tried to kill you. This day the LORD has avenged my lord the king against Saul and his offspring.”
chapters.zh: 将伊施波设的首级拿到希伯仑见大卫王，说，王的仇敌扫罗曾寻索王的性命。看哪，这是他儿子伊施波设的首级。耶和华今日为我主我王在扫罗和他后裔的身上报了仇。

chapters.en: David answered Rekab and his brother Baanah, the sons of Rimmon the Beerothite, “As surely as the LORD lives, who has delivered me out of every trouble,
chapters.zh: 大卫对比录人临门的儿子利甲和他兄弟巴拿说，我指着救我性命脱离一切苦难，永生的耶和华起誓，

chapters.en: when someone told me, ‘Saul is dead,’ and thought he was bringing good news, I seized him and put him to death in Ziklag. That was the reward I gave him for his news!
chapters.zh: 从前有人报告我说，扫罗死了，他自以为报好消息。我就拿住他，将他杀在洗革拉，这就作了他报消息的赏赐。

chapters.en: How much more—when wicked men have killed an innocent man in his own house and on his own bed—should I not now demand his blood from your hand and rid the earth of you!”
chapters.zh: 何况恶人将义人杀在他的床上，我岂不向你们讨流他血的罪，从世上除灭你们呢？

chapters.en: So David gave an order to his men, and they killed them. They cut off their hands and feet and hung the bodies by the pool in Hebron. But they took the head of Ish-Bosheth and buried it in Abner’s tomb at Hebron.
chapters.zh: 于是大卫吩咐少年人将他们杀了，砍断他们的手脚，挂在希伯仑的池旁，却将伊施波设的首级葬在希伯仑押尼珥的坟墓里。

chapters.en: All the tribes of Israel came to David at Hebron and said, “We are your own flesh and blood.
chapters.zh: 以色列众支派来到希伯仑见大卫，说，我们原是你的骨肉。

chapters.en: In the past, while Saul was king over us, you were the one who led Israel on their military campaigns. And the LORD said to you, ‘You will shepherd my people Israel, and you will become their ruler.’ ”
chapters.zh: 从前扫罗作我们王的时候，率领以色列人出入的是你。耶和华也曾应许你说，你必牧养我的民以色列，作以色列的君。

chapters.en: When all the elders of Israel had come to King David at Hebron, the king made a covenant with them at Hebron before the LORD, and they anointed David king over Israel.
chapters.zh: 于是以色列的长老都来到希伯仑见大卫王，大卫在希伯仑耶和华面前与他们立约，他们就膏大卫作以色列的王。

chapters.en: David was thirty years old when he became king, and he reigned forty years.
chapters.zh: 大卫登基的时候年三十岁，在位四十年。

chapters.en: In Hebron he reigned over Judah seven years and six months, and in Jerusalem he reigned over all Israel and Judah thirty-three years.
chapters.zh: 在希伯仑作犹大王七年零六个月，在耶路撒冷作以色列和犹大王三十三年。

chapters.en: The king and his men marched to Jerusalem to attack the Jebusites, who lived there. The Jebusites said to David, “You will not get in here; even the blind and the lame can ward you off.” They thought, “David cannot get in here.”
chapters.zh: 大卫和跟随他的人到了耶路撒冷，要攻打住那地方的耶布斯人。耶布斯人对大卫说，你若不赶出瞎子，瘸子，必不能进这地方。心里想大卫决不能进去。

chapters.en: Nevertheless, David captured the fortress of Zion—which is the City of David.
chapters.zh: 然而大卫攻取锡安的保障，就是大卫的城。

chapters.en: On that day David had said, “Anyone who conquers the Jebusites will have to use the water shaft to reach those ‘lame and blind’ who are David’s enemies. ” That is why they say, “The ‘blind and lame’ will not enter the palace.”
chapters.zh: 当日，大卫说，谁攻打耶布斯人，当上水沟攻打我心里所恨恶的瘸子，瞎子。从此有俗语说，在那里有瞎子，瘸子，他不能进屋去。

chapters.en: David then took up residence in the fortress and called it the City of David. He built up the area around it, from the terraces inward.
chapters.zh: 大卫住在保障里，给保障起名叫大卫城。大卫又从米罗以里，周围筑墙。

chapters.en: And he became more and more powerful, because the LORD God Almighty was with him.
chapters.zh: 大卫日见强盛，因为耶和华万军之神与他同在。

chapters.en: Now Hiram king of Tyre sent envoys to David, along with cedar logs and carpenters and stonemasons, and they built a palace for David.
chapters.zh: 推罗王希兰将香柏木运到大卫那里，又差遣使者和木匠，石匠给大卫建造宫殿。

chapters.en: Then David knew that the LORD had established him as king over Israel and had exalted his kingdom for the sake of his people Israel.
chapters.zh: 大卫就知道耶和华坚立他作以色列王，又为自己的民以色列使他的国兴旺。

chapters.en: After he left Hebron, David took more concubines and wives in Jerusalem, and more sons and daughters were born to him.
chapters.zh: 大卫离开希伯仑之后，在耶路撒冷又立后妃，又生儿女。

chapters.en: These are the names of the children born to him there: Shammua, Shobab, Nathan, Solomon,
chapters.zh: 在耶路撒冷所生的儿子是沙母亚，朔罢，拿单，所罗门，

chapters.en: Ibhar, Elishua, Nepheg, Japhia,
chapters.zh: 益辖，以利书亚，尼斐，雅非亚，

chapters.en: Elishama, Eliada and Eliphelet.
chapters.zh: 以利沙玛，以利雅大，以利法列。

chapters.en: When the Philistines heard that David had been anointed king over Israel, they went up in full force to search for him, but David heard about it and went down to the stronghold.
chapters.zh: 非利士人听见人膏大卫作以色列王，非利士众人就上来寻索大卫。大卫听见，就下到保障。

chapters.en: Now the Philistines had come and spread out in the Valley of Rephaim;
chapters.zh: 非利士人来了，布散在利乏音谷。

chapters.en: so David inquired of the LORD, “Shall I go and attack the Philistines? Will you deliver them into my hands?” The LORD answered him, “Go, for I will surely deliver the Philistines into your hands.”
chapters.zh: 大卫求问耶和华说，我可以上去攻打非利士人吗？你将他们交在我手里吗？耶和华说，你可以上去，我必将非利士人交在你手里。

chapters.en: So David went to Baal Perazim, and there he defeated them. He said, “As waters break out, the LORD has broken out against my enemies before me.” So that place was called Baal Perazim.
chapters.zh: 大卫来到巴力毗拉心，在那里击杀非利士人，说，耶和华在我面前冲破敌人，如同水冲去一般。因此称那地方为巴力毗拉心。

chapters.en: The Philistines abandoned their idols there, and David and his men carried them off.
chapters.zh: 非利士人将偶像撇在那里，大卫和跟随他的人拿去了。

chapters.en: Once more the Philistines came up and spread out in the Valley of Rephaim;
chapters.zh: 非利士人又上来，布散在利乏音谷。

chapters.en: so David inquired of the LORD, and he answered, “Do not go straight up, but circle around behind them and attack them in front of the poplar trees.
chapters.zh: 大卫求问耶和华。耶和华说，不要一直地上去，要转到他们后头，从桑林对面攻打他们。

chapters.en: As soon as you hear the sound of marching in the tops of the poplar trees, move quickly, because that will mean the LORD has gone out in front of you to strike the Philistine army.”
chapters.zh: 你听见桑树梢上有脚步的声音，就要急速前去，因为那时耶和华已经在你前头去攻打非利士人的军队。

chapters.en: So David did as the LORD commanded him, and he struck down the Philistines all the way from Gibeon to Gezer.
chapters.zh: 大卫就遵着耶和华所吩咐的去行，攻打非利士人，从迦巴直到基色。

chapters.en: David again brought together all the able young men of Israel—thirty thousand.
chapters.zh: 大卫又聚集以色列中所有挑选的人三万。

chapters.en: He and all his men went to Baalah in Judah to bring up from there the ark of God, which is called by the Name, the name of the LORD Almighty, who is enthroned between the cherubim on the ark.
chapters.zh: 大卫起身，率领跟随他的众人前往，要从巴拉犹大将神的约柜运来。这约柜就是坐在二基路伯上万军之耶和华留名的约柜。

chapters.en: They set the ark of God on a new cart and brought it from the house of Abinadab, which was on the hill. Uzzah and Ahio, sons of Abinadab, were guiding the new cart
chapters.zh: 他们将神的约柜从冈上亚比拿达的家里抬出来，放在新车上。亚比拿达的两个儿子乌撒和亚希约赶这新车。

chapters.en: with the ark of God on it, and Ahio was walking in front of it.
chapters.zh: 他们将神的约柜从冈上亚比拿达家里抬出来的时候，亚希约在柜前行走。

chapters.en: David and all Israel were celebrating with all their might before the LORD, with castanets, harps, lyres, timbrels, sistrums and cymbals.
chapters.zh: 大卫和以色列的全家在耶和华面前，用松木制造的各样乐器和琴，瑟，鼓，钹，锣，作乐跳舞。

chapters.en: When they came to the threshing floor of Nakon, Uzzah reached out and took hold of the ark of God, because the oxen stumbled.
chapters.zh: 到了拿艮的禾场，因为牛失前蹄（或作惊跳），乌撒就伸手扶住神的约柜。

chapters.en: The LORD’s anger burned against Uzzah because of his irreverent act; therefore God struck him down, and he died there beside the ark of God.
chapters.zh: 神耶和华向乌撒发怒，因这错误击杀他，他就死在神的约柜旁。

chapters.en: Then David was angry because the LORD’s wrath had broken out against Uzzah, and to this day that place is called Perez Uzzah.
chapters.zh: 大卫因耶和华击杀（原文作闯杀）乌撒，心里愁烦，就称那地方为毗列斯乌撒，直到今日。

chapters.en: David was afraid of the LORD that day and said, “How can the ark of the LORD ever come to me?”
chapters.zh: 那日，大卫惧怕耶和华，说，耶和华的约柜怎可运到我这里来。

chapters.en: He was not willing to take the ark of the LORD to be with him in the City of David. Instead, he took it to the house of Obed-Edom the Gittite.
chapters.zh: 于是大卫不肯将耶和华的约柜运进大卫的城，却运到迦特人俄别以东的家中。

chapters.en: The ark of the LORD remained in the house of Obed-Edom the Gittite for three months, and the LORD blessed him and his entire household.
chapters.zh: 耶和华的约柜在迦特人俄别以东家中三个月。耶和华赐福给俄别以东和他的全家。

chapters.en: Now King David was told, “The LORD has blessed the household of Obed-Edom and everything he has, because of the ark of God.” So David went to bring up the ark of God from the house of Obed-Edom to the City of David with rejoicing.
chapters.zh: 有人告诉大卫王说，耶和华因为约柜赐福给俄别以东的家和一切属他的。大卫就去，欢欢喜喜地将神的约柜从俄别以东家中抬到大卫的城里。

chapters.en: When those who were carrying the ark of the LORD had taken six steps, he sacrificed a bull and a fattened calf.
chapters.zh: 抬耶和华约柜的人走了六步，大卫就献牛与肥羊为祭。

chapters.en: Wearing a linen ephod, David was dancing before the LORD with all his might,
chapters.zh: 大卫穿着细麻布的以弗得，在耶和华面前极力跳舞。

chapters.en: while he and all Israel were bringing up the ark of the LORD with shouts and the sound of trumpets.
chapters.zh: 这样，大卫和以色列的全家欢呼吹角，将耶和华的约柜抬上来。

chapters.en: As the ark of the LORD was entering the City of David, Michal daughter of Saul watched from a window. And when she saw King David leaping and dancing before the LORD, she despised him in her heart.
chapters.zh: 耶和华的约柜进了大卫城的时候，扫罗的女儿米甲从窗户里观看，见大卫王在耶和华面前踊跃跳舞，心里就轻视他。

chapters.en: They brought the ark of the LORD and set it in its place inside the tent that David had pitched for it, and David sacrificed burnt offerings and fellowship offerings before the LORD.
chapters.zh: 众人将耶和华的约柜请进去，安放在所预备的地方，就是在大卫所搭的帐幕里。大卫在耶和华面前献燔祭和平安祭。

chapters.en: After he had finished sacrificing the burnt offerings and fellowship offerings, he blessed the people in the name of the LORD Almighty.
chapters.zh: 大卫献完了燔祭和平安祭，就奉万军之耶和华的名给民祝福，

chapters.en: Then he gave a loaf of bread, a cake of dates and a cake of raisins to each person in the whole crowd of Israelites, both men and women. And all the people went to their homes.
chapters.zh: 并且分给以色列众人，无论男女，每人一个饼，一块肉，一个葡萄饼。众人就各回各家去了。

chapters.en: When David returned home to bless his household, Michal daughter of Saul came out to meet him and said, “How the king of Israel has distinguished himself today, going around half-naked in full view of the slave girls of his servants as any vulgar fellow would!”
chapters.zh: 大卫回家要给眷属祝福。扫罗的女儿米甲出来迎接他，说，以色列王今日在臣仆的婢女眼前露体，如同一个轻贱人无耻露体一样，有好大的荣耀阿。

chapters.en: David said to Michal, “It was before the LORD, who chose me rather than your father or anyone from his house when he appointed me ruler over the LORD’s people Israel—I will celebrate before the LORD.
chapters.zh: 大卫对米甲说，这是在耶和华面前。耶和华已拣选我，废了你父和你父的全家，立我作耶和华民以色列的君，所以我必在耶和华面前跳舞。

chapters.en: I will become even more undignified than this, and I will be humiliated in my own eyes. But by these slave girls you spoke of, I will be held in honor.”
chapters.zh: 我也必更加卑微，自己看为轻贱。你所说的那些婢女，她们倒要尊敬我。

chapters.en: And Michal daughter of Saul had no children to the day of her death.
chapters.zh: 扫罗的女儿米甲，直到死日，没有生养儿女。

chapters.en: After the king was settled in his palace and the LORD had given him rest from all his enemies around him,
chapters.zh: 王住在自己宫中，耶和华使他安靖，不被四围的仇敌扰乱。

chapters.en: he said to Nathan the prophet, “Here I am, living in a house of cedar, while the ark of God remains in a tent.”
chapters.zh: 那时，王对先知拿单说，看哪，我住在香柏木的宫中，神的约柜反在幔子里。

chapters.en: Nathan replied to the king, “Whatever you have in mind, go ahead and do it, for the LORD is with you.”
chapters.zh: 拿单对王说，你可以照你的心意而行，因为耶和华与你同在。

chapters.en: But that night the word of the LORD came to Nathan, saying:
chapters.zh: 当夜，耶和华的话临到拿单说，

chapters.en: “Go and tell my servant David, ‘This is what the LORD says: Are you the one to build me a house to dwell in?
chapters.zh: 你去告诉我仆人大卫，说耶和华如此说，你岂可建造殿宇给我居住呢？

chapters.en: I have not dwelt in a house from the day I brought the Israelites up out of Egypt to this day. I have been moving from place to place with a tent as my dwelling.
chapters.zh: 自从我领以色列人出埃及直到今日，我未曾住过殿宇，常在会幕和帐幕中行走。

chapters.en: Wherever I have moved with all the Israelites, did I ever say to any of their rulers whom I commanded to shepherd my people Israel, “Why have you not built me a house of cedar?” ’
chapters.zh: 凡我同以色列人所走的地方，我何曾向以色列一支派的士师，就是我吩咐牧养我民以色列的说，你们为何不给我建造香柏木的殿宇呢？

chapters.en: “Now then, tell my servant David, ‘This is what the LORD Almighty says: I took you from the pasture, from tending the flock, and appointed you ruler over my people Israel.
chapters.zh: 现在，你要告诉我仆人大卫，说万军之耶和华如此说，我从羊圈中将你召来，叫你不再跟从羊群，立你作我民以色列的君。

chapters.en: I have been with you wherever you have gone, and I have cut off all your enemies from before you. Now I will make your name great, like the names of the greatest men on earth.
chapters.zh: 你无论往哪里去，我常与你同在，剪除你的一切仇敌。我必使你得大名，好像世上大大有名的人一样。

chapters.en: And I will provide a place for my people Israel and will plant them so that they can have a home of their own and no longer be disturbed. Wicked people will not oppress them anymore, as they did at the beginning
chapters.zh: 我必为我民以色列选定一个地方，栽培他们，使他们住自己的地方，不再迁移。凶恶之子也不像从前扰害他们，

chapters.en: and have done ever since the time I appointed leaders over my people Israel. I will also give you rest from all your enemies. “ ‘The LORD declares to you that the LORD himself will establish a house for you:
chapters.zh: 并不像我命士师治理我民以色列的时候一样。我必使你安靖，不被一切仇敌扰乱，并且我耶和华应许你，必为你建立家室。

chapters.en: When your days are over and you rest with your ancestors, I will raise up your offspring to succeed you, your own flesh and blood, and I will establish his kingdom.
chapters.zh: 你寿数满足，与你列祖同睡的时候，我必使你的后裔接续你的位。我也必坚定他的国。

chapters.en: He is the one who will build a house for my Name, and I will establish the throne of his kingdom forever.
chapters.zh: 他必为我的名建造殿宇。我必坚定他的国位，直到永远。

chapters.en: I will be his father, and he will be my son. When he does wrong, I will punish him with a rod wielded by men, with floggings inflicted by human hands.
chapters.zh: 我要作他的父，他要作我的子。他若犯了罪，我必用人的杖责打他，用人的鞭责罚他。

chapters.en: But my love will never be taken away from him, as I took it away from Saul, whom I removed from before you.
chapters.zh: 但我的慈爱仍不离开他，像离开在你面前所废弃的扫罗一样。

chapters.en: Your house and your kingdom will endure forever before me ; your throne will be established forever.’ ”
chapters.zh: 你的家和你的国必在我（原文作你）面前永远坚立。你的国位也必坚定，直到永远。

chapters.en: Nathan reported to David all the words of this entire revelation.
chapters.zh: 拿单就按这一切话，照这默示，告诉大卫。

chapters.en: Then King David went in and sat before the LORD, and he said: “Who am I, Sovereign LORD, and what is my family, that you have brought me this far?
chapters.zh: 于是大卫王进去，坐在耶和华面前，说，主耶和华阿，我是谁。我的家算什么。你竟使我到这地步呢？

chapters.en: And as if this were not enough in your sight, Sovereign LORD, you have also spoken about the future of the house of your servant—and this decree, Sovereign LORD, is for a mere human!
chapters.zh: 主耶和华阿，这在你眼中还看为小，又应许你仆人的家至于久远。主耶和华阿，这岂是人所常遇的事吗？

chapters.en: “What more can David say to you? For you know your servant, Sovereign LORD.
chapters.zh: 主耶和华阿，我还有何言可以对你说呢？因为你知道你的仆人。

chapters.en: For the sake of your word and according to your will, you have done this great thing and made it known to your servant.
chapters.zh: 你行这大事使仆人知道，是因你所应许的话，也是照你的心意。

chapters.en: “How great you are, Sovereign LORD! There is no one like you, and there is no God but you, as we have heard with our own ears.
chapters.zh: 主耶和华阿，你本为大，照我们耳中听见，没有可比你的。除你以外再无神。

chapters.en: And who is like your people Israel—the one nation on earth that God went out to redeem as a people for himself, and to make a name for himself, and to perform great and awesome wonders by driving out nations and their gods from before your people, whom you redeemed from Egypt?
chapters.zh: 世上有何民能比你的民以色列呢？你从埃及救赎他们作自己的子民，又在你赎出来的民面前行大而可畏的事，驱逐列邦人和他们的神，显出你的大名。

chapters.en: You have established your people Israel as your very own forever, and you, LORD, have become their God.
chapters.zh: 你曾坚立你的民以色列作你的子民，直到永远。你耶和华也作了他们的神。

chapters.en: “And now, LORD God, keep forever the promise you have made concerning your servant and his house. Do as you promised,
chapters.zh: 耶和华神阿，你所应许仆人和仆人家的话，求你坚定，直到永远。照你所说的而行。

chapters.en: so that your name will be great forever. Then people will say, ‘The LORD Almighty is God over Israel!’ And the house of your servant David will be established in your sight.
chapters.zh: 愿人永远尊你的名为大，说，万军之耶和华是治理以色列的神。这样，你仆人大卫的家必在你面前坚立。

chapters.en: “LORD Almighty, God of Israel, you have revealed this to your servant, saying, ‘I will build a house for you.’ So your servant has found courage to pray this prayer to you.
chapters.zh: 万军之耶和华以色列的神阿，因你启示你的仆人说，我必为你建立家室，所以仆人大胆向你如此祈祷。

chapters.en: Sovereign LORD, you are God! Your covenant is trustworthy, and you have promised these good things to your servant.
chapters.zh: 主耶和华阿，惟有你是神。你的话是真实的。你也应许将这福气赐给仆人。

chapters.en: Now be pleased to bless the house of your servant, that it may continue forever in your sight; for you, Sovereign LORD, have spoken, and with your blessing the house of your servant will be blessed forever.”
chapters.zh: 现在求你赐福与仆人的家，可以永存在你面前。主耶和华阿，这是你所应许的。愿你永远赐福与仆人的家。

chapters.en: In the course of time, David defeated the Philistines and subdued them, and he took Metheg Ammah from the control of the Philistines.
chapters.zh: 此后，大卫攻打非利士人，把他们治服，从他们手下夺取了京城的权柄（原文作母城的嚼环）。

chapters.en: David also defeated the Moabites. He made them lie down on the ground and measured them off with a length of cord. Every two lengths of them were put to death, and the third length was allowed to live. So the Moabites became subject to David and brought him tribute.
chapters.zh: 又攻打摩押人，使他们躺卧在地上，用绳量一量，量二绳的杀了，量一绳的存留。摩押人就归服大卫，给他进贡。

chapters.en: Moreover, David defeated Hadadezer son of Rehob, king of Zobah, when he went to restore his monument at the Euphrates River.
chapters.zh: 琐巴王利合的儿子哈大底谢往大河去，要夺回他的国权。大卫就攻打他，

chapters.en: David captured a thousand of his chariots, seven thousand charioteers and twenty thousand foot soldiers. He hamstrung all but a hundred of the chariot horses.
chapters.zh: 擒拿了他的马兵一千七百，步兵二万，将拉战车的马砍断蹄筋，但留下一百辆车的马。

chapters.en: When the Arameans of Damascus came to help Hadadezer king of Zobah, David struck down twenty-two thousand of them.
chapters.zh: 大马色的亚兰人来帮助琐巴王哈大底谢，大卫就杀了亚兰人二万二千。

chapters.en: He put garrisons in the Aramean kingdom of Damascus, and the Arameans became subject to him and brought tribute. The LORD gave David victory wherever he went.
chapters.zh: 于是大卫在大马色的亚兰地设立防营，亚兰人就归服他，给他进贡。大卫无论往哪里去，耶和华都使他得胜。

chapters.en: David took the gold shields that belonged to the officers of Hadadezer and brought them to Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 他夺了哈大底谢臣仆所拿的金盾牌，带到耶路撒冷。

chapters.en: From Tebah and Berothai, towns that belonged to Hadadezer, King David took a great quantity of bronze.
chapters.zh: 大卫王又从属哈大底谢的比他和比罗他城中夺取了许多的铜。

chapters.en: When Tou king of Hamath heard that David had defeated the entire army of Hadadezer,
chapters.zh: 哈马王陀以听见大卫杀败哈大底谢的全军，

chapters.en: he sent his son Joram to King David to greet him and congratulate him on his victory in battle over Hadadezer, who had been at war with Tou. Joram brought with him articles of silver, of gold and of bronze.
chapters.zh: 就打发他儿子约兰去见大卫王，问他的安，为他祝福，因为他杀败了哈大底谢，原来陀以与哈大底谢常常争战。约兰带了金银铜的器皿来，

chapters.en: King David dedicated these articles to the LORD, as he had done with the silver and gold from all the nations he had subdued:
chapters.zh: 大卫王将这些器皿和他治服各国所得来的金银都分别为圣，献给耶和华，

chapters.en: Edom and Moab, the Ammonites and the Philistines, and Amalek. He also dedicated the plunder taken from Hadadezer son of Rehob, king of Zobah.
chapters.zh: 就是从亚兰，摩押，亚扪，非利士，亚玛力人所得来的，以及从琐巴王利合的儿子哈大底谢所掠之物。

chapters.en: And David became famous after he returned from striking down eighteen thousand Edomites in the Valley of Salt.
chapters.zh: 大卫在盐谷击杀了亚兰（或作以东，见诗篇六十篇诗题）一万八千人回来，就得了大名。

chapters.en: He put garrisons throughout Edom, and all the Edomites became subject to David. The LORD gave David victory wherever he went.
chapters.zh: 又在以东全地设立防营，以东人就都归服大卫。大卫无论往哪里去，耶和华都使他得胜。

chapters.en: David reigned over all Israel, doing what was just and right for all his people.
chapters.zh: 大卫作以色列众人的王，又向众民秉公行义。

chapters.en: Joab son of Zeruiah was over the army; Jehoshaphat son of Ahilud was recorder;
chapters.zh: 洗鲁雅的儿子约押作元帅。亚希律的儿子约沙法作史官。

chapters.en: Zadok son of Ahitub and Ahimelek son of Abiathar were priests; Seraiah was secretary;
chapters.zh: 亚希突的儿子撒督和亚比亚他的儿子亚希米勒作祭司长。西莱雅作书记。

chapters.en: Benaiah son of Jehoiada was over the Kerethites and Pelethites; and David’s sons were priests.
chapters.zh: 耶何耶大的儿子比拿雅统辖基利提人和比利提人。大卫的众子都作领袖。

chapters.en: David asked, “Is there anyone still left of the house of Saul to whom I can show kindness for Jonathan’s sake?”
chapters.zh: 大卫问说，扫罗家还有剩下的人没有。我要因约拿单的缘故向他施恩。

chapters.en: Now there was a servant of Saul’s household named Ziba. They summoned him to appear before David, and the king said to him, “Are you Ziba?” “At your service,” he replied.
chapters.zh: 扫罗家有一个仆人，名叫洗巴，有人叫他来见大卫，王问他说，你是洗巴吗？回答说，仆人是。

chapters.en: The king asked, “Is there no one still alive from the house of Saul to whom I can show God’s kindness?” Ziba answered the king, “There is still a son of Jonathan; he is lame in both feet.”
chapters.zh: 王说，扫罗家还有人没有。我要照神的慈爱恩待他。洗巴对王说，还有约拿单的一个儿子，是瘸腿的。

chapters.en: “Where is he?” the king asked. Ziba answered, “He is at the house of Makir son of Ammiel in Lo Debar.”
chapters.zh: 王说，他在哪里。洗巴对王说，他在罗底巴，亚米利的儿子玛吉家里。

chapters.en: So King David had him brought from Lo Debar, from the house of Makir son of Ammiel.
chapters.zh: 于是大卫王打发人去，从罗底巴亚米利的儿子玛吉家里召了他来。

chapters.en: When Mephibosheth son of Jonathan, the son of Saul, came to David, he bowed down to pay him honor. David said, “Mephibosheth!” “At your service,” he replied.
chapters.zh: 扫罗的孙子，约拿单的儿子米非波设来见大卫，伏地叩拜。大卫说，米非波设。米非波设说，仆人在此。

chapters.en: “Don’t be afraid,” David said to him, “for I will surely show you kindness for the sake of your father Jonathan. I will restore to you all the land that belonged to your grandfather Saul, and you will always eat at my table.”
chapters.zh: 大卫说，你不要惧怕，我必因你父亲约拿单的缘故施恩与你，将你祖父扫罗的一切田地都归还你。你也可以常与我同席吃饭。

chapters.en: Mephibosheth bowed down and said, “What is your servant, that you should notice a dead dog like me?”
chapters.zh: 米非波设又叩拜，说，仆人算什么，不过如死狗一般，竟蒙王这样眷顾。

chapters.en: Then the king summoned Ziba, Saul’s steward, and said to him, “I have given your master’s grandson everything that belonged to Saul and his family.
chapters.zh: 王召了扫罗的仆人洗巴来，对他说，我已将属扫罗和他的一切家产都赐给你主人的儿子了。

chapters.en: You and your sons and your servants are to farm the land for him and bring in the crops, so that your master’s grandson may be provided for. And Mephibosheth, grandson of your master, will always eat at my table.” (Now Ziba had fifteen sons and twenty servants.)
chapters.zh: 你和你的众子，仆人要为你主人的儿子米非波设耕种田地，把所产的拿来供他食用。他却要常与我同席吃饭。洗巴有十五个儿子，二十个仆人。

chapters.en: Then Ziba said to the king, “Your servant will do whatever my lord the king commands his servant to do.” So Mephibosheth ate at David’s table like one of the king’s sons.
chapters.zh: 洗巴对王说，凡我主我王吩咐仆人的，仆人都必遵行。王又说，米非波设必与我同席吃饭，如王的儿子一样。

chapters.en: Mephibosheth had a young son named Mika, and all the members of Ziba’s household were servants of Mephibosheth.
chapters.zh: 米非波设有一个小儿子，名叫米迦。凡住在洗巴家里的人都作了米非波设的仆人。

chapters.en: And Mephibosheth lived in Jerusalem, because he always ate at the king’s table; he was lame in both feet.
chapters.zh: 于是米非波设住在耶路撒冷，常与王同席吃饭。他两腿都是瘸的。

chapters.en: In the course of time, the king of the Ammonites died, and his son Hanun succeeded him as king.
chapters.zh: 此后，亚扪人的王死了，他儿子哈嫩接续他作王。

chapters.en: David thought, “I will show kindness to Hanun son of Nahash, just as his father showed kindness to me.” So David sent a delegation to express his sympathy to Hanun concerning his father. When David’s men came to the land of the Ammonites,
chapters.zh: 大卫说，我要照哈嫩的父亲拿辖厚待我的恩典厚待哈嫩。于是大卫差遣臣仆，为他丧父安慰他。大卫的臣仆到了亚扪人的境内。

chapters.en: the Ammonite commanders said to Hanun their lord, “Do you think David is honoring your father by sending envoys to you to express sympathy? Hasn’t David sent them to you only to explore the city and spy it out and overthrow it?”
chapters.zh: 但亚扪人的首领对他们的主哈嫩说，大卫差人来安慰你，你想他是尊敬你父亲吗？他差臣仆来不是详察窥探，要倾覆这城吗？

chapters.en: So Hanun seized David’s envoys, shaved off half of each man’s beard, cut off their garments at the buttocks, and sent them away.
chapters.zh: 哈嫩便将大卫臣仆的胡须剃去一半，又割断他们下半截的衣服，使他们露出下体，打发他们回去。

chapters.en: When David was told about this, he sent messengers to meet the men, for they were greatly humiliated. The king said, “Stay at Jericho till your beards have grown, and then come back.”
chapters.zh: 有人告诉大卫，他就差人去迎接他们，因为他们甚觉羞耻，告诉他们说，可以住在耶利哥，等到胡须长起再回来。

chapters.en: When the Ammonites realized that they had become obnoxious to David, they hired twenty thousand Aramean foot soldiers from Beth Rehob and Zobah, as well as the king of Maakah with a thousand men, and also twelve thousand men from Tob.
chapters.zh: 亚扪人知道大卫憎恶他们，就打发人去，招募伯利合的亚兰人和琐巴的亚兰人，步兵二万，与玛迦王的人一千，陀伯人一万二千。

chapters.en: On hearing this, David sent Joab out with the entire army of fighting men.
chapters.zh: 大卫听见了，就差派约押统带勇猛的全军出去。

chapters.en: The Ammonites came out and drew up in battle formation at the entrance of their city gate, while the Arameans of Zobah and Rehob and the men of Tob and Maakah were by themselves in the open country.
chapters.zh: 亚扪人出来，在城门前摆阵。琐巴与利合的亚兰人，陀伯人，并玛迦人，另在郊野摆阵。

chapters.en: Joab saw that there were battle lines in front of him and behind him; so he selected some of the best troops in Israel and deployed them against the Arameans.
chapters.zh: 约押看见敌人在他前后摆阵，就从以色列军中挑选精兵，使他们对着亚兰人摆阵。

chapters.en: He put the rest of the men under the command of Abishai his brother and deployed them against the Ammonites.
chapters.zh: 其余的兵交与他兄弟亚比筛，对着亚扪人摆阵。

chapters.en: Joab said, “If the Arameans are too strong for me, then you are to come to my rescue; but if the Ammonites are too strong for you, then I will come to rescue you.
chapters.zh: 约押对亚比筛说，亚兰人若强过我，你就来帮助我。亚扪人若强过你，我就去帮助你。

chapters.en: Be strong, and let us fight bravely for our people and the cities of our God. The LORD will do what is good in his sight.”
chapters.zh: 我们都当刚强，为本国的民和神的城邑作大丈夫。愿耶和华凭他的意旨而行。

chapters.en: Then Joab and the troops with him advanced to fight the Arameans, and they fled before him.
chapters.zh: 于是，约押和跟随他的人前进攻打亚兰人。亚兰人在约押面前逃跑。

chapters.en: When the Ammonites realized that the Arameans were fleeing, they fled before Abishai and went inside the city. So Joab returned from fighting the Ammonites and came to Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 亚扪人见亚兰人逃跑，他们也在亚比筛面前逃跑进城。约押就离开亚扪人那里，回耶路撒冷去了。

chapters.en: After the Arameans saw that they had been routed by Israel, they regrouped.
chapters.zh: 亚兰人见自己被以色列人打败，就又聚集。

chapters.en: Hadadezer had Arameans brought from beyond the Euphrates River; they went to Helam, with Shobak the commander of Hadadezer’s army leading them.
chapters.zh: 哈大底谢差遣人，将大河那边的亚兰人调来。他们到了希兰，哈大底谢的将军朔法率领他们。

chapters.en: When David was told of this, he gathered all Israel, crossed the Jordan and went to Helam. The Arameans formed their battle lines to meet David and fought against him.
chapters.zh: 有人告诉大卫，他就聚集以色列众人，过约旦河，来到希兰。亚兰人迎着大卫摆阵，与他打仗。

chapters.en: But they fled before Israel, and David killed seven hundred of their charioteers and forty thousand of their foot soldiers. He also struck down Shobak the commander of their army, and he died there.
chapters.zh: 亚兰人在以色列人面前逃跑。大卫杀了亚兰七百辆战车的人，四万马兵，又杀了亚兰的将军朔法。

chapters.en: When all the kings who were vassals of Hadadezer saw that they had been routed by Israel, they made peace with the Israelites and became subject to them. So the Arameans were afraid to help the Ammonites anymore.
chapters.zh: 属哈大底谢的诸王见自己被以色列人打败，就与以色列人和好，归服他们。于是亚兰人不敢再帮助亚扪人了。

chapters.en: In the spring, at the time when kings go off to war, David sent Joab out with the king’s men and the whole Israelite army. They destroyed the Ammonites and besieged Rabbah. But David remained in Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 过了一年，到列王出战的时候，大卫又差派约押，率领臣仆和以色列众人出战。他们就打败亚扪人，围攻拉巴。大卫仍住在耶路撒冷。

chapters.en: One evening David got up from his bed and walked around on the roof of the palace. From the roof he saw a woman bathing. The woman was very beautiful,
chapters.zh: 一日，太阳平西，大卫从床上起来，在王宫的平顶上游行，看见一个妇人沐浴，容貌甚美，

chapters.en: and David sent someone to find out about her. The man said, “She is Bathsheba, the daughter of Eliam and the wife of Uriah the Hittite.”
chapters.zh: 大卫就差人打听那妇人是谁。有人说，她是以连的女儿，赫人乌利亚的妻拔示巴。

chapters.en: Then David sent messengers to get her. She came to him, and he slept with her. (Now she was purifying herself from her monthly uncleanness.) Then she went back home.
chapters.zh: 大卫差人去，将妇人接来。那时她的月经才得洁净。她来了，大卫与她同房，她就回家去了。

chapters.en: The woman conceived and sent word to David, saying, “I am pregnant.”
chapters.zh: 于是她怀了孕，打发人去告诉大卫说，我怀了孕。

chapters.en: So David sent this word to Joab: “Send me Uriah the Hittite.” And Joab sent him to David.
chapters.zh: 大卫差人到约押那里，说，你打发赫人乌利亚到我这里来。约押就打发乌利亚去见大卫。

chapters.en: When Uriah came to him, David asked him how Joab was, how the soldiers were and how the war was going.
chapters.zh: 乌利亚来了，大卫问约押好，也问兵好，又问争战的事怎样。

chapters.en: Then David said to Uriah, “Go down to your house and wash your feet.” So Uriah left the palace, and a gift from the king was sent after him.
chapters.zh: 大卫对乌利亚说，你回家去，洗洗脚吧。乌利亚出了王宫，随后王送他一分食物。

chapters.en: But Uriah slept at the entrance to the palace with all his master’s servants and did not go down to his house.
chapters.zh: 乌利亚却和他主人的仆人一同睡在宫门外，没有回家去。

chapters.en: David was told, “Uriah did not go home.” So he asked Uriah, “Haven’t you just come from a military campaign? Why didn’t you go home?”
chapters.zh: 有人告诉大卫说，乌利亚没有回家去。大卫就问乌利亚说，你从远路上来，为什么不回家去呢？

chapters.en: Uriah said to David, “The ark and Israel and Judah are staying in tents, and my commander Joab and my lord’s men are camped in the open country. How could I go to my house to eat and drink and make love to my wife? As surely as you live, I will not do such a thing!”
chapters.zh: 乌利亚对大卫说，约柜和以色列与犹大兵都住在棚里，我主约押和我主（或作王）的仆人都在田野安营，我岂可回家吃喝，与妻子同寝呢？我敢在王面前起誓（原文作我指着王和王的性命起誓），我决不行这事。

chapters.en: Then David said to him, “Stay here one more day, and tomorrow I will send you back.” So Uriah remained in Jerusalem that day and the next.
chapters.zh: 大卫吩咐乌利亚说，你今日仍住在这里，明日我打发你去。于是乌利亚那日和次日住在耶路撒冷。

chapters.en: At David’s invitation, he ate and drank with him, and David made him drunk. But in the evening Uriah went out to sleep on his mat among his master’s servants; he did not go home.
chapters.zh: 大卫召了乌利亚来，叫他在自己面前吃喝，使他喝醉。到了晚上，乌利亚出去与他主的仆人一同住宿，还没有回到家里去。

chapters.en: In the morning David wrote a letter to Joab and sent it with Uriah.
chapters.zh: 次日早晨，大卫写信与约押，交乌利亚随手带去。

chapters.en: In it he wrote, “Put Uriah out in front where the fighting is fiercest. Then withdraw from him so he will be struck down and die.”
chapters.zh: 信内写着说，要派乌利亚前进，到阵势极险之处，你们便退后，使他被杀。

chapters.en: So while Joab had the city under siege, he put Uriah at a place where he knew the strongest defenders were.
chapters.zh: 约押围城的时候，知道敌人那里有勇士，便将乌利亚派在那里。

chapters.en: When the men of the city came out and fought against Joab, some of the men in David’s army fell; moreover, Uriah the Hittite died.
chapters.zh: 城里的人出来和约押打仗。大卫的仆人中有几个被杀的，赫人乌利亚也死了。

chapters.en: Joab sent David a full account of the battle.
chapters.zh: 于是，约押差人去将争战的一切事告诉大卫，

chapters.en: He instructed the messenger: “When you have finished giving the king this account of the battle,
chapters.zh: 又嘱咐使者说，你把争战的一切事对王说完了，

chapters.en: the king’s anger may flare up, and he may ask you, ‘Why did you get so close to the city to fight? Didn’t you know they would shoot arrows from the wall?
chapters.zh: 王若发怒，问你说，你们打仗为什么挨近城墙呢？岂不知敌人必从城上射箭吗？

chapters.en: Who killed Abimelek son of Jerub-Besheth ? Didn’t a woman drop an upper millstone on him from the wall, so that he died in Thebez? Why did you get so close to the wall?’ If he asks you this, then say to him, ‘Moreover, your servant Uriah the Hittite is dead.’ ”
chapters.zh: 从前打死耶路比设（就是耶路巴力，见士师记九章一节）儿子亚比米勒的是谁呢？岂不是一个妇人从城上抛下一块上磨石来，打在他身上，他就死在提备斯吗？你们为什么挨近城墙呢？你就说，王的仆人，赫人乌利亚也死了。

chapters.en: The messenger set out, and when he arrived he told David everything Joab had sent him to say.
chapters.zh: 使者起身，来见大卫，照着约押所吩咐他的话奏告大卫。

chapters.en: The messenger said to David, “The men overpowered us and came out against us in the open, but we drove them back to the entrance of the city gate.
chapters.zh: 使者对大卫说，敌人强过我们，出到郊野与我们打仗，我们追杀他们，直到城门口。

chapters.en: Then the archers shot arrows at your servants from the wall, and some of the king’s men died. Moreover, your servant Uriah the Hittite is dead.”
chapters.zh: 射箭的从城上射王的仆人，射死几个，赫人乌利亚也死了。

chapters.en: David told the messenger, “Say this to Joab: ‘Don’t let this upset you; the sword devours one as well as another. Press the attack against the city and destroy it.’ Say this to encourage Joab.”
chapters.zh: 王向使者说，你告诉约押说，不要因这事愁闷，刀剑或吞灭这人或吞灭那人，没有一定的。你只管竭力攻城，将城倾覆。可以用这话勉励约押。

chapters.en: When Uriah’s wife heard that her husband was dead, she mourned for him.
chapters.zh: 乌利亚的妻听见丈夫乌利亚死了，就为他哀哭。

chapters.en: After the time of mourning was over, David had her brought to his house, and she became his wife and bore him a son. But the thing David had done displeased the LORD.
chapters.zh: 哀哭的日子过了，大卫差人将她接到宫里，她就作了大卫的妻，给大卫生了一个儿子。但大卫所行的这事，耶和华甚不喜悦。

chapters.en: The LORD sent Nathan to David. When he came to him, he said, “There were two men in a certain town, one rich and the other poor.
chapters.zh: 耶和华差遣拿单去见大卫。拿单到了大卫那里，对他说，在一座城里有两个人，一个是富户，一个是穷人。

chapters.en: The rich man had a very large number of sheep and cattle,
chapters.zh: 富户有许多牛群羊群。

chapters.en: but the poor man had nothing except one little ewe lamb he had bought. He raised it, and it grew up with him and his children. It shared his food, drank from his cup and even slept in his arms. It was like a daughter to him.
chapters.zh: 穷人除了所买来养活的一只小母羊羔之外，别无所有。羊羔在他家里和他儿女一同长大，吃他所吃的，喝他所喝的，睡在他怀中，在他看来如同女儿一样。

chapters.en: “Now a traveler came to the rich man, but the rich man refrained from taking one of his own sheep or cattle to prepare a meal for the traveler who had come to him. Instead, he took the ewe lamb that belonged to the poor man and prepared it for the one who had come to him.”
chapters.zh: 有一客人来到这富户家里。富户舍不得从自己的牛群羊群中取一只预备给客人吃，却取了那穷人的羊羔，预备给客人吃。

chapters.en: David burned with anger against the man and said to Nathan, “As surely as the LORD lives, the man who did this must die!
chapters.zh: 大卫就甚恼怒那人，对拿单说，我指着永生的耶和华起誓，行这事的人该死。

chapters.en: He must pay for that lamb four times over, because he did such a thing and had no pity.”
chapters.zh: 他必偿还羊羔四倍。因为他行这事，没有怜恤的心。

chapters.en: Then Nathan said to David, “You are the man! This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: ‘I anointed you king over Israel, and I delivered you from the hand of Saul.
chapters.zh: 拿单对大卫说，你就是那人。耶和华以色列的神如此说，我膏你作以色列的王，救你脱离扫罗的手。

chapters.en: I gave your master’s house to you, and your master’s wives into your arms. I gave you all Israel and Judah. And if all this had been too little, I would have given you even more.
chapters.zh: 我将你主人的家业赐给你，将你主人的妻交在你怀里，又将以色列和犹大家赐给你。你若还以为不足，我早就加倍地赐给你。

chapters.en: Why did you despise the word of the LORD by doing what is evil in his eyes? You struck down Uriah the Hittite with the sword and took his wife to be your own. You killed him with the sword of the Ammonites.
chapters.zh: 你为什么藐视耶和华的命令，行他眼中看为恶的事呢？你借亚扪人的刀杀害赫人乌利亚，又娶了他的妻为妻。

chapters.en: Now, therefore, the sword will never depart from your house, because you despised me and took the wife of Uriah the Hittite to be your own.’
chapters.zh: 你既藐视我，娶了赫人乌利亚的妻为妻，所以刀剑必永不离开你的家。

chapters.en: “This is what the LORD says: ‘Out of your own household I am going to bring calamity on you. Before your very eyes I will take your wives and give them to one who is close to you, and he will sleep with your wives in broad daylight.
chapters.zh: 耶和华如此说，我必从你家中兴起祸患攻击你。我必在你眼前把你的妃嫔赐给别人，他在日光之下就与她们同寝。

chapters.en: You did it in secret, but I will do this thing in broad daylight before all Israel.’ ”
chapters.zh: 你在暗中行这事，我却要在以色列众人面前，日光之下，报应你。

chapters.en: Then David said to Nathan, “I have sinned against the LORD.” Nathan replied, “The LORD has taken away your sin. You are not going to die.
chapters.zh: 大卫对拿单说，我得罪耶和华了。拿单说，耶和华已经除掉你的罪，你必不至于死。

chapters.en: But because by doing this you have shown utter contempt for the LORD, the son born to you will die.”
chapters.zh: 只是你行这事，叫耶和华的仇敌大得亵渎的机会，故此，你所得的孩子必定要死。

chapters.en: After Nathan had gone home, the LORD struck the child that Uriah’s wife had borne to David, and he became ill.
chapters.zh: 拿单就回家去了。耶和华击打乌利亚妻给大卫所生的孩子，使他得重病。

chapters.en: David pleaded with God for the child. He fasted and spent the nights lying in sackcloth on the ground.
chapters.zh: 所以大卫为这孩子恳求神，而且禁食，进入内室，终夜躺在地上。

chapters.en: The elders of his household stood beside him to get him up from the ground, but he refused, and he would not eat any food with them.
chapters.zh: 他家中的老臣来到他旁边，要把他从地上扶起来，他却不肯起来，也不同他们吃饭。

chapters.en: On the seventh day the child died. David’s attendants were afraid to tell him that the child was dead, for they thought, “While the child was still living, he wouldn’t listen to us when we spoke to him. How can we now tell him the child is dead? He may do something desperate.”
chapters.zh: 到第七日，孩子死了。大卫的臣仆不敢告诉他孩子死了，因他们说，孩子还活着的时候，我们劝他，他尚且不肯听我们的话，若告诉他孩子死了，岂不更加忧伤吗？

chapters.en: David noticed that his attendants were whispering among themselves, and he realized the child was dead. “Is the child dead?” he asked. “Yes,” they replied, “he is dead.”
chapters.zh: 大卫见臣仆彼此低声说话，就知道孩子死了，问臣仆说，孩子死了吗？他们说，死了。

chapters.en: Then David got up from the ground. After he had washed, put on lotions and changed his clothes, he went into the house of the LORD and worshiped. Then he went to his own house, and at his request they served him food, and he ate.
chapters.zh: 大卫就从地上起来，沐浴，抹膏，换了衣裳，进耶和华的殿敬拜。然后回宫，吩咐人摆饭，他便吃了。

chapters.en: His attendants asked him, “Why are you acting this way? While the child was alive, you fasted and wept, but now that the child is dead, you get up and eat!”
chapters.zh: 臣仆问他说，你所行的是什么意思。孩子活着的时候，你禁食哭泣。孩子死了，你倒起来吃饭。

chapters.en: He answered, “While the child was still alive, I fasted and wept. I thought, ‘Who knows? The LORD may be gracious to me and let the child live.’
chapters.zh: 大卫说，孩子还活着，我禁食哭泣。因为我想，或者耶和华怜恤我，使孩子不死也未可知。

chapters.en: But now that he is dead, why should I go on fasting? Can I bring him back again? I will go to him, but he will not return to me.”
chapters.zh: 孩子死了，我何必禁食，我岂能使他返回呢？我必往他那里去，他却不能回我这里来。

chapters.en: Then David comforted his wife Bathsheba, and he went to her and made love to her. She gave birth to a son, and they named him Solomon. The LORD loved him;
chapters.zh: 大卫安慰他的妻拔示巴，与她同寝，她就生了儿子，给他起名叫所罗门。耶和华也喜爱他，

chapters.en: and because the LORD loved him, he sent word through Nathan the prophet to name him Jedidiah.
chapters.zh: 就借先知拿单赐他一个名字，叫耶底底亚，因为耶和华爱他。

chapters.en: Meanwhile Joab fought against Rabbah of the Ammonites and captured the royal citadel.
chapters.zh: 约押攻取亚扪人的京城拉巴。

chapters.en: Joab then sent messengers to David, saying, “I have fought against Rabbah and taken its water supply.
chapters.zh: 约押打发使者去见大卫，说，我攻打拉巴，取其水城。

chapters.en: Now muster the rest of the troops and besiege the city and capture it. Otherwise I will take the city, and it will be named after me.”
chapters.zh: 现在你要聚集其余的军兵来，安营围攻这城，恐怕我取了这城，人就以我的名叫这城。

chapters.en: So David mustered the entire army and went to Rabbah, and attacked and captured it.
chapters.zh: 于是大卫聚集众军，往拉巴去攻城，就取了这城，

chapters.en: David took the crown from their king’s head, and it was placed on his own head. It weighed a talent of gold, and it was set with precious stones. David took a great quantity of plunder from the city
chapters.zh: 夺了亚扪人之王所戴的金冠冕（王或作玛勒堪。玛勒堪即米勒公，又名摩洛，亚扪族之神名），其上的金子重一他连得，又嵌着宝石。人将这冠冕戴在大卫头上。大卫从城里夺了许多财物，

chapters.en: and brought out the people who were there, consigning them to labor with saws and with iron picks and axes, and he made them work at brickmaking. David did this to all the Ammonite towns. Then he and his entire army returned to Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 将城里的人拉出来，放在锯下，或铁耙下，或铁斧下，或叫他经过砖窑（或作强他们用锯，或用打粮食的铁器，或用铁斧作工，或使在砖窑里服役）。大卫待亚扪各城的居民都是如此。其后，大卫和众军都回耶路撒冷去了。

chapters.en: In the course of time, Amnon son of David fell in love with Tamar, the beautiful sister of Absalom son of David.
chapters.zh: 大卫的儿子押沙龙有一个美貌的妹子，名叫他玛。大卫的儿子暗嫩爱她。

chapters.en: Amnon became so obsessed with his sister Tamar that he made himself ill. She was a virgin, and it seemed impossible for him to do anything to her.
chapters.zh: 暗嫩为他妹子他玛忧急成病。他玛还是处女，暗嫩以为难向她行事。

chapters.en: Now Amnon had an adviser named Jonadab son of Shimeah, David’s brother. Jonadab was a very shrewd man.
chapters.zh: 暗嫩有一个朋友，名叫约拿达，是大卫长兄示米亚的儿子。这约拿达为人极其狡猾。

chapters.en: He asked Amnon, “Why do you, the king’s son, look so haggard morning after morning? Won’t you tell me?” Amnon said to him, “I’m in love with Tamar, my brother Absalom’s sister.”
chapters.zh: 他问暗嫩说，王的儿子阿，为何一天比一天瘦弱呢？请你告诉我。暗嫩回答说，我爱我兄弟押沙龙的妹子他玛。

chapters.en: “Go to bed and pretend to be ill,” Jonadab said. “When your father comes to see you, say to him, ‘I would like my sister Tamar to come and give me something to eat. Let her prepare the food in my sight so I may watch her and then eat it from her hand.’ ”
chapters.zh: 约拿达说，你不如躺在床上装病。你父亲来看你，就对他说，求父叫我妹子他玛来，在我眼前预备食物，递给我吃，使我看见，好从她手里接过来吃。

chapters.en: So Amnon lay down and pretended to be ill. When the king came to see him, Amnon said to him, “I would like my sister Tamar to come and make some special bread in my sight, so I may eat from her hand.”
chapters.zh: 于是暗嫩躺卧装病。王来看他，他对王说，求父叫我妹子他玛来，在我眼前为我作两个饼，我好从她手里接过来吃。

chapters.en: David sent word to Tamar at the palace: “Go to the house of your brother Amnon and prepare some food for him.”
chapters.zh: 大卫就打发人到宫里，对他玛说，你往你哥哥暗嫩的屋里去，为他预备食物。

chapters.en: So Tamar went to the house of her brother Amnon, who was lying down. She took some dough, kneaded it, made the bread in his sight and baked it.
chapters.zh: 他玛就到她哥哥暗嫩的屋里。暗嫩正躺卧。他玛抟面，在他眼前作饼，且烤熟了，

chapters.en: Then she took the pan and served him the bread, but he refused to eat. “Send everyone out of here,” Amnon said. So everyone left him.
chapters.zh: 在他面前将饼从锅里倒出来，他却不肯吃，便说，众人离开我出去吧。众人就都离开他，出去了。

chapters.en: Then Amnon said to Tamar, “Bring the food here into my bedroom so I may eat from your hand.” And Tamar took the bread she had prepared and brought it to her brother Amnon in his bedroom.
chapters.zh: 暗嫩对他玛说，你把食物拿进卧房，我好从你手里接过来吃。他玛就把所作的饼拿进卧房，到她哥哥暗嫩那里，

chapters.en: But when she took it to him to eat, he grabbed her and said, “Come to bed with me, my sister.”
chapters.zh: 拿着饼上前给他吃，他便拉住他玛，说，我妹妹，你来与我同寝。

chapters.en: “No, my brother!” she said to him. “Don’t force me! Such a thing should not be done in Israel! Don’t do this wicked thing.
chapters.zh: 他玛说，我哥哥，不要玷辱我。以色列人中不当这样行，你不要作这丑事。

chapters.en: What about me? Where could I get rid of my disgrace? And what about you? You would be like one of the wicked fools in Israel. Please speak to the king; he will not keep me from being married to you.”
chapters.zh: 你玷辱了我，我何以掩盖我的羞耻呢？你在以色列中也成了愚妄人。你可以求王，他必不禁止我归你。

chapters.en: But he refused to listen to her, and since he was stronger than she, he raped her.
chapters.zh: 但暗嫩不肯听她的话，因比她力大，就玷辱她，与她同寝。

chapters.en: Then Amnon hated her with intense hatred. In fact, he hated her more than he had loved her. Amnon said to her, “Get up and get out!”
chapters.zh: 随后，暗嫩极其恨她，那恨她的心比先前爱她的心更甚，对她说，你起来，去吧。

chapters.en: “No!” she said to him. “Sending me away would be a greater wrong than what you have already done to me.” But he refused to listen to her.
chapters.zh: 他玛说，不要这样。你赶出我去的这罪比你才行的更重。但暗嫩不肯听她的话，

chapters.en: He called his personal servant and said, “Get this woman out of my sight and bolt the door after her.”
chapters.zh: 就叫伺候自己的仆人来，说，将这个女子赶出去。她一出去，你就关门，上闩。

chapters.en: So his servant put her out and bolted the door after her. She was wearing an ornate robe, for this was the kind of garment the virgin daughters of the king wore.
chapters.zh: 那时他玛穿着彩衣，因为没有出嫁的公主都是这样穿。暗嫩的仆人就把她赶出去，关门上闩。

chapters.en: Tamar put ashes on her head and tore the ornate robe she was wearing. She put her hands on her head and went away, weeping aloud as she went.
chapters.zh: 他玛把灰尘撒在头上，撕裂所穿的彩衣，以手抱头，一面行走，一面哭喊。

chapters.en: Her brother Absalom said to her, “Has that Amnon, your brother, been with you? Be quiet for now, my sister; he is your brother. Don’t take this thing to heart.” And Tamar lived in her brother Absalom’s house, a desolate woman.
chapters.zh: 她胞兄押沙龙问她说，莫非你哥哥暗嫩与你亲近了吗？我妹妹，暂且不要作声，他是你的哥哥，不要将这事放在心上。他玛就孤孤单单地住在她胞兄押沙龙家里。

chapters.en: When King David heard all this, he was furious.
chapters.zh: 大卫王听见这事，就甚发怒。

chapters.en: And Absalom never said a word to Amnon, either good or bad; he hated Amnon because he had disgraced his sister Tamar.
chapters.zh: 押沙龙并不和他哥哥暗嫩说好说歹。因为暗嫩玷辱他妹妹他玛，所以押沙龙恨恶他。

chapters.en: Two years later, when Absalom’s sheepshearers were at Baal Hazor near the border of Ephraim, he invited all the king’s sons to come there.
chapters.zh: 过了二年，在靠近以法莲的巴力夏琐有人为押沙龙剪羊毛。押沙龙请王的众子与他同去。

chapters.en: Absalom went to the king and said, “Your servant has had shearers come. Will the king and his attendants please join me?”
chapters.zh: 押沙龙来见王，说，现在有人为仆人剪羊毛，请王和王的臣仆与仆人同去。

chapters.en: “No, my son,” the king replied. “All of us should not go; we would only be a burden to you.” Although Absalom urged him, he still refused to go but gave him his blessing.
chapters.zh: 王对押沙龙说，我儿，我们不必都去，恐怕使你耗费太多。押沙龙再三请王，王仍是不肯去，只为他祝福。

chapters.en: Then Absalom said, “If not, please let my brother Amnon come with us.” The king asked him, “Why should he go with you?”
chapters.zh: 押沙龙说，王若不去，求王许我哥哥暗嫩同去。王说，何必要他去呢？

chapters.en: But Absalom urged him, so he sent with him Amnon and the rest of the king’s sons.
chapters.zh: 押沙龙再三求王，王就许暗嫩和王的众子与他同去。

chapters.en: Absalom ordered his men, “Listen! When Amnon is in high spirits from drinking wine and I say to you, ‘Strike Amnon down,’ then kill him. Don’t be afraid. Haven’t I given you this order? Be strong and brave.”
chapters.zh: 押沙龙吩咐仆人说，你们注意，看暗嫩饮酒畅快的时候，我对你们说杀暗嫩，你们便杀他，不要惧怕。这不是我吩咐你们的吗？你们只管壮胆奋勇。

chapters.en: So Absalom’s men did to Amnon what Absalom had ordered. Then all the king’s sons got up, mounted their mules and fled.
chapters.zh: 押沙龙的仆人就照押沙龙所吩咐的，向暗嫩行了。王的众子都起来，各人骑上骡子，逃跑了。

chapters.en: While they were on their way, the report came to David: “Absalom has struck down all the king’s sons; not one of them is left.”
chapters.zh: 他们还在路上，有风声传到大卫那里，说，押沙龙将王的众子都杀了，没有留下一个。

chapters.en: The king stood up, tore his clothes and lay down on the ground; and all his attendants stood by with their clothes torn.
chapters.zh: 王就起来，撕裂衣服，躺在地上。王的臣仆也都撕裂衣服，站在旁边。

chapters.en: But Jonadab son of Shimeah, David’s brother, said, “My lord should not think that they killed all the princes; only Amnon is dead. This has been Absalom’s express intention ever since the day Amnon raped his sister Tamar.
chapters.zh: 大卫的长兄，示米亚的儿子约拿达说，我主，不要以为王的众子少年人都杀了，只有暗嫩一个人死了。自从暗嫩玷辱押沙龙妹子他玛的那日，押沙龙就定意杀暗嫩了。

chapters.en: My lord the king should not be concerned about the report that all the king’s sons are dead. Only Amnon is dead.”
chapters.zh: 现在，我主我王，不要把这事放在心上，以为王的众子都死了，只有暗嫩一个人死了。

chapters.en: Meanwhile, Absalom had fled. Now the man standing watch looked up and saw many people on the road west of him, coming down the side of the hill. The watchman went and told the king, “I see men in the direction of Horonaim, on the side of the hill.”
chapters.zh: 押沙龙逃跑了。守望的少年人举目观看，见有许多人从山坡的路上来。

chapters.en: Jonadab said to the king, “See, the king’s sons have come; it has happened just as your servant said.”
chapters.zh: 约拿达对王说，看哪，王的众子都来了，果然与你仆人所说的相合。

chapters.en: As he finished speaking, the king’s sons came in, wailing loudly. The king, too, and all his attendants wept very bitterly.
chapters.zh: 话才说完，王的众子都到了，放声大哭，王和臣仆也都哭得甚恸。

chapters.en: Absalom fled and went to Talmai son of Ammihud, the king of Geshur. But King David mourned many days for his son.
chapters.zh: 押沙龙逃到基述王亚米忽的儿子达买那里去了。大卫天天为他儿子悲哀。

chapters.en: After Absalom fled and went to Geshur, he stayed there three years.
chapters.zh: 押沙龙逃到基述，在那里住了三年。

chapters.en: And King David longed to go to Absalom, for he was consoled concerning Amnon’s death.
chapters.zh: 暗嫩死了以后，大卫王得了安慰，心里切切想念押沙龙。

chapters.en: Joab son of Zeruiah knew that the king’s heart longed for Absalom.
chapters.zh: 洗鲁雅的儿子约押，知道王心里想念押沙龙，

chapters.en: So Joab sent someone to Tekoa and had a wise woman brought from there. He said to her, “Pretend you are in mourning. Dress in mourning clothes, and don’t use any cosmetic lotions. Act like a woman who has spent many days grieving for the dead.
chapters.zh: 就打发人往提哥亚去，从那里叫了一个聪明的妇人来，对她说，请你假装居丧的，穿上孝衣，不要用膏抹身，要装作为死者许久悲哀的妇人。

chapters.en: Then go to the king and speak these words to him.” And Joab put the words in her mouth.
chapters.zh: 进去见王，对王如此如此说。于是约押将当说的话教导了妇人。

chapters.en: When the woman from Tekoa went to the king, she fell with her face to the ground to pay him honor, and she said, “Help me, Your Majesty!”
chapters.zh: 提哥亚妇人到王面前，伏地叩拜，说，王阿，求你拯救。

chapters.en: The king asked her, “What is troubling you?” She said, “I am a widow; my husband is dead.
chapters.zh: 王问她说，你有什么事呢？回答说，婢女实在是寡妇，我丈夫死了。

chapters.en: I your servant had two sons. They got into a fight with each other in the field, and no one was there to separate them. One struck the other and killed him.
chapters.zh: 我有两个儿子，一日在田间争斗，没有人解劝，这个就打死那个。
