chapters.en: Then King David said, “Call in Bathsheba.” So she came into the king’s presence and stood before him.
chapters.zh: 大卫王吩咐说，叫拔示巴来。拔示巴就进来，站在王面前。

chapters.en: The king then took an oath: “As surely as the LORD lives, who has delivered me out of every trouble,
chapters.zh: 王起誓说，我指着救我性命脱离一切苦难，永生的耶和华起誓。

chapters.en: I will surely carry out this very day what I swore to you by the LORD, the God of Israel: Solomon your son shall be king after me, and he will sit on my throne in my place.”
chapters.zh: 我既然指着耶和华以色列的神向你起誓说，你儿子所罗门必接续我作王，坐在我的位上。我今日就必照这话而行。

chapters.en: Then Bathsheba bowed down with her face to the ground, prostrating herself before the king, and said, “May my lord King David live forever!”
chapters.zh: 于是，拔示巴脸伏于地，向王下拜，说，愿我主大卫王万岁。

chapters.en: King David said, “Call in Zadok the priest, Nathan the prophet and Benaiah son of Jehoiada.” When they came before the king,
chapters.zh: 大卫王又吩咐说，将祭司撒督，先知拿单，耶何耶大的儿子比拿雅召来。他们就都来到王面前。

chapters.en: he said to them: “Take your lord’s servants with you and have Solomon my son mount my own mule and take him down to Gihon.
chapters.zh: 王对他们说，要带领你们主的仆人，使我儿子所罗门骑我的骡子，送他下到基训。

chapters.en: There have Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet anoint him king over Israel. Blow the trumpet and shout, ‘Long live King Solomon!’
chapters.zh: 在那里，祭司撒督和先知拿单要膏他作以色列的王。你们也要吹角，说，愿所罗门王万岁。

chapters.en: Then you are to go up with him, and he is to come and sit on my throne and reign in my place. I have appointed him ruler over Israel and Judah.”
chapters.zh: 然后要跟随他上来，使他坐在我的位上，接续我作王。我已立他作以色列和犹大的君。

chapters.en: Benaiah son of Jehoiada answered the king, “Amen! May the LORD, the God of my lord the king, so declare it.
chapters.zh: 耶何耶大的儿子比拿雅对王说，阿们。愿耶和华我主我王的神也这样命定。

chapters.en: As the LORD was with my lord the king, so may he be with Solomon to make his throne even greater than the throne of my lord King David!”
chapters.zh: 耶和华怎样与我主我王同在，愿他照样与所罗门同在，使他的国位比我主大卫王的国位更大。

chapters.en: So Zadok the priest, Nathan the prophet, Benaiah son of Jehoiada, the Kerethites and the Pelethites went down and had Solomon mount King David’s mule, and they escorted him to Gihon.
chapters.zh: 于是，祭司撒督，先知拿单，耶何耶大的儿子比拿雅，和基利提人，比利提人都下去使所罗门骑大卫王的骡子，将他送到基训。

chapters.en: Zadok the priest took the horn of oil from the sacred tent and anointed Solomon. Then they sounded the trumpet and all the people shouted, “Long live King Solomon!”
chapters.zh: 祭司撒督就从帐幕中取了盛膏油的角来，用膏膏所罗门。人就吹角，众民都说，愿所罗门王万岁。

chapters.en: And all the people went up after him, playing pipes and rejoicing greatly, so that the ground shook with the sound.
chapters.zh: 众民跟随他上来，且吹笛，大大欢呼，声音震地。

chapters.en: Adonijah and all the guests who were with him heard it as they were finishing their feast. On hearing the sound of the trumpet, Joab asked, “What’s the meaning of all the noise in the city?”
chapters.zh: 亚多尼雅和所请的众客筵宴方毕，听见这声音。约押听见角声就说，城中为何有这响声呢？

chapters.en: Even as he was speaking, Jonathan son of Abiathar the priest arrived. Adonijah said, “Come in. A worthy man like you must be bringing good news.”
chapters.zh: 他正说话的时候，祭司亚比亚他的儿子约拿单来了。亚多尼雅对他说，进来吧。你是个忠义的人，必是报好信息。

chapters.en: “Not at all!” Jonathan answered. “Our lord King David has made Solomon king.
chapters.zh: 约拿单对亚多尼雅说，我们的主大卫王诚然立所罗门为王了。

chapters.en: The king has sent with him Zadok the priest, Nathan the prophet, Benaiah son of Jehoiada, the Kerethites and the Pelethites, and they have put him on the king’s mule,
chapters.zh: 王差遣祭司撒督，先知拿单，耶何耶大的儿子比拿雅，和基利提人，比利提人都去使所罗门骑王的骡子。

chapters.en: and Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet have anointed him king at Gihon. From there they have gone up cheering, and the city resounds with it. That’s the noise you hear.
chapters.zh: 祭司撒督和先知拿单在基训已经膏他作王。众人都从那里欢呼着上来，声音使城震动，这就是你们所听见的声音。

chapters.en: Moreover, Solomon has taken his seat on the royal throne.
chapters.zh: 并且所罗门登了国位。

chapters.en: Also, the royal officials have come to congratulate our lord King David, saying, ‘May your God make Solomon’s name more famous than yours and his throne greater than yours!’ And the king bowed in worship on his bed
chapters.zh: 王的臣仆也来为我们的主大卫王祝福，说，愿王的神使所罗门的名比王的名更尊荣。使他的国位比王的国位更大。王就在床上屈身下拜。

chapters.en: and said, ‘Praise be to the LORD, the God of Israel, who has allowed my eyes to see a successor on my throne today.’ ”
chapters.zh: 王又说，耶和华以色列的神是应当称颂的。因他赐我一人今日坐在我的位上，我也亲眼看见了。

chapters.en: At this, all Adonijah’s guests rose in alarm and dispersed.
chapters.zh: 亚多尼雅的众客听见这话就都惊惧，起来四散。

chapters.en: But Adonijah, in fear of Solomon, went and took hold of the horns of the altar.
chapters.zh: 亚多尼雅惧怕所罗门，就起来，去抓住祭坛的角。

chapters.en: Then Solomon was told, “Adonijah is afraid of King Solomon and is clinging to the horns of the altar. He says, ‘Let King Solomon swear to me today that he will not put his servant to death with the sword.’ ”
chapters.zh: 有人告诉所罗门说，亚多尼雅惧怕所罗门王，现在抓住祭坛的角，说，愿所罗门王今日向我起誓，必不用刀杀仆人。

chapters.en: Solomon replied, “If he shows himself to be worthy, not a hair of his head will fall to the ground; but if evil is found in him, he will die.”
chapters.zh: 所罗门说，他若作忠义的人，连一根头发也不至落在地上。他若行恶，必要死亡。

chapters.en: Then King Solomon sent men, and they brought him down from the altar. And Adonijah came and bowed down to King Solomon, and Solomon said, “Go to your home.”
chapters.zh: 于是所罗门王差遣人，使亚多尼雅从坛上下来，他就来，向所罗门王下拜。所罗门对他说，你回家去吧。

chapters.en: When the time drew near for David to die, he gave a charge to Solomon his son.
chapters.zh: 大卫的死期临近了，就嘱咐他儿子所罗门说，

chapters.en: “I am about to go the way of all the earth,” he said. “So be strong, act like a man,
chapters.zh: 我现在要走世人必走的路。所以，你当刚强，作大丈夫，

chapters.en: and observe what the LORD your God requires: Walk in obedience to him, and keep his decrees and commands, his laws and regulations, as written in the Law of Moses. Do this so that you may prosper in all you do and wherever you go
chapters.zh: 遵守耶和华你神所吩咐的，照着摩西律法上所写的行主的道，谨守他的律例，诫命，典章，法度。这样，你无论作什么事，不拘往何处去，尽都亨通。

chapters.en: and that the LORD may keep his promise to me: ‘If your descendants watch how they live, and if they walk faithfully before me with all their heart and soul, you will never fail to have a successor on the throne of Israel.’
chapters.zh: 耶和华必成就向我所应许的话说，你的子孙若谨慎自己的行为，尽心尽意诚诚实实地行在我面前，就不断人坐以色列的国位。

chapters.en: “Now you yourself know what Joab son of Zeruiah did to me—what he did to the two commanders of Israel’s armies, Abner son of Ner and Amasa son of Jether. He killed them, shedding their blood in peacetime as if in battle, and with that blood he stained the belt around his waist and the sandals on his feet.
chapters.zh: 你知道洗鲁雅的儿子约押向我所行的，就是杀了以色列的两个元帅，尼珥的儿子押尼珥和益帖的儿子亚玛撒。他在太平之时流这二人的血，如在争战之时一样，将这血染了腰间束的带和脚上穿的鞋。

chapters.en: Deal with him according to your wisdom, but do not let his gray head go down to the grave in peace.
chapters.zh: 所以你要照你的智慧行，不容他白头安然下阴间。

chapters.en: “But show kindness to the sons of Barzillai of Gilead and let them be among those who eat at your table. They stood by me when I fled from your brother Absalom.
chapters.zh: 你当恩待基列人巴西莱的众子，使他们常与你同席吃饭。因为我躲避你哥哥押沙龙的时候，他们拿食物来迎接我。

chapters.en: “And remember, you have with you Shimei son of Gera, the Benjamite from Bahurim, who called down bitter curses on me the day I went to Mahanaim. When he came down to meet me at the Jordan, I swore to him by the LORD: ‘I will not put you to death by the sword.’
chapters.zh: 在你这里有巴户琳的便雅悯人，基拉的儿子示每。我往玛哈念去的那日，他用狠毒的言语咒骂我，后来却下约旦河迎接我，我就指着耶和华向他起誓说，我必不用刀杀你。

chapters.en: But now, do not consider him innocent. You are a man of wisdom; you will know what to do to him. Bring his gray head down to the grave in blood.”
chapters.zh: 现在你不要以他为无罪。你是聪明人，必知道怎样待他，使他白头见杀，流血下到阴间。

chapters.en: Then David rested with his ancestors and was buried in the City of David.
chapters.zh: 大卫与他列祖同睡，葬在大卫城。

chapters.en: He had reigned forty years over Israel—seven years in Hebron and thirty-three in Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 大卫作以色列王四十年，在希伯仑作王七年，在耶路撒冷作王三十三年。

chapters.en: So Solomon sat on the throne of his father David, and his rule was firmly established.
chapters.zh: 所罗门坐他父亲大卫的位，他的国甚是坚固。

chapters.en: Now Adonijah, the son of Haggith, went to Bathsheba, Solomon’s mother. Bathsheba asked him, “Do you come peacefully?” He answered, “Yes, peacefully.”
chapters.zh: 哈及的儿子亚多尼雅去见所罗门的母亲拔示巴，拔示巴问他说，你来是为平安吗？回答说，是为平安。

chapters.en: Then he added, “I have something to say to you.” “You may say it,” she replied.
chapters.zh: 又说，我有话对你说。拔示巴说，你说吧。

chapters.en: “As you know,” he said, “the kingdom was mine. All Israel looked to me as their king. But things changed, and the kingdom has gone to my brother; for it has come to him from the LORD.
chapters.zh: 亚多尼雅说，你知道国原是归我的，以色列众人也都仰望我作王，不料，国反归了我兄弟，因他得国是出乎耶和华。

chapters.en: Now I have one request to make of you. Do not refuse me.” “You may make it,” she said.
chapters.zh: 现在我有一件事求你，望你不要推辞。拔示巴说，你说吧。

chapters.en: So he continued, “Please ask King Solomon—he will not refuse you—to give me Abishag the Shunammite as my wife.”
chapters.zh: 他说，求你请所罗门王将书念的女子亚比煞赐我为妻，因他必不推辞你。

chapters.en: “Very well,” Bathsheba replied, “I will speak to the king for you.”
chapters.zh: 拔示巴说，好，我必为你对王提说。

chapters.en: When Bathsheba went to King Solomon to speak to him for Adonijah, the king stood up to meet her, bowed down to her and sat down on his throne. He had a throne brought for the king’s mother, and she sat down at his right hand.
chapters.zh: 于是，拔示巴去见所罗门王，要为亚多尼雅提说。王起来迎接，向她下拜，就坐在位上，吩咐人为王母设一座位，她便坐在王的右边。

chapters.en: “I have one small request to make of you,” she said. “Do not refuse me.” The king replied, “Make it, my mother; I will not refuse you.”
chapters.zh: 拔示巴说，我有一件小事求你，望你不要推辞。王说，请母亲说，我必不推辞。

chapters.en: So she said, “Let Abishag the Shunammite be given in marriage to your brother Adonijah.”
chapters.zh: 拔示巴说，求你将书念的女子亚比煞赐给你哥哥亚多尼雅为妻。

chapters.en: King Solomon answered his mother, “Why do you request Abishag the Shunammite for Adonijah? You might as well request the kingdom for him—after all, he is my older brother—yes, for him and for Abiathar the priest and Joab son of Zeruiah!”
chapters.zh: 所罗门王对他母亲说，为何单替他求书念的女子亚比煞呢？也可以为他求国吧。他是我的哥哥，他有祭司亚比亚他和洗鲁雅的儿子约押为辅佐。

chapters.en: Then King Solomon swore by the LORD: “May God deal with me, be it ever so severely, if Adonijah does not pay with his life for this request!
chapters.zh: 所罗门王就指着耶和华起誓说，亚多尼雅这话是自己送命，不然，愿神重重地降罚与我。

chapters.en: And now, as surely as the LORD lives—he who has established me securely on the throne of my father David and has founded a dynasty for me as he promised—Adonijah shall be put to death today!”
chapters.zh: 耶和华坚立我，使我坐在父亲大卫的位上，照着所应许的话为我建立家室。现在我指着永生的耶和华起誓，亚多尼雅今日必被治死。

chapters.en: So King Solomon gave orders to Benaiah son of Jehoiada, and he struck down Adonijah and he died.
chapters.zh: 于是所罗门王差遣耶何耶大的儿子比拿雅，将亚多尼雅杀死。

chapters.en: To Abiathar the priest the king said, “Go back to your fields in Anathoth. You deserve to die, but I will not put you to death now, because you carried the ark of the Sovereign LORD before my father David and shared all my father’s hardships.”
chapters.zh: 王对祭司亚比亚他说，你回亚拿突归自己的田地去吧。你本是该死的，但因你在我父亲大卫面前抬过主耶和华的约柜，又与我父亲同受一切苦难，所以我今日不将你杀死。

chapters.en: So Solomon removed Abiathar from the priesthood of the LORD, fulfilling the word the LORD had spoken at Shiloh about the house of Eli.
chapters.zh: 所罗门就革除亚比亚他，不许他作耶和华的祭司。这样，便应验耶和华在示罗论以利家所说的话。

chapters.en: When the news reached Joab, who had conspired with Adonijah though not with Absalom, he fled to the tent of the LORD and took hold of the horns of the altar.
chapters.zh: 约押虽然没有归从押沙龙，却归从了亚多尼雅。他听见这风声，就逃到耶和华的帐幕，抓住祭坛的角。

chapters.en: King Solomon was told that Joab had fled to the tent of the LORD and was beside the altar. Then Solomon ordered Benaiah son of Jehoiada, “Go, strike him down!”
chapters.zh: 有人告诉所罗门王说，约押逃到耶和华的帐幕，现今在祭坛的旁边。所罗门就差遣耶何耶大的儿子比拿雅，说，你去将他杀死。

chapters.en: So Benaiah entered the tent of the LORD and said to Joab, “The king says, ‘Come out!’ ” But he answered, “No, I will die here.” Benaiah reported to the king, “This is how Joab answered me.”
chapters.zh: 比拿雅来到耶和华的帐幕，对约押说，王吩咐说，你出来吧。他说，我不出去，我要死在这里。比拿雅就去回覆王，说约押如此如此回答我。

chapters.en: Then the king commanded Benaiah, “Do as he says. Strike him down and bury him, and so clear me and my whole family of the guilt of the innocent blood that Joab shed.
chapters.zh: 王说，你可以照着他的话行，杀死他，将他葬埋，好叫约押流无辜人血的罪不归我和我的父家了。

chapters.en: The LORD will repay him for the blood he shed, because without my father David knowing it he attacked two men and killed them with the sword. Both of them—Abner son of Ner, commander of Israel’s army, and Amasa son of Jether, commander of Judah’s army—were better men and more upright than he.
chapters.zh: 耶和华必使约押流人血的罪归到他自己的头上。因为他用刀杀了两个比他又义又好的人，就是以色列元帅尼珥的儿子押尼珥和犹大元帅益帖的儿子亚玛撒，我父亲大卫却不知道。

chapters.en: May the guilt of their blood rest on the head of Joab and his descendants forever. But on David and his descendants, his house and his throne, may there be the LORD’s peace forever.”
chapters.zh: 故此，流这二人血的罪必归到约押和他后裔的头上，直到永远。惟有大卫和他的后裔，并他的家与国，必从耶和华那里得平安，直到永远。

chapters.en: So Benaiah son of Jehoiada went up and struck down Joab and killed him, and he was buried at his home out in the country.
chapters.zh: 于是耶何耶大的儿子比拿雅上去，将约押杀死，葬在旷野约押自己的坟墓里（坟墓原文作房屋）。

chapters.en: The king put Benaiah son of Jehoiada over the army in Joab’s position and replaced Abiathar with Zadok the priest.
chapters.zh: 王就立耶何耶大的儿子比拿雅作元帅，代替约押，又使祭司撒督代替亚比亚他。

chapters.en: Then the king sent for Shimei and said to him, “Build yourself a house in Jerusalem and live there, but do not go anywhere else.
chapters.zh: 王差遣人将示每召来，对他说，你要在耶路撒冷建造房屋居住，不可出来往别处去。

chapters.en: The day you leave and cross the Kidron Valley, you can be sure you will die; your blood will be on your own head.”
chapters.zh: 你当确实地知道，你何日出来过汲沦溪，何日必死。你的罪（原文作血）必归到自己的头上。

chapters.en: Shimei answered the king, “What you say is good. Your servant will do as my lord the king has said.” And Shimei stayed in Jerusalem for a long time.
chapters.zh: 示每对王说，这话甚好。我主我王怎样说，仆人必怎样行。于是示每多日住在耶路撒冷。

chapters.en: But three years later, two of Shimei’s slaves ran off to Achish son of Maakah, king of Gath, and Shimei was told, “Your slaves are in Gath.”
chapters.zh: 过了三年，示每的两个仆人逃到迦特王玛迦的儿子亚吉那里去。有人告诉示每说，你的仆人在迦特。

chapters.en: At this, he saddled his donkey and went to Achish at Gath in search of his slaves. So Shimei went away and brought the slaves back from Gath.
chapters.zh: 示每起来，备上驴，往迦特到亚吉那里去找他的仆人，就从迦特带他仆人回来。

chapters.en: When Solomon was told that Shimei had gone from Jerusalem to Gath and had returned,
chapters.zh: 有人告诉所罗门说，示每出耶路撒冷往迦特去，回来了。

chapters.en: the king summoned Shimei and said to him, “Did I not make you swear by the LORD and warn you, ‘On the day you leave to go anywhere else, you can be sure you will die’? At that time you said to me, ‘What you say is good. I will obey.’
chapters.zh: 王就差遣人将示每召了来，对他说，我岂不是叫你指着耶和华起誓，并且警戒你说你当确实地知道，你哪日出来往别处去，那日必死吗？你也对我说，这话甚好，我必听从。

chapters.en: Why then did you not keep your oath to the LORD and obey the command I gave you?”
chapters.zh: 现在你为何不遵守你指着耶和华起的誓和我所吩咐你的命令呢？

chapters.en: The king also said to Shimei, “You know in your heart all the wrong you did to my father David. Now the LORD will repay you for your wrongdoing.
chapters.zh: 王又对示每说，你向我父亲大卫所行的一切恶事，你自己心里也知道，所以耶和华必使你的罪恶归到自己的头上。

chapters.en: But King Solomon will be blessed, and David’s throne will remain secure before the LORD forever.”
chapters.zh: 惟有所罗门王必得福，并且大卫的国位必在耶和华面前坚定，直到永远。

chapters.en: Then the king gave the order to Benaiah son of Jehoiada, and he went out and struck Shimei down and he died. The kingdom was now established in Solomon’s hands.
chapters.zh: 于是王吩咐耶何耶大的儿子比拿雅，他就去杀死示每。这样，便坚定了所罗门的国位。

chapters.en: Solomon made an alliance with Pharaoh king of Egypt and married his daughter. He brought her to the City of David until he finished building his palace and the temple of the LORD, and the wall around Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 所罗门与埃及王法老结亲，娶了法老的女儿为妻，接她进入大卫城，直等到造完了自己的宫和耶和华的殿，并耶路撒冷周围的城墙。

chapters.en: The people, however, were still sacrificing at the high places, because a temple had not yet been built for the Name of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 当那些日子，百姓仍在丘坛献祭，因为还没有为耶和华的名建殿。

chapters.en: Solomon showed his love for the LORD by walking according to the instructions given him by his father David, except that he offered sacrifices and burned incense on the high places.
chapters.zh: 所罗门爱耶和华，遵行他父亲大卫的律例，只是还在丘坛献祭烧香。

chapters.en: The king went to Gibeon to offer sacrifices, for that was the most important high place, and Solomon offered a thousand burnt offerings on that altar.
chapters.zh: 所罗门王上基遍去献祭。因为在那里有极大的丘坛（极大或作出名），他在那坛上献一千牺牲作燔祭。

chapters.en: At Gibeon the LORD appeared to Solomon during the night in a dream, and God said, “Ask for whatever you want me to give you.”
chapters.zh: 在基遍，夜间梦中，耶和华向所罗门显现，对他说，你愿我赐你什么。你可以求。

chapters.en: Solomon answered, “You have shown great kindness to your servant, my father David, because he was faithful to you and righteous and upright in heart. You have continued this great kindness to him and have given him a son to sit on his throne this very day.
chapters.zh: 所罗门说，你仆人我父亲大卫用诚实，公义，正直的心行在你面前，你就向他大施恩典，又为他存留大恩，赐他一个儿子坐在他的位上，正如今日一样。

chapters.en: “Now, LORD my God, you have made your servant king in place of my father David. But I am only a little child and do not know how to carry out my duties.
chapters.zh: 耶和华我的神阿，如今你使仆人接续我父亲大卫作王。但我是幼童，不知道应当怎样出入。

chapters.en: Your servant is here among the people you have chosen, a great people, too numerous to count or number.
chapters.zh: 仆人住在你所拣选的民中，这民多得不可胜数。

chapters.en: So give your servant a discerning heart to govern your people and to distinguish between right and wrong. For who is able to govern this great people of yours?”
chapters.zh: 所以求你赐我智慧，可以判断你的民，能辨别是非。不然，谁能判断这众多的民呢？

chapters.en: The Lord was pleased that Solomon had asked for this.
chapters.zh: 所罗门因为求这事，就蒙主喜悦。

chapters.en: So God said to him, “Since you have asked for this and not for long life or wealth for yourself, nor have asked for the death of your enemies but for discernment in administering justice,
chapters.zh: 神对他说，你既然求这事，不为自己求寿，求富，也不求灭绝你仇敌的性命，单求智慧可以听讼，

chapters.en: I will do what you have asked. I will give you a wise and discerning heart, so that there will never have been anyone like you, nor will there ever be.
chapters.zh: 我就应允你所求的，赐你聪明智慧，甚至在你以前没有象你的，在你以后也没有象你的。

chapters.en: Moreover, I will give you what you have not asked for—both wealth and honor—so that in your lifetime you will have no equal among kings.
chapters.zh: 你所没有求的，我也赐给你，就是富足，尊荣，使你在世的日子，列王中没有一个能比你的。

chapters.en: And if you walk in obedience to me and keep my decrees and commands as David your father did, I will give you a long life.”
chapters.zh: 你若效法你父亲大卫，遵行我的道，谨守我的律例，诫命，我必使你长寿。

chapters.en: Then Solomon awoke—and he realized it had been a dream. He returned to Jerusalem, stood before the ark of the Lord’s covenant and sacrificed burnt offerings and fellowship offerings. Then he gave a feast for all his court.
chapters.zh: 所罗门醒了，不料是个梦。他就回到耶路撒冷，站在耶和华的约柜前，献燔祭和平安祭，又为他众臣仆设摆筵席。

chapters.en: Now two prostitutes came to the king and stood before him.
chapters.zh: 一日，有两个妓女来，站在王面前。

chapters.en: One of them said, “Pardon me, my lord. This woman and I live in the same house, and I had a baby while she was there with me.
chapters.zh: 一个说，我主阿，我和这妇人同住一房。她在房中的时候，我生了一个男孩。

chapters.en: The third day after my child was born, this woman also had a baby. We were alone; there was no one in the house but the two of us.
chapters.zh: 我生孩子后第三日，这妇人也生了孩子。我们是同住的，除了我们二人之外，房中再没有别人。

chapters.en: “During the night this woman’s son died because she lay on him.
chapters.zh: 夜间，这妇人睡着的时候，压死了她的孩子。

chapters.en: So she got up in the middle of the night and took my son from my side while I your servant was asleep. She put him by her breast and put her dead son by my breast.
chapters.zh: 她半夜起来，趁我睡着，从我旁边把我的孩子抱去，放在她怀里，将她的死孩子放在我怀里。

chapters.en: The next morning, I got up to nurse my son—and he was dead! But when I looked at him closely in the morning light, I saw that it wasn’t the son I had borne.”
chapters.zh: 天要亮的时候，我起来要给我的孩子吃奶，不料，孩子死了。及至天亮，我细细地察看，不是我所生的孩子。

chapters.en: The other woman said, “No! The living one is my son; the dead one is yours.” But the first one insisted, “No! The dead one is yours; the living one is mine.” And so they argued before the king.
chapters.zh: 那妇人说，不然，活孩子是我的，死孩子是你的。这妇人说，不然，死孩子是你的，活孩子是我的。她们在王面前如此争论。

chapters.en: The king said, “This one says, ‘My son is alive and your son is dead,’ while that one says, ‘No! Your son is dead and mine is alive.’ ”
chapters.zh: 王说，这妇人说活孩子是我的，死孩子是你的，那妇人说不然，死孩子是你的，活孩子是我的，

chapters.en: Then the king said, “Bring me a sword.” So they brought a sword for the king.
chapters.zh: 就吩咐说，拿刀来。人就拿刀来。

chapters.en: He then gave an order: “Cut the living child in two and give half to one and half to the other.”
chapters.zh: 王说，将活孩子劈成两半，一半给那妇人，一半给这妇人。

chapters.en: The woman whose son was alive was deeply moved out of love for her son and said to the king, “Please, my lord, give her the living baby! Don’t kill him!” But the other said, “Neither I nor you shall have him. Cut him in two!”
chapters.zh: 活孩子的母亲为自己的孩子心里急痛，就说，求我主将活孩子给那妇人吧，万不可杀他。那妇人说，这孩子也不归我，也不归你，把他劈了吧。

chapters.en: Then the king gave his ruling: “Give the living baby to the first woman. Do not kill him; she is his mother.”
chapters.zh: 王说，将活孩子给这妇人，万不可杀他。这妇人实在是他的母亲。

chapters.en: When all Israel heard the verdict the king had given, they held the king in awe, because they saw that he had wisdom from God to administer justice.
chapters.zh: 以色列众人听见王这样判断，就都敬畏他。因为见他心里有神的智慧，能以断案。

chapters.en: So King Solomon ruled over all Israel.
chapters.zh: 所罗门作以色列众人的王。

chapters.en: And these were his chief officials: Azariah son of Zadok—the priest;
chapters.zh: 他的臣子记在下面，撒督的儿子亚撒利雅作祭司，

chapters.en: Elihoreph and Ahijah, sons of Shisha—secretaries; Jehoshaphat son of Ahilud—recorder;
chapters.zh: 示沙的两个儿子以利何烈，亚希亚作书记，亚希律的儿子约沙法作史官，

chapters.en: Benaiah son of Jehoiada—commander in chief; Zadok and Abiathar—priests;
chapters.zh: 耶何耶大的儿子比拿雅作元帅，撒督和亚比亚他作祭司长，

chapters.en: Azariah son of Nathan—in charge of the district governors; Zabud son of Nathan—a priest and adviser to the king;
chapters.zh: 拿单的儿子亚撒利雅作众吏长，王的朋友拿单的儿子撒布得作领袖，

chapters.en: Ahishar—palace administrator; Adoniram son of Abda—in charge of forced labor.
chapters.zh: 亚希煞作家宰，亚比大的儿子亚多尼兰掌管服苦的人。

chapters.en: Solomon had twelve district governors over all Israel, who supplied provisions for the king and the royal household. Each one had to provide supplies for one month in the year.
chapters.zh: 所罗门在以色列全地立了十二个官吏，使他们供给王和王家的食物，每年各人供给一月。

chapters.en: These are their names: Ben-Hur—in the hill country of Ephraim;
chapters.zh: 他们的名字记在下面，在以法莲山地有便户珥。

chapters.en: Ben-Deker—in Makaz, Shaalbim, Beth Shemesh and Elon Bethhanan;
chapters.zh: 在玛迦斯，沙宾，伯示麦，以伦伯哈南有便底甲。

chapters.en: Ben-Hesed—in Arubboth (Sokoh and all the land of Hepher were his);
chapters.zh: 在亚鲁泊有便希悉，他管理梭哥和希弗全地。

chapters.en: Ben-Abinadab—in Naphoth Dor (he was married to Taphath daughter of Solomon);
chapters.zh: 在多珥山冈（或作全境）有便亚比拿达，他娶了所罗门的女儿他法为妻。

chapters.en: Baana son of Ahilud—in Taanach and Megiddo, and in all of Beth Shan next to Zarethan below Jezreel, from Beth Shan to Abel Meholah across to Jokmeam;
chapters.zh: 在他纳和米吉多，并靠近撒拉他拿，耶斯列下边的伯善全地，从伯善到亚伯米何拉直到约念之外，有亚希律的儿子巴拿。

chapters.en: Ben-Geber—in Ramoth Gilead (the settlements of Jair son of Manasseh in Gilead were his, as well as the region of Argob in Bashan and its sixty large walled cities with bronze gate bars);
chapters.zh: 在基列的拉末有便基别，他管理在基列的玛拿西子孙睚珥的城邑，巴珊的亚珥歌伯地的大城六十座，都有城墙和铜闩。

chapters.en: Ahinadab son of Iddo—in Mahanaim;
chapters.zh: 在玛哈念有易多的儿子亚希拿达。

chapters.en: Ahimaaz—in Naphtali (he had married Basemath daughter of Solomon);
chapters.zh: 在拿弗他利有亚希玛斯，他也娶了所罗门的一个女儿巴实抹为妻。

chapters.en: Baana son of Hushai—in Asher and in Aloth;
chapters.zh: 在亚设和亚禄有户筛的儿子巴拿。

chapters.en: Jehoshaphat son of Paruah—in Issachar;
chapters.zh: 在以萨迦有帕路亚的儿子约沙法。

chapters.en: Shimei son of Ela—in Benjamin;
chapters.zh: 在便雅悯有以拉的儿子示每。

chapters.en: Geber son of Uri—in Gilead (the country of Sihon king of the Amorites and the country of Og king of Bashan). He was the only governor over the district.
chapters.zh: 在基列地，就是从前属亚摩利王西宏和巴珊王噩之地，有乌利的儿子基别一人管理。

chapters.en: The people of Judah and Israel were as numerous as the sand on the seashore; they ate, they drank and they were happy.
chapters.zh: 犹大人和以色列人如同海边的沙那样多，都吃喝快乐。

chapters.en: And Solomon ruled over all the kingdoms from the Euphrates River to the land of the Philistines, as far as the border of Egypt. These countries brought tribute and were Solomon’s subjects all his life.
chapters.zh: 所罗门统管诸国，从大河到非利士地，直到埃及的边界。所罗门在世的日子，这些国都进贡服事他。

chapters.en: Solomon’s daily provisions were thirty cors of the finest flour and sixty cors of meal,
chapters.zh: 所罗门每日所用的食物，细面三十歌珥，粗面六十歌珥，

chapters.en: ten head of stall-fed cattle, twenty of pasture-fed cattle and a hundred sheep and goats, as well as deer, gazelles, roebucks and choice fowl.
chapters.zh: 肥牛十只，草场的牛二十只，羊一百只，还有鹿，羚羊，狍子，并肥禽。

chapters.en: For he ruled over all the kingdoms west of the Euphrates River, from Tiphsah to Gaza, and had peace on all sides.
chapters.zh: 所罗门管理大河西边的诸王，以及从提弗萨直到迦萨的全地，四境尽都平安。

chapters.en: During Solomon’s lifetime Judah and Israel, from Dan to Beersheba, lived in safety, everyone under their own vine and under their own fig tree.
chapters.zh: 所罗门在世的日子，从但到别是巴的犹大人和以色列人，都在自己的葡萄树下和无花果树下安然居住。

chapters.en: Solomon had four thousand stalls for chariot horses, and twelve thousand horses.
chapters.zh: 所罗门有套车的马四万，还有马兵一万二千。

chapters.en: The district governors, each in his month, supplied provisions for King Solomon and all who came to the king’s table. They saw to it that nothing was lacking.
chapters.zh: 那十二个官吏各按各月供给所罗门王，并一切与他同席之人的食物，一无所缺。

chapters.en: They also brought to the proper place their quotas of barley and straw for the chariot horses and the other horses.
chapters.zh: 众人各按各分，将养马与快马的大麦和干草送到官吏那里。

chapters.en: God gave Solomon wisdom and very great insight, and a breadth of understanding as measureless as the sand on the seashore.
chapters.zh: 神赐给所罗门极大的智慧聪明和广大的心，如同海沙不可测量。

chapters.en: Solomon’s wisdom was greater than the wisdom of all the people of the East, and greater than all the wisdom of Egypt.
chapters.zh: 所罗门的智慧超过东方人和埃及人的一切智慧。

chapters.en: He was wiser than anyone else, including Ethan the Ezrahite—wiser than Heman, Kalkol and Darda, the sons of Mahol. And his fame spread to all the surrounding nations.
chapters.zh: 他的智慧胜过万人，胜过以斯拉人以探，并玛曷的儿子希幔，甲各，达大的智慧。他的名声传扬在四围的列国。

chapters.en: He spoke three thousand proverbs and his songs numbered a thousand and five.
chapters.zh: 他作箴言三千句，诗歌一千零五首。

chapters.en: He spoke about plant life, from the cedar of Lebanon to the hyssop that grows out of walls. He also spoke about animals and birds, reptiles and fish.
chapters.zh: 他讲论草木，自利巴嫩的香柏树直到墙上长的牛膝草，又讲论飞禽走兽，昆虫水族。

chapters.en: From all nations people came to listen to Solomon’s wisdom, sent by all the kings of the world, who had heard of his wisdom.
chapters.zh: 天下列王听见所罗门的智慧，就都差人来听他的智慧话。

chapters.en: When Hiram king of Tyre heard that Solomon had been anointed king to succeed his father David, he sent his envoys to Solomon, because he had always been on friendly terms with David.
chapters.zh: 推罗王希兰，平素爱大卫。他听见以色列人膏所罗门，接续他父亲作王，就差遣臣仆来见他。

chapters.en: Solomon sent back this message to Hiram:
chapters.zh: 所罗门也差遣人去见希兰，说：

chapters.en: “You know that because of the wars waged against my father David from all sides, he could not build a temple for the Name of the LORD his God until the LORD put his enemies under his feet.
chapters.zh: “你知道我父亲大卫因四围的争战，不能为耶和华他神的名建殿，直等到耶和华使仇敌都服在他脚下。

chapters.en: But now the LORD my God has given me rest on every side, and there is no adversary or disaster.
chapters.zh: 现在耶和华我的神使我四围平安，没有仇敌，没有灾祸。

chapters.en: I intend, therefore, to build a temple for the Name of the LORD my God, as the LORD told my father David, when he said, ‘Your son whom I will put on the throne in your place will build the temple for my Name.’
chapters.zh: 我定意要为耶和华我神的名建殿，是照耶和华应许我父亲大卫的话说，我必使你儿子接续你坐你的位，他必为我的名建殿。

chapters.en: “So give orders that cedars of Lebanon be cut for me. My men will work with yours, and I will pay you for your men whatever wages you set. You know that we have no one so skilled in felling timber as the Sidonians.”
chapters.zh: 所以求你吩咐你的仆人在利巴嫩为我砍伐香柏木，我的仆人也必帮助他们，我必照你所定的，给你仆人的工价。因为你知道，在我们中间没有人像西顿人善于砍伐树木。”

chapters.en: When Hiram heard Solomon’s message, he was greatly pleased and said, “Praise be to the LORD today, for he has given David a wise son to rule over this great nation.”
chapters.zh: 希兰听见所罗门的话，就甚喜悦，说，今日应当称颂耶和华。因他赐给大卫一个有智慧的儿子，治理这众多的民。

chapters.en: So Hiram sent word to Solomon: “I have received the message you sent me and will do all you want in providing the cedar and juniper logs.
chapters.zh: 希兰打发人去见所罗门，说，你差遣人向我所提的那事，我都听见了。论到香柏木和松木，我必照你的心愿而行。

chapters.en: My men will haul them down from Lebanon to the Mediterranean Sea, and I will float them as rafts by sea to the place you specify. There I will separate them and you can take them away. And you are to grant my wish by providing food for my royal household.”
chapters.zh: 我的仆人必将这木料从利巴嫩运到海里，扎成筏子，浮海运到你所指定我的地方，在那里拆开，你就可以收取，你也要成全我的心愿，将食物给我的家。

chapters.en: In this way Hiram kept Solomon supplied with all the cedar and juniper logs he wanted,
chapters.zh: 于是希兰照着所罗门所要的，给他香柏木和松木。

chapters.en: and Solomon gave Hiram twenty thousand cors of wheat as food for his household, in addition to twenty thousand baths of pressed olive oil. Solomon continued to do this for Hiram year after year.
chapters.zh: 所罗门给希兰麦子二万歌珥，清油二十歌珥，作他家的食物。所罗门每年都是这样给希兰。

chapters.en: The LORD gave Solomon wisdom, just as he had promised him. There were peaceful relations between Hiram and Solomon, and the two of them made a treaty.
chapters.zh: 耶和华照着所应许的赐智慧给所罗门。希兰与所罗门和好，彼此立约。

chapters.en: King Solomon conscripted laborers from all Israel—thirty thousand men.
chapters.zh: 所罗门王从以色列人中挑取服苦的人共有三万，

chapters.en: He sent them off to Lebanon in shifts of ten thousand a month, so that they spent one month in Lebanon and two months at home. Adoniram was in charge of the forced labor.
chapters.zh: 派他们轮流每月一万人上利巴嫩去。一个月在利巴嫩，两个月在家里。亚多尼兰掌管他们。

chapters.en: Solomon had seventy thousand carriers and eighty thousand stonecutters in the hills,
chapters.zh: 所罗门用七万扛抬的，八万在山上凿石头的。

chapters.en: as well as thirty-three hundred foremen who supervised the project and directed the workers.
chapters.zh: 此外，所罗门用三千三百督工的，监管工人。

chapters.en: At the king’s command they removed from the quarry large blocks of high-grade stone to provide a foundation of dressed stone for the temple.
chapters.zh: 王下令，人就凿出又大又宝贵的石头来，用以立殿的根基。

chapters.en: The craftsmen of Solomon and Hiram and workers from Byblos cut and prepared the timber and stone for the building of the temple.
chapters.zh: 所罗门的匠人和希兰的匠人，并迦巴勒人，都将石头凿好，预备木料和石头建殿。

chapters.en: In the four hundred and eightieth year after the Israelites came out of Egypt, in the fourth year of Solomon’s reign over Israel, in the month of Ziv, the second month, he began to build the temple of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 以色列人出埃及地后四百八十年，所罗门作以色列王第四年西弗月，就是二月，开工建造耶和华的殿。

chapters.en: The temple that King Solomon built for the LORD was sixty cubits long, twenty wide and thirty high.
chapters.zh: 所罗门王为耶和华所建的殿，长六十肘，宽二十肘，高三十肘。

chapters.en: The portico at the front of the main hall of the temple extended the width of the temple, that is twenty cubits, and projected ten cubits from the front of the temple.
chapters.zh: 殿前的廊子长二十肘，与殿的宽窄一样，阔十肘。

chapters.en: He made narrow windows high up in the temple walls.
chapters.zh: 又为殿作了严紧的窗棂。

chapters.en: Against the walls of the main hall and inner sanctuary he built a structure around the building, in which there were side rooms.
chapters.zh: 靠着殿墙，围着外殿内殿，造了三层旁屋。

chapters.en: The lowest floor was five cubits wide, the middle floor six cubits and the third floor seven. He made offset ledges around the outside of the temple so that nothing would be inserted into the temple walls.
chapters.zh: 下层宽五肘，中层宽六肘，上层宽七肘。殿外旁屋的梁木搁在殿墙坎上，免得插入殿墙。

chapters.en: In building the temple, only blocks dressed at the quarry were used, and no hammer, chisel or any other iron tool was heard at the temple site while it was being built.
chapters.zh: 建殿是用山中凿成的石头。建殿的时候，锤子，斧子，和别样铁器的响声都没有听见。

chapters.en: The entrance to the lowest floor was on the south side of the temple; a stairway led up to the middle level and from there to the third.
chapters.zh: 在殿右边当中的旁屋有门，门内有旋螺的楼梯，可以上到第二层，从第二层可以上到第三层。

chapters.en: So he built the temple and completed it, roofing it with beams and cedar planks.
chapters.zh: 所罗门建殿，安置香柏木的栋梁，又用香柏木板遮盖。

chapters.en: And he built the side rooms all along the temple. The height of each was five cubits, and they were attached to the temple by beams of cedar.
chapters.zh: 靠着殿所造的旁屋，每层高五肘，香柏木的栋梁搁在殿墙坎上。

chapters.en: The word of the LORD came to Solomon:
chapters.zh: 耶和华的话临到所罗门说，

chapters.en: “As for this temple you are building, if you follow my decrees, observe my laws and keep all my commands and obey them, I will fulfill through you the promise I gave to David your father.
chapters.zh: 论到你所建的这殿，你若遵行我的律例，谨守我的典章，遵从我的一切诫命，我必向你应验我所应许你父亲大卫的话。

chapters.en: And I will live among the Israelites and will not abandon my people Israel.”
chapters.zh: 我必住在以色列人中间，并不丢弃我民以色列。

chapters.en: So Solomon built the temple and completed it.
chapters.zh: 所罗门建造殿宇。

chapters.en: He lined its interior walls with cedar boards, paneling them from the floor of the temple to the ceiling, and covered the floor of the temple with planks of juniper.
chapters.zh: 殿里面用香柏木板贴墙，从地到棚顶都用木板遮蔽，又用松木板铺地。

chapters.en: He partitioned off twenty cubits at the rear of the temple with cedar boards from floor to ceiling to form within the temple an inner sanctuary, the Most Holy Place.
chapters.zh: 内殿，就是至圣所，长二十肘，从地到棚顶用香柏木板遮蔽（或作隔断）。

chapters.en: The main hall in front of this room was forty cubits long.
chapters.zh: 内殿前的外殿，长四十肘。

chapters.en: The inside of the temple was cedar, carved with gourds and open flowers. Everything was cedar; no stone was to be seen.
chapters.zh: 殿里一点石头都不显露，一概用香柏木遮蔽。上面刻着野瓜和初开的花。

chapters.en: He prepared the inner sanctuary within the temple to set the ark of the covenant of the LORD there.
chapters.zh: 殿里预备了内殿，好安放耶和华的约柜。

chapters.en: The inner sanctuary was twenty cubits long, twenty wide and twenty high. He overlaid the inside with pure gold, and he also overlaid the altar of cedar.
chapters.zh: 内殿长二十肘，宽二十肘，高二十肘，墙面都贴上精金。又用香柏木作坛，包上精金。

chapters.en: Solomon covered the inside of the temple with pure gold, and he extended gold chains across the front of the inner sanctuary, which was overlaid with gold.
chapters.zh: 所罗门用精金贴了殿内的墙，又用金链子挂在内殿前门扇，用金包裹。

chapters.en: So he overlaid the whole interior with gold. He also overlaid with gold the altar that belonged to the inner sanctuary.
chapters.zh: 全殿都贴上金子，直到贴完。内殿前的坛，也都用金包裹。

chapters.en: For the inner sanctuary he made a pair of cherubim out of olive wood, each ten cubits high.
chapters.zh: 他用橄榄木作两个基路伯，各高十肘，安在内殿。

chapters.en: One wing of the first cherub was five cubits long, and the other wing five cubits—ten cubits from wing tip to wing tip.
chapters.zh: 这一个基路伯有两个翅膀，各长五肘，从这翅膀尖到那翅膀尖共有十肘。

chapters.en: The second cherub also measured ten cubits, for the two cherubim were identical in size and shape.
chapters.zh: 那一个基路伯的两个翅膀也是十肘，两个基路伯的尺寸，形像都是一样。

chapters.en: The height of each cherub was ten cubits.
chapters.zh: 这基路伯高十肘，那基路伯也是如此。

chapters.en: He placed the cherubim inside the innermost room of the temple, with their wings spread out. The wing of one cherub touched one wall, while the wing of the other touched the other wall, and their wings touched each other in the middle of the room.
chapters.zh: 他将两个基路伯安在内殿里。基路伯的翅膀是张开的，这基路伯的一个翅膀挨着这边的墙，那基路伯的一个翅膀挨着那边的墙，里边的两个翅膀在殿中间彼此相接。

chapters.en: He overlaid the cherubim with gold.
chapters.zh: 又用金子包裹二基路伯。

chapters.en: On the walls all around the temple, in both the inner and outer rooms, he carved cherubim, palm trees and open flowers.
chapters.zh: 内殿，外殿周围的墙上都刻着基路伯，棕树，和初开的花。

chapters.en: He also covered the floors of both the inner and outer rooms of the temple with gold.
chapters.zh: 内殿，外殿的地板都贴上金子。

chapters.en: For the entrance to the inner sanctuary he made doors out of olive wood that were one fifth of the width of the sanctuary.
chapters.zh: 又用橄榄木制造内殿的门扇，门楣，门框。门口有墙的五分之一。

chapters.en: And on the two olive-wood doors he carved cherubim, palm trees and open flowers, and overlaid the cherubim and palm trees with hammered gold.
chapters.zh: 在橄榄木作的两门扇上刻着基路伯，棕树，和初开的花，都贴上金子。

chapters.en: In the same way, for the entrance to the main hall he made doorframes out of olive wood that were one fourth of the width of the hall.
chapters.zh: 又用橄榄木制造外殿的门框，门口有墙的四分之一。

chapters.en: He also made two doors out of juniper wood, each having two leaves that turned in sockets.
chapters.zh: 用松木作门两扇。这扇分两扇，是折叠的。那扇分两扇。也是折叠的

chapters.en: He carved cherubim, palm trees and open flowers on them and overlaid them with gold hammered evenly over the carvings.
chapters.zh: 上面刻着基路伯，棕树，和初开的花，都用金子贴了。

chapters.en: And he built the inner courtyard of three courses of dressed stone and one course of trimmed cedar beams.
chapters.zh: 他又用凿成的石头三层，香柏木一层建筑内院。

chapters.en: The foundation of the temple of the LORD was laid in the fourth year, in the month of Ziv.
chapters.zh: 所罗门在位第四年西弗月，立了耶和华殿的根基。

chapters.en: In the eleventh year in the month of Bul, the eighth month, the temple was finished in all its details according to its specifications. He had spent seven years building it.
chapters.zh: 到十一年布勒月，就是八月，殿和一切属殿的都按着样式造成。他建殿的工夫共有七年。

chapters.en: It took Solomon thirteen years, however, to complete the construction of his palace.
chapters.zh: 所罗门为自己建造宫室，十三年方才造成。

chapters.en: He built the Palace of the Forest of Lebanon a hundred cubits long, fifty wide and thirty high, with four rows of cedar columns supporting trimmed cedar beams.
chapters.zh: 又建造利巴嫩林宫，长一百肘，宽五十肘，高三十肘，有香柏木柱三（原文作四）行，柱上有香柏木柁梁。

chapters.en: It was roofed with cedar above the beams that rested on the columns—forty-five beams, fifteen to a row.
chapters.zh: 其上以香柏木为盖，每行柱子十五根，共有四十五根。

chapters.en: Its windows were placed high in sets of three, facing each other.
chapters.zh: 有窗户三层，窗与窗相对。

chapters.en: All the doorways had rectangular frames; they were in the front part in sets of three, facing each other.
chapters.zh: 所有的门框都是厚木见方的，有窗户三层，窗与窗相对。

chapters.en: He made a colonnade fifty cubits long and thirty wide. In front of it was a portico, and in front of that were pillars and an overhanging roof.
chapters.zh: 并建造有柱子的廊子，长五十肘，宽三十肘。在这廊前又有廊子，廊外有柱子和台阶。

chapters.en: He built the throne hall, the Hall of Justice, where he was to judge, and he covered it with cedar from floor to ceiling.
chapters.zh: 又建造一廊，其中设立审判的座位，这廊从地到顶都用香柏木遮蔽。

chapters.en: And the palace in which he was to live, set farther back, was similar in design. Solomon also made a palace like this hall for Pharaoh’s daughter, whom he had married.
chapters.zh: 廊后院内有所罗门住的宫室。工作与这工作相同。所罗门又为所娶法老的女儿建造一宫，作法与这廊子一样。

chapters.en: All these structures, from the outside to the great courtyard and from foundation to eaves, were made of blocks of high-grade stone cut to size and smoothed on their inner and outer faces.
chapters.zh: 建造这一切所用的石头都是宝贵的，是按着尺寸凿成的，是用锯里外锯齐的。从根基直到檐石，从外头直到大院，都是如此。

chapters.en: The foundations were laid with large stones of good quality, some measuring ten cubits and some eight.
chapters.zh: 根基是宝贵的大石头，有长十肘的，有长八肘的。

chapters.en: Above were high-grade stones, cut to size, and cedar beams.
chapters.zh: 上面有香柏木和按着尺寸凿成宝贵的石头。

chapters.en: The great courtyard was surrounded by a wall of three courses of dressed stone and one course of trimmed cedar beams, as was the inner courtyard of the temple of the LORD with its portico.
chapters.zh: 大院周围有凿成的石头三层，香柏木一层，都照耶和华殿的内院和殿廊的样式。

chapters.en: King Solomon sent to Tyre and brought Huram,
chapters.zh: 所罗门王差遣人往推罗去，将户兰召了来。

chapters.en: whose mother was a widow from the tribe of Naphtali and whose father was from Tyre and a skilled craftsman in bronze. Huram was filled with wisdom, with understanding and with knowledge to do all kinds of bronze work. He came to King Solomon and did all the work assigned to him.
chapters.zh: 他是拿弗他利支派中一个寡妇的儿子，他父亲是推罗人，作铜匠的。户兰满有智慧，聪明，技能，善于各样铜作。他来到所罗门王那里，作王一切所要作的。

chapters.en: He cast two bronze pillars, each eighteen cubits high and twelve cubits in circumference.
chapters.zh: 他制造两根铜柱，每根高十八肘，围十二肘。

chapters.en: He also made two capitals of cast bronze to set on the tops of the pillars; each capital was five cubits high.
chapters.zh: 又用铜铸了两个柱顶安在柱上，各高五肘。

chapters.en: A network of interwoven chains adorned the capitals on top of the pillars, seven for each capital.
chapters.zh: 柱顶上有装修的网子和拧成的链索，每顶七个。

chapters.en: He made pomegranates in two rows encircling each network to decorate the capitals on top of the pillars. He did the same for each capital.
chapters.zh: 网子周围有两行石榴遮盖柱顶，两个柱顶都是如此。

chapters.en: The capitals on top of the pillars in the portico were in the shape of lilies, four cubits high.
chapters.zh: 廊子的柱顶径四肘，刻着百合花。

chapters.en: On the capitals of both pillars, above the bowl-shaped part next to the network, were the two hundred pomegranates in rows all around.
chapters.zh: 两柱顶的鼓肚上挨着网子，各有两行石榴环绕，两行共有二百。

chapters.en: He erected the pillars at the portico of the temple. The pillar to the south he named Jakin and the one to the north Boaz.
chapters.zh: 他将两根柱子立在殿廊前头，右边立一根，起名叫雅斤。左边立一根，起名叫波阿斯。

chapters.en: The capitals on top were in the shape of lilies. And so the work on the pillars was completed.
chapters.zh: 在柱顶上刻着百合花。这样，造柱子的工就完毕了。

chapters.en: He made the Sea of cast metal, circular in shape, measuring ten cubits from rim to rim and five cubits high. It took a line of thirty cubits to measure around it.
chapters.zh: 他又铸一个铜海，样式是圆的，高五肘，径十肘，围三十肘。

chapters.en: Below the rim, gourds encircled it—ten to a cubit. The gourds were cast in two rows in one piece with the Sea.
chapters.zh: 在海边之下，周围有野瓜的样式。每肘十瓜，共有两行，是铸海的时候铸上的。

chapters.en: The Sea stood on twelve bulls, three facing north, three facing west, three facing south and three facing east. The Sea rested on top of them, and their hindquarters were toward the center.
chapters.zh: 有十二只铜牛驮海，三只向北，三只向西，三只向南，三只向东。海在牛上，牛尾都向内。

chapters.en: It was a handbreadth in thickness, and its rim was like the rim of a cup, like a lily blossom. It held two thousand baths.
chapters.zh: 海厚一掌，边如杯边，又如百合花，可容二千吧特。

chapters.en: He also made ten movable stands of bronze; each was four cubits long, four wide and three high.
chapters.zh: 他用铜制造十个盆座，每座长四肘，宽四肘，高三肘。

chapters.en: This is how the stands were made: They had side panels attached to uprights.
chapters.zh: 座的造法是这样，四面都有心子，心子在边子当中，

chapters.en: On the panels between the uprights were lions, bulls and cherubim—and on the uprights as well. Above and below the lions and bulls were wreaths of hammered work.
chapters.zh: 心子上有狮子和牛，并基路伯。边上有小座，狮子和牛以下有垂下的璎珞。

chapters.en: Each stand had four bronze wheels with bronze axles, and each had a basin resting on four supports, cast with wreaths on each side.
chapters.zh: 每盆座有四个铜轮和铜轴。小座的四角上在盆以下，有铸成的盆架，其旁都有璎珞。

chapters.en: On the inside of the stand there was an opening that had a circular frame one cubit deep. This opening was round, and with its basework it measured a cubit and a half. Around its opening there was engraving. The panels of the stands were square, not round.
chapters.zh: 小座高一肘，口是圆的，仿佛座的样式，径一肘半，在口上有雕工，心子是方的，不是圆的。

chapters.en: The four wheels were under the panels, and the axles of the wheels were attached to the stand. The diameter of each wheel was a cubit and a half.
chapters.zh: 四个轮子在心子以下，轮轴与座相连，每轮高一肘半。

chapters.en: The wheels were made like chariot wheels; the axles, rims, spokes and hubs were all of cast metal.
chapters.zh: 轮的样式如同车轮。轴，辋，辐，毂都是铸的。

chapters.en: Each stand had four handles, one on each corner, projecting from the stand.
chapters.zh: 每座四角上都有盆架，是与座一同铸成的。

chapters.en: At the top of the stand there was a circular band half a cubit deep. The supports and panels were attached to the top of the stand.
chapters.zh: 座上有圆架，高半肘。座上有撑子和心子，是与座一同铸的。

chapters.en: He engraved cherubim, lions and palm trees on the surfaces of the supports and on the panels, in every available space, with wreaths all around.
chapters.zh: 在撑子和心子上刻着基路伯，狮子，和棕树，周围有璎珞。

chapters.en: This is the way he made the ten stands. They were all cast in the same molds and were identical in size and shape.
chapters.zh: 十个盆座都是这样，铸法，尺寸，样式相同。

chapters.en: He then made ten bronze basins, each holding forty baths and measuring four cubits across, one basin to go on each of the ten stands.
chapters.zh: 又用铜制造十个盆，每盆可容四十吧特。盆径四肘，在那十座上，每座安设一盆。

chapters.en: He placed five of the stands on the south side of the temple and five on the north. He placed the Sea on the south side, at the southeast corner of the temple.
chapters.zh: 五个安在殿门的右边，五个放在殿门的左边。又将海放在殿门的右旁，就是南边。

chapters.en: He also made the pots and shovels and sprinkling bowls. So Huram finished all the work he had undertaken for King Solomon in the temple of the LORD:
chapters.zh: 户兰又造了盆，铲子，和盘子。这样，他为所罗门王作完了耶和华殿的一切工。

chapters.en: the two pillars; the two bowl-shaped capitals on top of the pillars; the two sets of network decorating the two bowl-shaped capitals on top of the pillars;
chapters.zh: 所造的就是，两根柱子和柱上两个如球的顶。并两个盖柱顶的网子。

chapters.en: the four hundred pomegranates for the two sets of network (two rows of pomegranates for each network decorating the bowl-shaped capitals on top of the pillars);
chapters.zh: 和四百石榴，安在两个网子上，每网两行，盖着两个柱上如球的顶。

chapters.en: the ten stands with their ten basins;
chapters.zh: 十个座和其上的十个盆。

chapters.en: the Sea and the twelve bulls under it;
chapters.zh: 海和海下的十二只牛。

chapters.en: the pots, shovels and sprinkling bowls. All these objects that Huram made for King Solomon for the temple of the LORD were of burnished bronze.
chapters.zh: 盆，铲子，盘子。这一切都是户兰给所罗门王用光亮的铜为耶和华的殿造成的，

chapters.en: The king had them cast in clay molds in the plain of the Jordan between Sukkoth and Zarethan.
chapters.zh: 是遵王命在约旦平原，疏割和撒拉但中间借胶泥铸成的。

chapters.en: Solomon left all these things unweighed, because there were so many; the weight of the bronze was not determined.
chapters.zh: 这一切所罗门都没有过秤。因为甚多，铜的轻重也无法可查。

chapters.en: Solomon also made all the furnishings that were in the LORD’s temple: the golden altar; the golden table on which was the bread of the Presence;
chapters.zh: 所罗门又造耶和华殿里的金坛和陈设饼的金桌子。

chapters.en: the lampstands of pure gold (five on the right and five on the left, in front of the inner sanctuary); the gold floral work and lamps and tongs;
chapters.zh: 内殿前的精金灯台，右边五个，左边五个，并其上的金花，灯盏，蜡剪，

chapters.en: the pure gold basins, wick trimmers, sprinkling bowls, dishes and censers; and the gold sockets for the doors of the innermost room, the Most Holy Place, and also for the doors of the main hall of the temple.
chapters.zh: 与精金的杯，盘，镊子，调羹，火鼎，以及至圣所，内殿的门枢，和外殿的门枢。

chapters.en: When all the work King Solomon had done for the temple of the LORD was finished, he brought in the things his father David had dedicated—the silver and gold and the furnishings—and he placed them in the treasuries of the LORD’s temple.
chapters.zh: 所罗门王作完了耶和华殿的一切工，就把他父大卫分别为圣的金银和器皿都带来放在耶和华殿的府库里。

chapters.en: Then King Solomon summoned into his presence at Jerusalem the elders of Israel, all the heads of the tribes and the chiefs of the Israelite families, to bring up the ark of the LORD’s covenant from Zion, the City of David.
chapters.zh: 那时，所罗门将以色列的长老和各支派的首领，并以色列的族长，招聚到耶路撒冷，要把耶和华的约柜从大卫城就是锡安运上来。

chapters.en: All the Israelites came together to King Solomon at the time of the festival in the month of Ethanim, the seventh month.
chapters.zh: 以他念月，就是七月，在节前，以色列人都聚集到所罗门王那里。

chapters.en: When all the elders of Israel had arrived, the priests took up the ark,
chapters.zh: 以色列长老来到，祭司便抬起约柜，

chapters.en: and they brought up the ark of the LORD and the tent of meeting and all the sacred furnishings in it. The priests and Levites carried them up,
chapters.zh: 祭司和利未人将耶和华的约柜运上来，又将会幕和会幕的一切圣器具都带上来。

chapters.en: and King Solomon and the entire assembly of Israel that had gathered about him were before the ark, sacrificing so many sheep and cattle that they could not be recorded or counted.
chapters.zh: 所罗门王和聚集到他那里的以色列全会众，一同在约柜前献牛羊为祭，多得不可胜数。

chapters.en: The priests then brought the ark of the LORD’s covenant to its place in the inner sanctuary of the temple, the Most Holy Place, and put it beneath the wings of the cherubim.
chapters.zh: 祭司将耶和华的约柜抬进内殿，就是至圣所，放在两个基路伯的翅膀底下。

chapters.en: The cherubim spread their wings over the place of the ark and overshadowed the ark and its carrying poles.
chapters.zh: 基路伯张着翅膀在约柜之上，遮掩约柜和抬柜的杠。

chapters.en: These poles were so long that their ends could be seen from the Holy Place in front of the inner sanctuary, but not from outside the Holy Place; and they are still there today.
chapters.zh: 这杠甚长，杠头在内殿前的圣所可以看见，在殿外却不能看见，直到如今还在那里。

chapters.en: There was nothing in the ark except the two stone tablets that Moses had placed in it at Horeb, where the LORD made a covenant with the Israelites after they came out of Egypt.
chapters.zh: 约柜里惟有两块石版，就是以色列人出埃及地后，耶和华与他们立约的时候摩西在何烈山所放的。除此以外，并无别物。

chapters.en: When the priests withdrew from the Holy Place, the cloud filled the temple of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 祭司从圣所出来的时候，有云充满耶和华的殿。

chapters.en: And the priests could not perform their service because of the cloud, for the glory of the LORD filled his temple.
chapters.zh: 甚至祭司不能站立供职，因为耶和华的荣光充满了殿。

chapters.en: Then Solomon said, “The LORD has said that he would dwell in a dark cloud;
chapters.zh: 那时所罗门说，耶和华曾说，他必住在幽暗之处。

chapters.en: I have indeed built a magnificent temple for you, a place for you to dwell forever.”
chapters.zh: 我已经建造殿宇作你的居所，为你永远的住处。

chapters.en: While the whole assembly of Israel was standing there, the king turned around and blessed them.
chapters.zh: 王转脸为以色列会众祝福，以色列会众就都站立。

chapters.en: Then he said: “Praise be to the LORD, the God of Israel, who with his own hand has fulfilled what he promised with his own mouth to my father David. For he said,
chapters.zh: 所罗门说，耶和华以色列的神是应当称颂的。因他亲口向我父大卫所应许的，也亲手成就了。

chapters.en: ‘Since the day I brought my people Israel out of Egypt, I have not chosen a city in any tribe of Israel to have a temple built so that my Name might be there, but I have chosen David to rule my people Israel.’
chapters.zh: 他说，自从我领我民以色列出埃及以来，我未曾在以色列各支派中选择一城建造殿宇为我名的居所，但拣选大卫治理我民以色列。

chapters.en: “My father David had it in his heart to build a temple for the Name of the LORD, the God of Israel.
chapters.zh: 所罗门说，我父大卫曾立意，要为耶和华以色列神的名建殿。

chapters.en: But the LORD said to my father David, ‘You did well to have it in your heart to build a temple for my Name.
chapters.zh: 耶和华却对我父大卫说，你立意为我的名建殿，这意思甚好。

chapters.en: Nevertheless, you are not the one to build the temple, but your son, your own flesh and blood—he is the one who will build the temple for my Name.’
chapters.zh: 只是你不可建殿，惟你所生的儿子必为我名建殿。

chapters.en: “The LORD has kept the promise he made: I have succeeded David my father and now I sit on the throne of Israel, just as the LORD promised, and I have built the temple for the Name of the LORD, the God of Israel.
chapters.zh: 现在耶和华成就了他所应许的话，使我接续我父大卫坐以色列的国位，又为耶和华以色列神的名建造了殿。

chapters.en: I have provided a place there for the ark, in which is the covenant of the LORD that he made with our ancestors when he brought them out of Egypt.”
chapters.zh: 我也在其中为约柜预备一处。约柜内有耶和华的约，就是他领我们列祖出埃及地的时候，与他们所立的约。

chapters.en: Then Solomon stood before the altar of the LORD in front of the whole assembly of Israel, spread out his hands toward heaven
chapters.zh: 所罗门当着以色列会众，站在耶和华的坛前，向天举手说，

chapters.en: and said: “LORD, the God of Israel, there is no God like you in heaven above or on earth below—you who keep your covenant of love with your servants who continue wholeheartedly in your way.
chapters.zh: 耶和华以色列的神阿，天上地下没有神可比你的。你向那尽心行在你面前的仆人守约施慈爱。

chapters.en: You have kept your promise to your servant David my father; with your mouth you have promised and with your hand you have fulfilled it—as it is today.
chapters.zh: 向你仆人我父大卫所应许的话现在应验了。你亲口应许，亲手成就，正如今日一样。

chapters.en: “Now LORD, the God of Israel, keep for your servant David my father the promises you made to him when you said, ‘You shall never fail to have a successor to sit before me on the throne of Israel, if only your descendants are careful in all they do to walk before me faithfully as you have done.’
chapters.zh: 耶和华以色列的神阿，你所应许你仆人我父大卫的话说，你的子孙若谨慎自己的行为，在我面前行事象你所行的一样，就不断人坐以色列的国位。现在求你应验这话。

chapters.en: And now, God of Israel, let your word that you promised your servant David my father come true.
chapters.zh: 以色列的神阿，求你成就向你仆人我父大卫所应许的话。

chapters.en: “But will God really dwell on earth? The heavens, even the highest heaven, cannot contain you. How much less this temple I have built!
chapters.zh: 神果真住在地上吗？看哪，天和天上的天尚且不足你居住的，何况我所建的这殿呢？

chapters.en: Yet give attention to your servant’s prayer and his plea for mercy, LORD my God. Hear the cry and the prayer that your servant is praying in your presence this day.
chapters.zh: 惟求耶和华我的神垂顾仆人的祷告祈求，俯听仆人今日在你面前的祈祷呼吁。

chapters.en: May your eyes be open toward this temple night and day, this place of which you said, ‘My Name shall be there,’ so that you will hear the prayer your servant prays toward this place.
chapters.zh: 愿你昼夜看顾这殿，就是你应许立为你名的居所。求你垂听仆人向此处祷告的话。

chapters.en: Hear the supplication of your servant and of your people Israel when they pray toward this place. Hear from heaven, your dwelling place, and when you hear, forgive.
chapters.zh: 你仆人和你民以色列向此处祈祷的时候，求你在天上你的居所垂听，垂听而赦免。

chapters.en: “When anyone wrongs their neighbor and is required to take an oath and they come and swear the oath before your altar in this temple,
chapters.zh: 人若得罪邻舍，有人叫他起誓，他来到这殿在你的坛前起誓，

chapters.en: then hear from heaven and act. Judge between your servants, condemning the guilty by bringing down on their heads what they have done, and vindicating the innocent by treating them in accordance with their innocence.
chapters.zh: 求你在天上垂听，判断你的仆人，定恶人有罪，照他所行的报应在他头上。定义人有理，照他的义赏赐他。

chapters.en: “When your people Israel have been defeated by an enemy because they have sinned against you, and when they turn back to you and give praise to your name, praying and making supplication to you in this temple,
chapters.zh: 你的民以色列若得罪你，败在仇敌面前，又归向你，承认你的名，在这殿里祈求祷告，

chapters.en: then hear from heaven and forgive the sin of your people Israel and bring them back to the land you gave to their ancestors.
chapters.zh: 求你在天上垂听，赦免你民以色列的罪，使他们归回你赐给他们列祖之地。

chapters.en: “When the heavens are shut up and there is no rain because your people have sinned against you, and when they pray toward this place and give praise to your name and turn from their sin because you have afflicted them,
chapters.zh: 你的民因得罪你，你惩罚他们，使天闭塞不下雨。他们若向此处祷告，承认你的名，离开他们的罪，

chapters.en: then hear from heaven and forgive the sin of your servants, your people Israel. Teach them the right way to live, and send rain on the land you gave your people for an inheritance.
chapters.zh: 求你在天上垂听，赦免你仆人以色列民的罪，将当行的善道指教他们，且降雨在你的地，就是你赐给你民为业之地。

chapters.en: “When famine or plague comes to the land, or blight or mildew, locusts or grasshoppers, or when an enemy besieges them in any of their cities, whatever disaster or disease may come,
chapters.zh: 国中若有饥荒，瘟疫，旱风，霉烂，蝗虫，蚂蚱，或有仇敌犯境围困城邑，无论遭遇什么灾祸疾病，

chapters.en: and when a prayer or plea is made by anyone among your people Israel—being aware of the afflictions of their own hearts, and spreading out their hands toward this temple—
chapters.zh: 你的民以色列，或是众人，或是一人，自觉有罪（原文作灾），向这殿举手，无论祈求什么，祷告什么，

chapters.en: then hear from heaven, your dwelling place. Forgive and act; deal with everyone according to all they do, since you know their hearts (for you alone know every human heart),
chapters.zh: 求你在天上你的居所垂听赦免。你是知道人心的，要照各人所行的待他们，（惟有你知道世人的心），

chapters.en: so that they will fear you all the time they live in the land you gave our ancestors.
chapters.zh: 使他们在你赐给我们列祖之地上一生一世敬畏你。

chapters.en: “As for the foreigner who does not belong to your people Israel but has come from a distant land because of your name—
chapters.zh: 论到不属你民以色列的外邦人，为你名从远方而来，

chapters.en: for they will hear of your great name and your mighty hand and your outstretched arm—when they come and pray toward this temple,
chapters.zh: （他们听人论说你的大名和大能的手，并伸出来的膀臂）向这殿祷告，

chapters.en: then hear from heaven, your dwelling place. Do whatever the foreigner asks of you, so that all the peoples of the earth may know your name and fear you, as do your own people Israel, and may know that this house I have built bears your Name.
chapters.zh: 求你在天上你的居所垂听，照着外邦人所祈求的而行，使天下万民都认识你的名，敬畏你象你的民以色列一样。又使他们知道我建造的这殿是称为你名下的。

chapters.en: “When your people go to war against their enemies, wherever you send them, and when they pray to the LORD toward the city you have chosen and the temple I have built for your Name,
chapters.zh: 你的民若奉你的差遣，无论往何处去与仇敌争战，向耶和华所选择的城与我为你名所建造的殿祷告，

chapters.en: then hear from heaven their prayer and their plea, and uphold their cause.
chapters.zh: 求你在天上垂听他们的祷告祈求，使他们得胜。

chapters.en: “When they sin against you—for there is no one who does not sin—and you become angry with them and give them over to their enemies, who take them captive to their own lands, far away or near;
chapters.zh: 你的民若得罪你（世上没有不犯罪的人），你向他们发怒，将他们交给仇敌掳到仇敌之地，或远或近，

chapters.en: and if they have a change of heart in the land where they are held captive, and repent and plead with you in the land of their captors and say, ‘We have sinned, we have done wrong, we have acted wickedly’;
chapters.zh: 他们若在掳到之地想起罪来，回心转意，恳求你说，我们有罪了，我们悖逆了，我们作恶了。

chapters.en: and if they turn back to you with all their heart and soul in the land of their enemies who took them captive, and pray to you toward the land you gave their ancestors, toward the city you have chosen and the temple I have built for your Name;
chapters.zh: 他们若在掳到之地尽心尽性归服你，又向自己的地，就是你赐给他们列祖之地和你所选择的城，并我为你名所建造的殿祷告，

chapters.en: then from heaven, your dwelling place, hear their prayer and their plea, and uphold their cause.
chapters.zh: 求你在天上你的居所垂听他们的祷告祈求，为他们伸冤。

chapters.en: And forgive your people, who have sinned against you; forgive all the offenses they have committed against you, and cause their captors to show them mercy;
chapters.zh: 饶恕得罪你的民，赦免他们的一切过犯，使他们在掳他们的人面前蒙怜恤。

chapters.en: for they are your people and your inheritance, whom you brought out of Egypt, out of that iron-smelting furnace.
chapters.zh: 因为他们是你的子民，你的产业，是你从埃及领出来脱离铁炉的。

chapters.en: “May your eyes be open to your servant’s plea and to the plea of your people Israel, and may you listen to them whenever they cry out to you.
chapters.zh: 愿你的眼目看顾仆人，听你民以色列的祈求，无论何时向你祈求，愿你垂听。

chapters.en: For you singled them out from all the nations of the world to be your own inheritance, just as you declared through your servant Moses when you, Sovereign LORD, brought our ancestors out of Egypt.”
chapters.zh: 主耶和华阿，你将他们从地上的万民中分别出来作你的产业，是照你领我们列祖出埃及的时候，借你仆人摩西所应许的话。

chapters.en: When Solomon had finished all these prayers and supplications to the LORD, he rose from before the altar of the LORD, where he had been kneeling with his hands spread out toward heaven.
chapters.zh: 所罗门在耶和华的坛前屈膝跪着，向天举手，在耶和华面前祷告祈求已毕，就起来，

chapters.en: He stood and blessed the whole assembly of Israel in a loud voice, saying:
chapters.zh: 站着，大声为以色列全会众祝福，说，

chapters.en: “Praise be to the LORD, who has given rest to his people Israel just as he promised. Not one word has failed of all the good promises he gave through his servant Moses.
chapters.zh: 耶和华是应当称颂的。因为他照着一切所应许的赐平安给他的民以色列人，凡借他仆人摩西应许赐福的话，一句都没有落空。

chapters.en: May the LORD our God be with us as he was with our ancestors; may he never leave us nor forsake us.
chapters.zh: 愿耶和华我们的神与我们同在，像与我们列祖同在一样，不撇下我们，不丢弃我们，

chapters.en: May he turn our hearts to him, to walk in obedience to him and keep the commands, decrees and laws he gave our ancestors.
chapters.zh: 使我们的心归向他，遵行他的道，谨守他吩咐我们列祖的诫命，律例，典章。

chapters.en: And may these words of mine, which I have prayed before the LORD, be near to the LORD our God day and night, that he may uphold the cause of his servant and the cause of his people Israel according to each day’s need,
chapters.zh: 我在耶和华面前祈求的这些话，愿耶和华我们的神昼夜垂念，每日为他仆人与他民以色列伸冤，

chapters.en: so that all the peoples of the earth may know that the LORD is God and that there is no other.
chapters.zh: 使地上的万民都知道惟独耶和华是神，并无别神。

chapters.en: And may your hearts be fully committed to the LORD our God, to live by his decrees and obey his commands, as at this time.”
chapters.zh: 所以你们当向耶和华我们的神存诚实的心，遵行他的律例，谨守他的诫命，至终如今日一样。

chapters.en: Then the king and all Israel with him offered sacrifices before the LORD.
chapters.zh: 王和以色列众民一同在耶和华面前献祭。

chapters.en: Solomon offered a sacrifice of fellowship offerings to the LORD: twenty-two thousand cattle and a hundred and twenty thousand sheep and goats. So the king and all the Israelites dedicated the temple of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 所罗门向耶和华献平安祭，用牛二万二千，羊十二万。这样，王和以色列众民为耶和华的殿行奉献之礼。

chapters.en: On that same day the king consecrated the middle part of the courtyard in front of the temple of the LORD, and there he offered burnt offerings, grain offerings and the fat of the fellowship offerings, because the bronze altar that stood before the LORD was too small to hold the burnt offerings, the grain offerings and the fat of the fellowship offerings.
chapters.zh: 当日，王因耶和华殿前的铜坛太小，容不下燔祭，素祭，和平安祭牲的脂油，便将耶和华殿前院子当中分别为圣，在那里献燔祭，素祭，和平安祭牲的脂油。

chapters.en: So Solomon observed the festival at that time, and all Israel with him—a vast assembly, people from Lebo Hamath to the Wadi of Egypt. They celebrated it before the LORD our God for seven days and seven days more, fourteen days in all.
chapters.zh: 那时，所罗门和以色列众人，就是从哈马口直到埃及小河所有的以色列人，都聚集成为大会，在耶和华我们的神面前守节七日又七日，共十四日。

chapters.en: On the following day he sent the people away. They blessed the king and then went home, joyful and glad in heart for all the good things the LORD had done for his servant David and his people Israel.
chapters.zh: 第八日，王遣散众民。他们都为王祝福。因见耶和华向他仆人大卫和他民以色列所施的一切恩惠，就都心中喜乐，各归各家去了。

chapters.en: When Solomon had finished building the temple of the LORD and the royal palace, and had achieved all he had desired to do,
chapters.zh: 所罗门建造耶和华殿和王宫，并一切所愿意建造的都完毕了，

chapters.en: the LORD appeared to him a second time, as he had appeared to him at Gibeon.
chapters.zh: 耶和华就二次向所罗门显现，如先前在基遍向他显现一样，

chapters.en: The LORD said to him: “I have heard the prayer and plea you have made before me; I have consecrated this temple, which you have built, by putting my Name there forever. My eyes and my heart will always be there.
chapters.zh: 对他说，你向我所祷告祈求的，我都应允了。我已将你所建的这殿分别为圣，使我的名永远在其中。我的眼，我的心也必常在那里。

chapters.en: “As for you, if you walk before me faithfully with integrity of heart and uprightness, as David your father did, and do all I command and observe my decrees and laws,
chapters.zh: 你若效法你父大卫，存诚实正直的心行在我面前，遵行我一切所吩咐你的，谨守我的律例典章，

chapters.en: I will establish your royal throne over Israel forever, as I promised David your father when I said, ‘You shall never fail to have a successor on the throne of Israel.’
chapters.zh: 我就必坚固你的国位在以色列中，直到永远，正如我应许你父大卫说，你的子孙必不断人坐以色列的国位。

chapters.en: “But if you or your descendants turn away from me and do not observe the commands and decrees I have given you and go off to serve other gods and worship them,
chapters.zh: 倘若你们和你们的子孙转去不跟从我，不守我指示你们的诫命律例，去事奉敬拜别神，

chapters.en: then I will cut off Israel from the land I have given them and will reject this temple I have consecrated for my Name. Israel will then become a byword and an object of ridicule among all peoples.
chapters.zh: 我就必将以色列人从我赐给他们的地上剪除，并且我为己名所分别为圣的殿也必舍弃不顾，使以色列人在万民中作笑谈，被讥诮。

chapters.en: This temple will become a heap of rubble. All who pass by will be appalled and will scoff and say, ‘Why has the LORD done such a thing to this land and to this temple?’
chapters.zh: 这殿虽然甚高，将来经过的人必惊讶，嗤笑，说，耶和华为何向这地和这殿如此行呢？

chapters.en: People will answer, ‘Because they have forsaken the LORD their God, who brought their ancestors out of Egypt, and have embraced other gods, worshiping and serving them—that is why the LORD brought all this disaster on them.’ ”
chapters.zh: 人必回答说，是因此地的人离弃领他们列祖出埃及地之耶和华他们的神，去亲近别神，事奉敬拜他，所以耶和华使这一切灾祸临到他们。

chapters.en: At the end of twenty years, during which Solomon built these two buildings—the temple of the LORD and the royal palace—
chapters.zh: 所罗门建造耶和华殿和王宫，这两所二十年才完毕了。

chapters.en: King Solomon gave twenty towns in Galilee to Hiram king of Tyre, because Hiram had supplied him with all the cedar and juniper and gold he wanted.
chapters.zh: （推罗王希兰曾照所罗门所要的，资助他香柏木，松木，和金子）所罗门王就把加利利地的二十座城给了希兰。

chapters.en: But when Hiram went from Tyre to see the towns that Solomon had given him, he was not pleased with them.
chapters.zh: 希兰从推罗出来，察看所罗门给他的城邑，就不喜悦，

chapters.en: “What kind of towns are these you have given me, my brother?” he asked. And he called them the Land of Kabul, a name they have to this day.
chapters.zh: 说，我兄阿，你给我的是什么城邑呢？他就给这城邑之地起名叫迦步勒，直到今日。

chapters.en: Now Hiram had sent to the king 120 talents of gold.
chapters.zh: 希兰给所罗门一百二十他连得金子。

chapters.en: Here is the account of the forced labor King Solomon conscripted to build the LORD’s temple, his own palace, the terraces, the wall of Jerusalem, and Hazor, Megiddo and Gezer.
chapters.zh: 所罗门王挑取服苦的人，是为建造耶和华的殿，自己的宫，米罗，耶路撒冷的城墙，夏琐，米吉多，并基色。

chapters.en: (Pharaoh king of Egypt had attacked and captured Gezer. He had set it on fire. He killed its Canaanite inhabitants and then gave it as a wedding gift to his daughter, Solomon’s wife.
chapters.zh: 先前埃及王法老上来攻取基色，用火焚烧，杀了城内居住的迦南人，将城赐给他女儿所罗门的妻作妆奁。

chapters.en: And Solomon rebuilt Gezer.) He built up Lower Beth Horon,
chapters.zh: 所罗门建造基色，下伯和仑，

chapters.en: Baalath, and Tadmor in the desert, within his land,
chapters.zh: 巴拉，并国中旷野里的达莫，

chapters.en: as well as all his store cities and the towns for his chariots and for his horses —whatever he desired to build in Jerusalem, in Lebanon and throughout all the territory he ruled.
chapters.zh: 又建造所有的积货城，并屯车和马兵的城，与耶路撒冷，利巴嫩，以及自己治理的全国中所愿建造的。

chapters.en: There were still people left from the Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites, Hivites and Jebusites (these peoples were not Israelites).
chapters.zh: 至于国中所剩下不属以色列人的亚摩利人，赫人，比利洗人，希未人，耶布斯人，

chapters.en: Solomon conscripted the descendants of all these peoples remaining in the land—whom the Israelites could not exterminate —to serve as slave labor, as it is to this day.
chapters.zh: 就是以色列人不能灭尽的，所罗门挑取他们的后裔作服苦的奴仆，直到今日。

chapters.en: But Solomon did not make slaves of any of the Israelites; they were his fighting men, his government officials, his officers, his captains, and the commanders of his chariots and charioteers.
chapters.zh: 惟有以色列人，所罗门不使他们作奴仆，乃是作他的战士，臣仆，统领，军长，车兵长，马兵长。

chapters.en: They were also the chief officials in charge of Solomon’s projects—550 officials supervising those who did the work.
chapters.zh: 所罗门有五百五十督工的，监管工人。

chapters.en: After Pharaoh’s daughter had come up from the City of David to the palace Solomon had built for her, he constructed the terraces.
chapters.zh: 法老的女儿从大卫城搬到所罗门为她建造的宫里。那时，所罗门才建造米罗。

chapters.en: Three times a year Solomon sacrificed burnt offerings and fellowship offerings on the altar he had built for the LORD, burning incense before the LORD along with them, and so fulfilled the temple obligations.
chapters.zh: 所罗门每年三次在他为耶和华所筑的坛上献燔祭和平安祭，又在耶和华面前的坛上烧香。这样，他建造殿的工程完毕了。

chapters.en: King Solomon also built ships at Ezion Geber, which is near Elath in Edom, on the shore of the Red Sea.
chapters.zh: 所罗门王在以东地红海边，靠近以禄的以旬迦别制造船只。

chapters.en: And Hiram sent his men—sailors who knew the sea—to serve in the fleet with Solomon’s men.
chapters.zh: 希兰差遣他的仆人，就是熟悉泛海的船家，与所罗门的仆人一同坐船航海。

chapters.en: They sailed to Ophir and brought back 420 talents of gold, which they delivered to King Solomon.
chapters.zh: 他们到了俄斐，从那里得了四百二十他连得金子，运到所罗门王那里。

chapters.en: When the queen of Sheba heard about the fame of Solomon and his relationship to the LORD, she came to test Solomon with hard questions.
chapters.zh: 示巴女王听见所罗门因耶和华之名所得的名声，就来要用难解的话试问所罗门。

chapters.en: Arriving at Jerusalem with a very great caravan—with camels carrying spices, large quantities of gold, and precious stones—she came to Solomon and talked with him about all that she had on her mind.
chapters.zh: 跟随她到耶路撒冷的人甚多，又有骆驼驮着香料，宝石，和许多金子。她来见了所罗门王，就把心里所有的对所罗门都说出来。

chapters.en: Solomon answered all her questions; nothing was too hard for the king to explain to her.
chapters.zh: 所罗门王将她所问的都答上了，没有一句不明白，不能答的。

chapters.en: When the queen of Sheba saw all the wisdom of Solomon and the palace he had built,
chapters.zh: 示巴女王见所罗门大有智慧，和他所建造的宫室，

chapters.en: the food on his table, the seating of his officials, the attending servants in their robes, his cupbearers, and the burnt offerings he made at the temple of the LORD, she was overwhelmed.
chapters.zh: 席上的珍馐美味，群臣分列而坐，仆人两旁侍立，以及他们的衣服装饰和酒政的衣服装饰，又见他上耶和华殿的台阶（或作他在耶和华殿里所献的燔祭），就诧异得神不守舍。

chapters.en: She said to the king, “The report I heard in my own country about your achievements and your wisdom is true.
chapters.zh: 对王说，我在本国里所听见论到你的事和你的智慧实在是真的。

chapters.en: But I did not believe these things until I came and saw with my own eyes. Indeed, not even half was told me; in wisdom and wealth you have far exceeded the report I heard.
chapters.zh: 我先不信那些话，及至我来亲眼见了才知道人所告诉我的还不到一半。你的智慧和你的福分越过我所听见的风声。

chapters.en: How happy your people must be! How happy your officials, who continually stand before you and hear your wisdom!
chapters.zh: 你的臣子，你的仆人常侍立在你面前听你智慧的话是有福的。

chapters.en: Praise be to the LORD your God, who has delighted in you and placed you on the throne of Israel. Because of the LORD’s eternal love for Israel, he has made you king to maintain justice and righteousness.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华你的神是应当称颂的。他喜悦你，使你坐以色列的国位。因为他永远爱以色列，所以立你作王，使你秉公行义。

chapters.en: And she gave the king 120 talents of gold, large quantities of spices, and precious stones. Never again were so many spices brought in as those the queen of Sheba gave to King Solomon.
chapters.zh: 于是，示巴女王将一百二十他连得金子和宝石，与极多的香料，送给所罗门王。她送给王的香料，以后奉来的不再有这样多。

chapters.en: (Hiram’s ships brought gold from Ophir; and from there they brought great cargoes of almugwood and precious stones.
chapters.zh: 希兰的船只从俄斐运了金子来，又从俄斐运了许多檀香木（或作乌木下同）和宝石来。

chapters.en: The king used the almugwood to make supports for the temple of the LORD and for the royal palace, and to make harps and lyres for the musicians. So much almugwood has never been imported or seen since that day.)
chapters.zh: 王用檀香木为耶和华殿和王宫作栏杆，又为歌唱的人作琴瑟。以后再没有这样的檀香木进国来，也没有人看见过，直到如今。

chapters.en: King Solomon gave the queen of Sheba all she desired and asked for, besides what he had given her out of his royal bounty. Then she left and returned with her retinue to her own country.
chapters.zh: 示巴女王一切所要所求的，所罗门王都送给她，另外照自己的厚意馈送她。于是女王和她臣仆转回本国去了。

chapters.en: The weight of the gold that Solomon received yearly was 666 talents,
chapters.zh: 所罗门每年所得的金子共有六百六十六他连得。

chapters.en: not including the revenues from merchants and traders and from all the Arabian kings and the governors of the territories.
chapters.zh: 另外还有商人和杂族的诸王，与国中的省长，所进的金子。（杂族在历代下九章十四节作亚拉伯）

chapters.en: King Solomon made two hundred large shields of hammered gold; six hundred shekels of gold went into each shield.
chapters.zh: 所罗门王用锤出来的金子打成挡牌二百面，每面用金子六百舍客勒。

chapters.en: He also made three hundred small shields of hammered gold, with three minas of gold in each shield. The king put them in the Palace of the Forest of Lebanon.
chapters.zh: 又用锤出来的金子打成盾牌三百面，每面用金子三弥那，都放在利巴嫩林宫里。

chapters.en: Then the king made a great throne covered with ivory and overlaid with fine gold.
chapters.zh: 王用象牙制造一个宝座，用精金包裹。

chapters.en: The throne had six steps, and its back had a rounded top. On both sides of the seat were armrests, with a lion standing beside each of them.
chapters.zh: 宝座有六层台阶，座的后背是圆的，两旁有扶手，靠近扶手有两个狮子站立。

chapters.en: Twelve lions stood on the six steps, one at either end of each step. Nothing like it had ever been made for any other kingdom.
chapters.zh: 六层台阶上有十二个狮子站立，每层有两个，左边一个，右边一个。在列国中没有这样作的。

chapters.en: All King Solomon’s goblets were gold, and all the household articles in the Palace of the Forest of Lebanon were pure gold. Nothing was made of silver, because silver was considered of little value in Solomon’s days.
chapters.zh: 所罗门王一切的饮器都是金子的。利巴嫩林宫里的一切器皿都是精金的。所罗门年间，银子算不了什么。

chapters.en: The king had a fleet of trading ships at sea along with the ships of Hiram. Once every three years it returned, carrying gold, silver and ivory, and apes and baboons.
chapters.zh: 因为王有他施船只与希兰的船只一同航海，三年一次，装载金银，象牙，猿猴，孔雀回来。

chapters.en: King Solomon was greater in riches and wisdom than all the other kings of the earth.
chapters.zh: 所罗门王的财宝与智慧胜过天下的列王。

chapters.en: The whole world sought audience with Solomon to hear the wisdom God had put in his heart.
chapters.zh: 普天下的王都求见所罗门，要听神赐给他智慧的话。

chapters.en: Year after year, everyone who came brought a gift—articles of silver and gold, robes, weapons and spices, and horses and mules.
chapters.zh: 他们各带贡物，就是金器，银器，衣服，军械，香料，骡马，每年有一定之例。

chapters.en: Solomon accumulated chariots and horses; he had fourteen hundred chariots and twelve thousand horses, which he kept in the chariot cities and also with him in Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 所罗门聚集战车马兵，有战车一千四百辆，马兵一万二千名，安置在屯车的城邑和耶路撒冷，就是王那里。

chapters.en: The king made silver as common in Jerusalem as stones, and cedar as plentiful as sycamore-fig trees in the foothills.
chapters.zh: 王在耶路撒冷使银子多如石头，香柏木多如高原的桑树。

chapters.en: Solomon’s horses were imported from Egypt and from Kue —the royal merchants purchased them from Kue at the current price.
chapters.zh: 所罗门的马是从埃及带来的，是王的商人一群一群按着定价买来的。

chapters.en: They imported a chariot from Egypt for six hundred shekels of silver, and a horse for a hundred and fifty. They also exported them to all the kings of the Hittites and of the Arameans.
chapters.zh: 从埃及买来的车，每辆价银六百舍客勒，马每匹一百五十舍客勒。赫人诸王和亚兰诸王所买的车马，也是按这价值经他们手买来的。

chapters.en: King Solomon, however, loved many foreign women besides Pharaoh’s daughter—Moabites, Ammonites, Edomites, Sidonians and Hittites.
chapters.zh: 所罗门王在法老的女儿之外，又宠爱许多外邦女子，就是摩押女子，亚扪女子，以东女子，西顿女子，赫人女子。

chapters.en: They were from nations about which the LORD had told the Israelites, “You must not intermarry with them, because they will surely turn your hearts after their gods.” Nevertheless, Solomon held fast to them in love.
chapters.zh: 论到这些国的人，耶和华曾晓谕以色列人说，你们不可与她们往来相通，因为她们必诱惑你们的心去随从她们的神。所罗门却恋爱这些女子。

chapters.en: He had seven hundred wives of royal birth and three hundred concubines, and his wives led him astray.
chapters.zh: 所罗门有妃七百，都是公主。还有嫔三百。这些妃嫔诱惑他的心。

chapters.en: As Solomon grew old, his wives turned his heart after other gods, and his heart was not fully devoted to the LORD his God, as the heart of David his father had been.
chapters.zh: 所罗门年老的时候，他的妃嫔诱惑他的心去随从别神，不效法他父亲大卫诚诚实实地顺服耶和华他的神。

chapters.en: He followed Ashtoreth the goddess of the Sidonians, and Molek the detestable god of the Ammonites.
chapters.zh: 因为所罗门随从西顿人的女神亚斯他录和亚扪人可憎的神米勒公。

chapters.en: So Solomon did evil in the eyes of the LORD; he did not follow the LORD completely, as David his father had done.
chapters.zh: 所罗门行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，不效法他父亲大卫专心顺从耶和华。

chapters.en: On a hill east of Jerusalem, Solomon built a high place for Chemosh the detestable god of Moab, and for Molek the detestable god of the Ammonites.
chapters.zh: 所罗门为摩押可憎的神基抹和亚扪人可憎的神摩洛，在耶路撒冷对面的山上建筑丘坛。

chapters.en: He did the same for all his foreign wives, who burned incense and offered sacrifices to their gods.
chapters.zh: 他为那些向自己的神烧香献祭的外邦女子，就是他娶来的妃嫔也是这样行。

chapters.en: The LORD became angry with Solomon because his heart had turned away from the LORD, the God of Israel, who had appeared to him twice.
chapters.zh: 耶和华向所罗门发怒，因为他的心偏离向他两次显现的耶和华以色列的神。

chapters.en: Although he had forbidden Solomon to follow other gods, Solomon did not keep the LORD’s command.
chapters.zh: 耶和华曾吩咐他不可随从别神，他却没有遵守耶和华所吩咐的。

chapters.en: So the LORD said to Solomon, “Since this is your attitude and you have not kept my covenant and my decrees, which I commanded you, I will most certainly tear the kingdom away from you and give it to one of your subordinates.
chapters.zh: 所以耶和华对他说，你既行了这事，不遵守我所吩咐你守的约和律例，我必将你的国夺回，赐给你的臣子。

chapters.en: Nevertheless, for the sake of David your father, I will not do it during your lifetime. I will tear it out of the hand of your son.
chapters.zh: 然而，因你父亲大卫的缘故，我不在你活着的日子行这事，必从你儿子的手中将国夺回。

chapters.en: Yet I will not tear the whole kingdom from him, but will give him one tribe for the sake of David my servant and for the sake of Jerusalem, which I have chosen.”
chapters.zh: 只是我不将全国夺回，要因我仆人大卫和我所选择的耶路撒冷，还留一支派给你的儿子。

chapters.en: Then the LORD raised up against Solomon an adversary, Hadad the Edomite, from the royal line of Edom.
chapters.zh: 耶和华使以东人哈达兴起，作所罗门的敌人。他是以东王的后裔。

chapters.en: Earlier when David was fighting with Edom, Joab the commander of the army, who had gone up to bury the dead, had struck down all the men in Edom.
chapters.zh: 先前大卫攻击以东，元帅约押上去葬埋阵亡的人，将以东的男丁都杀了。

chapters.en: Joab and all the Israelites stayed there for six months, until they had destroyed all the men in Edom.
chapters.zh: 约押和以色列众人在以东住了六个月，直到将以东的男丁尽都剪除。

chapters.en: But Hadad, still only a boy, fled to Egypt with some Edomite officials who had served his father.
chapters.zh: 那时哈达还是幼童。他和他父亲的臣仆，几个以东人逃往埃及。

chapters.en: They set out from Midian and went to Paran. Then taking people from Paran with them, they went to Egypt, to Pharaoh king of Egypt, who gave Hadad a house and land and provided him with food.
chapters.zh: 他们从米甸起行，到了巴兰。从巴兰带着几个人来到埃及见埃及王法老。法老为他派定粮食，又给他房屋田地。

chapters.en: Pharaoh was so pleased with Hadad that he gave him a sister of his own wife, Queen Tahpenes, in marriage.
chapters.zh: 哈达在法老面前大蒙恩惠，以致法老将王后答比匿的妹子赐他为妻。

chapters.en: The sister of Tahpenes bore him a son named Genubath, whom Tahpenes brought up in the royal palace. There Genubath lived with Pharaoh’s own children.
chapters.zh: 答比匿的妹子给哈达生了一个儿子，名叫基努拔。答比匿使基努拔在法老的宫里断奶，基努拔就与法老的众子一同住在法老的宫里。

chapters.en: While he was in Egypt, Hadad heard that David rested with his ancestors and that Joab the commander of the army was also dead. Then Hadad said to Pharaoh, “Let me go, that I may return to my own country.”
chapters.zh: 哈达在埃及听见大卫与他列祖同睡，元帅约押也死了，就对法老说，求王容我回本国去。

chapters.en: “What have you lacked here that you want to go back to your own country?” Pharaoh asked. “Nothing,” Hadad replied, “but do let me go!”
chapters.zh: 法老对他说，你在我这里有什么缺乏，你竟要回你本国去呢？他回答说，我没有缺乏什么，只是求王容我回去。

chapters.en: And God raised up against Solomon another adversary, Rezon son of Eliada, who had fled from his master, Hadadezer king of Zobah.
chapters.zh: 神又使以利亚大的儿子利逊兴起，作所罗门的敌人。他先前逃避主人琐巴王哈大底谢。

chapters.en: When David destroyed Zobah’s army, Rezon gathered a band of men around him and became their leader; they went to Damascus, where they settled and took control.
chapters.zh: 大卫击杀琐巴人的时候，利逊招聚了一群人，自己作他们的头目，往大马色居住，在那里作王。

chapters.en: Rezon was Israel’s adversary as long as Solomon lived, adding to the trouble caused by Hadad. So Rezon ruled in Aram and was hostile toward Israel.
chapters.zh: 所罗门活着的时候，哈达为患之外，利逊也作以色列的敌人。他恨恶以色列人，且作了亚兰人的王。

chapters.en: Also, Jeroboam son of Nebat rebelled against the king. He was one of Solomon’s officials, an Ephraimite from Zeredah, and his mother was a widow named Zeruah.
chapters.zh: 所罗门的臣仆，尼八的儿子耶罗波安也举手攻击王。他是以法莲支派的洗利达人，他母亲是寡妇，名叫洗鲁阿。

chapters.en: Here is the account of how he rebelled against the king: Solomon had built the terraces and had filled in the gap in the wall of the city of David his father.
chapters.zh: 他举手攻击王的缘故，乃由先前所罗门建造米罗，修补他父亲大卫城的破口。

chapters.en: Now Jeroboam was a man of standing, and when Solomon saw how well the young man did his work, he put him in charge of the whole labor force of the tribes of Joseph.
chapters.zh: 耶罗波安是大有才能的人。所罗门见这少年人殷勤，就派他监管约瑟家的一切工程。

chapters.en: About that time Jeroboam was going out of Jerusalem, and Ahijah the prophet of Shiloh met him on the way, wearing a new cloak. The two of them were alone out in the country,
chapters.zh: 一日，耶罗波安出了耶路撒冷，示罗人先知亚希雅在路上遇见他。亚希雅身上穿着一件新衣。他们二人在田野，以外并无别人。

chapters.en: and Ahijah took hold of the new cloak he was wearing and tore it into twelve pieces.
chapters.zh: 亚希雅将自己穿的那件新衣撕成十二片，

chapters.en: Then he said to Jeroboam, “Take ten pieces for yourself, for this is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: ‘See, I am going to tear the kingdom out of Solomon’s hand and give you ten tribes.
chapters.zh: 对耶罗波安说，你可以拿十片。耶和华以色列的神如此说，我必将国从所罗门手里夺回，将十个支派赐给你。
