chapters.en: But for the sake of my servant David and the city of Jerusalem, which I have chosen out of all the tribes of Israel, he will have one tribe.
chapters.zh: （我因仆人大卫和我在以色列众支派中所选择的耶路撒冷城的缘故，仍给所罗门留一个支派。）

chapters.en: I will do this because they have forsaken me and worshiped Ashtoreth the goddess of the Sidonians, Chemosh the god of the Moabites, and Molek the god of the Ammonites, and have not walked in obedience to me, nor done what is right in my eyes, nor kept my decrees and laws as David, Solomon’s father, did.
chapters.zh: 因为他离弃我，敬拜西顿人的女神亚斯他录，摩押的神基抹，和亚扪人的神米勒公，没有遵从我的道，行我眼中看为正的事，守我的律例典章，像他父亲大卫一样。

chapters.en: “ ‘But I will not take the whole kingdom out of Solomon’s hand; I have made him ruler all the days of his life for the sake of David my servant, whom I chose and who obeyed my commands and decrees.
chapters.zh: 但我不从他手里将全国夺回。使他终身为君，是因我所拣选的仆人大卫谨守我的诫命律例。

chapters.en: I will take the kingdom from his son’s hands and give you ten tribes.
chapters.zh: 我必从他儿子的手里将国夺回，以十个支派赐给你，

chapters.en: I will give one tribe to his son so that David my servant may always have a lamp before me in Jerusalem, the city where I chose to put my Name.
chapters.zh: 还留一个支派给他的儿子，使我仆人大卫在我所选择立我名的耶路撒冷城里，在我面前长有灯光。

chapters.en: However, as for you, I will take you, and you will rule over all that your heart desires; you will be king over Israel.
chapters.zh: 我必拣选你，使你照心里一切所愿的，作王治理以色列。

chapters.en: If you do whatever I command you and walk in obedience to me and do what is right in my eyes by obeying my decrees and commands, as David my servant did, I will be with you. I will build you a dynasty as enduring as the one I built for David and will give Israel to you.
chapters.zh: 你若听从我一切所吩咐你的，遵行我的道，行我眼中看为正的事，谨守我的律例诫命，像我仆人大卫所行的，我就与你同在，为你立坚固的家，像我为大卫所立的一样，将以色列人赐给你。

chapters.en: I will humble David’s descendants because of this, but not forever.’ ”
chapters.zh: 我必因所罗门所行的使大卫后裔受患难，但不至于永远。

chapters.en: Solomon tried to kill Jeroboam, but Jeroboam fled to Egypt, to Shishak the king, and stayed there until Solomon’s death.
chapters.zh: 所罗门因此想要杀耶罗波安。耶罗波安却起身逃往埃及。到了埃及王示撒那里，就住在埃及，直到所罗门死了。

chapters.en: As for the other events of Solomon’s reign—all he did and the wisdom he displayed—are they not written in the book of the annals of Solomon?
chapters.zh: 所罗门其余的事，凡他所行的和他的智慧都写在所罗门记上。

chapters.en: Solomon reigned in Jerusalem over all Israel forty years.
chapters.zh: 所罗门在耶路撒冷作以色列众人的王共四十年。

chapters.en: Then he rested with his ancestors and was buried in the city of David his father. And Rehoboam his son succeeded him as king.
chapters.zh: 所罗门与他列祖同睡，葬在他父亲大卫的城里。他儿子罗波安接续他作王。

chapters.en: Rehoboam went to Shechem, for all Israel had gone there to make him king.
chapters.zh: 罗波安往示剑去。因为以色列人都到了示剑要立他作王。

chapters.en: When Jeroboam son of Nebat heard this (he was still in Egypt, where he had fled from King Solomon), he returned from Egypt.
chapters.zh: 尼八的儿子耶罗波安先前躲避所罗门王，逃往埃及，住在那里（他听见这事。）

chapters.en: So they sent for Jeroboam, and he and the whole assembly of Israel went to Rehoboam and said to him:
chapters.zh: 以色列人打发人去请他来，他就和以色列会众都来见罗波安，对他说，

chapters.en: “Your father put a heavy yoke on us, but now lighten the harsh labor and the heavy yoke he put on us, and we will serve you.”
chapters.zh: 你父亲使我们负重轭，作苦工。现在求你使我们作的苦工，负的重轭轻松些，我们就事奉你。

chapters.en: Rehoboam answered, “Go away for three days and then come back to me.” So the people went away.
chapters.zh: 罗波安对他们说，你们暂且去，第三日再来见我。民就去了。

chapters.en: Then King Rehoboam consulted the elders who had served his father Solomon during his lifetime. “How would you advise me to answer these people?” he asked.
chapters.zh: 罗波安之父所罗门在世的日子，有侍立在他面前的老年人，罗波安王和他们商议，说，你们给我出个什么主意，我好回覆这民。

chapters.en: They replied, “If today you will be a servant to these people and serve them and give them a favorable answer, they will always be your servants.”
chapters.zh: 老年人对他说，现在王若服事这民如仆人，用好话回答他们，他们就永远作王的仆人。

chapters.en: But Rehoboam rejected the advice the elders gave him and consulted the young men who had grown up with him and were serving him.
chapters.zh: 王却不用老年人给他出的主意，就和那些与他一同长大，在他面前侍立的少年人商议，

chapters.en: He asked them, “What is your advice? How should we answer these people who say to me, ‘Lighten the yoke your father put on us’?”
chapters.zh: 说，这民对我说，你父亲使我们负重轭，求你使我们轻松些。你们给我出个什么主意，我好回覆他们。

chapters.en: The young men who had grown up with him replied, “These people have said to you, ‘Your father put a heavy yoke on us, but make our yoke lighter.’ Now tell them, ‘My little finger is thicker than my father’s waist.
chapters.zh: 那同他长大的少年人说，这民对王说，你父亲使我们负重轭，求你使我们轻松些。王要对他们如此说，我的小拇指头比我父亲的腰还粗。

chapters.en: My father laid on you a heavy yoke; I will make it even heavier. My father scourged you with whips; I will scourge you with scorpions.’ ”
chapters.zh: 我父亲使你们负重轭，我必使你们负更重的轭。我父亲用鞭子责打你们，我要用蝎子鞭责打你们。

chapters.en: Three days later Jeroboam and all the people returned to Rehoboam, as the king had said, “Come back to me in three days.”
chapters.zh: 耶罗波安和众百姓遵着罗波安王所说你们第三日再来见我的那话，第三日他们果然来了。

chapters.en: The king answered the people harshly. Rejecting the advice given him by the elders,
chapters.zh: 王用严厉的话回答百姓，不用老年人给他所出的主意，

chapters.en: he followed the advice of the young men and said, “My father made your yoke heavy; I will make it even heavier. My father scourged you with whips; I will scourge you with scorpions.”
chapters.zh: 照着少年人所出的主意对民说，我父亲使你们负重轭，我必使你们负更重的轭。我父亲用鞭子责打你们，我要用蝎子鞭责打你们。

chapters.en: So the king did not listen to the people, for this turn of events was from the LORD, to fulfill the word the LORD had spoken to Jeroboam son of Nebat through Ahijah the Shilonite.
chapters.zh: 王不肯依从百姓，这事乃出于耶和华，为要应验他借示罗人亚希雅对尼八的儿子耶罗波安所说的话。

chapters.en: When all Israel saw that the king refused to listen to them, they answered the king: “What share do we have in David, what part in Jesse’s son? To your tents, Israel! Look after your own house, David!” So the Israelites went home.
chapters.zh: 以色列众民见王不依从他们，就对王说，我们与大卫有什么分儿呢？与耶西的儿子并没有关涉。以色列人哪，各回各家去吧。大卫家阿，自己顾自己吧。于是，以色列人都回自己家里去了，

chapters.en: But as for the Israelites who were living in the towns of Judah, Rehoboam still ruled over them.
chapters.zh: 惟独住犹大城邑的以色列人，罗波安仍作他们的王。

chapters.en: King Rehoboam sent out Adoniram, who was in charge of forced labor, but all Israel stoned him to death. King Rehoboam, however, managed to get into his chariot and escape to Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 罗波安王差遣掌管服苦之人的亚多兰往以色列人那里去，以色列人就用石头打死他。罗波安王急忙上车，逃回耶路撒冷去了。

chapters.en: So Israel has been in rebellion against the house of David to this day.
chapters.zh: 这样，以色列人背叛大卫家，直到今日。

chapters.en: When all the Israelites heard that Jeroboam had returned, they sent and called him to the assembly and made him king over all Israel. Only the tribe of Judah remained loyal to the house of David.
chapters.zh: 以色列众人听见耶罗波安回来了，就打发人去请他到会众面前，立他作以色列众人的王。除了犹大支派以外，没有顺从大卫家的。

chapters.en: When Rehoboam arrived in Jerusalem, he mustered all Judah and the tribe of Benjamin—a hundred and eighty thousand able young men—to go to war against Israel and to regain the kingdom for Rehoboam son of Solomon.
chapters.zh: 罗波安来到耶路撒冷，招聚犹大全家和便雅悯支派的人共十八万，都是挑选的战士，要与以色列家争战，好将国夺回，再归所罗门的儿子罗波安。

chapters.en: But this word of God came to Shemaiah the man of God:
chapters.zh: 但神的话临到神人示玛雅，说，

chapters.en: “Say to Rehoboam son of Solomon king of Judah, to all Judah and Benjamin, and to the rest of the people,
chapters.zh: 你去告诉所罗门的儿子犹大王罗波安和犹大，便雅悯全家，并其余的民说，

chapters.en: ‘This is what the LORD says: Do not go up to fight against your brothers, the Israelites. Go home, every one of you, for this is my doing.’ ” So they obeyed the word of the LORD and went home again, as the LORD had ordered.
chapters.zh: 耶和华如此说，你们不可上去与你们的弟兄以色列人争战。各归各家去吧。因为这事出于我。众人就听从耶和华的话，遵着耶和华的命回去了。

chapters.en: Then Jeroboam fortified Shechem in the hill country of Ephraim and lived there. From there he went out and built up Peniel.
chapters.zh: 耶罗波安在以法莲山地建筑示剑，就住在其中。又从示剑出去，建筑毗努伊勒。

chapters.en: Jeroboam thought to himself, “The kingdom will now likely revert to the house of David.
chapters.zh: 耶罗波安心里说，恐怕这国仍归大卫家。

chapters.en: If these people go up to offer sacrifices at the temple of the LORD in Jerusalem, they will again give their allegiance to their lord, Rehoboam king of Judah. They will kill me and return to King Rehoboam.”
chapters.zh: 这民若上耶路撒冷去，在耶和华的殿里献祭，他们的心必归向他们的主犹大王罗波安，就把我杀了，仍归犹大王罗波安。

chapters.en: After seeking advice, the king made two golden calves. He said to the people, “It is too much for you to go up to Jerusalem. Here are your gods, Israel, who brought you up out of Egypt.”
chapters.zh: 耶罗波安王就筹划定妥，铸造了两个金牛犊，对众民说，以色列人哪，你们上耶路撒冷去实在是难。这就是领你们出埃及地的神。

chapters.en: One he set up in Bethel, and the other in Dan.
chapters.zh: 他就把牛犊一只安在伯特利，一只安在但。

chapters.en: And this thing became a sin; the people came to worship the one at Bethel and went as far as Dan to worship the other.
chapters.zh: 这事叫百姓陷在罪里，因为他们往但去拜那牛犊。

chapters.en: Jeroboam built shrines on high places and appointed priests from all sorts of people, even though they were not Levites.
chapters.zh: 耶罗波安在丘坛那里建殿，将那不属利未人的凡民立为祭司。

chapters.en: He instituted a festival on the fifteenth day of the eighth month, like the festival held in Judah, and offered sacrifices on the altar. This he did in Bethel, sacrificing to the calves he had made. And at Bethel he also installed priests at the high places he had made.
chapters.zh: 耶罗波安定八月十五日为节期，像在犹大的节期一样，自己上坛献祭。他在伯特利也这样向他所铸的牛犊献祭，又将立为丘坛的祭司安置在伯特利。

chapters.en: On the fifteenth day of the eighth month, a month of his own choosing, he offered sacrifices on the altar he had built at Bethel. So he instituted the festival for the Israelites and went up to the altar to make offerings.
chapters.zh: 他在八月十五日，就是他私自所定的月日，为以色列人立作节期的日子，在伯特利上坛烧香。

chapters.en: By the word of the LORD a man of God came from Judah to Bethel, as Jeroboam was standing by the altar to make an offering.
chapters.zh: 那时，有一个神人奉耶和华的命从犹大来到伯特利。耶罗波安正站在坛旁要烧香。

chapters.en: By the word of the LORD he cried out against the altar: “Altar, altar! This is what the LORD says: ‘A son named Josiah will be born to the house of David. On you he will sacrifice the priests of the high places who make offerings here, and human bones will be burned on you.’ ”
chapters.zh: 神人奉耶和华的命向坛呼叫，说，坛哪，坛哪。耶和华如此说，大卫家里必生一个儿子，名叫约西亚，他必将丘坛的祭司，就是在你上面烧香的，杀在你上面，人的骨头也必烧在你上面。

chapters.en: That same day the man of God gave a sign: “This is the sign the LORD has declared: The altar will be split apart and the ashes on it will be poured out.”
chapters.zh: 当日，神人设个预兆，说，这坛必破裂，坛上的灰必倾撒，这是耶和华说的预兆。

chapters.en: When King Jeroboam heard what the man of God cried out against the altar at Bethel, he stretched out his hand from the altar and said, “Seize him!” But the hand he stretched out toward the man shriveled up, so that he could not pull it back.
chapters.zh: 耶罗波安王听见神人向伯特利的坛所呼叫的话，就从坛上伸手，说，拿住他吧。王向神人所伸的手就枯干了，不能弯回。

chapters.en: Also, the altar was split apart and its ashes poured out according to the sign given by the man of God by the word of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 坛也破裂了，坛上的灰倾撒了，正如神人奉耶和华的命所设的预兆。

chapters.en: Then the king said to the man of God, “Intercede with the LORD your God and pray for me that my hand may be restored.” So the man of God interceded with the LORD, and the king’s hand was restored and became as it was before.
chapters.zh: 王对神人说，请你为我祷告，求耶和华你神的恩典使我的手复原。于是神人祈祷耶和华，王的手就复了原，仍如寻常一样。

chapters.en: The king said to the man of God, “Come home with me for a meal, and I will give you a gift.”
chapters.zh: 王对神人说，请你同我回去吃饭，加添心力，我也必给你赏赐。

chapters.en: But the man of God answered the king, “Even if you were to give me half your possessions, I would not go with you, nor would I eat bread or drink water here.
chapters.zh: 神人对王说，你就是把你的宫一半给我，我也不同你进去，也不在这地方吃饭喝水。

chapters.en: For I was commanded by the word of the LORD: ‘You must not eat bread or drink water or return by the way you came.’ ”
chapters.zh: 因为有耶和华的话嘱咐我，说不可在伯特利吃饭喝水，也不可从你去的原路回来。

chapters.en: So he took another road and did not return by the way he had come to Bethel.
chapters.zh: 于是神人从别的路回去，不从伯特利来的原路回去。

chapters.en: Now there was a certain old prophet living in Bethel, whose sons came and told him all that the man of God had done there that day. They also told their father what he had said to the king.
chapters.zh: 有一个老先知住在伯特利，他儿子们来，将神人当日在伯特利所行的一切事和向王所说的话都告诉了父亲。

chapters.en: Their father asked them, “Which way did he go?” And his sons showed him which road the man of God from Judah had taken.
chapters.zh: 父亲问他们说，神人从哪条路去了呢？儿子们就告诉他。原来他们看见那从犹大来的神人所去的路。

chapters.en: So he said to his sons, “Saddle the donkey for me.” And when they had saddled the donkey for him, he mounted it
chapters.zh: 老先知就吩咐他儿子们说，你们为我备驴。他们备好了驴，他就骑上，

chapters.en: and rode after the man of God. He found him sitting under an oak tree and asked, “Are you the man of God who came from Judah?” “I am,” he replied.
chapters.zh: 去追赶神人，遇见他坐在橡树底下，就问他说，你是从犹大来的神人不是。他说，是。

chapters.en: So the prophet said to him, “Come home with me and eat.”
chapters.zh: 老先知对他说，请你同我回家吃饭。

chapters.en: The man of God said, “I cannot turn back and go with you, nor can I eat bread or drink water with you in this place.
chapters.zh: 神人说，我不可同你回去进你的家，也不可在这里同你吃饭喝水。

chapters.en: I have been told by the word of the LORD: ‘You must not eat bread or drink water there or return by the way you came.’ ”
chapters.zh: 因为有耶和华的话嘱咐我说，你在那里不可吃饭喝水，也不可从你去的原路回来。

chapters.en: The old prophet answered, “I too am a prophet, as you are. And an angel said to me by the word of the LORD: ‘Bring him back with you to your house so that he may eat bread and drink water.’ ” (But he was lying to him.)
chapters.zh: 老先知对他说，我也是先知，和你一样。有天使奉耶和华的命对我说，你去把他带回你的家，叫他吃饭喝水。这都是老先知诓哄他。

chapters.en: So the man of God returned with him and ate and drank in his house.
chapters.zh: 于是神人同老先知回去，在他家里吃饭喝水。

chapters.en: While they were sitting at the table, the word of the LORD came to the old prophet who had brought him back.
chapters.zh: 二人坐席的时候，耶和华的话临到那带神人回来的先知，

chapters.en: He cried out to the man of God who had come from Judah, “This is what the LORD says: ‘You have defied the word of the LORD and have not kept the command the LORD your God gave you.
chapters.zh: 他就对那从犹大来的神人说，耶和华如此说，你既违背耶和华的话，不遵守耶和华你神的命令，

chapters.en: You came back and ate bread and drank water in the place where he told you not to eat or drink. Therefore your body will not be buried in the tomb of your ancestors.’ ”
chapters.zh: 反倒回来，在耶和华禁止你吃饭喝水的地方吃了喝了，因此你的尸身不得入你列祖的坟墓。

chapters.en: When the man of God had finished eating and drinking, the prophet who had brought him back saddled his donkey for him.
chapters.zh: 吃喝完了，老先知为所带回来的先知备驴。

chapters.en: As he went on his way, a lion met him on the road and killed him, and his body was left lying on the road, with both the donkey and the lion standing beside it.
chapters.zh: 他就去了，在路上有个狮子遇见他，将他咬死，尸身倒在路上，驴站在尸身旁边，狮子也站在尸身旁边。

chapters.en: Some people who passed by saw the body lying there, with the lion standing beside the body, and they went and reported it in the city where the old prophet lived.
chapters.zh: 有人从那里经过，看见尸身倒在路上，狮子站在尸身旁边，就来到老先知所住的城里述说这事。

chapters.en: When the prophet who had brought him back from his journey heard of it, he said, “It is the man of God who defied the word of the LORD. The LORD has given him over to the lion, which has mauled him and killed him, as the word of the LORD had warned him.”
chapters.zh: 那带神人回来的先知听见这事，就说，这是那违背了耶和华命令的神人，所以耶和华把他交给狮子。狮子抓伤他，咬死他，是应验耶和华对他说的话。

chapters.en: The prophet said to his sons, “Saddle the donkey for me,” and they did so.
chapters.zh: 老先知就吩咐他儿子们说，你们为我备驴。他们就备了驴。

chapters.en: Then he went out and found the body lying on the road, with the donkey and the lion standing beside it. The lion had neither eaten the body nor mauled the donkey.
chapters.zh: 他去了，看见神人的尸身倒在路上，驴和狮子站在尸身旁边，狮子却没有吃尸身，也没有抓伤驴。

chapters.en: So the prophet picked up the body of the man of God, laid it on the donkey, and brought it back to his own city to mourn for him and bury him.
chapters.zh: 老先知就把神人的尸身驮在驴上，带回自己的城里，要哀哭他，葬埋他。

chapters.en: Then he laid the body in his own tomb, and they mourned over him and said, “Alas, my brother!”
chapters.zh: 就把他的尸身葬在自己的坟墓里，哀哭他，说，哀哉。我兄阿。

chapters.en: After burying him, he said to his sons, “When I die, bury me in the grave where the man of God is buried; lay my bones beside his bones.
chapters.zh: 安葬之后，老先知对他儿子们说，我死了，你们要葬我在神人的坟墓里，使我的尸骨靠近他的尸骨，

chapters.en: For the message he declared by the word of the LORD against the altar in Bethel and against all the shrines on the high places in the towns of Samaria will certainly come true.”
chapters.zh: 因为他奉耶和华的命，指着伯特利的坛，和撒玛利亚各城有丘坛之殿所说的话必定应验。

chapters.en: Even after this, Jeroboam did not change his evil ways, but once more appointed priests for the high places from all sorts of people. Anyone who wanted to become a priest he consecrated for the high places.
chapters.zh: 这事以后，耶罗波安仍不离开他的恶道，将凡民立为丘坛的祭司。凡愿意的，他都分别为圣，立为丘坛的祭司。

chapters.en: This was the sin of the house of Jeroboam that led to its downfall and to its destruction from the face of the earth.
chapters.zh: 这事叫耶罗波安的家陷在罪里，甚至他的家从地上除灭了。

chapters.en: At that time Abijah son of Jeroboam became ill,
chapters.zh: 那时，耶罗波安的儿子亚比雅病了。

chapters.en: and Jeroboam said to his wife, “Go, disguise yourself, so you won’t be recognized as the wife of Jeroboam. Then go to Shiloh. Ahijah the prophet is there—the one who told me I would be king over this people.
chapters.zh: 耶罗波安对他的妻说，你可以起来改装，使人不知道你是耶罗波安的妻，往示罗去，在那里有先知亚希雅。他曾告诉我说，你必作这民的王。

chapters.en: Take ten loaves of bread with you, some cakes and a jar of honey, and go to him. He will tell you what will happen to the boy.”
chapters.zh: 现在你要带十个饼，与几个薄饼，和一瓶蜜去见他，他必告诉你儿子将要怎样。

chapters.en: So Jeroboam’s wife did what he said and went to Ahijah’s house in Shiloh. Now Ahijah could not see; his sight was gone because of his age.
chapters.zh: 耶罗波安的妻就这样行，起身往示罗去，到了亚希雅的家。亚希雅因年纪老迈，眼目发直，不能看见。

chapters.en: But the LORD had told Ahijah, “Jeroboam’s wife is coming to ask you about her son, for he is ill, and you are to give her such and such an answer. When she arrives, she will pretend to be someone else.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华先晓谕亚希雅说，耶罗波安的妻要来问你，因她儿子病了，你当如此如此告诉她。她进来的时候必装作别的妇人。

chapters.en: So when Ahijah heard the sound of her footsteps at the door, he said, “Come in, wife of Jeroboam. Why this pretense? I have been sent to you with bad news.
chapters.zh: 她刚进门，亚希雅听见她脚步的响声，就说，耶罗波安的妻，进来吧。你为何装作别的妇人呢？我奉差遣将凶事告诉你。

chapters.en: Go, tell Jeroboam that this is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: ‘I raised you up from among the people and appointed you ruler over my people Israel.
chapters.zh: 你回去告诉耶罗波安说，耶和华以色列的神如此说，我从民中将你高举，立你作我民以色列的君，

chapters.en: I tore the kingdom away from the house of David and gave it to you, but you have not been like my servant David, who kept my commands and followed me with all his heart, doing only what was right in my eyes.
chapters.zh: 将国从大卫家夺回赐给你。你却不效法我仆人大卫，遵守我的诫命，一心顺从我，行我眼中看为正的事。

chapters.en: You have done more evil than all who lived before you. You have made for yourself other gods, idols made of metal; you have aroused my anger and turned your back on me.
chapters.zh: 你竟行恶，比那在你以先的更甚，为自己立了别神，铸了偶像，惹我发怒，将我丢在背后。

chapters.en: “ ‘Because of this, I am going to bring disaster on the house of Jeroboam. I will cut off from Jeroboam every last male in Israel—slave or free. I will burn up the house of Jeroboam as one burns dung, until it is all gone.
chapters.zh: 因此，我必使灾祸临到耶罗波安的家，将属耶罗波安的男丁，无论困住的，自由的都从以色列中剪除，必除尽耶罗波安的家，如人除尽粪土一般。

chapters.en: Dogs will eat those belonging to Jeroboam who die in the city, and the birds will feed on those who die in the country. The LORD has spoken!’
chapters.zh: 凡属耶罗波安的人，死在城中的必被狗吃，死在田野的必被空中的鸟吃。这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: “As for you, go back home. When you set foot in your city, the boy will die.
chapters.zh: 所以你起身回家去吧。你的脚一进城，你儿子就必死了。

chapters.en: All Israel will mourn for him and bury him. He is the only one belonging to Jeroboam who will be buried, because he is the only one in the house of Jeroboam in whom the LORD, the God of Israel, has found anything good.
chapters.zh: 以色列众人必为他哀哭，将他葬埋。凡属耶罗波安的人，惟有他得入坟墓。因为在耶罗波安的家中，只有他向耶和华以色列的神显出善行。

chapters.en: “The LORD will raise up for himself a king over Israel who will cut off the family of Jeroboam. Even now this is beginning to happen.
chapters.zh: 耶和华必另立一王治理以色列。到了日期，他必剪除耶罗波安的家。那日期已经到了。

chapters.en: And the LORD will strike Israel, so that it will be like a reed swaying in the water. He will uproot Israel from this good land that he gave to their ancestors and scatter them beyond the Euphrates River, because they aroused the LORD’s anger by making Asherah poles.
chapters.zh: 耶和华必击打以色列人，使他们摇动，像水中的芦苇一般。又将他们从耶和华赐给他们列祖的美地上拔出来，分散在大河那边。因为他们作木偶，惹耶和华发怒。

chapters.en: And he will give Israel up because of the sins Jeroboam has committed and has caused Israel to commit.”
chapters.zh: 因耶罗波安所犯的罪，又使以色列人陷在罪里，耶和华必将以色列人交给仇敌。

chapters.en: Then Jeroboam’s wife got up and left and went to Tirzah. As soon as she stepped over the threshold of the house, the boy died.
chapters.zh: 耶罗波安的妻起身回去，到了得撒，刚到门槛，儿子就死了。

chapters.en: They buried him, and all Israel mourned for him, as the LORD had said through his servant the prophet Ahijah.
chapters.zh: 以色列众人将他葬埋，为他哀哭，正如耶和华借他仆人先知亚希雅所说的话。

chapters.en: The other events of Jeroboam’s reign, his wars and how he ruled, are written in the book of the annals of the kings of Israel.
chapters.zh: 耶罗波安其余的事，他怎样争战，怎样作王，都写在以色列诸王记上。

chapters.en: He reigned for twenty-two years and then rested with his ancestors. And Nadab his son succeeded him as king.
chapters.zh: 耶罗波安作王二十二年，就与他列祖同睡。他儿子拿答接续他作王。

chapters.en: Rehoboam son of Solomon was king in Judah. He was forty-one years old when he became king, and he reigned seventeen years in Jerusalem, the city the LORD had chosen out of all the tribes of Israel in which to put his Name. His mother’s name was Naamah; she was an Ammonite.
chapters.zh: 所罗门的儿子罗波安作犹大王。他登基的时候年四十一岁，在耶路撒冷，就是耶和华从以色列众支派中所选择立他名的城，作王十七年。罗波安的母亲名叫拿玛，是亚扪人。

chapters.en: Judah did evil in the eyes of the LORD. By the sins they committed they stirred up his jealous anger more than those who were before them had done.
chapters.zh: 犹大人行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，犯罪触动他的愤恨，比他们列祖更甚。

chapters.en: They also set up for themselves high places, sacred stones and Asherah poles on every high hill and under every spreading tree.
chapters.zh: 因为他们在各高冈上，各青翠树下筑坛，立柱像和木偶。

chapters.en: There were even male shrine prostitutes in the land; the people engaged in all the detestable practices of the nations the LORD had driven out before the Israelites.
chapters.zh: 国中也有娈童。犹大人效法耶和华在以色列人面前所赶出的外邦人，行一切可憎恶的事。

chapters.en: In the fifth year of King Rehoboam, Shishak king of Egypt attacked Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 罗波安王第五年，埃及王示撒上来攻取耶路撒冷，

chapters.en: He carried off the treasures of the temple of the LORD and the treasures of the royal palace. He took everything, including all the gold shields Solomon had made.
chapters.zh: 夺了耶和华殿和王宫里的宝物，尽都带走，又夺去所罗门制造的金盾牌。

chapters.en: So King Rehoboam made bronze shields to replace them and assigned these to the commanders of the guard on duty at the entrance to the royal palace.
chapters.zh: 罗波安王制造铜盾牌代替那金盾牌，交给守王宫门的护卫长看守。

chapters.en: Whenever the king went to the LORD’s temple, the guards bore the shields, and afterward they returned them to the guardroom.
chapters.zh: 王每逢进耶和华的殿，护卫兵就拿这盾牌，随后仍将盾牌送回，放在护卫房。

chapters.en: As for the other events of Rehoboam’s reign, and all he did, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Judah?
chapters.zh: 罗波安其余的事，凡他所行的，都写在犹大列王记上。

chapters.en: There was continual warfare between Rehoboam and Jeroboam.
chapters.zh: 罗波安与耶罗波安时常争战。

chapters.en: And Rehoboam rested with his ancestors and was buried with them in the City of David. His mother’s name was Naamah; she was an Ammonite. And Abijah his son succeeded him as king.
chapters.zh: 罗波安与他列祖同睡，葬在大卫城他列祖的坟地里。他母亲名叫拿玛，是亚扪人。他儿子亚比央（又名亚比雅）接续他作王。

chapters.en: In the eighteenth year of the reign of Jeroboam son of Nebat, Abijah became king of Judah,
chapters.zh: 尼八的儿子耶罗波安王十八年，亚比央登基作犹大王，

chapters.en: and he reigned in Jerusalem three years. His mother’s name was Maakah daughter of Abishalom.
chapters.zh: 在耶路撒冷作王三年。他母亲名叫玛迦，是押沙龙的女儿。

chapters.en: He committed all the sins his father had done before him; his heart was not fully devoted to the LORD his God, as the heart of David his forefather had been.
chapters.zh: 亚比央行他父亲在他以前所行的一切恶，他的心不像他祖大卫的心，诚诚实实地顺服耶和华他的神。

chapters.en: Nevertheless, for David’s sake the LORD his God gave him a lamp in Jerusalem by raising up a son to succeed him and by making Jerusalem strong.
chapters.zh: 然而耶和华他的神因大卫的缘故，仍使他在耶路撒冷有灯光，叫他儿子接续他作王，坚立耶路撒冷。

chapters.en: For David had done what was right in the eyes of the LORD and had not failed to keep any of the LORD’s commands all the days of his life—except in the case of Uriah the Hittite.
chapters.zh: 因为大卫除了赫人乌利亚那件事，都是行耶和华眼中看为正的事，一生没有违背耶和华一切所吩咐的。

chapters.en: There was war between Abijah and Jeroboam throughout Abijah’s lifetime.
chapters.zh: 罗波安在世的日子常与耶罗波安争战。

chapters.en: As for the other events of Abijah’s reign, and all he did, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Judah? There was war between Abijah and Jeroboam.
chapters.zh: 亚比央其余的事，凡他所行的，都写在犹大列王记上。亚比央常与耶罗波安争战。

chapters.en: And Abijah rested with his ancestors and was buried in the City of David. And Asa his son succeeded him as king.
chapters.zh: 亚比央与他列祖同睡，葬在大卫的城里。他儿子亚撒接续他作王。

chapters.en: In the twentieth year of Jeroboam king of Israel, Asa became king of Judah,
chapters.zh: 以色列王耶罗波安二十年，亚撒登基作犹大王，

chapters.en: and he reigned in Jerusalem forty-one years. His grandmother’s name was Maakah daughter of Abishalom.
chapters.zh: 在耶路撒冷作王四十一年。他祖母名叫玛迦，是押沙龙的女儿。

chapters.en: Asa did what was right in the eyes of the LORD, as his father David had done.
chapters.zh: 亚撒效法他祖大卫行耶和华眼中看为正的事，

chapters.en: He expelled the male shrine prostitutes from the land and got rid of all the idols his ancestors had made.
chapters.zh: 从国中除去娈童，又除掉他列祖所造的一切偶像。

chapters.en: He even deposed his grandmother Maakah from her position as queen mother, because she had made a repulsive image for the worship of Asherah. Asa cut it down and burned it in the Kidron Valley.
chapters.zh: 并且贬了他祖母玛迦太后的位，因她造了可憎的偶像亚舍拉。亚撒砍下她的偶像，烧在汲沦溪边，

chapters.en: Although he did not remove the high places, Asa’s heart was fully committed to the LORD all his life.
chapters.zh: 只是丘坛还没有废去。亚撒一生却向耶和华存诚实的心。

chapters.en: He brought into the temple of the LORD the silver and gold and the articles that he and his father had dedicated.
chapters.zh: 亚撒将他父亲所分别为圣，与自己所分别为圣的金银和器皿，都奉到耶和华的殿里。

chapters.en: There was war between Asa and Baasha king of Israel throughout their reigns.
chapters.zh: 亚撒和以色列王巴沙在世的日子常常争战。

chapters.en: Baasha king of Israel went up against Judah and fortified Ramah to prevent anyone from leaving or entering the territory of Asa king of Judah.
chapters.zh: 以色列王巴沙上来要攻击犹大，修筑拉玛，不许人从犹大王亚撒那里出入。

chapters.en: Asa then took all the silver and gold that was left in the treasuries of the LORD’s temple and of his own palace. He entrusted it to his officials and sent them to Ben-Hadad son of Tabrimmon, the son of Hezion, the king of Aram, who was ruling in Damascus.
chapters.zh: 于是亚撒将耶和华殿和王宫府库里所剩下的金银都交在他臣仆手中，打发他们往住大马色的亚兰王希旬的孙子，他伯利们的儿子便哈达那里去，

chapters.en: “Let there be a treaty between me and you,” he said, “as there was between my father and your father. See, I am sending you a gift of silver and gold. Now break your treaty with Baasha king of Israel so he will withdraw from me.”
chapters.zh: 说，你父曾与我父立约，我与你也要立约。现在我将金银送你为礼物，求你废掉你与以色列王巴沙所立的约，使他离开我。

chapters.en: Ben-Hadad agreed with King Asa and sent the commanders of his forces against the towns of Israel. He conquered Ijon, Dan, Abel Beth Maakah and all Kinnereth in addition to Naphtali.
chapters.zh: 便哈达听从亚撒王的话，派军长去攻击以色列的城邑。他们就攻破以云，但，亚伯伯玛迦，基尼烈全境，拿弗他利全境。

chapters.en: When Baasha heard this, he stopped building Ramah and withdrew to Tirzah.
chapters.zh: 巴沙听见，就停工不修筑拉玛了，仍住在得撒。

chapters.en: Then King Asa issued an order to all Judah—no one was exempt—and they carried away from Ramah the stones and timber Baasha had been using there. With them King Asa built up Geba in Benjamin, and also Mizpah.
chapters.zh: 于是亚撒王宣告犹大众人，不准一个推辞，吩咐他们将巴沙修筑拉玛所用的石头，木头都运去，用以修筑便雅悯的迦巴和米斯巴。

chapters.en: As for all the other events of Asa’s reign, all his achievements, all he did and the cities he built, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Judah? In his old age, however, his feet became diseased.
chapters.zh: 亚撒其余的事，凡他所行的，并他的勇力与他所建筑的城邑，都写在犹大列王记上。亚撒年老的时候，脚上有病。

chapters.en: Then Asa rested with his ancestors and was buried with them in the city of his father David. And Jehoshaphat his son succeeded him as king.
chapters.zh: 亚撒与他列祖同睡，葬在他祖大卫城他列祖的坟地里。他儿子约沙法接续他作王。

chapters.en: Nadab son of Jeroboam became king of Israel in the second year of Asa king of Judah, and he reigned over Israel two years.
chapters.zh: 犹大王亚撒第二年，耶罗波安的儿子拿答登基作以色列王共二年，

chapters.en: He did evil in the eyes of the LORD, following the ways of his father and committing the same sin his father had caused Israel to commit.
chapters.zh: 拿答行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，行他父亲所行的，犯他父亲使以色列人陷在罪里的那罪。

chapters.en: Baasha son of Ahijah from the tribe of Issachar plotted against him, and he struck him down at Gibbethon, a Philistine town, while Nadab and all Israel were besieging it.
chapters.zh: 以萨迦人亚希雅的儿子巴沙背叛拿答，在非利士的基比顿杀了他。那时拿答和以色列众人正围困基比顿。

chapters.en: Baasha killed Nadab in the third year of Asa king of Judah and succeeded him as king.
chapters.zh: 在犹大王亚撒第三年巴沙杀了他，篡了他的位。

chapters.en: As soon as he began to reign, he killed Jeroboam’s whole family. He did not leave Jeroboam anyone that breathed, but destroyed them all, according to the word of the LORD given through his servant Ahijah the Shilonite.
chapters.zh: 巴沙一作王就杀了耶罗波安的全家，凡有气息的没有留下一个，都灭尽了，正应验耶和华借他仆人示罗人亚希雅所说的话。

chapters.en: This happened because of the sins Jeroboam had committed and had caused Israel to commit, and because he aroused the anger of the LORD, the God of Israel.
chapters.zh: 这是因为耶罗波安所犯的罪使以色列人陷在罪里，惹动耶和华以色列神的怒气。

chapters.en: As for the other events of Nadab’s reign, and all he did, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Israel?
chapters.zh: 拿答其余的事，凡他所行的，都写在以色列诸王记上。

chapters.en: There was war between Asa and Baasha king of Israel throughout their reigns.
chapters.zh: 亚撒和以色列王巴沙在世的日子常常争战。

chapters.en: In the third year of Asa king of Judah, Baasha son of Ahijah became king of all Israel in Tirzah, and he reigned twenty-four years.
chapters.zh: 犹大王亚撒第三年，亚希雅的儿子巴沙在得撒登基作以色列众人的王共二十四年。

chapters.en: He did evil in the eyes of the LORD, following the ways of Jeroboam and committing the same sin Jeroboam had caused Israel to commit.
chapters.zh: 他行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，行耶罗波安所行的道，犯他使以色列人陷在罪里的那罪。

chapters.en: Then the word of the LORD came to Jehu son of Hanani concerning Baasha:
chapters.zh: 耶和华的话临到哈拿尼的儿子耶户，责备巴沙说，

chapters.en: “I lifted you up from the dust and appointed you ruler over my people Israel, but you followed the ways of Jeroboam and caused my people Israel to sin and to arouse my anger by their sins.
chapters.zh: 我既从尘埃中提拔你，立你作我民以色列的君，你竟行耶罗波安所行的道，使我民以色列陷在罪里，惹我发怒，

chapters.en: So I am about to wipe out Baasha and his house, and I will make your house like that of Jeroboam son of Nebat.
chapters.zh: 我必除尽你和你的家，使你的家像尼八的儿子耶罗波安的家一样。

chapters.en: Dogs will eat those belonging to Baasha who die in the city, and birds will feed on those who die in the country.”
chapters.zh: 凡属巴沙的人，死在城中的必被狗吃，死在田野的必被空中的鸟吃。

chapters.en: As for the other events of Baasha’s reign, what he did and his achievements, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Israel?
chapters.zh: 巴沙其余的事，凡他所行的和他的勇力，都写在以色列诸王记上。

chapters.en: Baasha rested with his ancestors and was buried in Tirzah. And Elah his son succeeded him as king.
chapters.zh: 巴沙与他列祖同睡，葬在得撒。他儿子以拉接续他作王。

chapters.en: Moreover, the word of the LORD came through the prophet Jehu son of Hanani to Baasha and his house, because of all the evil he had done in the eyes of the LORD, arousing his anger by the things he did, becoming like the house of Jeroboam—and also because he destroyed it.
chapters.zh: 耶和华的话临到哈拿尼的儿子先知耶户，责备巴沙和他的家，因他行耶和华眼中看为恶的一切事，以他手所作的惹耶和华发怒，像耶罗波安的家一样，又因他杀了耶罗波安的全家。

chapters.en: In the twenty-sixth year of Asa king of Judah, Elah son of Baasha became king of Israel, and he reigned in Tirzah two years.
chapters.zh: 犹大王亚撒二十六年，巴沙的儿子以拉在得撒登基作以色列王共二年。

chapters.en: Zimri, one of his officials, who had command of half his chariots, plotted against him. Elah was in Tirzah at the time, getting drunk in the home of Arza, the palace administrator at Tirzah.
chapters.zh: 有管理他一半战车的臣子心利背叛他。当他在得撒家宰亚杂家里喝醉的时候，

chapters.en: Zimri came in, struck him down and killed him in the twenty-seventh year of Asa king of Judah. Then he succeeded him as king.
chapters.zh: 心利就进去杀了他，篡了他的位。这是犹大王亚撒二十七年的事。

chapters.en: As soon as he began to reign and was seated on the throne, he killed off Baasha’s whole family. He did not spare a single male, whether relative or friend.
chapters.zh: 心利一坐王位就杀了巴沙的全家，连他的亲属，朋友也没有留下一个男丁。

chapters.en: So Zimri destroyed the whole family of Baasha, in accordance with the word of the LORD spoken against Baasha through the prophet Jehu—
chapters.zh: 心利这样灭绝巴沙的全家，正如耶和华借先知耶户责备巴沙的话。

chapters.en: because of all the sins Baasha and his son Elah had committed and had caused Israel to commit, so that they aroused the anger of the LORD, the God of Israel, by their worthless idols.
chapters.zh: 这是因巴沙和他儿子以拉的一切罪，就是他们使以色列人陷在罪里的那罪，以虚无的神惹耶和华以色列神的怒气。

chapters.en: As for the other events of Elah’s reign, and all he did, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Israel?
chapters.zh: 以拉其余的事，凡他所行的，都写在以色列诸王记上。

chapters.en: In the twenty-seventh year of Asa king of Judah, Zimri reigned in Tirzah seven days. The army was encamped near Gibbethon, a Philistine town.
chapters.zh: 犹大王亚撒二十七年，心利在得撒作王七日。那时民正安营围攻非利士的基比顿。

chapters.en: When the Israelites in the camp heard that Zimri had plotted against the king and murdered him, they proclaimed Omri, the commander of the army, king over Israel that very day there in the camp.
chapters.zh: 民在营中听说心利背叛，又杀了王，故此以色列众人当日在营中立元帅暗利作以色列王。

chapters.en: Then Omri and all the Israelites with him withdrew from Gibbethon and laid siege to Tirzah.
chapters.zh: 暗利率领以色列众人，从基比顿上去，围困得撒。

chapters.en: When Zimri saw that the city was taken, he went into the citadel of the royal palace and set the palace on fire around him. So he died,
chapters.zh: 心利见城破失，就进了王宫的卫所，放火焚烧宫殿，自焚而死。

chapters.en: because of the sins he had committed, doing evil in the eyes of the LORD and following the ways of Jeroboam and committing the same sin Jeroboam had caused Israel to commit.
chapters.zh: 这是因他犯罪，行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，行耶罗波安所行的，犯他使以色列人陷在罪里的那罪。

chapters.en: As for the other events of Zimri’s reign, and the rebellion he carried out, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Israel?
chapters.zh: 心利其余的事和他背叛的情形都写在以色列诸王记上。

chapters.en: Then the people of Israel were split into two factions; half supported Tibni son of Ginath for king, and the other half supported Omri.
chapters.zh: 那时，以色列民分为两半，一半随从基纳的儿子提比尼，要立他作王。一半随从暗利。

chapters.en: But Omri’s followers proved stronger than those of Tibni son of Ginath. So Tibni died and Omri became king.
chapters.zh: 但随从暗利的民胜过随从基纳的儿子提比尼的民。提比尼死了，暗利就作了王。

chapters.en: In the thirty-first year of Asa king of Judah, Omri became king of Israel, and he reigned twelve years, six of them in Tirzah.
chapters.zh: 犹大王亚撒三十一年，暗利登基作以色列王共十二年。在得撒作王六年。

chapters.en: He bought the hill of Samaria from Shemer for two talents of silver and built a city on the hill, calling it Samaria, after Shemer, the name of the former owner of the hill.
chapters.zh: 暗利用二他连得银子向撒玛买了撒玛利亚山，在山上造城，就按着山的原主撒玛的名，给所造的城起名叫撒玛利亚。

chapters.en: But Omri did evil in the eyes of the LORD and sinned more than all those before him.
chapters.zh: 暗利行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，比他以前的列王作恶更甚。

chapters.en: He followed completely the ways of Jeroboam son of Nebat, committing the same sin Jeroboam had caused Israel to commit, so that they aroused the anger of the LORD, the God of Israel, by their worthless idols.
chapters.zh: 因他行了尼八的儿子耶罗波安所行的，犯他使以色列人陷在罪里的那罪，以虚无的神惹耶和华以色列神的怒气。

chapters.en: As for the other events of Omri’s reign, what he did and the things he achieved, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Israel?
chapters.zh: 暗利其余的事和他所显出的勇力都写在以色列诸王记上。

chapters.en: Omri rested with his ancestors and was buried in Samaria. And Ahab his son succeeded him as king.
chapters.zh: 暗利与他列祖同睡，葬在撒玛利亚。他儿子亚哈接续他作王。

chapters.en: In the thirty-eighth year of Asa king of Judah, Ahab son of Omri became king of Israel, and he reigned in Samaria over Israel twenty-two years.
chapters.zh: 犹大王亚撒三十八年，暗利的儿子亚哈登基作了以色列王。暗利的儿子亚哈在撒玛利亚作以色列王二十二年。

chapters.en: Ahab son of Omri did more evil in the eyes of the LORD than any of those before him.
chapters.zh: 暗利的儿子亚哈行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，比他以前的列王更甚，

chapters.en: He not only considered it trivial to commit the sins of Jeroboam son of Nebat, but he also married Jezebel daughter of Ethbaal king of the Sidonians, and began to serve Baal and worship him.
chapters.zh: 犯了尼八的儿子耶罗波安所犯的罪。他还以为轻，又娶了西顿王谒巴力的女儿耶洗别为妻，去事奉敬拜巴力，

chapters.en: He set up an altar for Baal in the temple of Baal that he built in Samaria.
chapters.zh: 在撒玛利亚建造巴力的庙，在庙里为巴力筑坛。

chapters.en: Ahab also made an Asherah pole and did more to arouse the anger of the LORD, the God of Israel, than did all the kings of Israel before him.
chapters.zh: 亚哈又作亚舍拉，他所行的惹耶和华以色列神的怒气，比他以前的以色列诸王更甚。

chapters.en: In Ahab’s time, Hiel of Bethel rebuilt Jericho. He laid its foundations at the cost of his firstborn son Abiram, and he set up its gates at the cost of his youngest son Segub, in accordance with the word of the LORD spoken by Joshua son of Nun.
chapters.zh: 亚哈在位的时候，有伯特利人希伊勒重修耶利哥城。立根基的时候，丧了长子亚比兰。安门的时候，丧了幼子西割，正如耶和华借嫩的儿子约书亚所说的话。

chapters.en: Now Elijah the Tishbite, from Tishbe in Gilead, said to Ahab, “As the LORD, the God of Israel, lives, whom I serve, there will be neither dew nor rain in the next few years except at my word.”
chapters.zh: 基列寄居的提斯比人以利亚对亚哈说，我指着所事奉永生耶和华以色列的神起誓，这几年我若不祷告，必不降露，不下雨。

chapters.en: Then the word of the LORD came to Elijah:
chapters.zh: 耶和华的话临到以利亚说，

chapters.en: “Leave here, turn eastward and hide in the Kerith Ravine, east of the Jordan.
chapters.zh: 你离开这里往东去，藏在约旦河东边的基立溪旁。

chapters.en: You will drink from the brook, and I have directed the ravens to supply you with food there.”
chapters.zh: 你要喝那溪里的水，我已吩咐乌鸦在那里供养你。

chapters.en: So he did what the LORD had told him. He went to the Kerith Ravine, east of the Jordan, and stayed there.
chapters.zh: 于是以利亚照着耶和华的话，去住在约旦河东的基立溪旁。

chapters.en: The ravens brought him bread and meat in the morning and bread and meat in the evening, and he drank from the brook.
chapters.zh: 乌鸦早晚给他叼饼和肉来，他也喝那溪里的水。

chapters.en: Some time later the brook dried up because there had been no rain in the land.
chapters.zh: 过了些日子，溪水就干了，因为雨没有下在地上。

chapters.en: Then the word of the LORD came to him:
chapters.zh: 耶和华的话临到他说，

chapters.en: “Go at once to Zarephath in the region of Sidon and stay there. I have directed a widow there to supply you with food.”
chapters.zh: 你起身往西顿的撒勒法去（撒勒法与路加福音四章二十六节同）住在那里．我已吩咐那里的一个寡妇供养你。

chapters.en: So he went to Zarephath. When he came to the town gate, a widow was there gathering sticks. He called to her and asked, “Would you bring me a little water in a jar so I may have a drink?”
chapters.zh: 以利亚就起身往撒勒法去。到了城门，见有一个寡妇在那里捡柴，以利亚呼叫她说，求你用器皿取点水来给我喝。

chapters.en: As she was going to get it, he called, “And bring me, please, a piece of bread.”
chapters.zh: 她去取水的时候，以利亚又呼叫她说，也求你拿点饼来给我。

chapters.en: “As surely as the LORD your God lives,” she replied, “I don’t have any bread—only a handful of flour in a jar and a little olive oil in a jug. I am gathering a few sticks to take home and make a meal for myself and my son, that we may eat it—and die.”
chapters.zh: 她说，我指着永生耶和华你的神起誓，我没有饼，坛内只有一把面，瓶里只有一点油。我现在找两根柴，回家要为我和我儿子作饼。我们吃了，死就死吧。

chapters.en: Elijah said to her, “Don’t be afraid. Go home and do as you have said. But first make a small loaf of bread for me from what you have and bring it to me, and then make something for yourself and your son.
chapters.zh: 以利亚对她说，不要惧怕。可以照你所说的去作吧。只要先为我作一个小饼拿来给我，然后为你和你的儿子作饼。

chapters.en: For this is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: ‘The jar of flour will not be used up and the jug of oil will not run dry until the day the LORD sends rain on the land.’ ”
chapters.zh: 因为耶和华以色列的神如此说，坛内的面必不减少，瓶里的油必不缺短，直到耶和华使雨降在地上的日子。

chapters.en: She went away and did as Elijah had told her. So there was food every day for Elijah and for the woman and her family.
chapters.zh: 妇人就照以利亚的话去行。她和她家中的人，并以利亚，吃了许多日子。

chapters.en: For the jar of flour was not used up and the jug of oil did not run dry, in keeping with the word of the LORD spoken by Elijah.
chapters.zh: 坛内的面果不减少，瓶里的油也不缺短，正如耶和华借以利亚所说的话。

chapters.en: Some time later the son of the woman who owned the house became ill. He grew worse and worse, and finally stopped breathing.
chapters.zh: 这事以后，作那家主母的妇人，她儿子病了。病得甚重，以致身无气息。

chapters.en: She said to Elijah, “What do you have against me, man of God? Did you come to remind me of my sin and kill my son?”
chapters.zh: 妇人对以利亚说，神人哪，我与你何干？你竟到我这里来，使神想念我的罪，以致我的儿子死呢？

chapters.en: “Give me your son,” Elijah replied. He took him from her arms, carried him to the upper room where he was staying, and laid him on his bed.
chapters.zh: 以利亚对她说，把你儿子交给我。以利亚就从妇人怀中将孩子接过来，抱到他所住的楼中，放在自己的床上，

chapters.en: Then he cried out to the LORD, “LORD my God, have you brought tragedy even on this widow I am staying with, by causing her son to die?”
chapters.zh: 就求告耶和华说，耶和华我的神阿，我寄居在这寡妇的家里，你就降祸与她，使她的儿子死了吗？

chapters.en: Then he stretched himself out on the boy three times and cried out to the LORD, “LORD my God, let this boy’s life return to him!”
chapters.zh: 以利亚三次伏在孩子的身上，求告耶和华说，耶和华我的神阿，求你使这孩子的灵魂仍入他的身体。

chapters.en: The LORD heard Elijah’s cry, and the boy’s life returned to him, and he lived.
chapters.zh: 耶和华应允以利亚的话，孩子的灵魂仍入他的身体，他就活了。

chapters.en: Elijah picked up the child and carried him down from the room into the house. He gave him to his mother and said, “Look, your son is alive!”
chapters.zh: 以利亚将孩子从楼上抱下来，进屋子交给他母亲，说，看哪，你的儿子活了。

chapters.en: Then the woman said to Elijah, “Now I know that you are a man of God and that the word of the LORD from your mouth is the truth.”
chapters.zh: 妇人对以利亚说，现在我知道你是神人，耶和华借你口所说的话是真的。

chapters.en: After a long time, in the third year, the word of the LORD came to Elijah: “Go and present yourself to Ahab, and I will send rain on the land.”
chapters.zh: 过了许久，到第三年，耶和华的话临到以利亚说，你去，使亚哈得见你。我要降雨在地上。

chapters.en: So Elijah went to present himself to Ahab. Now the famine was severe in Samaria,
chapters.zh: 以利亚就去，要使亚哈得见他。那时，撒玛利亚有大饥荒。

chapters.en: and Ahab had summoned Obadiah, his palace administrator. (Obadiah was a devout believer in the LORD.
chapters.zh: 亚哈将他的家宰俄巴底召了来。俄巴底甚是敬畏耶和华，

chapters.en: While Jezebel was killing off the LORD’s prophets, Obadiah had taken a hundred prophets and hidden them in two caves, fifty in each, and had supplied them with food and water.)
chapters.zh: 耶洗别杀耶和华众先知的时候，俄巴底将一百个先知藏了，每五十人藏在一个洞里，拿饼和水供养他们。

chapters.en: Ahab had said to Obadiah, “Go through the land to all the springs and valleys. Maybe we can find some grass to keep the horses and mules alive so we will not have to kill any of our animals.”
chapters.zh: 亚哈对俄巴底说，我们走遍这地，到一切水泉旁和一切溪边，或者找得着青草，可以救活骡马，免得绝了牲畜。

chapters.en: So they divided the land they were to cover, Ahab going in one direction and Obadiah in another.
chapters.zh: 于是二人分地游行，亚哈独走一路，俄巴底独走一路。

chapters.en: As Obadiah was walking along, Elijah met him. Obadiah recognized him, bowed down to the ground, and said, “Is it really you, my lord Elijah?”
chapters.zh: 俄巴底在路上恰与以利亚相遇，俄巴底认出他来，就俯伏在地，说，你是我主以利亚不是。

chapters.en: “Yes,” he replied. “Go tell your master, ‘Elijah is here.’ ”
chapters.zh: 回答说，是。你去告诉你主人说，以利亚在这里。

chapters.en: “What have I done wrong,” asked Obadiah, “that you are handing your servant over to Ahab to be put to death?
chapters.zh: 俄巴底说，仆人有什么罪，你竟要将我交在亚哈手里，使他杀我呢？

chapters.en: As surely as the LORD your God lives, there is not a nation or kingdom where my master has not sent someone to look for you. And whenever a nation or kingdom claimed you were not there, he made them swear they could not find you.
chapters.zh: 我指着永生耶和华你的神起誓，无论哪一邦哪一国，我主都打发人去找你。若说你没有在那里，就必使那邦那国的人起誓说，实在是找不着你。

chapters.en: But now you tell me to go to my master and say, ‘Elijah is here.’
chapters.zh: 现在你说，要去告诉你主人说，以利亚在这里。

chapters.en: I don’t know where the Spirit of the LORD may carry you when I leave you. If I go and tell Ahab and he doesn’t find you, he will kill me. Yet I your servant have worshiped the LORD since my youth.
chapters.zh: 恐怕我一离开你，耶和华的灵就提你到我所不知道的地方去。这样，我去告诉亚哈，他若找不着你，就必杀我。仆人却是自幼敬畏耶和华的。

chapters.en: Haven’t you heard, my lord, what I did while Jezebel was killing the prophets of the LORD? I hid a hundred of the LORD’s prophets in two caves, fifty in each, and supplied them with food and water.
chapters.zh: 耶洗别杀耶和华众先知的时候，我将耶和华的一百个先知藏了，每五十人藏在一个洞里，拿饼和水供养他们，岂没有人将这事告诉我主吗？

chapters.en: And now you tell me to go to my master and say, ‘Elijah is here.’ He will kill me!”
chapters.zh: 现在你说，要去告诉你主人说，以利亚在这里，他必杀我。

chapters.en: Elijah said, “As the LORD Almighty lives, whom I serve, I will surely present myself to Ahab today.”
chapters.zh: 以利亚说，我指着所事奉永生的万军之耶和华起誓，我今日必使亚哈得见我。

chapters.en: So Obadiah went to meet Ahab and told him, and Ahab went to meet Elijah.
chapters.zh: 于是俄巴底去迎着亚哈，告诉他。亚哈就去迎着以利亚。

chapters.en: When he saw Elijah, he said to him, “Is that you, you troubler of Israel?”
chapters.zh: 亚哈见了以利亚，便说，使以色列遭灾的就是你吗？

chapters.en: “I have not made trouble for Israel,” Elijah replied. “But you and your father’s family have. You have abandoned the LORD’s commands and have followed the Baals.
chapters.zh: 以利亚说，使以色列遭灾的不是我，乃是你和你父家。因为你们离弃耶和华的诫命，去随从巴力。

chapters.en: Now summon the people from all over Israel to meet me on Mount Carmel. And bring the four hundred and fifty prophets of Baal and the four hundred prophets of Asherah, who eat at Jezebel’s table.”
chapters.zh: 现在你当差遣人，招聚以色列众人和事奉巴力的那四百五十个先知，并耶洗别所供养事奉亚舍拉的那四百个先知，使他们都上迦密山去见我。

chapters.en: So Ahab sent word throughout all Israel and assembled the prophets on Mount Carmel.
chapters.zh: 亚哈就差遣人招聚以色列众人和先知都上迦密山。

chapters.en: Elijah went before the people and said, “How long will you waver between two opinions? If the LORD is God, follow him; but if Baal is God, follow him.” But the people said nothing.
chapters.zh: 以利亚前来对众民说，你们心持两意要到几时呢？若耶和华是神，就当顺从耶和华。若巴力是神，就当顺从巴力。众民一言不答。

chapters.en: Then Elijah said to them, “I am the only one of the LORD’s prophets left, but Baal has four hundred and fifty prophets.
chapters.zh: 以利亚对众民说，作耶和华先知的只剩下我一个人。巴力的先知却有四百五十个人。

chapters.en: Get two bulls for us. Let Baal’s prophets choose one for themselves, and let them cut it into pieces and put it on the wood but not set fire to it. I will prepare the other bull and put it on the wood but not set fire to it.
chapters.zh: 当给我们两只牛犊，巴力的先知可以挑选一只，切成块子，放在柴上，不要点火。我也预备一只牛犊放在柴上，也不点火。

chapters.en: Then you call on the name of your god, and I will call on the name of the LORD. The god who answers by fire—he is God.” Then all the people said, “What you say is good.”
chapters.zh: 你们求告你们神的名，我也求告耶和华的名。那降火显应的神，就是神。众民回答说，这话甚好。

chapters.en: Elijah said to the prophets of Baal, “Choose one of the bulls and prepare it first, since there are so many of you. Call on the name of your god, but do not light the fire.”
chapters.zh: 以利亚对巴力的先知说，你们既是人多，当先挑选一只牛犊，预备好了，就求告你们神的名，却不要点火。

chapters.en: So they took the bull given them and prepared it. Then they called on the name of Baal from morning till noon. “Baal, answer us!” they shouted. But there was no response; no one answered. And they danced around the altar they had made.
chapters.zh: 他们将所得的牛犊预备好了，从早晨到午间，求告巴力的名说，巴力阿，求你应允我们。却没有声音，没有应允的。他们在所筑的坛四围踊跳。

chapters.en: At noon Elijah began to taunt them. “Shout louder!” he said. “Surely he is a god! Perhaps he is deep in thought, or busy, or traveling. Maybe he is sleeping and must be awakened.”
chapters.zh: 到了正午，以利亚嬉笑他们，说，大声求告吧。因为他是神，他或默想，或走到一边，或行路，或睡觉，你们当叫醒他。

chapters.en: So they shouted louder and slashed themselves with swords and spears, as was their custom, until their blood flowed.
chapters.zh: 他们大声求告，按着他们的规矩，用刀枪自割，自刺，直到身体流血。

chapters.en: Midday passed, and they continued their frantic prophesying until the time for the evening sacrifice. But there was no response, no one answered, no one paid attention.
chapters.zh: 从午后直到献晚祭的时候，他们狂呼乱叫，却没有声音，没有应允的，也没有理会的。

chapters.en: Then Elijah said to all the people, “Come here to me.” They came to him, and he repaired the altar of the LORD, which had been torn down.
chapters.zh: 以利亚对众民说，你们到我这里来。众民就到他那里。他便重修已经毁坏耶和华的坛。

chapters.en: Elijah took twelve stones, one for each of the tribes descended from Jacob, to whom the word of the LORD had come, saying, “Your name shall be Israel.”
chapters.zh: 以利亚照雅各子孙支派的数目，取了十二块石头（耶和华的话曾临到雅各说，你的名要叫以色列），

chapters.en: With the stones he built an altar in the name of the LORD, and he dug a trench around it large enough to hold two seahs of seed.
chapters.zh: 用这些石头为耶和华的名筑一座坛，在坛的四围挖沟，可容谷种二细亚，

chapters.en: He arranged the wood, cut the bull into pieces and laid it on the wood. Then he said to them, “Fill four large jars with water and pour it on the offering and on the wood.”
chapters.zh: 又在坛上摆好了柴，把牛犊切成块子放在柴上，对众人说，你们用四个桶盛满水，倒在燔祭和柴上。

chapters.en: “Do it again,” he said, and they did it again. “Do it a third time,” he ordered, and they did it the third time.
chapters.zh: 又说，倒第二次。他们就倒第二次。又说，倒第三次。他们就倒第三次。

chapters.en: The water ran down around the altar and even filled the trench.
chapters.zh: 水流在坛的四围，沟里也满了水。

chapters.en: At the time of sacrifice, the prophet Elijah stepped forward and prayed: “LORD, the God of Abraham, Isaac and Israel, let it be known today that you are God in Israel and that I am your servant and have done all these things at your command.
chapters.zh: 到了献晚祭的时候，先知以利亚近前来，说，亚伯拉罕，以撒，以色列的神，耶和华阿，求你今日使人知道你是以色列的神，也知道我是你的仆人，又是奉你的命行这一切事。

chapters.en: Answer me, LORD, answer me, so these people will know that you, LORD, are God, and that you are turning their hearts back again.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，求你应允我，应允我。使这民知道你耶和华是神，又知道是你叫这民的心回转。

chapters.en: Then the fire of the LORD fell and burned up the sacrifice, the wood, the stones and the soil, and also licked up the water in the trench.
chapters.zh: 于是，耶和华降下火来，烧尽燔祭，木柴，石头，尘土，又烧干沟里的水。

chapters.en: When all the people saw this, they fell prostrate and cried, “The LORD—he is God! The LORD—he is God!”
chapters.zh: 众民看见了，就俯伏在地，说，耶和华是神。耶和华是神。

chapters.en: Then Elijah commanded them, “Seize the prophets of Baal. Don’t let anyone get away!” They seized them, and Elijah had them brought down to the Kishon Valley and slaughtered there.
chapters.zh: 以利亚对他们说，拿住巴力的先知，不容一人逃脱。众人就拿住他们。以利亚带他们到基顺河边，在那里杀了他们。

chapters.en: And Elijah said to Ahab, “Go, eat and drink, for there is the sound of a heavy rain.”
chapters.zh: 以利亚对亚哈说，你现在可以上去吃喝，因为有多雨的响声了。

chapters.en: So Ahab went off to eat and drink, but Elijah climbed to the top of Carmel, bent down to the ground and put his face between his knees.
chapters.zh: 亚哈就上去吃喝。以利亚上了迦密山顶，屈身在地，将脸伏在两膝之中。

chapters.en: “Go and look toward the sea,” he told his servant. And he went up and looked. “There is nothing there,” he said. Seven times Elijah said, “Go back.”
chapters.zh: 对仆人说，你上去，向海观看。仆人就上去观看，说，没有什么。他说，你再去观看。如此七次。

chapters.en: The seventh time the servant reported, “A cloud as small as a man’s hand is rising from the sea.” So Elijah said, “Go and tell Ahab, ‘Hitch up your chariot and go down before the rain stops you.’ ”
chapters.zh: 第七次仆人说，我看见有一小片云从海里上来，不过如人手那样大。以利亚说，你上去告诉亚哈，当套车下去，免得被雨阻挡。

chapters.en: Meanwhile, the sky grew black with clouds, the wind rose, a heavy rain started falling and Ahab rode off to Jezreel.
chapters.zh: 霎时间，天因风云黑暗，降下大雨。亚哈就坐车往耶斯列去了。

chapters.en: The power of the LORD came on Elijah and, tucking his cloak into his belt, he ran ahead of Ahab all the way to Jezreel.
chapters.zh: 耶和华的灵（原文作手）降在以利亚身上，他就束上腰，奔在亚哈前头，直到耶斯列的城门。

chapters.en: Now Ahab told Jezebel everything Elijah had done and how he had killed all the prophets with the sword.
chapters.zh: 亚哈将以利亚一切所行的和他用刀杀众先知的事都告诉耶洗别。

chapters.en: So Jezebel sent a messenger to Elijah to say, “May the gods deal with me, be it ever so severely, if by this time tomorrow I do not make your life like that of one of them.”
chapters.zh: 耶洗别就差遣人去见以利亚，告诉他说，明日约在这时候，我若不使你的性命像那些人的性命一样，愿神明重重地降罚与我。

chapters.en: Elijah was afraid and ran for his life. When he came to Beersheba in Judah, he left his servant there,
chapters.zh: 以利亚见这光景就起来逃命，到了犹大的别是巴，将仆人留在那里，

chapters.en: while he himself went a day’s journey into the wilderness. He came to a broom bush, sat down under it and prayed that he might die. “I have had enough, LORD,” he said. “Take my life; I am no better than my ancestors.”
chapters.zh: 自己在旷野走了一日的路程，来到一棵罗腾树下（罗腾，小树名，松类。下同），就坐在那里求死，说，耶和华阿，罢了。求你取我的性命，因为我不胜于我的列祖。

chapters.en: Then he lay down under the bush and fell asleep. All at once an angel touched him and said, “Get up and eat.”
chapters.zh: 他就躺在罗腾树下，睡着了。有一个天使拍他，说，起来吃吧。

chapters.en: He looked around, and there by his head was some bread baked over hot coals, and a jar of water. He ate and drank and then lay down again.
chapters.zh: 他观看，见头旁有一瓶水与炭火烧的饼，他就吃了喝了，仍然躺下。

chapters.en: The angel of the LORD came back a second time and touched him and said, “Get up and eat, for the journey is too much for you.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华的使者第二次来拍他，说，起来吃吧。因为你当走的路甚远。

chapters.en: So he got up and ate and drank. Strengthened by that food, he traveled forty days and forty nights until he reached Horeb, the mountain of God.
chapters.zh: 他就起来吃了喝了，仗着这饮食的力，走了四十昼夜，到了神的山，就是何烈山。

chapters.en: There he went into a cave and spent the night. And the word of the LORD came to him: “What are you doing here, Elijah?”
chapters.zh: 他在那里进了一个洞，就住在洞中。耶和华的话临到他说，以利亚阿，你在这里作什么。

chapters.en: He replied, “I have been very zealous for the LORD God Almighty. The Israelites have rejected your covenant, torn down your altars, and put your prophets to death with the sword. I am the only one left, and now they are trying to kill me too.”
chapters.zh: 他说，我为耶和华万军之神大发热心。因为以色列人背弃了你的约，毁坏了你的坛，用刀杀了你的先知，只剩下我一个人，他们还要寻索我的命。

chapters.en: The LORD said, “Go out and stand on the mountain in the presence of the LORD, for the LORD is about to pass by.” Then a great and powerful wind tore the mountains apart and shattered the rocks before the LORD, but the LORD was not in the wind. After the wind there was an earthquake, but the LORD was not in the earthquake.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说，你出来站在山上，在我面前。那时耶和华从那里经过，在他面前有烈风大作，崩山碎石，耶和华却不在风中。风后地震，耶和华却不在其中。

chapters.en: After the earthquake came a fire, but the LORD was not in the fire. And after the fire came a gentle whisper.
chapters.zh: 地震后有火，耶和华也不在火中。火后有微小的声音。

chapters.en: When Elijah heard it, he pulled his cloak over his face and went out and stood at the mouth of the cave. Then a voice said to him, “What are you doing here, Elijah?”
chapters.zh: 以利亚听见，就用外衣蒙上脸，出来站在洞口。有声音向他说，以利亚阿，你在这里作什么。

chapters.en: He replied, “I have been very zealous for the LORD God Almighty. The Israelites have rejected your covenant, torn down your altars, and put your prophets to death with the sword. I am the only one left, and now they are trying to kill me too.”
chapters.zh: 他说，我为耶和华万军之神大发热心。因为以色列人背弃了你的约，毁坏了你的坛，用刀杀了你的先知，只剩下我一个人，他们还要寻索我的命。

chapters.en: The LORD said to him, “Go back the way you came, and go to the Desert of Damascus. When you get there, anoint Hazael king over Aram.
chapters.zh: 耶和华对他说，你回去，从旷野往大马色去。到了那里，就要膏哈薛作亚兰王，

chapters.en: Also, anoint Jehu son of Nimshi king over Israel, and anoint Elisha son of Shaphat from Abel Meholah to succeed you as prophet.
chapters.zh: 又膏宁示的孙子耶户作以色列王，并膏亚伯米何拉人沙法的儿子以利沙作先知接续你。

chapters.en: Jehu will put to death any who escape the sword of Hazael, and Elisha will put to death any who escape the sword of Jehu.
chapters.zh: 将来躲避哈薛之刀的，必被耶户所杀。躲避耶户之刀的，必被以利沙所杀。

chapters.en: Yet I reserve seven thousand in Israel—all whose knees have not bowed down to Baal and whose mouths have not kissed him.”
chapters.zh: 但我在以色列人中为自己留下七千人，是未曾向巴力屈膝的，未曾与巴力亲嘴的。

chapters.en: So Elijah went from there and found Elisha son of Shaphat. He was plowing with twelve yoke of oxen, and he himself was driving the twelfth pair. Elijah went up to him and threw his cloak around him.
chapters.zh: 于是，以利亚离开那里走了，遇见沙法的儿子以利沙耕地。在他前头有十二对牛，自己赶着第十二对。以利亚到他那里去，将自己的外衣搭在他身上。

chapters.en: Elisha then left his oxen and ran after Elijah. “Let me kiss my father and mother goodbye,” he said, “and then I will come with you.” “Go back,” Elijah replied. “What have I done to you?”
chapters.zh: 以利沙就离开牛，跑到以利亚那里，说，求你容我先与父母亲嘴，然后我便跟随你。以利亚对他说，你回去吧，我向你作了什么呢？

chapters.en: So Elisha left him and went back. He took his yoke of oxen and slaughtered them. He burned the plowing equipment to cook the meat and gave it to the people, and they ate. Then he set out to follow Elijah and became his servant.
chapters.zh: 以利沙就离开他回去，宰了一对牛，用套牛的器具煮肉给民吃，随后就起身跟随以利亚，服事他。

chapters.en: Now Ben-Hadad king of Aram mustered his entire army. Accompanied by thirty-two kings with their horses and chariots, he went up and besieged Samaria and attacked it.
chapters.zh: 亚兰王便哈达聚集他的全军，率领三十二个王，带着车马上来围攻撒玛利亚。

chapters.en: He sent messengers into the city to Ahab king of Israel, saying, “This is what Ben-Hadad says:
chapters.zh: 又差遣使者进城见以色列王亚哈，对他说，便哈达如此说，

chapters.en: ‘Your silver and gold are mine, and the best of your wives and children are mine.’ ”
chapters.zh: 你的金银都要归我，你妻子儿女中最美的也要归我。

chapters.en: The king of Israel answered, “Just as you say, my lord the king. I and all I have are yours.”
chapters.zh: 以色列王回答说，我主我王阿，可以依着你的话，我与我所有的都归你。

chapters.en: The messengers came again and said, “This is what Ben-Hadad says: ‘I sent to demand your silver and gold, your wives and your children.
chapters.zh: 使者又来说，便哈达如此说，我已差遣人去见你，要你将你的金银，妻子，儿女都给我。

chapters.en: But about this time tomorrow I am going to send my officials to search your palace and the houses of your officials. They will seize everything you value and carry it away.’ ”
chapters.zh: 但明日约在这时候，我还要差遣臣仆到你那里，搜查你的家和你仆人的家，将你眼中一切所喜爱的都拿了去。

chapters.en: The king of Israel summoned all the elders of the land and said to them, “See how this man is looking for trouble! When he sent for my wives and my children, my silver and my gold, I did not refuse him.”
chapters.zh: 以色列王召了国中的长老来，对他们说，请你们看看，这人是怎样地谋害我，他先差遣人到我这里来，要我的妻子，儿女，和金银，我并没有推辞他。

chapters.en: The elders and the people all answered, “Don’t listen to him or agree to his demands.”
chapters.zh: 长老和百姓对王说，不要听从他，也不要应允他。

chapters.en: So he replied to Ben-Hadad’s messengers, “Tell my lord the king, ‘Your servant will do all you demanded the first time, but this demand I cannot meet.’ ” They left and took the answer back to Ben-Hadad.
chapters.zh: 故此，以色列王对便哈达的使者说，你们告诉我主我王说，王头一次差遣人向仆人所要的，仆人都依从。但这次所要的，我不能依从。使者就去回覆便哈达。

chapters.en: Then Ben-Hadad sent another message to Ahab: “May the gods deal with me, be it ever so severely, if enough dust remains in Samaria to give each of my men a handful.”
chapters.zh: 便哈达又差遣人去见亚哈说，撒玛利亚的尘土若够跟从我的人每人捧一捧的，愿神明重重地降罚与我。

chapters.en: The king of Israel answered, “Tell him: ‘One who puts on his armor should not boast like one who takes it off.’ ”
chapters.zh: 以色列王说，你告诉他说，才顶盔贯甲的，休要像摘盔卸甲的夸口。

chapters.en: Ben-Hadad heard this message while he and the kings were drinking in their tents, and he ordered his men: “Prepare to attack.” So they prepared to attack the city.
chapters.zh: 便哈达和诸王正在帐幕里喝酒，听见这话，就对他臣仆说，摆队吧。他们就摆队攻城。

chapters.en: Meanwhile a prophet came to Ahab king of Israel and announced, “This is what the LORD says: ‘Do you see this vast army? I will give it into your hand today, and then you will know that I am the LORD.’ ”
chapters.zh: 有一个先知来见以色列王亚哈，说，耶和华如此说，这一大群人你看见了吗？今日我必将他们交在你手里，你就知道我是耶和华。

chapters.en: “But who will do this?” asked Ahab. The prophet replied, “This is what the LORD says: ‘The junior officers under the provincial commanders will do it.’ ” “And who will start the battle?” he asked. The prophet answered, “You will.”
chapters.zh: 亚哈说，借着谁呢？他回答说，耶和华说，借着跟从省长的少年人。亚哈说，要谁率领呢？他说，要你亲自率领。

chapters.en: So Ahab summoned the 232 junior officers under the provincial commanders. Then he assembled the rest of the Israelites, 7,000 in all.
chapters.zh: 于是亚哈数点跟从省长的少年人，共有二百三十二名，后又数点以色列的众兵，共有七千名。

chapters.en: They set out at noon while Ben-Hadad and the 32 kings allied with him were in their tents getting drunk.
chapters.zh: 午间，他们就出城。便哈达和帮助他的三十二个王正在帐幕里痛饮。

chapters.en: The junior officers under the provincial commanders went out first. Now Ben-Hadad had dispatched scouts, who reported, “Men are advancing from Samaria.”
chapters.zh: 跟从省长的少年人先出城。便哈达差遣人去探望，他们回报说，有人从撒玛利亚出来了。

chapters.en: He said, “If they have come out for peace, take them alive; if they have come out for war, take them alive.”
chapters.zh: 他说，他们若为讲和出来，要活捉他们。若为打仗出来，也要活捉他们。

chapters.en: The junior officers under the provincial commanders marched out of the city with the army behind them
chapters.zh: 跟从省长的少年人出城，军兵跟随他们。

chapters.en: and each one struck down his opponent. At that, the Arameans fled, with the Israelites in pursuit. But Ben-Hadad king of Aram escaped on horseback with some of his horsemen.
chapters.zh: 各人遇见敌人就杀。亚兰人逃跑，以色列人追赶他们。亚兰王便哈达骑着马和马兵一同逃跑。

chapters.en: The king of Israel advanced and overpowered the horses and chariots and inflicted heavy losses on the Arameans.
chapters.zh: 以色列王出城攻打车马，大大击杀亚兰人。

chapters.en: Afterward, the prophet came to the king of Israel and said, “Strengthen your position and see what must be done, because next spring the king of Aram will attack you again.”
chapters.zh: 那先知来见以色列王，对他说，你当自强，留心怎样防备。因为到明年这时候，亚兰王必上来攻击你。

chapters.en: Meanwhile, the officials of the king of Aram advised him, “Their gods are gods of the hills. That is why they were too strong for us. But if we fight them on the plains, surely we will be stronger than they.
chapters.zh: 亚兰王的臣仆对亚兰王说，以色列人的神是山神，所以他们胜过我们。但在平原与他们打仗，我们必定得胜。

chapters.en: Do this: Remove all the kings from their commands and replace them with other officers.
chapters.zh: 王当这样行，把诸王革去，派军长代替他们，

chapters.en: You must also raise an army like the one you lost—horse for horse and chariot for chariot—so we can fight Israel on the plains. Then surely we will be stronger than they.” He agreed with them and acted accordingly.
chapters.zh: 又照着王丧失军兵之数，再招募一军，马补马，车补车，我们在平原与他们打仗，必定得胜。王便听臣仆的话去行。

chapters.en: The next spring Ben-Hadad mustered the Arameans and went up to Aphek to fight against Israel.
chapters.zh: 次年，便哈达果然点齐亚兰人上亚弗去，要与以色列人打仗。

chapters.en: When the Israelites were also mustered and given provisions, they marched out to meet them. The Israelites camped opposite them like two small flocks of goats, while the Arameans covered the countryside.
chapters.zh: 以色列人也点齐军兵，预备食物，迎着亚兰人出去，对着他们安营，好像两小群山羊羔。亚兰人却满了地面。

chapters.en: The man of God came up and told the king of Israel, “This is what the LORD says: ‘Because the Arameans think the LORD is a god of the hills and not a god of the valleys, I will deliver this vast army into your hands, and you will know that I am the LORD.’ ”
chapters.zh: 有神人来见以色列王，说，耶和华如此说，亚兰人既说我耶和华是山神，不是平原的神，所以我必将这一大群人都交在你手中，你们就知道我是耶和华。

chapters.en: For seven days they camped opposite each other, and on the seventh day the battle was joined. The Israelites inflicted a hundred thousand casualties on the Aramean foot soldiers in one day.
chapters.zh: 以色列人与亚兰人相对安营七日，到第七日两军交战。那一日以色列人杀了亚兰人步兵十万，

chapters.en: The rest of them escaped to the city of Aphek, where the wall collapsed on twenty-seven thousand of them. And Ben-Hadad fled to the city and hid in an inner room.
chapters.zh: 其余的逃入亚弗城。城墙塌倒，压死剩下的二万七千人。便哈达也逃入城，藏在严密的屋子里。

chapters.en: His officials said to him, “Look, we have heard that the kings of Israel are merciful. Let us go to the king of Israel with sackcloth around our waists and ropes around our heads. Perhaps he will spare your life.”
chapters.zh: 他的臣仆对他说，我们听说以色列王都是仁慈的王，现在我们不如腰束麻布，头套绳索，出去投降以色列王，或者他存留王的性命。

chapters.en: Wearing sackcloth around their waists and ropes around their heads, they went to the king of Israel and said, “Your servant Ben-Hadad says: ‘Please let me live.’ ” The king answered, “Is he still alive? He is my brother.”
chapters.zh: 于是他们腰束麻布，头套绳索，去见以色列王，说，王的仆人便哈达说，求王存留我的性命。亚哈说，他还活着吗？他是我的兄弟。

chapters.en: The men took this as a good sign and were quick to pick up his word. “Yes, your brother Ben-Hadad!” they said. “Go and get him,” the king said. When Ben-Hadad came out, Ahab had him come up into his chariot.
chapters.zh: 这些人留心探出他的口气来，便急忙就着他的话说，便哈达是王的兄弟。王说，你们去请他来。便哈达出来见王，王就请他上车。

chapters.en: “I will return the cities my father took from your father,” Ben-Hadad offered. “You may set up your own market areas in Damascus, as my father did in Samaria.” Ahab said, “On the basis of a treaty I will set you free.” So he made a treaty with him, and let him go.
chapters.zh: 便哈达对王说，我父从你父那里所夺的城邑，我必归还。你可以在大马色立街市，像我父在撒玛利亚所立的一样。亚哈说，我照此立约，放你回去，就与他立约，放他去了。

chapters.en: By the word of the LORD one of the company of the prophets said to his companion, “Strike me with your weapon,” but he refused.
chapters.zh: 有先知的一个门徒奉耶和华的命对他的同伴说，你打我吧。那人不肯打他。

chapters.en: So the prophet said, “Because you have not obeyed the LORD, as soon as you leave me a lion will kill you.” And after the man went away, a lion found him and killed him.
chapters.zh: 他就对那人说，你既不听从耶和华的话，你一离开我，必有狮子咬死你。那人一离开他，果然遇见狮子，把他咬死了。

chapters.en: The prophet found another man and said, “Strike me, please.” So the man struck him and wounded him.
chapters.zh: 先知的门徒又遇见一个人，对他说，你打我吧。那人就打他，将他打伤。

chapters.en: Then the prophet went and stood by the road waiting for the king. He disguised himself with his headband down over his eyes.
chapters.zh: 他就去了，用头巾蒙眼，改换面目，在路旁等候王。

chapters.en: As the king passed by, the prophet called out to him, “Your servant went into the thick of the battle, and someone came to me with a captive and said, ‘Guard this man. If he is missing, it will be your life for his life, or you must pay a talent of silver.’
chapters.zh: 王从那里经过，他向王呼叫说，仆人在阵上的时候，有人带了一个人来，对我说，你看守这人，若把他失了，你的性命必代替他的性命。不然，你必交出一他连得银子来。

chapters.en: While your servant was busy here and there, the man disappeared.” “That is your sentence,” the king of Israel said. “You have pronounced it yourself.”
chapters.zh: 仆人正在忙乱之间，那人就不见了。以色列王对他说，你自己定妥了，必照样判断你。

chapters.en: Then the prophet quickly removed the headband from his eyes, and the king of Israel recognized him as one of the prophets.
chapters.zh: 他急忙除掉蒙眼的头巾，以色列王就认出他是一个先知。

chapters.en: He said to the king, “This is what the LORD says: ‘You have set free a man I had determined should die. Therefore it is your life for his life, your people for his people.’ ”
chapters.zh: 他对王说，耶和华如此说，因你将我定要灭绝的人放去，你的命就必代替他的命，你的民也必代替他的民。

chapters.en: Sullen and angry, the king of Israel went to his palace in Samaria.
chapters.zh: 于是以色列王闷闷不乐地回到撒玛利亚，进了他的宫。

chapters.en: Some time later there was an incident involving a vineyard belonging to Naboth the Jezreelite. The vineyard was in Jezreel, close to the palace of Ahab king of Samaria.
chapters.zh: 这事以后，又有一事。耶斯列人拿伯在耶斯列有一个葡萄园，靠近撒玛利亚王亚哈的宫。

chapters.en: Ahab said to Naboth, “Let me have your vineyard to use for a vegetable garden, since it is close to my palace. In exchange I will give you a better vineyard or, if you prefer, I will pay you whatever it is worth.”
chapters.zh: 亚哈对拿伯说，你将你的葡萄园给我作菜园，因为是靠近我的宫。我就把更好的葡萄园换给你，或是你要银子，我就按着价值给你。

chapters.en: But Naboth replied, “The LORD forbid that I should give you the inheritance of my ancestors.”
chapters.zh: 拿伯对亚哈说，我敬畏耶和华，万不敢将我先人留下的产业给你。

chapters.en: So Ahab went home, sullen and angry because Naboth the Jezreelite had said, “I will not give you the inheritance of my ancestors.” He lay on his bed sulking and refused to eat.
chapters.zh: 亚哈因耶斯列人拿伯说我不敢将我先人留下的产业给你，就闷闷不乐地回宫，躺在床上，转脸向内，也不吃饭。

chapters.en: His wife Jezebel came in and asked him, “Why are you so sullen? Why won’t you eat?”
chapters.zh: 王后耶洗别来问他说，你为什么心里这样忧闷，不吃饭呢？

chapters.en: He answered her, “Because I said to Naboth the Jezreelite, ‘Sell me your vineyard; or if you prefer, I will give you another vineyard in its place.’ But he said, ‘I will not give you my vineyard.’ ”
chapters.zh: 他回答说，因我向耶斯列人拿伯说，你将你的葡萄园给我，我给你价银，或是你愿意，我就把别的葡萄园换给你。他却说，我不将我的葡萄园给你。

chapters.en: Jezebel his wife said, “Is this how you act as king over Israel? Get up and eat! Cheer up. I’ll get you the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite.”
chapters.zh: 王后耶洗别对亚哈说，你现在是治理以色列国不是。只管起来，心里畅畅快快地吃饭，我必将耶斯列人拿伯的葡萄园给你。

chapters.en: So she wrote letters in Ahab’s name, placed his seal on them, and sent them to the elders and nobles who lived in Naboth’s city with him.
chapters.zh: 于是托亚哈的名写信，用王的印印上，送给那些与拿伯同城居住的长老贵胄。

chapters.en: In those letters she wrote: “Proclaim a day of fasting and seat Naboth in a prominent place among the people.
chapters.zh: 信上写着说，你们当宣告禁食，叫拿伯坐在民间的高位上，

chapters.en: But seat two scoundrels opposite him and have them bring charges that he has cursed both God and the king. Then take him out and stone him to death.”
chapters.zh: 又叫两个匪徒坐在拿伯对面，作见证告他说，你谤渎神和王了。随后就把他拉出去用石头打死。

chapters.en: So the elders and nobles who lived in Naboth’s city did as Jezebel directed in the letters she had written to them.
chapters.zh: 那些与拿伯同城居住的长老贵胄得了耶洗别的信，就照信而行，

chapters.en: They proclaimed a fast and seated Naboth in a prominent place among the people.
chapters.zh: 宣告禁食，叫拿伯坐在民间的高位上。

chapters.en: Then two scoundrels came and sat opposite him and brought charges against Naboth before the people, saying, “Naboth has cursed both God and the king.” So they took him outside the city and stoned him to death.
chapters.zh: 有两个匪徒来，坐在拿伯的对面，当着众民作见证告他说，拿伯谤渎神和王了。众人就把他拉到城外，用石头打死。

chapters.en: Then they sent word to Jezebel: “Naboth has been stoned to death.”
chapters.zh: 于是打发人去见耶洗别，说，拿伯被石头打死了。

chapters.en: As soon as Jezebel heard that Naboth had been stoned to death, she said to Ahab, “Get up and take possession of the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite that he refused to sell you. He is no longer alive, but dead.”
chapters.zh: 耶洗别听见拿伯被石头打死，就对亚哈说，你起来得耶斯列人拿伯不肯为价银给你的葡萄园吧。现在他已经死了。

chapters.en: When Ahab heard that Naboth was dead, he got up and went down to take possession of Naboth’s vineyard.
chapters.zh: 亚哈听见拿伯死了，就起来，下去要得耶斯列人拿伯的葡萄园。

chapters.en: Then the word of the LORD came to Elijah the Tishbite:
chapters.zh: 耶和华的话临到提斯比人以利亚说，

chapters.en: “Go down to meet Ahab king of Israel, who rules in Samaria. He is now in Naboth’s vineyard, where he has gone to take possession of it.
chapters.zh: 你起来，去见住撒玛利亚的以色列王亚哈，他下去要得拿伯的葡萄园，现今正在那园里。

chapters.en: Say to him, ‘This is what the LORD says: Have you not murdered a man and seized his property?’ Then say to him, ‘This is what the LORD says: In the place where dogs licked up Naboth’s blood, dogs will lick up your blood—yes, yours!’ ”
chapters.zh: 你要对他说，耶和华如此说，你杀了人，又得他的产业吗？又要对他说，耶和华如此说，狗在何处舔拿伯的血，也必在何处舔你的血。

chapters.en: Ahab said to Elijah, “So you have found me, my enemy!” “I have found you,” he answered, “because you have sold yourself to do evil in the eyes of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 亚哈对以利亚说，我仇敌阿，你找到我吗？他回答说，我找到你了。因为你卖了自己，行耶和华眼中看为恶的事。

chapters.en: He says, ‘I am going to bring disaster on you. I will wipe out your descendants and cut off from Ahab every last male in Israel—slave or free.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说，我必使灾祸临到你，将你除尽。凡属你的男丁，无论困住的，自由的，都从以色列中剪除。

chapters.en: I will make your house like that of Jeroboam son of Nebat and that of Baasha son of Ahijah, because you have aroused my anger and have caused Israel to sin.’
chapters.zh: 我必使你的家像尼八的儿子耶罗波安的家，又像亚希雅的儿子巴沙的家。因为你惹我发怒，又使以色列人陷在罪里。

chapters.en: “And also concerning Jezebel the LORD says: ‘Dogs will devour Jezebel by the wall of Jezreel.’
chapters.zh: 论到耶洗别，耶和华也说，狗在耶斯列的外郭必吃耶洗别的肉。

chapters.en: “Dogs will eat those belonging to Ahab who die in the city, and the birds will feed on those who die in the country.”
chapters.zh: 凡属亚哈的人，死在城中的必被狗吃，死在田野的必被空中的鸟吃。

chapters.en: (There was never anyone like Ahab, who sold himself to do evil in the eyes of the LORD, urged on by Jezebel his wife.
chapters.zh: （从来没有像亚哈的，因他自卖，行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，受了王后耶洗别的耸动。

chapters.en: He behaved in the vilest manner by going after idols, like the Amorites the LORD drove out before Israel.)
chapters.zh: 就照耶和华在以色列人面前所赶出的亚摩利人，行了最可憎恶的事，信从偶像。）

chapters.en: When Ahab heard these words, he tore his clothes, put on sackcloth and fasted. He lay in sackcloth and went around meekly.
chapters.zh: 亚哈听见这话，就撕裂衣服，禁食，身穿麻布，睡卧也穿着麻布，并且缓缓而行。

chapters.en: Then the word of the LORD came to Elijah the Tishbite:
chapters.zh: 耶和华的话临到提斯比人以利亚说，

chapters.en: “Have you noticed how Ahab has humbled himself before me? Because he has humbled himself, I will not bring this disaster in his day, but I will bring it on his house in the days of his son.”
chapters.zh: 亚哈在我面前这样自卑，你看见了吗？因他在我面前自卑，他还在世的时候，我不降这祸。到他儿子的时候，我必降这祸与他的家。

chapters.en: For three years there was no war between Aram and Israel.
chapters.zh: 亚兰国和以色列国三年没有争战。

chapters.en: But in the third year Jehoshaphat king of Judah went down to see the king of Israel.
chapters.zh: 到第三年，犹大王约沙法下去见以色列王。

chapters.en: The king of Israel had said to his officials, “Don’t you know that Ramoth Gilead belongs to us and yet we are doing nothing to retake it from the king of Aram?”
chapters.zh: 以色列王对臣仆说，你们不知道基列的拉末是属我们的吗？我们岂可静坐不动，不从亚兰王手里夺回来吗？

chapters.en: So he asked Jehoshaphat, “Will you go with me to fight against Ramoth Gilead?” Jehoshaphat replied to the king of Israel, “I am as you are, my people as your people, my horses as your horses.”
chapters.zh: 亚哈问约沙法说，你肯同我去攻取基列的拉末吗？约沙法对以色列王说，你我不分彼此，我的民与你的民一样，我的马与你的马一样。

chapters.en: But Jehoshaphat also said to the king of Israel, “First seek the counsel of the LORD.”
chapters.zh: 约沙法对以色列王说，请你先求问耶和华。

chapters.en: So the king of Israel brought together the prophets—about four hundred men—and asked them, “Shall I go to war against Ramoth Gilead, or shall I refrain?” “Go,” they answered, “for the Lord will give it into the king’s hand.”
chapters.zh: 于是以色列王招聚先知，约有四百人，问他们说，我上去攻取基列的拉末可以不可以。他们说，可以上去，因为主必将那城交在王的手里。

chapters.en: But Jehoshaphat asked, “Is there no longer a prophet of the LORD here whom we can inquire of?”
chapters.zh: 约沙法说，这里不是还有耶和华的先知，我们可以求问他吗？

chapters.en: The king of Israel answered Jehoshaphat, “There is still one prophet through whom we can inquire of the LORD, but I hate him because he never prophesies anything good about me, but always bad. He is Micaiah son of Imlah.” “The king should not say such a thing,” Jehoshaphat replied.
chapters.zh: 以色列王对约沙法说，还有一个人，是音拉的儿子米该雅，我们可以托他求问耶和华。只是我恨他。因为他指着我所说的预言，不说吉语，单说凶言。约沙法说，王不必这样说。

chapters.en: So the king of Israel called one of his officials and said, “Bring Micaiah son of Imlah at once.”
chapters.zh: 以色列王就召了一个太监来，说，你快去，将音拉的儿子米该雅召来。

chapters.en: Dressed in their royal robes, the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat king of Judah were sitting on their thrones at the threshing floor by the entrance of the gate of Samaria, with all the prophets prophesying before them.
chapters.zh: 以色列王和犹大王约沙法在撒玛利亚城门前的空场上，各穿朝服，坐在位上，所有的先知都在他们面前说预言。

chapters.en: Now Zedekiah son of Kenaanah had made iron horns and he declared, “This is what the LORD says: ‘With these you will gore the Arameans until they are destroyed.’ ”
chapters.zh: 基拿拿的儿子西底家造了两个铁角，说，耶和华如此说，你要用这角抵触亚兰人，直到将他们灭尽。

chapters.en: All the other prophets were prophesying the same thing. “Attack Ramoth Gilead and be victorious,” they said, “for the LORD will give it into the king’s hand.”
chapters.zh: 所有的先知也都这样预言说，可以上基列的拉末去，必然得胜，因为耶和华必将那城交在王的手中。

chapters.en: The messenger who had gone to summon Micaiah said to him, “Look, the other prophets without exception are predicting success for the king. Let your word agree with theirs, and speak favorably.”
chapters.zh: 那去召米该雅的使者对米该雅说。众先知一口同音地都向王说吉言，你不如与他们说一样的话，也说吉言。

chapters.en: But Micaiah said, “As surely as the LORD lives, I can tell him only what the LORD tells me.”
chapters.zh: 米该雅说，我指着永生的耶和华起誓，耶和华对我说什么，我就说什么。

chapters.en: When he arrived, the king asked him, “Micaiah, shall we go to war against Ramoth Gilead, or not?” “Attack and be victorious,” he answered, “for the LORD will give it into the king’s hand.”
chapters.zh: 米该雅到王面前，王问他说，米该雅阿，我们上去攻取基列的拉末可以不可以。他回答说，可以上去，必然得胜，耶和华必将那城交在王的手中。

chapters.en: The king said to him, “How many times must I make you swear to tell me nothing but the truth in the name of the LORD?”
chapters.zh: 王对他说，我当嘱咐你几次，你才奉耶和华的名向我说实话呢？

chapters.en: Then Micaiah answered, “I saw all Israel scattered on the hills like sheep without a shepherd, and the LORD said, ‘These people have no master. Let each one go home in peace.’ ”
chapters.zh: 米该雅说，我看见以色列众民散在山上，如同没有牧人的羊群一般。耶和华说，这民没有主人，他们可以平平安安地各归各家去。

chapters.en: The king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, “Didn’t I tell you that he never prophesies anything good about me, but only bad?”
chapters.zh: 以色列王对约沙法说，我岂没有告诉你，这人指着我所说的预言，不说吉语单说凶言吗？

chapters.en: Micaiah continued, “Therefore hear the word of the LORD: I saw the LORD sitting on his throne with all the multitudes of heaven standing around him on his right and on his left.
chapters.zh: 米该雅说，你要听耶和华的话。我看见耶和华坐在宝座上，天上的万军侍立在他左右。

chapters.en: And the LORD said, ‘Who will entice Ahab into attacking Ramoth Gilead and going to his death there?’ “One suggested this, and another that.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说，谁去引诱亚哈上基列的拉末去阵亡呢？这个就这样说，那个就那样说。

chapters.en: Finally, a spirit came forward, stood before the LORD and said, ‘I will entice him.’
chapters.zh: 随后有一个神灵出来，站在耶和华面前，说，我去引诱他。

chapters.en: “ ‘By what means?’ the LORD asked. “ ‘I will go out and be a deceiving spirit in the mouths of all his prophets,’ he said. “ ‘You will succeed in enticing him,’ said the LORD. ‘Go and do it.’
chapters.zh: 耶和华问他说，你用何法呢？他说，我去，要在他众先知口中作谎言的灵。耶和华说，这样，你必能引诱他，你去如此行吧。

chapters.en: “So now the LORD has put a deceiving spirit in the mouths of all these prophets of yours. The LORD has decreed disaster for you.”
chapters.zh: 现在耶和华使谎言的灵入了你这些先知的口，并且耶和华已经命定降祸与你。

chapters.en: Then Zedekiah son of Kenaanah went up and slapped Micaiah in the face. “Which way did the spirit from the LORD go when he went from me to speak to you?” he asked.
chapters.zh: 基拿拿的儿子西底家前来，打米该雅的脸，说，耶和华的灵从哪里离开我与你说话呢？

chapters.en: Micaiah replied, “You will find out on the day you go to hide in an inner room.”
chapters.zh: 米该雅说，你进严密的屋子藏躲的那日，就必看见了。

chapters.en: The king of Israel then ordered, “Take Micaiah and send him back to Amon the ruler of the city and to Joash the king’s son
chapters.zh: 以色列王说，将米该雅带回，交给邑宰亚们和王的儿子约阿施，说

chapters.en: and say, ‘This is what the king says: Put this fellow in prison and give him nothing but bread and water until I return safely.’ ”
chapters.zh: 王如此说，把这个人下在监里，使他受苦，吃不饱喝不足，等候我平平安安地回来。

chapters.en: Micaiah declared, “If you ever return safely, the LORD has not spoken through me.” Then he added, “Mark my words, all you people!”
chapters.zh: 米该雅说，你若能平平安安地回来，那就是耶和华没有借我说这话了。又说，众民哪，你们都要听。

chapters.en: So the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat king of Judah went up to Ramoth Gilead.
chapters.zh: 以色列王和犹大王约沙法上基列的拉末去了。

chapters.en: The king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, “I will enter the battle in disguise, but you wear your royal robes.” So the king of Israel disguised himself and went into battle.
chapters.zh: 以色列王对约沙法说，我要改装上阵，你可以仍穿王服。以色列王就改装上阵。

chapters.en: Now the king of Aram had ordered his thirty-two chariot commanders, “Do not fight with anyone, small or great, except the king of Israel.”
chapters.zh: 先是亚兰王吩咐他的三十二个车兵长说，他们的兵将，无论大小，你们都不可与他们争战，只要与以色列王争战。

chapters.en: When the chariot commanders saw Jehoshaphat, they thought, “Surely this is the king of Israel.” So they turned to attack him, but when Jehoshaphat cried out,
chapters.zh: 车兵长看见约沙法，便说，这必是以色列王。就转过去与他争战，约沙法便呼喊。

chapters.en: the chariot commanders saw that he was not the king of Israel and stopped pursuing him.
chapters.zh: 车兵长见不是以色列王，就转去不追他了。

chapters.en: But someone drew his bow at random and hit the king of Israel between the sections of his armor. The king told his chariot driver, “Wheel around and get me out of the fighting. I’ve been wounded.”
chapters.zh: 有一人随便开弓，恰巧射入以色列王的甲缝里。王对赶车的说，我受了重伤，你转过车来，拉我出阵吧。

chapters.en: All day long the battle raged, and the king was propped up in his chariot facing the Arameans. The blood from his wound ran onto the floor of the chariot, and that evening he died.
chapters.zh: 那日，阵势越战越猛，有人扶王站在车上，抵挡亚兰人。到晚上，王就死了，血从伤处流在车中。

chapters.en: As the sun was setting, a cry spread through the army: “Every man to his town. Every man to his land!”
chapters.zh: 约在日落的时候，有号令传遍军中，说，各归本城，各归本地吧。
