chapters.en: As for the other events of the reign of Joash, and all he did, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Judah?
chapters.zh: 约阿施其余的事，凡他所行的都写在犹大列王记上。

chapters.en: His officials conspired against him and assassinated him at Beth Millo, on the road down to Silla.
chapters.zh: 约阿施的臣仆起来背叛，在下悉拉的米罗宫那里将他杀了。

chapters.en: The officials who murdered him were Jozabad son of Shimeath and Jehozabad son of Shomer. He died and was buried with his ancestors in the City of David. And Amaziah his son succeeded him as king.
chapters.zh: 杀他的那臣仆就是示米押的儿子约撒甲和朔默的儿子约萨拔。众人将他葬在大卫城他列祖的坟地里。他儿子亚玛谢接续他作王。

chapters.en: In the twenty-third year of Joash son of Ahaziah king of Judah, Jehoahaz son of Jehu became king of Israel in Samaria, and he reigned seventeen years.
chapters.zh: 犹大王亚哈谢的儿子约阿施二十三年，耶户的儿子约哈斯在撒玛利亚登基作以色列王十七年。

chapters.en: He did evil in the eyes of the LORD by following the sins of Jeroboam son of Nebat, which he had caused Israel to commit, and he did not turn away from them.
chapters.zh: 约哈斯行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，效法尼八的儿子耶罗波安使以色列人陷在罪里的那罪，总不离开。

chapters.en: So the LORD’s anger burned against Israel, and for a long time he kept them under the power of Hazael king of Aram and Ben-Hadad his son.
chapters.zh: 于是，耶和华的怒气向以色列人发作，将他们屡次交在亚兰王哈薛和他儿子便哈达的手里。

chapters.en: Then Jehoahaz sought the LORD’s favor, and the LORD listened to him, for he saw how severely the king of Aram was oppressing Israel.
chapters.zh: 约哈斯恳求耶和华，耶和华就应允他，因为见以色列人所受亚兰王的欺压。

chapters.en: The LORD provided a deliverer for Israel, and they escaped from the power of Aram. So the Israelites lived in their own homes as they had before.
chapters.zh: 耶和华赐给以色列人一位拯救者，使他们脱离亚兰人的手。于是以色列人仍旧安居在家里。

chapters.en: But they did not turn away from the sins of the house of Jeroboam, which he had caused Israel to commit; they continued in them. Also, the Asherah pole remained standing in Samaria.
chapters.zh: 然而他们不离开耶罗波安家使以色列人陷在罪里的那罪，仍然去行，并且在撒玛利亚留下亚舍拉。

chapters.en: Nothing had been left of the army of Jehoahaz except fifty horsemen, ten chariots and ten thousand foot soldiers, for the king of Aram had destroyed the rest and made them like the dust at threshing time.
chapters.zh: 亚兰王灭绝约哈斯的民，践踏他们如禾场上的尘沙，只给约哈斯留下五十马兵，十辆战车，一万步兵。

chapters.en: As for the other events of the reign of Jehoahaz, all he did and his achievements, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Israel?
chapters.zh: 约哈斯其余的事，凡他所行的和他的勇力都写在以色列诸王记上。

chapters.en: Jehoahaz rested with his ancestors and was buried in Samaria. And Jehoash his son succeeded him as king.
chapters.zh: 约哈斯与他列祖同睡，葬在撒玛利亚。他儿子约阿施接续他作王。

chapters.en: In the thirty-seventh year of Joash king of Judah, Jehoash son of Jehoahaz became king of Israel in Samaria, and he reigned sixteen years.
chapters.zh: 犹大王约阿施三十七年，约哈斯的儿子约阿施在撒玛利亚登基作以色列王十六年。

chapters.en: He did evil in the eyes of the LORD and did not turn away from any of the sins of Jeroboam son of Nebat, which he had caused Israel to commit; he continued in them.
chapters.zh: 他行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，不离开尼八的儿子耶罗波安使以色列人陷在罪里的一切罪，仍然去行。

chapters.en: As for the other events of the reign of Jehoash, all he did and his achievements, including his war against Amaziah king of Judah, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Israel?
chapters.zh: 约阿施其余的事，凡他所行的和他与犹大王亚玛谢争战的勇力，都写在以色列诸王记上。

chapters.en: Jehoash rested with his ancestors, and Jeroboam succeeded him on the throne. Jehoash was buried in Samaria with the kings of Israel.
chapters.zh: 约阿施与他列祖同睡，耶罗波安坐了他的位。约阿施与以色列诸王一同葬在撒玛利亚。

chapters.en: Now Elisha had been suffering from the illness from which he died. Jehoash king of Israel went down to see him and wept over him. “My father! My father!” he cried. “The chariots and horsemen of Israel!”
chapters.zh: 以利沙得了必死的病，以色列王约阿施下来看他，伏在他脸上哭泣，说，我父阿。我父阿。以色列的战车马兵阿。

chapters.en: Elisha said, “Get a bow and some arrows,” and he did so.
chapters.zh: 以利沙对他说，你取弓箭来。王就取了弓箭来。

chapters.en: “Take the bow in your hands,” he said to the king of Israel. When he had taken it, Elisha put his hands on the king’s hands.
chapters.zh: 又对以色列王说，你用手拿弓。王就用手拿弓。以利沙按手在王的手上，

chapters.en: “Open the east window,” he said, and he opened it. “Shoot!” Elisha said, and he shot. “The LORD’s arrow of victory, the arrow of victory over Aram!” Elisha declared. “You will completely destroy the Arameans at Aphek.”
chapters.zh: 说，你开朝东的窗户。他就开了。以利沙说，射箭吧。他就射箭。以利沙说，这是耶和华的得胜箭，就是战胜亚兰人的箭。因为你必在亚弗攻打亚兰人，直到灭尽他们。

chapters.en: Then he said, “Take the arrows,” and the king took them. Elisha told him, “Strike the ground.” He struck it three times and stopped.
chapters.zh: 以利沙又说，取几枝箭来。他就取了来。以利沙说，打地吧。他打了三次，便止住了。

chapters.en: The man of God was angry with him and said, “You should have struck the ground five or six times; then you would have defeated Aram and completely destroyed it. But now you will defeat it only three times.”
chapters.zh: 神人向他发怒，说，应当击打五六次，就能攻打亚兰人直到灭尽。现在只能打败亚兰人三次。

chapters.en: Elisha died and was buried. Now Moabite raiders used to enter the country every spring.
chapters.zh: 以利沙死了，人将他葬埋。到了新年，有一群摩押人犯境，

chapters.en: Once while some Israelites were burying a man, suddenly they saw a band of raiders; so they threw the man’s body into Elisha’s tomb. When the body touched Elisha’s bones, the man came to life and stood up on his feet.
chapters.zh: 有人正葬死人，忽然看见一群人，就把死人抛在以利沙的坟墓里，一碰着以利沙的骸骨，死人就复活，站起来了。

chapters.en: Hazael king of Aram oppressed Israel throughout the reign of Jehoahaz.
chapters.zh: 约哈斯年间，亚兰王哈薛屡次欺压以色列人。

chapters.en: But the LORD was gracious to them and had compassion and showed concern for them because of his covenant with Abraham, Isaac and Jacob. To this day he has been unwilling to destroy them or banish them from his presence.
chapters.zh: 耶和华却因与亚伯拉罕，以撒，雅各所立的约，仍施恩给以色列人，怜恤他们，眷顾他们，不肯灭尽他们，尚未赶逐他们离开自己面前。

chapters.en: Hazael king of Aram died, and Ben-Hadad his son succeeded him as king.
chapters.zh: 亚兰王哈薛死了，他儿子便哈达接续他作王。

chapters.en: Then Jehoash son of Jehoahaz recaptured from Ben-Hadad son of Hazael the towns he had taken in battle from his father Jehoahaz. Three times Jehoash defeated him, and so he recovered the Israelite towns.
chapters.zh: 从前哈薛和约阿施的父亲约哈斯争战，攻取了些城邑，现在约哈斯的儿子约阿施三次打败哈薛的儿子便哈达，就收回了以色列的城邑。

chapters.en: In the second year of Jehoash son of Jehoahaz king of Israel, Amaziah son of Joash king of Judah began to reign.
chapters.zh: 以色列王约哈斯的儿子约阿施第二年，犹大王约阿施的儿子亚玛谢登基。

chapters.en: He was twenty-five years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem twenty-nine years. His mother’s name was Jehoaddan; she was from Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 他登基的时候年二十五岁，在耶路撒冷作王二十九年。他母亲名叫约耶但，是耶路撒冷人。

chapters.en: He did what was right in the eyes of the LORD, but not as his father David had done. In everything he followed the example of his father Joash.
chapters.zh: 亚玛谢行耶和华眼中看为正的事，但不如他祖大卫，乃效法他父约阿施一切所行的。

chapters.en: The high places, however, were not removed; the people continued to offer sacrifices and burn incense there.
chapters.zh: 只是丘坛还没有废去，百姓仍在那里献祭烧香。

chapters.en: After the kingdom was firmly in his grasp, he executed the officials who had murdered his father the king.
chapters.zh: 国一坚定，就把杀他父王的臣仆杀了，

chapters.en: Yet he did not put the children of the assassins to death, in accordance with what is written in the Book of the Law of Moses where the LORD commanded: “Parents are not to be put to death for their children, nor children put to death for their parents; each will die for their own sin.”
chapters.zh: 却没有治死杀王之人的儿子，是照摩西律法书上耶和华所吩咐的说，不可因子杀父，也不可因父杀子，各人要为本身的罪而死。

chapters.en: He was the one who defeated ten thousand Edomites in the Valley of Salt and captured Sela in battle, calling it Joktheel, the name it has to this day.
chapters.zh: 亚玛谢在盐谷杀了以东人一万，又攻取了西拉，改名叫约帖，直到今日。

chapters.en: Then Amaziah sent messengers to Jehoash son of Jehoahaz, the son of Jehu, king of Israel, with the challenge: “Come, let us face each other in battle.”
chapters.zh: 那时，亚玛谢差遣使者去见耶户的孙子约哈斯的儿子以色列王约阿施，说，你来，我们二人相见于战场。

chapters.en: But Jehoash king of Israel replied to Amaziah king of Judah: “A thistle in Lebanon sent a message to a cedar in Lebanon, ‘Give your daughter to my son in marriage.’ Then a wild beast in Lebanon came along and trampled the thistle underfoot.
chapters.zh: 以色列王约阿施差遣使者去见犹大王亚玛谢，说，利巴嫩的蒺藜差遣使者去见利巴嫩的香柏树，说，将你的女儿给我儿子为妻。后来利巴嫩有一个野兽经过，把蒺藜践踏了。

chapters.en: You have indeed defeated Edom and now you are arrogant. Glory in your victory, but stay at home! Why ask for trouble and cause your own downfall and that of Judah also?”
chapters.zh: 你打败了以东人就心高气傲，你以此为荣耀，在家里安居就罢了，为何要惹祸，使自己和犹大国一同败亡呢？

chapters.en: Amaziah, however, would not listen, so Jehoash king of Israel attacked. He and Amaziah king of Judah faced each other at Beth Shemesh in Judah.
chapters.zh: 亚玛谢却不肯听这话。于是以色列王约阿施上来，在犹大的伯示麦与犹大王亚玛谢相见于战场。

chapters.en: Judah was routed by Israel, and every man fled to his home.
chapters.zh: 犹大人败在以色列人面前，各自逃回家里去了。

chapters.en: Jehoash king of Israel captured Amaziah king of Judah, the son of Joash, the son of Ahaziah, at Beth Shemesh. Then Jehoash went to Jerusalem and broke down the wall of Jerusalem from the Ephraim Gate to the Corner Gate—a section about four hundred cubits long.
chapters.zh: 以色列王约阿施在伯示麦擒住亚哈谢的孙子，约阿施的儿子犹大王亚玛谢，就来到耶路撒冷，拆毁耶路撒冷的城墙，从以法莲门直到角门共四百肘，

chapters.en: He took all the gold and silver and all the articles found in the temple of the LORD and in the treasuries of the royal palace. He also took hostages and returned to Samaria.
chapters.zh: 又将耶和华殿里与王宫府库里所有的金银和器皿都拿了去，并带人去为质，就回撒玛利亚去了。

chapters.en: As for the other events of the reign of Jehoash, what he did and his achievements, including his war against Amaziah king of Judah, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Israel?
chapters.zh: 约阿施其余所行的事和他的勇力，并与犹大王亚玛谢争战的事，都写在以色列诸王记上。

chapters.en: Jehoash rested with his ancestors and was buried in Samaria with the kings of Israel. And Jeroboam his son succeeded him as king.
chapters.zh: 约阿施与他列祖同睡，葬在撒玛利亚，以色列诸王的坟地里。他儿子耶罗波安接续他作王。

chapters.en: Amaziah son of Joash king of Judah lived for fifteen years after the death of Jehoash son of Jehoahaz king of Israel.
chapters.zh: 以色列王约哈斯的儿子约阿施死后，犹大王约阿施的儿子亚玛谢又活了十五年。

chapters.en: As for the other events of Amaziah’s reign, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Judah?
chapters.zh: 亚玛谢其余的事都写在犹大列王记上。

chapters.en: They conspired against him in Jerusalem, and he fled to Lachish, but they sent men after him to Lachish and killed him there.
chapters.zh: 耶路撒冷有人背叛亚玛谢，他就逃到拉吉。叛党却打发人到拉吉将他杀了。

chapters.en: He was brought back by horse and was buried in Jerusalem with his ancestors, in the City of David.
chapters.zh: 人就用马将他的尸首驮到耶路撒冷，葬在大卫城他列祖的坟地里。

chapters.en: Then all the people of Judah took Azariah, who was sixteen years old, and made him king in place of his father Amaziah.
chapters.zh: 犹大众民立亚玛谢的儿子亚撒利雅（又名乌西雅）接续他父作王，那时他年十六岁。

chapters.en: He was the one who rebuilt Elath and restored it to Judah after Amaziah rested with his ancestors.
chapters.zh: 亚玛谢与他列祖同睡之后，亚撒利雅收回以拉他仍归犹大，又重新修理。

chapters.en: In the fifteenth year of Amaziah son of Joash king of Judah, Jeroboam son of Jehoash king of Israel became king in Samaria, and he reigned forty-one years.
chapters.zh: 犹大王约阿施的儿子亚玛谢十五年，以色列王约阿施的儿子耶罗波安在撒玛利亚登基，作王四十一年。

chapters.en: He did evil in the eyes of the LORD and did not turn away from any of the sins of Jeroboam son of Nebat, which he had caused Israel to commit.
chapters.zh: 他行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，不离开尼八的儿子耶罗波安使以色列人陷在罪里的一切罪。

chapters.en: He was the one who restored the boundaries of Israel from Lebo Hamath to the Dead Sea, in accordance with the word of the LORD, the God of Israel, spoken through his servant Jonah son of Amittai, the prophet from Gath Hepher.
chapters.zh: 他收回以色列边界之地，从哈马口直到亚拉巴海，正如耶和华以色列的神，借他仆人迦特希弗人亚米太的儿子先知约拿所说的。

chapters.en: The LORD had seen how bitterly everyone in Israel, whether slave or free, was suffering; there was no one to help them.
chapters.zh: 因为耶和华看见以色列人甚是艰苦，无论困住的，自由的都没有了，也无人帮助以色列人。

chapters.en: And since the LORD had not said he would blot out the name of Israel from under heaven, he saved them by the hand of Jeroboam son of Jehoash.
chapters.zh: 耶和华并没有说要将以色列的名从天下涂抹，乃借约阿施的儿子耶罗波安拯救他们。

chapters.en: As for the other events of Jeroboam’s reign, all he did, and his military achievements, including how he recovered for Israel both Damascus and Hamath, which had belonged to Judah, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Israel?
chapters.zh: 耶罗波安其余的事，凡他所行的和他的勇力，他怎样争战，怎样收回大马色和先前属犹大的哈马归以色列，都写在以色列诸王记上。

chapters.en: Jeroboam rested with his ancestors, the kings of Israel. And Zechariah his son succeeded him as king.
chapters.zh: 耶罗波安与他列祖以色列诸王同睡。他儿子撒迦利雅接续他作王。

chapters.en: In the twenty-seventh year of Jeroboam king of Israel, Azariah son of Amaziah king of Judah began to reign.
chapters.zh: 以色列王耶罗波安二十七年，犹大王亚玛谢的儿子亚撒利雅登基，

chapters.en: He was sixteen years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem fifty-two years. His mother’s name was Jekoliah; she was from Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 他登基的时候年十六岁，在耶路撒冷作王五十二年。他母亲名叫耶可利雅，是耶路撒冷人。

chapters.en: He did what was right in the eyes of the LORD, just as his father Amaziah had done.
chapters.zh: 亚撒利雅行耶和华眼中看为正的事，效法他父亲亚玛谢一切所行的。

chapters.en: The high places, however, were not removed; the people continued to offer sacrifices and burn incense there.
chapters.zh: 只是丘坛还没有废去，百姓仍在那里献祭烧香。

chapters.en: The LORD afflicted the king with leprosy until the day he died, and he lived in a separate house. Jotham the king’s son had charge of the palace and governed the people of the land.
chapters.zh: 耶和华降灾与王，使他长大麻疯，直到死日，他就住在别的宫里。他的儿子约坦管理家事，治理国民。

chapters.en: As for the other events of Azariah’s reign, and all he did, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Judah?
chapters.zh: 亚撒利雅其余的事，凡他所行的都写在犹大列王记上。

chapters.en: Azariah rested with his ancestors and was buried near them in the City of David. And Jotham his son succeeded him as king.
chapters.zh: 亚撒利雅与他列祖同睡，葬在大卫城他列祖的坟地里。他儿子约坦接续他作王。

chapters.en: In the thirty-eighth year of Azariah king of Judah, Zechariah son of Jeroboam became king of Israel in Samaria, and he reigned six months.
chapters.zh: 犹大王亚撒利雅三十八年，耶罗波安的儿子撒迦利雅在撒玛利亚作以色列王六个月。

chapters.en: He did evil in the eyes of the LORD, as his predecessors had done. He did not turn away from the sins of Jeroboam son of Nebat, which he had caused Israel to commit.
chapters.zh: 他行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，效法他列祖所行的，不离开尼八的儿子耶罗波安使以色列人陷在罪里的那罪。

chapters.en: Shallum son of Jabesh conspired against Zechariah. He attacked him in front of the people, assassinated him and succeeded him as king.
chapters.zh: 雅比的儿子沙龙背叛他，在百姓面前击杀他，篡了他的位。

chapters.en: The other events of Zechariah’s reign are written in the book of the annals of the kings of Israel.
chapters.zh: 撒迦利雅其余的事都写在以色列诸王记上。

chapters.en: So the word of the LORD spoken to Jehu was fulfilled: “Your descendants will sit on the throne of Israel to the fourth generation.”
chapters.zh: 这是从前耶和华应许耶户说，你的子孙必坐以色列的国位直到四代。这话果然应验了。

chapters.en: Shallum son of Jabesh became king in the thirty-ninth year of Uzziah king of Judah, and he reigned in Samaria one month.
chapters.zh: 犹大王乌西雅（就是亚撒利雅）三十九年，雅比的儿子沙龙登基在撒玛利亚作王一个月。

chapters.en: Then Menahem son of Gadi went from Tirzah up to Samaria. He attacked Shallum son of Jabesh in Samaria, assassinated him and succeeded him as king.
chapters.zh: 迦底的儿子米拿现从得撒上撒玛利亚，杀了雅比的儿子沙龙，篡了他的位。

chapters.en: The other events of Shallum’s reign, and the conspiracy he led, are written in the book of the annals of the kings of Israel.
chapters.zh: 沙龙其余的事和他背叛的情形都写在以色列诸王记上。

chapters.en: At that time Menahem, starting out from Tirzah, attacked Tiphsah and everyone in the city and its vicinity, because they refused to open their gates. He sacked Tiphsah and ripped open all the pregnant women.
chapters.zh: 那时米拿现从得撒起攻打提斐萨和其四境，击杀城中一切的人，剖开其中所有的孕妇，都因他们没有给他开城。

chapters.en: In the thirty-ninth year of Azariah king of Judah, Menahem son of Gadi became king of Israel, and he reigned in Samaria ten years.
chapters.zh: 犹大王亚撒利雅三十九年，迦底的儿子米拿现登基，在撒玛利亚作以色列王十年。

chapters.en: He did evil in the eyes of the LORD. During his entire reign he did not turn away from the sins of Jeroboam son of Nebat, which he had caused Israel to commit.
chapters.zh: 他行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，终身不离开尼八的儿子耶罗波安使以色列人陷在罪里的那罪。

chapters.en: Then Pul king of Assyria invaded the land, and Menahem gave him a thousand talents of silver to gain his support and strengthen his own hold on the kingdom.
chapters.zh: 亚述王普勒来攻击以色列国，米拿现给他一千他连得银子，请普勒帮助他坚定国位。

chapters.en: Menahem exacted this money from Israel. Every wealthy person had to contribute fifty shekels of silver to be given to the king of Assyria. So the king of Assyria withdrew and stayed in the land no longer.
chapters.zh: 米拿现向以色列一切大富户索要银子，使他们各出五十舍客勒，就给了亚述王。于是亚述王回去，不在国中停留。

chapters.en: As for the other events of Menahem’s reign, and all he did, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Israel?
chapters.zh: 米拿现其余的事，凡他所行的都写在以色列诸王记上。

chapters.en: Menahem rested with his ancestors. And Pekahiah his son succeeded him as king.
chapters.zh: 米拿现与他列祖同睡。他儿子比加辖接续他作王。

chapters.en: In the fiftieth year of Azariah king of Judah, Pekahiah son of Menahem became king of Israel in Samaria, and he reigned two years.
chapters.zh: 犹大王亚撒利雅五十年，米拿现的儿子比加辖在撒玛利亚登基作以色列王二年。

chapters.en: Pekahiah did evil in the eyes of the LORD. He did not turn away from the sins of Jeroboam son of Nebat, which he had caused Israel to commit.
chapters.zh: 他行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，不离开尼八的儿子耶罗波安使以色列人陷在罪里的那罪。

chapters.en: One of his chief officers, Pekah son of Remaliah, conspired against him. Taking fifty men of Gilead with him, he assassinated Pekahiah, along with Argob and Arieh, in the citadel of the royal palace at Samaria. So Pekah killed Pekahiah and succeeded him as king.
chapters.zh: 比加辖的将军，利玛利的儿子比加背叛他，在撒玛利亚王宫里的卫所杀了他。亚珥歌伯和亚利耶并基列的五十人帮助比加。比加击杀他，篡了他的位。

chapters.en: The other events of Pekahiah’s reign, and all he did, are written in the book of the annals of the kings of Israel.
chapters.zh: 比加辖其余的事，凡他所行的都写在以色列诸王记上。

chapters.en: In the fifty-second year of Azariah king of Judah, Pekah son of Remaliah became king of Israel in Samaria, and he reigned twenty years.
chapters.zh: 犹大王亚撒利雅五十二年，利玛利的儿子比加在撒玛利亚登基作以色列王二十年。

chapters.en: He did evil in the eyes of the LORD. He did not turn away from the sins of Jeroboam son of Nebat, which he had caused Israel to commit.
chapters.zh: 他行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，不离开尼八的儿子耶罗波安使以色列人陷在罪里的那罪。

chapters.en: In the time of Pekah king of Israel, Tiglath-Pileser king of Assyria came and took Ijon, Abel Beth Maakah, Janoah, Kedesh and Hazor. He took Gilead and Galilee, including all the land of Naphtali, and deported the people to Assyria.
chapters.zh: 以色列王比加年间，亚述王提革拉毗列色来夺了以云，亚伯伯玛迦，亚挪，基低斯，夏琐，基列，加利利，和拿弗他利全地，将这些地方的居民都掳到亚述去了。

chapters.en: Then Hoshea son of Elah conspired against Pekah son of Remaliah. He attacked and assassinated him, and then succeeded him as king in the twentieth year of Jotham son of Uzziah.
chapters.zh: 乌西雅的儿子约坦二十年，以拉的儿子何细亚背叛利玛利的儿子比加，击杀他，篡了他的位。

chapters.en: As for the other events of Pekah’s reign, and all he did, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Israel?
chapters.zh: 比加其余的事，凡他所行的都写在以色列诸王记上。

chapters.en: In the second year of Pekah son of Remaliah king of Israel, Jotham son of Uzziah king of Judah began to reign.
chapters.zh: 以色列王利玛利的儿子比加第二年，犹大王乌西雅的儿子约坦登基。

chapters.en: He was twenty-five years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem sixteen years. His mother’s name was Jerusha daughter of Zadok.
chapters.zh: 他登基的时候年二十五岁，在耶路撒冷作王十六年。他母亲名叫耶路沙，是撒督的女儿。

chapters.en: He did what was right in the eyes of the LORD, just as his father Uzziah had done.
chapters.zh: 约坦行耶和华眼中看为正的事，效法他父亲乌西雅一切所行的。

chapters.en: The high places, however, were not removed; the people continued to offer sacrifices and burn incense there. Jotham rebuilt the Upper Gate of the temple of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 只是丘坛还没有废去，百姓仍在那里献祭烧香。约坦建立耶和华殿的上门。

chapters.en: As for the other events of Jotham’s reign, and what he did, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Judah?
chapters.zh: 约坦其余的事，凡他所行的都写在犹大列王记上。

chapters.en: (In those days the LORD began to send Rezin king of Aram and Pekah son of Remaliah against Judah.)
chapters.zh: 在那些日子，耶和华才使亚兰王利汛和利玛利的儿子比加去攻击犹大。

chapters.en: Jotham rested with his ancestors and was buried with them in the City of David, the city of his father. And Ahaz his son succeeded him as king.
chapters.zh: 约坦与他列祖同睡，葬在他祖大卫城他列祖的坟地里。他儿子亚哈斯接续他作王。

chapters.en: In the seventeenth year of Pekah son of Remaliah, Ahaz son of Jotham king of Judah began to reign.
chapters.zh: 利玛利的儿子比加十七年，犹大王约坦的儿子亚哈斯登基。

chapters.en: Ahaz was twenty years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem sixteen years. Unlike David his father, he did not do what was right in the eyes of the LORD his God.
chapters.zh: 他登基的时候年二十岁，在耶路撒冷作王十六年。不像他祖大卫行耶和华他神眼中看为正的事，

chapters.en: He followed the ways of the kings of Israel and even sacrificed his son in the fire, engaging in the detestable practices of the nations the LORD had driven out before the Israelites.
chapters.zh: 却效法以色列诸王所行的，又照着耶和华从以色列人面前赶出的外邦人所行可憎的事，使他的儿子经火，

chapters.en: He offered sacrifices and burned incense at the high places, on the hilltops and under every spreading tree.
chapters.zh: 并在丘坛上，山冈上，各青翠树下献祭烧香。

chapters.en: Then Rezin king of Aram and Pekah son of Remaliah king of Israel marched up to fight against Jerusalem and besieged Ahaz, but they could not overpower him.
chapters.zh: 亚兰王利汛和以色列王利玛利的儿子比加上来攻打耶路撒冷，围困亚哈斯，却不能胜他。

chapters.en: At that time, Rezin king of Aram recovered Elath for Aram by driving out the people of Judah. Edomites then moved into Elath and have lived there to this day.
chapters.zh: 当时亚兰王利汛收回以拉他归与亚兰，将犹大人从以拉他赶出去。亚兰人（有作以东人的）就来到以拉他，住在那里，直到今日。

chapters.en: Ahaz sent messengers to say to Tiglath-Pileser king of Assyria, “I am your servant and vassal. Come up and save me out of the hand of the king of Aram and of the king of Israel, who are attacking me.”
chapters.zh: 亚哈斯差遣使者去见亚述王提革拉毗列色，说，我是你的仆人，你的儿子。现在亚兰王和以色列王攻击我，求你来救我脱离他们的手。

chapters.en: And Ahaz took the silver and gold found in the temple of the LORD and in the treasuries of the royal palace and sent it as a gift to the king of Assyria.
chapters.zh: 亚哈斯将耶和华殿里和王宫府库里所有的金银都送给亚述王为礼物。

chapters.en: The king of Assyria complied by attacking Damascus and capturing it. He deported its inhabitants to Kir and put Rezin to death.
chapters.zh: 亚述王应允了他，就上去攻打大马色，将城攻取，杀了利汛，把居民掳到吉珥。

chapters.en: Then King Ahaz went to Damascus to meet Tiglath-Pileser king of Assyria. He saw an altar in Damascus and sent to Uriah the priest a sketch of the altar, with detailed plans for its construction.
chapters.zh: 亚哈斯王上大马色去迎接亚述王提革拉毗列色，在大马色看见一座坛，就照坛的规模样式作法画了图样，送到祭司乌利亚那里。

chapters.en: So Uriah the priest built an altar in accordance with all the plans that King Ahaz had sent from Damascus and finished it before King Ahaz returned.
chapters.zh: 祭司乌利亚照着亚哈斯王从大马色送来的图样，在亚哈斯王没有从大马色回来之先，建筑一座坛。

chapters.en: When the king came back from Damascus and saw the altar, he approached it and presented offerings on it.
chapters.zh: 王从大马色回来看见坛，就近前来，在坛上献祭。

chapters.en: He offered up his burnt offering and grain offering, poured out his drink offering, and splashed the blood of his fellowship offerings against the altar.
chapters.zh: 烧燔祭，素祭，浇奠祭，将平安祭牲的血洒在坛上，

chapters.en: As for the bronze altar that stood before the LORD, he brought it from the front of the temple—from between the new altar and the temple of the LORD—and put it on the north side of the new altar.
chapters.zh: 又将耶和华面前的铜坛从耶和华殿和新坛的中间搬到新坛的北边。

chapters.en: King Ahaz then gave these orders to Uriah the priest: “On the large new altar, offer the morning burnt offering and the evening grain offering, the king’s burnt offering and his grain offering, and the burnt offering of all the people of the land, and their grain offering and their drink offering. Splash against this altar the blood of all the burnt offerings and sacrifices. But I will use the bronze altar for seeking guidance.”
chapters.zh: 亚哈斯王吩咐祭司乌利亚说，早晨的燔祭，晚上的素祭，王的燔祭，素祭，国内众民的燔祭，素祭，奠祭都要烧在大坛上。燔祭牲和平安祭牲的血也要洒在这坛上，只是铜坛我要用以求问耶和华。

chapters.en: And Uriah the priest did just as King Ahaz had ordered.
chapters.zh: 祭司乌利亚就照着亚哈斯王所吩咐的行了。

chapters.en: King Ahaz cut off the side panels and removed the basins from the movable stands. He removed the Sea from the bronze bulls that supported it and set it on a stone base.
chapters.zh: 亚哈斯王打掉盆座四面镶着的心子，把盆从座上挪下来，又将铜海从驮海的铜牛上搬下来，放在铺石地。

chapters.en: He took away the Sabbath canopy that had been built at the temple and removed the royal entryway outside the temple of the LORD, in deference to the king of Assyria.
chapters.zh: 又因亚述王的缘故，将耶和华殿为安息日所盖的廊子和王从外入殿的廊子挪移，围绕耶和华的殿。

chapters.en: As for the other events of the reign of Ahaz, and what he did, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Judah?
chapters.zh: 亚哈斯其余所行的事都写在犹大列王记上。

chapters.en: Ahaz rested with his ancestors and was buried with them in the City of David. And Hezekiah his son succeeded him as king.
chapters.zh: 亚哈斯与他列祖同睡，葬在大卫城他列祖的坟地里。他儿子希西家接续他作王。

chapters.en: In the twelfth year of Ahaz king of Judah, Hoshea son of Elah became king of Israel in Samaria, and he reigned nine years.
chapters.zh: 犹大王亚哈斯十二年，以拉的儿子何细亚在撒玛利亚登基作以色列王九年。

chapters.en: He did evil in the eyes of the LORD, but not like the kings of Israel who preceded him.
chapters.zh: 他行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，只是不像在他以前的以色列诸王。

chapters.en: Shalmaneser king of Assyria came up to attack Hoshea, who had been Shalmaneser’s vassal and had paid him tribute.
chapters.zh: 亚述王撒缦以色上来攻击何细亚，何细亚就服事他，给他进贡。

chapters.en: But the king of Assyria discovered that Hoshea was a traitor, for he had sent envoys to So king of Egypt, and he no longer paid tribute to the king of Assyria, as he had done year by year. Therefore Shalmaneser seized him and put him in prison.
chapters.zh: 何细亚背叛，差人去见埃及王梭，不照往年所行的与亚述王进贡。亚述王知道了，就把他锁禁，囚在监里。

chapters.en: The king of Assyria invaded the entire land, marched against Samaria and laid siege to it for three years.
chapters.zh: 亚述王上来攻击以色列遍地，上到撒玛利亚，围困三年。

chapters.en: In the ninth year of Hoshea, the king of Assyria captured Samaria and deported the Israelites to Assyria. He settled them in Halah, in Gozan on the Habor River and in the towns of the Medes.
chapters.zh: 何细亚第九年亚述王攻取了撒玛利亚，将以色列人掳到亚述，把他们安置在哈腊与歌散的哈博河边，并玛代人的城邑。

chapters.en: All this took place because the Israelites had sinned against the LORD their God, who had brought them up out of Egypt from under the power of Pharaoh king of Egypt. They worshiped other gods
chapters.zh: 这是因以色列人得罪那领他们出埃及地，脱离埃及王法老手的耶和华他们的神，去敬畏别神，

chapters.en: and followed the practices of the nations the LORD had driven out before them, as well as the practices that the kings of Israel had introduced.
chapters.zh: 随从耶和华在他们面前所赶出外邦人的风俗和以色列诸王所立的条规。

chapters.en: The Israelites secretly did things against the LORD their God that were not right. From watchtower to fortified city they built themselves high places in all their towns.
chapters.zh: 以色列人暗中行不正的事，违背耶和华他们的神，在他们所有的城邑，从了望楼直到坚固城，建筑丘坛。

chapters.en: They set up sacred stones and Asherah poles on every high hill and under every spreading tree.
chapters.zh: 在各高冈上，各青翠树下立柱像和木偶。

chapters.en: At every high place they burned incense, as the nations whom the LORD had driven out before them had done. They did wicked things that aroused the LORD’s anger.
chapters.zh: 在丘坛上烧香，效法耶和华在他们面前赶出的外邦人所行的，又行恶事惹动耶和华的怒气。

chapters.en: They worshiped idols, though the LORD had said, “You shall not do this.”
chapters.zh: 且事奉偶像，就是耶和华警戒他们不可行的。

chapters.en: The LORD warned Israel and Judah through all his prophets and seers: “Turn from your evil ways. Observe my commands and decrees, in accordance with the entire Law that I commanded your ancestors to obey and that I delivered to you through my servants the prophets.”
chapters.zh: 但耶和华借众先知，先见劝戒以色列人和犹大人说，当离开你们的恶行，谨守我的诫命律例，遵行我吩咐你们列祖，并借我仆人众先知所传给你们的律法。

chapters.en: But they would not listen and were as stiff-necked as their ancestors, who did not trust in the LORD their God.
chapters.zh: 他们却不听从，竟硬着颈项，效法他们列祖，不信服耶和华他们的神，

chapters.en: They rejected his decrees and the covenant he had made with their ancestors and the statutes he had warned them to keep. They followed worthless idols and themselves became worthless. They imitated the nations around them although the LORD had ordered them, “Do not do as they do.”
chapters.zh: 厌弃他的律例和他与他们列祖所立的约，并劝戒他们的话，随从虚无的神，自己成为虚妄，效法周围的外邦人，就是耶和华嘱咐他们不可效法的。

chapters.en: They forsook all the commands of the LORD their God and made for themselves two idols cast in the shape of calves, and an Asherah pole. They bowed down to all the starry hosts, and they worshiped Baal.
chapters.zh: 离弃耶和华他们神的一切诫命，为自己铸了两个牛犊的像，立了亚舍拉，敬拜天上的万象，事奉巴力，

chapters.en: They sacrificed their sons and daughters in the fire. They practiced divination and sought omens and sold themselves to do evil in the eyes of the LORD, arousing his anger.
chapters.zh: 又使他们的儿女经火，用占卜，行法术卖了自己，行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，惹动他的怒气。

chapters.en: So the LORD was very angry with Israel and removed them from his presence. Only the tribe of Judah was left,
chapters.zh: 所以耶和华向以色列人大大发怒，从自己面前赶出他们，只剩下犹大一个支派。

chapters.en: and even Judah did not keep the commands of the LORD their God. They followed the practices Israel had introduced.
chapters.zh: 犹大人也不遵守耶和华他们神的诫命，随从以色列人所立的条规。

chapters.en: Therefore the LORD rejected all the people of Israel; he afflicted them and gave them into the hands of plunderers, until he thrust them from his presence.
chapters.zh: 耶和华就厌弃以色列全族，使他们受苦，把他们交在抢夺他们的人手中，以致赶出他们离开自己面前，

chapters.en: When he tore Israel away from the house of David, they made Jeroboam son of Nebat their king. Jeroboam enticed Israel away from following the LORD and caused them to commit a great sin.
chapters.zh: 将以色列国从大卫家夺回。他们就立尼八的儿子耶罗波安作王。耶罗波安引诱以色列人不随从耶和华，陷在大罪里。

chapters.en: The Israelites persisted in all the sins of Jeroboam and did not turn away from them
chapters.zh: 以色列人犯耶罗波安所犯的一切罪，总不离开，

chapters.en: until the LORD removed them from his presence, as he had warned through all his servants the prophets. So the people of Israel were taken from their homeland into exile in Assyria, and they are still there.
chapters.zh: 以致耶和华从自己面前赶出他们，正如借他仆人众先知所说的。这样，以色列人从本地被掳到亚述，直到今日。

chapters.en: The king of Assyria brought people from Babylon, Kuthah, Avva, Hamath and Sepharvaim and settled them in the towns of Samaria to replace the Israelites. They took over Samaria and lived in its towns.
chapters.zh: 亚述王从巴比伦，古他，亚瓦，哈马，和西法瓦音迁移人来，安置在撒玛利亚的城邑，代替以色列人。他们就得了撒玛利亚，住在其中。

chapters.en: When they first lived there, they did not worship the LORD; so he sent lions among them and they killed some of the people.
chapters.zh: 他们才住那里的时候，不敬畏耶和华，所以耶和华叫狮子进入他们中间，咬死了些人。

chapters.en: It was reported to the king of Assyria: “The people you deported and resettled in the towns of Samaria do not know what the god of that country requires. He has sent lions among them, which are killing them off, because the people do not know what he requires.”
chapters.zh: 有人告诉亚述王说，你所迁移安置在撒玛利亚各城的那些民，不知道那地之神的规矩，所以那神叫狮子进入他们中间，咬死他们。

chapters.en: Then the king of Assyria gave this order: “Have one of the priests you took captive from Samaria go back to live there and teach the people what the god of the land requires.”
chapters.zh: 亚述王就吩咐说，叫所掳来的祭司回去一个，使他住在那里，将那地之神的规矩指教那些民。

chapters.en: So one of the priests who had been exiled from Samaria came to live in Bethel and taught them how to worship the LORD.
chapters.zh: 于是有一个从撒玛利亚掳去的祭司回来，住在伯特利，指教他们怎样敬畏耶和华。

chapters.en: Nevertheless, each national group made its own gods in the several towns where they settled, and set them up in the shrines the people of Samaria had made at the high places.
chapters.zh: 然而，各族之人在所住的城里各为自己制造神像，安置在撒玛利亚人所造有丘坛的殿中。

chapters.en: The people from Babylon made Sukkoth Benoth, those from Kuthah made Nergal, and those from Hamath made Ashima;
chapters.zh: 巴比伦人造疏割比讷像。古他人造匿甲像。哈马人造亚示玛像。

chapters.en: the Avvites made Nibhaz and Tartak, and the Sepharvites burned their children in the fire as sacrifices to Adrammelek and Anammelek, the gods of Sepharvaim.
chapters.zh: 亚瓦人造匿哈和他珥他像。西法瓦音人用火焚烧儿女，献给西法瓦音的神亚得米勒和亚拿米勒。

chapters.en: They worshiped the LORD, but they also appointed all sorts of their own people to officiate for them as priests in the shrines at the high places.
chapters.zh: 他们惧怕耶和华，也从他们中间立丘坛的祭司，为他们在有丘坛的殿中献祭。

chapters.en: They worshiped the LORD, but they also served their own gods in accordance with the customs of the nations from which they had been brought.
chapters.zh: 他们又惧怕耶和华，又事奉自己的神，从何邦迁移，就随何邦的风俗。

chapters.en: To this day they persist in their former practices. They neither worship the LORD nor adhere to the decrees and regulations, the laws and commands that the LORD gave the descendants of Jacob, whom he named Israel.
chapters.zh: 他们直到如今仍照先前的风俗去行，不专心敬畏耶和华，不全守自己的规矩，典章，也不遵守耶和华吩咐雅各后裔的律法，诫命。雅各，就是从前耶和华起名叫以色列的。

chapters.en: When the LORD made a covenant with the Israelites, he commanded them: “Do not worship any other gods or bow down to them, serve them or sacrifice to them.
chapters.zh: 耶和华曾与他们立约，嘱咐他们说，不可敬畏别神，不可跪拜事奉他，也不可向他献祭。

chapters.en: But the LORD, who brought you up out of Egypt with mighty power and outstretched arm, is the one you must worship. To him you shall bow down and to him offer sacrifices.
chapters.zh: 但那用大能和伸出来的膀臂领你们出埃及地的耶和华，你们当敬畏，跪拜，向他献祭。

chapters.en: You must always be careful to keep the decrees and regulations, the laws and commands he wrote for you. Do not worship other gods.
chapters.zh: 他给你们写的律例，典章，律法，诫命，你们应当永远谨守遵行，不可敬畏别神。

chapters.en: Do not forget the covenant I have made with you, and do not worship other gods.
chapters.zh: 我耶和华与你们所立的约你们不可忘记，也不可敬畏别神。

chapters.en: Rather, worship the LORD your God; it is he who will deliver you from the hand of all your enemies.”
chapters.zh: 但要敬畏耶和华你们的神，他必救你们脱离一切仇敌的手。

chapters.en: They would not listen, however, but persisted in their former practices.
chapters.zh: 他们却不听从，仍照先前的风俗去行。

chapters.en: Even while these people were worshiping the LORD, they were serving their idols. To this day their children and grandchildren continue to do as their ancestors did.
chapters.zh: 如此这些民又惧怕耶和华，又事奉他们的偶像。他们子子孙孙也都照样行，效法他们的祖宗，直到今日。

chapters.en: In the third year of Hoshea son of Elah king of Israel, Hezekiah son of Ahaz king of Judah began to reign.
chapters.zh: 以色列王以拉的儿子何细亚第三年，犹大王亚哈斯的儿子希西家登基。

chapters.en: He was twenty-five years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem twenty-nine years. His mother’s name was Abijah daughter of Zechariah.
chapters.zh: 他登基的时候年二十五岁，在耶路撒冷作王二十九年。他母亲名叫亚比，是撒迦利雅的女儿。

chapters.en: He did what was right in the eyes of the LORD, just as his father David had done.
chapters.zh: 希西家行耶和华眼中看为正的事，效法他祖大卫一切所行的。

chapters.en: He removed the high places, smashed the sacred stones and cut down the Asherah poles. He broke into pieces the bronze snake Moses had made, for up to that time the Israelites had been burning incense to it. (It was called Nehushtan. )
chapters.zh: 他废去丘坛，毁坏柱像，砍下木偶，打碎摩西所造的铜蛇，因为到那时以色列人仍向铜蛇烧香。希西家叫铜蛇为铜块（或作人称铜蛇为铜像）。

chapters.en: Hezekiah trusted in the LORD, the God of Israel. There was no one like him among all the kings of Judah, either before him or after him.
chapters.zh: 希西家倚靠耶和华以色列的神，在他前后的犹大列王中没有一个及他的。

chapters.en: He held fast to the LORD and did not stop following him; he kept the commands the LORD had given Moses.
chapters.zh: 因为他专靠耶和华，总不离开，谨守耶和华所吩咐摩西的诫命。

chapters.en: And the LORD was with him; he was successful in whatever he undertook. He rebelled against the king of Assyria and did not serve him.
chapters.zh: 耶和华与他同在，他无论往何处去尽都亨通。他背叛，不肯事奉亚述王。

chapters.en: From watchtower to fortified city, he defeated the Philistines, as far as Gaza and its territory.
chapters.zh: 希西家攻击非利士人，直到迦萨，并迦萨的四境，从了望楼到坚固城。

chapters.en: In King Hezekiah’s fourth year, which was the seventh year of Hoshea son of Elah king of Israel, Shalmaneser king of Assyria marched against Samaria and laid siege to it.
chapters.zh: 希西家王第四年，就是以色列王以拉的儿子何细亚第七年，亚述王撒缦以色上来围困撒玛利亚。

chapters.en: At the end of three years the Assyrians took it. So Samaria was captured in Hezekiah’s sixth year, which was the ninth year of Hoshea king of Israel.
chapters.zh: 过了三年就攻取了城。希西家第六年，以色列王何细亚第九年，撒玛利亚被攻取了。

chapters.en: The king of Assyria deported Israel to Assyria and settled them in Halah, in Gozan on the Habor River and in towns of the Medes.
chapters.zh: 亚述王将以色列人掳到亚述，把他们安置在哈腊与歌散的哈博河边，并玛代人的城邑。

chapters.en: This happened because they had not obeyed the LORD their God, but had violated his covenant—all that Moses the servant of the LORD commanded. They neither listened to the commands nor carried them out.
chapters.zh: 都因他们不听从耶和华他们神的话，违背他的约，就是耶和华仆人摩西吩咐他们所当守的。

chapters.en: In the fourteenth year of King Hezekiah’s reign, Sennacherib king of Assyria attacked all the fortified cities of Judah and captured them.
chapters.zh: 希西家王十四年，亚述王西拿基立上来攻击犹大的一切坚固城，将城攻取。

chapters.en: So Hezekiah king of Judah sent this message to the king of Assyria at Lachish: “I have done wrong. Withdraw from me, and I will pay whatever you demand of me.” The king of Assyria exacted from Hezekiah king of Judah three hundred talents of silver and thirty talents of gold.
chapters.zh: 犹大王希西家差人往拉吉去见亚述王，说，我有罪了，求你离开我。凡你罚我的，我必承当。于是亚述王罚犹大王希西家银子三百他连得，金子三十他连得。

chapters.en: So Hezekiah gave him all the silver that was found in the temple of the LORD and in the treasuries of the royal palace.
chapters.zh: 希西家就把耶和华殿里和王宫府库里所有的银子都给了他。

chapters.en: At this time Hezekiah king of Judah stripped off the gold with which he had covered the doors and doorposts of the temple of the LORD, and gave it to the king of Assyria.
chapters.zh: 那时，犹大王希西家将耶和华殿门上的金子，和他自己包在柱上的金子，都刮下来，给了亚述王。

chapters.en: The king of Assyria sent his supreme commander, his chief officer and his field commander with a large army, from Lachish to King Hezekiah at Jerusalem. They came up to Jerusalem and stopped at the aqueduct of the Upper Pool, on the road to the Washerman’s Field.
chapters.zh: 亚述王从拉吉差遣他珥探，拉伯撒利，和拉伯沙基率领大军往耶路撒冷，到希西家王那里去。他们上到耶路撒冷，就站在上池的水沟旁，在漂布地的大路上。

chapters.en: They called for the king; and Eliakim son of Hilkiah the palace administrator, Shebna the secretary, and Joah son of Asaph the recorder went out to them.
chapters.zh: 他们呼叫王的时候，就有希勒家的儿子家宰以利亚敬，并书记舍伯那和亚萨的儿子史官约亚，出来见他们。

chapters.en: The field commander said to them, “Tell Hezekiah: “ ‘This is what the great king, the king of Assyria, says: On what are you basing this confidence of yours?
chapters.zh: 拉伯沙基说，你们去告诉希西家说，亚述大王如此说，你所倚靠的有什么可仗赖的呢？

chapters.en: You say you have the counsel and the might for war—but you speak only empty words. On whom are you depending, that you rebel against me?
chapters.zh: 你说有打仗的计谋和能力，我看不过是虚话。你到底倚靠谁才背叛我呢？

chapters.en: Look, I know you are depending on Egypt, that splintered reed of a staff, which pierces the hand of anyone who leans on it! Such is Pharaoh king of Egypt to all who depend on him.
chapters.zh: 看哪，你所倚靠的埃及是那压伤的苇杖人若靠这杖，就必刺透他的手。埃及王法老向一切倚靠他的人也是这样。

chapters.en: But if you say to me, “We are depending on the LORD our God”—isn’t he the one whose high places and altars Hezekiah removed, saying to Judah and Jerusalem, “You must worship before this altar in Jerusalem”?
chapters.zh: 你们若对我说，我们倚靠耶和华我们的神，希西家岂不是将神的丘坛和祭坛废去，且对犹大和耶路撒冷的人说，你们当在耶路撒冷这坛前敬拜吗？

chapters.en: “ ‘Come now, make a bargain with my master, the king of Assyria: I will give you two thousand horses—if you can put riders on them!
chapters.zh: 现在你把当头给我主亚述王，我给你二千匹马，看你这一面骑马的人够不够。

chapters.en: How can you repulse one officer of the least of my master’s officials, even though you are depending on Egypt for chariots and horsemen ?
chapters.zh: 若不然，怎能打败我主臣仆中最小的军长呢？你竟倚靠埃及的战车马兵吗？

chapters.en: Furthermore, have I come to attack and destroy this place without word from the LORD? The LORD himself told me to march against this country and destroy it.’ ”
chapters.zh: 现在我上来攻击毁灭这地，岂没有耶和华的意思吗？耶和华吩咐我说，你上去攻击毁灭这地吧。

chapters.en: Then Eliakim son of Hilkiah, and Shebna and Joah said to the field commander, “Please speak to your servants in Aramaic, since we understand it. Don’t speak to us in Hebrew in the hearing of the people on the wall.”
chapters.zh: 希勒家的儿子以利亚敬和舍伯那，并约亚，对拉伯沙基说，求你用亚兰言语和仆人说话，因为我们懂得。不要用犹大言语和我们说话，达到城上百姓的耳中。

chapters.en: But the commander replied, “Was it only to your master and you that my master sent me to say these things, and not to the people sitting on the wall—who, like you, will have to eat their own excrement and drink their own urine?”
chapters.zh: 拉伯沙基说，我主差遣我来，岂是单对你和你的主说这些话吗？不也是对这些坐在城上，要与你们一同吃自己粪，喝自己尿的人说吗？

chapters.en: Then the commander stood and called out in Hebrew, “Hear the word of the great king, the king of Assyria!
chapters.zh: 于是拉伯沙基站着，用犹大言语大声喊着说，你们当听亚述大王的话。

chapters.en: This is what the king says: Do not let Hezekiah deceive you. He cannot deliver you from my hand.
chapters.zh: 王如此说，你们不要被希西家欺哄了。因他不能救你们脱离我的手。

chapters.en: Do not let Hezekiah persuade you to trust in the LORD when he says, ‘The LORD will surely deliver us; this city will not be given into the hand of the king of Assyria.’
chapters.zh: 也不要听希西家使你们倚靠耶和华，说耶和华必要拯救我们，这城必不交在亚述王的手中。

chapters.en: “Do not listen to Hezekiah. This is what the king of Assyria says: Make peace with me and come out to me. Then each of you will eat fruit from your own vine and fig tree and drink water from your own cistern,
chapters.zh: 不要听希西家的话。因亚述王如此说，你们要与我和好，出来投降我，各人就可以吃自己葡萄树和无花果树的果子，喝自己井里的水。

chapters.en: until I come and take you to a land like your own—a land of grain and new wine, a land of bread and vineyards, a land of olive trees and honey. Choose life and not death! “Do not listen to Hezekiah, for he is misleading you when he says, ‘The LORD will deliver us.’
chapters.zh: 等我来领你们到一个地方与你们本地一样，就是有五谷和新酒之地，有粮食和葡萄园之地，有橄榄树和蜂蜜之地，好使你们存活，不至于死。希西家劝导你们，说耶和华必拯救我们；你们不要听他的话。

chapters.en: Has the god of any nation ever delivered his land from the hand of the king of Assyria?
chapters.zh: 列国的神有哪一个救他本国脱离亚述王的手呢？

chapters.en: Where are the gods of Hamath and Arpad? Where are the gods of Sepharvaim, Hena and Ivvah? Have they rescued Samaria from my hand?
chapters.zh: 哈马，亚珥拔的神在哪里呢？西法瓦音，希拿，以瓦的神在哪里呢？他们曾救撒玛利亚脱离我的手吗？

chapters.en: Who of all the gods of these countries has been able to save his land from me? How then can the LORD deliver Jerusalem from my hand?”
chapters.zh: 这些国的神有谁曾救自己的国脱离我的手呢？难道耶和华能救耶路撒冷脱离我的手吗？

chapters.en: But the people remained silent and said nothing in reply, because the king had commanded, “Do not answer him.”
chapters.zh: 百姓静默不言，并不回答一句，因为王曾吩咐说，不要回答他。

chapters.en: Then Eliakim son of Hilkiah the palace administrator, Shebna the secretary, and Joah son of Asaph the recorder went to Hezekiah, with their clothes torn, and told him what the field commander had said.
chapters.zh: 当下，希勒家的儿子家宰以利亚敬和书记舍伯那，并亚萨的儿子史官约亚，都撕裂衣服，来到希西家那里，将拉伯沙基的话告诉了他。

chapters.en: When King Hezekiah heard this, he tore his clothes and put on sackcloth and went into the temple of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 希西家王听见，就撕裂衣服，披上麻布，进了耶和华的殿。

chapters.en: He sent Eliakim the palace administrator, Shebna the secretary and the leading priests, all wearing sackcloth, to the prophet Isaiah son of Amoz.
chapters.zh: 使家宰以利亚敬和书记舍伯那，并祭司中的长老，都披上麻布，去见亚摩斯的儿子先知以赛亚，

chapters.en: They told him, “This is what Hezekiah says: This day is a day of distress and rebuke and disgrace, as when children come to the moment of birth and there is no strength to deliver them.
chapters.zh: 对他说，希西家如此说，今日是急难，责罚，凌辱的日子，就如妇人将要生产婴孩，却没有力量生产。

chapters.en: It may be that the LORD your God will hear all the words of the field commander, whom his master, the king of Assyria, has sent to ridicule the living God, and that he will rebuke him for the words the LORD your God has heard. Therefore pray for the remnant that still survives.”
chapters.zh: 或者耶和华你的神听见拉伯沙基的一切话，就是他主人亚述王打发他来辱骂永生神的话，耶和华你的神听见这话，就发斥责。故此，求你为余剩的民扬声祷告。

chapters.en: When King Hezekiah’s officials came to Isaiah,
chapters.zh: 希西家王的臣仆就去见以赛亚。

chapters.en: Isaiah said to them, “Tell your master, ‘This is what the LORD says: Do not be afraid of what you have heard—those words with which the underlings of the king of Assyria have blasphemed me.
chapters.zh: 以赛亚对他们说，要这样对你们的主人说，耶和华如此说，你听见亚述王的仆人亵渎我的话，不要惧怕。

chapters.en: Listen! When he hears a certain report, I will make him want to return to his own country, and there I will have him cut down with the sword.’ ”
chapters.zh: 我必惊动（原文作使灵进入）他的心，他要听见风声就归回本地。我必使他在那里倒在刀下。

chapters.en: When the field commander heard that the king of Assyria had left Lachish, he withdrew and found the king fighting against Libnah.
chapters.zh: 拉伯沙基回去，正遇见亚述王攻打立拿，原来他早听见亚述王拔营离开拉吉。

chapters.en: Now Sennacherib received a report that Tirhakah, the king of Cush, was marching out to fight against him. So he again sent messengers to Hezekiah with this word:
chapters.zh: 亚述王听见人论古实王特哈加说，他出来要与你争战。于是亚述王又打发使者去见希西家，吩咐他们说，

chapters.en: “Say to Hezekiah king of Judah: Do not let the god you depend on deceive you when he says, ‘Jerusalem will not be given into the hands of the king of Assyria.’
chapters.zh: 你们对犹大王希西家如此说，不要听你所倚靠的神欺哄你说，耶路撒冷必不交在亚述王的手中。

chapters.en: Surely you have heard what the kings of Assyria have done to all the countries, destroying them completely. And will you be delivered?
chapters.zh: 你总听说亚述诸王向列国所行的，乃是尽行灭绝，难道你还能得救吗？

chapters.en: Did the gods of the nations that were destroyed by my predecessors deliver them—the gods of Gozan, Harran, Rezeph and the people of Eden who were in Tel Assar?
chapters.zh: 我列祖所毁灭的，就是歌散，哈兰，利色，和属提拉撒的伊甸人，这些国的神何曾拯救这些国呢？

chapters.en: Where is the king of Hamath or the king of Arpad? Where are the kings of Lair, Sepharvaim, Hena and Ivvah?”
chapters.zh: 哈马的王，亚珥拔的王，西法瓦音城的王，希拿，和以瓦的王都在哪里呢？

chapters.en: Hezekiah received the letter from the messengers and read it. Then he went up to the temple of the LORD and spread it out before the LORD.
chapters.zh: 希西家从使者手里接过书信来，看完了，就上耶和华的殿，将书信在耶和华面前展开。

chapters.en: And Hezekiah prayed to the LORD: “LORD, the God of Israel, enthroned between the cherubim, you alone are God over all the kingdoms of the earth. You have made heaven and earth.
chapters.zh: 希西家向耶和华祷告说，坐在二基路伯上耶和华以色列的神阿，你是天下万国的神，你曾创造天地。

chapters.en: Give ear, LORD, and hear; open your eyes, LORD, and see; listen to the words Sennacherib has sent to ridicule the living God.
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，求你侧耳而听。耶和华阿，求你睁眼而看。要听西拿基立打发使者来辱骂永生神的话。

chapters.en: “It is true, LORD, that the Assyrian kings have laid waste these nations and their lands.
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，亚述诸王果然使列国和列国之地变为荒凉，

chapters.en: They have thrown their gods into the fire and destroyed them, for they were not gods but only wood and stone, fashioned by human hands.
chapters.zh: 将列国的神像都扔在火里。因为它本不是神，乃是人手所造的，是木头石头的，所以灭绝它。

chapters.en: Now, LORD our God, deliver us from his hand, so that all the kingdoms of the earth may know that you alone, LORD, are God.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华我们的神阿，现在求你救我们脱离亚述王的手，使天下万国都知道惟独你耶和华是神。

chapters.en: Then Isaiah son of Amoz sent a message to Hezekiah: “This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: I have heard your prayer concerning Sennacherib king of Assyria.
chapters.zh: 亚摩斯的儿子以赛亚就打发人去见希西家，说，耶和华以色列的神如此说，你既然求我攻击亚述王西拿基立，我已听见了。

chapters.en: This is the word that the LORD has spoken against him: “ ‘Virgin Daughter Zion despises you and mocks you. Daughter Jerusalem tosses her head as you flee.
chapters.zh: 耶和华论他这样说，锡安的处女藐视你，嗤笑你。耶路撒冷的女子向你摇头。

chapters.en: Who is it you have ridiculed and blasphemed? Against whom have you raised your voice and lifted your eyes in pride? Against the Holy One of Israel!
chapters.zh: 你辱骂谁。亵渎谁。扬起声来，高举眼目攻击谁呢？乃是攻击以色列的圣者。

chapters.en: By your messengers you have ridiculed the Lord. And you have said, “With my many chariots I have ascended the heights of the mountains, the utmost heights of Lebanon. I have cut down its tallest cedars, the choicest of its junipers. I have reached its remotest parts, the finest of its forests.
chapters.zh: 你借你的使者辱骂主，并说，我率领许多战车上山顶，到利巴嫩极深之处。我要砍伐其中高大的香柏树和佳美的松树。我必上极高之处，进入肥田的树林。

chapters.en: I have dug wells in foreign lands and drunk the water there. With the soles of my feet I have dried up all the streams of Egypt.”
chapters.zh: 我已经在外邦挖井喝水。我必用脚掌踏干埃及的一切河。

chapters.en: “ ‘Have you not heard? Long ago I ordained it. In days of old I planned it; now I have brought it to pass, that you have turned fortified cities into piles of stone.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说，我早先所作的，古时所立的，就是现在借你使坚固城荒废，变为乱堆，这事你岂没有听见吗？

chapters.en: Their people, drained of power, are dismayed and put to shame. They are like plants in the field, like tender green shoots, like grass sprouting on the roof, scorched before it grows up.
chapters.zh: 所以其中的居民力量甚小，惊惶羞愧。他们像野草，像青菜，如房顶上的草，又如未长成而枯干的禾稼。

chapters.en: “ ‘But I know where you are and when you come and go and how you rage against me.
chapters.zh: 你坐下，你出去，你进来，你向我发烈怒，我都知道。

chapters.en: Because you rage against me and because your insolence has reached my ears, I will put my hook in your nose and my bit in your mouth, and I will make you return by the way you came.’
chapters.zh: 因你向我发烈怒，又因你狂傲的话达到我耳中，我就要用钩子钩上你的鼻子，把嚼环放在你口里，使你从你来的路转回去。

chapters.en: “This will be the sign for you, Hezekiah: “This year you will eat what grows by itself, and the second year what springs from that. But in the third year sow and reap, plant vineyards and eat their fruit.
chapters.zh: 以色列人哪，我赐你们一个证据，你们今年要吃自生的，明年也要吃自长的。至于后年，你们要耕种收割，栽植葡萄园，吃其中的果子。

chapters.en: Once more a remnant of the kingdom of Judah will take root below and bear fruit above.
chapters.zh: 犹大家所逃脱余剩的，仍要往下扎根，向上结果。

chapters.en: For out of Jerusalem will come a remnant, and out of Mount Zion a band of survivors. “The zeal of the LORD Almighty will accomplish this.
chapters.zh: 必有余剩的民从耶路撒冷而出。必有逃脱的人从锡安山而来。耶和华的热心必成就这事。

chapters.en: “Therefore this is what the LORD says concerning the king of Assyria: “ ‘He will not enter this city or shoot an arrow here. He will not come before it with shield or build a siege ramp against it.
chapters.zh: 所以，耶和华论亚述王如此说，他必不得来到这城，也不在这里射箭，不得拿盾牌到城前，也不筑垒攻城。

chapters.en: By the way that he came he will return; he will not enter this city, declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 他从哪条路来，必从那条路回去，必不得来到这城。这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: I will defend this city and save it, for my sake and for the sake of David my servant.’ ”
chapters.zh: 因我为自己的缘故，又为我仆人大卫的缘故，必保护拯救这城。

chapters.en: That night the angel of the LORD went out and put to death a hundred and eighty-five thousand in the Assyrian camp. When the people got up the next morning—there were all the dead bodies!
chapters.zh: 当夜，耶和华的使者出去，在亚述营中杀了十八万五千人。清早有人起来，一看，都是死尸了。

chapters.en: So Sennacherib king of Assyria broke camp and withdrew. He returned to Nineveh and stayed there.
chapters.zh: 亚述王西拿基立就拔营回去，住在尼尼微。

chapters.en: One day, while he was worshiping in the temple of his god Nisrok, his sons Adrammelek and Sharezer killed him with the sword, and they escaped to the land of Ararat. And Esarhaddon his son succeeded him as king.
chapters.zh: 一日在他的神尼斯洛庙里叩拜，他儿子亚得米勒和沙利色用刀杀了他，就逃到亚拉腊地。他儿子以撒哈顿接续他作王。

chapters.en: In those days Hezekiah became ill and was at the point of death. The prophet Isaiah son of Amoz went to him and said, “This is what the LORD says: Put your house in order, because you are going to die; you will not recover.”
chapters.zh: 那时，希西家病得要死。亚摩斯的儿子先知以赛亚去见他，对他说，耶和华如此说，你当留遗命与你的家，因为你必死，不能活了。

chapters.en: Hezekiah turned his face to the wall and prayed to the LORD,
chapters.zh: 希西家就转脸朝墙，祷告耶和华说，

chapters.en: “Remember, LORD, how I have walked before you faithfully and with wholehearted devotion and have done what is good in your eyes.” And Hezekiah wept bitterly.
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，求你记念我在你面前怎样存完全的心，按诚实行事，又作你眼中所看为善的。希西家就痛哭了。

chapters.en: Before Isaiah had left the middle court, the word of the LORD came to him:
chapters.zh: 以赛亚出来，还没有到中院（院或作城），耶和华的话就临到他，说，

chapters.en: “Go back and tell Hezekiah, the ruler of my people, ‘This is what the LORD, the God of your father David, says: I have heard your prayer and seen your tears; I will heal you. On the third day from now you will go up to the temple of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 你回去告诉我民的君希西家说，耶和华你祖大卫的神如此说，我听见了你的祷告，看见了你的眼泪，我必医治你。到第三日，你必上到耶和华的殿。

chapters.en: I will add fifteen years to your life. And I will deliver you and this city from the hand of the king of Assyria. I will defend this city for my sake and for the sake of my servant David.’ ”
chapters.zh: 我必加增你十五年的寿数，并且我要救你和这城脱离亚述王的手。我为自己和我仆人大卫的缘故，必保护这城。

chapters.en: Then Isaiah said, “Prepare a poultice of figs.” They did so and applied it to the boil, and he recovered.
chapters.zh: 以赛亚说，当取一块无花果饼来。人就取了来，贴在疮上，王便痊愈了。

chapters.en: Hezekiah had asked Isaiah, “What will be the sign that the LORD will heal me and that I will go up to the temple of the LORD on the third day from now?”
chapters.zh: 希西家问以赛亚说，耶和华必医治我，到第三日，我能上耶和华的殿，有什么兆头呢？

chapters.en: Isaiah answered, “This is the LORD’s sign to you that the LORD will do what he has promised: Shall the shadow go forward ten steps, or shall it go back ten steps?”
chapters.zh: 以赛亚说，耶和华必成就他所说的。这是他给你的兆头，你要日影向前进十度呢？是要往后退十度呢？

chapters.en: “It is a simple matter for the shadow to go forward ten steps,” said Hezekiah. “Rather, have it go back ten steps.”
chapters.zh: 希西家回答说，日影向前进十度容易，我要日影往后退十度。

chapters.en: Then the prophet Isaiah called on the LORD, and the LORD made the shadow go back the ten steps it had gone down on the stairway of Ahaz.
chapters.zh: 先知以赛亚求告耶和华，耶和华就使亚哈斯的日晷向前进的日影，往后退了十度。

chapters.en: At that time Marduk-Baladan son of Baladan king of Babylon sent Hezekiah letters and a gift, because he had heard of Hezekiah’s illness.
chapters.zh: 那时，巴比伦王巴拉但的儿子比罗达巴拉但听见希西家病而痊愈，就送书信和礼物给他。

chapters.en: Hezekiah received the envoys and showed them all that was in his storehouses—the silver, the gold, the spices and the fine olive oil—his armory and everything found among his treasures. There was nothing in his palace or in all his kingdom that Hezekiah did not show them.
chapters.zh: 希西家听从使者的话，就把他宝库的金子，银子，香料，贵重的膏油，和他武库的一切军器，并他所有的财宝，都给他们看。他家中和他全国之内，希西家没有一样不给他们看的。

chapters.en: Then Isaiah the prophet went to King Hezekiah and asked, “What did those men say, and where did they come from?” “From a distant land,” Hezekiah replied. “They came from Babylon.”
chapters.zh: 于是先知以赛亚来见希西家王，问他说，这些人说什么。他们从哪里来见你。希西家说，他们从远方的巴比伦来。

chapters.en: The prophet asked, “What did they see in your palace?” “They saw everything in my palace,” Hezekiah said. “There is nothing among my treasures that I did not show them.”
chapters.zh: 以赛亚说，他们在你家里看见了什么。希西家说，凡我家中所有的，他们都看见了。我财宝中没有一样不给他们看的。

chapters.en: Then Isaiah said to Hezekiah, “Hear the word of the LORD:
chapters.zh: 以赛亚对希西家说，你要听耶和华的话，

chapters.en: The time will surely come when everything in your palace, and all that your predecessors have stored up until this day, will be carried off to Babylon. Nothing will be left, says the LORD.
chapters.zh: 日子必到，凡你家里所有的，并你列祖积蓄到如今的，都要被掳到巴比伦去，不留下一样。这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: And some of your descendants, your own flesh and blood who will be born to you, will be taken away, and they will become eunuchs in the palace of the king of Babylon.”
chapters.zh: 并且从你本身所生的众子，其中必有被掳去在巴比伦王宫里当太监的。

chapters.en: “The word of the LORD you have spoken is good,” Hezekiah replied. For he thought, “Will there not be peace and security in my lifetime?”
chapters.zh: 希西家对以赛亚说，你所说耶和华的话甚好。若在我的年日中有太平和稳固的景况，岂不是好吗？

chapters.en: As for the other events of Hezekiah’s reign, all his achievements and how he made the pool and the tunnel by which he brought water into the city, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Judah?
chapters.zh: 希西家其余的事和他的勇力，他怎样挖池，挖沟，引水入城，都写在犹大列王记上。

chapters.en: Hezekiah rested with his ancestors. And Manasseh his son succeeded him as king.
chapters.zh: 希西家与他列祖同睡。他儿子玛拿西接续他作王。

chapters.en: Manasseh was twelve years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem fifty-five years. His mother’s name was Hephzibah.
chapters.zh: 玛拿西登基的时候年十二岁，在耶路撒冷作王五十五年。他母亲名叫协西巴。

chapters.en: He did evil in the eyes of the LORD, following the detestable practices of the nations the LORD had driven out before the Israelites.
chapters.zh: 玛拿西行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，效法耶和华在以色列人面前赶出的外邦人所行可憎的事。

chapters.en: He rebuilt the high places his father Hezekiah had destroyed; he also erected altars to Baal and made an Asherah pole, as Ahab king of Israel had done. He bowed down to all the starry hosts and worshiped them.
chapters.zh: 重新建筑他父希西家所毁坏的丘坛，又为巴力筑坛，作亚舍拉像，效法以色列王亚哈所行的，且敬拜事奉天上的万象。

chapters.en: He built altars in the temple of the LORD, of which the LORD had said, “In Jerusalem I will put my Name.”
chapters.zh: 在耶和华殿宇中筑坛。耶和华曾指着这殿说，我必立我的名在耶路撒冷。

chapters.en: In the two courts of the temple of the LORD, he built altars to all the starry hosts.
chapters.zh: 他在耶和华殿的两院中为天上的万象筑坛，

chapters.en: He sacrificed his own son in the fire, practiced divination, sought omens, and consulted mediums and spiritists. He did much evil in the eyes of the LORD, arousing his anger.
chapters.zh: 并使他的儿子经火，又观兆，用法术，立交鬼的和行巫术的，多行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，惹动他的怒气。

chapters.en: He took the carved Asherah pole he had made and put it in the temple, of which the LORD had said to David and to his son Solomon, “In this temple and in Jerusalem, which I have chosen out of all the tribes of Israel, I will put my Name forever.
chapters.zh: 又在殿内立雕刻的亚舍拉像。耶和华曾对大卫和他儿子所罗门说，我在以色列众支派中所选择的耶路撒冷和这殿，必立我的名，直到永远。

chapters.en: I will not again make the feet of the Israelites wander from the land I gave their ancestors, if only they will be careful to do everything I commanded them and will keep the whole Law that my servant Moses gave them.”
chapters.zh: 以色列人若谨守遵行我一切所吩咐他们的，和我仆人摩西所吩咐他们的一切律法，我就不再使他们挪移离开我所赐给他们列祖之地。

chapters.en: But the people did not listen. Manasseh led them astray, so that they did more evil than the nations the LORD had destroyed before the Israelites.
chapters.zh: 他们却不听从。玛拿西引诱他们行恶，比耶和华在以色列人面前所灭的列国更甚。

chapters.en: The LORD said through his servants the prophets:
chapters.zh: 耶和华借他仆人众先知说，

chapters.en: “Manasseh king of Judah has committed these detestable sins. He has done more evil than the Amorites who preceded him and has led Judah into sin with his idols.
chapters.zh: 因犹大王玛拿西行这些可憎的恶事比先前亚摩利人所行的更甚，使犹大人拜他的偶像，陷在罪里。

chapters.en: Therefore this is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: I am going to bring such disaster on Jerusalem and Judah that the ears of everyone who hears of it will tingle.
chapters.zh: 所以耶和华以色列的神如此说，我必降祸与耶路撒冷和犹大，叫一切听见的人无不耳鸣。

chapters.en: I will stretch out over Jerusalem the measuring line used against Samaria and the plumb line used against the house of Ahab. I will wipe out Jerusalem as one wipes a dish, wiping it and turning it upside down.
chapters.zh: 我必用量撒玛利亚的准绳和亚哈家的线铊拉在耶路撒冷上，必擦净耶路撒冷，如人擦盘，将盘倒扣。

chapters.en: I will forsake the remnant of my inheritance and give them into the hands of enemies. They will be looted and plundered by all their enemies;
chapters.zh: 我必弃掉所余剩的子民（原文作产业），把他们交在仇敌手中，使他们成为一切仇敌掳掠之物。

chapters.en: they have done evil in my eyes and have aroused my anger from the day their ancestors came out of Egypt until this day.”
chapters.zh: 是因他们自从列祖出埃及直到如今，常行我眼中看为恶的事，惹动我的怒气。

chapters.en: Moreover, Manasseh also shed so much innocent blood that he filled Jerusalem from end to end—besides the sin that he had caused Judah to commit, so that they did evil in the eyes of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 玛拿西行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，使犹大人陷在罪里，又流许多无辜人的血，充满了耶路撒冷，从这边直到那边。

chapters.en: As for the other events of Manasseh’s reign, and all he did, including the sin he committed, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Judah?
chapters.zh: 玛拿西其余的事，凡他所行的和他所犯的罪都写在犹大列王记上。

chapters.en: Manasseh rested with his ancestors and was buried in his palace garden, the garden of Uzza. And Amon his son succeeded him as king.
chapters.zh: 玛拿西与他列祖同睡，葬在自己宫院乌撒的园内。他儿子亚们接续他作王。

chapters.en: Amon was twenty-two years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem two years. His mother’s name was Meshullemeth daughter of Haruz; she was from Jotbah.
chapters.zh: 亚们登基的时候年二十二岁，在耶路撒冷作王二年。他母亲名叫米舒利密，是约提巴人哈鲁斯的女儿。

chapters.en: He did evil in the eyes of the LORD, as his father Manasseh had done.
chapters.zh: 亚们行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，与他父亲玛拿西所行的一样。

chapters.en: He followed completely the ways of his father, worshiping the idols his father had worshiped, and bowing down to them.
chapters.zh: 行他父亲一切所行的，敬奉他父亲所敬奉的偶像，

chapters.en: He forsook the LORD, the God of his ancestors, and did not walk in obedience to him.
chapters.zh: 离弃耶和华他列祖的神，不遵行耶和华的道。

chapters.en: Amon’s officials conspired against him and assassinated the king in his palace.
chapters.zh: 亚们王的臣仆背叛他，在宫里杀了他。

chapters.en: Then the people of the land killed all who had plotted against King Amon, and they made Josiah his son king in his place.
chapters.zh: 但国民杀了那些背叛亚们王的人，立他儿子约西亚接续他作王。

chapters.en: As for the other events of Amon’s reign, and what he did, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Judah?
chapters.zh: 亚们其余所行的事都写在犹大列王记上。

chapters.en: He was buried in his tomb in the garden of Uzza. And Josiah his son succeeded him as king.
chapters.zh: 亚们葬在乌撒的园内自己的坟墓里。他儿子约西亚接续他作王。

chapters.en: Josiah was eight years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem thirty-one years. His mother’s name was Jedidah daughter of Adaiah; she was from Bozkath.
chapters.zh: 约西亚登基的时候年八岁，在耶路撒冷作王三十一年。他母亲名叫耶底大，是波斯加人亚大雅的女儿。

chapters.en: He did what was right in the eyes of the LORD and followed completely the ways of his father David, not turning aside to the right or to the left.
chapters.zh: 约西亚行耶和华眼中看为正的事，行他祖大卫一切所行的，不偏左右。

chapters.en: In the eighteenth year of his reign, King Josiah sent the secretary, Shaphan son of Azaliah, the son of Meshullam, to the temple of the LORD. He said:
chapters.zh: 约西亚王十八年，王差遣米书兰的孙子，亚萨利的儿子书记沙番上耶和华殿去，吩咐他说，

chapters.en: “Go up to Hilkiah the high priest and have him get ready the money that has been brought into the temple of the LORD, which the doorkeepers have collected from the people.
chapters.zh: 你去见大祭司希勒家，使他将奉到耶和华殿的银子，就是守门的从民中收聚的银子，数算数算，

chapters.en: Have them entrust it to the men appointed to supervise the work on the temple. And have these men pay the workers who repair the temple of the LORD—
chapters.zh: 交给耶和华殿里办事的人，使他们转交耶和华殿里作工的人，好修理殿的破坏之处，

chapters.en: the carpenters, the builders and the masons. Also have them purchase timber and dressed stone to repair the temple.
chapters.zh: 就是转交木匠和工人，并瓦匠，又买木料和凿成的石头修理殿宇，

chapters.en: But they need not account for the money entrusted to them, because they are honest in their dealings.”
chapters.zh: 将银子交在办事的人手里，不与他们算帐，因为他们办事诚实。

chapters.en: Hilkiah the high priest said to Shaphan the secretary, “I have found the Book of the Law in the temple of the LORD.” He gave it to Shaphan, who read it.
chapters.zh: 大祭司希勒家对书记沙番说，我在耶和华殿里得了律法书。希勒家将书递给沙番，沙番就看了。

chapters.en: Then Shaphan the secretary went to the king and reported to him: “Your officials have paid out the money that was in the temple of the LORD and have entrusted it to the workers and supervisors at the temple.”
chapters.zh: 书记沙番到王那里，回覆王说，你的仆人已将殿里的银子倒出数算，交给耶和华殿里办事的人了。

chapters.en: Then Shaphan the secretary informed the king, “Hilkiah the priest has given me a book.” And Shaphan read from it in the presence of the king.
chapters.zh: 书记沙番又对王说，祭司希勒家递给我一卷书。沙番就在王面前读那书。

chapters.en: When the king heard the words of the Book of the Law, he tore his robes.
chapters.zh: 王听见律法书上的话，便撕裂衣服，

chapters.en: He gave these orders to Hilkiah the priest, Ahikam son of Shaphan, Akbor son of Micaiah, Shaphan the secretary and Asaiah the king’s attendant:
chapters.zh: 吩咐祭司希勒家与沙番的儿子亚希甘，米该亚的儿子亚革波，书记沙番和王的臣仆亚撒雅，说，

chapters.en: “Go and inquire of the LORD for me and for the people and for all Judah about what is written in this book that has been found. Great is the LORD’s anger that burns against us because those who have gone before us have not obeyed the words of this book; they have not acted in accordance with all that is written there concerning us.”
chapters.zh: 你们去为我，为民，为犹大众人，以这书上的话求问耶和华。因为我们列祖没有听从这书上的言语，没有遵着书上所吩咐我们的去行，耶和华就向我们大发烈怒。

chapters.en: Hilkiah the priest, Ahikam, Akbor, Shaphan and Asaiah went to speak to the prophet Huldah, who was the wife of Shallum son of Tikvah, the son of Harhas, keeper of the wardrobe. She lived in Jerusalem, in the New Quarter.
chapters.zh: 于是，祭司希勒家和亚希甘，亚革波，沙番，亚撒雅都去见女先知户勒大。户勒大是掌管礼服沙龙的妻。沙龙是哈珥哈斯的孙子，特瓦的儿子。户勒大住在耶路撒冷第二区。他们请问于她。

chapters.en: She said to them, “This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: Tell the man who sent you to me,
chapters.zh: 她对他们说，耶和华以色列的神如此说，你们可以回覆那差遣你们来见我的人说，

chapters.en: ‘This is what the LORD says: I am going to bring disaster on this place and its people, according to everything written in the book the king of Judah has read.
chapters.zh: 耶和华如此说，我必照着犹大王所读那书上的一切话，降祸与这地和其上的居民。

chapters.en: Because they have forsaken me and burned incense to other gods and aroused my anger by all the idols their hands have made, my anger will burn against this place and will not be quenched.’
chapters.zh: 因为他们离弃我，向别神烧香，用他们手所作的惹我发怒，所以我的忿怒必向这地发作，总不止息。

chapters.en: Tell the king of Judah, who sent you to inquire of the LORD, ‘This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says concerning the words you heard:
chapters.zh: 然而，差遣你们来求问耶和华的犹大王，你们要这样回覆他说，耶和华以色列的神如此说，至于你所听见的话，

chapters.en: Because your heart was responsive and you humbled yourself before the LORD when you heard what I have spoken against this place and its people—that they would become a curse and be laid waste—and because you tore your robes and wept in my presence, I also have heard you, declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 就是听见我指着这地和其上的居民所说，要使这地变为荒场，民受咒诅的话，你便心里敬服，在我面前自卑，撕裂衣服，向我哭泣，因此我应允了你。这是我耶和华说的。

chapters.en: Therefore I will gather you to your ancestors, and you will be buried in peace. Your eyes will not see all the disaster I am going to bring on this place.’ ” So they took her answer back to the king.
chapters.zh: 我必使你平平安安地归到坟墓到你列祖那里。我要降与这地的一切灾祸，你也不至亲眼看见。他们就回覆王去了。

chapters.en: Then the king called together all the elders of Judah and Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 王差遣人招聚犹大和耶路撒冷的众长老来。

chapters.en: He went up to the temple of the LORD with the people of Judah, the inhabitants of Jerusalem, the priests and the prophets—all the people from the least to the greatest. He read in their hearing all the words of the Book of the Covenant, which had been found in the temple of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 王和犹大众人与耶路撒冷的居民，并祭司，先知，和所有的百姓，无论大小，都一同上到耶和华的殿。王就把耶和华殿里所得的约书念给他们听。

chapters.en: The king stood by the pillar and renewed the covenant in the presence of the LORD—to follow the LORD and keep his commands, statutes and decrees with all his heart and all his soul, thus confirming the words of the covenant written in this book. Then all the people pledged themselves to the covenant.
chapters.zh: 王站在柱旁，在耶和华面前立约，要尽心尽性地顺从耶和华，遵守他的诫命，法度，律例，成就这书上所记的约言。众民都服从这约。

chapters.en: The king ordered Hilkiah the high priest, the priests next in rank and the doorkeepers to remove from the temple of the LORD all the articles made for Baal and Asherah and all the starry hosts. He burned them outside Jerusalem in the fields of the Kidron Valley and took the ashes to Bethel.
chapters.zh: 王吩咐大祭司希勒家和副祭司，并把门的，将那为巴力和亚舍拉，并天上万象所造的器皿，都从耶和华殿里搬出来，在耶路撒冷外汲沦溪旁的田间烧了，把灰拿到伯特利去。

chapters.en: He did away with the idolatrous priests appointed by the kings of Judah to burn incense on the high places of the towns of Judah and on those around Jerusalem—those who burned incense to Baal, to the sun and moon, to the constellations and to all the starry hosts.
chapters.zh: 从前犹大列王所立拜偶像的祭司，在犹大城邑的丘坛和耶路撒冷的周围烧香，现在王都废去，又废去向巴力和日，月，行星（行星或作十二宫），并天上万象烧香的人。

chapters.en: He took the Asherah pole from the temple of the LORD to the Kidron Valley outside Jerusalem and burned it there. He ground it to powder and scattered the dust over the graves of the common people.
chapters.zh: 又从耶和华殿里将亚舍拉搬到耶路撒冷外汲沦溪边焚烧，打碎成灰，将灰撒在平民的坟上。

chapters.en: He also tore down the quarters of the male shrine prostitutes that were in the temple of the LORD, the quarters where women did weaving for Asherah.
chapters.zh: 又拆毁耶和华殿里娈童的屋子，就是妇女为亚舍拉织帐子的屋子，

chapters.en: Josiah brought all the priests from the towns of Judah and desecrated the high places, from Geba to Beersheba, where the priests had burned incense. He broke down the gateway at the entrance of the Gate of Joshua, the city governor, which was on the left of the city gate.
chapters.zh: 并且从犹大的城邑带众祭司来，污秽祭司烧香的丘坛，从迦巴直到别是巴，又拆毁城门旁的丘坛，这丘坛在邑宰约书亚门前，进城门的左边。

chapters.en: Although the priests of the high places did not serve at the altar of the LORD in Jerusalem, they ate unleavened bread with their fellow priests.
chapters.zh: 但是丘坛的祭司不登耶路撒冷耶和华的坛，只在他们弟兄中间吃无酵饼。

chapters.en: He desecrated Topheth, which was in the Valley of Ben Hinnom, so no one could use it to sacrifice their son or daughter in the fire to Molek.
chapters.zh: 又污秽欣嫩子谷的陀斐特，不许人在那里使儿女经火献给摩洛。

chapters.en: He removed from the entrance to the temple of the LORD the horses that the kings of Judah had dedicated to the sun. They were in the court near the room of an official named Nathan-Melek. Josiah then burned the chariots dedicated to the sun.
chapters.zh: 又将犹大列王在耶和华殿门旁，太监拿单米勒靠近游廊的屋子，向日头所献的马废去，且用火焚烧日车。

chapters.en: He pulled down the altars the kings of Judah had erected on the roof near the upper room of Ahaz, and the altars Manasseh had built in the two courts of the temple of the LORD. He removed them from there, smashed them to pieces and threw the rubble into the Kidron Valley.
chapters.zh: 犹大列王在亚哈斯楼顶上所筑的坛和玛拿西在耶和华殿两院中所筑的坛，王都拆毁打碎了，就把灰倒在汲沦溪中。

chapters.en: The king also desecrated the high places that were east of Jerusalem on the south of the Hill of Corruption—the ones Solomon king of Israel had built for Ashtoreth the vile goddess of the Sidonians, for Chemosh the vile god of Moab, and for Molek the detestable god of the people of Ammon.
chapters.zh: 从前以色列王所罗门在耶路撒冷前，邪僻山右边为西顿人可憎的神亚斯他录，摩押人可憎的神基抹，亚扪人可憎的神米勒公所筑的丘坛，王都污秽了，

chapters.en: Josiah smashed the sacred stones and cut down the Asherah poles and covered the sites with human bones.
chapters.zh: 又打碎柱像，砍下木偶，将人的骨头充满了那地方。

chapters.en: Even the altar at Bethel, the high place made by Jeroboam son of Nebat, who had caused Israel to sin—even that altar and high place he demolished. He burned the high place and ground it to powder, and burned the Asherah pole also.
chapters.zh: 他将伯特利的坛，就是叫以色列人陷在罪里，尼八的儿子耶罗波安所筑的那坛，都拆毁焚烧，打碎成灰，并焚烧了亚舍拉。

chapters.en: Then Josiah looked around, and when he saw the tombs that were there on the hillside, he had the bones removed from them and burned on the altar to defile it, in accordance with the word of the LORD proclaimed by the man of God who foretold these things.
chapters.zh: 约西亚回头，看见山上的坟墓，就打发人将坟墓里的骸骨取出来，烧在坛上，污秽了坛，正如从前神人宣传耶和华的话。

chapters.en: The king asked, “What is that tombstone I see?” The people of the city said, “It marks the tomb of the man of God who came from Judah and pronounced against the altar of Bethel the very things you have done to it.”
chapters.zh: 约西亚问说，我所看见的是什么碑。那城里的人回答说，先前有神人从犹大来，预先说王现在向伯特利坛所行的事，这就是他的墓碑。

chapters.en: “Leave it alone,” he said. “Don’t let anyone disturb his bones.” So they spared his bones and those of the prophet who had come from Samaria.
chapters.zh: 约西亚说，由他吧。不要挪移他的骸骨。他们就不动他的骸骨，也不动从撒玛利亚来那先知的骸骨。

chapters.en: Just as he had done at Bethel, Josiah removed all the shrines at the high places that the kings of Israel had built in the towns of Samaria and that had aroused the LORD’s anger.
chapters.zh: 从前以色列诸王在撒玛利亚的城邑建筑丘坛的殿，惹动耶和华的怒气，现在约西亚都废去了，就如他在伯特利所行的一般。

chapters.en: Josiah slaughtered all the priests of those high places on the altars and burned human bones on them. Then he went back to Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 又将丘坛的祭司都杀在坛上，并在坛上烧人的骨头，就回耶路撒冷去了。

chapters.en: The king gave this order to all the people: “Celebrate the Passover to the LORD your God, as it is written in this Book of the Covenant.”
chapters.zh: 王吩咐众民说，你们当照这约书上所写的，向耶和华你们的神守逾越节。

chapters.en: Neither in the days of the judges who led Israel nor in the days of the kings of Israel and the kings of Judah had any such Passover been observed.
chapters.zh: 自从士师治理以色列人和以色列王，犹大王的时候，直到如今，实在没有守过这样的逾越节。

chapters.en: But in the eighteenth year of King Josiah, this Passover was celebrated to the LORD in Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 只有约西亚王十八年在耶路撒冷向耶和华守这逾越节。

chapters.en: Furthermore, Josiah got rid of the mediums and spiritists, the household gods, the idols and all the other detestable things seen in Judah and Jerusalem. This he did to fulfill the requirements of the law written in the book that Hilkiah the priest had discovered in the temple of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 凡犹大国和耶路撒冷所有交鬼的，行巫术的，与家中的神像和偶像，并一切可憎之物，约西亚尽都除掉，成就了祭司希勒家在耶和华殿里所得律法书上所写的话。

chapters.en: Neither before nor after Josiah was there a king like him who turned to the LORD as he did—with all his heart and with all his soul and with all his strength, in accordance with all the Law of Moses.
chapters.zh: 在约西亚以前没有王像他尽心，尽性，尽力地归向耶和华，遵行摩西的一切律法。在他以后也没有兴起一个王像他。

chapters.en: Nevertheless, the LORD did not turn away from the heat of his fierce anger, which burned against Judah because of all that Manasseh had done to arouse his anger.
chapters.zh: 然而，耶和华向犹大所发猛烈的怒气仍不止息，是因玛拿西诸事惹动他。

chapters.en: So the LORD said, “I will remove Judah also from my presence as I removed Israel, and I will reject Jerusalem, the city I chose, and this temple, about which I said, ‘My Name shall be there.’ ”
chapters.zh: 耶和华说，我必将犹大人从我面前赶出，如同赶出以色列人一般。我必弃掉我从前所选择的这城耶路撒冷和我所说立我名的殿。

chapters.en: As for the other events of Josiah’s reign, and all he did, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Judah?
chapters.zh: 约西亚其余的事，凡他所行的都写在犹大列王记上。

chapters.en: While Josiah was king, Pharaoh Necho king of Egypt went up to the Euphrates River to help the king of Assyria. King Josiah marched out to meet him in battle, but Necho faced him and killed him at Megiddo.
chapters.zh: 约西亚年间，埃及王法老尼哥上到伯拉河攻击亚述王。约西亚王去抵挡他。埃及王遇见约西亚在米吉多，就杀了他。

chapters.en: Josiah’s servants brought his body in a chariot from Megiddo to Jerusalem and buried him in his own tomb. And the people of the land took Jehoahaz son of Josiah and anointed him and made him king in place of his father.
chapters.zh: 他的臣仆用车将他的尸首从米吉多送到耶路撒冷，葬在他自己的坟墓里。国民膏约西亚的儿子约哈斯接续他父亲作王。

chapters.en: Jehoahaz was twenty-three years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem three months. His mother’s name was Hamutal daughter of Jeremiah; she was from Libnah.
chapters.zh: 约哈斯登基的时候年二十三岁，在耶路撒冷作王三个月。他母亲名叫哈慕她，是立拿人耶利米的女儿。

chapters.en: He did evil in the eyes of the LORD, just as his predecessors had done.
chapters.zh: 约哈斯行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，效法他列祖一切所行的。

chapters.en: Pharaoh Necho put him in chains at Riblah in the land of Hamath so that he might not reign in Jerusalem, and he imposed on Judah a levy of a hundred talents of silver and a talent of gold.
chapters.zh: 法老尼哥将约哈斯锁禁在哈马地的利比拉，不许他在耶路撒冷作王，又罚犹大国银子一百他连得，金子一他连得。

chapters.en: Pharaoh Necho made Eliakim son of Josiah king in place of his father Josiah and changed Eliakim’s name to Jehoiakim. But he took Jehoahaz and carried him off to Egypt, and there he died.
chapters.zh: 法老尼哥立约西亚的儿子以利亚敬接续他父亲约西亚作王，给他改名叫约雅敬，却将约哈斯带到埃及，他就死在那里。

chapters.en: Jehoiakim paid Pharaoh Necho the silver and gold he demanded. In order to do so, he taxed the land and exacted the silver and gold from the people of the land according to their assessments.
chapters.zh: 约雅敬将金银给法老，遵着法老的命向国民征取金银，按着各人的力量派定，索要金银，好给法老尼哥。

chapters.en: Jehoiakim was twenty-five years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem eleven years. His mother’s name was Zebidah daughter of Pedaiah; she was from Rumah.
chapters.zh: 约雅敬登基的时候年二十五岁，在耶路撒冷作王十一年。他母亲名叫西布大，是鲁玛人毗大雅的女儿。

chapters.en: And he did evil in the eyes of the LORD, just as his predecessors had done.
chapters.zh: 约雅敬行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，效法他列祖一切所行的。

chapters.en: During Jehoiakim’s reign, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon invaded the land, and Jehoiakim became his vassal for three years. But then he turned against Nebuchadnezzar and rebelled.
chapters.zh: 约雅敬年间，巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒上到犹大。约雅敬服事他三年，然后背叛他。

chapters.en: The LORD sent Babylonian, Aramean, Moabite and Ammonite raiders against him to destroy Judah, in accordance with the word of the LORD proclaimed by his servants the prophets.
chapters.zh: 耶和华使迦勒底军，亚兰军，摩押军，和亚扪人的军来攻击约雅敬，毁灭犹大，正如耶和华借他仆人众先知所说的。

chapters.en: Surely these things happened to Judah according to the LORD’s command, in order to remove them from his presence because of the sins of Manasseh and all he had done,
chapters.zh: 这祸临到犹大人，诚然是耶和华所命的，要将他们从自己面前赶出，是因玛拿西所犯的一切罪。

chapters.en: including the shedding of innocent blood. For he had filled Jerusalem with innocent blood, and the LORD was not willing to forgive.
chapters.zh: 又因他流无辜人的血，充满了耶路撒冷。耶和华决不肯赦免。

chapters.en: As for the other events of Jehoiakim’s reign, and all he did, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Judah?
chapters.zh: 约雅敬其余的事，凡他所行的都写在犹大列王记上。

chapters.en: Jehoiakim rested with his ancestors. And Jehoiachin his son succeeded him as king.
chapters.zh: 约雅敬与他列祖同睡。他儿子约雅斤接续他作王。

chapters.en: The king of Egypt did not march out from his own country again, because the king of Babylon had taken all his territory, from the Wadi of Egypt to the Euphrates River.
chapters.zh: 埃及王不再从他国中出来。因为巴比伦王将埃及王所管之地，从埃及小河直到伯拉河都夺去了。

chapters.en: Jehoiachin was eighteen years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem three months. His mother’s name was Nehushta daughter of Elnathan; she was from Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 约雅斤登基的时候年十八岁，在耶路撒冷作王三个月。他母亲名叫尼护施她，是耶路撒冷人以利拿单的女儿。

chapters.en: He did evil in the eyes of the LORD, just as his father had done.
chapters.zh: 约雅斤行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，效法他父亲一切所行的。

chapters.en: At that time the officers of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon advanced on Jerusalem and laid siege to it,
chapters.zh: 那时，巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒的军兵上到耶路撒冷，围困城。

chapters.en: and Nebuchadnezzar himself came up to the city while his officers were besieging it.
chapters.zh: 当他军兵围困城的时候，巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒就亲自来了。

chapters.en: Jehoiachin king of Judah, his mother, his attendants, his nobles and his officials all surrendered to him. In the eighth year of the reign of the king of Babylon, he took Jehoiachin prisoner.
chapters.zh: 犹大王约雅斤和他母亲，臣仆，首领，太监一同出城，投降巴比伦王。巴比伦王便拿住他。那时是巴比伦王第八年。

chapters.en: As the LORD had declared, Nebuchadnezzar removed the treasures from the temple of the LORD and from the royal palace, and cut up the gold articles that Solomon king of Israel had made for the temple of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 巴比伦王将耶和华殿和王宫里的宝物都拿去了，将以色列王所罗门所造耶和华殿里的金器都毁坏了，正如耶和华所说的。

chapters.en: He carried all Jerusalem into exile: all the officers and fighting men, and all the skilled workers and artisans—a total of ten thousand. Only the poorest people of the land were left.
chapters.zh: 又将耶路撒冷的众民和众首领，并所有大能的勇士，共一万人，连一切木匠，铁匠都掳了去。除了国中极贫穷的人以外，没有剩下的。

chapters.en: Nebuchadnezzar took Jehoiachin captive to Babylon. He also took from Jerusalem to Babylon the king’s mother, his wives, his officials and the prominent people of the land.
chapters.zh: 并将约雅斤和王母，后妃，太监，与国中的大官，都从耶路撒冷掳到巴比伦去了。

chapters.en: The king of Babylon also deported to Babylon the entire force of seven thousand fighting men, strong and fit for war, and a thousand skilled workers and artisans.
chapters.zh: 又将一切勇士七千人和木匠，铁匠一千人，都是能上阵的勇士，全掳到巴比伦去了。

chapters.en: He made Mattaniah, Jehoiachin’s uncle, king in his place and changed his name to Zedekiah.
chapters.zh: 巴比伦王立约雅斤的叔叔玛探雅代替他作王，给玛探雅改名叫西底家。

chapters.en: Zedekiah was twenty-one years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem eleven years. His mother’s name was Hamutal daughter of Jeremiah; she was from Libnah.
chapters.zh: 西底家登基的时候年二十一岁，在耶路撒冷作王十一年。他母亲名叫哈慕她，是立拿人耶利米的女儿。

chapters.en: He did evil in the eyes of the LORD, just as Jehoiakim had done.
chapters.zh: 西底家行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，是照约雅敬一切所行的。

chapters.en: It was because of the LORD’s anger that all this happened to Jerusalem and Judah, and in the end he thrust them from his presence. Now Zedekiah rebelled against the king of Babylon.
chapters.zh: 因此耶和华的怒气在耶路撒冷和犹大发作，以致将人民从自己面前赶出。

chapters.en: So in the ninth year of Zedekiah’s reign, on the tenth day of the tenth month, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon marched against Jerusalem with his whole army. He encamped outside the city and built siege works all around it.
chapters.zh: 西底家背叛巴比伦王。他作王第九年十月初十日，巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒率领全军来攻击耶路撒冷，对城安营，四围筑垒攻城。

chapters.en: The city was kept under siege until the eleventh year of King Zedekiah.
chapters.zh: 于是城被围困，直到西底家王十一年。

chapters.en: By the ninth day of the fourth month the famine in the city had become so severe that there was no food for the people to eat.
chapters.zh: 四月初九日，城里有大饥荒，甚至百姓都没有粮食。
