chapters.en: Then the city wall was broken through, and the whole army fled at night through the gate between the two walls near the king’s garden, though the Babylonians were surrounding the city. They fled toward the Arabah,
chapters.zh: 城被攻破，一切兵丁就在夜间从靠近王园两城中间的门逃跑。迦勒底人正在四围攻城，王就向亚拉巴逃走。

chapters.en: but the Babylonian army pursued the king and overtook him in the plains of Jericho. All his soldiers were separated from him and scattered,
chapters.zh: 迦勒底的军队追赶王，在耶利哥的平原追上他。他的全军都离开他四散了。

chapters.en: and he was captured. He was taken to the king of Babylon at Riblah, where sentence was pronounced on him.
chapters.zh: 迦勒底人就拿住王，带他到利比拉巴比伦王那里审判他。

chapters.en: They killed the sons of Zedekiah before his eyes. Then they put out his eyes, bound him with bronze shackles and took him to Babylon.
chapters.zh: 在西底家眼前杀了他的众子，并且剜了西底家的眼睛，用铜链锁着他，带到巴比伦去。

chapters.en: On the seventh day of the fifth month, in the nineteenth year of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, Nebuzaradan commander of the imperial guard, an official of the king of Babylon, came to Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒十九年五月初七日，巴比伦王的臣仆，护卫长尼布撒拉旦来到耶路撒冷，

chapters.en: He set fire to the temple of the LORD, the royal palace and all the houses of Jerusalem. Every important building he burned down.
chapters.zh: 用火焚烧耶和华的殿和王宫，又焚烧耶路撒冷的房屋，就是各大户家的房屋。

chapters.en: The whole Babylonian army under the commander of the imperial guard broke down the walls around Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 跟从护卫长迦勒底的全军就拆毁耶路撒冷四围的城墙。

chapters.en: Nebuzaradan the commander of the guard carried into exile the people who remained in the city, along with the rest of the populace and those who had deserted to the king of Babylon.
chapters.zh: 那时护卫长尼布撒拉旦将城里所剩下的百姓，并已经投降巴比伦王的人，以及大众所剩下的人，都掳去了。

chapters.en: But the commander left behind some of the poorest people of the land to work the vineyards and fields.
chapters.zh: 但护卫长留下些民中最穷的，使他们修理葡萄园，耕种田地。

chapters.en: The Babylonians broke up the bronze pillars, the movable stands and the bronze Sea that were at the temple of the LORD and they carried the bronze to Babylon.
chapters.zh: 耶和华殿的铜柱，并耶和华殿的盆座和铜海，迦勒底人都打碎了，将那铜运到巴比伦去了，

chapters.en: They also took away the pots, shovels, wick trimmers, dishes and all the bronze articles used in the temple service.
chapters.zh: 又带去锅，铲子，蜡剪，调羹，并所用的一切铜器，

chapters.en: The commander of the imperial guard took away the censers and sprinkling bowls—all that were made of pure gold or silver.
chapters.zh: 火鼎，碗，无论金的银的，护卫长也都带去了。

chapters.en: The bronze from the two pillars, the Sea and the movable stands, which Solomon had made for the temple of the LORD, was more than could be weighed.
chapters.zh: 所罗门为耶和华殿所造的两根铜柱，一个铜海，和几个盆座，这一切的铜，多得无法可称。

chapters.en: Each pillar was eighteen cubits high. The bronze capital on top of one pillar was three cubits high and was decorated with a network and pomegranates of bronze all around. The other pillar, with its network, was similar.
chapters.zh: 这一根柱子高十八肘，柱上有铜顶，高三肘。铜顶的周围有网子和石榴，都是铜的。那一根柱子，照此一样，也有网子。

chapters.en: The commander of the guard took as prisoners Seraiah the chief priest, Zephaniah the priest next in rank and the three doorkeepers.
chapters.zh: 护卫长拿住大祭司西莱雅，副祭司西番亚，和三个把门的，

chapters.en: Of those still in the city, he took the officer in charge of the fighting men, and five royal advisers. He also took the secretary who was chief officer in charge of conscripting the people of the land and sixty of the conscripts who were found in the city.
chapters.zh: 又从城中拿住一个管理兵丁的官（或作太监），并在城里所遇常见王面的五个人和检点国民军长的书记，以及城里遇见的国民六十个人。

chapters.en: Nebuzaradan the commander took them all and brought them to the king of Babylon at Riblah.
chapters.zh: 护卫长尼布撒拉旦将这些人带到利比拉巴比伦王那里。

chapters.en: There at Riblah, in the land of Hamath, the king had them executed. So Judah went into captivity, away from her land.
chapters.zh: 巴比伦王就把他们击杀在哈马地的利比拉。这样，犹大人被掳去离开本地。

chapters.en: Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon appointed Gedaliah son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan, to be over the people he had left behind in Judah.
chapters.zh: 至于犹大国剩下的民，就是巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒所剩下的，巴比伦王立了沙番的孙子，亚希甘的儿子基大利作他们的省长。

chapters.en: When all the army officers and their men heard that the king of Babylon had appointed Gedaliah as governor, they came to Gedaliah at Mizpah—Ishmael son of Nethaniah, Johanan son of Kareah, Seraiah son of Tanhumeth the Netophathite, Jaazaniah the son of the Maakathite, and their men.
chapters.zh: 众军长和属他们的人听见巴比伦王立了基大利作省长，于是军长尼探雅的儿子以实玛利，加利亚的儿子约哈难，尼陀法人单户蔑的儿子西莱雅，玛迦人的儿子雅撒尼亚，和属他们的人都到米斯巴见基大利。

chapters.en: Gedaliah took an oath to reassure them and their men. “Do not be afraid of the Babylonian officials,” he said. “Settle down in the land and serve the king of Babylon, and it will go well with you.”
chapters.zh: 基大利向他们和属他们的人起誓说，你们不必惧怕迦勒底臣仆，只管住在这地服事巴比伦王，就可以得福。

chapters.en: In the seventh month, however, Ishmael son of Nethaniah, the son of Elishama, who was of royal blood, came with ten men and assassinated Gedaliah and also the men of Judah and the Babylonians who were with him at Mizpah.
chapters.zh: 七月间，宗室以利沙玛的孙子，尼探雅的儿子以实玛利带着十个人来，杀了基大利和同他在米斯巴的犹大人与迦勒底人。

chapters.en: At this, all the people from the least to the greatest, together with the army officers, fled to Egypt for fear of the Babylonians.
chapters.zh: 于是众民，无论大小，连众军长。因为惧怕迦勒底人，都起身往埃及去了。

chapters.en: In the thirty-seventh year of the exile of Jehoiachin king of Judah, in the year Awel-Marduk became king of Babylon, he released Jehoiachin king of Judah from prison. He did this on the twenty-seventh day of the twelfth month.
chapters.zh: 犹大王约雅斤被掳后三十七年，巴比伦王以未米罗达元年十二月二十七日，使犹大王约雅斤抬头，提他出监。

chapters.en: He spoke kindly to him and gave him a seat of honor higher than those of the other kings who were with him in Babylon.
chapters.zh: 又对他说恩言，使他的位高过与他一同在巴比伦众王的位，

chapters.en: So Jehoiachin put aside his prison clothes and for the rest of his life ate regularly at the king’s table.
chapters.zh: 给他脱了囚服。他终身常在巴比伦王面前吃饭。

chapters.en: Day by day the king gave Jehoiachin a regular allowance as long as he lived.
chapters.zh: 王赐他所需用的食物，日日赐他一分，终身都是这样。

chapters.en: Adam, Seth, Enosh,
chapters.zh: 亚当生塞特。塞特生以挪士。

chapters.en: Kenan, Mahalalel, Jared,
chapters.zh: 以挪士生该南。该南生玛勒列。玛勒列生雅列。

chapters.en: Enoch, Methuselah, Lamech, Noah.
chapters.zh: 雅列生以诺。以诺生玛土撒拉。玛土撒拉生拉麦。

chapters.en: The sons of Noah:Shem, Ham and Japheth.
chapters.zh: 拉麦生挪亚。挪亚生闪，含，雅弗。

chapters.en: The sons of Japheth: Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshek and Tiras.
chapters.zh: 雅弗的儿子是歌篾，玛各，玛代，雅完，土巴，米设，提拉。

chapters.en: The sons of Gomer: Ashkenaz, Riphath and Togarmah.
chapters.zh: 歌篾的儿子是亚实基拿，低法（低法创世记十章三节是利法），陀迦玛。

chapters.en: The sons of Javan: Elishah, Tarshish, the Kittites and the Rodanites.
chapters.zh: 雅完的儿子是以利沙，他施，基提，多单（多单有作罗单的）。

chapters.en: The sons of Ham: Cush, Egypt, Put and Canaan.
chapters.zh: 含的儿子是古实，麦西，弗，迦南。

chapters.en: The sons of Cush: Seba, Havilah, Sabta, Raamah and Sabteka. The sons of Raamah: Sheba and Dedan.
chapters.zh: 古实的儿子是西巴，哈腓拉，撒弗他，拉玛，撒弗提迦。拉玛的儿子是示巴，底但。

chapters.en: Cush was the father of Nimrod, who became a mighty warrior on earth.
chapters.zh: 古实生宁录。他为世上英雄之首。

chapters.en: Egypt was the father of the Ludites, Anamites, Lehabites, Naphtuhites,
chapters.zh: 麦西生路低人，亚拿米人，利哈比人，拿弗土希人，

chapters.en: Pathrusites, Kasluhites (from whom the Philistines came) and Caphtorites.
chapters.zh: 帕斯鲁细人，迦斯路希人，迦斐托人。从迦斐托出来的有非利士人。

chapters.en: Canaan was the father of Sidon his firstborn, and of the Hittites,
chapters.zh: 迦南生长子西顿，又生赫

chapters.en: Jebusites, Amorites, Girgashites,
chapters.zh: 和耶布斯人，亚摩利人，革迦撒人，

chapters.en: Hivites, Arkites, Sinites,
chapters.zh: 希未人，亚基人，西尼人，

chapters.en: Arvadites, Zemarites and Hamathites.
chapters.zh: 亚瓦底人，洗玛利人，并哈马人。

chapters.en: The sons of Shem: Elam, Ashur, Arphaxad, Lud and Aram. The sons of Aram:Uz, Hul, Gether and Meshek.
chapters.zh: 闪的儿子是以拦，亚述，亚法撒，路德，亚兰，乌斯，户勒，基帖，米设（米设创世记十章二十三节作玛施）。

chapters.en: Arphaxad was the father of Shelah, and Shelah the father of Eber.
chapters.zh: 亚法撒生沙拉。沙拉生希伯。

chapters.en: Two sons were born to Eber: One was named Peleg, because in his time the earth was divided; his brother was named Joktan.
chapters.zh: 希伯生了两个儿子，一个名叫法勒（法勒就是分的意思），因为那时人就分地居住。法勒的兄弟名叫约坍。

chapters.en: Joktan was the father of Almodad, Sheleph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah,
chapters.zh: 约坍生亚摩答，沙列，哈萨玛非，耶拉，

chapters.en: Hadoram, Uzal, Diklah,
chapters.zh: 哈多兰，乌萨，德拉，

chapters.en: Obal, Abimael, Sheba,
chapters.zh: 以巴录，亚比玛利，示巴，

chapters.en: Ophir, Havilah and Jobab. All these were sons of Joktan.
chapters.zh: 阿斐，哈腓拉，约巴。这都是约坍的儿子。

chapters.en: Shem, Arphaxad, Shelah,
chapters.zh: 闪生亚法撒。亚法撒生沙拉。

chapters.en: Eber, Peleg, Reu,
chapters.zh: 沙拉生希伯。希伯生法勒。法勒生拉吴。

chapters.en: Serug, Nahor, Terah
chapters.zh: 拉吴生西鹿。西鹿生拿鹤。拿鹤生他拉。

chapters.en: and Abram (that is, Abraham).
chapters.zh: 他拉生亚伯兰，亚伯兰就是亚伯拉罕。

chapters.en: The sons of Abraham: Isaac and Ishmael.
chapters.zh: 亚伯拉罕的儿子是以撒，以实玛利。

chapters.en: These were their descendants: Nebaioth the firstborn of Ishmael, Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam,
chapters.zh: 以实玛利的儿子记在下面，以实玛利的长子是尼拜约，其次是基达，押德别，米比衫，

chapters.en: Mishma, Dumah, Massa, Hadad, Tema,
chapters.zh: 米施玛，度玛，玛撒，哈达，提玛，

chapters.en: Jetur, Naphish and Kedemah. These were the sons of Ishmael.
chapters.zh: 伊突，拿非施，基底玛。这都是以实玛利的儿子。

chapters.en: The sons born to Keturah, Abraham’s concubine: Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak and Shuah. The sons of Jokshan: Sheba and Dedan.
chapters.zh: 亚伯拉罕的妾基土拉所生的儿子，就是心兰，约珊，米但，米甸，伊施巴，书亚。约珊的儿子是示巴，底但。

chapters.en: The sons of Midian: Ephah, Epher, Hanok, Abida and Eldaah. All these were descendants of Keturah.
chapters.zh: 米甸的儿子是以法，以弗，哈诺，亚比大，以勒大。这都是基土拉的子孙。

chapters.en: Abraham was the father of Isaac. The sons of Isaac: Esau and Israel.
chapters.zh: 亚伯拉罕生以撒。以撒的儿子是以扫和以色列。

chapters.en: The sons of Esau: Eliphaz, Reuel, Jeush, Jalam and Korah.
chapters.zh: 以扫的儿子是以利法，流珥，耶乌施，雅兰，可拉。

chapters.en: The sons of Eliphaz: Teman, Omar, Zepho, Gatam and Kenaz; by Timna: Amalek.
chapters.zh: 以利法的儿子是提幔，阿抹，洗玻，迦坦，基纳斯，亭纳，亚玛力。

chapters.en: The sons of Reuel: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah and Mizzah.
chapters.zh: 流珥的儿子是拿哈，谢拉，沙玛，米撒。

chapters.en: The sons of Seir: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah, Dishon, Ezer and Dishan.
chapters.zh: 西珥的儿子是罗坍，朔巴，祭便，亚拿，底顺，以察，底珊。

chapters.en: The sons of Lotan: Hori and Homam. Timna was Lotan’s sister.
chapters.zh: 罗坍的儿子是何利，荷幔。罗坍的妹子是亭纳。

chapters.en: The sons of Shobal: Alvan, Manahath, Ebal, Shepho and Onam. The sons of Zibeon: Aiah and Anah.
chapters.zh: 朔巴的儿子是亚勒文，玛拿辖，以巴录，示非，阿南。祭便的儿子是亚雅，亚拿。

chapters.en: The son of Anah: Dishon. The sons of Dishon: Hemdan, Eshban, Ithran and Keran.
chapters.zh: 亚拿的儿子是底顺。底顺的儿子是哈默兰，伊是班，益兰，基兰。

chapters.en: The sons of Ezer: Bilhan, Zaavan and Akan.The sons of Dishan : Uz and Aran.
chapters.zh: 以察的儿子是辟罕，撒番，亚干。底珊的儿子是乌斯，亚兰。

chapters.en: These were the kings who reigned in Edom before any Israelite king reigned: Bela son of Beor, whose city was named Dinhabah.
chapters.zh: 以色列人未有君王治理之先，在以东地作王的记在下面，有比珥的儿子比拉，他的京城名叫亭哈巴。

chapters.en: When Bela died, Jobab son of Zerah from Bozrah succeeded him as king.
chapters.zh: 比拉死了，波斯拉人谢拉的儿子约巴接续他作王。

chapters.en: When Jobab died, Husham from the land of the Temanites succeeded him as king.
chapters.zh: 约巴死了，提幔地的人户珊接续他作王。

chapters.en: When Husham died, Hadad son of Bedad, who defeated Midian in the country of Moab, succeeded him as king. His city was named Avith.
chapters.zh: 户珊死了，比达的儿子哈达接续他作王。这哈达就是在摩押地杀败米甸人的，他的京城名叫亚未得。

chapters.en: When Hadad died, Samlah from Masrekah succeeded him as king.
chapters.zh: 哈达死了，玛士利加人桑拉接续他作王。

chapters.en: When Samlah died, Shaul from Rehoboth on the river succeeded him as king.
chapters.zh: 桑拉死了，大河边的利河伯人扫罗接续他作王。

chapters.en: When Shaul died, Baal-Hanan son of Akbor succeeded him as king.
chapters.zh: 扫罗死了，亚革波的儿子巴勒哈南接续他作王。

chapters.en: When Baal-Hanan died, Hadad succeeded him as king. His city was named Pau, and his wife’s name was Mehetabel daughter of Matred, the daughter of Me-Zahab.
chapters.zh: 巴勒哈南死了，哈达接续他作王。他的京城名叫巴伊，他的妻子名叫米希他别，是米萨合的孙女，玛特列的女儿。

chapters.en: Hadad also died. The chiefs of Edom were: Timna, Alvah, Jetheth,
chapters.zh: 哈达死了，以东人的族长有亭纳族长，亚勒瓦族长，耶帖族长，

chapters.en: Oholibamah, Elah, Pinon,
chapters.zh: 亚何利巴玛族长，以拉族长，比嫩族长，

chapters.en: Kenaz, Teman, Mibzar,
chapters.zh: 基纳斯族长，提幔族长，米比萨族长，

chapters.en: Magdiel and Iram. These were the chiefs of Edom.
chapters.zh: 玛基叠族长，以兰族长。这都是以东人的族长。

chapters.en: These were the sons of Israel: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Zebulun,
chapters.zh: 以色列的儿子是流便，西缅，利未，犹大，以萨迦，西布伦，

chapters.en: Dan, Joseph, Benjamin, Naphtali, Gad and Asher.
chapters.zh: 但，约瑟，便雅悯，拿弗他利，迦得，亚设。

chapters.en: The sons of Judah: Er, Onan and Shelah. These three were born to him by a Canaanite woman, the daughter of Shua. Er, Judah’s firstborn, was wicked in the LORD’s sight; so the LORD put him to death.
chapters.zh: 犹大的儿子是珥，俄南，示拉，这三人是迦南人书亚女儿所生的。犹大的长子珥在耶和华眼中看为恶，耶和华就使他死了。

chapters.en: Judah’s daughter-in-law Tamar bore Perez and Zerah to Judah. He had five sons in all.
chapters.zh: 犹大的儿妇他玛给犹大生法勒斯和谢拉。犹大共有五个儿子。

chapters.en: The sons of Perez: Hezron and Hamul.
chapters.zh: 法勒斯的儿子是希斯仑，哈母勒。

chapters.en: The sons of Zerah: Zimri, Ethan, Heman, Kalkol and Darda —five in all.
chapters.zh: 谢拉的儿子是心利，以探，希幔，甲各，大拉（大拉即达大），共五人。

chapters.en: The son of Karmi: Achar, who brought trouble on Israel by violating the ban on taking devoted things.
chapters.zh: 迦米的儿子是亚干，这亚干在当灭的物上犯了罪，连累了以色列人。

chapters.en: The son of Ethan: Azariah.
chapters.zh: 以探的儿子是亚撒利雅。

chapters.en: The sons born to Hezron were: Jerahmeel, Ram and Caleb.
chapters.zh: 希斯仑所生的儿子是耶拉篾，兰，基路拜。

chapters.en: Ram was the father of Amminadab, and Amminadab the father of Nahshon, the leader of the people of Judah.
chapters.zh: 兰生亚米拿达。亚米拿达生拿顺。拿顺作犹大人的首领。

chapters.en: Nahshon was the father of Salmon, Salmon the father of Boaz,
chapters.zh: 拿顺生撒门。撒门生波阿斯。

chapters.en: Boaz the father of Obed and Obed the father of Jesse.
chapters.zh: 波阿斯生俄备得。俄备得生耶西。

chapters.en: Jesse was the father of Eliab his firstborn; the second son was Abinadab, the third Shimea,
chapters.zh: 耶西生长子以利押，次子亚比拿达，三子示米亚（示米亚即沙玛，见撒母耳上十六章九节），

chapters.en: the fourth Nethanel, the fifth Raddai,
chapters.zh: 四子拿坦业，五子拉代，

chapters.en: the sixth Ozem and the seventh David.
chapters.zh: 六子阿鲜，七子大卫。

chapters.en: Their sisters were Zeruiah and Abigail. Zeruiah’s three sons were Abishai, Joab and Asahel.
chapters.zh: 他们的姐妹是洗鲁雅和亚比该。洗鲁雅的儿子是亚比筛，约押，亚撒黑，共三人。

chapters.en: Abigail was the mother of Amasa, whose father was Jether the Ishmaelite.
chapters.zh: 亚比该生亚玛撒。亚玛撒的父亲是以实玛利人益帖。

chapters.en: Caleb son of Hezron had children by his wife Azubah (and by Jerioth). These were her sons: Jesher, Shobab and Ardon.
chapters.zh: 希斯仑的儿子迦勒娶阿苏巴和耶略为妻，阿苏巴的儿子是耶设，朔吧，押墩。

chapters.en: When Azubah died, Caleb married Ephrath, who bore him Hur.
chapters.zh: 阿苏巴死了，迦勒又娶以法他，生了户珥。

chapters.en: Hur was the father of Uri, and Uri the father of Bezalel.
chapters.zh: 户珥生乌利。乌利生比撒列。

chapters.en: Later, Hezron, when he was sixty years old, married the daughter of Makir the father of Gilead. He made love to her, and she bore him Segub.
chapters.zh: 希斯仑正六十岁娶了基列父亲玛吉的女儿，与她同房。玛吉的女儿生了西割。

chapters.en: Segub was the father of Jair, who controlled twenty-three towns in Gilead.
chapters.zh: 西割生睚珥。睚珥在基列地有二十三个城邑。

chapters.en: (But Geshur and Aram captured Havvoth Jair, as well as Kenath with its surrounding settlements—sixty towns.) All these were descendants of Makir the father of Gilead.
chapters.zh: 后来基述人和亚兰人夺了睚珥的城邑，并基纳和其乡村，共六十个。这都是基列父亲玛吉之子的。

chapters.en: After Hezron died in Caleb Ephrathah, Abijah the wife of Hezron bore him Ashhur the father of Tekoa.
chapters.zh: 希斯仑在迦勒以法他死后，他的妻亚比雅给他生了亚施户。亚施户是提哥亚的父亲。

chapters.en: The sons of Jerahmeel the firstborn of Hezron: Ram his firstborn, Bunah, Oren, Ozem and Ahijah.
chapters.zh: 希斯仑的长子耶拉篾生长子兰，又生布拿，阿连，阿鲜，亚希雅。

chapters.en: Jerahmeel had another wife, whose name was Atarah; she was the mother of Onam.
chapters.zh: 耶拉篾又娶一妻名叫亚她拉，是阿南的母亲。

chapters.en: The sons of Ram the firstborn of Jerahmeel: Maaz, Jamin and Eker.
chapters.zh: 耶拉篾长子兰的儿子是玛斯，雅悯，以结。

chapters.en: The sons of Onam: Shammai and Jada. The sons of Shammai: Nadab and Abishur.
chapters.zh: 阿南的儿子是沙买，雅大。沙买的儿子是拿答，亚比述。

chapters.en: Abishur’s wife was named Abihail, who bore him Ahban and Molid.
chapters.zh: 亚比述的妻名叫亚比孩，亚比孩给他生了亚办和摩利。

chapters.en: The sons of Nadab: Seled and Appaim. Seled died without children.
chapters.zh: 拿答的儿子是西列，亚遍。西列死了没有儿子。

chapters.en: The son of Appaim: Ishi, who was the father of Sheshan. Sheshan was the father of Ahlai.
chapters.zh: 亚遍的儿子是以示。以示的儿子是示珊。示珊的儿子是亚来。

chapters.en: The sons of Jada, Shammai’s brother: Jether and Jonathan. Jether died without children.
chapters.zh: 沙买兄弟雅大的儿子是益帖，约拿单。益帖死了没有儿子。

chapters.en: The sons of Jonathan: Peleth and Zaza. These were the descendants of Jerahmeel.
chapters.zh: 约拿单的儿子是比勒，撒萨。这都是撒拉篾的子孙。

chapters.en: Sheshan had no sons—only daughters. He had an Egyptian servant named Jarha.
chapters.zh: 示珊没有儿子，只有女儿。示珊有一个仆人名叫耶哈，是埃及人。

chapters.en: Sheshan gave his daughter in marriage to his servant Jarha, and she bore him Attai.
chapters.zh: 示珊将女儿给了仆人耶哈为妻，给他生了亚太。

chapters.en: Attai was the father of Nathan, Nathan the father of Zabad,
chapters.zh: 亚太生拿单。拿单生撒拔。

chapters.en: Zabad the father of Ephlal, Ephlal the father of Obed,
chapters.zh: 撒拔生以弗拉。以弗拉生俄备得。

chapters.en: Obed the father of Jehu, Jehu the father of Azariah,
chapters.zh: 俄备得生耶户。耶户生亚撒利雅。

chapters.en: Azariah the father of Helez, Helez the father of Eleasah,
chapters.zh: 亚撒利雅生希利斯。希利斯生以利亚萨。

chapters.en: Eleasah the father of Sismai, Sismai the father of Shallum,
chapters.zh: 以利亚萨生西斯买。西斯买生沙龙。

chapters.en: Shallum the father of Jekamiah, and Jekamiah the father of Elishama.
chapters.zh: 沙龙生耶加米雅。耶加米雅生以利沙玛。

chapters.en: The sons of Caleb the brother of Jerahmeel: Mesha his firstborn, who was the father of Ziph, and his son Mareshah, who was the father of Hebron.
chapters.zh: 耶拉篾兄弟迦勒的长子米沙，是西弗之祖玛利沙的儿子，是希伯仑之祖。

chapters.en: The sons of Hebron: Korah, Tappuah, Rekem and Shema.
chapters.zh: 希伯仑的儿子是可拉，他普亚，利肯，示玛。

chapters.en: Shema was the father of Raham, and Raham the father of Jorkeam. Rekem was the father of Shammai.
chapters.zh: 示玛生拉含，是约干之祖。利肯生沙买。

chapters.en: The son of Shammai was Maon, and Maon was the father of Beth Zur.
chapters.zh: 沙买的儿子是玛云。玛云是伯夙之祖。

chapters.en: Caleb’s concubine Ephah was the mother of Haran, Moza and Gazez. Haran was the father of Gazez.
chapters.zh: 迦勒的妾以法生哈兰，摩撒，迦谢。哈兰生迦卸。

chapters.en: The sons of Jahdai: Regem, Jotham, Geshan, Pelet, Ephah and Shaaph.
chapters.zh: 雅代的儿子是利健，约坦，基珊，毗力，以法，沙亚弗。

chapters.en: Caleb’s concubine Maakah was the mother of Sheber and Tirhanah.
chapters.zh: 迦勒的妾玛迦生示别，特哈拿，

chapters.en: She also gave birth to Shaaph the father of Madmannah and to Sheva the father of Makbenah and Gibea. Caleb’s daughter was Aksah.
chapters.zh: 又生麦玛拿之祖沙亚弗，抹比拿和基比亚之祖示法。迦勒的女儿是押撒。

chapters.en: These were the descendants of Caleb. The sons of Hur the firstborn of Ephrathah: Shobal the father of Kiriath Jearim,
chapters.zh: 迦勒的子孙就是以法他的长子，户珥的儿子，记在下面，基列耶琳之祖朔巴，

chapters.en: Salma the father of Bethlehem, and Hareph the father of Beth Gader.
chapters.zh: 伯利恒之祖萨玛，伯迦得之祖哈勒。

chapters.en: The descendants of Shobal the father of Kiriath Jearim were: Haroeh, half the Manahathites,
chapters.zh: 基列耶琳之祖朔巴的子孙是哈罗以和一半米努哈人（米努哈人即玛拿哈人）。

chapters.en: and the clans of Kiriath Jearim: the Ithrites, Puthites, Shumathites and Mishraites. From these descended the Zorathites and Eshtaolites.
chapters.zh: 基列耶琳的诸族是以帖人，布特人，舒玛人，密来人，又从这些族中生出琐拉人和以实陶人来。

chapters.en: The descendants of Salma: Bethlehem, the Netophathites, Atroth Beth Joab, half the Manahathites, the Zorites,
chapters.zh: 萨玛的子孙是伯利恒人，尼陀法人，亚他绿伯约押人，一半玛拿哈人，琐利人，

chapters.en: and the clans of scribes who lived at Jabez: the Tirathites, Shimeathites and Sucathites. These are the Kenites who came from Hammath, the father of the Rekabites.
chapters.zh: 和住雅比斯众文士家的特拉人，示米押人，苏甲人。这都是基尼人利甲家之祖哈末所生的。

chapters.en: These were the sons of David born to him in Hebron: The firstborn was Amnon the son of Ahinoam of Jezreel; the second, Daniel the son of Abigail of Carmel;
chapters.zh: 大卫在希伯仑所生的儿子记在下面，长子暗嫩是耶斯列人亚希暖生的。次子但以利是迦密人亚比该生的。

chapters.en: the third, Absalom the son of Maakah daughter of Talmai king of Geshur; the fourth, Adonijah the son of Haggith;
chapters.zh: 三子押沙龙是基述王达买的女儿玛迦生的。四子亚多尼雅是哈及生的。

chapters.en: the fifth, Shephatiah the son of Abital; and the sixth, Ithream, by his wife Eglah.
chapters.zh: 五子示法提雅是亚比他生的。六子以特念是大卫的妻以格拉生的。

chapters.en: These six were born to David in Hebron, where he reigned seven years and six months. David reigned in Jerusalem thirty-three years,
chapters.zh: 这六人都是大卫在希伯仑生的。大卫在希伯仑作王七年零六个月，在耶路撒冷作王三十三年。

chapters.en: and these were the children born to him there: Shammua, Shobab, Nathan and Solomon. These four were by Bathsheba daughter of Ammiel.
chapters.zh: 大卫在耶路撒冷所生的儿子是示米亚，朔吧，拿单，所罗门。这四人是亚米利的女儿拔书亚生的。

chapters.en: There were also Ibhar, Elishua, Eliphelet,
chapters.zh: 还有益辖，以利沙玛，以利法列，

chapters.en: Nogah, Nepheg, Japhia,
chapters.zh: 挪迦，尼斐，雅非亚，

chapters.en: Elishama, Eliada and Eliphelet—nine in all.
chapters.zh: 以利沙玛，以利雅大，以利法列，共九人。

chapters.en: All these were the sons of David, besides his sons by his concubines. And Tamar was their sister.
chapters.zh: 这都是大卫的儿子，还有他们的妹子他玛，妃嫔的儿子不在其内。

chapters.en: Solomon’s son was Rehoboam, Abijah his son, Asa his son, Jehoshaphat his son,
chapters.zh: 所罗门的儿子是罗波安。罗波安的儿子是亚比雅。亚比雅的儿子是亚撒。亚撒的儿子是约沙法。

chapters.en: Jehoram his son, Ahaziah his son, Joash his son,
chapters.zh: 约沙法的儿子是约兰。约兰的儿子是亚哈谢。亚哈谢的儿子是约阿施。

chapters.en: Amaziah his son, Azariah his son, Jotham his son,
chapters.zh: 约阿施的儿子是亚玛谢。亚玛谢的儿子是亚撒利雅。亚撒利雅的儿子是约坦。

chapters.en: Ahaz his son, Hezekiah his son, Manasseh his son,
chapters.zh: 约坦的儿子是亚哈斯。亚哈斯的儿子是希西家。希西家的儿子是玛拿西。

chapters.en: Amon his son, Josiah his son.
chapters.zh: 玛拿西的儿子是亚们。亚们的儿子是约西亚。

chapters.en: The sons of Josiah: Johanan the firstborn, Jehoiakim the second son, Zedekiah the third, Shallum the fourth.
chapters.zh: 约西亚的长子是约哈难，次子是约雅敬，三子是西底家，四子是沙龙。

chapters.en: The successors of Jehoiakim: Jehoiachin his son, and Zedekiah.
chapters.zh: 约雅敬的儿子是耶哥尼雅和西底家。

chapters.en: The descendants of Jehoiachin the captive: Shealtiel his son,
chapters.zh: 耶哥尼雅被掳。他的儿子是撒拉铁，

chapters.en: Malkiram, Pedaiah, Shenazzar, Jekamiah, Hoshama and Nedabiah.
chapters.zh: 玛基兰，毗大雅，示拿萨，耶加米，何沙玛，尼大比雅。

chapters.en: The sons of Pedaiah: Zerubbabel and Shimei. The sons of Zerubbabel: Meshullam and Hananiah. Shelomith was their sister.
chapters.zh: 毗大雅的儿子是所罗巴伯，示每。所罗巴伯的儿子是米书兰，哈拿尼雅，他们的妹子名叫示罗密。

chapters.en: There were also five others: Hashubah, Ohel, Berekiah, Hasadiah and Jushab-Hesed.
chapters.zh: 米书兰的儿子是哈舒巴，阿黑，比利家，哈撒底，于沙希悉，共五人。

chapters.en: The descendants of Hananiah: Pelatiah and Jeshaiah, and the sons of Rephaiah, of Arnan, of Obadiah and of Shekaniah.
chapters.zh: 哈拿尼雅的儿子是毗拉提，耶筛亚。还有利法雅的众子，亚珥难的众子，俄巴底亚的众子，示迦尼的众子。

chapters.en: The descendants of Shekaniah: Shemaiah and his sons: Hattush, Igal, Bariah, Neariah and Shaphat—six in all.
chapters.zh: 示迦尼的儿子是示玛雅。示玛雅的儿子是哈突，以甲，巴利亚，尼利雅，沙法，共六人。

chapters.en: The sons of Neariah: Elioenai, Hizkiah and Azrikam—three in all.
chapters.zh: 尼利雅的儿子是以利约乃，希西家，亚斯利干，共三人。

chapters.en: The sons of Elioenai: Hodaviah, Eliashib, Pelaiah, Akkub, Johanan, Delaiah and Anani—seven in all.
chapters.zh: 以利约乃的儿子是何大雅，以利亚实，毗莱雅，阿谷，约哈难，第莱雅，阿拿尼，共七人。

chapters.en: The descendants of Judah: Perez, Hezron, Karmi, Hur and Shobal.
chapters.zh: 犹大的儿子是法勒斯，希斯仑，迦米，户珥，朔巴。

chapters.en: Reaiah son of Shobal was the father of Jahath, and Jahath the father of Ahumai and Lahad. These were the clans of the Zorathites.
chapters.zh: 朔巴的儿子利亚雅生雅哈。雅哈生亚户买和拉哈。这是琐拉人的诸族。

chapters.en: These were the sons of Etam: Jezreel, Ishma and Idbash. Their sister was named Hazzelelponi.
chapters.zh: 以坦之祖的儿子是耶斯列，伊施玛，伊得巴。他们的妹子名叫哈悉勒玻尼。

chapters.en: Penuel was the father of Gedor, and Ezer the father of Hushah. These were the descendants of Hur, the firstborn of Ephrathah and father of Bethlehem.
chapters.zh: 基多之祖是毗努伊勒。户沙之祖是以谢珥。这都是伯利恒之祖以法他的长子户珥所生的。

chapters.en: Ashhur the father of Tekoa had two wives, Helah and Naarah.
chapters.zh: 提哥亚之祖亚施户有两个妻子，一名希拉，一名拿拉。

chapters.en: Naarah bore him Ahuzzam, Hepher, Temeni and Haahashtari. These were the descendants of Naarah.
chapters.zh: 拿拉给亚施户生亚户撒，希弗，提米尼，哈辖斯他利。这都是拿拉的儿子。

chapters.en: The sons of Helah: Zereth, Zohar, Ethnan,
chapters.zh: 希拉的儿子是洗列，琐辖，伊提南。

chapters.en: and Koz, who was the father of Anub and Hazzobebah and of the clans of Aharhel son of Harum.
chapters.zh: 哥斯生亚诺，琐比巴，并哈仑儿子亚哈黑的诸族。

chapters.en: Jabez was more honorable than his brothers. His mother had named him Jabez, saying, “I gave birth to him in pain.”
chapters.zh: 雅比斯比他众弟兄更尊贵，他母亲给他起名叫雅比斯，意思说，我生他甚是痛苦。

chapters.en: Jabez cried out to the God of Israel, “Oh, that you would bless me and enlarge my territory! Let your hand be with me, and keep me from harm so that I will be free from pain.” And God granted his request.
chapters.zh: 雅比斯求告以色列的神说，甚愿你赐福与我，扩张我的境界，常与我同在，保佑我不遭患难，不受艰苦。神就应允他所求的。

chapters.en: Kelub, Shuhah’s brother, was the father of Mehir, who was the father of Eshton.
chapters.zh: 书哈的弟兄基绿生米黑，米黑是伊施屯之祖。

chapters.en: Eshton was the father of Beth Rapha, Paseah and Tehinnah the father of Ir Nahash. These were the men of Rekah.
chapters.zh: 伊施屯生伯拉巴，巴西亚，并珥拿辖之祖提欣拿，这都是利迦人。

chapters.en: The sons of Kenaz: Othniel and Seraiah. The sons of Othniel: Hathath and Meonothai.
chapters.zh: 基纳斯的儿子是俄陀聂，西莱雅。俄陀聂的儿子是哈塔。

chapters.en: Meonothai was the father of Ophrah. Seraiah was the father of Joab, the father of Ge Harashim. It was called this because its people were skilled workers.
chapters.zh: 悯挪太生俄弗拉。西莱雅生革夏纳欣人之祖约押。他们都是匠人。

chapters.en: The sons of Caleb son of Jephunneh: Iru, Elah and Naam. The son of Elah: Kenaz.
chapters.zh: 耶孚尼的儿子是迦勒。迦勒的儿子是以路，以拉，拿安。以拉的儿子是基纳斯。

chapters.en: The sons of Jehallelel: Ziph, Ziphah, Tiria and Asarel.
chapters.zh: 耶哈利勒的儿子是西弗，西法，提利，亚撒列。

chapters.en: The sons of Ezrah: Jether, Mered, Epher and Jalon. One of Mered’s wives gave birth to Miriam, Shammai and Ishbah the father of Eshtemoa.
chapters.zh: 以斯拉的儿子是益帖，米列，以弗，雅伦。米列娶法老女儿比提雅为妻，生米利暗，沙买，和以实提摩之祖益巴。米列又娶犹大女子为妻，生基多之祖雅列，梭哥之祖希伯，和撒挪亚之祖耶古铁。

chapters.en: (His wife from the tribe of Judah gave birth to Jered the father of Gedor, Heber the father of Soko, and Jekuthiel the father of Zanoah.) These were the children of Pharaoh’s daughter Bithiah, whom Mered had married.
The sons of Hodiah’s wife, the sister of Naham: the father of Keilah the Garmite, and Eshtemoa the Maakathite.
chapters.zh: 荷第雅的妻是拿含的妹子，她所生的儿子是迦米人基伊拉和玛迦人以实提摩之祖。

chapters.en: The sons of Shimon: Amnon, Rinnah, Ben-Hanan and Tilon. The descendants of Ishi: Zoheth and Ben-Zoheth.
chapters.zh: 示门的儿子是暗嫩，林拿，便哈南，提伦。以示的儿子是梭黑与便梭黑。

chapters.en: The sons of Shelah son of Judah: Er the father of Lekah, Laadah the father of Mareshah and the clans of the linen workers at Beth Ashbea,
chapters.zh: 犹大的儿子是示拉。示拉的儿子是利迦之祖珥，玛利沙之祖拉大，和属亚实比族织细麻布的各家。

chapters.en: Jokim, the men of Kozeba, and Joash and Saraph, who ruled in Moab and Jashubi Lehem. (These records are from ancient times.)
chapters.zh: 还有约敬，哥西巴人，约阿施，萨拉，就是在摩押地掌权的，又有雅叔比利恒。这都是古时所记载的。

chapters.en: They were the potters who lived at Netaim and Gederah; they stayed there and worked for the king.
chapters.zh: 这些人都是窑匠，是尼他应和基低拉的居民。与王同处，为王作工。

chapters.en: The descendants of Simeon: Nemuel, Jamin, Jarib, Zerah and Shaul;
chapters.zh: 西缅的儿子是尼母利，雅悯，雅立，谢拉，扫罗。

chapters.en: Shallum was Shaul’s son, Mibsam his son and Mishma his son.
chapters.zh: 扫罗的儿子是沙龙。沙龙的儿子是米比衫。米比衫的儿子是米施玛。

chapters.en: The descendants of Mishma: Hammuel his son, Zakkur his son and Shimei his son.
chapters.zh: 米施玛的儿子是哈母利。哈母利的儿子是撒刻。撒刻的儿子是示每。

chapters.en: Shimei had sixteen sons and six daughters, but his brothers did not have many children; so their entire clan did not become as numerous as the people of Judah.
chapters.zh: 示每有十六个儿子，六个女儿，他弟兄的儿女不多，他们各家不如犹大族的人丁增多。

chapters.en: They lived in Beersheba, Moladah, Hazar Shual,
chapters.zh: 西缅人住在别是巴，摩拉大，哈萨书亚，

chapters.en: Bilhah, Ezem, Tolad,
chapters.zh: 辟拉，以森，陀腊，

chapters.en: Bethuel, Hormah, Ziklag,
chapters.zh: 彼土利，何珥玛，洗革拉，

chapters.en: Beth Markaboth, Hazar Susim, Beth Biri and Shaaraim. These were their towns until the reign of David.
chapters.zh: 伯玛嘉博，哈萨苏撒，伯比利，沙拉音，这些城邑直到大卫作王的时候都是属西缅人的。

chapters.en: Their surrounding villages were Etam, Ain, Rimmon, Token and Ashan—five towns—
chapters.zh: 他们的五个城邑是以坦，亚因，临门，陀健，亚珊。

chapters.en: and all the villages around these towns as far as Baalath. These were their settlements. And they kept a genealogical record.
chapters.zh: 还有属城的乡村，直到巴力。这是他们的住处，他们都有家谱。

chapters.en: Meshobab, Jamlech, Joshah son of Amaziah,
chapters.zh: 还有米所巴，雅米勒，亚玛谢的儿子约沙，

chapters.en: Joel, Jehu son of Joshibiah, the son of Seraiah, the son of Asiel,
chapters.zh: 约珥，约示比的儿子耶户。约示比是西莱雅的儿子。西莱雅是亚薛的儿子。

chapters.en: also Elioenai, Jaakobah, Jeshohaiah, Asaiah, Adiel, Jesimiel, Benaiah,
chapters.zh: 还有以利约乃，雅哥巴，约朔海，亚帅雅，亚底业，耶西篾，比拿雅，

chapters.en: and Ziza son of Shiphi, the son of Allon, the son of Jedaiah, the son of Shimri, the son of Shemaiah.
chapters.zh: 示非的儿子细撒。示非是亚龙的儿子。亚龙是耶大雅的儿子。耶大雅是申利的儿子。申利是示玛雅的儿子。

chapters.en: The men listed above by name were leaders of their clans. Their families increased greatly,
chapters.zh: 以上所记的人名都是作族长的，他们宗族的人数增多。

chapters.en: and they went to the outskirts of Gedor to the east of the valley in search of pasture for their flocks.
chapters.zh: 他们往平原东边基多口去，寻找牧放羊群的草场，

chapters.en: They found rich, good pasture, and the land was spacious, peaceful and quiet. Some Hamites had lived there formerly.
chapters.zh: 寻得肥美的草场地，又宽阔又平静。从前住那里的是含族的人。

chapters.en: The men whose names were listed came in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah. They attacked the Hamites in their dwellings and also the Meunites who were there and completely destroyed them, as is evident to this day. Then they settled in their place, because there was pasture for their flocks.
chapters.zh: 以上录名的人，在犹大王希西家年间，来攻击含族人的帐棚和那里所有的米乌尼人，将他们灭尽，就住在他们的地方，直到今日，因为那里有草场可以牧放羊群。

chapters.en: And five hundred of these Simeonites, led by Pelatiah, Neariah, Rephaiah and Uzziel, the sons of Ishi, invaded the hill country of Seir.
chapters.zh: 这西缅人中，有五百人上西珥山，率领他们的是以示的儿子毗拉提，尼利雅，利法雅，和乌薛，

chapters.en: They killed the remaining Amalekites who had escaped, and they have lived there to this day.
chapters.zh: 杀了逃脱剩下的亚玛力人，就住在那里直到今日。

chapters.en: The sons of Reuben the firstborn of Israel (he was the firstborn, but when he defiled his father’s marriage bed, his rights as firstborn were given to the sons of Joseph son of Israel; so he could not be listed in the genealogical record in accordance with his birthright,
chapters.zh: 以色列的长子原是流便。因他污秽了父亲的床，他长子的名分就归了约瑟。只是按家谱他不算长子。

chapters.en: and though Judah was the strongest of his brothers and a ruler came from him, the rights of the firstborn belonged to Joseph)—
chapters.zh: 犹大胜过一切弟兄，君王也是从他而出。长子的名分却归约瑟。

chapters.en: the sons of Reuben the firstborn of Israel: Hanok, Pallu, Hezron and Karmi.
chapters.zh: 以色列长子流便的儿子是哈诺，法路，希斯伦，迦米。

chapters.en: The descendants of Joel: Shemaiah his son, Gog his son, Shimei his son,
chapters.zh: 约珥的儿子是示玛雅。示玛雅的儿子是歌革。歌革的儿子是示每。

chapters.en: Micah his son, Reaiah his son, Baal his son,
chapters.zh: 示每的儿子是米迦。米迦的儿子是利亚雅。利亚雅的儿子是巴力。

chapters.en: and Beerah his son, whom Tiglath-Pileser king of Assyria took into exile. Beerah was a leader of the Reubenites.
chapters.zh: 巴力的儿子是备拉。这备拉作流便支派的首领，被亚述王提革拉毗尼色掳去。

chapters.en: Their relatives by clans, listed according to their genealogical records: Jeiel the chief, Zechariah,
chapters.zh: 他的弟兄照着宗族，按着家谱作族长的是耶利，撒迦利雅，比拉。

chapters.en: and Bela son of Azaz, the son of Shema, the son of Joel. They settled in the area from Aroer to Nebo and Baal Meon.
chapters.zh: 比拉是亚撒的儿子。亚撒是示玛的儿子。示玛是约珥的儿子。约珥所住的地方是从亚罗珥直到尼波和巴力免，

chapters.en: To the east they occupied the land up to the edge of the desert that extends to the Euphrates River, because their livestock had increased in Gilead.
chapters.zh: 又向东延到伯拉河这边的旷野，因为他们在基列地牲畜增多。

chapters.en: During Saul’s reign they waged war against the Hagrites, who were defeated at their hands; they occupied the dwellings of the Hagrites throughout the entire region east of Gilead.
chapters.zh: 扫罗年间，他们与夏甲人争战，夏甲人倒在他们手下，他们就在基列东边的全地，住在夏甲人的帐棚里。

chapters.en: The Gadites lived next to them in Bashan, as far as Salekah:
chapters.zh: 迦得的子孙在流便对面，住在巴珊地，延到撒迦。

chapters.en: Joel was the chief, Shapham the second, then Janai and Shaphat, in Bashan.
chapters.zh: 他们中间有作族长的约珥，有作副族长的沙番，还有雅乃和住在巴珊的沙法。

chapters.en: Their relatives, by families, were: Michael, Meshullam, Sheba, Jorai, Jakan, Zia and Eber—seven in all.
chapters.zh: 他们族弟兄是米迦勒，米书兰，示巴，约赖，雅干，细亚，希伯，共七人。

chapters.en: These were the sons of Abihail son of Huri, the son of Jaroah, the son of Gilead, the son of Michael, the son of Jeshishai, the son of Jahdo, the son of Buz.
chapters.zh: 这都是亚比孩的儿子。亚比孩是户利的儿子。户利是耶罗亚的儿子。耶罗亚是基列的儿子。基列是米迦勒的儿子。米迦勒是耶示筛的儿子。耶示筛是耶哈多的儿子。耶哈多是布斯的儿子。

chapters.en: Ahi son of Abdiel, the son of Guni, was head of their family.
chapters.zh: 还有古尼的孙子，押比叠的儿子亚希。这都是作族长的。

chapters.en: The Gadites lived in Gilead, in Bashan and its outlying villages, and on all the pasturelands of Sharon as far as they extended.
chapters.zh: 他们住在基列与巴珊和巴珊的乡村，并沙仑的郊野，直到四围的交界。

chapters.en: All these were entered in the genealogical records during the reigns of Jotham king of Judah and Jeroboam king of Israel.
chapters.zh: 这些人在犹大王约坦并在以色列王耶罗波安年间，都载入家谱。

chapters.en: The Reubenites, the Gadites and the half-tribe of Manasseh had 44,760 men ready for military service—able-bodied men who could handle shield and sword, who could use a bow, and who were trained for battle.
chapters.zh: 流便人，迦得人，和玛拿西半支派的人，能拿盾牌和刀剑，拉弓射箭，出征善战的勇士共有四万四千七百六十名。

chapters.en: They waged war against the Hagrites, Jetur, Naphish and Nodab.
chapters.zh: 他们与夏甲人，伊突人，拿非施人，挪答人争战。

chapters.en: They were helped in fighting them, and God delivered the Hagrites and all their allies into their hands, because they cried out to him during the battle. He answered their prayers, because they trusted in him.
chapters.zh: 他们得了神的帮助，夏甲人和跟随夏甲的人都交在他们手中。因为他们在阵上呼求神，倚赖神，神就应允他们。

chapters.en: They seized the livestock of the Hagrites—fifty thousand camels, two hundred fifty thousand sheep and two thousand donkeys. They also took one hundred thousand people captive,
chapters.zh: 他们掳掠了夏甲人的牲畜，有骆驼五万，羊二十五万，驴二千。又有人十万。

chapters.en: and many others fell slain, because the battle was God’s. And they occupied the land until the exile.
chapters.zh: 敌人被杀仆倒的甚多，因为这争战是出乎神。他们就住在敌人的地上，直到被掳的时候。

chapters.en: The people of the half-tribe of Manasseh were numerous; they settled in the land from Bashan to Baal Hermon, that is, to Senir (Mount Hermon).
chapters.zh: 玛拿西半支派的人住在那地。从巴珊延到巴力黑们，示尼珥与黑门山。

chapters.en: These were the heads of their families: Epher, Ishi, Eliel, Azriel, Jeremiah, Hodaviah and Jahdiel. They were brave warriors, famous men, and heads of their families.
chapters.zh: 他们的族长是以弗，以示，以列，亚斯列，耶利米，何达威雅，雅叠，都是大能的勇士，是有名的人，也是作族长的。

chapters.en: But they were unfaithful to the God of their ancestors and prostituted themselves to the gods of the peoples of the land, whom God had destroyed before them.
chapters.zh: 他们得罪了他们列祖的神，随从那地之民的神行邪淫。这民就是神在他们面前所除灭的。

chapters.en: So the God of Israel stirred up the spirit of Pul king of Assyria (that is, Tiglath-Pileser king of Assyria), who took the Reubenites, the Gadites and the half-tribe of Manasseh into exile. He took them to Halah, Habor, Hara and the river of Gozan, where they are to this day.
chapters.zh: 故此，以色列的神激动亚述王普勒和亚述王提革拉毗尼色的心，他们就把流便人，迦得人，玛拿西半支派的人掳到哈腊，哈博，哈拉与歌散河边，直到今日还在那里。

chapters.en: The sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath and Merari.
chapters.zh: 利未的儿子是革顺，哥辖，米拉利。

chapters.en: The sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, Hebron and Uzziel.
chapters.zh: 歌辖的儿子是暗兰，以斯哈，希伯伦，乌薛。

chapters.en: The children of Amram: Aaron, Moses and Miriam. The sons of Aaron: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.
chapters.zh: 暗兰的儿子是亚伦，摩西，还有女儿米利暗。亚伦的儿子是拿答，亚比户，以利亚撒，以他玛。

chapters.en: Eleazar was the father of Phinehas, Phinehas the father of Abishua,
chapters.zh: 以利亚撒生非尼哈。非尼哈生亚比书。

chapters.en: Abishua the father of Bukki, Bukki the father of Uzzi,
chapters.zh: 亚比书生布基。布基生乌西。

chapters.en: Uzzi the father of Zerahiah, Zerahiah the father of Meraioth,
chapters.zh: 乌西生西拉希雅。西拉希雅生米拉约。

chapters.en: Meraioth the father of Amariah, Amariah the father of Ahitub,
chapters.zh: 米拉约生亚玛利雅。亚玛利雅生亚希突。

chapters.en: Ahitub the father of Zadok, Zadok the father of Ahimaaz,
chapters.zh: 亚希突生撒督。撒督生亚希玛斯。

chapters.en: Ahimaaz the father of Azariah, Azariah the father of Johanan,
chapters.zh: 亚希玛斯生亚撒利雅。亚撒利雅生约哈难。

chapters.en: Johanan the father of Azariah (it was he who served as priest in the temple Solomon built in Jerusalem),
chapters.zh: 约哈难生亚撒利雅（这亚撒利雅在所罗门于耶路撒冷所建造的殿中，供祭司的职分）。

chapters.en: Azariah the father of Amariah, Amariah the father of Ahitub,
chapters.zh: 亚撒利雅生亚玛利雅。亚玛利雅生亚希突。

chapters.en: Ahitub the father of Zadok, Zadok the father of Shallum,
chapters.zh: 亚希突生撒督。撒督生沙龙。

chapters.en: Shallum the father of Hilkiah, Hilkiah the father of Azariah,
chapters.zh: 沙龙生希勒家。希勒家生亚撒利雅。

chapters.en: Azariah the father of Seraiah, and Seraiah the father of Jozadak.
chapters.zh: 亚撒利雅生西莱雅。西莱雅生约萨答。

chapters.en: Jozadak was deported when the LORD sent Judah and Jerusalem into exile by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar.
chapters.zh: 当耶和华借尼布甲尼撒的手掳掠犹大和耶路撒冷人的时候，这约萨答也被掳去。

chapters.en: The sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath and Merari.
chapters.zh: 利未的儿子是革顺，哥辖，米拉利。

chapters.en: These are the names of the sons of Gershon: Libni and Shimei.
chapters.zh: 革顺的儿子名叫立尼，示每。

chapters.en: The sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, Hebron and Uzziel.
chapters.zh: 哥辖的儿子是暗兰，以斯哈，希伯伦，乌薛。

chapters.en: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. These are the clans of the Levites listed according to their fathers:
chapters.zh: 米拉利的儿子是抹利，母示。这是按着利未人宗族分的各家。

chapters.en: Of Gershon: Libni his son, Jahath his son, Zimmah his son,
chapters.zh: 革顺的儿子是立尼。立尼的儿子是雅哈。雅哈的儿子是薪玛。

chapters.en: Joah his son, Iddo his son, Zerah his son and Jeatherai his son.
chapters.zh: 薪玛的儿子是约亚。约亚的儿子是易多。易多的儿子是谢拉。谢拉的儿子是耶特赖。

chapters.en: The descendants of Kohath: Amminadab his son, Korah his son, Assir his son,
chapters.zh: 哥辖的儿子是亚米拿达。亚米拿达的儿子是可拉。可拉的儿子是亚惜。

chapters.en: Elkanah his son, Ebiasaph his son, Assir his son,
chapters.zh: 亚惜的儿子是以利加拿。以利加拿的儿子是以比雅撒。以比雅撒的儿子是亚惜。

chapters.en: Tahath his son, Uriel his son, Uzziah his son and Shaul his son.
chapters.zh: 亚惜的儿子是他哈。他哈的儿子是乌列。乌列的儿子是乌西雅。乌西雅的儿子是少罗。

chapters.en: The descendants of Elkanah: Amasai, Ahimoth,
chapters.zh: 以利加拿的儿子是亚玛赛和亚希摩。

chapters.en: Elkanah his son, Zophai his son, Nahath his son,
chapters.zh: 亚希摩的儿子是以利加拿。以利加拿的儿子是琐菲。琐菲的儿子是拿哈。

chapters.en: Eliab his son, Jeroham his son, Elkanah his son and Samuel his son.
chapters.zh: 拿哈的儿子是以利押。以利押的儿子是耶罗罕。耶罗罕的儿子是以利加拿。以利加拿的儿子是撒母耳。

chapters.en: The sons of Samuel: Joel the firstborn and Abijah the second son.
chapters.zh: 撒母耳的长子是约珥，次子是亚比亚。

chapters.en: The descendants of Merari: Mahli, Libni his son, Shimei his son, Uzzah his son,
chapters.zh: 米拉利的儿子是抹利。抹利的儿子是立尼。立尼的儿子是示每。示每的儿子是乌撒。

chapters.en: Shimea his son, Haggiah his son and Asaiah his son.
chapters.zh: 乌撒的儿子是示米亚。示米亚的儿子是哈基雅。哈基雅的儿子是亚帅雅。

chapters.en: These are the men David put in charge of the music in the house of the LORD after the ark came to rest there.
chapters.zh: 约柜安设之后，大卫派人在耶和华殿中管理歌唱的事。

chapters.en: They ministered with music before the tabernacle, the tent of meeting, until Solomon built the temple of the LORD in Jerusalem. They performed their duties according to the regulations laid down for them.
chapters.zh: 他们就在会幕前当歌唱的差，及至所罗门在耶路撒冷建造了耶和华的殿，他们便按着班次供职。

chapters.en: Here are the men who served, together with their sons: From the Kohathites: Heman, the musician, the son of Joel, the son of Samuel,
chapters.zh: 供职的人和他们的子孙记在下面，哥辖的子孙中有歌唱的希幔。希幔是约珥的儿子。约珥是撒母耳的儿子。

chapters.en: the son of Elkanah, the son of Jeroham, the son of Eliel, the son of Toah,
chapters.zh: 撒母耳是以利加拿的儿子。以利加拿是耶罗罕的儿子。耶罗罕是以列的儿子。以列是陀亚的儿子。

chapters.en: the son of Zuph, the son of Elkanah, the son of Mahath, the son of Amasai,
chapters.zh: 陀亚是苏弗的儿子。苏弗是以利加拿的儿子。以利加拿是玛哈的儿子。玛哈是亚玛赛的儿子。

chapters.en: the son of Elkanah, the son of Joel, the son of Azariah, the son of Zephaniah,
chapters.zh: 亚玛赛是以利加拿的儿子。以利加拿是约珥的儿子。约珥是亚撒利雅的儿子。亚撒利雅是西番雅的儿子。

chapters.en: the son of Tahath, the son of Assir, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah,
chapters.zh: 西番雅是他哈的儿子。他哈是亚惜的儿子。亚惜是以比雅撒的儿子。以比雅撒是可拉的儿子。

chapters.en: the son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, the son of Israel;
chapters.zh: 可拉是以斯哈的儿子。以斯哈是哥辖的儿子。哥辖是利未的儿子。利未是以色列的儿子。

chapters.en: and Heman’s associate Asaph, who served at his right hand: Asaph son of Berekiah, the son of Shimea,
chapters.zh: 希幔的族兄亚萨是比利家的儿子，亚萨在希幔右边供职。比利家是示米亚的儿子。

chapters.en: the son of Michael, the son of Baaseiah,the son of Malkijah,
chapters.zh: 示米亚是米迦勒的儿子。米迦勒是巴西雅的儿子。巴西雅是玛基雅的儿子。

chapters.en: the son of Ethni, the son of Zerah, the son of Adaiah,
chapters.zh: 玛基雅是伊特尼的儿子。伊特尼是谢拉的儿子。谢拉是亚大雅的儿子。

chapters.en: the son of Ethan, the son of Zimmah, the son of Shimei,
chapters.zh: 亚大雅是以探的儿子。以探是薪玛的儿子。薪玛是示每的儿子。

chapters.en: the son of Jahath, the son of Gershon, the son of Levi;
chapters.zh: 示每是雅哈的儿子。雅哈是革顺的儿子。革顺是利未的儿子。

chapters.en: and from their associates, the Merarites, at his left hand: Ethan son of Kishi, the son of Abdi, the son of Malluk,
chapters.zh: 他们的族弟兄米拉利的子孙，在他们左边供职的有以探。以探是基示的儿子。基示是亚伯底的儿子。亚伯底是玛鹿的儿子。

chapters.en: the son of Hashabiah, the son of Amaziah, the son of Hilkiah,
chapters.zh: 玛鹿是哈沙比雅的儿子。哈沙比雅是亚玛谢的儿子。亚玛谢是希勒家的儿子。

chapters.en: the son of Amzi, the son of Bani, the son of Shemer,
chapters.zh: 希勒家是暗西的儿子。暗西是巴尼的儿子。巴尼是沙麦的儿子。

chapters.en: the son of Mahli, the son of Mushi, the son of Merari, the son of Levi.
chapters.zh: 沙麦是末力的儿子。末力是母示的儿子。母示是米拉利的儿子。米拉利是利未的儿子。

chapters.en: Their fellow Levites were assigned to all the other duties of the tabernacle, the house of God.
chapters.zh: 他们的族弟兄利未人也被派办神殿中的一切事。

chapters.en: But Aaron and his descendants were the ones who presented offerings on the altar of burnt offering and on the altar of incense in connection with all that was done in the Most Holy Place, making atonement for Israel, in accordance with all that Moses the servant of God had commanded.
chapters.zh: 亚伦和他的子孙在燔祭坛和香坛上献祭烧香，又在至圣所办理一切的事，为以色列人赎罪，是照神仆人摩西所吩咐的。

chapters.en: These were the descendants of Aaron: Eleazar his son, Phinehas his son, Abishua his son,
chapters.zh: 亚伦的儿子是以利亚撒。以利亚撒的儿子是非尼哈。非尼哈的儿子是亚比书。

chapters.en: Bukki his son, Uzzi his son, Zerahiah his son,
chapters.zh: 亚比书的儿子是布基。布基的儿子是乌西。乌西的儿子是西拉希雅。

chapters.en: Meraioth his son, Amariah his son, Ahitub his son,
chapters.zh: 西拉希雅的儿子是米拉约。米拉约的儿子是亚玛利雅。亚玛利雅的儿子是亚希突。

chapters.en: Zadok his son and Ahimaaz his son.
chapters.zh: 亚希突的儿子是撒督。撒督的儿子是亚希玛斯。

chapters.en: These were the locations of their settlements allotted as their territory (they were assigned to the descendants of Aaron who were from the Kohathite clan, because the first lot was for them):
chapters.zh: 他们的住处按着境内的营寨，记在下面。哥辖族亚伦的子孙先拈阄得地，

chapters.en: They were given Hebron in Judah with its surrounding pasturelands.
chapters.zh: 在犹大地中得了希伯仑和四围的郊野。

chapters.en: But the fields and villages around the city were given to Caleb son of Jephunneh.
chapters.zh: 只是属城的田地和村庄都为耶孚尼的儿子迦勒所得。

chapters.en: So the descendants of Aaron were given Hebron (a city of refuge), and Libnah, Jattir, Eshtemoa,
chapters.zh: 亚伦的子孙得了逃城希伯仑，又得了立拿与其郊野，雅提珥，以实提莫与其郊野。

chapters.en: Hilen, Debir,
chapters.zh: 希仑与其郊野，底璧与其郊野，

chapters.en: Ashan, Juttah and Beth Shemesh, together with their pasturelands.
chapters.zh: 亚珊与其郊野，伯示麦与其郊野。

chapters.en: And from the tribe of Benjamin they were given Gibeon, Geba, Alemeth and Anathoth, together with their pasturelands. The total number of towns distributed among the Kohathite clans came to thirteen.
chapters.zh: 在便雅悯支派的地中，得了迦巴与其郊野，阿勒篾与其郊野，亚拿突与其郊野。他们诸家所得的城共十三座。

chapters.en: The rest of Kohath’s descendants were allotted ten towns from the clans of half the tribe of Manasseh.
chapters.zh: 哥辖族其余的人又拈阄，在玛拿西半支派的地中得了十座城。

chapters.en: The descendants of Gershon, clan by clan, were allotted thirteen towns from the tribes of Issachar, Asher and Naphtali, and from the part of the tribe of Manasseh that is in Bashan.
chapters.zh: 革顺族按着宗族，在以萨迦支派的地中，亚设支派的地中，拿弗他利支派的地中，巴珊内玛拿西支派的地中，得了十三座城。

chapters.en: The descendants of Merari, clan by clan, were allotted twelve towns from the tribes of Reuben, Gad and Zebulun.
chapters.zh: 米拉利族按着宗族拈阄，在流便支派的地中，迦得支派的地中，西布伦支派的地中，得了十二座城。

chapters.en: So the Israelites gave the Levites these towns and their pasturelands.
chapters.zh: 以色列人将这些城与其郊野给了利未人。

chapters.en: From the tribes of Judah, Simeon and Benjamin they allotted the previously named towns.
chapters.zh: 这以上录名的城，在犹大，西缅，便雅悯三支派的地中，以色列人拈阄给了他们。

chapters.en: Some of the Kohathite clans were given as their territory towns from the tribe of Ephraim.
chapters.zh: 哥辖族中有几家在以法莲支派的地中也得了城邑，

chapters.en: In the hill country of Ephraim they were given Shechem (a city of refuge), and Gezer,
chapters.zh: 在以法莲山地得了逃城示剑与其郊野，又得了基色与其郊野，

chapters.en: Jokmeam, Beth Horon,
chapters.zh: 约缅与其郊野，伯和仑与其郊野，

chapters.en: Aijalon and Gath Rimmon, together with their pasturelands.
chapters.zh: 亚雅仑与其郊野，迦特临门与其郊野。

chapters.en: And from half the tribe of Manasseh the Israelites gave Aner and Bileam, together with their pasturelands, to the rest of the Kohathite clans.
chapters.zh: 哥辖族其余的人在玛拿西半支派的地中得了亚乃与其郊野，比连与其郊野。

chapters.en: The Gershonites received the following: From the clan of the half-tribe of Manasseh they received Golan in Bashan and also Ashtaroth, together with their pasturelands;
chapters.zh: 革顺族在玛拿西半支派的地中得了巴珊的哥兰与其郊野，亚斯他录与其郊野。

chapters.en: from the tribe of Issachar they received Kedesh, Daberath,
chapters.zh: 又在以萨迦支派的地中得了基低斯与其郊野，大比拉与其郊野，

chapters.en: Ramoth and Anem, together with their pasturelands;
chapters.zh: 拉末与其郊野，亚年与其郊野。

chapters.en: from the tribe of Asher they received Mashal, Abdon,
chapters.zh: 在亚设支派的地中得了玛沙与其郊野，押顿与其郊野，

chapters.en: Hukok and Rehob, together with their pasturelands;
chapters.zh: 户割与其郊野，利合与其郊野。

chapters.en: and from the tribe of Naphtali they received Kedesh in Galilee, Hammon and Kiriathaim, together with their pasturelands.
chapters.zh: 在拿弗他利支派的地中得了加利利的基低斯与其郊野，哈们与其郊野，基列亭与其郊野。

chapters.en: The Merarites (the rest of the Levites) received the following: From the tribe of Zebulun they received Jokneam, Kartah, Rimmono and Tabor, together with their pasturelands;
chapters.zh: 还有米拉利族的人在西布伦支派的地中得了临摩挪与其郊野，他泊与其郊野。

chapters.en: from the tribe of Reuben across the Jordan east of Jericho they received Bezer in the wilderness, Jahzah,
chapters.zh: 又在耶利哥的约旦河东，在流便支派的地中得了旷野的比悉与其郊野，雅哈撒与其郊野，

chapters.en: Kedemoth and Mephaath, together with their pasturelands;
chapters.zh: 基底莫与其郊野，米法押与其郊野。

chapters.en: and from the tribe of Gad they received Ramoth in Gilead, Mahanaim,
chapters.zh: 又在迦得支派的地中得了基列的拉末与其郊野，玛哈念与其郊野，

chapters.en: Heshbon and Jazer, together with their pasturelands.
chapters.zh: 希实本与其郊野，雅谢与其郊野。

chapters.en: The sons of Issachar: Tola, Puah, Jashub and Shimron—four in all.
chapters.zh: 以萨迦的儿子是陀拉，普瓦，雅述（雅述创世记第四十六章十三节作约伯），伸仑，共四人。

chapters.en: The sons of Tola: Uzzi, Rephaiah, Jeriel, Jahmai, Ibsam and Samuel—heads of their families. During the reign of David, the descendants of Tola listed as fighting men in their genealogy numbered 22,600.
chapters.zh: 陀拉的儿子是乌西，利法雅，耶勒，雅买，易伯散，示母利，都是陀拉的族长，是大能的勇士。到大卫年间，他们的人数共有二万二千六百名。

chapters.en: The son of Uzzi: Izrahiah. The sons of Izrahiah: Michael, Obadiah, Joel and Ishiah. All five of them were chiefs.
chapters.zh: 乌西的儿子是伊斯拉希。伊斯拉希的儿子是米迦勒，俄巴底亚，约珥，伊示雅，共五人，都是族长。

chapters.en: According to their family genealogy, they had 36,000 men ready for battle, for they had many wives and children.
chapters.zh: 他们所率领的，按着宗族出战的军队，共有三万六千人，因为他们的妻和子众多。

chapters.en: The relatives who were fighting men belonging to all the clans of Issachar, as listed in their genealogy, were 87,000 in all.
chapters.zh: 他们的族弟兄在以萨迦各族中都是大能的勇士，按着家谱计算共有八万七千人。

chapters.en: Three sons of Benjamin: Bela, Beker and Jediael.
chapters.zh: 便雅悯的儿子是比拉，比结，耶叠，共三人。

chapters.en: The sons of Bela: Ezbon, Uzzi, Uzziel, Jerimoth and Iri, heads of families—five in all. Their genealogical record listed 22,034 fighting men.
chapters.zh: 比拉的儿子是以斯本，乌西，乌薛，耶利摩，以利，共五人，都是族长，是大能的勇士。按着家谱计算，他们的子孙共有二万二千零三十四人。

chapters.en: The sons of Beker: Zemirah, Joash, Eliezer, Elioenai, Omri, Jeremoth, Abijah, Anathoth and Alemeth. All these were the sons of Beker.
chapters.zh: 比结的儿子是细米拉，约阿施，以利以谢，以利约乃，暗利，耶利摩，亚比雅，亚拿突，亚拉篾。这都是比结的儿子。

chapters.en: Their genealogical record listed the heads of families and 20,200 fighting men.
chapters.zh: 他们都是族长，是大能的勇士。按着家谱计算，他们的子孙共有二万零二百人。

chapters.en: The son of Jediael: Bilhan. The sons of Bilhan: Jeush, Benjamin, Ehud, Kenaanah, Zethan, Tarshish and Ahishahar.
chapters.zh: 耶叠的儿子是比勒罕。比勒罕的儿子是耶乌施，便雅悯，以忽，基拿拿，细坦，他施，亚希沙哈。

chapters.en: All these sons of Jediael were heads of families. There were 17,200 fighting men ready to go out to war.
chapters.zh: 这都是耶叠的儿子，都是族长，是大能的勇士。他们的子孙能上阵打仗的，共有一万七千二百人。

chapters.en: The Shuppites and Huppites were the descendants of Ir, and the Hushites the descendants of Aher.
chapters.zh: 还有以珥的儿子书品，户品，并亚黑的儿子户伸。

chapters.en: The sons of Naphtali: Jahziel, Guni, Jezer and Shillem —the descendants of Bilhah.
chapters.zh: 拿弗他利的儿子是雅薛，沽尼，耶色，沙龙。这都是辟拉的子孙。

chapters.en: The descendants of Manasseh: Asriel was his descendant through his Aramean concubine. She gave birth to Makir the father of Gilead.
chapters.zh: 玛拿西的儿子亚斯列是他妾亚兰人所生的，又生了基列之父玛吉。

chapters.en: Makir took a wife from among the Huppites and Shuppites. His sister’s name was Maakah. Another descendant was named Zelophehad, who had only daughters.
chapters.zh: 玛吉娶的妻是户品，书品的妹子，名叫玛迦。玛拿西的次子名叫西罗非哈。西罗非哈但有几个女儿。

chapters.en: Makir’s wife Maakah gave birth to a son and named him Peresh. His brother was named Sheresh, and his sons were Ulam and Rakem.
chapters.zh: 玛吉的妻玛迦生了一个儿子，起名叫毗利施。毗利施的兄弟名叫示利施。示利施的儿子是乌兰和利金。

chapters.en: The son of Ulam: Bedan. These were the sons of Gilead son of Makir, the son of Manasseh.
chapters.zh: 乌兰的儿子是比但。这都是基列的子孙。基列是玛吉的儿子，玛吉是玛拿西的儿子。

chapters.en: His sister Hammoleketh gave birth to Ishhod, Abiezer and Mahlah.
chapters.zh: 基列的妹子哈摩利吉生了伊施荷，亚比以谢，玛拉。

chapters.en: The sons of Shemida were: Ahian, Shechem, Likhi and Aniam.
chapters.zh: 示米大的儿子是亚现，示剑，利克希，阿尼安。

chapters.en: The descendants of Ephraim: Shuthelah, Bered his son, Tahath his son, Eleadah his son, Tahath his son,
chapters.zh: 以法莲的儿子是书提拉。书提拉的儿子是比列。比列的儿子是他哈。他哈的儿子是以拉大。以拉大的儿子是他哈。

chapters.en: Zabad his son and Shuthelah his son. Ezer and Elead were killed by the native-born men of Gath, when they went down to seize their livestock.
chapters.zh: 他哈的儿子是撒拔。撒拔的儿子是书提拉。以法莲又生以谢，以列。这二人因为下去夺取迦特人的牲畜，被本地的迦特人杀了。

chapters.en: Their father Ephraim mourned for them many days, and his relatives came to comfort him.
chapters.zh: 他们的父亲以法莲为他们悲哀了多日，他的弟兄都来安慰他。

chapters.en: Then he made love to his wife again, and she became pregnant and gave birth to a son. He named him Beriah, because there had been misfortune in his family.
chapters.zh: 以法莲与妻同房，他妻就怀孕生了一子，以法莲因为家里遭祸，就给这儿子起名叫比利亚。

chapters.en: His daughter was Sheerah, who built Lower and Upper Beth Horon as well as Uzzen Sheerah.
chapters.zh: 他的女儿名叫舍伊拉，就是建筑上伯和仑，下伯和仑与乌羡舍伊拉的。

chapters.en: Rephah was his son, Resheph his son,Telah his son, Tahan his son,
chapters.zh: 比利阿的儿子是利法和利悉。利悉的儿子是他拉。他拉的儿子是他罕。

chapters.en: Ladan his son, Ammihud his son, Elishama his son,
chapters.zh: 他罕的儿子是拉但。拉但的儿子是亚米忽。亚米忽的儿子是以利沙玛。

chapters.en: Nun his son and Joshua his son.
chapters.zh: 以利沙玛的儿子是嫩。嫩的儿子是约书亚。

chapters.en: Their lands and settlements included Bethel and its surrounding villages, Naaran to the east, Gezer and its villages to the west, and Shechem and its villages all the way to Ayyah and its villages.
chapters.zh: 以法莲人的地业和住处是伯特利与其村庄。东边拿兰，西边基色与其村庄。示剑与其村庄，直到迦萨与其村庄。

chapters.en: Along the borders of Manasseh were Beth Shan, Taanach, Megiddo and Dor, together with their villages. The descendants of Joseph son of Israel lived in these towns.
chapters.zh: 还有靠近玛拿西人的境界，伯善与其村庄。他纳与其村庄。米吉多与其村庄。多珥与其村庄。以色列儿子约瑟的子孙住在这些地方。

chapters.en: The sons of Asher: Imnah, Ishvah, Ishvi and Beriah. Their sister was Serah.
chapters.zh: 亚设的儿子是音拿，亦施瓦，亦施韦，比利亚，还有他们的妹子西拉。

chapters.en: The sons of Beriah: Heber and Malkiel, who was the father of Birzaith.
chapters.zh: 比利亚的儿子是希别，玛结。玛结是比撒威的父亲。

chapters.en: Heber was the father of Japhlet, Shomer and Hotham and of their sister Shua.
chapters.zh: 希别生雅弗勒，朔默，何坦，和他们的妹子书雅。

chapters.en: The sons of Japhlet: Pasak, Bimhal and Ashvath. These were Japhlet’s sons.
chapters.zh: 雅弗勒的儿子是巴萨，宾哈，亚施法。这都是雅弗勒的儿子。

chapters.en: The sons of Shomer: Ahi, Rohgah, Hubbah and Aram.
chapters.zh: 朔默的儿子是亚希，罗迦，耶户巴，亚兰。

chapters.en: The sons of his brother Helem: Zophah, Imna, Shelesh and Amal.
chapters.zh: 朔默兄弟希连的儿子是琐法，音那，示利斯，亚抹。

chapters.en: The sons of Zophah: Suah, Harnepher, Shual, Beri, Imrah,
chapters.zh: 琐法的儿子是书亚，哈尼弗，书阿勒，比利，音拉，

chapters.en: Bezer, Hod, Shamma, Shilshah, Ithran and Beera.
chapters.zh: 比悉，河得，珊玛，施沙，益兰，比拉。

chapters.en: The sons of Jether: Jephunneh, Pispah and Ara.
chapters.zh: 益帖的儿子是耶孚尼，毗斯巴，亚拉。

chapters.en: The sons of Ulla: Arah, Hanniel and Rizia.
chapters.zh: 乌拉的儿子是亚拉，汉尼业，利写。

chapters.en: All these were descendants of Asher—heads of families, choice men, brave warriors and outstanding leaders. The number of men ready for battle, as listed in their genealogy, was 26,000.
chapters.zh: 这都是亚设的子孙，都是族长，是精壮大能的勇士，也是首领中的头目，按着家谱计算，他们的子孙能出战的共有二万六千人。

chapters.en: Benjamin was the father of Bela his firstborn, Ashbel the second son, Aharah the third,
chapters.zh: 便雅悯的长子比拉，次子亚实别，三子亚哈拉，

chapters.en: Nohah the fourth and Rapha the fifth.
chapters.zh: 四子挪哈，五子拉法。

chapters.en: The sons of Bela were: Addar, Gera, Abihud,
chapters.zh: 比拉的儿子是亚大，基拉，亚比忽，

chapters.en: Abishua, Naaman, Ahoah,
chapters.zh: 亚比书，乃幔，亚何亚，

chapters.en: Gera, Shephuphan and Huram.
chapters.zh: 基拉，示孚汛，户兰。

chapters.en: These were the descendants of Ehud, who were heads of families of those living in Geba and were deported to Manahath:
chapters.zh: 以忽的儿子作迦巴居民的族长，被掳到玛拿辖。

chapters.en: Naaman, Ahijah, and Gera, who deported them and who was the father of Uzza and Ahihud.
chapters.zh: 以忽的儿子乃幔，亚希亚，基拉也被掳去。基拉生乌撒，亚希忽。

chapters.en: Sons were born to Shaharaim in Moab after he had divorced his wives Hushim and Baara.
chapters.zh: 沙哈连休他二妻户伸和巴拉之后，在摩押地生了儿子。

chapters.en: By his wife Hodesh he had Jobab, Zibia, Mesha, Malkam,
chapters.zh: 他与妻贺得同房，生了约巴，洗比雅，米沙，玛拉干，

chapters.en: Jeuz, Sakia and Mirmah. These were his sons, heads of families.
chapters.zh: 耶乌斯，沙迦，米玛。他这些儿子都是族长。

chapters.en: By Hushim he had Abitub and Elpaal.
chapters.zh: 他的妻户伸给他生的儿子有亚比突，以利巴力。

chapters.en: The sons of Elpaal: Eber, Misham, Shemed (who built Ono and Lod with its surrounding villages),
chapters.zh: 以利巴力的儿子是希伯，米珊，沙麦。沙麦建立阿挪和罗德二城与其村庄。

chapters.en: and Beriah and Shema, who were heads of families of those living in Aijalon and who drove out the inhabitants of Gath.
chapters.zh: 又有比利亚和示玛是亚雅仑居民的族长，是驱逐迦特人的。

chapters.en: Ahio, Shashak, Jeremoth,
chapters.zh: 亚希约，沙煞，耶利末，

chapters.en: Zebadiah, Arad, Eder,
chapters.zh: 西巴第雅，亚拉得，亚得，

chapters.en: Michael, Ishpah and Joha were the sons of Beriah.
chapters.zh: 米迦勒，伊施巴，约哈都是比利亚的儿子。

chapters.en: Zebadiah, Meshullam, Hizki, Heber,
chapters.zh: 西巴第雅，米书兰，希西基，希伯，

chapters.en: Ishmerai, Izliah and Jobab were the sons of Elpaal.
chapters.zh: 伊施米莱，伊斯利亚，约巴都是以利巴力的儿子。

chapters.en: Jakim, Zikri, Zabdi,
chapters.zh: 雅金，细基利，撒底，

chapters.en: Elienai, Zillethai, Eliel,
chapters.zh: 以利乃，洗勒太，以列，

chapters.en: Adaiah, Beraiah and Shimrath were the sons of Shimei.
chapters.zh: 亚大雅，比拉雅，申拉都是示每的儿子。

chapters.en: Ishpan, Eber, Eliel,
chapters.zh: 伊施班，希伯，以列，

chapters.en: Abdon, Zikri, Hanan,
chapters.zh: 亚伯顿，细基利，哈难，

chapters.en: Hananiah, Elam, Anthothijah,
chapters.zh: 哈拿尼雅，以拦，安陀提雅，

chapters.en: Iphdeiah and Penuel were the sons of Shashak.
chapters.zh: 伊弗底雅，毗努伊勒都是沙煞的儿子。

chapters.en: Shamsherai, Shehariah, Athaliah,
chapters.zh: 珊示莱，示哈利，亚他利雅，

chapters.en: Jaareshiah, Elijah and Zikri were the sons of Jeroham.
chapters.zh: 雅利西，以利亚，细基利都是耶罗罕的儿子。

chapters.en: All these were heads of families, chiefs as listed in their genealogy, and they lived in Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 这些人都是着名的族长，住在耶路撒冷。

chapters.en: Jeiel the father of Gibeon lived in Gibeon. His wife’s name was Maakah,
chapters.zh: 在基遍住的有基遍的父亲耶利。他的妻名叫玛迦。

chapters.en: and his firstborn son was Abdon, followed by Zur, Kish, Baal, Ner, Nadab,
chapters.zh: 他长子是亚伯顿。他又生苏珥，基士，巴力，拿答，

chapters.en: Gedor, Ahio, Zeker
chapters.zh: 基多，亚希约，撒迦，米基罗。

chapters.en: and Mikloth, who was the father of Shimeah. They too lived near their relatives in Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 米基罗生示米暗。这些人和他们的弟兄在耶路撒冷对面居住。

chapters.en: Ner was the father of Kish, Kish the father of Saul, and Saul the father of Jonathan, Malki-Shua, Abinadab and Esh-Baal.
chapters.zh: 尼珥生基士。基士生扫罗。扫罗生约拿单，麦基舒亚，亚比拿达，伊施巴力。

chapters.en: The son of Jonathan: Merib-Baal, who was the father of Micah.
chapters.zh: 约拿单的儿子是米力巴力（米力巴力撒母耳下四章四节作米非波设）。米力巴力生米迦。

chapters.en: The sons of Micah: Pithon, Melek, Tarea and Ahaz.
chapters.zh: 米迦的儿子是毗敦，米勒，他利亚，亚哈斯。

chapters.en: Ahaz was the father of Jehoaddah, Jehoaddah was the father of Alemeth, Azmaveth and Zimri, and Zimri was the father of Moza.
chapters.zh: 亚哈斯生耶何阿达。耶何阿达生亚拉篾，亚斯玛威，心利。心利生摩撒。

chapters.en: Moza was the father of Binea; Raphah was his son, Eleasah his son and Azel his son.
chapters.zh: 摩撒生比尼亚。比尼亚的儿子是拉法。拉法的儿子是以利亚萨。以利亚萨的儿子是亚悉。

chapters.en: Azel had six sons, and these were their names: Azrikam, Bokeru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah and Hanan. All these were the sons of Azel.
chapters.zh: 亚悉有六个儿子，他们的名字是亚斯利干，波基路，以实玛利，示亚利雅，俄巴底雅，哈难。这都是亚悉的儿子。

chapters.en: The sons of his brother Eshek: Ulam his firstborn, Jeush the second son and Eliphelet the third.
chapters.zh: 亚悉兄弟以设的长子是乌兰，次子耶乌施，三子是以利法列。

chapters.en: The sons of Ulam were brave warriors who could handle the bow. They had many sons and grandsons—150 in all. All these were the descendants of Benjamin.
chapters.zh: 乌兰的儿子都是大能的勇士，是弓箭手，他们有许多的子孙，共一百五十名，都是便雅悯人。

chapters.en: All Israel was listed in the genealogies recorded in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah. They were taken captive to Babylon because of their unfaithfulness.
chapters.zh: 以色列人都按家谱计算，写在以色列诸王记上。犹大人因犯罪就被掳到巴比伦。

chapters.en: Now the first to resettle on their own property in their own towns were some Israelites, priests, Levites and temple servants.
chapters.zh: 先从巴比伦回来，住在自己地业城邑中的有以色列人，祭司，利未人，尼提宁的首领。

chapters.en: Those from Judah, from Benjamin, and from Ephraim and Manasseh who lived in Jerusalem were:
chapters.zh: 住在耶路撒冷的有犹大人，便雅悯人，以法莲人，玛拿西人。

chapters.en: Uthai son of Ammihud, the son of Omri, the son of Imri, the son of Bani, a descendant of Perez son of Judah.
chapters.zh: 犹大儿子法勒斯的子孙中有乌太。乌太是亚米忽的儿子。亚米忽是暗利的儿子。暗利是音利的儿子。音利是巴尼的儿子。

chapters.en: Of the Shelanites : Asaiah the firstborn and his sons.
chapters.zh: 示罗的子孙中有长子亚帅雅和他的众子。

chapters.en: Of the Zerahites: Jeuel. The people from Judah numbered 690.
chapters.zh: 谢拉的子孙中有耶乌利和他的弟兄，共六百九十人。

chapters.en: Of the Benjamites: Sallu son of Meshullam, the son of Hodaviah, the son of Hassenuah;
chapters.zh: 便雅悯人中有哈西努的曾孙，何达威雅的孙子，米书兰的儿子撒路，

chapters.en: Ibneiah son of Jeroham; Elah son of Uzzi, the son of Mikri; and Meshullam son of Shephatiah, the son of Reuel, the son of Ibnijah.
chapters.zh: 又有耶罗罕的儿子伊比尼雅，米基立的孙子，乌西的儿子以拉，伊比尼雅的曾孙，流珥的孙子，示法提雅的儿子米书兰，

chapters.en: The people from Benjamin, as listed in their genealogy, numbered 956. All these men were heads of their families.
chapters.zh: 和他们的族弟兄，按着家谱计算共有九百五十六名。这些人都是他们的族长。

chapters.en: Of the priests: Jedaiah; Jehoiarib; Jakin;
chapters.zh: 祭司中有耶大雅，耶何雅立，雅斤，

chapters.en: Azariah son of Hilkiah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Zadok, the son of Meraioth, the son of Ahitub, the official in charge of the house of God;
chapters.zh: 还有管理神殿希勒家的儿子亚萨利雅。希勒家是米书兰的儿子。米书兰是撒督的儿子。撒督是米拉约的儿子。米拉约是亚希突的儿子。

chapters.en: Adaiah son of Jeroham, the son of Pashhur, the son of Malkijah; and Maasai son of Adiel, the son of Jahzerah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Meshillemith, the son of Immer.
chapters.zh: 有玛基雅的曾孙，巴施户珥的孙子，耶罗罕的儿子亚大雅，又有亚第业的儿子玛赛。亚第业是雅希细拉的儿子。雅希细拉是米书兰的儿子。米书兰是米实利密的儿子。米实利密是音麦的儿子。

chapters.en: The priests, who were heads of families, numbered 1,760. They were able men, responsible for ministering in the house of God.
chapters.zh: 他们和众弟兄都是族长，共有一千七百六十人，是善于作神殿使用之工的。

chapters.en: Of the Levites: Shemaiah son of Hasshub, the son of Azrikam, the son of Hashabiah, a Merarite;
chapters.zh: 利未人米拉利的子孙中，有哈沙比雅的曾孙，押利甘的孙子，哈述的儿子示玛雅。

chapters.en: Bakbakkar, Heresh, Galal and Mattaniah son of Mika, the son of Zikri, the son of Asaph;
chapters.zh: 有拔巴甲，黑勒施，迦拉，并亚萨的曾孙，细基利的孙子，米迦的儿子玛探雅，

chapters.en: Obadiah son of Shemaiah, the son of Galal, the son of Jeduthun; and Berekiah son of Asa, the son of Elkanah, who lived in the villages of the Netophathites.
chapters.zh: 又有耶杜顿的曾孙，迦拉的孙子，示玛雅的儿子俄巴底，还有以利加拿的孙子，亚撒的儿子比利家。他们都住在尼陀法人的村庄。

chapters.en: The gatekeepers: Shallum, Akkub, Talmon, Ahiman and their fellow Levites, Shallum their chief
chapters.zh: 守门的是沙龙，亚谷，达们，亚希幔，和他们的弟兄。沙龙为长。

chapters.en: being stationed at the King’s Gate on the east, up to the present time. These were the gatekeepers belonging to the camp of the Levites.
chapters.zh: 从前这些人看守朝东的王门，如今是利未营中守门的。

chapters.en: Shallum son of Kore, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah, and his fellow gatekeepers from his family (the Korahites) were responsible for guarding the thresholds of the tent just as their ancestors had been responsible for guarding the entrance to the dwelling of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 可拉的曾孙，以比雅撒的孙子，可利的儿子沙龙，和他的族弟兄可拉人都管理使用之工，并守会幕的门。他们的祖宗曾管理耶和华的营盘，又把守营门。

chapters.en: In earlier times Phinehas son of Eleazar was the official in charge of the gatekeepers, and the LORD was with him.
chapters.zh: 从前以利亚撒的儿子非尼哈管理他们，耶和华也与他同在。

chapters.en: Zechariah son of Meshelemiah was the gatekeeper at the entrance to the tent of meeting.
chapters.zh: 米施利米雅的儿子撒迦利雅是看守会幕之门的。

chapters.en: Altogether, those chosen to be gatekeepers at the thresholds numbered 212. They were registered by genealogy in their villages. The gatekeepers had been assigned to their positions of trust by David and Samuel the seer.
chapters.zh: 被选守门的人共有二百一十二名。他们在自己的村庄，按着家谱计算，是大卫和先见撒母耳所派当这紧要职任的。

chapters.en: They and their descendants were in charge of guarding the gates of the house of the LORD—the house called the tent of meeting.
chapters.zh: 他们和他们的子孙按着班次看守耶和华殿的门，就是会幕的门。

chapters.en: The gatekeepers were on the four sides: east, west, north and south.
chapters.zh: 在东西南北，四方都有守门的。

chapters.en: Their fellow Levites in their villages had to come from time to time and share their duties for seven-day periods.
chapters.zh: 他们的族弟兄住在村庄，每七日来与他们换班。

chapters.en: But the four principal gatekeepers, who were Levites, were entrusted with the responsibility for the rooms and treasuries in the house of God.
chapters.zh: 这四个门领都是利未人，各有紧要的职任，看守神殿的仓库。

chapters.en: They would spend the night stationed around the house of God, because they had to guard it; and they had charge of the key for opening it each morning.
chapters.zh: 他们住在神殿的四围，是因委托他们守殿，要每日早晨开门。

chapters.en: Some of them were in charge of the articles used in the temple service; they counted them when they were brought in and when they were taken out.
chapters.zh: 利未人中有管理使用器皿的，按着数目拿出拿入。

chapters.en: Others were assigned to take care of the furnishings and all the other articles of the sanctuary, as well as the special flour and wine, and the olive oil, incense and spices.
chapters.zh: 又有人管理器具和圣所的器皿，并细面，酒，油，乳香，香料。

chapters.en: But some of the priests took care of mixing the spices.
chapters.zh: 祭司中有人用香料作膏油。

chapters.en: A Levite named Mattithiah, the firstborn son of Shallum the Korahite, was entrusted with the responsibility for baking the offering bread.
chapters.zh: 利未人玛他提雅是可拉族沙龙的长子，他紧要的职任是管理盘中烤的物。

chapters.en: Some of the Kohathites, their fellow Levites, were in charge of preparing for every Sabbath the bread set out on the table.
chapters.zh: 他们族弟兄哥辖子孙中，有管理陈设饼的，每安息日预备摆列。

chapters.en: Those who were musicians, heads of Levite families, stayed in the rooms of the temple and were exempt from other duties because they were responsible for the work day and night.
chapters.zh: 歌唱的有利未人的族长，住在属殿的房屋，昼夜供职，不作别样的工。

chapters.en: All these were heads of Levite families, chiefs as listed in their genealogy, and they lived in Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 以上都是利未人着名的族长，住在耶路撒冷。

chapters.en: Jeiel the father of Gibeon lived in Gibeon. His wife’s name was Maakah,
chapters.zh: 在基遍住的有基遍的父亲耶利。他的妻名叫玛迦。

chapters.en: and his firstborn son was Abdon, followed by Zur, Kish, Baal, Ner, Nadab,
chapters.zh: 他长子是亚伯顿。他又生苏珥，基士，巴力，尼珥，拿答，

chapters.en: Gedor, Ahio, Zechariah and Mikloth.
chapters.zh: 基多，亚希约，撒迦利雅，米基罗。

chapters.en: Mikloth was the father of Shimeam. They too lived near their relatives in Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 米基罗生示米暗。这些人和他们的弟兄在耶路撒冷对面居住。

chapters.en: Ner was the father of Kish, Kish the father of Saul, and Saul the father of Jonathan, Malki-Shua, Abinadab and Esh-Baal.
chapters.zh: 尼珥生基士。基士生扫罗。扫罗生约拿单，麦基舒亚，亚比拿达，伊施巴力。

chapters.en: The son of Jonathan: Merib-Baal, who was the father of Micah.
chapters.zh: 约拿单的儿子是米力巴力（米力巴力即米非波设）。米力巴力生米迦。

chapters.en: The sons of Micah: Pithon, Melek, Tahrea and Ahaz.
chapters.zh: 米迦的儿子是毗敦，米勒，他利亚，亚哈斯。

chapters.en: Ahaz was the father of Jadah, Jadah was the father of Alemeth, Azmaveth and Zimri, and Zimri was the father of Moza.
chapters.zh: 亚哈斯生雅拉。雅拉生亚拉篾，亚斯玛威，心利。心利生摩撒。

chapters.en: Moza was the father of Binea; Rephaiah was his son, Eleasah his son and Azel his son.
chapters.zh: 摩撒生比尼亚。比尼亚生利法雅。利法雅的儿子是以利亚萨。以利亚萨的儿子是亚悉。

chapters.en: Azel had six sons, and these were their names: Azrikam, Bokeru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah and Hanan. These were the sons of Azel.
chapters.zh: 亚悉有六个儿子，他们的名字是亚斯利干，波基路，以实玛利，示亚利雅，俄巴底雅，哈难。这都是亚悉的儿子。

chapters.en: Now the Philistines fought against Israel; the Israelites fled before them, and many fell dead on Mount Gilboa.
chapters.zh: 非利士人与以色列人争战，以色列人在非利士人面前逃跑，在基利波山有被杀仆倒的。

chapters.en: The Philistines were in hot pursuit of Saul and his sons, and they killed his sons Jonathan, Abinadab and Malki-Shua.
chapters.zh: 非利士人紧追扫罗和他儿子们，就杀了扫罗的儿子约拿单，亚比拿达，麦基舒亚。

chapters.en: The fighting grew fierce around Saul, and when the archers overtook him, they wounded him.
chapters.zh: 势派甚大，扫罗被弓箭手追上，射伤甚重，

chapters.en: Saul said to his armor-bearer, “Draw your sword and run me through, or these uncircumcised fellows will come and abuse me.” But his armor-bearer was terrified and would not do it; so Saul took his own sword and fell on it.
chapters.zh: 就吩咐拿他兵器的人说，你拔出刀来，将我刺死，免得那些未受割礼的人来凌辱我。但拿兵器的人甚惧怕，不肯刺他。

chapters.en: When the armor-bearer saw that Saul was dead, he too fell on his sword and died.
chapters.zh: 扫罗就自己伏在刀上死了。拿兵器的人见扫罗已死，也伏在刀上死了。

chapters.en: So Saul and his three sons died, and all his house died together.
chapters.zh: 这样，扫罗和他三个儿子，并他的全家都一同死亡。

chapters.en: When all the Israelites in the valley saw that the army had fled and that Saul and his sons had died, they abandoned their towns and fled. And the Philistines came and occupied them.
chapters.zh: 住平原的以色列众人见以色列军兵逃跑，扫罗和他儿子都死了，也就弃城逃跑，非利士人便来住在其中。

chapters.en: The next day, when the Philistines came to strip the dead, they found Saul and his sons fallen on Mount Gilboa.
chapters.zh: 次日，非利士人来剥那被杀之人的衣服，看见扫罗和他儿子仆倒在基利波山，

chapters.en: They stripped him and took his head and his armor, and sent messengers throughout the land of the Philistines to proclaim the news among their idols and their people.
chapters.zh: 就剥了他的军装，割下他的首级，打发人到非利士地的四境（到或作送到）报信与他们的偶像和众民，

chapters.en: They put his armor in the temple of their gods and hung up his head in the temple of Dagon.
chapters.zh: 又将扫罗的军装放在他们神的庙里，将他的首级钉在大衮庙中。

chapters.en: When all the inhabitants of Jabesh Gilead heard what the Philistines had done to Saul,
chapters.zh: 基列雅比人听见非利士人向扫罗所行的一切事，

chapters.en: all their valiant men went and took the bodies of Saul and his sons and brought them to Jabesh. Then they buried their bones under the great tree in Jabesh, and they fasted seven days.
chapters.zh: 他们中间所有的勇士就起身前去，将扫罗和他儿子的尸身送到雅比，将他们的尸骨葬在雅比的橡树下，就禁食七日。

chapters.en: Saul died because he was unfaithful to the LORD; he did not keep the word of the LORD and even consulted a medium for guidance,
chapters.zh: 这样，扫罗死了。因为他干犯耶和华，没有遵守耶和华的命。又因他求问交鬼的妇人，

chapters.en: and did not inquire of the LORD. So the LORD put him to death and turned the kingdom over to David son of Jesse.
chapters.zh: 没有求问耶和华，所以耶和华使他被杀，把国归于耶西的儿子大卫。

chapters.en: All Israel came together to David at Hebron and said, “We are your own flesh and blood.
chapters.zh: 以色列众人聚集到希伯仑见大卫，说，我们原是你的骨肉。

chapters.en: In the past, even while Saul was king, you were the one who led Israel on their military campaigns. And the LORD your God said to you, ‘You will shepherd my people Israel, and you will become their ruler.’ ”
chapters.zh: 从前扫罗作王的时候，率领以色列人出入的是你。耶和华你的神也曾应许你说，你必牧养我的民以色列，作以色列的君。

chapters.en: When all the elders of Israel had come to King David at Hebron, he made a covenant with them at Hebron before the LORD, and they anointed David king over Israel, as the LORD had promised through Samuel.
chapters.zh: 于是以色列的长老都来到希伯仑见大卫王。大卫在希伯仑耶和华面前与他们立约，他们就膏大卫作以色列的王，是照耶和华借撒母耳所说的话。

chapters.en: David and all the Israelites marched to Jerusalem (that is, Jebus). The Jebusites who lived there
chapters.zh: 大卫和以色列众人到了耶路撒冷，就是耶布斯。那时耶布斯人住在那里。

chapters.en: said to David, “You will not get in here.” Nevertheless, David captured the fortress of Zion—which is the City of David.
chapters.zh: 耶布斯人对大卫说，你决不能进这地方。然而大卫攻取锡安的保障，就是大卫的城。

chapters.en: David had said, “Whoever leads the attack on the Jebusites will become commander-in-chief.” Joab son of Zeruiah went up first, and so he received the command.
chapters.zh: 大卫说，谁先攻打耶布斯人，必作首领元帅。洗鲁雅的儿子约押先上去，就作了元帅。

chapters.en: David then took up residence in the fortress, and so it was called the City of David.
chapters.zh: 大卫住在保障里，所以那保障叫作大卫城。

chapters.en: He built up the city around it, from the terraces to the surrounding wall, while Joab restored the rest of the city.
chapters.zh: 大卫又从米罗起，四围建筑城墙，其余的是约押修理。

chapters.en: And David became more and more powerful, because the LORD Almighty was with him.
chapters.zh: 大卫日见强盛，因为万军之耶和华与他同在。

chapters.en: These were the chiefs of David’s mighty warriors—they, together with all Israel, gave his kingship strong support to extend it over the whole land, as the LORD had promised—
chapters.zh: 以下记录跟随大卫勇士的首领，就是奋勇帮助他得国，照着耶和华吩咐以色列人的话，与以色列人一同立他作王的。

chapters.en: this is the list of David’s mighty warriors: Jashobeam, a Hakmonite, was chief of the officers ; he raised his spear against three hundred men, whom he killed in one encounter.
chapters.zh: 大卫勇士的数目记在下面，哈革摩尼的儿子雅朔班，他是军长的统领，一时举枪杀了三百人。

chapters.en: Next to him was Eleazar son of Dodai the Ahohite, one of the three mighty warriors.
chapters.zh: 其次是亚合人朵多的儿子以利亚撒，他是三个勇士里的一个。

chapters.en: He was with David at Pas Dammim when the Philistines gathered there for battle. At a place where there was a field full of barley, the troops fled from the Philistines.
chapters.zh: 他从前与大卫在巴斯达闵，非利士人聚集要打仗。那里有一块长满大麦的田，众民就在非利士人面前逃跑。

chapters.en: But they took their stand in the middle of the field. They defended it and struck the Philistines down, and the LORD brought about a great victory.
chapters.zh: 这勇士便站在那田间击杀非利士人，救护了那田。耶和华使以色列人大获全胜。

chapters.en: Three of the thirty chiefs came down to David to the rock at the cave of Adullam, while a band of Philistines was encamped in the Valley of Rephaim.
chapters.zh: 三十个勇士中的三个人下到磐石那里，进了亚杜兰洞见大卫。非利士的军队在利乏音谷安营。

chapters.en: At that time David was in the stronghold, and the Philistine garrison was at Bethlehem.
chapters.zh: 那时大卫在山寨，非利士人的防营在伯利恒。

chapters.en: David longed for water and said, “Oh, that someone would get me a drink of water from the well near the gate of Bethlehem!”
chapters.zh: 大卫渴想，说，甚愿有人将伯利恒城门旁井里的水打来给我喝。

chapters.en: So the Three broke through the Philistine lines, drew water from the well near the gate of Bethlehem and carried it back to David. But he refused to drink it; instead, he poured it out to the LORD.
chapters.zh: 这三个勇士就闯过非利士人的营盘，从伯利恒城门旁的井里打水，拿来奉给大卫。他却不肯喝，将水奠在耶和华面前，

chapters.en: “God forbid that I should do this!” he said. “Should I drink the blood of these men who went at the risk of their lives?” Because they risked their lives to bring it back, David would not drink it. Such were the exploits of the three mighty warriors.
chapters.zh: 说，我的神阿，这三个人冒死去打水，这水好像他们的血一般，我断不敢喝。如此，大卫不肯喝。这是三个勇士所作的事。

chapters.en: Abishai the brother of Joab was chief of the Three. He raised his spear against three hundred men, whom he killed, and so he became as famous as the Three.
chapters.zh: 约押的兄弟亚比筛是这三个勇士的首领。他举枪杀了三百人，就在三个勇士里得了名。

chapters.en: He was doubly honored above the Three and became their commander, even though he was not included among them.
chapters.zh: 他在这三个勇士里是最尊贵的，所以作他们的首领。只是不及前三个勇士。

chapters.en: Benaiah son of Jehoiada, a valiant fighter from Kabzeel, performed great exploits. He struck down Moab’s two mightiest warriors. He also went down into a pit on a snowy day and killed a lion.
chapters.zh: 有甲薛勇士耶何耶大的儿子比拿雅行过大能的事，他杀了摩押人亚利伊勒的两个儿子，又在下雪的时候下坑里去杀了一个狮子，

chapters.en: And he struck down an Egyptian who was five cubits tall. Although the Egyptian had a spear like a weaver’s rod in his hand, Benaiah went against him with a club. He snatched the spear from the Egyptian’s hand and killed him with his own spear.
chapters.zh: 又杀了一个埃及人。埃及人身高五肘，手里拿着枪，枪杆粗如织布的机轴。比拿雅只拿着棍子下去，从埃及人手里夺过枪来，用那枪将他刺死。

chapters.en: Such were the exploits of Benaiah son of Jehoiada; he too was as famous as the three mighty warriors.
chapters.zh: 这是耶何耶大的儿子比拿雅所行的事，就在三个勇士里得了名。

chapters.en: He was held in greater honor than any of the Thirty, but he was not included among the Three. And David put him in charge of his bodyguard.
chapters.zh: 他比那三十个勇士都尊贵，只是不及前三个勇士。大卫立他作护卫长。

chapters.en: The mighty warriors were: Asahel the brother of Joab, Elhanan son of Dodo from Bethlehem,
chapters.zh: 军中的勇士有约押的兄弟亚撒黑，伯利恒人朵多的儿子伊勒哈难，

chapters.en: Shammoth the Harorite, Helez the Pelonite,
chapters.zh: 哈律人沙玛，比伦人希利斯，

chapters.en: Ira son of Ikkesh from Tekoa, Abiezer from Anathoth,
chapters.zh: 提哥亚人益吉的儿子以拉，亚拿突人亚比以谢，

chapters.en: Sibbekai the Hushathite, Ilai the Ahohite,
chapters.zh: 户沙人西比该，亚合人以来，

chapters.en: Maharai the Netophathite, Heled son of Baanah the Netophathite,
chapters.zh: 尼陀法人玛哈莱，尼陀法人巴拿的儿子希立，

chapters.en: Ithai son of Ribai from Gibeah in Benjamin, Benaiah the Pirathonite,
chapters.zh: 便雅悯族基比亚人利拜的儿子以太，比拉顿人比拿雅，

chapters.en: Hurai from the ravines of Gaash, Abiel the Arbathite,
chapters.zh: 迦实溪人户莱，亚拉巴人亚比，

chapters.en: Azmaveth the Baharumite, Eliahba the Shaalbonite,
chapters.zh: 巴路米人押斯玛弗，沙本人以利雅哈巴，

chapters.en: the sons of Hashem the Gizonite, Jonathan son of Shagee the Hararite,
chapters.zh: 基孙人哈深的众子，哈拉人沙基的儿子约拿单，

chapters.en: Ahiam son of Sakar the Hararite, Eliphal son of Ur,
chapters.zh: 哈拉人沙甲的儿子亚希暗，吾珥的儿子以利法勒，

chapters.en: Hepher the Mekerathite, Ahijah the Pelonite,
chapters.zh: 米基拉人希弗，比伦人亚希雅，

chapters.en: Hezro the Carmelite, Naarai son of Ezbai,
chapters.zh: 迦密人希斯罗，伊斯拜的儿子拿莱，

chapters.en: Joel the brother of Nathan, Mibhar son of Hagri,
chapters.zh: 拿单的兄弟约珥，哈基利的儿子弥伯哈，

chapters.en: Zelek the Ammonite, Naharai the Berothite, the armor-bearer of Joab son of Zeruiah,
chapters.zh: 亚扪人洗勒，比录人拿哈莱，拿哈莱是给洗鲁雅的儿子约押拿兵器的。

chapters.en: Ira the Ithrite, Gareb the Ithrite,
chapters.zh: 以帖人以拉，以帖人迦立，

chapters.en: Uriah the Hittite, Zabad son of Ahlai,
chapters.zh: 赫人乌利亚，亚莱的儿子撒拔，

chapters.en: Adina son of Shiza the Reubenite, who was chief of the Reubenites, and the thirty with him,
chapters.zh: 流便人示撒的儿子亚第拿，他是流便支派中的一个族长，率领三十人。

chapters.en: Hanan son of Maakah, Joshaphat the Mithnite,
chapters.zh: 玛迦的儿子哈难，弥特尼人约沙法，

chapters.en: Uzzia the Ashterathite, Shama and Jeiel the sons of Hotham the Aroerite,
chapters.zh: 亚施他拉人乌西亚，亚罗珥人何坦的儿子沙玛，耶利，

chapters.en: Jediael son of Shimri, his brother Joha the Tizite,
chapters.zh: 提洗人申利的儿子耶叠和他的兄弟约哈，

chapters.en: Eliel the Mahavite, Jeribai and Joshaviah the sons of Elnaam, Ithmah the Moabite,
chapters.zh: 玛哈未人以利业，伊利拿安的儿子耶利拜，约沙未雅，摩押人伊特玛，

chapters.en: Eliel, Obed and Jaasiel the Mezobaite.
chapters.zh: 以利业，俄备得，并米琐八人雅西业。

chapters.en: These were the men who came to David at Ziklag, while he was banished from the presence of Saul son of Kish (they were among the warriors who helped him in battle;
chapters.zh: 大卫因怕基士的儿子扫罗，躲在洗革拉的时候，有勇士到他那里帮助他打仗。

chapters.en: they were armed with bows and were able to shoot arrows or to sling stones right-handed or left-handed; they were relatives of Saul from the tribe of Benjamin):
chapters.zh: 他们善于拉弓，能用左右两手甩石射箭，都是便雅悯人扫罗的族弟兄。

chapters.en: Ahiezer their chief and Joash the sons of Shemaah the Gibeathite; Jeziel and Pelet the sons of Azmaveth; Berakah, Jehu the Anathothite,
chapters.zh: 为首的是亚希以谢，其次是约阿施，都是基比亚人示玛的儿子。还有亚斯玛威的儿子耶薛和毗力，又有比拉迦，并亚拿突人耶户，

chapters.en: and Ishmaiah the Gibeonite, a mighty warrior among the Thirty, who was a leader of the Thirty; Jeremiah, Jahaziel, Johanan, Jozabad the Gederathite,
chapters.zh: 基遍人以实买雅，他在三十人中是勇士，管理他们，且有耶利米，雅哈悉，约哈难，和基得拉人约撒拔，

chapters.en: Eluzai, Jerimoth, Bealiah, Shemariah and Shephatiah the Haruphite;
chapters.zh: 伊利乌赛，耶利摩，比亚利雅，示玛利雅，哈律弗人示法提雅，

chapters.en: Elkanah, Ishiah, Azarel, Joezer and Jashobeam the Korahites;
chapters.zh: 可拉人以利加拿，耶西亚，亚萨列，约以谢，雅朔班，

chapters.en: and Joelah and Zebadiah the sons of Jeroham from Gedor.
chapters.zh: 基多人耶罗罕的儿子犹拉和西巴第雅。

chapters.en: Some Gadites defected to David at his stronghold in the wilderness. They were brave warriors, ready for battle and able to handle the shield and spear. Their faces were the faces of lions, and they were as swift as gazelles in the mountains.
chapters.zh: 迦得支派中有人到旷野的山寨投奔大卫，都是大能的勇士，能拿盾牌和枪的战士。他们的面貌好像狮子，快跑如同山上的鹿。

chapters.en: Ezer was the chief, Obadiah the second in command, Eliab the third,
chapters.zh: 第一以薛，第二俄巴底雅，第三以利押，

chapters.en: Mishmannah the fourth, Jeremiah the fifth,
chapters.zh: 第四弥施玛拿，第五耶利米，

chapters.en: Attai the sixth, Eliel the seventh,
chapters.zh: 第六亚太，第七以利业，

chapters.en: Johanan the eighth, Elzabad the ninth,
chapters.zh: 第八约哈难，第九以利萨巴，

chapters.en: Jeremiah the tenth and Makbannai the eleventh.
chapters.zh: 第十耶利米，第十一末巴奈。

chapters.en: These Gadites were army commanders; the least was a match for a hundred, and the greatest for a thousand.
chapters.zh: 这都是迦得人中的军长，至小的能抵一百人，至大的能抵一千人。

chapters.en: It was they who crossed the Jordan in the first month when it was overflowing all its banks, and they put to flight everyone living in the valleys, to the east and to the west.
chapters.zh: 正月，约旦河水涨过两岸的时候，他们过河，使一切住平原的人东奔西逃。

chapters.en: Other Benjamites and some men from Judah also came to David in his stronghold.
chapters.zh: 又有便雅悯和犹大人到山寨大卫那里。

chapters.en: David went out to meet them and said to them, “If you have come to me in peace to help me, I am ready for you to join me. But if you have come to betray me to my enemies when my hands are free from violence, may the God of our ancestors see it and judge you.”
chapters.zh: 大卫出去迎接他们，对他们说，你们若是和和平平地来帮助我，我心就与你们相契。你们若是将我这无罪的人卖在敌人手里，愿我们列祖的神察看责罚。

chapters.en: Then the Spirit came on Amasai, chief of the Thirty, and he said: “We are yours, David! We are with you, son of Jesse! Success, success to you, and success to those who help you, for your God will help you.” So David received them and made them leaders of his raiding bands.
chapters.zh: 那时神的灵感动那三十个勇士的首领亚玛撒，他就说，大卫阿，我们是归于你的。耶西的儿子阿，我们是帮助你的。愿你平平安安，愿帮助你的也都平安。因为你的神帮助你。大卫就收留他们，立他们作军长。

chapters.en: Some of the tribe of Manasseh defected to David when he went with the Philistines to fight against Saul. (He and his men did not help the Philistines because, after consultation, their rulers sent him away. They said, “It will cost us our heads if he deserts to his master Saul.”)
chapters.zh: 大卫从前与非利士人同去，要与扫罗争战，有些玛拿西人来投奔大卫，他们却没有帮助非利士人。因为非利士人的首领商议，打发他们回去，说，恐怕大卫拿我们的首级，归降他的主人扫罗。

chapters.en: When David went to Ziklag, these were the men of Manasseh who defected to him: Adnah, Jozabad, Jediael, Michael, Jozabad, Elihu and Zillethai, leaders of units of a thousand in Manasseh.
chapters.zh: 大卫往洗革拉去的时候，有玛拿西人的千夫长押拿，约撒拔，耶叠，米迦勒，约撒拔，以利户，洗勒太都来投奔他。

chapters.en: They helped David against raiding bands, for all of them were brave warriors, and they were commanders in his army.
chapters.zh: 这些人帮助大卫攻击群贼。他们都是大能的勇士，且作军长。

chapters.en: Day after day men came to help David, until he had a great army, like the army of God.
chapters.zh: 那时天天有人来帮助大卫，以致成了大军，如神的军一样。

chapters.en: These are the numbers of the men armed for battle who came to David at Hebron to turn Saul’s kingdom over to him, as the LORD had said:
chapters.zh: 预备打仗的兵来到希伯仑见大卫，要照着耶和华的话将扫罗的国位归与大卫。他们的数目如下，

chapters.en: from Judah, carrying shield and spear—6,800 armed for battle;
chapters.zh: 犹大支派，拿盾牌和枪预备打仗的有六千八百人。
