chapters.en: three thousand talents of gold (gold of Ophir) and seven thousand talents of refined silver, for the overlaying of the walls of the buildings,
chapters.zh: 就是俄斐金三千他连得，精链的银子七千他连得，以贴殿墙。

chapters.en: for the gold work and the silver work, and for all the work to be done by the craftsmen. Now, who is willing to consecrate themselves to the LORD today?”
chapters.zh: 金子作金器，银子作银器，并借匠人的手制造一切。今日有谁乐意将自己献给耶和华呢？

chapters.en: Then the leaders of families, the officers of the tribes of Israel, the commanders of thousands and commanders of hundreds, and the officials in charge of the king’s work gave willingly.
chapters.zh: 于是，众族长和以色列各支派的首领，千夫长，百夫长，并监管王工的官长，都乐意献上。

chapters.en: They gave toward the work on the temple of God five thousand talents and ten thousand darics of gold, ten thousand talents of silver, eighteen thousand talents of bronze and a hundred thousand talents of iron.
chapters.zh: 他们为神殿的使用献上金子五千他连得零一万达利克，银子一万他连得，铜一万八千他连得，铁十万他连得。

chapters.en: Anyone who had precious stones gave them to the treasury of the temple of the LORD in the custody of Jehiel the Gershonite.
chapters.zh: 凡有宝石的都交给革顺人耶歇，送入耶和华殿的府库。

chapters.en: The people rejoiced at the willing response of their leaders, for they had given freely and wholeheartedly to the LORD. David the king also rejoiced greatly.
chapters.zh: 因这些人诚心乐意献给耶和华，百姓就欢喜，大卫王也大大欢喜。

chapters.en: David praised the LORD in the presence of the whole assembly, saying, “Praise be to you, LORD, the God of our father Israel, from everlasting to everlasting.
chapters.zh: 所以，大卫在会众面前称颂耶和华说，耶和华我们的父，以色列的神是应当称颂，直到永永远远的。

chapters.en: Yours, LORD, is the greatness and the power and the glory and the majesty and the splendor, for everything in heaven and earth is yours. Yours, LORD, is the kingdom; you are exalted as head over all.
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，尊大，能力，荣耀，强胜，威严都是你的。凡天上地下的都是你的。国度也是你的，并且你为至高，为万有之首。

chapters.en: Wealth and honor come from you; you are the ruler of all things. In your hands are strength and power to exalt and give strength to all.
chapters.zh: 丰富尊荣都从你而来，你也治理万物。在你手里有大能大力，使人尊大强盛都出于你。

chapters.en: Now, our God, we give you thanks, and praise your glorious name.
chapters.zh: 我们的神阿，现在我们称谢你，赞美你荣耀之名。

chapters.en: “But who am I, and who are my people, that we should be able to give as generously as this? Everything comes from you, and we have given you only what comes from your hand.
chapters.zh: 我算什么，我的民算什么，竟能如此乐意奉献。因为万物都从你而来，我们把从你而得的献给你。

chapters.en: We are foreigners and strangers in your sight, as were all our ancestors. Our days on earth are like a shadow, without hope.
chapters.zh: 我们在你面前是客旅，是寄居的，与我们列祖一样。我们在世的日子如影儿，不能长存（或作没有长存的指望）。

chapters.en: LORD our God, all this abundance that we have provided for building you a temple for your Holy Name comes from your hand, and all of it belongs to you.
chapters.zh: 耶和华我们的神阿，我们预备这许多材料，要为你的圣名建造殿宇，都是从你而来，都是属你的。

chapters.en: I know, my God, that you test the heart and are pleased with integrity. All these things I have given willingly and with honest intent. And now I have seen with joy how willingly your people who are here have given to you.
chapters.zh: 我的神阿，我知道你察验人心，喜悦正直。我以正直的心乐意献上这一切物。现在我喜欢见你的民在这里都乐意奉献与你。

chapters.en: LORD, the God of our fathers Abraham, Isaac and Israel, keep these desires and thoughts in the hearts of your people forever, and keep their hearts loyal to you.
chapters.zh: 耶和华我们列祖亚伯拉罕，以撒，以色列的神阿，求你使你的民常存这样的心思意念，坚定他们的心归向你，

chapters.en: And give my son Solomon the wholehearted devotion to keep your commands, statutes and decrees and to do everything to build the palatial structure for which I have provided.”
chapters.zh: 又求你赐我儿子所罗门诚实的心，遵守你的命令，法度，律例，成就这一切的事，用我所预备的建造殿宇。

chapters.en: Then David said to the whole assembly, “Praise the LORD your God.” So they all praised the LORD, the God of their fathers; they bowed down, prostrating themselves before the LORD and the king.
chapters.zh: 大卫对全会众说，你们应当称颂耶和华你们的神。于是会众称颂耶和华他们列祖的神，低头拜耶和华与王。

chapters.en: The next day they made sacrifices to the LORD and presented burnt offerings to him: a thousand bulls, a thousand rams and a thousand male lambs, together with their drink offerings, and other sacrifices in abundance for all Israel.
chapters.zh: 次日，他们向耶和华献平安祭和燔祭，就是献公牛一千只，公绵羊一千只，羊羔一千只，并同献的奠祭。又为以色列众人献许多的祭。那日，他们在耶和华面前吃喝，大大欢乐。

chapters.en: They ate and drank with great joy in the presence of the LORD that day. Then they acknowledged Solomon son of David as king a second time, anointing him before the LORD to be ruler and Zadok to be priest.
chapters.zh: 他们奉耶和华的命再膏大卫的儿子所罗门作王，又膏撒督作祭司。

chapters.en: So Solomon sat on the throne of the LORD as king in place of his father David. He prospered and all Israel obeyed him.
chapters.zh: 于是所罗门坐在耶和华所赐的位上，接续他父亲大卫作王，万事亨通。以色列众人也都听从他。

chapters.en: All the officers and warriors, as well as all of King David’s sons, pledged their submission to King Solomon.
chapters.zh: 众首领和勇士，并大卫王的众子，都顺服所罗门王。

chapters.en: The LORD highly exalted Solomon in the sight of all Israel and bestowed on him royal splendor such as no king over Israel ever had before.
chapters.zh: 耶和华使所罗门在以色列众人眼前甚为尊大，极其威严，胜过在他以前的以色列王。

chapters.en: David son of Jesse was king over all Israel.
chapters.zh: 耶西的儿子大卫作以色列众人的王，

chapters.en: He ruled over Israel forty years—seven in Hebron and thirty-three in Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 作王共四十年，在希伯仑作王七年，在耶路撒冷作王三十三年。

chapters.en: He died at a good old age, having enjoyed long life, wealth and honor. His son Solomon succeeded him as king.
chapters.zh: 他年纪老迈，日子满足，享受丰富，尊荣，就死了。他儿子所罗门接续他作王。

chapters.en: As for the events of King David’s reign, from beginning to end, they are written in the records of Samuel the seer, the records of Nathan the prophet and the records of Gad the seer,
chapters.zh: 大卫王始终的事都写在先见撒母耳的书上和先知拿单并先见迦得的书上。

chapters.en: together with the details of his reign and power, and the circumstances that surrounded him and Israel and the kingdoms of all the other lands.
chapters.zh: 他的国事和他的勇力，以及他和以色列并列国所经过的事都写在这书上。

chapters.en: Solomon son of David established himself firmly over his kingdom, for the LORD his God was with him and made him exceedingly great.
chapters.zh: 大卫的儿子所罗门国位坚固。耶和华他的神与他同在，使他甚为尊大。

chapters.en: Then Solomon spoke to all Israel—to the commanders of thousands and commanders of hundreds, to the judges and to all the leaders in Israel, the heads of families—
chapters.zh: 所罗门吩咐以色列众人，就是千夫长，百夫长，审判官，首领与族长都来。

chapters.en: and Solomon and the whole assembly went to the high place at Gibeon, for God’s tent of meeting was there, which Moses the LORD’s servant had made in the wilderness.
chapters.zh: 所罗门和会众都往基遍的丘坛去，因那里有神的会幕，就是耶和华仆人摩西在旷野所制造的。

chapters.en: Now David had brought up the ark of God from Kiriath Jearim to the place he had prepared for it, because he had pitched a tent for it in Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 只是神的约柜，大卫已经从基列耶琳搬到他所预备的地方，因他曾在耶路撒冷为约柜支搭了帐幕，

chapters.en: But the bronze altar that Bezalel son of Uri, the son of Hur, had made was in Gibeon in front of the tabernacle of the LORD; so Solomon and the assembly inquired of him there.
chapters.zh: 并且户珥的孙子，乌利的儿子比撒列所造的铜坛也在基遍耶和华的会幕前。所罗门和会众都就近坛前。

chapters.en: Solomon went up to the bronze altar before the LORD in the tent of meeting and offered a thousand burnt offerings on it.
chapters.zh: 所罗门上到耶和华面前会幕的铜坛那里，献一千牺牲为燔祭。

chapters.en: That night God appeared to Solomon and said to him, “Ask for whatever you want me to give you.”
chapters.zh: 当夜，神向所罗门显现，对他说，你愿我赐你什么，你可以求。

chapters.en: Solomon answered God, “You have shown great kindness to David my father and have made me king in his place.
chapters.zh: 所罗门对神说，你曾向我父大卫大施慈爱，使我接续他作王。

chapters.en: Now, LORD God, let your promise to my father David be confirmed, for you have made me king over a people who are as numerous as the dust of the earth.
chapters.zh: 耶和华神阿，现在求你成就向我父大卫所应许的话。因你立我作这民的王，他们如同地上尘沙那样多。

chapters.en: Give me wisdom and knowledge, that I may lead this people, for who is able to govern this great people of yours?”
chapters.zh: 求你赐我智慧聪明，我好在这民前出入。不然，谁能判断这众多的民呢？

chapters.en: God said to Solomon, “Since this is your heart’s desire and you have not asked for wealth, possessions or honor, nor for the death of your enemies, and since you have not asked for a long life but for wisdom and knowledge to govern my people over whom I have made you king,
chapters.zh: 神对所罗门说，我已立你作我民的王。你既有这心意，并不求资财，丰富，尊荣，也不求灭绝那恨你之人的性命，又不求大寿数，只求智慧聪明好判断我的民。

chapters.en: therefore wisdom and knowledge will be given you. And I will also give you wealth, possessions and honor, such as no king who was before you ever had and none after you will have.”
chapters.zh: 我必赐你智慧聪明，也必赐你资财，丰富，尊荣。在你以前的列王都没有这样，在你以后也必没有这样的。

chapters.en: Then Solomon went to Jerusalem from the high place at Gibeon, from before the tent of meeting. And he reigned over Israel.
chapters.zh: 于是，所罗门从基遍丘坛会幕前回到耶路撒冷，治理以色列人。

chapters.en: Solomon accumulated chariots and horses; he had fourteen hundred chariots and twelve thousand horses, which he kept in the chariot cities and also with him in Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 所罗门聚集战车马兵，有战车一千四百辆，马兵一万二千名，安置在屯车的城邑和耶路撒冷，就是王那里。

chapters.en: The king made silver and gold as common in Jerusalem as stones, and cedar as plentiful as sycamore-fig trees in the foothills.
chapters.zh: 王在耶路撒冷使金银多如石头，香柏木多如高原的桑树。

chapters.en: Solomon’s horses were imported from Egypt and from Kue —the royal merchants purchased them from Kue at the current price.
chapters.zh: 所罗门的马是从埃及带来的，是王的商人一群一群按着定价买来的。

chapters.en: They imported a chariot from Egypt for six hundred shekels of silver, and a horse for a hundred and fifty. They also exported them to all the kings of the Hittites and of the Arameans.
chapters.zh: 他们从埃及买来的车，每辆价银六百舍客勒，马每匹一百五十舍客勒。赫人诸王和亚兰诸王所买的车马，也是按这价值经他们手买来的。

chapters.en: Solomon gave orders to build a temple for the Name of the LORD and a royal palace for himself.
chapters.zh: 所罗门定意要为耶和华的名建造殿宇，又为自己的国建造宫室。

chapters.en: He conscripted 70,000 men as carriers and 80,000 as stonecutters in the hills and 3,600 as foremen over them.
chapters.zh: 所罗门就挑选七万扛抬的，八万在山上凿石头的，三千六百督工的。

chapters.en: Solomon sent this message to Hiram king of Tyre: “Send me cedar logs as you did for my father David when you sent him cedar to build a palace to live in.
chapters.zh: 所罗门差人去见推罗王希兰，说，你曾运香柏木与我父大卫建宫居住，求你也这样待我。

chapters.en: Now I am about to build a temple for the Name of the LORD my God and to dedicate it to him for burning fragrant incense before him, for setting out the consecrated bread regularly, and for making burnt offerings every morning and evening and on the Sabbaths, at the New Moons and at the appointed festivals of the LORD our God. This is a lasting ordinance for Israel.
chapters.zh: 我要为耶和华我神的名建造殿宇，分别为圣献给他，在他面前焚烧美香，常摆陈设饼，每早晚，安息日，月朔，并耶和华我们神所定的节期献燔祭。这是以色列人永远的定例。

chapters.en: “The temple I am going to build will be great, because our God is greater than all other gods.
chapters.zh: 我所要建造的殿宇甚大。因为我们的神至大，超乎诸神。

chapters.en: But who is able to build a temple for him, since the heavens, even the highest heavens, cannot contain him? Who then am I to build a temple for him, except as a place to burn sacrifices before him?
chapters.zh: 天和天上的天，尚且不足他居住的，谁能为他建造殿宇呢？我是谁。能为他建造殿宇吗？不过在他面前烧香而已。

chapters.en: “Send me, therefore, a man skilled to work in gold and silver, bronze and iron, and in purple, crimson and blue yarn, and experienced in the art of engraving, to work in Judah and Jerusalem with my skilled workers, whom my father David provided.
chapters.zh: 现在求你差一个巧匠来，就是善用金，银，铜，铁，和紫色，朱红色，蓝色线，并精于雕刻之工的巧匠，与我父大卫在犹大和耶路撒冷所预备的巧匠一同作工。

chapters.en: “Send me also cedar, juniper and algum logs from Lebanon, for I know that your servants are skilled in cutting timber there. My servants will work with yours
chapters.zh: 又求你从利巴嫩运些香柏木，松木，檀香木到我这里来，因我知道你的仆人善于砍伐利巴嫩的树木。我的仆人也必与你的仆人同工。

chapters.en: to provide me with plenty of lumber, because the temple I build must be large and magnificent.
chapters.zh: 这样，可以给我预备许多的木料，因我要建造的殿宇高大出奇。

chapters.en: I will give your servants, the woodsmen who cut the timber, twenty thousand cors of ground wheat, twenty thousand cors of barley, twenty thousand baths of wine and twenty thousand baths of olive oil.”
chapters.zh: 你的仆人砍伐树木，我必给他们打好了的小麦二万歌珥，大麦二万歌珥，酒二万吧特，油二万吧特。

chapters.en: Hiram king of Tyre replied by letter to Solomon: “Because the LORD loves his people, he has made you their king.”
chapters.zh: 推罗王希兰写信回答所罗门说，耶和华因为爱他的子民，所以立你作他们的王。

chapters.en: And Hiram added: “Praise be to the LORD, the God of Israel, who made heaven and earth! He has given King David a wise son, endowed with intelligence and discernment, who will build a temple for the LORD and a palace for himself.
chapters.zh: 又说，创造天地的耶和华以色列的神是应当称颂的。他赐给大卫王一个有智慧的儿子，使他有谋略聪明，可以为耶和华建造殿宇，又为自己的国建造宫室。

chapters.en: “I am sending you Huram-Abi, a man of great skill,
chapters.zh: 现在我打发一个精巧有聪明的人去，他是我父亲希兰所用的，

chapters.en: whose mother was from Dan and whose father was from Tyre. He is trained to work in gold and silver, bronze and iron, stone and wood, and with purple and blue and crimson yarn and fine linen. He is experienced in all kinds of engraving and can execute any design given to him. He will work with your skilled workers and with those of my lord, David your father.
chapters.zh: 是但支派一个妇人的儿子。他父亲是推罗人，他善用金，银，铜，铁，石，木，和紫色，蓝色，朱红色线与细麻制造各物，并精于雕刻，又能想出各样的巧工。请你派定这人，与你的巧匠和你父，我主大卫的巧匠一同做工。

chapters.en: “Now let my lord send his servants the wheat and barley and the olive oil and wine he promised,
chapters.zh: 我主所说的小麦，大麦，酒，油，愿我主运来给众仆人。

chapters.en: and we will cut all the logs from Lebanon that you need and will float them as rafts by sea down to Joppa. You can then take them up to Jerusalem.”
chapters.zh: 我们必照你所需用的，从利巴嫩砍伐树木，扎成筏子，浮海运到约帕。你可以从那里运到耶路撒冷。

chapters.en: Solomon took a census of all the foreigners residing in Israel, after the census his father David had taken; and they were found to be 153,600.
chapters.zh: 所罗门仿照他父大卫数点住在以色列地所有寄居的外邦人，共有十五万三千六百名。

chapters.en: He assigned 70,000 of them to be carriers and 80,000 to be stonecutters in the hills, with 3,600 foremen over them to keep the people working.
chapters.zh: 使七万人扛抬材料，八万人在山上凿石头，三千六百人督理工作。

chapters.en: Then Solomon began to build the temple of the LORD in Jerusalem on Mount Moriah, where the LORD had appeared to his father David. It was on the threshing floor of Araunah the Jebusite, the place provided by David.
chapters.zh: 所罗门就在耶路撒冷，耶和华向他父大卫显现的摩利亚山上，就是耶布斯人阿珥楠的禾场上，大卫所指定的地方预备好了，开工建造耶和华的殿。

chapters.en: He began building on the second day of the second month in the fourth year of his reign.
chapters.zh: 所罗门作王第四年二月初二日开工建造。

chapters.en: The foundation Solomon laid for building the temple of God was sixty cubits long and twenty cubits wide (using the cubit of the old standard).
chapters.zh: 所罗门建筑神殿的根基，乃是这样，长六十肘，宽二十肘，都按着古时的尺寸。

chapters.en: The portico at the front of the temple was twenty cubits long across the width of the building and twenty cubits high. He overlaid the inside with pure gold.
chapters.zh: 殿前的廊子长二十肘，与殿的宽窄一样，高一百二十肘。里面贴上精金。

chapters.en: He paneled the main hall with juniper and covered it with fine gold and decorated it with palm tree and chain designs.
chapters.zh: 大殿的墙都用松木板遮蔽，又贴了精金，上面雕刻棕树和链子。

chapters.en: He adorned the temple with precious stones. And the gold he used was gold of Parvaim.
chapters.zh: 又用宝石装饰殿墙，使殿华美。所用的金子都是巴瓦音的金子。

chapters.en: He overlaid the ceiling beams, doorframes, walls and doors of the temple with gold, and he carved cherubim on the walls.
chapters.zh: 又用金子贴殿和殿的栋梁，门槛，墙壁，门扇。墙上雕刻基路伯。

chapters.en: He built the Most Holy Place, its length corresponding to the width of the temple—twenty cubits long and twenty cubits wide. He overlaid the inside with six hundred talents of fine gold.
chapters.zh: 又建造至圣所，长二十肘，与殿的宽窄一样，宽也是二十肘。贴上精金，共用金子六百他连得。

chapters.en: The gold nails weighed fifty shekels. He also overlaid the upper parts with gold.
chapters.zh: 金钉重五十舍客勒。楼房都贴上金子。

chapters.en: For the Most Holy Place he made a pair of sculptured cherubim and overlaid them with gold.
chapters.zh: 在至圣所按造像的法子造两个基路伯，用金子包裹。

chapters.en: The total wingspan of the cherubim was twenty cubits. One wing of the first cherub was five cubits long and touched the temple wall, while its other wing, also five cubits long, touched the wing of the other cherub.
chapters.zh: 两个基路伯的翅膀共长二十肘。这基路伯的一个翅膀长五肘，挨着殿这边的墙。那一个翅膀也长五肘，与那基路伯翅膀相接。

chapters.en: Similarly one wing of the second cherub was five cubits long and touched the other temple wall, and its other wing, also five cubits long, touched the wing of the first cherub.
chapters.zh: 那基路伯的一个翅膀长五肘，挨着殿那边的墙。那一个翅膀也长五肘，与这基路伯的翅膀相接。

chapters.en: The wings of these cherubim extended twenty cubits. They stood on their feet, facing the main hall.
chapters.zh: 两个基路伯张开翅膀，共长二十肘，面向外殿而立。

chapters.en: He made the curtain of blue, purple and crimson yarn and fine linen, with cherubim worked into it.
chapters.zh: 又用蓝色，紫色，朱红色线和细麻织幔子，在其上绣出基路伯来。

chapters.en: For the front of the temple he made two pillars, which together were thirty-five cubits long, each with a capital five cubits high.
chapters.zh: 在殿前造了两根柱子，高三十五肘。每柱顶高五肘。

chapters.en: He made interwoven chains and put them on top of the pillars. He also made a hundred pomegranates and attached them to the chains.
chapters.zh: 又照圣所内链子的样式作链子，安在柱顶上。又作一百石榴，安在链子上。

chapters.en: He erected the pillars in the front of the temple, one to the south and one to the north. The one to the south he named Jakin and the one to the north Boaz.
chapters.zh: 将两根柱子立在殿前，一根在右边，一根在左边。右边的起名叫雅斤，左边的起名叫波阿斯。

chapters.en: He made a bronze altar twenty cubits long, twenty cubits wide and ten cubits high.
chapters.zh: 他又制造一座铜坛，长二十肘，宽二十肘，高十肘。

chapters.en: He made the Sea of cast metal, circular in shape, measuring ten cubits from rim to rim and five cubits high. It took a line of thirty cubits to measure around it.
chapters.zh: 又铸一个铜海，样式是圆的，高五肘，径十肘，围三十肘。

chapters.en: Below the rim, figures of bulls encircled it—ten to a cubit. The bulls were cast in two rows in one piece with the Sea.
chapters.zh: 海周围有野瓜的样式，每肘十瓜，共有两行，是铸海的时候铸上的（野瓜原文作牛）。

chapters.en: The Sea stood on twelve bulls, three facing north, three facing west, three facing south and three facing east. The Sea rested on top of them, and their hindquarters were toward the center.
chapters.zh: 有十二只铜牛驮海，三只向北，三只向西，三只向南，三只向东。海在牛上，牛尾向内。

chapters.en: It was a handbreadth in thickness, and its rim was like the rim of a cup, like a lily blossom. It held three thousand baths.
chapters.zh: 海厚一掌，边如杯边，又如百合花，可容三千吧特。

chapters.en: He then made ten basins for washing and placed five on the south side and five on the north. In them the things to be used for the burnt offerings were rinsed, but the Sea was to be used by the priests for washing.
chapters.zh: 又制造十个盆，五个放在右边，五个放在左边，献燔祭所用之物都洗在其内。但海是为祭司沐浴的。

chapters.en: He made ten gold lampstands according to the specifications for them and placed them in the temple, five on the south side and five on the north.
chapters.zh: 他又照所定的样式造十个金灯台放在殿里，五个在右边，五个在左边。

chapters.en: He made ten tables and placed them in the temple, five on the south side and five on the north. He also made a hundred gold sprinkling bowls.
chapters.zh: 又造十张桌子放在殿里，五张在右边，五张在左边。又造一百个金碗。

chapters.en: He made the courtyard of the priests, and the large court and the doors for the court, and overlaid the doors with bronze.
chapters.zh: 又建立祭司院和大院，并院门，用铜包裹门扇。

chapters.en: He placed the Sea on the south side, at the southeast corner.
chapters.zh: 将海安在殿门的右边，就是南边。

chapters.en: And Huram also made the pots and shovels and sprinkling bowls. So Huram finished the work he had undertaken for King Solomon in the temple of God:
chapters.zh: 户兰又造了盆，铲，碗。这样，他为所罗门王作完了神殿的工。

chapters.en: the two pillars; the two bowl-shaped capitals on top of the pillars; the two sets of network decorating the two bowl-shaped capitals on top of the pillars;
chapters.zh: 所造的就是两根柱子和柱上两个如球的顶，并两个盖柱顶的网子，

chapters.en: the four hundred pomegranates for the two sets of network (two rows of pomegranates for each network, decorating the bowl-shaped capitals on top of the pillars);
chapters.zh: 和四百石榴，安在两个网子上，每网两行盖着两个柱上如球的顶。

chapters.en: the stands with their basins;
chapters.zh: 盆座和其上的盆，

chapters.en: the Sea and the twelve bulls under it;
chapters.zh: 海和海下的十二只牛，

chapters.en: the pots, shovels, meat forks and all related articles. All the objects that Huram-Abi made for King Solomon for the temple of the LORD were of polished bronze.
chapters.zh: 盆，铲子，肉锸子，与耶和华殿里的一切器皿，都是巧匠户兰用光亮的铜为所罗门王造成的，

chapters.en: The king had them cast in clay molds in the plain of the Jordan between Sukkoth and Zarethan.
chapters.zh: 是在约旦平原疏割和撒利但中间借胶泥铸成的。

chapters.en: All these things that Solomon made amounted to so much that the weight of the bronze could not be calculated.
chapters.zh: 所罗门制造的这一切甚多，铜的轻重无法可查。

chapters.en: Solomon also made all the furnishings that were in God’s temple: the golden altar; the tables on which was the bread of the Presence;
chapters.zh: 所罗门又造神殿里的金坛和陈设饼的桌子，

chapters.en: the lampstands of pure gold with their lamps, to burn in front of the inner sanctuary as prescribed;
chapters.zh: 并精金的灯台和灯盏，可以照例点在内殿前。

chapters.en: the gold floral work and lamps and tongs (they were solid gold);
chapters.zh: 灯台上的花和灯盏，并蜡剪都是金的，且是纯金的。

chapters.en: the pure gold wick trimmers, sprinkling bowls, dishes and censers; and the gold doors of the temple: the inner doors to the Most Holy Place and the doors of the main hall.
chapters.zh: 又用精金制造镊子，盘子，调羹，火鼎。至于殿门和至圣所的门扇，并殿的门扇，都是金子妆饰的。

chapters.en: When all the work Solomon had done for the temple of the LORD was finished, he brought in the things his father David had dedicated—the silver and gold and all the furnishings—and he placed them in the treasuries of God’s temple.
chapters.zh: 所罗门作完了耶和华殿的一切工，就把他父大卫分别为圣的金银和器皿都带来，放在神殿的府库里。

chapters.en: Then Solomon summoned to Jerusalem the elders of Israel, all the heads of the tribes and the chiefs of the Israelite families, to bring up the ark of the LORD’s covenant from Zion, the City of David.
chapters.zh: 那时，所罗门将以色列的长老，各支派的首领，并以色列的族长招聚到耶路撒冷，要把耶和华的约柜从大卫城就是锡安运上来。

chapters.en: And all the Israelites came together to the king at the time of the festival in the seventh month.
chapters.zh: 于是以色列众人在七月节前都聚集到王那里。

chapters.en: When all the elders of Israel had arrived, the Levites took up the ark,
chapters.zh: 以色列众长老来到，利未人便抬起约柜。

chapters.en: and they brought up the ark and the tent of meeting and all the sacred furnishings in it. The Levitical priests carried them up;
chapters.zh: 祭司利未人将约柜运上来，又将会幕和会幕的一切圣器具都带上来。

chapters.en: and King Solomon and the entire assembly of Israel that had gathered about him were before the ark, sacrificing so many sheep and cattle that they could not be recorded or counted.
chapters.zh: 所罗门王和聚集到他那里的以色列全会众都在约柜前献牛羊为祭，多得不可胜数。

chapters.en: The priests then brought the ark of the LORD’s covenant to its place in the inner sanctuary of the temple, the Most Holy Place, and put it beneath the wings of the cherubim.
chapters.zh: 祭司将耶和华的约柜抬进内殿，就是至圣所，放在两个基路伯的翅膀底下。

chapters.en: The cherubim spread their wings over the place of the ark and covered the ark and its carrying poles.
chapters.zh: 基路伯张着翅膀在约柜之上，遮掩约柜和抬柜的杠。

chapters.en: These poles were so long that their ends, extending from the ark, could be seen from in front of the inner sanctuary, but not from outside the Holy Place; and they are still there today.
chapters.zh: 这杠甚长，杠头在内殿前可以看见，在殿外却不能看见，直到如今还在那里。

chapters.en: There was nothing in the ark except the two tablets that Moses had placed in it at Horeb, where the LORD made a covenant with the Israelites after they came out of Egypt.
chapters.zh: 约柜里惟有两块石版，就是以色列人出埃及后，耶和华与他们立约的时候，摩西在何烈山所放的。除此以外，并无别物。

chapters.en: The priests then withdrew from the Holy Place. All the priests who were there had consecrated themselves, regardless of their divisions.
chapters.zh: 当时，在那里所有的祭司都已自洁，并不分班供职。

chapters.en: All the Levites who were musicians—Asaph, Heman, Jeduthun and their sons and relatives—stood on the east side of the altar, dressed in fine linen and playing cymbals, harps and lyres. They were accompanied by 120 priests sounding trumpets.
chapters.zh: 他们出圣所的时候，歌唱的利未人亚萨，希幔，耶杜顿，和他们的众子众弟兄都穿细麻布衣服，站在坛的东边，敲钹，鼓瑟，弹琴，同着他们有一百二十个祭司吹号。

chapters.en: The trumpeters and musicians joined in unison to give praise and thanks to the LORD. Accompanied by trumpets, cymbals and other instruments, the singers raised their voices in praise to the LORD and sang: “He is good; his love endures forever.” Then the temple of the LORD was filled with the cloud,
chapters.zh: 吹号的，歌唱的都一齐发声，声合为一，赞美感谢耶和华。吹号，敲钹，用各种乐器，扬声赞美耶和华说，耶和华本为善，他的慈爱永远长存。那时，耶和华的殿有云充满，

chapters.en: and the priests could not perform their service because of the cloud, for the glory of the LORD filled the temple of God.
chapters.zh: 甚至祭司不能站立供职，因为耶和华的荣光充满了神的殿。

chapters.en: Then Solomon said, “The LORD has said that he would dwell in a dark cloud;
chapters.zh: 那时，所罗门说，耶和华曾说他必住在幽暗之处。

chapters.en: I have built a magnificent temple for you, a place for you to dwell forever.”
chapters.zh: 但我已经建造殿宇作你的居所，为你永远的住处。

chapters.en: While the whole assembly of Israel was standing there, the king turned around and blessed them.
chapters.zh: 王转脸为以色列会众祝福，以色列会众就都站立。

chapters.en: Then he said: “Praise be to the LORD, the God of Israel, who with his hands has fulfilled what he promised with his mouth to my father David. For he said,
chapters.zh: 所罗门说，耶和华以色列的神是应当称颂的。因他亲口向我父大卫所应许的，也亲手成就了。

chapters.en: ‘Since the day I brought my people out of Egypt, I have not chosen a city in any tribe of Israel to have a temple built so that my Name might be there, nor have I chosen anyone to be ruler over my people Israel.
chapters.zh: 他说，自从我领我民出埃及地以来，我未曾在以色列众支派中选择一城建造殿宇为我名的居所，也未曾拣选一人作我民以色列的君。

chapters.en: But now I have chosen Jerusalem for my Name to be there, and I have chosen David to rule my people Israel.’
chapters.zh: 但选择耶路撒冷为我名的居所，又拣选大卫治理我民以色列。

chapters.en: “My father David had it in his heart to build a temple for the Name of the LORD, the God of Israel.
chapters.zh: 所罗门说，我父大卫曾立意要为耶和华以色列神的名建殿，

chapters.en: But the LORD said to my father David, ‘You did well to have it in your heart to build a temple for my Name.
chapters.zh: 耶和华却对我父大卫说，你立意要为我的名建殿，这意思甚好。

chapters.en: Nevertheless, you are not the one to build the temple, but your son, your own flesh and blood—he is the one who will build the temple for my Name.’
chapters.zh: 只是你不可建殿，惟你所生的儿子必为我名建殿。

chapters.en: “The LORD has kept the promise he made. I have succeeded David my father and now I sit on the throne of Israel, just as the LORD promised, and I have built the temple for the Name of the LORD, the God of Israel.
chapters.zh: 现在耶和华成就了他所应许的话，使我接续我父大卫坐以色列的国位，是照耶和华所说的，又为耶和华以色列神的名建造了殿。

chapters.en: There I have placed the ark, in which is the covenant of the LORD that he made with the people of Israel.”
chapters.zh: 我将约柜安置在其中，柜内有耶和华的约，就是他与以色列人所立的约。

chapters.en: Then Solomon stood before the altar of the LORD in front of the whole assembly of Israel and spread out his hands.
chapters.zh: 所罗门当着以色列会众，站在耶和华的坛前，举起手来，

chapters.en: Now he had made a bronze platform, five cubits long, five cubits wide and three cubits high, and had placed it in the center of the outer court. He stood on the platform and then knelt down before the whole assembly of Israel and spread out his hands toward heaven.
chapters.zh: 所罗门曾造一个铜台，长五肘，宽五肘，高三肘，放在院中。就站在台上，当着以色列的会众跪下，向天举手，

chapters.en: He said: “LORD, the God of Israel, there is no God like you in heaven or on earth—you who keep your covenant of love with your servants who continue wholeheartedly in your way.
chapters.zh: 说，耶和华以色列的神阿，天上地下没有神可比你的。你向那尽心行在你面前的仆人守约施慈爱。

chapters.en: You have kept your promise to your servant David my father; with your mouth you have promised and with your hand you have fulfilled it—as it is today.
chapters.zh: 向你仆人我父大卫所应许的话现在应验了。你亲口应许，亲手成就，正如今日一样。

chapters.en: “Now, LORD, the God of Israel, keep for your servant David my father the promises you made to him when you said, ‘You shall never fail to have a successor to sit before me on the throne of Israel, if only your descendants are careful in all they do to walk before me according to my law, as you have done.’
chapters.zh: 耶和华以色列的神阿，你所应许你仆人我父大卫的话说，你的子孙若谨慎自己的行为，遵守我的律法，象你在我面前所行的一样，就不断人坐以色列的国位。现在求你应验这话。

chapters.en: And now, LORD, the God of Israel, let your word that you promised your servant David come true.
chapters.zh: 耶和华以色列的神阿，求你成就向你仆人大卫所应许的话。

chapters.en: “But will God really dwell on earth with humans? The heavens, even the highest heavens, cannot contain you. How much less this temple I have built!
chapters.zh: 神果真与世人同住在地上吗？看哪，天和天上的天尚且不足你居住的，何况我所建的这殿呢？

chapters.en: Yet, LORD my God, give attention to your servant’s prayer and his plea for mercy. Hear the cry and the prayer that your servant is praying in your presence.
chapters.zh: 惟求耶和华我的神垂顾仆人的祷告祈求，俯听仆人在你面前的祈祷呼吁。

chapters.en: May your eyes be open toward this temple day and night, this place of which you said you would put your Name there. May you hear the prayer your servant prays toward this place.
chapters.zh: 愿你昼夜看顾这殿，就是你应许立为你名的居所。求你垂听仆人向此处祷告的话。

chapters.en: Hear the supplications of your servant and of your people Israel when they pray toward this place. Hear from heaven, your dwelling place; and when you hear, forgive.
chapters.zh: 你仆人和你民以色列向此处祈祷的时候，求你从天上你的居所垂听，垂听而赦免。

chapters.en: “When anyone wrongs their neighbor and is required to take an oath and they come and swear the oath before your altar in this temple,
chapters.zh: 人若得罪邻舍，有人叫他起誓，他来到这殿，在你的坛前起誓，

chapters.en: then hear from heaven and act. Judge between your servants, condemning the guilty and bringing down on their heads what they have done, and vindicating the innocent by treating them in accordance with their innocence.
chapters.zh: 求你从天上垂听，判断你的仆人，定恶人有罪，照他所行的报应在他头上。定义人有理，照他的义赏赐他。

chapters.en: “When your people Israel have been defeated by an enemy because they have sinned against you and when they turn back and give praise to your name, praying and making supplication before you in this temple,
chapters.zh: 你的民以色列若得罪你，败在仇敌面前，又回心转意承认你的名，在这殿里向你祈求祷告，

chapters.en: then hear from heaven and forgive the sin of your people Israel and bring them back to the land you gave to them and their ancestors.
chapters.zh: 求你从天上垂听，赦免你民以色列的罪，使他们归回你赐给他们和他们列祖之地。

chapters.en: “When the heavens are shut up and there is no rain because your people have sinned against you, and when they pray toward this place and give praise to your name and turn from their sin because you have afflicted them,
chapters.zh: 你的民因得罪你，你惩罚他们，使天闭塞不下雨，他们若向此处祷告，承认你的名，离开他们的罪，

chapters.en: then hear from heaven and forgive the sin of your servants, your people Israel. Teach them the right way to live, and send rain on the land you gave your people for an inheritance.
chapters.zh: 求你在天上垂听，赦免你仆人和你民以色列的罪，将当行的善道指教他们，且降雨在你的地，就是你赐给你民为业之地。

chapters.en: “When famine or plague comes to the land, or blight or mildew, locusts or grasshoppers, or when enemies besiege them in any of their cities, whatever disaster or disease may come,
chapters.zh: 国中若有饥荒，瘟疫，旱风，霉烂，蝗虫，蚂蚱，或有仇敌犯境，围困城邑，无论遭遇什么灾祸疾病，

chapters.en: and when a prayer or plea is made by anyone among your people Israel—being aware of their afflictions and pains, and spreading out their hands toward this temple—
chapters.zh: 你的民以色列，或是众人，或是一人，自觉灾祸甚苦，向这殿举手，无论祈求什么，祷告什么，

chapters.en: then hear from heaven, your dwelling place. Forgive, and deal with everyone according to all they do, since you know their hearts (for you alone know the human heart),
chapters.zh: 求你从天上你的居所垂听赦免。你是知道人心的，要照各人所行的待他们（惟有你知道世人的心），

chapters.en: so that they will fear you and walk in obedience to you all the time they live in the land you gave our ancestors.
chapters.zh: 使他们在你赐给我们列祖之地上一生一世敬畏你，遵行你的道。

chapters.en: “As for the foreigner who does not belong to your people Israel but has come from a distant land because of your great name and your mighty hand and your outstretched arm—when they come and pray toward this temple,
chapters.zh: 论到不属你民以色列的外邦人，为你的大名和大能的手，并伸出来的膀臂，从远方而来，向这殿祷告，

chapters.en: then hear from heaven, your dwelling place. Do whatever the foreigner asks of you, so that all the peoples of the earth may know your name and fear you, as do your own people Israel, and may know that this house I have built bears your Name.
chapters.zh: 求你从天上你的居所垂听，照着外邦人所祈求的而行，使天下万民都认识你的名，敬畏你，象你的民以色列一样，又使他们知道我建造的这殿是称为你名下的。

chapters.en: “When your people go to war against their enemies, wherever you send them, and when they pray to you toward this city you have chosen and the temple I have built for your Name,
chapters.zh: 你的民若奉你的差遣，无论往何处去与仇敌争战，向你所选择的城与我为你名所建造的殿祷告，

chapters.en: then hear from heaven their prayer and their plea, and uphold their cause.
chapters.zh: 求你从天上垂听他们的祷告祈求，使他们得胜。

chapters.en: “When they sin against you—for there is no one who does not sin—and you become angry with them and give them over to the enemy, who takes them captive to a land far away or near;
chapters.zh: 你的民若得罪你（世上没有不犯罪的人），你向他们发怒，将他们交给仇敌掳到或远或近之地。

chapters.en: and if they have a change of heart in the land where they are held captive, and repent and plead with you in the land of their captivity and say, ‘We have sinned, we have done wrong and acted wickedly’;
chapters.zh: 他们若在掳到之地想起罪来，回心转意，恳求你说，我们有罪了，我们悖逆了，我们作恶了。

chapters.en: and if they turn back to you with all their heart and soul in the land of their captivity where they were taken, and pray toward the land you gave their ancestors, toward the city you have chosen and toward the temple I have built for your Name;
chapters.zh: 他们若在掳到之地尽心尽性归服你，又向自己的地，就是你赐给他们列祖之地和你所选择的城，并我为你名所建造的殿祷告，

chapters.en: then from heaven, your dwelling place, hear their prayer and their pleas, and uphold their cause. And forgive your people, who have sinned against you.
chapters.zh: 求你从天上你的居所垂听你民的祷告祈求，为他们伸冤，赦免他们的过犯。

chapters.en: “Now, my God, may your eyes be open and your ears attentive to the prayers offered in this place.
chapters.zh: 我的神阿，现在求你睁眼看，侧耳听在此处所献的祷告。

chapters.en: “Now arise, LORD God, and come to your resting place, you and the ark of your might. May your priests, LORD God, be clothed with salvation, may your faithful people rejoice in your goodness.
chapters.zh: 耶和华神阿，求你起来，和你有能力的约柜同入安息之所。耶和华神阿，愿你的祭司披上救恩。愿你的圣民蒙福欢乐。

chapters.en: LORD God, do not reject your anointed one. Remember the great love promised to David your servant.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华神阿，求你不要厌弃你的受膏者，要记念向你仆人大卫所施的慈爱。

chapters.en: When Solomon finished praying, fire came down from heaven and consumed the burnt offering and the sacrifices, and the glory of the LORD filled the temple.
chapters.zh: 所罗门祈祷已毕，就有火从天上降下来，烧尽燔祭和别的祭。耶和华的荣光充满了殿。

chapters.en: The priests could not enter the temple of the LORD because the glory of the LORD filled it.
chapters.zh: 因耶和华的荣光充满了耶和华殿，所以祭司不能进殿。

chapters.en: When all the Israelites saw the fire coming down and the glory of the LORD above the temple, they knelt on the pavement with their faces to the ground, and they worshiped and gave thanks to the LORD, saying, “He is good; his love endures forever.”
chapters.zh: 那火降下，耶和华的荣光在殿上的时候，以色列众人看见，就在铺石地俯伏叩拜，称谢耶和华说，耶和华本为善，他的慈爱永远长存。

chapters.en: Then the king and all the people offered sacrifices before the LORD.
chapters.zh: 王和众民在耶和华面前献祭。

chapters.en: And King Solomon offered a sacrifice of twenty-two thousand head of cattle and a hundred and twenty thousand sheep and goats. So the king and all the people dedicated the temple of God.
chapters.zh: 所罗门王用牛二万二千，羊十二万献祭。这样，王和众民为神的殿行奉献之礼。

chapters.en: The priests took their positions, as did the Levites with the LORD’s musical instruments, which King David had made for praising the LORD and which were used when he gave thanks, saying, “His love endures forever.” Opposite the Levites, the priests blew their trumpets, and all the Israelites were standing.
chapters.zh: 祭司侍立，各供其职。利未人也拿着耶和华的乐器，就是大卫王造出来，借利未人颂赞耶和华的。（他的慈爱永远长存。）祭司在众人面前吹号，以色列人都站立。

chapters.en: Solomon consecrated the middle part of the courtyard in front of the temple of the LORD, and there he offered burnt offerings and the fat of the fellowship offerings, because the bronze altar he had made could not hold the burnt offerings, the grain offerings and the fat portions.
chapters.zh: 所罗门因他所造的铜坛容不下燔祭，素祭，和脂油，便将耶和华殿前院子当中分别为圣，在那里献燔祭和平安祭牲的脂油。

chapters.en: So Solomon observed the festival at that time for seven days, and all Israel with him—a vast assembly, people from Lebo Hamath to the Wadi of Egypt.
chapters.zh: 那时所罗门和以色列众人，就是从哈马口直到埃及小河，所有的以色列人都聚集成为大会，守节七日。

chapters.en: On the eighth day they held an assembly, for they had celebrated the dedication of the altar for seven days and the festival for seven days more.
chapters.zh: 第八日设立严肃会，行奉献坛的礼七日，守节七日。

chapters.en: On the twenty-third day of the seventh month he sent the people to their homes, joyful and glad in heart for the good things the LORD had done for David and Solomon and for his people Israel.
chapters.zh: 七月二十三日，王遣散众民。他们因见耶和华向大卫和所罗门与他民以色列所施的恩惠，就都心中喜乐，各归各家去了。

chapters.en: When Solomon had finished the temple of the LORD and the royal palace, and had succeeded in carrying out all he had in mind to do in the temple of the LORD and in his own palace,
chapters.zh: 所罗门造成了耶和华殿和王宫。在耶和华殿和王宫凡他心中所要作的，都顺顺利利地作成了。

chapters.en: the LORD appeared to him at night and said: “I have heard your prayer and have chosen this place for myself as a temple for sacrifices.
chapters.zh: 夜间耶和华向所罗门显现，对他说，我已听了你的祷告，也选择这地方作为祭祀我的殿宇。

chapters.en: “When I shut up the heavens so that there is no rain, or command locusts to devour the land or send a plague among my people,
chapters.zh: 我若使天闭塞不下雨，或使蝗虫吃这地的出产，或使瘟疫流行在我民中，

chapters.en: if my people, who are called by my name, will humble themselves and pray and seek my face and turn from their wicked ways, then I will hear from heaven, and I will forgive their sin and will heal their land.
chapters.zh: 这称为我名下的子民，若是自卑，祷告，寻求我的面，转离他们的恶行，我必从天上垂听，赦免他们的罪，医治他们的地。

chapters.en: Now my eyes will be open and my ears attentive to the prayers offered in this place.
chapters.zh: 我必睁眼看，侧耳听在此处所献的祷告。

chapters.en: I have chosen and consecrated this temple so that my Name may be there forever. My eyes and my heart will always be there.
chapters.zh: 现在我已选择这殿，分别为圣，使我的名永在其中，我的眼，我的心也必常在那里。

chapters.en: “As for you, if you walk before me faithfully as David your father did, and do all I command, and observe my decrees and laws,
chapters.zh: 你若在我面前效法你父大卫所行的，遵行我一切所吩咐你的，谨守我的律例典章，

chapters.en: I will establish your royal throne, as I covenanted with David your father when I said, ‘You shall never fail to have a successor to rule over Israel.’
chapters.zh: 我就必坚固你的国位，正如我与你父大卫所立的约，说，你的子孙必不断人作以色列的王。

chapters.en: “But if you turn away and forsake the decrees and commands I have given you and go off to serve other gods and worship them,
chapters.zh: 倘若你们转去丢弃我指示你们的律例诫命，去事奉敬拜别神，

chapters.en: then I will uproot Israel from my land, which I have given them, and will reject this temple I have consecrated for my Name. I will make it a byword and an object of ridicule among all peoples.
chapters.zh: 我就必将以色列人从我赐给他们的地上拔出根来，并且我为己名所分别为圣的殿也必舍弃不顾，使他在万民中作笑谈，被讥诮。

chapters.en: This temple will become a heap of rubble. All who pass by will be appalled and say, ‘Why has the LORD done such a thing to this land and to this temple?’
chapters.zh: 这殿虽然甚高，将来经过的人必惊讶说，耶和华为何向这地和这殿如此行呢？

chapters.en: People will answer, ‘Because they have forsaken the LORD, the God of their ancestors, who brought them out of Egypt, and have embraced other gods, worshiping and serving them—that is why he brought all this disaster on them.’ ”
chapters.zh: 人必回答说，是因此地的人离弃耶和华他们列祖的神，就是领他们出埃及地的神，去亲近别神，敬拜事奉他，所以耶和华使这一切灾祸临到他们。

chapters.en: At the end of twenty years, during which Solomon built the temple of the LORD and his own palace,
chapters.zh: 所罗门建造耶和华殿和王宫，二十年才完毕了。

chapters.en: Solomon rebuilt the villages that Hiram had given him, and settled Israelites in them.
chapters.zh: 以后所罗门重新修筑希兰送给他的那些城邑，使以色列人住在那里。

chapters.en: Solomon then went to Hamath Zobah and captured it.
chapters.zh: 所罗门往哈马琐巴去，攻取了那地方。

chapters.en: He also built up Tadmor in the desert and all the store cities he had built in Hamath.
chapters.zh: 所罗门建造旷野里的达莫，又建造哈马所有的积货城，

chapters.en: He rebuilt Upper Beth Horon and Lower Beth Horon as fortified cities, with walls and with gates and bars,
chapters.zh: 又建造上伯和仑，下伯和仑作为保障，都有墙，有门，有闩。

chapters.en: as well as Baalath and all his store cities, and all the cities for his chariots and for his horses —whatever he desired to build in Jerusalem, in Lebanon and throughout all the territory he ruled.
chapters.zh: 又建造巴拉和所有的积货城，并屯车辆马兵的城，与耶路撒冷，利巴嫩，以及自己治理的全国中所愿意建造的。

chapters.en: There were still people left from the Hittites, Amorites, Perizzites, Hivites and Jebusites (these people were not Israelites).
chapters.zh: 至于国中所剩下不属以色列人的赫人，亚摩利人，比利洗人，希未人，耶布斯人，

chapters.en: Solomon conscripted the descendants of all these people remaining in the land—whom the Israelites had not destroyed—to serve as slave labor, as it is to this day.
chapters.zh: 就是以色列人未曾灭绝的，所罗门挑取他们的后裔作服苦的奴仆，直到今日。

chapters.en: But Solomon did not make slaves of the Israelites for his work; they were his fighting men, commanders of his captains, and commanders of his chariots and charioteers.
chapters.zh: 惟有以色列人，所罗门不使他们当奴仆作工，乃是作他的战士，军长的统领，车兵长，马兵长。

chapters.en: They were also King Solomon’s chief officials—two hundred and fifty officials supervising the men.
chapters.zh: 所罗门王有二百五十督工的，监管工人。

chapters.en: Solomon brought Pharaoh’s daughter up from the City of David to the palace he had built for her, for he said, “My wife must not live in the palace of David king of Israel, because the places the ark of the LORD has entered are holy.”
chapters.zh: 所罗门将法老的女儿带出大卫城，上到为她建造的宫里。因所罗门说，耶和华约柜所到之处都为圣地，所以我的妻不可住在以色列王大卫的宫里。

chapters.en: On the altar of the LORD that he had built in front of the portico, Solomon sacrificed burnt offerings to the LORD,
chapters.zh: 所罗门在耶和华的坛上，就是在廊子前他所筑的坛上，与耶和华献燔祭。

chapters.en: according to the daily requirement for offerings commanded by Moses for the Sabbaths, the New Moons and the three annual festivals—the Festival of Unleavened Bread, the Festival of Weeks and the Festival of Tabernacles.
chapters.zh: 又遵着摩西的吩咐在安息日，月朔，并一年三节，就是除酵节，七七节，住棚节，献每日所当献的祭。

chapters.en: In keeping with the ordinance of his father David, he appointed the divisions of the priests for their duties, and the Levites to lead the praise and to assist the priests according to each day’s requirement. He also appointed the gatekeepers by divisions for the various gates, because this was what David the man of God had ordered.
chapters.zh: 所罗门照着他父大卫所定的例，派定祭司的班次，使他们各供己事，又使利未人各尽其职，赞美耶和华，在祭司面前作每日所当作的。又派守门的按着班次看守各门，因为神人大卫是这样吩咐的。

chapters.en: They did not deviate from the king’s commands to the priests or to the Levites in any matter, including that of the treasuries.
chapters.zh: 王所吩咐众祭司和利未人的，无论是管府库或办别的事，他们都不违背。

chapters.en: All Solomon’s work was carried out, from the day the foundation of the temple of the LORD was laid until its completion. So the temple of the LORD was finished.
chapters.zh: 所罗门建造耶和华的殿，从立根基直到成功的日子，工料俱备。这样，耶和华的殿全然完毕。

chapters.en: Then Solomon went to Ezion Geber and Elath on the coast of Edom.
chapters.zh: 那时，所罗门往以东地靠海的以旬迦别和以禄去。

chapters.en: And Hiram sent him ships commanded by his own men, sailors who knew the sea. These, with Solomon’s men, sailed to Ophir and brought back four hundred and fifty talents of gold, which they delivered to King Solomon.
chapters.zh: 希兰差遣他的臣仆，将船只和熟悉泛海的仆人送到所罗门那里。他们同着所罗门的仆人到了俄斐，得了四百五十他连得金子，运到所罗门王那里。

chapters.en: When the queen of Sheba heard of Solomon’s fame, she came to Jerusalem to test him with hard questions. Arriving with a very great caravan—with camels carrying spices, large quantities of gold, and precious stones—she came to Solomon and talked with him about all she had on her mind.
chapters.zh: 示巴女王听见所罗门的名声，就来到耶路撒冷，要用难解的话试问所罗门。跟随她的人甚多，又有骆驼驮着香料，宝石，和许多金子。她来见了所罗门，就把心里所有的对所罗门都说出来。

chapters.en: Solomon answered all her questions; nothing was too hard for him to explain to her.
chapters.zh: 所罗门将她所问的都答上了，没有一句不明白，不能答的。

chapters.en: When the queen of Sheba saw the wisdom of Solomon, as well as the palace he had built,
chapters.zh: 示巴女王见所罗门的智慧和他所建造的宫室，

chapters.en: the food on his table, the seating of his officials, the attending servants in their robes, the cupbearers in their robes and the burnt offerings he made at the temple of the LORD, she was overwhelmed.
chapters.zh: 席上的珍馐美味，群臣分列而坐，仆人两旁侍立，以及他们的衣服装饰，酒政，和酒政的衣服装饰，又见他上耶和华殿的台阶，就诧异得神不守舍，

chapters.en: She said to the king, “The report I heard in my own country about your achievements and your wisdom is true.
chapters.zh: 对王说，我在本国里所听见论到你的事和你的智慧实在是真的。

chapters.en: But I did not believe what they said until I came and saw with my own eyes. Indeed, not even half the greatness of your wisdom was told me; you have far exceeded the report I heard.
chapters.zh: 我先不信那些话，及至我来亲眼见了，才知道你的大智慧。人所告诉我的，还不到一半。你的实迹越过我所听见的名声。

chapters.en: How happy your people must be! How happy your officials, who continually stand before you and hear your wisdom!
chapters.zh: 你的群臣，你的仆人常侍立在你面前听你智慧的话是有福的。

chapters.en: Praise be to the LORD your God, who has delighted in you and placed you on his throne as king to rule for the LORD your God. Because of the love of your God for Israel and his desire to uphold them forever, he has made you king over them, to maintain justice and righteousness.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华你的神是应当称颂的。他喜悦你，使你坐他的国位，为耶和华你的神作王。因为你的神爱以色列人，要永远坚立他们，所以立你作他们的王，使你秉公行义。

chapters.en: Then she gave the king 120 talents of gold, large quantities of spices, and precious stones. There had never been such spices as those the queen of Sheba gave to King Solomon.
chapters.zh: 于是示巴女王将一百二十他连得金子和宝石，与极多的香料送给所罗门王。她送给王的香料，以后再没有这样的。

chapters.en: (The servants of Hiram and the servants of Solomon brought gold from Ophir; they also brought algumwood and precious stones.
chapters.zh: 希兰的仆人和所罗门的仆人从俄斐运了金子来，也运了檀香木（或作乌木。下同）和宝石来。

chapters.en: The king used the algumwood to make steps for the temple of the LORD and for the royal palace, and to make harps and lyres for the musicians. Nothing like them had ever been seen in Judah.)
chapters.zh: 王用檀香木为耶和华殿和王宫作台，又为歌唱的人作琴瑟。犹大地从来没有见过这样的。

chapters.en: King Solomon gave the queen of Sheba all she desired and asked for; he gave her more than she had brought to him. Then she left and returned with her retinue to her own country.
chapters.zh: 所罗门王按示巴女王所带来的，还她礼物，另外照她一切所要所求的，都送给她。于是女王和她臣仆转回本国去了。

chapters.en: The weight of the gold that Solomon received yearly was 666 talents,
chapters.zh: 所罗门每年所得的金子共有六百六十六他连得，

chapters.en: not including the revenues brought in by merchants and traders. Also all the kings of Arabia and the governors of the territories brought gold and silver to Solomon.
chapters.zh: 另外还有商人所进的金子，并且亚拉伯诸王与属国的省长都带金银给所罗门。

chapters.en: King Solomon made two hundred large shields of hammered gold; six hundred shekels of hammered gold went into each shield.
chapters.zh: 所罗门王用锤出来的金子打成挡牌二百面，每面用金子六百舍客勒。

chapters.en: He also made three hundred small shields of hammered gold, with three hundred shekels of gold in each shield. The king put them in the Palace of the Forest of Lebanon.
chapters.zh: 又用锤出来的金子打成盾牌三百面，每面用金子三百舍客勒，都放在利巴嫩林宫里。

chapters.en: Then the king made a great throne covered with ivory and overlaid with pure gold.
chapters.zh: 王用象牙制造一个大宝座，用精金包裹。

chapters.en: The throne had six steps, and a footstool of gold was attached to it. On both sides of the seat were armrests, with a lion standing beside each of them.
chapters.zh: 宝座有六层台阶，又有金脚凳，与宝座相连。宝座两旁有扶手，靠近扶手有两个狮子站立。

chapters.en: Twelve lions stood on the six steps, one at either end of each step. Nothing like it had ever been made for any other kingdom.
chapters.zh: 六层台阶上有十二个狮子站立，每层有两个，左边一个，右边一个。在列国中没有这样作的。

chapters.en: All King Solomon’s goblets were gold, and all the household articles in the Palace of the Forest of Lebanon were pure gold. Nothing was made of silver, because silver was considered of little value in Solomon’s day.
chapters.zh: 所罗门王一切的饮器都是金的，利巴嫩林宫里的一切器皿都是精金的。所罗门年间，银子算不了什么。

chapters.en: The king had a fleet of trading ships manned by Hiram’s servants. Once every three years it returned, carrying gold, silver and ivory, and apes and baboons.
chapters.zh: 因为王的船只与希兰的仆人一同往他施去。他施船只三年一次装载金，银，象牙，猿猴，孔雀回来。

chapters.en: King Solomon was greater in riches and wisdom than all the other kings of the earth.
chapters.zh: 所罗门王的财宝与智慧胜过天下的列王。

chapters.en: All the kings of the earth sought audience with Solomon to hear the wisdom God had put in his heart.
chapters.zh: 普天下的王都求见所罗门，要听神赐给他智慧的话。

chapters.en: Year after year, everyone who came brought a gift—articles of silver and gold, and robes, weapons and spices, and horses and mules.
chapters.zh: 他们各带贡物，就是金器，银器，衣服，军械，香料，骡马，每年有一定之例。

chapters.en: Solomon had four thousand stalls for horses and chariots, and twelve thousand horses, which he kept in the chariot cities and also with him in Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 所罗门有套车的马四千棚，有马兵一万二千，安置在屯车的城邑和耶路撒冷，就是王那里。

chapters.en: He ruled over all the kings from the Euphrates River to the land of the Philistines, as far as the border of Egypt.
chapters.zh: 所罗门统管诸王，从大河到非利士地，直到埃及的边界。

chapters.en: The king made silver as common in Jerusalem as stones, and cedar as plentiful as sycamore-fig trees in the foothills.
chapters.zh: 王在耶路撒冷使银子多如石头，香柏木多如高原的桑树。

chapters.en: Solomon’s horses were imported from Egypt and from all other countries.
chapters.zh: 有人从埃及和各国为所罗门赶马群来。

chapters.en: As for the other events of Solomon’s reign, from beginning to end, are they not written in the records of Nathan the prophet, in the prophecy of Ahijah the Shilonite and in the visions of Iddo the seer concerning Jeroboam son of Nebat?
chapters.zh: 所罗门其余的事，自始至终，不都写在先知拿单的书上和示罗人亚希雅的预言书上，并先见易多论尼八儿子耶罗波安的默示书上吗？

chapters.en: Solomon reigned in Jerusalem over all Israel forty years.
chapters.zh: 所罗门在耶路撒冷作以色列众人的王共四十年。

chapters.en: Then he rested with his ancestors and was buried in the city of David his father. And Rehoboam his son succeeded him as king.
chapters.zh: 所罗门与他列祖同睡，葬在他父大卫城里。他儿子罗波安接续他作王。

chapters.en: Rehoboam went to Shechem, for all Israel had gone there to make him king.
chapters.zh: 罗波安往示剑去，因为以色列人都到了示剑，要立他作王。

chapters.en: When Jeroboam son of Nebat heard this (he was in Egypt, where he had fled from King Solomon), he returned from Egypt.
chapters.zh: 尼八的儿子耶罗波安先前躲避所罗门王，逃往埃及，住在那里。他听见这事，就从埃及回来。

chapters.en: So they sent for Jeroboam, and he and all Israel went to Rehoboam and said to him:
chapters.zh: 以色列人打发人去请他，他就和以色列众人来见罗波安，对他说，

chapters.en: “Your father put a heavy yoke on us, but now lighten the harsh labor and the heavy yoke he put on us, and we will serve you.”
chapters.zh: 你父亲使我们负重轭作苦工，现在求你使我们作的苦工负的重轭轻松些，我们就事奉你。

chapters.en: Rehoboam answered, “Come back to me in three days.” So the people went away.
chapters.zh: 罗波安对他们说，第三日再来见我吧。民就去了。

chapters.en: Then King Rehoboam consulted the elders who had served his father Solomon during his lifetime. “How would you advise me to answer these people?” he asked.
chapters.zh: 罗波安之父所罗门在世的日子，有侍立在他面前的老年人，罗波安王和他们商议，说，你们给我出个什么主意，我好回覆这民。

chapters.en: They replied, “If you will be kind to these people and please them and give them a favorable answer, they will always be your servants.”
chapters.zh: 老年人对他说，王若恩待这民，使他们喜悦，用好话回覆他们，他们就永远作王的仆人。

chapters.en: But Rehoboam rejected the advice the elders gave him and consulted the young men who had grown up with him and were serving him.
chapters.zh: 王却不用老年人给他出的主意，就和那些与他一同长大，在他面前侍立的少年人商议，

chapters.en: He asked them, “What is your advice? How should we answer these people who say to me, ‘Lighten the yoke your father put on us’?”
chapters.zh: 说，这民对我说，你父亲使我们负重轭，求你使我们轻松些。你们给我出个什么主意，我好回覆他们。

chapters.en: The young men who had grown up with him replied, “The people have said to you, ‘Your father put a heavy yoke on us, but make our yoke lighter.’ Now tell them, ‘My little finger is thicker than my father’s waist.
chapters.zh: 那同他长大的少年人说，这民对王说，你父亲使我们负重轭，求你使我们轻松些。王要对他们如此说，我的小拇指比我父亲的腰还粗。

chapters.en: My father laid on you a heavy yoke; I will make it even heavier. My father scourged you with whips; I will scourge you with scorpions.’ ”
chapters.zh: 我父亲使你们负重轭，我必使你们负更重的轭。我父亲用鞭子责打你们，我要用蝎子鞭责打你们。

chapters.en: Three days later Jeroboam and all the people returned to Rehoboam, as the king had said, “Come back to me in three days.”
chapters.zh: 耶罗波安和众百姓遵着罗波安王所说你们第三日再来见我的那话，第三日他们果然来了。

chapters.en: The king answered them harshly. Rejecting the advice of the elders,
chapters.zh: 罗波安王用严厉的话回覆他们，不用老年人所出的主意，

chapters.en: he followed the advice of the young men and said, “My father made your yoke heavy; I will make it even heavier. My father scourged you with whips; I will scourge you with scorpions.”
chapters.zh: 照着少年人所出的主意对他们说，我父亲使你们负重轭，我必使你们负更重的轭。我父亲用鞭子责打你们，我要用蝎子鞭责打你们。

chapters.en: So the king did not listen to the people, for this turn of events was from God, to fulfill the word the LORD had spoken to Jeroboam son of Nebat through Ahijah the Shilonite.
chapters.zh: 王不肯依从百姓。这事乃出于神，为要应验耶和华借示罗人亚希雅对尼八儿子耶罗波安所说的话。

chapters.en: When all Israel saw that the king refused to listen to them, they answered the king: “What share do we have in David, what part in Jesse’s son? To your tents, Israel! Look after your own house, David!” So all the Israelites went home.
chapters.zh: 以色列众民见王不依从他们，就对王说，我们与大卫有什么分儿呢？与耶西的儿子并没有关涉。以色列人哪，各回各家去吧。大卫家阿，自己顾自己吧。于是，以色列众人都回自己家里去了。

chapters.en: But as for the Israelites who were living in the towns of Judah, Rehoboam still ruled over them.
chapters.zh: 惟独住在犹大城邑的以色列人，罗波安仍作他们的王。

chapters.en: King Rehoboam sent out Adoniram, who was in charge of forced labor, but the Israelites stoned him to death. King Rehoboam, however, managed to get into his chariot and escape to Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 罗波安王差遣掌管服苦之人的哈多兰往以色列人那里去，以色列人就用石头打死他。罗波安王急忙上车，逃回耶路撒冷去了。

chapters.en: So Israel has been in rebellion against the house of David to this day.
chapters.zh: 这样，以色列人背叛大卫家，直到今日。

chapters.en: When Rehoboam arrived in Jerusalem, he mustered Judah and Benjamin—a hundred and eighty thousand able young men—to go to war against Israel and to regain the kingdom for Rehoboam.
chapters.zh: 罗波安来到耶路撒冷，招聚犹大家和便雅悯家，共十八万人，都是挑选的战士，要与以色列人争战，好将国夺回再归自己。

chapters.en: But this word of the LORD came to Shemaiah the man of God:
chapters.zh: 但耶和华的话临到神人示玛雅说，

chapters.en: “Say to Rehoboam son of Solomon king of Judah and to all Israel in Judah and Benjamin,
chapters.zh: 你去告诉所罗门的儿子犹大王罗波安和住犹大，便雅悯的以色列众人说，

chapters.en: ‘This is what the LORD says: Do not go up to fight against your fellow Israelites. Go home, every one of you, for this is my doing.’ ” So they obeyed the words of the LORD and turned back from marching against Jeroboam.
chapters.zh: 耶和华如此说，你们不可上去与你们的弟兄争战，各归各家去吧。因为这事出于我。众人就听从耶和华的话归回，不去与耶罗波安争战。

chapters.en: Rehoboam lived in Jerusalem and built up towns for defense in Judah:
chapters.zh: 罗波安住在耶路撒冷，在犹大地修筑城邑，

chapters.en: Bethlehem, Etam, Tekoa,
chapters.zh: 为保障修筑伯利恒，以坦，提哥亚，

chapters.en: Beth Zur, Soko, Adullam,
chapters.zh: 伯夙，梭哥，亚杜兰，

chapters.en: Gath, Mareshah, Ziph,
chapters.zh: 迦特，玛利沙，西弗，

chapters.en: Adoraim, Lachish, Azekah,
chapters.zh: 亚多莱音，拉吉，亚西加，

chapters.en: Zorah, Aijalon and Hebron. These were fortified cities in Judah and Benjamin.
chapters.zh: 琐拉，亚雅仑，希伯仑。这都是犹大和便雅悯的坚固城。

chapters.en: He strengthened their defenses and put commanders in them, with supplies of food, olive oil and wine.
chapters.zh: 罗波安又坚固各处的保障，在其中安置军长，又预备下粮食，油，酒。

chapters.en: He put shields and spears in all the cities, and made them very strong. So Judah and Benjamin were his.
chapters.zh: 他在各城里预备盾牌和枪，且使城极其坚固。犹大和便雅悯都归了他。

chapters.en: The priests and Levites from all their districts throughout Israel sided with him.
chapters.zh: 以色列全地的祭司和利未人都从四方来归罗波安。

chapters.en: The Levites even abandoned their pasturelands and property and came to Judah and Jerusalem, because Jeroboam and his sons had rejected them as priests of the LORD
chapters.zh: 利未人撇下他们的郊野和产业，来到犹大与耶路撒冷，是因耶罗波安和他的儿子拒绝他们，不许他们供祭司职分事奉耶和华。

chapters.en: when he appointed his own priests for the high places and for the goat and calf idols he had made.
chapters.zh: 耶罗波安为丘坛，为鬼魔（原文作公山羊），为自己所铸造的牛犊设立祭司。

chapters.en: Those from every tribe of Israel who set their hearts on seeking the LORD, the God of Israel, followed the Levites to Jerusalem to offer sacrifices to the LORD, the God of their ancestors.
chapters.zh: 以色列各支派中，凡立定心意寻求耶和华以色列神的，都随从利未人，来到耶路撒冷祭祀耶和华他们列祖的神。

chapters.en: They strengthened the kingdom of Judah and supported Rehoboam son of Solomon three years, following the ways of David and Solomon during this time.
chapters.zh: 这样，就坚固犹大国，使所罗门的儿子罗波安强盛三年，因为他们三年遵行大卫和所罗门的道。

chapters.en: Rehoboam married Mahalath, who was the daughter of David’s son Jerimoth and of Abihail, the daughter of Jesse’s son Eliab.
chapters.zh: 罗波安娶大卫儿子耶利摩的女儿玛哈拉为妻，又娶耶西儿子以利押的女儿亚比孩为妻。

chapters.en: She bore him sons: Jeush, Shemariah and Zaham.
chapters.zh: 从她生了几个儿子，就是耶乌施，示玛利雅，撒罕。

chapters.en: Then he married Maakah daughter of Absalom, who bore him Abijah, Attai, Ziza and Shelomith.
chapters.zh: 后来又娶押沙龙的女儿玛迦（十三章二节作乌列的女儿米该雅），从她生了亚比雅，亚太，细撒，示罗密。

chapters.en: Rehoboam loved Maakah daughter of Absalom more than any of his other wives and concubines. In all, he had eighteen wives and sixty concubines, twenty-eight sons and sixty daughters.
chapters.zh: 罗波安娶十八个妻，立六十个妾，生二十八个儿子，六十个女儿。他却爱押沙龙的女儿玛迦，比爱别的妻妾更甚。

chapters.en: Rehoboam appointed Abijah son of Maakah as crown prince among his brothers, in order to make him king.
chapters.zh: 罗波安立玛迦的儿子亚比雅作太子，在他弟兄中为首，因为想要立他接续作王。

chapters.en: He acted wisely, dispersing some of his sons throughout the districts of Judah and Benjamin, and to all the fortified cities. He gave them abundant provisions and took many wives for them.
chapters.zh: 罗波安办事精明，使他众子分散在犹大和便雅悯全地各坚固城里，又赐他们许多粮食，为他们多寻妻子。

chapters.en: After Rehoboam’s position as king was established and he had become strong, he and all Israel with him abandoned the law of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 罗波安的国坚立，他强盛的时候就离弃耶和华的律法，以色列人也都随从他。

chapters.en: Because they had been unfaithful to the LORD, Shishak king of Egypt attacked Jerusalem in the fifth year of King Rehoboam.
chapters.zh: 罗波安王第五年，埃及王示撒上来攻打耶路撒冷，因为王和民得罪了耶和华。

chapters.en: With twelve hundred chariots and sixty thousand horsemen and the innumerable troops of Libyans, Sukkites and Cushites that came with him from Egypt,
chapters.zh: 示撒带战车一千二百辆，马兵六万，并且跟从他出埃及的路比人，苏基人，和古实人，多得不可胜数。

chapters.en: he captured the fortified cities of Judah and came as far as Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 他攻取了犹大的坚固城，就来到耶路撒冷。

chapters.en: Then the prophet Shemaiah came to Rehoboam and to the leaders of Judah who had assembled in Jerusalem for fear of Shishak, and he said to them, “This is what the LORD says, ‘You have abandoned me; therefore, I now abandon you to Shishak.’ ”
chapters.zh: 那时，犹大的首领因为示撒就聚集在耶路撒冷。有先知示玛雅去见罗波安和众首领，对他们说，耶和华如此说，你们离弃了我，所以我使你们落在示撒手里。

chapters.en: The leaders of Israel and the king humbled themselves and said, “The LORD is just.”
chapters.zh: 于是王和以色列的众首领都自卑说，耶和华是公义的。

chapters.en: When the LORD saw that they humbled themselves, this word of the LORD came to Shemaiah: “Since they have humbled themselves, I will not destroy them but will soon give them deliverance. My wrath will not be poured out on Jerusalem through Shishak.
chapters.zh: 耶和华见他们自卑，耶和华的话就临到示玛雅说，他们既自卑，我必不灭绝他们。必使他们略得拯救，我不借着示撒的手将我的怒气倒在耶路撒冷。

chapters.en: They will, however, become subject to him, so that they may learn the difference between serving me and serving the kings of other lands.”
chapters.zh: 然而他们必作示撒的仆人，好叫他们知道，服事我与服事外邦人有何分别。

chapters.en: When Shishak king of Egypt attacked Jerusalem, he carried off the treasures of the temple of the LORD and the treasures of the royal palace. He took everything, including the gold shields Solomon had made.
chapters.zh: 于是，埃及王示撒上来攻取耶路撒冷，夺了耶和华殿和王宫里的宝物，尽都带走，又夺去所罗门制造的金盾牌。

chapters.en: So King Rehoboam made bronze shields to replace them and assigned these to the commanders of the guard on duty at the entrance to the royal palace.
chapters.zh: 罗波安王制造铜盾牌代替那金盾牌，交给守王宫门的护卫长看守。

chapters.en: Whenever the king went to the LORD’s temple, the guards went with him, bearing the shields, and afterward they returned them to the guardroom.
chapters.zh: 王每逢进耶和华的殿，护卫兵就拿这盾牌，随后仍将盾牌送回，放在护卫房。

chapters.en: Because Rehoboam humbled himself, the LORD’s anger turned from him, and he was not totally destroyed. Indeed, there was some good in Judah.
chapters.zh: 王自卑的时候，耶和华的怒气就转消了，不将他灭尽，并且在犹大中间也有善益的事。

chapters.en: King Rehoboam established himself firmly in Jerusalem and continued as king. He was forty-one years old when he became king, and he reigned seventeen years in Jerusalem, the city the LORD had chosen out of all the tribes of Israel in which to put his Name. His mother’s name was Naamah; she was an Ammonite.
chapters.zh: 罗波安王自强，在耶路撒冷作王。他登基的时候年四十一岁，在耶路撒冷，就是耶和华从以色列众支派中所选择立他名的城，作王十七年。罗波安的母亲名叫拿玛，是亚扪人。

chapters.en: He did evil because he had not set his heart on seeking the LORD.
chapters.zh: 罗波安行恶，因他不立定心意寻求耶和华。

chapters.en: As for the events of Rehoboam’s reign, from beginning to end, are they not written in the records of Shemaiah the prophet and of Iddo the seer that deal with genealogies? There was continual warfare between Rehoboam and Jeroboam.
chapters.zh: 罗波安所行的事，自始至终不都写在先知示玛雅和先见易多的史记上吗？罗波安与耶罗波安时常争战。

chapters.en: Rehoboam rested with his ancestors and was buried in the City of David. And Abijah his son succeeded him as king.
chapters.zh: 罗波安与他列祖同睡，葬在大卫城里。他儿子亚比雅接续他作王。

chapters.en: In the eighteenth year of the reign of Jeroboam, Abijah became king of Judah,
chapters.zh: 耶罗波安王十八年，亚比雅登基作犹大王，

chapters.en: and he reigned in Jerusalem three years. His mother’s name was Maakah, a daughter of Uriel of Gibeah. There was war between Abijah and Jeroboam.
chapters.zh: 在耶路撒冷作王三年。他母亲名叫米该亚（米该亚又作玛迦），是基比亚人乌列的女儿。亚比雅常与耶罗波安争战。

chapters.en: Abijah went into battle with an army of four hundred thousand able fighting men, and Jeroboam drew up a battle line against him with eight hundred thousand able troops.
chapters.zh: 有一次亚比雅率领挑选的兵四十万摆阵，都是勇敢的战士。耶罗波安也挑选大能的勇士八十万，对亚比雅摆阵。

chapters.en: Abijah stood on Mount Zemaraim, in the hill country of Ephraim, and said, “Jeroboam and all Israel, listen to me!
chapters.zh: 亚比雅站在以法莲山地中的洗玛脸山上，说，耶罗波安和以色列众人哪，要听我说。

chapters.en: Don’t you know that the LORD, the God of Israel, has given the kingship of Israel to David and his descendants forever by a covenant of salt?
chapters.zh: 耶和华以色列的神曾立盐约（盐即不废坏的意思），将以色列国永远赐给大卫和他的子孙，你们不知道吗？

chapters.en: Yet Jeroboam son of Nebat, an official of Solomon son of David, rebelled against his master.
chapters.zh: 无奈大卫儿子所罗门的臣仆，尼八儿子耶罗波安起来背叛他的主人。

chapters.en: Some worthless scoundrels gathered around him and opposed Rehoboam son of Solomon when he was young and indecisive and not strong enough to resist them.
chapters.zh: 有些无赖的匪徒聚集跟从他，逞强攻击所罗门的儿子罗波安。那时罗波安还幼弱，不能抵挡他们。

chapters.en: “And now you plan to resist the kingdom of the LORD, which is in the hands of David’s descendants. You are indeed a vast army and have with you the golden calves that Jeroboam made to be your gods.
chapters.zh: 现在你们有意抗拒大卫子孙手下所治耶和华的国，你们的人也甚多，你们那里又有耶罗波安为你们所造当作神的金牛犊。

chapters.en: But didn’t you drive out the priests of the LORD, the sons of Aaron, and the Levites, and make priests of your own as the peoples of other lands do? Whoever comes to consecrate himself with a young bull and seven rams may become a priest of what are not gods.
chapters.zh: 你们不是驱逐耶和华的祭司亚伦的后裔和利未人吗？不是照着外邦人的恶俗为自己立祭司吗？无论何人牵一只公牛犊，七只公绵羊将自己分别出来，就可作虚无之神的祭司。

chapters.en: “As for us, the LORD is our God, and we have not forsaken him. The priests who serve the LORD are sons of Aaron, and the Levites assist them.
chapters.zh: 至于我们，耶和华是我们的神，我们并没有离弃他。我们有事奉耶和华的祭司，都是亚伦的后裔，并有利未人各尽其职，

chapters.en: Every morning and evening they present burnt offerings and fragrant incense to the LORD. They set out the bread on the ceremonially clean table and light the lamps on the gold lampstand every evening. We are observing the requirements of the LORD our God. But you have forsaken him.
chapters.zh: 每日早晚向耶和华献燔祭，烧美香，又在精金的桌子上摆陈设饼。又有金灯台和灯盏，每晚点起，因为我们遵守耶和华我们神的命。惟有你们离弃了他。

chapters.en: God is with us; he is our leader. His priests with their trumpets will sound the battle cry against you. People of Israel, do not fight against the LORD, the God of your ancestors, for you will not succeed.”
chapters.zh: 率领我们的是神，我们这里也有神的祭司拿号向你们吹出大声。以色列人哪，不要与耶和华你们列祖的神争战，因你们必不能亨通。

chapters.en: Now Jeroboam had sent troops around to the rear, so that while he was in front of Judah the ambush was behind them.
chapters.zh: 耶罗波安却在犹大人的后头设伏兵。这样，以色列人在犹大人的前头，伏兵在犹大人的后头。

chapters.en: Judah turned and saw that they were being attacked at both front and rear. Then they cried out to the LORD. The priests blew their trumpets
chapters.zh: 犹大人回头观看，见前后都有敌兵，就呼求耶和华，祭司也吹号。

chapters.en: and the men of Judah raised the battle cry. At the sound of their battle cry, God routed Jeroboam and all Israel before Abijah and Judah.
chapters.zh: 于是犹大人呐喊。犹大人呐喊的时候，神就使耶罗波安和以色列众人败在亚比雅与犹大人面前。

chapters.en: The Israelites fled before Judah, and God delivered them into their hands.
chapters.zh: 以色列人在犹大人面前逃跑，神将他们交在犹大人手里。

chapters.en: Abijah and his troops inflicted heavy losses on them, so that there were five hundred thousand casualties among Israel’s able men.
chapters.zh: 亚比雅和他的军兵大大杀戮以色列人，以色列人仆倒死亡的精兵有五十万。

chapters.en: The Israelites were subdued on that occasion, and the people of Judah were victorious because they relied on the LORD, the God of their ancestors.
chapters.zh: 那时，以色列人被制伏了，犹大人得胜，是因倚靠耶和华他们列祖的神。

chapters.en: Abijah pursued Jeroboam and took from him the towns of Bethel, Jeshanah and Ephron, with their surrounding villages.
chapters.zh: 亚比雅追赶耶罗波安，攻取了他的几座城，就是伯特利和属伯特利的镇市，耶沙拿和属耶沙拿的镇市，以法拉音（或作以弗伦）和属以法拉音的镇市。

chapters.en: Jeroboam did not regain power during the time of Abijah. And the LORD struck him down and he died.
chapters.zh: 亚比雅在世的时候，耶罗波安不能再强盛。耶和华攻击他，他就死了。

chapters.en: But Abijah grew in strength. He married fourteen wives and had twenty-two sons and sixteen daughters.
chapters.zh: 亚比雅却渐渐强盛，娶妻妾十四个，生了二十二个儿子，十六个女儿。

chapters.en: The other events of Abijah’s reign, what he did and what he said, are written in the annotations of the prophet Iddo.
chapters.zh: 亚比雅其余的事和他的言行都写在先知易多的传上。

chapters.en: And Abijah rested with his ancestors and was buried in the City of David. Asa his son succeeded him as king, and in his days the country was at peace for ten years.
chapters.zh: 亚比雅与他列祖同睡，葬在大卫城里。他儿子亚撒接续他作王。亚撒年间，国中太平十年。

chapters.en: Asa did what was good and right in the eyes of the LORD his God.
chapters.zh: 亚撒行耶和华他神眼中看为善为正的事，

chapters.en: He removed the foreign altars and the high places, smashed the sacred stones and cut down the Asherah poles.
chapters.zh: 除掉外邦神的坛和丘坛，打碎柱像，砍下木偶，

chapters.en: He commanded Judah to seek the LORD, the God of their ancestors, and to obey his laws and commands.
chapters.zh: 吩咐犹大人寻求耶和华他们列祖的神，遵行他的律法，诫命。

chapters.en: He removed the high places and incense altars in every town in Judah, and the kingdom was at peace under him.
chapters.zh: 又在犹大各城邑除掉丘坛和日像，那时国享太平。

chapters.en: He built up the fortified cities of Judah, since the land was at peace. No one was at war with him during those years, for the LORD gave him rest.
chapters.zh: 又在犹大建造了几座坚固城。国中太平数年，没有战争，因为耶和华赐他平安。

chapters.en: “Let us build up these towns,” he said to Judah, “and put walls around them, with towers, gates and bars. The land is still ours, because we have sought the LORD our God; we sought him and he has given us rest on every side.” So they built and prospered.
chapters.zh: 他对犹大人说，我们要建造这些城邑，四围筑墙，盖楼，安门，作闩。地还属我们，是因寻求耶和华我们的神。我们既寻求他，他就赐我们四境平安。于是建造城邑，诸事亨通。

chapters.en: Asa had an army of three hundred thousand men from Judah, equipped with large shields and with spears, and two hundred and eighty thousand from Benjamin, armed with small shields and with bows. All these were brave fighting men.
chapters.zh: 亚撒的军兵，出自犹大拿盾牌拿枪的三十万人。出自便雅悯拿盾牌拉弓的二十八万人。这都是大能的勇士。

chapters.en: Zerah the Cushite marched out against them with an army of thousands upon thousands and three hundred chariots, and came as far as Mareshah.
chapters.zh: 有古实王谢拉率领军兵一百万，战车三百辆，出来攻击犹大人，到了玛利沙。

chapters.en: Asa went out to meet him, and they took up battle positions in the Valley of Zephathah near Mareshah.
chapters.zh: 于是亚撒出去与他迎敌，就在玛利沙的洗法谷彼此摆阵。

chapters.en: Then Asa called to the LORD his God and said, “LORD, there is no one like you to help the powerless against the mighty. Help us, LORD our God, for we rely on you, and in your name we have come against this vast army. LORD, you are our God; do not let mere mortals prevail against you.”
chapters.zh: 亚撒呼求耶和华他的神说，耶和华阿，惟有你能帮助软弱的，胜过强盛的。耶和华我们的神阿，求你帮助我们。因为我们仰赖你，奉你的名来攻击这大军。耶和华阿，你是我们的神，不要容人胜过你。

chapters.en: The LORD struck down the Cushites before Asa and Judah. The Cushites fled,
chapters.zh: 于是耶和华使古实人败在亚撒和犹大人面前，古实人就逃跑了。

chapters.en: and Asa and his army pursued them as far as Gerar. Such a great number of Cushites fell that they could not recover; they were crushed before the LORD and his forces. The men of Judah carried off a large amount of plunder.
chapters.zh: 亚撒和跟随他的军兵追赶他们，直到基拉耳。古实人被杀的甚多，不能再强盛，因为败在耶和华与他军兵面前。犹大人就夺了许多财物，

chapters.en: They destroyed all the villages around Gerar, for the terror of the LORD had fallen on them. They looted all these villages, since there was much plunder there.
chapters.zh: 又打破基拉耳四围的城邑。耶和华使其中的人都甚恐惧。犹大人又将所有的城掳掠一空，因其中的财物甚多，

chapters.en: They also attacked the camps of the herders and carried off droves of sheep and goats and camels. Then they returned to Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 又毁坏了群畜的圈，夺取许多的羊和骆驼，就回耶路撒冷去了。

chapters.en: The Spirit of God came on Azariah son of Oded.
chapters.zh: 神的灵感动俄德的儿子亚撒利雅。

chapters.en: He went out to meet Asa and said to him, “Listen to me, Asa and all Judah and Benjamin. The LORD is with you when you are with him. If you seek him, he will be found by you, but if you forsake him, he will forsake you.
chapters.zh: 他出来迎接亚撒，对他说，亚撒和犹大，便雅悯众人哪，要听我说，你们若顺从耶和华，耶和华必与你们同在。你们若寻求他，就必寻见。你们若离弃他，他必离弃你们。

chapters.en: For a long time Israel was without the true God, without a priest to teach and without the law.
chapters.zh: 以色列人不信真神，没有训诲的祭司，也没有律法，已经好久了。

chapters.en: But in their distress they turned to the LORD, the God of Israel, and sought him, and he was found by them.
chapters.zh: 但他们在急难的时候归向耶和华以色列的神，寻求他，他就被他们寻见。

chapters.en: In those days it was not safe to travel about, for all the inhabitants of the lands were in great turmoil.
chapters.zh: 那时，出入的人不得平安，列国的居民都遭大乱。

chapters.en: One nation was being crushed by another and one city by another, because God was troubling them with every kind of distress.
chapters.zh: 这国攻击那国，这城攻击那城，互相破坏，因为神用各样灾难扰乱他们。

chapters.en: But as for you, be strong and do not give up, for your work will be rewarded.”
chapters.zh: 现在你们要刚强，不要手软，因你们所行的必得赏赐。

chapters.en: When Asa heard these words and the prophecy of Azariah son of Oded the prophet, he took courage. He removed the detestable idols from the whole land of Judah and Benjamin and from the towns he had captured in the hills of Ephraim. He repaired the altar of the LORD that was in front of the portico of the LORD’s temple.
chapters.zh: 亚撒听见这话和俄德儿子先知亚撒利雅的预言，就壮起胆来，在犹大，便雅悯全地，并以法莲山地所夺的各城，将可憎之物尽都除掉，又在耶和华殿的廊前重新修筑耶和华的坛。

chapters.en: Then he assembled all Judah and Benjamin and the people from Ephraim, Manasseh and Simeon who had settled among them, for large numbers had come over to him from Israel when they saw that the LORD his God was with him.
chapters.zh: 又招聚犹大，便雅悯的众人，并他们中间寄居的以法莲人，玛拿西人，西缅人。有许多以色列人归降亚撒，因见耶和华他的神与他同在。

chapters.en: They assembled at Jerusalem in the third month of the fifteenth year of Asa’s reign.
chapters.zh: 亚撒十五年三月，他们都聚集在耶路撒冷。

chapters.en: At that time they sacrificed to the LORD seven hundred head of cattle and seven thousand sheep and goats from the plunder they had brought back.
chapters.zh: 当日他们从所取的掳物中，将牛七百只，羊七千只献给耶和华。

chapters.en: They entered into a covenant to seek the LORD, the God of their ancestors, with all their heart and soul.
chapters.zh: 他们就立约，要尽心尽性地寻求耶和华他们列祖的神。

chapters.en: All who would not seek the LORD, the God of Israel, were to be put to death, whether small or great, man or woman.
chapters.zh: 凡不寻求耶和华以色列神的，无论大小，男女，必被治死。

chapters.en: They took an oath to the LORD with loud acclamation, with shouting and with trumpets and horns.
chapters.zh: 他们就大声欢呼，吹号吹角，向耶和华起誓。

chapters.en: All Judah rejoiced about the oath because they had sworn it wholeheartedly. They sought God eagerly, and he was found by them. So the LORD gave them rest on every side.
chapters.zh: 犹大众人为所起的誓欢喜。因他们是尽心起誓，尽意寻求耶和华，耶和华就被他们寻见，且赐他们四境平安。

chapters.en: King Asa also deposed his grandmother Maakah from her position as queen mother, because she had made a repulsive image for the worship of Asherah. Asa cut it down, broke it up and burned it in the Kidron Valley.
chapters.zh: 亚撒王贬了他祖母玛迦太后的位，因她造了可憎的偶像亚舍拉。亚撒砍下她的偶像，捣得粉碎，烧在汲沦溪边。

chapters.en: Although he did not remove the high places from Israel, Asa’s heart was fully committed to the LORD all his life.
chapters.zh: 只是丘坛还没有从以色列中废去，然而亚撒的心一生诚实。

chapters.en: He brought into the temple of God the silver and gold and the articles that he and his father had dedicated.
chapters.zh: 亚撒将他父所分别为圣，与自己所分别为圣的金银和器皿都奉到神的殿里。

chapters.en: There was no more war until the thirty-fifth year of Asa’s reign.
chapters.zh: 从这时直到亚撒三十五年，都没有争战的事。

chapters.en: In the thirty-sixth year of Asa’s reign Baasha king of Israel went up against Judah and fortified Ramah to prevent anyone from leaving or entering the territory of Asa king of Judah.
chapters.zh: 亚撒三十六年，以色列王巴沙上来攻击犹大，修筑拉玛，不许人从犹大王亚撒那里出入。

chapters.en: Asa then took the silver and gold out of the treasuries of the LORD’s temple and of his own palace and sent it to Ben-Hadad king of Aram, who was ruling in Damascus.
chapters.zh: 于是亚撒从耶和华殿和王宫的府库里拿出金银来，送与住大马色的亚兰王便哈达，说，

chapters.en: “Let there be a treaty between me and you,” he said, “as there was between my father and your father. See, I am sending you silver and gold. Now break your treaty with Baasha king of Israel so he will withdraw from me.”
chapters.zh: 你父曾与我父立约，我与你也要立约。现在我将金银送给你，求你废掉你与以色列王巴沙所立的约，使他离开我。

chapters.en: Ben-Hadad agreed with King Asa and sent the commanders of his forces against the towns of Israel. They conquered Ijon, Dan, Abel Maim and all the store cities of Naphtali.
chapters.zh: 便哈达听从亚撒王的话，派军长去攻击以色列的城邑。他们就攻破以云，但，亚伯玛音，和拿弗他利一切的积货城。

chapters.en: When Baasha heard this, he stopped building Ramah and abandoned his work.
chapters.zh: 巴沙听见就停工，不修筑拉玛了。

chapters.en: Then King Asa brought all the men of Judah, and they carried away from Ramah the stones and timber Baasha had been using. With them he built up Geba and Mizpah.
chapters.zh: 于是亚撒王率领犹大众人，将巴沙修筑拉玛所用的石头，木头都运去，用以修筑迦巴和米斯巴。

chapters.en: At that time Hanani the seer came to Asa king of Judah and said to him: “Because you relied on the king of Aram and not on the LORD your God, the army of the king of Aram has escaped from your hand.
chapters.zh: 那时，先见哈拿尼来见犹大王亚撒，对他说，因你仰赖亚兰王，没有仰赖耶和华你的神，所以亚兰王的军兵脱离了你的手。

chapters.en: Were not the Cushites and Libyans a mighty army with great numbers of chariots and horsemen ? Yet when you relied on the LORD, he delivered them into your hand.
chapters.zh: 古实人，路比人的军队不是甚大吗？战车马兵不是极多吗？只因你仰赖耶和华，他便将他们交在你手里。

chapters.en: For the eyes of the LORD range throughout the earth to strengthen those whose hearts are fully committed to him. You have done a foolish thing, and from now on you will be at war.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华的眼目遍察全地，要显大能帮助向他心存诚实的人。你这事行得愚昧。此后，你必有争战的事。

chapters.en: Asa was angry with the seer because of this; he was so enraged that he put him in prison. At the same time Asa brutally oppressed some of the people.
chapters.zh: 亚撒因此恼恨先见，将他囚在监里。那时亚撒也虐待一些人民。

chapters.en: The events of Asa’s reign, from beginning to end, are written in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel.
chapters.zh: 亚撒所行的事，自始至终都写在犹大和以色列诸王记上。

chapters.en: In the thirty-ninth year of his reign Asa was afflicted with a disease in his feet. Though his disease was severe, even in his illness he did not seek help from the LORD, but only from the physicians.
chapters.zh: 亚撒作王三十九年，他脚上有病，而且甚重。病的时候没有求耶和华，只求医生。

chapters.en: Then in the forty-first year of his reign Asa died and rested with his ancestors.
chapters.zh: 他作王四十一年而死，与他列祖同睡，

chapters.en: They buried him in the tomb that he had cut out for himself in the City of David. They laid him on a bier covered with spices and various blended perfumes, and they made a huge fire in his honor.
chapters.zh: 葬在大卫城自己所凿的坟墓里，放在床上，其床堆满各样馨香的香料，就是按作香的作法调和的香料，又为他烧了许多的物件。

chapters.en: Jehoshaphat his son succeeded him as king and strengthened himself against Israel.
chapters.zh: 亚撒的儿子约沙法接续他作王，奋勇自强，防备以色列人，

chapters.en: He stationed troops in all the fortified cities of Judah and put garrisons in Judah and in the towns of Ephraim that his father Asa had captured.
chapters.zh: 安置军兵在犹大一切坚固城里，又安置防兵在犹大地和他父亚撒所得以法莲的城邑中。

chapters.en: The LORD was with Jehoshaphat because he followed the ways of his father David before him. He did not consult the Baals
chapters.zh: 耶和华与约沙法同在。因为他行他祖大卫初行的道，不寻求巴力，

chapters.en: but sought the God of his father and followed his commands rather than the practices of Israel.
chapters.zh: 只寻求他父亲的神，遵行他的诫命，不效法以色列人的行为。

chapters.en: The LORD established the kingdom under his control; and all Judah brought gifts to Jehoshaphat, so that he had great wealth and honor.
chapters.zh: 所以耶和华坚定他的国，犹大众人给他进贡。约沙法大有尊荣资财。

chapters.en: His heart was devoted to the ways of the LORD; furthermore, he removed the high places and the Asherah poles from Judah.
chapters.zh: 他高兴遵行耶和华的道，并且从犹大除掉一切丘坛和木偶。

chapters.en: In the third year of his reign he sent his officials Ben-Hail, Obadiah, Zechariah, Nethanel and Micaiah to teach in the towns of Judah.
chapters.zh: 他作王第三年，就差遣臣子便亥伊勒，俄巴底，撒迦利雅，拿坦业，米该亚往犹大各城去教训百姓。

chapters.en: With them were certain Levites—Shemaiah, Nethaniah, Zebadiah, Asahel, Shemiramoth, Jehonathan, Adonijah, Tobijah and Tob-Adonijah—and the priests Elishama and Jehoram.
chapters.zh: 同着他们有利未人示玛雅，尼探雅，西巴第雅，亚撒黑，示米拉末，约拿单，亚多尼雅，多比雅，驼巴多尼雅，又有祭司以利沙玛，约兰同着他们。

chapters.en: They taught throughout Judah, taking with them the Book of the Law of the LORD; they went around to all the towns of Judah and taught the people.
chapters.zh: 他们带着耶和华的律法书，走遍犹大各城教训百姓。

chapters.en: The fear of the LORD fell on all the kingdoms of the lands surrounding Judah, so that they did not go to war against Jehoshaphat.
chapters.zh: 耶和华使犹大四围的列国都甚恐惧，不敢与约沙法争战。

chapters.en: Some Philistines brought Jehoshaphat gifts and silver as tribute, and the Arabs brought him flocks: seven thousand seven hundred rams and seven thousand seven hundred goats.
chapters.zh: 有些非利士人与约沙法送礼物，纳贡银。亚拉伯人也送他公绵羊七千七百只，公山羊七千七百只。

chapters.en: Jehoshaphat became more and more powerful; he built forts and store cities in Judah
chapters.zh: 约沙法日渐强大，在犹大建造营寨和积货城。

chapters.en: and had large supplies in the towns of Judah. He also kept experienced fighting men in Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 他在犹大城邑中有许多工程，又在耶路撒冷有战士，就是大能的勇士。

chapters.en: Their enrollment by families was as follows: From Judah, commanders of units of 1,000: Adnah the commander, with 300,000 fighting men;
chapters.zh: 他们的数目，按着宗族，记在下面，犹大族的，千夫长押拿为首率领大能的勇士三十万。

chapters.en: next, Jehohanan the commander, with 280,000;
chapters.zh: 其次是，千夫长约哈难率领大能的勇士二十八万。

chapters.en: next, Amasiah son of Zikri, who volunteered himself for the service of the LORD, with 200,000.
chapters.zh: 其次是细基利的儿子亚玛斯雅，他为耶和华牺牲自己，率领大能的勇士二十万。

chapters.en: From Benjamin: Eliada, a valiant soldier, with 200,000 men armed with bows and shields;
chapters.zh: 便雅悯族，是大能的勇士以利雅大率领，拿弓箭和盾牌的二十万。

chapters.en: next, Jehozabad, with 180,000 men armed for battle.
chapters.zh: 其次是，约萨拔率领预备打仗的十八万。

chapters.en: These were the men who served the king, besides those he stationed in the fortified cities throughout Judah.
chapters.zh: 这都是伺候王的，还有王在犹大全地坚固城所安置的不在其内。

chapters.en: Now Jehoshaphat had great wealth and honor, and he allied himself with Ahab by marriage.
chapters.zh: 约沙法大有尊荣资财，就与亚哈结亲。

chapters.en: Some years later he went down to see Ahab in Samaria. Ahab slaughtered many sheep and cattle for him and the people with him and urged him to attack Ramoth Gilead.
chapters.zh: 过了几年，他下到撒玛利亚去见亚哈。亚哈为他和跟从他的人宰了许多牛羊，劝他与自己同去攻取基列的拉末。

chapters.en: Ahab king of Israel asked Jehoshaphat king of Judah, “Will you go with me against Ramoth Gilead?” Jehoshaphat replied, “I am as you are, and my people as your people; we will join you in the war.”
chapters.zh: 以色列王亚哈问犹大王约沙法说，你肯同我去攻取基列的拉末吗？他回答说，你我不分彼此，我的民与你的民一样，必与你同去争战。

chapters.en: But Jehoshaphat also said to the king of Israel, “First seek the counsel of the LORD.”
chapters.zh: 约沙法对以色列王说，请你先求问耶和华。
