chapters.en: So the king of Israel brought together the prophets—four hundred men—and asked them, “Shall we go to war against Ramoth Gilead, or shall I not?” “Go,” they answered, “for God will give it into the king’s hand.”
chapters.zh: 于是以色列王招聚先知四百人，问他们说，我们上去攻取基列的拉末可以不可以。他们说，可以上去，因为神必将那城交在王的手里。

chapters.en: But Jehoshaphat asked, “Is there no longer a prophet of the LORD here whom we can inquire of?”
chapters.zh: 约沙法说，这里不是还有耶和华的先知，我们可以求问他吗？

chapters.en: The king of Israel answered Jehoshaphat, “There is still one prophet through whom we can inquire of the LORD, but I hate him because he never prophesies anything good about me, but always bad. He is Micaiah son of Imlah.” “The king should not say such a thing,” Jehoshaphat replied.
chapters.zh: 以色列王对约沙法说，还有一个人，是音拉的儿子米该雅。我们可以托他求问耶和华，只是我恨他。因为他指着我所说的预言，不说吉语，常说凶言。约沙法说，王不必这样说。

chapters.en: So the king of Israel called one of his officials and said, “Bring Micaiah son of Imlah at once.”
chapters.zh: 以色列王就召了一个太监来，说，你快去将音拉的儿子米该雅召来。

chapters.en: Dressed in their royal robes, the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat king of Judah were sitting on their thrones at the threshing floor by the entrance of the gate of Samaria, with all the prophets prophesying before them.
chapters.zh: 以色列王和犹大王约沙法在撒玛利亚城门前的空场上，各穿朝服坐在位上，所有的先知都在他们面前说预言。

chapters.en: Now Zedekiah son of Kenaanah had made iron horns, and he declared, “This is what the LORD says: ‘With these you will gore the Arameans until they are destroyed.’ ”
chapters.zh: 基拿拿的儿子西底家造了两个铁角，说，耶和华如此说，你要用这角抵触亚兰人，直到将他们灭尽。

chapters.en: All the other prophets were prophesying the same thing. “Attack Ramoth Gilead and be victorious,” they said, “for the LORD will give it into the king’s hand.”
chapters.zh: 所有的先知也都这样预言说，可以上基列的拉末去，必然得胜，因为耶和华必将那城交在王的手中。

chapters.en: The messenger who had gone to summon Micaiah said to him, “Look, the other prophets without exception are predicting success for the king. Let your word agree with theirs, and speak favorably.”
chapters.zh: 那去召米该雅的使者对米该雅说，众先知一口同音地都向王说吉言，你不如与他们说一样的话，也说吉言。

chapters.en: But Micaiah said, “As surely as the LORD lives, I can tell him only what my God says.”
chapters.zh: 米该雅说，我指着永生的耶和华起誓，我的神说什么，我就说什么。

chapters.en: When he arrived, the king asked him, “Micaiah, shall we go to war against Ramoth Gilead, or shall I not?” “Attack and be victorious,” he answered, “for they will be given into your hand.”
chapters.zh: 米该雅到王面前，王问他说，米该雅阿，我们上去攻取基列的拉末可以不可以。他说，可以上去，必然得胜，敌人必交在你们手里。

chapters.en: The king said to him, “How many times must I make you swear to tell me nothing but the truth in the name of the LORD?”
chapters.zh: 王对他说，我当嘱咐你几次，你才奉耶和华的名向我说实话呢？

chapters.en: Then Micaiah answered, “I saw all Israel scattered on the hills like sheep without a shepherd, and the LORD said, ‘These people have no master. Let each one go home in peace.’ ”
chapters.zh: 米该雅说，我看见以色列众民散在山上，如同没有牧人的羊群一般。耶和华说，这民没有主人，他们可以平平安安地各归各家去。

chapters.en: The king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, “Didn’t I tell you that he never prophesies anything good about me, but only bad?”
chapters.zh: 以色列王对约沙法说，我岂没有告诉你，这人指着我所说的预言，不说吉语，单说凶言吗？

chapters.en: Micaiah continued, “Therefore hear the word of the LORD: I saw the LORD sitting on his throne with all the multitudes of heaven standing on his right and on his left.
chapters.zh: 米该雅说，你们要听耶和华的话。我看见耶和华坐在宝座上，天上的万军侍立在他左右。

chapters.en: And the LORD said, ‘Who will entice Ahab king of Israel into attacking Ramoth Gilead and going to his death there?’ “One suggested this, and another that.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说，谁去引诱以色列王亚哈上基列的拉末去阵亡呢？这个就这样说，那个就那样说。

chapters.en: Finally, a spirit came forward, stood before the LORD and said, ‘I will entice him.’ “ ‘By what means?’ the LORD asked.
chapters.zh: 随后，有一个神灵出来，站在耶和华面前说，我去引诱他。耶和华问他说，你用何法呢？

chapters.en: “ ‘I will go and be a deceiving spirit in the mouths of all his prophets,’ he said. “ ‘You will succeed in enticing him,’ said the LORD. ‘Go and do it.’
chapters.zh: 他说，我去，要在他众先知口中作谎言的灵。耶和华说，这样，你必能引诱他，你去如此行吧。

chapters.en: “So now the LORD has put a deceiving spirit in the mouths of these prophets of yours. The LORD has decreed disaster for you.”
chapters.zh: 现在耶和华使谎言的灵入了你这些先知的口，并且耶和华已经命定降祸与你。

chapters.en: Then Zedekiah son of Kenaanah went up and slapped Micaiah in the face. “Which way did the spirit from the LORD go when he went from me to speak to you?” he asked.
chapters.zh: 基拿拿的儿子西底家前来打米该雅的脸，说，耶和华的灵从哪里离开我与你说话呢？

chapters.en: Micaiah replied, “You will find out on the day you go to hide in an inner room.”
chapters.zh: 米该雅说，你进严密的屋子藏躲的那日，就必看见了。

chapters.en: The king of Israel then ordered, “Take Micaiah and send him back to Amon the ruler of the city and to Joash the king’s son,
chapters.zh: 以色列王说，将米该雅带回，交给邑宰亚们和王的儿子约阿施，说，

chapters.en: and say, ‘This is what the king says: Put this fellow in prison and give him nothing but bread and water until I return safely.’ ”
chapters.zh: 王如此说，把这个人下在监里，使他受苦，吃不饱喝不足，等候我平平安安地回来。

chapters.en: Micaiah declared, “If you ever return safely, the LORD has not spoken through me.” Then he added, “Mark my words, all you people!”
chapters.zh: 米该雅说，你若能平安回来，那就是耶和华没有借我说这话了。又说，众民哪，你们都要听。

chapters.en: So the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat king of Judah went up to Ramoth Gilead.
chapters.zh: 以色列王和犹大王约沙法上基列的拉末去了。

chapters.en: The king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, “I will enter the battle in disguise, but you wear your royal robes.” So the king of Israel disguised himself and went into battle.
chapters.zh: 以色列王对约沙法说，我要改装上阵，你可以仍穿王服。于是以色列王改装，他们就上阵去了。

chapters.en: Now the king of Aram had ordered his chariot commanders, “Do not fight with anyone, small or great, except the king of Israel.”
chapters.zh: 先是亚兰王吩咐车兵长说，他们的兵将，无论大小，你们都不可与他们争战，只要与以色列王争战。

chapters.en: When the chariot commanders saw Jehoshaphat, they thought, “This is the king of Israel.” So they turned to attack him, but Jehoshaphat cried out, and the LORD helped him. God drew them away from him,
chapters.zh: 车兵长看见约沙法便说，这必是以色列王，就转过去与他争战。约沙法一呼喊，耶和华就帮助他，神又感动他们离开他。

chapters.en: for when the chariot commanders saw that he was not the king of Israel, they stopped pursuing him.
chapters.zh: 车兵长见不是以色列王，就转去不追他了。

chapters.en: But someone drew his bow at random and hit the king of Israel between the breastplate and the scale armor. The king told the chariot driver, “Wheel around and get me out of the fighting. I’ve been wounded.”
chapters.zh: 有一人随便开弓，恰巧射入以色列王的甲缝里。王对赶车的说，我受了重伤，你转过车来，拉我出阵吧。

chapters.en: All day long the battle raged, and the king of Israel propped himself up in his chariot facing the Arameans until evening. Then at sunset he died.
chapters.zh: 那日阵势越战越猛，以色列王勉强站在车上抵挡亚兰人，直到晚上。约在日落的时候，王就死了。

chapters.en: When Jehoshaphat king of Judah returned safely to his palace in Jerusalem,
chapters.zh: 犹大王约沙法平平安安地回耶路撒冷，到宫里去了。

chapters.en: Jehu the seer, the son of Hanani, went out to meet him and said to the king, “Should you help the wicked and love those who hate the LORD? Because of this, the wrath of the LORD is on you.
chapters.zh: 先见哈拿尼的儿子耶户出来迎接约沙法王，对他说，你岂当帮助恶人，爱那恨恶耶和华的人呢？因此耶和华的忿怒临到你。

chapters.en: There is, however, some good in you, for you have rid the land of the Asherah poles and have set your heart on seeking God.”
chapters.zh: 然而你还有善行，因你从国中除掉木偶，立定心意寻求神。

chapters.en: Jehoshaphat lived in Jerusalem, and he went out again among the people from Beersheba to the hill country of Ephraim and turned them back to the LORD, the God of their ancestors.
chapters.zh: 约沙法住在耶路撒冷，以后又出巡民间，从别是巴直到以法莲山地，引导民归向耶和华他们列祖的神。

chapters.en: He appointed judges in the land, in each of the fortified cities of Judah.
chapters.zh: 又在犹大国中遍地的坚固城里设立审判官，

chapters.en: He told them, “Consider carefully what you do, because you are not judging for mere mortals but for the LORD, who is with you whenever you give a verdict.
chapters.zh: 对他们说，你们办事应当谨慎。因为你们判断不是为人，乃是为耶和华。判断的时候，他必与你们同在。

chapters.en: Now let the fear of the LORD be on you. Judge carefully, for with the LORD our God there is no injustice or partiality or bribery.”
chapters.zh: 现在你们应当敬畏耶和华，谨慎办事。因为耶和华我们的神没有不义，不偏待人，也不受贿赂。

chapters.en: In Jerusalem also, Jehoshaphat appointed some of the Levites, priests and heads of Israelite families to administer the law of the LORD and to settle disputes. And they lived in Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 约沙法从利未人和祭司，并以色列族长中派定人，在耶路撒冷为耶和华判断，听民间的争讼，就回耶路撒冷去了。

chapters.en: He gave them these orders: “You must serve faithfully and wholeheartedly in the fear of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 约沙法嘱咐他们说，你们当敬畏耶和华，忠心诚实办事。

chapters.en: In every case that comes before you from your people who live in the cities—whether bloodshed or other concerns of the law, commands, decrees or regulations—you are to warn them not to sin against the LORD; otherwise his wrath will come on you and your people. Do this, and you will not sin.
chapters.zh: 住在各城里你们的弟兄，若有争讼的事来到你们这里，或为流血，或犯律法，诫命，律例，典章，你们要警戒他们，免得他们得罪耶和华，以致他的忿怒临到你们和你们的弟兄。这样行，你们就没有罪了。

chapters.en: “Amariah the chief priest will be over you in any matter concerning the LORD, and Zebadiah son of Ishmael, the leader of the tribe of Judah, will be over you in any matter concerning the king, and the Levites will serve as officials before you. Act with courage, and may the LORD be with those who do well.”
chapters.zh: 凡属耶和华的事，有大祭司亚玛利雅管理你们。凡属王的事，有犹大支派的族长以实玛利的儿子西巴第雅管理你们。在你们面前有利未人作官长。你们应当壮胆办事，愿耶和华与善人同在。

chapters.en: After this, the Moabites and Ammonites with some of the Meunites came to wage war against Jehoshaphat.
chapters.zh: 此后，摩押人和亚扪人，又有米乌尼人，一同来攻击约沙法。

chapters.en: Some people came and told Jehoshaphat, “A vast army is coming against you from Edom, from the other side of the Dead Sea. It is already in Hazezon Tamar” (that is, En Gedi).
chapters.zh: 有人来报告约沙法说，从海外亚兰（亚兰又作以东）那边有大军来攻击你，如今他们在哈洗逊他玛，就是隐基底。

chapters.en: Alarmed, Jehoshaphat resolved to inquire of the LORD, and he proclaimed a fast for all Judah.
chapters.zh: 约沙法便惧怕，定意寻求耶和华，在犹大全地宣告禁食。

chapters.en: The people of Judah came together to seek help from the LORD; indeed, they came from every town in Judah to seek him.
chapters.zh: 于是犹大人聚会，求耶和华帮助。犹大各城都有人出来寻求耶和华。

chapters.en: Then Jehoshaphat stood up in the assembly of Judah and Jerusalem at the temple of the LORD in the front of the new courtyard
chapters.zh: 约沙法就在犹大和耶路撒冷的会中，站在耶和华殿的新院前，

chapters.en: and said: “LORD, the God of our ancestors, are you not the God who is in heaven? You rule over all the kingdoms of the nations. Power and might are in your hand, and no one can withstand you.
chapters.zh: 说，耶和华我们列祖的神阿，你不是天上的神吗？你不是万邦万国的主宰吗？在你手中有大能大力，无人能抵挡你。

chapters.en: Our God, did you not drive out the inhabitants of this land before your people Israel and give it forever to the descendants of Abraham your friend?
chapters.zh: 我们的神阿，你不是曾在你民以色列人面前驱逐这地的居民，将这地赐给你朋友亚伯拉罕的后裔永远为业吗？

chapters.en: They have lived in it and have built in it a sanctuary for your Name, saying,
chapters.zh: 他们住在这地，又为你的名建造圣所，说，

chapters.en: ‘If calamity comes upon us, whether the sword of judgment, or plague or famine, we will stand in your presence before this temple that bears your Name and will cry out to you in our distress, and you will hear us and save us.’
chapters.zh: 倘有祸患临到我们，或刀兵灾殃，或瘟疫饥荒，我们在急难的时候，站在这殿前向你呼求，你必垂听而拯救，因为你的名在这殿里。

chapters.en: “But now here are men from Ammon, Moab and Mount Seir, whose territory you would not allow Israel to invade when they came from Egypt; so they turned away from them and did not destroy them.
chapters.zh: 从前以色列人出埃及地的时候，你不容以色列人侵犯亚扪人，摩押人，和西珥山人，以色列人就离开他们，不灭绝他们。

chapters.en: See how they are repaying us by coming to drive us out of the possession you gave us as an inheritance.
chapters.zh: 看哪，他们怎样报复我们，要来驱逐我们出离你的地，就是你赐给我们为业之地。

chapters.en: Our God, will you not judge them? For we have no power to face this vast army that is attacking us. We do not know what to do, but our eyes are on you.”
chapters.zh: 我们的神阿，你不惩罚他们吗？因为我们无力抵挡这来攻击我们的大军，我们也不知道怎样行，我们的眼目单仰望你。

chapters.en: All the men of Judah, with their wives and children and little ones, stood there before the LORD.
chapters.zh: 犹大众人和他们的婴孩，妻子，儿女都站在耶和华面前。

chapters.en: Then the Spirit of the LORD came on Jahaziel son of Zechariah, the son of Benaiah, the son of Jeiel, the son of Mattaniah, a Levite and descendant of Asaph, as he stood in the assembly.
chapters.zh: 那时，耶和华的灵在会中临到利未人亚萨的后裔玛探雅的玄孙，耶利的曾孙，比拿雅的孙子，撒迦利雅的儿子雅哈悉。

chapters.en: He said: “Listen, King Jehoshaphat and all who live in Judah and Jerusalem! This is what the LORD says to you: ‘Do not be afraid or discouraged because of this vast army. For the battle is not yours, but God’s.
chapters.zh: 他说，犹大众人，耶路撒冷的居民，和约沙法王，你们请听。耶和华对你们如此说，不要因这大军恐惧惊惶。因为胜败不在乎你们，乃在乎神。

chapters.en: Tomorrow march down against them. They will be climbing up by the Pass of Ziz, and you will find them at the end of the gorge in the Desert of Jeruel.
chapters.zh: 明日你们要下去迎敌，他们是从洗斯坡上来，你们必在耶鲁伊勒旷野前的谷口遇见他们。

chapters.en: You will not have to fight this battle. Take up your positions; stand firm and see the deliverance the LORD will give you, Judah and Jerusalem. Do not be afraid; do not be discouraged. Go out to face them tomorrow, and the LORD will be with you.’ ”
chapters.zh: 犹大和耶路撒冷人哪，这次你们不要争战，要摆阵站着，看耶和华为你们施行拯救。不要恐惧，也不要惊惶。明日当出去迎敌，因为耶和华与你们同在。

chapters.en: Jehoshaphat bowed down with his face to the ground, and all the people of Judah and Jerusalem fell down in worship before the LORD.
chapters.zh: 约沙法就面伏于地，犹大众人和耶路撒冷的居民也俯伏在耶和华面前，叩拜耶和华。

chapters.en: Then some Levites from the Kohathites and Korahites stood up and praised the LORD, the God of Israel, with a very loud voice.
chapters.zh: 哥辖族和可拉族的利未人都起来，用极大的声音赞美耶和华以色列的神。

chapters.en: Early in the morning they left for the Desert of Tekoa. As they set out, Jehoshaphat stood and said, “Listen to me, Judah and people of Jerusalem! Have faith in the LORD your God and you will be upheld; have faith in his prophets and you will be successful.”
chapters.zh: 次日清早，众人起来往提哥亚的旷野去。出去的时候，约沙法站着说，犹大人和耶路撒冷的居民哪，要听我说，信耶和华你们的神就必立稳。信他的先知就必亨通。

chapters.en: After consulting the people, Jehoshaphat appointed men to sing to the LORD and to praise him for the splendor of his holiness as they went out at the head of the army, saying: “Give thanks to the LORD, for his love endures forever.”
chapters.zh: 约沙法既与民商议了，就设立歌唱的人，颂赞耶和华，使他们穿上圣洁的礼服，走在军前赞美耶和华说，当称谢耶和华，因他的慈爱永远长存。

chapters.en: As they began to sing and praise, the LORD set ambushes against the men of Ammon and Moab and Mount Seir who were invading Judah, and they were defeated.
chapters.zh: 众人方唱歌赞美的时候，耶和华就派伏兵击杀那来攻击犹大人的亚扪人，摩押人，和西珥山人，他们就被打败了。

chapters.en: The Ammonites and Moabites rose up against the men from Mount Seir to destroy and annihilate them. After they finished slaughtering the men from Seir, they helped to destroy one another.
chapters.zh: 因为亚扪人和摩押人起来，击杀住西珥山的人，将他们灭尽。灭尽住西珥山的人之后，他们又彼此自相击杀。

chapters.en: When the men of Judah came to the place that overlooks the desert and looked toward the vast army, they saw only dead bodies lying on the ground; no one had escaped.
chapters.zh: 犹大人来到旷野的望楼，向那大军观看，见尸横遍地，没有一个逃脱的。

chapters.en: So Jehoshaphat and his men went to carry off their plunder, and they found among them a great amount of equipment and clothing and also articles of value—more than they could take away. There was so much plunder that it took three days to collect it.
chapters.zh: 约沙法和他的百姓就来收取敌人的财物，在尸首中见了许多财物，珍宝，他们剥脱下来的多得不可携带。因为甚多，直收取了三日。

chapters.en: On the fourth day they assembled in the Valley of Berakah, where they praised the LORD. This is why it is called the Valley of Berakah to this day.
chapters.zh: 第四日众人聚集在比拉迦（就是称颂的意思）谷，在那里称颂耶和华。因此那地方名叫比拉迦谷，直到今日。

chapters.en: Then, led by Jehoshaphat, all the men of Judah and Jerusalem returned joyfully to Jerusalem, for the LORD had given them cause to rejoice over their enemies.
chapters.zh: 犹大人和耶路撒冷人都欢欢喜喜地回耶路撒冷，约沙法率领他们。因为耶和华使他们战胜仇敌，就欢喜快乐。

chapters.en: They entered Jerusalem and went to the temple of the LORD with harps and lyres and trumpets.
chapters.zh: 他们弹琴，鼓瑟，吹号来到耶路撒冷，进了耶和华的殿。

chapters.en: The fear of God came on all the surrounding kingdoms when they heard how the LORD had fought against the enemies of Israel.
chapters.zh: 列邦诸国听见耶和华战败以色列的仇敌，就甚惧怕。

chapters.en: And the kingdom of Jehoshaphat was at peace, for his God had given him rest on every side.
chapters.zh: 这样，约沙法的国得享太平，因为神赐他四境平安。

chapters.en: So Jehoshaphat reigned over Judah. He was thirty-five years old when he became king of Judah, and he reigned in Jerusalem twenty-five years. His mother’s name was Azubah daughter of Shilhi.
chapters.zh: 约沙法作犹大王，登基的时候年三十五岁，在耶路撒冷作王二十五年。他母亲名叫阿苏巴，乃示利希的女儿。

chapters.en: He followed the ways of his father Asa and did not stray from them; he did what was right in the eyes of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 约沙法效法他父亚撒所行的，不偏左右，行耶和华眼中看为正的事。

chapters.en: The high places, however, were not removed, and the people still had not set their hearts on the God of their ancestors.
chapters.zh: 只是丘坛还没有废去，百姓也没有立定心意归向他们列祖的神。

chapters.en: The other events of Jehoshaphat’s reign, from beginning to end, are written in the annals of Jehu son of Hanani, which are recorded in the book of the kings of Israel.
chapters.zh: 约沙法其余的事，自始至终都写在哈拿尼的儿子耶户的书上，也载入以色列诸王记上。

chapters.en: Later, Jehoshaphat king of Judah made an alliance with Ahaziah king of Israel, whose ways were wicked.
chapters.zh: 此后，犹大王约沙法与以色列王亚哈谢交好。亚哈谢行恶太甚。

chapters.en: He agreed with him to construct a fleet of trading ships. After these were built at Ezion Geber,
chapters.zh: 二王合伙造船要往他施去，遂在以旬迦别造船。

chapters.en: Eliezer son of Dodavahu of Mareshah prophesied against Jehoshaphat, saying, “Because you have made an alliance with Ahaziah, the LORD will destroy what you have made.” The ships were wrecked and were not able to set sail to trade.
chapters.zh: 那时玛利沙人，多大瓦的儿子以利以谢向约沙法预言说，因你与亚哈谢交好，耶和华必破坏你所造的。后来那船果然破坏，不能往他施去了。

chapters.en: Then Jehoshaphat rested with his ancestors and was buried with them in the City of David. And Jehoram his son succeeded him as king.
chapters.zh: 约沙法与他列祖同睡，葬在大卫城他列祖的坟地里。他儿子约兰接续他作王。

chapters.en: Jehoram’s brothers, the sons of Jehoshaphat, were Azariah, Jehiel, Zechariah, Azariahu, Michael and Shephatiah. All these were sons of Jehoshaphat king of Israel.
chapters.zh: 约兰有几个兄弟，就是约沙法的儿子亚撒利雅，耶歇，撒迦利雅，亚撒利雅，米迦勒，示法提雅。这都是犹大王约沙法的儿子。

chapters.en: Their father had given them many gifts of silver and gold and articles of value, as well as fortified cities in Judah, but he had given the kingdom to Jehoram because he was his firstborn son.
chapters.zh: 他们的父亲将许多金银，财宝，和犹大地的坚固城赐给他们。但将国赐给约兰，因为他是长子。

chapters.en: When Jehoram established himself firmly over his father’s kingdom, he put all his brothers to the sword along with some of the officials of Israel.
chapters.zh: 约兰兴起坐他父的位，奋勇自强，就用刀杀了他的众兄弟和以色列的几个首领。

chapters.en: Jehoram was thirty-two years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem eight years.
chapters.zh: 约兰登基的时候年三十二岁，在耶路撒冷作王八年。

chapters.en: He followed the ways of the kings of Israel, as the house of Ahab had done, for he married a daughter of Ahab. He did evil in the eyes of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 他行以色列诸王的道，与亚哈家一样。因他娶了亚哈的女儿为妻，行耶和华眼中看为恶的事。

chapters.en: Nevertheless, because of the covenant the LORD had made with David, the LORD was not willing to destroy the house of David. He had promised to maintain a lamp for him and his descendants forever.
chapters.zh: 耶和华却因自己与大卫所立的约，不肯灭大卫的家，照他所应许的，永远赐灯光与大卫和他的子孙。

chapters.en: In the time of Jehoram, Edom rebelled against Judah and set up its own king.
chapters.zh: 约兰年间，以东人背叛犹大，脱离他的权下，自己立王。

chapters.en: So Jehoram went there with his officers and all his chariots. The Edomites surrounded him and his chariot commanders, but he rose up and broke through by night.
chapters.zh: 约兰就率领军长和所有的战车，夜间起来，攻击围困他的以东人和车兵长。

chapters.en: To this day Edom has been in rebellion against Judah. Libnah revolted at the same time, because Jehoram had forsaken the LORD, the God of his ancestors.
chapters.zh: 这样，以东人背叛犹大，脱离他的权下，直到今日。那时，立拿人也背叛了，因为约兰离弃耶和华他列祖的神。

chapters.en: He had also built high places on the hills of Judah and had caused the people of Jerusalem to prostitute themselves and had led Judah astray.
chapters.zh: 他又在犹大诸山建筑丘坛，使耶路撒冷的居民行邪淫，诱惑犹大人。

chapters.en: Jehoram received a letter from Elijah the prophet, which said: “This is what the LORD, the God of your father David, says: ‘You have not followed the ways of your father Jehoshaphat or of Asa king of Judah.
chapters.zh: 先知以利亚达信与约兰说，耶和华你祖大卫的神如此说，因为你不行你父约沙法和犹大王亚撒的道，

chapters.en: But you have followed the ways of the kings of Israel, and you have led Judah and the people of Jerusalem to prostitute themselves, just as the house of Ahab did. You have also murdered your own brothers, members of your own family, men who were better than you.
chapters.zh: 乃行以色列诸王的道，使犹大人和耶路撒冷的居民行邪淫，像亚哈家一样，又杀了你父家比你好的诸兄弟。

chapters.en: So now the LORD is about to strike your people, your sons, your wives and everything that is yours, with a heavy blow.
chapters.zh: 故此，耶和华降大灾与你的百姓和你的妻子，儿女，并你一切所有的。

chapters.en: You yourself will be very ill with a lingering disease of the bowels, until the disease causes your bowels to come out.’ ”
chapters.zh: 你的肠子必患病，日加沉重，以致你的肠子坠落下来。

chapters.en: The LORD aroused against Jehoram the hostility of the Philistines and of the Arabs who lived near the Cushites.
chapters.zh: 以后，耶和华激动非利士人和靠近古实的亚拉伯人来攻击约兰。

chapters.en: They attacked Judah, invaded it and carried off all the goods found in the king’s palace, together with his sons and wives. Not a son was left to him except Ahaziah, the youngest.
chapters.zh: 他们上来攻击犹大，侵入境内，掳掠了王宫里所有的财货和他的妻子，儿女，除了他小儿子约哈斯（又名亚哈谢）之外，没有留下一个儿子。

chapters.en: After all this, the LORD afflicted Jehoram with an incurable disease of the bowels.
chapters.zh: 这些事以后，耶和华使约兰的肠子患不能医治的病。

chapters.en: In the course of time, at the end of the second year, his bowels came out because of the disease, and he died in great pain. His people made no funeral fire in his honor, as they had for his predecessors.
chapters.zh: 他患此病缠绵日久，过了二年，肠子坠落下来，病重而死。他的民没有为他烧什么物件，像从前为他列祖所烧的一样。

chapters.en: Jehoram was thirty-two years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem eight years. He passed away, to no one’s regret, and was buried in the City of David, but not in the tombs of the kings.
chapters.zh: 约兰登基的时候年三十二岁，在耶路撒冷作王八年。他去世无人思慕，众人葬他在大卫城，只是不在列王的坟墓里。

chapters.en: The people of Jerusalem made Ahaziah, Jehoram’s youngest son, king in his place, since the raiders, who came with the Arabs into the camp, had killed all the older sons. So Ahaziah son of Jehoram king of Judah began to reign.
chapters.zh: 耶路撒冷的居民立约兰的小儿子亚哈谢接续他作王。因为跟随亚拉伯人来攻营的军兵曾杀了亚哈谢的众兄长。这样，犹大王约兰的儿子亚哈谢作了王。

chapters.en: Ahaziah was twenty-two years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem one year. His mother’s name was Athaliah, a granddaughter of Omri.
chapters.zh: 亚哈谢登基的时候年四十二岁（列王下八章二十六节作二十二岁），在耶路撒冷作王一年。他母亲名叫亚他利雅，是暗利的孙女。

chapters.en: He too followed the ways of the house of Ahab, for his mother encouraged him to act wickedly.
chapters.zh: 亚哈谢也行亚哈家的道。因为他母亲给他主谋，使他行恶。

chapters.en: He did evil in the eyes of the LORD, as the house of Ahab had done, for after his father’s death they became his advisers, to his undoing.
chapters.zh: 他行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，像亚哈家一样。因他父亲死后有亚哈家的人给他主谋，以致败坏。

chapters.en: He also followed their counsel when he went with Joram son of Ahab king of Israel to wage war against Hazael king of Aram at Ramoth Gilead. The Arameans wounded Joram;
chapters.zh: 他听从亚哈家的计谋，同以色列王亚哈的儿子约兰往基列的拉末去，与亚兰王哈薛争战。亚兰人打伤了约兰。

chapters.en: so he returned to Jezreel to recover from the wounds they had inflicted on him at Ramoth in his battle with Hazael king of Aram. Then Ahaziah son of Jehoram king of Judah went down to Jezreel to see Joram son of Ahab because he had been wounded.
chapters.zh: 约兰回到耶斯列，医治在拉末与亚兰王哈薛打仗所受的伤，犹大王约兰的儿子亚撒利雅（即亚哈谢）因为亚哈的儿子约兰病了，就下到耶斯列看望他。

chapters.en: Through Ahaziah’s visit to Joram, God brought about Ahaziah’s downfall. When Ahaziah arrived, he went out with Joram to meet Jehu son of Nimshi, whom the LORD had anointed to destroy the house of Ahab.
chapters.zh: 亚哈谢去见约兰就被害了，这是出乎神。因为他到了，就同约兰出去攻击宁示的孙子耶户。这耶户是耶和华所膏，使他剪除亚哈家的。

chapters.en: While Jehu was executing judgment on the house of Ahab, he found the officials of Judah and the sons of Ahaziah’s relatives, who had been attending Ahaziah, and he killed them.
chapters.zh: 耶户讨亚哈家罪的时候，遇见犹大的众首领和亚哈谢的众侄子服事亚哈谢，就把他们都杀了。

chapters.en: He then went in search of Ahaziah, and his men captured him while he was hiding in Samaria. He was brought to Jehu and put to death. They buried him, for they said, “He was a son of Jehoshaphat, who sought the LORD with all his heart.” So there was no one in the house of Ahaziah powerful enough to retain the kingdom.
chapters.zh: 亚哈谢藏在撒玛利亚，耶户寻找他，众人将他拿住，送到耶户那里，就杀了他，将他葬埋。因他们说，他是那尽心寻求耶和华之约沙法的儿子。这样，亚哈谢的家无力保守国权。

chapters.en: When Athaliah the mother of Ahaziah saw that her son was dead, she proceeded to destroy the whole royal family of the house of Judah.
chapters.zh: 亚哈谢的母亲亚他利雅见她儿子死了，就起来剿灭犹大王室。

chapters.en: But Jehosheba, the daughter of King Jehoram, took Joash son of Ahaziah and stole him away from among the royal princes who were about to be murdered and put him and his nurse in a bedroom. Because Jehosheba, the daughter of King Jehoram and wife of the priest Jehoiada, was Ahaziah’s sister, she hid the child from Athaliah so she could not kill him.
chapters.zh: 但王的女儿约示巴将亚哈谢的儿子约阿施从那被杀的王子中偷出来，把他和他的乳母都藏在卧房里。约示巴是约兰王的女儿，亚哈谢的妹子，祭司耶何耶大的妻。她收藏约阿施，躲避亚他利雅，免得被杀。

chapters.en: He remained hidden with them at the temple of God for six years while Athaliah ruled the land.
chapters.zh: 约阿施和她们一同藏在神殿里六年。亚他利雅篡了国位。

chapters.en: In the seventh year Jehoiada showed his strength. He made a covenant with the commanders of units of a hundred: Azariah son of Jeroham, Ishmael son of Jehohanan, Azariah son of Obed, Maaseiah son of Adaiah, and Elishaphat son of Zikri.
chapters.zh: 第七年，耶何耶大奋勇自强，将百夫长耶罗罕的儿子亚撒利雅，约哈难的儿子以实玛利，俄备得的儿子亚撒利雅，亚大雅的儿子玛西雅，细基利的儿子以利沙法召来，与他们立约。

chapters.en: They went throughout Judah and gathered the Levites and the heads of Israelite families from all the towns. When they came to Jerusalem,
chapters.zh: 他们走遍犹大，从犹大各城里招聚利未人和以色列的众族长到耶路撒冷来。

chapters.en: the whole assembly made a covenant with the king at the temple of God. Jehoiada said to them, “The king’s son shall reign, as the LORD promised concerning the descendants of David.
chapters.zh: 会众在神殿里与王立约。耶何耶大对他们说，看哪，王的儿子必当作王，正如耶和华指着大卫子孙所应许的话。

chapters.en: Now this is what you are to do: A third of you priests and Levites who are going on duty on the Sabbath are to keep watch at the doors,
chapters.zh: 又说，你们当这样行，祭司和利未人凡安息日进班的，三分之一要把守各门，

chapters.en: a third of you at the royal palace and a third at the Foundation Gate, and all the others are to be in the courtyards of the temple of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 三分之一要在王宫，三分之一要在基址门。众百姓要在耶和华殿的院内。

chapters.en: No one is to enter the temple of the LORD except the priests and Levites on duty; they may enter because they are consecrated, but all the others are to observe the LORD’s command not to enter.
chapters.zh: 除了祭司和供职的利未人之外，不准别人进耶和华的殿。惟独他们可以进去，因为他们圣洁。众百姓要遵守耶和华所吩咐的。

chapters.en: The Levites are to station themselves around the king, each with weapon in hand. Anyone who enters the temple is to be put to death. Stay close to the king wherever he goes.”
chapters.zh: 利未人要手中各拿兵器，四围护卫王。凡擅入殿宇的，必当治死。王出入的时候，你们当跟随他。

chapters.en: The Levites and all the men of Judah did just as Jehoiada the priest ordered. Each one took his men—those who were going on duty on the Sabbath and those who were going off duty—for Jehoiada the priest had not released any of the divisions.
chapters.zh: 利未人和犹大众人都照着祭司耶何耶大一切所吩咐的去行，各带所管安息日进班出班的人来，因为祭司耶何耶大不许他们下班。

chapters.en: Then he gave the commanders of units of a hundred the spears and the large and small shields that had belonged to King David and that were in the temple of God.
chapters.zh: 祭司耶何耶大便将神殿里所藏大卫王的枪，盾牌，挡牌交给百夫长，

chapters.en: He stationed all the men, each with his weapon in his hand, around the king—near the altar and the temple, from the south side to the north side of the temple.
chapters.zh: 又分派众民手中各拿兵器，在坛和殿那里，从殿右直到殿左，站在王子的四围。

chapters.en: Jehoiada and his sons brought out the king’s son and put the crown on him; they presented him with a copy of the covenant and proclaimed him king. They anointed him and shouted, “Long live the king!”
chapters.zh: 于是领王子出来，给他戴上冠冕，将律法书交给他，立他作王。耶何耶大和众子膏他，众人说，愿王万岁。

chapters.en: When Athaliah heard the noise of the people running and cheering the king, she went to them at the temple of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 亚他利雅听见民奔走赞美王的声音，就到民那里，进耶和华的殿，

chapters.en: She looked, and there was the king, standing by his pillar at the entrance. The officers and the trumpeters were beside the king, and all the people of the land were rejoicing and blowing trumpets, and musicians with their instruments were leading the praises. Then Athaliah tore her robes and shouted, “Treason! Treason!”
chapters.zh: 看见王站在殿门的柱旁，百夫长和吹号的人侍立在王左右，国民都欢乐吹号，又有歌唱的，用各样的乐器领人歌唱赞美。亚他利雅就撕裂衣服，喊叫说，反了。反了。

chapters.en: Jehoiada the priest sent out the commanders of units of a hundred, who were in charge of the troops, and said to them: “Bring her out between the ranks and put to the sword anyone who follows her.” For the priest had said, “Do not put her to death at the temple of the LORD.”
chapters.zh: 祭司耶何耶大带管辖军兵的百夫长出来，吩咐他们说，将她赶到班外，凡跟随她的必用刀杀死。因为祭司说，不可在耶和华殿里杀她。

chapters.en: So they seized her as she reached the entrance of the Horse Gate on the palace grounds, and there they put her to death.
chapters.zh: 众兵就闪开，让她去。她走到王宫的马门，便在那里把她杀了。

chapters.en: Jehoiada then made a covenant that he, the people and the king would be the LORD’s people.
chapters.zh: 耶何耶大与众民和王立约，都要作耶和华的民。

chapters.en: All the people went to the temple of Baal and tore it down. They smashed the altars and idols and killed Mattan the priest of Baal in front of the altars.
chapters.zh: 于是众民都到巴力庙，拆毁了庙，打碎坛和像，又在坛前将巴力的祭司玛坦杀了。

chapters.en: Then Jehoiada placed the oversight of the temple of the LORD in the hands of the Levitical priests, to whom David had made assignments in the temple, to present the burnt offerings of the LORD as written in the Law of Moses, with rejoicing and singing, as David had ordered.
chapters.zh: 耶何耶大派官看守耶和华的殿，是在祭司利未人手下。这祭司利未人是大卫分派在耶和华殿中，照摩西律法上所写的，给耶和华献燔祭，又按大卫所定的例，欢乐歌唱。

chapters.en: He also stationed gatekeepers at the gates of the LORD’s temple so that no one who was in any way unclean might enter.
chapters.zh: 且设立守门的把守耶和华殿的各门，无论为何事，不洁净的人都不准进去。

chapters.en: He took with him the commanders of hundreds, the nobles, the rulers of the people and all the people of the land and brought the king down from the temple of the LORD. They went into the palace through the Upper Gate and seated the king on the royal throne.
chapters.zh: 又率领百夫长和贵胄，与民间的官长，并国中的众民，请王从耶和华殿下来，由上门进入王宫，立王坐在国位上。

chapters.en: All the people of the land rejoiced, and the city was calm, because Athaliah had been slain with the sword.
chapters.zh: 国民都欢乐，合城都安静。众人已将亚他利雅用刀杀了。

chapters.en: Joash was seven years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem forty years. His mother’s name was Zibiah; she was from Beersheba.
chapters.zh: 约阿施登基的时候年七岁，在耶路撒冷作王四十年。他母亲名叫西比亚，是别是巴人。

chapters.en: Joash did what was right in the eyes of the LORD all the years of Jehoiada the priest.
chapters.zh: 祭司耶何耶大在世的时候，约阿施行耶和华眼中看为正的事。

chapters.en: Jehoiada chose two wives for him, and he had sons and daughters.
chapters.zh: 耶何耶大为他娶了两个妻，并且生儿养女。

chapters.en: Some time later Joash decided to restore the temple of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 此后，约阿施有意重修耶和华的殿，

chapters.en: He called together the priests and Levites and said to them, “Go to the towns of Judah and collect the money due annually from all Israel, to repair the temple of your God. Do it now.” But the Levites did not act at once.
chapters.zh: 便召聚众祭司和利未人，吩咐他们说，你们要往犹大各城去，使以色列众人捐纳银子，每年可以修理你们神的殿。你们要急速办理这事。只是利未人不急速办理。

chapters.en: Therefore the king summoned Jehoiada the chief priest and said to him, “Why haven’t you required the Levites to bring in from Judah and Jerusalem the tax imposed by Moses the servant of the LORD and by the assembly of Israel for the tent of the covenant law?”
chapters.zh: 王召了大祭司耶何耶大来，对他说，从前耶和华的仆人摩西，为法柜的帐幕与以色列会众所定的捐项，你为何不叫利未人照这例从犹大和耶路撒冷带来作殿的费用呢？

chapters.en: Now the sons of that wicked woman Athaliah had broken into the temple of God and had used even its sacred objects for the Baals.
chapters.zh: 因为那恶妇亚他利雅的众子曾拆毁神的殿，又用耶和华殿中分别为圣的物供奉巴力。

chapters.en: At the king’s command, a chest was made and placed outside, at the gate of the temple of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 于是王下令，众人作了一柜，放在耶和华殿的门外，

chapters.en: A proclamation was then issued in Judah and Jerusalem that they should bring to the LORD the tax that Moses the servant of God had required of Israel in the wilderness.
chapters.zh: 又通告犹大和耶路撒冷的百姓，要将神仆人摩西在旷野所吩咐以色列人的捐项给耶和华送来。

chapters.en: All the officials and all the people brought their contributions gladly, dropping them into the chest until it was full.
chapters.zh: 众首领和百姓都欢欢喜喜地将银子送来，投入柜中，直到捐完。

chapters.en: Whenever the chest was brought in by the Levites to the king’s officials and they saw that there was a large amount of money, the royal secretary and the officer of the chief priest would come and empty the chest and carry it back to its place. They did this regularly and collected a great amount of money.
chapters.zh: 利未人见银子多了，就把柜抬到王所派的司事面前。王的书记和大祭司的属员来将柜倒空，仍放在原处。日日都是这样，积蓄的银子甚多。

chapters.en: The king and Jehoiada gave it to those who carried out the work required for the temple of the LORD. They hired masons and carpenters to restore the LORD’s temple, and also workers in iron and bronze to repair the temple.
chapters.zh: 王与耶何耶大将银子交给耶和华殿里办事的人，他们就雇了石匠，木匠重修耶和华的殿，又雇了铁匠，铜匠修理耶和华的殿。

chapters.en: The men in charge of the work were diligent, and the repairs progressed under them. They rebuilt the temple of God according to its original design and reinforced it.
chapters.zh: 工人操作，渐渐修成，将神殿修造得与从前一样，而且甚是坚固。

chapters.en: When they had finished, they brought the rest of the money to the king and Jehoiada, and with it were made articles for the LORD’s temple: articles for the service and for the burnt offerings, and also dishes and other objects of gold and silver. As long as Jehoiada lived, burnt offerings were presented continually in the temple of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 工程完了，他们就把其余的银子拿到王与耶何耶大面前，用以制造耶和华殿供奉所用的器皿和调羹，并金银的器皿。耶何耶大在世的时候，众人常在耶和华殿里献燔祭。

chapters.en: Now Jehoiada was old and full of years, and he died at the age of a hundred and thirty.
chapters.zh: 耶何耶大年纪老迈，日子满足而死。死的时候年一百三十岁，

chapters.en: He was buried with the kings in the City of David, because of the good he had done in Israel for God and his temple.
chapters.zh: 葬在大卫城列王的坟墓里。因为他在以色列人中行善，又事奉神，修理神的殿。

chapters.en: After the death of Jehoiada, the officials of Judah came and paid homage to the king, and he listened to them.
chapters.zh: 耶何耶大死后，犹大的众首领来朝拜王。王就听从他们。

chapters.en: They abandoned the temple of the LORD, the God of their ancestors, and worshiped Asherah poles and idols. Because of their guilt, God’s anger came on Judah and Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 他们离弃耶和华他们列祖神的殿，去事奉亚舍拉和偶像。因他们这罪，就有忿怒临到犹大和耶路撒冷。

chapters.en: Although the LORD sent prophets to the people to bring them back to him, and though they testified against them, they would not listen.
chapters.zh: 但神仍遣先知到他们那里，引导他们归向耶和华。这先知警戒他们，他们却不肯听。

chapters.en: Then the Spirit of God came on Zechariah son of Jehoiada the priest. He stood before the people and said, “This is what God says: ‘Why do you disobey the LORD’s commands? You will not prosper. Because you have forsaken the LORD, he has forsaken you.’ ”
chapters.zh: 那时，神的灵感动祭司耶何耶大的儿子撒迦利亚，他就站在上面对民说，神如此说，你们为何干犯耶和华的诫命，以致不得亨通呢？因为你们离弃耶和华，所以他也离弃你们。

chapters.en: But they plotted against him, and by order of the king they stoned him to death in the courtyard of the LORD’s temple.
chapters.zh: 众民同心谋害撒迦利亚，就照王的吩咐，在耶和华殿的院内用石头打死他。

chapters.en: King Joash did not remember the kindness Zechariah’s father Jehoiada had shown him but killed his son, who said as he lay dying, “May the LORD see this and call you to account.”
chapters.zh: 这样，约阿施王不想念撒迦利亚的父亲耶何耶大向自己所施的恩，杀了他的儿子。撒迦利亚临死的时候说，愿耶和华鉴察伸冤。

chapters.en: At the turn of the year, the army of Aram marched against Joash; it invaded Judah and Jerusalem and killed all the leaders of the people. They sent all the plunder to their king in Damascus.
chapters.zh: 满了一年，亚兰的军兵上来攻击约阿施，来到犹大和耶路撒冷，杀了民中的众首领，将所掠的财货送到大马色王那里。

chapters.en: Although the Aramean army had come with only a few men, the LORD delivered into their hands a much larger army. Because Judah had forsaken the LORD, the God of their ancestors, judgment was executed on Joash.
chapters.zh: 亚兰的军兵虽来了一小队，耶和华却将大队的军兵交在他们手里，是因犹大人离弃耶和华他们列祖的神，所以借亚兰人惩罚约阿施。

chapters.en: When the Arameans withdrew, they left Joash severely wounded. His officials conspired against him for murdering the son of Jehoiada the priest, and they killed him in his bed. So he died and was buried in the City of David, but not in the tombs of the kings.
chapters.zh: 亚兰人离开约阿施的时候，他患重病。臣仆背叛他，要报祭司耶何耶大儿子流血之仇，杀他在床上，葬他在大卫城，只是不葬在列王的坟墓里。

chapters.en: Those who conspired against him were Zabad, son of Shimeath an Ammonite woman, and Jehozabad, son of Shimrith a Moabite woman.
chapters.zh: 背叛他的是亚扪妇人示米押的儿子撒拔和摩押妇人示米利的儿子约萨拔。

chapters.en: The account of his sons, the many prophecies about him, and the record of the restoration of the temple of God are written in the annotations on the book of the kings. And Amaziah his son succeeded him as king.
chapters.zh: 至于他的众子和他所受的警戒，并他重修神殿的事，都写在列王的传上。他儿子亚玛谢接续他作王。

chapters.en: Amaziah was twenty-five years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem twenty-nine years. His mother’s name was Jehoaddan; she was from Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 亚玛谢登基的时候年二十五岁，在耶路撒冷作王二十九年。他母亲名叫约耶但，是耶路撒冷人。

chapters.en: He did what was right in the eyes of the LORD, but not wholeheartedly.
chapters.zh: 亚玛谢行耶和华眼中看为正的事，只是心不专诚。

chapters.en: After the kingdom was firmly in his control, he executed the officials who had murdered his father the king.
chapters.zh: 国一坚定，就把杀他父王的臣仆杀了，

chapters.en: Yet he did not put their children to death, but acted in accordance with what is written in the Law, in the Book of Moses, where the LORD commanded: “Parents shall not be put to death for their children, nor children be put to death for their parents; each will die for their own sin.”
chapters.zh: 却没有治死他们的儿子，是照摩西律法书上耶和华所吩咐的说，不可因子杀父，也不可因父杀子，各人要为本身的罪而死。

chapters.en: Amaziah called the people of Judah together and assigned them according to their families to commanders of thousands and commanders of hundreds for all Judah and Benjamin. He then mustered those twenty years old or more and found that there were three hundred thousand men fit for military service, able to handle the spear and shield.
chapters.zh: 亚玛谢招聚犹大人，按着犹大和便雅悯的宗族设立千夫长，百夫长，又数点人数，从二十岁以外，能拿枪拿盾牌出去打仗的精兵共有三十万。

chapters.en: He also hired a hundred thousand fighting men from Israel for a hundred talents of silver.
chapters.zh: 又用银子一百他连得，从以色列招募了十万大能的勇士。

chapters.en: But a man of God came to him and said, “Your Majesty, these troops from Israel must not march with you, for the LORD is not with Israel—not with any of the people of Ephraim.
chapters.zh: 有一个神人来见亚玛谢，对他说，王阿，不要使以色列的军兵与你同去，因为耶和华不与以色列人以法莲的后裔同在。

chapters.en: Even if you go and fight courageously in battle, God will overthrow you before the enemy, for God has the power to help or to overthrow.”
chapters.zh: 你若一定要去，就奋勇争战吧。但神必使你败在敌人面前。因为神能助人得胜，也能使人倾败。

chapters.en: Amaziah asked the man of God, “But what about the hundred talents I paid for these Israelite troops?” The man of God replied, “The LORD can give you much more than that.”
chapters.zh: 亚玛谢问神人说，我给了以色列军的那一百他连得银子怎么样呢？神人回答说，耶和华能把更多的赐给你。

chapters.en: So Amaziah dismissed the troops who had come to him from Ephraim and sent them home. They were furious with Judah and left for home in a great rage.
chapters.zh: 于是亚玛谢将那从以法莲来的军兵分别出来，叫他们回家去。故此，他们甚恼怒犹大人，气忿忿地回家去了。

chapters.en: Amaziah then marshaled his strength and led his army to the Valley of Salt, where he killed ten thousand men of Seir.
chapters.zh: 亚玛谢壮起胆来，率领他的民到盐谷，杀了西珥人一万。

chapters.en: The army of Judah also captured ten thousand men alive, took them to the top of a cliff and threw them down so that all were dashed to pieces.
chapters.zh: 犹大人又生擒了一万带到山崖上，从那里把他们扔下去，以致他们都摔碎了。

chapters.en: Meanwhile the troops that Amaziah had sent back and had not allowed to take part in the war raided towns belonging to Judah from Samaria to Beth Horon. They killed three thousand people and carried off great quantities of plunder.
chapters.zh: 但亚玛谢所打发回去，不许一同出征的那些军兵攻打犹大各城，从撒玛利亚直到伯和仑，杀了三千人，抢了许多财物。

chapters.en: When Amaziah returned from slaughtering the Edomites, he brought back the gods of the people of Seir. He set them up as his own gods, bowed down to them and burned sacrifices to them.
chapters.zh: 亚玛谢杀了以东人回来，就把西珥的神像带回，立为自己的神，在它面前叩拜烧香。

chapters.en: The anger of the LORD burned against Amaziah, and he sent a prophet to him, who said, “Why do you consult this people’s gods, which could not save their own people from your hand?”
chapters.zh: 因此，耶和华的怒气向亚玛谢发作，就差一个先知去见他，说，这些神不能救它的民脱离你的手，你为何寻求它呢？

chapters.en: While he was still speaking, the king said to him, “Have we appointed you an adviser to the king? Stop! Why be struck down?” So the prophet stopped but said, “I know that God has determined to destroy you, because you have done this and have not listened to my counsel.”
chapters.zh: 先知与王说话的时候，王对他说，谁立你作王的谋士呢？你住口吧。为何找打呢？先知就止住了，又说，你行这事，不听从我的劝戒，我知道神定意要灭你。

chapters.en: After Amaziah king of Judah consulted his advisers, he sent this challenge to Jehoash son of Jehoahaz, the son of Jehu, king of Israel: “Come, let us face each other in battle.”
chapters.zh: 犹大王亚玛谢与群臣商议，就差遣使者去见耶户的孙子，约哈斯的儿子，以色列王约阿施，说，你来，我们二人相见于战场。

chapters.en: But Jehoash king of Israel replied to Amaziah king of Judah: “A thistle in Lebanon sent a message to a cedar in Lebanon, ‘Give your daughter to my son in marriage.’ Then a wild beast in Lebanon came along and trampled the thistle underfoot.
chapters.zh: 以色列王约阿施差遣使者去见犹大王亚玛谢，说，利巴嫩的蒺藜差遣使者去见利巴嫩的香柏树，说，将你的女儿给我儿子为妻。后来利巴嫩有一个野兽经过，把蒺藜践踏了。

chapters.en: You say to yourself that you have defeated Edom, and now you are arrogant and proud. But stay at home! Why ask for trouble and cause your own downfall and that of Judah also?”
chapters.zh: 你说，看哪，我打败了以东人，你就心高气傲，以致矜夸。你在家里安居就罢了，为何要惹祸使自己和犹大国一同败亡呢？

chapters.en: Amaziah, however, would not listen, for God so worked that he might deliver them into the hands of Jehoash, because they sought the gods of Edom.
chapters.zh: 亚玛谢却不肯听从。这是出乎神，好将他们交在敌人手里，因为他们寻求以东的神。

chapters.en: So Jehoash king of Israel attacked. He and Amaziah king of Judah faced each other at Beth Shemesh in Judah.
chapters.zh: 于是以色列王约阿施上来，在犹大的伯示麦与犹大王亚玛谢相见于战场。

chapters.en: Judah was routed by Israel, and every man fled to his home.
chapters.zh: 犹大人败在以色列人面前，各自逃回家里去了。

chapters.en: Jehoash king of Israel captured Amaziah king of Judah, the son of Joash, the son of Ahaziah, at Beth Shemesh. Then Jehoash brought him to Jerusalem and broke down the wall of Jerusalem from the Ephraim Gate to the Corner Gate—a section about four hundred cubits long.
chapters.zh: 以色列王约阿施在伯示麦擒住约哈斯（就是亚哈谢）的孙子，约阿施的儿子，犹大王亚玛谢，将他带到耶路撒冷，又拆毁耶路撒冷的城墙，从以法莲门直到角门，共四百肘。

chapters.en: He took all the gold and silver and all the articles found in the temple of God that had been in the care of Obed-Edom, together with the palace treasures and the hostages, and returned to Samaria.
chapters.zh: 又将俄别以东所看守神殿里的一切金银和器皿，与王宫里的财宝都拿了去，并带人去为质，就回撒玛利亚去了。

chapters.en: Amaziah son of Joash king of Judah lived for fifteen years after the death of Jehoash son of Jehoahaz king of Israel.
chapters.zh: 以色列王约哈斯的儿子约阿施死后，犹大王约阿施的儿子亚玛谢又活了十五年。

chapters.en: As for the other events of Amaziah’s reign, from beginning to end, are they not written in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel?
chapters.zh: 亚玛谢其余的事，自始至终不都写在犹大和以色列诸王记上吗？

chapters.en: From the time that Amaziah turned away from following the LORD, they conspired against him in Jerusalem and he fled to Lachish, but they sent men after him to Lachish and killed him there.
chapters.zh: 自从亚玛谢离弃耶和华之后，在耶路撒冷有人背叛他，他就逃到拉吉。叛党却打发人到拉吉，将他杀了。

chapters.en: He was brought back by horse and was buried with his ancestors in the City of Judah.
chapters.zh: 人就用马将他的尸首驮回，葬在犹大京城他列祖的坟地里。

chapters.en: Then all the people of Judah took Uzziah, who was sixteen years old, and made him king in place of his father Amaziah.
chapters.zh: 犹大众民立亚玛谢的儿子乌西雅（又名亚撒利雅）接续他父作王，那时他年十六岁。

chapters.en: He was the one who rebuilt Elath and restored it to Judah after Amaziah rested with his ancestors.
chapters.zh: 亚玛谢与他列祖同睡之后，乌西雅收回以禄仍归犹大，又重新修理。

chapters.en: Uzziah was sixteen years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem fifty-two years. His mother’s name was Jekoliah; she was from Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 乌西雅登基的时候年十六岁，在耶路撒冷作王五十二年。他母亲名叫耶可利雅，是耶路撒冷人。

chapters.en: He did what was right in the eyes of the LORD, just as his father Amaziah had done.
chapters.zh: 乌西雅行耶和华眼中看为正的事，效法他父亚玛谢一切所行的。

chapters.en: He sought God during the days of Zechariah, who instructed him in the fear of God. As long as he sought the LORD, God gave him success.
chapters.zh: 通晓神默示，撒迦利亚在世的时候，乌西雅定意寻求神。他寻求耶和华，神就使他亨通。

chapters.en: He went to war against the Philistines and broke down the walls of Gath, Jabneh and Ashdod. He then rebuilt towns near Ashdod and elsewhere among the Philistines.
chapters.zh: 他出去攻击非利士人，拆毁了迦特城，雅比尼城，和亚实突城。在非利士人中，在亚实突境内，又建筑了些城。

chapters.en: God helped him against the Philistines and against the Arabs who lived in Gur Baal and against the Meunites.
chapters.zh: 神帮助他攻击非利士人和住在姑珥巴力的亚拉伯人，并米乌尼人。

chapters.en: The Ammonites brought tribute to Uzziah, and his fame spread as far as the border of Egypt, because he had become very powerful.
chapters.zh: 亚扪人给乌西雅进贡。他的名声传到埃及，因他甚是强盛。

chapters.en: Uzziah built towers in Jerusalem at the Corner Gate, at the Valley Gate and at the angle of the wall, and he fortified them.
chapters.zh: 乌西雅在耶路撒冷的角门和谷门，并城墙转弯之处，建筑城楼，且甚坚固。

chapters.en: He also built towers in the wilderness and dug many cisterns, because he had much livestock in the foothills and in the plain. He had people working his fields and vineyards in the hills and in the fertile lands, for he loved the soil.
chapters.zh: 又在旷野与高原和平原，建筑望楼，挖了许多井，因他的牲畜甚多。又在山地和佳美之地，有农夫和修理葡萄园的人，因为他喜悦农事。

chapters.en: Uzziah had a well-trained army, ready to go out by divisions according to their numbers as mustered by Jeiel the secretary and Maaseiah the officer under the direction of Hananiah, one of the royal officials.
chapters.zh: 乌西雅又有军兵，照书记耶利和官长玛西雅所数点的，在王的一个将军哈拿尼雅手下，分队出战。

chapters.en: The total number of family leaders over the fighting men was 2,600.
chapters.zh: 族长，大能勇士的总数共有二千六百人，

chapters.en: Under their command was an army of 307,500 men trained for war, a powerful force to support the king against his enemies.
chapters.zh: 他们手下的军兵共有三十万七千五百人，都有大能，善于争战，帮助王攻击仇敌。

chapters.en: Uzziah provided shields, spears, helmets, coats of armor, bows and slingstones for the entire army.
chapters.zh: 乌西雅为全军预备盾牌，枪，盔，甲，弓，和甩石的机弦，

chapters.en: In Jerusalem he made devices invented for use on the towers and on the corner defenses so that soldiers could shoot arrows and hurl large stones from the walls. His fame spread far and wide, for he was greatly helped until he became powerful.
chapters.zh: 又在耶路撒冷使巧匠作机器，安在城楼和角楼上，用以射箭发石。乌西雅的名声传到远方。因为他得了非常的帮助，甚是强盛。

chapters.en: But after Uzziah became powerful, his pride led to his downfall. He was unfaithful to the LORD his God, and entered the temple of the LORD to burn incense on the altar of incense.
chapters.zh: 他既强盛，就心高气傲，以致行事邪僻，干犯耶和华他的神，进耶和华的殿，要在香坛上烧香。

chapters.en: Azariah the priest with eighty other courageous priests of the LORD followed him in.
chapters.zh: 祭司亚撒利雅率领耶和华勇敢的祭司八十人，跟随他进去。

chapters.en: They confronted King Uzziah and said, “It is not right for you, Uzziah, to burn incense to the LORD. That is for the priests, the descendants of Aaron, who have been consecrated to burn incense. Leave the sanctuary, for you have been unfaithful; and you will not be honored by the LORD God.”
chapters.zh: 他们就阻挡乌西雅王，对他说，乌西雅阿，给耶和华烧香不是你的事，乃是亚伦子孙承接圣职祭司的事。你出圣殿吧。因为你犯了罪。你行这事，耶和华神必不使你得荣耀。

chapters.en: Uzziah, who had a censer in his hand ready to burn incense, became angry. While he was raging at the priests in their presence before the incense altar in the LORD’s temple, leprosy broke out on his forehead.
chapters.zh: 乌西雅就发怒，手拿香炉要烧香。他向祭司发怒的时候，在耶和华殿中香坛旁众祭司面前，额上忽然发出大麻疯。

chapters.en: When Azariah the chief priest and all the other priests looked at him, they saw that he had leprosy on his forehead, so they hurried him out. Indeed, he himself was eager to leave, because the LORD had afflicted him.
chapters.zh: 大祭司亚撒利雅和众祭司观看，见他额上发出大麻疯，就催他出殿。他自己也急速出去，因为耶和华降灾与他。

chapters.en: King Uzziah had leprosy until the day he died. He lived in a separate house —leprous, and banned from the temple of the LORD. Jotham his son had charge of the palace and governed the people of the land.
chapters.zh: 乌西雅王长大麻疯直到死日，因此住在别的宫里，与耶和华的殿隔绝。他儿子约坦管理家事，治理国民。

chapters.en: The other events of Uzziah’s reign, from beginning to end, are recorded by the prophet Isaiah son of Amoz.
chapters.zh: 乌西雅其余的事，自始至终都是亚摩斯的儿子先知以赛亚所记的。

chapters.en: Uzziah rested with his ancestors and was buried near them in a cemetery that belonged to the kings, for people said, “He had leprosy.” And Jotham his son succeeded him as king.
chapters.zh: 乌西雅与他列祖同睡，葬在王陵的田间他列祖的坟地里。因为人说，他是长大麻疯的。他儿子约坦接续他作王。

chapters.en: Jotham was twenty-five years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem sixteen years. His mother’s name was Jerusha daughter of Zadok.
chapters.zh: 约坦登基的时候年二十五岁，在耶路撒冷作王十六年，他母亲名叫耶路沙，是撒督的女儿。

chapters.en: He did what was right in the eyes of the LORD, just as his father Uzziah had done, but unlike him he did not enter the temple of the LORD. The people, however, continued their corrupt practices.
chapters.zh: 约坦行耶和华眼中看为正的事，效法他父乌西雅一切所行的，只是不入耶和华的殿。百姓还行邪僻的事。

chapters.en: Jotham rebuilt the Upper Gate of the temple of the LORD and did extensive work on the wall at the hill of Ophel.
chapters.zh: 约坦建立耶和华殿的上门，在俄斐勒城上多有建造，

chapters.en: He built towns in the hill country of Judah and forts and towers in the wooded areas.
chapters.zh: 又在犹大山地建造城邑，在树林中建筑营寨和高楼。

chapters.en: Jotham waged war against the king of the Ammonites and conquered them. That year the Ammonites paid him a hundred talents of silver, ten thousand cors of wheat and ten thousand cors of barley. The Ammonites brought him the same amount also in the second and third years.
chapters.zh: 约坦与亚扪人的王打仗胜了他们，当年他们进贡银一百他连得，小麦一万歌珥，大麦一万歌珥。第二年，第三年也是这样。

chapters.en: Jotham grew powerful because he walked steadfastly before the LORD his God.
chapters.zh: 约坦在耶和华他神面前行正道，以致日渐强盛。

chapters.en: The other events in Jotham’s reign, including all his wars and the other things he did, are written in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah.
chapters.zh: 约坦其余的事和一切争战，并他的行为，都写在以色列和犹大列王记上。

chapters.en: He was twenty-five years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem sixteen years.
chapters.zh: 他登基的时候年二十五岁，在耶路撒冷作王十六年。

chapters.en: Jotham rested with his ancestors and was buried in the City of David. And Ahaz his son succeeded him as king.
chapters.zh: 约坦与他列祖同睡，葬在大卫城里。他儿子亚哈斯接续他作王。

chapters.en: Ahaz was twenty years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem sixteen years. Unlike David his father, he did not do what was right in the eyes of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 亚哈斯登基的时候年二十岁，在耶路撒冷作王十六年。不像他祖大卫行耶和华眼中看为正的事，

chapters.en: He followed the ways of the kings of Israel and also made idols for worshiping the Baals.
chapters.zh: 却行以色列诸王的道，又铸造巴力的像，

chapters.en: He burned sacrifices in the Valley of Ben Hinnom and sacrificed his children in the fire, engaging in the detestable practices of the nations the LORD had driven out before the Israelites.
chapters.zh: 并且在欣嫩子谷烧香，用火焚烧他的儿女，行耶和华在以色列人面前所驱逐的外邦人那可憎的事。

chapters.en: He offered sacrifices and burned incense at the high places, on the hilltops and under every spreading tree.
chapters.zh: 并在丘坛上，山冈上，各青翠树下献祭烧香。

chapters.en: Therefore the LORD his God delivered him into the hands of the king of Aram. The Arameans defeated him and took many of his people as prisoners and brought them to Damascus. He was also given into the hands of the king of Israel, who inflicted heavy casualties on him.
chapters.zh: 所以，耶和华他的神将他交在亚兰王手里。亚兰王打败他，掳了他许多的民，带到大马色去。神又将他交在以色列王手里，以色列王向他大行杀戮。

chapters.en: In one day Pekah son of Remaliah killed a hundred and twenty thousand soldiers in Judah—because Judah had forsaken the LORD, the God of their ancestors.
chapters.zh: 利玛利的儿子比加一日杀了犹大人十二万，都是勇士，因为他们离弃了耶和华他们列祖的神。

chapters.en: Zikri, an Ephraimite warrior, killed Maaseiah the king’s son, Azrikam the officer in charge of the palace, and Elkanah, second to the king.
chapters.zh: 有一个以法莲中的勇士，名叫细基利，杀了王的儿子玛西雅和管理王宫的押斯利甘，并宰相以利加拿。

chapters.en: The men of Israel took captive from their fellow Israelites who were from Judah two hundred thousand wives, sons and daughters. They also took a great deal of plunder, which they carried back to Samaria.
chapters.zh: 以色列人掳了他们的弟兄，连妇人带儿女共有二十万，又掠了许多的财物，带到撒玛利亚去了。

chapters.en: But a prophet of the LORD named Oded was there, and he went out to meet the army when it returned to Samaria. He said to them, “Because the LORD, the God of your ancestors, was angry with Judah, he gave them into your hand. But you have slaughtered them in a rage that reaches to heaven.
chapters.zh: 但那里有耶和华的一个先知，名叫俄德，出来迎接往撒玛利亚去的军兵，对他们说，因为耶和华你们列祖的神恼怒犹大人，所以将他们交在你们手里，你们竟怒气冲天，大行杀戮。

chapters.en: And now you intend to make the men and women of Judah and Jerusalem your slaves. But aren’t you also guilty of sins against the LORD your God?
chapters.zh: 如今你们又有意强逼犹大人和耶路撒冷人作你们的奴婢，你们岂不也有得罪耶和华你们神的事吗？

chapters.en: Now listen to me! Send back your fellow Israelites you have taken as prisoners, for the LORD’s fierce anger rests on you.”
chapters.zh: 现在你们当听我说，要将掳来的弟兄释放回去，因为耶和华向你们已经大发烈怒。

chapters.en: Then some of the leaders in Ephraim—Azariah son of Jehohanan, Berekiah son of Meshillemoth, Jehizkiah son of Shallum, and Amasa son of Hadlai—confronted those who were arriving from the war.
chapters.zh: 于是，以法莲人的几个族长就是约哈难的儿子亚撒利雅，米实利末的儿子比利家，沙龙的儿子耶希西家，哈得莱的儿子亚玛撒起来拦挡出兵回来的人，

chapters.en: “You must not bring those prisoners here,” they said, “or we will be guilty before the LORD. Do you intend to add to our sin and guilt? For our guilt is already great, and his fierce anger rests on Israel.”
chapters.zh: 对他们说，你们不可带进这被掳的人来。你们想要使我们得罪耶和华，加增我们的罪恶过犯。因为我们的罪过甚大，已经有烈怒临到以色列人了。

chapters.en: So the soldiers gave up the prisoners and plunder in the presence of the officials and all the assembly.
chapters.zh: 于是带兵器的人将掳来的人口和掠来的财物都留在众首领和会众的面前。

chapters.en: The men designated by name took the prisoners, and from the plunder they clothed all who were naked. They provided them with clothes and sandals, food and drink, and healing balm. All those who were weak they put on donkeys. So they took them back to their fellow Israelites at Jericho, the City of Palms, and returned to Samaria.
chapters.zh: 以上提名的那些人就站起，使被掳的人前来。其中有赤身的，就从所掠的财物中拿出衣服和鞋来，给他们穿，又给他们吃喝，用膏抹他们。其中有软弱的，就使他们骑驴，送到棕树城耶利哥他们弟兄那里，随后就回撒玛利亚去了。

chapters.en: At that time King Ahaz sent to the kings of Assyria for help.
chapters.zh: 那时，亚哈斯王差遣人去见亚述诸王，求他们帮助。

chapters.en: The Edomites had again come and attacked Judah and carried away prisoners,
chapters.zh: 因为以东人又来攻击犹大，掳掠子民。

chapters.en: while the Philistines had raided towns in the foothills and in the Negev of Judah. They captured and occupied Beth Shemesh, Aijalon and Gederoth, as well as Soko, Timnah and Gimzo, with their surrounding villages.
chapters.zh: 非利士人也来侵占高原和犹大南方的城邑，取了伯示麦，亚雅仑，基低罗，梭哥和属梭哥的乡村，亭纳和属亭纳的乡村，瑾锁和属瑾锁的乡村，就住在那里。

chapters.en: The LORD had humbled Judah because of Ahaz king of Israel, for he had promoted wickedness in Judah and had been most unfaithful to the LORD.
chapters.zh: 因为以色列王亚哈斯在犹大放肆，大大干犯耶和华，所以耶和华使犹大卑微。

chapters.en: Tiglath-Pileser king of Assyria came to him, but he gave him trouble instead of help.
chapters.zh: 亚述王提革拉毗尼色上来，却没有帮助他，反倒欺凌他。

chapters.en: Ahaz took some of the things from the temple of the LORD and from the royal palace and from the officials and presented them to the king of Assyria, but that did not help him.
chapters.zh: 亚哈斯从耶和华殿里和王宫中，并首领家内所取的财宝给了亚述王，这也无济于事。

chapters.en: In his time of trouble King Ahaz became even more unfaithful to the LORD.
chapters.zh: 这亚哈斯王在急难的时候，越发得罪耶和华。

chapters.en: He offered sacrifices to the gods of Damascus, who had defeated him; for he thought, “Since the gods of the kings of Aram have helped them, I will sacrifice to them so they will help me.” But they were his downfall and the downfall of all Israel.
chapters.zh: 他祭祀攻击他的大马色之神，说，因为亚兰王的神帮助他们，我也献祭与他，他好帮助我。但那些神使他和以色列众人败亡了。

chapters.en: Ahaz gathered together the furnishings from the temple of God and cut them in pieces. He shut the doors of the LORD’s temple and set up altars at every street corner in Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 亚哈斯将神殿里的器皿都聚了来，毁坏了，且封锁耶和华殿的门。在耶路撒冷各处的拐角建筑祭坛，

chapters.en: In every town in Judah he built high places to burn sacrifices to other gods and aroused the anger of the LORD, the God of his ancestors.
chapters.zh: 又在犹大各城建立丘坛，与别神烧香，惹动耶和华他列祖神的怒气。

chapters.en: The other events of his reign and all his ways, from beginning to end, are written in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel.
chapters.zh: 亚哈斯其余的事和他的行为，自始至终都写在犹大和以色列诸王记上。

chapters.en: Ahaz rested with his ancestors and was buried in the city of Jerusalem, but he was not placed in the tombs of the kings of Israel. And Hezekiah his son succeeded him as king.
chapters.zh: 亚哈斯与他列祖同睡，葬在耶路撒冷城里，没有送入以色列诸王的坟墓中。他儿子希西家接续他作王。

chapters.en: Hezekiah was twenty-five years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem twenty-nine years. His mother’s name was Abijah daughter of Zechariah.
chapters.zh: 希西家登基的时候年二十五岁，在耶路撒冷作王二十九年。他母亲名叫亚比雅，是撒迦利雅的女儿。

chapters.en: He did what was right in the eyes of the LORD, just as his father David had done.
chapters.zh: 希西家行耶和华眼中看为正的事，效法他祖大卫一切所行的。

chapters.en: In the first month of the first year of his reign, he opened the doors of the temple of the LORD and repaired them.
chapters.zh: 元年正月，开了耶和华殿的门，重新修理。

chapters.en: He brought in the priests and the Levites, assembled them in the square on the east side
chapters.zh: 他召众祭司和利未人来，聚集在东边的宽阔处，

chapters.en: and said: “Listen to me, Levites! Consecrate yourselves now and consecrate the temple of the LORD, the God of your ancestors. Remove all defilement from the sanctuary.
chapters.zh: 对他们说，利未人哪，当听我说，现在你们要洁净自己，又洁净耶和华你们列祖神的殿，从圣所中除去污秽之物。

chapters.en: Our parents were unfaithful; they did evil in the eyes of the LORD our God and forsook him. They turned their faces away from the LORD’s dwelling place and turned their backs on him.
chapters.zh: 我们列祖犯了罪，行耶和华我们神眼中看为恶的事，离弃他，转脸背向他的居所，

chapters.en: They also shut the doors of the portico and put out the lamps. They did not burn incense or present any burnt offerings at the sanctuary to the God of Israel.
chapters.zh: 封锁廊门，吹灭灯火，不在圣所中向以色列神烧香，或献燔祭。

chapters.en: Therefore, the anger of the LORD has fallen on Judah and Jerusalem; he has made them an object of dread and horror and scorn, as you can see with your own eyes.
chapters.zh: 因此，耶和华的忿怒临到犹大和耶路撒冷，将其中的人抛来抛去，令人惊骇，嗤笑，正如你们亲眼所见的。

chapters.en: This is why our fathers have fallen by the sword and why our sons and daughters and our wives are in captivity.
chapters.zh: 所以我们的祖宗倒在刀下，我们的妻子儿女也被掳掠。

chapters.en: Now I intend to make a covenant with the LORD, the God of Israel, so that his fierce anger will turn away from us.
chapters.zh: 现在我心中有意与耶和华以色列的神立约，好使他的烈怒转离我们。

chapters.en: My sons, do not be negligent now, for the LORD has chosen you to stand before him and serve him, to minister before him and to burn incense.”
chapters.zh: 我的众子阿，现在不要懈怠。因为耶和华拣选你们站在他面前事奉他，与他烧香。

chapters.en: Then these Levites set to work: from the Kohathites, Mahath son of Amasai and Joel son of Azariah; from the Merarites, Kish son of Abdi and Azariah son of Jehallelel; from the Gershonites, Joah son of Zimmah and Eden son of Joah;
chapters.zh: 于是，利未人哥辖的子孙，亚玛赛的儿子玛哈，亚撒利雅的儿子约珥。米拉利的子孙，亚伯底的儿子基士，耶哈利勒的儿子亚撒利雅。革顺的子孙，薪玛的儿子约亚，约亚的儿子伊甸，

chapters.en: from the descendants of Elizaphan, Shimri and Jeiel; from the descendants of Asaph, Zechariah and Mattaniah;
chapters.zh: 以利撒反的子孙申利和耶利。亚萨的子孙撒迦利雅和玛探雅。

chapters.en: from the descendants of Heman, Jehiel and Shimei; from the descendants of Jeduthun, Shemaiah and Uzziel.
chapters.zh: 希幔的子孙耶歇和示每。耶杜顿的子孙示玛雅和乌薛。

chapters.en: When they had assembled their fellow Levites and consecrated themselves, they went in to purify the temple of the LORD, as the king had ordered, following the word of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 起来聚集他们的弟兄，洁净自己，照着王的吩咐，耶和华的命令，进去洁净耶和华的殿。

chapters.en: The priests went into the sanctuary of the LORD to purify it. They brought out to the courtyard of the LORD’s temple everything unclean that they found in the temple of the LORD. The Levites took it and carried it out to the Kidron Valley.
chapters.zh: 祭司进入耶和华的殿要洁净殿，将殿中所有污秽之物搬到耶和华殿的院内，利未人接去，搬到外头汲沦溪边。

chapters.en: They began the consecration on the first day of the first month, and by the eighth day of the month they reached the portico of the LORD. For eight more days they consecrated the temple of the LORD itself, finishing on the sixteenth day of the first month.
chapters.zh: 从正月初一日洁净起，初八日到了耶和华的殿廊，用八日的工夫洁净耶和华的殿，到正月十六日才洁净完了。

chapters.en: Then they went in to King Hezekiah and reported: “We have purified the entire temple of the LORD, the altar of burnt offering with all its utensils, and the table for setting out the consecrated bread, with all its articles.
chapters.zh: 于是，他们晋见希西家王，说，我们已将耶和华的全殿和燔祭坛，并坛的一切器皿，陈设饼的桌子，与桌子的一切器皿都洁净了。

chapters.en: We have prepared and consecrated all the articles that King Ahaz removed in his unfaithfulness while he was king. They are now in front of the LORD’s altar.”
chapters.zh: 并且亚哈斯王在位犯罪的时候所废弃的器皿，我们预备齐全，且洁净了，现今都在耶和华的坛前。

chapters.en: Early the next morning King Hezekiah gathered the city officials together and went up to the temple of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 希西家王清早起来，聚集城里的首领都上耶和华的殿。

chapters.en: They brought seven bulls, seven rams, seven male lambs and seven male goats as a sin offering for the kingdom, for the sanctuary and for Judah. The king commanded the priests, the descendants of Aaron, to offer these on the altar of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 牵了七只公牛，七只公羊，七只羊羔，七只公山羊，要为国，为殿，为犹大人作赎罪祭。王吩咐亚伦的子孙众祭司，献在耶和华的坛上，

chapters.en: So they slaughtered the bulls, and the priests took the blood and splashed it against the altar; next they slaughtered the rams and splashed their blood against the altar; then they slaughtered the lambs and splashed their blood against the altar.
chapters.zh: 就宰了公牛，祭司接血洒在坛上，宰了公羊，把血洒在坛上，又宰了羊羔，也把血洒在坛上。

chapters.en: The goats for the sin offering were brought before the king and the assembly, and they laid their hands on them.
chapters.zh: 把那作赎罪祭的公山羊牵到王和会众面前，他们就按手在其上。

chapters.en: The priests then slaughtered the goats and presented their blood on the altar for a sin offering to atone for all Israel, because the king had ordered the burnt offering and the sin offering for all Israel.
chapters.zh: 祭司宰了羊，将血献在坛上作赎罪祭，为以色列众人赎罪，因为王吩咐将燔祭和赎罪祭为以色列众人献上。

chapters.en: He stationed the Levites in the temple of the LORD with cymbals, harps and lyres in the way prescribed by David and Gad the king’s seer and Nathan the prophet; this was commanded by the LORD through his prophets.
chapters.zh: 王又派利未人在耶和华殿中敲钹，鼓瑟，弹琴，乃照大卫和他先见迦得，并先知拿单所吩咐的，就是耶和华借先知所吩咐的。

chapters.en: So the Levites stood ready with David’s instruments, and the priests with their trumpets.
chapters.zh: 利未人拿大卫的乐器，祭司拿号，一同站立。

chapters.en: Hezekiah gave the order to sacrifice the burnt offering on the altar. As the offering began, singing to the LORD began also, accompanied by trumpets and the instruments of David king of Israel.
chapters.zh: 希西家吩咐在坛上献燔祭，燔祭一献，就唱赞美耶和华的歌，用号，并用以色列王大卫的乐器相和。

chapters.en: The whole assembly bowed in worship, while the musicians played and the trumpets sounded. All this continued until the sacrifice of the burnt offering was completed.
chapters.zh: 会众都敬拜，歌唱的歌唱，吹号的吹号，如此直到燔祭献完了。

chapters.en: When the offerings were finished, the king and everyone present with him knelt down and worshiped.
chapters.zh: 献完了祭，王和一切跟随的人都俯伏敬拜。

chapters.en: King Hezekiah and his officials ordered the Levites to praise the LORD with the words of David and of Asaph the seer. So they sang praises with gladness and bowed down and worshiped.
chapters.zh: 希西家王与众首领又吩咐利未人用大卫和先见亚萨的诗词颂赞耶和华。他们就欢欢喜喜地颂赞耶和华，低头敬拜。

chapters.en: Then Hezekiah said, “You have now dedicated yourselves to the LORD. Come and bring sacrifices and thank offerings to the temple of the LORD.” So the assembly brought sacrifices and thank offerings, and all whose hearts were willing brought burnt offerings.
chapters.zh: 希西家说，你们既然归耶和华为圣，就要前来把祭物和感谢祭奉到耶和华殿里。会众就把祭物和感谢祭奉来，凡甘心乐意的也将燔祭奉来。

chapters.en: The number of burnt offerings the assembly brought was seventy bulls, a hundred rams and two hundred male lambs—all of them for burnt offerings to the LORD.
chapters.zh: 会众所奉的燔祭如下，公牛七十只，公羊一百只，羊羔二百只，这都是作燔祭献给耶和华的。

chapters.en: The animals consecrated as sacrifices amounted to six hundred bulls and three thousand sheep and goats.
chapters.zh: 又有分别为圣之物，公牛六百只，绵羊三千只。

chapters.en: The priests, however, were too few to skin all the burnt offerings; so their relatives the Levites helped them until the task was finished and until other priests had been consecrated, for the Levites had been more conscientious in consecrating themselves than the priests had been.
chapters.zh: 但祭司太少，不能剥尽燔祭牲的皮，所以他们的弟兄利未人帮助他们，直等燔祭的事完了，又等别的祭司自洁了。因为利未人诚心自洁，胜过祭司。

chapters.en: There were burnt offerings in abundance, together with the fat of the fellowship offerings and the drink offerings that accompanied the burnt offerings. So the service of the temple of the LORD was reestablished.
chapters.zh: 燔祭和平安祭牲的脂油，并燔祭同献的奠祭甚多。这样，耶和华殿中的事务俱都齐备了（或作就整顿了）。

chapters.en: Hezekiah and all the people rejoiced at what God had brought about for his people, because it was done so quickly.
chapters.zh: 这事办的甚速，希西家和众民都喜乐，是因神为众民所预备的。

chapters.en: Hezekiah sent word to all Israel and Judah and also wrote letters to Ephraim and Manasseh, inviting them to come to the temple of the LORD in Jerusalem and celebrate the Passover to the LORD, the God of Israel.
chapters.zh: 希西家差遣人去见以色列和犹大众人，又写信给以法莲和玛拿西人，叫他们到耶路撒冷耶和华的殿，向耶和华以色列的神守逾越节。

chapters.en: The king and his officials and the whole assembly in Jerusalem decided to celebrate the Passover in the second month.
chapters.zh: 因为王和众首领，并耶路撒冷全会众已经商议，要在二月内守逾越节。

chapters.en: They had not been able to celebrate it at the regular time because not enough priests had consecrated themselves and the people had not assembled in Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 正月（原文作那时）间他们不能守。因为自洁的祭司尚不敷用，百姓也没有聚集在耶路撒冷。

chapters.en: The plan seemed right both to the king and to the whole assembly.
chapters.zh: 王与全会众都以这事为善。

chapters.en: They decided to send a proclamation throughout Israel, from Beersheba to Dan, calling the people to come to Jerusalem and celebrate the Passover to the LORD, the God of Israel. It had not been celebrated in large numbers according to what was written.
chapters.zh: 于是定了命令，传遍以色列，从别是巴直到但，使他们都来，在耶路撒冷向耶和华以色列的神守逾越节。因为照所写的例，守这节的不多了（或作因为民许久没有照所写的例守节了）。

chapters.en: At the king’s command, couriers went throughout Israel and Judah with letters from the king and from his officials, which read: “People of Israel, return to the LORD, the God of Abraham, Isaac and Israel, that he may return to you who are left, who have escaped from the hand of the kings of Assyria.
chapters.zh: 驿卒就把王和众首领的信，遵着王命传遍以色列和犹大。信内说，以色列人哪，你们当转向耶和华亚伯拉罕，以撒，以色列的神，好叫他转向你们这脱离亚述王手的余民。

chapters.en: Do not be like your parents and your fellow Israelites, who were unfaithful to the LORD, the God of their ancestors, so that he made them an object of horror, as you see.
chapters.zh: 你们不要效法你们列祖和你们的弟兄。他们干犯耶和华他们列祖的神，以致耶和华丢弃他们，使他们败亡（或作令人惊骇），正如你们所见的。

chapters.en: Do not be stiff-necked, as your ancestors were; submit to the LORD. Come to his sanctuary, which he has consecrated forever. Serve the LORD your God, so that his fierce anger will turn away from you.
chapters.zh: 现在不要象你们列祖硬着颈项，只要归顺耶和华，进入他的圣所，就是永远成圣的居所。又要事奉耶和华你们的神，好使他的烈怒转离你们。

chapters.en: If you return to the LORD, then your fellow Israelites and your children will be shown compassion by their captors and will return to this land, for the LORD your God is gracious and compassionate. He will not turn his face from you if you return to him.”
chapters.zh: 你们若转向耶和华，你们的弟兄和儿女必在掳掠他们的人面前蒙怜恤，得以归回这地，因为耶和华你们的神有恩典，施怜悯。你们若转向他，他必不转脸不顾你们。

chapters.en: The couriers went from town to town in Ephraim and Manasseh, as far as Zebulun, but people scorned and ridiculed them.
chapters.zh: 驿卒就由这城跑到那城，传遍了以法莲，玛拿西，直到西布伦。那里的人却戏笑他们，讥诮他们。

chapters.en: Nevertheless, some from Asher, Manasseh and Zebulun humbled themselves and went to Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 然而亚设，玛拿西，西布伦中也有人自卑，来到耶路撒冷。

chapters.en: Also in Judah the hand of God was on the people to give them unity of mind to carry out what the king and his officials had ordered, following the word of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 神也感动犹大人，使他们一心遵行王与众首领凭耶和华之言所发的命令。

chapters.en: A very large crowd of people assembled in Jerusalem to celebrate the Festival of Unleavened Bread in the second month.
chapters.zh: 二月，有许多人在耶路撒冷聚集，成为大会，要守除酵节。

chapters.en: They removed the altars in Jerusalem and cleared away the incense altars and threw them into the Kidron Valley.
chapters.zh: 他们起来，把耶路撒冷的祭坛和烧香的坛尽都除去，抛在汲沦溪中。

chapters.en: They slaughtered the Passover lamb on the fourteenth day of the second month. The priests and the Levites were ashamed and consecrated themselves and brought burnt offerings to the temple of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 二月十四日，宰了逾越节的羊羔。祭司与利未人觉得惭愧，就洁净自己，把燔祭奉到耶和华殿中，

chapters.en: Then they took up their regular positions as prescribed in the Law of Moses the man of God. The priests splashed against the altar the blood handed to them by the Levites.
chapters.zh: 遵着神人摩西的律法，照例站在自己的地方。祭司从利未人手里接过血来，洒在坛上。

chapters.en: Since many in the crowd had not consecrated themselves, the Levites had to kill the Passover lambs for all those who were not ceremonially clean and could not consecrate their lambs to the LORD.
chapters.zh: 会中有许多人尚未自洁，所以利未人为一切不洁之人宰逾越节的羊羔，使他们在耶和华面前成为圣洁。

chapters.en: Although most of the many people who came from Ephraim, Manasseh, Issachar and Zebulun had not purified themselves, yet they ate the Passover, contrary to what was written. But Hezekiah prayed for them, saying, “May the LORD, who is good, pardon everyone
chapters.zh: 以法莲，玛拿西，以萨迦，西布伦有许多人尚未自洁，他们却也吃逾越节的羊羔，不合所记录的定例。希西家为他们祷告说，凡专心寻求神，就是耶和华他列祖之神的，虽不照着圣所洁净之礼自洁，求至善的耶和华也饶恕他。

chapters.en: who sets their heart on seeking God—the LORD, the God of their ancestors—even if they are not clean according to the rules of the sanctuary.”
And the LORD heard Hezekiah and healed the people.
chapters.zh: 耶和华垂听希西家的祷告，就饶恕（原文作医治）百姓。

chapters.en: The Israelites who were present in Jerusalem celebrated the Festival of Unleavened Bread for seven days with great rejoicing, while the Levites and priests praised the LORD every day with resounding instruments dedicated to the LORD.
chapters.zh: 在耶路撒冷的以色列人大大喜乐，守除酵节七日。利未人和祭司用响亮的乐器，日日颂赞耶和华。

chapters.en: Hezekiah spoke encouragingly to all the Levites, who showed good understanding of the service of the LORD. For the seven days they ate their assigned portion and offered fellowship offerings and praised the LORD, the God of their ancestors.
chapters.zh: 希西家慰劳一切善于事奉耶和华的利未人。于是众人吃节筵七日，又献平安祭，且向耶和华他们列祖的神认罪。

chapters.en: The whole assembly then agreed to celebrate the festival seven more days; so for another seven days they celebrated joyfully.
chapters.zh: 全会众商议，要再守节七日。于是欢欢喜喜地又守节七日。

chapters.en: Hezekiah king of Judah provided a thousand bulls and seven thousand sheep and goats for the assembly, and the officials provided them with a thousand bulls and ten thousand sheep and goats. A great number of priests consecrated themselves.
chapters.zh: 犹大王希西家赐给会众公牛一千只，羊七千只为祭物。众首领也赐给会众公牛一千只，羊一万只，并有许多的祭司洁净自己。

chapters.en: The entire assembly of Judah rejoiced, along with the priests and Levites and all who had assembled from Israel, including the foreigners who had come from Israel and also those who resided in Judah.
chapters.zh: 犹大全会众，祭司，利未人，并那从以色列地来的会众和寄居的人，以及犹大寄居的人，尽都喜乐。

chapters.en: There was great joy in Jerusalem, for since the days of Solomon son of David king of Israel there had been nothing like this in Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 这样，在耶路撒冷大有喜乐，自从以色列王大卫儿子所罗门的时候，在耶路撒冷没有这样的喜乐。

chapters.en: The priests and the Levites stood to bless the people, and God heard them, for their prayer reached heaven, his holy dwelling place.
chapters.zh: 那时，祭司，利未人起来，为民祝福。他们的声音蒙神垂听，他们的祷告达到天上的圣所。

chapters.en: When all this had ended, the Israelites who were there went out to the towns of Judah, smashed the sacred stones and cut down the Asherah poles. They destroyed the high places and the altars throughout Judah and Benjamin and in Ephraim and Manasseh. After they had destroyed all of them, the Israelites returned to their own towns and to their own property.
chapters.zh: 这事既都完毕，在那里的以色列众人就到犹大的城邑，打碎柱像，砍断木偶，又在犹大，便雅悯，以法莲，玛拿西遍地将丘坛和祭坛拆毁净尽。于是以色列众人各回各城，各归各地。

chapters.en: Hezekiah assigned the priests and Levites to divisions—each of them according to their duties as priests or Levites—to offer burnt offerings and fellowship offerings, to minister, to give thanks and to sing praises at the gates of the LORD’s dwelling.
chapters.zh: 希西家派定祭司利未人的班次，各按各职献燔祭和平安祭，又在耶和华殿（原文作营）门内事奉，称谢颂赞耶和华。

chapters.en: The king contributed from his own possessions for the morning and evening burnt offerings and for the burnt offerings on the Sabbaths, at the New Moons and at the appointed festivals as written in the Law of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 王又从自己的产业中定出分来为燔祭，就是早晚的燔祭和安息日，月朔，并节期的燔祭，都是按耶和华律法上所载的。

chapters.en: He ordered the people living in Jerusalem to give the portion due the priests and Levites so they could devote themselves to the Law of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 又吩咐住耶路撒冷的百姓将祭司，利未人所应得的分给他们，使他们专心遵守耶和华的律法。

chapters.en: As soon as the order went out, the Israelites generously gave the firstfruits of their grain, new wine, olive oil and honey and all that the fields produced. They brought a great amount, a tithe of everything.
chapters.zh: 谕旨一出，以色列人就把初熟的五谷，新酒，油，蜜，和田地的出产多多送来，又把各物的十分之一送来的极多。

chapters.en: The people of Israel and Judah who lived in the towns of Judah also brought a tithe of their herds and flocks and a tithe of the holy things dedicated to the LORD their God, and they piled them in heaps.
chapters.zh: 住犹大各城的以色列人和犹大人也将牛羊的十分之一，并分别为圣归耶和华他们神之物，就是十分取一之物，尽都送来，积成堆垒。

chapters.en: They began doing this in the third month and finished in the seventh month.
chapters.zh: 从三月积起，到七月才完。

chapters.en: When Hezekiah and his officials came and saw the heaps, they praised the LORD and blessed his people Israel.
chapters.zh: 希西家和众首领来，看见堆垒，就称颂耶和华，又为耶和华的民以色列人祝福。

chapters.en: Hezekiah asked the priests and Levites about the heaps;
chapters.zh: 希西家向祭司，利未人查问这堆垒。

chapters.en: and Azariah the chief priest, from the family of Zadok, answered, “Since the people began to bring their contributions to the temple of the LORD, we have had enough to eat and plenty to spare, because the LORD has blessed his people, and this great amount is left over.”
chapters.zh: 撒督家的大祭司亚撒利雅回答说，自从民将供物送到耶和华殿以来，我们不但吃饱，且剩下的甚多。因为耶和华赐福给他的民，所剩下的才这样丰盛。

chapters.en: Hezekiah gave orders to prepare storerooms in the temple of the LORD, and this was done.
chapters.zh: 希西家吩咐在耶和华殿里预备仓房，他们就预备了。

chapters.en: Then they faithfully brought in the contributions, tithes and dedicated gifts. Konaniah, a Levite, was the overseer in charge of these things, and his brother Shimei was next in rank.
chapters.zh: 他们诚心将供物和十分取一之物，并分别为圣之物，都搬入仓内。利未人歌楠雅掌管这事，他兄弟示每为副管。

chapters.en: Jehiel, Azaziah, Nahath, Asahel, Jerimoth, Jozabad, Eliel, Ismakiah, Mahath and Benaiah were assistants of Konaniah and Shimei his brother. All these served by appointment of King Hezekiah and Azariah the official in charge of the temple of God.
chapters.zh: 耶歇，亚撒细雅，拿哈，亚撒黑，耶利末，约撒拔，以列，伊斯玛基雅，玛哈，比拿雅都是督理，在歌楠雅和他兄弟示每的手下，是希西家王和管理神殿的亚撒利雅所派的。

chapters.en: Kore son of Imnah the Levite, keeper of the East Gate, was in charge of the freewill offerings given to God, distributing the contributions made to the LORD and also the consecrated gifts.
chapters.zh: 守东门的利未人音拿的儿子可利，掌管乐意献与神的礼物，发放献与耶和华的供物和至圣的物。

chapters.en: Eden, Miniamin, Jeshua, Shemaiah, Amariah and Shekaniah assisted him faithfully in the towns of the priests, distributing to their fellow priests according to their divisions, old and young alike.
chapters.zh: 在他手下有伊甸，珉雅珉，耶书亚，示玛雅，亚玛利雅，示迦尼雅，在祭司的各城里供紧要的职任，无论弟兄大小，都按着班次分给他们。

chapters.en: In addition, they distributed to the males three years old or more whose names were in the genealogical records—all who would enter the temple of the LORD to perform the daily duties of their various tasks, according to their responsibilities and their divisions.
chapters.zh: 按家谱，三岁以外的男丁，凡每日进耶和华殿，按班次供职的，也分给他。

chapters.en: And they distributed to the priests enrolled by their families in the genealogical records and likewise to the Levites twenty years old or more, according to their responsibilities and their divisions.
chapters.zh: 又按宗族家谱分给祭司，按班次职任分给二十岁以外的利未人，

chapters.en: They included all the little ones, the wives, and the sons and daughters of the whole community listed in these genealogical records. For they were faithful in consecrating themselves.
chapters.zh: 又按家谱计算，分给他们会中的妻子，儿女。因他们身供要职，自洁成圣。

chapters.en: As for the priests, the descendants of Aaron, who lived on the farm lands around their towns or in any other towns, men were designated by name to distribute portions to every male among them and to all who were recorded in the genealogies of the Levites.
chapters.zh: 按名派定的人要把应得的分给亚伦子孙，住在各城郊野，祭司所有的男丁和一切载入家谱的利未人。

chapters.en: This is what Hezekiah did throughout Judah, doing what was good and right and faithful before the LORD his God.
chapters.zh: 希西家在犹大遍地这样办理，行耶和华他神眼中看为善为正为忠的事。

chapters.en: In everything that he undertook in the service of God’s temple and in obedience to the law and the commands, he sought his God and worked wholeheartedly. And so he prospered.
chapters.zh: 凡他所行的，无论是办神殿的事，是遵律法守诫命，是寻求他的神，都是尽心去行，无不亨通。

chapters.en: After all that Hezekiah had so faithfully done, Sennacherib king of Assyria came and invaded Judah. He laid siege to the fortified cities, thinking to conquer them for himself.
chapters.zh: 这虔诚的事以后，亚述王西拿基立来侵入犹大，围困一切坚固城，想要攻破占据。

chapters.en: When Hezekiah saw that Sennacherib had come and that he intended to wage war against Jerusalem,
chapters.zh: 希西家见西拿基立来，定意要攻打耶路撒冷，

chapters.en: he consulted with his officials and military staff about blocking off the water from the springs outside the city, and they helped him.
chapters.zh: 就与首领和勇士商议，塞住城外的泉源。他们就都帮助他。

chapters.en: They gathered a large group of people who blocked all the springs and the stream that flowed through the land. “Why should the kings of Assyria come and find plenty of water?” they said.
chapters.zh: 于是有许多人聚集，塞了一切泉源，并通流国中的小河，说，亚述王来，为何让他得着许多水呢？

chapters.en: Then he worked hard repairing all the broken sections of the wall and building towers on it. He built another wall outside that one and reinforced the terraces of the City of David. He also made large numbers of weapons and shields.
chapters.zh: 希西家力图自强，就修筑所有拆毁的城墙，高与城楼相齐。在城外又筑一城，坚固大卫城的米罗，制造了许多军器，盾牌。

chapters.en: He appointed military officers over the people and assembled them before him in the square at the city gate and encouraged them with these words:
chapters.zh: 设立军长管理百姓，将他们招聚在城门的宽阔处，用话勉励他们，说，

chapters.en: “Be strong and courageous. Do not be afraid or discouraged because of the king of Assyria and the vast army with him, for there is a greater power with us than with him.
chapters.zh: 你们当刚强壮胆，不要因亚述王和跟随他的大军恐惧，惊慌。因为与我们同在的，比与他们同在的更大。

chapters.en: With him is only the arm of flesh, but with us is the LORD our God to help us and to fight our battles.” And the people gained confidence from what Hezekiah the king of Judah said.
chapters.zh: 与他们同在的是肉臂，与我们同在的是耶和华我们的神，他必帮助我们，为我们争战。百姓就靠犹大王希西家的话，安然无惧了。

chapters.en: Later, when Sennacherib king of Assyria and all his forces were laying siege to Lachish, he sent his officers to Jerusalem with this message for Hezekiah king of Judah and for all the people of Judah who were there:
chapters.zh: 此后，亚述王西拿基立和他的全军攻打拉吉，就差遣臣仆到耶路撒冷见犹大王希西家和一切在耶路撒冷的犹大人，说，

chapters.en: “This is what Sennacherib king of Assyria says: On what are you basing your confidence, that you remain in Jerusalem under siege?
chapters.zh: 亚述王西拿基立如此说，你们倚靠什么，还在耶路撒冷受困呢？

chapters.en: When Hezekiah says, ‘The LORD our God will save us from the hand of the king of Assyria,’ he is misleading you, to let you die of hunger and thirst.
