chapters.zh: 这些人都娶了外邦女子为妻，其中也有生了儿女的。

chapters.en: The words of Nehemiah son of Hakaliah: In the month of Kislev in the twentieth year, while I was in the citadel of Susa,
chapters.zh: 哈迦利亚的儿子尼希米的言语如下。亚达薛西王二十年基斯流月，我在书珊城的宫中。

chapters.en: Hanani, one of my brothers, came from Judah with some other men, and I questioned them about the Jewish remnant that had survived the exile, and also about Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 那时，有我一个弟兄哈拿尼，同着几个人从犹大来。我问他们那些被掳归回，剩下逃脱的犹大人和耶路撒冷的光景。

chapters.en: They said to me, “Those who survived the exile and are back in the province are in great trouble and disgrace. The wall of Jerusalem is broken down, and its gates have been burned with fire.”
chapters.zh: 他们对我说，那些被掳归回剩下的人，在犹大省遭大难，受凌辱。并且耶路撒冷的城墙拆毁，城门被火焚烧。

chapters.en: When I heard these things, I sat down and wept. For some days I mourned and fasted and prayed before the God of heaven.
chapters.zh: 我听见这话，就坐下哭泣，悲哀几日。在天上的神面前禁食祈祷，说，

chapters.en: Then I said: “LORD, the God of heaven, the great and awesome God, who keeps his covenant of love with those who love him and keep his commandments,
chapters.zh: 耶和华天上的神，大而可畏的神阿，你向爱你，守你诫命的人守约施慈爱。

chapters.en: let your ear be attentive and your eyes open to hear the prayer your servant is praying before you day and night for your servants, the people of Israel. I confess the sins we Israelites, including myself and my father’s family, have committed against you.
chapters.zh: 愿你睁眼看，侧耳听，你仆人昼夜在你面前，为你众仆人以色列民的祈祷，承认我们以色列人向你所犯的罪。我与我父家都有罪了。

chapters.en: We have acted very wickedly toward you. We have not obeyed the commands, decrees and laws you gave your servant Moses.
chapters.zh: 我们向你所行的甚是邪恶，没有遵守你借着仆人，摩西所吩咐的诫命，律例，典章。

chapters.en: “Remember the instruction you gave your servant Moses, saying, ‘If you are unfaithful, I will scatter you among the nations,
chapters.zh: 求你记念所吩咐你仆人摩西的话，说，你们若犯罪，我就把你们分散在万民中。

chapters.en: but if you return to me and obey my commands, then even if your exiled people are at the farthest horizon, I will gather them from there and bring them to the place I have chosen as a dwelling for my Name.’
chapters.zh: 但你们若归向我，谨守遵行我的诫命，你们被赶散的人虽在天涯，我也必从那里将他们招聚回来，带到我所选择立为我名的居所。

chapters.en: “They are your servants and your people, whom you redeemed by your great strength and your mighty hand.
chapters.zh: 这都是你的仆人，你的百姓，就是你用大力，和大能的手所救赎的。

chapters.en: Lord, let your ear be attentive to the prayer of this your servant and to the prayer of your servants who delight in revering your name. Give your servant success today by granting him favor in the presence of this man.” I was cupbearer to the king.
chapters.zh: 主阿，求你侧耳听你仆人的祈祷，和喜爱敬畏你名众仆人的祈祷，使你仆人现今亨通，在王面前蒙恩。我是作王酒政的。

chapters.en: In the month of Nisan in the twentieth year of King Artaxerxes, when wine was brought for him, I took the wine and gave it to the king. I had not been sad in his presence before,
chapters.zh: 亚达薛西王二十年尼散月，在王面前摆酒，我拿起酒来奉给王。我素来在王面前没有愁容。

chapters.en: so the king asked me, “Why does your face look so sad when you are not ill? This can be nothing but sadness of heart.” I was very much afraid,
chapters.zh: 王对我说，你既没有病，为什么面带愁容呢？这不是别的，必是你心中愁烦。于是我甚惧怕。

chapters.en: but I said to the king, “May the king live forever! Why should my face not look sad when the city where my ancestors are buried lies in ruins, and its gates have been destroyed by fire?”
chapters.zh: 我对王说，愿王万岁。我列祖坟墓所在的那城荒凉，城门被火焚烧，我岂能面无愁容吗？

chapters.en: The king said to me, “What is it you want?” Then I prayed to the God of heaven,
chapters.zh: 王问我说，你要求什么。于是我默祷天上的神。

chapters.en: and I answered the king, “If it pleases the king and if your servant has found favor in his sight, let him send me to the city in Judah where my ancestors are buried so that I can rebuild it.”
chapters.zh: 我对王说，仆人若在王眼前蒙恩，王若喜欢，求王差遣我往犹大，到我列祖坟墓所在的那城去，我好重新建造。

chapters.en: Then the king, with the queen sitting beside him, asked me, “How long will your journey take, and when will you get back?” It pleased the king to send me; so I set a time.
chapters.zh: 那时王后坐在王的旁边。王问我说，你去要多少日子。几时回来。我就定了日期。于是王喜欢差遣我去。

chapters.en: I also said to him, “If it pleases the king, may I have letters to the governors of Trans-Euphrates, so that they will provide me safe-conduct until I arrive in Judah?
chapters.zh: 我又对王说，王若喜欢，求王赐我诏书，通知大河西的省长准我经过，直到犹大。

chapters.en: And may I have a letter to Asaph, keeper of the royal park, so he will give me timber to make beams for the gates of the citadel by the temple and for the city wall and for the residence I will occupy?” And because the gracious hand of my God was on me, the king granted my requests.
chapters.zh: 又赐诏书，通知管理王园林的亚萨，使他给我木料，作属殿营楼之门的横梁和城墙，与我自己房屋使用的。王就允准我，因我神施恩的手帮助我。

chapters.en: So I went to the governors of Trans-Euphrates and gave them the king’s letters. The king had also sent army officers and cavalry with me.
chapters.zh: 王派了军长和马兵护送我。我到了河西的省长那里，将王的诏书交给他们。

chapters.en: When Sanballat the Horonite and Tobiah the Ammonite official heard about this, they were very much disturbed that someone had come to promote the welfare of the Israelites.
chapters.zh: 和伦人参巴拉，并为奴的亚扪人多比雅，听见有人来为以色列人求好处，就甚恼怒。

chapters.en: I went to Jerusalem, and after staying there three days
chapters.zh: 我到了耶路撒冷，在那里住了三日。

chapters.en: I set out during the night with a few others. I had not told anyone what my God had put in my heart to do for Jerusalem. There were no mounts with me except the one I was riding on.
chapters.zh: 我夜间起来，有几个人也一同起来，但神使我心里要为耶路撒冷做什么事，我并没有告诉人。除了我骑的牲口以外，也没有别的牲口在我那里。

chapters.en: By night I went out through the Valley Gate toward the Jackal Well and the Dung Gate, examining the walls of Jerusalem, which had been broken down, and its gates, which had been destroyed by fire.
chapters.zh: 当夜我出了谷门，往野狗井去（野狗或作龙），到了粪厂门，察看耶路撒冷的城墙，见城墙拆毁，城门被火焚烧。

chapters.en: Then I moved on toward the Fountain Gate and the King’s Pool, but there was not enough room for my mount to get through;
chapters.zh: 我又往前，到了泉门和王池，但所骑的牲口没有地方过去。

chapters.en: so I went up the valley by night, examining the wall. Finally, I turned back and reentered through the Valley Gate.
chapters.zh: 于是夜间沿溪而上，察看城墙，又转身进入谷门，就回来了。

chapters.en: The officials did not know where I had gone or what I was doing, because as yet I had said nothing to the Jews or the priests or nobles or officials or any others who would be doing the work.
chapters.zh: 我往哪里去，我做什么事，官长都不知道。我还没有告诉犹大平民，祭司，贵胄，官长，和其余做工的人。

chapters.en: Then I said to them, “You see the trouble we are in: Jerusalem lies in ruins, and its gates have been burned with fire. Come, let us rebuild the wall of Jerusalem, and we will no longer be in disgrace.”
chapters.zh: 以后，我对他们说，我们所遭的难，耶路撒冷怎样荒凉，城门被火焚烧，你们都看见了。来吧，我们重建耶路撒冷的城墙，免得再受凌辱。

chapters.en: I also told them about the gracious hand of my God on me and what the king had said to me. They replied, “Let us start rebuilding.” So they began this good work.
chapters.zh: 我告诉他们我神施恩的手怎样帮助我，并王对我所说的话。他们就说，我们起来建造吧。于是他们奋勇做这善工。

chapters.en: But when Sanballat the Horonite, Tobiah the Ammonite official and Geshem the Arab heard about it, they mocked and ridiculed us. “What is this you are doing?” they asked. “Are you rebelling against the king?”
chapters.zh: 但和伦人参巴拉，并为奴的亚扪人多比雅，和亚拉伯人基善，听见就嗤笑我们，藐视我们，说，你们做什么呢？要背叛王吗？

chapters.en: I answered them by saying, “The God of heaven will give us success. We his servants will start rebuilding, but as for you, you have no share in Jerusalem or any claim or historic right to it.”
chapters.zh: 我回答他们说，天上的神必使我们亨通。我们作他仆人的，要起来建造。你们却在耶路撒冷无分，无权，无纪念。

chapters.en: Eliashib the high priest and his fellow priests went to work and rebuilt the Sheep Gate. They dedicated it and set its doors in place, building as far as the Tower of the Hundred, which they dedicated, and as far as the Tower of Hananel.
chapters.zh: 那时，大祭司以利亚实，和他的弟兄众祭司，起来建立羊门，分别为圣，安立门扇。又筑城墙到哈米亚楼，直到哈楠业楼，分别为圣。

chapters.en: The men of Jericho built the adjoining section, and Zakkur son of Imri built next to them.
chapters.zh: 其次是耶利哥人建造。其次是音利的儿子撒刻建造。

chapters.en: The Fish Gate was rebuilt by the sons of Hassenaah. They laid its beams and put its doors and bolts and bars in place.
chapters.zh: 哈西拿的子孙建立鱼门，架横梁，安门扇，和闩锁。

chapters.en: Meremoth son of Uriah, the son of Hakkoz, repaired the next section. Next to him Meshullam son of Berekiah, the son of Meshezabel, made repairs, and next to him Zadok son of Baana also made repairs.
chapters.zh: 其次是哈哥斯的孙子，乌利亚的儿子米利末修造。其次是米示萨别的孙子，比利迦的儿子米书兰修造。其次是巴拿的儿子撒督修造。

chapters.en: The next section was repaired by the men of Tekoa, but their nobles would not put their shoulders to the work under their supervisors.
chapters.zh: 其次是提哥亚人修造。但是他们的贵胄不用肩担他们主的工作（肩原文作颈项）。

chapters.en: The Jeshanah Gate was repaired by Joiada son of Paseah and Meshullam son of Besodeiah. They laid its beams and put its doors with their bolts and bars in place.
chapters.zh: 巴西亚的儿子，耶何耶大与比所玳的儿子，米书兰修造古门，架横梁，安门扇和闩锁。

chapters.en: Next to them, repairs were made by men from Gibeon and Mizpah—Melatiah of Gibeon and Jadon of Meronoth—places under the authority of the governor of Trans-Euphrates.
chapters.zh: 其次是基遍人米拉提，米伦人雅顿与基遍人，并属河西总督所管的米斯巴人修造。

chapters.en: Uzziel son of Harhaiah, one of the goldsmiths, repaired the next section; and Hananiah, one of the perfume-makers, made repairs next to that. They restored Jerusalem as far as the Broad Wall.
chapters.zh: 其次是银匠，哈海雅的儿子乌薛修造。其次是做香的哈拿尼雅修造。这些人修坚耶路撒冷，直到宽墙。

chapters.en: Rephaiah son of Hur, ruler of a half-district of Jerusalem, repaired the next section.
chapters.zh: 其次是管理耶路撒冷一半，户珥的儿子利法雅修造。

chapters.en: Adjoining this, Jedaiah son of Harumaph made repairs opposite his house, and Hattush son of Hashabneiah made repairs next to him.
chapters.zh: 其次是哈路抹的儿子，耶大雅对着自己的房屋修造。其次是哈沙尼的儿子哈突修造。

chapters.en: Malkijah son of Harim and Hasshub son of Pahath-Moab repaired another section and the Tower of the Ovens.
chapters.zh: 哈琳的儿子玛基雅，和巴哈摩押的儿子哈述修造一段，并修造炉楼。

chapters.en: Shallum son of Hallohesh, ruler of a half-district of Jerusalem, repaired the next section with the help of his daughters.
chapters.zh: 其次是管理耶路撒冷那一半，哈罗黑的儿子沙龙，和他的女儿们修造。

chapters.en: The Valley Gate was repaired by Hanun and the residents of Zanoah. They rebuilt it and put its doors with their bolts and bars in place. They also repaired a thousand cubits of the wall as far as the Dung Gate.
chapters.zh: 哈嫩和撒挪亚的居民修造谷门，立门，安门扇和闩锁，又建筑城墙一千肘，直到粪厂门。

chapters.en: The Dung Gate was repaired by Malkijah son of Rekab, ruler of the district of Beth Hakkerem. He rebuilt it and put its doors with their bolts and bars in place.
chapters.zh: 管理伯哈基琳，利甲的儿子玛基雅修造粪厂门，立门，安门扇和闩锁。

chapters.en: The Fountain Gate was repaired by Shallun son of Kol-Hozeh, ruler of the district of Mizpah. He rebuilt it, roofing it over and putting its doors and bolts and bars in place. He also repaired the wall of the Pool of Siloam, by the King’s Garden, as far as the steps going down from the City of David.
chapters.zh: 管理米斯巴，各荷西的儿子沙仑修造泉门，立门，盖门顶，安门扇和闩锁，又修造靠近王园西罗亚池的墙垣，直到那从大卫城下来的台阶。

chapters.en: Beyond him, Nehemiah son of Azbuk, ruler of a half-district of Beth Zur, made repairs up to a point opposite the tombs of David, as far as the artificial pool and the House of the Heroes.
chapters.zh: 其次是管理伯夙一半，押卜的儿子尼希米修造，直到大卫坟地的对面，又到挖成的池子，并勇士的房屋。

chapters.en: Next to him, the repairs were made by the Levites under Rehum son of Bani. Beside him, Hashabiah, ruler of half the district of Keilah, carried out repairs for his district.
chapters.zh: 其次是利未人，巴尼的儿子利宏修造。其次是管理基伊拉一半，哈沙比雅为他所管的本境修造。

chapters.en: Next to him, the repairs were made by their fellow Levites under Binnui son of Henadad, ruler of the other half-district of Keilah.
chapters.zh: 其次是利未人弟兄中管理基伊拉那一半，希拿达的儿子巴瓦伊修造。

chapters.en: Next to him, Ezer son of Jeshua, ruler of Mizpah, repaired another section, from a point facing the ascent to the armory as far as the angle of the wall.
chapters.zh: 其次是管理米斯巴，耶书亚的儿子以谢修造一段，对着武库的上坡，城墙转弯之处。

chapters.en: Next to him, Baruch son of Zabbai zealously repaired another section, from the angle to the entrance of the house of Eliashib the high priest.
chapters.zh: 其次是萨拜的儿子，巴录竭力修造一段，从城墙转弯，直到大祭司以利亚实的府门。

chapters.en: Next to him, Meremoth son of Uriah, the son of Hakkoz, repaired another section, from the entrance of Eliashib’s house to the end of it.
chapters.zh: 其次是哈哥斯的孙子，乌利亚的儿子米利末修造一段，从以利亚实的府门，直到以利亚实府的尽头。

chapters.en: The repairs next to him were made by the priests from the surrounding region.
chapters.zh: 其次是住平原的祭司修造。

chapters.en: Beyond them, Benjamin and Hasshub made repairs in front of their house; and next to them, Azariah son of Maaseiah, the son of Ananiah, made repairs beside his house.
chapters.zh: 其次是便雅悯与哈述，对着自己的房屋修造。其次是亚难尼的孙子，玛西雅的儿子，亚撒利雅在靠近自己的房屋修造。

chapters.en: Next to him, Binnui son of Henadad repaired another section, from Azariah’s house to the angle and the corner,
chapters.zh: 其次是希拿达的儿子，宾内修造一段，从亚撒利雅的房屋直到城墙转弯，又到城角。

chapters.en: and Palal son of Uzai worked opposite the angle and the tower projecting from the upper palace near the court of the guard. Next to him, Pedaiah son of Parosh
chapters.zh: 乌赛的儿子，巴拉修造对着城墙的转弯，和王上宫凸出来的城楼，靠近护卫院的那一段。其次是巴录的儿子毗大雅修造。

chapters.en: and the temple servants living on the hill of Ophel made repairs up to a point opposite the Water Gate toward the east and the projecting tower.
chapters.zh: （尼提宁住在俄斐勒，直到朝东水门的对面，和凸出来的城楼。）

chapters.en: Next to them, the men of Tekoa repaired another section, from the great projecting tower to the wall of Ophel.
chapters.zh: 其次是提哥亚人又修一段，对着那凸出来的大楼，直到俄斐勒的墙。

chapters.en: Above the Horse Gate, the priests made repairs, each in front of his own house.
chapters.zh: 从马门往上，众祭司各对自己的房屋修造。

chapters.en: Next to them, Zadok son of Immer made repairs opposite his house. Next to him, Shemaiah son of Shekaniah, the guard at the East Gate, made repairs.
chapters.zh: 其次是音麦的儿子，撒督对着自己的房屋修造。其次是守东门，示迦尼的儿子示玛雅修造。

chapters.en: Next to him, Hananiah son of Shelemiah, and Hanun, the sixth son of Zalaph, repaired another section. Next to them, Meshullam son of Berekiah made repairs opposite his living quarters.
chapters.zh: 其次是示利米雅的儿子哈拿尼雅，和萨拉的第六子哈嫩又修一段。其次是比利迦的儿子，米书兰对着自己的房屋修造。

chapters.en: Next to him, Malkijah, one of the goldsmiths, made repairs as far as the house of the temple servants and the merchants, opposite the Inspection Gate, and as far as the room above the corner;
chapters.zh: 其次是银匠玛基雅修造到尼提宁，和商人的房屋，对着哈米弗甲门，直到城的角楼。

chapters.en: and between the room above the corner and the Sheep Gate the goldsmiths and merchants made repairs.
chapters.zh: 银匠与商人在城的角楼，和羊门中间修造。

chapters.en: When Sanballat heard that we were rebuilding the wall, he became angry and was greatly incensed. He ridiculed the Jews,
chapters.zh: 参巴拉听见我们修造城墙就发怒，大大恼恨，嗤笑犹大人。

chapters.en: and in the presence of his associates and the army of Samaria, he said, “What are those feeble Jews doing? Will they restore their wall? Will they offer sacrifices? Will they finish in a day? Can they bring the stones back to life from those heaps of rubble—burned as they are?”
chapters.zh: 对他弟兄和撒玛利亚的军兵说，这些软弱的犹大人做什么呢？要保护自己吗？要献祭吗？要一日成功吗？要从土堆里拿出火烧的石头再立墙吗？

chapters.en: Tobiah the Ammonite, who was at his side, said, “What they are building—even a fox climbing up on it would break down their wall of stones!”
chapters.zh: 亚扪人多比雅站在旁边，说，他们所修造的石墙，就是狐狸上去也必崩裂。

chapters.en: Hear us, our God, for we are despised. Turn their insults back on their own heads. Give them over as plunder in a land of captivity.
chapters.zh: 我们的神阿，求你垂听，因为我们被藐视。求你使他们的毁谤归于他们的头上，使他们在掳到之地作为掠物。

chapters.en: Do not cover up their guilt or blot out their sins from your sight, for they have thrown insults in the face of the builders.
chapters.zh: 不要遮掩他们的罪孽，不要使他们的罪恶从你面前涂抹，因为他们在修造的人眼前惹动你的怒气。

chapters.en: So we rebuilt the wall till all of it reached half its height, for the people worked with all their heart.
chapters.zh: 这样，我们修造城墙，城墙就都连络，高至一半，因为百姓专心做工。

chapters.en: But when Sanballat, Tobiah, the Arabs, the Ammonites and the people of Ashdod heard that the repairs to Jerusalem’s walls had gone ahead and that the gaps were being closed, they were very angry.
chapters.zh: 参巴拉，多比雅，亚拉伯人，亚扪人，亚实突人听见修造耶路撒冷城墙，着手进行堵塞破裂的地方，就甚发怒。

chapters.en: They all plotted together to come and fight against Jerusalem and stir up trouble against it.
chapters.zh: 大家同谋要来攻击耶路撒冷，使城内扰乱。

chapters.en: But we prayed to our God and posted a guard day and night to meet this threat.
chapters.zh: 然而，我们祷告我们的神，又因他们的缘故，就派人看守，昼夜防备。

chapters.en: Meanwhile, the people in Judah said, “The strength of the laborers is giving out, and there is so much rubble that we cannot rebuild the wall.”
chapters.zh: 犹大人说，灰土尚多，扛抬的人力气已经衰败，所以我们不能建造城墙。

chapters.en: Also our enemies said, “Before they know it or see us, we will be right there among them and will kill them and put an end to the work.”
chapters.zh: 我们的敌人且说，趁他们不知，不见，我们进入他们中间，杀他们，使工作止住。

chapters.en: Then the Jews who lived near them came and told us ten times over, “Wherever you turn, they will attack us.”
chapters.zh: 那靠近敌人居住的犹大人，十次从各处来见我们，说，你们必要回到我们那里。

chapters.en: Therefore I stationed some of the people behind the lowest points of the wall at the exposed places, posting them by families, with their swords, spears and bows.
chapters.zh: 所以我使百姓各按宗族拿刀，拿枪，拿弓站在城墙后边低洼的空处。

chapters.en: After I looked things over, I stood up and said to the nobles, the officials and the rest of the people, “Don’t be afraid of them. Remember the Lord, who is great and awesome, and fight for your families, your sons and your daughters, your wives and your homes.”
chapters.zh: 我察看了，就起来对贵胄，官长，和其余的人说，不要怕他们。当记念主是大而可畏的。你们要为弟兄，儿女，妻子，家产争战。

chapters.en: When our enemies heard that we were aware of their plot and that God had frustrated it, we all returned to the wall, each to our own work.
chapters.zh: 仇敌听见我们知道他们的心意，见神也破坏他们的计谋，就不来了。我们都回到城墙那里，各作各的工。

chapters.en: From that day on, half of my men did the work, while the other half were equipped with spears, shields, bows and armor. The officers posted themselves behind all the people of Judah
chapters.zh: 从那日起，我的仆人一半做工，一半拿枪，拿盾牌，拿弓，穿铠甲（穿或作拿），官长都站在犹大众人的后边。

chapters.en: who were building the wall. Those who carried materials did their work with one hand and held a weapon in the other,
chapters.zh: 修造城墙的，扛抬材料的，都一手做工一手拿兵器。

chapters.en: and each of the builders wore his sword at his side as he worked. But the man who sounded the trumpet stayed with me.
chapters.zh: 修造的人都腰间佩刀修造，吹角的人在我旁边。

chapters.en: Then I said to the nobles, the officials and the rest of the people, “The work is extensive and spread out, and we are widely separated from each other along the wall.
chapters.zh: 我对贵胄，官长，和其余的人说，这工程浩大，我们在城墙上相离甚远。

chapters.en: Wherever you hear the sound of the trumpet, join us there. Our God will fight for us!”
chapters.zh: 你们听见角声在哪里，就聚集到我们那里去。我们的神必为我们争战。

chapters.en: So we continued the work with half the men holding spears, from the first light of dawn till the stars came out.
chapters.zh: 于是，我们做工，一半拿兵器，从天亮直到星宿出现的时候。

chapters.en: At that time I also said to the people, “Have every man and his helper stay inside Jerusalem at night, so they can serve us as guards by night and as workers by day.”
chapters.zh: 那时，我又对百姓说，各人和他的仆人，当在耶路撒冷住宿，好在夜间保守我们，白昼做工。

chapters.en: Neither I nor my brothers nor my men nor the guards with me took off our clothes; each had his weapon, even when he went for water.
chapters.zh: 这样，我和弟兄仆人，并跟从我的护兵都不脱衣服，出去打水也带兵器。

chapters.en: Now the men and their wives raised a great outcry against their fellow Jews.
chapters.zh: 百姓和他们的妻大大呼号，埋怨他们的弟兄犹大人。

chapters.en: Some were saying, “We and our sons and daughters are numerous; in order for us to eat and stay alive, we must get grain.”
chapters.zh: 有的说，我们和儿女人口众多，要去得粮食度命。

chapters.en: Others were saying, “We are mortgaging our fields, our vineyards and our homes to get grain during the famine.”
chapters.zh: 有的说，我们典了田地，葡萄园，房屋，要得粮食充饥。

chapters.en: Still others were saying, “We have had to borrow money to pay the king’s tax on our fields and vineyards.
chapters.zh: 有的说，我们已经指着田地，葡萄园，借了钱给王纳税。

chapters.en: Although we are of the same flesh and blood as our fellow Jews and though our children are as good as theirs, yet we have to subject our sons and daughters to slavery. Some of our daughters have already been enslaved, but we are powerless, because our fields and our vineyards belong to others.”
chapters.zh: 我们的身体与我们弟兄的身体一样。我们的儿女与他们的儿女一般。现在我们将要使儿女作人的仆婢，我们的女儿已有为婢的。我们并无力拯救，因为我们的田地，葡萄园已经归了别人。

chapters.en: When I heard their outcry and these charges, I was very angry.
chapters.zh: 我听见他们呼号说这些话，便甚发怒。

chapters.en: I pondered them in my mind and then accused the nobles and officials. I told them, “You are charging your own people interest!” So I called together a large meeting to deal with them
chapters.zh: 我心里筹划，就斥责贵胄和官长说，你们各人向弟兄取利。于是我招聚大会攻击他们。

chapters.en: and said: “As far as possible, we have bought back our fellow Jews who were sold to the Gentiles. Now you are selling your own people, only for them to be sold back to us!” They kept quiet, because they could find nothing to say.
chapters.zh: 我对他们说，我们尽力赎回我们弟兄，就是卖与外邦的犹大人。你们还要卖弟兄，使我们赎回来吗？他们就静默不语，无话可答。

chapters.en: So I continued, “What you are doing is not right. Shouldn’t you walk in the fear of our God to avoid the reproach of our Gentile enemies?
chapters.zh: 我又说，你们所行的不善。你们行事不当敬畏我们的神吗？不然，难免我们的仇敌外邦人毁谤我们。

chapters.en: I and my brothers and my men are also lending the people money and grain. But let us stop charging interest!
chapters.zh: 我和我的弟兄与仆人，也将银钱粮食借给百姓。我们大家都当免去利息。

chapters.en: Give back to them immediately their fields, vineyards, olive groves and houses, and also the interest you are charging them—one percent of the money, grain, new wine and olive oil.”
chapters.zh: 如今我劝你们将他们的田地，葡萄园，橄榄园，房屋，并向他们所取的银钱，粮食，新酒，和油，百分之一的利息都归还他们。

chapters.en: “We will give it back,” they said. “And we will not demand anything more from them. We will do as you say.” Then I summoned the priests and made the nobles and officials take an oath to do what they had promised.
chapters.zh: 众人说，我们必归还，不再向他们索要，必照你的话行。我就召了祭司来，叫众人起誓，必照着所应许的而行。

chapters.en: I also shook out the folds of my robe and said, “In this way may God shake out of their house and possessions anyone who does not keep this promise. So may such a person be shaken out and emptied!” At this the whole assembly said, “Amen,” and praised the LORD. And the people did as they had promised.
chapters.zh: 我也抖着胸前的衣襟，说，凡不成就这应许的，愿神照样抖他离开家产和他劳碌得来的，直到抖空了。会众都说，阿们。又赞美耶和华。百姓就照着所应许的去行。

chapters.en: Moreover, from the twentieth year of King Artaxerxes, when I was appointed to be their governor in the land of Judah, until his thirty-second year—twelve years—neither I nor my brothers ate the food allotted to the governor.
chapters.zh: 自从我奉派作犹大地的省长，就是从亚达薛西王二十年，直到三十二年，共十二年之久，我与我弟兄都没有吃省长的俸禄。

chapters.en: But the earlier governors—those preceding me—placed a heavy burden on the people and took forty shekels of silver from them in addition to food and wine. Their assistants also lorded it over the people. But out of reverence for God I did not act like that.
chapters.zh: 在我以前的省长加重百姓的担子，每日索要粮食和酒，并银子四十舍客勒，就是他们的仆人也辖制百姓。但我因敬畏神不这样行。

chapters.en: Instead, I devoted myself to the work on this wall. All my men were assembled there for the work; we did not acquire any land.
chapters.zh: 并且我恒心修造城墙，并没有置买田地。我的仆人也都聚集在那里做工。

chapters.en: Furthermore, a hundred and fifty Jews and officials ate at my table, as well as those who came to us from the surrounding nations.
chapters.zh: 除了从四围外邦中来的犹大人以外，有犹大平民和官长一百五十人在我席上吃饭。

chapters.en: Each day one ox, six choice sheep and some poultry were prepared for me, and every ten days an abundant supply of wine of all kinds. In spite of all this, I never demanded the food allotted to the governor, because the demands were heavy on these people.
chapters.zh: 每日预备一只公牛，六只肥羊，又预备些飞禽。每十日一次，多预备各样的酒。虽然如此，我并不要省长的俸禄，因为百姓服役甚重。

chapters.en: Remember me with favor, my God, for all I have done for these people.
chapters.zh: 我的神阿，求你记念我为这百姓所行的一切事，施恩与我。

chapters.en: When word came to Sanballat, Tobiah, Geshem the Arab and the rest of our enemies that I had rebuilt the wall and not a gap was left in it—though up to that time I had not set the doors in the gates—
chapters.zh: 参巴拉，多比雅，亚拉伯人基善，和我们其余的仇敌，听见我已经修完了城墙，其中没有破裂之处（那时我还没有安门扇）。

chapters.en: Sanballat and Geshem sent me this message: “Come, let us meet together in one of the villages on the plain of Ono.” But they were scheming to harm me;
chapters.zh: 参巴拉和基善就打发人来见我，说，请你来，我们在阿挪平原的一个村庄相会。他们却想害我。

chapters.en: so I sent messengers to them with this reply: “I am carrying on a great project and cannot go down. Why should the work stop while I leave it and go down to you?”
chapters.zh: 于是我差遣人去见他们，说，我现在办理大工，不能下去。焉能停工下去见你们呢？

chapters.en: Four times they sent me the same message, and each time I gave them the same answer.
chapters.zh: 他们这样四次打发人来见我，我都如此回答他们。

chapters.en: Then, the fifth time, Sanballat sent his aide to me with the same message, and in his hand was an unsealed letter
chapters.zh: 参巴拉第五次打发仆人来见我，手里拿着未封的信，

chapters.en: in which was written: “It is reported among the nations—and Geshem says it is true—that you and the Jews are plotting to revolt, and therefore you are building the wall. Moreover, according to these reports you are about to become their king
chapters.zh: 信上写着说，外邦人中有风声，迦施慕（就是基善见二章十九节）也说，你和犹大人谋反，修造城墙，你要作他们的王。

chapters.en: and have even appointed prophets to make this proclamation about you in Jerusalem: ‘There is a king in Judah!’ Now this report will get back to the king; so come, let us meet together.”
chapters.zh: 你又派先知在耶路撒冷指着你宣讲，说在犹大有王。现在这话必传与王知。所以请你来，与我们彼此商议。

chapters.en: I sent him this reply: “Nothing like what you are saying is happening; you are just making it up out of your head.”
chapters.zh: 我就差遣人去见他，说，你所说的这事，一概没有，是你心里捏造的。

chapters.en: They were all trying to frighten us, thinking, “Their hands will get too weak for the work, and it will not be completed.” But I prayed, “Now strengthen my hands.”
chapters.zh: 他们都要使我们惧怕，意思说，他们的手必软弱，以致工作不能成就。神阿，求你坚固我的手。

chapters.en: One day I went to the house of Shemaiah son of Delaiah, the son of Mehetabel, who was shut in at his home. He said, “Let us meet in the house of God, inside the temple, and let us close the temple doors, because men are coming to kill you—by night they are coming to kill you.”
chapters.zh: 我到了米希大别的孙子，第来雅的儿子示玛雅家里。那时，他闭门不出。他说，我们不如在神的殿里会面，将殿门关锁。因为他们要来杀你，就是夜里来杀你。

chapters.en: But I said, “Should a man like me run away? Or should someone like me go into the temple to save his life? I will not go!”
chapters.zh: 我说，像我这样的人岂要逃跑呢？像我这样的人岂能进入殿里保全生命呢？我不进去。

chapters.en: I realized that God had not sent him, but that he had prophesied against me because Tobiah and Sanballat had hired him.
chapters.zh: 我看明神没有差遣他，是他自己说这话攻击我，是多比雅和参巴拉贿买了他。

chapters.en: He had been hired to intimidate me so that I would commit a sin by doing this, and then they would give me a bad name to discredit me.
chapters.zh: 贿买他的缘故，是要叫我惧怕，依从他犯罪，他们好传扬恶言毁谤我。

chapters.en: Remember Tobiah and Sanballat, my God, because of what they have done; remember also the prophet Noadiah and how she and the rest of the prophets have been trying to intimidate me.
chapters.zh: 我的神阿，多比雅，参巴拉，女先知挪亚底，和其余的先知要叫我惧怕，求你记念他们所行的这些事。

chapters.en: So the wall was completed on the twenty-fifth of Elul, in fifty-two days.
chapters.zh: 以禄月二十五日，城墙修完了，共修了五十二天。

chapters.en: When all our enemies heard about this, all the surrounding nations were afraid and lost their self-confidence, because they realized that this work had been done with the help of our God.
chapters.zh: 我们一切仇敌，四围的外邦人听见了便惧怕，愁眉不展。因为见这工作完成是出乎我们的神。

chapters.en: Also, in those days the nobles of Judah were sending many letters to Tobiah, and replies from Tobiah kept coming to them.
chapters.zh: 在那些日子，犹大的贵胄屡次寄信与多比雅，多比雅也来信与他们。

chapters.en: For many in Judah were under oath to him, since he was son-in-law to Shekaniah son of Arah, and his son Jehohanan had married the daughter of Meshullam son of Berekiah.
chapters.zh: 在犹大有许多人与多比雅结盟。因他是亚拉的儿子，示迦尼的女婿，并且他的儿子，约哈难娶了比利迦儿子，米书兰的女儿为妻。

chapters.en: Moreover, they kept reporting to me his good deeds and then telling him what I said. And Tobiah sent letters to intimidate me.
chapters.zh: 他们常在我面前说多比雅的善行，也将我的话传与他。多比雅又常寄信来，要叫我惧怕。

chapters.en: After the wall had been rebuilt and I had set the doors in place, the gatekeepers, the musicians and the Levites were appointed.
chapters.zh: 城墙修完，我安了门扇，守门的，歌唱的，和利未人都已派定。

chapters.en: I put in charge of Jerusalem my brother Hanani, along with Hananiah the commander of the citadel, because he was a man of integrity and feared God more than most people do.
chapters.zh: 我就派我的弟兄哈拿尼，和营楼的宰官哈拿尼雅，管理耶路撒冷。因为哈拿尼雅是忠信的，又敬畏神过于众人。

chapters.en: I said to them, “The gates of Jerusalem are not to be opened until the sun is hot. While the gatekeepers are still on duty, have them shut the doors and bar them. Also appoint residents of Jerusalem as guards, some at their posts and some near their own houses.”
chapters.zh: 我吩咐他们说，等到太阳上升才可开耶路撒冷的城门。人尚看守的时候就要关门上闩。也当派耶路撒冷的居民，各按班次看守自己房屋对面之处。

chapters.en: Now the city was large and spacious, but there were few people in it, and the houses had not yet been rebuilt.
chapters.zh: 城是广大，其中的民却稀少，房屋还没有建造。

chapters.en: So my God put it into my heart to assemble the nobles, the officials and the common people for registration by families. I found the genealogical record of those who had been the first to return. This is what I found written there:
chapters.zh: 我的神感动我心，招聚贵胄，官长，和百姓，要照家谱计算。我找着第一次上来之人的家谱，其上写着。

chapters.en: These are the people of the province who came up from the captivity of the exiles whom Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon had taken captive (they returned to Jerusalem and Judah, each to his own town,
chapters.zh: 巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒，从前掳去犹大省的人，现在他们的子孙从被掳到之地回耶路撒冷和犹大，各归本城。

chapters.en: in company with Zerubbabel, Joshua, Nehemiah, Azariah, Raamiah, Nahamani, Mordecai, Bilshan, Mispereth, Bigvai, Nehum and Baanah): The list of the men of Israel:
chapters.zh: 他们是同着所罗巴伯，耶书亚，尼希米，亚撒利雅，拉米，拿哈玛尼，末底改，必珊，米斯毗列，比革瓦伊，尼宏，巴拿回来的。

chapters.en: the descendants of Parosh, 2,172
chapters.zh: 以色列人民的数目记在下面。巴录的子孙二千一百七十二名。

chapters.en: of Shephatiah, 372
chapters.zh: 示法提雅的子孙三百七十二名。

chapters.en: of Arah, 652
chapters.zh: 亚拉的子孙六百五十二名。

chapters.en: of Pahath-Moab (through the line of Jeshua and Joab), 2,818
chapters.zh: 巴哈摩押的后裔，就是耶书亚和约押的子孙二千八百一十八名。

chapters.en: of Elam, 1,254
chapters.zh: 以拦的子孙一千二百五十四名。

chapters.en: of Zattu, 845
chapters.zh: 萨土的子孙八百四十五名。

chapters.en: of Zaccai, 760
chapters.zh: 萨改的子孙七百六十名。

chapters.en: of Binnui, 648
chapters.zh: 宾内的子孙六百四十八名。

chapters.en: of Bebai, 628
chapters.zh: 比拜的子孙六百二十八名。

chapters.en: of Azgad, 2,322
chapters.zh: 押甲的子孙二千三百二十二名。

chapters.en: of Adonikam, 667
chapters.zh: 亚多尼干的子孙六百六十七名。

chapters.en: of Bigvai, 2,067
chapters.zh: 比革瓦伊的子孙二千零六十七名。

chapters.en: of Adin, 655
chapters.zh: 亚丁的子孙六百五十五名。

chapters.en: of Ater (through Hezekiah), 98
chapters.zh: 亚特的后裔，就是希西家的子孙九十八名。

chapters.en: of Hashum, 328
chapters.zh: 哈顺的子孙三百二十八名。

chapters.en: of Bezai, 324
chapters.zh: 比赛的子孙三百二十四名。

chapters.en: of Hariph, 112
chapters.zh: 哈拉的子孙一百一十二名。

chapters.en: of Gibeon, 95
chapters.zh: 基遍人九十五名。

chapters.en: the men of Bethlehem and Netophah, 188
chapters.zh: 伯利恒人和尼陀法人共一百八十八名。

chapters.en: of Anathoth, 128
chapters.zh: 亚拿突人一百二十八名。

chapters.en: of Beth Azmaveth, 42
chapters.zh: 伯亚斯玛弗人四十二名。

chapters.en: of Kiriath Jearim, Kephirah and Beeroth, 743
chapters.zh: 基列耶琳人，基非拉人，比录人共七百四十三名。

chapters.en: of Ramah and Geba, 621
chapters.zh: 拉玛人和迦巴人共六百二十一名。

chapters.en: of Micmash, 122
chapters.zh: 默玛人一百二十二名。

chapters.en: of Bethel and Ai, 123
chapters.zh: 伯特利人和艾人共一百二十三名。

chapters.en: of the other Nebo, 52
chapters.zh: 别的尼波人五十二名。

chapters.en: of the other Elam, 1,254
chapters.zh: 别的以拦子孙一千二百五十四名。

chapters.en: of Harim, 320
chapters.zh: 哈琳的子孙三百二十名。

chapters.en: of Jericho, 345
chapters.zh: 耶利哥人三百四十五名。

chapters.en: of Lod, Hadid and Ono, 721
chapters.zh: 罗德人，哈第人，阿挪人共七百二十一名。

chapters.en: of Senaah, 3,930
chapters.zh: 西拿人三千九百三十名。

chapters.en: The priests:
chapters.zh: 祭司。耶书亚家，耶大雅的子孙九百七十三名。

chapters.en: of Immer, 1,052
chapters.zh: 音麦的子孙一千零五十二名。

chapters.en: of Pashhur, 1,247
chapters.zh: 巴施户珥的子孙一千二百四十七名。

chapters.en: of Harim, 1,017
chapters.zh: 哈琳的子孙一千零一十七名。

chapters.en: The Levites:
chapters.zh: 利未人。何达威的后裔，就是耶书亚和甲篾的子孙七十四名。

chapters.en: The musicians:
chapters.zh: 歌唱的。亚萨的子孙一百四十八名。

chapters.en: The gatekeepers:
chapters.zh: 守门的。沙龙的子孙，亚特的子孙，达们的子孙，亚谷的子孙，哈底大的子孙，朔拜的子孙，共一百三十八名。

chapters.en: The temple servants:
chapters.zh: 尼提宁（就是殿役）。西哈的子孙，哈苏巴的子孙，答巴俄的子孙，

chapters.en: Keros, Sia, Padon,
chapters.zh: 基绿的子孙，西亚的子孙，巴顿的子孙，

chapters.en: Lebana, Hagaba, Shalmai,
chapters.zh: 利巴拿的子孙，哈迦巴的子孙，萨买的子孙，

chapters.en: Hanan, Giddel, Gahar,
chapters.zh: 哈难的子孙，吉德的子孙，迦哈的子孙，

chapters.en: Reaiah, Rezin, Nekoda,
chapters.zh: 利亚雅的子孙，利汛的子孙，尼哥大的子孙，

chapters.en: Gazzam, Uzza, Paseah,
chapters.zh: 迦散的子孙，乌撒的子孙，巴西亚的子孙，

chapters.en: Besai, Meunim, Nephusim,
chapters.zh: 比赛的子孙，米乌宁的子孙，尼普心的子孙，

chapters.en: Bakbuk, Hakupha, Harhur,
chapters.zh: 巴卜的子孙，哈古巴的子孙，哈忽的子孙，

chapters.en: Bazluth, Mehida, Harsha,
chapters.zh: 巴洗律的子孙，米希大的子孙，哈沙的子孙，

chapters.en: Barkos, Sisera, Temah,
chapters.zh: 巴柯的子孙，西西拉的子孙，答玛的子孙，

chapters.en: Neziah and Hatipha
chapters.zh: 尼细亚的子孙，哈提法的子孙。

chapters.en: The descendants of the servants of Solomon:
chapters.zh: 所罗门仆人的后裔，就是琐太的子孙，琐斐列的子孙，比路大的子孙，

chapters.en: Jaala, Darkon, Giddel,
chapters.zh: 雅拉的子孙，达昆的子孙，吉德的子孙，

chapters.en: Shephatiah, Hattil,
chapters.zh: 示法提雅的子孙，哈替的子孙，玻黑列哈斯巴音的子孙，亚们的子孙。

chapters.en: The temple servants and the descendants of the servants of Solomon, 392
chapters.zh: 尼提宁和所罗门仆人的后裔共三百九十二名。

chapters.en: The following came up from the towns of Tel Melah, Tel Harsha, Kerub, Addon and Immer, but they could not show that their families were descended from Israel:
chapters.zh: 从特米拉，特哈萨，基绿，亚顿，音麦上来的，不能指明他们的宗族谱系是以色列人不是。

chapters.en: the descendants of
chapters.zh: 他们是第莱雅的子孙，多比雅的子孙，尼哥大的子孙，共六百四十二名。

chapters.en: And from among the priests:
chapters.zh: 祭司中，哈巴雅的子孙，哈哥斯的子孙，巴西莱的子孙。因为他们的先祖娶了基列人，巴西莱的女儿为妻，所以起名叫巴西莱。

chapters.en: These searched for their family records, but they could not find them and so were excluded from the priesthood as unclean.
chapters.zh: 这三家的人，在族谱之中寻查自己的谱系，却寻不着，因此算为不洁，不准供祭司的职任。

chapters.en: The governor, therefore, ordered them not to eat any of the most sacred food until there should be a priest ministering with the Urim and Thummim.
chapters.zh: 省长对他们说，不可吃至圣的物，直到有用乌陵和土明，决疑的祭司兴起来。

chapters.en: The whole company numbered 42,360,
chapters.zh: 会众共有四万二千三百六十名。

chapters.en: besides their 7,337 male and female slaves; and they also had 245 male and female singers.
chapters.zh: 此外，还有他们的仆婢七千三百三十七名，又有歌唱的男女二百四十五名。

chapters.en: There were 736 horses, 245 mules,
chapters.zh: 他们有马七百三十六匹，骡子二百四十五匹，

chapters.en: 435 camels and 6,720 donkeys.
chapters.zh: 骆驼四百三十五只，驴六千七百二十匹。

chapters.en: Some of the heads of the families contributed to the work. The governor gave to the treasury 1,000 darics of gold, 50 bowls and 530 garments for priests.
chapters.zh: 有些族长为工程捐助。省长捐入库中的金子一千达利克，碗五十个，祭司的礼服五百三十件。

chapters.en: Some of the heads of the families gave to the treasury for the work 20,000 darics of gold and 2,200 minas of silver.
chapters.zh: 又有族长捐入工程库的金子，二万达利克，银子二千二百弥拿。

chapters.en: The total given by the rest of the people was 20,000 darics of gold, 2,000 minas of silver and 67 garments for priests.
chapters.zh: 其余百姓所捐的金子，二万达利克，银子二千弥拿，祭司的礼服六十七件。

chapters.en: The priests, the Levites, the gatekeepers, the musicians and the temple servants, along with certain of the people and the rest of the Israelites, settled in their own towns. When the seventh month came and the Israelites had settled in their towns,
chapters.zh: 于是祭司，利未人，守门的，歌唱的，民中的一些人，尼提宁，并以色列众人，各住在自己的城里。

chapters.en: all the people came together as one in the square before the Water Gate. They told Ezra the teacher of the Law to bring out the Book of the Law of Moses, which the LORD had commanded for Israel.
chapters.zh: 到了七月，以色列人住在自己的城里。那时，他们如同一人聚集在水门前的宽阔处，请文士以斯拉，将耶和华借摩西传给以色列人的律法书带来。

chapters.en: So on the first day of the seventh month Ezra the priest brought the Law before the assembly, which was made up of men and women and all who were able to understand.
chapters.zh: 七月初一日，祭司以斯拉将律法书，带到听了能明白的男女会众面前。

chapters.en: He read it aloud from daybreak till noon as he faced the square before the Water Gate in the presence of the men, women and others who could understand. And all the people listened attentively to the Book of the Law.
chapters.zh: 在水门前的宽阔处，从清早到晌午，在众男女，一切听了能明白的人面前读这律法书。众民侧耳而听。

chapters.en: Ezra the teacher of the Law stood on a high wooden platform built for the occasion. Beside him on his right stood Mattithiah, Shema, Anaiah, Uriah, Hilkiah and Maaseiah; and on his left were Pedaiah, Mishael, Malkijah, Hashum, Hashbaddanah, Zechariah and Meshullam.
chapters.zh: 文士以斯拉站在为这事特备的木台上。玛他提雅，示玛，亚奈雅，乌利亚，希勒家，和玛西雅站在他的右边。毗大雅，米沙利，玛基雅，哈顺，哈拔大拿，撒迦利亚，和米书兰站在他的左边。

chapters.en: Ezra opened the book. All the people could see him because he was standing above them; and as he opened it, the people all stood up.
chapters.zh: 以斯拉站在众民以上，在众民眼前展开这书。他一展开，众民就都站起来。

chapters.en: Ezra praised the LORD, the great God; and all the people lifted their hands and responded, “Amen! Amen!” Then they bowed down and worshiped the LORD with their faces to the ground.
chapters.zh: 以斯拉称颂耶和华至大的神。众民都举手应声说，阿们，阿们，就低头，面伏于地，敬拜耶和华。

chapters.en: The Levites—Jeshua, Bani, Sherebiah, Jamin, Akkub, Shabbethai, Hodiah, Maaseiah, Kelita, Azariah, Jozabad, Hanan and Pelaiah—instructed the people in the Law while the people were standing there.
chapters.zh: 耶书亚，巴尼，示利比，雅悯，亚谷，沙比太，荷第雅，玛西雅，基利他，亚撒利雅，约撒拔，哈难，毗莱雅，和利未人使百姓明白律法。百姓都站在自己的地方。

chapters.en: They read from the Book of the Law of God, making it clear and giving the meaning so that the people understood what was being read.
chapters.zh: 他们清清楚楚地念神的律法书，讲明意思，使百姓明白所念的。

chapters.en: Then Nehemiah the governor, Ezra the priest and teacher of the Law, and the Levites who were instructing the people said to them all, “This day is holy to the LORD your God. Do not mourn or weep.” For all the people had been weeping as they listened to the words of the Law.
chapters.zh: 省长尼希米和作祭司的文士以斯拉，并教训百姓的利未人，对众民说，今日是耶和华你们神的圣日，不要悲哀哭泣。这是因为众民听见律法书上的话都哭了。

chapters.en: Nehemiah said, “Go and enjoy choice food and sweet drinks, and send some to those who have nothing prepared. This day is holy to our Lord. Do not grieve, for the joy of the LORD is your strength.”
chapters.zh: 又对他们说，你们去吃肥美的，喝甘甜的，有不能预备的，就分给他。因为今日是我们主的圣日。你们不要忧愁，因靠耶和华而得的喜乐是你们的力量。

chapters.en: The Levites calmed all the people, saying, “Be still, for this is a holy day. Do not grieve.”
chapters.zh: 于是利未人使众民静默，说，今日是圣日。不要作声，也不要忧愁。

chapters.en: Then all the people went away to eat and drink, to send portions of food and to celebrate with great joy, because they now understood the words that had been made known to them.
chapters.zh: 众民都去吃喝，也分给人，大大快乐，因为他们明白所教训他们的话。

chapters.en: On the second day of the month, the heads of all the families, along with the priests and the Levites, gathered around Ezra the teacher to give attention to the words of the Law.
chapters.zh: 次日，众民的族长，祭司，和利未人都聚集到文士以斯拉那里，要留心听律法上的话。

chapters.en: They found written in the Law, which the LORD had commanded through Moses, that the Israelites were to live in temporary shelters during the festival of the seventh month
chapters.zh: 他们见律法上写着，耶和华借摩西吩咐以色列人要在七月节住棚，

chapters.en: and that they should proclaim this word and spread it throughout their towns and in Jerusalem: “Go out into the hill country and bring back branches from olive and wild olive trees, and from myrtles, palms and shade trees, to make temporary shelters”—as it is written.
chapters.zh: 并要在各城和耶路撒冷宣传报告说，你们当上山，将橄榄树，野橄榄树，番石榴树，棕树，和各样茂密树的枝子取来，照着所写的搭棚。

chapters.en: So the people went out and brought back branches and built themselves temporary shelters on their own roofs, in their courtyards, in the courts of the house of God and in the square by the Water Gate and the one by the Gate of Ephraim.
chapters.zh: 于是百姓出去，取了树枝来，各人在自己的房顶上，或院内，或神殿的院内，或水门的宽阔处，或以法莲门的宽阔处搭棚。

chapters.en: The whole company that had returned from exile built temporary shelters and lived in them. From the days of Joshua son of Nun until that day, the Israelites had not celebrated it like this. And their joy was very great.
chapters.zh: 从掳到之地归回的全会众就搭棚，住在棚里。从嫩的儿子约书亚的时候直到这日，以色列人没有这样行。于是众人大大喜乐。

chapters.en: Day after day, from the first day to the last, Ezra read from the Book of the Law of God. They celebrated the festival for seven days, and on the eighth day, in accordance with the regulation, there was an assembly.
chapters.zh: 从头一天，直到末一天，以斯拉每日念神的律法书。众人守节七日，第八日照例有严肃会。

chapters.en: On the twenty-fourth day of the same month, the Israelites gathered together, fasting and wearing sackcloth and putting dust on their heads.
chapters.zh: 这月二十四日，以色列人聚集禁食，身穿麻衣，头蒙灰尘。

chapters.en: Those of Israelite descent had separated themselves from all foreigners. They stood in their places and confessed their sins and the sins of their ancestors.
chapters.zh: 以色列人（人原文作种类）就与一切外邦人离绝，站着承认自己的罪恶和列祖的罪孽。

chapters.en: They stood where they were and read from the Book of the Law of the LORD their God for a quarter of the day, and spent another quarter in confession and in worshiping the LORD their God.
chapters.zh: 那日的四分之一，站在自己的地方，念耶和华他们神的律法书，又四分之一认罪，敬拜耶和华他们的神。

chapters.en: Standing on the stairs of the Levites were Jeshua, Bani, Kadmiel, Shebaniah, Bunni, Sherebiah, Bani and Kenani. They cried out with loud voices to the LORD their God.
chapters.zh: 耶书亚，巴尼，甲篾，示巴尼，布尼，示利比，巴尼，基拿尼站在利未人的台上，大声哀求耶和华他们的神。

chapters.en: And the Levites—Jeshua, Kadmiel, Bani, Hashabneiah, Sherebiah, Hodiah, Shebaniah and Pethahiah—said: “Stand up and praise the LORD your God, who is from everlasting to everlasting. ” “Blessed be your glorious name, and may it be exalted above all blessing and praise.
chapters.zh: 利未人耶书亚，甲篾，巴尼，哈沙尼，示利比，荷第雅，示巴尼，毗他希雅说，你们要站起来称颂耶和华你们的神，永世无尽。耶和华阿，你荣耀之名是应当称颂的。超乎一切称颂和赞美。

chapters.en: You alone are the LORD. You made the heavens, even the highest heavens, and all their starry host, the earth and all that is on it, the seas and all that is in them. You give life to everything, and the multitudes of heaven worship you.
chapters.zh: 你，惟独你是耶和华。你造了天和天上的天，并天上的万象，地和地上的万物，海和海中所有的。这一切都是你所保存的。天军也都敬拜你。

chapters.en: “You are the LORD God, who chose Abram and brought him out of Ur of the Chaldeans and named him Abraham.
chapters.zh: 你是耶和华神，曾拣选亚伯兰，领他出迦勒底的吾珥，给他改名叫亚伯拉罕。

chapters.en: You found his heart faithful to you, and you made a covenant with him to give to his descendants the land of the Canaanites, Hittites, Amorites, Perizzites, Jebusites and Girgashites. You have kept your promise because you are righteous.
chapters.zh: 你见他在你面前心里诚实，就与他立约。应许把迦南人，赫人，亚摩利人，比利洗人，耶布斯人，革迦撒人之地赐给他的后裔。且应验了你的话，因为你是公义的。

chapters.en: “You saw the suffering of our ancestors in Egypt; you heard their cry at the Red Sea.
chapters.zh: 你曾看见我们列祖在埃及所受的困苦，垂听他们在红海边的哀求。

chapters.en: You sent signs and wonders against Pharaoh, against all his officials and all the people of his land, for you knew how arrogantly the Egyptians treated them. You made a name for yourself, which remains to this day.
chapters.zh: 就施行神迹奇事在法老，和他一切臣仆，并他国中的众民身上。你也得了名声，正如今日一样，因为你知道他们向我们列祖行事狂傲。

chapters.en: You divided the sea before them, so that they passed through it on dry ground, but you hurled their pursuers into the depths, like a stone into mighty waters.
chapters.zh: 你又在我们列祖面前把海分开，使他们在海中行走干地，将追赶他们的人抛在深海，如石头抛在大水中。

chapters.en: By day you led them with a pillar of cloud, and by night with a pillar of fire to give them light on the way they were to take.
chapters.zh: 并且白昼用云柱引导他们，黑夜用火柱照亮他们当行的路。

chapters.en: “You came down on Mount Sinai; you spoke to them from heaven. You gave them regulations and laws that are just and right, and decrees and commands that are good.
chapters.zh: 你也降临在西乃山，从天上与他们说话，赐给他们正直的典章，真实的律法，美好的条例与诫命。

chapters.en: You made known to them your holy Sabbath and gave them commands, decrees and laws through your servant Moses.
chapters.zh: 又使他们知道你的安息圣日，并借你仆人摩西传给他们诫命，条例，律法。

chapters.en: In their hunger you gave them bread from heaven and in their thirst you brought them water from the rock; you told them to go in and take possession of the land you had sworn with uplifted hand to give them.
chapters.zh: 从天上赐下粮食充他们的饥，从磐石使水流出解他们的渴，又吩咐他们进去得你起誓应许赐给他们的地。

chapters.en: “But they, our ancestors, became arrogant and stiff-necked, and they did not obey your commands.
chapters.zh: 但我们的列祖行事狂傲，硬着颈项不听从你的诫命。

chapters.en: They refused to listen and failed to remember the miracles you performed among them. They became stiff-necked and in their rebellion appointed a leader in order to return to their slavery. But you are a forgiving God, gracious and compassionate, slow to anger and abounding in love. Therefore you did not desert them,
chapters.zh: 不肯顺从，也不记念你在他们中间所行的奇事，竟硬着颈项，居心背逆，自立首领，要回他们为奴之地。但你是乐意饶恕人，有恩典，有怜悯，不轻易发怒，有丰盛慈爱的神，并不丢弃他们。

chapters.en: even when they cast for themselves an image of a calf and said, ‘This is your god, who brought you up out of Egypt,’ or when they committed awful blasphemies.
chapters.zh: 他们虽然铸了一只牛犊，彼此说，这是领你出埃及的神。因而大大惹动你的怒气。

chapters.en: “Because of your great compassion you did not abandon them in the wilderness. By day the pillar of cloud did not fail to guide them on their path, nor the pillar of fire by night to shine on the way they were to take.
chapters.zh: 你还是大施怜悯，在旷野不丢弃他们。白昼，云柱不离开他们，仍引导他们行路。黑夜，火柱也不离开他们，仍照亮他们当行的路。

chapters.en: You gave your good Spirit to instruct them. You did not withhold your manna from their mouths, and you gave them water for their thirst.
chapters.zh: 你也赐下你良善的灵教训他们，未尝不赐吗哪使他们糊口，并赐水解他们的渴。

chapters.en: For forty years you sustained them in the wilderness; they lacked nothing, their clothes did not wear out nor did their feet become swollen.
chapters.zh: 在旷野四十年，你养育他们，他们就一无所缺。衣服没有穿破，脚也没有肿。

chapters.en: “You gave them kingdoms and nations, allotting to them even the remotest frontiers. They took over the country of Sihon king of Heshbon and the country of Og king of Bashan.
chapters.zh: 并且你将列国之地照分赐给他们，他们就得了西宏之地，希实本王之地，和巴珊王噩之地。

chapters.en: You made their children as numerous as the stars in the sky, and you brought them into the land that you told their parents to enter and possess.
chapters.zh: 你也使他们的子孙多如天上的星，带他们到你所应许他们列祖进入得为业之地。

chapters.en: Their children went in and took possession of the land. You subdued before them the Canaanites, who lived in the land; you gave the Canaanites into their hands, along with their kings and the peoples of the land, to deal with them as they pleased.
chapters.zh: 这样，他们进去得了那地，你在他们面前制伏那地的居民，就是迦南人。将迦南人和其君王，并那地的居民，都交在他们手里，让他们任意而待。

chapters.en: They captured fortified cities and fertile land; they took possession of houses filled with all kinds of good things, wells already dug, vineyards, olive groves and fruit trees in abundance. They ate to the full and were well-nourished; they reveled in your great goodness.
chapters.zh: 他们得了坚固的城邑，肥美的地土，充满各样美物的房屋，凿成的水井，葡萄园，橄榄园，并许多果木树。他们就吃而得饱，身体肥胖，因你的大恩，心中快乐。

chapters.en: “But they were disobedient and rebelled against you; they turned their backs on your law. They killed your prophets, who had warned them in order to turn them back to you; they committed awful blasphemies.
chapters.zh: 然而，他们不顺从，竟背叛你，将你的律法丢在背后，杀害那劝他们归向你的众先知，大大惹动你的怒气。

chapters.en: So you delivered them into the hands of their enemies, who oppressed them. But when they were oppressed they cried out to you. From heaven you heard them, and in your great compassion you gave them deliverers, who rescued them from the hand of their enemies.
chapters.zh: 所以你将他们交在敌人的手中，磨难他们。他们遭难的时候哀求你，你就从天上垂听，照你的大怜悯赐给他们拯救者，救他们脱离敌人的手。

chapters.en: “But as soon as they were at rest, they again did what was evil in your sight. Then you abandoned them to the hand of their enemies so that they ruled over them. And when they cried out to you again, you heard from heaven, and in your compassion you delivered them time after time.
chapters.zh: 但他们得平安之后，又在你面前行恶，所以你丢弃他们在仇敌的手中，使仇敌辖制他们。然而他们转回哀求你，你仍从天上垂听，屡次照你的怜悯拯救他们。

chapters.en: “You warned them in order to turn them back to your law, but they became arrogant and disobeyed your commands. They sinned against your ordinances, of which you said, ‘The person who obeys them will live by them.’ Stubbornly they turned their backs on you, became stiff-necked and refused to listen.
chapters.zh: 又警戒他们，要使他们归服你的律法。他们却行事狂傲，不听从你的诫命，干犯你的典章（人若遵行就必因此活着），扭转肩头，硬着颈项，不肯听从。

chapters.en: For many years you were patient with them. By your Spirit you warned them through your prophets. Yet they paid no attention, so you gave them into the hands of the neighboring peoples.
chapters.zh: 但你多年宽容他们，又用你的灵借众先知劝戒他们，他们仍不听从，所以你将他们交在列国之民的手中。

chapters.en: But in your great mercy you did not put an end to them or abandon them, for you are a gracious and merciful God.
chapters.zh: 然而你大发怜悯，不全然灭绝他们，也不丢弃他们。因为你是有恩典，有怜悯的神。

chapters.en: “Now therefore, our God, the great God, mighty and awesome, who keeps his covenant of love, do not let all this hardship seem trifling in your eyes—the hardship that has come on us, on our kings and leaders, on our priests and prophets, on our ancestors and all your people, from the days of the kings of Assyria until today.
chapters.zh: 我们的神阿，你是至大，至能，至可畏，守约施慈爱的神。我们的君王，首领，祭司，先知，列祖，和你的众民。从亚述列王的时候直到今日所遭遇的苦难，现在求你不要以为小。

chapters.en: In all that has happened to us, you have remained righteous; you have acted faithfully, while we acted wickedly.
chapters.zh: 在一切临到我们的事上，你却是公义的。因你所行的是诚实，我们所做的是邪恶。

chapters.en: Our kings, our leaders, our priests and our ancestors did not follow your law; they did not pay attention to your commands or the statutes you warned them to keep.
chapters.zh: 我们的君王，首领，祭司，列祖都不遵守你的律法。不听从你的诫命和你警戒他们的话。

chapters.en: Even while they were in their kingdom, enjoying your great goodness to them in the spacious and fertile land you gave them, they did not serve you or turn from their evil ways.
chapters.zh: 他们在本国里沾你大恩的时候，在你所赐给他们这广大肥美之地上不事奉你，也不转离他们的恶行。

chapters.en: “But see, we are slaves today, slaves in the land you gave our ancestors so they could eat its fruit and the other good things it produces.
chapters.zh: 我们现今作了奴仆。至于你所赐给我们列祖享受其上的土产，并美物之地，看哪，我们在这地上作了奴仆。

chapters.en: Because of our sins, its abundant harvest goes to the kings you have placed over us. They rule over our bodies and our cattle as they please. We are in great distress.
chapters.zh: 这地许多出产归了列王，就是你因我们的罪所派辖制我们的。他们任意辖制我们的身体和牲畜，我们遭了大难。

chapters.en: “In view of all this, we are making a binding agreement, putting it in writing, and our leaders, our Levites and our priests are affixing their seals to it.”
chapters.zh: 因这一切的事，我们立确实的约，写在册上。我们的首领，利未人，和祭司都签了名。

chapters.en: Those who sealed it were: Nehemiah the governor, the son of Hakaliah. Zedekiah,
chapters.zh: 签名的是，哈迦利亚的儿子省长尼希米，和西底家。

chapters.en: Seraiah, Azariah, Jeremiah,
chapters.zh: 祭司。西莱雅，亚撒利雅，耶利米，

chapters.en: Pashhur, Amariah, Malkijah,
chapters.zh: 巴施户珥，亚玛利雅，玛基雅，

chapters.en: Hattush, Shebaniah, Malluk,
chapters.zh: 哈突，示巴尼，玛鹿，

chapters.en: Harim, Meremoth, Obadiah,
chapters.zh: 哈琳，米利末，俄巴底亚，

chapters.en: Daniel, Ginnethon, Baruch,
chapters.zh: 但以理，近顿，巴录，

chapters.en: Meshullam, Abijah, Mijamin,
chapters.zh: 米书兰，亚比雅，米雅民，

chapters.en: Maaziah, Bilgai and Shemaiah. These were the priests.
chapters.zh: 玛西亚，璧该，示玛雅。

chapters.en: The Levites: Jeshua son of Azaniah, Binnui of the sons of Henadad, Kadmiel,
chapters.zh: 又有利未人，就是亚散尼的儿子耶书亚，希拿达的子孙宾内，甲篾。

chapters.en: and their associates: Shebaniah, Hodiah, Kelita, Pelaiah, Hanan,
chapters.zh: 还有他们的弟兄示巴尼，荷第雅，基利他，毗莱雅，哈难，

chapters.en: Mika, Rehob, Hashabiah,
chapters.zh: 米迦，利合，哈沙比雅，

chapters.en: Zakkur, Sherebiah, Shebaniah,
chapters.zh: 撒刻，示利比，示巴尼，

chapters.en: Hodiah, Bani and Beninu.
chapters.zh: 荷第雅，巴尼，比尼努。

chapters.en: The leaders of the people: Parosh, Pahath-Moab, Elam, Zattu, Bani,
chapters.zh: 又有民的首领，就是巴录，巴哈摩押，以拦，萨土，巴尼，

chapters.en: Bunni, Azgad, Bebai,
chapters.zh: 布尼，押甲，比拜，

chapters.en: Adonijah, Bigvai, Adin,
chapters.zh: 亚多尼雅，比革瓦伊，亚丁，

chapters.en: Ater, Hezekiah, Azzur,
chapters.zh: 亚特，希西家，押朔，

chapters.en: Hodiah, Hashum, Bezai,
chapters.zh: 荷第雅，哈顺，比赛，

chapters.en: Hariph, Anathoth, Nebai,
chapters.zh: 哈拉，亚拿突，尼拜，

chapters.en: Magpiash, Meshullam, Hezir,
chapters.zh: 抹比押，米书兰，希悉，

chapters.en: Meshezabel, Zadok, Jaddua,
chapters.zh: 米示萨别，撒督，押杜亚，

chapters.en: Pelatiah, Hanan, Anaiah,
chapters.zh: 毗拉提，哈难，亚奈雅，

chapters.en: Hoshea, Hananiah, Hasshub,
chapters.zh: 何细亚，哈拿尼雅，哈述，

chapters.en: Hallohesh, Pilha, Shobek,
chapters.zh: 哈罗黑，毗利哈，朔百，

chapters.en: Rehum, Hashabnah, Maaseiah,
chapters.zh: 利宏，哈沙拿，玛西雅，

chapters.en: Ahiah, Hanan, Anan,
chapters.zh: 亚希雅，哈难，亚难，

chapters.en: Malluk, Harim and Baanah.
chapters.zh: 玛鹿，哈琳，巴拿。

chapters.en: “The rest of the people—priests, Levites, gatekeepers, musicians, temple servants and all who separated themselves from the neighboring peoples for the sake of the Law of God, together with their wives and all their sons and daughters who are able to understand—
chapters.zh: 其余的民，祭司，利未人，守门的，歌唱的，尼提宁，和一切离绝邻邦居民归服神律法的，并他们的妻子，儿女，凡有知识能明白的。

chapters.en: all these now join their fellow Israelites the nobles, and bind themselves with a curse and an oath to follow the Law of God given through Moses the servant of God and to obey carefully all the commands, regulations and decrees of the LORD our Lord.
chapters.zh: 都随从他们贵胄的弟兄，发咒起誓，必遵行神借他仆人摩西所传的律法，谨守遵行耶和华我们主的一切诫命，典章，律例。

chapters.en: “We promise not to give our daughters in marriage to the peoples around us or take their daughters for our sons.
chapters.zh: 并不将我们的女儿嫁给这地的居民，也不为我们的儿子娶他们的女儿。

chapters.en: “When the neighboring peoples bring merchandise or grain to sell on the Sabbath, we will not buy from them on the Sabbath or on any holy day. Every seventh year we will forgo working the land and will cancel all debts.
chapters.zh: 这地的居民若在安息日，或什么圣日，带了货物或粮食来卖给我们，我们必不买。每逢第七年必不耕种，凡欠我们债的必不追讨。

chapters.en: “We assume the responsibility for carrying out the commands to give a third of a shekel each year for the service of the house of our God:
chapters.zh: 我们又为自己定例，每年各人捐银一舍客勒三分之一，为我们神殿的使用，

chapters.en: for the bread set out on the table; for the regular grain offerings and burnt offerings; for the offerings on the Sabbaths, at the New Moon feasts and at the appointed festivals; for the holy offerings; for sin offerings to make atonement for Israel; and for all the duties of the house of our God.
chapters.zh: 就是为陈设饼，常献的素祭，和燔祭，安息日，月朔，节期所献的与圣物，并以色列人的赎罪祭，以及我们神殿里一切的费用。

chapters.en: “We—the priests, the Levites and the people—have cast lots to determine when each of our families is to bring to the house of our God at set times each year a contribution of wood to burn on the altar of the LORD our God, as it is written in the Law.
chapters.zh: 我们的祭司，利未人，和百姓都掣签，看每年是哪一族按定期将献祭的柴奉到我们神的殿里。照着律法上所写的，烧在耶和华我们神的坛上。

chapters.en: “We also assume responsibility for bringing to the house of the LORD each year the firstfruits of our crops and of every fruit tree.
chapters.zh: 又定每年将我们地上初熟的土产，和各样树上初熟的果子，都奉到耶和华的殿里。

chapters.en: “As it is also written in the Law, we will bring the firstborn of our sons and of our cattle, of our herds and of our flocks to the house of our God, to the priests ministering there.
chapters.zh: 又照律法上所写的，将我们头胎的儿子，和首生的牛羊，都奉到我们神的殿，交给我们神殿里供职的祭司。

chapters.en: “Moreover, we will bring to the storerooms of the house of our God, to the priests, the first of our ground meal, of our grain offerings, of the fruit of all our trees and of our new wine and olive oil. And we will bring a tithe of our crops to the Levites, for it is the Levites who collect the tithes in all the towns where we work.
chapters.zh: 并将初熟之麦子所磨的面和举祭，各样树上初熟的果子，新酒与油奉给祭司，收在我们神殿的库房里，把我们地上所产的十分之一奉给利未人，因利未人在我们一切城邑的土产中当取十分之一。

chapters.en: A priest descended from Aaron is to accompany the Levites when they receive the tithes, and the Levites are to bring a tenth of the tithes up to the house of our God, to the storerooms of the treasury.
chapters.zh: 利未人取十分之一的时候，亚伦的子孙中，当有一个祭司与利未人同在。利未人也当从十分之一中取十分之一，奉到我们神殿的屋子里，收在库房中。

chapters.en: The people of Israel, including the Levites, are to bring their contributions of grain, new wine and olive oil to the storerooms, where the articles for the sanctuary and for the ministering priests, the gatekeepers and the musicians are also kept. “We will not neglect the house of our God.”
chapters.zh: 以色列人和利未人要将五谷，新酒，和油为举祭，奉到收存圣所器皿的屋子里，就是供职的祭司，守门的，歌唱的所住的屋子。这样，我们就不离弃我们神的殿。

chapters.en: Now the leaders of the people settled in Jerusalem. The rest of the people cast lots to bring one out of every ten of them to live in Jerusalem, the holy city, while the remaining nine were to stay in their own towns.
chapters.zh: 百姓的首领住在耶路撒冷。其余的百姓掣签，每十人中使一人来住在圣城耶路撒冷，那九人住在别的城邑。

chapters.en: The people commended all who volunteered to live in Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 凡甘心乐意住在耶路撒冷的，百姓都为他们祝福。

chapters.en: These are the provincial leaders who settled in Jerusalem (now some Israelites, priests, Levites, temple servants and descendants of Solomon’s servants lived in the towns of Judah, each on their own property in the various towns,
chapters.zh: 以色列人，祭司，利未人，尼提宁，和所罗门仆人的后裔都住在犹大城邑，各在自己的地业中。本省的首领住在耶路撒冷的，记在下面。

chapters.en: while other people from both Judah and Benjamin lived in Jerusalem): From the descendants of Judah: Athaiah son of Uzziah, the son of Zechariah, the son of Amariah, the son of Shephatiah, the son of Mahalalel, a descendant of Perez;
chapters.zh: 其中有些犹大人和便雅悯人。犹大人中有法勒斯的子孙，乌西雅的儿子亚他雅。乌西雅是撒迦利雅的儿子。撒迦利雅是亚玛利雅的儿子。亚玛利雅是示法提雅的儿子。示法提雅是玛勒列的儿子。

chapters.en: and Maaseiah son of Baruch, the son of Kol-Hozeh, the son of Hazaiah, the son of Adaiah, the son of Joiarib, the son of Zechariah, a descendant of Shelah.
chapters.zh: 又有巴录的儿子玛西雅。巴录是谷何西的儿子。谷何西是哈赛雅的儿子。哈赛雅是亚大雅的儿子。亚大雅是约雅立的儿子。约雅立是撒迦利雅的儿子。撒迦利雅是示罗尼的儿子。

chapters.en: The descendants of Perez who lived in Jerusalem totaled 468 men of standing.
chapters.zh: 住在耶路撒冷，法勒斯的子孙共四百六十八名，都是勇士。

chapters.en: From the descendants of Benjamin: Sallu son of Meshullam, the son of Joed, the son of Pedaiah, the son of Kolaiah, the son of Maaseiah, the son of Ithiel, the son of Jeshaiah,
chapters.zh: 便雅悯人中有米书兰的儿子撒路。米书兰是约叶的儿子。约叶是毗大雅的儿子。毗大雅是哥赖雅的儿子。哥赖雅是玛西雅的儿子。玛西雅是以铁的儿子。以铁是耶筛亚的儿子。

chapters.en: and his followers, Gabbai and Sallai—928 men.
chapters.zh: 其次有迦拜，撒来的子孙，共九百二十八名。

chapters.en: Joel son of Zikri was their chief officer, and Judah son of Hassenuah was over the New Quarter of the city.
chapters.zh: 细基利的儿子约珥是他们的长官。哈西努亚的儿子，犹大是耶路撒冷的副官。

chapters.en: From the priests: Jedaiah; the son of Joiarib; Jakin;
chapters.zh: 祭司中有雅斤，又有约雅立的儿子耶大雅。

chapters.en: Seraiah son of Hilkiah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Zadok, the son of Meraioth, the son of Ahitub, the official in charge of the house of God,
chapters.zh: 还有管理神殿的西莱雅，西莱雅是希勒家的儿子。希勒家是米书兰的儿子。米书兰是撒督的儿子。撒督是米拉约的儿子。米拉约是亚希突的儿子。

chapters.en: and their associates, who carried on work for the temple—822 men; Adaiah son of Jeroham, the son of Pelaliah, the son of Amzi, the son of Zechariah, the son of Pashhur, the son of Malkijah,
chapters.zh: 还有他们的弟兄在殿里供职的，共八百二十二名。又有耶罗罕的儿子亚大雅。耶罗罕是毗拉利的儿子。毗拉利是暗洗的儿子。暗洗是撒迦利亚的儿子。撒迦利亚是巴施户珥的儿子。巴施户珥是玛基雅的儿子。

chapters.en: and his associates, who were heads of families—242 men; Amashsai son of Azarel, the son of Ahzai, the son of Meshillemoth, the son of Immer,
chapters.zh: 还有他的弟兄作族长的，二百四十二名。又有亚萨列的儿子亚玛帅。亚萨列是亚哈赛的儿子。亚哈赛是米实利末的儿子。米实利末是音麦的儿子。

chapters.en: and his associates, who were men of standing—128. Their chief officer was Zabdiel son of Haggedolim.
chapters.zh: 还有他们弟兄，大能的勇士共一百二十八名。哈基多琳的儿子撒巴第业是他们的长官。

chapters.en: From the Levites: Shemaiah son of Hasshub, the son of Azrikam, the son of Hashabiah, the son of Bunni;
chapters.zh: 利未人中有哈述的儿子示玛雅。哈述是押利甘的儿子。押利甘是哈沙比雅的儿子。哈沙比雅是布尼的儿子。

chapters.en: Shabbethai and Jozabad, two of the heads of the Levites, who had charge of the outside work of the house of God;
chapters.zh: 又有利未人的族长，沙比太和约撒拔管理神殿的外事。

chapters.en: Mattaniah son of Mika, the son of Zabdi, the son of Asaph, the director who led in thanksgiving and prayer; Bakbukiah, second among his associates; and Abda son of Shammua, the son of Galal, the son of Jeduthun.
chapters.zh: 祈祷的时候，为称谢领首的是米迦的儿子玛他尼。米迦是撒底的儿子。撒底是亚萨的儿子。又有玛他尼弟兄中的八布迦为副。还有沙母亚的儿子押大。沙母亚是加拉的儿子。加拉是耶杜顿的儿子。

chapters.en: The Levites in the holy city totaled 284.
chapters.zh: 在圣城的利未人共二百八十四名。

chapters.en: The gatekeepers: Akkub, Talmon and their associates, who kept watch at the gates—172 men.
chapters.zh: 守门的是亚谷和达们，并守门的弟兄，共一百七十二名。

chapters.en: The rest of the Israelites, with the priests and Levites, were in all the towns of Judah, each on their ancestral property.
chapters.zh: 其余的以色列人，祭司，利未人都住在犹大的一切城邑，各在自己的地业中。

chapters.en: The temple servants lived on the hill of Ophel, and Ziha and Gishpa were in charge of them.
chapters.zh: 尼提宁却住在俄斐勒。西哈和基斯帕管理他们。

chapters.en: The chief officer of the Levites in Jerusalem was Uzzi son of Bani, the son of Hashabiah, the son of Mattaniah, the son of Mika. Uzzi was one of Asaph’s descendants, who were the musicians responsible for the service of the house of God.
chapters.zh: 在耶路撒冷，利未人的长官，管理神殿事务的是歌唱者亚萨的子孙，巴尼的儿子乌西。巴尼是哈沙比雅的儿子。哈沙比雅是玛他尼的儿子。玛他尼是米迦的儿子。

chapters.en: The musicians were under the king’s orders, which regulated their daily activity.
chapters.zh: 王为歌唱的出命令，每日供给他们必有一定之粮。

chapters.en: Pethahiah son of Meshezabel, one of the descendants of Zerah son of Judah, was the king’s agent in all affairs relating to the people.
chapters.zh: 犹大儿子谢拉的子孙，米示萨别的儿子毗他希雅，辅助王办理犹大民的事。

chapters.en: As for the villages with their fields, some of the people of Judah lived in Kiriath Arba and its surrounding settlements, in Dibon and its settlements, in Jekabzeel and its villages,
chapters.zh: 至于庄村和属庄村的田地，有犹大人住在基列亚巴，和属基列亚巴的乡村。底本和属底本的乡村。叶甲薛和属叶甲薛的庄村。

chapters.en: in Jeshua, in Moladah, in Beth Pelet,
chapters.zh: 耶书亚，摩拉大，伯帕列，

chapters.en: in Hazar Shual, in Beersheba and its settlements,
chapters.zh: 哈萨书亚，别是巴，和属别是巴的乡村。

chapters.en: in Ziklag, in Mekonah and its settlements,
chapters.zh: 洗革拉，米哥拿，和属米哥拿的乡村。

chapters.en: in En Rimmon, in Zorah, in Jarmuth,
chapters.zh: 音临门，琐拉，耶末，

chapters.en: Zanoah, Adullam and their villages, in Lachish and its fields, and in Azekah and its settlements. So they were living all the way from Beersheba to the Valley of Hinnom.
chapters.zh: 撒挪亚，亚杜兰，和属这两处的庄村。拉吉和属拉吉的田地。亚西加和属亚西加的乡村。他们所住的地方是从别是巴直到欣嫩谷。

chapters.en: The descendants of the Benjamites from Geba lived in Mikmash, Aija, Bethel and its settlements,
chapters.zh: 便雅悯人从迦巴起，住在密抹，亚雅，伯特利和属伯特利的乡村。

chapters.en: in Anathoth, Nob and Ananiah,
chapters.zh: 亚拿突，挪伯，亚难雅，

chapters.en: in Hazor, Ramah and Gittaim,
chapters.zh: 夏琐，拉玛，基他音，

chapters.en: in Hadid, Zeboim and Neballat,
chapters.zh: 哈叠，洗编，尼八拉，

chapters.en: in Lod and Ono, and in Ge Harashim.
chapters.zh: 罗德，阿挪，匠人之谷。

chapters.en: Some of the divisions of the Levites of Judah settled in Benjamin.
chapters.zh: 利未人中有几班曾住在犹大地归于便雅悯的。

chapters.en: These were the priests and Levites who returned with Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel and with Joshua: Seraiah, Jeremiah, Ezra,
chapters.zh: 同着撒拉铁的儿子所罗巴伯，和耶书亚回来的祭司，与利未人记在下面。祭司是西莱雅，耶利米，以斯拉，

chapters.en: Amariah, Malluk, Hattush,
chapters.zh: 亚玛利雅，玛鹿，哈突，

chapters.en: Shekaniah, Rehum, Meremoth,
chapters.zh: 示迦尼，利宏，米利末，

chapters.en: Iddo, Ginnethon, Abijah,
chapters.zh: 易多，近顿，亚比雅，

chapters.en: Mijamin, Moadiah, Bilgah,
chapters.zh: 米雅民，玛底雅，璧迦，

chapters.en: Shemaiah, Joiarib, Jedaiah,
chapters.zh: 示玛雅，约雅立，耶大雅，

chapters.en: Sallu, Amok, Hilkiah and Jedaiah. These were the leaders of the priests and their associates in the days of Joshua.
chapters.zh: 撒路，亚木，希勒家，耶大雅。这些人在耶书亚的时候作祭司，和他们弟兄的首领。

chapters.en: The Levites were Jeshua, Binnui, Kadmiel, Sherebiah, Judah, and also Mattaniah, who, together with his associates, was in charge of the songs of thanksgiving.
chapters.zh: 利未人是耶书亚，宾内，甲篾，示利比，犹大，玛他尼。这玛他尼和他的弟兄管理称谢的事。

chapters.en: Bakbukiah and Unni, their associates, stood opposite them in the services.
chapters.zh: 他们的弟兄八布迦，和乌尼照自己的班次与他们相对。

chapters.en: Joshua was the father of Joiakim, Joiakim the father of Eliashib, Eliashib the father of Joiada,
chapters.zh: 耶书亚生约雅金。约雅金生以利亚实。以利亚实生耶何耶大。

chapters.en: Joiada the father of Jonathan, and Jonathan the father of Jaddua.
chapters.zh: 耶何耶大生约拿单。约拿单生押杜亚。

chapters.en: In the days of Joiakim, these were the heads of the priestly families: of Seraiah’s family, Meraiah; of Jeremiah’s, Hananiah;
chapters.zh: 在约雅金的时候，祭司作族长的西莱雅族（或作班本段同）有米拉雅。耶利米族有哈拿尼雅。

chapters.en: of Ezra’s, Meshullam; of Amariah’s, Jehohanan;
chapters.zh: 以斯拉族有米书兰。亚玛利雅族有约哈难。

chapters.en: of Malluk’s, Jonathan; of Shekaniah’s, Joseph;
chapters.zh: 米利古族有约拿单。示巴尼族有约瑟。

chapters.en: of Harim’s, Adna; of Meremoth’s, Helkai;
chapters.zh: 哈琳族有押拿。米拉约族有希勒恺。

chapters.en: of Iddo’s, Zechariah; of Ginnethon’s, Meshullam;
chapters.zh: 易多族有撒迦利亚。近顿族有米书兰。

chapters.en: of Abijah’s, Zikri; of Miniamin’s and of Moadiah’s, Piltai;
chapters.zh: 亚比雅族有细基利。米拿民族某。摩亚底族有毗勒太。

chapters.en: of Bilgah’s, Shammua; of Shemaiah’s, Jehonathan;
chapters.zh: 璧迦族有沙母亚。示玛雅族有约拿单。

chapters.en: of Joiarib’s, Mattenai; of Jedaiah’s, Uzzi;
chapters.zh: 约雅立族有玛特乃。耶大雅族有乌西。

chapters.en: of Sallu’s, Kallai; of Amok’s, Eber;
chapters.zh: 撒来族有加莱。亚木族有希伯。

chapters.en: of Hilkiah’s, Hashabiah; of Jedaiah’s, Nethanel.
chapters.zh: 希勒家族有哈沙比雅。耶大雅族有拿坦业。

chapters.en: The family heads of the Levites in the days of Eliashib, Joiada, Johanan and Jaddua, as well as those of the priests, were recorded in the reign of Darius the Persian.
chapters.zh: 至于利未人，当以利亚实，耶何耶大，约哈难，押杜亚的时候，他们的族长记在册上。波斯王大利乌在位的时候，作族长的祭司也记在册上。

chapters.en: The family heads among the descendants of Levi up to the time of Johanan son of Eliashib were recorded in the book of the annals.
chapters.zh: 利未人作族长的记在历史上，直到以利亚实的儿子约哈难的时候。

chapters.en: And the leaders of the Levites were Hashabiah, Sherebiah, Jeshua son of Kadmiel, and their associates, who stood opposite them to give praise and thanksgiving, one section responding to the other, as prescribed by David the man of God.
chapters.zh: 利未人的族长是哈沙比雅，示利比，甲篾的儿子耶书亚，与他们弟兄的班次相对，照着神人大卫的命令一班一班地赞美称谢。

chapters.en: Mattaniah, Bakbukiah, Obadiah, Meshullam, Talmon and Akkub were gatekeepers who guarded the storerooms at the gates.
chapters.zh: 玛他尼，八布迦，俄巴底亚，米书兰，达们，亚谷是守门的，就是在库房那里守门。

chapters.en: They served in the days of Joiakim son of Joshua, the son of Jozadak, and in the days of Nehemiah the governor and of Ezra the priest, the teacher of the Law.
chapters.zh: 这都是在约撒达的孙子，耶书亚的儿子约雅金，和省长尼希米，并祭司文士以斯拉的时候，有职任的。

chapters.en: At the dedication of the wall of Jerusalem, the Levites were sought out from where they lived and were brought to Jerusalem to celebrate joyfully the dedication with songs of thanksgiving and with the music of cymbals, harps and lyres.
chapters.zh: 耶路撒冷城墙告成的时候，众民就把各处的利未人，招到耶路撒冷，要称谢，歌唱，敲钹，鼓瑟，弹琴，欢欢喜喜地行告成之礼。

chapters.en: The musicians also were brought together from the region around Jerusalem—from the villages of the Netophathites,
chapters.zh: 歌唱的人从耶路撒冷的周围，和尼陀法的村庄与伯吉甲，又从迦巴和押玛弗的田地聚集，因为歌唱的人在耶路撒冷四围为自己立了村庄。

chapters.en: from Beth Gilgal, and from the area of Geba and Azmaveth, for the musicians had built villages for themselves around Jerusalem.
When the priests and Levites had purified themselves ceremonially, they purified the people, the gates and the wall.
chapters.zh: 祭司和利未人就洁净自己，也洁净百姓和城门，并城墙。

chapters.en: I had the leaders of Judah go up on top of the wall. I also assigned two large choirs to give thanks. One was to proceed on top of the wall to the right, toward the Dung Gate.
chapters.zh: 我带犹大的首领上城，使称谢的人分为两大队，排列而行。第一队在城上往右边向粪厂门行走。

chapters.en: Hoshaiah and half the leaders of Judah followed them,
chapters.zh: 在他们后头的有何沙雅，与犹大首领的一半。

chapters.en: along with Azariah, Ezra, Meshullam,
chapters.zh: 又有亚撒利雅，以斯拉，米书兰，

chapters.en: Judah, Benjamin, Shemaiah, Jeremiah,
chapters.zh: 犹大，便雅悯，示玛雅，耶利米。

chapters.en: as well as some priests with trumpets, and also Zechariah son of Jonathan, the son of Shemaiah, the son of Mattaniah, the son of Micaiah, the son of Zakkur, the son of Asaph,
chapters.zh: 还有些吹号之祭司的子孙，约拿单的儿子撒迦利亚。约拿单是示玛雅的儿子。示玛雅是玛他尼的儿子。玛他尼是米该亚的儿子。米该亚是撒刻的儿子。撒刻是亚萨的儿子。

chapters.en: and his associates—Shemaiah, Azarel, Milalai, Gilalai, Maai, Nethanel, Judah and Hanani—with musical instruments prescribed by David the man of God. Ezra the teacher of the Law led the procession.
chapters.zh: 又有撒迦利亚的弟兄示玛雅，亚撒利，米拉莱，基拉莱，玛艾，拿坦业，犹大，哈拿尼，都拿着神人大卫的乐器，文士以斯拉引领他们。

chapters.en: At the Fountain Gate they continued directly up the steps of the City of David on the ascent to the wall and passed above the site of David’s palace to the Water Gate on the east.
chapters.zh: 他们经过泉门往前，从大卫城的台阶随地势而上，在大卫宫殿以上，直行到朝东的水门。

chapters.en: The second choir proceeded in the opposite direction. I followed them on top of the wall, together with half the people—past the Tower of the Ovens to the Broad Wall,
chapters.zh: 第二队称谢的人，要与那一队相迎而行。我和民的一半跟随他们，在城墙上过了炉楼，直到宽墙。

chapters.en: over the Gate of Ephraim, the Jeshanah Gate, the Fish Gate, the Tower of Hananel and the Tower of the Hundred, as far as the Sheep Gate. At the Gate of the Guard they stopped.
chapters.zh: 又过了以法莲门，古门，鱼门，哈楠业楼，哈米亚楼，直到羊门，就在护卫门站住。

chapters.en: The two choirs that gave thanks then took their places in the house of God; so did I, together with half the officials,
chapters.zh: 于是，这两队称谢的人连我，和官长的一半，站在神的殿里。

chapters.en: as well as the priests—Eliakim, Maaseiah, Miniamin, Micaiah, Elioenai, Zechariah and Hananiah with their trumpets—
chapters.zh: 还有祭司以利亚金，玛西雅，米拿民，米该雅，以利约乃，撒迦利亚，哈楠尼亚吹号。

chapters.en: and also Maaseiah, Shemaiah, Eleazar, Uzzi, Jehohanan, Malkijah, Elam and Ezer. The choirs sang under the direction of Jezrahiah.
chapters.zh: 又有玛西雅，示玛雅，以利亚撒，乌西，约哈难，玛基雅，以拦，和以谢奏乐。歌唱的就大声歌唱，伊斯拉希雅管理他们。

chapters.en: And on that day they offered great sacrifices, rejoicing because God had given them great joy. The women and children also rejoiced. The sound of rejoicing in Jerusalem could be heard far away.
chapters.zh: 那日，众人献大祭而欢乐。因为神使他们大大欢乐，连妇女带孩童也都欢乐，甚至耶路撒冷中的欢声听到远处。

chapters.en: At that time men were appointed to be in charge of the storerooms for the contributions, firstfruits and tithes. From the fields around the towns they were to bring into the storerooms the portions required by the Law for the priests and the Levites, for Judah was pleased with the ministering priests and Levites.
chapters.zh: 当日，派人管理库房，将举祭，初熟之物，和所取的十分之一，就是按各城田地，照律法所定归给祭司和利未人的分，都收在里头。犹大人因祭司和利未人供职，就欢乐了。

chapters.en: They performed the service of their God and the service of purification, as did also the musicians and gatekeepers, according to the commands of David and his son Solomon.
chapters.zh: 祭司利未人遵守神所吩咐的，并守洁净的礼。歌唱的，守门的，照着大卫和他儿子所罗门的命令也如此行。

chapters.en: For long ago, in the days of David and Asaph, there had been directors for the musicians and for the songs of praise and thanksgiving to God.
chapters.zh: 古时，在大卫和亚萨的日子，有歌唱的伶长，并有赞美称谢神的诗歌。

chapters.en: So in the days of Zerubbabel and of Nehemiah, all Israel contributed the daily portions for the musicians and the gatekeepers. They also set aside the portion for the other Levites, and the Levites set aside the portion for the descendants of Aaron.
chapters.zh: 当所罗巴伯和尼希米的时候，以色列众人将歌唱的，守门的，每日所当得的分供给他们，又给利未人当得的分。利未人又给亚伦的子孙当得的分。

chapters.en: On that day the Book of Moses was read aloud in the hearing of the people and there it was found written that no Ammonite or Moabite should ever be admitted into the assembly of God,
chapters.zh: 当日，人念摩西的律法书给百姓听，遇见书上写着说，亚扪人和摩押人永不可入神的会。

chapters.en: because they had not met the Israelites with food and water but had hired Balaam to call a curse down on them. (Our God, however, turned the curse into a blessing.)
chapters.zh: 因为他们没有拿食物，和水来迎接以色列人，且雇了巴兰咒诅他们，但我们的神使那咒诅变为祝福。

chapters.en: When the people heard this law, they excluded from Israel all who were of foreign descent.
chapters.zh: 以色列民听见这律法，就与一切闲杂人绝交。

chapters.en: Before this, Eliashib the priest had been put in charge of the storerooms of the house of our God. He was closely associated with Tobiah,
chapters.zh: 先是蒙派管理我们神殿中库房，的祭司以利亚实与多比雅结亲。

chapters.en: and he had provided him with a large room formerly used to store the grain offerings and incense and temple articles, and also the tithes of grain, new wine and olive oil prescribed for the Levites, musicians and gatekeepers, as well as the contributions for the priests.
chapters.zh: 便为他预备一间大屋子，就是从前收存素祭，乳香，器皿，和照命令供给利未人，歌唱的，守门的五谷，新酒，和油的十分之一，并归祭司举祭的屋子。

chapters.en: But while all this was going on, I was not in Jerusalem, for in the thirty-second year of Artaxerxes king of Babylon I had returned to the king. Some time later I asked his permission
chapters.zh: 那时我不在耶路撒冷。因为巴比伦王亚达薛西三十二年，我回到王那里。过了多日，我向王告假。

chapters.en: and came back to Jerusalem. Here I learned about the evil thing Eliashib had done in providing Tobiah a room in the courts of the house of God.
chapters.zh: 我来到耶路撒冷，就知道以利亚实为多比雅在神殿的院内，预备屋子的那件恶事。

chapters.en: I was greatly displeased and threw all Tobiah’s household goods out of the room.
chapters.zh: 我甚恼怒，就把多比雅的一切家具从屋里都抛出去。

chapters.en: I gave orders to purify the rooms, and then I put back into them the equipment of the house of God, with the grain offerings and the incense.
chapters.zh: 吩咐人洁净这屋子，遂将神殿的器皿和素祭，乳香又搬进去。

chapters.en: I also learned that the portions assigned to the Levites had not been given to them, and that all the Levites and musicians responsible for the service had gone back to their own fields.
chapters.zh: 我见利未人所当得的分，无人供给他们，甚至供职的利未人与歌唱的，俱各奔回自己的田地去了。

chapters.en: So I rebuked the officials and asked them, “Why is the house of God neglected?” Then I called them together and stationed them at their posts.
chapters.zh: 我就斥责官长说，为何离弃神的殿呢？我便招聚利未人，使他们照旧供职。

chapters.en: All Judah brought the tithes of grain, new wine and olive oil into the storerooms.
chapters.zh: 犹大众人就把五谷，新酒，和油的十分之一送入库房。

chapters.en: I put Shelemiah the priest, Zadok the scribe, and a Levite named Pedaiah in charge of the storerooms and made Hanan son of Zakkur, the son of Mattaniah, their assistant, because they were considered trustworthy. They were made responsible for distributing the supplies to their fellow Levites.
chapters.zh: 我派祭司示利米雅，文士撒督，和利未人毗大雅作库官管理库房。副官是哈难。哈难是撒刻的儿子。撒刻是玛他尼的儿子。这些人都是忠信的，他们的职分是将所供给的分给他们的弟兄。

chapters.en: Remember me for this, my God, and do not blot out what I have so faithfully done for the house of my God and its services.
chapters.zh: 我的神阿，求你因这事记念我，不要涂抹我为神的殿，与其中的礼节所行的善。

chapters.en: In those days I saw people in Judah treading winepresses on the Sabbath and bringing in grain and loading it on donkeys, together with wine, grapes, figs and all other kinds of loads. And they were bringing all this into Jerusalem on the Sabbath. Therefore I warned them against selling food on that day.
chapters.zh: 那些日子，我在犹大见有人在安息日榨酒（原文作踹酒榨），搬运禾捆驮在驴上。又把酒，葡萄，无花果，和各样的担子在安息日担入耶路撒冷，我就在他们卖食物的那日警戒他们。

chapters.en: People from Tyre who lived in Jerusalem were bringing in fish and all kinds of merchandise and selling them in Jerusalem on the Sabbath to the people of Judah.
chapters.zh: 又有推罗人住在耶路撒冷。他们把鱼和各样货物运进来，在安息日卖给犹大人。

chapters.en: I rebuked the nobles of Judah and said to them, “What is this wicked thing you are doing—desecrating the Sabbath day?
chapters.zh: 我就斥责犹大的贵胄说，你们怎么行这恶事犯了安息日呢？

chapters.en: Didn’t your ancestors do the same things, so that our God brought all this calamity on us and on this city? Now you are stirring up more wrath against Israel by desecrating the Sabbath.”
chapters.zh: 从前你们列祖岂不是这样行，以致我们神使一切灾祸临到我们，和这城吗？现在你们还犯安息日，使忿怒越发临到以色列。

chapters.en: When evening shadows fell on the gates of Jerusalem before the Sabbath, I ordered the doors to be shut and not opened until the Sabbath was over. I stationed some of my own men at the gates so that no load could be brought in on the Sabbath day.
chapters.zh: 在安息日的前一日，耶路撒冷城门有黑影的时候，我就吩咐人将门关锁，不过安息日不准开放。我又派我几个仆人管理城门，免得有人在安息日担什么担子进城。

chapters.en: Once or twice the merchants and sellers of all kinds of goods spent the night outside Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 于是商人和贩卖各样货物的，一两次住宿在耶路撒冷城外。

chapters.en: But I warned them and said, “Why do you spend the night by the wall? If you do this again, I will arrest you.” From that time on they no longer came on the Sabbath.
chapters.zh: 我就警戒他们说，你们为何在城外住宿呢？若再这样，我必下手拿办你们。从此以后，他们在安息日不再来了。

chapters.en: Then I commanded the Levites to purify themselves and go and guard the gates in order to keep the Sabbath day holy. Remember me for this also, my God, and show mercy to me according to your great love.
chapters.zh: 我吩咐利未人洁净自己，来守城门，使安息日为圣。我的神阿，求你因这事记念我，照你的大慈爱怜恤我。

chapters.en: Moreover, in those days I saw men of Judah who had married women from Ashdod, Ammon and Moab.
chapters.zh: 那些日子，我也见犹大人娶了亚实突，亚扪，摩押的女子为妻。

chapters.en: Half of their children spoke the language of Ashdod or the language of one of the other peoples, and did not know how to speak the language of Judah.
chapters.zh: 他们的儿女说话，一半是亚实突的话，不会说犹大的话，所说的是照着各族的方言。

chapters.en: I rebuked them and called curses down on them. I beat some of the men and pulled out their hair. I made them take an oath in God’s name and said: “You are not to give your daughters in marriage to their sons, nor are you to take their daughters in marriage for your sons or for yourselves.
chapters.zh: 我就斥责他们，咒诅他们，打了他们几个人，拔下他们的头发，叫他们指着神起誓，必不将自己的女儿嫁给外邦人的儿子，也不为自己和儿子娶他们的女儿。

chapters.en: Was it not because of marriages like these that Solomon king of Israel sinned? Among the many nations there was no king like him. He was loved by his God, and God made him king over all Israel, but even he was led into sin by foreign women.
chapters.zh: 我又说，以色列王所罗门不是在这样的事上犯罪吗？在多国中并没有一王像他，且蒙他神所爱，神立他作以色列全国的王。然而连他也被外邦女子引诱犯罪。

chapters.en: Must we hear now that you too are doing all this terrible wickedness and are being unfaithful to our God by marrying foreign women?”
chapters.zh: 如此，我岂听你们行这大恶，娶外邦女子干犯我们的神呢？

chapters.en: One of the sons of Joiada son of Eliashib the high priest was son-in-law to Sanballat the Horonite. And I drove him away from me.
chapters.zh: 大祭司以利亚实的孙子，耶何耶大的一个儿子是，和伦人参巴拉的女婿，我就从我这里把他赶出去。

chapters.en: Remember them, my God, because they defiled the priestly office and the covenant of the priesthood and of the Levites.
chapters.zh: 我的神阿，求你记念他们的罪。因为他们玷污了祭司的职任，违背你与祭司利未人所立的约。

chapters.en: So I purified the priests and the Levites of everything foreign, and assigned them duties, each to his own task.
chapters.zh: 这样，我洁净他们，使他们离绝一切外邦人，派定祭司和利未人的班次，使他们各尽其职。

chapters.en: I also made provision for contributions of wood at designated times, and for the firstfruits. Remember me with favor, my God.
chapters.zh: 我又派百姓按定期献柴，和初熟的土产。我的神阿，求你记念我，施恩与我。

chapters.en: This is what happened during the time of Xerxes, the Xerxes who ruled over 127 provinces stretching from India to Cush :
chapters.zh: 亚哈随鲁作王，从印度直到古实，统管一百二十七省。

chapters.en: At that time King Xerxes reigned from his royal throne in the citadel of Susa,
chapters.zh: 亚哈随鲁王在书珊城的宫登基。

chapters.en: and in the third year of his reign he gave a banquet for all his nobles and officials. The military leaders of Persia and Media, the princes, and the nobles of the provinces were present.
chapters.zh: 在位第三年，为他一切首领臣仆设摆筵席，有波斯和玛代的权贵，就是各省的贵胄与首领，在他面前。

chapters.en: For a full 180 days he displayed the vast wealth of his kingdom and the splendor and glory of his majesty.
chapters.zh: 他把他荣耀之国的丰富，和他美好威严的尊贵，给他们看了许多日，就是一百八十日。

chapters.en: When these days were over, the king gave a banquet, lasting seven days, in the enclosed garden of the king’s palace, for all the people from the least to the greatest who were in the citadel of Susa.
chapters.zh: 这日子满了，又为所有住书珊城的大小人民，在御园的院子里设摆筵席七日。

chapters.en: The garden had hangings of white and blue linen, fastened with cords of white linen and purple material to silver rings on marble pillars. There were couches of gold and silver on a mosaic pavement of porphyry, marble, mother-of-pearl and other costly stones.
chapters.zh: 有白色，绿色，蓝色的帐子，用细麻绳，紫色绳从银环内系在白玉石柱上。有金银的床榻摆在红，白，黄，黑玉石铺的石地上。

chapters.en: Wine was served in goblets of gold, each one different from the other, and the royal wine was abundant, in keeping with the king’s liberality.
chapters.zh: 用金器皿赐酒，器皿各有不同。御酒甚多，足显王的厚意。

chapters.en: By the king’s command each guest was allowed to drink with no restrictions, for the king instructed all the wine stewards to serve each man what he wished.
chapters.zh: 喝酒有例，不准勉强人，因王吩咐宫里的一切臣宰，让人各随己意。

chapters.en: Queen Vashti also gave a banquet for the women in the royal palace of King Xerxes.
chapters.zh: 王后瓦实提在亚哈随鲁王的宫内，也为妇女设摆筵席。

chapters.en: On the seventh day, when King Xerxes was in high spirits from wine, he commanded the seven eunuchs who served him—Mehuman, Biztha, Harbona, Bigtha, Abagtha, Zethar and Karkas—
chapters.zh: 第七日，亚哈随鲁王饮酒，心中快乐，就吩咐在他面前侍立的七个太监，米户幔，比斯他，哈波拿，比革他，亚拔他，西达，甲迦，
