chapters.en: “Where were you when I laid the earth’s foundation? Tell me, if you understand.
chapters.zh: 我立大地根基的时候，你在哪里呢？你若有聪明，只管说吧。

chapters.en: Who marked off its dimensions? Surely you know! Who stretched a measuring line across it?
chapters.zh: 你若晓得就说，是谁定地的尺度？是谁把准绳拉在其上？

chapters.en: On what were its footings set, or who laid its cornerstone—
chapters.zh: 地的根基安置在何处？地的角石是谁安放的？

chapters.en: while the morning stars sang together and all the angels shouted for joy?
chapters.zh: 那时晨星一同歌唱，神的众子也都欢呼。

chapters.en: “Who shut up the sea behind doors when it burst forth from the womb,
chapters.zh: 海水冲出，如出胎胞，那时谁将它关闭呢？

chapters.en: when I made the clouds its garment and wrapped it in thick darkness,
chapters.zh: 是我用云彩当海的衣服，用幽暗当包裹它的布，

chapters.en: when I fixed limits for it and set its doors and bars in place,
chapters.zh: 为它定界限，又安门和闩，

chapters.en: when I said, ‘This far you may come and no farther; here is where your proud waves halt’?
chapters.zh: 说，你只可到这里，不可越过。你狂傲的浪要到此止住。

chapters.en: “Have you ever given orders to the morning, or shown the dawn its place,
chapters.zh: 你自生以来，曾命定晨光，使清晨的日光知道本位。

chapters.en: that it might take the earth by the edges and shake the wicked out of it?
chapters.zh: 叫这光普照地的四极，将恶人从其中驱逐出来吗？

chapters.en: The earth takes shape like clay under a seal; its features stand out like those of a garment.
chapters.zh: 因这光，地面改变如泥上印印，万物出现如衣服一样。

chapters.en: The wicked are denied their light, and their upraised arm is broken.
chapters.zh: 亮光不照恶人，强横的膀臂也必折断。

chapters.en: “Have you journeyed to the springs of the sea or walked in the recesses of the deep?
chapters.zh: 你曾进到海源，或在深渊的隐密处行走吗？

chapters.en: Have the gates of death been shown to you? Have you seen the gates of the deepest darkness?
chapters.zh: 死亡的门曾向你显露吗？死荫的门你曾见过吗？

chapters.en: Have you comprehended the vast expanses of the earth? Tell me, if you know all this.
chapters.zh: 地的广大你能明透吗？你若全知道，只管说吧。

chapters.en: “What is the way to the abode of light? And where does darkness reside?
chapters.zh: 光明的居所从何而至？黑暗的本位在于何处？

chapters.en: Can you take them to their places? Do you know the paths to their dwellings?
chapters.zh: 你能带到本境，能看明其室之路吗？

chapters.en: Surely you know, for you were already born! You have lived so many years!
chapters.zh: 你总知道，因为你早已生在世上，你日子的数目也多。

chapters.en: “Have you entered the storehouses of the snow or seen the storehouses of the hail,
chapters.zh: 你曾进入雪库。或见过雹仓吗？

chapters.en: which I reserve for times of trouble, for days of war and battle?
chapters.zh: 这雪雹乃是我为降灾，并打仗和争战的日子所预备的。

chapters.en: What is the way to the place where the lightning is dispersed, or the place where the east winds are scattered over the earth?
chapters.zh: 光亮从何路分开？东风从何路分散遍地？

chapters.en: Who cuts a channel for the torrents of rain, and a path for the thunderstorm,
chapters.zh: 谁为雨水分道？谁为雷电开路？

chapters.en: to water a land where no one lives, an uninhabited desert,
chapters.zh: 使雨降在无人之地，无人居住的旷野。

chapters.en: to satisfy a desolate wasteland and make it sprout with grass?
chapters.zh: 使荒废凄凉之地得以丰足，青草得以发生。

chapters.en: Does the rain have a father? Who fathers the drops of dew?
chapters.zh: 雨有父吗？露水珠是谁生的呢？

chapters.en: From whose womb comes the ice? Who gives birth to the frost from the heavens
chapters.zh: 冰出于谁的胎？天上的霜是谁生的呢？

chapters.en: when the waters become hard as stone, when the surface of the deep is frozen?
chapters.zh: 诸水坚硬（或作隐藏）如石头，深渊之面凝结成冰。

chapters.en: “Can you bind the chains of the Pleiades? Can you loosen Orion’s belt?
chapters.zh: 你能系住昴星的结吗？能解开参星的带吗？

chapters.en: Can you bring forth the constellations in their seasonsor lead out the Bear with its cubs?
chapters.zh: 你能按时领出十二宫吗？能引导北斗和随它的众星吗（星原文作子）？

chapters.en: Do you know the laws of the heavens? Can you set up God’s dominion over the earth?
chapters.zh: 你知道天的定例吗？能使地归在天的权下吗？

chapters.en: “Can you raise your voice to the clouds and cover yourself with a flood of water?
chapters.zh: 你能向云彩扬起声来，使倾盆的雨遮盖你吗？

chapters.en: Do you send the lightning bolts on their way? Do they report to you, ‘Here we are’?
chapters.zh: 你能发出闪电，叫它行去，使它对你说，我们在这里。

chapters.en: Who gives the ibis wisdom or gives the rooster understanding?
chapters.zh: 谁将智慧放在怀中？谁将聪明赐于心内？

chapters.en: Who has the wisdom to count the clouds? Who can tip over the water jars of the heavens
chapters.zh: 谁能用智慧数算云彩呢？尘土聚集成团，土块紧紧结连。那时，谁能倾倒天上的瓶呢？

chapters.en: when the dust becomes hard and the clods of earth stick together?
“Do you hunt the prey for the lioness and satisfy the hunger of the lions
chapters.zh: 母狮子在洞中蹲伏，少壮狮子在隐密处埋伏。你能为它们抓取食物，使它们饱足吗？

chapters.en: when they crouch in their dens or lie in wait in a thicket?
Who provides food for the raven when its young cry out to God and wander about for lack of food?
chapters.zh: 乌鸦之雏因无食物飞来飞去，哀告神。那时，谁为它预备食物呢？

chapters.en: “Do you know when the mountain goats give birth? Do you watch when the doe bears her fawn?
chapters.zh: 山岩间的野山羊几时生产，你知道吗？母鹿下犊之期，你能察定吗？

chapters.en: Do you count the months till they bear? Do you know the time they give birth?
chapters.zh: 它们怀胎的月数，你能数算吗？它们几时生产，你能晓得吗？

chapters.en: They crouch down and bring forth their young; their labor pains are ended.
chapters.zh: 它们屈身，将子生下，就除掉疼痛。

chapters.en: Their young thrive and grow strong in the wilds; they leave and do not return.
chapters.zh: 这子渐渐肥壮，在荒野长大，去而不回。

chapters.en: “Who let the wild donkey go free? Who untied its ropes?
chapters.zh: 谁放野驴出去自由。谁解开快驴的绳索。

chapters.en: I gave it the wasteland as its home, the salt flats as its habitat.
chapters.zh: 我使旷野作它的住处，使咸地当它的居所。

chapters.en: It laughs at the commotion in the town; it does not hear a driver’s shout.
chapters.zh: 它嗤笑城内的喧嚷，不听赶牲口的喝声。

chapters.en: It ranges the hills for its pasture and searches for any green thing.
chapters.zh: 遍山是它的草场。它寻找各样青绿之物。

chapters.en: “Will the wild ox consent to serve you? Will it stay by your manger at night?
chapters.zh: 野牛岂肯服事你。岂肯住在你的槽旁。

chapters.en: Can you hold it to the furrow with a harness? Will it till the valleys behind you?
chapters.zh: 你岂能用套绳将野牛笼在犁沟之间。它岂肯随你耙山谷之地。

chapters.en: Will you rely on it for its great strength? Will you leave your heavy work to it?
chapters.zh: 岂可因它的力大就倚靠它。岂可把你的工交给它做吗？

chapters.en: Can you trust it to haul in your grain and bring it to your threshing floor?
chapters.zh: 岂可信靠它把你的粮食运到家，又收聚你禾场上的谷吗？

chapters.en: “The wings of the ostrich flap joyfully, though they cannot compare with the wings and feathers of the stork.
chapters.zh: 鸵鸟的翅膀欢然扇展，岂是显慈爱的翎毛和羽毛吗？

chapters.en: She lays her eggs on the ground and lets them warm in the sand,
chapters.zh: 因它把蛋留在地上，在尘土中使得温暖。

chapters.en: unmindful that a foot may crush them, that some wild animal may trample them.
chapters.zh: 却想不到被脚踹碎，或被野兽践踏。

chapters.en: She treats her young harshly, as if they were not hers; she cares not that her labor was in vain,
chapters.zh: 它忍心待雏，似乎不是自己的。虽然徒受劳苦，也不为雏惧怕。

chapters.en: for God did not endow her with wisdom or give her a share of good sense.
chapters.zh: 因为神使它没有智慧，也未将悟性赐给它。

chapters.en: Yet when she spreads her feathers to run, she laughs at horse and rider.
chapters.zh: 它几时挺身展开翅膀，就嗤笑马和骑马的人。

chapters.en: “Do you give the horse its strength or clothe its neck with a flowing mane?
chapters.zh: 马的大力是你所赐的吗？它颈项上的鬃是你给它披上的吗？

chapters.en: Do you make it leap like a locust, striking terror with its proud snorting?
chapters.zh: 是你叫它跳跃像蝗虫吗？它喷气之威使人惊惶。

chapters.en: It paws fiercely, rejoicing in its strength, and charges into the fray.
chapters.zh: 它在谷中刨地，自喜其力。它出去迎接佩带兵器的人。

chapters.en: It laughs at fear, afraid of nothing; it does not shy away from the sword.
chapters.zh: 它嗤笑可怕的事并不惊惶，也不因刀剑退回。

chapters.en: The quiver rattles against its side, along with the flashing spear and lance.
chapters.zh: 箭袋和发亮的枪，并短枪在它身上铮铮有声。

chapters.en: In frenzied excitement it eats up the ground; it cannot stand still when the trumpet sounds.
chapters.zh: 它发猛烈的怒气将地吞下。一听角声就不耐站立。

chapters.en: At the blast of the trumpet it snorts, ‘Aha!’ It catches the scent of battle from afar, the shout of commanders and the battle cry.
chapters.zh: 角每发声，它说呵哈。它从远处闻着战气，又听见军长大发雷声，和兵丁呐喊。

chapters.en: “Does the hawk take flight by your wisdom and spread its wings toward the south?
chapters.zh: 鹰雀飞翔，展开翅膀一直向南，岂是借你的智慧吗？

chapters.en: Does the eagle soar at your command and build its nest on high?
chapters.zh: 大鹰上腾在高处搭窝，岂是听你的吩咐吗？

chapters.en: It dwells on a cliff and stays there at night; a rocky crag is its stronghold.
chapters.zh: 它住在山岩，以山峰和坚固之所为家，

chapters.en: From there it looks for food; its eyes detect it from afar.
chapters.zh: 从那里窥看食物，眼睛远远观望。

chapters.en: Its young ones feast on blood, and where the slain are, there it is.”
chapters.zh: 它的雏也咂血。被杀的人在哪里。它也在哪里。

chapters.en: The LORD said to Job:
chapters.zh: 耶和华又对约伯说，

chapters.en: “Will the one who contends with the Almighty correct him? Let him who accuses God answer him!”
chapters.zh: 强辩的岂可与全能者争论吗？与神辩驳的可以回答这些吧。

chapters.en: Then Job answered the LORD:
chapters.zh: 于是，约伯回答耶和华说，

chapters.en: “I am unworthy—how can I reply to you? I put my hand over my mouth.
chapters.zh: 我是卑贱的。我用什么回答你呢？只好用手捂口。

chapters.en: I spoke once, but I have no answer— twice, but I will say no more.”
chapters.zh: 我说了一次，再不回答。说了两次，就不再说。

chapters.en: Then the LORD spoke to Job out of the storm:
chapters.zh: 于是，耶和华从旋风中回答约伯说，

chapters.en: “Brace yourself like a man; I will question you, and you shall answer me.
chapters.zh: 你要如勇士束腰。我问你，你可以指示我。

chapters.en: “Would you discredit my justice? Would you condemn me to justify yourself?
chapters.zh: 你岂可废弃我所拟定的。岂可定我有罪，好显自己为义吗？

chapters.en: Do you have an arm like God’s, and can your voice thunder like his?
chapters.zh: 你有神那样的膀臂吗？你能像他发雷声吗？

chapters.en: Then adorn yourself with glory and splendor, and clothe yourself in honor and majesty.
chapters.zh: 你要以荣耀庄严为妆饰，以尊荣威严为衣服。

chapters.en: Unleash the fury of your wrath, look at all who are proud and bring them low,
chapters.zh: 要发出你满溢的怒气，见一切骄傲的人，使他降卑。

chapters.en: look at all who are proud and humble them, crush the wicked where they stand.
chapters.zh: 见一切骄傲的人，将他制伏，把恶人践踏在本处。

chapters.en: Bury them all in the dust together; shroud their faces in the grave.
chapters.zh: 将他们一同隐藏在尘土中，把他们的脸蒙蔽在隐密处。

chapters.en: Then I myself will admit to you that your own right hand can save you.
chapters.zh: 我就认你右手能以救自己。

chapters.en: “Look at Behemoth, which I made along with you and which feeds on grass like an ox.
chapters.zh: 你且观看河马。我造你也造它。它吃草与牛一样。

chapters.en: What strength it has in its loins, what power in the muscles of its belly!
chapters.zh: 它的气力在腰间，能力在肚腹的筋上。

chapters.en: Its tail sways like a cedar; the sinews of its thighs are close-knit.
chapters.zh: 它摇动尾巴如香柏树。它大腿的筋互相联络。

chapters.en: Its bones are tubes of bronze, its limbs like rods of iron.
chapters.zh: 它的骨头好像铜管。它的肢体仿佛铁棍。

chapters.en: It ranks first among the works of God, yet its Maker can approach it with his sword.
chapters.zh: 它在神所造的物中为首。创造它的给它刀剑。

chapters.en: The hills bring it their produce, and all the wild animals play nearby.
chapters.zh: 诸山给它出食物，也是百兽游玩之处。

chapters.en: Under the lotus plants it lies, hidden among the reeds in the marsh.
chapters.zh: 它伏在莲叶之下，卧在芦苇隐密处和水洼子里。

chapters.en: The lotuses conceal it in their shadow; the poplars by the stream surround it.
chapters.zh: 莲叶的阴凉遮蔽它。溪旁的柳树环绕它。

chapters.en: A raging river does not alarm it; it is secure, though the Jordan should surge against its mouth.
chapters.zh: 河水泛滥，它不发战。就是约旦河的水涨到它口边，也是安然。

chapters.en: Can anyone capture it by the eyes, or trap it and pierce its nose?
chapters.zh: 在它防备的时候，谁能捉拿它？谁能牢笼它穿它的鼻子呢？

chapters.en: “Can you pull in Leviathan with a fishhook or tie down its tongue with a rope?
chapters.zh: 你能用鱼钩钓上鳄鱼吗？能用绳子压下它的舌头吗？

chapters.en: Can you put a cord through its nose or pierce its jaw with a hook?
chapters.zh: 你能用绳索穿它的鼻子吗？能用钩穿它的腮骨吗？

chapters.en: Will it keep begging you for mercy? Will it speak to you with gentle words?
chapters.zh: 它岂向你连连恳求，说柔和的话吗？

chapters.en: Will it make an agreement with you for you to take it as your slave for life?
chapters.zh: 岂肯与你立约，使你拿它永远作奴仆吗？

chapters.en: Can you make a pet of it like a bird or put it on a leash for the young women in your house?
chapters.zh: 你岂可拿它当雀鸟玩耍吗？岂可为你的幼女将它拴住吗？

chapters.en: Will traders barter for it? Will they divide it up among the merchants?
chapters.zh: 搭伙的渔夫岂可拿它当货物吗？能把它分给商人吗？

chapters.en: Can you fill its hide with harpoons or its head with fishing spears?
chapters.zh: 你能用倒钩枪扎满它的皮，能用鱼叉叉满它的头吗？

chapters.en: If you lay a hand on it, you will remember the struggle and never do it again!
chapters.zh: 你按手在它身上，想与它争战，就不再这样行吧。

chapters.en: Any hope of subduing it is false; the mere sight of it is overpowering.
chapters.zh: 人指望捉拿它是徒然的。一见它，岂不丧胆吗？

chapters.en: No one is fierce enough to rouse it. Who then is able to stand against me?
chapters.zh: 没有那么凶猛的人敢惹它。这样，谁能在我面前站立得住呢？

chapters.en: Who has a claim against me that I must pay? Everything under heaven belongs to me.
chapters.zh: 谁先给我什么，使我偿还呢？天下万物都是我的。

chapters.en: “I will not fail to speak of Leviathan’s limbs, its strength and its graceful form.
chapters.zh: 论到鳄鱼的肢体和其大力，并美好的骨骼，我不能缄默不言。

chapters.en: Who can strip off its outer coat? Who can penetrate its double coat of armor ?
chapters.zh: 谁能剥它的外衣？谁能进它上下牙骨之间呢？

chapters.en: Who dares open the doors of its mouth, ringed about with fearsome teeth?
chapters.zh: 谁能开它的腮颊？它牙齿四围是可畏的。

chapters.en: Its back has rows of shields tightly sealed together;
chapters.zh: 它以坚固的鳞甲为可夸，紧紧合闭，封得严密。

chapters.en: each is so close to the next that no air can pass between.
chapters.zh: 这鳞甲一一相连，甚至气不得透入其间，

chapters.en: They are joined fast to one another; they cling together and cannot be parted.
chapters.zh: 都是互相联络，胶结，不能分离。

chapters.en: Its snorting throws out flashes of light; its eyes are like the rays of dawn.
chapters.zh: 它打喷嚏就发出光来。它眼睛好像早晨的光线（光线原文作眼皮）。

chapters.en: Flames stream from its mouth; sparks of fire shoot out.
chapters.zh: 从它口中发出烧着的火把，与飞迸的火星。

chapters.en: Smoke pours from its nostrils as from a boiling pot over burning reeds.
chapters.zh: 从它鼻孔冒出烟来，如烧开的锅和点着的芦苇。

chapters.en: Its breath sets coals ablaze, and flames dart from its mouth.
chapters.zh: 它的气点着煤炭，有火焰从它口中发出。

chapters.en: Strength resides in its neck; dismay goes before it.
chapters.zh: 它颈项中存着劲力。在它面前的都恐吓蹦跳。

chapters.en: The folds of its flesh are tightly joined; they are firm and immovable.
chapters.zh: 它的肉块互相联络，紧贴其身，不能摇动。

chapters.en: Its chest is hard as rock, hard as a lower millstone.
chapters.zh: 它的心结实如石头，如下磨石那样结实。

chapters.en: When it rises up, the mighty are terrified; they retreat before its thrashing.
chapters.zh: 它一起来，勇士都惊恐，心里慌乱，便都昏迷。

chapters.en: The sword that reaches it has no effect, nor does the spear or the dart or the javelin.
chapters.zh: 人若用刀，用枪，用标枪，用尖枪扎它，都是无用。

chapters.en: Iron it treats like straw and bronze like rotten wood.
chapters.zh: 它以铁为干草，以铜为烂木。

chapters.en: Arrows do not make it flee; slingstones are like chaff to it.
chapters.zh: 箭不能恐吓它使它逃避。弹石在它看为碎秸。

chapters.en: A club seems to it but a piece of straw; it laughs at the rattling of the lance.
chapters.zh: 棍棒算为禾秸。它嗤笑短枪飕的响声。

chapters.en: Its undersides are jagged potsherds, leaving a trail in the mud like a threshing sledge.
chapters.zh: 它肚腹下如尖瓦片，它如钉耙经过淤泥。

chapters.en: It makes the depths churn like a boiling caldron and stirs up the sea like a pot of ointment.
chapters.zh: 它使深渊开滚如锅，使洋海如锅中的膏油。

chapters.en: It leaves a glistening wake behind it; one would think the deep had white hair.
chapters.zh: 它行的路随后发光，令人想深渊如同白发。

chapters.en: Nothing on earth is its equal— a creature without fear.
chapters.zh: 在地上没有像它造的那样，无所惧怕。

chapters.en: It looks down on all that are haughty; it is king over all that are proud.”
chapters.zh: 凡高大的，它无不藐视。它在骄傲的水族上作王。

chapters.en: Then Job replied to the LORD:
chapters.zh: 约伯回答耶和华说，

chapters.en: “I know that you can do all things; no purpose of yours can be thwarted.
chapters.zh: 我知道，你万事都能做。你的旨意不能拦阻。

chapters.en: You asked, ‘Who is this that obscures my plans without knowledge?’ Surely I spoke of things I did not understand, things too wonderful for me to know.
chapters.zh: 谁用无知的言语，使你的旨意隐藏呢？我所说的，是我不明白的。这些事太奇妙，是我不知道的。

chapters.en: “You said, ‘Listen now, and I will speak; I will question you, and you shall answer me.’
chapters.zh: 求你听我，我要说话。我问你，求你指示我。

chapters.en: My ears had heard of you but now my eyes have seen you.
chapters.zh: 我从前风闻有你，现在亲眼看见你。

chapters.en: Therefore I despise myself and repent in dust and ashes.”
chapters.zh: 因此我厌恶自己，（自己或作我的言语）在尘土和炉灰中懊悔。

chapters.en: After the LORD had said these things to Job, he said to Eliphaz the Temanite, “I am angry with you and your two friends, because you have not spoken the truth about me, as my servant Job has.
chapters.zh: 耶和华对约伯说话以后，就对提幔人以利法说，我的怒气向你和你两个朋友发作，因为你们议论我，不如我的仆人约伯说的是。

chapters.en: So now take seven bulls and seven rams and go to my servant Job and sacrifice a burnt offering for yourselves. My servant Job will pray for you, and I will accept his prayer and not deal with you according to your folly. You have not spoken the truth about me, as my servant Job has.”
chapters.zh: 现在你们要取七只公牛，七只公羊，到我仆人约伯那里去，为自己献上燔祭，我的仆人约伯就为你们祈祷。我因悦纳他，就不按你们的愚妄办你们。你们议论我，不如我的仆人约伯说的是。

chapters.en: So Eliphaz the Temanite, Bildad the Shuhite and Zophar the Naamathite did what the LORD told them; and the LORD accepted Job’s prayer.
chapters.zh: 于是提幔人以利法，书亚人比勒达，拿玛人琐法照着耶和华所吩咐的去行。耶和华就悦纳约伯。

chapters.en: After Job had prayed for his friends, the LORD restored his fortunes and gave him twice as much as he had before.
chapters.zh: 约伯为他的朋友祈祷。耶和华就使约伯从苦境转回（苦境原文作掳掠），并且耶和华赐给他的，比他从前所有的加倍。

chapters.en: All his brothers and sisters and everyone who had known him before came and ate with him in his house. They comforted and consoled him over all the trouble the LORD had brought on him, and each one gave him a piece of silver and a gold ring.
chapters.zh: 约伯的弟兄，姐妹，和以先所认识的人都来见他，在他家里一同吃饭。又论到耶和华所降与他的一切灾祸，都为他悲伤安慰他。每人也送他一块银子和一个金环。

chapters.en: The LORD blessed the latter part of Job’s life more than the former part. He had fourteen thousand sheep, six thousand camels, a thousand yoke of oxen and a thousand donkeys.
chapters.zh: 这样，耶和华后来赐福给约伯比先前更多。他有一万四千羊，六千骆驼，一千对牛，一千母驴。

chapters.en: And he also had seven sons and three daughters.
chapters.zh: 他也有七个儿子，三个女儿。

chapters.en: The first daughter he named Jemimah, the second Keziah and the third Keren-Happuch.
chapters.zh: 他给长女起名叫耶米玛，次女叫基洗亚，三女叫基连哈朴。

chapters.en: Nowhere in all the land were there found women as beautiful as Job’s daughters, and their father granted them an inheritance along with their brothers.
chapters.zh: 在那全地的妇女中，找不着像约伯的女儿那样美貌。她们的父亲使她们在弟兄中得产业。

chapters.en: After this, Job lived a hundred and forty years; he saw his children and their children to the fourth generation.
chapters.zh: 此后，约伯又活了一百四十年，得见他的儿孙，直到四代。

chapters.en: And so Job died, an old man and full of years.
chapters.zh: 这样，约伯年纪老迈，日子满足而死。

chapters.en: Blessed is the one who does not walk in step with the wicked or stand in the way that sinners take or sit in the company of mockers,
chapters.zh: 不从恶人的计谋，不站罪人的道路，不坐亵慢人的座位。

chapters.en: but whose delight is in the law of the LORD, and who meditates on his law day and night.
chapters.zh: 惟喜爱耶和华的律法，昼夜思想，这人便为有福。

chapters.en: That person is like a tree planted by streams of water, which yields its fruit in season and whose leaf does not wither— whatever they do prospers.
chapters.zh: 他要像一棵树栽在溪水旁，按时候结果子，叶子也不枯干。凡他所作的，尽都顺利。

chapters.en: Not so the wicked! They are like chaff that the wind blows away.
chapters.zh: 恶人并不是这样，乃像糠秕被风吹散。

chapters.en: Therefore the wicked will not stand in the judgment, nor sinners in the assembly of the righteous.
chapters.zh: 因此当审判的时候，恶人必站立不住，罪人在义人的会中，也是如此。

chapters.en: For the LORD watches over the way of the righteous, but the way of the wicked leads to destruction.
chapters.zh: 因为耶和华知道义人的道路。恶人的道路，却必灭亡。

chapters.en: Why do the nations conspire and the peoples plot in vain?
chapters.zh: 外邦为什么争闹，万民为什么谋算虚妄的事。

chapters.en: The kings of the earth rise up and the rulers band together against the LORD and against his anointed, saying,
chapters.zh: 世上的君王一齐起来，臣宰一同商议，要敌挡耶和华，并他的受膏者，

chapters.en: “Let us break their chains and throw off their shackles.”
chapters.zh: 说，我们要挣开他们的捆绑，脱去他们的绳索。

chapters.en: The One enthroned in heaven laughs; the Lord scoffs at them.
chapters.zh: 那坐在天上的必发笑。主必嗤笑他们。

chapters.en: He rebukes them in his anger and terrifies them in his wrath, saying,
chapters.zh: 那时他要在怒中责备他们，在烈怒中惊吓他们，

chapters.en: “I have installed my king on Zion, my holy mountain.”
chapters.zh: 说，我已经立我的君在锡安我的圣山上了。

chapters.en: I will proclaim the LORD’s decree: He said to me, “You are my son; today I have become your father.
chapters.zh: 受膏者说，我要传圣旨。耶和华曾对我说，你是我的儿子，我今日生你。

chapters.en: Ask me, and I will make the nations your inheritance, the ends of the earth your possession.
chapters.zh: 你求我，我就将列国赐你为基业，将地极赐你为田产。

chapters.en: You will break them with a rod of iron ; you will dash them to pieces like pottery.”
chapters.zh: 你必用铁杖打破他们。你必将他们如同窑匠的瓦器摔碎。

chapters.en: Therefore, you kings, be wise; be warned, you rulers of the earth.
chapters.zh: 现在你们君王应当省悟。你们世上的审判官该受管教。

chapters.en: Serve the LORD with fear and celebrate his rule with trembling.
chapters.zh: 当存畏惧事奉耶和华，又当存战兢而快乐。

chapters.en: Kiss his son, or he will be angry and your way will lead to your destruction, for his wrath can flare up in a moment. Blessed are all who take refuge in him.
chapters.zh: 当以嘴亲子，恐怕他发怒，你们便在道中灭亡，因为他的怒气快要发作。凡投靠他的，都是有福的。

chapters.en: LORD, how many are my foes! How many rise up against me!
chapters.zh: （大卫逃避他儿子押沙龙的时候作的诗。）耶和华阿，我的敌人何其加增。有许多人起来攻击我。

chapters.en: Many are saying of me, “God will not deliver him.”
chapters.zh: 有许多人议论我说，他得不着神的帮助。（细拉）

chapters.en: But you, LORD, are a shield around me, my glory, the One who lifts my head high.
chapters.zh: 但你耶和华是我四围的盾牌。是我的荣耀，又是叫我抬起头来的。

chapters.en: I call out to the LORD, and he answers me from his holy mountain.
chapters.zh: 我用我的声音求告耶和华，他就从他的圣山上应允我。（细拉）

chapters.en: I lie down and sleep; I wake again, because the LORD sustains me.
chapters.zh: 我躺下睡觉。我醒着。耶和华都保佑我。

chapters.en: I will not fear though tens of thousands assail me on every side.
chapters.zh: 虽有成万的百姓来周围攻击我，我也不怕。

chapters.en: Arise, LORD! Deliver me, my God! Strike all my enemies on the jaw; break the teeth of the wicked.
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，求你起来。我的神阿，求你救我。因为你打了我一切仇敌的腮骨，敲碎了恶人的牙齿。

chapters.en: From the LORD comes deliverance. May your blessing be on your people.
chapters.zh: 救恩属乎耶和华。愿你赐福给你的百姓。（细拉）

chapters.en: Answer me when I call to you, my righteous God. Give me relief from my distress; have mercy on me and hear my prayer.
chapters.zh: （大卫的诗，交与伶长。用丝弦的乐器。）显我为义的神阿，我呼吁的时候，求你应允我。我在困苦中，你曾使我宽广。现在求你怜恤我，听我的祷告。

chapters.en: How long will you people turn my glory into shame? How long will you love delusions and seek false gods
chapters.zh: 你们这上流人哪，你们将我的尊荣变为羞辱，要到几时呢你们喜爱虚妄，寻找虚假，要到几时呢？（细拉）

chapters.en: Know that the LORD has set apart his faithful servant for himself; the LORD hears when I call to him.
chapters.zh: 你们要知道耶和华已经分别虔诚人归他自己。我求告耶和华，他必听我。

chapters.en: Tremble and do not sin; when you are on your beds, search your hearts and be silent.
chapters.zh: 你们应当畏惧，不可犯罪。在床上的时候，要心里思想，并要肃静。（细拉）

chapters.en: Offer the sacrifices of the righteous and trust in the LORD.
chapters.zh: 当献上公义的祭，又当倚靠耶和华。

chapters.en: Many, LORD, are asking, “Who will bring us prosperity?” Let the light of your face shine on us.
chapters.zh: 有许多人说，谁能指示我们什么好处。耶和华阿，求你仰起脸来，光照我们。

chapters.en: Fill my heart with joy when their grain and new wine abound.
chapters.zh: 你使我心里快乐，胜过那丰收五谷新酒的人。

chapters.en: In peace I will lie down and sleep, for you alone, LORD, make me dwell in safety.
chapters.zh: 我必安然躺下睡觉，因为独有你耶和华使我安然居住。

chapters.en: Listen to my words, LORD, consider my lament.
chapters.zh: （大卫的诗，交与伶长。用吹的乐器。）耶和华阿，求你留心听我的言语，顾念我的心思。

chapters.en: Hear my cry for help, my King and my God, for to you I pray.
chapters.zh: 我的王我的神阿，求你垂听我呼求的声音。因为我向你祈祷。

chapters.en: In the morning, LORD, you hear my voice; in the morning I lay my requests before you and wait expectantly.
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，早晨你必听我的声音。早晨我必向你陈明我的心意，并要儆醒。

chapters.en: For you are not a God who is pleased with wickedness; with you, evil people are not welcome.
chapters.zh: 因为你不是喜悦恶事的神。恶人不能与你同居。

chapters.en: The arrogant cannot stand in your presence. You hate all who do wrong;
chapters.zh: 狂傲人不能站在你眼前。凡作孽的，都是你所恨恶的。

chapters.en: you destroy those who tell lies. The bloodthirsty and deceitful you, LORD, detest.
chapters.zh: 说谎言的，你必灭绝。好流人血弄诡诈的，都为耶和华所憎恶。

chapters.en: But I, by your great love, can come into your house; in reverence I bow down toward your holy temple.
chapters.zh: 至于我，我必凭你丰盛的慈爱进入你的居所。我必存敬畏你的心向你的圣殿下拜。

chapters.en: Lead me, LORD, in your righteousness because of my enemies— make your way straight before me.
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，求你因我的仇敌，凭你的公义，引领我。使你的道路在我面前正直。

chapters.en: Not a word from their mouth can be trusted; their heart is filled with malice. Their throat is an open grave; with their tongues they tell lies.
chapters.zh: 因为他们的口中没有诚实。他们的心里满有邪恶。他们的喉咙，是敞开的坟墓。他们用舌头谄媚人。

chapters.en: Declare them guilty, O God! Let their intrigues be their downfall. Banish them for their many sins, for they have rebelled against you.
chapters.zh: 神阿，求你定他们的罪。愿他们因自己的计谋跌倒。愿你在他们许多的过犯中，把他们逐出。因为他们背叛了你。

chapters.en: But let all who take refuge in you be glad; let them ever sing for joy. Spread your protection over them, that those who love your name may rejoice in you.
chapters.zh: 凡投靠你的，愿他们喜乐，时常欢呼，因为你护庇他们。又愿那爱你名的人，都靠你欢欣。

chapters.en: Surely, LORD, you bless the righteous; you surround them with your favor as with a shield.
chapters.zh: 因为你必赐福与义人。耶和华阿，你必用恩惠如同盾牌四面护卫他。

chapters.en: LORD, do not rebuke me in your anger or discipline me in your wrath.
chapters.zh: （大卫的诗，交与伶长。用丝弦的乐器，调用第八。）耶和华阿，求你不要在怒中责备我，也不要在烈怒中惩罚我。

chapters.en: Have mercy on me, LORD, for I am faint; heal me, LORD, for my bones are in agony.
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，求你可怜我。因为我软弱。耶和华阿，求你医治我。因为我的骨头发战。

chapters.en: My soul is in deep anguish. How long, LORD, how long?
chapters.zh: 我心也大大地惊惶。耶和华阿，你要到几时才救我呢？

chapters.en: Turn, LORD, and deliver me; save me because of your unfailing love.
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，求你转回，搭救我。因你的慈爱拯救我。

chapters.en: Among the dead no one proclaims your name. Who praises you from the grave?
chapters.zh: 因为在死地无人记念你，在阴间有谁称谢你。

chapters.en: I am worn out from my groaning. All night long I flood my bed with weeping and drench my couch with tears.
chapters.zh: 我因唉哼而困乏。我每夜流泪，把床榻漂起，把褥子湿透。

chapters.en: My eyes grow weak with sorrow; they fail because of all my foes.
chapters.zh: 我因忧愁眼睛干瘪。又因我一切的敌人眼睛昏花。

chapters.en: Away from me, all you who do evil, for the LORD has heard my weeping.
chapters.zh: 你们一切作孽的人，离开我吧。因为耶和华听了我哀哭的声音。

chapters.en: The LORD has heard my cry for mercy; the LORD accepts my prayer.
chapters.zh: 耶和华听了我的恳求。耶和华必收纳我的祷告。

chapters.en: All my enemies will be overwhelmed with shame and anguish; they will turn back and suddenly be put to shame.
chapters.zh: 我的一切仇敌都必羞愧，大大惊惶。他们必要退后，忽然羞愧。

chapters.en: LORD my God, I take refuge in you; save and deliver me from all who pursue me,
chapters.zh: （大卫指着便雅悯人古实的话，向耶和华唱的流离歌。）耶和华我的神阿，我投靠你。求你救我脱离一切追赶我的人，将我救拔出来。

chapters.en: or they will tear me apart like a lion and rip me to pieces with no one to rescue me.
chapters.zh: 恐怕他们像狮子撕裂我，甚至撕碎，无人搭救。

chapters.en: LORD my God, if I have done this and there is guilt on my hands—
chapters.zh: 耶和华我的神阿，我若行了这事，若有罪孽在我手里，

chapters.en: if I have repaid my ally with evil or without cause have robbed my foe—
chapters.zh: 我若以恶报那与我交好的人，连那无故与我为敌的，我也救了他，

chapters.en: then let my enemy pursue and overtake me; let him trample my life to the ground and make me sleep in the dust.
chapters.zh: 就任凭仇敌追赶我，直到追上。将我的性命踏在地下，使我的荣耀归于灰尘。（细拉）

chapters.en: Arise, LORD, in your anger; rise up against the rage of my enemies. Awake, my God; decree justice.
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，求你在怒中起来，挺身而立，抵挡我敌人的暴怒。求你为我兴起。你已经命定施行审判。

chapters.en: Let the assembled peoples gather around you, while you sit enthroned over them on high.
chapters.zh: 愿众民的会环绕你。愿你从其上归于高位。

chapters.en: Let the LORD judge the peoples. Vindicate me, LORD, according to my righteousness, according to my integrity, O Most High.
chapters.zh: 耶和华向众民施行审判。耶和华阿，求你按我的公义，和我心中的纯正，判断我。

chapters.en: Bring to an end the violence of the wicked and make the righteous secure— you, the righteous God who probes minds and hearts.
chapters.zh: 愿恶人的恶断绝。愿你坚立义人。因为公义的神察验人的心肠肺腑。

chapters.en: My shield is God Most High, who saves the upright in heart.
chapters.zh: 神是我的盾牌。他拯救心里正直的人。

chapters.en: God is a righteous judge, a God who displays his wrath every day.
chapters.zh: 神是公义的审判者，又是天天向恶人发怒的神。

chapters.en: If he does not relent, he will sharpen his sword; he will bend and string his bow.
chapters.zh: 若有人不回头，他的刀必磨快。弓必上弦，预备妥当了。

chapters.en: He has prepared his deadly weapons; he makes ready his flaming arrows.
chapters.zh: 他也预备了杀人的器械。他所射的是火箭。

chapters.en: Whoever is pregnant with evil conceives trouble and gives birth to disillusionment.
chapters.zh: 试看恶人因奸恶而劬劳。所怀的是毒害，所生的是虚假。

chapters.en: Whoever digs a hole and scoops it out falls into the pit they have made.
chapters.zh: 他掘了坑，又挖深了，竟掉在自己所挖的阱里。

chapters.en: The trouble they cause recoils on them; their violence comes down on their own heads.
chapters.zh: 他的毒害，必临到他自己的头上。他的强暴必落到他自己的脑袋上。

chapters.en: I will give thanks to the LORD because of his righteousness; I will sing the praises of the name of the LORD Most High.
chapters.zh: 我要照着耶和华的公义称谢他，歌颂耶和华至高者的名。

chapters.en: LORD, our Lord, how majestic is your name in all the earth! You have set your glory in the heavens.
chapters.zh: （大卫的诗，交与伶长。用迦特乐器。）耶和华我们的主阿，你的名在全地何其美。你将你的荣耀彰显于天。

chapters.en: Through the praise of children and infants you have established a stronghold against your enemies, to silence the foe and the avenger.
chapters.zh: 你因敌人的缘故，从婴孩和吃奶的口中，建立了能力，使仇敌和报仇的，闭口无言。

chapters.en: When I consider your heavens, the work of your fingers, the moon and the stars, which you have set in place,
chapters.zh: 我观看你指头所造的天，并你所陈设的月亮星宿，

chapters.en: what is mankind that you are mindful of them, human beings that you care for them?
chapters.zh: 便说，人算什么，你竟顾念他。世人算什么，你竟眷顾他。

chapters.en: You have made them a little lower than the angels and crowned them with glory and honor.
chapters.zh: 你叫他比天使（或作神）微小一点，并赐他荣耀尊贵为冠冕。

chapters.en: You made them rulers over the works of your hands; you put everything under their feet:
chapters.zh: 你派他管理你手所造的，使万物，就是一切的牛羊，田野的兽，空中的鸟，海里的鱼，凡经行海道的，都服在他的脚下。

chapters.en: all flocks and herds, and the animals of the wild,
the birds in the sky, and the fish in the sea, all that swim the paths of the seas.
LORD, our Lord, how majestic is your name in all the earth!
chapters.zh: 耶和华我们的主阿，你的名在全地何其美。

chapters.en: I will give thanks to you, LORD, with all my heart; I will tell of all your wonderful deeds.
chapters.zh: （大卫的诗，交与伶长。调用慕拉便。）我要一心称谢耶和华。我要传扬你一切奇妙的作为。

chapters.en: I will be glad and rejoice in you; I will sing the praises of your name, O Most High.
chapters.zh: 我要因你欢喜快乐。至高者阿，我要歌颂你的名。

chapters.en: My enemies turn back; they stumble and perish before you.
chapters.zh: 我的仇敌转身退去的时候，他们一见你的面，就跌倒灭亡。

chapters.en: For you have upheld my right and my cause, sitting enthroned as the righteous judge.
chapters.zh: 因你已经为我伸冤，为我辨屈。你坐在宝座上，按公义审判。

chapters.en: You have rebuked the nations and destroyed the wicked; you have blotted out their name for ever and ever.
chapters.zh: 你曾斥责外邦。你曾灭绝恶人。你曾涂抹他们的名，直到永永远远。

chapters.en: Endless ruin has overtaken my enemies, you have uprooted their cities; even the memory of them has perished.
chapters.zh: 仇敌到了尽头。他们被毁坏，直到永远。你拆毁他们的城邑。连他们的名号，都归于无有。

chapters.en: The LORD reigns forever; he has established his throne for judgment.
chapters.zh: 惟耶和华坐着为王，直到永远。他已经为审判设摆他的宝座。

chapters.en: He rules the world in righteousness and judges the peoples with equity.
chapters.zh: 他要按公义审判世界，按正直判断万民。

chapters.en: The LORD is a refuge for the oppressed, a stronghold in times of trouble.
chapters.zh: 耶和华又要给受欺压的人作高台，在患难的时候作高台。

chapters.en: Those who know your name trust in you, for you, LORD, have never forsaken those who seek you.
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，认识你名的人要倚靠你。因你没有离弃寻求你的人。

chapters.en: Sing the praises of the LORD, enthroned in Zion; proclaim among the nations what he has done.
chapters.zh: 应当歌颂居锡安的耶和华，将他所行的传扬在众民中。

chapters.en: For he who avenges blood remembers; he does not ignore the cries of the afflicted.
chapters.zh: 因为那追讨流人血之罪的，他记念受屈的人，不忘记困苦人的哀求。

chapters.en: LORD, see how my enemies persecute me! Have mercy and lift me up from the gates of death,
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，你是从死门把我提拔起来的。求你怜恤我。看那恨我的人所加给我的苦难。

chapters.en: that I may declare your praises in the gates of Daughter Zion, and there rejoice in your salvation.
chapters.zh: 好叫我述说你一切的美德。我必在锡安城的门（城原文作女子），因你的救恩欢乐。

chapters.en: The nations have fallen into the pit they have dug; their feet are caught in the net they have hidden.
chapters.zh: 外邦人陷在自己所掘的坑中。他们的脚，在自己暗设的网罗里缠住了。

chapters.en: The LORD is known by his acts of justice; the wicked are ensnared by the work of their hands.
chapters.zh: 耶和华已将自己显明了，他已施行审判。恶人被自己手所作的缠住了（或作他叫恶人被自己手所作的累住了）。（细拉）

chapters.en: The wicked go down to the realm of the dead, all the nations that forget God.
chapters.zh: 恶人，就是忘记神的外邦人，都必归到阴间。

chapters.en: But God will never forget the needy; the hope of the afflicted will never perish.
chapters.zh: 穷乏人必不永久被忘，困苦人的指望，必不永远落空。

chapters.en: Arise, LORD, do not let mortals triumph; let the nations be judged in your presence.
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，求你起来，不容人得胜。愿外邦人在你面前受审判。

chapters.en: Strike them with terror, LORD; let the nations know they are only mortal.
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，求你使外邦人恐惧。愿他们知道自己不过是人。（细拉）

chapters.en: Why, LORD, do you stand far off? Why do you hide yourself in times of trouble?
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，你为什么站在远处。在患难的时候，为什么隐藏。

chapters.en: In his arrogance the wicked man hunts down the weak, who are caught in the schemes he devises.
chapters.zh: 恶人在骄横中，把困苦人追得火急。愿他们陷在自己所设的计谋里。

chapters.en: He boasts about the cravings of his heart; he blesses the greedy and reviles the LORD.
chapters.zh: 因为恶人以心愿自夸。贪财的背弃耶和华，并且轻慢他（或作他祝福贪财的，却轻慢耶和华）。

chapters.en: In his pride the wicked man does not seek him; in all his thoughts there is no room for God.
chapters.zh: 恶人面带骄傲，说，耶和华必不追究。他一切所想的，都以为没有神。

chapters.en: His ways are always prosperous; your laws are rejected by him; he sneers at all his enemies.
chapters.zh: 凡他所作的，时常稳固。你的审判超过他的眼界。至于他一切的敌人，他都向他们喷气。

chapters.en: He says to himself, “Nothing will ever shake me.” He swears, “No one will ever do me harm.”
chapters.zh: 他心里说，我必不动摇，世世代代不遭灾难。

chapters.en: His mouth is full of lies and threats; trouble and evil are under his tongue.
chapters.zh: 他满口是咒骂，诡诈，欺压。舌底是毒害奸恶。

chapters.en: He lies in wait near the villages; from ambush he murders the innocent. His eyes watch in secret for his victims;
chapters.zh: 他在村庄埋伏等候。他在隐密处杀害无辜的人。他的眼睛窥探无倚无靠的人。

chapters.en: like a lion in cover he lies in wait. He lies in wait to catch the helpless; he catches the helpless and drags them off in his net.
chapters.zh: 他埋伏在暗地，如狮子蹲在洞中。他埋伏，要掳去困苦人。他拉网，就把困苦人掳去。

chapters.en: His victims are crushed, they collapse; they fall under his strength.
chapters.zh: 他屈身蹲伏，无倚无靠的人，就倒在他爪牙之下（爪牙或作强暴人），

chapters.en: He says to himself, “God will never notice; he covers his face and never sees.”
chapters.zh: 他心里说，神竟忘记了。他掩面，永不观看。

chapters.en: Arise, LORD! Lift up your hand, O God. Do not forget the helpless.
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，求你起来。神阿，求你举手。不要忘记困苦人。

chapters.en: Why does the wicked man revile God? Why does he say to himself, “He won’t call me to account”?
chapters.zh: 恶人为何轻慢神，心里说，你必不追究。

chapters.en: But you, God, see the trouble of the afflicted; you consider their grief and take it in hand. The victims commit themselves to you; you are the helper of the fatherless.
chapters.zh: 其实你已经观看。因为奸恶毒害，你都看见了，为要以手施行报应。无倚无靠的人，把自己交托你。你向来是帮助孤儿的。

chapters.en: Break the arm of the wicked man; call the evildoer to account for his wickedness that would not otherwise be found out.
chapters.zh: 愿你打断恶人的膀臂。至于坏人，愿你追究他的恶，直到净尽。

chapters.en: The LORD is King for ever and ever; the nations will perish from his land.
chapters.zh: 耶和华永永远远为王。外邦人从他的地已经灭绝了。

chapters.en: You, LORD, hear the desire of the afflicted; you encourage them, and you listen to their cry,
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，谦卑人的心愿，你早已知道（原文作听见）。你必预备他们的心，也必侧耳听他们的祈求。

chapters.en: defending the fatherless and the oppressed, so that mere earthly mortals will never again strike terror.
chapters.zh: 为要给孤儿和受欺压的人伸冤，使强横的人不再威吓他们。

chapters.en: In the LORD I take refuge. How then can you say to me: “Flee like a bird to your mountain.
chapters.zh: （大卫的诗，交与伶长。）我是投靠耶和华。你们怎么对我说，你当像鸟飞往你的山去。

chapters.en: For look, the wicked bend their bows; they set their arrows against the strings to shoot from the shadows at the upright in heart.
chapters.zh: 看哪，恶人弯弓，把箭搭在弦上，要在暗中射那心里正直的人。

chapters.en: When the foundations are being destroyed, what can the righteous do?”
chapters.zh: 根基若毁坏，义人还能作什么呢？

chapters.en: The LORD is in his holy temple; the LORD is on his heavenly throne. He observes everyone on earth; his eyes examine them.
chapters.zh: 耶和华在他的圣殿里，耶和华的宝座在天上。他的慧眼察看世人。

chapters.en: The LORD examines the righteous, but the wicked, those who love violence, he hates with a passion.
chapters.zh: 耶和华试验义人。惟有恶人和喜爱强暴的人，他心里恨恶。

chapters.en: On the wicked he will rain fiery coals and burning sulfur; a scorching wind will be their lot.
chapters.zh: 他要向恶人密布网罗。有烈火，硫磺，热风，作他们杯中的分。

chapters.en: For the LORD is righteous, he loves justice; the upright will see his face.
chapters.zh: 因为耶和华是公义的。他喜爱公义。正直人必得见他的面。

chapters.en: Help, LORD, for no one is faithful anymore; those who are loyal have vanished from the human race.
chapters.zh: （大卫的诗，交与伶长。调用第八。）耶和华阿，求你帮助，因虔诚人断绝了。世人中间的忠信人没有了。

chapters.en: Everyone lies to their neighbor; they flatter with their lips but harbor deception in their hearts.
chapters.zh: 人人向邻舍说谎。他们说话，是嘴唇油滑，心口不一。

chapters.en: May the LORD silence all flattering lips and every boastful tongue—
chapters.zh: 凡油滑的嘴唇，和夸大的舌头，耶和华必要剪除。

chapters.en: those who say, “By our tongues we will prevail; our own lips will defend us—who is lord over us?”
chapters.zh: 他们曾说，我们必能以舌头得胜。我们的嘴唇是我们自己的。谁能作我们的主呢？

chapters.en: “Because the poor are plundered and the needy groan, I will now arise,” says the LORD. “I will protect them from those who malign them.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华说，因为困苦人的冤屈，和贫穷人的叹息，我现在要起来，把他安置在他所切慕的稳妥之地。

chapters.en: And the words of the LORD are flawless, like silver purified in a crucible, like gold refined seven times.
chapters.zh: 耶和华的言语，是纯净的言语。如同银子在泥炉中炼过七次。

chapters.en: You, LORD, will keep the needy safe and will protect us forever from the wicked,
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，你必保护他们。你必保佑他们永远脱离这世代的人。

chapters.en: who freely strut about when what is vile is honored by the human race.
chapters.zh: 下流人在世人中升高，就有恶人到处游行。

chapters.en: How long, LORD? Will you forget me forever? How long will you hide your face from me?
chapters.zh: （大卫的诗，交与伶长。）耶和华阿，你忘记我要到几时呢？要到永远吗？你掩面不顾我要到几时呢？

chapters.en: How long must I wrestle with my thoughts and day after day have sorrow in my heart? How long will my enemy triumph over me?
chapters.zh: 我心里筹算，终日愁苦，要到几时呢？我的仇敌升高压制我，要到几时呢？

chapters.en: Look on me and answer, LORD my God. Give light to my eyes, or I will sleep in death,
chapters.zh: 耶和华我的神阿，求你看顾我，应允我，使我眼目光明，免得我沉睡至死。

chapters.en: and my enemy will say, “I have overcome him,” and my foes will rejoice when I fall.
chapters.zh: 免得我的仇敌说，我胜了他。免得我的敌人在我摇动的时候喜乐。

chapters.en: But I trust in your unfailing love; my heart rejoices in your salvation.
chapters.zh: 但我倚靠你的慈爱。我的心因你的救恩快乐。

chapters.en: I will sing the LORD’s praise, for he has been good to me.
chapters.zh: 我要向耶和华歌唱，因他用厚恩待我。

chapters.en: The fool says in his heart, “There is no God.” They are corrupt, their deeds are vile; there is no one who does good.
chapters.zh: （大卫的诗，交与伶长。）愚顽人心里说，没有神。他们都是邪恶，行了可憎恶的事。没有一个人行善。

chapters.en: The LORD looks down from heaven on all mankind to see if there are any who understand, any who seek God.
chapters.zh: 耶和华从天上垂看世人，要看有明白的没有，有寻求神的没有。

chapters.en: All have turned away, all have become corrupt; there is no one who does good, not even one.
chapters.zh: 他们都偏离正路，一同变为污秽。并没有行善的，连一个也没有。

chapters.en: Do all these evildoers know nothing? They devour my people as though eating bread; they never call on the LORD.
chapters.zh: 作孽的都没有知识吗？他们吞吃我的百姓，如同吃饭一样，并不求告耶和华。

chapters.en: But there they are, overwhelmed with dread, for God is present in the company of the righteous.
chapters.zh: 他们在那里大大地害怕，因为神在义人的族类中。

chapters.en: You evildoers frustrate the plans of the poor, but the LORD is their refuge.
chapters.zh: 你们叫困苦人的谋算，变为羞辱。然而耶和华是他的避难所。

chapters.en: Oh, that salvation for Israel would come out of Zion! When the LORD restores his people, let Jacob rejoice and Israel be glad!
chapters.zh: 但愿以色列的救恩从锡安而出。耶和华救回他被掳的子民，那时雅各要快乐，以色列要欢喜。

chapters.en: LORD, who may dwell in your sacred tent? Who may live on your holy mountain?
chapters.zh: （大卫的诗。）耶和华阿，谁能寄居你的帐幕？谁能住在你的圣山？

chapters.en: The one whose walk is blameless, who does what is righteous, who speaks the truth from their heart;
chapters.zh: 就是行为正直，作事公义，心里说实话的人。

chapters.en: whose tongue utters no slander, who does no wrong to a neighbor, and casts no slur on others;
chapters.zh: 他不以舌头谗谤人，不恶待朋友，也不随伙毁谤邻里。

chapters.en: who despises a vile person but honors those who fear the LORD; who keeps an oath even when it hurts, and does not change their mind;
chapters.zh: 他眼中藐视匪类，却尊重那敬畏耶和华的人。他发了誓，虽然自己吃亏，也不更改。

chapters.en: who lends money to the poor without interest; who does not accept a bribe against the innocent. Whoever does these things will never be shaken.
chapters.zh: 他不放债取利，不受贿赂以害无辜。行这些事的人，必永不动摇。

chapters.en: Keep me safe, my God, for in you I take refuge.
chapters.zh: （大卫的金诗。）神阿，求你保佑我，因为我投靠你。

chapters.en: I say to the LORD, “You are my Lord; apart from you I have no good thing.”
chapters.zh: 我的心哪，你曾对耶和华说，你是我的主。我的好处不在你以外。

chapters.en: I say of the holy people who are in the land, “They are the noble ones in whom is all my delight.”
chapters.zh: 论到世上的圣民，他们又美又善，是我最喜悦的。

chapters.en: Those who run after other gods will suffer more and more. I will not pour out libations of blood to such gods or take up their names on my lips.
chapters.zh: 以别神代替耶和华的（或作送礼物给别神的），他们的愁苦必加增。他们所浇奠的血我不献上，我嘴唇也不提别神的名号。

chapters.en: LORD, you alone are my portion and my cup; you make my lot secure.
chapters.zh: 耶和华是我的产业，是我杯中的分。我所得的你为我持守。

chapters.en: The boundary lines have fallen for me in pleasant places; surely I have a delightful inheritance.
chapters.zh: 用绳量给我的地界，坐落在佳美之处。我的产业实在美好。

chapters.en: I will praise the LORD, who counsels me; even at night my heart instructs me.
chapters.zh: 我必称颂那指教我的耶和华。我的心肠在夜间也警戒我。

chapters.en: I keep my eyes always on the LORD. With him at my right hand, I will not be shaken.
chapters.zh: 我将耶和华常摆在我面前。因他在我右边，我便不至摇动。

chapters.en: Therefore my heart is glad and my tongue rejoices; my body also will rest secure,
chapters.zh: 因此我的心欢喜，我的灵（原文作荣耀）快乐。我的肉身也要安然居住。

chapters.en: because you will not abandon me to the realm of the dead, nor will you let your faithful one see decay.
chapters.zh: 因为你必不将我的灵魂撇在阴间。也不叫你的圣者见朽坏。

chapters.en: You make known to me the path of life; you will fill me with joy in your presence, with eternal pleasures at your right hand.
chapters.zh: 你必将生命的道路指示我。在你面前有满足的喜乐。在你右手中有永远的福乐。

chapters.en: Hear me, LORD, my plea is just; listen to my cry. Hear my prayer— it does not rise from deceitful lips.
chapters.zh: （大卫的祈祷。）耶和华阿，求你听闻公义，侧耳听我的呼吁。求你留心听我这不出于诡诈嘴唇的祈祷。

chapters.en: Let my vindication come from you; may your eyes see what is right.
chapters.zh: 愿我的判语从你面前发出。愿你的眼睛观看公正。

chapters.en: Though you probe my heart, though you examine me at night and test me, you will find that I have planned no evil; my mouth has not transgressed.
chapters.zh: 你已经试验我的心。你在夜间鉴察我。你熬炼我，却找不着什么。我立志叫我口中没有过失。

chapters.en: Though people tried to bribe me, I have kept myself from the ways of the violent through what your lips have commanded.
chapters.zh: 论到人的行为，我借着你嘴唇的言语，自己谨守，不行强暴人的道路。

chapters.en: My steps have held to your paths; my feet have not stumbled.
chapters.zh: 我的脚踏定了你的路径，我的两脚未曾滑跌。

chapters.en: I call on you, my God, for you will answer me; turn your ear to me and hear my prayer.
chapters.zh: 神阿，我曾求告你，因为你必应允我。求你向我侧耳，听我的言语。

chapters.en: Show me the wonders of your great love, you who save by your right hand those who take refuge in you from their foes.
chapters.zh: 求你显出你奇妙的慈爱来。你是那用右手拯救投靠你的，脱离起来攻击他们的人。

chapters.en: Keep me as the apple of your eye; hide me in the shadow of your wings
chapters.zh: 求你保护我，如同保护眼中的瞳人。将我隐藏在你翅膀的荫下，

chapters.en: from the wicked who are out to destroy me, from my mortal enemies who surround me.
chapters.zh: 使我脱离那欺压我的恶人，就是围困我，要害我命的仇敌。

chapters.en: They close up their callous hearts, and their mouths speak with arrogance.
chapters.zh: 他们的心被脂油包裹。他们用口说骄傲的话。

chapters.en: They have tracked me down, they now surround me, with eyes alert, to throw me to the ground.
chapters.zh: 他们围困了我们的脚步。他们瞪着眼，要把我们推倒在地。

chapters.en: They are like a lion hungry for prey, like a fierce lion crouching in cover.
chapters.zh: 他像狮子急要抓食，又像少壮狮子蹲伏在暗处。

chapters.en: Rise up, LORD, confront them, bring them down; with your sword rescue me from the wicked.
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，求你起来，前去迎敌，将他打倒。用你的刀救护我命脱离恶人。

chapters.en: By your hand save me from such people, LORD, from those of this world whose reward is in this life. May what you have stored up for the wicked fill their bellies; may their children gorge themselves on it, and may there be leftovers for their little ones.
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，求你用手救我脱离世人，脱离那只在今生有福分的世人。你把你的财宝充满他们的肚腹。他们因有儿女就心满意足，将其余的财物留给他们的婴孩。

chapters.en: As for me, I will be vindicated and will see your face; when I awake, I will be satisfied with seeing your likeness.
chapters.zh: 至于我，我必在义中见你的面。我醒了的时候，得见你的形像（见或作看），就心满意足了。

chapters.en: I love you, LORD, my strength.
chapters.zh: （耶和华的仆人大卫的诗，交与伶长。当耶和华救他脱离一切仇敌和扫罗之手的日子，他向耶和华念这诗的话。说：）耶和华我的力量阿，我爱你。

chapters.en: The LORD is my rock, my fortress and my deliverer; my God is my rock, in whom I take refuge, my shield and the horn of my salvation, my stronghold.
chapters.zh: 耶和华是我的岩石，我的山寨，我的救主，我的神，我的磐石，我所投靠的。他是我的盾牌，是拯救我的角，是我的高台。

chapters.en: I called to the LORD, who is worthy of praise, and I have been saved from my enemies.
chapters.zh: 我要求告当赞美的耶和华。这样我必从仇敌手中被救出来。

chapters.en: The cords of death entangled me; the torrents of destruction overwhelmed me.
chapters.zh: 曾有死亡的绳索缠绕我。匪类的急流使我惊惧。

chapters.en: The cords of the grave coiled around me; the snares of death confronted me.
chapters.zh: 阴间的绳索缠绕我。死亡的网罗临到我。

chapters.en: In my distress I called to the LORD; I cried to my God for help. From his temple he heard my voice; my cry came before him, into his ears.
chapters.zh: 我在急难中求告耶和华，向我的神呼求。他从殿中听了我的声音，我在他面前的呼求入了他的耳中。

chapters.en: The earth trembled and quaked, and the foundations of the mountains shook; they trembled because he was angry.
chapters.zh: 那时因他发怒，地就摇撼战抖，山的根基也震动摇撼。

chapters.en: Smoke rose from his nostrils; consuming fire came from his mouth, burning coals blazed out of it.
chapters.zh: 从他鼻孔冒烟上腾，从他口中发火焚烧。连炭也着了。

chapters.en: He parted the heavens and came down; dark clouds were under his feet.
chapters.zh: 他又使天下垂，亲自降临。有黑云在他脚下。

chapters.en: He mounted the cherubim and flew; he soared on the wings of the wind.
chapters.zh: 他坐着基路伯飞行。他借着风的翅膀快飞。

chapters.en: He made darkness his covering, his canopy around him— the dark rain clouds of the sky.
chapters.zh: 他以黑暗为藏身之处，以水的黑暗，天空的厚云，为他四围的行宫。

chapters.en: Out of the brightness of his presence clouds advanced, with hailstones and bolts of lightning.
chapters.zh: 因他面前的光辉，他的厚云行过。便有冰雹火炭。

chapters.en: The LORD thundered from heaven; the voice of the Most High resounded.
chapters.zh: 耶和华也在天上打雷。至高者发出声音，便有冰雹火炭。

chapters.en: He shot his arrows and scattered the enemy, with great bolts of lightning he routed them.
chapters.zh: 他射出箭来，使仇敌四散。多多发出闪电，使他们扰乱。

chapters.en: The valleys of the sea were exposed and the foundations of the earth laid bare at your rebuke, LORD, at the blast of breath from your nostrils.
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，你的斥责一发，你鼻孔的气一出，海底就出现，大地的根基也显露。

chapters.en: He reached down from on high and took hold of me; he drew me out of deep waters.
chapters.zh: 他从高天伸手抓住我。把我从大水中拉上来。

chapters.en: He rescued me from my powerful enemy, from my foes, who were too strong for me.
chapters.zh: 他救我脱离我的劲敌，和那些恨我的人。因为他们比我强盛。

chapters.en: They confronted me in the day of my disaster, but the LORD was my support.
chapters.zh: 我遭遇灾难的日子，他们来攻击我。但耶和华是我的倚靠。

chapters.en: He brought me out into a spacious place; he rescued me because he delighted in me.
chapters.zh: 他又领我到宽阔之处。他救拔我，因他喜悦我。

chapters.en: The LORD has dealt with me according to my righteousness; according to the cleanness of my hands he has rewarded me.
chapters.zh: 耶和华按着我的公义报答我，按着我手中的清洁赏赐我。

chapters.en: For I have kept the ways of the LORD; I am not guilty of turning from my God.
chapters.zh: 因为我遵守了耶和华的道，未曾作恶离开我的神。

chapters.en: All his laws are before me; I have not turned away from his decrees.
chapters.zh: 他的一切典章常在我面前。他的律例我也未曾丢弃。

chapters.en: I have been blameless before him and have kept myself from sin.
chapters.zh: 我在他面前作了完全人。我也保守自己远离我的罪孽。

chapters.en: The LORD has rewarded me according to my righteousness, according to the cleanness of my hands in his sight.
chapters.zh: 所以耶和华按我的公义，按我在他眼前手中的清洁，偿还我。

chapters.en: To the faithful you show yourself faithful, to the blameless you show yourself blameless,
chapters.zh: 慈爱的人，你以慈爱待他。完全的人，你以完全待他。

chapters.en: to the pure you show yourself pure, but to the devious you show yourself shrewd.
chapters.zh: 清洁的人，你以清洁待他。乖僻的人，你以弯曲待他。

chapters.en: You save the humble but bring low those whose eyes are haughty.
chapters.zh: 困苦的百姓，你必拯救。高傲的眼目，你必使他降卑。

chapters.en: You, LORD, keep my lamp burning; my God turns my darkness into light.
chapters.zh: 你必点着我的灯。耶和华我的神必照明我的黑暗。

chapters.en: With your help I can advance against a troop ; with my God I can scale a wall.
chapters.zh: 我借着你冲入敌军，借着我的神跳过墙垣。

chapters.en: As for God, his way is perfect: The LORD’s word is flawless; he shields all who take refuge in him.
chapters.zh: 至于神，他的道是完全的。耶和华的话是炼净的。凡投靠他的，他便作他们的盾牌。

chapters.en: For who is God besides the LORD? And who is the Rock except our God?
chapters.zh: 除了耶和华，谁是神呢？除了我们的神，谁是磐石呢？

chapters.en: It is God who arms me with strength and keeps my way secure.
chapters.zh: 惟有那以力量束我的腰，使我行为完全的，他是神。

chapters.en: He makes my feet like the feet of a deer; he causes me to stand on the heights.
chapters.zh: 他使我的脚快如母鹿的蹄，又使我在高处安稳。

chapters.en: He trains my hands for battle; my arms can bend a bow of bronze.
chapters.zh: 他教导我的手能以争战，甚至我的膀臂能开铜弓。

chapters.en: You make your saving help my shield, and your right hand sustains me; your help has made me great.
chapters.zh: 你把你的救恩给我作盾牌。你的右手扶持我。你的温和使我为大。

chapters.en: You provide a broad path for my feet, so that my ankles do not give way.
chapters.zh: 你使我脚下的地步宽阔。我的脚未曾滑跌。

chapters.en: I pursued my enemies and overtook them; I did not turn back till they were destroyed.
chapters.zh: 我要追赶我的仇敌，并要追上他们。不将他们灭绝，我总不归回。

chapters.en: I crushed them so that they could not rise; they fell beneath my feet.
chapters.zh: 我要打伤他们，使他们不能起来。他们必倒在我的脚下。

chapters.en: You armed me with strength for battle; you humbled my adversaries before me.
chapters.zh: 因为你曾以力量束我的腰，使我能争战。你也使那起来攻击我的，都服在我以下。

chapters.en: You made my enemies turn their backs in flight, and I destroyed my foes.
chapters.zh: 你又使我的仇敌在我面前转背逃跑，叫我能以剪除那恨我的人。

chapters.en: They cried for help, but there was no one to save them— to the LORD, but he did not answer.
chapters.zh: 他们呼求，却无人拯救，就是呼求耶和华，他也不应允。

chapters.en: I beat them as fine as windblown dust; I trampled them like mud in the streets.
chapters.zh: 我捣碎他们，如同风前的灰尘，倒出他们，如同街上的泥土。

chapters.en: You have delivered me from the attacks of the people; you have made me the head of nations. People I did not know now serve me,
chapters.zh: 你救我脱离百姓的争竞，立我作列国的元首。我素不认识的民必事奉我。

chapters.en: foreigners cower before me; as soon as they hear of me, they obey me.
chapters.zh: 他们一听见我的名声，就必顺从我。外邦人要投降我。

chapters.en: They all lose heart; they come trembling from their strongholds.
chapters.zh: 外邦人要衰残，战战兢兢地出他们的营寨。

chapters.en: The LORD lives! Praise be to my Rock! Exalted be God my Savior!
chapters.zh: 耶和华是活神。愿我的磐石被人称颂。愿救我的神被人尊崇。

chapters.en: He is the God who avenges me, who subdues nations under me,
chapters.zh: 这位神，就是那为我伸冤，使众民服在我以下的。

chapters.en: who saves me from my enemies. You exalted me above my foes; from a violent man you rescued me.
chapters.zh: 你救我脱离仇敌。又把我举起，高过那些起来攻击我的。你救我脱离强暴的人。

chapters.en: Therefore I will praise you, LORD, among the nations; I will sing the praises of your name.
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，因此我要在外邦中称谢你，歌颂你的名。

chapters.en: He gives his king great victories; he shows unfailing love to his anointed, to David and to his descendants forever.
chapters.zh: 耶和华赐极大的救恩给他所立的王，施慈爱给他的受膏者，就是给大卫和他的后裔，直到永远。

chapters.en: The heavens declare the glory of God; the skies proclaim the work of his hands.
chapters.zh: （大卫的诗，交与伶长。）诸天述说神的荣耀，穹苍传扬他的手段。

chapters.en: Day after day they pour forth speech; night after night they reveal knowledge.
chapters.zh: 这日到那日发出言语。这夜到那夜传出知识。

chapters.en: They have no speech, they use no words; no sound is heard from them.
chapters.zh: 无言无语，也无声音可听。

chapters.en: Yet their voice goes out into all the earth, their words to the ends of the world. In the heavens God has pitched a tent for the sun.
chapters.zh: 他的量带通遍天下，他的言语传到地极。神在其间为太阳安设帐幕。

chapters.en: It is like a bridegroom coming out of his chamber, like a champion rejoicing to run his course.
chapters.zh: 太阳如同新郎出洞房，又如勇士欢然奔路。

chapters.en: It rises at one end of the heavens and makes its circuit to the other; nothing is deprived of its warmth.
chapters.zh: 他从天这边出来，绕到天那边。没有一物被隐藏不得他的热气。

chapters.en: The law of the LORD is perfect, refreshing the soul. The statutes of the LORD are trustworthy, making wise the simple.
chapters.zh: 耶和华的律法全备，能苏醒人心。耶和华的法度确定，能使愚人有智慧。

chapters.en: The precepts of the LORD are right, giving joy to the heart. The commands of the LORD are radiant, giving light to the eyes.
chapters.zh: 耶和华的训词正直，能快活人的心。耶和华的命令清洁，能明亮人的眼目。

chapters.en: The fear of the LORD is pure, enduring forever. The decrees of the LORD are firm, and all of them are righteous.
chapters.zh: 耶和华的道理洁净，存到永远。耶和华的典章真实，全然公义。

chapters.en: They are more precious than gold, than much pure gold; they are sweeter than honey, than honey from the honeycomb.
chapters.zh: 都比金子可羡慕，且比极多的精金可羡慕。比蜜甘甜，且比蜂房下滴的蜜甘甜。

chapters.en: By them your servant is warned; in keeping them there is great reward.
chapters.zh: 况且你的仆人因此受警戒。守着这些便有大赏。

chapters.en: But who can discern their own errors? Forgive my hidden faults.
chapters.zh: 谁能知道自己的错失呢？愿你赦免我隐而未现的过错。

chapters.en: Keep your servant also from willful sins; may they not rule over me. Then I will be blameless, innocent of great transgression.
chapters.zh: 求你拦阻仆人，不犯任意妄为的罪。不容这罪辖制我。我便完全，免犯大罪。

chapters.en: May these words of my mouth and this meditation of my heart be pleasing in your sight, LORD, my Rock and my Redeemer.
chapters.zh: 耶和华我的磐石，我的救赎主阿，愿我口中的言语，心里的意念，在你面前蒙悦纳。

chapters.en: May the LORD answer you when you are in distress; may the name of the God of Jacob protect you.
chapters.zh: （大卫的诗，交与伶长。）愿耶和华在你遭难的日子应允你。愿名为雅各神的高举你。

chapters.en: May he send you help from the sanctuary and grant you support from Zion.
chapters.zh: 愿他从圣所救助你，从锡安坚固你。

chapters.en: May he remember all your sacrifices and accept your burnt offerings.
chapters.zh: 记念你的一切供献，悦纳你的燔祭。（细拉）

chapters.en: May he give you the desire of your heart and make all your plans succeed.
chapters.zh: 将你心所愿的赐给你，成就你的一切筹算。

chapters.en: May we shout for joy over your victory and lift up our banners in the name of our God. May the LORD grant all your requests.
chapters.zh: 我们要因你的救恩夸胜，要奉我们神的名竖立旌旗。愿耶和华成就你一切所求的。

chapters.en: Now this I know: The LORD gives victory to his anointed. He answers him from his heavenly sanctuary with the victorious power of his right hand.
chapters.zh: 现在我知道耶和华救护他的受膏者，必从他的圣天上应允他，用右手的能力救护他。

chapters.en: Some trust in chariots and some in horses, but we trust in the name of the LORD our God.
chapters.zh: 有人靠车，有人靠马。但我们要提到耶和华我们神的名。

chapters.en: They are brought to their knees and fall, but we rise up and stand firm.
chapters.zh: 他们都屈身仆倒，我们却起来，立得正直。

chapters.en: LORD, give victory to the king! Answer us when we call!
chapters.zh: 求耶和华施行拯救。我们呼求的时候，愿王应允我们。

chapters.en: The king rejoices in your strength, LORD. How great is his joy in the victories you give!
chapters.zh: （大卫的诗，交与伶长。）耶和华阿，王必因你的能力欢喜。因你的救恩，他的快乐何其大。

chapters.en: You have granted him his heart’s desire and have not withheld the request of his lips.
chapters.zh: 他心里所愿的，你已经赐给他。他嘴唇所求的，你未尝不应允。（细拉）

chapters.en: You came to greet him with rich blessings and placed a crown of pure gold on his head.
chapters.zh: 你以美福迎接他，把精金的冠冕戴在他头上。

chapters.en: He asked you for life, and you gave it to him— length of days, for ever and ever.
chapters.zh: 他向你求寿，你便赐给他，就是日子长久，直到永远。

chapters.en: Through the victories you gave, his glory is great; you have bestowed on him splendor and majesty.
chapters.zh: 他因你的救恩大有荣耀。你又将尊荣威严加在他身上。

chapters.en: Surely you have granted him unending blessings and made him glad with the joy of your presence.
chapters.zh: 你使他有洪福，直到永远。又使他在你面前欢喜快乐。

chapters.en: For the king trusts in the LORD; through the unfailing love of the Most High he will not be shaken.
chapters.zh: 王倚靠耶和华，因至高者的慈爱必不摇动。

chapters.en: Your hand will lay hold on all your enemies; your right hand will seize your foes.
chapters.zh: 你的手要搜出你的一切仇敌。你的右手要搜出那些恨你的人。

chapters.en: When you appear for battle, you will burn them up as in a blazing furnace. The LORD will swallow them up in his wrath, and his fire will consume them.
chapters.zh: 你发怒的时候，要使他们如在炎热的火炉中。耶和华要在他的震怒中吞灭他们。那火要把他们烧尽了。

chapters.en: You will destroy their descendants from the earth, their posterity from mankind.
chapters.zh: 你必从世上灭绝他们的子孙（子孙原文作果子），从人间灭绝他们的后裔。

chapters.en: Though they plot evil against you and devise wicked schemes, they cannot succeed.
chapters.zh: 因为他们有意加害于你。他们想出计谋，却不能作成。

chapters.en: You will make them turn their backs when you aim at them with drawn bow.
chapters.zh: 你必使他们转背逃跑，向他们的脸搭箭在弦。

chapters.en: Be exalted in your strength, LORD; we will sing and praise your might.
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，愿你因自己的能力显为至高。这样，我们就唱诗，歌颂你的大能。

chapters.en: My God, my God, why have you forsaken me? Why are you so far from saving me, so far from my cries of anguish?
chapters.zh: （大卫的诗，交与伶长。调用朝鹿。）我的神，我的神，为什么离弃我。为什么远离不救我，不听我唉哼的言语。

chapters.en: My God, I cry out by day, but you do not answer, by night, but I find no rest.
chapters.zh: 我的神阿，我白日呼求，你不应允。夜间呼求，并不住声。

chapters.en: Yet you are enthroned as the Holy One; you are the one Israel praises.
chapters.zh: 但你是圣洁的，是用以色列的赞美为宝座的（宝座或作居所）。

chapters.en: In you our ancestors put their trust; they trusted and you delivered them.
chapters.zh: 我们的祖宗倚靠你。他们倚靠你，你便解救他们。

chapters.en: To you they cried out and were saved; in you they trusted and were not put to shame.
chapters.zh: 他们哀求你，便蒙解救。他们倚靠你，就不羞愧。

chapters.en: But I am a worm and not a man, scorned by everyone, despised by the people.
chapters.zh: 但我是虫，不是人。被众人羞辱，被百姓藐视。

chapters.en: All who see me mock me; they hurl insults, shaking their heads.
chapters.zh: 凡看见我的都嗤笑我。他们撇嘴摇头，说，

chapters.en: “He trusts in the LORD,” they say, “let the LORD rescue him. Let him deliver him, since he delights in him.”
chapters.zh: 他把自己交托耶和华，耶和华可以救他吧。耶和华既喜悦他，可以搭救他吧。

chapters.en: Yet you brought me out of the womb; you made me trust in you, even at my mother’s breast.
chapters.zh: 但你是叫我出母腹的。我在母怀里，你就使我有倚靠的心。

chapters.en: From birth I was cast on you; from my mother’s womb you have been my God.
chapters.zh: 我自出母胎就被交在你手里。从我母亲生我，你就是我的神。

chapters.en: Do not be far from me, for trouble is near and there is no one to help.
chapters.zh: 求你不要远离我。因为急难临近了，没有人帮助我。

chapters.en: Many bulls surround me; strong bulls of Bashan encircle me.
chapters.zh: 有许多公牛围绕我。巴珊大力的公牛四面困住我。

chapters.en: Roaring lions that tear their prey open their mouths wide against me.
chapters.zh: 他们向我张口，好像抓撕吼叫的狮子。

chapters.en: I am poured out like water, and all my bones are out of joint. My heart has turned to wax; it has melted within me.
chapters.zh: 我如水被倒出来。我的骨头都脱了节。我心在我里面如蜡熔化。

chapters.en: My mouth is dried up like a potsherd, and my tongue sticks to the roof of my mouth; you lay me in the dust of death.
chapters.zh: 我的精力枯干，如同瓦片。我的舌头贴在我牙床上。你将我安置在死地的尘土中。

chapters.en: Dogs surround me, a pack of villains encircles me; they pierce my hands and my feet.
chapters.zh: 犬类围着我。恶党环绕我。他们扎了我的手，我的脚。

chapters.en: All my bones are on display; people stare and gloat over me.
chapters.zh: 我的骨头，我都能数过。他们瞪着眼看我。

chapters.en: They divide my clothes among them and cast lots for my garment.
chapters.zh: 他们分我的外衣，为我的里衣拈阄。

chapters.en: But you, LORD, do not be far from me. You are my strength; come quickly to help me.
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，求你不要远离我。我的救主阿，求你快来帮助我。

chapters.en: Deliver me from the sword, my precious life from the power of the dogs.
chapters.zh: 求你救我的灵魂脱离刀剑，救我的生命脱离犬类（生命原文作独一者）。

chapters.en: Rescue me from the mouth of the lions; save me from the horns of the wild oxen.
chapters.zh: 救我脱离狮子的口。你已经应允我，使我脱离野牛的角。

chapters.en: I will declare your name to my people; in the assembly I will praise you.
chapters.zh: 我要将你的名传与我的弟兄。在会中我要赞美你。

chapters.en: You who fear the LORD, praise him! All you descendants of Jacob, honor him! Revere him, all you descendants of Israel!
chapters.zh: 你们敬畏耶和华的人，要赞美他。雅各的后裔，都要荣耀他。以色列的后裔，都要惧怕他。

chapters.en: For he has not despised or scorned the suffering of the afflicted one; he has not hidden his face from him but has listened to his cry for help.
chapters.zh: 因为他没有藐视憎恶受苦的人。也没有向他掩面。那受苦之人呼吁的时候，他就垂听。

chapters.en: From you comes the theme of my praise in the great assembly; before those who fear you I will fulfill my vows.
chapters.zh: 我在大会中赞美你的话，是从你而来的。我要在敬畏耶和华的人面前还我的愿。

chapters.en: The poor will eat and be satisfied; those who seek the LORD will praise him— may your hearts live forever!
chapters.zh: 谦卑的人必吃得饱足。寻求耶和华的人必赞美他。愿你们的心永远活着。

chapters.en: All the ends of the earth will remember and turn to the LORD, and all the families of the nations will bow down before him,
chapters.zh: 地的四极，都要想念耶和华，并且归顺他。列国的万族，都要在你面前敬拜。

chapters.en: for dominion belongs to the LORD and he rules over the nations.
chapters.zh: 因为国权是耶和华的。他是管理万国的。

chapters.en: All the rich of the earth will feast and worship; all who go down to the dust will kneel before him— those who cannot keep themselves alive.
chapters.zh: 地上一切丰肥的人，必吃喝而敬拜。凡下到尘土中不能存活自己性命的人，都要在他面前下拜。

chapters.en: Posterity will serve him; future generations will be told about the Lord.
chapters.zh: 他必有后裔事奉他。主所行的事，必传与后代。

chapters.en: They will proclaim his righteousness, declaring to a people yet unborn: He has done it!
chapters.zh: 他们必来把他的公义传给将要生的民，言明这事是他所行的。

chapters.en: The LORD is my shepherd, I lack nothing.
chapters.zh: （大卫的诗。）耶和华是我的牧者。我必不至缺乏。

chapters.en: He makes me lie down in green pastures, he leads me beside quiet waters,
chapters.zh: 他使我躺卧在青草地上，领我在可安歇的水边。

chapters.en: he refreshes my soul. He guides me along the right paths for his name’s sake.
chapters.zh: 他使我的灵魂苏醒，为自己的名引导我走义路。

chapters.en: Even though I walk through the darkest valley,I will fear no evil, for you are with me; your rod and your staff, they comfort me.
chapters.zh: 我虽然行过死荫的幽谷，也不怕遭害。因为你与我同在。你的杖，你的竿，都安慰我。

chapters.en: You prepare a table before me in the presence of my enemies. You anoint my head with oil; my cup overflows.
chapters.zh: 在我敌人面前，你为我摆设筵席。你用油膏了我的头，使我的福杯满溢。

chapters.en: Surely your goodness and love will follow me all the days of my life, and I will dwell in the house of the LORD forever.
chapters.zh: 我一生一世必有恩惠慈爱随着我。我且要住在耶和华的殿中，直到永远。

chapters.en: The earth is the LORD’s, and everything in it, the world, and all who live in it;
chapters.zh: （大卫的诗。）地和其中所充满的，世界和住在其间的，都属耶和华。

chapters.en: for he founded it on the seas and established it on the waters.
chapters.zh: 他把地建立在海上，安定在大水之上。

chapters.en: Who may ascend the mountain of the LORD? Who may stand in his holy place?
chapters.zh: 谁能登耶和华的山。谁能站在他的圣所。

chapters.en: The one who has clean hands and a pure heart, who does not trust in an idol or swear by a false god.
chapters.zh: 就是手洁心清，不向虚妄，起誓不怀诡诈的人。

chapters.en: They will receive blessing from the LORD and vindication from God their Savior.
chapters.zh: 他必蒙耶和华赐福，又蒙救他的神使他成义。

chapters.en: Such is the generation of those who seek him, who seek your face, God of Jacob.
chapters.zh: 这是寻求耶和华的族类，是寻求你面的雅各（细拉）。

chapters.en: Lift up your heads, you gates; be lifted up, you ancient doors, that the King of glory may come in.
chapters.zh: 众城门哪，你们要抬起头来。永久的门户，你们要被举起。那荣耀的王将要进来。

chapters.en: Who is this King of glory? The LORD strong and mighty, the LORD mighty in battle.
chapters.zh: 荣耀的王是谁呢？就是有力有能的耶和华，在战场上有能的耶和华。

chapters.en: Lift up your heads, you gates; lift them up, you ancient doors, that the King of glory may come in.
chapters.zh: 众城门哪，你们要抬起头来。永久的门户，你们要把头抬起。那荣耀的王将要进来。

chapters.en: Who is he, this King of glory? The LORD Almighty— he is the King of glory.
chapters.zh: 荣耀的王是谁呢？万军之耶和华，他是荣耀的王。（细拉）

chapters.en: In you, LORD my God, I put my trust.
chapters.zh: （大卫的诗。）耶和华阿，我的心仰望你。

chapters.en: I trust in you; do not let me be put to shame, nor let my enemies triumph over me.
chapters.zh: 我的神阿，我素来倚靠你。求你不要叫我羞愧。不要叫我的仇敌向我夸胜。

chapters.en: No one who hopes in you will ever be put to shame, but shame will come on those who are treacherous without cause.
chapters.zh: 凡等候你的必不羞愧。惟有那无故行奸诈的，必要羞愧。

chapters.en: Show me your ways, LORD, teach me your paths.
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，求你将你的道指示我，将你的路教训我。

chapters.en: Guide me in your truth and teach me, for you are God my Savior, and my hope is in you all day long.
chapters.zh: 求你以你的真理引导我，教训我。因为你是救我的神。我终日等候你。

chapters.en: Remember, LORD, your great mercy and love, for they are from of old.
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，求你记念你的怜悯和慈爱。因为这是亘古以来所常有的。

chapters.en: Do not remember the sins of my youth and my rebellious ways; according to your love remember me, for you, LORD, are good.
chapters.zh: 求你不要记念我幼年的罪愆，和我的过犯。耶和华阿，求你因你的恩惠，按你的慈爱记念我。

chapters.en: Good and upright is the LORD; therefore he instructs sinners in his ways.
chapters.zh: 耶和华是良善正直的。所以他必指示罪人走正路。

chapters.en: He guides the humble in what is right and teaches them his way.
chapters.zh: 他必按公平引领谦卑人，将他的道教训他们。

chapters.en: All the ways of the LORD are loving and faithful toward those who keep the demands of his covenant.
chapters.zh: 凡遵守他的约和他法度的人，耶和华都以慈爱诚实待他。

chapters.en: For the sake of your name, LORD, forgive my iniquity, though it is great.
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，求你因你的名赦免我的罪，因为我的罪重大。

chapters.en: Who, then, are those who fear the LORD? He will instruct them in the ways they should choose.
chapters.zh: 谁敬畏耶和华，耶和华必指示他当选择的道路。

chapters.en: They will spend their days in prosperity, and their descendants will inherit the land.
chapters.zh: 他必安然居住。他的后裔必承受地土。

chapters.en: The LORD confides in those who fear him; he makes his covenant known to them.
chapters.zh: 耶和华与敬畏他的人亲密。他必将自己的约指示他们。

chapters.en: My eyes are ever on the LORD, for only he will release my feet from the snare.
chapters.zh: 我的眼目时常仰望耶和华。因为他必将我的脚从网里拉出来。

chapters.en: Turn to me and be gracious to me, for I am lonely and afflicted.
chapters.zh: 求你转向我，怜恤我，因为我是孤独困苦。

chapters.en: Relieve the troubles of my heart and free me from my anguish.
chapters.zh: 我心里的愁苦甚多。求你救我脱离我的祸患。

chapters.en: Look on my affliction and my distress and take away all my sins.
chapters.zh: 求你看顾我的困苦，我的艰难，赦免我一切的罪。

chapters.en: See how numerous are my enemies and how fiercely they hate me!
chapters.zh: 求你察看我的仇敌，因为他们人多。并且痛痛的恨我。

chapters.en: Guard my life and rescue me; do not let me be put to shame, for I take refuge in you.
chapters.zh: 求你保护我的性命，搭救我，使我不至羞愧，因为我投靠你。

chapters.en: May integrity and uprightness protect me, because my hope, LORD, is in you.
chapters.zh: 愿纯全正直保守我，因为我等候你。

chapters.en: Deliver Israel, O God, from all their troubles!
chapters.zh: 神阿，求你救赎以色列脱离他一切的愁苦。

chapters.en: Vindicate me, LORD, for I have led a blameless life; I have trusted in the LORD and have not faltered.
chapters.zh: （大卫的诗。）耶和华阿，求你为我伸冤，因我向来行事纯全，我又倚靠耶和华并不摇动。

chapters.en: Test me, LORD, and try me, examine my heart and my mind;
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，求你察看我，试验我，熬炼我的肺腑心肠。

chapters.en: for I have always been mindful of your unfailing love and have lived in reliance on your faithfulness.
chapters.zh: 因为你的慈爱常在我眼前。我也按你的真理而行。

chapters.en: I do not sit with the deceitful, nor do I associate with hypocrites.
chapters.zh: 我没有和虚谎人同坐。也不与瞒哄人的同群。

chapters.en: I abhor the assembly of evildoers and refuse to sit with the wicked.
chapters.zh: 我恨恶恶人的会，必不与恶人同坐。

chapters.en: I wash my hands in innocence, and go about your altar, LORD,
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，我要洗手表明无辜，才环绕你的祭坛。

chapters.en: proclaiming aloud your praise and telling of all your wonderful deeds.
chapters.zh: 我好发称谢的声音。也要述说你一切奇妙的作为。

chapters.en: LORD, I love the house where you live, the place where your glory dwells.
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，我喜爱你所住的殿，和你显荣耀的居所。

chapters.en: Do not take away my soul along with sinners, my life with those who are bloodthirsty,
chapters.zh: 不要把我的灵魂和罪人一同除掉，不要把我的性命和流人血的一同除掉。

chapters.en: in whose hands are wicked schemes, whose right hands are full of bribes.
chapters.zh: 他们的手中有奸恶，右手满有贿赂。

chapters.en: I lead a blameless life; deliver me and be merciful to me.
chapters.zh: 至于我，却要行事纯全。求你救赎我，怜恤我。

chapters.en: My feet stand on level ground; in the great congregation I will praise the LORD.
chapters.zh: 我的脚站在平坦地方。在众会中我要称颂耶和华。

chapters.en: The LORD is my light and my salvation— whom shall I fear? The LORD is the stronghold of my life— of whom shall I be afraid?
chapters.zh: （大卫的诗。）耶和华是我的亮光，是我的拯救。我还怕谁呢？耶和华是我性命的保障（保障或作力量），我还惧谁呢？

chapters.en: When the wicked advance against me to devour me, it is my enemies and my foes who will stumble and fall.
chapters.zh: 那作恶的，就是我的仇敌，前来吃我肉的时候，就绊跌仆倒。

chapters.en: Though an army besiege me, my heart will not fear; though war break out against me, even then I will be confident.
chapters.zh: 虽有军兵安营攻击我，我的心也不害怕。虽然兴起刀兵攻击我，我必仍旧安稳。

chapters.en: One thing I ask from the LORD, this only do I seek: that I may dwell in the house of the LORD all the days of my life, to gaze on the beauty of the LORD and to seek him in his temple.
chapters.zh: 有一件事，我曾求耶和华，我仍要寻求。就是一生一世住在耶和华的殿中，瞻仰他的荣美，在他的殿里求问。

chapters.en: For in the day of trouble he will keep me safe in his dwelling; he will hide me in the shelter of his sacred tent and set me high upon a rock.
chapters.zh: 因为我遭遇患难，他必暗暗地保守我。在他亭子里，把我藏在他帐幕的隐密处，将我高举在磐石上。

chapters.en: Then my head will be exalted above the enemies who surround me; at his sacred tent I will sacrifice with shouts of joy; I will sing and make music to the LORD.
chapters.zh: 现在我得以昂首，高过四面的仇敌。我要在他的帐幕里欢然献祭。我要唱诗，歌颂耶和华。

chapters.en: Hear my voice when I call, LORD; be merciful to me and answer me.
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，我用声音呼吁的时候，求你垂听。并求你怜恤我，应允我。

chapters.en: My heart says of you, “Seek his face!” Your face, LORD, I will seek.
chapters.zh: 你说，你们当寻求我的面。那时我心向你说，耶和华阿，你的面我正要寻求。

chapters.en: Do not hide your face from me, do not turn your servant away in anger; you have been my helper. Do not reject me or forsake me, God my Savior.
chapters.zh: 不要向我掩面，不要发怒赶逐仆人。你向来是帮助我的。救我的神阿，不要丢掉我，也不要离弃我。

chapters.en: Though my father and mother forsake me, the LORD will receive me.
chapters.zh: 我父母离弃我，耶和华必收留我。

chapters.en: Teach me your way, LORD; lead me in a straight path because of my oppressors.
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，求你将你的道指教我，因我仇敌的缘故引导我走平坦的路。

chapters.en: Do not turn me over to the desire of my foes, for false witnesses rise up against me, spouting malicious accusations.
chapters.zh: 求你不要把我交给敌人，遂其所愿，因为妄作见证的，和口吐凶言的，起来攻击我。

chapters.en: I remain confident of this: I will see the goodness of the LORD in the land of the living.
chapters.zh: 我若不信在活人之地得见耶和华的恩惠，就早已丧胆了

chapters.en: Wait for the LORD; be strong and take heart and wait for the LORD.
chapters.zh: 要等候耶和华。当壮胆，坚固你的心。我再说，要等候耶和华。

chapters.en: To you, LORD, I call; you are my Rock, do not turn a deaf ear to me. For if you remain silent, I will be like those who go down to the pit.
chapters.zh: （大卫的诗。）耶和华阿，我要求告你。我的磐石阿，不要向我缄默。倘若你向我闭口，我就如将死的人一样。

chapters.en: Hear my cry for mercy as I call to you for help, as I lift up my hands toward your Most Holy Place.
chapters.zh: 我呼求你，向你至圣所举手的时候，求你垂听我恳求的声音。

chapters.en: Do not drag me away with the wicked, with those who do evil, who speak cordially with their neighbors but harbor malice in their hearts.
chapters.zh: 不要把我和恶人，并作孽的，一同除掉。他们与邻舍说和平话，心里却是奸恶。

chapters.en: Repay them for their deeds and for their evil work; repay them for what their hands have done and bring back on them what they deserve.
chapters.zh: 愿你按着他们所作的，并他们所行的恶事待他们。愿你照着他们手所作的待他们。将他们所应得的报应加给他们。

chapters.en: Because they have no regard for the deeds of the LORD and what his hands have done, he will tear them down and never build them up again.
chapters.zh: 他们既然不留心耶和华所行的，和他手所作的，他就必毁坏他们，不建立他们。

chapters.en: Praise be to the LORD, for he has heard my cry for mercy.
chapters.zh: 耶和华是应当称颂的，因为他听了我恳求的声音。

chapters.en: The LORD is my strength and my shield; my heart trusts in him, and he helps me. My heart leaps for joy, and with my song I praise him.
chapters.zh: 耶和华是我的力量，是我的盾牌。我心里倚靠他，就得帮助。所以我心中欢乐。我必用诗歌颂赞他。

chapters.en: The LORD is the strength of his people, a fortress of salvation for his anointed one.
chapters.zh: 耶和华是他百姓的力量，又是他受膏者得救的保障。

chapters.en: Save your people and bless your inheritance; be their shepherd and carry them forever.
chapters.zh: 求你拯救你的百姓，赐福给你的产业，牧养他们，扶持他们，直到永远。

chapters.en: Ascribe to the LORD, you heavenly beings, ascribe to the LORD glory and strength.
chapters.zh: （大卫的诗。）神的众子阿，你们要将荣耀能力，归给耶和华。归给耶和华。

chapters.en: Ascribe to the LORD the glory due his name; worship the LORD in the splendor of his holiness.
chapters.zh: 要将耶和华的名所当得的荣耀归给他。以圣洁的妆饰（的或作为）敬拜耶和华。

chapters.en: The voice of the LORD is over the waters; the God of glory thunders, the LORD thunders over the mighty waters.
chapters.zh: 耶和华的声音发在水上。荣耀的神打雷，耶和华打雷在大水之上。

chapters.en: The voice of the LORD is powerful; the voice of the LORD is majestic.
chapters.zh: 耶和华的声音大有能力。耶和华的声音满有威严。

chapters.en: The voice of the LORD breaks the cedars; the LORD breaks in pieces the cedars of Lebanon.
chapters.zh: 耶和华的声音震破香柏树。耶和华震碎利巴嫩的香柏树。

chapters.en: He makes Lebanon leap like a calf, Sirion like a young wild ox.
chapters.zh: 他也使之跳跃如牛犊，使利巴嫩和西连跳跃如野牛犊。

chapters.en: The voice of the LORD strikes with flashes of lightning.
chapters.zh: 耶和华的声音使火焰分岔。

chapters.en: The voice of the LORD shakes the desert; the LORD shakes the Desert of Kadesh.
chapters.zh: 耶和华的声音震动旷野。耶和华震动加低斯的旷野。

chapters.en: The voice of the LORD twists the oaks and strips the forests bare. And in his temple all cry, “Glory!”
chapters.zh: 耶和华的声音惊动母鹿落胎，树木也脱落净光。凡在他殿中的，都称说他的荣耀。

chapters.en: The LORD sits enthroned over the flood; the LORD is enthroned as King forever.
chapters.zh: 洪水泛滥之时，耶和华坐着为王。耶和华坐着为王，直到永远。

chapters.en: The LORD gives strength to his people; the LORD blesses his people with peace.
chapters.zh: 耶和华必赐力量给他的百姓。耶和华必赐平安的福给他的百姓。

chapters.en: I will exalt you, LORD, for you lifted me out of the depths and did not let my enemies gloat over me.
chapters.zh: （大卫在献殿的时候，作这诗歌。）耶和华阿，我要尊崇你，因为你曾提拔我，不叫仇敌向我夸耀。

chapters.en: LORD my God, I called to you for help, and you healed me.
chapters.zh: 耶和华我的神阿，我曾呼求你，你医治了我。

chapters.en: You, LORD, brought me up from the realm of the dead; you spared me from going down to the pit.
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，你曾把我的灵魂从阴间救上来，使我存活，不至于下坑。

chapters.en: Sing the praises of the LORD, you his faithful people; praise his holy name.
chapters.zh: 耶和华的圣民哪，你们要歌颂他，称赞他可记念的圣名。

chapters.en: For his anger lasts only a moment, but his favor lasts a lifetime; weeping may stay for the night, but rejoicing comes in the morning.
chapters.zh: 因为他的怒气不过是转眼之间。他的恩典乃是一生之久。一宿虽然有哭泣，早晨便必欢呼。

chapters.en: When I felt secure, I said, “I will never be shaken.”
chapters.zh: 至于我，我凡事平顺，便说，我永不动摇。

chapters.en: LORD, when you favored me, you made my royal mountain stand firm; but when you hid your face, I was dismayed.
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，你曾施恩，叫我的江山稳固。你掩了面，我就惊惶。

chapters.en: To you, LORD, I called; to the Lord I cried for mercy:
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，我曾求告你。我向耶和华恳求，说，

chapters.en: “What is gained if I am silenced, if I go down to the pit? Will the dust praise you? Will it proclaim your faithfulness?
chapters.zh: 我被害流血，下到坑中，有什么益处呢？尘土岂能称赞你，传说你的诚实吗？

chapters.en: Hear, LORD, and be merciful to me; LORD, be my help.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，求你应允我，怜恤我。耶和华阿，求你帮助我。

chapters.en: You turned my wailing into dancing; you removed my sackcloth and clothed me with joy,
chapters.zh: 你已将我的哀哭变为跳舞，将我的麻衣脱去，给我披上喜乐。

chapters.en: that my heart may sing your praises and not be silent. LORD my God, I will praise you forever.
chapters.zh: 好叫我的灵（原文作荣耀）歌颂你，并不住声。耶和华我的神阿，我要称谢你，直到永远。

chapters.en: In you, LORD, I have taken refuge; let me never be put to shame; deliver me in your righteousness.
chapters.zh: （大卫的诗，交与伶长。）耶和华阿，我投靠你，求你使我永不羞愧，凭你的公义搭救我。

chapters.en: Turn your ear to me, come quickly to my rescue; be my rock of refuge, a strong fortress to save me.
chapters.zh: 求你侧耳而听，快快救我，作我坚固的磐石，拯救我的保障。

chapters.en: Since you are my rock and my fortress, for the sake of your name lead and guide me.
chapters.zh: 因为你是我的岩石，我的山寨。所以求你为你名的缘故，引导我，指点我。

chapters.en: Keep me free from the trap that is set for me, for you are my refuge.
chapters.zh: 求你救我脱离人为我暗设的网罗。因为你是我的保障。

chapters.en: Into your hands I commit my spirit; deliver me, LORD, my faithful God.
chapters.zh: 我将我的灵魂交在你手里。耶和华诚实的神阿，你救赎了我。

chapters.en: I hate those who cling to worthless idols; as for me, I trust in the LORD.
chapters.zh: 我恨恶那信奉虚无之神的人。我却倚靠耶和华。

chapters.en: I will be glad and rejoice in your love, for you saw my affliction and knew the anguish of my soul.
chapters.zh: 我要为你的慈爱高兴欢喜。因为你见过我的困苦，知道我心中的艰难。

chapters.en: You have not given me into the hands of the enemy but have set my feet in a spacious place.
chapters.zh: 你未曾把我交在仇敌手里。你使我的脚站在宽阔之处。

chapters.en: Be merciful to me, LORD, for I am in distress; my eyes grow weak with sorrow, my soul and body with grief.
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，求你怜恤我，因为我在急难之中。我的眼睛因忧愁而干瘪，连我的身心，也不安舒。

chapters.en: My life is consumed by anguish and my years by groaning; my strength fails because of my affliction,and my bones grow weak.
chapters.zh: 我的生命为愁苦所消耗。我的年岁为叹息所旷废。我的力量因我的罪孽衰败。我的骨头也枯干。

chapters.en: Because of all my enemies, I am the utter contempt of my neighbors and an object of dread to my closest friends— those who see me on the street flee from me.
chapters.zh: 我因一切敌人成了羞辱，在我的邻舍跟前更甚。那认识我的都惧怕我。在外头看见我的都躲避我。

chapters.en: I am forgotten as though I were dead; I have become like broken pottery.
chapters.zh: 我被人忘记，如同死人，无人记念。我好像破碎的器皿。

chapters.en: For I hear many whispering, “Terror on every side!” They conspire against me and plot to take my life.
chapters.zh: 我听见了许多人的谗谤，四围都是惊吓。他们一同商议攻击我的时候，就图谋要害我的性命。

chapters.en: But I trust in you, LORD; I say, “You are my God.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，我仍旧倚靠你。我说，你是我的神。

chapters.en: My times are in your hands; deliver me from the hands of my enemies, from those who pursue me.
chapters.zh: 我终身的事在你手中。求你救我脱离仇敌的手，和那些逼迫我的人。

chapters.en: Let your face shine on your servant; save me in your unfailing love.
chapters.zh: 求你使你的脸光照仆人，凭你的慈爱拯救我。

chapters.en: Let me not be put to shame, LORD, for I have cried out to you; but let the wicked be put to shame and be silent in the realm of the dead.
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，求你叫我不至羞愧。因为我曾呼吁你。求你使恶人羞愧，使他们在阴间缄默无声。

chapters.en: Let their lying lips be silenced, for with pride and contempt they speak arrogantly against the righteous.
chapters.zh: 那撒谎的人，逞骄傲轻慢，出狂妄的话攻击义人。愿他的嘴哑而无言。

chapters.en: How abundant are the good things that you have stored up for those who fear you, that you bestow in the sight of all, on those who take refuge in you.
chapters.zh: 敬畏你投靠你的人，你为他们所积存的，在世人面前所施行的恩惠，是何等大呢。

chapters.en: In the shelter of your presence you hide them from all human intrigues; you keep them safe in your dwelling from accusing tongues.
chapters.zh: 你必把他们藏在你面前的隐密处，免得遇见人的计谋。你必暗暗地保守他们在亭子里，免受口舌的争闹。

chapters.en: Praise be to the LORD, for he showed me the wonders of his love when I was in a city under siege.
chapters.zh: 耶和华是应当称颂的。因为他在坚固城里，向我施展奇妙的慈爱。

chapters.en: In my alarm I said, “I am cut off from your sight!” Yet you heard my cry for mercy when I called to you for help.
chapters.zh: 至于我，我曾急促的说，我从你眼前被隔绝。然而我呼求你的时候，你仍听我恳求的声音。

chapters.en: Love the LORD, all his faithful people! The LORD preserves those who are true to him, but the proud he pays back in full.
chapters.zh: 耶和华的圣民哪，你们都要爱他。耶和华保护诚实人，足足报应行事骄傲的人。

chapters.en: Be strong and take heart, all you who hope in the LORD.
chapters.zh: 凡仰望耶和华的人，你们都要壮胆，坚固你们的心。

chapters.en: Blessed is the one whose transgressions are forgiven, whose sins are covered.
chapters.zh: （大卫的训诲诗。）得赦免其过，遮盖其罪的，这人是有福的。
