chapters.en: Blessed is the one whose sin the LORD does not count against them and in whose spirit is no deceit.
chapters.zh: 凡心里没有诡诈，耶和华不算为有罪的，这人是有福的。

chapters.en: When I kept silent, my bones wasted away through my groaning all day long.
chapters.zh: 我闭口不认罪的时候，因终日唉哼，而骨头枯干。

chapters.en: For day and night your hand was heavy on me; my strength was sapped as in the heat of summer.
chapters.zh: 黑夜白日，你的手在我身上沉重。我的精液耗尽，如同夏天的干旱。（细拉）

chapters.en: Then I acknowledged my sin to you and did not cover up my iniquity. I said, “I will confess my transgressions to the LORD.” And you forgave the guilt of my sin.
chapters.zh: 我向你陈明我的罪，不隐瞒我的恶。我说，我要向耶和华承认我的过犯，你就赦免我的罪恶。（细拉）

chapters.en: Therefore let all the faithful pray to you while you may be found; surely the rising of the mighty waters will not reach them.
chapters.zh: 为此，凡虔诚人，都当趁你可寻找的时候祷告你。大水泛溢的时候，必不能到他那里。

chapters.en: You are my hiding place; you will protect me from trouble and surround me with songs of deliverance.
chapters.zh: 你是我藏身之处。你必保佑我脱离苦难，以得救的乐歌，四面环绕我。（细拉）

chapters.en: I will instruct you and teach you in the way you should go; I will counsel you with my loving eye on you.
chapters.zh: 我要教导你，指示你当行的路。我要定睛在你身上劝戒你。

chapters.en: Do not be like the horse or the mule, which have no understanding but must be controlled by bit and bridle or they will not come to you.
chapters.zh: 你不可像那无知的骡马，必用嚼环辔头勒住他，不然，就不能驯服。

chapters.en: Many are the woes of the wicked, but the LORD’s unfailing love surrounds the one who trusts in him.
chapters.zh: 恶人必多受苦楚。惟独倚靠耶和华的，必有慈爱四面环绕他。

chapters.en: Rejoice in the LORD and be glad, you righteous; sing, all you who are upright in heart!
chapters.zh: 你们义人应当靠耶和华欢喜快乐。你们心里正直的人，都当欢呼。

chapters.en: Sing joyfully to the LORD, you righteous; it is fitting for the upright to praise him.
chapters.zh: 义人哪，你们应当靠耶和华欢乐。正直人的赞美是合宜的。

chapters.en: Praise the LORD with the harp; make music to him on the ten-stringed lyre.
chapters.zh: 你们应当弹琴称谢耶和华，用十弦瑟歌颂他。

chapters.en: Sing to him a new song; play skillfully, and shout for joy.
chapters.zh: 应当向他唱新歌，弹得巧妙，声音洪亮。

chapters.en: For the word of the LORD is right and true; he is faithful in all he does.
chapters.zh: 因为耶和华的言语正直。凡他所作的，尽都诚实。

chapters.en: The LORD loves righteousness and justice; the earth is full of his unfailing love.
chapters.zh: 他喜爱仁义公平。遍地满了耶和华的慈爱。

chapters.en: By the word of the LORD the heavens were made, their starry host by the breath of his mouth.
chapters.zh: 诸天借耶和华的命而造，万象借他口中的气而成。

chapters.en: He gathers the waters of the sea into jars ; he puts the deep into storehouses.
chapters.zh: 他聚集海水如垒，收藏深洋在库房。

chapters.en: Let all the earth fear the LORD; let all the people of the world revere him.
chapters.zh: 愿全地都敬畏耶和华。愿世上的居民，都惧怕他。

chapters.en: For he spoke, and it came to be; he commanded, and it stood firm.
chapters.zh: 因为他说有，就有。命立，就立。

chapters.en: The LORD foils the plans of the nations; he thwarts the purposes of the peoples.
chapters.zh: 耶和华使列国的筹算归于无有，使众民的思念无有功效。

chapters.en: But the plans of the LORD stand firm forever, the purposes of his heart through all generations.
chapters.zh: 耶和华的寿算永远立定，他心中的思念万代常存。

chapters.en: Blessed is the nation whose God is the LORD, the people he chose for his inheritance.
chapters.zh: 以耶和华为神的，那国是有福的。他所拣选为自己产业的，那民是有福的。

chapters.en: From heaven the LORD looks down and sees all mankind;
chapters.zh: 耶和华从天上观看。他看见一切的世人。

chapters.en: from his dwelling place he watches all who live on earth—
chapters.zh: 从他的居所，往外察看地上一切的居民。

chapters.en: he who forms the hearts of all, who considers everything they do.
chapters.zh: 他是那造成他们众人心的，留意他们一切作为的。

chapters.en: No king is saved by the size of his army; no warrior escapes by his great strength.
chapters.zh: 君王不能因兵多得胜。勇士不能因力大得救。

chapters.en: A horse is a vain hope for deliverance; despite all its great strength it cannot save.
chapters.zh: 靠马得救是枉然的。马也不能因力大救人。

chapters.en: But the eyes of the LORD are on those who fear him, on those whose hope is in his unfailing love,
chapters.zh: 耶和华的眼目，看顾敬畏他的人，和仰望他慈爱的人，

chapters.en: to deliver them from death and keep them alive in famine.
chapters.zh: 要救他们的命脱离死亡，并使他们在饥荒中存活。

chapters.en: We wait in hope for the LORD; he is our help and our shield.
chapters.zh: 我们的心向来等候耶和华。他是我们的帮助，我们的盾牌。

chapters.en: In him our hearts rejoice, for we trust in his holy name.
chapters.zh: 我们的心必靠他欢喜，因为我们向来倚靠他的圣名。

chapters.en: May your unfailing love be with us, LORD, even as we put our hope in you.
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，求你照着我们所仰望你的，向我们施行慈爱。

chapters.en: I will extol the LORD at all times; his praise will always be on my lips.
chapters.zh: （大卫在亚比米勒面前装疯，被他赶出去，就作这诗。）我要时时称颂耶和华。赞美他的话必常在我口中。

chapters.en: I will glory in the LORD; let the afflicted hear and rejoice.
chapters.zh: 我的心必因耶和华夸耀。谦卑人听见，就要喜乐。

chapters.en: Glorify the LORD with me; let us exalt his name together.
chapters.zh: 你们和我当称耶和华为大，一同高举他的名。

chapters.en: I sought the LORD, and he answered me; he delivered me from all my fears.
chapters.zh: 我曾寻求耶和华，他就应允我，救我脱离了一切的恐惧。

chapters.en: Those who look to him are radiant; their faces are never covered with shame.
chapters.zh: 凡仰望他的，便有光荣。他们的脸，必不蒙羞。

chapters.en: This poor man called, and the LORD heard him; he saved him out of all his troubles.
chapters.zh: 我这困苦人呼求，耶和华便垂听，救我脱离一切患难。

chapters.en: The angel of the LORD encamps around those who fear him, and he delivers them.
chapters.zh: 耶和华的使者，在敬畏他的人四围安营，搭救他们。

chapters.en: Taste and see that the LORD is good; blessed is the one who takes refuge in him.
chapters.zh: 你们要尝尝主恩的滋味，便知道他是美善。投靠他的人有福了。

chapters.en: Fear the LORD, you his holy people, for those who fear him lack nothing.
chapters.zh: 耶和华的圣民哪，你们当敬畏他，因敬畏他的一无所缺。

chapters.en: The lions may grow weak and hungry, but those who seek the LORD lack no good thing.
chapters.zh: 少壮狮子，还缺食忍饿。但寻求耶和华的。什么好处都不缺。

chapters.en: Come, my children, listen to me; I will teach you the fear of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 众弟子阿，你们当来听我的话。我要将敬畏耶和华的道教训你们。

chapters.en: Whoever of you loves life and desires to see many good days,
chapters.zh: 有何人喜好存活，爱慕长寿，得享美福。

chapters.en: keep your tongue from evil and your lips from telling lies.
chapters.zh: 就要禁止舌头不出恶言，嘴唇不说诡诈的话。

chapters.en: Turn from evil and do good; seek peace and pursue it.
chapters.zh: 要离恶行善，寻求和睦，一心追赶。

chapters.en: The eyes of the LORD are on the righteous, and his ears are attentive to their cry;
chapters.zh: 耶和华的眼目，看顾义人，他的耳朵，听他们的呼求。

chapters.en: but the face of the LORD is against those who do evil, to blot out their name from the earth.
chapters.zh: 耶和华向行恶的人变脸，要从世上除灭他们的名号。

chapters.en: The righteous cry out, and the LORD hears them; he delivers them from all their troubles.
chapters.zh: 义人呼求，耶和华听见了，便救他们脱离一切患难。

chapters.en: The LORD is close to the brokenhearted and saves those who are crushed in spirit.
chapters.zh: 耶和华靠近伤心的人，拯救灵性痛悔的人。

chapters.en: The righteous person may have many troubles, but the LORD delivers him from them all;
chapters.zh: 义人多有苦难。但耶和华救他脱离这一切。

chapters.en: he protects all his bones, not one of them will be broken.
chapters.zh: 又保全他一身的骨头，连一根也不折断。

chapters.en: Evil will slay the wicked; the foes of the righteous will be condemned.
chapters.zh: 恶必害死恶人。恨恶义人的，必被定罪。

chapters.en: The LORD will rescue his servants; no one who takes refuge in him will be condemned.
chapters.zh: 耶和华救赎他仆人的灵魂。凡投靠他的，必不至定罪。

chapters.en: Contend, LORD, with those who contend with me; fight against those who fight against me.
chapters.zh: （大卫的诗。）耶和华阿，与我相争的，求你与他们相争。与我相战的，求你与他们相战。

chapters.en: Take up shield and armor; arise and come to my aid.
chapters.zh: 拿着大小的盾牌，起来帮助我。

chapters.en: Brandish spear and javelinagainst those who pursue me. Say to me, “I am your salvation.”
chapters.zh: 抽出枪来，挡住那追赶我的。求你对我的灵魂说，我是拯救你的。

chapters.en: May those who seek my life be disgraced and put to shame; may those who plot my ruin be turned back in dismay.
chapters.zh: 愿那寻索我命的，蒙羞受辱。愿那谋害我的，退后羞愧。

chapters.en: May they be like chaff before the wind, with the angel of the LORD driving them away;
chapters.zh: 愿他们像风前的糠，有耶和华的使者赶逐他们。

chapters.en: may their path be dark and slippery, with the angel of the LORD pursuing them.
chapters.zh: 愿他们的道路，又暗又滑，有耶和华的使者追赶他们。

chapters.en: Since they hid their net for me without cause and without cause dug a pit for me,
chapters.zh: 因他们无故地为我暗设网罗。无故地挖坑要害我的性命。

chapters.en: may ruin overtake them by surprise— may the net they hid entangle them, may they fall into the pit, to their ruin.
chapters.zh: 愿灾祸忽然临到他身上。愿他暗设的网缠住自己。愿他落在其中遭灾祸。

chapters.en: Then my soul will rejoice in the LORD and delight in his salvation.
chapters.zh: 我的心必靠耶和华快乐，靠他的救恩高兴。

chapters.en: My whole being will exclaim, “Who is like you, LORD? You rescue the poor from those too strong for them, the poor and needy from those who rob them.”
chapters.zh: 我的骨头都要说，耶和华阿，谁能象你救护困苦人，脱离那比他强壮的，救护困苦穷乏人，脱离那抢夺他的。

chapters.en: Ruthless witnesses come forward; they question me on things I know nothing about.
chapters.zh: 凶恶的见证人起来，盘问我所不知道的事。

chapters.en: They repay me evil for good and leave me like one bereaved.
chapters.zh: 他们向我以恶报善，使我的灵魂孤苦。

chapters.en: Yet when they were ill, I put on sackcloth and humbled myself with fasting. When my prayers returned to me unanswered,
chapters.zh: 至于我，当他们有病的时候，我便穿麻衣，禁食刻苦己心。我所求的都归到自己的怀中。

chapters.en: I went about mourning as though for my friend or brother. I bowed my head in grief as though weeping for my mother.
chapters.zh: 我这样行，好像他是我的朋友，我的弟兄。我屈身悲哀，如同人为母亲哀痛。

chapters.en: But when I stumbled, they gathered in glee; assailants gathered against me without my knowledge. They slandered me without ceasing.
chapters.zh: 我在患难中，他们却欢喜，大家聚集。我所不认识的那些下流人，聚集攻击我。他们不住地把我撕裂。

chapters.en: Like the ungodly they maliciously mocked;they gnashed their teeth at me.
chapters.zh: 他们如同席上好嬉笑的狂妄人，向我咬牙。

chapters.en: How long, Lord, will you look on? Rescue me from their ravages, my precious life from these lions.
chapters.zh: 主阿，你看着不理，要到几时呢？求你救我的灵魂，脱离他们的残害，救我的生命，脱离少壮狮子。（生命原文作独一者）

chapters.en: I will give you thanks in the great assembly; among the throngs I will praise you.
chapters.zh: 我在大会中要称谢你，在众民中要赞美你。

chapters.en: Do not let those gloat over me who are my enemies without cause; do not let those who hate me without reason maliciously wink the eye.
chapters.zh: 求你不容那无理与我为仇的，向我夸耀。不容那无故恨我的，向我挤眼。

chapters.en: They do not speak peaceably, but devise false accusations against those who live quietly in the land.
chapters.zh: 因为他们不说和平话。倒想出诡诈的言语，害地上的安静人。

chapters.en: They sneer at me and say, “Aha! Aha! With our own eyes we have seen it.”
chapters.zh: 他们大大张口攻击我，说，阿哈，阿哈，我们的眼已经看见了。

chapters.en: LORD, you have seen this; do not be silent. Do not be far from me, Lord.
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，你已经看见了。求你不要闭口。主阿，求你不要远离我。

chapters.en: Awake, and rise to my defense! Contend for me, my God and Lord.
chapters.zh: 我的神我的主阿，求你奋兴醒起，判清我的事，伸明我的冤。

chapters.en: Vindicate me in your righteousness, LORD my God; do not let them gloat over me.
chapters.zh: 耶和华我的神阿，求你按你的公义判断我，不容他们向我夸耀。

chapters.en: Do not let them think, “Aha, just what we wanted!” or say, “We have swallowed him up.”
chapters.zh: 不容他们心里说，阿哈，遂我们的心愿了。不容他们说，我们已经把他吞了。

chapters.en: May all who gloat over my distress be put to shame and confusion; may all who exalt themselves over me be clothed with shame and disgrace.
chapters.zh: 愿那喜欢我遭难的，一同抱愧蒙羞。愿那向我妄自尊大的，披惭愧，蒙羞辱。

chapters.en: May those who delight in my vindication shout for joy and gladness; may they always say, “The LORD be exalted, who delights in the well-being of his servant.”
chapters.zh: 愿那喜悦我冤屈得伸的，（冤屈得伸原文作公义），欢呼快乐。愿他们常说，当尊耶和华为大。耶和华喜悦他的仆人平安。

chapters.en: My tongue will proclaim your righteousness, your praises all day long.
chapters.zh: 我的舌头，要终日论说你的公义，时常赞美你。

chapters.en: I have a message from God in my heart concerning the sinfulness of the wicked:There is no fear of God before their eyes.
chapters.zh: （耶和华的仆人大卫的诗，交与伶长。）恶人的罪过，在他心里说，我眼中不怕神。

chapters.en: In their own eyes they flatter themselves too much to detect or hate their sin.
chapters.zh: 他自夸自媚，以为他的罪孽终不显露，不被恨恶。

chapters.en: The words of their mouths are wicked and deceitful; they fail to act wisely or do good.
chapters.zh: 他口中的言语，尽是罪孽诡诈。他与智慧善行，已经断绝。

chapters.en: Even on their beds they plot evil; they commit themselves to a sinful course and do not reject what is wrong.
chapters.zh: 他在床上图谋罪孽，定意行不善的道，不憎恶恶事。

chapters.en: Your love, LORD, reaches to the heavens, your faithfulness to the skies.
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，你的慈爱，上及诸天。你的信实，达到穹苍。

chapters.en: Your righteousness is like the highest mountains, your justice like the great deep. You, LORD, preserve both people and animals.
chapters.zh: 你的公义，好像高山。你的判断，如同深渊。耶和华阿，人民牲畜，你都救护。

chapters.en: How priceless is your unfailing love, O God! People take refuge in the shadow of your wings.
chapters.zh: 神阿，你的慈爱，何其宝贵。世人投靠在你翅膀的荫下。

chapters.en: They feast on the abundance of your house; you give them drink from your river of delights.
chapters.zh: 他们必因你殿里的肥甘，得以饱足。你也必叫他们喝你乐河的水

chapters.en: For with you is the fountain of life; in your light we see light.
chapters.zh: 因为在你那里，有生命的源头。在你的光中，我们必得见光

chapters.en: Continue your love to those who know you, your righteousness to the upright in heart.
chapters.zh: 愿你常施慈爱给认识你的人。常以公义待心里正直的人。

chapters.en: May the foot of the proud not come against me, nor the hand of the wicked drive me away.
chapters.zh: 不容骄傲人的脚践踏我，不容凶恶人的手赶逐我。

chapters.en: See how the evildoers lie fallen— thrown down, not able to rise!
chapters.zh: 在那里作孽的人，已经仆倒。他们被推倒，不能再起来。

chapters.en: Do not fret because of those who are evil or be envious of those who do wrong;
chapters.zh: （大卫的诗。）不要为作恶的，心怀不平，也不要向那行不义的，生出嫉妒。

chapters.en: for like the grass they will soon wither, like green plants they will soon die away.
chapters.zh: 因为他们如草快被割下，又如青菜快要枯干。

chapters.en: Trust in the LORD and do good; dwell in the land and enjoy safe pasture.
chapters.zh: 你当倚靠耶和华而行善。住在地上，以他的信实为粮。

chapters.en: Take delight in the LORD, and he will give you the desires of your heart.
chapters.zh: 又要以耶和华为乐。他就将你心里所求的赐给你。

chapters.en: Commit your way to the LORD; trust in him and he will do this:
chapters.zh: 当将你的事交托耶和华，并倚靠他，他就必成全。

chapters.en: He will make your righteous reward shine like the dawn, your vindication like the noonday sun.
chapters.zh: 他要使你的公义，如光发出，使你的公平，明如正午。

chapters.en: Be still before the LORD and wait patiently for him; do not fret when people succeed in their ways, when they carry out their wicked schemes.
chapters.zh: 你当默然倚靠耶和华，耐性等候他。不要因那道路通达的，和那恶谋成就的，心怀不平。

chapters.en: Refrain from anger and turn from wrath; do not fret—it leads only to evil.
chapters.zh: 当止住怒气，离弃忿怒。不要心怀不平，以致作恶。

chapters.en: For those who are evil will be destroyed, but those who hope in the LORD will inherit the land.
chapters.zh: 因为作恶的，必被剪除。惟有等候耶和华的，必承受地土。

chapters.en: A little while, and the wicked will be no more; though you look for them, they will not be found.
chapters.zh: 还有片时，恶人要归于无有。你就是细察他的住处，也要归于无有。

chapters.en: But the meek will inherit the land and enjoy peace and prosperity.
chapters.zh: 但谦卑人必承受地土，以丰盛的平安为乐。

chapters.en: The wicked plot against the righteous and gnash their teeth at them;
chapters.zh: 恶人设谋害义人，又向他咬牙。

chapters.en: but the Lord laughs at the wicked, for he knows their day is coming.
chapters.zh: 主要笑他，因见他受罚的日子将要来到。

chapters.en: The wicked draw the sword and bend the bow to bring down the poor and needy, to slay those whose ways are upright.
chapters.zh: 恶人已经弓上弦，刀出鞘，要打倒困苦穷乏的人，要杀害行动正直的人。

chapters.en: But their swords will pierce their own hearts, and their bows will be broken.
chapters.zh: 他们的刀，必刺入自己的心，他们的弓，必被折断。

chapters.en: Better the little that the righteous have than the wealth of many wicked;
chapters.zh: 一个义人所有的虽少，强过许多恶人的富余。

chapters.en: for the power of the wicked will be broken, but the LORD upholds the righteous.
chapters.zh: 因为恶人的膀臂，必被折断。但耶和华是扶持义人。

chapters.en: The blameless spend their days under the LORD’s care, and their inheritance will endure forever.
chapters.zh: 耶和华知道完全人的日子。他们的产业，要存到永远。

chapters.en: In times of disaster they will not wither; in days of famine they will enjoy plenty.
chapters.zh: 他们在急难的时候，不至羞愧，在饥荒的日子，必得饱足。

chapters.en: But the wicked will perish: Though the LORD’s enemies are like the flowers of the field, they will be consumed, they will go up in smoke.
chapters.zh: 恶人却要灭亡。耶和华的仇敌，要像羊羔的脂油。（或作像草地的华美）他们要消灭，要如烟消灭。

chapters.en: The wicked borrow and do not repay, but the righteous give generously;
chapters.zh: 恶人借贷而不偿还。义人却恩待人，并且施舍。

chapters.en: those the LORD blesses will inherit the land, but those he curses will be destroyed.
chapters.zh: 蒙耶和华赐福的，必承受地土。被他咒诅的，必被剪除。

chapters.en: The LORD makes firm the steps of the one who delights in him;
chapters.zh: 义人的脚步，被耶和华立定。他的道路，耶和华也喜爱。

chapters.en: though he may stumble, he will not fall, for the LORD upholds him with his hand.
chapters.zh: 他虽失脚，也不至全身仆倒。因为耶和华用手搀扶他。（或作搀扶他的手）

chapters.en: I was young and now I am old, yet I have never seen the righteous forsaken or their children begging bread.
chapters.zh: 我从前年幼，现在年老，却未见过义人被弃。也未见过他的后裔讨饭。

chapters.en: They are always generous and lend freely; their children will be a blessing.
chapters.zh: 他终日恩待人，借给人。他的后裔也蒙福。

chapters.en: Turn from evil and do good; then you will dwell in the land forever.
chapters.zh: 你当离恶行善，就可永远安居。

chapters.en: For the LORD loves the just and will not forsake his faithful ones. Wrongdoers will be completely destroyed ; the offspring of the wicked will perish.
chapters.zh: 因为耶和华喜爱公平，不撇弃他的圣民。他们永蒙保佑。但恶人的后裔，必被剪除。

chapters.en: The righteous will inherit the land and dwell in it forever.
chapters.zh: 义人必承受地土，永居其上。

chapters.en: The mouths of the righteous utter wisdom, and their tongues speak what is just.
chapters.zh: 义人的口谈论智慧，他的舌头讲说公平。

chapters.en: The law of their God is in their hearts; their feet do not slip.
chapters.zh: 神的律法在他心里。他的脚总不滑跌。

chapters.en: The wicked lie in wait for the righteous, intent on putting them to death;
chapters.zh: 恶人窥探义人，想要杀他。

chapters.en: but the LORD will not leave them in the power of the wicked or let them be condemned when brought to trial.
chapters.zh: 耶和华必不撇他在恶人手中，当审判的时候，也不定他的罪。

chapters.en: Hope in the LORD and keep his way. He will exalt you to inherit the land; when the wicked are destroyed, you will see it.
chapters.zh: 你当等候耶和华，遵守他的道，他就抬举你，使你承受地土。恶人被剪除的时候，你必看见。

chapters.en: I have seen a wicked and ruthless man flourishing like a luxuriant native tree,
chapters.zh: 我见过恶人大有势力，好像一根青翠树在本土生发。

chapters.en: but he soon passed away and was no more; though I looked for him, he could not be found.
chapters.zh: 有人从那里经过，不料，他没有了。我也寻找他，却寻不着。

chapters.en: Consider the blameless, observe the upright; a future awaits those who seek peace.
chapters.zh: 你要细察那完全人，观看那正直人。因为和平人有好结局。

chapters.en: But all sinners will be destroyed; there will be no future for the wicked.
chapters.zh: 至于犯法的人，必一同灭绝。恶人终必剪除。

chapters.en: The salvation of the righteous comes from the LORD; he is their stronghold in time of trouble.
chapters.zh: 但义人得救，是由于耶和华。他在患难时作他们的营寨。

chapters.en: The LORD helps them and delivers them; he delivers them from the wicked and saves them, because they take refuge in him.
chapters.zh: 耶和华帮助他们，解救他们。他解救他们脱离恶人，把他们救出来，因为他们投靠他。

chapters.en: LORD, do not rebuke me in your anger or discipline me in your wrath.
chapters.zh: （大卫的记念诗）耶和华阿，求你不要在怒中责备我。不要在烈怒中惩罚我。

chapters.en: Your arrows have pierced me, and your hand has come down on me.
chapters.zh: 因为你的箭射入我身，你的手压住我。

chapters.en: Because of your wrath there is no health in my body; there is no soundness in my bones because of my sin.
chapters.zh: 因你的恼怒，我的肉无一完全。因我的罪过，我的骨头也不安宁。

chapters.en: My guilt has overwhelmed me like a burden too heavy to bear.
chapters.zh: 我的罪孽高过我的头，如同重担叫我担当不起。

chapters.en: My wounds fester and are loathsome because of my sinful folly.
chapters.zh: 因我的愚昧，我的伤发臭流脓。

chapters.en: I am bowed down and brought very low; all day long I go about mourning.
chapters.zh: 我疼痛，大大拳曲，终日哀痛。

chapters.en: My back is filled with searing pain; there is no health in my body.
chapters.zh: 我满腰是火。我的肉无一完全。

chapters.en: I am feeble and utterly crushed; I groan in anguish of heart.
chapters.zh: 我被压伤，身体疲倦。因心里不安，我就唉哼。

chapters.en: All my longings lie open before you, Lord; my sighing is not hidden from you.
chapters.zh: 主阿，我的心愿都在你面前。我的叹息不向你隐瞒。

chapters.en: My heart pounds, my strength fails me; even the light has gone from my eyes.
chapters.zh: 我心跳动，我力衰微，连我眼中的光，也没有了。

chapters.en: My friends and companions avoid me because of my wounds; my neighbors stay far away.
chapters.zh: 我的良朋密友，因我的灾病，都躲在旁边站着。我的亲戚本家，也远远地站立。

chapters.en: Those who want to kill me set their traps, those who would harm me talk of my ruin; all day long they scheme and lie.
chapters.zh: 那寻索我命的，设下网罗。那想要害我的，口出恶言，终日思想诡计。

chapters.en: I am like the deaf, who cannot hear, like the mute, who cannot speak;
chapters.zh: 但我如聋子不听，像哑巴不开口。

chapters.en: I have become like one who does not hear, whose mouth can offer no reply.
chapters.zh: 我如不听见的人，口中没有回话。

chapters.en: LORD, I wait for you; you will answer, Lord my God.
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，我仰望你。主我的神阿，你必应允我。

chapters.en: For I said, “Do not let them gloat or exalt themselves over me when my feet slip.”
chapters.zh: 我曾说，恐怕他们向我夸耀。我失脚的时候，他们向我夸大。

chapters.en: For I am about to fall, and my pain is ever with me.
chapters.zh: 我几乎跌倒，我的痛苦常在我面前。

chapters.en: I confess my iniquity; I am troubled by my sin.
chapters.zh: 我要承认我的罪孽。我要因我的罪忧愁。

chapters.en: Many have become my enemies without cause ; those who hate me without reason are numerous.
chapters.zh: 但我的仇敌又活泼又强壮。无理恨我的增多了。

chapters.en: Those who repay my good with evil lodge accusations against me, though I seek only to do what is good.
chapters.zh: 以恶报善的与我作对，因我是追求良善。

chapters.en: LORD, do not forsake me; do not be far from me, my God.
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，求你不要撇弃我。我的神阿，求你不要远离我。

chapters.en: Come quickly to help me, my Lord and my Savior.
chapters.zh: 拯救我的主阿，求你快快帮助我。

chapters.en: I said, “I will watch my ways and keep my tongue from sin; I will put a muzzle on my mouth while in the presence of the wicked.”
chapters.zh: （大卫的诗，交与伶长耶杜顿。）我曾说，我要谨慎我的言行，免得我舌头犯罪。恶人在我面前的时候，我要用嚼环勒住我的口。

chapters.en: So I remained utterly silent, not even saying anything good. But my anguish increased;
chapters.zh: 我默然无声，连好话也不出口。我的愁苦就发动了。

chapters.en: my heart grew hot within me. While I meditated, the fire burned; then I spoke with my tongue:
chapters.zh: 我的心在我里面发热。我默想的时候，火就烧起，我便用舌头说话。

chapters.en: “Show me, LORD, my life’s end and the number of my days; let me know how fleeting my life is.
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，求你叫我晓得我身之终，我的寿数几何，叫我知道我的生命不长。

chapters.en: You have made my days a mere handbreadth; the span of my years is as nothing before you. Everyone is but a breath, even those who seem secure.
chapters.zh: 你使我的年日，窄如手掌。我一生的年数，在你面前，如同无有。各人最稳妥的时候，真是全然虚幻。（细拉）

chapters.en: “Surely everyone goes around like a mere phantom; in vain they rush about, heaping up wealth without knowing whose it will finally be.
chapters.zh: 世人行动实系幻影。他们忙乱，真是枉然。积蓄财宝，不知将来有谁收取。

chapters.en: “But now, Lord, what do I look for? My hope is in you.
chapters.zh: 主阿，如今我等什么呢？我的指望在乎你。

chapters.en: Save me from all my transgressions; do not make me the scorn of fools.
chapters.zh: 求你救我脱离一切的过犯。不要使我受愚顽人的羞辱。

chapters.en: I was silent; I would not open my mouth, for you are the one who has done this.
chapters.zh: 因我所遭遇的是出于你，我就默然不语。

chapters.en: Remove your scourge from me; I am overcome by the blow of your hand.
chapters.zh: 求你把你的责罚，从我身上免去。因你手的责打，我便消灭。

chapters.en: When you rebuke and discipline anyone for their sin, you consume their wealth like a moth— surely everyone is but a breath.
chapters.zh: 你因人的罪恶，惩罚他的时候，叫他的笑容消灭，（的笑容或作所喜爱的）如衣被虫所咬。世人真是虚幻。（细拉）

chapters.en: “Hear my prayer, LORD, listen to my cry for help; do not be deaf to my weeping. I dwell with you as a foreigner, a stranger, as all my ancestors were.
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿。求你听我的祷告，留心听我的呼求。我流泪，求你不要静默无声。因为我在你面前是客旅，是寄居的，像我列祖一般。

chapters.en: Look away from me, that I may enjoy life again before I depart and am no more.”
chapters.zh: 求你宽容我，使我在去而不返之先，可以力量复原。

chapters.en: I waited patiently for the LORD; he turned to me and heard my cry.
chapters.zh: （大卫的诗，交与伶长）我曾耐性等候耶和华。他垂听我的呼求。

chapters.en: He lifted me out of the slimy pit, out of the mud and mire; he set my feet on a rock and gave me a firm place to stand.
chapters.zh: 他从祸坑里，从淤泥中，把我拉上来，使我的脚立在磐石上，使我脚步稳当。

chapters.en: He put a new song in my mouth, a hymn of praise to our God. Many will see and fear the LORD and put their trust in him.
chapters.zh: 他使我口唱新歌，就是赞美我们神的话。许多人必看见而惧怕，并要倚靠耶和华。

chapters.en: Blessed is the one who trusts in the LORD, who does not look to the proud, to those who turn aside to false gods.
chapters.zh: 那倚靠耶和华，不理会狂傲和偏向虚假之辈的，这人便为有福。

chapters.en: Many, LORD my God, are the wonders you have done, the things you planned for us. None can compare with you; were I to speak and tell of your deeds, they would be too many to declare.
chapters.zh: 耶和华我的神阿，你所行的奇事，并你向我们所怀的意念甚多，不能向你陈明。若要陈明，其事不可胜数。

chapters.en: Sacrifice and offering you did not desire— but my ears you have opened — burnt offerings and sin offerings you did not require.
chapters.zh: 祭物和礼物，你不喜悦。你已经开通我的耳朵。燔祭和赎罪祭，非你所要。

chapters.en: Then I said, “Here I am, I have come— it is written about me in the scroll.
chapters.zh: 那时我说，看哪，我来了。我的事在经卷上已经记载了。

chapters.en: I desire to do your will, my God; your law is within my heart.”
chapters.zh: 我的神阿，我乐意照你的旨意行。你的律法在我心里。

chapters.en: I proclaim your saving acts in the great assembly; I do not seal my lips, LORD, as you know.
chapters.zh: 我在大会中宣传公义的佳音。我必不止住我的嘴唇。耶和华阿，这是你所知道的。

chapters.en: I do not hide your righteousness in my heart; I speak of your faithfulness and your saving help. I do not conceal your love and your faithfulness from the great assembly.
chapters.zh: 我未曾把你的公义藏在心里。我已陈明你的信实，和你的救恩。我在大会中未曾隐瞒你的慈爱，和诚实。

chapters.en: Do not withhold your mercy from me, LORD; may your love and faithfulness always protect me.
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，求你不要向我止住你的慈悲。愿你的慈爱和诚实，常常保佑我。

chapters.en: For troubles without number surround me; my sins have overtaken me, and I cannot see. They are more than the hairs of my head, and my heart fails within me.
chapters.zh: 因有无数的祸患围困我。我的罪孽追上了我，使我不能昂首。这罪孽比我的头发还多。我就心寒胆战。

chapters.en: Be pleased to save me, LORD; come quickly, LORD, to help me.
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，求你开恩搭救我。耶和华阿，求你速速帮助我。

chapters.en: May all who want to take my life be put to shame and confusion; may all who desire my ruin be turned back in disgrace.
chapters.zh: 愿那些寻找我，要灭我命的，一同抱愧蒙羞。愿那些喜悦我受害的，退后受辱。

chapters.en: May those who say to me, “Aha! Aha!” be appalled at their own shame.
chapters.zh: 愿那些对我说，阿哈，阿哈的，因羞愧而败亡。

chapters.en: But may all who seek you rejoice and be glad in you; may those who long for your saving help always say, “The LORD is great!”
chapters.zh: 愿一切寻求你的，因你高兴欢喜。愿那些喜爱你救恩的，常说，当尊耶和华为大。

chapters.en: But as for me, I am poor and needy; may the Lord think of me. You are my help and my deliverer; you are my God, do not delay.
chapters.zh: 但我是困苦穷乏的，主仍顾念我。你是帮助我的，搭救我的。神阿，求你不要耽延。

chapters.en: Blessed are those who have regard for the weak; the LORD delivers them in times of trouble.
chapters.zh: （大卫的诗，交与伶长。）眷顾贫穷的有福了。他遭难的日子，耶和华必搭救他。

chapters.en: The LORD protects and preserves them— they are counted among the blessed in the land— he does not give them over to the desire of their foes.
chapters.zh: 耶和华必保全他，使他存活。他必在地上享福。求你不要把他交给仇敌，遂其所愿。

chapters.en: The LORD sustains them on their sickbed and restores them from their bed of illness.
chapters.zh: 他病重在榻，耶和华必扶持他。他在病中，你必给他铺床。

chapters.en: I said, “Have mercy on me, LORD; heal me, for I have sinned against you.”
chapters.zh: 我曾说，耶和华阿，求你怜恤我，医治我。因为我得罪了你。

chapters.en: My enemies say of me in malice, “When will he die and his name perish?”
chapters.zh: 我的仇敌用恶言议论我，说，他几时死，他的名才灭亡呢？

chapters.en: When one of them comes to see me, he speaks falsely, while his heart gathers slander; then he goes out and spreads it around.
chapters.zh: 他来看我，就说假话。他心存奸恶，走到外边才说出来。

chapters.en: All my enemies whisper together against me; they imagine the worst for me, saying,
chapters.zh: 一切恨我的，都交头接耳的议论我。他们设计要害我。

chapters.en: “A vile disease has afflicted him; he will never get up from the place where he lies.”
chapters.zh: 他们说，有怪病贴在他身上。他已躺卧，必不能再起来。

chapters.en: Even my close friend, someone I trusted, one who shared my bread, has turned against me.
chapters.zh: 连我知己的朋友，我所倚靠吃过我饭的，也用脚踢我。

chapters.en: But may you have mercy on me, LORD; raise me up, that I may repay them.
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，求你怜恤我，使我起来，好报复他们。

chapters.en: I know that you are pleased with me, for my enemy does not triumph over me.
chapters.zh: 因我的仇敌不得向我夸胜。我从此便知道你喜爱我。

chapters.en: Because of my integrity you uphold me and set me in your presence forever.
chapters.zh: 你因我纯正，就扶持我，使我永远站在你的面前。

chapters.en: Praise be to the LORD, the God of Israel, from everlasting to everlasting. Amen and Amen.
chapters.zh: 耶和华以色列的神，是应当称颂的，从亘古直到永远。阿们，阿们。

chapters.en: As the deer pants for streams of water, so my soul pants for you, my God.
chapters.zh: （可拉后裔的训诲诗，交与伶长。）神阿，我的心切慕你，如鹿切慕溪水。

chapters.en: My soul thirsts for God, for the living God. When can I go and meet with God?
chapters.zh: 我的心渴想神，就是永生神。我几时得朝见神呢？

chapters.en: My tears have been my food day and night, while people say to me all day long, “Where is your God?”
chapters.zh: 我昼夜以眼泪当饮食。人不住地对我说，你的神在哪里呢？

chapters.en: These things I remember as I pour out my soul: how I used to go to the house of God under the protection of the Mighty One with shouts of joy and praise among the festive throng.
chapters.zh: 我从前与众人同往，用欢呼称赞的声音，领他们到神的殿里，大家守节。我追想这些事，我的心极其悲伤。

chapters.en: Why, my soul, are you downcast? Why so disturbed within me? Put your hope in God, for I will yet praise him, my Savior and my God.
chapters.zh: 我的心哪，你为何忧闷，为何在我里面烦躁。应当仰望神。因他笑脸帮助我，我还要称赞他。

chapters.en: My soul is downcast within me; therefore I will remember you from the land of the Jordan, the heights of Hermon—from Mount Mizar.
chapters.zh: 我的神阿，我的心在我里面忧闷。所以我从约但地，从黑门岭，从米萨山，记念你。

chapters.en: Deep calls to deep in the roar of your waterfalls; all your waves and breakers have swept over me.
chapters.zh: 你的瀑布发声，深渊就与深渊响应。你的波浪洪涛漫过我身。

chapters.en: By day the LORD directs his love, at night his song is with me— a prayer to the God of my life.
chapters.zh: 白昼耶和华必向我施慈爱。黑夜我要歌颂祷告赐我生命的神。

chapters.en: I say to God my Rock, “Why have you forgotten me? Why must I go about mourning, oppressed by the enemy?”
chapters.zh: 我要对神我的磐石说，你为何忘记我呢？我为何因仇敌的欺压时常哀痛呢？

chapters.en: My bones suffer mortal agony as my foes taunt me, saying to me all day long, “Where is your God?”
chapters.zh: 我的敌人辱骂我，好像打碎我的骨头，不住地对我说，你的神在哪里呢？

chapters.en: Why, my soul, are you downcast? Why so disturbed within me? Put your hope in God, for I will yet praise him, my Savior and my God.
chapters.zh: 我的心哪，你为何忧闷？为何在我里面烦躁？应当仰望神。因我还要称赞他。他是我脸上的光荣，（原文作帮助），是我的神。

chapters.en: Vindicate me, my God, and plead my cause against an unfaithful nation. Rescue me from those who are deceitful and wicked.
chapters.zh: 神阿，求你伸我的冤，向不虔诚的国，为我辨屈。求你救我脱离诡诈不义的人。

chapters.en: You are God my stronghold. Why have you rejected me? Why must I go about mourning, oppressed by the enemy?
chapters.zh: 因为你是赐我力量的神，为何丢弃我呢？我为何因仇敌的欺压时常哀痛呢？

chapters.en: Send me your light and your faithful care, let them lead me; let them bring me to your holy mountain, to the place where you dwell.
chapters.zh: 求你发出你的亮光和真实，好引导我，带我到你的圣山，到你的居所。

chapters.en: Then I will go to the altar of God, to God, my joy and my delight. I will praise you with the lyre, O God, my God.
chapters.zh: 我就走到神的祭坛，到我最喜乐的神那里。神阿，我的神，我要弹琴称赞你。

chapters.en: Why, my soul, are you downcast? Why so disturbed within me? Put your hope in God, for I will yet praise him, my Savior and my God.
chapters.zh: 我的心哪，你为何忧闷？为何在我里面烦躁？应当仰望神。因我还要称赞他。他是我脸上的光荣，（原文作帮助）是我的神。

chapters.en: We have heard it with our ears, O God; our ancestors have told us what you did in their days, in days long ago.
chapters.zh: （可拉后裔的训诲诗，交与伶长。）神阿，你在古时，我们列祖的日子，所行的事，我们亲耳听见了，我们的列祖，也给我们述说过。

chapters.en: With your hand you drove out the nations and planted our ancestors; you crushed the peoples and made our ancestors flourish.
chapters.zh: 你曾用手赶出外邦人，却栽培了我们列祖。你苦待列邦，却叫我们列祖发达。

chapters.en: It was not by their sword that they won the land, nor did their arm bring them victory; it was your right hand, your arm, and the light of your face, for you loved them.
chapters.zh: 因为他们不是靠自己的刀剑得地土，也不是靠自己的膀臂得胜。乃是靠你的右手，你的膀臂，和你脸上的亮光，因为你喜悦他们。

chapters.en: You are my King and my God, who decrees victories for Jacob.
chapters.zh: 神阿，你是我的王，求你出令，使雅各得胜。

chapters.en: Through you we push back our enemies; through your name we trample our foes.
chapters.zh: 我们靠你要推倒我们的敌人。靠你的名要践踏那起来攻击我们的人。

chapters.en: I put no trust in my bow, my sword does not bring me victory;
chapters.zh: 因为我必不靠我的弓，我的刀也不能使我得胜。

chapters.en: but you give us victory over our enemies, you put our adversaries to shame.
chapters.zh: 惟你救了我们脱离敌人，使恨我们的人羞愧。

chapters.en: In God we make our boast all day long, and we will praise your name forever.
chapters.zh: 我们终日因神夸耀，还要永远称谢你的名。（细拉）

chapters.en: But now you have rejected and humbled us; you no longer go out with our armies.
chapters.zh: 但如今你丢弃了我们，使我们受辱，不和我们的军兵同去。

chapters.en: You made us retreat before the enemy, and our adversaries have plundered us.
chapters.zh: 你使我们向敌人转身退后。那恨我们的人任意抢夺。

chapters.en: You gave us up to be devoured like sheep and have scattered us among the nations.
chapters.zh: 你使我们当作快要被吃的羊，把我们分散在列邦中。

chapters.en: You sold your people for a pittance, gaining nothing from their sale.
chapters.zh: 你卖了你的子民，也不赚利。所得的价值，并不加添你的资财。

chapters.en: You have made us a reproach to our neighbors, the scorn and derision of those around us.
chapters.zh: 你使我们受邻国的羞辱，被四围的人嗤笑讥刺。

chapters.en: You have made us a byword among the nations; the peoples shake their heads at us.
chapters.zh: 你使我们在列邦中作了笑谈，使众民向我们摇头。

chapters.en: I live in disgrace all day long, and my face is covered with shame
chapters.zh: 我的凌辱，终日在我面前。我脸上的羞愧，将我遮蔽。

chapters.en: at the taunts of those who reproach and revile me, because of the enemy, who is bent on revenge.
chapters.zh: 都因那辱骂毁谤人的声音，又因仇敌和报仇人的缘故。

chapters.en: All this came upon us, though we had not forgotten you; we had not been false to your covenant.
chapters.zh: 这都临到我们身上。我们却没有忘记你。也没有违背你的约。

chapters.en: Our hearts had not turned back; our feet had not strayed from your path.
chapters.zh: 我们的心没有退后，我们的脚也没有偏离你的路。

chapters.en: But you crushed us and made us a haunt for jackals; you covered us over with deep darkness.
chapters.zh: 你在野狗之处压伤我们，用死荫遮蔽我们。

chapters.en: If we had forgotten the name of our God or spread out our hands to a foreign god,
chapters.zh: 倘若我们忘了神的名，或向别神举手，

chapters.en: would not God have discovered it, since he knows the secrets of the heart?
chapters.zh: 神岂不鉴察这事吗？因为他晓得人心里的隐秘。

chapters.en: Yet for your sake we face death all day long; we are considered as sheep to be slaughtered.
chapters.zh: 我们为你的缘故终日被杀，人看我们如将宰的羊。

chapters.en: Awake, Lord! Why do you sleep? Rouse yourself! Do not reject us forever.
chapters.zh: 主阿，求你睡醒，为何尽睡呢？求你兴起，不要永远丢弃我们。

chapters.en: Why do you hide your face and forget our misery and oppression?
chapters.zh: 你为何掩面，不顾我们所遭的苦难，和所受的欺压。

chapters.en: We are brought down to the dust; our bodies cling to the ground.
chapters.zh: 我们的性命伏于尘土。我们的肚腹紧贴地面。

chapters.en: Rise up and help us; rescue us because of your unfailing love.
chapters.zh: 求你起来帮助我们，凭你的慈爱救赎我们。

chapters.en: My heart is stirred by a noble theme as I recite my verses for the king; my tongue is the pen of a skillful writer.
chapters.zh: （可拉后裔的训诲诗，又是爱慕歌，交与伶长，调用百合花。）我心里涌出美辞。我论到我为王作的事。我的舌头是快手笔。

chapters.en: You are the most excellent of men and your lips have been anointed with grace, since God has blessed you forever.
chapters.zh: 你比世人更美，在你嘴里满有恩惠。所以神赐福给你，直到永远。

chapters.en: Gird your sword on your side, you mighty one; clothe yourself with splendor and majesty.
chapters.zh: 大能者阿，愿你腰间佩刀，大有荣耀和威严。

chapters.en: In your majesty ride forth victoriously in the cause of truth, humility and justice; let your right hand achieve awesome deeds.
chapters.zh: 为真理，谦卑，公义，赫然坐车前往，无不得胜。你的右手必显明可畏的事。

chapters.en: Let your sharp arrows pierce the hearts of the king’s enemies; let the nations fall beneath your feet.
chapters.zh: 你的箭锋快，射中王敌之心。万民仆倒在你以下。

chapters.en: Your throne, O God, will last for ever and ever; a scepter of justice will be the scepter of your kingdom.
chapters.zh: 神阿，你的宝座是永永远远的，你的国权是正直的。

chapters.en: You love righteousness and hate wickedness; therefore God, your God, has set you above your companions by anointing you with the oil of joy.
chapters.zh: 你喜爱公义，恨恶罪恶。所以神，就是你的神，用喜乐油膏你，胜过膏你的同伴。

chapters.en: All your robes are fragrant with myrrh and aloes and cassia; from palaces adorned with ivory the music of the strings makes you glad.
chapters.zh: 你的衣服，都有没药沉香肉桂的香气。象牙宫中有丝弦乐器的声音，使你欢喜。

chapters.en: Daughters of kings are among your honored women; at your right hand is the royal bride in gold of Ophir.
chapters.zh: 有君王的女儿，在你尊贵妇女之中。王后佩戴俄斐金饰，站在你右边。

chapters.en: Listen, daughter, and pay careful attention: Forget your people and your father’s house.
chapters.zh: 女子阿，你要听，要想，要侧耳而听。不要记念你的民，和你的父家。

chapters.en: Let the king be enthralled by your beauty; honor him, for he is your lord.
chapters.zh: 王就羡慕你的美貌。因为他是你的主。你当敬拜他。

chapters.en: The city of Tyre will come with a gift,people of wealth will seek your favor.
chapters.zh: 推罗的民，（民原文作女子），必来送礼。民中的富足人，也必向你求恩。

chapters.en: All glorious is the princess within her chamber; her gown is interwoven with gold.
chapters.zh: 王女在宫里，极其荣华。他的衣服是用金线绣的。

chapters.en: In embroidered garments she is led to the king; her virgin companions follow her— those brought to be with her.
chapters.zh: 他要穿锦绣的衣服，被引到王前。随从他的陪伴童女，也要被带到你面前。

chapters.en: Led in with joy and gladness, they enter the palace of the king.
chapters.zh: 他们要欢喜快乐被引导。他们要进入王宫。

chapters.en: Your sons will take the place of your fathers; you will make them princes throughout the land.
chapters.zh: 你的子孙要接续你的列祖。你要立他们在全地作王。

chapters.en: I will perpetuate your memory through all generations; therefore the nations will praise you for ever and ever.
chapters.zh: 我必叫你的名被万代记念。所以万民要永永远远称谢你。

chapters.en: God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in trouble.
chapters.zh: （可拉后裔的诗歌，交与伶长，调用女音。）神是我们的避难所，是我们的力量，是我们在患难中随时的帮助。

chapters.en: Therefore we will not fear, though the earth give way and the mountains fall into the heart of the sea,
chapters.zh: 所以地虽改变，山虽摇动到海心，

chapters.en: though its waters roar and foam and the mountains quake with their surging.
chapters.zh: 其中的水虽砰訇翻腾，山虽因海涨而战抖，我们也不害怕。（细拉）。

chapters.en: There is a river whose streams make glad the city of God, the holy place where the Most High dwells.
chapters.zh: 有一道河。这河的分汊，使神的城欢喜。这城就是至高者居住的圣所。

chapters.en: God is within her, she will not fall; God will help her at break of day.
chapters.zh: 神在其中。城必不动摇。到天一亮，神必帮助这城。

chapters.en: Nations are in uproar, kingdoms fall; he lifts his voice, the earth melts.
chapters.zh: 外邦喧嚷，列国动摇。神发声，地便熔化。

chapters.en: The LORD Almighty is with us; the God of Jacob is our fortress.
chapters.zh: 万军之耶和华与我们同在。雅各的神是我们的避难所。（细拉）。

chapters.en: Come and see what the LORD has done, the desolations he has brought on the earth.
chapters.zh: 你们来看耶和华的作为，看他使地怎样荒凉。

chapters.en: He makes wars cease to the ends of the earth. He breaks the bow and shatters the spear; he burns the shields with fire.
chapters.zh: 他止息刀兵，直到地极。他折弓断枪，把战车焚烧在火中。

chapters.en: He says, “Be still, and know that I am God; I will be exalted among the nations, I will be exalted in the earth.”
chapters.zh: 你们要休息，要知道我是神。我必在外邦中被尊崇，在遍地上也被尊崇。

chapters.en: The LORD Almighty is with us; the God of Jacob is our fortress.
chapters.zh: 万军之耶和华与我们同在。雅各的神，是我们的避难所。

chapters.en: Clap your hands, all you nations; shout to God with cries of joy.
chapters.zh: （可拉后裔的诗，交与伶长。）万民哪，你们都要拍掌。要用夸胜的声音向神呼喊。

chapters.en: For the LORD Most High is awesome, the great King over all the earth.
chapters.zh: 因为耶和华至高者是可畏的。他是治理全地的大君王。

chapters.en: He subdued nations under us, peoples under our feet.
chapters.zh: 他叫万民服在我们以下，又叫列邦服在我们脚下。

chapters.en: He chose our inheritance for us, the pride of Jacob, whom he loved.
chapters.zh: 他为我们选择产业，就是他所爱之雅各的荣耀。（细拉）。

chapters.en: God has ascended amid shouts of joy, the LORD amid the sounding of trumpets.
chapters.zh: 神上升，有喊声相送。耶和华上升，有角声相送。

chapters.en: Sing praises to God, sing praises; sing praises to our King, sing praises.
chapters.zh: 你们要向神歌颂，歌颂，向我们王歌颂，歌颂。

chapters.en: For God is the King of all the earth; sing to him a psalm of praise.
chapters.zh: 因为神是全地的王。你们要用悟性歌颂。

chapters.en: God reigns over the nations; God is seated on his holy throne.
chapters.zh: 神作王治理万国。神坐在他的圣宝座上。

chapters.en: The nobles of the nations assemble as the people of the God of Abraham, for the kings of the earth belong to God; he is greatly exalted.
chapters.zh: 列邦的君王聚集，要作亚伯拉罕之神的民。因为世界的盾牌，是属神的。他为至高。

chapters.en: Great is the LORD, and most worthy of praise, in the city of our God, his holy mountain.
chapters.zh: （可拉后裔的诗歌。）耶和华本为大，在我们神的城中，在他的圣山上，该受大赞美。

chapters.en: Beautiful in its loftiness, the joy of the whole earth, like the heights of Zaphon is Mount Zion, the city of the Great King.
chapters.zh: 锡安山，大君王的城，在北面居高华美，为全地所喜悦。

chapters.en: God is in her citadels; he has shown himself to be her fortress.
chapters.zh: 神在其宫中自显为避难所。

chapters.en: When the kings joined forces, when they advanced together,
chapters.zh: 看哪，众王会合，一同经过。

chapters.en: they saw her and were astounded; they fled in terror.
chapters.zh: 他们见了这城，就惊奇丧胆，急忙逃跑。

chapters.en: Trembling seized them there, pain like that of a woman in labor.
chapters.zh: 他们在那里被战兢疼痛抓住，好像产难的妇人一样。

chapters.en: You destroyed them like ships of Tarshish shattered by an east wind.
chapters.zh: 神阿，你用东风打破他施的船只。

chapters.en: As we have heard, so we have seen in the city of the LORD Almighty, in the city of our God: God makes her secure forever.
chapters.zh: 我们在万军之耶和华的城中，就是我们神的城中，所看见的，正如我们所听见的。神必坚立这城，直到永远。（细拉）。

chapters.en: Within your temple, O God, we meditate on your unfailing love.
chapters.zh: 神阿，我们在你的殿中，想念你的慈爱。

chapters.en: Like your name, O God, your praise reaches to the ends of the earth; your right hand is filled with righteousness.
chapters.zh: 神阿，你受的赞美，正与你的名相称，直到地极。你的右手满了公义。

chapters.en: Mount Zion rejoices, the villages of Judah are glad because of your judgments.
chapters.zh: 因你的判断，锡安山应当欢喜，犹大的城邑，应当快乐。（城邑原文作女子）

chapters.en: Walk about Zion, go around her, count her towers,
chapters.zh: 你们当周游锡安，四围旋绕，数点城楼，

chapters.en: consider well her ramparts, view her citadels, that you may tell of them to the next generation.
chapters.zh: 细看他的外郭，察看他的宫殿，为要传说到后代。

chapters.en: For this God is our God for ever and ever; he will be our guide even to the end.
chapters.zh: 因为这神永永远远为我们的神。他必作我们引路的，直到死时。

chapters.en: Hear this, all you peoples; listen, all who live in this world,
chapters.zh: （可拉后裔的诗，交与伶长。）万民哪，你们都当听这话，世上一切的居民，

chapters.en: both low and high, rich and poor alike:
chapters.zh: 无论上流下流，富足贫穷，都当留心听。

chapters.en: My mouth will speak words of wisdom; the meditation of my heart will give you understanding.
chapters.zh: 我口要说智慧的言语。我心要想通达的道理。

chapters.en: I will turn my ear to a proverb; with the harp I will expound my riddle:
chapters.zh: 我要侧耳听比喻，用琴解谜语。

chapters.en: Why should I fear when evil days come, when wicked deceivers surround me—
chapters.zh: 在患难的日子，奸恶随我脚跟，四面环绕我，我何必惧怕。

chapters.en: those who trust in their wealth and boast of their great riches?
chapters.zh: 那些倚仗财货自夸钱财多的人，

chapters.en: No one can redeem the life of another or give to God a ransom for them—
chapters.zh: 一个也无法赎自己的弟兄，也不能替他将赎价给神，

chapters.en: the ransom for a life is costly, no payment is ever enough—
chapters.zh: 叫他长远活着，不见朽坏。因为赎他生命的价值极贵，只可永远罢休。

chapters.en: so that they should live on forever and not see decay.
For all can see that the wise die, that the foolish and the senseless also perish, leaving their wealth to others.
chapters.zh: 他必见智慧人死。又见愚顽人和畜类人，一同灭亡，将他们的财货留给别人。

chapters.en: Their tombs will remain their houses forever, their dwellings for endless generations, though they had named lands after themselves.
chapters.zh: 他们心里思想，他们的家室必永存，住宅必留到万代。他们以自己的名，称自己的地。

chapters.en: People, despite their wealth, do not endure; they are like the beasts that perish.
chapters.zh: 但人居尊贵中不能长久，如同死亡的畜类一样。

chapters.en: This is the fate of those who trust in themselves, and of their followers, who approve their sayings.
chapters.zh: 他们行的这道，本为自己的愚昧。但他们以后的人，还佩服他们的话语。（细拉）。

chapters.en: They are like sheep and are destined to die; death will be their shepherd (but the upright will prevail over them in the morning). Their forms will decay in the grave, far from their princely mansions.
chapters.zh: 他们如同羊群派定下阴间。死亡必作他们的牧者。到了早晨，正直人必管辖他们。他们的美容，必被阴间所灭，以致无处可存。

chapters.en: But God will redeem me from the realm of the dead; he will surely take me to himself.
chapters.zh: 只是神必救赎我的灵魂，脱离阴间的权柄，因他必收纳我。（细拉）

chapters.en: Do not be overawed when others grow rich, when the splendor of their houses increases;
chapters.zh: 见人发财家室增荣的时候，你不要惧怕。

chapters.en: for they will take nothing with them when they die, their splendor will not descend with them.
chapters.zh: 因为他死的时候，什么也不能带去。他的荣耀不能随他下去。

chapters.en: Though while they live they count themselves blessed— and people praise you when you prosper—
chapters.zh: 他活着的时候，虽然自夸为有福，（你若利己，人必夸奖你）。

chapters.en: they will join those who have gone before them, who will never again see the light of life.
chapters.zh: 他仍必归到他历代的祖宗那里，永不见光。

chapters.en: People who have wealth but lack understanding are like the beasts that perish.
chapters.zh: 人在尊贵中，而不醒悟，就如死亡的畜类一样。

chapters.en: The Mighty One, God, the LORD, speaks and summons the earth from the rising of the sun to where it sets.
chapters.zh: （亚萨的诗。）大能者神耶和华，已经发言招呼天下，从日出之地到日落之处。

chapters.en: From Zion, perfect in beauty, God shines forth.
chapters.zh: 从全美的锡安中，神已经发光了。

chapters.en: Our God comes and will not be silent; a fire devours before him, and around him a tempest rages.
chapters.zh: 我们的神要来，决不闭口。有烈火在他面前吞灭，有暴风在他四围大刮。

chapters.en: He summons the heavens above, and the earth, that he may judge his people:
chapters.zh: 他招呼上天下地，为要审判他的民，

chapters.en: “Gather to me this consecrated people, who made a covenant with me by sacrifice.”
chapters.zh: 说，招聚我的圣民到我这里来，就是那些用祭物与我立约的人。

chapters.en: And the heavens proclaim his righteousness, for he is a God of justice.
chapters.zh: 诸天必表明他的公义。因为神是施行审判的。（细拉）

chapters.en: “Listen, my people, and I will speak; I will testify against you, Israel: I am God, your God.
chapters.zh: 我的民哪，你们当听我的话。以色列阿，我要劝戒你。我是神，是你的神。

chapters.en: I bring no charges against you concerning your sacrifices or concerning your burnt offerings, which are ever before me.
chapters.zh: 我并不因你的祭物责备你。你的燔祭常在我面前。

chapters.en: I have no need of a bull from your stall or of goats from your pens,
chapters.zh: 我不从你家中取公牛，也不从你圈内取山羊。

chapters.en: for every animal of the forest is mine, and the cattle on a thousand hills.
chapters.zh: 因为树林中的百兽是我的，千山上的牲畜也是我的。

chapters.en: I know every bird in the mountains, and the insects in the fields are mine.
chapters.zh: 山中的飞鸟，我都知道。野地的走兽，也都属我。

chapters.en: If I were hungry I would not tell you, for the world is mine, and all that is in it.
chapters.zh: 我若是饥饿，我不用告诉你。因为世界，和其中所充满的，都是我的。

chapters.en: Do I eat the flesh of bulls or drink the blood of goats?
chapters.zh: 我岂吃公牛的肉呢？我岂喝山羊的血呢？

chapters.en: “Sacrifice thank offerings to God, fulfill your vows to the Most High,
chapters.zh: 你们要以感谢为祭献与神。又要向至高者还你的愿。

chapters.en: and call on me in the day of trouble; I will deliver you, and you will honor me.”
chapters.zh: 并要在患难之日求告我，我必搭救你。你也要荣耀我。

chapters.en: But to the wicked person, God says: “What right have you to recite my laws or take my covenant on your lips?
chapters.zh: 但神对恶人说，你怎敢传说我的律例，口中提到我的约呢？

chapters.en: You hate my instruction and cast my words behind you.
chapters.zh: 其实你恨恶管教，将我的言语丢在背后。

chapters.en: When you see a thief, you join with him; you throw in your lot with adulterers.
chapters.zh: 你见了盗贼，就乐意与他同伙，又与行奸淫的人，一同有分。

chapters.en: You use your mouth for evil and harness your tongue to deceit.
chapters.zh: 你口任说恶言，你舌编造诡诈。

chapters.en: You sit and testify against your brother and slander your own mother’s son.
chapters.zh: 你坐着毁谤你的兄弟，谗毁你亲母的儿子。

chapters.en: When you did these things and I kept silent, you thought I was exactly like you. But I now arraign you and set my accusations before you.
chapters.zh: 你行了这些事，我还闭口不言。你想我恰和你一样。其实我要责备你，将这些事摆在你眼前。

chapters.en: “Consider this, you who forget God, or I will tear you to pieces, with no one to rescue you:
chapters.zh: 你们忘记神的，要思想这事，免得我把你们撕碎，无人搭救。

chapters.en: Those who sacrifice thank offerings honor me, and to the blameless I will show my salvation.”
chapters.zh: 凡以感谢献上为祭的，便是荣耀我。那按正路而行的，我必使他得着我的救恩。

chapters.en: Have mercy on me, O God, according to your unfailing love; according to your great compassion blot out my transgressions.
chapters.zh: （大卫与拔示巴同室以后，先知拿单来见他。他作这诗，交与伶长。）神阿，求你按你的慈爱怜恤我，按你丰盛的慈悲涂抹我的过犯。

chapters.en: Wash away all my iniquity and cleanse me from my sin.
chapters.zh: 求你将我的罪孽洗除净尽，并洁除我的罪。

chapters.en: For I know my transgressions, and my sin is always before me.
chapters.zh: 因为我知道我的过犯，我的罪常在我面前。

chapters.en: Against you, you only, have I sinned and done what is evil in your sight; so you are right in your verdict and justified when you judge.
chapters.zh: 我向你犯罪，惟独得罪了你，在你眼前行了这恶，以致你责备我的时候，显为公义。判断我的时候，显为清正。

chapters.en: Surely I was sinful at birth, sinful from the time my mother conceived me.
chapters.zh: 我是在罪孽里生的。在我母亲怀胎的时候，就有了罪。

chapters.en: Yet you desired faithfulness even in the womb; you taught me wisdom in that secret place.
chapters.zh: 你所喜爱的，是内里诚实。你在我隐密处，必使我得智慧。

chapters.en: Cleanse me with hyssop, and I will be clean; wash me, and I will be whiter than snow.
chapters.zh: 求你用牛膝草洁净我，我就干净，求你洗涤我，我就比雪更白。

chapters.en: Let me hear joy and gladness; let the bones you have crushed rejoice.
chapters.zh: 求你使我得听欢喜快乐的声音，使你所压伤的骨头，可以踊跃。

chapters.en: Hide your face from my sins and blot out all my iniquity.
chapters.zh: 求你掩面不看我的罪，涂抹我一切的罪孽。

chapters.en: Create in me a pure heart, O God, and renew a steadfast spirit within me.
chapters.zh: 神阿，求你为我造清洁的心，使我里面重新有正直的灵。（正直或作坚定）。

chapters.en: Do not cast me from your presence or take your Holy Spirit from me.
chapters.zh: 不要丢弃我，使我离开你的面。不要从我收回你的圣灵。

chapters.en: Restore to me the joy of your salvation and grant me a willing spirit, to sustain me.
chapters.zh: 求你使我仍得救恩之乐，赐我乐意的灵扶持我。

chapters.en: Then I will teach transgressors your ways, so that sinners will turn back to you.
chapters.zh: 我就把你的道指教有过犯的人。罪人必归顺你。

chapters.en: Deliver me from the guilt of bloodshed, O God, you who are God my Savior, and my tongue will sing of your righteousness.
chapters.zh: 神阿，你是拯救我的神。求你救我脱离流人血的罪。我的舌头就高声歌唱你的公义。

chapters.en: Open my lips, Lord, and my mouth will declare your praise.
chapters.zh: 主阿，求你使我嘴唇张开，我的口便传扬赞美你的话。

chapters.en: You do not delight in sacrifice, or I would bring it; you do not take pleasure in burnt offerings.
chapters.zh: 你本不喜爱祭物。若喜爱，我就献上。燔祭你也不喜悦。

chapters.en: My sacrifice, O God, is a broken spirit; a broken and contrite heart you, God, will not despise.
chapters.zh: 神所要的祭，就是忧伤的灵。神阿，忧伤痛悔的心，你必不轻看。

chapters.en: May it please you to prosper Zion, to build up the walls of Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 求你随你的美意善待锡安，建造耶路撒冷的城墙。

chapters.en: Then you will delight in the sacrifices of the righteous, in burnt offerings offered whole; then bulls will be offered on your altar.
chapters.zh: 那时，你必喜爱公义的祭，和燔祭并全牲的燔祭。那时，人必将公牛献在你坛上。

chapters.en: Why do you boast of evil, you mighty hero? Why do you boast all day long, you who are a disgrace in the eyes of God?
chapters.zh: （以东人多益来告诉扫罗说，大卫到了亚希米勒家。那时，大卫作这训诲诗，交与伶长。）勇士阿，你为何以作恶自夸。神的慈爱是常存的。

chapters.en: You who practice deceit, your tongue plots destruction; it is like a sharpened razor.
chapters.zh: 你的舌头邪恶诡诈，好像剃头刀，快利伤人。

chapters.en: You love evil rather than good, falsehood rather than speaking the truth.
chapters.zh: 你爱恶胜似爱善，又爱说谎，不爱说公义。（细拉）

chapters.en: You love every harmful word, you deceitful tongue!
chapters.zh: 诡诈的舌头阿，你爱说一切毁灭的话。

chapters.en: Surely God will bring you down to everlasting ruin: He will snatch you up and pluck you from your tent; he will uproot you from the land of the living.
chapters.zh: 神也要毁灭你，直到永远。他要把你拿去，从你的帐棚中抽出，从活人之地将你拔出。（细拉）

chapters.en: The righteous will see and fear; they will laugh at you, saying,
chapters.zh: 义人要看见而惧怕，并要笑他。

chapters.en: “Here now is the man who did not make God his stronghold but trusted in his great wealth and grew strong by destroying others!”
chapters.zh: 说，看哪，这就是那不以神为他力量的人。只倚仗他丰富的财物，在邪恶上坚立自己。

chapters.en: But I am like an olive tree flourishing in the house of God; I trust in God’s unfailing love for ever and ever.
chapters.zh: 至于我，就像神殿中的青橄榄树。我永永远远倚靠神的慈爱。

chapters.en: For what you have done I will always praise you in the presence of your faithful people. And I will hope in your name, for your name is good.
chapters.zh: 我要称谢你，直到永远，因为你行了这事。我也要在你圣民面前仰望你的名。这名本为美好。

chapters.en: The fool says in his heart, “There is no God.” They are corrupt, and their ways are vile; there is no one who does good.
chapters.zh: （大卫的训诲诗，交与伶长，调用麻哈拉。）愚顽人心里说，没有神。他们都是邪恶，行了可憎恶的罪孽。没有一个人行善。

chapters.en: God looks down from heaven on all mankind to see if there are any who understand, any who seek God.
chapters.zh: 神从天上垂看世人，要看有明白的没有，有寻求他的没有。

chapters.en: Everyone has turned away, all have become corrupt; there is no one who does good, not even one.
chapters.zh: 他们各人都退后，一同变为污秽。并没有行善的。连一个也没有。

chapters.en: Do all these evildoers know nothing? They devour my people as though eating bread; they never call on God.
chapters.zh: 作孽的没有知识吗？他们吞吃我的百姓如同吃饭一样。并不求告神。

chapters.en: But there they are, overwhelmed with dread, where there was nothing to dread. God scattered the bones of those who attacked you; you put them to shame, for God despised them.
chapters.zh: 他们在无可惧怕之处，就大大害怕。因为神把那安营攻击你之人的骨头散开了。你使他们蒙羞，因为神弃绝了他们。

chapters.en: Oh, that salvation for Israel would come out of Zion! When God restores his people, let Jacob rejoice and Israel be glad!
chapters.zh: 但愿以色列的救恩从锡安而出。神救回他被掳的子民，那时，雅各要快乐，以色列要欢喜。

chapters.en: Save me, O God, by your name; vindicate me by your might.
chapters.zh: （西弗人来对扫罗说，大卫岂不是在我们那里藏身吗？那时大卫作这训诲诗，交与伶长。用丝弦的乐器。）神阿，求你以你的名救我，凭你的大能为我伸冤。

chapters.en: Hear my prayer, O God; listen to the words of my mouth.
chapters.zh: 神阿，求你听我的祷告，留心听我口中的言语。

chapters.en: Arrogant foes are attacking me; ruthless people are trying to kill me— people without regard for God.
chapters.zh: 因为外人起来攻击我，强暴人寻索我的命。他们眼中没有神。（细拉）

chapters.en: Surely God is my help; the Lord is the one who sustains me.
chapters.zh: 神是帮助我的，是扶持我命的。

chapters.en: Let evil recoil on those who slander me; in your faithfulness destroy them.
chapters.zh: 他要报应我仇敌所行的恶。求你凭你的诚实灭绝他们。

chapters.en: I will sacrifice a freewill offering to you; I will praise your name, LORD, for it is good.
chapters.zh: 我要把甘心祭献给你。耶和华阿，我要称赞你的名。这名本为美好。

chapters.en: You have delivered me from all my troubles, and my eyes have looked in triumph on my foes.
chapters.zh: 他从一切的急难中，把我救出来。我的眼睛也看见了我仇敌遭报。

chapters.en: Listen to my prayer, O God, do not ignore my plea;
chapters.zh: （大卫的训诲诗，交与伶长，用丝弦的乐器）神阿，求你留心听我的祷告。不要隐藏不听我的恳求。

chapters.en: hear me and answer me. My thoughts trouble me and I am distraught
chapters.zh: 求你侧耳听我，应允我。我哀叹不安，发声唉哼。

chapters.en: because of what my enemy is saying, because of the threats of the wicked; for they bring down suffering on me and assail me in their anger.
chapters.zh: 都因仇敌的声音，恶人的欺压。因为他们将罪孽加在我身上，发怒气逼迫我。

chapters.en: My heart is in anguish within me; the terrors of death have fallen on me.
chapters.zh: 我心在我里面甚是疼痛。死的惊惶临到我身。

chapters.en: Fear and trembling have beset me; horror has overwhelmed me.
chapters.zh: 恐惧战兢归到我身，惊恐漫过了我。

chapters.en: I said, “Oh, that I had the wings of a dove! I would fly away and be at rest.
chapters.zh: 我说，但愿我有翅膀像鸽子，我就飞去得享安息。

chapters.en: I would flee far away and stay in the desert;
chapters.zh: 我必远游宿在旷野。（细拉）

chapters.en: I would hurry to my place of shelter, far from the tempest and storm.”
chapters.zh: 我必速速逃到避所，脱离狂风暴雨。

chapters.en: Lord, confuse the wicked, confound their words, for I see violence and strife in the city.
chapters.zh: 主阿，求你吞灭他们，变乱他们的舌头。因为我在城中见了强暴争竞的事。

chapters.en: Day and night they prowl about on its walls; malice and abuse are within it.
chapters.zh: 他们在城墙上昼夜绕行。在城内也有罪孽和奸恶。

chapters.en: Destructive forces are at work in the city; threats and lies never leave its streets.
chapters.zh: 邪恶在其中，欺压和诡诈不离街市。

chapters.en: If an enemy were insulting me, I could endure it; if a foe were rising against me, I could hide.
chapters.zh: 原来不是仇敌辱骂我。若是仇敌，还可忍耐。也不是恨我的人向我狂大。若是恨我的人，就必躲避他。

chapters.en: But it is you, a man like myself, my companion, my close friend,
chapters.zh: 不料是你，你原与我平等，是我的同伴，是我知己的朋友。

chapters.en: with whom I once enjoyed sweet fellowship at the house of God, as we walked about among the worshipers.
chapters.zh: 我们素常彼此谈论，以为甘甜。我们与群众在神的殿中同行。

chapters.en: Let death take my enemies by surprise; let them go down alive to the realm of the dead, for evil finds lodging among them.
chapters.zh: 愿死亡忽然临到他们。愿他们活活地下入阴间。因为他们的住处，他们的心中，都是邪恶。

chapters.en: As for me, I call to God, and the LORD saves me.
chapters.zh: 至于我，我要求告神。耶和华必拯救我。

chapters.en: Evening, morning and noon I cry out in distress, and he hears my voice.
chapters.zh: 我要晚上，早晨，晌午，哀声悲叹。他也必听我的声音。

chapters.en: He rescues me unharmed from the battle waged against me, even though many oppose me.
chapters.zh: 他救赎我命脱离攻击我的人，使我得享平安。因为与我相争的人甚多。

chapters.en: God, who is enthroned from of old, who does not change— he will hear them and humble them, because they have no fear of God.
chapters.zh: 那没有更变，不敬畏神的人，从太古常存的神，必听见而苦待他。

chapters.en: My companion attacks his friends; he violates his covenant.
chapters.zh: 他背了约，伸手攻击与他和好的人。

chapters.en: His talk is smooth as butter, yet war is in his heart; his words are more soothing than oil, yet they are drawn swords.
chapters.zh: 他的口如奶油光滑，他的心却怀着争战。他的话比油柔和，其实是拔出来的刀。

chapters.en: Cast your cares on the LORD and he will sustain you; he will never let the righteous be shaken.
chapters.zh: 你要把你的重担卸给耶和华，他必抚养你，他永不叫义人动摇。

chapters.en: But you, God, will bring down the wicked into the pit of decay; the bloodthirsty and deceitful will not live out half their days. But as for me, I trust in you.
chapters.zh: 神阿，你必使恶人下入灭亡的坑。流人血行诡诈的人，必活不到半世，但我要倚靠你。

chapters.en: Be merciful to me, my God, for my enemies are in hot pursuit; all day long they press their attack.
chapters.zh: （非利士人在迦特拿住大卫。那时他作这金诗，交与伶长，调用远方无声鸽）神阿，求你怜悯我，因为人要把我吞了，终日攻击欺压我。

chapters.en: My adversaries pursue me all day long; in their pride many are attacking me.
chapters.zh: 我的仇敌终日要把我吞了。因逞骄傲攻击我的人甚多。

chapters.en: When I am afraid, I put my trust in you.
chapters.zh: 我惧怕的时候要倚靠你。

chapters.en: In God, whose word I praise— in God I trust and am not afraid. What can mere mortals do to me?
chapters.zh: 我倚靠神。我要赞美他的话。我倚靠神，必不惧怕。血气之辈能把我怎么样呢？

chapters.en: All day long they twist my words; all their schemes are for my ruin.
chapters.zh: 他们终日颠倒我的话。他们一切的心思，都是要害我。

chapters.en: They conspire, they lurk, they watch my steps, hoping to take my life.
chapters.zh: 他们聚集，埋伏窥探我的脚踪。等候要害我的命。

chapters.en: Because of their wickedness do not let them escape; in your anger, God, bring the nations down.
chapters.zh: 他们岂能因罪孽逃脱吗？神阿，求你在怒中使众民堕落。

chapters.en: Record my misery; list my tears on your scroll — are they not in your record?
chapters.zh: 我几次流离，你都记数。求你把我眼泪装在你的皮袋里。这不都记在你册子上吗？

chapters.en: Then my enemies will turn back when I call for help. By this I will know that God is for me.
chapters.zh: 我呼求的日子，我的仇敌都要转身退后。神帮助我，这是我所知道的。

chapters.en: In God, whose word I praise, in the LORD, whose word I praise—
chapters.zh: 我倚靠神。我要赞美他的话。我倚靠耶和华。我要赞美他的话。

chapters.en: in God I trust and am not afraid. What can man do to me?
chapters.zh: 我倚靠神，必不惧怕。人能把我怎么样呢？

chapters.en: I am under vows to you, my God; I will present my thank offerings to you.
chapters.zh: 神阿，我向你所许的愿在我身上。我要将感谢祭献给你。

chapters.en: For you have delivered me from death and my feet from stumbling, that I may walk before God in the light of life.
chapters.zh: 因为你救我的命脱离死亡。你岂不是救护我的脚不跌倒，使我在生命光中行在神面前吗？

chapters.en: Have mercy on me, my God, have mercy on me, for in you I take refuge. I will take refuge in the shadow of your wings until the disaster has passed.
chapters.zh: （大卫逃避扫罗，藏在洞里。那时他作这金诗，交与伶长，调用休要毁坏）神阿，求你怜悯我，怜悯我。因为我的心投靠你。我要投靠在你翅膀的荫下，等到灾害过去。

chapters.en: I cry out to God Most High, to God, who vindicates me.
chapters.zh: 我要求告至高的神，就是为我成全诸事的神。

chapters.en: He sends from heaven and saves me, rebuking those who hotly pursue me—God sends forth his love and his faithfulness.
chapters.zh: 那要吞我的人辱骂我的时候，神从天上必施恩救我。也必向我发出慈爱和诚实。

chapters.en: I am in the midst of lions; I am forced to dwell among ravenous beasts— men whose teeth are spears and arrows, whose tongues are sharp swords.
chapters.zh: 我的性命在狮子中间。我躺卧在性如烈火的世人当中。他们的牙齿是枪，箭。他们的舌头是快刀。

chapters.en: Be exalted, O God, above the heavens; let your glory be over all the earth.
chapters.zh: 神阿，愿你崇高，过于诸天。愿你的荣耀，高过全地。

chapters.en: They spread a net for my feet— I was bowed down in distress. They dug a pit in my path— but they have fallen into it themselves.
chapters.zh: 他们为我的脚设下网罗，压制我的心。他们在我面前挖了坑，自己反掉在其中。（细拉）

chapters.en: My heart, O God, is steadfast, my heart is steadfast; I will sing and make music.
chapters.zh: 神阿，我心坚定，我心坚定。我要唱诗，我要歌颂。

chapters.en: Awake, my soul! Awake, harp and lyre! I will awaken the dawn.
chapters.zh: 我的灵阿，（原文作荣耀）你当醒起，琴瑟阿，你们当醒起。我自己要极早醒起。

chapters.en: I will praise you, Lord, among the nations; I will sing of you among the peoples.
chapters.zh: 主阿，我要在万民中称谢你。在列邦中歌颂你。

chapters.en: For great is your love, reaching to the heavens; your faithfulness reaches to the skies.
chapters.zh: 因为你的慈爱，高及诸天。你的诚实，达到穹苍。

chapters.en: Be exalted, O God, above the heavens; let your glory be over all the earth.
chapters.zh: 神阿，愿你崇高，过于诸天。愿你的荣耀，高过全地。

chapters.en: Do you rulers indeed speak justly? Do you judge people with equity?
chapters.zh: （大卫的金诗，交与伶长，调用休要毁坏）世人哪，你们默然不语，真合公义吗？施行审判，岂按正直吗？

chapters.en: No, in your heart you devise injustice, and your hands mete out violence on the earth.
chapters.zh: 不然，你们是心中作恶。你们在地上秤出你们手所行的强暴。

chapters.en: Even from birth the wicked go astray; from the womb they are wayward, spreading lies.
chapters.zh: 恶人一出母胎，就与神疏远。一离母腹，便走错路，说谎话。

chapters.en: Their venom is like the venom of a snake, like that of a cobra that has stopped its ears,
chapters.zh: 他们的毒气，好像蛇的毒气。他们好像塞耳的聋虺，

chapters.en: that will not heed the tune of the charmer, however skillful the enchanter may be.
chapters.zh: 不听行法术的声音。虽用极灵的咒语，也是不听。

chapters.en: Break the teeth in their mouths, O God; LORD, tear out the fangs of those lions!
chapters.zh: 神阿，求你敲碎他们口中的牙。耶和华阿，求你敲掉少壮狮子的大牙。

chapters.en: Let them vanish like water that flows away; when they draw the bow, let their arrows fall short.
chapters.zh: 愿他们消灭如急流的水一般。他们瞅准射箭的时候，愿箭头仿佛砍断。

chapters.en: May they be like a slug that melts away as it moves along, like a stillborn child that never sees the sun.
chapters.zh: 愿他们像蜗牛消化过去，又像妇人坠落未见天日的胎。

chapters.en: Before your pots can feel the heat of the thorns— whether they be green or dry—the wicked will be swept away.
chapters.zh: 你们用荆棘烧火。锅还未热，他要用旋风把青的和烧着的一齐刮去。

chapters.en: The righteous will be glad when they are avenged, when they dip their feet in the blood of the wicked.
chapters.zh: 义人见仇敌遭报，就欢喜，要在恶人的血中洗脚。

chapters.en: Then people will say, “Surely the righteous still are rewarded; surely there is a God who judges the earth.”
chapters.zh: 因此，人必说，义人诚然有善报。在地上果有施行判断的神。

chapters.en: Deliver me from my enemies, O God; be my fortress against those who are attacking me.
chapters.zh: （扫罗打发人窥探大卫的房屋，要杀他。那时大卫用这金诗，交与伶长，调用休要毁坏）我的神阿，求你救我脱离仇敌，把我安置在高处，得脱那些起来攻击我的人。

chapters.en: Deliver me from evildoers and save me from those who are after my blood.
chapters.zh: 求你救我脱离作孽的人，和喜爱流人血的人。

chapters.en: See how they lie in wait for me! Fierce men conspire against me for no offense or sin of mine, LORD.
chapters.zh: 因为他们埋伏，要害我的命，有能力的人聚集来攻击我。耶和华阿，这不是为我的过犯，也不是为我的罪愆。

chapters.en: I have done no wrong, yet they are ready to attack me. Arise to help me; look on my plight!
chapters.zh: 我虽然无过，他们预备整齐，跑来攻击我。求你兴起鉴察帮助我。

chapters.en: You, LORD God Almighty, you who are the God of Israel, rouse yourself to punish all the nations; show no mercy to wicked traitors.
chapters.zh: 万军之神耶和华以色列的神阿，求你兴起，惩治万邦。不要怜悯行诡诈的恶人。（细拉）

chapters.en: They return at evening, snarling like dogs, and prowl about the city.
chapters.zh: 他们晚上转回，叫号如狗，围城绕行。

chapters.en: See what they spew from their mouths— the words from their lips are sharp as swords, and they think, “Who can hear us?”
chapters.zh: 他们口中喷吐恶言，嘴里有刀，他们说有谁听见。

chapters.en: But you laugh at them, LORD; you scoff at all those nations.
chapters.zh: 但你耶和华必笑话他们。你要嗤笑万邦。

chapters.en: You are my strength, I watch for you; you, God, are my fortress,
chapters.zh: 我的力量阿，我必仰望你。因为神是我的高台。

chapters.en: my God on whom I can rely. God will go before me and will let me gloat over those who slander me.
chapters.zh: 我的神要以慈爱迎接我。神要叫我看见我仇敌遭报。

chapters.en: But do not kill them, Lord our shield,or my people will forget. In your might uproot them and bring them down.
chapters.zh: 不要杀他们，恐怕我的民忘记。主阿，你是我们的盾牌。求你用你的能力使他们四散，且降为卑。

chapters.en: For the sins of their mouths, for the words of their lips, let them be caught in their pride. For the curses and lies they utter,
chapters.zh: 因他们口中的罪，和嘴里的言语，并咒骂虚谎的话，愿他们在骄傲之中被缠住了。

chapters.en: consume them in your wrath, consume them till they are no more. Then it will be known to the ends of the earth that God rules over Jacob.
chapters.zh: 求你发怒，使他们消灭，以至归于无有，叫他们知道神在雅各中间掌权，直到地极。（细拉）

chapters.en: They return at evening, snarling like dogs, and prowl about the city.
chapters.zh: 到了晚上，任凭他们转回。任凭他们叫号如狗，围城绕行。

chapters.en: They wander about for food and howl if not satisfied.
chapters.zh: 他们必走来走去，寻找食物。若不得饱，就终夜在外。

chapters.en: But I will sing of your strength, in the morning I will sing of your love; for you are my fortress, my refuge in times of trouble.
chapters.zh: 但我要歌颂你的力量，早晨要高唱你的慈爱。因为你作过我的高台。在我急难的日子，作过我的避难所。

chapters.en: You are my strength, I sing praise to you; you, God, are my fortress, my God on whom I can rely.
chapters.zh: 我的力量阿，我要歌颂你。因为神是我的高台，是赐恩与我的神。

chapters.en: You have rejected us, God, and burst upon us; you have been angry—now restore us!
chapters.zh: （大卫与两河间的亚兰并琐巴的亚兰争战的时候，约押转回，在盐谷攻击以东，杀了一万二千人。那时大卫作这金诗，叫人学习，交与伶长。调用为证的百合花。）神阿，你丢弃了我们，使我们破败；你向我们发怒，求你使我们复兴。

chapters.en: You have shaken the land and torn it open; mend its fractures, for it is quaking.
chapters.zh: 你使地震动，而且崩裂。求你将裂口医好。因为地摇动。

chapters.en: You have shown your people desperate times; you have given us wine that makes us stagger.
chapters.zh: 你叫你的民遇见艰难。你叫我们喝那使人东倒西歪的酒。

chapters.en: But for those who fear you, you have raised a banner to be unfurled against the bow.
chapters.zh: 你把旌旗赐给敬畏你的人，可以为真理扬起来。（细拉）

chapters.en: Save us and help us with your right hand, that those you love may be delivered.
chapters.zh: 求你应允我们，用右手拯救我们，好叫你所亲爱的人得救。

chapters.en: God has spoken from his sanctuary: “In triumph I will parcel out Shechem and measure off the Valley of Sukkoth.
chapters.zh: 神已经指着他的圣洁说，（说或作应许我）我要欢乐。我要分开示剑，丈量疏割谷。

chapters.en: Gilead is mine, and Manasseh is mine; Ephraim is my helmet, Judah is my scepter.
chapters.zh: 基列是我的。玛拿西也是我的。以法莲是护卫我头的。犹大是我的杖。

chapters.en: Moab is my washbasin, on Edom I toss my sandal; over Philistia I shout in triumph.”
chapters.zh: 摩押是我的沐浴盆。我要向以东抛鞋。非利士阿，你还能因我欢呼吗？

chapters.en: Who will bring me to the fortified city? Who will lead me to Edom?
chapters.zh: 谁能领我进坚固城。谁能引我到以东地。

chapters.en: Is it not you, God, you who have now rejected us and no longer go out with our armies?
chapters.zh: 神阿，你不是丢弃了我们吗？神阿，你不和我们的军兵同去吗？

chapters.en: Give us aid against the enemy, for human help is worthless.
chapters.zh: 求你帮助我们攻击敌人，因为人的帮助是枉然的。

chapters.en: With God we will gain the victory, and he will trample down our enemies.
chapters.zh: 我们倚靠神，才得施展大能，因为践踏我们敌人的就是他。

chapters.en: Hear my cry, O God; listen to my prayer.
chapters.zh: （大卫的诗，交与伶长。用丝弦的乐器。）神阿，求你听我的呼求，侧耳听我的祷告。

chapters.en: From the ends of the earth I call to you, I call as my heart grows faint; lead me to the rock that is higher than I.
chapters.zh: 我心里发昏的时候，我要从地极求告你。求你领我到那比我更高的磐石。

chapters.en: For you have been my refuge, a strong tower against the foe.
chapters.zh: 因为你作过我的避难所，作过我的坚固台，脱离仇敌。

chapters.en: I long to dwell in your tent forever and take refuge in the shelter of your wings.
chapters.zh: 我要永远住在你的帐幕里。我要投靠在你翅膀下的隐密处。（细拉）

chapters.en: For you, God, have heard my vows; you have given me the heritage of those who fear your name.
chapters.zh: 神阿，你原是听了我所许的愿。你将产业赐给敬畏你名的人。

chapters.en: Increase the days of the king’s life, his years for many generations.
chapters.zh: 你要加添王的寿数。他的年岁必存到世世。

chapters.en: May he be enthroned in God’s presence forever; appoint your love and faithfulness to protect him.
chapters.zh: 他必永远坐在神面前。愿你预备慈爱和诚实保佑他。

chapters.en: Then I will ever sing in praise of your name and fulfill my vows day after day.
chapters.zh: 这样，我要歌颂你的名直到永远，好天天还我所许的愿。

chapters.en: Truly my soul finds rest in God; my salvation comes from him.
chapters.zh: （大卫的诗，照耶杜顿的作法，交与伶长。）我的心默默无声，专等候神。我的救恩是从他而来。

chapters.en: Truly he is my rock and my salvation; he is my fortress, I will never be shaken.
chapters.zh: 惟独他是我的磐石，我的拯救。他是我的高台。我必不很动摇。

chapters.en: How long will you assault me? Would all of you throw me down— this leaning wall, this tottering fence?
chapters.zh: 你们大家攻击一人，把他毁坏。如同毁坏歪斜的墙，将倒的壁，要到几时呢？

chapters.en: Surely they intend to topple me from my lofty place; they take delight in lies. With their mouths they bless, but in their hearts they curse.
chapters.zh: 他们彼此商议，专要从他的尊位上把他推下。他们喜爱谎话。口虽祝福，心却咒诅。（细拉）

chapters.en: Yes, my soul, find rest in God; my hope comes from him.
chapters.zh: 我的心哪，你当默默无声，专等候神。因为我的盼望是从他而来。

chapters.en: Truly he is my rock and my salvation; he is my fortress, I will not be shaken.
chapters.zh: 惟独他是我的磐石，我的拯救。他是我的高台。我必不动摇。

chapters.en: My salvation and my honor depend on God ; he is my mighty rock, my refuge.
chapters.zh: 我的拯救，我的荣耀，都在乎神。我力量的磐石，我的避难所，都在乎神。

chapters.en: Trust in him at all times, you people; pour out your hearts to him, for God is our refuge.
chapters.zh: 你们众民当时时倚靠他，在他面前倾心吐意。神是我们的避难所。（细拉）

chapters.en: Surely the lowborn are but a breath, the highborn are but a lie. If weighed on a balance, they are nothing; together they are only a breath.
chapters.zh: 下流人真是虚空，上流人也是虚假。放在天平里就必浮起。他们一共比空气还轻。

chapters.en: Do not trust in extortion or put vain hope in stolen goods; though your riches increase, do not set your heart on them.
chapters.zh: 不要仗势欺人，也不要因抢夺而骄傲。若财宝加增，不要放在心上。

chapters.en: One thing God has spoken, two things I have heard: “Power belongs to you, God,
chapters.zh: 神说了一次，两次，我都听见，就是能力都属乎神。

chapters.en: and with you, Lord, is unfailing love”; and, “You reward everyone according to what they have done.”
chapters.zh: 主阿，慈爱也是属乎你。因为你照着各人所行的报应他。

chapters.en: You, God, are my God, earnestly I seek you; I thirst for you, my whole being longs for you, in a dry and parched land where there is no water.
chapters.zh: （大卫在犹大旷野的时候，作了这诗。）神阿，你是我的神，我要切切地寻求你。在干旱疲乏无水之地，我渴想你，我的心切慕你。

chapters.en: I have seen you in the sanctuary and beheld your power and your glory.
chapters.zh: 我在圣所中曾如此瞻仰你，为要见你的能力，和你的荣耀。

chapters.en: Because your love is better than life, my lips will glorify you.
chapters.zh: 因你的慈爱比生命更好，我的嘴唇要颂赞你。

chapters.en: I will praise you as long as I live, and in your name I will lift up my hands.
chapters.zh: 我还活的时候，要这样称颂你。我要奉你的名举手。

chapters.en: I will be fully satisfied as with the richest of foods; with singing lips my mouth will praise you.
chapters.zh: 我在床上记念你，在夜更的时候思想你，我的心就像饱足了骨髓肥油。我也要以欢乐的嘴唇赞美你。

chapters.en: On my bed I remember you; I think of you through the watches of the night.
Because you are my help, I sing in the shadow of your wings.
chapters.zh: 因为你曾帮助我，我就在你翅膀的荫下欢呼。

chapters.en: I cling to you; your right hand upholds me.
chapters.zh: 我心紧紧的跟随你。你的右手扶持我。

chapters.en: Those who want to kill me will be destroyed; they will go down to the depths of the earth.
chapters.zh: 但那些寻索要灭我命的人，必往地底下去。

chapters.en: They will be given over to the sword and become food for jackals.
chapters.zh: 他们必被刀剑所杀，被野狗所吃。

chapters.en: But the king will rejoice in God; all who swear by God will glory in him, while the mouths of liars will be silenced.
chapters.zh: 但是王必因神欢喜。凡指着他发誓的，必要夸口。因为说谎之人的口，必被塞住。

chapters.en: Hear me, my God, as I voice my complaint; protect my life from the threat of the enemy.
chapters.zh: （大卫的诗，交与伶长。）神阿，我哀叹的时候，求你听我的声音。求你保护我的性命，不受仇敌的惊恐。

chapters.en: Hide me from the conspiracy of the wicked, from the plots of evildoers.
chapters.zh: 求你把我隐藏，使我脱离作恶之人的暗谋，和作孽之人的扰乱。

chapters.en: They sharpen their tongues like swords and aim cruel words like deadly arrows.
chapters.zh: 他们磨舌如刀，发出苦毒的言语，好像比准了的箭。

chapters.en: They shoot from ambush at the innocent; they shoot suddenly, without fear.
chapters.zh: 要在暗地射完全人。他们忽然射他，并不惧怕。

chapters.en: They encourage each other in evil plans, they talk about hiding their snares; they say, “Who will see it ?”
chapters.zh: 他们彼此勉励设下恶计。他们商量暗设网罗，说，谁能看见。

chapters.en: They plot injustice and say, “We have devised a perfect plan!” Surely the human mind and heart are cunning.
chapters.zh: 他们图谋奸恶，说，我们是极力图谋的。他们各人的意念心思是深的。

chapters.en: But God will shoot them with his arrows; they will suddenly be struck down.
chapters.zh: 但神要射他们。他们忽然被箭射伤。

chapters.en: He will turn their own tongues against them and bring them to ruin; all who see them will shake their heads in scorn.
chapters.zh: 他们必然绊跌，被自己的舌头所害。凡看见他们的，必都摇头。

chapters.en: All people will fear; they will proclaim the works of God and ponder what he has done.
chapters.zh: 众人都要害怕，要传扬神的工作，并且明白他的作为。

chapters.en: The righteous will rejoice in the LORD and take refuge in him; all the upright in heart will glory in him!
chapters.zh: 义人必因耶和华欢喜，并要投靠他。凡心里正直的人，都要夸口。

chapters.en: Praise awaits you, our God, in Zion; to you our vows will be fulfilled.
chapters.zh: （大卫的诗歌，交与伶长。）神阿，锡安的人都等候赞美你，所许的愿，也要向你偿还。

chapters.en: You who answer prayer, to you all people will come.
chapters.zh: 听祷告的主阿，凡有血气的，都要来就你。

chapters.en: When we were overwhelmed by sins, you forgave our transgressions.
chapters.zh: 罪孽胜了我。至于我们的过犯，你都要赦免。

chapters.en: Blessed are those you choose and bring near to live in your courts! We are filled with the good things of your house, of your holy temple.
chapters.zh: 你所拣选，使他亲近你，住在你院中的，这人便为有福。我们必因你居所，你圣殿的美福知足了。

chapters.en: You answer us with awesome and righteous deeds, God our Savior, the hope of all the ends of the earth and of the farthest seas,
chapters.zh: 拯救我们的神阿，你必以威严秉公义应允我们。你本是一切地极，和海上远处的人所倚靠的。

chapters.en: who formed the mountains by your power, having armed yourself with strength,
chapters.zh: 他既以大能束腰，就用力量安定诸山。

chapters.en: who stilled the roaring of the seas, the roaring of their waves, and the turmoil of the nations.
chapters.zh: 使诸海的响声，和其中波浪的响声，并万民的喧哗，都平静了。

chapters.en: The whole earth is filled with awe at your wonders; where morning dawns, where evening fades, you call forth songs of joy.
chapters.zh: 住在地极的人，因你的神迹惧怕。你使日出日落之地都欢呼。

chapters.en: You care for the land and water it; you enrich it abundantly. The streams of God are filled with water to provide the people with grain, for so you have ordained it.
chapters.zh: 你眷顾地，降下透雨，使地大得肥美。神的河满了水。你这样浇灌了地，好为人预备五谷。

chapters.en: You drench its furrows and level its ridges; you soften it with showers and bless its crops.
chapters.zh: 你浇透地的犁沟，润平犁脊。降甘霖，使地软和。其中发长的，蒙你赐福。

chapters.en: You crown the year with your bounty, and your carts overflow with abundance.
chapters.zh: 你以恩典为年岁的冠冕。你的路径都滴下脂油。

chapters.en: The grasslands of the wilderness overflow; the hills are clothed with gladness.
chapters.zh: 滴在旷野的草场上。小山以欢乐束腰。

chapters.en: The meadows are covered with flocks and the valleys are mantled with grain; they shout for joy and sing.
chapters.zh: 草场以羊群为衣。谷中也长满了五谷。这一切都欢呼歌唱。

chapters.en: Shout for joy to God, all the earth!
chapters.zh: （一篇诗歌，交与伶长。）全地都当向神欢呼。

chapters.en: Sing the glory of his name; make his praise glorious.
chapters.zh: 歌颂他名的荣耀。用赞美的言语，将他的荣耀发明。

chapters.en: Say to God, “How awesome are your deeds! So great is your power that your enemies cringe before you.
chapters.zh: 当对神说，你的作为何等可畏。因你的大能仇敌要投降你。

chapters.en: All the earth bows down to you; they sing praise to you, they sing the praises of your name.”
chapters.zh: 全地要敬拜你，歌颂你，要歌颂你的名。（细拉）

chapters.en: Come and see what God has done, his awesome deeds for mankind!
chapters.zh: 你们来看神所行的。他向世人所作之事，是可畏的。

chapters.en: He turned the sea into dry land, they passed through the waters on foot— come, let us rejoice in him.
chapters.zh: 他将海变成干地。众民步行过河。我们在那里因他欢喜。

chapters.en: He rules forever by his power, his eyes watch the nations— let not the rebellious rise up against him.
chapters.zh: 他用权能治理万民，直到永远。他的眼睛鉴察列邦。悖逆的人不可自高。（细拉）

chapters.en: Praise our God, all peoples, let the sound of his praise be heard;
chapters.zh: 万民哪，你们当称颂我们的神。使人得听赞美他的声音。

chapters.en: he has preserved our lives and kept our feet from slipping.
chapters.zh: 他使我们的性命存活，也不叫我们的脚摇动。

chapters.en: For you, God, tested us; you refined us like silver.
chapters.zh: 神阿，你曾试验我们，熬炼我们，如熬炼银子一样。

chapters.en: You brought us into prison and laid burdens on our backs.
chapters.zh: 你使我们进入网罗，把重担放在我们的身上。

chapters.en: You let people ride over our heads; we went through fire and water, but you brought us to a place of abundance.
chapters.zh: 你使人坐车轧我们的头。我们经过水火。你却使我们到丰富之地。

chapters.en: I will come to your temple with burnt offerings and fulfill my vows to you—
chapters.zh: 我要用燔祭进你的殿，向你还我的愿。

chapters.en: vows my lips promised and my mouth spoke when I was in trouble.
chapters.zh: 就是在急难时我嘴唇所发的，口中所许的。

chapters.en: I will sacrifice fat animals to you and an offering of rams; I will offer bulls and goats.
chapters.zh: 我要把肥牛作燔祭，将公羊的香祭献给你。又把公牛和山羊献上。（细拉）

chapters.en: Come and hear, all you who fear God; let me tell you what he has done for me.
chapters.zh: 凡敬畏神的人，你们都来听。我要述说他为我所行的事。

chapters.en: I cried out to him with my mouth; his praise was on my tongue.
chapters.zh: 我曾用口求告他，我的舌头，也称他为高。

chapters.en: If I had cherished sin in my heart, the Lord would not have listened;
chapters.zh: 我若心里注重罪孽，主必不听。

chapters.en: but God has surely listened and has heard my prayer.
chapters.zh: 但神实在听见了。他侧耳听了我祷告的声音。

chapters.en: Praise be to God, who has not rejected my prayer or withheld his love from me!
chapters.zh: 神是应当称颂的。他并没有推却我的祷告，也没有叫他的慈爱离开我。

chapters.en: May God be gracious to us and bless us and make his face shine on us—
chapters.zh: （一篇诗歌，交与伶长。用丝弦的乐器。）愿神怜悯我们，赐福与我们，用脸光照我们。（细拉）

chapters.en: so that your ways may be known on earth, your salvation among all nations.
chapters.zh: 好叫世界得知你的道路，万国得知你的救恩。

chapters.en: May the peoples praise you, God; may all the peoples praise you.
chapters.zh: 神阿，愿列邦称赞你，愿万民都称赞你。

chapters.en: May the nations be glad and sing for joy, for you rule the peoples with equity and guide the nations of the earth.
chapters.zh: 愿万国都快乐欢呼。因为你必按公正审判万民，引导世上的万国。（细拉）

chapters.en: May the peoples praise you, God; may all the peoples praise you.
chapters.zh: 神阿，愿列邦称赞你。愿万民都称赞你。

chapters.en: The land yields its harvest; God, our God, blesses us.
chapters.zh: 地已经出了土产。神，就是我们的神，要赐福与我们。

chapters.en: May God bless us still, so that all the ends of the earth will fear him.
chapters.zh: 神要赐福与我们。地的四极都要敬畏他。

chapters.en: May God arise, may his enemies be scattered; may his foes flee before him.
chapters.zh: （大卫的诗歌，交与伶长。）愿神兴起，使他的仇敌四散，叫那恨他的人，从他面前逃跑。

chapters.en: May you blow them away like smoke— as wax melts before the fire, may the wicked perish before God.
chapters.zh: 他们被驱逐，如烟被风吹散。恶人见神之面而消灭，如蜡被火熔化。

chapters.en: But may the righteous be glad and rejoice before God; may they be happy and joyful.
chapters.zh: 惟有义人必然欢喜，在神面前高兴快乐。

chapters.en: Sing to God, sing in praise of his name, extol him who rides on the clouds ; rejoice before him—his name is the LORD.
chapters.zh: 你们当向神唱诗，歌颂他的名。为那坐车行过旷野的，修平大路。他的名是耶和华。要在他面前欢乐。

chapters.en: A father to the fatherless, a defender of widows, is God in his holy dwelling.
chapters.zh: 神在他的圣所作孤儿的父，作寡妇的伸冤者。

chapters.en: God sets the lonely in families,he leads out the prisoners with singing; but the rebellious live in a sun-scorched land.
chapters.zh: 神叫孤独的有家，使被囚的出来享福。惟有悖逆的住在干燥之地。

chapters.en: When you, God, went out before your people, when you marched through the wilderness,
chapters.zh: 神阿，你曾在你百姓前头出来，在旷野行走。（细拉）

chapters.en: the earth shook, the heavens poured down rain, before God, the One of Sinai, before God, the God of Israel.
chapters.zh: 那时地见神的面而震动，天也落雨。西乃山见以色列神的面也震动。

chapters.en: You gave abundant showers, O God; you refreshed your weary inheritance.
chapters.zh: 神阿，你降下大雨。你产业以色列疲乏的时候，你使他坚固。

chapters.en: Your people settled in it, and from your bounty, God, you provided for the poor.
chapters.zh: 你的会众住在其中。神阿，你的恩惠是为困苦人预备的。
