chapters.en: The Lord announces the word, and the women who proclaim it are a mighty throng:
chapters.zh: 主发命令，传好信息的妇女成了大群。

chapters.en: “Kings and armies flee in haste; the women at home divide the plunder.
chapters.zh: 统兵的君王逃跑了，逃跑了。在家等候的妇女，分受所夺的。

chapters.en: Even while you sleep among the sheep pens,the wings of my dove are sheathed with silver, its feathers with shining gold.”
chapters.zh: 你们安卧在羊圈的时候，好像鸽子的翅膀镀白银，翎毛镀黄金一般。

chapters.en: When the Almighty scattered the kings in the land, it was like snow fallen on Mount Zalmon.
chapters.zh: 全能者在境内赶散列王的时候，势如飘雪在撒们。

chapters.en: Mount Bashan, majestic mountain, Mount Bashan, rugged mountain,
chapters.zh: 巴珊山是神的山。巴珊山是多峰多岭的山。

chapters.en: why gaze in envy, you rugged mountain, at the mountain where God chooses to reign, where the LORD himself will dwell forever?
chapters.zh: 你们多峰多岭的山哪，为何斜看神所愿居住的山。耶和华必住这山。直到永远。

chapters.en: The chariots of God are tens of thousands and thousands of thousands; the Lord has come from Sinai into his sanctuary.
chapters.zh: 神的车辇累万盈千。主在其中，好像在西乃圣山一样。

chapters.en: When you ascended on high, you took many captives; you received gifts from people, even from the rebellious— that you,LORD God, might dwell there.
chapters.zh: 你已经升上高天，掳掠仇敌，你在人间，就是在悖逆的人间，受了供献，叫耶和华神可以与他们同住。

chapters.en: Praise be to the Lord, to God our Savior, who daily bears our burdens.
chapters.zh: 天天背负我们重担的主，就是拯救我们的神。是应当称颂的。（细拉）

chapters.en: Our God is a God who saves; from the Sovereign LORD comes escape from death.
chapters.zh: 神是为我们施行诸般救恩的神。人能脱离死亡，是在乎主耶和华。

chapters.en: Surely God will crush the heads of his enemies, the hairy crowns of those who go on in their sins.
chapters.zh: 但神要打破他仇敌的头，就是那常犯罪之人的发顶。

chapters.en: The Lord says, “I will bring them from Bashan; I will bring them from the depths of the sea,
chapters.zh: 主说，我要使众民从巴珊而归，使他们从深海而回。

chapters.en: that your feet may wade in the blood of your foes, while the tongues of your dogs have their share.”
chapters.zh: 使你打碎仇敌，你的脚踹在血中，使你狗的舌头，从其中得分。

chapters.en: Your procession, God, has come into view, the procession of my God and King into the sanctuary.
chapters.zh: 神阿，你是我的神，我的王。人已经看见你行走，进入圣所。

chapters.en: In front are the singers, after them the musicians; with them are the young women playing the timbrels.
chapters.zh: 歌唱的行在前，作乐的随在后，都在击鼓的童女中间。

chapters.en: Praise God in the great congregation; praise the LORD in the assembly of Israel.
chapters.zh: 从以色列源头而来的，当在各会中称颂主神。

chapters.en: There is the little tribe of Benjamin, leading them, there the great throng of Judah’s princes, and there the princes of Zebulun and of Naphtali.
chapters.zh: 在那里有统管他们的小便雅悯，有犹大的首领，和他们的群众。有西布伦的首领。有拿弗他利的首领。

chapters.en: Summon your power, God ; show us your strength, our God, as you have done before.
chapters.zh: 以色列的能力，是神所赐的。神阿，求你坚固你为我们所成全的事。

chapters.en: Because of your temple at Jerusalem kings will bring you gifts.
chapters.zh: 因你耶路撒冷的殿，列王必带贡物献给你。

chapters.en: Rebuke the beast among the reeds, the herd of bulls among the calves of the nations. Humbled, may the beast bring bars of silver. Scatter the nations who delight in war.
chapters.zh: 求你叱喝芦苇中的野兽，和群公牛，并列邦中的牛犊，把银块踹在脚下。神已经赶散好争战的列邦。

chapters.en: Envoys will come from Egypt; Cush will submit herself to God.
chapters.zh: 埃及的公侯要出来朝见神。古实人要急忙举手祷告。

chapters.en: Sing to God, you kingdoms of the earth, sing praise to the Lord,
chapters.zh: 世上的列国阿，你们要向神歌唱。愿你们歌颂主，

chapters.en: to him who rides across the highest heavens, the ancient heavens, who thunders with mighty voice.
chapters.zh: 歌颂那自古驾行在诸天以上的主。他发出声音，是极大的声音。

chapters.en: Proclaim the power of God, whose majesty is over Israel, whose power is in the heavens.
chapters.zh: 你们要将能力归给神。他的威荣在以色列之上，他的能力是在穹苍。

chapters.en: You, God, are awesome in your sanctuary; the God of Israel gives power and strength to his people. Praise be to God!
chapters.zh: 神阿，你从圣所显为可畏。以色列的神，是那将力量权能赐给他百姓的。神是应当称颂的。

chapters.en: Save me, O God, for the waters have come up to my neck.
chapters.zh: （大卫的诗，交与伶长，调用百合花。）神阿，求你救我。因为众水要淹没我。

chapters.en: I sink in the miry depths, where there is no foothold. I have come into the deep waters; the floods engulf me.
chapters.zh: 我陷在深淤泥中，没有立脚之地。我到了深水中。大水漫过我身。

chapters.en: I am worn out calling for help; my throat is parched. My eyes fail, looking for my God.
chapters.zh: 我因呼求困乏，喉咙发干。我因等候神，眼睛失明。

chapters.en: Those who hate me without reason outnumber the hairs of my head; many are my enemies without cause, those who seek to destroy me. I am forced to restore what I did not steal.
chapters.zh: 无故恨我的，比我头发还多。无理与我为仇，要把我剪除的甚为强盛。我没有抢夺的，要叫我偿还。

chapters.en: You, God, know my folly; my guilt is not hidden from you.
chapters.zh: 神阿，我的愚昧你原知道。我的罪愆不能隐瞒。

chapters.en: Lord, the LORD Almighty, may those who hope in you not be disgraced because of me; God of Israel, may those who seek you not be put to shame because of me.
chapters.zh: 万军的主耶和华阿，求你叫那等候你的，不要因我蒙羞。以色列的神阿，求你叫那寻求你的，不要因我受辱。

chapters.en: For I endure scorn for your sake, and shame covers my face.
chapters.zh: 因我为你的缘故受了辱骂，满面羞愧。

chapters.en: I am a foreigner to my own family, a stranger to my own mother’s children;
chapters.zh: 我的弟兄看我为外路人。我的同胞看我为外邦人。

chapters.en: for zeal for your house consumes me, and the insults of those who insult you fall on me.
chapters.zh: 因我为你的殿心里焦急，如同火烧。并且辱骂你人的辱骂，都落在我身上。

chapters.en: When I weep and fast, I must endure scorn;
chapters.zh: 我哭泣，以禁食刻苦我心，这倒算为我的羞辱。

chapters.en: when I put on sackcloth, people make sport of me.
chapters.zh: 我拿麻布当衣裳。就成了他们的笑谈。

chapters.en: Those who sit at the gate mock me, and I am the song of the drunkards.
chapters.zh: 坐在城门口的谈论我。酒徒也以我为歌曲。

chapters.en: But I pray to you, LORD, in the time of your favor; in your great love, O God, answer me with your sure salvation.
chapters.zh: 但我在悦纳的时候，向你耶和华祈祷。神阿，求你按你丰盛的慈爱，凭你拯救的诚实，应允我。

chapters.en: Rescue me from the mire, do not let me sink; deliver me from those who hate me, from the deep waters.
chapters.zh: 求你搭救我出离淤泥，不叫我陷在其中。求你使我脱离那些恨我的人，使我出离深水。

chapters.en: Do not let the floodwaters engulf me or the depths swallow me up or the pit close its mouth over me.
chapters.zh: 求你不容大水漫过我，不容深渊吞灭我，不容坑坎在我以上合口。

chapters.en: Answer me, LORD, out of the goodness of your love; in your great mercy turn to me.
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，求你应允我，因为你的慈爱本为美好。求你按你丰盛的慈悲，回转眷顾我。

chapters.en: Do not hide your face from your servant; answer me quickly, for I am in trouble.
chapters.zh: 不要掩面不顾你的仆人。我是在急难之中。求你速速地应允我。

chapters.en: Come near and rescue me; deliver me because of my foes.
chapters.zh: 求你亲近我，救赎我。求你因我的仇敌把我赎回。

chapters.en: You know how I am scorned, disgraced and shamed; all my enemies are before you.
chapters.zh: 你知道我受的辱骂，欺凌，羞辱。我的敌人都在你面前。

chapters.en: Scorn has broken my heart and has left me helpless; I looked for sympathy, but there was none, for comforters, but I found none.
chapters.zh: 辱骂伤破了我的心。我又满了忧愁。我指望有人体恤，却没有一个。我指望有人安慰，却找不着一个。

chapters.en: They put gall in my food and gave me vinegar for my thirst.
chapters.zh: 他们拿苦胆给我当食物。我渴了，他们拿醋给我喝。

chapters.en: May the table set before them become a snare; may it become retribution and a trap.
chapters.zh: 愿他们的筵席，在他们面前变为网罗，在他们平安的时候，变为机槛。

chapters.en: May their eyes be darkened so they cannot see, and their backs be bent forever.
chapters.zh: 愿他们的眼睛昏蒙，不得看见。愿你使他们的腰常常战抖。

chapters.en: Pour out your wrath on them; let your fierce anger overtake them.
chapters.zh: 求你将你的恼恨，倒在他们身上，叫你的烈怒追上他们。

chapters.en: May their place be deserted; let there be no one to dwell in their tents.
chapters.zh: 愿他们的住处，变为荒场。愿他们的帐棚，无人居住。

chapters.en: For they persecute those you wound and talk about the pain of those you hurt.
chapters.zh: 因为你所击打的，他们就逼迫。你所击伤的他们戏说他的愁苦。

chapters.en: Charge them with crime upon crime; do not let them share in your salvation.
chapters.zh: 愿你在他们的罪上加罪，不容他们在你面前称义。

chapters.en: May they be blotted out of the book of life and not be listed with the righteous.
chapters.zh: 愿他们从生命册上被涂抹，不得记录在义人之中。

chapters.en: But as for me, afflicted and in pain— may your salvation, God, protect me.
chapters.zh: 但我是困苦忧伤的。神阿，愿你的救恩，将我安置在高处。

chapters.en: I will praise God’s name in song and glorify him with thanksgiving.
chapters.zh: 我要以诗歌赞美神的名，以感谢称他为大。

chapters.en: This will please the LORD more than an ox, more than a bull with its horns and hooves.
chapters.zh: 这便叫耶和华喜悦，胜似献牛，或是献有角有蹄的公牛。

chapters.en: The poor will see and be glad— you who seek God, may your hearts live!
chapters.zh: 谦卑的人看见了，就喜乐。寻求神的人，愿你们的心苏醒。

chapters.en: The LORD hears the needy and does not despise his captive people.
chapters.zh: 因为耶和华听了穷乏人，不藐视被囚的人。

chapters.en: Let heaven and earth praise him, the seas and all that move in them,
chapters.zh: 愿天和地，洋海，和其中一切的动物，都赞美他。

chapters.en: for God will save Zion and rebuild the cities of Judah. Then people will settle there and possess it;
chapters.zh: 因为神要拯救锡安，建造犹大的城邑。他的民要在那里居住，得以为业。

chapters.en: the children of his servants will inherit it, and those who love his name will dwell there.
chapters.zh: 他仆人的后裔，要承受为业。爱他名的人，也要住在其中。

chapters.en: Hasten, O God, to save me; come quickly, LORD, to help me.
chapters.zh: （大卫的记念诗，交与伶长。）神阿，求你快快搭救我。耶和华阿，求你速速帮助我。

chapters.en: May those who want to take my life be put to shame and confusion; may all who desire my ruin be turned back in disgrace.
chapters.zh: 愿那些寻索我命的，抱愧蒙羞。愿那些喜悦我遭害的，退后受辱。

chapters.en: May those who say to me, “Aha! Aha!” turn back because of their shame.
chapters.zh: 愿那些对我说，阿哈，阿哈的，因羞愧退后。

chapters.en: But may all who seek you rejoice and be glad in you; may those who long for your saving help always say, “The LORD is great!”
chapters.zh: 愿一切寻求你的，因你高兴欢喜。愿那些喜爱你救恩的常说，当尊神为大。

chapters.en: But as for me, I am poor and needy; come quickly to me, O God. You are my help and my deliverer; LORD, do not delay.
chapters.zh: 但我是困苦穷乏的。神阿，求你速速到我这里来。你是帮助我的，搭救我的。耶和华阿，求你不要耽延。

chapters.en: In you, LORD, I have taken refuge; let me never be put to shame.
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，我投靠你。求你叫我永不羞愧。

chapters.en: In your righteousness, rescue me and deliver me; turn your ear to me and save me.
chapters.zh: 求你凭你的公义搭救我，救拔我，侧耳听我，拯救我。

chapters.en: Be my rock of refuge, to which I can always go; give the command to save me, for you are my rock and my fortress.
chapters.zh: 求你作我常住的磐石。你已经命定要救我。因为你是我的岩石，我的山寨。

chapters.en: Deliver me, my God, from the hand of the wicked, from the grasp of those who are evil and cruel.
chapters.zh: 我的神阿，求你救我脱离恶人的手，脱离不义和残暴之人的手。

chapters.en: For you have been my hope, Sovereign LORD, my confidence since my youth.
chapters.zh: 主耶和华阿，你是我所盼望的。从我年幼你是我所倚靠的。

chapters.en: From birth I have relied on you; you brought me forth from my mother’s womb. I will ever praise you.
chapters.zh: 我从出母胎被你扶持。使我出母腹的是你。我必常常赞美你。

chapters.en: I have become a sign to many; you are my strong refuge.
chapters.zh: 许多人以我为怪。但你是我坚固的避难所。

chapters.en: My mouth is filled with your praise, declaring your splendor all day long.
chapters.zh: 你的赞美，你的荣耀，终日必满了我的口。

chapters.en: Do not cast me away when I am old; do not forsake me when my strength is gone.
chapters.zh: 我年老的时候，求你不要丢弃我。我力气衰弱的时候，求你不要离弃我。

chapters.en: For my enemies speak against me; those who wait to kill me conspire together.
chapters.zh: 我的仇敌议论我。那些窥探要害我命的彼此商议，

chapters.en: They say, “God has forsaken him; pursue him and seize him, for no one will rescue him.”
chapters.zh: 说，神已经离弃他。我们追赶他，捉拿他吧。因为没有人搭救。

chapters.en: Do not be far from me, my God; come quickly, God, to help me.
chapters.zh: 神阿，求你不要远离我。我的神阿，求你速速帮助我。

chapters.en: May my accusers perish in shame; may those who want to harm me be covered with scorn and disgrace.
chapters.zh: 愿那与我性命为敌的，羞愧被灭。愿那谋害我的，受辱蒙羞。

chapters.en: As for me, I will always have hope; I will praise you more and more.
chapters.zh: 我却要常常盼望，并要越发赞美你。

chapters.en: My mouth will tell of your righteous deeds, of your saving acts all day long— though I know not how to relate them all.
chapters.zh: 我的口终日要述说你的公义，和你的救恩。因我不计其数。

chapters.en: I will come and proclaim your mighty acts, Sovereign LORD; I will proclaim your righteous deeds, yours alone.
chapters.zh: 我要来说主耶和华大能的事。我单要提说你的公义。

chapters.en: Since my youth, God, you have taught me, and to this day I declare your marvelous deeds.
chapters.zh: 神阿，自我年幼时，你就教训我。直到如今，我传扬你奇妙的作为。

chapters.en: Even when I am old and gray, do not forsake me, my God, till I declare your power to the next generation, your mighty acts to all who are to come.
chapters.zh: 神阿，我到年老发白的时候，求你不要离弃我，等我将你的能力指示下代，将你的大能指示后世的人。

chapters.en: Your righteousness, God, reaches to the heavens, you who have done great things. Who is like you, God?
chapters.zh: 神阿，你的公义甚高。行过大事的神阿，谁能象你。

chapters.en: Though you have made me see troubles, many and bitter, you will restore my life again; from the depths of the earth you will again bring me up.
chapters.zh: 你是叫我们多经历重大急难的，必使我们复活。从地的深处救上来。

chapters.en: You will increase my honor and comfort me once more.
chapters.zh: 求你使我越发昌大，又转来安慰我。

chapters.en: I will praise you with the harp for your faithfulness, my God; I will sing praise to you with the lyre, Holy One of Israel.
chapters.zh: 我的神阿，我要鼓瑟称赞你，称赞你的诚实。以色列的圣者阿，我要弹琴歌颂你。

chapters.en: My lips will shout for joy when I sing praise to you— I whom you have delivered.
chapters.zh: 我歌颂你的时候，我的嘴唇，和你所赎我的灵魂，都必欢呼。

chapters.en: My tongue will tell of your righteous acts all day long, for those who wanted to harm me have been put to shame and confusion.
chapters.zh: 并且我的舌头，必终日讲论你的公义，因为那些谋害我的人，已经蒙羞受辱了。

chapters.en: Endow the king with your justice, O God, the royal son with your righteousness.
chapters.zh: （所罗门的诗。）神阿，求你将判断的权柄赐给王，将公义赐给王的儿子。

chapters.en: May he judge your people in righteousness, your afflicted ones with justice.
chapters.zh: 他要按公义审判你的民，按公平审判你的困苦人。

chapters.en: May the mountains bring prosperity to the people, the hills the fruit of righteousness.
chapters.zh: 大山小山，都要因公义使民得享平安。

chapters.en: May he defend the afflicted among the people and save the children of the needy; may he crush the oppressor.
chapters.zh: 他必为民中的困苦人伸冤，拯救穷乏之辈，压碎那欺压人的。

chapters.en: May he endure as long as the sun, as long as the moon, through all generations.
chapters.zh: 太阳还存，月亮还在，人要敬畏你，直到万代。

chapters.en: May he be like rain falling on a mown field, like showers watering the earth.
chapters.zh: 他必降临，像雨降在已割的草地上，如甘霖滋润田地。

chapters.en: In his days may the righteous flourish and prosperity abound till the moon is no more.
chapters.zh: 在他的日子义人要发旺，大有平安，好像月亮长存。

chapters.en: May he rule from sea to sea and from the River to the ends of the earth.
chapters.zh: 他要执掌权柄，从这海直到那海，从大河直到地极。

chapters.en: May the desert tribes bow before him and his enemies lick the dust.
chapters.zh: 住在旷野的，必在他面前下拜。他的仇敌，必要舔土。

chapters.en: May the kings of Tarshish and of distant shores bring tribute to him. May the kings of Sheba and Seba present him gifts.
chapters.zh: 他施和海岛的王要进贡。示巴和西巴的王要献礼物。

chapters.en: May all kings bow down to him and all nations serve him.
chapters.zh: 诸王都要叩拜他，万国都要事奉他。

chapters.en: For he will deliver the needy who cry out, the afflicted who have no one to help.
chapters.zh: 因为穷乏人呼求的时候，他要搭救，没有人帮助的困苦人，他也要搭救。

chapters.en: He will take pity on the weak and the needy and save the needy from death.
chapters.zh: 他要怜恤贫寒和穷乏的人，拯救穷苦人的性命。

chapters.en: He will rescue them from oppression and violence, for precious is their blood in his sight.
chapters.zh: 他要救赎他们脱离欺压和强暴。他们的血在他眼中看为宝贵。

chapters.en: Long may he live! May gold from Sheba be given him. May people ever pray for him and bless him all day long.
chapters.zh: 他们要存活。示巴的金子要奉给他。人要常常为他祷告，终日称颂他。

chapters.en: May grain abound throughout the land; on the tops of the hills may it sway. May the crops flourish like Lebanon and thrive like the grass of the field.
chapters.zh: 在地的山顶上，五谷必然茂盛。（五谷必然茂盛或作有一把五谷）所结的谷实，要响动如利巴嫩的树林。城里的人，要发旺如地上的草。

chapters.en: May his name endure forever; may it continue as long as the sun. Then all nations will be blessed through him,and they will call him blessed.
chapters.zh: 他的名要存到永远，要留传如日之久。人要因他蒙福。万国要称他有福。

chapters.en: Praise be to the LORD God, the God of Israel, who alone does marvelous deeds.
chapters.zh: 独行奇事的耶和华以色列的神，是应当称颂的。

chapters.en: Praise be to his glorious name forever; may the whole earth be filled with his glory. Amen and Amen.
chapters.zh: 他荣耀的名，也当称颂，直到永远。愿他的荣耀，充满全地。阿们，阿们。

chapters.en: This concludes the prayers of David son of Jesse.
chapters.zh: 耶西的儿子大卫的祈祷完毕。

chapters.en: Surely God is good to Israel, to those who are pure in heart.
chapters.zh: （亚萨的诗。）神实在恩待以色列那些清心的人。

chapters.en: But as for me, my feet had almost slipped; I had nearly lost my foothold.
chapters.zh: 至于我，我的脚几乎失闪。我的脚险些滑跌。

chapters.en: For I envied the arrogant when I saw the prosperity of the wicked.
chapters.zh: 我见恶人和狂傲人享平安，就心怀不平。

chapters.en: They have no struggles; their bodies are healthy and strong.
chapters.zh: 他们死的时候，没有疼痛。他们的力气，却也壮实。

chapters.en: They are free from common human burdens; they are not plagued by human ills.
chapters.zh: 他们不像别人受苦，也不像别人遭灾。

chapters.en: Therefore pride is their necklace; they clothe themselves with violence.
chapters.zh: 所以骄傲如链子戴在他们的项上。强暴像衣裳遮住他们的身体。

chapters.en: From their callous hearts comes iniquity ; their evil imaginations have no limits.
chapters.zh: 他们的眼睛，因体胖而凸出。他们所得的，过于心里所想的。

chapters.en: They scoff, and speak with malice; with arrogance they threaten oppression.
chapters.zh: 他们讥笑人，凭恶意说欺压人的话。他们说话自高。

chapters.en: Their mouths lay claim to heaven, and their tongues take possession of the earth.
chapters.zh: 他们的口亵渎上天，他们的舌毁谤全地。

chapters.en: Therefore their people turn to them and drink up waters in abundance.
chapters.zh: 所以神的民归到这里，喝尽了满杯的苦水。

chapters.en: They say, “How would God know? Does the Most High know anything?”
chapters.zh: 他们说，神怎能晓得？至高者岂有知识呢？

chapters.en: This is what the wicked are like— always free of care, they go on amassing wealth.
chapters.zh: 看哪，这就是恶人。他们既是常享安逸，财宝便加增。

chapters.en: Surely in vain I have kept my heart pure and have washed my hands in innocence.
chapters.zh: 我实在徒然洁净了我的心，徒然洗手表明无辜。

chapters.en: All day long I have been afflicted, and every morning brings new punishments.
chapters.zh: 因为我终日遭灾难，每早晨受惩治。

chapters.en: If I had spoken out like that, I would have betrayed your children.
chapters.zh: 我若说，我要这样讲，这就是以奸诈待你的众子。

chapters.en: When I tried to understand all this, it troubled me deeply
chapters.zh: 我思索怎能明白这事，眼看实系为难。

chapters.en: till I entered the sanctuary of God; then I understood their final destiny.
chapters.zh: 等我进了神的圣所，思想他们的结局。

chapters.en: Surely you place them on slippery ground; you cast them down to ruin.
chapters.zh: 你实在把他们安在滑地，使他们掉在沉沦之中。

chapters.en: How suddenly are they destroyed, completely swept away by terrors!
chapters.zh: 他们转眼之间，成了何等的荒凉。他们被惊恐灭尽了。

chapters.en: They are like a dream when one awakes; when you arise, Lord, you will despise them as fantasies.
chapters.zh: 人睡醒了怎样看梦，主阿，你醒了，也必照样轻看他们的影像。

chapters.en: When my heart was grieved and my spirit embittered,
chapters.zh: 因而我心里发酸，肺腑被刺。

chapters.en: I was senseless and ignorant; I was a brute beast before you.
chapters.zh: 我这样愚昧无知，在你面前如畜类一般。

chapters.en: Yet I am always with you; you hold me by my right hand.
chapters.zh: 然而我常与你同在。你搀着我的右手。

chapters.en: You guide me with your counsel, and afterward you will take me into glory.
chapters.zh: 你要以你的训言引导我，以后必接我到荣耀里。

chapters.en: Whom have I in heaven but you? And earth has nothing I desire besides you.
chapters.zh: 除你以外，在天上我有谁呢？除你以外，在地上我也没有所爱慕的。

chapters.en: My flesh and my heart may fail, but God is the strength of my heart and my portion forever.
chapters.zh: 我的肉体，和我的心肠衰残。但神是我心里的力量，又是我的福分，直到永远。

chapters.en: Those who are far from you will perish; you destroy all who are unfaithful to you.
chapters.zh: 远离你的，必要死亡。凡离弃你行邪淫的，你都灭绝了。

chapters.en: But as for me, it is good to be near God. I have made the Sovereign LORD my refuge; I will tell of all your deeds.
chapters.zh: 但我亲近神是与我有益。我以主耶和华为我的避难所，好叫我述说你一切的作为。

chapters.en: O God, why have you rejected us forever? Why does your anger smolder against the sheep of your pasture?
chapters.zh: （亚萨的训诲诗。）神阿，你为何永远丢弃我们呢？你为何向你草场的羊发怒如烟冒出呢？

chapters.en: Remember the nation you purchased long ago, the people of your inheritance, whom you redeemed— Mount Zion, where you dwelt.
chapters.zh: 求你记念你古时所得来的会众，就是你所赎作你产业支派的。并记念你向来所居住的锡安山。

chapters.en: Turn your steps toward these everlasting ruins, all this destruction the enemy has brought on the sanctuary.
chapters.zh: 求你举步去看那日久荒凉之地，仇敌在圣所中所行的一切恶事。

chapters.en: Your foes roared in the place where you met with us; they set up their standards as signs.
chapters.zh: 你的敌人在你会中吼叫。他们竖了自己的旗为记号。

chapters.en: They behaved like men wielding axes to cut through a thicket of trees.
chapters.zh: 他们好像人扬起斧子，砍伐林中的树。

chapters.en: They smashed all the carved paneling with their axes and hatchets.
chapters.zh: 圣所中一切雕刻的，他们现在用斧子锤子打坏了。

chapters.en: They burned your sanctuary to the ground; they defiled the dwelling place of your Name.
chapters.zh: 他们用火焚烧你的圣所，亵渎你名的居所，拆毁到地。

chapters.en: They said in their hearts, “We will crush them completely!” They burned every place where God was worshiped in the land.
chapters.zh: 他们心里说，我们要尽行毁灭，他们就在遍地把神的会所都烧毁了。

chapters.en: We are given no signs from God; no prophets are left, and none of us knows how long this will be.
chapters.zh: 我们不见我们的标帜。不再有先知。我们内中也没有人知道这灾祸要到几时呢？

chapters.en: How long will the enemy mock you, God? Will the foe revile your name forever?
chapters.zh: 神阿，敌人辱骂要到几时呢？仇敌亵渎你的名，要到永远吗？

chapters.en: Why do you hold back your hand, your right hand? Take it from the folds of your garment and destroy them!
chapters.zh: 你为什么缩回你的右手。求你从怀中伸出来，毁灭他们。

chapters.en: But God is my King from long ago; he brings salvation on the earth.
chapters.zh: 神自古以来为我的王，在地上施行拯救。

chapters.en: It was you who split open the sea by your power; you broke the heads of the monster in the waters.
chapters.zh: 你曾用能力将海分开，将水中大鱼的头打破。

chapters.en: It was you who crushed the heads of Leviathan and gave it as food to the creatures of the desert.
chapters.zh: 你曾砸碎鳄鱼的头，把他给旷野的禽兽为食物。（禽兽原文作民）

chapters.en: It was you who opened up springs and streams; you dried up the ever-flowing rivers.
chapters.zh: 你曾分裂磐石，水便成了溪河，你使长流的江河干了。

chapters.en: The day is yours, and yours also the night; you established the sun and moon.
chapters.zh: 白昼属你，黑夜也属你。亮光和日头，是你所预备的。

chapters.en: It was you who set all the boundaries of the earth; you made both summer and winter.
chapters.zh: 地的一切疆界，是你所立的。夏天和冬天是你所定的。

chapters.en: Remember how the enemy has mocked you, LORD, how foolish people have reviled your name.
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，仇敌辱骂，愚顽民亵渎了你的名，求你记念这事。

chapters.en: Do not hand over the life of your dove to wild beasts; do not forget the lives of your afflicted people forever.
chapters.zh: 不要将你斑鸠的性命交给野兽。不要永远忘记你困苦人的性命。

chapters.en: Have regard for your covenant, because haunts of violence fill the dark places of the land.
chapters.zh: 求你顾念所立的约。因为地上黑暗之处，都满了强暴的居所。

chapters.en: Do not let the oppressed retreat in disgrace; may the poor and needy praise your name.
chapters.zh: 不要叫受欺压的人蒙羞回去。要叫困苦穷乏的人赞美你的名。

chapters.en: Rise up, O God, and defend your cause; remember how fools mock you all day long.
chapters.zh: 神阿，求你起来，为自己伸诉。要记念愚顽人怎样终日辱骂你。

chapters.en: Do not ignore the clamor of your adversaries, the uproar of your enemies, which rises continually.
chapters.zh: 不要忘记你敌人的声音。那起来敌你之人的喧哗时常上升。

chapters.en: We praise you, God, we praise you, for your Name is near; people tell of your wonderful deeds.
chapters.zh: （亚萨的诗歌，交与伶长，调用休要毁坏。）神阿，我们称谢你，我们称谢你，因为你的名相近，人都述说你奇妙的作为。

chapters.en: You say, “I choose the appointed time; it is I who judge with equity.
chapters.zh: 我到了所定的日期，必按正直施行审判。

chapters.en: When the earth and all its people quake, it is I who hold its pillars firm.
chapters.zh: 地和其上的居民，都消化了。我曾立了地的柱子。（细拉）

chapters.en: To the arrogant I say, ‘Boast no more,’ and to the wicked, ‘Do not lift up your horns.
chapters.zh: 我对狂傲人说，不要行事狂傲。对凶恶人说，不要举角。

chapters.en: Do not lift your horns against heaven; do not speak so defiantly.’ ”
chapters.zh: 不要把你们的角高举。不要挺着颈项说话。

chapters.en: No one from the east or the west or from the desert can exalt themselves.
chapters.zh: 因为高举非从东，非从西，也非从南而来。

chapters.en: It is God who judges: He brings one down, he exalts another.
chapters.zh: 惟有神断定。他使这人降卑，使那人升高。

chapters.en: In the hand of the LORD is a cup full of foaming wine mixed with spices; he pours it out, and all the wicked of the earth drink it down to its very dregs.
chapters.zh: 耶和华手里有杯。其中的酒起沫。杯内满了搀杂的酒。他倒出来。地上的恶人必都喝这酒的渣滓，而且喝尽。

chapters.en: As for me, I will declare this forever; I will sing praise to the God of Jacob,
chapters.zh: 但我要宣扬，直到永远。我要歌颂雅各的神。

chapters.en: who says, “I will cut off the horns of all the wicked, but the horns of the righteous will be lifted up.”
chapters.zh: 恶人一切的角，我要砍断。惟有义人的角，必被高举。

chapters.en: God is renowned in Judah; in Israel his name is great.
chapters.zh: （亚萨的诗歌，交与伶长，用丝弦的乐器。）在犹大神为人所认识。在以色列他的名为大。

chapters.en: His tent is in Salem, his dwelling place in Zion.
chapters.zh: 在撒冷有他的帐幕，在锡安有他的居所。

chapters.en: There he broke the flashing arrows, the shields and the swords, the weapons of war.
chapters.zh: 他在那里折断弓上的火箭，并盾牌，刀剑，和争战的兵器。（细拉）

chapters.en: You are radiant with light, more majestic than mountains rich with game.
chapters.zh: 你从有野食之山而来，有光华和荣美。

chapters.en: The valiant lie plundered, they sleep their last sleep; not one of the warriors can lift his hands.
chapters.zh: 心中勇敢的人，都被抢夺。他们睡了长觉。没有一个英雄能措手。

chapters.en: At your rebuke, God of Jacob, both horse and chariot lie still.
chapters.zh: 雅各的神阿，你的斥责一发坐车的，骑马的，都沉睡了。

chapters.en: It is you alone who are to be feared. Who can stand before you when you are angry?
chapters.zh: 惟独你是可畏的。你怒气一发，谁能在你面前站得住呢？

chapters.en: From heaven you pronounced judgment, and the land feared and was quiet—
chapters.zh: 你从天上使人听判断。神起来施行审判，要救地上一切谦卑的人。那时地就惧怕而静默。（细拉）

chapters.en: when you, God, rose up to judge, to save all the afflicted of the land.
Surely your wrath against mankind brings you praise, and the survivors of your wrath are restrained.
chapters.zh: 人的忿怒，要成全你的荣美。人的余怒，你要禁止。

chapters.en: Make vows to the LORD your God and fulfill them; let all the neighboring lands bring gifts to the One to be feared.
chapters.zh: 你们许愿，当向耶和华你们的神还愿。在他四面的人，都当拿贡物献给那可畏的主。

chapters.en: He breaks the spirit of rulers; he is feared by the kings of the earth.
chapters.zh: 他要挫折王子的骄气。他向地上的君王，显威可畏。

chapters.en: I cried out to God for help; I cried out to God to hear me.
chapters.zh: （亚萨的诗，照耶杜顿的作法，交与伶长。）我要向神发声呼求。我向神发声，他必留心听我。

chapters.en: When I was in distress, I sought the Lord; at night I stretched out untiring hands, and I would not be comforted.
chapters.zh: 我在患难之日寻求主。我在夜间不住地举手祷告。我的心不肯受安慰。

chapters.en: I remembered you, God, and I groaned; I meditated, and my spirit grew faint.
chapters.zh: 我想念神，就烦躁不安。我沉吟悲伤，心便发昏。（细拉）

chapters.en: You kept my eyes from closing; I was too troubled to speak.
chapters.zh: 你叫我不能闭眼。我烦乱不安，甚至不能说话。

chapters.en: I thought about the former days, the years of long ago;
chapters.zh: 我追想古时之日，上古之年。

chapters.en: I remembered my songs in the night. My heart meditated and my spirit asked:
chapters.zh: 我想起我夜间的歌曲，扪心自问。我心里也仔细省察。

chapters.en: “Will the Lord reject forever? Will he never show his favor again?
chapters.zh: 难道主要永远丢弃我，不再施恩吗？

chapters.en: Has his unfailing love vanished forever? Has his promise failed for all time?
chapters.zh: 难道他的慈爱永远穷尽，他的应许世世废弃吗？

chapters.en: Has God forgotten to be merciful? Has he in anger withheld his compassion?”
chapters.zh: 难道神忘记开恩。因发怒就止住他的慈悲吗？（细拉）

chapters.en: Then I thought, “To this I will appeal: the years when the Most High stretched out his right hand.
chapters.zh: 我便说，这是我的懦弱。但我要追念至高者显出右手之年代。

chapters.en: I will remember the deeds of the LORD; yes, I will remember your miracles of long ago.
chapters.zh: 我要提说耶和华所行的。我要记念你古时的奇事。

chapters.en: I will consider all your works and meditate on all your mighty deeds.”
chapters.zh: 我也要思想你的经营，默念你的作为。

chapters.en: Your ways, God, are holy. What god is as great as our God?
chapters.zh: 神阿，你的作为是洁净的。有何神大如神呢？

chapters.en: You are the God who performs miracles; you display your power among the peoples.
chapters.zh: 你是行奇事的神。你曾在列邦中彰显你的能力。

chapters.en: With your mighty arm you redeemed your people, the descendants of Jacob and Joseph.
chapters.zh: 你曾用你的膀臂赎了你的民，就是雅各和约瑟的子孙。（细拉）

chapters.en: The waters saw you, God, the waters saw you and writhed; the very depths were convulsed.
chapters.zh: 神阿，诸水见你，一见就都惊惶。深渊也都战抖。

chapters.en: The clouds poured down water, the heavens resounded with thunder; your arrows flashed back and forth.
chapters.zh: 云中倒出水来。天空发出响声。你的箭也飞行四方。

chapters.en: Your thunder was heard in the whirlwind, your lightning lit up the world; the earth trembled and quaked.
chapters.zh: 你的雷声在旋风中。电光照亮世界。大地战抖震动。

chapters.en: Your path led through the sea, your way through the mighty waters, though your footprints were not seen.
chapters.zh: 你的道在海中，你的路在大水中，你的脚踪无人知道。

chapters.en: You led your people like a flock by the hand of Moses and Aaron.
chapters.zh: 你曾借摩西和亚伦的手，引导你的百姓，好像羊群一般。

chapters.en: My people, hear my teaching; listen to the words of my mouth.
chapters.zh: （亚萨的训诲诗。）我的民哪，你们要留心听我的训诲，侧耳听我口中的话。

chapters.en: I will open my mouth with a parable; I will utter hidden things, things from of old—
chapters.zh: 我要开口说比喻。我要说出古时的谜语。

chapters.en: things we have heard and known, things our ancestors have told us.
chapters.zh: 是我们所听见所知道的，也是我们的祖宗告诉我们的。

chapters.en: We will not hide them from their descendants; we will tell the next generation the praiseworthy deeds of the LORD, his power, and the wonders he has done.
chapters.zh: 我们不将这些事向他们的子孙隐瞒。要将耶和华的美德和他的能力，并他奇妙的作为，述说给后代听。

chapters.en: He decreed statutes for Jacob and established the law in Israel, which he commanded our ancestors to teach their children,
chapters.zh: 因为他在雅各中立法度，在以色列中设律法，是他吩咐我们祖宗，要传给子孙的。

chapters.en: so the next generation would know them, even the children yet to be born, and they in turn would tell their children.
chapters.zh: 使将要生的后代子孙，可以晓得。他们也要起来告诉他们的子孙。

chapters.en: Then they would put their trust in God and would not forget his deeds but would keep his commands.
chapters.zh: 好叫他们仰望神，不忘记神的作为。惟要守他的命令。

chapters.en: They would not be like their ancestors— a stubborn and rebellious generation, whose hearts were not loyal to God, whose spirits were not faithful to him.
chapters.zh: 不要像他们的祖宗，是顽梗悖逆居心不正之辈，向着神心不诚实。

chapters.en: The men of Ephraim, though armed with bows, turned back on the day of battle;
chapters.zh: 以法莲的子孙，带着兵器，拿着弓，临阵之日，转身退后。

chapters.en: they did not keep God’s covenant and refused to live by his law.
chapters.zh: 他们不遵守神的约，不肯照他的律法行。

chapters.en: They forgot what he had done, the wonders he had shown them.
chapters.zh: 又忘记他所行的，和他显给他们奇妙的作为。

chapters.en: He did miracles in the sight of their ancestors in the land of Egypt, in the region of Zoan.
chapters.zh: 他在埃及地，在琐安田，在他们祖宗的眼前，施行奇事。

chapters.en: He divided the sea and led them through; he made the water stand up like a wall.
chapters.zh: 他将海分裂，使他们过去。又叫水立起如垒。

chapters.en: He guided them with the cloud by day and with light from the fire all night.
chapters.zh: 他白日用云彩，终夜用火光，引导他们。

chapters.en: He split the rocks in the wilderness and gave them water as abundant as the seas;
chapters.zh: 他在旷野分裂磐石，多多地给他们水喝，如从深渊而出。

chapters.en: he brought streams out of a rocky crag and made water flow down like rivers.
chapters.zh: 他使水从磐石涌出，叫水如江河下流。

chapters.en: But they continued to sin against him, rebelling in the wilderness against the Most High.
chapters.zh: 他们却仍旧得罪他，在干燥之地悖逆至高者。

chapters.en: They willfully put God to the test by demanding the food they craved.
chapters.zh: 他们心中试探神，随自己所欲的求食物。

chapters.en: They spoke against God; they said, “Can God really spread a table in the wilderness?
chapters.zh: 并且妄论神，说，神在旷野岂能摆设筵席吗？

chapters.en: True, he struck the rock, and water gushed out, streams flowed abundantly, but can he also give us bread? Can he supply meat for his people?”
chapters.zh: 他曾击打磐石，使水涌出，成了江河。他还能赐粮食吗？还能为他的百姓预备肉吗？

chapters.en: When the LORD heard them, he was furious; his fire broke out against Jacob, and his wrath rose against Israel,
chapters.zh: 所以耶和华听见，就发怒。有烈火向雅各烧起，有怒气向以色列上腾。

chapters.en: for they did not believe in God or trust in his deliverance.
chapters.zh: 因为他们不信服神，不倚赖他的救恩。

chapters.en: Yet he gave a command to the skies above and opened the doors of the heavens;
chapters.zh: 他却吩咐天空，又敞开天上的门。

chapters.en: he rained down manna for the people to eat, he gave them the grain of heaven.
chapters.zh: 降吗哪像雨给他们吃，将天上的粮食赐给他们。

chapters.en: Human beings ate the bread of angels; he sent them all the food they could eat.
chapters.zh: 各人（或作人）吃大能者的食物。他赐下粮食，使他们饱足。

chapters.en: He let loose the east wind from the heavens and by his power made the south wind blow.
chapters.zh: 他领东风起在天空，又用能力引了南风来。

chapters.en: He rained meat down on them like dust, birds like sand on the seashore.
chapters.zh: 他降肉像雨在他们当中，多如尘土，又降飞鸟，多如海沙。

chapters.en: He made them come down inside their camp, all around their tents.
chapters.zh: 落在他们的营中，在他们住处的四面。

chapters.en: They ate till they were gorged— he had given them what they craved.
chapters.zh: 他们吃了，而且饱足。这样，就随了他们所欲的。

chapters.en: But before they turned from what they craved, even while the food was still in their mouths,
chapters.zh: 他们贪而无厌，食物还在他们口中的时候，

chapters.en: God’s anger rose against them; he put to death the sturdiest among them, cutting down the young men of Israel.
chapters.zh: 神的怒气，就向他们上腾，杀了他们内中的肥壮人。打倒以色列的少年人。

chapters.en: In spite of all this, they kept on sinning; in spite of his wonders, they did not believe.
chapters.zh: 虽是这样，他们仍旧犯罪，不信他奇妙的作为。

chapters.en: So he ended their days in futility and their years in terror.
chapters.zh: 因此他叫他们的日子，全归虚空，叫他们的年岁，尽属惊恐。

chapters.en: Whenever God slew them, they would seek him; they eagerly turned to him again.
chapters.zh: 他杀他们的时候，他们才求问他，回心转意，切切地寻求神。

chapters.en: They remembered that God was their Rock, that God Most High was their Redeemer.
chapters.zh: 他们也追念神是他们的磐石，至高的神，是他们的救赎主。

chapters.en: But then they would flatter him with their mouths, lying to him with their tongues;
chapters.zh: 他们却用口谄媚他，用舌向他说谎。

chapters.en: their hearts were not loyal to him, they were not faithful to his covenant.
chapters.zh: 因他们的心向他不正，在他的约上，也不忠心。

chapters.en: Yet he was merciful; he forgave their iniquities and did not destroy them. Time after time he restrained his anger and did not stir up his full wrath.
chapters.zh: 但他有怜悯，赦免他们的罪孽，不灭绝他们。而且屡次消他的怒气，不发尽他的忿怒。

chapters.en: He remembered that they were but flesh, a passing breeze that does not return.
chapters.zh: 他想到他们不过是血气，是一阵去而不返的风。

chapters.en: How often they rebelled against him in the wilderness and grieved him in the wasteland!
chapters.zh: 他们在旷野悖逆他，在荒地叫他担忧，何其多呢？

chapters.en: Again and again they put God to the test; they vexed the Holy One of Israel.
chapters.zh: 他们再三试探神，惹动以色列的圣者。

chapters.en: They did not remember his power— the day he redeemed them from the oppressor,
chapters.zh: 他们不追念他的能力（原文作手），和赎他们脱离敌人的日子。

chapters.en: the day he displayed his signs in Egypt, his wonders in the region of Zoan.
chapters.zh: 他怎样在埃及地显神迹，在琐安田显奇事。

chapters.en: He turned their river into blood; they could not drink from their streams.
chapters.zh: 把他们的江河，并河汊的水，都变为血，使他们不能喝。

chapters.en: He sent swarms of flies that devoured them, and frogs that devastated them.
chapters.zh: 他叫苍蝇成群，落在他们当中，嘬尽他们。又叫青蛙灭了他们。

chapters.en: He gave their crops to the grasshopper, their produce to the locust.
chapters.zh: 把他们的土产交给蚂蚱，把他们辛苦得来的交给蝗虫。

chapters.en: He destroyed their vines with hail and their sycamore-figs with sleet.
chapters.zh: 他降冰雹打坏他们的葡萄树。下严霜打坏他们的桑树。

chapters.en: He gave over their cattle to the hail, their livestock to bolts of lightning.
chapters.zh: 又把他们的牲畜交给冰雹，把他们的群畜交给闪电。

chapters.en: He unleashed against them his hot anger, his wrath, indignation and hostility— a band of destroying angels.
chapters.zh: 他使猛烈的怒气，和忿怒，恼恨，苦难，成了一群降灾的使者，临到他们。

chapters.en: He prepared a path for his anger; he did not spare them from death but gave them over to the plague.
chapters.zh: 他为自己的怒气修平了路，将他们交给瘟疫，使他们死亡。

chapters.en: He struck down all the firstborn of Egypt, the firstfruits of manhood in the tents of Ham.
chapters.zh: 在埃及击杀一切长子，在含的帐棚中，击杀他们强壮时头生的。

chapters.en: But he brought his people out like a flock; he led them like sheep through the wilderness.
chapters.zh: 他却领出自己的民如羊，在旷野引他们如羊群。

chapters.en: He guided them safely, so they were unafraid; but the sea engulfed their enemies.
chapters.zh: 他领他们稳稳妥妥的，使他们不至害怕。海却淹没他们的仇敌。

chapters.en: And so he brought them to the border of his holy land, to the hill country his right hand had taken.
chapters.zh: 他带他们到自己圣地的边界，到他右手所得的这山地。

chapters.en: He drove out nations before them and allotted their lands to them as an inheritance; he settled the tribes of Israel in their homes.
chapters.zh: 他在他们面前赶出外邦人，用绳子将外邦的地量给他们为业，叫以色列支派的人，住在他们的帐棚里。

chapters.en: But they put God to the test and rebelled against the Most High; they did not keep his statutes.
chapters.zh: 他们仍旧试探悖逆至高的神，不守他的法度。

chapters.en: Like their ancestors they were disloyal and faithless, as unreliable as a faulty bow.
chapters.zh: 反倒退后，行诡诈，像他们的祖宗一样。他们改变，如同翻背的弓。

chapters.en: They angered him with their high places; they aroused his jealousy with their idols.
chapters.zh: 因他们的丘坛，惹了他的怒气，因他们雕刻的偶像，触动他的愤恨。

chapters.en: When God heard them, he was furious; he rejected Israel completely.
chapters.zh: 神听见，就发怒，极其憎恶以色列人。

chapters.en: He abandoned the tabernacle of Shiloh, the tent he had set up among humans.
chapters.zh: 甚至他离弃示罗的帐幕，就是他在人间所搭的帐棚。

chapters.en: He sent the ark of his might into captivity, his splendor into the hands of the enemy.
chapters.zh: 又将他的约柜（原文作能力）交与人掳去，将他的荣耀交在敌人手中。

chapters.en: He gave his people over to the sword; he was furious with his inheritance.
chapters.zh: 并将他的百姓交与刀剑，向他的产业发怒。

chapters.en: Fire consumed their young men, and their young women had no wedding songs;
chapters.zh: 少年人被火烧灭。处女也无喜歌。

chapters.en: their priests were put to the sword, and their widows could not weep.
chapters.zh: 祭司倒在刀下。寡妇却不哀哭。

chapters.en: Then the Lord awoke as from sleep, as a warrior wakes from the stupor of wine.
chapters.zh: 那时主像世人睡醒，像勇士饮酒呼喊。

chapters.en: He beat back his enemies; he put them to everlasting shame.
chapters.zh: 他就打退了他的敌人，叫他们永蒙羞辱。

chapters.en: Then he rejected the tents of Joseph, he did not choose the tribe of Ephraim;
chapters.zh: 并且他弃掉约瑟的帐棚，不拣选以法莲支派，

chapters.en: but he chose the tribe of Judah, Mount Zion, which he loved.
chapters.zh: 却拣选犹大支派，他所喜爱的锡安山。

chapters.en: He built his sanctuary like the heights, like the earth that he established forever.
chapters.zh: 盖造他的圣所，好像高峰，又像他建立永存之地。

chapters.en: He chose David his servant and took him from the sheep pens;
chapters.zh: 又拣选他的仆人大卫，从羊圈中将他召来。

chapters.en: from tending the sheep he brought him to be the shepherd of his people Jacob, of Israel his inheritance.
chapters.zh: 叫他不再跟从那些带奶的母羊，为要牧养自己的百姓雅各，和自己的产业以色列。

chapters.en: And David shepherded them with integrity of heart; with skillful hands he led them.
chapters.zh: 于是他按心中的纯正，牧养他们，用手中的巧妙，引导他们。

chapters.en: O God, the nations have invaded your inheritance; they have defiled your holy temple, they have reduced Jerusalem to rubble.
chapters.zh: （亚萨的诗。）神阿，外邦人进入你的产业，污秽你的圣殿，使耶路撒冷变成荒堆。

chapters.en: They have left the dead bodies of your servants as food for the birds of the sky, the flesh of your own people for the animals of the wild.
chapters.zh: 把你仆人的尸首，交与天空的飞鸟为食，把你圣民的肉，交与地上的野兽。

chapters.en: They have poured out blood like water all around Jerusalem, and there is no one to bury the dead.
chapters.zh: 在耶路撒冷周围流他们的血如水，无人葬埋。

chapters.en: We are objects of contempt to our neighbors, of scorn and derision to those around us.
chapters.zh: 我们成为邻国的羞辱，成为我们四围人的嗤笑讥刺。

chapters.en: How long, LORD? Will you be angry forever? How long will your jealousy burn like fire?
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，这到几时呢？你要动怒到永远吗？你的愤恨要如火焚烧吗？

chapters.en: Pour out your wrath on the nations that do not acknowledge you, on the kingdoms that do not call on your name;
chapters.zh: 愿你将你的忿怒倒在那不认识你的外邦，和那不求告你名的国度。

chapters.en: for they have devoured Jacob and devastated his homeland.
chapters.zh: 因为他们吞了雅各，把他的住处变为荒场。

chapters.en: Do not hold against us the sins of past generations; may your mercy come quickly to meet us, for we are in desperate need.
chapters.zh: 求你不要记念我们先祖的罪孽，向我们追讨。愿你的慈悲快迎着我们。因为我们落到极卑微的地步。

chapters.en: Help us, God our Savior, for the glory of your name; deliver us and forgive our sins for your name’s sake.
chapters.zh: 拯救我们的神阿，求你因你名的荣耀，帮助我们，为你名的缘故，搭救我们，赦免我们的罪。

chapters.en: Why should the nations say, “Where is their God?” Before our eyes, make known among the nations that you avenge the outpoured blood of your servants.
chapters.zh: 为何容外邦人说，他们的神在哪里呢？愿你使外邦人知道你在我们眼前，伸你仆人流血的冤。

chapters.en: May the groans of the prisoners come before you; with your strong arm preserve those condemned to die.
chapters.zh: 愿被囚之人的叹息，达到你面前。愿你按你的大能力，存留那些将要死的人。

chapters.en: Pay back into the laps of our neighbors seven times the contempt they have hurled at you, Lord.
chapters.zh: 主阿，愿你将我们邻邦所羞辱你的羞辱，加七倍归到他们身上。

chapters.en: Then we your people, the sheep of your pasture, will praise you forever; from generation to generation we will proclaim your praise.
chapters.zh: 这样，你的民，你草场的羊，要称谢你，直到永远。要述说赞美你的话，直到万代。

chapters.en: Hear us, Shepherd of Israel, you who lead Joseph like a flock. You who sit enthroned between the cherubim, shine forth
chapters.zh: （亚萨的诗，交与伶长，调用为证的百合花。）领约瑟如领羊群之以色列的牧者阿，求你留心听。坐在二基路伯上的阿，求你发出光来。

chapters.en: before Ephraim, Benjamin and Manasseh. Awaken your might; come and save us.
chapters.zh: 在以法莲便雅悯玛拿西前面施展你的大能，来救我们。

chapters.en: Restore us, O God; make your face shine on us, that we may be saved.
chapters.zh: 神阿，求你使我们回转（回转或作复兴），使你的脸发光，我们便要得救。

chapters.en: How long, LORD God Almighty, will your anger smolder against the prayers of your people?
chapters.zh: 耶和华万军之神阿，你向你百姓的祷告发怒，要到几时呢？

chapters.en: You have fed them with the bread of tears; you have made them drink tears by the bowlful.
chapters.zh: 你以眼泪当食物给他们吃，又多量出眼泪给他们喝。

chapters.en: You have made us an object of derision to our neighbors, and our enemies mock us.
chapters.zh: 你使邻邦因我们分争。我们的仇敌彼此戏笑。

chapters.en: Restore us, God Almighty; make your face shine on us, that we may be saved.
chapters.zh: 万军之神阿，求你使我们回转，使你的脸发光，我们便要得救。

chapters.en: You transplanted a vine from Egypt; you drove out the nations and planted it.
chapters.zh: 你从埃及挪出一棵葡萄树，赶出外邦人，把这树栽上。

chapters.en: You cleared the ground for it, and it took root and filled the land.
chapters.zh: 你在这树根前预备了地方，他就深深扎根，爬满了地。

chapters.en: The mountains were covered with its shade, the mighty cedars with its branches.
chapters.zh: 他的影子遮满了山，枝子好像佳美的香柏树。

chapters.en: Its branches reached as far as the Sea,its shoots as far as the River.
chapters.zh: 他发出枝子，长到大海，发出蔓子，延到大河。

chapters.en: Why have you broken down its walls so that all who pass by pick its grapes?
chapters.zh: 你为何拆毁这树的篱笆，任凭一切过路的人摘取。

chapters.en: Boars from the forest ravage it, and insects from the fields feed on it.
chapters.zh: 林中出来的野猪，把他糟踏，野地的走兽，拿他当食物。

chapters.en: Return to us, God Almighty! Look down from heaven and see! Watch over this vine,
chapters.zh: 万军之神阿，求你回转，从天上垂看，眷顾这葡萄树，

chapters.en: the root your right hand has planted, the son you have raised up for yourself.
chapters.zh: 保护你右手所栽的，和你为自己所坚固的枝子。

chapters.en: Your vine is cut down, it is burned with fire; at your rebuke your people perish.
chapters.zh: 这树已经被火焚烧被刀砍伐，他们因你脸上的怒容就灭亡了。

chapters.en: Let your hand rest on the man at your right hand, the son of man you have raised up for yourself.
chapters.zh: 愿你的手扶持你右边的人，就是你为自己所坚固的人子。

chapters.en: Then we will not turn away from you; revive us, and we will call on your name.
chapters.zh: 这样，我们便不退后离开你。求你救活我们，我们就要求告你的名。

chapters.en: Restore us, LORD God Almighty; make your face shine on us, that we may be saved.
chapters.zh: 耶和华万军之神阿，求你使我们回转，使你的脸发光，我们便要得救。

chapters.en: Sing for joy to God our strength; shout aloud to the God of Jacob!
chapters.zh: （亚萨的诗，交与伶长。用迦特乐器。）你们当向神我们的力量大声欢呼，向雅各的神发声欢乐，

chapters.en: Begin the music, strike the timbrel, play the melodious harp and lyre.
chapters.zh: 唱起诗歌，打手鼓，弹美琴与瑟。

chapters.en: Sound the ram’s horn at the New Moon, and when the moon is full, on the day of our festival;
chapters.zh: 当在月朔，并月望，我们过节的日期，吹角。

chapters.en: this is a decree for Israel, an ordinance of the God of Jacob.
chapters.zh: 因这是为以色列定的律例，是雅各神的典章。

chapters.en: When God went out against Egypt, he established it as a statute for Joseph. I heard an unknown voice say:
chapters.zh: 他去攻击埃及地的时候，在约瑟中间立此为证。我在那里听见我所不明白的言语。

chapters.en: “I removed the burden from their shoulders; their hands were set free from the basket.
chapters.zh: 神说，我使你的肩得脱重担，你的手放下筐子。

chapters.en: In your distress you called and I rescued you, I answered you out of a thundercloud; I tested you at the waters of Meribah.
chapters.zh: 你在急难中呼求，我就搭救你。我在雷的隐密处应允你，在米利巴水那里试验你。（细拉）

chapters.en: Hear me, my people, and I will warn you— if you would only listen to me, Israel!
chapters.zh: 我的民哪，你当听。我要劝戒你。以色列阿，甚愿你肯听从我。

chapters.en: You shall have no foreign god among you; you shall not worship any god other than me.
chapters.zh: 在你当中不可有别的神。外邦的神，你也不可下拜。

chapters.en: I am the LORD your God, who brought you up out of Egypt. Open wide your mouth and I will fill it.
chapters.zh: 我是耶和华你的神，曾把你从埃及地领上来。你要大大张口，我就给你充满。

chapters.en: “But my people would not listen to me; Israel would not submit to me.
chapters.zh: 无奈我的民不听我的声音。以色列全不理我。

chapters.en: So I gave them over to their stubborn hearts to follow their own devices.
chapters.zh: 我便任凭他们心里刚硬，随自己的计谋而行。

chapters.en: “If my people would only listen to me, if Israel would only follow my ways,
chapters.zh: 甚愿我的民肯听从我，以色列肯行我的道。

chapters.en: how quickly I would subdue their enemies and turn my hand against their foes!
chapters.zh: 我便速速治服他们的仇敌，反手攻击他们的敌人。

chapters.en: Those who hate the LORD would cringe before him, and their punishment would last forever.
chapters.zh: 恨耶和华的人必来投降，但他的百姓，必永久长存。

chapters.en: But you would be fed with the finest of wheat; with honey from the rock I would satisfy you.”
chapters.zh: 他也必拿上好的麦子给他们吃。又拿从磐石出的蜂蜜，叫他们饱足。

chapters.en: God presides in the great assembly; he renders judgment among the “gods”:
chapters.zh: （亚萨的诗。）神站在有权力者的会中。在诸神中行审判。

chapters.en: “How long will you defend the unjust and show partiality to the wicked?
chapters.zh: 说，你们审判不秉公义，徇恶人的情面，要到几时呢？（细拉）

chapters.en: Defend the weak and the fatherless; uphold the cause of the poor and the oppressed.
chapters.zh: 你们当为贫寒的人和孤儿伸冤。当为困苦和穷乏的人施行公义。

chapters.en: Rescue the weak and the needy; deliver them from the hand of the wicked.
chapters.zh: 当保护贫寒和穷乏的人，救他们脱离恶人的手。

chapters.en: “The ‘gods’ know nothing, they understand nothing. They walk about in darkness; all the foundations of the earth are shaken.
chapters.zh: 你们仍不知道，也不明白，在黑暗中走来走去。地的根基都摇动了。

chapters.en: “I said, ‘You are “gods”; you are all sons of the Most High.’
chapters.zh: 我曾说，你们是神，都是至高者的儿子。

chapters.en: But you will die like mere mortals; you will fall like every other ruler.”
chapters.zh: 然而你们要死，与世人一样。要仆倒，像王子中的一位。

chapters.en: Rise up, O God, judge the earth, for all the nations are your inheritance.
chapters.zh: 神阿，求你起来，审判世界。因为你要得万邦为业。

chapters.en: O God, do not remain silent; do not turn a deaf ear, do not stand aloof, O God.
chapters.zh: （亚萨的诗歌。）神阿，求你不要静默。神阿，求你不要闭口，也不要不作声。

chapters.en: See how your enemies growl, how your foes rear their heads.
chapters.zh: 因为你的仇敌喧嚷。恨你的抬起头来。

chapters.en: With cunning they conspire against your people; they plot against those you cherish.
chapters.zh: 他们同谋奸诈，要害你的百姓，彼此商议，要害你所隐藏的人。

chapters.en: “Come,” they say, “let us destroy them as a nation, so that Israel’s name is remembered no more.”
chapters.zh: 他们说，来吧，我们将他们剪灭，使他们不再成国。使以色列的名，不再被人记念。

chapters.en: With one mind they plot together; they form an alliance against you—
chapters.zh: 他们同心商议，彼此结盟，要抵挡你。

chapters.en: the tents of Edom and the Ishmaelites, of Moab and the Hagrites,
chapters.zh: 就是住帐棚的以东人，和以实玛利人。摩押和夏甲人。

chapters.en: Byblos, Ammon and Amalek, Philistia, with the people of Tyre.
chapters.zh: 迦巴勒，亚扪，和亚玛力，非利士，并推罗的居民。

chapters.en: Even Assyria has joined them to reinforce Lot’s descendants.
chapters.zh: 亚述也与他们连合。他们作罗得子孙的帮手。（细拉）

chapters.en: Do to them as you did to Midian, as you did to Sisera and Jabin at the river Kishon,
chapters.zh: 求你待他们如待米甸，如在基顺河待西西拉和耶宾一样。

chapters.en: who perished at Endor and became like dung on the ground.
chapters.zh: 他们在隐多珥灭亡，成了地上的粪土。

chapters.en: Make their nobles like Oreb and Zeeb, all their princes like Zebah and Zalmunna,
chapters.zh: 求你叫他们的首领，像俄立和西伊伯，叫他们的王子，都像西巴和撒慕拿。

chapters.en: who said, “Let us take possession of the pasturelands of God.”
chapters.zh: 他们说，我们要得神的住处，作为自己的产业。

chapters.en: Make them like tumbleweed, my God, like chaff before the wind.
chapters.zh: 我的神阿，求你叫他们像旋风的尘土，像风前的碎秸。

chapters.en: As fire consumes the forest or a flame sets the mountains ablaze,
chapters.zh: 火怎样焚烧树林，火焰怎样烧着山岭。

chapters.en: so pursue them with your tempest and terrify them with your storm.
chapters.zh: 求你也照样用狂风追赶他们，用暴雨恐吓他们。

chapters.en: Cover their faces with shame, LORD, so that they will seek your name.
chapters.zh: 愿你使他们满面羞耻，好叫他们寻求你耶和华的名。

chapters.en: May they ever be ashamed and dismayed; may they perish in disgrace.
chapters.zh: 愿他们永远羞愧惊惶。愿他们惭愧灭亡。

chapters.en: Let them know that you, whose name is the LORD— that you alone are the Most High over all the earth.
chapters.zh: 使他们知道惟独你名为耶和华的，是全地以上的至高者。

chapters.en: How lovely is your dwelling place, LORD Almighty!
chapters.zh: （可拉后裔的诗，交与伶长。用迦特乐器。）万军之耶和华阿，你的居所何等可爱。

chapters.en: My soul yearns, even faints, for the courts of the LORD; my heart and my flesh cry out for the living God.
chapters.zh: 我羡慕渴想耶和华的院宇。我的心肠，我的肉体，向永生神呼吁（或作欢呼）。

chapters.en: Even the sparrow has found a home, and the swallow a nest for herself, where she may have her young— a place near your altar, LORD Almighty, my King and my God.
chapters.zh: 万军之耶和华我的王，我的神阿，在你祭坛那里，麻雀为自己找着房屋。燕子为自己找着抱雏之窝。

chapters.en: Blessed are those who dwell in your house; they are ever praising you.
chapters.zh: 如此住在你殿中的，便为有福。他们仍要赞美你。（细拉）

chapters.en: Blessed are those whose strength is in you, whose hearts are set on pilgrimage.
chapters.zh: 靠你有力量心中想往锡安大道的，这人便为有福。

chapters.en: As they pass through the Valley of Baka, they make it a place of springs; the autumn rains also cover it with pools.
chapters.zh: 他们经过流泪谷，叫这谷变为泉源之地。并有秋雨之福，盖满了全谷。

chapters.en: They go from strength to strength, till each appears before God in Zion.
chapters.zh: 他们行走，力上加力，各人到锡安朝见神。

chapters.en: Hear my prayer, LORD God Almighty; listen to me, God of Jacob.
chapters.zh: 耶和华万军之神阿，求你听我的祷告。雅各的神阿，求你留心听。（细拉）

chapters.en: Look on our shield, O God; look with favor on your anointed one.
chapters.zh: 神阿，你是我们的盾牌。求你垂顾观看你受膏者的面。

chapters.en: Better is one day in your courts than a thousand elsewhere; I would rather be a doorkeeper in the house of my God than dwell in the tents of the wicked.
chapters.zh: 在你的院宇住一日，胜似在别处住千日。宁可在我神殿中看门，不愿住在恶人的帐棚里。

chapters.en: For the LORD God is a sun and shield; the LORD bestows favor and honor; no good thing does he withhold from those whose walk is blameless.
chapters.zh: 因为耶和华神是日头，是盾牌，要赐下恩惠和荣耀。他未尝留下一样好处，不给那些行动正直的人。

chapters.en: LORD Almighty, blessed is the one who trusts in you.
chapters.zh: 万军之耶和华阿，倚靠你的人，便为有福。

chapters.en: You, LORD, showed favor to your land; you restored the fortunes of Jacob.
chapters.zh: （可拉后裔的诗，交与伶长。）耶和华阿，你已经向你的地施恩，救回被掳的雅各。

chapters.en: You forgave the iniquity of your people and covered all their sins.
chapters.zh: 你赦免了你百姓的罪孽，遮盖了他们一切的过犯。（细拉）

chapters.en: You set aside all your wrath and turned from your fierce anger.
chapters.zh: 你收转了所发的忿怒，和你猛烈的怒气。

chapters.en: Restore us again, God our Savior, and put away your displeasure toward us.
chapters.zh: 拯救我们的神阿，求你使我们回转，叫你的恼恨向我们止息。

chapters.en: Will you be angry with us forever? Will you prolong your anger through all generations?
chapters.zh: 你要向我们发怒到永远吗？你要将你的怒气延留到万代吗？

chapters.en: Will you not revive us again, that your people may rejoice in you?
chapters.zh: 你不再将我们救活，使你的百姓靠你欢喜吗？

chapters.en: Show us your unfailing love, LORD, and grant us your salvation.
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，求你使我们得见你的慈爱，又将你的救恩赐给我们。

chapters.en: I will listen to what God the LORD says; he promises peace to his people, his faithful servants— but let them not turn to folly.
chapters.zh: 我要听神耶和华所说的话。因为他必应许将平安赐给他的百姓，他的圣民。他们却不可再转去妄行。

chapters.en: Surely his salvation is near those who fear him, that his glory may dwell in our land.
chapters.zh: 他的救恩，诚然与敬畏他的人相近，叫荣耀住在我们的地上。

chapters.en: Love and faithfulness meet together; righteousness and peace kiss each other.
chapters.zh: 慈爱和诚实，彼此相遇。公义和平安，彼此相亲。

chapters.en: Faithfulness springs forth from the earth, and righteousness looks down from heaven.
chapters.zh: 诚实从地而生，公义从天而现。

chapters.en: The LORD will indeed give what is good, and our land will yield its harvest.
chapters.zh: 耶和华必将好处赐给我们。我们的地，也要多出土产。

chapters.en: Righteousness goes before him and prepares the way for his steps.
chapters.zh: 公义要行在他面前，叫他的脚踪，成为可走的路。

chapters.en: Hear me, LORD, and answer me, for I am poor and needy.
chapters.zh: （大卫的祈祷。）耶和华阿，求你侧耳应允我，因我是困苦穷乏的。

chapters.en: Guard my life, for I am faithful to you; save your servant who trusts in you. You are my God;
chapters.zh: 求你保存我的性命。因我是虔诚人。我的神阿，求你拯救这倚靠你的仆人。

chapters.en: have mercy on me, Lord, for I call to you all day long.
chapters.zh: 主阿，求你怜悯我，因我终日求告你。

chapters.en: Bring joy to your servant, Lord, for I put my trust in you.
chapters.zh: 主阿，求你使仆人心里欢喜。因为我的心仰望你。

chapters.en: You, Lord, are forgiving and good, abounding in love to all who call to you.
chapters.zh: 主阿，你本为良善，乐意饶恕人，有丰盛的慈爱，赐给凡求告你的人。

chapters.en: Hear my prayer, LORD; listen to my cry for mercy.
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，求你留心听我的祷告，垂听我恳求的声音。

chapters.en: When I am in distress, I call to you, because you answer me.
chapters.zh: 我在患难之日要求告你。因为你必应允我。

chapters.en: Among the gods there is none like you, Lord; no deeds can compare with yours.
chapters.zh: 主阿，诸神之中，没有可比你的。你的作为也无可比。

chapters.en: All the nations you have made will come and worship before you, Lord; they will bring glory to your name.
chapters.zh: 主阿，你所造的万民，都要来敬拜你。他们也要荣耀你的名。

chapters.en: For you are great and do marvelous deeds; you alone are God.
chapters.zh: 因你为大，且行奇妙的事。惟独你是神。

chapters.en: Teach me your way, LORD, that I may rely on your faithfulness; give me an undivided heart, that I may fear your name.
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，求你将你的道指教我。我要照你的真理行。求你使我专心敬畏你的名。

chapters.en: I will praise you, Lord my God, with all my heart; I will glorify your name forever.
chapters.zh: 主我的神阿，我要一心称赞你。我要荣耀你的名，直到永远。

chapters.en: For great is your love toward me; you have delivered me from the depths, from the realm of the dead.
chapters.zh: 因为你向我发的慈爱是大的。你救了我的灵魂，免入极深的阴间。

chapters.en: Arrogant foes are attacking me, O God; ruthless people are trying to kill me— they have no regard for you.
chapters.zh: 神阿，骄傲的人起来攻击我，又有一党强横的人寻索我的命。他们没有将你放在眼中。

chapters.en: But you, Lord, are a compassionate and gracious God, slow to anger, abounding in love and faithfulness.
chapters.zh: 主阿，你是有怜悯有恩典的神，不轻易发怒，并有丰盛的慈爱和诚实。

chapters.en: Turn to me and have mercy on me; show your strength in behalf of your servant; save me, because I serve you just as my mother did.
chapters.zh: 求你向我转脸，怜恤我，将你的力量赐给仆人，救你婢女的儿子。

chapters.en: Give me a sign of your goodness, that my enemies may see it and be put to shame, for you, LORD, have helped me and comforted me.
chapters.zh: 求你向我显出恩待我的凭据，叫恨我的人看见，便羞愧，因为你耶和华帮助我，安慰我。

chapters.en: He has founded his city on the holy mountain.
chapters.zh: （可拉后裔的诗歌。）耶和华所立的根基在圣山上。

chapters.en: The LORD loves the gates of Zion more than all the other dwellings of Jacob.
chapters.zh: 他爱锡安的门，胜于爱雅各一切的住处。

chapters.en: Glorious things are said of you, city of God:
chapters.zh: 神的城阿，有荣耀的事乃指着你说的。（细拉）

chapters.en: “I will record Rahab and Babylon among those who acknowledge me— Philistia too, and Tyre, along with Cush — and will say, ‘This one was born in Zion.’ ”
chapters.zh: 我要提起拉哈伯，和巴比伦人是在认识我之中的，看哪，非利士，和推罗，并古实人，个个生在那里。

chapters.en: Indeed, of Zion it will be said, “This one and that one were born in her, and the Most High himself will establish her.”
chapters.zh: 论到锡安必说，这一个那一个都生在其中。而且至高者必亲自坚立这城。

chapters.en: The LORD will write in the register of the peoples: “This one was born in Zion.”
chapters.zh: 当耶和华记录万民的时候，他要点出这一个生在那里。（细拉）

chapters.en: As they make music they will sing, “All my fountains are in you.”
chapters.zh: 歌唱的，跳舞的，都要说，我的泉源都在你里面。

chapters.en: LORD, you are the God who saves me; day and night I cry out to you.
chapters.zh: （可拉后裔的诗歌，就是以斯拉人希幔的训诲诗，交与伶长。调用麻哈拉利暗俄。）耶和华拯救我的神阿，我昼夜在你面前呼吁。

chapters.en: May my prayer come before you; turn your ear to my cry.
chapters.zh: 愿我的祷告达到你面前。求你侧耳听我的呼求。

chapters.en: I am overwhelmed with troubles and my life draws near to death.
chapters.zh: 因为我心里满了患难，我的性命临近阴间。

chapters.en: I am counted among those who go down to the pit; I am like one without strength.
chapters.zh: 我算和下坑的人同列，如同无力的人一样。（无力或作没有帮助）

chapters.en: I am set apart with the dead, like the slain who lie in the grave, whom you remember no more, who are cut off from your care.
chapters.zh: 我被丢在死人中，好像被杀的人，躺在坟墓里。他们是你不再记念的，与你隔绝了。

chapters.en: You have put me in the lowest pit, in the darkest depths.
chapters.zh: 你把我放在极深的坑里，在黑暗地方，在深处。

chapters.en: Your wrath lies heavily on me; you have overwhelmed me with all your waves.
chapters.zh: 你的忿怒重压我身。你用一切的波浪困住我。（细拉）

chapters.en: You have taken from me my closest friends and have made me repulsive to them. I am confined and cannot escape;
chapters.zh: 你把我所认识的隔在远处，使我为他们所憎恶。我被拘困，不得出来。

chapters.en: my eyes are dim with grief. I call to you, LORD, every day; I spread out my hands to you.
chapters.zh: 我的眼睛，因困苦而干瘪。耶和华阿，我天天求告你，向你举手。

chapters.en: Do you show your wonders to the dead? Do their spirits rise up and praise you?
chapters.zh: 你岂要行奇事给死人看吗？难道阴魂还能起来称赞你吗？（细拉）

chapters.en: Is your love declared in the grave, your faithfulness in Destruction ?
chapters.zh: 岂能在坟墓里述说你的慈爱吗？岂能在灭亡中述说你的信实吗？

chapters.en: Are your wonders known in the place of darkness, or your righteous deeds in the land of oblivion?
chapters.zh: 你的奇事，岂能在幽暗里被知道吗？你的公义，岂能在忘记之地被知道吗？

chapters.en: But I cry to you for help, LORD; in the morning my prayer comes before you.
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，我呼求你。我早晨的祷告要达到你面前。

chapters.en: Why, LORD, do you reject me and hide your face from me?
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，你为何丢弃我。为何掩面不顾我。

chapters.en: From my youth I have suffered and been close to death; I have borne your terrors and am in despair.
chapters.zh: 我自幼受苦，几乎死亡。我受你的惊恐，甚至慌张。

chapters.en: Your wrath has swept over me; your terrors have destroyed me.
chapters.zh: 你的烈怒漫过我身。你的惊吓，把我剪除。

chapters.en: All day long they surround me like a flood; they have completely engulfed me.
chapters.zh: 这些终日如水环绕我，一齐都来围困我。

chapters.en: You have taken from me friend and neighbor— darkness is my closest friend.
chapters.zh: 你把我的良朋密友隔在远处，使我所认识的人，进入黑暗里。

chapters.en: I will sing of the LORD’s great love forever; with my mouth I will make your faithfulness known through all generations.
chapters.zh: （以斯拉人以探的训诲诗。）我要歌唱耶和华的慈爱，直到永远。我要用口将你的信实传与万代。

chapters.en: I will declare that your love stands firm forever, that you have established your faithfulness in heaven itself.
chapters.zh: 因我曾说，你的慈悲，必建立到永远。你的信实，必坚立在天上。

chapters.en: You said, “I have made a covenant with my chosen one, I have sworn to David my servant,
chapters.zh: 我与我所拣选的人立了约，向我的仆人大卫起了誓。

chapters.en: ‘I will establish your line forever and make your throne firm through all generations.’ ”
chapters.zh: 我要建立你的后裔，直到永远，要建立你的宝座，直到万代。

chapters.en: The heavens praise your wonders, LORD, your faithfulness too, in the assembly of the holy ones.
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，诸天要称赞你的奇事。在圣者的会中，要称赞你的信实。

chapters.en: For who in the skies above can compare with the LORD? Who is like the LORD among the heavenly beings?
chapters.zh: 在天空谁能比耶和华呢？神的众子中，谁能像耶和华呢？

chapters.en: In the council of the holy ones God is greatly feared; he is more awesome than all who surround him.
chapters.zh: 他在圣者的会中，是大有威严的神，比一切在他四围的更可畏惧。

chapters.en: Who is like you, LORD God Almighty? You, LORD, are mighty, and your faithfulness surrounds you.
chapters.zh: 耶和华万军之神阿，哪一个大能者象你耶和华？你的信实，是在你的四围。

chapters.en: You rule over the surging sea; when its waves mount up, you still them.
chapters.zh: 你管辖海的狂傲。波浪翻腾，你就使他平静了。

chapters.en: You crushed Rahab like one of the slain; with your strong arm you scattered your enemies.
chapters.zh: 你打碎了拉哈伯似乎是已杀的人。你用有能的膀臂打散了你的仇敌。

chapters.en: The heavens are yours, and yours also the earth; you founded the world and all that is in it.
chapters.zh: 天属你，地也属你。世界和其中所充满的，都为你所建立。

chapters.en: You created the north and the south; Tabor and Hermon sing for joy at your name.
chapters.zh: 南北为你所创造。他泊和黑门都因你的名欢呼。

chapters.en: Your arm is endowed with power; your hand is strong, your right hand exalted.
chapters.zh: 你有大能的膀臂。你的手有力，你的右手也高举。

chapters.en: Righteousness and justice are the foundation of your throne; love and faithfulness go before you.
chapters.zh: 公义和公平，是你宝座的根基。慈爱和诚实，行在你前面。

chapters.en: Blessed are those who have learned to acclaim you, who walk in the light of your presence, LORD.
chapters.zh: 知道向你欢呼的，那民是有福的。耶和华阿，他们在你脸上的光里行走。

chapters.en: They rejoice in your name all day long; they celebrate your righteousness.
chapters.zh: 他们因你的名终日欢乐，因你的公义得以高举。

chapters.en: For you are their glory and strength, and by your favor you exalt our horn.
chapters.zh: 你是他们力量的荣耀。因为你喜悦我们，我们的角必被高举。

chapters.en: Indeed, our shield belongs to the LORD, our king to the Holy One of Israel.
chapters.zh: 我们的盾牌属耶和华。我们的王属以色列的圣者。

chapters.en: Once you spoke in a vision, to your faithful people you said: “I have bestowed strength on a warrior; I have raised up a young man from among the people.
chapters.zh: 当时你在异象中晓谕你的圣民，说，我已把救助之力，加在那有能者的身上。我高举那从民中所拣选的。

chapters.en: I have found David my servant; with my sacred oil I have anointed him.
chapters.zh: 我寻得我的仆人大卫，用我的圣膏膏他。

chapters.en: My hand will sustain him; surely my arm will strengthen him.
chapters.zh: 我的手必使他坚立。我的膀臂也必坚固他。

chapters.en: The enemy will not get the better of him; the wicked will not oppress him.
chapters.zh: 仇敌必不勒索他，凶恶之子，也不苦害他。

chapters.en: I will crush his foes before him and strike down his adversaries.
chapters.zh: 我要在他面前打碎他的敌人，击杀那恨他的人。

chapters.en: My faithful love will be with him, and through my name his horn will be exalted.
chapters.zh: 只是我的信实，和我的慈爱，要与他同在。因我的名，他的角必被高举。

chapters.en: I will set his hand over the sea, his right hand over the rivers.
chapters.zh: 我要使他的左手伸到海上，右手伸到河上。

chapters.en: He will call out to me, ‘You are my Father, my God, the Rock my Savior.’
chapters.zh: 他要称呼我说，你是我的父是我的神，是拯救我的磐石。

chapters.en: And I will appoint him to be my firstborn, the most exalted of the kings of the earth.
chapters.zh: 我也要立他为长子，为世上最高的君王。

chapters.en: I will maintain my love to him forever, and my covenant with him will never fail.
chapters.zh: 我要为他存留我的慈爱，直到永远。我与他立的约，必要坚定。

chapters.en: I will establish his line forever, his throne as long as the heavens endure.
chapters.zh: 我也要使他的后裔，存到永远，使他的宝座，如天之久。

chapters.en: “If his sons forsake my law and do not follow my statutes,
chapters.zh: 倘若他的子孙离弃我的律法，不照我的典章行。

chapters.en: if they violate my decrees and fail to keep my commands,
chapters.zh: 背弃我的律例，不遵守我的诫命。

chapters.en: I will punish their sin with the rod, their iniquity with flogging;
chapters.zh: 我就要用杖责罚他们的过犯，用鞭责罚他们的罪孽。

chapters.en: but I will not take my love from him, nor will I ever betray my faithfulness.
chapters.zh: 只是我必不将我的慈爱，全然收回，也必不叫我的信实废弃。

chapters.en: I will not violate my covenant or alter what my lips have uttered.
chapters.zh: 我必不背弃我的约，也不改变我口中所出的。

chapters.en: Once for all, I have sworn by my holiness— and I will not lie to David—
chapters.zh: 我一次指着自己的圣洁起誓。我决不向大卫说谎。

chapters.en: that his line will continue forever and his throne endure before me like the sun;
chapters.zh: 他的后裔要存到永远，他的宝座在我面前，如日之恒一般。

chapters.en: it will be established forever like the moon, the faithful witness in the sky.”
chapters.zh: 又如月亮永远坚立，如天上确实的见证。（细拉）

chapters.en: But you have rejected, you have spurned, you have been very angry with your anointed one.
chapters.zh: 但你恼怒你的受膏者，就丢掉弃绝他。

chapters.en: You have renounced the covenant with your servant and have defiled his crown in the dust.
chapters.zh: 你厌恶了与仆人所立的约，将他的冠冕践踏于地。

chapters.en: You have broken through all his walls and reduced his strongholds to ruins.
chapters.zh: 你拆毁了他一切的篱笆。使他的保障，变为荒场。

chapters.en: All who pass by have plundered him; he has become the scorn of his neighbors.
chapters.zh: 凡过路的人，都抢夺他。他成为邻邦的羞辱。

chapters.en: You have exalted the right hand of his foes; you have made all his enemies rejoice.
chapters.zh: 你高举了他敌人的右手。你叫他一切的仇敌欢喜。

chapters.en: Indeed, you have turned back the edge of his sword and have not supported him in battle.
chapters.zh: 你叫他的刀剑卷刃，叫他在争战之中站立不住。

chapters.en: You have put an end to his splendor and cast his throne to the ground.
chapters.zh: 你使他的光辉止息，将他的宝座推倒于地。

chapters.en: You have cut short the days of his youth; you have covered him with a mantle of shame.
chapters.zh: 你减少他青年的日子。又使他蒙羞。（细拉）

chapters.en: How long, LORD? Will you hide yourself forever? How long will your wrath burn like fire?
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，这要到几时呢？你要将自己隐藏到永远吗？你的忿怒如火焚烧，要到几时呢？

chapters.en: Remember how fleeting is my life. For what futility you have created all humanity!
chapters.zh: 求你想念我的时候是何等的短少。你创造世人，要使他们归何等的虚空呢？（细拉）

chapters.en: Who can live and not see death, or who can escape the power of the grave?
chapters.zh: 谁能常活免死，救他的灵魂脱离阴间的权柄呢？（细拉）

chapters.en: Lord, where is your former great love, which in your faithfulness you swore to David?
chapters.zh: 主阿，你从前凭你的信实向大卫立誓，要施行的慈爱在哪里呢？

chapters.en: Remember, Lord, how your servant has been mocked, how I bear in my heart the taunts of all the nations,
chapters.zh: 主阿，求你记念仆人们所受的羞辱，记念我怎样将一切强盛民的羞辱存在我怀里。

chapters.en: the taunts with which your enemies, LORD, have mocked, with which they have mocked every step of your anointed one.
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，你的仇敌，用这羞辱，羞辱了你的仆人，羞辱了你受膏者的脚踪。

chapters.en: Praise be to the LORD forever! Amen and Amen.
chapters.zh: 耶和华是应当称颂的，直到永远。阿们，阿们。

chapters.en: Lord, you have been our dwelling place throughout all generations.
chapters.zh: （神人摩西的祈祷。）主阿，你世世代代作我们的居所。

chapters.en: Before the mountains were born or you brought forth the whole world, from everlasting to everlasting you are God.
chapters.zh: 诸山未曾生出，地与世界你未曾造成，从亘古到永远，你是神。

chapters.en: You turn people back to dust, saying, “Return to dust, you mortals.”
chapters.zh: 你使人归于尘土，说，你们世人要归回。

chapters.en: A thousand years in your sight are like a day that has just gone by, or like a watch in the night.
chapters.zh: 在你看来，千年如已过的昨日，又如夜间的一更。

chapters.en: Yet you sweep people away in the sleep of death— they are like the new grass of the morning:
chapters.zh: 你叫他们如水冲去。他们如睡一觉。早晨他们如生长的草。

chapters.en: In the morning it springs up new, but by evening it is dry and withered.
chapters.zh: 早晨发芽生长，晚上割下枯干。

chapters.en: We are consumed by your anger and terrified by your indignation.
chapters.zh: 我们因你的怒气而消灭，因你的忿怒而惊惶。

chapters.en: You have set our iniquities before you, our secret sins in the light of your presence.
chapters.zh: 你将我们的罪孽摆在你面前，将我们的隐恶摆在你面光之中。

chapters.en: All our days pass away under your wrath; we finish our years with a moan.
chapters.zh: 我们经过的日子，都在你震怒之下。我们度尽的年岁好像一声叹息。

chapters.en: Our days may come to seventy years, or eighty, if our strength endures; yet the best of them are but trouble and sorrow, for they quickly pass, and we fly away.
chapters.zh: 我们一生的年日是七十岁。若是强壮可到八十岁。但其中所矜夸的，不过是劳苦愁烦。转眼成空，我们便如飞而去。

chapters.en: If only we knew the power of your anger! Your wrath is as great as the fear that is your due.
chapters.zh: 谁晓得你怒气的权势？谁按着你该受的敬畏晓得你的忿怒呢？

chapters.en: Teach us to number our days, that we may gain a heart of wisdom.
chapters.zh: 求你指教我们怎样数算自己的日子，好叫我们得着智慧的心。

chapters.en: Relent, LORD! How long will it be? Have compassion on your servants.
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，我们要等到几时呢？求你转回，为你的仆人后悔。

chapters.en: Satisfy us in the morning with your unfailing love, that we may sing for joy and be glad all our days.
chapters.zh: 求你使我们早早饱得你的慈爱，好叫我们一生一世欢呼喜乐。

chapters.en: Make us glad for as many days as you have afflicted us, for as many years as we have seen trouble.
chapters.zh: 求你照着你使我们受苦的日子，和我们遭难的年岁，叫我们喜乐。

chapters.en: May your deeds be shown to your servants, your splendor to their children.
chapters.zh: 愿你的作为向你仆人显现。愿你的荣耀向他们子孙显明。

chapters.en: May the favor of the Lord our God rest on us; establish the work of our hands for us— yes, establish the work of our hands.
chapters.zh: 愿主我们神的荣美，归于我们身上。愿你坚立我们手所作的工。我们手所作的工，愿你坚立。

chapters.en: Whoever dwells in the shelter of the Most High will rest in the shadow of the Almighty.
chapters.zh: 住在至高者隐密处的，必住在全能者的荫下。

chapters.en: I will say of the LORD, “He is my refuge and my fortress, my God, in whom I trust.”
chapters.zh: 我要论到耶和华说，他是我的避难所，是我的山寨，是我的神，是我所倚靠的。

chapters.en: Surely he will save you from the fowler’s snare and from the deadly pestilence.
chapters.zh: 他必救你脱离捕鸟人的网罗，和毒害的瘟疫。

chapters.en: He will cover you with his feathers, and under his wings you will find refuge; his faithfulness will be your shield and rampart.
chapters.zh: 他必用自己的翎毛遮蔽你。你要投靠在他的翅膀底下。他的诚实，是大小的盾牌。

chapters.en: You will not fear the terror of night, nor the arrow that flies by day,
chapters.zh: 你必不怕黑夜的惊骇，或是白日飞的箭。

chapters.en: nor the pestilence that stalks in the darkness, nor the plague that destroys at midday.
chapters.zh: 也不怕黑夜行的瘟疫，或是午间灭人的毒病。

chapters.en: A thousand may fall at your side, ten thousand at your right hand, but it will not come near you.
chapters.zh: 虽有千人仆倒在你旁边，万人仆倒在你右边，这灾却不得临近你。

chapters.en: You will only observe with your eyes and see the punishment of the wicked.
chapters.zh: 你惟亲眼观看，见恶人遭报。

chapters.en: If you say, “The LORD is my refuge,” and you make the Most High your dwelling,
chapters.zh: 耶和华是我的避难所。你已将至高者当你的居所。

chapters.en: no harm will overtake you, no disaster will come near your tent.
chapters.zh: 祸患必不临到你，灾害也不挨近你的帐棚。

chapters.en: For he will command his angels concerning you to guard you in all your ways;
chapters.zh: 因他要为你吩咐他的使者，在你行的一切道路上保护你。

chapters.en: they will lift you up in their hands, so that you will not strike your foot against a stone.
chapters.zh: 他们要用手托着你，免得你的脚碰在石头上。

chapters.en: You will tread on the lion and the cobra; you will trample the great lion and the serpent.
chapters.zh: 你要踹在狮子和虺蛇的身上，践踏少壮狮子和大蛇。

chapters.en: “Because he loves me,” says the LORD, “I will rescue him; I will protect him, for he acknowledges my name.
chapters.zh: 神说，因为他专心爱我，我就要搭救他。因为他知道我的名，我要把他安置在高处。

chapters.en: He will call on me, and I will answer him; I will be with him in trouble, I will deliver him and honor him.
chapters.zh: 他若求告我，我就应允他。他在急难中，我要与他同在。我要搭救他，使他尊贵。

chapters.en: With long life I will satisfy him and show him my salvation.”
chapters.zh: 我要使他足享长寿，将我的救恩显明给他。

chapters.en: It is good to praise the LORD and make music to your name, O Most High,
chapters.zh: （安息日的诗歌。）称谢耶和华，歌颂你至高者的名。

chapters.en: proclaiming your love in the morning and your faithfulness at night,
chapters.zh: 用十弦的乐器和瑟，用琴弹幽雅的声音，早晨传扬你的慈爱，每夜传扬你的信实，这本为美事。

chapters.en: to the music of the ten-stringed lyre and the melody of the harp.
For you make me glad by your deeds, LORD; I sing for joy at what your hands have done.
chapters.zh: 因你耶和华借着你的作为，叫我高兴。我要因你手的工作欢呼。

chapters.en: How great are your works, LORD, how profound your thoughts!
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，你的工作何其大，你的心思极其深。

chapters.en: Senseless people do not know, fools do not understand,
chapters.zh: 畜类人不晓得，愚顽人也不明白。

chapters.en: that though the wicked spring up like grass and all evildoers flourish, they will be destroyed forever.
chapters.zh: 恶人茂盛如草，一切作孽之人发旺的时候，正是他们要灭亡，直到永远。

chapters.en: But you, LORD, are forever exalted.
chapters.zh: 惟你耶和华是至高，直到永远。

chapters.en: For surely your enemies, LORD, surely your enemies will perish; all evildoers will be scattered.
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，你的仇敌都要灭亡，一切作孽的也要离散。

chapters.en: You have exalted my horn like that of a wild ox; fine oils have been poured on me.
chapters.zh: 你却高举了我的角，如野牛的角。我是被新油膏了的。

chapters.en: My eyes have seen the defeat of my adversaries; my ears have heard the rout of my wicked foes.
chapters.zh: 我眼睛看见仇敌遭报，我耳朵听见那些起来攻击我的恶人受罚。

chapters.en: The righteous will flourish like a palm tree, they will grow like a cedar of Lebanon;
chapters.zh: 义人要发旺如棕树，生长如利巴嫩的香柏树。

chapters.en: planted in the house of the LORD, they will flourish in the courts of our God.
chapters.zh: 他们栽于耶和华的殿中，发旺在我们神的院里。

chapters.en: They will still bear fruit in old age, they will stay fresh and green,
chapters.zh: 他们年老的时候，仍要结果子。要满了汁浆而常发青。

chapters.en: proclaiming, “The LORD is upright; he is my Rock, and there is no wickedness in him.”
chapters.zh: 好显明耶和华是正直的，他是我的磐石，在他毫无不义。

chapters.en: The LORD reigns, he is robed in majesty; the LORD is robed in majesty and armed with strength; indeed, the world is established, firm and secure.
chapters.zh: 耶和华作王。他以威严为衣穿上。耶和华以能力为衣，以能力束腰。世界就坚定，不得动摇。

chapters.en: Your throne was established long ago; you are from all eternity.
chapters.zh: 你的宝座从太初立定。你从亘古就有。

chapters.en: The seas have lifted up, LORD, the seas have lifted up their voice; the seas have lifted up their pounding waves.
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，大水扬起，大水发声，波浪澎湃。

chapters.en: Mightier than the thunder of the great waters, mightier than the breakers of the sea— the LORD on high is mighty.
chapters.zh: 耶和华在高处大有能力，胜过诸水的响声，洋海的大浪。

chapters.en: Your statutes, LORD, stand firm; holiness adorns your house for endless days.
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，你的法度最的确。你的殿永称为圣，是合宜的。

chapters.en: The LORD is a God who avenges. O God who avenges, shine forth.
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，你是伸冤的神。伸冤的神阿，求你发出光来。

chapters.en: Rise up, Judge of the earth; pay back to the proud what they deserve.
chapters.zh: 审判世界的主阿，求你挺身而立，使骄傲人受应得的报应。

chapters.en: How long, LORD, will the wicked, how long will the wicked be jubilant?
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，恶人夸胜要到几时呢？要到几时呢？

chapters.en: They pour out arrogant words; all the evildoers are full of boasting.
chapters.zh: 他们絮絮叨叨，说傲慢的话。一切作孽的人，都自己夸张。

chapters.en: They crush your people, LORD; they oppress your inheritance.
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，他们强压你的百姓，苦害你的产业。

chapters.en: They slay the widow and the foreigner; they murder the fatherless.
chapters.zh: 他们杀死寡妇和寄居的，又杀害孤儿。

chapters.en: They say, “The LORD does not see; the God of Jacob takes no notice.”
chapters.zh: 他们说，耶和华必不看见，雅各的神必不思念。

chapters.en: Take notice, you senseless ones among the people; you fools, when will you become wise?
chapters.zh: 你们民间的畜类人当思想。你们愚顽人，到几时才有智慧呢？

chapters.en: Does he who fashioned the ear not hear? Does he who formed the eye not see?
chapters.zh: 造耳朵的，难道自己不听见吗？造眼睛的，难道自己不看见吗？

chapters.en: Does he who disciplines nations not punish? Does he who teaches mankind lack knowledge?
chapters.zh: 管教列邦的，就是叫人得知识的，难道自己不惩治人吗？

chapters.en: The LORD knows all human plans; he knows that they are futile.
chapters.zh: 耶和华知道人的意念是虚妄的。

chapters.en: Blessed is the one you discipline, LORD, the one you teach from your law;
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，你所管教，用律法所教训的人，是有福的。

chapters.en: you grant them relief from days of trouble, till a pit is dug for the wicked.
chapters.zh: 你使他在遭难的日子，得享平安。惟有恶人陷在所挖的坑中。

chapters.en: For the LORD will not reject his people; he will never forsake his inheritance.
chapters.zh: 因为耶和华必不丢弃他的百姓，也不离弃他的产业。

chapters.en: Judgment will again be founded on righteousness, and all the upright in heart will follow it.
chapters.zh: 审判要转向公义。心里正直的，必都随从。

chapters.en: Who will rise up for me against the wicked? Who will take a stand for me against evildoers?
chapters.zh: 谁肯为我起来攻击作恶的。谁肯为我站起抵挡作孽的。

chapters.en: Unless the LORD had given me help, I would soon have dwelt in the silence of death.
chapters.zh: 若不是耶和华帮助我，我就住在寂静之中了。

chapters.en: When I said, “My foot is slipping,” your unfailing love, LORD, supported me.
chapters.zh: 我正说我失了脚，耶和华阿，那时你的慈爱扶助我。

chapters.en: When anxiety was great within me, your consolation brought me joy.
chapters.zh: 我心里多忧多疑，你安慰我，就使我欢乐。

chapters.en: Can a corrupt throne be allied with you— a throne that brings on misery by its decrees?
chapters.zh: 那借着律例架弄残害，在位上行奸恶的，岂能与你相交吗？

chapters.en: The wicked band together against the righteous and condemn the innocent to death.
chapters.zh: 他们大家聚集攻击义人，将无辜的人定为死罪。

chapters.en: But the LORD has become my fortress, and my God the rock in whom I take refuge.
chapters.zh: 但耶和华向来作了我的高台。我的神作了我投靠的磐石。

chapters.en: He will repay them for their sins and destroy them for their wickedness; the LORD our God will destroy them.
chapters.zh: 他叫他们的罪孽归到他们身上。他们正在行恶之中，他要剪除他们。耶和华我们的神要把他们剪除。

chapters.en: Come, let us sing for joy to the LORD; let us shout aloud to the Rock of our salvation.
chapters.zh: 来阿，我们要向耶和华歌唱，向拯救我们的磐石欢呼。

chapters.en: Let us come before him with thanksgiving and extol him with music and song.
chapters.zh: 我们要来感谢他，用诗歌向他欢呼。

chapters.en: For the LORD is the great God, the great King above all gods.
chapters.zh: 因耶和华为大神，为大王，超乎万神之上。

chapters.en: In his hand are the depths of the earth, and the mountain peaks belong to him.
chapters.zh: 地的深处在他手中。山的高峰也属他。

chapters.en: The sea is his, for he made it, and his hands formed the dry land.
chapters.zh: 海洋属他。是他造的。旱地也是他手造成的。

chapters.en: Come, let us bow down in worship, let us kneel before the LORD our Maker;
chapters.zh: 来阿，我们要屈身敬拜，在造我们的耶和华面前跪下。

chapters.en: for he is our God and we are the people of his pasture, the flock under his care. Today, if only you would hear his voice,
chapters.zh: 因为他是我们的神。我们是他草场的羊，是他手下的民。惟愿你们今天听他的话。

chapters.en: “Do not harden your hearts as you did at Meribah,as you did that day at Massah in the wilderness,
chapters.zh: 你们不可硬着心，像当日在米利巴，就是在旷野的玛撒。

chapters.en: where your ancestors tested me; they tried me, though they had seen what I did.
chapters.zh: 那时你们的祖宗试我探我，并且观看我的作为。

chapters.en: For forty years I was angry with that generation; I said, ‘They are a people whose hearts go astray, and they have not known my ways.’
chapters.zh: 四十年之久，我厌烦那世代，说，这是心里迷糊的百姓，竟不晓得我的作为。

chapters.en: So I declared on oath in my anger, ‘They shall never enter my rest.’ ”
chapters.zh: 所以我在怒中起誓，说，他们断不可进入我的安息。

chapters.en: Sing to the LORD a new song; sing to the LORD, all the earth.
chapters.zh: 你们要向耶和华唱新歌。全地都要向耶和华歌唱。

chapters.en: Sing to the LORD, praise his name; proclaim his salvation day after day.
chapters.zh: 要向耶和华歌唱，称颂他的名，天天传扬他的救恩。

chapters.en: Declare his glory among the nations, his marvelous deeds among all peoples.
chapters.zh: 在列邦中述说他的荣耀，在万民中述说他的奇事。

chapters.en: For great is the LORD and most worthy of praise; he is to be feared above all gods.
chapters.zh: 因耶和华为大，当受极大的赞美。他在万神之上当受敬畏。

chapters.en: For all the gods of the nations are idols, but the LORD made the heavens.
chapters.zh: 外邦的神都属虚无。惟独耶和华创造诸天。

chapters.en: Splendor and majesty are before him; strength and glory are in his sanctuary.
chapters.zh: 有尊荣和威严在他面前。有能力与华美在他圣所。

chapters.en: Ascribe to the LORD, all you families of nations, ascribe to the LORD glory and strength.
chapters.zh: 民中的万族阿，你们要将荣耀能力归给耶和华，都归给耶和华。

chapters.en: Ascribe to the LORD the glory due his name; bring an offering and come into his courts.
chapters.zh: 要将耶和华的名所当得的荣耀归给他，拿供物来进入他的院宇。

chapters.en: Worship the LORD in the splendor of his holiness; tremble before him, all the earth.
chapters.zh: 当以圣洁的妆饰（的或作为），敬拜耶和华。全地要在他面前战抖。

chapters.en: Say among the nations, “The LORD reigns.” The world is firmly established, it cannot be moved; he will judge the peoples with equity.
chapters.zh: 人在列邦中要说，耶和华作王，世界就坚定，不得动摇。他要按公正审判众民。

chapters.en: Let the heavens rejoice, let the earth be glad; let the sea resound, and all that is in it.
chapters.zh: 愿天欢喜，愿地快乐。愿海和其中所充满的澎湃。

chapters.en: Let the fields be jubilant, and everything in them; let all the trees of the forest sing for joy.
chapters.zh: 愿田和其中所有的都欢乐。那时林中的树木，都要在耶和华面前欢呼。

chapters.en: Let all creation rejoice before the LORD, for he comes, he comes to judge the earth. He will judge the world in righteousness and the peoples in his faithfulness.
chapters.zh: 因为他来了。他来要审判全地。他要按公义审判世界，按他的信实审判万民。

chapters.en: The LORD reigns, let the earth be glad; let the distant shores rejoice.
chapters.zh: 耶和华作王。愿地快乐，愿众海岛欢喜。

chapters.en: Clouds and thick darkness surround him; righteousness and justice are the foundation of his throne.
chapters.zh: 密云和幽暗，在他的四围。公义和公平，是他宝座的根基。

chapters.en: Fire goes before him and consumes his foes on every side.
chapters.zh: 有烈火在他前头行，烧灭他四围的敌人。

chapters.en: His lightning lights up the world; the earth sees and trembles.
chapters.zh: 他的闪电光照世界。大地看见便震动。

chapters.en: The mountains melt like wax before the LORD, before the Lord of all the earth.
chapters.zh: 诸山见耶和华的面，就是全地之主的面，便消化如蜡。

chapters.en: The heavens proclaim his righteousness, and all peoples see his glory.
chapters.zh: 诸天表明他的公义，万民看见他的荣耀。

chapters.en: All who worship images are put to shame, those who boast in idols— worship him, all you gods!
