chapters.zh: 愿一切事奉雕刻的偶像，靠虚无之神自夸的，都蒙羞愧。万神哪，你们都当拜他。

chapters.en: Zion hears and rejoices and the villages of Judah are glad because of your judgments, LORD.
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，锡安听见你的判断，就欢喜，犹大的城邑（原文作女子），也都快乐。

chapters.en: For you, LORD, are the Most High over all the earth; you are exalted far above all gods.
chapters.zh: 因为你耶和华至高超乎全地。你被尊崇，远超万神之上。

chapters.en: Let those who love the LORD hate evil, for he guards the lives of his faithful ones and delivers them from the hand of the wicked.
chapters.zh: 你们爱耶和华的，都当恨恶罪恶。他保护圣民的性命，搭救他们脱离恶人的手。

chapters.en: Light shines on the righteous and joy on the upright in heart.
chapters.zh: 散布亮光，是为义人。预备喜乐，是为正直人。

chapters.en: Rejoice in the LORD, you who are righteous, and praise his holy name.
chapters.zh: 你们义人当靠耶和华欢喜，称谢他可记念的圣名。

chapters.en: Sing to the LORD a new song, for he has done marvelous things; his right hand and his holy arm have worked salvation for him.
chapters.zh: （一篇诗。）你们要向耶和华唱新歌。因为他行过奇妙的事。他的右手和圣臂，施行救恩。

chapters.en: The LORD has made his salvation known and revealed his righteousness to the nations.
chapters.zh: 耶和华发明了他的救恩，在列邦人眼前显出公义。

chapters.en: He has remembered his love and his faithfulness to Israel; all the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.
chapters.zh: 记念他向以色列家所发的慈爱，所凭的信实。地的四极，都看见我们神的救恩。

chapters.en: Shout for joy to the LORD, all the earth, burst into jubilant song with music;
chapters.zh: 全地都要向耶和华欢乐。要发起大声欢呼歌颂。

chapters.en: make music to the LORD with the harp, with the harp and the sound of singing,
chapters.zh: 要用琴歌颂耶和华，用琴和诗歌的声音歌颂他。

chapters.en: with trumpets and the blast of the ram’s horn— shout for joy before the LORD, the King.
chapters.zh: 用号和角声，在大君王耶和华面前欢呼。

chapters.en: Let the sea resound, and everything in it, the world, and all who live in it.
chapters.zh: 愿海和其中所充满的澎湃。世界和住在其间的，也要发声。

chapters.en: Let the rivers clap their hands, let the mountains sing together for joy;
chapters.zh: 愿大水拍手。愿诸山在耶和华面前一同欢呼。

chapters.en: let them sing before the LORD, for he comes to judge the earth. He will judge the world in righteousness and the peoples with equity.
chapters.zh: 因为他来，要审判遍地。他要按公义审判世界，按公正审判万民。

chapters.en: The LORD reigns, let the nations tremble; he sits enthroned between the cherubim, let the earth shake.
chapters.zh: 耶和华作王，万民当战抖。他坐在二基路伯上，地当动摇。

chapters.en: Great is the LORD in Zion; he is exalted over all the nations.
chapters.zh: 耶和华在锡安为大。他超乎万民之上。

chapters.en: Let them praise your great and awesome name— he is holy.
chapters.zh: 他们当称赞他大而可畏的名。他本为圣。

chapters.en: The King is mighty, he loves justice— you have established equity; in Jacob you have done what is just and right.
chapters.zh: 王有能力喜爱公平，坚立公正，在雅各中施行公平和公义。

chapters.en: Exalt the LORD our God and worship at his footstool; he is holy.
chapters.zh: 你们当尊崇耶和华我们的神，在他脚凳前下拜。他本为圣。

chapters.en: Moses and Aaron were among his priests, Samuel was among those who called on his name; they called on the LORD and he answered them.
chapters.zh: 在他的祭司中有摩西和亚伦，在求告他名的人中有撒母耳，他们求告耶和华，他就应允他们。

chapters.en: He spoke to them from the pillar of cloud; they kept his statutes and the decrees he gave them.
chapters.zh: 他在云柱中对他们说话。他们遵守他的法度，和他所赐给他们的律例。

chapters.en: LORD our God, you answered them; you were to Israel a forgiving God, though you punished their misdeeds.
chapters.zh: 耶和华我们的神阿，你应允他们。你是赦免他们的神，却按他们所行的报应他们。

chapters.en: Exalt the LORD our God and worship at his holy mountain, for the LORD our God is holy.
chapters.zh: 你们要尊崇耶和华我们的神，在他的圣山下拜。因为耶和华我们的神本为圣。

chapters.en: Shout for joy to the LORD, all the earth.
chapters.zh: （称谢诗。）普天下当向耶和华欢呼。

chapters.en: Worship the LORD with gladness; come before him with joyful songs.
chapters.zh: 你们当乐意事奉耶和华。当来向他歌唱。

chapters.en: Know that the LORD is God. It is he who made us, and we are his ; we are his people, the sheep of his pasture.
chapters.zh: 你们当晓得耶和华是神。我们是他造的，也是属他的。我们是他的民，也是他草场的羊。

chapters.en: Enter his gates with thanksgiving and his courts with praise; give thanks to him and praise his name.
chapters.zh: 当称谢进入他的门，当赞美进入他的院。当感谢他，称颂他的名。

chapters.en: For the LORD is good and his love endures forever; his faithfulness continues through all generations.
chapters.zh: 因为耶和华本为善，他的慈爱，存到永远，他的信实，直到万代。

chapters.en: I will sing of your love and justice; to you, LORD, I will sing praise.
chapters.zh: （大卫的诗。）我要歌唱慈爱和公平。耶和华阿，我要向你歌颂。

chapters.en: I will be careful to lead a blameless life— when will you come to me? I will conduct the affairs of my house with a blameless heart.
chapters.zh: 我要用智慧行完全的道。你几时到我这里来呢？我要存完全的心，行在我家中。

chapters.en: I will not look with approval on anything that is vile. I hate what faithless people do; I will have no part in it.
chapters.zh: 邪僻的事，我都不摆在我眼前。悖逆人所做的事，我甚恨恶，不容沾在我身上。

chapters.en: The perverse of heart shall be far from me; I will have nothing to do with what is evil.
chapters.zh: 弯曲的心思，我必远离。一切的恶人（或作恶事），我不认识。

chapters.en: Whoever slanders their neighbor in secret, I will put to silence; whoever has haughty eyes and a proud heart, I will not tolerate.
chapters.zh: 在暗中谗谤他邻居的，我必将他灭绝。眼目高傲，心里骄纵的，我必不容他。

chapters.en: My eyes will be on the faithful in the land, that they may dwell with me; the one whose walk is blameless will minister to me.
chapters.zh: 我眼要看国中的诚实人，叫他们与我同住。行为完全的，他要伺候我。

chapters.en: No one who practices deceit will dwell in my house; no one who speaks falsely will stand in my presence.
chapters.zh: 行诡诈的，必不得住在我家里。说谎话的，必不得立在我眼前。

chapters.en: Every morning I will put to silence all the wicked in the land; I will cut off every evildoer from the city of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 我每日早晨，要灭绝国中所有的恶人。好把一切作孽的，从耶和华的城里剪除。

chapters.en: Hear my prayer, LORD; let my cry for help come to you.
chapters.zh: （困苦人发昏的时候，在耶和华面前吐露苦情的祷告。）耶和华阿，求你听我的祷告，容我的呼求达到你面前。

chapters.en: Do not hide your face from me when I am in distress. Turn your ear to me; when I call, answer me quickly.
chapters.zh: 我在急难的日子，求你向我侧耳，不要向我掩面。我呼求的日子，求你快快应允我。

chapters.en: For my days vanish like smoke; my bones burn like glowing embers.
chapters.zh: 因为，我的年日如烟云消灭，我的骨头，如火把烧着。

chapters.en: My heart is blighted and withered like grass; I forget to eat my food.
chapters.zh: 我的心被伤，如草枯干，甚至我忘记吃饭。

chapters.en: In my distress I groan aloud and am reduced to skin and bones.
chapters.zh: 因我唉哼的声音，我的肉紧贴骨头。

chapters.en: I am like a desert owl, like an owl among the ruins.
chapters.zh: 我如同旷野的鹈鹕。我好像荒场的猫头鹰。

chapters.en: I lie awake; I have become like a bird alone on a roof.
chapters.zh: 我儆醒不睡。我像房顶上孤单的麻雀。

chapters.en: All day long my enemies taunt me; those who rail against me use my name as a curse.
chapters.zh: 我的仇敌终日辱骂我。向我猖狂的人指着我赌咒。

chapters.en: For I eat ashes as my food and mingle my drink with tears
chapters.zh: 我吃过炉灰，如同吃饭。我所喝的与眼泪搀杂。

chapters.en: because of your great wrath, for you have taken me up and thrown me aside.
chapters.zh: 这都因你的恼恨和忿怒。你把我拾起来，又把我摔下去。

chapters.en: My days are like the evening shadow; I wither away like grass.
chapters.zh: 我的年日，如日影偏斜。我也如草枯干。

chapters.en: But you, LORD, sit enthroned forever; your renown endures through all generations.
chapters.zh: 惟你耶和华必存到永远。你可记念的名，也存到万代。

chapters.en: You will arise and have compassion on Zion, for it is time to show favor to her; the appointed time has come.
chapters.zh: 你必起来怜恤锡安，因现在是可怜她的时候。日期已经到了。

chapters.en: For her stones are dear to your servants; her very dust moves them to pity.
chapters.zh: 你的仆人原来喜悦她的石头，可怜她的尘土。

chapters.en: The nations will fear the name of the LORD, all the kings of the earth will revere your glory.
chapters.zh: 列国要敬畏耶和华的名。世上诸王都敬畏你的荣耀。

chapters.en: For the LORD will rebuild Zion and appear in his glory.
chapters.zh: 因为耶和华建造了锡安，在他荣耀里显现。

chapters.en: He will respond to the prayer of the destitute; he will not despise their plea.
chapters.zh: 他垂听穷人的祷告，并不藐视他们的祈求。

chapters.en: Let this be written for a future generation, that a people not yet created may praise the LORD:
chapters.zh: 这必为后代的人记下。将来受造的民，要赞美耶和华。

chapters.en: “The LORD looked down from his sanctuary on high, from heaven he viewed the earth,
chapters.zh: 因为他从至高的圣所垂看。耶和华从天向地观察。

chapters.en: to hear the groans of the prisoners and release those condemned to death.”
chapters.zh: 要垂听被囚之人的叹息。要释放将要死的人。

chapters.en: So the name of the LORD will be declared in Zion and his praise in Jerusalem
chapters.zh: 使人在锡安传扬耶和华的名，在耶路撒冷传扬赞美他的话。

chapters.en: when the peoples and the kingdoms assemble to worship the LORD.
chapters.zh: 就是在万民和列国聚会事奉耶和华的时候。

chapters.en: In the course of my life he broke my strength; he cut short my days.
chapters.zh: 他使我的力量，中道衰弱，使我的年日短少。

chapters.en: So I said: “Do not take me away, my God, in the midst of my days; your years go on through all generations.
chapters.zh: 我说，我的神阿，不要使我中年去世。你的年数世世无穷。

chapters.en: In the beginning you laid the foundations of the earth, and the heavens are the work of your hands.
chapters.zh: 你起初立了地的根基。天也是你手所造的。

chapters.en: They will perish, but you remain; they will all wear out like a garment. Like clothing you will change them and they will be discarded.
chapters.zh: 天地都要灭没，你却要长存。天地都要如外衣渐渐旧了。你要将天地如里衣更换，天地就改变了。

chapters.en: But you remain the same, and your years will never end.
chapters.zh: 惟有你永不改变。你的年数，没有穷尽。

chapters.en: The children of your servants will live in your presence; their descendants will be established before you.”
chapters.zh: 你仆人的子孙要长存。他们的后裔，要坚立在你面前。

chapters.en: Praise the LORD, my soul; all my inmost being, praise his holy name.
chapters.zh: （大卫的诗。）我的心哪，你要称颂耶和华。凡在我里面的，也要称颂他的圣名。

chapters.en: Praise the LORD, my soul, and forget not all his benefits—
chapters.zh: 我的心哪，你要称颂耶和华，不可忘记他的一切恩惠。

chapters.en: who forgives all your sins and heals all your diseases,
chapters.zh: 他赦免你的一切罪孽，医治你的一切疾病。

chapters.en: who redeems your life from the pit and crowns you with love and compassion,
chapters.zh: 他救赎你的命脱离死亡，以仁爱和慈悲为你的冠冕。

chapters.en: who satisfies your desires with good things so that your youth is renewed like the eagle’s.
chapters.zh: 他用美物，使你所愿的得以知足，以致你如鹰返老还童。

chapters.en: The LORD works righteousness and justice for all the oppressed.
chapters.zh: 耶和华施行公义，为一切受屈的人伸冤。

chapters.en: He made known his ways to Moses, his deeds to the people of Israel:
chapters.zh: 他使摩西知道他的法则，叫以色列人晓得他的作为。

chapters.en: The LORD is compassionate and gracious, slow to anger, abounding in love.
chapters.zh: 耶和华有怜悯，有恩典，不轻易发怒，且有丰盛的慈爱。

chapters.en: He will not always accuse, nor will he harbor his anger forever;
chapters.zh: 他不长久责备，也不永远怀怒。

chapters.en: he does not treat us as our sins deserve or repay us according to our iniquities.
chapters.zh: 他没有按我们的罪过待我们，也没有照我们的罪孽报应我们。

chapters.en: For as high as the heavens are above the earth, so great is his love for those who fear him;
chapters.zh: 天离地何等的高，他的慈爱向敬畏他的人，也是何等的大。

chapters.en: as far as the east is from the west, so far has he removed our transgressions from us.
chapters.zh: 东离西有多远，他叫我们的过犯，离我们也有多远。

chapters.en: As a father has compassion on his children, so the LORD has compassion on those who fear him;
chapters.zh: 父亲怎样怜恤他的儿女，耶和华也怎样怜恤敬畏他的人。

chapters.en: for he knows how we are formed, he remembers that we are dust.
chapters.zh: 因为他知道我们的本体，思念我们不过是尘土。

chapters.en: The life of mortals is like grass, they flourish like a flower of the field;
chapters.zh: 至于世人，他的年日如草一样。他发旺如野地的花。

chapters.en: the wind blows over it and it is gone, and its place remembers it no more.
chapters.zh: 经风一吹，便归无有。他的原处，也不再认识他。

chapters.en: But from everlasting to everlasting the LORD’s love is with those who fear him, and his righteousness with their children’s children—
chapters.zh: 但耶和华的慈爱，归于敬畏他的人，从亘古到永远。他的公义，也归于子子孙孙。

chapters.en: with those who keep his covenant and remember to obey his precepts.
chapters.zh: 就是那些遵守他的约，记念他的训词而遵行的人。

chapters.en: The LORD has established his throne in heaven, and his kingdom rules over all.
chapters.zh: 耶和华在天上立定宝座。他的权柄（原文作国）统管万有。

chapters.en: Praise the LORD, you his angels, you mighty ones who do his bidding, who obey his word.
chapters.zh: 听从他命令成全他旨意有大能的天使，都要称颂耶和华。

chapters.en: Praise the LORD, all his heavenly hosts, you his servants who do his will.
chapters.zh: 你们作他的诸军作他的仆役行他所喜悦的，都要称颂耶和华。

chapters.en: Praise the LORD, all his works everywhere in his dominion. Praise the LORD, my soul.
chapters.zh: 你们一切被他造的，在他所治理的各处，都要称颂耶和华。我的心哪，你要称颂耶和华。

chapters.en: Praise the LORD, my soul. LORD my God, you are very great; you are clothed with splendor and majesty.
chapters.zh: 我的心哪，你要称颂耶和华。耶和华我的神阿，你为至大。你以尊荣威严为衣服。

chapters.en: The LORD wraps himself in light as with a garment; he stretches out the heavens like a tent
chapters.zh: 披上亮光，如披外袍，铺张穹苍，如铺幔子。

chapters.en: and lays the beams of his upper chambers on their waters. He makes the clouds his chariot and rides on the wings of the wind.
chapters.zh: 在水中立楼阁的栋梁，用云彩为车辇，借着风的翅膀而行。

chapters.en: He makes winds his messengers,flames of fire his servants.
chapters.zh: 以风为使者，以火焰为仆役。

chapters.en: He set the earth on its foundations; it can never be moved.
chapters.zh: 将地立在根基上，使地永不动摇。

chapters.en: You covered it with the watery depths as with a garment; the waters stood above the mountains.
chapters.zh: 你用深水遮盖地面，犹如衣裳。诸水高过山岭。

chapters.en: But at your rebuke the waters fled, at the sound of your thunder they took to flight;
chapters.zh: 你的斥责一发，水便奔逃。你的雷声一发，水便奔流。

chapters.en: they flowed over the mountains, they went down into the valleys, to the place you assigned for them.
chapters.zh: （诸山升上，诸谷沉下（或作随山上翻，随谷下流）），归你为它所安定之地

chapters.en: You set a boundary they cannot cross; never again will they cover the earth.
chapters.zh: 你定了界限，使水不能过去，不再转回遮盖地面。

chapters.en: He makes springs pour water into the ravines; it flows between the mountains.
chapters.zh: 耶和华使泉源涌在山谷，流在山间。

chapters.en: They give water to all the beasts of the field; the wild donkeys quench their thirst.
chapters.zh: 使野地的走兽有水喝，野驴得解其渴。

chapters.en: The birds of the sky nest by the waters; they sing among the branches.
chapters.zh: 天上的飞鸟在水旁住宿，在树枝上啼叫。

chapters.en: He waters the mountains from his upper chambers; the land is satisfied by the fruit of his work.
chapters.zh: 他从楼阁中浇灌山岭。因他作为的功效，地就丰足。

chapters.en: He makes grass grow for the cattle, and plants for people to cultivate— bringing forth food from the earth:
chapters.zh: 他使草生长，给六畜吃。使菜蔬发长，供给人用。使人从地里能得食物。

chapters.en: wine that gladdens human hearts, oil to make their faces shine, and bread that sustains their hearts.
chapters.zh: 又得酒能悦人心，得油能润人面，得粮能养人心。

chapters.en: The trees of the LORD are well watered, the cedars of Lebanon that he planted.
chapters.zh: 佳美的树木，就是利巴嫩的香柏树，是耶和华所栽种的，都满了汁浆。

chapters.en: There the birds make their nests; the stork has its home in the junipers.
chapters.zh: 雀鸟在其上搭窝。至于鹤，松树是它的房屋。

chapters.en: The high mountains belong to the wild goats; the crags are a refuge for the hyrax.
chapters.zh: 高山为野山羊的住所。岩石为沙番的藏处。

chapters.en: He made the moon to mark the seasons, and the sun knows when to go down.
chapters.zh: 你安置月亮为定节令。日头自知沉落。

chapters.en: You bring darkness, it becomes night, and all the beasts of the forest prowl.
chapters.zh: 你造黑暗为夜，林中的百兽就都爬出来。

chapters.en: The lions roar for their prey and seek their food from God.
chapters.zh: 少壮狮子吼叫，要抓食，向神寻求食物。

chapters.en: The sun rises, and they steal away; they return and lie down in their dens.
chapters.zh: 日头一出，兽便躲避，卧在洞里。

chapters.en: Then people go out to their work, to their labor until evening.
chapters.zh: 人出去做工，劳碌直到晚上。

chapters.en: How many are your works, LORD! In wisdom you made them all; the earth is full of your creatures.
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，你所造的何其多，都是你用智慧造成的。遍地满了你的丰富。

chapters.en: There is the sea, vast and spacious, teeming with creatures beyond number— living things both large and small.
chapters.zh: 那里有海，又大又广。其中有无数的动物。大小活物都有。

chapters.en: There the ships go to and fro, and Leviathan, which you formed to frolic there.
chapters.zh: 那里有船行走。有你所造的鳄鱼游泳在其中。

chapters.en: All creatures look to you to give them their food at the proper time.
chapters.zh: 这都仰望你按时给它食物。

chapters.en: When you give it to them, they gather it up; when you open your hand, they are satisfied with good things.
chapters.zh: 你给它们，它们便拾起来；你张手，它们饱得美食。

chapters.en: When you hide your face, they are terrified; when you take away their breath, they die and return to the dust.
chapters.zh: 你掩面，它们便惊惶。你收回它们的气，它们就死亡，归于尘土。

chapters.en: When you send your Spirit, they are created, and you renew the face of the ground.
chapters.zh: 你发出你的灵，它们便受造。你使地面更换为新。

chapters.en: May the glory of the LORD endure forever; may the LORD rejoice in his works—
chapters.zh: 愿耶和华的荣耀存到永远。愿耶和华喜悦自己所造的。

chapters.en: he who looks at the earth, and it trembles, who touches the mountains, and they smoke.
chapters.zh: 他看地，地便震动。他摸山，山就冒烟。

chapters.en: I will sing to the LORD all my life; I will sing praise to my God as long as I live.
chapters.zh: 我要一生向耶和华唱诗。我还活的时候，要向我神歌颂。

chapters.en: May my meditation be pleasing to him, as I rejoice in the LORD.
chapters.zh: 愿他以我的默念为甘甜。我要因耶和华欢喜。

chapters.en: But may sinners vanish from the earth and the wicked be no more. Praise the LORD, my soul. Praise the LORD.
chapters.zh: 愿罪人从世上消灭。愿恶人归于无有。我的心哪，要称颂耶和华。你们要赞美耶和华。（原文作哈利路亚下同）

chapters.en: Give praise to the LORD, proclaim his name; make known among the nations what he has done.
chapters.zh: 你们要称谢耶和华，求告他的名，在万民中传扬他的作为。

chapters.en: Sing to him, sing praise to him; tell of all his wonderful acts.
chapters.zh: 要向他唱诗歌颂，谈论他一切奇妙的作为。

chapters.en: Glory in his holy name; let the hearts of those who seek the LORD rejoice.
chapters.zh: 要以他的圣名夸耀。寻求耶和华的人，心中应当欢喜。

chapters.en: Look to the LORD and his strength; seek his face always.
chapters.zh: 要寻求耶和华与他的能力，时常寻求他的面。

chapters.en: Remember the wonders he has done, his miracles, and the judgments he pronounced,
chapters.zh: 他仆人亚伯拉罕的后裔，他所拣选雅各的子孙哪，你们要记念他奇妙的作为和他的奇事，并他口中的判语。

chapters.en: you his servants, the descendants of Abraham, his chosen ones, the children of Jacob.
He is the LORD our God; his judgments are in all the earth.
chapters.zh: 他是耶和华我们的神。全地都有他的判断。

chapters.en: He remembers his covenant forever, the promise he made, for a thousand generations,
chapters.zh: 他记念他的约，直到永远，他所吩咐的话，直到千代。

chapters.en: the covenant he made with Abraham, the oath he swore to Isaac.
chapters.zh: 就是与亚伯拉罕所立的约，向以撒所起的誓。

chapters.en: He confirmed it to Jacob as a decree, to Israel as an everlasting covenant:
chapters.zh: 他又将这约向雅各定为律例，向以色列定为永远的约，

chapters.en: “To you I will give the land of Canaan as the portion you will inherit.”
chapters.zh: 说，我必将迦南地赐给你，作你产业的分。

chapters.en: When they were but few in number, few indeed, and strangers in it,
chapters.zh: 当时，他们人丁有限，数目稀少，并且在那地为寄居的。

chapters.en: they wandered from nation to nation, from one kingdom to another.
chapters.zh: 他们从这邦游到那邦，从这国行到那国。

chapters.en: He allowed no one to oppress them; for their sake he rebuked kings:
chapters.zh: 他不容什么人欺负他们，为他们的缘故责备君王，

chapters.en: “Do not touch my anointed ones; do my prophets no harm.”
chapters.zh: 说，不可难为我受膏的人，也不可恶待我的先知。

chapters.en: He called down famine on the land and destroyed all their supplies of food;
chapters.zh: 他命饥荒降在那地上，将所倚靠的粮食全行断绝。

chapters.en: and he sent a man before them— Joseph, sold as a slave.
chapters.zh: 在他们以先打发一个人去。约瑟被卖为奴仆。

chapters.en: They bruised his feet with shackles, his neck was put in irons,
chapters.zh: 人用脚镣伤他的脚，他被铁链捆拘。

chapters.en: till what he foretold came to pass, till the word of the LORD proved him true.
chapters.zh: 耶和华的话试炼他，直等到他所说的应验了。

chapters.en: The king sent and released him, the ruler of peoples set him free.
chapters.zh: 王打发人把他解开，就是治理众民的，把他释放。

chapters.en: He made him master of his household, ruler over all he possessed,
chapters.zh: 立他作王家之主，掌管他一切所有的。

chapters.en: to instruct his princes as he pleased and teach his elders wisdom.
chapters.zh: 使他随意捆绑他的臣宰，将智慧教导他的长老。

chapters.en: Then Israel entered Egypt; Jacob resided as a foreigner in the land of Ham.
chapters.zh: 以色列也到了埃及，雅各在含地寄居。

chapters.en: The LORD made his people very fruitful; he made them too numerous for their foes,
chapters.zh: 耶和华使他的百姓生养众多，使他们比敌人强盛。

chapters.en: whose hearts he turned to hate his people, to conspire against his servants.
chapters.zh: 使敌人的心转去恨他的百姓，并用诡计待他的仆人。

chapters.en: He sent Moses his servant, and Aaron, whom he had chosen.
chapters.zh: 他打发他的仆人摩西，和他所拣选的亚伦。

chapters.en: They performed his signs among them, his wonders in the land of Ham.
chapters.zh: 在敌人中间显他的神迹，在含地显他的奇事。

chapters.en: He sent darkness and made the land dark— for had they not rebelled against his words?
chapters.zh: 他命黑暗，就有黑暗。没有违背他话的。

chapters.en: He turned their waters into blood, causing their fish to die.
chapters.zh: 他叫埃及的水变为血，叫他们的鱼死了。

chapters.en: Their land teemed with frogs, which went up into the bedrooms of their rulers.
chapters.zh: 在他们的地上，以及王宫的内室，青蛙多多滋生。

chapters.en: He spoke, and there came swarms of flies, and gnats throughout their country.
chapters.zh: 他说一声，苍蝇就成群而来，并有虱子进入他们四境。

chapters.en: He turned their rain into hail, with lightning throughout their land;
chapters.zh: 他给他们降下冰雹为雨，在他们的地上降下火焰。

chapters.en: he struck down their vines and fig trees and shattered the trees of their country.
chapters.zh: 他也击打他们的葡萄树和无花果树，毁坏他们境内的树木。

chapters.en: He spoke, and the locusts came, grasshoppers without number;
chapters.zh: 他说一声，就有蝗虫蚂蚱上来，不计其数，

chapters.en: they ate up every green thing in their land, ate up the produce of their soil.
chapters.zh: 吃尽了他们地上各样的菜蔬，和田地的出产。

chapters.en: Then he struck down all the firstborn in their land, the firstfruits of all their manhood.
chapters.zh: 他又击杀他们国内一切的长子，就是他们强壮时头生的。

chapters.en: He brought out Israel, laden with silver and gold, and from among their tribes no one faltered.
chapters.zh: 他领自己的百姓带银子金子出来。他支派中没有一个软弱的。

chapters.en: Egypt was glad when they left, because dread of Israel had fallen on them.
chapters.zh: 他们出来的时候，埃及人便欢喜。原来埃及人惧怕他们。

chapters.en: He spread out a cloud as a covering, and a fire to give light at night.
chapters.zh: 他铺张云彩当遮盖，夜间使火光照。

chapters.en: They asked, and he brought them quail; he fed them well with the bread of heaven.
chapters.zh: 他们一求，他就使鹌鹑飞来，并用天上的粮食，叫他们饱足。

chapters.en: He opened the rock, and water gushed out; it flowed like a river in the desert.
chapters.zh: 他打开磐石，水就涌出。在干旱之处，水流成河。

chapters.en: For he remembered his holy promise given to his servant Abraham.
chapters.zh: 这都因他记念他的圣言，和他的仆人亚伯拉罕。

chapters.en: He brought out his people with rejoicing, his chosen ones with shouts of joy;
chapters.zh: 他带领百姓欢乐而出，带领选民欢呼前往。

chapters.en: he gave them the lands of the nations, and they fell heir to what others had toiled for—
chapters.zh: 他将列国的地赐给他们，他们便承受众民劳碌得来的。

chapters.en: that they might keep his precepts and observe his laws. Praise the LORD.
chapters.zh: 好使他们遵他的律例，守他的律法。你们要赞美耶和华。

chapters.en: Praise the LORD.Give thanks to the LORD, for he is good; his love endures forever.
chapters.zh: 你们要赞美耶和华。要称谢耶和华，因他本为善。他的慈爱永远长存。

chapters.en: Who can proclaim the mighty acts of the LORD or fully declare his praise?
chapters.zh: 谁能传说耶和华的大能，谁能表明他一切的美德。

chapters.en: Blessed are those who act justly, who always do what is right.
chapters.zh: 凡遵守公平，常行公义的，这人便为有福。

chapters.en: Remember me, LORD, when you show favor to your people, come to my aid when you save them,
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，你用恩惠待你的百姓，求你也用这恩惠记念我，开你的救恩眷顾我，

chapters.en: that I may enjoy the prosperity of your chosen ones, that I may share in the joy of your nation and join your inheritance in giving praise.
chapters.zh: 使我见你选民的福，乐你国民的乐，与你的产业一同夸耀。

chapters.en: We have sinned, even as our ancestors did; we have done wrong and acted wickedly.
chapters.zh: 我们与我们的祖宗一同犯罪。我们作了孽，行了恶。

chapters.en: When our ancestors were in Egypt, they gave no thought to your miracles; they did not remember your many kindnesses, and they rebelled by the sea, the Red Sea.
chapters.zh: 我们的祖宗在埃及不明白你的奇事，不记念你丰盛的慈爱，反倒在红海行了悖逆。

chapters.en: Yet he saved them for his name’s sake, to make his mighty power known.
chapters.zh: 然而，他因自己的名拯救他们，为要彰显他的大能。

chapters.en: He rebuked the Red Sea, and it dried up; he led them through the depths as through a desert.
chapters.zh: 并且斥责红海，海便干了；他带领他们经过深处，如同经过旷野。

chapters.en: He saved them from the hand of the foe; from the hand of the enemy he redeemed them.
chapters.zh: 他拯救他们脱离恨他们人的手，从仇敌手中救赎他们。

chapters.en: The waters covered their adversaries; not one of them survived.
chapters.zh: 水淹没他们的敌人，没有一个存留。

chapters.en: Then they believed his promises and sang his praise.
chapters.zh: 那时，他们才信了他的话，歌唱赞美他。

chapters.en: But they soon forgot what he had done and did not wait for his plan to unfold.
chapters.zh: 等不多时，他们就忘了他的作为，不仰望他的指教，

chapters.en: In the desert they gave in to their craving; in the wilderness they put God to the test.
chapters.zh: 反倒在旷野大起欲心，在荒地试探神。

chapters.en: So he gave them what they asked for, but sent a wasting disease among them.
chapters.zh: 他将他们所求的赐给他们，却使他们的心灵软弱。

chapters.en: In the camp they grew envious of Moses and of Aaron, who was consecrated to the LORD.
chapters.zh: 他们又在营中嫉妒摩西，和耶和华的圣者亚伦。

chapters.en: The earth opened up and swallowed Dathan; it buried the company of Abiram.
chapters.zh: 地裂开，吞下大坍，掩盖亚比兰一党的人。

chapters.en: Fire blazed among their followers; a flame consumed the wicked.
chapters.zh: 有火在他们的党中发起，有火焰烧毁了恶人。

chapters.en: At Horeb they made a calf and worshiped an idol cast from metal.
chapters.zh: 他们在何烈山造了牛犊，叩拜铸成的像。

chapters.en: They exchanged their glorious God for an image of a bull, which eats grass.
chapters.zh: 如此将他们荣耀的主，换为吃草之牛的像。

chapters.en: They forgot the God who saved them, who had done great things in Egypt,
chapters.zh: 忘了神他们的救主。他曾在埃及行大事。

chapters.en: miracles in the land of Ham and awesome deeds by the Red Sea.
chapters.zh: 在含地行奇事，在红海行可畏的事。

chapters.en: So he said he would destroy them— had not Moses, his chosen one, stood in the breach before him to keep his wrath from destroying them.
chapters.zh: 所以，他说要灭绝他们。若非有他所拣选的摩西站在当中（原文作破口），使他的忿怒转消，恐怕他就灭绝他们。

chapters.en: Then they despised the pleasant land; they did not believe his promise.
chapters.zh: 他们又藐视那美地，不信他的话，

chapters.en: They grumbled in their tents and did not obey the LORD.
chapters.zh: 在自己帐棚内发怨言，不听耶和华的声音。

chapters.en: So he swore to them with uplifted hand that he would make them fall in the wilderness,
chapters.zh: 所以，他对他们起誓，必叫他们倒在旷野，

chapters.en: make their descendants fall among the nations and scatter them throughout the lands.
chapters.zh: 叫他们的后裔倒在列国之中，分散在各地。

chapters.en: They yoked themselves to the Baal of Peor and ate sacrifices offered to lifeless gods;
chapters.zh: 他们又与巴力毗珥连合，且吃了祭死神（或作人）的物。

chapters.en: they aroused the LORD’s anger by their wicked deeds, and a plague broke out among them.
chapters.zh: 他们这样行，惹耶和华发怒，便有瘟疫流行在他们中间。

chapters.en: But Phinehas stood up and intervened, and the plague was checked.
chapters.zh: 那时，非尼哈站起，刑罚恶人，瘟疫这才止息。

chapters.en: This was credited to him as righteousness for endless generations to come.
chapters.zh: 那就算为他的义，世世代代，直到永远。

chapters.en: By the waters of Meribah they angered the LORD, and trouble came to Moses because of them;
chapters.zh: 他们在米利巴水又叫耶和华发怒，甚至摩西也受了亏损。

chapters.en: for they rebelled against the Spirit of God, and rash words came from Moses’ lips.
chapters.zh: 是因他们惹动他的灵，摩西（原文作他）用嘴说了急躁的话。

chapters.en: They did not destroy the peoples as the LORD had commanded them,
chapters.zh: 他们不照耶和华所吩咐的灭绝外邦人，

chapters.en: but they mingled with the nations and adopted their customs.
chapters.zh: 反与他们混杂相合，学习他们的行为，

chapters.en: They worshiped their idols, which became a snare to them.
chapters.zh: 事奉他们的偶像，这就成了自己的网罗。

chapters.en: They sacrificed their sons and their daughters to false gods.
chapters.zh: 把自己的儿女祭祀鬼魔，

chapters.en: They shed innocent blood, the blood of their sons and daughters, whom they sacrificed to the idols of Canaan, and the land was desecrated by their blood.
chapters.zh: 流无辜人的血，就是自己儿女的血，把他们祭祀迦南的偶像，那地就被血污秽了。

chapters.en: They defiled themselves by what they did; by their deeds they prostituted themselves.
chapters.zh: 这样，他们被自己所做的污秽了，在行为上犯了邪淫。

chapters.en: Therefore the LORD was angry with his people and abhorred his inheritance.
chapters.zh: 所以，耶和华的怒气，向他的百姓发作，憎恶他的产业。

chapters.en: He gave them into the hands of the nations, and their foes ruled over them.
chapters.zh: 将他们交在外邦人的手里；恨他们的人就辖制他们。

chapters.en: Their enemies oppressed them and subjected them to their power.
chapters.zh: 他们的仇敌也欺压他们，他们就伏在敌人手下。

chapters.en: Many times he delivered them, but they were bent on rebellion and they wasted away in their sin.
chapters.zh: 他屡次搭救他们，他们却设谋背逆，因自己的罪孽降为卑下。

chapters.en: Yet he took note of their distress when he heard their cry;
chapters.zh: 然而，他听见他们哀告的时候，就眷顾他们的急难。

chapters.en: for their sake he remembered his covenant and out of his great love he relented.
chapters.zh: 为他们记念他的约，照他丰盛的慈爱后悔。

chapters.en: He caused all who held them captive to show them mercy.
chapters.zh: 他也使他们在凡掳掠他们的人面前蒙怜恤。

chapters.en: Save us, LORD our God, and gather us from the nations, that we may give thanks to your holy name and glory in your praise.
chapters.zh: 耶和华我们的神阿，求你拯救我们，从外邦中招聚我们，我们好称赞你的圣名，以赞美你为夸胜。

chapters.en: Praise be to the LORD, the God of Israel, from everlasting to everlasting. Let all the people say, “Amen!” Praise the LORD.
chapters.zh: 耶和华以色列的神是应当称颂的，从亘古直到永远。愿众民都说，阿们。你们要赞美耶和华。

chapters.en: Give thanks to the LORD, for he is good; his love endures forever.
chapters.zh: 你们要称谢耶和华，因他本为善。他的慈爱，永远长存。

chapters.en: Let the redeemed of the LORD tell their story— those he redeemed from the hand of the foe,
chapters.zh: 愿耶和华的赎民说这话，就是他从敌人手中所救赎的，

chapters.en: those he gathered from the lands, from east and west, from north and south.
chapters.zh: 从各地，从东从西，从南从北，所招聚来的。

chapters.en: Some wandered in desert wastelands, finding no way to a city where they could settle.
chapters.zh: 他们在旷野荒地漂流，寻不见可住的城邑。

chapters.en: They were hungry and thirsty, and their lives ebbed away.
chapters.zh: 又饥又渴，心里发昏。

chapters.en: Then they cried out to the LORD in their trouble, and he delivered them from their distress.
chapters.zh: 于是，他们在苦难中哀求耶和华，他从他们的祸患中搭救他们。

chapters.en: He led them by a straight way to a city where they could settle.
chapters.zh: 又领他们行走直路，使他们往可居住的城邑。

chapters.en: Let them give thanks to the LORD for his unfailing love and his wonderful deeds for mankind,
chapters.zh: 但愿人因耶和华的慈爱和他向人所行的奇事都称赞他。

chapters.en: for he satisfies the thirsty and fills the hungry with good things.
chapters.zh: 因他使心里渴慕的人，得以知足，使心里饥饿的人，得饱美物。

chapters.en: Some sat in darkness, in utter darkness, prisoners suffering in iron chains,
chapters.zh: 那些坐在黑暗中死荫里的人，被困苦和铁链捆锁，

chapters.en: because they rebelled against God’s commands and despised the plans of the Most High.
chapters.zh: 是因他们违背神的话语，藐视至高者的旨意。

chapters.en: So he subjected them to bitter labor; they stumbled, and there was no one to help.
chapters.zh: 所以，他用劳苦治服他们的心。他们仆倒，无人扶助。

chapters.en: Then they cried to the LORD in their trouble, and he saved them from their distress.
chapters.zh: 于是，他们在苦难中哀求耶和华，他从他们的祸患中拯救他们。

chapters.en: He brought them out of darkness, the utter darkness, and broke away their chains.
chapters.zh: 他从黑暗中，和死荫里，领他们出来，折断他们的绑索。

chapters.en: Let them give thanks to the LORD for his unfailing love and his wonderful deeds for mankind,
chapters.zh: 但愿人因耶和华的慈爱，和他向人所行的奇事都称赞他。

chapters.en: for he breaks down gates of bronze and cuts through bars of iron.
chapters.zh: 因为他打破了铜门，砍断了铁闩。

chapters.en: Some became fools through their rebellious ways and suffered affliction because of their iniquities.
chapters.zh: 愚妄人因自己的过犯，和自己的罪孽便受苦楚。

chapters.en: They loathed all food and drew near the gates of death.
chapters.zh: 他们心里厌恶各样的食物，就临近死门。

chapters.en: Then they cried to the LORD in their trouble, and he saved them from their distress.
chapters.zh: 于是，他们在苦难中哀求耶和华，他从他们的祸患中拯救他们。

chapters.en: He sent out his word and healed them; he rescued them from the grave.
chapters.zh: 他发命医治他们，救他们脱离死亡。

chapters.en: Let them give thanks to the LORD for his unfailing love and his wonderful deeds for mankind.
chapters.zh: 但愿人因耶和华的慈爱，和他向人所行的奇事都称赞他。

chapters.en: Let them sacrifice thank offerings and tell of his works with songs of joy.
chapters.zh: 愿他们以感谢为祭献给他，欢呼述说他的作为。

chapters.en: Some went out on the sea in ships; they were merchants on the mighty waters.
chapters.zh: 在海上坐船，在大水中经理事务的。

chapters.en: They saw the works of the LORD, his wonderful deeds in the deep.
chapters.zh: 他们看见耶和华的作为，并他在深水中的奇事。

chapters.en: For he spoke and stirred up a tempest that lifted high the waves.
chapters.zh: 因他一吩咐，狂风就起来，海中的波浪也扬起。

chapters.en: They mounted up to the heavens and went down to the depths; in their peril their courage melted away.
chapters.zh: 他们上到天空，下到海底，他们的心因患难便消化。

chapters.en: They reeled and staggered like drunkards; they were at their wits’ end.
chapters.zh: 他们摇摇幌幌。东倒西歪，好像醉酒的人。他们的智慧无法可施。

chapters.en: Then they cried out to the LORD in their trouble, and he brought them out of their distress.
chapters.zh: 于是，他们在苦难中哀求耶和华，他从他们的祸患中领出他们来。

chapters.en: He stilled the storm to a whisper; the waves of the sea were hushed.
chapters.zh: 他使狂风止息，波浪就平静。

chapters.en: They were glad when it grew calm, and he guided them to their desired haven.
chapters.zh: 风息浪静，他们便欢喜。他就引他们到所愿去的海口。

chapters.en: Let them give thanks to the LORD for his unfailing love and his wonderful deeds for mankind.
chapters.zh: 但愿人因耶和华的慈爱，和他向人所行的奇事都称赞他。

chapters.en: Let them exalt him in the assembly of the people and praise him in the council of the elders.
chapters.zh: 愿他们在民的会中尊崇他，在长老的位上赞美他。

chapters.en: He turned rivers into a desert, flowing springs into thirsty ground,
chapters.zh: 他使江河变为旷野，叫水泉变为干渴之地。

chapters.en: and fruitful land into a salt waste, because of the wickedness of those who lived there.
chapters.zh: 使肥地变为碱地。这都因其间居民的罪恶。

chapters.en: He turned the desert into pools of water and the parched ground into flowing springs;
chapters.zh: 他使旷野变为水潭，叫旱地变为水泉。

chapters.en: there he brought the hungry to live, and they founded a city where they could settle.
chapters.zh: 他使饥饿的人住在那里，好建造可住的城邑。

chapters.en: They sowed fields and planted vineyards that yielded a fruitful harvest;
chapters.zh: 又种田地，栽葡萄园，得享所出的土产。

chapters.en: he blessed them, and their numbers greatly increased, and he did not let their herds diminish.
chapters.zh: 他又赐福给他们，叫他们生养众多。也不叫他们的牲畜减少。

chapters.en: Then their numbers decreased, and they were humbled by oppression, calamity and sorrow;
chapters.zh: 他们又因暴虐，患难，愁苦，就减少且卑下。

chapters.en: he who pours contempt on nobles made them wander in a trackless waste.
chapters.zh: 他使君王蒙羞被辱，使他们在荒废无路之地漂流。

chapters.en: But he lifted the needy out of their affliction and increased their families like flocks.
chapters.zh: 他却将穷乏人安置在高处，脱离苦难，使他的家属多如羊群。

chapters.en: The upright see and rejoice, but all the wicked shut their mouths.
chapters.zh: 正直人看见，就欢喜。罪孽之辈，必塞口无言。

chapters.en: Let the one who is wise heed these things and ponder the loving deeds of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 凡有智慧的，必在这些事上留心，也必思想耶和华的慈爱。

chapters.en: My heart, O God, is steadfast; I will sing and make music with all my soul.
chapters.zh: （大卫的诗歌。）神阿，我心坚定。我口（原文作荣耀）要唱诗歌颂。

chapters.en: Awake, harp and lyre! I will awaken the dawn.
chapters.zh: 琴瑟阿，你们当醒起。我自己要极早醒起。

chapters.en: I will praise you, LORD, among the nations; I will sing of you among the peoples.
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，我要在万民中称谢你，在列邦中歌颂你。

chapters.en: For great is your love, higher than the heavens; your faithfulness reaches to the skies.
chapters.zh: 因为，你的慈爱，大过诸天；你的诚实，达到穹苍。

chapters.en: Be exalted, O God, above the heavens; let your glory be over all the earth.
chapters.zh: 神阿，愿你崇高过于诸天。愿你的荣耀，高过全地。

chapters.en: Save us and help us with your right hand, that those you love may be delivered.
chapters.zh: 求你应允我们，用右手拯救我们，好叫你所亲爱的人得救。

chapters.en: God has spoken from his sanctuary: “In triumph I will parcel out Shechem and measure off the Valley of Sukkoth.
chapters.zh: 神已经指着他的圣洁说（说或作应许我），我要欢乐。我要分开示剑，丈量疏割谷。

chapters.en: Gilead is mine, Manasseh is mine; Ephraim is my helmet, Judah is my scepter.
chapters.zh: 基列是我的。玛拿西是我的。以法莲是护卫我头的。犹大是我的杖。

chapters.en: Moab is my washbasin, on Edom I toss my sandal; over Philistia I shout in triumph.”
chapters.zh: 摩押是我的沐浴盆。我要向以东抛鞋。我必因胜非利士呼喊。

chapters.en: Who will bring me to the fortified city? Who will lead me to Edom?
chapters.zh: 谁能领我进坚固城。谁能引我到以东地。

chapters.en: Is it not you, God, you who have rejected us and no longer go out with our armies?
chapters.zh: 神阿，你不是丢弃了我们吗？神阿，你不和我们的军兵同去吗？

chapters.en: Give us aid against the enemy, for human help is worthless.
chapters.zh: 求你帮助我们攻击敌人，因为人的帮助是枉然的。

chapters.en: With God we will gain the victory, and he will trample down our enemies.
chapters.zh: 我们倚靠神，才得施展大能，因为践踏我们敌人的就是他。

chapters.en: My God, whom I praise, do not remain silent,
chapters.zh: （大卫的诗，交与伶长。）我所赞美的神阿，求你不要闭口不言。

chapters.en: for people who are wicked and deceitful have opened their mouths against me; they have spoken against me with lying tongues.
chapters.zh: 因为恶人的嘴，和诡诈人的口，已经张开攻击我。他们用撒谎的舌头对我说话。

chapters.en: With words of hatred they surround me; they attack me without cause.
chapters.zh: 他们围绕我，说怨恨的话，又无故地攻打我。

chapters.en: In return for my friendship they accuse me, but I am a man of prayer.
chapters.zh: 他们与我为敌以报我爱。但我专心祈祷。

chapters.en: They repay me evil for good, and hatred for my friendship.
chapters.zh: 他们向我以恶报善，以恨报爱。

chapters.en: Appoint someone evil to oppose my enemy; let an accuser stand at his right hand.
chapters.zh: 愿你派一个恶人辖制他，派一个对头站在他右边。

chapters.en: When he is tried, let him be found guilty, and may his prayers condemn him.
chapters.zh: 他受审判的时候，愿他出来担当罪名。愿他的祈祷反成为罪。

chapters.en: May his days be few; may another take his place of leadership.
chapters.zh: 愿他的年日短少。愿别人得他的职分。

chapters.en: May his children be fatherless and his wife a widow.
chapters.zh: 愿他的儿女为孤儿，他的妻子为寡妇。

chapters.en: May his children be wandering beggars; may they be driven from their ruined homes.
chapters.zh: 愿他的儿女漂流讨饭，从他们荒凉之处出来求食。

chapters.en: May a creditor seize all he has; may strangers plunder the fruits of his labor.
chapters.zh: 愿强暴的债主牢笼他一切所有的。愿外人抢他劳碌得来的。

chapters.en: May no one extend kindness to him or take pity on his fatherless children.
chapters.zh: 愿无人向他延绵施恩。愿无人可怜他的孤儿。

chapters.en: May his descendants be cut off, their names blotted out from the next generation.
chapters.zh: 愿他的后人断绝，名字被涂抹，不传于下代。

chapters.en: May the iniquity of his fathers be remembered before the LORD; may the sin of his mother never be blotted out.
chapters.zh: 愿他祖宗的罪孽被耶和华记念。愿他母亲的罪过不被涂抹。

chapters.en: May their sins always remain before the LORD, that he may blot out their name from the earth.
chapters.zh: 愿这些罪常在耶和华面前，使他的名号断绝于世。

chapters.en: For he never thought of doing a kindness, but hounded to death the poor and the needy and the brokenhearted.
chapters.zh: 因为他不想施恩，却逼迫困苦穷乏的，和伤心的人，要把他们治死。

chapters.en: He loved to pronounce a curse— may it come back on him. He found no pleasure in blessing— may it be far from him.
chapters.zh: 他爱咒骂，咒骂就临到他。他不喜爱福乐，福乐就与他远离。

chapters.en: He wore cursing as his garment; it entered into his body like water, into his bones like oil.
chapters.zh: 他拿咒骂当衣服穿上。这咒骂就如水进他里面，像油入他的骨头。

chapters.en: May it be like a cloak wrapped about him, like a belt tied forever around him.
chapters.zh: 愿这咒骂当他遮身的衣服，当他常束的腰带。

chapters.en: May this be the LORD’s payment to my accusers, to those who speak evil of me.
chapters.zh: 这就是我对头，和用恶言议论我的人，从耶和华那里所受的报应。

chapters.en: But you, Sovereign LORD, help me for your name’s sake; out of the goodness of your love, deliver me.
chapters.zh: 主耶和华阿，求你为你的名恩待我。因你的慈爱美好，求你搭救我。

chapters.en: For I am poor and needy, and my heart is wounded within me.
chapters.zh: 因为我困苦穷乏，内心受伤。

chapters.en: I fade away like an evening shadow; I am shaken off like a locust.
chapters.zh: 我如日影渐渐偏斜而去。我如蝗虫被抖出来。

chapters.en: My knees give way from fasting; my body is thin and gaunt.
chapters.zh: 我因禁食，膝骨软弱；我身上的肉也渐渐瘦了。

chapters.en: I am an object of scorn to my accusers; when they see me, they shake their heads.
chapters.zh: 我受他们的羞辱。他们看见我，便摇头。

chapters.en: Help me, LORD my God; save me according to your unfailing love.
chapters.zh: 耶和华我的神阿，求你帮助我，照你的慈爱拯救我。

chapters.en: Let them know that it is your hand, that you, LORD, have done it.
chapters.zh: 使他们知道这是你的手，是你耶和华所行的事。

chapters.en: While they curse, may you bless; may those who attack me be put to shame, but may your servant rejoice.
chapters.zh: 任凭他们咒骂。惟愿你赐福。他们几时起来就必蒙羞，你的仆人却要欢喜。

chapters.en: May my accusers be clothed with disgrace and wrapped in shame as in a cloak.
chapters.zh: 愿我的对头，披戴羞辱。愿他们以自己的羞愧为外袍遮身。

chapters.en: With my mouth I will greatly extol the LORD; in the great throng of worshipers I will praise him.
chapters.zh: 我要用口极力称谢耶和华。我要在众人中间赞美他。

chapters.en: For he stands at the right hand of the needy, to save their lives from those who would condemn them.
chapters.zh: 因为他必站在穷乏人的右边，要救他脱离审判他灵魂的人。

chapters.en: The LORD says to my lord:“Sit at my right hand until I make your enemies a footstool for your feet.”
chapters.zh: （大卫的诗。）耶和华对我主说，你坐在我的右边，等我使你仇敌作你的脚凳。

chapters.en: The LORD will extend your mighty scepter from Zion, saying, “Rule in the midst of your enemies!”
chapters.zh: 耶和华必使你从锡安伸出能力的杖来。你要在你仇敌中掌权。

chapters.en: Your troops will be willing on your day of battle. Arrayed in holy splendor, your young men will come to you like dew from the morning’s womb.
chapters.zh: 当你掌权的日子（或作行军的日子），你的民要以圣洁的妆饰为衣（或作以圣洁为妆饰），甘心牺牲自己。你的民多如清晨的甘露（或作你少年时光耀如清晨的甘露）。

chapters.en: The LORD has sworn and will not change his mind: “You are a priest forever, in the order of Melchizedek.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华起了誓，决不后悔，说，你是照着麦基洗德的等次，永远为祭司。

chapters.en: The Lord is at your right hand ; he will crush kings on the day of his wrath.
chapters.zh: 在你右边的主，当他发怒的日子，必打伤列王。

chapters.en: He will judge the nations, heaping up the dead and crushing the rulers of the whole earth.
chapters.zh: 他要在列邦中刑罚恶人，尸首就遍满各处。他要在许多国中打破仇敌的头

chapters.en: He will drink from a brook along the way,and so he will lift his head high.
chapters.zh: 他要喝路旁的河水，因此必抬起头来。

chapters.en: Praise the LORD.I will extol the LORD with all my heart in the council of the upright and in the assembly.
chapters.zh: 你们要赞美耶和华。我要在正直人的大会中，并公会中，一心称谢耶和华。

chapters.en: Great are the works of the LORD; they are pondered by all who delight in them.
chapters.zh: 耶和华的作为本为大。凡喜爱的都必考察。

chapters.en: Glorious and majestic are his deeds, and his righteousness endures forever.
chapters.zh: 他所行的是尊荣和威严。他的公义存到永远。

chapters.en: He has caused his wonders to be remembered; the LORD is gracious and compassionate.
chapters.zh: 他行了奇事，使人记念。耶和华有恩惠，有怜悯。

chapters.en: He provides food for those who fear him; he remembers his covenant forever.
chapters.zh: 他赐粮食给敬畏他的人。他必永远记念他的约。

chapters.en: He has shown his people the power of his works, giving them the lands of other nations.
chapters.zh: 他向百姓显出大能的作为，把外邦的地赐给他们为业。

chapters.en: The works of his hands are faithful and just; all his precepts are trustworthy.
chapters.zh: 他手所行的，是诚实公平。他的训词都是确实的。

chapters.en: They are established for ever and ever, enacted in faithfulness and uprightness.
chapters.zh: 是永永远远坚定的，是按诚实正直设立的。

chapters.en: He provided redemption for his people; he ordained his covenant forever— holy and awesome is his name.
chapters.zh: 他向百姓施行救赎，命定他的约，直到永远。他的名圣而可畏。

chapters.en: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom; all who follow his precepts have good understanding. To him belongs eternal praise.
chapters.zh: 敬畏耶和华是智慧得开端。凡遵行他命令的，是聪明人。耶和华是永远当赞美的

chapters.en: Praise the LORD.Blessed are those who fear the LORD, who find great delight in his commands.
chapters.zh: 你们要赞美耶和华。敬畏耶和华，甚喜爱他命令的，这人便为有福。

chapters.en: Their children will be mighty in the land; the generation of the upright will be blessed.
chapters.zh: 他的后裔在世必强盛。正直人的后代，必要蒙福。

chapters.en: Wealth and riches are in their houses, and their righteousness endures forever.
chapters.zh: 他家中有货物，有钱财。他的公义存到永远。

chapters.en: Even in darkness light dawns for the upright, for those who are gracious and compassionate and righteous.
chapters.zh: 正直人在黑暗中，有光向他发现。他有恩惠，有怜悯，有公义。

chapters.en: Good will come to those who are generous and lend freely, who conduct their affairs with justice.
chapters.zh: 施恩与人，借贷与人的，这人事情顺利。他被审判的时候，要诉明自己的冤。

chapters.en: Surely the righteous will never be shaken; they will be remembered forever.
chapters.zh: 他永不动摇。义人被记念，直到永远。

chapters.en: They will have no fear of bad news; their hearts are steadfast, trusting in the LORD.
chapters.zh: 他必不怕凶恶的信息。他心坚定，倚靠耶和华。

chapters.en: Their hearts are secure, they will have no fear; in the end they will look in triumph on their foes.
chapters.zh: 他心确定，总不惧怕，直到他看见敌人遭报。

chapters.en: They have freely scattered their gifts to the poor, their righteousness endures forever; their horn will be lifted high in honor.
chapters.zh: 他施舍钱财，周济贫穷。他的仁义存到永远。他的角必被高举，大有荣耀。

chapters.en: The wicked will see and be vexed, they will gnash their teeth and waste away; the longings of the wicked will come to nothing.
chapters.zh: 恶人看见便恼恨。必咬牙而消化。恶人的心愿，要归灭绝。

chapters.en: Praise the LORD.Praise the LORD, you his servants; praise the name of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 你们要赞美耶和华。耶和华的仆人哪，你们要赞美，赞美耶和华的名。

chapters.en: Let the name of the LORD be praised, both now and forevermore.
chapters.zh: 耶和华的名，是应当称颂的，从今时直到永远。

chapters.en: From the rising of the sun to the place where it sets, the name of the LORD is to be praised.
chapters.zh: 从日出之地，到日落之处，耶和华的名是应当赞美的。

chapters.en: The LORD is exalted over all the nations, his glory above the heavens.
chapters.zh: 耶和华超乎万民之上。他的荣耀高过诸天。

chapters.en: Who is like the LORD our God, the One who sits enthroned on high,
chapters.zh: 谁像耶和华我们的神呢？他坐在至高之处，

chapters.en: who stoops down to look on the heavens and the earth?
chapters.zh: 自己谦卑，观看天上地下的事。

chapters.en: He raises the poor from the dust and lifts the needy from the ash heap;
chapters.zh: 他从灰尘里抬举贫寒人，从粪堆中提拔穷乏人。

chapters.en: he seats them with princes, with the princes of his people.
chapters.zh: 使他们与王子同坐，就是与本国的王子同坐。

chapters.en: He settles the childless woman in her home as a happy mother of children. Praise the LORD.
chapters.zh: 他使不能生育的妇人安居家中，为多子的乐母。你们要赞美耶和华。

chapters.en: When Israel came out of Egypt, Jacob from a people of foreign tongue,
chapters.zh: 以色列出了埃及，雅各家离开说异言之民。

chapters.en: Judah became God’s sanctuary, Israel his dominion.
chapters.zh: 那时，犹大为主的圣所，以色列为他所治理的国度。

chapters.en: The sea looked and fled, the Jordan turned back;
chapters.zh: 沧海看见就奔逃。约旦河也倒流。

chapters.en: the mountains leaped like rams, the hills like lambs.
chapters.zh: 大山踊跃，如公羊。小山跳舞，如羊羔。

chapters.en: Why was it, sea, that you fled? Why, Jordan, did you turn back?
chapters.zh: 沧海阿，你为何奔逃。约旦哪，你为何倒流。

chapters.en: Why, mountains, did you leap like rams, you hills, like lambs?
chapters.zh: 大山哪，你为何踊跃，如公羊。小山哪，你为何跳舞，如羊羔。

chapters.en: Tremble, earth, at the presence of the Lord, at the presence of the God of Jacob,
chapters.zh: 大地阿，你因见主的面，就是雅各神的面，便要震动。

chapters.en: who turned the rock into a pool, the hard rock into springs of water.
chapters.zh: 他叫磐石变为水池，叫坚石变为泉源。

chapters.en: Not to us, LORD, not to us but to your name be the glory, because of your love and faithfulness.
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，荣耀不要归与我们，不要归与我们。要因你的慈爱和诚实归在你的名下。

chapters.en: Why do the nations say, “Where is their God?”
chapters.zh: 为何容外邦人说，他们的神在哪里呢？

chapters.en: Our God is in heaven; he does whatever pleases him.
chapters.zh: 然而，我们的神在天上。都随自己的意旨行事。

chapters.en: But their idols are silver and gold, made by human hands.
chapters.zh: 他们的偶像，是金的，银的，是人手所造的。

chapters.en: They have mouths, but cannot speak, eyes, but cannot see.
chapters.zh: 有口却不能言，有眼却不能看。

chapters.en: They have ears, but cannot hear, noses, but cannot smell.
chapters.zh: 有耳却不能听。有鼻却不能闻。

chapters.en: They have hands, but cannot feel, feet, but cannot walk, nor can they utter a sound with their throats.
chapters.zh: 有手却不能摸。有脚却不能走。有喉咙也不能出声。

chapters.en: Those who make them will be like them, and so will all who trust in them.
chapters.zh: 造他的要和他一样。凡靠他的也要如此。

chapters.en: All you Israelites, trust in the LORD— he is their help and shield.
chapters.zh: 以色列阿，你要倚靠耶和华。他是你的帮助，和你的盾牌。

chapters.en: House of Aaron, trust in the LORD— he is their help and shield.
chapters.zh: 亚伦家阿，你们要倚靠耶和华。他是你们的帮助，和你们的盾牌。

chapters.en: You who fear him, trust in the LORD— he is their help and shield.
chapters.zh: 你们敬畏耶和华的，要倚靠耶和华。他是你们的帮助，和你们的盾牌。

chapters.en: The LORD remembers us and will bless us: He will bless his people Israel, he will bless the house of Aaron,
chapters.zh: 耶和华向来眷念我们。他还要赐福给我们，要赐福给以色列的家，赐福给亚伦的家。

chapters.en: he will bless those who fear the LORD— small and great alike.
chapters.zh: 凡敬畏耶和华的，无论大小，主必赐福给他。

chapters.en: May the LORD cause you to flourish, both you and your children.
chapters.zh: 愿耶和华叫你们和你们的子孙，日见加增。

chapters.en: May you be blessed by the LORD, the Maker of heaven and earth.
chapters.zh: 你们蒙了造天地之耶和华的福。

chapters.en: The highest heavens belong to the LORD, but the earth he has given to mankind.
chapters.zh: 天，是耶和华的天。地，他却给了世人。

chapters.en: It is not the dead who praise the LORD, those who go down to the place of silence;
chapters.zh: 死人不能赞美耶和华。下到寂静中的也都不能。

chapters.en: it is we who extol the LORD, both now and forevermore. Praise the LORD.
chapters.zh: 但我们要称颂耶和华，从今时直到永远。你们要赞美耶和华。

chapters.en: I love the LORD, for he heard my voice; he heard my cry for mercy.
chapters.zh: 我爱耶和华，因为他听了我的声音，和我的恳求。

chapters.en: Because he turned his ear to me, I will call on him as long as I live.
chapters.zh: 他既向我侧耳，我一生要求告他。

chapters.en: The cords of death entangled me, the anguish of the grave came over me; I was overcome by distress and sorrow.
chapters.zh: 死亡的绳索缠绕我，阴间的痛苦抓住我。我遭遇患难愁苦。

chapters.en: Then I called on the name of the LORD: “LORD, save me!”
chapters.zh: 那时，我便求告耶和华的名，说，耶和华阿，求你救我的灵魂。

chapters.en: The LORD is gracious and righteous; our God is full of compassion.
chapters.zh: 耶和华有恩惠，有公义。我们的神以怜悯为怀。

chapters.en: The LORD protects the unwary; when I was brought low, he saved me.
chapters.zh: 耶和华保护愚人。我落到卑微的地步，他救了我。

chapters.en: Return to your rest, my soul, for the LORD has been good to you.
chapters.zh: 我的心哪，你要仍归安乐，因为耶和华用厚恩待你。

chapters.en: For you, LORD, have delivered me from death, my eyes from tears, my feet from stumbling,
chapters.zh: 主阿，你救我的命，免了死亡，救我的眼，免了流泪，救我的脚，免了跌倒。

chapters.en: that I may walk before the LORD in the land of the living.
chapters.zh: 我要在耶和华面前，行活人之路。

chapters.en: I trusted in the LORD when I said, “I am greatly afflicted”;
chapters.zh: 我因信，所以如此说话。我受了极大的困苦。

chapters.en: in my alarm I said, “Everyone is a liar.”
chapters.zh: 我曾急促地说，人都是说谎的。

chapters.en: What shall I return to the LORD for all his goodness to me?
chapters.zh: 我拿什么报答耶和华向我所赐的一切厚恩。

chapters.en: I will lift up the cup of salvation and call on the name of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 我要举起救恩的杯，称扬耶和华的名。

chapters.en: I will fulfill my vows to the LORD in the presence of all his people.
chapters.zh: 我要在他众民面前向耶和华还我的愿。

chapters.en: Precious in the sight of the LORD is the death of his faithful servants.
chapters.zh: 在耶和华眼中，看圣民之死，极为宝贵。

chapters.en: Truly I am your servant, LORD; I serve you just as my mother did; you have freed me from my chains.
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，我真是你的仆人。我是你的仆人，是你婢女的儿子。你已经解开我的绑索。

chapters.en: I will sacrifice a thank offering to you and call on the name of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 我要以感谢为祭献给你，又要求告耶和华的名。

chapters.en: I will fulfill my vows to the LORD in the presence of all his people,
chapters.zh: 我要在他众民面前，在耶和华殿的院内，在耶路撒冷当中，向耶和华还我的愿。你们要赞美耶和华。

chapters.en: in the courts of the house of the LORD— in your midst, Jerusalem. Praise the LORD.
Praise the LORD, all you nations; extol him, all you peoples.
chapters.zh: 万国阿，你们都当赞美耶和华。万民哪，你们都当颂赞他。

chapters.en: For great is his love toward us, and the faithfulness of the LORD endures forever. Praise the LORD.
chapters.zh: 因为他向我们大施慈爱。耶和华的诚实存到永远。你们要赞美耶和华。

chapters.en: Give thanks to the LORD, for he is good; his love endures forever.
chapters.zh: 你们要称谢耶和华，因他本为善。他的慈爱永远长存。

chapters.en: Let Israel say: “His love endures forever.”
chapters.zh: 愿以色列说，他的慈爱永远长存。

chapters.en: Let the house of Aaron say: “His love endures forever.”
chapters.zh: 愿亚伦的家说，他的慈爱永远长存。

chapters.en: Let those who fear the LORD say: “His love endures forever.”
chapters.zh: 愿敬畏耶和华的说，他的慈爱永远长存。

chapters.en: When hard pressed, I cried to the LORD; he brought me into a spacious place.
chapters.zh: 我在急难中求告耶和华，他就应允我，把我安置在宽阔之地。

chapters.en: The LORD is with me; I will not be afraid. What can mere mortals do to me?
chapters.zh: 有耶和华帮助我。我必不惧怕。人能把我怎么样呢？

chapters.en: The LORD is with me; he is my helper. I look in triumph on my enemies.
chapters.zh: 在那帮助我的人中，有耶和华帮助我，所以我要看见那恨我的人遭报。

chapters.en: It is better to take refuge in the LORD than to trust in humans.
chapters.zh: 投靠耶和华，强似倚赖人。

chapters.en: It is better to take refuge in the LORD than to trust in princes.
chapters.zh: 投靠耶和华，强似倚赖王子。

chapters.en: All the nations surrounded me, but in the name of the LORD I cut them down.
chapters.zh: 万民围绕我。我靠耶和华的名，必剿灭他们。

chapters.en: They surrounded me on every side, but in the name of the LORD I cut them down.
chapters.zh: 他们环绕我，围困我。我靠耶和华的名，必剿灭他们。

chapters.en: They swarmed around me like bees, but they were consumed as quickly as burning thorns; in the name of the LORD I cut them down.
chapters.zh: 他们如同蜂子围绕我，好像烧荆棘的火，必被熄灭。我靠耶和华的名，必剿灭他们。

chapters.en: I was pushed back and about to fall, but the LORD helped me.
chapters.zh: 你推我，要叫我跌倒，但耶和华帮助了我。

chapters.en: The LORD is my strength and my defense ; he has become my salvation.
chapters.zh: 耶和华是我的力量，是我的诗歌。他也成了我的拯救。

chapters.en: Shouts of joy and victory resound in the tents of the righteous: “The LORD’s right hand has done mighty things!
chapters.zh: 在义人的帐棚里，有欢呼拯救的声音。耶和华的右手施展大能。

chapters.en: The LORD’s right hand is lifted high; the LORD’s right hand has done mighty things!”
chapters.zh: 耶和华的右手高举。耶和华的右手施展大能。

chapters.en: I will not die but live, and will proclaim what the LORD has done.
chapters.zh: 我必不至死，仍要存活，并要传扬耶和华的作为。

chapters.en: The LORD has chastened me severely, but he has not given me over to death.
chapters.zh: 耶和华虽严严地惩治我，却未曾将我交于死亡。

chapters.en: Open for me the gates of the righteous; I will enter and give thanks to the LORD.
chapters.zh: 给我敞开义门。我要进去称谢耶和华。

chapters.en: This is the gate of the LORD through which the righteous may enter.
chapters.zh: 这是耶和华的门。义人要进去。

chapters.en: I will give you thanks, for you answered me; you have become my salvation.
chapters.zh: 我要称谢你，因为你已经应允我，又成了我的拯救。

chapters.en: The stone the builders rejected has become the cornerstone;
chapters.zh: 匠人所弃的石头，已成了房角的头块石头。

chapters.en: the LORD has done this, and it is marvelous in our eyes.
chapters.zh: 这是耶和华所做的，在我们眼中看为希奇。

chapters.en: The LORD has done it this very day; let us rejoice today and be glad.
chapters.zh: 这是耶和华所定的日子。我们在其中要高兴欢喜。

chapters.en: LORD, save us! LORD, grant us success!
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，求你拯救。耶和华阿，求你使我们亨通。

chapters.en: Blessed is he who comes in the name of the LORD. From the house of the LORD we bless you.
chapters.zh: 奉耶和华名来的，是应当称颂的。我们从耶和华的殿中，为你们祝福。

chapters.en: The LORD is God, and he has made his light shine on us. With boughs in hand, join in the festal procession up to the horns of the altar.
chapters.zh: 耶和华是神。他光照了我们。理当用绳索把祭牲拴住，牵到坛角那里。

chapters.en: You are my God, and I will praise you; you are my God, and I will exalt you.
chapters.zh: 你是我的神，我要称谢你。你是我的神，我要尊崇你。

chapters.en: Give thanks to the LORD, for he is good; his love endures forever.
chapters.zh: 你们要称谢耶和华，因他本为善。他的慈爱永远长存。

chapters.en: Blessed are those whose ways are blameless, who walk according to the law of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 行为完全，遵行耶和华律法的，这人便为有福。

chapters.en: Blessed are those who keep his statutes and seek him with all their heart—
chapters.zh: 遵守他的法度，一心寻求他的，这人便为有福。

chapters.en: they do no wrong but follow his ways.
chapters.zh: 这人不做非义的事，但遵行他的道。

chapters.en: You have laid down precepts that are to be fully obeyed.
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，你曾将你的训词吩咐我们，为要我们殷勤遵守。

chapters.en: Oh, that my ways were steadfast in obeying your decrees!
chapters.zh: 但愿我行事坚定，得以遵守你的律例。

chapters.en: Then I would not be put to shame when I consider all your commands.
chapters.zh: 我看重你的一切命令，就不至于羞愧。

chapters.en: I will praise you with an upright heart as I learn your righteous laws.
chapters.zh: 我学了你公义的判语，就要以正直的心称谢你。

chapters.en: I will obey your decrees; do not utterly forsake me.
chapters.zh: 我必守你的律例。求你总不要丢弃我。

chapters.en: How can a young person stay on the path of purity? By living according to your word.
chapters.zh: 少年人用什么洁净他的行为呢？是要遵行你的话。

chapters.en: I seek you with all my heart; do not let me stray from your commands.
chapters.zh: 我一心寻求了你。求你不要叫我偏离你的命令。

chapters.en: I have hidden your word in my heart that I might not sin against you.
chapters.zh: 我将你的话藏在心里，免得我得罪你。

chapters.en: Praise be to you, LORD; teach me your decrees.
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，你是应当称颂的。求你将你的律例教训我。

chapters.en: With my lips I recount all the laws that come from your mouth.
chapters.zh: 我用嘴唇传扬你口中的一切典章。

chapters.en: I rejoice in following your statutes as one rejoices in great riches.
chapters.zh: 我喜悦你的法度，如同喜悦一切的财物。

chapters.en: I meditate on your precepts and consider your ways.
chapters.zh: 我要默想你的训词，看重你的道路。

chapters.en: I delight in your decrees; I will not neglect your word.
chapters.zh: 我要在你的律例中自乐。我不忘记你的话。

chapters.en: Be good to your servant while I live, that I may obey your word.
chapters.zh: 求你用厚恩待你的仆人，使我存活。我就遵守你的话。

chapters.en: Open my eyes that I may see wonderful things in your law.
chapters.zh: 求你开我的眼睛，使我看出你律法中的奇妙。

chapters.en: I am a stranger on earth; do not hide your commands from me.
chapters.zh: 我是在地上作寄居的。求你不要向我隐瞒你的命令。

chapters.en: My soul is consumed with longing for your laws at all times.
chapters.zh: 我时常切慕你的典章，甚至心碎。

chapters.en: You rebuke the arrogant, who are accursed, those who stray from your commands.
chapters.zh: 受咒诅偏离你命令的骄傲人，你已经责备他们。

chapters.en: Remove from me their scorn and contempt, for I keep your statutes.
chapters.zh: 求你除掉我所受的羞辱和藐视。因我遵守你的法度。

chapters.en: Though rulers sit together and slander me, your servant will meditate on your decrees.
chapters.zh: 虽有首领坐着妄论我。你仆人却思想你的律例。

chapters.en: Your statutes are my delight; they are my counselors.
chapters.zh: 你的法度，是我所喜乐的，是我的谋士。

chapters.en: I am laid low in the dust; preserve my life according to your word.
chapters.zh: 我的性命几乎归于尘土。求你照你的话，将我救活。

chapters.en: I gave an account of my ways and you answered me; teach me your decrees.
chapters.zh: 我述说我所行的，你应允了我。求你将你的律例教训我。

chapters.en: Cause me to understand the way of your precepts, that I may meditate on your wonderful deeds.
chapters.zh: 求你使我明白你的训词，我就思想你的奇事。

chapters.en: My soul is weary with sorrow; strengthen me according to your word.
chapters.zh: 我的心因愁苦而消化。求你照你的话使我坚立。

chapters.en: Keep me from deceitful ways; be gracious to me and teach me your law.
chapters.zh: 求你使我离开奸诈的道，开恩将你的律法赐给我。

chapters.en: I have chosen the way of faithfulness; I have set my heart on your laws.
chapters.zh: 我拣选了忠信的道，将你的典章摆在我面前。

chapters.en: I hold fast to your statutes, LORD; do not let me be put to shame.
chapters.zh: 我持守你的法度。耶和华阿，求你不要叫我羞愧。

chapters.en: I run in the path of your commands, for you have broadened my understanding.
chapters.zh: 你开广我心的时候，我就往你命令的道上直奔。

chapters.en: Teach me, LORD, the way of your decrees, that I may follow it to the end.
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，求你将你的律例指教我，我必遵守到底。

chapters.en: Give me understanding, so that I may keep your law and obey it with all my heart.
chapters.zh: 求你赐我悟性，我便遵守你的律法。且要一心遵守。

chapters.en: Direct me in the path of your commands, for there I find delight.
chapters.zh: 求你叫我遵行你的命令。因为这是我所喜乐的。

chapters.en: Turn my heart toward your statutes and not toward selfish gain.
chapters.zh: 求你使我的心，趋向你的法度，不趋向非义之财。

chapters.en: Turn my eyes away from worthless things; preserve my life according to your word.
chapters.zh: 求你叫我转眼不看虚假，又叫我在你的道中生活。

chapters.en: Fulfill your promise to your servant, so that you may be feared.
chapters.zh: 你向敬畏你的人所应许的话，求你向仆人坚定。

chapters.en: Take away the disgrace I dread, for your laws are good.
chapters.zh: 求你使我所怕的羞辱远离我，因你的典章本为美。

chapters.en: How I long for your precepts! In your righteousness preserve my life.
chapters.zh: 我羡慕你的训词。求你使我在你的公义上生活。

chapters.en: May your unfailing love come to me, LORD, your salvation, according to your promise;
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，愿你照你的话，使你的慈爱，就是你的救恩，临到我身上。

chapters.en: then I can answer anyone who taunts me, for I trust in your word.
chapters.zh: 我就有话回答那羞辱我的。因我倚靠你的话。

chapters.en: Never take your word of truth from my mouth, for I have put my hope in your laws.
chapters.zh: 求你叫真理的话，总不离开我口。因我仰望你的典章。

chapters.en: I will always obey your law, for ever and ever.
chapters.zh: 我要常守你的律法，直到永永远远。

chapters.en: I will walk about in freedom, for I have sought out your precepts.
chapters.zh: 我要自由而行（或作我要行在宽阔之地）。因我素来考究你的训词。

chapters.en: I will speak of your statutes before kings and will not be put to shame,
chapters.zh: 我也要在君王面前，论说你的法度，并不至于羞愧。

chapters.en: for I delight in your commands because I love them.
chapters.zh: 我要在你的命令中自乐。这命令素来是我所爱的。

chapters.en: I reach out for your commands, which I love, that I may meditate on your decrees.
chapters.zh: 我又要遵行（原文作举手）你的命令。这命令素来是我所爱的。我也要思想你的律例。

chapters.en: Remember your word to your servant, for you have given me hope.
chapters.zh: 求你记念向你仆人所应许的话，叫我有盼望。

chapters.en: My comfort in my suffering is this: Your promise preserves my life.
chapters.zh: 这话将我救活了。我在患难中，因此得安慰。

chapters.en: The arrogant mock me unmercifully, but I do not turn from your law.
chapters.zh: 骄傲的人甚侮慢我。我却未曾偏离你的律法。

chapters.en: I remember, LORD, your ancient laws, and I find comfort in them.
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，我记念你从古以来的典章，就得了安慰。

chapters.en: Indignation grips me because of the wicked, who have forsaken your law.
chapters.zh: 我见恶人离弃你的律法，就怒气发作，犹如火烧。

chapters.en: Your decrees are the theme of my song wherever I lodge.
chapters.zh: 我在世寄居，素来以你的律例为诗歌。

chapters.en: In the night, LORD, I remember your name, that I may keep your law.
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，我夜间记念你的名，遵守你的律法。

chapters.en: This has been my practice: I obey your precepts.
chapters.zh: 我所以如此，是因我守你的训词。

chapters.en: You are my portion, LORD; I have promised to obey your words.
chapters.zh: 耶和华是我的福分。我曾说，我要遵守你的言语。

chapters.en: I have sought your face with all my heart; be gracious to me according to your promise.
chapters.zh: 我一心求过你的恩。愿你照你的话怜悯我。

chapters.en: I have considered my ways and have turned my steps to your statutes.
chapters.zh: 我思想我所行的道，就转步归向你的法度。

chapters.en: I will hasten and not delay to obey your commands.
chapters.zh: 我急忙遵守你的命令，并不迟延。

chapters.en: Though the wicked bind me with ropes, I will not forget your law.
chapters.zh: 恶人的绳索缠绕我。我却没有忘记你的律法。

chapters.en: At midnight I rise to give you thanks for your righteous laws.
chapters.zh: 我因你公义的典章，半夜必起来称谢你。

chapters.en: I am a friend to all who fear you, to all who follow your precepts.
chapters.zh: 凡敬畏你，守你训词的人，我都与他作伴。

chapters.en: The earth is filled with your love, LORD; teach me your decrees.
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，你的慈爱遍满大地。求你将你的律例教训我。

chapters.en: Do good to your servant according to your word, LORD.
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，你向来是照你的话善待仆人。

chapters.en: Teach me knowledge and good judgment, for I trust your commands.
chapters.zh: 求你将精明和知识赐给我。因我信了你的命令。

chapters.en: Before I was afflicted I went astray, but now I obey your word.
chapters.zh: 我未受苦以先，走迷了路，现在却遵守你的话。

chapters.en: You are good, and what you do is good; teach me your decrees.
chapters.zh: 你本为善，所行的也善。求你将你的律例教训我。

chapters.en: Though the arrogant have smeared me with lies, I keep your precepts with all my heart.
chapters.zh: 骄傲人编造谎言攻击我。我却要一心守你的训词。

chapters.en: Their hearts are callous and unfeeling, but I delight in your law.
chapters.zh: 他们心蒙脂油。我却喜爱你的律法。

chapters.en: It was good for me to be afflicted so that I might learn your decrees.
chapters.zh: 我受苦是与我有益，为要使我学习你的律例。

chapters.en: The law from your mouth is more precious to me than thousands of pieces of silver and gold.
chapters.zh: 你口中的训言（或作律法），与我有益，胜于千万的金银。

chapters.en: Your hands made me and formed me; give me understanding to learn your commands.
chapters.zh: 你的手制造我，建立我。求你赐我悟性，可以学习你的命令。

chapters.en: May those who fear you rejoice when they see me, for I have put my hope in your word.
chapters.zh: 敬畏你的人见我，就要欢喜。因我仰望你的话。

chapters.en: I know, LORD, that your laws are righteous, and that in faithfulness you have afflicted me.
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，我知道你的判语是公义的。你使我受苦，是以诚实待我。

chapters.en: May your unfailing love be my comfort, according to your promise to your servant.
chapters.zh: 求你照着应许仆人的话，以慈爱安慰我。

chapters.en: Let your compassion come to me that I may live, for your law is my delight.
chapters.zh: 愿你的慈悲临到我，使我存活。因你的律法是我所喜爱的。

chapters.en: May the arrogant be put to shame for wronging me without cause; but I will meditate on your precepts.
chapters.zh: 愿骄傲人蒙羞。因为他们无理地倾覆我。但我要思想你的训词。

chapters.en: May those who fear you turn to me, those who understand your statutes.
chapters.zh: 愿敬畏你的人归向我，他们就知道你的法度。

chapters.en: May I wholeheartedly follow your decrees, that I may not be put to shame.
chapters.zh: 愿我的心在你的律例上完全，使我不至蒙羞。

chapters.en: My soul faints with longing for your salvation, but I have put my hope in your word.
chapters.zh: 我心渴想你的救恩，仰望你的应许。

chapters.en: My eyes fail, looking for your promise; I say, “When will you comfort me?”
chapters.zh: 我因盼望你的应许，眼睛失明，说，你何时安慰我。

chapters.en: Though I am like a wineskin in the smoke, I do not forget your decrees.
chapters.zh: 我好像烟薰的皮袋。却不忘记你的律例。

chapters.en: How long must your servant wait? When will you punish my persecutors?
chapters.zh: 你仆人的年日有多少呢？你几时向逼迫我的人施行审判呢？

chapters.en: The arrogant dig pits to trap me, contrary to your law.
chapters.zh: 不从你律法的骄傲人，为我掘了坑。

chapters.en: All your commands are trustworthy; help me, for I am being persecuted without cause.
chapters.zh: 你的命令尽都诚实。他们无理地逼迫我，求你帮助我。

chapters.en: They almost wiped me from the earth, but I have not forsaken your precepts.
chapters.zh: 他们几乎把我从世上灭绝，但我没有离弃你的训词。

chapters.en: In your unfailing love preserve my life, that I may obey the statutes of your mouth.
chapters.zh: 求你照你的慈爱将我救活。我就遵守你口中的法度。

chapters.en: Your word, LORD, is eternal; it stands firm in the heavens.
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，你的话安定在天，直到永远。

chapters.en: Your faithfulness continues through all generations; you established the earth, and it endures.
chapters.zh: 你的诚实存到万代。你坚定了地，地就长存。

chapters.en: Your laws endure to this day, for all things serve you.
chapters.zh: 天地照你的安排，存到今日。万物都是你的仆役。

chapters.en: If your law had not been my delight, I would have perished in my affliction.
chapters.zh: 我若不是喜爱你的律法，早就在苦难中灭绝了。

chapters.en: I will never forget your precepts, for by them you have preserved my life.
chapters.zh: 我永不忘记你的训词。因你用这训词将我救活了。

chapters.en: Save me, for I am yours; I have sought out your precepts.
chapters.zh: 我是属你的，求你救我，因我寻求了你的训词。

chapters.en: The wicked are waiting to destroy me, but I will ponder your statutes.
chapters.zh: 恶人等待我，要灭绝我，我却要揣摩你的法度。

chapters.en: To all perfection I see a limit, but your commands are boundless.
chapters.zh: 我看万事尽都有限。惟有你的命令，极其宽广。

chapters.en: Oh, how I love your law! I meditate on it all day long.
chapters.zh: 我何等爱慕你的律法，终日不住地思想。

chapters.en: Your commands are always with me and make me wiser than my enemies.
chapters.zh: 你的命令常存在我心里，使我比仇敌有智慧。

chapters.en: I have more insight than all my teachers, for I meditate on your statutes.
chapters.zh: 我比我的师傅更通达。因我思想你的法度。

chapters.en: I have more understanding than the elders, for I obey your precepts.
chapters.zh: 我比年老的更明白，因我守了你的训词。

chapters.en: I have kept my feet from every evil path so that I might obey your word.
chapters.zh: 我禁止我脚走一切的邪路，为要遵守你的话。

chapters.en: I have not departed from your laws, for you yourself have taught me.
chapters.zh: 我没有偏离你的典章，因为你教训了我。

chapters.en: How sweet are your words to my taste, sweeter than honey to my mouth!
chapters.zh: 你的言语，在我上膛何等甘美。在我口中比蜜更甜。

chapters.en: I gain understanding from your precepts; therefore I hate every wrong path.
chapters.zh: 我借着你的训词，得以明白。所以我恨一切的假道。

chapters.en: Your word is a lamp for my feet, a light on my path.
chapters.zh: 你的话是我脚前的灯，是我路上的光。

chapters.en: I have taken an oath and confirmed it, that I will follow your righteous laws.
chapters.zh: 你公义的典章，我曾起誓遵守，我必按誓而行。

chapters.en: I have suffered much; preserve my life, LORD, according to your word.
chapters.zh: 我甚是受苦。耶和华阿，求你照你的话将我救活。

chapters.en: Accept, LORD, the willing praise of my mouth, and teach me your laws.
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，求你悦纳我口中的赞美为供物，又将你的典章教训我。

chapters.en: Though I constantly take my life in my hands, I will not forget your law.
chapters.zh: 我的性命常在危险之中，我却不忘记你的律法。

chapters.en: The wicked have set a snare for me, but I have not strayed from your precepts.
chapters.zh: 恶人为我设下网罗。我却没有偏离你的训词。

chapters.en: Your statutes are my heritage forever; they are the joy of my heart.
chapters.zh: 我以你的法度为永远的产业。因这是我心中所喜爱的。

chapters.en: My heart is set on keeping your decrees to the very end.
chapters.zh: 我的心专向你的律例，永远遵行，一直到底。

chapters.en: I hate double-minded people, but I love your law.
chapters.zh: 心怀二意的人，为我所恨。但你的律法，为我所爱。

chapters.en: You are my refuge and my shield; I have put my hope in your word.
chapters.zh: 你是我藏身之处，又是我的盾牌。我甚仰望你的话语。

chapters.en: Away from me, you evildoers, that I may keep the commands of my God!
chapters.zh: 作恶的人哪，你们离开我吧，我好遵守我神的命令。

chapters.en: Sustain me, my God, according to your promise, and I will live; do not let my hopes be dashed.
chapters.zh: 求你照你的话扶持我，使我存活，也不叫我因失望而害羞。

chapters.en: Uphold me, and I will be delivered; I will always have regard for your decrees.
chapters.zh: 求你扶持我，我便得救，时常看重你的律例。

chapters.en: You reject all who stray from your decrees, for their delusions come to nothing.
chapters.zh: 凡偏离你律例的人，你都轻弃他们。因为他们的诡诈必归虚空。

chapters.en: All the wicked of the earth you discard like dross; therefore I love your statutes.
chapters.zh: 凡地上的恶人，你除掉他，好像除掉渣滓。因此我爱你的法度。

chapters.en: My flesh trembles in fear of you; I stand in awe of your laws.
chapters.zh: 我因惧怕你，肉就发抖。我也怕你的判语。

chapters.en: I have done what is righteous and just; do not leave me to my oppressors.
chapters.zh: 我行过公平和公义。求你不要撇下我给欺压我的人。

chapters.en: Ensure your servant’s well-being; do not let the arrogant oppress me.
chapters.zh: 求你为仆人作保，使我得好处。不容骄傲人欺压我。

chapters.en: My eyes fail, looking for your salvation, looking for your righteous promise.
chapters.zh: 我因盼望你的救恩，和你公义的话，眼睛失明。

chapters.en: Deal with your servant according to your love and teach me your decrees.
chapters.zh: 求你照你的慈爱待仆人，将你的律例教训我。

chapters.en: I am your servant; give me discernment that I may understand your statutes.
chapters.zh: 我是你的仆人。求你赐我悟性，使我得知你的法度。

chapters.en: It is time for you to act, LORD; your law is being broken.
chapters.zh: 这是耶和华降罚的时候，因人废了你的律法。

chapters.en: Because I love your commands more than gold, more than pure gold,
chapters.zh: 所以，我爱你的命令胜于金子，更胜于精金。

chapters.en: and because I consider all your precepts right, I hate every wrong path.
chapters.zh: 你一切的训词，在万事上我都以为正直。我却恨恶一切假道。

chapters.en: Your statutes are wonderful; therefore I obey them.
chapters.zh: 你的法度奇妙，所以我一心谨守。

chapters.en: The unfolding of your words gives light; it gives understanding to the simple.
chapters.zh: 你的言语一解开，就发出亮光，使愚人通达。

chapters.en: I open my mouth and pant, longing for your commands.
chapters.zh: 我张口而气喘。因我切慕你的命令。

chapters.en: Turn to me and have mercy on me, as you always do to those who love your name.
chapters.zh: 求你转向我，怜悯我，好象你素常待那些爱你名的人。

chapters.en: Direct my footsteps according to your word; let no sin rule over me.
chapters.zh: 求你用你的话，使我脚步稳当，不许什么罪孽辖制我。

chapters.en: Redeem me from human oppression, that I may obey your precepts.
chapters.zh: 求你救我脱离人的欺压。我要遵守你的训词。

chapters.en: Make your face shine on your servant and teach me your decrees.
chapters.zh: 求你用脸光照仆人。又将你的律例教训我。

chapters.en: Streams of tears flow from my eyes, for your law is not obeyed.
chapters.zh: 我的眼泪下流成河，因为他们不守你的律法。

chapters.en: You are righteous, LORD, and your laws are right.
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，你是公义的，你的判语也是正直的。

chapters.en: The statutes you have laid down are righteous; they are fully trustworthy.
chapters.zh: 你所命定的法度，是凭公义和至诚。

chapters.en: My zeal wears me out, for my enemies ignore your words.
chapters.zh: 我心焦急，如同火烧，因我敌人忘记你的言语。

chapters.en: Your promises have been thoroughly tested, and your servant loves them.
chapters.zh: 你的话极其精炼。所以你的仆人喜爱。

chapters.en: Though I am lowly and despised, I do not forget your precepts.
chapters.zh: 我微小，被人藐视。却不忘记你的训词。

chapters.en: Your righteousness is everlasting and your law is true.
chapters.zh: 你的公义永远长存。你的律法尽都真实。

chapters.en: Trouble and distress have come upon me, but your commands give me delight.
chapters.zh: 我遭遇患难愁苦。你的命令却是我所喜爱的。

chapters.en: Your statutes are always righteous; give me understanding that I may live.
chapters.zh: 你的法度永远是公义的。求你赐我悟性，我就活了。

chapters.en: I call with all my heart; answer me, LORD, and I will obey your decrees.
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，我一心呼吁你。求你应允我，我必谨守你的律例。

chapters.en: I call out to you; save me and I will keep your statutes.
chapters.zh: 我向你呼吁，求你救我。我要遵守你的法度。

chapters.en: I rise before dawn and cry for help; I have put my hope in your word.
chapters.zh: 我趁天未亮呼求。我仰望了你的言语。

chapters.en: My eyes stay open through the watches of the night, that I may meditate on your promises.
chapters.zh: 我趁夜更未换，将眼睁开，为要思想你的话语。

chapters.en: Hear my voice in accordance with your love; preserve my life, LORD, according to your laws.
chapters.zh: 求你照你的慈爱听我的声音。耶和华阿，求你照你的典章，将我救活。

chapters.en: Those who devise wicked schemes are near, but they are far from your law.
chapters.zh: 追求奸恶的人临近了。他们远离你的律法。

chapters.en: Yet you are near, LORD, and all your commands are true.
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，你与我相近。你一切的命令尽都真实。

chapters.en: Long ago I learned from your statutes that you established them to last forever.
chapters.zh: 我因学你的法度，久已知道是你永远立定的。

chapters.en: Look on my suffering and deliver me, for I have not forgotten your law.
chapters.zh: 求你看顾我的苦难，搭救我，因我不忘记你的律法。

chapters.en: Defend my cause and redeem me; preserve my life according to your promise.
chapters.zh: 求你为我辨屈，救赎我，照你的话将我救活。

chapters.en: Salvation is far from the wicked, for they do not seek out your decrees.
chapters.zh: 救恩远离恶人。因为他们不寻求你的律例。

chapters.en: Your compassion, LORD, is great; preserve my life according to your laws.
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，你的慈悲本为大。求你照你的典章将我救活。

chapters.en: Many are the foes who persecute me, but I have not turned from your statutes.
chapters.zh: 逼迫我的，抵挡我的，很多，我却没有偏离你的法度。

chapters.en: I look on the faithless with loathing, for they do not obey your word.
chapters.zh: 我看见奸恶的人，就甚憎恶，因为他们不遵守你的话。

chapters.en: See how I love your precepts; preserve my life, LORD, in accordance with your love.
chapters.zh: 你看我怎样爱你的训词。耶和华阿，求你照你的慈爱将我救活。

chapters.en: All your words are true; all your righteous laws are eternal.
chapters.zh: 你话的总纲是真实。你一切公义的典章是永远长存。

chapters.en: Rulers persecute me without cause, but my heart trembles at your word.
chapters.zh: 首领无故地逼迫我。但我的心畏惧你的言语。

chapters.en: I rejoice in your promise like one who finds great spoil.
chapters.zh: 我喜爱你的话，好像人得了许多掳物。

chapters.en: I hate and detest falsehood but I love your law.
chapters.zh: 谎话是我所恨恶所憎嫌的。惟你的律法，是我所爱的。

chapters.en: Seven times a day I praise you for your righteous laws.
chapters.zh: 我因你公义的典章，一天七次赞美你。

chapters.en: Great peace have those who love your law, and nothing can make them stumble.
chapters.zh: 爱你律法的人，有大平安。什么都不能使他们绊脚。

chapters.en: I wait for your salvation, LORD, and I follow your commands.
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，我仰望了你的救恩，遵行了你的命令。

chapters.en: I obey your statutes, for I love them greatly.
chapters.zh: 我心里守了你的法度。这法度我甚喜爱。

chapters.en: I obey your precepts and your statutes, for all my ways are known to you.
chapters.zh: 我遵守了你的训词和法度。因我一切所行的，都在你面前。

chapters.en: May my cry come before you, LORD; give me understanding according to your word.
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，愿我的呼吁达到你面前，照你的话赐我悟性。

chapters.en: May my supplication come before you; deliver me according to your promise.
chapters.zh: 愿我的恳求达到你面前，照你的话搭救我。

chapters.en: May my lips overflow with praise, for you teach me your decrees.
chapters.zh: 愿我的嘴发出赞美的话。因为你将律例教训我。

chapters.en: May my tongue sing of your word, for all your commands are righteous.
chapters.zh: 愿我的舌头歌唱你的话。因你一切的命令尽都公义。

chapters.en: May your hand be ready to help me, for I have chosen your precepts.
chapters.zh: 愿你用手帮助我。因我拣选了你的训词。

chapters.en: I long for your salvation, LORD, and your law gives me delight.
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，我切慕你的救恩。你的律法也是我所喜爱的。

chapters.en: Let me live that I may praise you, and may your laws sustain me.
chapters.zh: 愿我的性命存活，得以赞美你。愿你的典章帮助我。

chapters.en: I have strayed like a lost sheep. Seek your servant, for I have not forgotten your commands.
chapters.zh: 我如亡羊走迷了路。求你寻找仆人。因我不忘记你的命令。

chapters.en: I call on the LORD in my distress, and he answers me.
chapters.zh: （上行（或作登阶。下同）之诗。）我在急难中求告耶和华，他就应允我。

chapters.en: Save me, LORD, from lying lips and from deceitful tongues.
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，求你救我脱离说谎的嘴唇，和诡诈的舌头。

chapters.en: What will he do to you, and what more besides, you deceitful tongue?
chapters.zh: 诡诈的舌头阿，要给你什么呢？要拿什么加给你呢？

chapters.en: He will punish you with a warrior’s sharp arrows, with burning coals of the broom bush.
chapters.zh: 就是勇士的利箭，和罗腾木的炭火（罗腾小树名松类）。

chapters.en: Woe to me that I dwell in Meshek, that I live among the tents of Kedar!
chapters.zh: 我寄居在米设，住在基达帐棚之中，有祸了。

chapters.en: Too long have I lived among those who hate peace.
chapters.zh: 我与那恨恶和睦的人，许久同住。

chapters.en: I am for peace; but when I speak, they are for war.
chapters.zh: 我愿和睦。但我发言，他们就要争战。

chapters.en: I lift up my eyes to the mountains— where does my help come from?
chapters.zh: （上行之诗。）我要向山举目。我的帮助从何而来。

chapters.en: My help comes from the LORD, the Maker of heaven and earth.
chapters.zh: 我的帮助从造天地的耶和华而来。

chapters.en: He will not let your foot slip— he who watches over you will not slumber;
chapters.zh: 他必不叫你的脚摇动。保护你的必不打盹。

chapters.en: indeed, he who watches over Israel will neither slumber nor sleep.
chapters.zh: 保护以色列的，也不打盹，也不睡觉。

chapters.en: The LORD watches over you— the LORD is your shade at your right hand;
chapters.zh: 保护你的是耶和华。耶和华在你右边荫庇你。

chapters.en: the sun will not harm you by day, nor the moon by night.
chapters.zh: 白日太阳必不伤你，夜间月亮必不害你。

chapters.en: The LORD will keep you from all harm— he will watch over your life;
chapters.zh: 耶和华要保护你，免受一切的灾害。他要保护你的性命。

chapters.en: the LORD will watch over your coming and going both now and forevermore.
chapters.zh: 你出你入耶和华要保护你，从今时直到永远。

chapters.en: I rejoiced with those who said to me, “Let us go to the house of the LORD.”
chapters.zh: （大卫上行之诗。）人对我说，我们往耶和华的殿去，我就欢喜。

chapters.en: Our feet are standing in your gates, Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 耶路撒冷阿，我们的脚站在你的门内。

chapters.en: Jerusalem is built like a city that is closely compacted together.
chapters.zh: 耶路撒冷被建造，如同连络整齐的一座城。

chapters.en: That is where the tribes go up— the tribes of the LORD— to praise the name of the LORD according to the statute given to Israel.
chapters.zh: 众支派，就是耶和华的支派，上那里去，按以色列的常例（或作作以色列的证据）称赞耶和华的名。

chapters.en: There stand the thrones for judgment, the thrones of the house of David.
chapters.zh: 因为在那里设立审判的宝座，就是大卫家的宝座。

chapters.en: Pray for the peace of Jerusalem: “May those who love you be secure.
chapters.zh: 你们要为耶路撒冷求平安。耶路撒冷阿，爱你的人必然兴旺。

chapters.en: May there be peace within your walls and security within your citadels.”
chapters.zh: 愿你城中平安，愿你宫内兴旺。

chapters.en: For the sake of my family and friends, I will say, “Peace be within you.”
chapters.zh: 因我弟兄和同伴的缘故，我要说，愿平安在你中间。

chapters.en: For the sake of the house of the LORD our God, I will seek your prosperity.
chapters.zh: 因耶和华我们神殿的缘故，我要为你求福。

chapters.en: I lift up my eyes to you, to you who sit enthroned in heaven.
chapters.zh: （上行之诗。）坐在天上的主阿，我向你举目。

chapters.en: As the eyes of slaves look to the hand of their master, as the eyes of a female slave look to the hand of her mistress, so our eyes look to the LORD our God, till he shows us his mercy.
chapters.zh: 看哪，仆人的眼睛怎样望主人的手，使女的眼睛怎样望主母的手，我们的眼睛也照样望耶和华我们的神，直到他怜悯我们。

chapters.en: Have mercy on us, LORD, have mercy on us, for we have endured no end of contempt.
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，求你怜悯我们，怜悯我们。因为我们被藐视，已到极处。

chapters.en: We have endured no end of ridicule from the arrogant, of contempt from the proud.
chapters.zh: 我们被那些安逸人的讥诮，和骄傲人的藐视，已到极处。

chapters.en: If the LORD had not been on our side— let Israel say—
chapters.zh: （大卫上行之诗。）以色列人要说，若不是耶和华帮助我们，

chapters.en: if the LORD had not been on our side when people attacked us,
chapters.zh: 若不是耶和华帮助我们，当人起来攻击我们，

chapters.en: they would have swallowed us alive when their anger flared against us;
chapters.zh: 向我们发怒的时候，就把我们活活地吞了。

chapters.en: the flood would have engulfed us, the torrent would have swept over us,
chapters.zh: 那时，波涛必漫过我们，河水必淹没我们。

chapters.en: the raging waters would have swept us away.
chapters.zh: 狂傲的水必淹没我们。

chapters.en: Praise be to the LORD, who has not let us be torn by their teeth.
chapters.zh: 耶和华是应当称颂的。他没有把我们当野食交给他们吞吃（原文作牙齿）。

chapters.en: We have escaped like a bird from the fowler’s snare; the snare has been broken, and we have escaped.
chapters.zh: 我们好像雀鸟，从捕鸟人的网罗里逃脱。网罗破裂，我们逃脱了。

chapters.en: Our help is in the name of the LORD, the Maker of heaven and earth.
