chapters.zh: 我们得帮助，是在乎倚靠造天地之耶和华的名。

chapters.en: Those who trust in the LORD are like Mount Zion, which cannot be shaken but endures forever.
chapters.zh: （上行之诗。）倚靠耶和华的人，好像锡安山，永不动摇。

chapters.en: As the mountains surround Jerusalem, so the LORD surrounds his people both now and forevermore.
chapters.zh: 众山怎样围绕耶路撒冷，耶和华也照样围绕他的百姓，从今时直到永远。

chapters.en: The scepter of the wicked will not remain over the land allotted to the righteous, for then the righteous might use their hands to do evil.
chapters.zh: 恶人的杖不常落在义人的分上，免得义人伸手作恶。

chapters.en: LORD, do good to those who are good, to those who are upright in heart.
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，求你善待那些为善，和心里正直的人。

chapters.en: But those who turn to crooked ways the LORD will banish with the evildoers. Peace be on Israel.
chapters.zh: 至于那偏行弯曲道路的人，耶和华必使他和作恶的人一同出去受刑。愿平安归于以色列。

chapters.en: When the LORD restored the fortunes of Zion, we were like those who dreamed.
chapters.zh: （上行之诗。）当耶和华将那些被掳的带回锡安的时候，我们好像做梦的人。

chapters.en: Our mouths were filled with laughter, our tongues with songs of joy. Then it was said among the nations, “The LORD has done great things for them.”
chapters.zh: 我们满口喜笑，满舌欢呼的时候，外邦中就有人说，耶和华为他们行了大事。

chapters.en: The LORD has done great things for us, and we are filled with joy.
chapters.zh: 耶和华果然为我们行了大事，我们就欢喜。

chapters.en: Restore our fortunes,LORD, like streams in the Negev.
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，求你使我们被掳的人归回，好像南地的河水复流。

chapters.en: Those who sow with tears will reap with songs of joy.
chapters.zh: 流泪撒种的，必欢呼收割。

chapters.en: Those who go out weeping, carrying seed to sow, will return with songs of joy, carrying sheaves with them.
chapters.zh: 那带种流泪出去的，必要欢欢乐乐地带禾捆回来。

chapters.en: Unless the LORD builds the house, the builders labor in vain. Unless the LORD watches over the city, the guards stand watch in vain.
chapters.zh: （所罗门上行之诗。）若不是耶和华建造房屋，建造的人就枉然劳力。若不是耶和华看守城池，看守的人就枉然儆醒。

chapters.en: In vain you rise early and stay up late, toiling for food to eat— for he grants sleep to those he loves.
chapters.zh: 你们清晨早起，夜晚安歇，吃劳碌得来的饭，本是枉然。惟有耶和华所亲爱的，必叫他安然睡觉。

chapters.en: Children are a heritage from the LORD, offspring a reward from him.
chapters.zh: 儿女是耶和华所赐的产业。所怀的胎是他所给的赏赐。

chapters.en: Like arrows in the hands of a warrior are children born in one’s youth.
chapters.zh: 少年时所生的儿女，好像勇士手中的箭。

chapters.en: Blessed is the man whose quiver is full of them. They will not be put to shame when they contend with their opponents in court.
chapters.zh: 箭袋充满的人便为有福。他们在城门口和仇敌说话的时候，必不至于羞愧。

chapters.en: Blessed are all who fear the LORD, who walk in obedience to him.
chapters.zh: （上行之诗。）凡敬畏耶和华，遵行他道的人便为有福。

chapters.en: You will eat the fruit of your labor; blessings and prosperity will be yours.
chapters.zh: 你要吃劳碌得来的。你要享福，事情顺利。

chapters.en: Your wife will be like a fruitful vine within your house; your children will be like olive shoots around your table.
chapters.zh: 你妻子在你的内室，好像多结果子的葡萄树。你儿女围绕你的桌子，好像橄榄栽子。

chapters.en: Yes, this will be the blessing for the man who fears the LORD.
chapters.zh: 看哪，敬畏耶和华的人，必要这样蒙福。

chapters.en: May the LORD bless you from Zion; may you see the prosperity of Jerusalem all the days of your life.
chapters.zh: 愿耶和华从锡安赐福给你。愿你一生一世，看见耶路撒冷的好处。

chapters.en: May you live to see your children’s children— peace be on Israel.
chapters.zh: 愿你看见你儿女的儿女。愿平安归于以色列。

chapters.en: “They have greatly oppressed me from my youth,” let Israel say;
chapters.zh: （上行之诗。）以色列当说，从我幼年以来，敌人屡次苦害我，

chapters.en: “they have greatly oppressed me from my youth, but they have not gained the victory over me.
chapters.zh: 从我幼年以来，敌人屡次苦害我，却没有胜了我。

chapters.en: Plowmen have plowed my back and made their furrows long.
chapters.zh: 如同扶犁的在我背上扶犁而耕，耕的犁沟甚长。

chapters.en: But the LORD is righteous; he has cut me free from the cords of the wicked.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华是公义的。他砍断了恶人的绳索。

chapters.en: May all who hate Zion be turned back in shame.
chapters.zh: 愿恨恶锡安的，都蒙羞退后。

chapters.en: May they be like grass on the roof, which withers before it can grow;
chapters.zh: 愿他们像房顶上的草，未长成而枯干。

chapters.en: a reaper cannot fill his hands with it, nor one who gathers fill his arms.
chapters.zh: 收割的不够一把，捆禾的也不满怀。

chapters.en: May those who pass by not say to them, “The blessing of the LORD be on you; we bless you in the name of the LORD.”
chapters.zh: 过路的也不说，愿耶和华所赐的福，归与你们。我们奉耶和华的名，给你们祝福。

chapters.en: Out of the depths I cry to you, LORD;
chapters.zh: （上行之诗。）耶和华阿，我从深处向你求告。

chapters.en: Lord, hear my voice. Let your ears be attentive to my cry for mercy.
chapters.zh: 主阿，求你听我的声音。愿你侧耳听我恳求的声音。

chapters.en: If you, LORD, kept a record of sins, Lord, who could stand?
chapters.zh: 主耶和华阿，你若究察罪孽，谁能站得住呢？

chapters.en: But with you there is forgiveness, so that we can, with reverence, serve you.
chapters.zh: 但在你有赦免之恩，要叫人敬畏你。

chapters.en: I wait for the LORD, my whole being waits, and in his word I put my hope.
chapters.zh: 我等候耶和华，我的心等候。我也仰望他的话。

chapters.en: I wait for the Lord more than watchmen wait for the morning, more than watchmen wait for the morning.
chapters.zh: 我的心等候主，胜于守夜的，等候天亮，胜于守夜的，等候天亮。

chapters.en: Israel, put your hope in the LORD, for with the LORD is unfailing love and with him is full redemption.
chapters.zh: 以色列阿，你当仰望耶和华。因他有慈爱，有丰盛的救恩。

chapters.en: He himself will redeem Israel from all their sins.
chapters.zh: 他必救赎以色列脱离一切的罪孽。

chapters.en: My heart is not proud, LORD, my eyes are not haughty; I do not concern myself with great matters or things too wonderful for me.
chapters.zh: （大卫上行之诗。）耶和华阿，我的心不狂傲，我的眼不高大。重大和测不透的事，我也不敢行。

chapters.en: But I have calmed and quieted myself, I am like a weaned child with its mother; like a weaned child I am content.
chapters.zh: 我的心平稳安静，好像断过奶的孩子在他母亲的怀中。我的心在我里面真像断过奶的孩子。

chapters.en: Israel, put your hope in the LORD both now and forevermore.
chapters.zh: 以色列阿，你当仰望耶和华，从今时直到永远。

chapters.en: LORD, remember David and all his self-denial.
chapters.zh: （上行之诗。）耶和华阿，求你记念大卫所受的一切苦难。

chapters.en: He swore an oath to the LORD, he made a vow to the Mighty One of Jacob:
chapters.zh: 他怎样向耶和华起誓，向雅各的大能者许愿，

chapters.en: “I will not enter my house or go to my bed,
chapters.zh: 说，我必不进我的帐幕，也不上我的床榻。

chapters.en: I will allow no sleep to my eyes or slumber to my eyelids,
chapters.zh: 我不容我的眼睛睡觉，也不容我的眼目打盹。

chapters.en: till I find a place for the LORD, a dwelling for the Mighty One of Jacob.”
chapters.zh: 直等我为耶和华寻得所在，为雅各的大能者寻得居所。

chapters.en: We heard it in Ephrathah, we came upon it in the fields of Jaar:
chapters.zh: 我们听说约柜在以法他，我们在基列耶琳就寻见了。

chapters.en: “Let us go to his dwelling place, let us worship at his footstool, saying,
chapters.zh: 我们要进他的居所，在他脚凳前下拜。

chapters.en: ‘Arise, LORD, and come to your resting place, you and the ark of your might.
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，求你兴起，和你有能力的约柜同入安息之所。

chapters.en: May your priests be clothed with your righteousness; may your faithful people sing for joy.’ ”
chapters.zh: 愿你的祭司披上公义。愿你的圣民欢呼。

chapters.en: For the sake of your servant David, do not reject your anointed one.
chapters.zh: 求你因你仆人大卫的缘故，不要厌弃你的受膏者。

chapters.en: The LORD swore an oath to David, a sure oath he will not revoke: “One of your own descendants I will place on your throne.
chapters.zh: 耶和华向大卫，凭诚实起了誓，必不反覆，说，我要使你所生的坐在你的宝座上。

chapters.en: If your sons keep my covenant and the statutes I teach them, then their sons will sit on your throne for ever and ever.”
chapters.zh: 你的众子若守我的约，和我所教训他们的法度，他们的子孙，必永远坐在你的宝座上。

chapters.en: For the LORD has chosen Zion, he has desired it for his dwelling, saying,
chapters.zh: 因为耶和华拣选了锡安，愿意当作自己的居所，

chapters.en: “This is my resting place for ever and ever; here I will sit enthroned, for I have desired it.
chapters.zh: 说，这是我永远安息之所。我要住在这里，因为是我所愿意的。

chapters.en: I will bless her with abundant provisions; her poor I will satisfy with food.
chapters.zh: 我要使其中的粮食丰满，使其中的穷人饱足。

chapters.en: I will clothe her priests with salvation, and her faithful people will ever sing for joy.
chapters.zh: 我要使祭司披上救恩，圣民大声欢呼。

chapters.en: “Here I will make a horn grow for David and set up a lamp for my anointed one.
chapters.zh: 我要叫大卫的角，在那里发生。我为我的受膏者，预备明灯。

chapters.en: I will clothe his enemies with shame, but his head will be adorned with a radiant crown.”
chapters.zh: 我要使他的仇敌披上羞耻。但他的冠冕，要在头上发光。

chapters.en: How good and pleasant it is when God’s people live together in unity!
chapters.zh: （大卫上行之诗。）看哪，弟兄和睦同居，是何等的善，何等的美。

chapters.en: It is like precious oil poured on the head, running down on the beard, running down on Aaron’s beard, down on the collar of his robe.
chapters.zh: 这好比那贵重的油，浇在亚伦的头上，流到胡须，又流到他的衣襟。

chapters.en: It is as if the dew of Hermon were falling on Mount Zion. For there the LORD bestows his blessing, even life forevermore.
chapters.zh: 又好比黑门的甘露，降在锡安山。因为在那里有耶和华所命定的福，就是永远的生命。

chapters.en: Praise the LORD, all you servants of the LORD who minister by night in the house of the LORD.
chapters.zh: （上行之诗。）耶和华的仆人，夜间站在耶和华殿中的，你们当称颂耶和华。

chapters.en: Lift up your hands in the sanctuary and praise the LORD.
chapters.zh: 你们当向圣所举手，称颂耶和华。

chapters.en: May the LORD bless you from Zion, he who is the Maker of heaven and earth.
chapters.zh: 愿造天地的耶和华，从锡安赐福给你们。

chapters.en: Praise the LORD.Praise the name of the LORD; praise him, you servants of the LORD,
chapters.zh: 你们要赞美耶和华。你们要赞美耶和华的名。耶和华的仆人站在耶和华殿中，站在我们神殿院中的，你们要赞美他。

chapters.en: you who minister in the house of the LORD, in the courts of the house of our God.
Praise the LORD, for the LORD is good; sing praise to his name, for that is pleasant.
chapters.zh: 你们要赞美耶和华。耶和华本为善。要歌颂他的名，因为这是美好的。

chapters.en: For the LORD has chosen Jacob to be his own, Israel to be his treasured possession.
chapters.zh: 耶和华拣选雅各归自己，拣选以色列特作自己的子民。

chapters.en: I know that the LORD is great, that our Lord is greater than all gods.
chapters.zh: 原来我知道耶和华为大，也知道我们的主超乎万神之上。

chapters.en: The LORD does whatever pleases him, in the heavens and on the earth, in the seas and all their depths.
chapters.zh: 耶和华在天上，在地下，在海中，在一切的深处，都随自己的意旨而行。

chapters.en: He makes clouds rise from the ends of the earth; he sends lightning with the rain and brings out the wind from his storehouses.
chapters.zh: 他使云雾从地极上腾，造电随雨而闪，从府库中带出风来。

chapters.en: He struck down the firstborn of Egypt, the firstborn of people and animals.
chapters.zh: 他将埃及头生的，连人带牲畜都击杀了。

chapters.en: He sent his signs and wonders into your midst, Egypt, against Pharaoh and all his servants.
chapters.zh: 埃及阿，他施行神迹奇事，在你当中，在法老和他一切臣仆身上。

chapters.en: He struck down many nations and killed mighty kings—
chapters.zh: 他击杀许多的民，又杀戮大能的王，

chapters.en: Sihon king of the Amorites, Og king of Bashan, and all the kings of Canaan—
chapters.zh: 就是亚摩利王西宏，和巴珊王噩，并迦南一切的国王，

chapters.en: and he gave their land as an inheritance, an inheritance to his people Israel.
chapters.zh: 将他们的地，赏赐他的百姓以色列为业。

chapters.en: Your name, LORD, endures forever, your renown, LORD, through all generations.
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，你的名存到永远。耶和华阿，你可记念的名存到万代。

chapters.en: For the LORD will vindicate his people and have compassion on his servants.
chapters.zh: 耶和华要为他的百姓伸冤，为他的仆人后悔。

chapters.en: The idols of the nations are silver and gold, made by human hands.
chapters.zh: 外邦的偶像是金的，银的，是人手所造的。

chapters.en: They have mouths, but cannot speak, eyes, but cannot see.
chapters.zh: 有口却不能言，有眼却不能看，

chapters.en: They have ears, but cannot hear, nor is there breath in their mouths.
chapters.zh: 有耳却不能听，口中也没有气息。

chapters.en: Those who make them will be like them, and so will all who trust in them.
chapters.zh: 造他的要和他一样，凡靠他的也要如此。

chapters.en: All you Israelites, praise the LORD; house of Aaron, praise the LORD;
chapters.zh: 以色列家阿，你们要称颂耶和华。亚伦家阿，你们要称颂耶和华。

chapters.en: house of Levi, praise the LORD; you who fear him, praise the LORD.
chapters.zh: 利未家阿，你们要称颂耶和华。你们敬畏耶和华的，要称颂耶和华。

chapters.en: Praise be to the LORD from Zion, to him who dwells in Jerusalem. Praise the LORD.
chapters.zh: 住在耶路撒冷的耶和华，该从锡安受称颂。你们要赞美耶和华。

chapters.en: Give thanks to the LORD, for he is good. His love endures forever.
chapters.zh: 你们要称谢耶和华，因他本为善。他的慈爱永远长存。

chapters.en: Give thanks to the God of gods. His love endures forever.
chapters.zh: 你们要称谢万神之神，因他的慈爱永远长存。

chapters.en: Give thanks to the Lord of lords: His love endures forever.
chapters.zh: 你们要称谢万主之主，因他的慈爱永远长存。

chapters.en: to him who alone does great wonders, His love endures forever.
chapters.zh: 称谢那独行大奇事的，因他的慈爱永远长存。

chapters.en: who by his understanding made the heavens, His love endures forever.
chapters.zh: 称谢那用智慧造天的，因他的慈爱永远长存。

chapters.en: who spread out the earth upon the waters, His love endures forever.
chapters.zh: 称谢那铺地在水以上的，因他的慈爱永远长存。

chapters.en: who made the great lights— His love endures forever.
chapters.zh: 称谢那造成大光的，因他的慈爱永远长存。

chapters.en: the sun to govern the day, His love endures forever.
chapters.zh: 他造日头管白昼，因他的慈爱永远长存。

chapters.en: the moon and stars to govern the night; His love endures forever.
chapters.zh: 他造月亮星宿管黑夜，因他的慈爱永远长存。

chapters.en: to him who struck down the firstborn of Egypt His love endures forever.
chapters.zh: 称谢那击杀埃及人之长子的，因他的慈爱永远长存。

chapters.en: and brought Israel out from among them His love endures forever.
chapters.zh: 他领以色列人从他们中间出来，因他的慈爱永远长存。

chapters.en: with a mighty hand and outstretched arm; His love endures forever.
chapters.zh: 他施展大能的手和伸出来的膀臂，因他的慈爱永远长存。

chapters.en: to him who divided the Red Sea asunder His love endures forever.
chapters.zh: 称谢那分裂红海的，因他的慈爱永远长存。

chapters.en: and brought Israel through the midst of it, His love endures forever.
chapters.zh: 他领以色列从其中经过，因他的慈爱永远长存。

chapters.en: but swept Pharaoh and his army into the Red Sea; His love endures forever.
chapters.zh: 却把法老和他的军兵推翻在红海里，因他的慈爱永远长存。

chapters.en: to him who led his people through the wilderness; His love endures forever.
chapters.zh: 称谢那引导自己的民行走旷野的，因他的慈爱永远长存。

chapters.en: to him who struck down great kings, His love endures forever.
chapters.zh: 称谢那击杀大君王的，因他的慈爱永远长存。

chapters.en: and killed mighty kings— His love endures forever.
chapters.zh: 他杀戮有名的君王，因他的慈爱永远长存。

chapters.en: Sihon king of the Amorites His love endures forever.
chapters.zh: 就是杀戮亚摩利王西宏，因他的慈爱永远长存。

chapters.en: and Og king of Bashan— His love endures forever.
chapters.zh: 又杀巴珊王噩，因他的慈爱永远长存。

chapters.en: and gave their land as an inheritance, His love endures forever.
chapters.zh: 他将他们的地赐他的百姓为业，因他的慈爱永远长存。

chapters.en: an inheritance to his servant Israel. His love endures forever.
chapters.zh: 就是赐他的仆人以色列为业，因他的慈爱永远长存。

chapters.en: He remembered us in our low estate His love endures forever.
chapters.zh: 他顾念我们在卑微的地步，因他的慈爱永远长存。

chapters.en: and freed us from our enemies. His love endures forever.
chapters.zh: 他救拔我们脱离敌人，因他的慈爱永远长存。

chapters.en: He gives food to every creature. His love endures forever.
chapters.zh: 他赐粮食给凡有血气的，因他的慈爱永远长存。

chapters.en: Give thanks to the God of heaven. His love endures forever.
chapters.zh: 你们要称谢天上的神，因他的慈爱永远长存。

chapters.en: By the rivers of Babylon we sat and wept when we remembered Zion.
chapters.zh: 我们曾在巴比伦的河边坐下，一追想锡安就哭了。

chapters.en: There on the poplars we hung our harps,
chapters.zh: 我们把琴挂在那里的柳树上。

chapters.en: for there our captors asked us for songs, our tormentors demanded songs of joy; they said, “Sing us one of the songs of Zion!”
chapters.zh: 因为在那里，掳掠我们的要我们唱歌，抢夺我们的，要我们作乐，说，给我们唱一首锡安歌吧。

chapters.en: How can we sing the songs of the LORD while in a foreign land?
chapters.zh: 我们怎能在外邦唱耶和华的歌呢？

chapters.en: If I forget you, Jerusalem, may my right hand forget its skill.
chapters.zh: 耶路撒冷阿，我若忘记你，情愿我的右手忘记技巧。

chapters.en: May my tongue cling to the roof of my mouth if I do not remember you, if I do not consider Jerusalem my highest joy.
chapters.zh: 我若不记念你，若不看耶路撒冷过于我所最喜乐的，情愿我的舌头贴于上膛。

chapters.en: Remember, LORD, what the Edomites did on the day Jerusalem fell. “Tear it down,” they cried, “tear it down to its foundations!”
chapters.zh: 耶路撒冷遭难的日子，以东人说，拆毁，拆毁，直拆到根基。耶和华阿求你记念这仇。

chapters.en: Daughter Babylon, doomed to destruction, happy is the one who repays you according to what you have done to us.
chapters.zh: 将要被灭的巴比伦城阿（城原文作女子），报复你象你待我们的，那人便为有福。

chapters.en: Happy is the one who seizes your infants and dashes them against the rocks.
chapters.zh: 拿你的婴孩摔在磐石上的，那人便为有福。

chapters.en: I will praise you, LORD, with all my heart; before the “gods” I will sing your praise.
chapters.zh: （大卫的诗。）我要一心称谢你，在诸神面前歌颂你。

chapters.en: I will bow down toward your holy temple and will praise your name for your unfailing love and your faithfulness, for you have so exalted your solemn decree that it surpasses your fame.
chapters.zh: 我要向你的圣殿下拜，为你的慈爱和诚实称赞你的名。因你使你的话显为大，过于你所应许的（或作超乎你的名声）。

chapters.en: When I called, you answered me; you greatly emboldened me.
chapters.zh: 我呼求的日子，你就应允我，鼓励我，使我心里有能力。

chapters.en: May all the kings of the earth praise you, LORD, when they hear what you have decreed.
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，地上的君王，都要称谢你，因他们听见了你口中的言语。

chapters.en: May they sing of the ways of the LORD, for the glory of the LORD is great.
chapters.zh: 他们要歌颂耶和华的作为，因耶和华大有荣耀。

chapters.en: Though the LORD is exalted, he looks kindly on the lowly; though lofty, he sees them from afar.
chapters.zh: 耶和华虽高，仍看顾低微的人。他却从远处看出骄傲的人。

chapters.en: Though I walk in the midst of trouble, you preserve my life. You stretch out your hand against the anger of my foes; with your right hand you save me.
chapters.zh: 我虽行在患难中，你必将我救活。我的仇敌发怒，你必伸手抵挡他们。你的右手也必救我。

chapters.en: The LORD will vindicate me; your love, LORD, endures forever— do not abandon the works of your hands.
chapters.zh: 耶和华必成全关乎我的事。耶和华阿，你的慈爱永远长存。求你不要离弃你手所造的。

chapters.en: You have searched me, LORD, and you know me.
chapters.zh: （大卫的诗，交与伶长。）耶和华阿，你已经鉴察我，认识我。

chapters.en: You know when I sit and when I rise; you perceive my thoughts from afar.
chapters.zh: 我坐下，我起来，你都晓得。你从远处知道我的意念。

chapters.en: You discern my going out and my lying down; you are familiar with all my ways.
chapters.zh: 我行路，我躺卧，你都细察，你也深知我一切所行的。

chapters.en: Before a word is on my tongue you, LORD, know it completely.
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，我舌头上的话，你没有一句不知道的。

chapters.en: You hem me in behind and before, and you lay your hand upon me.
chapters.zh: 你在我前后环绕我，按手在我身上。

chapters.en: Such knowledge is too wonderful for me, too lofty for me to attain.
chapters.zh: 这样的知识奇妙，是我不能测的。至高，是我不能及的。

chapters.en: Where can I go from your Spirit? Where can I flee from your presence?
chapters.zh: 我往那里去躲避你的灵。我往那里逃躲避你的面。

chapters.en: If I go up to the heavens, you are there; if I make my bed in the depths, you are there.
chapters.zh: 我若升到天上，你在那里。我若在阴间下榻，你也在那里。

chapters.en: If I rise on the wings of the dawn, if I settle on the far side of the sea,
chapters.zh: 我若展开清晨的翅膀，飞到海极居住。

chapters.en: even there your hand will guide me, your right hand will hold me fast.
chapters.zh: 就是在那里，你的手必引导我，你的右手，也必扶持我。

chapters.en: If I say, “Surely the darkness will hide me and the light become night around me,”
chapters.zh: 我若说，黑暗必定遮蔽我，我周围的亮光必成为黑夜。

chapters.en: even the darkness will not be dark to you; the night will shine like the day, for darkness is as light to you.
chapters.zh: 黑暗也不能遮蔽我使你不见，黑夜却如白昼发亮。黑暗和光明，在你看都是一样。

chapters.en: For you created my inmost being; you knit me together in my mother’s womb.
chapters.zh: 我的肺腑是你所造的。我在母腹中，你已覆庇我。

chapters.en: I praise you because I am fearfully and wonderfully made; your works are wonderful, I know that full well.
chapters.zh: 我要称谢你，因我受造，奇妙可畏。你的作为奇妙，这是我心深知道的。

chapters.en: My frame was not hidden from you when I was made in the secret place, when I was woven together in the depths of the earth.
chapters.zh: 我在暗中受造，在地的深处被联络。那时，我的形体并不向你隐藏。

chapters.en: Your eyes saw my unformed body; all the days ordained for me were written in your book before one of them came to be.
chapters.zh: 我未成形的体质，你的眼早已看见了。你所定的日子，我尚未度一日（或作我被造的肢体尚未有其一），你都写在你的册上了。

chapters.en: How precious to me are your thoughts, God! How vast is the sum of them!
chapters.zh: 神阿，你的意念向我何等宝贵。其数何等众多。

chapters.en: Were I to count them, they would outnumber the grains of sand— when I awake, I am still with you.
chapters.zh: 我若数点，比海沙更多。我睡醒的时候，仍和你同在。

chapters.en: If only you, God, would slay the wicked! Away from me, you who are bloodthirsty!
chapters.zh: 神阿，你必要杀戮恶人。所以，你们好流人血的，离开我去吧。

chapters.en: They speak of you with evil intent; your adversaries misuse your name.
chapters.zh: 因为他们说恶言顶撞你。你的仇敌也妄称你的名。

chapters.en: Do I not hate those who hate you, LORD, and abhor those who are in rebellion against you?
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，恨恶你的，我岂不恨恶他们吗？攻击你的，我岂不憎嫌他们吗？

chapters.en: I have nothing but hatred for them; I count them my enemies.
chapters.zh: 我切切地恨恶他们，以他们为仇敌。

chapters.en: Search me, God, and know my heart; test me and know my anxious thoughts.
chapters.zh: 神阿，求你鉴察我，知道我的心思，试炼我，知道我的意念。

chapters.en: See if there is any offensive way in me, and lead me in the way everlasting.
chapters.zh: 看在我里面有什么恶行没有，引导我走永生的道路。

chapters.en: Rescue me, LORD, from evildoers; protect me from the violent,
chapters.zh: （大卫的诗，交与伶长。）耶和华阿，求你拯救我脱离凶恶的人，保护我脱离强暴的人。

chapters.en: who devise evil plans in their hearts and stir up war every day.
chapters.zh: 他们心中图谋奸恶，常常聚集要争战。

chapters.en: They make their tongues as sharp as a serpent’s; the poison of vipers is on their lips.
chapters.zh: 他们使舌头尖利如蛇，嘴里有虺蛇的毒气。（细拉）

chapters.en: Keep me safe, LORD, from the hands of the wicked; protect me from the violent, who devise ways to trip my feet.
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，求你拯救我脱离恶人的手，保护我脱离强暴的人。他们图谋推我跌倒。

chapters.en: The arrogant have hidden a snare for me; they have spread out the cords of their net and have set traps for me along my path.
chapters.zh: 骄傲人为我暗设网罗和绳索。他们在路旁铺下网，设下圈套。（细拉）

chapters.en: I say to the LORD, “You are my God.” Hear, LORD, my cry for mercy.
chapters.zh: 我曾对耶和华说，你是我的神。耶和华阿，求你留心听我恳求的声音。

chapters.en: Sovereign LORD, my strong deliverer, you shield my head in the day of battle.
chapters.zh: 主耶和华，我救恩的力量阿，在争战的日子，你遮蔽了我的头。

chapters.en: Do not grant the wicked their desires, LORD; do not let their plans succeed.
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，求你不要遂恶人的心愿。不要成就他们的计谋，恐怕他们自高。（细拉）

chapters.en: Those who surround me proudly rear their heads; may the mischief of their lips engulf them.
chapters.zh: 至于那些昂首围困我的人，愿他们嘴唇的奸恶陷害（原文作遮蔽）自己。

chapters.en: May burning coals fall on them; may they be thrown into the fire, into miry pits, never to rise.
chapters.zh: 愿火炭落在他们身上。愿他们被丢在火中，抛在深坑里，不能再起来。

chapters.en: May slanderers not be established in the land; may disaster hunt down the violent.
chapters.zh: 说恶言的人，在地上必坚立不住。祸患必猎取强暴的人，将他打倒。

chapters.en: I know that the LORD secures justice for the poor and upholds the cause of the needy.
chapters.zh: 我知道耶和华必为困苦人伸冤，必为穷乏人辨屈。

chapters.en: Surely the righteous will praise your name, and the upright will live in your presence.
chapters.zh: 义人必要称赞你的名。正直人必住在你面前。

chapters.en: I call to you, LORD, come quickly to me; hear me when I call to you.
chapters.zh: （大卫的诗。）耶和华阿，我曾求告你，求你快快临到我这里。我求告你的时候，愿你留心听我的声音。

chapters.en: May my prayer be set before you like incense; may the lifting up of my hands be like the evening sacrifice.
chapters.zh: 愿我的祷告，如香陈列在你面前。愿我举手祈求，如献晚祭。

chapters.en: Set a guard over my mouth, LORD; keep watch over the door of my lips.
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，求你禁止我的口，把守我的嘴。

chapters.en: Do not let my heart be drawn to what is evil so that I take part in wicked deeds along with those who are evildoers; do not let me eat their delicacies.
chapters.zh: 求你不叫我的心，偏向邪恶，以致我和作孽的人同行恶事。也不叫我吃他们的美食。

chapters.en: Let a righteous man strike me—that is a kindness; let him rebuke me—that is oil on my head. My head will not refuse it, for my prayer will still be against the deeds of evildoers.
chapters.zh: 任凭义人击打我，这算为仁慈。任凭他责备我，这算为头上的膏油。我的头不要躲闪。正在他们行恶的时候，我仍要祈祷。

chapters.en: Their rulers will be thrown down from the cliffs, and the wicked will learn that my words were well spoken.
chapters.zh: 他们的审判官，被扔在岩下。众人要听我的话，因为这话甘甜。

chapters.en: They will say, “As one plows and breaks up the earth, so our bones have been scattered at the mouth of the grave.”
chapters.zh: 我们的骨头散在墓旁，好像人耕田，刨地的土块。

chapters.en: But my eyes are fixed on you, Sovereign LORD; in you I take refuge—do not give me over to death.
chapters.zh: 主耶和华阿，我的眼目仰望你。我投靠你，求你不要将我撇得孤苦。

chapters.en: Keep me safe from the traps set by evildoers, from the snares they have laid for me.
chapters.zh: 求你保护我脱离恶人为我设的网罗，和作孽之人的圈套。

chapters.en: Let the wicked fall into their own nets, while I pass by in safety.
chapters.zh: 愿恶人落在自己的网里，我却得以逃脱。

chapters.en: I cry aloud to the LORD; I lift up my voice to the LORD for mercy.
chapters.zh: （大卫在洞里作的训诲诗，乃是祈祷。）我发声哀告耶和华，发声恳求耶和华。

chapters.en: I pour out before him my complaint; before him I tell my trouble.
chapters.zh: 我在他面前吐露我的苦情，陈说我的患难。

chapters.en: When my spirit grows faint within me, it is you who watch over my way. In the path where I walk people have hidden a snare for me.
chapters.zh: 我的灵在我里面发昏的时候，你知道我的道路。在我行的路上，敌人为我暗设网罗。

chapters.en: Look and see, there is no one at my right hand; no one is concerned for me. I have no refuge; no one cares for my life.
chapters.zh: 求你向我右边观看，因为没有人认识我。我无处避难，也没有人眷顾我。

chapters.en: I cry to you, LORD; I say, “You are my refuge, my portion in the land of the living.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，我曾向你哀求。我说，你是我的避难所。在活人之地，你是我的福分。

chapters.en: Listen to my cry, for I am in desperate need; rescue me from those who pursue me, for they are too strong for me.
chapters.zh: 求你侧耳听我的呼求，因我落到极卑之地。求你救我脱离逼迫我的人，因为他们比我强盛。

chapters.en: Set me free from my prison, that I may praise your name. Then the righteous will gather about me because of your goodness to me.
chapters.zh: 求你领我出离被囚之地，我好称赞你的名。义人必环绕我，因为你是用厚恩待我。

chapters.en: LORD, hear my prayer, listen to my cry for mercy; in your faithfulness and righteousness come to my relief.
chapters.zh: （大卫的诗。）耶和华阿，求你听我的祷告，留心听我的恳求，凭你的信实和公义应允我。

chapters.en: Do not bring your servant into judgment, for no one living is righteous before you.
chapters.zh: 求你不要审问仆人。因为在你面前，凡活着的人，没有一个是义的。

chapters.en: The enemy pursues me, he crushes me to the ground; he makes me dwell in the darkness like those long dead.
chapters.zh: 原来仇敌逼迫我，将我打倒在地，使我住在幽暗之处，像死了许久的人一样。

chapters.en: So my spirit grows faint within me; my heart within me is dismayed.
chapters.zh: 所以，我的灵在我里面发昏。我的心在我里面凄惨。

chapters.en: I remember the days of long ago; I meditate on all your works and consider what your hands have done.
chapters.zh: 我追想古时之日，思想你的一切作为，默念你手的工作。

chapters.en: I spread out my hands to you; I thirst for you like a parched land.
chapters.zh: 我向你举手。我的心渴想你，如干旱之地盼雨一样。（细拉）

chapters.en: Answer me quickly, LORD; my spirit fails. Do not hide your face from me or I will be like those who go down to the pit.
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，求你速速应允我。我心神耗尽。不要向我掩面，免得我像那些下坑的人一样。

chapters.en: Let the morning bring me word of your unfailing love, for I have put my trust in you. Show me the way I should go, for to you I entrust my life.
chapters.zh: 求你使我清晨得听你慈爱之言，因我倚靠你。求你使我知道当行的路，因我的心仰望你。

chapters.en: Rescue me from my enemies, LORD, for I hide myself in you.
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，求你救我脱离我的仇敌。我往你那里藏身。

chapters.en: Teach me to do your will, for you are my God; may your good Spirit lead me on level ground.
chapters.zh: 求你指教我遵行你的旨意，因你是我的神。你的灵本为善。求你引我到平坦之地。

chapters.en: For your name’s sake, LORD, preserve my life; in your righteousness, bring me out of trouble.
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，求你为你的名将我救活。凭你的公义，将我从患难中领出来。

chapters.en: In your unfailing love, silence my enemies; destroy all my foes, for I am your servant.
chapters.zh: 凭你的慈爱剪除我的仇敌，灭绝一切苦待我的人，因我是你的仆人。

chapters.en: Praise be to the LORD my Rock, who trains my hands for war, my fingers for battle.
chapters.zh: （大卫的诗。）耶和华我的磐石，是应当称颂的。他教导我的手争战，教导我的指头打仗。

chapters.en: He is my loving God and my fortress, my stronghold and my deliverer, my shield, in whom I take refuge, who subdues peoples under me.
chapters.zh: 他是我慈爱的主，我的山寨，我的高台，我的救主，我的盾牌，是我所投靠的。他使我的百姓服在我以下。

chapters.en: LORD, what are human beings that you care for them, mere mortals that you think of them?
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，人算什么，你竟认识他。世人算什么，你竟顾念他。

chapters.en: They are like a breath; their days are like a fleeting shadow.
chapters.zh: 人好像一口气。他的年日，如同影儿快快过去。

chapters.en: Part your heavens, LORD, and come down; touch the mountains, so that they smoke.
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，求你使天下垂，亲自降临，摸山，山就冒烟。

chapters.en: Send forth lightning and scatter the enemy; shoot your arrows and rout them.
chapters.zh: 求你发出闪电，使他们四散，射出你的箭，使他们扰乱。

chapters.en: Reach down your hand from on high; deliver me and rescue me from the mighty waters, from the hands of foreigners
chapters.zh: 求你从上伸手救拔我，救我出离大水，救我脱离外邦人的手。

chapters.en: whose mouths are full of lies, whose right hands are deceitful.
chapters.zh: 他们的口说谎话。他们的右手起假誓。

chapters.en: I will sing a new song to you, my God; on the ten-stringed lyre I will make music to you,
chapters.zh: 神阿，我要向你唱新歌，用十弦瑟向你歌颂。

chapters.en: to the One who gives victory to kings, who delivers his servant David. From the deadly sword
chapters.zh: 你是那拯救君王的。你是那救仆人大卫脱离害命之刀的。

chapters.en: deliver me; rescue me from the hands of foreigners whose mouths are full of lies, whose right hands are deceitful.
chapters.zh: 求你救拔我，救我脱离外邦人的手。他们的口说谎话。他们的右手起假誓。

chapters.en: Then our sons in their youth will be like well-nurtured plants, and our daughters will be like pillars carved to adorn a palace.
chapters.zh: 我们的儿子，从幼年好像树栽子长大。我们的女儿如同殿角石，是按建宫的样式凿成的。

chapters.en: Our barns will be filled with every kind of provision. Our sheep will increase by thousands, by tens of thousands in our fields;
chapters.zh: 我们的仓盈满，能出各样的粮食。我们的羊，在田间孳生千万。

chapters.en: our oxen will draw heavy loads.There will be no breaching of walls, no going into captivity, no cry of distress in our streets.
chapters.zh: 我们的牛驮着满驮，没有人闯进来抢夺，也没有人出去争战。我们的街市上，也没有哭号的声音。

chapters.en: Blessed is the people of whom this is true; blessed is the people whose God is the LORD.
chapters.zh: 遇见这光景的百姓，便为有福。有耶和华为他们的神，这百姓便为有福。

chapters.en: I will exalt you, my God the King; I will praise your name for ever and ever.
chapters.zh: （大卫的赞美诗。）我的神我的王阿，我要尊崇你。我要永永远远称颂你的名。

chapters.en: Every day I will praise you and extol your name for ever and ever.
chapters.zh: 我要天天称颂你，也要永永远远赞美你的名。

chapters.en: Great is the LORD and most worthy of praise; his greatness no one can fathom.
chapters.zh: 耶和华本为大，该受大赞美。其大无法测度。

chapters.en: One generation commends your works to another; they tell of your mighty acts.
chapters.zh: 这代要对那代颂赞你的作为，也要传扬你的大能。

chapters.en: They speak of the glorious splendor of your majesty— and I will meditate on your wonderful works.
chapters.zh: 我要默念你威严的尊荣，和你奇妙的作为。

chapters.en: They tell of the power of your awesome works— and I will proclaim your great deeds.
chapters.zh: 人要传说你可畏之事的能力。我也要传扬你的大德。

chapters.en: They celebrate your abundant goodness and joyfully sing of your righteousness.
chapters.zh: 他们记念你的大恩，就要传出来，并要歌唱你的公义。

chapters.en: The LORD is gracious and compassionate, slow to anger and rich in love.
chapters.zh: 耶和华有恩惠，有怜悯，不轻易发怒，大有慈爱。

chapters.en: The LORD is good to all; he has compassion on all he has made.
chapters.zh: 耶和华善待万民，他的慈悲，覆庇他一切所造的。

chapters.en: All your works praise you, LORD; your faithful people extol you.
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，你一切所造，的都要称谢你。你的圣民也要称颂你，

chapters.en: They tell of the glory of your kingdom and speak of your might,
chapters.zh: 传说你国的荣耀，谈论你的大能，

chapters.en: so that all people may know of your mighty acts and the glorious splendor of your kingdom.
chapters.zh: 好叫世人知道你大能的作为，并你国度威严的荣耀。

chapters.en: Your kingdom is an everlasting kingdom, and your dominion endures through all generations. The LORD is trustworthy in all he promises and faithful in all he does.
chapters.zh: 你的国是永远的国，你执掌的权柄，存到万代。

chapters.en: The LORD upholds all who fall and lifts up all who are bowed down.
chapters.zh: 凡跌倒的，耶和华将他们扶持。凡被压下的，将他们扶起。

chapters.en: The eyes of all look to you, and you give them their food at the proper time.
chapters.zh: 万民都举目仰望你。你随时给他们食物。

chapters.en: You open your hand and satisfy the desires of every living thing.
chapters.zh: 你张手，使有生气的都随愿饱足。

chapters.en: The LORD is righteous in all his ways and faithful in all he does.
chapters.zh: 耶和华在他一切所行的，无不公义。在他一切所作的，都有慈爱。

chapters.en: The LORD is near to all who call on him, to all who call on him in truth.
chapters.zh: 凡求告耶和华的，就是诚心求告他的，耶和华便与他们相近。

chapters.en: He fulfills the desires of those who fear him; he hears their cry and saves them.
chapters.zh: 敬畏他的，他必成就他们的心愿。也必听他们的呼求，拯救他们。

chapters.en: The LORD watches over all who love him, but all the wicked he will destroy.
chapters.zh: 耶和华保护一切爱他的人，却要灭绝一切的恶人。

chapters.en: My mouth will speak in praise of the LORD. Let every creature praise his holy name for ever and ever.
chapters.zh: 我的口要说出赞美耶和华的话。惟愿凡有血气的，都永永远远称颂他的圣名。

chapters.en: Praise the LORD.Praise the LORD, my soul.
chapters.zh: 你们要赞美耶和华。我的心哪，你要赞美耶和华。

chapters.en: I will praise the LORD all my life; I will sing praise to my God as long as I live.
chapters.zh: 我一生要赞美耶和华。我还活的时候要歌颂我的神。

chapters.en: Do not put your trust in princes, in human beings, who cannot save.
chapters.zh: 你们不要倚靠君王，不要倚靠世人。他一点不能帮助。

chapters.en: When their spirit departs, they return to the ground; on that very day their plans come to nothing.
chapters.zh: 他的气一断，就归回尘土。他所打算的，当日就消灭了。

chapters.en: Blessed are those whose help is the God of Jacob, whose hope is in the LORD their God.
chapters.zh: 以雅各的神为帮助，仰望耶和华他神的，这人便为有福。

chapters.en: He is the Maker of heaven and earth, the sea, and everything in them— he remains faithful forever.
chapters.zh: 耶和华造天，地，海，和其中的万物。他守诚实，直到永远。

chapters.en: He upholds the cause of the oppressed and gives food to the hungry. The LORD sets prisoners free,
chapters.zh: 他为受屈的伸冤，赐食物与饥饿的。耶和华释放被囚的。

chapters.en: the LORD gives sight to the blind, the LORD lifts up those who are bowed down, the LORD loves the righteous.
chapters.zh: 耶和华开了瞎子的眼睛。耶和华扶起被压下的人。耶和华喜爱义人。

chapters.en: The LORD watches over the foreigner and sustains the fatherless and the widow, but he frustrates the ways of the wicked.
chapters.zh: 耶和华保护寄居的，扶持孤儿和寡妇，却使恶人的道路弯曲。

chapters.en: The LORD reigns forever, your God, O Zion, for all generations. Praise the LORD.
chapters.zh: 耶和华要作王，直到永远。锡安哪，你的神要作王，直到万代。你们要赞美耶和华。

chapters.en: Praise the LORD.How good it is to sing praises to our God, how pleasant and fitting to praise him!
chapters.zh: 你们要赞美耶和华，因歌颂我们的神为善为美。赞美的话是合宜的。

chapters.en: The LORD builds up Jerusalem; he gathers the exiles of Israel.
chapters.zh: 耶和华建造耶路撒冷，聚集以色列中被赶散的人。

chapters.en: He heals the brokenhearted and binds up their wounds.
chapters.zh: 他医好伤心的人，裹好他们的伤处。

chapters.en: He determines the number of the stars and calls them each by name.
chapters.zh: 他数点星宿的数目，一一称它的名。

chapters.en: Great is our Lord and mighty in power; his understanding has no limit.
chapters.zh: 我们的主为大，最有能力。他的智慧无法测度。

chapters.en: The LORD sustains the humble but casts the wicked to the ground.
chapters.zh: 耶和华扶持谦卑人，将恶人倾覆于地。

chapters.en: Sing to the LORD with grateful praise; make music to our God on the harp.
chapters.zh: 你们要以感谢向耶和华歌唱，用琴向我们的神歌颂。

chapters.en: He covers the sky with clouds; he supplies the earth with rain and makes grass grow on the hills.
chapters.zh: 他用云遮天，为地降雨，使草生长在山上。

chapters.en: He provides food for the cattle and for the young ravens when they call.
chapters.zh: 他赐食给走兽，和啼叫的小乌鸦。

chapters.en: His pleasure is not in the strength of the horse, nor his delight in the legs of the warrior;
chapters.zh: 他不喜悦马的力大，不喜爱人的腿快。

chapters.en: the LORD delights in those who fear him, who put their hope in his unfailing love.
chapters.zh: 耶和华喜爱敬畏他和盼望他慈爱的人。

chapters.en: Extol the LORD, Jerusalem; praise your God, Zion.
chapters.zh: 耶路撒冷阿，你要颂赞耶和华。锡安哪，你要赞美你的神。

chapters.en: He strengthens the bars of your gates and blesses your people within you.
chapters.zh: 因为他坚固了你的门闩，赐福给你中间的儿女。

chapters.en: He grants peace to your borders and satisfies you with the finest of wheat.
chapters.zh: 他使你境内平安。用上好的麦子使你满足。

chapters.en: He sends his command to the earth; his word runs swiftly.
chapters.zh: 他发命在地。他的话颁行最快。

chapters.en: He spreads the snow like wool and scatters the frost like ashes.
chapters.zh: 他降雪如羊毛，撒霜如炉灰。

chapters.en: He hurls down his hail like pebbles. Who can withstand his icy blast?
chapters.zh: 他掷下冰雹如碎渣。他发出寒冷，谁能当得起呢？

chapters.en: He sends his word and melts them; he stirs up his breezes, and the waters flow.
chapters.zh: 他一出令，这些就都消化。他使风刮起，水便流动。

chapters.en: He has revealed his word to Jacob, his laws and decrees to Israel.
chapters.zh: 他将他的道指示雅各，将他的律例典章指示以色列。

chapters.en: He has done this for no other nation; they do not know his laws.Praise the LORD.
chapters.zh: 别国他都没有这样待过。至于他的典章，他们向来没有知道。你们要赞美耶和华。

chapters.en: Praise the LORD.Praise the LORD from the heavens; praise him in the heights above.
chapters.zh: 你们要赞美耶和华，从天上赞美耶和华，在高处赞美他。

chapters.en: Praise him, all his angels; praise him, all his heavenly hosts.
chapters.zh: 他的众使者都要赞美他。他的诸军都要赞美他。

chapters.en: Praise him, sun and moon; praise him, all you shining stars.
chapters.zh: 日头月亮，你们要赞美他。放光的星宿，你们都要赞美他。

chapters.en: Praise him, you highest heavens and you waters above the skies.
chapters.zh: 天上的天，和天上的水，你们都要赞美他。

chapters.en: Let them praise the name of the LORD, for at his command they were created,
chapters.zh: 愿这些都赞美耶和华的名。因他一吩咐便都造成。

chapters.en: and he established them for ever and ever— he issued a decree that will never pass away.
chapters.zh: 他将这些立定，直到永永远远。他定了命，不能废去（废去或作越过）。

chapters.en: Praise the LORD from the earth, you great sea creatures and all ocean depths,
chapters.zh: 所有在地上的，大鱼和一切深洋，

chapters.en: lightning and hail, snow and clouds, stormy winds that do his bidding,
chapters.zh: 火与冰雹，雪和雾气，成就他命的狂风，

chapters.en: you mountains and all hills, fruit trees and all cedars,
chapters.zh: 大山和小山，结果的树木，和一切香柏树，

chapters.en: wild animals and all cattle, small creatures and flying birds,
chapters.zh: 野兽和一切牲畜，昆虫和飞鸟，

chapters.en: kings of the earth and all nations, you princes and all rulers on earth,
chapters.zh: 世上的君王和万民，首领和世上一切审判官，

chapters.en: young men and women, old men and children.
chapters.zh: 少年人和处女，老年人和孩童，都当赞美耶和华。

chapters.en: Let them praise the name of the LORD, for his name alone is exalted; his splendor is above the earth and the heavens.
chapters.zh: 愿这些都赞美耶和华的名。因为独有他的名被尊崇。他的荣耀在天地之上。

chapters.en: And he has raised up for his people a horn,the praise of all his faithful servants, of Israel, the people close to his heart. Praise the LORD.
chapters.zh: 他将他百姓的角高举，因此他（因此他或作他使）一切圣民以色列人，就是与他相近的百姓，都赞美他。你们要赞美耶和华。

chapters.en: Praise the LORD.Sing to the LORD a new song, his praise in the assembly of his faithful people.
chapters.zh: 你们要赞美耶和华，向耶和华唱新歌，在圣民的会中赞美他。

chapters.en: Let Israel rejoice in their Maker; let the people of Zion be glad in their King.
chapters.zh: 愿以色列因造他的主欢喜。愿锡安的民，因他们的王快乐。

chapters.en: Let them praise his name with dancing and make music to him with timbrel and harp.
chapters.zh: 愿他们跳舞赞美他的名，击鼓弹琴歌颂他。

chapters.en: For the LORD takes delight in his people; he crowns the humble with victory.
chapters.zh: 因为耶和华喜爱他的百姓。他要用救恩当作谦卑人的妆饰。

chapters.en: Let his faithful people rejoice in this honor and sing for joy on their beds.
chapters.zh: 愿圣民因所得的荣耀高兴。愿他们在床上欢呼。

chapters.en: May the praise of God be in their mouths and a double-edged sword in their hands,
chapters.zh: 愿他们口中称赞神为高，手里有两刃的刀。

chapters.en: to inflict vengeance on the nations and punishment on the peoples,
chapters.zh: 为要报复列邦，刑罚万民。

chapters.en: to bind their kings with fetters, their nobles with shackles of iron,
chapters.zh: 要用链子捆他们的君王，用铁镣锁他们的大臣。

chapters.en: to carry out the sentence written against them— this is the glory of all his faithful people. Praise the LORD.
chapters.zh: 要在他们身上施行所记录的审判。他的圣民都有这荣耀。你们要赞美耶和华。

chapters.en: Praise the LORD.Praise God in his sanctuary; praise him in his mighty heavens.
chapters.zh: 你们要赞美耶和华，在神的圣所赞美他，在他显能力的穹苍赞美他。

chapters.en: Praise him for his acts of power; praise him for his surpassing greatness.
chapters.zh: 要因他大能的作为赞美他，按着他极美的大德赞美他。

chapters.en: Praise him with the sounding of the trumpet, praise him with the harp and lyre,
chapters.zh: 要用角声赞美他，鼓瑟弹琴赞美他。

chapters.en: praise him with timbrel and dancing, praise him with the strings and pipe,
chapters.zh: 击鼓跳舞赞美他，用丝弦的乐器，和箫的声音赞美他。

chapters.en: praise him with the clash of cymbals, praise him with resounding cymbals.
chapters.zh: 用大响的钹赞美他，用高声的钹赞美他。

chapters.en: Let everything that has breath praise the LORD. Praise the LORD.
chapters.zh: 凡有气息的，都要赞美耶和华。你们要赞美耶和华。

chapters.en: The proverbs of Solomon son of David, king of Israel:
chapters.zh: 以色列王大卫儿子所罗门的箴言。

chapters.en: for gaining wisdom and instruction; for understanding words of insight;
chapters.zh: 要使人晓得智慧和训诲。分辨通达的言语。

chapters.en: for receiving instruction in prudent behavior, doing what is right and just and fair;
chapters.zh: 使人处事，领受智慧，仁义，公平，正直的训诲。

chapters.en: for giving prudence to those who are simple,knowledge and discretion to the young—
chapters.zh: 使愚人灵明，使少年人有知识和谋略。

chapters.en: let the wise listen and add to their learning, and let the discerning get guidance—
chapters.zh: 使智慧人听见，增长学问。使聪明人得着智谋。

chapters.en: for understanding proverbs and parables, the sayings and riddles of the wise.
chapters.zh: 使人明白箴言和譬喻，懂得智慧人的言词和谜语。

chapters.en: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of knowledge, but fools despise wisdom and instruction.
chapters.zh: 敬畏耶和华是知识的开端。愚妄人藐视智慧和训诲。

chapters.en: Listen, my son, to your father’s instruction and do not forsake your mother’s teaching.
chapters.zh: 我儿，要听你父亲的训诲，不可离弃你母亲的法则。（或作指教）

chapters.en: They are a garland to grace your head and a chain to adorn your neck.
chapters.zh: 因为这要作你头上的华冠，你项上的金链。

chapters.en: My son, if sinful men entice you, do not give in to them.
chapters.zh: 我儿，恶人若引诱你，你不可随从。

chapters.en: If they say, “Come along with us; let’s lie in wait for innocent blood, let’s ambush some harmless soul;
chapters.zh: 他们若说，你与我们同去，我们要埋伏流人之血，要蹲伏害无罪之人。

chapters.en: let’s swallow them alive, like the grave, and whole, like those who go down to the pit;
chapters.zh: 我们好像阴间，把他们活活吞下。他们如同下坑的人，被我们囫囵吞了。

chapters.en: we will get all sorts of valuable things and fill our houses with plunder;
chapters.zh: 我们必得各样宝物，将所掳来的装满房屋。

chapters.en: cast lots with us; we will all share the loot”—
chapters.zh: 你与我们大家同分。我们共用一个囊袋。

chapters.en: my son, do not go along with them, do not set foot on their paths;
chapters.zh: 我儿，不要与他们同行一道。禁止你脚走他们的路。

chapters.en: for their feet rush into evil, they are swift to shed blood.
chapters.zh: 因为他们的脚奔跑行恶，他们急速流人的血。

chapters.en: How useless to spread a net where every bird can see it!
chapters.zh: 好像飞鸟，网罗设在眼前仍不躲避。

chapters.en: These men lie in wait for their own blood; they ambush only themselves!
chapters.zh: 这些人埋伏，是为自流己血。蹲伏是为自害己命。

chapters.en: Such are the paths of all who go after ill-gotten gain; it takes away the life of those who get it.
chapters.zh: 凡贪恋财利的，所行之路，都是如此。这贪恋之心，乃夺去得财者之命。

chapters.en: Out in the open wisdom calls aloud, she raises her voice in the public square;
chapters.zh: 智慧在街市上呼喊，在宽阔处发声。

chapters.en: on top of the wall she cries out, at the city gate she makes her speech:
chapters.zh: 在热闹街头喊叫，在城门口，在城中发出言语。

chapters.en: “How long will you who are simple love your simple ways? How long will mockers delight in mockery and fools hate knowledge?
chapters.zh: 说你们愚昧人喜爱愚昧，亵慢人喜欢亵慢，愚顽人恨恶知识，要到几时呢？

chapters.en: Repent at my rebuke! Then I will pour out my thoughts to you, I will make known to you my teachings.
chapters.zh: 你们当因我的责备回转。我要将我的灵浇灌你们，将我的话指示你们。

chapters.en: But since you refuse to listen when I call and no one pays attention when I stretch out my hand,
chapters.zh: 我呼唤你们不肯听从。我伸手，无人理会。

chapters.en: since you disregard all my advice and do not accept my rebuke,
chapters.zh: 反轻弃我一切的劝戒，不肯受我的责备。

chapters.en: I in turn will laugh when disaster strikes you; I will mock when calamity overtakes you—
chapters.zh: 你们遭灾难，我就发笑惊恐临到你们，我必嗤笑。

chapters.en: when calamity overtakes you like a storm, when disaster sweeps over you like a whirlwind, when distress and trouble overwhelm you.
chapters.zh: 惊恐临到你们，好像狂风，灾难来到，如同暴风。急难痛苦临到你们身上。

chapters.en: “Then they will call to me but I will not answer; they will look for me but will not find me,
chapters.zh: 那时，你们必呼求我，我却不答应，恳切的寻找我，却寻不见。

chapters.en: since they hated knowledge and did not choose to fear the LORD.
chapters.zh: 因为你们恨恶知识，不喜爱敬畏耶和华，

chapters.en: Since they would not accept my advice and spurned my rebuke,
chapters.zh: 不听我的劝戒，藐视我一切的责备，

chapters.en: they will eat the fruit of their ways and be filled with the fruit of their schemes.
chapters.zh: 所以必吃自结的果子，充满自设的计谋。

chapters.en: For the waywardness of the simple will kill them, and the complacency of fools will destroy them;
chapters.zh: 愚昧人背道，必杀己身，愚顽人安逸，必害己命。

chapters.en: but whoever listens to me will live in safety and be at ease, without fear of harm.”
chapters.zh: 惟有听从我的，必安然居住，得享安静，不怕灾祸。

chapters.en: My son, if you accept my words and store up my commands within you,
chapters.zh: 我儿，你若领受我的言语，存记我的命令，

chapters.en: turning your ear to wisdom and applying your heart to understanding—
chapters.zh: 侧耳听智慧，专心求聪明。

chapters.en: indeed, if you call out for insight and cry aloud for understanding,
chapters.zh: 呼求明哲，扬声求聪明，

chapters.en: and if you look for it as for silver and search for it as for hidden treasure,
chapters.zh: 寻找他如寻找银子，搜求他如搜求隐藏的珍宝，

chapters.en: then you will understand the fear of the LORD and find the knowledge of God.
chapters.zh: 你就明白敬畏耶和华，得以认识神。

chapters.en: For the LORD gives wisdom; from his mouth come knowledge and understanding.
chapters.zh: 因为耶和华赐人智慧。知识和聪明，都由他口而出。

chapters.en: He holds success in store for the upright, he is a shield to those whose walk is blameless,
chapters.zh: 他给正直人存留真智慧，给行为纯正的人作盾牌。

chapters.en: for he guards the course of the just and protects the way of his faithful ones.
chapters.zh: 为要保守公平人的路，护庇虔敬人的道。

chapters.en: Then you will understand what is right and just and fair—every good path.
chapters.zh: 你也必明白仁义，公平，正直，一切的善道。

chapters.en: For wisdom will enter your heart, and knowledge will be pleasant to your soul.
chapters.zh: 智慧必入你心。你的灵要以知识为美。

chapters.en: Discretion will protect you, and understanding will guard you.
chapters.zh: 谋略必护卫你。聪明必保守你。

chapters.en: Wisdom will save you from the ways of wicked men, from men whose words are perverse,
chapters.zh: 要救你脱离恶道，（恶道或作恶人的道）脱离说乖谬话的人。

chapters.en: who have left the straight paths to walk in dark ways,
chapters.zh: 那等人舍弃正直的路，行走黑暗的道，

chapters.en: who delight in doing wrong and rejoice in the perverseness of evil,
chapters.zh: 欢喜作恶，喜爱恶人的乖僻。

chapters.en: whose paths are crooked and who are devious in their ways.
chapters.zh: 在他们的道中弯曲，在他们的路上偏僻。

chapters.en: Wisdom will save you also from the adulterous woman, from the wayward woman with her seductive words,
chapters.zh: 智慧要救你脱离淫妇，就是那油嘴滑舌的外女。

chapters.en: who has left the partner of her youth and ignored the covenant she made before God.
chapters.zh: 她离弃幼年的配偶，忘了神的盟约。

chapters.en: Surely her house leads down to death and her paths to the spirits of the dead.
chapters.zh: 她的家陷入死地，她的路偏向阴间。

chapters.en: None who go to her return or attain the paths of life.
chapters.zh: 凡到她那里去的不得转回，也得不着生命的路。

chapters.en: Thus you will walk in the ways of the good and keep to the paths of the righteous.
chapters.zh: 智慧必使你行善人的道，守义人的路。

chapters.en: For the upright will live in the land, and the blameless will remain in it;
chapters.zh: 正直人必在世上居住。完全人必在地上存留。

chapters.en: but the wicked will be cut off from the land, and the unfaithful will be torn from it.
chapters.zh: 惟有恶人必然剪除。奸诈的必然拔出。

chapters.en: My son, do not forget my teaching, but keep my commands in your heart,
chapters.zh: 我儿，不要忘记我的法则。（或作指教）你心要谨守我的诫命。

chapters.en: for they will prolong your life many years and bring you peace and prosperity.
chapters.zh: 因为他必将长久的日子，生命的年数，与平安，加给你。

chapters.en: Let love and faithfulness never leave you; bind them around your neck, write them on the tablet of your heart.
chapters.zh: 不可使慈爱诚实离开你。要系在你颈项上，刻在你心版上。

chapters.en: Then you will win favor and a good name in the sight of God and man.
chapters.zh: 这样，你必在神和世人眼前蒙恩宠，有聪明。

chapters.en: Trust in the LORD with all your heart and lean not on your own understanding;
chapters.zh: 你要专心仰赖耶和华，不可倚靠自己的聪明。

chapters.en: in all your ways submit to him, and he will make your paths straight.
chapters.zh: 在你一切所行的事上，都要认定他，他必指引你的路。

chapters.en: Do not be wise in your own eyes; fear the LORD and shun evil.
chapters.zh: 不要自以为有智慧。要敬畏耶和华，远离恶事。

chapters.en: This will bring health to your body and nourishment to your bones.
chapters.zh: 这便医治你的肚脐，滋润你的百骨。

chapters.en: Honor the LORD with your wealth, with the firstfruits of all your crops;
chapters.zh: 你要以财物，和一切初熟的土产，尊荣耶和华。

chapters.en: then your barns will be filled to overflowing, and your vats will brim over with new wine.
chapters.zh: 这样，你的仓房，必充满有余，你的酒榨，有新酒盈溢。

chapters.en: My son, do not despise the LORD’s discipline, and do not resent his rebuke,
chapters.zh: 我儿，你不可轻看耶和华的管教，（或作惩治）也不可厌烦他的责备。

chapters.en: because the LORD disciplines those he loves, as a father the son he delights in.
chapters.zh: 因为耶和华所爱的，他必责备。正如父亲责备所喜爱的儿子。

chapters.en: Blessed are those who find wisdom, those who gain understanding,
chapters.zh: 得智慧，得聪明的，这人便为有福。

chapters.en: for she is more profitable than silver and yields better returns than gold.
chapters.zh: 因为得智慧胜过得银子，其利益强如精金。

chapters.en: She is more precious than rubies; nothing you desire can compare with her.
chapters.zh: 比珍珠（或作红宝石）宝贵。你一切所喜爱的，都不足与比较。

chapters.en: Long life is in her right hand; in her left hand are riches and honor.
chapters.zh: 他右手有长寿。左手有富贵。

chapters.en: Her ways are pleasant ways, and all her paths are peace.
chapters.zh: 他的道是安乐，他的路全是平安。

chapters.en: She is a tree of life to those who take hold of her; those who hold her fast will be blessed.
chapters.zh: 他与持守他的作生命树。持定他的俱各有福。

chapters.en: By wisdom the LORD laid the earth’s foundations, by understanding he set the heavens in place;
chapters.zh: 耶和华以智慧立地。以聪明定天。

chapters.en: by his knowledge the watery depths were divided, and the clouds let drop the dew.
chapters.zh: 以知识使深渊裂开，使天空滴下甘露。

chapters.en: My son, do not let wisdom and understanding out of your sight, preserve sound judgment and discretion;
chapters.zh: 我儿，要谨守真智慧和谋略。不可使他离开你的眼目。

chapters.en: they will be life for you, an ornament to grace your neck.
chapters.zh: 这样，他必作你的生命，颈项的美饰。

chapters.en: Then you will go on your way in safety, and your foot will not stumble.
chapters.zh: 你就坦然行路，不至碰脚。

chapters.en: When you lie down, you will not be afraid; when you lie down, your sleep will be sweet.
chapters.zh: 你躺下，必不惧怕。你躺卧，睡得香甜。

chapters.en: Have no fear of sudden disaster or of the ruin that overtakes the wicked,
chapters.zh: 忽然来的惊恐，不要害怕。恶人遭毁灭，也不要恐惧。

chapters.en: for the LORD will be at your side and will keep your foot from being snared.
chapters.zh: 因为耶和华是你所倚靠的。他必保守你的脚不陷入网罗。

chapters.en: Do not withhold good from those to whom it is due, when it is in your power to act.
chapters.zh: 你手若有行善的力量，不可推辞，就当向那应得的人施行。

chapters.en: Do not say to your neighbor, “Come back tomorrow and I’ll give it to you”— when you already have it with you.
chapters.zh: 你那里若有现成的，不可对邻舍说，去吧，明天再来，我必给你。

chapters.en: Do not plot harm against your neighbor, who lives trustfully near you.
chapters.zh: 你的邻舍，既在你附近安居，你不可设计害他。

chapters.en: Do not accuse anyone for no reason— when they have done you no harm.
chapters.zh: 人未曾加害与你，不可无故与他相争。

chapters.en: Do not envy the violent or choose any of their ways.
chapters.zh: 不可嫉妒强暴的人，也不可选择他所行的路。

chapters.en: For the LORD detests the perverse but takes the upright into his confidence.
chapters.zh: 因为乖僻人为耶和华所憎恶。正直人为他所亲密。

chapters.en: The LORD’s curse is on the house of the wicked, but he blesses the home of the righteous.
chapters.zh: 耶和华咒诅恶人的家庭，赐福与义人的居所。

chapters.en: He mocks proud mockers but shows favor to the humble and oppressed.
chapters.zh: 他讥诮那好讥诮的人，赐恩给谦卑的人。

chapters.en: The wise inherit honor, but fools get only shame.
chapters.zh: 智慧人必承受尊荣。愚昧人高升也成为羞辱。

chapters.en: Listen, my sons, to a father’s instruction; pay attention and gain understanding.
chapters.zh: 众子阿，要听父亲的教训，留心得知聪明。

chapters.en: I give you sound learning, so do not forsake my teaching.
chapters.zh: 因我所给你们的，是好教训。不可离弃我的法则。（或作指教）

chapters.en: For I too was a son to my father, still tender, and cherished by my mother.
chapters.zh: 我在父亲面前为孝子，在母亲眼中为独一的娇儿。

chapters.en: Then he taught me, and he said to me, “Take hold of my words with all your heart; keep my commands, and you will live.
chapters.zh: 父亲教训我说，你心要存记我的言语，遵守我的命令，便得存活。

chapters.en: Get wisdom, get understanding; do not forget my words or turn away from them.
chapters.zh: 要得智慧，要得聪明。不可忘记，也不可偏离我口中的言语。

chapters.en: Do not forsake wisdom, and she will protect you; love her, and she will watch over you.
chapters.zh: 不可离弃智慧，智慧就护卫你。要爱他，他就保守你。

chapters.en: The beginning of wisdom is this: Get wisdom. Though it cost all you have, get understanding.
chapters.zh: 智慧为首。所以要得智慧。在你一切所得之内，必得聪明。（或作用你一切所得的去换聪明）

chapters.en: Cherish her, and she will exalt you; embrace her, and she will honor you.
chapters.zh: 高举智慧，他就使你高升。怀抱智慧，他就使你尊荣。

chapters.en: She will give you a garland to grace your head and present you with a glorious crown.”
chapters.zh: 他必将华冠加在你头上，把荣冕交给你。

chapters.en: Listen, my son, accept what I say, and the years of your life will be many.
chapters.zh: 我儿，你要听受我的言语，就必延年益寿。

chapters.en: I instruct you in the way of wisdom and lead you along straight paths.
chapters.zh: 我已指教你走智慧的道，引导你行正直的路。

chapters.en: When you walk, your steps will not be hampered; when you run, you will not stumble.
chapters.zh: 你行走，脚步必不致狭窄。你奔跑，也不致跌倒。

chapters.en: Hold on to instruction, do not let it go; guard it well, for it is your life.
chapters.zh: 要持定训诲，不可放松。必当谨守，因为他是你的生命。

chapters.en: Do not set foot on the path of the wicked or walk in the way of evildoers.
chapters.zh: 不可行恶人的路。不要走坏人的道。

chapters.en: Avoid it, do not travel on it; turn from it and go on your way.
chapters.zh: 要躲避，不可经过。要转身而去。

chapters.en: For they cannot rest until they do evil; they are robbed of sleep till they make someone stumble.
chapters.zh: 这等人若不行恶，不得睡觉。不使人跌倒，睡卧不安。

chapters.en: They eat the bread of wickedness and drink the wine of violence.
chapters.zh: 因为他们以奸恶吃饼，以强暴喝酒。

chapters.en: The path of the righteous is like the morning sun, shining ever brighter till the full light of day.
chapters.zh: 但义人的路，好像黎明的光，越照越明，直到日午。

chapters.en: But the way of the wicked is like deep darkness; they do not know what makes them stumble.
chapters.zh: 恶人的道好像幽暗。自己不知因什么跌倒。

chapters.en: My son, pay attention to what I say; turn your ear to my words.
chapters.zh: 我儿，要留心听我的言词，侧耳听我的话语。

chapters.en: Do not let them out of your sight, keep them within your heart;
chapters.zh: 都不可离你的眼目。要存记在你心中。

chapters.en: for they are life to those who find them and health to one’s whole body.
chapters.zh: 因为得着他的，就得了生命，又得了医全体的良药。

chapters.en: Above all else, guard your heart, for everything you do flows from it.
chapters.zh: 你要保守你心，胜过保守一切。（或作你要切切保守你心）因为一生的果效，是由心发出。

chapters.en: Keep your mouth free of perversity; keep corrupt talk far from your lips.
chapters.zh: 你要除掉邪僻的口，弃绝乖谬的嘴。

chapters.en: Let your eyes look straight ahead; fix your gaze directly before you.
chapters.zh: 你的眼目，要向前正看，你的眼睛，（原文作皮）当向前直观。

chapters.en: Give careful thought to the paths for your feet and be steadfast in all your ways.
chapters.zh: 要修平你脚下的路，坚定你一切的道。

chapters.en: Do not turn to the right or the left; keep your foot from evil.
chapters.zh: 不可偏向左右。要使你的脚离开邪恶。

chapters.en: My son, pay attention to my wisdom, turn your ear to my words of insight,
chapters.zh: 我儿，要留心我智慧的话语，侧耳听我聪明的言词。

chapters.en: that you may maintain discretion and your lips may preserve knowledge.
chapters.zh: 为要使你谨守谋略，嘴唇保存知识。

chapters.en: For the lips of the adulterous woman drip honey, and her speech is smoother than oil;
chapters.zh: 因为淫妇的嘴滴下蜂蜜，她的口比油更滑。

chapters.en: but in the end she is bitter as gall, sharp as a double-edged sword.
chapters.zh: 至终却苦似茵陈，快如两刃的刀。

chapters.en: Her feet go down to death; her steps lead straight to the grave.
chapters.zh: 她的脚，下入死地。她脚步，踏住阴间。

chapters.en: She gives no thought to the way of life; her paths wander aimlessly, but she does not know it.
chapters.zh: 以致她找不着生命平坦的道。她的路变迁不定，自己还不知道。

chapters.en: Now then, my sons, listen to me; do not turn aside from what I say.
chapters.zh: 众子阿，现在要听从我，不可离弃我口中的话。

chapters.en: Keep to a path far from her, do not go near the door of her house,
chapters.zh: 你所行的道要离她远，不可就近她的房门。

chapters.en: lest you lose your honor to others and your dignity to one who is cruel,
chapters.zh: 恐怕将你的尊荣给别人，将你的岁月给残忍的人。

chapters.en: lest strangers feast on your wealth and your toil enrich the house of another.
chapters.zh: 恐怕外人满得你的力量，你劳碌得来的，归入外人的家。

chapters.en: At the end of your life you will groan, when your flesh and body are spent.
chapters.zh: 终久你皮肉和身体消毁，你就悲叹，

chapters.en: You will say, “How I hated discipline! How my heart spurned correction!
chapters.zh: 说，我怎么恨恶训诲，心中藐视责备，

chapters.en: I would not obey my teachers or turn my ear to my instructors.
chapters.zh: 也不听从我师傅的话，又不侧耳听那教训我的人。

chapters.en: And I was soon in serious trouble in the assembly of God’s people.”
chapters.zh: 我在圣会里，几乎落在诸般恶中。

chapters.en: Drink water from your own cistern, running water from your own well.
chapters.zh: 你要喝自己池中的水，饮自己井里的活水。

chapters.en: Should your springs overflow in the streets, your streams of water in the public squares?
chapters.zh: 你的泉源岂可涨溢在外。你的河水岂可流在街上。

chapters.en: Let them be yours alone, never to be shared with strangers.
chapters.zh: 惟独归你一人，不可与外人同用。

chapters.en: May your fountain be blessed, and may you rejoice in the wife of your youth.
chapters.zh: 要使你的泉源蒙福。要喜悦你幼年所娶的妻。

chapters.en: A loving doe, a graceful deer— may her breasts satisfy you always, may you ever be intoxicated with her love.
chapters.zh: 她如可爱的母鹿，可喜的母鹿。愿她的胸怀，使你时时知足。她的爱情，使你常常恋慕。

chapters.en: Why, my son, be intoxicated with another man’s wife? Why embrace the bosom of a wayward woman?
chapters.zh: 我儿，你为何恋慕淫妇，为何抱外女的胸怀。

chapters.en: For your ways are in full view of the LORD, and he examines all your paths.
chapters.zh: 因为人所行的道，都在耶和华眼前。他也修平人一切的路。

chapters.en: The evil deeds of the wicked ensnare them; the cords of their sins hold them fast.
chapters.zh: 恶人必被自己的罪孽捉住。他必被自己的罪恶如绳索缠绕。

chapters.en: For lack of discipline they will die, led astray by their own great folly.
chapters.zh: 他因不受训诲，就必死亡。又因愚昧过甚，必走差了路。

chapters.en: My son, if you have put up security for your neighbor, if you have shaken hands in pledge for a stranger,
chapters.zh: 我儿，你若为朋友作保，替外人击掌，

chapters.en: you have been trapped by what you said, ensnared by the words of your mouth.
chapters.zh: 你就被口中的话语缠住，被嘴里的言语捉住。

chapters.en: So do this, my son, to free yourself, since you have fallen into your neighbor’s hands: Go—to the point of exhaustion—and give your neighbor no rest!
chapters.zh: 我儿，你既落在朋友手中，就当这样行，才可救自己。你要自卑，去恳求你的朋友。

chapters.en: Allow no sleep to your eyes, no slumber to your eyelids.
chapters.zh: 不要容你的眼睛睡觉，不要容你的眼皮打盹。

chapters.en: Free yourself, like a gazelle from the hand of the hunter, like a bird from the snare of the fowler.
chapters.zh: 要救自己，如鹿脱离猎户的手，如鸟脱离捕鸟人的手。

chapters.en: Go to the ant, you sluggard; consider its ways and be wise!
chapters.zh: 懒惰人哪，你去察看蚂蚁的动作，就可得智慧。

chapters.en: It has no commander, no overseer or ruler,
chapters.zh: 蚂蚁没有元帅，没有官长，没有君王，

chapters.en: yet it stores its provisions in summer and gathers its food at harvest.
chapters.zh: 尚且在夏天预备食物，在收割时聚敛粮食。

chapters.en: How long will you lie there, you sluggard? When will you get up from your sleep?
chapters.zh: 懒惰人哪，你要睡到几时呢？你何时睡醒呢？

chapters.en: A little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the hands to rest—
chapters.zh: 再睡片时，打盹片时，抱着手躺卧片时，

chapters.en: and poverty will come on you like a thief and scarcity like an armed man.
chapters.zh: 你的贫穷就必如强盗速来，你的缺乏仿佛拿兵器的人来到。

chapters.en: A troublemaker and a villain, who goes about with a corrupt mouth,
chapters.zh: 无赖的恶徒，行动就用乖僻的口。

chapters.en: who winks maliciously with his eye, signals with his feet and motions with his fingers,
chapters.zh: 用眼传神，用脚示意，用指点划。

chapters.en: who plots evil with deceit in his heart— he always stirs up conflict.
chapters.zh: 心中乖僻，常设恶谋，布散分争。

chapters.en: Therefore disaster will overtake him in an instant; he will suddenly be destroyed—without remedy.
chapters.zh: 所以灾难必忽然临到他身。他必顷刻败坏无法可治。

chapters.en: There are six things the LORD hates, seven that are detestable to him:
chapters.zh: 耶和华所恨恶的有六样，连他心所憎恶的共有七样。

chapters.en: haughty eyes, a lying tongue, hands that shed innocent blood,
chapters.zh: 就是高傲的眼，撒谎的舌，流无辜人血的手，

chapters.en: a heart that devises wicked schemes, feet that are quick to rush into evil,
chapters.zh: 图谋恶计的心，飞跑行恶的脚，

chapters.en: a false witness who pours out lies and a person who stirs up conflict in the community.
chapters.zh: 吐谎言的假见证，并弟兄中布散分争的人。

chapters.en: My son, keep your father’s command and do not forsake your mother’s teaching.
chapters.zh: 我儿，要谨守你父亲的诫命，不可离弃你母亲的法则。（或作指教）

chapters.en: Bind them always on your heart; fasten them around your neck.
chapters.zh: 要常系在你心上，挂在你项上。

chapters.en: When you walk, they will guide you; when you sleep, they will watch over you; when you awake, they will speak to you.
chapters.zh: 你行走，他必引导你。你躺卧，他必保守你。你睡醒，他必与你谈论。

chapters.en: For this command is a lamp, this teaching is a light, and correction and instruction are the way to life,
chapters.zh: 因为诫命是灯，法则（或作指教）是光。训诲的责备是生命的道。

chapters.en: keeping you from your neighbor’s wife, from the smooth talk of a wayward woman.
chapters.zh: 能保你远离恶妇，远离外女谄媚的舌头。

chapters.en: Do not lust in your heart after her beauty or let her captivate you with her eyes.
chapters.zh: 你心中不要恋慕她的美色，也不要被她眼皮勾引。

chapters.en: For a prostitute can be had for a loaf of bread, but another man’s wife preys on your very life.
chapters.zh: 因为妓女能使人只剩一块饼，淫妇猎取人宝贵的生命。

chapters.en: Can a man scoop fire into his lap without his clothes being burned?
chapters.zh: 人若怀里搋火，衣服岂能不烧呢？

chapters.en: Can a man walk on hot coals without his feet being scorched?
chapters.zh: 人若在火炭上走，脚岂能不烫呢？

chapters.en: So is he who sleeps with another man’s wife; no one who touches her will go unpunished.
chapters.zh: 亲近邻舍之妻的，也是如此。凡挨近她的，不免受罚。

chapters.en: People do not despise a thief if he steals to satisfy his hunger when he is starving.
chapters.zh: 贼因饥饿偷窃充饥，人不藐视他。

chapters.en: Yet if he is caught, he must pay sevenfold, though it costs him all the wealth of his house.
chapters.zh: 若被找着，他必赔还七倍。必将家中所有的，尽都偿还。

chapters.en: But a man who commits adultery has no sense; whoever does so destroys himself.
chapters.zh: 与妇人行淫的，便是无知，行这事的，必丧掉生命。

chapters.en: Blows and disgrace are his lot, and his shame will never be wiped away.
chapters.zh: 他必受伤损，必被凌辱。他的羞耻不得涂抹。

chapters.en: For jealousy arouses a husband’s fury, and he will show no mercy when he takes revenge.
chapters.zh: 因为人的嫉恨，成了烈怒。报仇的时候，决不留情。

chapters.en: He will not accept any compensation; he will refuse a bribe, however great it is.
chapters.zh: 什么赎价，他都不顾。你虽送许多礼物，他也不肯干休。

chapters.en: My son, keep my words and store up my commands within you.
chapters.zh: 我儿，你要遵守我的言语，将我的命令存记在心。

chapters.en: Keep my commands and you will live; guard my teachings as the apple of your eye.
chapters.zh: 遵守我的命令，就得存活。保守我的法则，（或作指教）好像保守眼中的瞳人。

chapters.en: Bind them on your fingers; write them on the tablet of your heart.
chapters.zh: 系在你指头上，刻在你心版上。

chapters.en: Say to wisdom, “You are my sister,” and to insight, “You are my relative.”
chapters.zh: 对智慧说，你是我的姊妹。称呼聪明为你的亲人。

chapters.en: They will keep you from the adulterous woman, from the wayward woman with her seductive words.
chapters.zh: 他就保你远离淫妇，远离说谄媚话的外女。

chapters.en: At the window of my house I looked down through the lattice.
chapters.zh: 我曾在我房屋的窗户内，从我窗棂之间，往外观看。

chapters.en: I saw among the simple, I noticed among the young men, a youth who had no sense.
chapters.zh: 见愚蒙人内，少年人中，分明有一个无知的少年人，

chapters.en: He was going down the street near her corner, walking along in the direction of her house
chapters.zh: 从街上经过，走近淫妇的巷口，直往通她家的路去，

chapters.en: at twilight, as the day was fading, as the dark of night set in.
chapters.zh: 在黄昏，或晚上，或半夜，或黑暗之中，

chapters.en: Then out came a woman to meet him, dressed like a prostitute and with crafty intent.
chapters.zh: 看哪，有一个妇人来迎接他，是妓女的打扮，有诡诈的心思。

chapters.en: (She is unruly and defiant, her feet never stay at home;
chapters.zh: 这妇人喧嚷不守约束，在家里停不住脚。

chapters.en: now in the street, now in the squares, at every corner she lurks.)
chapters.zh: 有时在街市上，有时在宽阔处，或在各巷口蹲伏。

chapters.en: She took hold of him and kissed him and with a brazen face she said:
chapters.zh: 拉住那少年人，与他亲嘴，脸无羞耻对他说，

chapters.en: “Today I fulfilled my vows, and I have food from my fellowship offering at home.
chapters.zh: 平安祭在我这里。今日才还了我所许的愿。

chapters.en: So I came out to meet you; I looked for you and have found you!
chapters.zh: 因此，我出来迎接你，恳切求见你的面，恰巧遇见了你。

chapters.en: I have covered my bed with colored linens from Egypt.
chapters.zh: 我已经用绣花毯子，和埃及线织的花纹布，铺了我的床。

chapters.en: I have perfumed my bed with myrrh, aloes and cinnamon.
chapters.zh: 我又用没药，沉香，桂皮，薰了我的榻。

chapters.en: Come, let’s drink deeply of love till morning; let’s enjoy ourselves with love!
chapters.zh: 你来，我们可以饱享爱情，直到早晨。我们可以彼此亲爱欢乐。

chapters.en: My husband is not at home; he has gone on a long journey.
chapters.zh: 因为我丈夫不在家，出门行远路。

chapters.en: He took his purse filled with money and will not be home till full moon.”
chapters.zh: 他手拿银囊。必到月望才回家。

chapters.en: With persuasive words she led him astray; she seduced him with her smooth talk.
chapters.zh: 淫妇用许多巧言诱他随从，用谄媚的嘴逼他同行。

chapters.en: All at once he followed her like an ox going to the slaughter, like a deer stepping into a noose
chapters.zh: 少年人立刻跟随她，好像牛往宰杀之地，又像愚昧人带锁链，去受刑罚。

chapters.en: till an arrow pierces his liver, like a bird darting into a snare, little knowing it will cost him his life.
chapters.zh: 直等箭穿他的肝，如同雀鸟急入网罗，却不知是自丧己命。

chapters.en: Now then, my sons, listen to me; pay attention to what I say.
chapters.zh: 众子阿，现在要听从我，留心听我口中的话。

chapters.en: Do not let your heart turn to her ways or stray into her paths.
chapters.zh: 你的心，不可偏向淫妇的道。不要入她的迷途。

chapters.en: Many are the victims she has brought down; her slain are a mighty throng.
chapters.zh: 因为被她伤害仆倒的不少。被她杀戮的而且甚多。

chapters.en: Her house is a highway to the grave, leading down to the chambers of death.
chapters.zh: 她的家是在阴间之路，下到死亡之宫。

chapters.en: Does not wisdom call out? Does not understanding raise her voice?
chapters.zh: 智慧岂不呼叫，聪明岂不发声。

chapters.en: At the highest point along the way, where the paths meet, she takes her stand;
chapters.zh: 他在道旁高处的顶上，在十字路口站立。

chapters.en: beside the gate leading into the city, at the entrance, she cries aloud:
chapters.zh: 在城门旁，在城门口，在城门洞，大声说，

chapters.en: “To you, O people, I call out; I raise my voice to all mankind.
chapters.zh: 众人哪，我呼叫你们。我向世人发声，

chapters.en: You who are simple, gain prudence; you who are foolish, set your hearts on it.
chapters.zh: 说，愚蒙人哪，你们要会悟灵明。愚昧人哪，你们当心里明白。

chapters.en: Listen, for I have trustworthy things to say; I open my lips to speak what is right.
chapters.zh: 你们当听，因我要说极美的话。我张嘴要论正直的事。

chapters.en: My mouth speaks what is true, for my lips detest wickedness.
chapters.zh: 我的口要发出真理。我的嘴憎恶邪恶。

chapters.en: All the words of my mouth are just; none of them is crooked or perverse.
chapters.zh: 我口中的言语，都是公义，并无弯曲乖僻。

chapters.en: To the discerning all of them are right; they are upright to those who have found knowledge.
chapters.zh: 有聪明的以为明显，得知识的以为正直。

chapters.en: Choose my instruction instead of silver, knowledge rather than choice gold,
chapters.zh: 你们当受我的教训，不受白银。宁得知识，胜过黄金。

chapters.en: for wisdom is more precious than rubies, and nothing you desire can compare with her.
chapters.zh: 因为智慧比珍珠（或作红宝石）更美。一切可喜爱的，都不足与比较。

chapters.en: “I, wisdom, dwell together with prudence; I possess knowledge and discretion.
chapters.zh: 我智慧以灵明为居所，又寻得知识和谋略。

chapters.en: To fear the LORD is to hate evil; I hate pride and arrogance, evil behavior and perverse speech.
chapters.zh: 敬畏耶和华，在乎恨恶邪恶。那骄傲，狂妄，并恶道，以及乖谬的口，都为我所恨恶。

chapters.en: Counsel and sound judgment are mine; I have insight, I have power.
chapters.zh: 我有谋略，和真知识。我乃聪明。我有能力。

chapters.en: By me kings reign and rulers issue decrees that are just;
chapters.zh: 帝王借我坐国位。君王借我定公平。

chapters.en: by me princes govern, and nobles—all who rule on earth.
chapters.zh: 王子和首领，世上一切的审判官，都是借我掌权。

chapters.en: I love those who love me, and those who seek me find me.
chapters.zh: 爱我的，我也爱他。恳切寻求我的，必寻得见。

chapters.en: With me are riches and honor, enduring wealth and prosperity.
chapters.zh: 丰富尊荣在我。恒久的财并公义也在我。

chapters.en: My fruit is better than fine gold; what I yield surpasses choice silver.
chapters.zh: 我的果实胜过黄金。强如精金，我的出产超乎高银。

chapters.en: I walk in the way of righteousness, along the paths of justice,
chapters.zh: 我在公义的道上走，在公平的路中行。

chapters.en: bestowing a rich inheritance on those who love me and making their treasuries full.
chapters.zh: 使爱我的承受货财，并充满他们的府库。

chapters.en: “The LORD brought me forth as the first of his works,before his deeds of old;
chapters.zh: 在耶和华造化的起头，在太初创造万物之先，就有了我。

chapters.en: I was formed long ages ago, at the very beginning, when the world came to be.
chapters.zh: 从亘古，从太初，未有世界以前，我已被立。

chapters.en: When there were no watery depths, I was given birth, when there were no springs overflowing with water;
chapters.zh: 没有深渊，没有大水的泉源，我已生出。

chapters.en: before the mountains were settled in place, before the hills, I was given birth,
chapters.zh: 大山未曾奠定，小山未有之先，我已生出。

chapters.en: before he made the world or its fields or any of the dust of the earth.
chapters.zh: 耶和华还没有创造大地，和田野，并世上的土质，我已生出。

chapters.en: I was there when he set the heavens in place, when he marked out the horizon on the face of the deep,
chapters.zh: 他立高天，我在那里。他在渊面的周围，划出圆圈，

chapters.en: when he established the clouds above and fixed securely the fountains of the deep,
chapters.zh: 上使穹苍坚硬，下使渊源稳固，

chapters.en: when he gave the sea its boundary so the waters would not overstep his command, and when he marked out the foundations of the earth.
chapters.zh: 为沧海定出界限，使水不越过他的命令，立定大地的根基。

chapters.en: Then I was constantly at his side. I was filled with delight day after day, rejoicing always in his presence,
chapters.zh: 那时，我在他那里为工师，日日为他所喜爱，常常在他面前踊跃，

chapters.en: rejoicing in his whole world and delighting in mankind.
chapters.zh: 踊跃在他为人预备可住之地，也喜悦住在世人之间。

chapters.en: “Now then, my children, listen to me; blessed are those who keep my ways.
chapters.zh: 众子阿，现在要听从我。因为谨守我道的，便为有福。

chapters.en: Listen to my instruction and be wise; do not disregard it.
chapters.zh: 要听教训，就得智慧，不可弃绝。

chapters.en: Blessed are those who listen to me, watching daily at my doors, waiting at my doorway.
chapters.zh: 听从我，日日在我门口仰望，在我门框旁边等候的，那人便为有福。

chapters.en: For those who find me find life and receive favor from the LORD.
chapters.zh: 因为寻得我的，就寻得生命，也必蒙耶和华的恩惠。

chapters.en: But those who fail to find me harm themselves; all who hate me love death.”
chapters.zh: 得罪我的，却害了自己的性命。恨恶我的，都喜爱死亡。

chapters.en: Wisdom has built her house; she has set up its seven pillars.
chapters.zh: 智慧建造房屋，凿成七根柱子，

chapters.en: She has prepared her meat and mixed her wine; she has also set her table.
chapters.zh: 宰杀牲畜，调和旨酒，设摆筵席。

chapters.en: She has sent out her servants, and she calls from the highest point of the city,
chapters.zh: 打发使女出去，自己在城中至高处呼叫，

chapters.en: “Let all who are simple come to my house!” To those who have no sense she says,
chapters.zh: 说，谁是愚蒙人，可以转到这里来。又对那无知的人说，

chapters.en: “Come, eat my food and drink the wine I have mixed.
chapters.zh: 你们来，吃我的饼，喝我调和的酒。

chapters.en: Leave your simple ways and you will live; walk in the way of insight.”
chapters.zh: 你们愚蒙人，要舍弃愚蒙，就得存活。并要走光明的道。

chapters.en: Whoever corrects a mocker invites insults; whoever rebukes the wicked incurs abuse.
chapters.zh: 指斥亵慢人的，必受辱骂。责备恶人的，必被玷污。

chapters.en: Do not rebuke mockers or they will hate you; rebuke the wise and they will love you.
chapters.zh: 不要责备亵慢人，恐怕他恨你。要责备智慧人，他必爱你。

chapters.en: Instruct the wise and they will be wiser still; teach the righteous and they will add to their learning.
chapters.zh: 教导智慧人，他就越发有智慧。指示义人，他就增长学问。

chapters.en: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom, and knowledge of the Holy One is understanding.
chapters.zh: 敬畏耶和华，是智慧的开端。认识至圣者，便是聪明。

chapters.en: For through wisdom your days will be many, and years will be added to your life.
chapters.zh: 你借着我，日子必增多，年岁也必加添。

chapters.en: If you are wise, your wisdom will reward you; if you are a mocker, you alone will suffer.
chapters.zh: 你若有智慧，是与自己有益。你若亵慢，就必独自担当。

chapters.en: Folly is an unruly woman; she is simple and knows nothing.
chapters.zh: 愚昧的妇人喧嚷。她是愚蒙，一无所知。

chapters.en: She sits at the door of her house, on a seat at the highest point of the city,
chapters.zh: 她坐在自己的家门口，坐在城中高处的座位上，

chapters.en: calling out to those who pass by, who go straight on their way,
chapters.zh: 呼叫过路的，就是直行其道的人，

chapters.en: “Let all who are simple come to my house!” To those who have no sense she says,
chapters.zh: 说，谁是愚蒙人，可以转到这里来。又对那无知的人说，

chapters.en: “Stolen water is sweet; food eaten in secret is delicious!”
chapters.zh: 偷来的水是甜的，暗吃的饼是好的。

chapters.en: But little do they know that the dead are there, that her guests are deep in the realm of the dead.
chapters.zh: 人却不知有阴魂在她那里。她的客在阴间的深处。

chapters.en: The proverbs of Solomon: A wise son brings joy to his father, but a foolish son brings grief to his mother.
chapters.zh: 所罗门的箴言。智慧之子，使父亲欢乐。愚昧之子，叫母亲担忧。

chapters.en: Ill-gotten treasures have no lasting value, but righteousness delivers from death.
chapters.zh: 不义之财，毫无益处。惟有公义，能救人脱离死亡。

chapters.en: The LORD does not let the righteous go hungry, but he thwarts the craving of the wicked.
chapters.zh: 耶和华不使义人受饥饿。恶人所欲的他必推开。

chapters.en: Lazy hands make for poverty, but diligent hands bring wealth.
chapters.zh: 手懒的要受贫穷。手勤的却要富足。

chapters.en: He who gathers crops in summer is a prudent son, but he who sleeps during harvest is a disgraceful son.
chapters.zh: 夏天聚敛的，是智慧之子。收割时沉睡的，是贻羞之子。

chapters.en: Blessings crown the head of the righteous, but violence overwhelms the mouth of the wicked.
chapters.zh: 福祉临到义人的头。强暴蒙蔽恶人的口。

chapters.en: The name of the righteous is used in blessings, but the name of the wicked will rot.
chapters.zh: 义人的纪念被称赞。恶人的名字必朽烂。

chapters.en: The wise in heart accept commands, but a chattering fool comes to ruin.
chapters.zh: 心中智慧的，必受命令。口里愚妄的，必致倾倒。

chapters.en: Whoever walks in integrity walks securely, but whoever takes crooked paths will be found out.
chapters.zh: 行正直路的，步步安稳。走弯曲道的，必致败露。

chapters.en: Whoever winks maliciously causes grief, and a chattering fool comes to ruin.
chapters.zh: 以眼传神的，使人忧患。口里愚妄的，必致倾倒。

chapters.en: The mouth of the righteous is a fountain of life, but the mouth of the wicked conceals violence.
chapters.zh: 义人的口是生命的泉源。强暴蒙蔽恶人的口。

chapters.en: Hatred stirs up conflict, but love covers over all wrongs.
chapters.zh: 恨能挑启争端。爱能遮掩一切过错。

chapters.en: Wisdom is found on the lips of the discerning, but a rod is for the back of one who has no sense.
chapters.zh: 明哲人嘴里有智慧。无知人背上受刑杖。

chapters.en: The wise store up knowledge, but the mouth of a fool invites ruin.
chapters.zh: 智慧人积存知识。愚妄人的口速致败坏。

chapters.en: The wealth of the rich is their fortified city, but poverty is the ruin of the poor.
chapters.zh: 富户的财物，是他的坚城。穷人的贫乏，是他的败坏。

chapters.en: The wages of the righteous is life, but the earnings of the wicked are sin and death.
chapters.zh: 义人的勤劳致生。恶人的进项致死。（死原文作罪）

chapters.en: Whoever heeds discipline shows the way to life, but whoever ignores correction leads others astray.
chapters.zh: 谨守训诲的，乃在生命的道上。违弃责备的，便失迷了路。

chapters.en: Whoever conceals hatred with lying lips and spreads slander is a fool.
chapters.zh: 隐藏怨恨的，有说谎的嘴。口出谗谤的，是愚妄的人。

chapters.en: Sin is not ended by multiplying words, but the prudent hold their tongues.
chapters.zh: 多言多语难免有过。禁止嘴唇是有智慧。

chapters.en: The tongue of the righteous is choice silver, but the heart of the wicked is of little value.
chapters.zh: 义人的舌，乃似高银。恶人的心，所值无几。

chapters.en: The lips of the righteous nourish many, but fools die for lack of sense.
chapters.zh: 义人的口教养多人。愚昧人因无知而死亡。

chapters.en: The blessing of the LORD brings wealth, without painful toil for it.
chapters.zh: 耶和华所赐的福，使人富足。并不加上忧虑。

chapters.en: A fool finds pleasure in wicked schemes, but a person of understanding delights in wisdom.
chapters.zh: 愚妄人以行恶为戏耍。明哲人却以智慧为乐。

chapters.en: What the wicked dread will overtake them; what the righteous desire will be granted.
chapters.zh: 恶人所怕的必临到他。义人所愿的必蒙应允。

chapters.en: When the storm has swept by, the wicked are gone, but the righteous stand firm forever.
chapters.zh: 暴风一过，恶人归于无有。义人的根基却是永久。

chapters.en: As vinegar to the teeth and smoke to the eyes, so are sluggards to those who send them.
chapters.zh: 懒惰人叫差他的人，如醋倒牙，如烟薰目。

chapters.en: The fear of the LORD adds length to life, but the years of the wicked are cut short.
chapters.zh: 敬畏耶和华，使人日子加多。但恶人的年岁必被减少。

chapters.en: The prospect of the righteous is joy, but the hopes of the wicked come to nothing.
chapters.zh: 义人的盼望，必得喜乐。恶人的指望，必至灭没。

chapters.en: The way of the LORD is a refuge for the blameless, but it is the ruin of those who do evil.
chapters.zh: 耶和华的道，是正直人的保障。却成了作孽人的败坏。

chapters.en: The righteous will never be uprooted, but the wicked will not remain in the land.
chapters.zh: 义人永不挪移。恶人不得住在地上。

chapters.en: From the mouth of the righteous comes the fruit of wisdom, but a perverse tongue will be silenced.
chapters.zh: 义人的口，滋生智慧。乖谬的舌，必被割断。

chapters.en: The lips of the righteous know what finds favor, but the mouth of the wicked only what is perverse.
chapters.zh: 义人的嘴，能令人喜悦。恶人的口，说乖谬的话。

chapters.en: The LORD detests dishonest scales, but accurate weights find favor with him.
chapters.zh: 诡诈的天平，为耶和华所憎恶。公平的法码，为他所喜悦。

chapters.en: When pride comes, then comes disgrace, but with humility comes wisdom.
chapters.zh: 骄傲来，羞耻也来。谦逊人却有智慧。

chapters.en: The integrity of the upright guides them, but the unfaithful are destroyed by their duplicity.
chapters.zh: 正直人的纯正，必引导自己。奸诈人的乖僻，必毁灭自己。

chapters.en: Wealth is worthless in the day of wrath, but righteousness delivers from death.
chapters.zh: 发怒的日子，赀财无益。惟有公义能救人脱离死亡。

chapters.en: The righteousness of the blameless makes their paths straight, but the wicked are brought down by their own wickedness.
chapters.zh: 完全人的义，必指引他的路。但恶人必因自己的恶跌倒。

chapters.en: The righteousness of the upright delivers them, but the unfaithful are trapped by evil desires.
chapters.zh: 正直人的义，必拯救自己。奸诈人必陷在自己的罪孽中。

chapters.en: Hopes placed in mortals die with them; all the promise of their power comes to nothing.
chapters.zh: 恶人一死，他的指望必灭绝。罪人的盼望，也必灭没。

chapters.en: The righteous person is rescued from trouble, and it falls on the wicked instead.
chapters.zh: 义人得脱离患难，有恶人来代替他。

chapters.en: With their mouths the godless destroy their neighbors, but through knowledge the righteous escape.
chapters.zh: 不虔敬的人用口败坏邻舍。义人却因知识得救。

chapters.en: When the righteous prosper, the city rejoices; when the wicked perish, there are shouts of joy.
chapters.zh: 义人享福合城喜乐。恶人灭亡，人都欢呼。

chapters.en: Through the blessing of the upright a city is exalted, but by the mouth of the wicked it is destroyed.
chapters.zh: 城因正直人祝福便高举。却因邪恶人的口就倾覆。

chapters.en: Whoever derides their neighbor has no sense, but the one who has understanding holds their tongue.
chapters.zh: 藐视邻舍的，毫无智慧。明哲人却静默不言。

chapters.en: A gossip betrays a confidence, but a trustworthy person keeps a secret.
chapters.zh: 往来传舌的，泄漏密事。心中诚实的，遮隐事情。

chapters.en: For lack of guidance a nation falls, but victory is won through many advisers.
chapters.zh: 无智谋，民就败落。谋士多，人便安居。

chapters.en: Whoever puts up security for a stranger will surely suffer, but whoever refuses to shake hands in pledge is safe.
chapters.zh: 为外人作保的，必受亏损。恨恶击掌的，却得安稳。

chapters.en: A kindhearted woman gains honor, but ruthless men gain only wealth.
chapters.zh: 恩德的妇女得尊荣。强暴的男子得赀财。

chapters.en: Those who are kind benefit themselves, but the cruel bring ruin on themselves.
chapters.zh: 仁慈的人，善待自己。残忍的人，扰害己身。

chapters.en: A wicked person earns deceptive wages, but the one who sows righteousness reaps a sure reward.
chapters.zh: 恶人经营，得虚浮的工价。撒义种的，得实在的果效。

chapters.en: Truly the righteous attain life, but whoever pursues evil finds death.
chapters.zh: 恒心为义的，必得生命。追求邪恶的，必致死亡。

chapters.en: The LORD detests those whose hearts are perverse, but he delights in those whose ways are blameless.
chapters.zh: 心中乖僻的，为耶和华所憎恶。行事完全的，为他所喜悦。

chapters.en: Be sure of this: The wicked will not go unpunished, but those who are righteous will go free.
chapters.zh: 恶人虽然连手，必不免受罚。义人的后裔，必得拯救。

chapters.en: Like a gold ring in a pig’s snout is a beautiful woman who shows no discretion.
chapters.zh: 妇女美貌而无见识，如同金环带在猪鼻上。

chapters.en: The desire of the righteous ends only in good, but the hope of the wicked only in wrath.
chapters.zh: 义人的心愿，尽得好处。恶人的指望，致干忿怒。

chapters.en: One person gives freely, yet gains even more; another withholds unduly, but comes to poverty.
chapters.zh: 有施散的，却更增添。有吝惜过度的，反致穷乏。

chapters.en: A generous person will prosper; whoever refreshes others will be refreshed.
chapters.zh: 好施舍的，必得丰裕。滋润人的，必得滋润。
