chapters.en: Then sheep will graze as in their own pasture; lambs will feed among the ruins of the rich.
chapters.zh: 那时羊羔必来吃草，如同在自己的草场，丰肥人的荒场被游行的人吃尽。

chapters.en: Woe to those who draw sin along with cords of deceit, and wickedness as with cart ropes,
chapters.zh: 祸哉，那些以虚假之细绳牵罪孽的人，他们又像以套绳拉罪恶。

chapters.en: to those who say, “Let God hurry; let him hasten his work so we may see it. The plan of the Holy One of Israel— let it approach, let it come into view, so we may know it.”
chapters.zh: 说，任他急速行，赶快成就他的作为，使我们看看。任以色列圣者所谋划的临近成就，使我们知道。

chapters.en: Woe to those who call evil good and good evil, who put darkness for light and light for darkness, who put bitter for sweet and sweet for bitter.
chapters.zh: 祸哉，那些称恶为善，称善为恶，以暗为光，以光为暗，以苦为甜，以甜为苦的人。

chapters.en: Woe to those who are wise in their own eyes and clever in their own sight.
chapters.zh: 祸哉，那些自以为有智慧，自看为通达的人。

chapters.en: Woe to those who are heroes at drinking wine and champions at mixing drinks,
chapters.zh: 祸哉，那些勇于饮酒，以能力调浓酒的人。

chapters.en: who acquit the guilty for a bribe, but deny justice to the innocent.
chapters.zh: 他们因受贿赂，就称恶人为义，将义人的义夺去。

chapters.en: Therefore, as tongues of fire lick up straw and as dry grass sinks down in the flames, so their roots will decay and their flowers blow away like dust; for they have rejected the law of the LORD Almighty and spurned the word of the Holy One of Israel.
chapters.zh: 火苗怎样吞灭碎秸，干草怎样落在火焰之中，照样，他们的根必像朽物，他们的花，必像灰尘飞腾。因为他们厌弃万军之耶和华的训诲，藐视以色列圣者的言语。

chapters.en: Therefore the LORD’s anger burns against his people; his hand is raised and he strikes them down. The mountains shake, and the dead bodies are like refuse in the streets. Yet for all this, his anger is not turned away, his hand is still upraised.
chapters.zh: 所以耶和华的怒气向他的百姓发作，他的手伸出攻击他们，山岭就震动，他们的尸首在街市上好像粪土。虽然如此，他的怒气还未转消，他的手仍伸不缩。

chapters.en: He lifts up a banner for the distant nations, he whistles for those at the ends of the earth. Here they come, swiftly and speedily!
chapters.zh: 他必竖立大旗，招远方的国民，发丝声叫他们从地极而来。看哪，他们必急速奔来。

chapters.en: Not one of them grows tired or stumbles, not one slumbers or sleeps; not a belt is loosened at the waist, not a sandal strap is broken.
chapters.zh: 其中没有疲倦的，绊跌的，没有打盹的，睡觉的。腰带并不放松，鞋带也不折断。

chapters.en: Their arrows are sharp, all their bows are strung; their horses’ hooves seem like flint, their chariot wheels like a whirlwind.
chapters.zh: 他们的箭快利，弓也上了弦。马蹄算如坚石，车轮好像旋风。

chapters.en: Their roar is like that of the lion, they roar like young lions; they growl as they seize their prey and carry it off with no one to rescue.
chapters.zh: 他们要吼叫像母狮子，咆哮像少壮狮子。他们要咆哮抓食，坦然叼去，无人救回。

chapters.en: In that day they will roar over it like the roaring of the sea. And if one looks at the land, there is only darkness and distress; even the sun will be darkened by clouds.
chapters.zh: 那日他们要向以色列人吼叫，向海浪砰訇。人若望地，只见黑暗艰难。光明在云中变为昏暗。

chapters.en: In the year that King Uzziah died, I saw the Lord, high and exalted, seated on a throne; and the train of his robe filled the temple.
chapters.zh: 当乌西雅王崩的那年，我见主坐在高高的宝座上。他的衣裳垂下，遮满圣殿。

chapters.en: Above him were seraphim, each with six wings: With two wings they covered their faces, with two they covered their feet, and with two they were flying.
chapters.zh: 其上有撒拉弗侍立。各有六个翅膀。用两个翅膀遮脸，两个翅膀遮脚，两个翅膀飞翔。

chapters.en: And they were calling to one another: “Holy, holy, holy is the LORD Almighty; the whole earth is full of his glory.”
chapters.zh: 彼此呼喊说，圣哉，圣哉，圣哉，万军之耶和华。他的荣光充满全地。

chapters.en: At the sound of their voices the doorposts and thresholds shook and the temple was filled with smoke.
chapters.zh: 因呼喊者的声音，门槛的根基震动，殿充满了烟云。

chapters.en: “Woe to me!” I cried. “I am ruined! For I am a man of unclean lips, and I live among a people of unclean lips, and my eyes have seen the King, the LORD Almighty.”
chapters.zh: 那时我说，祸哉，我灭亡了。因为我是嘴唇不洁的人，又住在嘴唇不洁的民中。又因我眼见大君王万军之耶和华。

chapters.en: Then one of the seraphim flew to me with a live coal in his hand, which he had taken with tongs from the altar.
chapters.zh: 有一撒拉弗飞到我跟前，手里拿着红炭，是用火剪从坛上取下来的。

chapters.en: With it he touched my mouth and said, “See, this has touched your lips; your guilt is taken away and your sin atoned for.”
chapters.zh: 将炭沾我的口，说，看哪，这炭沾了你的嘴。你的罪孽便除掉，你的罪恶就赦免了。

chapters.en: Then I heard the voice of the Lord saying, “Whom shall I send? And who will go for us?” And I said, “Here am I. Send me!”
chapters.zh: 我又听见主的声音，说，我可以差遣谁呢？谁肯为我们去呢？我说，我在这里，请差遣我。

chapters.en: He said, “Go and tell this people: “ ‘Be ever hearing, but never understanding; be ever seeing, but never perceiving.’
chapters.zh: 他说，你去告诉这百姓说，你们听是要听见，却不明白。看是要看见，却不晓得。

chapters.en: Make the heart of this people calloused; make their ears dull and close their eyes.Otherwise they might see with their eyes, hear with their ears, understand with their hearts, and turn and be healed.”
chapters.zh: 要使这百姓心蒙脂油，耳朵发沉，眼睛昏迷。恐怕眼睛看见，耳朵听见，心里明白，回转过来，便得医治。

chapters.en: Then I said, “For how long, Lord?” And he answered: “Until the cities lie ruined and without inhabitant, until the houses are left deserted and the fields ruined and ravaged,
chapters.zh: 我就说，主阿，这到几时为止呢？他说，直到城邑荒凉，无人居住，房屋空闲无人，地土极其荒凉。

chapters.en: until the LORD has sent everyone far away and the land is utterly forsaken.
chapters.zh: 并且耶和华将人迁到远方，在这境内撇下的地土很多。

chapters.en: And though a tenth remains in the land, it will again be laid waste. But as the terebinth and oak leave stumps when they are cut down, so the holy seed will be the stump in the land.”
chapters.zh: 境内剩下的人，若还有十分之一，也必被吞灭。像栗树，橡树，虽被砍伐，树墩子，却仍存留。这圣洁的种类在国中也是如此。

chapters.en: When Ahaz son of Jotham, the son of Uzziah, was king of Judah, King Rezin of Aram and Pekah son of Remaliah king of Israel marched up to fight against Jerusalem, but they could not overpower it.
chapters.zh: 乌西雅的孙子约坦的儿子犹大王亚哈斯在位的时候，亚兰王利汛，和利玛利的儿子以色列王比加上来攻打耶路撒冷，却不能攻取。

chapters.en: Now the house of David was told, “Aram has allied itself with Ephraim”; so the hearts of Ahaz and his people were shaken, as the trees of the forest are shaken by the wind.
chapters.zh: 有人告诉大卫家说，亚兰与以法莲已经同盟。王的心和百姓的心就都跳动，好像林中的树被风吹动一样。

chapters.en: Then the LORD said to Isaiah, “Go out, you and your son Shear-Jashub, to meet Ahaz at the end of the aqueduct of the Upper Pool, on the road to the Launderer’s Field.
chapters.zh: 耶和华对以赛亚说，你和你的儿子施亚雅述出去，到上池的水沟头，在漂布地的大路上，去迎接亚哈斯。

chapters.en: Say to him, ‘Be careful, keep calm and don’t be afraid. Do not lose heart because of these two smoldering stubs of firewood—because of the fierce anger of Rezin and Aram and of the son of Remaliah.
chapters.zh: 对他说，你要谨慎安静。不要因亚兰王利汛，和利玛利的儿子，这两个冒烟的火把头所发的烈怒害怕，也不要心里胆怯。

chapters.en: Aram, Ephraim and Remaliah’s son have plotted your ruin, saying,
chapters.zh: 因为亚兰，和以法莲，并利玛利的儿子，设恶谋害你，

chapters.en: “Let us invade Judah; let us tear it apart and divide it among ourselves, and make the son of Tabeel king over it.”
chapters.zh: 说，我们可以上去，攻击犹大，扰乱它，攻破它，在其中立他比勒的儿子为王。

chapters.en: Yet this is what the Sovereign LORD says: “ ‘It will not take place, it will not happen,
chapters.zh: 所以主耶和华如此说，这所谋的必立不住，也不得成就。

chapters.en: for the head of Aram is Damascus, and the head of Damascus is only Rezin. Within sixty-five years Ephraim will be too shattered to be a people.
chapters.zh: 原来亚兰的首城是大马色，大马色的首领是利汛。六十五年之内，以法莲必然破坏，不再成为国民。

chapters.en: The head of Ephraim is Samaria, and the head of Samaria is only Remaliah’s son. If you do not stand firm in your faith, you will not stand at all.’ ”
chapters.zh: 以法莲的首城是撒玛利亚，撒玛利亚的首领是利玛利的儿子。你们若是不信，定然不得立稳。

chapters.en: Again the LORD spoke to Ahaz,
chapters.zh: 耶和华又晓谕亚哈斯说，

chapters.en: “Ask the LORD your God for a sign, whether in the deepest depths or in the highest heights.”
chapters.zh: 你向耶和华你的神求一个兆头。或求显在深处，或求显在高处。

chapters.en: But Ahaz said, “I will not ask; I will not put the LORD to the test.”
chapters.zh: 亚哈斯说，我不求，我不试探耶和华。

chapters.en: Then Isaiah said, “Hear now, you house of David! Is it not enough to try the patience of humans? Will you try the patience of my God also?
chapters.zh: 以赛亚说，大卫家阿，你们当听。你们使人厌烦岂算小事，还要使我的神厌烦吗？

chapters.en: Therefore the Lord himself will give you a sign: The virgin will conceive and give birth to a son, and will call him Immanuel.
chapters.zh: 因此，主自己要给你们一个兆头，必有童女怀孕生子，给他起名叫以马内利。（就是神与我们同在的意思）

chapters.en: He will be eating curds and honey when he knows enough to reject the wrong and choose the right,
chapters.zh: 到他晓得弃恶择善的时候，他必吃奶油与蜂蜜。

chapters.en: for before the boy knows enough to reject the wrong and choose the right, the land of the two kings you dread will be laid waste.
chapters.zh: 因为在这孩子还不晓得弃恶择善之先，你所憎恶的那二王之地，必致见弃。

chapters.en: The LORD will bring on you and on your people and on the house of your father a time unlike any since Ephraim broke away from Judah—he will bring the king of Assyria.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华必使亚述王攻击你的日子临到，你和你的百姓，并你的父家，自从以法莲离开犹大以来，未曾有这样的日子。

chapters.en: In that day the LORD will whistle for flies from the Nile delta in Egypt and for bees from the land of Assyria.
chapters.zh: 那时，耶和华要发丝声，使埃及江河源头的苍蝇，和亚述地的蜂子飞来。

chapters.en: They will all come and settle in the steep ravines and in the crevices in the rocks, on all the thornbushes and at all the water holes.
chapters.zh: 都必飞来，落在荒凉的谷内，磐石的穴里，和一切荆棘篱笆中，并一切的草场上。

chapters.en: In that day the Lord will use a razor hired from beyond the Euphrates River—the king of Assyria—to shave your heads and private parts, and to cut off your beards also.
chapters.zh: 那时，主必用大河外赁的剃头刀，就是亚述王，剃去头发，和脚上的毛，并要剃净胡须。

chapters.en: In that day, a person will keep alive a young cow and two goats.
chapters.zh: 那时，一个人要养活一只母牛犊，两只母绵羊。

chapters.en: And because of the abundance of the milk they give, there will be curds to eat. All who remain in the land will eat curds and honey.
chapters.zh: 因为出的奶多，他就得吃奶油。在境内所剩的人，都要吃奶油与蜂蜜。

chapters.en: In that day, in every place where there were a thousand vines worth a thousand silver shekels, there will be only briers and thorns.
chapters.zh: 从前凡种一千棵葡萄树，值银一千舍客勒的地方，到那时，必长荆棘和蒺藜。

chapters.en: Hunters will go there with bow and arrow, for the land will be covered with briers and thorns.
chapters.zh: 人上那里去，必带弓箭，因为遍地满了荆棘和蒺藜。

chapters.en: As for all the hills once cultivated by the hoe, you will no longer go there for fear of the briers and thorns; they will become places where cattle are turned loose and where sheep run.
chapters.zh: 所有用锄刨挖的山地，你因怕荆棘和蒺藜，不敢上那里去。只可成了放牛之处，为羊践踏之地。

chapters.en: The LORD said to me, “Take a large scroll and write on it with an ordinary pen: Maher-Shalal-Hash-Baz.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华对我说，你取一个大牌，拿人所用的笔，（或作人常用的字）写上玛黑珥沙拉勒哈施吧斯。（就是掳掠速临抢夺快到的意思）

chapters.en: So I called in Uriah the priest and Zechariah son of Jeberekiah as reliable witnesses for me.
chapters.zh: 我要用诚实的见证人，祭司乌利亚，和耶比利家的儿子撒迦利亚，记录这事。

chapters.en: Then I made love to the prophetess, and she conceived and gave birth to a son. And the LORD said to me, “Name him Maher-Shalal-Hash-Baz.
chapters.zh: 我以赛亚与妻子（原文作女先知）同室。她怀孕生子，耶和华就对我说，给他起名叫玛黑珥沙拉勒哈施吧斯。

chapters.en: For before the boy knows how to say ‘My father’ or ‘My mother,’ the wealth of Damascus and the plunder of Samaria will be carried off by the king of Assyria.”
chapters.zh: 因为在这小孩子不晓得叫父叫母之先，大马色的财宝，和撒玛利亚的掳物，必在亚述王面前搬了去。

chapters.en: The LORD spoke to me again:
chapters.zh: 耶和华又晓谕我说，

chapters.en: “Because this people has rejected the gently flowing waters of Shiloah and rejoices over Rezin and the son of Remaliah,
chapters.zh: 这百姓既厌弃西罗亚缓流的水，喜悦利汛和利玛利的儿子。

chapters.en: therefore the Lord is about to bring against them the mighty floodwaters of the Euphrates— the king of Assyria with all his pomp. It will overflow all its channels, run over all its banks
chapters.zh: 因此，主必使大河翻腾的水猛然冲来，就是亚述王，和他所有的威势。必漫过一切的水道，涨过两岸。

chapters.en: and sweep on into Judah, swirling over it, passing through it and reaching up to the neck. Its outspread wings will cover the breadth of your land, Immanuel !”
chapters.zh: 必冲入犹大。涨溢泛滥，直到颈项。以马内利阿，他展开翅膀，遍满你的地。

chapters.en: Raise the war cry, you nations, and be shattered! Listen, all you distant lands. Prepare for battle, and be shattered! Prepare for battle, and be shattered!
chapters.zh: 列国的人民哪，任凭你们喧嚷，终必破坏。远方的众人哪，当侧耳而听。任凭你们束起腰来，终必破坏。你们束起腰来，终必破坏。

chapters.en: Devise your strategy, but it will be thwarted; propose your plan, but it will not stand, for God is with us.
chapters.zh: 任凭你们同谋，终归无有。任凭你们言定，终不成立。因为神与我们同在。

chapters.en: This is what the LORD says to me with his strong hand upon me, warning me not to follow the way of this people:
chapters.zh: 耶和华以大能的手，指教我不可行这百姓所行的道，对我这样说，

chapters.en: “Do not call conspiracy everything this people calls a conspiracy; do not fear what they fear, and do not dread it.
chapters.zh: 这百姓说，同谋背叛，你们不要说，同谋背叛。他们所怕的，你们不要怕，也不要畏惧。

chapters.en: The LORD Almighty is the one you are to regard as holy, he is the one you are to fear, he is the one you are to dread.
chapters.zh: 但要尊万军之耶和华为圣。以他为你们所当怕的，所当畏惧的。

chapters.en: He will be a holy place; for both Israel and Judah he will be a stone that causes people to stumble and a rock that makes them fall. And for the people of Jerusalem he will be a trap and a snare.
chapters.zh: 他必作为圣所。却向以色列两家作绊脚的石头，跌人的磐石。向耶路撒冷的居民，作为圈套和网罗。

chapters.en: Many of them will stumble; they will fall and be broken, they will be snared and captured.”
chapters.zh: 许多人必在其上绊脚跌倒，而且跌碎，并陷入网罗，被缠住。

chapters.en: Bind up this testimony of warning and seal up God’s instruction among my disciples.
chapters.zh: 你要卷起律法书，在我门徒中间封住训诲。

chapters.en: I will wait for the LORD, who is hiding his face from the descendants of Jacob. I will put my trust in him.
chapters.zh: 我要等候那掩面不顾雅各家的耶和华，我也要仰望他。

chapters.en: Here am I, and the children the LORD has given me. We are signs and symbols in Israel from the LORD Almighty, who dwells on Mount Zion.
chapters.zh: 看哪，我与耶和华所给我的儿女，就是从住在锡安山万军之耶和华来的，在以色列中作为预兆和奇迹。

chapters.en: When someone tells you to consult mediums and spiritists, who whisper and mutter, should not a people inquire of their God? Why consult the dead on behalf of the living?
chapters.zh: 有人对你们说，当求问那些交鬼的，和行巫术的，就是声音绵蛮，言语微细的。你们便回答说，百姓不当求问自己的神吗？岂可为活人求问死人呢？

chapters.en: Consult God’s instruction and the testimony of warning. If anyone does not speak according to this word, they have no light of dawn.
chapters.zh: 人当以训诲和法度为标准。他们所说的，若不与此相符，必不得见晨光。

chapters.en: Distressed and hungry, they will roam through the land; when they are famished, they will become enraged and, looking upward, will curse their king and their God.
chapters.zh: 他们必经过这地，受艰难，受饥饿。饥饿的时候，心中焦躁，咒骂自己的君王，和自己的神。

chapters.en: Then they will look toward the earth and see only distress and darkness and fearful gloom, and they will be thrust into utter darkness.
chapters.zh: 仰观上天，俯察下地，不料，尽是艰难，黑暗，和幽暗的痛苦。他们必被赶入乌黑的黑暗中去。

chapters.en: Nevertheless, there will be no more gloom for those who were in distress. In the past he humbled the land of Zebulun and the land of Naphtali, but in the future he will honor Galilee of the nations, by the Way of the Sea, beyond the Jordan—
chapters.zh: 但那受过痛苦的，必不再见幽暗。从前神使西布伦地，和拿弗他利地被藐视。末后却使这沿海的路，约旦河外，外邦人的加利利地，得着荣耀。

chapters.en: The people walking in darkness have seen a great light; on those living in the land of deep darkness a light has dawned.
chapters.zh: 在黑暗中行走的百姓，看见了大光。住在死荫之地的人，有光照耀他们。

chapters.en: You have enlarged the nation and increased their joy; they rejoice before you as people rejoice at the harvest, as warriors rejoice when dividing the plunder.
chapters.zh: 你使这国民繁多，加增他们的喜乐。他们在你面前欢喜，好像收割的欢喜，像人分掳物那样的快乐。

chapters.en: For as in the day of Midian’s defeat, you have shattered the yoke that burdens them, the bar across their shoulders, the rod of their oppressor.
chapters.zh: 因为他们所负的重轭，和肩头上的杖，并欺压他们人的棍，你都已经折断，好像在米甸的日子一样。

chapters.en: Every warrior’s boot used in battle and every garment rolled in blood will be destined for burning, will be fuel for the fire.
chapters.zh: 战士在乱杀之间所穿戴的盔甲，并那滚在血中的衣服，都必作为可烧的，当作火柴。

chapters.en: For to us a child is born, to us a son is given, and the government will be on his shoulders. And he will be called Wonderful Counselor, Mighty God, Everlasting Father, Prince of Peace.
chapters.zh: 因有一婴孩为我们而生，有一子赐给我们。政权必担在他的肩头上。他名称为奇妙，策士，全能的神，永在的父，和平的君。

chapters.en: Of the greatness of his government and peace there will be no end. He will reign on David’s throne and over his kingdom, establishing and upholding it with justice and righteousness from that time on and forever. The zeal of the LORD Almighty will accomplish this.
chapters.zh: 他的政权与平安必加增无穷。他必在大卫的宝座上，治理他的国，以公平公义使国坚定稳固，从今直到永远。万军之耶和华的热心，必成就这事。

chapters.en: The Lord has sent a message against Jacob; it will fall on Israel.
chapters.zh: 主使一言入于雅各家，落于以色列家。

chapters.en: All the people will know it— Ephraim and the inhabitants of Samaria— who say with pride and arrogance of heart,
chapters.zh: 这众百姓，就是以法莲和撒玛利亚的居民，都要知道。他们凭骄傲自大的心说，

chapters.en: “The bricks have fallen down, but we will rebuild with dressed stone; the fig trees have been felled, but we will replace them with cedars.”
chapters.zh: 砖墙塌了，我们却要凿石头建筑，桑树砍了，我们却要换香柏树。

chapters.en: But the LORD has strengthened Rezin’s foes against them and has spurred their enemies on.
chapters.zh: 因此，耶和华要高举利汛的敌人，来攻击以色列，并要激动以色列的仇敌，

chapters.en: Arameans from the east and Philistines from the west have devoured Israel with open mouth. Yet for all this, his anger is not turned away, his hand is still upraised.
chapters.zh: 东有亚兰人，西有非利士人。他们张口要吞吃以色列。虽然如此，耶和华的怒气还未转消，他的手仍伸不缩。

chapters.en: But the people have not returned to him who struck them, nor have they sought the LORD Almighty.
chapters.zh: 这百姓还没有归向击打他们的主，也没有寻求万军之耶和华。

chapters.en: So the LORD will cut off from Israel both head and tail, both palm branch and reed in a single day;
chapters.zh: 因此，耶和华一日之间，必从以色列中剪除头与尾，棕枝与芦苇。

chapters.en: the elders and dignitaries are the head, the prophets who teach lies are the tail.
chapters.zh: 长老和尊贵人，就是头。以谎言教人的先知，就是尾。

chapters.en: Those who guide this people mislead them, and those who are guided are led astray.
chapters.zh: 因为引导这百姓的，使他们走错了路。被引导的，都必败亡。

chapters.en: Therefore the Lord will take no pleasure in the young men, nor will he pity the fatherless and widows, for everyone is ungodly and wicked, every mouth speaks folly. Yet for all this, his anger is not turned away, his hand is still upraised.
chapters.zh: 所以主必不喜悦他们的少年人，也不怜恤他们的孤儿寡妇。因为各人是亵渎的，是行恶的，并且各人的口，都说愚妄的话。虽然如此，耶和华的怒气还未转消，他的手仍伸不缩。

chapters.en: Surely wickedness burns like a fire; it consumes briers and thorns, it sets the forest thickets ablaze, so that it rolls upward in a column of smoke.
chapters.zh: 邪恶像火焚烧，烧灭荆棘和蒺藜。在稠密的树林中着起来，就成为烟柱，旋转上腾。

chapters.en: By the wrath of the LORD Almighty the land will be scorched and the people will be fuel for the fire; they will not spare one another.
chapters.zh: 因万军之耶和华的烈怒，地都烧遍。百姓成为火柴，无人怜爱弟兄。

chapters.en: On the right they will devour, but still be hungry; on the left they will eat, but not be satisfied. Each will feed on the flesh of their own offspring :
chapters.zh: 有人右边抢夺，仍受饥饿。左边吞吃，仍不饱足。各人吃自己膀臂上的肉。

chapters.en: Manasseh will feed on Ephraim, and Ephraim on Manasseh; together they will turn against Judah. Yet for all this, his anger is not turned away, his hand is still upraised.
chapters.zh: 玛拿西吞吃（或作攻击下同）以法莲，以法莲吞吃玛拿西。又一同攻击犹大。虽然如此，耶和华的怒气还未转消，他的手仍伸不缩。

chapters.en: Woe to those who make unjust laws, to those who issue oppressive decrees,
chapters.zh: 祸哉，那些设立不义之律例的，和记录奸诈之判语的。

chapters.en: to deprive the poor of their rights and withhold justice from the oppressed of my people, making widows their prey and robbing the fatherless.
chapters.zh: 为要屈枉穷乏人，夺去我民中困苦人的理，以寡妇当作掳物，以孤儿当作掠物。

chapters.en: What will you do on the day of reckoning, when disaster comes from afar? To whom will you run for help? Where will you leave your riches?
chapters.zh: 到降罚的日子，有灾祸从远方临到，那时，你们怎样行呢？你们向谁逃奔求救呢？你们的荣耀（或作财宝）存留何处呢？

chapters.en: Nothing will remain but to cringe among the captives or fall among the slain. Yet for all this, his anger is not turned away, his hand is still upraised.
chapters.zh: 他们只得屈身在被掳的人以下，仆倒在被杀的人以下，虽然如此，耶和华的怒气还未转消，他的手仍伸不缩。

chapters.en: “Woe to the Assyrian, the rod of my anger, in whose hand is the club of my wrath!
chapters.zh: 亚述是我怒气的棍，手中拿我恼恨的杖。

chapters.en: I send him against a godless nation, I dispatch him against a people who anger me, to seize loot and snatch plunder, and to trample them down like mud in the streets.
chapters.zh: 我要打发他攻击亵渎的国民，吩咐他攻击我所恼怒的百姓，抢财为掳物，夺货为掠物，将他们践踏，像街上的泥土一样。

chapters.en: But this is not what he intends, this is not what he has in mind; his purpose is to destroy, to put an end to many nations.
chapters.zh: 然而他不是这样的意思，他心也不这样打算。他心里倒想毁灭，剪除不少的国。

chapters.en: ‘Are not my commanders all kings?’ he says.
chapters.zh: 他说，我的臣仆，岂不都是王吗？

chapters.en: ‘Has not Kalno fared like Carchemish? Is not Hamath like Arpad, and Samaria like Damascus?
chapters.zh: 迦勒挪岂不像迦基米施吗？哈马岂不像亚珥拔吗？撒玛利亚岂不像大马色吗？

chapters.en: As my hand seized the kingdoms of the idols, kingdoms whose images excelled those of Jerusalem and Samaria—
chapters.zh: 我手已经够到有偶像的国。这些国雕刻的偶像过于耶路撒冷和撒玛利亚的偶像。

chapters.en: shall I not deal with Jerusalem and her images as I dealt with Samaria and her idols?’ ”
chapters.zh: 我怎样待撒玛利亚，和其中的偶像，岂不照样待耶路撒冷，和其中的偶像吗？

chapters.en: When the Lord has finished all his work against Mount Zion and Jerusalem, he will say, “I will punish the king of Assyria for the willful pride of his heart and the haughty look in his eyes.
chapters.zh: 主在锡安山，和耶路撒冷，成就他一切工作的时候，主说，我必罚亚述王自大的心，和他高傲眼目的荣耀。

chapters.en: For he says: “ ‘By the strength of my hand I have done this, and by my wisdom, because I have understanding. I removed the boundaries of nations, I plundered their treasures; like a mighty one I subdued their kings.
chapters.zh: 因为他说，我所成就的事，是靠我手的能力，和我的智慧。我本有聪明。我挪移列国的地界，抢夺他们所积蓄的财宝，并且我像勇士，使坐宝座的降为卑。

chapters.en: As one reaches into a nest, so my hand reached for the wealth of the nations; as people gather abandoned eggs, so I gathered all the countries; not one flapped a wing, or opened its mouth to chirp.’ ”
chapters.zh: 我的手够到列国的财宝，好像人够到鸟窝。我也得了全地，好像人拾起所弃的雀蛋。没有动翅膀的，没有张嘴的，也没有鸣叫的。

chapters.en: Does the ax raise itself above the person who swings it, or the saw boast against the one who uses it? As if a rod were to wield the person who lifts it up, or a club brandish the one who is not wood!
chapters.zh: 斧，岂可向用斧砍木的自夸呢？锯，岂可向用锯的自大呢？好比棍抡起那举棍的，好比杖举起那非木的人。

chapters.en: Therefore, the Lord, the LORD Almighty, will send a wasting disease upon his sturdy warriors; under his pomp a fire will be kindled like a blazing flame.
chapters.zh: 因此，主万军之耶和华，必使亚述王的肥壮人变为瘦弱。在他的荣华之下，必有火着起，如同焚烧一样。

chapters.en: The Light of Israel will become a fire, their Holy One a flame; in a single day it will burn and consume his thorns and his briers.
chapters.zh: 以色列的光必如火，他的圣者必如火焰。在一日之间，将亚述王的荆棘，和蒺藜，焚烧净尽。

chapters.en: The splendor of his forests and fertile fields it will completely destroy, as when a sick person wastes away.
chapters.zh: 又将他树林，和肥田的荣耀，全然烧尽。好像拿军旗的昏过去一样。

chapters.en: And the remaining trees of his forests will be so few that a child could write them down.
chapters.zh: 他林中剩下的树必稀少，就是孩子也能写其数。

chapters.en: In that day the remnant of Israel, the survivors of Jacob, will no longer rely on him who struck them down but will truly rely on the LORD, the Holy One of Israel.
chapters.zh: 到那日，以色列所剩下的，和雅各家所逃脱的，不再倚靠那击打他们的，却要诚实倚靠耶和华以色列的圣者。

chapters.en: A remnant will return, a remnant of Jacob will return to the Mighty God.
chapters.zh: 所剩下的，就是雅各家所剩下的，必归回全能的神。

chapters.en: Though your people be like the sand by the sea, Israel, only a remnant will return. Destruction has been decreed, overwhelming and righteous.
chapters.zh: 以色列阿，你的百姓，虽多如海沙，惟有剩下的归回。原来灭绝的事已定，必有公义施行，如水涨溢。

chapters.en: The Lord, the LORD Almighty, will carry out the destruction decreed upon the whole land.
chapters.zh: 因为主万军之耶和华，在全地之中，必成就所定规的结局。

chapters.en: Therefore this is what the Lord, the LORD Almighty, says: “My people who live in Zion, do not be afraid of the Assyrians, who beat you with a rod and lift up a club against you, as Egypt did.
chapters.zh: 所以主万军之耶和华如此说，住锡安我的百姓阿，亚述王虽然用棍击打你，又照埃及的样子，举杖攻击你，你却不要怕他。

chapters.en: Very soon my anger against you will end and my wrath will be directed to their destruction.”
chapters.zh: 因为还有一点点时候，向你们发的忿恨就要完毕，我的怒气要向他发作，使他灭亡。

chapters.en: The LORD Almighty will lash them with a whip, as when he struck down Midian at the rock of Oreb; and he will raise his staff over the waters, as he did in Egypt.
chapters.zh: 万军之耶和华要兴起鞭来攻击他，好像在俄立磐石那里杀戮米甸人一样。耶和华的杖，要向海伸出，把杖举起，像在埃及一样。

chapters.en: In that day their burden will be lifted from your shoulders, their yoke from your neck; the yoke will be broken because you have grown so fat.
chapters.zh: 到那日，亚述王的重担必离开你的肩头，他的轭必离开你的颈项。那轭也必因肥壮的缘故撑断。（或作因膏油的缘故毁坏）

chapters.en: They enter Aiath; they pass through Migron; they store supplies at Mikmash.
chapters.zh: 亚述王来到亚叶，经过米矶仑。在密抹安放辎重。

chapters.en: They go over the pass, and say, “We will camp overnight at Geba.” Ramah trembles; Gibeah of Saul flees.
chapters.zh: 他们过了隘口，在迦巴住宿。拉玛人战兢。扫罗的基比亚人逃跑。

chapters.en: Cry out, Daughter Gallim! Listen, Laishah! Poor Anathoth!
chapters.zh: 迦琳的居民哪，（居民原文作女子）要高声呼喊。莱煞人哪，须听。哀哉，困苦的亚拿突阿。

chapters.en: Madmenah is in flight; the people of Gebim take cover.
chapters.zh: 玛得米那人躲避。基柄的居民逃遁。

chapters.en: This day they will halt at Nob; they will shake their fist at the mount of Daughter Zion, at the hill of Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 当那日，亚述王要在挪伯歇兵。向锡安女子的山，就是耶路撒冷的山，抡手攻他。

chapters.en: See, the Lord, the LORD Almighty, will lop off the boughs with great power. The lofty trees will be felled, the tall ones will be brought low.
chapters.zh: 看哪，主万军之耶和华，以惊吓削去树枝。长高的必被砍下，高大的必被伐倒。

chapters.en: He will cut down the forest thickets with an ax; Lebanon will fall before the Mighty One.
chapters.zh: 稠密的树林，他要用铁器砍下，利巴嫩的树木必被大能者伐倒。

chapters.en: A shoot will come up from the stump of Jesse; from his roots a Branch will bear fruit.
chapters.zh: 从耶西的残干必长出嫩枝，从他根生的枝子必结果实。

chapters.en: The Spirit of the LORD will rest on him— the Spirit of wisdom and of understanding, the Spirit of counsel and of might, the Spirit of the knowledge and fear of the LORD—
chapters.zh: 耶和华的灵必住在他身上，就是使他有智慧和聪明的灵，谋略和能力的灵，知识和敬畏耶和华的灵。

chapters.en: and he will delight in the fear of the LORD. He will not judge by what he sees with his eyes, or decide by what he hears with his ears;
chapters.zh: 他必以敬畏耶和华为乐。行审判不凭眼见，断是非也不凭耳闻。

chapters.en: but with righteousness he will judge the needy, with justice he will give decisions for the poor of the earth. He will strike the earth with the rod of his mouth; with the breath of his lips he will slay the wicked.
chapters.zh: 却要以公义审判贫穷人，以正直判断世上的谦卑人。以口中的杖击打世界。以嘴里的气杀戮恶人。

chapters.en: Righteousness will be his belt and faithfulness the sash around his waist.
chapters.zh: 公义必当他的腰带，信实必当他胁下的带子。

chapters.en: The wolf will live with the lamb, the leopard will lie down with the goat, the calf and the lion and the yearling together; and a little child will lead them.
chapters.zh: 豺狼必与绵羊羔同居，豹子与山羊羔同卧。少壮狮子，与牛犊，并肥畜同群。小孩子要牵引他们。

chapters.en: The cow will feed with the bear, their young will lie down together, and the lion will eat straw like the ox.
chapters.zh: 牛必与熊同食。牛犊必与小熊同卧。狮子必吃草与牛一样。

chapters.en: The infant will play near the cobra’s den, and the young child will put its hand into the viper’s nest.
chapters.zh: 吃奶的孩子必玩耍在虺蛇的洞口，断奶的婴儿必按手在毒蛇的穴上。

chapters.en: They will neither harm nor destroy on all my holy mountain, for the earth will be filled with the knowledge of the LORD as the waters cover the sea.
chapters.zh: 在我圣山的遍处，这一切都不伤人，不害物。因为认识耶和华的知识要充满遍地，好像水充满洋海一般。

chapters.en: In that day the Root of Jesse will stand as a banner for the peoples; the nations will rally to him, and his resting place will be glorious.
chapters.zh: 到那日，耶西的根立作万民的大旗。外邦人必寻求他。他安息之所大有荣耀。

chapters.en: In that day the Lord will reach out his hand a second time to reclaim the surviving remnant of his people from Assyria, from Lower Egypt, from Upper Egypt, from Cush, from Elam, from Babylonia, from Hamath and from the islands of the Mediterranean.
chapters.zh: 当那日，主必二次伸手救回自己百姓中所余剩的，就是在亚述，埃及，巴忒罗，古实，以拦，示拿，哈马，并众海岛所剩下的。

chapters.en: He will raise a banner for the nations and gather the exiles of Israel; he will assemble the scattered people of Judah from the four quarters of the earth.
chapters.zh: 他必向列国竖立大旗，招回以色列被赶散的人，又从地的四方聚集分散的犹大人。

chapters.en: Ephraim’s jealousy will vanish, and Judah’s enemies will be destroyed; Ephraim will not be jealous of Judah, nor Judah hostile toward Ephraim.
chapters.zh: 以法莲的嫉妒就必消散，扰害犹大的必被剪除。以法莲必不嫉妒犹大，犹大也不扰害以法莲。

chapters.en: They will swoop down on the slopes of Philistia to the west; together they will plunder the people to the east. They will subdue Edom and Moab, and the Ammonites will be subject to them.
chapters.zh: 他们要向西飞，扑在非利士人的肩头上。（肩头上或作西界）一同掳掠东方人，伸手按住以东和摩押。亚扪人也必顺服他们。

chapters.en: The LORD will dry up the gulf of the Egyptian sea; with a scorching wind he will sweep his hand over the Euphrates River. He will break it up into seven streams so that anyone can cross over in sandals.
chapters.zh: 耶和华必使埃及海汊枯干。抡手用暴热的风，使大河分为七条，令人过去不至湿脚。

chapters.en: There will be a highway for the remnant of his people that is left from Assyria, as there was for Israel when they came up from Egypt.
chapters.zh: 为主余剩的百姓，就是从亚述剩下回来的，必有一条大道，如当日以色列从埃及地上来一样。

chapters.en: In that day you will say: “I will praise you, LORD. Although you were angry with me, your anger has turned away and you have comforted me.
chapters.zh: 到那日，你必说，耶和华阿，我要称谢你因为你虽然向我发怒，你的怒气却已转消，你又安慰了我。

chapters.en: Surely God is my salvation; I will trust and not be afraid. The LORD, the LORD himself, is my strength and my defense ; he has become my salvation.”
chapters.zh: 看哪，神是我的拯救。我要倚靠他，并不惧怕。因为主耶和华是我的力量，是我的诗歌。他也成了我的拯救。

chapters.en: With joy you will draw water from the wells of salvation.
chapters.zh: 所以你们必从救恩的泉源欢然取水。

chapters.en: In that day you will say: “Give praise to the LORD, proclaim his name; make known among the nations what he has done, and proclaim that his name is exalted.
chapters.zh: 在那日，你们要说，当称谢耶和华，求告他的名，将他所行的传扬在万民中，提说他的名已被尊崇。

chapters.en: Sing to the LORD, for he has done glorious things; let this be known to all the world.
chapters.zh: 你们要向耶和华唱歌。因他所行的甚是美好。但愿这事普传天下。

chapters.en: Shout aloud and sing for joy, people of Zion, for great is the Holy One of Israel among you.”
chapters.zh: 锡安的居民哪，当扬声欢呼。因为在你们中间的以色列圣者，乃为至大。

chapters.en: A prophecy against Babylon that Isaiah son of Amoz saw:
chapters.zh: 亚摩斯的儿子以赛亚得默示论巴比伦。

chapters.en: Raise a banner on a bare hilltop, shout to them; beckon to them to enter the gates of the nobles.
chapters.zh: 应当在净光的山竖立大旗，向群众扬声招手，使他们进入贵胄的门。

chapters.en: I have commanded those I prepared for battle; I have summoned my warriors to carry out my wrath— those who rejoice in my triumph.
chapters.zh: 我吩咐我所挑出来的人。我招呼我的勇士，就是那矜夸高傲之辈，为要成就我怒中所定的。

chapters.en: Listen, a noise on the mountains, like that of a great multitude! Listen, an uproar among the kingdoms, like nations massing together! The LORD Almighty is mustering an army for war.
chapters.zh: 山间有多人的声音，好像是大国人民。有许多国的民聚集哄嚷的声音。这是万军之耶和华点齐军队，预备打仗。

chapters.en: They come from faraway lands, from the ends of the heavens— the LORD and the weapons of his wrath— to destroy the whole country.
chapters.zh: 他们从远方来，从天边来，就是耶和华并他恼恨的兵器，要毁灭这全地。

chapters.en: Wail, for the day of the LORD is near; it will come like destruction from the Almighty.
chapters.zh: 你们要哀号，因为耶和华的日子临近了。这日来到，好像毁灭从全能者来到。

chapters.en: Because of this, all hands will go limp, every heart will melt with fear.
chapters.zh: 所以人手都必软弱，人心都必消化。

chapters.en: Terror will seize them, pain and anguish will grip them; they will writhe like a woman in labor. They will look aghast at each other, their faces aflame.
chapters.zh: 他们必惊惶悲痛。愁苦必将他们抓住。他们疼痛，好像产难的妇人一样。彼此惊奇相看，脸如火焰。

chapters.en: See, the day of the LORD is coming —a cruel day, with wrath and fierce anger— to make the land desolate and destroy the sinners within it.
chapters.zh: 耶和华的日子临到，必有残忍，忿恨，烈怒。使这地荒凉，从其中除灭罪人。

chapters.en: The stars of heaven and their constellations will not show their light. The rising sun will be darkened and the moon will not give its light.
chapters.zh: 天上的众星群宿，都不发光。日头一出，就变黑暗，月亮也不放光。

chapters.en: I will punish the world for its evil, the wicked for their sins. I will put an end to the arrogance of the haughty and will humble the pride of the ruthless.
chapters.zh: 我必因邪恶，刑罚世界，因罪孽，刑罚恶人。使骄傲人的狂妄止息，制伏强暴人的狂傲。

chapters.en: I will make people scarcer than pure gold, more rare than the gold of Ophir.
chapters.zh: 我必使人比精金还少，使人比俄斐纯金更少。

chapters.en: Therefore I will make the heavens tremble; and the earth will shake from its place at the wrath of the LORD Almighty, in the day of his burning anger.
chapters.zh: 我万军之耶和华在忿恨中发烈怒的日子，必使天震动，使地摇撼，离其本位。

chapters.en: Like a hunted gazelle, like sheep without a shepherd, they will all return to their own people, they will flee to their native land.
chapters.zh: 人必像被追赶的鹿，像无人收聚的羊，各归回本族，各逃到本土。

chapters.en: Whoever is captured will be thrust through; all who are caught will fall by the sword.
chapters.zh: 凡被仇敌追上的，必被刺死。凡被捉住的，必被刀杀。

chapters.en: Their infants will be dashed to pieces before their eyes; their houses will be looted and their wives violated.
chapters.zh: 他们的婴孩，必在他们眼前摔碎。他们的房屋，必被抢夺。他们的妻子，必被玷污。

chapters.en: See, I will stir up against them the Medes, who do not care for silver and have no delight in gold.
chapters.zh: 我必激动玛代人来攻击他们。玛代人不注重银子，也不喜爱金子。

chapters.en: Their bows will strike down the young men; they will have no mercy on infants, nor will they look with compassion on children.
chapters.zh: 他们必用弓击碎少年人，不怜悯妇人所生的，眼也不顾惜孩子。

chapters.en: Babylon, the jewel of kingdoms, the pride and glory of the Babylonians,will be overthrown by God like Sodom and Gomorrah.
chapters.zh: 巴比伦素来为列国的荣耀，为迦勒底人所矜夸的华美，必像神所倾覆的所多玛蛾摩拉一样。

chapters.en: She will never be inhabited or lived in through all generations; there no nomads will pitch their tents, there no shepherds will rest their flocks.
chapters.zh: 其内必永无人烟，世世代代无人居住。亚拉伯人也不在那里支搭帐棚。牧羊的人，也不使羊群卧在那里。

chapters.en: But desert creatures will lie there, jackals will fill her houses; there the owls will dwell, and there the wild goats will leap about.
chapters.zh: 只有旷野的走兽卧在那里。咆哮的兽满了房屋。鸵鸟住在那里。野山羊在那里跳舞。

chapters.en: Hyenas will inhabit her strongholds, jackals her luxurious palaces. Her time is at hand, and her days will not be prolonged.
chapters.zh: 豺狼必在他宫中呼号。野狗必在他华美殿内吼叫。巴比伦受罚的时候临近，他的日子，必不长久。

chapters.en: The LORD will have compassion on Jacob; once again he will choose Israel and will settle them in their own land. Foreigners will join them and unite with the descendants of Jacob.
chapters.zh: 耶和华要怜恤雅各，必再拣选以色列，将他们安置在本地。寄居的必与他们联合，紧贴雅各家。

chapters.en: Nations will take them and bring them to their own place. And Israel will take possession of the nations and make them male and female servants in the LORD’s land. They will make captives of their captors and rule over their oppressors.
chapters.zh: 外邦人必将他们带回本土。以色列家必在耶和华的地上得外邦人为仆婢。也要掳掠先前掳掠他们的，辖制先前欺压他们的。

chapters.en: On the day the LORD gives you relief from your suffering and turmoil and from the harsh labor forced on you,
chapters.zh: 当耶和华使你脱离愁苦，烦恼，并人勉强你作的苦工，得享安息的日子，

chapters.en: you will take up this taunt against the king of Babylon: How the oppressor has come to an end! How his fury has ended!
chapters.zh: 你必提这诗歌论巴比伦王说，欺压人的何竟息灭，强暴的何竟止息。

chapters.en: The LORD has broken the rod of the wicked, the scepter of the rulers,
chapters.zh: 耶和华折断了恶人的杖，辖制人的圭，

chapters.en: which in anger struck down peoples with unceasing blows, and in fury subdued nations with relentless aggression.
chapters.zh: 就是在忿怒中连连攻击众民的，在怒气中辖制列国，行逼迫无人阻止的。

chapters.en: All the lands are at rest and at peace; they break into singing.
chapters.zh: 现在全地得安息，享平静。人皆发声欢呼。

chapters.en: Even the junipers and the cedars of Lebanon gloat over you and say, “Now that you have been laid low, no one comes to cut us down.”
chapters.zh: 松树和利巴嫩的香柏树，都因你欢乐，说，自从你仆倒，再无人上来砍伐我们。

chapters.en: The realm of the dead below is all astir to meet you at your coming; it rouses the spirits of the departed to greet you— all those who were leaders in the world; it makes them rise from their thrones— all those who were kings over the nations.
chapters.zh: 你下到阴间，阴间就因你震动，来迎接你。又因你惊动在世曾为首领的阴魂，并使那曾为列国君王的，都离位站起。

chapters.en: They will all respond, they will say to you, “You also have become weak, as we are; you have become like us.”
chapters.zh: 他们都要发言对你说，你也变为软弱，像我们一样吗？你也成了我们的样子吗？

chapters.en: All your pomp has been brought down to the grave, along with the noise of your harps; maggots are spread out beneath you and worms cover you.
chapters.zh: 你的威势，和你琴瑟的声音，都下到阴间。你下铺的是虫，上盖的是蛆。

chapters.en: How you have fallen from heaven, morning star, son of the dawn! You have been cast down to the earth, you who once laid low the nations!
chapters.zh: 明亮之星，早晨之子阿，你何竟从天坠落。你这攻败列国的，何竟被砍倒在地上。

chapters.en: You said in your heart, “I will ascend to the heavens; I will raise my throne above the stars of God; I will sit enthroned on the mount of assembly, on the utmost heights of Mount Zaphon.
chapters.zh: 你心里曾说，我要升到天上。我要高举我的宝座在神众星以上。我要坐在聚会的山上，在北方的极处，

chapters.en: I will ascend above the tops of the clouds; I will make myself like the Most High.”
chapters.zh: 我要升到高云之上。我要与至上者同等。

chapters.en: But you are brought down to the realm of the dead, to the depths of the pit.
chapters.zh: 然而你必坠落阴间，到坑中极深之处。

chapters.en: Those who see you stare at you, they ponder your fate: “Is this the man who shook the earth and made kingdoms tremble,
chapters.zh: 凡看见你的，都要定睛看你，留意看你，说，使大地战抖，使列国震动，

chapters.en: the man who made the world a wilderness, who overthrew its cities and would not let his captives go home?”
chapters.zh: 使世界如同荒野，使城邑倾覆，不释放被掳的人归家，是这个人吗？

chapters.en: All the kings of the nations lie in state, each in his own tomb.
chapters.zh: 列国的君王俱各在自己阴宅的荣耀中安睡。

chapters.en: But you are cast out of your tomb like a rejected branch; you are covered with the slain, with those pierced by the sword, those who descend to the stones of the pit. Like a corpse trampled underfoot,
chapters.zh: 惟独你被抛弃，不得入你的坟墓，好像可憎的枝子。以被杀的人为衣，就是被刀刺透，坠落坑中石头那里的。你又像被践踏的尸首一样。

chapters.en: you will not join them in burial, for you have destroyed your land and killed your people. Let the offspring of the wicked never be mentioned again.
chapters.zh: 你不得与君王同葬，因为你败坏你的国，杀戮你的民。恶人后裔的名，必永不提说。

chapters.en: Prepare a place to slaughter his children for the sins of their ancestors; they are not to rise to inherit the land and cover the earth with their cities.
chapters.zh: 先人既有罪孽，就要预备杀戮他的子孙，免得他们兴起来，得了遍地，在世上修满城邑。

chapters.en: “I will rise up against them,” declares the LORD Almighty. “I will wipe out Babylon’s name and survivors, her offspring and descendants,” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 万军之耶和华说，我必兴起攻击他们，将巴比伦的名号，和所余剩的人，连子带孙一并剪除。这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: “I will turn her into a place for owls and into swampland; I will sweep her with the broom of destruction,” declares the LORD Almighty.
chapters.zh: 我必使巴比伦为箭猪所得，又变为水池。我要用灭亡的扫帚扫净他。这是万军之耶和华说的。

chapters.en: The LORD Almighty has sworn, “Surely, as I have planned, so it will be, and as I have purposed, so it will happen.
chapters.zh: 万军之耶和华起誓，说，我怎样思想，必照样成就。我怎样定意，必照样成立。

chapters.en: I will crush the Assyrian in my land; on my mountains I will trample him down. His yoke will be taken from my people, and his burden removed from their shoulders.”
chapters.zh: 就是在我地上打折亚述人，在我山上将他践踏，他加的轭，必离开以色列人。他加的重担，必离开他们的肩头。

chapters.en: This is the plan determined for the whole world; this is the hand stretched out over all nations.
chapters.zh: 这是向全地所定的旨意。这是向万国所伸出的手。

chapters.en: For the LORD Almighty has purposed, and who can thwart him? His hand is stretched out, and who can turn it back?
chapters.zh: 万军之耶和华既然定意，谁能废弃呢？他的手已经伸出，谁能转回呢？

chapters.en: This prophecy came in the year King Ahaz died:
chapters.zh: 亚哈斯王崩的那年，就有以下的默示。

chapters.en: Do not rejoice, all you Philistines, that the rod that struck you is broken; from the root of that snake will spring up a viper, its fruit will be a darting, venomous serpent.
chapters.zh: 非利士全地阿，不要因击打你的杖折断就喜乐。因为从蛇的根，必生出毒蛇。它所生的，是火焰的飞龙。

chapters.en: The poorest of the poor will find pasture, and the needy will lie down in safety. But your root I will destroy by famine; it will slay your survivors.
chapters.zh: 贫寒人的长子，必有所食，穷乏人必安然躺卧。我必以饥荒，治死你的根，你所余剩的人，必被杀戮。

chapters.en: Wail, you gate! Howl, you city! Melt away, all you Philistines! A cloud of smoke comes from the north, and there is not a straggler in its ranks.
chapters.zh: 门哪，应当哀号。城阿，应当呼喊。非利士全地阿，你都消化了。因为有烟从北方出来，他行伍中并无乱队的。

chapters.en: What answer shall be given to the envoys of that nation? “The LORD has established Zion, and in her his afflicted people will find refuge.”
chapters.zh: 可怎样回答外邦的使者呢？（外邦或指非利士）必说，耶和华建立了锡安，他百姓中的困苦人，必投奔在其中。

chapters.en: A prophecy against Moab: Ar in Moab is ruined, destroyed in a night! Kir in Moab is ruined, destroyed in a night!
chapters.zh: 论摩押的默示。一夜之间，摩押的亚珥，变为荒废，归于无有。一夜之间，摩押的基珥，变为荒废，归于无有。

chapters.en: Dibon goes up to its temple, to its high places to weep; Moab wails over Nebo and Medeba. Every head is shaved and every beard cut off.
chapters.zh: 他们上巴益，又往底本，到高处去哭泣。摩押人因尼波和米底巴哀号，各人头上光秃，胡须剃净。

chapters.en: In the streets they wear sackcloth; on the roofs and in the public squares they all wail, prostrate with weeping.
chapters.zh: 他们在街市上都腰束麻布，在房顶上和宽阔处，俱各哀号，眼泪汪汪。

chapters.en: Heshbon and Elealeh cry out, their voices are heard all the way to Jahaz. Therefore the armed men of Moab cry out, and their hearts are faint.
chapters.zh: 希实本和以利亚利悲哀的声音，达到雅杂。所以摩押带兵器的高声喊嚷。人心战兢。

chapters.en: My heart cries out over Moab; her fugitives flee as far as Zoar, as far as Eglath Shelishiyah. They go up the hill to Luhith, weeping as they go; on the road to Horonaim they lament their destruction.
chapters.zh: 我心为摩押悲哀，他的贵胄，（或作逃民）逃到琐珥，到伊基拉，施利施亚。他们上鲁希坡随走随哭。在何罗念的路上，因毁灭举起哀声。

chapters.en: The waters of Nimrim are dried up and the grass is withered; the vegetation is gone and nothing green is left.
chapters.zh: 因为宁林的水成为干涸。青草枯干，嫩草灭没，青绿之物，一无所有。

chapters.en: So the wealth they have acquired and stored up they carry away over the Ravine of the Poplars.
chapters.zh: 因此，摩押人所得的财物，和所积蓄的，都要运过柳树河。

chapters.en: Their outcry echoes along the border of Moab; their wailing reaches as far as Eglaim, their lamentation as far as Beer Elim.
chapters.zh: 哀声遍闻摩押的四境。哀号的声音，达到以基莲。哀号的声音，达到比珥以琳。

chapters.en: The waters of Dimon are full of blood, but I will bring still more upon Dimon — a lion upon the fugitives of Moab and upon those who remain in the land.
chapters.zh: 底们的水充满了血。我还要加增底们的灾难，叫狮子来追上摩押逃脱的民，和那地上所余剩的人。

chapters.en: Send lambs as tribute to the ruler of the land, from Sela, across the desert, to the mount of Daughter Zion.
chapters.zh: 你们当将羊羔奉给那地掌权的，从西拉往旷野，送到锡安城的山。（城原文作女子）

chapters.en: Like fluttering birds pushed from the nest, so are the women of Moab at the fords of the Arnon.
chapters.zh: 摩押的居民，（居民原文作女子）在亚嫩渡口，必像游飞的鸟，如拆窝的雏。

chapters.en: “Make up your mind,” Moab says. “Render a decision. Make your shadow like night— at high noon. Hide the fugitives, do not betray the refugees.
chapters.zh: 求你献谋略，行公平，使你的影子在午间如黑夜，隐藏被赶散的人，不可显露逃民。

chapters.en: Let the Moabite fugitives stay with you; be their shelter from the destroyer.” The oppressor will come to an end, and destruction will cease; the aggressor will vanish from the land.
chapters.zh: 求你容我这被赶散的人和你同居。至于摩押，求你作他的隐密处脱离灭命者的面。勒索人的归于无有，毁灭的事止息了，欺压人的从国中除灭了。

chapters.en: In love a throne will be established; in faithfulness a man will sit on it— one from the house of David— one who in judging seeks justice and speeds the cause of righteousness.
chapters.zh: 必有宝座因慈爱坚立。必有一位诚诚实实坐在其上，在大卫帐幕中施行审判，寻求公平，速行公义。

chapters.en: We have heard of Moab’s pride— how great is her arrogance!— of her conceit, her pride and her insolence; but her boasts are empty.
chapters.zh: 我们听说摩押人骄傲，是极其骄傲，听说他狂妄，骄傲，忿怒，他夸大的话，是虚空的。

chapters.en: Therefore the Moabites wail, they wail together for Moab. Lament and grieve for the raisin cakes of Kir Hareseth.
chapters.zh: 因此，摩押人必为摩押哀号，人人都要哀号。你们摩押人要为吉珥哈列设的葡萄饼哀叹，极其忧伤。

chapters.en: The fields of Heshbon wither, the vines of Sibmah also. The rulers of the nations have trampled down the choicest vines, which once reached Jazer and spread toward the desert. Their shoots spread out and went as far as the sea.
chapters.zh: 因为希实本的田地，和西比玛的葡萄树，都衰残了。列国的君主折断其上美好的枝子。这枝子长到雅谢延到旷野。嫩枝向外探出，直探过盐海。

chapters.en: So I weep, as Jazer weeps, for the vines of Sibmah. Heshbon and Elealeh, I drench you with tears! The shouts of joy over your ripened fruit and over your harvests have been stilled.
chapters.zh: 因此，我要为西比玛的葡萄树哀哭，与雅谢人哀哭一样。希实本，以利亚利阿，我要以眼泪浇灌你。因为有交战呐喊的声音，临到你夏天的果子，并你收割的庄稼。

chapters.en: Joy and gladness are taken away from the orchards; no one sings or shouts in the vineyards; no one treads out wine at the presses, for I have put an end to the shouting.
chapters.zh: 从肥美的田中，夺去了欢喜快乐。在葡萄园里，必无歌唱，也无欢呼的声音。踹酒的在酒榨中不得踹出酒来。我使他欢呼的声音止息。

chapters.en: My heart laments for Moab like a harp, my inmost being for Kir Hareseth.
chapters.zh: 因此我心腹为摩押哀鸣如琴，我心肠为吉珥哈列设，也是如此。

chapters.en: When Moab appears at her high place, she only wears herself out; when she goes to her shrine to pray, it is to no avail.
chapters.zh: 摩押人朝见的时候，在高处疲乏，又到他圣所祈祷，也不蒙应允。

chapters.en: This is the word the LORD has already spoken concerning Moab.
chapters.zh: 这是耶和华从前论摩押的话。

chapters.en: But now the LORD says: “Within three years, as a servant bound by contract would count them, Moab’s splendor and all her many people will be despised, and her survivors will be very few and feeble.”
chapters.zh: 但现在耶和华说，三年之内，照雇工的年数，摩押的荣耀，与他的群众，必被藐视，余剩的人，甚少无几。

chapters.en: A prophecy against Damascus: “See, Damascus will no longer be a city but will become a heap of ruins.
chapters.zh: 论大马色的默示。看哪，大马色已被废弃，不再为城，必变作乱堆。

chapters.en: The cities of Aroer will be deserted and left to flocks, which will lie down, with no one to make them afraid.
chapters.zh: 亚罗珥的城邑，已被撇弃。必成为牧羊之处，羊在那里躺卧，无人惊吓。

chapters.en: The fortified city will disappear from Ephraim, and royal power from Damascus; the remnant of Aram will be like the glory of the Israelites,” declares the LORD Almighty.
chapters.zh: 以法莲不再有保障。大马色不再有国权，亚兰所剩下的，必像以色列人的荣耀消灭一样。这是万军之耶和华说的。

chapters.en: “In that day the glory of Jacob will fade; the fat of his body will waste away.
chapters.zh: 到那日雅各的荣耀，必至枵薄，他肥胖的身体，必渐瘦弱。

chapters.en: It will be as when reapers harvest the standing grain, gathering the grain in their arms— as when someone gleans heads of grain in the Valley of Rephaim.
chapters.zh: 就必像收割的人，收敛禾稼，用手割取穗子。又像人在利乏音谷拾取遗落的穗子。

chapters.en: Yet some gleanings will remain, as when an olive tree is beaten, leaving two or three olives on the topmost branches, four or five on the fruitful boughs,” declares the LORD, the God of Israel.
chapters.zh: 其间所剩下的不多，好像人打橄榄树，在尽上的枝梢上，只剩两三个果子，在多果树的旁枝上，只剩四五个果子。这是耶和华以色列的神说的。

chapters.en: In that day people will look to their Maker and turn their eyes to the Holy One of Israel.
chapters.zh: 当那日人必仰望造他们的主，眼目重看以色列的圣者。

chapters.en: They will not look to the altars, the work of their hands, and they will have no regard for the Asherah poles and the incense altars their fingers have made.
chapters.zh: 他们必不仰望祭坛，就是自己手所筑的，也不重看自己指头所作的，无论是木偶，是日像。

chapters.en: In that day their strong cities, which they left because of the Israelites, will be like places abandoned to thickets and undergrowth. And all will be desolation.
chapters.zh: 在那日他们的坚固城，必像树林中和山顶上所撇弃的地方，就是从前在以色列人面前被人撇弃的。这样，地就荒凉了。

chapters.en: You have forgotten God your Savior; you have not remembered the Rock, your fortress. Therefore, though you set out the finest plants and plant imported vines,
chapters.zh: 因你忘记救你的神，不记念你能力的磐石。所以你栽上佳美的树秧子，插上异样的栽子。

chapters.en: though on the day you set them out, you make them grow, and on the morning when you plant them, you bring them to bud, yet the harvest will be as nothing in the day of disease and incurable pain.
chapters.zh: 栽种的日子，你周围圈上篱笆，又到早晨使你所种的开花。但在愁苦极其伤痛的日子，所收割的，都飞去了。

chapters.en: Woe to the many nations that rage— they rage like the raging sea! Woe to the peoples who roar— they roar like the roaring of great waters!
chapters.zh: 唉，多民哄嚷，好像海浪澎湃，列邦奔腾，好像猛水滔滔。

chapters.en: Although the peoples roar like the roar of surging waters, when he rebukes them they flee far away, driven before the wind like chaff on the hills, like tumbleweed before a gale.
chapters.zh: 列邦奔腾，好像多水滔滔。但神斥责他们，他们就远远逃避，又被追赶，如同山上的风前糠，又如暴风前的旋风土。

chapters.en: In the evening, sudden terror! Before the morning, they are gone! This is the portion of those who loot us, the lot of those who plunder us.
chapters.zh: 到晚上有惊吓，未到早晨他们就没有了。这是掳掠我们之人所得的分，是抢夺我们之人的报应。

chapters.en: Woe to the land of whirring wings along the rivers of Cush,
chapters.zh: 唉，古实河外翅膀刷刷响声之地，

chapters.en: which sends envoys by sea in papyrus boats over the water. Go, swift messengers, to a people tall and smooth-skinned, to a people feared far and wide, an aggressive nation of strange speech, whose land is divided by rivers.
chapters.zh: 差遣使者在水面上，坐蒲草船过海。先知说，你们快行的使者，要到高大光滑的民那里去。自从开国以来那民极其可畏，是分地界践踏人的，他们的地有江河分开。

chapters.en: All you people of the world, you who live on the earth, when a banner is raised on the mountains, you will see it, and when a trumpet sounds, you will hear it.
chapters.zh: 世上一切的居民，和地上所住的人哪，山上竖立大旗的时候，你们要看。吹角的时候，你们要听。

chapters.en: This is what the LORD says to me: “I will remain quiet and will look on from my dwelling place, like shimmering heat in the sunshine, like a cloud of dew in the heat of harvest.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华对我这样说，我要安静，在我的居所观看，如同日光中的清热，又如露水的云雾在收割的热天。

chapters.en: For, before the harvest, when the blossom is gone and the flower becomes a ripening grape, he will cut off the shoots with pruning knives, and cut down and take away the spreading branches.
chapters.zh: 收割之先，花开已谢，花也成了将熟的葡萄，他必用镰刀削去嫩枝，又砍掉蔓延的枝条。

chapters.en: They will all be left to the mountain birds of prey and to the wild animals; the birds will feed on them all summer, the wild animals all winter.
chapters.zh: 都要撇给山间的鸷鸟，和地上的野兽。夏天鸷鸟要宿在其上，冬天野兽都卧在其中。

chapters.en: At that time gifts will be brought to the LORD Almighty from a people tall and smooth-skinned, from a people feared far and wide, an aggressive nation of strange speech, whose land is divided by rivers— the gifts will be brought to Mount Zion, the place of the Name of the LORD Almighty.
chapters.zh: 到那时这高大光滑的民，就是从开国以来极其可畏，分地界践踏人的，他们的地有江河分开，他们必将礼物奉给万军之耶和华，就是奉到锡安山，耶和华安置他名的地方。

chapters.en: A prophecy against Egypt: See, the LORD rides on a swift cloud and is coming to Egypt. The idols of Egypt tremble before him, and the hearts of the Egyptians melt with fear.
chapters.zh: 论埃及的默示。看哪，耶和华乘驾快云，临到埃及。埃及的偶像在他面前战兢。埃及人的心在里面消化。

chapters.en: “I will stir up Egyptian against Egyptian— brother will fight against brother, neighbor against neighbor, city against city, kingdom against kingdom.
chapters.zh: 我必激动埃及人攻击埃及人，弟兄攻击弟兄，邻舍攻击邻舍，这城攻击那城，这国攻击那国。

chapters.en: The Egyptians will lose heart, and I will bring their plans to nothing; they will consult the idols and the spirits of the dead, the mediums and the spiritists.
chapters.zh: 埃及人的心神，必在里面耗尽。我必败坏他们的谋略。他们必求问偶像，和念咒的，交鬼的，行巫术的。

chapters.en: I will hand the Egyptians over to the power of a cruel master, and a fierce king will rule over them,” declares the Lord, the LORD Almighty.
chapters.zh: 我必将埃及人交在残忍主的手中。强暴王必辖制他们。这是主万军之耶和华说的。

chapters.en: The waters of the river will dry up, and the riverbed will be parched and dry.
chapters.zh: 海中的水必绝尽，河也消没干涸。

chapters.en: The canals will stink; the streams of Egypt will dwindle and dry up. The reeds and rushes will wither,
chapters.zh: 江河要变臭，埃及的河水，都必减少枯干。苇子和芦荻，都必衰残。

chapters.en: also the plants along the Nile, at the mouth of the river. Every sown field along the Nile will become parched, will blow away and be no more.
chapters.zh: 靠尼罗河旁的草田，并沿尼罗河所种的田，都必枯干，庄稼被风吹去，归于无有。

chapters.en: The fishermen will groan and lament, all who cast hooks into the Nile; those who throw nets on the water will pine away.
chapters.zh: 打鱼的必哀哭，在尼罗河一切钓鱼的必悲伤，在水上撒网的，必都衰弱。

chapters.en: Those who work with combed flax will despair, the weavers of fine linen will lose hope.
chapters.zh: 用梳好的麻造物的，和织白布的，都必羞愧。

chapters.en: The workers in cloth will be dejected, and all the wage earners will be sick at heart.
chapters.zh: 国柱必被打碎，所有佣工的，心必愁烦。

chapters.en: The officials of Zoan are nothing but fools; the wise counselors of Pharaoh give senseless advice. How can you say to Pharaoh, “I am one of the wise men, a disciple of the ancient kings”?
chapters.zh: 琐安的首领，极其愚昧，法老大有智慧的谋士，所筹画的，成为愚昧。你们怎敢对法老说，我是智慧人的子孙，我是古王的后裔？

chapters.en: Where are your wise men now? Let them show you and make known what the LORD Almighty has planned against Egypt.
chapters.zh: 你的智慧人在哪里呢？万军之耶和华向埃及所定的旨意，他们可以知道，可以告诉你吧。

chapters.en: The officials of Zoan have become fools, the leaders of Memphis are deceived; the cornerstones of her peoples have led Egypt astray.
chapters.zh: 琐安的首领，都变为愚昧，挪弗的首领，都受了迷惑。当埃及支派房角石的使埃及人走错了路。

chapters.en: The LORD has poured into them a spirit of dizziness; they make Egypt stagger in all that she does, as a drunkard staggers around in his vomit.
chapters.zh: 耶和华使乖谬的灵，搀入埃及中间。首领使埃及一切所作的都有差错，好像醉酒之人呕吐的时候，东倒西歪一样。

chapters.en: There is nothing Egypt can do— head or tail, palm branch or reed.
chapters.zh: 埃及中无论是头与尾，棕枝与芦苇，所作之工，都不成就。

chapters.en: In that day the Egyptians will become weaklings. They will shudder with fear at the uplifted hand that the LORD Almighty raises against them.
chapters.zh: 到那日，埃及人必像妇人一样。他们必因万军之耶和华在埃及以上所抡的手，战兢惧怕。

chapters.en: And the land of Judah will bring terror to the Egyptians; everyone to whom Judah is mentioned will be terrified, because of what the LORD Almighty is planning against them.
chapters.zh: 犹大地必使埃及惊恐。向谁提起犹大地，谁就惧怕。这是因万军之耶和华向埃及所定的旨意。

chapters.en: In that day five cities in Egypt will speak the language of Canaan and swear allegiance to the LORD Almighty. One of them will be called the City of the Sun.
chapters.zh: 当那日埃及地必有五城的人说迦南的方言，又指着万军之耶和华起誓。有一城，必称为灭亡城。

chapters.en: In that day there will be an altar to the LORD in the heart of Egypt, and a monument to the LORD at its border.
chapters.zh: 当那日，在埃及地中必有为耶和华筑的一座坛。在埃及的边界上，必有为耶和华立的一根柱。

chapters.en: It will be a sign and witness to the LORD Almighty in the land of Egypt. When they cry out to the LORD because of their oppressors, he will send them a savior and defender, and he will rescue them.
chapters.zh: 这都要在埃及地为万军之耶和华作记号和证据。埃及人因为受人的欺压哀求耶和华，他就差遣一位救主，作护卫者，拯救他们。

chapters.en: So the LORD will make himself known to the Egyptians, and in that day they will acknowledge the LORD. They will worship with sacrifices and grain offerings; they will make vows to the LORD and keep them.
chapters.zh: 耶和华必被埃及人所认识。在那日埃及人必认识耶和华，也要献祭物和供物敬拜他，并向耶和华许愿还愿。

chapters.en: The LORD will strike Egypt with a plague; he will strike them and heal them. They will turn to the LORD, and he will respond to their pleas and heal them.
chapters.zh: 耶和华必击打埃及，又击打，又医治，埃及人就归向耶和华。他必应允他们的祷告，医治他们。

chapters.en: In that day there will be a highway from Egypt to Assyria. The Assyrians will go to Egypt and the Egyptians to Assyria. The Egyptians and Assyrians will worship together.
chapters.zh: 当那日必有从埃及通亚述去的大道。亚述人要进入埃及，埃及人也进入亚述。埃及人要与亚述人一同敬拜耶和华。

chapters.en: In that day Israel will be the third, along with Egypt and Assyria, a blessing on the earth.
chapters.zh: 当那日以色列必与埃及亚述三国一律，使地上的人得福。

chapters.en: The LORD Almighty will bless them, saying, “Blessed be Egypt my people, Assyria my handiwork, and Israel my inheritance.”
chapters.zh: 因为万军之耶和华赐福给他们，说，埃及我的百姓，亚述我手的工作，以色列我的产业，都有福了。

chapters.en: In the year that the supreme commander, sent by Sargon king of Assyria, came to Ashdod and attacked and captured it—
chapters.zh: 亚述王撒珥根打发他珥探到亚实突的那年，他珥探就攻打亚实突，将城攻取。

chapters.en: at that time the LORD spoke through Isaiah son of Amoz. He said to him, “Take off the sackcloth from your body and the sandals from your feet.” And he did so, going around stripped and barefoot.
chapters.zh: 那时耶和华晓谕亚摩斯的儿子以赛亚说，你去解掉你腰间的麻布，脱下你脚上的鞋。以赛亚就这样作，露身赤脚行走。

chapters.en: Then the LORD said, “Just as my servant Isaiah has gone stripped and barefoot for three years, as a sign and portent against Egypt and Cush,
chapters.zh: 耶和华说，我仆人以赛亚怎样露身赤脚行走三年，作为关乎埃及和古实的预兆奇迹。

chapters.en: so the king of Assyria will lead away stripped and barefoot the Egyptian captives and Cushite exiles, young and old, with buttocks bared—to Egypt’s shame.
chapters.zh: 照样，亚述王也必掳去埃及人，掠去古实人，无论老少，都露身赤脚，现出下体，使埃及蒙羞。

chapters.en: Those who trusted in Cush and boasted in Egypt will be dismayed and put to shame.
chapters.zh: 以色列人必因所仰望的古实，所夸耀的埃及，惊惶羞愧。

chapters.en: In that day the people who live on this coast will say, ‘See what has happened to those we relied on, those we fled to for help and deliverance from the king of Assyria! How then can we escape?’ ”
chapters.zh: 那时这沿海一带的居民必说，看哪，我们素所仰望的，就是我们为脱离亚述王逃往求救的，不过是如此。我们怎能逃脱呢？

chapters.en: A prophecy against the Desert by the Sea: Like whirlwinds sweeping through the southland, an invader comes from the desert, from a land of terror.
chapters.zh: 论海旁旷野的默示。有仇敌从旷野，从可怕之地而来，好像南方的旋风，猛然扫过。

chapters.en: A dire vision has been shown to me: The traitor betrays, the looter takes loot. Elam, attack! Media, lay siege! I will bring to an end all the groaning she caused.
chapters.zh: 令人凄惨的异象，已默示于我。诡诈的行诡诈，毁灭的行毁灭。以拦哪，你要上去。玛代阿，你要围困。主说，我使一切叹息止住。

chapters.en: At this my body is racked with pain, pangs seize me, like those of a woman in labor; I am staggered by what I hear, I am bewildered by what I see.
chapters.zh: 所以我满腰疼痛。痛苦将我抓住，好像产难的妇人一样。我疼痛甚至不能听。我惊惶甚至不能看。

chapters.en: My heart falters, fear makes me tremble; the twilight I longed for has become a horror to me.
chapters.zh: 我心慌张，惊恐威吓我，我所羡慕的黄昏，变为我的战兢。

chapters.en: They set the tables, they spread the rugs, they eat, they drink! Get up, you officers, oil the shields!
chapters.zh: 他们摆设筵席，派人守望，又吃又喝。首领阿，你们起来，用油抹盾牌。

chapters.en: This is what the Lord says to me: “Go, post a lookout and have him report what he sees.
chapters.zh: 主对我如此说，你去设立守望的，使他将所看见的述说。

chapters.en: When he sees chariots with teams of horses, riders on donkeys or riders on camels, let him be alert, fully alert.”
chapters.zh: 他看见军队，就是骑马的一对一对地来，又看见驴队，骆驼队，就要侧耳细听。

chapters.en: And the lookout shouted, “Day after day, my lord, I stand on the watchtower; every night I stay at my post.
chapters.zh: 他像狮子吼叫，说，主阿，我白日常站在望楼上，整夜立在我守望所。

chapters.en: Look, here comes a man in a chariot with a team of horses. And he gives back the answer: ‘Babylon has fallen, has fallen! All the images of its gods lie shattered on the ground!’ ”
chapters.zh: 看哪，有一队军兵骑着马，一对一对地来。他就说，巴比伦倾倒了。倾倒了，他一切雕刻的神像，都打碎于地。

chapters.en: My people who are crushed on the threshing floor, I tell you what I have heard from the LORD Almighty, from the God of Israel.
chapters.zh: 我被打的禾稼，我场上的谷阿，我从万军之耶和华以色列的神那里所听见的，都告诉你们了。

chapters.en: A prophecy against Dumah : Someone calls to me from Seir, “Watchman, what is left of the night? Watchman, what is left of the night?”
chapters.zh: 论度玛的默示。有人声从西珥呼问我，说，守望的阿，夜里如何。守望的阿，夜里如何。

chapters.en: The watchman replies, “Morning is coming, but also the night. If you would ask, then ask; and come back yet again.”
chapters.zh: 守望的说，早晨将到，黑夜也来。你们若要问，就可以问，可以回头再来。

chapters.en: A prophecy against Arabia: You caravans of Dedanites, who camp in the thickets of Arabia,
chapters.zh: 论亚拉伯的默示。底但结伴的客旅阿，你们必在亚拉伯的树林中住宿。

chapters.en: bring water for the thirsty; you who live in Tema, bring food for the fugitives.
chapters.zh: 提玛地的居民拿水来，送给口渴的，拿饼来迎接逃避的。

chapters.en: They flee from the sword, from the drawn sword, from the bent bow and from the heat of battle.
chapters.zh: 因为他们逃避刀剑，和出了鞘的刀，并上了弦的弓，与刀兵的重灾。

chapters.en: This is what the Lord says to me: “Within one year, as a servant bound by contract would count it, all the splendor of Kedar will come to an end.
chapters.zh: 主对我这样说，一年之内，照雇工的年数，基达的一切荣耀必归于无有。

chapters.en: The survivors of the archers, the warriors of Kedar, will be few.” The LORD, the God of Israel, has spoken.
chapters.zh: 弓箭手所余剩的，就是基达人的勇士，必然稀少。因为这是耶和华以色列的神说的。

chapters.en: A prophecy against the Valley of Vision: What troubles you now, that you have all gone up on the roofs,
chapters.zh: 论异象谷的默示。有什么事使你这满城的人都上房顶呢？

chapters.en: you town so full of commotion, you city of tumult and revelry? Your slain were not killed by the sword, nor did they die in battle.
chapters.zh: 你这满处呐喊，大有喧哗的城，欢乐的邑阿，你中间被杀的，并不是被刀杀，也不是因打仗死亡。

chapters.en: All your leaders have fled together; they have been captured without using the bow. All you who were caught were taken prisoner together, having fled while the enemy was still far away.
chapters.zh: 你所有的官长一同逃跑，都为弓箭手所捆绑。你中间一切被找到的都一同被捆绑。他们本是逃往远方的。

chapters.en: Therefore I said, “Turn away from me; let me weep bitterly. Do not try to console me over the destruction of my people.”
chapters.zh: 所以我说，你们转眼不看我，我要痛哭。不要因我众民（原文作民女）的毁灭，就竭力安慰我。

chapters.en: The Lord, the LORD Almighty, has a day of tumult and trampling and terror in the Valley of Vision, a day of battering down walls and of crying out to the mountains.
chapters.zh: 因为主万军之耶和华使异象谷有溃乱，践踏，烦扰的日子。城被攻破，哀声达到山间。

chapters.en: Elam takes up the quiver, with her charioteers and horses; Kir uncovers the shield.
chapters.zh: 以拦带着箭袋，还有坐战车的和马兵，吉珥揭开盾牌。

chapters.en: Your choicest valleys are full of chariots, and horsemen are posted at the city gates.
chapters.zh: 你嘉美的谷遍满战车，也有马兵在城门前排列。

chapters.en: The Lord stripped away the defenses of Judah, and you looked in that day to the weapons in the Palace of the Forest.
chapters.zh: 他去掉犹大的遮盖。那日，你就仰望林库内的军器。

chapters.en: You saw that the walls of the City of David were broken through in many places; you stored up water in the Lower Pool.
chapters.zh: 你们看见大卫城的破口很多，便聚积下池的水。

chapters.en: You counted the buildings in Jerusalem and tore down houses to strengthen the wall.
chapters.zh: 又数点耶路撒冷的房屋，将房屋拆毁，修补城墙。

chapters.en: You built a reservoir between the two walls for the water of the Old Pool, but you did not look to the One who made it, or have regard for the One who planned it long ago.
chapters.zh: 又在两道城墙中间挖一个聚水池，可盛旧池的水。却不仰望作这事的主，也不顾念从古定这事的。

chapters.en: The Lord, the LORD Almighty, called you on that day to weep and to wail, to tear out your hair and put on sackcloth.
chapters.zh: 当那日，主万军之耶和华叫人哭泣哀号，头上光秃，身披麻布。

chapters.en: But see, there is joy and revelry, slaughtering of cattle and killing of sheep, eating of meat and drinking of wine! “Let us eat and drink,” you say, “for tomorrow we die!”
chapters.zh: 谁知，人倒欢喜快乐，宰牛杀羊，吃肉喝酒，说，我们吃喝吧，因为明天要死了。

chapters.en: The LORD Almighty has revealed this in my hearing: “Till your dying day this sin will not be atoned for,” says the Lord, the LORD Almighty.
chapters.zh: 万军之耶和华亲自默示我，说，这罪孽直到你们死，断不得赦免。这是主万军之耶和华说的。

chapters.en: This is what the Lord, the LORD Almighty, says: “Go, say to this steward, to Shebna the palace administrator:
chapters.zh: 主万军之耶和华这样说，你去见掌银库的，就是家宰舍伯那，对他说，

chapters.en: What are you doing here and who gave you permission to cut out a grave for yourself here, hewing your grave on the height and chiseling your resting place in the rock?
chapters.zh: 你在这里作什么呢？有什么人竟在这里凿坟墓，就是在高处为自己凿坟墓，在磐石中为自己凿出安身之所。

chapters.en: “Beware, the LORD is about to take firm hold of you and hurl you away, you mighty man.
chapters.zh: 看哪，耶和华必像大有力的人，将你紧紧缠裹，竭力抛去。

chapters.en: He will roll you up tightly like a ball and throw you into a large country. There you will die and there the chariots you were so proud of will become a disgrace to your master’s house.
chapters.zh: 他必将你滚成一团，抛在宽阔之地，好像抛球一样。你这主人家的羞辱，必在那里坐你荣耀的车，也必在那里死亡。

chapters.en: I will depose you from your office, and you will be ousted from your position.
chapters.zh: 我必赶逐你离开官职。你必从你的原位撤下。

chapters.en: “In that day I will summon my servant, Eliakim son of Hilkiah.
chapters.zh: 到那日我必召我仆人希勒家的儿子以利亚敬来。

chapters.en: I will clothe him with your robe and fasten your sash around him and hand your authority over to him. He will be a father to those who live in Jerusalem and to the people of Judah.
chapters.zh: 将你的外袍给他穿上，将你的腰带给他系紧，将你的政权交在他手中。他必作耶路撒冷居民和犹大家的父。

chapters.en: I will place on his shoulder the key to the house of David; what he opens no one can shut, and what he shuts no one can open.
chapters.zh: 我必将大卫家的钥匙放在他肩头上。他开，无人能关。他关，无人能开。

chapters.en: I will drive him like a peg into a firm place; he will become a seat of honor for the house of his father.
chapters.zh: 我必将他安稳，像钉子钉在坚固处。他必作为他父家荣耀的宝座。

chapters.en: All the glory of his family will hang on him: its offspring and offshoots—all its lesser vessels, from the bowls to all the jars.
chapters.zh: 他父家所有的荣耀，连儿女带子孙，都挂在他身上，好像一切小器皿，从杯子到酒瓶挂上一样。

chapters.en: “In that day,” declares the LORD Almighty, “the peg driven into the firm place will give way; it will be sheared off and will fall, and the load hanging on it will be cut down.” The LORD has spoken.
chapters.zh: 万军之耶和华说，当那日，钉在坚固处的钉子必压斜，被砍断落地。挂在其上的重担必被剪断。因为这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: A prophecy against Tyre: Wail, you ships of Tarshish! For Tyre is destroyed and left without house or harbor. From the land of Cyprus word has come to them.
chapters.zh: 论推罗的默示。他施的船只，都要哀号。因为推罗变为荒场，甚至没有房屋，没有可进之路。这消息是从基提地得来的。

chapters.en: Be silent, you people of the island and you merchants of Sidon, whom the seafarers have enriched.
chapters.zh: 沿海的居民，就是素来靠航海西顿的商家得丰盛的，你们当静默无言。

chapters.en: On the great waters came the grain of the Shihor; the harvest of the Nile was the revenue of Tyre, and she became the marketplace of the nations.
chapters.zh: 在大水之上，西曷的粮食，尼罗河的庄稼，是推罗的进项。他作列国的大码头。

chapters.en: Be ashamed, Sidon, and you fortress of the sea, for the sea has spoken: “I have neither been in labor nor given birth; I have neither reared sons nor brought up daughters.”
chapters.zh: 西顿哪，你当惭愧。因为大海说，就是海中的保障说，我没有劬劳，也没有生产，没有养育男子，也没有抚养童女。

chapters.en: When word comes to Egypt, they will be in anguish at the report from Tyre.
chapters.zh: 这风声传到埃及，埃及人为推罗的风声，极其疼痛。

chapters.en: Cross over to Tarshish; wail, you people of the island.
chapters.zh: 推罗人哪，你们当过到他施去。沿海的居民哪，你们都当哀号。

chapters.en: Is this your city of revelry, the old, old city, whose feet have taken her to settle in far-off lands?
chapters.zh: 这是你们欢乐的城，从上古而有的吗？其中的居民，往远方寄居。

chapters.en: Who planned this against Tyre, the bestower of crowns, whose merchants are princes, whose traders are renowned in the earth?
chapters.zh: 推罗本是赐冠冕的。他的商家是王子，他的买卖人，是世上的尊贵人。遭遇如此，是谁定的呢？

chapters.en: The LORD Almighty planned it, to bring down her pride in all her splendor and to humble all who are renowned on the earth.
chapters.zh: 是万军之耶和华所定的，为要污辱一切高傲的荣耀，使地上一切的尊贵人被藐视。

chapters.en: Till your land as they do along the Nile, Daughter Tarshish, for you no longer have a harbor.
chapters.zh: 他施的民哪，（民原文作女）可以流行你的地，好像尼罗河，不再有腰带拘紧你。

chapters.en: The LORD has stretched out his hand over the sea and made its kingdoms tremble. He has given an order concerning Phoenicia that her fortresses be destroyed.
chapters.zh: 耶和华已经向海伸手，震动列国。至于迦南，他已经吩咐拆毁其中的保障。

chapters.en: He said, “No more of your reveling, Virgin Daughter Sidon, now crushed! “Up, cross over to Cyprus; even there you will find no rest.”
chapters.zh: 他又说，受欺压西顿的居民哪，（居民原文作处女）你必不得再欢乐，起来，过到基提去。就是在那里，也不得安歇。

chapters.en: Look at the land of the Babylonians,this people that is now of no account! The Assyrians have made it a place for desert creatures; they raised up their siege towers, they stripped its fortresses bare and turned it into a ruin.
chapters.zh: 看哪，迦勒底人之地向来没有这民。这国是亚述人为住旷野的人所立的。现在他们建筑戍楼，拆毁推罗的宫殿，使它成为荒凉。

chapters.en: Wail, you ships of Tarshish; your fortress is destroyed!
chapters.zh: 他施的船只都要哀号。因为你们的保障变为荒场。

chapters.en: At that time Tyre will be forgotten for seventy years, the span of a king’s life. But at the end of these seventy years, it will happen to Tyre as in the song of the prostitute:
chapters.zh: 到那时推罗必被忘记七十年，照着一王的年日。七十年后，推罗的景况，必像妓女所唱的歌。

chapters.en: “Take up a harp, walk through the city, you forgotten prostitute; play the harp well, sing many a song, so that you will be remembered.”
chapters.zh: 你这被忘记的妓女阿，拿琴周流城内，巧弹多唱，使人再想念你。

chapters.en: At the end of seventy years, the LORD will deal with Tyre. She will return to her lucrative prostitution and will ply her trade with all the kingdoms on the face of the earth.
chapters.zh: 七十年后，耶和华必眷顾推罗，他就仍得利息，（原文作雇价下同）与地上的万国交易。（原文作行淫）

chapters.en: Yet her profit and her earnings will be set apart for the LORD; they will not be stored up or hoarded. Her profits will go to those who live before the LORD, for abundant food and fine clothes.
chapters.zh: 他的货财和利息，要归耶和华为圣，必不积攒存留。因为他的货财必为住在耶和华面前的人所得，使他们吃饱，穿耐久的衣服。

chapters.en: See, the LORD is going to lay waste the earth and devastate it; he will ruin its face and scatter its inhabitants—
chapters.zh: 看哪，耶和华使地空虚，变为荒凉。又翻转大地，将居民分散。

chapters.en: it will be the same for priest as for people, for the master as for his servant, for the mistress as for her servant, for seller as for buyer, for borrower as for lender, for debtor as for creditor.
chapters.zh: 那时百姓怎样，祭司也怎样。仆人怎样，主人也怎样。婢女怎样，主母也怎样。买物的怎样，卖物的也怎样。放债的怎样，借债的也怎样。取利的怎样，出利的也怎样。

chapters.en: The earth will be completely laid waste and totally plundered. The LORD has spoken this word.
chapters.zh: 地必全然空虚，尽都荒凉。因为这话是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: The earth dries up and withers, the world languishes and withers, the heavens languish with the earth.
chapters.zh: 地上悲哀衰残，世界败落衰残，地上居高位的人也败落了。

chapters.en: The earth is defiled by its people; they have disobeyed the laws, violated the statutes and broken the everlasting covenant.
chapters.zh: 地被其上的居民污秽。因为他们犯了律法，废了律例，背了永约。

chapters.en: Therefore a curse consumes the earth; its people must bear their guilt. Therefore earth’s inhabitants are burned up, and very few are left.
chapters.zh: 所以地被咒诅吞灭，住在其上的显为有罪。地上的居民被火焚烧，剩下的人稀少。

chapters.en: The new wine dries up and the vine withers; all the merrymakers groan.
chapters.zh: 新酒悲哀，葡萄树衰残，心中欢乐的，俱都叹息。

chapters.en: The joyful timbrels are stilled, the noise of the revelers has stopped, the joyful harp is silent.
chapters.zh: 击鼓之乐止息，宴乐人的声音完毕，弹琴之乐也止息了。

chapters.en: No longer do they drink wine with a song; the beer is bitter to its drinkers.
chapters.zh: 人必不得饮酒唱歌。喝浓酒的，必以为苦。

chapters.en: The ruined city lies desolate; the entrance to every house is barred.
chapters.zh: 荒凉的城拆毁了。各家关门闭户，使人都不得进去。

chapters.en: In the streets they cry out for wine; all joy turns to gloom, all joyful sounds are banished from the earth.
chapters.zh: 在街上因酒有悲叹的声音。一切喜乐变为昏暗。地上的欢乐归于无有。

chapters.en: The city is left in ruins, its gate is battered to pieces.
chapters.zh: 城中只有荒凉，城门拆毁净尽。

chapters.en: So will it be on the earth and among the nations, as when an olive tree is beaten, or as when gleanings are left after the grape harvest.
chapters.zh: 在地上的万民中，必像打过的橄榄树，又像已摘的葡萄所剩无几。

chapters.en: They raise their voices, they shout for joy; from the west they acclaim the LORD’s majesty.
chapters.zh: 这些人要高声欢呼。他们为耶和华的威严，从海那里扬起声来。

chapters.en: Therefore in the east give glory to the LORD; exalt the name of the LORD, the God of Israel, in the islands of the sea.
chapters.zh: 因此你们要在东方荣耀耶和华，在众海岛荣耀耶和华以色列神的名。

chapters.en: From the ends of the earth we hear singing: “Glory to the Righteous One.” But I said, “I waste away, I waste away! Woe to me! The treacherous betray! With treachery the treacherous betray!”
chapters.zh: 我们听见从地极有人歌唱，说，荣耀归于义人。我却说，我消灭了，我消灭了，我有祸了。诡诈的行诡诈，诡诈的大行诡诈。

chapters.en: Terror and pit and snare await you, people of the earth.
chapters.zh: 地上的居民哪，恐惧，陷坑，网罗，都临近你。

chapters.en: Whoever flees at the sound of terror will fall into a pit; whoever climbs out of the pit will be caught in a snare. The floodgates of the heavens are opened, the foundations of the earth shake.
chapters.zh: 躲避恐惧声音的必坠入陷坑。从陷坑上来的必被网罗缠住。因为天上的窗户都开了，地的根基也震动了。

chapters.en: The earth is broken up, the earth is split asunder, the earth is violently shaken.
chapters.zh: 地全然破坏，尽都崩裂，大大地震动了。

chapters.en: The earth reels like a drunkard, it sways like a hut in the wind; so heavy upon it is the guilt of its rebellion that it falls—never to rise again.
chapters.zh: 地要东倒西歪，好像醉酒的人。又摇来摇去，好像吊床。罪过在其上沉重，必然塌陷，不能复起。

chapters.en: In that day the LORD will punish the powers in the heavens above and the kings on the earth below.
chapters.zh: 到那日耶和华在高处必惩罚高处的众军，在地上必惩罚地上的列王，

chapters.en: They will be herded together like prisoners bound in a dungeon; they will be shut up in prison and be punished after many days.
chapters.zh: 他们必被聚集，像囚犯被聚在牢狱中，并要囚在监牢里，多日之后便被讨罪。（或作眷顾）

chapters.en: The moon will be dismayed, the sun ashamed; for the LORD Almighty will reign on Mount Zion and in Jerusalem, and before its elders—with great glory.
chapters.zh: 那时月亮要蒙羞，日头要惭愧。因为万军之耶和华必在锡安山，在耶路撒冷作王。在敬畏他的长老面前，必有荣耀。

chapters.en: LORD, you are my God; I will exalt you and praise your name, for in perfect faithfulness you have done wonderful things, things planned long ago.
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，你是我的神。我要尊崇你，我要称赞你的名。因为你以忠信诚实行过奇妙的事。成就你古时所定的。

chapters.en: You have made the city a heap of rubble, the fortified town a ruin, the foreigners’ stronghold a city no more; it will never be rebuilt.
chapters.zh: 你使城变为乱堆，使坚固城变为荒场，使外邦人宫殿的城，不再为城，永远不再建造。

chapters.en: Therefore strong peoples will honor you; cities of ruthless nations will revere you.
chapters.zh: 所以刚强的民，必荣耀你。强暴之国的城，必敬畏你。

chapters.en: You have been a refuge for the poor, a refuge for the needy in their distress, a shelter from the storm and a shade from the heat. For the breath of the ruthless is like a storm driving against a wall
chapters.zh: 因为当强暴人催逼人的时候，如同暴风直吹墙壁，你就作贫穷人的保障，作困乏人急难中的保障，作躲暴风之处，作避炎热的阴凉。

chapters.en: and like the heat of the desert. You silence the uproar of foreigners; as heat is reduced by the shadow of a cloud, so the song of the ruthless is stilled.
chapters.zh: 你要压制外邦人的喧哗，好像干燥地的热气下落，禁止强暴人的凯歌，好像热气被云影消化。

chapters.en: On this mountain the LORD Almighty will prepare a feast of rich food for all peoples, a banquet of aged wine— the best of meats and the finest of wines.
chapters.zh: 在这山上万军之耶和华，必为万民用肥甘设摆筵席，用陈酒和满髓的肥甘，并澄清的陈酒，设摆筵席。

chapters.en: On this mountain he will destroy the shroud that enfolds all peoples, the sheet that covers all nations;
chapters.zh: 他又必在这山上，除灭遮盖万民之物，和遮蔽万国蒙脸的帕子。

chapters.en: he will swallow up death forever. The Sovereign LORD will wipe away the tears from all faces; he will remove his people’s disgrace from all the earth. The LORD has spoken.
chapters.zh: 他已经吞灭死亡直到永远。主耶和华必擦去各人脸上的眼泪，又除掉普天下他百姓的羞辱。因为这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: In that day they will say, “Surely this is our God; we trusted in him, and he saved us. This is the LORD, we trusted in him; let us rejoice and be glad in his salvation.”
chapters.zh: 到那日人必说，看哪，这是我们的神。我们素来等候他，他必拯救我们，这是耶和华，我们素来等候他，我们必因他的救恩。欢喜快乐。

chapters.en: The hand of the LORD will rest on this mountain; but Moab will be trampled in their land as straw is trampled down in the manure.
chapters.zh: 耶和华的手，必按在这山上。摩押人在所居之地必被践踏，好像干草被践踏在粪池的水中。

chapters.en: They will stretch out their hands in it, as swimmers stretch out their hands to swim. God will bring down their pride despite the cleverness of their hands.
chapters.zh: 他必在其中伸开手，好像游泳的人伸手游泳。但耶和华必使他的骄傲，和他手所行的诡计，一并败落。

chapters.en: He will bring down your high fortified walls and lay them low; he will bring them down to the ground, to the very dust.
chapters.zh: 耶和华使你城上的坚固高台倾倒，拆平直到尘埃。

chapters.en: In that day this song will be sung in the land of Judah: We have a strong city; God makes salvation its walls and ramparts.
chapters.zh: 当那日在犹大地人必唱这歌，说，我们有坚固的城。耶和华要将救恩定为城墙，为外郭。

chapters.en: Open the gates that the righteous nation may enter, the nation that keeps faith.
chapters.zh: 敞开城门，使守信的义民得以进入。

chapters.en: You will keep in perfect peace those whose minds are steadfast, because they trust in you.
chapters.zh: 坚心倚赖你的，你必保守他十分平安，因为他倚靠你。

chapters.en: Trust in the LORD forever, for the LORD, the LORD himself, is the Rock eternal.
chapters.zh: 你们当倚靠耶和华直到永远。因为耶和华是永久的磐石。

chapters.en: He humbles those who dwell on high, he lays the lofty city low; he levels it to the ground and casts it down to the dust.
chapters.zh: 他使住高处的，与高城一并败落，将城拆毁，拆平直到尘埃。

chapters.en: Feet trample it down— the feet of the oppressed, the footsteps of the poor.
chapters.zh: 要被脚践踏，就是被困苦人的脚，和穷乏人的脚践踏。

chapters.en: The path of the righteous is level; you, the Upright One, make the way of the righteous smooth.
chapters.zh: 义人的道，是正直的，你为正直的主，必修平义人的路。

chapters.en: Yes, LORD, walking in the way of your laws,we wait for you; your name and renown are the desire of our hearts.
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，我们在你行审判的路上等候你。我们心里所羡慕的是你的名，就是你那可记念的名。

chapters.en: My soul yearns for you in the night; in the morning my spirit longs for you. When your judgments come upon the earth, the people of the world learn righteousness.
chapters.zh: 夜间我心中羡慕你。我里面的灵切切寻求你。因为你在世上行审判的时候，地上的居民就学习公义。

chapters.en: But when grace is shown to the wicked, they do not learn righteousness; even in a land of uprightness they go on doing evil and do not regard the majesty of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 以恩惠待恶人，他仍不学习公义。在正直的地上，他必行事不义，也不注意耶和华的威严。

chapters.en: LORD, your hand is lifted high, but they do not see it. Let them see your zeal for your people and be put to shame; let the fire reserved for your enemies consume them.
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，你的手高举，他们仍然不看。却要看你为百姓发的热心，因而抱愧。并且有火烧灭你的敌人。

chapters.en: LORD, you establish peace for us; all that we have accomplished you have done for us.
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，你必派定我们得平安。因为我们所作的事，都是你给我们成就的。

chapters.en: LORD our God, other lords besides you have ruled over us, but your name alone do we honor.
chapters.zh: 耶和华我们的神阿，在你以外曾有别的主管辖我们，但我们专要倚靠你，提你的名。

chapters.en: They are now dead, they live no more; their spirits do not rise. You punished them and brought them to ruin; you wiped out all memory of them.
chapters.zh: 他们死了，必不能再活。他们去世，必不能再起。因为你刑罚他们，毁灭他们，他们的名号就全然消灭。

chapters.en: You have enlarged the nation, LORD; you have enlarged the nation. You have gained glory for yourself; you have extended all the borders of the land.
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，你增添国民，你增添国民。你得了荣耀，又扩张地的四境。

chapters.en: LORD, they came to you in their distress; when you disciplined them, they could barely whisper a prayer.
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，他们在急难中寻求你。你的惩罚临到他们身上，他们就倾心吐胆祷告你。

chapters.en: As a pregnant woman about to give birth writhes and cries out in her pain, so were we in your presence, LORD.
chapters.zh: 妇人怀孕，临产疼痛，在痛苦之中喊叫，耶和华阿，我们在你面前，也是如此。

chapters.en: We were with child, we writhed in labor, but we gave birth to wind. We have not brought salvation to the earth, and the people of the world have not come to life.
chapters.zh: 我们也曾怀孕疼痛，所产的竟像风一样，我们在地上未曾行什么拯救的事。世上的居民也未曾败落。

chapters.en: But your dead will live, LORD; their bodies will rise— let those who dwell in the dust wake up and shout for joy— your dew is like the dew of the morning; the earth will give birth to her dead.
chapters.zh: 死人（原文作你的死人）要复活。尸首（原文作我的尸首）要兴起。睡在尘埃的阿，要醒起歌唱。因你的甘露好像菜蔬上的甘露，地也要交出死人来。

chapters.en: Go, my people, enter your rooms and shut the doors behind you; hide yourselves for a little while until his wrath has passed by.
chapters.zh: 我的百姓阿，你们要来进入内室，关上门，隐藏片时，等到忿怒过去。

chapters.en: See, the LORD is coming out of his dwelling to punish the people of the earth for their sins. The earth will disclose the blood shed on it; the earth will conceal its slain no longer.
chapters.zh: 因为耶和华从他的居所出来，要刑罚地上居民的罪孽。地也必露出其中的血，不再掩盖被杀的人。

chapters.en: In that day, the LORD will punish with his sword— his fierce, great and powerful sword— Leviathan the gliding serpent, Leviathan the coiling serpent; he will slay the monster of the sea.
chapters.zh: 到那日，耶和华必用他刚硬有力的大刀，刑罚鳄鱼，就是那快行的蛇，刑罚鳄鱼，就是那曲行的蛇。并杀海中的大鱼。

chapters.en: In that day— “Sing about a fruitful vineyard:
chapters.zh: 当那日有出酒的葡萄园。你们要指这园唱歌，说，

chapters.en: I, the LORD, watch over it; I water it continually. I guard it day and night so that no one may harm it.
chapters.zh: 我耶和华是看守葡萄园的，我必时刻浇灌，昼夜看守，免得有人损害。

chapters.en: I am not angry. If only there were briers and thorns confronting me! I would march against them in battle; I would set them all on fire.
chapters.zh: 我心中不存忿怒。惟愿荆棘蒺藜与我交战，我就勇往直前，把他一同焚烧。

chapters.en: Or else let them come to me for refuge; let them make peace with me, yes, let them make peace with me.”
chapters.zh: 不然，让他持住我的能力，使他与我和好。愿他与我和好。

chapters.en: In days to come Jacob will take root, Israel will bud and blossom and fill all the world with fruit.
chapters.zh: 将来雅各要扎根，以色列要发芽开花。他们的果实，必充满世界。

chapters.en: Has the LORD struck her as he struck down those who struck her? Has she been killed as those were killed who killed her?
chapters.zh: 主击打他们，岂像击打那些击打他们的人吗？他们被杀戮，岂像被他们所杀戮的吗？

chapters.en: By warfare and exile you contend with her— with his fierce blast he drives her out, as on a day the east wind blows.
chapters.zh: 你打发他们去，是相机宜与他们相争。刮东风的日子，就用暴风将他们逐去。

chapters.en: By this, then, will Jacob’s guilt be atoned for, and this will be the full fruit of the removal of his sin: When he makes all the altar stones to be like limestone crushed to pieces, no Asherah poles or incense altars will be left standing.
