chapters.en: Half of the wood he burns in the fire; over it he prepares his meal, he roasts his meat and eats his fill. He also warms himself and says, “Ah! I am warm; I see the fire.”
chapters.zh: 他把一分烧在火中，把一分烤肉吃饱。自己烤火说，阿哈，我暖和了，我见火了。

chapters.en: From the rest he makes a god, his idol; he bows down to it and worships. He prays to it and says, “Save me! You are my god!”
chapters.zh: 他用剩下的作了一神，就是雕刻的偶像，他向这偶像俯伏叩拜，祷告它说，求你拯救我，因你是我的神。

chapters.en: They know nothing, they understand nothing; their eyes are plastered over so they cannot see, and their minds closed so they cannot understand.
chapters.zh: 他们不知道，也不思想，因为耶和华闭住他们的眼不能看见，塞住他们的心不能明白。

chapters.en: No one stops to think, no one has the knowledge or understanding to say, “Half of it I used for fuel; I even baked bread over its coals, I roasted meat and I ate. Shall I make a detestable thing from what is left? Shall I bow down to a block of wood?”
chapters.zh: 谁心里也不醒悟，也没有知识，没有聪明，能说，我曾拿一分在火中烧了，在炭火上烤过饼，我也烤过肉吃，这剩下的，我岂要作可憎的物吗？我岂可向木头叩拜呢？

chapters.en: Such a person feeds on ashes; a deluded heart misleads him; he cannot save himself, or say, “Is not this thing in my right hand a lie?”
chapters.zh: 他以灰为食，心中昏迷，使他偏邪，他不能自救，也不能说，我右手中岂不是有虚谎吗？

chapters.en: “Remember these things, Jacob, for you, Israel, are my servant. I have made you, you are my servant; Israel, I will not forget you.
chapters.zh: 雅各以色列阿，你是我的仆人，要记念这些事。以色列阿，你是我的仆人，我造就你必不忘记你。

chapters.en: I have swept away your offenses like a cloud, your sins like the morning mist. Return to me, for I have redeemed you.”
chapters.zh: 我涂抹了你的过犯，像厚云消散。我涂抹了你的罪恶，如薄云灭没。你当归向我，因我救赎了你。

chapters.en: Sing for joy, you heavens, for the LORD has done this; shout aloud, you earth beneath. Burst into song, you mountains, you forests and all your trees, for the LORD has redeemed Jacob, he displays his glory in Israel.
chapters.zh: 诸天哪，应当歌唱，因为耶和华作成这事。地的深处阿，应当欢呼，众山应当发声歌唱，树林和其中所有的树，都当如此，因为耶和华救赎了雅各，并要因以色列荣耀自己。

chapters.en: “This is what the LORD says— your Redeemer, who formed you in the womb: I am the LORD, the Maker of all things, who stretches out the heavens, who spreads out the earth by myself,
chapters.zh: 从你出胎，造就你的救赎主耶和华如此说，我耶和华是创造万物的，是独自铺张诸天，铺开大地的。（谁与我同在呢）

chapters.en: who foils the signs of false prophets and makes fools of diviners, who overthrows the learning of the wise and turns it into nonsense,
chapters.zh: 使说假话的兆头失效，使占卜的癫狂，使智慧人退后，使他的知识变为愚拙。

chapters.en: who carries out the words of his servants and fulfills the predictions of his messengers, who says of Jerusalem, ‘It shall be inhabited,’ of the towns of Judah, ‘They shall be rebuilt,’ and of their ruins, ‘I will restore them,’
chapters.zh: 使我仆人的话语立定，我使者的谋算成就。论到耶路撒冷说，必有人居住。论到犹大的城邑说，必被建造。其中的荒场我也必兴起。

chapters.en: who says to the watery deep, ‘Be dry, and I will dry up your streams,’
chapters.zh: 对深渊说，你干了吧。我也要使你的江河干涸。

chapters.en: who says of Cyrus, ‘He is my shepherd and will accomplish all that I please; he will say of Jerusalem, “Let it be rebuilt,” and of the temple, “Let its foundations be laid.” ’
chapters.zh: 论古列说，他是我的牧人，必成就我所喜悦的，必下令建造耶路撒冷，发命立稳圣殿的根基。

chapters.en: “This is what the LORD says to his anointed, to Cyrus, whose right hand I take hold of to subdue nations before him and to strip kings of their armor, to open doors before him so that gates will not be shut:
chapters.zh: 我耶和华所膏的古列，我搀扶他的右手，使列国降伏在他面前，我也要放松列王的腰带，使城门在他面前敞开，不得关闭，我对他如此说，

chapters.en: I will go before you and will level the mountains ; I will break down gates of bronze and cut through bars of iron.
chapters.zh: 我必在你前面行，修平崎岖之地。我必打破铜门，砍断铁闩。

chapters.en: I will give you hidden treasures, riches stored in secret places, so that you may know that I am the LORD, the God of Israel, who summons you by name.
chapters.zh: 我要将暗中的宝物，和隐密的财宝赐给你，使你知道提名召你的，就是我耶和华以色列的神。

chapters.en: For the sake of Jacob my servant, of Israel my chosen, I summon you by name and bestow on you a title of honor, though you do not acknowledge me.
chapters.zh: 因我仆人雅各，我所拣选以色列的缘故，我就提名召你。你虽不认识我，我也加给你名号。

chapters.en: I am the LORD, and there is no other; apart from me there is no God. I will strengthen you, though you have not acknowledged me,
chapters.zh: 我是耶和华，在我以外并没有别神，除了我以外再没有神。你虽不认识我，我必给你束腰，

chapters.en: so that from the rising of the sun to the place of its setting people may know there is none besides me. I am the LORD, and there is no other.
chapters.zh: 从日出之地到日落之处，使人都知道除了我以外，没有别神，我是耶和华，在我以外并没有别神。

chapters.en: I form the light and create darkness, I bring prosperity and create disaster; I, the LORD, do all these things.
chapters.zh: 我造光，又造暗。我施平安，又降灾祸。造作这一切的是我耶和华。

chapters.en: “You heavens above, rain down my righteousness; let the clouds shower it down. Let the earth open wide, let salvation spring up, let righteousness flourish with it; I, the LORD, have created it.
chapters.zh: 诸天哪，自上而滴。穹苍降下公义，地面开裂，产出救恩，使公义一同发生，这都是我耶和华所造的。

chapters.en: “Woe to those who quarrel with their Maker, those who are nothing but potsherds among the potsherds on the ground. Does the clay say to the potter, ‘What are you making?’ Does your work say, ‘The potter has no hands’?
chapters.zh: 祸哉，那与造他的主争论的，他不过是地上瓦片中的一块瓦片。泥土岂可对抟弄他的说，你作什么呢？所作的物，岂可说，你没有手呢？

chapters.en: Woe to the one who says to a father, ‘What have you begotten?’ or to a mother, ‘What have you brought to birth?’
chapters.zh: 祸哉，那对父亲说，你生的是什么呢？或对母亲（原文作妇人）说，你产的是什么呢？

chapters.en: “This is what the LORD says— the Holy One of Israel, and its Maker: Concerning things to come, do you question me about my children, or give me orders about the work of my hands?
chapters.zh: 耶和华以色列的圣者，就是造就以色列的，如此说，将来的事你们可以问我。至于我的众子，并我手的工作，你们可以求我命定。（求我命定原文作吩咐我）

chapters.en: It is I who made the earth and created mankind on it. My own hands stretched out the heavens; I marshaled their starry hosts.
chapters.zh: 我造地，又造人在地上，我亲手铺张诸天，天上万象也是我所命定的。

chapters.en: I will raise up Cyrus in my righteousness: I will make all his ways straight. He will rebuild my city and set my exiles free, but not for a price or reward, says the LORD Almighty.”
chapters.zh: 我凭公义兴起古列，（古列原文作他）又要修直他一切道路。他必建造我的城，释放我被掳的民，不是为工价，也不是为赏赐。这是万军之耶和华说的。

chapters.en: This is what the LORD says: “The products of Egypt and the merchandise of Cush,and those tall Sabeans— they will come over to you and will be yours; they will trudge behind you, coming over to you in chains. They will bow down before you and plead with you, saying, ‘Surely God is with you, and there is no other; there is no other god.’ ”
chapters.zh: 耶和华如此说，埃及劳碌得来的，和古实的货物必归你，身量高大的西巴人，必投降你，也要属你，他们必带着锁链过来随从你。又向你下拜祈求你说，神真在你们中间，此外再没有别神；再没有别的神。

chapters.en: Truly you are a God who has been hiding himself, the God and Savior of Israel.
chapters.zh: 救主以色列的神阿，你实在是自隐的神。

chapters.en: All the makers of idols will be put to shame and disgraced; they will go off into disgrace together.
chapters.zh: 凡制造偶像的，都必抱愧蒙羞，都要一同归于惭愧。

chapters.en: But Israel will be saved by the LORD with an everlasting salvation; you will never be put to shame or disgraced, to ages everlasting.
chapters.zh: 惟有以色列必蒙耶和华的拯救，得永远的救恩。你们必不蒙羞，也不抱愧，直到永世无尽。

chapters.en: For this is what the LORD says— he who created the heavens, he is God; he who fashioned and made the earth, he founded it; he did not create it to be empty, but formed it to be inhabited— he says: “I am the LORD, and there is no other.
chapters.zh: 创造诸天的耶和华，制造成全大地的神，他创造坚定大地，并非使地荒凉，是要给人居住。他如此说，我是耶和华，再没有别神。

chapters.en: I have not spoken in secret, from somewhere in a land of darkness; I have not said to Jacob’s descendants, ‘Seek me in vain.’ I, the LORD, speak the truth; I declare what is right.
chapters.zh: 我没有在隐密黑暗之地说话，我没有对雅各的后裔说，你们寻求我是徒然的，我耶和华所讲的是公义，所说的是正直。

chapters.en: “Gather together and come; assemble, you fugitives from the nations. Ignorant are those who carry about idols of wood, who pray to gods that cannot save.
chapters.zh: 你们从列国逃脱的人，要一同聚集前来。那些抬着雕刻木偶，祷告不能救人之神的，毫无知识。

chapters.en: Declare what is to be, present it— let them take counsel together. Who foretold this long ago, who declared it from the distant past? Was it not I, the LORD? And there is no God apart from me, a righteous God and a Savior; there is none but me.
chapters.zh: 你们要述说陈明你们的理，让他们彼此商议。谁从古时指明，谁从上古述说，不是我耶和华吗？除了我以外，再没有神。我是公义的神，又是救主，除了我以外，再没有别神。

chapters.en: “Turn to me and be saved, all you ends of the earth; for I am God, and there is no other.
chapters.zh: 地极的人都当仰望我，就必得救。因为我是神，再没有别神。

chapters.en: By myself I have sworn, my mouth has uttered in all integrity a word that will not be revoked: Before me every knee will bow; by me every tongue will swear.
chapters.zh: 我指着自己起誓，我口所出的话是凭公义，并不反回，万膝必向我跪拜，万口必凭我起誓。

chapters.en: They will say of me, ‘In the LORD alone are deliverance and strength.’ ” All who have raged against him will come to him and be put to shame.
chapters.zh: 人论我说，公义，能力，惟独在乎耶和华。人都必归向他，凡向他发怒的，必至蒙羞。

chapters.en: But all the descendants of Israel will find deliverance in the LORD and will make their boast in him.
chapters.zh: 以色列的后裔，都必因耶和华得称为义，并要夸耀。

chapters.en: Bel bows down, Nebo stoops low; their idols are borne by beasts of burden.The images that are carried about are burdensome, a burden for the weary.
chapters.zh: 彼勒屈身，尼波弯腰。巴比伦的偶像驮在兽和牲畜上，他们所抬的如今成了重驮，使牲畜疲乏。

chapters.en: They stoop and bow down together; unable to rescue the burden, they themselves go off into captivity.
chapters.zh: 都一同弯腰屈身，不能保全重驮，自己倒被掳去。

chapters.en: “Listen to me, you descendants of Jacob, all the remnant of the people of Israel, you whom I have upheld since your birth, and have carried since you were born.
chapters.zh: 雅各家，以色列家一切余剩的，要听我言，你们自从生下，就蒙我保抱，自从出胎，便蒙我怀搋。

chapters.en: Even to your old age and gray hairs I am he, I am he who will sustain you. I have made you and I will carry you; I will sustain you and I will rescue you.
chapters.zh: 直到你们年老，我仍这样，直到你们发白，我仍怀搋，我已造作，也必保抱，我必怀抱，也必拯救。

chapters.en: “With whom will you compare me or count me equal? To whom will you liken me that we may be compared?
chapters.zh: 你们将谁与我相比，与我同等，可以与我比较，使我们相同呢？

chapters.en: Some pour out gold from their bags and weigh out silver on the scales; they hire a goldsmith to make it into a god, and they bow down and worship it.
chapters.zh: 那从囊中抓金子，用天平平银子的人，雇银匠制造神像，他们又俯伏，又叩拜。

chapters.en: They lift it to their shoulders and carry it; they set it up in its place, and there it stands. From that spot it cannot move. Even though someone cries out to it, it cannot answer; it cannot save them from their troubles.
chapters.zh: 他们将神像抬起，扛在肩上，安置在定处，它就站立，不离本位，人呼求它，它不能答应，也不能救人脱离患难。

chapters.en: “Remember this, keep it in mind, take it to heart, you rebels.
chapters.zh: 你们当想念这事，自己作大丈夫。悖逆的人哪，要心里思想。

chapters.en: Remember the former things, those of long ago; I am God, and there is no other; I am God, and there is none like me.
chapters.zh: 你们要追念上古的事，因为我是神，并无别神，我是神，再没有能比我的。

chapters.en: I make known the end from the beginning, from ancient times, what is still to come. I say, ‘My purpose will stand, and I will do all that I please.’
chapters.zh: 我从起初指明末后的事，从古时言明未成的事，说，我的筹算必立定，凡我所喜悦的，我必成就。

chapters.en: From the east I summon a bird of prey; from a far-off land, a man to fulfill my purpose. What I have said, that I will bring about; what I have planned, that I will do.
chapters.zh: 我召鸷鸟从东方来，召那成就我筹算的人从远方来。我已说出，也必成就，我已谋定，也必作成。

chapters.en: Listen to me, you stubborn-hearted, you who are now far from my righteousness.
chapters.zh: 你们这些心中顽梗，远离公义的，当听我言。

chapters.en: I am bringing my righteousness near, it is not far away; and my salvation will not be delayed. I will grant salvation to Zion, my splendor to Israel.
chapters.zh: 我使我的公义临近，必不远离，我的救恩必不迟延，我要为以色列我的荣耀，在锡安施行救恩。

chapters.en: “Go down, sit in the dust, Virgin Daughter Babylon; sit on the ground without a throne, queen city of the Babylonians.No more will you be called tender or delicate.
chapters.zh: 巴比伦的处女阿，下来坐在尘埃，迦勒底的闺女阿，没有宝座，要坐在地上，因为你不再称为柔弱娇嫩的。

chapters.en: Take millstones and grind flour; take off your veil. Lift up your skirts, bare your legs, and wade through the streams.
chapters.zh: 要用磨磨面。揭去帕子，脱去长衣，露腿趟河。

chapters.en: Your nakedness will be exposed and your shame uncovered. I will take vengeance; I will spare no one.”
chapters.zh: 你的下体必被露出，你的丑陋必被看见。我要报仇，谁也不宽容。

chapters.en: Our Redeemer—the LORD Almighty is his name— is the Holy One of Israel.
chapters.zh: 我们救赎主的名是万军之耶和华以色列的圣者。

chapters.en: “Sit in silence, go into darkness, queen city of the Babylonians; no more will you be called queen of kingdoms.
chapters.zh: 迦勒底的闺女阿，你要默然静坐，进入暗中，因为你不再称为列国的主母。

chapters.en: I was angry with my people and desecrated my inheritance; I gave them into your hand, and you showed them no mercy. Even on the aged you laid a very heavy yoke.
chapters.zh: 我向我的百姓发怒，使我的产业被亵渎，将他们交在你手中，你毫不怜悯他们，把极重的轭加在老年人身上。

chapters.en: You said, ‘I am forever— the eternal queen!’ But you did not consider these things or reflect on what might happen.
chapters.zh: 你自己说，我必永为主母，所以你不将这事放在心上，也不思想这事的结局。

chapters.en: “Now then, listen, you lover of pleasure, lounging in your security and saying to yourself, ‘I am, and there is none besides me. I will never be a widow or suffer the loss of children.’
chapters.zh: 你这专好宴乐，安然居住的，现在当听这话，你心中说，惟有我，除我以外再没有别的，我必不至寡居，也不遭丧子之事。

chapters.en: Both of these will overtake you in a moment, on a single day: loss of children and widowhood. They will come upon you in full measure, in spite of your many sorceries and all your potent spells.
chapters.zh: 哪知丧子，寡居，这两件事，在一日转眼之间必临到你，正在你多行邪术，广施符咒的时候，这两件事必全然临到你身上。

chapters.en: You have trusted in your wickedness and have said, ‘No one sees me.’ Your wisdom and knowledge mislead you when you say to yourself, ‘I am, and there is none besides me.’
chapters.zh: 你素来倚仗自己的恶行，说，无人看见我。你的智慧，聪明，使你偏邪，并且你心里说，惟有我，除我以外再没有别的。

chapters.en: Disaster will come upon you, and you will not know how to conjure it away. A calamity will fall upon you that you cannot ward off with a ransom; a catastrophe you cannot foresee will suddenly come upon you.
chapters.zh: 因此，祸患要临到你身，你不知何时发现。（何时发现或作如何驱逐）灾害落在你身上，你也不能除掉。所不知道的毁灭，也必忽然临到你身。

chapters.en: “Keep on, then, with your magic spells and with your many sorceries, which you have labored at since childhood. Perhaps you will succeed, perhaps you will cause terror.
chapters.zh: 站起来吧，用你从幼年劳神施行的符咒，和你许多的邪术，或者可得益处，或者可得强胜。

chapters.en: All the counsel you have received has only worn you out! Let your astrologers come forward, those stargazers who make predictions month by month, let them save you from what is coming upon you.
chapters.zh: 你筹划太多，以致疲倦。让那些观天象的，看星宿的，在月朔说预言的，都站起来，救你脱离所要临到你的事。

chapters.en: Surely they are like stubble; the fire will burn them up. They cannot even save themselves from the power of the flame. These are not coals for warmth; this is not a fire to sit by.
chapters.zh: 他们要像碎秸被火焚烧，不能救自己脱离火焰之力，这火并非可烤的炭火，也不是可以坐在其前的火。

chapters.en: That is all they are to you— these you have dealt with and labored with since childhood. All of them go on in their error; there is not one that can save you.
chapters.zh: 你所劳神的事，都要这样与你无益。从幼年与你贸易的，也都各奔各乡，无人救你。

chapters.en: “Listen to this, you descendants of Jacob, you who are called by the name of Israel and come from the line of Judah, you who take oaths in the name of the LORD and invoke the God of Israel— but not in truth or righteousness—
chapters.zh: 雅各家，称为以色列名下，从犹大水源出来的，当听我言。你们指着耶和华的名起誓，提说以色列的神，却不凭诚实，不凭公义。

chapters.en: you who call yourselves citizens of the holy city and claim to rely on the God of Israel— the LORD Almighty is his name:
chapters.zh: （他们自称为圣城的人，所倚靠的是名为万军之耶和华以色列的神）

chapters.en: I foretold the former things long ago, my mouth announced them and I made them known; then suddenly I acted, and they came to pass.
chapters.zh: 主说，早先的事我从古时说明，已经出了我的口，也是我所指示的，我忽然行作，事便成就。

chapters.en: For I knew how stubborn you were; your neck muscles were iron, your forehead was bronze.
chapters.zh: 因为我素来知道你是顽梗的，你的颈项是铁的，你的额是铜的，

chapters.en: Therefore I told you these things long ago; before they happened I announced them to you so that you could not say, ‘My images brought them about; my wooden image and metal god ordained them.’
chapters.zh: 所以我从古时将这事给你说明，在未成以先指示你，免得你说，这些事是我的偶像所行的，是我雕刻的偶像，和我铸造的偶像所命定的。

chapters.en: You have heard these things; look at them all. Will you not admit them? “From now on I will tell you of new things, of hidden things unknown to you.
chapters.zh: 你已经听见，现在要看见这一切，你不说明吗？从今以后，我将新事就是你所不知道的隐密事，指示你。

chapters.en: They are created now, and not long ago; you have not heard of them before today. So you cannot say, ‘Yes, I knew of them.’
chapters.zh: 这事是现今造的，并非从古就有，在今日以先，你也未曾听见，免得你说，这事我早已知道了。

chapters.en: You have neither heard nor understood; from of old your ears have not been open. Well do I know how treacherous you are; you were called a rebel from birth.
chapters.zh: 你未曾听见，未曾知道，你的耳朵从来未曾开通。我原知道你行事极其诡诈，你自从出胎以来，便称为悖逆的。

chapters.en: For my own name’s sake I delay my wrath; for the sake of my praise I hold it back from you, so as not to destroy you completely.
chapters.zh: 我为我的名，暂且忍怒，为我的颂赞，向你容忍，不将你剪除。

chapters.en: See, I have refined you, though not as silver; I have tested you in the furnace of affliction.
chapters.zh: 我熬炼你，却不像熬炼银子。你在苦难的炉中，我拣选你。

chapters.en: For my own sake, for my own sake, I do this. How can I let myself be defamed? I will not yield my glory to another.
chapters.zh: 我为自己的缘故必行这事，我焉能使我的名被亵渎，我必不将我的荣耀归给假神。

chapters.en: “Listen to me, Jacob, Israel, whom I have called: I am he; I am the first and I am the last.
chapters.zh: 雅各，我所选召的以色列阿，当听我言。我是耶和华，我是首先的，也是末后的。

chapters.en: My own hand laid the foundations of the earth, and my right hand spread out the heavens; when I summon them, they all stand up together.
chapters.zh: 我手立了地的根基，我右手铺张诸天，我一招呼便都立住。

chapters.en: “Come together, all of you, and listen: Which of the idols has foretold these things? The LORD’s chosen ally will carry out his purpose against Babylon; his arm will be against the Babylonians.
chapters.zh: 你们都当聚集而听，他们（或作偶像）内中谁说过这些事。耶和华所爱的人，必向巴比伦行他所喜悦的事，他的膀臂也要加在迦勒底人身上。

chapters.en: I, even I, have spoken; yes, I have called him. I will bring him, and he will succeed in his mission.
chapters.zh: 惟有我曾说过，我又选召他，领他来，他的道路就必亨通。

chapters.en: “Come near me and listen to this: “From the first announcement I have not spoken in secret; at the time it happens, I am there.” And now the Sovereign LORD has sent me, endowed with his Spirit.
chapters.zh: 你们要就近我来听这话。我从起头并未曾在隐密处说话，自从有这事，我就在那里。现在主耶和华差遣我和他的灵来。（或作耶和华和他的灵差遣我来）

chapters.en: This is what the LORD says— your Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel: “I am the LORD your God, who teaches you what is best for you, who directs you in the way you should go.
chapters.zh: 耶和华你的救赎主，以色列的圣者如此说，我是耶和华你的神，教训你使你得益处，引导你所当行的路。

chapters.en: If only you had paid attention to my commands, your peace would have been like a river, your well-being like the waves of the sea.
chapters.zh: 甚愿你素来听从我的命令，你的平安就如河水，你的公义就如海浪。

chapters.en: Your descendants would have been like the sand, your children like its numberless grains; their name would never be blotted out nor destroyed from before me.”
chapters.zh: 你的后裔也必多如海沙，你腹中所生的也必多如沙粒。他的名在我面前必不剪除，也不灭绝。

chapters.en: Leave Babylon, flee from the Babylonians! Announce this with shouts of joy and proclaim it. Send it out to the ends of the earth; say, “The LORD has redeemed his servant Jacob.”
chapters.zh: 你们要从巴比伦出来，从迦勒底人中逃脱，以欢呼的声音传扬说，耶和华救赎了他的仆人雅各，你们要将这事宣扬到地极。

chapters.en: They did not thirst when he led them through the deserts; he made water flow for them from the rock; he split the rock and water gushed out.
chapters.zh: 耶和华引导他们，经过沙漠，他们并不干渴，他为他们使水从磐石而流，分裂磐石水就涌出。

chapters.en: “There is no peace,” says the LORD, “for the wicked.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华说，恶人必不得平安。

chapters.en: Listen to me, you islands; hear this, you distant nations: Before I was born the LORD called me; from my mother’s womb he has spoken my name.
chapters.zh: 众海岛阿，当听我言。远方的众民哪，留心而听。自我出胎，耶和华就选召我，自出母腹，他就提我的名。

chapters.en: He made my mouth like a sharpened sword, in the shadow of his hand he hid me; he made me into a polished arrow and concealed me in his quiver.
chapters.zh: 他使我的口如快刀，将我藏在他手荫之下。又使我成为磨亮的箭，将我藏在他箭袋之中。

chapters.en: He said to me, “You are my servant, Israel, in whom I will display my splendor.”
chapters.zh: 对我说，你是我的仆人以色列，我必因你得荣耀。

chapters.en: But I said, “I have labored in vain; I have spent my strength for nothing at all. Yet what is due me is in the LORD’s hand, and my reward is with my God.”
chapters.zh: 我却说，我劳碌是徒然，我尽力是虚无虚空，然而我当得的理必在耶和华那里，我的赏赐必在我神那里。

chapters.en: And now the LORD says— he who formed me in the womb to be his servant to bring Jacob back to him and gather Israel to himself, for I am honored in the eyes of the LORD and my God has been my strength—
chapters.zh: 耶和华从我出胎造就我作他的仆人，要使雅各归向他，使以色列到他那里聚集。（原来耶和华看我为尊贵，我的神也成为我的力量）

chapters.en: he says: “It is too small a thing for you to be my servant to restore the tribes of Jacob and bring back those of Israel I have kept. I will also make you a light for the Gentiles, that my salvation may reach to the ends of the earth.”
chapters.zh: 现在他说，你作我的仆人，使雅各众支派复兴，使以色列中得保全的归回，尚为小事，我还要使你作外邦人的光，叫你施行我的救恩，直到地极。

chapters.en: This is what the LORD says— the Redeemer and Holy One of Israel— to him who was despised and abhorred by the nation, to the servant of rulers: “Kings will see you and stand up, princes will see and bow down, because of the LORD, who is faithful, the Holy One of Israel, who has chosen you.”
chapters.zh: 救赎主以色列的圣者耶和华，对那被人所藐视，本国所憎恶，官长所虐待的，如此说，君王要看见就站起，首领也要下拜，都因信实的耶和华，就是拣选你以色列的圣者。

chapters.en: This is what the LORD says: “In the time of my favor I will answer you, and in the day of salvation I will help you; I will keep you and will make you to be a covenant for the people, to restore the land and to reassign its desolate inheritances,
chapters.zh: 耶和华如此说，在悦纳的时候我应允了你，在拯救的日子我济助了你，我要保护你，使你作众民的中保，（中保原文作约）复兴遍地，使人承受荒凉之地为业。

chapters.en: to say to the captives, ‘Come out,’ and to those in darkness, ‘Be free!’ “They will feed beside the roads and find pasture on every barren hill.
chapters.zh: 对那被捆绑的人说，出来吧。对那在黑暗的人说，显露吧。他们在路上必得饮食，在一切净光的高处必有食物。

chapters.en: They will neither hunger nor thirst, nor will the desert heat or the sun beat down on them. He who has compassion on them will guide them and lead them beside springs of water.
chapters.zh: 不饥不渴，炎热和烈日必不伤害他们，因为怜恤他们的，必引导他们，领他们到水泉旁边。

chapters.en: I will turn all my mountains into roads, and my highways will be raised up.
chapters.zh: 我必使我的众山成为大道，我的大路也被修高。

chapters.en: See, they will come from afar— some from the north, some from the west, some from the region of Aswan. ”
chapters.zh: 看哪，这些从远方来，这些从北方，从西方来，这些从秦国来。（秦原文作希尼）

chapters.en: Shout for joy, you heavens; rejoice, you earth; burst into song, you mountains! For the LORD comforts his people and will have compassion on his afflicted ones.
chapters.zh: 诸天哪，应当欢呼。大地阿，应当快乐。众山哪，应当发声歌唱。因为耶和华已经安慰他的百姓，也要怜恤他困苦之民。

chapters.en: But Zion said, “The LORD has forsaken me, the Lord has forgotten me.”
chapters.zh: 锡安说，耶和华离弃了我，主忘记了我。

chapters.en: “Can a mother forget the baby at her breast and have no compassion on the child she has borne? Though she may forget, I will not forget you!
chapters.zh: 妇人焉能忘记她吃奶的婴孩，不怜恤她所生的儿子。即或有忘记的，我却不忘记你。

chapters.en: See, I have engraved you on the palms of my hands; your walls are ever before me.
chapters.zh: 看哪，我将你铭刻在我掌上，你的墙垣常在我眼前。

chapters.en: Your children hasten back, and those who laid you waste depart from you.
chapters.zh: 你的儿女必急速归回，毁坏你的，使你荒废的，必都离你出去。

chapters.en: Lift up your eyes and look around; all your children gather and come to you. As surely as I live,” declares the LORD, “you will wear them all as ornaments; you will put them on, like a bride.
chapters.zh: 你举目向四方观看，他们都聚集来到你这里。耶和华说，我指着我的永生起誓，你必要以他们为妆饰佩戴，以他们为华带束腰，像新妇一样。

chapters.en: “Though you were ruined and made desolate and your land laid waste, now you will be too small for your people, and those who devoured you will be far away.
chapters.zh: 至于你荒废凄凉之处，并你被毁坏之地，现今众民居住必显为太窄。吞灭你的必离你遥远。

chapters.en: The children born during your bereavement will yet say in your hearing, ‘This place is too small for us; give us more space to live in.’
chapters.zh: 你必听见丧子之后所生的儿女说，这地方我居住太窄，求你给我地方居住。

chapters.en: Then you will say in your heart, ‘Who bore me these? I was bereaved and barren; I was exiled and rejected. Who brought these up? I was left all alone, but these—where have they come from?’ ”
chapters.zh: 那时你心里必说，我既丧子独居，是被掳的，漂流在外，谁给我生这些，谁将这些养大呢？撇下我一人独居的时候，这些在哪里呢？

chapters.en: This is what the Sovereign LORD says: “See, I will beckon to the nations, I will lift up my banner to the peoples; they will bring your sons in their arms and carry your daughters on their hips.
chapters.zh: 主耶和华如此说，我必向列国举手，向万民竖立大旗，他们必将你的众子怀中抱来，将你的众女肩上扛来。

chapters.en: Kings will be your foster fathers, and their queens your nursing mothers. They will bow down before you with their faces to the ground; they will lick the dust at your feet. Then you will know that I am the LORD; those who hope in me will not be disappointed.”
chapters.zh: 列王必作你的养父，王后必作你的乳母。他们必将脸伏地，向你下拜，并舔你脚上的尘土。你便知道我是耶和华，等候我的必不至羞愧。

chapters.en: Can plunder be taken from warriors, or captives be rescued from the fierce ?
chapters.zh: 勇士抢去的岂能夺回，该掳掠的岂能解救吗？

chapters.en: But this is what the LORD says: “Yes, captives will be taken from warriors, and plunder retrieved from the fierce; I will contend with those who contend with you, and your children I will save.
chapters.zh: 但耶和华如此说，就是勇士所掳掠的，也可以夺回，强暴人所抢的，也可以解救，与你相争的我必与他相争，我要拯救你的儿女。

chapters.en: I will make your oppressors eat their own flesh; they will be drunk on their own blood, as with wine. Then all mankind will know that I, the LORD, am your Savior, your Redeemer, the Mighty One of Jacob.”
chapters.zh: 并且我必使那欺压你的吃自己的肉，也要以自己的血喝醉，好像喝甜酒一样。凡有血气的，必都知道我耶和华是你的救主，是你的救赎主，是雅各的大能者。

chapters.en: This is what the LORD says: “Where is your mother’s certificate of divorce with which I sent her away? Or to which of my creditors did I sell you? Because of your sins you were sold; because of your transgressions your mother was sent away.
chapters.zh: 耶和华如此说，我休你们的母亲，休书在哪里呢？我将你们卖给我哪一个债主呢？你们被卖，是因你们的罪孽。你们的母亲被休，是因你们的过犯。

chapters.en: When I came, why was there no one? When I called, why was there no one to answer? Was my arm too short to deliver you? Do I lack the strength to rescue you? By a mere rebuke I dry up the sea, I turn rivers into a desert; their fish rot for lack of water and die of thirst.
chapters.zh: 我来的时候，为何无人等候呢？我呼唤的时候，为何无人答应呢？我的膀臂岂是缩短，不能救赎吗？我岂无拯救之力吗？看哪，我一斥责，海就干了，我使江河变为旷野。其中的鱼因无水腥臭，干渴而死。

chapters.en: I clothe the heavens with darkness and make sackcloth its covering.”
chapters.zh: 我使诸天以黑暗为衣服，以麻布为遮盖。

chapters.en: The Sovereign LORD has given me a well-instructed tongue, to know the word that sustains the weary. He wakens me morning by morning, wakens my ear to listen like one being instructed.
chapters.zh: 主耶和华赐我受教者的舌头，使我知道怎样用言语扶助疲乏的人。主每早晨提醒，提醒我的耳朵，使我能听，像受教者一样。

chapters.en: The Sovereign LORD has opened my ears; I have not been rebellious, I have not turned away.
chapters.zh: 主耶和华开通我的耳朵，我并没有违背，也没有退后。

chapters.en: I offered my back to those who beat me, my cheeks to those who pulled out my beard; I did not hide my face from mocking and spitting.
chapters.zh: 人打我的背，我任他打。人拔我腮颊的胡须，我由他拔。人辱我吐我，我并不掩面。

chapters.en: Because the Sovereign LORD helps me, I will not be disgraced. Therefore have I set my face like flint, and I know I will not be put to shame.
chapters.zh: 主耶和华必帮助我，所以我不抱愧。我硬着脸面好像坚石，我也知道我必不至蒙羞。

chapters.en: He who vindicates me is near. Who then will bring charges against me? Let us face each other! Who is my accuser? Let him confront me!
chapters.zh: 称我为义的与我相近。谁与我争论，可以与我一同站立。谁与我作对，可以就近我来。

chapters.en: It is the Sovereign LORD who helps me. Who will condemn me? They will all wear out like a garment; the moths will eat them up.
chapters.zh: 主耶和华要帮助我。谁能定我有罪呢？他们都像衣服渐渐旧了，为蛀虫所咬。

chapters.en: Who among you fears the LORD and obeys the word of his servant? Let the one who walks in the dark, who has no light, trust in the name of the LORD and rely on their God.
chapters.zh: 你们中间谁是敬畏耶和华听从他仆人之话的。这人行在暗中，没有亮光，当倚靠耶和华的名，仗赖自己的神。

chapters.en: But now, all you who light fires and provide yourselves with flaming torches, go, walk in the light of your fires and of the torches you have set ablaze. This is what you shall receive from my hand: You will lie down in torment.
chapters.zh: 凡你们点火用火把围绕自己的。可以行在你们的火焰里，并你们所点的火把中。这是我手所定的。你们必躺在悲惨之中。

chapters.en: “Listen to me, you who pursue righteousness and who seek the LORD: Look to the rock from which you were cut and to the quarry from which you were hewn;
chapters.zh: 你们这追求公义寻求耶和华的，当听我言。你们要追想被凿而出的磐石，被挖而出的岩穴。

chapters.en: look to Abraham, your father, and to Sarah, who gave you birth. When I called him he was only one man, and I blessed him and made him many.
chapters.zh: 要追想你们的祖宗亚伯拉罕，和生养你们的撒拉。因为亚伯拉罕独自一人的时候，我选召他，赐福与他，使他人数增多。

chapters.en: The LORD will surely comfort Zion and will look with compassion on all her ruins; he will make her deserts like Eden, her wastelands like the garden of the LORD. Joy and gladness will be found in her, thanksgiving and the sound of singing.
chapters.zh: 耶和华已经安慰锡安，和锡安一切的荒场，使旷野像伊甸，使沙漠像耶和华的园囿。在其中必有欢喜，快乐，感谢和歌唱的声音。

chapters.en: “Listen to me, my people; hear me, my nation: Instruction will go out from me; my justice will become a light to the nations.
chapters.zh: 我的百姓阿，要向我留心。我的国民哪，要向我侧耳。因为训诲必从我而出，我必坚定我的公理为万民之光。

chapters.en: My righteousness draws near speedily, my salvation is on the way, and my arm will bring justice to the nations. The islands will look to me and wait in hope for my arm.
chapters.zh: 我的公义临近，我的救恩发出，我的膀臂要审判万民。海岛都要等候我，倚赖我的膀臂。

chapters.en: Lift up your eyes to the heavens, look at the earth beneath; the heavens will vanish like smoke, the earth will wear out like a garment and its inhabitants die like flies. But my salvation will last forever, my righteousness will never fail.
chapters.zh: 你们要向天举目，观看下地。因为天必像烟云消散，地必如衣服渐渐旧了。其上的居民，也要如此死亡。（如此死亡或作像蠓虫死亡）惟有我的救恩永远长存，我的公义也不废掉。

chapters.en: “Hear me, you who know what is right, you people who have taken my instruction to heart: Do not fear the reproach of mere mortals or be terrified by their insults.
chapters.zh: 知道公义，将我训诲存在心中的民，要听我言不要怕人的辱骂，也不要因人的毁谤惊惶。

chapters.en: For the moth will eat them up like a garment; the worm will devour them like wool. But my righteousness will last forever, my salvation through all generations.”
chapters.zh: 因为蛀虫必咬他们，好像咬衣服，虫子必咬他们，如同咬羊绒。惟有我的公义永远长存，我的救恩直到万代。

chapters.en: Awake, awake, arm of the LORD, clothe yourself with strength! Awake, as in days gone by, as in generations of old. Was it not you who cut Rahab to pieces, who pierced that monster through?
chapters.zh: 耶和华的膀臂阿，兴起，兴起，以能力为衣穿上，像古时的年日，上古的世代兴起一样。从前砍碎拉哈伯，刺透大鱼的，不是你吗？

chapters.en: Was it not you who dried up the sea, the waters of the great deep, who made a road in the depths of the sea so that the redeemed might cross over?
chapters.zh: 使海与深渊的水干涸，使海的深处变为赎民经过之路的，不是你吗？

chapters.en: Those the LORD has rescued will return. They will enter Zion with singing; everlasting joy will crown their heads. Gladness and joy will overtake them, and sorrow and sighing will flee away.
chapters.zh: 耶和华救赎的民必归回，歌唱来到锡安。永乐必归到他们的头上，他们必得着欢喜快乐，忧愁叹息尽都逃避。

chapters.en: “I, even I, am he who comforts you. Who are you that you fear mere mortals, human beings who are but grass,
chapters.zh: 惟有我，是安慰你们的。你是谁？竟怕那必死的人，怕那要变如草的世人。

chapters.en: that you forget the LORD your Maker, who stretches out the heavens and who lays the foundations of the earth, that you live in constant terror every day because of the wrath of the oppressor, who is bent on destruction? For where is the wrath of the oppressor?
chapters.zh: 却忘记铺张诸天，立定地基，创造你的耶和华。又因欺压者图谋毁灭要发的暴怒，整天害怕。其实那欺压者的暴怒在哪里呢？

chapters.en: The cowering prisoners will soon be set free; they will not die in their dungeon, nor will they lack bread.
chapters.zh: 被掳去的快得释放，必不死而下坑。他的食物，也不致缺乏。

chapters.en: For I am the LORD your God, who stirs up the sea so that its waves roar— the LORD Almighty is his name.
chapters.zh: 我是耶和华你的神，搅动大海，使海中的波浪澎湃。万军之耶和华是我的名。

chapters.en: I have put my words in your mouth and covered you with the shadow of my hand— I who set the heavens in place, who laid the foundations of the earth, and who say to Zion, ‘You are my people.’ ”
chapters.zh: 我将我的话传给你，用我的手影遮蔽你，为要栽定诸天，立定地基。又对锡安说，你是我的百姓。

chapters.en: Awake, awake! Rise up, Jerusalem, you who have drunk from the hand of the LORD the cup of his wrath, you who have drained to its dregs the goblet that makes people stagger.
chapters.zh: 耶路撒冷阿，兴起，兴起，站起来。你从耶和华手中喝了他忿怒之杯，喝了那使人东倒西歪的爵，以至喝尽。

chapters.en: Among all the children she bore there was none to guide her; among all the children she reared there was none to take her by the hand.
chapters.zh: 他所生育的诸子中没有一个引导他的。他所养大的诸子中没有一个搀扶他的。

chapters.en: These double calamities have come upon you— who can comfort you?— ruin and destruction, famine and sword— who can console you?
chapters.zh: 荒凉，毁灭，饥荒，刀兵，这几样临到你，谁为你举哀？我如何能安慰你呢？

chapters.en: Your children have fainted; they lie at every street corner, like antelope caught in a net. They are filled with the wrath of the LORD, with the rebuke of your God.
chapters.zh: 你的众子发昏，在各市口上躺卧，好像黄羊在网罗之中。都满了耶和华的忿怒，你神的斥责。

chapters.en: Therefore hear this, you afflicted one, made drunk, but not with wine.
chapters.zh: 因此，你这困苦却非因酒而醉的，要听我言。

chapters.en: This is what your Sovereign LORD says, your God, who defends his people: “See, I have taken out of your hand the cup that made you stagger; from that cup, the goblet of my wrath, you will never drink again.
chapters.zh: 你的主耶和华，就是为他百姓辨屈的神，如此说，看哪，我已将那使人东倒西歪的杯，就是我忿怒的爵，从你手中接过来。你必不至再喝。

chapters.en: I will put it into the hands of your tormentors, who said to you, ‘Fall prostrate that we may walk on you.’ And you made your back like the ground, like a street to be walked on.”
chapters.zh: 我必将这杯，递在苦待你的人手中。他们曾对你说，你屈身，由我们践踏过去吧。你便以背为地，好像街市，任人经过。

chapters.en: Awake, awake, Zion, clothe yourself with strength! Put on your garments of splendor, Jerusalem, the holy city. The uncircumcised and defiled will not enter you again.
chapters.zh: 锡安哪，兴起，兴起，披上你的能力。圣城耶路撒冷阿，穿上你华美的衣服。因为从今以后，未受割礼不洁净的，必不再进入你中间。

chapters.en: Shake off your dust; rise up, sit enthroned, Jerusalem. Free yourself from the chains on your neck, Daughter Zion, now a captive.
chapters.zh: 耶路撒冷阿，要抖下尘土。起来坐在位上。锡安被掳的居民哪，（居民原文作女子）要解开你颈项的锁链。

chapters.en: For this is what the LORD says: “You were sold for nothing, and without money you will be redeemed.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华如此说，你们是无价被卖的，也必无银被赎。

chapters.en: For this is what the Sovereign LORD says: “At first my people went down to Egypt to live; lately, Assyria has oppressed them.
chapters.zh: 主耶和华如此说，起先我的百姓下到埃及，在那里寄居，又有亚述人无故欺压他们。

chapters.en: “And now what do I have here?” declares the LORD. “For my people have been taken away for nothing, and those who rule them mock, ” declares the LORD. “And all day long my name is constantly blasphemed.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说，我的百姓既是无价被掳去，如今我在这里作什么呢？耶和华说，辖制他们的人呼叫，我的名整天受亵渎

chapters.en: Therefore my people will know my name; therefore in that day they will know that it is I who foretold it. Yes, it is I.”
chapters.zh: 所以我的百姓必知道我的名。到那日他们必知道说这话的就是我，看哪，是我。

chapters.en: How beautiful on the mountains are the feet of those who bring good news, who proclaim peace, who bring good tidings, who proclaim salvation, who say to Zion, “Your God reigns!”
chapters.zh: 那报佳音，传平安，报好信，传救恩的，对锡安说，你的神作王了。这人的脚登山何等佳美。

chapters.en: Listen! Your watchmen lift up their voices; together they shout for joy. When the LORD returns to Zion, they will see it with their own eyes.
chapters.zh: 听阿，你守望之人的声音。他们扬起声来，一同歌唱。因为耶和华归回锡安的时候，他们必亲眼看见。

chapters.en: Burst into songs of joy together, you ruins of Jerusalem, for the LORD has comforted his people, he has redeemed Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 耶路撒冷的荒场阿，要发起欢声，一同歌唱。因为耶和华安慰了他的百姓。救赎了耶路撒冷。

chapters.en: The LORD will lay bare his holy arm in the sight of all the nations, and all the ends of the earth will see the salvation of our God.
chapters.zh: 耶和华在万国眼前露出圣臂。地极的人都看见我们神的救恩了。

chapters.en: Depart, depart, go out from there! Touch no unclean thing! Come out from it and be pure, you who carry the articles of the LORD’s house.
chapters.zh: 你们离开吧，离开吧，从巴比伦出来，不要沾不洁净的物。要从其中出来。你们扛抬耶和华器皿的人哪，务要自洁。

chapters.en: But you will not leave in haste or go in flight; for the LORD will go before you, the God of Israel will be your rear guard.
chapters.zh: 你们出来必不至急忙，也不至奔逃。因为耶和华必在你们前头行。以色列的神必作你们的后盾。

chapters.en: See, my servant will act wisely ; he will be raised and lifted up and highly exalted.
chapters.zh: 我的仆人行事必有智慧，（或作行事通达）必被高举上升，且成为至高。

chapters.en: Just as there were many who were appalled at him — his appearance was so disfigured beyond that of any human being and his form marred beyond human likeness—
chapters.zh: 许多人因他（原文作你）惊奇，（他的面貌比别人憔悴，他的形容比世人枯槁）

chapters.en: so he will sprinkle many nations,and kings will shut their mouths because of him. For what they were not told, they will see, and what they have not heard, they will understand.
chapters.zh: 这样，他必洗净（或作鼓动）许多国民。君王要向他闭口。因所未曾传与他们的，他们必看见。未曾听见的，他们要明白。

chapters.en: Who has believed our message and to whom has the arm of the LORD been revealed?
chapters.zh: 我们所传的，（或作所传与我们的）有谁信呢？耶和华的膀臂向谁显露呢？

chapters.en: He grew up before him like a tender shoot, and like a root out of dry ground. He had no beauty or majesty to attract us to him, nothing in his appearance that we should desire him.
chapters.zh: 他在耶和华面前生长如嫩芽，像根出于干地。他无佳形美容，我们看见他的时候，也无美貌使我们羡慕他。

chapters.en: He was despised and rejected by mankind, a man of suffering, and familiar with pain. Like one from whom people hide their faces he was despised, and we held him in low esteem.
chapters.zh: 他被藐视，被人厌弃，多受痛苦，常经忧患。他被藐视，好像被人掩面不看的一样。我们也不尊重他。

chapters.en: Surely he took up our pain and bore our suffering, yet we considered him punished by God, stricken by him, and afflicted.
chapters.zh: 他诚然担当我们的忧患，背负我们的痛苦。我们却以为他受责罚，被神击打苦待了。

chapters.en: But he was pierced for our transgressions, he was crushed for our iniquities; the punishment that brought us peace was on him, and by his wounds we are healed.
chapters.zh: 哪知他为我们的过犯受害，为我们的罪孽压伤。因他受的刑罚我们得平安。因他受的鞭伤我们得医治。

chapters.en: We all, like sheep, have gone astray, each of us has turned to our own way; and the LORD has laid on him the iniquity of us all.
chapters.zh: 我们都如羊走迷，各人偏行己路。耶和华使我们众人的罪孽都归在他身上。

chapters.en: He was oppressed and afflicted, yet he did not open his mouth; he was led like a lamb to the slaughter, and as a sheep before its shearers is silent, so he did not open his mouth.
chapters.zh: 他被欺压，在受苦的时候却不开口。（或作他受欺压却自卑不开口）他像羊羔被牵到宰杀之地，又像羊在剪毛的人手下无声，他也是这样不开口。

chapters.en: By oppression and judgment he was taken away. Yet who of his generation protested? For he was cut off from the land of the living; for the transgression of my people he was punished.
chapters.zh: 因受欺压和审判他被夺去。至于他同世的人，谁想他受鞭打，从活人之地被剪除，是因我百姓的罪过呢？

chapters.en: He was assigned a grave with the wicked, and with the rich in his death, though he had done no violence, nor was any deceit in his mouth.
chapters.zh: 他虽然未行强暴，口中也没有诡诈，人还使他与恶人同埋。谁知死的时候与财主同葬。

chapters.en: Yet it was the LORD’s will to crush him and cause him to suffer, and though the LORD makes his life an offering for sin, he will see his offspring and prolong his days, and the will of the LORD will prosper in his hand.
chapters.zh: 耶和华却定意（或作喜悦）将他压伤，使他受痛苦。耶和华以他为赎罪祭。（或作他献本身为赎罪祭）他必看见后裔，并且延长年日，耶和华所喜悦的事，必在他手中亨通。

chapters.en: After he has suffered, he will see the light of life and be satisfied ; by his knowledge my righteous servant will justify many, and he will bear their iniquities.
chapters.zh: 他必看见自己劳苦的功效，便心满意足。有许多人，因认识我的义仆得称为义。并且他要担当他们的罪孽。

chapters.en: Therefore I will give him a portion among the great,and he will divide the spoils with the strong,because he poured out his life unto death, and was numbered with the transgressors. For he bore the sin of many, and made intercession for the transgressors.
chapters.zh: 所以我要使他与位大的同分，与强盛的均分掳物。因为他将命倾倒，以致于死。他也被列在罪犯之中。他却担当多人的罪，又为罪犯代求。

chapters.en: “Sing, barren woman, you who never bore a child; burst into song, shout for joy, you who were never in labor; because more are the children of the desolate woman than of her who has a husband,” says the LORD.
chapters.zh: 你这不怀孕不生养的，要歌唱。你这未曾经过产难的，要发声歌唱，扬声欢呼。因为没有丈夫的，比有丈夫的儿女更多。这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: “Enlarge the place of your tent, stretch your tent curtains wide, do not hold back; lengthen your cords, strengthen your stakes.
chapters.zh: 要扩张你帐幕之地，张大你居所的幔子，不要限止，要放长你的绳子，坚固你的橛子。

chapters.en: For you will spread out to the right and to the left; your descendants will dispossess nations and settle in their desolate cities.
chapters.zh: 因为你要向左向右开展。你的后裔必得多国为业，又使荒凉的城邑有人居住。

chapters.en: “Do not be afraid; you will not be put to shame. Do not fear disgrace; you will not be humiliated. You will forget the shame of your youth and remember no more the reproach of your widowhood.
chapters.zh: 不要惧怕，因你必不致蒙羞。也不要抱愧，因你必不至受辱。你必忘记幼年的羞愧，不再记念你寡居的羞辱。

chapters.en: For your Maker is your husband— the LORD Almighty is his name— the Holy One of Israel is your Redeemer; he is called the God of all the earth.
chapters.zh: 因为造你的，是你的丈夫。万军之耶和华是他的名。救赎你的，是以色列的圣者。他必称为全地之神。

chapters.en: The LORD will call you back as if you were a wife deserted and distressed in spirit— a wife who married young, only to be rejected,” says your God.
chapters.zh: 耶和华召你，如召被离弃心中忧伤的妻，就是幼年所娶被弃的妻。这是你神所说的。

chapters.en: “For a brief moment I abandoned you, but with deep compassion I will bring you back.
chapters.zh: 我离弃你不过片时，却要施大恩将你收回。

chapters.en: In a surge of anger I hid my face from you for a moment, but with everlasting kindness I will have compassion on you,” says the LORD your Redeemer.
chapters.zh: 我的怒气涨溢，顷刻之间向你掩面，却要以永远的慈爱怜恤你。这是耶和华你的救赎主说的。

chapters.en: “To me this is like the days of Noah, when I swore that the waters of Noah would never again cover the earth. So now I have sworn not to be angry with you, never to rebuke you again.
chapters.zh: 这事在我好像挪亚的洪水。我怎样起誓不再使挪亚的洪水漫过遍地，我也照样起誓不再向你发怒，也不斥责你。

chapters.en: Though the mountains be shaken and the hills be removed, yet my unfailing love for you will not be shaken nor my covenant of peace be removed,” says the LORD, who has compassion on you.
chapters.zh: 大山可以挪开，小山可以迁移。但我的慈爱必不离开你，我平安的约也不迁移。这是怜恤你的耶和华说的。

chapters.en: “Afflicted city, lashed by storms and not comforted, I will rebuild you with stones of turquoise,your foundations with lapis lazuli.
chapters.zh: 你这受困苦被风飘荡不得安慰的人哪，我必以彩色安置你的石头，以蓝宝石立定你的根基。

chapters.en: I will make your battlements of rubies, your gates of sparkling jewels, and all your walls of precious stones.
chapters.zh: 又以红宝石造你的女墙，以红玉造你的城门，以宝石造你四围的边界。（或作外郭）

chapters.en: All your children will be taught by the LORD, and great will be their peace.
chapters.zh: 你的儿女都要受耶和华的教训。你的儿女必大享平安。

chapters.en: In righteousness you will be established: Tyranny will be far from you; you will have nothing to fear. Terror will be far removed; it will not come near you.
chapters.zh: 你必因公义得坚立。必远离欺压，不至害怕。你必远离惊吓，惊吓必不临近你。

chapters.en: If anyone does attack you, it will not be my doing; whoever attacks you will surrender to you.
chapters.zh: 即或有人聚集，却不由于我。凡聚集攻击你的，必因你仆倒。（因你仆倒或作投降你）

chapters.en: “See, it is I who created the blacksmith who fans the coals into flame and forges a weapon fit for its work. And it is I who have created the destroyer to wreak havoc;
chapters.zh: 吹嘘炭火，打造合用器械的铁匠，是我所造。残害人行毁灭的，也是我所造。

chapters.en: no weapon forged against you will prevail, and you will refute every tongue that accuses you. This is the heritage of the servants of the LORD, and this is their vindication from me,” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 凡为攻击你造成的器械，必不利用。凡在审判时兴起用舌攻击你的，你必定他为有罪。这是耶和华仆人的产业，是他们从我所得的义。这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: “Come, all you who are thirsty, come to the waters; and you who have no money, come, buy and eat! Come, buy wine and milk without money and without cost.
chapters.zh: 你们一切干渴的都当就近水来。没有银钱的也可以来。你们都来，买了吃。不用银钱，不用价值，也来买酒和奶。

chapters.en: Why spend money on what is not bread, and your labor on what does not satisfy? Listen, listen to me, and eat what is good, and you will delight in the richest of fare.
chapters.zh: 你们为何花钱（原文作平银）买那不足为食物的，用劳碌得来的买那不使人饱足的呢？你们要留意听我的话，就能吃那美物，得享肥甘，心中喜乐。

chapters.en: Give ear and come to me; listen, that you may live. I will make an everlasting covenant with you, my faithful love promised to David.
chapters.zh: 你们当就近我来。侧耳而听，就必得活。我必与你们立永约，就是应许大卫那可靠的恩典。

chapters.en: See, I have made him a witness to the peoples, a ruler and commander of the peoples.
chapters.zh: 我已立他作万民的见证，为万民的君王和司令。

chapters.en: Surely you will summon nations you know not, and nations you do not know will come running to you, because of the LORD your God, the Holy One of Israel, for he has endowed you with splendor.”
chapters.zh: 你素不认识的国民，你也必召来。素不认识你的国民，也必向你奔跑，都因耶和华你的神以色列的圣者。因为他已经荣耀你。

chapters.en: Seek the LORD while he may be found; call on him while he is near.
chapters.zh: 当趁耶和华可寻找的时候寻找他，相近的时候求告他。

chapters.en: Let the wicked forsake their ways and the unrighteous their thoughts. Let them turn to the LORD, and he will have mercy on them, and to our God, for he will freely pardon.
chapters.zh: 恶人当离弃自己的道路。不义的人当除掉自己的意念，归向耶和华，耶和华就必怜恤他，当归向我们的神，因为神必广行赦免。

chapters.en: “For my thoughts are not your thoughts, neither are your ways my ways,” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说，我的意念，非同你们的意念，我的道路，非同你们的道路。

chapters.en: “As the heavens are higher than the earth, so are my ways higher than your ways and my thoughts than your thoughts.
chapters.zh: 天怎样高过地，照样我的道路，高过你们的道路，我的意念，高过你们的意念。

chapters.en: As the rain and the snow come down from heaven, and do not return to it without watering the earth and making it bud and flourish, so that it yields seed for the sower and bread for the eater,
chapters.zh: 雨雪从天而降，并不返回，却滋润地土，使地上发芽结实，使撒种的有种，使要吃的有粮。

chapters.en: so is my word that goes out from my mouth: It will not return to me empty, but will accomplish what I desire and achieve the purpose for which I sent it.
chapters.zh: 我口所出的话，也必如此，决不徒然返回，却要成就我所喜悦的，在我发他去成就的事上（发他去成就或作所命定）必然亨通。

chapters.en: You will go out in joy and be led forth in peace; the mountains and hills will burst into song before you, and all the trees of the field will clap their hands.
chapters.zh: 你们必欢欢喜喜而出来，平平安安蒙引导。大山小山必在你们面前发声歌唱。田野的树木也都拍掌。

chapters.en: Instead of the thornbush will grow the juniper, and instead of briers the myrtle will grow. This will be for the LORD’s renown, for an everlasting sign, that will endure forever.”
chapters.zh: 松树长出代替荆棘。番石榴长出代替蒺藜。这要为耶和华留名，作为永远的证据，不能剪除。

chapters.en: This is what the LORD says: “Maintain justice and do what is right, for my salvation is close at hand and my righteousness will soon be revealed.
chapters.zh: 耶和华如此说，你们当守公平，行公义。因我的救恩临近，我的公义将要显现。

chapters.en: Blessed is the one who does this— the person who holds it fast, who keeps the Sabbath without desecrating it, and keeps their hands from doing any evil.”
chapters.zh: 谨守安息日而不干犯，禁止己手而不作恶。如此行，如此持守的人，便为有福。

chapters.en: Let no foreigner who is bound to the LORD say, “The LORD will surely exclude me from his people.” And let no eunuch complain, “I am only a dry tree.”
chapters.zh: 与耶和华联合的外邦人不要说，耶和华必定将我从他民中分别出来。太监也不要说，我是枯树。

chapters.en: For this is what the LORD says: “To the eunuchs who keep my Sabbaths, who choose what pleases me and hold fast to my covenant—
chapters.zh: 因为耶和华如此说，那些谨守我的安息日，拣选我所喜悦的事，持守我约的太监。

chapters.en: to them I will give within my temple and its walls a memorial and a name better than sons and daughters; I will give them an everlasting name that will endure forever.
chapters.zh: 我必使他们在我殿中，在我墙内，有记念，有名号，比有儿女的更美。我必赐他们永远的名，不能剪除。

chapters.en: And foreigners who bind themselves to the LORD to minister to him, to love the name of the LORD, and to be his servants, all who keep the Sabbath without desecrating it and who hold fast to my covenant—
chapters.zh: 还有那些与耶和华联合的外邦人，要事奉他，要爱耶和华的名，要作他的仆人，就是凡守安息日不干犯，又持守他（原文作我）约的人。

chapters.en: these I will bring to my holy mountain and give them joy in my house of prayer. Their burnt offerings and sacrifices will be accepted on my altar; for my house will be called a house of prayer for all nations.”
chapters.zh: 我必领他们到我的圣山，使他们在祷告我的殿中喜乐。他们的燔祭，和平安祭，在我坛上必蒙悦纳。因我的殿必称为万民祷告的殿。

chapters.en: The Sovereign LORD declares— he who gathers the exiles of Israel: “I will gather still others to them besides those already gathered.”
chapters.zh: 主耶和华，就是招聚以色列被赶散的，说，在这被招聚的人以外，我还要招聚别人归并他们。

chapters.en: Come, all you beasts of the field, come and devour, all you beasts of the forest!
chapters.zh: 田野的诸兽，都来吞吃吧。林中的诸兽，也要如此。

chapters.en: Israel’s watchmen are blind, they all lack knowledge; they are all mute dogs, they cannot bark; they lie around and dream, they love to sleep.
chapters.zh: 他看守的人是瞎眼的，都没有知识，都是哑吧狗，不能叫唤。但知作梦，躺卧，贪睡。

chapters.en: They are dogs with mighty appetites; they never have enough. They are shepherds who lack understanding; they all turn to their own way, they seek their own gain.
chapters.zh: 这些狗贪食，不知饱足。这些牧人不能明白，各人偏行己路，各从各方求自己的利益。

chapters.en: “Come,” each one cries, “let me get wine! Let us drink our fill of beer! And tomorrow will be like today, or even far better.”
chapters.zh: 他们说，来吧，我去拿酒，我们饱饮浓酒。明日必和今日一样，就是宴乐无量极大之日。

chapters.en: The righteous perish, and no one takes it to heart; the devout are taken away, and no one understands that the righteous are taken away to be spared from evil.
chapters.zh: 义人死亡，无人放在心上。虔诚人被收去，无人思念。这义人被收去是免了将来的祸患。

chapters.en: Those who walk uprightly enter into peace; they find rest as they lie in death.
chapters.zh: 他们得享（原文作进入）平安，素行正直的，各人在坟里（原文作床上）安歇。

chapters.en: “But you—come here, you children of a sorceress, you offspring of adulterers and prostitutes!
chapters.zh: 你们这些巫婆的儿子，奸夫和妓女的种子，都要前来。

chapters.en: Who are you mocking? At whom do you sneer and stick out your tongue? Are you not a brood of rebels, the offspring of liars?
chapters.zh: 你们向谁戏笑，向谁张口吐舌呢？你们岂不是悖逆的儿女，虚谎的种类呢？

chapters.en: You burn with lust among the oaks and under every spreading tree; you sacrifice your children in the ravines and under the overhanging crags.
chapters.zh: 你们在橡树中间，在各青翠树下欲火攻心。在山谷间，在石穴下杀了儿女。

chapters.en: The idols among the smooth stones of the ravines are your portion; indeed, they are your lot. Yes, to them you have poured out drink offerings and offered grain offerings. In view of all this, should I relent?
chapters.zh: 在谷中光滑石头里有你的分。这些就是你所得的分。你也向他浇了奠祭，献了供物。因这事我岂能容忍吗？

chapters.en: You have made your bed on a high and lofty hill; there you went up to offer your sacrifices.
chapters.zh: 你在高而又高的山上安设床榻，也上那里去献祭。

chapters.en: Behind your doors and your doorposts you have put your pagan symbols. Forsaking me, you uncovered your bed, you climbed into it and opened it wide; you made a pact with those whose beds you love, and you looked with lust on their naked bodies.
chapters.zh: 你在门后，在门框后，立起你的记念，向外人赤露。又上去扩张床榻，与他们立约。你在那里看见他们的床，就甚喜爱。

chapters.en: You went to Molek with olive oil and increased your perfumes. You sent your ambassadors far away; you descended to the very realm of the dead!
chapters.zh: 你把油带到王那里，又多加香料，打发使者往远方去，自卑自贱直到阴间。

chapters.en: You wearied yourself by such going about, but you would not say, ‘It is hopeless.’ You found renewal of your strength, and so you did not faint.
chapters.zh: 你因路远疲倦，却不说，这是枉然。你以为有复兴之力，所以不觉疲惫。

chapters.en: “Whom have you so dreaded and feared that you have not been true to me, and have neither remembered me nor taken this to heart? Is it not because I have long been silent that you do not fear me?
chapters.zh: 你怕谁？因谁恐惧？竟说谎，不记念我，又不将这事放在心上。我不是许久闭口不言，你仍不怕我吗？

chapters.en: I will expose your righteousness and your works, and they will not benefit you.
chapters.zh: 我要指明你的公义。至于你所行的，都必与你无益。

chapters.en: When you cry out for help, let your collection of idols save you! The wind will carry all of them off, a mere breath will blow them away. But whoever takes refuge in me will inherit the land and possess my holy mountain.”
chapters.zh: 你哀求的时候，让你所聚集的拯救你吧。风要把他们刮散。一口气要把他们都吹去。但那投靠我的必得地土，必承受我的圣山为业。

chapters.en: And it will be said: “Build up, build up, prepare the road! Remove the obstacles out of the way of my people.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华要说，你们修筑修筑，预备道路，将绊脚石从我百姓的路中除掉。

chapters.en: For this is what the high and exalted One says— he who lives forever, whose name is holy: “I live in a high and holy place, but also with the one who is contrite and lowly in spirit, to revive the spirit of the lowly and to revive the heart of the contrite.
chapters.zh: 因为那至高至上，永远长存，（原文作住在永远）名为圣者的如此说，我住在至高至圣的所在，也与心灵痛悔谦卑的人同居，要使谦卑人的灵苏醒，也使痛悔人的心苏醒。

chapters.en: I will not accuse them forever, nor will I always be angry, for then they would faint away because of me— the very people I have created.
chapters.zh: 我必不永远相争，也不长久发怒。恐怕我所造的人与灵性，都必发昏。

chapters.en: I was enraged by their sinful greed; I punished them, and hid my face in anger, yet they kept on in their willful ways.
chapters.zh: 因他贪婪的罪孽，我就发怒击打他。我向他掩面发怒，他却仍然随心背道。

chapters.en: I have seen their ways, but I will heal them; I will guide them and restore comfort to Israel’s mourners,
chapters.zh: 我看见他所行的道，也要医治他。又要引导他，使他和那一同伤心的人，再得安慰。

chapters.en: creating praise on their lips. Peace, peace, to those far and near,” says the LORD. “And I will heal them.”
chapters.zh: 我造就嘴唇的果子。愿平安康泰归与远处的人，也归与近处的人，并且我要医治他。这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: But the wicked are like the tossing sea, which cannot rest, whose waves cast up mire and mud.
chapters.zh: 惟独恶人，好像翻腾的海，不得平静，其中的水，常涌出污秽和淤泥来。

chapters.en: “There is no peace,” says my God, “for the wicked.”
chapters.zh: 我的神说，恶人必不得平安。

chapters.en: “Shout it aloud, do not hold back. Raise your voice like a trumpet. Declare to my people their rebellion and to the descendants of Jacob their sins.
chapters.zh: 你要大声喊叫，不可止息，扬起声来好像吹角，向我百姓说明他们的过犯，向雅各家说明他们的罪恶。

chapters.en: For day after day they seek me out; they seem eager to know my ways, as if they were a nation that does what is right and has not forsaken the commands of its God. They ask me for just decisions and seem eager for God to come near them.
chapters.zh: 他们天天寻求我，乐意明白我的道。好像行义的国民，不离弃他们神的典章，向我求问公义的判语，喜悦亲近神。

chapters.en: ‘Why have we fasted,’ they say, ‘and you have not seen it? Why have we humbled ourselves, and you have not noticed?’ “Yet on the day of your fasting, you do as you please and exploit all your workers.
chapters.zh: 他们说，我们禁食，你为何不看见呢？我们刻苦己心，你为何不理会呢？看哪，你们禁食的日子，仍求利益，勒逼人为你们作苦工。

chapters.en: Your fasting ends in quarreling and strife, and in striking each other with wicked fists. You cannot fast as you do today and expect your voice to be heard on high.
chapters.zh: 你们禁食，却互相争竞，以凶恶的拳头打人。你们今日禁食，不得使你们的声音听闻于上。

chapters.en: Is this the kind of fast I have chosen, only a day for people to humble themselves? Is it only for bowing one’s head like a reed and for lying in sackcloth and ashes? Is that what you call a fast, a day acceptable to the LORD?
chapters.zh: 这样禁食，岂是我所拣选使人刻苦己心的日子吗？岂是叫人垂头像苇子，用麻布和炉灰铺在他以下吗？你这可称为禁食为耶和华所悦纳的日子吗？

chapters.en: “Is not this the kind of fasting I have chosen: to loose the chains of injustice and untie the cords of the yoke, to set the oppressed free and break every yoke?
chapters.zh: 我所拣选的禁食，不是要松开凶恶的绳，解下轭上的索，使被欺压的得自由，折断一切的轭吗？

chapters.en: Is it not to share your food with the hungry and to provide the poor wanderer with shelter— when you see the naked, to clothe them, and not to turn away from your own flesh and blood?
chapters.zh: 不是要把你的饼，分给饥饿的人。将飘流的穷人，接到你家中。见赤身的，给他衣服遮体。顾恤自己的骨肉而不掩藏吗？

chapters.en: Then your light will break forth like the dawn, and your healing will quickly appear; then your righteousness will go before you, and the glory of the LORD will be your rear guard.
chapters.zh: 这样你的光就必发现如早晨的光。你所得的医治，要速速发明。你的公义，必在你前面行。耶和华的荣光，必作你的后盾。

chapters.en: Then you will call, and the LORD will answer; you will cry for help, and he will say: Here am I. “If you do away with the yoke of oppression, with the pointing finger and malicious talk,
chapters.zh: 那时你求告，耶和华必应允。你呼求，他必说，我在这里。你若从你中间除掉重轭，和指摘人的指头，并发恶言的事。

chapters.en: and if you spend yourselves in behalf of the hungry and satisfy the needs of the oppressed, then your light will rise in the darkness, and your night will become like the noonday.
chapters.zh: 你心若向饥饿的人发怜悯，使困苦的人得满足。你的光就必在黑暗中发现，你的幽暗必变如正午。

chapters.en: The LORD will guide you always; he will satisfy your needs in a sun-scorched land and will strengthen your frame. You will be like a well-watered garden, like a spring whose waters never fail.
chapters.zh: 耶和华也必时常引导你，在干旱之地，使你心满意足，骨头强壮。你必像浇灌的园子，又像水流不绝的泉源。

chapters.en: Your people will rebuild the ancient ruins and will raise up the age-old foundations; you will be called Repairer of Broken Walls, Restorer of Streets with Dwellings.
chapters.zh: 那些出于你的人，必修造久已荒废之处。你要建立拆毁累代的根基。你必称为补破口的，和重修路径与人居住的。

chapters.en: “If you keep your feet from breaking the Sabbath and from doing as you please on my holy day, if you call the Sabbath a delight and the LORD’s holy day honorable, and if you honor it by not going your own way and not doing as you please or speaking idle words,
chapters.zh: 你若在安息日掉转（或作谨慎）你的脚步，在我圣日不以操作为喜乐，称安息日为可喜乐的，称耶和华的圣日为可尊重的。而且尊敬这日，不办自己的私事，不随自己的私意，不说自己的私话。

chapters.en: then you will find your joy in the LORD, and I will cause you to ride in triumph on the heights of the land and to feast on the inheritance of your father Jacob.” The mouth of the LORD has spoken.
chapters.zh: 你就以耶和华为乐。耶和华要使你乘驾地的高处。又以你祖雅各的产业养育你。这是耶和华亲口说的。

chapters.en: Surely the arm of the LORD is not too short to save, nor his ear too dull to hear.
chapters.zh: 耶和华的膀臂，并非缩短不能拯救。耳朵，并非发沉不能听见。

chapters.en: But your iniquities have separated you from your God; your sins have hidden his face from you, so that he will not hear.
chapters.zh: 但你们的罪孽使你们与神隔绝，你们的罪恶使他掩面不听你们。

chapters.en: For your hands are stained with blood, your fingers with guilt. Your lips have spoken falsely, and your tongue mutters wicked things.
chapters.zh: 因你们的手被血沾染，你们的指头被罪孽沾污。你们的嘴唇说谎言，你们的舌头出恶语。

chapters.en: No one calls for justice; no one pleads a case with integrity. They rely on empty arguments, they utter lies; they conceive trouble and give birth to evil.
chapters.zh: 无一人按公义告状，无一人凭诚实辨白。都倚靠虚妄，说谎言。所怀的是毒害，所生的是罪孽。

chapters.en: They hatch the eggs of vipers and spin a spider’s web. Whoever eats their eggs will die, and when one is broken, an adder is hatched.
chapters.zh: 他们抱毒蛇蛋，结蜘蛛网。人吃这蛋必死。这蛋被踏，必出蝮蛇。

chapters.en: Their cobwebs are useless for clothing; they cannot cover themselves with what they make. Their deeds are evil deeds, and acts of violence are in their hands.
chapters.zh: 所结的网，不能成为衣服，所作的，也不能遮盖自己。他们的行为都是罪孽，手所作的都是强暴。

chapters.en: Their feet rush into sin; they are swift to shed innocent blood. They pursue evil schemes; acts of violence mark their ways.
chapters.zh: 他们的脚奔跑行恶，他们急速流无辜人的血。意念都是罪孽。所经过的路都荒凉毁灭。

chapters.en: The way of peace they do not know; there is no justice in their paths. They have turned them into crooked roads; no one who walks along them will know peace.
chapters.zh: 平安的路，他们不知道。所行的事没有公平。他们为自己修弯曲的路。凡行此路的，都不知道平安。

chapters.en: So justice is far from us, and righteousness does not reach us. We look for light, but all is darkness; for brightness, but we walk in deep shadows.
chapters.zh: 因此公平离我们远，公义追不上我们。我们指望光亮，却是黑暗。指望光明，却行幽暗。

chapters.en: Like the blind we grope along the wall, feeling our way like people without eyes. At midday we stumble as if it were twilight; among the strong, we are like the dead.
chapters.zh: 我们摸索墙壁，好像瞎子。我们摸索如同无目之人。我们晌午绊脚，如在黄昏一样。我们在肥壮人中，像死人一般。

chapters.en: We all growl like bears; we moan mournfully like doves. We look for justice, but find none; for deliverance, but it is far away.
chapters.zh: 我们咆哮如熊，哀鸣如鸽。指望公平，却是没有。指望救恩，却远离我们。

chapters.en: For our offenses are many in your sight, and our sins testify against us. Our offenses are ever with us, and we acknowledge our iniquities:
chapters.zh: 我们的过犯在你面前增多，罪恶作见证告我们。过犯与我们同在。至于我们的罪孽，我们都知道。

chapters.en: rebellion and treachery against the LORD, turning our backs on our God, inciting revolt and oppression, uttering lies our hearts have conceived.
chapters.zh: 就是悖逆不认识耶和华，转去不跟从我们的神，说欺压和叛逆的话，心怀谎言，随即说出。

chapters.en: So justice is driven back, and righteousness stands at a distance; truth has stumbled in the streets, honesty cannot enter.
chapters.zh: 并且公平转而退后，公义站在远处。诚实在街上仆倒，正直也不得进入。

chapters.en: Truth is nowhere to be found, and whoever shuns evil becomes a prey. The LORD looked and was displeased that there was no justice.
chapters.zh: 诚实少见。离恶的人反成掠物。那时，耶和华看见没有公平，甚不喜悦。

chapters.en: He saw that there was no one, he was appalled that there was no one to intervene; so his own arm achieved salvation for him, and his own righteousness sustained him.
chapters.zh: 他见无人拯救，无人代求，甚为诧异。就用自己的膀臂施行拯救。以公义扶持自己。

chapters.en: He put on righteousness as his breastplate, and the helmet of salvation on his head; he put on the garments of vengeance and wrapped himself in zeal as in a cloak.
chapters.zh: 他以公义为铠甲，（或作护心镜）以拯救为头盔，以报仇为衣服，以热心为外袍。

chapters.en: According to what they have done, so will he repay wrath to his enemies and retribution to his foes; he will repay the islands their due.
chapters.zh: 他必按人的行为施报，恼怒他的敌人，报复他的仇敌，向众海岛施行报应。

chapters.en: From the west, people will fear the name of the LORD, and from the rising of the sun, they will revere his glory. For he will come like a pent-up flood that the breath of the LORD drives along.
chapters.zh: 如此，人从日落之处，必敬畏耶和华的名。从日出之地，也必敬畏他的荣耀。因为仇敌好像急流的河水冲来，是耶和华之气所驱逐的。

chapters.en: “The Redeemer will come to Zion, to those in Jacob who repent of their sins,” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 必有一位救赎主，来到锡安雅各族中转离过犯的人那里。这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: “As for me, this is my covenant with them,” says the LORD. “My Spirit, who is on you, will not depart from you, and my words that I have put in your mouth will always be on your lips, on the lips of your children and on the lips of their descendants—from this time on and forever,” says the LORD.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说，至于我与他们所立的约，乃是这样。我加给你的灵，传给你的话，必不离你的口，也不离你后裔与你后裔之后裔的口，从今直到永远。这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: “Arise, shine, for your light has come, and the glory of the LORD rises upon you.
chapters.zh: 兴起发光。因为你的光已经来到，耶和华的荣耀发现照耀你。

chapters.en: See, darkness covers the earth and thick darkness is over the peoples, but the LORD rises upon you and his glory appears over you.
chapters.zh: 看哪，黑暗遮盖大地，幽暗遮盖万民。耶和华却要显现照耀你，他的荣耀要现在你身上。

chapters.en: Nations will come to your light, and kings to the brightness of your dawn.
chapters.zh: 万国要来就你的光，君王要来就你发现的光辉。

chapters.en: “Lift up your eyes and look about you: All assemble and come to you; your sons come from afar, and your daughters are carried on the hip.
chapters.zh: 你举目向四方观看。众人都聚集来到你这里。你的众子从远方而来，你的众女也被怀抱而来。

chapters.en: Then you will look and be radiant, your heart will throb and swell with joy; the wealth on the seas will be brought to you, to you the riches of the nations will come.
chapters.zh: 那时你看见就有光荣，你心又跳动，又宽畅。因为大海丰盛的货物，必转来归你，列国的财宝，也必来归你。

chapters.en: Herds of camels will cover your land, young camels of Midian and Ephah. And all from Sheba will come, bearing gold and incense and proclaiming the praise of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 成群的骆驼，并米甸和以法的独峰驼，必遮满你。示巴的众人，都必来到。要奉上黄金乳香，又要传说耶和华的赞美。

chapters.en: All Kedar’s flocks will be gathered to you, the rams of Nebaioth will serve you; they will be accepted as offerings on my altar, and I will adorn my glorious temple.
chapters.zh: 基达的羊群，都必聚集到你这里，尼拜约的公羊，要供你使用。在我坛上必蒙悦纳。我必荣耀我荣耀的殿。

chapters.en: “Who are these that fly along like clouds, like doves to their nests?
chapters.zh: 那些飞来如云，又如鸽子向窗户飞回的，是谁呢？

chapters.en: Surely the islands look to me; in the lead are the ships of Tarshish,bringing your children from afar, with their silver and gold, to the honor of the LORD your God, the Holy One of Israel, for he has endowed you with splendor.
chapters.zh: 众海岛必等候我，首先是他施的船只，将你的众子，连他们的金银，从远方一同带来，都为耶和华你神的名，又为以色列的圣者，因为他已经荣耀了你。

chapters.en: “Foreigners will rebuild your walls, and their kings will serve you. Though in anger I struck you, in favor I will show you compassion.
chapters.zh: 外邦人必建筑你的城墙，他们的王必服事你。我曾发怒击打你，现今却施恩怜恤你。

chapters.en: Your gates will always stand open, they will never be shut, day or night, so that people may bring you the wealth of the nations— their kings led in triumphal procession.
chapters.zh: 你的城门必时常开放，昼夜不关，使人把列国的财物带来归你，并将他们的君王牵引而来。

chapters.en: For the nation or kingdom that will not serve you will perish; it will be utterly ruined.
chapters.zh: 哪一邦哪一国不事奉你，就必灭亡，也必全然荒废。

chapters.en: “The glory of Lebanon will come to you, the juniper, the fir and the cypress together, to adorn my sanctuary; and I will glorify the place for my feet.
chapters.zh: 利巴嫩的荣耀，就是松树，杉树，黄杨树，都必一同归你，为要修饰我圣所之地。我也要使我脚踏之处得荣耀。

chapters.en: The children of your oppressors will come bowing before you; all who despise you will bow down at your feet and will call you the City of the LORD, Zion of the Holy One of Israel.
chapters.zh: 素来苦待你的，他的子孙都必屈身来就你。藐视你的，都要在你脚下跪拜。他们要称你为耶和华的城，为以色列圣者的锡安。

chapters.en: “Although you have been forsaken and hated, with no one traveling through, I will make you the everlasting pride and the joy of all generations.
chapters.zh: 你虽然被撇弃被厌恶，甚至无人经过，我却使你变为永远的荣华，成为累代的喜乐。

chapters.en: You will drink the milk of nations and be nursed at royal breasts. Then you will know that I, the LORD, am your Savior, your Redeemer, the Mighty One of Jacob.
chapters.zh: 你也必吃万国的奶，又吃君王的奶。你便知道我耶和华是你的救主，是你的救赎主，雅各的大能者。

chapters.en: Instead of bronze I will bring you gold, and silver in place of iron. Instead of wood I will bring you bronze, and iron in place of stones. I will make peace your governor and well-being your ruler.
chapters.zh: 我要拿金子代替铜，拿银子代替铁，拿铜代替木头，拿铁代替石头。并要以和平为你的官长，以公义为你的监督。

chapters.en: No longer will violence be heard in your land, nor ruin or destruction within your borders, but you will call your walls Salvation and your gates Praise.
chapters.zh: 你地上不再听见强暴的事，境内不再听见荒凉毁灭的事。你必称你的墙为拯救，称你的门为赞美。

chapters.en: The sun will no more be your light by day, nor will the brightness of the moon shine on you, for the LORD will be your everlasting light, and your God will be your glory.
chapters.zh: 日头不再作你白昼的光，月亮也不再发光照耀你。耶和华却要作你永远的光，你神要为你的荣耀。

chapters.en: Your sun will never set again, and your moon will wane no more; the LORD will be your everlasting light, and your days of sorrow will end.
chapters.zh: 你的日头不再下落，你的月亮也不退缩。因为耶和华必作你永远的光，你悲哀的日子也完毕了。

chapters.en: Then all your people will be righteous and they will possess the land forever. They are the shoot I have planted, the work of my hands, for the display of my splendor.
chapters.zh: 你的居民都成为义人，永远得地为业，是我种的栽子，我手的工作，使我得荣耀。

chapters.en: The least of you will become a thousand, the smallest a mighty nation. I am the LORD; in its time I will do this swiftly.”
chapters.zh: 至小的族要加增千倍，微弱的国必成为强盛。我耶和华要按定期速成这事。

chapters.en: The Spirit of the Sovereign LORD is on me, because the LORD has anointed me to proclaim good news to the poor. He has sent me to bind up the brokenhearted, to proclaim freedom for the captives and release from darkness for the prisoners,
chapters.zh: 主耶和华的灵在我身上。因为耶和华用膏膏我，叫我传好信息给谦卑的人，（或作传福音给贫穷的人）差遣我医好伤心的人，报告被掳的得释放，被囚的出监牢。

chapters.en: to proclaim the year of the LORD’s favor and the day of vengeance of our God, to comfort all who mourn,
chapters.zh: 报告耶和华的恩年，和我们神报仇的日子。安慰一切悲哀的人。

chapters.en: and provide for those who grieve in Zion— to bestow on them a crown of beauty instead of ashes, the oil of joy instead of mourning, and a garment of praise instead of a spirit of despair. They will be called oaks of righteousness, a planting of the LORD for the display of his splendor.
chapters.zh: 赐华冠与锡安悲哀的人，代替灰尘，喜乐油，代替悲哀，赞美衣，代替忧伤之灵。使他们称为公义树，是耶和华所栽的，叫他得荣耀。

chapters.en: They will rebuild the ancient ruins and restore the places long devastated; they will renew the ruined cities that have been devastated for generations.
chapters.zh: 他们必修造已久的荒场，建立先前凄凉之处，重修历代荒凉之城。

chapters.en: Strangers will shepherd your flocks; foreigners will work your fields and vineyards.
chapters.zh: 那时，外人必起来牧放你们的羊群，外邦人必作你们耕种田地的，修理葡萄园的。

chapters.en: And you will be called priests of the LORD, you will be named ministers of our God. You will feed on the wealth of nations, and in their riches you will boast.
chapters.zh: 你们倒要称为耶和华的祭司。人必称你们为我们神的仆役。你们必吃用列国的财物，因得他们的荣耀自夸。

chapters.en: Instead of your shame you will receive a double portion, and instead of disgrace you will rejoice in your inheritance. And so you will inherit a double portion in your land, and everlasting joy will be yours.
chapters.zh: 你们必得加倍的好处，代替所受的羞辱。分中所得的喜乐，必代替所受的凌辱。在境内必得加倍的产业。永远之乐必归与你们。（原文作他们）

chapters.en: “For I, the LORD, love justice; I hate robbery and wrongdoing. In my faithfulness I will reward my people and make an everlasting covenant with them.
chapters.zh: 因为我耶和华喜爱公平，恨恶抢夺和罪孽。我要凭诚实施行报应，并要与我的百姓立永约。

chapters.en: Their descendants will be known among the nations and their offspring among the peoples. All who see them will acknowledge that they are a people the LORD has blessed.”
chapters.zh: 他们的后裔必在列国中被人认识，他们的子孙在众民中也是如此。凡看见他们的，必认他们是耶和华赐福的后裔。

chapters.en: I delight greatly in the LORD; my soul rejoices in my God. For he has clothed me with garments of salvation and arrayed me in a robe of his righteousness, as a bridegroom adorns his head like a priest, and as a bride adorns herself with her jewels.
chapters.zh: 我因耶和华大大欢喜，我的心靠神快乐。因他以拯救为衣给我穿上，以公义为袍给我披上，好像新郎戴上华冠，又像新妇佩戴妆饰。

chapters.en: For as the soil makes the sprout come up and a garden causes seeds to grow, so the Sovereign LORD will make righteousness and praise spring up before all nations.
chapters.zh: 田地怎样使百谷发芽，园子怎样使所种的发生，主耶和华必照样使公义和赞美在万民中发出。

chapters.en: For Zion’s sake I will not keep silent, for Jerusalem’s sake I will not remain quiet, till her vindication shines out like the dawn, her salvation like a blazing torch.
chapters.zh: 我因锡安必不静默，为耶路撒冷必不息声，直到他的公义如光辉发出，他的救恩如明灯发亮。

chapters.en: The nations will see your vindication, and all kings your glory; you will be called by a new name that the mouth of the LORD will bestow.
chapters.zh: 列国必见你的公义，列王必见你的荣耀。你必得新名的称呼，是耶和华亲口所起的。

chapters.en: You will be a crown of splendor in the LORD’s hand, a royal diadem in the hand of your God.
chapters.zh: 你在耶和华的手中要作为华冠，在你神的掌上必作为冕旒。

chapters.en: No longer will they call you Deserted, or name your land Desolate. But you will be called Hephzibah,and your land Beulah ; for the LORD will take delight in you, and your land will be married.
chapters.zh: 你必不再称为撇弃的，你的地也不再称为荒凉的，你却要称为我所喜悦的，你的地也必称为有夫之妇。因为耶和华喜悦你，你的地也必归他。

chapters.en: As a young man marries a young woman, so will your Builder marry you; as a bridegroom rejoices over his bride, so will your God rejoice over you.
chapters.zh: 少年人怎样娶处女，你的众民（民原文作子）也要照样娶你。新郎怎样喜悦新妇，你的神也要照样喜悦你。

chapters.en: I have posted watchmen on your walls, Jerusalem; they will never be silent day or night. You who call on the LORD, give yourselves no rest,
chapters.zh: 耶路撒冷阿，我在你城上设立守望的。他们昼夜必不静默。呼吁耶和华的，你们不要歇息，

chapters.en: and give him no rest till he establishes Jerusalem and makes her the praise of the earth.
chapters.zh: 也不要使他歇息，直等他建立耶路撒冷，使耶路撒冷在地上成为可赞美的。

chapters.en: The LORD has sworn by his right hand and by his mighty arm: “Never again will I give your grain as food for your enemies, and never again will foreigners drink the new wine for which you have toiled;
chapters.zh: 耶和华指着自己的右手和大能的膀臂起誓，说，我必不再将你的五谷给你仇敌作食物，外邦人也不再喝你劳碌得来的新酒。

chapters.en: but those who harvest it will eat it and praise the LORD, and those who gather the grapes will drink it in the courts of my sanctuary.”
chapters.zh: 惟有那收割的要吃，并赞美耶和华。那聚敛的要在我圣所的院内喝。

chapters.en: Pass through, pass through the gates! Prepare the way for the people. Build up, build up the highway! Remove the stones. Raise a banner for the nations.
chapters.zh: 你们当从门经过经过。预备百姓的路。修筑修筑大道。捡去石头。为万民竖立大旗。

chapters.en: The LORD has made proclamation to the ends of the earth: “Say to Daughter Zion, ‘See, your Savior comes! See, his reward is with him, and his recompense accompanies him.’ ”
chapters.zh: 看哪，耶和华曾宣告到地极，对锡安的居民（原文作女子）说，你的拯救者来到。他的赏赐在他那里，他的报应在他面前。

chapters.en: They will be called the Holy People, the Redeemed of the LORD; and you will be called Sought After, the City No Longer Deserted.
chapters.zh: 人必称他们为圣民，为耶和华的赎民。你也必称为被眷顾不撇弃的城。

chapters.en: Who is this coming from Edom, from Bozrah, with his garments stained crimson? Who is this, robed in splendor, striding forward in the greatness of his strength? “It is I, proclaiming victory, mighty to save.”
chapters.zh: 这从以东的波斯拉来，穿红衣服，装扮华美，能力广大，大步行走的是谁呢？就是我，是凭公义说话，以大能施行拯救。

chapters.en: Why are your garments red, like those of one treading the winepress?
chapters.zh: 你的装扮为何有红色，你的衣服为何像踹酒榨的呢？

chapters.en: “I have trodden the winepress alone; from the nations no one was with me. I trampled them in my anger and trod them down in my wrath; their blood spattered my garments, and I stained all my clothing.
chapters.zh: 我独自踹酒榨。众民中无一人与我同在。我发怒将他们踹下，发烈怒将他们践踏。他们的血溅在我衣服上，并且污染了我一切的衣裳。

chapters.en: It was for me the day of vengeance; the year for me to redeem had come.
chapters.zh: 因为报仇之日在我心中，救赎我民之年已经来到。

chapters.en: I looked, but there was no one to help, I was appalled that no one gave support; so my own arm achieved salvation for me, and my own wrath sustained me.
chapters.zh: 我仰望，见无人帮助。我诧异，没有人扶持。所以我自己的膀臂为我施行拯救。我的烈怒将我扶持。

chapters.en: I trampled the nations in my anger; in my wrath I made them drunk and poured their blood on the ground.”
chapters.zh: 我发怒，踹下众民，发烈怒，使他们沉醉，又将他们的血倒在地上。

chapters.en: I will tell of the kindnesses of the LORD, the deeds for which he is to be praised, according to all the LORD has done for us— yes, the many good things he has done for Israel, according to his compassion and many kindnesses.
chapters.zh: 我要照耶和华一切所赐给我们的，提起他的慈爱，和美德，并他向以色列家所施的大恩，这恩是照他的怜恤和丰盛的慈爱赐给他们的。

chapters.en: He said, “Surely they are my people, children who will be true to me”; and so he became their Savior.
chapters.zh: 他说，他们诚然是我的百姓，不行虚假的子民。这样，他就作了他们的救主。

chapters.en: In all their distress he too was distressed, and the angel of his presence saved them.In his love and mercy he redeemed them; he lifted them up and carried them all the days of old.
chapters.zh: 他们在一切苦难中，他也同受苦难。并且他面前的使者拯救他们。他以慈爱和怜悯救赎他们。在古时的日子，常保抱他们，怀搋他们。

chapters.en: Yet they rebelled and grieved his Holy Spirit. So he turned and became their enemy and he himself fought against them.
chapters.zh: 他们竟悖逆，使主的圣灵担忧。他就转作他们的仇敌，亲自攻击他们。

chapters.en: Then his people recalled the days of old, the days of Moses and his people— where is he who brought them through the sea, with the shepherd of his flock? Where is he who set his Holy Spirit among them,
chapters.zh: 那时，他们（原文作他）想起古时的日子摩西和他百姓，说，将百姓和牧养他全群的人从海里领上来的，在哪里呢？将他的圣灵降在他们中间的，在哪里呢？

chapters.en: who sent his glorious arm of power to be at Moses’ right hand, who divided the waters before them, to gain for himself everlasting renown,
chapters.zh: 使他荣耀的膀臂在摩西的右手边行动，在他们前面将水分开，要建立自己永远的名，

chapters.en: who led them through the depths? Like a horse in open country, they did not stumble;
chapters.zh: 带领他们经过深处，如马行走旷野，使他们不至绊跌的，在哪里呢？

chapters.en: like cattle that go down to the plain, they were given rest by the Spirit of the LORD. This is how you guided your people to make for yourself a glorious name.
chapters.zh: 耶和华的灵使他们得安息，仿佛牲畜下到山谷，照样，你也引导你的百姓，要建立自己荣耀的名。

chapters.en: Look down from heaven and see, from your lofty throne, holy and glorious. Where are your zeal and your might? Your tenderness and compassion are withheld from us.
chapters.zh: 求你从天上垂顾，从你圣洁荣耀的居所观看。你的热心和你大能的作为在哪里呢？你爱慕的心肠和怜悯向我们止住了。

chapters.en: But you are our Father, though Abraham does not know us or Israel acknowledge us; you, LORD, are our Father, our Redeemer from of old is your name.
chapters.zh: 亚伯拉罕虽然不认识我们，以色列也不承认我们，你却是我们的父。耶和华阿，你是我们的父。从万古以来，你名称为我们的救赎主。

chapters.en: Why, LORD, do you make us wander from your ways and harden our hearts so we do not revere you? Return for the sake of your servants, the tribes that are your inheritance.
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，你为何使我们走差离开你的道，使我们心里刚硬不敬畏你呢？求你为你仆人为你产业支派的缘故转回来。

chapters.en: For a little while your people possessed your holy place, but now our enemies have trampled down your sanctuary.
chapters.zh: 你的圣民不过暂时得这产业。我们的敌人已经践踏你的圣所。

chapters.en: We are yours from of old; but you have not ruled over them, they have not been called by your name.
chapters.zh: 我们好象你未曾治理的人，又像未曾得称你名下的人。

chapters.en: Oh, that you would rend the heavens and come down, that the mountains would tremble before you!
chapters.zh: 愿你裂天而降，愿山在你面前震动，

chapters.en: As when fire sets twigs ablaze and causes water to boil, come down to make your name known to your enemies and cause the nations to quake before you!
chapters.zh: 好像火烧干柴，又像火将水烧开。使你敌人知道你的名，使列国在你面前发颤。

chapters.en: For when you did awesome things that we did not expect, you came down, and the mountains trembled before you.
chapters.zh: 你曾行我们不能逆料可畏的事。那时你降临，山岭在你面前震动。

chapters.en: Since ancient times no one has heard, no ear has perceived, no eye has seen any God besides you, who acts on behalf of those who wait for him.
chapters.zh: 从古以来人未曾听见，未曾耳闻，未曾眼见，在你以外有什么神为等候他的人行事。

chapters.en: You come to the help of those who gladly do right, who remember your ways. But when we continued to sin against them, you were angry. How then can we be saved?
chapters.zh: 你迎接那欢喜行义记念你道的人，你曾发怒，我们仍犯罪。这景况已久。我们还能得救吗？

chapters.en: All of us have become like one who is unclean, and all our righteous acts are like filthy rags; we all shrivel up like a leaf, and like the wind our sins sweep us away.
chapters.zh: 我们都像不洁净的人，所有的义都像污秽的衣服。我们都像叶子渐渐枯干。我们的罪孽好像风把我们吹去。

chapters.en: No one calls on your name or strives to lay hold of you; for you have hidden your face from us and have given us over to our sins.
chapters.zh: 并且无人求告你的名，无人奋力抓住你。原来你掩面不顾我们，使我们因罪孽消化。

chapters.en: Yet you, LORD, are our Father. We are the clay, you are the potter; we are all the work of your hand.
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，现在你仍是我们的父。我们是泥，你是窑匠。我们都是你手的工作。

chapters.en: Do not be angry beyond measure, LORD; do not remember our sins forever. Oh, look on us, we pray, for we are all your people.
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，求你不要大发震怒，也不要永远记念罪孽。求你垂顾我们，我们都是你的百姓。

chapters.en: Your sacred cities have become a wasteland; even Zion is a wasteland, Jerusalem a desolation.
chapters.zh: 你的圣邑变为旷野，锡安变为旷野，耶路撒冷成为荒场。

chapters.en: Our holy and glorious temple, where our ancestors praised you, has been burned with fire, and all that we treasured lies in ruins.
chapters.zh: 我们圣洁华美的殿，就是我们列祖赞美你的所在，被火焚烧。我们所羡慕的美地，尽都荒废。

chapters.en: After all this, LORD, will you hold yourself back? Will you keep silent and punish us beyond measure?
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，有这些事，你还忍得住吗？你仍静默使我们深受苦难吗？

chapters.en: “I revealed myself to those who did not ask for me; I was found by those who did not seek me. To a nation that did not call on my name, I said, ‘Here am I, here am I.’
chapters.zh: 素来没有访问我的，现在求问我。没有寻找我的，我叫他们遇见。没有称为我名下的，我对他们说，我在这里，我在这里。

chapters.en: All day long I have held out my hands to an obstinate people, who walk in ways not good, pursuing their own imaginations—
chapters.zh: 我整天伸手招呼那悖逆的百姓，他们随自己的意念行不善之道。

chapters.en: a people who continually provoke me to my very face, offering sacrifices in gardens and burning incense on altars of brick;
chapters.zh: 这百姓时常当面惹我发怒，在园中献祭，在坛（原文作砖）上烧香。

chapters.en: who sit among the graves and spend their nights keeping secret vigil; who eat the flesh of pigs, and whose pots hold broth of impure meat;
chapters.zh: 在坟墓间坐着，在隐密处住宿，吃猪肉，他们器皿中有可憎之物作的汤。

chapters.en: who say, ‘Keep away; don’t come near me, for I am too sacred for you!’ Such people are smoke in my nostrils, a fire that keeps burning all day.
chapters.zh: 且对人说，你站开吧，不要挨近我，因为我比你圣洁。主说，这些人是我鼻中的烟，是整天烧着的火。

chapters.en: “See, it stands written before me: I will not keep silent but will pay back in full; I will pay it back into their laps—
chapters.zh: 看哪，这都写在我面前，我必不静默，必施行报应，必将你们的罪孽，和你们列祖的罪孽，就是在山上烧香，在冈上亵渎我的罪孽，一同报应在他们后人怀中。我先要把他们所行的量给他们。这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: both your sins and the sins of your ancestors,” says the LORD. “Because they burned sacrifices on the mountains and defied me on the hills, I will measure into their laps the full payment for their former deeds.”

This is what the LORD says: “As when juice is still found in a cluster of grapes and people say, ‘Don’t destroy it, there is still a blessing in it,’ so will I do in behalf of my servants; I will not destroy them all.
chapters.zh: 耶和华如此说，葡萄中寻得新酒，人就说，不要毁坏，因为福在其中。我因我仆人的缘故也必照样而行，不将他们全然毁灭。

chapters.en: I will bring forth descendants from Jacob, and from Judah those who will possess my mountains; my chosen people will inherit them, and there will my servants live.
chapters.zh: 我必从雅各中领出后裔，从犹大中领出承受我众山的。我的选民必承受，我的仆人要在那里居住。

chapters.en: Sharon will become a pasture for flocks, and the Valley of Achor a resting place for herds, for my people who seek me.
chapters.zh: 沙仑平原必成为羊群的圈，亚割谷必成为牛群躺卧之处。都为寻求我的民所得。

chapters.en: “But as for you who forsake the LORD and forget my holy mountain, who spread a table for Fortune and fill bowls of mixed wine for Destiny,
