chapters.zh: 但你们这些离弃耶和华，忘记我的圣山，给时运摆筵席，（原文作桌子）给天命盛满调和酒的。

chapters.en: I will destine you for the sword, and all of you will fall in the slaughter; for I called but you did not answer, I spoke but you did not listen. You did evil in my sight and chose what displeases me.”
chapters.zh: 我要命定你们归在刀下，都必屈身被杀，因为我呼唤，你们没有答应。我说话，你们没有听从。反倒行我眼中看为恶的，拣选我所不喜悦的。

chapters.en: Therefore this is what the Sovereign LORD says: “My servants will eat, but you will go hungry; my servants will drink, but you will go thirsty; my servants will rejoice, but you will be put to shame.
chapters.zh: 所以主耶和华如此说，我的仆人必得吃，你们却饥饿。我的仆人必得喝，你们却干渴。我的仆人必欢喜，你们却蒙羞。

chapters.en: My servants will sing out of the joy of their hearts, but you will cry out from anguish of heart and wail in brokenness of spirit.
chapters.zh: 我的仆人因心中高兴欢呼，你们却因心中忧愁哀哭，又因心里忧伤哀号。

chapters.en: You will leave your name for my chosen ones to use in their curses; the Sovereign LORD will put you to death, but to his servants he will give another name.
chapters.zh: 你们必留下自己的名，为我选民指着赌咒。主耶和华必杀你们，另起别名称呼他的仆人。

chapters.en: Whoever invokes a blessing in the land will do so by the one true God; whoever takes an oath in the land will swear by the one true God. For the past troubles will be forgotten and hidden from my eyes.
chapters.zh: 这样，在地上为自己求福的，必凭真实的神求福。在地上起誓的，必指真实的神起誓。因为从前的患难已经忘记，也从我眼前隐藏了。

chapters.en: “See, I will create new heavens and a new earth. The former things will not be remembered, nor will they come to mind.
chapters.zh: 看哪，我造新天新地，从前的事不再被记念，也不再追想。

chapters.en: But be glad and rejoice forever in what I will create, for I will create Jerusalem to be a delight and its people a joy.
chapters.zh: 你们当因我所造的永远欢喜快乐。因我造耶路撒冷为人所喜，造其中的居民为人所乐。

chapters.en: I will rejoice over Jerusalem and take delight in my people; the sound of weeping and of crying will be heard in it no more.
chapters.zh: 我必因耶路撒冷欢喜，因我的百姓快乐。其中必不再听见哭泣的声音，和哀号的声音。

chapters.en: “Never again will there be in it an infant who lives but a few days, or an old man who does not live out his years; the one who dies at a hundred will be thought a mere child; the one who fails to reach a hundred will be considered accursed.
chapters.zh: 其中必没有数日夭亡的婴孩，也没有寿数不满的老者。因为百岁死的仍算孩童，有百岁死的罪人算被咒诅。

chapters.en: They will build houses and dwell in them; they will plant vineyards and eat their fruit.
chapters.zh: 他们要建造房屋，自己居住。栽种葡萄园，吃其中的果子。

chapters.en: No longer will they build houses and others live in them, or plant and others eat. For as the days of a tree, so will be the days of my people; my chosen ones will long enjoy the work of their hands.
chapters.zh: 他们建造的，别人不得住。他们栽种的，别人不得吃。因为我民的日子必像树木的日子。我选民亲手劳碌得来的必长久享用。

chapters.en: They will not labor in vain, nor will they bear children doomed to misfortune; for they will be a people blessed by the LORD, they and their descendants with them.
chapters.zh: 他们必不徒然劳碌，所生产的，也不遭灾害。因为都是蒙耶和华赐福的后裔，他们的子孙也是如此。

chapters.en: Before they call I will answer; while they are still speaking I will hear.
chapters.zh: 他们尚未求告，我就应允。正说话的时候，我就垂听。

chapters.en: The wolf and the lamb will feed together, and the lion will eat straw like the ox, and dust will be the serpent’s food. They will neither harm nor destroy on all my holy mountain,” says the LORD.
chapters.zh: 豺狼必与羊羔同食，狮子必吃草与牛一样。尘土必作蛇的食物。在我圣山的遍处，这一切都不伤人不害物，这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: This is what the LORD says: “Heaven is my throne, and the earth is my footstool. Where is the house you will build for me? Where will my resting place be?
chapters.zh: 耶和华如此说，天是我的座位，地是我的脚凳。你们要为我造何等的殿宇，哪里是我安息的地方呢？

chapters.en: Has not my hand made all these things, and so they came into being?” declares the LORD. “These are the ones I look on with favor: those who are humble and contrite in spirit, and who tremble at my word.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说，这一切都是我手所造的，所以就都有了。但我所看顾的就是虚心痛悔因我话而战兢的人。（虚心原文作贫穷）

chapters.en: But whoever sacrifices a bull is like one who kills a person, and whoever offers a lamb is like one who breaks a dog’s neck; whoever makes a grain offering is like one who presents pig’s blood, and whoever burns memorial incense is like one who worships an idol. They have chosen their own ways, and they delight in their abominations;
chapters.zh: 假冒为善的宰牛好像杀人。献羊羔好像打折狗项。献供物好像献猪血。烧乳香好像称颂偶像。这等人拣选自己的道路，心里喜悦行可憎恶的事。

chapters.en: so I also will choose harsh treatment for them and will bring on them what they dread. For when I called, no one answered, when I spoke, no one listened. They did evil in my sight and chose what displeases me.”
chapters.zh: 我也必拣选迷惑他们的事，使他们所惧怕的临到他们。因为我呼唤，无人答应。我说话，他们不听从。反倒行我眼中看为恶的，拣选我所不喜悦的。

chapters.en: Hear the word of the LORD, you who tremble at his word: “Your own people who hate you, and exclude you because of my name, have said, ‘Let the LORD be glorified, that we may see your joy!’ Yet they will be put to shame.
chapters.zh: 你们因耶和华言语战兢的人，当听他的话。你们的弟兄，就是恨恶你们，因我名赶出你们的，曾说，愿耶和华得荣耀，使我们得见你们的喜乐。但蒙羞的究竟是他们。

chapters.en: Hear that uproar from the city, hear that noise from the temple! It is the sound of the LORD repaying his enemies all they deserve.
chapters.zh: 有喧哗的声音出自城中，有声音出于殿中，是耶和华向仇敌施行报应的声音。

chapters.en: “Before she goes into labor, she gives birth; before the pains come upon her, she delivers a son.
chapters.zh: 锡安未曾劬劳，就生产。未觉疼痛，就生出男孩。

chapters.en: Who has ever heard of such things? Who has ever seen things like this? Can a country be born in a day or a nation be brought forth in a moment? Yet no sooner is Zion in labor than she gives birth to her children.
chapters.zh: 国岂能一日而生？民岂能一时而产？因为锡安一劬劳，便生下儿女，这样的事，谁曾听见？谁曾看见呢？

chapters.en: Do I bring to the moment of birth and not give delivery?” says the LORD. “Do I close up the womb when I bring to delivery?” says your God.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说，我既使她临产，岂不使她生产呢？你的神说，我既使她生产，岂能使她闭胎不生呢？

chapters.en: “Rejoice with Jerusalem and be glad for her, all you who love her; rejoice greatly with her, all you who mourn over her.
chapters.zh: 你们爱慕耶路撒冷的，都要与她一同欢喜快乐。你们为她悲哀的，都要与她一同乐上加乐。

chapters.en: For you will nurse and be satisfied at her comforting breasts; you will drink deeply and delight in her overflowing abundance.”
chapters.zh: 使你们在她安慰的怀中吃奶得饱。使他们得她丰盛的荣耀，犹如挤奶，满心喜乐。

chapters.en: For this is what the LORD says: “I will extend peace to her like a river, and the wealth of nations like a flooding stream; you will nurse and be carried on her arm and dandled on her knees.
chapters.zh: 耶和华如此说，我要使平安延及她，好像江河，使列国的荣耀延及她，如同涨溢的河，你们要从中享受。（原文作咂）你们必蒙抱在肋旁，摇弄在膝上。

chapters.en: As a mother comforts her child, so will I comfort you; and you will be comforted over Jerusalem.”
chapters.zh: 母亲怎样安慰儿子，我就照样安慰你们。你们也必因（或作在）耶路撒冷得安慰。

chapters.en: When you see this, your heart will rejoice and you will flourish like grass; the hand of the LORD will be made known to his servants, but his fury will be shown to his foes.
chapters.zh: 你们看见，就心中快乐，你们的骨头必得滋润，像嫩草一样。而且耶和华的手向他仆人所行的，必被人知道。他也要向仇敌发恼恨。

chapters.en: See, the LORD is coming with fire, and his chariots are like a whirlwind; he will bring down his anger with fury, and his rebuke with flames of fire.
chapters.zh: 看哪，耶和华必在火中降临，他的车辇像旋风，以烈怒施行报应，以火焰施行责罚。

chapters.en: For with fire and with his sword the LORD will execute judgment on all people, and many will be those slain by the LORD.
chapters.zh: 因为耶和华在一切有血气的人身上，必以火与刀施行审判。被耶和华所杀的必多。

chapters.en: “Those who consecrate and purify themselves to go into the gardens, following one who is among those who eat the flesh of pigs, rats and other unclean things—they will meet their end together with the one they follow,” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 那些分别为圣，洁净自己的，进入园内跟在其中一个人的后头，吃猪肉和仓鼠并可憎之物，他们必一同灭绝。这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: “And I, because of what they have planned and done, am about to come and gather the people of all nations and languages, and they will come and see my glory.
chapters.zh: 我知道他们的行为和他们的意念。时候将到，我必将万民万族（族原文作舌）聚来。看见我的荣耀。

chapters.en: “I will set a sign among them, and I will send some of those who survive to the nations—to Tarshish, to the Libyans and Lydians (famous as archers), to Tubal and Greece, and to the distant islands that have not heard of my fame or seen my glory. They will proclaim my glory among the nations.
chapters.zh: 我要显神迹（或作记号）在他们中间，逃脱的我要差到列国去，就是到他施，普勒，拉弓的路德，和土巴，雅完，并素来没有听见我名声，没有看见我荣耀辽远的海岛。他们必将我的荣耀传扬在列国中。

chapters.en: And they will bring all your people, from all the nations, to my holy mountain in Jerusalem as an offering to the LORD—on horses, in chariots and wagons, and on mules and camels,” says the LORD. “They will bring them, as the Israelites bring their grain offerings, to the temple of the LORD in ceremonially clean vessels.
chapters.zh: 他们必将你们的弟兄从列国中送回，使他们或骑马，或坐车，坐轿，骑骡子，骑独峰驼，到我的圣山耶路撒冷，作为供物献给耶和华，好像以色列人用洁净的器皿盛供物奉到耶和华的殿中；这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: And I will select some of them also to be priests and Levites,” says the LORD.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说，我也必从他们中间取人为祭司，为利未人。

chapters.en: “As the new heavens and the new earth that I make will endure before me,” declares the LORD, “so will your name and descendants endure.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说，我所要造的新天新地，怎样在我面前长存，你们的后裔和你们的名字，也必照样长存。

chapters.en: From one New Moon to another and from one Sabbath to another, all mankind will come and bow down before me,” says the LORD.
chapters.zh: 每逢月朔，安息日，凡有血气的必来在我面前下拜。这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: “And they will go out and look on the dead bodies of those who rebelled against me; the worms that eat them will not die, the fire that burns them will not be quenched, and they will be loathsome to all mankind.”
chapters.zh: 他们必出去观看那些违背我人的尸首。因为他们的虫是不死的，他们的火是不灭的。凡有血气的，都必憎恶他们。

chapters.en: The words of Jeremiah son of Hilkiah, one of the priests at Anathoth in the territory of Benjamin.
chapters.zh: 便雅悯地亚拿突城的祭司中，希勒家的儿子耶利米的话记在下面。

chapters.en: The word of the LORD came to him in the thirteenth year of the reign of Josiah son of Amon king of Judah,
chapters.zh: 犹大王亚们的儿子约西亚在位十三年，耶和华的话临到耶利米。

chapters.en: and through the reign of Jehoiakim son of Josiah king of Judah, down to the fifth month of the eleventh year of Zedekiah son of Josiah king of Judah, when the people of Jerusalem went into exile.
chapters.zh: 从犹大王约西亚的儿子约雅敬在位的时候，直到犹大王约西亚的儿子西底家在位的末年，就是十一年五月间耶路撒冷人被掳的时候，耶和华的话也常临到耶利米。

chapters.en: The word of the LORD came to me, saying,
chapters.zh: 耶利米说，耶和华的话临到我说，

chapters.en: “Before I formed you in the womb I knew you, before you were born I set you apart; I appointed you as a prophet to the nations.”
chapters.zh: 我未将你造在腹中，我已晓得你。你未出母胎，我已分别你为圣。我已派你作列国的先知。

chapters.en: “Alas, Sovereign LORD,” I said, “I do not know how to speak; I am too young.”
chapters.zh: 我就说，主耶和华阿，我不知怎样说，因为我是年幼的。

chapters.en: But the LORD said to me, “Do not say, ‘I am too young.’ You must go to everyone I send you to and say whatever I command you.
chapters.zh: 耶和华对我说，你不要说我是年幼的，因为我差遣你到谁那里去，你都要去。我吩咐你说什么话，你都要说。

chapters.en: Do not be afraid of them, for I am with you and will rescue you,” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 你不要惧怕他们，因为我与你同在，要拯救你。这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: Then the LORD reached out his hand and touched my mouth and said to me, “I have put my words in your mouth.
chapters.zh: 于是耶和华伸手按我的口，对我说，我已将当说的话传给你。

chapters.en: See, today I appoint you over nations and kingdoms to uproot and tear down, to destroy and overthrow, to build and to plant.”
chapters.zh: 看哪，我今日立你在列邦列国之上，为要施行拔出，拆毁，毁坏，倾覆，又要建立，栽植。

chapters.en: The word of the LORD came to me: “What do you see, Jeremiah?” “I see the branch of an almond tree,” I replied.
chapters.zh: 耶和华的话又临到我说，耶利米，你看见什么。我说，我看见一根杏树枝。

chapters.en: The LORD said to me, “You have seen correctly, for I am watching to see that my word is fulfilled.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华对我说，你看得不错。因为我留意保守我的话，使得成就。

chapters.en: The word of the LORD came to me again: “What do you see?” “I see a pot that is boiling,” I answered. “It is tilting toward us from the north.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华的话第二次临到我说，你看见什么。我说，我看见一个烧开的锅，从北而倾。

chapters.en: The LORD said to me, “From the north disaster will be poured out on all who live in the land.
chapters.zh: 耶和华对我说，必有灾祸从北方发出，临到这地的一切居民。

chapters.en: I am about to summon all the peoples of the northern kingdoms,” declares the LORD. “Their kings will come and set up their thrones in the entrance of the gates of Jerusalem; they will come against all her surrounding walls and against all the towns of Judah.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说，看哪，我要召北方列国的众族。他们要来，各安座位在耶路撒冷的城门口，周围攻击城墙，又要攻击犹大的一切城邑。

chapters.en: I will pronounce my judgments on my people because of their wickedness in forsaking me, in burning incense to other gods and in worshiping what their hands have made.
chapters.zh: 至于这民的一切恶，就是离弃我，向别神烧香，跪拜自己手所造的，我要发出我的判语，攻击他们。

chapters.en: “Get yourself ready! Stand up and say to them whatever I command you. Do not be terrified by them, or I will terrify you before them.
chapters.zh: 所以你当束腰，起来将我所吩咐你的一切话告诉他们。不要因他们惊惶，免得我使你在他们面前惊惶。

chapters.en: Today I have made you a fortified city, an iron pillar and a bronze wall to stand against the whole land—against the kings of Judah, its officials, its priests and the people of the land.
chapters.zh: 看哪，我今日使你成为坚城，铁柱，铜墙，与全地和犹大的君王，首领，祭司，并地上的众民反对。

chapters.en: They will fight against you but will not overcome you, for I am with you and will rescue you,” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 他们要攻击你，却不能胜你。因为我与你同在，要拯救你。这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: The word of the LORD came to me:
chapters.zh: 耶和华的话临到我说，

chapters.en: “Go and proclaim in the hearing of Jerusalem: “This is what the LORD says: “ ‘I remember the devotion of your youth, how as a bride you loved me and followed me through the wilderness, through a land not sown.
chapters.zh: 你去向耶路撒冷人的耳中喊叫说，耶和华如此说，你幼年的恩爱，婚姻的爱情，你怎样在旷野，在未曾耕种之地跟随我，我都记得。

chapters.en: Israel was holy to the LORD, the firstfruits of his harvest; all who devoured her were held guilty, and disaster overtook them,’ ” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 那时以色列归耶和华为圣，作为土产初熟的果子。凡吞吃它的必算为有罪，灾祸必临到他们。这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: Hear the word of the LORD, you descendants of Jacob, all you clans of Israel.
chapters.zh: 雅各家，以色列家的各族阿，你们当听耶和华的话。

chapters.en: This is what the LORD says: “What fault did your ancestors find in me, that they strayed so far from me? They followed worthless idols and became worthless themselves.
chapters.zh: 耶和华如此说，你们的列祖见我有什么不义，竟远离我，随从虚无的神，自己成为虚妄的呢？

chapters.en: They did not ask, ‘Where is the LORD, who brought us up out of Egypt and led us through the barren wilderness, through a land of deserts and ravines, a land of drought and utter darkness, a land where no one travels and no one lives?’
chapters.zh: 他们也不说，那领我们从埃及地上来，引导我们经过旷野，沙漠有深坑之地，和干旱死荫，无人经过，无人居住之地的耶和华在哪里呢？

chapters.en: I brought you into a fertile land to eat its fruit and rich produce. But you came and defiled my land and made my inheritance detestable.
chapters.zh: 我领你们进入肥美之地，使你们得吃其中的果子和美物。但你们进入的时候就玷污我的地，使我的产业成为可憎的。

chapters.en: The priests did not ask, ‘Where is the LORD?’ Those who deal with the law did not know me; the leaders rebelled against me. The prophets prophesied by Baal, following worthless idols.
chapters.zh: 祭司都不说，耶和华在哪里呢？传讲律法的都不认识我。官长违背我。先知借巴力说预言，随从无益的神。

chapters.en: “Therefore I bring charges against you again,” declares the LORD. “And I will bring charges against your children’s children.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说，我因此必与你们争辩，也必与你们的子孙争辩。

chapters.en: Cross over to the coasts of Cyprus and look, send to Kedar  and observe closely; see if there has ever been anything like this:
chapters.zh: 你们且过到基提海岛去察看，打发人往基达去留心查考，看曾有这样的事没有。

chapters.en: Has a nation ever changed its gods? (Yet they are not gods at all.) But my people have exchanged their glorious God for worthless idols.
chapters.zh: 岂有一国换了他的神吗？其实这不是神。但我的百姓将他们的荣耀换了那无益的神。

chapters.en: Be appalled at this, you heavens, and shudder with great horror,” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 诸天哪，要因此惊奇，极其恐慌，甚为凄凉。这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: “My people have committed two sins: They have forsaken me, the spring of living water, and have dug their own cisterns, broken cisterns that cannot hold water.
chapters.zh: 因为我的百姓作了两件恶事，就是离弃我这活水的泉源，为自己凿出池子，是破裂不能存水的池子。

chapters.en: Is Israel a servant, a slave by birth? Why then has he become plunder?
chapters.zh: 以色列是仆人吗？是家中生的奴仆吗？为何成为掠物呢？

chapters.en: Lions have roared; they have growled at him. They have laid waste his land; his towns are burned and deserted.
chapters.zh: 少壮狮子向他咆哮，大声吼叫，使他的地荒凉。城邑也都焚烧，无人居住。

chapters.en: Also, the men of Memphis and Tahpanhes have cracked your skull.
chapters.zh: 挪弗人和答比匿人也打破你的头顶。

chapters.en: Have you not brought this on yourselves by forsaking the LORD your God when he led you in the way?
chapters.zh: 这事临到你身上，不是你自招的吗？不是因耶和华你神引你行路的时候，你离弃他吗？

chapters.en: Now why go to Egypt to drink water from the Nile  ? And why go to Assyria to drink water from the Euphrates?
chapters.zh: 现今你为何在埃及路上要喝西曷的水呢？你为何在亚述路上要喝大河的水呢？

chapters.en: Your wickedness will punish you; your backsliding will rebuke you. Consider then and realize how evil and bitter it is for you when you forsake the LORD your God and have no awe of me,” declares the Lord, the LORD Almighty.
chapters.zh: 你自己的恶必惩治你。你背道的事必责备你。由此可知可见，你离弃耶和华你的神，不存敬畏我的心，乃为恶事，为苦事。这是主万军之耶和华说的。

chapters.en: “Long ago you broke off your yoke and tore off your bonds; you said, ‘I will not serve you!’ Indeed, on every high hill and under every spreading tree you lay down as a prostitute.
chapters.zh: 我在古时折断你的轭，解开你的绳索。你说，我必不事奉耶和华。因为你在各高冈上，各青翠树下屈身行淫。（或作我在古时折断你的轭，解开你的绳索，你就说，我必不事奉别神。谁知你在各高冈上，各青翠树下，仍屈身行淫。）

chapters.en: I had planted you like a choice vine of sound and reliable stock. How then did you turn against me into a corrupt, wild vine?
chapters.zh: 然而，我栽你是上等的葡萄树，全然是真种子。你怎么向我变为外邦葡萄树的坏枝子呢？

chapters.en: Although you wash yourself with soap and use an abundance of cleansing powder, the stain of your guilt is still before me,” declares the Sovereign LORD.
chapters.zh: 你虽用碱，多用肥皂洗濯，你罪孽的痕迹仍然在我面前显出。这是主耶和华说的。

chapters.en: “How can you say, ‘I am not defiled; I have not run after the Baals’? See how you behaved in the valley; consider what you have done. You are a swift she-camel running here and there,
chapters.zh: 你怎能说，我没有玷污，没有随从众巴力。你看你谷中的路，就知道你所行的如何。你是快行的独峰驼，狂奔乱走。

chapters.en: a wild donkey accustomed to the desert, sniffing the wind in her craving— in her heat who can restrain her? Any males that pursue her need not tire themselves; at mating time they will find her.
chapters.zh: 你是野驴，惯在旷野，欲心发动就吸风。起性的时候谁能使它转去呢？凡寻找它的必不至疲乏。在它的月分必能寻见。

chapters.en: Do not run until your feet are bare and your throat is dry. But you said, ‘It’s no use! I love foreign gods, and I must go after them.’
chapters.zh: 我说，你不要使脚上无鞋，喉咙干渴。你倒说，这是枉然。我喜爱别神，我必随从他们。

chapters.en: “As a thief is disgraced when he is caught, so the people of Israel are disgraced— they, their kings and their officials, their priests and their prophets.
chapters.zh: 贼被捉拿，怎样羞愧，以色列家和他们的君王，首领，祭司，先知也都照样羞愧。

chapters.en: They say to wood, ‘You are my father,’ and to stone, ‘You gave me birth.’ They have turned their backs to me and not their faces; yet when they are in trouble, they say, ‘Come and save us!’
chapters.zh: 他们向木头说，你是我的父。向石头说，你是生我的。他们以背向我，不以面向我。及至遭遇患难的时候却说，起来拯救我们。

chapters.en: Where then are the gods you made for yourselves? Let them come if they can save you when you are in trouble! For you, Judah, have as many gods as you have towns.
chapters.zh: 你为自己作的神在哪里呢？你遭遇患难的时候，叫他们起来拯救你吧。犹大阿，你神的数目与你城的数目相等。

chapters.en: “Why do you bring charges against me? You have all rebelled against me,” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说，你们为何与我争辩呢？你们都违背了我。

chapters.en: “In vain I punished your people; they did not respond to correction. Your sword has devoured your prophets like a ravenous lion.
chapters.zh: 我责打你们的儿女是徒然的，他们不受惩治。你们自己的刀吞灭你们的先知，好像残害的狮子。

chapters.en: “You of this generation, consider the word of the LORD: “Have I been a desert to Israel or a land of great darkness? Why do my people say, ‘We are free to roam; we will come to you no more’?
chapters.zh: 这世代的人哪，你们要看明耶和华的话。我岂向以色列作旷野呢？或作幽暗之地呢？我的百姓为何说，我们脱离约束，再不归向你了。

chapters.en: Does a young woman forget her jewelry, a bride her wedding ornaments? Yet my people have forgotten me, days without number.
chapters.zh: 处女岂能忘记她的妆饰呢？新妇岂能忘记她的美衣呢？我的百姓却忘记了我无数的日子。

chapters.en: How skilled you are at pursuing love! Even the worst of women can learn from your ways.
chapters.zh: 你怎么修饰你的道路要求爱情呢？就是恶劣的妇人你也叫她们行你的路。

chapters.en: On your clothes is found the lifeblood of the innocent poor, though you did not catch them breaking in. Yet in spite of all this
chapters.zh: 并且你的衣襟上有无辜穷人的血。你杀他们并不是遇见他们挖窟窿，乃是因这一切的事。

chapters.en: you say, ‘I am innocent; he is not angry with me.’ But I will pass judgment on you because you say, ‘I have not sinned.’
chapters.zh: 你还说，我无辜。耶和华的怒气必定向我消了。看哪，我必审问你。因你自说，我没有犯罪。

chapters.en: Why do you go about so much, changing your ways? You will be disappointed by Egypt as you were by Assyria.
chapters.zh: 你为何东跑西奔要更换你的路呢？你必因埃及蒙羞，像从前因亚述蒙羞一样。

chapters.en: You will also leave that place with your hands on your head, for the LORD has rejected those you trust; you will not be helped by them.
chapters.zh: 你也必两手抱头从埃及出来。因为耶和华已经弃绝你所倚靠的，你必不因他们得顺利。

chapters.en: “If a man divorces his wife and she leaves him and marries another man, should he return to her again? Would not the land be completely defiled? But you have lived as a prostitute with many lovers— would you now return to me?” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 有话说，人若休妻，妻离他而去，作了别人的妻，前夫岂能再收回她来？若收回她来，那地岂不是大大玷污了吗？但你和许多亲爱的行邪淫，还可以归向我。这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: “Look up to the barren heights and see. Is there any place where you have not been ravished? By the roadside you sat waiting for lovers, sat like a nomad in the desert. You have defiled the land with your prostitution and wickedness.
chapters.zh: 你向净光的高处举目观看，你在何处没有淫行呢？你坐在道旁等候，好像亚拉伯人在旷野埋伏一样，并且你的淫行邪恶玷污了全地。

chapters.en: Therefore the showers have been withheld, and no spring rains have fallen. Yet you have the brazen look of a prostitute; you refuse to blush with shame.
chapters.zh: 因此甘霖停止，春（原文作晚）雨不降。你还是有娼妓之脸，不顾羞耻。

chapters.en: Have you not just called to me: ‘My Father, my friend from my youth,
chapters.zh: 从今以后，你岂不向我呼叫说，我父阿，你是我幼年的恩主。

chapters.en: will you always be angry? Will your wrath continue forever?’ This is how you talk, but you do all the evil you can.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华岂永远怀怒，存留到底吗？看哪，你又发恶言又行坏事，随自己的私意而行（或作你虽这样说还是行恶放纵欲心）。

chapters.en: During the reign of King Josiah, the LORD said to me, “Have you seen what faithless Israel has done? She has gone up on every high hill and under every spreading tree and has committed adultery there.
chapters.zh: 约西亚王在位的时候，耶和华又对我说，背道的以色列所行的，你看见没有。她上各高山，在各青翠树下行淫。

chapters.en: I thought that after she had done all this she would return to me but she did not, and her unfaithful sister Judah saw it.
chapters.zh: 她行这些事以后，我说她必归向我，她却不归向我。她奸诈的妹妹犹大也看见了。

chapters.en: I gave faithless Israel her certificate of divorce and sent her away because of all her adulteries. Yet I saw that her unfaithful sister Judah had no fear; she also went out and committed adultery.
chapters.zh: 背道的以色列行淫，我为这缘故给她休书休她。我看见她奸诈的妹妹犹大，还不惧怕，也去行淫。

chapters.en: Because Israel’s immorality mattered so little to her, she defiled the land and committed adultery with stone and wood.
chapters.zh: 因以色列轻忽了她的淫乱，和石头木头行淫，地就被玷污了。

chapters.en: In spite of all this, her unfaithful sister Judah did not return to me with all her heart, but only in pretense,” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 虽有这一切的事，她奸诈的妹妹犹大还不一心归向我，不过是假意归我。这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: The LORD said to me, “Faithless Israel is more righteous than unfaithful Judah.
chapters.zh: 耶和华对我说，背道的以色列比奸诈的犹大还显为义。

chapters.en: Go, proclaim this message toward the north: “ ‘Return, faithless Israel,’ declares the LORD, ‘I will frown on you no longer, for I am faithful,’ declares the LORD, ‘I will not be angry forever.
chapters.zh: 你去向北方宣告说，耶和华说，背道的以色列阿，回来吧。我必不怒目看你们。因为我是慈爱的，我必不永远存怒。这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: Only acknowledge your guilt— you have rebelled against the LORD your God, you have scattered your favors to foreign gods under every spreading tree, and have not obeyed me,’ ” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 只要承认你的罪孽，就是你违背耶和华你的神，在各青翠树下向别神东奔西跑，没有听从我的话。这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: “Return, faithless people,” declares the LORD, “for I am your husband. I will choose you—one from a town and two from a clan—and bring you to Zion.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说，背道的儿女阿，回来吧。因为我作你们的丈夫，并且我必将你们从一城取一人，从一族取两人，带到锡安。

chapters.en: Then I will give you shepherds after my own heart, who will lead you with knowledge and understanding.
chapters.zh: 我也必将合我心的牧者赐给你们。他们必以知识和智慧牧养你们。

chapters.en: In those days, when your numbers have increased greatly in the land,” declares the LORD, “people will no longer say, ‘The ark of the covenant of the LORD.’ It will never enter their minds or be remembered; it will not be missed, nor will another one be made.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说，你们在国中生养众多。当那些日子，人必不再提说耶和华的约柜，不追想，不记念，不觉缺少，也不再制造。

chapters.en: At that time they will call Jerusalem The Throne of the LORD, and all nations will gather in Jerusalem to honor the name of the LORD. No longer will they follow the stubbornness of their evil hearts.
chapters.zh: 那时，人必称耶路撒冷为耶和华的宝座。万国必到耶路撒冷，在耶和华立名的地方聚集。他们必不再随从自己顽梗的恶心行事。

chapters.en: In those days the people of Judah will join the people of Israel, and together they will come from a northern land to the land I gave your ancestors as an inheritance.
chapters.zh: 当那些日子，犹大家要和以色列家同行，从北方之地一同来到我赐给你们列祖为业之地。

chapters.en: “I myself said, “ ‘How gladly would I treat you like my children and give you a pleasant land, the most beautiful inheritance of any nation.’ I thought you would call me ‘Father’ and not turn away from following me.
chapters.zh: 我说，我怎样将你安置在儿女之中，赐给你美地，就是万国中肥美的产业。我又说，你们必称我为父，也不再转去不跟从我。

chapters.en: But like a woman unfaithful to her husband, so you, Israel, have been unfaithful to me,” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 以色列家，你们向我行诡诈，真像妻子行诡诈离开他丈夫一样。这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: A cry is heard on the barren heights, the weeping and pleading of the people of Israel, because they have perverted their ways and have forgotten the LORD their God.
chapters.zh: 在净光的高处听见人声，就是以色列人哭泣恳求之声，乃因他们走弯曲之道，忘记耶和华他们的神。

chapters.en: “Return, faithless people; I will cure you of backsliding.” “Yes, we will come to you, for you are the LORD our God.
chapters.zh: 你们这背道的儿女阿，回来吧。我要医治你们背道的病。看哪，我们来到你这里，因你是耶和华我们的神。

chapters.en: Surely the idolatrous commotion on the hills and mountains is a deception; surely in the LORD our God is the salvation of Israel.
chapters.zh: 仰望从小山或从大山的喧嚷中得帮助，真是枉然的。以色列得救，诚然在乎耶和华我们的神。

chapters.en: From our youth shameful gods have consumed the fruits of our ancestors’ labor— their flocks and herds, their sons and daughters.
chapters.zh: 从我们幼年以来，那可耻的偶像将我们列祖所劳碌得来的羊群，牛群，和他们的儿女都吞吃了。

chapters.en: Let us lie down in our shame, and let our disgrace cover us. We have sinned against the LORD our God, both we and our ancestors; from our youth till this day we have not obeyed the LORD our God.”
chapters.zh: 我们在羞耻中躺卧吧。愿惭愧将我们遮盖。因为从立国（原文作幼年）以来，我们和我们的列祖常常得罪耶和华我们的神，没有听从耶和华我们神的话。

chapters.en: “If you, Israel, will return, then return to me,” declares the LORD. “If you put your detestable idols out of my sight and no longer go astray,
chapters.zh: 耶和华说，以色列阿，你若回来归向我，若从我眼前除掉你可憎的偶像，你就不被迁移。

chapters.en: and if in a truthful, just and righteous way you swear, ‘As surely as the LORD lives,’ then the nations will invoke blessings by him and in him they will boast.”
chapters.zh: 你必凭诚实，公平，公义，指着永生的耶和华起誓。列国必因耶和华称自己为有福，也必因他夸耀。

chapters.en: This is what the LORD says to the people of Judah and to Jerusalem: “Break up your unplowed ground and do not sow among thorns.
chapters.zh: 耶和华对犹大和耶路撒冷人如此说，要开垦你们的荒地，不要撒种在荆棘中。

chapters.en: Circumcise yourselves to the LORD, circumcise your hearts, you people of Judah and inhabitants of Jerusalem, or my wrath will flare up and burn like fire because of the evil you have done— burn with no one to quench it.
chapters.zh: 犹大人和耶路撒冷的居民哪，你们当自行割礼，归耶和华，将心里的污秽除掉。恐怕我的忿怒因你们的恶行发作，如火着起，甚至无人能以熄灭。

chapters.en: “Announce in Judah and proclaim in Jerusalem and say: ‘Sound the trumpet throughout the land!’ Cry aloud and say: ‘Gather together! Let us flee to the fortified cities!’
chapters.zh: 你们当传扬在犹大，宣告在耶路撒冷说，你们当在国中吹角，高声呼叫说，你们当聚集。我们好进入坚固城。

chapters.en: Raise the signal to go to Zion! Flee for safety without delay! For I am bringing disaster from the north, even terrible destruction.”
chapters.zh: 应当向锡安竖立大旗。要逃避，不要迟延，因我必使灾祸与大毁灭从北方来到。

chapters.en: A lion has come out of his lair; a destroyer of nations has set out. He has left his place to lay waste your land. Your towns will lie in ruins without inhabitant.
chapters.zh: 有狮子从密林中上来，是毁坏列国的。它已经动身出离本处，要使你的地荒凉，使你的城邑变为荒场无人居住。

chapters.en: So put on sackcloth, lament and wail, for the fierce anger of the LORD has not turned away from us.
chapters.zh: 因此，你们当腰束麻布，大声哀号，因为耶和华的烈怒没有向我们转消。

chapters.en: “In that day,” declares the LORD, “the king and the officials will lose heart, the priests will be horrified, and the prophets will be appalled.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华说，到那时，君王和首领的心都要消灭。祭司都要惊奇，先知都要诧异。

chapters.en: Then I said, “Alas, Sovereign LORD! How completely you have deceived this people and Jerusalem by saying, ‘You will have peace,’ when the sword is at our throats!”
chapters.zh: 我说，哀哉。主耶和华阿，你真是大大地欺哄这百姓和耶路撒冷，说，你们必得平安。其实刀剑害及性命了。

chapters.en: At that time this people and Jerusalem will be told, “A scorching wind from the barren heights in the desert blows toward my people, but not to winnow or cleanse;
chapters.zh: 那时，必有话对这百姓和耶路撒冷说，有一阵热风从旷野净光的高处向我的众民（原文作民女）刮来，不是为簸扬，也不是为扬净。

chapters.en: a wind too strong for that comes from me. Now I pronounce my judgments against them.”
chapters.zh: 必有一阵更大的风从这些地方为我刮来。现在我又必发出判语，攻击他们。

chapters.en: Look! He advances like the clouds, his chariots come like a whirlwind, his horses are swifter than eagles. Woe to us! We are ruined!
chapters.zh: 看哪，仇敌必如云上来。他的战车如旋风，他的马匹比鹰更快。我们有祸了。我们败落了。

chapters.en: Jerusalem, wash the evil from your heart and be saved. How long will you harbor wicked thoughts?
chapters.zh: 耶路撒冷阿，你当洗去心中的恶，使你可以得救。恶念存在你心里要到几时呢？

chapters.en: A voice is announcing from Dan, proclaiming disaster from the hills of Ephraim.
chapters.zh: 有声音从但传扬，从以法莲山报祸患。

chapters.en: “Tell this to the nations, proclaim concerning Jerusalem: ‘A besieging army is coming from a distant land, raising a war cry against the cities of Judah.
chapters.zh: 你们当传给列国，报告攻击耶路撒冷的事说，有探望的人从远方来到，向犹大的城邑大声呐喊。

chapters.en: They surround her like men guarding a field, because she has rebelled against me,’ ” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 他们周围攻击耶路撒冷，好像看守田园的，因为她背叛了我。这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: “Your own conduct and actions have brought this on you. This is your punishment. How bitter it is! How it pierces to the heart!”
chapters.zh: 你的行动，你的作为，招惹这事。这是你罪恶的结果，实在是苦，是害及你心了。

chapters.en: Oh, my anguish, my anguish! I writhe in pain. Oh, the agony of my heart! My heart pounds within me, I cannot keep silent. For I have heard the sound of the trumpet; I have heard the battle cry.
chapters.zh: 我的肺腑阿，我的肺腑阿，我心疼痛。我心在我里面烦躁不安。我不能静默不言，因为我已经听见角声和打仗的喊声。

chapters.en: Disaster follows disaster; the whole land lies in ruins. In an instant my tents are destroyed, my shelter in a moment.
chapters.zh: 毁坏的信息连络不绝，因为全地荒废。我的帐棚忽然毁坏。我的幔子顷刻破裂。

chapters.en: How long must I see the battle standard and hear the sound of the trumpet?
chapters.zh: 我看见大旗，听见角声，要到几时呢？

chapters.en: “My people are fools; they do not know me. They are senseless children; they have no understanding. They are skilled in doing evil; they know not how to do good.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华说，我的百性愚顽，不认识我。他们是愚昧无知的儿女，有智慧行恶，没有知识行善。

chapters.en: I looked at the earth, and it was formless and empty; and at the heavens, and their light was gone.
chapters.zh: 先知说，我观看地，不料，地是空虚混沌。我观看天，天也无光。

chapters.en: I looked at the mountains, and they were quaking; all the hills were swaying.
chapters.zh: 我观看大山，不料，尽都震动，小山也都摇来摇去。

chapters.en: I looked, and there were no people; every bird in the sky had flown away.
chapters.zh: 我观看，不料，无人。空中的飞鸟也都躲避。

chapters.en: I looked, and the fruitful land was a desert; all its towns lay in ruins before the LORD, before his fierce anger.
chapters.zh: 我观看，不料，肥田变为荒地。一切城邑在耶和华面前，因他的烈怒都被拆毁。

chapters.en: This is what the LORD says: “The whole land will be ruined, though I will not destroy it completely.
chapters.zh: 耶和华如此说，全地必然荒凉，我却不毁灭净尽。

chapters.en: Therefore the earth will mourn and the heavens above grow dark, because I have spoken and will not relent, I have decided and will not turn back.”
chapters.zh: 因此，地要悲哀，在上的天也必黑暗。因为我言已出，我意已定，必不后悔，也不转意不作。

chapters.en: At the sound of horsemen and archers every town takes to flight. Some go into the thickets; some climb up among the rocks. All the towns are deserted; no one lives in them.
chapters.zh: 各城的人因马兵和弓箭手的响声就都逃跑，进入密林，爬上磐石。各城被撇下，无人住在其中。

chapters.en: What are you doing, you devastated one? Why dress yourself in scarlet and put on jewels of gold? Why highlight your eyes with makeup? You adorn yourself in vain. Your lovers despise you; they want to kill you.
chapters.zh: 你凄凉的时候要怎样行呢？你虽穿上朱红衣服，佩戴黄金装饰，用颜料修饰眼目，这样标致是枉然的。恋爱你的藐视你，并且寻索你的性命。

chapters.en: I hear a cry as of a woman in labor, a groan as of one bearing her first child— the cry of Daughter Zion gasping for breath, stretching out her hands and saying, “Alas! I am fainting; my life is given over to murderers.”
chapters.zh: 我听见有声音，仿佛妇人产难的声音，好像生头胎疼痛的声音，是锡安女子的声音（女子就是指民的意思）。她喘着气，挓挲手，说，我有祸了。在杀人的跟前，我的心发昏了。

chapters.en: “Go up and down the streets of Jerusalem, look around and consider, search through her squares. If you can find but one person who deals honestly and seeks the truth, I will forgive this city.
chapters.zh: 你们当在耶路撒冷的街上跑来跑去，在宽阔处寻找，看看有一人行公义求诚实没有。若有，我就赦免这城。

chapters.en: Although they say, ‘As surely as the LORD lives,’ still they are swearing falsely.”
chapters.zh: 其中的人虽然指着永生的耶和华起誓，所起的誓实在是假的。

chapters.en: LORD, do not your eyes look for truth? You struck them, but they felt no pain; you crushed them, but they refused correction. They made their faces harder than stone and refused to repent.
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，你的眼目不是看顾诚实吗？你击打他们，他们却不伤恸。你毁灭他们，他们仍不受惩治。他们使脸刚硬过于磐石，不肯回头。

chapters.en: I thought, “These are only the poor; they are foolish, for they do not know the way of the LORD, the requirements of their God.
chapters.zh: 我说，这些人实在是贫穷的，是愚昧的，因为不晓得耶和华的作为和他们神的法则。

chapters.en: So I will go to the leaders and speak to them; surely they know the way of the LORD, the requirements of their God.” But with one accord they too had broken off the yoke and torn off the bonds.
chapters.zh: 我要去见尊大的人，对他们说话，因为他们晓得耶和华的作为和他们神的法则。哪知，这些人齐心将轭折断，挣开绳索。

chapters.en: Therefore a lion from the forest will attack them, a wolf from the desert will ravage them, a leopard will lie in wait near their towns to tear to pieces any who venture out, for their rebellion is great and their backslidings many.
chapters.zh: 因此，林中的狮子必害死他们。晚上（或作野地）的豺狼必灭绝他们。豹子要在城外窥伺他们。凡出城的必被撕碎。因为他们的罪过极多，背道的事也加增了。

chapters.en: “Why should I forgive you? Your children have forsaken me and sworn by gods that are not gods. I supplied all their needs, yet they committed adultery and thronged to the houses of prostitutes.
chapters.zh: 我怎能赦免你呢？你的儿女离弃我，又指着那不是神的起誓。我使他们饱足，他们就行奸淫，成群地聚集在娼妓家里。

chapters.en: They are well-fed, lusty stallions, each neighing for another man’s wife.
chapters.zh: 他们像喂饱的马到处乱跑，各向他邻舍的妻发嘶声。

chapters.en: Should I not punish them for this?” declares the LORD. “Should I not avenge myself on such a nation as this?
chapters.zh: 耶和华说，我岂不因这些事讨罪呢？岂不报复这样的国民呢？

chapters.en: “Go through her vineyards and ravage them, but do not destroy them completely. Strip off her branches, for these people do not belong to the LORD.
chapters.zh: 你们要上她葡萄园的墙施行毁坏，但不可毁坏净尽，只可除掉她的枝子，因为不属耶和华。

chapters.en: The people of Israel and the people of Judah have been utterly unfaithful to me,” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 原来以色列家和犹大家大行诡诈攻击我。这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: They have lied about the LORD; they said, “He will do nothing! No harm will come to us; we will never see sword or famine.
chapters.zh: 他们不认耶和华，说，这并不是他，灾祸必不临到我们。刀剑和饥荒，我们也看不见。

chapters.en: The prophets are but wind and the word is not in them; so let what they say be done to them.”
chapters.zh: 先知的话必成为风。道也不在他们里面。这灾必临到他们身上。

chapters.en: Therefore this is what the LORD God Almighty says: “Because the people have spoken these words, I will make my words in your mouth a fire and these people the wood it consumes.
chapters.zh: 所以耶和华万军之神如此说，因为百姓说这话，我必使我的话在你口中为火，使他们为柴。这火便将他们烧灭。

chapters.en: People of Israel,” declares the LORD, “I am bringing a distant nation against you— an ancient and enduring nation, a people whose language you do not know, whose speech you do not understand.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说，以色列家阿，我必使一国的民从远方来攻击你，是强盛的国，是从古而有的国。他们的言语你不晓得，他们的话你不明白。

chapters.en: Their quivers are like an open grave; all of them are mighty warriors.
chapters.zh: 他们的箭袋是敞开的坟墓。他们都是勇士。

chapters.en: They will devour your harvests and food, devour your sons and daughters; they will devour your flocks and herds, devour your vines and fig trees. With the sword they will destroy the fortified cities in which you trust.
chapters.zh: 他们必吃尽你的庄稼和你的粮食，是你儿女该吃的。必吃尽你的牛羊，吃尽你的葡萄和无花果。又必用刀毁坏你所倚靠的坚固城。

chapters.en: “Yet even in those days,” declares the LORD, “I will not destroy you completely.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说，就是到那时，我也不将你们毁灭净尽。

chapters.en: And when the people ask, ‘Why has the LORD our God done all this to us?’ you will tell them, ‘As you have forsaken me and served foreign gods in your own land, so now you will serve foreigners in a land not your own.’
chapters.zh: 百姓若说，耶和华我们的神为什么向我们行这一切事呢？你就对他们说，你们怎样离弃耶和华（原文作我），在你们的地上事奉外邦神，也必照样在不属你们的地上事奉外邦人。

chapters.en: “Announce this to the descendants of Jacob and proclaim it in Judah:
chapters.zh: 当传扬在雅各家，报告在犹大说，

chapters.en: Hear this, you foolish and senseless people, who have eyes but do not see, who have ears but do not hear:
chapters.zh: 愚昧无知的百姓阿，你们有眼不看，有耳不听，现在当听这话。

chapters.en: Should you not fear me?” declares the LORD. “Should you not tremble in my presence? I made the sand a boundary for the sea, an everlasting barrier it cannot cross. The waves may roll, but they cannot prevail; they may roar, but they cannot cross it.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说，你们怎么不惧怕我呢？我以永远的定例，用沙为海的界限，水不得越过。因此，你们在我面前还不战兢吗？波浪虽然翻腾，却不能逾越。虽然怒涛澎湃，却不能过去。

chapters.en: But these people have stubborn and rebellious hearts; they have turned aside and gone away.
chapters.zh: 但这百姓有背叛忤逆的心。他们叛我而去，

chapters.en: They do not say to themselves, ‘Let us fear the LORD our God, who gives autumn and spring rains in season, who assures us of the regular weeks of harvest.’
chapters.zh: 心内也不说，我们应当敬畏耶和华我们的神。他按时赐雨，就是秋雨春雨，又为我们定收割的节令，永存不废。

chapters.en: Your wrongdoings have kept these away; your sins have deprived you of good.
chapters.zh: 你们的罪孽使这些事转离你们。你们的罪恶使你们不能得福。

chapters.en: “Among my people are the wicked who lie in wait like men who snare birds and like those who set traps to catch people.
chapters.zh: 因为在我民中有恶人。他们埋伏窥探，好像捕鸟的人。他们设立圈套陷害人。

chapters.en: Like cages full of birds, their houses are full of deceit; they have become rich and powerful
chapters.zh: 笼内怎样满了雀鸟，他们的房中也照样充满诡诈。所以他们得成为大，而且富足。

chapters.en: and have grown fat and sleek. Their evil deeds have no limit; they do not seek justice. They do not promote the case of the fatherless; they do not defend the just cause of the poor.
chapters.zh: 他们肥胖光润，作恶过甚，不为人伸冤。就是不为孤儿伸冤，不使他亨通，也不为穷人辨屈。

chapters.en: Should I not punish them for this?” declares the LORD. “Should I not avenge myself on such a nation as this?
chapters.zh: 耶和华说，我岂不因这些事讨罪呢？岂不报复这样的国民呢？

chapters.en: “A horrible and shocking thing has happened in the land:
chapters.zh: 国中有可惊骇，可憎恶的事，

chapters.en: The prophets prophesy lies, the priests rule by their own authority, and my people love it this way. But what will you do in the end?
chapters.zh: 就是先知说假预言，祭司借他们把持权柄。我的百姓也喜爱这些事，到了结局你们怎样行呢？

chapters.en: “Flee for safety, people of Benjamin! Flee from Jerusalem! Sound the trumpet in Tekoa! Raise the signal over Beth Hakkerem! For disaster looms out of the north, even terrible destruction.
chapters.zh: 便雅悯人哪，你们要逃出耶路撒冷，在提哥亚吹角，在伯哈基琳立号旗。因为有灾祸与大毁灭从北方张望。

chapters.en: I will destroy Daughter Zion, so beautiful and delicate.
chapters.zh: 那秀美娇嫩的锡安女子，我必剪除（女子就是指民的意思）。

chapters.en: Shepherds with their flocks will come against her; they will pitch their tents around her, each tending his own portion.”
chapters.zh: 牧人必引他们的羊群到她那里，在她周围支搭帐棚，各在自己所占之地使羊吃草。

chapters.en: “Prepare for battle against her! Arise, let us attack at noon! But, alas, the daylight is fading, and the shadows of evening grow long.
chapters.zh: 你们要准备攻击她。起来吧，我们可以趁午时上去。哀哉。日已渐斜，晚影拖长了。

chapters.en: So arise, let us attack at night and destroy her fortresses!”
chapters.zh: 起来吧，我们夜间上去，毁坏她的宫殿。

chapters.en: This is what the LORD Almighty says: “Cut down the trees and build siege ramps against Jerusalem. This city must be punished; it is filled with oppression.
chapters.zh: 因为万军之耶和华如此说，你们要砍伐树木，筑垒攻打耶路撒冷。这就是那该罚的城，其中尽是欺压。

chapters.en: As a well pours out its water, so she pours out her wickedness. Violence and destruction resound in her; her sickness and wounds are ever before me.
chapters.zh: 井怎样涌出水来，这城也照样涌出恶来。在其间常听见有强暴毁灭的事，病患损伤也常在我面前。

chapters.en: Take warning, Jerusalem, or I will turn away from you and make your land desolate so no one can live in it.”
chapters.zh: 耶路撒冷阿，你当受教，免得我心与你生疏，免得我使你荒凉，成为无人居住之地。

chapters.en: This is what the LORD Almighty says: “Let them glean the remnant of Israel as thoroughly as a vine; pass your hand over the branches again, like one gathering grapes.”
chapters.zh: 万军之耶和华曾如此说，敌人必掳尽以色列剩下的民，如同摘净葡萄一样。你要像摘葡萄的人摘了又摘，回手放在筐子里。

chapters.en: To whom can I speak and give warning? Who will listen to me? Their ears are closed so they cannot hear. The word of the LORD is offensive to them; they find no pleasure in it.
chapters.zh: 现在我可以向谁说话作见证，使他们听呢？他们的耳朵未受割礼，不能听见。看哪，耶和华的话他们以为羞辱，不以为喜悦。

chapters.en: But I am full of the wrath of the LORD, and I cannot hold it in. “Pour it out on the children in the street and on the young men gathered together; both husband and wife will be caught in it, and the old, those weighed down with years.
chapters.zh: 因此我被耶和华的忿怒充满，难以含忍。我要倾在街中的孩童和聚会的少年人身上，连夫带妻，并年老的与日子满足的都必被擒拿。

chapters.en: Their houses will be turned over to others, together with their fields and their wives, when I stretch out my hand against those who live in the land,” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 他们的房屋，田地，和妻子都必转归别人。我要伸手攻击这地的居民。这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: “From the least to the greatest, all are greedy for gain; prophets and priests alike, all practice deceit.
chapters.zh: 因为他们从最小的到至大的都一味地贪婪，从先知到祭司都行事虚谎。

chapters.en: They dress the wound of my people as though it were not serious. ‘Peace, peace,’ they say, when there is no peace.
chapters.zh: 他们轻轻忽忽地医治我百姓的损伤，说，平安了。平安了。其实没有平安。

chapters.en: Are they ashamed of their detestable conduct? No, they have no shame at all; they do not even know how to blush. So they will fall among the fallen; they will be brought down when I punish them,” says the LORD.
chapters.zh: 他们行可憎的事知道惭愧吗？不然，他们毫不惭愧，也不知羞耻。因此，他们必在仆倒的人中仆倒。我向他们讨罪的时候，他们必致跌倒。这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: This is what the LORD says: “Stand at the crossroads and look; ask for the ancient paths, ask where the good way is, and walk in it, and you will find rest for your souls. But you said, ‘We will not walk in it.’
chapters.zh: 耶和华如此说，你们当站在路上察看，访问古道，哪是善道，便行在其间。这样，你们心里必得安息。他们却说，我们不行在其间。

chapters.en: I appointed watchmen over you and said, ‘Listen to the sound of the trumpet!’ But you said, ‘We will not listen.’
chapters.zh: 我设立守望的人照管你们，说，要听角声。他们却说，我们不听。

chapters.en: Therefore hear, you nations; you who are witnesses, observe what will happen to them.
chapters.zh: 列国阿，因此你们当听。会众阿，要知道他们必遭遇的事。

chapters.en: Hear, you earth: I am bringing disaster on this people, the fruit of their schemes, because they have not listened to my words and have rejected my law.
chapters.zh: 地阿，当听。我必使灾祸临到这百姓，就是他们意念所结的果子。因为他们不听从我的言语，至于我的训诲（或作律法），他们也厌弃了。

chapters.en: What do I care about incense from Sheba or sweet calamus from a distant land? Your burnt offerings are not acceptable; your sacrifices do not please me.”
chapters.zh: 从示巴出的乳香，从远方出的菖蒲（或作甘蔗）奉来给我有何益呢？你们的燔祭不蒙悦纳。你们的平安祭，我也不喜悦。

chapters.en: Therefore this is what the LORD says: “I will put obstacles before this people. Parents and children alike will stumble over them; neighbors and friends will perish.”
chapters.zh: 所以耶和华如此说，我要将绊脚石放在这百姓前面。父亲和儿子要一同跌在其上。邻舍与朋友也都灭亡。

chapters.en: This is what the LORD says: “Look, an army is coming from the land of the north; a great nation is being stirred up from the ends of the earth.
chapters.zh: 耶和华如此说，看哪，有一种民从北方而来，并有一大国被激动，从地极来到。

chapters.en: They are armed with bow and spear; they are cruel and show no mercy. They sound like the roaring sea as they ride on their horses; they come like men in battle formation to attack you, Daughter Zion.”
chapters.zh: 他们拿弓和枪，性情残忍，不施怜悯。他们的声音像海浪澎湃。锡安城阿（城原文作女子），他们骑马都摆队伍，如上战场的人要攻击你。

chapters.en: We have heard reports about them, and our hands hang limp. Anguish has gripped us, pain like that of a woman in labor.
chapters.zh: 我们听见他们的风声，手就发软。痛苦将我们抓住，疼痛仿佛产难的妇人。

chapters.en: Do not go out to the fields or walk on the roads, for the enemy has a sword, and there is terror on every side.
chapters.zh: 你们不要往田野去，也不要行在路上，因四围有仇敌的刀剑和惊吓。

chapters.en: Put on sackcloth, my people, and roll in ashes; mourn with bitter wailing as for an only son, for suddenly the destroyer will come upon us.
chapters.zh: 我民哪（民原文作民女），应当腰束麻布，滚在灰中。你要悲伤，如丧独生子痛痛哭号，因为灭命的要忽然临到我们。

chapters.en: “I have made you a tester of metals and my people the ore, that you may observe and test their ways.
chapters.zh: 我使你在我民中为高台，为保障（高台或作试验人的），使你知道试验他们的行动。

chapters.en: They are all hardened rebels, going about to slander. They are bronze and iron; they all act corruptly.
chapters.zh: 他们都是极悖逆的，往来谗谤人。他们是铜是铁，都行坏事。

chapters.en: The bellows blow fiercely to burn away the lead with fire, but the refining goes on in vain; the wicked are not purged out.
chapters.zh: 风箱吹火，铅被烧毁。他们炼而又炼，终是徒然。因为恶劣的还未除掉。

chapters.en: They are called rejected silver, because the LORD has rejected them.”
chapters.zh: 人必称他们为被弃的银渣，因为耶和华已经弃掉他们。

chapters.en: This is the word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD:
chapters.zh: 耶和华的话临到耶利米说，

chapters.en: “Stand at the gate of the LORD’s house and there proclaim this message: “ ‘Hear the word of the LORD, all you people of Judah who come through these gates to worship the LORD.
chapters.zh: 你当站在耶和华殿的门口，在那里宣传这话说，你们进这些门敬拜耶和华的一切犹大人，当听耶和华的话。

chapters.en: This is what the LORD Almighty, the God of Israel, says: Reform your ways and your actions, and I will let you live in this place.
chapters.zh: 万军之耶和华以色列的神如此说，你们改正行动作为，我就使你们在这地方仍然居住。

chapters.en: Do not trust in deceptive words and say, “This is the temple of the LORD, the temple of the LORD, the temple of the LORD!”
chapters.zh: 你们不要倚靠虚谎的话，说，这些是耶和华的殿，是耶和华的殿，是耶和华的殿。

chapters.en: If you really change your ways and your actions and deal with each other justly,
chapters.zh: 你们若实在改正行动作为，在人和邻舍中间诚然施行公平，

chapters.en: if you do not oppress the foreigner, the fatherless or the widow and do not shed innocent blood in this place, and if you do not follow other gods to your own harm,
chapters.zh: 不欺压寄居的和孤儿寡妇。在这地方不流无辜人的血，也不随从别神陷害自己。

chapters.en: then I will let you live in this place, in the land I gave your ancestors for ever and ever.
chapters.zh: 我就使你们在这地方仍然居住，就是我古时所赐给你们列祖的地，直到永远。

chapters.en: But look, you are trusting in deceptive words that are worthless.
chapters.zh: 看哪，你们倚靠虚谎无益的话。

chapters.en: “ ‘Will you steal and murder, commit adultery and perjury, burn incense to Baal and follow other gods you have not known,
chapters.zh: 你们偷盗，杀害，奸淫，起假誓，向巴力烧香，并随从素不认识的别神，

chapters.en: and then come and stand before me in this house, which bears my Name, and say, “We are safe”—safe to do all these detestable things?
chapters.zh: 且来到这称为我名下的殿，在我面前敬拜。又说，我们可以自由了。你们这样的举动是要行那些可憎的事吗？

chapters.en: Has this house, which bears my Name, become a den of robbers to you? But I have been watching! declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 这称为我名下的殿在你们眼中岂可看为贼窝吗？我都看见了。这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: “ ‘Go now to the place in Shiloh where I first made a dwelling for my Name, and see what I did to it because of the wickedness of my people Israel.
chapters.zh: 你们且往示罗去，就是我先前立为我名的居所，察看我因这百姓以色列的罪恶向那地所行的如何。

chapters.en: While you were doing all these things, declares the LORD, I spoke to you again and again, but you did not listen; I called you, but you did not answer.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说，现在因你们行了这一切的事，我也从早起来警戒你们，你们却不听从。呼唤你们，你们却不答应。

chapters.en: Therefore, what I did to Shiloh I will now do to the house that bears my Name, the temple you trust in, the place I gave to you and your ancestors.
chapters.zh: 所以我要向这称我为名下，你们所倚靠的殿，与我所赐给你们和你们列祖的地施行，照我从前向示罗所行的一样。

chapters.en: I will thrust you from my presence, just as I did all your fellow Israelites, the people of Ephraim.’
chapters.zh: 我必将你们从我眼前赶出，正如赶出你们的众弟兄，就是以法莲的一切后裔。

chapters.en: “So do not pray for this people nor offer any plea or petition for them; do not plead with me, for I will not listen to you.
chapters.zh: 所以，你不要为这百姓祈祷。不要为他们呼求祷告，也不要向我为他们祈求，因我不听允你。

chapters.en: Do you not see what they are doing in the towns of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem?
chapters.zh: 他们在犹大城邑中和耶路撒冷街上所行的，你没有看见吗？

chapters.en: The children gather wood, the fathers light the fire, and the women knead the dough and make cakes to offer to the Queen of Heaven. They pour out drink offerings to other gods to arouse my anger.
chapters.zh: 孩子捡柴，父亲烧火，妇女抟面作饼，献给天后，又向别神浇奠祭，惹我发怒。

chapters.en: But am I the one they are provoking? declares the LORD. Are they not rather harming themselves, to their own shame?
chapters.zh: 耶和华说，他们岂是惹我发怒呢？不是自己惹祸，以致脸上惭愧吗？

chapters.en: “ ‘Therefore this is what the Sovereign LORD says: My anger and my wrath will be poured out on this place—on man and beast, on the trees of the field and on the crops of your land—and it will burn and not be quenched.
chapters.zh: 所以主耶和华如此说，看哪，我必将我的怒气和忿怒倾在这地方的人和牲畜身上，并田野的树木和地里的出产上，必如火着起，不能熄灭。

chapters.en: “ ‘This is what the LORD Almighty, the God of Israel, says: Go ahead, add your burnt offerings to your other sacrifices and eat the meat yourselves!
chapters.zh: 万军之耶和华以色列的神如此说，你们将燔祭加在平安祭上，吃肉吧。

chapters.en: For when I brought your ancestors out of Egypt and spoke to them, I did not just give them commands about burnt offerings and sacrifices,
chapters.zh: 因为我将你们列祖从埃及地领出来的那日，燔祭平安祭的事我并没有提说，也没有吩咐他们。

chapters.en: but I gave them this command: Obey me, and I will be your God and you will be my people. Walk in obedience to all I command you, that it may go well with you.
chapters.zh: 我只吩咐他们这一件说，你们当听从我的话，我就作你们的神，你们也作我的子民。你们行我所吩咐的一切道，就可以得福。

chapters.en: But they did not listen or pay attention; instead, they followed the stubborn inclinations of their evil hearts. They went backward and not forward.
chapters.zh: 他们却不听从，不侧耳而听，竟随从自己的计谋和顽梗的恶心，向后不向前。

chapters.en: From the time your ancestors left Egypt until now, day after day, again and again I sent you my servants the prophets.
chapters.zh: 自从你们列祖出埃及地的那日，直到今日，我差遣我的仆人众先知到你们那里去，每日从早起来差遣他们。

chapters.en: But they did not listen to me or pay attention. They were stiff-necked and did more evil than their ancestors.’
chapters.zh: 你们却不听从，不侧耳而听，竟硬着颈项行恶，比你们列祖更甚。

chapters.en: “When you tell them all this, they will not listen to you; when you call to them, they will not answer.
chapters.zh: 你要将这一切的话告诉他们，他们却不听从。呼唤他们，他们却不答应。

chapters.en: Therefore say to them, ‘This is the nation that has not obeyed the LORD its God or responded to correction. Truth has perished; it has vanished from their lips.
chapters.zh: 你要对他们说，这就是不听从耶和华他们神的话，不受教训的国民。从他们的口中，诚实灭绝了。

chapters.en: “ ‘Cut off your hair and throw it away; take up a lament on the barren heights, for the LORD has rejected and abandoned this generation that is under his wrath.
chapters.zh: 耶路撒冷阿，要剪发抛弃，在净光的高处举哀。因为耶和华丢掉离弃了惹他忿怒的世代。

chapters.en: “ ‘The people of Judah have done evil in my eyes, declares the LORD. They have set up their detestable idols in the house that bears my Name and have defiled it.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说，犹大人行我眼中看为恶的事，将可憎之物设立在称为我名下的殿中，污秽这殿。

chapters.en: They have built the high places of Topheth in the Valley of Ben Hinnom to burn their sons and daughters in the fire—something I did not command, nor did it enter my mind.
chapters.zh: 他们在欣嫩子谷建筑陀斐特的丘坛，好在火中焚烧自己的儿女。这并不是我所吩咐的，也不是我心所起的意。

chapters.en: So beware, the days are coming, declares the LORD, when people will no longer call it Topheth or the Valley of Ben Hinnom, but the Valley of Slaughter, for they will bury the dead in Topheth until there is no more room.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说，因此，日子将到，这地方不再称为陀斐特和欣嫩子谷，反倒称为杀戮谷。因为要在陀斐特葬埋尸首，甚至无处可葬。

chapters.en: Then the carcasses of this people will become food for the birds and the wild animals, and there will be no one to frighten them away.
chapters.zh: 并且这百姓的尸首必给空中的飞鸟和地上的野兽作食物，并无人哄赶。

chapters.en: I will bring an end to the sounds of joy and gladness and to the voices of bride and bridegroom in the towns of Judah and the streets of Jerusalem, for the land will become desolate.
chapters.zh: 那时，我必使犹大城邑中和耶路撒冷街上，欢喜和快乐的声音，新郎和新妇的声音，都止息了，因为地必成为荒场。

chapters.en: “ ‘At that time, declares the LORD, the bones of the kings and officials of Judah, the bones of the priests and prophets, and the bones of the people of Jerusalem will be removed from their graves.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说，到那时，人必将犹大王的骸骨和他首领的骸骨，祭司的骸骨，先知的骸骨，并耶路撒冷居民的骸骨，都从坟墓中取出来，

chapters.en: They will be exposed to the sun and the moon and all the stars of the heavens, which they have loved and served and which they have followed and consulted and worshiped. They will not be gathered up or buried, but will be like dung lying on the ground.
chapters.zh: 抛散在日头，月亮，和天上众星之下，就是他们从前所喜爱，所事奉，所随从，所求问，所敬拜的。这些骸骨不再收殓，不再葬埋，必在地面上成为粪土。

chapters.en: Wherever I banish them, all the survivors of this evil nation will prefer death to life, declares the LORD Almighty.’
chapters.zh: 并且这恶族所剩下的民在我所赶他们到的各处，宁可拣死不拣生。这是万军之耶和华说的。

chapters.en: “Say to them, ‘This is what the LORD says: “ ‘When people fall down, do they not get up? When someone turns away, do they not return?
chapters.zh: 你要对他们说，耶和华如此说，人跌倒，不再起来吗？人转去，不再转来吗？

chapters.en: Why then have these people turned away? Why does Jerusalem always turn away? They cling to deceit; they refuse to return.
chapters.zh: 这耶路撒冷的民，为何恒久背道呢？他们守定诡诈，不肯回头。

chapters.en: I have listened attentively, but they do not say what is right. None of them repent of their wickedness, saying, “What have I done?” Each pursues their own course like a horse charging into battle.
chapters.zh: 我留心听，听见他们说不正直的话。无人悔改恶行，说，我作的是什么呢？他们各人转奔己路，如马直闯战场。

chapters.en: Even the stork in the sky knows her appointed seasons, and the dove, the swift and the thrush observe the time of their migration. But my people do not know the requirements of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 空中的鹳鸟知道来去的定期。斑鸠燕子与白鹤也守候当来的时令。我的百姓却不知道耶和华的法则。

chapters.en: “ ‘How can you say, “We are wise, for we have the law of the LORD,” when actually the lying pen of the scribes has handled it falsely?
chapters.zh: 你们怎么说，我们有智慧，耶和华的律法在我们这里。看哪，文士的假笔舞弄虚假。

chapters.en: The wise will be put to shame; they will be dismayed and trapped. Since they have rejected the word of the LORD, what kind of wisdom do they have?
chapters.zh: 智慧人惭愧，惊惶，被擒拿。他们弃掉耶和华的话，心里还有什么智慧呢？

chapters.en: Therefore I will give their wives to other men and their fields to new owners. From the least to the greatest, all are greedy for gain; prophets and priests alike, all practice deceit.
chapters.zh: 所以我必将他们的妻子给别人，将他们的田地给别人为业。因为他们从最小的到至大的都一味地贪婪，从先知到祭司都行事虚谎。

chapters.en: They dress the wound of my people as though it were not serious. “Peace, peace,” they say, when there is no peace.
chapters.zh: 他们轻轻忽忽地医治我百姓的损伤，说，平安了。平安了。其实没有平安。

chapters.en: Are they ashamed of their detestable conduct? No, they have no shame at all; they do not even know how to blush. So they will fall among the fallen; they will be brought down when they are punished, says the LORD.
chapters.zh: 他们行可憎的事知道惭愧吗？不然，他们毫不惭愧，也不知羞耻。因此他们必在仆倒的人中仆倒。我向他们讨罪的时候，他们必致跌倒。这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: “ ‘I will take away their harvest, declares the LORD. There will be no grapes on the vine. There will be no figs on the tree, and their leaves will wither. What I have given them will be taken from them. ’ ”
chapters.zh: 耶和华说，我必使他们全然灭绝。葡萄树上必没有葡萄，无花果树上必没有果子，叶子也必枯干。我所赐给他们的，必离开他们过去。

chapters.en: Why are we sitting here? Gather together! Let us flee to the fortified cities and perish there! For the LORD our God has doomed us to perish and given us poisoned water to drink, because we have sinned against him.
chapters.zh: 我们为何静坐不动呢？我们当聚集，进入坚固城，在那里静默不言。因为耶和华我们的神使我们静默不言，又将苦胆水给我们喝，都因我们得罪了耶和华。

chapters.en: We hoped for peace but no good has come, for a time of healing but there is only terror.
chapters.zh: 我们指望平安，却得不着好处。指望痊愈的时候，不料，受了惊惶。

chapters.en: The snorting of the enemy’s horses is heard from Dan; at the neighing of their stallions the whole land trembles. They have come to devour the land and everything in it, the city and all who live there.
chapters.zh: 听见从但那里敌人的马喷鼻气，他的壮马发嘶声，全地就都震动。因为他们来吞灭这地和其上所有的，吞灭这城与其中的居民。

chapters.en: “See, I will send venomous snakes among you, vipers that cannot be charmed, and they will bite you,” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 看哪，我必使毒蛇到你们中间，是不服法术的，必咬你们。这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: You who are my Comforter in sorrow, my heart is faint within me.
chapters.zh: 我有忧愁，愿能自慰。我心在我里面发昏。

chapters.en: Listen to the cry of my people from a land far away: “Is the LORD not in Zion? Is her King no longer there?” “Why have they aroused my anger with their images, with their worthless foreign idols?”
chapters.zh: 听阿，是我百姓的哀声从极远之地而来，说，耶和华不在锡安吗？锡安的王不在其中吗？耶和华说，他们为什么以雕刻的偶像和外邦虚无的神惹我发怒呢？

chapters.en: “The harvest is past, the summer has ended, and we are not saved.”
chapters.zh: 麦秋已过，夏令已完，我们还未得救。

chapters.en: Since my people are crushed, I am crushed; I mourn, and horror grips me.
chapters.zh: 先知说，因我百姓的损伤，我也受了损伤。我哀痛，惊惶将我抓住。

chapters.en: Is there no balm in Gilead? Is there no physician there? Why then is there no healing for the wound of my people?
chapters.zh: 在基列岂没有乳香呢？在那里岂没有医生呢？我百姓为何不得痊愈呢？

chapters.en: Oh, that my head were a spring of water and my eyes a fountain of tears! I would weep day and night for the slain of my people.
chapters.zh: 但愿我的头为水，我的眼为泪的泉源，我好为我百姓（原文作民女。七节同）中被杀的人昼夜哭泣。

chapters.en: Oh, that I had in the desert a lodging place for travelers, so that I might leave my people and go away from them; for they are all adulterers, a crowd of unfaithful people.
chapters.zh: 惟愿我在旷野有行路人住宿之处，使我可以离开我的民出去。因他们都是行奸淫的，是行诡诈的一党。

chapters.en: “They make ready their tongue like a bow, to shoot lies; it is not by truth that they triumph in the land. They go from one sin to another; they do not acknowledge me,” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 他们弯起舌头像弓一样，为要说谎话。他们在国中增长势力，不是为行诚实，乃是恶上加恶，并不认识我。这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: “Beware of your friends; do not trust anyone in your clan. For every one of them is a deceiver,and every friend a slanderer.
chapters.zh: 你们各人当谨防邻舍，不可信靠弟兄。因为弟兄尽行欺骗，邻舍都往来谗谤人。

chapters.en: Friend deceives friend, and no one speaks the truth. They have taught their tongues to lie; they weary themselves with sinning.
chapters.zh: 他们各人欺哄邻舍，不说真话。他们教舌头学习说谎，劳劳碌碌地作孽。

chapters.en: You live in the midst of deception; in their deceit they refuse to acknowledge me,” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 你的住处在诡诈的人中。他们因行诡诈，不肯认识我。这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: Therefore this is what the LORD Almighty says: “See, I will refine and test them, for what else can I do because of the sin of my people?
chapters.zh: 所以万军之耶和华如此说，看哪，我要将他们融化熬炼。不然，我因我百姓的罪该怎样行呢？

chapters.en: Their tongue is a deadly arrow; it speaks deceitfully. With their mouths they all speak cordially to their neighbors, but in their hearts they set traps for them.
chapters.zh: 他们的舌头是毒箭，说话诡诈。人与邻舍口说和平话，心却谋害他。

chapters.en: Should I not punish them for this?” declares the LORD. “Should I not avenge myself on such a nation as this?”
chapters.zh: 耶和华说，我岂不因这些事讨他们的罪呢？岂不报复这样的国民呢？

chapters.en: I will weep and wail for the mountains and take up a lament concerning the wilderness grasslands. They are desolate and untraveled, and the lowing of cattle is not heard. The birds have all fled and the animals are gone.
chapters.zh: 我要为山岭哭泣悲哀，为旷野的草场扬声哀号。因为都已干焦，甚至无人经过。人也听不见牲畜鸣叫，空中的飞鸟和地上的野兽都已逃去。

chapters.en: “I will make Jerusalem a heap of ruins, a haunt of jackals; and I will lay waste the towns of Judah so no one can live there.”
chapters.zh: 我必使耶路撒冷变为乱堆，为野狗的住处，也必使犹大的城邑变为荒场，无人居住。

chapters.en: Who is wise enough to understand this? Who has been instructed by the LORD and can explain it? Why has the land been ruined and laid waste like a desert that no one can cross?
chapters.zh: 谁是智慧人，可以明白这事？耶和华的口向谁说过，使他可以传说？遍地为何灭亡，干焦好像旷野，甚至无人经过呢？

chapters.en: The LORD said, “It is because they have forsaken my law, which I set before them; they have not obeyed me or followed my law.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说，因为这百姓离弃我，在他们面前所设立的律法没有遵行，也没有听从我的话。

chapters.en: Instead, they have followed the stubbornness of their hearts; they have followed the Baals, as their ancestors taught them.”
chapters.zh: 只随从自己顽梗的心行事，照他们列祖所教训的随从众巴力。

chapters.en: Therefore this is what the LORD Almighty, the God of Israel, says: “See, I will make this people eat bitter food and drink poisoned water.
chapters.zh: 所以万军之耶和华以色列的神如此说，看哪，我必将茵陈给这百姓吃，又将苦胆水给他们喝。

chapters.en: I will scatter them among nations that neither they nor their ancestors have known, and I will pursue them with the sword until I have made an end of them.”
chapters.zh: 我要把他们散在列邦中，就是他们和他们列祖素不认识的列邦。我也要使刀剑追杀他们，直到将他们灭尽。

chapters.en: This is what the LORD Almighty says: “Consider now! Call for the wailing women to come; send for the most skillful of them.
chapters.zh: 万军之耶和华如此说，你们应当思想，将善唱哀歌的妇女召来，又打发人召善哭的妇女来，

chapters.en: Let them come quickly and wail over us till our eyes overflow with tears and water streams from our eyelids.
chapters.zh: 叫她们速速为我们举哀，使我们眼泪汪汪，使我们的眼皮涌出水来。

chapters.en: The sound of wailing is heard from Zion: ‘How ruined we are! How great is our shame! We must leave our land because our houses are in ruins.’ ”
chapters.zh: 因为听见哀声出于锡安，说，我们怎样败落了。我们大大地惭愧。我们撇下地土。人也拆毁了我们的房屋。

chapters.en: Now, you women, hear the word of the LORD; open your ears to the words of his mouth. Teach your daughters how to wail; teach one another a lament.
chapters.zh: 妇女们哪，你们当听耶和华的话，领受他口中的言语。又当教导你们的儿女举哀，各人教导邻舍唱哀歌。

chapters.en: Death has climbed in through our windows and has entered our fortresses; it has removed the children from the streets and the young men from the public squares.
chapters.zh: 因为死亡上来，进了我们的窗户，入了我们的宫殿。要从外边剪除孩童，从街上剪除少年人。

chapters.en: Say, “This is what the LORD declares: “ ‘Dead bodies will lie like dung on the open field, like cut grain behind the reaper, with no one to gather them.’ ”
chapters.zh: 你当说，耶和华如此说，人的尸首必倒在田野像粪土，又像收割的人遗落的一把禾稼，无人收取。

chapters.en: This is what the LORD says: “Let not the wise boast of their wisdom or the strong boast of their strength or the rich boast of their riches,
chapters.zh: 耶和华如此说，智慧人不要因他的智慧夸口，勇士不要因他的勇力夸口，财主不要因他的财物夸口。

chapters.en: but let the one who boasts boast about this: that they have the understanding to know me, that I am the LORD, who exercises kindness, justice and righteousness on earth, for in these I delight,” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 夸口的却因他有聪明，认识我是耶和华，又知道我喜悦在世上施行慈爱，公平，和公义，以此夸口。这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: “The days are coming,” declares the LORD, “when I will punish all who are circumcised only in the flesh—
chapters.zh: 耶和华说，看哪，日子将到，我要刑罚一切受过割礼，心却未受割礼的，

chapters.en: Egypt, Judah, Edom, Ammon, Moab and all who live in the wilderness in distant places. For all these nations are really uncircumcised, and even the whole house of Israel is uncircumcised in heart.”
chapters.zh: 就是埃及，犹大，以东，亚扪人，摩押人，和一切住在旷野剃周围头发的。因为列国人都没有受割礼，以色列人心中也没有受割礼。

chapters.en: Hear what the LORD says to you, people of Israel.
chapters.zh: 以色列家阿，要听耶和华对你们所说的话。

chapters.en: This is what the LORD says: “Do not learn the ways of the nations or be terrified by signs in the heavens, though the nations are terrified by them.
chapters.zh: 耶和华如此说，你们不要效法列国的行为，也不要为天象惊惶，因列国为此事惊惶。

chapters.en: For the practices of the peoples are worthless; they cut a tree out of the forest, and a craftsman shapes it with his chisel.
chapters.zh: 众民的风俗是虚空的。他们在树林中用斧子砍伐一棵树，匠人用手工造成偶像。

chapters.en: They adorn it with silver and gold; they fasten it with hammer and nails so it will not totter.
chapters.zh: 他们用金银妆饰它，用钉子和锤子钉稳，使它不动摇。

chapters.en: Like a scarecrow in a cucumber field, their idols cannot speak; they must be carried because they cannot walk. Do not fear them; they can do no harm nor can they do any good.”
chapters.zh: 它好像棕树，是镟成的，不能说话，不能行走，必须有人抬着。你们不要怕它。它不能降祸，也无力降福。

chapters.en: No one is like you, LORD; you are great, and your name is mighty in power.
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，没有能比你的。你本为大，有大能大力的名。

chapters.en: Who should not fear you, King of the nations? This is your due. Among all the wise leaders of the nations and in all their kingdoms, there is no one like you.
chapters.zh: 万国的王阿，谁不敬畏你。敬畏你本是合宜的。因为在列国的智慧人中，虽有政权的尊荣，也不能比你。

chapters.en: They are all senseless and foolish; they are taught by worthless wooden idols.
chapters.zh: 他们尽都是畜类，是愚昧的。偶像的训诲算什么呢？偶像不过是木头。

chapters.en: Hammered silver is brought from Tarshish and gold from Uphaz. What the craftsman and goldsmith have made is then dressed in blue and purple— all made by skilled workers.
chapters.zh: 有银子打成片，是从他施带来的，并有从乌法来的金子，都是匠人和银匠的手工，又有蓝色紫色料的衣服，都是巧匠的工作。

chapters.en: But the LORD is the true God; he is the living God, the eternal King. When he is angry, the earth trembles; the nations cannot endure his wrath.
chapters.zh: 惟耶和华是真神，是活神，是永远的王。他一发怒，大地震动。他一恼恨，列国都担当不起。

chapters.en: “Tell them this: ‘These gods, who did not make the heavens and the earth, will perish from the earth and from under the heavens.’ ”
chapters.zh: 你们要对他们如此说，不是那创造天地的神，必从地上从天下被除灭。

chapters.en: But God made the earth by his power; he founded the world by his wisdom and stretched out the heavens by his understanding.
chapters.zh: 耶和华用能力创造大地，用智慧建立世界，用聪明铺张穹苍。

chapters.en: When he thunders, the waters in the heavens roar; he makes clouds rise from the ends of the earth. He sends lightning with the rain and brings out the wind from his storehouses.
chapters.zh: 他一发声，空中便有多水激动。他使云雾从地极上腾。他造电随雨而闪，从他府库中带出风来。

chapters.en: Everyone is senseless and without knowledge; every goldsmith is shamed by his idols. The images he makes are a fraud; they have no breath in them.
chapters.zh: 各人都成了畜类，毫无知识。各银匠都因他雕刻的偶像羞愧。他所铸的偶像本是虚假的，其中并无气息，

chapters.en: They are worthless, the objects of mockery; when their judgment comes, they will perish.
chapters.zh: 都是虚无的，是迷惑人的工作。到追讨的时候必被除灭。

chapters.en: He who is the Portion of Jacob is not like these, for he is the Maker of all things, including Israel, the people of his inheritance— the LORD Almighty is his name.
chapters.zh: 雅各的分不像这些，因他是造作万有的主。以色列也是他产业的支派，万军之耶和华是他的名。

chapters.en: Gather up your belongings to leave the land, you who live under siege.
chapters.zh: 受围困的人哪，当收拾你的财物，从国中带出去。

chapters.en: For this is what the LORD says: “At this time I will hurl out those who live in this land; I will bring distress on them so that they may be captured.”
chapters.zh: 因为耶和华如此说，这时候，我必将此地的居民，好像用机弦甩出去，又必加害在他们身上，使他们觉悟。

chapters.en: Woe to me because of my injury! My wound is incurable! Yet I said to myself, “This is my sickness, and I must endure it.”
chapters.zh: 民说，祸哉。我受损伤。我的伤痕极其重大。我却说，这真是我的痛苦，必须忍受。

chapters.en: My tent is destroyed; all its ropes are snapped. My children are gone from me and are no more; no one is left now to pitch my tent or to set up my shelter.
chapters.zh: 我的帐棚毁坏。我的绳索折断。我的儿女离我出去，没有了。无人再支搭我的帐棚，挂起我的幔子。

chapters.en: The shepherds are senseless and do not inquire of the LORD; so they do not prosper and all their flock is scattered.
chapters.zh: 因为牧人都成为畜类，没有求问耶和华，所以不得顺利。他们的羊群也都分散。

chapters.en: Listen! The report is coming— a great commotion from the land of the north! It will make the towns of Judah desolate, a haunt of jackals.
chapters.zh: 有风声。看哪，敌人来了。有大扰乱从北方出来，要使犹大城邑变为荒凉，成为野狗的住处。

chapters.en: LORD, I know that people’s lives are not their own; it is not for them to direct their steps.
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，我晓得人的道路不由自己，行路的人也不能定自己的脚步。

chapters.en: Discipline me, LORD, but only in due measure— not in your anger, or you will reduce me to nothing.
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，求你从宽惩治我，不要在你的怒中惩治我，恐怕使我归于无有。

chapters.en: Pour out your wrath on the nations that do not acknowledge you, on the peoples who do not call on your name. For they have devoured Jacob; they have devoured him completely and destroyed his homeland.
chapters.zh: 愿你将忿怒倾在不认识你的列国中，和不求告你名的各族上。因为他们吞了雅各，不但吞了，而且灭绝，把他的住处变为荒场。

chapters.en: This is the word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD:
chapters.zh: 耶和华的话临到耶利米说，

chapters.en: “Listen to the terms of this covenant and tell them to the people of Judah and to those who live in Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 当听这约的话，告诉犹大人和耶路撒冷的居民，

chapters.en: Tell them that this is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: ‘Cursed is the one who does not obey the terms of this covenant—
chapters.zh: 对他们说，耶和华以色列的神如此说，不听从这约之话的人必受咒诅。

chapters.en: the terms I commanded your ancestors when I brought them out of Egypt, out of the iron-smelting furnace.’ I said, ‘Obey me and do everything I command you, and you will be my people, and I will be your God.
chapters.zh: 这约是我将你们列祖从埃及地领出来，脱离铁炉的那日所吩咐他们的，说，你们要听从我的话，照我一切所吩咐的去行。这样，你们就作我的子民，我也作你们的神。

chapters.en: Then I will fulfill the oath I swore to your ancestors, to give them a land flowing with milk and honey’—the land you possess today.” I answered, “Amen, LORD.”
chapters.zh: 我好坚定向你们列祖所起的誓，给他们流奶与蜜之地，正如今日一样。我就回答说，耶和华阿，阿们。

chapters.en: The LORD said to me, “Proclaim all these words in the towns of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem: ‘Listen to the terms of this covenant and follow them.
chapters.zh: 耶和华对我说，你要在犹大城邑中和耶路撒冷街市上，宣告这一切话说，你们当听从遵行这约的话。

chapters.en: From the time I brought your ancestors up from Egypt until today, I warned them again and again, saying, “Obey me.”
chapters.zh: 因为我将你们列祖从埃及地领出来的那日，直到今日，都是从早起来，切切诰诫他们说，你们当听从我的话。

chapters.en: But they did not listen or pay attention; instead, they followed the stubbornness of their evil hearts. So I brought on them all the curses of the covenant I had commanded them to follow but that they did not keep.’ ”
chapters.zh: 他们却不听从，不侧耳而听，竟随从自己顽梗的恶心去行。所以我使这约中一切咒诅的话临到他们身上。这约是我吩咐他们行的，他们却不去行。

chapters.en: Then the LORD said to me, “There is a conspiracy among the people of Judah and those who live in Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 耶和华对我说，在犹大人和耶路撒冷居民中有同谋背叛的事。

chapters.en: They have returned to the sins of their ancestors, who refused to listen to my words. They have followed other gods to serve them. Both Israel and Judah have broken the covenant I made with their ancestors.
chapters.zh: 他们转去效法他们的先祖，不肯听我的话，犯罪作孽，又随从别神，事奉它。以色列家和犹大家背了我与他们列祖所立的约。

chapters.en: Therefore this is what the LORD says: ‘I will bring on them a disaster they cannot escape. Although they cry out to me, I will not listen to them.
chapters.zh: 所以耶和华如此说，我必使灾祸临到他们，是他们不能逃脱的。他们必向我哀求，我却不听。

chapters.en: The towns of Judah and the people of Jerusalem will go and cry out to the gods to whom they burn incense, but they will not help them at all when disaster strikes.
chapters.zh: 那时，犹大城邑的人和耶路撒冷的居民要去哀求他们烧香所供奉的神。只是遭难的时候，这些神毫不拯救他们。

chapters.en: You, Judah, have as many gods as you have towns; and the altars you have set up to burn incense to that shameful god Baal are as many as the streets of Jerusalem.’
chapters.zh: 犹大阿，你神的数目与你城的数目相等。你为那可耻的巴力所筑烧香的坛也与耶路撒冷街道的数目相等。

chapters.en: “Do not pray for this people or offer any plea or petition for them, because I will not listen when they call to me in the time of their distress.
chapters.zh: 所以你不要为这百姓祈祷，不要为他们呼求祷告。因为他们遭难向我哀求的时候，我必不应允。

chapters.en: “What is my beloved doing in my temple as she, with many others, works out her evil schemes? Can consecrated meat avert your punishment? When you engage in your wickedness, then you rejoice. ”
chapters.zh: 我所亲爱的，既行许多淫乱，圣肉也离了你，你在我殿中作什么呢？你作恶就喜乐。

chapters.en: The LORD called you a thriving olive tree with fruit beautiful in form. But with the roar of a mighty storm he will set it on fire, and its branches will be broken.
chapters.zh: 从前耶和华给你起名叫青橄榄树，又华美又结好果子。如今他用哄嚷之声，点火在其上，枝子也被折断。

chapters.en: The LORD Almighty, who planted you, has decreed disaster for you, because the people of both Israel and Judah have done evil and aroused my anger by burning incense to Baal.
chapters.zh: 原来栽培你的万军之耶和华已经说，要降祸攻击你，是因以色列家和犹大家行恶，向巴力烧香，惹我发怒，是自作自受。

chapters.en: Because the LORD revealed their plot to me, I knew it, for at that time he showed me what they were doing.
chapters.zh: 耶和华指示我，我就知道。你将他们所行的给我指明。

chapters.en: I had been like a gentle lamb led to the slaughter; I did not realize that they had plotted against me, saying, “Let us destroy the tree and its fruit; let us cut him off from the land of the living, that his name be remembered no more.”
chapters.zh: 我却像柔顺的羊羔被牵到宰杀之地。我并不知道他们设计谋害我，说，我们把树连果子都灭了吧。将他从活人之地剪除，使他的名不再被记念。

chapters.en: But you, LORD Almighty, who judge righteously and test the heart and mind, let me see your vengeance on them, for to you I have committed my cause.
chapters.zh: 按公义判断，察验人肺腑心肠的万军之耶和华阿，我却要见你在他们身上报仇，因我将我的案件向你禀明了。

chapters.en: Therefore this is what the LORD says about the people of Anathoth who are threatening to kill you, saying, “Do not prophesy in the name of the LORD or you will die by our hands”—
chapters.zh: 所以，耶和华论到寻索你命的亚拿突人如此说，他们说，你不要奉耶和华的名说预言，免得你死在我们手中。

chapters.en: therefore this is what the LORD Almighty says: “I will punish them. Their young men will die by the sword, their sons and daughters by famine.
chapters.zh: 所以万军之耶和华如此说，看哪，我必刑罚他们。他们的少年人必被刀剑杀死，他们的儿女必因饥荒灭亡，

chapters.en: Not even a remnant will be left to them, because I will bring disaster on the people of Anathoth in the year of their punishment.”
chapters.zh: 并且没有余剩的人留给他们。因为在追讨之年，我必使灾祸临到亚拿突人。

chapters.en: You are always righteous, LORD, when I bring a case before you. Yet I would speak with you about your justice: Why does the way of the wicked prosper? Why do all the faithless live at ease?
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，我与你争辩的时候，你显为义。但有一件，我还要与你理论，恶人的道路为何亨通呢？大行诡诈的为何得安逸呢？

chapters.en: You have planted them, and they have taken root; they grow and bear fruit. You are always on their lips but far from their hearts.
chapters.zh: 你栽培了他们，他们也扎了根，长大，而且结果。他们的口是与你相近，心却与你远离。

chapters.en: Yet you know me, LORD; you see me and test my thoughts about you. Drag them off like sheep to be butchered! Set them apart for the day of slaughter!
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，你晓得我，看见我，察验我向你是怎样的心。求你将他们拉出来，好像将宰的羊，叫他们等候杀戮的日子。

chapters.en: How long will the land lie parched and the grass in every field be withered? Because those who live in it are wicked, the animals and birds have perished. Moreover, the people are saying, “He will not see what happens to us.”
chapters.zh: 这地悲哀，通国的青草枯干，要到几时呢？因其上居民的恶行，牲畜和飞鸟都灭绝了。他们曾说，他看不见我们的结局。

chapters.en: “If you have raced with men on foot and they have worn you out, how can you compete with horses? If you stumble in safe country, how will you manage in the thickets by the Jordan?
chapters.zh: 耶和华说，你若与步行的人同跑，尚且觉累，怎能与马赛跑呢？你在平安之地，虽然安稳，在约旦河边的丛林要怎样行呢？

chapters.en: Your relatives, members of your own family— even they have betrayed you; they have raised a loud cry against you. Do not trust them, though they speak well of you.
chapters.zh: 因为连你弟兄和你父家都用奸诈待你。他们也在你后边大声喊叫，虽向你说好话，你也不要信他们。

chapters.en: “I will forsake my house, abandon my inheritance; I will give the one I love into the hands of her enemies.
chapters.zh: 我离了我的殿宇，撇弃我的产业，将我心里所亲爱的交在她仇敌的手中。

chapters.en: My inheritance has become to me like a lion in the forest. She roars at me; therefore I hate her.
chapters.zh: 我的产业向我如林中的狮子，她发声攻击我，因此我恨恶她。

chapters.en: Has not my inheritance become to me like a speckled bird of prey that other birds of prey surround and attack? Go and gather all the wild beasts; bring them to devour.
chapters.zh: 我的产业向我岂如斑点的鸷鸟呢？鸷鸟岂在她四围攻击她呢？你们要去聚集田野的百兽，带来吞吃吧。

chapters.en: Many shepherds will ruin my vineyard and trample down my field; they will turn my pleasant field into a desolate wasteland.
chapters.zh: 许多牧人毁坏我的葡萄园，践踏我的分，使我美好的分变为荒凉的旷野。

chapters.en: It will be made a wasteland, parched and desolate before me; the whole land will be laid waste because there is no one who cares.
chapters.zh: 他们使地荒凉。地既荒凉，便向我悲哀。全地荒凉，因无人介意。

chapters.en: Over all the barren heights in the desert destroyers will swarm, for the sword of the LORD will devour from one end of the land to the other; no one will be safe.
chapters.zh: 灭命的都来到旷野中一切净光的高处。耶和华的刀从地这边直到地那边尽行杀灭。凡有血气的都不得平安。

chapters.en: They will sow wheat but reap thorns; they will wear themselves out but gain nothing. They will bear the shame of their harvest because of the LORD’s fierce anger.”
chapters.zh: 他们种的是麦子，收的是荆棘。劳劳苦苦却毫无益处。因耶和华的烈怒，你们必为自己的土产羞愧。

chapters.en: This is what the LORD says: “As for all my wicked neighbors who seize the inheritance I gave my people Israel, I will uproot them from their lands and I will uproot the people of Judah from among them.
chapters.zh: 耶和华如此说，一切恶邻，就是占据我使百姓以色列所承受产业的，我要将他们拔出本地，又要将犹大家从他们中间拔出来。

chapters.en: But after I uproot them, I will again have compassion and will bring each of them back to their own inheritance and their own country.
chapters.zh: 我拔出他们以后，我必转过来怜悯他们，把他们再带回来，各归本业，各归故土。

chapters.en: And if they learn well the ways of my people and swear by my name, saying, ‘As surely as the LORD lives’—even as they once taught my people to swear by Baal—then they will be established among my people.
chapters.zh: 他们若殷勤学习我百姓的道，指着我的名起誓，说，我指着永生的耶和华起誓，正如他们从前教我百姓指着巴力起誓，他们就必建立在我百姓中间。

chapters.en: But if any nation does not listen, I will completely uproot and destroy it,” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 他们若是不听，我必拔出那国，拔出而且毁灭。这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: This is what the LORD said to me: “Go and buy a linen belt and put it around your waist, but do not let it touch water.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华对我如此说，你去买一根麻布带子束腰，不可放在水中。

chapters.en: So I bought a belt, as the LORD directed, and put it around my waist.
chapters.zh: 我就照着耶和华的话，买了一根带子束腰。

chapters.en: Then the word of the LORD came to me a second time:
chapters.zh: 耶和华的话第二次临到我说，

chapters.en: “Take the belt you bought and are wearing around your waist, and go now to Perath and hide it there in a crevice in the rocks.”
chapters.zh: 要拿着你所买的腰带，就是你腰上的带子，起来往伯拉河去，将腰带藏在那里的磐石穴中。

chapters.en: So I went and hid it at Perath, as the LORD told me.
chapters.zh: 我就去，照着耶和华所吩咐我的，将腰带藏在伯拉河边。

chapters.en: Many days later the LORD said to me, “Go now to Perath and get the belt I told you to hide there.”
chapters.zh: 过了多日，耶和华对我说，你起来往伯拉河去，将我吩咐你藏在那里的腰带取出来。

chapters.en: So I went to Perath and dug up the belt and took it from the place where I had hidden it, but now it was ruined and completely useless.
chapters.zh: 我就往伯拉河去，将腰带从我所藏的地方刨出来，见腰带已经变坏，毫无用了。

chapters.en: Then the word of the LORD came to me:
chapters.zh: 耶和华的话临到我说，

chapters.en: “This is what the LORD says: ‘In the same way I will ruin the pride of Judah and the great pride of Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 耶和华如此说，我必照样败坏犹大的骄傲和耶路撒冷的大骄傲。

chapters.en: These wicked people, who refuse to listen to my words, who follow the stubbornness of their hearts and go after other gods to serve and worship them, will be like this belt—completely useless!
chapters.zh: 这恶民不肯听我的话，按自己顽梗的心而行，随从别神，事奉敬拜，他们也必像这腰带变为无用。

chapters.en: For as a belt is bound around the waist, so I bound all the people of Israel and all the people of Judah to me,’ declares the LORD, ‘to be my people for my renown and praise and honor. But they have not listened.’
chapters.zh: 耶和华说，腰带怎样紧贴人腰，照样，我也使以色列全家和犹大全家紧贴我，好叫他们属我为子民，使我得名声，得颂赞，得荣耀。他们却不肯听。

chapters.en: “Say to them: ‘This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: Every wineskin should be filled with wine.’ And if they say to you, ‘Don’t we know that every wineskin should be filled with wine?’
chapters.zh: 所以你要对他们说，耶和华以色列的神如此说，各坛都要盛满了酒。他们必对你说，我们岂不确知各坛都要盛满了酒呢？

chapters.en: then tell them, ‘This is what the LORD says: I am going to fill with drunkenness all who live in this land, including the kings who sit on David’s throne, the priests, the prophets and all those living in Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 你就要对他们说，耶和华如此说，我必使这地的一切居民，就是坐大卫宝座的君王和祭司，与先知，并耶路撒冷的一切居民，都酩酊大醉。

chapters.en: I will smash them one against the other, parents and children alike, declares the LORD. I will allow no pity or mercy or compassion to keep me from destroying them.’ ”
chapters.zh: 耶和华说，我要使他们彼此相碰，就是父与子彼此相碰。我必不可怜，不顾惜，不怜悯，以致灭绝他们。

chapters.en: Hear and pay attention, do not be arrogant, for the LORD has spoken.
chapters.zh: 你们当听，当侧耳而听。不要骄傲，因为耶和华已经说了。

chapters.en: Give glory to the LORD your God before he brings the darkness, before your feet stumble on the darkening hills. You hope for light, but he will turn it to utter darkness and change it to deep gloom.
chapters.zh: 耶和华你们的神未使黑暗来到，你们的脚未在昏暗山上绊跌之先，当将荣耀归给他。免得你们盼望光明，他使光明变为死荫，成为幽暗。
