chapters.en: If you do not listen, I will weep in secret because of your pride; my eyes will weep bitterly, overflowing with tears, because the LORD’s flock will be taken captive.
chapters.zh: 你们若不听这话，我必因你们的骄傲在暗地哭泣。我眼必痛哭流泪，因为耶和华的群众被掳去了。

chapters.en: Say to the king and to the queen mother, “Come down from your thrones, for your glorious crowns will fall from your heads.”
chapters.zh: 你要对君王和太后说，你们当自卑，坐在下边。因你们的头巾，就是你们的华冠，已经脱落了。

chapters.en: The cities in the Negev will be shut up, and there will be no one to open them. All Judah will be carried into exile, carried completely away.
chapters.zh: 南方的城尽都关闭，无人开放。犹大全被掳掠，且掳掠净尽。

chapters.en: Look up and see those who are coming from the north. Where is the flock that was entrusted to you, the sheep of which you boasted?
chapters.zh: 你们要举目观看从北方来的人。先前赐给你的群众，就是你佳美的群众，如今在哪里呢？

chapters.en: What will you say when the LORD sets over you those you cultivated as your special allies? Will not pain grip you like that of a woman in labor?
chapters.zh: 耶和华立你自己所交的朋友为首，辖制你，那时你还有什么话说呢？痛苦岂不将你抓住像产难的妇人吗？

chapters.en: And if you ask yourself, “Why has this happened to me?”— it is because of your many sins that your skirts have been torn off and your body mistreated.
chapters.zh: 你若心里说，这一切事为何临到我呢？你的衣襟揭起，你的脚跟受伤，是因你的罪孽甚多。

chapters.en: Can an Ethiopian change his skin or a leopard its spots? Neither can you do good who are accustomed to doing evil.
chapters.zh: 古实人岂能改变皮肤呢？豹岂能改变斑点呢？若能，你们这习惯行恶的便能行善了。

chapters.en: “I will scatter you like chaff driven by the desert wind.
chapters.zh: 所以我必用旷野的风吹散他们，像吹过的碎秸一样。

chapters.en: This is your lot, the portion I have decreed for you,” declares the LORD, “because you have forgotten me and trusted in false gods.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说，这是你所当得的，是我量给你的分。因为你忘记我，倚靠虚假（或作偶像）。

chapters.en: I will pull up your skirts over your face that your shame may be seen—
chapters.zh: 所以我要揭起你的衣襟，蒙在你脸上，显出你的丑陋。

chapters.en: your adulteries and lustful neighings, your shameless prostitution! I have seen your detestable acts on the hills and in the fields. Woe to you, Jerusalem! How long will you be unclean?”
chapters.zh: 你那些可憎恶之事就是在田野的山上行奸淫，发嘶声，作淫乱的事我都看见了。耶路撒冷阿，你有祸了。你不肯洁净，还要到几时呢？

chapters.en: This is the word of the LORD that came to Jeremiah concerning the drought:
chapters.zh: 耶和华论到干旱之灾的话临到耶利米，

chapters.en: “Judah mourns, her cities languish; they wail for the land, and a cry goes up from Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 犹大悲哀，城门衰败。众人披上黑衣坐在地上。耶路撒冷的哀声上达。

chapters.en: The nobles send their servants for water; they go to the cisterns but find no water. They return with their jars unfilled; dismayed and despairing, they cover their heads.
chapters.zh: 他们的贵胄打发家僮打水。他们来到水池，见没有水，就拿着空器皿，蒙羞惭愧，抱头而回。

chapters.en: The ground is cracked because there is no rain in the land; the farmers are dismayed and cover their heads.
chapters.zh: 耕地的也蒙羞抱头。因为无雨降在地上，地都干裂。

chapters.en: Even the doe in the field deserts her newborn fawn because there is no grass.
chapters.zh: 田野的母鹿生下小鹿，就撇弃，因为无草。

chapters.en: Wild donkeys stand on the barren heights and pant like jackals; their eyes fail for lack of food.”
chapters.zh: 野驴站在净光的高处，喘气好像野狗。因为无草，眼目失明。

chapters.en: Although our sins testify against us, do something, LORD, for the sake of your name. For we have often rebelled; we have sinned against you.
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，我们的罪孽虽然作见证告我们，还求你为你名的缘故行事。我们本是多次背道，得罪了你。

chapters.en: You who are the hope of Israel, its Savior in times of distress, why are you like a stranger in the land, like a traveler who stays only a night?
chapters.zh: 以色列所盼望，在患难时作他救主的阿，你为何在这地像寄居的，又像行路的只住一宵呢？

chapters.en: Why are you like a man taken by surprise, like a warrior powerless to save? You are among us, LORD, and we bear your name; do not forsake us!
chapters.zh: 你为何像受惊的人，像不能救人的勇士呢？耶和华阿，你仍在我们中间。我们也称为你名下的人，求你不要离开我们。

chapters.en: This is what the LORD says about this people: “They greatly love to wander; they do not restrain their feet. So the LORD does not accept them; he will now remember their wickedness and punish them for their sins.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华对这百姓如此说，这百姓喜爱妄行（原文作飘流），不禁止脚步，所以耶和华不悦纳他们。现今要记念他们的罪孽，追讨他们的罪恶。

chapters.en: Then the LORD said to me, “Do not pray for the well-being of this people.
chapters.zh: 耶和华又对我说，不要为这百姓祈祷求好处。

chapters.en: Although they fast, I will not listen to their cry; though they offer burnt offerings and grain offerings, I will not accept them. Instead, I will destroy them with the sword, famine and plague.”
chapters.zh: 他们禁食的时候，我不听他们的呼求。他们献燔祭和素祭，我也不悦纳。我却要用刀剑，饥荒，瘟疫灭绝他们。

chapters.en: But I said, “Alas, Sovereign LORD! The prophets keep telling them, ‘You will not see the sword or suffer famine. Indeed, I will give you lasting peace in this place.’ ”
chapters.zh: 我就说，唉。主耶和华阿，那些先知常对他们说，你们必不看见刀剑，也不遭遇饥荒。耶和华要在这地方赐你们长久的平安。

chapters.en: Then the LORD said to me, “The prophets are prophesying lies in my name. I have not sent them or appointed them or spoken to them. They are prophesying to you false visions, divinations, idolatries and the delusions of their own minds.
chapters.zh: 耶和华对我说，那些先知托我的名说假预言，我并没有打发他们，没有吩咐他们，也没有对他们说话。他们向你们预言的，乃是虚假的异象和占卜，并虚无的事，以及本心的诡诈。

chapters.en: Therefore this is what the LORD says about the prophets who are prophesying in my name: I did not send them, yet they are saying, ‘No sword or famine will touch this land.’ Those same prophets will perish by sword and famine.
chapters.zh: 所以耶和华如此说，论到托我名说预言的那些先知，我并没有打发他们。他们还说这地不能有刀剑饥荒，其实那些先知必被刀剑饥荒灭绝。

chapters.en: And the people they are prophesying to will be thrown out into the streets of Jerusalem because of the famine and sword. There will be no one to bury them, their wives, their sons and their daughters. I will pour out on them the calamity they deserve.
chapters.zh: 听他们说预言的百姓必因饥荒刀剑抛在耶路撒冷的街道上，无人葬埋。他们连妻子带儿女，都是如此。我必将他们的恶倒在他们身上（或作我必使他们罪恶的报应临到他们身上）。

chapters.en: “Speak this word to them: “ ‘Let my eyes overflow with tears night and day without ceasing; for the Virgin Daughter, my people, has suffered a grievous wound, a crushing blow.
chapters.zh: 你要将这话对他们说，愿我眼泪汪汪，昼夜不息，因为我百姓（原文作民的处女）受了裂口破坏的大伤。

chapters.en: If I go into the country, I see those slain by the sword; if I go into the city, I see the ravages of famine. Both prophet and priest have gone to a land they know not.’ ”
chapters.zh: 我若出往田间，就见有被刀杀的。我若进入城内，就见有因饥荒患病的。连先知带祭司在国中往来，也是毫无知识（或作不知怎样才好）。

chapters.en: Have you rejected Judah completely? Do you despise Zion? Why have you afflicted us so that we cannot be healed? We hoped for peace but no good has come, for a time of healing but there is only terror.
chapters.zh: 你全然弃掉犹大吗？你心厌恶锡安吗？为何击打我们，以致无法医治呢？我们指望平安，却得不着好处。指望痊愈，不料，受了惊惶。

chapters.en: We acknowledge our wickedness, LORD, and the guilt of our ancestors; we have indeed sinned against you.
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，我们承认自己的罪恶，和我们列祖的罪孽，因我们得罪了你。

chapters.en: For the sake of your name do not despise us; do not dishonor your glorious throne. Remember your covenant with us and do not break it.
chapters.zh: 求你为你名的缘故，不厌恶我们，不辱没你荣耀的宝座。求你追念，不要背了与我们所立的约。

chapters.en: Do any of the worthless idols of the nations bring rain? Do the skies themselves send down showers? No, it is you, LORD our God. Therefore our hope is in you, for you are the one who does all this.
chapters.zh: 外邦人虚无的神中有能降雨的吗？天能自降甘霖吗？耶和华我们的神阿，能如此的不是你吗？所以，我们仍要等候你，因为这一切都是你所造的。

chapters.en: Then the LORD said to me: “Even if Moses and Samuel were to stand before me, my heart would not go out to this people. Send them away from my presence! Let them go!
chapters.zh: 耶和华对我说，虽有摩西和撒母耳站在我面前代求，我的心也不顾惜这百姓。你将他们从我眼前赶出，叫他们去吧。

chapters.en: And if they ask you, ‘Where shall we go?’ tell them, ‘This is what the LORD says: “ ‘Those destined for death, to death; those for the sword, to the sword; those for starvation, to starvation; those for captivity, to captivity.’
chapters.zh: 他们问你说，我们往哪里去呢？你便告诉他们，耶和华如此说，定为死亡的，必至死亡。定为刀杀的，必交刀杀。定为饥荒的，必遭饥荒。定为掳掠的，必被掳掠。

chapters.en: “I will send four kinds of destroyers against them,” declares the LORD, “the sword to kill and the dogs to drag away and the birds and the wild animals to devour and destroy.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说，我命定四样害他们，就是刀剑杀戮，狗类撕裂，空中的飞鸟，和地上的野兽吞吃毁灭。

chapters.en: I will make them abhorrent to all the kingdoms of the earth because of what Manasseh son of Hezekiah king of Judah did in Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 又必使他们在天下万国中抛来抛去，都因犹大王希西家的儿子玛拿西在耶路撒冷所行的事。

chapters.en: “Who will have pity on you, Jerusalem? Who will mourn for you? Who will stop to ask how you are?
chapters.zh: 耶路撒冷阿，谁可怜你呢？谁为你悲伤呢？谁转身问你的安呢？

chapters.en: You have rejected me,” declares the LORD. “You keep on backsliding. So I will reach out and destroy you; I am tired of holding back.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说，你弃绝了我，转身退后。因此我伸手攻击你，毁坏你。我后悔甚不耐烦。

chapters.en: I will winnow them with a winnowing fork at the city gates of the land. I will bring bereavement and destruction on my people, for they have not changed their ways.
chapters.zh: 我在境内各城门口（或作我在这地边界的关口），用簸箕簸了我的百姓，使他们丧掉儿女。我毁灭他们，他们仍不转离所行的道。

chapters.en: I will make their widows more numerous than the sand of the sea. At midday I will bring a destroyer against the mothers of their young men; suddenly I will bring down on them anguish and terror.
chapters.zh: 他们的寡妇在我面前比海沙更多。我使灭命的午间来，攻击少年人的母亲，使痛苦惊吓忽然临到她身上。

chapters.en: The mother of seven will grow faint and breathe her last. Her sun will set while it is still day; she will be disgraced and humiliated. I will put the survivors to the sword before their enemies,” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 生过七子的妇人力衰气绝。尚在白昼，日头忽落。她抱愧蒙羞。其余的人，我必在他们敌人跟前，交与刀剑。这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: Alas, my mother, that you gave me birth, a man with whom the whole land strives and contends! I have neither lent nor borrowed, yet everyone curses me.
chapters.zh: 我的母亲哪，我有祸了。因你生我作为遍地相争相竞的人。我素来没有借贷与人，人也没有借贷与我，人人却都咒骂我。

chapters.en: The LORD said, “Surely I will deliver you for a good purpose; surely I will make your enemies plead with you in times of disaster and times of distress.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说，我必要坚固你，使你得好处。灾祸苦难临到的时候，我必要使仇敌央求你。

chapters.en: “Can a man break iron— iron from the north—or bronze?
chapters.zh: 人岂能将铜与铁，就是北方的铁折断呢？

chapters.en: “Your wealth and your treasures I will give as plunder, without charge, because of all your sins throughout your country.
chapters.zh: 我必因你在四境之内所犯的一切罪，把你的货物财宝当掠物，白白地交给仇敌。

chapters.en: I will enslave you to your enemies in a land you do not know, for my anger will kindle a fire that will burn against you.”
chapters.zh: 我也必使仇敌带这掠物到你所不认识的地去，因我怒中起的火要将你们焚烧。

chapters.en: LORD, you understand; remember me and care for me. Avenge me on my persecutors. You are long-suffering—do not take me away; think of how I suffer reproach for your sake.
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，你是知道的。求你记念我，眷顾我，向逼迫我的人为我报仇。不要向他们忍怒取我的命，要知道我为你的缘故受了凌辱。

chapters.en: When your words came, I ate them; they were my joy and my heart’s delight, for I bear your name, LORD God Almighty.
chapters.zh: 耶和华万军之神阿，我得着你的言语就当食物吃了。你的言语是我心中的欢喜快乐，因我是称为你名下的人。

chapters.en: I never sat in the company of revelers, never made merry with them; I sat alone because your hand was on me and you had filled me with indignation.
chapters.zh: 我没有坐在宴乐人的会中，也没有欢乐。我因你的感动（感动原文作手）独自静坐，因你使我满心愤恨。

chapters.en: Why is my pain unending and my wound grievous and incurable? You are to me like a deceptive brook, like a spring that fails.
chapters.zh: 我的痛苦为何长久不止呢？我的伤痕为何无法医治，不能痊愈呢？难道你待我有诡诈，像流干的河道吗？

chapters.en: Therefore this is what the LORD says: “If you repent, I will restore you that you may serve me; if you utter worthy, not worthless, words, you will be my spokesman. Let this people turn to you, but you must not turn to them.
chapters.zh: 耶和华如此说，你若归回，我就将你再带来，使你站在我面前。你若将宝贵的和下贱的分别出来，你就可以当作我的口。他们必归向你，你却不可归向他们。

chapters.en: I will make you a wall to this people, a fortified wall of bronze; they will fight against you but will not overcome you, for I am with you to rescue and save you,” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 我必使你向这百姓成为坚固的铜墙。他们必攻击你，却不能胜你。因我与你同在，要拯救你，搭救你。这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: “I will save you from the hands of the wicked and deliver you from the grasp of the cruel.”
chapters.zh: 我必搭救你脱离恶人的手，救赎你脱离强暴人的手。

chapters.en: Then the word of the LORD came to me:
chapters.zh: 耶和华的话又临到我说，

chapters.en: “You must not marry and have sons or daughters in this place.”
chapters.zh: 你在这地方不可娶妻，生儿养女。

chapters.en: For this is what the LORD says about the sons and daughters born in this land and about the women who are their mothers and the men who are their fathers:
chapters.zh: 因为论到在这地方所生的儿女，又论到在这国中生养他们的父母，耶和华如此说，

chapters.en: “They will die of deadly diseases. They will not be mourned or buried but will be like dung lying on the ground. They will perish by sword and famine, and their dead bodies will become food for the birds and the wild animals.”
chapters.zh: 他们必死得甚苦，无人哀哭，必不得葬埋，必在地上像粪土，必被刀剑和饥荒灭绝。他们的尸首必给空中的飞鸟和地上的野兽作食物。

chapters.en: For this is what the LORD says: “Do not enter a house where there is a funeral meal; do not go to mourn or show sympathy, because I have withdrawn my blessing, my love and my pity from this people,” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 耶和华如此说，不要进入丧家，不要去哀哭，也不要为他们悲伤，因我已将我的平安，慈爱，怜悯从这百姓夺去了。这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: “Both high and low will die in this land. They will not be buried or mourned, and no one will cut themselves or shave their head for the dead.
chapters.zh: 连大带小，都必在这地死亡，不得葬埋。人必不为他们哀哭，不用刀划身，也不使头光秃。

chapters.en: No one will offer food to comfort those who mourn for the dead—not even for a father or a mother—nor will anyone give them a drink to console them.
chapters.zh: 他们有丧事，人必不为他们掰饼，因死人安慰他们。他们丧父丧母，人也不给他们一杯酒安慰他们。

chapters.en: “And do not enter a house where there is feasting and sit down to eat and drink.
chapters.zh: 你不可进入宴乐的家，与他们同坐吃喝。

chapters.en: For this is what the LORD Almighty, the God of Israel, says: Before your eyes and in your days I will bring an end to the sounds of joy and gladness and to the voices of bride and bridegroom in this place.
chapters.zh: 因为万军之耶和华以色列的神如此说，你们还活着的日子在你们眼前，我必使欢喜和快乐的声音，新郎和新妇的声音，从这地方止息了。

chapters.en: “When you tell these people all this and they ask you, ‘Why has the LORD decreed such a great disaster against us? What wrong have we done? What sin have we committed against the LORD our God?’
chapters.zh: 你将这一切的话指示这百姓。他们问你说，耶和华为什么说，要降这大灾祸攻击我们呢？我们有什么罪孽呢？我们向耶和华我们的神犯了什么罪呢？

chapters.en: then say to them, ‘It is because your ancestors forsook me,’ declares the LORD, ‘and followed other gods and served and worshiped them. They forsook me and did not keep my law.
chapters.zh: 你就对他们说，耶和华说，因为你们列祖离弃我，随从别神，事奉敬拜，不遵守我的律法，

chapters.en: But you have behaved more wickedly than your ancestors. See how all of you are following the stubbornness of your evil hearts instead of obeying me.
chapters.zh: 而且你们行恶比你们列祖更甚。因为各人随从自己顽梗的恶心行事，甚至不听从我，

chapters.en: So I will throw you out of this land into a land neither you nor your ancestors have known, and there you will serve other gods day and night, for I will show you no favor.’
chapters.zh: 所以我必将你们从这地赶出，直赶到你们和你们列祖素不认识的地。你们在那里必昼夜事奉别神，因为我必不向你们施恩。

chapters.en: “However, the days are coming,” declares the LORD, “when it will no longer be said, ‘As surely as the LORD lives, who brought the Israelites up out of Egypt,’
chapters.zh: 耶和华说，日子将到，人必不再指着那领以色列人从埃及地上来之永生的耶和华起誓，

chapters.en: but it will be said, ‘As surely as the LORD lives, who brought the Israelites up out of the land of the north and out of all the countries where he had banished them.’ For I will restore them to the land I gave their ancestors.
chapters.zh: 却要指着那领以色列人从北方之地，并赶他们到的各国上来之永生的耶和华起誓，并且我要领他们再入我从前赐给他们列祖之地。

chapters.en: “But now I will send for many fishermen,” declares the LORD, “and they will catch them. After that I will send for many hunters, and they will hunt them down on every mountain and hill and from the crevices of the rocks.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说，我要召许多打鱼的把以色列人打上来，然后我要召许多打猎的，从各山上，各冈上，各石穴中猎取他们。

chapters.en: My eyes are on all their ways; they are not hidden from me, nor is their sin concealed from my eyes.
chapters.zh: 因我的眼目察看他们的一切行为。他们不能在我面前遮掩，他们的罪孽也不能在我眼前隐藏。

chapters.en: I will repay them double for their wickedness and their sin, because they have defiled my land with the lifeless forms of their vile images and have filled my inheritance with their detestable idols.”
chapters.zh: 我先要加倍报应他们的罪孽和罪恶。因为他们用可憎之尸玷污我的地土，又用可厌之物充满我的产业。

chapters.en: LORD, my strength and my fortress, my refuge in time of distress, to you the nations will come from the ends of the earth and say, “Our ancestors possessed nothing but false gods, worthless idols that did them no good.
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，你是我的力量，是我的保障。在苦难之日是我的避难所。列国人必从地极来到你这里，说，我们列祖所承受的，不过是虚假，是虚空无益之物。

chapters.en: Do people make their own gods? Yes, but they are not gods!”
chapters.zh: 人岂可为自己制造神呢？其实这不是神。

chapters.en: “Therefore I will teach them— this time I will teach them my power and might. Then they will know that my name is the LORD.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说，我要使他们知道，就是这一次使他们知道我的手和我的能力。他们就知道我的名是耶和华了。

chapters.en: “Judah’s sin is engraved with an iron tool, inscribed with a flint point, on the tablets of their hearts and on the horns of their altars.
chapters.zh: 犹大的罪是用铁笔，用金钢钻记录的，铭刻在他们的心版上和坛角上。

chapters.en: Even their children remember their altars and Asherah poles beside the spreading trees and on the high hills.
chapters.zh: 他们的儿女记念他们高冈上，青翠树旁的坛和木偶。

chapters.en: My mountain in the land and your wealth and all your treasures I will give away as plunder, together with your high places, because of sin throughout your country.
chapters.zh: 我田野的山哪，我必因你在四境之内所犯的罪，把你的货物，财宝，并丘坛当掠物交给仇敌。

chapters.en: Through your own fault you will lose the inheritance I gave you. I will enslave you to your enemies in a land you do not know, for you have kindled my anger, and it will burn forever.”
chapters.zh: 并且你因自己的罪必失去我所赐给你的产业。我也必使你在你所不认识的地上服事你的仇敌。因为你使我怒中起火，直烧到永远。

chapters.en: This is what the LORD says: “Cursed is the one who trusts in man, who draws strength from mere flesh and whose heart turns away from the LORD.
chapters.zh: 耶和华如此说，倚靠人血肉的膀臂，心中离弃耶和华的，那人有祸了。

chapters.en: That person will be like a bush in the wastelands; they will not see prosperity when it comes. They will dwell in the parched places of the desert, in a salt land where no one lives.
chapters.zh: 因他必像沙漠的杜松，不见福乐来到，却要住旷野干旱之处，无人居住的碱地。

chapters.en: “But blessed is the one who trusts in the LORD, whose confidence is in him.
chapters.zh: 倚靠耶和华，以耶和华为可靠的，那人有福了。

chapters.en: They will be like a tree planted by the water that sends out its roots by the stream. It does not fear when heat comes; its leaves are always green. It has no worries in a year of drought and never fails to bear fruit.”
chapters.zh: 他必像树栽于水旁，在河边扎根，炎热来到，并不惧怕，叶子仍必青翠，在干旱之年毫无挂虑，而且结果不止。

chapters.en: The heart is deceitful above all things and beyond cure. Who can understand it?
chapters.zh: 人心比万物都诡诈，坏到极处，谁能识透呢？

chapters.en: “I the LORD search the heart and examine the mind, to reward each person according to their conduct, according to what their deeds deserve.”
chapters.zh: 我耶和华是鉴察人心，试验人肺腑的，要照各人所行的和他作事的结果报应他。

chapters.en: Like a partridge that hatches eggs it did not lay are those who gain riches by unjust means. When their lives are half gone, their riches will desert them, and in the end they will prove to be fools.
chapters.zh: 那不按正道得财的，好像鹧鸪抱不是自己下的蛋。到了中年，那财都必离开他，他终久成为愚顽人。

chapters.en: A glorious throne, exalted from the beginning, is the place of our sanctuary.
chapters.zh: 我们的圣所是荣耀的宝座，从太初安置在高处。

chapters.en: LORD, you are the hope of Israel; all who forsake you will be put to shame. Those who turn away from you will be written in the dust because they have forsaken the LORD, the spring of living water.
chapters.zh: 耶和华以色列的盼望阿，凡离弃你的必至蒙羞。耶和华说，离开我的，他们的名字必写在土里，因为他们离弃我这活水的泉源。

chapters.en: Heal me, LORD, and I will be healed; save me and I will be saved, for you are the one I praise.
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，求你医治我，我便痊愈，拯救我，我便得救。因你是我所赞美的。

chapters.en: They keep saying to me, “Where is the word of the LORD? Let it now be fulfilled!”
chapters.zh: 他们对我说，耶和华的话在哪里呢？叫这话应验吧。

chapters.en: I have not run away from being your shepherd; you know I have not desired the day of despair. What passes my lips is open before you.
chapters.zh: 至于我，那跟从你作牧人的职分，我并没有急忙离弃，也没有想那灾殃的日子。这是你知道的。我口中所出的言语都在你面前。

chapters.en: Do not be a terror to me; you are my refuge in the day of disaster.
chapters.zh: 不要使我因你惊恐。当灾祸的日子，你是我的避难所。

chapters.en: Let my persecutors be put to shame, but keep me from shame; let them be terrified, but keep me from terror. Bring on them the day of disaster; destroy them with double destruction.
chapters.zh: 愿那些逼迫我的蒙羞，却不要使我蒙羞。使他们惊惶，却不要使我惊惶。使灾祸的日子临到他们，以加倍的毁坏毁坏他们。

chapters.en: This is what the LORD said to me: “Go and stand at the Gate of the People, through which the kings of Judah go in and out; stand also at all the other gates of Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 耶和华对我如此说，你去站在平民的门口，就是犹大君王出入的门，又站在耶路撒冷的各门口，

chapters.en: Say to them, ‘Hear the word of the LORD, you kings of Judah and all people of Judah and everyone living in Jerusalem who come through these gates.
chapters.zh: 对他们说，你们这犹大君王和犹大众人，并耶路撒冷的一切居民，凡从这些门进入的都当听耶和华的话。

chapters.en: This is what the LORD says: Be careful not to carry a load on the Sabbath day or bring it through the gates of Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 耶和华如此说，你们要谨慎，不要在安息日担什么担子进入耶路撒冷的各门。

chapters.en: Do not bring a load out of your houses or do any work on the Sabbath, but keep the Sabbath day holy, as I commanded your ancestors.
chapters.zh: 也不要在安息日从家中担出担子去。无论何工都不可作，只要以安息日为圣日，正如我所吩咐你们列祖的。

chapters.en: Yet they did not listen or pay attention; they were stiff-necked and would not listen or respond to discipline.
chapters.zh: 他们却不听从，不侧耳而听，竟硬着颈项不听，不受教训。

chapters.en: But if you are careful to obey me, declares the LORD, and bring no load through the gates of this city on the Sabbath, but keep the Sabbath day holy by not doing any work on it,
chapters.zh: 耶和华说，你们若留意听从我，在安息日不担什么担子进入这城的各门，只以安息日为圣日，在那日无论何工都不作。

chapters.en: then kings who sit on David’s throne will come through the gates of this city with their officials. They and their officials will come riding in chariots and on horses, accompanied by the men of Judah and those living in Jerusalem, and this city will be inhabited forever.
chapters.zh: 那时就有坐大卫宝座的君王和首领，他们与犹大人，并耶路撒冷的居民，或坐车，或骑马，进入这城的各门，而且这城必存到永远。

chapters.en: People will come from the towns of Judah and the villages around Jerusalem, from the territory of Benjamin and the western foothills, from the hill country and the Negev, bringing burnt offerings and sacrifices, grain offerings and incense, and bringing thank offerings to the house of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 也必有人从犹大城邑和耶路撒冷四围的各处，从便雅悯地，高原，山地，并南地而来，都带燔祭，平安祭，素祭，和乳香，并感谢祭，到耶和华的殿去。

chapters.en: But if you do not obey me to keep the Sabbath day holy by not carrying any load as you come through the gates of Jerusalem on the Sabbath day, then I will kindle an unquenchable fire in the gates of Jerusalem that will consume her fortresses.’ ”
chapters.zh: 你们若不听从我，不以安息日为圣日，仍在安息日担担子，进入耶路撒冷的各门，我必在各门中点火。这火也必烧毁耶路撒冷的宫殿，不能熄灭。

chapters.en: This is the word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD:
chapters.zh: 耶和华的话临到耶利米说，

chapters.en: “Go down to the potter’s house, and there I will give you my message.”
chapters.zh: 你起来，下到窑匠的家里去，我在那里要使你听我的话。

chapters.en: So I went down to the potter’s house, and I saw him working at the wheel.
chapters.zh: 我就下到窑匠的家里去，正遇他转轮作器皿。

chapters.en: But the pot he was shaping from the clay was marred in his hands; so the potter formed it into another pot, shaping it as seemed best to him.
chapters.zh: 窑匠用泥作的器皿，在他手中作坏了，他又用这泥另作别的器皿。窑匠看怎样好，就怎样作。

chapters.en: Then the word of the LORD came to me.
chapters.zh: 耶和华的话就临到我说，

chapters.en: He said, “Can I not do with you, Israel, as this potter does?” declares the LORD. “Like clay in the hand of the potter, so are you in my hand, Israel.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说，以色列家阿，我待你们，岂不能照这窑匠弄泥吗？以色列家阿，泥在窑匠的手中怎样，你们在我的手中也怎样。

chapters.en: If at any time I announce that a nation or kingdom is to be uprooted, torn down and destroyed,
chapters.zh: 我何时论到一邦或一国说，要拔出，拆毁，毁坏。

chapters.en: and if that nation I warned repents of its evil, then I will relent and not inflict on it the disaster I had planned.
chapters.zh: 我所说的那一邦，若是转意离开他们的恶，我就必后悔，不将我想要施行的灾祸降与他们。

chapters.en: And if at another time I announce that a nation or kingdom is to be built up and planted,
chapters.zh: 我何时论到一邦或一国说，要建立，栽植。

chapters.en: and if it does evil in my sight and does not obey me, then I will reconsider the good I had intended to do for it.
chapters.zh: 他们若行我眼中看为恶的事，不听从我的话，我就必后悔，不将我所说的福气赐给他们。

chapters.en: “Now therefore say to the people of Judah and those living in Jerusalem, ‘This is what the LORD says: Look! I am preparing a disaster for you and devising a plan against you. So turn from your evil ways, each one of you, and reform your ways and your actions.’
chapters.zh: 现在你要对犹大人和耶路撒冷的居民说，耶和华如此说，我造出灾祸攻击你们，定意刑罚你们。你们各人当回头离开所行的恶道，改正你们的行动作为。

chapters.en: But they will reply, ‘It’s no use. We will continue with our own plans; we will all follow the stubbornness of our evil hearts.’ ”
chapters.zh: 他们却说，这是枉然。我们要照自己的计谋去行。各人随自己顽梗的恶心作事。

chapters.en: Therefore this is what the LORD says: “Inquire among the nations: Who has ever heard anything like this? A most horrible thing has been done by Virgin Israel.
chapters.zh: 所以，耶和华如此说，你们且往各国访问，有谁听见这样的事。以色列民（原文作处女）行了一件极可憎恶的事。

chapters.en: Does the snow of Lebanon ever vanish from its rocky slopes? Do its cool waters from distant sources ever stop flowing?
chapters.zh: 利巴嫩的雪从田野的磐石上岂能断绝呢？从远处流下的凉水岂能干涸呢？

chapters.en: Yet my people have forgotten me; they burn incense to worthless idols, which made them stumble in their ways, in the ancient paths. They made them walk in byways, on roads not built up.
chapters.zh: 我的百姓竟忘记我，向假神烧香，使他们在所行的路上，在古道上绊跌，使他们行没有修筑的斜路，

chapters.en: Their land will be an object of horror and of lasting scorn; all who pass by will be appalled and will shake their heads.
chapters.zh: 以致他们的地令人惊骇，常常嗤笑。凡经过这地的必惊骇摇头。

chapters.en: Like a wind from the east, I will scatter them before their enemies; I will show them my back and not my face in the day of their disaster.”
chapters.zh: 我必在仇敌面前分散他们，好像用东风吹散一样。遭难的日子，我必以背向他们，不以面向他们。

chapters.en: They said, “Come, let’s make plans against Jeremiah; for the teaching of the law by the priest will not cease, nor will counsel from the wise, nor the word from the prophets. So come, let’s attack him with our tongues and pay no attention to anything he says.”
chapters.zh: 他们就说，来吧。我们可以设计谋害耶利米。因为我们有祭司讲律法，智慧人设谋略，先知说预言，都不能断绝。来吧。我们可以用舌头击打他，不要理会他的一切话。

chapters.en: Listen to me, LORD; hear what my accusers are saying!
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，求你理会我，且听那些与我争竞之人的话。

chapters.en: Should good be repaid with evil? Yet they have dug a pit for me. Remember that I stood before you and spoke in their behalf to turn your wrath away from them.
chapters.zh: 岂可以恶报善呢？他们竟挖坑要害我的性命。求你记念我怎样站在你面前为他们代求，要使你的忿怒向他们转消。

chapters.en: So give their children over to famine; hand them over to the power of the sword. Let their wives be made childless and widows; let their men be put to death, their young men slain by the sword in battle.
chapters.zh: 故此，愿你将他们的儿女交与饥荒和刀剑。愿他们的妻无子，且作寡妇。又愿他们的男人被死亡所灭，他们的少年人在阵上被刀击杀。

chapters.en: Let a cry be heard from their houses when you suddenly bring invaders against them, for they have dug a pit to capture me and have hidden snares for my feet.
chapters.zh: 你使敌军忽然临到他们的时候，愿人听见哀声从他们的屋内发出。因他们挖坑要捉拿我，暗设网罗要绊我的脚。

chapters.en: But you, LORD, know all their plots to kill me. Do not forgive their crimes or blot out their sins from your sight. Let them be overthrown before you; deal with them in the time of your anger.
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，他们要杀我的那一切计谋，你都知道。不要赦免他们的罪孽，也不要从你面前涂抹他们的罪恶，要叫他们在你面前跌倒。愿你发怒的时候罚办他们。

chapters.en: This is what the LORD says: “Go and buy a clay jar from a potter. Take along some of the elders of the people and of the priests
chapters.zh: 耶和华如此说，你去买窑匠的瓦瓶，又带百姓中的长老和祭司中的长老，

chapters.en: and go out to the Valley of Ben Hinnom, near the entrance of the Potsherd Gate. There proclaim the words I tell you,
chapters.zh: 出去到欣嫩子谷，哈珥西（哈珥西就是瓦片的意思）的门口那里，宣告我所吩咐你的话，

chapters.en: and say, ‘Hear the word of the LORD, you kings of Judah and people of Jerusalem. This is what the LORD Almighty, the God of Israel, says: Listen! I am going to bring a disaster on this place that will make the ears of everyone who hears of it tingle.
chapters.zh: 说，犹大君王和耶路撒冷的居民哪，当听耶和华的话。万军之耶和华以色列的神如此说，我必使灾祸临到这地方，凡听见的人都必耳鸣。

chapters.en: For they have forsaken me and made this a place of foreign gods; they have burned incense in it to gods that neither they nor their ancestors nor the kings of Judah ever knew, and they have filled this place with the blood of the innocent.
chapters.zh: 因为他们和他们列祖，并犹大君王离弃我，将这地方看为平常，在这里向素不认识的别神烧香，又使这地方满了无辜人的血，

chapters.en: They have built the high places of Baal to burn their children in the fire as offerings to Baal—something I did not command or mention, nor did it enter my mind.
chapters.zh: 又建筑巴力的丘坛，好在火中焚烧自己的儿子，作为燔祭献给巴力。这不是我所吩咐的，不是我所提说的，也不是我心所起的意。

chapters.en: So beware, the days are coming, declares the LORD, when people will no longer call this place Topheth or the Valley of Ben Hinnom, but the Valley of Slaughter.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说，因此，日子将到，这地方不再称为陀斐特和欣嫩子谷，反倒称为杀戮谷。

chapters.en: “ ‘In this place I will ruin the plans of Judah and Jerusalem. I will make them fall by the sword before their enemies, at the hands of those who want to kill them, and I will give their carcasses as food to the birds and the wild animals.
chapters.zh: 我必在这地方使犹大和耶路撒冷的计谋落空，也必使他们在仇敌面前倒于刀下，并寻索其命的人手下。他们的尸首，我必给空中的飞鸟和地上的野兽作食物。

chapters.en: I will devastate this city and make it an object of horror and scorn; all who pass by will be appalled and will scoff because of all its wounds.
chapters.zh: 我必使这城令人惊骇嗤笑。凡经过的人，必因这城所遭的灾惊骇嗤笑。

chapters.en: I will make them eat the flesh of their sons and daughters, and they will eat one another’s flesh because their enemies will press the siege so hard against them to destroy them.’
chapters.zh: 我必使他们在围困窘迫之中，就是仇敌和寻索其命的人窘迫他们的时候，各人吃自己儿女的肉和朋友的肉。

chapters.en: “Then break the jar while those who go with you are watching,
chapters.zh: 你要在同去的人眼前打碎那瓶，

chapters.en: and say to them, ‘This is what the LORD Almighty says: I will smash this nation and this city just as this potter’s jar is smashed and cannot be repaired. They will bury the dead in Topheth until there is no more room.
chapters.zh: 对他们说，万军之耶和华如此说，我要照样打碎这民和这城，正如人打碎窑匠的瓦器，以致不能再囫囵。并且人要在陀斐特葬埋尸首，甚至无处可葬。

chapters.en: This is what I will do to this place and to those who live here, declares the LORD. I will make this city like Topheth.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说，我必向这地方和其中的居民如此行，使这城与陀斐特一样。

chapters.en: The houses in Jerusalem and those of the kings of Judah will be defiled like this place, Topheth—all the houses where they burned incense on the roofs to all the starry hosts and poured out drink offerings to other gods.’ ”
chapters.zh: 耶路撒冷的房屋和犹大君王的宫殿是已经被玷污的，就是他们在其上向天上的万象烧香，向别神浇奠祭的宫殿房屋，都必与陀斐特一样。

chapters.en: Jeremiah then returned from Topheth, where the LORD had sent him to prophesy, and stood in the court of the LORD’s temple and said to all the people,
chapters.zh: 耶利米从陀斐特就是耶和华差他去说预言的地方回来，站在耶和华殿的院中，对众人说，

chapters.en: “This is what the LORD Almighty, the God of Israel, says: ‘Listen! I am going to bring on this city and all the villages around it every disaster I pronounced against them, because they were stiff-necked and would not listen to my words.’ ”
chapters.zh: 万军之耶和华以色列的神如此说，我必使我所说的一切灾祸临到这城和属城的一切城邑，因为他们硬着颈项不听我的话。

chapters.en: When the priest Pashhur son of Immer, the official in charge of the temple of the LORD, heard Jeremiah prophesying these things,
chapters.zh: 祭司音麦的儿子巴施户珥作耶和华殿的总管，听见耶利米预言这些事，

chapters.en: he had Jeremiah the prophet beaten and put in the stocks at the Upper Gate of Benjamin at the LORD’s temple.
chapters.zh: 他就打先知耶利米，用耶和华殿里便雅悯高门内的枷，将他枷在那里。

chapters.en: The next day, when Pashhur released him from the stocks, Jeremiah said to him, “The LORD’s name for you is not Pashhur, but Terror on Every Side.
chapters.zh: 次日，巴施户珥将耶利米开枷释放。于是耶利米对他说，耶和华不是叫你的名为巴施户珥，乃是叫你玛歌珥米撒毕（就是四面惊吓的意思）。

chapters.en: For this is what the LORD says: ‘I will make you a terror to yourself and to all your friends; with your own eyes you will see them fall by the sword of their enemies. I will give all Judah into the hands of the king of Babylon, who will carry them away to Babylon or put them to the sword.
chapters.zh: 因耶和华如此说，我必使你自觉惊吓，你也必使众朋友惊吓。他们必倒在仇敌的刀下，你也必亲眼看见。我必将犹大人全交在巴比伦王的手中，他要将他们掳到巴比伦去，也要用刀将他们杀戮。

chapters.en: I will deliver all the wealth of this city into the hands of their enemies—all its products, all its valuables and all the treasures of the kings of Judah. They will take it away as plunder and carry it off to Babylon.
chapters.zh: 并且我要将这城中的一切货财和劳碌得来的，并一切珍宝，以及犹大君王所有的宝物，都交在他们仇敌的手中。仇敌要当作掠物带到巴比伦去。

chapters.en: And you, Pashhur, and all who live in your house will go into exile to Babylon. There you will die and be buried, you and all your friends to whom you have prophesied lies.’ ”
chapters.zh: 你这巴施户珥和一切住在你家中的人都必被掳去。你和你的众朋友，就是你向他们说假预言的，都必到巴比伦去，要死在那里，葬在那里。

chapters.en: You deceived me, LORD, and I was deceived ; you overpowered me and prevailed. I am ridiculed all day long; everyone mocks me.
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，你曾劝导我，我也听了你的劝导。你比我有力量，且胜了我。我终日成为笑话，人人都戏弄我。

chapters.en: Whenever I speak, I cry out proclaiming violence and destruction. So the word of the LORD has brought me insult and reproach all day long.
chapters.zh: 我每逢讲论的时候，就发出哀声，我喊叫说，有强暴和毁灭。因为耶和华的话终日成了我的凌辱，讥刺。

chapters.en: But if I say, “I will not mention his word or speak anymore in his name,” his word is in my heart like a fire, a fire shut up in my bones. I am weary of holding it in; indeed, I cannot.
chapters.zh: 我若说，我不再提耶和华，也不再奉他的名讲论，我便心里觉得似乎有烧着的火闭塞在我骨中，我就含忍不住，不能自禁。

chapters.en: I hear many whispering, “Terror on every side! Denounce him! Let’s denounce him!” All my friends are waiting for me to slip, saying, “Perhaps he will be deceived; then we will prevail over him and take our revenge on him.”
chapters.zh: 我听见了许多人的谗谤，四围都是惊吓。就是我知己的朋友也都窥探我，愿我跌倒，说，告他吧，我们也要告他。或者他被引诱，我们就能胜他，在他身上报仇。

chapters.en: But the LORD is with me like a mighty warrior; so my persecutors will stumble and not prevail. They will fail and be thoroughly disgraced; their dishonor will never be forgotten.
chapters.zh: 然而，耶和华与我同在，好像甚可怕的勇士。因此，逼迫我的必都绊跌，不能得胜。他们必大大蒙羞，就是受永不忘记的羞辱，因为他们行事没有智慧。

chapters.en: LORD Almighty, you who examine the righteous and probe the heart and mind, let me see your vengeance on them, for to you I have committed my cause.
chapters.zh: 试验义人，察看人肺腑心肠的万军之耶和华阿，求你容我见你在他们身上报仇，因我将我的案件向你禀明了。

chapters.en: Sing to the LORD! Give praise to the LORD! He rescues the life of the needy from the hands of the wicked.
chapters.zh: 你们要向耶和华唱歌。赞美耶和华。因他救了穷人的性命脱离恶人的手。

chapters.en: Cursed be the day I was born! May the day my mother bore me not be blessed!
chapters.zh: 愿我生的那日受咒诅。愿我母亲产我的那日不蒙福。

chapters.en: Cursed be the man who brought my father the news, who made him very glad, saying, “A child is born to you—a son!”
chapters.zh: 给我父亲报信说你得了儿子，使我父亲甚欢喜的，愿那人受咒诅。

chapters.en: May that man be like the towns the LORD overthrew without pity. May he hear wailing in the morning, a battle cry at noon.
chapters.zh: 愿那人像耶和华所倾覆而不后悔的城邑。愿他早晨听见哀声，晌午听见呐喊。

chapters.en: For he did not kill me in the womb, with my mother as my grave, her womb enlarged forever.
chapters.zh: 因他在我未出胎的时候不杀我，使我母亲成了我的坟墓，胎就时常重大。

chapters.en: Why did I ever come out of the womb to see trouble and sorrow and to end my days in shame?
chapters.zh: 我为何出胎见劳碌愁苦，使我的年日因羞愧消灭呢？

chapters.en: The word came to Jeremiah from the LORD when King Zedekiah sent to him Pashhur son of Malkijah and the priest Zephaniah son of Maaseiah. They said:
chapters.zh: 耶和华的话临到耶利米。那时，西底家王打发玛基雅的儿子巴施户珥，和玛西雅的儿子祭司西番雅，去见耶利米，说，

chapters.en: “Inquire now of the LORD for us because Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon is attacking us. Perhaps the LORD will perform wonders for us as in times past so that he will withdraw from us.”
chapters.zh: 请你为我们求问耶和华。因为巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒来攻击我们，或者耶和华照他一切奇妙的作为待我们，使巴比伦王离开我们上去。

chapters.en: But Jeremiah answered them, “Tell Zedekiah,
chapters.zh: 耶利米对他们说，你们当对西底家这样说，

chapters.en: ‘This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: I am about to turn against you the weapons of war that are in your hands, which you are using to fight the king of Babylon and the Babylonians who are outside the wall besieging you. And I will gather them inside this city.
chapters.zh: 耶和华以色列的神如此说，我要使你们手中的兵器，就是你们在城外与巴比伦王和围困你们的迦勒底人打仗的兵器翻转过来，又要使这些都聚集在这城中。

chapters.en: I myself will fight against you with an outstretched hand and a mighty arm in furious anger and in great wrath.
chapters.zh: 并且我要在怒气，忿怒，和大恼恨中，用伸出来的手，并大能的膀臂，亲自攻击你们。

chapters.en: I will strike down those who live in this city—both man and beast—and they will die of a terrible plague.
chapters.zh: 又要击打这城的居民，连人带牲畜都必遭遇大瘟疫死亡。

chapters.en: After that, declares the LORD, I will give Zedekiah king of Judah, his officials and the people in this city who survive the plague, sword and famine, into the hands of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon and to their enemies who want to kill them. He will put them to the sword; he will show them no mercy or pity or compassion.’
chapters.zh: 以后我要将犹大王西底家和他的臣仆百姓，就是在城内，从瘟疫，刀剑，饥荒中剩下的人，都交在巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒的手中和他们仇敌，并寻索其命的人手中。巴比伦王必用刀击杀他们，不顾惜，不可怜，不怜悯。这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: “Furthermore, tell the people, ‘This is what the LORD says: See, I am setting before you the way of life and the way of death.
chapters.zh: 你要对这百姓说，耶和华如此说，看哪，我将生命的路和死亡的路摆在你们面前。

chapters.en: Whoever stays in this city will die by the sword, famine or plague. But whoever goes out and surrenders to the Babylonians who are besieging you will live; they will escape with their lives.
chapters.zh: 住在这城里的必遭刀剑，饥荒，瘟疫而死。但出去归降围困你们迦勒底人的必得存活，要以自己的命为掠物。

chapters.en: I have determined to do this city harm and not good, declares the LORD. It will be given into the hands of the king of Babylon, and he will destroy it with fire.’
chapters.zh: 耶和华说，我向这城变脸，降祸不降福。这城必交在巴比伦王的手中，他必用火焚烧。

chapters.en: “Moreover, say to the royal house of Judah, ‘Hear the word of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 至于犹大王的家，你们当听耶和华的话。

chapters.en: This is what the LORD says to you, house of David: “ ‘Administer justice every morning; rescue from the hand of the oppressor the one who has been robbed, or my wrath will break out and burn like fire because of the evil you have done— burn with no one to quench it.
chapters.zh: 大卫家阿，耶和华如此说，你们每早晨要施行公平，拯救被抢夺的脱离欺压人的手，恐怕我的忿怒因你们的恶行发作，如火着起，甚至无人能以熄灭。

chapters.en: I am against you, Jerusalem, you who live above this valley on the rocky plateau, declares the LORD— you who say, “Who can come against us? Who can enter our refuge?”
chapters.zh: 耶和华说，住山谷和平原磐石上的居民，你们说，谁能下来攻击我们。谁能进入我们的住处呢？看哪，我与你们为敌。

chapters.en: I will punish you as your deeds deserve, declares the LORD. I will kindle a fire in your forests that will consume everything around you.’ ”
chapters.zh: 耶和华又说，我必按你们作事的结果刑罚你们。我也必使火在耶路撒冷的林中着起，将她四围所有的尽行烧灭。

chapters.en: This is what the LORD says: “Go down to the palace of the king of Judah and proclaim this message there:
chapters.zh: 耶和华如此说，你下到犹大王的宫中，在那里说这话，

chapters.en: ‘Hear the word of the LORD to you, king of Judah, you who sit on David’s throne—you, your officials and your people who come through these gates.
chapters.zh: 说，坐大卫宝座的犹大王阿，你和你的臣仆，并进入城门的百姓，都当听耶和华的话。

chapters.en: This is what the LORD says: Do what is just and right. Rescue from the hand of the oppressor the one who has been robbed. Do no wrong or violence to the foreigner, the fatherless or the widow, and do not shed innocent blood in this place.
chapters.zh: 耶和华如此说，你们要施行公平和公义，拯救被抢夺的脱离欺压人的手，不可亏负寄居的和孤儿寡妇，不可以强暴待他们，在这地方也不可流无辜人的血。

chapters.en: For if you are careful to carry out these commands, then kings who sit on David’s throne will come through the gates of this palace, riding in chariots and on horses, accompanied by their officials and their people.
chapters.zh: 你们若认真行这事，就必有坐大卫宝座的君王和他的臣仆百姓，或坐车或骑马，从这城的各门进入。

chapters.en: But if you do not obey these commands, declares the LORD, I swear by myself that this palace will become a ruin.’ ”
chapters.zh: 你们若不听这些话，耶和华说，我指着自己起誓，这城必变为荒场。

chapters.en: For this is what the LORD says about the palace of the king of Judah: “Though you are like Gilead to me, like the summit of Lebanon, I will surely make you like a wasteland, like towns not inhabited.
chapters.zh: 耶和华论到犹大王的家如此说，我看你如基列，如利巴嫩顶。然而，我必使你变为旷野，为无人居住的城邑。

chapters.en: I will send destroyers against you, each man with his weapons, and they will cut up your fine cedar beams and throw them into the fire.
chapters.zh: 我要预备行毁灭的人，各拿器械攻击你。他们要砍下你佳美的香柏树，扔在火中。

chapters.en: “People from many nations will pass by this city and will ask one another, ‘Why has the LORD done such a thing to this great city?’
chapters.zh: 许多国的民要经过这城，各人对邻舍说，耶和华为何向这大城如此行呢？

chapters.en: And the answer will be: ‘Because they have forsaken the covenant of the LORD their God and have worshiped and served other gods.’ ”
chapters.zh: 他们必回答说，是因离弃了耶和华他们神的约，事奉敬拜别神。

chapters.en: Do not weep for the dead king or mourn his loss; rather, weep bitterly for him who is exiled, because he will never return nor see his native land again.
chapters.zh: 不要为死人哭号。不要为他悲伤，却要为离家出外的人大大哭号。因为他不得再回来，也不得再见他的本国。

chapters.en: For this is what the LORD says about Shallum son of Josiah, who succeeded his father as king of Judah but has gone from this place: “He will never return.
chapters.zh: 因为耶和华论到从这地方出去的犹大王约西亚的儿子沙龙（列王下二十三章三十节名约哈斯），就是接续他父亲约西亚作王的，这样说，他必不得再回到这里来，

chapters.en: He will die in the place where they have led him captive; he will not see this land again.”
chapters.zh: 却要死在被掳去的地方，必不得再见这地。

chapters.en: “Woe to him who builds his palace by unrighteousness, his upper rooms by injustice, making his own people work for nothing, not paying them for their labor.
chapters.zh: 那行不义盖房，行不公造楼，白白使用人的手工不给工价的有祸了。

chapters.en: He says, ‘I will build myself a great palace with spacious upper rooms.’ So he makes large windows in it, panels it with cedar and decorates it in red.
chapters.zh: 他说，我要为自己盖广大的房，宽敞的楼，为自己开窗户。这楼房的护墙板是香柏木的，楼房是丹色油漆的。

chapters.en: “Does it make you a king to have more and more cedar? Did not your father have food and drink? He did what was right and just, so all went well with him.
chapters.zh: 难道你作王是在乎造香柏木楼房争胜吗？你的父亲岂不是也吃也喝，也施行公平和公义吗？那时他得了福乐。

chapters.en: He defended the cause of the poor and needy, and so all went well. Is that not what it means to know me?” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 他为困苦和穷乏人伸冤，那时就得了福乐。认识我不在乎此吗？这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: “But your eyes and your heart are set only on dishonest gain, on shedding innocent blood and on oppression and extortion.”
chapters.zh: 惟有你的眼和你的心专顾贪婪，流无辜人的血，行欺压和强暴。

chapters.en: Therefore this is what the LORD says about Jehoiakim son of Josiah king of Judah: “They will not mourn for him: ‘Alas, my brother! Alas, my sister!’ They will not mourn for him: ‘Alas, my master! Alas, his splendor!’
chapters.zh: 所以，耶和华论到犹大王约西亚的儿子约雅敬如此说，人必不为他举哀，说，哀哉。我的哥哥。或说，哀哉。我的姐姐。也不为他举哀，说，哀哉。我的主。或说，哀哉。我主的荣华。

chapters.en: He will have the burial of a donkey— dragged away and thrown outside the gates of Jerusalem.”
chapters.zh: 他被埋葬，好像埋驴一样，要拉出去扔在耶路撒冷的城门之外。

chapters.en: “Go up to Lebanon and cry out, let your voice be heard in Bashan, cry out from Abarim, for all your allies are crushed.
chapters.zh: 你要上利巴嫩哀号，在巴珊扬声，从亚巴琳哀号，因为你所亲爱的都毁灭了。

chapters.en: I warned you when you felt secure, but you said, ‘I will not listen!’ This has been your way from your youth; you have not obeyed me.
chapters.zh: 你兴盛的时候，我对你说话。你却说，我不听。你自幼年以来总是这样，不听从我的话。

chapters.en: The wind will drive all your shepherds away, and your allies will go into exile. Then you will be ashamed and disgraced because of all your wickedness.
chapters.zh: 你的牧人要被风吞吃，你所亲爱的必被掳去。那时你必因你一切的恶抱愧蒙羞。

chapters.en: You who live in ‘Lebanon, ’ who are nestled in cedar buildings, how you will groan when pangs come upon you, pain like that of a woman in labor!
chapters.zh: 你这住利巴嫩，在香柏树上搭窝的，有痛苦临到你，好像疼痛临到产难的妇人，那时你何等可怜。

chapters.en: “As surely as I live,” declares the LORD, “even if you, Jehoiachin son of Jehoiakim king of Judah, were a signet ring on my right hand, I would still pull you off.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说，犹大王约雅敬的儿子哥尼雅（又名耶哥尼雅下同），虽是我右手上带印的戒指，我凭我的永生起誓，也必将你从其上摘下来，

chapters.en: I will deliver you into the hands of those who want to kill you, those you fear—Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon and the Babylonians.
chapters.zh: 并且我必将你交给寻索你命的人和你所惧怕的人手中，就是巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒和迦勒底人的手中。

chapters.en: I will hurl you and the mother who gave you birth into another country, where neither of you was born, and there you both will die.
chapters.zh: 我也必将你和生你的母亲赶到别国，并不是你们生的地方。你们必死在那里，

chapters.en: You will never come back to the land you long to return to.”
chapters.zh: 但心中甚想归回之地，必不得归回。

chapters.en: Is this man Jehoiachin a despised, broken pot, an object no one wants? Why will he and his children be hurled out, cast into a land they do not know?
chapters.zh: 哥尼雅这人是被轻看，破坏的器皿吗？是无人喜爱的器皿吗？他和他的后裔为何被赶到不认识之地呢？

chapters.en: O land, land, land, hear the word of the LORD!
chapters.zh: 地阿，地阿，地阿，当听耶和华的话。

chapters.en: This is what the LORD says: “Record this man as if childless, a man who will not prosper in his lifetime, for none of his offspring will prosper, none will sit on the throne of David or rule anymore in Judah.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华如此说，要写明这人算为无子，是平生不得亨通的。因为他后裔中再无一人得亨通，能坐在大卫的宝座上治理犹大。

chapters.en: “Woe to the shepherds who are destroying and scattering the sheep of my pasture!” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说，那些残害，赶散我草场之羊的牧人有祸了。

chapters.en: Therefore this is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says to the shepherds who tend my people: “Because you have scattered my flock and driven them away and have not bestowed care on them, I will bestow punishment on you for the evil you have done,” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 耶和华以色列的神斥责那些牧养他百姓的牧人，如此说，你们赶散我的羊群，并没有看顾他们。我必讨你们这行恶的罪。这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: “I myself will gather the remnant of my flock out of all the countries where I have driven them and will bring them back to their pasture, where they will be fruitful and increase in number.
chapters.zh: 我要将我羊群中所余剩的，从我赶他们到的各国内招聚出来，领他们归回本圈。他们也必生养众多。

chapters.en: I will place shepherds over them who will tend them, and they will no longer be afraid or terrified, nor will any be missing,” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 我必设立照管他们的牧人，牧养他们。他们不再惧怕，不再惊惶，也不缺少一个。这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: “The days are coming,” declares the LORD, “when I will raise up for David a righteous Branch, a King who will reign wisely and do what is just and right in the land.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说，日子将到，我要给大卫兴起一个公义的苗裔。他必掌王权，行事有智慧，在地上施行公平和公义。

chapters.en: In his days Judah will be saved and Israel will live in safety. This is the name by which he will be called: The LORD Our Righteous Savior.
chapters.zh: 在他的日子，犹大必得救，以色列也安然居住。他的名必称为耶和华我们的义。

chapters.en: “So then, the days are coming,” declares the LORD, “when people will no longer say, ‘As surely as the LORD lives, who brought the Israelites up out of Egypt,’
chapters.zh: 耶和华说，日子将到，人必不再指着那领以色列人从埃及地上来永生的耶和华起誓，

chapters.en: but they will say, ‘As surely as the LORD lives, who brought the descendants of Israel up out of the land of the north and out of all the countries where he had banished them.’ Then they will live in their own land.”
chapters.zh: 却要指着那领以色列家的后裔从北方和赶他们到的各国中上来，永生的耶和华起誓。他们必住在本地。

chapters.en: Concerning the prophets: My heart is broken within me; all my bones tremble. I am like a drunken man, like a strong man overcome by wine, because of the LORD and his holy words.
chapters.zh: 论到那些先知，我心在我里面忧伤，我骨头都发颤。因耶和华和他的圣言，我像醉酒的人，像被酒所胜的人。

chapters.en: The land is full of adulterers; because of the curse the land lies parched and the pastures in the wilderness are withered. The prophets follow an evil course and use their power unjustly.
chapters.zh: 地满了行淫的人。因妄自赌咒，地就悲哀。旷野的草场都枯干了。他们所行的道乃是恶的。他们的勇力使得不正。

chapters.en: “Both prophet and priest are godless; even in my temple I find their wickedness,” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 连先知带祭司都是亵渎的，就是在我殿中我也看见他们的恶。这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: “Therefore their path will become slippery; they will be banished to darkness and there they will fall. I will bring disaster on them in the year they are punished,” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 因此，他们的道路必像黑暗中的滑地，他们必被追赶，在这路中仆倒。因为当追讨之年，我必使灾祸临到他们。这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: “Among the prophets of Samaria I saw this repulsive thing: They prophesied by Baal and led my people Israel astray.
chapters.zh: 我在撒玛利亚的先知中曾见愚妄。他们借巴力说预言，使我的百姓以色列走错了路。

chapters.en: And among the prophets of Jerusalem I have seen something horrible: They commit adultery and live a lie. They strengthen the hands of evildoers, so that not one of them turns from their wickedness. They are all like Sodom to me; the people of Jerusalem are like Gomorrah.”
chapters.zh: 我在耶路撒冷的先知中曾见可憎恶的事。他们行奸淫，作事虚妄，又坚固恶人的手，甚至无人回头离开他的恶。他们在我面前都像所多玛。耶路撒冷的居民都像蛾摩拉。

chapters.en: Therefore this is what the LORD Almighty says concerning the prophets: “I will make them eat bitter food and drink poisoned water, because from the prophets of Jerusalem ungodliness has spread throughout the land.”
chapters.zh: 所以万军之耶和华论到先知如此说，我必将茵陈给他们吃，又将苦胆水给他们喝。因为亵渎的事出于耶路撒冷的先知，流行遍地。

chapters.en: This is what the LORD Almighty says: “Do not listen to what the prophets are prophesying to you; they fill you with false hopes. They speak visions from their own minds, not from the mouth of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 万军之耶和华如此说，这些先知向你们说预言，你们不要听他们的话。他们以虚空教训你们，所说的异象是出于自己的心，不是出于耶和华的口。

chapters.en: They keep saying to those who despise me, ‘The LORD says: You will have peace.’ And to all who follow the stubbornness of their hearts they say, ‘No harm will come to you.’
chapters.zh: 他们常对藐视我的人说，耶和华说，你们必享平安。又对一切按自己顽梗之心而行的人说，必没有灾祸临到你们。

chapters.en: But which of them has stood in the council of the LORD to see or to hear his word? Who has listened and heard his word?
chapters.zh: 有谁站在耶和华的会中得以听见并会悟他的话呢？有谁留心听他的话呢？

chapters.en: See, the storm of the LORD will burst out in wrath, a whirlwind swirling down on the heads of the wicked.
chapters.zh: 看哪。耶和华的忿怒好像暴风，已经发出。是暴烈的旋风，必转到恶人的头上。

chapters.en: The anger of the LORD will not turn back until he fully accomplishes the purposes of his heart. In days to come you will understand it clearly.
chapters.zh: 耶和华的怒气必不转消，直到他心中所拟定的成就了。末后的日子你们要全然明白。

chapters.en: I did not send these prophets, yet they have run with their message; I did not speak to them, yet they have prophesied.
chapters.zh: 我没有打发那些先知，他们竟自奔跑。我没有对他们说话，他们竟自预言。

chapters.en: But if they had stood in my council, they would have proclaimed my words to my people and would have turned them from their evil ways and from their evil deeds.
chapters.zh: 他们若是站在我的会中，就必使我的百姓听我的话，又使他们回头离开恶道和他们所行的恶。

chapters.en: “Am I only a God nearby,” declares the LORD, “and not a God far away?
chapters.zh: 耶和华说，我岂为近处的神呢？不也为远处的神吗？

chapters.en: Who can hide in secret places so that I cannot see them?” declares the LORD. “Do not I fill heaven and earth?” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说，人岂能在隐密处藏身，使我看不见他呢？耶和华说，我岂不充满天地吗？

chapters.en: “I have heard what the prophets say who prophesy lies in my name. They say, ‘I had a dream! I had a dream!’
chapters.zh: 我已听见那些先知所说的，就是托我名说的假预言，他们说，我作了梦。我作了梦。

chapters.en: How long will this continue in the hearts of these lying prophets, who prophesy the delusions of their own minds?
chapters.zh: 说假预言的先知，就是预言本心诡诈的先知，他们这样存心要到几时呢？

chapters.en: They think the dreams they tell one another will make my people forget my name, just as their ancestors forgot my name through Baal worship.
chapters.zh: 他们各人将所作的梦对邻舍述说，想要使我的百姓忘记我的名，正如他们列祖因巴力忘记我的名一样。

chapters.en: Let the prophet who has a dream recount the dream, but let the one who has my word speak it faithfully. For what has straw to do with grain?” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 得梦的先知可以述说那梦。得我话的人可以诚实讲说我的话。糠秕怎能与麦子比较呢？这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: “Is not my word like fire,” declares the LORD, “and like a hammer that breaks a rock in pieces?
chapters.zh: 耶和华说，我的话岂不像火，又像能打碎磐石的大锤吗？

chapters.en: “Therefore,” declares the LORD, “I am against the prophets who steal from one another words supposedly from me.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说，那些先知各从邻舍偷窃我的言语，因此我必与他们反对。

chapters.en: Yes,” declares the LORD, “I am against the prophets who wag their own tongues and yet declare, ‘The LORD declares.’
chapters.zh: 耶和华说，那些先知用舌头，说是耶和华说的。我必与他们反对。

chapters.en: Indeed, I am against those who prophesy false dreams,” declares the LORD. “They tell them and lead my people astray with their reckless lies, yet I did not send or appoint them. They do not benefit these people in the least,” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说，那些以幻梦为预言，又述说这梦，以谎言和矜夸使我百姓走错了路的，我必与他们反对。我没有打发他们，也没有吩咐他们。他们与这百姓毫无益处。这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: “When these people, or a prophet or a priest, ask you, ‘What is the message from the LORD?’ say to them, ‘What message? I will forsake you, declares the LORD.’
chapters.zh: 无论是百姓，是先知，是祭司，问你说，耶和华有什么默示呢？你就对他们说，什么默示阿。耶和华说，我要撇弃你们。

chapters.en: If a prophet or a priest or anyone else claims, ‘This is a message from the LORD,’ I will punish them and their household.
chapters.zh: 无论是先知，是祭司，是百姓，说耶和华的默示，我必刑罚那人和他的家。

chapters.en: This is what each of you keeps saying to your friends and other Israelites: ‘What is the LORD’s answer?’ or ‘What has the LORD spoken?’
chapters.zh: 你们各人要对邻舍，各人要对弟兄如此说，耶和华回答什么？耶和华说了什么呢？

chapters.en: But you must not mention ‘a message from the LORD’ again, because each one’s word becomes their own message. So you distort the words of the living God, the LORD Almighty, our God.
chapters.zh: 耶和华的默示你们不可再提，各人所说的话必作自己的重担（重担和默示原文同），因为你们谬用永生神，万军之耶和华我们神的言语。

chapters.en: This is what you keep saying to a prophet: ‘What is the LORD’s answer to you?’ or ‘What has the LORD spoken?’
chapters.zh: 你们要对先知如此说，耶和华回答你什么。耶和华说了什么呢？

chapters.en: Although you claim, ‘This is a message from the LORD,’ this is what the LORD says: You used the words, ‘This is a message from the LORD,’ even though I told you that you must not claim, ‘This is a message from the LORD.’
chapters.zh: 你们若说耶和华的默示，耶和华就如此说，因你们说耶和华的默示这句话，我也打发人到你们那里去，告诉你们不可说耶和华的默示。

chapters.en: Therefore, I will surely forget you and cast you out of my presence along with the city I gave to you and your ancestors.
chapters.zh: 所以我必全然忘记你们，将你们和我所赐给你们并你们列祖的城撇弃了。

chapters.en: I will bring on you everlasting disgrace—everlasting shame that will not be forgotten.”
chapters.zh: 又必使永远的凌辱和长久的羞耻临到你们，是不能忘记的。

chapters.en: After Jehoiachin son of Jehoiakim king of Judah and the officials, the skilled workers and the artisans of Judah were carried into exile from Jerusalem to Babylon by Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, the LORD showed me two baskets of figs placed in front of the temple of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒将犹大王约雅敬的儿子耶哥尼雅和犹大的首领，并工匠，铁匠从耶路撒冷掳去，带到巴比伦。这事以后，耶和华指给我看，有两筐无花果放在耶和华的殿前。

chapters.en: One basket had very good figs, like those that ripen early; the other basket had very bad figs, so bad they could not be eaten.
chapters.zh: 一筐是极好的无花果，好像是初熟的。一筐是极坏的无花果，坏得不可吃。

chapters.en: Then the LORD asked me, “What do you see, Jeremiah?” “Figs,” I answered. “The good ones are very good, but the bad ones are so bad they cannot be eaten.”
chapters.zh: 于是耶和华问我说，耶利米你看见什么。我说，我看见无花果，好的极好，坏的极坏，坏得不可吃。

chapters.en: Then the word of the LORD came to me:
chapters.zh: 耶和华的话临到我说，

chapters.en: “This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: ‘Like these good figs, I regard as good the exiles from Judah, whom I sent away from this place to the land of the Babylonians.
chapters.zh: 耶和华以色列的神如此说，被掳去的犹大人，就是我打发离开这地到迦勒底人之地去的，我必看顾他们如这好无花果，使他们得好处。

chapters.en: My eyes will watch over them for their good, and I will bring them back to this land. I will build them up and not tear them down; I will plant them and not uproot them.
chapters.zh: 我要眷顾他们，使他们得好处，领他们归回这地。我也要建立他们，必不拆毁，栽植他们，并不拔出。

chapters.en: I will give them a heart to know me, that I am the LORD. They will be my people, and I will be their God, for they will return to me with all their heart.
chapters.zh: 我要赐他们认识我的心，知道我是耶和华。他们要作我的子民，我要作他们的神，因为他们要一心归向我。

chapters.en: “ ‘But like the bad figs, which are so bad they cannot be eaten,’ says the LORD, ‘so will I deal with Zedekiah king of Judah, his officials and the survivors from Jerusalem, whether they remain in this land or live in Egypt.
chapters.zh: 耶和华如此说，我必将犹大王西底家和他的首领，以及剩在这地耶路撒冷的余民，并住在埃及地的犹大人都交出来，好像那极坏，坏得不可吃的无花果。

chapters.en: I will make them abhorrent and an offense to all the kingdoms of the earth, a reproach and a byword, a curse and an object of ridicule, wherever I banish them.
chapters.zh: 我必使他们交出来，在天下万国中抛来抛去，遭遇灾祸。在我赶逐他们到的各处成为凌辱，笑谈，讥刺，咒诅。

chapters.en: I will send the sword, famine and plague against them until they are destroyed from the land I gave to them and their ancestors.’ ”
chapters.zh: 我必使刀剑，饥荒，瘟疫临到他们，直到他们从我所赐给他们和他们列祖之地灭绝。

chapters.en: The word came to Jeremiah concerning all the people of Judah in the fourth year of Jehoiakim son of Josiah king of Judah, which was the first year of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon.
chapters.zh: 犹大王约西亚的儿子约雅敬第四年，就是巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒的元年，耶和华论犹大众民的话临到耶利米。

chapters.en: So Jeremiah the prophet said to all the people of Judah and to all those living in Jerusalem:
chapters.zh: 先知耶利米就将这话对犹大众人和耶路撒冷的一切居民说，

chapters.en: For twenty-three years—from the thirteenth year of Josiah son of Amon king of Judah until this very day—the word of the LORD has come to me and I have spoken to you again and again, but you have not listened.
chapters.zh: 从犹大王亚们的儿子约西亚十三年直到今日，这二十三年之内，常有耶和华的话临到我。我也对你们传说，就是从早起来传说，只是你们没有听从。

chapters.en: And though the LORD has sent all his servants the prophets to you again and again, you have not listened or paid any attention.
chapters.zh: 耶和华也从早起来，差遣他的仆人众先知到你们这里来（只是你们没有听从，也没有侧耳而听），

chapters.en: They said, “Turn now, each of you, from your evil ways and your evil practices, and you can stay in the land the LORD gave to you and your ancestors for ever and ever.
chapters.zh: 说，你们各人当回头，离开恶道和所作的恶，便可居住耶和华古时所赐给你们和你们列祖之地，直到永远。

chapters.en: Do not follow other gods to serve and worship them; do not arouse my anger with what your hands have made. Then I will not harm you.”
chapters.zh: 不可随从别神事奉敬拜，以你们手所作的惹我发怒。这样，我就不加害与你们。

chapters.en: “But you did not listen to me,” declares the LORD, “and you have aroused my anger with what your hands have made, and you have brought harm to yourselves.”
chapters.zh: 然而你们没有听从我，竟以手所作的惹我发怒，陷害自己。这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: Therefore the LORD Almighty says this: “Because you have not listened to my words,
chapters.zh: 所以万军之耶和华如此说，因为你们没有听从我的话，

chapters.en: I will summon all the peoples of the north and my servant Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon,” declares the LORD, “and I will bring them against this land and its inhabitants and against all the surrounding nations. I will completely destroy them and make them an object of horror and scorn, and an everlasting ruin.
chapters.zh: 我必召北方的众族和我仆人巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒来攻击这地和这地的居民，并四围一切的国民。我要将他们尽行灭绝，以致他们令人惊骇，嗤笑，并且永久荒凉。这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: I will banish from them the sounds of joy and gladness, the voices of bride and bridegroom, the sound of millstones and the light of the lamp.
chapters.zh: 我又要使欢喜和快乐的声音，新郎和新妇的声音，推磨的声音和灯的亮光，从他们中间止息。

chapters.en: This whole country will become a desolate wasteland, and these nations will serve the king of Babylon seventy years.
chapters.zh: 这全地必然荒凉，令人惊骇。这些国民要服事巴比伦王七十年。

chapters.en: “But when the seventy years are fulfilled, I will punish the king of Babylon and his nation, the land of the Babylonians, for their guilt,” declares the LORD, “and will make it desolate forever.
chapters.zh: 七十年满了以后，我必刑罚巴比伦王和那国民，并迦勒底人之地，因他们的罪孽使那地永远荒凉。这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: I will bring on that land all the things I have spoken against it, all that are written in this book and prophesied by Jeremiah against all the nations.
chapters.zh: 我也必使我向那地所说的话，就是记在这书上的话，是耶利米向这些国民说的预言，都临到那地。

chapters.en: They themselves will be enslaved by many nations and great kings; I will repay them according to their deeds and the work of their hands.”
chapters.zh: 因为有多国和大君王必使迦勒底人作奴仆。我也必照他们的行为，按他们手所作的报应他们。

chapters.en: This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, said to me: “Take from my hand this cup filled with the wine of my wrath and make all the nations to whom I send you drink it.
chapters.zh: 耶和华以色列的神对我如此说，你从我手中接这杯忿怒的酒，使我所差遣你去的各国的民喝。

chapters.en: When they drink it, they will stagger and go mad because of the sword I will send among them.”
chapters.zh: 他们喝了就要东倒西歪，并要发狂，因我使刀剑临到他们中间。

chapters.en: So I took the cup from the LORD’s hand and made all the nations to whom he sent me drink it:
chapters.zh: 我就从耶和华的手中接了这杯，给耶和华所差遣我去的各国的民喝，

chapters.en: Jerusalem and the towns of Judah, its kings and officials, to make them a ruin and an object of horror and scorn, a curse —as they are today;
chapters.zh: 就是耶路撒冷和犹大的城邑，并耶路撒冷的君王与首领，使这城邑荒凉，令人惊骇，嗤笑，咒诅，正如今日一样。

chapters.en: Pharaoh king of Egypt, his attendants, his officials and all his people,
chapters.zh: 又有埃及王法老和他的臣仆，首领，以及他的众民，

chapters.en: and all the foreign people there; all the kings of Uz; all the kings of the Philistines (those of Ashkelon, Gaza, Ekron, and the people left at Ashdod);
chapters.zh: 并杂族的人民和乌斯地的诸王，与非利士地的诸王，亚实基伦，迦萨，以革伦，以及亚实突剩下的人。

chapters.en: Edom, Moab and Ammon;
chapters.zh: 以东，摩押，亚扪人，

chapters.en: all the kings of Tyre and Sidon; the kings of the coastlands across the sea;
chapters.zh: 推罗的诸王，西顿的诸王，海岛的诸王，

chapters.en: Dedan, Tema, Buz and all who are in distant places ;
chapters.zh: 底但，提玛，布斯，和一切剃周围头发的。

chapters.en: all the kings of Arabia and all the kings of the foreign people who live in the wilderness;
chapters.zh: 亚拉伯的诸王，住旷野杂族人民的诸王，

chapters.en: all the kings of Zimri, Elam and Media;
chapters.zh: 心利的诸王，以拦的诸王，玛代的诸王，

chapters.en: and all the kings of the north, near and far, one after the other—all the kingdoms on the face of the earth. And after all of them, the king of Sheshak will drink it too.
chapters.zh: 北方远近的诸王，以及天下地上的万国喝了，以后示沙克（就是巴比伦）王也要喝。

chapters.en: “Then tell them, ‘This is what the LORD Almighty, the God of Israel, says: Drink, get drunk and vomit, and fall to rise no more because of the sword I will send among you.’
chapters.zh: 你要对他们说，万军之耶和华以色列的神如此说，你们要喝，且要喝醉，要呕吐，且要跌倒，不得再起来，都因我使刀剑临到你们中间。

chapters.en: But if they refuse to take the cup from your hand and drink, tell them, ‘This is what the LORD Almighty says: You must drink it!
chapters.zh: 他们若不肯从你手接这杯喝，你就要对他们说，万军之耶和华如此说，你们一定要喝。

chapters.en: See, I am beginning to bring disaster on the city that bears my Name, and will you indeed go unpunished? You will not go unpunished, for I am calling down a sword on all who live on the earth, declares the LORD Almighty.’
chapters.zh: 我既从称为我名下的城起首施行灾祸，你们能尽免刑罚吗？你们必不能免，因为我要命刀剑临到地上一切的居民。这是万军之耶和华说的。

chapters.en: “Now prophesy all these words against them and say to them: “ ‘The LORD will roar from on high; he will thunder from his holy dwelling and roar mightily against his land. He will shout like those who tread the grapes, shout against all who live on the earth.
chapters.zh: 所以你要向他们预言这一切的话，攻击他们，说，耶和华必从高天吼叫，从圣所发声，向自己的羊群大声吼叫。他要向地上一切的居民呐喊，像踹葡萄的一样。

chapters.en: The tumult will resound to the ends of the earth, for the LORD will bring charges against the nations; he will bring judgment on all mankind and put the wicked to the sword,’ ” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 必有响声达到地极，因为耶和华与列国相争。凡有血气的，他必审问。至于恶人，他必交给刀剑。这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: This is what the LORD Almighty says: “Look! Disaster is spreading from nation to nation; a mighty storm is rising from the ends of the earth.”
chapters.zh: 万军之耶和华如此说，看哪，必有灾祸从这国发到那国，并有大暴风从地极刮起。

chapters.en: At that time those slain by the LORD will be everywhere—from one end of the earth to the other. They will not be mourned or gathered up or buried, but will be like dung lying on the ground.
chapters.zh: 到那日，从地这边直到地那边都有耶和华所杀戮的。必无人哀哭，不得收殓，不得葬埋，必在地上成为粪土。

chapters.en: Weep and wail, you shepherds; roll in the dust, you leaders of the flock. For your time to be slaughtered has come; you will fall like the best of the rams.
chapters.zh: 牧人哪，你们当哀号，呼喊。群众的头目阿，你们要滚在灰中，因为你们被杀戮分散的日子足足来到。你们要跌碎，好像美器打碎一样。

chapters.en: The shepherds will have nowhere to flee, the leaders of the flock no place to escape.
chapters.zh: 牧人无路逃跑。群众的头目也无法逃脱。

chapters.en: Hear the cry of the shepherds, the wailing of the leaders of the flock, for the LORD is destroying their pasture.
chapters.zh: 听阿，有牧人呼喊，有群众头目哀号的声音，因为耶和华使他们的草场变为荒场。

chapters.en: The peaceful meadows will be laid waste because of the fierce anger of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 耶和华发出猛烈的怒气，平安的羊圈就都寂静无声。

chapters.en: Like a lion he will leave his lair, and their land will become desolate because of the sword of the oppressor and because of the LORD’s fierce anger.
chapters.zh: 他离了隐密处像狮子一样，他们的地，因刀剑凶猛的欺压，又因他猛烈的怒气都成为可惊骇的。

chapters.en: Early in the reign of Jehoiakim son of Josiah king of Judah, this word came from the LORD:
chapters.zh: 犹大王约西亚的儿子约雅敬登基的时候，有这话从耶和华临到耶利米说，

chapters.en: “This is what the LORD says: Stand in the courtyard of the LORD’s house and speak to all the people of the towns of Judah who come to worship in the house of the LORD. Tell them everything I command you; do not omit a word.
chapters.zh: 耶和华如此说，你站在耶和华殿的院内，对犹大众城邑的人，就是到耶和华殿来礼拜的，说我所吩咐你的一切话，一字不可删减。

chapters.en: Perhaps they will listen and each will turn from their evil ways. Then I will relent and not inflict on them the disaster I was planning because of the evil they have done.
chapters.zh: 或者他们肯听从，各人回头离开恶道，使我后悔不将我因他们所行的恶，想要施行的灾祸降与他们。

chapters.en: Say to them, ‘This is what the LORD says: If you do not listen to me and follow my law, which I have set before you,
chapters.zh: 你要对他们说，耶和华如此说，你们若不听从我，不遵行我设立在你们面前的律法，

chapters.en: and if you do not listen to the words of my servants the prophets, whom I have sent to you again and again (though you have not listened),
chapters.zh: 不听我从早起来差遣到你们那里去我仆人众先知的话（你们还是没有听从），

chapters.en: then I will make this house like Shiloh and this city a curse among all the nations of the earth.’ ”
chapters.zh: 我就必使这殿如示罗，使这城为地上万国所咒诅的。

chapters.en: The priests, the prophets and all the people heard Jeremiah speak these words in the house of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 耶利米在耶和华殿中说的这些话，祭司，先知与众民都听见了。

chapters.en: But as soon as Jeremiah finished telling all the people everything the LORD had commanded him to say, the priests, the prophets and all the people seized him and said, “You must die!
chapters.zh: 耶利米说完了耶和华所吩咐他对众人说的一切话，祭司，先知与众民都来抓住他，说，你必要死。

chapters.en: Why do you prophesy in the LORD’s name that this house will be like Shiloh and this city will be desolate and deserted?” And all the people crowded around Jeremiah in the house of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 你为何托耶和华的名预言，说这殿必如示罗，这城必变为荒场无人居住呢？于是众民都在耶和华的殿中聚集到耶利米那里。

chapters.en: When the officials of Judah heard about these things, they went up from the royal palace to the house of the LORD and took their places at the entrance of the New Gate of the LORD’s house.
chapters.zh: 犹大的首领听见这事，就从王宫上到耶和华的殿，坐在耶和华殿的新门口。

chapters.en: Then the priests and the prophets said to the officials and all the people, “This man should be sentenced to death because he has prophesied against this city. You have heard it with your own ears!”
chapters.zh: 祭司，先知对首领和众民说，这人是该死的。因为他说预言攻击这城，正如你们亲耳所听见的。

chapters.en: Then Jeremiah said to all the officials and all the people: “The LORD sent me to prophesy against this house and this city all the things you have heard.
chapters.zh: 耶利米就对众首领和众民说，耶和华差遣我预言，攻击这殿和这城，说你们所听见的这一切话。

chapters.en: Now reform your ways and your actions and obey the LORD your God. Then the LORD will relent and not bring the disaster he has pronounced against you.
chapters.zh: 现在要改正你们的行动作为，听从耶和华你们神的话，他就必后悔，不将所说的灾祸降与你们。

chapters.en: As for me, I am in your hands; do with me whatever you think is good and right.
chapters.zh: 至于我，我在你们手中，你们眼看何为善，何为正，就那样待我吧。

chapters.en: Be assured, however, that if you put me to death, you will bring the guilt of innocent blood on yourselves and on this city and on those who live in it, for in truth the LORD has sent me to you to speak all these words in your hearing.”
chapters.zh: 但你们要确实地知道，若把我治死，就使无辜人的血归到你们和这城，并其中的居民了。因为耶和华实在差遣我到你们这里来，将这一切话传与你们耳中。

chapters.en: Then the officials and all the people said to the priests and the prophets, “This man should not be sentenced to death! He has spoken to us in the name of the LORD our God.”
chapters.zh: 首领和众民就对祭司，先知说，这人是不该死的，因为他是奉耶和华我们神的名，向我们说话

chapters.en: Some of the elders of the land stepped forward and said to the entire assembly of people,
chapters.zh: 国中的长老就有几个人起来，对聚会的众民说，

chapters.en: “Micah of Moresheth prophesied in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah. He told all the people of Judah, ‘This is what the LORD Almighty says: “ ‘Zion will be plowed like a field, Jerusalem will become a heap of rubble, the temple hill a mound overgrown with thickets.’
chapters.zh: 当犹大王希西家的日子，有摩利沙人弥迦对犹大众人预言说，万军之耶和华如此说，锡安必被耕种像一块田。耶路撒冷必变为乱堆。这殿的山必像丛林的高处。

chapters.en: “Did Hezekiah king of Judah or anyone else in Judah put him to death? Did not Hezekiah fear the LORD and seek his favor? And did not the LORD relent, so that he did not bring the disaster he pronounced against them? We are about to bring a terrible disaster on ourselves!”
chapters.zh: 犹大王希西家和犹大众人岂是把他治死呢？希西家岂不是敬畏耶和华，恳求他的恩吗？耶和华就后悔，不把自己所说的灾祸降与他们。若治死这人，我们就作了大恶，自害己命。

chapters.en: (Now Uriah son of Shemaiah from Kiriath Jearim was another man who prophesied in the name of the LORD; he prophesied the same things against this city and this land as Jeremiah did.
chapters.zh: 又有一个人奉耶和华的名说预言，是基列耶琳人示玛雅的儿子乌利亚，他照耶利米的一切话说预言，攻击这城和这地。

chapters.en: When King Jehoiakim and all his officers and officials heard his words, the king was determined to put him to death. But Uriah heard of it and fled in fear to Egypt.
chapters.zh: 约雅敬王和他众勇士，众首领听见了乌利亚的话，王就想要把他治死。乌利亚听见就惧怕，逃往埃及去了。

chapters.en: King Jehoiakim, however, sent Elnathan son of Akbor to Egypt, along with some other men.
chapters.zh: 约雅敬王便打发亚革波的儿子以利拿单，带领几个人往埃及去。

chapters.en: They brought Uriah out of Egypt and took him to King Jehoiakim, who had him struck down with a sword and his body thrown into the burial place of the common people.)
chapters.zh: 他们就从埃及将乌利亚带出来，送到约雅敬王那里。王用刀杀了他，把他的尸首抛在平民的坟地中。

chapters.en: Furthermore, Ahikam son of Shaphan supported Jeremiah, and so he was not handed over to the people to be put to death.
chapters.zh: 然而，沙番的儿子亚希甘保护耶利米，不交在百姓的手中治死他。

chapters.en: Early in the reign of Zedekiah son of Josiah king of Judah, this word came to Jeremiah from the LORD:
chapters.zh: 犹大王约西亚的儿子约雅敬（约雅敬是西底家的别名，看第三节）登基的时候，有这话从耶和华临到耶利米说，

chapters.en: This is what the LORD said to me: “Make a yoke out of straps and crossbars and put it on your neck.
chapters.zh: 耶和华对我如此说，你作绳索与轭，加在自己的颈项上，

chapters.en: Then send word to the kings of Edom, Moab, Ammon, Tyre and Sidon through the envoys who have come to Jerusalem to Zedekiah king of Judah.
chapters.zh: 借那些来到耶路撒冷见犹大王西底家的使臣之手，把绳索与轭送到以东王，摩押王，亚扪王，推罗王，西顿王那里，

chapters.en: Give them a message for their masters and say, ‘This is what the LORD Almighty, the God of Israel, says: “Tell this to your masters:
chapters.zh: 且嘱咐使臣，传与他们的主人说，万军之耶和华以色列的神如此说，

chapters.en: With my great power and outstretched arm I made the earth and its people and the animals that are on it, and I give it to anyone I please.
chapters.zh: 我用大能和伸出来的膀臂，创造大地和地上的人民，牲畜。我看给谁相宜，就把地给谁。

chapters.en: Now I will give all your countries into the hands of my servant Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon; I will make even the wild animals subject to him.
chapters.zh: 现在我将这些地都交给我仆人巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒的手，我也将田野的走兽给他使用。

chapters.en: All nations will serve him and his son and his grandson until the time for his land comes; then many nations and great kings will subjugate him.
chapters.zh: 列国都必服事他和他的儿孙，直到他本国遭报的日期来到。那时，多国和大君王要使他作他们的奴仆。

chapters.en: “ ‘ “If, however, any nation or kingdom will not serve Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon or bow its neck under his yoke, I will punish that nation with the sword, famine and plague, declares the LORD, until I destroy it by his hand.
chapters.zh: 无论哪一邦哪一国，不肯服事这巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒，也不把颈项放在巴比伦王的轭下，我必用刀剑，饥荒，瘟疫刑罚那邦，直到我借巴比伦王的手将他们毁灭。这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: So do not listen to your prophets, your diviners, your interpreters of dreams, your mediums or your sorcerers who tell you, ‘You will not serve the king of Babylon.’
chapters.zh: 至于你们，不可听从你们的先知和占卜的，圆梦的，观兆的，以及行邪术的。他们告诉你们说，你们不至服事巴比伦王。

chapters.en: They prophesy lies to you that will only serve to remove you far from your lands; I will banish you and you will perish.
chapters.zh: 他们向你们说假预言，要叫你们迁移，远离本地，以致我将你们赶出去，使你们灭亡。

chapters.en: But if any nation will bow its neck under the yoke of the king of Babylon and serve him, I will let that nation remain in its own land to till it and to live there, declares the LORD.” ’ ”
chapters.zh: 但哪一邦肯把颈项放在巴比伦王的轭下服事他，我必使那邦仍在本地存留，得以耕种居住。这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: I gave the same message to Zedekiah king of Judah. I said, “Bow your neck under the yoke of the king of Babylon; serve him and his people, and you will live.
chapters.zh: 我就照这一切的话对犹大王西底家说，要把你们的颈项放在巴比伦王的轭下，服事他和他的百姓，便得存活。

chapters.en: Why will you and your people die by the sword, famine and plague with which the LORD has threatened any nation that will not serve the king of Babylon?
chapters.zh: 你和你的百姓为何要因刀剑，饥荒，瘟疫死亡，正如耶和华论到不服事巴比伦王的那国说的话呢？

chapters.en: Do not listen to the words of the prophets who say to you, ‘You will not serve the king of Babylon,’ for they are prophesying lies to you.
chapters.zh: 不可听那些先知对你们所说的话。他们说，你们不至服事巴比伦王，其实他们向你们说假预言。

chapters.en: ‘I have not sent them,’ declares the LORD. ‘They are prophesying lies in my name. Therefore, I will banish you and you will perish, both you and the prophets who prophesy to you.’ ”
chapters.zh: 耶和华说，我并没有打发他们，他们却托我的名说假预言，好使我将你们和向你们说预言的那些先知赶出去，一同灭亡。

chapters.en: Then I said to the priests and all these people, “This is what the LORD says: Do not listen to the prophets who say, ‘Very soon now the articles from the LORD’s house will be brought back from Babylon.’ They are prophesying lies to you.
chapters.zh: 我又对祭司和这众民说，耶和华如此说，你们不可听那先知对你们所说的预言。他们说，耶和华殿中的器皿快要从巴比伦带回来。其实他们向你们说假预言。

chapters.en: Do not listen to them. Serve the king of Babylon, and you will live. Why should this city become a ruin?
chapters.zh: 不可听从他们，只管服事巴比伦王便得存活。这城何至变为荒场呢？

chapters.en: If they are prophets and have the word of the LORD, let them plead with the LORD Almighty that the articles remaining in the house of the LORD and in the palace of the king of Judah and in Jerusalem not be taken to Babylon.
chapters.zh: 他们若果是先知，有耶和华的话临到他们，让他们祈求万军之耶和华，使那在耶和华殿中和犹大王宫内，并耶路撒冷剩下的器皿，不被带到巴比伦去。

chapters.en: For this is what the LORD Almighty says about the pillars, the bronze Sea, the movable stands and the other articles that are left in this city,
chapters.zh: 因为万军之耶和华论到柱子，铜海，盆座，并剩在这城里的器皿，

chapters.en: which Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon did not take away when he carried Jehoiachin son of Jehoiakim king of Judah into exile from Jerusalem to Babylon, along with all the nobles of Judah and Jerusalem—
chapters.zh: 就是巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒掳掠犹大王约雅敬的儿子耶哥尼雅，和犹大，耶路撒冷一切贵胄的时候所没有掠去的器皿。

chapters.en: yes, this is what the LORD Almighty, the God of Israel, says about the things that are left in the house of the LORD and in the palace of the king of Judah and in Jerusalem:
chapters.zh: 论到那在耶和华殿中和犹大王宫内，并耶路撒冷剩下的器皿，万军之耶和华以色列的神如此说，

chapters.en: ‘They will be taken to Babylon and there they will remain until the day I come for them,’ declares the LORD. ‘Then I will bring them back and restore them to this place.’ ”
chapters.zh: 必被带到巴比伦存在那里，直到我眷顾以色列人的日子。那时，我必将这器皿带回来，交还此地。这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: In the fifth month of that same year, the fourth year, early in the reign of Zedekiah king of Judah, the prophet Hananiah son of Azzur, who was from Gibeon, said to me in the house of the LORD in the presence of the priests and all the people:
chapters.zh: 当年，就是犹大王西底家登基第四年五月，基遍人押朔的儿子，先知哈拿尼雅，在耶和华的殿中当着祭司和众民对我说，

chapters.en: “This is what the LORD Almighty, the God of Israel, says: ‘I will break the yoke of the king of Babylon.
chapters.zh: 万军之耶和华以色列的神如此说，我已经折断巴比伦王的轭。

chapters.en: Within two years I will bring back to this place all the articles of the LORD’s house that Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon removed from here and took to Babylon.
chapters.zh: 二年之内，我要将巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒从这地掠到巴比伦的器皿，就是耶和华殿中的一切器皿都带回此地。

chapters.en: I will also bring back to this place Jehoiachin son of Jehoiakim king of Judah and all the other exiles from Judah who went to Babylon,’ declares the LORD, ‘for I will break the yoke of the king of Babylon.’ ”
chapters.zh: 我又要将犹大王约雅敬的儿子耶哥尼雅，和被掳到巴比伦去的一切犹大人，带回此地，因为我要折断巴比伦王的轭。这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: Then the prophet Jeremiah replied to the prophet Hananiah before the priests and all the people who were standing in the house of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 先知耶利米当着祭司和站在耶和华殿里的众民对先知哈拿尼雅说，

chapters.en: He said, “Amen! May the LORD do so! May the LORD fulfill the words you have prophesied by bringing the articles of the LORD’s house and all the exiles back to this place from Babylon.
chapters.zh: 阿们。愿耶和华如此行，愿耶和华成就你所预言的话，将耶和华殿中的器皿和一切被掳去的人从巴比伦带回此地。

chapters.en: Nevertheless, listen to what I have to say in your hearing and in the hearing of all the people:
chapters.zh: 然而我向你和众民耳中所要说的话，你应当听。

chapters.en: From early times the prophets who preceded you and me have prophesied war, disaster and plague against many countries and great kingdoms.
chapters.zh: 从古以来，在你我以前的先知，向多国和大邦说预言，论到争战，灾祸，瘟疫的事。

chapters.en: But the prophet who prophesies peace will be recognized as one truly sent by the LORD only if his prediction comes true.”
chapters.zh: 先知预言的平安，到话语成就的时候，人便知道他真是耶和华所差来的。

chapters.en: Then the prophet Hananiah took the yoke off the neck of the prophet Jeremiah and broke it,
chapters.zh: 于是，先知哈拿尼雅将先知耶利米颈项上的轭取下来，折断了。

chapters.en: and he said before all the people, “This is what the LORD says: ‘In the same way I will break the yoke of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon off the neck of all the nations within two years.’ ” At this, the prophet Jeremiah went on his way.
chapters.zh: 哈拿尼雅又当着众民说，耶和华如此说，二年之内我必照样从列国人的颈项上折断巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒的轭。于是先知耶利米就走了。

chapters.en: After the prophet Hananiah had broken the yoke off the neck of the prophet Jeremiah, the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah:
chapters.zh: 先知哈拿尼雅把先知耶利米颈项上的轭折断以后，耶和华的话临到耶利米说，

chapters.en: “Go and tell Hananiah, ‘This is what the LORD says: You have broken a wooden yoke, but in its place you will get a yoke of iron.
chapters.zh: 你去告诉哈拿尼雅说，耶和华如此说，你折断木轭，却换了铁轭。

chapters.en: This is what the LORD Almighty, the God of Israel, says: I will put an iron yoke on the necks of all these nations to make them serve Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and they will serve him. I will even give him control over the wild animals.’ ”
chapters.zh: 因为万军之耶和华以色列的神如此说，我已将铁轭加在这些国的颈项上，使他们服事巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒，他们总要服事他。我也把田野的走兽给了他。

chapters.en: Then the prophet Jeremiah said to Hananiah the prophet, “Listen, Hananiah! The LORD has not sent you, yet you have persuaded this nation to trust in lies.
chapters.zh: 于是先知耶利米对先知哈拿尼雅说，哈拿尼雅阿，你应当听。耶和华并没有差遣你，你竟使这百姓倚靠谎言。

chapters.en: Therefore this is what the LORD says: ‘I am about to remove you from the face of the earth. This very year you are going to die, because you have preached rebellion against the LORD.’ ”
chapters.zh: 所以耶和华如此说，看哪，我要叫你去世，你今年必死，因为你向耶和华说了叛逆的话。

chapters.en: In the seventh month of that same year, Hananiah the prophet died.
chapters.zh: 这样，先知哈拿尼雅当年七月间就死了。

chapters.en: This is the text of the letter that the prophet Jeremiah sent from Jerusalem to the surviving elders among the exiles and to the priests, the prophets and all the other people Nebuchadnezzar had carried into exile from Jerusalem to Babylon.
chapters.zh: 先知耶利米从耶路撒冷寄信与被掳的祭司，先知，和众民，并生存的长老，就是尼布甲尼撒从耶路撒冷掳到巴比伦去的。

chapters.en: (This was after King Jehoiachin and the queen mother, the court officials and the leaders of Judah and Jerusalem, the skilled workers and the artisans had gone into exile from Jerusalem.)
chapters.zh: （这在耶哥尼雅王和太后，太监，并犹大，耶路撒冷的首领，以及工匠，铁匠都离了耶路撒冷以后。）

chapters.en: He entrusted the letter to Elasah son of Shaphan and to Gemariah son of Hilkiah, whom Zedekiah king of Judah sent to King Nebuchadnezzar in Babylon. It said:
chapters.zh: 他借沙番的儿子以利亚萨和希勒家的儿子基玛利的手寄去。他们二人是犹大王西底家打发往巴比伦去见尼布甲尼撒王的。

chapters.en: This is what the LORD Almighty, the God of Israel, says to all those I carried into exile from Jerusalem to Babylon:
chapters.zh: 信上说，万军之耶和华以色列的神，对一切被掳去的，就是我使他们从耶路撒冷被掳到巴比伦的人，如此说，

chapters.en: “Build houses and settle down; plant gardens and eat what they produce.
chapters.zh: 你们要盖造房屋，住在其中。栽种田园，吃其中所产的。

chapters.en: Marry and have sons and daughters; find wives for your sons and give your daughters in marriage, so that they too may have sons and daughters. Increase in number there; do not decrease.
chapters.zh: 娶妻生儿女，为你们的儿子娶妻，使你们的女儿嫁人，生儿养女。在那里生养众多，不至减少。

chapters.en: Also, seek the peace and prosperity of the city to which I have carried you into exile. Pray to the LORD for it, because if it prospers, you too will prosper.”
