chapters.zh: 我所使你们被掳到的那城，你们要为那城求平安，为那城祷告耶和华。因为那城得平安，你们也随着得平安。

chapters.en: Yes, this is what the LORD Almighty, the God of Israel, says: “Do not let the prophets and diviners among you deceive you. Do not listen to the dreams you encourage them to have.
chapters.zh: 万军之耶和华以色列的神如此说，不要被你们中间的先知和占卜的诱惑，也不要听信自己所作的梦。

chapters.en: They are prophesying lies to you in my name. I have not sent them,” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 因为他们托我的名对你们说假预言，我并没有差遣他们。这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: This is what the LORD says: “When seventy years are completed for Babylon, I will come to you and fulfill my good promise to bring you back to this place.
chapters.zh: 耶和华如此说，为巴比伦所定的七十年满了以后，我要眷顾你们，向你们成就我的恩言，使你们仍回此地。

chapters.en: For I know the plans I have for you,” declares the LORD, “plans to prosper you and not to harm you, plans to give you hope and a future.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说，我知道我向你们所怀的意念是赐平安的意念，不是降灾祸的意念，要叫你们末后有指望。

chapters.en: Then you will call on me and come and pray to me, and I will listen to you.
chapters.zh: 你们要呼求我，祷告我，我就应允你们。

chapters.en: You will seek me and find me when you seek me with all your heart.
chapters.zh: 你们寻求我，若专心寻求我，就必寻见。

chapters.en: I will be found by you,” declares the LORD, “and will bring you back from captivity. I will gather you from all the nations and places where I have banished you,” declares the LORD, “and will bring you back to the place from which I carried you into exile.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华说，我必被你们寻见，我也必使你们被掳的人归回，将你们从各国中和我所赶你们到的各处招聚了来，又将你们带回我使你们被掳掠离开的地方。这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: You may say, “The LORD has raised up prophets for us in Babylon,”
chapters.zh: 你们说，耶和华在巴比伦为我们兴起先知。

chapters.en: but this is what the LORD says about the king who sits on David’s throne and all the people who remain in this city, your fellow citizens who did not go with you into exile—
chapters.zh: 所以耶和华论到坐大卫宝座的王和住在这城里的一切百姓，就是未曾与你们一同被掳的弟兄，

chapters.en: yes, this is what the LORD Almighty says: “I will send the sword, famine and plague against them and I will make them like figs that are so bad they cannot be eaten.
chapters.zh: 万军之耶和华如此说，看哪，我必使刀剑，饥荒，瘟疫临到他们，使他们像极坏的无花果，坏得不可吃。

chapters.en: I will pursue them with the sword, famine and plague and will make them abhorrent to all the kingdoms of the earth, a curse and an object of horror, of scorn and reproach, among all the nations where I drive them.
chapters.zh: 我必用刀剑，饥荒，瘟疫追赶他们，使他们在天下万国抛来抛去，在我所赶他们到的各国中，令人咒诅，惊骇，嗤笑，羞辱。

chapters.en: For they have not listened to my words,” declares the LORD, “words that I sent to them again and again by my servants the prophets. And you exiles have not listened either,” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说，这是因为他们没有听从我的话，就是我从早起来差遣我仆人众先知去说的，无奈他们不听。这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: Therefore, hear the word of the LORD, all you exiles whom I have sent away from Jerusalem to Babylon.
chapters.zh: 所以你们一切被掳去的，就是我从耶路撒冷打发到巴比伦去的，当听耶和华的话。

chapters.en: This is what the LORD Almighty, the God of Israel, says about Ahab son of Kolaiah and Zedekiah son of Maaseiah, who are prophesying lies to you in my name: “I will deliver them into the hands of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and he will put them to death before your very eyes.
chapters.zh: 万军之耶和华以色列的神论到哥赖雅的儿子亚哈，并玛西雅的儿子西底家，如此说，他们是托我名向你们说假预言的，我必将他们交在巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒的手中。他要在你们眼前杀害他们。

chapters.en: Because of them, all the exiles from Judah who are in Babylon will use this curse: ‘May the LORD treat you like Zedekiah and Ahab, whom the king of Babylon burned in the fire.’
chapters.zh: 住巴比伦一切被掳的犹大人必借这二人赌咒说，愿耶和华使你像巴比伦王在火中烧的西底家和亚哈一样。

chapters.en: For they have done outrageous things in Israel; they have committed adultery with their neighbors’ wives, and in my name they have uttered lies—which I did not authorize. I know it and am a witness to it,” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 这二人是在以色列中行了丑事，与邻舍的妻行淫，又假托我名说我未曾吩咐他们的话。知道的是我，作见证的也是我。这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: Tell Shemaiah the Nehelamite,
chapters.zh: 论到尼希兰人示玛雅，你当说，

chapters.en: “This is what the LORD Almighty, the God of Israel, says: You sent letters in your own name to all the people in Jerusalem, to the priest Zephaniah son of Maaseiah, and to all the other priests. You said to Zephaniah,
chapters.zh: 万军之耶和华以色列的神如此说，你曾用自己的名寄信给耶路撒冷的众民和祭司玛西雅的儿子西番雅，并众祭司，说，

chapters.en: ‘The LORD has appointed you priest in place of Jehoiada to be in charge of the house of the LORD; you should put any maniac who acts like a prophet into the stocks and neck-irons.
chapters.zh: 耶和华已经立你西番雅为祭司，代替祭司耶何耶大，使耶和华殿中有官长，好将一切狂妄自称为先知的人用枷枷住，用锁锁住。

chapters.en: So why have you not reprimanded Jeremiah from Anathoth, who poses as a prophet among you?
chapters.zh: 现在亚拿突人耶利米向你们自称为先知，你们为何没有责备他呢？

chapters.en: He has sent this message to us in Babylon: It will be a long time. Therefore build houses and settle down; plant gardens and eat what they produce.’ ”
chapters.zh: 因为他寄信给我们在巴比伦的人说，被掳的事必长久。你们要盖造房屋，住在其中。栽种田园，吃其中所产的。

chapters.en: Zephaniah the priest, however, read the letter to Jeremiah the prophet.
chapters.zh: 祭司西番雅就把这信念给先知耶利米听。

chapters.en: Then the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah:
chapters.zh: 于是耶和华的话临到耶利米说，

chapters.en: “Send this message to all the exiles: ‘This is what the LORD says about Shemaiah the Nehelamite: Because Shemaiah has prophesied to you, even though I did not send him, and has persuaded you to trust in lies,
chapters.zh: 你当寄信给一切被掳的人说，耶和华论到尼希兰人示玛雅说，因为示玛雅向你们说预言，我并没有差遣他，他使你们倚靠谎言。

chapters.en: this is what the LORD says: I will surely punish Shemaiah the Nehelamite and his descendants. He will have no one left among this people, nor will he see the good things I will do for my people, declares the LORD, because he has preached rebellion against me.’ ”
chapters.zh: 所以耶和华如此说，我必刑罚尼希兰人示玛雅和他的后裔，他必无一人存留住在这民中，也不得见我所要赐与我百姓的福乐，因为他向耶和华说了叛逆的话。这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: This is the word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD:
chapters.zh: 耶和华的话临到耶利米说，

chapters.en: “This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: ‘Write in a book all the words I have spoken to you.
chapters.zh: 耶和华以色列的神如此说，你将我对你说过的一切话都写在书上。

chapters.en: The days are coming,’ declares the LORD, ‘when I will bring my people Israel and Judah back from captivity and restore them to the land I gave their ancestors to possess,’ says the LORD.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华说，日子将到，我要使我的百姓以色列和犹大被掳的人归回。我也要使他们回到我所赐给他们列祖之地，他们就得这地为业。这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: These are the words the LORD spoke concerning Israel and Judah:
chapters.zh: 以下是耶和华论到以色列和犹大所说的话，

chapters.en: “This is what the LORD says: “ ‘Cries of fear are heard— terror, not peace.
chapters.zh: 耶和华如此说，我们听见声音，是战抖惧怕而不平安的声音。

chapters.en: Ask and see: Can a man bear children? Then why do I see every strong man with his hands on his stomach like a woman in labor, every face turned deathly pale?
chapters.zh: 你们且访问看看，男人有产难吗？我怎么看见人人用手掐腰，像产难的妇人，脸面都变青了呢？

chapters.en: How awful that day will be! No other will be like it. It will be a time of trouble for Jacob, but he will be saved out of it.
chapters.zh: 哀哉。那日为大，无日可比。这是雅各遭难的时候，但他必被救出来。

chapters.en: “ ‘In that day,’ declares the LORD Almighty, ‘I will break the yoke off their necks and will tear off their bonds; no longer will foreigners enslave them.
chapters.zh: 万军之耶和华说，到那日，我必从你颈项上折断仇敌的轭，扭开他的绳索。外邦人不得再使你作他们的奴仆。

chapters.en: Instead, they will serve the LORD their God and David their king, whom I will raise up for them.
chapters.zh: 你们却要事奉耶和华你们的神和我为你们所要兴起的王大卫。

chapters.en: “ ‘So do not be afraid, Jacob my servant; do not be dismayed, Israel,’ declares the LORD. ‘I will surely save you out of a distant place, your descendants from the land of their exile. Jacob will again have peace and security, and no one will make him afraid.
chapters.zh: 故此，耶和华说，我的仆人雅各阿，不要惧怕。以色列阿，不要惊惶。因我要从远方拯救你，从被掳到之地拯救你的后裔。雅各必回来得享平靖安逸，无人使他害怕。

chapters.en: I am with you and will save you,’ declares the LORD. ‘Though I completely destroy all the nations among which I scatter you, I will not completely destroy you. I will discipline you but only in due measure; I will not let you go entirely unpunished.’
chapters.zh: 因我与你同在，要拯救你，也要将所赶散你到的那些国灭绝净尽，却不将你灭绝净尽，倒要从宽惩治你，万不能不罚你（不罚你或作以你为无罪）。这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: “This is what the LORD says: “ ‘Your wound is incurable, your injury beyond healing.
chapters.zh: 耶和华如此说，你的损伤无法医治。你的伤痕极其重大。

chapters.en: There is no one to plead your cause, no remedy for your sore, no healing for you.
chapters.zh: 无人为你分诉，使你的伤痕得以缠裹。你没有医治的良药。

chapters.en: All your allies have forgotten you; they care nothing for you. I have struck you as an enemy would and punished you as would the cruel, because your guilt is so great and your sins so many.
chapters.zh: 你所亲爱的都忘记你，不来探问（或作理会）你。我因你的罪孽甚大，罪恶众多，曾用仇敌加的伤害伤害你，用残忍者的惩治惩治你。

chapters.en: Why do you cry out over your wound, your pain that has no cure? Because of your great guilt and many sins I have done these things to you.
chapters.zh: 你为何因损伤哀号呢？你的痛苦无法医治。我因你的罪孽甚大，罪恶众多，曾将这些加在你身上。

chapters.en: “ ‘But all who devour you will be devoured; all your enemies will go into exile. Those who plunder you will be plundered; all who make spoil of you I will despoil.
chapters.zh: 故此，凡吞吃你的必被吞吃。你的敌人个个都被掳去。掳掠你的必成为掳物。抢夺你的必成为掠物。

chapters.en: But I will restore you to health and heal your wounds,’ declares the LORD, ‘because you are called an outcast, Zion for whom no one cares.’
chapters.zh: 耶和华说，我必使你痊愈，医好你的伤痕，都因人称你为被赶散的，说，这是锡安，无人来探问（或作理会）的。

chapters.en: “This is what the LORD says: “ ‘I will restore the fortunes of Jacob’s tents and have compassion on his dwellings; the city will be rebuilt on her ruins, and the palace will stand in its proper place.
chapters.zh: 耶和华如此说，我必使雅各被掳去的帐棚归回，也必顾惜他的住处。城必建造在原旧的山冈。宫殿也照旧有人居住。

chapters.en: From them will come songs of thanksgiving and the sound of rejoicing. I will add to their numbers, and they will not be decreased; I will bring them honor, and they will not be disdained.
chapters.zh: 必有感谢和欢乐的声音从其中发出，我要使他们增多，不致减少。使他们尊荣，不致卑微。

chapters.en: Their children will be as in days of old, and their community will be established before me; I will punish all who oppress them.
chapters.zh: 他们的儿女要如往日。他们的会众坚立在我面前。凡欺压他们的，我必刑罚他。

chapters.en: Their leader will be one of their own; their ruler will arise from among them. I will bring him near and he will come close to me— for who is he who will devote himself to be close to me?’ declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 他们的君王必是属乎他们的。掌权的必从他们中间而出。我要使他就近我，他也要亲近我。不然，谁有胆量亲近我呢？这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: “‘So you will be my people, and I will be your God.’ ”
chapters.zh: 你们要作我的子民，我要作你们的神。

chapters.en: See, the storm of the LORD will burst out in wrath, a driving wind swirling down on the heads of the wicked.
chapters.zh: 看哪，耶和华的忿怒好像暴风已经发出。是扫灭的暴风，必转到恶人的头上。

chapters.en: The fierce anger of the LORD will not turn back until he fully accomplishes the purposes of his heart. In days to come you will understand this.
chapters.zh: 耶和华的烈怒必不转消，直到他心中所拟定的成就了。末后的日子你们要明白。

chapters.en: “At that time,” declares the LORD, “I will be the God of all the families of Israel, and they will be my people.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华说，那时，我必作以色列各家的神。他们必作我的子民。

chapters.en: This is what the LORD says: “The people who survive the sword will find favor in the wilderness; I will come to give rest to Israel.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华如此说，脱离刀剑的就是以色列人。我使他享安息的时候，他曾在旷野蒙恩。

chapters.en: The LORD appeared to us in the past, saying: “I have loved you with an everlasting love; I have drawn you with unfailing kindness.
chapters.zh: 古时（或作从远方）耶和华向以色列（原文作我）显现，说，我以永远的爱爱你，因此我以慈爱吸引你。

chapters.en: I will build you up again, and you, Virgin Israel, will be rebuilt. Again you will take up your timbrels and go out to dance with the joyful.
chapters.zh: 以色列的民哪（民原文作处女），我要再建立你，你就被建立。你必再以击鼓为美，与欢乐的人一同跳舞而出。

chapters.en: Again you will plant vineyards on the hills of Samaria; the farmers will plant them and enjoy their fruit.
chapters.zh: 又必在撒玛利亚的山上栽种葡萄园，栽种的人要享用所结的果子。

chapters.en: There will be a day when watchmen cry out on the hills of Ephraim, ‘Come, let us go up to Zion, to the LORD our God.’ ”
chapters.zh: 日子必到，以法莲山上守望的人必呼叫说，起来吧。我们可以上锡安，到耶和华我们的神那里去。

chapters.en: This is what the LORD says: “Sing with joy for Jacob; shout for the foremost of the nations. Make your praises heard, and say, ‘LORD, save your people, the remnant of Israel.’
chapters.zh: 耶和华如此说，你们当为雅各欢乐歌唱，因万国中为首的欢呼。当传扬颂赞说，耶和华阿，求你拯救你的百姓以色列所剩下的人。

chapters.en: See, I will bring them from the land of the north and gather them from the ends of the earth. Among them will be the blind and the lame, expectant mothers and women in labor; a great throng will return.
chapters.zh: 我必将他们从北方领来，从地极招聚。同着他们来的有瞎子，瘸子，孕妇，产妇。他们必成为大帮回到这里来。

chapters.en: They will come with weeping; they will pray as I bring them back. I will lead them beside streams of water on a level path where they will not stumble, because I am Israel’s father, and Ephraim is my firstborn son.
chapters.zh: 他们要哭泣而来。我要照他们恳求的引导他们，使他们在河水旁走正直的路，在其上不致绊跌。因为我是以色列的父，以法莲是我的长子。

chapters.en: “Hear the word of the LORD, you nations; proclaim it in distant coastlands: ‘He who scattered Israel will gather them and will watch over his flock like a shepherd.’
chapters.zh: 列国阿，要听耶和华的话，传扬在远处的海岛说，赶散以色列的必招聚他，又看守他，好像牧人看守羊群。

chapters.en: For the LORD will deliver Jacob and redeem them from the hand of those stronger than they.
chapters.zh: 因耶和华救赎了雅各，救赎他脱离比他更强之人的手。

chapters.en: They will come and shout for joy on the heights of Zion; they will rejoice in the bounty of the LORD— the grain, the new wine and the olive oil, the young of the flocks and herds. They will be like a well-watered garden, and they will sorrow no more.
chapters.zh: 他们要来到锡安的高处歌唱，又流归耶和华施恩之地，就是有五谷，新酒，和油，并羊羔，牛犊之地。他们的心必像浇灌的园子。他们也不再有一点愁烦。

chapters.en: Then young women will dance and be glad, young men and old as well. I will turn their mourning into gladness; I will give them comfort and joy instead of sorrow.
chapters.zh: 那时，处女必欢乐跳舞。年少的，年老的，也必一同欢乐。因为我要使他们的悲哀变为欢喜，并要安慰他们，使他们的愁烦转为快乐。

chapters.en: I will satisfy the priests with abundance, and my people will be filled with my bounty,” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 我必以肥油使祭司的心满足。我的百姓也要因我的恩惠知足。这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: This is what the LORD says: “A voice is heard in Ramah, mourning and great weeping, Rachel weeping for her children and refusing to be comforted, because they are no more.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华如此说，在拉玛听见号啕痛哭的声音，是拉结哭她儿女，不肯受安慰，因为他们都不在了。

chapters.en: This is what the LORD says: “Restrain your voice from weeping and your eyes from tears, for your work will be rewarded,” declares the LORD. “They will return from the land of the enemy.
chapters.zh: 耶和华如此说，你禁止声音不要哀哭，禁止眼目不要流泪，因你所作之工必有赏赐。他们必从敌国归回。这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: So there is hope for your descendants,” declares the LORD. “Your children will return to their own land.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说，你末后必有指望。你的儿女必回到自己的境界。

chapters.en: “I have surely heard Ephraim’s moaning: ‘You disciplined me like an unruly calf, and I have been disciplined. Restore me, and I will return, because you are the LORD my God.
chapters.zh: 我听见以法莲为自己悲叹说，你责罚我，我便受责罚，像不惯负轭的牛犊一样。求你使我回转，我便回转，因为你是耶和华我的神。

chapters.en: After I strayed, I repented; after I came to understand, I beat my breast. I was ashamed and humiliated because I bore the disgrace of my youth.’
chapters.zh: 我回转以后就真正懊悔。受教以后就拍腿叹息。我因担当幼年的凌辱就抱愧蒙羞。

chapters.en: Is not Ephraim my dear son, the child in whom I delight? Though I often speak against him, I still remember him. Therefore my heart yearns for him; I have great compassion for him,” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说，以法莲是我的爱子吗？是可喜悦的孩子吗？我每逢责备他，仍深顾念他。所以我的心肠恋慕他。我必要怜悯他。

chapters.en: “Set up road signs; put up guideposts. Take note of the highway, the road that you take. Return, Virgin Israel, return to your towns.
chapters.zh: 以色列民哪（民原文作处女），你当为自己设立指路碑，竖起引路柱。你要留心向大路，就是你所去的原路。你当回转，回转到你这些城邑。

chapters.en: How long will you wander, unfaithful Daughter Israel? The LORD will create a new thing on earth— the woman will return to the man.”
chapters.zh: 背道的民哪（民原文作女子），你反来复去要到几时呢？耶和华在地上造了一件新事，就是女子护卫男子。

chapters.en: This is what the LORD Almighty, the God of Israel, says: “When I bring them back from captivity, the people in the land of Judah and in its towns will once again use these words: ‘The LORD bless you, you prosperous city, you sacred mountain.’
chapters.zh: 万军之耶和华以色列的神如此说，我使被掳之人归回的时候，他们在犹大地和其中的城邑必再这样说，公义的居所阿，圣山哪，愿耶和华赐福给你。

chapters.en: People will live together in Judah and all its towns—farmers and those who move about with their flocks.
chapters.zh: 犹大和属犹大城邑的人，农夫和放羊的人，要一同住在其中。

chapters.en: I will refresh the weary and satisfy the faint.”
chapters.zh: 疲乏的人，我使他饱饫。愁烦的人，我使他知足。

chapters.en: At this I awoke and looked around. My sleep had been pleasant to me.
chapters.zh: 先知说，我醒了，觉着睡得香甜。

chapters.en: “The days are coming,” declares the LORD, “when I will plant the kingdoms of Israel and Judah with the offspring of people and of animals.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说，日子将到，我要把人的种和牲畜的种播种在以色列家和犹大家。

chapters.en: Just as I watched over them to uproot and tear down, and to overthrow, destroy and bring disaster, so I will watch over them to build and to plant,” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 我先前怎样留意将他们拔出，拆毁，毁坏，倾覆，苦害，也必照样留意将他们建立，栽植。这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: “In those days people will no longer say, ‘The parents have eaten sour grapes, and the children’s teeth are set on edge.’
chapters.zh: 当那些日子，人不再说，父亲吃了酸葡萄，儿子的牙酸倒了。

chapters.en: Instead, everyone will die for their own sin; whoever eats sour grapes—their own teeth will be set on edge.
chapters.zh: 但各人必因自己的罪死亡。凡吃酸葡萄的，自己的牙必酸倒。

chapters.en: “The days are coming,” declares the LORD, “when I will make a new covenant with the people of Israel and with the people of Judah.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说，日子将到，我要与以色列家和犹大家另立新约，

chapters.en: It will not be like the covenant I made with their ancestors when I took them by the hand to lead them out of Egypt, because they broke my covenant, though I was a husband to them, ” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 不像我拉着他们祖宗的手，领他们出埃及地的时候，与他们所立的约。我虽作他们的丈夫，他们却背了我的约。这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: “This is the covenant I will make with the people of Israel after that time,” declares the LORD. “I will put my law in their minds and write it on their hearts. I will be their God, and they will be my people.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说，那些日子以后，我与以色列家所立的约乃是这样，我要将我的律法放在他们里面，写在他们心上。我要作他们的神，他们要作我的子民。

chapters.en: No longer will they teach their neighbor, or say to one another, ‘Know the LORD,’ because they will all know me, from the least of them to the greatest,” declares the LORD. “For I will forgive their wickedness and will remember their sins no more.”
chapters.zh: 他们各人不再教导自己的邻舍和自己的弟兄说，你该认识耶和华，因为他们从最小的到至大的都必认识我。我要赦免他们的罪孽，不再记念他们的罪恶。这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: This is what the LORD says, he who appoints the sun to shine by day, who decrees the moon and stars to shine by night, who stirs up the sea so that its waves roar— the LORD Almighty is his name:
chapters.zh: 那使太阳白日发光，使星月有定例，黑夜发亮，又搅动大海，使海中波浪匉訇的，万军之耶和华是他的名。他如此说，

chapters.en: “Only if these decrees vanish from my sight,” declares the LORD, “will Israel ever cease being a nation before me.”
chapters.zh: 这些定例若能在我面前废掉，以色列的后裔也就在我面前断绝，永远不再成国。这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: This is what the LORD says: “Only if the heavens above can be measured and the foundations of the earth below be searched out will I reject all the descendants of Israel because of all they have done,” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 耶和华如此说，若能量度上天，寻察下地的根基，我就因以色列后裔一切所行的弃绝他们。这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: “The days are coming,” declares the LORD, “when this city will be rebuilt for me from the Tower of Hananel to the Corner Gate.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说，日子将到，这城必为耶和华建造，从哈楠业楼直到角门。

chapters.en: The measuring line will stretch from there straight to the hill of Gareb and then turn to Goah.
chapters.zh: 准绳要往外量出，直到迦立山，又转到歌亚。

chapters.en: The whole valley where dead bodies and ashes are thrown, and all the terraces out to the Kidron Valley on the east as far as the corner of the Horse Gate, will be holy to the LORD. The city will never again be uprooted or demolished.”
chapters.zh: 抛尸的全谷和倒灰之处，并一切田地，直到汲沦溪，又直到东方马门的拐角，都要归耶和华为圣，不再拔出，不再倾覆，直到永远。

chapters.en: This is the word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD in the tenth year of Zedekiah king of Judah, which was the eighteenth year of Nebuchadnezzar.
chapters.zh: 犹大王西底家第十年，就是尼布甲尼撒十八年，耶和华的话临到耶利米。

chapters.en: The army of the king of Babylon was then besieging Jerusalem, and Jeremiah the prophet was confined in the courtyard of the guard in the royal palace of Judah.
chapters.zh: 那时巴比伦王的军队围困耶路撒冷，先知耶利米囚在护卫兵的院内，在犹大王的宫中。

chapters.en: Now Zedekiah king of Judah had imprisoned him there, saying, “Why do you prophesy as you do? You say, ‘This is what the LORD says: I am about to give this city into the hands of the king of Babylon, and he will capture it.
chapters.zh: 因为犹大王西底家已将他囚禁，说，你为什么预言说，耶和华如此说，我必将这城交在巴比伦王的手中，他必攻取这城。

chapters.en: Zedekiah king of Judah will not escape the Babylonians but will certainly be given into the hands of the king of Babylon, and will speak with him face to face and see him with his own eyes.
chapters.zh: 犹大王西底家必不能逃脱迦勒底人的手，定要交在巴比伦王的手中，要口对口彼此说话，眼对眼彼此相看。

chapters.en: He will take Zedekiah to Babylon, where he will remain until I deal with him, declares the LORD. If you fight against the Babylonians, you will not succeed.’ ”
chapters.zh: 巴比伦王必将西底家带到巴比伦。西底家必住在那里，直到我眷顾他的时候。你们虽与迦勒底人争战，却不顺利。这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: Jeremiah said, “The word of the LORD came to me:
chapters.zh: 耶利米说，耶和华的话临到我说，

chapters.en: Hanamel son of Shallum your uncle is going to come to you and say, ‘Buy my field at Anathoth, because as nearest relative it is your right and duty to buy it.’
chapters.zh: 你叔叔沙龙的儿子哈拿篾必来见你，说，我在亚拿突的那块地，求你买来。因你买这地是合乎赎回之理。

chapters.en: “Then, just as the LORD had said, my cousin Hanamel came to me in the courtyard of the guard and said, ‘Buy my field at Anathoth in the territory of Benjamin. Since it is your right to redeem it and possess it, buy it for yourself.’ “I knew that this was the word of the LORD;
chapters.zh: 我叔叔的儿子哈拿篾果然照耶和华的话来到护卫兵的院内，对我说，我在便雅悯境内，亚拿突的那块地，求你买来。因你买来是合乎承受之理，是你当赎的。你为自己买来吧。我耶利米就知道这是耶和华的话。

chapters.en: so I bought the field at Anathoth from my cousin Hanamel and weighed out for him seventeen shekels of silver.
chapters.zh: 我便向我叔叔的儿子哈拿篾买了亚拿突的那块地，平了十七舍客勒银子给他。

chapters.en: I signed and sealed the deed, had it witnessed, and weighed out the silver on the scales.
chapters.zh: 我在契上画押，将契封缄，又请见证人来，并用天平将银子平给他。

chapters.en: I took the deed of purchase—the sealed copy containing the terms and conditions, as well as the unsealed copy—
chapters.zh: 我便将照例按规所立的买契，就是封缄的那一张和敞着的那一张，

chapters.en: and I gave this deed to Baruch son of Neriah, the son of Mahseiah, in the presence of my cousin Hanamel and of the witnesses who had signed the deed and of all the Jews sitting in the courtyard of the guard.
chapters.zh: 当着我叔叔的儿子哈拿篾和画押作见证的人，并坐在护卫兵院内的一切犹大人眼前，交给玛西雅的孙子尼利亚的儿子巴录。

chapters.en: “In their presence I gave Baruch these instructions:
chapters.zh: 当着他们众人眼前，我嘱咐巴录说，

chapters.en: ‘This is what the LORD Almighty, the God of Israel, says: Take these documents, both the sealed and unsealed copies of the deed of purchase, and put them in a clay jar so they will last a long time.
chapters.zh: 万军之耶和华以色列的神如此说，要将这封缄的和敞着的两张契放在瓦器里，可以存留多日。

chapters.en: For this is what the LORD Almighty, the God of Israel, says: Houses, fields and vineyards will again be bought in this land.’
chapters.zh: 因为万军之耶和华以色列的神如此说，将来在这地必有人再买房屋，田地，和葡萄园。

chapters.en: “After I had given the deed of purchase to Baruch son of Neriah, I prayed to the LORD:
chapters.zh: 我将买契交给尼利亚的儿子巴录以后，便祷告耶和华说，

chapters.en: “Ah, Sovereign LORD, you have made the heavens and the earth by your great power and outstretched arm. Nothing is too hard for you.
chapters.zh: 主耶和华阿，你曾用大能和伸出来的膀臂创造天地，在你没有难成的事。

chapters.en: You show love to thousands but bring the punishment for the parents’ sins into the laps of their children after them. Great and mighty God, whose name is the LORD Almighty,
chapters.zh: 你施慈爱与千万人，又将父亲的罪孽报应在他后世子孙的怀中，是至大全能的神，万军之耶和华是你的名。

chapters.en: great are your purposes and mighty are your deeds. Your eyes are open to the ways of all mankind; you reward each person according to their conduct and as their deeds deserve.
chapters.zh: 谋事有大略，行事有大能，注目观看世人一切的举动，为要照各人所行的和他作事的结果报应他。

chapters.en: You performed signs and wonders in Egypt and have continued them to this day, in Israel and among all mankind, and have gained the renown that is still yours.
chapters.zh: 在埃及地显神迹奇事，直到今日在以色列和别人中间也是如此，使自己得了名声，正如今日一样。

chapters.en: You brought your people Israel out of Egypt with signs and wonders, by a mighty hand and an outstretched arm and with great terror.
chapters.zh: 用神迹奇事和大能的手，并伸出来的膀臂与大可畏的事，领你的百姓以色列出了埃及。

chapters.en: You gave them this land you had sworn to give their ancestors, a land flowing with milk and honey.
chapters.zh: 将这地赐给他们，就是你向他们列祖起誓应许赐给他们流奶与蜜之地。

chapters.en: They came in and took possession of it, but they did not obey you or follow your law; they did not do what you commanded them to do. So you brought all this disaster on them.
chapters.zh: 他们进入这地得了为业，却不听从你的话，也不遵行你的律法。你一切所吩咐他们行的，他们一无所行，因此你使这一切的灾祸临到他们。

chapters.en: “See how the siege ramps are built up to take the city. Because of the sword, famine and plague, the city will be given into the hands of the Babylonians who are attacking it. What you said has happened, as you now see.
chapters.zh: 看哪，敌人已经来到，筑垒要攻取这城。城也因刀剑，饥荒，瘟疫交在攻城的迦勒底人手中。你所说的话都成就了，你也看见了。

chapters.en: And though the city will be given into the hands of the Babylonians, you, Sovereign LORD, say to me, ‘Buy the field with silver and have the transaction witnessed.’ ”
chapters.zh: 主耶和华阿，你对我说，要用银子为自己买那块地，又请见证人。其实这城已交在迦勒底人的手中了。

chapters.en: Then the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah:
chapters.zh: 耶和华的话临到耶利米说，

chapters.en: “I am the LORD, the God of all mankind. Is anything too hard for me?
chapters.zh: 我是耶和华，是凡有血气者的神，岂有我难成的事吗？

chapters.en: Therefore this is what the LORD says: I am about to give this city into the hands of the Babylonians and to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, who will capture it.
chapters.zh: 耶和华如此说，我必将这城交付迦勒底人的手和巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒的手，他必攻取这城。

chapters.en: The Babylonians who are attacking this city will come in and set it on fire; they will burn it down, along with the houses where the people aroused my anger by burning incense on the roofs to Baal and by pouring out drink offerings to other gods.
chapters.zh: 攻城的迦勒底人必来放火焚烧这城和其中的房屋。在这房屋上，人曾向巴力烧香，向别神浇奠，惹我发怒。

chapters.en: “The people of Israel and Judah have done nothing but evil in my sight from their youth; indeed, the people of Israel have done nothing but arouse my anger with what their hands have made, declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 以色列人和犹大人自从幼年以来，专行我眼中看为恶的事。以色列人尽以手所作的惹我发怒。这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: From the day it was built until now, this city has so aroused my anger and wrath that I must remove it from my sight.
chapters.zh: 这城自从建造的那日直到今日，常惹我的怒气和忿怒，使我将这城从我面前除掉。

chapters.en: The people of Israel and Judah have provoked me by all the evil they have done—they, their kings and officials, their priests and prophets, the people of Judah and those living in Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 是因以色列人和犹大人一切的邪恶，就是他们和他们的君王，首领，祭司，先知，并犹大的众人，以及耶路撒冷的居民所行的，惹我发怒。

chapters.en: They turned their backs to me and not their faces; though I taught them again and again, they would not listen or respond to discipline.
chapters.zh: 他们以背向我，不以面向我。我虽从早起来教训他们，他们却不听从，不受教训，

chapters.en: They set up their vile images in the house that bears my Name and defiled it.
chapters.zh: 竟把可憎之物设立在称为我名下的殿中，污秽了这殿。

chapters.en: They built high places for Baal in the Valley of Ben Hinnom to sacrifice their sons and daughters to Molek, though I never commanded—nor did it enter my mind—that they should do such a detestable thing and so make Judah sin.
chapters.zh: 他们在欣嫩子谷建筑巴力的丘坛，好使自己的儿女经火归摩洛。他们行这可憎的事，使犹大陷在罪里，这并不是我所吩咐的，也不是我心所起的意。

chapters.en: “You are saying about this city, ‘By the sword, famine and plague it will be given into the hands of the king of Babylon’; but this is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says:
chapters.zh: 现在论到这城，就是你们所说，已经因刀剑，饥荒，瘟疫交在巴比伦王手中的，耶和华以色列的神如此说，

chapters.en: I will surely gather them from all the lands where I banish them in my furious anger and great wrath; I will bring them back to this place and let them live in safety.
chapters.zh: 我在怒气，忿怒，和大恼恨中，将以色列人赶到各国。日后我必从那里将他们招聚出来，领他们回到此地，使他们安然居住。

chapters.en: They will be my people, and I will be their God.
chapters.zh: 他们要作我的子民，我要作他们的神。

chapters.en: I will give them singleness of heart and action, so that they will always fear me and that all will then go well for them and for their children after them.
chapters.zh: 我要使他们彼此同心同道，好叫他们永远敬畏我，使他们和他们后世的子孙得福乐，

chapters.en: I will make an everlasting covenant with them: I will never stop doing good to them, and I will inspire them to fear me, so that they will never turn away from me.
chapters.zh: 又要与他们立永远的约，必随着他们施恩，并不离开他们，且使他们有敬畏我的心，不离开我。

chapters.en: I will rejoice in doing them good and will assuredly plant them in this land with all my heart and soul.
chapters.zh: 我必欢喜施恩与他们，要尽心尽意，诚诚实实将他们栽于此地。

chapters.en: “This is what the LORD says: As I have brought all this great calamity on this people, so I will give them all the prosperity I have promised them.
chapters.zh: 因为耶和华如此说，我怎样使这一切大祸临到这百姓，我也要照样使我所应许他们的一切福乐都临到他们。

chapters.en: Once more fields will be bought in this land of which you say, ‘It is a desolate waste, without people or animals, for it has been given into the hands of the Babylonians.’
chapters.zh: 你们说，这地是荒凉，无人民，无牲畜，是交付迦勒底人手之地。日后在这境内，必有人置买田地。

chapters.en: Fields will be bought for silver, and deeds will be signed, sealed and witnessed in the territory of Benjamin, in the villages around Jerusalem, in the towns of Judah and in the towns of the hill country, of the western foothills and of the Negev, because I will restore their fortunes, declares the LORD.”
chapters.zh: 在便雅悯地，耶路撒冷四围的各处，犹大的城邑，山地的城邑，高原的城邑，并南地的城邑，人必用银子买田地，在契上画押，将契封缄，请出见证人，因为我必使被掳的人归回。这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: While Jeremiah was still confined in the courtyard of the guard, the word of the LORD came to him a second time:
chapters.zh: 耶利米还囚在护卫兵的院内，耶和华的话第二次临到他说，

chapters.en: “This is what the LORD says, he who made the earth, the LORD who formed it and established it—the LORD is his name:
chapters.zh: 成就的是耶和华，造作，为要建立的也是耶和华。耶和华是他的名。他如此说，

chapters.en: ‘Call to me and I will answer you and tell you great and unsearchable things you do not know.’
chapters.zh: 你求告我，我就应允你，并将你所不知道，又大又难的事指示你。

chapters.en: For this is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says about the houses in this city and the royal palaces of Judah that have been torn down to be used against the siege ramps and the sword
chapters.zh: 论到这城中的房屋和犹大王的宫室，就是拆毁为挡敌人高垒和刀剑的，耶和华以色列的神如此说，

chapters.en: in the fight with the Babylonians : ‘They will be filled with the dead bodies of the people I will slay in my anger and wrath. I will hide my face from this city because of all its wickedness.
chapters.zh: 人要与迦勒底人争战，正是拿死尸充满这房屋，就是我在怒气和忿怒中所杀的人，因他们的一切恶，我就掩面不顾这城。

chapters.en: “ ‘Nevertheless, I will bring health and healing to it; I will heal my people and will let them enjoy abundant peace and security.
chapters.zh: 看哪，我要使这城得以痊愈安舒，使城中的人得医治，又将丰盛的平安和诚实显明与他们。

chapters.en: I will bring Judah and Israel back from captivity and will rebuild them as they were before.
chapters.zh: 我也要使犹大被掳的和以色列被掳的归回，并建立他们和起初一样。

chapters.en: I will cleanse them from all the sin they have committed against me and will forgive all their sins of rebellion against me.
chapters.zh: 我要除净他们的一切罪，就是向我所犯的罪。又要赦免他们的一切罪，就是干犯我，违背我的罪。

chapters.en: Then this city will bring me renown, joy, praise and honor before all nations on earth that hear of all the good things I do for it; and they will be in awe and will tremble at the abundant prosperity and peace I provide for it.’
chapters.zh: 这城要在地上万国人面前使我得颂赞，得荣耀，名为可喜可乐之城。万国人因听见我向这城所赐的福乐，所施的恩惠平安，就惧怕战兢。

chapters.en: “This is what the LORD says: ‘You say about this place, “It is a desolate waste, without people or animals.” Yet in the towns of Judah and the streets of Jerusalem that are deserted, inhabited by neither people nor animals, there will be heard once more
chapters.zh: 耶和华如此说，你们论这地方，说是荒废无人民无牲畜之地，但在这荒凉无人民无牲畜的犹大城邑和耶路撒冷的街上，

chapters.en: the sounds of joy and gladness, the voices of bride and bridegroom, and the voices of those who bring thank offerings to the house of the LORD, saying, “Give thanks to the LORD Almighty, for the LORD is good; his love endures forever.” For I will restore the fortunes of the land as they were before,’ says the LORD.
chapters.zh: 必再听见有欢喜和快乐的声音，新郎和新妇的声音，并听见有人说，要称谢万军之耶和华，因耶和华本为善。他的慈爱永远长存。又有奉感谢祭到耶和华殿中之人的声音。因为我必使这地被掳的人归回，和起初一样。这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: “This is what the LORD Almighty says: ‘In this place, desolate and without people or animals—in all its towns there will again be pastures for shepherds to rest their flocks.
chapters.zh: 万军之耶和华如此说，在这荒废无人民无牲畜之地，并其中所有的城邑，必再有牧人的住处。他们要使羊群躺卧在那里。

chapters.en: In the towns of the hill country, of the western foothills and of the Negev, in the territory of Benjamin, in the villages around Jerusalem and in the towns of Judah, flocks will again pass under the hand of the one who counts them,’ says the LORD.
chapters.zh: 在山地的城邑，高原的城邑，南地的城邑，便雅悯地，耶路撒冷四围的各处，和犹大的城邑必再有羊群从数点的人手下经过。这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: “ ‘The days are coming,’ declares the LORD, ‘when I will fulfill the good promise I made to the people of Israel and Judah.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说，日子将到，我应许以色列家和犹大家的恩言必然成就。

chapters.en: “ ‘In those days and at that time I will make a righteous Branch sprout from David’s line; he will do what is just and right in the land.
chapters.zh: 当那日子，那时候，我必使大卫公义的苗裔长起来。他必在地上施行公平和公义。

chapters.en: In those days Judah will be saved and Jerusalem will live in safety. This is the name by which it will be called: The LORD Our Righteous Savior.’
chapters.zh: 在那日子犹大必得救，耶路撒冷必安然居住，他的名必称为耶和华我们的义。

chapters.en: For this is what the LORD says: ‘David will never fail to have a man to sit on the throne of Israel,
chapters.zh: 因为耶和华如此说，大卫必永不断人坐在以色列家的宝座上。

chapters.en: nor will the Levitical priests ever fail to have a man to stand before me continually to offer burnt offerings, to burn grain offerings and to present sacrifices.’ ”
chapters.zh: 祭司，利未人在我面前也不断人献燔祭，烧素祭，时常办理献祭的事。

chapters.en: The word of the LORD came to Jeremiah:
chapters.zh: 耶和华的话临到耶利米说，

chapters.en: “This is what the LORD says: ‘If you can break my covenant with the day and my covenant with the night, so that day and night no longer come at their appointed time,
chapters.zh: 耶和华如此说，你们若能废弃我所立白日黑夜的约，使白日黑夜不按时轮转，

chapters.en: then my covenant with David my servant—and my covenant with the Levites who are priests ministering before me—can be broken and David will no longer have a descendant to reign on his throne.
chapters.zh: 就能废弃我与我仆人大卫所立的约，使他没有儿子在他的宝座上为王，并能废弃我与事奉我的祭司，利未人所立的约。

chapters.en: I will make the descendants of David my servant and the Levites who minister before me as countless as the stars in the sky and as measureless as the sand on the seashore.’ ”
chapters.zh: 天上的万象不能数算，海边的尘沙也不能斗量。我必照样使我仆人大卫的后裔和事奉我的利未人多起来。

chapters.en: The word of the LORD came to Jeremiah:
chapters.zh: 耶和华的话临到耶利米说，

chapters.en: “Have you not noticed that these people are saying, ‘The LORD has rejected the two kingdoms he chose’? So they despise my people and no longer regard them as a nation.
chapters.zh: 你没有揣摩这百姓的话吗？他们说，耶和华所拣选的二族，他已经弃绝了。他们这样藐视我的百姓，以为不再成国。

chapters.en: This is what the LORD says: ‘If I have not made my covenant with day and night and established the laws of heaven and earth,
chapters.zh: 耶和华如此说，若是我立白日黑夜的约不能存住，若是我未曾安排天地的定例，

chapters.en: then I will reject the descendants of Jacob and David my servant and will not choose one of his sons to rule over the descendants of Abraham, Isaac and Jacob. For I will restore their fortunes and have compassion on them.’ ”
chapters.zh: 我就弃绝雅各的后裔和我仆人大卫的后裔，不使大卫的后裔治理亚伯拉罕，以撒，雅各的后裔。因为我必使他们被掳的人归回，也必怜悯他们。

chapters.en: While Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon and all his army and all the kingdoms and peoples in the empire he ruled were fighting against Jerusalem and all its surrounding towns, this word came to Jeremiah from the LORD:
chapters.zh: 巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒率领他的全军和地上属他的各国各邦，攻打耶路撒冷和属耶路撒冷所有的城邑。那时，耶和华的话临到耶利米说，

chapters.en: “This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: Go to Zedekiah king of Judah and tell him, ‘This is what the LORD says: I am about to give this city into the hands of the king of Babylon, and he will burn it down.
chapters.zh: 耶和华以色列的神说，你去告诉犹大王西底家，耶和华如此说，我要将这城交付巴比伦王的手，他必用火焚烧。

chapters.en: You will not escape from his grasp but will surely be captured and given into his hands. You will see the king of Babylon with your own eyes, and he will speak with you face to face. And you will go to Babylon.
chapters.zh: 你必不能逃脱他的手，定被拿住，交在他的手中。你的眼要见巴比伦王的眼，他要口对口和你说话，你也必到巴比伦去。

chapters.en: “ ‘Yet hear the LORD’s promise to you, Zedekiah king of Judah. This is what the LORD says concerning you: You will not die by the sword;
chapters.zh: 犹大王西底家阿，你还要听耶和华的话。耶和华论到你如此说，你必不被刀剑杀死，

chapters.en: you will die peacefully. As people made a funeral fire in honor of your predecessors, the kings who ruled before you, so they will make a fire in your honor and lament, “Alas, master!” I myself make this promise, declares the LORD.’ ”
chapters.zh: 你必平安而死，人必为你焚烧物件，好像为你列祖，就是在你以前的先王焚烧一般。人必为你举哀，说，哀哉。我主阿。耶和华说，这话是我说的。

chapters.en: Then Jeremiah the prophet told all this to Zedekiah king of Judah, in Jerusalem,
chapters.zh: 于是，先知耶利米在耶路撒冷将这一切话告诉犹大王西底家。

chapters.en: while the army of the king of Babylon was fighting against Jerusalem and the other cities of Judah that were still holding out—Lachish and Azekah. These were the only fortified cities left in Judah.
chapters.zh: 那时，巴比伦王的军队正攻打耶路撒冷，又攻打犹大所剩下的城邑，就是拉吉和亚西加。原来犹大的坚固城只剩下这两座。

chapters.en: The word came to Jeremiah from the LORD after King Zedekiah had made a covenant with all the people in Jerusalem to proclaim freedom for the slaves.
chapters.zh: 西底家王与耶路撒冷的众民立约，要向他们宣告自由，叫各人任他希伯来的仆人和婢女自由出去，谁也不可使他的一个犹大弟兄作奴仆。（此后，有耶和华的话临到耶利米。）

chapters.en: Everyone was to free their Hebrew slaves, both male and female; no one was to hold a fellow Hebrew in bondage.
So all the officials and people who entered into this covenant agreed that they would free their male and female slaves and no longer hold them in bondage. They agreed, and set them free.
chapters.zh: 所有立约的首领和众民就任他的仆人婢女自由出去，谁也不再叫他们作奴仆。大家都顺从，将他们释放了。

chapters.en: But afterward they changed their minds and took back the slaves they had freed and enslaved them again.
chapters.zh: 后来却又反悔，叫所任去自由的仆人婢女回来，勉强他们仍为仆婢。

chapters.en: Then the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah:
chapters.zh: 因此耶和华的话临到耶利米说，

chapters.en: “This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: I made a covenant with your ancestors when I brought them out of Egypt, out of the land of slavery. I said,
chapters.zh: 耶和华以色列的神如此说，我将你们的列祖从埃及地为奴之家领出来的时候，与他们立约说，

chapters.en: ‘Every seventh year each of you must free any fellow Hebrews who have sold themselves to you. After they have served you six years, you must let them go free.’ Your ancestors, however, did not listen to me or pay attention to me.
chapters.zh: 你的一个希伯来弟兄若卖给你，服事你六年，到第七年你们各人就要任他自由出去。只是你们列祖不听从我，也不侧耳而听。

chapters.en: Recently you repented and did what is right in my sight: Each of you proclaimed freedom to your own people. You even made a covenant before me in the house that bears my Name.
chapters.zh: 如今你们回转，行我眼中看为正的事，各人向邻舍宣告自由，并且在称为我名下的殿中，在我面前立约。

chapters.en: But now you have turned around and profaned my name; each of you has taken back the male and female slaves you had set free to go where they wished. You have forced them to become your slaves again.
chapters.zh: 你们却又反悔，亵渎我的名，各人叫所任去随意自由的仆人婢女回来，勉强他们仍为仆婢。

chapters.en: “Therefore this is what the LORD says: You have not obeyed me; you have not proclaimed freedom to your own people. So I now proclaim ‘freedom’ for you, declares the LORD—‘freedom’ to fall by the sword, plague and famine. I will make you abhorrent to all the kingdoms of the earth.
chapters.zh: 所以耶和华如此说，你们没有听从我，各人向弟兄邻舍宣告自由。看哪。我向你们宣告一样自由，就是使你们自由于刀剑，饥荒，瘟疫之下，并且使你们在天下万国中抛来抛去。这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: Those who have violated my covenant and have not fulfilled the terms of the covenant they made before me, I will treat like the calf they cut in two and then walked between its pieces.
chapters.zh: 犹大的首领，耶路撒冷的首领，太监，祭司，和国中的众民曾将牛犊劈开，分成两半，从其中经过，在我面前立约。后来又违背我的约，不遵行这约上的话。

chapters.en: The leaders of Judah and Jerusalem, the court officials, the priests and all the people of the land who walked between the pieces of the calf,
I will deliver into the hands of their enemies who want to kill them. Their dead bodies will become food for the birds and the wild animals.
chapters.zh: 我必将他们交在仇敌和寻索其命的人手中。他们的尸首必给空中的飞鸟和地上的野兽作食物。

chapters.en: “I will deliver Zedekiah king of Judah and his officials into the hands of their enemies who want to kill them, to the army of the king of Babylon, which has withdrawn from you.
chapters.zh: 并且我必将犹大王西底家和他的首领交在他们仇敌和寻索其命的人，与那暂离你们而去巴比伦王军队的手中。

chapters.en: I am going to give the order, declares the LORD, and I will bring them back to this city. They will fight against it, take it and burn it down. And I will lay waste the towns of Judah so no one can live there.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华说，我必吩咐他们回到这城，攻打这城，将城攻取，用火焚烧。我也要使犹大的城邑变为荒场，无人居住。

chapters.en: This is the word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD during the reign of Jehoiakim son of Josiah king of Judah:
chapters.zh: 当犹大王约西亚之子约雅敬的时候，耶和华的话临到耶利米说，

chapters.en: “Go to the Rekabite family and invite them to come to one of the side rooms of the house of the LORD and give them wine to drink.”
chapters.zh: 你去见利甲族的人，和他们说话，领他们进入耶和华殿的一间屋子，给他们酒喝。

chapters.en: So I went to get Jaazaniah son of Jeremiah, the son of Habazziniah, and his brothers and all his sons—the whole family of the Rekabites.
chapters.zh: 我就将哈巴洗尼雅的孙子雅利米雅的儿子雅撒尼亚和他弟兄，并他众子，以及利甲全族的人，

chapters.en: I brought them into the house of the LORD, into the room of the sons of Hanan son of Igdaliah the man of God. It was next to the room of the officials, which was over that of Maaseiah son of Shallum the doorkeeper.
chapters.zh: 领到耶和华的殿，进入神人伊基大利的儿子哈难众子的屋子。那屋子在首领的屋子旁边，在沙龙之子把门的玛西雅屋子以上。

chapters.en: Then I set bowls full of wine and some cups before the Rekabites and said to them, “Drink some wine.”
chapters.zh: 于是我在利甲族人面前设摆盛满酒的碗和杯，对他们说，请你们喝酒。

chapters.en: But they replied, “We do not drink wine, because our forefather Jehonadab son of Rekab gave us this command: ‘Neither you nor your descendants must ever drink wine.
chapters.zh: 他们却说，我们不喝酒。因为我们先祖利甲的儿子约拿达曾吩咐我们说，你们与你们的子孙永不可喝酒，

chapters.en: Also you must never build houses, sow seed or plant vineyards; you must never have any of these things, but must always live in tents. Then you will live a long time in the land where you are nomads.’
chapters.zh: 也不可盖房，撒种，栽种葡萄园，但一生的年日要住帐棚，使你们的日子在寄居之地得以延长。

chapters.en: We have obeyed everything our forefather Jehonadab son of Rekab commanded us. Neither we nor our wives nor our sons and daughters have ever drunk wine
chapters.zh: 凡我们先祖利甲的儿子约拿达所吩咐我们的话，我们都听从了。我们和我们的妻子儿女一生的年日都不喝酒，

chapters.en: or built houses to live in or had vineyards, fields or crops.
chapters.zh: 也不盖房居住，也没有葡萄园，田地，和种子，

chapters.en: We have lived in tents and have fully obeyed everything our forefather Jehonadab commanded us.
chapters.zh: 但住帐棚，听从我们先祖约拿达的话，照他所吩咐我们的去行。

chapters.en: But when Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon invaded this land, we said, ‘Come, we must go to Jerusalem to escape the Babylonian and Aramean armies.’ So we have remained in Jerusalem.”
chapters.zh: 巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒上此地来，我们因怕迦勒底的军队和亚兰的军队，就说，来吧，我们到耶路撒冷去。这样，我们才住在耶路撒冷。

chapters.en: Then the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah, saying:
chapters.zh: 耶和华的话临到耶利米说，

chapters.en: “This is what the LORD Almighty, the God of Israel, says: Go and tell the people of Judah and those living in Jerusalem, ‘Will you not learn a lesson and obey my words?’ declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 万军之耶和华以色列的神如此说，你去对犹大人和耶路撒冷的居民说，耶和华说，你们不受教训，不听从我的话吗？

chapters.en: ‘Jehonadab son of Rekab ordered his descendants not to drink wine and this command has been kept. To this day they do not drink wine, because they obey their forefather’s command. But I have spoken to you again and again, yet you have not obeyed me.
chapters.zh: 利甲的儿子约拿达所吩咐他子孙不可喝酒的话，他们已经遵守，直到今日也不喝酒，因为他们听从先祖的吩咐。我从早起来警戒你们，你们却不听从我。

chapters.en: Again and again I sent all my servants the prophets to you. They said, “Each of you must turn from your wicked ways and reform your actions; do not follow other gods to serve them. Then you will live in the land I have given to you and your ancestors.” But you have not paid attention or listened to me.
chapters.zh: 我从早起来，差遣我的仆人众先知去，说，你们各人当回头，离开恶道，改正行为，不随从事奉别神，就必住在我所赐给你们和你们列祖的地上。只是你们没有听从我，也没有侧耳而听。

chapters.en: The descendants of Jehonadab son of Rekab have carried out the command their forefather gave them, but these people have not obeyed me.’
chapters.zh: 利甲的儿子约拿达的子孙能遵守先人所吩咐他们的命，这百姓却没有听从我。

chapters.en: “Therefore this is what the LORD God Almighty, the God of Israel, says: ‘Listen! I am going to bring on Judah and on everyone living in Jerusalem every disaster I pronounced against them. I spoke to them, but they did not listen; I called to them, but they did not answer.’ ”
chapters.zh: 因此，耶和华万军之神，以色列的神如此说，我要使我所说的一切灾祸临到犹大人和耶路撒冷的一切居民。因为我对他们说话，他们没有听从。我呼唤他们，他们没有答应。

chapters.en: Then Jeremiah said to the family of the Rekabites, “This is what the LORD Almighty, the God of Israel, says: ‘You have obeyed the command of your forefather Jehonadab and have followed all his instructions and have done everything he ordered.’
chapters.zh: 耶利米对利甲族的人说，万军之耶和华以色列的神如此说，因你们听从你们先祖约拿达的吩咐，谨守他的一切诫命，照他所吩咐你们的去行，

chapters.en: Therefore this is what the LORD Almighty, the God of Israel, says: ‘Jehonadab son of Rekab will never fail to have a descendant to serve me.’ ”
chapters.zh: 所以万军之耶和华以色列的神如此说，利甲的儿子约拿达必永不缺人侍立在我面前。

chapters.en: In the fourth year of Jehoiakim son of Josiah king of Judah, this word came to Jeremiah from the LORD:
chapters.zh: 犹大王约西亚的儿子约雅敬第四年，耶和华的话临到耶利米说，

chapters.en: “Take a scroll and write on it all the words I have spoken to you concerning Israel, Judah and all the other nations from the time I began speaking to you in the reign of Josiah till now.
chapters.zh: 你取一书卷，将我对你说攻击以色列和犹大，并各国的一切话，从我对你说话的那日，就是从约西亚的日子起直到今日，都写在其上。

chapters.en: Perhaps when the people of Judah hear about every disaster I plan to inflict on them, they will each turn from their wicked ways; then I will forgive their wickedness and their sin.”
chapters.zh: 或者犹大家听见我想要降与他们的一切灾祸，各人就回头，离开恶道，我好赦免他们的罪孽和罪恶。

chapters.en: So Jeremiah called Baruch son of Neriah, and while Jeremiah dictated all the words the LORD had spoken to him, Baruch wrote them on the scroll.
chapters.zh: 所以，耶利米召了尼利亚的儿子巴录来。巴录就从耶利米口中，将耶和华对耶利米所说的一切话写在书卷上。

chapters.en: Then Jeremiah told Baruch, “I am restricted; I am not allowed to go to the LORD’s temple.
chapters.zh: 耶利米吩咐巴录说，我被拘管，不能进耶和华的殿。

chapters.en: So you go to the house of the LORD on a day of fasting and read to the people from the scroll the words of the LORD that you wrote as I dictated. Read them to all the people of Judah who come in from their towns.
chapters.zh: 所以你要去趁禁食的日子，在耶和华殿中将耶和华的话，就是你从我口中所写在书卷上的话，念给百姓和一切从犹大城邑出来的人听。

chapters.en: Perhaps they will bring their petition before the LORD and will each turn from their wicked ways, for the anger and wrath pronounced against this people by the LORD are great.”
chapters.zh: 或者他们在耶和华面前恳求各人回头，离开恶道，因为耶和华向这百姓所说要发的怒气和忿怒是大的。

chapters.en: Baruch son of Neriah did everything Jeremiah the prophet told him to do; at the LORD’s temple he read the words of the LORD from the scroll.
chapters.zh: 尼利亚的儿子巴录就照先知耶利米一切所吩咐的去行，在耶和华的殿中从书上念耶和华的话。

chapters.en: In the ninth month of the fifth year of Jehoiakim son of Josiah king of Judah, a time of fasting before the LORD was proclaimed for all the people in Jerusalem and those who had come from the towns of Judah.
chapters.zh: 犹大王约西亚的儿子约雅敬第五年九月，耶路撒冷的众民和那从犹大城邑来到耶路撒冷的众民，在耶和华面前宣告禁食的日子，

chapters.en: From the room of Gemariah son of Shaphan the secretary, which was in the upper courtyard at the entrance of the New Gate of the temple, Baruch read to all the people at the LORD’s temple the words of Jeremiah from the scroll.
chapters.zh: 巴录就在耶和华殿的上院，耶和华殿的新门口，沙番的儿子文士基玛利雅的屋内，念书上耶利米的话给众民听。

chapters.en: When Micaiah son of Gemariah, the son of Shaphan, heard all the words of the LORD from the scroll,
chapters.zh: 沙番的孙子，基玛利雅的儿子米该亚听见书上耶和华的一切话，

chapters.en: he went down to the secretary’s room in the royal palace, where all the officials were sitting: Elishama the secretary, Delaiah son of Shemaiah, Elnathan son of Akbor, Gemariah son of Shaphan, Zedekiah son of Hananiah, and all the other officials.
chapters.zh: 他就下到王宫，进入文士的屋子。众首领，就是文士以利沙玛，示玛雅的儿子第莱雅，亚革波的儿子以利拿单，沙番的儿子基玛利雅，哈拿尼雅的儿子西底家，和其余的首领都坐在那里。

chapters.en: After Micaiah told them everything he had heard Baruch read to the people from the scroll,
chapters.zh: 于是米该亚对他们述说他所听见的一切话，就是巴录向百姓念那书的时候所听见的。

chapters.en: all the officials sent Jehudi son of Nethaniah, the son of Shelemiah, the son of Cushi, to say to Baruch, “Bring the scroll from which you have read to the people and come.” So Baruch son of Neriah went to them with the scroll in his hand.
chapters.zh: 众首领就打发古示的曾孙，示利米雅的孙子，尼探雅的儿子犹底到巴录那里，对他说，你将所念给百姓听的书卷拿在手中到我们这里来。尼利亚的儿子巴录就手拿书卷来到他们那里。

chapters.en: They said to him, “Sit down, please, and read it to us.” So Baruch read it to them.
chapters.zh: 他们对他说，请你坐下，念给我们听。巴录就念给他们听。

chapters.en: When they heard all these words, they looked at each other in fear and said to Baruch, “We must report all these words to the king.”
chapters.zh: 他们听见这一切话就害怕，面面相观，对巴录说，我们必须将这一切话告诉王。

chapters.en: Then they asked Baruch, “Tell us, how did you come to write all this? Did Jeremiah dictate it?”
chapters.zh: 他们问巴录说，请你告诉我们，你怎样从他口中写这一切话呢？

chapters.en: “Yes,” Baruch replied, “he dictated all these words to me, and I wrote them in ink on the scroll.”
chapters.zh: 巴录回答说，他用口向我说这一切话，我就用笔墨写在书上。

chapters.en: Then the officials said to Baruch, “You and Jeremiah, go and hide. Don’t let anyone know where you are.”
chapters.zh: 众首领对巴录说，你和耶利米要去藏起来，不可叫人知道你们在哪里。

chapters.en: After they put the scroll in the room of Elishama the secretary, they went to the king in the courtyard and reported everything to him.
chapters.zh: 众首领进院见王，却先把书卷存在文士以利沙玛的屋内，以后将这一切话说给王听。

chapters.en: The king sent Jehudi to get the scroll, and Jehudi brought it from the room of Elishama the secretary and read it to the king and all the officials standing beside him.
chapters.zh: 王就打发犹底去拿这书卷来，他便从文士以利沙玛的屋内取来，念给王和王左右侍立的众首领听。

chapters.en: It was the ninth month and the king was sitting in the winter apartment, with a fire burning in the firepot in front of him.
chapters.zh: 那时正是九月，王坐在过冬的房屋里，王的前面火盆中有烧着的火。

chapters.en: Whenever Jehudi had read three or four columns of the scroll, the king cut them off with a scribe’s knife and threw them into the firepot, until the entire scroll was burned in the fire.
chapters.zh: 犹底念了三四篇（或作行），王就用文士的刀将书卷割破，扔在火盆中，直到全卷在火中烧尽了。

chapters.en: The king and all his attendants who heard all these words showed no fear, nor did they tear their clothes.
chapters.zh: 王和听见这一切话的臣仆都不惧怕，也不撕裂衣服。

chapters.en: Even though Elnathan, Delaiah and Gemariah urged the king not to burn the scroll, he would not listen to them.
chapters.zh: 以利拿单和第莱雅，并基玛利雅恳求王不要烧这书卷，他却不听。

chapters.en: Instead, the king commanded Jerahmeel, a son of the king, Seraiah son of Azriel and Shelemiah son of Abdeel to arrest Baruch the scribe and Jeremiah the prophet. But the LORD had hidden them.
chapters.zh: 王就吩咐哈米勒的儿子（或作王的儿子）耶拉篾和亚斯列的儿子西莱雅，并亚伯叠的儿子示利米雅，去捉拿文士巴录和先知耶利米。耶和华却将他们隐藏。

chapters.en: After the king burned the scroll containing the words that Baruch had written at Jeremiah’s dictation, the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah:
chapters.zh: 王烧了书卷。其上有巴录从耶利米口中所写的话。以后耶和华的话临到耶利米说，

chapters.en: “Take another scroll and write on it all the words that were on the first scroll, which Jehoiakim king of Judah burned up.
chapters.zh: 你再取一卷，将犹大王约雅敬所烧第一卷上的一切话写在其上。

chapters.en: Also tell Jehoiakim king of Judah, ‘This is what the LORD says: You burned that scroll and said, “Why did you write on it that the king of Babylon would certainly come and destroy this land and wipe from it both man and beast?”
chapters.zh: 论到犹大王约雅敬你要说，耶和华如此说，你烧了书卷，说，你为什么在其上写着，说巴比伦王必要来毁灭这地，使这地上绝了人民牲畜呢？

chapters.en: Therefore this is what the LORD says about Jehoiakim king of Judah: He will have no one to sit on the throne of David; his body will be thrown out and exposed to the heat by day and the frost by night.
chapters.zh: 所以耶和华论到犹大王约雅敬说，他后裔中必没有人坐在大卫的宝座上。他的尸首必被抛弃，白日受炎热，黑夜受寒霜。

chapters.en: I will punish him and his children and his attendants for their wickedness; I will bring on them and those living in Jerusalem and the people of Judah every disaster I pronounced against them, because they have not listened.’ ”
chapters.zh: 我必因他和他后裔，并他臣仆的罪孽刑罚他们。我要使我所说的一切灾祸临到他们和耶路撒冷的居民，并犹大人。只是他们不听。

chapters.en: So Jeremiah took another scroll and gave it to the scribe Baruch son of Neriah, and as Jeremiah dictated, Baruch wrote on it all the words of the scroll that Jehoiakim king of Judah had burned in the fire. And many similar words were added to them.
chapters.zh: 于是，耶利米又取一书卷交给尼利亚的儿子文士巴录，他就从耶利米的口中写了犹大王约雅敬所烧前卷上的一切话，另外又添了许多相彷的话。

chapters.en: Zedekiah son of Josiah was made king of Judah by Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon; he reigned in place of Jehoiachin son of Jehoiakim.
chapters.zh: 约西亚的儿子西底家代替约雅敬的儿子哥尼雅为王，是巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒立在犹大地作王的。

chapters.en: Neither he nor his attendants nor the people of the land paid any attention to the words the LORD had spoken through Jeremiah the prophet.
chapters.zh: 但西底家和他的臣仆，并国中的百姓，都不听从耶和华借先知耶利米所说的话。

chapters.en: King Zedekiah, however, sent Jehukal son of Shelemiah with the priest Zephaniah son of Maaseiah to Jeremiah the prophet with this message: “Please pray to the LORD our God for us.”
chapters.zh: 西底家王打发示利米雅的儿子犹甲，和祭司玛西雅的儿子西番雅，去见先知耶利米，说，求你为我们祷告耶和华我们的神。

chapters.en: Now Jeremiah was free to come and go among the people, for he had not yet been put in prison.
chapters.zh: 那时耶利米在民中出入，因为他们还没有把他囚在监里。

chapters.en: Pharaoh’s army had marched out of Egypt, and when the Babylonians who were besieging Jerusalem heard the report about them, they withdrew from Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 法老的军队已经从埃及出来，那围困耶路撒冷的迦勒底人听见他们的风声，就拔营离开耶路撒冷去了。

chapters.en: Then the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah the prophet:
chapters.zh: 耶和华的话临到先知耶利米说，

chapters.en: “This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: Tell the king of Judah, who sent you to inquire of me, ‘Pharaoh’s army, which has marched out to support you, will go back to its own land, to Egypt.
chapters.zh: 耶和华以色列的神如此说，犹大王打发你们来求问我，你们要如此对他说，那出来帮助你们法老的军队必回埃及本国去。

chapters.en: Then the Babylonians will return and attack this city; they will capture it and burn it down.’
chapters.zh: 迦勒底人必再来攻打这城，并要攻取，用火焚烧。

chapters.en: “This is what the LORD says: Do not deceive yourselves, thinking, ‘The Babylonians will surely leave us.’ They will not!
chapters.zh: 耶和华如此说，你们不要自欺说迦勒底人必定离开我们，因为他们必不离开。

chapters.en: Even if you were to defeat the entire Babylonian army that is attacking you and only wounded men were left in their tents, they would come out and burn this city down.”
chapters.zh: 你们即便杀败了与你们争战的迦勒底全军，但剩下受伤的人也必各人从帐棚里起来，用火焚烧这城。

chapters.en: After the Babylonian army had withdrawn from Jerusalem because of Pharaoh’s army,
chapters.zh: 迦勒底的军队因怕法老的军队，拔营离开耶路撒冷的时候，

chapters.en: Jeremiah started to leave the city to go to the territory of Benjamin to get his share of the property among the people there.
chapters.zh: 耶利米就杂在民中出离耶路撒冷，要往便雅悯地去，在那里得自己的地业。

chapters.en: But when he reached the Benjamin Gate, the captain of the guard, whose name was Irijah son of Shelemiah, the son of Hananiah, arrested him and said, “You are deserting to the Babylonians!”
chapters.zh: 他到了便雅悯门那里，有守门官名叫伊利雅，是哈拿尼亚的孙子，示利米雅的儿子，他就拿住先知耶利米，说，你是投降迦勒底人哪。

chapters.en: “That’s not true!” Jeremiah said. “I am not deserting to the Babylonians.” But Irijah would not listen to him; instead, he arrested Jeremiah and brought him to the officials.
chapters.zh: 耶利米说，你这是谎话，我并不是投降迦勒底人。伊利雅不听他的话，就拿住他，解到首领那里。

chapters.en: They were angry with Jeremiah and had him beaten and imprisoned in the house of Jonathan the secretary, which they had made into a prison.
chapters.zh: 首领恼怒耶利米，就打了他，将他囚在文士约拿单的房屋中，因为他们以这房屋当作监牢。

chapters.en: Jeremiah was put into a vaulted cell in a dungeon, where he remained a long time.
chapters.zh: 耶利米来到狱中，进入牢房，在那里囚了多日。

chapters.en: Then King Zedekiah sent for him and had him brought to the palace, where he asked him privately, “Is there any word from the LORD?” “Yes,” Jeremiah replied, “you will be delivered into the hands of the king of Babylon.”
chapters.zh: 西底家王打发人提出他来，在自己的宫内私下问他说，从耶和华有什么话临到没有。耶利米说，有。又说，你必交在巴比伦王手中。

chapters.en: Then Jeremiah said to King Zedekiah, “What crime have I committed against you or your attendants or this people, that you have put me in prison?
chapters.zh: 耶利米又对西底家王说，我在什么事上得罪你，或你的臣仆，或这百姓，你竟将我囚在监里呢？

chapters.en: Where are your prophets who prophesied to you, ‘The king of Babylon will not attack you or this land’?
chapters.zh: 对你们预言巴比伦王必不来攻击你们和这地的先知，现今在哪里呢？

chapters.en: But now, my lord the king, please listen. Let me bring my petition before you: Do not send me back to the house of Jonathan the secretary, or I will die there.”
chapters.zh: 主我的王阿，求你现在垂听，准我在你面前的恳求，不要使我回到文士约拿单的房屋中，免得我死在那里。

chapters.en: King Zedekiah then gave orders for Jeremiah to be placed in the courtyard of the guard and given a loaf of bread from the street of the bakers each day until all the bread in the city was gone. So Jeremiah remained in the courtyard of the guard.
chapters.zh: 于是，西底家王下令，他们就把耶利米交在护卫兵的院中，每天从饼铺街取一个饼给他，直到城中的饼用尽了。这样，耶利米仍在护卫兵的院中。

chapters.en: Shephatiah son of Mattan, Gedaliah son of Pashhur, Jehukal son of Shelemiah, and Pashhur son of Malkijah heard what Jeremiah was telling all the people when he said,
chapters.zh: 玛坦的儿子示法提雅，巴施户珥的儿子基大利，示利米雅的儿子犹甲，玛基雅的儿子巴示户珥听见耶利米对众人所说的话，说，

chapters.en: “This is what the LORD says: ‘Whoever stays in this city will die by the sword, famine or plague, but whoever goes over to the Babylonians will live. They will escape with their lives; they will live.’
chapters.zh: 耶和华如此说，住在这城里的必遭刀剑，饥荒，瘟疫而死。但出去归降迦勒底人的必得存活，就是以自己命为掠物的，必得存活。

chapters.en: And this is what the LORD says: ‘This city will certainly be given into the hands of the army of the king of Babylon, who will capture it.’ ”
chapters.zh: 耶和华如此说，这城必要交在巴比伦王军队的手中，他必攻取这城。

chapters.en: Then the officials said to the king, “This man should be put to death. He is discouraging the soldiers who are left in this city, as well as all the people, by the things he is saying to them. This man is not seeking the good of these people but their ruin.”
chapters.zh: 于是首领对王说，求你将这人治死。因他向城里剩下的兵丁和众民说这样的话，使他们的手发软。这人不是求这百姓得平安，乃是叫他们受灾祸。

chapters.en: “He is in your hands,” King Zedekiah answered. “The king can do nothing to oppose you.”
chapters.zh: 西底家王说，他在你们手中，无论何事，王也不能与你们反对。

chapters.en: So they took Jeremiah and put him into the cistern of Malkijah, the king’s son, which was in the courtyard of the guard. They lowered Jeremiah by ropes into the cistern; it had no water in it, only mud, and Jeremiah sank down into the mud.
chapters.zh: 他们就拿住耶利米，下在哈米勒的儿子（或作王的儿子）玛基雅的牢狱里。那牢狱在护卫兵的院中。他们用绳子将耶利米系下去。牢狱里没有水，只有淤泥，耶利米就陷在淤泥中。

chapters.en: But Ebed-Melek, a Cushite, an official in the royal palace, heard that they had put Jeremiah into the cistern. While the king was sitting in the Benjamin Gate,
chapters.zh: 在王宫的太监古实人以伯米勒，听见他们将耶利米下了牢狱（那时王坐在便雅悯门口），

chapters.en: Ebed-Melek went out of the palace and said to him,
chapters.zh: 以伯米勒就从王宫里出来，对王说，

chapters.en: “My lord the king, these men have acted wickedly in all they have done to Jeremiah the prophet. They have thrown him into a cistern, where he will starve to death when there is no longer any bread in the city.”
chapters.zh: 主我的王阿，这些人向先知耶利米一味地行恶，将他下在牢狱中。他在那里必因饥饿而死，因为城中再没有粮食。

chapters.en: Then the king commanded Ebed-Melek the Cushite, “Take thirty men from here with you and lift Jeremiah the prophet out of the cistern before he dies.”
chapters.zh: 王就吩咐古实人以伯米勒说，你从这里带领三十人，趁着先知耶利米未死以前，将他从牢狱中提上来。

chapters.en: So Ebed-Melek took the men with him and went to a room under the treasury in the palace. He took some old rags and worn-out clothes from there and let them down with ropes to Jeremiah in the cistern.
chapters.zh: 于是以伯米勒带领这些人同去，进入王宫，到库房以下，从那里取了些碎布和破烂的衣服，用绳子缒下牢狱去到耶利米那里。

chapters.en: Ebed-Melek the Cushite said to Jeremiah, “Put these old rags and worn-out clothes under your arms to pad the ropes.” Jeremiah did so,
chapters.zh: 古实人以伯米勒对耶利米说，你用这些碎布和破烂的衣服放在绳子上，垫你的胳肢窝。耶利米就照样行了。

chapters.en: and they pulled him up with the ropes and lifted him out of the cistern. And Jeremiah remained in the courtyard of the guard.
chapters.zh: 这样，他们用绳子将耶利米从牢狱里拉上来。耶利米仍在护卫兵的院中。

chapters.en: Then King Zedekiah sent for Jeremiah the prophet and had him brought to the third entrance to the temple of the LORD. “I am going to ask you something,” the king said to Jeremiah. “Do not hide anything from me.”
chapters.zh: 西底家王打发人带领先知耶利米，进耶和华殿中第三门里见王。王就对耶利米说，我要问你一件事，你丝毫不可向我隐瞒。

chapters.en: Jeremiah said to Zedekiah, “If I give you an answer, will you not kill me? Even if I did give you counsel, you would not listen to me.”
chapters.zh: 耶利米对西底家说，我若告诉你，你岂不定要杀我吗？我若劝戒你，你必不听从我。

chapters.en: But King Zedekiah swore this oath secretly to Jeremiah: “As surely as the LORD lives, who has given us breath, I will neither kill you nor hand you over to those who want to kill you.”
chapters.zh: 西底家王就私下向耶利米说，我指着那造我们生命之永生的耶和华起誓，我必不杀你，也不将你交在寻索你命的人手中。

chapters.en: Then Jeremiah said to Zedekiah, “This is what the LORD God Almighty, the God of Israel, says: ‘If you surrender to the officers of the king of Babylon, your life will be spared and this city will not be burned down; you and your family will live.
chapters.zh: 耶利米对西底家说，耶和华万军之神，以色列的神如此说，你若出去归降巴比伦王的首领，你的命就必存活，这城也不至被火焚烧，你和你的全家都必存活。

chapters.en: But if you will not surrender to the officers of the king of Babylon, this city will be given into the hands of the Babylonians and they will burn it down; you yourself will not escape from them.’ ”
chapters.zh: 你若不出去归降巴比伦王的首领，这城必交在迦勒底人手中。他们必用火焚烧，你也不得脱离他们的手。

chapters.en: King Zedekiah said to Jeremiah, “I am afraid of the Jews who have gone over to the Babylonians, for the Babylonians may hand me over to them and they will mistreat me.”
chapters.zh: 西底家王对耶利米说，我怕那些投降迦勒底人的犹大人，恐怕迦勒底人将我交在他们手中，他们戏弄我。

chapters.en: “They will not hand you over,” Jeremiah replied. “Obey the LORD by doing what I tell you. Then it will go well with you, and your life will be spared.
chapters.zh: 耶利米说，迦勒底人必不将你交出。求你听从我对你所说耶和华的话，这样你必得好处，你的命也必存活。

chapters.en: But if you refuse to surrender, this is what the LORD has revealed to me:
chapters.zh: 你若不肯出去，耶和华指示我的话乃是这样，

chapters.en: All the women left in the palace of the king of Judah will be brought out to the officials of the king of Babylon. Those women will say to you: “ ‘They misled you and overcame you— those trusted friends of yours. Your feet are sunk in the mud; your friends have deserted you.’
chapters.zh: 犹大王宫里所剩的妇女必都带到巴比伦王的首领那里。这些妇女必说，你知己的朋友催逼你，胜过你。见你的脚陷入淤泥中，就转身退后了。

chapters.en: “All your wives and children will be brought out to the Babylonians. You yourself will not escape from their hands but will be captured by the king of Babylon; and this city will be burned down.”
chapters.zh: 人必将你的后妃和你的儿女带到迦勒底人那里。你也不得脱离他们的手，必被巴比伦王的手捉住。你也必使这城被火焚烧。

chapters.en: Then Zedekiah said to Jeremiah, “Do not let anyone know about this conversation, or you may die.
chapters.zh: 西底家对耶利米说，不要使人知道这些话，你就不至于死。

chapters.en: If the officials hear that I talked with you, and they come to you and say, ‘Tell us what you said to the king and what the king said to you; do not hide it from us or we will kill you,’
chapters.zh: 首领若听见了我与你说话，就来见你，问你说，你对王说什么话不要向我们隐瞒，我们就不杀你。王向你说什么话也要告诉我们。

chapters.en: then tell them, ‘I was pleading with the king not to send me back to Jonathan’s house to die there.’ ”
chapters.zh: 你就对他们说，我在王面前恳求不要叫我回到约拿单的房屋死在那里。

chapters.en: All the officials did come to Jeremiah and question him, and he told them everything the king had ordered him to say. So they said no more to him, for no one had heard his conversation with the king.
chapters.zh: 随后众首领来见耶利米，问他，他就照王所吩咐的一切话回答他们。他们不再与他说话，因为事情没有泄漏。

chapters.en: And Jeremiah remained in the courtyard of the guard until the day Jerusalem was captured. This is how Jerusalem was taken:
chapters.zh: 于是耶利米仍在护卫兵的院中，直到耶路撒冷被攻取的日子。

chapters.en: In the ninth year of Zedekiah king of Judah, in the tenth month, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon marched against Jerusalem with his whole army and laid siege to it.
chapters.zh: 犹大王西底家第九年十月，巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒率领全军来围困耶路撒冷。

chapters.en: And on the ninth day of the fourth month of Zedekiah’s eleventh year, the city wall was broken through.
chapters.zh: 西底家十一年四月初九日，城被攻破。

chapters.en: Then all the officials of the king of Babylon came and took seats in the Middle Gate: Nergal-Sharezer of Samgar, Nebo-Sarsekim a chief officer, Nergal-Sharezer a high official and all the other officials of the king of Babylon.
chapters.zh: 耶路撒冷被攻取的时候，巴比伦王的首领尼甲沙利薛，三甲尼波，撒西金，拉撒力，尼甲沙利薛，拉墨，并巴比伦王其余的一切首领都来坐在中门。

chapters.en: When Zedekiah king of Judah and all the soldiers saw them, they fled; they left the city at night by way of the king’s garden, through the gate between the two walls, and headed toward the Arabah.
chapters.zh: 犹大王西底家和一切兵丁看见他们，就在夜间从靠近王园两城中间的门出城逃跑，往亚拉巴逃去。

chapters.en: But the Babylonian army pursued them and overtook Zedekiah in the plains of Jericho. They captured him and took him to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon at Riblah in the land of Hamath, where he pronounced sentence on him.
chapters.zh: 迦勒底的军队追赶他们，在耶利哥的平原追上西底家，将他拿住，带到哈马地的利比拉，巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒那里。尼布甲尼撒就审判他。

chapters.en: There at Riblah the king of Babylon slaughtered the sons of Zedekiah before his eyes and also killed all the nobles of Judah.
chapters.zh: 巴比伦王在利比拉，西底家眼前杀了他的众子，又杀了犹大的一切贵胄，

chapters.en: Then he put out Zedekiah’s eyes and bound him with bronze shackles to take him to Babylon.
chapters.zh: 并且剜西底家的眼睛，用铜链锁着他，要带到巴比伦去。

chapters.en: The Babylonians set fire to the royal palace and the houses of the people and broke down the walls of Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 迦勒底人用火焚烧王宫和百姓的房屋，又拆毁耶路撒冷的城墙。

chapters.en: Nebuzaradan commander of the imperial guard carried into exile to Babylon the people who remained in the city, along with those who had gone over to him, and the rest of the people.
chapters.zh: 那时，护卫长尼布撒拉旦将城里所剩下的百姓和投降他的逃民，以及其余的民都掳到巴比伦去了。

chapters.en: But Nebuzaradan the commander of the guard left behind in the land of Judah some of the poor people, who owned nothing; and at that time he gave them vineyards and fields.
chapters.zh: 护卫长尼布撒拉旦却将民中毫无所有的穷人留在犹大地，当时给他们葡萄园和田地。

chapters.en: Now Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon had given these orders about Jeremiah through Nebuzaradan commander of the imperial guard:
chapters.zh: 巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒提到耶利米，嘱咐护卫长尼布撒拉旦说，

chapters.en: “Take him and look after him; don’t harm him but do for him whatever he asks.”
chapters.zh: 你领他去，好好地看待他，切不可害他。他对你怎么说，你就向他怎么行。

chapters.en: So Nebuzaradan the commander of the guard, Nebushazban a chief officer, Nergal-Sharezer a high official and all the other officers of the king of Babylon
chapters.zh: 护卫长尼布撒拉旦和尼布沙斯班，拉撒力，尼甲沙利薛，拉墨，并巴比伦王的一切官长，

chapters.en: sent and had Jeremiah taken out of the courtyard of the guard. They turned him over to Gedaliah son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan, to take him back to his home. So he remained among his own people.
chapters.zh: 打发人去，将耶利米从护卫兵院中提出来，交与沙番的孙子亚希甘的儿子基大利，带回家去。于是耶利米住在民中。

chapters.en: While Jeremiah had been confined in the courtyard of the guard, the word of the LORD came to him:
chapters.zh: 耶利米还囚在护卫兵院中的时候，耶和华的话临到他说，

chapters.en: “Go and tell Ebed-Melek the Cushite, ‘This is what the LORD Almighty, the God of Israel, says: I am about to fulfill my words against this city—words concerning disaster, not prosperity. At that time they will be fulfilled before your eyes.
chapters.zh: 你去告诉古实人以伯米勒说，万军之耶和华以色列的神如此说，我说降祸不降福的话必临到这城，到那时必在你面前成就了。

chapters.en: But I will rescue you on that day, declares the LORD; you will not be given into the hands of those you fear.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说，到那日我必拯救你，你必不至交在你所怕的人手中。

chapters.en: I will save you; you will not fall by the sword but will escape with your life, because you trust in me, declares the LORD.’ ”
chapters.zh: 我定要搭救你，你不至倒在刀下，却要以自己的命为掠物，因你倚靠我。这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: The word came to Jeremiah from the LORD after Nebuzaradan commander of the imperial guard had released him at Ramah. He had found Jeremiah bound in chains among all the captives from Jerusalem and Judah who were being carried into exile to Babylon.
chapters.zh: 耶利米锁在耶路撒冷和犹大被掳到巴比伦的人中，护卫长尼布撒拉旦将他从拉玛释放以后，耶和华的话临到耶利米。

chapters.en: When the commander of the guard found Jeremiah, he said to him, “The LORD your God decreed this disaster for this place.
chapters.zh: 护卫长将耶利米叫来，对他说，耶和华你的神曾说要降这祸与此地。

chapters.en: And now the LORD has brought it about; he has done just as he said he would. All this happened because you people sinned against the LORD and did not obey him.
chapters.zh: 耶和华使这祸临到，照他所说的行了。因为你们得罪耶和华，没有听从他的话，所以这事临到你们。

chapters.en: But today I am freeing you from the chains on your wrists. Come with me to Babylon, if you like, and I will look after you; but if you do not want to, then don’t come. Look, the whole country lies before you; go wherever you please.”
chapters.zh: 现在我解开你手上的链子，你若看与我同往巴比伦去好，就可以去，我必厚待你。你若看与我同往巴比伦去不好，就不必去。看哪，全地在你面前，你以为哪里美好，哪里合宜，只管上哪里去吧。

chapters.en: However, before Jeremiah turned to go, Nebuzaradan added, “Go back to Gedaliah son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan, whom the king of Babylon has appointed over the towns of Judah, and live with him among the people, or go anywhere else you please.” Then the commander gave him provisions and a present and let him go.
chapters.zh: 耶利米还没有回去，护卫长说，你可以回到沙番的孙子亚希甘的儿子基大利那里去。现在巴比伦王立他作犹大城邑的省长。你可以在他那里住在民中，不然，你看哪里合宜就可以上哪里去。于是护卫长送他粮食和礼物，释放他去了。

chapters.en: So Jeremiah went to Gedaliah son of Ahikam at Mizpah and stayed with him among the people who were left behind in the land.
chapters.zh: 耶利米就到米斯巴见亚希甘的儿子基大利，在他那里住在境内剩下的民中。

chapters.en: When all the army officers and their men who were still in the open country heard that the king of Babylon had appointed Gedaliah son of Ahikam as governor over the land and had put him in charge of the men, women and children who were the poorest in the land and who had not been carried into exile to Babylon,
chapters.zh: 在田野的一切军长，和属他们的人，听见巴比伦王立了亚希甘的儿子基大利作境内的省长，并将没有掳到巴比伦的男人，妇女，孩童，和境内极穷的人全交给他。

chapters.en: they came to Gedaliah at Mizpah—Ishmael son of Nethaniah, Johanan and Jonathan the sons of Kareah, Seraiah son of Tanhumeth, the sons of Ephai the Netophathite, and Jaazaniah the son of the Maakathite, and their men.
chapters.zh: 于是军长尼探雅的儿子以实玛利，加利亚的两个儿子约哈难和约拿单，单户篾的儿子西莱雅，并尼陀法人以斐的众子，玛迦人的儿子耶撒尼亚和属他们的人，都到米斯巴见基大利。

chapters.en: Gedaliah son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan, took an oath to reassure them and their men. “Do not be afraid to serve the Babylonians, ” he said. “Settle down in the land and serve the king of Babylon, and it will go well with you.
chapters.zh: 沙番的孙子亚希甘的儿子基大利向他们和属他们的人起誓说，不要怕服事迦勒底人，只管住在这地，服事巴比伦王，就可以得福。

chapters.en: I myself will stay at Mizpah to represent you before the Babylonians who come to us, but you are to harvest the wine, summer fruit and olive oil, and put them in your storage jars, and live in the towns you have taken over.”
chapters.zh: 至于我，我要住在米斯巴，伺候那到我们这里来的迦勒底人。只是你们当积蓄酒，油，和夏天的果子，收在器皿里，住在你们所占的城邑中。

chapters.en: When all the Jews in Moab, Ammon, Edom and all the other countries heard that the king of Babylon had left a remnant in Judah and had appointed Gedaliah son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan, as governor over them,
chapters.zh: 在摩押地和亚扪人中，在以东地和各国的一切犹大人，听见巴比伦王留下些犹大人，并立沙番的孙子亚希甘的儿子基大利管理他们。

chapters.en: they all came back to the land of Judah, to Gedaliah at Mizpah, from all the countries where they had been scattered. And they harvested an abundance of wine and summer fruit.
chapters.zh: 这一切犹大人就从所赶到的各处回来，到犹大地的米斯巴基大利那里，又积蓄了许多的酒，并夏天的果子。

chapters.en: Johanan son of Kareah and all the army officers still in the open country came to Gedaliah at Mizpah
chapters.zh: 加利亚的儿子约哈难和在田野的一切军长来到米斯巴见基大利，

chapters.en: and said to him, “Don’t you know that Baalis king of the Ammonites has sent Ishmael son of Nethaniah to take your life?” But Gedaliah son of Ahikam did not believe them.
chapters.zh: 对他说，亚扪人的王巴利斯打发尼探雅的儿子以实玛利来要你的命，你知道吗？亚希甘的儿子基大利却不信他们的话。

chapters.en: Then Johanan son of Kareah said privately to Gedaliah in Mizpah, “Let me go and kill Ishmael son of Nethaniah, and no one will know it. Why should he take your life and cause all the Jews who are gathered around you to be scattered and the remnant of Judah to perish?”
chapters.zh: 加利亚的儿子约哈难在米斯巴私下对基大利说，求你容我去杀尼探雅的儿子以实玛利，必无人知道。何必让他要你的命，使聚集到你这里来的犹大人都分散，以致犹大剩下的人都灭亡呢？

chapters.en: But Gedaliah son of Ahikam said to Johanan son of Kareah, “Don’t do such a thing! What you are saying about Ishmael is not true.”
chapters.zh: 亚希甘的儿子基大利对加利亚的儿子约哈难说，你不可行这事，你所论以实玛利的话是假的。

chapters.en: In the seventh month Ishmael son of Nethaniah, the son of Elishama, who was of royal blood and had been one of the king’s officers, came with ten men to Gedaliah son of Ahikam at Mizpah. While they were eating together there,
chapters.zh: 七月间，王的大臣宗室以利沙玛的孙子，尼探雅的儿子以实玛利带着十个人，来到米斯巴见亚希甘的儿子基大利。他们在米斯巴一同吃饭。

chapters.en: Ishmael son of Nethaniah and the ten men who were with him got up and struck down Gedaliah son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan, with the sword, killing the one whom the king of Babylon had appointed as governor over the land.
chapters.zh: 尼探雅的儿子以实玛利和同他来的那十个人起来，用刀杀了沙番的孙子亚希甘的儿子基大利，就是巴比伦王所立为全地省长的。

chapters.en: Ishmael also killed all the men of Judah who were with Gedaliah at Mizpah, as well as the Babylonian soldiers who were there.
chapters.zh: 以实玛利又杀了在米斯巴，基大利那里的一切犹大人和所遇见的迦勒底兵丁。

chapters.en: The day after Gedaliah’s assassination, before anyone knew about it,
chapters.zh: 他杀了基大利，无人知道。

chapters.en: eighty men who had shaved off their beards, torn their clothes and cut themselves came from Shechem, Shiloh and Samaria, bringing grain offerings and incense with them to the house of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 第二天，有八十人从示剑和示罗，并撒玛利亚来，胡须剃去，衣服撕裂，身体划破，手拿素祭和乳香，要奉到耶和华的殿。

chapters.en: Ishmael son of Nethaniah went out from Mizpah to meet them, weeping as he went. When he met them, he said, “Come to Gedaliah son of Ahikam.”
chapters.zh: 尼探雅的儿子以实玛利出米斯巴迎接他们，随走随哭。遇见了他们，就对他们说，你们可以来见亚希甘的儿子基大利。

chapters.en: When they went into the city, Ishmael son of Nethaniah and the men who were with him slaughtered them and threw them into a cistern.
chapters.zh: 他们到了城中，尼探雅的儿子以实玛利和同着他的人就将他们杀了，抛在坑中。

chapters.en: But ten of them said to Ishmael, “Don’t kill us! We have wheat and barley, olive oil and honey, hidden in a field.” So he let them alone and did not kill them with the others.
chapters.zh: 只是他们中间有十个人对以实玛利说，不要杀我们，因为我们有许多大麦，小麦，油，蜜藏在田间。于是他住了手，没有将他们杀在弟兄中间。

chapters.en: Now the cistern where he threw all the bodies of the men he had killed along with Gedaliah was the one King Asa had made as part of his defense against Baasha king of Israel. Ishmael son of Nethaniah filled it with the dead.
chapters.zh: 以实玛利将所杀之人的尸首都抛在坑里基大利的旁边。这坑是从前亚撒王因怕以色列王巴沙所挖的。尼探雅的儿子以实玛利将那些被杀的人填满了坑。

chapters.en: Ishmael made captives of all the rest of the people who were in Mizpah—the king’s daughters along with all the others who were left there, over whom Nebuzaradan commander of the imperial guard had appointed Gedaliah son of Ahikam. Ishmael son of Nethaniah took them captive and set out to cross over to the Ammonites.
chapters.zh: 以实玛利将米斯巴剩下的人，就是众公主和仍住在米斯巴所有的百姓，原是护卫长尼布撒拉旦交给亚希甘的儿子基大利的，都掳去了。尼探雅的儿子以实玛利掳了他们，要往亚扪人那里去。

chapters.en: When Johanan son of Kareah and all the army officers who were with him heard about all the crimes Ishmael son of Nethaniah had committed,
chapters.zh: 加利亚的儿子约哈难，和同着他的众军长，听见尼探雅的儿子以实玛利所行的一切恶，

chapters.en: they took all their men and went to fight Ishmael son of Nethaniah. They caught up with him near the great pool in Gibeon.
chapters.zh: 就带领众人前往，要和尼探雅的儿子以实玛利争战，在基遍的大水旁（或作大水池旁）遇见他。

chapters.en: When all the people Ishmael had with him saw Johanan son of Kareah and the army officers who were with him, they were glad.
chapters.zh: 以实玛利那里的众人看见加利亚的儿子约哈难和同着他的众军长，就都欢喜。

chapters.en: All the people Ishmael had taken captive at Mizpah turned and went over to Johanan son of Kareah.
chapters.zh: 这样，以实玛利从米斯巴所掳去的众人都转身归加利亚的儿子约哈难去了。

chapters.en: But Ishmael son of Nethaniah and eight of his men escaped from Johanan and fled to the Ammonites.
chapters.zh: 尼探雅的儿子以实玛利和八个人脱离约哈难的手，逃往亚扪人那里去了。

chapters.en: Then Johanan son of Kareah and all the army officers who were with him led away all the people of Mizpah who had survived, whom Johanan had recovered from Ishmael son of Nethaniah after Ishmael had assassinated Gedaliah son of Ahikam—the soldiers, women, children and court officials he had recovered from Gibeon.
chapters.zh: 尼探雅的儿子以实玛利杀了亚希甘的儿子基大利，从米斯巴将剩下的一切百姓，兵丁，妇女，孩童，太监掳到基遍之后，加利亚的儿子约哈难和同着他的众军长将他们都夺回来，

chapters.en: And they went on, stopping at Geruth Kimham near Bethlehem on their way to Egypt
chapters.zh: 带到靠近伯利恒的金罕寓（或作基罗特金罕）住下，要进入埃及去。

chapters.en: to escape the Babylonians. They were afraid of them because Ishmael son of Nethaniah had killed Gedaliah son of Ahikam, whom the king of Babylon had appointed as governor over the land.
chapters.zh: 因为尼探雅的儿子以实玛利杀了巴比伦王所立为省长的亚希甘的儿子基大利，约哈难惧怕迦勒底人。

chapters.en: Then all the army officers, including Johanan son of Kareah and Jezaniah son of Hoshaiah, and all the people from the least to the greatest approached
chapters.zh: 众军长和加利亚的儿子约哈难，并何沙雅的儿子耶撒尼亚（耶撒尼亚又名亚撒利雅，见四十三章二节）以及众百姓，从最小的到至大的都进前来，

chapters.en: Jeremiah the prophet and said to him, “Please hear our petition and pray to the LORD your God for this entire remnant. For as you now see, though we were once many, now only a few are left.
chapters.zh: 对先知耶利米说，求你准我们在你面前祈求，为我们这剩下的人祷告耶和华你的神。我们本来众多，现在剩下的极少，这是你亲眼所见的。

chapters.en: Pray that the LORD your God will tell us where we should go and what we should do.”
chapters.zh: 愿耶和华你的神指示我们所当走的路，所当作的事。

chapters.en: “I have heard you,” replied Jeremiah the prophet. “I will certainly pray to the LORD your God as you have requested; I will tell you everything the LORD says and will keep nothing back from you.”
chapters.zh: 先知耶利米对他们说，我已经听见你们了，我必照着你们的话祷告耶和华你们的神。耶和华无论回答什么，我必都告诉你们，毫不隐瞒。

chapters.en: Then they said to Jeremiah, “May the LORD be a true and faithful witness against us if we do not act in accordance with everything the LORD your God sends you to tell us.
chapters.zh: 于是他们对耶利米说，我们若不照耶和华你的神差遣你来说的一切话行，愿耶和华在我们中间作真实诚信的见证。

chapters.en: Whether it is favorable or unfavorable, we will obey the LORD our God, to whom we are sending you, so that it will go well with us, for we will obey the LORD our God.”
chapters.zh: 我们现在请你到耶和华我们的神面前，他说的无论是好是歹，我们都必听从。我们听从耶和华我们神的话，就可以得福。

chapters.en: Ten days later the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah.
chapters.zh: 过了十天，耶和华的话临到耶利米。

chapters.en: So he called together Johanan son of Kareah and all the army officers who were with him and all the people from the least to the greatest.
chapters.zh: 他就将加利亚的儿子约哈难和同着他的众军长，并众百姓，从最小的到至大的都叫了来，

chapters.en: He said to them, “This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, to whom you sent me to present your petition, says:
chapters.zh: 对他们说，耶和华以色列的神，就是你们请我在他面前为你们祈求的主，如此说，

chapters.en: ‘If you stay in this land, I will build you up and not tear you down; I will plant you and not uproot you, for I have relented concerning the disaster I have inflicted on you.
chapters.zh: 你们若仍住在这地，我就建立你们，必不拆毁，栽植你们，并不拔出，因我为降与你们的灾祸后悔了。

chapters.en: Do not be afraid of the king of Babylon, whom you now fear. Do not be afraid of him, declares the LORD, for I am with you and will save you and deliver you from his hands.
chapters.zh: 不要怕你们所怕的巴比伦王。耶和华说，不要怕他。因为我与你们同在，要拯救你们脱离他的手。

chapters.en: I will show you compassion so that he will have compassion on you and restore you to your land.’
chapters.zh: 我也要使他发怜悯，好怜悯你们，叫你们归回本地。

chapters.en: “However, if you say, ‘We will not stay in this land,’ and so disobey the LORD your God,
chapters.zh: 倘若你们说，我们不住在这地，以致不听从耶和华你们神的话，

chapters.en: and if you say, ‘No, we will go and live in Egypt, where we will not see war or hear the trumpet or be hungry for bread,’
chapters.zh: 说，我们不住这地，却要进入埃及地，在那里看不见争战，听不见角声，也不至无食饥饿。我们必住在那里。

chapters.en: then hear the word of the LORD, you remnant of Judah. This is what the LORD Almighty, the God of Israel, says: ‘If you are determined to go to Egypt and you do go to settle there,
chapters.zh: 你们所剩下的犹大人哪，现在要听耶和华的话。万军之耶和华以色列的神如此说，你们若定意要进入埃及，在那里寄居，

chapters.en: then the sword you fear will overtake you there, and the famine you dread will follow you into Egypt, and there you will die.
