chapters.zh: 你们所惧怕的刀剑在埃及地必追上你们。你们所惧怕的饥荒在埃及要紧紧地跟随你们。你们必死在那里。

chapters.en: Indeed, all who are determined to go to Egypt to settle there will die by the sword, famine and plague; not one of them will survive or escape the disaster I will bring on them.’
chapters.zh: 凡定意要进入埃及在那里寄居的必遭刀剑，饥荒，瘟疫而死，无一人存留，逃脱我所降与他们的灾祸。

chapters.en: This is what the LORD Almighty, the God of Israel, says: ‘As my anger and wrath have been poured out on those who lived in Jerusalem, so will my wrath be poured out on you when you go to Egypt. You will be a curse and an object of horror, a curse and an object of reproach; you will never see this place again.’
chapters.zh: 万军之耶和华以色列的神如此说，我怎样将我的怒气和忿怒倾在耶路撒冷的居民身上，你们进入埃及的时候，我也必照样将我的忿怒倾在你们身上，以致你们令人辱骂，惊骇，咒诅，羞辱，你们不得再见这地方。

chapters.en: “Remnant of Judah, the LORD has told you, ‘Do not go to Egypt.’ Be sure of this: I warn you today
chapters.zh: 所剩下的犹大人哪，耶和华论到你们说，不要进入埃及去。你们要确实地知道我今日警教你们了。

chapters.en: that you made a fatal mistake when you sent me to the LORD your God and said, ‘Pray to the LORD our God for us; tell us everything he says and we will do it.’
chapters.zh: 你们用诡诈自害。因为你们请我到耶和华你们的神那里，说，求你为我们祷告耶和华我们神，照耶和华我们的神一切所说的告诉我们，我们就必遵行。

chapters.en: I have told you today, but you still have not obeyed the LORD your God in all he sent me to tell you.
chapters.zh: 我今日将这话告诉你们，耶和华你们的神为你们的事差遣我到你们那里说的，你们却一样没有听从。

chapters.en: So now, be sure of this: You will die by the sword, famine and plague in the place where you want to go to settle.”
chapters.zh: 现在你们要确实地知道，你们在所要去寄居之地必遭刀剑，饥荒，瘟疫而死。

chapters.en: When Jeremiah had finished telling the people all the words of the LORD their God—everything the LORD had sent him to tell them—
chapters.zh: 耶利米向众百姓说完了耶和华他们神的一切话，就是耶和华他们神差遣他去所说的一切话。

chapters.en: Azariah son of Hoshaiah and Johanan son of Kareah and all the arrogant men said to Jeremiah, “You are lying! The LORD our God has not sent you to say, ‘You must not go to Egypt to settle there.’
chapters.zh: 何沙雅的儿子亚撒利雅和加利亚的儿子约哈难，并一切狂傲的人，就对耶利米说，你说谎言。耶和华我们的神并没有差遣你来说，你们不可进入埃及，在那里寄居。

chapters.en: But Baruch son of Neriah is inciting you against us to hand us over to the Babylonians, so they may kill us or carry us into exile to Babylon.”
chapters.zh: 这是尼利亚的儿子巴录挑唆你害我们，要将我们交在迦勒底人的手中，使我们有被杀的，有被掳到巴比伦去的。

chapters.en: So Johanan son of Kareah and all the army officers and all the people disobeyed the LORD’s command to stay in the land of Judah.
chapters.zh: 于是加利亚的儿子约哈难和一切军长，并众百姓，不听从耶和华的话住在犹大地。

chapters.en: Instead, Johanan son of Kareah and all the army officers led away all the remnant of Judah who had come back to live in the land of Judah from all the nations where they had been scattered.
chapters.zh: 加利亚的儿子约哈难和一切军长却将所剩下的犹大人，就是从被赶到各国回来在犹大地寄居的男人，妇女，孩童，和众公主，并护卫长尼布撒拉旦所留在沙番的孙子亚希甘的儿子基大利那里的众人，与先知耶利米，以及尼利亚的儿子巴录，

chapters.en: They also led away all those whom Nebuzaradan commander of the imperial guard had left with Gedaliah son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan—the men, the women, the children and the king’s daughters. And they took Jeremiah the prophet and Baruch son of Neriah along with them.
So they entered Egypt in disobedience to the LORD and went as far as Tahpanhes.
chapters.zh: 都带入埃及地，到了答比匿。这是因他们不听从耶和华的话。

chapters.en: In Tahpanhes the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah:
chapters.zh: 在答比匿，耶和华的话临到耶利米说，

chapters.en: “While the Jews are watching, take some large stones with you and bury them in clay in the brick pavement at the entrance to Pharaoh’s palace in Tahpanhes.
chapters.zh: 你在犹大人眼前要用手拿几块大石头，藏在砌砖的灰泥中，就是在答比匿法老的宫门那里，

chapters.en: Then say to them, ‘This is what the LORD Almighty, the God of Israel, says: I will send for my servant Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and I will set his throne over these stones I have buried here; he will spread his royal canopy above them.
chapters.zh: 对他们说，万军之耶和华以色列的神如此说，我必召我的仆人巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒来。在所藏的石头上我要安置他的宝座。他必将光华的宝帐支搭在其上。

chapters.en: He will come and attack Egypt, bringing death to those destined for death, captivity to those destined for captivity, and the sword to those destined for the sword.
chapters.zh: 他要来攻击埃及地，定为死亡的，必至死亡。定为掳掠的，必被掳掠。定为刀杀的，必交刀杀。

chapters.en: He will set fire to the temples of the gods of Egypt; he will burn their temples and take their gods captive. As a shepherd picks his garment clean of lice, so he will pick Egypt clean and depart.
chapters.zh: 我要在埃及神的庙中使火着起，巴比伦王要将庙宇焚烧，神像掳去。他要得（得原文作披上）埃及地，好像牧人披上外衣，从那里安然而去。

chapters.en: There in the temple of the sun in Egypt he will demolish the sacred pillars and will burn down the temples of the gods of Egypt.’ ”
chapters.zh: 他必打碎埃及地伯示麦的柱像，用火焚烧埃及神的庙宇。

chapters.en: This word came to Jeremiah concerning all the Jews living in Lower Egypt—in Migdol, Tahpanhes and Memphis—and in Upper Egypt:
chapters.zh: 有临到耶利米的话，论及一切住在埃及地的犹大人，就是住在密夺，答比匿，挪弗，巴忒罗境内的犹大人，说，

chapters.en: “This is what the LORD Almighty, the God of Israel, says: You saw the great disaster I brought on Jerusalem and on all the towns of Judah. Today they lie deserted and in ruins
chapters.zh: 万军之耶和华以色列的神如此说，我所降与耶路撒冷和犹大各城的一切灾祸你们都看见了。那些城邑今日荒凉，无人居住。

chapters.en: because of the evil they have done. They aroused my anger by burning incense to and worshiping other gods that neither they nor you nor your ancestors ever knew.
chapters.zh: 这是因居民所行的恶，去烧香事奉别神，就是他们和你们，并你们列祖所不认识的神，惹我发怒。

chapters.en: Again and again I sent my servants the prophets, who said, ‘Do not do this detestable thing that I hate!’
chapters.zh: 我从早起来差遣我的仆人众先知去说，你们切不要行我所厌恶这可憎之事。

chapters.en: But they did not listen or pay attention; they did not turn from their wickedness or stop burning incense to other gods.
chapters.zh: 他们却不听从，不侧耳而听，不转离恶事，仍向别神烧香。

chapters.en: Therefore, my fierce anger was poured out; it raged against the towns of Judah and the streets of Jerusalem and made them the desolate ruins they are today.
chapters.zh: 因此，我的怒气和忿怒都倒出来，在犹大城邑中和耶路撒冷的街市上，如火着起，以致都荒废凄凉，正如今日一样。

chapters.en: “Now this is what the LORD God Almighty, the God of Israel, says: Why bring such great disaster on yourselves by cutting off from Judah the men and women, the children and infants, and so leave yourselves without a remnant?
chapters.zh: 现在耶和华万军之神，以色列的神如此说，你们为何作这大恶自害己命，使你们的男人，妇女，婴孩，和吃奶的都从犹大中剪除，不留一人呢？

chapters.en: Why arouse my anger with what your hands have made, burning incense to other gods in Egypt, where you have come to live? You will destroy yourselves and make yourselves a curse and an object of reproach among all the nations on earth.
chapters.zh: 就是因你们手所作的，在所去寄居的埃及地向别神烧香惹我发怒，使你们被剪除，在天下万国中令人咒诅羞辱。

chapters.en: Have you forgotten the wickedness committed by your ancestors and by the kings and queens of Judah and the wickedness committed by you and your wives in the land of Judah and the streets of Jerusalem?
chapters.zh: 你们列祖的恶行，犹大列王和他们后妃的恶行，你们自己和你们妻子的恶行，就是在犹大地，耶路撒冷街上所行的，你们都忘了吗？

chapters.en: To this day they have not humbled themselves or shown reverence, nor have they followed my law and the decrees I set before you and your ancestors.
chapters.zh: 到如今还没有懊悔，没有惧怕，没有遵行我在你们和你们列祖面前所设立的法度律例。

chapters.en: “Therefore this is what the LORD Almighty, the God of Israel, says: I am determined to bring disaster on you and to destroy all Judah.
chapters.zh: 所以万军之耶和华以色列的神如此说，我必向你们变脸降灾，以致剪除犹大众人。

chapters.en: I will take away the remnant of Judah who were determined to go to Egypt to settle there. They will all perish in Egypt; they will fall by the sword or die from famine. From the least to the greatest, they will die by sword or famine. They will become a curse and an object of horror, a curse and an object of reproach.
chapters.zh: 那定意进入埃及地，在那里寄居的，就是所剩下的犹大人，我必使他们尽都灭绝，必在埃及地仆倒，必因刀剑饥荒灭绝。从最小的到至大的都必遭刀剑饥荒而死，以致令人辱骂，惊骇，咒诅，羞辱。

chapters.en: I will punish those who live in Egypt with the sword, famine and plague, as I punished Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 我怎样用刀剑，饥荒，瘟疫刑罚耶路撒冷，也必照样刑罚那些住在埃及地的犹大人。

chapters.en: None of the remnant of Judah who have gone to live in Egypt will escape or survive to return to the land of Judah, to which they long to return and live; none will return except a few fugitives.”
chapters.zh: 甚至那进入埃及地寄居的，就是所剩下的犹大人，都不得逃脱，也不得存留归回犹大地。他们心中甚想归回居住之地。除了逃脱的以外，一个都不能归回。

chapters.en: Then all the men who knew that their wives were burning incense to other gods, along with all the women who were present—a large assembly—and all the people living in Lower and Upper Egypt, said to Jeremiah,
chapters.zh: 那些住在埃及地巴忒罗知道自己妻子向别神烧香的，与旁边站立的众妇女，聚集成群，回答耶利米说，

chapters.en: “We will not listen to the message you have spoken to us in the name of the LORD!
chapters.zh: 论到你奉耶和华的名向我们所说的话，我们必不听从。

chapters.en: We will certainly do everything we said we would: We will burn incense to the Queen of Heaven and will pour out drink offerings to her just as we and our ancestors, our kings and our officials did in the towns of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem. At that time we had plenty of food and were well off and suffered no harm.
chapters.zh: 我们定要成就我们口中所出的一切话，向天后烧香，浇奠祭，按着我们与我们列祖，君王，首领在犹大的城邑中和耶路撒冷的街市上素常所行的一样。因为那时我们吃饱饭，享福乐，并不见灾祸。

chapters.en: But ever since we stopped burning incense to the Queen of Heaven and pouring out drink offerings to her, we have had nothing and have been perishing by sword and famine.”
chapters.zh: 自从我们停止向天后烧香，浇奠祭，我们倒缺乏一切，又因刀剑饥荒灭绝。

chapters.en: The women added, “When we burned incense to the Queen of Heaven and poured out drink offerings to her, did not our husbands know that we were making cakes impressed with her image and pouring out drink offerings to her?”
chapters.zh: 妇女说，我们向天后烧香，浇奠祭，作天后像的饼供奉她，向她浇奠祭，是外乎我们的丈夫吗？

chapters.en: Then Jeremiah said to all the people, both men and women, who were answering him,
chapters.zh: 耶利米对一切那样回答他的男人妇女说，

chapters.en: “Did not the LORD remember and call to mind the incense burned in the towns of Judah and the streets of Jerusalem by you and your ancestors, your kings and your officials and the people of the land?
chapters.zh: 你们与你们列祖，君王，首领，并国内的百姓，在犹大城邑中和耶路撒冷街市上所烧的香，耶和华岂不记念，心中岂不思想吗？

chapters.en: When the LORD could no longer endure your wicked actions and the detestable things you did, your land became a curse and a desolate waste without inhabitants, as it is today.
chapters.zh: 耶和华因你们所作的恶，所行可憎的事，不能再容忍，所以你们的地荒凉，令人惊骇咒诅，无人居住，正如今日一样。

chapters.en: Because you have burned incense and have sinned against the LORD and have not obeyed him or followed his law or his decrees or his stipulations, this disaster has come upon you, as you now see.”
chapters.zh: 你们烧香，得罪耶和华，没有听从他的话，没有遵行他的律法，条例，法度，所以你们遭遇这灾祸，正如今日一样。

chapters.en: Then Jeremiah said to all the people, including the women, “Hear the word of the LORD, all you people of Judah in Egypt.
chapters.zh: 耶利米又对众民和众妇女说，你们在埃及地的一切犹大人当听耶和华的话。

chapters.en: This is what the LORD Almighty, the God of Israel, says: You and your wives have done what you said you would do when you promised, ‘We will certainly carry out the vows we made to burn incense and pour out drink offerings to the Queen of Heaven.’ “Go ahead then, do what you promised! Keep your vows!
chapters.zh: 万军之耶和华以色列的神如此说，你们和你们的妻都口中说，手里作，说，我们定要偿还所许的愿，向天后烧香，浇奠祭。现在你们只管坚定所许的愿而偿还吧。

chapters.en: But hear the word of the LORD, all you Jews living in Egypt: ‘I swear by my great name,’ says the LORD, ‘that no one from Judah living anywhere in Egypt will ever again invoke my name or swear, “As surely as the Sovereign LORD lives.”
chapters.zh: 所以你们住在埃及地的一切犹大人当听耶和华的话。耶和华说，我指着我的大名起誓，在埃及全地，我的名不再被犹大一个人的口称呼说，我指着主永生的耶和华起誓。

chapters.en: For I am watching over them for harm, not for good; the Jews in Egypt will perish by sword and famine until they are all destroyed.
chapters.zh: 我向他们留意降祸不降福。在埃及地的一切犹大人必因刀剑，饥荒所灭，直到灭尽。

chapters.en: Those who escape the sword and return to the land of Judah from Egypt will be very few. Then the whole remnant of Judah who came to live in Egypt will know whose word will stand—mine or theirs.
chapters.zh: 脱离刀剑，从埃及地归回犹大地的人数很少。那进入埃及地要在那里寄居的，就是所剩下的犹大人，必知道是谁的话立得住，是我的话呢？是他们的话呢？

chapters.en: “ ‘This will be the sign to you that I will punish you in this place,’ declares the LORD, ‘so that you will know that my threats of harm against you will surely stand.’
chapters.zh: 耶和华说，我在这地方刑罚你们，必有预兆，使你们知道我降祸与你们的话必要立得住。

chapters.en: This is what the LORD says: ‘I am going to deliver Pharaoh Hophra king of Egypt into the hands of his enemies who want to kill him, just as I gave Zedekiah king of Judah into the hands of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, the enemy who wanted to kill him.’ ”
chapters.zh: 耶和华如此说，我必将埃及王法老合弗拉交在他仇敌和寻索其命的人手中，像我将犹大王西底家交在他仇敌，和寻索其命的巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒手中一样。

chapters.en: When Baruch son of Neriah wrote on a scroll the words Jeremiah the prophet dictated in the fourth year of Jehoiakim son of Josiah king of Judah, Jeremiah said this to Baruch:
chapters.zh: 犹大王约西亚的儿子约雅敬第四年，尼利亚的儿子巴录将先知耶利米口中所说的话写在书上。耶利米说，

chapters.en: “This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says to you, Baruch:
chapters.zh: 巴录阿，耶和华以色列的神说，

chapters.en: You said, ‘Woe to me! The LORD has added sorrow to my pain; I am worn out with groaning and find no rest.’
chapters.zh: 巴录（原文作你）曾说，哀哉。耶和华将忧愁加在我的痛苦上，我因唉哼而困乏，不得安歇。

chapters.en: But the LORD has told me to say to you, ‘This is what the LORD says: I will overthrow what I have built and uproot what I have planted, throughout the earth.
chapters.zh: 你要这样告诉他，耶和华如此说，我所建立的，我必拆毁。我所栽植的，我必拔出。在全地我都如此行。

chapters.en: Should you then seek great things for yourself? Do not seek them. For I will bring disaster on all people, declares the LORD, but wherever you go I will let you escape with your life.’ ”
chapters.zh: 你为自己图谋大事吗？不要图谋。我必使灾祸临到凡有血气的。但你无论往哪里去，我必使你以自己的命为掠物。这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: This is the word of the LORD that came to Jeremiah the prophet concerning the nations:
chapters.zh: 耶和华论列国的话临到先知耶利米。

chapters.en: Concerning Egypt: This is the message against the army of Pharaoh Necho king of Egypt, which was defeated at Carchemish on the Euphrates River by Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon in the fourth year of Jehoiakim son of Josiah king of Judah:
chapters.zh: 论到关乎埃及王法老尼哥的军队，这军队安营在伯拉河边的迦基米施，是巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒在犹大王约西亚的儿子约雅敬第四年所打败的。

chapters.en: “Prepare your shields, both large and small, and march out for battle!
chapters.zh: 你们要预备大小盾牌，往前上阵。

chapters.en: Harness the horses, mount the steeds! Take your positions with helmets on! Polish your spears, put on your armor!
chapters.zh: 你们套上车，骑上马。顶盔站立，磨枪贯甲。

chapters.en: What do I see? They are terrified, they are retreating, their warriors are defeated. They flee in haste without looking back, and there is terror on every side,” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 我为何看见他们惊惶转身退后呢？他们的勇士打败了，急忙逃跑，并不回头。惊吓四围都有。这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: “The swift cannot flee nor the strong escape. In the north by the River Euphrates they stumble and fall.
chapters.zh: 不要容快跑的逃避。不要容勇士逃脱（或作快跑的不能逃避。勇士不能逃脱）。他们在北方伯拉河边绊跌仆倒。

chapters.en: “Who is this that rises like the Nile, like rivers of surging waters?
chapters.zh: 像尼罗河涨发，像江河之水翻腾的是谁呢？

chapters.en: Egypt rises like the Nile, like rivers of surging waters. She says, ‘I will rise and cover the earth; I will destroy cities and their people.’
chapters.zh: 埃及像尼罗河涨发，像江河的水翻腾。他说，我要涨发遮盖遍地。我要毁灭城邑和其中的居民。

chapters.en: Charge, you horses! Drive furiously, you charioteers! March on, you warriors—men of Cush and Put who carry shields, men of Lydia who draw the bow.
chapters.zh: 马匹上去吧。车辆急行吧。勇士，就是手拿盾牌的古实人和弗人（又作吕彼亚人），并拉弓的路德族，都出去吧。

chapters.en: But that day belongs to the Lord, the LORD Almighty— a day of vengeance, for vengeance on his foes. The sword will devour till it is satisfied, till it has quenched its thirst with blood. For the Lord, the LORD Almighty, will offer sacrifice in the land of the north by the River Euphrates.
chapters.zh: 那日是主万军之耶和华报仇的日子，要向敌人报仇。刀剑必吞吃得饱，饮血饮足。因为主万军之耶和华在北方伯拉河边有献祭的事。

chapters.en: “Go up to Gilead and get balm, Virgin Daughter Egypt. But you try many medicines in vain; there is no healing for you.
chapters.zh: 埃及的民哪（民原文作处女），可以上基列取乳香去。你虽多服良药，总是徒然，不得治好。

chapters.en: The nations will hear of your shame; your cries will fill the earth. One warrior will stumble over another; both will fall down together.”
chapters.zh: 列国听见你的羞辱，遍地满了你的哀声。勇士与勇士彼此相碰，一齐跌倒。

chapters.en: This is the message the LORD spoke to Jeremiah the prophet about the coming of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon to attack Egypt:
chapters.zh: 耶和华对先知耶利米所说的话，论到巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒要来攻击埃及地，

chapters.en: “Announce this in Egypt, and proclaim it in Migdol; proclaim it also in Memphis and Tahpanhes: ‘Take your positions and get ready, for the sword devours those around you.’
chapters.zh: 你们要传扬在埃及，宣告在密夺，报告在挪弗，答比匿说，要站起出队，自作准备，因为刀剑在你四围施行吞灭的事。

chapters.en: Why will your warriors be laid low? They cannot stand, for the LORD will push them down.
chapters.zh: 你的壮士为何被冲去呢？他们站立不住。因为耶和华驱逐他们，

chapters.en: They will stumble repeatedly; they will fall over each other. They will say, ‘Get up, let us go back to our own people and our native lands, away from the sword of the oppressor.’
chapters.zh: 使多人绊跌。他们也彼此撞倒，说，起来吧。我们再往本民本地去，好躲避欺压的刀剑。

chapters.en: There they will exclaim, ‘Pharaoh king of Egypt is only a loud noise; he has missed his opportunity.’
chapters.zh: 他们在那里喊叫说，埃及王法老不过是个声音（不过是个声音或作已经败亡）。他已错过所定的时候了。

chapters.en: “As surely as I live,” declares the King, whose name is the LORD Almighty, “one will come who is like Tabor among the mountains, like Carmel by the sea.
chapters.zh: 君王名为万军之耶和华的说，我指着我的永生起誓，尼布甲尼撒（原文作他）来的势派必像他泊在众山之中，像迦密在海边一样。

chapters.en: Pack your belongings for exile, you who live in Egypt, for Memphis will be laid waste and lie in ruins without inhabitant.
chapters.zh: 住在埃及的民哪（民原文作女子），要预备掳去时所用的物件。因为挪弗必成为荒场，且被烧毁，无人居住。

chapters.en: “Egypt is a beautiful heifer, but a gadfly is coming against her from the north.
chapters.zh: 埃及是肥美的母牛犊。但出于北方的毁灭（毁灭或作牛虻）来到了。来到了。

chapters.en: The mercenaries in her ranks are like fattened calves. They too will turn and flee together, they will not stand their ground, for the day of disaster is coming upon them, the time for them to be punished.
chapters.zh: 其中的雇勇好像圈里的肥牛犊，他们转身退后，一齐逃跑，站立不住。因为他们遭难的日子，追讨的时候已经临到。

chapters.en: Egypt will hiss like a fleeing serpent as the enemy advances in force; they will come against her with axes, like men who cut down trees.
chapters.zh: 其中的声音好像蛇行一样。敌人要成队而来，如砍伐树木的手拿斧子攻击他。

chapters.en: They will chop down her forest,” declares the LORD, “dense though it be. They are more numerous than locusts, they cannot be counted.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说，埃及的树林虽然不能寻察（或作穿不过），敌人却要砍伐，因他们多于蝗虫，不可胜数。

chapters.en: Daughter Egypt will be put to shame, given into the hands of the people of the north.”
chapters.zh: 埃及的民（民原文作女子）必然蒙羞，必交在北方人的手中。

chapters.en: The LORD Almighty, the God of Israel, says: “I am about to bring punishment on Amon god of Thebes, on Pharaoh, on Egypt and her gods and her kings, and on those who rely on Pharaoh.
chapters.zh: 万军之耶和华以色列的神说，我必刑罚挪的亚扪（埃及尊大之神）和法老，并埃及与埃及的神，以及君王，也必刑罚法老和倚靠他的人。

chapters.en: I will give them into the hands of those who want to kill them—Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon and his officers. Later, however, Egypt will be inhabited as in times past,” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 我要将他们交付寻索其命之人的手和巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒与他臣仆的手。以后埃及必再有人居住，与从前一样。这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: “Do not be afraid, Jacob my servant; do not be dismayed, Israel. I will surely save you out of a distant place, your descendants from the land of their exile. Jacob will again have peace and security, and no one will make him afraid.
chapters.zh: 我的仆人雅各阿，不要惧怕。以色列阿，不要惊惶。因我要从远方拯救你，从被掳到之地拯救你的后裔。雅各必回来，得享平靖安逸，无人使他害怕。

chapters.en: Do not be afraid, Jacob my servant, for I am with you,” declares the LORD. “Though I completely destroy all the nations among which I scatter you, I will not completely destroy you. I will discipline you but only in due measure; I will not let you go entirely unpunished.”
chapters.zh: 我的仆人雅各阿，不要惧怕。因我与你同在。我要将我所赶你到的那些国灭绝净尽，却不将你灭绝净尽，倒要从宽惩治你，万不能不罚你（不罚你或作以你为无罪）。这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: This is the word of the LORD that came to Jeremiah the prophet concerning the Philistines before Pharaoh attacked Gaza:
chapters.zh: 法老攻击迦萨之先，有耶和华论非利士人的话临到先知耶利米。

chapters.en: This is what the LORD says: “See how the waters are rising in the north; they will become an overflowing torrent. They will overflow the land and everything in it, the towns and those who live in them. The people will cry out; all who dwell in the land will wail
chapters.zh: 耶和华如此说，有水从北方发起，成为涨溢的河，要涨过遍地和其中所有的，并城和其中所住的。人必呼喊。境内的居民都必哀号。

chapters.en: at the sound of the hooves of galloping steeds, at the noise of enemy chariots and the rumble of their wheels. Parents will not turn to help their children; their hands will hang limp.
chapters.zh: 听见敌人壮马蹄跳的响声和战车隆隆，车轮轰轰。为父的手就发软，不回头看顾儿女。

chapters.en: For the day has come to destroy all the Philistines and to remove all survivors who could help Tyre and Sidon. The LORD is about to destroy the Philistines, the remnant from the coasts of Caphtor.
chapters.zh: 因为日子将到，要毁灭一切非利士人，剪除帮助推罗，西顿所剩下的人。原来耶和华必毁灭非利士人，就是迦斐托海岛余剩的人。

chapters.en: Gaza will shave her head in mourning; Ashkelon will be silenced. You remnant on the plain, how long will you cut yourselves?
chapters.zh: 迦萨成了光秃。平原中所剩的亚实基伦归于无有。你用刀划身，要到几时呢？

chapters.en: “ ‘Alas, sword of the LORD, how long till you rest? Return to your sheath; cease and be still.’
chapters.zh: 耶和华的刀剑哪，你到几时才止息呢？你要入鞘，安靖不动。

chapters.en: But how can it rest when the LORD has commanded it, when he has ordered it to attack Ashkelon and the coast?”
chapters.zh: 耶和华既吩咐你攻击亚实基伦和海边之地，他已经派定你，焉能止息呢？

chapters.en: Concerning Moab: This is what the LORD Almighty, the God of Israel, says: “Woe to Nebo, for it will be ruined. Kiriathaim will be disgraced and captured; the stronghold will be disgraced and shattered.
chapters.zh: 论摩押。万军之耶和华以色列的神如此说，尼波有祸了。因变为荒场。基列亭蒙羞被攻取。米斯迦蒙羞被毁坏。

chapters.en: Moab will be praised no more; in Heshbon people will plot her downfall: ‘Come, let us put an end to that nation.’ You, the people of Madmen, will also be silenced; the sword will pursue you.
chapters.zh: 摩押不再被称赞。有人在希实本设计谋害她，说，来吧。我们将她剪除，不再成国。玛得缅哪，你也必默默无声。刀剑必追赶你。

chapters.en: Cries of anguish arise from Horonaim, cries of great havoc and destruction.
chapters.zh: 从何罗念有喊荒凉大毁灭的哀声，

chapters.en: Moab will be broken; her little ones will cry out.
chapters.zh: 摩押毁灭了。她的孩童（或作家僮）发哀声，使人听见。

chapters.en: They go up the hill to Luhith, weeping bitterly as they go; on the road down to Horonaim anguished cries over the destruction are heard.
chapters.zh: 人上鲁希坡随走随哭，因为在何罗念的下坡听见毁灭的哀声。

chapters.en: Flee! Run for your lives; become like a bush in the desert.
chapters.zh: 你们要奔逃，自救性命，独自居住，好像旷野的杜松。

chapters.en: Since you trust in your deeds and riches, you too will be taken captive, and Chemosh will go into exile, together with his priests and officials.
chapters.zh: 你因倚靠自己所作的和自己的财宝必被攻取。基抹和属他的祭司，首领也要一同被掳去。

chapters.en: The destroyer will come against every town, and not a town will escape. The valley will be ruined and the plateau destroyed, because the LORD has spoken.
chapters.zh: 行毁灭的必来到各城，并无一城得免。山谷必至败落，平原必被毁坏。正如耶和华所说的。

chapters.en: Put salt on Moab, for she will be laid waste ; her towns will become desolate, with no one to live in them.
chapters.zh: 要将翅膀给摩押，使她可以飞去。她的城邑必至荒凉，无人居住。

chapters.en: “A curse on anyone who is lax in doing the LORD’s work! A curse on anyone who keeps their sword from bloodshed!
chapters.zh: 懒惰为耶和华行事的，必受咒诅。禁止刀剑不经血的，必受咒诅。

chapters.en: “Moab has been at rest from youth, like wine left on its dregs, not poured from one jar to another— she has not gone into exile. So she tastes as she did, and her aroma is unchanged.
chapters.zh: 摩押自幼年以来常享安逸，如酒在渣滓上澄清，没有从这器皿倒在那器皿里，也未曾被掳去。因此，它的原味尚存，香气未变。

chapters.en: But days are coming,” declares the LORD, “when I will send men who pour from pitchers, and they will pour her out; they will empty her pitchers and smash her jars.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说，日子将到，我必打发倒酒的往她那里去，将她倒出来，倒空她的器皿，打碎她的坛子。

chapters.en: Then Moab will be ashamed of Chemosh, as Israel was ashamed when they trusted in Bethel.
chapters.zh: 摩押必因基抹羞愧，像以色列家从前倚靠伯特利的神羞愧一样。

chapters.en: “How can you say, ‘We are warriors, men valiant in battle’?
chapters.zh: 你们怎么说，我们是勇士，是有勇力打仗的呢？

chapters.en: Moab will be destroyed and her towns invaded; her finest young men will go down in the slaughter,” declares the King, whose name is the LORD Almighty.
chapters.zh: 摩押变为荒场，敌人上去进了她的城邑。她所特选的少年人下去遭了杀戮。这是君王名为万军之耶和华说的。

chapters.en: “The fall of Moab is at hand; her calamity will come quickly.
chapters.zh: 摩押的灾殃临近。她的苦难速速来到。

chapters.en: Mourn for her, all who live around her, all who know her fame; say, ‘How broken is the mighty scepter, how broken the glorious staff!’
chapters.zh: 凡在她四围的和认识她名的，你们都要为她悲伤，说，那结实的杖和那美好的棍，何竟折断了呢？

chapters.en: “Come down from your glory and sit on the parched ground, you inhabitants of Daughter Dibon, for the one who destroys Moab will come up against you and ruin your fortified cities.
chapters.zh: 住在底本的民哪（民原文作女子），要从你荣耀的位上下来，坐受干渴。因毁灭摩押的上来攻击你，毁坏了你的保障。

chapters.en: Stand by the road and watch, you who live in Aroer. Ask the man fleeing and the woman escaping, ask them, ‘What has happened?’
chapters.zh: 住亚罗珥的阿，要站在道旁观望，问逃避的男人和逃脱的女人说，是什么事呢？

chapters.en: Moab is disgraced, for she is shattered. Wail and cry out! Announce by the Arnon that Moab is destroyed.
chapters.zh: 摩押因毁坏蒙羞。你们要哀号呼喊，要在亚嫩旁报告说，摩押变为荒场。

chapters.en: Judgment has come to the plateau— to Holon, Jahzah and Mephaath,
chapters.zh: 刑罚临到平原之地的何伦，雅杂，米法押，

chapters.en: to Dibon, Nebo and Beth Diblathaim,
chapters.zh: 底本，尼波，伯低比拉太音，

chapters.en: to Kiriathaim, Beth Gamul and Beth Meon,
chapters.zh: 基列亭，伯迦末，伯米恩，

chapters.en: to Kerioth and Bozrah— to all the towns of Moab, far and near.
chapters.zh: 加略，波斯拉，和摩押地远近所有的城邑。

chapters.en: Moab’s horn is cut off; her arm is broken,” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 摩押的角砍断了，摩押的膀臂折断了。这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: “Make her drunk, for she has defied the LORD. Let Moab wallow in her vomit; let her be an object of ridicule.
chapters.zh: 你们要使摩押沉醉，因她向耶和华夸大。她要在自己所吐之中打滚，又要被人嗤笑。

chapters.en: Was not Israel the object of your ridicule? Was she caught among thieves, that you shake your head in scorn whenever you speak of her?
chapters.zh: 摩押阿，你不曾嗤笑以色列吗？她岂是在贼中查出来的呢？你每逢提到她便摇头。

chapters.en: Abandon your towns and dwell among the rocks, you who live in Moab. Be like a dove that makes its nest at the mouth of a cave.
chapters.zh: 摩押的居民哪，要离开城邑，住在山崖里，像鸽子在深渊口上搭窝。

chapters.en: “We have heard of Moab’s pride— how great is her arrogance!— of her insolence, her pride, her conceit and the haughtiness of her heart.
chapters.zh: 我们听说摩押人骄傲，是极其骄傲。听说他自高自傲，并且狂妄，居心自大。

chapters.en: I know her insolence but it is futile,” declares the LORD, “and her boasts accomplish nothing.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说，我知道他的忿怒是虚空的。他夸大的话一无所成。

chapters.en: Therefore I wail over Moab, for all Moab I cry out, I moan for the people of Kir Hareseth.
chapters.zh: 因此，我要为摩押哀号，为摩押全地呼喊。人必为吉珥哈列设人叹息。

chapters.en: I weep for you, as Jazer weeps, you vines of Sibmah. Your branches spread as far as the sea ; they reached as far as Jazer. The destroyer has fallen on your ripened fruit and grapes.
chapters.zh: 西比玛的葡萄树阿，我为你哀哭，甚于雅谢人哀哭。你的枝子蔓延过海，直长到雅谢海。那行毁灭的已经临到你夏天的果子和你所摘的葡萄。

chapters.en: Joy and gladness are gone from the orchards and fields of Moab. I have stopped the flow of wine from the presses; no one treads them with shouts of joy. Although there are shouts, they are not shouts of joy.
chapters.zh: 肥田和摩押地的欢喜快乐都被夺去。我使酒榨的酒绝流，无人踹酒欢呼。那欢呼却变为仇敌的呐喊（原文作那欢呼却不是欢呼）。

chapters.en: “The sound of their cry rises from Heshbon to Elealeh and Jahaz, from Zoar as far as Horonaim and Eglath Shelishiyah, for even the waters of Nimrim are dried up.
chapters.zh: 希实本人发的哀声达到以利亚利，直达到雅杂。从琐珥达到何罗念，直到伊基拉施利施亚，因为宁林的水必然干涸。

chapters.en: In Moab I will put an end to those who make offerings on the high places and burn incense to their gods,” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说，我必在摩押地使那在丘坛献祭的，和那向他的神烧香的都断绝了。

chapters.en: “So my heart laments for Moab like the music of a pipe; it laments like a pipe for the people of Kir Hareseth. The wealth they acquired is gone.
chapters.zh: 我心腹为摩押哀鸣如箫，我心肠为吉珥哈列设人也是如此，因摩押人所得的财物都灭没了。

chapters.en: Every head is shaved and every beard cut off; every hand is slashed and every waist is covered with sackcloth.
chapters.zh: 各人头上光秃，胡须剪短，手有划伤，腰束麻布。

chapters.en: On all the roofs in Moab and in the public squares there is nothing but mourning, for I have broken Moab like a jar that no one wants,” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 在摩押的各房顶上和街市上处处有人哀哭。因我打碎摩押，好像打碎无人喜悦的器皿。这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: “How shattered she is! How they wail! How Moab turns her back in shame! Moab has become an object of ridicule, an object of horror to all those around her.”
chapters.zh: 摩押何等毁坏。何等哀号。何等羞愧转背。这样，摩押必令四围的人嗤笑惊骇。

chapters.en: This is what the LORD says: “Look! An eagle is swooping down, spreading its wings over Moab.
chapters.zh: 耶和华如此说，仇敌必如大鹰飞起，展开翅膀，攻击摩押。

chapters.en: Kerioth will be captured and the strongholds taken. In that day the hearts of Moab’s warriors will be like the heart of a woman in labor.
chapters.zh: 加略被攻取，保障也被占据。到那日，摩押的勇士心中疼痛如临产的妇人。

chapters.en: Moab will be destroyed as a nation because she defied the LORD.
chapters.zh: 摩押必被毁灭，不再成国，因她向耶和华夸大。

chapters.en: Terror and pit and snare await you, you people of Moab,” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说，摩押的居民哪，恐惧，陷坑，网罗都临近你。

chapters.en: “Whoever flees from the terror will fall into a pit, whoever climbs out of the pit will be caught in a snare; for I will bring on Moab the year of her punishment,” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 躲避恐惧的必坠入陷坑。从陷坑上来的必被网罗缠住。因我必使追讨之年临到摩押。这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: “In the shadow of Heshbon the fugitives stand helpless, for a fire has gone out from Heshbon, a blaze from the midst of Sihon; it burns the foreheads of Moab, the skulls of the noisy boasters.
chapters.zh: 躲避的人无力站在希实本的影下。因为有火从希实本发出，有火焰出于西宏的城，烧尽摩押的角和哄嚷人的头顶。

chapters.en: Woe to you, Moab! The people of Chemosh are destroyed; your sons are taken into exile and your daughters into captivity.
chapters.zh: 摩押阿，你有祸了。属基抹的民灭亡了。因你的众子都被掳去，你的众女也被掳去。

chapters.en: “Yet I will restore the fortunes of Moab in days to come,” declares the LORD. Here ends the judgment on Moab.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说，到末后，我还要使被掳的摩押人归回。摩押受审判的话到此为止。

chapters.en: Concerning the Ammonites: This is what the LORD says: “Has Israel no sons? Has Israel no heir? Why then has Molek taken possession of Gad? Why do his people live in its towns?
chapters.zh: 论亚扪人。耶和华如此说，以色列没有儿子吗？没有后嗣吗？玛勒堪为何得迦得之地为业呢？属他的民为何住其中的城邑呢？

chapters.en: But the days are coming,” declares the LORD, “when I will sound the battle cry against Rabbah of the Ammonites; it will become a mound of ruins, and its surrounding villages will be set on fire. Then Israel will drive out those who drove her out,” says the LORD.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说，日子将到，我必使人听见打仗的喊声，是攻击亚扪人拉巴的喊声。拉巴要成为乱堆。属她的乡村（原文作女子）要被火焚烧。先前得以色列地为业的，此时以色列倒要得他们的地为业。这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: “Wail, Heshbon, for Ai is destroyed! Cry out, you inhabitants of Rabbah! Put on sackcloth and mourn; rush here and there inside the walls, for Molek will go into exile, together with his priests and officials.
chapters.zh: 希实本哪，你要哀号，因为爱地变为荒场。拉巴的居民哪（居民原文作女子），要呼喊，以麻布束腰。要哭号，在篱笆中跑来跑去。因玛勒堪和属他的祭司，首领要一同被掳去。

chapters.en: Why do you boast of your valleys, boast of your valleys so fruitful? Unfaithful Daughter Ammon, you trust in your riches and say, ‘Who will attack me?’
chapters.zh: 背道的民哪（民原文作女子），你们为何因有山谷，就是水流的山谷夸张呢？为何倚靠财宝说，谁能来到我们这里呢？

chapters.en: I will bring terror on you from all those around you,” declares the Lord, the LORD Almighty. “Every one of you will be driven away, and no one will gather the fugitives.
chapters.zh: 主万军之耶和华说，我要使恐吓从四围的人中临到你们。你们必被赶出，各人一直前往，没有人收聚逃民。

chapters.en: “Yet afterward, I will restore the fortunes of the Ammonites,” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 后来我还要使被掳的亚扪人归回。这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: Concerning Edom: This is what the LORD Almighty says: “Is there no longer wisdom in Teman? Has counsel perished from the prudent? Has their wisdom decayed?
chapters.zh: 论以东。万军之耶和华如此说，提幔中再没有智慧吗？明哲人不再有谋略吗？他们的智慧尽归无有吗？

chapters.en: Turn and flee, hide in deep caves, you who live in Dedan, for I will bring disaster on Esau at the time when I punish him.
chapters.zh: 底但的居民哪，要转身逃跑，住在深密处。因为我向以扫追讨的时候，必使灾殃临到他。

chapters.en: If grape pickers came to you, would they not leave a few grapes? If thieves came during the night, would they not steal only as much as they wanted?
chapters.zh: 摘葡萄的若来到他那里，岂不剩下些葡萄呢？盗贼若夜间而来，岂不毁坏直到够了呢？

chapters.en: But I will strip Esau bare; I will uncover his hiding places, so that he cannot conceal himself. His armed men are destroyed, also his allies and neighbors, so there is no one to say,
chapters.zh: 我却使以扫赤露，显出他的隐密处。他不能自藏。他的后裔，弟兄，邻舍尽都灭绝。他也归于无有。

chapters.en: ‘Leave your fatherless children; I will keep them alive. Your widows too can depend on me.’ ”
chapters.zh: 你撇下孤儿，我必保全他们的命。你的寡妇可以倚靠我。

chapters.en: This is what the LORD says: “If those who do not deserve to drink the cup must drink it, why should you go unpunished? You will not go unpunished, but must drink it.
chapters.zh: 耶和华如此说，原不该喝那杯的一定要喝。你能尽免刑罚吗？你必不能免，一定要喝。

chapters.en: I swear by myself,” declares the LORD, “that Bozrah will become a ruin and a curse, an object of horror and reproach; and all its towns will be in ruins forever.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华说，我指着自己起誓，波斯拉必令人惊骇，羞辱，咒诅，并且荒凉。她的一切城邑必变为永远的荒场。

chapters.en: I have heard a message from the LORD; an envoy was sent to the nations to say, “Assemble yourselves to attack it! Rise up for battle!”
chapters.zh: 我从耶和华那里听见信息，并有使者被差往列国去，说，你们聚集来攻击以东，要起来争战。

chapters.en: “Now I will make you small among the nations, despised by mankind.
chapters.zh: 我使你在列国中为最小，在世人中被藐视。

chapters.en: The terror you inspire and the pride of your heart have deceived you, you who live in the clefts of the rocks, who occupy the heights of the hill. Though you build your nest as high as the eagle’s, from there I will bring you down,” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 住在山穴中据守山顶的阿，论到你的威吓，你因心中的狂傲自欺。你虽如大鹰高高搭窝，我却从那里拉下你来。这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: “Edom will become an object of horror; all who pass by will be appalled and will scoff because of all its wounds.
chapters.zh: 以东必令人惊骇。凡经过的人就受惊骇，又因她一切的灾祸嗤笑。

chapters.en: As Sodom and Gomorrah were overthrown, along with their neighboring towns,” says the LORD, “so no one will live there; no people will dwell in it.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说，必无人住在那里，也无人在其中寄居，要像所多玛，蛾摩拉，和邻近的城邑倾覆的时候一样。

chapters.en: “Like a lion coming up from Jordan’s thickets to a rich pastureland, I will chase Edom from its land in an instant. Who is the chosen one I will appoint for this? Who is like me and who can challenge me? And what shepherd can stand against me?”
chapters.zh: 仇敌必像狮子从约旦河边的丛林上来，攻击坚固的居所。转眼之间，我要使以东人逃跑，离开这地。谁蒙拣选，我就派谁治理这地。谁能比我呢？谁能给我定规日期呢？有何牧人能在我面前站立得住呢？

chapters.en: Therefore, hear what the LORD has planned against Edom, what he has purposed against those who live in Teman: The young of the flock will be dragged away; their pasture will be appalled at their fate.
chapters.zh: 你们要听耶和华攻击以东所说的谋略和他攻击提幔居民所定的旨意。仇敌定要将他们群众微弱的拉去，定要使他们的居所荒凉。

chapters.en: At the sound of their fall the earth will tremble; their cry will resound to the Red Sea.
chapters.zh: 因他们仆倒的声音，地就震动。人在红海那里必听见呼喊的声音。

chapters.en: Look! An eagle will soar and swoop down, spreading its wings over Bozrah. In that day the hearts of Edom’s warriors will be like the heart of a woman in labor.
chapters.zh: 仇敌必如大鹰飞起，展开翅膀攻击波斯拉。到那日，以东的勇士心中疼痛如临产的妇人。

chapters.en: Concerning Damascus: “Hamath and Arpad are dismayed, for they have heard bad news. They are disheartened, troubled like the restless sea.
chapters.zh: 论大马色。哈马和亚珥拔蒙羞，因他们听见凶恶的信息就消化了。海上有忧愁，不得平静。

chapters.en: Damascus has become feeble, she has turned to flee and panic has gripped her; anguish and pain have seized her, pain like that of a woman in labor.
chapters.zh: 大马色发软，转身逃跑。战兢将她捉住。痛苦忧愁将她抓住，如产难的妇人一样。

chapters.en: Why has the city of renown not been abandoned, the town in which I delight?
chapters.zh: 我所喜乐可称赞的城，为何被撇弃了呢？

chapters.en: Surely, her young men will fall in the streets; all her soldiers will be silenced in that day,” declares the LORD Almighty.
chapters.zh: 她的少年人必仆倒在街上。当那日，一切兵丁必默默无声。这是万军之耶和华说的。

chapters.en: “I will set fire to the walls of Damascus; it will consume the fortresses of Ben-Hadad.”
chapters.zh: 我必在大马色城中使火着起，烧灭便哈达的宫殿。

chapters.en: Concerning Kedar and the kingdoms of Hazor, which Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon attacked: This is what the LORD says: “Arise, and attack Kedar and destroy the people of the East.
chapters.zh: 论巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒所攻打的基达和夏琐的诸国。耶和华如此说，迦勒底人哪，起来上基达去，毁灭东方人。

chapters.en: Their tents and their flocks will be taken; their shelters will be carried off with all their goods and camels. People will shout to them, ‘Terror on every side!’
chapters.zh: 他们的帐棚和羊群都要夺去，将幔子和一切器皿，并骆驼为自己掠去。人向他们喊着说，四围都有惊吓。

chapters.en: “Flee quickly away! Stay in deep caves, you who live in Hazor,” declares the LORD. “Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon has plotted against you; he has devised a plan against you.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说，夏琐的居民哪，要逃奔远方，住在深密处。因为巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒设计谋害你们，起意攻击你们。

chapters.en: “Arise and attack a nation at ease, which lives in confidence,” declares the LORD, “a nation that has neither gates nor bars; its people live far from danger.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说，迦勒底人哪，起来。上安逸无虑的居民那里去。他们是无门无闩，独自居住的。

chapters.en: Their camels will become plunder, and their large herds will be spoils of war. I will scatter to the winds those who are in distant places and will bring disaster on them from every side,” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 他们的骆驼必成为掠物。他们众多的牲畜必成为掳物。我必将剃周围头发的人分散四方（方原文作风），使灾殃从四围临到他们。这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: “Hazor will become a haunt of jackals, a desolate place forever. No one will live there; no people will dwell in it.”
chapters.zh: 夏琐必成为野狗的住处，永远凄凉。必无人住在那里，也无人在其中寄居。

chapters.en: This is the word of the LORD that came to Jeremiah the prophet concerning Elam, early in the reign of Zedekiah king of Judah:
chapters.zh: 犹大王西底家登基的时候，耶和华论以拦的话临到先知耶利米说，

chapters.en: This is what the LORD Almighty says: “See, I will break the bow of Elam, the mainstay of their might.
chapters.zh: 万军之耶和华如此说，我必折断以拦人的弓，就是他们为首的权力。

chapters.en: I will bring against Elam the four winds from the four quarters of heaven; I will scatter them to the four winds, and there will not be a nation where Elam’s exiles do not go.
chapters.zh: 我要使四风从天的四方刮来，临到以拦人，将他们分散四方（方原文作风）。这被赶散的人没有一国不到的。

chapters.en: I will shatter Elam before their foes, before those who want to kill them; I will bring disaster on them, even my fierce anger,” declares the LORD. “I will pursue them with the sword until I have made an end of them.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说，我必使以拦人在仇敌和寻索其命的人面前惊惶。我也必使灾祸，就是我的烈怒临到他们，又必使刀剑追杀他们，直到将他们灭尽。

chapters.en: I will set my throne in Elam and destroy her king and officials,” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 我要在以拦设立我的宝座，从那里除灭君王和首领。这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: “Yet I will restore the fortunes of Elam in days to come,” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 到末后，我还要使被掳的以拦人归回。这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: This is the word the LORD spoke through Jeremiah the prophet concerning Babylon and the land of the Babylonians :
chapters.zh: 耶和华借先知耶利米论巴比伦和迦勒底人之地所说的话。

chapters.en: “Announce and proclaim among the nations, lift up a banner and proclaim it; keep nothing back, but say, ‘Babylon will be captured; Bel will be put to shame, Marduk filled with terror. Her images will be put to shame and her idols filled with terror.’
chapters.zh: 你们要在万国中传扬报告，竖立大旗。要报告，不可隐瞒，说，巴比伦被攻取，彼勒蒙羞，米罗达惊惶。巴比伦的神像都蒙羞。她的偶像都惊惶。

chapters.en: A nation from the north will attack her and lay waste her land. No one will live in it; both people and animals will flee away.
chapters.zh: 因有一国从北方上来攻击她，使她的地荒凉，无人居住，连人带牲畜都逃走了。

chapters.en: “In those days, at that time,” declares the LORD, “the people of Israel and the people of Judah together will go in tears to seek the LORD their God.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说，当那日子，那时候，以色列人要和犹大人同来，随走随哭，寻求耶和华他们的神。

chapters.en: They will ask the way to Zion and turn their faces toward it. They will come and bind themselves to the LORD in an everlasting covenant that will not be forgotten.
chapters.zh: 他们必访问锡安，又面向这里，说，来吧，你们要与耶和华联合为永远不忘的约。

chapters.en: “My people have been lost sheep; their shepherds have led them astray and caused them to roam on the mountains. They wandered over mountain and hill and forgot their own resting place.
chapters.zh: 我的百姓作了迷失的羊，牧人使他们走差路，使他们转到山上。他们从大山走到小山，竟忘了安歇之处。

chapters.en: Whoever found them devoured them; their enemies said, ‘We are not guilty, for they sinned against the LORD, their verdant pasture, the LORD, the hope of their ancestors.’
chapters.zh: 凡遇见他们的，就把他们吞灭。敌人说，我们没有罪。因他们得罪那作公义居所的耶和华，就是他们列祖所仰望的耶和华。

chapters.en: “Flee out of Babylon; leave the land of the Babylonians, and be like the goats that lead the flock.
chapters.zh: 我民哪，你们要从巴比伦中逃走，从迦勒底人之地出去，要像羊群前面走的公山羊。

chapters.en: For I will stir up and bring against Babylon an alliance of great nations from the land of the north. They will take up their positions against her, and from the north she will be captured. Their arrows will be like skilled warriors who do not return empty-handed.
chapters.zh: 因我必激动联合的大国从北方上来攻击巴比伦，他们要摆阵攻击她。她必从那里被攻取。他们的箭好像善射之勇士的箭，一枝也不徒然返回。

chapters.en: So Babylonia will be plundered; all who plunder her will have their fill,” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 迦勒底必成为掠物。凡掳掠她的都必心满意足。这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: “Because you rejoice and are glad, you who pillage my inheritance, because you frolic like a heifer threshing grain and neigh like stallions,
chapters.zh: 抢夺我产业的阿，你们因欢喜快乐，且像踹谷撒欢的母牛犊，又像发嘶声的壮马。

chapters.en: your mother will be greatly ashamed; she who gave you birth will be disgraced. She will be the least of the nations— a wilderness, a dry land, a desert.
chapters.zh: 你们的母巴比伦就极其抱愧，生你们的必然蒙羞。她要列在诸国之末，成为旷野，旱地，沙漠。

chapters.en: Because of the LORD’s anger she will not be inhabited but will be completely desolate. All who pass Babylon will be appalled; they will scoff because of all her wounds.
chapters.zh: 因耶和华的忿怒，必无人居住，要全然荒凉。凡经过巴比伦的要受惊骇，又因她所遭的灾殃嗤笑。

chapters.en: “Take up your positions around Babylon, all you who draw the bow. Shoot at her! Spare no arrows, for she has sinned against the LORD.
chapters.zh: 所有拉弓的，你们要在巴比伦的四围摆阵，射箭攻击她。不要爱惜箭枝，因她得罪了耶和华。

chapters.en: Shout against her on every side! She surrenders, her towers fall, her walls are torn down. Since this is the vengeance of the LORD, take vengeance on her; do to her as she has done to others.
chapters.zh: 你们要在她四围呐喊。她已经投降。外郭坍塌了，城墙拆毁了，因为这是耶和华报仇的事。你们要向巴比伦报仇。她怎样待人，也要怎样待她。

chapters.en: Cut off from Babylon the sower, and the reaper with his sickle at harvest. Because of the sword of the oppressor let everyone return to their own people, let everyone flee to their own land.
chapters.zh: 你们要将巴比伦撒种的和收割时拿镰刀的都剪除了。他们各人因怕欺压的刀剑，必归回本族，逃到本土。

chapters.en: “Israel is a scattered flock that lions have chased away. The first to devour them was the king of Assyria; the last to crush their bones was Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon.”
chapters.zh: 以色列是打散的羊，是被狮子赶出的。首先是亚述王将他吞灭，末后是巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒将他的骨头折断。

chapters.en: Therefore this is what the LORD Almighty, the God of Israel, says: “I will punish the king of Babylon and his land as I punished the king of Assyria.
chapters.zh: 所以万军之耶和华以色列的神如此说，我必罚巴比伦王和他的地，像我从前罚亚述王一样。

chapters.en: But I will bring Israel back to their own pasture, and they will graze on Carmel and Bashan; their appetite will be satisfied on the hills of Ephraim and Gilead.
chapters.zh: 我必再领以色列回他的草场，他必在迦密和巴珊吃草，又在以法莲山上和基列境内得以饱足。

chapters.en: In those days, at that time,” declares the LORD, “search will be made for Israel’s guilt, but there will be none, and for the sins of Judah, but none will be found, for I will forgive the remnant I spare.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说，当那日子，那时候，虽寻以色列的罪孽，一无所有。虽寻犹大的罪恶，也无所见。因为我所留下的人，我必赦免。

chapters.en: “Attack the land of Merathaim and those who live in Pekod. Pursue, kill and completely destroy them,” declares the LORD. “Do everything I have commanded you.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说，上去攻击米拉大翁之地，又攻击比割的居民。要追杀灭尽，照我一切所吩咐你的去行。

chapters.en: The noise of battle is in the land, the noise of great destruction!
chapters.zh: 境内有打仗和大毁灭的响声。

chapters.en: How broken and shattered is the hammer of the whole earth! How desolate is Babylon among the nations!
chapters.zh: 全地的大锤何竟砍断破坏。巴比伦在列国中何竟荒凉。

chapters.en: I set a trap for you, Babylon, and you were caught before you knew it; you were found and captured because you opposed the LORD.
chapters.zh: 巴比伦哪，我为你设下网罗，你不知不觉被缠住。你被寻着，也被捉住。因为你与耶和华争竞。

chapters.en: The LORD has opened his arsenal and brought out the weapons of his wrath, for the Sovereign LORD Almighty has work to do in the land of the Babylonians.
chapters.zh: 耶和华已经开了武库，拿出他恼恨的兵器。因为主万军之耶和华在迦勒底人之地有当作的事。

chapters.en: Come against her from afar. Break open her granaries; pile her up like heaps of grain. Completely destroy her and leave her no remnant.
chapters.zh: 你们要从极远的边界来攻击她，开她的仓廪，将她堆如高堆，毁灭净尽，丝毫不留。

chapters.en: Kill all her young bulls; let them go down to the slaughter! Woe to them! For their day has come, the time for them to be punished.
chapters.zh: 要杀她的一切牛犊，使他们下去遭遇杀戮。他们有祸了，因为追讨他们的日子已经来到。

chapters.en: Listen to the fugitives and refugees from Babylon declaring in Zion how the LORD our God has taken vengeance, vengeance for his temple.
chapters.zh: 有从巴比伦之地逃避出来的人，在锡安扬声报告耶和华我们的神报仇，就是为他的殿报仇。

chapters.en: “Summon archers against Babylon, all those who draw the bow. Encamp all around her; let no one escape. Repay her for her deeds; do to her as she has done. For she has defied the LORD, the Holy One of Israel.
chapters.zh: 招集一切弓箭手来攻击巴比伦。要在巴比伦四围安营，不要容一人逃脱，照着她所作的报应她。她怎样待人，也要怎样待她，因为她向耶和华以色列的圣者发了狂傲。

chapters.en: Therefore, her young men will fall in the streets; all her soldiers will be silenced in that day,” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 所以她的少年人必仆倒在街上。当那日，一切兵丁必默默无声。这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: “See, I am against you, you arrogant one,” declares the Lord, the LORD Almighty, “for your day has come, the time for you to be punished.
chapters.zh: 主万军之耶和华说，你这狂傲的阿，我与你反对，因为我追讨你的日子已经来到。

chapters.en: The arrogant one will stumble and fall and no one will help her up; I will kindle a fire in her towns that will consume all who are around her.”
chapters.zh: 狂傲的必绊跌仆倒，无人扶起。我也必使火在他的城邑中着起来，将他四围所有的尽行烧灭。

chapters.en: This is what the LORD Almighty says: “The people of Israel are oppressed, and the people of Judah as well. All their captors hold them fast, refusing to let them go.
chapters.zh: 万军之耶和华如此说，以色列人和犹大人一同受欺压。凡掳掠他们的都紧紧抓住他们，不肯释放。

chapters.en: Yet their Redeemer is strong; the LORD Almighty is his name. He will vigorously defend their cause so that he may bring rest to their land, but unrest to those who live in Babylon.
chapters.zh: 他们的救赎主大有能力，万军之耶和华是他的名。他必伸清他们的冤，好使全地得平安，并搅扰巴比伦的居民。

chapters.en: “A sword against the Babylonians!” declares the LORD— “against those who live in Babylon and against her officials and wise men!
chapters.zh: 耶和华说，有刀剑临到迦勒底人和巴比伦的居民，并她的首领与智慧人。

chapters.en: A sword against her false prophets! They will become fools. A sword against her warriors! They will be filled with terror.
chapters.zh: 有刀剑临到矜夸的人，他们就成为愚昧。有刀剑临到她的勇士，他们就惊惶。

chapters.en: A sword against her horses and chariots and all the foreigners in her ranks! They will become weaklings. A sword against her treasures! They will be plundered.
chapters.zh: 有刀剑临到她的马匹，车辆，和其中杂族的人民。他们必像妇女一样。有刀剑临到她的宝物，就被抢夺。

chapters.en: A drought on her waters! They will dry up. For it is a land of idols, idols that will go mad with terror.
chapters.zh: 有干旱临到她的众水，就必干涸。因为这是有雕刻偶像之地，人因偶像而颠狂。

chapters.en: “So desert creatures and hyenas will live there, and there the owl will dwell. It will never again be inhabited or lived in from generation to generation.
chapters.zh: 所以旷野的走兽和豺狼必住在那里，鸵鸟也住在其中，永无人烟，世世代代无人居住。

chapters.en: As I overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah along with their neighboring towns,” declares the LORD, “so no one will live there; no people will dwell in it.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说，必无人住在那里，也无人在其中寄居，要像我倾覆所多玛，蛾摩拉，和邻近的城邑一样。

chapters.en: “Look! An army is coming from the north; a great nation and many kings are being stirred up from the ends of the earth.
chapters.zh: 看哪，有一种民从北方而来，并有一大国和许多君王被激动，从地极来到。

chapters.en: They are armed with bows and spears; they are cruel and without mercy. They sound like the roaring sea as they ride on their horses; they come like men in battle formation to attack you, Daughter Babylon.
chapters.zh: 他们拿弓和枪，性情残忍，不施怜悯。他们的声音像海浪澎湃。巴比伦城（城原文作女子）阿，他们骑马，都摆队伍如上战场的人，要攻击你。

chapters.en: The king of Babylon has heard reports about them, and his hands hang limp. Anguish has gripped him, pain like that of a woman in labor.
chapters.zh: 巴比伦王听见他们的风声，手就发软，痛苦将他抓住，疼痛仿佛产难的妇人。

chapters.en: Like a lion coming up from Jordan’s thickets to a rich pastureland, I will chase Babylon from its land in an instant. Who is the chosen one I will appoint for this? Who is like me and who can challenge me? And what shepherd can stand against me?”
chapters.zh: 仇敌必像狮子从约旦河边的丛林上来，攻击坚固的居所。转眼之间，我要使他们逃跑，离开这地。谁蒙拣选，我就派谁治理这地。谁能比我呢？谁能给我定规日期呢？有何牧人能在我面前站立得住呢？

chapters.en: Therefore, hear what the LORD has planned against Babylon, what he has purposed against the land of the Babylonians: The young of the flock will be dragged away; their pasture will be appalled at their fate.
chapters.zh: 你们要听耶和华攻击巴比伦所说的谋略和他攻击迦勒底人之地所定的旨意。仇敌定要将他们群众微弱的拉去，定要使他们的居所荒凉。

chapters.en: At the sound of Babylon’s capture the earth will tremble; its cry will resound among the nations.
chapters.zh: 因巴比伦被取的声音，地就震动，人在列邦都听见呼喊的声音。

chapters.en: This is what the LORD says: “See, I will stir up the spirit of a destroyer against Babylon and the people of Leb Kamai.
chapters.zh: 耶和华如此说，我必使毁灭的风刮起，攻击巴比伦和住在立加米的人。

chapters.en: I will send foreigners to Babylon to winnow her and to devastate her land; they will oppose her on every side in the day of her disaster.
chapters.zh: 我要打发外邦人来到巴比伦，簸扬她，使她的地空虚。在她遭祸的日子，他们要周围攻击她。

chapters.en: Let not the archer string his bow, nor let him put on his armor. Do not spare her young men; completely destroy her army.
chapters.zh: 拉弓的，要向拉弓的和贯甲挺身的射箭。不要怜惜她的少年人。要灭尽她的全军。

chapters.en: They will fall down slain in Babylon,fatally wounded in her streets.
chapters.zh: 他们必在迦勒底人之地被杀仆倒，在巴比伦的街上被刺透。

chapters.en: For Israel and Judah have not been forsaken by their God, the LORD Almighty, though their land is full of guilt before the Holy One of Israel.
chapters.zh: 以色列和犹大虽然境内充满违背以色列圣者的罪，却没有被他的神万军之耶和华丢弃。

chapters.en: “Flee from Babylon! Run for your lives! Do not be destroyed because of her sins. It is time for the LORD’s vengeance; he will repay her what she deserves.
chapters.zh: 你们要从巴比伦中逃奔，各救自己的性命。不要陷在她的罪孽中一同灭亡。因为这是耶和华报仇的时候，他必向巴比伦施行报应。

chapters.en: Babylon was a gold cup in the LORD’s hand; she made the whole earth drunk. The nations drank her wine; therefore they have now gone mad.
chapters.zh: 巴比伦素来是耶和华手中的金杯，使天下沉醉。万国喝了她的酒就颠狂了。

chapters.en: Babylon will suddenly fall and be broken. Wail over her! Get balm for her pain; perhaps she can be healed.
chapters.zh: 巴比伦忽然倾覆毁坏。要为她哀号。为止她的疼痛，拿乳香或者可以治好。

chapters.en: “ ‘We would have healed Babylon, but she cannot be healed; let us leave her and each go to our own land, for her judgment reaches to the skies, it rises as high as the heavens.’
chapters.zh: 我们想医治巴比伦，她却没有治好。离开她吧。我们各人归回本国。因为她受的审判通于上天，达到穹苍。

chapters.en: “ ‘The LORD has vindicated us; come, let us tell in Zion what the LORD our God has done.’
chapters.zh: 耶和华已经彰显我们的公义。来吧。我们可以在锡安报告耶和华我们神的作为。

chapters.en: “Sharpen the arrows, take up the shields! The LORD has stirred up the kings of the Medes, because his purpose is to destroy Babylon. The LORD will take vengeance, vengeance for his temple.
chapters.zh: 你们要磨尖了箭头，抓住盾牌。耶和华定意攻击巴比伦，将她毁灭，所以激动了玛代君王的心。因这是耶和华报仇，就是为自己的殿报仇。

chapters.en: Lift up a banner against the walls of Babylon! Reinforce the guard, station the watchmen, prepare an ambush! The LORD will carry out his purpose, his decree against the people of Babylon.
chapters.zh: 你们要竖立大旗，攻击巴比伦的城墙。要坚固了望台，派定守望的设下埋伏。因为耶和华指着巴比伦居民所说的话，所定的意，他已经作成。

chapters.en: You who live by many waters and are rich in treasures, your end has come, the time for you to be destroyed.
chapters.zh: 住在众水之上多有财宝的阿，你的结局到了。你贪婪之量满了。

chapters.en: The LORD Almighty has sworn by himself: I will surely fill you with troops, as with a swarm of locusts, and they will shout in triumph over you.
chapters.zh: 万军之耶和华指着自己起誓说，我必使敌人充满你，像蚂蚱一样。他们必呐喊攻击你。

chapters.en: “He made the earth by his power; he founded the world by his wisdom and stretched out the heavens by his understanding.
chapters.zh: 耶和华用能力创造大地，用智慧建立世界，用聪明铺张穹苍。

chapters.en: When he thunders, the waters in the heavens roar; he makes clouds rise from the ends of the earth. He sends lightning with the rain and brings out the wind from his storehouses.
chapters.zh: 他一发声，空中便有多水激动。他使云雾从地极上腾。他造电随雨而闪，从他府库中带出风来。

chapters.en: “Everyone is senseless and without knowledge; every goldsmith is shamed by his idols. The images he makes are a fraud; they have no breath in them.
chapters.zh: 各人都成了畜类，毫无知识。各银匠都因他的偶像羞愧。他所铸的偶像本是虚假的，其中并无气息，

chapters.en: They are worthless, the objects of mockery; when their judgment comes, they will perish.
chapters.zh: 都是虚无的，是迷惑人的工作，到追讨的时候，必被除灭。

chapters.en: He who is the Portion of Jacob is not like these, for he is the Maker of all things, including the people of his inheritance— the LORD Almighty is his name.
chapters.zh: 雅各的分不像这些，因他是造作万有的主。以色列也是他产业的支派。万军之耶和华是他的名。

chapters.en: “You are my war club, my weapon for battle— with you I shatter nations, with you I destroy kingdoms,
chapters.zh: 你是我争战的斧子和打仗的兵器。我要用你打碎列国，用你毁灭列邦。

chapters.en: with you I shatter horse and rider, with you I shatter chariot and driver,
chapters.zh: 用你打碎马和骑马的。用你打碎战车和坐在其上的。

chapters.en: with you I shatter man and woman, with you I shatter old man and youth, with you I shatter young man and young woman,
chapters.zh: 用你打碎男人和女人。用你打碎老年人和少年人。用你打碎壮丁和处女。

chapters.en: with you I shatter shepherd and flock, with you I shatter farmer and oxen, with you I shatter governors and officials.
chapters.zh: 用你打碎牧人和他的群畜。用你打碎农夫和他一对牛。用你打碎省长和副省长。

chapters.en: “Before your eyes I will repay Babylon and all who live in Babylonia for all the wrong they have done in Zion,” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说，我必在你们眼前报复巴比伦人和迦勒底居民在锡安所行的诸恶。

chapters.en: “I am against you, you destroying mountain, you who destroy the whole earth,” declares the LORD. “I will stretch out my hand against you, roll you off the cliffs, and make you a burned-out mountain.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说，你这行毁灭的山哪，就是毁灭天下的山，我与你反对。我必向你伸手，将你从山岩滚下去，使你成为烧毁的山。

chapters.en: No rock will be taken from you for a cornerstone, nor any stone for a foundation, for you will be desolate forever,” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 人必不从你那里取石头为房角石，也不取石头为根基石。你必永远荒凉。这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: “Lift up a banner in the land! Blow the trumpet among the nations! Prepare the nations for battle against her; summon against her these kingdoms: Ararat, Minni and Ashkenaz. Appoint a commander against her; send up horses like a swarm of locusts.
chapters.zh: 要在境内竖立大旗，在各国中吹角，使列国预备攻击巴比伦，将亚拉腊，米尼，亚实基拿各国招来攻击她。又派军长来攻击她，使马匹上来如蚂蚱，

chapters.en: Prepare the nations for battle against her— the kings of the Medes, their governors and all their officials, and all the countries they rule.
chapters.zh: 使列国和玛代君王，与省长和副省长，并他们所管全地之人，都预备攻击她。

chapters.en: The land trembles and writhes, for the LORD’s purposes against Babylon stand— to lay waste the land of Babylon so that no one will live there.
chapters.zh: 地必震动而瘠苦。因耶和华向巴比伦所定的旨意成立了，使巴比伦之地荒凉，无人居住。

chapters.en: Babylon’s warriors have stopped fighting; they remain in their strongholds. Their strength is exhausted; they have become weaklings. Her dwellings are set on fire; the bars of her gates are broken.
chapters.zh: 巴比伦的勇士止息争战，藏在坚垒之中。他们的勇力衰尽，好像妇女一样。巴比伦的住处有火着起，门闩都折断了。

chapters.en: One courier follows another and messenger follows messenger to announce to the king of Babylon that his entire city is captured,
chapters.zh: 通报的要彼此相遇，送信的要互相迎接，报告巴比伦王说，城的四方被攻取了，

chapters.en: the river crossings seized, the marshes set on fire, and the soldiers terrified.”
chapters.zh: 渡口被占据了，苇塘被火烧了，兵丁也惊慌了。

chapters.en: This is what the LORD Almighty, the God of Israel, says: “Daughter Babylon is like a threshing floor at the time it is trampled; the time to harvest her will soon come.”
chapters.zh: 万军之耶和华以色列的神如此说，巴比伦城（城原文作女子）好像踹谷的禾场。再过片时，收割她的时候就到了。

chapters.en: “Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon has devoured us, he has thrown us into confusion, he has made us an empty jar. Like a serpent he has swallowed us and filled his stomach with our delicacies, and then has spewed us out.
chapters.zh: 以色列人说，巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒吞灭我，压碎我，使我成为空虚的器皿。他像大鱼将我吞下，用我的美物充满他的肚腹，又将我赶出去。

chapters.en: May the violence done to our flesh be on Babylon,” say the inhabitants of Zion. “May our blood be on those who live in Babylonia,” says Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 锡安的居民要说，巴比伦以强暴待我，损害我的身体，愿这罪归给她。耶路撒冷人要说，愿流我们血的罪归到迦勒底的居民。

chapters.en: Therefore this is what the LORD says: “See, I will defend your cause and avenge you; I will dry up her sea and make her springs dry.
chapters.zh: 所以，耶和华如此说，我必为你伸冤，为你报仇。我必使巴比伦的海枯竭，使她的泉源干涸。

chapters.en: Babylon will be a heap of ruins, a haunt of jackals, an object of horror and scorn, a place where no one lives.
chapters.zh: 巴比伦必成为乱堆，为野狗的住处，令人惊骇，嗤笑，并且无人居住。

chapters.en: Her people all roar like young lions, they growl like lion cubs.
chapters.zh: 他们要像少壮狮子咆哮，像小狮子吼叫。

chapters.en: But while they are aroused, I will set out a feast for them and make them drunk, so that they shout with laughter— then sleep forever and not awake,” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 他们火热的时候，我必为他们设摆酒席，使他们沉醉，好叫他们快乐，睡了长觉，永不醒起。这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: “I will bring them down like lambs to the slaughter, like rams and goats.
chapters.zh: 我必使他们像羊羔，像公绵羊和公山羊下到宰杀之地。

chapters.en: “How Sheshak will be captured, the boast of the whole earth seized! How desolate Babylon will be among the nations!
chapters.zh: 示沙克（就是巴比伦）何竟被攻取，天下所称赞的何竟被占据。巴比伦在列国中何竟变为荒场。

chapters.en: The sea will rise over Babylon; its roaring waves will cover her.
chapters.zh: 海水涨起，漫过巴比伦。她被许多海浪遮盖。

chapters.en: Her towns will be desolate, a dry and desert land, a land where no one lives, through which no one travels.
chapters.zh: 她的城邑变为荒场，旱地，沙漠，无人居住，无人经过之地。

chapters.en: I will punish Bel in Babylon and make him spew out what he has swallowed. The nations will no longer stream to him. And the wall of Babylon will fall.
chapters.zh: 我必刑罚巴比伦的彼勒，使他吐出所吞的。万民必不再流归他那里。巴比伦的城墙也必坍塌了。

chapters.en: “Come out of her, my people! Run for your lives! Run from the fierce anger of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 我的民哪，你们要从其中出去。各人拯救自己，躲避耶和华的烈怒。

chapters.en: Do not lose heart or be afraid when rumors are heard in the land; one rumor comes this year, another the next, rumors of violence in the land and of ruler against ruler.
chapters.zh: 你们不要心惊胆怯，也不要因境内所听见的风声惧怕。因为这年有风声传来。那年也有风声传来，境内有强暴的事，官长攻击官长。

chapters.en: For the time will surely come when I will punish the idols of Babylon; her whole land will be disgraced and her slain will all lie fallen within her.
chapters.zh: 日子将到，我必刑罚巴比伦雕刻的偶像。她全地必然抱愧。她被杀的人必在其中仆倒。

chapters.en: Then heaven and earth and all that is in them will shout for joy over Babylon, for out of the north destroyers will attack her,” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 那时，天地和其中所有的，必因巴比伦欢呼，因为行毁灭的要从北方来到她那里。这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: “Babylon must fall because of Israel’s slain, just as the slain in all the earth have fallen because of Babylon.
chapters.zh: 巴比伦怎样使以色列被杀的人仆倒，照样她全地被杀的人也必在巴比伦仆倒。

chapters.en: You who have escaped the sword, leave and do not linger! Remember the LORD in a distant land, and call to mind Jerusalem.”
chapters.zh: 你们躲避刀剑的要快走，不要站住。要在远方记念耶和华，心中追想耶路撒冷。

chapters.en: “We are disgraced, for we have been insulted and shame covers our faces, because foreigners have entered the holy places of the LORD’s house.”
chapters.zh: 我们听见辱骂就蒙羞，满面惭愧，因为外邦人进入耶和华殿的圣所。

chapters.en: “But days are coming,” declares the LORD, “when I will punish her idols, and throughout her land the wounded will groan.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说，日子将到，我必刑罚巴比伦雕刻的偶像，通国受伤的人必唉哼。

chapters.en: Even if Babylon ascends to the heavens and fortifies her lofty stronghold, I will send destroyers against her,” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 巴比伦虽升到天上，虽使她坚固的高处更坚固，还有行毁灭的从我这里到她那里。这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: “The sound of a cry comes from Babylon, the sound of great destruction from the land of the Babylonians.
chapters.zh: 有哀号的声音从巴比伦出来。有大毁灭的响声从迦勒底人之地发出。

chapters.en: The LORD will destroy Babylon; he will silence her noisy din. Waves of enemies will rage like great waters; the roar of their voices will resound.
chapters.zh: 因耶和华使巴比伦变为荒场，使其中的大声灭绝。仇敌仿佛众水，波浪砰訇，响声已经发出。

chapters.en: A destroyer will come against Babylon; her warriors will be captured, and their bows will be broken. For the LORD is a God of retribution; he will repay in full.
chapters.zh: 这是行毁灭的临到巴比伦。巴比伦的勇士被捉住，他们的弓折断了。因为耶和华是施行报应的神，必定施行报应。

chapters.en: I will make her officials and wise men drunk, her governors, officers and warriors as well; they will sleep forever and not awake,” declares the King, whose name is the LORD Almighty.
chapters.zh: 君王名为万军之耶和华的说，我必使巴比伦的首领，智慧人，省长，副省长，和勇士都沉醉，使他们睡了长觉，永不醒起。

chapters.en: This is what the LORD Almighty says: “Babylon’s thick wall will be leveled and her high gates set on fire; the peoples exhaust themselves for nothing, the nations’ labor is only fuel for the flames.”
chapters.zh: 万军之耶和华如此说，巴比伦宽阔的城墙必全然倾倒。她高大的城门必被火焚烧。众民所劳碌的必致虚空。列国所劳碌的被火焚烧，他们都必困乏。

chapters.en: This is the message Jeremiah the prophet gave to the staff officer Seraiah son of Neriah, the son of Mahseiah, when he went to Babylon with Zedekiah king of Judah in the fourth year of his reign.
chapters.zh: 犹大王西底家在位第四年，上巴比伦去的时候，玛西雅的孙子，尼利亚的儿子西莱雅与王同去（西莱雅是王宫的大臣），先知耶利米有话吩咐他。

chapters.en: Jeremiah had written on a scroll about all the disasters that would come upon Babylon—all that had been recorded concerning Babylon.
chapters.zh: 耶利米将一切要临到巴比伦的灾祸，就是论到巴比伦的一切话，写在书上。

chapters.en: He said to Seraiah, “When you get to Babylon, see that you read all these words aloud.
chapters.zh: 耶利米对西莱雅说，你到了巴比伦务要念这书上的话。

chapters.en: Then say, ‘LORD, you have said you will destroy this place, so that neither people nor animals will live in it; it will be desolate forever.’
chapters.zh: 又说，耶和华阿，你曾论到这地方说，要剪除，甚至连人带牲畜没有在这里居住的，必永远荒凉。

chapters.en: When you finish reading this scroll, tie a stone to it and throw it into the Euphrates.
chapters.zh: 你念完了这书，就把一块石头拴在书上，扔在伯拉河中。

chapters.en: Then say, ‘So will Babylon sink to rise no more because of the disaster I will bring on her. And her people will fall.’ ” The words of Jeremiah end here.
chapters.zh: 说，巴比伦因耶和华所要降与她的灾祸，必如此沉下去，不再兴起，人民也必困乏。耶利米的话到此为止。

chapters.en: Zedekiah was twenty-one years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem eleven years. His mother’s name was Hamutal daughter of Jeremiah; she was from Libnah.
chapters.zh: 西底家登基的时候年二十一岁，在耶路撒冷作王十一年。他母亲名叫哈慕他，是立拿人耶利米的女儿。

chapters.en: He did evil in the eyes of the LORD, just as Jehoiakim had done.
chapters.zh: 西底家行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，是照约雅敬一切所行的。

chapters.en: It was because of the LORD’s anger that all this happened to Jerusalem and Judah, and in the end he thrust them from his presence. Now Zedekiah rebelled against the king of Babylon.
chapters.zh: 因此耶和华的怒气在耶路撒冷和犹大发作，以致将人民从自己的面前赶出。

chapters.en: So in the ninth year of Zedekiah’s reign, on the tenth day of the tenth month, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon marched against Jerusalem with his whole army. They encamped outside the city and built siege works all around it.
chapters.zh: 西底家背叛巴比伦王。他作王第九年十月初十日，巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒率领全军来攻击耶路撒冷，对城安营，四围筑垒攻城。

chapters.en: The city was kept under siege until the eleventh year of King Zedekiah.
chapters.zh: 于是城被围困直到西底家王十一年。

chapters.en: By the ninth day of the fourth month the famine in the city had become so severe that there was no food for the people to eat.
chapters.zh: 四月初九日，城里有大饥荒，甚至百姓都没有粮食。

chapters.en: Then the city wall was broken through, and the whole army fled. They left the city at night through the gate between the two walls near the king’s garden, though the Babylonians were surrounding the city. They fled toward the Arabah,
chapters.zh: 城被攻破，一切兵丁就在夜间从靠近王园两城中间的门，出城逃跑。迦勒底人正在四围攻城。他们就往亚拉巴逃去。

chapters.en: but the Babylonian army pursued King Zedekiah and overtook him in the plains of Jericho. All his soldiers were separated from him and scattered,
chapters.zh: 迦勒底的军队追赶西底家王，在耶利哥的平原追上他。他的全军都离开他四散了。

chapters.en: and he was captured. He was taken to the king of Babylon at Riblah in the land of Hamath, where he pronounced sentence on him.
chapters.zh: 迦勒底人就拿住王，带他到哈马地的利比拉巴比伦王那里。巴比伦王便审判他。

chapters.en: There at Riblah the king of Babylon killed the sons of Zedekiah before his eyes; he also killed all the officials of Judah.
chapters.zh: 巴比伦王在西底家眼前杀了他的众子，又在利比拉杀了犹大的一切首领，

chapters.en: Then he put out Zedekiah’s eyes, bound him with bronze shackles and took him to Babylon, where he put him in prison till the day of his death.
chapters.zh: 并且剜了西底家的眼睛，用铜链锁着他，带到巴比伦去，将他囚在监里，直到他死的日子。

chapters.en: On the tenth day of the fifth month, in the nineteenth year of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, Nebuzaradan commander of the imperial guard, who served the king of Babylon, came to Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒十九年五月初十日，在巴比伦王面前侍立的护卫长尼布撒拉旦进入耶路撒冷，

chapters.en: He set fire to the temple of the LORD, the royal palace and all the houses of Jerusalem. Every important building he burned down.
chapters.zh: 用火焚烧耶和华的殿和王宫，又焚烧耶路撒冷的房屋，就是各大户家的房屋。

chapters.en: The whole Babylonian army, under the commander of the imperial guard, broke down all the walls around Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 跟从护卫长迦勒底的全军就拆毁耶路撒冷四围的城墙。

chapters.en: Nebuzaradan the commander of the guard carried into exile some of the poorest people and those who remained in the city, along with the rest of the craftsmen and those who had deserted to the king of Babylon.
chapters.zh: 那时护卫长尼布撒拉旦将民中最穷的和城里所剩下的百姓，并已经投降巴比伦王的人，以及大众所剩下的人，都掳去了。

chapters.en: But Nebuzaradan left behind the rest of the poorest people of the land to work the vineyards and fields.
chapters.zh: 但护卫长尼布撒拉旦留下些民中最穷的，使他们修理葡萄园，耕种田地。

chapters.en: The Babylonians broke up the bronze pillars, the movable stands and the bronze Sea that were at the temple of the LORD and they carried all the bronze to Babylon.
chapters.zh: 耶和华殿的铜柱并殿内的盆座和铜海，迦勒底人都打碎了，将那铜运到巴比伦去了，

chapters.en: They also took away the pots, shovels, wick trimmers, sprinkling bowls, dishes and all the bronze articles used in the temple service.
chapters.zh: 又带去锅，铲子，蜡剪，盘子，调羹，并所用的一切铜器，

chapters.en: The commander of the imperial guard took away the basins, censers, sprinkling bowls, pots, lampstands, dishes and bowls used for drink offerings—all that were made of pure gold or silver.
chapters.zh: 杯，火鼎，碗，盆，灯台，调羹，爵，无论金的银的，护卫长也都带去了。

chapters.en: The bronze from the two pillars, the Sea and the twelve bronze bulls under it, and the movable stands, which King Solomon had made for the temple of the LORD, was more than could be weighed.
chapters.zh: 所罗门为耶和华殿所造的两根铜柱，一个铜海，并座下的十二只铜牛，这一切的铜多得无法可称。

chapters.en: Each pillar was eighteen cubits high and twelve cubits in circumference ; each was four fingers thick, and hollow.
chapters.zh: 这一根柱子高十八肘，厚四指，是空的，围十二肘。

chapters.en: The bronze capital on top of one pillar was five cubits high and was decorated with a network and pomegranates of bronze all around. The other pillar, with its pomegranates, was similar.
chapters.zh: 柱上有铜顶，高五肘。铜顶的周围有网子和石榴，都是铜的。那一根柱子照此一样，也有石榴。

chapters.en: There were ninety-six pomegranates on the sides; the total number of pomegranates above the surrounding network was a hundred.
chapters.zh: 柱子四面有九十六个石榴，在网子周围，共有一百石榴。

chapters.en: The commander of the guard took as prisoners Seraiah the chief priest, Zephaniah the priest next in rank and the three doorkeepers.
chapters.zh: 护卫长拿住大祭司西莱雅，副祭司西番亚，和三个把门的，

chapters.en: Of those still in the city, he took the officer in charge of the fighting men, and seven royal advisers. He also took the secretary who was chief officer in charge of conscripting the people of the land, sixty of whom were found in the city.
chapters.zh: 又从城中拿住一个管理兵丁的官（或作太监），并在城里所遇常见王面的七个人和检点国民军长的书记，以及城里所遇见的国民六十个人。

chapters.en: Nebuzaradan the commander took them all and brought them to the king of Babylon at Riblah.
chapters.zh: 护卫长尼布撒拉旦将这些人带到利比拉巴比伦王那里。

chapters.en: There at Riblah, in the land of Hamath, the king had them executed. So Judah went into captivity, away from her land.
chapters.zh: 巴比伦王就把他们击杀在哈马地的利比拉。这样，犹大人被掳去离开本地。

chapters.en: This is the number of the people Nebuchadnezzar carried into exile: in the seventh year, 3,023 Jews;
chapters.zh: 尼布甲尼撒所掳的民数记在下面，在他第七年掳去犹大人三千零二十三名。

chapters.en: in Nebuchadnezzar’s eighteenth year, 832 people from Jerusalem;
chapters.zh: 尼布甲尼撒十八年从耶路撒冷掳去八百三十二人。

chapters.en: in his twenty-third year, 745 Jews taken into exile by Nebuzaradan the commander of the imperial guard. There were 4,600 people in all.
chapters.zh: 尼布甲尼撒二十三年，护卫长尼布撒拉旦掳去犹大人七百四十五名。共有四千六百人。

chapters.en: In the thirty-seventh year of the exile of Jehoiachin king of Judah, in the year Awel-Marduk became king of Babylon, on the twenty-fifth day of the twelfth month, he released Jehoiachin king of Judah and freed him from prison.
chapters.zh: 犹大王约雅斤被掳后三十七年，巴比伦王以未米罗达元年十二月二十五日，使犹大王约雅斤抬头，提他出监，

chapters.en: He spoke kindly to him and gave him a seat of honor higher than those of the other kings who were with him in Babylon.
chapters.zh: 又对他说恩言，使他的位高过与他一同在巴比伦众王的位，

chapters.en: So Jehoiachin put aside his prison clothes and for the rest of his life ate regularly at the king’s table.
chapters.zh: 给他脱了囚服。他终身在巴比伦王面前吃饭。

chapters.en: Day by day the king of Babylon gave Jehoiachin a regular allowance as long as he lived, till the day of his death.
chapters.zh: 巴比伦王赐他所需用的食物，日日赐他一分，终身是这样，直到他死的日子。

chapters.en: How deserted lies the city, once so full of people! How like a widow is she, who once was great among the nations! She who was queen among the provinces has now become a slave.
chapters.zh: 先前满有人民的城，现在何竟独坐。先前在列国中为大的，现在竟如寡妇。先前在诸省中为王后的，现在成为进贡的。

chapters.en: Bitterly she weeps at night, tears are on her cheeks. Among all her lovers there is no one to comfort her. All her friends have betrayed her; they have become her enemies.
chapters.zh: 她夜间痛哭，泪流满腮。在一切所亲爱的中间没有一个安慰她的。她的朋友都以诡诈待她，成为她的仇敌。

chapters.en: After affliction and harsh labor, Judah has gone into exile. She dwells among the nations; she finds no resting place. All who pursue her have overtaken her in the midst of her distress.
chapters.zh: 犹大因遭遇苦难，又因多服劳苦就迁到外邦。她住在列国中，寻不着安息。追逼她的都在狭窄之地将她追上。

chapters.en: The roads to Zion mourn, for no one comes to her appointed festivals. All her gateways are desolate, her priests groan, her young women grieve, and she is in bitter anguish.
chapters.zh: 锡安的路径因无人来守圣节就悲伤。她的城门凄凉。她的祭司叹息。她的处女受艰难，自己也愁苦。

chapters.en: Her foes have become her masters; her enemies are at ease. The LORD has brought her grief because of her many sins. Her children have gone into exile, captive before the foe.
chapters.zh: 她的敌人为首。她的仇敌亨通。因耶和华为她许多的罪过使她受苦。她的孩童被敌人掳去。

chapters.en: All the splendor has departed from Daughter Zion. Her princes are like deer that find no pasture; in weakness they have fled before the pursuer.
chapters.zh: 锡安城的威荣（城原文作女子下同）全都失去。她的首领像找不着草场的鹿。在追赶的人前无力行走。

chapters.en: In the days of her affliction and wandering Jerusalem remembers all the treasures that were hers in days of old. When her people fell into enemy hands, there was no one to help her. Her enemies looked at her and laughed at her destruction.
chapters.zh: 耶路撒冷在困苦窘迫之时，就追想古时一切的乐境。她百姓落在敌人手中，无人救济。敌人看见，就因她的荒凉嗤笑。

chapters.en: Jerusalem has sinned greatly and so has become unclean. All who honored her despise her, for they have all seen her naked; she herself groans and turns away.
chapters.zh: 耶路撒冷大大犯罪，所以成为不洁之物。素来尊敬她的，见她赤露就都藐视她。她自己也叹息退后。

chapters.en: Her filthiness clung to her skirts; she did not consider her future. Her fall was astounding; there was none to comfort her. “Look, LORD, on my affliction, for the enemy has triumphed.”
chapters.zh: 她的污秽是在衣襟上。她不思想自己的结局，所以非常地败落，无人安慰她。她说，耶和华阿，求你看我的苦难，因为仇敌夸大。

chapters.en: The enemy laid hands on all her treasures; she saw pagan nations enter her sanctuary— those you had forbidden to enter your assembly.
chapters.zh: 敌人伸手，夺取她的美物。她眼见外邦人进入她的圣所论这外邦人，你曾吩咐不可入你的会中。

chapters.en: All her people groan as they search for bread; they barter their treasures for food to keep themselves alive. “Look, LORD, and consider, for I am despised.”
chapters.zh: 她的民都叹息，寻求食物。他们用美物换粮食，要救性命。他们说，耶和华阿，求你观看，因为我甚是卑贱。

chapters.en: “Is it nothing to you, all you who pass by? Look around and see. Is any suffering like my suffering that was inflicted on me, that the LORD brought on me in the day of his fierce anger?
chapters.zh: 你们一切过路的人哪，这事你们不介意吗？你们要观看，有像这临到我的痛苦没有就是耶和华在他发烈怒的日子使我所受的苦。

chapters.en: “From on high he sent fire, sent it down into my bones. He spread a net for my feet and turned me back. He made me desolate, faint all the day long.
chapters.zh: 他从高天使火进入我的骨头，克制了我。他铺下网罗，绊我的脚，使我转回。他使我终日凄凉发昏。

chapters.en: “My sins have been bound into a yoke ; by his hands they were woven together. They have been hung on my neck, and the Lord has sapped my strength. He has given me into the hands of those I cannot withstand.
chapters.zh: 我罪过的轭是他手所绑的，犹如轭绳缚在我颈项上。他使我的力量衰败。主将我交在我所不能敌挡的人手中。

chapters.en: “The Lord has rejected all the warriors in my midst; he has summoned an army against me to crush my young men. In his winepress the Lord has trampled Virgin Daughter Judah.
chapters.zh: 主轻弃我中间的一切勇士，招聚多人（原文作大会）攻击我，要压碎我的少年人。主将犹大居民踹下，像在酒榨中一样。

chapters.en: “This is why I weep and my eyes overflow with tears. No one is near to comfort me, no one to restore my spirit. My children are destitute because the enemy has prevailed.”
chapters.zh: 我因这些事哭泣。我眼泪汪汪。因为那当安慰我，救我性命的，离我甚远。我的儿女孤苦，因为仇敌得了胜。

chapters.en: Zion stretches out her hands, but there is no one to comfort her. The LORD has decreed for Jacob that his neighbors become his foes; Jerusalem has become an unclean thing among them.
chapters.zh: 锡安举手，无人安慰。耶和华论雅各已经出令，使四围的人作他仇敌。耶路撒冷在他们中间像不洁之物。

chapters.en: “The LORD is righteous, yet I rebelled against his command. Listen, all you peoples; look on my suffering. My young men and young women have gone into exile.
chapters.zh: 耶和华是公义的。他这样待我，是因我违背他的命令。众民哪，请听我的话，看我的痛苦。我的处女和少年人都被掳去。

chapters.en: “I called to my allies but they betrayed me. My priests and my elders perished in the city while they searched for food to keep themselves alive.
chapters.zh: 我招呼我所亲爱的，他们却愚弄我。我的祭司和长老正寻求食物，救性命的时候，就在城中绝气。

chapters.en: “See, LORD, how distressed I am! I am in torment within, and in my heart I am disturbed, for I have been most rebellious. Outside, the sword bereaves; inside, there is only death.
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，求你观看，因为我在急难中。我心肠扰乱。我心在我里面翻转，因我大大悖逆。在外，刀剑使人丧子。在家，犹如死亡。

chapters.en: “People have heard my groaning, but there is no one to comfort me. All my enemies have heard of my distress; they rejoice at what you have done. May you bring the day you have announced so they may become like me.
chapters.zh: 听见我叹息的有人。安慰我的却无人。我的仇敌都听见我所遭的患难。因你作这事，他们都喜乐。你必使你报告的日子来到，他们就像我一样。

chapters.en: “Let all their wickedness come before you; deal with them as you have dealt with me because of all my sins. My groans are many and my heart is faint.”
chapters.zh: 愿他们的恶行都呈在你面前。你怎样因我的一切罪过待我，求你照样待他们。因我叹息甚多，心中发昏。

chapters.en: How the Lord has covered Daughter Zion with the cloud of his anger ! He has hurled down the splendor of Israel from heaven to earth; he has not remembered his footstool in the day of his anger.
chapters.zh: 主何竟发怒，使黑云遮蔽锡安城。他将以色列的华美从天扔在地上。在他发怒的日子并不记念自己的脚凳。

chapters.en: Without pity the Lord has swallowed up all the dwellings of Jacob; in his wrath he has torn down the strongholds of Daughter Judah. He has brought her kingdom and its princes down to the ground in dishonor.
chapters.zh: 主吞灭雅各一切的住处，并不顾惜。他发怒倾覆犹大民的保障，使这保障坍倒在地。他辱没这国和其中的首领。

chapters.en: In fierce anger he has cut off every horn of Israel. He has withdrawn his right hand at the approach of the enemy. He has burned in Jacob like a flaming fire that consumes everything around it.
chapters.zh: 他发烈怒，把以色列的角全然砍断，在仇敌面前收回右手。他像火焰四围吞灭，将雅各烧毁。

chapters.en: Like an enemy he has strung his bow; his right hand is ready. Like a foe he has slain all who were pleasing to the eye; he has poured out his wrath like fire on the tent of Daughter Zion.
chapters.zh: 他张弓好像仇敌。他站着举起右手，如同敌人将悦人眼目的，尽行杀戮。在锡安百姓的帐棚上倒出他的忿怒，像火一样。

chapters.en: The Lord is like an enemy; he has swallowed up Israel. He has swallowed up all her palaces and destroyed her strongholds. He has multiplied mourning and lamentation for Daughter Judah.
chapters.zh: 主如仇敌吞灭以色列和锡安的一切宫殿，拆毁百姓的保障。在犹大民中加增悲伤哭号。

chapters.en: He has laid waste his dwelling like a garden; he has destroyed his place of meeting. The LORD has made Zion forget her appointed festivals and her Sabbaths; in his fierce anger he has spurned both king and priest.
chapters.zh: 他强取自己的帐幕，好像是园中的窝棚，毁坏他的聚会之处。耶和华使圣节和安息日在锡安都被忘记，又在怒气的愤恨中藐视君王和祭司。

chapters.en: The Lord has rejected his altar and abandoned his sanctuary. He has given the walls of her palaces into the hands of the enemy; they have raised a shout in the house of the LORD as on the day of an appointed festival.
chapters.zh: 耶和华丢弃自己的祭坛，憎恶自己的圣所，将宫殿的墙垣交付仇敌。他们在耶和华的殿中喧嚷，像在圣会之日一样。

chapters.en: The LORD determined to tear down the wall around Daughter Zion. He stretched out a measuring line and did not withhold his hand from destroying. He made ramparts and walls lament; together they wasted away.
chapters.zh: 耶和华定意拆毁锡安的城墙。他拉了准绳，不将手收回，定要毁灭。他使外郭和城墙都悲哀，一同衰败。

chapters.en: Her gates have sunk into the ground; their bars he has broken and destroyed. Her king and her princes are exiled among the nations, the law is no more, and her prophets no longer find visions from the LORD.
chapters.zh: 锡安的门都陷入地内。主将她的门闩毁坏，折断。她的君王和首领落在没有律法的列国中。她的先知不得见耶和华的异象。

chapters.en: The elders of Daughter Zion sit on the ground in silence; they have sprinkled dust on their heads and put on sackcloth. The young women of Jerusalem have bowed their heads to the ground.
chapters.zh: 锡安城的长老坐在地上默默无声。他们扬起尘土落在头上，腰束麻布。耶路撒冷的处女垂头至地。

chapters.en: My eyes fail from weeping, I am in torment within; my heart is poured out on the ground because my people are destroyed, because children and infants faint in the streets of the city.
chapters.zh: 我眼中流泪，以致失明，我的心肠扰乱，肝胆涂地，都因我众民遭毁灭，又因孩童和吃奶的在城内街上发昏。

chapters.en: They say to their mothers, “Where is bread and wine?” as they faint like the wounded in the streets of the city, as their lives ebb away in their mothers’ arms.
chapters.zh: 那时，他们在城内街上发昏，好像受伤的，在母亲的怀里，将要丧命。对母亲说，谷酒在哪里呢？

chapters.en: What can I say for you? With what can I compare you, Daughter Jerusalem? To what can I liken you, that I may comfort you, Virgin Daughter Zion? Your wound is as deep as the sea. Who can heal you?
chapters.zh: 耶路撒冷的民哪，我可用什么向你证明呢？我可用什么与你相比呢？锡安的民哪，我可拿什么和你比较，好安慰你呢？因为你的裂口大如海，谁能医治你呢？

chapters.en: The visions of your prophets were false and worthless; they did not expose your sin to ward off your captivity. The prophecies they gave you were false and misleading.
chapters.zh: 你的先知为你见虚假和愚昧的异象，并没有显露你的罪孽，使你被掳的归回。却为你见虚假的默示和使你被赶出本境的缘故。

chapters.en: All who pass your way clap their hands at you; they scoff and shake their heads at Daughter Jerusalem: “Is this the city that was called the perfection of beauty, the joy of the whole earth?”
chapters.zh: 凡过路的都向你拍掌。他们向耶路撒冷城嗤笑，摇头，说，难道人所称为全美的，称为全地所喜悦的，就是这城吗？

chapters.en: All your enemies open their mouths wide against you; they scoff and gnash their teeth and say, “We have swallowed her up. This is the day we have waited for; we have lived to see it.”
chapters.zh: 你的仇敌都向你大大张口。他们嗤笑，又切齿说，我们吞灭她。这真是我们所盼望的日子临到了。我们亲眼看见了。

chapters.en: The LORD has done what he planned; he has fulfilled his word, which he decreed long ago. He has overthrown you without pity, he has let the enemy gloat over you, he has exalted the horn of your foes.
chapters.zh: 耶和华成就了他所定的，应验了他古时所命定的。他倾覆了，并不顾惜，使你的仇敌向你夸耀。使你敌人的角也被高举。

chapters.en: The hearts of the people cry out to the Lord. You walls of Daughter Zion, let your tears flow like a river day and night; give yourself no relief, your eyes no rest.
chapters.zh: 锡安民的心哀求主。锡安的城墙阿，愿你流泪如河，昼夜不息。愿你眼中的瞳人泪流不止。

chapters.en: Arise, cry out in the night, as the watches of the night begin; pour out your heart like water in the presence of the Lord. Lift up your hands to him for the lives of your children, who faint from hunger at every street corner.
chapters.zh: 夜间，每逢交更的时候要起来呼喊，在主面前倾心如水。你的孩童在各市口上受饿发昏。你要为他们的性命向主举手祷告。

chapters.en: “Look, LORD, and consider: Whom have you ever treated like this? Should women eat their offspring, the children they have cared for? Should priest and prophet be killed in the sanctuary of the Lord?
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，求你观看。见你向谁这样行。妇人岂可吃自己所生育手里所摇弄的婴孩吗？祭司和先知岂可在主的圣所中被杀戮吗？

chapters.en: “Young and old lie together in the dust of the streets; my young men and young women have fallen by the sword. You have slain them in the day of your anger; you have slaughtered them without pity.
