chapters.zh: 少年人和老年人都在街上躺卧。我的处女和壮丁都倒在刀下。你发怒的日子杀死他们。你杀了，并不顾惜。

chapters.en: “As you summon to a feast day, so you summoned against me terrors on every side. In the day of the LORD’s anger no one escaped or survived; those I cared for and reared my enemy has destroyed.”
chapters.zh: 你招聚四围惊吓我的，像在大会的日子招聚人一样。耶和华发怒的日子，无人逃脱，无人存留。我所摇弄所养育的婴孩，仇敌都杀净了。

chapters.en: I am the man who has seen affliction by the rod of the LORD’s wrath.
chapters.zh: 我是因耶和华忿怒的杖，遭遇困苦的人。

chapters.en: He has driven me away and made me walk in darkness rather than light;
chapters.zh: 他引导我，使我行在黑暗中，不行在光明里。

chapters.en: indeed, he has turned his hand against me again and again, all day long.
chapters.zh: 他真是终日再三反手攻击我。

chapters.en: He has made my skin and my flesh grow old and has broken my bones.
chapters.zh: 他使我的皮肉枯干。他折断（或作压伤）我的骨头。

chapters.en: He has besieged me and surrounded me with bitterness and hardship.
chapters.zh: 他筑垒攻击我，用苦楚（原文作苦胆）和艰难围困我。

chapters.en: He has made me dwell in darkness like those long dead.
chapters.zh: 他使我住在幽暗之处，像死了许久的人一样。

chapters.en: He has walled me in so I cannot escape; he has weighed me down with chains.
chapters.zh: 他用篱笆围住我，使我不能出去。他使我的铜链沉重。

chapters.en: Even when I call out or cry for help, he shuts out my prayer.
chapters.zh: 我哀号求救。他使我的祷告不得上达。

chapters.en: He has barred my way with blocks of stone; he has made my paths crooked.
chapters.zh: 他用凿过的石头挡住我的道。他使我的路弯曲。

chapters.en: Like a bear lying in wait, like a lion in hiding,
chapters.zh: 他向我如熊埋伏，如狮子在隐密处。

chapters.en: he dragged me from the path and mangled me and left me without help.
chapters.zh: 他使我转离正路，将我撕碎，使我凄凉。

chapters.en: He drew his bow and made me the target for his arrows.
chapters.zh: 他张弓将我当作箭靶子。

chapters.en: He pierced my heart with arrows from his quiver.
chapters.zh: 他把箭袋中的箭射入我的肺腑。

chapters.en: I became the laughingstock of all my people; they mock me in song all day long.
chapters.zh: 我成了众民的笑话。他们终日以我为歌曲。

chapters.en: He has filled me with bitter herbs and given me gall to drink.
chapters.zh: 他用苦楚充满我，使我饱用茵陈。

chapters.en: He has broken my teeth with gravel; he has trampled me in the dust.
chapters.zh: 他又用沙石碜断我的牙，用灰尘将我蒙蔽。

chapters.en: I have been deprived of peace; I have forgotten what prosperity is.
chapters.zh: 你使我远离平安，我忘记好处。

chapters.en: So I say, “My splendor is gone and all that I had hoped from the LORD.”
chapters.zh: 我就说，我的力量衰败。我在耶和华那里毫无指望。

chapters.en: I remember my affliction and my wandering, the bitterness and the gall.
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，求你记念我如茵陈和苦胆的困苦窘迫。

chapters.en: I well remember them, and my soul is downcast within me.
chapters.zh: 我心想念这些，就在里面忧闷。

chapters.en: Yet this I call to mind and therefore I have hope:
chapters.zh: 我想起这事，心里就有指望。

chapters.en: Because of the LORD’s great love we are not consumed, for his compassions never fail.
chapters.zh: 我们不至消灭，是出于耶和华诸般的慈爱。是因他的怜悯不至断绝。

chapters.en: They are new every morning; great is your faithfulness.
chapters.zh: 每早晨，这都是新的。你的诚实极其广大。

chapters.en: I say to myself, “The LORD is my portion; therefore I will wait for him.”
chapters.zh: 我心里说，耶和华是我的分，因此，我要仰望他。

chapters.en: The LORD is good to those whose hope is in him, to the one who seeks him;
chapters.zh: 凡等候耶和华，心里寻求他的，耶和华必施恩给他。

chapters.en: it is good to wait quietly for the salvation of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 人仰望耶和华，静默等候他的救恩，这原是好的。

chapters.en: It is good for a man to bear the yoke while he is young.
chapters.zh: 人在幼年负轭，这原是好的。

chapters.en: Let him sit alone in silence, for the LORD has laid it on him.
chapters.zh: 他当独坐无言，因为这是耶和华加在他身上的。

chapters.en: Let him bury his face in the dust— there may yet be hope.
chapters.zh: 他当口贴尘埃，或者有指望。

chapters.en: Let him offer his cheek to one who would strike him, and let him be filled with disgrace.
chapters.zh: 他当由人打他的腮颊，要满受凌辱。

chapters.en: For no one is cast off by the Lord forever.
chapters.zh: 因为主必不永远丢弃人。

chapters.en: Though he brings grief, he will show compassion, so great is his unfailing love.
chapters.zh: 主虽使人忧愁，还要照他诸般的慈爱发怜悯。

chapters.en: For he does not willingly bring affliction or grief to anyone.
chapters.zh: 因他并不甘心使人受苦，使人忧愁。

chapters.en: To crush underfoot all prisoners in the land,
chapters.zh: 人将世上被囚的踹（原文作压）在脚下，

chapters.en: to deny people their rights before the Most High,
chapters.zh: 或在至高者面前屈枉人，

chapters.en: to deprive them of justice— would not the Lord see such things?
chapters.zh: 或在人的讼事上颠倒是非，这都是主看不上的。

chapters.en: Who can speak and have it happen if the Lord has not decreed it?
chapters.zh: 除非主命定，谁能说成就成呢？

chapters.en: Is it not from the mouth of the Most High that both calamities and good things come?
chapters.zh: 祸福不都出于至高者的口吗？

chapters.en: Why should the living complain when punished for their sins?
chapters.zh: 活人因自己的罪受罚，为何发怨言呢？

chapters.en: Let us examine our ways and test them, and let us return to the LORD.
chapters.zh: 我们当深深考察自己的行为，再归向耶和华。

chapters.en: Let us lift up our hearts and our hands to God in heaven, and say:
chapters.zh: 我们当诚心向天上的神举手祷告。

chapters.en: “We have sinned and rebelled and you have not forgiven.
chapters.zh: 我们犯罪背逆，你并不赦免。

chapters.en: “You have covered yourself with anger and pursued us; you have slain without pity.
chapters.zh: 你自被怒气遮蔽，追赶我们。你施行杀戮，并不顾惜。

chapters.en: You have covered yourself with a cloud so that no prayer can get through.
chapters.zh: 你以黑云遮蔽自己，以致祷告不得透入。

chapters.en: You have made us scum and refuse among the nations.
chapters.zh: 你使我们在万民中成为污秽和渣滓。

chapters.en: “All our enemies have opened their mouths wide against us.
chapters.zh: 我们的仇敌都向我们大大张口。

chapters.en: We have suffered terror and pitfalls, ruin and destruction.”
chapters.zh: 恐惧和陷坑，残害和毁灭，都临近我们。

chapters.en: Streams of tears flow from my eyes because my people are destroyed.
chapters.zh: 因我众民遭的毁灭，我就眼泪下流如河。

chapters.en: My eyes will flow unceasingly, without relief,
chapters.zh: 我的眼多多流泪，总不止息，

chapters.en: until the LORD looks down from heaven and sees.
chapters.zh: 直等耶和华垂顾，从天观看。

chapters.en: What I see brings grief to my soul because of all the women of my city.
chapters.zh: 因我本城的众民，我的眼，使我的心伤痛。

chapters.en: Those who were my enemies without cause hunted me like a bird.
chapters.zh: 无故与我为仇的追逼我，像追雀鸟一样。

chapters.en: They tried to end my life in a pit and threw stones at me;
chapters.zh: 他们使我的命在牢狱中断绝，并将一块石头抛在我身上。

chapters.en: the waters closed over my head, and I thought I was about to perish.
chapters.zh: 众水流过我头，我说，我命断绝了。

chapters.en: I called on your name, LORD, from the depths of the pit.
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，我从深牢中求告你的名。

chapters.en: You heard my plea: “Do not close your ears to my cry for relief.”
chapters.zh: 你曾听见我的声音。我求你解救，你不要掩耳不听。

chapters.en: You came near when I called you, and you said, “Do not fear.”
chapters.zh: 我求告你的日子，你临近我，说，不要惧怕。

chapters.en: You, Lord, took up my case; you redeemed my life.
chapters.zh: 主阿，你伸明了我的冤。你救赎了我的命。

chapters.en: LORD, you have seen the wrong done to me. Uphold my cause!
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，你见了我受的委屈。求你为我伸冤。

chapters.en: You have seen the depth of their vengeance, all their plots against me.
chapters.zh: 他们仇恨我，谋害我，你都看见了。

chapters.en: LORD, you have heard their insults, all their plots against me—
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，你听见他们辱骂我的话，知道他们向我所设的计，

chapters.en: what my enemies whisper and mutter against me all day long.
chapters.zh: 并那些起来攻击我的人口中所说的话，以及终日向我所设的计谋。

chapters.en: Look at them! Sitting or standing, they mock me in their songs.
chapters.zh: 求你观看，他们坐下，起来，都以我为歌曲。

chapters.en: Pay them back what they deserve, LORD, for what their hands have done.
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，你要按着他们手所作的向他们施行报应。

chapters.en: Put a veil over their hearts, and may your curse be on them!
chapters.zh: 你要使他们心里刚硬，使你的咒诅临到他们。

chapters.en: Pursue them in anger and destroy them from under the heavens of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 你要发怒追赶他们，从耶和华的天下除灭他们。

chapters.en: How the gold has lost its luster, the fine gold become dull! The sacred gems are scattered at every street corner.
chapters.zh: 黄金何其失光；纯金何其变色。圣所的石头倒在各市口上。

chapters.en: How the precious children of Zion, once worth their weight in gold, are now considered as pots of clay, the work of a potter’s hands!
chapters.zh: 锡安宝贵的众子好比精金，现在何竟算为窑匠手所作的瓦瓶。

chapters.en: Even jackals offer their breasts to nurse their young, but my people have become heartless like ostriches in the desert.
chapters.zh: 野狗尚且把奶乳哺其子，我民的妇人倒成为残忍，好像旷野的鸵鸟一般。

chapters.en: Because of thirst the infant’s tongue sticks to the roof of its mouth; the children beg for bread, but no one gives it to them.
chapters.zh: 吃奶孩子的舌头因干渴贴住上膛。孩童求饼，无人掰给他们。

chapters.en: Those who once ate delicacies are destitute in the streets. Those brought up in royal purple now lie on ash heaps.
chapters.zh: 素来吃美好食物的，现今在街上变为孤寒。素来卧朱红褥子的，现今躺卧粪堆。

chapters.en: The punishment of my people is greater than that of Sodom, which was overthrown in a moment without a hand turned to help her.
chapters.zh: 都因我众民的罪孽比所多玛的罪还大。所多玛虽然无人加手于她，还是转眼之间被倾覆。

chapters.en: Their princes were brighter than snow and whiter than milk, their bodies more ruddy than rubies, their appearance like lapis lazuli.
chapters.zh: 锡安的贵胄素来比雪纯净，比奶更白。他们的身体比红宝玉（或作珊瑚）更红，像光润的蓝宝石一样。

chapters.en: But now they are blacker than soot; they are not recognized in the streets. Their skin has shriveled on their bones; it has become as dry as a stick.
chapters.zh: 现在他们的面貌比煤炭更黑，以致在街上无人认识。他们的皮肤紧贴骨头，枯干如同槁木。

chapters.en: Those killed by the sword are better off than those who die of famine; racked with hunger, they waste away for lack of food from the field.
chapters.zh: 饿死的不如被刀杀的，因为这是缺了田间的土产，就身体衰弱，渐渐消灭。

chapters.en: With their own hands compassionate women have cooked their own children, who became their food when my people were destroyed.
chapters.zh: 慈悲的妇人，当我众民被毁灭的时候，亲手煮自己的儿女作为食物。

chapters.en: The LORD has given full vent to his wrath; he has poured out his fierce anger. He kindled a fire in Zion that consumed her foundations.
chapters.zh: 耶和华发怒成就他所定的，倒出他的烈怒。在锡安使火着起，烧毁锡安的根基。

chapters.en: The kings of the earth did not believe, nor did any of the peoples of the world, that enemies and foes could enter the gates of Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 地上的君王和世上的居民都不信敌人和仇敌能进耶路撒冷的城门。

chapters.en: But it happened because of the sins of her prophets and the iniquities of her priests, who shed within her the blood of the righteous.
chapters.zh: 这都因她先知的罪恶和祭司的罪孽。他们在城中流了义人的血。

chapters.en: Now they grope through the streets as if they were blind. They are so defiled with blood that no one dares to touch their garments.
chapters.zh: 他们在街上如瞎子乱走，又被血玷污，以致人不能摸他们的衣服。

chapters.en: “Go away! You are unclean!” people cry to them. “Away! Away! Don’t touch us!” When they flee and wander about, people among the nations say, “They can stay here no longer.”
chapters.zh: 人向他们喊着说，不洁净的，躲开，躲开。不要挨近我。他们逃走飘流的时候，列国中有人说，他们不可仍在这里寄居。

chapters.en: The LORD himself has scattered them; he no longer watches over them. The priests are shown no honor, the elders no favor.
chapters.zh: 耶和华发怒，将他们分散，不再眷顾他们。人不重看祭司，也不厚待长老。

chapters.en: Moreover, our eyes failed, looking in vain for help; from our towers we watched for a nation that could not save us.
chapters.zh: 我们仰望人来帮助，以致眼目失明，还是枉然。我们所盼望的，竟盼望一个不能救人的国。

chapters.en: People stalked us at every step, so we could not walk in our streets. Our end was near, our days were numbered, for our end had come.
chapters.zh: 仇敌追赶我们的脚步像打猎的，以致我们不敢在自己的街上行走。我们的结局临近。我们的日子满足。我们的结局来到了。

chapters.en: Our pursuers were swifter than eagles in the sky; they chased us over the mountains and lay in wait for us in the desert.
chapters.zh: 追赶我们的比空中的鹰更快。他们在山上追逼我们，在旷野埋伏，等候我们。

chapters.en: The LORD’s anointed, our very life breath, was caught in their traps. We thought that under his shadow we would live among the nations.
chapters.zh: 耶和华的受膏者好比我们鼻中的气，在他们的坑中被捉住。我们曾论到他说，我们必在他荫下，在列国中存活。

chapters.en: Rejoice and be glad, Daughter Edom, you who live in the land of Uz. But to you also the cup will be passed; you will be drunk and stripped naked.
chapters.zh: 住乌斯地的以东民哪，只管欢喜快乐。苦杯也必传到你那里。你必喝醉，以致露体。

chapters.en: Your punishment will end, Daughter Zion; he will not prolong your exile. But he will punish your sin, Daughter Edom, and expose your wickedness.
chapters.zh: 锡安的民哪，你罪孽的刑罚受足了，耶和华必不使你再被掳去。以东的民哪，他必追讨你的罪孽，显露你的罪恶。

chapters.en: Remember, LORD, what has happened to us; look, and see our disgrace.
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，求你记念我们所遭遇的事，观看我们所受的凌辱。

chapters.en: Our inheritance has been turned over to strangers, our homes to foreigners.
chapters.zh: 我们的产业归与外邦人。我们的房屋归与外路人。

chapters.en: We have become fatherless, our mothers are widows.
chapters.zh: 我们是无父的孤儿。我们的母亲好像寡妇。

chapters.en: We must buy the water we drink; our wood can be had only at a price.
chapters.zh: 我们出钱才得水喝。我们的柴是人卖给我们的。

chapters.en: Those who pursue us are at our heels; we are weary and find no rest.
chapters.zh: 追赶我们的，到了我们的颈项上。我们疲乏不得歇息。

chapters.en: We submitted to Egypt and Assyria to get enough bread.
chapters.zh: 我们投降埃及人和亚述人，为要得粮吃饱。

chapters.en: Our ancestors sinned and are no more, and we bear their punishment.
chapters.zh: 我们列祖犯罪，而今不在了。我们担当他们的罪孽。

chapters.en: Slaves rule over us, and there is no one to free us from their hands.
chapters.zh: 奴仆辖制我们，无人救我们脱离他们的手。

chapters.en: We get our bread at the risk of our lives because of the sword in the desert.
chapters.zh: 因为旷野的刀剑，我们冒着险才得粮食。

chapters.en: Our skin is hot as an oven, feverish from hunger.
chapters.zh: 因饥饿燥热，我们的皮肤就黑如炉。

chapters.en: Women have been violated in Zion, and virgins in the towns of Judah.
chapters.zh: 敌人在锡安玷污妇人，在犹大的城邑玷污处女。

chapters.en: Princes have been hung up by their hands; elders are shown no respect.
chapters.zh: 他们吊起首领的手，也不尊敬老人的面。

chapters.en: Young men toil at the millstones; boys stagger under loads of wood.
chapters.zh: 少年人扛磨石，孩童背木柴，都绊跌了。

chapters.en: The elders are gone from the city gate; the young men have stopped their music.
chapters.zh: 老年人在城门口断绝。少年人不再作乐。

chapters.en: Joy is gone from our hearts; our dancing has turned to mourning.
chapters.zh: 我们心中的快乐止息，跳舞变为悲哀。

chapters.en: The crown has fallen from our head. Woe to us, for we have sinned!
chapters.zh: 冠冕从我们的头上落下。我们犯罪了，我们有祸了。

chapters.en: Because of this our hearts are faint, because of these things our eyes grow dim
chapters.zh: 这些事我们心里发昏，我们的眼睛昏花。

chapters.en: for Mount Zion, which lies desolate, with jackals prowling over it.
chapters.zh: 锡安山荒凉，野狗（或作狐狸）行在其上。

chapters.en: You, LORD, reign forever; your throne endures from generation to generation.
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，你存到永远。你的宝座存到万代。

chapters.en: Why do you always forget us? Why do you forsake us so long?
chapters.zh: 你为何永远忘记我们。为何许久离弃我们。

chapters.en: Restore us to yourself, LORD, that we may return; renew our days as of old
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，求你使我们向你回转，我们便得回转。求你复新我们的日子，像古时一样。

chapters.en: unless you have utterly rejected us and are angry with us beyond measure.
chapters.zh: 你竟全然弃绝我们，向我们大发烈怒。

chapters.en: In my thirtieth year, in the fourth month on the fifth day, while I was among the exiles by the Kebar River, the heavens were opened and I saw visions of God.
chapters.zh: 当三十年四月初五日，以西结（原文作我）在迦巴鲁河边被掳的人中，天就开了，得见神的异象。

chapters.en: On the fifth of the month—it was the fifth year of the exile of King Jehoiachin—
chapters.zh: 正是约雅斤王被掳去第五年四月初五日，

chapters.en: the word of the LORD came to Ezekiel the priest, the son of Buzi, by the Kebar River in the land of the Babylonians. There the hand of the LORD was on him.
chapters.zh: 在迦勒底人之地，迦巴鲁河边，耶和华的话特特临到布西的儿子祭司以西结。耶和华的灵（原文作手）降在他身上。

chapters.en: I looked, and I saw a windstorm coming out of the north—an immense cloud with flashing lightning and surrounded by brilliant light. The center of the fire looked like glowing metal,
chapters.zh: 我观看，见狂风从北方刮来，随着有一朵包括闪烁火的大云，周围有光辉。从其中的火内发出好像光耀的精金。

chapters.en: and in the fire was what looked like four living creatures. In appearance their form was human,
chapters.zh: 又从其中显出四个活物的形像来。他们的形状是这样，有人的形像，

chapters.en: but each of them had four faces and four wings.
chapters.zh: 各有四个脸面，四个翅膀。

chapters.en: Their legs were straight; their feet were like those of a calf and gleamed like burnished bronze.
chapters.zh: 他们的腿是直的，脚掌好像牛犊之蹄，都灿烂如光明的铜。

chapters.en: Under their wings on their four sides they had human hands. All four of them had faces and wings,
chapters.zh: 在四面的翅膀以下有人的手。这四个活物的脸和翅膀乃是这样，

chapters.en: and the wings of one touched the wings of another. Each one went straight ahead; they did not turn as they moved.
chapters.zh: 翅膀彼此相接，行走并不转身，俱各直往前行。

chapters.en: Their faces looked like this: Each of the four had the face of a human being, and on the right side each had the face of a lion, and on the left the face of an ox; each also had the face of an eagle.
chapters.zh: 至于脸的形像，前面各有人的脸，右面各有狮子的脸，左面各有牛的脸，后面各有鹰的脸。

chapters.en: Such were their faces. They each had two wings spreading out upward, each wing touching that of the creature on either side; and each had two other wings covering its body.
chapters.zh: 各展开上边的两个翅膀相接，各以下边的两个翅膀遮体。

chapters.en: Each one went straight ahead. Wherever the spirit would go, they would go, without turning as they went.
chapters.zh: 他们俱各直往前行。灵往哪里去，他们就往那里去，行走并不转身。

chapters.en: The appearance of the living creatures was like burning coals of fire or like torches. Fire moved back and forth among the creatures; it was bright, and lightning flashed out of it.
chapters.zh: 至于四活物的形像，就如烧着火炭的形状，又如火把的形状。火在四活物中间上去下来，这火有光辉，从火中发出闪电。

chapters.en: The creatures sped back and forth like flashes of lightning.
chapters.zh: 这活物往来奔走，好像电光一闪。

chapters.en: As I looked at the living creatures, I saw a wheel on the ground beside each creature with its four faces.
chapters.zh: 我正观看活物的时候，见活物的脸旁各有一轮在地上。

chapters.en: This was the appearance and structure of the wheels: They sparkled like topaz, and all four looked alike. Each appeared to be made like a wheel intersecting a wheel.
chapters.zh: 轮的形状和颜色（原文作作法）好像水苍玉。四轮都是一个样式，形状和作法好像轮中套轮。

chapters.en: As they moved, they would go in any one of the four directions the creatures faced; the wheels did not change direction as the creatures went.
chapters.zh: 轮行走的时候，向四方都能直行，并不掉转。

chapters.en: Their rims were high and awesome, and all four rims were full of eyes all around.
chapters.zh: 至于轮辋，高而可畏。四个轮辋周围满有眼睛。

chapters.en: When the living creatures moved, the wheels beside them moved; and when the living creatures rose from the ground, the wheels also rose.
chapters.zh: 活物行走，轮也在旁边行走。活物从地上升，轮也都上升。

chapters.en: Wherever the spirit would go, they would go, and the wheels would rise along with them, because the spirit of the living creatures was in the wheels.
chapters.zh: 灵往哪里去，活物就往那里去。活物上升，轮也在活物旁边上升，因为活物的灵在轮中。

chapters.en: When the creatures moved, they also moved; when the creatures stood still, they also stood still; and when the creatures rose from the ground, the wheels rose along with them, because the spirit of the living creatures was in the wheels.
chapters.zh: 那些行走，这些也行走。那些站住，这些也站住。那些从地上升，轮也在旁边上升，因为活物的灵在轮中。

chapters.en: Spread out above the heads of the living creatures was what looked something like a vault, sparkling like crystal, and awesome.
chapters.zh: 活物的头以上有穹苍的形像，看着像可畏的水晶，铺张在活物的头以上。

chapters.en: Under the vault their wings were stretched out one toward the other, and each had two wings covering its body.
chapters.zh: 穹苍以下，活物的翅膀直张，彼此相对。每活物有两个翅膀遮体。

chapters.en: When the creatures moved, I heard the sound of their wings, like the roar of rushing waters, like the voice of the Almighty, like the tumult of an army. When they stood still, they lowered their wings.
chapters.zh: 活物行走的时候，我听见翅膀的响声，像大水的声音，像全能者的声音，也像军队哄嚷的声音。活物站住的时候，便将翅膀垂下。

chapters.en: Then there came a voice from above the vault over their heads as they stood with lowered wings.
chapters.zh: 在他们头以上的穹苍之上有声音。他们站住的时候，便将翅膀垂下。

chapters.en: Above the vault over their heads was what looked like a throne of lapis lazuli, and high above on the throne was a figure like that of a man.
chapters.zh: 在他们头以上的穹苍之上有宝座的形像，仿佛蓝宝石。在宝座形像以上有仿佛人的形状。

chapters.en: I saw that from what appeared to be his waist up he looked like glowing metal, as if full of fire, and that from there down he looked like fire; and brilliant light surrounded him.
chapters.zh: 我见从他腰以上有仿佛光耀的精金，周围都有火的形状，又见从他腰以下有仿佛火的形状，周围也有光辉。

chapters.en: Like the appearance of a rainbow in the clouds on a rainy day, so was the radiance around him. This was the appearance of the likeness of the glory of the LORD. When I saw it, I fell facedown, and I heard the voice of one speaking.
chapters.zh: 下雨的日子，云中虹的形状怎样，周围光辉的形状也是怎样。这就是耶和华荣耀的形像。我一看见就俯伏在地，又听见一位说话的声音。

chapters.en: He said to me, “Son of man, stand up on your feet and I will speak to you.”
chapters.zh: 他对我说，人子阿，你站起来，我要和你说话。

chapters.en: As he spoke, the Spirit came into me and raised me to my feet, and I heard him speaking to me.
chapters.zh: 他对我说话的时候，灵就进入我里面，使我站起来，我便听见那位对我说话的声音。

chapters.en: He said: “Son of man, I am sending you to the Israelites, to a rebellious nation that has rebelled against me; they and their ancestors have been in revolt against me to this very day.
chapters.zh: 他对我说，人子阿，我差你往悖逆的国民以色列人那里去。他们是悖逆我的，他们和他们的列祖违背我，直到今日。

chapters.en: The people to whom I am sending you are obstinate and stubborn. Say to them, ‘This is what the Sovereign LORD says.’
chapters.zh: 这众子面无羞耻，心里刚硬。我差你往他们那里去，你要对他们说，主耶和华如此说。

chapters.en: And whether they listen or fail to listen—for they are a rebellious people—they will know that a prophet has been among them.
chapters.zh: 他们或听，或不听，（他们是悖逆之家），必知道在他们中间有了先知。

chapters.en: And you, son of man, do not be afraid of them or their words. Do not be afraid, though briers and thorns are all around you and you live among scorpions. Do not be afraid of what they say or be terrified by them, though they are a rebellious people.
chapters.zh: 人子阿，虽有荆棘和蒺藜在你那里，你又住在蝎子中间，总不要怕他们，也不要怕他们的话。他们虽是悖逆之家，还不要怕他们的话，也不要因他们的脸色惊惶。

chapters.en: You must speak my words to them, whether they listen or fail to listen, for they are rebellious.
chapters.zh: 他们或听，或不听，你只管将我的话告诉他们。他们是极其悖逆的。

chapters.en: But you, son of man, listen to what I say to you. Do not rebel like that rebellious people; open your mouth and eat what I give you.”
chapters.zh: 人子阿，要听我对你所说的话，不要悖逆像那悖逆之家，你要开口吃我所赐给你的。

chapters.en: Then I looked, and I saw a hand stretched out to me. In it was a scroll,
chapters.zh: 我观看，见有一只手向我伸出来，手中有一书卷。

chapters.en: which he unrolled before me. On both sides of it were written words of lament and mourning and woe.
chapters.zh: 他将书卷在我面前展开，内外都写着字，其上所写的有哀号，叹息，悲痛的话。

chapters.en: And he said to me, “Son of man, eat what is before you, eat this scroll; then go and speak to the people of Israel.”
chapters.zh: 他对我说，人子阿，要吃你所得的，要吃这书卷，好去对以色列家讲说。

chapters.en: So I opened my mouth, and he gave me the scroll to eat.
chapters.zh: 于是我开口，他就使我吃这书卷，

chapters.en: Then he said to me, “Son of man, eat this scroll I am giving you and fill your stomach with it.” So I ate it, and it tasted as sweet as honey in my mouth.
chapters.zh: 又对我说，人子阿，要吃我所赐给你的这书卷，充满你的肚腹。我就吃了，口中觉得其甜如蜜。

chapters.en: He then said to me: “Son of man, go now to the people of Israel and speak my words to them.
chapters.zh: 他对我说，人子阿，你往以色列家那里去，将我的话对他们讲说。

chapters.en: You are not being sent to a people of obscure speech and strange language, but to the people of Israel—
chapters.zh: 你奉差遣不是往那说话深奥，言语难懂的民那里去，乃是往以色列家去。

chapters.en: not to many peoples of obscure speech and strange language, whose words you cannot understand. Surely if I had sent you to them, they would have listened to you.
chapters.zh: 不是往那说话深奥，言语难懂的多国去，他们的话语是你不懂得的。我若差你往他们那里去，他们必听从你。

chapters.en: But the people of Israel are not willing to listen to you because they are not willing to listen to me, for all the Israelites are hardened and obstinate.
chapters.zh: 以色列家却不肯听从你，因为他们不肯听从我。原来以色列全家是额坚心硬的人。

chapters.en: But I will make you as unyielding and hardened as they are.
chapters.zh: 看哪，我使你的脸硬过他们的脸，使你的额硬过他们的额。

chapters.en: I will make your forehead like the hardest stone, harder than flint. Do not be afraid of them or terrified by them, though they are a rebellious people.”
chapters.zh: 我使你的额像金钢钻，比火石更硬。他们虽是悖逆之家，你不要怕他们，也不要因他们的脸色惊惶。

chapters.en: And he said to me, “Son of man, listen carefully and take to heart all the words I speak to you.
chapters.zh: 他又对我说，人子阿，我对你所说的一切话，要心里领会，耳中听闻。

chapters.en: Go now to your people in exile and speak to them. Say to them, ‘This is what the Sovereign LORD says,’ whether they listen or fail to listen.”
chapters.zh: 你往你本国被掳的子民那里去，他们或听，或不听，你要对他们讲说，告诉他们这是主耶和华说的。

chapters.en: Then the Spirit lifted me up, and I heard behind me a loud rumbling sound as the glory of the LORD rose from the place where it was standing.
chapters.zh: 那时，灵将我举起，我就听见在我身后有震动轰轰的声音，说，从耶和华的所在显出来的荣耀是该称颂的。

chapters.en: It was the sound of the wings of the living creatures brushing against each other and the sound of the wheels beside them, a loud rumbling sound.
chapters.zh: 我又听见那活物翅膀相碰，与活物旁边轮子旋转震动轰轰的响声。

chapters.en: The Spirit then lifted me up and took me away, and I went in bitterness and in the anger of my spirit, with the strong hand of the LORD on me.
chapters.zh: 于是灵将我举起，带我而去。我心中甚苦，灵性忿激，并且耶和华的灵（原文作手）在我身上大有能力。

chapters.en: I came to the exiles who lived at Tel Aviv near the Kebar River. And there, where they were living, I sat among them for seven days—deeply distressed.
chapters.zh: 我就来到提勒亚毕，住在迦巴鲁河边被掳的人那里，到他们所住的地方，在他们中间忧忧闷闷地坐了七日。

chapters.en: At the end of seven days the word of the LORD came to me:
chapters.zh: 过了七日，耶和华的话临到我说，

chapters.en: “Son of man, I have made you a watchman for the people of Israel; so hear the word I speak and give them warning from me.
chapters.zh: 人子阿，我立你作以色列家守望的人，所以你要听我口中的话，替我警戒他们。

chapters.en: When I say to a wicked person, ‘You will surely die,’ and you do not warn them or speak out to dissuade them from their evil ways in order to save their life, that wicked person will die for their sin, and I will hold you accountable for their blood.
chapters.zh: 我何时指着恶人说，他必要死。你若不警戒他，也不劝戒他，使他离开恶行，拯救他的性命，这恶人必死在罪孽之中。我却要向你讨他丧命的罪（原文作血）。

chapters.en: But if you do warn the wicked person and they do not turn from their wickedness or from their evil ways, they will die for their sin; but you will have saved yourself.
chapters.zh: 倘若你警戒恶人，他仍不转离罪恶，也不离开恶行，他必死在罪孽之中，你却救自己脱离了罪。

chapters.en: “Again, when a righteous person turns from their righteousness and does evil, and I put a stumbling block before them, they will die. Since you did not warn them, they will die for their sin. The righteous things that person did will not be remembered, and I will hold you accountable for their blood.
chapters.zh: 再者，义人何时离义而犯罪，我将绊脚石放在他面前，他就必死。因你没有警戒他，他必死在罪中，他素来所行的义不被记念。我却要向你讨他丧命的罪（原文作血）。

chapters.en: But if you do warn the righteous person not to sin and they do not sin, they will surely live because they took warning, and you will have saved yourself.”
chapters.zh: 倘若你警戒义人，使他不犯罪，他就不犯罪。他因受警戒就必存活，你也救自己脱离了罪。

chapters.en: The hand of the LORD was on me there, and he said to me, “Get up and go out to the plain, and there I will speak to you.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华的灵（原文作手）在那里降在我身上。他对我说，你起来往平原去，我要在那里和你说话。

chapters.en: So I got up and went out to the plain. And the glory of the LORD was standing there, like the glory I had seen by the Kebar River, and I fell facedown.
chapters.zh: 于是我起来往平原去，不料，耶和华的荣耀正如我在迦巴鲁河边所见的一样，停在那里，我就俯伏于地。

chapters.en: Then the Spirit came into me and raised me to my feet. He spoke to me and said: “Go, shut yourself inside your house.
chapters.zh: 灵就进入我里面，使我站起来。耶和华对我说，你进房屋去，将门关上。

chapters.en: And you, son of man, they will tie with ropes; you will be bound so that you cannot go out among the people.
chapters.zh: 人子阿，人必用绳索捆绑你，你就不能出去在他们中间来往。

chapters.en: I will make your tongue stick to the roof of your mouth so that you will be silent and unable to rebuke them, for they are a rebellious people.
chapters.zh: 我必使你的舌头贴住上膛，以致你哑口，不能作责备他们的人。他们原是悖逆之家。

chapters.en: But when I speak to you, I will open your mouth and you shall say to them, ‘This is what the Sovereign LORD says.’ Whoever will listen let them listen, and whoever will refuse let them refuse; for they are a rebellious people.
chapters.zh: 但我对你说话的时候，必使你开口，你就要对他们说，主耶和华如此说。听的可以听，不听的任他不听，因为他们是悖逆之家。

chapters.en: “Now, son of man, take a block of clay, put it in front of you and draw the city of Jerusalem on it.
chapters.zh: 人子阿，你要拿一块砖，摆在你面前，将一座耶路撒冷城画在其上，

chapters.en: Then lay siege to it: Erect siege works against it, build a ramp up to it, set up camps against it and put battering rams around it.
chapters.zh: 又围困这城，造台筑垒，安营攻击，在四围安设撞锤攻城，

chapters.en: Then take an iron pan, place it as an iron wall between you and the city and turn your face toward it. It will be under siege, and you shall besiege it. This will be a sign to the people of Israel.
chapters.zh: 又要拿个铁鏊，放在你和城的中间，作为铁墙。你要对面攻击这城，使城被困。这样，好作以色列家的预兆。

chapters.en: “Then lie on your left side and put the sin of the people of Israel upon yourself. You are to bear their sin for the number of days you lie on your side.
chapters.zh: 你要向左侧卧，承当以色列家的罪孽。要按你向左侧卧的日数，担当他们的罪孽。

chapters.en: I have assigned you the same number of days as the years of their sin. So for 390 days you will bear the sin of the people of Israel.
chapters.zh: 因为我已将他们作孽的年数定为你向左侧卧的日数，就是三百九十日，你要这样担当以色列家的罪孽。

chapters.en: “After you have finished this, lie down again, this time on your right side, and bear the sin of the people of Judah. I have assigned you 40 days, a day for each year.
chapters.zh: 再者，你满了这些日子，还要向右侧卧，担当犹大家的罪孽。我给你定规侧卧四十日，一日顶一年。

chapters.en: Turn your face toward the siege of Jerusalem and with bared arm prophesy against her.
chapters.zh: 你要露出膀臂，面向被困的耶路撒冷，说预言攻击这城。

chapters.en: I will tie you up with ropes so that you cannot turn from one side to the other until you have finished the days of your siege.
chapters.zh: 我用绳索捆绑你，使你不能辗转，直等你满了困城的日子。

chapters.en: “Take wheat and barley, beans and lentils, millet and spelt; put them in a storage jar and use them to make bread for yourself. You are to eat it during the 390 days you lie on your side.
chapters.zh: 你要取小麦，大麦，豆子，红豆，小米，粗麦，装在一个器皿中，用以为自己作饼。要按你侧卧的三百九十日吃这饼。

chapters.en: Weigh out twenty shekels of food to eat each day and eat it at set times.
chapters.zh: 你所吃的要按分两吃，每日二十舍客勒，按时而吃。

chapters.en: Also measure out a sixth of a hin of water and drink it at set times.
chapters.zh: 你喝水也要按制子，每日喝一欣六分之一，按时而喝。

chapters.en: Eat the food as you would a loaf of barley bread; bake it in the sight of the people, using human excrement for fuel.”
chapters.zh: 你吃这饼像吃大麦饼一样，要用人粪在众人眼前烧烤。

chapters.en: The LORD said, “In this way the people of Israel will eat defiled food among the nations where I will drive them.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华说，以色列人在我所赶他们到的各国中，也必这样吃不洁净的食物。

chapters.en: Then I said, “Not so, Sovereign LORD! I have never defiled myself. From my youth until now I have never eaten anything found dead or torn by wild animals. No impure meat has ever entered my mouth.”
chapters.zh: 我说，哎。主耶和华阿，我素来未曾被玷污，从幼年到如今没有吃过自死的，或被野兽撕裂的，那可憎的肉也未曾入我的口。

chapters.en: “Very well,” he said, “I will let you bake your bread over cow dung instead of human excrement.”
chapters.zh: 于是他对我说，看哪，我给你牛粪代替人粪，你要将你的饼烤在其上。

chapters.en: He then said to me: “Son of man, I am about to cut off the food supply in Jerusalem. The people will eat rationed food in anxiety and drink rationed water in despair,
chapters.zh: 他又对我说，人子阿，我必在耶路撒冷折断他们的杖，就是断绝他们的粮。他们吃饼要按分两，忧虑而吃。喝水也要按制子，惊惶而喝。

chapters.en: for food and water will be scarce. They will be appalled at the sight of each other and will waste away because of their sin.
chapters.zh: 使他们缺粮缺水，彼此惊惶，因自己的罪孽消灭。

chapters.en: “Now, son of man, take a sharp sword and use it as a barber’s razor to shave your head and your beard. Then take a set of scales and divide up the hair.
chapters.zh: 人子阿，你要拿一把快刀，当作剃头刀，用这刀剃你的头发和你的胡须，用天平将须发平分。

chapters.en: When the days of your siege come to an end, burn a third of the hair inside the city. Take a third and strike it with the sword all around the city. And scatter a third to the wind. For I will pursue them with drawn sword.
chapters.zh: 围困城的日子满了，你要将三分之一在城中用火焚烧，将三分之一在城的四围用刀砍碎，将三分之一任风吹散。我也要拔刀追赶。

chapters.en: But take a few hairs and tuck them away in the folds of your garment.
chapters.zh: 你要从其中取几根包在衣襟里，

chapters.en: Again, take a few of these and throw them into the fire and burn them up. A fire will spread from there to all Israel.
chapters.zh: 再从这几根中取些扔在火中焚烧，从里面必有火出来烧入以色列全家。

chapters.en: “This is what the Sovereign LORD says: This is Jerusalem, which I have set in the center of the nations, with countries all around her.
chapters.zh: 主耶和华如此说，这就是耶路撒冷。我曾将她安置在列邦之中。列国都在她的四围。

chapters.en: Yet in her wickedness she has rebelled against my laws and decrees more than the nations and countries around her. She has rejected my laws and has not followed my decrees.
chapters.zh: 她行恶，违背我的典章，过于列国。干犯我的律例，过于四围的列邦，因为她弃掉我的典章。至于我的律例，她并没有遵行。

chapters.en: “Therefore this is what the Sovereign LORD says: You have been more unruly than the nations around you and have not followed my decrees or kept my laws. You have not even conformed to the standards of the nations around you.
chapters.zh: 所以主耶和华如此说，因为你们纷争过于四围的列国，也不遵行我的律例，不谨守我的典章，并以遵从四围列国的恶规尚不满意，

chapters.en: “Therefore this is what the Sovereign LORD says: I myself am against you, Jerusalem, and I will inflict punishment on you in the sight of the nations.
chapters.zh: 所以主耶和华如此说，看哪，我与你反对，必在列国的眼前，在你中间，施行审判。

chapters.en: Because of all your detestable idols, I will do to you what I have never done before and will never do again.
chapters.zh: 并且因你一切可憎的事，我要在你中间行我所未曾行的，以后我也不再照着行。

chapters.en: Therefore in your midst parents will eat their children, and children will eat their parents. I will inflict punishment on you and will scatter all your survivors to the winds.
chapters.zh: 在你中间父亲要吃儿子，儿子要吃父亲。我必向你施行审判，我必将你所剩下的分散四方（方原文作风）。

chapters.en: Therefore as surely as I live, declares the Sovereign LORD, because you have defiled my sanctuary with all your vile images and detestable practices, I myself will shave you; I will not look on you with pity or spare you.
chapters.zh: 主耶和华说，我指着我的永生起誓，因你用一切可憎的物，可厌的事玷污了我的圣所，故此，我定要使你人数减少，我眼必不顾惜你，也不可怜你。

chapters.en: A third of your people will die of the plague or perish by famine inside you; a third will fall by the sword outside your walls; and a third I will scatter to the winds and pursue with drawn sword.
chapters.zh: 你的民三分之一必遭瘟疫而死，在你中间必因饥荒消灭。三分之一必在你四围倒在刀下。我必将三分之一分散四方（方原文作风），并要拔刀追赶他们。

chapters.en: “Then my anger will cease and my wrath against them will subside, and I will be avenged. And when I have spent my wrath on them, they will know that I the LORD have spoken in my zeal.
chapters.zh: 我要这样成就怒中所定的。我向他们发的忿怒止息了，自己就得着安慰。我在他们身上成就怒中所定的那时，他们就知道我耶和华所说的是出于热心。

chapters.en: “I will make you a ruin and a reproach among the nations around you, in the sight of all who pass by.
chapters.zh: 并且我必使你在四围的列国中，在经过的众人眼前，成了荒凉和羞辱。

chapters.en: You will be a reproach and a taunt, a warning and an object of horror to the nations around you when I inflict punishment on you in anger and in wrath and with stinging rebuke. I the LORD have spoken.
chapters.zh: 这样，我必以怒气和忿怒，并烈怒的责备，向你施行审判。那时，你就在四围的列国中成为羞辱，讥刺，警戒，惊骇。这是我耶和华说的。

chapters.en: When I shoot at you with my deadly and destructive arrows of famine, I will shoot to destroy you. I will bring more and more famine upon you and cut off your supply of food.
chapters.zh: 那时，我要将灭人，使人饥荒的恶箭，就是射去灭人的，射在你们身上，并要加增你们的饥荒，断绝你们所倚靠的粮食。

chapters.en: I will send famine and wild beasts against you, and they will leave you childless. Plague and bloodshed will sweep through you, and I will bring the sword against you. I the LORD have spoken.”
chapters.zh: 又要使饥荒和恶兽到你那里，叫你丧子，瘟疫和流血的事也必盛行在你那里。我也要使刀剑临到你。这是我耶和华说的。

chapters.en: The word of the LORD came to me:
chapters.zh: 耶和华的话临到我说，

chapters.en: “Son of man, set your face against the mountains of Israel; prophesy against them
chapters.zh: 人子阿，你要面向以色列的众山说预言，

chapters.en: and say: ‘You mountains of Israel, hear the word of the Sovereign LORD. This is what the Sovereign LORD says to the mountains and hills, to the ravines and valleys: I am about to bring a sword against you, and I will destroy your high places.
chapters.zh: 说，以色列的众山哪，要听主耶和华的话。主耶和华对大山，小冈，水沟，山谷如此说，我必使刀剑临到你们，也必毁灭你们的丘坛。

chapters.en: Your altars will be demolished and your incense altars will be smashed; and I will slay your people in front of your idols.
chapters.zh: 你们的祭坛必然荒凉，你们的日像必被打碎。我要使你们被杀的人倒在你们的偶像面前。

chapters.en: I will lay the dead bodies of the Israelites in front of their idols, and I will scatter your bones around your altars.
chapters.zh: 我也要将以色列人的尸首放在他们的偶像面前，将你们的骸骨抛散在你们祭坛的四围。

chapters.en: Wherever you live, the towns will be laid waste and the high places demolished, so that your altars will be laid waste and devastated, your idols smashed and ruined, your incense altars broken down, and what you have made wiped out.
chapters.zh: 在你们一切的住处，城邑要变为荒场，丘坛必然凄凉，使你们的祭坛荒废，将你们的偶像打碎。你们的日像被砍倒，你们的工作被毁灭。

chapters.en: Your people will fall slain among you, and you will know that I am the LORD.
chapters.zh: 被杀的人必倒在你们中间，你们就知道我是耶和华。

chapters.en: “ ‘But I will spare some, for some of you will escape the sword when you are scattered among the lands and nations.
chapters.zh: 你们分散在各国的时候，我必在列邦中使你们有剩下脱离刀剑的人。

chapters.en: Then in the nations where they have been carried captive, those who escape will remember me—how I have been grieved by their adulterous hearts, which have turned away from me, and by their eyes, which have lusted after their idols. They will loathe themselves for the evil they have done and for all their detestable practices.
chapters.zh: 那脱离刀剑的人必在所掳到的各国中记念我，为他们心中何等伤破，是因他们起淫心，远离我，眼对偶像行邪淫。他们因行一切可憎的恶事，必厌恶自己。

chapters.en: And they will know that I am the LORD; I did not threaten in vain to bring this calamity on them.
chapters.zh: 他们必知道我是耶和华。我说要使这灾祸临到他们身上，并非空话。

chapters.en: “ ‘This is what the Sovereign LORD says: Strike your hands together and stamp your feet and cry out “Alas!” because of all the wicked and detestable practices of the people of Israel, for they will fall by the sword, famine and plague.
chapters.zh: 主耶和华如此说，你当拍手顿足，说，哀哉。以色列家行这一切可憎的恶事，他们必倒在刀剑，饥荒，瘟疫之下。

chapters.en: One who is far away will die of the plague, and one who is near will fall by the sword, and anyone who survives and is spared will die of famine. So will I pour out my wrath on them.
chapters.zh: 在远处的，必遭瘟疫而死。在近处的，必倒在刀剑之下。那存留被围困的，必因饥荒而死。我必这样在他们身上成就我怒中所定的。

chapters.en: And they will know that I am the LORD, when their people lie slain among their idols around their altars, on every high hill and on all the mountaintops, under every spreading tree and every leafy oak—places where they offered fragrant incense to all their idols.
chapters.zh: 他们被杀的人，倒在他们祭坛四围的偶像中，就是各高冈，各山顶，各青翠树下，各茂密的橡树下，乃是他们献馨香的祭牲给一切偶像的地方。那时，他们就知道我是耶和华。

chapters.en: And I will stretch out my hand against them and make the land a desolate waste from the desert to Diblah —wherever they live. Then they will know that I am the LORD.’ ”
chapters.zh: 我必伸手攻击他们，使他们的地从旷野到第伯拉他一切住处极其荒凉，他们就知道我是耶和华

chapters.en: The word of the LORD came to me:
chapters.zh: 耶和华的话又临到我说，

chapters.en: “Son of man, this is what the Sovereign LORD says to the land of Israel: “ ‘The end! The end has come upon the four corners of the land!
chapters.zh: 人子阿，主耶和华对以色列地如此说，结局到了，结局到了地的四境。

chapters.en: The end is now upon you, and I will unleash my anger against you. I will judge you according to your conduct and repay you for all your detestable practices.
chapters.zh: 现在你的结局已经临到，我必使我的怒气归与你，也必按你的行为审判你，照你一切可憎的事刑罚你。

chapters.en: I will not look on you with pity; I will not spare you. I will surely repay you for your conduct and for the detestable practices among you. “ ‘Then you will know that I am the LORD.’
chapters.zh: 我眼必不顾惜你，也不可怜你，却要按你所行的报应你，照你中间可憎的事刑罚你。你就知道我是耶和华。

chapters.en: “This is what the Sovereign LORD says: “ ‘Disaster! Unheard-of disaster! See, it comes!
chapters.zh: 主耶和华如此说，有一灾，独有一灾。看哪，临近了。

chapters.en: The end has come! The end has come! It has roused itself against you. See, it comes!
chapters.zh: 结局来了，结局来了，向你兴起。看哪，来到了。

chapters.en: Doom has come upon you, upon you who dwell in the land. The time has come! The day is near! There is panic, not joy, on the mountains.
chapters.zh: 境内的居民哪，所定的灾临到你，时候到了，日子近了，乃是哄嚷并非在山上欢呼的日子。

chapters.en: I am about to pour out my wrath on you and spend my anger against you. I will judge you according to your conduct and repay you for all your detestable practices.
chapters.zh: 我快要将我的忿怒倾在你身上，向你成就我怒中所定的，按你的行为审判你，照你一切可憎的事刑罚你。

chapters.en: I will not look on you with pity; I will not spare you. I will repay you for your conduct and for the detestable practices among you. “ ‘Then you will know that it is I the LORD who strikes you.
chapters.zh: 我眼必不顾惜你，也不可怜你，必按你所行的报应你，照你中间可憎的事刑罚你。你就知道击打你的是我耶和华。

chapters.en: “ ‘See, the day! See, it comes! Doom has burst forth, the rod has budded, arrogance has blossomed!
chapters.zh: 看哪，看哪，日子快到了，所定的灾已经发出。杖已经开花，骄傲已经发芽。

chapters.en: Violence has arisen,a rod to punish the wicked. None of the people will be left, none of that crowd— none of their wealth, nothing of value.
chapters.zh: 强暴兴起，成了罚恶的杖。以色列人，或是他们的群众，或是他们的财宝，无一存留，他们中间也没有得尊荣的。

chapters.en: The time has come! The day has arrived! Let not the buyer rejoice nor the seller grieve, for my wrath is on the whole crowd.
chapters.zh: 时候到了，日子近了，买主不可欢喜，卖主不可愁烦，因为烈怒已经临到他们众人身上。

chapters.en: The seller will not recover the property that was sold— as long as both buyer and seller live. For the vision concerning the whole crowd will not be reversed. Because of their sins, not one of them will preserve their life.
chapters.zh: 卖主虽然存活，却不能归回再得所卖的，因为这异象关乎他们众人。谁都不得归回，也没有人在他的罪孽中坚立自己。

chapters.en: “ ‘They have blown the trumpet, they have made all things ready, but no one will go into battle, for my wrath is on the whole crowd.
chapters.zh: 他们已经吹角，预备齐全，却无一人出战，因为我的烈怒临到他们众人身上。

chapters.en: Outside is the sword; inside are plague and famine. Those in the country will die by the sword; those in the city will be devoured by famine and plague.
chapters.zh: 在外有刀剑，在内有瘟疫，饥荒。在田野的，必遭刀剑而死。在城中的，必有饥荒，瘟疫吞灭他。

chapters.en: The fugitives who escape will flee to the mountains. Like doves of the valleys, they will all moan, each for their own sins.
chapters.zh: 其中所逃脱的就必逃脱，各人因自己的罪孽在山上发出悲声，好像谷中的鸽子哀鸣。

chapters.en: Every hand will go limp; every leg will be wet with urine.
chapters.zh: 手都发软，膝弱如水。

chapters.en: They will put on sackcloth and be clothed with terror. Every face will be covered with shame, and every head will be shaved.
chapters.zh: 要用麻布束腰，被战兢所盖。各人脸上羞愧，头上光秃。

chapters.en: “ ‘They will throw their silver into the streets, and their gold will be treated as a thing unclean. Their silver and gold will not be able to deliver them in the day of the LORD’s wrath. It will not satisfy their hunger or fill their stomachs, for it has caused them to stumble into sin.
chapters.zh: 他们要将银子抛在街上，金子看如污秽之物。当耶和华发怒的日子，他们的金银不能救他们，不能使心里知足，也不能使肚腹饱满，因为这金银作了他们罪孽的绊脚石。

chapters.en: They took pride in their beautiful jewelry and used it to make their detestable idols. They made it into vile images; therefore I will make it a thing unclean for them.
chapters.zh: 论到耶和华妆饰华美的殿，他建立得威严，他们却在其中制造可憎可厌的偶像，所以这殿我使他们看如污秽之物。

chapters.en: I will give their wealth as plunder to foreigners and as loot to the wicked of the earth, who will defile it.
chapters.zh: 我必将这殿交付外邦人为掠物，交付地上的恶人为掳物。他们也必亵渎这殿。

chapters.en: I will turn my face away from the people, and robbers will desecrate the place I treasure. They will enter it and will defile it.
chapters.zh: 我必转脸不顾以色列人，他们亵渎我隐密之所，强盗也必进去亵渎。

chapters.en: “ ‘Prepare chains! For the land is full of bloodshed, and the city is full of violence.
chapters.zh: 要制造锁链。因为这地遍满流血的罪，城邑充满强暴的事，

chapters.en: I will bring the most wicked of nations to take possession of their houses. I will put an end to the pride of the mighty, and their sanctuaries will be desecrated.
chapters.zh: 所以我必使列国中最恶的人来占据他们的房屋。我必使强暴人的骄傲止息，他们的圣所都要被亵渎。

chapters.en: When terror comes, they will seek peace in vain.
chapters.zh: 毁灭临近了，他们要求平安，却无平安可得。

chapters.en: Calamity upon calamity will come, and rumor upon rumor. They will go searching for a vision from the prophet, priestly instruction in the law will cease, the counsel of the elders will come to an end.
chapters.zh: 灾害加上灾害，风声接连风声。他们必向先知求异象，但祭司讲的律法，长老设的谋略都必断绝。

chapters.en: The king will mourn, the prince will be clothed with despair, and the hands of the people of the land will tremble. I will deal with them according to their conduct, and by their own standards I will judge them. “ ‘Then they will know that I am the LORD.’ ”
chapters.zh: 君要悲哀，王要披凄凉为衣，国民的手都发颤。我必照他们的行为待他们，按他们应得的审判他们，他们就知道我是耶和华。

chapters.en: In the sixth year, in the sixth month on the fifth day, while I was sitting in my house and the elders of Judah were sitting before me, the hand of the Sovereign LORD came on me there.
chapters.zh: 第六年六月初五日，我坐在家中。犹大的众长老坐在我面前。在那里主耶和华的灵（原文作手）降在我身上。

chapters.en: I looked, and I saw a figure like that of a man. From what appeared to be his waist down he was like fire, and from there up his appearance was as bright as glowing metal.
chapters.zh: 我观看，见有形像仿佛火的形状，从他腰以下的形状有火，从他腰以上有光辉的形状，仿佛光耀的精金。

chapters.en: He stretched out what looked like a hand and took me by the hair of my head. The Spirit lifted me up between earth and heaven and in visions of God he took me to Jerusalem, to the entrance of the north gate of the inner court, where the idol that provokes to jealousy stood.
chapters.zh: 他伸出仿佛一只手的样式，抓住我的一绺头发，灵就将我举到天地中间，在神的异象中，带我到耶路撒冷朝北的内院门口，在那里有触动主怒偶像的坐位，就是惹动忌邪的。

chapters.en: And there before me was the glory of the God of Israel, as in the vision I had seen in the plain.
chapters.zh: 谁知，在那里有以色列神的荣耀，形状与我在平原所见的一样。

chapters.en: Then he said to me, “Son of man, look toward the north.” So I looked, and in the entrance north of the gate of the altar I saw this idol of jealousy.
chapters.zh: 神对我说，人子阿，你举目向北观看。我就举目向北观看，见祭坛门的北边在门口有这惹忌邪的偶像。

chapters.en: And he said to me, “Son of man, do you see what they are doing—the utterly detestable things the Israelites are doing here, things that will drive me far from my sanctuary? But you will see things that are even more detestable.”
chapters.zh: 又对我说，人子阿，以色列家所行的，就是在此行这大可憎的事，使我远离我的圣所，你看见了吗？你还要看见另有大可憎的事。

chapters.en: Then he brought me to the entrance to the court. I looked, and I saw a hole in the wall.
chapters.zh: 他领我到院门口。我观看，见墙上有个窟窿。

chapters.en: He said to me, “Son of man, now dig into the wall.” So I dug into the wall and saw a doorway there.
chapters.zh: 他对我说，人子阿，你要挖墙。我一挖墙，见有一门。

chapters.en: And he said to me, “Go in and see the wicked and detestable things they are doing here.”
chapters.zh: 他说，你进去，看他们在这里所行可憎的恶事。

chapters.en: So I went in and looked, and I saw portrayed all over the walls all kinds of crawling things and unclean animals and all the idols of Israel.
chapters.zh: 我进去一看，谁知，在四面墙上画着各样爬物和可憎的走兽，并以色列家一切的偶像。

chapters.en: In front of them stood seventy elders of Israel, and Jaazaniah son of Shaphan was standing among them. Each had a censer in his hand, and a fragrant cloud of incense was rising.
chapters.zh: 在这些像前有以色列家的七十个长老站立，沙番的儿子雅撒尼亚也站在其中。各人手拿香炉，烟云的香气上腾。

chapters.en: He said to me, “Son of man, have you seen what the elders of Israel are doing in the darkness, each at the shrine of his own idol? They say, ‘The LORD does not see us; the LORD has forsaken the land.’ ”
chapters.zh: 他对我说，人子阿，以色列家的长老暗中在各人画像屋里所行的，你看见了吗？他们常说，耶和华看不见我们。耶和华已经离弃这地。

chapters.en: Again, he said, “You will see them doing things that are even more detestable.”
chapters.zh: 他又说，你还要看见他们另外行大可憎的事。

chapters.en: Then he brought me to the entrance of the north gate of the house of the LORD, and I saw women sitting there, mourning the god Tammuz.
chapters.zh: 他领我到耶和华殿外院朝北的门口。谁知，在那里有妇女坐着，为搭模斯哭泣。

chapters.en: He said to me, “Do you see this, son of man? You will see things that are even more detestable than this.”
chapters.zh: 他对我说，人子阿，你看见了吗？你还要看见比这更可憎的事。

chapters.en: He then brought me into the inner court of the house of the LORD, and there at the entrance to the temple, between the portico and the altar, were about twenty-five men. With their backs toward the temple of the LORD and their faces toward the east, they were bowing down to the sun in the east.
chapters.zh: 他又领我到耶和华殿的内院。谁知，在耶和华的殿门口，廊子和祭坛中间，约有二十五个人背向耶和华的殿，面向东方拜日头。

chapters.en: He said to me, “Have you seen this, son of man? Is it a trivial matter for the people of Judah to do the detestable things they are doing here? Must they also fill the land with violence and continually arouse my anger? Look at them putting the branch to their nose!
chapters.zh: 他对我说，人子阿，你看见了吗？犹大家在此行这可憎的事还算为小吗？他们在这地遍行强暴，再三惹我发怒，他们手拿枝条举向鼻前。

chapters.en: Therefore I will deal with them in anger; I will not look on them with pity or spare them. Although they shout in my ears, I will not listen to them.”
chapters.zh: 因此，我也要以忿怒行事，我眼必不顾惜，也不可怜他们。他们虽向我耳中大声呼求，我还是不听。

chapters.en: Then I heard him call out in a loud voice, “Bring near those who are appointed to execute judgment on the city, each with a weapon in his hand.”
chapters.zh: 他向我耳中大声喊叫说，要使那监管这城的人手中各拿灭命的兵器前来。

chapters.en: And I saw six men coming from the direction of the upper gate, which faces north, each with a deadly weapon in his hand. With them was a man clothed in linen who had a writing kit at his side. They came in and stood beside the bronze altar.
chapters.zh: 忽然有六个人从朝北的上门而来，各人手拿杀人的兵器。内中有一人身穿细麻衣，腰间带着墨盒子。他们进来，站在铜祭坛旁。

chapters.en: Now the glory of the God of Israel went up from above the cherubim, where it had been, and moved to the threshold of the temple. Then the LORD called to the man clothed in linen who had the writing kit at his side
chapters.zh: 以色列神的荣耀本在基路伯上，现今从那里升到殿的门槛。神将那身穿细麻衣，腰间带着墨盒子的人召来。

chapters.en: and said to him, “Go throughout the city of Jerusalem and put a mark on the foreheads of those who grieve and lament over all the detestable things that are done in it.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华对他说，你去走遍耶路撒冷全城，那些因城中所行可憎之事叹息哀哭的人，画记号在额上。

chapters.en: As I listened, he said to the others, “Follow him through the city and kill, without showing pity or compassion.
chapters.zh: 我耳中听见他对其余的人说，要跟随他走遍全城，以行击杀。你们的眼不要顾惜，也不要可怜他们。

chapters.en: Slaughter the old men, the young men and women, the mothers and children, but do not touch anyone who has the mark. Begin at my sanctuary.” So they began with the old men who were in front of the temple.
chapters.zh: 要将年老的，年少的，并处女，婴孩，和妇女，从圣所起全都杀尽，只是凡有记号的人不要挨近他。于是他们从殿前的长老杀起。

chapters.en: Then he said to them, “Defile the temple and fill the courts with the slain. Go!” So they went out and began killing throughout the city.
chapters.zh: 他对他们说，要污秽这殿，使院中充满被杀的人。你们出去吧。他们就出去，在城中击杀。

chapters.en: While they were killing and I was left alone, I fell facedown, crying out, “Alas, Sovereign LORD! Are you going to destroy the entire remnant of Israel in this outpouring of your wrath on Jerusalem?”
chapters.zh: 他们击杀的时候，我被留下，我就俯伏在地，说，哎。主耶和华阿，你将忿怒倾在耶路撒冷，岂要将以色列所剩下的人都灭绝吗？

chapters.en: He answered me, “The sin of the people of Israel and Judah is exceedingly great; the land is full of bloodshed and the city is full of injustice. They say, ‘The LORD has forsaken the land; the LORD does not see.’
chapters.zh: 他对我说，以色列家和犹大家的罪孽极其重大。遍地有流血的事，满城有冤屈，因为他们说，耶和华已经离弃这地，他看不见我们。

chapters.en: So I will not look on them with pity or spare them, but I will bring down on their own heads what they have done.”
chapters.zh: 故此，我眼必不顾惜，也不可怜他们，要照他们所行的报应在他们头上。

chapters.en: Then the man in linen with the writing kit at his side brought back word, saying, “I have done as you commanded.”
chapters.zh: 那穿细麻衣，腰间带着墨盒子的人将这事回覆说，我已经照你所吩咐的行了。

chapters.en: I looked, and I saw the likeness of a throne of lapis lazuli above the vault that was over the heads of the cherubim.
chapters.zh: 我观看，见基路伯头上的穹苍之中，显出蓝宝石的形状，仿佛宝座的形像。

chapters.en: The LORD said to the man clothed in linen, “Go in among the wheels beneath the cherubim. Fill your hands with burning coals from among the cherubim and scatter them over the city.” And as I watched, he went in.
chapters.zh: 主对那穿细麻衣的人说，你进去，在旋转的轮内基路伯以下，从基路伯中间将火炭取满两手，撒在城上。我就见他进去。

chapters.en: Now the cherubim were standing on the south side of the temple when the man went in, and a cloud filled the inner court.
chapters.zh: 那人进去的时候，基路伯站在殿的右边，云彩充满了内院。

chapters.en: Then the glory of the LORD rose from above the cherubim and moved to the threshold of the temple. The cloud filled the temple, and the court was full of the radiance of the glory of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 耶和华的荣耀从基路伯那里上升，停在门槛以上。殿内满了云彩，院宇也被耶和华荣耀的光辉充满。

chapters.en: The sound of the wings of the cherubim could be heard as far away as the outer court, like the voice of God Almighty when he speaks.
chapters.zh: 基路伯翅膀的响声听到外院，好像全能神说话的声音。

chapters.en: When the LORD commanded the man in linen, “Take fire from among the wheels, from among the cherubim,” the man went in and stood beside a wheel.
chapters.zh: 他吩咐那穿细麻衣的人说，要从旋转的轮内基路伯中间取火。那人就进去站在一个轮子旁边。

chapters.en: Then one of the cherubim reached out his hand to the fire that was among them. He took up some of it and put it into the hands of the man in linen, who took it and went out.
chapters.zh: 有一个基路伯从基路伯中伸手到基路伯中间的火那里，取些放在那穿细麻衣的人两手中，那人就拿出去了。

chapters.en: (Under the wings of the cherubim could be seen what looked like human hands.)
chapters.zh: 在基路伯翅膀之下，显出有人手的样式。

chapters.en: I looked, and I saw beside the cherubim four wheels, one beside each of the cherubim; the wheels sparkled like topaz.
chapters.zh: 我又观看，见基路伯旁边有四个轮子。这基路伯旁有一个轮子，那基路伯旁有一个轮子，每基路伯都是如此。轮子的颜色（原文作形状）仿佛水苍玉。

chapters.en: As for their appearance, the four of them looked alike; each was like a wheel intersecting a wheel.
chapters.zh: 至于四轮的形状，都是一个样式，仿佛轮中套轮。

chapters.en: As they moved, they would go in any one of the four directions the cherubim faced; the wheels did not turn about as the cherubim went. The cherubim went in whatever direction the head faced, without turning as they went.
chapters.zh: 轮行走的时候，向四方都能直行，并不掉转。头向何方，他们也随向何方，行走的时候并不掉转。

chapters.en: Their entire bodies, including their backs, their hands and their wings, were completely full of eyes, as were their four wheels.
chapters.zh: 他们全身，连背带手和翅膀，并轮周围都满了眼睛。这四个基路伯的轮子都是如此。

chapters.en: I heard the wheels being called “the whirling wheels.”
chapters.zh: 至于这些轮子，我耳中听见说是旋转的。

chapters.en: Each of the cherubim had four faces: One face was that of a cherub, the second the face of a human being, the third the face of a lion, and the fourth the face of an eagle.
chapters.zh: 基路伯各有四脸，第一是基路伯的脸，第二是人的脸，第三是狮子的脸，第四是鹰的脸。

chapters.en: Then the cherubim rose upward. These were the living creatures I had seen by the Kebar River.
chapters.zh: 基路伯升上去了。这是我在迦巴鲁河边所见的活物。

chapters.en: When the cherubim moved, the wheels beside them moved; and when the cherubim spread their wings to rise from the ground, the wheels did not leave their side.
chapters.zh: 基路伯行走，轮也在旁边行走。基路伯展开翅膀，离地上升，轮也不转离他们旁边。

chapters.en: When the cherubim stood still, they also stood still; and when the cherubim rose, they rose with them, because the spirit of the living creatures was in them.
chapters.zh: 那些站住，这些也站住。那些上升，这些也一同上升，因为活物的灵在轮中。

chapters.en: Then the glory of the LORD departed from over the threshold of the temple and stopped above the cherubim.
chapters.zh: 耶和华的荣耀从殿的门槛那里出去，停在基路伯以上。

chapters.en: While I watched, the cherubim spread their wings and rose from the ground, and as they went, the wheels went with them. They stopped at the entrance of the east gate of the LORD’s house, and the glory of the God of Israel was above them.
chapters.zh: 基路伯出去的时候，就展开翅膀，在我眼前离地上升。轮也在他们的旁边，都停在耶和华殿的东门口。在他们以上有以色列神的荣耀。

chapters.en: These were the living creatures I had seen beneath the God of Israel by the Kebar River, and I realized that they were cherubim.
chapters.zh: 这是我在迦巴鲁河边所见，以色列神荣耀以下的活物，我就知道他们是基路伯。

chapters.en: Each had four faces and four wings, and under their wings was what looked like human hands.
chapters.zh: 各有四个脸面，四个翅膀，翅膀以下有人手的样式。

chapters.en: Their faces had the same appearance as those I had seen by the Kebar River. Each one went straight ahead.
chapters.zh: 至于他们脸的模样，并身体的形像，是我从前在迦巴鲁河边所看见的。他们俱各直往前行。

chapters.en: Then the Spirit lifted me up and brought me to the gate of the house of the LORD that faces east. There at the entrance of the gate were twenty-five men, and I saw among them Jaazaniah son of Azzur and Pelatiah son of Benaiah, leaders of the people.
chapters.zh: 灵将我举起，带到耶和华殿向东的东门。谁知，在门口有二十五个人，我见其中有民间的首领押朔的儿子雅撒尼亚和比拿雅的儿子毗拉提。

chapters.en: The LORD said to me, “Son of man, these are the men who are plotting evil and giving wicked advice in this city.
chapters.zh: 耶和华对我说，人子阿，这就是图谋罪孽的人，在这城中给人设恶谋。

chapters.en: They say, ‘Haven’t our houses been recently rebuilt? This city is a pot, and we are the meat in it.’
chapters.zh: 他们说，盖房屋的时候尚未临近。这城是锅，我们是肉。

chapters.en: Therefore prophesy against them; prophesy, son of man.”
chapters.zh: 人子阿，因此你当说预言，说预言攻击他们。

chapters.en: Then the Spirit of the LORD came on me, and he told me to say: “This is what the LORD says: That is what you are saying, you leaders in Israel, but I know what is going through your mind.
chapters.zh: 耶和华的灵降在我身上，对我说，你当说，耶和华如此说，以色列家阿，你们口中所说的，心里所想的，我都知道。

chapters.en: You have killed many people in this city and filled its streets with the dead.
chapters.zh: 你们在这城中杀人增多，使被杀的人充满街道。

chapters.en: “Therefore this is what the Sovereign LORD says: The bodies you have thrown there are the meat and this city is the pot, but I will drive you out of it.
chapters.zh: 所以主耶和华如此说，你们杀在城中的人就是肉，这城就是锅。你们却要从其中被带出去。

chapters.en: You fear the sword, and the sword is what I will bring against you, declares the Sovereign LORD.
chapters.zh: 你们怕刀剑，我必使刀剑临到你们。这是主耶和华说的。

chapters.en: I will drive you out of the city and deliver you into the hands of foreigners and inflict punishment on you.
chapters.zh: 我必从这城中带出你们去，交在外邦人的手中，且要在你们中间施行审判。

chapters.en: You will fall by the sword, and I will execute judgment on you at the borders of Israel. Then you will know that I am the LORD.
chapters.zh: 你们必倒在刀下。我必在以色列的境界审判你们，你们就知道我是耶和华。

chapters.en: This city will not be a pot for you, nor will you be the meat in it; I will execute judgment on you at the borders of Israel.
chapters.zh: 这城必不作你们的锅，你们也不作其中的肉。我必在以色列的境界审判你们，

chapters.en: And you will know that I am the LORD, for you have not followed my decrees or kept my laws but have conformed to the standards of the nations around you.”
chapters.zh: 你们就知道我是耶和华。因为你们没有遵行我的律例，也没有顺从我的典章，却随从你们四围列国的恶规。

chapters.en: Now as I was prophesying, Pelatiah son of Benaiah died. Then I fell facedown and cried out in a loud voice, “Alas, Sovereign LORD! Will you completely destroy the remnant of Israel?”
chapters.zh: 我正说预言的时候，比拿雅的儿子毗拉提死了。于是我俯伏在地，大声呼叫说，哎。主耶和华阿，你要将以色列剩下的人灭绝净尽吗？

chapters.en: The word of the LORD came to me:
chapters.zh: 耶和华的话临到我说，

chapters.en: “Son of man, the people of Jerusalem have said of your fellow exiles and all the other Israelites, ‘They are far away from the LORD; this land was given to us as our possession.’
chapters.zh: 人子阿，耶路撒冷的居民对你的弟兄，你的本族，你的亲属，以色列全家，就是对大众说，你们远离耶和华吧。这地是赐给我们为业的。

chapters.en: “Therefore say: ‘This is what the Sovereign LORD says: Although I sent them far away among the nations and scattered them among the countries, yet for a little while I have been a sanctuary for them in the countries where they have gone.’
chapters.zh: 所以你当说，耶和华如此说，我虽将以色列全家远远迁移到列国中，将他们分散在列邦内，我还要在他们所到的列邦，暂作他们的圣所。

chapters.en: “Therefore say: ‘This is what the Sovereign LORD says: I will gather you from the nations and bring you back from the countries where you have been scattered, and I will give you back the land of Israel again.’
chapters.zh: 你当说，主耶和华如此说，我必从万民中招聚你们，从分散的列国内聚集你们，又要将以色列地赐给你们。

chapters.en: “They will return to it and remove all its vile images and detestable idols.
chapters.zh: 他们必到那里，也必从其中除掉一切可憎可厌的物。

chapters.en: I will give them an undivided heart and put a new spirit in them; I will remove from them their heart of stone and give them a heart of flesh.
chapters.zh: 我要使他们有合一的心，也要将新灵放在他们里面，又从他们肉体中除掉石心，赐给他们肉心，

chapters.en: Then they will follow my decrees and be careful to keep my laws. They will be my people, and I will be their God.
chapters.zh: 使他们顺从我的律例，谨守遵行我的典章。他们要作我的子民，我要作他们的神。

chapters.en: But as for those whose hearts are devoted to their vile images and detestable idols, I will bring down on their own heads what they have done, declares the Sovereign LORD.”
chapters.zh: 至于那些心中随从可憎可厌之物的，我必照他们所行的报应在他们头上。这是主耶和华说的。

chapters.en: Then the cherubim, with the wheels beside them, spread their wings, and the glory of the God of Israel was above them.
chapters.zh: 于是，基路伯展开翅膀，轮子都在他们旁边。在他们以上有以色列神的荣耀。

chapters.en: The glory of the LORD went up from within the city and stopped above the mountain east of it.
chapters.zh: 耶和华的荣耀从城中上升，停在城东的那座山上。

chapters.en: The Spirit lifted me up and brought me to the exiles in Babylonia in the vision given by the Spirit of God. Then the vision I had seen went up from me,
chapters.zh: 灵将我举起，在异象中借着神的灵将我带进迦勒底地，到被掳的人那里。我所见的异象就离我上升去了。

chapters.en: and I told the exiles everything the LORD had shown me.
chapters.zh: 我便将耶和华所指示我的一切事都说给被掳的人听。

chapters.en: The word of the LORD came to me:
chapters.zh: 耶和华的话又临到我说，

chapters.en: “Son of man, you are living among a rebellious people. They have eyes to see but do not see and ears to hear but do not hear, for they are a rebellious people.
chapters.zh: 人子阿，你住在悖逆的家中。他们有眼睛看不见，有耳朵听不见，因为他们是悖逆之家。

chapters.en: “Therefore, son of man, pack your belongings for exile and in the daytime, as they watch, set out and go from where you are to another place. Perhaps they will understand, though they are a rebellious people.
chapters.zh: 所以人子阿，你要预备掳去使用的物件，在白日当他们眼前从你所住的地方移到别处去。他们虽是悖逆之家，或者可以揣摩思想。

chapters.en: During the daytime, while they watch, bring out your belongings packed for exile. Then in the evening, while they are watching, go out like those who go into exile.
chapters.zh: 你要在白日当他们眼前带出你的物件去，好像预备掳去使用的物件。到了晚上，你要在他们眼前亲自出去，像被掳的人出去一样。

chapters.en: While they watch, dig through the wall and take your belongings out through it.
chapters.zh: 你要在他们眼前挖通了墙，从其中将物件带出去。

chapters.en: Put them on your shoulder as they are watching and carry them out at dusk. Cover your face so that you cannot see the land, for I have made you a sign to the Israelites.”
chapters.zh: 到天黑时，你要当他们眼前搭在肩头上带出去，并要蒙住脸看不见地，因为我立你作以色列家的预兆。

chapters.en: So I did as I was commanded. During the day I brought out my things packed for exile. Then in the evening I dug through the wall with my hands. I took my belongings out at dusk, carrying them on my shoulders while they watched.
chapters.zh: 我就照着所吩咐的去行，白日带出我的物件，好像预备掳去使用的物件。到了晚上，我用手挖通了墙。天黑的时候，就当他们眼前搭在肩头上带出去。

chapters.en: In the morning the word of the LORD came to me:
chapters.zh: 次日早晨，耶和华的话临到我说，

chapters.en: “Son of man, did not the Israelites, that rebellious people, ask you, ‘What are you doing?’
chapters.zh: 人子阿，以色列家，就是那悖逆之家，岂不是问你说，你作什么呢？

chapters.en: “Say to them, ‘This is what the Sovereign LORD says: This prophecy concerns the prince in Jerusalem and all the Israelites who are there.’
chapters.zh: 你要对他们说，主耶和华如此说，这是关乎耶路撒冷的君王和他周围以色列全家的预表（原文作担子）。

chapters.en: Say to them, ‘I am a sign to you.’ “As I have done, so it will be done to them. They will go into exile as captives.
chapters.zh: 你要说，我作你们的预兆，我怎样行，他们所遭遇的也必怎样，他们必被掳去。

chapters.en: “The prince among them will put his things on his shoulder at dusk and leave, and a hole will be dug in the wall for him to go through. He will cover his face so that he cannot see the land.
chapters.zh: 他们中间的君王也必在天黑的时候将物件搭在肩头上带出去。他们要挖通了墙，从其中带出去。他必蒙住脸，眼看不见地。

chapters.en: I will spread my net for him, and he will be caught in my snare; I will bring him to Babylonia, the land of the Chaldeans, but he will not see it, and there he will die.
chapters.zh: 我必将我的网撒在他身上，他必在我的网罗中缠住。我必带他到迦勒底人之地的巴比伦。他虽死在那里，却看不见那地。

chapters.en: I will scatter to the winds all those around him—his staff and all his troops—and I will pursue them with drawn sword.
chapters.zh: 周围一切帮助他的和他所有的军队，我必分散四方（方原文作风），也要拔刀追赶他们。

chapters.en: “They will know that I am the LORD, when I disperse them among the nations and scatter them through the countries.
chapters.zh: 我将他们四散在列国，分散在列邦的时候，他们就知道我是耶和华。

chapters.en: But I will spare a few of them from the sword, famine and plague, so that in the nations where they go they may acknowledge all their detestable practices. Then they will know that I am the LORD.”
chapters.zh: 我却要留下他们几个人得免刀剑，饥荒，瘟疫，使他们在所到的各国中述说他们一切可憎的事，人就知道我是耶和华。

chapters.en: The word of the LORD came to me:
chapters.zh: 耶和华的话又临到我说，

chapters.en: “Son of man, tremble as you eat your food, and shudder in fear as you drink your water.
chapters.zh: 人子阿，你吃饭必胆战，喝水必惶惶忧虑。

chapters.en: Say to the people of the land: ‘This is what the Sovereign LORD says about those living in Jerusalem and in the land of Israel: They will eat their food in anxiety and drink their water in despair, for their land will be stripped of everything in it because of the violence of all who live there.
chapters.zh: 你要对这地的百姓说，主耶和华论耶路撒冷和以色列地的居民如此说，他们吃饭必忧虑，喝水必惊惶。因其中居住的众人所行强暴的事，这地必然荒废，一无所存。

chapters.en: The inhabited towns will be laid waste and the land will be desolate. Then you will know that I am the LORD.’ ”
chapters.zh: 有居民的城邑必变为荒场，地也必变为荒废。你们就知道我是耶和华。

chapters.en: The word of the LORD came to me:
chapters.zh: 耶和华的话临到我说，

chapters.en: “Son of man, what is this proverb you have in the land of Israel: ‘The days go by and every vision comes to nothing’?
chapters.zh: 人子阿，在你们以色列地怎么有这俗语，说日子迟延，一切异象都落了空呢？

chapters.en: Say to them, ‘This is what the Sovereign LORD says: I am going to put an end to this proverb, and they will no longer quote it in Israel.’ Say to them, ‘The days are near when every vision will be fulfilled.
chapters.zh: 你要告诉他们说，主耶和华如此说，我必使这俗语止息，以色列中不再用这俗语。你却要对他们说，日子临近，一切的异象必都应验。

chapters.en: For there will be no more false visions or flattering divinations among the people of Israel.
chapters.zh: 从此，在以色列家中必不再有虚假的异象和奉承的占卜。

chapters.en: But I the LORD will speak what I will, and it shall be fulfilled without delay. For in your days, you rebellious people, I will fulfill whatever I say, declares the Sovereign LORD.’ ”
chapters.zh: 我耶和华说话，所说的必定成就，不再耽延。你们这悖逆之家，我所说的话必趁你们在世的日子成就。这是主耶和华说的。

chapters.en: The word of the LORD came to me:
chapters.zh: 耶和华的话又临到我说，

chapters.en: “Son of man, the Israelites are saying, ‘The vision he sees is for many years from now, and he prophesies about the distant future.’
chapters.zh: 人子阿，以色列家的人说，他所见的异象是关乎后来许多的日子，所说的预言是指着极远的时候。

chapters.en: “Therefore say to them, ‘This is what the Sovereign LORD says: None of my words will be delayed any longer; whatever I say will be fulfilled, declares the Sovereign LORD.’ ”
chapters.zh: 所以你要对他们说，主耶和华如此说，我的话没有一句再耽延的，我所说的必定成就。这是主耶和华说的。

chapters.en: The word of the LORD came to me:
chapters.zh: 耶和华的话临到我说，

chapters.en: “Son of man, prophesy against the prophets of Israel who are now prophesying. Say to those who prophesy out of their own imagination: ‘Hear the word of the LORD!
chapters.zh: 人子阿，你要说预言攻击以色列中说预言的先知，对那些本己心发预言的说，你们当听耶和华的话。

chapters.en: This is what the Sovereign LORD says: Woe to the foolish prophets who follow their own spirit and have seen nothing!
chapters.zh: 主耶和华如此说，愚顽的先知有祸了，他们随从自己的心意，却一无所见。

chapters.en: Your prophets, Israel, are like jackals among ruins.
chapters.zh: 以色列阿，你的先知好像荒场中的狐狸，

chapters.en: You have not gone up to the breaches in the wall to repair it for the people of Israel so that it will stand firm in the battle on the day of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 没有上去堵挡破口，也没有为以色列家重修墙垣，使他们当耶和华的日子在阵上站立得住。

chapters.en: Their visions are false and their divinations a lie. Even though the LORD has not sent them, they say, “The LORD declares,” and expect him to fulfill their words.
chapters.zh: 这些人所见的是虚假，是谎诈的占卜。他们说是耶和华说的，其实耶和华并没有差遣他们，他们倒使人指望那话必然立定。

chapters.en: Have you not seen false visions and uttered lying divinations when you say, “The LORD declares,” though I have not spoken?
chapters.zh: 你们岂不是见了虚假的异象吗？岂不是说了谎诈的占卜吗？你们说，这是耶和华说的，其实我没有说。

chapters.en: “ ‘Therefore this is what the Sovereign LORD says: Because of your false words and lying visions, I am against you, declares the Sovereign LORD.
chapters.zh: 所以主耶和华如此说，因你们说的是虚假，见的是谎诈，我就与你们反对。这是主耶和华说的。

chapters.en: My hand will be against the prophets who see false visions and utter lying divinations. They will not belong to the council of my people or be listed in the records of Israel, nor will they enter the land of Israel. Then you will know that I am the Sovereign LORD.
chapters.zh: 我的手必攻击那见虚假异象，用谎诈占卜的先知，他们必不列在我百姓的会中，不录在以色列家的册上，也不进入以色列地。你们就知道我是主耶和华。

chapters.en: “ ‘Because they lead my people astray, saying, “Peace,” when there is no peace, and because, when a flimsy wall is built, they cover it with whitewash,
chapters.zh: 因为他们诱惑我的百姓，说，平安。其实没有平安，就像有人立起墙壁，他们倒用未泡透的灰抹上。

chapters.en: therefore tell those who cover it with whitewash that it is going to fall. Rain will come in torrents, and I will send hailstones hurtling down, and violent winds will burst forth.
chapters.zh: 所以你要对那些抹上未泡透灰的人说，墙要倒塌，必有暴雨漫过。大冰雹阿，你们要降下，狂风也要吹裂这墙。

chapters.en: When the wall collapses, will people not ask you, “Where is the whitewash you covered it with?”
chapters.zh: 这墙倒塌之后，人岂不问你们说，你们抹上未泡透的灰在哪里呢？

chapters.en: “ ‘Therefore this is what the Sovereign LORD says: In my wrath I will unleash a violent wind, and in my anger hailstones and torrents of rain will fall with destructive fury.
chapters.zh: 所以主耶和华如此说，我要发怒，使狂风吹裂这墙，在怒中使暴雨漫过，又发怒降下大冰雹，毁灭这墙。

chapters.en: I will tear down the wall you have covered with whitewash and will level it to the ground so that its foundation will be laid bare. When it falls, you will be destroyed in it; and you will know that I am the LORD.
chapters.zh: 我要这样拆毁你们那未泡透灰所抹的墙，拆平到地，以致根基露出，墙必倒塌，你们也必在其中灭亡。你们就知道我是耶和华。

chapters.en: So I will pour out my wrath against the wall and against those who covered it with whitewash. I will say to you, “The wall is gone and so are those who whitewashed it,
chapters.zh: 我要这样向墙和用未泡透灰抹墙的人成就我怒中所定的，并要对你们说，墙和抹墙的人都没有了。

chapters.en: those prophets of Israel who prophesied to Jerusalem and saw visions of peace for her when there was no peace, declares the Sovereign LORD.” ’
chapters.zh: 这抹墙的就是以色列的先知，他们指着耶路撒冷说预言，为这城见了平安的异象，其实没有平安。这是主耶和华说的。

chapters.en: “Now, son of man, set your face against the daughters of your people who prophesy out of their own imagination. Prophesy against them
chapters.zh: 人子阿，你要面向本民中，从己心发预言的女子说预言，攻击她们，

chapters.en: and say, ‘This is what the Sovereign LORD says: Woe to the women who sew magic charms on all their wrists and make veils of various lengths for their heads in order to ensnare people. Will you ensnare the lives of my people but preserve your own?
chapters.zh: 说主耶和华如此说，这些妇女有祸了。她们为众人的膀臂缝靠枕，给高矮之人作下垂的头巾，为要猎取人的性命。难道你们要猎取我百姓的性命，为利己将人救活吗？

chapters.en: You have profaned me among my people for a few handfuls of barley and scraps of bread. By lying to my people, who listen to lies, you have killed those who should not have died and have spared those who should not live.
chapters.zh: 你们为两把大麦，为几块饼，在我民中亵渎我，对肯听谎言的民说谎，杀死不该死的人，救活不该活的人。

chapters.en: “ ‘Therefore this is what the Sovereign LORD says: I am against your magic charms with which you ensnare people like birds and I will tear them from your arms; I will set free the people that you ensnare like birds.
chapters.zh: 所以主耶和华如此说，看哪，我与你们的靠枕反对，就是你们用以猎取人，使人的性命如鸟飞的。我要将靠枕从你们的膀臂上扯去，释放你们猎取如鸟飞的人。

chapters.en: I will tear off your veils and save my people from your hands, and they will no longer fall prey to your power. Then you will know that I am the LORD.
chapters.zh: 我也必撕裂你们下垂的头巾，救我百姓脱离你们的手，不再被猎取，落在你们手中。你们就知道我是耶和华。

chapters.en: Because you disheartened the righteous with your lies, when I had brought them no grief, and because you encouraged the wicked not to turn from their evil ways and so save their lives,
chapters.zh: 我不使义人伤心，你们却以谎话使他伤心，又坚固恶人的手，使他不回头离开恶道得以救活。

chapters.en: therefore you will no longer see false visions or practice divination. I will save my people from your hands. And then you will know that I am the LORD.’ ”
chapters.zh: 你们就不再见虚假的异象，也不再行占卜的事。我必救我的百姓脱离你们的手。你们就知道我是耶和华。

chapters.en: Some of the elders of Israel came to me and sat down in front of me.
chapters.zh: 有几个以色列长老到我这里来，坐在我面前。

chapters.en: Then the word of the LORD came to me:
chapters.zh: 耶和华的话就临到我说，

chapters.en: “Son of man, these men have set up idols in their hearts and put wicked stumbling blocks before their faces. Should I let them inquire of me at all?
chapters.zh: 人子阿，这些人已将他们的假神接到心里，把陷于罪的绊脚石放在面前，我岂能丝毫被他们求问吗？

chapters.en: Therefore speak to them and tell them, ‘This is what the Sovereign LORD says: When any of the Israelites set up idols in their hearts and put a wicked stumbling block before their faces and then go to a prophet, I the LORD will answer them myself in keeping with their great idolatry.
chapters.zh: 所以你要告诉他们，主耶和华如此说，以色列家的人中，凡将他的假神接到心里，把陷于罪的绊脚石放在面前，又就了先知来的，我耶和华在他所求的事上，必按他众多的假神回答他（或作必按他拜许多假神的罪报应他），

chapters.en: I will do this to recapture the hearts of the people of Israel, who have all deserted me for their idols.’
chapters.zh: 好在以色列家的心事上捉住他们，因为他们都借着假神与我生疏。

chapters.en: “Therefore say to the people of Israel, ‘This is what the Sovereign LORD says: Repent! Turn from your idols and renounce all your detestable practices!
chapters.zh: 所以你要告诉以色列家说，主耶和华如此说，回头吧。离开你们的偶像，转脸莫从你们一切可憎的事。

chapters.en: “ ‘When any of the Israelites or any foreigner residing in Israel separate themselves from me and set up idols in their hearts and put a wicked stumbling block before their faces and then go to a prophet to inquire of me, I the LORD will answer them myself.
chapters.zh: 因为以色列家的人，或在以色列中寄居的外人，凡与我隔绝，将他的假神接到心里，把陷于罪的绊脚石放在面前，又就了先知来要为自己的事求问我的，我耶和华必亲自回答他。

chapters.en: I will set my face against them and make them an example and a byword. I will remove them from my people. Then you will know that I am the LORD.
chapters.zh: 我必向那人变脸，使他作了警戒，笑谈，令人惊骇，并且我要将他从我民中剪除。你们就知道我是耶和华。

chapters.en: “ ‘And if the prophet is enticed to utter a prophecy, I the LORD have enticed that prophet, and I will stretch out my hand against him and destroy him from among my people Israel.
chapters.zh: 先知若被迷惑说一句预言，是我耶和华任那先知受迷惑，我也必向他伸手，将他从我民以色列中除灭。

chapters.en: They will bear their guilt—the prophet will be as guilty as the one who consults him.
chapters.zh: 他们必担当自己的罪孽。先知的罪孽和求问之人的罪孽都是一样，

chapters.en: Then the people of Israel will no longer stray from me, nor will they defile themselves anymore with all their sins. They will be my people, and I will be their God, declares the Sovereign LORD.’ ”
chapters.zh: 好使以色列家不再走迷离开我，不再因各样的罪过玷污自己，只要作我的子民，我作他们的神。这是主耶和华说的。

chapters.en: The word of the LORD came to me:
chapters.zh: 耶和华的话临到我说，

chapters.en: “Son of man, if a country sins against me by being unfaithful and I stretch out my hand against it to cut off its food supply and send famine upon it and kill its people and their animals,
chapters.zh: 人子阿，若有一国犯罪干犯我，我也向他伸手折断他们的杖，就是断绝他们的粮，使饥荒临到那地，将人与牲畜从其中剪除。

chapters.en: even if these three men—Noah, Daniel and Job—were in it, they could save only themselves by their righteousness, declares the Sovereign LORD.
chapters.zh: 其中虽有挪亚，但以理，约伯这三人，他们只能因他们的义救自己的性命。这是主耶和华说的。

chapters.en: “Or if I send wild beasts through that country and they leave it childless and it becomes desolate so that no one can pass through it because of the beasts,
chapters.zh: 我若使恶兽经过糟践那地，使地荒凉，以致因这些兽，人都不得经过。

chapters.en: as surely as I live, declares the Sovereign LORD, even if these three men were in it, they could not save their own sons or daughters. They alone would be saved, but the land would be desolate.
chapters.zh: 虽有这三人在其中，主耶和华说，我指着我的永生起誓，他们连儿带女都不能得救，只能自己得救，那地仍然荒凉。

chapters.en: “Or if I bring a sword against that country and say, ‘Let the sword pass throughout the land,’ and I kill its people and their animals,
chapters.zh: 或者我使刀剑临到那地，说，刀剑哪，要经过那地，以致我将人与牲畜从其中剪除。

chapters.en: as surely as I live, declares the Sovereign LORD, even if these three men were in it, they could not save their own sons or daughters. They alone would be saved.
chapters.zh: 虽有这三人在其中，主耶和华说，我指着我的永生起誓，他们连儿带女都不能得救，只能自己得救。

chapters.en: “Or if I send a plague into that land and pour out my wrath on it through bloodshed, killing its people and their animals,
chapters.zh: 或者我叫瘟疫流行那地，使我灭命（原文作带血）的忿怒倾在其上，好将人与牲畜从其中剪除。

chapters.en: as surely as I live, declares the Sovereign LORD, even if Noah, Daniel and Job were in it, they could save neither son nor daughter. They would save only themselves by their righteousness.
chapters.zh: 虽有挪亚，但以理，约伯在其中，主耶和华说，我指着我的永生起誓，他们连儿带女都不能救，只能因他们的义救自己的性命。

chapters.en: “For this is what the Sovereign LORD says: How much worse will it be when I send against Jerusalem my four dreadful judgments—sword and famine and wild beasts and plague—to kill its men and their animals!
chapters.zh: 主耶和华如此说，我将这四样大灾就是刀剑，饥荒，恶兽，瘟疫降在耶路撒冷，将人与牲畜从其中剪除，岂不更重吗？

chapters.en: Yet there will be some survivors—sons and daughters who will be brought out of it. They will come to you, and when you see their conduct and their actions, you will be consoled regarding the disaster I have brought on Jerusalem—every disaster I have brought on it.
chapters.zh: 然而其中必有剩下的人，他们连儿带女必带到你们这里来，你们看见他们所行所为的，要因我降给耶路撒冷的一切灾祸，便得了安慰。

chapters.en: You will be consoled when you see their conduct and their actions, for you will know that I have done nothing in it without cause, declares the Sovereign LORD.”
chapters.zh: 你们看见他们所行所为的，得了安慰，就知道我在耶路撒冷中所行的并非无故。这是主耶和华说的。

chapters.en: The word of the LORD came to me:
chapters.zh: 耶和华的话临到我说，

chapters.en: “Son of man, how is the wood of a vine different from that of a branch from any of the trees in the forest?
chapters.zh: 人子阿，葡萄树比别样树有什么强处。葡萄枝比众树枝有什么好处。

chapters.en: Is wood ever taken from it to make anything useful? Do they make pegs from it to hang things on?
chapters.zh: 其上可以取木料作什么工用，可以取来作钉子挂什么器皿吗？

chapters.en: And after it is thrown on the fire as fuel and the fire burns both ends and chars the middle, is it then useful for anything?
chapters.zh: 看哪，已经抛在火中当作柴烧，火既烧了两头，中间也被烧了，还有益于工用吗？

chapters.en: If it was not useful for anything when it was whole, how much less can it be made into something useful when the fire has burned it and it is charred?
chapters.zh: 完全的时候尚且不合乎什么工用，何况被火烧坏，还能合乎什么工用吗？

chapters.en: “Therefore this is what the Sovereign LORD says: As I have given the wood of the vine among the trees of the forest as fuel for the fire, so will I treat the people living in Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 所以，主耶和华如此说，众树以内的葡萄树，我怎样使它在火中当柴，也必照样待耶路撒冷的居民。

chapters.en: I will set my face against them. Although they have come out of the fire, the fire will yet consume them. And when I set my face against them, you will know that I am the LORD.
chapters.zh: 我必向他们变脸。他们虽从火中出来，火却要烧灭他们。我向他们变脸的时候，你们就知道我是耶和华。

chapters.en: I will make the land desolate because they have been unfaithful, declares the Sovereign LORD.”
chapters.zh: 我必使地土荒凉，因为他们行事干犯我。这是主耶和华说的。

chapters.en: The word of the LORD came to me:
chapters.zh: 耶和华的话又临到我说，

chapters.en: “Son of man, confront Jerusalem with her detestable practices
chapters.zh: 人子阿，你要使耶路撒冷知道她那些可憎的事，

chapters.en: and say, ‘This is what the Sovereign LORD says to Jerusalem: Your ancestry and birth were in the land of the Canaanites; your father was an Amorite and your mother a Hittite.
chapters.zh: 说主耶和华对耶路撒冷如此说，你根本，你出世，是在迦南地。你父亲是亚摩利人，你母亲是赫人。

chapters.en: On the day you were born your cord was not cut, nor were you washed with water to make you clean, nor were you rubbed with salt or wrapped in cloths.
chapters.zh: 论到你出世的景况，在你初生的日子没有为你断脐带，也没有用水洗你，使你洁净，丝毫没有撒盐在你身上，也没有用布裹你。

chapters.en: No one looked on you with pity or had compassion enough to do any of these things for you. Rather, you were thrown out into the open field, for on the day you were born you were despised.
chapters.zh: 谁的眼也不可怜你，为你作一件这样的事怜恤你。但你初生的日子扔在田野，是因你被厌恶。

chapters.en: “ ‘Then I passed by and saw you kicking about in your blood, and as you lay there in your blood I said to you, “Live!”
chapters.zh: 我从你旁边经过，见你滚在血中，就对你说，你虽在血中，仍可存活。你虽在血中，仍可存活。

chapters.en: I made you grow like a plant of the field. You grew and developed and entered puberty. Your breasts had formed and your hair had grown, yet you were stark naked.
chapters.zh: 我使你生长好像田间所长的，你就渐渐长大，以至极其俊美，两乳成形，头发长成，你却仍然赤身露体。

chapters.en: “ ‘Later I passed by, and when I looked at you and saw that you were old enough for love, I spread the corner of my garment over you and covered your naked body. I gave you my solemn oath and entered into a covenant with you, declares the Sovereign LORD, and you became mine.
chapters.zh: 我从你旁边经过，看见你的时候正动爱情，便用衣襟搭在你身上，遮盖你的赤体。又向你起誓，与你结盟，你就归于我。这是主耶和华说的。

chapters.en: “ ‘I bathed you with water and washed the blood from you and put ointments on you.
chapters.zh: 那时我用水洗你，洗净你身上的血，又用油抹你。

chapters.en: I clothed you with an embroidered dress and put sandals of fine leather on you. I dressed you in fine linen and covered you with costly garments.
