chapters.zh: 我也使你身穿绣花衣服，脚穿海狗皮鞋，并用细麻布给你束腰，用丝绸为衣披在你身上，

chapters.en: I adorned you with jewelry: I put bracelets on your arms and a necklace around your neck,
chapters.zh: 又用妆饰打扮你，将镯子戴在你手上，将金链戴在你项上。

chapters.en: and I put a ring on your nose, earrings on your ears and a beautiful crown on your head.
chapters.zh: 我也将环子戴在你鼻子上，将耳环戴在你耳朵上，将华冠戴在你头上。

chapters.en: So you were adorned with gold and silver; your clothes were of fine linen and costly fabric and embroidered cloth. Your food was honey, olive oil and the finest flour. You became very beautiful and rose to be a queen.
chapters.zh: 这样，你就有金银的妆饰，穿的是细麻衣和丝绸，并绣花衣。吃的是细面，蜂蜜，并油。你也极其美貌，发达到王后的尊荣。

chapters.en: And your fame spread among the nations on account of your beauty, because the splendor I had given you made your beauty perfect, declares the Sovereign LORD.
chapters.zh: 你美貌的名声传在列邦中，你十分美貌，是因我加在你身上的威荣。这是主耶和华说的。

chapters.en: “ ‘But you trusted in your beauty and used your fame to become a prostitute. You lavished your favors on anyone who passed by and your beauty became his.
chapters.zh: 只是你仗着自己的美貌，又因你的名声就行邪淫。你纵情淫乱，使过路的任意而行。

chapters.en: You took some of your garments to make gaudy high places, where you carried on your prostitution. You went to him, and he possessed your beauty.
chapters.zh: 你用衣服为自己在高处结彩，在其上行邪淫。这样的事将来必没有，也必不再行了。

chapters.en: You also took the fine jewelry I gave you, the jewelry made of my gold and silver, and you made for yourself male idols and engaged in prostitution with them.
chapters.zh: 你又将我所给你那华美的金银，宝器为自己制造人像，与他行邪淫。

chapters.en: And you took your embroidered clothes to put on them, and you offered my oil and incense before them.
chapters.zh: 又用你的绣花衣服给他披上，并将我的膏油和香料摆在他跟前。

chapters.en: Also the food I provided for you—the flour, olive oil and honey I gave you to eat—you offered as fragrant incense before them. That is what happened, declares the Sovereign LORD.
chapters.zh: 又将我赐给你的食物，就是我赐给你吃的细面，油，和蜂蜜，都摆在他跟前为馨香的供物。这是主耶和华说的。

chapters.en: “ ‘And you took your sons and daughters whom you bore to me and sacrificed them as food to the idols. Was your prostitution not enough?
chapters.zh: 并且你将给我所生的儿女焚献给他。

chapters.en: You slaughtered my children and sacrificed them to the idols.
chapters.zh: 你行淫乱岂是小事，竟将我的儿女杀了，使他们经火归与他吗？

chapters.en: In all your detestable practices and your prostitution you did not remember the days of your youth, when you were naked and bare, kicking about in your blood.
chapters.zh: 你行这一切可憎和淫乱的事，并未追念你幼年赤身露体滚在血中的日子。

chapters.en: “ ‘Woe! Woe to you, declares the Sovereign LORD. In addition to all your other wickedness,
chapters.zh: 你行这一切恶事之后（主耶和华说，你有祸了。有祸了。）

chapters.en: you built a mound for yourself and made a lofty shrine in every public square.
chapters.zh: 又为自己建造圆顶花楼，在各街上作了高台。

chapters.en: At every street corner you built your lofty shrines and degraded your beauty, spreading your legs with increasing promiscuity to anyone who passed by.
chapters.zh: 你在一切市口上建造高台，使你的美貌变为可憎的，又与一切过路的多行淫乱。

chapters.en: You engaged in prostitution with the Egyptians, your neighbors with large genitals, and aroused my anger with your increasing promiscuity.
chapters.zh: 你也和你邻邦放纵情欲的埃及人行淫，加增你的淫乱，惹我发怒。

chapters.en: So I stretched out my hand against you and reduced your territory; I gave you over to the greed of your enemies, the daughters of the Philistines, who were shocked by your lewd conduct.
chapters.zh: 因此我伸手攻击你，减少你应用的粮食，又将你交给恨你的非利士众女（众女是城邑的意思本章下同），使她们任意待你。她们见你的淫行，为你羞耻。

chapters.en: You engaged in prostitution with the Assyrians too, because you were insatiable; and even after that, you still were not satisfied.
chapters.zh: 你因贪色无厌，又与亚述人行淫，与他们行淫之后，仍不满意，

chapters.en: Then you increased your promiscuity to include Babylonia, a land of merchants, but even with this you were not satisfied.
chapters.zh: 并且多行淫乱，直到那贸易之地，就是迦勒底，你仍不满意。

chapters.en: “ ‘I am filled with fury against you, declares the Sovereign LORD, when you do all these things, acting like a brazen prostitute!
chapters.zh: 主耶和华说，你行这一切事，都是不知羞耻妓女所行的，可见你的心是何等懦弱。

chapters.en: When you built your mounds at every street corner and made your lofty shrines in every public square, you were unlike a prostitute, because you scorned payment.
chapters.zh: 因你在一切市口上建造圆顶花楼，在各街上作了高台，你却藐视赏赐，不像妓女。

chapters.en: “ ‘You adulterous wife! You prefer strangers to your own husband!
chapters.zh: 哎。你这行淫的妻阿，宁肯接外人，不接丈夫。

chapters.en: All prostitutes receive gifts, but you give gifts to all your lovers, bribing them to come to you from everywhere for your illicit favors.
chapters.zh: 凡妓女是得人赠送，你反倒赠送你所爱的人，贿赂他们从四围来与你行淫。

chapters.en: So in your prostitution you are the opposite of others; no one runs after you for your favors. You are the very opposite, for you give payment and none is given to you.
chapters.zh: 你行淫与别的妇女相反，因为不是人从你行淫。你既赠送人，人并不赠送你。所以你与别的妇女相反。

chapters.en: “ ‘Therefore, you prostitute, hear the word of the LORD!
chapters.zh: 你这妓女阿，要听耶和华的话。

chapters.en: This is what the Sovereign LORD says: Because you poured out your lust and exposed your naked body in your promiscuity with your lovers, and because of all your detestable idols, and because you gave them your children’s blood,
chapters.zh: 主耶和华如此说，因你的污秽倾泄了，你与你所爱的行淫露出下体，又因你拜一切可憎的偶像，流儿女的血献给他，

chapters.en: therefore I am going to gather all your lovers, with whom you found pleasure, those you loved as well as those you hated. I will gather them against you from all around and will strip you in front of them, and they will see you stark naked.
chapters.zh: 我就要将你一切相欢相爱的和你一切所恨的都聚集来，从四围攻击你。又将你的下体露出，使他们看尽了。

chapters.en: I will sentence you to the punishment of women who commit adultery and who shed blood; I will bring on you the blood vengeance of my wrath and jealous anger.
chapters.zh: 我也要审判你，好像官长审判淫妇和流人血的妇女一样。我因忿怒忌恨，使流血的罪归到你身上。

chapters.en: Then I will deliver you into the hands of your lovers, and they will tear down your mounds and destroy your lofty shrines. They will strip you of your clothes and take your fine jewelry and leave you stark naked.
chapters.zh: 我又要将你交在他们手中。他们必拆毁你的圆顶花楼，毁坏你的高台，剥去你的衣服，夺取你的华美宝器，留下你赤身露体。

chapters.en: They will bring a mob against you, who will stone you and hack you to pieces with their swords.
chapters.zh: 他们也必带多人来攻击你，用石头打死你，用刀剑刺透你，

chapters.en: They will burn down your houses and inflict punishment on you in the sight of many women. I will put a stop to your prostitution, and you will no longer pay your lovers.
chapters.zh: 用火焚烧你的房屋，在许多妇人眼前向你施行审判。我必使你不再行淫，也不再赠送与人。

chapters.en: Then my wrath against you will subside and my jealous anger will turn away from you; I will be calm and no longer angry.
chapters.zh: 这样，我就止息向你发的忿怒，我的忌恨也要离开你，我要安静不再恼怒。

chapters.en: “ ‘Because you did not remember the days of your youth but enraged me with all these things, I will surely bring down on your head what you have done, declares the Sovereign LORD. Did you not add lewdness to all your other detestable practices?
chapters.zh: 因你不追念你幼年的日子，在这一切的事上向我发烈怒，所以我必照你所行的报应在你头上，你就不再贪淫，行那一切可憎的事。这是主耶和华说的。

chapters.en: “ ‘Everyone who quotes proverbs will quote this proverb about you: “Like mother, like daughter.”
chapters.zh: 凡说俗语的必用俗语攻击你，说，母亲怎样，女儿也怎样。

chapters.en: You are a true daughter of your mother, who despised her husband and her children; and you are a true sister of your sisters, who despised their husbands and their children. Your mother was a Hittite and your father an Amorite.
chapters.zh: 你正是你母亲的女儿，厌弃丈夫和儿女。你正是你姐妹的姐妹，厌弃丈夫和儿女。你母亲是赫人，你父亲是亚摩利人。

chapters.en: Your older sister was Samaria, who lived to the north of you with her daughters; and your younger sister, who lived to the south of you with her daughters, was Sodom.
chapters.zh: 你的姐姐是撒玛利亚，她和她的众女住在你左边。你的妹妹是所多玛，她和她的众女住在你右边。

chapters.en: You not only followed their ways and copied their detestable practices, but in all your ways you soon became more depraved than they.
chapters.zh: 你没有效法她们的行为，也没有照她们可憎的事去作，你以那为小事，你一切所行的倒比她们更坏。

chapters.en: As surely as I live, declares the Sovereign LORD, your sister Sodom and her daughters never did what you and your daughters have done.
chapters.zh: 主耶和华说，我指着我的永生起誓，你妹妹所多玛与她的众女尚未行你和你众女所行的事。

chapters.en: “ ‘Now this was the sin of your sister Sodom: She and her daughters were arrogant, overfed and unconcerned; they did not help the poor and needy.
chapters.zh: 看哪，你妹妹所多玛的罪孽是这样，她和她的众女都心骄气傲，粮食饱足，大享安逸，并没有扶助困苦和穷乏人的手。

chapters.en: They were haughty and did detestable things before me. Therefore I did away with them as you have seen.
chapters.zh: 她们狂傲，在我面前行可憎的事，我看见便将她们除掉。

chapters.en: Samaria did not commit half the sins you did. You have done more detestable things than they, and have made your sisters seem righteous by all these things you have done.
chapters.zh: 撒玛利亚没有犯你一半的罪，你行可憎的事比她更多，使你的姐妹因你所行一切可憎的事，倒显为义。

chapters.en: Bear your disgrace, for you have furnished some justification for your sisters. Because your sins were more vile than theirs, they appear more righteous than you. So then, be ashamed and bear your disgrace, for you have made your sisters appear righteous.
chapters.zh: 你既断定你姐妹为义（为义或作当受羞辱），就要担当自己的羞辱。因你所犯的罪比她们更为可憎，她们就比你更显为义。你既使你的姐妹显为义，你就要抱愧担当自己的羞辱。

chapters.en: “ ‘However, I will restore the fortunes of Sodom and her daughters and of Samaria and her daughters, and your fortunes along with them,
chapters.zh: 我必叫她们被掳的归回，就是叫所多玛和她的众女，撒玛利亚和她的众女，并你们中间被掳的，都要归回，

chapters.en: so that you may bear your disgrace and be ashamed of all you have done in giving them comfort.
chapters.zh: 好使你担当自己的羞辱，并因你一切所行的使她们得安慰，你就抱愧。

chapters.en: And your sisters, Sodom with her daughters and Samaria with her daughters, will return to what they were before; and you and your daughters will return to what you were before.
chapters.zh: 你的妹妹所多玛和她的众女必归回原位。撒玛利亚和她的众女，你和你的众女，也必归回原位。

chapters.en: You would not even mention your sister Sodom in the day of your pride,
chapters.zh: 在你骄傲的日子，你的恶行没有显露以先，你的口就不提你的妹妹所多玛。那受了凌辱的亚兰众女和亚兰四围非利士的众女都恨恶你，藐视你。

chapters.en: before your wickedness was uncovered. Even so, you are now scorned by the daughters of Edom and all her neighbors and the daughters of the Philistines—all those around you who despise you.
You will bear the consequences of your lewdness and your detestable practices, declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说，你贪淫和可憎的事，你已经担当了。

chapters.en: “ ‘This is what the Sovereign LORD says: I will deal with you as you deserve, because you have despised my oath by breaking the covenant.
chapters.zh: 主耶和华如此说，你这轻看誓言，背弃盟约的，我必照你所行的待你。

chapters.en: Yet I will remember the covenant I made with you in the days of your youth, and I will establish an everlasting covenant with you.
chapters.zh: 然而我要追念在你幼年时与你所立的约，也要与你立定永约。

chapters.en: Then you will remember your ways and be ashamed when you receive your sisters, both those who are older than you and those who are younger. I will give them to you as daughters, but not on the basis of my covenant with you.
chapters.zh: 你接待你姐姐和你妹妹的时候，你要追念你所行的，自觉惭愧。并且我要将她们赐你为女儿，却不是按着前约。

chapters.en: So I will establish my covenant with you, and you will know that I am the LORD.
chapters.zh: 我要坚定与你所立的约（你就知道我是耶和华），

chapters.en: Then, when I make atonement for you for all you have done, you will remember and be ashamed and never again open your mouth because of your humiliation, declares the Sovereign LORD.’ ”
chapters.zh: 好使你在我赦免你一切所行的时候，心里追念，自觉抱愧，又因你的羞辱就不再开口。这是主耶和华说的。

chapters.en: The word of the LORD came to me:
chapters.zh: 耶和华的话临到我说，

chapters.en: “Son of man, set forth an allegory and tell it to the Israelites as a parable.
chapters.zh: 人子阿，你要向以色列家出谜语，设比喻，

chapters.en: Say to them, ‘This is what the Sovereign LORD says: A great eagle with powerful wings, long feathers and full plumage of varied colors came to Lebanon. Taking hold of the top of a cedar,
chapters.zh: 说主耶和华如此说，有一大鹰，翅膀大，翎毛长，羽毛丰满，彩色俱备，来到利巴嫩，将香柏树梢拧去，

chapters.en: he broke off its topmost shoot and carried it away to a land of merchants, where he planted it in a city of traders.
chapters.zh: 就是折去香柏树尽尖的嫩枝，叼到贸易之地，放在买卖城中。

chapters.en: “ ‘He took one of the seedlings of the land and put it in fertile soil. He planted it like a willow by abundant water,
chapters.zh: 又将以色列地的枝子栽于肥田里，插在大水旁，如插柳树，

chapters.en: and it sprouted and became a low, spreading vine. Its branches turned toward him, but its roots remained under it. So it became a vine and produced branches and put out leafy boughs.
chapters.zh: 就渐渐生长，成为蔓延矮小的葡萄树。其枝转向那鹰，其根在鹰以下，于是成了葡萄树，生出枝子，发出小枝。

chapters.en: “ ‘But there was another great eagle with powerful wings and full plumage. The vine now sent out its roots toward him from the plot where it was planted and stretched out its branches to him for water.
chapters.zh: 又有一大鹰，翅膀大，羽毛多。这葡萄树从栽种的畦中向这鹰弯过根来，发出枝子，好得它的浇灌。

chapters.en: It had been planted in good soil by abundant water so that it would produce branches, bear fruit and become a splendid vine.’
chapters.zh: 这树栽于肥田多水的旁边，好生枝子，结果子，成为佳美的葡萄树。

chapters.en: “Say to them, ‘This is what the Sovereign LORD says: Will it thrive? Will it not be uprooted and stripped of its fruit so that it withers? All its new growth will wither. It will not take a strong arm or many people to pull it up by the roots.
chapters.zh: 你要说，主耶和华如此说，这葡萄树岂能发旺呢？鹰岂不拔出它的根来，芟除它的果子，使它枯干，使它发的嫩叶都枯干了吗？也不用大力和多民，就拔出它的根来。

chapters.en: It has been planted, but will it thrive? Will it not wither completely when the east wind strikes it—wither away in the plot where it grew?’ ”
chapters.zh: 葡萄树虽然栽种，岂能发旺呢？一经东风，岂不全然枯干吗？必在生长的畦中枯干了。

chapters.en: Then the word of the LORD came to me:
chapters.zh: 耶和华的话临到我说，

chapters.en: “Say to this rebellious people, ‘Do you not know what these things mean?’ Say to them: ‘The king of Babylon went to Jerusalem and carried off her king and her nobles, bringing them back with him to Babylon.
chapters.zh: 你对那悖逆之家说，你们不知道这些事是什么意思吗？你要告诉他们说，巴比伦王曾到耶路撒冷，将其中的君王和首领带到巴比伦自己那里去。

chapters.en: Then he took a member of the royal family and made a treaty with him, putting him under oath. He also carried away the leading men of the land,
chapters.zh: 从以色列的宗室中取一人与他立约，使他发誓，并将国中有势力的人掳去，

chapters.en: so that the kingdom would be brought low, unable to rise again, surviving only by keeping his treaty.
chapters.zh: 使国低微不能自强，惟因守盟约得以存立。

chapters.en: But the king rebelled against him by sending his envoys to Egypt to get horses and a large army. Will he succeed? Will he who does such things escape? Will he break the treaty and yet escape?
chapters.zh: 他却背叛巴比伦王，打发使者往埃及去，要他们给他马匹和多民。他岂能亨通呢？行这样事的人岂能逃脱呢？他背约岂能逃脱呢？

chapters.en: “ ‘As surely as I live, declares the Sovereign LORD, he shall die in Babylon, in the land of the king who put him on the throne, whose oath he despised and whose treaty he broke.
chapters.zh: 他轻看向王所起的誓，背弃王与他所立的约。主耶和华说，我指着我的永生起誓，他定要死在立他作王，巴比伦王的京都。

chapters.en: Pharaoh with his mighty army and great horde will be of no help to him in war, when ramps are built and siege works erected to destroy many lives.
chapters.zh: 敌人筑垒造台，与他打仗的时候，为要剪除多人，法老虽领大军队和大群众，还是不能帮助他。

chapters.en: He despised the oath by breaking the covenant. Because he had given his hand in pledge and yet did all these things, he shall not escape.
chapters.zh: 他轻看誓言，背弃盟约，已经投降，却又作这一切的事，他必不能逃脱。

chapters.en: “ ‘Therefore this is what the Sovereign LORD says: As surely as I live, I will repay him for despising my oath and breaking my covenant.
chapters.zh: 所以主耶和华如此说，我指着我的永生起誓，他既轻看指我所起的誓，背弃指我所立的约，我必要使这罪归在他头上。

chapters.en: I will spread my net for him, and he will be caught in my snare. I will bring him to Babylon and execute judgment on him there because he was unfaithful to me.
chapters.zh: 我必将我的网撒在他身上，他必在我的网罗中缠住。我必带他到巴比伦，并要在那里因他干犯我的罪刑罚他。

chapters.en: All his choice troops will fall by the sword, and the survivors will be scattered to the winds. Then you will know that I the LORD have spoken.
chapters.zh: 他的一切军队，凡逃跑的，都必倒在刀下。所剩下的，也必分散四方（方原文作风）。你们就知道说这话的是我耶和华。

chapters.en: “ ‘This is what the Sovereign LORD says: I myself will take a shoot from the very top of a cedar and plant it; I will break off a tender sprig from its topmost shoots and plant it on a high and lofty mountain.
chapters.zh: 主耶和华如此说，我要将香柏树梢拧去栽上，就是从尽尖的嫩枝中折一嫩枝，栽于极高的山上。

chapters.en: On the mountain heights of Israel I will plant it; it will produce branches and bear fruit and become a splendid cedar. Birds of every kind will nest in it; they will find shelter in the shade of its branches.
chapters.zh: 在以色列高处的山栽上。它就生枝子，结果子，成为佳美的香柏树，各类飞鸟都必宿在其下，就是宿在枝子的荫下。

chapters.en: All the trees of the forest will know that I the LORD bring down the tall tree and make the low tree grow tall. I dry up the green tree and make the dry tree flourish. “ ‘I the LORD have spoken, and I will do it.’ ”
chapters.zh: 田野的树木都必知道我耶和华使高树矮小，矮树高大。青树枯干，枯树发旺。我耶和华如此说，也如此行了。

chapters.en: The word of the LORD came to me:
chapters.zh: 耶和华的话又临到我说，

chapters.en: “What do you people mean by quoting this proverb about the land of Israel: “ ‘The parents eat sour grapes, and the children’s teeth are set on edge’?
chapters.zh: 你们在以色列地怎么用这俗语说父亲吃了酸葡萄，儿子的牙酸倒了呢？

chapters.en: “As surely as I live, declares the Sovereign LORD, you will no longer quote this proverb in Israel.
chapters.zh: 主耶和华说，我指着我的永生起誓，你们在以色列中，必不再有用这俗语的因由。

chapters.en: For everyone belongs to me, the parent as well as the child—both alike belong to me. The one who sins is the one who will die.
chapters.zh: 看哪，世人都是属我的。为父的怎样属我，为子的也照样属我。犯罪的，他必死亡。

chapters.en: “Suppose there is a righteous man who does what is just and right.
chapters.zh: 人若是公义，且行正直与合理的事，

chapters.en: He does not eat at the mountain shrines or look to the idols of Israel. He does not defile his neighbor’s wife or have sexual relations with a woman during her period.
chapters.zh: 未曾在山上吃过祭偶像之物，未曾仰望以色列家的偶像，未曾玷污邻舍的妻，未曾在妇人的经期内亲近她，

chapters.en: He does not oppress anyone, but returns what he took in pledge for a loan. He does not commit robbery but gives his food to the hungry and provides clothing for the naked.
chapters.zh: 未曾亏负人，乃将欠债之人的当头还给他。未曾抢夺人的物件，却将食物给饥饿的人吃，将衣服给赤身的人穿。

chapters.en: He does not lend to them at interest or take a profit from them. He withholds his hand from doing wrong and judges fairly between two parties.
chapters.zh: 未曾向借钱的弟兄取利，也未曾向借粮的弟兄多要，缩手不作罪孽，在两人之间，按至理判断。

chapters.en: He follows my decrees and faithfully keeps my laws. That man is righteous; he will surely live, declares the Sovereign LORD.
chapters.zh: 遵行我的律例，谨守我的典章，按诚实行事这人是公义的，必定存活。这是主耶和华说的。

chapters.en: “Suppose he has a violent son, who sheds blood or does any of these other things
chapters.zh: 他若生一个儿子，作强盗，是流人血的，不行以上所说之善，反行其中之恶，乃在山上吃过祭偶像之物，并玷污邻舍的妻，

chapters.en: (though the father has done none of them): “He eats at the mountain shrines. He defiles his neighbor’s wife.
He oppresses the poor and needy. He commits robbery. He does not return what he took in pledge. He looks to the idols. He does detestable things.
chapters.zh: 亏负困苦和穷乏的人，抢夺人的物，未曾将当头还给人，仰望偶像，并行可憎的事，

chapters.en: He lends at interest and takes a profit. Will such a man live? He will not! Because he has done all these detestable things, he is to be put to death; his blood will be on his own head.
chapters.zh: 向借钱的弟兄取利，向借粮的弟兄多要这人岂能存活呢？他必不能存活。他行这一切可憎的事，必要死亡，他的罪必归到他身上（罪原文作血）。

chapters.en: “But suppose this son has a son who sees all the sins his father commits, and though he sees them, he does not do such things:
chapters.zh: 他若生一个儿子，见父亲所犯的一切罪便惧怕（有古卷作思量），不照样去作。

chapters.en: “He does not eat at the mountain shrines or look to the idols of Israel. He does not defile his neighbor’s wife.
chapters.zh: 未曾在山上吃过祭偶像之物，未曾仰望以色列家的偶像，未曾玷污邻舍的妻，

chapters.en: He does not oppress anyone or require a pledge for a loan. He does not commit robbery but gives his food to the hungry and provides clothing for the naked.
chapters.zh: 未曾亏负人，未曾取人的当头，未曾抢夺人的物件，却将食物给饥饿的人吃，将衣服给赤身的人穿，

chapters.en: He withholds his hand from mistreating the poor and takes no interest or profit from them. He keeps my laws and follows my decrees. He will not die for his father’s sin; he will surely live.
chapters.zh: 缩手不害贫穷人，未曾向借钱的弟兄取利，也未曾向借粮的弟兄多要。他顺从我的典章，遵行我的律例，就不因父亲的罪孽死亡，定要存活。

chapters.en: But his father will die for his own sin, because he practiced extortion, robbed his brother and did what was wrong among his people.
chapters.zh: 至于他父亲。因为欺人太甚，抢夺弟兄，在本国的民中行不善，他必因自己的罪孽死亡。

chapters.en: “Yet you ask, ‘Why does the son not share the guilt of his father?’ Since the son has done what is just and right and has been careful to keep all my decrees, he will surely live.
chapters.zh: 你们还说，儿子为何不担当父亲的罪孽呢？儿子行正直与合理的事，谨守遵行我的一切律例，他必定存活。

chapters.en: The one who sins is the one who will die. The child will not share the guilt of the parent, nor will the parent share the guilt of the child. The righteousness of the righteous will be credited to them, and the wickedness of the wicked will be charged against them.
chapters.zh: 惟有犯罪的，他必死亡。儿子必不担当父亲的罪孽，父亲也不担当儿子的罪孽。义人的善果必归自己，恶人的恶报也必归自己。

chapters.en: “But if a wicked person turns away from all the sins they have committed and keeps all my decrees and does what is just and right, that person will surely live; they will not die.
chapters.zh: 恶人若回头离开所作的一切罪恶，谨守我一切的律例，行正直与合理的事，他必定存活，不致死亡。

chapters.en: None of the offenses they have committed will be remembered against them. Because of the righteous things they have done, they will live.
chapters.zh: 他所犯的一切罪过都不被记念，因所行的义，他必存活。

chapters.en: Do I take any pleasure in the death of the wicked? declares the Sovereign LORD. Rather, am I not pleased when they turn from their ways and live?
chapters.zh: 主耶和华说，恶人死亡，岂是我喜悦的吗？不是喜悦他回头离开所行的道存活吗？

chapters.en: “But if a righteous person turns from their righteousness and commits sin and does the same detestable things the wicked person does, will they live? None of the righteous things that person has done will be remembered. Because of the unfaithfulness they are guilty of and because of the sins they have committed, they will die.
chapters.zh: 义人若转离义行而作罪孽，照着恶人所行一切可憎的事而行，他岂能存活吗？他所行的一切义都不被记念。他必因所犯的罪，所行的恶死亡。

chapters.en: “Yet you say, ‘The way of the Lord is not just.’ Hear, you Israelites: Is my way unjust? Is it not your ways that are unjust?
chapters.zh: 你们还说，主的道不公平。以色列家阿，你们当听，我的道岂不公平吗？你们的道岂不是不公平吗？

chapters.en: If a righteous person turns from their righteousness and commits sin, they will die for it; because of the sin they have committed they will die.
chapters.zh: 义人若转离义行而作罪孽死亡，他是因所作的罪孽死亡。

chapters.en: But if a wicked person turns away from the wickedness they have committed and does what is just and right, they will save their life.
chapters.zh: 再者，恶人若回头离开所行的恶，行正直与合理的事，他必将性命救活了。

chapters.en: Because they consider all the offenses they have committed and turn away from them, that person will surely live; they will not die.
chapters.zh: 因为他思量，回头离开所犯的一切罪过，必定存活，不致死亡。

chapters.en: Yet the Israelites say, ‘The way of the Lord is not just.’ Are my ways unjust, people of Israel? Is it not your ways that are unjust?
chapters.zh: 以色列家还说，主的道不公平。以色列家阿，我的道岂不公平吗？你们的道岂不是不公平吗？

chapters.en: “Therefore, you Israelites, I will judge each of you according to your own ways, declares the Sovereign LORD. Repent! Turn away from all your offenses; then sin will not be your downfall.
chapters.zh: 所以主耶和华说，以色列家阿，我必按你们各人所行的审判你们。你们当回头离开所犯的一切罪过。这样，罪孽必不使你们败亡。

chapters.en: Rid yourselves of all the offenses you have committed, and get a new heart and a new spirit. Why will you die, people of Israel?
chapters.zh: 你们要将所犯的一切罪过尽行抛弃，自作一个新心和新灵。以色列家阿，你们何必死亡呢？

chapters.en: For I take no pleasure in the death of anyone, declares the Sovereign LORD. Repent and live!
chapters.zh: 主耶和华说，我不喜悦那死人之死，所以你们当回头而存活。

chapters.en: “Take up a lament concerning the princes of Israel
chapters.zh: 你当为以色列的王作起哀歌，

chapters.en: and say: “ ‘What a lioness was your mother among the lions! She lay down among them and reared her cubs.
chapters.zh: 说，你的母亲是什么呢？是个母狮子，蹲伏在狮子中间，在少壮狮子中养育小狮子。

chapters.en: She brought up one of her cubs, and he became a strong lion. He learned to tear the prey and he became a man-eater.
chapters.zh: 在它小狮子中养大一个，成了少壮狮子，学会抓食而吃人。

chapters.en: The nations heard about him, and he was trapped in their pit. They led him with hooks to the land of Egypt.
chapters.zh: 列国听见了就把它捉在他们的坑中，用钩子拉到埃及地去。

chapters.en: “ ‘When she saw her hope unfulfilled, her expectation gone, she took another of her cubs and made him a strong lion.
chapters.zh: 母狮见自己等候失了指望，就从它小狮子中又将一个养为少壮狮子。

chapters.en: He prowled among the lions, for he was now a strong lion. He learned to tear the prey and he became a man-eater.
chapters.zh: 它在众狮子中走来走去，成了少壮狮子，学会抓食而吃人。

chapters.en: He broke down their strongholds and devastated their towns. The land and all who were in it were terrified by his roaring.
chapters.zh: 它知道列国的宫殿，又使他们的城邑变为荒场。因它咆哮的声音，遍地和其中所有的就都荒废。

chapters.en: Then the nations came against him, those from regions round about. They spread their net for him, and he was trapped in their pit.
chapters.zh: 于是四围邦国各省的人来攻击它，将网撒在它身上，捉在他们的坑中。

chapters.en: With hooks they pulled him into a cage and brought him to the king of Babylon. They put him in prison, so his roar was heard no longer on the mountains of Israel.
chapters.zh: 他们用钩子钩住它，将它放在笼中，带到巴比伦王那里，将它放入坚固之所，使它的声音在以色列山上不再听见。

chapters.en: “ ‘Your mother was like a vine in your vineyard planted by the water; it was fruitful and full of branches because of abundant water.
chapters.zh: 你的母亲先前如葡萄树，极其茂盛（原文作在你血中），栽于水旁。因为水多，就多结果子，满生枝子。

chapters.en: Its branches were strong, fit for a ruler’s scepter. It towered high above the thick foliage, conspicuous for its height and for its many branches.
chapters.zh: 生出坚固的枝干，可作掌权者的杖。这枝干高举在茂密的枝中，而且它生长高大，枝子繁多，远远可见。

chapters.en: But it was uprooted in fury and thrown to the ground. The east wind made it shrivel, it was stripped of its fruit; its strong branches withered and fire consumed them.
chapters.zh: 但这葡萄树因忿怒被拔出摔在地上。东风吹干其上的果子，坚固的枝干折断枯干，被火烧毁了。

chapters.en: Now it is planted in the desert, in a dry and thirsty land.
chapters.zh: 如今栽于旷野干旱无水之地。

chapters.en: Fire spread from one of its main branches and consumed its fruit. No strong branch is left on it fit for a ruler’s scepter.’ “This is a lament and is to be used as a lament.”
chapters.zh: 火也从它枝干中发出，烧灭果子，以致没有坚固的枝干可作掌权者的杖。这是哀歌，也必用以作哀歌。

chapters.en: In the seventh year, in the fifth month on the tenth day, some of the elders of Israel came to inquire of the LORD, and they sat down in front of me.
chapters.zh: 第七年五月初十日，有以色列的几个长老来求问耶和华，坐在我面前。

chapters.en: Then the word of the LORD came to me:
chapters.zh: 耶和华的话临到我说，

chapters.en: “Son of man, speak to the elders of Israel and say to them, ‘This is what the Sovereign LORD says: Have you come to inquire of me? As surely as I live, I will not let you inquire of me, declares the Sovereign LORD.’
chapters.zh: 人子阿，你要告诉以色列的长老说，主耶和华如此说，你们来是求问我吗？主耶和华说，我指着我的永生起誓，我必不被你们求问。

chapters.en: “Will you judge them? Will you judge them, son of man? Then confront them with the detestable practices of their ancestors
chapters.zh: 人子阿，你要审问审问他们吗？你当使他们知道他们列祖那些可憎的事，

chapters.en: and say to them: ‘This is what the Sovereign LORD says: On the day I chose Israel, I swore with uplifted hand to the descendants of Jacob and revealed myself to them in Egypt. With uplifted hand I said to them, “I am the LORD your God.”
chapters.zh: 对他们说，主耶和华如此说，当日我拣选以色列，向雅各家的后裔起誓，在埃及地将自己向他们显现，说，我是耶和华你们的神。

chapters.en: On that day I swore to them that I would bring them out of Egypt into a land I had searched out for them, a land flowing with milk and honey, the most beautiful of all lands.
chapters.zh: 那日我向他们起誓，必领他们出埃及地，到我为他们察看的流奶与蜜之地。那地在万国中是有荣耀的。

chapters.en: And I said to them, “Each of you, get rid of the vile images you have set your eyes on, and do not defile yourselves with the idols of Egypt. I am the LORD your God.”
chapters.zh: 我对他们说，你们各人要抛弃眼所喜爱那可憎之物，不可因埃及的偶像玷污自己。我是耶和华你们的神。

chapters.en: “ ‘But they rebelled against me and would not listen to me; they did not get rid of the vile images they had set their eyes on, nor did they forsake the idols of Egypt. So I said I would pour out my wrath on them and spend my anger against them in Egypt.
chapters.zh: 他们却悖逆我，不肯听从我，不抛弃他们眼所喜爱那可憎之物，不离弃埃及的偶像。我就说，我要将我的忿怒倾在他们身上，在埃及地向他们成就我怒中所定的。

chapters.en: But for the sake of my name, I brought them out of Egypt. I did it to keep my name from being profaned in the eyes of the nations among whom they lived and in whose sight I had revealed myself to the Israelites.
chapters.zh: 我却为我名的缘故没有这样行，免得我名在他们所住的列国人眼前被亵渎。我领他们出埃及地，在这列国人的眼前将自己向他们显现。

chapters.en: Therefore I led them out of Egypt and brought them into the wilderness.
chapters.zh: 这样，我就使他们出埃及地，领他们到旷野，

chapters.en: I gave them my decrees and made known to them my laws, by which the person who obeys them will live.
chapters.zh: 将我的律例赐给他们，将我的典章指示他们。人若遵行就必因此活着。

chapters.en: Also I gave them my Sabbaths as a sign between us, so they would know that I the LORD made them holy.
chapters.zh: 又将我的安息日赐给他们，好在我与他们中间为证据，使他们知道我耶和华是叫他们成为圣的。

chapters.en: “ ‘Yet the people of Israel rebelled against me in the wilderness. They did not follow my decrees but rejected my laws—by which the person who obeys them will live—and they utterly desecrated my Sabbaths. So I said I would pour out my wrath on them and destroy them in the wilderness.
chapters.zh: 以色列家却在旷野悖逆我，不顺从我的律例，厌弃我的典章（人若遵行就必因此活着），大大干犯我的安息日。我就说，要在旷野将我的忿怒倾在他们身上，灭绝他们。

chapters.en: But for the sake of my name I did what would keep it from being profaned in the eyes of the nations in whose sight I had brought them out.
chapters.zh: 我却为我名的缘故，没有这样行，免得我的名在我领他们出埃及的列国人眼前被亵渎。

chapters.en: Also with uplifted hand I swore to them in the wilderness that I would not bring them into the land I had given them—a land flowing with milk and honey, the most beautiful of all lands—
chapters.zh: 并且我在旷野向他们起誓，必不领他们进入我所赐给他们流奶与蜜之地，那地在万国中是有荣耀的。

chapters.en: because they rejected my laws and did not follow my decrees and desecrated my Sabbaths. For their hearts were devoted to their idols.
chapters.zh: 因为他们厌弃我的典章，不顺从我的律例，干犯我的安息日，他们的心随从自己的偶像。

chapters.en: Yet I looked on them with pity and did not destroy them or put an end to them in the wilderness.
chapters.zh: 虽然如此，我眼仍顾惜他们，不毁灭他们，不在旷野将他们灭绝净尽。

chapters.en: I said to their children in the wilderness, “Do not follow the statutes of your parents or keep their laws or defile yourselves with their idols.
chapters.zh: 我在旷野对他们的儿女说，不要遵行你们父亲的律例，不要谨守他们的恶规，也不要因他们的偶像玷污自己。

chapters.en: I am the LORD your God; follow my decrees and be careful to keep my laws.
chapters.zh: 我是耶和华你们的神，你们要顺从我的律例，谨守遵行我的典章，

chapters.en: Keep my Sabbaths holy, that they may be a sign between us. Then you will know that I am the LORD your God.”
chapters.zh: 且以我的安息日为圣。这日在我与你们中间为证据，使你们知道我是耶和华你们的神。

chapters.en: “ ‘But the children rebelled against me: They did not follow my decrees, they were not careful to keep my laws, of which I said, “The person who obeys them will live by them,” and they desecrated my Sabbaths. So I said I would pour out my wrath on them and spend my anger against them in the wilderness.
chapters.zh: 只是他们的儿女悖逆我，不顺从我的律例，也不谨守遵行我的典章（人若遵行就必因此活着），干犯我的安息日。我就说，要将我的忿怒倾在他们身上，在旷野向他们成就我怒中所定的。

chapters.en: But I withheld my hand, and for the sake of my name I did what would keep it from being profaned in the eyes of the nations in whose sight I had brought them out.
chapters.zh: 虽然如此，我却为我名的缘故缩手没有这样行，免得我的名在我领他们出埃及的列国人眼前被亵渎。

chapters.en: Also with uplifted hand I swore to them in the wilderness that I would disperse them among the nations and scatter them through the countries,
chapters.zh: 并且我在旷野向他们起誓，必将他们分散在列国，四散在列邦。

chapters.en: because they had not obeyed my laws but had rejected my decrees and desecrated my Sabbaths, and their eyes lusted after their parents’ idols.
chapters.zh: 因为他们不遵行我的典章，竟厌弃我的律例，干犯我的安息日，眼目仰望他们父亲的偶像。

chapters.en: So I gave them other statutes that were not good and laws through which they could not live;
chapters.zh: 我也任他们遵行不美的律例，谨守不能使人活着的恶规。

chapters.en: I defiled them through their gifts—the sacrifice of every firstborn—that I might fill them with horror so they would know that I am the LORD.’
chapters.zh: 因他们将一切头生的经火，我就任凭他们在这供献的事上玷污自己，好叫他们凄凉，使他们知道我是耶和华。

chapters.en: “Therefore, son of man, speak to the people of Israel and say to them, ‘This is what the Sovereign LORD says: In this also your ancestors blasphemed me by being unfaithful to me:
chapters.zh: 人子阿，你要告诉以色列家说，主耶和华如此说，你们的列祖在得罪我的事上亵渎我。

chapters.en: When I brought them into the land I had sworn to give them and they saw any high hill or any leafy tree, there they offered their sacrifices, made offerings that aroused my anger, presented their fragrant incense and poured out their drink offerings.
chapters.zh: 因为我领他们到了我起誓应许赐给他们的地，他们看见各高山，各茂密树，就在那里献祭，奉上惹我发怒的供物，也在那里焚烧馨香的祭牲，并浇上奠祭。

chapters.en: Then I said to them: What is this high place you go to?’ ” (It is called Bamah to this day.)
chapters.zh: 我就对他们说，你们所上的那高处叫什么呢？那高处的名字叫巴麻直到今日。

chapters.en: “Therefore say to the Israelites: ‘This is what the Sovereign LORD says: Will you defile yourselves the way your ancestors did and lust after their vile images?
chapters.zh: 所以你要对以色列家说，主耶和华如此说，你们仍照你们列祖所行的玷污自己吗？仍照他们可憎的事行邪淫吗？

chapters.en: When you offer your gifts—the sacrifice of your children in the fire—you continue to defile yourselves with all your idols to this day. Am I to let you inquire of me, you Israelites? As surely as I live, declares the Sovereign LORD, I will not let you inquire of me.
chapters.zh: 你们奉上供物使你们儿子经火的时候，仍将一切偶像玷污自己，直到今日吗？以色列家阿，我岂被你们求问吗？主耶和华说，我指着我的永生起誓，我必不被你们求问。

chapters.en: “ ‘You say, “We want to be like the nations, like the peoples of the world, who serve wood and stone.” But what you have in mind will never happen.
chapters.zh: 你们说，我们要像外邦人和列国的宗族一样，去事奉木头与石头。你们所起的这心意万不能成就。

chapters.en: As surely as I live, declares the Sovereign LORD, I will reign over you with a mighty hand and an outstretched arm and with outpoured wrath.
chapters.zh: 主耶和华说，我指着我的永生起誓，我总要作王，用大能的手和伸出来的膀臂，并倾出来的忿怒，治理你们。

chapters.en: I will bring you from the nations and gather you from the countries where you have been scattered—with a mighty hand and an outstretched arm and with outpoured wrath.
chapters.zh: 我必用大能的手和伸出来的膀臂，并倾出来的忿怒，将你们从万民中领出来，从分散的列国内聚集你们。

chapters.en: I will bring you into the wilderness of the nations and there, face to face, I will execute judgment upon you.
chapters.zh: 我必带你们到外邦人的旷野，在那里当面刑罚你们。

chapters.en: As I judged your ancestors in the wilderness of the land of Egypt, so I will judge you, declares the Sovereign LORD.
chapters.zh: 我怎样在埃及地的旷野刑罚你们的列祖，也必照样刑罚你们。这是主耶和华说的。

chapters.en: I will take note of you as you pass under my rod, and I will bring you into the bond of the covenant.
chapters.zh: 我必使你们从杖下经过，使你们被约拘束。

chapters.en: I will purge you of those who revolt and rebel against me. Although I will bring them out of the land where they are living, yet they will not enter the land of Israel. Then you will know that I am the LORD.
chapters.zh: 我必从你们中间除净叛逆和得罪我的人，将他们从所寄居的地方领出来，他们却不得入以色列地。你们就知道我是耶和华。

chapters.en: “ ‘As for you, people of Israel, this is what the Sovereign LORD says: Go and serve your idols, every one of you! But afterward you will surely listen to me and no longer profane my holy name with your gifts and idols.
chapters.zh: 以色列家阿，至于你们，主耶和华如此说，从此以后若不听从我，就任凭你们去事奉偶像，只是不可再因你们的供物和偶像亵渎我的圣名。

chapters.en: For on my holy mountain, the high mountain of Israel, declares the Sovereign LORD, there in the land all the people of Israel will serve me, and there I will accept them. There I will require your offerings and your choice gifts, along with all your holy sacrifices.
chapters.zh: 主耶和华说，在我的圣山，就是以色列高处的山，所有以色列的全家都要事奉我。我要在那里悦纳你们，向你们要供物和初熟的土产，并一切的圣物。

chapters.en: I will accept you as fragrant incense when I bring you out from the nations and gather you from the countries where you have been scattered, and I will be proved holy through you in the sight of the nations.
chapters.zh: 我从万民中领你们出来，从分散的列国内聚集你们，那时我必悦纳你们好像馨香之祭，要在外邦人眼前在你们身上显为圣。

chapters.en: Then you will know that I am the LORD, when I bring you into the land of Israel, the land I had sworn with uplifted hand to give to your ancestors.
chapters.zh: 我领你们进入以色列地，就是我起誓应许赐给你们列祖之地，那时你们就知道我是耶和华。

chapters.en: There you will remember your conduct and all the actions by which you have defiled yourselves, and you will loathe yourselves for all the evil you have done.
chapters.zh: 你们在那里要追念玷污自己的行动作为，又要因所作的一切恶事厌恶自己。

chapters.en: You will know that I am the LORD, when I deal with you for my name’s sake and not according to your evil ways and your corrupt practices, you people of Israel, declares the Sovereign LORD.’ ”
chapters.zh: 主耶和华说，以色列家阿，我为我名的缘故，不照着你们的恶行和你们的坏事待你们。你们就知道我是耶和华。

chapters.en: The word of the LORD came to me:
chapters.zh: 耶和华的话临到我说，

chapters.en: “Son of man, set your face toward the south; preach against the south and prophesy against the forest of the southland.
chapters.zh: 人子阿，你要面向南方，向南滴下预言攻击南方田野的树林。

chapters.en: Say to the southern forest: ‘Hear the word of the LORD. This is what the Sovereign LORD says: I am about to set fire to you, and it will consume all your trees, both green and dry. The blazing flame will not be quenched, and every face from south to north will be scorched by it.
chapters.zh: 对南方的树林说，要听耶和华的话。主耶和华如此说，我必使火在你中间着起，烧灭你中间的一切青树和枯树，猛烈的火焰必不熄灭。从南到北，人的脸面都被烧焦。

chapters.en: Everyone will see that I the LORD have kindled it; it will not be quenched.’ ”
chapters.zh: 凡有血气的都必知道是我耶和华使火着起，这火必不熄灭。

chapters.en: Then I said, “Sovereign LORD, they are saying of me, ‘Isn’t he just telling parables?’ ”
chapters.zh: 于是我说，哎。主耶和华阿，人都指着我说，他岂不是说比喻的吗？

chapters.en: The word of the LORD came to me:
chapters.zh: 耶和华的话临到我说，

chapters.en: “Son of man, set your face against Jerusalem and preach against the sanctuary. Prophesy against the land of Israel
chapters.zh: 人子阿，你要面向耶路撒冷和圣所滴下预言，攻击以色列地。

chapters.en: and say to her: ‘This is what the LORD says: I am against you. I will draw my sword from its sheath and cut off from you both the righteous and the wicked.
chapters.zh: 对以色列地说，耶和华如此说，我与你为敌，并要拔刀出鞘，从你中间将义人和恶人一并剪除。

chapters.en: Because I am going to cut off the righteous and the wicked, my sword will be unsheathed against everyone from south to north.
chapters.zh: 我既要从你中间剪除义人和恶人，所以我的刀要出鞘，自南至北攻击一切有血气的。

chapters.en: Then all people will know that I the LORD have drawn my sword from its sheath; it will not return again.’
chapters.zh: 一切有血气的就知道我耶和华已经拔刀出鞘，必不再入鞘。

chapters.en: “Therefore groan, son of man! Groan before them with broken heart and bitter grief.
chapters.zh: 人子阿，你要叹息，在他们眼前弯着腰，苦苦地叹息。

chapters.en: And when they ask you, ‘Why are you groaning?’ you shall say, ‘Because of the news that is coming. Every heart will melt with fear and every hand go limp; every spirit will become faint and every leg will be wet with urine.’ It is coming! It will surely take place, declares the Sovereign LORD.”
chapters.zh: 他们问你说，为何叹息呢？你就说，因为有风声，灾祸要来。人心都必消化，手都发软，精神衰败，膝弱如水。看哪，这灾祸临近，必然成就。这是主耶和华说的。

chapters.en: The word of the LORD came to me:
chapters.zh: 耶和华的话临到我说，

chapters.en: “Son of man, prophesy and say, ‘This is what the Lord says: “ ‘A sword, a sword, sharpened and polished—
chapters.zh: 人子阿，你要预言。耶和华吩咐我如此说，有刀，有刀，是磨快擦亮的。

chapters.en: sharpened for the slaughter, polished to flash like lightning! “ ‘Shall we rejoice in the scepter of my royal son? The sword despises every such stick.
chapters.zh: 磨快为要行杀戮，擦亮为要像闪电。我们岂可快乐吗？罚我子的杖藐视各树。

chapters.en: “ ‘The sword is appointed to be polished, to be grasped with the hand; it is sharpened and polished, made ready for the hand of the slayer.
chapters.zh: 这刀已经交给人擦亮，为要应手使用。这刀已经磨快擦亮，好交在行杀戮的人手中。

chapters.en: Cry out and wail, son of man, for it is against my people; it is against all the princes of Israel. They are thrown to the sword along with my people. Therefore beat your breast.
chapters.zh: 人子阿，你要呼喊哀号，因为这刀临到我的百姓和以色列一切的首领。他们和我的百姓都交在刀下，所以你要拍腿叹息。

chapters.en: “ ‘Testing will surely come. And what if even the scepter, which the sword despises, does not continue? declares the Sovereign LORD.’
chapters.zh: 有试验的事。若那藐视的杖归于无有，怎么样呢？这是主耶和华说的。

chapters.en: “So then, son of man, prophesy and strike your hands together. Let the sword strike twice, even three times. It is a sword for slaughter— a sword for great slaughter, closing in on them from every side.
chapters.zh: 人子阿，你要拍掌预言。我耶和华要使这刀，就是致死伤的刀，一连三次加倍刺人，进入他们的内屋，使大人受死伤的就是这刀。

chapters.en: So that hearts may melt with fear and the fallen be many, I have stationed the sword for slaughter at all their gates. Look! It is forged to strike like lightning, it is grasped for slaughter.
chapters.zh: 我设立这恐吓人的刀，攻击他们的一切城门，使他们的心消化，加增他们跌倒的事。哎。这刀造得像闪电，磨得尖利，要行杀戮。

chapters.en: Slash to the right, you sword, then to the left, wherever your blade is turned.
chapters.zh: 刀阿，你归在右边，摆在左边。你面向哪方，就向那方杀戮。

chapters.en: I too will strike my hands together, and my wrath will subside. I the LORD have spoken.”
chapters.zh: 我也要拍掌，并要使我的忿怒止息。这是我耶和华说的。

chapters.en: The word of the LORD came to me:
chapters.zh: 耶和华的话又临到我说，

chapters.en: “Son of man, mark out two roads for the sword of the king of Babylon to take, both starting from the same country. Make a signpost where the road branches off to the city.
chapters.zh: 人子阿，你要定出两条路，好使巴比伦王的刀来。这两条路必从一地分出来，又要在通城的路口上画出一只手来。

chapters.en: Mark out one road for the sword to come against Rabbah of the Ammonites and another against Judah and fortified Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 你要定出一条路，使刀来到亚扪人的拉巴。又要定出一条路，使刀来到犹大的坚固城耶路撒冷。

chapters.en: For the king of Babylon will stop at the fork in the road, at the junction of the two roads, to seek an omen: He will cast lots with arrows, he will consult his idols, he will examine the liver.
chapters.zh: 因为巴比伦王站在岔路那里，在两条路口上要占卜。他摇签（原文作箭）求问神像，察看牺牲的肝。

chapters.en: Into his right hand will come the lot for Jerusalem, where he is to set up battering rams, to give the command to slaughter, to sound the battle cry, to set battering rams against the gates, to build a ramp and to erect siege works.
chapters.zh: 在右手中拿着为耶路撒冷占卜的签，使他安设撞城锤，张口叫杀，扬声呐喊，筑垒造台，以撞城锤，攻打城门。

chapters.en: It will seem like a false omen to those who have sworn allegiance to him, but he will remind them of their guilt and take them captive.
chapters.zh: 据那些曾起誓的犹大人看来，这是虚假的占卜。但巴比伦王要使他们想起罪孽，以致将他们捉住。

chapters.en: “Therefore this is what the Sovereign LORD says: ‘Because you people have brought to mind your guilt by your open rebellion, revealing your sins in all that you do—because you have done this, you will be taken captive.
chapters.zh: 主耶和华如此说，因你们的过犯显露，使你们的罪孽被记念，以致你们的罪恶在行为上都彰显出来。又因你们被记念，就被捉住。

chapters.en: “ ‘You profane and wicked prince of Israel, whose day has come, whose time of punishment has reached its climax,
chapters.zh: 你这受死伤行恶的以色列王阿，罪孽的尽头到了，受报的日子已到。

chapters.en: this is what the Sovereign LORD says: Take off the turban, remove the crown. It will not be as it was: The lowly will be exalted and the exalted will be brought low.
chapters.zh: 主耶和华如此说，当除掉冠，摘下冕，景况必不再像先前。要使卑者升为高，使高者降为卑。

chapters.en: A ruin! A ruin! I will make it a ruin! The crown will not be restored until he to whom it rightfully belongs shall come; to him I will give it.’
chapters.zh: 我要将这国倾覆，倾覆，而又倾覆。这国也必不再有，直等到那应得的人来到，我就赐给他。

chapters.en: “And you, son of man, prophesy and say, ‘This is what the Sovereign LORD says about the Ammonites and their insults: “ ‘A sword, a sword, drawn for the slaughter, polished to consume and to flash like lightning!
chapters.zh: 人子阿，要发预言说，主耶和华论到亚扪人和他们的凌辱，吩咐我如此说，有刀，有拔出来的刀，已经擦亮，为行杀戮，使他像闪电以行吞灭。

chapters.en: Despite false visions concerning you and lying divinations about you, it will be laid on the necks of the wicked who are to be slain, whose day has come, whose time of punishment has reached its climax.
chapters.zh: 人为你见虚假的异象，行谎诈的占卜，使你倒在受死伤之恶人的颈项上。他们罪孽到了尽头，受报的日子已到。

chapters.en: “ ‘Let the sword return to its sheath. In the place where you were created, in the land of your ancestry, I will judge you.
chapters.zh: 你将刀收入鞘吧。在你受造之处，生长之地，我必刑罚你。

chapters.en: I will pour out my wrath on you and breathe out my fiery anger against you; I will deliver you into the hands of brutal men, men skilled in destruction.
chapters.zh: 我必将我的恼恨倒在你身上，将我烈怒的火喷在你身上。又将你交在善于杀灭的畜类人手中。

chapters.en: You will be fuel for the fire, your blood will be shed in your land, you will be remembered no more; for I the LORD have spoken.’ ”
chapters.zh: 你必当柴被火焚烧，你的血必流在国中，你必不再被记念，因为这是我耶和华说的。

chapters.en: The word of the LORD came to me:
chapters.zh: 耶和华的话又临到我说，

chapters.en: “Son of man, will you judge her? Will you judge this city of bloodshed? Then confront her with all her detestable practices
chapters.zh: 人子阿，你要审问审问这流人血的城吗？当使她知道她一切可憎的事。

chapters.en: and say: ‘This is what the Sovereign LORD says: You city that brings on herself doom by shedding blood in her midst and defiles herself by making idols,
chapters.zh: 你要说，主耶和华如此说，哎。这城有流人血的事在其中，叫她受报的日期来到，又作偶像玷污自己，陷害自己。

chapters.en: you have become guilty because of the blood you have shed and have become defiled by the idols you have made. You have brought your days to a close, and the end of your years has come. Therefore I will make you an object of scorn to the nations and a laughingstock to all the countries.
chapters.zh: 你因流了人的血，就为有罪。你作了偶像，就玷污自己，使你受报之日临近，报应之年来到。所以我叫你受列国的凌辱和列邦的讥诮。

chapters.en: Those who are near and those who are far away will mock you, you infamous city, full of turmoil.
chapters.zh: 你这名臭，多乱的城阿，那些离你近，离你远的都必讥诮你。

chapters.en: “ ‘See how each of the princes of Israel who are in you uses his power to shed blood.
chapters.zh: 看哪，以色列的首领各逞其能，在你中间流人之血。

chapters.en: In you they have treated father and mother with contempt; in you they have oppressed the foreigner and mistreated the fatherless and the widow.
chapters.zh: 在你中间有轻慢父母的，有欺压寄居的，有亏负孤儿寡妇的。

chapters.en: You have despised my holy things and desecrated my Sabbaths.
chapters.zh: 你藐视了我的圣物，干犯了我的安息日。

chapters.en: In you are slanderers who are bent on shedding blood; in you are those who eat at the mountain shrines and commit lewd acts.
chapters.zh: 在你中间有谗谤人，流人血的。有在山上吃过祭偶像之物的，有行淫乱的。

chapters.en: In you are those who dishonor their father’s bed; in you are those who violate women during their period, when they are ceremonially unclean.
chapters.zh: 在你中间有露继母下体羞辱父亲的，有玷辱月经不洁净之妇人的。

chapters.en: In you one man commits a detestable offense with his neighbor’s wife, another shamefully defiles his daughter-in-law, and another violates his sister, his own father’s daughter.
chapters.zh: 这人与邻舍的妻行可憎的事。那人贪淫玷污儿妇。还有玷辱同父之姐妹的。

chapters.en: In you are people who accept bribes to shed blood; you take interest and make a profit from the poor. You extort unjust gain from your neighbors. And you have forgotten me, declares the Sovereign LORD.
chapters.zh: 在你中间有为流人血受贿赂的。有向借钱的弟兄取利，向借粮的弟兄多要的。且因贪得无餍，欺压邻舍夺取财物，竟忘了我。这是主耶和华说的。

chapters.en: “ ‘I will surely strike my hands together at the unjust gain you have made and at the blood you have shed in your midst.
chapters.zh: 看哪，我因你所得不义之财和你中间所流的血，就拍掌叹息。

chapters.en: Will your courage endure or your hands be strong in the day I deal with you? I the LORD have spoken, and I will do it.
chapters.zh: 到了我惩罚你的日子，你的心还能忍受吗？你的手还能有力吗？我耶和华说了这话，就必照着行。

chapters.en: I will disperse you among the nations and scatter you through the countries; and I will put an end to your uncleanness.
chapters.zh: 我必将你分散在列国，四散在列邦。我也必从你中间除掉你的污秽。

chapters.en: When you have been defiled in the eyes of the nations, you will know that I am the LORD.’ ”
chapters.zh: 你必在列国人的眼前因自己所行的被亵渎，你就知道我是耶和华。

chapters.en: Then the word of the LORD came to me:
chapters.zh: 耶和华的话临到我说，

chapters.en: “Son of man, the people of Israel have become dross to me; all of them are the copper, tin, iron and lead left inside a furnace. They are but the dross of silver.
chapters.zh: 人子阿，以色列家在我看为渣滓。他们都是炉中的铜，锡，铁，铅，都是银渣滓。

chapters.en: Therefore this is what the Sovereign LORD says: ‘Because you have all become dross, I will gather you into Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 所以主耶和华如此说，因你们都成为渣滓，我必聚集你们在耶路撒冷中。

chapters.en: As silver, copper, iron, lead and tin are gathered into a furnace to be melted with a fiery blast, so will I gather you in my anger and my wrath and put you inside the city and melt you.
chapters.zh: 人怎样将银，铜，铁，铅，锡聚在炉中，吹火熔化。照样，我也要发怒气和忿怒，将你们聚集放在城中，熔化你们。

chapters.en: I will gather you and I will blow on you with my fiery wrath, and you will be melted inside her.
chapters.zh: 我必聚集你们，把我烈怒的火吹在你们身上，你们就在其中熔化。

chapters.en: As silver is melted in a furnace, so you will be melted inside her, and you will know that I the LORD have poured out my wrath on you.’ ”
chapters.zh: 银子怎样熔化在炉中，你们也必照样熔化在城中，你们就知道我耶和华是将忿怒倒在你们身上了。

chapters.en: Again the word of the LORD came to me:
chapters.zh: 耶和华的话临到我说，

chapters.en: “Son of man, say to the land, ‘You are a land that has not been cleansed or rained on in the day of wrath.’
chapters.zh: 人子阿，你要对这地说，你是未得洁净之地，在恼恨的日子也没有雨下在你以上。

chapters.en: There is a conspiracy of her princes within her like a roaring lion tearing its prey; they devour people, take treasures and precious things and make many widows within her.
chapters.zh: 其中的先知同谋背叛，如咆哮的狮子抓撕掠物。他们吞灭人民，抢夺财宝，使这地多有寡妇。

chapters.en: Her priests do violence to my law and profane my holy things; they do not distinguish between the holy and the common; they teach that there is no difference between the unclean and the clean; and they shut their eyes to the keeping of my Sabbaths, so that I am profaned among them.
chapters.zh: 其中的祭司强解我的律法，亵渎我的圣物，不分别圣的和俗的，也不使人分辨洁净的和不洁净的，又遮眼不顾我的安息日。我也在他们中间被亵慢。

chapters.en: Her officials within her are like wolves tearing their prey; they shed blood and kill people to make unjust gain.
chapters.zh: 其中的首领仿佛豺狼抓撕掠物，杀人流血，伤害人命，要得不义之财。

chapters.en: Her prophets whitewash these deeds for them by false visions and lying divinations. They say, ‘This is what the Sovereign LORD says’—when the LORD has not spoken.
chapters.zh: 其中的先知为百姓用未泡透的灰抹墙，就是为他们见虚假的异象，用谎诈的占卜，说，主耶和华如此说，其实耶和华没有说。

chapters.en: The people of the land practice extortion and commit robbery; they oppress the poor and needy and mistreat the foreigner, denying them justice.
chapters.zh: 国内众民一味地欺压，惯行抢夺，亏负困苦穷乏的，背理欺压寄居的。

chapters.en: “I looked for someone among them who would build up the wall and stand before me in the gap on behalf of the land so I would not have to destroy it, but I found no one.
chapters.zh: 我在他们中间寻找一人重修墙垣，在我面前为这国站在破口防堵，使我不灭绝这国，却找不着一个。

chapters.en: So I will pour out my wrath on them and consume them with my fiery anger, bringing down on their own heads all they have done, declares the Sovereign LORD.”
chapters.zh: 所以我将恼恨倒在他们身上，用烈怒的火灭了他们，照他们所行的报应在他们头上。这是主耶和华说的。

chapters.en: The word of the LORD came to me:
chapters.zh: 耶和华的话又临到我说，

chapters.en: “Son of man, there were two women, daughters of the same mother.
chapters.zh: 人子阿，有两个女子，是一母所生，

chapters.en: They became prostitutes in Egypt, engaging in prostitution from their youth. In that land their breasts were fondled and their virgin bosoms caressed.
chapters.zh: 她们在埃及行邪淫，在幼年时行邪淫。她们在那里作处女的时候，有人拥抱她们的怀，抚摸她们的乳。

chapters.en: The older was named Oholah, and her sister was Oholibah. They were mine and gave birth to sons and daughters. Oholah is Samaria, and Oholibah is Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 她们的名字，姐姐名叫阿荷拉，妹妹名叫阿荷利巴。她们都归于我，生了儿女。论到她们的名字，阿荷拉就是撒玛利亚，阿荷利巴就是耶路撒冷。

chapters.en: “Oholah engaged in prostitution while she was still mine; and she lusted after her lovers, the Assyrians—warriors
chapters.zh: 阿荷拉归我之后行邪淫，贪恋所爱的人，就是她的邻邦亚述人。

chapters.en: clothed in blue, governors and commanders, all of them handsome young men, and mounted horsemen.
chapters.zh: 这些人都穿蓝衣，作省长，副省长，都骑着马，是可爱的少年人。

chapters.en: She gave herself as a prostitute to all the elite of the Assyrians and defiled herself with all the idols of everyone she lusted after.
chapters.zh: 阿荷拉就与亚述人中最美的男子放纵淫行，她因所恋爱之人的一切偶像，玷污自己。

chapters.en: She did not give up the prostitution she began in Egypt, when during her youth men slept with her, caressed her virgin bosom and poured out their lust on her.
chapters.zh: 自从在埃及的时候，她就没有离开淫乱，因为她年幼作处女的时候，埃及人与她行淫，抚摸她的乳，纵欲与她行淫。

chapters.en: “Therefore I delivered her into the hands of her lovers, the Assyrians, for whom she lusted.
chapters.zh: 因此，我将她交在她所爱的人手中，就是她所恋爱的亚述人手中。

chapters.en: They stripped her naked, took away her sons and daughters and killed her with the sword. She became a byword among women, and punishment was inflicted on her.
chapters.zh: 他们就露了她的下体，掳掠她的儿女，用刀杀了她，使她在妇女中留下臭名，因他们向她施行审判。

chapters.en: “Her sister Oholibah saw this, yet in her lust and prostitution she was more depraved than her sister.
chapters.zh: 她妹妹阿荷利巴虽然看见了，却还贪恋，比她姐姐更丑。行淫乱比她姐姐更多。

chapters.en: She too lusted after the Assyrians—governors and commanders, warriors in full dress, mounted horsemen, all handsome young men.
chapters.zh: 她贪恋邻邦的亚述人，就是穿极华美的衣服，骑着马的省长，副省长，都是可爱的少年人。

chapters.en: I saw that she too defiled herself; both of them went the same way.
chapters.zh: 我看见她被玷污了，她姐妹二人同行一路。

chapters.en: “But she carried her prostitution still further. She saw men portrayed on a wall, figures of Chaldeans portrayed in red,
chapters.zh: 阿荷利巴又加增淫行，因她看见人像画在墙上，就是用丹色所画迦勒底人的像，

chapters.en: with belts around their waists and flowing turbans on their heads; all of them looked like Babylonian chariot officers, natives of Chaldea.
chapters.zh: 腰间系着带子，头上有下垂的裹头巾，都是军长的形状，仿照巴比伦人的形像。他们的故土就是迦勒底。

chapters.en: As soon as she saw them, she lusted after them and sent messengers to them in Chaldea.
chapters.zh: 阿荷利巴一看见就贪恋他们，打发使者往迦勒底去见他们。

chapters.en: Then the Babylonians came to her, to the bed of love, and in their lust they defiled her. After she had been defiled by them, she turned away from them in disgust.
chapters.zh: 巴比伦人就来登她爱情的床，与她行淫玷污她。她被玷污，随后心里与他们生疏。

chapters.en: When she carried on her prostitution openly and exposed her naked body, I turned away from her in disgust, just as I had turned away from her sister.
chapters.zh: 这样，她显露淫行，又显露下体。我心就与她生疏，像先前与她姐姐生疏一样。

chapters.en: Yet she became more and more promiscuous as she recalled the days of her youth, when she was a prostitute in Egypt.
chapters.zh: 她还加增她的淫行，追念她幼年在埃及地行邪淫的日子，

chapters.en: There she lusted after her lovers, whose genitals were like those of donkeys and whose emission was like that of horses.
chapters.zh: 贪恋情人身壮精足，如驴如马。

chapters.en: So you longed for the lewdness of your youth, when in Egypt your bosom was caressed and your young breasts fondled.
chapters.zh: 这样，你就想起你幼年的淫行。那时，埃及人拥抱你的怀，抚摸你的乳。

chapters.en: “Therefore, Oholibah, this is what the Sovereign LORD says: I will stir up your lovers against you, those you turned away from in disgust, and I will bring them against you from every side—
chapters.zh: 阿荷利巴阿，主耶和华如此说，我必激动你先爱而后生疏的人来攻击你。我必使他们来，在你四围攻击你。

chapters.en: the Babylonians and all the Chaldeans, the men of Pekod and Shoa and Koa, and all the Assyrians with them, handsome young men, all of them governors and commanders, chariot officers and men of high rank, all mounted on horses.
chapters.zh: 所来的就是巴比伦人，迦勒底的众人，比割人，书亚人，哥亚人，同着他们的还有亚述众人，乃是作省长，副省长，作军长有名声的，都骑着马，是可爱的少年人。

chapters.en: They will come against you with weapons, chariots and wagons and with a throng of people; they will take up positions against you on every side with large and small shields and with helmets. I will turn you over to them for punishment, and they will punish you according to their standards.
chapters.zh: 他们必带兵器，战车，辎重车，率领大众来攻击你。他们要拿大小盾牌，顶盔摆阵，在你四围攻击你。我要将审判的事交给他们，他们必按着自己的条例审判你。

chapters.en: I will direct my jealous anger against you, and they will deal with you in fury. They will cut off your noses and your ears, and those of you who are left will fall by the sword. They will take away your sons and daughters, and those of you who are left will be consumed by fire.
chapters.zh: 我必以忌恨攻击你。他们必以忿怒办你。他们必割去你的鼻子和耳朵。你遗留（或作余剩下同）的人必倒在刀下。他们必掳去你的儿女。你所遗留的必被火焚烧。

chapters.en: They will also strip you of your clothes and take your fine jewelry.
chapters.zh: 他们必剥去你的衣服，夺取你华美的宝器。

chapters.en: So I will put a stop to the lewdness and prostitution you began in Egypt. You will not look on these things with longing or remember Egypt anymore.
chapters.zh: 这样，我必使你的淫行和你从埃及地染来的淫乱止息了，使你不再仰望亚述，也不再追念埃及。

chapters.en: “For this is what the Sovereign LORD says: I am about to deliver you into the hands of those you hate, to those you turned away from in disgust.
chapters.zh: 主耶和华如此说，我必将你交在你所恨恶的人手中，就是你心与他生疏的人手中。

chapters.en: They will deal with you in hatred and take away everything you have worked for. They will leave you stark naked, and the shame of your prostitution will be exposed. Your lewdness and promiscuity
chapters.zh: 他们必以恨恶办你，夺取你一切劳碌得来的，留下你赤身露体。你淫乱的下体，连你的淫行，带你的淫乱，都被显露。

chapters.en: have brought this on you, because you lusted after the nations and defiled yourself with their idols.
chapters.zh: 人必向你行这些事。因为你随从外邦人行邪淫，被他们的偶像玷污了。

chapters.en: You have gone the way of your sister; so I will put her cup into your hand.
chapters.zh: 你走了你姐姐所走的路，所以我必将她的杯交在你手中。

chapters.en: “This is what the Sovereign LORD says: “You will drink your sister’s cup, a cup large and deep; it will bring scorn and derision, for it holds so much.
chapters.zh: 主耶和华如此说，你必喝你姐姐所喝的杯。那杯又深又广，盛得甚多，使你被人嗤笑讥刺。

chapters.en: You will be filled with drunkenness and sorrow, the cup of ruin and desolation, the cup of your sister Samaria.
chapters.zh: 你必酩酊大醉，满有愁苦，喝干你姐姐撒玛利亚的杯，就是令人惊骇凄凉的杯。

chapters.en: You will drink it and drain it dry and chew on its pieces— and you will tear your breasts. I have spoken, declares the Sovereign LORD.
chapters.zh: 你必喝这杯，以致喝尽。杯破又龈杯片，撕裂自己的乳。因为这事我曾说过。这是主耶和华说的。

chapters.en: “Therefore this is what the Sovereign LORD says: Since you have forgotten me and turned your back on me, you must bear the consequences of your lewdness and prostitution.”
chapters.zh: 主耶和华如此说，因你忘记我，将我丢在背后，所以你要担当你淫行和淫乱的报应。

chapters.en: The LORD said to me: “Son of man, will you judge Oholah and Oholibah? Then confront them with their detestable practices,
chapters.zh: 耶和华又对我说，人子阿，你要审问阿荷拉与阿荷利巴吗？当指出她们所行可憎的事。

chapters.en: for they have committed adultery and blood is on their hands. They committed adultery with their idols; they even sacrificed their children, whom they bore to me, as food for them.
chapters.zh: 她们行淫，手中有杀人的血，又与偶像行淫，并使她们为我所生的儿女经火烧给偶像。

chapters.en: They have also done this to me: At that same time they defiled my sanctuary and desecrated my Sabbaths.
chapters.zh: 此外，她们还有向我所行的，就是同日玷污我的圣所，干犯我的安息日。

chapters.en: On the very day they sacrificed their children to their idols, they entered my sanctuary and desecrated it. That is what they did in my house.
chapters.zh: 她们杀了儿女献与偶像，当天又入我的圣所，将圣所亵渎了。她们在我殿中所行的乃是如此。

chapters.en: “They even sent messengers for men who came from far away, and when they arrived you bathed yourself for them, applied eye makeup and put on your jewelry.
chapters.zh: 况且你们二妇打发使者去请远方人。使者到他们那里，他们就来了。你们为他们沐浴己身，粉饰眼目，佩戴妆饰，

chapters.en: You sat on an elegant couch, with a table spread before it on which you had placed the incense and olive oil that belonged to me.
chapters.zh: 坐在华美的床上，前面摆设桌案，将我的香料膏油摆在其上。

chapters.en: “The noise of a carefree crowd was around her; drunkards were brought from the desert along with men from the rabble, and they put bracelets on the wrists of the woman and her sister and beautiful crowns on their heads.
chapters.zh: 在那里有群众安逸欢乐的声音，并有粗俗的人和酒徒从旷野同来，把镯子戴在二妇的手上，把华冠戴在她们的头上。

chapters.en: Then I said about the one worn out by adultery, ‘Now let them use her as a prostitute, for that is all she is.’
chapters.zh: 我论这行淫衰老的妇人说，现在人还要与她行淫，她也要与人行淫。

chapters.en: And they slept with her. As men sleep with a prostitute, so they slept with those lewd women, Oholah and Oholibah.
chapters.zh: 人与阿荷拉，并阿荷利巴二淫妇苟合，好像与妓女苟合。

chapters.en: But righteous judges will sentence them to the punishment of women who commit adultery and shed blood, because they are adulterous and blood is on their hands.
chapters.zh: 必有义人，照审判淫妇和流人血的妇人之例，审判她们。因为她们是淫妇，手中有杀人的血。

chapters.en: “This is what the Sovereign LORD says: Bring a mob against them and give them over to terror and plunder.
chapters.zh: 主耶和华如此说，我必使多人来攻击她们，使她们抛来抛去，被人抢夺。

chapters.en: The mob will stone them and cut them down with their swords; they will kill their sons and daughters and burn down their houses.
chapters.zh: 这些人必用石头打死她们，用刀剑杀害她们，又杀戮她们的儿女，用火焚烧她们的房屋。

chapters.en: “So I will put an end to lewdness in the land, that all women may take warning and not imitate you.
chapters.zh: 这样，我必使淫行从境内止息，好叫一切妇人都受警戒，不效法你们的淫行。

chapters.en: You will suffer the penalty for your lewdness and bear the consequences of your sins of idolatry. Then you will know that I am the Sovereign LORD.”
chapters.zh: 人必照着你们的淫行报应你们。你们要担当拜偶像的罪，就知道我是主耶和华。

chapters.en: In the ninth year, in the tenth month on the tenth day, the word of the LORD came to me:
chapters.zh: 第九年十月初十日，耶和华的话又临到我说，

chapters.en: “Son of man, record this date, this very date, because the king of Babylon has laid siege to Jerusalem this very day.
chapters.zh: 人子阿，今日正是巴比伦王就近耶路撒冷的日子，你要将这日记下，

chapters.en: Tell this rebellious people a parable and say to them: ‘This is what the Sovereign LORD says: “ ‘Put on the cooking pot; put it on and pour water into it.
chapters.zh: 要向这悖逆之家设比喻说，主耶和华如此说，将锅放在火上，放好了，就倒水在其中。

chapters.en: Put into it the pieces of meat, all the choice pieces—the leg and the shoulder. Fill it with the best of these bones;
chapters.zh: 将肉块，就是一切肥美的肉块，腿，和肩都聚在其中，拿美好的骨头把锅装满。

chapters.en: take the pick of the flock. Pile wood beneath it for the bones; bring it to a boil and cook the bones in it.
chapters.zh: 取羊群中最好的，将柴堆在锅下，使锅开滚，好把骨头煮在其中。

chapters.en: “ ‘For this is what the Sovereign LORD says: “ ‘Woe to the city of bloodshed, to the pot now encrusted, whose deposit will not go away! Take the meat out piece by piece in whatever order it comes.
chapters.zh: 主耶和华如此说，祸哉。这流人血的城，就是长锈的锅。其中的锈未曾除掉，须要将肉块从其中一一取出来，不必为它拈阄。

chapters.en: “ ‘For the blood she shed is in her midst: She poured it on the bare rock; she did not pour it on the ground, where the dust would cover it.
chapters.zh: 城中所流的血倒在净光的磐石上，不倒在地上，用土掩盖。

chapters.en: To stir up wrath and take revenge I put her blood on the bare rock, so that it would not be covered.
chapters.zh: 这城中所流的血倒在净光的磐石上，不得掩盖，乃是出于我，为要发忿怒施行报应。

chapters.en: “ ‘Therefore this is what the Sovereign LORD says: “ ‘Woe to the city of bloodshed! I, too, will pile the wood high.
chapters.zh: 所以主耶和华如此说，祸哉。这流人血的城，我也必大堆火柴，

chapters.en: So heap on the wood and kindle the fire. Cook the meat well, mixing in the spices; and let the bones be charred.
chapters.zh: 添上木柴，使火着旺，将肉煮烂，把汤熬浓，使骨头烤焦。

chapters.en: Then set the empty pot on the coals till it becomes hot and its copper glows, so that its impurities may be melted and its deposit burned away.
chapters.zh: 把锅倒空坐在炭火上，使锅烧热，使铜烧红，熔化其中的污秽，除净其上的锈。

chapters.en: It has frustrated all efforts; its heavy deposit has not been removed, not even by fire.
chapters.zh: 这锅劳碌疲乏，所长的大锈仍未除掉。这锈就是用火也不能除掉。

chapters.en: “ ‘Now your impurity is lewdness. Because I tried to cleanse you but you would not be cleansed from your impurity, you will not be clean again until my wrath against you has subsided.
chapters.zh: 在你污秽中有淫行，我洁净你，你却不洁净。你的污秽再不能洁净，直等我向你发的忿怒止息。

chapters.en: “ ‘I the LORD have spoken. The time has come for me to act. I will not hold back; I will not have pity, nor will I relent. You will be judged according to your conduct and your actions, declares the Sovereign LORD.’ ”
chapters.zh: 我耶和华说过的必定成就，必照话而行，必不返回，必不顾惜，也不后悔。人必照你的举动行为审判你。这是主耶和华说的。

chapters.en: The word of the LORD came to me:
chapters.zh: 耶和华的话又临到我说，

chapters.en: “Son of man, with one blow I am about to take away from you the delight of your eyes. Yet do not lament or weep or shed any tears.
chapters.zh: 人子阿，我要将你眼目所喜爱的忽然取去，你却不可悲哀哭泣，也不可流泪，

chapters.en: Groan quietly; do not mourn for the dead. Keep your turban fastened and your sandals on your feet; do not cover your mustache and beard or eat the customary food of mourners.”
chapters.zh: 只可叹息，不可出声，不可办理丧事。头上仍勒裹头巾，脚上仍穿鞋，不可蒙着嘴唇，也不可吃吊丧的食物。

chapters.en: So I spoke to the people in the morning, and in the evening my wife died. The next morning I did as I had been commanded.
chapters.zh: 于是我将这事早晨告诉百姓，晚上我的妻就死了。次日早晨我便遵命而行。

chapters.en: Then the people asked me, “Won’t you tell us what these things have to do with us? Why are you acting like this?”
chapters.zh: 百姓问我说，你这样行与我们有什么关系，你不告诉我们吗？

chapters.en: So I said to them, “The word of the LORD came to me:
chapters.zh: 我回答他们，耶和华的话临到我说，

chapters.en: Say to the people of Israel, ‘This is what the Sovereign LORD says: I am about to desecrate my sanctuary—the stronghold in which you take pride, the delight of your eyes, the object of your affection. The sons and daughters you left behind will fall by the sword.
chapters.zh: 你告诉以色列家，主耶和华如此说，我必使我的圣所，就是你们势力所夸耀，眼里所喜爱，心中所爱惜的被亵渎，并且你们所遗留的儿女必倒在刀下。

chapters.en: And you will do as I have done. You will not cover your mustache and beard or eat the customary food of mourners.
chapters.zh: 那时，你们必行我仆人所行的，不蒙着嘴唇，也不吃吊丧的食物。

chapters.en: You will keep your turbans on your heads and your sandals on your feet. You will not mourn or weep but will waste away because of your sins and groan among yourselves.
chapters.zh: 你们仍要头上勒裹头巾，脚上穿鞋。不可悲哀哭泣。你们必因自己的罪孽相对叹息，渐渐消灭。

chapters.en: Ezekiel will be a sign to you; you will do just as he has done. When this happens, you will know that I am the Sovereign LORD.’
chapters.zh: 以西结必这样为你们作预兆。凡他所行的，你们也必照样行。那事来到，你们就知道我是主耶和华。

chapters.en: “And you, son of man, on the day I take away their stronghold, their joy and glory, the delight of their eyes, their heart’s desire, and their sons and daughters as well—
chapters.zh: 人子阿，我除掉他们所倚靠，所欢喜的荣耀，并眼中所喜爱，心里所重看的儿女。

chapters.en: on that day a fugitive will come to tell you the news.
chapters.zh: 那日逃脱的人岂不来到你这里，使你耳闻这事吗？

chapters.en: At that time your mouth will be opened; you will speak with him and will no longer be silent. So you will be a sign to them, and they will know that I am the LORD.”
chapters.zh: 你必向逃脱的人开口说话，不再哑口。你必这样为他们作预兆，他们就知道我是耶和华。

chapters.en: The word of the LORD came to me:
chapters.zh: 耶和华的话临到我说，

chapters.en: “Son of man, set your face against the Ammonites and prophesy against them.
chapters.zh: 人子阿，你要面向亚扪人说预言，攻击他们，

chapters.en: Say to them, ‘Hear the word of the Sovereign LORD. This is what the Sovereign LORD says: Because you said “Aha!” over my sanctuary when it was desecrated and over the land of Israel when it was laid waste and over the people of Judah when they went into exile,
chapters.zh: 说，你们当听主耶和华的话。主耶和华如此说，我的圣所被亵渎，以色列地变荒凉，犹大家被掳掠。那时，你便因这些事说，阿哈。

chapters.en: therefore I am going to give you to the people of the East as a possession. They will set up their camps and pitch their tents among you; they will eat your fruit and drink your milk.
chapters.zh: 所以我必将你的地交给东方人为业。他们必在你的地上安营居住，吃你的果子，喝你的奶。

chapters.en: I will turn Rabbah into a pasture for camels and Ammon into a resting place for sheep. Then you will know that I am the LORD.
chapters.zh: 我必使拉巴为骆驼场，使亚扪人的地为羊群躺卧之处，你们就知道我是耶和华。

chapters.en: For this is what the Sovereign LORD says: Because you have clapped your hands and stamped your feet, rejoicing with all the malice of your heart against the land of Israel,
chapters.zh: 主耶和华如此说，因你拍手顿足，以满心的恨恶向以色列地欢喜，

chapters.en: therefore I will stretch out my hand against you and give you as plunder to the nations. I will wipe you out from among the nations and exterminate you from the countries. I will destroy you, and you will know that I am the LORD.’ ”
chapters.zh: 所以我伸手攻击你，将你交给列国作为掳物。我必从万民中剪除你，使你从万国中败亡。我必除灭你，你就知道我是耶和华。

chapters.en: “This is what the Sovereign LORD says: ‘Because Moab and Seir said, “Look, Judah has become like all the other nations,”
chapters.zh: 主耶和华如此说，因摩押和西珥人说，看哪，犹大家与列国无异，

chapters.en: therefore I will expose the flank of Moab, beginning at its frontier towns—Beth Jeshimoth, Baal Meon and Kiriathaim—the glory of that land.
chapters.zh: 所以我要破开摩押边界上的城邑，就是摩押人看为本国之荣耀的伯耶西末，巴力免，基列亭，

chapters.en: I will give Moab along with the Ammonites to the people of the East as a possession, so that the Ammonites will not be remembered among the nations;
chapters.zh: 好使东方人来攻击亚扪人。我必将亚扪人之地交给他们为业，使亚扪人在列国中不再被记念。

chapters.en: and I will inflict punishment on Moab. Then they will know that I am the LORD.’ ”
chapters.zh: 我必向摩押施行审判，他们就知道我是耶和华。

chapters.en: “This is what the Sovereign LORD says: ‘Because Edom took revenge on Judah and became very guilty by doing so,
chapters.zh: 主耶和华如此说，因为以东报仇雪恨，攻击犹大家，向他们报仇，大大有罪，

chapters.en: therefore this is what the Sovereign LORD says: I will stretch out my hand against Edom and kill both man and beast. I will lay it waste, and from Teman to Dedan they will fall by the sword.
chapters.zh: 所以主耶和华如此说，我必伸手攻击以东，剪除人与牲畜，使以东从提幔起，人必倒在刀下，地要变为荒凉，直到底但。

chapters.en: I will take vengeance on Edom by the hand of my people Israel, and they will deal with Edom in accordance with my anger and my wrath; they will know my vengeance, declares the Sovereign LORD.’ ”
chapters.zh: 我必借我民以色列的手报复以东。以色列民必照我的怒气，按我的忿怒在以东施报，以东人就知道是我施报。这是主耶和华说的。

chapters.en: “This is what the Sovereign LORD says: ‘Because the Philistines acted in vengeance and took revenge with malice in their hearts, and with ancient hostility sought to destroy Judah,
chapters.zh: 主耶和华如此说，因非利士人向犹大人报仇，就是以恨恶的心报仇雪恨，永怀仇恨，要毁灭他们，

chapters.en: therefore this is what the Sovereign LORD says: I am about to stretch out my hand against the Philistines, and I will wipe out the Kerethites and destroy those remaining along the coast.
chapters.zh: 所以主耶和华如此说，我必伸手攻击非利士人，剪除基利提人，灭绝沿海剩下的居民。

chapters.en: I will carry out great vengeance on them and punish them in my wrath. Then they will know that I am the LORD, when I take vengeance on them.’ ”
chapters.zh: 我向他们大施报应，发怒斥责他们。我报复他们的时候，他们就知道我是耶和华。

chapters.en: In the eleventh month of the twelfth year, on the first day of the month, the word of the LORD came to me:
chapters.zh: 第十一年十一月初一日，耶和华的话临到我说，

chapters.en: “Son of man, because Tyre has said of Jerusalem, ‘Aha! The gate to the nations is broken, and its doors have swung open to me; now that she lies in ruins I will prosper,’
chapters.zh: 人子阿，因推罗向耶路撒冷说，阿哈，那作众民之门的已经破坏，向我开放。她既变为荒场，我必丰盛。

chapters.en: therefore this is what the Sovereign LORD says: I am against you, Tyre, and I will bring many nations against you, like the sea casting up its waves.
chapters.zh: 所以，主耶和华如此说，推罗阿，我必与你为敌，使许多国民上来攻击你，如同海使波浪涌上来一样。

chapters.en: They will destroy the walls of Tyre and pull down her towers; I will scrape away her rubble and make her a bare rock.
chapters.zh: 他们必破坏推罗的墙垣，拆毁她的城楼。我也要刮净尘土，使她成为净光的磐石。

chapters.en: Out in the sea she will become a place to spread fishnets, for I have spoken, declares the Sovereign LORD. She will become plunder for the nations,
chapters.zh: 她必在海中作晒网的地方，也必成为列国的掳物。这是主耶和华说的。

chapters.en: and her settlements on the mainland will be ravaged by the sword. Then they will know that I am the LORD.
chapters.zh: 属推罗城邑的居民（城邑的居民原文作田间的众女八节同）必被刀剑杀灭，他们就知道我是耶和华。

chapters.en: “For this is what the Sovereign LORD says: From the north I am going to bring against Tyre Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, king of kings, with horses and chariots, with horsemen and a great army.
chapters.zh: 主耶和华如此说，我必使诸王之王的巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒率领马匹车辆，马兵，军队，和许多人民从北方来攻击你推罗。

chapters.en: He will ravage your settlements on the mainland with the sword; he will set up siege works against you, build a ramp up to your walls and raise his shields against you.
chapters.zh: 他必用刀剑杀灭属你城邑的居民，也必造台筑垒举盾牌攻击你。

chapters.en: He will direct the blows of his battering rams against your walls and demolish your towers with his weapons.
chapters.zh: 他必安设撞城锤攻破你的墙垣，用铁器拆毁你的城楼。

chapters.en: His horses will be so many that they will cover you with dust. Your walls will tremble at the noise of the warhorses, wagons and chariots when he enters your gates as men enter a city whose walls have been broken through.
chapters.zh: 因他的马匹众多，尘土扬起遮蔽你。他进入你的城门，好像人进入已有破口之城。那时，你的墙垣必因骑马的和战车，辎重车的响声震动。

chapters.en: The hooves of his horses will trample all your streets; he will kill your people with the sword, and your strong pillars will fall to the ground.
chapters.zh: 他的马蹄必践踏你一切的街道，他必用刀杀戮你的居民。你坚固的柱子（或作柱像）必倒在地上。

chapters.en: They will plunder your wealth and loot your merchandise; they will break down your walls and demolish your fine houses and throw your stones, timber and rubble into the sea.
chapters.zh: 人必以你的财宝为掳物，以你的货财为掠物，破坏你的墙垣，拆毁你华美的房屋，将你的石头，木头，尘土都抛在水中。

chapters.en: I will put an end to your noisy songs, and the music of your harps will be heard no more.
chapters.zh: 我必使你唱歌的声音止息，人也不再听见你弹琴的声音。

chapters.en: I will make you a bare rock, and you will become a place to spread fishnets. You will never be rebuilt, for I the LORD have spoken, declares the Sovereign LORD.
chapters.zh: 我必使你成为净光的磐石，作晒网的地方。你不得再被建造，因为这是主耶和华说的。

chapters.en: “This is what the Sovereign LORD says to Tyre: Will not the coastlands tremble at the sound of your fall, when the wounded groan and the slaughter takes place in you?
chapters.zh: 主耶和华对推罗如此说，在你中间行杀戮，受伤之人唉哼的时候，因你倾倒的响声，海岛岂不都震动吗？

chapters.en: Then all the princes of the coast will step down from their thrones and lay aside their robes and take off their embroidered garments. Clothed with terror, they will sit on the ground, trembling every moment, appalled at you.
chapters.zh: 那时靠海的君王必都下位，除去朝服，脱下花衣，披上战兢，坐在地上，时刻发抖，为你惊骇。

chapters.en: Then they will take up a lament concerning you and say to you: “ ‘How you are destroyed, city of renown, peopled by men of the sea! You were a power on the seas, you and your citizens; you put your terror on all who lived there.
chapters.zh: 他们必为你作起哀歌说，你这有名之城，素为航海之人居住，在海上为最坚固的。平日你和居民使一切住在那里的人无不惊恐。现在何竟毁灭了。

chapters.en: Now the coastlands tremble on the day of your fall; the islands in the sea are terrified at your collapse.’
chapters.zh: 如今在你这倾覆的日子，海岛都必战兢。海中的群岛见你归于无有就都惊惶。

chapters.en: “This is what the Sovereign LORD says: When I make you a desolate city, like cities no longer inhabited, and when I bring the ocean depths over you and its vast waters cover you,
chapters.zh: 主耶和华如此说，推罗阿，我使你变为荒凉，如无人居住的城邑。又使深水漫过你，大水淹没你。

chapters.en: then I will bring you down with those who go down to the pit, to the people of long ago. I will make you dwell in the earth below, as in ancient ruins, with those who go down to the pit, and you will not return or take your place in the land of the living.
chapters.zh: 那时，我要叫你下入阴府，与古时的人一同在地的深处，久已荒凉之地居住，使你不再有居民。我也要在活人之地显荣耀（我也云云或作在活人之地不再有荣耀）。

chapters.en: I will bring you to a horrible end and you will be no more. You will be sought, but you will never again be found, declares the Sovereign LORD.”
chapters.zh: 我必叫你令人惊恐，不再存留于世。人虽寻找你，却永寻不见。这是主耶和华说的。

chapters.en: The word of the LORD came to me:
chapters.zh: 耶和华的话又临到我说，

chapters.en: “Son of man, take up a lament concerning Tyre.
chapters.zh: 人子阿，要为推罗作起哀歌，

chapters.en: Say to Tyre, situated at the gateway to the sea, merchant of peoples on many coasts, ‘This is what the Sovereign LORD says: “ ‘You say, Tyre, “I am perfect in beauty.”
chapters.zh: 说，你居住海口，是众民的商埠。你的交易通到许多的海岛。主耶和华如此说，推罗阿，你曾说，我是全然美丽的。

chapters.en: Your domain was on the high seas; your builders brought your beauty to perfection.
chapters.zh: 你的境界在海中，造你的使你全然美丽。

chapters.en: They made all your timbers of juniper from Senir ; they took a cedar from Lebanon to make a mast for you.
chapters.zh: 他们用示尼珥的松树作你的一切板，用利巴嫩的香柏树作桅杆，

chapters.en: Of oaks from Bashan they made your oars; of cypress wood from the coasts of Cyprus they made your deck, adorned with ivory.
chapters.zh: 用巴珊的橡树作你的桨，用象牙镶嵌基提海岛的黄杨木为坐板（坐板或作舱板）。

chapters.en: Fine embroidered linen from Egypt was your sail and served as your banner; your awnings were of blue and purple from the coasts of Elishah.
chapters.zh: 你的篷帆是用埃及绣花细麻布作的，可以作你的大旗。你的凉棚是用以利沙岛的蓝色，紫色布作的。

chapters.en: Men of Sidon and Arvad were your oarsmen; your skilled men, Tyre, were aboard as your sailors.
chapters.zh: 西顿和亚发的居民作你荡桨的。推罗阿，你中间的智慧人作掌舵的。

chapters.en: Veteran craftsmen of Byblos were on board as shipwrights to caulk your seams. All the ships of the sea and their sailors came alongside to trade for your wares.
chapters.zh: 迦巴勒的老者和聪明人都在你中间作补缝的。一切泛海的船只和水手都在你中间经营交易的事。

chapters.en: “ ‘Men of Persia, Lydia and Put served as soldiers in your army. They hung their shields and helmets on your walls, bringing you splendor.
chapters.zh: 波斯人，路德人，弗人在你军营中作战士。他们在你中间悬挂盾牌和头盔，彰显你的尊荣。

chapters.en: Men of Arvad and Helek guarded your walls on every side; men of Gammad were in your towers. They hung their shields around your walls; they brought your beauty to perfection.
chapters.zh: 亚发人和你的军队都在你四围的墙上，你的望楼也有勇士。他们悬挂盾牌，成全你的美丽。

chapters.en: “ ‘Tarshish did business with you because of your great wealth of goods; they exchanged silver, iron, tin and lead for your merchandise.
chapters.zh: 他施人因你多有各类的财物，就作你的客商，拿银，铁，锡，铅兑换你的货物。

chapters.en: “ ‘Greece, Tubal and Meshek did business with you; they traded human beings and articles of bronze for your wares.
chapters.zh: 雅完人，土巴人，米设人都与你交易。他们用人口和铜器兑换你的货物。

chapters.en: “ ‘Men of Beth Togarmah exchanged chariot horses, cavalry horses and mules for your merchandise.
chapters.zh: 陀迦玛族用马和战马并骡子兑换你的货物。

chapters.en: “ ‘The men of Rhodes traded with you, and many coastlands were your customers; they paid you with ivory tusks and ebony.
chapters.zh: 底但人与你交易，许多海岛作你的码头。他们拿象牙，乌木与你兑换（兑换或作进贡）。

chapters.en: “ ‘Aram did business with you because of your many products; they exchanged turquoise, purple fabric, embroidered work, fine linen, coral and rubies for your merchandise.
chapters.zh: 亚兰人因你的工作很多，就作你的客商。他们用绿宝石，紫色布绣货，细麻布，珊瑚，红宝石兑换你的货物。

chapters.en: “ ‘Judah and Israel traded with you; they exchanged wheat from Minnith and confections, honey, olive oil and balm for your wares.
chapters.zh: 犹大和以色列地的人都与你交易。他们用米匿的麦子，饼，蜜，油，乳香兑换你的货物。

chapters.en: “ ‘Damascus did business with you because of your many products and great wealth of goods. They offered wine from Helbon, wool from Zahar
chapters.zh: 大马色人因你的工作很多，又因你多有各类的财物，就拿黑本酒和白羊毛与你交易。

chapters.en: and casks of wine from Izal in exchange for your wares: wrought iron, cassia and calamus.
chapters.zh: 威但人和雅完人拿纺成的线，亮铁，桂皮，菖蒲兑换你的货物。

chapters.en: “ ‘Dedan traded in saddle blankets with you.
chapters.zh: 底但人用高贵的毯子，鞍，屉与你交易。

chapters.en: “ ‘Arabia and all the princes of Kedar were your customers; they did business with you in lambs, rams and goats.
chapters.zh: 亚拉伯人和基达的一切首领都作你的客商，用羊羔，公绵羊，公山羊与你交易。

chapters.en: “ ‘The merchants of Sheba and Raamah traded with you; for your merchandise they exchanged the finest of all kinds of spices and precious stones, and gold.
chapters.zh: 示巴和拉玛的商人与你交易，他们用各类上好的香料，各类的宝石，和黄金兑换你的货物。

chapters.en: “ ‘Harran, Kanneh and Eden and merchants of Sheba, Ashur and Kilmad traded with you.
chapters.zh: 哈兰人，干尼人，伊甸人，示巴的商人，和亚述人，基抹人与你交易。

chapters.en: In your marketplace they traded with you beautiful garments, blue fabric, embroidered work and multicolored rugs with cords twisted and tightly knotted.
chapters.zh: 这些商人以美好的货物包在绣花蓝色包袱内，又有华丽的衣服装在香柏木的箱子里，用绳捆着与你交易。

chapters.en: “ ‘The ships of Tarshish serve as carriers for your wares. You are filled with heavy cargo as you sail the sea.
chapters.zh: 他施的船只接连成帮为你运货，你便在海中丰富极其荣华。

chapters.en: Your oarsmen take you out to the high seas. But the east wind will break you to pieces far out at sea.
chapters.zh: 荡桨的已经把你荡到大水之处，东风在海中将你打破。

chapters.en: Your wealth, merchandise and wares, your mariners, sailors and shipwrights, your merchants and all your soldiers, and everyone else on board will sink into the heart of the sea on the day of your shipwreck.
chapters.zh: 你的资财，物件，货物，水手，掌舵的，补缝的，经营交易的，并你中间的战士和人民，在你破坏的日子必都沉在海中。

chapters.en: The shorelands will quake when your sailors cry out.
chapters.zh: 你掌舵的呼号之声一发，郊野都必震动。

chapters.en: All who handle the oars will abandon their ships; the mariners and all the sailors will stand on the shore.
chapters.zh: 凡荡桨的和水手，并一切泛海掌舵的，都必下船登岸。

chapters.en: They will raise their voice and cry bitterly over you; they will sprinkle dust on their heads and roll in ashes.
chapters.zh: 他们必为你放声痛哭，把尘土撒在头上，在灰中打滚。

chapters.en: They will shave their heads because of you and will put on sackcloth. They will weep over you with anguish of soul and with bitter mourning.
chapters.zh: 又为你使头上光秃，用麻布束腰，号啕痛哭，苦苦悲哀。

chapters.en: As they wail and mourn over you, they will take up a lament concerning you: “Who was ever silenced like Tyre, surrounded by the sea?”
chapters.zh: 他们哀号的时候，为你作起哀歌哀哭，说，有何城如推罗？有何城如她在海中成为寂寞的呢？

chapters.en: When your merchandise went out on the seas, you satisfied many nations; with your great wealth and your wares you enriched the kings of the earth.
chapters.zh: 你由海上运出货物，就使许多国民充足。你以许多资财，货物使地上的君王丰富。

chapters.en: Now you are shattered by the sea in the depths of the waters; your wares and all your company have gone down with you.
chapters.zh: 你在深水中被海浪打破的时候，你的货物和你中间的一切人民，就都沉下去了。

chapters.en: All who live in the coastlands are appalled at you; their kings shudder with horror and their faces are distorted with fear.
chapters.zh: 海岛的居民为你惊奇。他们的君王都甚恐慌，面带愁容。
