chapters.en: The merchants among the nations scoff at you; you have come to a horrible end and will be no more.’ ”
chapters.zh: 各国民中的客商都向你发嘶声。你令人惊恐，不再存留于世，直到永远。

chapters.en: The word of the LORD came to me:
chapters.zh: 耶和华的话又临到我说，

chapters.en: “Son of man, say to the ruler of Tyre, ‘This is what the Sovereign LORD says: “ ‘In the pride of your heart you say, “I am a god; I sit on the throne of a god in the heart of the seas.” But you are a mere mortal and not a god, though you think you are as wise as a god.
chapters.zh: 人子阿，你对推罗君王说，主耶和华如此说，因你心里高傲，说，我是神。我在海中坐神之位。你虽然居心自比神，也不过是人，并不是神。

chapters.en: Are you wiser than Daniel ? Is no secret hidden from you?
chapters.zh: 看哪，你比但以理更有智慧，什么秘事都不能向你隐藏。

chapters.en: By your wisdom and understanding you have gained wealth for yourself and amassed gold and silver in your treasuries.
chapters.zh: 你靠自己的智慧聪明得了金银财宝，收入库中。

chapters.en: By your great skill in trading you have increased your wealth, and because of your wealth your heart has grown proud.
chapters.zh: 你靠自己的大智慧和贸易增添资财，又因资财心里高傲。

chapters.en: “ ‘Therefore this is what the Sovereign LORD says: “ ‘Because you think you are wise, as wise as a god,
chapters.zh: 所以主耶和华如此说，因你居心自比神，

chapters.en: I am going to bring foreigners against you, the most ruthless of nations; they will draw their swords against your beauty and wisdom and pierce your shining splendor.
chapters.zh: 我必使外邦人，就是列国中的强暴人临到你这里。他们必拔刀砍坏你用智慧得来的美物，亵渎你的荣光。

chapters.en: They will bring you down to the pit, and you will die a violent death in the heart of the seas.
chapters.zh: 他们必使你下坑。你必死在海中，与被杀的人一样。

chapters.en: Will you then say, “I am a god,” in the presence of those who kill you? You will be but a mortal, not a god, in the hands of those who slay you.
chapters.zh: 在杀你的人面前你还能说我是神吗？其实你在杀害你的人手中，不过是人，并不是神。

chapters.en: You will die the death of the uncircumcised at the hands of foreigners. I have spoken, declares the Sovereign LORD.’ ”
chapters.zh: 你必死在外邦人手中，与未受割礼（或作不洁下同）的人一样，因为这是主耶和华说的。

chapters.en: The word of the LORD came to me:
chapters.zh: 耶和华的话临到我说，

chapters.en: “Son of man, take up a lament concerning the king of Tyre and say to him: ‘This is what the Sovereign LORD says: “ ‘You were the seal of perfection, full of wisdom and perfect in beauty.
chapters.zh: 人子阿，你为推罗王作起哀歌，说主耶和华如此说，你无所不备，智慧充足，全然美丽。

chapters.en: You were in Eden, the garden of God; every precious stone adorned you: carnelian, chrysolite and emerald, topaz, onyx and jasper, lapis lazuli, turquoise and beryl.Your settings and mountings were made of gold; on the day you were created they were prepared.
chapters.zh: 你曾在伊甸神的园中，佩戴各样宝石，就是红宝石，红璧玺，金钢石，水苍玉，红玛瑙，碧玉，蓝宝石，绿宝石，红玉，和黄金。又有精美的鼓笛在你那里，都是在你受造之日预备齐全的。

chapters.en: You were anointed as a guardian cherub, for so I ordained you. You were on the holy mount of God; you walked among the fiery stones.
chapters.zh: 你是那受膏遮掩约柜的基路伯。我将你安置在神的圣山上。你在发光如火的宝石中间往来。

chapters.en: You were blameless in your ways from the day you were created till wickedness was found in you.
chapters.zh: 你从受造之日所行的都完全，后来在你中间又察出不义。

chapters.en: Through your widespread trade you were filled with violence, and you sinned. So I drove you in disgrace from the mount of God, and I expelled you, guardian cherub, from among the fiery stones.
chapters.zh: 因你贸易很多，就被强暴的事充满，以致犯罪，所以我因你亵渎圣地，就从神的山驱逐你。遮掩约柜的基路伯阿，我已将你从发光如火的宝石中除灭。

chapters.en: Your heart became proud on account of your beauty, and you corrupted your wisdom because of your splendor. So I threw you to the earth; I made a spectacle of you before kings.
chapters.zh: 你因美丽心中高傲，又因荣光败坏智慧，我已将你摔倒在地，使你倒在君王面前，好叫他们目睹眼见。

chapters.en: By your many sins and dishonest trade you have desecrated your sanctuaries. So I made a fire come out from you, and it consumed you, and I reduced you to ashes on the ground in the sight of all who were watching.
chapters.zh: 你因罪孽众多，贸易不公，就亵渎你那里的圣所。故此，我使火从你中间发出，烧灭你，使你在所有观看的人眼前变为地上的炉灰。

chapters.en: All the nations who knew you are appalled at you; you have come to a horrible end and will be no more.’ ”
chapters.zh: 各国民中，凡认识你的，都必为你惊奇。你令人惊恐，不再存留于世，直到永远。

chapters.en: The word of the LORD came to me:
chapters.zh: 耶和华的话临到我说，

chapters.en: “Son of man, set your face against Sidon; prophesy against her
chapters.zh: 人子阿，你要向西顿预言攻击她，

chapters.en: and say: ‘This is what the Sovereign LORD says: “ ‘I am against you, Sidon, and among you I will display my glory. You will know that I am the LORD, when I inflict punishment on you and within you am proved to be holy.
chapters.zh: 说主耶和华如此说，西顿哪，我与你为敌，我必在你中间得荣耀。我在你中间施行审判，显为圣的时候，人就知道我是耶和华。

chapters.en: I will send a plague upon you and make blood flow in your streets. The slain will fall within you, with the sword against you on every side. Then you will know that I am the LORD.
chapters.zh: 我必使瘟疫进入西顿，使血流在她街上。被杀的必在其中仆倒，四围有刀剑临到她，人就知道我是耶和华。

chapters.en: “ ‘No longer will the people of Israel have malicious neighbors who are painful briers and sharp thorns. Then they will know that I am the Sovereign LORD.
chapters.zh: 四围恨恶以色列家的人，必不再向他们作刺人的荆棘，伤人的蒺藜，人就知道我是主耶和华。

chapters.en: “ ‘This is what the Sovereign LORD says: When I gather the people of Israel from the nations where they have been scattered, I will be proved holy through them in the sight of the nations. Then they will live in their own land, which I gave to my servant Jacob.
chapters.zh: 主耶和华如此说，我将分散在万民中的以色列家招聚回来，向他们在列邦人眼前显为圣的时候，他们就在我赐给我仆人雅各之地，仍然居住。

chapters.en: They will live there in safety and will build houses and plant vineyards; they will live in safety when I inflict punishment on all their neighbors who maligned them. Then they will know that I am the LORD their God.’ ”
chapters.zh: 他们要在这地上安然居住。我向四围恨恶他们的众人施行审判以后，他们要盖造房屋，栽种葡萄园，安然居住，就知道我是耶和华他们的神。

chapters.en: In the tenth year, in the tenth month on the twelfth day, the word of the LORD came to me:
chapters.zh: 第十年十月十二日，耶和华的话临到我说，

chapters.en: “Son of man, set your face against Pharaoh king of Egypt and prophesy against him and against all Egypt.
chapters.zh: 人子阿，你要向埃及王法老预言攻击他和埃及全地，

chapters.en: Speak to him and say: ‘This is what the Sovereign LORD says: “ ‘I am against you, Pharaoh king of Egypt, you great monster lying among your streams. You say, “The Nile belongs to me; I made it for myself.”
chapters.zh: 说主耶和华如此说，埃及王法老阿，我与你这卧在自己河中的大鱼为敌。你曾说，这河是我的，是我为自己造的。

chapters.en: But I will put hooks in your jaws and make the fish of your streams stick to your scales. I will pull you out from among your streams, with all the fish sticking to your scales.
chapters.zh: 我耶和华必用钩子钩住你的腮颊，又使江河中的鱼贴住你的鳞甲。我必将你和所有贴住你鳞甲的鱼，从江河中拉上来，

chapters.en: I will leave you in the desert, you and all the fish of your streams. You will fall on the open field and not be gathered or picked up. I will give you as food to the beasts of the earth and the birds of the sky.
chapters.zh: 把你并江河中的鱼都抛在旷野。你必倒在田间，不被收殓，不被掩埋。我已将你给地上野兽，空中飞鸟作食物。

chapters.en: Then all who live in Egypt will know that I am the LORD. “ ‘You have been a staff of reed for the people of Israel.
chapters.zh: 埃及一切的居民，因向以色列家成了芦苇的杖，就知道我是耶和华。

chapters.en: When they grasped you with their hands, you splintered and you tore open their shoulders; when they leaned on you, you broke and their backs were wrenched.
chapters.zh: 他们用手持住你，你就断折，伤了他们的肩。他们倚靠你，你就断折，闪了他们的腰。

chapters.en: “ ‘Therefore this is what the Sovereign LORD says: I will bring a sword against you and kill both man and beast.
chapters.zh: 所以主耶和华如此说，我必使刀剑临到你，从你中间将人与牲畜剪除。

chapters.en: Egypt will become a desolate wasteland. Then they will know that I am the LORD. “ ‘Because you said, “The Nile is mine; I made it,”
chapters.zh: 埃及地必荒废凄凉，他们就知道我是耶和华。因为法老说，这河是我的，是我所造的，

chapters.en: therefore I am against you and against your streams, and I will make the land of Egypt a ruin and a desolate waste from Migdol to Aswan, as far as the border of Cush.
chapters.zh: 所以我必与你并你的江河为敌，使埃及地，从色弗尼塔直到古实境界，全然荒废凄凉。

chapters.en: The foot of neither man nor beast will pass through it; no one will live there for forty years.
chapters.zh: 人的脚，兽的蹄都不经过，四十年之久并无人居住。

chapters.en: I will make the land of Egypt desolate among devastated lands, and her cities will lie desolate forty years among ruined cities. And I will disperse the Egyptians among the nations and scatter them through the countries.
chapters.zh: 我必使埃及地在荒凉的国中成为荒凉，使埃及城在荒废的城中变为荒废，共有四十年。我必将埃及人分散在列国，四散在列邦。

chapters.en: “ ‘Yet this is what the Sovereign LORD says: At the end of forty years I will gather the Egyptians from the nations where they were scattered.
chapters.zh: 主耶和华如此说，满了四十年，我必招聚分散在各国民中的埃及人。

chapters.en: I will bring them back from captivity and return them to Upper Egypt, the land of their ancestry. There they will be a lowly kingdom.
chapters.zh: 我必叫埃及被掳的人回来，使他们归回本地巴忒罗。在那里必成为低微的国，

chapters.en: It will be the lowliest of kingdoms and will never again exalt itself above the other nations. I will make it so weak that it will never again rule over the nations.
chapters.zh: 必为列国中最低微的，也不再自高于列国之上。我必减少他们，以致不再辖制列国。

chapters.en: Egypt will no longer be a source of confidence for the people of Israel but will be a reminder of their sin in turning to her for help. Then they will know that I am the Sovereign LORD.’ ”
chapters.zh: 埃及必不再作以色列家所倚靠的。以色列家仰望埃及人的时候，便思念罪孽。他们就知道我是主耶和华。

chapters.en: In the twenty-seventh year, in the first month on the first day, the word of the LORD came to me:
chapters.zh: 二十七年正月初一日，耶和华的话临到我说，

chapters.en: “Son of man, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon drove his army in a hard campaign against Tyre; every head was rubbed bare and every shoulder made raw. Yet he and his army got no reward from the campaign he led against Tyre.
chapters.zh: 人子阿，巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒使他的军兵大大效劳，攻打推罗，以致头都光秃，肩都磨破。然而他和他的军兵攻打推罗，并没有从那里得什么酬劳。

chapters.en: Therefore this is what the Sovereign LORD says: I am going to give Egypt to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and he will carry off its wealth. He will loot and plunder the land as pay for his army.
chapters.zh: 所以主耶和华如此说，我必将埃及地赐给巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒。他必掳掠埃及群众，抢其中的财为掳物，夺其中的货为掠物，这就可以作他军兵的酬劳。

chapters.en: I have given him Egypt as a reward for his efforts because he and his army did it for me, declares the Sovereign LORD.
chapters.zh: 我将埃及地赐给他，酬他所效的劳，因王与军兵是为我勤劳。这是主耶和华说的。

chapters.en: “On that day I will make a horn grow for the Israelites, and I will open your mouth among them. Then they will know that I am the LORD.”
chapters.zh: 当那日，我必使以色列家的角发生，又必使你以西结在他们中间得以开口。他们就知道我是耶和华。

chapters.en: The word of the LORD came to me:
chapters.zh: 耶和华的话又临到我说，

chapters.en: “Son of man, prophesy and say: ‘This is what the Sovereign LORD says: “ ‘Wail and say, “Alas for that day!”
chapters.zh: 人子阿，你要发预言说，主耶和华如此说，哀哉这日。你们应当哭号。

chapters.en: For the day is near, the day of the LORD is near— a day of clouds, a time of doom for the nations.
chapters.zh: 因为耶和华的日子临近，就是密云之日，列国受罚之期。

chapters.en: A sword will come against Egypt, and anguish will come upon Cush.When the slain fall in Egypt, her wealth will be carried away and her foundations torn down.
chapters.zh: 必有刀剑临到埃及。在埃及被杀之人仆倒的时候，古实人就有痛苦，人民必被掳掠，基址必被拆毁。

chapters.en: Cush and Libya, Lydia and all Arabia, Kub and the people of the covenant land will fall by the sword along with Egypt.
chapters.zh: 古实人，弗人（或作吕彼亚人），路德人，杂族的人民，并古巴人，以及同盟之地的人都要与埃及人一同倒在刀下。

chapters.en: “ ‘This is what the LORD says: “ ‘The allies of Egypt will fall and her proud strength will fail. From Migdol to Aswan they will fall by the sword within her, declares the Sovereign LORD.
chapters.zh: 耶和华如此说，扶助埃及的也必倾倒。埃及因势力而有的骄傲必降低微。其中的人民，从色弗尼塔起（见二十九章十节）必倒在刀下。这是主耶和华说的。

chapters.en: “ ‘They will be desolate among desolate lands, and their cities will lie among ruined cities.
chapters.zh: 埃及地在荒凉的国中必成为荒凉。埃及城在荒废的城中也变为荒废。

chapters.en: Then they will know that I am the LORD, when I set fire to Egypt and all her helpers are crushed.
chapters.zh: 我在埃及中使火着起。帮助埃及的，都被灭绝。那时，他们就知道我是耶和华。

chapters.en: “ ‘On that day messengers will go out from me in ships to frighten Cush out of her complacency. Anguish will take hold of them on the day of Egypt’s doom, for it is sure to come.
chapters.zh: 到那日，必有使者坐船，从我面前出去，使安逸无虑的古实人惊惧。必有痛苦临到他们，好像埃及遭灾的日子一样。看哪，这事临近了。

chapters.en: “ ‘This is what the Sovereign LORD says: “ ‘I will put an end to the hordes of Egypt by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon.
chapters.zh: 主耶和华如此说，我必借巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒的手，除灭埃及众人。

chapters.en: He and his army—the most ruthless of nations— will be brought in to destroy the land. They will draw their swords against Egypt and fill the land with the slain.
chapters.zh: 他和随从他的人，就是列国中强暴的，必进来毁灭这地。他们必拔刀攻击埃及，使遍地有被杀的人。

chapters.en: I will dry up the waters of the Nile and sell the land to an evil nation; by the hand of foreigners I will lay waste the land and everything in it. I the LORD have spoken.
chapters.zh: 我必使江河干涸，将地卖在恶人的手中。我必借外邦人的手，使这地和其中所有的变为凄凉。这是我耶和华说的。

chapters.en: “ ‘This is what the Sovereign LORD says: “ ‘I will destroy the idols and put an end to the images in Memphis. No longer will there be a prince in Egypt, and I will spread fear throughout the land.
chapters.zh: 主耶和华如此说，我必毁灭偶像，从挪弗除灭神像。必不再有君王出自埃及地。我要使埃及地的人惧怕。

chapters.en: I will lay waste Upper Egypt, set fire to Zoan and inflict punishment on Thebes.
chapters.zh: 我必使巴忒罗荒凉，在琐安中使火着起，向挪施行审判。

chapters.en: I will pour out my wrath on Pelusium, the stronghold of Egypt, and wipe out the hordes of Thebes.
chapters.zh: 我必将我的忿怒倒在埃及的保障上，就是训上，并要剪除挪的众人。

chapters.en: I will set fire to Egypt; Pelusium will writhe in agony. Thebes will be taken by storm; Memphis will be in constant distress.
chapters.zh: 我必在埃及中使火着起。训必大大痛苦。挪必被攻破。挪弗白日见仇敌（白日或作终日）。

chapters.en: The young men of Heliopolis and Bubastis will fall by the sword, and the cities themselves will go into captivity.
chapters.zh: 亚文和比伯实的少年人必倒在刀下。这些城的人必被掳掠。

chapters.en: Dark will be the day at Tahpanhes when I break the yoke of Egypt; there her proud strength will come to an end. She will be covered with clouds, and her villages will go into captivity.
chapters.zh: 我在答比匿折断埃及的诸轭，使她因势力而有的骄傲在其中止息。那时，日光必退去。至于这城，必有密云遮蔽，其中的女子必被掳掠。

chapters.en: So I will inflict punishment on Egypt, and they will know that I am the LORD.’ ”
chapters.zh: 我必这样向埃及施行审判，他们就知道我是耶和华。

chapters.en: In the eleventh year, in the first month on the seventh day, the word of the LORD came to me:
chapters.zh: 十一年正月初七日，耶和华的话临到我说，

chapters.en: “Son of man, I have broken the arm of Pharaoh king of Egypt. It has not been bound up to be healed or put in a splint so that it may become strong enough to hold a sword.
chapters.zh: 人子阿，我已打折埃及王法老的膀臂。没有敷药，也没有用布缠好，使他有力持刀。

chapters.en: Therefore this is what the Sovereign LORD says: I am against Pharaoh king of Egypt. I will break both his arms, the good arm as well as the broken one, and make the sword fall from his hand.
chapters.zh: 所以主耶和华如此说，看哪，我与埃及王法老为敌，必将他有力的膀臂和已打折的膀臂全行打断，使刀从他手中坠落。

chapters.en: I will disperse the Egyptians among the nations and scatter them through the countries.
chapters.zh: 我必将埃及人分散在列国，四散在列邦。

chapters.en: I will strengthen the arms of the king of Babylon and put my sword in his hand, but I will break the arms of Pharaoh, and he will groan before him like a mortally wounded man.
chapters.zh: 我必使巴比伦王的膀臂有力，将我的刀交在他手中。却要打断法老的膀臂，他就在巴比伦王面前唉哼，如同受死伤的人一样。

chapters.en: I will strengthen the arms of the king of Babylon, but the arms of Pharaoh will fall limp. Then they will know that I am the LORD, when I put my sword into the hand of the king of Babylon and he brandishes it against Egypt.
chapters.zh: 我必扶持巴比伦王的膀臂，法老的膀臂却要下垂。我将我的刀交在巴比伦王手中，他必举刀攻击埃及地，他们就知道我是耶和华。

chapters.en: I will disperse the Egyptians among the nations and scatter them through the countries. Then they will know that I am the LORD.”
chapters.zh: 我必将埃及人分散在列国，四散在列邦。他们就知道我是耶和华。

chapters.en: In the eleventh year, in the third month on the first day, the word of the LORD came to me:
chapters.zh: 十一年三月初一日，耶和华的话临到我说，

chapters.en: “Son of man, say to Pharaoh king of Egypt and to his hordes: “ ‘Who can be compared with you in majesty?
chapters.zh: 人子阿，你要向埃及王法老和他的众人说，在威势上谁能与你相比呢？

chapters.en: Consider Assyria, once a cedar in Lebanon, with beautiful branches overshadowing the forest; it towered on high, its top above the thick foliage.
chapters.zh: 亚述王曾如利巴嫩中的香柏树，枝条荣美，影密如林，极其高大，树尖插入云中。

chapters.en: The waters nourished it, deep springs made it grow tall; their streams flowed all around its base and sent their channels to all the trees of the field.
chapters.zh: 众水使它生长。深水使它长大。所栽之地有江河围流，汊出的水道延到田野诸树。

chapters.en: So it towered higher than all the trees of the field; its boughs increased and its branches grew long, spreading because of abundant waters.
chapters.zh: 所以它高大超过田野诸树。发旺的时候，枝子繁多，因得大水之力枝条长长。

chapters.en: All the birds of the sky nested in its boughs, all the animals of the wild gave birth under its branches; all the great nations lived in its shade.
chapters.zh: 空中的飞鸟都在枝子上搭窝。田野的走兽都在枝条下生子。所有大国的人民都在它荫下居住。

chapters.en: It was majestic in beauty, with its spreading boughs, for its roots went down to abundant waters.
chapters.zh: 树大条长，成为荣美，因为根在众水之旁。

chapters.en: The cedars in the garden of God could not rival it, nor could the junipers equal its boughs, nor could the plane trees compare with its branches— no tree in the garden of God could match its beauty.
chapters.zh: 神园中的香柏树不能遮蔽它。松树不及它的枝子。枫树不及它的枝条。神园中的树都没有它荣美。

chapters.en: I made it beautiful with abundant branches, the envy of all the trees of Eden in the garden of God.
chapters.zh: 我使它的枝条蕃多，成为荣美，以致神伊甸园中的树都嫉妒它。

chapters.en: “ ‘Therefore this is what the Sovereign LORD says: Because the great cedar towered over the thick foliage, and because it was proud of its height,
chapters.zh: 所以主耶和华如此说，因它高大，树尖插入云中，心骄气傲，

chapters.en: I gave it into the hands of the ruler of the nations, for him to deal with according to its wickedness. I cast it aside,
chapters.zh: 我就必将它交给列国中大有威势的人。他必定办它。我因它的罪恶，已经驱逐它。

chapters.en: and the most ruthless of foreign nations cut it down and left it. Its boughs fell on the mountains and in all the valleys; its branches lay broken in all the ravines of the land. All the nations of the earth came out from under its shade and left it.
chapters.zh: 外邦人，就是列邦中强暴的，将它砍断弃掉。它的枝条落在山间和一切谷中，它的枝子折断，落在地的一切河旁。地上的众民已经走去，离开它的荫下。

chapters.en: All the birds settled on the fallen tree, and all the wild animals lived among its branches.
chapters.zh: 空中的飞鸟都要宿在这败落的树上，田野的走兽都要卧在它的枝条下，

chapters.en: Therefore no other trees by the waters are ever to tower proudly on high, lifting their tops above the thick foliage. No other trees so well-watered are ever to reach such a height; they are all destined for death, for the earth below, among mortals who go down to the realm of the dead.
chapters.zh: 好使水旁的诸树不因高大而自尊，也不将树尖插入云中，并且那些得水滋润，有势力的，也不得高大自立。因为它们在世人中，和下坑的人都被交与死亡，到阴府去了。

chapters.en: “ ‘This is what the Sovereign LORD says: On the day it was brought down to the realm of the dead I covered the deep springs with mourning for it; I held back its streams, and its abundant waters were restrained. Because of it I clothed Lebanon with gloom, and all the trees of the field withered away.
chapters.zh: 主耶和华如此说，它下阴间的那日，我便使人悲哀。我为它遮盖深渊，使江河凝结，大水停流。我也使利巴嫩为它凄惨，田野的诸树都因它发昏。

chapters.en: I made the nations tremble at the sound of its fall when I brought it down to the realm of the dead to be with those who go down to the pit. Then all the trees of Eden, the choicest and best of Lebanon, the well-watered trees, were consoled in the earth below.
chapters.zh: 我将它扔到阴间，与下坑的人一同下去。那时，列国听见它坠落的响声就都震动，并且伊甸的一切树就是利巴嫩得水滋润，最佳最美的树都在阴府受了安慰。

chapters.en: They too, like the great cedar, had gone down to the realm of the dead, to those killed by the sword, along with the armed men who lived in its shade among the nations.
chapters.zh: 它们也与它同下阴间，到被杀的人那里。它们曾作它的膀臂，在列国中它的荫下居住。

chapters.en: “ ‘Which of the trees of Eden can be compared with you in splendor and majesty? Yet you, too, will be brought down with the trees of Eden to the earth below; you will lie among the uncircumcised, with those killed by the sword. “ ‘This is Pharaoh and all his hordes, declares the Sovereign LORD.’ ”
chapters.zh: 在这样荣耀威势上，在伊甸园诸树中，谁能与你相比呢？然而你要与伊甸的诸树一同下到阴府，在未受割礼的人中，与被杀的人一同躺卧。法老和他的群众乃是如此。这是主耶和华说的。

chapters.en: In the twelfth year, in the twelfth month on the first day, the word of the LORD came to me:
chapters.zh: 十二年十二月初一日，耶和华的话临到我说，

chapters.en: “Son of man, take up a lament concerning Pharaoh king of Egypt and say to him: “ ‘You are like a lion among the nations; you are like a monster in the seas thrashing about in your streams, churning the water with your feet and muddying the streams.
chapters.zh: 人子阿，你要为埃及王法老作哀歌，说，从前你在列国中，如同少壮狮子。现在你却像海中的大鱼。你冲出江河，用爪搅动诸水，使江河浑浊。

chapters.en: “ ‘This is what the Sovereign LORD says: “ ‘With a great throng of people I will cast my net over you, and they will haul you up in my net.
chapters.zh: 主耶和华如此说，我必用多国的人民，将我的网撒在你身上，把你拉上来。

chapters.en: I will throw you on the land and hurl you on the open field. I will let all the birds of the sky settle on you and all the animals of the wild gorge themselves on you.
chapters.zh: 我必将你丢在地上，抛在田野，使空中的飞鸟都落在你身上，使遍地的野兽吃你得饱。

chapters.en: I will spread your flesh on the mountains and fill the valleys with your remains.
chapters.zh: 我必将你的肉丢在山间，用你高大的尸首填满山谷。

chapters.en: I will drench the land with your flowing blood all the way to the mountains, and the ravines will be filled with your flesh.
chapters.zh: 我又必用你的血浇灌你所游泳之地，漫过山顶。河道都必充满。

chapters.en: When I snuff you out, I will cover the heavens and darken their stars; I will cover the sun with a cloud, and the moon will not give its light.
chapters.zh: 我将你扑灭的时候，要把天遮蔽，使众星昏暗，以密云遮掩太阳，月亮也不放光。

chapters.en: All the shining lights in the heavens I will darken over you; I will bring darkness over your land, declares the Sovereign LORD.
chapters.zh: 我必使天上的亮光都在你以上变为昏暗，使你的地上黑暗。这是主耶和华说的。

chapters.en: I will trouble the hearts of many peoples when I bring about your destruction among the nations, among lands you have not known.
chapters.zh: 我使你败亡的风声传到你所不认识的各国。那时，我必使多民的心因你愁烦。

chapters.en: I will cause many peoples to be appalled at you, and their kings will shudder with horror because of you when I brandish my sword before them. On the day of your downfall each of them will tremble every moment for his life.
chapters.zh: 我在许多国民和君王面前向你抡我的刀，国民就必因你惊奇，君王也必因你极其恐慌。在你仆倒的日子，他们各人为自己的性命时刻战兢。

chapters.en: “ ‘For this is what the Sovereign LORD says: “ ‘The sword of the king of Babylon will come against you.
chapters.zh: 主耶和华如此说，巴比伦王的刀必临到你。

chapters.en: I will cause your hordes to fall by the swords of mighty men— the most ruthless of all nations. They will shatter the pride of Egypt, and all her hordes will be overthrown.
chapters.zh: 我必借勇士的刀使你的众民仆倒。这勇士都是列国中强暴的。他们必使埃及的骄傲归于无有。埃及的众民必被灭绝。

chapters.en: I will destroy all her cattle from beside abundant waters no longer to be stirred by the foot of man or muddied by the hooves of cattle.
chapters.zh: 我必从埃及多水旁除灭所有的走兽。人脚兽蹄必不再搅浑这水。

chapters.en: Then I will let her waters settle and make her streams flow like oil, declares the Sovereign LORD.
chapters.zh: 那时，我必使埃及河澄清，江河像油缓流。这是主耶和华说的。

chapters.en: When I make Egypt desolate and strip the land of everything in it, when I strike down all who live there, then they will know that I am the LORD.’
chapters.zh: 我使埃及地变为荒废凄凉。这地缺少从前所充满的，又击杀其中一切的居民。那时，他们就知道我是耶和华。

chapters.en: “This is the lament they will chant for her. The daughters of the nations will chant it; for Egypt and all her hordes they will chant it, declares the Sovereign LORD.”
chapters.zh: 人必用这哀歌去哀哭，列国的女子为埃及和她的群众也必以此悲哀。这是主耶和华说的。

chapters.en: In the twelfth year, on the fifteenth day of the month, the word of the LORD came to me:
chapters.zh: 十二年十二月十五日，耶和华的话临到我说，

chapters.en: “Son of man, wail for the hordes of Egypt and consign to the earth below both her and the daughters of mighty nations, along with those who go down to the pit.
chapters.zh: 人子阿，你要为埃及群众哀号，又要将埃及和有名之国的女子，并下坑的人，一同扔到阴府去。

chapters.en: Say to them, ‘Are you more favored than others? Go down and be laid among the uncircumcised.’
chapters.zh: 你埃及的美丽胜过谁呢？你下去与未受割礼的人一同躺卧吧。

chapters.en: They will fall among those killed by the sword. The sword is drawn; let her be dragged off with all her hordes.
chapters.zh: 他们必在被杀的人中仆到。她被交给刀剑，要把她和她的群众拉去。

chapters.en: From within the realm of the dead the mighty leaders will say of Egypt and her allies, ‘They have come down and they lie with the uncircumcised, with those killed by the sword.’
chapters.zh: 强盛的勇士要在阴间对埃及王和帮助他的说话。他们是未受割礼被杀的人，已经下去，躺卧不动。

chapters.en: “Assyria is there with her whole army; she is surrounded by the graves of all her slain, all who have fallen by the sword.
chapters.zh: 亚述和她的众民都在那里，她民的坟墓在她四围。他们都是被杀倒在刀下的。

chapters.en: Their graves are in the depths of the pit and her army lies around her grave. All who had spread terror in the land of the living are slain, fallen by the sword.
chapters.zh: 他们的坟墓在坑中极深之处。她的众民在她坟墓的四围，都是被杀倒在刀下的。他们曾在活人之地使人惊恐。

chapters.en: “Elam is there, with all her hordes around her grave. All of them are slain, fallen by the sword. All who had spread terror in the land of the living went down uncircumcised to the earth below. They bear their shame with those who go down to the pit.
chapters.zh: 以拦也在那里，她的群众在她坟墓的四围，都是被杀倒在刀下，未受割礼而下阴府的。他们曾在活人之地使人惊恐，并且与下坑的人一同担当羞辱。

chapters.en: A bed is made for her among the slain, with all her hordes around her grave. All of them are uncircumcised, killed by the sword. Because their terror had spread in the land of the living, they bear their shame with those who go down to the pit; they are laid among the slain.
chapters.zh: 人给她和她的群众在被杀的人中设立床榻。她民的坟墓在她四围，他们都是未受割礼被刀杀的。他们曾在活人之地使人惊恐，并且与下坑的人一同担当羞辱。以拦已经放在被杀的人中。

chapters.en: “Meshek and Tubal are there, with all their hordes around their graves. All of them are uncircumcised, killed by the sword because they spread their terror in the land of the living.
chapters.zh: 米设，土巴，和她们的群众都在那里。她民的坟墓在她四围，他们都是未受割礼被刀杀的。他们曾在活人之地使人惊恐。

chapters.en: But they do not lie with the fallen warriors of old, who went down to the realm of the dead with their weapons of war—their swords placed under their heads and their shields resting on their bones—though these warriors also had terrorized the land of the living.
chapters.zh: 他们不得与那未受割礼仆倒的勇士一同躺卧。这些勇士带着兵器下阴间，头枕刀剑，骨头上有本身的罪孽。他们曾在活人之地使勇士惊恐。

chapters.en: “You too, Pharaoh, will be broken and will lie among the uncircumcised, with those killed by the sword.
chapters.zh: 法老阿，你必在未受割礼的人中败坏，与那些被杀的人一同躺卧。

chapters.en: “Edom is there, her kings and all her princes; despite their power, they are laid with those killed by the sword. They lie with the uncircumcised, with those who go down to the pit.
chapters.zh: 以东也在那里。她君王和一切首领虽然仗着势力，还是放在被杀的人中。他们必与未受割礼的和下坑的人一同躺卧。

chapters.en: “All the princes of the north and all the Sidonians are there; they went down with the slain in disgrace despite the terror caused by their power. They lie uncircumcised with those killed by the sword and bear their shame with those who go down to the pit.
chapters.zh: 在那里有北方的众王子和一切西顿人，都与被杀的人下去。他们虽然仗着势力使人惊恐，还是蒙羞。他们未受割礼，和被刀杀的一同躺卧，与下坑的人一同担当羞辱。

chapters.en: “Pharaoh—he and all his army—will see them and he will be consoled for all his hordes that were killed by the sword, declares the Sovereign LORD.
chapters.zh: 法老看见他们，便为他被杀的军队受安慰。这是主耶和华说的。

chapters.en: Although I had him spread terror in the land of the living, Pharaoh and all his hordes will be laid among the uncircumcised, with those killed by the sword, declares the Sovereign LORD.”
chapters.zh: 我任凭法老在活人之地使人惊恐，法老和他的群众必放在未受割礼和被杀的人中。这是主耶和华说的。

chapters.en: The word of the LORD came to me:
chapters.zh: 耶和华的话临到我说，

chapters.en: “Son of man, speak to your people and say to them: ‘When I bring the sword against a land, and the people of the land choose one of their men and make him their watchman,
chapters.zh: 人子阿，你要告诉本国的子民说，我使刀剑临到哪一国，那一国的民从他们中间选立一人为守望的。

chapters.en: and he sees the sword coming against the land and blows the trumpet to warn the people,
chapters.zh: 他见刀剑临到那地，若吹角警戒众民，

chapters.en: then if anyone hears the trumpet but does not heed the warning and the sword comes and takes their life, their blood will be on their own head.
chapters.zh: 凡听见角声不受警戒的，刀剑若来除灭了他，他的罪就必归到自己的头上（罪原文作血）。

chapters.en: Since they heard the sound of the trumpet but did not heed the warning, their blood will be on their own head. If they had heeded the warning, they would have saved themselves.
chapters.zh: 他听见角声，不受警戒，他的罪必归到自己的身上。他若受警戒，便是救了自己的性命。

chapters.en: But if the watchman sees the sword coming and does not blow the trumpet to warn the people and the sword comes and takes someone’s life, that person’s life will be taken because of their sin, but I will hold the watchman accountable for their blood.’
chapters.zh: 倘若守望的人见刀剑临到，不吹角，以致民不受警戒，刀剑来杀了他们中间的一个人，他虽然死在罪孽之中，我却要向守望的人讨他丧命的罪（罪原文作血）。

chapters.en: “Son of man, I have made you a watchman for the people of Israel; so hear the word I speak and give them warning from me.
chapters.zh: 人子阿，我照样立你作以色列家守望的人。所以你要听我口中的话，替我警戒他们。

chapters.en: When I say to the wicked, ‘You wicked person, you will surely die,’ and you do not speak out to dissuade them from their ways, that wicked person will die for their sin, and I will hold you accountable for their blood.
chapters.zh: 我对恶人说，恶人哪，你必要死。你以西结若不开口警戒恶人，使他离开所行的道，这恶人必死在罪孽之中，我却要向你讨他丧命的罪（罪原文作血）。

chapters.en: But if you do warn the wicked person to turn from their ways and they do not do so, they will die for their sin, though you yourself will be saved.
chapters.zh: 倘若你警戒恶人转离所行的道，他仍不转离，他必死在罪孽之中，你却救自己脱离了罪。

chapters.en: “Son of man, say to the Israelites, ‘This is what you are saying: “Our offenses and sins weigh us down, and we are wasting away because of them. How then can we live?” ’
chapters.zh: 人子阿，你要对以色列家说，你们常说，我们的过犯罪恶在我们身上，我们必因此消灭，怎能存活呢？

chapters.en: Say to them, ‘As surely as I live, declares the Sovereign LORD, I take no pleasure in the death of the wicked, but rather that they turn from their ways and live. Turn! Turn from your evil ways! Why will you die, people of Israel?’
chapters.zh: 你对他们说，主耶和华说，我指着我的永生起誓，我断不喜悦恶人死亡，惟喜悦恶人转离所行的道而活。以色列家阿，你们转回，转回吧。离开恶道，何必死亡呢？

chapters.en: “Therefore, son of man, say to your people, ‘If someone who is righteous disobeys, that person’s former righteousness will count for nothing. And if someone who is wicked repents, that person’s former wickedness will not bring condemnation. The righteous person who sins will not be allowed to live even though they were formerly righteous.’
chapters.zh: 人子阿，你要对本国的人民说，义人的义，在犯罪之日不能救他。至于恶人的恶，在他转离恶行之日也不能使他倾倒。义人在犯罪之日也不能因他的义存活。

chapters.en: If I tell a righteous person that they will surely live, but then they trust in their righteousness and do evil, none of the righteous things that person has done will be remembered; they will die for the evil they have done.
chapters.zh: 我对义人说，你必定存活。他若倚靠他的义而作罪孽，他所行的义都不被记念。他必因所作的罪孽死亡。

chapters.en: And if I say to a wicked person, ‘You will surely die,’ but they then turn away from their sin and do what is just and right—
chapters.zh: 再者，我对恶人说，你必定死亡。他若转离他的罪，行正直与合理的事，

chapters.en: if they give back what they took in pledge for a loan, return what they have stolen, follow the decrees that give life, and do no evil—that person will surely live; they will not die.
chapters.zh: 还人的当头和所抢夺的，遵行生命的律例，不作罪孽，他必定存活，不致死亡。

chapters.en: None of the sins that person has committed will be remembered against them. They have done what is just and right; they will surely live.
chapters.zh: 他所犯的一切罪必不被记念。他行了正直与合理的事，必定存活。

chapters.en: “Yet your people say, ‘The way of the Lord is not just.’ But it is their way that is not just.
chapters.zh: 你本国的子民还说，主的道不公平。其实他们的道不公平。

chapters.en: If a righteous person turns from their righteousness and does evil, they will die for it.
chapters.zh: 义人转离他的义而作罪孽，就必因此死亡。

chapters.en: And if a wicked person turns away from their wickedness and does what is just and right, they will live by doing so.
chapters.zh: 恶人转离他的恶，行正直与合理的事，就必因此存活。

chapters.en: Yet you Israelites say, ‘The way of the Lord is not just.’ But I will judge each of you according to your own ways.”
chapters.zh: 你们还说，主的道不公平。以色列家阿，我必按你们各人所行的审判你们。

chapters.en: In the twelfth year of our exile, in the tenth month on the fifth day, a man who had escaped from Jerusalem came to me and said, “The city has fallen!”
chapters.zh: 我们被掳之后十二年十月初五日，有人从耶路撒冷逃到我这里，说，城已攻破。

chapters.en: Now the evening before the man arrived, the hand of the LORD was on me, and he opened my mouth before the man came to me in the morning. So my mouth was opened and I was no longer silent.
chapters.zh: 逃来的人未到前一日的晚上，耶和华的灵（原文作手）降在我身上，开我的口。到第二日早晨，那人来到我这里，我口就开了，不再缄默。

chapters.en: Then the word of the LORD came to me:
chapters.zh: 耶和华的话临到我说，

chapters.en: “Son of man, the people living in those ruins in the land of Israel are saying, ‘Abraham was only one man, yet he possessed the land. But we are many; surely the land has been given to us as our possession.’
chapters.zh: 人子阿，住在以色列荒废之地的人说，亚伯拉罕独自一人能得这地为业，我们人数众多，这地更是给我们为业的。

chapters.en: Therefore say to them, ‘This is what the Sovereign LORD says: Since you eat meat with the blood still in it and look to your idols and shed blood, should you then possess the land?
chapters.zh: 所以你要对他们说，主耶和华如此说，你们吃带血的物，仰望偶像，并且杀人流血，你们还能得这地为业吗？

chapters.en: You rely on your sword, you do detestable things, and each of you defiles his neighbor’s wife. Should you then possess the land?’
chapters.zh: 你们倚仗自己的刀剑行可憎的事，人人玷污邻舍的妻，你们还能得这地为业吗？

chapters.en: “Say this to them: ‘This is what the Sovereign LORD says: As surely as I live, those who are left in the ruins will fall by the sword, those out in the country I will give to the wild animals to be devoured, and those in strongholds and caves will die of a plague.
chapters.zh: 你要对他们这样说，主耶和华如此说，我指着我的永生起誓，在荒场中的，必倒在刀下。在田野间的，必交给野兽吞吃。在保障和洞里的，必遭瘟疫而死。

chapters.en: I will make the land a desolate waste, and her proud strength will come to an end, and the mountains of Israel will become desolate so that no one will cross them.
chapters.zh: 我必使这地荒凉，令人惊骇。她因势力而有的骄傲也必止息。以色列的山都必荒凉，无人经过。

chapters.en: Then they will know that I am the LORD, when I have made the land a desolate waste because of all the detestable things they have done.’
chapters.zh: 我因他们所行一切可憎的事使地荒凉，令人惊骇。那时，他们就知道我是耶和华。

chapters.en: “As for you, son of man, your people are talking together about you by the walls and at the doors of the houses, saying to each other, ‘Come and hear the message that has come from the LORD.’
chapters.zh: 人子阿，你本国的子民在墙垣旁边，在房屋门口谈论你。弟兄对弟兄彼此说，来吧。听听有什么话从耶和华而出。

chapters.en: My people come to you, as they usually do, and sit before you to hear your words, but they do not put them into practice. Their mouths speak of love, but their hearts are greedy for unjust gain.
chapters.zh: 他们来到你这里如同民来聚会，坐在你面前仿佛是我的民。他们听你的话却不去行。因为他们的口多显爱情，心却追随财利。

chapters.en: Indeed, to them you are nothing more than one who sings love songs with a beautiful voice and plays an instrument well, for they hear your words but do not put them into practice.
chapters.zh: 他们看你如善于奏乐，声音幽雅之人所唱的雅歌，他们听你的话却不去行。

chapters.en: “When all this comes true—and it surely will—then they will know that a prophet has been among them.”
chapters.zh: 看哪，所说的快要应验。应验了，他们就知道在他们中间有了先知。

chapters.en: The word of the LORD came to me:
chapters.zh: 耶和华的话临到我说，

chapters.en: “Son of man, prophesy against the shepherds of Israel; prophesy and say to them: ‘This is what the Sovereign LORD says: Woe to you shepherds of Israel who only take care of yourselves! Should not shepherds take care of the flock?
chapters.zh: 人子阿，你要向以色列的牧人发预言，攻击他们，说，主耶和华如此说，祸哉。以色列的牧人只知牧养自己。牧人岂不当牧养群羊吗？

chapters.en: You eat the curds, clothe yourselves with the wool and slaughter the choice animals, but you do not take care of the flock.
chapters.zh: 你们吃脂油，穿羊毛，宰肥壮的，却不牧养群羊。

chapters.en: You have not strengthened the weak or healed the sick or bound up the injured. You have not brought back the strays or searched for the lost. You have ruled them harshly and brutally.
chapters.zh: 瘦弱的，你们没有养壮。有病的，你们没有医治。受伤的，你们没有缠裹。被逐的，你们没有领回。失丧的，你们没有寻找。但用强暴严严地辖制。

chapters.en: So they were scattered because there was no shepherd, and when they were scattered they became food for all the wild animals.
chapters.zh: 因无牧人，羊就分散。既分散，便作了一切野兽的食物。

chapters.en: My sheep wandered over all the mountains and on every high hill. They were scattered over the whole earth, and no one searched or looked for them.
chapters.zh: 我的羊在诸山间，在各高冈上流离，在全地上分散，无人去寻，无人去找。

chapters.en: “ ‘Therefore, you shepherds, hear the word of the LORD:
chapters.zh: 所以，你们这些牧人要听耶和华的话。

chapters.en: As surely as I live, declares the Sovereign LORD, because my flock lacks a shepherd and so has been plundered and has become food for all the wild animals, and because my shepherds did not search for my flock but cared for themselves rather than for my flock,
chapters.zh: 主耶和华说，我指着我的永生起誓，我的羊因无牧人就成为掠物，也作了一切野兽的食物。我的牧人不寻找我的羊。这些牧人只知牧养自己，并不牧养我的羊。

chapters.en: therefore, you shepherds, hear the word of the LORD:
chapters.zh: 所以你们这些牧人要听耶和华的话。

chapters.en: This is what the Sovereign LORD says: I am against the shepherds and will hold them accountable for my flock. I will remove them from tending the flock so that the shepherds can no longer feed themselves. I will rescue my flock from their mouths, and it will no longer be food for them.
chapters.zh: 主耶和华如此说，我必与牧人为敌，必向他们的手追讨我的羊，使他们不再牧放群羊。牧人也不再牧养自己。我必救我的羊脱离他们的口，不再作他们的食物。

chapters.en: “ ‘For this is what the Sovereign LORD says: I myself will search for my sheep and look after them.
chapters.zh: 主耶和华如此说，看哪，我必亲自寻找我的羊，将它们寻见。

chapters.en: As a shepherd looks after his scattered flock when he is with them, so will I look after my sheep. I will rescue them from all the places where they were scattered on a day of clouds and darkness.
chapters.zh: 牧人在羊群四散的日子怎样寻找他的羊，我必照样寻找我的羊。这些羊在密云黑暗的日子散到各处，我必从那里救回它们来。

chapters.en: I will bring them out from the nations and gather them from the countries, and I will bring them into their own land. I will pasture them on the mountains of Israel, in the ravines and in all the settlements in the land.
chapters.zh: 我必从万民中领出它们，从各国内聚集它们，引导它们归回故土，也必在以色列山上一切溪水旁边，境内一切可居之处牧养它们。

chapters.en: I will tend them in a good pasture, and the mountain heights of Israel will be their grazing land. There they will lie down in good grazing land, and there they will feed in a rich pasture on the mountains of Israel.
chapters.zh: 我必在美好的草场牧养它们。它们的圈必在以色列高处的山上，它们必在佳美之圈中躺卧，也在以色列山肥美的草场吃草。

chapters.en: I myself will tend my sheep and have them lie down, declares the Sovereign LORD.
chapters.zh: 主耶和华说，我必亲自作我羊的牧人，使它们得以躺卧。

chapters.en: I will search for the lost and bring back the strays. I will bind up the injured and strengthen the weak, but the sleek and the strong I will destroy. I will shepherd the flock with justice.
chapters.zh: 失丧的，我必寻找。被逐的，我必领回。受伤的，我必缠裹。有病的，我必医治。只是肥的壮的，我必除灭，也要秉公牧养它们。

chapters.en: “ ‘As for you, my flock, this is what the Sovereign LORD says: I will judge between one sheep and another, and between rams and goats.
chapters.zh: 我的羊群哪，论到你们，主耶和华如此说，我必在羊与羊中间，公绵羊与公山羊中间施行判断。

chapters.en: Is it not enough for you to feed on the good pasture? Must you also trample the rest of your pasture with your feet? Is it not enough for you to drink clear water? Must you also muddy the rest with your feet?
chapters.zh: 你们这些肥壮的羊，在美好的草场吃草还以为小事吗？剩下的草，你们竟用蹄践踏了。你们喝清水，剩下的水，你们竟用蹄搅浑了。

chapters.en: Must my flock feed on what you have trampled and drink what you have muddied with your feet?
chapters.zh: 至于我的羊，只得吃你们所践踏的，喝你们所搅浑的。

chapters.en: “ ‘Therefore this is what the Sovereign LORD says to them: See, I myself will judge between the fat sheep and the lean sheep.
chapters.zh: 所以，主耶和华如此说，我必在肥羊和瘦羊中间施行判断。

chapters.en: Because you shove with flank and shoulder, butting all the weak sheep with your horns until you have driven them away,
chapters.zh: 因为你们用胁用肩拥挤一切瘦弱的，又用角抵触，以致使它们四散。

chapters.en: I will save my flock, and they will no longer be plundered. I will judge between one sheep and another.
chapters.zh: 所以，我必拯救我的群羊不再作掠物。我也必在羊和羊中间施行判断。

chapters.en: I will place over them one shepherd, my servant David, and he will tend them; he will tend them and be their shepherd.
chapters.zh: 我必立一牧人照管他们，牧养他们，就是我的仆人大卫。他必牧养他们，作他们的牧人。

chapters.en: I the LORD will be their God, and my servant David will be prince among them. I the LORD have spoken.
chapters.zh: 我耶和华必作他们的神，我的仆人大卫必在他们中间作王。这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: “ ‘I will make a covenant of peace with them and rid the land of savage beasts so that they may live in the wilderness and sleep in the forests in safety.
chapters.zh: 我必与他们立平安的约，使恶兽从境内断绝，他们就必安居在旷野，躺卧在林中。

chapters.en: I will make them and the places surrounding my hill a blessing. I will send down showers in season; there will be showers of blessing.
chapters.zh: 我必使他们与我山的四围成为福源，我也必叫时雨落下，必有福如甘霖而降。

chapters.en: The trees will yield their fruit and the ground will yield its crops; the people will be secure in their land. They will know that I am the LORD, when I break the bars of their yoke and rescue them from the hands of those who enslaved them.
chapters.zh: 田野的树必结果，地也必有出产。他们必在故土安然居住。我折断他们所负的轭，救他们脱离那以他们为奴之人的手。那时，他们就知道我是耶和华。

chapters.en: They will no longer be plundered by the nations, nor will wild animals devour them. They will live in safety, and no one will make them afraid.
chapters.zh: 他们必不再作外邦人的掠物，地上的野兽也不再吞吃他们。却要安然居住，无人惊吓。

chapters.en: I will provide for them a land renowned for its crops, and they will no longer be victims of famine in the land or bear the scorn of the nations.
chapters.zh: 我必给他们兴起有名的植物。他们在境内不再为饥荒所灭，也不再受外邦人的羞辱，

chapters.en: Then they will know that I, the LORD their God, am with them and that they, the Israelites, are my people, declares the Sovereign LORD.
chapters.zh: 必知道我，耶和华他们的神是与他们同在，并知道他们以色列家是我的民。这是主耶和华说的。

chapters.en: You are my sheep, the sheep of my pasture, and I am your God, declares the Sovereign LORD.’ ”
chapters.zh: 你们作我的羊，我草场上的羊，乃是以色列人，我也是你们的神。这是主耶和华说的。

chapters.en: The word of the LORD came to me:
chapters.zh: 耶和华的话又临到我说，

chapters.en: “Son of man, set your face against Mount Seir; prophesy against it
chapters.zh: 人子阿，你要面向西珥山发预言，攻击它，

chapters.en: and say: ‘This is what the Sovereign LORD says: I am against you, Mount Seir, and I will stretch out my hand against you and make you a desolate waste.
chapters.zh: 对它说，主耶和华如此说，西珥山哪，我与你为敌，必向你伸手攻击你，使你荒凉，令人惊骇。

chapters.en: I will turn your towns into ruins and you will be desolate. Then you will know that I am the LORD.
chapters.zh: 我必使你的城邑变为荒场，成为凄凉。你就知道我是耶和华。

chapters.en: “ ‘Because you harbored an ancient hostility and delivered the Israelites over to the sword at the time of their calamity, the time their punishment reached its climax,
chapters.zh: 因为你永怀仇恨，在以色列人遭灾，罪孽到了尽头的时候，将他们交与刀剑，

chapters.en: therefore as surely as I live, declares the Sovereign LORD, I will give you over to bloodshed and it will pursue you. Since you did not hate bloodshed, bloodshed will pursue you.
chapters.zh: 所以主耶和华说，我指着我的永生起誓，我必使你遭遇流血的报应，罪（原文作血本节同）必追赶你。你既不恨恶杀人流血，所以这罪必追赶你。

chapters.en: I will make Mount Seir a desolate waste and cut off from it all who come and go.
chapters.zh: 我必使西珥山荒凉，令人惊骇，来往经过的人我必剪除。

chapters.en: I will fill your mountains with the slain; those killed by the sword will fall on your hills and in your valleys and in all your ravines.
chapters.zh: 我必使西珥山满有被杀的人。被刀杀的，必倒在你小山和山谷，并一切的溪水中。

chapters.en: I will make you desolate forever; your towns will not be inhabited. Then you will know that I am the LORD.
chapters.zh: 我必使你永远荒凉，使你的城邑无人居住，你的民就知道我是耶和华。

chapters.en: “ ‘Because you have said, “These two nations and countries will be ours and we will take possession of them,” even though I the LORD was there,
chapters.zh: 因为你曾说，这二国这二邦必归于我，我必得为业。（其实耶和华仍在那里）

chapters.en: therefore as surely as I live, declares the Sovereign LORD, I will treat you in accordance with the anger and jealousy you showed in your hatred of them and I will make myself known among them when I judge you.
chapters.zh: 所以主耶和华说，我指着我的永生起誓，我必照你的怒气和你从仇恨中向他们所发的嫉妒待你。我审判你的时候，必将自己显明在他们中间。

chapters.en: Then you will know that I the LORD have heard all the contemptible things you have said against the mountains of Israel. You said, “They have been laid waste and have been given over to us to devour.”
chapters.zh: 你也必知道我耶和华听见了你的一切毁谤，就是你攻击以色列山的话，说，这些山荒凉，是归我们吞灭的。

chapters.en: You boasted against me and spoke against me without restraint, and I heard it.
chapters.zh: 你们也用口向我夸大，增添与我反对的话，我都听见了。

chapters.en: This is what the Sovereign LORD says: While the whole earth rejoices, I will make you desolate.
chapters.zh: 主耶和华如此说，全地欢乐的时候，我必使你荒凉。

chapters.en: Because you rejoiced when the inheritance of Israel became desolate, that is how I will treat you. You will be desolate, Mount Seir, you and all of Edom. Then they will know that I am the LORD.’ ”
chapters.zh: 你怎样因以色列家的地业荒凉而喜乐，我必照你所行的待你。西珥山哪，你和以东全地必都荒凉。你们就知道我是耶和华。

chapters.en: “Son of man, prophesy to the mountains of Israel and say, ‘Mountains of Israel, hear the word of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 人子阿，你要对以色列山发预言说，以色列山哪，要听耶和华的话。

chapters.en: This is what the Sovereign LORD says: The enemy said of you, “Aha! The ancient heights have become our possession.” ’
chapters.zh: 主耶和华如此说，因仇敌说，阿哈。这永久的山冈都归我们为业了。

chapters.en: Therefore prophesy and say, ‘This is what the Sovereign LORD says: Because they ravaged and crushed you from every side so that you became the possession of the rest of the nations and the object of people’s malicious talk and slander,
chapters.zh: 所以要发预言说，主耶和华如此说，因为敌人使你荒凉，四围吞吃，好叫你归与其余的外邦人为业，并且多嘴多舌的人提起你来，百姓也说你有臭名。

chapters.en: therefore, mountains of Israel, hear the word of the Sovereign LORD: This is what the Sovereign LORD says to the mountains and hills, to the ravines and valleys, to the desolate ruins and the deserted towns that have been plundered and ridiculed by the rest of the nations around you—
chapters.zh: 故此，以色列山要听主耶和华的话。大山小冈，水沟山谷，荒废之地，被弃之城，为四围其余的外邦人所占据，所讥刺的，

chapters.en: this is what the Sovereign LORD says: In my burning zeal I have spoken against the rest of the nations, and against all Edom, for with glee and with malice in their hearts they made my land their own possession so that they might plunder its pastureland.’
chapters.zh: 主耶和华对你们如此说，我真发愤恨如火，责备那其余的外邦人和以东的众人。他们快乐满怀，心存恨恶，将我的地归自己为业，又看为被弃的掠物。

chapters.en: Therefore prophesy concerning the land of Israel and say to the mountains and hills, to the ravines and valleys: ‘This is what the Sovereign LORD says: I speak in my jealous wrath because you have suffered the scorn of the nations.
chapters.zh: 所以，你要指着以色列地说预言，对大山小冈，水沟山谷说，主耶和华如此说，我发愤恨和忿怒说，因你们曾受外邦人的羞辱，

chapters.en: Therefore this is what the Sovereign LORD says: I swear with uplifted hand that the nations around you will also suffer scorn.
chapters.zh: 所以我起誓说，你们四围的外邦人总要担当自己的羞辱。这是主耶和华说的。

chapters.en: “ ‘But you, mountains of Israel, will produce branches and fruit for my people Israel, for they will soon come home.
chapters.zh: 以色列山哪，你必发枝条，为我的民以色列结果子，因为他们快要来到。

chapters.en: I am concerned for you and will look on you with favor; you will be plowed and sown,
chapters.zh: 看哪，我是帮助你的，也必向你转意，使你得以耕种。

chapters.en: and I will cause many people to live on you—yes, all of Israel. The towns will be inhabited and the ruins rebuilt.
chapters.zh: 我必使以色列全家的人数在你上面增多，城邑有人居住，荒场再被建造。

chapters.en: I will increase the number of people and animals living on you, and they will be fruitful and become numerous. I will settle people on you as in the past and will make you prosper more than before. Then you will know that I am the LORD.
chapters.zh: 我必使人和牲畜在你上面加增。他们必生养众多。我要使你照旧有人居住，并要赐福与你比先前更多，你就知道我是耶和华。

chapters.en: I will cause people, my people Israel, to live on you. They will possess you, and you will be their inheritance; you will never again deprive them of their children.
chapters.zh: 我必使人，就是我的民以色列，行在你上面。他们必得你为业。你也不再使他们丧子。

chapters.en: “ ‘This is what the Sovereign LORD says: Because some say to you, “You devour people and deprive your nation of its children,”
chapters.zh: 主耶和华如此说，因为人对你说，你是吞吃人的，又使国民丧子。

chapters.en: therefore you will no longer devour people or make your nation childless, declares the Sovereign LORD.
chapters.zh: 所以主耶和华说，你必不再吞吃人，也不再使国民丧子。

chapters.en: No longer will I make you hear the taunts of the nations, and no longer will you suffer the scorn of the peoples or cause your nation to fall, declares the Sovereign LORD.’ ”
chapters.zh: 我使你不再听见各国的羞辱，不再受万民的辱骂，也不再使国民绊跌。这是主耶和华说的。

chapters.en: Again the word of the LORD came to me:
chapters.zh: 耶和华的话又临到我说，

chapters.en: “Son of man, when the people of Israel were living in their own land, they defiled it by their conduct and their actions. Their conduct was like a woman’s monthly uncleanness in my sight.
chapters.zh: 人子阿。以色列家住在本地的时候，在行动作为上玷污那地。他们的行为在我面前，好像正在经期的妇人那样污秽。

chapters.en: So I poured out my wrath on them because they had shed blood in the land and because they had defiled it with their idols.
chapters.zh: 所以我因他们在那地上流人的血，又因他们以偶像玷污那地，就把我的忿怒倾在他们身上。

chapters.en: I dispersed them among the nations, and they were scattered through the countries; I judged them according to their conduct and their actions.
chapters.zh: 我将他们分散在列国，四散在列邦，按他们的行动作为惩罚他们。

chapters.en: And wherever they went among the nations they profaned my holy name, for it was said of them, ‘These are the LORD’s people, and yet they had to leave his land.’
chapters.zh: 他们到了所去的列国，就使我的圣名被亵渎。因为人谈论他们说，这是耶和华的民，是从耶和华的地出来的。

chapters.en: I had concern for my holy name, which the people of Israel profaned among the nations where they had gone.
chapters.zh: 我却顾惜我的圣名，就是以色列家在所到的列国中所亵渎的。

chapters.en: “Therefore say to the Israelites, ‘This is what the Sovereign LORD says: It is not for your sake, people of Israel, that I am going to do these things, but for the sake of my holy name, which you have profaned among the nations where you have gone.
chapters.zh: 所以，你要对以色列家说，主耶和华如此说，以色列家阿，我行这事不是为你们，乃是为我的圣名，就是在你们到的列国中所亵渎的。

chapters.en: I will show the holiness of my great name, which has been profaned among the nations, the name you have profaned among them. Then the nations will know that I am the LORD, declares the Sovereign LORD, when I am proved holy through you before their eyes.
chapters.zh: 我要使我的大名显为圣。这名在列国中已被亵渎，就是你们在他们中间所亵渎的。我在他们眼前，在你们身上显为圣的时候，他们就知道我是耶和华。这是主耶和华说的。

chapters.en: “ ‘For I will take you out of the nations; I will gather you from all the countries and bring you back into your own land.
chapters.zh: 我必从各国收取你们，从列邦聚集你们，引导你们归回本地。

chapters.en: I will sprinkle clean water on you, and you will be clean; I will cleanse you from all your impurities and from all your idols.
chapters.zh: 我必用清水洒在你们身上，你们就洁净了。我要洁净你们，使你们脱离一切的污秽，弃掉一切的偶像。

chapters.en: I will give you a new heart and put a new spirit in you; I will remove from you your heart of stone and give you a heart of flesh.
chapters.zh: 我也要赐给你们一个新心，将新灵放在你们里面，又从你们的肉体中除掉石心，赐给你们肉心。

chapters.en: And I will put my Spirit in you and move you to follow my decrees and be careful to keep my laws.
chapters.zh: 我必将我的灵放在你们里面，使你们顺从我的律例，谨守遵行我的典章。

chapters.en: Then you will live in the land I gave your ancestors; you will be my people, and I will be your God.
chapters.zh: 你们必住在我所赐给你们列祖之地。你们要作我的子民，我要作你们的神。

chapters.en: I will save you from all your uncleanness. I will call for the grain and make it plentiful and will not bring famine upon you.
chapters.zh: 我必救你们脱离一切的污秽，也必命五谷丰登，不使你们遭遇饥荒。

chapters.en: I will increase the fruit of the trees and the crops of the field, so that you will no longer suffer disgrace among the nations because of famine.
chapters.zh: 我必使树木多结果子，田地多出土产，好叫你们不再因饥荒受外邦人的讥诮。

chapters.en: Then you will remember your evil ways and wicked deeds, and you will loathe yourselves for your sins and detestable practices.
chapters.zh: 那时，你们必追想你们的恶行和你们不善的作为，就因你们的罪孽和可憎的事厌恶自己。

chapters.en: I want you to know that I am not doing this for your sake, declares the Sovereign LORD. Be ashamed and disgraced for your conduct, people of Israel!
chapters.zh: 主耶和华说，你们要知道，我这样行不是为你们。以色列家阿，当为自己的行为抱愧蒙羞。

chapters.en: “ ‘This is what the Sovereign LORD says: On the day I cleanse you from all your sins, I will resettle your towns, and the ruins will be rebuilt.
chapters.zh: 主耶和华如此说，我洁净你们，使你们脱离一切罪孽的日子，必使城邑有人居住，荒场再被建造。

chapters.en: The desolate land will be cultivated instead of lying desolate in the sight of all who pass through it.
chapters.zh: 过路的人虽看为荒废之地，现今这荒废之地仍得耕种。

chapters.en: They will say, “This land that was laid waste has become like the garden of Eden; the cities that were lying in ruins, desolate and destroyed, are now fortified and inhabited.”
chapters.zh: 他们必说，这先前为荒废之地，现在成如伊甸园。这荒废凄凉，毁坏的城邑现在坚固有人居住。

chapters.en: Then the nations around you that remain will know that I the LORD have rebuilt what was destroyed and have replanted what was desolate. I the LORD have spoken, and I will do it.’
chapters.zh: 那时，在你们四围其余的外邦人必知道我耶和华修造那毁坏之处，培植那荒废之地。我耶和华说过，也必成就。

chapters.en: “This is what the Sovereign LORD says: Once again I will yield to Israel’s plea and do this for them: I will make their people as numerous as sheep,
chapters.zh: 主耶和华如此说，我要加增以色列家的人数，多如羊群。他们必为这事向我求问，我要给他们成就。

chapters.en: as numerous as the flocks for offerings at Jerusalem during her appointed festivals. So will the ruined cities be filled with flocks of people. Then they will know that I am the LORD.”
chapters.zh: 耶路撒冷在守节作祭物所献的羊群怎样多，照样，荒凉的城邑必被人群充满。他们就知道我是耶和华。

chapters.en: The hand of the LORD was on me, and he brought me out by the Spirit of the LORD and set me in the middle of a valley; it was full of bones.
chapters.zh: 耶和华的灵（原文作手）降在我身上。耶和华借他的灵带我出去，将我放在平原中。这平原遍满骸骨。

chapters.en: He led me back and forth among them, and I saw a great many bones on the floor of the valley, bones that were very dry.
chapters.zh: 他使我从骸骨的四围经过，谁知在平原的骸骨甚多，而且极其枯干。

chapters.en: He asked me, “Son of man, can these bones live?” I said, “Sovereign LORD, you alone know.”
chapters.zh: 他对我说，人子阿，这些骸骨能复活吗？我说，主耶和华阿，你是知道的。

chapters.en: Then he said to me, “Prophesy to these bones and say to them, ‘Dry bones, hear the word of the LORD!
chapters.zh: 他又对我说，你向这些骸骨发预言说，枯干的骸骨阿，要听耶和华的话。

chapters.en: This is what the Sovereign LORD says to these bones: I will make breath enter you, and you will come to life.
chapters.zh: 主耶和华对这些骸骨如此说，我必使气息进入你们里面，你们就要活了。

chapters.en: I will attach tendons to you and make flesh come upon you and cover you with skin; I will put breath in you, and you will come to life. Then you will know that I am the LORD.’ ”
chapters.zh: 我必给你们加上筋，使你们长肉，又将皮遮蔽你们，使气息进入你们里面，你们就要活了。你们便知道我是耶和华。

chapters.en: So I prophesied as I was commanded. And as I was prophesying, there was a noise, a rattling sound, and the bones came together, bone to bone.
chapters.zh: 于是，我遵命说预言。正说预言的时候，不料，有响声，有地震。骨与骨互相联络。

chapters.en: I looked, and tendons and flesh appeared on them and skin covered them, but there was no breath in them.
chapters.zh: 我观看，见骸骨上有筋，也长了肉，又有皮遮蔽其上，只是还没有气息。

chapters.en: Then he said to me, “Prophesy to the breath; prophesy, son of man, and say to it, ‘This is what the Sovereign LORD says: Come, breath, from the four winds and breathe into these slain, that they may live.’ ”
chapters.zh: 主对我说，人子阿，你要发预言，向风发预言，说主耶和华如此说，气息阿，要从四方（原文作风）而来，吹在这些被杀的人身上，使他们活了。

chapters.en: So I prophesied as he commanded me, and breath entered them; they came to life and stood up on their feet—a vast army.
chapters.zh: 于是我遵命说预言，气息就进入骸骨，骸骨便活了，并且站起来，成为极大的军队。

chapters.en: Then he said to me: “Son of man, these bones are the people of Israel. They say, ‘Our bones are dried up and our hope is gone; we are cut off.’
chapters.zh: 主对我说，人子阿，这些骸骨就是以色列全家。他们说，我们的骨头枯干了，我们的指望失去了，我们灭绝净尽了。

chapters.en: Therefore prophesy and say to them: ‘This is what the Sovereign LORD says: My people, I am going to open your graves and bring you up from them; I will bring you back to the land of Israel.
chapters.zh: 所以你要发预言对他们说，主耶和华如此说，我的民哪，我必开你们的坟墓，使你们从坟墓中出来，领你们进入以色列地。

chapters.en: Then you, my people, will know that I am the LORD, when I open your graves and bring you up from them.
chapters.zh: 我的民哪，我开你们的坟墓，使你们从坟墓中出来，你们就知道我是耶和华。

chapters.en: I will put my Spirit in you and you will live, and I will settle you in your own land. Then you will know that I the LORD have spoken, and I have done it, declares the LORD.’ ”
chapters.zh: 我必将我的灵放在你们里面，你们就要活了。我将你们安置在本地，你们就知道我耶和华如此说，也如此成就了。这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: The word of the LORD came to me:
chapters.zh: 耶和华的话又临到我说，

chapters.en: “Son of man, take a stick of wood and write on it, ‘Belonging to Judah and the Israelites associated with him.’ Then take another stick of wood, and write on it, ‘Belonging to Joseph (that is, to Ephraim) and all the Israelites associated with him.’
chapters.zh: 人子阿，你要取一根木杖，在其上写为犹大和他的同伴以色列人。又取一根木杖，在其上写为约瑟，就是为以法莲，又为他的同伴以色列全家。

chapters.en: Join them together into one stick so that they will become one in your hand.
chapters.zh: 你要使这两根木杖接连为一，在你手中成为一根。

chapters.en: “When your people ask you, ‘Won’t you tell us what you mean by this?’
chapters.zh: 你本国的子民问你说，这是什么意思。你不指示我们吗？

chapters.en: say to them, ‘This is what the Sovereign LORD says: I am going to take the stick of Joseph—which is in Ephraim’s hand—and of the Israelite tribes associated with him, and join it to Judah’s stick. I will make them into a single stick of wood, and they will become one in my hand.’
chapters.zh: 你就对他们说，主耶和华如此说，我要将约瑟和他同伴以色列支派的杖，就是那在以法莲手中的，与犹大的杖一同接连为一，在我手中成为一根。

chapters.en: Hold before their eyes the sticks you have written on
chapters.zh: 你所写的那两根杖要在他们眼前拿在手中，

chapters.en: and say to them, ‘This is what the Sovereign LORD says: I will take the Israelites out of the nations where they have gone. I will gather them from all around and bring them back into their own land.
chapters.zh: 要对他们说，主耶和华如此说，我要将以色列人从他们所到的各国收取，又从四围聚集他们，引导他们归回本地。

chapters.en: I will make them one nation in the land, on the mountains of Israel. There will be one king over all of them and they will never again be two nations or be divided into two kingdoms.
chapters.zh: 我要使他们在那地，在以色列山上成为一国，有一王作他们众民的王。他们不再为二国，决不再分为二国。

chapters.en: They will no longer defile themselves with their idols and vile images or with any of their offenses, for I will save them from all their sinful backsliding, and I will cleanse them. They will be my people, and I will be their God.
chapters.zh: 也不再因偶像和可憎的物，并一切的罪过玷污自己。我却要救他们出离一切的住处，就是他们犯罪的地方。我要洁净他们，如此，他们要作我的子民，我要作他们的神。

chapters.en: “ ‘My servant David will be king over them, and they will all have one shepherd. They will follow my laws and be careful to keep my decrees.
chapters.zh: 我的仆人大卫必作他们的王。众民必归一个牧人。他们必顺从我的典章，谨守遵行我的律例。

chapters.en: They will live in the land I gave to my servant Jacob, the land where your ancestors lived. They and their children and their children’s children will live there forever, and David my servant will be their prince forever.
chapters.zh: 他们必住在我赐给我仆人雅各的地上，就是你们列祖所住之地。他们和他们的子孙，并子孙的子孙，都永远住在那里。我的仆人大卫必作他们的王，直到永远。

chapters.en: I will make a covenant of peace with them; it will be an everlasting covenant. I will establish them and increase their numbers, and I will put my sanctuary among them forever.
chapters.zh: 并且我要与他们立平安的约，作为永约。我也要将他们安置在本地，使他们的人数增多，又在他们中间设立我的圣所，直到永远。

chapters.en: My dwelling place will be with them; I will be their God, and they will be my people.
chapters.zh: 我的居所必在他们中间。我要作他们的神，他们要作我的子民。

chapters.en: Then the nations will know that I the LORD make Israel holy, when my sanctuary is among them forever.’ ”
chapters.zh: 我的圣所在以色列人中间直到永远，外邦人就必知道我是叫以色列成为圣的耶和华。

chapters.en: The word of the LORD came to me:
chapters.zh: 耶和华的话临到我说，

chapters.en: “Son of man, set your face against Gog, of the land of Magog, the chief prince of Meshek and Tubal; prophesy against him
chapters.zh: 人子阿，你要面向玛各地的歌革，就是罗施，米设，土巴的王发预言攻击他，

chapters.en: and say: ‘This is what the Sovereign LORD says: I am against you, Gog, chief prince of Meshek and Tubal.
chapters.zh: 说主耶和华如此说，罗施，米设，土巴的王歌革阿，我与你为敌。

chapters.en: I will turn you around, put hooks in your jaws and bring you out with your whole army—your horses, your horsemen fully armed, and a great horde with large and small shields, all of them brandishing their swords.
chapters.zh: 我必用钩子钩住你的腮颊，调转你，将你和你的军兵，马匹，马兵带出来，都披挂整齐，成了大队，有大小盾牌，各拿刀剑。

chapters.en: Persia, Cush and Put will be with them, all with shields and helmets,
chapters.zh: 波斯人，古实人，和弗人（又作吕彼亚人），各拿盾牌，头上戴盔。

chapters.en: also Gomer with all its troops, and Beth Togarmah from the far north with all its troops—the many nations with you.
chapters.zh: 歌篾人和他的军队，北方极处的陀迦玛族和他的军队，这许多国的民都同着你。

chapters.en: “ ‘Get ready; be prepared, you and all the hordes gathered about you, and take command of them.
chapters.zh: 那聚集到你这里的各队都当准备。你自己也要准备，作他们的大帅。

chapters.en: After many days you will be called to arms. In future years you will invade a land that has recovered from war, whose people were gathered from many nations to the mountains of Israel, which had long been desolate. They had been brought out from the nations, and now all of them live in safety.
chapters.zh: 过了多日，你必被差派。到末后之年，你必来到脱离刀剑从列国收回之地，到以色列常久荒凉的山上。但那从列国中招聚出来的必在其上安然居住。

chapters.en: You and all your troops and the many nations with you will go up, advancing like a storm; you will be like a cloud covering the land.
chapters.zh: 你和你的军队，并同着你许多国的民，必如暴风上来，如密云遮盖地面。

chapters.en: “ ‘This is what the Sovereign LORD says: On that day thoughts will come into your mind and you will devise an evil scheme.
chapters.zh: 主耶和华如此说，到那时，你心必起意念，图谋恶计，

chapters.en: You will say, “I will invade a land of unwalled villages; I will attack a peaceful and unsuspecting people—all of them living without walls and without gates and bars.
chapters.zh: 说，我要上那无城墙的乡村，我要到那安静的民那里，他们都没有城墙，无门，无闩，安然居住。

chapters.en: I will plunder and loot and turn my hand against the resettled ruins and the people gathered from the nations, rich in livestock and goods, living at the center of the land. ”
chapters.zh: 我去要抢财为掳物，夺货为掠物，反手攻击那从前荒凉，现在有人居住之地，又攻击那住世界中间，从列国招聚，得了牲畜财货的民。

chapters.en: Sheba and Dedan and the merchants of Tarshish and all her villages will say to you, “Have you come to plunder? Have you gathered your hordes to loot, to carry off silver and gold, to take away livestock and goods and to seize much plunder?” ’
chapters.zh: 示巴人，底但人，他施的客商，和其间的少壮狮子都必问你说，你来要抢财为掳物吗？你聚集军队要夺货为掠物吗？要夺取金银，掳去牲畜，财货吗？要抢夺许多财宝为掳物吗？

chapters.en: “Therefore, son of man, prophesy and say to Gog: ‘This is what the Sovereign LORD says: In that day, when my people Israel are living in safety, will you not take notice of it?
chapters.zh: 人子阿，你要因此发预言，对歌革说，主耶和华如此说，到我民以色列安然居住之日，你岂不知道吗？

chapters.en: You will come from your place in the far north, you and many nations with you, all of them riding on horses, a great horde, a mighty army.
chapters.zh: 你必从本地，从北方的极处率领许多国的民来，都骑着马，乃一大队极多的军兵。

chapters.en: You will advance against my people Israel like a cloud that covers the land. In days to come, Gog, I will bring you against my land, so that the nations may know me when I am proved holy through you before their eyes.
chapters.zh: 歌革阿，你必上来攻击我的民以色列，如密云遮盖地面。末后的日子，我必带你来攻击我的地，到我在外邦人眼前，在你身上显为圣的时候，好叫他们认识我。

chapters.en: “ ‘This is what the Sovereign LORD says: You are the one I spoke of in former days by my servants the prophets of Israel. At that time they prophesied for years that I would bring you against them.
chapters.zh: 主耶和华如此说，我在古时借我的仆人以色列的先知所说的，就是你吗？当日他们多年预言我必带你来攻击以色列人。

chapters.en: This is what will happen in that day: When Gog attacks the land of Israel, my hot anger will be aroused, declares the Sovereign LORD.
chapters.zh: 主耶和华说，歌革上来攻击以色列地的时候，我的怒气要从鼻孔里发出。

chapters.en: In my zeal and fiery wrath I declare that at that time there shall be a great earthquake in the land of Israel.
chapters.zh: 我发愤恨和烈怒如火说，那日在以色列地必有大震动，

chapters.en: The fish in the sea, the birds in the sky, the beasts of the field, every creature that moves along the ground, and all the people on the face of the earth will tremble at my presence. The mountains will be overturned, the cliffs will crumble and every wall will fall to the ground.
chapters.zh: 甚至海中的鱼，天空的鸟，田野的兽，并地上的一切昆虫，和其上的众人，因见我的面就都震动。山岭必崩裂，陡岩必塌陷，墙垣都必坍倒。

chapters.en: I will summon a sword against Gog on all my mountains, declares the Sovereign LORD. Every man’s sword will be against his brother.
chapters.zh: 主耶和华说，我必命我的诸山发刀剑来攻击歌革。人都要用刀剑杀害弟兄。

chapters.en: I will execute judgment on him with plague and bloodshed; I will pour down torrents of rain, hailstones and burning sulfur on him and on his troops and on the many nations with him.
chapters.zh: 我必用瘟疫和流血的事刑罚他。我也必将暴雨，大雹与火，并硫磺降与他和他的军队，并他所率领的众民。

chapters.en: And so I will show my greatness and my holiness, and I will make myself known in the sight of many nations. Then they will know that I am the LORD.’
chapters.zh: 我必显为大，显为圣，在多国人的眼前显现。他们就知道我是耶和华。

chapters.en: “Son of man, prophesy against Gog and say: ‘This is what the Sovereign LORD says: I am against you, Gog, chief prince of Meshek and Tubal.
chapters.zh: 人子阿，你要向歌革发预言攻击他，说主耶和华如此说，罗施，米设，土巴的王歌革阿，我与你为敌。

chapters.en: I will turn you around and drag you along. I will bring you from the far north and send you against the mountains of Israel.
chapters.zh: 我必调转你，领你前往，使你从北方的极处上来，带你到以色列的山上。

chapters.en: Then I will strike your bow from your left hand and make your arrows drop from your right hand.
chapters.zh: 我必从你左手打落你的弓，从你右手打掉你的箭。

chapters.en: On the mountains of Israel you will fall, you and all your troops and the nations with you. I will give you as food to all kinds of carrion birds and to the wild animals.
chapters.zh: 你和你的军队，并同着你的列国人，都必倒在以色列的山上。我必将你给各类的鸷鸟和田野的走兽作食物。

chapters.en: You will fall in the open field, for I have spoken, declares the Sovereign LORD.
chapters.zh: 你必倒在田野，因为我曾说过。这是主耶和华说的。

chapters.en: I will send fire on Magog and on those who live in safety in the coastlands, and they will know that I am the LORD.
chapters.zh: 我要降火在玛各和海岛安然居住的人身上，他们就知道我是耶和华。

chapters.en: “ ‘I will make known my holy name among my people Israel. I will no longer let my holy name be profaned, and the nations will know that I the LORD am the Holy One in Israel.
chapters.zh: 我要在我民以色列中显出我的圣名，也不容我的圣名再被亵渎，列国人就知道我是耶和华以色列中的圣者。

chapters.en: It is coming! It will surely take place, declares the Sovereign LORD. This is the day I have spoken of.
chapters.zh: 主耶和华说，这日事情临近，也必成就，乃是我所说的日子。

chapters.en: “ ‘Then those who live in the towns of Israel will go out and use the weapons for fuel and burn them up—the small and large shields, the bows and arrows, the war clubs and spears. For seven years they will use them for fuel.
chapters.zh: 住以色列城邑的人必出去捡器械，就是大小盾牌，弓箭，梃杖，枪矛，都当柴烧火，直烧七年，

chapters.en: They will not need to gather wood from the fields or cut it from the forests, because they will use the weapons for fuel. And they will plunder those who plundered them and loot those who looted them, declares the Sovereign LORD.
chapters.zh: 甚至他们不必从田野捡柴，也不必从树林伐木。因为他们要用器械烧火，并且抢夺那抢夺他们的人，掳掠那掳掠他们的人。这是主耶和华说的。

chapters.en: “ ‘On that day I will give Gog a burial place in Israel, in the valley of those who travel east of the Sea. It will block the way of travelers, because Gog and all his hordes will be buried there. So it will be called the Valley of Hamon Gog.
chapters.zh: 当那日，我必将以色列地的谷，就是海东人所经过的谷，赐给歌革为坟地，使经过的人到此停步。在那里人必葬埋歌革和他的群众，就称那地为哈们歌革谷。

chapters.en: “ ‘For seven months the Israelites will be burying them in order to cleanse the land.
chapters.zh: 以色列家的人必用七个月葬埋他们，为要洁净全地。

chapters.en: All the people of the land will bury them, and the day I display my glory will be a memorable day for them, declares the Sovereign LORD.
chapters.zh: 全地的居民都必葬埋他们。当我得荣耀的日子，这事必叫他们得名声。这是主耶和华说的。

chapters.en: People will be continually employed in cleansing the land. They will spread out across the land and, along with others, they will bury any bodies that are lying on the ground. “ ‘After the seven months they will carry out a more detailed search.
chapters.zh: 他们必分派人时常巡查遍地，与过路的人一同葬埋那剩在地面上的尸首，好洁净全地。过了七个月，他们还要巡查。

chapters.en: As they go through the land, anyone who sees a human bone will leave a marker beside it until the gravediggers bury it in the Valley of Hamon Gog,
chapters.zh: 巡查遍地的人要经过全地，见有人的骸骨，就在旁边立一标记，等葬埋的人来将骸骨葬在哈们歌革谷。

chapters.en: near a town called Hamonah. And so they will cleanse the land.’
chapters.zh: 他们必这样洁净那地，并有一城名叫哈摩那。

chapters.en: “Son of man, this is what the Sovereign LORD says: Call out to every kind of bird and all the wild animals: ‘Assemble and come together from all around to the sacrifice I am preparing for you, the great sacrifice on the mountains of Israel. There you will eat flesh and drink blood.
chapters.zh: 人子阿，主耶和华如此说，你要对各类的飞鸟和田野的走兽说，你们聚集来吧，要从四方聚到我为你们献祭之地，就是在以色列山上献大祭之地，好叫你们吃肉，喝血。

chapters.en: You will eat the flesh of mighty men and drink the blood of the princes of the earth as if they were rams and lambs, goats and bulls—all of them fattened animals from Bashan.
chapters.zh: 你们必吃勇士的肉，喝地上首领的血，就如吃公绵羊，羊羔，公山羊，公牛，都是巴珊的肥畜。

chapters.en: At the sacrifice I am preparing for you, you will eat fat till you are glutted and drink blood till you are drunk.
chapters.zh: 你们吃我为你们所献的祭，必吃饱了脂油，喝醉了血。

chapters.en: At my table you will eat your fill of horses and riders, mighty men and soldiers of every kind,’ declares the Sovereign LORD.
chapters.zh: 你们必在我席上饱吃马匹和坐车的人，并勇士和一切的战士。这是主耶和华说的。

chapters.en: “I will display my glory among the nations, and all the nations will see the punishment I inflict and the hand I lay on them.
chapters.zh: 我必显我的荣耀在列国中。万民就必看见我所行的审判与我在他们身上所加的手。

chapters.en: From that day forward the people of Israel will know that I am the LORD their God.
chapters.zh: 这样，从那日以后，以色列家必知道我是耶和华他们的神。

chapters.en: And the nations will know that the people of Israel went into exile for their sin, because they were unfaithful to me. So I hid my face from them and handed them over to their enemies, and they all fell by the sword.
chapters.zh: 列国人也必知道以色列家被掳掠是因他们的罪孽。他们得罪我，我就掩面不顾，将他们交在敌人手中，他们便都倒在刀下。

chapters.en: I dealt with them according to their uncleanness and their offenses, and I hid my face from them.
chapters.zh: 我是照他们的污秽和罪过待他们，并且我掩面不顾他们。

chapters.en: “Therefore this is what the Sovereign LORD says: I will now restore the fortunes of Jacob and will have compassion on all the people of Israel, and I will be zealous for my holy name.
chapters.zh: 主耶和华如此说，我要使雅各被掳的人归回，要怜悯以色列全家，又为我的圣名发热心。

chapters.en: They will forget their shame and all the unfaithfulness they showed toward me when they lived in safety in their land with no one to make them afraid.
chapters.zh: 他们在本地安然居住，无人惊吓，是我将他们从万民中领回，从仇敌之地召来。我在许多国的民眼前，在他们身上显为圣的时候，他们要担当自己的羞辱和干犯我的一切罪。

chapters.en: When I have brought them back from the nations and have gathered them from the countries of their enemies, I will be proved holy through them in the sight of many nations.
Then they will know that I am the LORD their God, for though I sent them into exile among the nations, I will gather them to their own land, not leaving any behind.
chapters.zh: 因我使他们被掳到外邦人中，后又聚集他们归回本地，他们就知道我是耶和华他们的神。我必不再留他们一人在外邦。

chapters.en: I will no longer hide my face from them, for I will pour out my Spirit on the people of Israel, declares the Sovereign LORD.”
chapters.zh: 我也不再掩面不顾他们，因我已将我的灵浇灌以色列家。这是主耶和华说的。

chapters.en: In the twenty-fifth year of our exile, at the beginning of the year, on the tenth of the month, in the fourteenth year after the fall of the city—on that very day the hand of the LORD was on me and he took me there.
chapters.zh: 我们被掳掠第二十五年，耶路撒冷城攻破后十四年，正在年初，月之初十日，耶和华的灵（原文作手）降在我身上，他把我带到以色列地。

chapters.en: In visions of God he took me to the land of Israel and set me on a very high mountain, on whose south side were some buildings that looked like a city.
chapters.zh: 在神的异象中带我到以色列地，安置在至高的山上。在山上的南边有仿佛一座城建立。

chapters.en: He took me there, and I saw a man whose appearance was like bronze; he was standing in the gateway with a linen cord and a measuring rod in his hand.
chapters.zh: 他带我到那里，见有一人，颜色（原文作形状）如铜，手拿麻绳和量度的竿，站在门口。

chapters.en: The man said to me, “Son of man, look carefully and listen closely and pay attention to everything I am going to show you, for that is why you have been brought here. Tell the people of Israel everything you see.”
chapters.zh: 那人对我说，人子阿，凡我所指示你的，你都要用眼看，用耳听，并要放在心上。我带你到这里来，特为要指示你。凡你所见的，你都要告诉以色列家。

chapters.en: I saw a wall completely surrounding the temple area. The length of the measuring rod in the man’s hand was six long cubits, each of which was a cubit and a handbreadth. He measured the wall; it was one measuring rod thick and one rod high.
chapters.zh: 我见殿四围有墙。那人手拿量度的竿，长六肘，每肘是一肘零一掌。他用竿量墙，厚一竿，高一竿。

chapters.en: Then he went to the east gate. He climbed its steps and measured the threshold of the gate; it was one rod deep.
chapters.zh: 他到了朝东的门，就上门的台阶，量门的这槛，宽一竿。又量门的那槛，宽一竿。

chapters.en: The alcoves for the guards were one rod long and one rod wide, and the projecting walls between the alcoves were five cubits thick. And the threshold of the gate next to the portico facing the temple was one rod deep.
chapters.zh: 又有卫房，每房长一竿，宽一竿，相隔五肘。门槛，就是挨着向殿的廊门槛，宽一竿。

chapters.en: Then he measured the portico of the gateway;
chapters.zh: 他又量向殿门的廊子，宽一竿。

chapters.en: it was eight cubits deep and its jambs were two cubits thick. The portico of the gateway faced the temple.
chapters.zh: 又量门廊，宽八肘，墙柱厚二肘。那门的廊子向着殿。

chapters.en: Inside the east gate were three alcoves on each side; the three had the same measurements, and the faces of the projecting walls on each side had the same measurements.
chapters.zh: 东门洞有卫房，这旁三间，那旁三间，都是一样的尺寸。这边的柱子和那边的柱子，也是一样的尺寸。

chapters.en: Then he measured the width of the entrance of the gateway; it was ten cubits and its length was thirteen cubits.
chapters.zh: 他量门口，宽十肘，长十三肘。

chapters.en: In front of each alcove was a wall one cubit high, and the alcoves were six cubits square.
chapters.zh: 卫房前展出的境界，这边一肘，那边一肘。卫房这边六肘，那边六肘。

chapters.en: Then he measured the gateway from the top of the rear wall of one alcove to the top of the opposite one; the distance was twenty-five cubits from one parapet opening to the opposite one.
chapters.zh: 又量门洞，从这卫房顶的后檐到那卫房顶的后檐，宽二十五肘。卫房门与门相对。

chapters.en: He measured along the faces of the projecting walls all around the inside of the gateway—sixty cubits. The measurement was up to the portico facing the courtyard.
chapters.zh: 又量（量原文作造）廊子六十肘（七十经作二十肘），墙柱外是院子，有廊为界，在门洞两边。

chapters.en: The distance from the entrance of the gateway to the far end of its portico was fifty cubits.
chapters.zh: 从大门口到内廊前，共五十肘。

chapters.en: The alcoves and the projecting walls inside the gateway were surmounted by narrow parapet openings all around, as was the portico; the openings all around faced inward. The faces of the projecting walls were decorated with palm trees.
chapters.zh: 卫房和门洞两旁柱间并廊子，都有严紧的窗棂。里边都有窗棂，柱上有雕刻的棕树。

chapters.en: Then he brought me into the outer court. There I saw some rooms and a pavement that had been constructed all around the court; there were thirty rooms along the pavement.
chapters.zh: 他带我到外院，见院的四围有铺石地。铺石地上有屋子三十间。

chapters.en: It abutted the sides of the gateways and was as wide as they were long; this was the lower pavement.
chapters.zh: 铺石地，就是矮铺石地在各门洞两旁，以门洞的长短为度。

chapters.en: Then he measured the distance from the inside of the lower gateway to the outside of the inner court; it was a hundred cubits on the east side as well as on the north.
chapters.zh: 他从下门量到内院外，共宽一百肘，东面北面都是如此。

chapters.en: Then he measured the length and width of the north gate, leading into the outer court.
chapters.zh: 他量外院朝北的门，长宽若干。

chapters.en: Its alcoves—three on each side—its projecting walls and its portico had the same measurements as those of the first gateway. It was fifty cubits long and twenty-five cubits wide.
chapters.zh: 门洞的卫房，这旁三间，那旁三间。门洞的柱子和廊子，与第一门的尺寸一样。门洞长五十肘，宽二十五肘。

chapters.en: Its openings, its portico and its palm tree decorations had the same measurements as those of the gate facing east. Seven steps led up to it, with its portico opposite them.
chapters.zh: 其窗棂和廊子，并雕刻的棕树，与朝东的门尺寸一样。登七层台阶上到这门，前面有廊子。

chapters.en: There was a gate to the inner court facing the north gate, just as there was on the east. He measured from one gate to the opposite one; it was a hundred cubits.
chapters.zh: 内院有门与这门相对，北面东面都是如此。他从这门量到那门，共一百肘。

chapters.en: Then he led me to the south side and I saw the south gate. He measured its jambs and its portico, and they had the same measurements as the others.
chapters.zh: 他带我往南去，见朝南有门，又照先前的尺寸量门洞的柱子和廊子。

chapters.en: The gateway and its portico had narrow openings all around, like the openings of the others. It was fifty cubits long and twenty-five cubits wide.
chapters.zh: 门洞两旁与廊子的周围都有窗棂，和先量的窗棂一样。门洞长五十肘，宽二十五肘。

chapters.en: Seven steps led up to it, with its portico opposite them; it had palm tree decorations on the faces of the projecting walls on each side.
chapters.zh: 登七层台阶上到这门，前面有廊子。柱上有雕刻的棕树，这边一棵，那边一棵。

chapters.en: The inner court also had a gate facing south, and he measured from this gate to the outer gate on the south side; it was a hundred cubits.
chapters.zh: 内院朝南有门。从这门量到朝南的那门，共一百肘。

chapters.en: Then he brought me into the inner court through the south gate, and he measured the south gate; it had the same measurements as the others.
chapters.zh: 他带我从南门到内院，就照先前的尺寸量南门。

chapters.en: Its alcoves, its projecting walls and its portico had the same measurements as the others. The gateway and its portico had openings all around. It was fifty cubits long and twenty-five cubits wide.
chapters.zh: 卫房和柱子，并廊子都照先前的尺寸。门洞两旁与廊子的周围都有窗棂。门洞长五十肘，宽二十五肘。

chapters.en: (The porticoes of the gateways around the inner court were twenty-five cubits wide and five cubits deep.)
chapters.zh: 周围有廊子，长二十五肘，宽五肘。

chapters.en: Its portico faced the outer court; palm trees decorated its jambs, and eight steps led up to it.
chapters.zh: 廊子朝着外院，柱上有雕刻的棕树。登八层台阶上到这门。

chapters.en: Then he brought me to the inner court on the east side, and he measured the gateway; it had the same measurements as the others.
chapters.zh: 他带我到内院的东面，就照先前的尺寸量东门。

chapters.en: Its alcoves, its projecting walls and its portico had the same measurements as the others. The gateway and its portico had openings all around. It was fifty cubits long and twenty-five cubits wide.
chapters.zh: 卫房和柱子，并廊子都照先前的尺寸。门洞两旁与廊子的周围都有窗棂。门洞长五十肘，宽二十五肘。

chapters.en: Its portico faced the outer court; palm trees decorated the jambs on either side, and eight steps led up to it.
chapters.zh: 廊子朝着外院。门洞两旁的柱子都有雕刻的棕树。登八层台阶上到这门。

chapters.en: Then he brought me to the north gate and measured it. It had the same measurements as the others,
chapters.zh: 他带我到北门，就照先前的尺寸量那门，

chapters.en: as did its alcoves, its projecting walls and its portico, and it had openings all around. It was fifty cubits long and twenty-five cubits wide.
chapters.zh: 就是量卫房和柱子，并廊子。门洞周围都有窗棂。门洞长五十肘，宽二十五肘。

chapters.en: Its portico faced the outer court; palm trees decorated the jambs on either side, and eight steps led up to it.
chapters.zh: 廊柱朝着外院。门洞两旁的柱子都有雕刻的棕树。登八层台阶上到这门。

chapters.en: A room with a doorway was by the portico in each of the inner gateways, where the burnt offerings were washed.
chapters.zh: 门洞的柱旁有屋子和门。祭司（原文作他们）在那里洗燔祭牲。

chapters.en: In the portico of the gateway were two tables on each side, on which the burnt offerings, sin offerings and guilt offerings were slaughtered.
chapters.zh: 在门廊内，这边有两张桌子，那边有两张桌子，在其上可以宰杀燔祭牲，赎罪祭牲，和赎愆祭牲。

chapters.en: By the outside wall of the portico of the gateway, near the steps at the entrance of the north gateway were two tables, and on the other side of the steps were two tables.
chapters.zh: 上到朝北的门口，这边有两张桌子，门廊那边也有两张桌子。

chapters.en: So there were four tables on one side of the gateway and four on the other—eight tables in all—on which the sacrifices were slaughtered.
chapters.zh: 门这边有四张桌子，那边有四张桌子，共八张。在其上祭司宰杀牺牲。

chapters.en: There were also four tables of dressed stone for the burnt offerings, each a cubit and a half long, a cubit and a half wide and a cubit high. On them were placed the utensils for slaughtering the burnt offerings and the other sacrifices.
chapters.zh: 为燔祭牲有四张桌子，是凿过的石头作成的，长一肘半，宽一肘半，高一肘。祭司将宰杀燔祭牲和平安祭牲所用的器皿放在其上。

chapters.en: And double-pronged hooks, each a handbreadth long, were attached to the wall all around. The tables were for the flesh of the offerings.
chapters.zh: 有钩子，宽一掌，钉在廊内的四围。桌子上有牺牲的肉。

chapters.en: Outside the inner gate, within the inner court, were two rooms, one at the side of the north gate and facing south, and another at the side of the south gate and facing north.
chapters.zh: 在北门旁，内院里有屋子，为歌唱的人而设。这屋子朝南。在南门旁，又有一间朝北（南原文作东）。

chapters.en: He said to me, “The room facing south is for the priests who guard the temple,
chapters.zh: 他对我说，这朝南的屋子是为看守殿宇的祭司。

chapters.en: and the room facing north is for the priests who guard the altar. These are the sons of Zadok, who are the only Levites who may draw near to the LORD to minister before him.”
chapters.zh: 那朝北的屋子是为看守祭坛的祭司。这些祭司是利未人中撒督的子孙，近前来事奉耶和华的。
