chapters.en: They will come from Egypt, trembling like sparrows, from Assyria, fluttering like doves. I will settle them in their homes,” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 他们必如雀鸟从埃及急速而来，又如鸽子从亚述地来到，我必使他们住自己的房屋。这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: Ephraim has surrounded me with lies, Israel with deceit. And Judah is unruly against God, even against the faithful Holy One.
chapters.zh: 以法莲用谎话，以色列家用诡计围绕我，犹大却靠神掌权，向圣者有忠心。（或作犹大向神，向诚实的圣者犹疑不定）。

chapters.en: Ephraim feeds on the wind; he pursues the east wind all day and multiplies lies and violence. He makes a treaty with Assyria and sends olive oil to Egypt.
chapters.zh: 以法莲吃风，且追赶东风。时常增添虚谎和强暴。与亚述立约，把油送到埃及。

chapters.en: The LORD has a charge to bring against Judah; he will punish Jacob according to his ways and repay him according to his deeds.
chapters.zh: 耶和华与犹大争辩，必照雅各所行的惩罚他，按他所做的报应他。

chapters.en: In the womb he grasped his brother’s heel; as a man he struggled with God.
chapters.zh: 他在腹中抓住哥哥的脚跟，壮年的时候与神较力。

chapters.en: He struggled with the angel and overcame him; he wept and begged for his favor. He found him at Bethel and talked with him there—
chapters.zh: 与天使较力，并且得胜，哭泣恳求，在伯特利遇见耶和华。耶和华万军之神在那里晓谕我们以色列人，耶和华是他可记念的名。

chapters.en: the LORD God Almighty, the LORD is his name!
But you must return to your God; maintain love and justice, and wait for your God always.
chapters.zh: 所以你当归向你的神，谨守仁爱，公平，常常等候你的神。

chapters.en: The merchant uses dishonest scales and loves to defraud.
chapters.zh: 以法莲是商人，手里有诡诈的天平，爱行欺骗。

chapters.en: Ephraim boasts, “I am very rich; I have become wealthy. With all my wealth they will not find in me any iniquity or sin.”
chapters.zh: 以法莲说，我果然成了富足，得了财宝，我所劳碌得来的，人必不见有什么不义，可算为罪的。

chapters.en: “I have been the LORD your God ever since you came out of Egypt; I will make you live in tents again, as in the days of your appointed festivals.
chapters.zh: 自从你出埃及地以来，我就是耶和华你的神，我必使你再住帐棚，如在大会的日子一样。

chapters.en: I spoke to the prophets, gave them many visions and told parables through them.”
chapters.zh: 我已晓谕众先知，并且加增默示，借先知设立比喻。

chapters.en: Is Gilead wicked? Its people are worthless! Do they sacrifice bulls in Gilgal? Their altars will be like piles of stones on a plowed field.
chapters.zh: 基列人没有罪孽吗？他们全然是虚假的。人在吉甲献牛犊为祭，他们的祭坛，好像田间犁沟中的乱堆。

chapters.en: Jacob fled to the country of Aram ; Israel served to get a wife, and to pay for her he tended sheep.
chapters.zh: 从前雅各逃到亚兰地，以色列为得妻服事人，为得妻与人放羊。

chapters.en: The LORD used a prophet to bring Israel up from Egypt, by a prophet he cared for him.
chapters.zh: 耶和华借先知领以色列从埃及上来，以色列也借先知而得保存。

chapters.en: But Ephraim has aroused his bitter anger; his Lord will leave on him the guilt of his bloodshed and will repay him for his contempt.
chapters.zh: 以法莲大大惹动主怒，所以他流血的罪，必归在他身上，主必将那因以法莲所受的羞辱归还他。

chapters.en: When Ephraim spoke, people trembled; he was exalted in Israel. But he became guilty of Baal worship and died.
chapters.zh: 从前以法莲说话，人都战兢，他在以色列中居处高位，但他在事奉巴力的事上犯罪就死了。

chapters.en: Now they sin more and more; they make idols for themselves from their silver, cleverly fashioned images, all of them the work of craftsmen. It is said of these people, “They offer human sacrifices! They kiss calf-idols!”
chapters.zh: 现今他们罪上加罪，用银子为自己铸造偶像，就是照自己的聪明制造。都是匠人的工作，有人论说，献祭的人可以向牛犊亲嘴。

chapters.en: Therefore they will be like the morning mist, like the early dew that disappears, like chaff swirling from a threshing floor, like smoke escaping through a window.
chapters.zh: 因此，他们必如早晨的云雾，又如速散的甘露，像场上的糠秕被狂风吹去，又像烟气腾于窗外。

chapters.en: “But I have been the LORD your God ever since you came out of Egypt. You shall acknowledge no God but me, no Savior except me.
chapters.zh: 自从你出埃及地以来，我就是耶和华你的神。在我以外，你不可认识别神，除我以外并没有救主。

chapters.en: I cared for you in the wilderness, in the land of burning heat.
chapters.zh: 我曾在旷野干旱之地认识你。

chapters.en: When I fed them, they were satisfied; when they were satisfied, they became proud; then they forgot me.
chapters.zh: 这些民照我所赐的食物得了饱足，既得饱足，心就高傲，忘记了我。

chapters.en: So I will be like a lion to them, like a leopard I will lurk by the path.
chapters.zh: 因此，我向他们如狮子，又如豹伏在道旁。

chapters.en: Like a bear robbed of her cubs, I will attack them and rip them open; like a lion I will devour them— a wild animal will tear them apart.
chapters.zh: 我遇见他们必像丢崽子的母熊，撕裂他们的胸膛（或作心膜），在那里，我必像母狮吞吃他们。野兽必撕裂他们。

chapters.en: “You are destroyed, Israel, because you are against me, against your helper.
chapters.zh: 以色列阿，你与我反对，就是反对帮助你的，自取败坏。

chapters.en: Where is your king, that he may save you? Where are your rulers in all your towns, of whom you said, ‘Give me a king and princes’?
chapters.zh: 你曾求我说，给我立王和首领，现在你的王在哪里呢？治理你的在哪里呢？让他在你所有的城中拯救你吧。

chapters.en: So in my anger I gave you a king, and in my wrath I took him away.
chapters.zh: 我在怒气中将王赐你，又在烈怒中将王废去。

chapters.en: The guilt of Ephraim is stored up, his sins are kept on record.
chapters.zh: 以法莲的罪孽包裹，他的罪恶收藏。

chapters.en: Pains as of a woman in childbirth come to him, but he is a child without wisdom; when the time arrives, he doesn’t have the sense to come out of the womb.
chapters.zh: 产妇的疼痛必临到他身上。他是无智慧之子，到了产期不当迟延。

chapters.en: “I will deliver this people from the power of the grave; I will redeem them from death. Where, O death, are your plagues? Where, O grave, is your destruction? “I will have no compassion,
chapters.zh: 我必救赎他们脱离阴间，救赎他们脱离死亡。死亡阿，你的灾害在哪里呢？阴间哪，你的毁灭在哪里呢？在我眼前绝无后悔之事。

chapters.en: even though he thrives among his brothers. An east wind from the LORD will come, blowing in from the desert; his spring will fail and his well dry up. His storehouse will be plundered of all its treasures.
chapters.zh: 他在弟兄中虽然茂盛，必有东风刮来，就是耶和华的风从旷野上来，他的泉源必干，他的源头必竭，仇敌必掳掠他所积蓄的一切宝器。

chapters.en: The people of Samaria must bear their guilt, because they have rebelled against their God. They will fall by the sword; their little ones will be dashed to the ground, their pregnant women ripped open.”
chapters.zh: 撒玛利亚必担当自己的罪，因为悖逆她的神。她必倒在刀下，婴孩必被摔死。孕妇必被剖开。

chapters.en: Return, Israel, to the LORD your God. Your sins have been your downfall!
chapters.zh: 以色列阿，你要归向耶和华你的神。你是因自己的罪孽跌倒了。

chapters.en: Take words with you and return to the LORD. Say to him: “Forgive all our sins and receive us graciously, that we may offer the fruit of our lips.
chapters.zh: 当归向耶和华，用言语祷告他说，求你除净罪孽，悦纳善行，这样。我们就把嘴唇的祭，代替牛犊献上。

chapters.en: Assyria cannot save us; we will not mount warhorses. We will never again say ‘Our gods’ to what our own hands have made, for in you the fatherless find compassion.”
chapters.zh: 我们不向亚述求救。不骑埃及的马。也不再对我们手所造的说，你是我们的神。因为孤儿在你耶和华那里得蒙怜悯。

chapters.en: “I will heal their waywardness and love them freely, for my anger has turned away from them.
chapters.zh: 我必医治他们背道的病，甘心爱他们，因为我的怒气向他们转消。

chapters.en: I will be like the dew to Israel; he will blossom like a lily. Like a cedar of Lebanon he will send down his roots;
chapters.zh: 我必向以色列如甘露，他必如百合花开放，如利巴嫩的树木扎根。

chapters.en: his young shoots will grow. His splendor will be like an olive tree, his fragrance like a cedar of Lebanon.
chapters.zh: 他的枝条必延长，他的荣华如橄榄树，他的香气如利巴嫩的香柏树。

chapters.en: People will dwell again in his shade; they will flourish like the grain, they will blossom like the vine— Israel’s fame will be like the wine of Lebanon.
chapters.zh: 曾住在他荫下的必归回，发旺如五谷。开花如葡萄树。他的香气如利巴嫩的酒。

chapters.en: Ephraim, what more have I to do with idols? I will answer him and care for him. I am like a flourishing juniper; your fruitfulness comes from me.”
chapters.zh: 以法莲必说，我与偶像还有什么关涉呢？我耶和华回答他，也必顾念他。我如青翠的松树，你的果子从我而得。

chapters.en: Who is wise? Let them realize these things. Who is discerning? Let them understand. The ways of the LORD are right; the righteous walk in them, but the rebellious stumble in them.
chapters.zh: 谁是智慧人，可以明白这些事，谁是通达人，可以知道这一切。因为，耶和华的道是正直的，义人必在其中行走，罪人却在其上跌倒。

chapters.en: The word of the LORD that came to Joel son of Pethuel.
chapters.zh: 耶和华的话临到毗土珥的儿子约珥。

chapters.en: Hear this, you elders; listen, all who live in the land. Has anything like this ever happened in your days or in the days of your ancestors?
chapters.zh: 老年人哪，当听我的话。国中的居民哪，都要侧耳而听。在你们的日子，或你们列祖的日子，曾有这样的事吗？

chapters.en: Tell it to your children, and let your children tell it to their children, and their children to the next generation.
chapters.zh: 你们要将这事传与子，子传与孙，孙传与后代。

chapters.en: What the locust swarm has left the great locusts have eaten; what the great locusts have left the young locusts have eaten; what the young locusts have left other locusts have eaten.
chapters.zh: 剪虫剩下的，蝗虫来吃。蝗虫剩下的，蝻子来吃。蝻子剩下的，蚂蚱来吃。

chapters.en: Wake up, you drunkards, and weep! Wail, all you drinkers of wine; wail because of the new wine, for it has been snatched from your lips.
chapters.zh: 酒醉的人哪，要清醒哭泣。好酒的人哪，都要为甜酒哀号。因为从你们的口中断绝了。

chapters.en: A nation has invaded my land, a mighty army without number; it has the teeth of a lion, the fangs of a lioness.
chapters.zh: 有一队蝗虫（原文是民）又强盛又无数，侵犯我的地。它的牙齿如狮子的牙齿，大牙如母狮的大牙。

chapters.en: It has laid waste my vines and ruined my fig trees. It has stripped off their bark and thrown it away, leaving their branches white.
chapters.zh: 它毁坏我的葡萄树，剥了我无花果树的皮，剥尽而丢弃，使枝条露白。

chapters.en: Mourn like a virgin in sackcloth grieving for the betrothed of her youth.
chapters.zh: 我的民哪，你当哀号，像处女腰束麻布，为幼年的丈夫哀号。

chapters.en: Grain offerings and drink offerings are cut off from the house of the LORD. The priests are in mourning, those who minister before the LORD.
chapters.zh: 素祭和奠祭从耶和华的殿中断绝。事奉耶和华的祭司都悲哀。

chapters.en: The fields are ruined, the ground is dried up; the grain is destroyed, the new wine is dried up, the olive oil fails.
chapters.zh: 田荒凉，地悲哀，因为五谷毁坏，新酒干竭，油也缺乏。

chapters.en: Despair, you farmers, wail, you vine growers; grieve for the wheat and the barley, because the harvest of the field is destroyed.
chapters.zh: 农夫阿，你们要惭愧，修理葡萄园的阿，你们要哀号，因为大麦小麦，与田间的庄稼，都灭绝了。

chapters.en: The vine is dried up and the fig tree is withered; the pomegranate, the palm and the apple tree— all the trees of the field—are dried up. Surely the people’s joy is withered away.
chapters.zh: 葡萄树枯干，无花果树衰残。石榴树，棕树，苹果树，连田野一切的树木，也都枯干。众人的喜乐尽都消灭。

chapters.en: Put on sackcloth, you priests, and mourn; wail, you who minister before the altar. Come, spend the night in sackcloth, you who minister before my God; for the grain offerings and drink offerings are withheld from the house of your God.
chapters.zh: 祭司阿，你们当腰束麻布痛哭。伺候祭坛的阿，你们要哀号。事奉我神的阿，你们要来披上麻布过夜。因为素祭，和奠祭，从你们神的殿中断绝了。

chapters.en: Declare a holy fast; call a sacred assembly. Summon the elders and all who live in the land to the house of the LORD your God, and cry out to the LORD.
chapters.zh: 你们要分定禁食的日子，宣告严肃会，招聚长老，和国中的一切居民，到耶和华你们神的殿，向耶和华哀求。

chapters.en: Alas for that day! For the day of the LORD is near; it will come like destruction from the Almighty.
chapters.zh: 哀哉，耶和华的日子临近了。这日来到，好像毁灭从全能者来到。

chapters.en: Has not the food been cut off before our very eyes— joy and gladness from the house of our God?
chapters.zh: 粮食不是在我们眼前断绝了吗？欢喜快乐不是从我们神的殿中止息了吗？

chapters.en: The seeds are shriveled beneath the clods.The storehouses are in ruins, the granaries have been broken down, for the grain has dried up.
chapters.zh: 谷种在土块下朽烂。仓也荒凉，廪也破坏。因为五谷枯干了。

chapters.en: How the cattle moan! The herds mill about because they have no pasture; even the flocks of sheep are suffering.
chapters.zh: 牲畜哀鸣，牛群混乱，因为无草。羊群也受了困苦。

chapters.en: To you, LORD, I call, for fire has devoured the pastures in the wilderness and flames have burned up all the trees of the field.
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，我向你求告。因为火烧灭旷野的草场，火焰烧尽田野的树木。

chapters.en: Even the wild animals pant for you; the streams of water have dried up and fire has devoured the pastures in the wilderness.
chapters.zh: 田野的走兽向你发喘。因为溪水干涸，火也烧灭旷野的草场。

chapters.en: Blow the trumpet in Zion; sound the alarm on my holy hill. Let all who live in the land tremble, for the day of the LORD is coming. It is close at hand—
chapters.zh: 你们要在锡安吹角，在我圣山吹出大声。国中的居民，都要发颤。因为耶和华的日子将到，已经临近。

chapters.en: a day of darkness and gloom, a day of clouds and blackness. Like dawn spreading across the mountains a large and mighty army comes, such as never was in ancient times nor ever will be in ages to come.
chapters.zh: 那日是黑暗，幽冥，密云，乌黑的日子，好像晨光铺满山岭。有一队蝗虫（原文作民）又大又强。从来没有这样的，以后直到万代，也必没有。

chapters.en: Before them fire devours, behind them a flame blazes. Before them the land is like the garden of Eden, behind them, a desert waste— nothing escapes them.
chapters.zh: 他们前面如火烧灭，后面如火焰烧尽。未到以前，地如伊甸园，过去以后，成了荒凉的旷野。没有一样能躲避他们的。

chapters.en: They have the appearance of horses; they gallop along like cavalry.
chapters.zh: 他们的形状如马，奔跑如马兵。

chapters.en: With a noise like that of chariots they leap over the mountaintops, like a crackling fire consuming stubble, like a mighty army drawn up for battle.
chapters.zh: 在山顶蹦跳的响声，如车辆的响声，又如火焰烧碎秸的响声，好像强盛的民摆阵预备打仗。

chapters.en: At the sight of them, nations are in anguish; every face turns pale.
chapters.zh: 他们一来，众民伤恸，脸都变色。

chapters.en: They charge like warriors; they scale walls like soldiers. They all march in line, not swerving from their course.
chapters.zh: 他们如勇士奔跑，像战士爬城，各都步行，不乱队伍。

chapters.en: They do not jostle each other; each marches straight ahead. They plunge through defenses without breaking ranks.
chapters.zh: 彼此并不拥挤，向前各行其路。直闯兵器，不偏左右。

chapters.en: They rush upon the city; they run along the wall. They climb into the houses; like thieves they enter through the windows.
chapters.zh: 他们蹦上城，蹿上墙，爬上房屋，进入窗户如同盗贼。

chapters.en: Before them the earth shakes, the heavens tremble, the sun and moon are darkened, and the stars no longer shine.
chapters.zh: 他们一来地震天动，日月昏暗，星宿无光。

chapters.en: The LORD thunders at the head of his army; his forces are beyond number, and mighty is the army that obeys his command. The day of the LORD is great; it is dreadful. Who can endure it?
chapters.zh: 耶和华在他军旅前发声。他的队伍甚大。成就他命的，是强盛者。因为耶和华的日子大而可畏。谁能当得起呢？

chapters.en: “Even now,” declares the LORD, “return to me with all your heart, with fasting and weeping and mourning.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华说，虽然如此。你们应当禁食，哭泣，悲哀，一心归向我。

chapters.en: Rend your heart and not your garments. Return to the LORD your God, for he is gracious and compassionate, slow to anger and abounding in love, and he relents from sending calamity.
chapters.zh: 你们要撕裂心肠，不撕裂衣服。归向耶和华你们的神。因为他有恩典。有怜悯，不轻易发怒，有丰盛的慈爱，并且后悔不降所说的灾。

chapters.en: Who knows? He may turn and relent and leave behind a blessing— grain offerings and drink offerings for the LORD your God.
chapters.zh: 或者他转意后悔，留下余福，就是留下献给耶和华你们神的素祭，和奠祭，也未可知。

chapters.en: Blow the trumpet in Zion, declare a holy fast, call a sacred assembly.
chapters.zh: 你们要在锡安吹角，分定禁食的日子，宣告严肃会。

chapters.en: Gather the people, consecrate the assembly; bring together the elders, gather the children, those nursing at the breast. Let the bridegroom leave his room and the bride her chamber.
chapters.zh: 聚集众民，使会众自洁，招聚老者，聚集孩童，和吃奶的。使新郎出离洞房，新妇出离内室。

chapters.en: Let the priests, who minister before the LORD, weep between the portico and the altar. Let them say, “Spare your people, LORD. Do not make your inheritance an object of scorn, a byword among the nations. Why should they say among the peoples, ‘Where is their God?’ ”
chapters.zh: 事奉耶和华的祭司，要在廊子和祭坛中间哭泣，说，耶和华阿，求你顾惜你的百姓，不要使你的产业受羞辱，列邦管辖他们。为何容列国的人说，他们的神在哪里呢？

chapters.en: Then the LORD was jealous for his land and took pity on his people.
chapters.zh: 耶和华就为自己的地发热心，怜恤他的百姓。

chapters.en: The LORD replied to them: “I am sending you grain, new wine and olive oil, enough to satisfy you fully; never again will I make you an object of scorn to the nations.
chapters.zh: 耶和华应允他的百姓，说，我必赐给你们五谷，新酒，和油，使你们饱足。我也不再使你们受列国的羞辱。

chapters.en: “I will drive the northern horde far from you, pushing it into a parched and barren land; its eastern ranks will drown in the Dead Sea and its western ranks in the Mediterranean Sea. And its stench will go up; its smell will rise.” Surely he has done great things!
chapters.zh: 却要使北方来的军队远离你们，将他们赶到干旱荒废之地，前队赶入东海，后队赶入西海。因为他们所行的大恶（原文是事），臭气上升，腥味腾空。

chapters.en: Do not be afraid, land of Judah; be glad and rejoice. Surely the LORD has done great things!
chapters.zh: 地土阿，不要惧怕，要欢喜快乐。因为耶和华行了大事。

chapters.en: Do not be afraid, you wild animals, for the pastures in the wilderness are becoming green. The trees are bearing their fruit; the fig tree and the vine yield their riches.
chapters.zh: 田野的走兽阿，不要惧怕。因为旷野的草发生，树木结果，无花果树。葡萄树也都效力。

chapters.en: Be glad, people of Zion, rejoice in the LORD your God, for he has given you the autumn rains because he is faithful. He sends you abundant showers, both autumn and spring rains, as before.
chapters.zh: 锡安的民哪，你们要快乐，为耶和华你们的神欢喜。因他赐给你们合宜的秋雨，为你们降下甘霖，就是秋雨，春雨，和先前一样。

chapters.en: The threshing floors will be filled with grain; the vats will overflow with new wine and oil.
chapters.zh: 禾场必满了麦子，酒榨与油榨必有新酒和油盈溢。

chapters.en: “I will repay you for the years the locusts have eaten— the great locust and the young locust, the other locusts and the locust swarm — my great army that I sent among you.
chapters.zh: 我打发到你们中间的大军队，就是蝗虫，蝻子，蚂蚱，剪虫，那些年所吃的，我要补还你们。

chapters.en: You will have plenty to eat, until you are full, and you will praise the name of the LORD your God, who has worked wonders for you; never again will my people be shamed.
chapters.zh: 你们必多吃，而得饱足，就赞美为你们行奇妙事之耶和华你们神的名。我的百姓，必永远不至羞愧。

chapters.en: Then you will know that I am in Israel, that I am the LORD your God, and that there is no other; never again will my people be shamed.
chapters.zh: 你们必知道我是在以色列中间，又知道我是耶和华你们的神，在我以外并无别神。我的百姓必永远不至羞愧。

chapters.en: “And afterward, I will pour out my Spirit on all people. Your sons and daughters will prophesy, your old men will dream dreams, your young men will see visions.
chapters.zh: 以后，我要将我的灵浇灌凡有血气的。你们的儿女要说预言。你们的老年人要作异梦。少年人要见异象。

chapters.en: Even on my servants, both men and women, I will pour out my Spirit in those days.
chapters.zh: 在那些日子，我要将我的灵浇灌我的仆人和使女。

chapters.en: I will show wonders in the heavens and on the earth, blood and fire and billows of smoke.
chapters.zh: 在天上地下，我要显出奇事，有血有火，有烟柱。

chapters.en: The sun will be turned to darkness and the moon to blood before the coming of the great and dreadful day of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 日头要变为黑暗，月亮要变为血，这都在耶和华大而可畏的日子未到以前。

chapters.en: And everyone who calls on the name of the LORD will be saved; for on Mount Zion and in Jerusalem there will be deliverance, as the LORD has said, even among the survivors whom the LORD calls.
chapters.zh: 到那时候，凡求告耶和华名的就必得救。因为照耶和华所说的，在锡安山耶路撒冷必有逃脱的人，在剩下的人中必有耶和华所召的。

chapters.en: “In those days and at that time, when I restore the fortunes of Judah and Jerusalem,
chapters.zh: 到那日，我使犹大和耶路撒冷被掳之人归回的时候，

chapters.en: I will gather all nations and bring them down to the Valley of Jehoshaphat.There I will put them on trial for what they did to my inheritance, my people Israel, because they scattered my people among the nations and divided up my land.
chapters.zh: 我要聚集万民，带他们下到约沙法谷。在那里施行审判，因为他们将我的百姓，就是我的产业以色列，分散在列国中，又分取我的地土，

chapters.en: They cast lots for my people and traded boys for prostitutes; they sold girls for wine to drink.
chapters.zh: 且为我的百姓拈阄，将童子换妓女，卖童女买酒喝。

chapters.en: “Now what have you against me, Tyre and Sidon and all you regions of Philistia? Are you repaying me for something I have done? If you are paying me back, I will swiftly and speedily return on your own heads what you have done.
chapters.zh: 推罗，西顿，和非利士四境的人哪，你们与我何干。你们要报复我吗？若报复我，我必使报应速速归到你们的头上。

chapters.en: For you took my silver and my gold and carried off my finest treasures to your temples.
chapters.zh: 你们既然夺取我的金银，又将我可爱的宝物带入你们宫殿，（或作庙中），

chapters.en: You sold the people of Judah and Jerusalem to the Greeks, that you might send them far from their homeland.
chapters.zh: 并将犹大人，和耶路撒冷人，卖给希腊人（原文是雅完人），使他们远离自己的境界。

chapters.en: “See, I am going to rouse them out of the places to which you sold them, and I will return on your own heads what you have done.
chapters.zh: 我必激动他们离开你们所卖到之地，又必使报应归到你们的头上。

chapters.en: I will sell your sons and daughters to the people of Judah, and they will sell them to the Sabeans, a nation far away.” The LORD has spoken.
chapters.zh: 我必将你们的儿女卖在犹大人的手中，他们必卖给远方示巴国的人。这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: Proclaim this among the nations: Prepare for war! Rouse the warriors! Let all the fighting men draw near and attack.
chapters.zh: 当在万民中宣告说，要预备打仗。激动勇士。使一切战士上前来。

chapters.en: Beat your plowshares into swords and your pruning hooks into spears. Let the weakling say, “I am strong!”
chapters.zh: 要将犁头打成刀剑，将镰刀打成戈矛。软弱的要说，我有勇力。

chapters.en: Come quickly, all you nations from every side, and assemble there. Bring down your warriors, LORD!
chapters.zh: 四围的列国阿，你们要速速地来，一同聚集。耶和华阿，求你使你的大能者降临。

chapters.en: “Let the nations be roused; let them advance into the Valley of Jehoshaphat, for there I will sit to judge all the nations on every side.
chapters.zh: 万民都当兴起，上到约沙法谷。因为我必坐在那里，审判四围的列国。

chapters.en: Swing the sickle, for the harvest is ripe. Come, trample the grapes, for the winepress is full and the vats overflow— so great is their wickedness!”
chapters.zh: 开镰吧。因为庄稼熟了。践踏吧。因为酒榨满了，酒池盈溢。他们的罪恶甚大。

chapters.en: Multitudes, multitudes in the valley of decision! For the day of the LORD is near in the valley of decision.
chapters.zh: 许多许多的人在断定谷。因为耶和华的日子临近断定谷。

chapters.en: The sun and moon will be darkened, and the stars no longer shine.
chapters.zh: 日月昏暗，星宿无光。

chapters.en: The LORD will roar from Zion and thunder from Jerusalem; the earth and the heavens will tremble. But the LORD will be a refuge for his people, a stronghold for the people of Israel.
chapters.zh: 耶和华必从锡安吼叫，从耶路撒冷发声。天地就震动。耶和华却要作他百姓的避难所，作以色列人的保障。

chapters.en: “Then you will know that I, the LORD your God, dwell in Zion, my holy hill. Jerusalem will be holy; never again will foreigners invade her.
chapters.zh: 你们就知道我是耶和华你们的神，且又住在锡安我的圣山。那时，耶路撒冷必成为圣，外邦人不再从其中经过。

chapters.en: “In that day the mountains will drip new wine, and the hills will flow with milk; all the ravines of Judah will run with water. A fountain will flow out of the LORD’s house and will water the valley of acacias.
chapters.zh: 到那日，大山要滴甜酒。小山要流奶子，犹大溪河都有水流。必有泉源从耶和华的殿中流出来，滋润什亭谷。

chapters.en: But Egypt will be desolate, Edom a desert waste, because of violence done to the people of Judah, in whose land they shed innocent blood.
chapters.zh: 埃及必然荒凉，以东变为凄凉的旷野，都因向犹大人所行的强暴，又因在本地流无辜人的血。

chapters.en: Judah will be inhabited forever and Jerusalem through all generations.
chapters.zh: 但犹大必存到永远，耶路撒冷必存到万代。

chapters.en: Shall I leave their innocent blood unavenged? No, I will not.” The LORD dwells in Zion!
chapters.zh: 我未曾报复（或作洗除下同）流血的罪，现在我要报复。因为耶和华住在锡安。

chapters.en: The words of Amos, one of the shepherds of Tekoa—the vision he saw concerning Israel two years before the earthquake, when Uzziah was king of Judah and Jeroboam son of Jehoash was king of Israel.
chapters.zh: 当犹大王乌西雅，以色列王约阿施的儿子，耶罗波安在位的时候，大地震前二年，提哥亚牧人中的阿摩司得默示论以色列。

chapters.en: He said: “The LORD roars from Zion and thunders from Jerusalem; the pastures of the shepherds dry up, and the top of Carmel withers.”
chapters.zh: 他说，耶和华必从锡安吼叫，从耶路撒冷发声。牧人的草场要悲哀，迦密的山顶要枯干。

chapters.en: This is what the LORD says: “For three sins of Damascus, even for four, I will not relent. Because she threshed Gilead with sledges having iron teeth,
chapters.zh: 耶和华如此说，大马色三番四次地犯罪，我必不免去她的刑罚。因为她以打粮食的铁器打过基列。

chapters.en: I will send fire on the house of Hazael that will consume the fortresses of Ben-Hadad.
chapters.zh: 我却要降火在哈薛的家中，烧灭便哈达的宫殿。

chapters.en: I will break down the gate of Damascus; I will destroy the king who is in the Valley of Avenand the one who holds the scepter in Beth Eden. The people of Aram will go into exile to Kir,” says the LORD.
chapters.zh: 我必折断大马色的门闩，剪除亚文平原的居民，和伯伊甸掌权的。亚兰人必被掳到吉珥。这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: This is what the LORD says: “For three sins of Gaza, even for four, I will not relent. Because she took captive whole communities and sold them to Edom,
chapters.zh: 耶和华如此说，迦萨三番四次的犯罪，我必不免去她的刑罚。因为她掳掠众民交给以东。

chapters.en: I will send fire on the walls of Gaza that will consume her fortresses.
chapters.zh: 我却要降火在迦萨的城内，烧灭其中的宫殿。

chapters.en: I will destroy the king of Ashdod and the one who holds the scepter in Ashkelon. I will turn my hand against Ekron, till the last of the Philistines are dead,” says the Sovereign LORD.
chapters.zh: 我必剪除亚实突的居民，和亚实基伦掌权的。也必反手攻击以革伦。非利士人所余剩的必都灭亡。这是主耶和华说的。

chapters.en: This is what the LORD says: “For three sins of Tyre, even for four, I will not relent. Because she sold whole communities of captives to Edom, disregarding a treaty of brotherhood,
chapters.zh: 耶和华如此说，推罗三番四次的犯罪，我必不免去她的刑罚。因为她将众民交给以东，并不记念弟兄的盟约。

chapters.en: I will send fire on the walls of Tyre that will consume her fortresses.”
chapters.zh: 我却要降火在推罗的城内，烧灭其中的宫殿。

chapters.en: This is what the LORD says: “For three sins of Edom, even for four, I will not relent. Because he pursued his brother with a sword and slaughtered the women of the land, because his anger raged continually and his fury flamed unchecked,
chapters.zh: 耶和华如此说，以东三番四次的犯罪，我必不免去她的刑罚。因为她拿刀追赶兄弟，毫无怜悯，发怒撕裂，永怀忿怒。

chapters.en: I will send fire on Teman that will consume the fortresses of Bozrah.”
chapters.zh: 我却要降火在提幔，烧灭波斯拉的宫殿。

chapters.en: This is what the LORD says: “For three sins of Ammon, even for four, I will not relent. Because he ripped open the pregnant women of Gilead in order to extend his borders,
chapters.zh: 耶和华如此说，亚扪人三番四次的犯罪，我必不免去他们的刑罚。因为他们剖开基列的孕妇，扩张自己的境界。

chapters.en: I will set fire to the walls of Rabbah that will consume her fortresses amid war cries on the day of battle, amid violent winds on a stormy day.
chapters.zh: 我却要在争战呐喊的日子，旋风狂暴的时候，点火在拉巴的城内，烧灭其中的宫殿。

chapters.en: Her king will go into exile, he and his officials together,” says the LORD.
chapters.zh: 他们的王和首领，必一同被掳去。这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: This is what the LORD says: “For three sins of Moab, even for four, I will not relent. Because he burned to ashes the bones of Edom’s king,
chapters.zh: 耶和华如此说，摩押三番四次的犯罪，我必不免去她的刑罚。因为她将以东王的骸骨焚烧成灰。

chapters.en: I will send fire on Moab that will consume the fortresses of Kerioth.Moab will go down in great tumult amid war cries and the blast of the trumpet.
chapters.zh: 我却要降火在摩押，烧灭加略的宫殿。摩押必在哄嚷呐喊吹角之中死亡。

chapters.en: I will destroy her ruler and kill all her officials with him,” says the LORD.
chapters.zh: 我必剪除摩押中的审判者，将其中的一切首领，和他一同杀戮。这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: This is what the LORD says: “For three sins of Judah, even for four, I will not relent. Because they have rejected the law of the LORD and have not kept his decrees, because they have been led astray by false gods,the gods their ancestors followed,
chapters.zh: 耶和华如此说，犹大人三番四次的犯罪，我必不免去他们的刑罚。因为他们厌弃耶和华的训诲，不遵守他的律例。他们列祖所随从虚假的偶像，使他们走迷了。

chapters.en: I will send fire on Judah that will consume the fortresses of Jerusalem.”
chapters.zh: 我却要降火在犹大，烧灭耶路撒冷的宫殿。

chapters.en: This is what the LORD says: “For three sins of Israel, even for four, I will not relent. They sell the innocent for silver, and the needy for a pair of sandals.
chapters.zh: 耶和华如此说，以色列人三番四次的犯罪，我必不免去他们的刑罚。因他们为银子卖了义人，为一双鞋卖了穷人。

chapters.en: They trample on the heads of the poor as on the dust of the ground and deny justice to the oppressed. Father and son use the same girl and so profane my holy name.
chapters.zh: 他们见穷人头上所蒙的灰也都垂涎。阻碍谦卑人的道路。父子同一个女子行淫，亵渎我的圣名。

chapters.en: They lie down beside every altar on garments taken in pledge. In the house of their god they drink wine taken as fines.
chapters.zh: 他们在各坛旁，铺人所当的衣服，卧在其上。又在他们神的庙中，喝受罚之人的酒。

chapters.en: “Yet I destroyed the Amorites before them, though they were tall as the cedars and strong as the oaks. I destroyed their fruit above and their roots below.
chapters.zh: 我从以色列人面前除灭亚摩利人。他虽高大如香柏树，坚固如橡树，我却上灭他的果子，下绝他的根本。

chapters.en: I brought you up out of Egypt and led you forty years in the wilderness to give you the land of the Amorites.
chapters.zh: 我也将你们从埃及地领上来，在旷野引导你们四十年，使你们得亚摩利人之地为业。

chapters.en: “I also raised up prophets from among your children and Nazirites from among your youths. Is this not true, people of Israel?” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 我从你们子弟中兴起先知，又从你们少年人中兴起拿细耳人。以色列人哪，不是这样吗？这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: “But you made the Nazirites drink wine and commanded the prophets not to prophesy.
chapters.zh: 你们却给拿细耳人酒喝，嘱咐先知说，不要说预言。

chapters.en: “Now then, I will crush you as a cart crushes when loaded with grain.
chapters.zh: 看哪，在你们所住之地，我必压你们，如同装满禾捆的车压物一样。

chapters.en: The swift will not escape, the strong will not muster their strength, and the warrior will not save his life.
chapters.zh: 快跑的不能逃脱，有力的不能用力，刚勇的也不能自救。

chapters.en: The archer will not stand his ground, the fleet-footed soldier will not get away, and the horseman will not save his life.
chapters.zh: 拿弓的不能站立，腿快的不能逃脱。骑马的也不能自救。

chapters.en: Even the bravest warriors will flee naked on that day,” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 到那日，勇士中最有胆量的，必赤身逃跑。这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: Hear this word, people of Israel, the word the LORD has spoken against you—against the whole family I brought up out of Egypt:
chapters.zh: 以色列人哪，你们全家是我从埃及地领上来的，当听耶和华攻击你们的话。

chapters.en: “You only have I chosen of all the families of the earth; therefore I will punish you for all your sins.”
chapters.zh: 在地上万族中，我只认识你们。因此，我必追讨你们的一切罪孽。

chapters.en: Do two walk together unless they have agreed to do so?
chapters.zh: 二人若不同心，岂能同行呢？

chapters.en: Does a lion roar in the thicket when it has no prey? Does it growl in its den when it has caught nothing?
chapters.zh: 狮子若非抓食，岂能在林中咆哮呢？少壮狮子若无所得，岂能从洞中发声呢？

chapters.en: Does a bird swoop down to a trap on the ground when no bait is there? Does a trap spring up from the ground if it has not caught anything?
chapters.zh: 若没有机槛，雀鸟岂能陷在网罗里呢？网罗若无所得，岂能从地上翻起呢？

chapters.en: When a trumpet sounds in a city, do not the people tremble? When disaster comes to a city, has not the LORD caused it?
chapters.zh: 城中若吹角，百姓岂不惊恐呢？灾祸若临到一城，岂非耶和华所降的吗？

chapters.en: Surely the Sovereign LORD does nothing without revealing his plan to his servants the prophets.
chapters.zh: 主耶和华若不将奥秘指示他的仆人众先知，就一无所行。

chapters.en: The lion has roared— who will not fear? The Sovereign LORD has spoken— who can but prophesy?
chapters.zh: 狮子吼叫，谁不惧怕呢？主耶和华发命，谁能不说预言呢？

chapters.en: Proclaim to the fortresses of Ashdod and to the fortresses of Egypt: “Assemble yourselves on the mountains of Samaria; see the great unrest within her and the oppression among her people.”
chapters.zh: 要在亚实突的宫殿中，和埃及地的宫殿里，传扬说，你们要聚集在撒玛利亚的山上，就看见城中有何等大的扰乱与欺压的事。

chapters.en: “They do not know how to do right,” declares the LORD, “who store up in their fortresses what they have plundered and looted.”
chapters.zh: 那些以强暴抢夺财物，积蓄在自己家中的人，不知道行正直的事。这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: Therefore this is what the Sovereign LORD says: “An enemy will overrun your land, pull down your strongholds and plunder your fortresses.”
chapters.zh: 所以主耶和华如此说，敌人必来围攻这地，使你的势力衰微，抢掠你的家宅。

chapters.en: This is what the LORD says: “As a shepherd rescues from the lion’s mouth only two leg bones or a piece of an ear, so will the Israelites living in Samaria be rescued, with only the head of a bed and a piece of fabric from a couch. ”
chapters.zh: 耶和华如此说，牧人怎样从狮子口中抢回两条羊腿或半个耳朵，住撒玛利亚的以色列人躺卧在床角上，或铺绣花毯的榻上，他们得救也不过如此。

chapters.en: “Hear this and testify against the descendants of Jacob,” declares the Lord, the LORD God Almighty.
chapters.zh: 主耶和华万军之神说，当听这话，警戒雅各家。

chapters.en: “On the day I punish Israel for her sins, I will destroy the altars of Bethel; the horns of the altar will be cut off and fall to the ground.
chapters.zh: 我讨以色列罪的日子，也要讨伯特利祭坛的罪。坛角必被砍下，坠落于地。

chapters.en: I will tear down the winter house along with the summer house; the houses adorned with ivory will be destroyed and the mansions will be demolished,” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 我要拆毁过冬和过夏的房屋，象牙的房屋也必毁灭，高大的房屋都归无有。这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: Hear this word, you cows of Bashan on Mount Samaria, you women who oppress the poor and crush the needy and say to your husbands, “Bring us some drinks!”
chapters.zh: 你们住撒玛利亚山如巴珊母牛的阿，当听我的话，你们欺负贫寒的，压碎穷乏的，对家主说，拿酒来，我们喝吧。

chapters.en: The Sovereign LORD has sworn by his holiness: “The time will surely come when you will be taken away with hooks, the last of you with fishhooks.
chapters.zh: 主耶和华指着自己的圣洁起誓说，日子快到，人必用钩子将你们钩去，用鱼钩将你们余剩的钩去。

chapters.en: You will each go straight out through breaches in the wall, and you will be cast out toward Harmon, ” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 你们各人必从破口直往前行，投入哈门。这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: “Go to Bethel and sin; go to Gilgal and sin yet more. Bring your sacrifices every morning, your tithes every three years.
chapters.zh: 以色列人哪，任你们往伯特利去犯罪，到吉甲加增罪过。每日早晨献上你们的祭物，每三日奉上你们的十分之一。

chapters.en: Burn leavened bread as a thank offering and brag about your freewill offerings— boast about them, you Israelites, for this is what you love to do,” declares the Sovereign LORD.
chapters.zh: 任你们献有酵的感谢祭，把甘心祭宣传报告给众人，因为是你们所喜爱的。这是主耶和华说的。

chapters.en: “I gave you empty stomachs in every city and lack of bread in every town, yet you have not returned to me,” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 我使你们在一切城中牙齿干净，在你们各处粮食缺乏，你们仍不归向我。这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: “I also withheld rain from you when the harvest was still three months away. I sent rain on one town, but withheld it from another. One field had rain; another had none and dried up.
chapters.zh: 在收割的前三月，我使雨停止，不降在你们那里。我降雨在这城，不降雨在那城。这块地有雨，那块地无雨，无雨的就枯干了。

chapters.en: People staggered from town to town for water but did not get enough to drink, yet you have not returned to me,” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 这样，两三城的人凑到一城去找水，却喝不足。你们仍不归向我。这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: “Many times I struck your gardens and vineyards, destroying them with blight and mildew. Locusts devoured your fig and olive trees, yet you have not returned to me,” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 我以旱（风，霉烂攻击你们。你们园中许多菜蔬，葡萄树，无花果树，橄榄树都被剪虫所吃。你们仍不归向我。这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: “I sent plagues among you as I did to Egypt. I killed your young men with the sword, along with your captured horses. I filled your nostrils with the stench of your camps, yet you have not returned to me,” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 我降瘟疫在你们中间，像在埃及一样。用刀杀戮你们的少年人，使你们的马匹被掳掠，营中尸首的臭气扑鼻。你们仍不归向我。这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: “I overthrew some of you as I overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah. You were like a burning stick snatched from the fire, yet you have not returned to me,” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 我倾覆你们中间的城邑，如同我从前倾覆所多玛，蛾摩拉一样，使你们好像从火中抽出来的一根柴。你们仍不归向我。这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: “Therefore this is what I will do to you, Israel, and because I will do this to you, Israel, prepare to meet your God.”
chapters.zh: 以色列阿，我必向你如此行。以色列阿，我既这样行，你当预备迎见你的神。

chapters.en: He who forms the mountains, who creates the wind, and who reveals his thoughts to mankind, who turns dawn to darkness, and treads on the heights of the earth— the LORD God Almighty is his name.
chapters.zh: 那创山，造风，将心意指示人，使晨光变为幽暗，脚踏在地之高处的。他的名是耶和华万军之神。

chapters.en: Hear this word, Israel, this lament I take up concerning you:
chapters.zh: 以色列家阿，要听我为你们所作的哀歌。

chapters.en: “Fallen is Virgin Israel, never to rise again, deserted in her own land, with no one to lift her up.”
chapters.zh: 以色列民（原文作处女）跌倒，不得再起，躺在地上，无人搀扶。

chapters.en: This is what the Sovereign LORD says to Israel: “Your city that marches out a thousand strong will have only a hundred left; your town that marches out a hundred strong will have only ten left.”
chapters.zh: 主耶和华如此说，以色列家的城，发出一千兵的，只剩一百，发出一百的，只剩十个。

chapters.en: This is what the LORD says to Israel: “Seek me and live;
chapters.zh: 耶和华向以色列家如此说，你们要寻求我，就必存活。

chapters.en: do not seek Bethel, do not go to Gilgal, do not journey to Beersheba. For Gilgal will surely go into exile, and Bethel will be reduced to nothing. ”
chapters.zh: 不要往伯特利寻求，不要进入吉甲，不要过到别是巴。因为吉甲必被掳掠，伯特利也必归于无有。

chapters.en: Seek the LORD and live, or he will sweep through the tribes of Joseph like a fire; it will devour them, and Bethel will have no one to quench it.
chapters.zh: 要寻求耶和华，就必存活。免得他在约瑟家像火发出，在伯特利焚烧，无人扑灭。

chapters.en: There are those who turn justice into bitterness and cast righteousness to the ground.
chapters.zh: 你们这使公平变为茵陈，将公义丢弃于地的，

chapters.en: He who made the Pleiades and Orion, who turns midnight into dawn and darkens day into night, who calls for the waters of the sea and pours them out over the face of the land— the LORD is his name.
chapters.zh: 要寻求那造昴星和参星，使死荫变为晨光，使白日变为黑夜，命海水来浇在地上的，（耶和华是他的名）

chapters.en: With a blinding flash he destroys the stronghold and brings the fortified city to ruin.
chapters.zh: 他使力强的忽遭灭亡，以致保障遭遇毁坏。

chapters.en: There are those who hate the one who upholds justice in court and detest the one who tells the truth.
chapters.zh: 你们怨恨那在城门口责备人的，憎恶那说正直话的。

chapters.en: You levy a straw tax on the poor and impose a tax on their grain. Therefore, though you have built stone mansions, you will not live in them; though you have planted lush vineyards, you will not drink their wine.
chapters.zh: 你们践踏贫民，向他们勒索麦子。你们用凿过的石头建造房屋，却不得住在其内，栽种美好的葡萄园，却不得喝所出的酒。

chapters.en: For I know how many are your offenses and how great your sins. There are those who oppress the innocent and take bribes and deprive the poor of justice in the courts.
chapters.zh: 我知道你们的罪过何等多，你们的罪恶何等大。你们苦待义人，收受贿赂，在城门口屈枉穷乏人。

chapters.en: Therefore the prudent keep quiet in such times, for the times are evil.
chapters.zh: 所以通达人见这样的时势，必静默不言。因为时势真恶。

chapters.en: Seek good, not evil, that you may live. Then the LORD God Almighty will be with you, just as you say he is.
chapters.zh: 你们要求善，不要求恶，就必存活。这样，耶和华万军之神，必照你们所说的，与你们同在。

chapters.en: Hate evil, love good; maintain justice in the courts. Perhaps the LORD God Almighty will have mercy on the remnant of Joseph.
chapters.zh: 要恶恶好善，在城门口秉公行义。或者耶和华万军之神，向约瑟的余民施恩。

chapters.en: Therefore this is what the Lord, the LORD God Almighty, says: “There will be wailing in all the streets and cries of anguish in every public square. The farmers will be summoned to weep and the mourners to wail.
chapters.zh: 主耶和华万军之神如此说，在一切宽阔处必有哀号的声音。在各街市上必有人说，哀哉，哀哉。又必叫农夫来哭号，叫善唱哀歌的来举哀。

chapters.en: There will be wailing in all the vineyards, for I will pass through your midst,” says the LORD.
chapters.zh: 在各葡萄园，必有哀号的声音。因为我必从你中间经过。这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: Woe to you who long for the day of the LORD! Why do you long for the day of the LORD? That day will be darkness, not light.
chapters.zh: 想望耶和华日子来到的有祸了。你们为何想望耶和华的日子呢？那日黑暗没有光明，

chapters.en: It will be as though a man fled from a lion only to meet a bear, as though he entered his house and rested his hand on the wall only to have a snake bite him.
chapters.zh: 景况好像人躲避狮子又遇见熊。或是进房屋以手靠墙，就被蛇咬。

chapters.en: Will not the day of the LORD be darkness, not light— pitch-dark, without a ray of brightness?
chapters.zh: 耶和华的日子，不是黑暗没有光明吗？不是幽暗毫无光辉吗？

chapters.en: “I hate, I despise your religious festivals; your assemblies are a stench to me.
chapters.zh: 我厌恶你们的节期，也不喜悦你们的严肃会。

chapters.en: Even though you bring me burnt offerings and grain offerings, I will not accept them. Though you bring choice fellowship offerings, I will have no regard for them.
chapters.zh: 你们虽然向我献燔祭，和素祭，我却不悦纳。也不顾你们用肥畜献的平安祭。

chapters.en: Away with the noise of your songs! I will not listen to the music of your harps.
chapters.zh: 要使你们歌唱的声音远离我。因为我不听你们弹琴的响声。

chapters.en: But let justice roll on like a river, righteousness like a never-failing stream!
chapters.zh: 惟愿公平如大水滚滚，使公义如江河滔滔。

chapters.en: “Did you bring me sacrifices and offerings forty years in the wilderness, people of Israel?
chapters.zh: 以色列家阿，你们在旷野四十年，岂是将祭物和供物献给我呢？

chapters.en: You have lifted up the shrine of your king, the pedestal of your idols, the star of your god — which you made for yourselves.
chapters.zh: 你们抬着为自己所造之摩洛的帐幕，和偶像的龛，并你们的神星。

chapters.en: Therefore I will send you into exile beyond Damascus,” says the LORD, whose name is God Almighty.
chapters.zh: 所以我要把你们掳到大马色以外。这是耶和华，名为万军之神说的。

chapters.en: Woe to you who are complacent in Zion, and to you who feel secure on Mount Samaria, you notable men of the foremost nation, to whom the people of Israel come!
chapters.zh: 国为列国之首，人最着名，且为以色列家所归向，在锡安和撒玛利亚山安逸无虑的，有祸了。

chapters.en: Go to Kalneh and look at it; go from there to great Hamath, and then go down to Gath in Philistia. Are they better off than your two kingdoms? Is their land larger than yours?
chapters.zh: 你们要过到甲尼察看，从那里往大城哈马去，又下到非利士人的迦特，看那些国比你们的国还强吗？境界比你们的境界还宽吗？

chapters.en: You put off the day of disaster and bring near a reign of terror.
chapters.zh: 你们以为降祸的日子还远，坐在位上尽行强暴（或作行强暴使审判临近）。

chapters.en: You lie on beds adorned with ivory and lounge on your couches. You dine on choice lambs and fattened calves.
chapters.zh: 你们躺卧在象牙床上，舒身在榻上，吃群中的羊羔，棚里的牛犊。

chapters.en: You strum away on your harps like David and improvise on musical instruments.
chapters.zh: 弹琴鼓瑟唱消闲的歌曲，为自己制造乐器，如同大卫所造的。

chapters.en: You drink wine by the bowlful and use the finest lotions, but you do not grieve over the ruin of Joseph.
chapters.zh: 以大碗喝酒，用上等的油抹身。却不为约瑟的苦难担忧。

chapters.en: Therefore you will be among the first to go into exile; your feasting and lounging will end.
chapters.zh: 所以这些人必在被掳的人中首先被掳。舒身的人荒宴之乐必消灭了。

chapters.en: The Sovereign LORD has sworn by himself—the LORD God Almighty declares: “I abhor the pride of Jacob and detest his fortresses; I will deliver up the city and everything in it.”
chapters.zh: 主耶和华万军之神指着自己起誓说，我憎恶雅各的荣华，厌弃他的宫殿。因此，我必将城和其中所有的，都交付敌人。

chapters.en: If ten people are left in one house, they too will die.
chapters.zh: 那时，若在一房之内剩下十个人，也都必死。

chapters.en: And if the relative who comes to carry the bodies out of the house to burn them asks anyone who might be hiding there, “Is anyone else with you?” and he says, “No,” then he will go on to say, “Hush! We must not mention the name of the LORD.”
chapters.zh: 死人的伯叔，就是烧他尸首的，要将这尸首搬到房外，问房屋内间的人说，你那里还有人没有。他必说，没有。又说，不要作声，因为我们不可提耶和华的名。

chapters.en: For the LORD has given the command, and he will smash the great house into pieces and the small house into bits.
chapters.zh: 看哪，耶和华出令，大房就被攻破，小屋就被打裂。

chapters.en: Do horses run on the rocky crags? Does one plow the sea with oxen? But you have turned justice into poison and the fruit of righteousness into bitterness—
chapters.zh: 马岂能在崖石上奔跑？人岂能在那里用牛耕种呢？你们却使公平变为苦胆，使公义的果子变为茵陈。

chapters.en: you who rejoice in the conquest of Lo Debarand say, “Did we not take Karnaim by our own strength?”
chapters.zh: 你们喜爱虚浮的事，自夸说，我们不是凭自己的力量取了角吗？

chapters.en: For the LORD God Almighty declares, “I will stir up a nation against you, Israel, that will oppress you all the way from Lebo Hamath to the valley of the Arabah.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华，万军之神说，以色列家阿，我必兴起一国攻击你们。他们必欺压你们，从哈马口直到亚拉巴的河。

chapters.en: This is what the Sovereign LORD showed me: He was preparing swarms of locusts after the king’s share had been harvested and just as the late crops were coming up.
chapters.zh: 主耶和华指示我一件事。为王割菜之后（菜或作草），菜又发生，刚发生的时候，主造蝗虫。

chapters.en: When they had stripped the land clean, I cried out, “Sovereign LORD, forgive! How can Jacob survive? He is so small!”
chapters.zh: 蝗虫吃尽那地的青物，我就说，主耶和华阿，求你赦免。因为雅各微弱，他怎能站立得住呢？

chapters.en: So the LORD relented. “This will not happen,” the LORD said.
chapters.zh: 耶和华就后悔说，这灾可以免了。

chapters.en: This is what the Sovereign LORD showed me: The Sovereign LORD was calling for judgment by fire; it dried up the great deep and devoured the land.
chapters.zh: 主耶和华又指示我一件事。他命火来惩罚以色列，火就吞灭深渊，险些将地烧灭。

chapters.en: Then I cried out, “Sovereign LORD, I beg you, stop! How can Jacob survive? He is so small!”
chapters.zh: 我就说，主耶和华阿，求你止息。因为雅各微弱。他怎能站立得住呢？

chapters.en: So the LORD relented. “This will not happen either,” the Sovereign LORD said.
chapters.zh: 耶和华就后悔说，这灾也可免了。

chapters.en: This is what he showed me: The Lord was standing by a wall that had been built true to plumb, with a plumb line in his hand.
chapters.zh: 他又指示我一件事。有一道墙是按准绳建筑的，主手拿准绳站在其上。

chapters.en: And the LORD asked me, “What do you see, Amos?” “A plumb line,” I replied. Then the Lord said, “Look, I am setting a plumb line among my people Israel; I will spare them no longer.
chapters.zh: 耶和华对我说，阿摩司阿，你看见什么。我说，看见准绳。主说，我要吊起准绳在我民以色列中。我必不再宽恕他们。

chapters.en: “The high places of Isaac will be destroyed and the sanctuaries of Israel will be ruined; with my sword I will rise against the house of Jeroboam.”
chapters.zh: 以撒的丘坛必然凄凉，以色列的圣所必然荒废。我必兴起，用刀攻击耶罗波安的家。

chapters.en: Then Amaziah the priest of Bethel sent a message to Jeroboam king of Israel: “Amos is raising a conspiracy against you in the very heart of Israel. The land cannot bear all his words.
chapters.zh: 伯特利的祭司亚玛谢打发人，到以色列王耶罗波安那里，说，阿摩司在以色列家中图谋背叛你。他所说的一切话，这国担当不起。

chapters.en: For this is what Amos is saying: “ ‘Jeroboam will die by the sword, and Israel will surely go into exile, away from their native land.’ ”
chapters.zh: 因为阿摩司如此说，耶罗波安必被刀杀，以色列民定被掳去离开本地。

chapters.en: Then Amaziah said to Amos, “Get out, you seer! Go back to the land of Judah. Earn your bread there and do your prophesying there.
chapters.zh: 亚玛谢又对阿摩司说，你这先见哪，要逃往犹大地去，在那里糊口，在那里说预言。

chapters.en: Don’t prophesy anymore at Bethel, because this is the king’s sanctuary and the temple of the kingdom.”
chapters.zh: 却不要在伯特利再说预言，因为这里有王的圣所，有王的宫殿。

chapters.en: Amos answered Amaziah, “I was neither a prophet nor the son of a prophet, but I was a shepherd, and I also took care of sycamore-fig trees.
chapters.zh: 阿摩司对亚玛谢说，我原不是先知，也不是先知的门徒（原文作儿子）。我是牧人，又是修理桑树的。

chapters.en: But the LORD took me from tending the flock and said to me, ‘Go, prophesy to my people Israel.’
chapters.zh: 耶和华选召我，使我不跟从羊群，对我说，你去向我民以色列说预言。

chapters.en: Now then, hear the word of the LORD. You say, “ ‘Do not prophesy against Israel, and stop preaching against the descendants of Isaac.’
chapters.zh: 亚玛谢阿，现在你要听耶和华的话。你说，不要向以色列说预言，也不要向以撒家滴下预言。

chapters.en: “Therefore this is what the LORD says: “ ‘Your wife will become a prostitute in the city, and your sons and daughters will fall by the sword. Your land will be measured and divided up, and you yourself will die in a pagan country. And Israel will surely go into exile, away from their native land.’ ”
chapters.zh: 所以耶和华如此说，你的妻子必在城中作妓女，你的儿女必倒在刀下，你的地必有人用绳子量了分取，你自己必死在污秽之地，以色列民定被掳去离开本地。

chapters.en: This is what the Sovereign LORD showed me: a basket of ripe fruit.
chapters.zh: 主耶和华又指示我一件事。我看见一筐夏天的果子。

chapters.en: “What do you see, Amos?” he asked. “A basket of ripe fruit,” I answered. Then the LORD said to me, “The time is ripe for my people Israel; I will spare them no longer.
chapters.zh: 他说，阿摩司阿，你看见什么。我说，看见一筐夏天的果子。耶和华说，我民以色列的结局到了。我必不再宽恕他们。

chapters.en: “In that day,” declares the Sovereign LORD, “the songs in the temple will turn to wailing. Many, many bodies—flung everywhere! Silence!”
chapters.zh: 主耶和华说，那日，殿中的诗歌变为哀号。必有许多尸首在各处抛弃，无人作声。

chapters.en: Hear this, you who trample the needy and do away with the poor of the land,
chapters.zh: 你们这些要吞吃穷乏人，使困苦人衰败的，当听我的话。

chapters.en: saying, “When will the New Moon be over that we may sell grain, and the Sabbath be ended that we may market wheat?”— skimping on the measure, boosting the price and cheating with dishonest scales,
chapters.zh: 你们说，月朔几时过去，我们好卖粮。安息日几时过去，我们好摆开麦子，卖出用小升斗，收银用大戥子，用诡诈的天平欺哄人。

chapters.en: buying the poor with silver and the needy for a pair of sandals, selling even the sweepings with the wheat.
chapters.zh: 好用银子买贫寒人，用一双鞋换穷乏人，将坏了的麦子卖给人。

chapters.en: The LORD has sworn by himself, the Pride of Jacob: “I will never forget anything they have done.
chapters.zh: 耶和华指着雅各的荣耀起誓说，他们的一切行为，我必永远不忘。

chapters.en: “Will not the land tremble for this, and all who live in it mourn? The whole land will rise like the Nile; it will be stirred up and then sink like the river of Egypt.
chapters.zh: 地岂不因这事震动，其上的居民，不也悲哀吗？地必全然像尼罗河涨起，如同埃及河涌上落下。

chapters.en: “In that day,” declares the Sovereign LORD, “I will make the sun go down at noon and darken the earth in broad daylight.
chapters.zh: 主耶和华说，到那日，我必使日头在午间落下，使地在白昼黑暗。

chapters.en: I will turn your religious festivals into mourning and all your singing into weeping. I will make all of you wear sackcloth and shave your heads. I will make that time like mourning for an only son and the end of it like a bitter day.
chapters.zh: 我必使你们的节期变为悲哀，歌曲变为哀歌。众人腰束麻布，头上光秃，使这场悲哀如丧独生子，至终如痛苦的日子一样。

chapters.en: “The days are coming,” declares the Sovereign LORD, “when I will send a famine through the land— not a famine of food or a thirst for water, but a famine of hearing the words of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 主耶和华说，日子将到，我必命饥荒降在地上。人饥饿非因无饼，干渴非因无水，乃因不听耶和华的话。

chapters.en: People will stagger from sea to sea and wander from north to east, searching for the word of the LORD, but they will not find it.
chapters.zh: 他们必飘流，从这海到那海，从北边到东边，往来奔跑，寻求耶和华的话，却寻不着。

chapters.en: “In that day “the lovely young women and strong young men will faint because of thirst.
chapters.zh: 当那日，美貌的处女，和少年的男子，必因干渴发昏。

chapters.en: Those who swear by the sin of Samaria— who say, ‘As surely as your god lives, Dan,’ or, ‘As surely as the god of Beersheba lives’— they will fall, never to rise again.”
chapters.zh: 那指着撒玛利亚牛犊（原文作罪）起誓的，说，但哪，我们指着你那里的活神起誓。又说，我们指着别是巴的神道（神原文作活）起誓。这些人都必仆倒，永不再起来。

chapters.en: I saw the Lord standing by the altar, and he said: “Strike the tops of the pillars so that the thresholds shake. Bring them down on the heads of all the people; those who are left I will kill with the sword. Not one will get away, none will escape.
chapters.zh: 我看见主站在祭坛旁边。他说，你要击打柱顶，使门槛震动，打碎柱顶，落在众人头上。所剩下的人，我必用刀杀戮。无一人能逃避，无一人能逃脱。

chapters.en: Though they dig down to the depths below, from there my hand will take them. Though they climb up to the heavens above, from there I will bring them down.
chapters.zh: 他们虽然挖透阴间，我的手必取出他们来。虽然爬上天去，我必拿下他们来。

chapters.en: Though they hide themselves on the top of Carmel, there I will hunt them down and seize them. Though they hide from my eyes at the bottom of the sea, there I will command the serpent to bite them.
chapters.zh: 虽然藏在迦密山顶，我必搜寻，捉出他们来。虽然从我眼前藏在海底，我必命蛇咬他们。

chapters.en: Though they are driven into exile by their enemies, there I will command the sword to slay them. “I will keep my eye on them for harm and not for good.”
chapters.zh: 虽被仇敌掳去，我必命刀剑杀戮他们。我必向他们定住眼目。降祸不降福。

chapters.en: The Lord, the LORD Almighty— he touches the earth and it melts, and all who live in it mourn; the whole land rises like the Nile, then sinks like the river of Egypt;
chapters.zh: 主万军之耶和华摸地，地就消化，凡住在地上的，都必悲哀。地必全然像尼罗河涨起，如同埃及河落下。

chapters.en: he builds his lofty palace in the heavens and sets its foundation on the earth; he calls for the waters of the sea and pours them out over the face of the land— the LORD is his name.
chapters.zh: 那在天上建造楼阁，在地上安定穹苍，命海水浇在地上的，耶和华是他的名。

chapters.en: “Are not you Israelites the same to me as the Cushites ?” declares the LORD. “Did I not bring Israel up from Egypt, the Philistines from Caphtorand the Arameans from Kir?
chapters.zh: 耶和华说，以色列人哪，我岂不看你们如古实人吗？我岂不是领以色列人出埃及地，领非利士人出迦斐托，领亚兰人出吉珥吗？

chapters.en: “Surely the eyes of the Sovereign LORD are on the sinful kingdom. I will destroy it from the face of the earth. Yet I will not totally destroy the descendants of Jacob,” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 主耶和华的眼目察看这有罪的国。必将这国从地上灭绝，却不将雅各家灭绝净尽。这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: “For I will give the command, and I will shake the people of Israel among all the nations as grain is shaken in a sieve, and not a pebble will reach the ground.
chapters.zh: 我必出令，将以色列家分散在列国中，好像用筛子筛谷，连一粒也不落在地上。

chapters.en: All the sinners among my people will die by the sword, all those who say, ‘Disaster will not overtake or meet us.’
chapters.zh: 我民中的一切罪人说，灾祸必追不上我们，也迎不着我们。他们必死在刀下。

chapters.en: “In that day I will restore David’s fallen shelter— I will repair its broken walls and restore its ruins— and will rebuild it as it used to be,
chapters.zh: 到那日，我必建立大卫倒塌的帐幕，堵住其中的破口，把那破坏的建立起来，重新修造，像古时一样。

chapters.en: so that they may possess the remnant of Edom and all the nations that bear my name, ” declares the LORD, who will do these things.
chapters.zh: 使以色列人得以东所余剩的，和所有称为我名下的国。此乃行这事的耶和华说的。

chapters.en: “The days are coming,” declares the LORD, “when the reaper will be overtaken by the plowman and the planter by the one treading grapes. New wine will drip from the mountains and flow from all the hills,
chapters.zh: 耶和华说，日子将到，耕种的必接续收割的，踹葡萄的必接续撒种的。大山要滴下甜酒，小山都必流奶（原文作消化，见约珥书第三章十八节）。

chapters.en: and I will bring my people Israel back from exile.“They will rebuild the ruined cities and live in them. They will plant vineyards and drink their wine; they will make gardens and eat their fruit.
chapters.zh: 我必使我民以色列被掳的归回，他们必重修荒废的城邑居住，栽种葡萄园，喝其中所出的酒；修造果木园，吃其中的果子。

chapters.en: I will plant Israel in their own land, never again to be uprooted from the land I have given them,” says the LORD your God.
chapters.zh: 我要将他们栽于本地，他们不再从我所赐给他们的地上拔出来。这是耶和华你的神说的。

chapters.en: The vision of Obadiah. This is what the Sovereign LORD says about Edom— We have heard a message from the LORD: An envoy was sent to the nations to say, “Rise, let us go against her for battle”—
chapters.zh: 俄巴底亚得了耶和华的默示。论以东，说，我从耶和华那里听见信息，并有使者被差往列国去，说，起来吧，一同起来与以东争战。

chapters.en: “See, I will make you small among the nations; you will be utterly despised.
chapters.zh: 我使你以东在列国中为最小的，被人大大藐视。

chapters.en: The pride of your heart has deceived you, you who live in the clefts of the rocks and make your home on the heights, you who say to yourself, ‘Who can bring me down to the ground?’
chapters.zh: 住在山穴中，居所在高处的阿，你因狂傲自欺，心里说，谁能将我拉下地去呢？

chapters.en: Though you soar like the eagle and make your nest among the stars, from there I will bring you down,” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 你虽如大鹰高飞，在星宿之间搭窝，我必从那里拉下你来。这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: “If thieves came to you, if robbers in the night— oh, what a disaster awaits you!— would they not steal only as much as they wanted? If grape pickers came to you, would they not leave a few grapes?
chapters.zh: 盗贼若来在你那里，或强盗夜间而来，（你何竟被剪除）岂不偷窃直到够了呢？摘葡萄的若来到你那里，岂不剩下些葡萄呢？

chapters.en: But how Esau will be ransacked, his hidden treasures pillaged!
chapters.zh: 以扫的隐密处，何竟被搜寻？他隐藏的宝物何竟被查出？

chapters.en: All your allies will force you to the border; your friends will deceive and overpower you; those who eat your bread will set a trap for you,but you will not detect it.
chapters.zh: 与你结盟的，都送你上路，直到交界。与你和好的，欺骗你，且胜过你。与你一同吃饭的，设下网罗陷害你。在你心里毫无聪明。

chapters.en: “In that day,” declares the LORD, “will I not destroy the wise men of Edom, those of understanding in the mountains of Esau?
chapters.zh: 耶和华说，到那日，我岂不从以东除灭智慧人，从以扫山除灭聪明人。

chapters.en: Your warriors, Teman, will be terrified, and everyone in Esau’s mountains will be cut down in the slaughter.
chapters.zh: 提幔哪，你的勇士必惊惶，甚至以扫山的人，都被杀戮剪除。

chapters.en: Because of the violence against your brother Jacob, you will be covered with shame; you will be destroyed forever.
chapters.zh: 因你向兄弟雅各行强暴，羞愧必遮盖你，你也必永远断绝。

chapters.en: On the day you stood aloof while strangers carried off his wealth and foreigners entered his gates and cast lots for Jerusalem, you were like one of them.
chapters.zh: 当外人掳掠雅各的财物，外邦人进入他的城门，为耶路撒冷拈阄的日子，你竟站在一旁，像与他们同伙。

chapters.en: You should not gloat over your brother in the day of his misfortune, nor rejoice over the people of Judah in the day of their destruction, nor boast so much in the day of their trouble.
chapters.zh: 你兄弟遭难的日子，你不当瞪眼看着，犹大人被灭的日子，你不当因此欢乐。他们遭难的日子，你不当说狂傲的话。

chapters.en: You should not march through the gates of my people in the day of their disaster, nor gloat over them in their calamity in the day of their disaster, nor seize their wealth in the day of their disaster.
chapters.zh: 我民遭灾的日子，你不当进他们的城门。他们遭灾的日子，你不当瞪眼看着他们受苦。他们遭灾的日子，你不当伸手抢他们的财物。

chapters.en: You should not wait at the crossroads to cut down their fugitives, nor hand over their survivors in the day of their trouble.
chapters.zh: 你不当站在岔路口，剪除他们中间逃脱的。他们遭难的日子，你不当将他们剩下的人交付仇敌。

chapters.en: “The day of the LORD is near for all nations. As you have done, it will be done to you; your deeds will return upon your own head.
chapters.zh: 耶和华降罚的日子临近万国。你怎样行，他也必照样向你行。你的报应必归到你头上。

chapters.en: Just as you drank on my holy hill, so all the nations will drink continually; they will drink and drink and be as if they had never been.
chapters.zh: 你们犹大人在我圣山怎样喝了苦杯，万国也必照样常常地喝。且喝且咽，他们就归于无有。

chapters.en: But on Mount Zion will be deliverance; it will be holy, and Jacob will possess his inheritance.
chapters.zh: 在锡安山必有逃脱的人，那山也必成圣。雅各家必得原有的产业。

chapters.en: Jacob will be a fire and Joseph a flame; Esau will be stubble, and they will set him on fire and destroy him. There will be no survivors from Esau.” The LORD has spoken.
chapters.zh: 雅各家必成为大火，约瑟家必为火焰，以扫家必如碎秸，火必将他烧着吞灭。以扫家必无余剩的。这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: People from the Negev will occupy the mountains of Esau, and people from the foothills will possess the land of the Philistines. They will occupy the fields of Ephraim and Samaria, and Benjamin will possess Gilead.
chapters.zh: 南地的人必得以扫山，高原的人必得非利士地，也得以法莲地，和撒玛利亚地，便雅悯人必得基列。

chapters.en: This company of Israelite exiles who are in Canaan will possess the land as far as Zarephath; the exiles from Jerusalem who are in Sepharad will possess the towns of the Negev.
chapters.zh: 在迦南人中被掳的以色列众人，必得地直到撒勒法。在西法拉中被掳的耶路撒冷人，必得南地的城邑。

chapters.en: Deliverers will go up on Mount Zion to govern the mountains of Esau. And the kingdom will be the LORD’s.
chapters.zh: 必有拯救者上到锡安山，审判以扫山，国度就归耶和华了。

chapters.en: The word of the LORD came to Jonah son of Amittai:
chapters.zh: 耶和华的话临到亚米太的儿子约拿，说，

chapters.en: “Go to the great city of Nineveh and preach against it, because its wickedness has come up before me.”
chapters.zh: 你起来往尼尼微大城去，向其中的居民呼喊。因为他们的恶达到我面前。

chapters.en: But Jonah ran away from the LORD and headed for Tarshish. He went down to Joppa, where he found a ship bound for that port. After paying the fare, he went aboard and sailed for Tarshish to flee from the LORD.
chapters.zh: 约拿却起来，逃往他施去躲避耶和华。下到约帕，遇见一只船，要往他施去。他就给了船价，上了船，要与船上的人同往他施去躲避耶和华。

chapters.en: Then the LORD sent a great wind on the sea, and such a violent storm arose that the ship threatened to break up.
chapters.zh: 然而耶和华使海中起大风，海就狂风大作，甚至船几乎破坏。

chapters.en: All the sailors were afraid and each cried out to his own god. And they threw the cargo into the sea to lighten the ship. But Jonah had gone below deck, where he lay down and fell into a deep sleep.
chapters.zh: 水手便惧怕，各人哀求自己的神。他们将船上的货物抛在海中，为要使船轻些。约拿已下到底舱，躺卧沉睡。

chapters.en: The captain went to him and said, “How can you sleep? Get up and call on your god! Maybe he will take notice of us so that we will not perish.”
chapters.zh: 船主到他那里对他说，你这沉睡的人哪，为何这样呢？起来，求告你的神，或者神顾念我们，使我们不至灭亡。

chapters.en: Then the sailors said to each other, “Come, let us cast lots to find out who is responsible for this calamity.” They cast lots and the lot fell on Jonah.
chapters.zh: 船上的人彼此说，来吧，我们掣签，看看这灾临到我们是因谁的缘故。于是他们掣签，掣出约拿来。

chapters.en: So they asked him, “Tell us, who is responsible for making all this trouble for us? What kind of work do you do? Where do you come from? What is your country? From what people are you?”
chapters.zh: 众人对他说，请你告诉我们，这灾临到我们是因谁的缘故。你以何事为业。你从哪里来。你是哪一国，属哪一族的人。

chapters.en: He answered, “I am a Hebrew and I worship the LORD, the God of heaven, who made the sea and the dry land.”
chapters.zh: 他说，我是希伯来人。我敬畏耶和华，那创造沧海旱地之天上的神。

chapters.en: This terrified them and they asked, “What have you done?” (They knew he was running away from the LORD, because he had already told them so.)
chapters.zh: 他们就大大惧怕，对他说，你做的是什么事呢？他们已经知道他躲避耶和华，因为他告诉了他们。

chapters.en: The sea was getting rougher and rougher. So they asked him, “What should we do to you to make the sea calm down for us?”
chapters.zh: 他们问他说，我们当向你怎样行，使海浪平静呢？这话是因海浪越发翻腾。

chapters.en: “Pick me up and throw me into the sea,” he replied, “and it will become calm. I know that it is my fault that this great storm has come upon you.”
chapters.zh: 他对他们说，你们将我抬起来，抛在海中，海就平静了。我知道你们遭这大风，是因我的缘故。

chapters.en: Instead, the men did their best to row back to land. But they could not, for the sea grew even wilder than before.
chapters.zh: 然而那些人竭力荡桨，要把船拢岸，却是不能。因为海浪越发向他们翻腾。

chapters.en: Then they cried out to the LORD, “Please, LORD, do not let us die for taking this man’s life. Do not hold us accountable for killing an innocent man, for you, LORD, have done as you pleased.”
chapters.zh: 他们便求告耶和华说，耶和华阿，我们恳求你，不要因这人的性命使我们死亡，不要使流无辜血的罪归与我们。因为你耶和华是随自己的意旨行事。

chapters.en: Then they took Jonah and threw him overboard, and the raging sea grew calm.
chapters.zh: 他们遂将约拿抬起，抛在海中，海的狂浪就平息了。

chapters.en: At this the men greatly feared the LORD, and they offered a sacrifice to the LORD and made vows to him.
chapters.zh: 那些人便大大敬畏耶和华，向耶和华献祭，并且许愿。

chapters.en: Now the LORD provided a huge fish to swallow Jonah, and Jonah was in the belly of the fish three days and three nights.
chapters.zh: 耶和华安排一条大鱼吞了约拿，他在鱼腹中三日三夜。

chapters.en: From inside the fish Jonah prayed to the LORD his God.
chapters.zh: 约拿在鱼腹中祷告耶和华他的神，

chapters.en: He said: “In my distress I called to the LORD, and he answered me. From deep in the realm of the dead I called for help, and you listened to my cry.
chapters.zh: 说，我遭遇患难求告耶和华，你就应允我。从阴间的深处呼求，你就俯听我的声音。

chapters.en: You hurled me into the depths, into the very heart of the seas, and the currents swirled about me; all your waves and breakers swept over me.
chapters.zh: 你将我投下深渊，就是海的深处。大水环绕我。你的波浪洪涛都漫过我身。

chapters.en: I said, ‘I have been banished from your sight; yet I will look again toward your holy temple.’
chapters.zh: 我说，我从你眼前虽被驱逐，我仍要仰望你的圣殿。

chapters.en: The engulfing waters threatened me,the deep surrounded me; seaweed was wrapped around my head.
chapters.zh: 诸水环绕我，几乎淹没我。深渊围住我，海草缠绕我的头。

chapters.en: To the roots of the mountains I sank down; the earth beneath barred me in forever. But you, LORD my God, brought my life up from the pit.
chapters.zh: 我下到山根。地的门将我永远关住。耶和华我的神阿，你却将我的性命，从坑中救出来。

chapters.en: “When my life was ebbing away, I remembered you, LORD, and my prayer rose to you, to your holy temple.
chapters.zh: 我心在我里面发昏的时候，我就想念耶和华。我的祷告进入你的圣殿，达到你的面前。

chapters.en: “Those who cling to worthless idols turn away from God’s love for them.
chapters.zh: 那信奉虚无之神的人，离弃怜爱他们的主。

chapters.en: But I, with shouts of grateful praise, will sacrifice to you. What I have vowed I will make good. I will say, ‘Salvation comes from the LORD.’ ”
chapters.zh: 但我必用感谢的声音献祭与你。我所许的愿，我必偿还。救恩出于耶和华。

chapters.en: And the LORD commanded the fish, and it vomited Jonah onto dry land.
chapters.zh: 耶和华吩咐鱼，鱼就把约拿吐在旱地上。

chapters.en: Then the word of the LORD came to Jonah a second time:
chapters.zh: 耶和华的话，二次临到约拿说，

chapters.en: “Go to the great city of Nineveh and proclaim to it the message I give you.”
chapters.zh: 你起来，往尼尼微大城去，向其中的居民宣告我所吩咐你的话。

chapters.en: Jonah obeyed the word of the LORD and went to Nineveh. Now Nineveh was a very large city; it took three days to go through it.
chapters.zh: 约拿便照耶和华的话起来，往尼尼微去。这尼尼微是极大的城，有三日的路程。

chapters.en: Jonah began by going a day’s journey into the city, proclaiming, “Forty more days and Nineveh will be overthrown.”
chapters.zh: 约拿进城走了一日，宣告说，再等四十日，尼尼微必倾覆了。

chapters.en: The Ninevites believed God. A fast was proclaimed, and all of them, from the greatest to the least, put on sackcloth.
chapters.zh: 尼尼微人信服神，便宣告禁食，从最大的到至小的，都穿麻衣（或作披上麻布）。

chapters.en: When Jonah’s warning reached the king of Nineveh, he rose from his throne, took off his royal robes, covered himself with sackcloth and sat down in the dust.
chapters.zh: 这信息传到尼尼微王的耳中，他就下了宝座，脱下朝服，披上麻布，坐在灰中。

chapters.en: This is the proclamation he issued in Nineveh: “By the decree of the king and his nobles: Do not let people or animals, herds or flocks, taste anything; do not let them eat or drink.
chapters.zh: 他又使人遍告尼尼微通城，说，王和大臣有令，人不可尝什么，牲畜，牛羊不可吃草，也不可喝水。

chapters.en: But let people and animals be covered with sackcloth. Let everyone call urgently on God. Let them give up their evil ways and their violence.
chapters.zh: 人与牲畜都当披上麻布，人要切切求告神。各人回头离开所行的恶道，丢弃手中的强暴。

chapters.en: Who knows? God may yet relent and with compassion turn from his fierce anger so that we will not perish.”
chapters.zh: 或者神转意后悔，不发烈怒，使我们不至灭亡，也未可知。

chapters.en: When God saw what they did and how they turned from their evil ways, he relented and did not bring on them the destruction he had threatened.
chapters.zh: 于是神察看他们的行为，见他们离开恶道，他就后悔，不把所说的灾祸降与他们了。

chapters.en: But to Jonah this seemed very wrong, and he became angry.
chapters.zh: 这事约拿大大不悦，且甚发怒。

chapters.en: He prayed to the LORD, “Isn’t this what I said, LORD, when I was still at home? That is what I tried to forestall by fleeing to Tarshish. I knew that you are a gracious and compassionate God, slow to anger and abounding in love, a God who relents from sending calamity.
chapters.zh: 就祷告耶和华说，耶和华阿，我在本国的时候，岂不是这样说吗？我知道你是有恩典，有怜悯的神，不轻易发怒，有丰盛的慈爱，并且后悔不降所说的灾，所以我急速逃往他施去。

chapters.en: Now, LORD, take away my life, for it is better for me to die than to live.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，现在求你取我的命吧。因为我死了比活着还好。

chapters.en: But the LORD replied, “Is it right for you to be angry?”
chapters.zh: 耶和华说，你这样发怒合乎理吗？

chapters.en: Jonah had gone out and sat down at a place east of the city. There he made himself a shelter, sat in its shade and waited to see what would happen to the city.
chapters.zh: 于是约拿出城，坐在城的东边，在那里为自己搭了一座棚，坐在棚的荫下，要看看那城究竟如何。

chapters.en: Then the LORD God provided a leafy plant and made it grow up over Jonah to give shade for his head to ease his discomfort, and Jonah was very happy about the plant.
chapters.zh: 耶和华神安排一棵蓖麻，使其发生高过约拿，影儿遮盖他的头，救他脱离苦楚。约拿因这棵蓖麻大大喜乐。

chapters.en: But at dawn the next day God provided a worm, which chewed the plant so that it withered.
chapters.zh: 次日黎明，神却安排一条虫子咬这蓖麻，以致枯槁。

chapters.en: When the sun rose, God provided a scorching east wind, and the sun blazed on Jonah’s head so that he grew faint. He wanted to die, and said, “It would be better for me to die than to live.”
chapters.zh: 日头出来的时候，神安排炎热的东风。日头曝晒约拿的头，使他发昏，他就为自己求死，说，我死了比活着还好。

chapters.en: But God said to Jonah, “Is it right for you to be angry about the plant?” “It is,” he said. “And I’m so angry I wish I were dead.”
chapters.zh: 神对约拿说，你因这棵蓖麻发怒合乎理吗？他说，我发怒以至于死都合乎理。

chapters.en: But the LORD said, “You have been concerned about this plant, though you did not tend it or make it grow. It sprang up overnight and died overnight.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说，这蓖麻不是你栽种的，也不是你培养的。一夜发生，一夜干死，你尚且爱惜。

chapters.en: And should I not have concern for the great city of Nineveh, in which there are more than a hundred and twenty thousand people who cannot tell their right hand from their left—and also many animals?”
chapters.zh: 何况这尼尼微大城，其中不能分辨左手右手的有十二万多人，并有许多牲畜。我岂能不爱惜呢？

chapters.en: The word of the LORD that came to Micah of Moresheth during the reigns of Jotham, Ahaz and Hezekiah, kings of Judah—the vision he saw concerning Samaria and Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 当犹大王约坦，亚哈斯，希西家在位的时候，摩利沙人弥迦得耶和华的默示，论撒玛利亚和耶路撒冷。

chapters.en: Hear, you peoples, all of you, listen, earth and all who live in it, that the Sovereign LORD may bear witness against you, the Lord from his holy temple.
chapters.zh: 万民哪，你们都要听。地和其上所有的，也都要侧耳而听。主耶和华从他的圣殿，要见证你们的不是。

chapters.en: Look! The LORD is coming from his dwelling place; he comes down and treads on the heights of the earth.
chapters.zh: 看哪，耶和华出了他的居所，降临步行地的高处。

chapters.en: The mountains melt beneath him and the valleys split apart, like wax before the fire, like water rushing down a slope.
chapters.zh: 众山在他以下必消化，诸谷必崩裂，如蜡化在火中，如水冲下山坡。

chapters.en: All this is because of Jacob’s transgression, because of the sins of the people of Israel. What is Jacob’s transgression? Is it not Samaria? What is Judah’s high place? Is it not Jerusalem?
chapters.zh: 这都因雅各的罪过，以色列家的罪恶。雅各的罪过在哪里呢？岂不是在撒玛利亚吗？犹大的丘坛在哪里呢？岂不是在耶路撒冷吗？

chapters.en: “Therefore I will make Samaria a heap of rubble, a place for planting vineyards. I will pour her stones into the valley and lay bare her foundations.
chapters.zh: 所以，我必使撒玛利亚变为田野的乱堆，又作为种葡萄之处。也必将她的石头倒在谷中，露出根基来。

chapters.en: All her idols will be broken to pieces; all her temple gifts will be burned with fire; I will destroy all her images. Since she gathered her gifts from the wages of prostitutes, as the wages of prostitutes they will again be used.”
chapters.zh: 她一切雕刻的偶像必被打碎，她所得的财物必被火烧，所有的偶像我必毁灭。因为是从妓女雇价所聚来的，后必归为妓女的雇价。

chapters.en: Because of this I will weep and wail; I will go about barefoot and naked. I will howl like a jackal and moan like an owl.
chapters.zh: 先知说，因此我必大声哀号，赤脚露体而行。又要呼号如野狗，哀鸣如鸵鸟。

chapters.en: For Samaria’s plague is incurable; it has spread to Judah. It has reached the very gate of my people, even to Jerusalem itself.
chapters.zh: 因为撒玛利亚的伤痕无法医治，延及犹大和耶路撒冷我民的城门。

chapters.en: Tell it not in Gath ; weep not at all. In Beth Ophrahroll in the dust.
chapters.zh: 不要在迦特报告这事，总不要哭泣。我在伯亚弗拉滚于灰尘之中。

chapters.en: Pass by naked and in shame, you who live in Shaphir.Those who live in Zaananwill not come out. Beth Ezel is in mourning; it no longer protects you.
chapters.zh: 沙斐的居民哪，你们要赤身蒙羞过去。撒南的居民不敢出来。伯以薛人的哀哭，使你们无处可站。

chapters.en: Those who live in Maroth writhe in pain, waiting for relief, because disaster has come from the LORD, even to the gate of Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 玛律的居民心甚忧急，切望得好处，因为灾祸从耶和华那里临到耶路撒冷的城门。

chapters.en: You who live in Lachish, harness fast horses to the chariot. You are where the sin of Daughter Zion began, for the transgressions of Israel were found in you.
chapters.zh: 拉吉的居民哪，要用快马套车。锡安民（民原文作女子）的罪由你而起。以色列人的罪过在你那里显出。

chapters.en: Therefore you will give parting gifts to Moresheth Gath. The town of Akzib will prove deceptive to the kings of Israel.
chapters.zh: 犹大阿，你要将礼物送给摩利设迦特。亚革悉的众族，必用诡诈待以色列诸王。

chapters.en: I will bring a conqueror against you who live in Mareshah.The nobles of Israel will flee to Adullam.
chapters.zh: 玛利沙的居民哪，我必使那夺取你的来到你这里。以色列的尊贵人（原文作荣耀）必到亚杜兰。

chapters.en: Shave your head in mourning for the children in whom you delight; make yourself as bald as the vulture, for they will go from you into exile.
chapters.zh: 犹大阿，要为你所喜爱的儿女剪除你的头发，使头光秃。要大大地光秃，如同秃鹰。因为他们都被掳去离开你。

chapters.en: Woe to those who plan iniquity, to those who plot evil on their beds! At morning’s light they carry it out because it is in their power to do it.
chapters.zh: 祸哉，那些在床上图谋罪孽，造作奸恶的。天一发亮，因手有能力就行出来了。

chapters.en: They covet fields and seize them, and houses, and take them. They defraud people of their homes, they rob them of their inheritance.
chapters.zh: 他们贪图田地就占据。贪图房屋便夺取。他们欺压人，霸占房屋和产业。

chapters.en: Therefore, the LORD says: “I am planning disaster against this people, from which you cannot save yourselves. You will no longer walk proudly, for it will be a time of calamity.
chapters.zh: 所以耶和华如此说，我筹划灾祸降与这族，这祸在你们的颈项上不能解脱，你们也不能昂首而行。因为这时势是恶的。

chapters.en: In that day people will ridicule you; they will taunt you with this mournful song: ‘We are utterly ruined; my people’s possession is divided up. He takes it from me! He assigns our fields to traitors.’ ”
chapters.zh: 到那日，必有人向你们提起悲惨的哀歌，讥刺说，我们全然败落了。耶和华将我们的分转归别人。何竟使这分离开我们。他将我们的田地分给悖逆的人。

chapters.en: Therefore you will have no one in the assembly of the LORD to divide the land by lot.
chapters.zh: 所以，在耶和华的会中，你必没有人拈阄拉准绳。

chapters.en: “Do not prophesy,” their prophets say. “Do not prophesy about these things; disgrace will not overtake us.”
chapters.zh: 他们（或作假先知）说，你们不可说预言，不可向这些人说预言，不住地羞辱我们。

chapters.en: You descendants of Jacob, should it be said, “Does the LORD become impatient? Does he do such things?” “Do not my words do good to the one whose ways are upright?
chapters.zh: 雅各家阿，岂可说耶和华的心不忍耐吗（或作心肠狭窄吗）？这些事是他所行的吗？我耶和华的言语，岂不是与行动正直的人有益吗？

chapters.en: Lately my people have risen up like an enemy. You strip off the rich robe from those who pass by without a care, like men returning from battle.
chapters.zh: 然而，近来我的民兴起如仇敌，从那些安然经过不愿打仗之人身上剥去外衣。

chapters.en: You drive the women of my people from their pleasant homes. You take away my blessing from their children forever.
chapters.zh: 你们将我民中的妇人从安乐家中赶出，又将我的荣耀从她们的小孩子尽行夺去。

chapters.en: Get up, go away! For this is not your resting place, because it is defiled, it is ruined, beyond all remedy.
chapters.zh: 你们起来去吧。这不是你们安息之所。因为污秽使人（或作地）毁灭，而且大大毁灭。

chapters.en: If a liar and deceiver comes and says, ‘I will prophesy for you plenty of wine and beer,’ that would be just the prophet for this people!
chapters.zh: 若有人心存虚假，用谎言说，我要向你们预言得清酒和浓酒。那人就必作这民的先知。

chapters.en: “I will surely gather all of you, Jacob; I will surely bring together the remnant of Israel. I will bring them together like sheep in a pen, like a flock in its pasture; the place will throng with people.
chapters.zh: 雅各家阿，我必要聚集你们，必要招聚以色列剩下的人，安置在一处，如波斯拉的羊，又如草场上的羊群。因为人数众多就必大大喧哗。

chapters.en: The One who breaks open the way will go up before them; they will break through the gate and go out. Their King will pass through before them, the LORD at their head.”
chapters.zh: 开路的（或作破城的）在他们前面上去。他们直闯过城门，从城门出去。他们的王在前面行，耶和华引导他们。

chapters.en: Then I said, “Listen, you leaders of Jacob, you rulers of Israel. Should you not embrace justice,
chapters.zh: 我说，雅各的首领，以色列家的官长阿，你们要听。你们不当知道公平吗？

chapters.en: you who hate good and love evil; who tear the skin from my people and the flesh from their bones;
chapters.zh: 你们恶善好恶。从人身上剥皮，从人骨头上剔肉。

chapters.en: who eat my people’s flesh, strip off their skin and break their bones in pieces; who chop them up like meat for the pan, like flesh for the pot?”
chapters.zh: 吃我民的肉，剥他们的皮，打折他们的骨头，分成块子像要下锅，又像釜中的肉。

chapters.en: Then they will cry out to the LORD, but he will not answer them. At that time he will hide his face from them because of the evil they have done.
chapters.zh: 到了遭灾的时候，这些人必哀求耶和华，他却不应允他们。那时他必照他们所行的恶事，向他们掩面。

chapters.en: This is what the LORD says: “As for the prophets who lead my people astray, they proclaim ‘peace’ if they have something to eat, but prepare to wage war against anyone who refuses to feed them.
chapters.zh: 论到使我民走差路的先知，他们牙齿有所嚼的，他们就呼喊说，平安了。凡不供给他们吃的，他们就预备攻击他（预备攻击他或作说必遭遇刀兵）耶和华如此说，

chapters.en: Therefore night will come over you, without visions, and darkness, without divination. The sun will set for the prophets, and the day will go dark for them.
chapters.zh: 你们必遭遇黑夜，以致不见异象。又必遭遇幽暗，以致不能占卜。日头必向你们沉落，白昼变为黑暗。

chapters.en: The seers will be ashamed and the diviners disgraced. They will all cover their faces because there is no answer from God.”
chapters.zh: 先见必抱愧，占卜的必蒙羞，都必捂着嘴唇，因为神不应允他们。

chapters.en: But as for me, I am filled with power, with the Spirit of the LORD, and with justice and might, to declare to Jacob his transgression, to Israel his sin.
chapters.zh: 至于我，我借耶和华的灵，满有力量公平才能，可以向雅各说明他的过犯，向以色列指出他的罪恶。

chapters.en: Hear this, you leaders of Jacob, you rulers of Israel, who despise justice and distort all that is right;
chapters.zh: 雅各家的首领，以色列家的官长阿，当听我的话。你们厌恶公平，在一切事上屈枉正直。

chapters.en: who build Zion with bloodshed, and Jerusalem with wickedness.
chapters.zh: 以人血建立锡安，以罪孽建造耶路撒冷。

chapters.en: Her leaders judge for a bribe, her priests teach for a price, and her prophets tell fortunes for money. Yet they look for the LORD’s support and say, “Is not the LORD among us? No disaster will come upon us.”
chapters.zh: 首领为贿赂行审判，祭司为雇价施训诲，先知为银钱行占卜。他们却倚赖耶和华，说，耶和华不是在我们中间吗？灾祸必不临到我们。

chapters.en: Therefore because of you, Zion will be plowed like a field, Jerusalem will become a heap of rubble, the temple hill a mound overgrown with thickets.
chapters.zh: 所以因你们的缘故，锡安必被耕种像一块田，耶路撒冷必变为乱堆，这殿的山必像丛林的高处。

chapters.en: In the last days the mountain of the LORD’s temple will be established as the highest of the mountains; it will be exalted above the hills, and peoples will stream to it.
chapters.zh: 末后的日子，耶和华殿的山必坚立，超乎诸山，高举过于万岭。万民都要流归这山。

chapters.en: Many nations will come and say, “Come, let us go up to the mountain of the LORD, to the temple of the God of Jacob. He will teach us his ways, so that we may walk in his paths.” The law will go out from Zion, the word of the LORD from Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 必有许多国的民前往，说，来吧，我们登耶和华的山，奔雅各神的殿。主必将他的道教训我们，我们也要行他的路。因为训诲必出于锡安，耶和华的言语必出于耶路撒冷。

chapters.en: He will judge between many peoples and will settle disputes for strong nations far and wide. They will beat their swords into plowshares and their spears into pruning hooks. Nation will not take up sword against nation, nor will they train for war anymore.
chapters.zh: 他必在多国的民中施行审判，为远方强盛的国断定是非。他们要将刀打成犁头，把枪打成镰刀。这国不举刀攻击那国，他们也不再学习战事。

chapters.en: Everyone will sit under their own vine and under their own fig tree, and no one will make them afraid, for the LORD Almighty has spoken.
chapters.zh: 人人都要坐在自己葡萄树下和无花果树下，无人惊吓。这是万军之耶和华亲口说的。

chapters.en: All the nations may walk in the name of their gods, but we will walk in the name of the LORD our God for ever and ever.
chapters.zh: 万民各奉己神的名而行。我们却永永远远奉耶和华我们神的名而行。

chapters.en: “In that day,” declares the LORD, “I will gather the lame; I will assemble the exiles and those I have brought to grief.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说，到那日，我必聚集瘸腿的，招聚被赶出的，和我所惩治的。

chapters.en: I will make the lame my remnant, those driven away a strong nation. The LORD will rule over them in Mount Zion from that day and forever.
chapters.zh: 我必使瘸腿的为余剩之民，使赶到远方的为强盛之民。耶和华要在锡安山作王治理他们，从今直到永远。

chapters.en: As for you, watchtower of the flock, stronghold of Daughter Zion, the former dominion will be restored to you; kingship will come to Daughter Jerusalem.”
chapters.zh: 你这羊群的高台，锡安城的山哪（城原文作女子），从前的权柄，就是耶路撒冷民的国权（民原文作女子），必归与你。

chapters.en: Why do you now cry aloud— have you no king ? Has your ruler perished, that pain seizes you like that of a woman in labor?
chapters.zh: 现在你为何大声哭号呢？疼痛抓住你仿佛产难的妇人。是因你中间没有君王吗？你的谋士灭亡了吗？

chapters.en: Writhe in agony, Daughter Zion, like a woman in labor, for now you must leave the city to camp in the open field. You will go to Babylon; there you will be rescued. There the LORD will redeem you out of the hand of your enemies.
chapters.zh: 锡安的民哪（民原文作女子），你要疼痛劬劳，仿佛产难的妇人。因为你必从城里出来，住在田野，到巴比伦去。在那里要蒙解救，在那里耶和华必救赎你脱离仇敌的手。

chapters.en: But now many nations are gathered against you. They say, “Let her be defiled, let our eyes gloat over Zion!”
chapters.zh: 现在有许多国的民聚集攻击你，说，愿锡安被玷污，愿我们亲眼见她遭报。

chapters.en: But they do not know the thoughts of the LORD; they do not understand his plan, that he has gathered them like sheaves to the threshing floor.
chapters.zh: 他们却不知道耶和华的意念，也不明白他的筹划。他聚集他们，好像把禾捆聚到禾场一样。

chapters.en: “Rise and thresh, Daughter Zion, for I will give you horns of iron; I will give you hooves of bronze, and you will break to pieces many nations.” You will devote their ill-gotten gains to the LORD, their wealth to the Lord of all the earth.
chapters.zh: 锡安的民哪（民原文作女子），起来踹谷吧。我必使你的角成为铁，使你的蹄成为铜。你必打碎多国的民。将他们的财献与耶和华，将他们的货献与普天下的主。

chapters.en: Marshal your troops now, city of troops, for a siege is laid against us. They will strike Israel’s ruler on the cheek with a rod.
chapters.zh: 成群的民哪（民原文作女子），现在你要聚集成队。因为仇敌围攻我们，要用杖击打以色列审判者的脸。

chapters.en: “But you, Bethlehem Ephrathah, though you are small among the clans of Judah, out of you will come for me one who will be ruler over Israel, whose origins are from of old, from ancient times.”
chapters.zh: 伯利恒，以法他阿，你在犹大诸城中为小。将来必有一位从你那里出来，在以色列中为我作掌权的。他的根源从亘古，从太初就有。

chapters.en: Therefore Israel will be abandoned until the time when she who is in labor bears a son, and the rest of his brothers return to join the Israelites.
chapters.zh: 耶和华必将以色列人交付敌人，直等那生产的妇人生下子来。那时掌权者（原文作他）其余的弟兄必归到以色列人那里。

chapters.en: He will stand and shepherd his flock in the strength of the LORD, in the majesty of the name of the LORD his God. And they will live securely, for then his greatness will reach to the ends of the earth.
chapters.zh: 他必起来，倚靠耶和华的大能，并耶和华他神之名的威严，牧养他的羊群。他们要安然居住。因为他必日见尊大，直到地极。

chapters.en: And he will be our peace when the Assyrians invade our land and march through our fortresses. We will raise against them seven shepherds, even eight commanders,
chapters.zh: 这位必作我们的平安。当亚述人进入我们的地境，践踏宫殿的时候，我们就立起七个牧者，八个首领攻击他。

chapters.en: who will rule the land of Assyria with the sword, the land of Nimrod with drawn sword.He will deliver us from the Assyrians when they invade our land and march across our borders.
chapters.zh: 他们必用刀剑毁坏亚述地，和宁录地的关口。亚述人进入我们的地境，践踏的时候，他必拯救我们。

chapters.en: The remnant of Jacob will be in the midst of many peoples like dew from the LORD, like showers on the grass, which do not wait for anyone or depend on man.
chapters.zh: 雅各余剩的人必在多国的民中，如从耶和华那里降下的露水，又如甘霖降在草上。不仗赖人力，也不等候世人之功。

chapters.en: The remnant of Jacob will be among the nations, in the midst of many peoples, like a lion among the beasts of the forest, like a young lion among flocks of sheep, which mauls and mangles as it goes, and no one can rescue.
chapters.zh: 雅各余剩的人必在多国多民中，如林间百兽中的狮子，又如少壮狮子在羊群中。他若经过，就必践踏撕裂，无人搭救。

chapters.en: Your hand will be lifted up in triumph over your enemies, and all your foes will be destroyed.
chapters.zh: 愿你的手举起，高过敌人，愿你的仇敌都被剪除。

chapters.en: “In that day,” declares the LORD, “I will destroy your horses from among you and demolish your chariots.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说，到那日，我必从你中间剪除马匹，毁坏车辆。

chapters.en: I will destroy the cities of your land and tear down all your strongholds.
chapters.zh: 也必从你国中除灭城邑，拆毁一切的保障。

chapters.en: I will destroy your witchcraft and you will no longer cast spells.
chapters.zh: 又必除掉你手中的邪术。你那里也不再有占卜的。

chapters.en: I will destroy your idols and your sacred stones from among you; you will no longer bow down to the work of your hands.
chapters.zh: 我必从你中间除灭雕刻的偶像，和柱像。你就不再跪拜自己手所造的。
