chapters.en: I will uproot from among you your Asherah poles when I demolish your cities.
chapters.zh: 我必从你中间拔出木偶。又毁灭你的城邑。

chapters.en: I will take vengeance in anger and wrath on the nations that have not obeyed me.”
chapters.zh: 我也必在怒气，和忿怒中向那不听从的列国施报。

chapters.en: Listen to what the LORD says: “Stand up, plead my case before the mountains; let the hills hear what you have to say.
chapters.zh: 以色列人哪，当听耶和华的话。要起来向山岭争辩，使冈陵听你的话。

chapters.en: “Hear, you mountains, the LORD’s accusation; listen, you everlasting foundations of the earth. For the LORD has a case against his people; he is lodging a charge against Israel.
chapters.zh: 山岭和地永久的根基阿，要听耶和华争辩的话。因为耶和华要与他的百姓争辩，与以色列争论。

chapters.en: “My people, what have I done to you? How have I burdened you? Answer me.
chapters.zh: 我的百姓阿，我向你做了什么呢？我在什么事上使你厌烦？你可以对我证明。

chapters.en: I brought you up out of Egypt and redeemed you from the land of slavery. I sent Moses to lead you, also Aaron and Miriam.
chapters.zh: 我曾将你从埃及地领出来，从作奴仆之家救赎你。我也差遣摩西，亚伦，和米利暗在你前面行。

chapters.en: My people, remember what Balak king of Moab plotted and what Balaam son of Beor answered. Remember your journey from Shittim to Gilgal, that you may know the righteous acts of the LORD.”
chapters.zh: 我的百姓阿，你们当追念摩押王巴勒所设的谋，和比珥的儿子巴兰回答他的话，并你们从什亭到吉甲所遇见的事，好使你们知道耶和华公义的作为。

chapters.en: With what shall I come before the LORD and bow down before the exalted God? Shall I come before him with burnt offerings, with calves a year old?
chapters.zh: 我朝见耶和华，在至高神面前跪拜，当献上什么呢？岂可献一岁的牛犊为燔祭吗？

chapters.en: Will the LORD be pleased with thousands of rams, with ten thousand rivers of olive oil? Shall I offer my firstborn for my transgression, the fruit of my body for the sin of my soul?
chapters.zh: 耶和华岂喜悦千千的公羊，或是万万的油河吗？我岂可为自己的罪过，献我的长子吗？为心中的罪恶，献我身所生的吗？

chapters.en: He has shown you, O mortal, what is good. And what does the LORD require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
chapters.zh: 世人哪，耶和华已指示你何为善。他向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

chapters.en: Listen! The LORD is calling to the city— and to fear your name is wisdom— “Heed the rod and the One who appointed it.
chapters.zh: 耶和华向这城呼叫，智慧人必敬畏他的名。你们当听是谁派定刑杖的惩罚。

chapters.en: Am I still to forget your ill-gotten treasures, you wicked house, and the short ephah, which is accursed?
chapters.zh: 恶人家中不仍有非义之财，和可恶的小升斗吗？

chapters.en: Shall I acquit someone with dishonest scales, with a bag of false weights?
chapters.zh: 我若用不公道的天平，和囊中诡诈的法码，岂可算为清洁呢？

chapters.en: Your rich people are violent; your inhabitants are liars and their tongues speak deceitfully.
chapters.zh: 城里的富户满行强暴，其中的居民也说谎言，口中的舌头是诡诈的。

chapters.en: Therefore, I have begun to destroy you, to ruin you because of your sins.
chapters.zh: 因此，我击打你，使你的伤痕甚重。使你因你的罪恶荒凉。

chapters.en: You will eat but not be satisfied; your stomach will still be empty.You will store up but save nothing, because what you save I will give to the sword.
chapters.zh: 你要吃，却吃不饱。你的虚弱，必显在你中间。你必挪去，却不得救护。所救护的，我必交给刀剑。

chapters.en: You will plant but not harvest; you will press olives but not use the oil, you will crush grapes but not drink the wine.
chapters.zh: 你必撒种，却不得收割。踹橄榄，却不得油抹身。踹葡萄，却不得酒喝。

chapters.en: You have observed the statutes of Omri and all the practices of Ahab’s house; you have followed their traditions. Therefore I will give you over to ruin and your people to derision; you will bear the scorn of the nations. ”
chapters.zh: 因为你守暗利的恶规，行亚哈家一切所行的，顺从他们的计谋。因此，我必使你荒凉，使你的居民令人嗤笑。你们也必担当我民的羞辱。

chapters.en: What misery is mine! I am like one who gathers summer fruit at the gleaning of the vineyard; there is no cluster of grapes to eat, none of the early figs that I crave.
chapters.zh: 哀哉，我（或指以色列）好像夏天的果子已被收尽，又像摘了葡萄所剩下的。没有一挂可吃的，我心羡慕初熟的无花果。

chapters.en: The faithful have been swept from the land; not one upright person remains. Everyone lies in wait to shed blood; they hunt each other with nets.
chapters.zh: 地上虔诚人灭尽，世间没有正直人。各人埋伏，要杀人流血。都用网罗猎取弟兄。

chapters.en: Both hands are skilled in doing evil; the ruler demands gifts, the judge accepts bribes, the powerful dictate what they desire— they all conspire together.
chapters.zh: 他们双手作恶。君王徇情面，审判官要贿赂。位分大的吐出恶意。都彼此结联行恶。

chapters.en: The best of them is like a brier, the most upright worse than a thorn hedge. The day God visits you has come, the day your watchmen sound the alarm. Now is the time of your confusion.
chapters.zh: 他们最好的，不过是蒺藜。最正直的，不过是荆棘篱笆。你守望者说降罚的日子已经来到。他们必扰乱不安。

chapters.en: Do not trust a neighbor; put no confidence in a friend. Even with the woman who lies in your embrace guard the words of your lips.
chapters.zh: 不要倚赖邻舍。不要信靠密友。要守住你的口，不要向你怀中的妻提说。

chapters.en: For a son dishonors his father, a daughter rises up against her mother, a daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law— a man’s enemies are the members of his own household.
chapters.zh: 因为，儿子藐视父亲，女儿抗拒母亲，媳妇抗拒婆婆。人的仇敌，就是自己家里的人。

chapters.en: But as for me, I watch in hope for the LORD, I wait for God my Savior; my God will hear me.
chapters.zh: 至于我，我要仰望耶和华，要等候那救我的神。我的神必应允我。

chapters.en: Do not gloat over me, my enemy! Though I have fallen, I will rise. Though I sit in darkness, the LORD will be my light.
chapters.zh: 我的仇敌阿，不要向我夸耀。我虽跌倒，却要起来。我虽坐在黑暗里，耶和华却作我的光。

chapters.en: Because I have sinned against him, I will bear the LORD’s wrath, until he pleads my case and upholds my cause. He will bring me out into the light; I will see his righteousness.
chapters.zh: 我要忍受耶和华的恼怒，因我得罪了他。直等他为我辨屈，为我伸冤。他必领我到光明中，我必得见他的公义。

chapters.en: Then my enemy will see it and will be covered with shame, she who said to me, “Where is the LORD your God?” My eyes will see her downfall; even now she will be trampled underfoot like mire in the streets.
chapters.zh: 那时我的仇敌，就是曾对我说耶和华你神在哪里的，他一看见这事就被羞愧遮盖。我必亲眼见他遭报。他必被践踏，如同街上的泥土。

chapters.en: The day for building your walls will come, the day for extending your boundaries.
chapters.zh: 以色列阿，日子必到，你的墙垣必重修。到那日，你的境界必开展（或作命令必传到远方）。

chapters.en: In that day people will come to you from Assyria and the cities of Egypt, even from Egypt to the Euphrates and from sea to sea and from mountain to mountain.
chapters.zh: 当那日，人必从亚述，从埃及的城邑，从埃及到大河，从这海到那海，从这山到那山，都归到你这里。

chapters.en: The earth will become desolate because of its inhabitants, as the result of their deeds.
chapters.zh: 然而，这地因居民的缘故，又因他们行事的结果，必然荒凉。

chapters.en: Shepherd your people with your staff, the flock of your inheritance, which lives by itself in a forest, in fertile pasturelands.Let them feed in Bashan and Gilead as in days long ago.
chapters.zh: 求耶和华在迦密山的树林中，用你的杖牧放你独居的民，就是你产业的羊群。求你容他们在巴珊和基列得食物，像古时一样。

chapters.en: “As in the days when you came out of Egypt, I will show them my wonders.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华说，我要把奇事显给他们看，好像出埃及地的时候一样。

chapters.en: Nations will see and be ashamed, deprived of all their power. They will put their hands over their mouths and their ears will become deaf.
chapters.zh: 列国看见这事，就必为自己的势力惭愧。他们必用手捂口，掩耳不听。

chapters.en: They will lick dust like a snake, like creatures that crawl on the ground. They will come trembling out of their dens; they will turn in fear to the LORD our God and will be afraid of you.
chapters.zh: 他们必舔土如蛇，又如土中腹行的物，战战兢兢地出他们的营寨。他们必战惧投降耶和华，也必因我们的神而惧怕。

chapters.en: Who is a God like you, who pardons sin and forgives the transgression of the remnant of his inheritance? You do not stay angry forever but delight to show mercy.
chapters.zh: 神阿，有何神象你，赦免罪孽，饶恕你产业之余民的罪过。不永远怀怒，喜爱施恩。

chapters.en: You will again have compassion on us; you will tread our sins underfoot and hurl all our iniquities into the depths of the sea.
chapters.zh: 必再怜悯我们，将我们的罪孽踏在脚下，又将我们的一切罪投于深海。

chapters.en: You will be faithful to Jacob, and show love to Abraham, as you pledged on oath to our ancestors in days long ago.
chapters.zh: 你必按古时起誓应许我们列祖的话，向雅各发诚实，向亚伯拉罕施慈爱。

chapters.en: A prophecy concerning Nineveh. The book of the vision of Nahum the Elkoshite.
chapters.zh: 论尼尼微的默示，就是伊勒歌斯人那鸿所得的默示。

chapters.en: The LORD is a jealous and avenging God; the LORD takes vengeance and is filled with wrath. The LORD takes vengeance on his foes and vents his wrath against his enemies.
chapters.zh: 耶和华是忌邪施报的神。耶和华施报大有忿怒。向他的敌人施报，向他的仇敌怀怒。

chapters.en: The LORD is slow to anger but great in power; the LORD will not leave the guilty unpunished. His way is in the whirlwind and the storm, and clouds are the dust of his feet.
chapters.zh: 耶和华不轻易发怒，大有能力，万不以有罪的为无罪。他乘旋风和暴风而来，云彩为他脚下的尘土。

chapters.en: He rebukes the sea and dries it up; he makes all the rivers run dry. Bashan and Carmel wither and the blossoms of Lebanon fade.
chapters.zh: 他斥责海，使海干了，使一切江河干涸。巴珊和迦密的树林衰残，利巴嫩的花草也衰残了。

chapters.en: The mountains quake before him and the hills melt away. The earth trembles at his presence, the world and all who live in it.
chapters.zh: 大山因他震动，小山也都消化。大地在他面前突起，世界和住在其间的，也都如此。

chapters.en: Who can withstand his indignation? Who can endure his fierce anger? His wrath is poured out like fire; the rocks are shattered before him.
chapters.zh: 他发忿恨，谁能立得住呢？他发烈怒，谁能当得起呢？他的忿怒如火倾倒，磐石因他崩裂。

chapters.en: The LORD is good, a refuge in times of trouble. He cares for those who trust in him,
chapters.zh: 耶和华本为善，在患难的日子为人的保障。并且认得那些投靠他的人。

chapters.en: but with an overwhelming flood he will make an end of Nineveh; he will pursue his foes into the realm of darkness.
chapters.zh: 但他必以涨溢的洪水淹没尼尼微，又驱逐仇敌进入黑暗。

chapters.en: Whatever they plot against the LORD he will bring to an end; trouble will not come a second time.
chapters.zh: 尼尼微人哪，设何谋攻击耶和华呢？他必将你们灭绝净尽。灾难不再兴起。

chapters.en: They will be entangled among thorns and drunk from their wine; they will be consumed like dry stubble.
chapters.zh: 你们像丛杂的荆棘，像喝醉了的人，又如枯干的碎秸全然烧灭。

chapters.en: From you, Nineveh, has one come forth who plots evil against the LORD and devises wicked plans.
chapters.zh: 有一人从你那里出来，图谋邪恶，设恶计攻击耶和华。

chapters.en: This is what the LORD says: “Although they have allies and are numerous, they will be destroyed and pass away. Although I have afflicted you, Judah, I will afflict you no more.
chapters.zh: 耶和华如此说，尼尼微虽然势力充足，人数繁多，也被剪除，归于无有。犹大阿，我虽然使你受苦，却不再使你受苦。

chapters.en: Now I will break their yoke from your neck and tear your shackles away.”
chapters.zh: 现在我必从你颈项上折断他的轭，扭开他的绳索。

chapters.en: The LORD has given a command concerning you, Nineveh: “You will have no descendants to bear your name. I will destroy the images and idols that are in the temple of your gods. I will prepare your grave, for you are vile.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华已经出令，指着尼尼微说，你名下的人必不留后。我必从你神的庙中，除灭雕刻的偶像，和铸造的偶像。我必因你鄙陋，使你归于坟墓。

chapters.en: Look, there on the mountains, the feet of one who brings good news, who proclaims peace! Celebrate your festivals, Judah, and fulfill your vows. No more will the wicked invade you; they will be completely destroyed.
chapters.zh: 看哪，有报好信传平安之人的脚登山，说，犹大阿，可以守你的节期，还你所许的愿吧。因为那恶人不再从你中间经过。他已灭绝净尽了。

chapters.en: An attacker advances against you, Nineveh. Guard the fortress, watch the road, brace yourselves, marshal all your strength!
chapters.zh: 尼尼微阿，那打碎邦国的上来攻击你。你要看守保障，谨防道路，使腰强壮，大大勉力。

chapters.en: The LORD will restore the splendor of Jacob like the splendor of Israel, though destroyers have laid them waste and have ruined their vines.
chapters.zh: 耶和华复兴雅各的荣华，好像以色列的荣华一样。因为使地空虚的，已经使雅各和以色列空虚，将他们的葡萄枝毁坏了。

chapters.en: The shields of the soldiers are red; the warriors are clad in scarlet. The metal on the chariots flashes on the day they are made ready; the spears of juniper are brandished.
chapters.zh: 他勇士的盾牌是红的，精兵都穿朱红衣服。在他预备争战的日子，战车上的钢铁闪烁如火，柏木把的枪也抡起来了。

chapters.en: The chariots storm through the streets, rushing back and forth through the squares. They look like flaming torches; they dart about like lightning.
chapters.zh: 车辆在街上（或作城外）急行，在宽阔处奔来奔去，形状如火把，飞跑如闪电。

chapters.en: Nineveh summons her picked troops, yet they stumble on their way. They dash to the city wall; the protective shield is put in place.
chapters.zh: 尼尼微王招聚他的贵胄。他们步行绊跌。速上城墙，预备挡牌。

chapters.en: The river gates are thrown open and the palace collapses.
chapters.zh: 河闸开放，宫殿冲没。

chapters.en: It is decreed that Nineveh be exiled and carried away. Her female slaves moan like doves and beat on their breasts.
chapters.zh: 王后蒙羞，被人掳去，宫女捶胸，哀鸣如鸽。此乃命定之事。

chapters.en: Nineveh is like a pool whose water is draining away. “Stop! Stop!” they cry, but no one turns back.
chapters.zh: 尼尼微自古以来充满人民。如同聚水的池子，现在居民却都逃跑。虽有人呼喊说，站住，站住，却无人回顾。

chapters.en: Plunder the silver! Plunder the gold! The supply is endless, the wealth from all its treasures!
chapters.zh: 你们抢掠金银吧。因为所积蓄的无穷，华美的宝器无数。

chapters.en: She is pillaged, plundered, stripped! Hearts melt, knees give way, bodies tremble, every face grows pale.
chapters.zh: 尼尼微现在空虚荒凉，人心消化，双膝相碰，腰都疼痛，脸都变色。

chapters.en: Where now is the lions’ den, the place where they fed their young, where the lion and lioness went, and the cubs, with nothing to fear?
chapters.zh: 狮子的洞和少壮狮子喂养之处在哪里呢？公狮母狮小狮游行，无人惊吓之地在哪里呢？

chapters.en: The lion killed enough for his cubs and strangled the prey for his mate, filling his lairs with the kill and his dens with the prey.
chapters.zh: 公狮为小狮撕碎许多食物，为母狮掐死活物，把撕碎的，掐死的充满它的洞穴。

chapters.en: “I am against you,” declares the LORD Almighty. “I will burn up your chariots in smoke, and the sword will devour your young lions. I will leave you no prey on the earth. The voices of your messengers will no longer be heard.”
chapters.zh: 万军之耶和华说，我与你为敌，必将你的车辆焚烧成烟，刀剑也必吞灭你的少壮狮子。我必从地上除灭你所撕碎的，你使者的声音必不再听见。

chapters.en: Woe to the city of blood, full of lies, full of plunder, never without victims!
chapters.zh: 祸哉，这流人血的城，充满谎诈和强暴。抢夺的事，总不止息。

chapters.en: The crack of whips, the clatter of wheels, galloping horses and jolting chariots!
chapters.zh: 鞭声响亮，车轮轰轰，马匹踢跳，车辆奔腾，

chapters.en: Charging cavalry, flashing swords and glittering spears! Many casualties, piles of dead, bodies without number, people stumbling over the corpses—
chapters.zh: 马兵争先，刀剑发光，枪矛闪烁，被杀的甚多，尸首成了大堆，尸骸无数，人碰着而跌倒。

chapters.en: all because of the wanton lust of a prostitute, alluring, the mistress of sorceries, who enslaved nations by her prostitution and peoples by her witchcraft.
chapters.zh: 都因那美貌的妓女多有淫行，惯行邪术，借淫行诱惑列国，用邪术诱惑多族（诱惑原文作卖）。

chapters.en: “I am against you,” declares the LORD Almighty. “I will lift your skirts over your face. I will show the nations your nakedness and the kingdoms your shame.
chapters.zh: 万军之耶和华说，我与你为敌。我必揭起你的衣襟，蒙在你脸上，使列国看见你的赤体，使列邦观看你的丑陋。

chapters.en: I will pelt you with filth, I will treat you with contempt and make you a spectacle.
chapters.zh: 我必将可憎污秽之物抛在你身上，辱没你，为众目所观。

chapters.en: All who see you will flee from you and say, ‘Nineveh is in ruins—who will mourn for her?’ Where can I find anyone to comfort you?”
chapters.zh: 凡看见你的，都必逃跑离开你，说，尼尼微荒凉了。有谁为你悲伤呢？我何处寻得安慰你的人呢？

chapters.en: Are you better than Thebes, situated on the Nile, with water around her? The river was her defense, the waters her wall.
chapters.zh: 你岂比挪亚们强呢？挪亚们坐落在众河之间，周围有水。海作她的濠沟（海指尼罗河），又作她的城墙。

chapters.en: Cush and Egypt were her boundless strength; Put and Libya were among her allies.
chapters.zh: 古实和埃及是她无穷的力量。弗人和路比族是她的帮手。

chapters.en: Yet she was taken captive and went into exile. Her infants were dashed to pieces at every street corner. Lots were cast for her nobles, and all her great men were put in chains.
chapters.zh: 但她被迁移，被掳去。她的婴孩在各市口上也被摔死。人为她的尊贵人拈阄，她所有的大人都被链子锁着。

chapters.en: You too will become drunk; you will go into hiding and seek refuge from the enemy.
chapters.zh: 你也必喝醉，必被埋藏。并因仇敌的缘故寻求避难所。

chapters.en: All your fortresses are like fig trees with their first ripe fruit; when they are shaken, the figs fall into the mouth of the eater.
chapters.zh: 你一切保障，必像无花果树上初熟的无花果。若一摇撼，就落在想吃之人的口中。

chapters.en: Look at your troops— they are all weaklings. The gates of your land are wide open to your enemies; fire has consumed the bars of your gates.
chapters.zh: 你地上的人民，如同妇女。你国中的关口，向仇敌敞开。你的门闩被火焚烧。

chapters.en: Draw water for the siege, strengthen your defenses! Work the clay, tread the mortar, repair the brickwork!
chapters.zh: 你要打水预备受困。要坚固你的保障。踹土和泥，修补砖窑。

chapters.en: There the fire will consume you; the sword will cut you down— they will devour you like a swarm of locusts. Multiply like grasshoppers, multiply like locusts!
chapters.zh: 在那里，火必烧灭你，刀必杀戮你，吞灭你如同蝻子。任你加增人数多如蝻子，多如蝗虫吧。

chapters.en: You have increased the number of your merchants till they are more numerous than the stars in the sky, but like locusts they strip the land and then fly away.
chapters.zh: 你增添商贾，多过天上的星。蝻子吃尽而去。

chapters.en: Your guards are like locusts, your officials like swarms of locusts that settle in the walls on a cold day— but when the sun appears they fly away, and no one knows where.
chapters.zh: 你的首领，多如蝗虫，你的军长，仿佛成群的蚂蚱，天凉的时候，齐落在篱笆上，日头一出便都飞去，人不知道落在何处。

chapters.en: King of Assyria, your shepherds slumber; your nobles lie down to rest. Your people are scattered on the mountains with no one to gather them.
chapters.zh: 亚述王阿，你的牧人睡觉，你的贵胄安歇。你的人民散在山间，无人招聚。

chapters.en: Nothing can heal you; your wound is fatal. All who hear the news about you clap their hands at your fall, for who has not felt your endless cruelty?
chapters.zh: 你的损伤无法医治，你的伤痕极其重大。凡听你信息的，必都因此向你拍掌。你所行的恶，谁没有时常遭遇呢？

chapters.en: The prophecy that Habakkuk the prophet received.
chapters.zh: 先知哈巴谷所得的默示。

chapters.en: How long, LORD, must I call for help, but you do not listen? Or cry out to you, “Violence!” but you do not save?
chapters.zh: 他说，耶和华阿，我呼求你，你不应允，要到几时呢？我因强暴哀求你，你还不拯救。

chapters.en: Why do you make me look at injustice? Why do you tolerate wrongdoing? Destruction and violence are before me; there is strife, and conflict abounds.
chapters.zh: 你为何使我看见罪孽？你为何看着奸恶而不理呢？毁灭和强暴在我面前。又起了争端和相斗的事。

chapters.en: Therefore the law is paralyzed, and justice never prevails. The wicked hem in the righteous, so that justice is perverted.
chapters.zh: 因此律法放松，公理也不显明。恶人围困义人。所以公理显然颠倒。

chapters.en: “Look at the nations and watch— and be utterly amazed. For I am going to do something in your days that you would not believe, even if you were told.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说，你们要向列国中观看，大大惊奇。因为在你们的时候，我行一件事，虽有人告诉你们，你们总是不信。

chapters.en: I am raising up the Babylonians,that ruthless and impetuous people, who sweep across the whole earth to seize dwellings not their own.
chapters.zh: 我必兴起迦勒底人，就是那残忍暴躁之民，通行遍地，占据那不属自己的住处。

chapters.en: They are a feared and dreaded people; they are a law to themselves and promote their own honor.
chapters.zh: 他威武可畏。判断和势力，都任意发出。

chapters.en: Their horses are swifter than leopards, fiercer than wolves at dusk. Their cavalry gallops headlong; their horsemen come from afar. They fly like an eagle swooping to devour;
chapters.zh: 他的马比豹更快，比晚上的豺狼更猛。马兵踊跃争先，都从远方而来，他们飞跑如鹰抓食。

chapters.en: they all come intent on violence. Their hordes advance like a desert wind and gather prisoners like sand.
chapters.zh: 都为行强暴而来。定住脸面向前，将掳掠的人聚集，多如尘沙。

chapters.en: They mock kings and scoff at rulers. They laugh at all fortified cities; by building earthen ramps they capture them.
chapters.zh: 他们讥诮君王，笑话首领，嗤笑一切保障，筑垒攻取。

chapters.en: Then they sweep past like the wind and go on— guilty people, whose own strength is their god.”
chapters.zh: 他以自己的势力为神，像风猛然扫过，显为有罪。

chapters.en: LORD, are you not from everlasting? My God, my Holy One, you will never die. You, LORD, have appointed them to execute judgment; you, my Rock, have ordained them to punish.
chapters.zh: 耶和华我的神，我的圣者阿，你不是从亘古而有吗？我们必不致死。耶和华阿，你派定他为要刑罚人。磐石阿，你设立他为要惩治人。

chapters.en: Your eyes are too pure to look on evil; you cannot tolerate wrongdoing. Why then do you tolerate the treacherous? Why are you silent while the wicked swallow up those more righteous than themselves?
chapters.zh: 你眼目清洁，不看邪僻，不看奸恶。行诡诈的，你为何看着不理呢？恶人吞灭比自己公义的，你为何静默不语呢？

chapters.en: You have made people like the fish in the sea, like the sea creatures that have no ruler.
chapters.zh: 你为何使人如海中的鱼，又如没有管辖的爬物呢？

chapters.en: The wicked foe pulls all of them up with hooks, he catches them in his net, he gathers them up in his dragnet; and so he rejoices and is glad.
chapters.zh: 他用钩钩住，用网捕获，用拉网聚集他们。因此，他欢喜快乐。

chapters.en: Therefore he sacrifices to his net and burns incense to his dragnet, for by his net he lives in luxury and enjoys the choicest food.
chapters.zh: 就向网献祭，向网烧香。因他由此得肥美的分，和富裕的食物。

chapters.en: Is he to keep on emptying his net, destroying nations without mercy?
chapters.zh: 他岂可屡次倒空网罗，将列国的人时常杀戮，毫不顾惜呢？

chapters.en: I will stand at my watch and station myself on the ramparts; I will look to see what he will say to me, and what answer I am to give to this complaint.
chapters.zh: 我要站在守望所，立在望楼上观看，看耶和华对我说什么话，我可用什么话向他诉冤。（向他诉冤或作回答所疑问的）。

chapters.en: Then the LORD replied: “Write down the revelation and make it plain on tablets so that a herald may run with it.
chapters.zh: 他对我说，将这默示明明地写在版上，使读的人容易读（或作随跑随读）。

chapters.en: For the revelation awaits an appointed time; it speaks of the end and will not prove false. Though it linger, wait for it; it will certainly come and will not delay.
chapters.zh: 因为这默示有一定的日期，快要应验，并不虚谎。虽然迟延，还要等候。因为必然临到，不再迟延。

chapters.en: “See, the enemy is puffed up; his desires are not upright— but the righteous person will live by his faithfulness —
chapters.zh: 迦勒底人自高自大，心不正直。惟义人因信得生。

chapters.en: indeed, wine betrays him; he is arrogant and never at rest. Because he is as greedy as the grave and like death is never satisfied, he gathers to himself all the nations and takes captive all the peoples.
chapters.zh: 迦勒底人因酒诡诈，狂傲，不住在家中，扩充心欲，好像阴间。他如死不能知足，聚集万国，堆积万民，都归自己。

chapters.en: “Will not all of them taunt him with ridicule and scorn, saying, “ ‘Woe to him who piles up stolen goods and makes himself wealthy by extortion! How long must this go on?’
chapters.zh: 这些国的民，岂不都要提起诗歌，并俗语讥刺他，说，祸哉，迦勒底人，你增添不属自己的财物，多多取人的当头，要到几时为止呢？

chapters.en: Will not your creditors suddenly arise? Will they not wake up and make you tremble? Then you will become their prey.
chapters.zh: 咬伤你的岂不忽然起来，扰害你的岂不兴起，你就作他们的掳物吗？

chapters.en: Because you have plundered many nations, the peoples who are left will plunder you. For you have shed human blood; you have destroyed lands and cities and everyone in them.
chapters.zh: 因你抢夺许多的国，杀人流血，向国内的城，并城中一切居民施行强暴，所以各国剩下的民，都必抢夺你。

chapters.en: “Woe to him who builds his house by unjust gain, setting his nest on high to escape the clutches of ruin!
chapters.zh: 为本家积蓄不义之财，在高处搭窝，指望免灾的有祸了。

chapters.en: You have plotted the ruin of many peoples, shaming your own house and forfeiting your life.
chapters.zh: 你图谋剪除多国的民，犯了罪，使你的家蒙羞，自害己命。

chapters.en: The stones of the wall will cry out, and the beams of the woodwork will echo it.
chapters.zh: 墙里的石头必呼叫，房内的栋梁必应声。

chapters.en: “Woe to him who builds a city with bloodshed and establishes a town by injustice!
chapters.zh: 以人血建城，以罪孽立邑的有祸了。

chapters.en: Has not the LORD Almighty determined that the people’s labor is only fuel for the fire, that the nations exhaust themselves for nothing?
chapters.zh: 众民所劳碌得来的被火焚烧，列国由劳乏而得的，归于虚空，不都是出于万军之耶和华吗？

chapters.en: For the earth will be filled with the knowledge of the glory of the LORD as the waters cover the sea.
chapters.zh: 认识耶和华荣耀的知识，要充满遍地，好像水充满洋海一般。

chapters.en: “Woe to him who gives drink to his neighbors, pouring it from the wineskin till they are drunk, so that he can gaze on their naked bodies!
chapters.zh: 给人酒喝，又加上毒物，使他喝醉，好看见他下体的，有祸了。

chapters.en: You will be filled with shame instead of glory. Now it is your turn! Drink and let your nakedness be exposed ! The cup from the LORD’s right hand is coming around to you, and disgrace will cover your glory.
chapters.zh: 你满受羞辱，不得荣耀。你也喝吧，显出是未受割礼的。耶和华右手的杯，必传到你那里，你的荣耀，就变为大大地羞辱。

chapters.en: The violence you have done to Lebanon will overwhelm you, and your destruction of animals will terrify you. For you have shed human blood; you have destroyed lands and cities and everyone in them.
chapters.zh: 你向利巴嫩行强暴，与残害惊吓野兽的事，必遮盖你。因你杀人流血，向国内的城，并城中一切居民，施行强暴。

chapters.en: “Of what value is an idol carved by a craftsman? Or an image that teaches lies? For the one who makes it trusts in his own creation; he makes idols that cannot speak.
chapters.zh: 雕刻的偶像，人将它刻出来，有什么益处呢？铸造的偶像，就是虚谎的师傅。制造者倚靠这哑巴偶像，有什么益处呢？

chapters.en: Woe to him who says to wood, ‘Come to life!’ Or to lifeless stone, ‘Wake up!’ Can it give guidance? It is covered with gold and silver; there is no breath in it.”
chapters.zh: 对木偶说，醒起，对哑巴石像说，起来，那人有祸了。这个还能教训人吗？看哪，是包裹金银的，其中毫无气息。

chapters.en: The LORD is in his holy temple; let all the earth be silent before him.
chapters.zh: 惟耶和华在他的圣殿中。全地的人，都当在他面前肃敬静默。

chapters.en: A prayer of Habakkuk the prophet. On shigionoth.
chapters.zh: 先知哈巴谷的祷告，调用流离歌。

chapters.en: LORD, I have heard of your fame; I stand in awe of your deeds, LORD. Repeat them in our day, in our time make them known; in wrath remember mercy.
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，我听见你的名声（名声或作言语），就惧怕。耶和华阿，求你在这些年间复兴你的作为，在这些年间显明出来，在发怒的时候，以怜悯为念。

chapters.en: God came from Teman, the Holy One from Mount Paran.His glory covered the heavens and his praise filled the earth.
chapters.zh: 神从提幔而来，圣者从巴兰山临到。（细拉）他的荣光遮蔽诸天，颂赞充满大地。

chapters.en: His splendor was like the sunrise; rays flashed from his hand, where his power was hidden.
chapters.zh: 他的辉煌如同日光。从他手里射出光线。在其中藏着他的能力。

chapters.en: Plague went before him; pestilence followed his steps.
chapters.zh: 在他前面有瘟疫流行，在他脚下有热症发出。

chapters.en: He stood, and shook the earth; he looked, and made the nations tremble. The ancient mountains crumbled and the age-old hills collapsed— but he marches on forever.
chapters.zh: 他站立，量了大地（或作使地震动），观看，赶散万民。永久的山崩裂，长存的岭塌陷。他的作为与古时一样。

chapters.en: I saw the tents of Cushan in distress, the dwellings of Midian in anguish.
chapters.zh: 我见古珊的帐棚遭难，米甸的幔子战兢。

chapters.en: Were you angry with the rivers, LORD? Was your wrath against the streams? Did you rage against the sea when you rode your horses and your chariots to victory?
chapters.zh: 耶和华阿，你乘在马上，坐在得胜的车上，岂是不喜悦江河，向江河发怒气，向洋海发愤恨吗？

chapters.en: You uncovered your bow, you called for many arrows. You split the earth with rivers;
chapters.zh: 你的弓全然显露。向众支派所起的誓，都是可信的。（细拉）你以江河分开大地。

chapters.en: the mountains saw you and writhed. Torrents of water swept by; the deep roared and lifted its waves on high.
chapters.zh: 山岭见你，无不战惧。大水泛滥过去，深渊发声，汹涌翻腾。（原文作向上举手）。

chapters.en: Sun and moon stood still in the heavens at the glint of your flying arrows, at the lightning of your flashing spear.
chapters.zh: 因你的箭射出发光，你的枪闪出光耀，日月都在本宫停住。

chapters.en: In wrath you strode through the earth and in anger you threshed the nations.
chapters.zh: 你发愤恨通行大地。发怒气责打列国，如同打粮。

chapters.en: You came out to deliver your people, to save your anointed one. You crushed the leader of the land of wickedness, you stripped him from head to foot.
chapters.zh: 你出来要拯救你的百姓，拯救你的受膏者，打破恶人家长的头。露出他的脚，（脚原文作根基），直到颈项。（细拉）

chapters.en: With his own spear you pierced his head when his warriors stormed out to scatter us, gloating as though about to devour the wretched who were in hiding.
chapters.zh: 你用敌人的戈矛刺透他战士的头。他们来如旋风，要将我们分散。他们所喜爱的，是暗中吞吃贫民。

chapters.en: You trampled the sea with your horses, churning the great waters.
chapters.zh: 你乘马践踏红海，就是践踏汹涌的大水。

chapters.en: I heard and my heart pounded, my lips quivered at the sound; decay crept into my bones, and my legs trembled. Yet I will wait patiently for the day of calamity to come on the nation invading us.
chapters.zh: 我听见耶和华的声音，身体战兢，嘴唇发颤，骨中朽烂。我在所立之处战兢。我只可安静等候灾难之日临到，犯境之民上来。

chapters.en: Though the fig tree does not bud and there are no grapes on the vines, though the olive crop fails and the fields produce no food, though there are no sheep in the pen and no cattle in the stalls,
chapters.zh: 虽然无花果树不发旺，葡萄树不结果，橄榄树也不效力，田地不出粮食，圈中绝了羊，棚内也没有牛。

chapters.en: yet I will rejoice in the LORD, I will be joyful in God my Savior.
chapters.zh: 然而我要因耶和华欢欣，因救我的神喜乐。

chapters.en: The Sovereign LORD is my strength; he makes my feet like the feet of a deer, he enables me to tread on the heights.
chapters.zh: 主耶和华是我的力量。他使我的脚快如母鹿的蹄。又使我稳行在高处。这歌交与伶长，用丝弦的乐器。

chapters.en: The word of the LORD that came to Zephaniah son of Cushi, the son of Gedaliah, the son of Amariah, the son of Hezekiah, during the reign of Josiah son of Amon king of Judah:
chapters.zh: 当犹大王亚们的儿子约西亚在位的时候，耶和华的话临到希西家的元孙，亚玛利雅的曾孙，基大利的孙子，古示的儿子西番雅。

chapters.en: “I will sweep away everything from the face of the earth,” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说，我必从地上除灭万类。

chapters.en: “I will sweep away both man and beast; I will sweep away the birds in the sky and the fish in the sea— and the idols that cause the wicked to stumble.”“When I destroy all mankind on the face of the earth,” declares the LORD,
chapters.zh: 我必除灭人和牲畜，与空中的鸟，海里的鱼，以及绊脚石和恶人。我必将人从地上剪除。这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: “I will stretch out my hand against Judah and against all who live in Jerusalem. I will destroy every remnant of Baal worship in this place, the very names of the idolatrous priests—
chapters.zh: 我必伸手攻击犹大和耶路撒冷的一切居民。也必从这地方剪除所剩下的巴力，并基玛林的名和祭司，

chapters.en: those who bow down on the roofs to worship the starry host, those who bow down and swear by the LORD and who also swear by Molek,
chapters.zh: 与那些在房顶上敬拜天上万象的，并那些敬拜耶和华指着他起誓，又指着玛勒堪起誓的，

chapters.en: those who turn back from following the LORD and neither seek the LORD nor inquire of him.”
chapters.zh: 与那些转去不跟从耶和华的，和不寻求耶和华，也不访问他的。

chapters.en: Be silent before the Sovereign LORD, for the day of the LORD is near. The LORD has prepared a sacrifice; he has consecrated those he has invited.
chapters.zh: 你要在主耶和华面前静默无声，因为耶和华的日子快到。耶和华已经预备祭物，将他的客分别为圣。

chapters.en: “On the day of the LORD’s sacrifice I will punish the officials and the king’s sons and all those clad in foreign clothes.
chapters.zh: 到了我耶和华献祭的日子，必惩罚首领和王子，并一切穿外邦衣服的。

chapters.en: On that day I will punish all who avoid stepping on the threshold,who fill the temple of their gods with violence and deceit.
chapters.zh: 到那日，我必惩罚一切跳过门槛，将强暴和诡诈得来之物充满主人房屋的。

chapters.en: “On that day,” declares the LORD, “a cry will go up from the Fish Gate, wailing from the New Quarter, and a loud crash from the hills.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说，当那日，从鱼门必发出悲哀的声音，从二城发出哀号的声音，从山间发出大破裂的响声。

chapters.en: Wail, you who live in the market district ; all your merchants will be wiped out, all who trade with silver will be destroyed.
chapters.zh: 玛革提施的居民哪，你们要哀号，因为迦南的商民都灭亡了。凡搬运银子的都被剪除。

chapters.en: At that time I will search Jerusalem with lamps and punish those who are complacent, who are like wine left on its dregs, who think, ‘The LORD will do nothing, either good or bad.’
chapters.zh: 那时，我必用灯巡查耶路撒冷。我必惩罚那些如酒在渣滓上澄清的。他们心里说，耶和华必不降福，也不降祸。

chapters.en: Their wealth will be plundered, their houses demolished. Though they build houses, they will not live in them; though they plant vineyards, they will not drink the wine.”
chapters.zh: 他们的财宝，必成为掠物，他们的房屋，必变为荒场。他们必建造房屋，却不得住在其内，栽种葡萄园，却不得喝所出的酒。

chapters.en: The great day of the LORD is near— near and coming quickly. The cry on the day of the LORD is bitter; the Mighty Warrior shouts his battle cry.
chapters.zh: 耶和华的大日临近，临近而且甚快，乃是耶和华日子的风声。勇士必痛痛的哭号。

chapters.en: That day will be a day of wrath— a day of distress and anguish, a day of trouble and ruin, a day of darkness and gloom, a day of clouds and blackness—
chapters.zh: 那日是忿怒的日子，是急难困苦的日子，是荒废凄凉的日子，是黑暗，幽冥，密云，乌黑的日子。

chapters.en: a day of trumpet and battle cry against the fortified cities and against the corner towers.
chapters.zh: 是吹角呐喊的日子，要攻击坚固城，和高大的城楼。

chapters.en: “I will bring such distress on all people that they will grope about like those who are blind, because they have sinned against the LORD. Their blood will be poured out like dust and their entrails like dung.
chapters.zh: 我必使灾祸临到人身上，使他们行走如同瞎眼的，因为得罪了我。他们的血，必倒出如灰尘，他们的肉，必抛弃如粪土。

chapters.en: Neither their silver nor their gold will be able to save them on the day of the LORD’s wrath.” In the fire of his jealousy the whole earth will be consumed, for he will make a sudden end of all who live on the earth.
chapters.zh: 当耶和华发怒的日子，他们的金银不能救他们。他的忿怒如火，必烧灭全地，毁灭这地的一切居民，而且大大毁灭。

chapters.en: Gather together, gather yourselves together, you shameful nation,
chapters.zh: 不知羞耻的国民哪，你们应当聚集。趁命令没有发出，日子过去如风前的糠，耶和华的烈怒未临到你们，他发怒的日子未到以先，你们应当聚集前来。

chapters.en: before the decree takes effect and that day passes like windblown chaff, before the LORD’s fierce anger comes upon you, before the day of the LORD’s wrath comes upon you.
Seek the LORD, all you humble of the land, you who do what he commands. Seek righteousness, seek humility; perhaps you will be sheltered on the day of the LORD’s anger.
chapters.zh: 世上遵守耶和华典章的谦卑人哪，你们都当寻求耶和华。当寻求公义谦卑，或者在耶和华发怒的日子，可以隐藏起来。

chapters.en: Gaza will be abandoned and Ashkelon left in ruins. At midday Ashdod will be emptied and Ekron uprooted.
chapters.zh: 迦萨必致见弃。亚实基伦必然荒凉。人在正午必赶出亚实突的民。以革伦也被拔出根来。

chapters.en: Woe to you who live by the sea, you Kerethite people; the word of the LORD is against you, Canaan, land of the Philistines. He says, “I will destroy you, and none will be left.”
chapters.zh: 住沿海之地的基利提族有祸了。迦南，非利士人之地阿，耶和华的话与你反对，说，我必毁灭你，以致无人居住。

chapters.en: The land by the sea will become pastures having wells for shepherds and pens for flocks.
chapters.zh: 沿海之地要变为草场，其上有牧人的住处，和羊群的圈。

chapters.en: That land will belong to the remnant of the people of Judah; there they will find pasture. In the evening they will lie down in the houses of Ashkelon. The LORD their God will care for them; he will restore their fortunes.
chapters.zh: 这地必为犹大家剩下的人所得。他们必在那里牧放群羊。晚上必躺卧在亚实基伦的房屋中。因为耶和华他们的神，必眷顾他们，使他们被掳的人归回。

chapters.en: “I have heard the insults of Moab and the taunts of the Ammonites, who insulted my people and made threats against their land.
chapters.zh: 我听见摩押人的毁谤，和亚扪人的辱骂，就是毁谤我的百姓，自夸自大。侵犯他们的境界。

chapters.en: Therefore, as surely as I live,” declares the LORD Almighty, the God of Israel, “surely Moab will become like Sodom, the Ammonites like Gomorrah— a place of weeds and salt pits, a wasteland forever. The remnant of my people will plunder them; the survivors of my nation will inherit their land.”
chapters.zh: 万军之耶和华以色列的神说，我指着我的永生起誓，摩押必像所多玛，亚扪人必像蛾摩拉，都变为刺草，盐坑，永远荒废之地。我百姓所剩下的，必掳掠他们，我国中所余剩的，必得着他们的地。

chapters.en: This is what they will get in return for their pride, for insulting and mocking the people of the LORD Almighty.
chapters.zh: 这事临到他们，是因他们骄傲，自夸自大，毁谤万军之耶和华的百姓。

chapters.en: The LORD will be awesome to them when he destroys all the gods of the earth. Distant nations will bow down to him, all of them in their own lands.
chapters.zh: 耶和华必向他们显可畏之威。因他必叫世上的诸神瘦弱，列国海岛的居民各在自己的地方敬拜他。

chapters.en: “You Cushites, too, will be slain by my sword.”
chapters.zh: 古实人哪，你们必被我的刀所杀。

chapters.en: He will stretch out his hand against the north and destroy Assyria, leaving Nineveh utterly desolate and dry as the desert.
chapters.zh: 耶和华必伸手攻击北方，毁灭亚述，使尼尼微荒凉，又干旱如旷野。

chapters.en: Flocks and herds will lie down there, creatures of every kind. The desert owl and the screech owl will roost on her columns. Their hooting will echo through the windows, rubble will fill the doorways, the beams of cedar will be exposed.
chapters.zh: 群畜，就是各国的走兽（国或作类），必卧在其中。鹈鹕和箭猪要宿在柱顶上在窗户内有鸣叫的声音。门槛都必毁坏。香柏木已经露出。

chapters.en: This is the city of revelry that lived in safety. She said to herself, “I am the one! And there is none besides me.” What a ruin she has become, a lair for wild beasts! All who pass by her scoff and shake their fists.
chapters.zh: 这是素来欢乐安然居住的城，心里说，惟有我，除我以外再没有别的。现在何竟荒凉，成为野兽躺卧之处。凡经过的人都必摇手嗤笑她。

chapters.en: Woe to the city of oppressors, rebellious and defiled!
chapters.zh: 这悖逆，污秽，欺压的城，有祸了。

chapters.en: She obeys no one, she accepts no correction. She does not trust in the LORD, she does not draw near to her God.
chapters.zh: 她不听从命令，不领受训诲，不倚靠耶和华，不亲近她的神。

chapters.en: Her officials within her are roaring lions; her rulers are evening wolves, who leave nothing for the morning.
chapters.zh: 她中间的首领是咆哮的狮子。她的审判官是晚上的豺狼，一点食物也不留到早晨。

chapters.en: Her prophets are unprincipled; they are treacherous people. Her priests profane the sanctuary and do violence to the law.
chapters.zh: 她的先知是虚浮诡诈的人。她的祭司亵渎圣所，强解律法。

chapters.en: The LORD within her is righteous; he does no wrong. Morning by morning he dispenses his justice, and every new day he does not fail, yet the unrighteous know no shame.
chapters.zh: 耶和华在她中间是公义的，断不做非义的事，每早晨显明他的公义，无日不然。只是不义的人不知羞耻。

chapters.en: “I have destroyed nations; their strongholds are demolished. I have left their streets deserted, with no one passing through. Their cities are laid waste; they are deserted and empty.
chapters.zh: 我耶和华已经除灭列国的民。他们的城楼毁坏。我使他们的街道荒凉，以致无人经过。他们的城邑毁灭，以致无人，也无居民。

chapters.en: Of Jerusalem I thought, ‘Surely you will fear me and accept correction!’ Then her place of refuge would not be destroyed, nor all my punishments come upon her. But they were still eager to act corruptly in all they did.
chapters.zh: 我说，你只要敬畏我，领受训诲。如此，你的住处，不致照我所拟定的除灭。只是你们从早起来，就在一切事上败坏自己。

chapters.en: Therefore wait for me,” declares the LORD, “for the day I will stand up to testify.I have decided to assemble the nations, to gather the kingdoms and to pour out my wrath on them— all my fierce anger. The whole world will be consumed by the fire of my jealous anger.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说，你们要等候我，直到我兴起掳掠的日子，因为我已定意招聚列国，聚集列邦，将我的恼怒，就是我的烈怒，都倾在她们身上。我的忿怒如火，必烧灭全地。

chapters.en: “Then I will purify the lips of the peoples, that all of them may call on the name of the LORD and serve him shoulder to shoulder.
chapters.zh: 那时，我必使万民用清洁的言语，好求告我耶和华的名，同心合意地事奉我。

chapters.en: From beyond the rivers of Cush my worshipers, my scattered people, will bring me offerings.
chapters.zh: 祈祷我的，就是我所分散的民（原文作女子下同），必从古实河外来，给我献供物。

chapters.en: On that day you, Jerusalem, will not be put to shame for all the wrongs you have done to me, because I will remove from you your arrogant boasters. Never again will you be haughty on my holy hill.
chapters.zh: 当那日，你必不因你一切得罪我的事，自觉羞愧。因为那时我必从你中间除掉矜夸高傲之辈，你也不再于我的圣山狂傲。

chapters.en: But I will leave within you the meek and humble. The remnant of Israel will trust in the name of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 我却要在你中间，留下困苦贫寒的民。他们必投靠我耶和华的名。

chapters.en: They will do no wrong; they will tell no lies. A deceitful tongue will not be found in their mouths. They will eat and lie down and no one will make them afraid.”
chapters.zh: 以色列所剩下的人，必不作罪孽，不说谎言，口中也没有诡诈的舌头。而且吃喝躺卧，无人惊吓。

chapters.en: Sing, Daughter Zion; shout aloud, Israel! Be glad and rejoice with all your heart, Daughter Jerusalem!
chapters.zh: 锡安的民哪，应当歌唱。以色列阿，应当欢呼。耶路撒冷的民哪，应当满心欢喜快乐。

chapters.en: The LORD has taken away your punishment, he has turned back your enemy. The LORD, the King of Israel, is with you; never again will you fear any harm.
chapters.zh: 耶和华已经除去你的刑罚，赶出你的仇敌。以色列的王耶和华在你中间，你必不再惧怕灾祸。

chapters.en: On that day they will say to Jerusalem, “Do not fear, Zion; do not let your hands hang limp.
chapters.zh: 当那日，必有话向耶路撒冷说，不要惧怕。锡安哪，不要手软。

chapters.en: The LORD your God is with you, the Mighty Warrior who saves. He will take great delight in you; in his love he will no longer rebuke you, but will rejoice over you with singing.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华你的神，是施行拯救，大有能力的主，他在你中间必因你欢欣喜乐，默然爱你，且因你喜乐而欢呼。

chapters.en: “I will remove from you all who mourn over the loss of your appointed festivals, which is a burden and reproach for you.
chapters.zh: 那些属你，为无大会愁烦，因你担当羞辱的，我必聚集他们。

chapters.en: At that time I will deal with all who oppressed you. I will rescue the lame; I will gather the exiles. I will give them praise and honor in every land where they have suffered shame.
chapters.zh: 那时，我必罚办一切苦待你的人，又拯救你瘸腿的。聚集你被赶出的。那些在全地受羞辱的，我必使他们得称赞，有名声。

chapters.en: At that time I will gather you; at that time I will bring you home. I will give you honor and praise among all the peoples of the earth when I restore your fortunes before your very eyes,” says the LORD..
chapters.zh: 那时，我必领你们进来，聚集你们。我使你们被掳之人归回的时候，就必使你们在地上的万民中有名声，得称赞。这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: In the second year of King Darius, on the first day of the sixth month, the word of the LORD came through the prophet Haggai to Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and to Joshua son of Jozadak, the high priest:
chapters.zh: 大利乌王第二年六月初一日，耶和华的话借先知哈该，向犹大省长撒拉铁的儿子所罗巴伯和约撒答的儿子大祭司约书亚说，

chapters.en: This is what the LORD Almighty says: “These people say, ‘The time has not yet come to rebuild the LORD’s house.’ ”
chapters.zh: 万军之耶和华如此说，这百姓说，建造耶和华殿的时候尚未来到。

chapters.en: Then the word of the LORD came through the prophet Haggai:
chapters.zh: 那时耶和华的话临到先知哈该说，

chapters.en: “Is it a time for you yourselves to be living in your paneled houses, while this house remains a ruin?”
chapters.zh: 这殿仍然荒凉，你们自己还住天花板的房屋吗？

chapters.en: Now this is what the LORD Almighty says: “Give careful thought to your ways.
chapters.zh: 现在万军之耶和华如此说，你们要省察自己的行为。

chapters.en: You have planted much, but harvested little. You eat, but never have enough. You drink, but never have your fill. You put on clothes, but are not warm. You earn wages, only to put them in a purse with holes in it.”
chapters.zh: 你们撒的种多，收的却少。你们吃，却不得饱。喝，却不得足。穿衣服，却不得暖。得工钱的，将工钱装在破漏的囊中。

chapters.en: This is what the LORD Almighty says: “Give careful thought to your ways.
chapters.zh: 万军之耶和华如此说，你们要省察自己的行为。

chapters.en: Go up into the mountains and bring down timber and build my house, so that I may take pleasure in it and be honored,” says the LORD.
chapters.zh: 你们要上山取木料，建造这殿。我就因此喜乐，且得荣耀。这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: “You expected much, but see, it turned out to be little. What you brought home, I blew away. Why?” declares the LORD Almighty. “Because of my house, which remains a ruin, while each of you is busy with your own house.
chapters.zh: 你们盼望多得，所得的却少。你们收到家中，我就吹去。这是为什么呢？因为我的殿荒凉，你们各人却顾自己的房屋（顾原文作奔）。这是万军之耶和华说的。

chapters.en: Therefore, because of you the heavens have withheld their dew and the earth its crops.
chapters.zh: 所以为你们的缘故，天就不降甘露，地也不出土产。

chapters.en: I called for a drought on the fields and the mountains, on the grain, the new wine, the olive oil and everything else the ground produces, on people and livestock, and on all the labor of your hands.”
chapters.zh: 我命干旱临到地土，山冈，五谷，新酒，和油，并地上的出产，人民，牲畜，以及人手一切劳碌得来的。

chapters.en: Then Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel, Joshua son of Jozadak, the high priest, and the whole remnant of the people obeyed the voice of the LORD their God and the message of the prophet Haggai, because the LORD their God had sent him. And the people feared the LORD.
chapters.zh: 那时，撒拉铁的儿子所罗巴伯，和约撒答的儿子大祭司约书亚，并剩下的百姓，都听从耶和华他们神的话，和先知哈该奉耶和华他们神差来所说的话。百姓也在耶和华面前存敬畏的心。

chapters.en: Then Haggai, the LORD’s messenger, gave this message of the LORD to the people: “I am with you,” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 耶和华的使者哈该，奉耶和华差遣对百姓说，耶和华说，我与你们同在。

chapters.en: So the LORD stirred up the spirit of Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and the spirit of Joshua son of Jozadak, the high priest, and the spirit of the whole remnant of the people. They came and began to work on the house of the LORD Almighty, their God,
chapters.zh: 耶和华激动犹大省长撒拉铁的儿子所罗巴伯，和约撒答的儿子大祭司约书亚，并剩下之百姓的心。他们就来为万军之耶和华他们神的殿做工。

chapters.en: on the twenty-fourth day of the sixth month. In the second year of King Darius,
chapters.zh: 这是在大利乌王第二年六月二十四日。

chapters.en: on the twenty-first day of the seventh month, the word of the LORD came through the prophet Haggai:
chapters.zh: 七月二十一日，耶和华的话临到先知哈该说，

chapters.en: “Speak to Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, to Joshua son of Jozadak, the high priest, and to the remnant of the people. Ask them,
chapters.zh: 你要晓谕犹大省长撒拉铁的儿子所罗巴伯，和约撒答的儿子大祭司约书亚。并剩下的百姓，说，

chapters.en: ‘Who of you is left who saw this house in its former glory? How does it look to you now? Does it not seem to you like nothing?
chapters.zh: 你们中间存留的，有谁见过这殿从前的荣耀呢？现在你们看着如何？岂不在眼中看如无有吗？

chapters.en: But now be strong, Zerubbabel,’ declares the LORD. ‘Be strong, Joshua son of Jozadak, the high priest. Be strong, all you people of the land,’ declares the LORD, ‘and work. For I am with you,’ declares the LORD Almighty.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说，所罗巴伯阿，虽然如此，你当刚强。约撒答的儿子大祭司约书亚阿，你也当刚强。这地的百姓，你们都当刚强做工，因为我与你们同在。这是万军之耶和华说的。

chapters.en: ‘This is what I covenanted with you when you came out of Egypt. And my Spirit remains among you. Do not fear.’
chapters.zh: 这是照着你们出埃及我与你们立约的话。那时，我的灵住在你们中间。你们不要惧怕。

chapters.en: “This is what the LORD Almighty says: ‘In a little while I will once more shake the heavens and the earth, the sea and the dry land.
chapters.zh: 万军之耶和华如此说，过不多时，我必再一次震动天地，沧海，与旱地。

chapters.en: I will shake all nations, and what is desired by all nations will come, and I will fill this house with glory,’ says the LORD Almighty.
chapters.zh: 我必震动万国。万国的珍宝必都运来（或作万国所羡慕的必来到），我就使这殿满了荣耀。这是万军之耶和华说的。

chapters.en: ‘The silver is mine and the gold is mine,’ declares the LORD Almighty.
chapters.zh: 万军之耶和华说，银子是我的，金子也是我的。

chapters.en: ‘The glory of this present house will be greater than the glory of the former house,’ says the LORD Almighty. ‘And in this place I will grant peace,’ declares the LORD Almighty.”
chapters.zh: 这殿后来的荣耀，必大过先前的荣耀。在这地方我必赐平安。这是万军之耶和华说的。

chapters.en: On the twenty-fourth day of the ninth month, in the second year of Darius, the word of the LORD came to the prophet Haggai:
chapters.zh: 大利乌王第二年，九月二十四日，耶和华的话临到先知哈该说，

chapters.en: “This is what the LORD Almighty says: ‘Ask the priests what the law says:
chapters.zh: 万军之耶和华如此说，你要向祭司问律法，

chapters.en: If someone carries consecrated meat in the fold of their garment, and that fold touches some bread or stew, some wine, olive oil or other food, does it become consecrated?’ ” The priests answered, “No.”
chapters.zh: 说，若有人用衣襟兜圣肉，这衣襟挨着饼，或汤，或酒，或油，或别的食物，便算为圣吗？祭司说，不算为圣。

chapters.en: Then Haggai said, “If a person defiled by contact with a dead body touches one of these things, does it become defiled?” “Yes,” the priests replied, “it becomes defiled.”
chapters.zh: 哈该又说，若有人因摸死尸染了污秽，然后挨着这些物的那一样，这物算污秽吗？祭司说，必算污秽。

chapters.en: Then Haggai said, “ ‘So it is with this people and this nation in my sight,’ declares the LORD. ‘Whatever they do and whatever they offer there is defiled.
chapters.zh: 于是哈该说，耶和华说，这民这国，在我面前也是如此。他们手下的各样工作，都是如此。他们在坛上所献的也是如此。

chapters.en: “ ‘Now give careful thought to this from this day on —consider how things were before one stone was laid on another in the LORD’s temple.
chapters.zh: 现在你们要追想，此日以前，耶和华的殿，没有一块石头垒在石头上的光景。

chapters.en: When anyone came to a heap of twenty measures, there were only ten. When anyone went to a wine vat to draw fifty measures, there were only twenty.
chapters.zh: 在那一切日子，有人来到谷堆，想得二十斗，只得了十斗。有人来到酒池，想得五十桶，只得了二十桶。

chapters.en: I struck all the work of your hands with blight, mildew and hail, yet you did not return to me,’ declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 在你们手下的各样工作上，我以旱风，霉烂，冰雹，攻击你们。你们仍不归向我。这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: ‘From this day on, from this twenty-fourth day of the ninth month, give careful thought to the day when the foundation of the LORD’s temple was laid. Give careful thought:
chapters.zh: 你们要追想此日以前，就是从这九月二十四日起，追想到立耶和华殿根基的日子。

chapters.en: Is there yet any seed left in the barn? Until now, the vine and the fig tree, the pomegranate and the olive tree have not borne fruit. “ ‘From this day on I will bless you.’ ”
chapters.zh: 仓里有谷种吗？葡萄树，无花果树，石榴树，橄榄树都没有结果子。从今日起，我必赐福与你们。

chapters.en: The word of the LORD came to Haggai a second time on the twenty-fourth day of the month:
chapters.zh: 这月二十四日，耶和华的话二次临到哈该说，

chapters.en: “Tell Zerubbabel governor of Judah that I am going to shake the heavens and the earth.
chapters.zh: 你要告诉犹大省长所罗巴伯说，我必震动天地。

chapters.en: I will overturn royal thrones and shatter the power of the foreign kingdoms. I will overthrow chariots and their drivers; horses and their riders will fall, each by the sword of his brother.
chapters.zh: 我必倾覆列国的宝座，除灭列邦的势力，并倾覆战车，和坐在其上的。马必跌倒，骑马的败落，各人被弟兄的刀所杀。

chapters.en: “ ‘On that day,’ declares the LORD Almighty, ‘I will take you, my servant Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel,’ declares the LORD, ‘and I will make you like my signet ring, for I have chosen you,’ declares the LORD Almighty.”
chapters.zh: 万军之耶和华说，我仆人撒拉铁的儿子所罗巴伯阿，到那日，我必以你为印，因我拣选了你。这是万军之耶和华说的。

chapters.en: In the eighth month of the second year of Darius, the word of the LORD came to the prophet Zechariah son of Berekiah, the son of Iddo:
chapters.zh: 大利乌王第二年八月，耶和华的话临到易多的孙子，比利家的儿子，先知撒迦利亚，说，

chapters.en: “The LORD was very angry with your ancestors.
chapters.zh: 耶和华曾向你们列祖大大发怒。

chapters.en: Therefore tell the people: This is what the LORD Almighty says: ‘Return to me,’ declares the LORD Almighty, ‘and I will return to you,’ says the LORD Almighty.
chapters.zh: 所以你要对以色列人说，万军之耶和华如此说，你们要转向我，我就转向你们。这是万军之耶和华说的。

chapters.en: Do not be like your ancestors, to whom the earlier prophets proclaimed: This is what the LORD Almighty says: ‘Turn from your evil ways and your evil practices.’ But they would not listen or pay attention to me, declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 不要效法你们列祖。从前的先知呼叫他们说，万军之耶和华如此说，你们要回头，离开你们的恶道恶行。他们却不听，也不顺从我。这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: Where are your ancestors now? And the prophets, do they live forever?
chapters.zh: 你们的列祖在哪里呢？那些先知能永远存活吗？

chapters.en: But did not my words and my decrees, which I commanded my servants the prophets, overtake your ancestors? “Then they repented and said, ‘The LORD Almighty has done to us what our ways and practices deserve, just as he determined to do.’ ”
chapters.zh: 只是我的言语和律例，就是所吩咐我仆人众先知的，岂不临到你们列祖吗？他们就回头，说，万军之耶和华定意，按我们的行动作为，向我们怎样行，他已照样行了。

chapters.en: On the twenty-fourth day of the eleventh month, the month of Shebat, in the second year of Darius, the word of the LORD came to the prophet Zechariah son of Berekiah, the son of Iddo.
chapters.zh: 大利乌第二年十一月，就是细吧特月二十四日，耶和华的话临到易多的孙子，比利家的儿子先知撒迦利亚，说，

chapters.en: During the night I had a vision, and there before me was a man mounted on a red horse. He was standing among the myrtle trees in a ravine. Behind him were red, brown and white horses.
chapters.zh: 我夜间观看，见一人骑着红马，站在洼地番石榴树中间。在他身后又有红马，黄马，和白马。

chapters.en: I asked, “What are these, my lord?” The angel who was talking with me answered, “I will show you what they are.”
chapters.zh: 我对与我说话的天使说，主阿，这是什么意思。他说，我要指示你这是什么意思。

chapters.en: Then the man standing among the myrtle trees explained, “They are the ones the LORD has sent to go throughout the earth.”
chapters.zh: 那站在番石榴树中间的人说，这是奉耶和华差遣，在遍地走来走去的。

chapters.en: And they reported to the angel of the LORD who was standing among the myrtle trees, “We have gone throughout the earth and found the whole world at rest and in peace.”
chapters.zh: 那些骑马的，对站在番石榴树中间耶和华的使者说，我们已在遍地走来走去，见全地都安息平静。

chapters.en: Then the angel of the LORD said, “LORD Almighty, how long will you withhold mercy from Jerusalem and from the towns of Judah, which you have been angry with these seventy years?”
chapters.zh: 于是，耶和华的使者说，万军之耶和华阿，你恼恨耶路撒冷，和犹大的城邑，已经七十年，你不施怜悯要到几时呢？

chapters.en: So the LORD spoke kind and comforting words to the angel who talked with me.
chapters.zh: 耶和华就用美善的安慰话，回答那与我说话的天使。

chapters.en: Then the angel who was speaking to me said, “Proclaim this word: This is what the LORD Almighty says: ‘I am very jealous for Jerusalem and Zion,
chapters.zh: 与我说话的天使对我说，你要宣告说，万军之耶和华如此说，我为耶路撒冷，为锡安，心里极其火热。

chapters.en: and I am very angry with the nations that feel secure. I was only a little angry, but they went too far with the punishment.’
chapters.zh: 我甚恼怒那安逸的列国。因我从前稍微恼怒我民，他们就加害过分。

chapters.en: “Therefore this is what the LORD says: ‘I will return to Jerusalem with mercy, and there my house will be rebuilt. And the measuring line will be stretched out over Jerusalem,’ declares the LORD Almighty.
chapters.zh: 所以耶和华如此说，现今我回到耶路撒冷，仍施怜悯。我的殿必重建在其中，准绳必拉在耶路撒冷之上。这是万军之耶和华说的。

chapters.en: “Proclaim further: This is what the LORD Almighty says: ‘My towns will again overflow with prosperity, and the LORD will again comfort Zion and choose Jerusalem.’ ”
chapters.zh: 你要再宣告说，万军之耶和华如此说，我的城邑必再丰盛发达。耶和华必再安慰锡安，拣选耶路撒冷。

chapters.en: Then I looked up, and there before me were four horns.
chapters.zh: 我举目观看，见有四角。

chapters.en: I asked the angel who was speaking to me, “What are these?” He answered me, “These are the horns that scattered Judah, Israel and Jerusalem.”
chapters.zh: 我就问与我说话的天使说，这是什么意思。他回答说，这是打散犹大，以色列，和耶路撒冷的角。

chapters.en: Then the LORD showed me four craftsmen.
chapters.zh: 耶和华又指四个匠人给我看。

chapters.en: I asked, “What are these coming to do?” He answered, “These are the horns that scattered Judah so that no one could raise their head, but the craftsmen have come to terrify them and throw down these horns of the nations who lifted up their horns against the land of Judah to scatter its people.”
chapters.zh: 我说，他们来做什么呢？他说，这是打散犹大的角，使人不敢抬头。但这些匠人来威吓列国，打掉他们的角，就是举起打散犹大地的角。

chapters.en: Then I looked up, and there before me was a man with a measuring line in his hand.
chapters.zh: 我又举目观看，见一人手拿准绳。

chapters.en: I asked, “Where are you going?” He answered me, “To measure Jerusalem, to find out how wide and how long it is.”
chapters.zh: 我说，你往哪里去？他对我说，要去量耶路撒冷，看有多宽多长。

chapters.en: While the angel who was speaking to me was leaving, another angel came to meet him
chapters.zh: 与我说话的天使去的时候，又有一位天使迎着他来，

chapters.en: and said to him: “Run, tell that young man, ‘Jerusalem will be a city without walls because of the great number of people and animals in it.
chapters.zh: 对他说，你跑去告诉那少年人说，耶路撒冷必有人居住，好像无城墙的乡村，因为人民和牲畜甚多。

chapters.en: And I myself will be a wall of fire around it,’ declares the LORD, ‘and I will be its glory within.’
chapters.zh: 耶和华说，我要作耶路撒冷四围的火城，并要作其中的荣耀。

chapters.en: “Come! Come! Flee from the land of the north,” declares the LORD, “for I have scattered you to the four winds of heaven,” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说，我从前分散你们在天的四方。（原文作犹如天的四风），现在你们要从北方之地逃回。这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: “Come, Zion! Escape, you who live in Daughter Babylon!”
chapters.zh: 与巴比伦人同住的锡安民哪，应当逃脱。

chapters.en: For this is what the LORD Almighty says: “After the Glorious One has sent me against the nations that have plundered you—for whoever touches you touches the apple of his eye—
chapters.zh: 万军之耶和华说，在显出荣耀之后，差遣我去惩罚那掳掠你们的列国。摸你们的，就是摸他眼中的瞳人。

chapters.en: I will surely raise my hand against them so that their slaves will plunder them. Then you will know that the LORD Almighty has sent me.
chapters.zh: 看哪，我（或作他）要向他们抡手，他们就必作服事他们之人的掳物，你们便知道万军之耶和华差遣我了。

chapters.en: “Shout and be glad, Daughter Zion. For I am coming, and I will live among you,” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 锡安城阿，应当欢乐歌唱，因为我来要住在你中间。这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: “Many nations will be joined with the LORD in that day and will become my people. I will live among you and you will know that the LORD Almighty has sent me to you.
chapters.zh: 那时，必有许多国归附耶和华，作他（原文作我）的子民。他（原文作我）要住在你中间，你就知道万军之耶和华差遣我到你那里去了。

chapters.en: The LORD will inherit Judah as his portion in the holy land and will again choose Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 耶和华必收回犹大作他圣地的分，也必再拣选耶路撒冷。

chapters.en: Be still before the LORD, all mankind, because he has roused himself from his holy dwelling.”
chapters.zh: 凡有血气的，都当在耶和华面前静默无声。因为他兴起，从圣所出来了。

chapters.en: Then he showed me Joshua the high priest standing before the angel of the LORD, and Satan standing at his right side to accuse him.
chapters.zh: 天使（原文作他）又指给我看，大祭司约书亚，站在耶和华的使者面前，撒但也站在约书亚的右边，与他作对。

chapters.en: The LORD said to Satan, “The LORD rebuke you, Satan! The LORD, who has chosen Jerusalem, rebuke you! Is not this man a burning stick snatched from the fire?”
chapters.zh: 耶和华向撒但说，撒但哪，耶和华责备你，就是拣选耶路撒冷的耶和华责备你。这不是从火中抽出来的一根柴吗？

chapters.en: Now Joshua was dressed in filthy clothes as he stood before the angel.
chapters.zh: 约书亚穿着污秽的衣服，站在使者面前。

chapters.en: The angel said to those who were standing before him, “Take off his filthy clothes.” Then he said to Joshua, “See, I have taken away your sin, and I will put fine garments on you.”
chapters.zh: 使者吩咐站在面前的说，你们要脱去他污秽的衣服。又对约书亚说，我使你脱离罪孽，要给你穿上华美的衣服。

chapters.en: Then I said, “Put a clean turban on his head.” So they put a clean turban on his head and clothed him, while the angel of the LORD stood by.
chapters.zh: 我说，要将洁净的冠冕戴在他头上。他们就把洁净的冠冕戴在他头上，给他穿上华美的衣服，耶和华的使者在旁边站立。

chapters.en: The angel of the LORD gave this charge to Joshua:
chapters.zh: 耶和华的使者告诫约书亚说，

chapters.en: “This is what the LORD Almighty says: ‘If you will walk in obedience to me and keep my requirements, then you will govern my house and have charge of my courts, and I will give you a place among these standing here.
chapters.zh: 万军之耶和华如此说，你若遵行我的道，谨守我的命令，你就可以管理我的家，看守我的院宇。我也要使你在这些站立的人中间来往。

chapters.en: “ ‘Listen, High Priest Joshua, you and your associates seated before you, who are men symbolic of things to come: I am going to bring my servant, the Branch.
chapters.zh: 大祭司约书亚阿，你和坐在你面前的同伴都当听。（他们是作预兆的）。我必使我仆人大卫的苗裔发出。

chapters.en: See, the stone I have set in front of Joshua! There are seven eyes on that one stone, and I will engrave an inscription on it,’ says the LORD Almighty, ‘and I will remove the sin of this land in a single day.
chapters.zh: 看哪，我在约书亚面前所立的石头，在一块石头上有七眼。万军之耶和华说，我要亲自雕刻这石头，并要在一日之间，除掉这地的罪孽。

chapters.en: “ ‘In that day each of you will invite your neighbor to sit under your vine and fig tree,’ declares the LORD Almighty.”
chapters.zh: 当那日，你们各人要请邻舍坐在葡萄树和无花果树下。这是万军之耶和华说的。

chapters.en: Then the angel who talked with me returned and woke me up, like someone awakened from sleep.
chapters.zh: 那与我说话的天使又来叫醒我，好像人睡觉被唤醒一样。

chapters.en: He asked me, “What do you see?” I answered, “I see a solid gold lampstand with a bowl at the top and seven lamps on it, with seven channels to the lamps.
chapters.zh: 他问我说，你看见了什么。我说，我看见了一个纯金的灯台，顶上有灯盏，灯台上有七盏灯，每盏有七个管子。

chapters.en: Also there are two olive trees by it, one on the right of the bowl and the other on its left.”
chapters.zh: 旁边有两棵橄榄树，一棵在灯盏的右边，一棵在灯盏的左边。

chapters.en: I asked the angel who talked with me, “What are these, my lord?”
chapters.zh: 我问与我说话的天使说，主阿，这是什么意思。

chapters.en: He answered, “Do you not know what these are?” “No, my lord,” I replied.
chapters.zh: 与我说话的天使回答我说，你不知道这是什么意思吗？我说，主阿，我不知道。

chapters.en: So he said to me, “This is the word of the LORD to Zerubbabel: ‘Not by might nor by power, but by my Spirit,’ says the LORD Almighty.
chapters.zh: 他对我说，这是耶和华指示所罗巴伯的。万军之耶和华说，不是倚靠势力，不是倚靠才能，乃是倚靠我的灵，方能成事。

chapters.en: “What are you, mighty mountain? Before Zerubbabel you will become level ground. Then he will bring out the capstone to shouts of ‘God bless it! God bless it!’ ”
chapters.zh: 大山哪，你算什么呢？在所罗巴伯面前，你必成为平地。他必搬出一块石头，安在殿顶上。人且大声欢呼，说，愿恩惠恩惠归与这殿（殿或作石）。

chapters.en: Then the word of the LORD came to me:
chapters.zh: 耶和华的话又临到我说，

chapters.en: “The hands of Zerubbabel have laid the foundation of this temple; his hands will also complete it. Then you will know that the LORD Almighty has sent me to you.
chapters.zh: 所罗巴伯的手，立了这殿的根基。他的手也必完成这工。你就知道万军之耶和华差遣我到你们这里来了。

chapters.en: “Who dares despise the day of small things, since the seven eyes of the LORD that range throughout the earth will rejoice when they see the chosen capstone in the hand of Zerubbabel?”
chapters.zh: 谁藐视这日的事为小呢？这七眼乃是耶和华的眼睛，遍察全地，见所罗巴伯手拿线铊就欢喜。

chapters.en: Then I asked the angel, “What are these two olive trees on the right and the left of the lampstand?”
chapters.zh: 我又问天使说，这灯台左右的两棵橄榄树，是什么意思。

chapters.en: Again I asked him, “What are these two olive branches beside the two gold pipes that pour out golden oil?”
chapters.zh: 我二次问他说，这两根橄榄枝，在两个流出金色油的金嘴旁边，是什么意思。

chapters.en: He replied, “Do you not know what these are?” “No, my lord,” I said.
chapters.zh: 他对我说，你不知道这是什么意思吗？我说，主阿，我不知道。

chapters.en: So he said, “These are the two who are anointed to serve the Lord of all the earth.”
chapters.zh: 他说，这是两个受膏者，站在普天下主的旁边。

chapters.en: I looked again, and there before me was a flying scroll.
chapters.zh: 我又举目观看，见有一飞行的书卷。

chapters.en: He asked me, “What do you see?” I answered, “I see a flying scroll, twenty cubits long and ten cubits wide. ”
chapters.zh: 他问我说，你看见什么。我回答说，我看见一飞行的书卷，长二十肘。宽十肘。

chapters.en: And he said to me, “This is the curse that is going out over the whole land; for according to what it says on one side, every thief will be banished, and according to what it says on the other, everyone who swears falsely will be banished.
chapters.zh: 他对我说，这是发出行在遍地上的咒诅。凡偷窃的必按卷上这面的话除灭。凡起假誓的必按卷上那面的话除灭。

chapters.en: The LORD Almighty declares, ‘I will send it out, and it will enter the house of the thief and the house of anyone who swears falsely by my name. It will remain in that house and destroy it completely, both its timbers and its stones.’ ”
chapters.zh: 万军之耶和华说，我必使这书卷出去，进入偷窃人的家，和指我名起假誓人的家，必常在他家里，连房屋带木石都毁灭了。

chapters.en: Then the angel who was speaking to me came forward and said to me, “Look up and see what is appearing.”
chapters.zh: 与我说话的天使出来，对我说，你要举目观看，见所出来的是什么？

chapters.en: I asked, “What is it?” He replied, “It is a basket.” And he added, “This is the iniquity of the people throughout the land.”
chapters.zh: 我说，这是什么呢？他说，这出来的是量器。他又说，这是恶人，在遍地的形状。

chapters.en: Then the cover of lead was raised, and there in the basket sat a woman!
chapters.zh: （我见有一片圆铅被举起来）这坐在量器中的是个妇人。

chapters.en: He said, “This is wickedness,” and he pushed her back into the basket and pushed its lead cover down on it.
chapters.zh: 天使说，这是罪恶。他就把妇人扔在量器中，将那片圆铅扔在量器的口上。

chapters.en: Then I looked up—and there before me were two women, with the wind in their wings! They had wings like those of a stork, and they lifted up the basket between heaven and earth.
chapters.zh: 我又举目观看，见有两个妇人出来，在她们翅膀中有风，飞得甚快。翅膀如同鹳鸟的翅膀。她们将量器抬起来，悬在天地中间。

chapters.en: “Where are they taking the basket?” I asked the angel who was speaking to me.
chapters.zh: 我问与我说话的天使说，她们要将量器抬到哪里去呢？

chapters.en: He replied, “To the country of Babylonia to build a house for it. When the house is ready, the basket will be set there in its place.”
chapters.zh: 他对我说，要往示拿地去，为它盖造房屋。等房屋齐备，就把它安置在自己的地方。

chapters.en: I looked up again, and there before me were four chariots coming out from between two mountains—mountains of bronze.
chapters.zh: 我又举目观看，见有四辆车从两山中间出来。那山是铜山。

chapters.en: The first chariot had red horses, the second black,
chapters.zh: 第一辆车套着红马，第二辆车套着黑马。

chapters.en: the third white, and the fourth dappled—all of them powerful.
chapters.zh: 第三辆车套着白马，第四辆车套着有斑点的壮马。

chapters.en: I asked the angel who was speaking to me, “What are these, my lord?”
chapters.zh: 我就问与我说话的天使说，主阿，这是什么意思。

chapters.en: The angel answered me, “These are the four spirits of heaven, going out from standing in the presence of the Lord of the whole world.
chapters.zh: 天使回答我说，这是天的四风，是从普天下的主面前出来的。

chapters.en: The one with the black horses is going toward the north country, the one with the white horses toward the west, and the one with the dappled horses toward the south.”
chapters.zh: 套着黑马的车往北方去，白马跟随在后。有斑点的马往南方去。

chapters.en: When the powerful horses went out, they were straining to go throughout the earth. And he said, “Go throughout the earth!” So they went throughout the earth.
chapters.zh: 壮马出来，要在遍地走来走去。天使说，你们只管在遍地走来走去。它们就照样行了。

chapters.en: Then he called to me, “Look, those going toward the north country have given my Spirit rest in the land of the north.”
chapters.zh: 他又呼叫我说，看哪，往北方去的，已在北方安慰我的心。

chapters.en: The word of the LORD came to me:
chapters.zh: 耶和华的话临到我说，

chapters.en: “Take silver and gold from the exiles Heldai, Tobijah and Jedaiah, who have arrived from Babylon. Go the same day to the house of Josiah son of Zephaniah.
chapters.zh: 你要从被掳之人中取黑玳，多比雅，耶大雅的金银。这三人是从巴比伦来到西番雅的儿子约西亚的家里。当日你要进他的家，

chapters.en: Take the silver and gold and make a crown, and set it on the head of the high priest, Joshua son of Jozadak.
chapters.zh: 取这金银作冠冕，戴在约撒答的儿子，大祭司约书亚的头上。

chapters.en: Tell him this is what the LORD Almighty says: ‘Here is the man whose name is the Branch, and he will branch out from his place and build the temple of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 对他说，万军之耶和华如此说，看哪，那名称为（大卫苗裔的，他要在本处长起来。并要建造耶和华的殿。

chapters.en: It is he who will build the temple of the LORD, and he will be clothed with majesty and will sit and rule on his throne. And he will be a priest on his throne. And there will be harmony between the two.’
chapters.zh: 他要建造耶和华的殿，并担负尊荣，坐在位上掌王权。又必在位上作祭司，使两职之间筹定和平。

chapters.en: The crown will be given to Heldai, Tobijah, Jedaiah and Hen son of Zephaniah as a memorial in the temple of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 这冠冕要归希连（就是黑玳），多比雅，耶大雅，和西番雅的儿子贤（贤就是约西亚），放在耶和华的殿里为记念。

chapters.en: Those who are far away will come and help to build the temple of the LORD, and you will know that the LORD Almighty has sent me to you. This will happen if you diligently obey the LORD your God.”
chapters.zh: 远方的人也要来建造耶和华的殿。你们就知道万军之耶和华差遣我，到你们这里来。你们若留意听从耶和华你们神的话，这事必然成就。

chapters.en: In the fourth year of King Darius, the word of the LORD came to Zechariah on the fourth day of the ninth month, the month of Kislev.
chapters.zh: 大利乌王第四年九月，就是基斯流月初四日，耶和华的话临到撒迦利亚。

chapters.en: The people of Bethel had sent Sharezer and Regem-Melek, together with their men, to entreat the LORD
chapters.zh: 那时伯特利人已经打发沙利色和利坚米勒，并跟从他们的人，去恳求耶和华的恩，

chapters.en: by asking the priests of the house of the LORD Almighty and the prophets, “Should I mourn and fast in the fifth month, as I have done for so many years?”
chapters.zh: 并问万军之耶和华殿中的祭司，和先知说，我历年以来，在五月间哭泣斋戒，现在还当这样行吗？

chapters.en: Then the word of the LORD Almighty came to me:
chapters.zh: 万军之耶和华的话就临到我说，

chapters.en: “Ask all the people of the land and the priests, ‘When you fasted and mourned in the fifth and seventh months for the past seventy years, was it really for me that you fasted?
chapters.zh: 你要宣告国内的众民，和祭司，说，你们这七十年在五月，七月禁食悲哀，岂是丝毫向我禁食吗？

chapters.en: And when you were eating and drinking, were you not just feasting for yourselves?
chapters.zh: 你们吃喝，不是为自己吃，为自己喝吗？

chapters.en: Are these not the words the LORD proclaimed through the earlier prophets when Jerusalem and its surrounding towns were at rest and prosperous, and the Negev and the western foothills were settled?’ ”
chapters.zh: 当耶路撒冷和四围的城邑有居民，正兴盛，南地高原有人居住的时候，耶和华借从前的先知所宣告的话，你们不当听吗？

chapters.en: And the word of the LORD came again to Zechariah:
chapters.zh: 耶和华的话又临到撒迦利亚说，

chapters.en: “This is what the LORD Almighty said: ‘Administer true justice; show mercy and compassion to one another.
chapters.zh: 万军之耶和华曾对你们的列祖如此说，要按至理判断，各人以慈爱怜悯弟兄。

chapters.en: Do not oppress the widow or the fatherless, the foreigner or the poor. Do not plot evil against each other.’
chapters.zh: 不可欺压寡妇，孤儿，寄居的，和贫穷人。谁都不可心里谋害弟兄。

chapters.en: “But they refused to pay attention; stubbornly they turned their backs and covered their ears.
chapters.zh: 他们却不肯听从，扭转肩头，塞耳不听。

chapters.en: They made their hearts as hard as flint and would not listen to the law or to the words that the LORD Almighty had sent by his Spirit through the earlier prophets. So the LORD Almighty was very angry.
chapters.zh: 使心硬如金钢石，不听律法，和万军之耶和华用灵借从前的先知所说的话。故此，万军之耶和华大发烈怒。

chapters.en: “ ‘When I called, they did not listen; so when they called, I would not listen,’ says the LORD Almighty.
chapters.zh: 万军之耶和华说，我曾呼唤他们，他们不听。将来他们呼求我，我也不听。

chapters.en: ‘I scattered them with a whirlwind among all the nations, where they were strangers. The land they left behind them was so desolate that no one traveled through it. This is how they made the pleasant land desolate.’ ”
chapters.zh: 我必以旋风吹散他们到素不认识的万国中。这样，他们的地就荒凉，甚至无人来往经过。因为他们使美好之地荒凉了。

chapters.en: The word of the LORD Almighty came to me.
chapters.zh: 万军之耶和华的话临到我说，

chapters.en: This is what the LORD Almighty says: “I am very jealous for Zion; I am burning with jealousy for her.”
chapters.zh: 万军之耶和华如此说，我为锡安心里极其火热。我为她火热，向她的仇敌发烈怒。

chapters.en: This is what the LORD says: “I will return to Zion and dwell in Jerusalem. Then Jerusalem will be called the Faithful City, and the mountain of the LORD Almighty will be called the Holy Mountain.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华如此说，我现在回到锡安，要住在耶路撒冷中。耶路撒冷必称为诚实的城，万军之耶和华的山必称为圣山。

chapters.en: This is what the LORD Almighty says: “Once again men and women of ripe old age will sit in the streets of Jerusalem, each of them with cane in hand because of their age.
chapters.zh: 万军之耶和华如此说，将来必有年老的男女，坐在耶路撒冷街上。因为年纪老迈就手拿拐杖。

chapters.en: The city streets will be filled with boys and girls playing there.”
chapters.zh: 城中街上必满有男孩女孩玩耍。

chapters.en: This is what the LORD Almighty says: “It may seem marvelous to the remnant of this people at that time, but will it seem marvelous to me?” declares the LORD Almighty.
chapters.zh: 万军之耶和华如此说，到那日，这事在余剩的民眼中看为希奇，在我眼中也看为希奇吗？这是万军之耶和华说的。

chapters.en: This is what the LORD Almighty says: “I will save my people from the countries of the east and the west.
chapters.zh: 万军之耶和华如此说，我要从东方从西方救回我的民。

chapters.en: I will bring them back to live in Jerusalem; they will be my people, and I will be faithful and righteous to them as their God.”
chapters.zh: 我要领他们来，使他们住在耶路撒冷中。他们要作我的子民，我要作他们的神，都凭诚实和公义。

chapters.en: This is what the LORD Almighty says: “Now hear these words, ‘Let your hands be strong so that the temple may be built.’ This is also what the prophets said who were present when the foundation was laid for the house of the LORD Almighty.
chapters.zh: 万军之耶和华如此说，当建造万军之耶和华的殿，立根基之日的先知所说的话，现在你们听见，应当手里强壮。

chapters.en: Before that time there were no wages for people or hire for animals. No one could go about their business safely because of their enemies, since I had turned everyone against their neighbor.
chapters.zh: 那日以先，人得不着雇价，牲畜也是如此。且因敌人的缘故，出入之人，不得平安。乃因我使众人互相攻击。

chapters.en: But now I will not deal with the remnant of this people as I did in the past,” declares the LORD Almighty.
chapters.zh: 但如今，我待这余剩的民必不像从前。这是万军之耶和华说的。

chapters.en: “The seed will grow well, the vine will yield its fruit, the ground will produce its crops, and the heavens will drop their dew. I will give all these things as an inheritance to the remnant of this people.
chapters.zh: 因为他们必平安撒种。葡萄树必结果子，地土必有出产，天也必降甘露。我要使这余剩的民，享受这一切的福。

chapters.en: Just as you, Judah and Israel, have been a curse among the nations, so I will save you, and you will be a blessing. Do not be afraid, but let your hands be strong.”
chapters.zh: 犹大家和以色列家阿，你们从前在列国中，怎样成为可咒诅的，照样，我要拯救你们，使人称你们为有福的（或作使你们叫人得福）。你们不要惧怕，手要强壮。

chapters.en: This is what the LORD Almighty says: “Just as I had determined to bring disaster on you and showed no pity when your ancestors angered me,” says the LORD Almighty,
chapters.zh: 万军之耶和华如此说，你们列祖惹我发怒的时候，我怎样定意降祸，并不后悔。

chapters.en: “so now I have determined to do good again to Jerusalem and Judah. Do not be afraid.
chapters.zh: 现在我照样定意施恩与耶路撒冷和犹大家，你们不要惧怕。

chapters.en: These are the things you are to do: Speak the truth to each other, and render true and sound judgment in your courts;
chapters.zh: 你们所当行的是这样，各人与邻舍说话诚实，在城门口按至理判断，使人和睦。

chapters.en: do not plot evil against each other, and do not love to swear falsely. I hate all this,” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 谁都不可心里谋害邻舍，也不可喜爱起假誓。因为这些事都为我所恨恶。这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: The word of the LORD Almighty came to me.
chapters.zh: 万军之耶和华的话临到我说，

chapters.en: This is what the LORD Almighty says: “The fasts of the fourth, fifth, seventh and tenth months will become joyful and glad occasions and happy festivals for Judah. Therefore love truth and peace.”
chapters.zh: 万军之耶和华如此说，四月五月禁食的日子，七月十月禁食的日子，必变为犹大家欢喜快乐的日子，和欢乐的节期。所以你们要喜爱诚实与和平。

chapters.en: This is what the LORD Almighty says: “Many peoples and the inhabitants of many cities will yet come,
chapters.zh: 万军之耶和华如此说，将来必有列国的人，和多城的居民来到。

chapters.en: and the inhabitants of one city will go to another and say, ‘Let us go at once to entreat the LORD and seek the LORD Almighty. I myself am going.’
chapters.zh: 这城的居民必到那城，说，我们要快去恳求耶和华的恩，寻求万军之耶和华。我也要去。

chapters.en: And many peoples and powerful nations will come to Jerusalem to seek the LORD Almighty and to entreat him.”
chapters.zh: 必有列邦的人，和强国的民，来到耶路撒冷，寻求万军之耶和华。恳求耶和华的恩。

chapters.en: This is what the LORD Almighty says: “In those days ten people from all languages and nations will take firm hold of one Jew by the hem of his robe and say, ‘Let us go with you, because we have heard that God is with you.’ ”
chapters.zh: 万军之耶和华如此说，在那些日子，必有十个人从列国诸族中出来（族原文作方言），拉住一个犹大人的衣襟，说，我们要与你们同去，因为我们听见神与你们同在了。

chapters.en: The word of the LORD is against the land of Hadrak and will come to rest on Damascus— for the eyes of all people and all the tribes of Israel are on the LORD—
chapters.zh: 耶和华的默示应验在哈得拉地，大马色（世人和以色列各支派的眼目都仰望耶和华）。

chapters.en: and on Hamath too, which borders on it, and on Tyre and Sidon, though they are very skillful.
chapters.zh: 和靠近的哈马，并推罗，西顿，因为这二城的人大有智慧。

chapters.en: Tyre has built herself a stronghold; she has heaped up silver like dust, and gold like the dirt of the streets.
chapters.zh: 推罗为自己修筑保障，积蓄银子如尘沙，堆起精金如街上的泥土。

chapters.en: But the Lord will take away her possessions and destroy her power on the sea, and she will be consumed by fire.
chapters.zh: 主必赶出她，打败她海上的权力。她必被火烧灭。

chapters.en: Ashkelon will see it and fear; Gaza will writhe in agony, and Ekron too, for her hope will wither. Gaza will lose her king and Ashkelon will be deserted.
chapters.zh: 亚实基伦看见必惧怕。迦萨看见甚痛苦。以革伦因失了盼望蒙羞。迦萨必不再有君王。亚实基伦也不再有居民。

chapters.en: A mongrel people will occupy Ashdod, and I will put an end to the pride of the Philistines.
chapters.zh: 私生子（或作外族人）必住在亚实突。我必除灭非利士人的骄傲。

chapters.en: I will take the blood from their mouths, the forbidden food from between their teeth. Those who are left will belong to our God and become a clan in Judah, and Ekron will be like the Jebusites.
chapters.zh: 我必除去他口中带血之肉，和牙齿内可憎之物。他必作为余剩的人归与我们的神，必在犹大像族长，以革伦人必如耶布斯人。

chapters.en: But I will encamp at my temple to guard it against marauding forces. Never again will an oppressor overrun my people, for now I am keeping watch.
chapters.zh: 我必在我家的四围安营，使敌军不得任意往来。暴虐的人也不再经过，因为我亲眼看顾我的家。

chapters.en: Rejoice greatly, Daughter Zion! Shout, Daughter Jerusalem! See, your king comes to you, righteous and victorious, lowly and riding on a donkey, on a colt, the foal of a donkey.
chapters.zh: 锡安的民哪，应当大大喜乐。耶路撒冷的民哪，应当欢呼。看哪，你的王来到你这里。他是公义的，并且施行拯救，谦谦和和地骑着驴，就是骑着驴的驹子。

chapters.en: I will take away the chariots from Ephraim and the warhorses from Jerusalem, and the battle bow will be broken. He will proclaim peace to the nations. His rule will extend from sea to sea and from the River to the ends of the earth.
chapters.zh: 我必除灭以法莲的战车，和耶路撒冷的战马。争战的弓也必除灭。他必向列国讲和平。他的权柄必从这海管到那海，从大河管到地极。

chapters.en: As for you, because of the blood of my covenant with you, I will free your prisoners from the waterless pit.
chapters.zh: 锡安哪，我因与你立约的血，将你中间被掳而囚的人，从无水的坑中释放出来。

chapters.en: Return to your fortress, you prisoners of hope; even now I announce that I will restore twice as much to you.
chapters.zh: 你们被囚而有指望的人，都要转回保障。我今日说明，我必加倍赐福给你们。

chapters.en: I will bend Judah as I bend my bow and fill it with Ephraim. I will rouse your sons, Zion, against your sons, Greece, and make you like a warrior’s sword.
chapters.zh: 我拿犹大作上弦的弓，我拿以法莲为张弓的箭。锡安哪，我要激发你的众子，攻击希腊（原文作雅完）的众子，使你如勇士的刀。

chapters.en: Then the LORD will appear over them; his arrow will flash like lightning. The Sovereign LORD will sound the trumpet; he will march in the storms of the south,
chapters.zh: 耶和华必显现在他们以上。他的箭必射出像闪电。主耶和华必吹角，乘南方的旋风而行。

chapters.en: and the LORD Almighty will shield them. They will destroy and overcome with slingstones. They will drink and roar as with wine; they will be full like a bowl used for sprinkling the corners of the altar.
chapters.zh: 万军之耶和华必保护他们。他们必吞灭仇敌，践踏弹石。他们必喝血呐喊，犹如饮酒。他们必像盛满血的碗，又像坛的四角满了血。

chapters.en: The LORD their God will save his people on that day as a shepherd saves his flock. They will sparkle in his land like jewels in a crown.
chapters.zh: 当那日，耶和华他们的神必看他的民，如群羊拯救他们。因为他们必像冠冕上的宝石，高举在他的地以上（高举云云或作在他的地上发光辉）。

chapters.en: How attractive and beautiful they will be! Grain will make the young men thrive, and new wine the young women.
chapters.zh: 他的恩慈何等大，他的荣美何其盛。五谷健壮少男，新酒培养处女。

chapters.en: Ask the LORD for rain in the springtime; it is the LORD who sends the thunderstorms. He gives showers of rain to all people, and plants of the field to everyone.
chapters.zh: 当春雨的时候，你们要向发闪电的耶和华求雨。他必为众人降下甘霖，使田园生长菜蔬。

chapters.en: The idols speak deceitfully, diviners see visions that lie; they tell dreams that are false, they give comfort in vain. Therefore the people wander like sheep oppressed for lack of a shepherd.
chapters.zh: 因为，家神所言的是虚空，卜士所见的是虚假，做梦者所说的是假梦。他们白白地安慰人。所以众人如羊流离，因无牧人就受苦。

chapters.en: “My anger burns against the shepherds, and I will punish the leaders; for the LORD Almighty will care for his flock, the people of Judah, and make them like a proud horse in battle.
chapters.zh: 我的怒气向牧人发作，我必惩罚公山羊。因我万军之耶和华眷顾自己的羊群，就是犹大家，必使他们如骏马在阵上。

chapters.en: From Judah will come the cornerstone, from him the tent peg, from him the battle bow, from him every ruler.
chapters.zh: 房角石，钉子，争战的弓，和一切掌权的都从他而出。

chapters.en: Together they will be like warriors in battle trampling their enemy into the mud of the streets. They will fight because the LORD is with them, and they will put the enemy horsemen to shame.
chapters.zh: 他们必如勇士，在阵上将仇敌践踏在街上的泥土中。他们必争战，因为耶和华与他们同在。骑马的也必羞愧。

chapters.en: “I will strengthen Judah and save the tribes of Joseph. I will restore them because I have compassion on them. They will be as though I had not rejected them, for I am the LORD their God and I will answer them.
chapters.zh: 我要坚固犹大家，拯救约瑟家，要领他们归回。我要怜恤他们，他们必像未曾弃绝的一样。都因我是耶和华他们的神，我必应允他们的祷告。

chapters.en: The Ephraimites will become like warriors, and their hearts will be glad as with wine. Their children will see it and be joyful; their hearts will rejoice in the LORD.
chapters.zh: 以法莲人必如勇士，他们心中畅快如同喝酒。他们的儿女必看见而快活。他们的心必因耶和华喜乐。

chapters.en: I will signal for them and gather them in. Surely I will redeem them; they will be as numerous as before.
chapters.zh: 我要发嘶声，聚集他们。因我已经救赎他们。他们的人数必加增，如从前加增一样。

chapters.en: Though I scatter them among the peoples, yet in distant lands they will remember me. They and their children will survive, and they will return.
chapters.zh: 我虽然（或作必）播散他们在列国中，他们必在远方记念我。他们与儿女都必存活，且得归回。

chapters.en: I will bring them back from Egypt and gather them from Assyria. I will bring them to Gilead and Lebanon, and there will not be room enough for them.
chapters.zh: 我必再领他们出埃及地，招聚他们出亚述，领他们到基列和利巴嫩，这地尚且不够他们居住。

chapters.en: They will pass through the sea of trouble; the surging sea will be subdued and all the depths of the Nile will dry up. Assyria’s pride will be brought down and Egypt’s scepter will pass away.
chapters.zh: 耶和华必经过苦海，击打海浪，使尼罗河的深处都枯干。亚述的骄傲必至卑微。埃及的权柄必然灭没。

chapters.en: I will strengthen them in the LORD and in his name they will live securely,” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 我必使他们倚靠我，得以坚固。一举一动必奉我的名。这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: Open your doors, Lebanon, so that fire may devour your cedars!
chapters.zh: 利巴嫩哪，开开你的门，任火烧灭你的香柏树。

chapters.en: Wail, you juniper, for the cedar has fallen; the stately trees are ruined! Wail, oaks of Bashan; the dense forest has been cut down!
chapters.zh: 松树阿，应当哀号，因为香柏树倾倒，佳美的树毁坏。巴珊的橡树阿，应当哀号，因为茂盛的树林已经倒了。

chapters.en: Listen to the wail of the shepherds; their rich pastures are destroyed! Listen to the roar of the lions; the lush thicket of the Jordan is ruined!
chapters.zh: 听阿，有牧人哀号的声音，因他们荣华的草场毁坏了。有少壮狮子咆哮的声音，因约旦河旁的丛林荒废了。

chapters.en: This is what the LORD my God says: “Shepherd the flock marked for slaughter.
chapters.zh: 耶和华我的神如此说，你撒迦利亚要牧养这将宰的群羊。

chapters.en: Their buyers slaughter them and go unpunished. Those who sell them say, ‘Praise the LORD, I am rich!’ Their own shepherds do not spare them.
chapters.zh: 买他们的宰了他们，以自己为无罪。卖他们的说，耶和华是应当称颂的，因我成为富足。牧养他们的并不怜恤他们。

chapters.en: For I will no longer have pity on the people of the land,” declares the LORD. “I will give everyone into the hands of their neighbors and their king. They will devastate the land, and I will not rescue anyone from their hands.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华说，我不再怜恤这地的居民。必将这民交给各人的邻舍，和他们王的手中。他们必毁灭这地，我也不救这民脱离他们的手。

chapters.en: So I shepherded the flock marked for slaughter, particularly the oppressed of the flock. Then I took two staffs and called one Favor and the other Union, and I shepherded the flock.
chapters.zh: 于是，我牧养这将宰的群羊，就是群中最困苦的羊。我拿着两根杖。一根我称为荣美，一根我称为联索。这样，我牧养了群羊。

chapters.en: In one month I got rid of the three shepherds. The flock detested me, and I grew weary of them
chapters.zh: 一月之内，我除灭三个牧人。因为我的心厌烦他们，他们的心也憎嫌我。

chapters.en: and said, “I will not be your shepherd. Let the dying die, and the perishing perish. Let those who are left eat one another’s flesh.”
chapters.zh: 我就说，我不牧养你们。要死的，由他死。要丧亡的，由他丧亡。余剩的，由他们彼此相食。

chapters.en: Then I took my staff called Favor and broke it, revoking the covenant I had made with all the nations.
chapters.zh: 我折断那称为荣美的杖，表明我废弃与万民所立的约。

chapters.en: It was revoked on that day, and so the oppressed of the flock who were watching me knew it was the word of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 当日就废弃了。这样，那些仰望我的困苦羊，就知道所说的是耶和华的话。

chapters.en: I told them, “If you think it best, give me my pay; but if not, keep it.” So they paid me thirty pieces of silver.
chapters.zh: 我对他们说，你们若以为美，就给我工价，不然，就罢了。于是他们给了三十块钱，作为我的工价。

chapters.en: And the LORD said to me, “Throw it to the potter”—the handsome price at which they valued me! So I took the thirty pieces of silver and threw them to the potter at the house of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 耶和华吩咐我说，要把众人所估定美好的价值，丢给窑户。我便将这三十块钱，在耶和华的殿中丢给窑户了。

chapters.en: Then I broke my second staff called Union, breaking the family bond between Judah and Israel.
