chapters.zh: 你们这假冒为善的文士和法利赛人有祸了。因为你们洗净杯盘的外面，里面却盛满了勒索和放荡。

chapters.en: Blind Pharisee! First clean the inside of the cup and dish, and then the outside also will be clean.
chapters.zh: 你这瞎眼的法利赛人，先洗净杯盘的里面，好叫外面也干净了。

chapters.en: “Woe to you, teachers of the law and Pharisees, you hypocrites! You are like whitewashed tombs, which look beautiful on the outside but on the inside are full of the bones of the dead and everything unclean.
chapters.zh: 你们这假冒为善的文士和法利赛人有祸了。因为你们好像粉饰的坟墓，外面好看，里面却装满了死人的骨头，和一切的污秽。

chapters.en: In the same way, on the outside you appear to people as righteous but on the inside you are full of hypocrisy and wickedness.
chapters.zh: 你们也是如此，在人前，外面显出公义来，里面却装满了假善和不法的事。

chapters.en: “Woe to you, teachers of the law and Pharisees, you hypocrites! You build tombs for the prophets and decorate the graves of the righteous.
chapters.zh: 你们这假冒为善的文士和法利赛人有祸了。因为你们建造先知的坟，修饰义人的墓，说，

chapters.en: And you say, ‘If we had lived in the days of our ancestors, we would not have taken part with them in shedding the blood of the prophets.’
chapters.zh: 若是我们在我们祖宗的时候，必不和他们同流先知的血。

chapters.en: So you testify against yourselves that you are the descendants of those who murdered the prophets.
chapters.zh: 这就是你们自己证明，是杀害先知者的子孙了。

chapters.en: Go ahead, then, and complete what your ancestors started!
chapters.zh: 你们去充满你们祖宗的恶贯吧。

chapters.en: “You snakes! You brood of vipers! How will you escape being condemned to hell?
chapters.zh: 你们这些蛇类，毒蛇之种阿，怎能逃脱地狱的刑罚呢？

chapters.en: Therefore I am sending you prophets and sages and teachers. Some of them you will kill and crucify; others you will flog in your synagogues and pursue from town to town.
chapters.zh: 所以我差遣先知和智慧人并文士，到你们这里来。有的你们要杀害，要钉十字架。有的你们要在会堂里鞭打，从这城追逼到那城。

chapters.en: And so upon you will come all the righteous blood that has been shed on earth, from the blood of righteous Abel to the blood of Zechariah son of Berekiah, whom you murdered between the temple and the altar.
chapters.zh: 叫世上所流义人的血，都归到你们身上。从义人亚伯的血起，直到你们在殿和坛中间所杀的巴拉加的儿子撒迦利亚的血为止。

chapters.en: Truly I tell you, all this will come on this generation.
chapters.zh: 我实在告诉你们，这一切的罪，都要归到这世代了。

chapters.en: “Jerusalem, Jerusalem, you who kill the prophets and stone those sent to you, how often I have longed to gather your children together, as a hen gathers her chicks under her wings, and you were not willing.
chapters.zh: 耶路撒冷阿，耶路撒冷阿，你常杀害先知，又用石头打死那奉差遣到你这里来的人。我多次愿意聚集你的儿女，好像母鸡把小鸡聚集在翅膀底下，只是你们不愿意。

chapters.en: Look, your house is left to you desolate.
chapters.zh: 看哪，你们的家成为荒场，留给你们。

chapters.en: For I tell you, you will not see me again until you say, ‘Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord.’”
chapters.zh: 我告诉你们，从今以后，你们不得再见我，直等到你们说，奉主名来的，是应当称颂的。

chapters.en: Jesus left the temple and was walking away when his disciples came up to him to call his attention to its buildings.
chapters.zh: 耶稣出了圣殿，正走的时候，门徒进前来，把殿宇指给他看。

chapters.en: “Do you see all these things?” he asked. “Truly I tell you, not one stone here will be left on another; every one will be thrown down.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣对他们说，你们不是看见这殿宇吗？我实在告诉你们，将来在这里，没有一块石头留在石头上不被拆毁了。

chapters.en: As Jesus was sitting on the Mount of Olives, the disciples came to him privately. “Tell us,” they said, “when will this happen, and what will be the sign of your coming and of the end of the age?”
chapters.zh: 耶稣在橄榄山上坐着，门徒暗暗地来说，请告诉我们，什么时候有这些事？你降临和世界的末了，有什么预兆呢？

chapters.en: Jesus answered: “Watch out that no one deceives you.
chapters.zh: 耶稣回答说，你们要谨慎，免得有人迷惑你们。

chapters.en: For many will come in my name, claiming, ‘I am the Messiah,’ and will deceive many.
chapters.zh: 因为将来有好些人冒我的名来，说，我是基督，并且要迷惑许多人。

chapters.en: You will hear of wars and rumors of wars, but see to it that you are not alarmed. Such things must happen, but the end is still to come.
chapters.zh: 你们也要听见打仗和打仗的风声，总不要惊慌。因为这些事是必须有的。只是末期还没有到。

chapters.en: Nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom. There will be famines and earthquakes in various places.
chapters.zh: 民要攻打民，国要攻打国。多处必有饥荒，地震。

chapters.en: All these are the beginning of birth pains.
chapters.zh: 这都是灾难的起头。（灾难原文作生产之难）。

chapters.en: “Then you will be handed over to be persecuted and put to death, and you will be hated by all nations because of me.
chapters.zh: 那时，人要把你们陷在患难里，也要杀害你们。你们又要为我的名，被万民恨恶。

chapters.en: At that time many will turn away from the faith and will betray and hate each other,
chapters.zh: 那时，必有许多人跌倒，也要彼此陷害，彼此恨恶。

chapters.en: and many false prophets will appear and deceive many people.
chapters.zh: 且有好些假先知起来，迷惑多人。

chapters.en: Because of the increase of wickedness, the love of most will grow cold,
chapters.zh: 只因不法的事增多，许多人的爱心，才渐渐冷淡了。

chapters.en: but the one who stands firm to the end will be saved.
chapters.zh: 惟有忍耐到底的，必然得救。

chapters.en: And this gospel of the kingdom will be preached in the whole world as a testimony to all nations, and then the end will come.
chapters.zh: 这天国的福音，要传遍天下，对万民作见证，然后末期才来到。

chapters.en: “So when you see standing in the holy place ‘the abomination that causes desolation,’spoken of through the prophet Daniel—let the reader understand—
chapters.zh: 你们看见先知但以理所说的，那行毁坏可憎的站在圣地。（读这经的人须要会意）。

chapters.en: then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains.
chapters.zh: 那时，在犹太的，应当逃到山上。

chapters.en: Let no one on the housetop go down to take anything out of the house.
chapters.zh: 在房上的，不要下来拿家里的东西。

chapters.en: Let no one in the field go back to get their cloak.
chapters.zh: 在田里的，也不要回去取衣裳。

chapters.en: How dreadful it will be in those days for pregnant women and nursing mothers!
chapters.zh: 当那些日子，怀孕的和奶孩子的有祸了。

chapters.en: Pray that your flight will not take place in winter or on the Sabbath.
chapters.zh: 你们应当祈求，叫你们逃走的时候，不遇见冬天，或是安息日。

chapters.en: For then there will be great distress, unequaled from the beginning of the world until now—and never to be equaled again.
chapters.zh: 因为那时必有大灾难，从世界的起头，直到如今，没有这样的灾难，后来也必没有。

chapters.en: “If those days had not been cut short, no one would survive, but for the sake of the elect those days will be shortened.
chapters.zh: 若不减少那日子，凡有血气的，总没有一个得救的。只是为选民，那日子必减少了。

chapters.en: At that time if anyone says to you, ‘Look, here is the Messiah!’ or, ‘There he is!’ do not believe it.
chapters.zh: 那时若有人对你们说，基督在这里。或说，基督在那里，你们不要信。

chapters.en: For false messiahs and false prophets will appear and perform great signs and wonders to deceive, if possible, even the elect.
chapters.zh: 因为假基督，假先知，将要起来，显大神迹，大奇事。倘若能行，连选民也就迷惑了。

chapters.en: See, I have told you ahead of time.
chapters.zh: 看哪，我预先告诉你们了。

chapters.en: “So if anyone tells you, ‘There he is, out in the wilderness,’ do not go out; or, ‘Here he is, in the inner rooms,’ do not believe it.
chapters.zh: 若有人对你们说，看哪，基督在旷野里。你们不要出去。或说，看哪，基督在内屋中。你们不要信。

chapters.en: For as lightning that comes from the east is visible even in the west, so will be the coming of the Son of Man.
chapters.zh: 闪电从东边发出，直照到西边。人子降临，也要这样。

chapters.en: Wherever there is a carcass, there the vultures will gather.
chapters.zh: 尸首在哪里，鹰也必聚在哪里。

chapters.en: “Immediately after the distress of those days “ ‘the sun will be darkened, and the moon will not give its light; the stars will fall from the sky, and the heavenly bodies will be shaken.’
chapters.zh: 那些日子的灾难一过去，日头就变黑了，月亮也不放光，众星要从天上坠落，天势都要震动。

chapters.en: “Then will appear the sign of the Son of Man in heaven. And then all the peoples of the earth will mourn when they see the Son of Man coming on the clouds of heaven, with power and great glory.
chapters.zh: 那时，人子的兆头要显在天上，地上的万族都要哀哭。他们要看见人子，有能力，有大荣耀，驾着天上的云降临。

chapters.en: And he will send his angels with a loud trumpet call, and they will gather his elect from the four winds, from one end of the heavens to the other.
chapters.zh: 他要差遣使者，用号筒的大声，将他的选民，从四方，从天这边到天那边，都招聚了来（方原文作风）。

chapters.en: “Now learn this lesson from the fig tree: As soon as its twigs get tender and its leaves come out, you know that summer is near.
chapters.zh: 你们可以从无花果树学个比方。当树枝发嫩长叶的时候，你们就知道夏天近了。

chapters.en: Even so, when you see all these things, you know that itis near, right at the door.
chapters.zh: 这样，你们看见这一切的事，也该知道人子近了，正在门口了。

chapters.en: Truly I tell you, this generation will certainly not pass away until all these things have happened.
chapters.zh: 我实在告诉你们，这世代还没有过去，这些事都要成就。

chapters.en: Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will never pass away.
chapters.zh: 天地要废去，我的话却不能废去。

chapters.en: “But about that day or hour no one knows, not even the angels in heaven, nor the Son,but only the Father.
chapters.zh: 但那日子，那时辰，没有人知道，连天上的使者也不知道，子也不知道，惟独父知道。

chapters.en: As it was in the days of Noah, so it will be at the coming of the Son of Man.
chapters.zh: 挪亚的日子怎样，人子降临也要怎样。

chapters.en: For in the days before the flood, people were eating and drinking, marrying and giving in marriage, up to the day Noah entered the ark;
chapters.zh: 当洪水以前的日子，人照常吃喝嫁娶，直到挪亚进方舟的那日。

chapters.en: and they knew nothing about what would happen until the flood came and took them all away. That is how it will be at the coming of the Son of Man.
chapters.zh: 不知不觉洪水来了，把他们全都冲去。人子降临也要这样。

chapters.en: Two men will be in the field; one will be taken and the other left.
chapters.zh: 那时，两个人在田里，取去一个，撇下一个。

chapters.en: Two women will be grinding with a hand mill; one will be taken and the other left.
chapters.zh: 两个女人推磨。取去一个，撇下一个。

chapters.en: “Therefore keep watch, because you do not know on what day your Lord will come.
chapters.zh: 所以你们要儆醒，因为不知道你们的主是哪一天来到。

chapters.en: But understand this: If the owner of the house had known at what time of night the thief was coming, he would have kept watch and would not have let his house be broken into.
chapters.zh: 家主若知道几更天有贼来，就必儆醒，不容人挖透房屋。这是你们所知道的。

chapters.en: So you also must be ready, because the Son of Man will come at an hour when you do not expect him.
chapters.zh: 所以你们也要预备。因为你们想不到的时候，人子就来了。

chapters.en: “Who then is the faithful and wise servant, whom the master has put in charge of the servants in his household to give them their food at the proper time?
chapters.zh: 谁是忠心有见识的仆人，为主人所派，管理家里的人，按时分粮给他们呢？

chapters.en: It will be good for that servant whose master finds him doing so when he returns.
chapters.zh: 主人来到，看见他这样行，那仆人就有福了。

chapters.en: Truly I tell you, he will put him in charge of all his possessions.
chapters.zh: 我实在告诉你们，主人要派他管理一切所有的。

chapters.en: But suppose that servant is wicked and says to himself, ‘My master is staying away a long time,’
chapters.zh: 倘若那恶仆心里说，我的主人必来得迟，

chapters.en: and he then begins to beat his fellow servants and to eat and drink with drunkards.
chapters.zh: 就动手打他的同伴，又和酒醉的人一同吃喝。

chapters.en: The master of that servant will come on a day when he does not expect him and at an hour he is not aware of.
chapters.zh: 在想不到的日子，不知道的时辰，那仆人的主人要来，

chapters.en: He will cut him to pieces and assign him a place with the hypocrites, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
chapters.zh: 重重地处治他，（或作把他腰斩了）定他和假冒为善的人同罪。在那里必要哀哭切齿了。

chapters.en: “At that time the kingdom of heaven will be like ten virgins who took their lamps and went out to meet the bridegroom.
chapters.zh: 那时，天国好比十个童女，拿着灯，出去迎接新郎。

chapters.en: Five of them were foolish and five were wise.
chapters.zh: 其中有五个是愚拙的。五个是聪明的。

chapters.en: The foolish ones took their lamps but did not take any oil with them.
chapters.zh: 愚拙的拿着灯，却不预备油。

chapters.en: The wise ones, however, took oil in jars along with their lamps.
chapters.zh: 聪明的拿着灯，又预备油在器皿里。

chapters.en: The bridegroom was a long time in coming, and they all became drowsy and fell asleep.
chapters.zh: 新郎迟延的时候，她们都打盹睡着了。

chapters.en: “At midnight the cry rang out: ‘Here’s the bridegroom! Come out to meet him!’
chapters.zh: 半夜有人喊着说，新郎来了，你们出来迎接他。

chapters.en: “Then all the virgins woke up and trimmed their lamps.
chapters.zh: 那些童女就都起来收拾灯。

chapters.en: The foolish ones said to the wise, ‘Give us some of your oil; our lamps are going out.’
chapters.zh: 愚拙的对聪明的说，请分点油给我们。因为我们的灯要灭了。

chapters.en: “ ‘No,’ they replied, ‘there may not be enough for both us and you. Instead, go to those who sell oil and buy some for yourselves.’
chapters.zh: 聪明的回答说，恐怕不够你我用的。不如你们自己到卖油的那里去买吧。

chapters.en: “But while they were on their way to buy the oil, the bridegroom arrived. The virgins who were ready went in with him to the wedding banquet. And the door was shut.
chapters.zh: 她们去买的时候，新郎到了。那预备好了的，同他进去坐席。门就关了。

chapters.en: “Later the others also came. ‘Lord, Lord,’ they said, ‘open the door for us!’
chapters.zh: 其余的童女，随后也来了，说，主阿，主阿，给我们开门。

chapters.en: “But he replied, ‘Truly I tell you, I don’t know you.’
chapters.zh: 他却回答说，我实在告诉你们，我不认识你们。

chapters.en: “Therefore keep watch, because you do not know the day or the hour.
chapters.zh: 所以你们要儆醒，因为那日子，那时辰，你们不知道。

chapters.en: “Again, it will be like a man going on a journey, who called his servants and entrusted his wealth to them.
chapters.zh: 天国又好比一个人要往外国去，就叫了仆人来，把他的家业交给他们。

chapters.en: To one he gave five bags of gold, to another two bags, and to another one bag,each according to his ability. Then he went on his journey.
chapters.zh: 按着各人的才干，给他们银子。一个给了五千，一个给了二千，一个给了一千。就往外国去了。

chapters.en: The man who had received five bags of gold went at once and put his money to work and gained five bags more.
chapters.zh: 那领五千的，随即拿去做买卖，另外赚了五千。

chapters.en: So also, the one with two bags of gold gained two more.
chapters.zh: 那领二千的，也照样另赚了二千。

chapters.en: But the man who had received one bag went off, dug a hole in the ground and hid his master’s money.
chapters.zh: 但那领一千的，去掘开地，把主人的银子埋藏了。

chapters.en: “After a long time the master of those servants returned and settled accounts with them.
chapters.zh: 过了许久，那些仆人的主人来了，和他们算账。

chapters.en: The man who had received five bags of gold brought the other five. ‘Master,’ he said, ‘you entrusted me with five bags of gold. See, I have gained five more.’
chapters.zh: 那领五千银子的，又带着那另外的五千来，说，主阿，你交给我五千银子，请看，我又赚了五千。

chapters.en: “His master replied, ‘Well done, good and faithful servant! You have been faithful with a few things; I will put you in charge of many things. Come and share your master’s happiness!’
chapters.zh: 主人说，好，你这又良善又忠心的仆人。你在不多的事上有忠心，我要把许多事派你管理。可以进来享受你主人的快乐。

chapters.en: “The man with two bags of gold also came. ‘Master,’ he said, ‘you entrusted me with two bags of gold; see, I have gained two more.’
chapters.zh: 那领二千的也来说，主阿，你交给我二千银子，请看，我又赚了二千。

chapters.en: “His master replied, ‘Well done, good and faithful servant! You have been faithful with a few things; I will put you in charge of many things. Come and share your master’s happiness!’
chapters.zh: 主人说，好，你这又良善又忠心的仆人。你在不多的事上有忠心，我要把许多事派你管理。可以进来享受你主人的快乐。

chapters.en: “Then the man who had received one bag of gold came. ‘Master,’ he said, ‘I knew that you are a hard man, harvesting where you have not sown and gathering where you have not scattered seed.
chapters.zh: 那领一千的，也来说，主阿，我知道你是忍心的人，没有种的地方要收割，没有散的地方要聚敛。

chapters.en: So I was afraid and went out and hid your gold in the ground. See, here is what belongs to you.’
chapters.zh: 我就害怕，去把你的一千银子埋藏在地里。请看，你的原银子在这里。

chapters.en: “His master replied, ‘You wicked, lazy servant! So you knew that I harvest where I have not sown and gather where I have not scattered seed?
chapters.zh: 主人回答说，你这又恶又懒的仆人，你既知道我没有种的地方要收割，没有散的地方要聚敛。

chapters.en: Well then, you should have put my money on deposit with the bankers, so that when I returned I would have received it back with interest.
chapters.zh: 就当把我的银子放给兑换银钱的人，到我来的时候，可以连本带利收回。

chapters.en: “ ‘So take the bag of gold from him and give it to the one who has ten bags.
chapters.zh: 夺过他这一千来，给那有一万的。

chapters.en: For whoever has will be given more, and they will have an abundance. Whoever does not have, even what they have will be taken from them.
chapters.zh: 因为凡有的，还要加给他，叫他有余。没有的，连他所有的，也要夺过来。

chapters.en: And throw that worthless servant outside, into the darkness, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.’
chapters.zh: 把这无用的仆人，丢在外面黑暗里。在那里必要哀哭切齿了。

chapters.en: “When the Son of Man comes in his glory, and all the angels with him, he will sit on his glorious throne.
chapters.zh: 当人子在他荣耀里同着众天使降临的时候，要坐在他荣耀的宝座上。

chapters.en: All the nations will be gathered before him, and he will separate the people one from another as a shepherd separates the sheep from the goats.
chapters.zh: 万民都要聚集在他面前。他要把他们分别出来，好像牧羊的分别绵羊、山羊一般。

chapters.en: He will put the sheep on his right and the goats on his left.
chapters.zh: 把绵羊安置在右边，山羊在左边。

chapters.en: “Then the King will say to those on his right, ‘Come, you who are blessed by my Father; take your inheritance, the kingdom prepared for you since the creation of the world.
chapters.zh: 于是王要向那右边的说，你们这蒙我父赐福的，可来承受那创世以来为你们所预备的国。

chapters.en: For I was hungry and you gave me something to eat, I was thirsty and you gave me something to drink, I was a stranger and you invited me in,
chapters.zh: 因为我饿了，你们给我吃。渴了，你们给我喝。我作客旅，你们留我住。

chapters.en: I needed clothes and you clothed me, I was sick and you looked after me, I was in prison and you came to visit me.’
chapters.zh: 我赤身露体，你们给我穿。我病了，你们看顾我。我在监里，你们来看我。

chapters.en: “Then the righteous will answer him, ‘Lord, when did we see you hungry and feed you, or thirsty and give you something to drink?
chapters.zh: 义人就回答说，主阿，我们什么时候见你饿了给你吃，渴了给你喝？

chapters.en: When did we see you a stranger and invite you in, or needing clothes and clothe you?
chapters.zh: 什么时候见你作客旅留你住，或是赤身露体给你穿？

chapters.en: When did we see you sick or in prison and go to visit you?’
chapters.zh: 又什么时候见你病了，或是在监里，来看你呢？

chapters.en: “The King will reply, ‘Truly I tell you, whatever you did for one of the least of these brothers and sisters of mine, you did for me.’
chapters.zh: 王要回答说，我实在告诉你们，这些事你们既作在我这弟兄中一个最小的身上，就是作在我身上了。

chapters.en: “Then he will say to those on his left, ‘Depart from me, you who are cursed, into the eternal fire prepared for the devil and his angels.
chapters.zh: 王又要向那左边的说，你们这被咒诅的人，离开我，进入那为魔鬼和他的使者所预备的永火里去。

chapters.en: For I was hungry and you gave me nothing to eat, I was thirsty and you gave me nothing to drink,
chapters.zh: 因为我饿了，你们不给我吃。渴了，你们不给我喝。

chapters.en: I was a stranger and you did not invite me in, I needed clothes and you did not clothe me, I was sick and in prison and you did not look after me.’
chapters.zh: 我作客旅，你们不留我住。我赤身露体，你们不给我穿。我病了，我在监里，你们不来看顾我。

chapters.en: “They also will answer, ‘Lord, when did we see you hungry or thirsty or a stranger or needing clothes or sick or in prison, and did not help you?’
chapters.zh: 他们也要回答说，主阿，我们什么时候见你饿了，或渴了，或作客旅，或赤身露体，或病了，或在监里，不伺候你呢？

chapters.en: “He will reply, ‘Truly I tell you, whatever you did not do for one of the least of these, you did not do for me.’
chapters.zh: 王要回答说，我实在告诉你们，这些事你们既不作在我这弟兄中一个最小的身上，就是不作在我身上了。

chapters.en: “Then they will go away to eternal punishment, but the righteous to eternal life.”
chapters.zh: 这些人要往永刑里去。那些义人要往永生里去。

chapters.en: When Jesus had finished saying all these things, he said to his disciples,
chapters.zh: 耶稣说完了这一切的话，就对门徒说，

chapters.en: “As you know, the Passover is two days away—and the Son of Man will be handed over to be crucified.”
chapters.zh: 你们知道过两天是逾越节，人子将要被交给人，钉在十字架上。

chapters.en: Then the chief priests and the elders of the people assembled in the palace of the high priest, whose name was Caiaphas,
chapters.zh: 那时，祭司长和民间的长老，聚集在大祭司称为该亚法的院里。

chapters.en: and they schemed to arrest Jesus secretly and kill him.
chapters.zh: 大家商议，要用诡计拿住耶稣杀他。

chapters.en: “But not during the festival,” they said, “or there may be a riot among the people.”
chapters.zh: 只是说，当节的日子不可，恐怕民间生乱。

chapters.en: While Jesus was in Bethany in the home of Simon the Leper,
chapters.zh: 耶稣在伯大尼长大麻疯的西门家里，

chapters.en: a woman came to him with an alabaster jar of very expensive perfume, which she poured on his head as he was reclining at the table.
chapters.zh: 有一个女人，拿着一玉瓶极贵的香膏来，趁耶稣坐席的时候，浇在他的头上。

chapters.en: When the disciples saw this, they were indignant. “Why this waste?” they asked.
chapters.zh: 门徒看见，就很不喜悦，说，何用这样的枉费呢？

chapters.en: “This perfume could have been sold at a high price and the money given to the poor.”
chapters.zh: 这香膏可以卖许多钱，周济穷人。

chapters.en: Aware of this, Jesus said to them, “Why are you bothering this woman? She has done a beautiful thing to me.
chapters.zh: 耶稣看出他们的意思，就说，为什么难为这女人呢？她在我身上作的，是一件美事。

chapters.en: The poor you will always have with you,but you will not always have me.
chapters.zh: 因为常有穷人和你们同在。只是你们不常有我。

chapters.en: When she poured this perfume on my body, she did it to prepare me for burial.
chapters.zh: 她将这香膏浇在我身上，是为我安葬作的。

chapters.en: Truly I tell you, wherever this gospel is preached throughout the world, what she has done will also be told, in memory of her.”
chapters.zh: 我实在告诉你们，普天之下，无论在什么地方传这福音，也要述说这女人所行的，作个纪念。

chapters.en: Then one of the Twelve—the one called Judas Iscariot—went to the chief priests
chapters.zh: 当下，十二门徒里，有一个称为加略人犹大的，去见祭司长说，

chapters.en: and asked, “What are you willing to give me if I deliver him over to you?” So they counted out for him thirty pieces of silver.
chapters.zh: 我把他交给你们，你们愿意给我多少钱。他们就给了他三十块钱。

chapters.en: From then on Judas watched for an opportunity to hand him over.
chapters.zh: 从那时候，他就找机会，要把耶稣交给他们。

chapters.en: On the first day of the Festival of Unleavened Bread, the disciples came to Jesus and asked, “Where do you want us to make preparations for you to eat the Passover?”
chapters.zh: 除酵节的第一天，门徒来问耶稣说，你吃逾越节的筵席，要我们在哪里给你预备？

chapters.en: He replied, “Go into the city to a certain man and tell him, ‘The Teacher says: My appointed time is near. I am going to celebrate the Passover with my disciples at your house.’ ”
chapters.zh: 耶稣说，你们进城去，到某人那里，对他说，夫子说，我的时候快到了。我与门徒要在你家里守逾越节。

chapters.en: So the disciples did as Jesus had directed them and prepared the Passover.
chapters.zh: 门徒遵着耶稣所吩咐的就去预备了逾越节的筵席。

chapters.en: When evening came, Jesus was reclining at the table with the Twelve.
chapters.zh: 到了晚上，耶稣和十二个门徒坐席。

chapters.en: And while they were eating, he said, “Truly I tell you, one of you will betray me.”
chapters.zh: 正吃的时候，耶稣说，我实在告诉你们，你们中间有一个人要卖我了。

chapters.en: They were very sad and began to say to him one after the other, “Surely you don’t mean me, Lord?”
chapters.zh: 他们就甚忧愁，一个一个地问他说，主，是我吗？

chapters.en: Jesus replied, “The one who has dipped his hand into the bowl with me will betray me.
chapters.zh: 耶稣回答说，同我蘸手在盘子里的，就是他要卖我。

chapters.en: The Son of Man will go just as it is written about him. But woe to that man who betrays the Son of Man! It would be better for him if he had not been born.”
chapters.zh: 人子必要去世，正如经上指着他所写的，但卖人子的人有祸了。那人不生在世上倒好。

chapters.en: Then Judas, the one who would betray him, said, “Surely you don’t mean me, Rabbi?” Jesus answered, “You have said so.”
chapters.zh: 卖耶稣的犹大问他说，拉比，是我吗？耶稣说，你说的是。

chapters.en: While they were eating, Jesus took bread, and when he had given thanks, he broke it and gave it to his disciples, saying, “Take and eat; this is my body.”
chapters.zh: 他们吃的时候，耶稣拿起饼来，祝福，就掰开，递给门徒，说，你们拿着吃，这是我的身体。

chapters.en: Then he took a cup, and when he had given thanks, he gave it to them, saying, “Drink from it, all of you.
chapters.zh: 又拿起杯来，祝谢了，递给他们，说，你们都喝这个。

chapters.en: This is my blood of the covenant, which is poured out for many for the forgiveness of sins.
chapters.zh: 因为这是我立约的血，为多人流出来，使罪得赦。

chapters.en: I tell you, I will not drink from this fruit of the vine from now on until that day when I drink it new with you in my Father’s kingdom.”
chapters.zh: 但我告诉你们，从今以后，我不再喝这葡萄汁，直到我在我父的国里，同你们喝新的那日子。

chapters.en: When they had sung a hymn, they went out to the Mount of Olives.
chapters.zh: 他们唱了诗，就出来往橄榄山去。

chapters.en: Then Jesus told them, “This very night you will all fall away on account of me, for it is written: “ ‘I will strike the shepherd, and the sheep of the flock will be scattered.’
chapters.zh: 那时，耶稣对他们说，今夜你们为我的缘故，都要跌倒。因为经上记着说，我要击打牧人，羊就分散了。

chapters.en: But after I have risen, I will go ahead of you into Galilee.”
chapters.zh: 但我复活以后，要在你们以先往加利利去。

chapters.en: Peter replied, “Even if all fall away on account of you, I never will.”
chapters.zh: 彼得说，众人虽然为你的缘故跌倒，我却永不跌倒。

chapters.en: “Truly I tell you,” Jesus answered, “this very night, before the rooster crows, you will disown me three times.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣说，我实在告诉你，今夜鸡叫以先，你要三次不认我。

chapters.en: But Peter declared, “Even if I have to die with you, I will never disown you.” And all the other disciples said the same.
chapters.zh: 彼得说，我就是必须和你同死，也总不能不认你。众门徒都是这样说。

chapters.en: Then Jesus went with his disciples to a place called Gethsemane, and he said to them, “Sit here while I go over there and pray.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣同门徒来到一个地方，名叫客西马尼，就对他们说，你们坐在这里，等我到那边去祷告。

chapters.en: He took Peter and the two sons of Zebedee along with him, and he began to be sorrowful and troubled.
chapters.zh: 于是带着彼得，和西庇太的两个儿子同去，就忧愁起来，极其难过。

chapters.en: Then he said to them, “My soul is overwhelmed with sorrow to the point of death. Stay here and keep watch with me.”
chapters.zh: 便对他们说，我心里甚是忧伤，几乎要死。你们在这里等候，和我一同儆醒。

chapters.en: Going a little farther, he fell with his face to the ground and prayed, “My Father, if it is possible, may this cup be taken from me. Yet not as I will, but as you will.”
chapters.zh: 他就稍往前走，俯伏在地祷告说，我父阿，倘若可行，求你叫这杯离开我。然而不要照我的意思，只要照你的意思。

chapters.en: Then he returned to his disciples and found them sleeping. “Couldn’t you men keep watch with me for one hour?” he asked Peter.
chapters.zh: 来到门徒那里，见他们睡着了，就对彼得说，怎么样，你们不能同我儆醒片时吗？

chapters.en: “Watch and pray so that you will not fall into temptation. The spirit is willing, but the flesh is weak.”
chapters.zh: 总要儆醒祷告，免得入了迷惑。你们心灵固然愿意，肉体却软弱了。

chapters.en: He went away a second time and prayed, “My Father, if it is not possible for this cup to be taken away unless I drink it, may your will be done.”
chapters.zh: 第二次又去祷告说，我父阿，这杯若不能离开我，必要我喝，就愿你的意旨成全。

chapters.en: When he came back, he again found them sleeping, because their eyes were heavy.
chapters.zh: 又来见他们睡着了，因为他们的眼睛困倦。

chapters.en: So he left them and went away once more and prayed the third time, saying the same thing.
chapters.zh: 耶稣又离开他们去了。第三次祷告，说的话还是与先前一样。

chapters.en: Then he returned to the disciples and said to them, “Are you still sleeping and resting? Look, the hour has come, and the Son of Man is delivered into the hands of sinners.
chapters.zh: 于是来到门徒那里，对他们说，现在你们仍然睡觉安歇吧。（吧或作吗）时候到了，人子被卖在罪人手里了。

chapters.en: Rise! Let us go! Here comes my betrayer!”
chapters.zh: 起来，我们走吧。看哪，卖我的人近了。

chapters.en: While he was still speaking, Judas, one of the Twelve, arrived. With him was a large crowd armed with swords and clubs, sent from the chief priests and the elders of the people.
chapters.zh: 说话之间，那十二个门徒里的犹大来了，并有许多人，带着刀棒，从祭司长和民间的长老那里，与他同来。

chapters.en: Now the betrayer had arranged a signal with them: “The one I kiss is the man; arrest him.”
chapters.zh: 那卖耶稣的，给了他们一个暗号，说，我与谁亲嘴，谁就是他。你们可以拿住他。

chapters.en: Going at once to Jesus, Judas said, “Greetings, Rabbi!” and kissed him.
chapters.zh: 犹大随即到耶稣跟前说，请拉比安。就与他亲嘴。

chapters.en: Jesus replied, “Do what you came for, friend.”Then the men stepped forward, seized Jesus and arrested him.
chapters.zh: 耶稣对他说，朋友，你来要作的事，就作吧。于是那些人上前，下手拿住耶稣。

chapters.en: With that, one of Jesus’ companions reached for his sword, drew it out and struck the servant of the high priest, cutting off his ear.
chapters.zh: 有跟随耶稣的一个人，伸手拔出刀来，将大祭司的仆人砍了一刀，削掉了他一个耳朵。

chapters.en: “Put your sword back in its place,” Jesus said to him, “for all who draw the sword will die by the sword.
chapters.zh: 耶稣对他说，收刀入鞘吧。凡动刀的，必死在刀下。

chapters.en: Do you think I cannot call on my Father, and he will at once put at my disposal more than twelve legions of angels?
chapters.zh: 你想我不能求我父，现在为我差遣十二营多天使来吗？

chapters.en: But how then would the Scriptures be fulfilled that say it must happen in this way?”
chapters.zh: 若是这样，经上所说，事情必须如此的话，怎么应验呢？

chapters.en: In that hour Jesus said to the crowd, “Am I leading a rebellion, that you have come out with swords and clubs to capture me? Every day I sat in the temple courts teaching, and you did not arrest me.
chapters.zh: 当时，耶稣对众人说，你们带着刀棒，出来拿我，如同拿强盗吗？我天天坐在殿里教训人，你们并没有拿我。

chapters.en: But this has all taken place that the writings of the prophets might be fulfilled.” Then all the disciples deserted him and fled.
chapters.zh: 但这一切的事成就了，为要应验先知书上的话。当下门徒都离开他逃走了。

chapters.en: Those who had arrested Jesus took him to Caiaphas the high priest, where the teachers of the law and the elders had assembled.
chapters.zh: 拿耶稣的人，把他带到大祭司该亚法那里去。文士和长老，已经在那里聚会。

chapters.en: But Peter followed him at a distance, right up to the courtyard of the high priest. He entered and sat down with the guards to see the outcome.
chapters.zh: 彼得远远地跟着耶稣，直到大祭司的院子，进到里面，就和差役同坐，要看这事到底怎样。

chapters.en: The chief priests and the whole Sanhedrin were looking for false evidence against Jesus so that they could put him to death.
chapters.zh: 祭司长和全公会，寻找假见证，控告耶稣，要治死他。

chapters.en: But they did not find any, though many false witnesses came forward. Finally two came forward
chapters.zh: 虽有好些人来作假见证，总得不着实据。末后有两个人前来说，

chapters.en: and declared, “This fellow said, ‘I am able to destroy the temple of God and rebuild it in three days.’ ”
chapters.zh: 这个人曾说，我能拆毁神的殿，三日内又建造起来。

chapters.en: Then the high priest stood up and said to Jesus, “Are you not going to answer? What is this testimony that these men are bringing against you?”
chapters.zh: 大祭司就站起来，对耶稣说，你什么都不回答吗？这些人作见证告你的是什么呢？

chapters.en: But Jesus remained silent. The high priest said to him, “I charge you under oath by the living God: Tell us if you are the Messiah, the Son of God.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣却不言语。大祭司对他说，我指着永生神，叫你起誓告诉我们，你是神的儿子基督不是。

chapters.en: “You have said so,” Jesus replied. “But I say to all of you: From now on you will see the Son of Man sitting at the right hand of the Mighty One and coming on the clouds of heaven.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣对他说，你说的是。然而我告诉你们，后来你们要看见人子，坐在那权能者的右边，驾着天上的云降临。

chapters.en: Then the high priest tore his clothes and said, “He has spoken blasphemy! Why do we need any more witnesses? Look, now you have heard the blasphemy.
chapters.zh: 大祭司就撕开衣服说，他说了僭妄的话，我们何必再用见证人呢？这僭妄的话，现在你们都听见了。

chapters.en: What do you think?” “He is worthy of death,” they answered.
chapters.zh: 你们的意见如何？他们回答说，他是该死的。

chapters.en: Then they spit in his face and struck him with their fists. Others slapped him
chapters.zh: 他们就吐唾沫在他脸上，用拳头打他。也有用手掌打他的，说，

chapters.en: and said, “Prophesy to us, Messiah. Who hit you?”
chapters.zh: 基督阿，你是先知，告诉我们打你的是谁。

chapters.en: Now Peter was sitting out in the courtyard, and a servant girl came to him. “You also were with Jesus of Galilee,” she said.
chapters.zh: 彼得在外面院子里坐着，有一个使女前来说，你素来也是同那加利利人耶稣一伙的。

chapters.en: But he denied it before them all. “I don’t know what you’re talking about,” he said.
chapters.zh: 彼得在众人面前却不承认，说，我不知道你说的是什么。

chapters.en: Then he went out to the gateway, where another servant girl saw him and said to the people there, “This fellow was with Jesus of Nazareth.”
chapters.zh: 既出去，到了门口，又有一个使女看见他，就对那里的人说，这个人也是同拿撒勒人耶稣一伙的。

chapters.en: He denied it again, with an oath: “I don’t know the man!”
chapters.zh: 彼得又不承认，并且起誓说，我不认得那个人。

chapters.en: After a little while, those standing there went up to Peter and said, “Surely you are one of them; your accent gives you away.”
chapters.zh: 过了不多的时候，旁边站着的人前来，对彼得说，你真是他们一党的。你的口音把你露出来了。

chapters.en: Then he began to call down curses, and he swore to them, “I don’t know the man!” Immediately a rooster crowed.
chapters.zh: 彼得就发咒起誓地说，我不认得那个人。立时鸡就叫了。

chapters.en: Then Peter remembered the word Jesus had spoken: “Before the rooster crows, you will disown me three times.” And he went outside and wept bitterly.
chapters.zh: 彼得想起耶稣所说的话，鸡叫以先，你要三次不认我。他就出去痛哭。

chapters.en: Early in the morning, all the chief priests and the elders of the people made their plans how to have Jesus executed.
chapters.zh: 到了早晨，众祭司长和民间的长老，大家商议，要治死耶稣。

chapters.en: So they bound him, led him away and handed him over to Pilate the governor.
chapters.zh: 就把他捆绑解去交给巡抚彼拉多。

chapters.en: When Judas, who had betrayed him, saw that Jesus was condemned, he was seized with remorse and returned the thirty pieces of silver to the chief priests and the elders.
chapters.zh: 这时候，卖耶稣的犹大，看见耶稣已经定了罪，就后悔，把那三十块钱，拿回来给祭司长和长老说，

chapters.en: “I have sinned,” he said, “for I have betrayed innocent blood.” “What is that to us?” they replied. “That’s your responsibility.”
chapters.zh: 我卖了无辜之人的血，是有罪了。他们说，那与我们有什么相干？你自己承当吧。

chapters.en: So Judas threw the money into the temple and left. Then he went away and hanged himself.
chapters.zh: 犹大就把那银钱丢在殿里，出去吊死了。

chapters.en: The chief priests picked up the coins and said, “It is against the law to put this into the treasury, since it is blood money.”
chapters.zh: 祭司长拾起银钱来说，这是血价，不可放在库里。

chapters.en: So they decided to use the money to buy the potter’s field as a burial place for foreigners.
chapters.zh: 他们商议，就用那银钱买了窑户的一块田，为要埋葬外乡人。

chapters.en: That is why it has been called the Field of Blood to this day.
chapters.zh: 所以那块田，直到今日还叫作血田。

chapters.en: Then what was spoken by Jeremiah the prophet was fulfilled: “They took the thirty pieces of silver, the price set on him by the people of Israel,
chapters.zh: 这就应了先知耶利米的话，说，他们用那三十块钱，就是被估定之人的价钱，是以色列人中所估定的，

chapters.en: and they used them to buy the potter’s field, as the Lord commanded me.”
chapters.zh: 买了窑户的一块田。这是照着主所吩咐我的。

chapters.en: Meanwhile Jesus stood before the governor, and the governor asked him, “Are you the king of the Jews?” “You have said so,” Jesus replied.
chapters.zh: 耶稣站在巡抚面前，巡抚问他说，你是犹太人的王吗？耶稣说，你说的是。

chapters.en: When he was accused by the chief priests and the elders, he gave no answer.
chapters.zh: 他被祭司长和长老控告的时候什么都不回答。

chapters.en: Then Pilate asked him, “Don’t you hear the testimony they are bringing against you?”
chapters.zh: 彼拉多就对他说，他们作见证，告你这么多的事，你没有听见吗？

chapters.en: But Jesus made no reply, not even to a single charge—to the great amazement of the governor.
chapters.zh: 耶稣仍不回答，连一句话也不说，以致巡抚甚觉希奇。

chapters.en: Now it was the governor’s custom at the festival to release a prisoner chosen by the crowd.
chapters.zh: 巡抚有一个常例，每逢这节期，随众人所要的，释放一个囚犯给他们。

chapters.en: At that time they had a well-known prisoner whose name was Jesus Barabbas.
chapters.zh: 当时，有一个出名的囚犯叫巴拉巴。

chapters.en: So when the crowd had gathered, Pilate asked them, “Which one do you want me to release to you: Jesus Barabbas, or Jesus who is called the Messiah?”
chapters.zh: 众人聚集的时候，彼拉多就对他们说，你们要我释放哪一个给你们？是巴拉巴呢？是称为基督的耶稣呢？

chapters.en: For he knew it was out of self-interest that they had handed Jesus over to him.
chapters.zh: 巡抚原知道，他们是因为嫉妒才把他解了来。

chapters.en: While Pilate was sitting on the judge’s seat, his wife sent him this message: “Don’t have anything to do with that innocent man, for I have suffered a great deal today in a dream because of him.”
chapters.zh: 正坐堂的时候，他的夫人打发人来说，这义人的事，你一点不可管。因为我今天在梦中，为他受了许多的苦。

chapters.en: But the chief priests and the elders persuaded the crowd to ask for Barabbas and to have Jesus executed.
chapters.zh: 祭司长和长老，挑唆众人，求释放巴拉巴，除灭耶稣。

chapters.en: “Which of the two do you want me to release to you?” asked the governor. “Barabbas,” they answered.
chapters.zh: 巡抚对众人说，这两个人，你们要我释放哪一个给你们呢？他们说，巴拉巴。

chapters.en: “What shall I do, then, with Jesus who is called the Messiah?” Pilate asked. They all answered, “Crucify him!”
chapters.zh: 彼拉多说，这样，那称为基督的耶稣，我怎么办他呢？他们都说，把他钉十字架。

chapters.en: “Why? What crime has he committed?” asked Pilate. But they shouted all the louder, “Crucify him!”
chapters.zh: 巡抚说，为什么呢？他作了什么恶事呢？他们便极力地喊着说，把他钉十字架。

chapters.en: When Pilate saw that he was getting nowhere, but that instead an uproar was starting, he took water and washed his hands in front of the crowd. “I am innocent of this man’s blood,” he said. “It is your responsibility!”
chapters.zh: 彼拉多见说也无济于事，反要生乱，就拿水在众人面前洗手，说，流这义人的血，罪不在我，你们承当吧。

chapters.en: All the people answered, “His blood is on us and on our children!”
chapters.zh: 众人都回答说，他的血归到我们，和我们的子孙身上。

chapters.en: Then he released Barabbas to them. But he had Jesus flogged, and handed him over to be crucified.
chapters.zh: 于是彼拉多释放巴拉巴给他们，把耶稣鞭打了，交给人钉十字架。

chapters.en: Then the governor’s soldiers took Jesus into the Praetorium and gathered the whole company of soldiers around him.
chapters.zh: 巡抚的兵就把耶稣带进衙门，叫全营的兵都聚集在他那里。

chapters.en: They stripped him and put a scarlet robe on him,
chapters.zh: 他们给他脱了衣服，穿上一件朱红色袍子。

chapters.en: and then twisted together a crown of thorns and set it on his head. They put a staff in his right hand. Then they knelt in front of him and mocked him. “Hail, king of the Jews!” they said.
chapters.zh: 用荆棘编作冠冕，戴在他头上，拿一根苇子放在他右手里。跪在他面前戏弄他说，恭喜犹太人的王阿。

chapters.en: They spit on him, and took the staff and struck him on the head again and again.
chapters.zh: 又吐唾沫在他脸上，拿苇子打他的头。

chapters.en: After they had mocked him, they took off the robe and put his own clothes on him. Then they led him away to crucify him.
chapters.zh: 戏弄完了，就给他脱了袍子，仍穿上他自己的衣服，带他出去，要钉十字架。

chapters.en: As they were going out, they met a man from Cyrene, named Simon, and they forced him to carry the cross.
chapters.zh: 他们出来的时候，遇见一个古利奈人，名叫西门，就勉强他同去，好背着耶稣的十字架。

chapters.en: They came to a place called Golgotha (which means “the place of the skull”).
chapters.zh: 到了一个地方，名叫各各他，意思就是髑髅地。

chapters.en: There they offered Jesus wine to drink, mixed with gall; but after tasting it, he refused to drink it.
chapters.zh: 兵丁拿苦胆调和的酒，给耶稣喝。他尝了，就不肯喝。

chapters.en: When they had crucified him, they divided up his clothes by casting lots.
chapters.zh: 他们既将他钉在十字架上，就拈阄分他的衣服。

chapters.en: And sitting down, they kept watch over him there.
chapters.zh: 又坐在那里看守他。

chapters.en: Above his head they placed the written charge against him: THIS IS JESUS, THE KING OF THE JEWS.
chapters.zh: 在他头以上，安一个牌子，写着他的罪状，说，这是犹太人的王耶稣。

chapters.en: Two rebels were crucified with him, one on his right and one on his left.
chapters.zh: 当时，有两个强盗，和他同钉十字架，一个在右边，一个在左边。

chapters.en: Those who passed by hurled insults at him, shaking their heads
chapters.zh: 从那里经过的人，讥诮他，摇着头说，

chapters.en: and saying, “You who are going to destroy the temple and build it in three days, save yourself! Come down from the cross, if you are the Son of God!”
chapters.zh: 你这拆毁圣殿，三日又建造起来的，可以救自己吧。你如果是神的儿子，就从十字架上下来吧。

chapters.en: In the same way the chief priests, the teachers of the law and the elders mocked him.
chapters.zh: 祭司长和文士并长老，也是这样戏弄他，说，

chapters.en: “He saved others,” they said, “but he can’t save himself! He’s the king of Israel! Let him come down now from the cross, and we will believe in him.
chapters.zh: 他救了别人，不能救自己。他是以色列的王，现在可以从十字架上下来，我们就信他。

chapters.en: He trusts in God. Let God rescue him now if he wants him, for he said, ‘I am the Son of God.’ ”
chapters.zh: 他倚靠神，神若喜悦他，现在可以救他。因为他曾说，我是神的儿子。

chapters.en: In the same way the rebels who were crucified with him also heaped insults on him.
chapters.zh: 那和他同钉的强盗，也是这样的讥诮他。

chapters.en: From noon until three in the afternoon darkness came over all the land.
chapters.zh: 从午正到申初，遍地都黑暗了。

chapters.en: About three in the afternoon Jesus cried out in a loud voice, “Eli, Eli,lemasabachthani?” (which means “My God, my God, why have you forsaken me?”).
chapters.zh: 约在申初，耶稣大声喊着说，以利，以利，拉马撒巴各大尼？就是说，我的神，我的神，为什么离弃我？

chapters.en: When some of those standing there heard this, they said, “He’s calling Elijah.”
chapters.zh: 站在那里的人，有的听见就说，这个人呼叫以利亚呢。

chapters.en: Immediately one of them ran and got a sponge. He filled it with wine vinegar, put it on a staff, and offered it to Jesus to drink.
chapters.zh: 内中有一个人，赶紧跑去，拿海绒蘸满了醋，绑在苇子上，送给他喝。

chapters.en: The rest said, “Now leave him alone. Let’s see if Elijah comes to save him.”
chapters.zh: 其余的人说，且等着，看以利亚来救他不来。

chapters.en: And when Jesus had cried out again in a loud voice, he gave up his spirit.
chapters.zh: 耶稣又大声喊叫，气就断了。

chapters.en: At that moment the curtain of the temple was torn in two from top to bottom. The earth shook, the rocks split
chapters.zh: 忽然殿里的幔子，从上到下裂为两半。地也震动。磐石也崩裂。

chapters.en: and the tombs broke open. The bodies of many holy people who had died were raised to life.
chapters.zh: 坟墓也开了。已睡圣徒的身体，多有起来的。

chapters.en: They came out of the tombs after Jesus’ resurrection and went into the holy city and appeared to many people.
chapters.zh: 到耶稣复活以后，他们从坟墓里出来，进了圣城，向许多人显现。

chapters.en: When the centurion and those with him who were guarding Jesus saw the earthquake and all that had happened, they were terrified, and exclaimed, “Surely he was the Son of God!”
chapters.zh: 百夫长和一同看守耶稣的人，看见地震，并所经历的事，就极其害怕，说，这真是神的儿子了。

chapters.en: Many women were there, watching from a distance. They had followed Jesus from Galilee to care for his needs.
chapters.zh: 有好些妇女在那里远远地观看。她们是从加利利跟随耶稣来服事他的。

chapters.en: Among them were Mary Magdalene, Mary the mother of James and Joseph, and the mother of Zebedee’s sons.
chapters.zh: 内中有抹大拉的马利亚，又有雅各和约西的母亲马利亚，并有西庇太两个儿子的母亲。

chapters.en: As evening approached, there came a rich man from Arimathea, named Joseph, who had himself become a disciple of Jesus.
chapters.zh: 到了晚上，有一个财主，名叫约瑟，是亚利马太来的。他也是耶稣的门徒。

chapters.en: Going to Pilate, he asked for Jesus’ body, and Pilate ordered that it be given to him.
chapters.zh: 这人去见彼拉多，求耶稣的身体。彼拉多就吩咐给他。

chapters.en: Joseph took the body, wrapped it in a clean linen cloth,
chapters.zh: 约瑟取了身体，用干净细麻布裹好，

chapters.en: and placed it in his own new tomb that he had cut out of the rock. He rolled a big stone in front of the entrance to the tomb and went away.
chapters.zh: 安放在自己的新坟墓里，就是他凿在磐石里的。他又把大石头滚到墓门口，就去了。

chapters.en: Mary Magdalene and the other Mary were sitting there opposite the tomb.
chapters.zh: 有抹大拉的马利亚，和那个马利亚在那里，对着坟墓坐着。

chapters.en: The next day, the one after Preparation Day, the chief priests and the Pharisees went to Pilate.
chapters.zh: 次日，就是预备日的第二天，祭司长和法利赛人聚集，来见彼拉多，说，

chapters.en: “Sir,” they said, “we remember that while he was still alive that deceiver said, ‘After three days I will rise again.’
chapters.zh: 大人，我们记得那诱惑人的，还活着的时候，曾说，三日后我要复活。

chapters.en: So give the order for the tomb to be made secure until the third day. Otherwise, his disciples may come and steal the body and tell the people that he has been raised from the dead. This last deception will be worse than the first.”
chapters.zh: 因此，请吩咐人将坟墓把守妥当，直到第三日。恐怕他的门徒来把他偷了去，就告诉百姓说，他从死里复活了。这样，那后来的迷惑，比先前的更利害了。

chapters.en: “Take a guard,” Pilate answered. “Go, make the tomb as secure as you know how.”
chapters.zh: 彼拉多说，你们有看守的兵。去吧，尽你们所能的，把守妥当。

chapters.en: So they went and made the tomb secure by putting a seal on the stone and posting the guard.
chapters.zh: 他们就带着看守的兵同去，封了石头，将坟墓把守妥当。

chapters.en: After the Sabbath, at dawn on the first day of the week, Mary Magdalene and the other Mary went to look at the tomb.
chapters.zh: 安息日将尽，七日的头一日，天快亮的时候，抹大拉的马利亚，和那个马利亚，来看坟墓。

chapters.en: There was a violent earthquake, for an angel of the Lord came down from heaven and, going to the tomb, rolled back the stone and sat on it.
chapters.zh: 忽然地大震动。因为有主的使者，从天上下来，把石头滚开，坐在上面。

chapters.en: His appearance was like lightning, and his clothes were white as snow.
chapters.zh: 他的像貌如同闪电，衣服洁白如雪。

chapters.en: The guards were so afraid of him that they shook and became like dead men.
chapters.zh: 看守的人，就因他吓得浑身乱战，甚至和死人一样。

chapters.en: The angel said to the women, “Do not be afraid, for I know that you are looking for Jesus, who was crucified.
chapters.zh: 天使对妇女说，不要害怕，我知道你们是寻找那钉十字架的耶稣。

chapters.en: He is not here; he has risen, just as he said. Come and see the place where he lay.
chapters.zh: 他不在这里，照他所说的，已经复活了。你们来看安放主的地方。

chapters.en: Then go quickly and tell his disciples: ‘He has risen from the dead and is going ahead of you into Galilee. There you will see him.’ Now I have told you.”
chapters.zh: 快去告诉他的门徒，说他从死里复活了，并且在你们以先往加利利去，在那里你们要见他。看哪，我已经告诉你们了。

chapters.en: So the women hurried away from the tomb, afraid yet filled with joy, and ran to tell his disciples.
chapters.zh: 妇女们就急忙离开坟墓，又害怕，又大大地欢喜，跑去要报给他的门徒。

chapters.en: Suddenly Jesus met them. “Greetings,” he said. They came to him, clasped his feet and worshiped him.
chapters.zh: 忽然耶稣遇见她们，说，愿你们平安。她们就上前抱住他的脚拜他。

chapters.en: Then Jesus said to them, “Do not be afraid. Go and tell my brothers to go to Galilee; there they will see me.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣对她们说，不要害怕，你们去告诉我的弟兄，叫他们往加利利去，在那里必见我。

chapters.en: While the women were on their way, some of the guards went into the city and reported to the chief priests everything that had happened.
chapters.zh: 他们去的时候，看守的兵，有几个进城去，将所经历的事，都报给祭司长。

chapters.en: When the chief priests had met with the elders and devised a plan, they gave the soldiers a large sum of money,
chapters.zh: 祭司长和长老聚集商议，就拿许多银钱给兵丁说，

chapters.en: telling them, “You are to say, ‘His disciples came during the night and stole him away while we were asleep.’
chapters.zh: 你们要这样说，夜间我们睡觉的时候，他的门徒来把他偷去了。

chapters.en: If this report gets to the governor, we will satisfy him and keep you out of trouble.”
chapters.zh: 倘若这话被巡抚听见，有我们劝他，保你们无事。

chapters.en: So the soldiers took the money and did as they were instructed. And this story has been widely circulated among the Jews to this very day.
chapters.zh: 兵丁受了银钱，就照所嘱咐他们的去行。这话就传说在犹太人中间，直到今日。

chapters.en: Then the eleven disciples went to Galilee, to the mountain where Jesus had told them to go.
chapters.zh: 十一个门徒往加利利去，到了耶稣约定的山上。

chapters.en: When they saw him, they worshiped him; but some doubted.
chapters.zh: 他们见了耶稣就拜他。然而还有人疑惑。

chapters.en: Then Jesus came to them and said, “All authority in heaven and on earth has been given to me.
chapters.zh: 耶稣进前来，对他们说，天上，地下所有的权柄，都赐给我了。

chapters.en: Therefore go and make disciples of all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit,
chapters.zh: 所以你们要去，使万民作我的门徒，奉父子圣灵的名，给他们施洗。（或作给他们施洗归于父子圣灵的名）

chapters.en: and teaching them to obey everything I have commanded you. And surely I am with you always, to the very end of the age.”
chapters.zh: 凡我所吩咐你们的，都教训他们遵守，我就常与你们同在，直到世界的末了。

chapters.en: The beginning of the good news about Jesus the Messiah, the Son of God,
chapters.zh: 神的儿子，耶稣基督福音的起头，

chapters.en: as it is written in Isaiah the prophet: “I will send my messenger ahead of you, who will prepare your way” —
chapters.zh: 正如先知以赛亚书上记着说，（有古卷无以赛亚三字）看哪，我要差遣我的使者在你前面，预备道路。

chapters.en: “a voice of one calling in the wilderness, ‘Prepare the way for the Lord, make straight paths for him.’ ”
chapters.zh: 在旷野有人声喊着说，预备主的道，修直他的路。

chapters.en: And so John the Baptist appeared in the wilderness, preaching a baptism of repentance for the forgiveness of sins.
chapters.zh: 照这话，约翰来了，在旷野施洗，传悔改的洗礼，使罪得赦。

chapters.en: The whole Judean countryside and all the people of Jerusalem went out to him. Confessing their sins, they were baptized by him in the Jordan River.
chapters.zh: 犹太全地，和耶路撒冷的人，都出去到约翰那里，承认他们的罪，在约但河里受他的洗。

chapters.en: John wore clothing made of camel’s hair, with a leather belt around his waist, and he ate locusts and wild honey.
chapters.zh: 约翰穿骆驼毛的衣服，腰束皮带，吃的是蝗虫野蜜。

chapters.en: And this was his message: “After me comes the one more powerful than I, the straps of whose sandals I am not worthy to stoop down and untie.
chapters.zh: 他传道说，有一位在我以后来的，能力比我更大，我就是弯腰给他解鞋带，也是不配的。

chapters.en: I baptize you with water, but he will baptize you with the Holy Spirit.”
chapters.zh: 我是用水给你们施洗，他却要用圣灵给你们施洗。

chapters.en: At that time Jesus came from Nazareth in Galilee and was baptized by John in the Jordan.
chapters.zh: 那时，耶稣从加利利的拿撒勒来，在约但河里受了约翰的洗。

chapters.en: Just as Jesus was coming up out of the water, he saw heaven being torn open and the Spirit descending on him like a dove.
chapters.zh: 他从水里一上来，就看见天裂开了，圣灵仿佛鸽子，降在他身上。

chapters.en: And a voice came from heaven: “You are my Son, whom I love; with you I am well pleased.”
chapters.zh: 又有声音从天上来说，你是我的爱子，我喜悦你。

chapters.en: At once the Spirit sent him out into the wilderness,
chapters.zh: 圣灵就把耶稣催到旷野里去。

chapters.en: and he was in the wilderness forty days, being tempted by Satan. He was with the wild animals, and angels attended him.
chapters.zh: 他在旷野四十天受撒但的试探。并与野兽同在一处。且有天使来伺候他。

chapters.en: After John was put in prison, Jesus went into Galilee, proclaiming the good news of God.
chapters.zh: 约翰下监以后，耶稣来到加利利，宣传神的福音，

chapters.en: “The time has come,” he said. “The kingdom of God has come near. Repent and believe the good news!”
chapters.zh: 说，日期满了，神的国近了。你们当悔改，信福音。

chapters.en: As Jesus walked beside the Sea of Galilee, he saw Simon and his brother Andrew casting a net into the lake, for they were fishermen.
chapters.zh: 耶稣顺着加利利的海边走，看见西门，和西门的兄弟安得烈，在海里撒网。他们本是打鱼的。

chapters.en: “Come, follow me,” Jesus said, “and I will send you out to fish for people.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣对他们说，来跟从我，我要叫你们得人如得鱼一样。

chapters.en: At once they left their nets and followed him.
chapters.zh: 他们就立刻舍了网，跟从了他。

chapters.en: When he had gone a little farther, he saw James son of Zebedee and his brother John in a boat, preparing their nets.
chapters.zh: 耶稣稍往前走，又见西庇太的儿子雅各，和雅各的兄弟约翰，在船上补网。

chapters.en: Without delay he called them, and they left their father Zebedee in the boat with the hired men and followed him.
chapters.zh: 耶稣随即招呼他们。他们就把父亲西庇太，和雇工人留在船上，跟从耶稣去了。

chapters.en: They went to Capernaum, and when the Sabbath came, Jesus went into the synagogue and began to teach.
chapters.zh: 到了迦百农，耶稣就在安息日进了会堂教训人。

chapters.en: The people were amazed at his teaching, because he taught them as one who had authority, not as the teachers of the law.
chapters.zh: 众人很希奇他的教训。因为他教训他们，正像有权柄的人，不像文士。

chapters.en: Just then a man in their synagogue who was possessed by an impure spirit cried out,
chapters.zh: 在会堂里有一个人，被污鬼附着。他喊叫说，

chapters.en: “What do you want with us, Jesus of Nazareth? Have you come to destroy us? I know who you are—the Holy One of God!”
chapters.zh: 拿撒勒人耶稣，我们与你有什么相干，你来灭我们吗？我知道你是谁，乃是神的圣者。

chapters.en: “Be quiet!” said Jesus sternly. “Come out of him!”
chapters.zh: 耶稣责备他说，不要作声，从这人身上出来吧。

chapters.en: The impure spirit shook the man violently and came out of him with a shriek.
chapters.zh: 污鬼叫那人抽了一阵疯，大声喊叫，就出来了。

chapters.en: The people were all so amazed that they asked each other, “What is this? A new teaching—and with authority! He even gives orders to impure spirits and they obey him.”
chapters.zh: 众人都惊讶，以致彼此对问说，这是什么事，是个新道理阿。他用权柄吩咐污鬼，连污鬼也听从了他。

chapters.en: News about him spread quickly over the whole region of Galilee.
chapters.zh: 耶稣的名声，就传遍了加利利的四方。

chapters.en: As soon as they left the synagogue, they went with James and John to the home of Simon and Andrew.
chapters.zh: 他们一出会堂，就同着雅各约翰，进了西门和安得烈的家。

chapters.en: Simon’s mother-in-law was in bed with a fever, and they immediately told Jesus about her.
chapters.zh: 西门的岳母，正害热病躺着。就有人告诉耶稣。

chapters.en: So he went to her, took her hand and helped her up. The fever left her and she began to wait on them.
chapters.zh: 耶稣进前拉着她的手，扶她起来，热就退了，她就服事他们。

chapters.en: That evening after sunset the people brought to Jesus all the sick and demon-possessed.
chapters.zh: 天晚日落的时候，有人带着一切害病的，和被鬼附的，来到耶稣跟前。

chapters.en: The whole town gathered at the door,
chapters.zh: 合城的人都聚集在门前。

chapters.en: and Jesus healed many who had various diseases. He also drove out many demons, but he would not let the demons speak because they knew who he was.
chapters.zh: 耶稣治好了许多害各样病的人，又赶出许多鬼，不许鬼说话，因为鬼认识他。

chapters.en: Very early in the morning, while it was still dark, Jesus got up, left the house and went off to a solitary place, where he prayed.
chapters.zh: 次日早晨，天未亮的时候，耶稣起来，到旷野地方去，在那里祷告。

chapters.en: Simon and his companions went to look for him,
chapters.zh: 西门和同伴追了他去。

chapters.en: and when they found him, they exclaimed: “Everyone is looking for you!”
chapters.zh: 遇见了就对他说，众人都找你。

chapters.en: Jesus replied, “Let us go somewhere else—to the nearby villages—so I can preach there also. That is why I have come.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣对他们说，我们可以往别处去，到邻近的乡村，我也好在那里传道。因为我是为这事出来的。

chapters.en: So he traveled throughout Galilee, preaching in their synagogues and driving out demons.
chapters.zh: 于是在加利利全地，进了会堂，传道赶鬼。

chapters.en: A man with leprosy came to him and begged him on his knees, “If you are willing, you can make me clean.”
chapters.zh: 有一个长大麻疯的，来求耶稣，向他跪下说，你若肯，必能叫我洁净了。

chapters.en: Jesus was indignant. He reached out his hand and touched the man. “I am willing,” he said. “Be clean!”
chapters.zh: 耶稣动了慈心，就伸手摸他，说，我肯，你洁净了吧。

chapters.en: Immediately the leprosy left him and he was cleansed.
chapters.zh: 大麻疯即时离开他，他就洁净了。

chapters.en: Jesus sent him away at once with a strong warning:
chapters.zh: 耶稣严严地嘱咐他，就打发他走，

chapters.en: “See that you don’t tell this to anyone. But go, show yourself to the priest and offer the sacrifices that Moses commanded for your cleansing, as a testimony to them.”
chapters.zh: 对他说，你要谨慎，什么话都不可告诉人。只要去把身体给祭司察看，又因为你洁净了，献上摩西所吩咐的礼物，对众人作证据。

chapters.en: Instead he went out and began to talk freely, spreading the news. As a result, Jesus could no longer enter a town openly but stayed outside in lonely places. Yet the people still came to him from everywhere.
chapters.zh: 那人出去，倒说许多的话，把这件事传扬开了，叫耶稣以后不得再明明地进城，只好在外边旷野地方。人从各处都就了他来。

chapters.en: A few days later, when Jesus again entered Capernaum, the people heard that he had come home.
chapters.zh: 过了些日子，耶稣又进了迦百农。人听见他在房子里，

chapters.en: They gathered in such large numbers that there was no room left, not even outside the door, and he preached the word to them.
chapters.zh: 就有许多人聚集，甚至连门前都没有空地，耶稣就对他们讲道。

chapters.en: Some men came, bringing to him a paralyzed man, carried by four of them.
chapters.zh: 有人带着一个瘫子来见耶稣，是用四个人抬来的。

chapters.en: Since they could not get him to Jesus because of the crowd, they made an opening in the roof above Jesus by digging through it and then lowered the mat the man was lying on.
chapters.zh: 因为人多，不得近前，就把耶稣所在的房子，拆了房顶，既拆通了，就把瘫子连所躺卧的褥子都缒下来。

chapters.en: When Jesus saw their faith, he said to the paralyzed man, “Son, your sins are forgiven.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣见他们的信心，就对瘫子说，小子，你的罪赦了。

chapters.en: Now some teachers of the law were sitting there, thinking to themselves,
chapters.zh: 有几个文士坐在那里，心里议论说，

chapters.en: “Why does this fellow talk like that? He’s blaspheming! Who can forgive sins but God alone?”
chapters.zh: 这个人为什么这样说呢？他说僭妄的话了。除了神以外，谁能赦罪呢？

chapters.en: Immediately Jesus knew in his spirit that this was what they were thinking in their hearts, and he said to them, “Why are you thinking these things?
chapters.zh: 耶稣心中知道他们心里这样议论，就说，你们心里为什么这样议论呢？

chapters.en: Which is easier: to say to this paralyzed man, ‘Your sins are forgiven,’ or to say, ‘Get up, take your mat and walk’?
chapters.zh: 或对瘫子说，你的罪赦了，或说，起来拿你的褥子行走，那一样容易呢？

chapters.en: But I want you to know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins.” So he said to the man,
chapters.zh: 但要叫你们知道人子在地上有赦罪的权柄，就对瘫子说，

chapters.en: “I tell you, get up, take your mat and go home.”
chapters.zh: 我吩咐你起来，拿你的褥子回家去吧。

chapters.en: He got up, took his mat and walked out in full view of them all. This amazed everyone and they praised God, saying, “We have never seen anything like this!”
chapters.zh: 那人就起来，立刻拿着褥子，当众人面前出去了。以致众人都惊奇，归荣耀与神说，我们从来没有见过这样的事。

chapters.en: Once again Jesus went out beside the lake. A large crowd came to him, and he began to teach them.
chapters.zh: 耶稣又出到海边去，众人都就了他来，他便教训他们。

chapters.en: As he walked along, he saw Levi son of Alphaeus sitting at the tax collector’s booth. “Follow me,” Jesus told him, and Levi got up and followed him.
chapters.zh: 耶稣经过的时候，看见亚勒腓的儿子利未，坐在税关上，就对他说，你跟从我来。他就起来跟从了耶稣。

chapters.en: While Jesus was having dinner at Levi’s house, many tax collectors and sinners were eating with him and his disciples, for there were many who followed him.
chapters.zh: 耶稣在利未家里坐席的时候，有好些税吏和罪人，与耶稣并门徒一同坐席。因为这样的人多，他们也跟随耶稣。

chapters.en: When the teachers of the law who were Pharisees saw him eating with the sinners and tax collectors, they asked his disciples: “Why does he eat with tax collectors and sinners?”
chapters.zh: 法利赛人中的文士，（有古卷作文士和法利赛人）看见耶稣和罪人并税吏一同吃饭，就对他门徒说，他和税吏并罪人一同吃喝吗？

chapters.en: On hearing this, Jesus said to them, “It is not the healthy who need a doctor, but the sick. I have not come to call the righteous, but sinners.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣听见，就对他们说，健康的人用不着医生，有病的人才用得着。我来本不是召义人，乃是召罪人。

chapters.en: Now John’s disciples and the Pharisees were fasting. Some people came and asked Jesus, “How is it that John’s disciples and the disciples of the Pharisees are fasting, but yours are not?”
chapters.zh: 当下，约翰的门徒和法利赛人禁食。他们来问耶稣说，约翰的门徒和法利赛人的门徒禁食，你的门徒倒不禁食，这是为什么呢？

chapters.en: Jesus answered, “How can the guests of the bridegroom fast while he is with them? They cannot, so long as they have him with them.
chapters.zh: 耶稣对他们说，新郎和陪伴之人同在的时候，陪伴之人岂能禁食呢？新郎还同在，他们不能禁食。

chapters.en: But the time will come when the bridegroom will be taken from them, and on that day they will fast.
chapters.zh: 但日子将到，新郎要离开他们，那日他们就要禁食。

chapters.en: “No one sews a patch of unshrunk cloth on an old garment. Otherwise, the new piece will pull away from the old, making the tear worse.
chapters.zh: 没有人把新布缝在旧衣服上。恐怕所补上的新布，带坏了旧衣服，破的就更大了。

chapters.en: And no one pours new wine into old wineskins. Otherwise, the wine will burst the skins, and both the wine and the wineskins will be ruined. No, they pour new wine into new wineskins.”
chapters.zh: 也没有人把新酒装在旧皮袋里。恐怕酒把皮袋裂开，酒和皮袋就都坏了。惟把新酒装在新皮袋里。

chapters.en: One Sabbath Jesus was going through the grainfields, and as his disciples walked along, they began to pick some heads of grain.
chapters.zh: 耶稣当安息日，从麦地经过。他门徒行路的时候，掐了麦穗。

chapters.en: The Pharisees said to him, “Look, why are they doing what is unlawful on the Sabbath?”
chapters.zh: 法利赛人对耶稣说，看哪，他们在安息日为什么作不可作的事呢？

chapters.en: He answered, “Have you never read what David did when he and his companions were hungry and in need?
chapters.zh: 耶稣对他们说，经上记着大卫和跟从他的人，缺乏饥饿之时所作的事，你们没有念过吗？

chapters.en: In the days of Abiathar the high priest, he entered the house of God and ate the consecrated bread, which is lawful only for priests to eat. And he also gave some to his companions.”
chapters.zh: 他当亚比亚他作大祭司的时候，怎么进了神的殿，吃了陈设饼，又给跟从他的人吃。这饼除了祭司以外，人都不可吃。

chapters.en: Then he said to them, “The Sabbath was made for man, not man for the Sabbath.
chapters.zh: 又对他们说，安息日是为人设立的，人不是为安息日设立的。

chapters.en: So the Son of Man is Lord even of the Sabbath.”
chapters.zh: 所以人子也是安息日的主

chapters.en: Another time Jesus went into the synagogue, and a man with a shriveled hand was there.
chapters.zh: 耶稣又进了会堂。在那里有一个人枯干了一只手。

chapters.en: Some of them were looking for a reason to accuse Jesus, so they watched him closely to see if he would heal him on the Sabbath.
chapters.zh: 众人窥探耶稣，在安息日医治不医治，意思是要控告耶稣。

chapters.en: Jesus said to the man with the shriveled hand, “Stand up in front of everyone.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣对那枯干一只手的人说，起来，站在当中。

chapters.en: Then Jesus asked them, “Which is lawful on the Sabbath: to do good or to do evil, to save life or to kill?” But they remained silent.
chapters.zh: 又问众人说，在安息日行善行恶，救命害命，那样是可以的呢？他们都不作声。

chapters.en: He looked around at them in anger and, deeply distressed at their stubborn hearts, said to the man, “Stretch out your hand.” He stretched it out, and his hand was completely restored.
chapters.zh: 耶稣怒目周围看他们，忧愁他们的心刚硬，就对那人说，伸出手来。他把手一伸，手就复了原。

chapters.en: Then the Pharisees went out and began to plot with the Herodians how they might kill Jesus.
chapters.zh: 法利赛人出去，同希律一党的人商议，怎样可以除灭耶稣。

chapters.en: Jesus withdrew with his disciples to the lake, and a large crowd from Galilee followed.
chapters.zh: 耶稣和门徒退到海边去。有许多人从加利利跟随他。

chapters.en: When they heard about all he was doing, many people came to him from Judea, Jerusalem, Idumea, and the regions across the Jordan and around Tyre and Sidon.
chapters.zh: 还有许多人听见他所作的大事，就从犹太，耶路撒冷，以土买，约但河外，并推罗西顿的四方，来到他那里。

chapters.en: Because of the crowd he told his disciples to have a small boat ready for him, to keep the people from crowding him.
chapters.zh: 他因为人多，就吩咐门徒叫一只小船伺候着，免得众人拥挤他。

chapters.en: For he had healed many, so that those with diseases were pushing forward to touch him.
chapters.zh: 他治好了许多人，所以凡有灾病的，都挤进来要摸他。

chapters.en: Whenever the impure spirits saw him, they fell down before him and cried out, “You are the Son of God.”
chapters.zh: 污鬼无论何时看见他就俯伏在他面前喊着说，你是神的儿子。

chapters.en: But he gave them strict orders not to tell others about him.
chapters.zh: 耶稣再三地嘱咐他们，不要把他显露出来。

chapters.en: Jesus went up on a mountainside and called to him those he wanted, and they came to him.
chapters.zh: 耶稣上了山，随自己的意思叫人来，他们便来到他那里。

chapters.en: He appointed twelve that they might be with him and that he might send them out to preach
chapters.zh: 他就设立十二个人，要他们常和自己同在，也要差他们去传道，

chapters.en: and to have authority to drive out demons.
chapters.zh: 并给他们权柄赶鬼。

chapters.en: These are the twelve he appointed: Simon (to whom he gave the name Peter),
chapters.zh: 这十二个人有西门，耶稣又给他起名叫彼得。

chapters.en: James son of Zebedee and his brother John (to them he gave the name Boanerges, which means “sons of thunder”),
chapters.zh: 还有西庇太的儿子雅各，和雅各的兄弟约翰。又给这两个人起名叫半尼其，就是雷子的意思。

chapters.en: Andrew, Philip, Bartholomew, Matthew, Thomas, James son of Alphaeus, Thaddaeus, Simon the Zealot
chapters.zh: 又有安得烈，腓力，巴多罗买，马太，多马，亚勒腓的儿子雅各，和达太，并奋锐党的西门。

chapters.en: and Judas Iscariot, who betrayed him.
chapters.zh: 还有卖耶稣的加略人犹大。

chapters.en: Then Jesus entered a house, and again a crowd gathered, so that he and his disciples were not even able to eat.
chapters.zh: 耶稣进了一个屋子，众人又聚集，甚至他连饭也顾不得吃。

chapters.en: When his family heard about this, they went to take charge of him, for they said, “He is out of his mind.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣的亲属听见，就出来要拉住他，因为他们说他癫狂了。

chapters.en: And the teachers of the law who came down from Jerusalem said, “He is possessed by Beelzebul! By the prince of demons he is driving out demons.”
chapters.zh: 从耶路撒冷下来的文士说，他是被别西卜附着。又说，他是靠着鬼王赶鬼。

chapters.en: So Jesus called them over to him and began to speak to them in parables: “How can Satan drive out Satan?
chapters.zh: 耶稣叫他们来，用比喻对他们说，撒但怎能赶出撒但呢？

chapters.en: If a kingdom is divided against itself, that kingdom cannot stand.
chapters.zh: 若一国自相分争，那国就站立不住。

chapters.en: If a house is divided against itself, that house cannot stand.
chapters.zh: 若一家自相分争，那家就站立不住。

chapters.en: And if Satan opposes himself and is divided, he cannot stand; his end has come.
chapters.zh: 若撒但自相攻打分争，他就站立不住，必要灭亡。

chapters.en: In fact, no one can enter a strong man’s house without first tying him up. Then he can plunder the strong man’s house.
chapters.zh: 没有人能进壮士家里抢夺他的家具。必先捆住那壮士，才可以抢夺他的家。

chapters.en: Truly I tell you, people can be forgiven all their sins and every slander they utter,
chapters.zh: 我实在告诉你们，世人一切的罪，和一切亵渎的话，都可得赦免。

chapters.en: but whoever blasphemes against the Holy Spirit will never be forgiven; they are guilty of an eternal sin.”
chapters.zh: 凡亵渎圣灵的，却永不得赦免，乃要担当永远的罪。

chapters.en: He said this because they were saying, “He has an impure spirit.”
chapters.zh: 这话是因为他们说，他是被污鬼附着的。

chapters.en: Then Jesus’ mother and brothers arrived. Standing outside, they sent someone in to call him.
chapters.zh: 当下耶稣的母亲，和弟兄，来站在外边，打发人去叫他。

chapters.en: A crowd was sitting around him, and they told him, “Your mother and brothers are outside looking for you.”
chapters.zh: 有许多人在耶稣周围坐着。他们就告诉他说，看哪，你母亲，和你弟兄，在外边找你。

chapters.en: “Who are my mother and my brothers?” he asked.
chapters.zh: 耶稣回答说，谁是我的母亲，谁是我的弟兄。

chapters.en: Then he looked at those seated in a circle around him and said, “Here are my mother and my brothers!
chapters.zh: 就四面观看那周围坐着的人，说，看哪，我的母亲，我的弟兄。

chapters.en: Whoever does God’s will is my brother and sister and mother.”
chapters.zh: 凡遵行神旨意的人，就是我的弟兄姐妹和母亲了。

chapters.en: Again Jesus began to teach by the lake. The crowd that gathered around him was so large that he got into a boat and sat in it out on the lake, while all the people were along the shore at the water’s edge.
chapters.zh: 耶稣又在海边教训人。有许多人到他那里聚集，他只得上船坐下。船在海里，众人都靠近海站在岸上。

chapters.en: He taught them many things by parables, and in his teaching said:
chapters.zh: 耶稣就用比喻教训他们许多道理。在教训之间，对他们说，

chapters.en: “Listen! A farmer went out to sow his seed.
chapters.zh: 你们听阿。有一个撒种的。出去撒种。

chapters.en: As he was scattering the seed, some fell along the path, and the birds came and ate it up.
chapters.zh: 撒的时候，有落在路旁的，飞鸟来吃尽了。

chapters.en: Some fell on rocky places, where it did not have much soil. It sprang up quickly, because the soil was shallow.
chapters.zh: 有落在土浅石头地上的，土既不深，发苗最快。

chapters.en: But when the sun came up, the plants were scorched, and they withered because they had no root.
chapters.zh: 日头出来一晒，因为没有根，就枯干了。

chapters.en: Other seed fell among thorns, which grew up and choked the plants, so that they did not bear grain.
chapters.zh: 有落在荆棘里的，荆棘长起来，把他挤住了，就不结实。

chapters.en: Still other seed fell on good soil. It came up, grew and produced a crop, some multiplying thirty, some sixty, some a hundred times.”
chapters.zh: 又有落在好土里的，就发生长大，结实有三十倍的，有六十倍的，有一百倍的。

chapters.en: Then Jesus said, “Whoever has ears to hear, let them hear.”
chapters.zh: 又说，有耳可听的，就应当听。

chapters.en: When he was alone, the Twelve and the others around him asked him about the parables.
chapters.zh: 无人的时候，跟随耶稣的人，和十二个门徒，问他这比喻的意思。

chapters.en: He told them, “The secret of the kingdom of God has been given to you. But to those on the outside everything is said in parables
chapters.zh: 耶稣对他们说，神国的奥秘，只叫你们知道，若是对外人讲，凡事就用比喻。

chapters.en: so that, “ ‘they may be ever seeing but never perceiving, and ever hearing but never understanding; otherwise they might turn and be forgiven!’”
chapters.zh: 叫他们看是看见，却不晓得。听是听见，却不明白。恐怕他们回转过来，就得赦免。

chapters.en: Then Jesus said to them, “Don’t you understand this parable? How then will you understand any parable?
chapters.zh: 又对他们说，你们不明白这比喻吗？这样怎能明白一切的比喻呢？

chapters.en: The farmer sows the word.
chapters.zh: 撒种之人所撒的，就是道。

chapters.en: Some people are like seed along the path, where the word is sown. As soon as they hear it, Satan comes and takes away the word that was sown in them.
chapters.zh: 那撒在路旁的，就是人听了道，撒但立刻来，把撒在他心里的道夺了去。

chapters.en: Others, like seed sown on rocky places, hear the word and at once receive it with joy.
chapters.zh: 那撒在石头地上的，就是人听了道，立刻欢喜领受。

chapters.en: But since they have no root, they last only a short time. When trouble or persecution comes because of the word, they quickly fall away.
chapters.zh: 但他心里没有根，不过是暂时的，及至为道遭了患难，或是受了逼迫，立刻就跌倒了。

chapters.en: Still others, like seed sown among thorns, hear the word;
chapters.zh: 还有那撒在荆棘里的，就是人听了道。

chapters.en: but the worries of this life, the deceitfulness of wealth and the desires for other things come in and choke the word, making it unfruitful.
chapters.zh: 后来有世上的思虑，钱财的迷惑，和别样的私欲，进来把道挤住了，就不能结实。

chapters.en: Others, like seed sown on good soil, hear the word, accept it, and produce a crop—some thirty, some sixty, some a hundred times what was sown.”
chapters.zh: 那撒在好地上的，就是人听道，又领受，并且结实，有三十倍的，有六十倍的，有一百倍的。

chapters.en: He said to them, “Do you bring in a lamp to put it under a bowl or a bed? Instead, don’t you put it on its stand?
chapters.zh: 耶稣又对他们说，人拿灯来，岂是要放在斗底下，床底下，不放在灯台上吗？

chapters.en: For whatever is hidden is meant to be disclosed, and whatever is concealed is meant to be brought out into the open.
chapters.zh: 因为掩藏的事，没有不显出来的。隐瞒的事，没有不露出来的。

chapters.en: If anyone has ears to hear, let them hear.”
chapters.zh: 有耳可听的，就应当听。

chapters.en: “Consider carefully what you hear,” he continued. “With the measure you use, it will be measured to you—and even more.
chapters.zh: 又说你们所听的要留心。你们用什么量器量给人，也必用什么量器量给你们，并且要多给你们。

chapters.en: Whoever has will be given more; whoever does not have, even what they have will be taken from them.”
chapters.zh: 因为有的还要给他。没有的，连他所有的也要夺去。

chapters.en: He also said, “This is what the kingdom of God is like. A man scatters seed on the ground.
chapters.zh: 又说，神的国，如同人把种撒在地上，

chapters.en: Night and day, whether he sleeps or gets up, the seed sprouts and grows, though he does not know how.
chapters.zh: 黑夜睡觉，白日起来，这种就发芽渐长，那人却不晓得如何这样。

chapters.en: All by itself the soil produces grain—first the stalk, then the head, then the full kernel in the head.
chapters.zh: 地生五谷，是出于自然的。先发苗，后长穗，再后穗上结成饱满的子粒。

chapters.en: As soon as the grain is ripe, he puts the sickle to it, because the harvest has come.”
chapters.zh: 谷既熟了，就用镰刀去割，因为收成的时候到了。

chapters.en: Again he said, “What shall we say the kingdom of God is like, or what parable shall we use to describe it?
chapters.zh: 又说，神的国，我们可用什么比较呢？可用什么比喻表明呢？

chapters.en: It is like a mustard seed, which is the smallest of all seeds on earth.
chapters.zh: 好像一粒芥菜种，种在地里的时候，虽比地上的百种都小，

chapters.en: Yet when planted, it grows and becomes the largest of all garden plants, with such big branches that the birds can perch in its shade.”
chapters.zh: 但种上以后，就长起来，比各样的菜都大，又长出大枝来。甚至天上的飞鸟，可以宿在它的荫下。

chapters.en: With many similar parables Jesus spoke the word to them, as much as they could understand.
chapters.zh: 耶稣用许多这样的比喻，照他们所能听的，对他们讲道。

chapters.en: He did not say anything to them without using a parable. But when he was alone with his own disciples, he explained everything.
chapters.zh: 若不用比喻，就不对他们讲。没有人的时候，就把一切的道讲给门徒听。

chapters.en: That day when evening came, he said to his disciples, “Let us go over to the other side.”
chapters.zh: 当那天晚上，耶稣对门徒说，我们渡到那边去吧。

chapters.en: Leaving the crowd behind, they took him along, just as he was, in the boat. There were also other boats with him.
chapters.zh: 门徒离开众人，耶稣仍在船上，他们就把他一同带去。也有别的船和他同行。

chapters.en: A furious squall came up, and the waves broke over the boat, so that it was nearly swamped.
chapters.zh: 忽然起了暴风，波浪打入船内，甚至船要满了水。

chapters.en: Jesus was in the stern, sleeping on a cushion. The disciples woke him and said to him, “Teacher, don’t you care if we drown?”
chapters.zh: 耶稣在船尾上，枕着枕头睡觉。门徒叫醒了他，说，夫子，我们丧命，你不顾吗？

chapters.en: He got up, rebuked the wind and said to the waves, “Quiet! Be still!” Then the wind died down and it was completely calm.
chapters.zh: 耶稣醒了，斥责风，向海说，住了吧，静了吧。风就止住，大大地平静了。

chapters.en: He said to his disciples, “Why are you so afraid? Do you still have no faith?”
chapters.zh: 耶稣对他们说，为什么胆怯。你们还没有信心吗？

chapters.en: They were terrified and asked each other, “Who is this? Even the wind and the waves obey him!”
chapters.zh: 他们就大大地惧怕，彼此说，这到底是谁，连风和海也听从他了。

chapters.en: They went across the lake to the region of the Gerasenes.
chapters.zh: 他们来到海那边，格拉森人的地方。

chapters.en: When Jesus got out of the boat, a man with an impure spirit came from the tombs to meet him.
chapters.zh: 耶稣一下船，就有一个被污鬼附着的人，从坟茔里出来迎着他。

chapters.en: This man lived in the tombs, and no one could bind him anymore, not even with a chain.
chapters.zh: 那人常住在坟茔里，没有人能捆住他，就是用铁链也不能。

chapters.en: For he had often been chained hand and foot, but he tore the chains apart and broke the irons on his feet. No one was strong enough to subdue him.
chapters.zh: 因为人屡次用脚镣和铁链捆锁他，铁链竟被他挣断了，脚镣也被他弄碎了。总没有人能制伏他。

chapters.en: Night and day among the tombs and in the hills he would cry out and cut himself with stones.
chapters.zh: 他昼夜常在坟茔里和山中喊叫，又用石头砍自己。

chapters.en: When he saw Jesus from a distance, he ran and fell on his knees in front of him.
chapters.zh: 他远远地看见耶稣，就跑过去拜他。

chapters.en: He shouted at the top of his voice, “What do you want with me, Jesus, Son of the Most High God? In God’s name don’t torture me!”
chapters.zh: 大声呼叫说，至高神的儿子耶稣，我与你有什么相干。我指着神恳求你，不要叫我受苦。

chapters.en: For Jesus had said to him, “Come out of this man, you impure spirit!”
chapters.zh: 是因耶稣曾吩咐他说，污鬼阿，从这人身上出来吧。

chapters.en: Then Jesus asked him, “What is your name?”“My name is Legion,” he replied, “for we are many.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣问他说，你名叫什么。回答说，我名叫群，因为我们多的缘故。

chapters.en: And he begged Jesus again and again not to send them out of the area.
chapters.zh: 就再三地求耶稣，不要叫他们离开那地方。

chapters.en: A large herd of pigs was feeding on the nearby hillside.
chapters.zh: 在那里山坡上，有一大群猪吃食。

chapters.en: The demons begged Jesus, “Send us among the pigs; allow us to go into them.”
chapters.zh: 鬼就央求耶稣说，求你打发我们往猪群里附着猪去。

chapters.en: He gave them permission, and the impure spirits came out and went into the pigs. The herd, about two thousand in number, rushed down the steep bank into the lake and were drowned.
chapters.zh: 耶稣准了他们。污鬼就出来，进入猪里去。于是那群猪闯下山崖，投在海里，淹死了。猪的数目，约有二千。

chapters.en: Those tending the pigs ran off and reported this in the town and countryside, and the people went out to see what had happened.
chapters.zh: 放猪的就逃跑了，去告诉城里和乡下的人。众人就来要看是什么事。

chapters.en: When they came to Jesus, they saw the man who had been possessed by the legion of demons, sitting there, dressed and in his right mind; and they were afraid.
chapters.zh: 他们来到耶稣那里，看见那被鬼附着的人，就是从前被群鬼所附的，坐着，穿上衣服，心里明白过来。他们就害怕。

chapters.en: Those who had seen it told the people what had happened to the demon-possessed man—and told about the pigs as well.
chapters.zh: 看见这事的，便将鬼附之人所遇见的，和那群猪的事，都告诉了众人。

chapters.en: Then the people began to plead with Jesus to leave their region.
chapters.zh: 众人就央求耶稣离开他们的境界。

chapters.en: As Jesus was getting into the boat, the man who had been demon-possessed begged to go with him.
chapters.zh: 耶稣上船的时候，那从前被鬼附着的人，恳求和耶稣同在。

chapters.en: Jesus did not let him, but said, “Go home to your own people and tell them how much the Lord has done for you, and how he has had mercy on you.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣不许，却对他说，你回家去，到你的亲属那里，将主为你所作的，是何等大的事，是怎样怜悯你，都告诉他们。

chapters.en: So the man went away and began to tell in the Decapolis how much Jesus had done for him. And all the people were amazed.
chapters.zh: 那人就走了，在低加波利，传扬耶稣为他作了何等大的事，众人就都希奇。

chapters.en: When Jesus had again crossed over by boat to the other side of the lake, a large crowd gathered around him while he was by the lake.
chapters.zh: 耶稣坐船又渡到那边去，就有许多人到他那里聚集。他正在海边上。

chapters.en: Then one of the synagogue leaders, named Jairus, came, and when he saw Jesus, he fell at his feet.
chapters.zh: 有一个管会堂的人，名叫睚鲁，来见耶稣，就俯伏在他脚前，

chapters.en: He pleaded earnestly with him, “My little daughter is dying. Please come and put your hands on her so that she will be healed and live.”
chapters.zh: 再三地求他说，我的小女儿快要死了，求你去按手在她身上，使她痊愈，得以活了。

chapters.en: So Jesus went with him. A large crowd followed and pressed around him.
chapters.zh: 耶稣就和他同去，有许多人跟随拥挤他。

chapters.en: And a woman was there who had been subject to bleeding for twelve years.
chapters.zh: 有一个女人，患了十二年的血漏，

chapters.en: She had suffered a great deal under the care of many doctors and had spent all she had, yet instead of getting better she grew worse.
chapters.zh: 在好些医生手里，受了许多的苦。又花尽了她所有的，一点也不见好，病势反倒更重了。

chapters.en: When she heard about Jesus, she came up behind him in the crowd and touched his cloak,
chapters.zh: 她听见耶稣的事，就从后头来，杂在众人中间，摸耶稣的衣裳。

chapters.en: because she thought, “If I just touch his clothes, I will be healed.”
chapters.zh: 意思说，我只摸他的衣裳，就必痊愈。

chapters.en: Immediately her bleeding stopped and she felt in her body that she was freed from her suffering.
chapters.zh: 于是她血漏的源头，立刻干了。她便觉得身上的灾病好了。

chapters.en: At once Jesus realized that power had gone out from him. He turned around in the crowd and asked, “Who touched my clothes?”
chapters.zh: 耶稣顿时心里觉得有能力从自己身上出去，就在众人中间转过来说，谁摸我的衣裳。

chapters.en: “You see the people crowding against you,” his disciples answered, “and yet you can ask, ‘Who touched me?’ ”
chapters.zh: 门徒对他说，你看众人拥挤你，还说谁摸我吗？

chapters.en: But Jesus kept looking around to see who had done it.
chapters.zh: 耶稣周围观看，要见作这事的女人。

chapters.en: Then the woman, knowing what had happened to her, came and fell at his feet and, trembling with fear, told him the whole truth.
chapters.zh: 那女人知道在自己身上所成的事，就恐惧战兢，来俯伏在耶稣跟前，将实情全告诉他。

chapters.en: He said to her, “Daughter, your faith has healed you. Go in peace and be freed from your suffering.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣对她说，女儿，你的信救了你，平平安安地回去吧。你的灾病痊愈了。

chapters.en: While Jesus was still speaking, some people came from the house of Jairus, the synagogue leader. “Your daughter is dead,” they said. “Why bother the teacher anymore?”
chapters.zh: 还说话的时候，有人从管会堂的家里来说，你的女儿死了，何必还劳动先生呢？

chapters.en: Overhearing what they said, Jesus told him, “Don’t be afraid; just believe.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣听见所说的话，就对管会堂的说，不要怕。只要信。

chapters.en: He did not let anyone follow him except Peter, James and John the brother of James.
chapters.zh: 于是带着彼得，雅各，和雅各的兄弟约翰同去，不许别人跟随他。

chapters.en: When they came to the home of the synagogue leader, Jesus saw a commotion, with people crying and wailing loudly.
chapters.zh: 他们来到管会堂的家里，耶稣看见那里乱嚷，并有人大大地哭泣哀号。

chapters.en: He went in and said to them, “Why all this commotion and wailing? The child is not dead but asleep.”
chapters.zh: 进到里面，就对他们说，为什么乱嚷哭泣呢？孩子不是死了，是睡着了。

chapters.en: But they laughed at him. After he put them all out, he took the child’s father and mother and the disciples who were with him, and went in where the child was.
chapters.zh: 他们就嗤笑耶稣。耶稣把他们都撵出去，就带着孩子的父母，和跟随的人进了孩子所在的地方。

chapters.en: He took her by the hand and said to her, “Talitha koum!” (which means “Little girl, I say to you, get up!”).
chapters.zh: 就拉着孩子的手，对她说，大利大古米。翻出来，就是说，闺女，我吩咐你起来。

chapters.en: Immediately the girl stood up and began to walk around (she was twelve years old). At this they were completely astonished.
chapters.zh: 那闺女立时起来走。他们就大大地惊奇。闺女已经十二岁了。

chapters.en: He gave strict orders not to let anyone know about this, and told them to give her something to eat.
chapters.zh: 耶稣切切地嘱咐他们，不要叫人知道这事。又吩咐给她东西吃。

chapters.en: Jesus left there and went to his hometown, accompanied by his disciples.
chapters.zh: 耶稣离开那里，来到自己的家乡。门徒也跟从他。

chapters.en: When the Sabbath came, he began to teach in the synagogue, and many who heard him were amazed. “Where did this man get these things?” they asked. “What’s this wisdom that has been given him? What are these remarkable miracles he is performing?
chapters.zh: 到了安息日，他在会堂里教训人。众人听见，就甚希奇，说，这人从哪里有这些事呢？所赐给他的是什么智慧？他手所作的是何等的异能呢？

chapters.en: Isn’t this the carpenter? Isn’t this Mary’s son and the brother of James, Joseph, Judas and Simon? Aren’t his sisters here with us?” And they took offense at him.
chapters.zh: 这不是那木匠吗？不是马利亚的儿子，雅各，约西，犹大，西门的长兄吗？他妹妹们不也是在我们这里吗？他们就厌弃他。（厌弃他原文作因他跌倒）

chapters.en: Jesus said to them, “A prophet is not without honor except in his own town, among his relatives and in his own home.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣对他们说，大凡先知，除了本地亲属本家之外，没有不被人尊敬的。

chapters.en: He could not do any miracles there, except lay his hands on a few sick people and heal them.
chapters.zh: 耶稣就在那里不得行什么异能，不过按手在几个病人身上，治好他们。

chapters.en: He was amazed at their lack of faith. Then Jesus went around teaching from village to village.
chapters.zh: 他也诧异他们不信，就往周围乡村教训人去了。

chapters.en: Calling the Twelve to him, he began to send them out two by two and gave them authority over impure spirits.
chapters.zh: 耶稣叫了十二个门徒来，差遣他们两个两个的出去。也赐给他们权柄，制伏污鬼。

chapters.en: These were his instructions: “Take nothing for the journey except a staff—no bread, no bag, no money in your belts.
chapters.zh: 并且嘱咐他们，行路的时候，不要带食物和口袋，腰袋里也不要带钱，除了拐杖以外，什么都不要带。

chapters.en: Wear sandals but not an extra shirt.
chapters.zh: 只要穿鞋。也不要穿两件挂子。

chapters.en: Whenever you enter a house, stay there until you leave that town.
chapters.zh: 又对他们说，你们无论到何处，进了人的家，就住在那里，直到离开那地方。

chapters.en: And if any place will not welcome you or listen to you, leave that place and shake the dust off your feet as a testimony against them.”
chapters.zh: 何处的人，不接待你们，不听你们，你们离开那里的时候，就把脚上的尘土跺下去，对他们作见证。

chapters.en: They went out and preached that people should repent.
chapters.zh: 门徒就出去，传道叫人悔改。

chapters.en: They drove out many demons and anointed many sick people with oil and healed them.
chapters.zh: 又赶出许多的鬼，用油抹了许多病人，治好他们。

chapters.en: King Herod heard about this, for Jesus’ name had become well known. Some were saying, “John the Baptist has been raised from the dead, and that is why miraculous powers are at work in him.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣的名声传扬出来。希律王听见了，就说，施洗的约翰从死里复活了，所以这些异能由他里面发出来。

chapters.en: Others said, “He is Elijah.” And still others claimed, “He is a prophet, like one of the prophets of long ago.”
chapters.zh: 但别人说，是以利亚。又有人说，是先知，正像先知中的一位。

chapters.en: But when Herod heard this, he said, “John, whom I beheaded, has been raised from the dead!”
chapters.zh: 希律听见，却说，是我所斩的约翰，他复活了。

chapters.en: For Herod himself had given orders to have John arrested, and he had him bound and put in prison. He did this because of Herodias, his brother Philip’s wife, whom he had married.
chapters.zh: 先是希律为他兄弟腓力的妻子希罗底的缘故，差人去拿住约翰，锁在监里，因为希律已经娶了那妇人。

chapters.en: For John had been saying to Herod, “It is not lawful for you to have your brother’s wife.”
chapters.zh: 约翰曾对希律说，你娶你兄弟的妻子是不合理的。

chapters.en: So Herodias nursed a grudge against John and wanted to kill him. But she was not able to,
chapters.zh: 于是希罗底怀恨他，想要杀他。只是不能。

chapters.en: because Herod feared John and protected him, knowing him to be a righteous and holy man. When Herod heard John, he was greatly puzzled ; yet he liked to listen to him.
chapters.zh: 因为希律知道约翰是义人，是圣人，所以敬畏他，保护他。听他讲论，就多照着行。并且乐意听他。（多照着行有古卷作游移不定）

chapters.en: Finally the opportune time came. On his birthday Herod gave a banquet for his high officials and military commanders and the leading men of Galilee.
chapters.zh: 有一天，恰巧是希律的生日，希律摆设筵席，请了大臣和千夫长，并加利利作首领的。
