chapters.en: When the daughter of Herodias came in and danced, she pleased Herod and his dinner guests. The king said to the girl, “Ask me for anything you want, and I’ll give it to you.”
chapters.zh: 希罗底的女儿进来跳舞，使希律和同席的人都欢喜。王就对女子说，你随意向我求什么，我必给你。

chapters.en: And he promised her with an oath, “Whatever you ask I will give you, up to half my kingdom.”
chapters.zh: 又对她起誓说，随你向我求什么，就是我国的一半，我也必给你。

chapters.en: She went out and said to her mother, “What shall I ask for?” “The head of John the Baptist,” she answered.
chapters.zh: 她就出去，对她母亲说，我可以求什么呢？她母亲说，施洗约翰的头。

chapters.en: At once the girl hurried in to the king with the request: “I want you to give me right now the head of John the Baptist on a platter.”
chapters.zh: 她就急忙进去见王，求他说，我愿王立时把施洗约翰的头，放在盘子里给我。

chapters.en: The king was greatly distressed, but because of his oaths and his dinner guests, he did not want to refuse her.
chapters.zh: 王就甚忧愁。但因他所起的誓，又因同席的人，就不肯推辞。

chapters.en: So he immediately sent an executioner with orders to bring John’s head. The man went, beheaded John in the prison,
chapters.zh: 随即差一个护卫兵，吩咐拿约翰的头来。护卫兵就去在监里斩了约翰，

chapters.en: and brought back his head on a platter. He presented it to the girl, and she gave it to her mother.
chapters.zh: 把头放在盘子里，拿来给女子，女子就给她母亲。

chapters.en: On hearing of this, John’s disciples came and took his body and laid it in a tomb.
chapters.zh: 约翰的门徒听见了，就来把他的尸首领去，葬在坟墓里。

chapters.en: The apostles gathered around Jesus and reported to him all they had done and taught.
chapters.zh: 使徒聚集到耶稣那里，将一切所作的事，所传的道，全告诉他。

chapters.en: Then, because so many people were coming and going that they did not even have a chance to eat, he said to them, “Come with me by yourselves to a quiet place and get some rest.”
chapters.zh: 他就说，你们来同我暗暗地到旷野地方去歇一歇。这是因为来往的人多，他们连吃饭也没有工夫。

chapters.en: So they went away by themselves in a boat to a solitary place.
chapters.zh: 他们就坐船，暗暗地往旷野地方去。

chapters.en: But many who saw them leaving recognized them and ran on foot from all the towns and got there ahead of them.
chapters.zh: 众人看见他们去，有许多认识他们的，就从各城步行，一同跑到那里，比他们先赶到了。

chapters.en: When Jesus landed and saw a large crowd, he had compassion on them, because they were like sheep without a shepherd. So he began teaching them many things.
chapters.zh: 耶稣出来，见有许多的人，就怜悯他们。因为他们如同羊没有牧人一般。于是开口教训他们许多道理。

chapters.en: By this time it was late in the day, so his disciples came to him. “This is a remote place,” they said, “and it’s already very late.
chapters.zh: 天已经晚了，门徒进前来说，这是野地，天已经晚了，

chapters.en: Send the people away so that they can go to the surrounding countryside and villages and buy themselves something to eat.”
chapters.zh: 请叫众人散开，他们好往四面乡村里去，自己买什么吃。

chapters.en: But he answered, “You give them something to eat.”They said to him, “That would take more than half a year’s wages ! Are we to go and spend that much on bread and give it to them to eat?”
chapters.zh: 耶稣回答说，你们给他们吃吧。门徒说，我们可以去买二十两银子的饼，给他们吃吗？

chapters.en: “How many loaves do you have?” he asked. “Go and see.”When they found out, they said, “Five—and two fish.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣说，你们有多少饼，可以去看看。他们知道了，就说，五个饼，两条鱼。

chapters.en: Then Jesus directed them to have all the people sit down in groups on the green grass.
chapters.zh: 耶稣吩咐他们叫众人一帮一帮的，坐在青草地上。

chapters.en: So they sat down in groups of hundreds and fifties.
chapters.zh: 众人就一排一排的坐下，有一百一排的，有五十一排的。

chapters.en: Taking the five loaves and the two fish and looking up to heaven, he gave thanks and broke the loaves. Then he gave them to his disciples to distribute to the people. He also divided the two fish among them all.
chapters.zh: 耶稣拿着这五个饼，两条鱼，望着天祝福，掰开饼，递给门徒摆在众人面前。也把那两条鱼分给众人。

chapters.en: They all ate and were satisfied,
chapters.zh: 他们都吃，并且吃饱了。

chapters.en: and the disciples picked up twelve basketfuls of broken pieces of bread and fish.
chapters.zh: 门徒就把碎饼碎鱼，收拾起来，装满了十二个篮子。

chapters.en: The number of the men who had eaten was five thousand.
chapters.zh: 吃饼的男人，共有五千。

chapters.en: Immediately Jesus made his disciples get into the boat and go on ahead of him to Bethsaida, while he dismissed the crowd.
chapters.zh: 耶稣随即催门徒上船，先渡到那边伯赛大去，等他叫众人散开。

chapters.en: After leaving them, he went up on a mountainside to pray.
chapters.zh: 他既辞别了他们，就往山上去祷告。

chapters.en: Later that night, the boat was in the middle of the lake, and he was alone on land.
chapters.zh: 到了晚上，船在海中，耶稣独自在岸上。

chapters.en: He saw the disciples straining at the oars, because the wind was against them. Shortly before dawn he went out to them, walking on the lake. He was about to pass by them,
chapters.zh: 看见门徒，因风不顺，摇橹甚苦。夜里约有四更天，就在海面上走往他们那里去，意思要走过他们去。

chapters.en: but when they saw him walking on the lake, they thought he was a ghost. They cried out,
chapters.zh: 但门徒看见他在海面上走，以为是鬼怪，就喊叫起来。

chapters.en: because they all saw him and were terrified. Immediately he spoke to them and said, “Take courage! It is I. Don’t be afraid.”
chapters.zh: 因为他们都看见了他，且甚惊慌。耶稣连忙对他们说，你们放心。是我，不要怕。

chapters.en: Then he climbed into the boat with them, and the wind died down. They were completely amazed,
chapters.zh: 于是到他们那里上了船，风就住了。他们心里十分惊奇。

chapters.en: for they had not understood about the loaves; their hearts were hardened.
chapters.zh: 这是因为他们不明白那分饼的事，心里还是愚顽。

chapters.en: When they had crossed over, they landed at Gennesaret and anchored there.
chapters.zh: 既渡过去，来到革尼撒勒地方，就靠了岸。

chapters.en: As soon as they got out of the boat, people recognized Jesus.
chapters.zh: 一下船，众人认得是耶稣。

chapters.en: They ran throughout that whole region and carried the sick on mats to wherever they heard he was.
chapters.zh: 就跑遍那一带地方，听见他在何处，便将有病的人，用褥子抬到那里。

chapters.en: And wherever he went—into villages, towns or countryside—they placed the sick in the marketplaces. They begged him to let them touch even the edge of his cloak, and all who touched it were healed.
chapters.zh: 凡耶稣所到的地方，或村中，或城里，或乡间，他们都将病人放在街市上，求耶稣只容他们摸他的衣裳穗子。凡摸着的人，就都好了。

chapters.en: The Pharisees and some of the teachers of the law who had come from Jerusalem gathered around Jesus
chapters.zh: 有法利赛人，和几个文士，从耶路撒冷来，到耶稣那里聚集。

chapters.en: and saw some of his disciples eating food with hands that were defiled, that is, unwashed.
chapters.zh: 他们曾看见他的门徒中，有人用俗手，就是没有洗的手，吃饭。

chapters.en: (The Pharisees and all the Jews do not eat unless they give their hands a ceremonial washing, holding to the tradition of the elders.
chapters.zh: （原来法利赛人，和犹太人，都拘守古人的遗传，若不仔细洗手，就不吃饭。

chapters.en: When they come from the marketplace they do not eat unless they wash. And they observe many other traditions, such as the washing of cups, pitchers and kettles. )
chapters.zh: 从市上来，若不洗浴，也不吃饭，还有好些别的规矩，他们历代拘守，就是洗杯，罐，铜器，等物）。

chapters.en: So the Pharisees and teachers of the law asked Jesus, “Why don’t your disciples live according to the tradition of the elders instead of eating their food with defiled hands?”
chapters.zh: 法利赛人和文士问他说，你的门徒为什么不照古人的遗传，用俗手吃饭呢？

chapters.en: He replied, “Isaiah was right when he prophesied about you hypocrites; as it is written: “ ‘These people honor me with their lips, but their hearts are far from me.
chapters.zh: 耶稣说，以赛亚指着你们假冒为善之人所说的预言，是不错的，如经上说，这百姓用嘴唇尊敬我，心却远离我。

chapters.en: They worship me in vain; their teachings are merely human rules.’
chapters.zh: 他们将人的吩咐，当作道理教导人，所以拜我也是枉然。

chapters.en: You have let go of the commands of God and are holding on to human traditions.”
chapters.zh: 你们是离弃神的诫命，拘守人的遗传。

chapters.en: And he continued, “You have a fine way of setting aside the commands of God in order to observe your own traditions!
chapters.zh: 又说，你们诚然是废弃神的诫命，要守自己的遗传。

chapters.en: For Moses said, ‘Honor your father and mother,’and, ‘Anyone who curses their father or mother is to be put to death.’
chapters.zh: 摩西说，当孝敬父母。又说，咒骂父母的，必治死他。

chapters.en: But you say that if anyone declares that what might have been used to help their father or mother is Corban (that is, devoted to God)—
chapters.zh: 你们倒说，人若对父母说，我所当奉给你的，已经作了各耳板，（各耳板，就是供献的意思）

chapters.en: then you no longer let them do anything for their father or mother.
chapters.zh: 以后你们就不容他再奉养父母。

chapters.en: Thus you nullify the word of God by your tradition that you have handed down. And you do many things like that.”
chapters.zh: 这就是你们承接遗传，废了神的道。你们还作许多这样的事

chapters.en: Again Jesus called the crowd to him and said, “Listen to me, everyone, and understand this.
chapters.zh: 耶稣又叫众人来，对他们说，你们都要听我的话，也要明白。

chapters.en: Nothing outside a person can defile them by going into them. Rather, it is what comes out of a person that defiles them.”
chapters.zh: 从外面进去的，不能污秽人，惟有从里面出来的，乃能污秽人。（有古卷在此有，

chapters.en: If anyone has ears to hear, let him hear.]
chapters.zh: 有耳可听的就应当听）。

chapters.en: After he had left the crowd and entered the house, his disciples asked him about this parable.
chapters.zh: 耶稣离开众人，进了屋子，门徒就问他这比喻的意思。

chapters.en: “Are you so dull?” he asked. “Don’t you see that nothing that enters a person from the outside can defile them?
chapters.zh: 耶稣对他们说，你们也是这样不明白吗？岂不晓得凡从外面进入的，不能污秽人。

chapters.en: For it doesn’t go into their heart but into their stomach, and then out of the body.” (In saying this, Jesus declared all foods clean.)
chapters.zh: 因为不是入他的心，乃是入他的肚腹，又落到茅厕里。这是说，各样的食物，都是洁净的。

chapters.en: He went on: “What comes out of a person is what defiles them.
chapters.zh: 又说，从人里面出来的，那才能污秽人。

chapters.en: For it is from within, out of a person’s heart, that evil thoughts come—sexual immorality, theft, murder,
chapters.zh: 因为从里面，就是从人心里，发出恶念，苟合，

chapters.en: adultery, greed, malice, deceit, lewdness, envy, slander, arrogance and folly.
chapters.zh: 偷盗，凶杀，奸淫，贪婪，邪恶，诡诈，淫荡，嫉妒，毁谤，骄傲，狂妄。

chapters.en: All these evils come from inside and defile a person.”
chapters.zh: 这一切的恶，都是从里面出来，且能污秽人。

chapters.en: Jesus left that place and went to the vicinity of Tyre. He entered a house and did not want anyone to know it; yet he could not keep his presence secret.
chapters.zh: 耶稣从那里起身，往推罗西顿的境内去。进了一家，不愿意人知道，却隐藏不住。

chapters.en: In fact, as soon as she heard about him, a woman whose little daughter was possessed by an impure spirit came and fell at his feet.
chapters.zh: 当下有一个妇人，她的小女儿被污鬼附着，听见耶稣的事，就来俯伏在他脚前。

chapters.en: The woman was a Greek, born in Syrian Phoenicia. She begged Jesus to drive the demon out of her daughter.
chapters.zh: 这妇人是希利尼人，属叙利非尼基族。她求耶稣赶出那鬼，离开她的女儿。

chapters.en: “First let the children eat all they want,” he told her, “for it is not right to take the children’s bread and toss it to the dogs.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣对她说，让儿女们先吃饱。不好拿儿女的饼丢给狗吃。

chapters.en: “Lord,” she replied, “even the dogs under the table eat the children’s crumbs.”
chapters.zh: 妇人回答说，主阿，不错。但是狗在桌子底下，也吃孩子们的碎渣儿。

chapters.en: Then he told her, “For such a reply, you may go; the demon has left your daughter.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣对她说，因这句话，你回去吧。鬼已经离开你的女儿了。

chapters.en: She went home and found her child lying on the bed, and the demon gone.
chapters.zh: 她就回家去，见小孩子躺在床上，鬼已经出去了。

chapters.en: Then Jesus left the vicinity of Tyre and went through Sidon, down to the Sea of Galilee and into the region of the Decapolis.
chapters.zh: 耶稣又离了推罗的境界，经过西顿，就从低加波利境内来到加利利海。

chapters.en: There some people brought to him a man who was deaf and could hardly talk, and they begged Jesus to place his hand on him.
chapters.zh: 有人带着一个耳聋舌结的人，来见耶稣，求他按手在他身上。

chapters.en: After he took him aside, away from the crowd, Jesus put his fingers into the man’s ears. Then he spit and touched the man’s tongue.
chapters.zh: 耶稣领他离开众人，到一边去，就用指头探他的耳朵，吐唾沫抹他的舌头，

chapters.en: He looked up to heaven and with a deep sigh said to him, “Ephphatha!” (which means “Be opened!”).
chapters.zh: 望天叹息，对他说，以法大，就是说，开了吧。

chapters.en: At this, the man’s ears were opened, his tongue was loosened and he began to speak plainly.
chapters.zh: 他的耳朵就开了，舌结也解了，说话也清楚了。

chapters.en: Jesus commanded them not to tell anyone. But the more he did so, the more they kept talking about it.
chapters.zh: 耶稣嘱咐他们，不要告诉人。但他越发嘱咐，他们越发传扬开了。

chapters.en: People were overwhelmed with amazement. “He has done everything well,” they said. “He even makes the deaf hear and the mute speak.”
chapters.zh: 众人分外希奇，说，他所作的事都好，他连聋子也叫他们听见，哑吧也叫他们说话。

chapters.en: During those days another large crowd gathered. Since they had nothing to eat, Jesus called his disciples to him and said,
chapters.zh: 那时，又有许多人聚集，并没有什么吃的。耶稣叫门徒来，说，

chapters.en: “I have compassion for these people; they have already been with me three days and have nothing to eat.
chapters.zh: 我怜悯这众人，因为他们同我在这里已经三天，也没有吃的了。

chapters.en: If I send them home hungry, they will collapse on the way, because some of them have come a long distance.”
chapters.zh: 我若打发他们饿着回家，就必在路上困乏。因为其中有从远处来的。

chapters.en: His disciples answered, “But where in this remote place can anyone get enough bread to feed them?”
chapters.zh: 门徒回答说，在这野地，从哪里能得饼，叫这些人吃饱呢？

chapters.en: “How many loaves do you have?” Jesus asked. “Seven,” they replied.
chapters.zh: 耶稣问他们说，你们有多少饼？他们说，七个。

chapters.en: He told the crowd to sit down on the ground. When he had taken the seven loaves and given thanks, he broke them and gave them to his disciples to distribute to the people, and they did so.
chapters.zh: 他吩咐众人坐在地上，就拿着这七个饼，祝谢了，掰开递给门徒叫他们摆开，门徒就摆在众人面前。

chapters.en: They had a few small fish as well; he gave thanks for them also and told the disciples to distribute them.
chapters.zh: 又有几条小鱼。耶稣祝了福，就吩咐也摆在众人面前。

chapters.en: The people ate and were satisfied. Afterward the disciples picked up seven basketfuls of broken pieces that were left over.
chapters.zh: 众人都吃，并且吃饱了。收拾剩下的零碎，有七筐子。

chapters.en: About four thousand were present. After he had sent them away,
chapters.zh: 人数约有四千。耶稣打发他们走了，

chapters.en: he got into the boat with his disciples and went to the region of Dalmanutha.
chapters.zh: 随即同门徒上船，来到大玛努他境内。

chapters.en: The Pharisees came and began to question Jesus. To test him, they asked him for a sign from heaven.
chapters.zh: 法利赛人出来盘问耶稣，求他从天上显个神迹给他们看，想要试探他。

chapters.en: He sighed deeply and said, “Why does this generation ask for a sign? Truly I tell you, no sign will be given to it.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣心里深深的叹息说，这世代为什么求神迹呢？我实在告诉你们，没有神迹给这世代看。

chapters.en: Then he left them, got back into the boat and crossed to the other side.
chapters.zh: 他就离开他们，又上船往海那边去了。

chapters.en: The disciples had forgotten to bring bread, except for one loaf they had with them in the boat.
chapters.zh: 门徒忘了带饼。在船上除了一个饼，没有别的食物。

chapters.en: “Be careful,” Jesus warned them. “Watch out for the yeast of the Pharisees and that of Herod.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣嘱咐他们说，你们要谨慎，防备法利赛人的酵，和希律的酵。

chapters.en: They discussed this with one another and said, “It is because we have no bread.”
chapters.zh: 他们彼此议论说，这是因为我们没有饼吧。

chapters.en: Aware of their discussion, Jesus asked them: “Why are you talking about having no bread? Do you still not see or understand? Are your hearts hardened?
chapters.zh: 耶稣看出来，就说，你们为什么因为没有饼就议论呢？你们还不省悟，还不明白吗？你们的心还是愚顽吗？

chapters.en: Do you have eyes but fail to see, and ears but fail to hear? And don’t you remember?
chapters.zh: 你们有眼睛看不见吗？有耳朵，听不见吗？也不记得吗？

chapters.en: When I broke the five loaves for the five thousand, how many basketfuls of pieces did you pick up?”“Twelve,” they replied.
chapters.zh: 我掰开那五个饼分给五千人，你们收拾的零碎，装满了多少篮子呢？他们说，十二个。

chapters.en: “And when I broke the seven loaves for the four thousand, how many basketfuls of pieces did you pick up?”They answered, “Seven.”
chapters.zh: 又掰开那七个饼分给四千人，你们收拾的零碎，装满了多少筐子呢？他们说，七个。

chapters.en: He said to them, “Do you still not understand?”
chapters.zh: 耶稣说，你们还是不明白吗？

chapters.en: They came to Bethsaida, and some people brought a blind man and begged Jesus to touch him.
chapters.zh: 他们来到伯赛大，有人带一个瞎子来，求耶稣摸他。

chapters.en: He took the blind man by the hand and led him outside the village. When he had spit on the man’s eyes and put his hands on him, Jesus asked, “Do you see anything?”
chapters.zh: 耶稣拉着瞎子的手，领他到村外。就吐唾沫在他眼睛上，按手在他身上，问他说，你看见什么了。

chapters.en: He looked up and said, “I see people; they look like trees walking around.”
chapters.zh: 他就抬头一看说，我看见人了。他们好像树木，并且行走。

chapters.en: Once more Jesus put his hands on the man’s eyes. Then his eyes were opened, his sight was restored, and he saw everything clearly.
chapters.zh: 随后又按手在他眼睛上，他定睛一看，就复了原，样样都看得清楚了。

chapters.en: Jesus sent him home, saying, “Don’t even go into the village.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣打发他回家，说，连这村子你也不要进去。

chapters.en: Jesus and his disciples went on to the villages around Caesarea Philippi. On the way he asked them, “Who do people say I am?”
chapters.zh: 耶稣和门徒出去，往该撒利亚腓立比的村庄去。在路上问门徒说，人说我是谁。

chapters.en: They replied, “Some say John the Baptist; others say Elijah; and still others, one of the prophets.”
chapters.zh: 他们说，有人说，是施洗的约翰。有人说，是以利亚。又有人说，是先知里的一位。

chapters.en: “But what about you?” he asked. “Who do you say I am?”Peter answered, “You are the Messiah.”
chapters.zh: 又问他们说，你们说我是谁。彼得回答说，你是基督。

chapters.en: Jesus warned them not to tell anyone about him.
chapters.zh: 耶稣就禁戒他们，不要告诉人。

chapters.en: He then began to teach them that the Son of Man must suffer many things and be rejected by the elders, the chief priests and the teachers of the law, and that he must be killed and after three days rise again.
chapters.zh: 从此他教训他们说，人子必须受许多的苦，被长老祭司长和文士弃绝，并且被杀，过三天复活。

chapters.en: He spoke plainly about this, and Peter took him aside and began to rebuke him.
chapters.zh: 耶稣明明地说这话，彼得就拉着他，劝他。

chapters.en: But when Jesus turned and looked at his disciples, he rebuked Peter. “Get behind me, Satan!” he said. “You do not have in mind the concerns of God, but merely human concerns.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣转过来，看着门徒，就责备彼得说，撒但，退我后边去吧。因为你不体贴神的意思，只体贴人的意思。

chapters.en: Then he called the crowd to him along with his disciples and said: “Whoever wants to be my disciple must deny themselves and take up their cross and follow me.
chapters.zh: 于是叫众人和门徒来，对他们说，若有人要跟从我，就当舍己，背起他的十字架来跟从我。

chapters.en: For whoever wants to save their life will lose it, but whoever loses their life for me and for the gospel will save it.
chapters.zh: 因为凡要救自己生命的，（生命或作灵魂下同）必丧掉生命。凡为我和福音丧掉生命的，必救了生命。

chapters.en: What good is it for someone to gain the whole world, yet forfeit their soul?
chapters.zh: 人就是赚得全世界，赔上自己的生命，有什么益处呢？

chapters.en: Or what can anyone give in exchange for their soul?
chapters.zh: 人还能拿什么换生命呢？

chapters.en: If anyone is ashamed of me and my words in this adulterous and sinful generation, the Son of Man will be ashamed of them when he comes in his Father’s glory with the holy angels.”
chapters.zh: 凡在这淫乱罪恶的世代，把我和我的道当作可耻的，人子在他父的荣耀里，同圣天使降临的时候，也要把那人当作可耻的。

chapters.en: And he said to them, “Truly I tell you, some who are standing here will not taste death before they see that the kingdom of God has come with power.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣又对他们说，我实在告诉你们，站在这里的，有人在没尝死味以前，必要看见神的国大有能力临到。

chapters.en: After six days Jesus took Peter, James and John with him and led them up a high mountain, where they were all alone. There he was transfigured before them.
chapters.zh: 过了六天，耶稣带着彼得，雅各，约翰，暗暗地上了高山，就在他们面前变了形像。

chapters.en: His clothes became dazzling white, whiter than anyone in the world could bleach them.
chapters.zh: 衣服放光，极其洁白。地上漂布的，没有一个能漂得那样白。

chapters.en: And there appeared before them Elijah and Moses, who were talking with Jesus.
chapters.zh: 忽然有以利亚同摩西向他们显现。并且和耶稣说话。

chapters.en: Peter said to Jesus, “Rabbi, it is good for us to be here. Let us put up three shelters—one for you, one for Moses and one for Elijah.”
chapters.zh: 彼得对耶稣说，拉比，（拉比就是夫子）我们在这里真好。可以搭三座棚，一座为你，一座为摩西，一座为以利亚。

chapters.en: (He did not know what to say, they were so frightened.)
chapters.zh: 彼得不知道说什么才好。因为他们甚是惧怕，

chapters.en: Then a cloud appeared and covered them, and a voice came from the cloud: “This is my Son, whom I love. Listen to him!”
chapters.zh: 有一朵云彩来遮盖他们。也有声音从云彩里出来说，这是我的爱子，你们要听他。

chapters.en: Suddenly, when they looked around, they no longer saw anyone with them except Jesus.
chapters.zh: 门徒忽然周围一看，不再见一人，只见耶稣同他们在那里。

chapters.en: As they were coming down the mountain, Jesus gave them orders not to tell anyone what they had seen until the Son of Man had risen from the dead.
chapters.zh: 下山的时候，耶稣嘱咐他们说，人子还没有从死里复活，你们不要将所看见的告诉人。

chapters.en: They kept the matter to themselves, discussing what “rising from the dead” meant.
chapters.zh: 门徒将这话存记在心，彼此议论从死里复活是什么意思。

chapters.en: And they asked him, “Why do the teachers of the law say that Elijah must come first?”
chapters.zh: 他们就问耶稣说，文士为什么说，以利亚必须先来。

chapters.en: Jesus replied, “To be sure, Elijah does come first, and restores all things. Why then is it written that the Son of Man must suffer much and be rejected?
chapters.zh: 耶稣说，以利亚固然先来，复兴万事。经上不是指着人子说，他要受许多的苦，被人轻慢呢？

chapters.en: But I tell you, Elijah has come, and they have done to him everything they wished, just as it is written about him.”
chapters.zh: 我告诉你们，以利亚已经来了，他们也任意待他，正如经上所指着他的话。

chapters.en: When they came to the other disciples, they saw a large crowd around them and the teachers of the law arguing with them.
chapters.zh: 耶稣到了门徒那里，看见有许多人围着他们，又有文士和他们辩论。

chapters.en: As soon as all the people saw Jesus, they were overwhelmed with wonder and ran to greet him.
chapters.zh: 众人一见耶稣，都甚希奇，就跑上去问他的安。

chapters.en: “What are you arguing with them about?” he asked.
chapters.zh: 耶稣问他们说，你们和他们辩论的是什么。

chapters.en: A man in the crowd answered, “Teacher, I brought you my son, who is possessed by a spirit that has robbed him of speech.
chapters.zh: 众人中间有一个人回答说，夫子，我带了我的儿子到你这里来，他被哑巴鬼附着。

chapters.en: Whenever it seizes him, it throws him to the ground. He foams at the mouth, gnashes his teeth and becomes rigid. I asked your disciples to drive out the spirit, but they could not.”
chapters.zh: 无论在哪里，鬼捉弄他，把他摔倒，他就口中流沫，咬牙切齿，身体枯干，我请过你的门徒把鬼赶出去，他们却是不能。

chapters.en: “You unbelieving generation,” Jesus replied, “how long shall I stay with you? How long shall I put up with you? Bring the boy to me.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣说，嗳，不信的世代阿，我在你们这里要到几时呢？我忍耐你们要到几时呢？把他带到我这里来吧。

chapters.en: So they brought him. When the spirit saw Jesus, it immediately threw the boy into a convulsion. He fell to the ground and rolled around, foaming at the mouth.
chapters.zh: 他们就带了他来。他一见耶稣，鬼便叫他重重地抽疯。倒在地上，翻来覆去，口中流沫。

chapters.en: Jesus asked the boy’s father, “How long has he been like this?”“From childhood,” he answered.
chapters.zh: 耶稣问他父亲说，他得这病，有多少日子呢？回答说，从小的时候。

chapters.en: “It has often thrown him into fire or water to kill him. But if you can do anything, take pity on us and help us.”
chapters.zh: 鬼屡次把他扔在火里，水里，要灭他。你若能作什么，求你怜悯我们，帮助我们。

chapters.en: “ ‘If you can’?” said Jesus. “Everything is possible for one who believes.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣对他说，你若能信，在信的人，凡事都能。

chapters.en: Immediately the boy’s father exclaimed, “I do believe; help me overcome my unbelief!”
chapters.zh: 孩子的父亲立时喊着说，我信。但我信不足，求主帮助。（有古卷作立时流泪地喊着说）

chapters.en: When Jesus saw that a crowd was running to the scene, he rebuked the impure spirit. “You deaf and mute spirit,” he said, “I command you, come out of him and never enter him again.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣看见众人都跑上来，就斥责那污鬼，说，你这聋哑的鬼，我吩咐你从他里头出来，再不要进去。

chapters.en: The spirit shrieked, convulsed him violently and came out. The boy looked so much like a corpse that many said, “He’s dead.”
chapters.zh: 那鬼喊叫，使孩子大大地抽了一阵疯，就出来了。孩子好像死了一般，以致众人多半说，他是死了。

chapters.en: But Jesus took him by the hand and lifted him to his feet, and he stood up.
chapters.zh: 但耶稣拉着他的手，扶他起来，他就站起来了。

chapters.en: After Jesus had gone indoors, his disciples asked him privately, “Why couldn’t we drive it out?”
chapters.zh: 耶稣进了屋子，门徒就暗暗地问他说，我们为什么不能赶出他去呢？

chapters.en: He replied, “This kind can come out only by prayer.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣说，非用祷告，（有古卷在此有禁食二字）这一类的鬼，总不能出来。（或作不能赶他出来）

chapters.en: They left that place and passed through Galilee. Jesus did not want anyone to know where they were,
chapters.zh: 他们离开那地方，经过加利利。耶稣不愿意人知道。

chapters.en: because he was teaching his disciples. He said to them, “The Son of Man is going to be delivered into the hands of men. They will kill him, and after three days he will rise.”
chapters.zh: 于是教训门徒，说，人子将要被交在人手里，他们要杀害他。被杀以后，过三天他要复活。

chapters.en: But they did not understand what he meant and were afraid to ask him about it.
chapters.zh: 门徒却不明白这话，又不敢问他。

chapters.en: They came to Capernaum. When he was in the house, he asked them, “What were you arguing about on the road?”
chapters.zh: 他们来到迦百农。耶稣在屋里问门徒说，你们在路上议论的是什么。

chapters.en: But they kept quiet because on the way they had argued about who was the greatest.
chapters.zh: 门徒不作声，因为他们在路上彼此争论谁为大。

chapters.en: Sitting down, Jesus called the Twelve and said, “Anyone who wants to be first must be the very last, and the servant of all.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣坐下，叫十二个门徒来，说，若有人愿意作首先的，他必作众人末后的，作众人的用人。

chapters.en: He took a little child whom he placed among them. Taking the child in his arms, he said to them,
chapters.zh: 于是领过一个小孩子来，叫他站在门徒中间。又抱起他来，对他们说，

chapters.en: “Whoever welcomes one of these little children in my name welcomes me; and whoever welcomes me does not welcome me but the one who sent me.”
chapters.zh: 凡为我名，接待一个像这小孩子的就是接待我。凡接待我的，不是接待我，乃是接待那差我来的。

chapters.en: “Teacher,” said John, “we saw someone driving out demons in your name and we told him to stop, because he was not one of us.”
chapters.zh: 约翰对耶稣说，夫子，我们看见一个人，奉你的名赶鬼，我们就禁止他，因为他不跟从我们。

chapters.en: “Do not stop him,” Jesus said. “For no one who does a miracle in my name can in the next moment say anything bad about me,
chapters.zh: 耶稣说，不要禁止他。因为没有人奉我名行异能，反倒轻易毁谤我。

chapters.en: for whoever is not against us is for us.
chapters.zh: 不敌挡我们的，就是帮助我们的。

chapters.en: Truly I tell you, anyone who gives you a cup of water in my name because you belong to the Messiah will certainly not lose their reward.
chapters.zh: 凡因你们是属基督，给你们一杯水喝的，我实在告诉你们，他不能不得赏赐。

chapters.en: “If anyone causes one of these little ones—those who believe in me—to stumble, it would be better for them if a large millstone were hung around their neck and they were thrown into the sea.
chapters.zh: 凡使这信我的一个小子跌倒的，倒不如把大磨石拴在这人的颈项上，扔在海里。

chapters.en: If your hand causes you to stumble, cut it off. It is better for you to enter life maimed than with two hands to go into hell, where the fire never goes out.
chapters.zh: 倘若你一只手叫你跌倒，就把它砍下来。

chapters.en: Where their worm does not die, and the fire is not quenched.
chapters.zh: 你缺了肢体进入永生，强如有两只手落到地狱，入那不灭的火里去。

chapters.en: And if your foot causes you to stumble, cut it off. It is better for you to enter life crippled than to have two feet and be thrown into hell.
chapters.zh: 倘若你一只脚叫你跌倒，就把它砍下来。

chapters.en: Where their worm does not die, and the fire is not quenched.
chapters.zh: 你瘸腿进入永生，强如有两只脚被丢在地狱里。

chapters.en: And if your eye causes you to stumble, pluck it out. It is better for you to enter the kingdom of God with one eye than to have two eyes and be thrown into hell,
chapters.zh: 倘若你一只眼叫你跌倒，就去掉它。你只有一只眼进入神的国，强如有两只眼被丢在地狱里。

chapters.en: where “ ‘the worms that eat them do not die,and the fire is not quenched.’
chapters.zh: 在那里虫是不死的，火是不灭的。

chapters.en: Everyone will be salted with fire.
chapters.zh: 因为必用火当盐，腌各人。（有古卷在此有凡祭物必用盐腌）

chapters.en: “Salt is good, but if it loses its saltiness, how can you make it salty again? Have salt among yourselves, and be at peace with each other.”
chapters.zh: 盐本是好的，若失了味，可用什么叫它再咸呢？你们里头应当有盐，彼此和睦。

chapters.en: Jesus then left that place and went into the region of Judea and across the Jordan. Again crowds of people came to him, and as was his custom, he taught them.
chapters.zh: 耶稣从那里起身，来到犹太的境界，并约但河外。众人又聚集到他那里，他又照常教训他们。

chapters.en: Some Pharisees came and tested him by asking, “Is it lawful for a man to divorce his wife?”
chapters.zh: 有法利赛人来问他说，人休妻可以不可以，意思要试探他。

chapters.en: “What did Moses command you?” he replied.
chapters.zh: 耶稣回答说，摩西吩咐你们的是什么。

chapters.en: They said, “Moses permitted a man to write a certificate of divorce and send her away.”
chapters.zh: 他们说，摩西许人写了休书便可以休妻。

chapters.en: “It was because your hearts were hard that Moses wrote you this law,” Jesus replied.
chapters.zh: 耶稣说，摩西因为你们的心硬，所以写这条例给你们。

chapters.en: “But at the beginning of creation God ‘made them male and female.’
chapters.zh: 但从起初创造的时候，神造人是造男造女。

chapters.en: ‘For this reason a man will leave his father and mother and be united to his wife,
chapters.zh: 因此人要离开父母，与妻子连合，二人成为一体。

chapters.en: and the two will become one flesh.’So they are no longer two, but one flesh.
chapters.zh: 既然如此，夫妻不再是两个人，乃是一体的了。

chapters.en: Therefore what God has joined together, let no one separate.”
chapters.zh: 所以神配合的，人不可分开。

chapters.en: When they were in the house again, the disciples asked Jesus about this.
chapters.zh: 到了屋里，门徒就问他这事。

chapters.en: He answered, “Anyone who divorces his wife and marries another woman commits adultery against her.
chapters.zh: 耶稣对他们说，凡休妻另娶的，就是犯奸淫，辜负他的妻子。

chapters.en: And if she divorces her husband and marries another man, she commits adultery.”
chapters.zh: 妻子若离弃丈夫另嫁，也是犯奸淫了。

chapters.en: People were bringing little children to Jesus for him to place his hands on them, but the disciples rebuked them.
chapters.zh: 有人带着小孩子来见耶稣，要耶稣摸他们，门徒便责备那些人。

chapters.en: When Jesus saw this, he was indignant. He said to them, “Let the little children come to me, and do not hinder them, for the kingdom of God belongs to such as these.
chapters.zh: 耶稣看见就恼怒，对门徒说，让小孩子到我这里来，不要禁止他们。因为在神国的，正是这样的人。

chapters.en: Truly I tell you, anyone who will not receive the kingdom of God like a little child will never enter it.”
chapters.zh: 我实在告诉你们，凡要承受神国的，若不像小孩子，断不能进去。

chapters.en: And he took the children in his arms, placed his hands on them and blessed them.
chapters.zh: 于是抱着小孩子，给他们按手，为他们祝福。

chapters.en: As Jesus started on his way, a man ran up to him and fell on his knees before him. “Good teacher,” he asked, “what must I do to inherit eternal life?”
chapters.zh: 耶稣出来行路的时候，有一个人跑来，跪在他面前问他说，良善的夫子，我当作什么事，才可以承受永生。

chapters.en: “Why do you call me good?” Jesus answered. “No one is good—except God alone.
chapters.zh: 耶稣对他说，你为什么称我是良善的。除了神一位之外，再没有良善的。

chapters.en: You know the commandments: ‘You shall not murder, you shall not commit adultery, you shall not steal, you shall not give false testimony, you shall not defraud, honor your father and mother.’”
chapters.zh: 诫命你是晓得的，不可杀人，不可奸淫，不可偷盗，不可作假见证，不可亏负人，当孝敬父母。

chapters.en: “Teacher,” he declared, “all these I have kept since I was a boy.”
chapters.zh: 他对耶稣说，夫子，这一切我从小都遵守了。

chapters.en: Jesus looked at him and loved him. “One thing you lack,” he said. “Go, sell everything you have and give to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven. Then come, follow me.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣看着他，就爱他，对他说，你还缺少一件。去变卖你所有的，分给穷人，就必有财宝在天上。你还要来跟从我。

chapters.en: At this the man’s face fell. He went away sad, because he had great wealth.
chapters.zh: 他听见这话，脸上就变了色，忧忧愁愁地走了。因为他的产业很多。

chapters.en: Jesus looked around and said to his disciples, “How hard it is for the rich to enter the kingdom of God!”
chapters.zh: 耶稣周围一看，对门徒说，有钱财的人进神的国是何等的难哪。

chapters.en: The disciples were amazed at his words. But Jesus said again, “Children, how hard it isto enter the kingdom of God!
chapters.zh: 门徒希奇他的话。耶稣又对他们说，小子，倚靠钱财的人进神的国，是何等的难哪。

chapters.en: It is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle than for someone who is rich to enter the kingdom of God.”
chapters.zh: 骆驼穿过针的眼，比财主进神的国，还容易呢。

chapters.en: The disciples were even more amazed, and said to each other, “Who then can be saved?”
chapters.zh: 门徒就分外希奇，对他说，这样谁能得救呢？

chapters.en: Jesus looked at them and said, “With man this is impossible, but not with God; all things are possible with God.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣看着他们说，在人是不能，在神却不然。因为神凡事都能。

chapters.en: Then Peter spoke up, “We have left everything to follow you!”
chapters.zh: 彼得就对他说，看哪，我们已经撇下所有的跟从你了。

chapters.en: “Truly I tell you,” Jesus replied, “no one who has left home or brothers or sisters or mother or father or children or fields for me and the gospel
chapters.zh: 耶稣说，我实在告诉你们，人为我和福音，撇下房屋，或是弟兄，姐妹，父母，儿女，田地。

chapters.en: will fail to receive a hundred times as much in this present age: homes, brothers, sisters, mothers, children and fields—along with persecutions—and in the age to come eternal life.
chapters.zh: 没有不在今世得百倍的，就是房屋，弟兄，姐妹，母亲，儿女，田地，并且要受逼迫。在来世必得永生。

chapters.en: But many who are first will be last, and the last first.”
chapters.zh: 然而有许多在前的将要在后，在后的将要在前。

chapters.en: They were on their way up to Jerusalem, with Jesus leading the way, and the disciples were astonished, while those who followed were afraid. Again he took the Twelve aside and told them what was going to happen to him.
chapters.zh: 他们行路上耶路撒冷去。耶稣在前头走，门徒就希奇，跟从的人也害怕。耶稣又叫过十二个门徒来，把自己将要遭遇的事，告诉他们说，

chapters.en: “We are going up to Jerusalem,” he said, “and the Son of Man will be delivered over to the chief priests and the teachers of the law. They will condemn him to death and will hand him over to the Gentiles,
chapters.zh: 看哪，我们上耶路撒冷去，人子将要被交给祭司长和文士，他们要定他死罪，交给外邦人。

chapters.en: who will mock him and spit on him, flog him and kill him. Three days later he will rise.”
chapters.zh: 他们要戏弄他，吐唾沫在他脸上，鞭打他，杀害他。过了三天，他要复活。

chapters.en: Then James and John, the sons of Zebedee, came to him. “Teacher,” they said, “we want you to do for us whatever we ask.”
chapters.zh: 西庇太的儿子雅各，约翰进前来，对耶稣说，夫子，我们无论求你什么，愿你给我们作。

chapters.en: “What do you want me to do for you?” he asked.
chapters.zh: 耶稣说，要我给你们作什么。

chapters.en: They replied, “Let one of us sit at your right and the other at your left in your glory.”
chapters.zh: 他们说，赐我们在你的荣耀里，一个坐在你右边，一个坐在你左边。

chapters.en: “You don’t know what you are asking,” Jesus said. “Can you drink the cup I drink or be baptized with the baptism I am baptized with?”
chapters.zh: 耶稣说，你们不知道所求的是什么。我所喝的杯。你们能喝吗？我所受的洗，你们能受吗？

chapters.en: “We can,” they answered. Jesus said to them, “You will drink the cup I drink and be baptized with the baptism I am baptized with,
chapters.zh: 他们说，我们能。耶稣说，我所喝的杯，你们也要喝。我所受的洗，你们也要受。

chapters.en: but to sit at my right or left is not for me to grant. These places belong to those for whom they have been prepared.”
chapters.zh: 只是坐在我的左右，不是我可以赐的。乃是为谁预备的，就赐给谁。

chapters.en: When the ten heard about this, they became indignant with James and John.
chapters.zh: 那十个门徒听见，就恼怒雅各，约翰。

chapters.en: Jesus called them together and said, “You know that those who are regarded as rulers of the Gentiles lord it over them, and their high officials exercise authority over them.
chapters.zh: 耶稣叫他们来，对他们说，你们知道，外邦人有尊为君王的，治理他们。有大臣操权管束他们。

chapters.en: Not so with you. Instead, whoever wants to become great among you must be your servant,
chapters.zh: 只是在你们中间，不是这样。你们中间，谁愿为大，就必作你们的用人。

chapters.en: and whoever wants to be first must be slave of all.
chapters.zh: 在你们中间，谁愿为首，就必作众人的仆人。

chapters.en: For even the Son of Man did not come to be served, but to serve, and to give his life as a ransom for many.”
chapters.zh: 因为人子来，并不是要受人的服事，乃是要服事人，并且要舍命，作多人的赎价。

chapters.en: Then they came to Jericho. As Jesus and his disciples, together with a large crowd, were leaving the city, a blind man, Bartimaeus (which means “son of Timaeus”), was sitting by the roadside begging.
chapters.zh: 到了耶利哥。耶稣同门徒并许多人出耶利哥的时候，有一个讨饭的瞎子，是底买的儿子巴底买，坐在路旁。

chapters.en: When he heard that it was Jesus of Nazareth, he began to shout, “Jesus, Son of David, have mercy on me!”
chapters.zh: 他听见是拿撒勒的耶稣，就喊着说，大卫的子孙耶稣阿，可怜我吧。

chapters.en: Many rebuked him and told him to be quiet, but he shouted all the more, “Son of David, have mercy on me!”
chapters.zh: 有许多人责备他，不许他作声，他却越发大声喊着说，大卫的子孙哪，可怜我吧。

chapters.en: Jesus stopped and said, “Call him.”So they called to the blind man, “Cheer up! On your feet! He’s calling you.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣就站住，说，叫过他来。他们就叫那瞎子，对他说，放心，起来，他叫你啦。

chapters.en: Throwing his cloak aside, he jumped to his feet and came to Jesus.
chapters.zh: 瞎子就丢下衣服，跳起来，走到耶稣那里。

chapters.en: “What do you want me to do for you?” Jesus asked him. The blind man said, “Rabbi, I want to see.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣说，要我为你作什么。瞎子说，拉波尼，我要能看见。（拉波尼就是夫子）

chapters.en: “Go,” said Jesus, “your faith has healed you.” Immediately he received his sight and followed Jesus along the road.
chapters.zh: 耶稣说，你去吧。你的信救了你了。瞎子立刻看见了，就在路上跟随耶稣。

chapters.en: As they approached Jerusalem and came to Bethphage and Bethany at the Mount of Olives, Jesus sent two of his disciples,
chapters.zh: 耶稣和门徒将近耶路撒冷，到了伯法其和伯大尼，在橄榄山那里。耶稣就打发两个门徒，

chapters.en: saying to them, “Go to the village ahead of you, and just as you enter it, you will find a colt tied there, which no one has ever ridden. Untie it and bring it here.
chapters.zh: 对他们说，你们往对面村子里去。一进去的时候，必看见一匹驴驹拴在那里，是从来没有人骑过的。可以解开牵来。

chapters.en: If anyone asks you, ‘Why are you doing this?’ say, ‘The Lord needs it and will send it back here shortly.’ ”
chapters.zh: 若有人对你们说，为什么作这事。你们就说，主要用它。那人必立时让你们牵来。

chapters.en: They went and found a colt outside in the street, tied at a doorway. As they untied it,
chapters.zh: 他们去了，便看见一匹驴驹，拴在门外街道上，就把它解开。

chapters.en: some people standing there asked, “What are you doing, untying that colt?”
chapters.zh: 在那里站着的人，有几个说，你们解驴驹作什么。

chapters.en: They answered as Jesus had told them to, and the people let them go.
chapters.zh: 门徒照着耶稣所说的回答，那些人就任凭他们牵去了。

chapters.en: When they brought the colt to Jesus and threw their cloaks over it, he sat on it.
chapters.zh: 他们把驴驹牵到耶稣那里，把自己的衣服搭在上面，耶稣就骑上。

chapters.en: Many people spread their cloaks on the road, while others spread branches they had cut in the fields.
chapters.zh: 有许多人，把衣服铺在路上，也有人把田间的树枝砍下来，铺在路上。

chapters.en: Those who went ahead and those who followed shouted, “Hosanna! ” “Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord!”
chapters.zh: 前行后随的人，都喊着说，和散那，（和散那原有求救的意思，在此乃是称颂的话）奉主名来的，是应当称颂的。

chapters.en: “Blessed is the coming kingdom of our father David!” “Hosanna in the highest heaven!”
chapters.zh: 那将要来的我祖大卫之国，是应当称颂的。高高在上，和散那。

chapters.en: Jesus entered Jerusalem and went into the temple courts. He looked around at everything, but since it was already late, he went out to Bethany with the Twelve.
chapters.zh: 耶稣进了耶路撒冷，入了圣殿，周围看了各样物件。天色已晚，就和十二个门徒出城往伯大尼去了。

chapters.en: The next day as they were leaving Bethany, Jesus was hungry.
chapters.zh: 第二天，他们从伯大尼出来。耶稣饿了，

chapters.en: Seeing in the distance a fig tree in leaf, he went to find out if it had any fruit. When he reached it, he found nothing but leaves, because it was not the season for figs.
chapters.zh: 远远地看见一棵无花果树，树上有叶子，就往那里去，或者在树上可以找着什么。到了树下，竟找不着什么，不过有叶子。因为不是收无花果的时候。

chapters.en: Then he said to the tree, “May no one ever eat fruit from you again.” And his disciples heard him say it.
chapters.zh: 耶稣就对树说，从今以后，永没有人吃你的果子。他的门徒也听见了。

chapters.en: On reaching Jerusalem, Jesus entered the temple courts and began driving out those who were buying and selling there. He overturned the tables of the money changers and the benches of those selling doves,
chapters.zh: 他们来到耶路撒冷，耶稣进入圣殿，赶出殿里作买卖的人，推倒兑换银钱之人的桌子，和卖鸽子之人的凳子。

chapters.en: and would not allow anyone to carry merchandise through the temple courts.
chapters.zh: 也不许人拿着器具从殿里经过。

chapters.en: And as he taught them, he said, “Is it not written: ‘My house will be called a house of prayer for all nations’? But you have made it ‘a den of robbers.’”
chapters.zh: 便教训他们说，经上不是记着说，我的殿必称为万国祷告的殿吗？你们倒使它成为贼窝了。

chapters.en: The chief priests and the teachers of the law heard this and began looking for a way to kill him, for they feared him, because the whole crowd was amazed at his teaching.
chapters.zh: 祭司长和文士听见这话就想法子要除灭耶稣。却又怕他，因为众人都希奇他的教训。

chapters.en: When evening came, Jesus and his disciples went out of the city.
chapters.zh: 每天晚上，耶稣出城去。

chapters.en: In the morning, as they went along, they saw the fig tree withered from the roots.
chapters.zh: 早晨，他们从那里经过，看见无花果树连根都枯干了。

chapters.en: Peter remembered and said to Jesus, “Rabbi, look! The fig tree you cursed has withered!”
chapters.zh: 彼得想起耶稣的话来，就对他说，拉比，请看，你所咒诅的无花果树，已经枯干了。

chapters.en: “Have faith in God,” Jesus answered.
chapters.zh: 耶稣回答说，你们当信服神。

chapters.en: “TrulyI tell you, if anyone says to this mountain, ‘Go, throw yourself into the sea,’ and does not doubt in their heart but believes that what they say will happen, it will be done for them.
chapters.zh: 我实在告诉你们，无论何人对这座山说，你挪开此地投在海里。他若心里不疑惑，只信他所说的必成，就必给他成了。

chapters.en: Therefore I tell you, whatever you ask for in prayer, believe that you have received it, and it will be yours.
chapters.zh: 所以我告诉你们，凡你们祷告祈求的，无论是什么，只要信是得着的，就必得着。

chapters.en: And when you stand praying, if you hold anything against anyone, forgive them, so that your Father in heaven may forgive you your sins.”
chapters.zh: 你们站着祷告的时候，若想起有人得罪你们，就当饶恕他，好叫你们在天上的父，也饶恕你们的过犯。

chapters.en: But if you do not forgive, neither will your Father who is in heaven forgive your sins.
chapters.zh: 你们若不饶恕人，你们在天上的父，也不饶恕你们的过犯。（有古卷无此节）

chapters.en: They arrived again in Jerusalem, and while Jesus was walking in the temple courts, the chief priests, the teachers of the law and the elders came to him.
chapters.zh: 他们又来到耶路撒冷。耶稣在殿里行走的时候，祭司长和文士并长老进前来，

chapters.en: “By what authority are you doing these things?” they asked. “And who gave you authority to do this?”
chapters.zh: 问他说，你仗着什么权柄作这些事？给你这权柄的是谁呢？

chapters.en: Jesus replied, “I will ask you one question. Answer me, and I will tell you by what authority I am doing these things.
chapters.zh: 耶稣对他们说，我要问你们一句话，你们回答我，我就告诉你们，我仗着什么权柄作这些事。

chapters.en: John’s baptism—was it from heaven, or of human origin? Tell me!”
chapters.zh: 约翰的洗礼，是从天上来的是从人间来的呢？你们可以回答我。

chapters.en: They discussed it among themselves and said, “If we say, ‘From heaven,’ he will ask, ‘Then why didn’t you believe him?’
chapters.zh: 他们彼此商议说，我们若说从天上来，他必说，这样，你们为什么不信他呢？

chapters.en: But if we say, ‘Of human origin’ …” (They feared the people, for everyone held that John really was a prophet.)
chapters.zh: 若说从人间来，却又怕百姓。因为众人真以约翰为先知。

chapters.en: So they answered Jesus, “We don’t know.” Jesus said, “Neither will I tell you by what authority I am doing these things.”
chapters.zh: 于是回答耶稣说，我们不知道。耶稣说，我也不告诉你们，我仗着什么权柄作这些事。

chapters.en: Jesus then began to speak to them in parables: “A man planted a vineyard. He put a wall around it, dug a pit for the winepress and built a watchtower. Then he rented the vineyard to some farmers and moved to another place.
chapters.zh: 耶稣就用比喻对他们说，有人栽了一个葡萄园，周围圈上篱笆，挖了一个压酒池，盖了一座楼，租给园户，就往外国去了。

chapters.en: At harvest time he sent a servant to the tenants to collect from them some of the fruit of the vineyard.
chapters.zh: 到了时候，打发一个仆人到园户那里，要从园户收葡萄园的果子。

chapters.en: But they seized him, beat him and sent him away empty-handed.
chapters.zh: 园户拿住他，打了他，叫他空手回去。

chapters.en: Then he sent another servant to them; they struck this man on the head and treated him shamefully.
chapters.zh: 再打发一个仆人到他们那里。他们打伤他的头，并且凌辱他。

chapters.en: He sent still another, and that one they killed. He sent many others; some of them they beat, others they killed.
chapters.zh: 又打发一个仆人去。他们就杀了他。后又打发好些仆人去。有被他们打的，有被他们杀的。

chapters.en: “He had one left to send, a son, whom he loved. He sent him last of all, saying, ‘They will respect my son.’
chapters.zh: 园主还有一位，是他的爱子，末后又打发他去，意思说，他们必尊敬我的儿子。

chapters.en: “But the tenants said to one another, ‘This is the heir. Come, let’s kill him, and the inheritance will be ours.’
chapters.zh: 不料，那些园户彼此说，这是承受产业的。来吧，我们杀他，产业就归我们了。

chapters.en: So they took him and killed him, and threw him out of the vineyard.
chapters.zh: 于是拿住他，杀了他，把他丢在园外。

chapters.en: “What then will the owner of the vineyard do? He will come and kill those tenants and give the vineyard to others.
chapters.zh: 这样，葡萄园的主人要怎样办呢？他要来除灭那些园户，将葡萄园转给别人。

chapters.en: Haven’t you read this passage of Scripture: “ ‘The stone the builders rejected has become the cornerstone;
chapters.zh: 经上写着说匠人所弃的石头，已作了房角的头块石头。

chapters.en: the Lord has done this, and it is marvelous in our eyes’?”
chapters.zh: 这是主所作的，在我们眼中看为希奇。这经你们没有念过吗？

chapters.en: Then the chief priests, the teachers of the law and the elders looked for a way to arrest him because they knew he had spoken the parable against them. But they were afraid of the crowd; so they left him and went away.
chapters.zh: 他们看出这比喻是指着他们说的，就想要捉拿他，只是惧怕百姓。于是离开他走了。

chapters.en: Later they sent some of the Pharisees and Herodians to Jesus to catch him in his words.
chapters.zh: 后来他们打发几个法利赛人和几个希律党的人，到耶稣那里，要就着他的话陷害他。

chapters.en: They came to him and said, “Teacher, we know that you are a man of integrity. You aren’t swayed by others, because you pay no attention to who they are; but you teach the way of God in accordance with the truth. Is it right to pay the imperial tax to Caesar or not?
chapters.zh: 他们来了，就对他说，夫子，我们知道你是诚实的，什么人你都不徇情面。因为你不看人的外貌，乃是诚诚实实传神的道。纳税给该撒可以不可以。

chapters.en: Should we pay or shouldn’t we?” But Jesus knew their hypocrisy. “Why are you trying to trap me?” he asked. “Bring me a denarius and let me look at it.”
chapters.zh: 我们该纳不该纳。耶稣知道他们的假意，就对他们说，你们为什么试探我。拿一个银钱来给我看。

chapters.en: They brought the coin, and he asked them, “Whose image is this? And whose inscription?”“Caesar’s,” they replied.
chapters.zh: 他们就拿了来。耶稣说，这像和这号是谁的。他们说，是该撒的。

chapters.en: Then Jesus said to them, “Give back to Caesar what is Caesar’s and to God what is God’s.”And they were amazed at him.
chapters.zh: 耶稣说，该撒的物当归给该撒，神的物当归给神。他们就很希奇他。

chapters.en: Then the Sadducees, who say there is no resurrection, came to him with a question.
chapters.zh: 撒都该人常说，没有复活的事。他们来问耶稣说，

chapters.en: “Teacher,” they said, “Moses wrote for us that if a man’s brother dies and leaves a wife but no children, the man must marry the widow and raise up offspring for his brother.
chapters.zh: 夫子，摩西为我们写着说，人若死了，撇下妻子，没有孩子，他兄弟当娶他的妻，为哥哥生子立后。

chapters.en: Now there were seven brothers. The first one married and died without leaving any children.
chapters.zh: 有弟兄七人，第一个娶了妻，死了，没有留下孩子。

chapters.en: The second one married the widow, but he also died, leaving no child. It was the same with the third.
chapters.zh: 第二个娶了她，也死了，没有留下孩子。第三个也是这样。

chapters.en: In fact, none of the seven left any children. Last of all, the woman died too.
chapters.zh: 那七个人都没有留下孩子。末了，那妇人也死了。

chapters.en: At the resurrection whose wife will she be, since the seven were married to her?”
chapters.zh: 当复活的时候，她是哪一个的妻子呢？因为他们七个人都娶过她。

chapters.en: Jesus replied, “Are you not in error because you do not know the Scriptures or the power of God?
chapters.zh: 耶稣说，你们所以错了，岂不是因为不明白圣经，不晓得神的大能吗？

chapters.en: When the dead rise, they will neither marry nor be given in marriage; they will be like the angels in heaven.
chapters.zh: 人从死里复活，也不娶，也不嫁，乃像天上的使者一样。

chapters.en: Now about the dead rising—have you not read in the Book of Moses, in the account of the burning bush, how God said to him, ‘I am the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob’?
chapters.zh: 论到死人复活，你们没有念过摩西的书，荆棘篇上所载的吗？神对摩西说，我是亚伯拉罕的神，以撒的神，雅各的神。

chapters.en: He is not the God of the dead, but of the living. You are badly mistaken!”
chapters.zh: 神不是死人的神，乃是活人的神。你们是大错了。

chapters.en: One of the teachers of the law came and heard them debating. Noticing that Jesus had given them a good answer, he asked him, “Of all the commandments, which is the most important?”
chapters.zh: 有一个文士来，听见他们辩论，晓得耶稣回答得好，就问他说，诫命中哪是第一要紧的呢？

chapters.en: “The most important one,” answered Jesus, “is this: ‘Hear, O Israel: The Lord our God, the Lord is one.
chapters.zh: 耶稣回答说，第一要紧的，就是说，以色列阿，你要听。主我们神，是独一的主。

chapters.en: Love the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your mind and with all your strength.’
chapters.zh: 你要尽心，尽性，尽意，尽力，爱主你的神。

chapters.en: The second is this: ‘Love your neighbor as yourself.’There is no commandment greater than these.”
chapters.zh: 其次，就是说，要爱人如己。再没有比这两条诫命更大的了。

chapters.en: “Well said, teacher,” the man replied. “You are right in saying that God is one and there is no other but him.
chapters.zh: 那文士对耶稣说，夫子说，神是一位，实在不错。除了他以外，再没有别的神。

chapters.en: To love him with all your heart, with all your understanding and with all your strength, and to love your neighbor as yourself is more important than all burnt offerings and sacrifices.”
chapters.zh: 并且尽心，尽智，尽力爱他，又爱人如己，就比一切燔祭，和各样祭祀，好得多。

chapters.en: When Jesus saw that he had answered wisely, he said to him, “You are not far from the kingdom of God.” And from then on no one dared ask him any more questions.
chapters.zh: 耶稣见他回答的有智慧，就对他说，你离神的国不远了。从此以后，没有人敢再问他什么。

chapters.en: While Jesus was teaching in the temple courts, he asked, “Why do the teachers of the law say that the Messiah is the son of David?
chapters.zh: 耶稣在殿里教训人，就问他们说，文士怎么说，基督是大卫的子孙呢？

chapters.en: David himself, speaking by the Holy Spirit, declared: “ ‘The Lord said to my Lord:“Sit at my right hand until I put your enemies under your feet.” ’
chapters.zh: 大卫被圣灵感动说，主对我主说，你坐在我的右边，等我使你仇敌作你的脚凳。

chapters.en: David himself calls him ‘Lord.’ How then can he be his son?”The large crowd listened to him with delight.
chapters.zh: 大卫既自己称他为主，他怎么又是大卫的子孙呢？众人都喜欢听他。

chapters.en: As he taught, Jesus said, “Watch out for the teachers of the law. They like to walk around in flowing robes and be greeted with respect in the marketplaces,
chapters.zh: 耶稣在教训之间，说，你们要防备文士，他们好穿长衣游行，喜爱人在街市上问他们的安，

chapters.en: and have the most important seats in the synagogues and the places of honor at banquets.
chapters.zh: 又喜爱会堂里的高位筵席上的首座。

chapters.en: They devour widows’ houses and for a show make lengthy prayers. These men will be punished most severely.”
chapters.zh: 他们侵吞寡妇的家产，假意作很长的祷告。这些人要受更重的刑罚。

chapters.en: Jesus sat down opposite the place where the offerings were put and watched the crowd putting their money into the temple treasury. Many rich people threw in large amounts.
chapters.zh: 耶稣对银库坐着，看众人怎样投钱入库。有好些财主，往里投了若干的钱。

chapters.en: But a poor widow came and put in two very small copper coins, worth only a few cents.
chapters.zh: 有一个穷寡妇来，往里投了两个小钱，就是一个大钱。

chapters.en: Calling his disciples to him, Jesus said, “Truly I tell you, this poor widow has put more into the treasury than all the others.
chapters.zh: 耶稣叫门徒来，说，我实在告诉你们，这穷寡妇投入库里的，比众人所投的更多。

chapters.en: They all gave out of their wealth; but she, out of her poverty, put in everything—all she had to live on.”
chapters.zh: 因为他们都是自己有余，拿出来投在里头。但这寡妇是自己不足，把她一切养生的都投上了。

chapters.en: As Jesus was leaving the temple, one of his disciples said to him, “Look, Teacher! What massive stones! What magnificent buildings!”
chapters.zh: 耶稣从殿里出来的时候，有一个门徒对他说，夫子，请看，这是何等的石头，何等的殿宇。

chapters.en: “Do you see all these great buildings?” replied Jesus. “Not one stone here will be left on another; every one will be thrown down.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣对他说，你看见这大殿宇吗？将来在这里没有一块石头留在石头上，不被拆毁了。

chapters.en: As Jesus was sitting on the Mount of Olives opposite the temple, Peter, James, John and Andrew asked him privately,
chapters.zh: 耶稣在橄榄山上对圣殿而坐。彼得，雅各，约翰，和安得烈，暗暗地问他说，

chapters.en: “Tell us, when will these things happen? And what will be the sign that they are all about to be fulfilled?”
chapters.zh: 请告诉我们，什么时候有这些事呢？这一切事，将成的时候，有什么预兆呢？

chapters.en: Jesus said to them: “Watch out that no one deceives you.
chapters.zh: 耶稣说，你们要谨慎，免得有人迷惑你们。

chapters.en: Many will come in my name, claiming, ‘I am he,’ and will deceive many.
chapters.zh: 将来有好些人冒我的名来，说，我是基督。并且要迷惑许多人。

chapters.en: When you hear of wars and rumors of wars, do not be alarmed. Such things must happen, but the end is still to come.
chapters.zh: 你们听见打仗，和打仗的风声，不要惊慌。这些事是必须有的，只是末期还没有到。

chapters.en: Nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom. There will be earthquakes in various places, and famines. These are the beginning of birth pains.
chapters.zh: 民要攻打民，国要攻打国，多处必有地震，饥荒。这都是灾难的起头。（灾难原文作生产之难）

chapters.en: “You must be on your guard. You will be handed over to the local councils and flogged in the synagogues. On account of me you will stand before governors and kings as witnesses to them.
chapters.zh: 但你们要谨慎。因为人要把你们交给公会，并且你们在会堂里要受鞭打。又为我的缘故，站在诸侯与君王面前，对他们作见证。

chapters.en: And the gospel must first be preached to all nations.
chapters.zh: 然而福音必须先传给万民。

chapters.en: Whenever you are arrested and brought to trial, do not worry beforehand about what to say. Just say whatever is given you at the time, for it is not you speaking, but the Holy Spirit.
chapters.zh: 人把你们拉去交官的时候，不要预先思虑说什么。到那时候，赐给你们什么话，你们就说什么，因为说话的不是你们，乃是圣灵。

chapters.en: “Brother will betray brother to death, and a father his child. Children will rebel against their parents and have them put to death.
chapters.zh: 弟兄要把弟兄，父亲要把儿子，送到死地。儿女要起来与父母为敌，害死他们。

chapters.en: Everyone will hate you because of me, but the one who stands firm to the end will be saved.
chapters.zh: 并且你们要为我的名，被众人恨恶，惟有忍耐到底的，必然得救。

chapters.en: “When you see ‘the abomination that causes desolation’standing where itoes not belong—let the reader understand—then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains.
chapters.zh: 你们看见那行毁坏可憎的，站在不当站的地方。（读这经的人，须要会意）那时在犹太的，应当逃到山上。

chapters.en: Let no one on the housetop go down or enter the house to take anything out.
chapters.zh: 在房上的，不要下来，也不要进去拿家里的东西。

chapters.en: Let no one in the field go back to get their cloak.
chapters.zh: 在田里的，也不要回去取衣裳。

chapters.en: How dreadful it will be in those days for pregnant women and nursing mothers!
chapters.zh: 当那些日子，怀孕的和奶孩子的有祸了。

chapters.en: Pray that this will not take place in winter,
chapters.zh: 你们应当祈求，叫这些事不在冬天临到。

chapters.en: because those will be days of distress unequaled from the beginning, when God created the world, until now—and never to be equaled again.
chapters.zh: 因为在那些日子必有灾难，自从神创造万物直到如今，并没有这样的灾难。后来也必没有。

chapters.en: “If the Lord had not cut short those days, no one would survive. But for the sake of the elect, whom he has chosen, he has shortened them.
chapters.zh: 若不是主减少那日子，凡有血气的，总没有一个得救的。只是为主的选民，他将那日子减少了。

chapters.en: At that time if anyone says to you, ‘Look, here is the Messiah!’ or, ‘Look, there he is!’ do not believe it.
chapters.zh: 那时若有人对你们说，看哪，基督在这里。或说，基督在那里。你们不要信。

chapters.en: For false messiahs and false prophets will appear and perform signs and wonders to deceive, if possible, even the elect.
chapters.zh: 因为假基督，假先知，将要起来，显神迹奇事。倘若能行，就把选民迷惑了。

chapters.en: So be on your guard; I have told you everything ahead of time.
chapters.zh: 你们要谨慎。看哪，凡事我都预先告诉你们了。

chapters.en: “But in those days, following that distress, “ ‘the sun will be darkened, and the moon will not give its light;
chapters.zh: 在那些日子，那灾难以后，日头要变黑了，月亮也不放光，

chapters.en: the stars will fall from the sky, and the heavenly bodies will be shaken.’
chapters.zh: 众星要从天上坠落，天势都要震动。

chapters.en: “At that time people will see the Son of Man coming in clouds with great power and glory.
chapters.zh: 那时他们（马太二十四章三十节作地上的万族）要看见人子有大能力，大荣耀，驾云降临。

chapters.en: And he will send his angels and gather his elect from the four winds, from the ends of the earth to the ends of the heavens.
chapters.zh: 他要差遣天使，把他的选民，从四方，从地极直到天边，都招聚了来。（方原文作风）

chapters.en: “Now learn this lesson from the fig tree: As soon as its twigs get tender and its leaves come out, you know that summer is near.
chapters.zh: 你们可以从无花果树学个比方。当树枝发嫩长叶的时候，你们就知道夏天近了。

chapters.en: Even so, when you see these things happening, you know that itis near, right at the door.
chapters.zh: 这样，你们几时看见这些事成就，也该知道人子近了，（人子或作神的国）正在门口了。

chapters.en: Truly I tell you, this generation will certainly not pass away until all these things have happened.
chapters.zh: 我实在告诉你们，这世代还没有过去，这些事都要成就。

chapters.en: Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will never pass away.
chapters.zh: 天地要废去。我的话却不能废去。

chapters.en: “But about that day or hour no one knows, not even the angels in heaven, nor the Son, but only the Father.
chapters.zh: 但那日子，那时辰，没有人知道，连天上的使者也不知道，子也不知道，惟有父知道。

chapters.en: Be on guard! Be alert! You do not know when that time will come.
chapters.zh: 你们要谨慎，儆醒祈祷，因为你们不晓得那日期几时来到。

chapters.en: It’s like a man going away: He leaves his house and puts his servants in charge, each with their assigned task, and tells the one at the door to keep watch.
chapters.zh: 这事正如一个人离开本家，寄居外邦，把权柄交给仆人，分派各人当作的工，又吩咐看门的儆醒。

chapters.en: “Therefore keep watch because you do not know when the owner of the house will come back—whether in the evening, or at midnight, or when the rooster crows, or at dawn.
chapters.zh: 所以你们要儆醒，因为你们不知道家主什么时候来，或晚上，或半夜，或鸡叫，或早晨。

chapters.en: If he comes suddenly, do not let him find you sleeping.
chapters.zh: 恐怕他忽然来到，看见你们睡着了。

chapters.en: What I say to you, I say to everyone: ‘Watch!’ ”
chapters.zh: 我对你们所说的话，也是对众人说，要儆醒。

chapters.en: Now the Passover and the Festival of Unleavened Bread were only two days away, and the chief priests and the teachers of the law were scheming to arrest Jesus secretly and kill him.
chapters.zh: 过两天是逾越节，又是除酵节。祭司长和文士，想法子怎么用诡计捉拿耶稣杀他。

chapters.en: “But not during the festival,” they said, “or the people may riot.”
chapters.zh: 只是说，当节的日子不可，恐怕百姓生乱。

chapters.en: While he was in Bethany, reclining at the table in the home of Simon the Leper, a woman came with an alabaster jar of very expensive perfume, made of pure nard. She broke the jar and poured the perfume on his head.
chapters.zh: 耶稣在伯大尼长大麻疯的西门家里坐席的时候，有一个女人，拿着一玉瓶至贵的真哪哒香膏来，打破玉瓶，把膏浇在耶稣的头上。

chapters.en: Some of those present were saying indignantly to one another, “Why this waste of perfume?
chapters.zh: 有几个人心中很不喜悦，说，何用这样枉费香膏呢？

chapters.en: It could have been sold for more than a year’s wages and the money given to the poor.” And they rebuked her harshly.
chapters.zh: 这香膏可以卖三十多两银子周济穷人。他们就向那女人生气。

chapters.en: “Leave her alone,” said Jesus. “Why are you bothering her? She has done a beautiful thing to me.
chapters.zh: 耶稣说，由她吧。为什么难为她呢？她在我身上作的是一件美事。

chapters.en: The poor you will always have with you,and you can help them any time you want. But you will not always have me.
chapters.zh: 因为常有穷人和你们同在，要向他们行善，随时都可以。只是你们不常有我。

chapters.en: She did what she could. She poured perfume on my body beforehand to prepare for my burial.
chapters.zh: 她所作的，是尽她所能的。她是为我安葬的事，把香膏预先浇在我身上。

chapters.en: Truly I tell you, wherever the gospel is preached throughout the world, what she has done will also be told, in memory of her.”
chapters.zh: 我实在告诉你们，普天之下，无论在什么地方传这福音，也要述说这女人所作的以为记念。

chapters.en: Then Judas Iscariot, one of the Twelve, went to the chief priests to betray Jesus to them.
chapters.zh: 十二门徒之中有一个加略人犹大，去见祭司长，要把耶稣交给他们。

chapters.en: They were delighted to hear this and promised to give him money. So he watched for an opportunity to hand him over.
chapters.zh: 他们听见就欢喜，又应许给他银子。他就寻思如何得便，把耶稣交给他们。

chapters.en: On the first day of the Festival of Unleavened Bread, when it was customary to sacrifice the Passover lamb, Jesus’ disciples asked him, “Where do you want us to go and make preparations for you to eat the Passover?”
chapters.zh: 除酵节的第一天，就是宰逾越羊羔的那一天，门徒对耶稣说，你吃逾越节的筵席，要我们往哪里去预备呢？

chapters.en: So he sent two of his disciples, telling them, “Go into the city, and a man carrying a jar of water will meet you. Follow him.
chapters.zh: 耶稣就打发两个门徒，对他们说，你们进城去，必有人拿着一瓶水，迎面而来。你们就跟着他。

chapters.en: Say to the owner of the house he enters, ‘The Teacher asks: Where is my guest room, where I may eat the Passover with my disciples?’
chapters.zh: 他进那家去，你们就对那家的主人说，夫子说，客房在哪里？我与门徒好在那里吃逾越节的筵席。

chapters.en: He will show you a large room upstairs, furnished and ready. Make preparations for us there.”
chapters.zh: 他必指给你们摆设整齐的一间大楼，你们就在那里为我们预备。

chapters.en: The disciples left, went into the city and found things just as Jesus had told them. So they prepared the Passover.
chapters.zh: 门徒出去，进了城，所遇见的，正如耶稣所说的。他们就预备了逾越节的筵席

chapters.en: When evening came, Jesus arrived with the Twelve.
chapters.zh: 到了晚上，耶稣和十二个门徒都来了。

chapters.en: While they were reclining at the table eating, he said, “Truly I tell you, one of you will betray me—one who is eating with me.”
chapters.zh: 他们坐席正吃的时候，耶稣说，我实在告诉你们，你们中间有一个与我同吃的人要卖我了。

chapters.en: They were saddened, and one by one they said to him, “Surely you don’t mean me?”
chapters.zh: 他们就忧愁起来，一个一个地问他说，是我吗？

chapters.en: “It is one of the Twelve,” he replied, “one who dips bread into the bowl with me.
chapters.zh: 耶稣对他们说，是十二个门徒中同我蘸手在盘子里的那个人。

chapters.en: The Son of Man will go just as it is written about him. But woe to that man who betrays the Son of Man! It would be better for him if he had not been born.”
chapters.zh: 人子必要去世，正如经上指着他所写的。但卖人子的人有祸了，那人不生在世上倒好。

chapters.en: While they were eating, Jesus took bread, and when he had given thanks, he broke it and gave it to his disciples, saying, “Take it; this is my body.”
chapters.zh: 他们吃的时候，耶稣拿起饼来，祝了福，就掰开递给他们说，你们拿着吃。这是我的身体。

chapters.en: Then he took a cup, and when he had given thanks, he gave it to them, and they all drank from it.
chapters.zh: 又拿起杯来，祝谢了，递给他们。他们都喝了。

chapters.en: “This is my blood of the covenant, which is poured out for many,” he said to them.
chapters.zh: 耶稣说，这是我立约的血，为多人流出来的。

chapters.en: “Truly I tell you, I will not drink again from the fruit of the vine until that day when I drink it new in the kingdom of God.”
chapters.zh: 我实在告诉你们，我不再喝这葡萄汁，直到我在神的国里，喝新的那日子。

chapters.en: When they had sung a hymn, they went out to the Mount of Olives.
chapters.zh: 他们唱了诗，就出来，往橄榄山去。

chapters.en: “You will all fall away,” Jesus told them, “for it is written: “ ‘I will strike the shepherd, and the sheep will be scattered.’
chapters.zh: 耶稣对他们说，你们都要跌倒了。因为经上记着说，我要击打牧人，羊就分散了。

chapters.en: But after I have risen, I will go ahead of you into Galilee.”
chapters.zh: 但我复活以后，要在你们以先往加利利去。

chapters.en: Peter declared, “Even if all fall away, I will not.”
chapters.zh: 彼得说，众人虽然跌倒，我总不能。

chapters.en: “Truly I tell you,” Jesus answered, “today—yes, tonight—before the rooster crows twice you yourself will disown me three times.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣对他说，我实在告诉你，就在今天夜里，鸡叫两遍以先，你要三次不认我。

chapters.en: But Peter insisted emphatically, “Even if I have to die with you, I will never disown you.” And all the others said the same.
chapters.zh: 彼得却极力地说，我就是必须和你同死，也总不能不认你。众门徒都是这样说。

chapters.en: They went to a place called Gethsemane, and Jesus said to his disciples, “Sit here while I pray.”
chapters.zh: 他们来到一个地方，名叫客西马尼。耶稣对门徒说，你们坐在这里，等我祷告。

chapters.en: He took Peter, James and John along with him, and he began to be deeply distressed and troubled.
chapters.zh: 于是带着彼得，雅各，约翰同去，就惊恐起来，极其难过。

chapters.en: “My soul is overwhelmed with sorrow to the point of death,” he said to them. “Stay here and keep watch.”
chapters.zh: 对他们说，我心里甚是忧伤，几乎要死。你们在这里，等候儆醒。

chapters.en: Going a little farther, he fell to the ground and prayed that if possible the hour might pass from him.
chapters.zh: 他就稍往前走，俯伏在地祷告说，倘若可行，便叫那时候过去。

chapters.en: “Abba,Father,” he said, “everything is possible for you. Take this cup from me. Yet not what I will, but what you will.”
chapters.zh: 他说，阿爸，父阿，在你凡事都能。求你将这杯撤去。然而不要从我的意思，只要从你的意思。

chapters.en: Then he returned to his disciples and found them sleeping. “Simon,” he said to Peter, “are you asleep? Couldn’t you keep watch for one hour?
chapters.zh: 耶稣回来，见他们睡着了，就对彼得说，西门，你睡觉吗？不能儆醒片时吗？

chapters.en: Watch and pray so that you will not fall into temptation. The spirit is willing, but the flesh is weak.”
chapters.zh: 总要儆醒祷告，免得入了迷惑。你们心灵固然愿意，肉体却软弱了。

chapters.en: Once more he went away and prayed the same thing.
chapters.zh: 耶稣又去祷告，说的话还是与先前一样。

chapters.en: When he came back, he again found them sleeping, because their eyes were heavy. They did not know what to say to him.
chapters.zh: 又来见他们睡着了，因为他们的眼睛甚是困倦。他们也不知道怎么回答。

chapters.en: Returning the third time, he said to them, “Are you still sleeping and resting? Enough! The hour has come. Look, the Son of Man is delivered into the hands of sinners.
chapters.zh: 第三次来，对他们说，现在你们仍然睡觉安歇吧。（吧或作吗）够了，时候到了。看哪，人子被卖在罪人手里了。

chapters.en: Rise! Let us go! Here comes my betrayer!”
chapters.zh: 起来，我们走吧。看哪，那卖我的人近了。

chapters.en: Just as he was speaking, Judas, one of the Twelve, appeared. With him was a crowd armed with swords and clubs, sent from the chief priests, the teachers of the law, and the elders.
chapters.zh: 说话之间，忽然那十二个门徒里的犹大来了，并有许多人带着刀棒，从祭司长和文士并长老那里与他同来。

chapters.en: Now the betrayer had arranged a signal with them: “The one I kiss is the man; arrest him and lead him away under guard.”
chapters.zh: 卖耶稣的人曾给他们一个暗号，说，我与谁亲嘴，谁就是他。你们把他拿住，牢牢靠靠的带去。

chapters.en: Going at once to Jesus, Judas said, “Rabbi!” and kissed him.
chapters.zh: 犹大来了，随即到耶稣跟前说，拉比，便与他亲嘴。

chapters.en: The men seized Jesus and arrested him.
chapters.zh: 他们就下手拿住他。

chapters.en: Then one of those standing near drew his sword and struck the servant of the high priest, cutting off his ear.
chapters.zh: 旁边站着的人，有一个拔出刀来，将大祭司的仆人砍了一刀，削掉了他一个耳朵。

chapters.en: “Am I leading a rebellion,” said Jesus, “that you have come out with swords and clubs to capture me?
chapters.zh: 耶稣对他们说，你们带着刀棒，出来拿我，如同拿强盗吗？

chapters.en: Every day I was with you, teaching in the temple courts, and you did not arrest me. But the Scriptures must be fulfilled.”
chapters.zh: 我天天教训人，同你们在殿里，你们并没有拿我。但这事成就，为要应验经上的话。

chapters.en: Then everyone deserted him and fled.
chapters.zh: 门徒都离开他逃走了。

chapters.en: A young man, wearing nothing but a linen garment, was following Jesus. When they seized him,
chapters.zh: 有一个少年人，赤身披着一块麻布，跟随耶稣，众人就捉拿他。

chapters.en: he fled naked, leaving his garment behind.
chapters.zh: 他却丢了麻布，赤身逃走了。

chapters.en: They took Jesus to the high priest, and all the chief priests, the elders and the teachers of the law came together.
chapters.zh: 他们把耶稣带到大祭司那里。又有众祭司长和长老并文士，都来和大祭司一同聚集。

chapters.en: Peter followed him at a distance, right into the courtyard of the high priest. There he sat with the guards and warmed himself at the fire.
chapters.zh: 彼得远远地跟着耶稣，一直进入大祭司的院里，和差役一同坐在火光里烤火。

chapters.en: The chief priests and the whole Sanhedrin were looking for evidence against Jesus so that they could put him to death, but they did not find any.
chapters.zh: 祭司长和全公会寻找见证控告耶稣，要治死他。却寻不着。

chapters.en: Many testified falsely against him, but their statements did not agree.
chapters.zh: 因为有好些人作假见证告他，只是他们的见证，各不相合。

chapters.en: Then some stood up and gave this false testimony against him:
chapters.zh: 又有几个人站起来，作假见证告他说，

chapters.en: “We heard him say, ‘I will destroy this temple made with human hands and in three days will build another, not made with hands.’ ”
chapters.zh: 我们听见他说，我要拆毁这人手所造的殿，三日内就另造一座不是人手所造的。

chapters.en: Yet even then their testimony did not agree.
chapters.zh: 他们就是这么作见证，也是各不相合。

chapters.en: Then the high priest stood up before them and asked Jesus, “Are you not going to answer? What is this testimony that these men are bringing against you?”
chapters.zh: 大祭司起来，站在中间，问耶稣说，你什么都不回答吗？这些人作见证告你的是什么呢？

chapters.en: But Jesus remained silent and gave no answer. Again the high priest asked him, “Are you the Messiah, the Son of the Blessed One?”
chapters.zh: 耶稣却不言语，一句也不回答。大祭司又问他说，你是那当称颂者的儿子基督不是。

chapters.en: “I am,” said Jesus. “And you will see the Son of Man sitting at the right hand of the Mighty One and coming on the clouds of heaven.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣说，我是。你们必看见人子，坐在那权能者的右边，驾着天上的云降临。

chapters.en: The high priest tore his clothes. “Why do we need any more witnesses?” he asked.
chapters.zh: 大祭司就撕开衣服，说，我们何必再用见证人呢？

chapters.en: “You have heard the blasphemy. What do you think?” They all condemned him as worthy of death.
chapters.zh: 你们已经听见他这僭妄的话了。你们的意见如何？他们都定他该死的罪。

chapters.en: Then some began to spit at him; they blindfolded him, struck him with their fists, and said, “Prophesy!” And the guards took him and beat him.
chapters.zh: 就有人吐唾沫在他脸上，又蒙着他的脸，用拳头打他，对他说，你说预言吧。差役接过他来用手掌打他。

chapters.en: While Peter was below in the courtyard, one of the servant girls of the high priest came by.
chapters.zh: 彼得在下边，院子里，来了大祭司的一个使女。

chapters.en: When she saw Peter warming himself, she looked closely at him. “You also were with that Nazarene, Jesus,” she said.
chapters.zh: 见彼得烤火，就看着他说，你素来也是同拿撒勒人耶稣一伙的。

chapters.en: But he denied it. “I don’t know or understand what you’re talking about,” he said, and went out into the entryway.
chapters.zh: 彼得却不承认，说，我不知道，也不明白你说的是什么。于是出来，到了前院。鸡就叫了。

chapters.en: When the servant girl saw him there, she said again to those standing around, “This fellow is one of them.”
chapters.zh: 那使女看见他，又对旁边站着的人说，这也是他们一党的。

chapters.en: Again he denied it. After a little while, those standing near said to Peter, “Surely you are one of them, for you are a Galilean.”
chapters.zh: 彼得又不承认。过了不多的时候，旁边站着的人又对彼得说，你真是他们一党的。因为你是加利利人。

chapters.en: He began to call down curses, and he swore to them, “I don’t know this man you’re talking about.”
chapters.zh: 彼得就发咒起誓地说，我不认得你们说的这个人。

chapters.en: Immediately the rooster crowed the second time. Then Peter remembered the word Jesus had spoken to him: “Before the rooster crows twice you will disown me three times.” And he broke down and wept.
chapters.zh: 立时鸡叫了第二遍。彼得想起耶稣对他所说的话，鸡叫两遍以先，你要三次不认我。思想起来，就哭了。

chapters.en: Very early in the morning, the chief priests, with the elders, the teachers of the law and the whole Sanhedrin, made their plans. So they bound Jesus, led him away and handed him over to Pilate.
chapters.zh: 一到早晨，祭司长和长老文士全公会的人大家商议，就把耶稣捆绑解去，交给彼拉多。

chapters.en: “Are you the king of the Jews?” asked Pilate. “You have said so,” Jesus replied.
chapters.zh: 彼拉多问他说，你是犹太人的王吗？耶稣回答说，你说的是。

chapters.en: The chief priests accused him of many things.
chapters.zh: 祭司长告他许多的事。

chapters.en: So again Pilate asked him, “Aren’t you going to answer? See how many things they are accusing you of.”
chapters.zh: 彼拉多又问他说，你看，他们告你这么多的事，你什么都不回答吗？

chapters.en: But Jesus still made no reply, and Pilate was amazed.
chapters.zh: 耶稣仍不回答，以致彼拉多觉得希奇。

chapters.en: Now it was the custom at the festival to release a prisoner whom the people requested.
chapters.zh: 每逢这节期，巡抚照众人所求的，释放一个囚犯给他们。

chapters.en: A man called Barabbas was in prison with the insurrectionists who had committed murder in the uprising.
chapters.zh: 有一个人名叫巴拉巴，和作乱的人一同捆绑。他们作乱的时候，曾杀过人。

chapters.en: The crowd came up and asked Pilate to do for them what he usually did.
chapters.zh: 众人上去求巡抚，照常例给他们办。

chapters.en: “Do you want me to release to you the king of the Jews?” asked Pilate,
chapters.zh: 彼拉多说，你们要我释放犹太人的王给你们吗？

chapters.en: knowing it was out of self-interest that the chief priests had handed Jesus over to him.
chapters.zh: 他原晓得祭司长是因为嫉妒才把耶稣解了来。

chapters.en: But the chief priests stirred up the crowd to have Pilate release Barabbas instead.
chapters.zh: 只是祭司长挑唆众人，宁可释放巴拉巴给他们。

chapters.en: “What shall I do, then, with the one you call the king of the Jews?” Pilate asked them.
chapters.zh: 彼拉多又说，那么样你们所称为犹太人的王，我怎么办他呢？

chapters.en: “Crucify him!” they shouted.
chapters.zh: 他们又喊着说，把他钉十字架。

chapters.en: “Why? What crime has he committed?” asked Pilate. But they shouted all the louder, “Crucify him!”
chapters.zh: 彼拉多说，为什么呢？他作了什么恶事呢？他们便极力地喊着说，把他钉十字架。

chapters.en: Wanting to satisfy the crowd, Pilate released Barabbas to them. He had Jesus flogged, and handed him over to be crucified.
chapters.zh: 彼拉多要叫众人喜悦，就释放巴拉巴给他们，将耶稣鞭打了，交给人钉十字架。

chapters.en: The soldiers led Jesus away into the palace (that is, the Praetorium) and called together the whole company of soldiers.
chapters.zh: 兵丁把耶稣带进衙门院里。叫齐了全营的兵。

chapters.en: They put a purple robe on him, then twisted together a crown of thorns and set it on him.
chapters.zh: 他们给他穿上紫袍，又用荆棘编作冠冕给他戴上。

chapters.en: And they began to call out to him, “Hail, king of the Jews!”
chapters.zh: 就庆贺他说，恭喜犹太人的王阿。

chapters.en: Again and again they struck him on the head with a staff and spit on him. Falling on their knees, they paid homage to him.
chapters.zh: 又拿一根苇子，打他的头，吐唾沫在他脸上屈膝拜他。

chapters.en: And when they had mocked him, they took off the purple robe and put his own clothes on him. Then they led him out to crucify him.
chapters.zh: 戏弄完了，就给他脱了紫袍，仍穿上他自己的衣服，带他出去，要钉十字架。

chapters.en: A certain man from Cyrene, Simon, the father of Alexander and Rufus, was passing by on his way in from the country, and they forced him to carry the cross.
chapters.zh: 有一个古利奈人西门，就是亚力山大和鲁孚的父亲，从乡下来，经过那地方。他们就勉强他同去，好背着耶稣的十字架。

chapters.en: They brought Jesus to the place called Golgotha (which means “the place of the skull”).
chapters.zh: 他们带耶稣到了各各他地方，（各各他翻出来，就是髑髅地）

chapters.en: Then they offered him wine mixed with myrrh, but he did not take it.
chapters.zh: 拿没药调和的酒给耶稣，他却不受。

chapters.en: And they crucified him. Dividing up his clothes, they cast lots to see what each would get.
chapters.zh: 于是将他钉在十字架上，拈阄分他的衣服，看是谁得什么。

chapters.en: It was nine in the morning when they crucified him.
chapters.zh: 钉他在十字架上，是巳初的时候。

chapters.en: The written notice of the charge against him read: THE KING OF THE JEWS.
chapters.zh: 在上面有他的罪状，写的是犹太人的王。

chapters.en: They crucified two rebels with him, one on his right and one on his left.
chapters.zh: 他们又把两个强盗，和他同钉十字架。一个在右边，一个在左边。（有古卷在此有

chapters.en: and the scripture was fulfilled which says, “He was counted with the lawless ones” (Isa 53:12)
chapters.zh: 这就应了经上的话说，他被列在罪犯之中）

chapters.en: Those who passed by hurled insults at him, shaking their heads and saying,“So! You who are going to destroy the temple and build it in three days,
chapters.zh: 从那里经过的人辱骂他，摇着头说，咳，你这拆毁圣殿，三日又建造起来的。

chapters.en: come down from the cross and save yourself!”
chapters.zh: 可以救自己从十字架上下来吧。

chapters.en: In the same way the chief priests and the teachers of the law mocked him among themselves. “He saved others,” they said, “but he can’t save himself!
chapters.zh: 祭司长和文士也是这样戏弄他，彼此说，他救了别人，不能救自己。

chapters.en: Let this Messiah, this king of Israel, come down now from the cross, that we may see and believe.” Those crucified with him also heaped insults on him.
chapters.zh: 以色列的王基督，现在可以从十字架上下来，叫我们看见，就信了。那和他同钉的人也是讥诮他。

chapters.en: At noon, darkness came over the whole land until three in the afternoon.
chapters.zh: 从午正到申初遍地都黑暗了。

chapters.en: And at three in the afternoon Jesus cried out in a loud voice, “Eloi, Eloi, lema sabachthani?” (which means “My God, my God, why have you forsaken me?”).
chapters.zh: 申初的时候，耶稣大声喊着说，以罗伊，以罗伊，拉马撒巴各大尼？翻出来，就是，我的神，我的神，为什么离弃我？

chapters.en: When some of those standing near heard this, they said, “Listen, he’s calling Elijah.”
chapters.zh: 旁边站着的人，有的听见就说，看哪，他叫以利亚呢。

chapters.en: Someone ran, filled a sponge with wine vinegar, put it on a staff, and offered it to Jesus to drink. “Now leave him alone. Let’s see if Elijah comes to take him down,” he said.
chapters.zh: 有一个人跑去，把海绒蘸满了醋，绑在苇子上，送给他喝，说，且等着，看以利亚来不来把他取下。

chapters.en: With a loud cry, Jesus breathed his last.
chapters.zh: 耶稣大声喊叫，气就断了。

chapters.en: The curtain of the temple was torn in two from top to bottom.
chapters.zh: 殿里的幔子，从上到下裂为两半。

chapters.en: And when the centurion, who stood there in front of Jesus, saw how he died,he said, “Surely this man was the Son of God!”
chapters.zh: 对面站着的百夫长，看见耶稣这样喊叫断气，（有古卷无喊叫二字）就说，这人真是神的儿子。

chapters.en: Some women were watching from a distance. Among them were Mary Magdalene, Mary the mother of James the younger and of Joseph,and Salome.
chapters.zh: 还有些妇女，远远地观看。内中有抹大拉的马利亚，又有小雅各和约西的母亲马利亚，并有撒罗米。

chapters.en: In Galilee these women had followed him and cared for his needs. Many other women who had come up with him to Jerusalem were also there.
chapters.zh: 就是耶稣在加利利的时候，跟随他，服事他的那些人，还有同耶稣上耶路撒冷的好些妇女在那里观看。

chapters.en: It was Preparation Day (that is, the day before the Sabbath). So as evening approached,
chapters.zh: 到了晚上，因为这是预备日，就是安息日的前一日，

chapters.en: Joseph of Arimathea, a prominent member of the Council, who was himself waiting for the kingdom of God, went boldly to Pilate and asked for Jesus’ body.
chapters.zh: 有亚利马太的约瑟前来，他是尊贵的议士，也是等候神国的。他放胆进去见彼拉多，求耶稣的身体。

chapters.en: Pilate was surprised to hear that he was already dead. Summoning the centurion, he asked him if Jesus had already died.
chapters.zh: 彼拉多诧异耶稣已经死了。便叫百夫长来，问他耶稣死了久不久。

chapters.en: When he learned from the centurion that it was so, he gave the body to Joseph.
chapters.zh: 既从百夫长得知实情，就把耶稣的尸首赐给约瑟。

chapters.en: So Joseph bought some linen cloth, took down the body, wrapped it in the linen, and placed it in a tomb cut out of rock. Then he rolled a stone against the entrance of the tomb.
chapters.zh: 约瑟买了细麻布，把耶稣取下来，用细麻布裹好，安放在磐石中凿出来的坟墓里。又滚过一块石头来挡住墓门。

chapters.en: Mary Magdalene and Mary the mother of Joseph saw where he was laid.
chapters.zh: 抹大拉的马利亚，和约西的母亲马利亚。都看见安放他的地方。

chapters.en: When the Sabbath was over, Mary Magdalene, Mary the mother of James, and Salome bought spices so that they might go to anoint Jesus’ body.
chapters.zh: 过了安息日，抹大拉的马利亚，和雅各的母亲马利亚，并撒罗米，买了香膏，要去膏耶稣的身体。

chapters.en: Very early on the first day of the week, just after sunrise, they were on their way to the tomb
chapters.zh: 七日的第一日清早，出太阳的时候，她们来到坟墓那里。

chapters.en: and they asked each other, “Who will roll the stone away from the entrance of the tomb?”
chapters.zh: 彼此说，谁给我们把石头从墓门滚开呢？

chapters.en: But when they looked up, they saw that the stone, which was very large, had been rolled away.
chapters.zh: 那石头原来很大，她们抬头一看，却见石头已经滚开了。

chapters.en: As they entered the tomb, they saw a young man dressed in a white robe sitting on the right side, and they were alarmed.
chapters.zh: 她们进了坟墓，看见一个少年人坐在右边，穿着白袍。就甚惊恐。

chapters.en: “Don’t be alarmed,” he said. “You are looking for Jesus the Nazarene, who was crucified. He has risen! He is not here. See the place where they laid him.
chapters.zh: 那少年人对她们说，不要惊恐。你们寻找那钉十字架的拿撒勒人耶稣。他已经复活了，不在这里。请看安放他的地方。

chapters.en: But go, tell his disciples and Peter, ‘He is going ahead of you into Galilee. There you will see him, just as he told you.’ ”
chapters.zh: 你们可以去告诉他的门徒和彼得说，他在你们以先往加利利去。在那里你们要见他，正如他从前所告诉你们的。

chapters.en: Trembling and bewildered, the women went out and fled from the tomb. They said nothing to anyone, because they were afraid.
chapters.zh: 她们就出来，从坟墓那里逃跑。又发抖，又惊奇，什么也不告诉人。因为她们害怕。

chapters.en: When Jesus rose early on the first day of the week, he appeared first to Mary Magdalene, out of whom he had driven seven demons.
chapters.zh: 在七日的第一日清早，耶稣复活了，就先向抹大拉的马利亚显现。耶稣从她身上曾赶出七个鬼。

chapters.en: She went and told those who had been with him and who were mourning and weeping.
chapters.zh: 她去告诉那向来跟随耶稣的人。那时他们正哀恸哭泣。

chapters.en: When they heard that Jesus was alive and that she had seen him, they did not believe it.
chapters.zh: 他们听见耶稣活了，被马利亚看见，却是不信。

chapters.en: Afterward Jesus appeared in a different form to two of them while they were walking in the country.
chapters.zh: 这事以后，门徒中间有两个人，往乡下去。走路的时候，耶稣变了形像向他们显现，

chapters.en: These returned and reported it to the rest; but they did not believe them either.
chapters.zh: 他们就去告诉其余的门徒。其余的门徒，也是不信。

chapters.en: Later Jesus appeared to the Eleven as they were eating; he rebuked them for their lack of faith and their stubborn refusal to believe those who had seen him after he had risen.
chapters.zh: 后来，十一个门徒坐席的时候，耶稣向他们显现，责备他们不信，心里刚硬。因为他们不信那些在他复活以后看见他的人。

chapters.en: He said to them, “Go into all the world and preach the gospel to all creation.
chapters.zh: 他又对他们说，你们往普天下去，传福音给万民听。（万民原文作凡受造的）

chapters.en: Whoever believes and is baptized will be saved, but whoever does not believe will be condemned.
chapters.zh: 信而受洗的必然得救。不信的必被定罪。

chapters.en: And these signs will accompany those who believe: In my name they will drive out demons; they will speak in new tongues;
chapters.zh: 信的人必有神迹随着他们，就是奉我的名赶鬼。说新方言。

chapters.en: they will pick up snakes with their hands; and when they drink deadly poison, it will not hurt them at all; they will place their hands on sick people, and they will get well.”
chapters.zh: 手能拿蛇。若喝了什么毒物，也必不受害。手按病人，病人就必好了。

chapters.en: After the Lord Jesus had spoken to them, he was taken up into heaven and he sat at the right hand of God.
chapters.zh: 主耶稣和他们说完了话，后来被接到天上，坐在神的右边。

chapters.en: Then the disciples went out and preached everywhere, and the Lord worked with them and confirmed his word by the signs that accompanied it.
chapters.zh: 门徒出去，到处宣传福音，主和他们同工，用神迹随着，证实所传的道。阿们。

chapters.en: Many have undertaken to draw up an account of the things that have been fulfilled among us,
chapters.zh: 提阿非罗大人哪，有好些人提笔作书，述说在我们中间所成就的事，是照传道的人，从起初亲眼看见，又传给我们的。

chapters.en: just as they were handed down to us by those who from the first were eyewitnesses and servants of the word.
With this in mind, since I myself have carefully investigated everything from the beginning, I too decided to write an orderly account for you, most excellent Theophilus,
chapters.zh: 这些事我既从起头都详细考察了，就定意要按着次序写给你，

chapters.en: so that you may know the certainty of the things you have been taught.
chapters.zh: 使你知道所学之道都是确实的。

chapters.en: In the time of Herod king of Judea there was a priest named Zechariah, who belonged to the priestly division of Abijah; his wife Elizabeth was also a descendant of Aaron.
chapters.zh: 当犹太王希律的时候，亚比雅班里有一个祭司，名叫撒迦利亚。他妻子是亚伦的后人，名叫以利沙伯。

chapters.en: Both of them were righteous in the sight of God, observing all the Lord’s commands and decrees blamelessly.
chapters.zh: 他们二人，在神面前都是义人，遵行主的一切诫命礼仪，没有可指摘的。

chapters.en: But they were childless because Elizabeth was not able to conceive, and they were both very old.
chapters.zh: 只是没有孩子，因为以利沙伯不生育，两个人又年纪老迈了。

chapters.en: Once when Zechariah’s division was on duty and he was serving as priest before God,
chapters.zh: 撒迦利亚按班次，在神面前供祭司的职分，

chapters.en: he was chosen by lot, according to the custom of the priesthood, to go into the temple of the Lord and burn incense.
chapters.zh: 照祭司的规矩掣签，得进主殿烧香。

chapters.en: And when the time for the burning of incense came, all the assembled worshipers were praying outside.
chapters.zh: 烧香的时候，众百姓在外面祷告。
