chapters.zh: 当时耶稣对他们说，民要攻打民，国要攻打国。

chapters.en: There will be great earthquakes, famines and pestilences in various places, and fearful events and great signs from heaven.
chapters.zh: 地要大大震动，多处必有饥荒瘟疫。又有可怕的异象，和大神迹，从天上显现。

chapters.en: “But before all this, they will seize you and persecute you. They will hand you over to synagogues and put you in prison, and you will be brought before kings and governors, and all on account of my name.
chapters.zh: 但这一切的事以先，人要下手拿住你们，逼迫你们，把你们交给会堂，并且收在监里，又为我的名拉你们到君王诸侯面前。

chapters.en: And so you will bear testimony to me.
chapters.zh: 但这些事终必为你们的见证。

chapters.en: But make up your mind not to worry beforehand how you will defend yourselves.
chapters.zh: 所以你们当立定心意，不要预先思想怎样分诉。

chapters.en: For I will give you words and wisdom that none of your adversaries will be able to resist or contradict.
chapters.zh: 因为我必赐你们口才智慧，是你们一切敌人所敌不住，驳不倒的。

chapters.en: You will be betrayed even by parents, brothers and sisters, relatives and friends, and they will put some of you to death.
chapters.zh: 连你们的父母，弟兄，亲族，朋友，也要把你们交官。你们也有被他们害死的。

chapters.en: Everyone will hate you because of me.
chapters.zh: 你们要为我的名，被众人恨恶。

chapters.en: But not a hair of your head will perish.
chapters.zh: 然而你们连一根头发，也必不损坏。

chapters.en: Stand firm, and you will win life.
chapters.zh: 你们常存忍耐，就必保全灵魂。或作必得生命

chapters.en: “When you see Jerusalem being surrounded by armies, you will know that its desolation is near.
chapters.zh: 你们看见耶路撒冷被兵围困，就可知道他成荒场的日子近了。

chapters.en: Then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains, let those in the city get out, and let those in the country not enter the city.
chapters.zh: 那时，在犹太的，应当逃到山上。在城里的，应当出来。在乡下的，不要进城。

chapters.en: For this is the time of punishment in fulfillment of all that has been written.
chapters.zh: 因为这是报应的日子，使经上所写的都得应验。

chapters.en: How dreadful it will be in those days for pregnant women and nursing mothers! There will be great distress in the land and wrath against this people.
chapters.zh: 当那些日子，怀孕的和奶孩子的有祸了。因为将有大灾难降在这地方，也有震怒临到这百姓。

chapters.en: They will fall by the sword and will be taken as prisoners to all the nations. Jerusalem will be trampled on by the Gentiles until the times of the Gentiles are fulfilled.
chapters.zh: 他们要倒在刀下，又被掳到各国去，耶路撒冷要被外邦人践踏，直到外邦人的日期满了。

chapters.en: “There will be signs in the sun, moon and stars. On the earth, nations will be in anguish and perplexity at the roaring and tossing of the sea.
chapters.zh: 日月星辰要显出异兆。地上的邦国也有困苦。因海中波浪的响声，就慌慌不定。

chapters.en: People will faint from terror, apprehensive of what is coming on the world, for the heavenly bodies will be shaken.
chapters.zh: 天势都要震动。人想起那将要临到世界的事，就都吓得魂不附体。

chapters.en: At that time they will see the Son of Man coming in a cloud with power and great glory.
chapters.zh: 那时，他们要看见人子，有能力，有大荣耀，驾云降临。

chapters.en: When these things begin to take place, stand up and lift up your heads, because your redemption is drawing near.”
chapters.zh: 一有这些事，你们就当挺身昂首。因为你们得赎的日子近了。

chapters.en: He told them this parable: “Look at the fig tree and all the trees.
chapters.zh: 耶稣又设比喻对他们说，你们看无花果树，和各样的树。

chapters.en: When they sprout leaves, you can see for yourselves and know that summer is near.
chapters.zh: 他发芽的时候，你们一看见自然晓得夏天近了。

chapters.en: Even so, when you see these things happening, you know that the kingdom of God is near.
chapters.zh: 这样，你们看见这些事渐渐的成就，也该晓得神的国近了。

chapters.en: “Truly I tell you, this generation will certainly not pass away until all these things have happened.
chapters.zh: 我实在告诉你们，这世代还没有过去，这些事都要成就。

chapters.en: Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will never pass away.
chapters.zh: 天地要废去，我的话却不能废去。

chapters.en: “Be careful, or your hearts will be weighed down with carousing, drunkenness and the anxieties of life, and that day will close on you suddenly like a trap.
chapters.zh: 你们要谨慎，恐怕因贪食醉酒并今生的思虑，累住你们的心，那日子就如同网罗忽然临到你们。

chapters.en: For it will come on all those who live on the face of the whole earth.
chapters.zh: 因为那日子要这样临到全地上一切居住的人。

chapters.en: Be always on the watch, and pray that you may be able to escape all that is about to happen, and that you may be able to stand before the Son of Man.”
chapters.zh: 你们要时时儆醒，常常祈求，使你们能逃避这一切要来的事，得以站立在人子面前。

chapters.en: Each day Jesus was teaching at the temple, and each evening he went out to spend the night on the hill called the Mount of Olives,
chapters.zh: 耶稣每日在殿里教训人，每夜出城在一座山，名叫橄榄山住宿。

chapters.en: and all the people came early in the morning to hear him at the temple.
chapters.zh: 众百姓清早上圣殿，到耶稣那里，要听他讲道。

chapters.en: Now the Festival of Unleavened Bread, called the Passover, was approaching,
chapters.zh: 除酵节，又名逾越节，近了。

chapters.en: and the chief priests and the teachers of the law were looking for some way to get rid of Jesus, for they were afraid of the people.
chapters.zh: 祭司长和文士，想法子怎么才能杀害耶稣，是因他们惧怕百姓。

chapters.en: Then Satan entered Judas, called Iscariot, one of the Twelve.
chapters.zh: 这时，撒但入了那称为加略人犹大的心，他本是十二门徒里的一个，

chapters.en: And Judas went to the chief priests and the officers of the temple guard and discussed with them how he might betray Jesus.
chapters.zh: 他去和祭司长并守殿官商量，怎么可以把耶稣交给他们。

chapters.en: They were delighted and agreed to give him money.
chapters.zh: 他们欢喜，就约定给他银子。

chapters.en: He consented, and watched for an opportunity to hand Jesus over to them when no crowd was present.
chapters.zh: 他应允了，就找机会要趁众人不在跟前的时候，把耶稣交给他们。

chapters.en: Then came the day of Unleavened Bread on which the Passover lamb had to be sacrificed.
chapters.zh: 除酵节，须宰逾越羊羔的那一天到了。

chapters.en: Jesus sent Peter and John, saying, “Go and make preparations for us to eat the Passover.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣打发彼得，约翰，说，你们去为我们预备逾越节的筵席，好叫我们吃。

chapters.en: “Where do you want us to prepare for it?” they asked.
chapters.zh: 他们问他说，要我们在哪里预备？

chapters.en: He replied, “As you enter the city, a man carrying a jar of water will meet you. Follow him to the house that he enters,
chapters.zh: 耶稣说，你们进了城，必有人拿着一瓶水迎面而来。你们就跟着他，到他所进的房子里去。

chapters.en: and say to the owner of the house, ‘The Teacher asks: Where is the guest room, where I may eat the Passover with my disciples?’
chapters.zh: 对那家的主人说，夫子说，客房在哪里？我与门徒好在那里吃逾越节的筵席。

chapters.en: He will show you a large room upstairs, all furnished. Make preparations there.”
chapters.zh: 他必指给你们摆设整齐的一间大楼，你们就在那里预备。

chapters.en: They left and found things just as Jesus had told them. So they prepared the Passover.
chapters.zh: 他们去了，所遇见的，正如耶稣所说的。他们就预备了逾越节的筵席。

chapters.en: When the hour came, Jesus and his apostles reclined at the table.
chapters.zh: 时候到了，耶稣坐席，使徒也和他同坐。

chapters.en: And he said to them, “I have eagerly desired to eat this Passover with you before I suffer.
chapters.zh: 耶稣对他们说，我很愿意在受害以先，和你们吃这逾越节的筵席。

chapters.en: For I tell you, I will not eat it again until it finds fulfillment in the kingdom of God.”
chapters.zh: 我告诉你们，我不再吃这筵席，直到成就在神的国里。

chapters.en: After taking the cup, he gave thanks and said, “Take this and divide it among you.
chapters.zh: 耶稣接过杯来，祝谢了，说，你们拿这个，大家分着喝。

chapters.en: For I tell you I will not drink again from the fruit of the vine until the kingdom of God comes.”
chapters.zh: 我告诉你们，从今以后，我不再喝这葡萄汁，直等神的国来到。

chapters.en: And he took bread, gave thanks and broke it, and gave it to them, saying, “This is my body given for you; do this in remembrance of me.”
chapters.zh: 又拿起饼来祝谢了，就掰开递给他们，说，这是我的身体，为你们舍的。你们也应当如此行，为的是记念我。

chapters.en: In the same way, after the supper he took the cup, saying, “This cup is the new covenant in my blood, which is poured out for you.
chapters.zh: 饭后也照样拿起杯来，说，这杯是用我血所立的新约，是为你们流出来的。

chapters.en: But the hand of him who is going to betray me is with mine on the table.
chapters.zh: 看哪，那卖我之人的手，与我一同在桌子上。

chapters.en: The Son of Man will go as it has been decreed. But woe to that man who betrays him!”
chapters.zh: 人子固然要照所预定的去世。但卖人子的人有祸了。

chapters.en: They began to question among themselves which of them it might be who would do this.
chapters.zh: 他们就彼此对问，是哪一个要作这事。

chapters.en: A dispute also arose among them as to which of them was considered to be greatest.
chapters.zh: 门徒起了争论，他们中间哪一个可算为大。

chapters.en: Jesus said to them, “The kings of the Gentiles lord it over them; and those who exercise authority over them call themselves Benefactors.
chapters.zh: 耶稣说，外邦人有君王为主治理他们。那掌权管他们的称为恩主。

chapters.en: But you are not to be like that. Instead, the greatest among you should be like the youngest, and the one who rules like the one who serves.
chapters.zh: 但你们不可这样。你们里头为大的，倒要像年幼的。为首领的，倒要像服事人的。

chapters.en: For who is greater, the one who is at the table or the one who serves? Is it not the one who is at the table? But I am among you as one who serves.
chapters.zh: 是谁为大？是坐席的呢？是服事人的呢？不是坐席的大吗？然而我在你们中间，如同服事人的。

chapters.en: You are those who have stood by me in my trials.
chapters.zh: 我在磨炼之中，常和我同在的就是你们。

chapters.en: And I confer on you a kingdom, just as my Father conferred one on me,
chapters.zh: 我将国赐给你们，正如我父赐给我一样。

chapters.en: so that you may eat and drink at my table in my kingdom and sit on thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.
chapters.zh: 叫你们在我国里，坐在我的席上吃喝。并且坐在宝座上，审判以色列十二个支派。

chapters.en: “Simon, Simon, Satan has asked to sift all of you as wheat.
chapters.zh: 主又说，西门，西门，撒但想要得着你们，好筛你们，像筛麦子一样。

chapters.en: But I have prayed for you, Simon, that your faith may not fail. And when you have turned back, strengthen your brothers.”
chapters.zh: 但我已经为你祈求，叫你不至于失了信心。你回头以后，要坚固你的弟兄。

chapters.en: But he replied, “Lord, I am ready to go with you to prison and to death.”
chapters.zh: 彼得说，主阿，我就是同你下监，同你受死，也是甘心。

chapters.en: Jesus answered, “I tell you, Peter, before the rooster crows today, you will deny three times that you know me.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣说，彼得，我告诉你，今日鸡还没有叫，你要三次说不认得我。

chapters.en: Then Jesus asked them, “When I sent you without purse, bag or sandals, did you lack anything?”“Nothing,” they answered.
chapters.zh: 耶稣又对他们说，我差你们出去的时候，没有钱囊，没有口袋，没有鞋，你们缺少什么没有。他们说，没有。

chapters.en: He said to them, “But now if you have a purse, take it, and also a bag; and if you don’t have a sword, sell your cloak and buy one.
chapters.zh: 耶稣说，但如今有钱囊的可以带着，有口袋的也可以带着。没有刀的要卖衣服买刀。

chapters.en: It is written: ‘And he was numbered with the transgressors’; and I tell you that this must be fulfilled in me. Yes, what is written about me is reaching its fulfillment.”
chapters.zh: 我告诉你们，经上写着说，他被列在罪犯之中。这话必应验在我身上，因为那关系我的事，必然成就。

chapters.en: The disciples said, “See, Lord, here are two swords.” “That’s enough!” he replied.
chapters.zh: 他们说，主阿，请看，这里有两把刀。耶稣说，够了。

chapters.en: Jesus went out as usual to the Mount of Olives, and his disciples followed him.
chapters.zh: 耶稣出来，照常往橄榄山去。门徒也跟随他。

chapters.en: On reaching the place, he said to them, “Pray that you will not fall into temptation.”
chapters.zh: 到了那地方，就对他们说，你们要祷告，免得入了迷惑。

chapters.en: He withdrew about a stone’s throw beyond them, knelt down and prayed,
chapters.zh: 于是离开他们，约有扔一块石头那么远，跪下祷告，

chapters.en: “Father, if you are willing, take this cup from me; yet not my will, but yours be done.”
chapters.zh: 说，父阿，你若愿意，就把这杯撤去。然而不要成就我的意思，只要成就你的意思。

chapters.en: An angel from heaven appeared to him and strengthened him.
chapters.zh: 有一位天使，从天上显现，加添他的力量。

chapters.en: And being in anguish, he prayed more earnestly, and his sweat was like drops of blood falling to the ground.
chapters.zh: 耶稣极其伤痛，祷告更加恳切。汗珠如大血点，滴在地上。

chapters.en: When he rose from prayer and went back to the disciples, he found them asleep, exhausted from sorrow.
chapters.zh: 祷告完了，就起来，到门徒那里，见他们因为忧愁都睡着了。

chapters.en: “Why are you sleeping?” he asked them. “Get up and pray so that you will not fall into temptation.”
chapters.zh: 就对他们说，你们为什么睡觉呢？起来祷告，免得入了迷惑。

chapters.en: While he was still speaking a crowd came up, and the man who was called Judas, one of the Twelve, was leading them. He approached Jesus to kiss him,
chapters.zh: 说话之间，来了许多人，那十二个门徒里名叫犹大的，走在前头，就近耶稣，要与他亲嘴。

chapters.en: but Jesus asked him, “Judas, are you betraying the Son of Man with a kiss?”
chapters.zh: 耶稣对他说，犹大，你用亲嘴的暗号卖人子吗？

chapters.en: When Jesus’ followers saw what was going to happen, they said, “Lord, should we strike with our swords?”
chapters.zh: 左右的人见光景不好，就说，主阿，我们拿刀砍可以不可以？

chapters.en: And one of them struck the servant of the high priest, cutting off his right ear.
chapters.zh: 内中有一个人，把大祭司的仆人砍了一刀，削掉了他的右耳。

chapters.en: But Jesus answered, “No more of this!” And he touched the man’s ear and healed him.
chapters.zh: 耶稣说，到了这个地步，由他们吧。就摸那人的耳朵，把他治好了。

chapters.en: Then Jesus said to the chief priests, the officers of the temple guard, and the elders, who had come for him, “Am I leading a rebellion, that you have come with swords and clubs?
chapters.zh: 耶稣对那些来拿他的祭司长，和守殿官，并长老，说，你们带着刀棒，出来拿我，如同拿强盗吗？

chapters.en: Every day I was with you in the temple courts, and you did not lay a hand on me. But this is your hour—when darkness reigns.”
chapters.zh: 我天天同你们在殿里，你们不下手拿我。现在却是你们的时候，黑暗掌权了。

chapters.en: Then seizing him, they led him away and took him into the house of the high priest. Peter followed at a distance.
chapters.zh: 他们拿住耶稣，把他带到大祭司的宅里。彼得远远地跟着。

chapters.en: And when some there had kindled a fire in the middle of the courtyard and had sat down together, Peter sat down with them.
chapters.zh: 他们在院子里生了火，一同坐着。彼得也坐在他们中间。

chapters.en: A servant girl saw him seated there in the firelight. She looked closely at him and said, “This man was with him.”
chapters.zh: 有一个使女，看见彼得坐在火光里，就定睛看他，说，这个人素来也是同那人一伙的。

chapters.en: But he denied it. “Woman, I don’t know him,” he said.
chapters.zh: 彼得却不承认，说，女子，我不认得他。

chapters.en: A little later someone else saw him and said, “You also are one of them.” “Man, I am not!” Peter replied.
chapters.zh: 过了不多的时候，又有一个人看见他，说，你也是他们一党的。彼得说，你这个人，我不是。

chapters.en: About an hour later another asserted, “Certainly this fellow was with him, for he is a Galilean.”
chapters.zh: 约过了一小时，又有一个人极力地说，他实在是同那人一伙的。因为他也是加利利人。

chapters.en: Peter replied, “Man, I don’t know what you’re talking about!” Just as he was speaking, the rooster crowed.
chapters.zh: 彼得说，你这个人，我不晓得你说的是什么。正说话之间鸡就叫了。

chapters.en: The Lord turned and looked straight at Peter. Then Peter remembered the word the Lord had spoken to him: “Before the rooster crows today, you will disown me three times.”
chapters.zh: 主转过身来，看彼得。彼得便想起主对他所说的话，今日鸡叫以先，你要三次不认我。

chapters.en: And he went outside and wept bitterly.
chapters.zh: 他就出去痛哭。

chapters.en: The men who were guarding Jesus began mocking and beating him.
chapters.zh: 看守耶稣的人戏弄他，打他，

chapters.en: They blindfolded him and demanded, “Prophesy! Who hit you?”
chapters.zh: 又蒙着他的眼，问他说，你是先知，告诉我们，打你的是谁。

chapters.en: And they said many other insulting things to him.
chapters.zh: 他们还用许多别的话辱骂他。

chapters.en: At daybreak the council of the elders of the people, both the chief priests and the teachers of the law, met together, and Jesus was led before them.
chapters.zh: 天一亮，民间的众长老连祭司长带文士都聚会。把耶稣带到他们的公会里，

chapters.en: “If you are the Messiah,” they said, “tell us.” Jesus answered, “If I tell you, you will not believe me,
chapters.zh: 说，你若是基督，就告诉我们。耶稣说，我若告诉你们，你们也不信。

chapters.en: and if I asked you, you would not answer.
chapters.zh: 我若问你们，你们也不回答。

chapters.en: But from now on, the Son of Man will be seated at the right hand of the mighty God.”
chapters.zh: 从今以后，人子要坐在神权能的右边。

chapters.en: They all asked, “Are you then the Son of God?” He replied, “You say that I am.”
chapters.zh: 他们都说，这样，你是神的儿子吗？耶稣说，你们所说的是。

chapters.en: Then they said, “Why do we need any more testimony? We have heard it from his own lips.”
chapters.zh: 他们说，何必再用见证呢？他亲口所说的，我们都亲自听见了。

chapters.en: Then the whole assembly rose and led him off to Pilate.
chapters.zh: 众人都起来，把耶稣解到彼拉多面前。

chapters.en: And they began to accuse him, saying, “We have found this man subverting our nation. He opposes payment of taxes to Caesar and claims to be Messiah, a king.”
chapters.zh: 就告他说，我们见这人诱惑国民，禁止纳税给该撒，并说自己是基督，是王。

chapters.en: So Pilate asked Jesus, “Are you the king of the Jews?” “You have said so,” Jesus replied.
chapters.zh: 彼拉多问耶稣说，你是犹太人的王吗？耶稣回答说，你说的是。

chapters.en: Then Pilate announced to the chief priests and the crowd, “I find no basis for a charge against this man.”
chapters.zh: 彼拉多对祭司长和众人说，我查不出这人有什么罪来。

chapters.en: But they insisted, “He stirs up the people all over Judea by his teaching. He started in Galilee and has come all the way here.”
chapters.zh: 但他们越发极力地说，他煽惑百姓，在犹太遍地传道，从加利利起，直到这里了。

chapters.en: On hearing this, Pilate asked if the man was a Galilean.
chapters.zh: 彼拉多一听见，就问这人是加利利人吗？

chapters.en: When he learned that Jesus was under Herod’s jurisdiction, he sent him to Herod, who was also in Jerusalem at that time.
chapters.zh: 既晓得耶稣属希律所管，就把他送到希律那里去。那时希律正在耶路撒冷。

chapters.en: When Herod saw Jesus, he was greatly pleased, because for a long time he had been wanting to see him. From what he had heard about him, he hoped to see him perform a sign of some sort.
chapters.zh: 希律看见耶稣，就很欢喜。因为听见过他的事，久已想要见他。并且指望看他行一件神迹。

chapters.en: He plied him with many questions, but Jesus gave him no answer.
chapters.zh: 于是问他许多的话。耶稣却一言不答。

chapters.en: The chief priests and the teachers of the law were standing there, vehemently accusing him.
chapters.zh: 祭司长和文士，都站着极力地告他。

chapters.en: Then Herod and his soldiers ridiculed and mocked him. Dressing him in an elegant robe, they sent him back to Pilate.
chapters.zh: 希律和他的兵丁就藐视耶稣，戏弄他，给他穿上华丽衣服，把他送回彼拉多那里去。

chapters.en: That day Herod and Pilate became friends—before this they had been enemies.
chapters.zh: 从前希律和彼拉多彼此有仇。在那一天就成了朋友。

chapters.en: Pilate called together the chief priests, the rulers and the people,
chapters.zh: 彼拉多传齐了祭司长，和官府，并百姓，

chapters.en: and said to them, “You brought me this man as one who was inciting the people to rebellion. I have examined him in your presence and have found no basis for your charges against him.
chapters.zh: 就对他们说，你们解这人到我这里，说他是诱惑百姓的。看哪，我也曾将你们告他的事，在你们面前审问他，并没有查出他什么罪来。

chapters.en: Neither has Herod, for he sent him back to us; as you can see, he has done nothing to deserve death.
chapters.zh: 就是希律也是如此，所以把他送回来。可见他没有作什么该死的事。

chapters.en: Therefore, I will punish him and then release him. ”
chapters.zh: 故此我要责打他，把他释放了。（有古卷在此有

chapters.en: [Now he was obliged to release one man to them at the Feast.]
chapters.zh: 每逢这节期巡抚必须释放一个囚犯给他们。）

chapters.en: But the whole crowd shouted, “Away with this man! Release Barabbas to us!”
chapters.zh: 众人却一齐喊着说，除掉这个人，释放巴拉巴给我们。

chapters.en: (Barabbas had been thrown into prison for an insurrection in the city, and for murder.)
chapters.zh: 这巴拉巴是因在城里作乱杀人下在监里的。

chapters.en: Wanting to release Jesus, Pilate appealed to them again.
chapters.zh: 彼拉多愿意释放耶稣，就又劝解他们。

chapters.en: But they kept shouting, “Crucify him! Crucify him!”
chapters.zh: 无奈他们喊着说，钉他十字架，钉他十字架

chapters.en: For the third time he spoke to them: “Why? What crime has this man committed? I have found in him no grounds for the death penalty. Therefore I will have him punished and then release him.”
chapters.zh: 彼拉多第三次对他们说，为什么呢？这人作了什么恶事呢？我并没有查出他什么该死的罪来。所以我要责打他，把他释放了。

chapters.en: But with loud shouts they insistently demanded that he be crucified, and their shouts prevailed.
chapters.zh: 他们大声催逼彼拉多，求他把耶稣钉在十字架上。他们的声音就得了胜，

chapters.en: So Pilate decided to grant their demand.
chapters.zh: 彼拉多这才照他们所求的定案。

chapters.en: He released the man who had been thrown into prison for insurrection and murder, the one they asked for, and surrendered Jesus to their will.
chapters.zh: 把他们所求的那作乱杀人下在监里的，释放了。把耶稣交给他们，任凭他们的意思行。

chapters.en: As the soldiers led him away, they seized Simon from Cyrene, who was on his way in from the country, and put the cross on him and made him carry it behind Jesus.
chapters.zh: 带耶稣去的时候，有一个古利奈人西门，从乡下来。他们就抓住他，把十字架搁在他身上，叫他背着跟随耶稣。

chapters.en: A large number of people followed him, including women who mourned and wailed for him.
chapters.zh: 有许多百姓，跟随耶稣，内中有好些妇女，妇女们为他号啕痛哭。

chapters.en: Jesus turned and said to them, “Daughters of Jerusalem, do not weep for me; weep for yourselves and for your children.
chapters.zh: 耶稣转身对她们说，耶路撒冷的女子，不要为我哭，当为自己和自己的儿女哭。

chapters.en: For the time will come when you will say, ‘Blessed are the childless women, the wombs that never bore and the breasts that never nursed!’
chapters.zh: 因为日子要到，人必说，不生育的，和未曾怀胎的，未曾乳养婴孩的，有福了。

chapters.en: Then “ ‘they will say to the mountains, “Fall on us!” and to the hills, “Cover us!” ’
chapters.zh: 那时，人要向大山说，倒在我们身上。向小山说，遮盖我们。

chapters.en: For if people do these things when the tree is green, what will happen when it is dry?”
chapters.zh: 这些事既行在有汁水的树上，那枯干的树，将来怎么样呢？

chapters.en: Two other men, both criminals, were also led out with him to be executed.
chapters.zh: 又有两个犯人，和耶稣一同带来处死。

chapters.en: When they came to the place called the Skull, they crucified him there, along with the criminals—one on his right, the other on his left.
chapters.zh: 到了一个地方，名叫髑髅地，就在那里把耶稣钉在十字架上，又钉了两个犯人，一个在左边，一个在右边。

chapters.en: Jesus said, “Father, forgive them, for they do not know what they are doing.” And they divided up his clothes by casting lots.
chapters.zh: 当下耶稣说，父阿，赦免他们。因为他们所作的，他们不晓得。兵丁就拈阄分他的衣服。

chapters.en: The people stood watching, and the rulers even sneered at him. They said, “He saved others; let him save himself if he is God’s Messiah, the Chosen One.”
chapters.zh: 百姓站在那里观看。官府也嗤笑他说，他救了别人。他若是基督，神所拣选的，可以救自己吧。

chapters.en: The soldiers also came up and mocked him. They offered him wine vinegar
chapters.zh: 兵丁也戏弄他，上前拿醋送给他喝，

chapters.en: and said, “If you are the king of the Jews, save yourself.”
chapters.zh: 说，你若是犹太人的王，可以救自己吧。

chapters.en: There was a written notice above him, which read: THIS IS THE KING OF THE JEWS.
chapters.zh: 在耶稣以上有一个牌子，有古卷在此有用希利尼罗马希伯来的文字写着，这是犹太人的王。

chapters.en: One of the criminals who hung there hurled insults at him: “Aren’t you the Messiah? Save yourself and us!”
chapters.zh: 那同钉的两个犯人，有一个讥诮他说，你不是基督吗？可以救自己和我们吧。

chapters.en: But the other criminal rebuked him. “Don’t you fear God,” he said, “since you are under the same sentence?
chapters.zh: 那一个就应声责备他说，你既是一样受刑的，还不怕神吗？

chapters.en: We are punished justly, for we are getting what our deeds deserve. But this man has done nothing wrong.”
chapters.zh: 我们是应该的。因我们所受的，与我们所作的相称。但这个人没有作过一件不好的事。

chapters.en: Then he said, “Jesus, remember me when you come into your kingdom. ”
chapters.zh: 就说，耶稣阿，你得国降临的时候，求你记念我。

chapters.en: Jesus answered him, “Truly I tell you, today you will be with me in paradise.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣对他说，我实在告诉你，今日你要同我在乐园里了。

chapters.en: It was now about noon, and darkness came over the whole land until three in the afternoon,
chapters.zh: 那时约有午正，遍地都黑暗了，直到申初，

chapters.en: for the sun stopped shining. And the curtain of the temple was torn in two.
chapters.zh: 日头变黑了。殿里的幔子从当中裂为两半。

chapters.en: Jesus called out with a loud voice, “Father, into your hands I commit my spirit.” When he had said this, he breathed his last.
chapters.zh: 耶稣大声喊着说，父阿，我将我的灵魂交在你手里。说了这话，气就断了。

chapters.en: The centurion, seeing what had happened, praised God and said, “Surely this was a righteous man.”
chapters.zh: 百夫长看见所成的事，就归荣耀与神说，这真是个义人。

chapters.en: When all the people who had gathered to witness this sight saw what took place, they beat their breasts and went away.
chapters.zh: 聚集观看的众人，见了这所成的事，都捶着胸回去了。

chapters.en: But all those who knew him, including the women who had followed him from Galilee, stood at a distance, watching these things.
chapters.zh: 还有一切与耶稣熟识的人，和从加利利跟着他来的妇女们，都远远地站着，看这些事。

chapters.en: Now there was a man named Joseph, a member of the Council, a good and upright man,
chapters.zh: 有一个人名叫约瑟，是个议士，为人善良公义。

chapters.en: who had not consented to their decision and action. He came from the Judean town of Arimathea, and he himself was waiting for the kingdom of God.
chapters.zh: 众人所谋所为，他并没有附从。他本是犹太亚利马太城里素常盼望神国的人。

chapters.en: Going to Pilate, he asked for Jesus’ body.
chapters.zh: 这人去见彼拉多，求耶稣的身体。

chapters.en: Then he took it down, wrapped it in linen cloth and placed it in a tomb cut in the rock, one in which no one had yet been laid.
chapters.zh: 就取下来用细麻布裹好，安放在石头凿成的坟墓里，那里头从来没有葬过人。

chapters.en: It was Preparation Day, and the Sabbath was about to begin.
chapters.zh: 那日是预备日，安息日也快到了。

chapters.en: The women who had come with Jesus from Galilee followed Joseph and saw the tomb and how his body was laid in it.
chapters.zh: 那些从加利利和耶稣同来的妇女，跟在后面，看见了坟墓，和他的身体怎样安放。

chapters.en: Then they went home and prepared spices and perfumes. But they rested on the Sabbath in obedience to the commandment.
chapters.zh: 她们就回去，预备了香料香膏。她们在安息日，便遵着诫命安息了。

chapters.en: On the first day of the week, very early in the morning, the women took the spices they had prepared and went to the tomb.
chapters.zh: 七日的头一日，黎明的时候，那些妇女带着所预备的香料，来到坟墓前。

chapters.en: They found the stone rolled away from the tomb,
chapters.zh: 看见石头已经从坟墓滚开了。

chapters.en: but when they entered, they did not find the body of the Lord Jesus.
chapters.zh: 她们就进去，只是不见主耶稣的身体。

chapters.en: While they were wondering about this, suddenly two men in clothes that gleamed like lightning stood beside them.
chapters.zh: 正在猜疑之间，忽然有两个人站在旁边。衣服放光。

chapters.en: In their fright the women bowed down with their faces to the ground, but the men said to them, “Why do you look for the living among the dead?
chapters.zh: 妇女们惊怕，将脸伏地。那两个人就对她们说，为什么在死人中找活人呢？

chapters.en: He is not here; he has risen! Remember how he told you, while he was still with you in Galilee:
chapters.zh: 他不在这里，已经复活了。当记念他还在加利利的时候，怎样告诉你们，

chapters.en: ‘The Son of Man must be delivered over to the hands of sinners, be crucified and on the third day be raised again.’ ”
chapters.zh: 说，人子必须被交在罪人手里，钉在十字架上，第三日复活。

chapters.en: Then they remembered his words.
chapters.zh: 她们就想起耶稣的话来，

chapters.en: When they came back from the tomb, they told all these things to the Eleven and to all the others.
chapters.zh: 便从坟墓那里回去，把这一切事告诉十一个使徒和其余的人。

chapters.en: It was Mary Magdalene, Joanna, Mary the mother of James, and the others with them who told this to the apostles.
chapters.zh: 那告诉使徒的，就是抹大拉的马利亚，和约亚拿，并雅各的母亲马利亚，还有与她们在一处的妇女。

chapters.en: But they did not believe the women, because their words seemed to them like nonsense.
chapters.zh: 她们这些话，使徒以为是胡言，就不相信。

chapters.en: Peter, however, got up and ran to the tomb. Bending over, he saw the strips of linen lying by themselves, and he went away, wondering to himself what had happened.
chapters.zh: 彼得起来，跑到坟墓前，低头往里看，见细麻布独在一处，就回去了，心里希奇所成的事。

chapters.en: Now that same day two of them were going to a village called Emmaus, about seven miles from Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 正当那日，门徒中有两个人往一个村子去，这村子名叫以马忤斯，离耶路撒冷约有二十五里。

chapters.en: They were talking with each other about everything that had happened.
chapters.zh: 他们彼此谈论所遇见的这一切事。

chapters.en: As they talked and discussed these things with each other, Jesus himself came up and walked along with them;
chapters.zh: 正谈论相问的时候，耶稣亲自就近他们，和他们同行。

chapters.en: but they were kept from recognizing him.
chapters.zh: 只是他们的眼睛迷糊了，不认识他。

chapters.en: He asked them, “What are you discussing together as you walk along?”They stood still, their faces downcast.
chapters.zh: 耶稣对他们说，你们走路彼此谈论的是什么事呢？他们就站住，脸上带着愁容。

chapters.en: One of them, named Cleopas, asked him, “Are you the only one visiting Jerusalem who does not know the things that have happened there in these days?”
chapters.zh: 二人中有一个名叫革流巴的，回答说，你在耶路撒冷作客，还不知道这几天在那里所出的事吗？

chapters.en: “What things?” he asked. “About Jesus of Nazareth,” they replied. “He was a prophet, powerful in word and deed before God and all the people.
chapters.zh: 耶稣说，什么事呢？他们说，就是拿撒勒人耶稣的事。他是个先知，在神和众百姓面前，说话行事都有大能。

chapters.en: The chief priests and our rulers handed him over to be sentenced to death, and they crucified him;
chapters.zh: 祭司长和我们的官府，竟把他解去定了死罪，钉在十字架上。

chapters.en: but we had hoped that he was the one who was going to redeem Israel. And what is more, it is the third day since all this took place.
chapters.zh: 但我们素来所盼望要赎以色列民的就是他。不但如此，而且这事成就，现在已经三天了。

chapters.en: In addition, some of our women amazed us. They went to the tomb early this morning
chapters.zh: 再者，我们中间有几个妇女使我们惊奇，她们清早到了坟墓那里。

chapters.en: but didn’t find his body. They came and told us that they had seen a vision of angels, who said he was alive.
chapters.zh: 不见他的身体，就回来告诉我们说，看见了天使显现，说他活了。

chapters.en: Then some of our companions went to the tomb and found it just as the women had said, but they did not see Jesus.”
chapters.zh: 又有我们的几个人，往坟墓那里去，所遇见的，正如妇女们所说的，只是没有看见他。

chapters.en: He said to them, “How foolish you are, and how slow to believe all that the prophets have spoken!
chapters.zh: 耶稣对他们说，无知的人哪，先知所说的一切话，你们的心，信得太迟钝了。

chapters.en: Did not the Messiah have to suffer these things and then enter his glory?”
chapters.zh: 基督这样受害，又进入他的荣耀，岂不是应当的吗？

chapters.en: And beginning with Moses and all the Prophets, he explained to them what was said in all the Scriptures concerning himself.
chapters.zh: 于是从摩西和众先知起，凡经上所指着自己的话，都给他们讲解明白了。

chapters.en: As they approached the village to which they were going, Jesus continued on as if he were going farther.
chapters.zh: 将近他们所去的村子，耶稣好像还要往前行

chapters.en: But they urged him strongly, “Stay with us, for it is nearly evening; the day is almost over.” So he went in to stay with them.
chapters.zh: 他们却强留他说，时候晚了，日头已经平西了，请你同我们住下吧。耶稣就进去，要同他们住下。

chapters.en: When he was at the table with them, he took bread, gave thanks, broke it and began to give it to them.
chapters.zh: 到了坐席的时候，耶稣拿起饼来，祝谢了，掰开，递给他们。

chapters.en: Then their eyes were opened and they recognized him, and he disappeared from their sight.
chapters.zh: 他们的眼睛明亮了，这才认出他来。忽然耶稣不见了。

chapters.en: They asked each other, “Were not our hearts burning within us while he talked with us on the road and opened the Scriptures to us?”
chapters.zh: 他们彼此说，在路上，他和我们说话，给我们讲解圣经的时候，我们的心岂不是火热的吗？

chapters.en: They got up and returned at once to Jerusalem. There they found the Eleven and those with them, assembled together
chapters.zh: 他们就立时起身，回耶路撒冷去，正遇见十一个使徒，和他们的同人，聚集在一处。

chapters.en: and saying, “It is true! The Lord has risen and has appeared to Simon.”
chapters.zh: 说，主果然复活，已经现给西门看了。

chapters.en: Then the two told what had happened on the way, and how Jesus was recognized by them when he broke the bread.
chapters.zh: 两个人就把路上所遇见，和掰饼的时候怎么被他们认出来的事，都述说了一遍。

chapters.en: While they were still talking about this, Jesus himself stood among them and said to them, “Peace be with you.”
chapters.zh: 正说这话的时候，耶稣亲自站在他们当中，说，愿你们平安。

chapters.en: They were startled and frightened, thinking they saw a ghost.
chapters.zh: 他们却惊慌害怕，以为所看见的是魂。

chapters.en: He said to them, “Why are you troubled, and why do doubts rise in your minds?
chapters.zh: 耶稣说，你们为什么愁烦？为什么心里起疑念呢？

chapters.en: Look at my hands and my feet. It is I myself! Touch me and see; a ghost does not have flesh and bones, as you see I have.”
chapters.zh: 你们看我的手，我的脚，就知道实在是我了。摸我看看。魂无骨无肉，你们看我是有的。

chapters.en: When he had said this, he showed them his hands and feet.
chapters.zh: 说了这话，就把手和脚给他们看。

chapters.en: And while they still did not believe it because of joy and amazement, he asked them, “Do you have anything here to eat?”
chapters.zh: 他们正喜得不敢信，并且希奇，耶稣就说，你们这里有什么吃的没有。

chapters.en: They gave him a piece of broiled fish,
chapters.zh: 他们便给他一片烧鱼。（有古卷在此有和一块蜜房）

chapters.en: and he took it and ate it in their presence.
chapters.zh: 他接过来，在他们面前吃了。

chapters.en: He said to them, “This is what I told you while I was still with you: Everything must be fulfilled that is written about me in the Law of Moses, the Prophets and the Psalms.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣对他们说，这就是我从前与你们同在之时，所告诉你们的话，说，摩西的律法，先知的书，和诗篇上所记的，凡指着我的话，都必须应验。

chapters.en: Then he opened their minds so they could understand the Scriptures.
chapters.zh: 于是耶稣开他们的心窍，使他们能明白圣经。

chapters.en: He told them, “This is what is written: The Messiah will suffer and rise from the dead on the third day,
chapters.zh: 又对他们说，照经上所写的，基督必受害，第三日从死里复活。

chapters.en: and repentance for the forgiveness of sins will be preached in his name to all nations, beginning at Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 并且人要奉他的名传悔改赦罪的道，从耶路撒冷起直传到万邦。

chapters.en: You are witnesses of these things.
chapters.zh: 你们就是这些事的见证。

chapters.en: I am going to send you what my Father has promised; but stay in the city until you have been clothed with power from on high.”
chapters.zh: 我要将我父所应许的降在你们身上。你们要在城里等候，直到你们领受从上头来的能力。

chapters.en: When he had led them out to the vicinity of Bethany, he lifted up his hands and blessed them.
chapters.zh: 耶稣领他们到伯大尼的对面，就举手给他们祝福。

chapters.en: While he was blessing them, he left them and was taken up into heaven.
chapters.zh: 正祝福的时候，他就离开他们，被带到天上去了。

chapters.en: Then they worshiped him and returned to Jerusalem with great joy.
chapters.zh: 他们就拜他，大大地欢喜，回耶路撒冷去。

chapters.en: And they stayed continually at the temple, praising God.
chapters.zh: 常在殿里称颂神。

chapters.en: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.
chapters.zh: 太初有道，道与神同在，道就是神。

chapters.en: He was with God in the beginning.
chapters.zh: 这道太初与神同在。

chapters.en: Through him all things were made; without him nothing was made that has been made.
chapters.zh: 万物是借着他造的。凡被造的，没有一样不是借着他造的。

chapters.en: In him was life, and that life was the light of all mankind.
chapters.zh: 生命在他里头。这生命就是人的光。

chapters.en: The light shines in the darkness, and the darkness has not overcome it.
chapters.zh: 光照在黑暗里，黑暗却不接受光。

chapters.en: There was a man sent from God whose name was John.
chapters.zh: 有一个人，是从神那里差来的，名叫约翰。

chapters.en: He came as a witness to testify concerning that light, so that through him all might believe.
chapters.zh: 这人来，为要作见证，就是为光作见证，叫众人因他可以信。

chapters.en: He himself was not the light; he came only as a witness to the light.
chapters.zh: 他不是那光，乃是要为光作见证。

chapters.en: The true light that gives light to everyone was coming into the world.
chapters.zh: 那光是真光，照亮一切生在世上的人。

chapters.en: He was in the world, and though the world was made through him, the world did not recognize him.
chapters.zh: 他在世界，世界也是借着他造的，世界却不认识他。

chapters.en: He came to that which was his own, but his own did not receive him.
chapters.zh: 他到自己的地方来，自己的人倒不接待他。

chapters.en: Yet to all who did receive him, to those who believed in his name, he gave the right to become children of God—
chapters.zh: 凡接待他的，就是信他名的人，他就赐他们权柄，作神的儿女。

chapters.en: children born not of natural descent, nor of human decision or a husband’s will, but born of God.
chapters.zh: 这等人不是从血气生的，不是从情欲生的，也不是从人意生的，乃是从神生的。

chapters.en: The Word became flesh and made his dwelling among us. We have seen his glory, the glory of the one and only Son, who came from the Father, full of grace and truth.
chapters.zh: 道成了肉身住在我们中间，充充满满的有恩典有真理。我们也见过他的荣光，正是父独生子的荣光。

chapters.en: (John testified concerning him. He cried out, saying, “This is the one I spoke about when I said, ‘He who comes after me has surpassed me because he was before me.’ ”)
chapters.zh: 约翰为他作见证，喊着说，这就是我曾说，那在我以后来的，反成了在我以前的。因他本来在我以前。

chapters.en: Out of his fullness we have all received grace in place of grace already given.
chapters.zh: 从他丰满的恩典里我们都领受了，而且恩上加恩。

chapters.en: For the law was given through Moses; grace and truth came through Jesus Christ.
chapters.zh: 律法本是借着摩西传的，恩典和真理，都是由耶稣基督来的。

chapters.en: No one has ever seen God, but the one and only Son, who is himself God and is in closest relationship with the Father, has made him known.
chapters.zh: 从来没有人看见神。只有在父怀里的独生子将他表明出来。

chapters.en: Now this was John’s testimony when the Jewish leaders in Jerusalem sent priests and Levites to ask him who he was.
chapters.zh: 约翰所作的见证，记在下面。犹太人从耶路撒冷差祭司和利未人到约翰那里，问他说，你是谁。

chapters.en: He did not fail to confess, but confessed freely, “I am not the Messiah.”
chapters.zh: 他就明说，并不隐瞒。明说，我不是基督。

chapters.en: They asked him, “Then who are you? Are you Elijah?” He said, “I am not.” “Are you the Prophet?” He answered, “No.”
chapters.zh: 他们又问他说，这样你是谁呢？是以利亚吗？他说，我不是。是那先知吗？他回答说，不是。

chapters.en: Finally they said, “Who are you? Give us an answer to take back to those who sent us. What do you say about yourself?”
chapters.zh: 于是他们说，你到底是谁？叫我们好回覆差我们来的人。你自己说，你是谁。

chapters.en: John replied in the words of Isaiah the prophet, “I am the voice of one calling in the wilderness, ‘Make straight the way for the Lord.’ ”
chapters.zh: 他说，我就是那在旷野有人声喊着说，修直主的道路，正如先知以赛亚所说的。

chapters.en: Now the Pharisees who had been sent
chapters.zh: 那些人是法利赛人差来的。（或作那差来的是法利赛人）

chapters.en: questioned him, “Why then do you baptize if you are not the Messiah, nor Elijah, nor the Prophet?”
chapters.zh: 他们就问他说，你既不是基督，不是以利亚，也不是那先知，为什么施洗呢？

chapters.en: “I baptize with water,” John replied, “but among you stands one you do not know.
chapters.zh: 约翰回答说，我是用水施洗，但有一位站在你们中间，是你们不认识的，

chapters.en: He is the one who comes after me, the straps of whose sandals I am not worthy to untie.”
chapters.zh: 就是那在我以后来的，我给他解鞋带，也不配。

chapters.en: This all happened at Bethany on the other side of the Jordan, where John was baptizing.
chapters.zh: 这是在约但河外，伯大尼，（有古卷作伯大巴喇）约翰施洗的地方作的见证。

chapters.en: The next day John saw Jesus coming toward him and said, “Look, the Lamb of God, who takes away the sin of the world!
chapters.zh: 次日，约翰看见耶稣来到他那里，就说，看哪，神的羔羊，除去（或作背负）世人罪孽的。

chapters.en: This is the one I meant when I said, ‘A man who comes after me has surpassed me because he was before me.’
chapters.zh: 这就是我曾说，有一位在我以后来，反成了在我以前的。因他本来在我以前。

chapters.en: I myself did not know him, but the reason I came baptizing with water was that he might be revealed to Israel.”
chapters.zh: 我先前不认识他，如今我来用水施洗，为要叫他显明给以色列人。

chapters.en: Then John gave this testimony: “I saw the Spirit come down from heaven as a dove and remain on him.
chapters.zh: 约翰又作见证说，我曾看见圣灵，仿佛鸽子从天降下，住在他的身上。

chapters.en: And I myself did not know him, but the one who sent me to baptize with water told me, ‘The man on whom you see the Spirit come down and remain is the one who will baptize with the Holy Spirit.’
chapters.zh: 我先前不认识他。只是那差我来用水施洗的，对我说，你看见圣灵降下来，住在谁的身上，谁就是用圣灵施洗的。

chapters.en: I have seen and I testify that this is God’s Chosen One.”
chapters.zh: 我看见了，就证明这是神的儿子。

chapters.en: The next day John was there again with two of his disciples.
chapters.zh: 再次日，约翰同两个门徒站在那里。

chapters.en: When he saw Jesus passing by, he said, “Look, the Lamb of God!”
chapters.zh: 他见耶稣行走，就说，看哪，这是神的羔羊。

chapters.en: When the two disciples heard him say this, they followed Jesus.
chapters.zh: 两个门徒听见他的话，就跟从了耶稣。

chapters.en: Turning around, Jesus saw them following and asked, “What do you want?”They said, “Rabbi” (which means “Teacher”), “where are you staying?”
chapters.zh: 耶稣转过身来，看见他们跟着，就问他们说，你们要什么？他们说，拉比，在哪里住？（拉比翻出来，就是夫子）

chapters.en: “Come,” he replied, “and you will see.”So they went and saw where he was staying, and they spent that day with him. It was about four in the afternoon.
chapters.zh: 耶稣说，你们来看。他们就去看他在哪里住，这一天便与他同住，那时约有申正了。

chapters.en: Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother, was one of the two who heard what John had said and who had followed Jesus.
chapters.zh: 听见约翰的话，跟从耶稣的那两个人，一个是西门彼得的兄弟安得烈。

chapters.en: The first thing Andrew did was to find his brother Simon and tell him, “We have found the Messiah” (that is, the Christ).
chapters.zh: 他先找着自己的哥哥西门，对他说，我们遇见弥赛亚了，（弥赛亚翻出来，就是基督）

chapters.en: And he brought him to Jesus. Jesus looked at him and said, “You are Simon son of John. You will be called Cephas” (which, when translated, is Peter ).
chapters.zh: 于是领他去见耶稣。耶稣看着他说，你是约翰的儿子西门，（约翰马太十六章十七节称约拿）你要称为矶法。（矶法翻出来，就是彼得）

chapters.en: The next day Jesus decided to leave for Galilee. Finding Philip, he said to him, “Follow me.”
chapters.zh: 又次日，耶稣想要往加利利去，遇见腓力，就对他说，来跟从我吧。

chapters.en: Philip, like Andrew and Peter, was from the town of Bethsaida.
chapters.zh: 这腓力是伯赛大人，和安得烈、彼得同城。

chapters.en: Philip found Nathanael and told him, “We have found the one Moses wrote about in the Law, and about whom the prophets also wrote—Jesus of Nazareth, the son of Joseph.”
chapters.zh: 腓力找着拿但业，对他说，摩西在律法上所写的，和众先知所记的那一位，我们遇见了，就是约瑟的儿子拿撒勒人耶稣。

chapters.en: “Nazareth! Can anything good come from there?” Nathanael asked. “Come and see,” said Philip.
chapters.zh: 拿但业对他说，拿撒勒还能出什么好的吗？腓力说，你来看。

chapters.en: When Jesus saw Nathanael approaching, he said of him, “Here truly is an Israelite in whom there is no deceit.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣看见拿但业来，就指着他说，看哪，这是个真以色列人，他心里是没有诡诈的。

chapters.en: “How do you know me?” Nathanael asked. Jesus answered, “I saw you while you were still under the fig tree before Philip called you.”
chapters.zh: 拿但业对耶稣说，你从哪里知道我呢？耶稣回答说，腓力还没有招呼你，你在无花果树底下，我就看见你了。

chapters.en: Then Nathanael declared, “Rabbi, you are the Son of God; you are the king of Israel.”
chapters.zh: 拿但业说，拉比，你是神的儿子，你是以色列的王。

chapters.en: Jesus said, “You believe because I told you I saw you under the fig tree. You will see greater things than that.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣对他说，因为我说在无花果树底下看见你，你就信吗？你将要看见比这更大的事。

chapters.en: He then added, “Very truly I tell you,you will see ‘heaven open, and the angels of God ascending and descending on’the Son of Man.”
chapters.zh: 又说，我实实在在地告诉你们，你们将要看见天开了，神的使者上去下来在人子身上。

chapters.en: On the third day a wedding took place at Cana in Galilee. Jesus’ mother was there,
chapters.zh: 第三日，在加利利的迦拿有娶亲的筵席。耶稣的母亲在那里。

chapters.en: and Jesus and his disciples had also been invited to the wedding.
chapters.zh: 耶稣和他的门徒也被请去赴席。

chapters.en: When the wine was gone, Jesus’ mother said to him, “They have no more wine.”
chapters.zh: 酒用尽了，耶稣的母亲对他说，他们没有酒了。

chapters.en: “Woman,why do you involve me?” Jesus replied. “My hour has not yet come.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣说，母亲，（原文作妇人）我与你有什么相干。我的时候还没有到。

chapters.en: His mother said to the servants, “Do whatever he tells you.”
chapters.zh: 他母亲对用人说，他告诉你们什么，你们就作什么。

chapters.en: Nearby stood six stone water jars, the kind used by the Jews for ceremonial washing, each holding from twenty to thirty gallons.
chapters.zh: 照犹太人洁净的规矩，有六口石缸摆在那里，每口可以盛两三桶水。

chapters.en: Jesus said to the servants, “Fill the jars with water”; so they filled them to the brim.
chapters.zh: 耶稣对用人说，把缸倒满了水。他们就倒满了，直到缸口。

chapters.en: Then he told them, “Now draw some out and take it to the master of the banquet.”They did so,
chapters.zh: 耶稣又说，现在可以舀出来，送给管筵席的。他们就送了去。

chapters.en: and the master of the banquet tasted the water that had been turned into wine. He did not realize where it had come from, though the servants who had drawn the water knew. Then he called the bridegroom aside
chapters.zh: 管筵席的尝了那水变的酒，并不知道是哪里来的，只有舀水的用人知道。管筵席的便叫新郎来。

chapters.en: and said, “Everyone brings out the choice wine first and then the cheaper wine after the guests have had too much to drink; but you have saved the best till now.”
chapters.zh: 对他说，人都是先摆上好酒。等客喝足了，才摆上次的。你倒把好酒留到如今。

chapters.en: What Jesus did here in Cana of Galilee was the first of the signs through which he revealed his glory; and his disciples believed in him.
chapters.zh: 这是耶稣所行的头一件神迹，是在加利利的迦拿行的，显出他的荣耀来。他的门徒就信他了。

chapters.en: After this he went down to Capernaum with his mother and brothers and his disciples. There they stayed for a few days.
chapters.zh: 这事以后，耶稣与他的母亲弟兄和门徒，都下迦百农去。在那里住了不多几日。

chapters.en: When it was almost time for the Jewish Passover, Jesus went up to Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 犹太人的逾越节近了，耶稣就上耶路撒冷去。

chapters.en: In the temple courts he found people selling cattle, sheep and doves, and others sitting at tables exchanging money.
chapters.zh: 看见殿里有卖牛羊鸽子的，并有兑换银钱的人，坐在那里。

chapters.en: So he made a whip out of cords, and drove all from the temple courts, both sheep and cattle; he scattered the coins of the money changers and overturned their tables.
chapters.zh: 耶稣就拿绳子作成鞭子，把牛羊都赶出殿去。倒出兑换银钱之人的银钱，推翻他们的桌子。

chapters.en: To those who sold doves he said, “Get these out of here! Stop turning my Father’s house into a market!”
chapters.zh: 又对卖鸽子的说，把这些东西拿去。不要将我父的殿，当作买卖的地方。

chapters.en: His disciples remembered that it is written: “Zeal for your house will consume me.”
chapters.zh: 他的门徒就想起经上记着说，我为你的殿，心里焦急，如同火烧。

chapters.en: The Jews then responded to him, “What sign can you show us to prove your authority to do all this?”
chapters.zh: 因此，犹太人问他说，你既作这些事，还显什么神迹给我们看呢？

chapters.en: Jesus answered them, “Destroy this temple, and I will raise it again in three days.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣回答说，你们拆毁这殿，我三日内要再建立起来。

chapters.en: They replied, “It has taken forty-six years to build this temple, and you are going to raise it in three days?”
chapters.zh: 犹太人便说，这殿是四十六年才造成的，你三日内就再建立起来吗？

chapters.en: But the temple he had spoken of was his body.
chapters.zh: 但耶稣这话，是以他的身体为殿。

chapters.en: After he was raised from the dead, his disciples recalled what he had said. Then they believed the scripture and the words that Jesus had spoken.
chapters.zh: 所以到他从死里复活以后，门徒就想起他说过这话，便信了圣经和耶稣所说的。

chapters.en: Now while he was in Jerusalem at the Passover Festival, many people saw the signs he was performing and believed in his name.
chapters.zh: 当耶稣在耶路撒冷过逾越节的时候，有许多人看见他所行的神迹，就信了他的名。

chapters.en: But Jesus would not entrust himself to them, for he knew all people.
chapters.zh: 耶稣却不将自己交托他们，因为他知道万人。

chapters.en: He did not need any testimony about mankind, for he knew what was in each person.
chapters.zh: 也用不着谁见证人怎样。因他知道人心里所存的。

chapters.en: Now there was a Pharisee, a man named Nicodemus who was a member of the Jewish ruling council.
chapters.zh: 有一个法利赛人，名叫尼哥底母，是犹太人的官。

chapters.en: He came to Jesus at night and said, “Rabbi, we know that you are a teacher who has come from God. For no one could perform the signs you are doing if God were not with him.”
chapters.zh: 这人夜里来见耶稣，说，拉比，我们知道你是由神那里来作师傅的。因为你所行的神迹，若没有神同在，无人能行。

chapters.en: Jesus replied, “Very truly I tell you, no one can see the kingdom of God unless they are born again.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣回答说，我实实在在地告诉你，人若不重生，就不能见神的国。

chapters.en: “How can someone be born when they are old?” Nicodemus asked. “Surely they cannot enter a second time into their mother’s womb to be born!”
chapters.zh: 尼哥底母说，人已经老了，如何能重生呢？岂能再进母腹生出来吗？

chapters.en: Jesus answered, “Very truly I tell you, no one can enter the kingdom of God unless they are born of water and the Spirit.
chapters.zh: 耶稣说，我实实在在地告诉你，人若不是从水和圣灵生的，就不能进神的国。

chapters.en: Flesh gives birth to flesh, but the Spirit gives birth to spirit.
chapters.zh: 从肉身生的，就是肉身。从灵生的，就是灵。

chapters.en: You should not be surprised at my saying, ‘You must be born again.’
chapters.zh: 我说，你们必须重生，你不要以为希奇。

chapters.en: The wind blows wherever it pleases. You hear its sound, but you cannot tell where it comes from or where it is going. So it is with everyone born of the Spirit.”
chapters.zh: 风随着意思吹，你听见风的响声，却不晓得从哪里来，往哪里去。凡从圣灵生的，也是如此。

chapters.en: “How can this be?” Nicodemus asked.
chapters.zh: 尼哥底母问他说，怎能有这事呢？

chapters.en: “You are Israel’s teacher,” said Jesus, “and do you not understand these things?
chapters.zh: 耶稣回答说，你是以色列人的先生，还不明白这事吗？

chapters.en: Very truly I tell you, we speak of what we know, and we testify to what we have seen, but still you people do not accept our testimony.
chapters.zh: 我实实在在地告诉你，我们所说的，是我们知道的，我们所见证的，是我们见过的。你们却不领受我们的见证。

chapters.en: I have spoken to you of earthly things and you do not believe; how then will you believe if I speak of heavenly things?
chapters.zh: 我对你们说地上的事，你们尚且不信，若说天上的事，如何能信呢？

chapters.en: No one has ever gone into heaven except the one who came from heaven—the Son of Man.
chapters.zh: 除了从天降下仍旧在天的人子，没有人升过天。

chapters.en: Just as Moses lifted up the snake in the wilderness, so the Son of Man must be lifted up,
chapters.zh: 摩西在旷野怎样举蛇，人子也必照样被举起来。

chapters.en: that everyone who believes may have eternal life in him.”
chapters.zh: 叫一切信他的都得永生。（或作叫一切信的人在他里面得永生）

chapters.en: For God so loved the world that he gave his one and only Son, that whoever believes in him shall not perish but have eternal life.
chapters.zh: 神爱世人，甚至将他的独生子赐给他们，叫一切信他的，不至灭亡，反得永生。

chapters.en: For God did not send his Son into the world to condemn the world, but to save the world through him.
chapters.zh: 因为神差他的儿子降世，不是要定世人的罪，（或作审判世人下同）乃是要叫世人因他得救。

chapters.en: Whoever believes in him is not condemned, but whoever does not believe stands condemned already because they have not believed in the name of God’s one and only Son.
chapters.zh: 信他的人，不被定罪。不信的人，罪已经定了，因为他不信神独生子的名。

chapters.en: This is the verdict: Light has come into the world, but people loved darkness instead of light because their deeds were evil.
chapters.zh: 光来到世间，世人因自己的行为是恶的，不爱光倒爱黑暗，定他们的罪就是在此。

chapters.en: Everyone who does evil hates the light, and will not come into the light for fear that their deeds will be exposed.
chapters.zh: 凡作恶的便恨光，并不来就光，恐怕他的行为受责备。

chapters.en: But whoever lives by the truth comes into the light, so that it may be seen plainly that what they have done has been done in the sight of God.
chapters.zh: 但行真理的必来就光，要显明他所行的是靠神而行。

chapters.en: After this, Jesus and his disciples went out into the Judean countryside, where he spent some time with them, and baptized.
chapters.zh: 这事以后，耶稣和门徒到了犹太地，在那里居住施洗。

chapters.en: Now John also was baptizing at Aenon near Salim, because there was plenty of water, and people were coming and being baptized.
chapters.zh: 约翰在靠近撒冷的哀嫩也施洗，因为那里水多。众人都去受洗。

chapters.en: (This was before John was put in prison.)
chapters.zh: 那时约翰还没有下在监里。

chapters.en: An argument developed between some of John’s disciples and a certain Jew over the matter of ceremonial washing.
chapters.zh: 约翰的门徒，和一个犹太人辩论洁净的礼。

chapters.en: They came to John and said to him, “Rabbi, that man who was with you on the other side of the Jordan—the one you testified about—look, he is baptizing, and everyone is going to him.”
chapters.zh: 就来见约翰说，拉比，从前同你在约但河外，你所见证的那位，现在施洗，众人都往他那里去了。

chapters.en: To this John replied, “A person can receive only what is given them from heaven.
chapters.zh: 约翰说，若不是从天上赐的，人就不能得什么。

chapters.en: You yourselves can testify that I said, ‘I am not the Messiah but am sent ahead of him.’
chapters.zh: 我曾说，我不是基督，是奉差遣在他前面的，你们自己可以给我作见证。

chapters.en: The bride belongs to the bridegroom. The friend who attends the bridegroom waits and listens for him, and is full of joy when he hears the bridegroom’s voice. That joy is mine, and it is now complete.
chapters.zh: 娶新妇的，就是新郎。新郎的朋友站着听见新郎的声音就甚喜乐。故此我这喜乐满足了。

chapters.en: He must become greater; I must become less.”
chapters.zh: 他必兴旺，我必衰微。

chapters.en: The one who comes from above is above all; the one who is from the earth belongs to the earth, and speaks as one from the earth. The one who comes from heaven is above all.
chapters.zh: 从天上来的，是在万有之上。从地上来的，是属乎地，他所说的，也是属乎地从天上来的，是在万有之上。

chapters.en: He testifies to what he has seen and heard, but no one accepts his testimony.
chapters.zh: 他将所见所闻的见证出来，只是没有人领受他的见证。

chapters.en: Whoever has accepted it has certified that God is truthful.
chapters.zh: 那领受他见证的，就印上印，证明神是真的。

chapters.en: For the one whom God has sent speaks the words of God, for God gives the Spirit without limit.
chapters.zh: 神所差来的，就说神的话。因为神赐圣灵给他，是没有限量的。

chapters.en: The Father loves the Son and has placed everything in his hands.
chapters.zh: 父爱子，已将万有交在他手里。

chapters.en: Whoever believes in the Son has eternal life, but whoever rejects the Son will not see life, for God’s wrath remains on them.
chapters.zh: 信子的人有永生。不信子的人得不着永生，（原文作不得见永生）神的震怒常在他身上。

chapters.en: Now Jesus learned that the Pharisees had heard that he was gaining and baptizing more disciples than John—
chapters.zh: 主知道法利赛人听见他收门徒施洗比约翰还多，

chapters.en: although in fact it was not Jesus who baptized, but his disciples.
chapters.zh: （其实不是耶稣亲自施洗，乃是他的门徒施洗）

chapters.en: So he left Judea and went back once more to Galilee.
chapters.zh: 他就离了犹太，又往加利利去。

chapters.en: Now he had to go through Samaria.
chapters.zh: 必须经过撒玛利亚。

chapters.en: So he came to a town in Samaria called Sychar, near the plot of ground Jacob had given to his son Joseph.
chapters.zh: 于是到了撒玛利亚的一座城，名叫叙加，靠近雅各给他儿子约瑟的那块地。

chapters.en: Jacob’s well was there, and Jesus, tired as he was from the journey, sat down by the well. It was about noon.
chapters.zh: 在那里有雅各井。耶稣因走路困乏，就坐在井旁。那时约有午正。

chapters.en: When a Samaritan woman came to draw water, Jesus said to her, “Will you give me a drink?”
chapters.zh: 有一个撒玛利亚的妇人来打水。耶稣对她说，请你给我水喝。

chapters.en: (His disciples had gone into the town to buy food.)
chapters.zh: 那时门徒进城买食物去了。

chapters.en: The Samaritan woman said to him, “You are a Jew and I am a Samaritan woman. How can you ask me for a drink?” (For Jews do not associate with Samaritans. )
chapters.zh: 撒玛利亚的妇人对他说，你既是犹太人，怎么向我一个撒玛利亚妇人要水喝呢？原来犹太人和撒玛利亚人没有来往。

chapters.en: Jesus answered her, “If you knew the gift of God and who it is that asks you for a drink, you would have asked him and he would have given you living water.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣回答说，你若知道神的恩赐，和对你说给我水喝的是谁，你必早求他，他也必早给了你活水。

chapters.en: “Sir,” the woman said, “you have nothing to draw with and the well is deep. Where can you get this living water?
chapters.zh: 妇人说，先生没有打水的器具，井又深，你从哪里得活水呢？

chapters.en: Are you greater than our father Jacob, who gave us the well and drank from it himself, as did also his sons and his livestock?”
chapters.zh: 我们的祖宗雅各，将这井留给我们。他自己和儿子并牲畜，也都喝这井里的水，难道你比他还大吗？

chapters.en: Jesus answered, “Everyone who drinks this water will be thirsty again,
chapters.zh: 耶稣回答说，凡喝这水的，还要再渴。

chapters.en: but whoever drinks the water I give them will never thirst. Indeed, the water I give them will become in them a spring of water welling up to eternal life.”
chapters.zh: 人若喝我所赐的水就永远不渴。我所赐的水，要在他里头成为泉源，直涌到永生。

chapters.en: The woman said to him, “Sir, give me this water so that I won’t get thirsty and have to keep coming here to draw water.”
chapters.zh: 妇人说，先生，请把这水赐给我，叫我不渴，也不用来这么远打水。

chapters.en: He told her, “Go, call your husband and come back.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣说，你去叫你丈夫也到这里来。

chapters.en: “I have no husband,” she replied. Jesus said to her, “You are right when you say you have no husband.
chapters.zh: 妇人说，我没有丈夫。耶稣说，你说没有丈夫，是不错的。

chapters.en: The fact is, you have had five husbands, and the man you now have is not your husband. What you have just said is quite true.”
chapters.zh: 你已经有五个丈夫。你现在有的，并不是你的丈夫。你这话是真的。

chapters.en: “Sir,” the woman said, “I can see that you are a prophet.
chapters.zh: 妇人说，先生，我看出你是先知。

chapters.en: Our ancestors worshiped on this mountain, but you Jews claim that the place where we must worship is in Jerusalem.”
chapters.zh: 我们的祖宗在这山上礼拜。你们倒说，应当礼拜的地方是在耶路撒冷。

chapters.en: “Woman,” Jesus replied, “believe me, a time is coming when you will worship the Father neither on this mountain nor in Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 耶稣说，妇人，你当信我，时候将到，你们拜父，也不在这山上，也不在耶路撒冷。

chapters.en: You Samaritans worship what you do not know; we worship what we do know, for salvation is from the Jews.
chapters.zh: 你们所拜的，你们不知道。我们所拜的，我们知道。因为救恩是从犹太人出来的。

chapters.en: Yet a time is coming and has now come when the true worshipers will worship the Father in the Spirit and in truth, for they are the kind of worshipers the Father seeks.
chapters.zh: 时候将到，如今就是了，那真正拜父的，要用心灵和诚实拜他，因为父要这样的人拜他。

chapters.en: God is spirit, and his worshipers must worship in the Spirit and in truth.”
chapters.zh: 神是个灵（或无个字）所以拜他的，必须用心灵和诚实拜他。

chapters.en: The woman said, “I know that Messiah” (called Christ) “is coming. When he comes, he will explain everything to us.”
chapters.zh: 妇人说，我知道弥赛亚，（就是那称为基督的）要来。他来了，必将一切的事都告诉我们。

chapters.en: Then Jesus declared, “I, the one speaking to you—I am he.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣说，这和你说话的就是他。

chapters.en: Just then his disciples returned and were surprised to find him talking with a woman. But no one asked, “What do you want?” or “Why are you talking with her?”
chapters.zh: 当下门徒回来，就希奇耶稣和一个妇人说话。只是没有人说，你是要什么？或说，你为什么和她说话？

chapters.en: Then, leaving her water jar, the woman went back to the town and said to the people,
chapters.zh: 那妇人就留下水罐子，往城里去，对众人说，

chapters.en: “Come, see a man who told me everything I ever did. Could this be the Messiah?”
chapters.zh: 你们来看，有一个人将我素来所行的一切事，都给我说出来了，莫非这就是基督吗？

chapters.en: They came out of the town and made their way toward him.
chapters.zh: 众人就出城往耶稣那里去。

chapters.en: Meanwhile his disciples urged him, “Rabbi, eat something.”
chapters.zh: 这其间，门徒对耶稣说，拉比请吃。

chapters.en: But he said to them, “I have food to eat that you know nothing about.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣说，我有食物吃，是你们不知道的。

chapters.en: Then his disciples said to each other, “Could someone have brought him food?”
chapters.zh: 门徒就彼此对问说，莫非有人拿什么给他吃吗？

chapters.en: “My food,” said Jesus, “is to do the will of him who sent me and to finish his work.
chapters.zh: 耶稣说，我的食物，就是遵行差我来者的旨意，作成他的工。

chapters.en: Don’t you have a saying, ‘It’s still four months until harvest’? I tell you, open your eyes and look at the fields! They are ripe for harvest.
chapters.zh: 你们岂不说，到收割的时候，还有四个月吗？我告诉你们，举目向田观看，庄稼已经熟了，（原文作发白）可以收割了。

chapters.en: Even now the one who reaps draws a wage and harvests a crop for eternal life, so that the sower and the reaper may be glad together.
chapters.zh: 收割的人得工价，积蓄五谷到永生。叫撒种的和收割的一同快乐。

chapters.en: Thus the saying ‘One sows and another reaps’ is true.
chapters.zh: 俗语说，那人撒种，这人收割，这话可见是真的。

chapters.en: I sent you to reap what you have not worked for. Others have done the hard work, and you have reaped the benefits of their labor.”
chapters.zh: 我差你们去收你们所没有劳苦的。别人劳苦，你们享受他们所劳苦的。

chapters.en: Many of the Samaritans from that town believed in him because of the woman’s testimony, “He told me everything I ever did.”
chapters.zh: 那城里有好些撒玛利亚人信了耶稣，因为那妇人作见证说，他将我素来所行的一切事，都给我说出来了。

chapters.en: So when the Samaritans came to him, they urged him to stay with them, and he stayed two days.
chapters.zh: 于是撒玛利亚人来见耶稣，求他在他们那里住下。他便在那里住了两天。

chapters.en: And because of his words many more became believers.
chapters.zh: 因耶稣的话，信的人就更多了。

chapters.en: They said to the woman, “We no longer believe just because of what you said; now we have heard for ourselves, and we know that this man really is the Savior of the world.”
chapters.zh: 便对妇人说，现在我们信，不是因为你的话，是我们亲自听见了，知道这真是救世主。

chapters.en: After the two days he left for Galilee.
chapters.zh: 过了那两天，耶稣离了那地方，往加利利去。

chapters.en: (Now Jesus himself had pointed out that a prophet has no honor in his own country.)
chapters.zh: 因为耶稣自己作过见证说，先知在本地是没有人尊敬的。

chapters.en: When he arrived in Galilee, the Galileans welcomed him. They had seen all that he had done in Jerusalem at the Passover Festival, for they also had been there.
chapters.zh: 到了加利利，加利利人既然看见他在耶路撒冷过节所行的一切事，就接待他。因为他们也是上去过节。

chapters.en: Once more he visited Cana in Galilee, where he had turned the water into wine. And there was a certain royal official whose son lay sick at Capernaum.
chapters.zh: 耶稣又到了加利利的迦拿，就是他从前变水为酒的地方。有一个大臣，他的儿子在迦百农患病。

chapters.en: When this man heard that Jesus had arrived in Galilee from Judea, he went to him and begged him to come and heal his son, who was close to death.
chapters.zh: 他听见耶稣从犹太到了加利利，就来见他，求他下去医治他的儿子。因为他儿子快要死了。

chapters.en: “Unless you people see signs and wonders,” Jesus told him, “you will never believe.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣就对他说，若不看见神迹奇事，你们总是不信。

chapters.en: The royal official said, “Sir, come down before my child dies.”
chapters.zh: 那大臣说，先生，求你趁着我的孩子还没有死，就下去。

chapters.en: “Go,” Jesus replied, “your son will live.”The man took Jesus at his word and departed.
chapters.zh: 耶稣对他说，回去吧。你的儿子活了。那人信耶稣所说的话，就回去了。

chapters.en: While he was still on the way, his servants met him with the news that his boy was living.
chapters.zh: 正下去的时候，他的仆人迎见他，说，他的儿子活了。

chapters.en: When he inquired as to the time when his son got better, they said to him, “Yesterday, at one in the afternoon, the fever left him.”
chapters.zh: 他就问什么时候见好的。他们说，昨日未时热就退了。

chapters.en: Then the father realized that this was the exact time at which Jesus had said to him, “Your son will live.” So he and his whole household believed.
chapters.zh: 他便知道这正是耶稣对他说，你儿子活了的时候，他自己和全家就都信了。

chapters.en: This was the second sign Jesus performed after coming from Judea to Galilee.
chapters.zh: 这是耶稣在加利利行的第二件神迹，是他从犹太回去以后行的。

chapters.en: Some time later, Jesus went up to Jerusalem for one of the Jewish festivals.
chapters.zh: 这事以后，到了犹太人的一个节期。耶稣就上耶路撒冷去。

chapters.en: Now there is in Jerusalem near the Sheep Gate a pool, which in Aramaic is called Bethesda and which is surrounded by five covered colonnades.
chapters.zh: 在耶路撒冷，靠近羊门，有一个池子，希伯来话叫作毕士大，旁边有五个廊子。

chapters.en: Here a great number of disabled people used to lie—the blind, the lame, the paralyzed.
chapters.zh: 里面躺着瞎眼的，瘸腿的，血气枯干的，许多病人。（有古卷在此有等候水动

chapters.en: [From time to time an angel of the Lord would come down and stir up the waters. The first one into the pool after each such disturbance would be cured of whatever disease he had.]
chapters.zh: 因为有天使按时下池子搅动那水，水动之后，谁先下去，无论害什么病，就痊愈了）。

chapters.en: One who was there had been an invalid for thirty-eight years.
chapters.zh: 在那里有一个人，病了三十八年。

chapters.en: When Jesus saw him lying there and learned that he had been in this condition for a long time, he asked him, “Do you want to get well?”
chapters.zh: 耶稣看见他躺着，知道他病了许久，就问他说，你要痊愈吗？

chapters.en: “Sir,” the invalid replied, “I have no one to help me into the pool when the water is stirred. While I am trying to get in, someone else goes down ahead of me.”
chapters.zh: 病人回答说，先生，水动的时候，没有人把我放在池子里。我正去的时候，就有别人比我先下去。

chapters.en: Then Jesus said to him, “Get up! Pick up your mat and walk.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣对他说，起来，拿你的褥子走吧。

chapters.en: At once the man was cured; he picked up his mat and walked. The day on which this took place was a Sabbath,
chapters.zh: 那人立刻痊愈，就拿起褥子来走了。

chapters.en: and so the Jewish leaders said to the man who had been healed, “It is the Sabbath; the law forbids you to carry your mat.”
chapters.zh: 那天是安息日，所以犹太人对那医好的人说，今天是安息日，你拿褥子是不可的。

chapters.en: But he replied, “The man who made me well said to me, ‘Pick up your mat and walk.’ ”
chapters.zh: 他却回答说，那使我痊愈的，对我说，拿你的褥子走吧。

chapters.en: So they asked him, “Who is this fellow who told you to pick it up and walk?”
chapters.zh: 他们问他说，对你说拿褥子走的，是什么人？

chapters.en: The man who was healed had no idea who it was, for Jesus had slipped away into the crowd that was there.
chapters.zh: 那医好的人不知道是谁。因为那里的人多，耶稣已经躲开了。

chapters.en: Later Jesus found him at the temple and said to him, “See, you are well again. Stop sinning or something worse may happen to you.”
chapters.zh: 后来耶稣在殿里遇见他，对他说，你已经痊愈了。不要再犯罪。恐怕你遭遇的更加利害。

chapters.en: The man went away and told the Jewish leaders that it was Jesus who had made him well.
chapters.zh: 那人就去告诉犹太人，使他痊愈的是耶稣。

chapters.en: So, because Jesus was doing these things on the Sabbath, the Jewish leaders began to persecute him.
chapters.zh: 所以犹太人逼迫耶稣，因为他在安息日作了这事。

chapters.en: In his defense Jesus said to them, “My Father is always at his work to this very day, and I too am working.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣就对他们说，我父作事直到如今，我也作事。

chapters.en: For this reason they tried all the more to kill him; not only was he breaking the Sabbath, but he was even calling God his own Father, making himself equal with God.
chapters.zh: 所以犹太人越发想要杀他。因他不但犯了安息日，并且称神为他的父，将自己和神当作平等。

chapters.en: Jesus gave them this answer: “Very truly I tell you, the Son can do nothing by himself; he can do only what he sees his Father doing, because whatever the Father does the Son also does.
chapters.zh: 耶稣对他们说，我实实在在地告诉你们，子凭着自己不能作什么，惟有看见父所作的，子才能作。父所作的事，子也照样作。

chapters.en: For the Father loves the Son and shows him all he does. Yes, and he will show him even greater works than these, so that you will be amazed.
chapters.zh: 父爱子，将自己所作的一切事指给他看。还要将比这更大的事指给他看，叫你们希奇。

chapters.en: For just as the Father raises the dead and gives them life, even so the Son gives life to whom he is pleased to give it.
chapters.zh: 父怎样叫死人起来，使他们活着，子也照样随自己的意思使人活着。

chapters.en: Moreover, the Father judges no one, but has entrusted all judgment to the Son,
chapters.zh: 父不审判什么人，乃将审判的事全交与子。

chapters.en: that all may honor the Son just as they honor the Father. Whoever does not honor the Son does not honor the Father, who sent him.
chapters.zh: 叫人都尊敬子，如同尊敬父一样。不尊敬子的，就是不尊敬差子来的父。

chapters.en: “Very truly I tell you, whoever hears my word and believes him who sent me has eternal life and will not be judged but has crossed over from death to life.
chapters.zh: 我实实在在地告诉你们，那听我话，又信差我来者的，就有永生，不至于定罪，是已经出死入生了。

chapters.en: Very truly I tell you, a time is coming and has now come when the dead will hear the voice of the Son of God and those who hear will live.
chapters.zh: 我实实在在地告诉你们，时候将到，现在就是了，死人要听见神儿子的声音。听见的人就要活了。

chapters.en: For as the Father has life in himself, so he has granted the Son also to have life in himself.
chapters.zh: 因为父怎样在自己有生命，就赐给他儿子也照样在自己有生命。

chapters.en: And he has given him authority to judge because he is the Son of Man.
chapters.zh: 并且因为他是人子，就赐给他行审判的权柄。

chapters.en: “Do not be amazed at this, for a time is coming when all who are in their graves will hear his voice
chapters.zh: 你们不要把这事看作希奇。时候要到，凡在坟墓里的，都要听见他的声音，就出来。

chapters.en: and come out—those who have done what is good will rise to live, and those who have done what is evil will rise to be condemned.
chapters.zh: 行善的复活得生，作恶的复活定罪。

chapters.en: By myself I can do nothing; I judge only as I hear, and my judgment is just, for I seek not to please myself but him who sent me.
chapters.zh: 我凭着自己不能作什么。我怎么听见，就怎么审判。我的审判也是公平的。因为我不求自己的意思，只求那差我来者的意思。

chapters.en: “If I testify about myself, my testimony is not true.
chapters.zh: 我若为自己作见证，我的见证就不真。

chapters.en: There is another who testifies in my favor, and I know that his testimony about me is true.
chapters.zh: 另有一位给我作见证。我也知道他给我作的见证是真的。

chapters.en: “You have sent to John and he has testified to the truth.
chapters.zh: 你们曾差人到约翰那里，他为真理作过见证。

chapters.en: Not that I accept human testimony; but I mention it that you may be saved.
chapters.zh: 其实我所受的见证，不是从人来的。然而我说这些话，为要叫你们得救。

chapters.en: John was a lamp that burned and gave light, and you chose for a time to enjoy his light.
chapters.zh: 约翰是点着的明灯。你们情愿暂时喜欢他的光。

chapters.en: “I have testimony weightier than that of John. For the works that the Father has given me to finish—the very works that I am doing—testify that the Father has sent me.
chapters.zh: 但我有比约翰更大的见证。因为父交给我要我成就的事，就是我所作的事，这便见证我是父所差来的。

chapters.en: And the Father who sent me has himself testified concerning me. You have never heard his voice nor seen his form,
chapters.zh: 差我来的父，也为我作过见证。你们从来没有听见他的声音，也没有看见他的形像。

chapters.en: nor does his word dwell in you, for you do not believe the one he sent.
chapters.zh: 你们并没有他的道存在心里。因为他所差来的，你们不信。

chapters.en: You study the Scriptures diligently because you think that in them you have eternal life. These are the very Scriptures that testify about me,
chapters.zh: 你们查考圣经。（或作应当查考圣经）因你们以为内中有永生。给我作见证的就是这经。

chapters.en: yet you refuse to come to me to have life.
chapters.zh: 然而你们不肯到我这里来得生命。

chapters.en: “I do not accept glory from human beings,
chapters.zh: 我不受从人来的荣耀。

chapters.en: but I know you. I know that you do not have the love of God in your hearts.
chapters.zh: 但我知道你们心里，没有神的爱。

chapters.en: I have come in my Father’s name, and you do not accept me; but if someone else comes in his own name, you will accept him.
chapters.zh: 我奉我父的名来，你们并不接待我。若有别人奉自己的名来，你们倒要接待他。

chapters.en: How can you believe since you accept glory from one another but do not seek the glory that comes from the only God?
chapters.zh: 你们互相受荣耀，却不求从独一之神来的荣耀，怎能信我呢？

chapters.en: “But do not think I will accuse you before the Father. Your accuser is Moses, on whom your hopes are set.
chapters.zh: 不要想我在父面前要告你们。有一位告你们的，就是你们所仰赖的摩西。

chapters.en: If you believed Moses, you would believe me, for he wrote about me.
chapters.zh: 你们如果信摩西，也必信我。因为他书上有指着我写的话。

chapters.en: But since you do not believe what he wrote, how are you going to believe what I say?”
chapters.zh: 你们若不信他的书，怎能信我的话呢？

chapters.en: Some time after this, Jesus crossed to the far shore of the Sea of Galilee (that is, the Sea of Tiberias),
chapters.zh: 这事以后，耶稣渡过加利利海，就是提比哩亚海。

chapters.en: and a great crowd of people followed him because they saw the signs he had performed by healing the sick.
chapters.zh: 有许多人，因为看见他在病人身上所行的神迹，就跟随他。

chapters.en: Then Jesus went up on a mountainside and sat down with his disciples.
chapters.zh: 耶稣上了山，和门徒一同坐在那里。

chapters.en: The Jewish Passover Festival was near.
chapters.zh: 那时犹太人的逾越节近了。

chapters.en: When Jesus looked up and saw a great crowd coming toward him, he said to Philip, “Where shall we buy bread for these people to eat?”
chapters.zh: 耶稣举目看见许多人来，就对腓力说，我们从哪里买饼叫这些人吃呢？

chapters.en: He asked this only to test him, for he already had in mind what he was going to do.
chapters.zh: 他说这话，是要试验腓力。他自己原知道要怎样行。

chapters.en: Philip answered him, “It would take more than half a year’s wages to buy enough bread for each one to have a bite!”
chapters.zh: 腓力回答说，就是二十两银子的饼，叫他们各人吃一点，也是不够的。

chapters.en: Another of his disciples, Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother, spoke up,
chapters.zh: 有一个门徒，就是西门彼得的兄弟安得烈，对耶稣说，

chapters.en: “Here is a boy with five small barley loaves and two small fish, but how far will they go among so many?”
chapters.zh: 在这里有一个孩童，带着五个大麦饼，两条鱼。只是分给这许多人，还算什么呢？

chapters.en: Jesus said, “Have the people sit down.” There was plenty of grass in that place, and they sat down (about five thousand men were there).
chapters.zh: 耶稣说，你们叫众人坐下。原来那地方的草多，众人就坐下。数目约有五千。

chapters.en: Jesus then took the loaves, gave thanks, and distributed to those who were seated as much as they wanted. He did the same with the fish.
chapters.zh: 耶稣拿起饼来，祝谢了，就分给那坐着的人。分鱼也是这样，都随着他们所要的。

chapters.en: When they had all had enough to eat, he said to his disciples, “Gather the pieces that are left over. Let nothing be wasted.”
chapters.zh: 他们吃饱了，耶稣对门徒说，把剩下的零碎，收拾起来，免得有糟蹋的。

chapters.en: So they gathered them and filled twelve baskets with the pieces of the five barley loaves left over by those who had eaten.
chapters.zh: 他们便将那五个大麦饼的零碎，就是众人吃了剩下的，收拾起来，装满了十二个篮子。

chapters.en: After the people saw the sign Jesus performed, they began to say, “Surely this is the Prophet who is to come into the world.”
chapters.zh: 众人看见耶稣所行的神迹。就说，这真是那要到世间来的先知。

chapters.en: Jesus, knowing that they intended to come and make him king by force, withdrew again to a mountain by himself.
chapters.zh: 耶稣既知道众人要来强逼他作王，就独自又退到山上去了。

chapters.en: When evening came, his disciples went down to the lake,
chapters.zh: 到了晚上，他的门徒下海边去，

chapters.en: where they got into a boat and set off across the lake for Capernaum. By now it was dark, and Jesus had not yet joined them.
chapters.zh: 上了船，要过海往迦百农去。天已经黑了，耶稣还没有来到他们那里。

chapters.en: A strong wind was blowing and the waters grew rough.
chapters.zh: 忽然狂风大作，海就翻腾起来。

chapters.en: When they had rowed about three or four miles, they saw Jesus approaching the boat, walking on the water; and they were frightened.
chapters.zh: 门徒摇橹约行了十里多路，看见耶稣在海面上走，渐渐近了船，他们就害怕。

chapters.en: But he said to them, “It is I; don’t be afraid.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣对他们说，是我。不要怕。

chapters.en: Then they were willing to take him into the boat, and immediately the boat reached the shore where they were heading.
chapters.zh: 门徒就喜欢接他上船，船立时到了他们所要去的地方。

chapters.en: The next day the crowd that had stayed on the opposite shore of the lake realized that only one boat had been there, and that Jesus had not entered it with his disciples, but that they had gone away alone.
chapters.zh: 第二日，站在海那边的众人，知道那里没有别的船，只有一只小船，又知道耶稣没有同他的门徒上船，乃是门徒自己去的。

chapters.en: Then some boats from Tiberias landed near the place where the people had eaten the bread after the Lord had given thanks.
chapters.zh: 然而有几只小船从提比哩亚来，靠近主祝谢后分饼给人吃的地方。

chapters.en: Once the crowd realized that neither Jesus nor his disciples were there, they got into the boats and went to Capernaum in search of Jesus.
chapters.zh: 众人见耶稣和门徒，都不在那里，就上了船，往迦百农去找耶稣。

chapters.en: When they found him on the other side of the lake, they asked him, “Rabbi, when did you get here?”
chapters.zh: 既在海那边找着了，就对他说，拉比，是几时到这里来的。

chapters.en: Jesus answered, “Very truly I tell you, you are looking for me, not because you saw the signs I performed but because you ate the loaves and had your fill.
chapters.zh: 耶稣回答说，我实实在在地告诉你们，你们找我，并不是因见了神迹，乃是因吃饼得饱。

chapters.en: Do not work for food that spoils, but for food that endures to eternal life, which the Son of Man will give you. For on him God the Father has placed his seal of approval.”
chapters.zh: 不要为那必坏的食物劳力，要为那存到永生的食物劳力，就是人子要赐给你们的。因为人子是父神所印证的。

chapters.en: Then they asked him, “What must we do to do the works God requires?”
chapters.zh: 众人问他说，我们当行什么，才算作神的工呢？

chapters.en: Jesus answered, “The work of God is this: to believe in the one he has sent.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣回答说，信神所差来的，这就是作神的工。

chapters.en: So they asked him, “What sign then will you give that we may see it and believe you? What will you do?
chapters.zh: 他们又说，你行什么神迹，叫我们看见就信你。你到底作什么事呢？

chapters.en: Our ancestors ate the manna in the wilderness; as it is written: ‘He gave them bread from heaven to eat.’ ”
chapters.zh: 我们的祖宗在旷野吃过吗哪，如经上写着说，他从天上赐下粮来给他们吃。

chapters.en: Jesus said to them, “Very truly I tell you, it is not Moses who has given you the bread from heaven, but it is my Father who gives you the true bread from heaven.
chapters.zh: 耶稣说，我实实在在地告诉你们，那从天上来的粮，不是摩西赐给你们的，乃是我父将天上来的真粮赐给你们。

chapters.en: For the bread of God is the bread that comes down from heaven and gives life to the world.”
chapters.zh: 因为神的粮，就是那从天上降下来赐生命给世界的。

chapters.en: “Sir,” they said, “always give us this bread.”
chapters.zh: 他们说，主阿，常将这粮赐给我们。

chapters.en: Then Jesus declared, “I am the bread of life. Whoever comes to me will never go hungry, and whoever believes in me will never be thirsty.
chapters.zh: 耶稣说，我就是生命的粮。到我这里来的，必定不饿。信我的，永远不渴。

chapters.en: But as I told you, you have seen me and still you do not believe.
chapters.zh: 只是我对你们说过，你们已经看见我，还是不信。

chapters.en: All those the Father gives me will come to me, and whoever comes to me I will never drive away.
chapters.zh: 凡父所赐给我的人，必到我这里来。到我这里来的，我总不丢弃他。

chapters.en: For I have come down from heaven not to do my will but to do the will of him who sent me.
chapters.zh: 因为我从天上降下来，不是要按自己的意思行，乃是要按那差我来者的意思行。

chapters.en: And this is the will of him who sent me, that I shall lose none of all those he has given me, but raise them up at the last day.
chapters.zh: 差我来者的意思，就是他所赐给我的，叫我一个也不失落，在末日却叫他复活。

chapters.en: For my Father’s will is that everyone who looks to the Son and believes in him shall have eternal life, and I will raise them up at the last day.”
chapters.zh: 因为我父的意思，是叫一切见子而信的人得永生。并且在末日我要叫他复活。

chapters.en: At this the Jews there began to grumble about him because he said, “I am the bread that came down from heaven.”
chapters.zh: 犹太人因为耶稣说，我是从天上降下来的粮，就私下议论他。

chapters.en: They said, “Is this not Jesus, the son of Joseph, whose father and mother we know? How can he now say, ‘I came down from heaven’?”
chapters.zh: 说，这不是约瑟的儿子耶稣吗？他的父母我们岂不认得吗？他如今怎么说，我是从天上降下来的呢？

chapters.en: “Stop grumbling among yourselves,” Jesus answered.
chapters.zh: 耶稣回答说，你们不要大家议论。

chapters.en: “No one can come to me unless the Father who sent me draws them, and I will raise them up at the last day.
chapters.zh: 若不是差我来的父吸引人，就没有能到我这里来的。到我这里来的，在末日我要叫他复活。

chapters.en: It is written in the Prophets: ‘They will all be taught by God.’Everyone who has heard the Father and learned from him comes to me.
chapters.zh: 在先知书上写着说，他们都要蒙神的教训。凡听见父之教训又学习的，就到我这里来。

chapters.en: No one has seen the Father except the one who is from God; only he has seen the Father.
chapters.zh: 这不是说，有人看见过父，惟独从神来的，他看见过父。

chapters.en: Very truly I tell you, the one who believes has eternal life.
chapters.zh: 我实实在在地告诉你们，信的人有永生。

chapters.en: I am the bread of life.
chapters.zh: 我就是生命的粮。

chapters.en: Your ancestors ate the manna in the wilderness, yet they died.
chapters.zh: 你们的祖宗在旷野吃过吗哪，还是死了。

chapters.en: But here is the bread that comes down from heaven, which anyone may eat and not die.
chapters.zh: 这是从天上降下来的粮，叫人吃了就不死。

chapters.en: I am the living bread that came down from heaven. Whoever eats this bread will live forever. This bread is my flesh, which I will give for the life of the world.”
chapters.zh: 我是从天上降下来生命的粮。人若吃这粮，就必永远活着。我所要赐的粮，就是我的肉，为世人之生命所赐的。

chapters.en: Then the Jews began to argue sharply among themselves, “How can this man give us his flesh to eat?”
chapters.zh: 因此，犹太人彼此争论说，这个人怎能把他的肉，给我们吃呢？

chapters.en: Jesus said to them, “Very truly I tell you, unless you eat the flesh of the Son of Man and drink his blood, you have no life in you.
chapters.zh: 耶稣说，我实实在在地告诉你们，你们若不吃人子的肉，不喝人子的血，就没有生命在你们里面。

chapters.en: Whoever eats my flesh and drinks my blood has eternal life, and I will raise them up at the last day.
chapters.zh: 吃我肉，喝我血的人就有永生。在末日我要叫他复活。

chapters.en: For my flesh is real food and my blood is real drink.
chapters.zh: 我的肉真是可吃的，我的血真是可喝的。

chapters.en: Whoever eats my flesh and drinks my blood remains in me, and I in them.
chapters.zh: 吃我肉喝我血的人，常在我里面，我也常在他里面。

chapters.en: Just as the living Father sent me and I live because of the Father, so the one who feeds on me will live because of me.
chapters.zh: 永活的父怎样差我来，我又因父活着，照样，吃我肉的人，也要因我活着。

chapters.en: This is the bread that came down from heaven. Your ancestors ate manna and died, but whoever feeds on this bread will live forever.”
chapters.zh: 这就是从天上降下来的粮。吃这粮的人，就永远活着，不象你们的祖宗吃过吗哪，还是死了。

chapters.en: He said this while teaching in the synagogue in Capernaum.
chapters.zh: 这些话是耶稣在迦百农会堂里教训人说的。

chapters.en: On hearing it, many of his disciples said, “This is a hard teaching. Who can accept it?”
chapters.zh: 他的门徒中有好些人听见了，就说，这话甚难，谁能听呢？

chapters.en: Aware that his disciples were grumbling about this, Jesus said to them, “Does this offend you?
chapters.zh: 耶稣心里知道门徒为这话议论，就对他们说，这话是叫你们厌弃吗？（厌弃原文作跌倒）

chapters.en: Then what if you see the Son of Man ascend to where he was before!
chapters.zh: 倘或你们看见人子升到他原来所在之处，怎么样呢？

chapters.en: The Spirit gives life; the flesh counts for nothing. The words I have spoken to you—they are full of the Spirit and life.
chapters.zh: 叫人活着的乃是灵，肉体是无益的。我对你们所说的话，就是灵，就是生命。

chapters.en: Yet there are some of you who do not believe.” For Jesus had known from the beginning which of them did not believe and who would betray him.
chapters.zh: 只是你们中间有不信的人。耶稣从起头就知道，谁不信他，谁要卖他。

chapters.en: He went on to say, “This is why I told you that no one can come to me unless the Father has enabled them.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣又说，所以我对你们说过，若不是蒙我父的恩赐，没有人能到我这里来。

chapters.en: From this time many of his disciples turned back and no longer followed him.
chapters.zh: 从此他门徒中多有退去的，不再和他同行。

chapters.en: “You do not want to leave too, do you?” Jesus asked the Twelve.
chapters.zh: 耶稣就对那十二个门徒说，你们也要去吗？

chapters.en: Simon Peter answered him, “Lord, to whom shall we go? You have the words of eternal life.
chapters.zh: 西门彼得回答说，主阿，你有永生之道，我们还归从谁呢？

chapters.en: We have come to believe and to know that you are the Holy One of God.”
chapters.zh: 我们已经信了，又知道你是神的圣者。

chapters.en: Then Jesus replied, “Have I not chosen you, the Twelve? Yet one of you is a devil!”
chapters.zh: 耶稣说，我不是拣选了你们十二个门徒吗？但你们中间有一个是魔鬼。

chapters.en: (He meant Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot, who, though one of the Twelve, was later to betray him.)
chapters.zh: 耶稣这话是指着加略人西门的儿子犹大说的。他本是十二个门徒里的一个，后来要卖耶稣的。

chapters.en: After this, Jesus went around in Galilee. He did not want to go about in Judea because the Jewish leaders there were looking for a way to kill him.
chapters.zh: 这事以后，耶稣在加利利游行，不愿在犹太游行。因为犹太人想要杀他。

chapters.en: But when the Jewish Festival of Tabernacles was near,
chapters.zh: 当时犹太人的住棚节近了。

chapters.en: Jesus’ brothers said to him, “Leave Galilee and go to Judea, so that your disciples there may see the works you do.
chapters.zh: 耶稣的弟兄就对他说，你离开这里上犹太去吧，叫你的门徒也看见你所行的事。

chapters.en: No one who wants to become a public figure acts in secret. Since you are doing these things, show yourself to the world.”
chapters.zh: 人要显扬名声，没有在暗处行事的。你如果行这些事，就当将自己显明给世人看。

chapters.en: For even his own brothers did not believe in him.
chapters.zh: 因为连他的弟兄说这话，是因为不信他。

chapters.en: Therefore Jesus told them, “My time is not yet here; for you any time will do.
chapters.zh: 耶稣就对他们说，我的时候还没有到。你们的时候常是方便的。

chapters.en: The world cannot hate you, but it hates me because I testify that its works are evil.
chapters.zh: 世人不能恨你们，却是恨我。因为我指证他们所作的事是恶的。

chapters.en: You go to the festival. I am not going up to this festival, because my time has not yet fully come.”
chapters.zh: 你们上去过节吧。我现在不上去过这节。因为我的时候还没有满。

chapters.en: After he had said this, he stayed in Galilee.
chapters.zh: 耶稣说了这话，仍旧住在加利利。

chapters.en: However, after his brothers had left for the festival, he went also, not publicly, but in secret.
chapters.zh: 但他弟兄上去以后，他也上去过节，不是明去，似乎是暗去的。

chapters.en: Now at the festival the Jewish leaders were watching for Jesus and asking, “Where is he?”
chapters.zh: 正在节期，犹太人寻找耶稣说，他在那里。

chapters.en: Among the crowds there was widespread whispering about him. Some said, “He is a good man.” Others replied, “No, he deceives the people.”
chapters.zh: 众人为他纷纷议论。有的说，他是好人。有的说，不然，他是迷惑众人的。

chapters.en: But no one would say anything publicly about him for fear of the leaders.
chapters.zh: 只是没有人明明地讲论他，因为怕犹太人。

chapters.en: Not until halfway through the festival did Jesus go up to the temple courts and begin to teach.
chapters.zh: 到了节期，耶稣上殿里去教训人。

chapters.en: The Jews there were amazed and asked, “How did this man get such learning without having been taught?”
chapters.zh: 犹太人就希奇说，这个人没有学过，怎么明白书呢？
