chapters.en: Jesus answered, “My teaching is not my own. It comes from the one who sent me.
chapters.zh: 耶稣说，我的教训不是我自己的，乃是那差我来者的。

chapters.en: Anyone who chooses to do the will of God will find out whether my teaching comes from God or whether I speak on my own.
chapters.zh: 人若立志遵着他的旨意行，就必晓得这教训或是出于神，或是我凭着自己说的。

chapters.en: Whoever speaks on their own does so to gain personal glory, but he who seeks the glory of the one who sent him is a man of truth; there is nothing false about him.
chapters.zh: 人凭着自己说，是求自己的荣耀。惟有求那差他来者的荣耀，这人是真的，在他心里没有不义。

chapters.en: Has not Moses given you the law? Yet not one of you keeps the law. Why are you trying to kill me?”
chapters.zh: 摩西岂不是传律法给你们吗？你们却没有一个人守律法。为什么想要杀我呢？

chapters.en: “You are demon-possessed,” the crowd answered. “Who is trying to kill you?”
chapters.zh: 众人回答说，你是被鬼附着了。谁想要杀你。

chapters.en: Jesus said to them, “I did one miracle, and you are all amazed.
chapters.zh: 耶稣说，我作了一件事，你们都以为希奇。

chapters.en: Yet, because Moses gave you circumcision (though actually it did not come from Moses, but from the patriarchs), you circumcise a boy on the Sabbath.
chapters.zh: 摩西传割礼给你们，（其实不是从摩西起的，乃是从祖先起的）因此你们也在安息日给人行割礼。

chapters.en: Now if a boy can be circumcised on the Sabbath so that the law of Moses may not be broken, why are you angry with me for healing a man’s whole body on the Sabbath?
chapters.zh: 人若在安息日受割礼，免得违背摩西的律法。我在安息日叫一个人全然好了，你们就向我生气吗？

chapters.en: Stop judging by mere appearances, but instead judge correctly.”
chapters.zh: 不可按外貌断定是非，总要按公平断定是非。

chapters.en: At that point some of the people of Jerusalem began to ask, “Isn’t this the man they are trying to kill?
chapters.zh: 耶路撒冷人中有的说，这不是他们想要杀的人吗？

chapters.en: Here he is, speaking publicly, and they are not saying a word to him. Have the authorities really concluded that he is the Messiah?
chapters.zh: 你看他还明明地讲道，他们也不向他说什么。难道官长真知道这是基督吗？

chapters.en: But we know where this man is from; when the Messiah comes, no one will know where he is from.”
chapters.zh: 然而我们知道这个人从哪里来。只是基督来的时候，没有人知道他从哪里来。

chapters.en: Then Jesus, still teaching in the temple courts, cried out, “Yes, you know me, and you know where I am from. I am not here on my own authority, but he who sent me is true. You do not know him,
chapters.zh: 那时耶稣在殿里教训人，大声说，你们也知道我，也知道我从哪里来。我来并不是由于自己，但那差我来的是真的。你们不认识他。

chapters.en: but I know him because I am from him and he sent me.”
chapters.zh: 我却认识他。因为我是从他来的，他也是差了我来。

chapters.en: At this they tried to seize him, but no one laid a hand on him, because his hour had not yet come.
chapters.zh: 他们就想要捉拿耶稣。只是没有人下手，因为他的时候还没有到。

chapters.en: Still, many in the crowd believed in him. They said, “When the Messiah comes, will he perform more signs than this man?”
chapters.zh: 但众人中间有好些信他的，说，基督来的时候，他所行的神迹，岂能比这人所行的更多吗？

chapters.en: The Pharisees heard the crowd whispering such things about him. Then the chief priests and the Pharisees sent temple guards to arrest him.
chapters.zh: 法利赛人听见众人为耶稣这样纷纷议论，祭司长和法利赛人，就打发差役去捉拿他。

chapters.en: Jesus said, “I am with you for only a short time, and then I am going to the one who sent me.
chapters.zh: 于是耶稣说，我还有不多的时候和你们同在，以后就回到差我来的那里去。

chapters.en: You will look for me, but you will not find me; and where I am, you cannot come.”
chapters.zh: 你们要找我，却找不着。我所在的地方你们不能到。

chapters.en: The Jews said to one another, “Where does this man intend to go that we cannot find him? Will he go where our people live scattered among the Greeks, and teach the Greeks?
chapters.zh: 犹太人就彼此对问说，这人要往哪里去，叫我们找不着呢？难道他要往散住希利尼中的犹太人那里去教训希利尼人吗？

chapters.en: What did he mean when he said, ‘You will look for me, but you will not find me,’ and ‘Where I am, you cannot come’?”
chapters.zh: 他说，你们要找我，却找不着，我所在的地方，你们不能到。这话是什么意思呢？

chapters.en: On the last and greatest day of the festival, Jesus stood and said in a loud voice, “Let anyone who is thirsty come to me and drink.
chapters.zh: 节期的末日，就是最大之日，耶稣站着高声说，人若渴了，可以到我这里来喝。

chapters.en: Whoever believes in me, as Scripture has said, rivers of living water will flow from within them.”
chapters.zh: 信我的人，就如经上所说，从他腹中要流出活水的江河来。

chapters.en: By this he meant the Spirit, whom those who believed in him were later to receive. Up to that time the Spirit had not been given, since Jesus had not yet been glorified.
chapters.zh: 耶稣这话是指着信他之人，要受圣灵说的，那时还没有赐下圣灵来，因为耶稣尚未得着荣耀。

chapters.en: On hearing his words, some of the people said, “Surely this man is the Prophet.”
chapters.zh: 众人听见这话，有的说，这真是那先知。

chapters.en: Others said, “He is the Messiah.” Still others asked, “How can the Messiah come from Galilee?
chapters.zh: 有的说，这是基督。但也有的说，基督岂是从加利利出来的吗？

chapters.en: Does not Scripture say that the Messiah will come from David’s descendants and from Bethlehem, the town where David lived?”
chapters.zh: 经上岂不是说，基督是大卫的后裔，从大卫本乡伯利恒出来的吗？

chapters.en: Thus the people were divided because of Jesus.
chapters.zh: 于是众人因着耶稣起了分争。

chapters.en: Some wanted to seize him, but no one laid a hand on him.
chapters.zh: 其中有人要捉拿他。只是无人下手。

chapters.en: Finally the temple guards went back to the chief priests and the Pharisees, who asked them, “Why didn’t you bring him in?”
chapters.zh: 差役回到祭司长和法利赛人那里。他们对差役说，你们为什么没有带他来呢？

chapters.en: “No one ever spoke the way this man does,” the guards replied.
chapters.zh: 差役回答说，从来没有像他这样说话的。

chapters.en: “You mean he has deceived you also?” the Pharisees retorted.
chapters.zh: 法利赛人说，你们也受了迷惑吗？

chapters.en: “Have any of the rulers or of the Pharisees believed in him?
chapters.zh: 官长或是法利赛人，岂有信他的呢？

chapters.en: No! But this mob that knows nothing of the law—there is a curse on them.”
chapters.zh: 但这些不明白律法的百姓，是被咒诅的。

chapters.en: Nicodemus, who had gone to Jesus earlier and who was one of their own number, asked,
chapters.zh: 内中有尼哥底母，就是从前去见耶稣的，对他们说，

chapters.en: “Does our law condemn a man without first hearing him to find out what he has been doing?”
chapters.zh: 不先听本人的口供，不知道他所作的事，难道我们的律法还定他的罪吗？

chapters.en: They replied, “Are you from Galilee, too? Look into it, and you will find that a prophet does not come out of Galilee.”Then they all went home
chapters.zh: 他们回答说，你也是出于加利利吗？你且去查考，就可知道，加利利没有出过先知。

chapters.en: but Jesus went to the Mount of Olives.
chapters.zh: 于是各人都回家去了。耶稣却往橄榄山去。

chapters.en: At dawn he appeared again in the temple courts, where all the people gathered around him, and he sat down to teach them.
chapters.zh: 清早又回到殿里。众百姓都到他那里去，他就坐下教训他们。

chapters.en: The teachers of the law and the Pharisees brought in a woman caught in adultery. They made her stand before the group
chapters.zh: 文士和法利赛人，带着一个行淫时被拿的妇人来，叫他站在当中。

chapters.en: and said to Jesus, “Teacher, this woman was caught in the act of adultery.
chapters.zh: 就对耶稣说，夫子，这妇人是正行淫之时被拿的。

chapters.en: In the Law Moses commanded us to stone such women. Now what do you say?”
chapters.zh: 摩西在律法上吩咐我们，把这样的妇人用石头打死。你说该把她怎么样呢？

chapters.en: They were using this question as a trap, in order to have a basis for accusing him. But Jesus bent down and started to write on the ground with his finger.
chapters.zh: 他们说这话，乃试探耶稣，要得着告他的把柄。耶稣却弯着腰用指头在地上画字。

chapters.en: When they kept on questioning him, he straightened up and said to them, “Let any one of you who is without sin be the first to throw a stone at her.”
chapters.zh: 他们还是不住地问他，耶稣就直起腰来，对他们说，你们中间谁是没有罪的，谁就可以先拿石头打她。

chapters.en: Again he stooped down and wrote on the ground.
chapters.zh: 于是又弯着腰用指头在地上画字。

chapters.en: At this, those who heard began to go away one at a time, the older ones first, until only Jesus was left, with the woman still standing there.
chapters.zh: 他们听见这话，就从老到少一个一个地都出去了。只剩下耶稣一人。还有那妇人仍然站在当中。

chapters.en: Jesus straightened up and asked her, “Woman, where are they? Has no one condemned you?”
chapters.zh: 耶稣就直起腰来，对她说，妇人，那些人在哪里呢？没有人定你的罪吗？

chapters.en: “No one, sir,” she said. “Then neither do I condemn you,” Jesus declared. “Go now and leave your life of sin.”
chapters.zh: 她说，主阿，没有。耶稣说，我也不定你的罪。去吧。从此不要再犯罪了。

chapters.en: When Jesus spoke again to the people, he said, “I am the light of the world. Whoever follows me will never walk in darkness, but will have the light of life.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣又对众人说，我是世界的光。跟从我的，就不在黑暗里走，必要得着生命的光。

chapters.en: The Pharisees challenged him, “Here you are, appearing as your own witness; your testimony is not valid.”
chapters.zh: 法利赛人对他说，你是为自己作见证。你的见证不真。

chapters.en: Jesus answered, “Even if I testify on my own behalf, my testimony is valid, for I know where I came from and where I am going. But you have no idea where I come from or where I am going.
chapters.zh: 耶稣说，我虽然为自己作见证，我的见证还是真的。因我知道我从哪里来，往哪里去。你们却不知道我从哪里来，往哪里去。

chapters.en: You judge by human standards; I pass judgment on no one.
chapters.zh: 你们是以外貌（原文作凭肉身）判断人。我却不判断人。

chapters.en: But if I do judge, my decisions are true, because I am not alone. I stand with the Father, who sent me.
chapters.zh: 就是判断人，我的判断也是真的。因为不是我独自在这里，还有差我来的父与我同在。

chapters.en: In your own Law it is written that the testimony of two witnesses is true.
chapters.zh: 你们的律法上也记着说，两个人的见证是真的。

chapters.en: I am one who testifies for myself; my other witness is the Father, who sent me.”
chapters.zh: 我是为自己作见证，还有差我来的父，也是为我作见证。

chapters.en: Then they asked him, “Where is your father?” “You do not know me or my Father,” Jesus replied. “If you knew me, you would know my Father also.”
chapters.zh: 他们就问他说，你的父在哪里？耶稣回答说，你们不认识我，也不认识我的父。若是认识我，也就认识我的父。

chapters.en: He spoke these words while teaching in the temple courts near the place where the offerings were put. Yet no one seized him, because his hour had not yet come.
chapters.zh: 这些话是耶稣在殿里的库房，教训人时所说的。也没有人拿他。因为他的时候还没有到。

chapters.en: Once more Jesus said to them, “I am going away, and you will look for me, and you will die in your sin. Where I go, you cannot come.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣又对他们说，我要去了，你们要找我，并且你们要死在罪中。我所去的地方，你们不能到。

chapters.en: This made the Jews ask, “Will he kill himself? Is that why he says, ‘Where I go, you cannot come’?”
chapters.zh: 犹太人说，他说我所去的地方，你们不能到，难道他要自尽吗？

chapters.en: But he continued, “You are from below; I am from above. You are of this world; I am not of this world.
chapters.zh: 耶稣对他们说，你们是从下头来的，我是从上头来的。你们是属这世界的，我不是属这世界的。

chapters.en: I told you that you would die in your sins; if you do not believe that I am he, you will indeed die in your sins.”
chapters.zh: 所以我对你们说，你们要死在罪中，你们若不信我是基督，必要死在罪中。

chapters.en: “Who are you?” they asked. “Just what I have been telling you from the beginning,” Jesus replied.
chapters.zh: 他们就问他说，你是谁？耶稣对他们说，就是我从起初所告诉你们的。

chapters.en: “I have much to say in judgment of you. But he who sent me is trustworthy, and what I have heard from him I tell the world.”
chapters.zh: 我有许多事讲论你们，判断你们，但那差我来的是真的。我在他那里所听见的，我就传给世人。

chapters.en: They did not understand that he was telling them about his Father.
chapters.zh: 他们不明白耶稣是指着父说的。

chapters.en: So Jesus said, “When you have lifted up  the Son of Man, then you will know that I am he and that I do nothing on my own but speak just what the Father has taught me.
chapters.zh: 所以耶稣说，你们举起人子以后，必知道我是基督，并且知道我没有一件事，是凭着自己作的。我说这些话，乃是照着父所教训我的。

chapters.en: The one who sent me is with me; he has not left me alone, for I always do what pleases him.”
chapters.zh: 那差我来的，是与我同在。他没有撇下我独自在这里，因为我常作他所喜悦的事。

chapters.en: Even as he spoke, many believed in him.
chapters.zh: 耶稣说这话的时候，就有许多人信他。

chapters.en: To the Jews who had believed him, Jesus said, “If you hold to my teaching, you are really my disciples.
chapters.zh: 耶稣对信他的犹太人说，你们若常常遵守我的道，就真是我的门徒。

chapters.en: Then you will know the truth, and the truth will set you free.”
chapters.zh: 你们必晓得真理，真理必叫你们得以自由。

chapters.en: They answered him, “We are Abraham’s descendants and have never been slaves of anyone. How can you say that we shall be set free?”
chapters.zh: 他们回答说，我们是亚伯拉罕的后裔，从来没有作过谁的奴仆。你怎么说，你们必得自由呢？

chapters.en: Jesus replied, “Very truly I tell you, everyone who sins is a slave to sin.
chapters.zh: 耶稣回答说，我实实在在地告诉你们。所有犯罪的，就是罪的奴仆。

chapters.en: Now a slave has no permanent place in the family, but a son belongs to it forever.
chapters.zh: 奴仆不能永远住在家里，儿子是永远住在家里。

chapters.en: So if the Son sets you free, you will be free indeed.
chapters.zh: 所以天父的儿子若叫你们自由，你们就真自由了。

chapters.en: I know that you are Abraham’s descendants. Yet you are looking for a way to kill me, because you have no room for my word.
chapters.zh: 我知道你们是亚伯拉罕的子孙，你们却想要杀我。因为你们心里容不下我的道。

chapters.en: I am telling you what I have seen in the Father’s presence, and you are doing what you have heard from your father.”
chapters.zh: 我所说的，是在我父那里看见的。你们所行的，是在你们的父那里听见的。

chapters.en: “Abraham is our father,” they answered. “If you were Abraham’s children,” said Jesus, “then you would   do what Abraham did.
chapters.zh: 他们说，我们的父就是亚伯拉罕。耶稣说，你们若是亚伯拉罕的儿子，就必行亚伯拉罕所行的事。

chapters.en: As it is, you are looking for a way to kill me, a man who has told you the truth that I heard from God. Abraham did not do such things.
chapters.zh: 我将在神那里所听见的真理，告诉了你们，现在你们却想要杀我。这不是亚伯拉罕所行的事。

chapters.en: You are doing the works of your own father.” “We are not illegitimate children,” they protested. “The only Father we have is God himself.”
chapters.zh: 你们是行你们父所行的事。他们说，我们不是从淫乱生的。我们只有一位父就是神。

chapters.en: Jesus said to them, “If God were your Father, you would love me, for I have come here from God. I have not come on my own; God sent me.
chapters.zh: 耶稣说，倘若神是你们的父，你们就必爱我。因为我本是出于神，也是从神而来，并不是由着自己来，乃是他差我来。

chapters.en: Why is my language not clear to you? Because you are unable to hear what I say.
chapters.zh: 你们为什么不明白我的话呢？无非是因你们不能听我的道。

chapters.en: You belong to your father, the devil, and you want to carry out your father’s desires. He was a murderer from the beginning, not holding to the truth, for there is no truth in him. When he lies, he speaks his native language, for he is a liar and the father of lies.
chapters.zh: 你们是出于你们的父魔鬼，你们父的私欲，你们偏要行，他从起初是杀人的，不守真理。因他心里没有真理，他说谎是出于自己，因他本来是说谎的，也是说谎之人的父。

chapters.en: Yet because I tell the truth, you do not believe me!
chapters.zh: 我将真理告诉你们，你们就因此不信我。

chapters.en: Can any of you prove me guilty of sin? If I am telling the truth, why don’t you believe me?
chapters.zh: 你们中间谁能指证我有罪呢？我既然将真理告诉你们，为什么不信我呢？

chapters.en: Whoever belongs to God hears what God says. The reason you do not hear is that you do not belong to God.”
chapters.zh: 出于神的，必听神的话。你们不听，因为你们不是出于神。

chapters.en: The Jews answered him, “Aren’t we right in saying that you are a Samaritan and demon-possessed?”
chapters.zh: 犹太人回答说，我们说，你是撒玛利亚人，并且是鬼附着的，这话岂不正对吗？

chapters.en: “I am not possessed by a demon,” said Jesus, “but I honor my Father and you dishonor me.
chapters.zh: 耶稣说，我不是鬼附着的。我尊敬我的父，你们倒轻慢我。

chapters.en: I am not seeking glory for myself; but there is one who seeks it, and he is the judge.
chapters.zh: 我不求自己的荣耀。有一位为我求荣耀定是非的。

chapters.en: Very truly I tell you, whoever obeys my word will never see death.”
chapters.zh: 我实实在在地告诉你们，人若遵守我的道，就永远不见死。

chapters.en: At this they exclaimed, “Now we know that you are demon-possessed! Abraham died and so did the prophets, yet you say that whoever obeys your word will never taste death.
chapters.zh: 犹太人对他说，现在我们知道你是鬼附着的。亚伯拉罕死了，众先知也死了。你还说，人若遵守我的道，就永远不尝死味。

chapters.en: Are you greater than our father Abraham? He died, and so did the prophets. Who do you think you are?”
chapters.zh: 难道你比我们的祖宗亚伯拉罕还大吗？他死了，众先知也死了。你将自己当作什么人呢？

chapters.en: Jesus replied, “If I glorify myself, my glory means nothing. My Father, whom you claim as your God, is the one who glorifies me.
chapters.zh: 耶稣回答说，我若荣耀自己，我的荣耀就算不得什么。荣耀我的乃是我的父，就是你们所说是你们的神。

chapters.en: Though you do not know him, I know him. If I said I did not, I would be a liar like you, but I do know him and obey his word.
chapters.zh: 你们未曾认识他。我却认识他。我若说不认识他，我就是说谎的，象你们一样，但我认识他，也遵守他的道。

chapters.en: Your father Abraham rejoiced at the thought of seeing my day; he saw it and was glad.”
chapters.zh: 你们的祖宗亚伯拉罕欢欢喜喜地仰望我的日子。既看见了，就快乐。

chapters.en: “You are not yet fifty years old,” they said to him, “and you have seen Abraham!”
chapters.zh: 犹太人说，你还没有五十岁，岂见过亚伯拉罕呢？

chapters.en: “Very truly I tell you,” Jesus answered, “before Abraham was born, I am!”
chapters.zh: 耶稣说，我实实在在地告诉你们，还没有亚伯拉罕，就有了我。

chapters.en: At this, they picked up stones to stone him, but Jesus hid himself, slipping away from the temple grounds.
chapters.zh: 于是他们拿石头要打他。耶稣却躲藏，从殿里出去了。

chapters.en: As he went along, he saw a man blind from birth.
chapters.zh: 耶稣过去的时候，看见一个人生来是瞎眼的。

chapters.en: His disciples asked him, “Rabbi, who sinned, this man or his parents, that he was born blind?”
chapters.zh: 门徒问耶稣说，拉比，这人生来是瞎眼的，是谁犯了罪？是这人呢？是他父母呢？

chapters.en: “Neither this man nor his parents sinned,” said Jesus, “but this happened so that the works of God might be displayed in him.
chapters.zh: 耶稣回答说，也不是这人犯了罪，也不是他父母犯了罪，是要在他身上显出神的作为来。

chapters.en: As long as it is day, we must do the works of him who sent me. Night is coming, when no one can work.
chapters.zh: 趁着白日，我们必须作那差我来者的工。黑夜将到，就没有人能作工了。

chapters.en: While I am in the world, I am the light of the world.”
chapters.zh: 我在世上的时候，是世上的光。

chapters.en: After saying this, he spit on the ground, made some mud with the saliva, and put it on the man’s eyes.
chapters.zh: 耶稣说了这话，就吐唾沫在地上，用唾沫和泥抹在瞎子的眼睛上，

chapters.en: “Go,” he told him, “wash in the Pool of Siloam” (this word means “Sent”). So the man went and washed, and came home seeing.
chapters.zh: 对他说，你往西罗亚池子里去洗，（西罗亚翻出来，就是奉差遣）他去一洗，回头就看见了。

chapters.en: His neighbors and those who had formerly seen him begging asked, “Isn’t this the same man who used to sit and beg?”
chapters.zh: 他的邻舍，和那素常见他是讨饭的，就说，这不是那从前坐着讨饭的人吗？

chapters.en: Some claimed that he was. Others said, “No, he only looks like him.” But he himself insisted, “I am the man.”
chapters.zh: 有人说，是他。又有人说，不是，却是像他。他自己说，是我。

chapters.en: “How then were your eyes opened?” they asked.
chapters.zh: 他们对他说，你的眼睛是怎么开的呢？

chapters.en: He replied, “The man they call Jesus made some mud and put it on my eyes. He told me to go to Siloam and wash. So I went and washed, and then I could see.”
chapters.zh: 他回答说，有一个人名叫耶稣。他和泥抹我的眼睛，对我说，你往西罗亚池子去洗。我去一洗，就看见了。

chapters.en: “Where is this man?” they asked him. “I don’t know,” he said.
chapters.zh: 他们说，那个人在哪里？他说，我不知道。

chapters.en: They brought to the Pharisees the man who had been blind.
chapters.zh: 他们把从前瞎眼的人，带到法利赛人那里。

chapters.en: Now the day on which Jesus had made the mud and opened the man’s eyes was a Sabbath.
chapters.zh: 耶稣和泥开他眼睛的日子是安息日。

chapters.en: Therefore the Pharisees also asked him how he had received his sight. “He put mud on my eyes,” the man replied, “and I washed, and now I see.”
chapters.zh: 法利赛人也问他是怎么得看见的。瞎子对他们说，他把泥抹在我的眼睛上，我去一洗，就看见了。

chapters.en: Some of the Pharisees said, “This man is not from God, for he does not keep the Sabbath.” But others asked, “How can a sinner perform such signs?” So they were divided.
chapters.zh: 法利赛人中有的说，这个人不是从神来的，因为他不守安息日。又有人说，一个罪人怎能行这样的神迹呢？他们就起了纷争。

chapters.en: Then they turned again to the blind man, “What have you to say about him? It was your eyes he opened.” The man replied, “He is a prophet.”
chapters.zh: 他们又对瞎子说，他既然开了你的眼睛，你说他是怎样的人呢？他说，是个先知。

chapters.en: They still did not believe that he had been blind and had received his sight until they sent for the man’s parents.
chapters.zh: 犹太人不信他从前是瞎眼，后来能看见的，等到叫了他的父母来，

chapters.en: “Is this your son?” they asked. “Is this the one you say was born blind? How is it that now he can see?”
chapters.zh: 问他们说，这是你们的儿子吗？你们说他生来是瞎眼的，如今怎么能看见了呢？

chapters.en: “We know he is our son,” the parents answered, “and we know he was born blind.
chapters.zh: 他父母回答说，他是我们的儿子，生来就瞎眼，这是我们知道的。

chapters.en: But how he can see now, or who opened his eyes, we don’t know. Ask him. He is of age; he will speak for himself.”
chapters.zh: 至于他如今怎么能看见，我们却不知道。是谁开了他的眼睛，我们也不知道。他已经成了人，你们问他吧。他自己必能说。

chapters.en: His parents said this because they were afraid of the Jewish leaders, who already had decided that anyone who acknowledged that Jesus was the Messiah would be put out of the synagogue.
chapters.zh: 他父母说这话，是怕犹太人，因为犹太人已经商议定了，若有认耶稣是基督的，要把他赶出会堂。

chapters.en: That was why his parents said, “He is of age; ask him.”
chapters.zh: 因此他父母说，他已经成了人，你们问他吧。

chapters.en: A second time they summoned the man who had been blind. “Give glory to God by telling the truth,” they said. “We know this man is a sinner.”
chapters.zh: 所以法利赛人第二次叫了那从前瞎眼的人来，对他说，你该将荣耀归给神。我们知道这人是个罪人。

chapters.en: He replied, “Whether he is a sinner or not, I don’t know. One thing I do know. I was blind but now I see!”
chapters.zh: 他说，他是个罪人不是，我不知道。有一件事我知道，从前我是眼瞎的，如今能看见了。

chapters.en: Then they asked him, “What did he do to you? How did he open your eyes?”
chapters.zh: 他们就问他说，他向你作什么？是怎么开了你的眼睛呢？

chapters.en: He answered, “I have told you already and you did not listen. Why do you want to hear it again? Do you want to become his disciples too?”
chapters.zh: 他回答说，我方才告诉你们，你们不听。为什么又要听呢？莫非你们也要作他的门徒吗？

chapters.en: Then they hurled insults at him and said, “You are this fellow’s disciple! We are disciples of Moses!
chapters.zh: 他们就骂他说，你是他的门徒。我们是摩西的门徒。

chapters.en: We know that God spoke to Moses, but as for this fellow, we don’t even know where he comes from.”
chapters.zh: 神对摩西说话，是我们知道的。只是这个人，我们不知道他从哪里来。

chapters.en: The man answered, “Now that is remarkable! You don’t know where he comes from, yet he opened my eyes.
chapters.zh: 那人回答说，他开了我的眼睛，你们竟不知道他从哪里来，这真是奇怪。

chapters.en: We know that God does not listen to sinners. He listens to the godly person who does his will.
chapters.zh: 我们知道神不听罪人。惟有敬奉神，遵行他旨意的，神才听他。

chapters.en: Nobody has ever heard of opening the eyes of a man born blind.
chapters.zh: 从创世以来，未曾听见有人把生来是瞎子的眼睛开了。

chapters.en: If this man were not from God, he could do nothing.”
chapters.zh: 这人若不是从神来的，什么也不能作。

chapters.en: To this they replied, “You were steeped in sin at birth; how dare you lecture us!” And they threw him out.
chapters.zh: 他们回答说，你全然生在罪孽中，还要教训我们吗？于是把他赶出去了。

chapters.en: Jesus heard that they had thrown him out, and when he found him, he said, “Do you believe in the Son of Man?”
chapters.zh: 耶稣听说他们把他赶出去。后来遇见他，就说，你信神的儿子吗？

chapters.en: “Who is he, sir?” the man asked. “Tell me so that I may believe in him.”
chapters.zh: 他回答说，主阿，谁是神的儿子，叫我信他呢？

chapters.en: Jesus said, “You have now seen him; in fact, he is the one speaking with you.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣说，你已经看见他，现在和你说话的就是他。

chapters.en: Then the man said, “Lord, I believe,” and he worshiped him.
chapters.zh: 他说，主阿，我信。就拜耶稣。

chapters.en: Jesus said,“For judgment I have come into this world, so that the blind will see and those who see will become blind.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣说，我为审判到这世上来，叫不能看见的，可以看见。能看见的，反瞎了眼。

chapters.en: Some Pharisees who were with him heard him say this and asked, “What? Are we blind too?”
chapters.zh: 同他在那里的法利赛人，听见这话，就说，难道我们也瞎了眼吗？

chapters.en: Jesus said, “If you were blind, you would not be guilty of sin; but now that you claim you can see, your guilt remains.
chapters.zh: 耶稣对他们说，你们若瞎了眼，就没有罪了。但如今你们说，我们能看见，所以你们的罪还在。

chapters.en: “Very truly I tell you Pharisees, anyone who does not enter the sheep pen by the gate, but climbs in by some other way, is a thief and a robber.
chapters.zh: 我实实在在地告诉你们，人进羊圈，不从门进去，倒从别处爬进去，那人就是贼，就是强盗。

chapters.en: The one who enters by the gate is the shepherd of the sheep.
chapters.zh: 从门进去的，才是羊的牧人。

chapters.en: The gatekeeper opens the gate for him, and the sheep listen to his voice. He calls his own sheep by name and leads them out.
chapters.zh: 看门的就给他开门。羊也听他的声音。他按着名叫自己的羊，把羊领出来。

chapters.en: When he has brought out all his own, he goes on ahead of them, and his sheep follow him because they know his voice.
chapters.zh: 既放出自己的羊来，就在前头走，羊也跟着他，因为认得他的声音。

chapters.en: But they will never follow a stranger; in fact, they will run away from him because they do not recognize a stranger’s voice.”
chapters.zh: 羊不跟着生人，因为不认得他的声音。必要逃跑。

chapters.en: Jesus used this figure of speech, but the Pharisees did not understand what he was telling them.
chapters.zh: 耶稣将这比喻告诉他们。但他们不明白所说的是什么意思。

chapters.en: Therefore Jesus said again, “Very truly I tell you, I am the gate for the sheep.
chapters.zh: 所以耶稣又对他们说，我实实在在地告诉你们，我就是羊的门，

chapters.en: All who have come before me are thieves and robbers, but the sheep have not listened to them.
chapters.zh: 凡在我以先来的，都是贼，是强盗。羊却不听他们。

chapters.en: I am the gate; whoever enters through me will be saved.They will come in and go out, and find pasture.
chapters.zh: 我就是门。凡从我进来的，必然得救，并且出入得草吃。

chapters.en: The thief comes only to steal and kill and destroy; I have come that they may have life, and have it to the full.
chapters.zh: 盗贼来，无非要偷窃，杀害，毁坏。我来了，是要叫羊（或作人）得生命，并且得的更丰盛。

chapters.en: “I am the good shepherd. The good shepherd lays down his life for the sheep.
chapters.zh: 我是好牧人，好牧人为羊舍命。

chapters.en: The hired hand is not the shepherd and does not own the sheep. So when he sees the wolf coming, he abandons the sheep and runs away. Then the wolf attacks the flock and scatters it.
chapters.zh: 若是雇工，不是牧人，羊也不是他自己的，他看见狼来，就撇下羊逃走。狼抓住羊，赶散了羊群。

chapters.en: The man runs away because he is a hired hand and cares nothing for the sheep.
chapters.zh: 雇工逃走，因他是雇工，并不顾念羊。

chapters.en: “I am the good shepherd; I know my sheep and my sheep know me—
chapters.zh: 我是好牧人。我认识我的羊，我的羊也认识我。

chapters.en: just as the Father knows me and I know the Father—and I lay down my life for the sheep.
chapters.zh: 正如父认识我，我也认识父一样。并且我为羊舍命。

chapters.en: I have other sheep that are not of this sheep pen. I must bring them also. They too will listen to my voice, and there shall be one flock and one shepherd.
chapters.zh: 我另外有羊，不是这圈里的。我必须领他们来，他们也要听我的声音。并且要合成一群，归一个牧人了。

chapters.en: The reason my Father loves me is that I lay down my life—only to take it up again.
chapters.zh: 我父爱我，因我将命舍去，好再取回来。

chapters.en: No one takes it from me, but I lay it down of my own accord. I have authority to lay it down and authority to take it up again. This command I received from my Father.”
chapters.zh: 没有人夺我的命去，是我自己舍的。我有权柄舍了，也有权柄取回来。这是我从我父所受的命令。

chapters.en: The Jews who heard these words were again divided.
chapters.zh: 犹太人为这些话，又起了纷争。

chapters.en: Many of them said, “He is demon-possessed and raving mad. Why listen to him?”
chapters.zh: 内中有好些人说，他是被鬼附着，而且疯了。为什么听他呢？

chapters.en: But others said, “These are not the sayings of a man possessed by a demon. Can a demon open the eyes of the blind?”
chapters.zh: 又有人说，这不是鬼附之人所说的话。鬼岂能叫瞎子的眼睛开了呢？

chapters.en: Then came the Festival of Dedication at Jerusalem. It was winter,
chapters.zh: 在耶路撒冷有修殿节。是冬天的时候。

chapters.en: and Jesus was in the temple courts walking in Solomon’s Colonnade.
chapters.zh: 耶稣在殿里所罗门的廊下行走。

chapters.en: The Jews who were there gathered around him, saying, “How long will you keep us in suspense? If you are the Messiah, tell us plainly.”
chapters.zh: 犹太人围着他，说，你叫我们犹疑不定到几时呢？你若是基督，就明明地告诉我们。

chapters.en: Jesus answered, “I did tell you, but you do not believe. The works I do in my Father’s name testify about me,
chapters.zh: 耶稣回答说，我已经告诉你们，你们不信。我奉我父之名所行的事，可以为我作见证。

chapters.en: but you do not believe because you are not my sheep.
chapters.zh: 只是你们不信，因为你们不是我的羊。

chapters.en: My sheep listen to my voice; I know them, and they follow me.
chapters.zh: 我的羊听我的声音，我也认识他们，他们也跟着我。

chapters.en: I give them eternal life, and they shall never perish; no one will snatch them out of my hand.
chapters.zh: 我又赐给他们永生。他们永不灭亡，谁也不能从我手里把他们夺去。

chapters.en: My Father, who has given them to me, is greater than all; no one can snatch them out of my Father’s hand.
chapters.zh: 我父把羊赐给我，他比万有都大。谁也不能从我父手里把他们夺去。

chapters.en: I and the Father are one.”
chapters.zh: 我与父原为一。

chapters.en: Again his Jewish opponents picked up stones to stone him,
chapters.zh: 犹太人又拿起石头来要打他。

chapters.en: but Jesus said to them, “I have shown you many good works from the Father. For which of these do you stone me?”
chapters.zh: 耶稣对他们说，我从父显出许多善事给你们看，你们是为哪一件拿石头打我呢？

chapters.en: “We are not stoning you for any good work,” they replied, “but for blasphemy, because you, a mere man, claim to be God.”
chapters.zh: 犹太人回答说，我们不是为善事拿石头打你，是为你说僭妄的话。又为你是个人，反将自己当作神。

chapters.en: Jesus answered them, “Is it not written in your Law, ‘I have said you are “gods” ’?
chapters.zh: 耶稣说，你们的律法上岂不是写着，我曾说你们是神吗？

chapters.en: If he called them ‘gods,’ to whom the word of God came—and Scripture cannot be set aside—
chapters.zh: 经上的话是不能废的。若那些承受神道的人，尚且称为神，

chapters.en: what about the one whom the Father set apart as his very own and sent into the world? Why then do you accuse me of blasphemy because I said, ‘I am God’s Son’?
chapters.zh: 父所分别为圣，又差到世间来的，他自称是神的儿子，你们还向他说，你说僭妄的话吗？

chapters.en: Do not believe me unless I do the works of my Father.
chapters.zh: 我若不行我父的事，你们就不必信我。

chapters.en: But if I do them, even though you do not believe me, believe the works, that you may know and understand that the Father is in me, and I in the Father.”
chapters.zh: 我若行了，你们纵然不信我，也当信这些事。叫你们又知道，又明白，父在我里面，我也在父里面。

chapters.en: Again they tried to seize him, but he escaped their grasp.
chapters.zh: 他们又要拿他。他却逃出他们的手走了。

chapters.en: Then Jesus went back across the Jordan to the place where John had been baptizing in the early days. There he stayed,
chapters.zh: 耶稣又往约但河外去，到了约翰起初施洗的地方，就住在那里。

chapters.en: and many people came to him. They said, “Though John never performed a sign, all that John said about this man was true.”
chapters.zh: 有许多人来到他那里。他们说约翰一件神迹没有行过。但约翰指着这人所说的一切话都是真的。

chapters.en: And in that place many believed in Jesus.
chapters.zh: 在那里信耶稣的人就多了。

chapters.en: Now a man named Lazarus was sick. He was from Bethany, the village of Mary and her sister Martha.
chapters.zh: 有一个患病的人，名叫拉撒路，住在伯大尼，就是马利亚和她姐姐马大的村庄。

chapters.en: (This Mary, whose brother Lazarus now lay sick, was the same one who poured perfume on the Lord and wiped his feet with her hair.)
chapters.zh: 这马利亚就是那用香膏抹主，又用头发擦他脚的。患病的拉撒路是她的兄弟。

chapters.en: So the sisters sent word to Jesus, “Lord, the one you love is sick.”
chapters.zh: 她姊妹两个就打发人去见耶稣说，主阿，你所爱的人病了。

chapters.en: When he heard this, Jesus said, “This sickness will not end in death. No, it is for God’s glory so that God’s Son may be glorified through it.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣听见就说，这病不至于死，乃是为神的荣耀，叫神的儿子因此得荣耀。

chapters.en: Now Jesus loved Martha and her sister and Lazarus.
chapters.zh: 耶稣素来爱马大，和她妹子，并拉撒路。

chapters.en: So when he heard that Lazarus was sick, he stayed where he was two more days,
chapters.zh: 听见拉撒路病了，就在所居之地，仍住了两天。

chapters.en: and then he said to his disciples, “Let us go back to Judea.”
chapters.zh: 然后对门徒说，我们再往犹太去吧。

chapters.en: “But Rabbi,” they said, “a short while ago the Jews there tried to stone you, and yet you are going back?”
chapters.zh: 门徒说，拉比，犹太人近来要拿石头打你，你还往那里去吗？

chapters.en: Jesus answered, “Are there not twelve hours of daylight? Anyone who walks in the daytime will not stumble, for they see by this world’s light.
chapters.zh: 耶稣回答说，白日不是有十二小时吗？人在白日走路，就不至跌倒，因为看见这世上的光。

chapters.en: It is when a person walks at night that they stumble, for they have no light.”
chapters.zh: 若在黑夜走路，就必跌倒，因为他没有光。

chapters.en: After he had said this, he went on to tell them, “Our friend Lazarus has fallen asleep; but I am going there to wake him up.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣说了这话，随后对他们说，我们的朋友拉撒路睡了，我去叫醒他。

chapters.en: His disciples replied, “Lord, if he sleeps, he will get better.”
chapters.zh: 门徒说，主阿，他若睡了，就必好了。

chapters.en: Jesus had been speaking of his death, but his disciples thought he meant natural sleep.
chapters.zh: 耶稣这话是指着他死说的。他们却以为是说照常睡了。

chapters.en: So then he told them plainly, “Lazarus is dead,
chapters.zh: 耶稣就明明地告诉他们说，拉撒路死了。

chapters.en: and for your sake I am glad I was not there, so that you may believe. But let us go to him.”
chapters.zh: 我没有在那里就欢喜，这是为你们的缘故，好叫你们相信。如今我们可以往他那里去吧。

chapters.en: Then Thomas (also known as Didymus ) said to the rest of the disciples, “Let us also go, that we may die with him.”
chapters.zh: 多马，又称为低土马，就对那同作门徒的说，我们也去和他同死吧。

chapters.en: On his arrival, Jesus found that Lazarus had already been in the tomb for four days.
chapters.zh: 耶稣到了，就知道拉撒路在坟墓里，已经四天了。

chapters.en: Now Bethany was less than two miles from Jerusalem,
chapters.zh: 伯大尼离耶路撒冷不远，约有六里路。

chapters.en: and many Jews had come to Martha and Mary to comfort them in the loss of their brother.
chapters.zh: 有好些犹太人来看马大和马利亚，要为她们的兄弟安慰她们。

chapters.en: When Martha heard that Jesus was coming, she went out to meet him, but Mary stayed at home.
chapters.zh: 马大听见耶稣来了，就出去迎接他。马利亚却仍然坐在家里。

chapters.en: “Lord,” Martha said to Jesus, “if you had been here, my brother would not have died.
chapters.zh: 马大对耶稣说，主阿，你若早在这里，我兄弟必不死。

chapters.en: But I know that even now God will give you whatever you ask.”
chapters.zh: 就是现在，我也知道，你无论向神求什么，神也必赐给你。

chapters.en: Jesus said to her, “Your brother will rise again.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣说，你兄弟必然复活。

chapters.en: Martha answered, “I know he will rise again in the resurrection at the last day.”
chapters.zh: 马大说，我知道在末日复活的时候，他必复活。

chapters.en: Jesus said to her, “I am the resurrection and the life. The one who believes in me will live, even though they die;
chapters.zh: 耶稣对他说，复活在我，生命也在我。信我的人，虽然死了，也必复活。

chapters.en: and whoever lives by believing in me will never die. Do you believe this?”
chapters.zh: 凡活着信我的人，必永远不死。你信这话吗？

chapters.en: “Yes, Lord,” she replied, “I believe that you are the Messiah, the Son of God, who is to come into the world.”
chapters.zh: 马大说，主阿，是的，我信你是基督，是神的儿子，就是那要临到世界的。

chapters.en: After she had said this, she went back and called her sister Mary aside. “The Teacher is here,” she said, “and is asking for you.”
chapters.zh: 马大说了这话，就回去暗暗地叫她妹子，马利亚说，夫子来了，叫你。

chapters.en: When Mary heard this, she got up quickly and went to him.
chapters.zh: 马利亚听见了就急忙起来，到耶稣那里去。

chapters.en: Now Jesus had not yet entered the village, but was still at the place where Martha had met him.
chapters.zh: 那时，耶稣还没有进村子，仍在马大迎接他的地方。

chapters.en: When the Jews who had been with Mary in the house, comforting her, noticed how quickly she got up and went out, they followed her, supposing she was going to the tomb to mourn there.
chapters.zh: 那些同马利亚在家里安慰她的犹太人，见她急忙起来出去，就跟着她，以为她要往坟墓那里去哭。

chapters.en: When Mary reached the place where Jesus was and saw him, she fell at his feet and said, “Lord, if you had been here, my brother would not have died.”
chapters.zh: 马利亚到了耶稣那里，看见他，就俯伏在他脚前，说，主阿，你若早在这里，我兄弟必不死。

chapters.en: When Jesus saw her weeping, and the Jews who had come along with her also weeping, he was deeply moved in spirit and troubled.
chapters.zh: 耶稣看见她哭，并看见与她同来的犹太人也哭，就心里悲叹，又甚忧愁。

chapters.en: “Where have you laid him?” he asked. “Come and see, Lord,” they replied.
chapters.zh: 便说，你们把他安放在哪里？他们回答说，请主来看。

chapters.en: Jesus wept.
chapters.zh: 耶稣哭了。

chapters.en: Then the Jews said, “See how he loved him!”
chapters.zh: 犹太人就说，你看他爱这人是何等恳切。

chapters.en: But some of them said, “Could not he who opened the eyes of the blind man have kept this man from dying?”
chapters.zh: 其中有人说，他既然开了瞎子的眼睛，岂不能叫这人不死吗？

chapters.en: Jesus, once more deeply moved, came to the tomb. It was a cave with a stone laid across the entrance.
chapters.zh: 耶稣又心里悲叹，来到坟墓前。那坟墓是个洞，有一块石头挡着。

chapters.en: “Take away the stone,” he said. “But, Lord,” said Martha, the sister of the dead man, “by this time there is a bad odor, for he has been there four days.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣说，你们把石头挪开。那死人的姐姐马大对他说，主阿，他现在必是臭了，因为他死了已经四天了。

chapters.en: Then Jesus said, “Did I not tell you that if you believe, you will see the glory of God?”
chapters.zh: 耶稣说，我不是对你说过，你若信，就必看见神的荣耀吗？

chapters.en: So they took away the stone. Then Jesus looked up and said, “Father, I thank you that you have heard me.
chapters.zh: 他们就把石头挪开。耶稣举目望天说，父阿，我感谢你，因为你已经听我。

chapters.en: I knew that you always hear me, but I said this for the benefit of the people standing here, that they may believe that you sent me.”
chapters.zh: 我也知道你常听我，但我说这话，是为周围站着的众人，叫他们信是你差了我来。

chapters.en: When he had said this, Jesus called in a loud voice, “Lazarus, come out!”
chapters.zh: 说了这话，就大声呼叫说，拉撒路出来。

chapters.en: The dead man came out, his hands and feet wrapped with strips of linen, and a cloth around his face. Jesus said to them, “Take off the grave clothes and let him go.”
chapters.zh: 那死人就出来了，手脚裹着布，脸上包着手巾。耶稣对他们说，解开，叫他走。

chapters.en: Therefore many of the Jews who had come to visit Mary, and had seen what Jesus did, believed in him.
chapters.zh: 那些来看马利亚的犹太人，见了耶稣所作的事，就多有信他的。

chapters.en: But some of them went to the Pharisees and told them what Jesus had done.
chapters.zh: 但其中也有去见法利赛人的，将耶稣所作的事告诉他们。

chapters.en: Then the chief priests and the Pharisees called a meeting of the Sanhedrin. “What are we accomplishing?” they asked. “Here is this man performing many signs.
chapters.zh: 祭司长和法利赛人聚集公会，说，这人行好些神迹，我们怎么办呢？

chapters.en: If we let him go on like this, everyone will believe in him, and then the Romans will come and take away both our temple and our nation.”
chapters.zh: 若这样由着他，人人都要信他。罗马人也要来夺我们的地土，和我们的百姓。

chapters.en: Then one of them, named Caiaphas, who was high priest that year, spoke up, “You know nothing at all!
chapters.zh: 内中有一个人，名叫该亚法，本年作大祭司，对他们说，你们不知道什么。

chapters.en: You do not realize that it is better for you that one man die for the people than that the whole nation perish.”
chapters.zh: 独不想一个人替百姓死，免得通国灭亡，就是你们的益处。

chapters.en: He did not say this on his own, but as high priest that year he prophesied that Jesus would die for the Jewish nation,
chapters.zh: 他这话不是出于自己，是因他本年作大祭司，所以预言耶稣将要替这一国死。

chapters.en: and not only for that nation but also for the scattered children of God, to bring them together and make them one.
chapters.zh: 也不但替这一国死，并要将神四散的子民，都聚集归一。

chapters.en: So from that day on they plotted to take his life.
chapters.zh: 从那日起，他们就商议要杀耶稣。

chapters.en: Therefore Jesus no longer moved about publicly among the people of Judea. Instead he withdrew to a region near the wilderness, to a village called Ephraim, where he stayed with his disciples.
chapters.zh: 所以耶稣不再显然行在犹太人中间，就离开那里往靠近旷野的地方去。到了一座城，名叫以法莲，就在那里和门徒同住。

chapters.en: When it was almost time for the Jewish Passover, many went up from the country to Jerusalem for their ceremonial cleansing before the Passover.
chapters.zh: 犹太人的逾越节近了。有许多人从乡下上耶路撒冷去，要在节前洁净自己。

chapters.en: They kept looking for Jesus, and as they stood in the temple courts they asked one another, “What do you think? Isn’t he coming to the festival at all?”
chapters.zh: 他们就寻找耶稣，站在殿里彼此说，你们的意思如何，他不来过节吗？

chapters.en: But the chief priests and the Pharisees had given orders that anyone who found out where Jesus was should report it so that they might arrest him.
chapters.zh: 那时，祭司长和法利赛人早已吩咐说，若有人知道耶稣在哪里，就要报明，好去拿他。

chapters.en: Six days before the Passover, Jesus came to Bethany, where Lazarus lived, whom Jesus had raised from the dead.
chapters.zh: 逾越节前六日，耶稣来到伯大尼，就是他叫拉撒路从死里复活之处。

chapters.en: Here a dinner was given in Jesus’ honor. Martha served, while Lazarus was among those reclining at the table with him.
chapters.zh: 有人在那里给耶稣预备筵席。马大伺候，拉撒路也在那同耶稣坐席的人中。

chapters.en: Then Mary took about a pint of pure nard, an expensive perfume; she poured it on Jesus’ feet and wiped his feet with her hair. And the house was filled with the fragrance of the perfume.
chapters.zh: 马利亚就拿着一斤极贵的真哪哒香膏，抹耶稣的脚，又用自己头发去擦。屋里就满了膏的香气。

chapters.en: But one of his disciples, Judas Iscariot, who was later to betray him, objected,
chapters.zh: 有一个门徒，就是那将要卖耶稣的加略人犹大，

chapters.en: “Why wasn’t this perfume sold and the money given to the poor? It was worth a year’s wages. ”
chapters.zh: 说，这香膏为什么不卖三十两银子周济穷人呢？

chapters.en: He did not say this because he cared about the poor but because he was a thief; as keeper of the money bag, he used to help himself to what was put into it.
chapters.zh: 他说这话，并不是挂念穷人，乃因他是个贼，又带着钱囊，常取其中所存的。

chapters.en: “Leave her alone,” Jesus replied. “It was intended that she should save this perfume for the day of my burial.
chapters.zh: 耶稣说，由她吧，她是为我安葬之日存留的。

chapters.en: You will always have the poor among you,but you will not always have me.”
chapters.zh: 因为常有穷人和你们同在。只是你们不常有我。

chapters.en: Meanwhile a large crowd of Jews found out that Jesus was there and came, not only because of him but also to see Lazarus, whom he had raised from the dead.
chapters.zh: 有许多犹太人知道耶稣在那里，就来了，不但是为耶稣的缘故，也是要看他从死里所复活的拉撒路。

chapters.en: So the chief priests made plans to kill Lazarus as well,
chapters.zh: 但祭司长商议连拉撒路也要杀了。

chapters.en: for on account of him many of the Jews were going over to Jesus and believing in him.
chapters.zh: 因有好些犹太人，为拉撒路的缘故，回去信了耶稣。

chapters.en: The next day the great crowd that had come for the festival heard that Jesus was on his way to Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 第二天，有许多上来过节的人，听见耶稣将到耶路撒冷，

chapters.en: They took palm branches and went out to meet him, shouting, “Hosanna! ” “Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord!”“Blessed is the king of Israel!”
chapters.zh: 就拿着棕树枝，出去迎接他，喊着说，和散那，奉主名来的以色列王，是应当称颂的。

chapters.en: Jesus found a young donkey and sat on it, as it is written:
chapters.zh: 耶稣得了一个驴驹，就骑上。如经上所记的说，

chapters.en: “Do not be afraid, Daughter Zion; see, your king is coming, seated on a donkey’s colt.”
chapters.zh: 锡安的民哪，（民原文作女子）不要惧怕，你的王骑着驴驹来了。

chapters.en: At first his disciples did not understand all this. Only after Jesus was glorified did they realize that these things had been written about him and that these things had been done to him.
chapters.zh: 这些事门徒起先不明白。等到耶稣得了荣耀以后，才想起这话是指着他写的，并且众人果然向他这样行了。

chapters.en: Now the crowd that was with him when he called Lazarus from the tomb and raised him from the dead continued to spread the word.
chapters.zh: 当耶稣呼唤拉撒路叫他从死复活出坟墓的时候，同耶稣在那里的众人，就作见证。

chapters.en: Many people, because they had heard that he had performed this sign, went out to meet him.
chapters.zh: 众人因听见耶稣行了这神迹，就去迎接他。

chapters.en: So the Pharisees said to one another, “See, this is getting us nowhere. Look how the whole world has gone after him!”
chapters.zh: 法利赛人彼此说，看哪，你们是徒劳无益，世人都随从他去了。

chapters.en: Now there were some Greeks among those who went up to worship at the festival.
chapters.zh: 那时，上来过节礼拜的人中，有几个希利尼人。

chapters.en: They came to Philip, who was from Bethsaida in Galilee, with a request. “Sir,” they said, “we would like to see Jesus.”
chapters.zh: 他们来见加利利伯赛大的腓力，求他说，先生，我们愿意见耶稣。

chapters.en: Philip went to tell Andrew; Andrew and Philip in turn told Jesus.
chapters.zh: 腓力去告诉安得烈，安得烈同腓力去告诉耶稣。

chapters.en: Jesus replied, “The hour has come for the Son of Man to be glorified.
chapters.zh: 耶稣说，人子得荣耀的时候到了。

chapters.en: Very truly I tell you, unless a kernel of wheat falls to the ground and dies, it remains only a single seed. But if it dies, it produces many seeds.
chapters.zh: 我实实在在地告诉你们，一粒麦子不落在地里死了，仍旧是一粒。若是死了，就结出许多子粒来。

chapters.en: Anyone who loves their life will lose it, while anyone who hates their life in this world will keep it for eternal life.
chapters.zh: 爱惜自己生命的，就失丧生命。在这世上恨恶自己生命的，就要保守生命到永生。

chapters.en: Whoever serves me must follow me; and where I am, my servant also will be. My Father will honor the one who serves me.
chapters.zh: 若有人服事我，就当跟从我。我在哪里，服事我的人，也要在哪里。若有人服事我，我父必尊重他。

chapters.en: “Now my soul is troubled, and what shall I say? ‘Father, save me from this hour’? No, it was for this very reason I came to this hour.
chapters.zh: 我现在心里忧愁，我说什么才好呢？父阿，救我脱离这时候。但我原是为这时候来的。

chapters.en: Father, glorify your name!”Then a voice came from heaven, “I have glorified it, and will glorify it again.”
chapters.zh: 父阿，愿你荣耀你的名。当时就有声音从天上来说，我已经荣耀了我的名，还要再荣耀。

chapters.en: The crowd that was there and heard it said it had thundered; others said an angel had spoken to him.
chapters.zh: 站在旁边的众人听见，就说，打雷了。还有人说，有天使对他说话。

chapters.en: Jesus said, “This voice was for your benefit, not mine.
chapters.zh: 耶稣说，这声音不是为我，是为你们来的。

chapters.en: Now is the time for judgment on this world; now the prince of this world will be driven out.
chapters.zh: 现在这世界受审判。这世界的王要被赶出去。

chapters.en: And I, when I am lifted up from the earth, will draw all people to myself.”
chapters.zh: 我若从地上被举起来，就要吸引万人来归我。

chapters.en: He said this to show the kind of death he was going to die.
chapters.zh: 耶稣这话原是指着自己将要怎样死说的。

chapters.en: The crowd spoke up, “We have heard from the Law that the Messiah will remain forever, so how can you say, ‘The Son of Man must be lifted up’? Who is this ‘Son of Man’?”
chapters.zh: 众人回答说，我们听见律法上有话说，基督是永存的。你怎么说，人子必须被举起来呢？这人子是谁呢？

chapters.en: Then Jesus told them, “You are going to have the light just a little while longer. Walk while you have the light, before darkness overtakes you. Whoever walks in the dark does not know where they are going.
chapters.zh: 耶稣对他们说，光在你们中间，还有不多的时候，应当趁着有光行走，免得黑暗临到你们。那在黑暗里行走的，不知道往何处去。

chapters.en: Believe in the light while you have the light, so that you may become children of light.” When he had finished speaking, Jesus left and hid himself from them.
chapters.zh: 你们应当趁着有光，信从这光，使你们成为光明之子。耶稣说了这话，就离开他们，隐藏了。

chapters.en: Even after Jesus had performed so many signs in their presence, they still would not believe in him.
chapters.zh: 他虽然在他们面前行了许多神迹，他们还是不信他。

chapters.en: This was to fulfill the word of Isaiah the prophet: “Lord, who has believed our message and to whom has the arm of the Lord been revealed?”
chapters.zh: 这是要应验先知以赛亚的话说，主阿，我们所传的，有谁信呢？主的膀臂向谁显露呢？

chapters.en: For this reason they could not believe, because, as Isaiah says elsewhere:
chapters.zh: 他们所以不能信，因为以赛亚又说，

chapters.en: “He has blinded their eyes and hardened their hearts, so they can neither see with their eyes, nor understand with their hearts, nor turn—and I would heal them.”
chapters.zh: 主叫他们瞎了眼，硬了心，免得他们眼睛看见，心里明白，回转过来，我就医治他们。

chapters.en: Isaiah said this because he saw Jesus’ glory and spoke about him.
chapters.zh: 以赛亚因为看见他的荣耀，就指着他说这话。

chapters.en: Yet at the same time many even among the leaders believed in him. But because of the Pharisees they would not openly acknowledge their faith for fear they would be put out of the synagogue;
chapters.zh: 虽然如此，官长中却有好些信他的。只因法利赛人的缘故，就不承认，恐怕被赶出会堂。

chapters.en: for they loved human praise more than praise from God.
chapters.zh: 这是因他们爱人的荣耀，过于爱神的荣耀。

chapters.en: Then Jesus cried out, “Whoever believes in me does not believe in me only, but in the one who sent me.
chapters.zh: 耶稣大声说，信我的，不是信我，乃是信那差我来的。

chapters.en: The one who looks at me is seeing the one who sent me.
chapters.zh: 人看见我，就是看见那差我来的。

chapters.en: I have come into the world as a light, so that no one who believes in me should stay in darkness.
chapters.zh: 我到世上来，乃是光，叫凡信我的，不住在黑暗里。

chapters.en: “If anyone hears my words but does not keep them, I do not judge that person. For I did not come to judge the world, but to save the world.
chapters.zh: 若有人听见我的话不遵守，我不审判他。我来本不是要审判世界，乃是要拯救世界。

chapters.en: There is a judge for the one who rejects me and does not accept my words; the very words I have spoken will condemn them at the last day.
chapters.zh: 弃绝我不领受我话的人，有审判他的。就是我所讲的道，在末日要审判他。

chapters.en: For I did not speak on my own, but the Father who sent me commanded me to say all that I have spoken.
chapters.zh: 因为我没有凭着自己讲。惟有差我来的父，已经给我命令，叫我说什么，讲什么。

chapters.en: I know that his command leads to eternal life. So whatever I say is just what the Father has told me to say.”
chapters.zh: 我也知道他的命令就是永生。故此我所讲的话，正是照着父对我所说的。

chapters.en: It was just before the Passover Festival. Jesus knew that the hour had come for him to leave this world and go to the Father. Having loved his own who were in the world, he loved them to the end.
chapters.zh: 逾越节以前，耶稣知道自己离世归父的时候到了。他既然爱世间属自己的人，就爱他们到底。

chapters.en: The evening meal was in progress, and the devil had already prompted Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot, to betray Jesus.
chapters.zh: 吃晚饭的时候，（魔鬼已将卖耶稣的意思，放在西门的儿子加略人犹大心里）。

chapters.en: Jesus knew that the Father had put all things under his power, and that he had come from God and was returning to God;
chapters.zh: 耶稣知道父已将万有交在他手里，且知道自己是从神出来的，又要归到神那里去，

chapters.en: so he got up from the meal, took off his outer clothing, and wrapped a towel around his waist.
chapters.zh: 就离席站起来脱了衣服，拿一条手巾束腰。

chapters.en: After that, he poured water into a basin and began to wash his disciples’ feet, drying them with the towel that was wrapped around him.
chapters.zh: 随后把水倒在盆里，就洗门徒的脚，并用自己所束的手巾擦干。

chapters.en: He came to Simon Peter, who said to him, “Lord, are you going to wash my feet?”
chapters.zh: 挨到西门彼得，彼得对他说，主阿，你洗我的脚吗？

chapters.en: Jesus replied, “You do not realize now what I am doing, but later you will understand.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣回答说，我所作的，你如今不知道，后来必明白。

chapters.en: “No,” said Peter, “you shall never wash my feet.” Jesus answered, “Unless I wash you, you have no part with me.”
chapters.zh: 彼得说，你永不可洗我的脚。耶稣说，我若不洗你，你就与我无分了。

chapters.en: “Then, Lord,” Simon Peter replied, “not just my feet but my hands and my head as well!”
chapters.zh: 西门彼得说，主阿，不但我的脚，连手和头也要洗。

chapters.en: Jesus answered, “Those who have had a bath need only to wash their feet; their whole body is clean. And you are clean, though not every one of you.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣说，凡洗过澡的人，只要把脚一洗，全身就干净了。你们是干净的，然而不都是干净的。

chapters.en: For he knew who was going to betray him, and that was why he said not every one was clean.
chapters.zh: 耶稣原知道要卖他的是谁，所以说，你们不都是干净的。

chapters.en: When he had finished washing their feet, he put on his clothes and returned to his place. “Do you understand what I have done for you?” he asked them.
chapters.zh: 耶稣洗完了他们的脚，就穿上衣服，又坐下，对他们说，我向你们所作的，你们明白吗？

chapters.en: “You call me ‘Teacher’ and ‘Lord,’ and rightly so, for that is what I am.
chapters.zh: 你们称呼我夫子，称呼我主，你们说的不错。我本来是。

chapters.en: Now that I, your Lord and Teacher, have washed your feet, you also should wash one another’s feet.
chapters.zh: 我是你们的主，你们的夫子，尚且洗你们的脚，你们也当彼此洗脚。

chapters.en: I have set you an example that you should do as I have done for you.
chapters.zh: 我给你们作了榜样，叫你们照着我向你们所作的去作。

chapters.en: Very truly I tell you, no servant is greater than his master, nor is a messenger greater than the one who sent him.
chapters.zh: 我实实在在地告诉你们，仆人不能大于主人。差人也不能大于差他的人。

chapters.en: Now that you know these things, you will be blessed if you do them.
chapters.zh: 你们既知道这事，若是去行就有福了。

chapters.en: “I am not referring to all of you; I know those I have chosen. But this is to fulfill this passage of Scripture: ‘He who shared my bread has turned against me.’
chapters.zh: 我这话不是指着你们众人说的。我知道我所拣选的是谁。现在要应验经上的话，说，同我吃饭的人，用脚踢我。

chapters.en: “I am telling you now before it happens, so that when it does happen you will believe that I am who I am.
chapters.zh: 如今事情还没有成就，我要先告诉你们，叫你们到事情成就的时候，可以信我是基督

chapters.en: Very truly I tell you, whoever accepts anyone I send accepts me; and whoever accepts me accepts the one who sent me.”
chapters.zh: 我实实在在地告诉你们，有人接待我所差遣的，就是接待我。接待我，就是接待那差遣我的。

chapters.en: After he had said this, Jesus was troubled in spirit and testified, “Very truly I tell you, one of you is going to betray me.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣说了这话，心里忧愁，就明说，我实实在在地告诉你们，你们中间有一个人要卖我了。

chapters.en: His disciples stared at one another, at a loss to know which of them he meant.
chapters.zh: 门徒彼此对看，猜不透所说的是谁。

chapters.en: One of them, the disciple whom Jesus loved, was reclining next to him.
chapters.zh: 有一个门徒，是耶稣所爱的，侧身挨近耶稣的怀里。

chapters.en: Simon Peter motioned to this disciple and said, “Ask him which one he means.”
chapters.zh: 西门彼得点头对他说，你告诉我们，主是指着谁说的。

chapters.en: Leaning back against Jesus, he asked him, “Lord, who is it?”
chapters.zh: 那门徒便就势靠着耶稣的胸膛，问他说，主阿，是谁呢？

chapters.en: Jesus answered, “It is the one to whom I will give this piece of bread when I have dipped it in the dish.” Then, dipping the piece of bread, he gave it to Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot.
chapters.zh: 耶稣回答说，我蘸一点饼给谁，就是谁。耶稣就蘸了一点饼，递给加略人西门的儿子犹大。

chapters.en: As soon as Judas took the bread, Satan entered into him. So Jesus told him, “What you are about to do, do quickly.”
chapters.zh: 他吃了以后，撒但就入了他的心。耶稣便对他说，你所作的快作吧。

chapters.en: But no one at the meal understood why Jesus said this to him.
chapters.zh: 同席的人，没有一个知道是为什么对他说这话。

chapters.en: Since Judas had charge of the money, some thought Jesus was telling him to buy what was needed for the festival, or to give something to the poor.
chapters.zh: 有人因犹大带着钱囊，以为耶稣是对他说，你去买我们过节所应用的东西。或是叫他拿什么周济穷人。

chapters.en: As soon as Judas had taken the bread, he went out. And it was night.
chapters.zh: 犹大受了那点饼，立刻就出去。那时候是夜间了。

chapters.en: When he was gone, Jesus said, “Now the Son of Man is glorified and God is glorified in him.
chapters.zh: 他既出去，耶稣就说，如今人子得了荣耀，神在人子身上也得了荣耀。

chapters.en: If God is glorified in him,God will glorify the Son in himself, and will glorify him at once.
chapters.zh: 神要因自己荣耀人子，并且要快快地荣耀他。

chapters.en: “My children, I will be with you only a little longer. You will look for me, and just as I told the Jews, so I tell you now: Where I am going, you cannot come.
chapters.zh: 小子们，我还有不多的时候，与你们同在。后来你们要找我，但我所去的地方，你们不能到。这话我曾对犹太人说过，如今也照样对你们说。

chapters.en: “A new command I give you: Love one another. As I have loved you, so you must love one another.
chapters.zh: 我赐给你们一条新命令，乃是叫你们彼此相爱。我怎样爱你们，你们也要怎样相爱。

chapters.en: By this everyone will know that you are my disciples, if you love one another.”
chapters.zh: 你们若有彼此相爱的心，众人因此就认出你们是我的门徒了。

chapters.en: Simon Peter asked him, “Lord, where are you going?” Jesus replied, “Where I am going, you cannot follow now, but you will follow later.”
chapters.zh: 西门彼得问耶稣说，主往哪里去。耶稣回答说，我所去的地方，你现在不能跟我去。后来却要跟我去。

chapters.en: Peter asked, “Lord, why can’t I follow you now? I will lay down my life for you.”
chapters.zh: 彼得说，主阿，我为什么现在不能跟你去？我愿意为你舍命。

chapters.en: Then Jesus answered, “Will you really lay down your life for me? Very truly I tell you, before the rooster crows, you will disown me three times!
chapters.zh: 耶稣说，你愿意为我舍命吗？我实实在在地告诉你，鸡叫以先，你要三次不认我。

chapters.en: “Do not let your hearts be troubled. You believe in God; believe also in me.
chapters.zh: 你们心里不要忧愁。你们信神，也当信我。

chapters.en: My Father’s house has many rooms; if that were not so, would I have told you that I am going there to prepare a place for you?
chapters.zh: 在我父的家里，有许多住处。若是没有，我就早已告诉你们了。我去原是为你们预备地方去。

chapters.en: And if I go and prepare a place for you, I will come back and take you to be with me that you also may be where I am.
chapters.zh: 我若去为你们预备了地方，就必再来接你们到我那里去，我在哪里，叫你们也在哪里。

chapters.en: You know the way to the place where I am going.”
chapters.zh: 我往哪里去，你们知道。那条路，你们也知道。（有古卷作我往哪里去你们知道那条路）

chapters.en: Thomas said to him, “Lord, we don’t know where you are going, so how can we know the way?”
chapters.zh: 多马对他说，主阿，我们不知道你往哪里去，怎么知道那条路呢？

chapters.en: Jesus answered, “I am the way and the truth and the life. No one comes to the Father except through me.
chapters.zh: 耶稣说，我就是道路，真理，生命。若不借着我，没有人能到父那里去。

chapters.en: If you really know me, you will know my Father as well. From now on, you do know him and have seen him.”
chapters.zh: 你们若认识我，也就认识我的父。从今以后，你们认识他，并且已经看见他。

chapters.en: Philip said, “Lord, show us the Father and that will be enough for us.”
chapters.zh: 腓力对他说，求主将父显给我们看，我们就知足了。

chapters.en: Jesus answered: “Don’t you know me, Philip, even after I have been among you such a long time? Anyone who has seen me has seen the Father. How can you say, ‘Show us the Father’?
chapters.zh: 耶稣对他说，腓力，我与你们同在这样长久，你还不认识我吗？人看见了我，就是看见了父。你怎么说，将父显给我们看呢？

chapters.en: Don’t you believe that I am in the Father, and that the Father is in me? The words I say to you I do not speak on my own authority. Rather, it is the Father, living in me, who is doing his work.
chapters.zh: 我在父里面，父在我里面，你不信吗？我对你们所说的话，不是凭着自己说的，乃是住在我里面的父作他自己的事。

chapters.en: Believe me when I say that I am in the Father and the Father is in me; or at least believe on the evidence of the works themselves.
chapters.zh: 你们当信我，我在父里面，父在我里面。即或不信，也当因我所作的事信我。

chapters.en: Very truly I tell you, whoever believes in me will do the works I have been doing, and they will do even greater things than these, because I am going to the Father.
chapters.zh: 我实实在在地告诉你们，我所作的事，信我的人也要作。并且要作比这更大的事。因为我往父那里去。

chapters.en: And I will do whatever you ask in my name, so that the Father may be glorified in the Son.
chapters.zh: 你们奉我的名，无论求什么，我必成就，叫父因儿子得荣耀。

chapters.en: You may ask me for anything in my name, and I will do it.
chapters.zh: 你们若奉我的名求什么，我必成就。

chapters.en: “If you love me, keep my commands.
chapters.zh: 你们若爱我，就必遵守我的命令。

chapters.en: And I will ask the Father, and he will give you another advocate to help you and be with you forever—
chapters.zh: 我要求父，父就另外赐给你们一位保惠师，（或作训慰师下同）叫他永远与你们同在。

chapters.en: the Spirit of truth. The world cannot accept him, because it neither sees him nor knows him. But you know him, for he lives with you and will be in you.
chapters.zh: 就是真理的圣灵，乃世人不能接受的。因为不见他，也不认识他。你们却认识他。因他常与你们同在，也要在你们里面。

chapters.en: I will not leave you as orphans; I will come to you.
chapters.zh: 我不撇下你们为孤儿，我必到你们这里来。

chapters.en: Before long, the world will not see me anymore, but you will see me. Because I live, you also will live.
chapters.zh: 还有不多的时候，世人不再看见我。你们却看见我。因为我活着，你们也要活着。

chapters.en: On that day you will realize that I am in my Father, and you are in me, and I am in you.
chapters.zh: 到那日，你们就知道我在父里面，你们在我里面，我也在你们里面。

chapters.en: Whoever has my commands and keeps them is the one who loves me. The one who loves me will be loved by my Father, and I too will love them and show myself to them.”
chapters.zh: 有了我的命令又遵守的，这人就是爱我的。爱我的必蒙我父爱他，我也要爱他，并且要向他显现。

chapters.en: Then Judas (not Judas Iscariot) said, “But, Lord, why do you intend to show yourself to us and not to the world?”
chapters.zh: 犹大（不是加略人犹大）问耶稣说，主阿，为什么要向我们显现，不向世人显现呢？

chapters.en: Jesus replied, “Anyone who loves me will obey my teaching. My Father will love them, and we will come to them and make our home with them.
chapters.zh: 耶稣回答说，人若爱我，就必遵守我的道。我父也必爱他，并且我们要到他那里去，与他同住。

chapters.en: Anyone who does not love me will not obey my teaching. These words you hear are not my own; they belong to the Father who sent me.
chapters.zh: 不爱我的人就不遵守我的道。你们所听见的道不是我的，乃是差我来之父的道。

chapters.en: “All this I have spoken while still with you.
chapters.zh: 我还与你们同住的时候，已将这些话对你们说了。

chapters.en: But the Advocate, the Holy Spirit, whom the Father will send in my name, will teach you all things and will remind you of everything I have said to you.
chapters.zh: 但保惠师，就是父因我的名所要差来的圣灵，他要将一切的事，指教你们，并且要叫你们想起我对你们所说的一切话。

chapters.en: Peace I leave with you; my peace I give you. I do not give to you as the world gives. Do not let your hearts be troubled and do not be afraid.
chapters.zh: 我留下平安给你们，我将我的平安赐给你们。我所赐的，不像世人所赐的。你们心里不要忧愁，也不要胆怯。

chapters.en: “You heard me say, ‘I am going away and I am coming back to you.’ If you loved me, you would be glad that I am going to the Father, for the Father is greater than I.
chapters.zh: 你们听见我对你们说了，我去还要到你们这里来。你们若爱我，因我到父那里去，就必喜乐，因为父是比我大的。

chapters.en: I have told you now before it happens, so that when it does happen you will believe.
chapters.zh: 现在事情还没有成就，我预先告诉你们，叫你们到事情成就的时候，就可以信。

chapters.en: I will not say much more to you, for the prince of this world is coming. He has no hold over me,
chapters.zh: 以后我不再和你们多说话，因为这世界的王将到。他在我里面是毫无所有。

chapters.en: but he comes so that the world may learn that I love the Father and do exactly what my Father has commanded me.“Come now; let us leave.
chapters.zh: 但要叫世人知道我爱父，并且父怎样吩咐我，我就怎样行。起来我们走吧。

chapters.en: “I am the true vine, and my Father is the gardener.
chapters.zh: 我是真葡萄树，我父是栽培的人。

chapters.en: He cuts off every branch in me that bears no fruit, while every branch that does bear fruit he prunesso that it will be even more fruitful.
chapters.zh: 凡属我不结果子的枝子，他就剪去。凡结果子的，他就修理干净，使枝子结果子更多。

chapters.en: You are already clean because of the word I have spoken to you.
chapters.zh: 现在你们因我讲给你们的道，已经干净了。

chapters.en: Remain in me, as I also remain in you. No branch can bear fruit by itself; it must remain in the vine. Neither can you bear fruit unless you remain in me.
chapters.zh: 你们要常在我里面，我也常在你们里面。枝子若不常在葡萄树上，自己就不能结果子。你们若不常在我里面，也是这样。

chapters.en: “I am the vine; you are the branches. If you remain in me and I in you, you will bear much fruit; apart from me you can do nothing.
chapters.zh: 我是葡萄树，你们是枝子。常在我里面的，我也常在他里面，这人就多结果子。因为离了我，你们就不能作什么。

chapters.en: If you do not remain in me, you are like a branch that is thrown away and withers; such branches are picked up, thrown into the fire and burned.
chapters.zh: 人若不常在我里面，就像枝子丢在外面枯干，人拾起来，扔在火里烧了。

chapters.en: If you remain in me and my words remain in you, ask whatever you wish, and it will be done for you.
chapters.zh: 你们若常在我里面，我的话也常在你们里面，凡你们所愿意的，祈求就给你们成就。

chapters.en: This is to my Father’s glory, that you bear much fruit, showing yourselves to be my disciples.
chapters.zh: 你们多结果子，我父就因此得荣耀，你们也就是我的门徒了。

chapters.en: “As the Father has loved me, so have I loved you. Now remain in my love.
chapters.zh: 我爱你们，正如父爱我一样。你们要常在我的爱里。

chapters.en: If you keep my commands, you will remain in my love, just as I have kept my Father’s commands and remain in his love.
chapters.zh: 你们若遵守我的命令，就常在我的爱里。正如我遵守了我父的命令，常在他的爱里。

chapters.en: I have told you this so that my joy may be in you and that your joy may be complete.
chapters.zh: 这些事我已经对你们说了，是要叫我的喜乐，存在你们心里，并叫你们的喜乐可以满足。

chapters.en: My command is this: Love each other as I have loved you.
chapters.zh: 你们要彼此相爱，像我爱你们一样，这就是我的命令。

chapters.en: Greater love has no one than this: to lay down one’s life for one’s friends.
chapters.zh: 人为朋友舍命，人的爱心没有比这个大的。

chapters.en: You are my friends if you do what I command.
chapters.zh: 你们若遵行我所吩咐的，就是我的朋友了。

chapters.en: I no longer call you servants, because a servant does not know his master’s business. Instead, I have called you friends, for everything that I learned from my Father I have made known to you.
chapters.zh: 以后我不再称你们为仆人。因仆人不知道主人所作的事。我乃称你们为朋友。因我从我父所听见的。已经都告诉你们了。

chapters.en: You did not choose me, but I chose you and appointed you so that you might go and bear fruit—fruit that will last—and so that whatever you ask in my name the Father will give you.
chapters.zh: 不是你们拣选了我，是我拣选了你们，并且分派你们去结果子，叫你们的果子常存。使你们奉我的名，无论向父求什么，他就赐给你们。

chapters.en: This is my command: Love each other.
chapters.zh: 我这样吩咐你们，是要叫你们彼此相爱。

chapters.en: “If the world hates you, keep in mind that it hated me first.
chapters.zh: 世人若恨你们，你们知道（或作该知道）恨你们以先，已经恨我了。

chapters.en: If you belonged to the world, it would love you as its own. As it is, you do not belong to the world, but I have chosen you out of the world. That is why the world hates you.
chapters.zh: 你们若属世界，世界必爱属自己的。只因你们不属世界。乃是我从世界中拣选了你们，所以世界就恨你们。

chapters.en: Remember what I told you: ‘A servant is not greater than his master.’If they persecuted me, they will persecute you also. If they obeyed my teaching, they will obey yours also.
chapters.zh: 你们要记念我从前对你们所说的话，仆人不能大于主人。他们若逼迫了我，也要逼迫你们。若遵守了我的话，也要遵守你们的话。

chapters.en: They will treat you this way because of my name, for they do not know the one who sent me.
chapters.zh: 但他们因我的名，要向你们行这一切的事，因为他们不认识那差我来的。

chapters.en: If I had not come and spoken to them, they would not be guilty of sin; but now they have no excuse for their sin.
chapters.zh: 我若没有来教训他们，他们就没有罪。但如今他们的罪无可推诿了。

chapters.en: Whoever hates me hates my Father as well.
chapters.zh: 恨我的，也恨我的父。

chapters.en: If I had not done among them the works no one else did, they would not be guilty of sin. As it is, they have seen, and yet they have hated both me and my Father.
chapters.zh: 我若没有在他们中间行过别人未曾行的事，他们就没有罪。但如今连我与我的父，他们也看见也恨恶了。

chapters.en: But this is to fulfill what is written in their Law: ‘They hated me without reason.’
chapters.zh: 这要应验他们律法上所写的话说，他们无故恨我。

chapters.en: “When the Advocate comes, whom I will send to you from the Father—the Spirit of truth who goes out from the Father—he will testify about me.
chapters.zh: 但我要从父那里差保惠师来，就是从父出来真理的圣灵。他来了，就要为我作见证。

chapters.en: And you also must testify, for you have been with me from the beginning.
chapters.zh: 你们也要作见证，因为你们从起头就与我同在。

chapters.en: “All this I have told you so that you will not fall away.
chapters.zh: 我已将这些事告诉你们，使你们不至于跌倒。

chapters.en: They will put you out of the synagogue; in fact, the time is coming when anyone who kills you will think they are offering a service to God.
chapters.zh: 人要把你们赶出会堂。并且时候将到，凡杀你们的，就以为是事奉神。

chapters.en: They will do such things because they have not known the Father or me.
chapters.zh: 他们这样行，是因未曾认识父，也未曾认识我。

chapters.en: I have told you this, so that when their time comes you will remember that I warned you about them. I did not tell you this from the beginning because I was with you,
chapters.zh: 我将这事告诉你们，是叫你们到了时候，可以想起我对你们说过了。我起先没有将这事告诉你们，因为我与你们同在。

chapters.en: but now I am going to him who sent me. None of you asks me, ‘Where are you going?’
chapters.zh: 现今我往差我来的父那里去。你们中间并没有人问我，你往哪里去？

chapters.en: Rather, you are filled with grief because I have said these things.
chapters.zh: 只因我将这事告诉你们，你们就满心忧愁。

chapters.en: But very truly I tell you, it is for your good that I am going away. Unless I go away, the Advocate will not come to you; but if I go, I will send him to you.
chapters.zh: 然而我将真情告诉你们。我去是与你们有益的。我若不去，保惠师就不到你们这里来。我若去，就差他来。

chapters.en: When he comes, he will prove the world to be in the wrong about sin and righteousness and judgment:
chapters.zh: 他既来了，就要叫世人为罪，为义，为审判，自己责备自己。

chapters.en: about sin, because people do not believe in me;
chapters.zh: 为罪，是因他们不信我。

chapters.en: about righteousness, because I am going to the Father, where you can see me no longer;
chapters.zh: 为义，是因我往父那里去，你们就不再见我。

chapters.en: and about judgment, because the prince of this world now stands condemned.
chapters.zh: 为审判，是因这世界的王受了审判。

chapters.en: “I have much more to say to you, more than you can now bear.
chapters.zh: 我还有好些事要告诉你们，但你们现在担当不了（或作不能领会）。

chapters.en: But when he, the Spirit of truth, comes, he will guide you into all the truth. He will not speak on his own; he will speak only what he hears, and he will tell you what is yet to come.
chapters.zh: 只等真理的圣灵来了，他要引导你们明白（原文作进入）一切的真理。因为他不是凭自己说的，乃是把他所听见的都说出来。并要把将来的事告诉你们。

chapters.en: He will glorify me because it is from me that he will receive what he will make known to you.
chapters.zh: 他要荣耀我。因为他要将受于我的，告诉你们。

chapters.en: All that belongs to the Father is mine. That is why I said the Spirit will receive from me what he will make known to you.”
chapters.zh: 凡父所有的，都是我的，所以我说，他要将受于我的，告诉你们。

chapters.en: Jesus went on to say, “In a little while you will see me no more, and then after a little while you will see me.”
chapters.zh: 等不多时，你们就不得见我。再等不多时，你们还要见我。

chapters.en: At this, some of his disciples said to one another, “What does he mean by saying, ‘In a little while you will see me no more, and then after a little while you will see me,’ and ‘Because I am going to the Father’?”
chapters.zh: 有几个门徒就彼此说，他对我们说，等不多时，你们就不得见我。再等不多时，你们还要见我。又说，因我往父那里去。这是什么意思呢？

chapters.en: They kept asking, “What does he mean by ‘a little while’? We don’t understand what he is saying.”
chapters.zh: 门徒彼此说，他说等不多时，到底是什么意思呢？我们不明白他所说的话。

chapters.en: Jesus saw that they wanted to ask him about this, so he said to them, “Are you asking one another what I meant when I said, ‘In a little while you will see me no more, and then after a little while you will see me’?
chapters.zh: 耶稣看出他们要问他，就说，我说等不多时，你们就不得见我，再等不多时，你们还要见我。你们为这话彼此相问吗？

chapters.en: Very truly I tell you, you will weep and mourn while the world rejoices. You will grieve, but your grief will turn to joy.
chapters.zh: 我实实在在地告诉你们，你们将要痛哭，哀号，世人倒要喜乐。你们将要忧愁，然而你们的忧愁，要变为喜乐。

chapters.en: A woman giving birth to a child has pain because her time has come; but when her baby is born she forgets the anguish because of her joy that a child is born into the world.
chapters.zh: 妇人生产的时候，就忧愁，因为她的时候到了。既生了孩子，就不再记念那苦楚，因为欢喜世上生了一个人。

chapters.en: So with you: Now is your time of grief, but I will see you again and you will rejoice, and no one will take away your joy.
chapters.zh: 你们现在也是忧愁。但我要再见你们，你们的心就喜乐了。这喜乐，也没有人能夺去。

chapters.en: In that day you will no longer ask me anything. Very truly I tell you, my Father will give you whatever you ask in my name.
chapters.zh: 到那日，你们什么也就不问我了。我实实在在地告诉你们，你们若向父求什么，他必因我的名，赐给你们。

chapters.en: Until now you have not asked for anything in my name. Ask and you will receive, and your joy will be complete.
chapters.zh: 向来你们没有奉我的名求什么，如今你们求就必得着，叫你们的喜乐可以满足。

chapters.en: “Though I have been speaking figuratively, a time is coming when I will no longer use this kind of language but will tell you plainly about my Father.
chapters.zh: 这些事，我是用比喻对你们说的。时候将到，我不再用比喻对你们说，乃要将父明明地告诉你们。

chapters.en: In that day you will ask in my name. I am not saying that I will ask the Father on your behalf.
chapters.zh: 到那日，你们要奉我的名祈求。我并不对你们说，我要为你们求父。

chapters.en: No, the Father himself loves you because you have loved me and have believed that I came from God.
chapters.zh: 父自己爱你们，因为你们已经爱我，又信我是从父出来的。

chapters.en: I came from the Father and entered the world; now I am leaving the world and going back to the Father.”
chapters.zh: 我从父出来，到了世界。我又离开世界，往父那里去。

chapters.en: Then Jesus’ disciples said, “Now you are speaking clearly and without figures of speech.
chapters.zh: 门徒说，如今你是明说，并不用比喻了。

chapters.en: Now we can see that you know all things and that you do not even need to have anyone ask you questions. This makes us believe that you came from God.”
chapters.zh: 现在我们晓得你凡事都知道，也不用人问你。因此我们信你是从神出来的。

chapters.en: “Do you now believe?” Jesus replied.
chapters.zh: 耶稣说，现在你们信吗？

chapters.en: “A time is coming and in fact has come when you will be scattered, each to your own home. You will leave me all alone. Yet I am not alone, for my Father is with me.
chapters.zh: 看哪，时候将到，且是已经到了，你们要分散，各归自己的地方去，留下我独自一人。其实我不是独自一人，因为有父与我同在。

chapters.en: “I have told you these things, so that in me you may have peace. In this world you will have trouble. But take heart! I have overcome the world.”
chapters.zh: 我将这些事告诉你们，是要叫你们在我里面有平安。在世上你们有苦难。但你们可以放心，我已经胜了世界。

chapters.en: After Jesus said this, he looked toward heaven and prayed: “Father, the hour has come. Glorify your Son, that your Son may glorify you.
chapters.zh: 耶稣说了这话，就举目望天说，父阿，时候到了。愿你荣耀你的儿子，使儿子也荣耀你。

chapters.en: For you granted him authority over all people that he might give eternal life to all those you have given him.
chapters.zh: 正如你曾赐给他权柄，管理凡有血气的，叫他将永生赐给你所赐给他的人。

chapters.en: Now this is eternal life: that they know you, the only true God, and Jesus Christ, whom you have sent.
chapters.zh: 认识你独一的真神，并且认识你所差来的耶稣基督，这就是永生。

chapters.en: I have brought you glory on earth by finishing the work you gave me to do.
chapters.zh: 我在地上已经荣耀你，你所托付我的事，我已成全了。

chapters.en: And now, Father, glorify me in your presence with the glory I had with you before the world began.
chapters.zh: 父阿，现在求你使我同你享荣耀，就是未有世界以先，我同你所有的荣耀。

chapters.en: “I have revealed you to those whom you gave me out of the world. They were yours; you gave them to me and they have obeyed your word.
chapters.zh: 你从世上赐给我的人，我已将你的名显明与他们。他们本是你的，你将他们赐给我，他们也遵守了你的道。

chapters.en: Now they know that everything you have given me comes from you.
chapters.zh: 如今他们知道，凡你所赐给我的，都是从你那里来的。

chapters.en: For I gave them the words you gave me and they accepted them. They knew with certainty that I came from you, and they believed that you sent me.
chapters.zh: 因为你所赐给我的道，我已经赐给他们。他们也领受了，又确实知道，我是从你出来的，并且信你差了我来。

chapters.en: I pray for them. I am not praying for the world, but for those you have given me, for they are yours.
chapters.zh: 我为他们祈求。不为世人祈求，却为你所赐给我的人祈求，因他们本是你的。

chapters.en: All I have is yours, and all you have is mine. And glory has come to me through them.
chapters.zh: 凡是我的都是你的，你的也是我的。并且我因他们得了荣耀。

chapters.en: I will remain in the world no longer, but they are still in the world, and I am coming to you. Holy Father, protect them by the power of your name, the name you gave me, so that they may be one as we are one.
chapters.zh: 从今以后，我不在世上，他们却在世上，我往你那里去。圣父阿，求你因你所赐给我的名保守他们，叫他们合而为一，像我们一样。

chapters.en: While I was with them, I protected them and kept them safe by that name you gave me. None has been lost except the one doomed to destruction so that Scripture would be fulfilled.
chapters.zh: 我与他们同在的时候，因你所赐给我的名，保守了他们，我也护卫了他们，其中除了那灭亡之子，没有一个灭亡的。好叫经上的话得应验。

chapters.en: “I am coming to you now, but I say these things while I am still in the world, so that they may have the full measure of my joy within them.
chapters.zh: 现在我往你那里去。我还在世上说这话，是叫他们心里充满我的喜乐。

chapters.en: I have given them your word and the world has hated them, for they are not of the world any more than I am of the world.
chapters.zh: 我已将你的道赐给他们。世界又恨他们，因为他们不属世界，正如我不属世界一样。

chapters.en: My prayer is not that you take them out of the world but that you protect them from the evil one.
chapters.zh: 我不求你叫他们离开世界，只求你保守他们脱离那恶者。（或作脱离罪恶）

chapters.en: They are not of the world, even as I am not of it.
chapters.zh: 他们不属世界，正如我不属世界一样。

chapters.en: Sanctify them by the truth; your word is truth.
chapters.zh: 求你用真理使他们成圣。你的道就是真理。

chapters.en: As you sent me into the world, I have sent them into the world.
chapters.zh: 你怎样差我到世上，我也照样差他们到世上。

chapters.en: For them I sanctify myself, that they too may be truly sanctified.
chapters.zh: 我为他们的缘故，自己分别为圣，叫他们也因真理成圣。

chapters.en: “My prayer is not for them alone. I pray also for those who will believe in me through their message,
chapters.zh: 我不但为这些人祈求，也为那些因他们的话信我的人祈求。

chapters.en: that all of them may be one, Father, just as you are in me and I am in you. May they also be in us so that the world may believe that you have sent me.
chapters.zh: 使他们都合而为一。正如你父在我里面，我在你里面，使他们也在我们里面。叫世人可以信你差了我来。

chapters.en: I have given them the glory that you gave me, that they may be one as we are one—
chapters.zh: 你所赐给我的荣耀，我已赐给他们，使他们合而为一，像我们合而为一。

chapters.en: I in them and you in me—so that they may be brought to complete unity. Then the world will know that you sent me and have loved them even as you have loved me.
chapters.zh: 我在他们里面，你在我里面，使他们完完全全的合而为一。叫世人知道你差了我来，也知道你爱他们如同爱我一样。

chapters.en: “Father, I want those you have given me to be with me where I am, and to see my glory, the glory you have given me because you loved me before the creation of the world.
chapters.zh: 父阿，我在哪里，愿你所赐给我的人也同我在哪里，叫他们看见你所赐给我的荣耀。因为创立世界以前，你已经爱我了。

chapters.en: “Righteous Father, though the world does not know you, I know you, and they know that you have sent me.
chapters.zh: 公义的父阿，世人未曾认识你，我却认识你。这些人也知道你差了我来。

chapters.en: I have made you known to them, and will continue to make you known in order that the love you have for me may be in them and that I myself may be in them.”
chapters.zh: 我已将你的名指示他们，还要指示他们，使你所爱我的爱在他们里面，我也在他们里面。

chapters.en: When he had finished praying, Jesus left with his disciples and crossed the Kidron Valley. On the other side there was a garden, and he and his disciples went into it.
chapters.zh: 耶稣说了这话，就同门徒出去，过了汲沦溪，在那里有一个园子，他和门徒进去了。

chapters.en: Now Judas, who betrayed him, knew the place, because Jesus had often met there with his disciples.
chapters.zh: 卖耶稣的犹大也知道那地方。因为耶稣和门徒屡次上那里去聚集。

chapters.en: So Judas came to the garden, guiding a detachment of soldiers and some officials from the chief priests and the Pharisees. They were carrying torches, lanterns and weapons.
chapters.zh: 犹大领了一队兵，和祭司长并法利赛人的差役，拿着灯笼，火把，兵器，就来到园里。

chapters.en: Jesus, knowing all that was going to happen to him, went out and asked them, “Who is it you want?”
chapters.zh: 耶稣知道将要临到自己的一切事，就出来，对他们说，你们找谁？

chapters.en: “Jesus of Nazareth,” they replied. “I am he,” Jesus said. (And Judas the traitor was standing there with them.)
chapters.zh: 他们回答说，找拿撒勒人耶稣。耶稣说，我就是。卖他的犹大也同他们站在那里。

chapters.en: When Jesus said, “I am he,” they drew back and fell to the ground.
chapters.zh: 耶稣一说我就是，他们就退后倒在地上。

chapters.en: Again he asked them, “Who is it you want?”“Jesus of Nazareth,” they said.
chapters.zh: 他又问他们说，你们找谁？他们说，找拿撒勒人耶稣。

chapters.en: Jesus answered, “I told you that I am he. If you are looking for me, then let these men go.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣说，我已经告诉你们，我就是。你们若找我，就让这些人去吧。

chapters.en: This happened so that the words he had spoken would be fulfilled: “I have not lost one of those you gave me.”
chapters.zh: 这要应验耶稣从前的话，说，你所赐给我的人，我没有失落一个。

chapters.en: Then Simon Peter, who had a sword, drew it and struck the high priest’s servant, cutting off his right ear. (The servant’s name was Malchus.)
chapters.zh: 西门彼得带着一把刀，就拔出来，将大祭司的仆人砍了一刀，削掉他的右耳。那仆人名叫马勒古。

chapters.en: Jesus commanded Peter, “Put your sword away! Shall I not drink the cup the Father has given me?”
chapters.zh: 耶稣就对彼得说，收刀入鞘吧。我父所给我的那杯，我岂可不喝呢？

chapters.en: Then the detachment of soldiers with its commander and the Jewish officials arrested Jesus. They bound him
chapters.zh: 那队兵和千夫长并犹太人的差役，就拿住耶稣，把他捆绑了。

chapters.en: and brought him first to Annas, who was the father-in-law of Caiaphas, the high priest that year.
chapters.zh: 先带到亚那面前。因为亚那是本年作大祭司该亚法的岳父。

chapters.en: Caiaphas was the one who had advised the Jewish leaders that it would be good if one man died for the people.
chapters.zh: 这该亚法，就是从前向犹太人发议论说，一个人替百姓死是有益的那位。

chapters.en: Simon Peter and another disciple were following Jesus. Because this disciple was known to the high priest, he went with Jesus into the high priest’s courtyard,
chapters.zh: 西门彼得跟着耶稣，还有一个门徒跟着。那门徒是大祭司所认识的。他就同耶稣进了大祭司的院子。

chapters.en: but Peter had to wait outside at the door. The other disciple, who was known to the high priest, came back, spoke to the servant girl on duty there and brought Peter in.
chapters.zh: 彼得却站在门外。大祭司所认识的那个门徒出来，和看门的使女说了一声，就领彼得进去。

chapters.en: “You aren’t one of this man’s disciples too, are you?” she asked Peter. He replied, “I am not.”
chapters.zh: 那看门的使女对彼得说，你不也是这人的门徒吗？他说，我不是。

chapters.en: It was cold, and the servants and officials stood around a fire they had made to keep warm. Peter also was standing with them, warming himself.
chapters.zh: 仆人和差役，因为天冷，就生了炭火，站在那里烤火。彼得也同他们站着烤火。

chapters.en: Meanwhile, the high priest questioned Jesus about his disciples and his teaching.
chapters.zh: 大祭司就以耶稣的门徒和他的教训盘问他。

chapters.en: “I have spoken openly to the world,” Jesus replied. “I always taught in synagogues or at the temple, where all the Jews come together. I said nothing in secret.
chapters.zh: 耶稣回答说，我从来是明明地对世人说话。我常在会堂和殿里，就是犹太人聚集的地方，教训人。我在暗地里，并没有说什么。

chapters.en: Why question me? Ask those who heard me. Surely they know what I said.”
chapters.zh: 你为什么问我呢？可以问那听见的人，我对他们说的是什么。我所说的，他们都知道。

chapters.en: When Jesus said this, one of the officials nearby slapped him in the face. “Is this the way you answer the high priest?” he demanded.
chapters.zh: 耶稣说了这话，旁边站着的一个差役，用手掌打他说，你这样回答大祭司吗？

chapters.en: “If I said something wrong,” Jesus replied, “testify as to what is wrong. But if I spoke the truth, why did you strike me?”
chapters.zh: 耶稣说，我若说的不是，你可以指证那不是。我若说的是，你为什么打我呢？

chapters.en: Then Annas sent him bound to Caiaphas the high priest.
chapters.zh: 亚那就把耶稣解到大祭司该亚法那里，仍是捆着解去的。

chapters.en: Meanwhile, Simon Peter was still standing there warming himself. So they asked him, “You aren’t one of his disciples too, are you?” He denied it, saying, “I am not.”
chapters.zh: 西门彼得正站着烤火，有人对他说，你不也是他的门徒吗？彼得不承认，说，我不是。

chapters.en: One of the high priest’s servants, a relative of the man whose ear Peter had cut off, challenged him, “Didn’t I see you with him in the garden?”
chapters.zh: 有大祭司的一个仆人，是彼得削掉耳朵那人的亲属，说，我不是看见你同他在园子里吗？

chapters.en: Again Peter denied it, and at that moment a rooster began to crow.
chapters.zh: 彼得又不承认。立时鸡就叫了。

chapters.en: Then the Jewish leaders took Jesus from Caiaphas to the palace of the Roman governor. By now it was early morning, and to avoid ceremonial uncleanness they did not enter the palace, because they wanted to be able to eat the Passover.
chapters.zh: 众人将耶稣从该亚法那里往衙门内解去。那时天还早。他们自己却不进衙门，恐怕染了污秽，不能吃逾越节的筵席。

chapters.en: So Pilate came out to them and asked, “What charges are you bringing against this man?”
chapters.zh: 彼拉多就出来，到他们那里，说，你们告这人是为什么事呢？

chapters.en: “If he were not a criminal,” they replied, “we would not have handed him over to you.”
chapters.zh: 他们回答说，这人若不是作恶的，我们就不把他交给你。

chapters.en: Pilate said, “Take him yourselves and judge him by your own law.” “But we have no right to execute anyone,” they objected.
chapters.zh: 彼拉多说，你们自己带他去，按着你们的律法审问他吧。犹太人说，我们没有杀人的权柄。

chapters.en: This took place to fulfill what Jesus had said about the kind of death he was going to die.
chapters.zh: 这要应验耶稣所说，自己将要怎样死的话了。

chapters.en: Pilate then went back inside the palace, summoned Jesus and asked him, “Are you the king of the Jews?”
chapters.zh: 彼拉多又进了衙门，叫耶稣来，对他说，你是犹太人的王吗？

chapters.en: “Is that your own idea,” Jesus asked, “or did others talk to you about me?”
chapters.zh: 耶稣回答说，这话是你自己说的，还是别人论我对你说的呢？

chapters.en: “Am I a Jew?” Pilate replied. “Your own people and chief priests handed you over to me. What is it you have done?”
chapters.zh: 彼拉多说，我岂是犹太人呢？你本国的人和祭司长，把你交给我。你作了什么事呢？

chapters.en: Jesus said, “My kingdom is not of this world. If it were, my servants would fight to prevent my arrest by the Jewish leaders. But now my kingdom is from another place.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣回答说，我的国不属这世界。我的国若属这世界，我的臣仆必要争战，使我不至于被交给犹太人。只是我的国不属这世界。

chapters.en: “You are a king, then!” said Pilate. Jesus answered, “You say that I am a king. In fact, the reason I was born and came into the world is to testify to the truth. Everyone on the side of truth listens to me.”
chapters.zh: 彼拉多就对他说，这样，你是王吗？耶稣回答说，你说我是王。我为此而生，也为此来到世间，特为给真理作见证。凡属真理的人，就听我的话。
