chapters.en: “What is truth?” retorted Pilate. With this he went out again to the Jews gathered there and said, “I find no basis for a charge against him.
chapters.zh: 彼拉多说，真理是什么呢？说了这话，又出来到犹太人那里，对他们说，我查不出他有什么罪来。

chapters.en: But it is your custom for me to release to you one prisoner at the time of the Passover. Do you want me to release ‘the king of the Jews’?”
chapters.zh: 但你们有个规矩，在逾越节要我给你们释放一个人，你们要我给你们释放犹太人的王吗？

chapters.en: They shouted back, “No, not him! Give us Barabbas!” Now Barabbas had taken part in an uprising.
chapters.zh: 他们又喊着说，不要这人，要巴拉巴。这巴拉巴是个强盗。

chapters.en: Then Pilate took Jesus and had him flogged.
chapters.zh: 当下彼拉多将耶稣鞭打了。

chapters.en: The soldiers twisted together a crown of thorns and put it on his head. They clothed him in a purple robe
chapters.zh: 兵丁用荆棘编作冠冕，戴在他头上，给他穿上紫袍。

chapters.en: and went up to him again and again, saying, “Hail, king of the Jews!” And they slapped him in the face.
chapters.zh: 又挨近他说，恭喜犹太人的王阿。他们就用手掌打他。

chapters.en: Once more Pilate came out and said to the Jews gathered there, “Look, I am bringing him out to you to let you know that I find no basis for a charge against him.”
chapters.zh: 彼拉多又出来对众人说，我带他出来见你们，叫你们知道我查不出他有什么罪来。

chapters.en: When Jesus came out wearing the crown of thorns and the purple robe, Pilate said to them, “Here is the man!”
chapters.zh: 耶稣出来，戴着荆棘冠冕，穿着紫袍。彼拉多对他们说，你们看这个人。

chapters.en: As soon as the chief priests and their officials saw him, they shouted, “Crucify! Crucify!” But Pilate answered, “You take him and crucify him. As for me, I find no basis for a charge against him.”
chapters.zh: 祭司长和差役看见他，就喊着说，钉他十字架，钉他十字架。彼拉多说，你们自己把他钉十字架吧。我查不出他有什么罪来。

chapters.en: The Jewish leaders insisted, “We have a law, and according to that law he must die, because he claimed to be the Son of God.”
chapters.zh: 犹太人回答说，我们有律法，按那律法，他是该死的，因他以自己为神的儿子。

chapters.en: When Pilate heard this, he was even more afraid,
chapters.zh: 彼拉多听见这话，越发害怕。

chapters.en: and he went back inside the palace. “Where do you come from?” he asked Jesus, but Jesus gave him no answer.
chapters.zh: 又进衙门，对耶稣说，你是哪里来的？耶稣却不回答。

chapters.en: “Do you refuse to speak to me?” Pilate said. “Don’t you realize I have power either to free you or to crucify you?”
chapters.zh: 彼拉多说，你不对我说话吗？你岂不知我有权柄释放你，也有权柄把你钉十字架吗？

chapters.en: Jesus answered, “You would have no power over me if it were not given to you from above. Therefore the one who handed me over to you is guilty of a greater sin.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣回答说，若不是从上头赐给你的，你就毫无权柄办我。所以把我交给你的那人，罪更重了。

chapters.en: From then on, Pilate tried to set Jesus free, but the Jewish leaders kept shouting, “If you let this man go, you are no friend of Caesar. Anyone who claims to be a king opposes Caesar.”
chapters.zh: 从此彼拉多想要释放耶稣。无奈犹太人喊着说，你若释放这个人，就不是该撒的忠臣。（原文作朋友）凡以自己为王的，就是背叛该撒了。

chapters.en: When Pilate heard this, he brought Jesus out and sat down on the judge’s seat at a place known as the Stone Pavement (which in Aramaic is Gabbatha).
chapters.zh: 彼拉多听见这话，就带耶稣出来，到了一个地方，名叫铺华石处，希伯来话叫厄巴大，就在那里坐堂。

chapters.en: It was the day of Preparation of the Passover; it was about noon. “Here is your king,” Pilate said to the Jews.
chapters.zh: 那日是预备逾越节的日子，约有午正。彼拉多对犹太人说，看哪，这是你们的王。

chapters.en: But they shouted, “Take him away! Take him away! Crucify him!” “Shall I crucify your king?” Pilate asked. “We have no king but Caesar,” the chief priests answered.
chapters.zh: 他们喊着说，除掉他，除掉他，钉他在十字架上。彼拉多说，我可以把你们的王钉十字架吗？祭司长回答说，除了该撒，我们没有王。

chapters.en: Finally Pilate handed him over to them to be crucified. So the soldiers took charge of Jesus.
chapters.zh: 于是彼拉多将耶稣交给他们去钉十字架。

chapters.en: Carrying his own cross, he went out to the place of the Skull (which in Aramaic is called Golgotha).
chapters.zh: 他们就把耶稣带了去。耶稣背着自己的十字架出来，到了一个地方，名叫髑髅地，希伯来话叫各各他。

chapters.en: There they crucified him, and with him two others—one on each side and Jesus in the middle.
chapters.zh: 他们就在那里钉他在十字架上，还有两个人和他一同钉着，一边一个，耶稣在中间。

chapters.en: Pilate had a notice prepared and fastened to the cross. It read: JESUS OF NAZARETH, THE KING OF THE JEWS.
chapters.zh: 彼拉多又用牌子写了一个名号，安在十字架上。写的是犹太人的王，拿撒勒人耶稣。

chapters.en: Many of the Jews read this sign, for the place where Jesus was crucified was near the city, and the sign was written in Aramaic, Latin and Greek.
chapters.zh: 有许多犹太人念这名号。因为耶稣被钉十字架的地方，与城相近，并且是用希伯来，罗马，希利尼，三样文字写的。

chapters.en: The chief priests of the Jews protested to Pilate, “Do not write ‘The King of the Jews,’ but that this man claimed to be king of the Jews.”
chapters.zh: 犹太人的祭司长，就对彼拉多说，不要写犹太人的王。要写他自己说我是犹太人的王。

chapters.en: Pilate answered, “What I have written, I have written.”
chapters.zh: 彼拉多说，我所写的，我已经写上了。

chapters.en: When the soldiers crucified Jesus, they took his clothes, dividing them into four shares, one for each of them, with the undergarment remaining. This garment was seamless, woven in one piece from top to bottom.
chapters.zh: 兵丁既然将耶稣钉在十字架上，就拿他的衣服分为四分，每兵一分。又拿他的里衣。这件里衣，原来没有缝儿，是上下一片织成的。

chapters.en: “Let’s not tear it,” they said to one another. “Let’s decide by lot who will get it.” This happened that the scripture might be fulfilled that said, “They divided my clothes among them and cast lots for my garment.”So this is what the soldiers did.
chapters.zh: 他们就彼此说，我们不要撕开，只要拈阄，看谁得着。这要应验经上的话说，他们分了我的外衣，为我的里衣拈阄。兵丁果然作了这事。

chapters.en: Near the cross of Jesus stood his mother, his mother’s sister, Mary the wife of Clopas, and Mary Magdalene.
chapters.zh: 站在耶稣十字架旁边的，有他母亲，与他母亲的姊妹，并革罗吧的妻子马利亚，和抹大拉的马利亚。

chapters.en: When Jesus saw his mother there, and the disciple whom he loved standing nearby, he said to her, “Woman,here is your son,”
chapters.zh: 耶稣见母亲和他所爱的那门徒站在旁边，就对他母亲说，母亲（原文作妇人），看你的儿子。

chapters.en: and to the disciple, “Here is your mother.” From that time on, this disciple took her into his home.
chapters.zh: 又对那门徒说，看你的母亲。从此那门徒就接她到自己家里去了。

chapters.en: Later, knowing that everything had now been finished, and so that Scripture would be fulfilled, Jesus said, “I am thirsty.”
chapters.zh: 这事以后，耶稣知道各样的事已经成了，为要使经上的话应验，就说，我渴了。

chapters.en: A jar of wine vinegar was there, so they soaked a sponge in it, put the sponge on a stalk of the hyssop plant, and lifted it to Jesus’ lips.
chapters.zh: 有一个器皿盛满了醋，放在那里。他们就拿海绒蘸满了醋，绑在牛膝草上，送到他口。

chapters.en: When he had received the drink, Jesus said, “It is finished.” With that, he bowed his head and gave up his spirit.
chapters.zh: 耶稣尝（原文作受）了那醋，就说，成了。便低下头，将灵魂交付神了。

chapters.en: Now it was the day of Preparation, and the next day was to be a special Sabbath. Because the Jewish leaders did not want the bodies left on the crosses during the Sabbath, they asked Pilate to have the legs broken and the bodies taken down.
chapters.zh: 犹太人因这日是预备日，又因那安息日是个大日，就求彼拉多叫人打断他们的腿，把他们拿去，免得尸首当安息日留在十字架上。

chapters.en: The soldiers therefore came and broke the legs of the first man who had been crucified with Jesus, and then those of the other.
chapters.zh: 于是兵丁来，把头一个人的腿，并与耶稣同钉第二个人的腿，都打断了。

chapters.en: But when they came to Jesus and found that he was already dead, they did not break his legs.
chapters.zh: 只是来到耶稣那里，见他已经死了，就不打断他的腿。

chapters.en: Instead, one of the soldiers pierced Jesus’ side with a spear, bringing a sudden flow of blood and water.
chapters.zh: 惟有一个兵拿枪扎他的肋旁，随即有血和水流出来。

chapters.en: The man who saw it has given testimony, and his testimony is true. He knows that he tells the truth, and he testifies so that you also may believe.
chapters.zh: 看见这事的那人就作见证，他的见证也是真的，并且他知道自己所说的是真的，叫你们也可以信。

chapters.en: These things happened so that the scripture would be fulfilled: “Not one of his bones will be broken,”
chapters.zh: 这些事成了，为要应验经上的话说，他的骨头，一根也不可折断。

chapters.en: and, as another scripture says, “They will look on the one they have pierced.”
chapters.zh: 经上又有一句说，他们要仰望自己所扎的人。

chapters.en: Later, Joseph of Arimathea asked Pilate for the body of Jesus. Now Joseph was a disciple of Jesus, but secretly because he feared the Jewish leaders. With Pilate’s permission, he came and took the body away.
chapters.zh: 这些事以后，有亚利马太人约瑟，是耶稣的门徒，只因怕犹太人，就暗暗地作门徒，他来求彼拉多，要把耶稣的身体领去。彼拉多允准，他就把耶稣的身体领去了。

chapters.en: He was accompanied by Nicodemus, the man who earlier had visited Jesus at night. Nicodemus brought a mixture of myrrh and aloes, about seventy-five pounds.
chapters.zh: 又有尼哥底母，就是先前夜里去见耶稣的，带着没药，和沉香，约有一百斤前来。

chapters.en: Taking Jesus’ body, the two of them wrapped it, with the spices, in strips of linen. This was in accordance with Jewish burial customs.
chapters.zh: 他们就照犹太人殡葬的规矩，把耶稣的身体，用细麻布加上香料裹好了。

chapters.en: At the place where Jesus was crucified, there was a garden, and in the garden a new tomb, in which no one had ever been laid.
chapters.zh: 在耶稣钉十字架的地方，有一个园子。园子里有一座新坟墓，是从来没有葬过人的。

chapters.en: Because it was the Jewish day of Preparation and since the tomb was nearby, they laid Jesus there.
chapters.zh: 只因是犹太人的预备日，又因那坟墓近，他们就把耶稣安放在那里。

chapters.en: Early on the first day of the week, while it was still dark, Mary Magdalene went to the tomb and saw that the stone had been removed from the entrance.
chapters.zh: 七日的第一日清早，天还黑的时候，抹大拉的马利亚来到坟墓那里，看见石头从坟墓挪开了。

chapters.en: So she came running to Simon Peter and the other disciple, the one Jesus loved, and said, “They have taken the Lord out of the tomb, and we don’t know where they have put him!”
chapters.zh: 就跑来见西门彼得，和耶稣所爱的那个门徒，对他们说，有人把主从坟墓里挪了去，我们不知道放在哪里。

chapters.en: So Peter and the other disciple started for the tomb.
chapters.zh: 彼得和那门徒就出来，往坟墓那里去。

chapters.en: Both were running, but the other disciple outran Peter and reached the tomb first.
chapters.zh: 两个人同跑，那门徒比彼得跑得更快，先到了坟墓。

chapters.en: He bent over and looked in at the strips of linen lying there but did not go in.
chapters.zh: 低头往里看，就见细麻布还放在那里。只是没有进去。

chapters.en: Then Simon Peter came along behind him and went straight into the tomb. He saw the strips of linen lying there,
chapters.zh: 西门彼得随后也到了，进坟墓里去，就看见细麻布还放在那里。

chapters.en: as well as the cloth that had been wrapped around Jesus’ head. The cloth was still lying in its place, separate from the linen.
chapters.zh: 又看见耶稣的裹头巾，没有和细麻布放在一处，是另在一处卷着。

chapters.en: Finally the other disciple, who had reached the tomb first, also went inside. He saw and believed.
chapters.zh: 先到坟墓的那门徒也进去，看见就信了。

chapters.en: (They still did not understand from Scripture that Jesus had to rise from the dead.)
chapters.zh: 因为他们还不明白圣经的意思，就是耶稣必要从死里复活。

chapters.en: Then the disciples went back to where they were staying.
chapters.zh: 于是两个门徒回自己的住处去了。

chapters.en: Now Mary stood outside the tomb crying. As she wept, she bent over to look into the tomb
chapters.zh: 马利亚却站在坟墓外面哭。哭的时候，低头往坟墓里看，

chapters.en: and saw two angels in white, seated where Jesus’ body had been, one at the head and the other at the foot.
chapters.zh: 就见两个天使，穿着白衣，在安放耶稣身体的地方坐着，一个在头，一个在脚。

chapters.en: They asked her, “Woman, why are you crying?” “They have taken my Lord away,” she said, “and I don’t know where they have put him.”
chapters.zh: 天使对她说，妇人，你为什么哭？她说，因为有人把我主挪了去，我不知道放在哪里。

chapters.en: At this, she turned around and saw Jesus standing there, but she did not realize that it was Jesus.
chapters.zh: 说了这话，就转过身来，看见耶稣站在那里，却不知道是耶稣。

chapters.en: He asked her, “Woman, why are you crying? Who is it you are looking for?”Thinking he was the gardener, she said, “Sir, if you have carried him away, tell me where you have put him, and I will get him.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣问她说，妇人，为什么哭？你找谁呢？马利亚以为是看园的，就对他说，先生，若是你把他移了去，请告诉我，你把他放在哪里，我便去取他。

chapters.en: Jesus said to her, “Mary.”She turned toward him and cried out in Aramaic, “Rabboni!” (which means “Teacher”).
chapters.zh: 耶稣说，马利亚。马利亚就转过来，用希伯来话对他说，拉波尼。（拉波尼就是夫子的意思）

chapters.en: Jesus said, “Do not hold on to me, for I have not yet ascended to the Father. Go instead to my brothers and tell them, ‘I am ascending to my Father and your Father, to my God and your God.’ ”
chapters.zh: 耶稣说，不要摸我。因我还没有升上去见我的父。你往我弟兄那里去，告诉他们说，我要升上去，见我的父，也是你们的父。见我的神，也是你们的神。

chapters.en: Mary Magdalene went to the disciples with the news: “I have seen the Lord!” And she told them that he had said these things to her.
chapters.zh: 抹大拉的马利亚就去告诉门徒说，我已经看见了主。她又将主对她说的这话告诉他们。

chapters.en: On the evening of that first day of the week, when the disciples were together, with the doors locked for fear of the Jewish leaders, Jesus came and stood among them and said, “Peace be with you!”
chapters.zh: 那日，（就是七日的第一日）晚上，门徒所在的地方，因怕犹太人，门都关了。耶稣来站在当中，对他们说，愿你们平安。

chapters.en: After he said this, he showed them his hands and side. The disciples were overjoyed when they saw the Lord.
chapters.zh: 说了这话，就把手和肋旁，指给他们看。门徒看见主，就喜乐了。

chapters.en: Again Jesus said, “Peace be with you! As the Father has sent me, I am sending you.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣又对他们说，愿你们平安。父怎样差遣了我，我也照样差遣你们。

chapters.en: And with that he breathed on them and said, “Receive the Holy Spirit.
chapters.zh: 说了这话，就向他们吹一口气，说，你们受圣灵。

chapters.en: If you forgive anyone’s sins, their sins are forgiven; if you do not forgive them, they are not forgiven.”
chapters.zh: 你们赦免谁的罪，谁的罪就赦免了。你们留下谁的罪，谁的罪就留下了。

chapters.en: Now Thomas (also known as Didymus ), one of the Twelve, was not with the disciples when Jesus came.
chapters.zh: 那十二个门徒中，有称为低土马的多马。耶稣来的时候，他没有和他们同在。

chapters.en: So the other disciples told him, “We have seen the Lord!” But he said to them, “Unless I see the nail marks in his hands and put my finger where the nails were, and put my hand into his side, I will not believe.”
chapters.zh: 那些门徒就对他说，我们已经看见主了。多马却说，我非看见他手上的钉痕，用指头探入那钉痕，又用手探入他的肋旁，我总不信。

chapters.en: A week later his disciples were in the house again, and Thomas was with them. Though the doors were locked, Jesus came and stood among them and said, “Peace be with you!”
chapters.zh: 过了八日，门徒又在屋里，多马也和他们同在，门都关了。耶稣来站在当中说，愿你们平安。

chapters.en: Then he said to Thomas, “Put your finger here; see my hands. Reach out your hand and put it into my side. Stop doubting and believe.”
chapters.zh: 就对多马说，伸过你的指头来，摸（摸原文作看）我的手。伸出你的手来，探入我的肋旁。不要疑惑，总要信。

chapters.en: Thomas said to him, “My Lord and my God!”
chapters.zh: 多马说，我的主，我的神。

chapters.en: Then Jesus told him, “Because you have seen me, you have believed; blessed are those who have not seen and yet have believed.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣对他说，你因看见了我才信。那没有看见就信的，有福了。

chapters.en: Jesus performed many other signs in the presence of his disciples, which are not recorded in this book.
chapters.zh: 耶稣在门徒面前，另外行了许多神迹，没有记在这书上。

chapters.en: But these are written that you may believe that Jesus is the Messiah, the Son of God, and that by believing you may have life in his name.
chapters.zh: 但记这些事，要叫你们信耶稣是基督，是神的儿子。并且叫你们信了他，就可以因他的名得生命。

chapters.en: Afterward Jesus appeared again to his disciples, by the Sea of Galilee. It happened this way:
chapters.zh: 这些事以后，耶稣在提比哩亚海边，又向门徒显现。他怎样显现记在下面。

chapters.en: Simon Peter, Thomas (also known as Didymus ), Nathanael from Cana in Galilee, the sons of Zebedee, and two other disciples were together.
chapters.zh: 有西门彼得，和称为低土马的多马，并加利利的迦拿人拿但业，还有西庇太的两个儿子，又有两个门徒，都在一处。

chapters.en: “I’m going out to fish,” Simon Peter told them, and they said, “We’ll go with you.” So they went out and got into the boat, but that night they caught nothing.
chapters.zh: 西门彼得对他们说，我打鱼去。他们说，我们也和你同去。他们就出去，上了船，那一夜并没有打着什么。

chapters.en: Early in the morning, Jesus stood on the shore, but the disciples did not realize that it was Jesus.
chapters.zh: 天将亮的时候，耶稣站在岸上。门徒却不知道是耶稣。

chapters.en: He called out to them, “Friends, haven’t you any fish?”“No,” they answered.
chapters.zh: 耶稣就对他们说，小子，你们有吃的没有。他们回答说，没有。

chapters.en: He said, “Throw your net on the right side of the boat and you will find some.” When they did, they were unable to haul the net in because of the large number of fish.
chapters.zh: 耶稣说，你们把网撒在船的右边，就必得着。他们便撒下网去，竟拉不上来了，因为鱼甚多。

chapters.en: Then the disciple whom Jesus loved said to Peter, “It is the Lord!” As soon as Simon Peter heard him say, “It is the Lord,” he wrapped his outer garment around him (for he had taken it off) and jumped into the water.
chapters.zh: 耶稣所爱的那门徒对彼得说，是主。那时西门彼得赤着身子，一听见是主，就束上一件外衣，跳在海里。

chapters.en: The other disciples followed in the boat, towing the net full of fish, for they were not far from shore, about a hundred yards.
chapters.zh: 其余的门徒（离岸不远，约有二百肘，（古时以肘为尺，一肘约有今时尺半）就在小船上把那网鱼拉过来。

chapters.en: When they landed, they saw a fire of burning coals there with fish on it, and some bread.
chapters.zh: 他们上了岸，就看见那里有炭火，上面有鱼，又有饼。

chapters.en: Jesus said to them, “Bring some of the fish you have just caught.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣对他们说，把刚才打的鱼，拿几条来。

chapters.en: So Simon Peter climbed back into the boat and dragged the net ashore. It was full of large fish, 153, but even with so many the net was not torn.
chapters.zh: 西门彼得就去，（或作上船）把网拉到岸上，那网满了大鱼，共一百五十三条。鱼虽这样多，网却没有破。

chapters.en: Jesus said to them, “Come and have breakfast.” None of the disciples dared ask him, “Who are you?” They knew it was the Lord.
chapters.zh: 耶稣说，你们来吃早饭。门徒中没有一个敢问他，你是谁？因为知道是主。

chapters.en: Jesus came, took the bread and gave it to them, and did the same with the fish.
chapters.zh: 耶稣就来拿饼和鱼给他们。

chapters.en: This was now the third time Jesus appeared to his disciples after he was raised from the dead.
chapters.zh: 耶稣从死里复活以后，向门徒显现，这是第三次。

chapters.en: When they had finished eating, Jesus said to Simon Peter, “Simon son of John, do you love me more than these?”“Yes, Lord,” he said, “you know that I love you.” Jesus said, “Feed my lambs.”
chapters.zh: 他们吃完了早饭，耶稣对西门彼得说，约翰的儿子西门，（约翰马太十六章十七节称约拿）你爱我比这些更深吗？彼得说，主阿，是的。你知道我爱你。耶稣对他说，你喂养我的小羊。

chapters.en: Again Jesus said, “Simon son of John, do you love me?”He answered, “Yes, Lord, you know that I love you.” Jesus said, “Take care of my sheep.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣第二次又对他说，约翰的儿子西门，你爱我吗？彼得说，主阿，是的。你知道我爱你。耶稣说，你牧养我的羊。

chapters.en: The third time he said to him, “Simon son of John, do you love me?”Peter was hurt because Jesus asked him the third time, “Do you love me?” He said, “Lord, you know all things; you know that I love you.” Jesus said, “Feed my sheep.
chapters.zh: 第三次对他说，约翰的儿子西门，你爱我吗？彼得因为耶稣第三次对他说，你爱我吗？就忧愁，对耶稣说，主阿，你是无所不知的，你知道我爱你。耶稣说，你喂养我的羊。

chapters.en: Very truly I tell you, when you were younger you dressed yourself and went where you wanted; but when you are old you will stretch out your hands, and someone else will dress you and lead you where you do not want to go.”
chapters.zh: 我实实在在地告诉你，你年少的时候，自己束上带子，随意往来，但年老的时候，你要伸出手来，别人要把你束上，带你到不愿意去的地方。

chapters.en: Jesus said this to indicate the kind of death by which Peter would glorify God. Then he said to him, “Follow me!”
chapters.zh: 耶稣说这话，是指着彼得要怎样死荣耀神。说了这话，就对他说，你跟从我吧。

chapters.en: Peter turned and saw that the disciple whom Jesus loved was following them. (This was the one who had leaned back against Jesus at the supper and had said, “Lord, who is going to betray you?”)
chapters.zh: 彼得转过来，看见耶稣所爱的那门徒跟着，就是在晚饭的时候，靠着耶稣胸膛，说，主阿，卖你的是谁的那门徒。

chapters.en: When Peter saw him, he asked, “Lord, what about him?”
chapters.zh: 彼得看见他，就问耶稣说，主阿，这人将来如何？

chapters.en: Jesus answered, “If I want him to remain alive until I return, what is that to you? You must follow me.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣对他说，我若要他等到我来的时候，与你何干，你跟从我吧。

chapters.en: Because of this, the rumor spread among the believers that this disciple would not die. But Jesus did not say that he would not die; he only said, “If I want him to remain alive until I return, what is that to you?”
chapters.zh: 于是这话传在弟兄中间，说那门徒不死。其实耶稣不是说他不死。乃是说我若要他等到我来的时候，与你何干。

chapters.en: This is the disciple who testifies to these things and who wrote them down. We know that his testimony is true.
chapters.zh: 为这些事作见证，并且记载这些事的，就是这门徒。我们也知道他的见证是真的。

chapters.en: Jesus did many other things as well. If every one of them were written down, I suppose that even the whole world would not have room for the books that would be written.
chapters.zh: 耶稣所行的事，还有许多，若是一一的都写出来，我想所写的书，就是世界也容不下了。

chapters.en: In my former book, Theophilus, I wrote about all that Jesus began to do and to teach
chapters.zh: 提阿非罗阿，我已经作了前书，论到耶稣开头一切所行所教训的，

chapters.en: until the day he was taken up to heaven, after giving instructions through the Holy Spirit to the apostles he had chosen.
chapters.zh: 直到他借着圣灵吩咐所拣选的使徒，以后被接上升的日子为止。

chapters.en: After his suffering, he presented himself to them and gave many convincing proofs that he was alive. He appeared to them over a period of forty days and spoke about the kingdom of God.
chapters.zh: 他受害之后，用许多的凭据，将自己活活地显给使徒看，四十天之久向他们显现，讲说神国的事。

chapters.en: On one occasion, while he was eating with them, he gave them this command: “Do not leave Jerusalem, but wait for the gift my Father promised, which you have heard me speak about.
chapters.zh: 耶稣和他们聚集的时候，嘱咐他们说，不要离开耶路撒冷，要等候父所应许的，就是你们听见我说过的。

chapters.en: For John baptized with water, but in a few days you will be baptized with the Holy Spirit.”
chapters.zh: 约翰是用水施洗。但不多几日，你们要受圣灵的洗。

chapters.en: Then they gathered around him and asked him, “Lord, are you at this time going to restore the kingdom to Israel?”
chapters.zh: 他们聚集的时候，问耶稣说，主阿，你复兴以色列国，就在这时候吗？

chapters.en: He said to them: “It is not for you to know the times or dates the Father has set by his own authority.
chapters.zh: 耶稣对他们说，父凭着自己的权柄，所定的时候日期，不是你们可以知道的。

chapters.en: But you will receive power when the Holy Spirit comes on you; and you will be my witnesses in Jerusalem, and in all Judea and Samaria, and to the ends of the earth.”
chapters.zh: 但圣灵降临在你们身上，你们就必得着能力。并要在耶路撒冷，犹太全地，和撒玛利亚，直到地极，作我的见证。

chapters.en: After he said this, he was taken up before their very eyes, and a cloud hid him from their sight.
chapters.zh: 说了这话，他们正看的时候，他就被取上升，有一朵云彩把他接去，便看不见他了。

chapters.en: They were looking intently up into the sky as he was going, when suddenly two men dressed in white stood beside them.
chapters.zh: 当他往上去，他们定睛望天的时候，忽然有两个人，身穿白衣，站在旁边，说，

chapters.en: “Men of Galilee,” they said, “why do you stand here looking into the sky? This same Jesus, who has been taken from you into heaven, will come back in the same way you have seen him go into heaven.”
chapters.zh: 加利利人哪，你们为什么站着望天呢？这离开你们被接升天的耶稣，你们见他怎样往天上去，他还要怎样来。

chapters.en: Then the apostles returned to Jerusalem from the hill called the Mount of Olives, a Sabbath day’s walk from the city.
chapters.zh: 有一座山名叫橄榄山，离耶路撒冷不远，约有安息日可走的路程。当下门徒从那里回耶路撒冷去。

chapters.en: When they arrived, they went upstairs to the room where they were staying. Those present were Peter, John, James and Andrew; Philip and Thomas, Bartholomew and Matthew; James son of Alphaeus and Simon the Zealot, and Judas son of James.
chapters.zh: 进了城，就上了所住的一间楼房。在那里有彼得，约翰，雅各，安得烈，腓力，多马，巴多罗买，马太，亚勒腓的儿子雅各，奋锐党的西门，和雅各的儿子（或作兄弟）犹大。

chapters.en: They all joined together constantly in prayer, along with the women and Mary the mother of Jesus, and with his brothers.
chapters.zh: 这些人，同着几个妇人，和耶稣的母亲马利亚，并耶稣的弟兄，都同心合意地恒切祷告。

chapters.en: In those days Peter stood up among the believers (a group numbering about a hundred and twenty)
chapters.zh: 那时，有许多人聚会，约有一百二十名，彼得就在弟兄中间站起来，说，

chapters.en: and said, “Brothers and sisters, the Scripture had to be fulfilled in which the Holy Spirit spoke long ago through David concerning Judas, who served as guide for those who arrested Jesus.
chapters.zh: 弟兄们，圣灵借大卫的口，在圣经上，预言领人捉拿耶稣的犹大。这话是必须应验的。

chapters.en: He was one of our number and shared in our ministry.”
chapters.zh: 他本来列在我们数中，并且在使徒的职任上得了一分。

chapters.en: (With the payment he received for his wickedness, Judas bought a field; there he fell headlong, his body burst open and all his intestines spilled out.
chapters.zh: 这人用他作恶的工价，买了一块田，以后身子仆倒，肚腹崩裂，肠子都流出来。

chapters.en: Everyone in Jerusalem heard about this, so they called that field in their language Akeldama, that is, Field of Blood.)
chapters.zh: 住在耶路撒冷的众人都知道这事，所以按着他们那里的话，给那块田起名叫亚革大马，就是血田的意思。

chapters.en: “For,” said Peter, “it is written in the Book of Psalms: “ ‘May his place be deserted; let there be no one to dwell in it,’and, “ ‘May another take his place of leadership.’
chapters.zh: 因为诗篇上写着说，愿他的住处，变为荒场，无人在内居住。又说，愿别人得他的职分。

chapters.en: Therefore it is necessary to choose one of the men who have been with us the whole time the Lord Jesus was living among us,
chapters.zh: 所以主耶稣在我们中间始终出入的时候，

chapters.en: beginning from John’s baptism to the time when Jesus was taken up from us. For one of these must become a witness with us of his resurrection.”
chapters.zh: 就是从约翰施洗起，直到主离开我们被接上升的日子为止，必须从那常与我们作伴的人中，立一位与我们同作耶稣复活的见证。

chapters.en: So they nominated two men: Joseph called Barsabbas (also known as Justus) and Matthias.
chapters.zh: 于是选举两个人，就是那叫作巴撒巴又称呼犹士都的约瑟，和马提亚。

chapters.en: Then they prayed, “Lord, you know everyone’s heart. Show us which of these two you have chosen
chapters.zh: 众人就祷告说，主阿，你知道万人的心，求你从这两个人中，指明你所拣选的是谁，叫他得这使徒的位分。这位分犹大已经丢弃，往自己的地方去了。

chapters.en: to take over this apostolic ministry, which Judas left to go where he belongs.”
Then they cast lots, and the lot fell to Matthias; so he was added to the eleven apostles.
chapters.zh: 于是众人为他们摇签，摇出马提亚来。他就和十一个使徒同列。

chapters.en: When the day of Pentecost came, they were all together in one place.
chapters.zh: 五旬节到了，门徒都聚集在一处。

chapters.en: Suddenly a sound like the blowing of a violent wind came from heaven and filled the whole house where they were sitting.
chapters.zh: 忽然从天上有响声下来，好像一阵大风吹过，充满了他们所坐的屋子。

chapters.en: They saw what seemed to be tongues of fire that separated and came to rest on each of them.
chapters.zh: 又有舌头如火焰显现出来，分开落在他们各人头上。

chapters.en: All of them were filled with the Holy Spirit and began to speak in other tongues as the Spirit enabled them.
chapters.zh: 他们就都被圣灵充满，按着圣灵所赐的口才，说起别国的话来。

chapters.en: Now there were staying in Jerusalem God-fearing Jews from every nation under heaven.
chapters.zh: 那时，有虔诚的犹太人，从天下各国来，住在耶路撒冷。

chapters.en: When they heard this sound, a crowd came together in bewilderment, because each one heard their own language being spoken.
chapters.zh: 这声音一响，众人都来聚集，各人听见门徒用众人的乡谈说话，就甚纳闷。

chapters.en: Utterly amazed, they asked: “Aren’t all these who are speaking Galileans?
chapters.zh: 都惊讶希奇说，看哪，这说话的不都是加利利人吗？

chapters.en: Then how is it that each of us hears them in our native language?
chapters.zh: 我们各人，怎么听见他们说我们生来所用的乡谈呢？

chapters.en: Parthians, Medes and Elamites; residents of Mesopotamia, Judea and Cappadocia, Pontus and Asia,
chapters.zh: 我们帕提亚人，玛代人，以拦人，和住在米所波大米，犹太，加帕多家，本都，亚西亚，

chapters.en: Phrygia and Pamphylia, Egypt and the parts of Libya near Cyrene; visitors from Rome
chapters.zh: 弗吕家，旁非利亚，埃及的人，并靠近古利奈的吕彼亚一带地方的人，从罗马来的客旅中，或是犹太人，或是进犹太教的人，

chapters.en: (both Jews and converts to Judaism); Cretans and Arabs—we hear them declaring the wonders of God in our own tongues!”
chapters.zh: 革哩底和亚拉伯人，都听见他们用我们的乡谈，讲说神的大作为。

chapters.en: Amazed and perplexed, they asked one another, “What does this mean?”
chapters.zh: 众人就都惊讶猜疑，彼此说，这是什么意思呢？

chapters.en: Some, however, made fun of them and said, “They have had too much wine.”
chapters.zh: 还有人讥诮说，他们无非是新酒灌满了。

chapters.en: Then Peter stood up with the Eleven, raised his voice and addressed the crowd: “Fellow Jews and all of you who live in Jerusalem, let me explain this to you; listen carefully to what I say.
chapters.zh: 彼得和十一个使徒，站起，高声说，犹太人，和一切住在耶路撒冷的人哪，这件事你们当知道，也当侧耳听我的话。

chapters.en: These people are not drunk, as you suppose. It’s only nine in the morning!
chapters.zh: 你们想这些人是醉了，其实不是醉了，因为时候刚到巳初。

chapters.en: No, this is what was spoken by the prophet Joel:
chapters.zh: 这正是先知约珥所说的。

chapters.en: “ ‘In the last days, God says, I will pour out my Spirit on all people. Your sons and daughters will prophesy, your young men will see visions, your old men will dream dreams.
chapters.zh: 神说，在末后的日子，我要将我的灵浇灌凡有血气的。你们的儿女要说预言。你们的少年人要见异象。老年人要作异梦。

chapters.en: Even on my servants, both men and women, I will pour out my Spirit in those days, and they will prophesy.
chapters.zh: 在那些日子，我要将我的灵浇灌我的仆人和使女，他们就要说预言。

chapters.en: I will show wonders in the heavens above and signs on the earth below, blood and fire and billows of smoke.
chapters.zh: 在天上我要显出奇事，在地下我要显出神迹，有血，有火，有烟雾。

chapters.en: The sun will be turned to darkness and the moon to blood before the coming of the great and glorious day of the Lord.
chapters.zh: 日头要变为黑暗，月亮要变为血，这都在主大而明显的日子未到以前。

chapters.en: And everyone who calls on the name of the Lord will be saved.’
chapters.zh: 到那时候，凡求告主名的，就必得救。

chapters.en: “Fellow Israelites, listen to this: Jesus of Nazareth was a man accredited by God to you by miracles, wonders and signs, which God did among you through him, as you yourselves know.
chapters.zh: 以色列人哪，请听我的话。神借着拿撒勒人耶稣，在你们中间施行异能，奇事，神迹，将他证明出来，这是你们自己知道的。

chapters.en: This man was handed over to you by God’s deliberate plan and foreknowledge; and you, with the help of wicked men, put him to death by nailing him to the cross.
chapters.zh: 他既按着神的定旨先见，被交与人，你们就借着无法之人的手，把他钉在十字架上杀了。

chapters.en: But God raised him from the dead, freeing him from the agony of death, because it was impossible for death to keep its hold on him.
chapters.zh: 神却将死的痛苦解释了，叫他复活。因为他原不能被死拘禁。

chapters.en: David said about him: “ ‘I saw the Lord always before me. Because he is at my right hand, I will not be shaken.
chapters.zh: 大卫指着他说，我看见主常在我眼前，他在我右边，叫我不至于摇动。

chapters.en: Therefore my heart is glad and my tongue rejoices; my body also will rest in hope,
chapters.zh: 所以我心里欢喜，我的灵（原文作舌）快乐。并且我的肉身要安居在指望中。

chapters.en: because you will not abandon me to the realm of the dead, you will not let your holy one see decay.
chapters.zh: 因你必不将我的灵魂撇在阴间，也不叫你的圣者见朽坏。

chapters.en: You have made known to me the paths of life; you will fill me with joy in your presence.’
chapters.zh: 你已将生命的道路指示我，必叫我因见你的面，（或作叫我在你面前）得着满足的快乐。

chapters.en: “Fellow Israelites, I can tell you confidently that the patriarch David died and was buried, and his tomb is here to this day.
chapters.zh: 弟兄们，先祖大卫的事，我可以明明地对你们说，他死了，也葬埋了，并且他的坟墓，直到今日还在我们这里。

chapters.en: But he was a prophet and knew that God had promised him on oath that he would place one of his descendants on his throne.
chapters.zh: 大卫既是先知，又晓得神曾向他起誓，要从他的后裔中，立一位坐在他的宝座上。

chapters.en: Seeing what was to come, he spoke of the resurrection of the Messiah, that he was not abandoned to the realm of the dead, nor did his body see decay.
chapters.zh: 就预先看明这事，讲论基督复活说，他的灵魂，不撇在阴间，他的肉身，也不见朽坏。

chapters.en: God has raised this Jesus to life, and we are all witnesses of it.
chapters.zh: 这耶稣，神已经叫他复活了，我们都为这事作见证。

chapters.en: Exalted to the right hand of God, he has received from the Father the promised Holy Spirit and has poured out what you now see and hear.
chapters.zh: 他既被神的右手高举，（或作他既高举在神的右边）又从父受了所应许的圣灵，就把你们所看见所听见的，浇灌下来。

chapters.en: For David did not ascend to heaven, and yet he said, “ ‘The Lord said to my Lord: “Sit at my right hand
chapters.zh: 大卫并没有升到天上，但自己说，主对我主说，你坐在我的右边，

chapters.en: until I make your enemies a footstool for your feet.” ’
chapters.zh: 等我使你仇敌作你的脚凳。

chapters.en: “Therefore let all Israel be assured of this: God has made this Jesus, whom you crucified, both Lord and Messiah.”
chapters.zh: 故此，以色列全家当确实的知道，你们钉在十字架上的这位耶稣，神已经立他为主为基督了。

chapters.en: When the people heard this, they were cut to the heart and said to Peter and the other apostles, “Brothers, what shall we do?”
chapters.zh: 众人听见这话，觉得扎心，就对彼得和其余的使徒说，弟兄们，我们当怎样行。

chapters.en: Peter replied, “Repent and be baptized, every one of you, in the name of Jesus Christ for the forgiveness of your sins. And you will receive the gift of the Holy Spirit.
chapters.zh: 彼得说，你们各人要悔改，奉耶稣基督的名受洗，叫你们的罪得赦，就必领受所赐的圣灵。

chapters.en: The promise is for you and your children and for all who are far off—for all whom the Lord our God will call.”
chapters.zh: 因为这应许是给你们，和你们的儿女，并一切在远方的人，就是主我们神所召来的。

chapters.en: With many other words he warned them; and he pleaded with them, “Save yourselves from this corrupt generation.”
chapters.zh: 彼得还用许多话作见证，劝勉他们说，你们当救自己脱离这弯曲的世代。

chapters.en: Those who accepted his message were baptized, and about three thousand were added to their number that day.
chapters.zh: 于是领受他话的人，就受了洗，那一天，门徒约添了三千人。

chapters.en: They devoted themselves to the apostles’ teaching and to fellowship, to the breaking of bread and to prayer.
chapters.zh: 都恒心遵守使徒的教训，彼此交接，掰饼，祈祷。

chapters.en: Everyone was filled with awe at the many wonders and signs performed by the apostles.
chapters.zh: 众人都惧怕。使徒又行了许多奇事神迹。

chapters.en: All the believers were together and had everything in common.
chapters.zh: 信的人都在一处，凡物公用。

chapters.en: They sold property and possessions to give to anyone who had need.
chapters.zh: 并且卖了田产家业，照各人所需用的分给各人。

chapters.en: Every day they continued to meet together in the temple courts. They broke bread in their homes and ate together with glad and sincere hearts,
chapters.zh: 他们天天同心合意，恒切地在殿里且在家中掰饼，存着欢喜诚实的心用饭，

chapters.en: praising God and enjoying the favor of all the people. And the Lord added to their number daily those who were being saved.
chapters.zh: 赞美神，得众民的喜爱。主将得救的人，天天加给他们。

chapters.en: One day Peter and John were going up to the temple at the time of prayer—at three in the afternoon.
chapters.zh: 申初祷告的时候，彼得，约翰，上圣殿去。

chapters.en: Now a man who was lame from birth was being carried to the temple gate called Beautiful, where he was put every day to beg from those going into the temple courts.
chapters.zh: 有一个人，生来是瘸腿的，天天被人抬来，放在殿的一个门口，那门名叫美门，要求进殿的人周济。

chapters.en: When he saw Peter and John about to enter, he asked them for money.
chapters.zh: 他看见彼得约翰将要进殿，就求他们周济。

chapters.en: Peter looked straight at him, as did John. Then Peter said, “Look at us!”
chapters.zh: 彼得约翰定睛看他。彼得说，你看我们。

chapters.en: So the man gave them his attention, expecting to get something from them.
chapters.zh: 那人就留意看他们，指望得着什么。

chapters.en: Then Peter said, “Silver or gold I do not have, but what I do have I give you. In the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, walk.”
chapters.zh: 彼得说，金银我都没有，只把我所有的给你，我奉拿撒勒人耶稣基督的名，叫你起来行走。

chapters.en: Taking him by the right hand, he helped him up, and instantly the man’s feet and ankles became strong.
chapters.zh: 于是拉着他的右手，扶他起来，他的脚和踝子骨，立刻健壮了。

chapters.en: He jumped to his feet and began to walk. Then he went with them into the temple courts, walking and jumping, and praising God.
chapters.zh: 就跳起来，站着，又行走。同他们进了殿，走着，跳着，赞美神。

chapters.en: When all the people saw him walking and praising God,
chapters.zh: 百姓都看见他行走，赞美神。

chapters.en: they recognized him as the same man who used to sit begging at the temple gate called Beautiful, and they were filled with wonder and amazement at what had happened to him.
chapters.zh: 认得他是那素常坐在殿的美门口求周济的，就因他所遇着的事，满心希奇惊讶。

chapters.en: While the man held on to Peter and John, all the people were astonished and came running to them in the place called Solomon’s Colonnade.
chapters.zh: 那人正在称为所罗门的廊下，拉着彼得，约翰。众百姓一齐跑到他们那里，很觉希奇。

chapters.en: When Peter saw this, he said to them: “Fellow Israelites, why does this surprise you? Why do you stare at us as if by our own power or godliness we had made this man walk?
chapters.zh: 彼得看见，就对百姓说，以色列人哪，为什么把这事当作希奇呢？为什么定睛看我们，以为我们凭自己的能力和虔诚，使这人行走呢？

chapters.en: The God of Abraham, Isaac and Jacob, the God of our fathers, has glorified his servant Jesus. You handed him over to be killed, and you disowned him before Pilate, though he had decided to let him go.
chapters.zh: 亚伯拉罕，以撒，雅各的神，就是我们列祖的神，已经荣耀了他的仆人耶稣。（仆人或作儿子）你们却把他交付彼拉多。彼拉多定意要释放他，你们竟在彼拉多面前弃绝了他。

chapters.en: You disowned the Holy and Righteous One and asked that a murderer be released to you.
chapters.zh: 你们弃绝了那圣洁公义者，反求着释放一个凶手给你们。

chapters.en: You killed the author of life, but God raised him from the dead. We are witnesses of this.
chapters.zh: 你们杀了那生命的主，神却叫他从死里复活了。我们都是为这事作见证。

chapters.en: By faith in the name of Jesus, this man whom you see and know was made strong. It is Jesus’ name and the faith that comes through him that has completely healed him, as you can all see.
chapters.zh: 我们因信他的名，他的名便叫你们所看见所认识的这人，健壮了。正是他所赐的信心，叫这人在你们众人面前全然好了。

chapters.en: “Now, fellow Israelites, I know that you acted in ignorance, as did your leaders.
chapters.zh: 弟兄们，我晓得你们作这事，是出于不知，你们的官长也是如此。

chapters.en: But this is how God fulfilled what he had foretold through all the prophets, saying that his Messiah would suffer.
chapters.zh: 但神曾借众先知的口，预言基督将要受害，就这样应验了。

chapters.en: Repent, then, and turn to God, so that your sins may be wiped out, that times of refreshing may come from the Lord,
chapters.zh: 所以你们当悔改归正，使你们的罪得以涂抹，这样，那安舒的日子，就必从主面前来到。

chapters.en: and that he may send the Messiah, who has been appointed for you—even Jesus.
chapters.zh: 主也必差遣所预定给你们的基督耶稣降临。

chapters.en: Heaven must receive him until the time comes for God to restore everything, as he promised long ago through his holy prophets.
chapters.zh: 天必留他，等到万物复兴的时候，就是神从创世以来，借着圣先知的口所说的。

chapters.en: For Moses said, ‘The Lord your God will raise up for you a prophet like me from among your own people; you must listen to everything he tells you.
chapters.zh: 摩西曾说，主神要从你们弟兄中间，给你们兴起一位先知像我，凡他向你们所说的，你们都要听从。

chapters.en: Anyone who does not listen to him will be completely cut off from their people.’
chapters.zh: 凡不听从那先知的，必要从民中全然灭绝。

chapters.en: “Indeed, beginning with Samuel, all the prophets who have spoken have foretold these days.
chapters.zh: 从撒母耳以来的众先知，凡说预言的，也都说到这些日子。

chapters.en: And you are heirs of the prophets and of the covenant God made with your fathers. He said to Abraham, ‘Through your offspring all peoples on earth will be blessed.’
chapters.zh: 你们是先知的子孙，也承受神与你们祖宗所立的约，就是对亚伯拉罕说，地上万族，都要因你的后裔得福。

chapters.en: When God raised up his servant, he sent him first to you to bless you by turning each of you from your wicked ways.”
chapters.zh: 神既兴起他的仆人，（或作儿子）就先差他到你们这里来，赐福给你们，叫你们各人回转，离开罪恶。

chapters.en: The priests and the captain of the temple guard and the Sadducees came up to Peter and John while they were speaking to the people.
chapters.zh: 使徒对百姓说话的时候，祭司们和守殿官，并撒都该人，忽然来了。

chapters.en: They were greatly disturbed because the apostles were teaching the people, proclaiming in Jesus the resurrection of the dead.
chapters.zh: 因他们教训百姓，本着耶稣，传说死人复活，就很烦恼。

chapters.en: They seized Peter and John and, because it was evening, they put them in jail until the next day.
chapters.zh: 于是下手拿住他们。因为天已经晚了，就把他们押到第二天。

chapters.en: But many who heard the message believed; so the number of men who believed grew to about five thousand.
chapters.zh: 但听道之人，有许多信的，男丁数目，约到五千。

chapters.en: The next day the rulers, the elders and the teachers of the law met in Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 第二天，官府，长老，和文士，在耶路撒冷聚会。

chapters.en: Annas the high priest was there, and so were Caiaphas, John, Alexander and others of the high priest’s family.
chapters.zh: 又有大祭司亚那，和该亚法，约翰，亚力山大，并大祭司的亲族都在那里。

chapters.en: They had Peter and John brought before them and began to question them: “By what power or what name did you do this?”
chapters.zh: 叫使徒站在当中，就问他们说，你们用什么能力，奉谁的名，作这事呢？

chapters.en: Then Peter, filled with the Holy Spirit, said to them: “Rulers and elders of the people!
chapters.zh: 那时，彼得被圣灵充满，对他们说，

chapters.en: If we are being called to account today for an act of kindness shown to a man who was lame and are being asked how he was healed,
chapters.zh: 治民的官府，和长老阿，倘若今日，因为在残疾人身上所行的善事，查问我们他是怎么得了痊愈。

chapters.en: then know this, you and all the people of Israel: It is by the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, whom you crucified but whom God raised from the dead, that this man stands before you healed.
chapters.zh: 你们众人，和以色列百姓，都当知道，站在你们面前的这人得痊愈，是因你们所钉十字架，神叫他从死里复活的，拿撒勒人耶稣基督的名。

chapters.en: Jesus is “ ‘the stone you builders rejected, which has become the cornerstone.’
chapters.zh: 他是你们匠人所弃的石头，已成了房角的头块石头。

chapters.en: Salvation is found in no one else, for there is no other name under heaven given to mankind by which we must be saved.”
chapters.zh: 除他以外，别无拯救。因为在天下人间，没有赐下别的名，我们可以靠着得救。

chapters.en: When they saw the courage of Peter and John and realized that they were unschooled, ordinary men, they were astonished and they took note that these men had been with Jesus.
chapters.zh: 他们见彼得约翰的胆量，又看出他们原是没有学问的小民，就希奇，认明他们是跟过耶稣的。

chapters.en: But since they could see the man who had been healed standing there with them, there was nothing they could say.
chapters.zh: 又看见那治好了的人，和他们一同站着，就无话可驳。

chapters.en: So they ordered them to withdraw from the Sanhedrin and then conferred together.
chapters.zh: 于是吩咐他们从公会出去，就彼此商议说，

chapters.en: “What are we going to do with these men?” they asked. “Everyone living in Jerusalem knows they have performed a notable sign, and we cannot deny it.
chapters.zh: 我们当怎样办这两个人呢？因为他们诚然行了一件明显的神迹，凡住耶路撒冷的人都知道，我们也不能说没有。

chapters.en: But to stop this thing from spreading any further among the people, we must warn them to speak no longer to anyone in this name.”
chapters.zh: 惟恐这事越发传扬在民间，我们必须恐吓他们，叫他们不再奉这名对人讲论。

chapters.en: Then they called them in again and commanded them not to speak or teach at all in the name of Jesus.
chapters.zh: 于是叫了他们来，禁止他们，总不可奉耶稣的名讲论教训人。

chapters.en: But Peter and John replied, “Which is right in God’s eyes: to listen to you, or to him? You be the judges!
chapters.zh: 彼得约翰说，听从你们，不听从神，这在神面前合理不合理，你们自己酌量吧。

chapters.en: As for us, we cannot help speaking about what we have seen and heard.”
chapters.zh: 我们所看见所听见的，不能不说。

chapters.en: After further threats they let them go. They could not decide how to punish them, because all the people were praising God for what had happened.
chapters.zh: 官长为百姓的缘故，想不出法子刑罚他们，又恐吓一番，把他们释放了。这是因众人为所行的奇事，都归荣耀与神。

chapters.en: For the man who was miraculously healed was over forty years old.
chapters.zh: 原来借着神迹医好的那人，有四十多岁了。

chapters.en: On their release, Peter and John went back to their own people and reported all that the chief priests and the elders had said to them.
chapters.zh: 二人既被释放，就到会友那里去，把祭司长和长老所说的话，都告诉他们。

chapters.en: When they heard this, they raised their voices together in prayer to God. “Sovereign Lord,” they said, “you made the heavens and the earth and the sea, and everything in them.
chapters.zh: 他们听见了，就同心合意地，高声向神说，主阿，你是造天，地，海，和其中万物的。

chapters.en: You spoke by the Holy Spirit through the mouth of your servant, our father David: “ ‘Why do the nations rage and the peoples plot in vain?
chapters.zh: 你曾借着圣灵，托你仆人我们祖宗大卫的口，说，外邦为什么争闹，万民为什么谋算虚妄的事。

chapters.en: The kings of the earth rise up and the rulers band together against the Lord and against his anointed one. ’
chapters.zh: 世上的君王一齐起来，臣宰也聚集，要敌挡主，并主的受膏者。（或作基督）

chapters.en: Indeed Herod and Pontius Pilate met together with the Gentiles and the people of Israel in this city to conspire against your holy servant Jesus, whom you anointed.
chapters.zh: 希律和本丢彼拉多，外邦人和以色列民，果然在这城里聚集，要攻打你所膏的圣仆耶稣，（仆或作子）。

chapters.en: They did what your power and will had decided beforehand should happen.
chapters.zh: 成就你手和你意旨所预定必有的事。

chapters.en: Now, Lord, consider their threats and enable your servants to speak your word with great boldness.
chapters.zh: 他们恐吓我们，现在求主鉴察。一面叫你仆人大放胆量，讲你的道，一面伸出你的手来，医治疾病，并且使神迹奇事，因着你圣仆耶稣的名行出来（仆或作子）。

chapters.en: Stretch out your hand to heal and perform signs and wonders through the name of your holy servant Jesus.”
After they prayed, the place where they were meeting was shaken. And they were all filled with the Holy Spirit and spoke the word of God boldly.
chapters.zh: 祷告完了，聚会的地方震动，他们就都被圣灵充满，放胆讲论神的道。

chapters.en: All the believers were one in heart and mind. No one claimed that any of their possessions was their own, but they shared everything they had.
chapters.zh: 那许多信的人，都是一心一意的，没有一人说，他的东西有一样是自己的，都是大家公用。

chapters.en: With great power the apostles continued to testify to the resurrection of the Lord Jesus. And God’s grace was so powerfully at work in them all
chapters.zh: 使徒大有能力，见证主耶稣复活。众人也都蒙大恩。

chapters.en: that there were no needy persons among them. For from time to time those who owned land or houses sold them, brought the money from the sales
chapters.zh: 内中也没有一个缺乏的，因为人人将田产房屋都卖了，把所卖的价银拿来，放在使徒脚前。

chapters.en: and put it at the apostles’ feet, and it was distributed to anyone who had need.
chapters.zh: 照各人所需用的，分给各人。

chapters.en: Joseph, a Levite from Cyprus, whom the apostles called Barnabas (which means “son of encouragement”),
chapters.zh: 有一个利未人，生在居比路，名叫约瑟，使徒称他为巴拿巴。（巴拿巴翻出来，就是劝慰子）。

chapters.en: sold a field he owned and brought the money and put it at the apostles’ feet.
chapters.zh: 他有田地，也卖了，把价银拿来，放在使徒脚前。

chapters.en: Now a man named Ananias, together with his wife Sapphira, also sold a piece of property.
chapters.zh: 有一个人，名叫亚拿尼亚，同他的妻子撒非喇，卖了田产。

chapters.en: With his wife’s full knowledge he kept back part of the money for himself, but brought the rest and put it at the apostles’ feet.
chapters.zh: 把价银私自留下几分，他的妻子也知道，其余的几分，拿来放在使徒脚前。

chapters.en: Then Peter said, “Ananias, how is it that Satan has so filled your heart that you have lied to the Holy Spirit and have kept for yourself some of the money you received for the land?
chapters.zh: 彼得说，亚拿尼亚为什么撒但充满了你的心，叫你欺哄圣灵，把田地的价银私自留下几分呢？

chapters.en: Didn’t it belong to you before it was sold? And after it was sold, wasn’t the money at your disposal? What made you think of doing such a thing? You have not lied just to human beings but to God.”
chapters.zh: 田地还没有卖，不是你自己的吗？既卖了，价银不是你作主吗？你怎么心里起这意念呢？你不是欺哄人，是欺哄神了。

chapters.en: When Ananias heard this, he fell down and died. And great fear seized all who heard what had happened.
chapters.zh: 亚拿尼亚听见这话，就仆倒断了气。听见的人都甚惧怕。

chapters.en: Then some young men came forward, wrapped up his body, and carried him out and buried him.
chapters.zh: 有些少年人起来，把他包裹抬出去埋葬了。

chapters.en: About three hours later his wife came in, not knowing what had happened.
chapters.zh: 约过了三小时，他的妻子进来，还不知道这事。

chapters.en: Peter asked her, “Tell me, is this the price you and Ananias got for the land?” “Yes,” she said, “that is the price.”
chapters.zh: 彼得对她说，你告诉我，你们卖田地的价银，就是这些吗？她说，就是这些。

chapters.en: Peter said to her, “How could you conspire to test the Spirit of the Lord? Listen! The feet of the men who buried your husband are at the door, and they will carry you out also.”
chapters.zh: 彼得说，你们为什么同心试探主的灵呢？埋葬你丈夫之人的脚，已到门口，他们也要把你抬出去。

chapters.en: At that moment she fell down at his feet and died. Then the young men came in and, finding her dead, carried her out and buried her beside her husband.
chapters.zh: 妇人立刻仆倒在彼得脚前，断了气。那些少年人进来，见她已经死了，就抬出去，埋在她丈夫旁边。

chapters.en: Great fear seized the whole church and all who heard about these events.
chapters.zh: 全教会，和听见这事的人，都甚惧怕。

chapters.en: The apostles performed many signs and wonders among the people. And all the believers used to meet together in Solomon’s Colonnade.
chapters.zh: 主借使徒的手，在民间行了许多神迹奇事，（他们（或作信的人）都同心合意地在所罗门的廊下。

chapters.en: No one else dared join them, even though they were highly regarded by the people.
chapters.zh: 其余的人，没有一个敢贴近他们。百姓却尊重他们。

chapters.en: Nevertheless, more and more men and women believed in the Lord and were added to their number.
chapters.zh: 信而归主的人越发增添，连男带女很多）。

chapters.en: As a result, people brought the sick into the streets and laid them on beds and mats so that at least Peter’s shadow might fall on some of them as he passed by.
chapters.zh: 甚至有人将病人抬到街上，放在床上，或褥子上，指望彼得过来的时候，或者得他的影儿照在什么人身上。

chapters.en: Crowds gathered also from the towns around Jerusalem, bringing their sick and those tormented by impure spirits, and all of them were healed.
chapters.zh: 还有许多人，带着病人，和被污鬼缠磨的，从耶路撒冷四围的城邑来，全都得了医治。

chapters.en: Then the high priest and all his associates, who were members of the party of the Sadducees, were filled with jealousy.
chapters.zh: 大祭司和他的一切同人，就是撒都该教门的人，都起来，满心忌恨。

chapters.en: They arrested the apostles and put them in the public jail.
chapters.zh: 就下手拿住使徒，收在外监。

chapters.en: But during the night an angel of the Lord opened the doors of the jail and brought them out.
chapters.zh: 但主的使者，夜间开了监门，领他们出来，

chapters.en: “Go, stand in the temple courts,” he said, “and tell the people all about this new life.”
chapters.zh: 说，你们去站在殿里，把这生命的道，都讲给百姓听。

chapters.en: At daybreak they entered the temple courts, as they had been told, and began to teach the people. When the high priest and his associates arrived, they called together the Sanhedrin—the full assembly of the elders of Israel—and sent to the jail for the apostles.
chapters.zh: 使徒听了这话，天将亮的时候，就进殿里去教训人。大祭司和他的同人来了，叫齐公会的人，和以色列族的众长老，就差人到监里去，要把使徒提出来。

chapters.en: But on arriving at the jail, the officers did not find them there. So they went back and reported,
chapters.zh: 但差役到了，不见他们在监里，就回来禀报说，

chapters.en: “We found the jail securely locked, with the guards standing at the doors; but when we opened them, we found no one inside.”
chapters.zh: 我们看见监牢关得极妥当，看守的人也站在门外，及至开了门，里面一个人都不见。

chapters.en: On hearing this report, the captain of the temple guard and the chief priests were at a loss, wondering what this might lead to.
chapters.zh: 守殿官和祭司长听见这话，心里犯难，不知这事将来如何。

chapters.en: Then someone came and said, “Look! The men you put in jail are standing in the temple courts teaching the people.”
chapters.zh: 有一个人来禀报说，你们收在监里的人，现在站在殿里教训百姓。

chapters.en: At that, the captain went with his officers and brought the apostles. They did not use force, because they feared that the people would stone them.
chapters.zh: 于是守殿官和差役去带使徒来，并没有用强暴。因为怕百姓用石头打他们。

chapters.en: The apostles were brought in and made to appear before the Sanhedrin to be questioned by the high priest.
chapters.zh: 带到了，便叫使徒站在公会前，大祭司问他们说，

chapters.en: “We gave you strict orders not to teach in this name,” he said. “Yet you have filled Jerusalem with your teaching and are determined to make us guilty of this man’s blood.”
chapters.zh: 我们不是严严地禁止你们，不可奉这名教训人吗？你们倒把你们的道理充满了耶路撒冷，想要叫这人的血归到我们身上。

chapters.en: Peter and the other apostles replied: “We must obey God rather than human beings!
chapters.zh: 彼得和众使徒回答说，顺从神，不顺从人，是应当的。

chapters.en: The God of our ancestors raised Jesus from the dead—whom you killed by hanging him on a cross.
chapters.zh: 你们挂在木头上杀害的耶稣，我们祖宗的神已经叫他复活。

chapters.en: God exalted him to his own right hand as Prince and Savior that he might bring Israel to repentance and forgive their sins.
chapters.zh: 神且用右手将他高举，（或作他就是神高举在自己的右边）叫他作君王，作救主，将悔改的心，和赦罪的恩，赐给以色列人。

chapters.en: We are witnesses of these things, and so is the Holy Spirit, whom God has given to those who obey him.”
chapters.zh: 我们为这事作见证。神赐给顺从之人的圣灵，也为这事作见证。

chapters.en: When they heard this, they were furious and wanted to put them to death.
chapters.zh: 公会的人听见就极其恼怒，想要杀他们。

chapters.en: But a Pharisee named Gamaliel, a teacher of the law, who was honored by all the people, stood up in the Sanhedrin and ordered that the men be put outside for a little while.
chapters.zh: 但有一个法利赛人，名叫迦玛列，是众百姓所敬重的教法师，在公会中站起来，吩咐人把使徒暂且带到外面去。

chapters.en: Then he addressed the Sanhedrin: “Men of Israel, consider carefully what you intend to do to these men.
chapters.zh: 就对众人说，以色列人哪，论到这些人，你们应当小心怎样办理。

chapters.en: Some time ago Theudas appeared, claiming to be somebody, and about four hundred men rallied to him. He was killed, all his followers were dispersed, and it all came to nothing.
chapters.zh: 从前丢大起来，自夸为大。附从他的人约有四百。他被杀后，附从他的全都散了，归于无有。

chapters.en: After him, Judas the Galilean appeared in the days of the census and led a band of people in revolt. He too was killed, and all his followers were scattered.
chapters.zh: 此后报名上册的时候，又有加利利的犹大起来，引诱些百姓跟从他，他也灭亡，附从他的人也都四散了。

chapters.en: Therefore, in the present case I advise you: Leave these men alone! Let them go! For if their purpose or activity is of human origin, it will fail.
chapters.zh: 现在我劝你们不要管这些人，任凭他们吧，他们所谋的，所行的，若是出于人，必要败坏。

chapters.en: But if it is from God, you will not be able to stop these men; you will only find yourselves fighting against God.”
chapters.zh: 若是出于神，你们就不能败坏他们。恐怕你们倒是攻击神了。

chapters.en: His speech persuaded them. They called the apostles in and had them flogged. Then they ordered them not to speak in the name of Jesus, and let them go.
chapters.zh: 公会的人听从了他，便叫使徒来，把他们打了，又吩咐他们不可奉耶稣的名讲道，就把他们释放了。

chapters.en: The apostles left the Sanhedrin, rejoicing because they had been counted worthy of suffering disgrace for the Name.
chapters.zh: 他们离开公会，心里欢喜。因被算是配为这名受辱。

chapters.en: Day after day, in the temple courts and from house to house, they never stopped teaching and proclaiming the good news that Jesus is the Messiah.
chapters.zh: 他们就每日在殿里，在家里，不住地教训人，传耶稣是基督。

chapters.en: In those days when the number of disciples was increasing, the Hellenistic Jews among them complained against the Hebraic Jews because their widows were being overlooked in the daily distribution of food.
chapters.zh: 那时，门徒增多，有说希利尼话的犹太人，向希伯来人发怨言。因为在天天的供给上忽略了他们的寡妇。

chapters.en: So the Twelve gathered all the disciples together and said, “It would not be right for us to neglect the ministry of the word of God in order to wait on tables.
chapters.zh: 十二使徒叫众门徒来，对他们说，我们撇下神的道，去管理饭食，原是不合宜的。

chapters.en: Brothers and sisters, choose seven men from among you who are known to be full of the Spirit and wisdom. We will turn this responsibility over to them
chapters.zh: 所以弟兄们，当从你们中间选出七个有好名声，被圣灵充满，智慧充足的人，我们就派他们管理这事。

chapters.en: and will give our attention to prayer and the ministry of the word.”
chapters.zh: 但我们要专心以祈祷传道为事。

chapters.en: This proposal pleased the whole group. They chose Stephen, a man full of faith and of the Holy Spirit; also Philip, Procorus, Nicanor, Timon, Parmenas, and Nicolas from Antioch, a convert to Judaism.
chapters.zh: 大众都喜悦这话，就拣选了司提反，乃是大有信心，圣灵充满的人，又拣选腓利，伯罗哥罗，尼迦挪，提门，巴米拿，并进犹太教的安提阿人尼哥拉。

chapters.en: They presented these men to the apostles, who prayed and laid their hands on them.
chapters.zh: 叫他们站在使徒面前。使徒祷告了，就按手在他们头上。

chapters.en: So the word of God spread. The number of disciples in Jerusalem increased rapidly, and a large number of priests became obedient to the faith.
chapters.zh: 神的道兴旺起来。在耶路撒冷门徒数目加增的甚多。也有许多祭司信从了这道。

chapters.en: Now Stephen, a man full of God’s grace and power, performed great wonders and signs among the people.
chapters.zh: 司提反满得恩惠能力，在民间行了大奇事和神迹。

chapters.en: Opposition arose, however, from members of the Synagogue of the Freedmen (as it was called)—Jews of Cyrene and Alexandria as well as the provinces of Cilicia and Asia—who began to argue with Stephen.
chapters.zh: 当时有称利百地拿会堂的几个人，并有古利奈，亚力山太，基利家，亚西亚，各处会堂的几个人，都起来，和司提反辩论。

chapters.en: But they could not stand up against the wisdom the Spirit gave him as he spoke.
chapters.zh: 司提反是以智慧和圣灵说话，众人敌挡不住。

chapters.en: Then they secretly persuaded some men to say, “We have heard Stephen speak blasphemous words against Moses and against God.”
chapters.zh: 就买出人来说，我们听见他说谤渎摩西，和神的话。

chapters.en: So they stirred up the people and the elders and the teachers of the law. They seized Stephen and brought him before the Sanhedrin.
chapters.zh: 他们又耸动了百姓，长老，并文士，就忽然来捉拿他，把他带到公会去，

chapters.en: They produced false witnesses, who testified, “This fellow never stops speaking against this holy place and against the law.
chapters.zh: 设下假见证说，这个人说话，不住地糟践圣所和律法。

chapters.en: For we have heard him say that this Jesus of Nazareth will destroy this place and change the customs Moses handed down to us.”
chapters.zh: 我们曾听见他说，这拿撒勒人耶稣，要毁坏此地，也要改变摩西所交给我们的规条。

chapters.en: All who were sitting in the Sanhedrin looked intently at Stephen, and they saw that his face was like the face of an angel.
chapters.zh: 在公会里坐着的人，都定睛看他，见他的面貌，好像天使的面貌。

chapters.en: Then the high priest asked Stephen, “Are these charges true?”
chapters.zh: 大祭司就说，这些事果然有吗？

chapters.en: To this he replied: “Brothers and fathers, listen to me! The God of glory appeared to our father Abraham while he was still in Mesopotamia, before he lived in Harran.
chapters.zh: 司提反说，诸位父兄请听。当日我们的祖宗亚伯拉罕在米所波大米还未住哈兰的时候，荣耀的神向他显现，

chapters.en: ‘Leave your country and your people,’ God said, ‘and go to the land I will show you.’
chapters.zh: 对他说，你要离开本地和亲族，往我所要指示你的地方去。

chapters.en: “So he left the land of the Chaldeans and settled in Harran. After the death of his father, God sent him to this land where you are now living.
chapters.zh: 他就离开迦勒底人之地住在哈兰。他父亲死了以后，神使他从那里搬到你们现在所住之地。

chapters.en: He gave him no inheritance here, not even enough ground to set his foot on. But God promised him that he and his descendants after him would possess the land, even though at that time Abraham had no child.
chapters.zh: 在这地方神并没有给他产业，连立足之地也没有给他。但应许要将这地赐给他和他的后裔为业。那时他还没有儿子。

chapters.en: God spoke to him in this way: ‘For four hundred years your descendants will be strangers in a country not their own, and they will be enslaved and mistreated.
chapters.zh: 神说，他的后裔，必寄居外邦，那里的人，要叫他们作奴仆，苦待他们四百年。

chapters.en: But I will punish the nation they serve as slaves,’ God said, ‘and afterward they will come out of that country and worship me in this place.’
chapters.zh: 神又说，使他们作奴仆的那国，我要惩罚，以后他们要出来，在这地方事奉我。

chapters.en: Then he gave Abraham the covenant of circumcision. And Abraham became the father of Isaac and circumcised him eight days after his birth. Later Isaac became the father of Jacob, and Jacob became the father of the twelve patriarchs.
chapters.zh: 神又赐他割礼的约。于是亚伯拉罕生了以撒，第八日给他行了割礼。以撒生雅各，雅各生十二位先祖。

chapters.en: “Because the patriarchs were jealous of Joseph, they sold him as a slave into Egypt. But God was with him
chapters.zh: 先祖嫉妒约瑟，把他卖到埃及去。神却与他同在，

chapters.en: and rescued him from all his troubles. He gave Joseph wisdom and enabled him to gain the goodwill of Pharaoh king of Egypt. So Pharaoh made him ruler over Egypt and all his palace.
chapters.zh: 救他脱离一切苦难，又使他在埃及王法老面前，得恩典有智慧。法老就派他作埃及国的宰相兼管全家。

chapters.en: “Then a famine struck all Egypt and Canaan, bringing great suffering, and our ancestors could not find food.
chapters.zh: 后来埃及和迦南全地遭遇饥荒，大受艰难，我们的祖宗，就绝了粮。

chapters.en: When Jacob heard that there was grain in Egypt, he sent our forefathers on their first visit.
chapters.zh: 雅各听见在埃及有粮，就打发我们的祖宗，初次往那里去。

chapters.en: On their second visit, Joseph told his brothers who he was, and Pharaoh learned about Joseph’s family.
chapters.zh: 第二次约瑟与弟兄们相认，他的亲族也被法老知道了。

chapters.en: After this, Joseph sent for his father Jacob and his whole family, seventy-five in all.
chapters.zh: 约瑟就打发弟兄请父亲雅各，和全家七十五个人都来。

chapters.en: Then Jacob went down to Egypt, where he and our ancestors died.
chapters.zh: 于是雅各下了埃及，后来他和我们的祖宗都死在那里。

chapters.en: Their bodies were brought back to Shechem and placed in the tomb that Abraham had bought from the sons of Hamor at Shechem for a certain sum of money.
chapters.zh: 又被带到示剑，葬于亚伯拉罕在示剑用银子从哈抹子孙买来的坟墓里。

chapters.en: “As the time drew near for God to fulfill his promise to Abraham, the number of our people in Egypt had greatly increased.
chapters.zh: 及至神应许亚伯拉罕的日期将到，以色列民在埃及兴盛众多，

chapters.en: Then ‘a new king, to whom Joseph meant nothing, came to power in Egypt.’
chapters.zh: 直到有不晓得约瑟的新王兴起。

chapters.en: He dealt treacherously with our people and oppressed our ancestors by forcing them to throw out their newborn babies so that they would die.
chapters.zh: 他用诡计待我们的宗族，苦害我们的祖宗，叫他们丢弃婴孩，使婴孩不能存活。

chapters.en: “At that time Moses was born, and he was no ordinary child. For three months he was cared for by his family.
chapters.zh: 那时，摩西生下来，俊美非凡，在他父亲家里抚养了三个月。

chapters.en: When he was placed outside, Pharaoh’s daughter took him and brought him up as her own son.
chapters.zh: 他被丢弃的时候，法老的女儿拾了去，养为自己的儿子。

chapters.en: Moses was educated in all the wisdom of the Egyptians and was powerful in speech and action.
chapters.zh: 摩西学了埃及人一切的学问，说话行事，都有才能。

chapters.en: “When Moses was forty years old, he decided to visit his own people, the Israelites.
chapters.zh: 他将到四十岁，心中起意，去看望他的弟兄以色列人。

chapters.en: He saw one of them being mistreated by an Egyptian, so he went to his defense and avenged him by killing the Egyptian.
chapters.zh: 到了那里，见他们一个人受冤屈，就护庇他，为那受欺压的人报仇，打死了那埃及人。

chapters.en: Moses thought that his own people would realize that God was using him to rescue them, but they did not.
chapters.zh: 他以为弟兄必明白神是借他的手搭救他们。他们却不明白。

chapters.en: The next day Moses came upon two Israelites who were fighting. He tried to reconcile them by saying, ‘Men, you are brothers; why do you want to hurt each other?’
chapters.zh: 第二天，遇见两个以色列人争斗，就劝他们和睦，说，你们二位是弟兄，为什么彼此欺负呢？

chapters.en: “But the man who was mistreating the other pushed Moses aside and said, ‘Who made you ruler and judge over us?
chapters.zh: 那欺负邻舍的，把他推开说，谁立你作我们的首领，和审判官呢？

chapters.en: Are you thinking of killing me as you killed the Egyptian yesterday?’
chapters.zh: 难道你要杀我，像昨天杀那埃及人吗？

chapters.en: When Moses heard this, he fled to Midian, where he settled as a foreigner and had two sons.
chapters.zh: 摩西听见这话就逃走了，寄居于米甸。在那里生了两个儿子。

chapters.en: “After forty years had passed, an angel appeared to Moses in the flames of a burning bush in the desert near Mount Sinai.
chapters.zh: 过了四十年，在西乃山的旷野，有一位天使，从荆棘火焰中，向摩西显现。

chapters.en: When he saw this, he was amazed at the sight. As he went over to get a closer look, he heard the Lord say:
chapters.zh: 摩西见了那异象，便觉希奇。正进前观看的时候，有主的声音说，

chapters.en: ‘I am the God of your fathers, the God of Abraham, Isaac and Jacob.’ Moses trembled with fear and did not dare to look.
chapters.zh: 我是你列祖的神，就是亚伯拉罕的神，以撒的神，雅各的神。摩西战战兢兢，不敢观看。

chapters.en: “Then the Lord said to him, ‘Take off your sandals, for the place where you are standing is holy ground.
chapters.zh: 主对他说，把你脚上的鞋脱下来。因为你所站之地是圣地。

chapters.en: I have indeed seen the oppression of my people in Egypt. I have heard their groaning and have come down to set them free. Now come, I will send you back to Egypt.’
chapters.zh: 我的百姓在埃及所受的困苦，我实在看见了。他们悲叹的声音，我也听见了。我下来要救他们，你来，我要差你往埃及去。

chapters.en: “This is the same Moses they had rejected with the words, ‘Who made you ruler and judge?’ He was sent to be their ruler and deliverer by God himself, through the angel who appeared to him in the bush.
chapters.zh: 这摩西，就是百姓弃绝说，谁立你作我们的首领，和审判官的。神却借那在荆棘中显现之使者的手，差派他作首领，作救赎的。

chapters.en: He led them out of Egypt and performed wonders and signs in Egypt, at the Red Sea and for forty years in the wilderness.
chapters.zh: 这人领百姓出来，在埃及，在红海，在旷野，四十年间行了奇事神迹。

chapters.en: “This is the Moses who told the Israelites, ‘God will raise up for you a prophet like me from your own people.’
chapters.zh: 那曾对以色列人说，神要从你们弟兄中间，给你们兴起一位先知像我的，就是这位摩西。

chapters.en: He was in the assembly in the wilderness, with the angel who spoke to him on Mount Sinai, and with our ancestors; and he received living words to pass on to us.
chapters.zh: 这人曾在旷野会中，和西乃山上与那对他说话的天使同在，又与我们的祖宗同在，并且领受活泼的圣言传给我们。

chapters.en: “But our ancestors refused to obey him. Instead, they rejected him and in their hearts turned back to Egypt.
chapters.zh: 我们的祖宗不肯听从，反弃绝他，心里归向埃及，

chapters.en: They told Aaron, ‘Make us gods who will go before us. As for this fellow Moses who led us out of Egypt—we don’t know what has happened to him!’
chapters.zh: 对亚伦说，你且为我们造些神像，在我们前面引路。因为领我们出埃及地的那个摩西，我们不知道他遭了什么事。

chapters.en: That was the time they made an idol in the form of a calf. They brought sacrifices to it and reveled in what their own hands had made.
chapters.zh: 那时，他们造了一个牛犊，又拿祭物献给那像，欢喜自己手中的工作。

chapters.en: But God turned away from them and gave them over to the worship of the sun, moon and stars. This agrees with what is written in the book of the prophets: “ ‘Did you bring me sacrifices and offerings forty years in the wilderness, people of Israel?
chapters.zh: 神就转脸不顾，任凭他们事奉天上的日月星辰，正如先知书上所写的说，以色列家阿，你们四十年间在旷野，岂是将牺牲和祭物献给我吗？

chapters.en: You have taken up the tabernacle of Molek and the star of your god Rephan, the idols you made to worship. Therefore I will send you into exile’ beyond Babylon.
chapters.zh: 你们抬着摩洛的帐幕，和理番神的星。就是你们所造为要敬拜的像。因此，我要把你们迁到巴比伦外去。

chapters.en: “Our ancestors had the tabernacle of the covenant law with them in the wilderness. It had been made as God directed Moses, according to the pattern he had seen.
chapters.zh: 我们的祖宗在旷野，有法柜的帐幕，是神吩咐摩西叫他照所看见的样式作的。

chapters.en: After receiving the tabernacle, our ancestors under Joshua brought it with them when they took the land from the nations God drove out before them. It remained in the land until the time of David,
chapters.zh: 这帐幕，我们的祖宗相继承受，当神在他们面前赶出外邦人去的时候，他们同约书亚把帐幕搬进承受为业之地，直存到大卫的日子。

chapters.en: who enjoyed God’s favor and asked that he might provide a dwelling place for the God of Jacob.
chapters.zh: 大卫在神面前蒙恩，祈求为雅各的神预备居所。

chapters.en: But it was Solomon who built a house for him.
chapters.zh: 却是所罗门为神造成殿宇。

chapters.en: “However, the Most High does not live in houses made by human hands. As the prophet says:
chapters.zh: 其实至高者并不住人手所造的。就如先知所言，

chapters.en: “ ‘Heaven is my throne, and the earth is my footstool. What kind of house will you build for me? says the Lord. Or where will my resting place be?
chapters.zh: 主说，天是我的座位，地是我的脚凳。你们要为我造何等的殿宇？哪里是我安息的地方呢？

chapters.en: Has not my hand made all these things?’
chapters.zh: 这一切不都是我手所造的吗？

chapters.en: “You stiff-necked people! Your hearts and ears are still uncircumcised. You are just like your ancestors: You always resist the Holy Spirit!
chapters.zh: 你们这硬着颈项，心与耳未受割礼的人，常时抗拒圣灵。你们的祖宗怎样，你们也怎样。

chapters.en: Was there ever a prophet your ancestors did not persecute? They even killed those who predicted the coming of the Righteous One. And now you have betrayed and murdered him—
chapters.zh: 那一个先知，不是你们祖宗逼迫呢？他们也把预先传说那义者要来的人杀了。如今你们又把那义者卖了，杀了。

chapters.en: you who have received the law that was given through angels but have not obeyed it.”
chapters.zh: 你们受了天使所传的律法，竟不遵守。

chapters.en: When the members of the Sanhedrin heard this, they were furious and gnashed their teeth at him.
chapters.zh: 众人听见这话，就极其恼怒，向司提反咬牙切齿。

chapters.en: But Stephen, full of the Holy Spirit, looked up to heaven and saw the glory of God, and Jesus standing at the right hand of God.
chapters.zh: 但司提反被圣灵充满，定睛望天，看见神的荣耀，又看见耶稣站在神的右边。

chapters.en: “Look,” he said, “I see heaven open and the Son of Man standing at the right hand of God.”
chapters.zh: 就说，我看见天开了，人子站在神的右边。

chapters.en: At this they covered their ears and, yelling at the top of their voices, they all rushed at him,
chapters.zh: 众人大声喊叫，捂着耳朵，齐心拥上前去。

chapters.en: dragged him out of the city and began to stone him. Meanwhile, the witnesses laid their coats at the feet of a young man named Saul.
chapters.zh: 把他推到城外，用石头打他。作见证的人，把衣裳放在一个少年人名叫扫罗的脚前。

chapters.en: While they were stoning him, Stephen prayed, “Lord Jesus, receive my spirit.”
chapters.zh: 他们正用石头打的时候，司提反呼吁主说，求主耶稣接收我的灵魂。

chapters.en: Then he fell on his knees and cried out, “Lord, do not hold this sin against them.” When he had said this, he fell asleep.
chapters.zh: 又跪下大声喊着说，主阿，不要将这罪归于他们。说了这话就睡了。扫罗也喜悦他被害。

chapters.en: And Saul approved of their killing him. On that day a great persecution broke out against the church in Jerusalem, and all except the apostles were scattered throughout Judea and Samaria.
chapters.zh: 从这日起，耶路撒冷的教会，大遭逼迫。除了使徒以外，门徒都分散在犹太和撒玛利亚各处。

chapters.en: Godly men buried Stephen and mourned deeply for him.
chapters.zh: 有虔诚的人，把司提反埋葬了，为他捶胸大哭。

chapters.en: But Saul began to destroy the church. Going from house to house, he dragged off both men and women and put them in prison.
chapters.zh: 扫罗却残害教会，进各人的家，拉着男女下在监里。

chapters.en: Those who had been scattered preached the word wherever they went.
chapters.zh: 那些分散的人，往各处去传道。

chapters.en: Philip went down to a city in Samaria and proclaimed the Messiah there.
chapters.zh: 腓利下撒玛利亚城去，宣讲基督。

chapters.en: When the crowds heard Philip and saw the signs he performed, they all paid close attention to what he said.
chapters.zh: 众人听见了，又看见腓利所行的神迹，就同心合意地听从他的话。

chapters.en: For with shrieks, impure spirits came out of many, and many who were paralyzed or lame were healed.
chapters.zh: 因为有许多人被污鬼附着，那些鬼大声呼叫，从他们身上出来。还有许多瘫痪的，瘸腿的，都得了医治。

chapters.en: So there was great joy in that city.
chapters.zh: 在那城里，就大有欢喜。

chapters.en: Now for some time a man named Simon had practiced sorcery in the city and amazed all the people of Samaria. He boasted that he was someone great,
chapters.zh: 有一个人，名叫西门，向来在那城里行邪术，妄自尊大，使撒玛利亚的百姓惊奇。

chapters.en: and all the people, both high and low, gave him their attention and exclaimed, “This man is rightly called the Great Power of God.”
chapters.zh: 无论大小，都听从他，说，这人就是那称为神的大能者。

chapters.en: They followed him because he had amazed them for a long time with his sorcery.
chapters.zh: 他们听从他，因他久用邪术，使他们惊奇。

chapters.en: But when they believed Philip as he proclaimed the good news of the kingdom of God and the name of Jesus Christ, they were baptized, both men and women.
chapters.zh: 及至他们信了腓利所传神国的福音，和耶稣基督的名，连男带女就受了洗。

chapters.en: Simon himself believed and was baptized. And he followed Philip everywhere, astonished by the great signs and miracles he saw.
chapters.zh: 西门自己也信了。既受了洗，就常与腓利在一处。看见他所行的神迹和大异能，就甚惊奇。

chapters.en: When the apostles in Jerusalem heard that Samaria had accepted the word of God, they sent Peter and John to Samaria.
chapters.zh: 使徒在耶路撒冷，听见撒玛利亚人领受了神的道，就打发彼得约翰往他们那里去。

chapters.en: When they arrived, they prayed for the new believers there that they might receive the Holy Spirit,
chapters.zh: 两个人到了，就为他们祷告，要叫他们受圣灵。

chapters.en: because the Holy Spirit had not yet come on any of them; they had simply been baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus.
chapters.zh: 因为圣灵还没有降在他们一个人身上。他们只奉主耶稣的名受了洗。

chapters.en: Then Peter and John placed their hands on them, and they received the Holy Spirit.
chapters.zh: 于是使徒按手在他们头上，他们就受了圣灵。

chapters.en: When Simon saw that the Spirit was given at the laying on of the apostles’ hands, he offered them money
chapters.zh: 西门看见使徒按手，便有圣灵赐下。就拿钱给使徒，

chapters.en: and said, “Give me also this ability so that everyone on whom I lay my hands may receive the Holy Spirit.”
chapters.zh: 说，把这权柄也给我，叫我手按着谁。谁就可以受圣灵。

chapters.en: Peter answered: “May your money perish with you, because you thought you could buy the gift of God with money!
chapters.zh: 彼得说，你的银子，和你一同灭亡吧。因你想神的恩赐，是可以用钱买的。

chapters.en: You have no part or share in this ministry, because your heart is not right before God.
chapters.zh: 你在这道上，无分无关。因为在神面前，你的心不正。

chapters.en: Repent of this wickedness and pray to the Lord in the hope that he may forgive you for having such a thought in your heart.
chapters.zh: 你当懊悔你这罪恶，祈求主。或者你心里的意念可得赦免。

chapters.en: For I see that you are full of bitterness and captive to sin.”
chapters.zh: 我看出你正在苦胆之中，被罪恶捆绑。

chapters.en: Then Simon answered, “Pray to the Lord for me so that nothing you have said may happen to me.”
chapters.zh: 西门说，愿你们为我求主，叫你们所说的，没有一样临到我身上。

chapters.en: After they had further proclaimed the word of the Lord and testified about Jesus, Peter and John returned to Jerusalem, preaching the gospel in many Samaritan villages.
chapters.zh: 使徒既证明主道，而且传讲，就回耶路撒冷去，一路在撒玛利亚好些村庄传扬福音。

chapters.en: Now an angel of the Lord said to Philip, “Go south to the road—the desert road—that goes down from Jerusalem to Gaza.”
chapters.zh: 有主的一个使者对腓利说，起来，向南走，往那从耶路撒冷下迦萨的路上去。那路是旷野。

chapters.en: So he started out, and on his way he met an Ethiopian eunuch, an important official in charge of all the treasury of the Kandake (which means “queen of the Ethiopians”). This man had gone to Jerusalem to worship,
chapters.zh: 腓利就起身去了。不料，有一个埃提阿伯（即古实，见以赛亚十八章一节）人，是个有大权的太监，在埃提阿伯女王干大基的手下总管银库，他上耶路撒冷礼拜去了。

chapters.en: and on his way home was sitting in his chariot reading the Book of Isaiah the prophet.
chapters.zh: 现在回来，在车上坐着，念先知以赛亚的书。

chapters.en: The Spirit told Philip, “Go to that chariot and stay near it.”
chapters.zh: 圣灵对腓利说，你去贴近那车走。

chapters.en: Then Philip ran up to the chariot and heard the man reading Isaiah the prophet. “Do you understand what you are reading?” Philip asked.
chapters.zh: 腓利就跑到太监那里，听见他念先知以赛亚的书，便问他说，你所念的，你明白吗？

chapters.en: “How can I,” he said, “unless someone explains it to me?” So he invited Philip to come up and sit with him.
chapters.zh: 他说，没有人指教我，怎能明白呢？于是请腓利上车，与他同坐。

chapters.en: This is the passage of Scripture the eunuch was reading: “He was led like a sheep to the slaughter, and as a lamb before its shearer is silent, so he did not open his mouth.
chapters.zh: 他所念的那段经，说，他像羊被牵到宰杀之地，又像羊羔在剪毛的人手下无声，他也是这样不开口。

chapters.en: In his humiliation he was deprived of justice. Who can speak of his descendants? For his life was taken from the earth.”
chapters.zh: 他卑微的时候，人不按公义审判他。（原文作他的审判被夺去）谁能述说他的世代，因为他的生命从地上夺去。

chapters.en: The eunuch asked Philip, “Tell me, please, who is the prophet talking about, himself or someone else?”
chapters.zh: 太监对腓利说，请问先知说这话，是指着谁，是指着自己呢？是指着别人呢？

chapters.en: Then Philip began with that very passage of Scripture and told him the good news about Jesus.
chapters.zh: 腓利就开口从这经上起，对他传讲耶稣

chapters.en: As they traveled along the road, they came to some water and the eunuch said, “Look, here is water. What can stand in the way of my being baptized? ”
chapters.zh: 二人正往前走，到了有水的地方，太监说，看哪，这里有水，我受洗有什么妨碍呢？（有古卷在此有

chapters.en: [Philip said, “If you believe with all your heart, you may.” The eunuch answered, “I believe that Jesus Christ is the Son of God.”]
chapters.zh: 腓利说，你若是一心相信就可以，他回答说，我信耶稣基督是神的儿子）

chapters.en: And he gave orders to stop the chariot. Then both Philip and the eunuch went down into the water and Philip baptized him.
chapters.zh: 于是吩咐车站住，腓利和太监二人同下水里去，腓利就给他施洗。

chapters.en: When they came up out of the water, the Spirit of the Lord suddenly took Philip away, and the eunuch did not see him again, but went on his way rejoicing.
chapters.zh: 从水里上来，主的灵把腓利提了去，太监也不再见他了，就欢欢喜喜地走路。

chapters.en: Philip, however, appeared at Azotus and traveled about, preaching the gospel in all the towns until he reached Caesarea.
chapters.zh: 后来有人在亚锁都遇见腓利，他走遍那地方，在各城宣传福音，直到该撒利亚。

chapters.en: Meanwhile, Saul was still breathing out murderous threats against the Lord’s disciples. He went to the high priest
chapters.zh: 扫罗仍然向主的门徒，口吐威吓凶杀的话，去见大祭司，

chapters.en: and asked him for letters to the synagogues in Damascus, so that if he found any there who belonged to the Way, whether men or women, he might take them as prisoners to Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 求文书给大马色的各会堂，若是找着信奉这道的人，无论男女，都准他捆绑带到耶路撒冷。

chapters.en: As he neared Damascus on his journey, suddenly a light from heaven flashed around him.
chapters.zh: 扫罗行路，将到大马色，忽然从天上发光，四面照着他。

chapters.en: He fell to the ground and heard a voice say to him, “Saul, Saul, why do you persecute me?”
chapters.zh: 他就仆倒在地，听见有声音对他说，扫罗，扫罗，你为什么逼迫我。

chapters.en: “Who are you, Lord?” Saul asked. “I am Jesus, whom you are persecuting,” he replied.
chapters.zh: 他说，主阿，你是谁。主说，我就是你所逼迫的耶稣。

chapters.en: “Now get up and go into the city, and you will be told what you must do.”
chapters.zh: 起来，进城去，你所当作的事，必有人告诉你。

chapters.en: The men traveling with Saul stood there speechless; they heard the sound but did not see anyone.
chapters.zh: 同行的人，站在那里，说不出话来，听见声音，却看不见人。

chapters.en: Saul got up from the ground, but when he opened his eyes he could see nothing. So they led him by the hand into Damascus.
chapters.zh: 扫罗从地上起来，睁开眼睛，竟不能看见什么。有人拉他的手，领他进了大马色。

chapters.en: For three days he was blind, and did not eat or drink anything.
chapters.zh: 三日不能看见，也不吃，也不喝。

chapters.en: In Damascus there was a disciple named Ananias. The Lord called to him in a vision, “Ananias!”“Yes, Lord,” he answered.
chapters.zh: 当下在大马色，有一个门徒，名叫亚拿尼亚。主在异象中对他说，亚拿尼亚。他说，主，我在这里。

chapters.en: The Lord told him, “Go to the house of Judas on Straight Street and ask for a man from Tarsus named Saul, for he is praying.
chapters.zh: 主对他说，起来，往直街去，在犹大的家里，访问一个大数人名叫扫罗。他正祷告。

chapters.en: In a vision he has seen a man named Ananias come and place his hands on him to restore his sight.”
chapters.zh: 又看见了一个人，名叫亚拿尼亚，进来按手在他身上，叫他能看见。

chapters.en: “Lord,” Ananias answered, “I have heard many reports about this man and all the harm he has done to your holy people in Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 亚拿尼亚回答说，主阿，我听见许多人说，这人怎样在耶路撒冷多多苦害你的圣徒。

chapters.en: And he has come here with authority from the chief priests to arrest all who call on your name.”
chapters.zh: 并且他在这里有从祭司长得来的权柄捆绑一切求告你名的人。

chapters.en: But the Lord said to Ananias, “Go! This man is my chosen instrument to proclaim my name to the Gentiles and their kings and to the people of Israel.
chapters.zh: 主对亚拿尼亚说，你只管去。他是我所拣选的器皿，要在外邦人和君王并以色列人面前，宣扬我的名。

chapters.en: I will show him how much he must suffer for my name.”
chapters.zh: 我也要指示他，为我的名必须受许多的苦难。

chapters.en: Then Ananias went to the house and entered it. Placing his hands on Saul, he said, “Brother Saul, the Lord—Jesus, who appeared to you on the road as you were coming here—has sent me so that you may see again and be filled with the Holy Spirit.”
chapters.zh: 亚拿尼亚就去了，进入那家，把手按在扫罗身上说，兄弟扫罗，在你来的路上，向你显现的主，就是耶稣，打发我来，叫你能看见，又被圣灵充满。

chapters.en: Immediately, something like scales fell from Saul’s eyes, and he could see again. He got up and was baptized,
chapters.zh: 扫罗的眼睛上，好像有鳞立刻掉下来，他就能看见，于是起来受了洗。

chapters.en: and after taking some food, he regained his strength. Saul spent several days with the disciples in Damascus.
chapters.zh: 吃过饭就健壮了。扫罗和大马色的门徒同住了些日子。

chapters.en: At once he began to preach in the synagogues that Jesus is the Son of God.
chapters.zh: 就在各会堂里宣传耶稣，说他是神的儿子。

chapters.en: All those who heard him were astonished and asked, “Isn’t he the man who raised havoc in Jerusalem among those who call on this name? And hasn’t he come here to take them as prisoners to the chief priests?”
chapters.zh: 凡听见的人，都惊奇说，在耶路撒冷残害求告这名的，不是这人吗？并且他到这里来，特要捆绑他们带到祭司长那里。

chapters.en: Yet Saul grew more and more powerful and baffled the Jews living in Damascus by proving that Jesus is the Messiah.
chapters.zh: 但扫罗越发有能力，驳倒住大马色的犹太人，证明耶稣是基督。

chapters.en: After many days had gone by, there was a conspiracy among the Jews to kill him,
chapters.zh: 过了好些日子，犹太人商议要杀扫罗。

chapters.en: but Saul learned of their plan. Day and night they kept close watch on the city gates in order to kill him.
chapters.zh: 但他们的计谋，被扫罗知道了。他们又昼夜在城门守候要杀他。

chapters.en: But his followers took him by night and lowered him in a basket through an opening in the wall.
chapters.zh: 他的门徒就在夜间，用筐子把他从城墙上缒下去。

chapters.en: When he came to Jerusalem, he tried to join the disciples, but they were all afraid of him, not believing that he really was a disciple.
chapters.zh: 扫罗到了耶路撒冷，想与门徒结交。他们却都怕他，不信他是门徒。

chapters.en: But Barnabas took him and brought him to the apostles. He told them how Saul on his journey had seen the Lord and that the Lord had spoken to him, and how in Damascus he had preached fearlessly in the name of Jesus.
chapters.zh: 惟有巴拿巴接待他，领去见使徒，把他在路上怎么看见主，主怎么向他说话，他在大马色，怎么奉耶稣的名放胆传道，都述说出来。

chapters.en: So Saul stayed with them and moved about freely in Jerusalem, speaking boldly in the name of the Lord.
chapters.zh: 于是扫罗在耶路撒冷，和门徒出入来往，

chapters.en: He talked and debated with the Hellenistic Jews, but they tried to kill him.
chapters.zh: 奉主的名，放胆传道。并与说希利尼话的犹太人，讲论辩驳。他们却想法子要杀他。

chapters.en: When the believers learned of this, they took him down to Caesarea and sent him off to Tarsus.
chapters.zh: 弟兄们知道了，就送他下该撒利亚，打发他往大数去。

chapters.en: Then the church throughout Judea, Galilee and Samaria enjoyed a time of peace and was strengthened. Living in the fear of the Lord and encouraged by the Holy Spirit, it increased in numbers.
chapters.zh: 那时犹太，加利利，撒玛利亚，各处的教会都得平安，被建立。凡事敬畏主，蒙圣灵的安慰，人数就增多了。

chapters.en: As Peter traveled about the country, he went to visit the Lord’s people who lived in Lydda.
chapters.zh: 彼得周流四方的时候，也到了居住吕大的圣徒那里。

chapters.en: There he found a man named Aeneas, who was paralyzed and had been bedridden for eight years.
chapters.zh: 遇见一个人，名叫以尼雅，得了瘫痪，在褥子上躺卧八年。

chapters.en: “Aeneas,” Peter said to him, “Jesus Christ heals you. Get up and roll up your mat.” Immediately Aeneas got up.
chapters.zh: 彼得对他说，以尼雅，耶稣基督医好你了。起来收拾你的褥子。他就立刻起来了。

chapters.en: All those who lived in Lydda and Sharon saw him and turned to the Lord.
chapters.zh: 凡住吕大和沙仑的人都看见了他，就归服主。

chapters.en: In Joppa there was a disciple named Tabitha (in Greek her name is Dorcas); she was always doing good and helping the poor.
chapters.zh: 在约帕有一个女徒，名叫大比大，翻希利尼话，就是多加。（多加就是羚羊的意思）她广行善事，多施周济。

chapters.en: About that time she became sick and died, and her body was washed and placed in an upstairs room.
chapters.zh: 当时，她患病而死。有人把她洗了。停在楼上。

chapters.en: Lydda was near Joppa; so when the disciples heard that Peter was in Lydda, they sent two men to him and urged him, “Please come at once!”
chapters.zh: 吕大原与约帕相近。门徒听见彼得在那里，就打发两个人去见他，央求他说，快到我们那里去，不要耽延。

chapters.en: Peter went with them, and when he arrived he was taken upstairs to the room. All the widows stood around him, crying and showing him the robes and other clothing that Dorcas had made while she was still with them.
chapters.zh: 彼得就起身和他们同去。到了，便有人领他上楼。众寡妇都站在彼得旁边哭，拿多加与她们同在时，所做的里衣外衣给他看。

chapters.en: Peter sent them all out of the room; then he got down on his knees and prayed. Turning toward the dead woman, he said, “Tabitha, get up.” She opened her eyes, and seeing Peter she sat up.
chapters.zh: 彼得叫她们都出去，就跪下祷告，转身对着死人说，大比大，起来，她就睁开眼睛，见了彼得，便坐起来。

chapters.en: He took her by the hand and helped her to her feet. Then he called for the believers, especially the widows, and presented her to them alive.
chapters.zh: 彼得伸手扶她起来，叫众圣徒和寡妇进去，把多加活活地交给他们。

chapters.en: This became known all over Joppa, and many people believed in the Lord.
chapters.zh: 这事传遍了约帕，就有许多人信了主。

chapters.en: Peter stayed in Joppa for some time with a tanner named Simon.
chapters.zh: 此后彼得在约帕一个硝皮匠西门的家里，住了多日。

chapters.en: At Caesarea there was a man named Cornelius, a centurion in what was known as the Italian Regiment.
chapters.zh: 在该撒利亚有一个人，名叫哥尼流，是义大利营的百夫长。
