chapters.en: He and all his family were devout and God-fearing; he gave generously to those in need and prayed to God regularly.
chapters.zh: 他是个虔诚人，他和全家都敬畏神，多多周济百姓，常常祷告神。

chapters.en: One day at about three in the afternoon he had a vision. He distinctly saw an angel of God, who came to him and said, “Cornelius!”
chapters.zh: 有一天，约在申初，他在异象中，明明看见神的一个使者进去，到他那里，说，哥尼流。

chapters.en: Cornelius stared at him in fear. “What is it, Lord?” he asked. The angel answered, “Your prayers and gifts to the poor have come up as a memorial offering before God.
chapters.zh: 哥尼流定睛看他，惊怕说，主阿，什么事呢？天使说，你的祷告，和你的周济，达到神面前已蒙记念了。

chapters.en: Now send men to Joppa to bring back a man named Simon who is called Peter.
chapters.zh: 现在你当打发人往约帕去，请那称呼彼得的西门来。

chapters.en: He is staying with Simon the tanner, whose house is by the sea.”
chapters.zh: 他住在海边一个硝皮匠西门的家里。房子在海边上。

chapters.en: When the angel who spoke to him had gone, Cornelius called two of his servants and a devout soldier who was one of his attendants.
chapters.zh: 向他说话的天使去后，哥尼流叫了两个家人，和常伺候他的一个虔诚兵来。

chapters.en: He told them everything that had happened and sent them to Joppa.
chapters.zh: 把这事都述说给他们听，就打发他们往约帕去。

chapters.en: About noon the following day as they were on their journey and approaching the city, Peter went up on the roof to pray.
chapters.zh: 第二天，他们行路将近那城，彼得约在午正，上房顶去祷告。

chapters.en: He became hungry and wanted something to eat, and while the meal was being prepared, he fell into a trance.
chapters.zh: 觉得饿了，想要吃。那家的人正预备饭的时候，彼得魂游象外。

chapters.en: He saw heaven opened and something like a large sheet being let down to earth by its four corners.
chapters.zh: 看见天开了，有一物降下，好像一块大布。系着四角，缒在地上。

chapters.en: It contained all kinds of four-footed animals, as well as reptiles and birds.
chapters.zh: 里面有地上各样四足的走兽，和昆虫，并天上的飞鸟。

chapters.en: Then a voice told him, “Get up, Peter. Kill and eat.”
chapters.zh: 又有声音向他说，彼得起来，宰了吃。

chapters.en: “Surely not, Lord!” Peter replied. “I have never eaten anything impure or unclean.”
chapters.zh: 彼得却说，主阿，这是不可的，凡俗物，和不洁净的物，我从来没有吃过。

chapters.en: The voice spoke to him a second time, “Do not call anything impure that God has made clean.”
chapters.zh: 第二次有声音向他说，神所洁净的，你不可当作俗物。

chapters.en: This happened three times, and immediately the sheet was taken back to heaven.
chapters.zh: 这样一连三次，那物随即收回天上去了。

chapters.en: While Peter was wondering about the meaning of the vision, the men sent by Cornelius found out where Simon’s house was and stopped at the gate.
chapters.zh: 彼得心里正在猜疑之间，不知所看见的异象是什么意思，哥尼流所差来的人，已经访问到西门的家，站在门外，

chapters.en: They called out, asking if Simon who was known as Peter was staying there.
chapters.zh: 喊着问，有称呼彼得的西门住在这里没有。

chapters.en: While Peter was still thinking about the vision, the Spirit said to him, “Simon, three men are looking for you.
chapters.zh: 彼得还思想那异象的时候，圣灵向他说，有三个人来找你。

chapters.en: So get up and go downstairs. Do not hesitate to go with them, for I have sent them.”
chapters.zh: 起来，下去，和他们同往，不要疑惑。因为是我差他们来的。

chapters.en: Peter went down and said to the men, “I’m the one you’re looking for. Why have you come?”
chapters.zh: 于是彼得下去见那些人，说，我就是你们所找的人。你们来是为什么缘故。

chapters.en: The men replied, “We have come from Cornelius the centurion. He is a righteous and God-fearing man, who is respected by all the Jewish people. A holy angel told him to ask you to come to his house so that he could hear what you have to say.”
chapters.zh: 他们说，百夫长哥尼流是个义人，敬畏神，为犹太通国所称赞，他蒙一位圣天使指示，叫他请你到他家里去，听你的话。

chapters.en: Then Peter invited the men into the house to be his guests. The next day Peter started out with them, and some of the believers from Joppa went along.
chapters.zh: 彼得就请他们进去，住了一宿。次日起身和他们同去，还有约帕的几个弟兄同着他去。

chapters.en: The following day he arrived in Caesarea. Cornelius was expecting them and had called together his relatives and close friends.
chapters.zh: 又次日，他们进入该撒利亚。哥尼流已经请了他的亲属密友，等候他们。

chapters.en: As Peter entered the house, Cornelius met him and fell at his feet in reverence.
chapters.zh: 彼得一进去，哥尼流就迎接他，俯伏在他脚前拜他。

chapters.en: But Peter made him get up. “Stand up,” he said, “I am only a man myself.”
chapters.zh: 彼得却拉他说，你起来，我也是人。

chapters.en: While talking with him, Peter went inside and found a large gathering of people.
chapters.zh: 彼得和他说着话进去，见有好些人在那里聚集，

chapters.en: He said to them: “You are well aware that it is against our law for a Jew to associate with or visit a Gentile. But God has shown me that I should not call anyone impure or unclean.
chapters.zh: 就对他们说，你们知道犹太人，和别国的人亲近来往，本是不合例的。但神已经指示我，无论什么人，都不可看作俗而不洁净的。

chapters.en: So when I was sent for, I came without raising any objection. May I ask why you sent for me?”
chapters.zh: 所以我被请的时候，就不推辞而来。现在请问，你们叫我来有什么意思呢？

chapters.en: Cornelius answered: “Three days ago I was in my house praying at this hour, at three in the afternoon. Suddenly a man in shining clothes stood before me
chapters.zh: 哥尼流说，前四天这个时候，我在家中守着申初的祷告，忽然有一个人，穿着光明的衣裳，站在我面前，

chapters.en: and said, ‘Cornelius, God has heard your prayer and remembered your gifts to the poor.
chapters.zh: 说，哥尼流，你的祷告，已蒙垂听，你的周济，达到神面前已蒙记念了。

chapters.en: Send to Joppa for Simon who is called Peter. He is a guest in the home of Simon the tanner, who lives by the sea.’
chapters.zh: 你当打发人往约帕去，请那称呼彼得的西门来，他住在海边一个硝皮匠西门的家里。

chapters.en: So I sent for you immediately, and it was good of you to come. Now we are all here in the presence of God to listen to everything the Lord has commanded you to tell us.”
chapters.zh: 所以我立时打发人去请你，你来了很好。现今我们都在神面前，要听主所吩咐你的一切话。

chapters.en: Then Peter began to speak: “I now realize how true it is that God does not show favoritism
chapters.zh: 彼得就开口说，我真看出神是不偏待人。

chapters.en: but accepts from every nation the one who fears him and does what is right.
chapters.zh: 原来各国中，那敬畏主行义的人，都为主所悦纳。

chapters.en: You know the message God sent to the people of Israel, announcing the good news of peace through Jesus Christ, who is Lord of all.
chapters.zh: 神借着耶稣基督（他是万有的主）传和平的福音，将这道赐给以色列人。

chapters.en: You know what has happened throughout the province of Judea, beginning in Galilee after the baptism that John preached—
chapters.zh: 这话在约翰宣传洗礼以后，从加利利起，传遍了犹太。

chapters.en: how God anointed Jesus of Nazareth with the Holy Spirit and power, and how he went around doing good and healing all who were under the power of the devil, because God was with him.
chapters.zh: 神怎样以圣灵和能力，膏拿撒勒人耶稣，这都是你们知道的。他周流四方行善事，医好凡被魔鬼压制的人。因为神与他同在。

chapters.en: “We are witnesses of everything he did in the country of the Jews and in Jerusalem. They killed him by hanging him on a cross,
chapters.zh: 他在犹太人之地，并耶路撒冷，所行的一切事，有我们作见证。他们竟把他挂在木头上杀了。

chapters.en: but God raised him from the dead on the third day and caused him to be seen.
chapters.zh: 第三日神叫他复活，显现出来，

chapters.en: He was not seen by all the people, but by witnesses whom God had already chosen—by us who ate and drank with him after he rose from the dead.
chapters.zh: 不是显现给众人看，乃是显现给神预先所拣选为他作见证的人看，就是我们这些在他从死里复活以后，和他同吃同喝的人。

chapters.en: He commanded us to preach to the people and to testify that he is the one whom God appointed as judge of the living and the dead.
chapters.zh: 他吩咐我们传道给众人，证明他是神所立定的，要作审判活人死人的主。

chapters.en: All the prophets testify about him that everyone who believes in him receives forgiveness of sins through his name.”
chapters.zh: 众先知也为他作见证，说，凡信他的人，必因他的名，得蒙赦罪。

chapters.en: While Peter was still speaking these words, the Holy Spirit came on all who heard the message.
chapters.zh: 彼得还说这话的时候，圣灵降在一切听道的人身上。

chapters.en: The circumcised believers who had come with Peter were astonished that the gift of the Holy Spirit had been poured out even on Gentiles.
chapters.zh: 那些奉割礼和彼得同来的信徒，见圣灵的恩赐也浇在外邦人身上，就都希奇。

chapters.en: For they heard them speaking in tongues and praising God. Then Peter said,
chapters.zh: 因听见他们说方言，称赞神为大。

chapters.en: “Surely no one can stand in the way of their being baptized with water. They have received the Holy Spirit just as we have.”
chapters.zh: 于是彼得说，这些人既受了圣灵，与我们一样，谁能禁止用水给他们施洗呢？

chapters.en: So he ordered that they be baptized in the name of Jesus Christ. Then they asked Peter to stay with them for a few days.
chapters.zh: 就吩咐奉耶稣基督的名给他们施洗。他们又请彼得住了几天。

chapters.en: The apostles and the believers throughout Judea heard that the Gentiles also had received the word of God.
chapters.zh: 使徒和在犹太的众弟兄，听说外邦人也领受了神的道。

chapters.en: So when Peter went up to Jerusalem, the circumcised believers criticized him
chapters.zh: 及至彼得上了耶路撒冷，那些奉割礼的门徒和他争辩说，

chapters.en: and said, “You went into the house of uncircumcised men and ate with them.”
chapters.zh: 你进入未受割礼之人的家，和他们一同吃饭了。

chapters.en: Starting from the beginning, Peter told them the whole story:
chapters.zh: 彼得就开口，把这事挨次给他们讲解说，

chapters.en: “I was in the city of Joppa praying, and in a trance I saw a vision. I saw something like a large sheet being let down from heaven by its four corners, and it came down to where I was.
chapters.zh: 我在约帕城里祷告的时候，魂游象外，看见异象，有一物降下，好像一块大布，系着四角，从天缒下，直来到我跟前。

chapters.en: I looked into it and saw four-footed animals of the earth, wild beasts, reptiles and birds.
chapters.zh: 我定睛观看，见内中有地上四足的牲畜，和野兽，昆虫，并天上的飞鸟。

chapters.en: Then I heard a voice telling me, ‘Get up, Peter. Kill and eat.’
chapters.zh: 我且听见有声音向我说，彼得，起来，宰了吃。

chapters.en: “I replied, ‘Surely not, Lord! Nothing impure or unclean has ever entered my mouth.’
chapters.zh: 我说，主阿，这是不可的。凡俗而不洁净的物，从来没有入过我的口。

chapters.en: “The voice spoke from heaven a second time, ‘Do not call anything impure that God has made clean.’
chapters.zh: 第二次，有声音从天上说，神所洁净的，你不可当作俗物。

chapters.en: This happened three times, and then it was all pulled up to heaven again.
chapters.zh: 这样一连三次，就都收回天上去了。

chapters.en: “Right then three men who had been sent to me from Caesarea stopped at the house where I was staying.
chapters.zh: 正当那时，有三个人站在我们所住的房门前，是从该撒利亚差来见我的。

chapters.en: The Spirit told me to have no hesitation about going with them. These six brothers also went with me, and we entered the man’s house.
chapters.zh: 圣灵吩咐我和他们同去，不要疑惑。（或作不要分别等类）同着我去的，还有这六位弟兄。我们都进了那人的家。

chapters.en: He told us how he had seen an angel appear in his house and say, ‘Send to Joppa for Simon who is called Peter.
chapters.zh: 那人就告诉我们，他如何看见一位天使，站在他屋里，说，你打发人往约帕去，请那称呼彼得的西门来。

chapters.en: He will bring you a message through which you and all your household will be saved.’
chapters.zh: 他有话告诉你，可以叫你和你的全家得救。

chapters.en: “As I began to speak, the Holy Spirit came on them as he had come on us at the beginning.
chapters.zh: 我一开讲，圣灵便降在他们身上，正像当初降在我们身上一样。

chapters.en: Then I remembered what the Lord had said: ‘John baptized with water, but you will be baptized with the Holy Spirit.’
chapters.zh: 我就想起主的话说，约翰是用水施洗，但你们要受圣灵的洗。

chapters.en: So if God gave them the same gift he gave us who believed in the Lord Jesus Christ, who was I to think that I could stand in God’s way?”
chapters.zh: 神既然给他们恩赐，像在我们信主耶稣基督的时候，给了我们一样，我是谁，能拦阻神呢？

chapters.en: When they heard this, they had no further objections and praised God, saying, “So then, even to Gentiles God has granted repentance that leads to life.”
chapters.zh: 众人听见这话，就不言语了。只归荣耀与神，说，这样看来，神也赐恩给外邦人，叫他们悔改得生命了。

chapters.en: Now those who had been scattered by the persecution that broke out when Stephen was killed traveled as far as Phoenicia, Cyprus and Antioch, spreading the word only among Jews.
chapters.zh: 那些因司提反的事遭患难四散的门徒，直走到腓尼基，和居比路，并安提阿。他们不向别人讲道，只向犹太人讲。

chapters.en: Some of them, however, men from Cyprus and Cyrene, went to Antioch and began to speak to Greeks also, telling them the good news about the Lord Jesus.
chapters.zh: 但内中有居比路，和古利奈人，他们到了安提阿，也向希利尼人传讲主耶稣。（有古卷作也向说希利尼话的犹太人传讲主耶稣）

chapters.en: The Lord’s hand was with them, and a great number of people believed and turned to the Lord.
chapters.zh: 主与他们同在，信而归主的人就很多了。

chapters.en: News of this reached the church in Jerusalem, and they sent Barnabas to Antioch.
chapters.zh: 这风声传到耶路撒冷教会人的耳中，他们就打发巴拿巴出去，走到安提阿为止。

chapters.en: When he arrived and saw what the grace of God had done, he was glad and encouraged them all to remain true to the Lord with all their hearts.
chapters.zh: 他到了那里，看见神所赐的恩，就欢喜，劝勉众人，立定心志，恒久靠主。

chapters.en: He was a good man, full of the Holy Spirit and faith, and a great number of people were brought to the Lord.
chapters.zh: 这巴拿巴原是个好人，被圣灵充满，大有信心。于是有许多人归服了主。

chapters.en: Then Barnabas went to Tarsus to look for Saul,
chapters.zh: 他又往大数去找扫罗，

chapters.en: and when he found him, he brought him to Antioch. So for a whole year Barnabas and Saul met with the church and taught great numbers of people. The disciples were called Christians first at Antioch.
chapters.zh: 找着了，就带他到安提阿去。他们足有一年的工夫，和教会一同聚集，教训了许多人。门徒称为基督徒，是从安提阿起首。

chapters.en: During this time some prophets came down from Jerusalem to Antioch.
chapters.zh: 当那些日子，有几位先知从耶路撒冷下到安提阿。

chapters.en: One of them, named Agabus, stood up and through the Spirit predicted that a severe famine would spread over the entire Roman world. (This happened during the reign of Claudius.)
chapters.zh: 内中有一位，名叫亚迦布站起来，借着圣灵，指明天下将有大饥荒。这事到革老丢年间果然有了。

chapters.en: The disciples, as each one was able, decided to provide help for the brothers and sisters living in Judea.
chapters.zh: 于是门徒定意，照各人的力量捐钱，送去供给住在犹太的弟兄。

chapters.en: This they did, sending their gift to the elders by Barnabas and Saul.
chapters.zh: 他们就这样行，把捐项托巴拿巴和扫罗，送到众长老那里。

chapters.en: It was about this time that King Herod arrested some who belonged to the church, intending to persecute them.
chapters.zh: 那时，希律王下手苦害教会中几个人。

chapters.en: He had James, the brother of John, put to death with the sword.
chapters.zh: 用刀杀了约翰的哥哥雅各。

chapters.en: When he saw that this met with approval among the Jews, he proceeded to seize Peter also. This happened during the Festival of Unleavened Bread.
chapters.zh: 他见犹太人喜欢这事，又去捉拿彼得。那时正是除酵的日子。

chapters.en: After arresting him, he put him in prison, handing him over to be guarded by four squads of four soldiers each. Herod intended to bring him out for public trial after the Passover.
chapters.zh: 希律拿了彼得收在监里，交付四班兵丁看守，每班四个人，意思要在逾越节后，把他提出来，当着百姓办他。

chapters.en: So Peter was kept in prison, but the church was earnestly praying to God for him.
chapters.zh: 于是彼得被囚在监里。教会却为他切切地祷告神。

chapters.en: The night before Herod was to bring him to trial, Peter was sleeping between two soldiers, bound with two chains, and sentries stood guard at the entrance.
chapters.zh: 希律将要提他出来的前一夜，彼得被两条铁链锁着，睡在两个兵丁当中。看守的人也在门外看守。

chapters.en: Suddenly an angel of the Lord appeared and a light shone in the cell. He struck Peter on the side and woke him up. “Quick, get up!” he said, and the chains fell off Peter’s wrists.
chapters.zh: 忽然有主的一个使者，站在旁边，屋里有光照耀。天使拍彼得的肋旁，拍醒了他，说，快快起来。那铁链就从他手上脱落下来。

chapters.en: Then the angel said to him, “Put on your clothes and sandals.” And Peter did so. “Wrap your cloak around you and follow me,” the angel told him.
chapters.zh: 天使对他说，束上带子。穿上鞋。他就那样作。天使又说，披上外衣跟着我来。

chapters.en: Peter followed him out of the prison, but he had no idea that what the angel was doing was really happening; he thought he was seeing a vision.
chapters.zh: 彼得就出来跟着他，不知道天使所作是真的，只当见了异象。

chapters.en: They passed the first and second guards and came to the iron gate leading to the city. It opened for them by itself, and they went through it. When they had walked the length of one street, suddenly the angel left him.
chapters.zh: 过了第一层，第二层监牢，就来到临街的铁门。那门自己开了。他们出来，走过一条街，天使便离开他去了。

chapters.en: Then Peter came to himself and said, “Now I know without a doubt that the Lord has sent his angel and rescued me from Herod’s clutches and from everything the Jewish people were hoping would happen.”
chapters.zh: 彼得醒悟过来，说，我现在真知道主差遣他的使者，救我脱离希律的手，和犹太百姓一切所盼望的。

chapters.en: When this had dawned on him, he went to the house of Mary the mother of John, also called Mark, where many people had gathered and were praying.
chapters.zh: 想了一想，就往那称呼马可的约翰他母亲马利亚家去。在那里有好些人聚集祷告。

chapters.en: Peter knocked at the outer entrance, and a servant named Rhoda came to answer the door.
chapters.zh: 彼得敲外门，有一个使女，名叫罗大出来探听。

chapters.en: When she recognized Peter’s voice, she was so overjoyed she ran back without opening it and exclaimed, “Peter is at the door!”
chapters.zh: 听得是彼得的声音，就欢喜得顾不得开门，跑进去告诉众人说，彼得站在门外。

chapters.en: “You’re out of your mind,” they told her. When she kept insisting that it was so, they said, “It must be his angel.”
chapters.zh: 他们说，你是疯了。使女极力地说，真是他。他们说，必是他的天使。

chapters.en: But Peter kept on knocking, and when they opened the door and saw him, they were astonished.
chapters.zh: 彼得不住地敲门。他们开了门，看见他，就甚惊奇。

chapters.en: Peter motioned with his hand for them to be quiet and described how the Lord had brought him out of prison. “Tell James and the other brothers and sisters about this,” he said, and then he left for another place.
chapters.zh: 彼得摆手，不要他们作声，就告诉他们主怎样领他出监。又说，你们把这事告诉雅各，和众弟兄。于是出去往别处去了。

chapters.en: In the morning, there was no small commotion among the soldiers as to what had become of Peter.
chapters.zh: 到了天亮，兵丁扰乱得很，不知道彼得往哪里去了。

chapters.en: After Herod had a thorough search made for him and did not find him, he cross-examined the guards and ordered that they be executed. Then Herod went from Judea to Caesarea and stayed there.
chapters.zh: 希律找他，找不着，就审问看守的人，吩咐把他们拉去杀了。后来希律离开犹太，下该撒利亚去，住在那里。

chapters.en: He had been quarreling with the people of Tyre and Sidon; they now joined together and sought an audience with him. After securing the support of Blastus, a trusted personal servant of the king, they asked for peace, because they depended on the king’s country for their food supply.
chapters.zh: 希律恼怒推罗西顿的人。他们那一带地方，是从王的地土得粮，因此就托了王的内侍臣伯拉斯都的情，一心来求和。

chapters.en: On the appointed day Herod, wearing his royal robes, sat on his throne and delivered a public address to the people.
chapters.zh: 希律在所定的日子，穿上朝服，坐在位上，对他们讲论一番。

chapters.en: They shouted, “This is the voice of a god, not of a man.”
chapters.zh: 百姓喊着说，这是神的声音，不是人的声音。

chapters.en: Immediately, because Herod did not give praise to God, an angel of the Lord struck him down, and he was eaten by worms and died.
chapters.zh: 希律不归荣耀给神，所以主的使者立刻罚他。他被虫所咬，气就绝了。

chapters.en: But the word of God continued to spread and flourish.
chapters.zh: 神的道日见兴旺，越发广传。

chapters.en: When Barnabas and Saul had finished their mission, they returned from Jerusalem, taking with them John, also called Mark.
chapters.zh: 巴拿巴和扫罗，办完了他们供给的事，就从耶路撒冷回来，带着称呼马可的约翰同去。

chapters.en: Now in the church at Antioch there were prophets and teachers: Barnabas, Simeon called Niger, Lucius of Cyrene, Manaen (who had been brought up with Herod the tetrarch) and Saul.
chapters.zh: 在安提阿的教会中，有几位先知和教师，就是巴拿巴，和称呼尼结的西面，古利奈人路求，与分封之王希律同养的马念，并扫罗。

chapters.en: While they were worshiping the Lord and fasting, the Holy Spirit said, “Set apart for me Barnabas and Saul for the work to which I have called them.”
chapters.zh: 他们事奉主，禁食的时候，圣灵说，要为我分派巴拿巴和扫罗，去作我召他们所作的工。

chapters.en: So after they had fasted and prayed, they placed their hands on them and sent them off.
chapters.zh: 于是禁食祷告，按手在他们头上，就打发他们去了。

chapters.en: The two of them, sent on their way by the Holy Spirit, went down to Seleucia and sailed from there to Cyprus.
chapters.zh: 他们既被圣灵差遣，就下到西流基，从那里坐船往居比路去。

chapters.en: When they arrived at Salamis, they proclaimed the word of God in the Jewish synagogues. John was with them as their helper.
chapters.zh: 到了撒拉米，就在犹太人各会堂里传讲神的道。也有约翰作他们的帮手。

chapters.en: They traveled through the whole island until they came to Paphos. There they met a Jewish sorcerer and false prophet named Bar-Jesus,
chapters.zh: 经过全岛，直到帕弗，在那里遇见一个有法术假充先知的犹太人，名叫巴耶稣。

chapters.en: who was an attendant of the proconsul, Sergius Paulus. The proconsul, an intelligent man, sent for Barnabas and Saul because he wanted to hear the word of God.
chapters.zh: 这人常和方伯士求保罗同在，士求保罗是个通达人。他请了巴拿巴和扫罗来，要听神的道。

chapters.en: But Elymas the sorcerer (for that is what his name means) opposed them and tried to turn the proconsul from the faith.
chapters.zh: 只是那行法术的以吕马，（这名翻出来就是行法术的意思）敌挡使徒，要叫方伯不信真道。

chapters.en: Then Saul, who was also called Paul, filled with the Holy Spirit, looked straight at Elymas and said,
chapters.zh: 扫罗又名保罗，被圣灵充满定睛看他，

chapters.en: “You are a child of the devil and an enemy of everything that is right! You are full of all kinds of deceit and trickery. Will you never stop perverting the right ways of the Lord?
chapters.zh: 说，你这充满各样诡诈奸恶，魔鬼的儿子，众善的仇敌，你混乱主的正道还不止住吗？

chapters.en: Now the hand of the Lord is against you. You are going to be blind for a time, not even able to see the light of the sun.” Immediately mist and darkness came over him, and he groped about, seeking someone to lead him by the hand.
chapters.zh: 现在主的手加在你身上。你要瞎眼，暂且不见日光。他的眼睛立刻昏蒙黑暗，四下里求人拉着手领他。

chapters.en: When the proconsul saw what had happened, he believed, for he was amazed at the teaching about the Lord.
chapters.zh: 方伯看见所作的事，很希奇主的道，就信了。

chapters.en: From Paphos, Paul and his companions sailed to Perga in Pamphylia, where John left them to return to Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 保罗和他的同人，从帕弗开船，来到旁非利亚的别加。约翰就离开他们回耶路撒冷去。

chapters.en: From Perga they went on to Pisidian Antioch. On the Sabbath they entered the synagogue and sat down.
chapters.zh: 他们离了别加往前行，来到彼西底的安提阿。在安息日进会堂坐下。

chapters.en: After the reading from the Law and the Prophets, the leaders of the synagogue sent word to them, saying, “Brothers, if you have a word of exhortation for the people, please speak.”
chapters.zh: 读完了律法和先知的书，管会堂的叫人过去，对他们说，二位兄台，若有什么劝勉众人的话，请说。

chapters.en: Standing up, Paul motioned with his hand and said: “Fellow Israelites and you Gentiles who worship God, listen to me!
chapters.zh: 保罗就站起来，举手说，以色列人，和一切敬畏神的人，请听。

chapters.en: The God of the people of Israel chose our ancestors; he made the people prosper during their stay in Egypt; with mighty power he led them out of that country;
chapters.zh: 这以色列民的神，拣选了我们的祖宗，当民寄居埃及的时候，抬举他们，用大能的手领他们出来。

chapters.en: for about forty years he endured their conduct in the wilderness;
chapters.zh: 又在旷野容忍他们约有四十年。（容忍或作抚养）

chapters.en: and he overthrew seven nations in Canaan, giving their land to his people as their inheritance.
chapters.zh: 既灭了迦南地七族的人，就把那地分给他们为业。

chapters.en: All this took about 450 years. “After this, God gave them judges until the time of Samuel the prophet.
chapters.zh: 此后，给他们设立士师，约有四百五十年，直到先知撒母耳的时候。

chapters.en: Then the people asked for a king, and he gave them Saul son of Kish, of the tribe of Benjamin, who ruled forty years.
chapters.zh: 后来他们求一个王，神就将便雅悯支派中，基士的儿子扫罗，给他们作王四十年。

chapters.en: After removing Saul, he made David their king. God testified concerning him: ‘I have found David son of Jesse, a man after my own heart; he will do everything I want him to do.’
chapters.zh: 既废了扫罗，就选立大卫作他们的王。又为他作见证说，我寻得耶西的儿子大卫，他是合我心意的人，凡事要遵行我的旨意。

chapters.en: “From this man’s descendants God has brought to Israel the Savior Jesus, as he promised.
chapters.zh: 从这人的后裔中，神已经照着所应许的，为以色列人立了一位救主，就是耶稣。

chapters.en: Before the coming of Jesus, John preached repentance and baptism to all the people of Israel.
chapters.zh: 在他没有出来以先，约翰向以色列众民宣讲悔改的洗礼。

chapters.en: As John was completing his work, he said: ‘Who do you suppose I am? I am not the one you are looking for. But there is one coming after me whose sandals I am not worthy to untie.’
chapters.zh: 约翰将行尽他的程途说，你们以为我是谁？我不是基督。只是有一位在我以后来的，我解他脚上的鞋带，也是不配的。

chapters.en: “Fellow children of Abraham and you God-fearing Gentiles, it is to us that this message of salvation has been sent.
chapters.zh: 弟兄们，亚伯拉罕的子孙，和你们中间敬畏神的人哪，这救世的道，是传给我们的。

chapters.en: The people of Jerusalem and their rulers did not recognize Jesus, yet in condemning him they fulfilled the words of the prophets that are read every Sabbath.
chapters.zh: 耶路撒冷居住的人，和他们的官长，因为不认识基督，也不明白每安息日所读众先知的书，就把基督定了死罪，正应了先知的预言。

chapters.en: Though they found no proper ground for a death sentence, they asked Pilate to have him executed.
chapters.zh: 虽然查不出他有当死的罪来，还是求彼拉多杀他。

chapters.en: When they had carried out all that was written about him, they took him down from the cross and laid him in a tomb.
chapters.zh: 既成就了经上指着他所记的一切话，就把他从木头上取下来，放在坟墓里。

chapters.en: But God raised him from the dead,
chapters.zh: 神却叫他从死里复活。

chapters.en: and for many days he was seen by those who had traveled with him from Galilee to Jerusalem. They are now his witnesses to our people.
chapters.zh: 那从加利利同他上耶路撒冷的人多日看见他，这些人如今在民间是他的见证。

chapters.en: “We tell you the good news: What God promised our ancestors
chapters.zh: 我们也报好信息给你们，就是那应许祖宗的话，

chapters.en: he has fulfilled for us, their children, by raising up Jesus. As it is written in the second Psalm: “ ‘You are my son; today I have become your father.’
chapters.zh: 神已经向我们这作儿女的应验，叫耶稣复活了。正如诗篇第二篇上记着说，你是我的儿子，我今日生你。

chapters.en: God raised him from the dead so that he will never be subject to decay. As God has said, “ ‘I will give you the holy and sure blessings promised to David.’
chapters.zh: 论到神叫他从死里复活，不再归于朽坏，就这样说，我必将所应许大卫那圣洁可靠的恩典，赐给你们。

chapters.en: So it is also stated elsewhere: “ ‘You will not let your holy one see decay.’
chapters.zh: 又有一篇上说，你必不叫你的圣者见朽坏。

chapters.en: “Now when David had served God’s purpose in his own generation, he fell asleep; he was buried with his ancestors and his body decayed.
chapters.zh: 大卫在世的时候，遵行了神的旨意，就睡了，（或作大卫按神的旨意服事了他那一世的人就睡了）。归到他祖宗那里，已见朽坏。

chapters.en: But the one whom God raised from the dead did not see decay.
chapters.zh: 惟独神所复活的，他并未见朽坏。

chapters.en: “Therefore, my friends, I want you to know that through Jesus the forgiveness of sins is proclaimed to you.
chapters.zh: 所以弟兄们，你们当晓得，赦罪的道是由这人传给你们的。

chapters.en: Through him everyone who believes is set free from every sin, a justification you were not able to obtain under the law of Moses.
chapters.zh: 你们靠摩西的律法，在一切不得称义的事上，信靠这人，就都得称义了。

chapters.en: Take care that what the prophets have said does not happen to you:
chapters.zh: 所以你们务要小心，免得先知书上所说的临到你们。

chapters.en: “ ‘Look, you scoffers, wonder and perish, for I am going to do something in your days that you would never believe, even if someone told you.’ ”
chapters.zh: 主说，你们这轻慢的人要观看，要惊奇，要灭亡。因为在你们的时候，我行一件事，虽有人告诉你们，你们总是不信。

chapters.en: As Paul and Barnabas were leaving the synagogue, the people invited them to speak further about these things on the next Sabbath.
chapters.zh: 他们出会堂的时候，众人请他们到下安息日，再讲这话给他们听。

chapters.en: When the congregation was dismissed, many of the Jews and devout converts to Judaism followed Paul and Barnabas, who talked with them and urged them to continue in the grace of God.
chapters.zh: 散会以后，犹太人和敬虔进犹太教的人，多有跟从保罗，巴拿巴的，二人对他们讲道，劝他们务要恒久在神的恩中。

chapters.en: On the next Sabbath almost the whole city gathered to hear the word of the Lord.
chapters.zh: 到下安息日，合城的人，几乎都来聚集，要听神的道。

chapters.en: When the Jews saw the crowds, they were filled with jealousy. They began to contradict what Paul was saying and heaped abuse on him.
chapters.zh: 但犹太人看见人这样多，就满心嫉妒，硬驳保罗所说的话，并且毁谤。

chapters.en: Then Paul and Barnabas answered them boldly: “We had to speak the word of God to you first. Since you reject it and do not consider yourselves worthy of eternal life, we now turn to the Gentiles.
chapters.zh: 保罗和巴拿巴放胆说，神的道先讲给你们，原是应当的，只因你们弃绝这道，断定自己不配得永生，我们就转向外邦人去。

chapters.en: For this is what the Lord has commanded us: “ ‘I have made you a light for the Gentiles, that you may bring salvation to the ends of the earth.’ ”
chapters.zh: 因为主曾这样吩咐我们说，我已经立你作外邦人的光，叫你施行救恩直到地极。

chapters.en: When the Gentiles heard this, they were glad and honored the word of the Lord; and all who were appointed for eternal life believed.
chapters.zh: 外邦人听见这话，就欢喜了，赞美神的道，凡预定得永生的人都信了。

chapters.en: The word of the Lord spread through the whole region.
chapters.zh: 于是主的道，传遍了那一带地方。

chapters.en: But the Jewish leaders incited the God-fearing women of high standing and the leading men of the city. They stirred up persecution against Paul and Barnabas, and expelled them from their region.
chapters.zh: 但犹太人挑唆虔敬尊贵的妇女，和城内有名望的人，逼迫保罗，巴拿巴，将他们赶出境外。

chapters.en: So they shook the dust off their feet as a warning to them and went to Iconium.
chapters.zh: 二人对着众人跺下脚上的尘土，就往以哥念去了。

chapters.en: And the disciples were filled with joy and with the Holy Spirit.
chapters.zh: 门徒满心喜乐，又被圣灵充满。

chapters.en: At Iconium Paul and Barnabas went as usual into the Jewish synagogue. There they spoke so effectively that a great number of Jews and Greeks believed.
chapters.zh: 二人在以哥念同进犹太人的会堂，在那里讲的叫犹太人，和希利尼人，信的很多。

chapters.en: But the Jews who refused to believe stirred up the other Gentiles and poisoned their minds against the brothers.
chapters.zh: 但那不顺从的犹太人耸动外邦人，叫他们心里恼恨弟兄。

chapters.en: So Paul and Barnabas spent considerable time there, speaking boldly for the Lord, who confirmed the message of his grace by enabling them to perform signs and wonders.
chapters.zh: 二人在那里住了多日，倚靠主放胆讲道。主借他们的手，施行神迹奇事，证明他的恩道。

chapters.en: The people of the city were divided; some sided with the Jews, others with the apostles.
chapters.zh: 城里的众人就分了党。有附从犹太人的，有附从使徒的。

chapters.en: There was a plot afoot among both Gentiles and Jews, together with their leaders, to mistreat them and stone them.
chapters.zh: 那时，外邦人和犹太人，并他们的官长，一齐拥上来，要凌辱使徒，用石头打他们。

chapters.en: But they found out about it and fled to the Lycaonian cities of Lystra and Derbe and to the surrounding country,
chapters.zh: 使徒知道了，就逃往吕高尼的路司得，特庇，两个城，和周围地方去。

chapters.en: where they continued to preach the gospel.
chapters.zh: 在那里传福音。

chapters.en: In Lystra there sat a man who was lame. He had been that way from birth and had never walked.
chapters.zh: 路司得城里，坐着一个两脚无力的人，生来是瘸腿的，从来没有走过。

chapters.en: He listened to Paul as he was speaking. Paul looked directly at him, saw that he had faith to be healed
chapters.zh: 他听保罗讲道。保罗定睛看他，见他有信心，可得痊愈，

chapters.en: and called out, “Stand up on your feet!” At that, the man jumped up and began to walk.
chapters.zh: 就大声说，你起来，两脚站直。那人就跳起来而且行走。

chapters.en: When the crowd saw what Paul had done, they shouted in the Lycaonian language, “The gods have come down to us in human form!”
chapters.zh: 众人看见保罗所作的事，就用吕高尼的话，大声说，有神借着人形，降临在我们中间了。

chapters.en: Barnabas they called Zeus, and Paul they called Hermes because he was the chief speaker.
chapters.zh: 于是称巴拿巴为丢斯，称保罗为希耳米，因为他说话领首。

chapters.en: The priest of Zeus, whose temple was just outside the city, brought bulls and wreaths to the city gates because he and the crowd wanted to offer sacrifices to them.
chapters.zh: 有城外丢斯庙的祭司，牵着牛，拿着花圈，来到门前，要同众人向使徒献祭。

chapters.en: But when the apostles Barnabas and Paul heard of this, they tore their clothes and rushed out into the crowd, shouting:
chapters.zh: 巴拿巴，保罗，二使徒听见，就撕开衣裳，跳进众人中间，喊着说，

chapters.en: “Friends, why are you doing this? We too are only human, like you. We are bringing you good news, telling you to turn from these worthless things to the living God, who made the heavens and the earth and the sea and everything in them.
chapters.zh: 诸君，为什么作这事呢？我们也是人，性情和你们一样。我们传福音给你们，是叫你们离弃这些虚妄，归向那创造天，地，海，和其中万物的永生神。

chapters.en: In the past, he let all nations go their own way.
chapters.zh: 他在从前的世代，任凭万国各行其道。

chapters.en: Yet he has not left himself without testimony: He has shown kindness by giving you rain from heaven and crops in their seasons; he provides you with plenty of food and fills your hearts with joy.”
chapters.zh: 然而为自己未尝不显出证据来，就如常施恩惠，从天降雨，赏赐丰年，叫你们饮食饱足，满心喜乐。

chapters.en: Even with these words, they had difficulty keeping the crowd from sacrificing to them.
chapters.zh: 二人说了这些话，仅仅地拦住众人不献祭与他们。

chapters.en: Then some Jews came from Antioch and Iconium and won the crowd over. They stoned Paul and dragged him outside the city, thinking he was dead.
chapters.zh: 但有些犹太人，从安提阿和以哥念来，挑唆众人，就用石头打保罗，以为他是死了，便拖到城外。

chapters.en: But after the disciples had gathered around him, he got up and went back into the city. The next day he and Barnabas left for Derbe.
chapters.zh: 门徒正围着他，他就起来，走进城去。第二天，同巴拿巴往特庇去，

chapters.en: They preached the gospel in that city and won a large number of disciples. Then they returned to Lystra, Iconium and Antioch,
chapters.zh: 对那城里的人传了福音，使好些人作门徒。就回路司得，以哥念，安提阿去，

chapters.en: strengthening the disciples and encouraging them to remain true to the faith. “We must go through many hardships to enter the kingdom of God,” they said.
chapters.zh: 坚固门徒的心，劝他们恒守所信的道。又说，我们进入神的国，必须经历许多艰难。

chapters.en: Paul and Barnabas appointed elders for them in each church and, with prayer and fasting, committed them to the Lord, in whom they had put their trust.
chapters.zh: 二人在各教会中选立了长老，又禁食祷告，就把他们交托所信的主。

chapters.en: After going through Pisidia, they came into Pamphylia,
chapters.zh: 二人经过彼西底，来到旁非利亚。

chapters.en: and when they had preached the word in Perga, they went down to Attalia.
chapters.zh: 在别加讲了道，就下亚大利去。

chapters.en: From Attalia they sailed back to Antioch, where they had been committed to the grace of God for the work they had now completed.
chapters.zh: 从那里坐船，往安提阿去。当初他们被众人所托蒙神之恩，要办现在所作之工，就是在这地方。

chapters.en: On arriving there, they gathered the church together and reported all that God had done through them and how he had opened a door of faith to the Gentiles.
chapters.zh: 到了那里，聚集了会众，就述说神借他们所行的一切事，并神怎样为外邦人开了信道的门。

chapters.en: And they stayed there a long time with the disciples.
chapters.zh: 二人就在那里同门徒住了多日。

chapters.en: Certain people came down from Judea to Antioch and were teaching the believers: “Unless you are circumcised, according to the custom taught by Moses, you cannot be saved.”
chapters.zh: 有几个人，从犹太下来，教训弟兄们说，你们若不按摩西的规条受割礼，不能得救。

chapters.en: This brought Paul and Barnabas into sharp dispute and debate with them. So Paul and Barnabas were appointed, along with some other believers, to go up to Jerusalem to see the apostles and elders about this question.
chapters.zh: 保罗巴拿巴与他们大大地分争辩论，众门徒就定规，叫保罗，巴拿巴和本会中几个人，为所辩论的，上耶路撒冷去，见使徒和长老。

chapters.en: The church sent them on their way, and as they traveled through Phoenicia and Samaria, they told how the Gentiles had been converted. This news made all the believers very glad.
chapters.zh: 于是教会送他们起行，他们经过腓尼基，撒玛利亚，随处传说外邦人归主的事，叫众弟兄都甚欢喜。

chapters.en: When they came to Jerusalem, they were welcomed by the church and the apostles and elders, to whom they reported everything God had done through them.
chapters.zh: 到了耶路撒冷，教会和使徒并长老，都接待他们，他们就述说神同他们所行的一切事。

chapters.en: Then some of the believers who belonged to the party of the Pharisees stood up and said, “The Gentiles must be circumcised and required to keep the law of Moses.”
chapters.zh: 惟有几个信徒是法利赛教门的人，起来说，必须给外邦人行割礼，吩咐他们遵守摩西的律法。

chapters.en: The apostles and elders met to consider this question.
chapters.zh: 使徒和长老，聚会商议这事。

chapters.en: After much discussion, Peter got up and addressed them: “Brothers, you know that some time ago God made a choice among you that the Gentiles might hear from my lips the message of the gospel and believe.
chapters.zh: 辩论已经多了，彼得就起来，说，诸位弟兄，你们知道神早已在你们中间拣选了我，叫外邦人从我口中得听福音之道，而且相信。

chapters.en: God, who knows the heart, showed that he accepted them by giving the Holy Spirit to them, just as he did to us.
chapters.zh: 知道人心的神，也为他们作了见证。赐圣灵给他们，正如给我们一样。

chapters.en: He did not discriminate between us and them, for he purified their hearts by faith.
chapters.zh: 又借着信，洁净了他们的心，并不分他们我们。

chapters.en: Now then, why do you try to test God by putting on the necks of Gentiles a yoke that neither we nor our ancestors have been able to bear?
chapters.zh: 现在为什么试探神，要把我们祖宗和我们所不能负的轭，放在门徒的颈项上呢？

chapters.en: No! We believe it is through the grace of our Lord Jesus that we are saved, just as they are.”
chapters.zh: 我们得救，乃是因主耶稣的恩，和他们一样，这是我们所信的。

chapters.en: The whole assembly became silent as they listened to Barnabas and Paul telling about the signs and wonders God had done among the Gentiles through them.
chapters.zh: 众人都默默无声，听巴拿巴和保罗，述说神借他们在外邦人中所行的神迹奇事。

chapters.en: When they finished, James spoke up. “Brothers,” he said, “listen to me.
chapters.zh: 他们住了声，雅各就说，诸位弟兄，请听我的话。

chapters.en: Simon has described to us how God first intervened to choose a people for his name from the Gentiles.
chapters.zh: 方才西门述说神当初怎样眷顾外邦人，从他们中间选取百姓归于自己的名下

chapters.en: The words of the prophets are in agreement with this, as it is written:
chapters.zh: 众先知的话，也与这意思相合。

chapters.en: “ ‘After this I will return and rebuild David’s fallen tent. Its ruins I will rebuild, and I will restore it,
chapters.zh: 正如经上所写的，此后我要回来，重新修造大卫倒塌的帐幕，把那破坏的，重新修造建立起来。

chapters.en: that the rest of mankind may seek the Lord, even all the Gentiles who bear my name, says the Lord, who does these things’ —
chapters.zh: 叫余剩的人，就是凡称为我名下的外邦人，都寻求主。

chapters.en: things known from long ago.
chapters.zh: 这话是从创世以来，显明这事的主说的。

chapters.en: “It is my judgment, therefore, that we should not make it difficult for the Gentiles who are turning to God.
chapters.zh: 所以据我的意见，不可难为那归服神的外邦人。

chapters.en: Instead we should write to them, telling them to abstain from food polluted by idols, from sexual immorality, from the meat of strangled animals and from blood.
chapters.zh: 只要写信，吩咐他们禁戒偶像的污秽和奸淫，并勒死的牲畜，和血。

chapters.en: For the law of Moses has been preached in every city from the earliest times and is read in the synagogues on every Sabbath.”
chapters.zh: 因为从古以来，摩西的书在各城有人传讲，每逢安息日，在会堂里诵读。

chapters.en: Then the apostles and elders, with the whole church, decided to choose some of their own men and send them to Antioch with Paul and Barnabas. They chose Judas (called Barsabbas) and Silas, men who were leaders among the believers.
chapters.zh: 那时，使徒和长老并全教会，定意从他们中间拣选人，差他们和保罗，巴拿巴，同往安提阿去。所拣选的，就是称呼巴撒巴的犹大，和西拉，这两个人在弟兄中是作首领的。

chapters.en: With them they sent the following letter: The apostles and elders, your brothers, To the Gentile believers in Antioch, Syria and Cilicia: Greetings.
chapters.zh: 于是写信交付他们，内中说，使徒和作长老的弟兄们，问安提阿，叙利亚，基利家外邦众弟兄的安。

chapters.en: We have heard that some went out from us without our authorization and disturbed you, troubling your minds by what they said.
chapters.zh: 我们听说有几个人，从我们这里出去，用言语搅扰你们，惑乱你们的心。（有古卷在此有你们必须受割礼守摩西的律法）。其实我们并没有吩咐他们。

chapters.en: So we all agreed to choose some men and send them to you with our dear friends Barnabas and Paul—
chapters.zh: 所以我们同心定意，拣选几个人，差他们同我们所亲爱的巴拿巴，和保罗，往你们那里去。

chapters.en: men who have risked their lives for the name of our Lord Jesus Christ.
chapters.zh: 这二人是为我主耶稣基督的名，不顾性命的。

chapters.en: Therefore we are sending Judas and Silas to confirm by word of mouth what we are writing.
chapters.zh: 我们就差了犹大和西拉，他们也要亲口诉说这些事。

chapters.en: It seemed good to the Holy Spirit and to us not to burden you with anything beyond the following requirements:
chapters.zh: 因为圣灵和我们，定意不将别的重担放在你们身上。惟有几件事是不可少的，

chapters.en: You are to abstain from food sacrificed to idols, from blood, from the meat of strangled animals and from sexual immorality. You will do well to avoid these things. FAREWELL.
chapters.zh: 就是禁戒祭偶像的物，和血，并勒死的牲畜，和奸淫。这几件你们若能自己禁戒不犯，就好了。愿你们平安。

chapters.en: So the men were sent off and went down to Antioch, where they gathered the church together and delivered the letter.
chapters.zh: 他们既奉了差遣，就下安提阿去，聚集众人，交付书信。

chapters.en: The people read it and were glad for its encouraging message.
chapters.zh: 众人念了，因为信上安慰的话，就欢喜了。

chapters.en: Judas and Silas, who themselves were prophets, said much to encourage and strengthen the believers.
chapters.zh: 犹大和西拉也是先知，就用许多话劝勉弟兄，坚固他们。

chapters.en: After spending some time there, they were sent off by the believers with the blessing of peace to return to those who had sent them.
chapters.zh: 住了些日子，弟兄们打发他们平平安安地回到差遣他们的人那里去。（有古卷在此有

chapters.en: but Silas decided to remain there.
chapters.zh: 惟有西拉定意仍住在那里。）

chapters.en: But Paul and Barnabas remained in Antioch, where they and many others taught and preached the word of the Lord.
chapters.zh: 但保罗和巴拿巴，仍住在安提阿，和许多别人一同教训人，传主的道。

chapters.en: Some time later Paul said to Barnabas, “Let us go back and visit the believers in all the towns where we preached the word of the Lord and see how they are doing.”
chapters.zh: 过了些日子，保罗对巴拿巴说，我们可以回到从前宣传主道的各城，看望弟兄们景况如何。

chapters.en: Barnabas wanted to take John, also called Mark, with them,
chapters.zh: 巴拿巴有意，要带称呼马可的约翰同去。

chapters.en: but Paul did not think it wise to take him, because he had deserted them in Pamphylia and had not continued with them in the work.
chapters.zh: 但保罗，因为马可从前在旁非利亚离开他们，不和他们同去作工，就以为不可带他去。

chapters.en: They had such a sharp disagreement that they parted company. Barnabas took Mark and sailed for Cyprus,
chapters.zh: 于是二人起了争论，甚至彼此分开。巴拿巴带着马可，坐船往居比路去。

chapters.en: but Paul chose Silas and left, commended by the believers to the grace of the Lord.
chapters.zh: 保罗拣选了西拉，也出去，蒙弟兄们把他交于主的恩中。

chapters.en: He went through Syria and Cilicia, strengthening the churches.
chapters.zh: 他就走遍叙利亚，基利家，坚固众教会。

chapters.en: Paul came to Derbe and then to Lystra, where a disciple named Timothy lived, whose mother was Jewish and a believer but whose father was a Greek.
chapters.zh: 保罗来到特庇，又到路司得。在那里有一个门徒，名叫提摩太，是信主之犹太妇人的儿子，他父亲却是希利尼人。

chapters.en: The believers at Lystra and Iconium spoke well of him.
chapters.zh: 路司得和以哥念的弟兄，都称赞他。

chapters.en: Paul wanted to take him along on the journey, so he circumcised him because of the Jews who lived in that area, for they all knew that his father was a Greek.
chapters.zh: 保罗要带他同去，只因那些地方的犹太人，都知道他父亲是希利尼人，就给他行了割礼。

chapters.en: As they traveled from town to town, they delivered the decisions reached by the apostles and elders in Jerusalem for the people to obey.
chapters.zh: 他们经过各城，把耶路撒冷使徒和长老所定的条规，交给门徒遵守。

chapters.en: So the churches were strengthened in the faith and grew daily in numbers.
chapters.zh: 于是众教会信心越发坚固，人数天天加增。

chapters.en: Paul and his companions traveled throughout the region of Phrygia and Galatia, having been kept by the Holy Spirit from preaching the word in the province of Asia.
chapters.zh: 圣灵既然禁止他们在亚西亚讲道，他们就经过弗吕家，加拉太一带地方。

chapters.en: When they came to the border of Mysia, they tried to enter Bithynia, but the Spirit of Jesus would not allow them to.
chapters.zh: 到了每西亚的边界，他们想要往庇推尼去，耶稣的灵却不许。

chapters.en: So they passed by Mysia and went down to Troas.
chapters.zh: 他们就越过每西亚，下到特罗亚去。

chapters.en: During the night Paul had a vision of a man of Macedonia standing and begging him, “Come over to Macedonia and help us.”
chapters.zh: 在夜间有异象现与保罗。有一个马其顿人，站着求他说，请你过到马其顿来帮助我们。

chapters.en: After Paul had seen the vision, we got ready at once to leave for Macedonia, concluding that God had called us to preach the gospel to them.
chapters.zh: 保罗既看见这异象，我们随即想要往马其顿去，以为神召我们传福音给那里的人听。

chapters.en: From Troas we put out to sea and sailed straight for Samothrace, and the next day we went on to Neapolis.
chapters.zh: 于是从特罗亚开船，一直行到撒摩特喇，第二天到了尼亚波利。

chapters.en: From there we traveled to Philippi, a Roman colony and the leading city of that district of Macedonia. And we stayed there several days.
chapters.zh: 从那里来到腓立比，就是马其顿这一方的头一个城。也是罗马的驻防城。我们在这城里住了几天。

chapters.en: On the Sabbath we went outside the city gate to the river, where we expected to find a place of prayer. We sat down and began to speak to the women who had gathered there.
chapters.zh: 当安息日，我们出城门，到了河边，知道那里有一个祷告的地方，我们就坐下对那聚会的妇女讲道。

chapters.en: One of those listening was a woman from the city of Thyatira named Lydia, a dealer in purple cloth. She was a worshiper of God. The Lord opened her heart to respond to Paul’s message.
chapters.zh: 有一个卖紫色布疋的妇人，名叫吕底亚，是推雅推喇城的人，素来敬拜神。她听见了，主就开导她的心，叫她留心听保罗所讲的话。

chapters.en: When she and the members of her household were baptized, she invited us to her home. “If you consider me a believer in the Lord,” she said, “come and stay at my house.” And she persuaded us.
chapters.zh: 她和她一家，既领了洗，便求我们说，你们若以为我是真信主的，（或作你们若以为我是忠心事主的）请到我家里来住。于是强留我们。

chapters.en: Once when we were going to the place of prayer, we were met by a female slave who had a spirit by which she predicted the future. She earned a great deal of money for her owners by fortune-telling.
chapters.zh: 后来，我们往那祷告的地方去。有一个使女迎着面来，她被巫鬼所附，用法术，叫她主人们大得财利。

chapters.en: She followed Paul and the rest of us, shouting, “These men are servants of the Most High God, who are telling you the way to be saved.”
chapters.zh: 她跟随保罗和我们，喊着说，这些人是至高神的仆人，对你们传说救人的道。

chapters.en: She kept this up for many days. Finally Paul became so annoyed that he turned around and said to the spirit, “In the name of Jesus Christ I command you to come out of her!” At that moment the spirit left her.
chapters.zh: 她一连多日这样喊叫，保罗就心中厌烦，转身对那鬼说，我奉耶稣基督的名，吩咐你从她身上出来。那鬼当时就出来了。

chapters.en: When her owners realized that their hope of making money was gone, they seized Paul and Silas and dragged them into the marketplace to face the authorities.
chapters.zh: 使女的主人们，见得利的指望没有了，便揪住保罗和西拉，拉他们到市上去见首领。

chapters.en: They brought them before the magistrates and said, “These men are Jews, and are throwing our city into an uproar
chapters.zh: 又带到官长面前说，这些人原是犹太人，竟骚扰我们的城，

chapters.en: by advocating customs unlawful for us Romans to accept or practice.”
chapters.zh: 传我们罗马人所不可受，不可行的规矩。

chapters.en: The crowd joined in the attack against Paul and Silas, and the magistrates ordered them to be stripped and beaten with rods.
chapters.zh: 众人就一同起来攻击他们。官长吩咐剥了他们的衣裳，用棍打。

chapters.en: After they had been severely flogged, they were thrown into prison, and the jailer was commanded to guard them carefully.
chapters.zh: 打了许多棍，便将他们下在监里，嘱咐禁卒严紧看守。

chapters.en: When he received these orders, he put them in the inner cell and fastened their feet in the stocks.
chapters.zh: 禁卒领了这样的命，就把他们下在内监里，两脚上了木狗。

chapters.en: About midnight Paul and Silas were praying and singing hymns to God, and the other prisoners were listening to them.
chapters.zh: 约在半夜，保罗和西拉，祷告唱诗赞美神，众囚犯也侧耳而听。

chapters.en: Suddenly there was such a violent earthquake that the foundations of the prison were shaken. At once all the prison doors flew open, and everyone’s chains came loose.
chapters.zh: 忽然地大震动，甚至监牢的地基都摇动了。监门立刻全开，众囚犯的锁链也都松开了。

chapters.en: The jailer woke up, and when he saw the prison doors open, he drew his sword and was about to kill himself because he thought the prisoners had escaped.
chapters.zh: 禁卒一醒，看见监门全开，以为囚犯已经逃走，就拔刀要自杀。

chapters.en: But Paul shouted, “Don’t harm yourself! We are all here!”
chapters.zh: 保罗大声呼叫说，不要伤害自己，我们都在这里。

chapters.en: The jailer called for lights, rushed in and fell trembling before Paul and Silas.
chapters.zh: 禁卒叫人拿灯来，就跳进去，战战兢兢地俯伏在保罗西拉面前。

chapters.en: He then brought them out and asked, “Sirs, what must I do to be saved?”
chapters.zh: 又领他们出来说，二位先生，我当怎样行才可以得救？

chapters.en: They replied, “Believe in the Lord Jesus, and you will be saved—you and your household.”
chapters.zh: 他们说，当信主耶稣，你和你一家都必得救。

chapters.en: Then they spoke the word of the Lord to him and to all the others in his house.
chapters.zh: 他们就把主的道，讲给他和他全家的人听。

chapters.en: At that hour of the night the jailer took them and washed their wounds; then immediately he and all his household were baptized.
chapters.zh: 当夜就在那时候，禁卒把他们带去，洗他们的伤。他和属乎他的人，立时都受了洗。

chapters.en: The jailer brought them into his house and set a meal before them; he was filled with joy because he had come to believe in God—he and his whole household.
chapters.zh: 于是禁卒领他们上自己家里去，给他们摆上饭，他和全家，因为信了神，都很喜乐。

chapters.en: When it was daylight, the magistrates sent their officers to the jailer with the order: “Release those men.”
chapters.zh: 到了天亮，官长打发差役来说，释放那两个人吧。

chapters.en: The jailer told Paul, “The magistrates have ordered that you and Silas be released. Now you can leave. Go in peace.”
chapters.zh: 禁卒就把这话告诉保罗说，官长打发人来叫释放你们。如今可以出监，平平安安地去吧。

chapters.en: But Paul said to the officers: “They beat us publicly without a trial, even though we are Roman citizens, and threw us into prison. And now do they want to get rid of us quietly? No! Let them come themselves and escort us out.”
chapters.zh: 保罗却说，我们是罗马人，并没有定罪，他们就在众人面前打了我们，又把我们下在监里。现在要私下撵我们出去吗？这是不行的。叫他们自己来领我们出去吧。

chapters.en: The officers reported this to the magistrates, and when they heard that Paul and Silas were Roman citizens, they were alarmed.
chapters.zh: 差役把这话回禀官长。官长听见他们是罗马人，就害怕了。

chapters.en: They came to appease them and escorted them from the prison, requesting them to leave the city.
chapters.zh: 于是来劝他们，领他们出来，请他们离开那城。

chapters.en: After Paul and Silas came out of the prison, they went to Lydia’s house, where they met with the brothers and sisters and encouraged them. Then they left.
chapters.zh: 二人出了监，往吕底亚家里去。见了弟兄们，劝慰他们一番，就走了。

chapters.en: When Paul and his companions had passed through Amphipolis and Apollonia, they came to Thessalonica, where there was a Jewish synagogue.
chapters.zh: 保罗和西拉，经过暗妃波里，亚波罗尼亚，来到帖撒罗尼迦，在那里有犹太人的会堂。

chapters.en: As was his custom, Paul went into the synagogue, and on three Sabbath days he reasoned with them from the Scriptures,
chapters.zh: 保罗照他素常的规矩进去，一连三个安息日，本着圣经与他们辩论，

chapters.en: explaining and proving that the Messiah had to suffer and rise from the dead. “This Jesus I am proclaiming to you is the Messiah,” he said.
chapters.zh: 讲解陈明基督必须受害，从死里复活。又说，我所传与你们的这位耶稣，就是基督。

chapters.en: Some of the Jews were persuaded and joined Paul and Silas, as did a large number of God-fearing Greeks and quite a few prominent women.
chapters.zh: 他们中间有些人听了劝，就附从保罗和西拉。并有许多虔敬的希利尼人，尊贵的妇女也不少。

chapters.en: But other Jews were jealous; so they rounded up some bad characters from the marketplace, formed a mob and started a riot in the city. They rushed to Jason’s house in search of Paul and Silas in order to bring them out to the crowd.
chapters.zh: 但那不信的犹太人心里嫉妒，招聚了些市井匪类，搭伙成群，耸动合城的人，闯进耶孙的家，要将保罗西拉带到百姓那里。

chapters.en: But when they did not find them, they dragged Jason and some other believers before the city officials, shouting: “These men who have caused trouble all over the world have now come here,
chapters.zh: 找不着他们，就把耶孙和几个弟兄，拉到地方官那里，喊叫说，那搅乱天下的，也到这里来了。

chapters.en: and Jason has welcomed them into his house. They are all defying Caesar’s decrees, saying that there is another king, one called Jesus.”
chapters.zh: 耶孙收留他们。这些人都违背该撒的命令，说另有一个王耶稣。

chapters.en: When they heard this, the crowd and the city officials were thrown into turmoil.
chapters.zh: 众人和地方官，听见这话，就惊慌了。

chapters.en: Then they made Jason and the others post bond and let them go.
chapters.zh: 于是取了耶孙和其余之人的保状，就释放了他们。

chapters.en: As soon as it was night, the believers sent Paul and Silas away to Berea. On arriving there, they went to the Jewish synagogue.
chapters.zh: 弟兄们，随即在夜间打发保罗和西拉往庇哩亚去。二人到了，就进入犹太人的会堂。

chapters.en: Now the Berean Jews were of more noble character than those in Thessalonica, for they received the message with great eagerness and examined the Scriptures every day to see if what Paul said was true.
chapters.zh: 这地方的人，贤于帖撒罗尼迦的人，甘心领受这道，天天考查圣经，要晓得这道，是与不是。

chapters.en: As a result, many of them believed, as did also a number of prominent Greek women and many Greek men.
chapters.zh: 所以他们中间多有相信的。又有希利尼尊贵的妇女，男子也不少。

chapters.en: But when the Jews in Thessalonica learned that Paul was preaching the word of God at Berea, some of them went there too, agitating the crowds and stirring them up.
chapters.zh: 但帖撒罗尼迦的犹太人，知道保罗又在庇哩亚传神的道，也就往那里去，耸动搅扰众人。

chapters.en: The believers immediately sent Paul to the coast, but Silas and Timothy stayed at Berea.
chapters.zh: 当时弟兄们便打发保罗往海边去。西拉和提摩太仍住在庇哩亚。

chapters.en: Those who escorted Paul brought him to Athens and then left with instructions for Silas and Timothy to join him as soon as possible.
chapters.zh: 送保罗的人带他到了雅典。既领了保罗的命，叫西拉和提摩太速速到他这里来，就回去了。

chapters.en: While Paul was waiting for them in Athens, he was greatly distressed to see that the city was full of idols.
chapters.zh: 保罗在雅典等候他们的时候，看见满城都是偶像，就心里着急。

chapters.en: So he reasoned in the synagogue with both Jews and God-fearing Greeks, as well as in the marketplace day by day with those who happened to be there.
chapters.zh: 于是在会堂里，与犹太人，和虔敬的人，并每日在市上所遇见的人辩论。

chapters.en: A group of Epicurean and Stoic philosophers began to debate with him. Some of them asked, “What is this babbler trying to say?” Others remarked, “He seems to be advocating foreign gods.” They said this because Paul was preaching the good news about Jesus and the resurrection.
chapters.zh: 还有以彼古罗和斯多亚两门的学士，与他争论。有的说，这胡言乱语的要说什么。有的说，他似乎是传说外邦鬼神的。这话是因保罗传讲耶稣，与复活的道。

chapters.en: Then they took him and brought him to a meeting of the Areopagus, where they said to him, “May we know what this new teaching is that you are presenting?
chapters.zh: 他们就把他带到亚略巴古说，你所讲的这新道，我们也可以知道吗？

chapters.en: You are bringing some strange ideas to our ears, and we would like to know what they mean.”
chapters.zh: 因为你有些奇怪的事，传到我们耳中。我们愿意知道这些事是什么意思。

chapters.en: (All the Athenians and the foreigners who lived there spent their time doing nothing but talking about and listening to the latest ideas.)
chapters.zh: 雅典人，和住在那里的客人，都不顾别的事，只将新闻说说听听

chapters.en: Paul then stood up in the meeting of the Areopagus and said: “People of Athens! I see that in every way you are very religious.
chapters.zh: 保罗站在亚略巴古当中，说，众位雅典人哪，我看你们凡事很敬畏鬼神。

chapters.en: For as I walked around and looked carefully at your objects of worship, I even found an altar with this inscription: TO AN UNKNOWN GOD. So you are ignorant of the very thing you worship—and this is what I am going to proclaim to you.
chapters.zh: 我游行的时候，观看你们所敬拜的，遇见一座坛，上面写着未识之神。你们所不认识而敬拜的，我现在告诉你们。

chapters.en: “The God who made the world and everything in it is the Lord of heaven and earth and does not live in temples built by human hands.
chapters.zh: 创造宇宙和其中万物的神，既是天地的主，就不住人手所造的殿。

chapters.en: And he is not served by human hands, as if he needed anything. Rather, he himself gives everyone life and breath and everything else.
chapters.zh: 也不用人手服事，好像缺少什么，自己倒将生命气息，万物，赐给万人。

chapters.en: From one man he made all the nations, that they should inhabit the whole earth; and he marked out their appointed times in history and the boundaries of their lands.
chapters.zh: 他从一本造出万族的人，（本有古卷作血脉），住在全地上，并且预先定准他们的年限，和所住的疆界。

chapters.en: God did this so that they would seek him and perhaps reach out for him and find him, though he is not far from any one of us.
chapters.zh: 要叫他们寻求神，或者可以揣摩而得，其实他离我们各人不远。

chapters.en: ‘For in him we live and move and have our being.’ As some of your own poets have said, ‘We are his offspring.’
chapters.zh: 我们生活，动作，存留，都在乎他，就如你们作诗的，有人说，我们也是他所生的。

chapters.en: “Therefore since we are God’s offspring, we should not think that the divine being is like gold or silver or stone—an image made by human design and skill.
chapters.zh: 我们既是神所生的，就不当以为神的神性像人用手艺，心思，所雕刻的金，银，石。

chapters.en: In the past God overlooked such ignorance, but now he commands all people everywhere to repent.
chapters.zh: 世人蒙昧无知的时候，神并不监察，如今却吩咐各处的人都要悔改。

chapters.en: For he has set a day when he will judge the world with justice by the man he has appointed. He has given proof of this to everyone by raising him from the dead.”
chapters.zh: 因为他已经定了日子，要借着他所设立的人，按公义审判天下。并且叫他从死里复活，给万人作可信的凭据。

chapters.en: When they heard about the resurrection of the dead, some of them sneered, but others said, “We want to hear you again on this subject.”
chapters.zh: 众人听见从死里复活的话，就有讥诮他的，又有人说，我们再听你讲这个吧。

chapters.en: At that, Paul left the Council.
chapters.zh: 于是保罗从他们当中出去了。

chapters.en: Some of the people became followers of Paul and believed. Among them was Dionysius, a member of the Areopagus, also a woman named Damaris, and a number of others.
chapters.zh: 但有几个人贴近他，信了主，其中有亚略巴古的官丢尼修，并一个妇人，名叫大马哩，还有别人一同信从。

chapters.en: After this, Paul left Athens and went to Corinth.
chapters.zh: 这事以后，保罗离了雅典，来到哥林多。

chapters.en: There he met a Jew named Aquila, a native of Pontus, who had recently come from Italy with his wife Priscilla, because Claudius had ordered all Jews to leave Rome. Paul went to see them,
chapters.zh: 遇见一个犹太人，名叫亚居拉，他生在本都。因为革老丢命犹太人都离开罗马，新近带着妻百基拉，从义大利来。保罗就投奔了他们。

chapters.en: and because he was a tentmaker as they were, he stayed and worked with them.
chapters.zh: 他们本是制造帐棚为业。保罗因与他们同业，就和他们同住作工。

chapters.en: Every Sabbath he reasoned in the synagogue, trying to persuade Jews and Greeks.
chapters.zh: 每逢安息日，保罗在会堂里辩论，劝化犹太人和希利尼人。

chapters.en: When Silas and Timothy came from Macedonia, Paul devoted himself exclusively to preaching, testifying to the Jews that Jesus was the Messiah.
chapters.zh: 西拉和提摩太从马其顿来的时候，保罗为道迫切，向犹太人证明耶稣是基督。

chapters.en: But when they opposed Paul and became abusive, he shook out his clothes in protest and said to them, “Your blood be on your own heads! I am innocent of it. From now on I will go to the Gentiles.”
chapters.zh: 他们既抗拒，毁谤，保罗就抖着衣裳说，你们的罪归到你们自己头上，（罪原文作血）与我无干，（原文作我却干净）从今以后，我要往外邦人那里去，

chapters.en: Then Paul left the synagogue and went next door to the house of Titius Justus, a worshiper of God.
chapters.zh: 于是离开那里，到了一个人的家中，这人名叫提多犹士都，是敬拜神的，他的家靠近会堂。

chapters.en: Crispus, the synagogue leader, and his entire household believed in the Lord; and many of the Corinthians who heard Paul believed and were baptized.
chapters.zh: 管会堂的基利司布和全家都信了主。还有许多哥林多人听了，就相信受洗。

chapters.en: One night the Lord spoke to Paul in a vision: “Do not be afraid; keep on speaking, do not be silent.
chapters.zh: 夜间主在异象中对保罗说，不要怕，只管讲，不要闭口。

chapters.en: For I am with you, and no one is going to attack and harm you, because I have many people in this city.”
chapters.zh: 有我与你同在，必没有人下手害你。因为在这城里我有许多的百姓。

chapters.en: So Paul stayed in Corinth for a year and a half, teaching them the word of God.
chapters.zh: 保罗在那里住了一年零六个月，将神的道教训他们。

chapters.en: While Gallio was proconsul of Achaia, the Jews of Corinth made a united attack on Paul and brought him to the place of judgment.
chapters.zh: 到迦流作亚该亚方伯的时候，犹太人同心起来攻击保罗，拉他到公堂，

chapters.en: “This man,” they charged, “is persuading the people to worship God in ways contrary to the law.”
chapters.zh: 说，这个人劝人不按着律法敬拜神。

chapters.en: Just as Paul was about to speak, Gallio said to them, “If you Jews were making a complaint about some misdemeanor or serious crime, it would be reasonable for me to listen to you.
chapters.zh: 保罗刚要开口，迦流就对犹太人说，你们这些犹太人，如果是为冤枉，或奸恶的事，我理当耐性听你们。

chapters.en: But since it involves questions about words and names and your own law—settle the matter yourselves. I will not be a judge of such things.”
chapters.zh: 但所争论的，若是关乎言语，名目，和你们的律法，你们自己去办吧。这样的事我不愿意审问。

chapters.en: So he drove them off.
chapters.zh: 就把他们撵出公堂。

chapters.en: Then the crowd there turned on Sosthenes the synagogue leader and beat him in front of the proconsul; and Gallio showed no concern whatever.
chapters.zh: 众人便揪住管会堂的所提尼，在堂前打他。这些事迦流都不管。

chapters.en: Paul stayed on in Corinth for some time. Then he left the brothers and sisters and sailed for Syria, accompanied by Priscilla and Aquila. Before he sailed, he had his hair cut off at Cenchreae because of a vow he had taken.
chapters.zh: 保罗又住了多日，就辞别了弟兄，坐船往叙利亚去，百基拉，亚居拉和他同去。他因为许过愿，就在坚革哩剪了头发。

chapters.en: They arrived at Ephesus, where Paul left Priscilla and Aquila. He himself went into the synagogue and reasoned with the Jews.
chapters.zh: 到了以弗所，保罗就把他们留在那里，自己进了会堂，和犹太人辩论。

chapters.en: When they asked him to spend more time with them, he declined.
chapters.zh: 众人请他多住些日子，他却不允。

chapters.en: But as he left, he promised, “I will come back if it is God’s will.” Then he set sail from Ephesus.
chapters.zh: 就辞别他们说，神若许我，我还要回到你们这里。于是开船离了以弗所。

chapters.en: When he landed at Caesarea, he went up to Jerusalem and greeted the church and then went down to Antioch.
chapters.zh: 在该撒利亚下了船，就上耶路撒冷去问教会安，随后下安提阿去。

chapters.en: After spending some time in Antioch, Paul set out from there and traveled from place to place throughout the region of Galatia and Phrygia, strengthening all the disciples.
chapters.zh: 住了些日子，又离开那里，挨次经过加拉太和弗吕家地方，坚固众门徒。

chapters.en: Meanwhile a Jew named Apollos, a native of Alexandria, came to Ephesus. He was a learned man, with a thorough knowledge of the Scriptures.
chapters.zh: 有一个犹太人，名叫亚波罗，来到以弗所。他生在亚力山太，是有学问的，最能讲解圣经。（学问或作口才）。

chapters.en: He had been instructed in the way of the Lord, and he spoke with great fervor and taught about Jesus accurately, though he knew only the baptism of John.
chapters.zh: 这人已经在主的道上受了教训，心里火热，将耶稣的事，详细讲论教训人。只是他单晓得约翰的洗礼。

chapters.en: He began to speak boldly in the synagogue. When Priscilla and Aquila heard him, they invited him to their home and explained to him the way of God more adequately.
chapters.zh: 他在会堂里放胆讲道，百基拉，亚居拉听见，就接他来，将神的道给他讲解更加详细。

chapters.en: When Apollos wanted to go to Achaia, the brothers and sisters encouraged him and wrote to the disciples there to welcome him. When he arrived, he was a great help to those who by grace had believed.
chapters.zh: 他想要往亚该亚去。弟兄们就勉励他，并写信请门徒接待他。（或作弟兄们就写信劝门徒接待他）他到了那里，多帮助那蒙恩信主的人。

chapters.en: For he vigorously refuted his Jewish opponents in public debate, proving from the Scriptures that Jesus was the Messiah.
chapters.zh: 在众人面前极有能力，驳倒犹太人，引圣经证明耶稣是基督。

chapters.en: While Apollos was at Corinth, Paul took the road through the interior and arrived at Ephesus. There he found some disciples
chapters.zh: 亚波罗在哥林多的时候，保罗经过了上边一带地方，就来到以弗所。在那里遇见几个门徒。

chapters.en: and asked them, “Did you receive the Holy Spirit when you believed?” They answered, “No, we have not even heard that there is a Holy Spirit.”
chapters.zh: 问他们说，你们信的时候，受了圣灵没有。他们回答说，没有，也未曾听见有圣灵赐下来

chapters.en: So Paul asked, “Then what baptism did you receive?” “John’s baptism,” they replied.
chapters.zh: 保罗说，这样，你们受的是什么洗呢？他们说，是约翰的洗。

chapters.en: Paul said, “John’s baptism was a baptism of repentance. He told the people to believe in the one coming after him, that is, in Jesus.”
chapters.zh: 保罗说，约翰所行的是悔改的洗，告诉百姓，当信那在他以后要来的，就是耶稣。

chapters.en: On hearing this, they were baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus.
chapters.zh: 他们听见这话，就奉主耶稣的名受洗。

chapters.en: When Paul placed his hands on them, the Holy Spirit came on them, and they spoke in tongues and prophesied.
chapters.zh: 保罗按手在他们头上，圣灵便降在他们身上。他们就说方言，又说预言。（或作又讲道）。

chapters.en: There were about twelve men in all.
chapters.zh: 一共约有十二个人。

chapters.en: Paul entered the synagogue and spoke boldly there for three months, arguing persuasively about the kingdom of God.
chapters.zh: 保罗进会堂，放胆讲道，一连三个月，辩论神国的事，劝化众人。

chapters.en: But some of them became obstinate; they refused to believe and publicly maligned the Way. So Paul left them. He took the disciples with him and had discussions daily in the lecture hall of Tyrannus.
chapters.zh: 后来有些人，心里刚硬不信，在众人面前毁谤这道，保罗就离开他们，也叫门徒与他们分离，便在推喇奴的学房，天天辩论。

chapters.en: This went on for two years, so that all the Jews and Greeks who lived in the province of Asia heard the word of the Lord.
chapters.zh: 这样有两年之久，叫一切住在亚西亚的，无论是犹太人，是希利尼人，都听见主的道。

chapters.en: God did extraordinary miracles through Paul,
chapters.zh: 神借保罗的手，行了些非常的奇事。

chapters.en: so that even handkerchiefs and aprons that had touched him were taken to the sick, and their illnesses were cured and the evil spirits left them.
chapters.zh: 甚至有人从保罗身上拿手巾，或围裙，放在病人身上，病就退了，恶鬼也出去了。

chapters.en: Some Jews who went around driving out evil spirits tried to invoke the name of the Lord Jesus over those who were demon-possessed. They would say, “In the name of the Jesus whom Paul preaches, I command you to come out.”
chapters.zh: 那时，有几个游行各处，念咒赶鬼的犹太人，向那被恶鬼附的人，擅自称主耶稣的名，说，我奉保罗所传的耶稣，敕令你们出来。

chapters.en: Seven sons of Sceva, a Jewish chief priest, were doing this.
chapters.zh: 作这事的，有犹太祭司长士基瓦的七个儿子。

chapters.en: One day the evil spirit answered them, “Jesus I know, and Paul I know about, but who are you?”
chapters.zh: 恶鬼回答他们说，耶稣我认识，保罗我也知道。你们却是谁呢？

chapters.en: Then the man who had the evil spirit jumped on them and overpowered them all. He gave them such a beating that they ran out of the house naked and bleeding.
chapters.zh: 恶鬼所附的人，就跳在他们身上，胜了其中二人，制伏他们，叫他们赤着身子受了伤，从那房子里逃出去了。

chapters.en: When this became known to the Jews and Greeks living in Ephesus, they were all seized with fear, and the name of the Lord Jesus was held in high honor.
chapters.zh: 凡住在以弗所的，无论是犹太人，是希利尼人，都知道这事，也都惧怕，主耶稣的名从此就尊大了。

chapters.en: Many of those who believed now came and openly confessed what they had done.
chapters.zh: 那已经信的，多有人来承认诉说自己所行的事。

chapters.en: A number who had practiced sorcery brought their scrolls together and burned them publicly. When they calculated the value of the scrolls, the total came to fifty thousand drachmas.
chapters.zh: 平素行邪术的，也有许多人把书拿来，堆积在众人面前焚烧。他们算计书价，便知道共合五万块钱。

chapters.en: In this way the word of the Lord spread widely and grew in power.
chapters.zh: 主的道大大兴旺而且得胜，就是这样。

chapters.en: After all this had happened, Paul decided to go to Jerusalem, passing through Macedonia and Achaia. “After I have been there,” he said, “I must visit Rome also.”
chapters.zh: 这些事完了，保罗心里定意，经过了马其顿，亚该亚就往耶路撒冷去，又说，我到了那里以后，也必须往罗马去看看。

chapters.en: He sent two of his helpers, Timothy and Erastus, to Macedonia, while he stayed in the province of Asia a little longer.
chapters.zh: 于是从帮助他的人中，打发提摩太，以拉都二人，往马其顿去。自己暂时等在亚西亚。

chapters.en: About that time there arose a great disturbance about the Way.
chapters.zh: 那时，因为这道起的扰乱不小。

chapters.en: A silversmith named Demetrius, who made silver shrines of Artemis, brought in a lot of business for the craftsmen there.
chapters.zh: 有一个银匠，名叫底米丢，是制造亚底米神银龛的，他使这样手艺人生意发达。

chapters.en: He called them together, along with the workers in related trades, and said: “You know, my friends, that we receive a good income from this business.
chapters.zh: 他聚集他们和同行的工人，说，众位，你们知道我们是倚靠这生意发财。

chapters.en: And you see and hear how this fellow Paul has convinced and led astray large numbers of people here in Ephesus and in practically the whole province of Asia. He says that gods made by human hands are no gods at all.
chapters.zh: 这保罗不但在以弗所，也几乎在亚西亚全地，引诱迷惑许多人，说，人手所作的不是神，这是你们所看见所听见的。

chapters.en: There is danger not only that our trade will lose its good name, but also that the temple of the great goddess Artemis will be discredited; and the goddess herself, who is worshiped throughout the province of Asia and the world, will be robbed of her divine majesty.”
chapters.zh: 这样，不独我们这事业，被人藐视，就是大女神亚底米的庙，也要被人轻忽，连亚西亚全地，和普天下，所敬拜的大女神之威荣，也要销灭了。

chapters.en: When they heard this, they were furious and began shouting: “Great is Artemis of the Ephesians!”
chapters.zh: 众人听见，就怒气填胸，喊着说，大哉以弗所人的亚底米阿。

chapters.en: Soon the whole city was in an uproar. The people seized Gaius and Aristarchus, Paul’s traveling companions from Macedonia, and all of them rushed into the theater together.
chapters.zh: 满城都轰动起来。众人拿住与保罗同行的马其顿人该犹和亚里达古，齐心拥进戏园里去。

chapters.en: Paul wanted to appear before the crowd, but the disciples would not let him.
chapters.zh: 保罗想要进去，到百姓那里，门徒却不许他去。

chapters.en: Even some of the officials of the province, friends of Paul, sent him a message begging him not to venture into the theater.
chapters.zh: 还有亚西亚几位首领，是保罗的朋友，打发人来劝他，不要冒险到戏园里去。

chapters.en: The assembly was in confusion: Some were shouting one thing, some another. Most of the people did not even know why they were there.
chapters.zh: 聚集的人，纷纷乱乱，有喊叫这个的，有喊叫那个的，大半不知道是为什么聚集。

chapters.en: The Jews in the crowd pushed Alexander to the front, and they shouted instructions to him. He motioned for silence in order to make a defense before the people.
chapters.zh: 有人把亚力山大从众人中带出来，犹太人推他往前，亚力山大就摆手，要向百姓分诉。

chapters.en: But when they realized he was a Jew, they all shouted in unison for about two hours: “Great is Artemis of the Ephesians!”
chapters.zh: 只因他们认出他是犹太人，就大家同声喊着说，大哉以弗所人的亚底米阿。如此约有两小时

chapters.en: The city clerk quieted the crowd and said: “Fellow Ephesians, doesn’t all the world know that the city of Ephesus is the guardian of the temple of the great Artemis and of her image, which fell from heaven?
chapters.zh: 那城里的书记，安抚了众人，就说，以弗所人哪，谁不知道以弗所人的城，是看守大亚底米的庙，和从丢斯那里落下来的像呢？

chapters.en: Therefore, since these facts are undeniable, you ought to calm down and not do anything rash.
chapters.zh: 这事既是驳不倒的，你们就当安静，不可造次。

chapters.en: You have brought these men here, though they have neither robbed temples nor blasphemed our goddess.
chapters.zh: 你们把这些人带来，他们并没有偷窃庙中之物，也没有亵渎我们的女神。

chapters.en: If, then, Demetrius and his fellow craftsmen have a grievance against anybody, the courts are open and there are proconsuls. They can press charges.
chapters.zh: 若是底米丢和他同行的人，有控告人的事，自有放告的日子。（或作自有公堂）也有方伯，可以彼此对告。

chapters.en: If there is anything further you want to bring up, it must be settled in a legal assembly.
chapters.zh: 你们若问别的事，就可以照常例聚集断定。

chapters.en: As it is, we are in danger of being charged with rioting because of what happened today. In that case we would not be able to account for this commotion, since there is no reason for it.”
chapters.zh: 今日的扰乱，本是无缘无故，我们难免被查问。论到这样聚众，我们也说不出所以然来。

chapters.en: After he had said this, he dismissed the assembly.
chapters.zh: 说了这话，便叫众人散去。

chapters.en: When the uproar had ended, Paul sent for the disciples and, after encouraging them, said goodbye and set out for Macedonia.
chapters.zh: 乱定之后，保罗请门徒来，劝勉他们，就辞别起行，往马其顿去。

chapters.en: He traveled through that area, speaking many words of encouragement to the people, and finally arrived in Greece,
chapters.zh: 走遍了那一带地方，用许多话劝勉门徒，（或作众人）然后来到希腊。

chapters.en: where he stayed three months. Because some Jews had plotted against him just as he was about to sail for Syria, he decided to go back through Macedonia.
chapters.zh: 在那里住了三个月，将要坐船往叙利亚去。犹太人设计要害他，他就定意从马其顿回去。

chapters.en: He was accompanied by Sopater son of Pyrrhus from Berea, Aristarchus and Secundus from Thessalonica, Gaius from Derbe, Timothy also, and Tychicus and Trophimus from the province of Asia.
chapters.zh: 同他到亚西亚去的，有庇哩亚人毕罗斯的儿子所巴特，帖撒罗尼迦人亚里达古，和西公都，还有特庇人该犹，并提摩太，又有亚西亚人推基古，和特罗非摩。

chapters.en: These men went on ahead and waited for us at Troas.
chapters.zh: 这些人先走在特罗亚等候我们。

chapters.en: But we sailed from Philippi after the Festival of Unleavened Bread, and five days later joined the others at Troas, where we stayed seven days.
chapters.zh: 过了除酵的日子，我们从腓立比开船，五天到了特罗亚，和他们相会，在那里住了七天。

chapters.en: On the first day of the week we came together to break bread. Paul spoke to the people and, because he intended to leave the next day, kept on talking until midnight.
chapters.zh: 七日的第一日，我们聚会掰饼的时候，保罗因为要次日起行，就与他们讲论，直讲到半夜。

chapters.en: There were many lamps in the upstairs room where we were meeting.
chapters.zh: 我们聚会的那座楼上，有好些灯烛。

chapters.en: Seated in a window was a young man named Eutychus, who was sinking into a deep sleep as Paul talked on and on. When he was sound asleep, he fell to the ground from the third story and was picked up dead.
chapters.zh: 有一个少年人，名叫犹推古，坐在窗台上，困倦沉睡。保罗讲了多时，少年人睡熟了，就从三层楼上掉下去。扶起他来，已经死了。

chapters.en: Paul went down, threw himself on the young man and put his arms around him. “Don’t be alarmed,” he said. “He’s alive!”
chapters.zh: 保罗下去，伏在他身上，抱着他，说，你们不要发慌，他的灵魂还在身上。

chapters.en: Then he went upstairs again and broke bread and ate. After talking until daylight, he left.
chapters.zh: 保罗又上去，掰饼，吃了，谈论许久，直到天亮，这才走了。

chapters.en: The people took the young man home alive and were greatly comforted.
chapters.zh: 有人把那童子活活地领来，得的安慰不小。

chapters.en: We went on ahead to the ship and sailed for Assos, where we were going to take Paul aboard. He had made this arrangement because he was going there on foot.
chapters.zh: 我们先上船开往亚朔去，意思要在那里接保罗。因为他是这样安排的，他自己打算要步行。

chapters.en: When he met us at Assos, we took him aboard and went on to Mitylene.
chapters.zh: 他既在亚朔与我们相会，我们就接他上船，来到米推利尼。

chapters.en: The next day we set sail from there and arrived off Chios. The day after that we crossed over to Samos, and on the following day arrived at Miletus.
chapters.zh: 从那里开船，次日到了基阿的对面。又次日，在撒摩靠岸。又次日，来到米利都。

chapters.en: Paul had decided to sail past Ephesus to avoid spending time in the province of Asia, for he was in a hurry to reach Jerusalem, if possible, by the day of Pentecost.
chapters.zh: 乃因保罗早已定意越过以弗所，免得在亚西亚耽延。他急忙前走，巴不得赶五旬节能到耶路撒冷。

chapters.en: From Miletus, Paul sent to Ephesus for the elders of the church.
chapters.zh: 保罗从米利都打发人往以弗所去，请教会的长老来。

chapters.en: When they arrived, he said to them: “You know how I lived the whole time I was with you, from the first day I came into the province of Asia.
chapters.zh: 他们来了，保罗就说，你们知道，自从我到亚西亚的日子以来，在你们中间始终为人如何，

chapters.en: I served the Lord with great humility and with tears and in the midst of severe testing by the plots of my Jewish opponents.
chapters.zh: 服事主，凡事谦卑，眼中流泪，又因犹太人的谋害，经历试炼。

chapters.en: You know that I have not hesitated to preach anything that would be helpful to you but have taught you publicly and from house to house.
chapters.zh: 你们也知道，凡与你们有益的，我没有一样避讳不说的。或在众人面前，或在各人家里，我都教导你们。

chapters.en: I have declared to both Jews and Greeks that they must turn to God in repentance and have faith in our Lord Jesus.
chapters.zh: 又对犹太人，和希利尼人，证明当向神悔改，信靠我主耶稣基督。

chapters.en: “And now, compelled by the Spirit, I am going to Jerusalem, not knowing what will happen to me there.
chapters.zh: 现在我往耶路撒冷去，心甚迫切，（原文作心被捆绑）不知道在那里要遇见什么事。

chapters.en: I only know that in every city the Holy Spirit warns me that prison and hardships are facing me.
chapters.zh: 但知道圣灵在各城里向我指证，说，有捆锁与患难等待我。

chapters.en: However, I consider my life worth nothing to me; my only aim is to finish the race and complete the task the Lord Jesus has given me—the task of testifying to the good news of God’s grace.
chapters.zh: 我却不以性命为念，也不看为宝贵，只要行完我的路程，成就我从主耶稣所领受的职事，证明神恩惠的福音。

chapters.en: “Now I know that none of you among whom I have gone about preaching the kingdom will ever see me again.
chapters.zh: 我素常在你们中间来往，传讲神国的道，如今我晓得你们以后都不得再见我的面了。

chapters.en: Therefore, I declare to you today that I am innocent of the blood of any of you.
chapters.zh: 所以我今日向你们证明，你们中间无论何人死亡，罪不在我身上。（原文作我于众人的血是洁净的）。

chapters.en: For I have not hesitated to proclaim to you the whole will of God.
chapters.zh: 因为神的旨意，我并没有一样避讳不传给你们的。

chapters.en: Keep watch over yourselves and all the flock of which the Holy Spirit has made you overseers. Be shepherds of the church of God, which he bought with his own blood.
chapters.zh: 圣灵立你们作全群的监督，你们就当为自己谨慎，也为全群谨慎，牧养神的教会，就是他用自己血所买来的（或作救赎的）。

chapters.en: I know that after I leave, savage wolves will come in among you and will not spare the flock.
chapters.zh: 我知道我去之后，必有凶暴的豺狼，进入你们中间，不爱惜羊群。

chapters.en: Even from your own number men will arise and distort the truth in order to draw away disciples after them.
chapters.zh: 就是你们中间，也必有人起来，说悖谬的话，要引诱门徒跟从他们。

chapters.en: So be on your guard! Remember that for three years I never stopped warning each of you night and day with tears.
chapters.zh: 所以你们应当儆醒，记念我三年之久，昼夜不住地流泪，劝戒你们各人。

chapters.en: “Now I commit you to God and to the word of his grace, which can build you up and give you an inheritance among all those who are sanctified.
chapters.zh: 如今我把你们交托神，和他恩惠的道。这道能建立你们，叫你们和一切成圣的人同得基业。

chapters.en: I have not coveted anyone’s silver or gold or clothing.
chapters.zh: 我未曾贪图一个人的金，银，衣服。

chapters.en: You yourselves know that these hands of mine have supplied my own needs and the needs of my companions.
chapters.zh: 我这两只手，常供给我和同人的需用，这是你们自己知道的。

chapters.en: In everything I did, I showed you that by this kind of hard work we must help the weak, remembering the words the Lord Jesus himself said: ‘It is more blessed to give than to receive.’ ”
chapters.zh: 我凡事给你们作榜样，叫你们知道，应当这样劳苦，扶助软弱的人，又当记念主耶稣的话，说，施比受更为有福。

chapters.en: When Paul had finished speaking, he knelt down with all of them and prayed.
chapters.zh: 保罗说完了这话，就跪下同众人祷告。

chapters.en: They all wept as they embraced him and kissed him.
chapters.zh: 众人痛哭，抱着保罗的颈项，和他亲嘴。

chapters.en: What grieved them most was his statement that they would never see his face again. Then they accompanied him to the ship.
chapters.zh: 叫他们最伤心的，就是他说，以后不能再见我的面那句话。于是送他上船去了。

chapters.en: After we had torn ourselves away from them, we put out to sea and sailed straight to Kos. The next day we went to Rhodes and from there to Patara.
chapters.zh: 我们离别了众人，就开船一直行到哥士。第二天到了罗底，从那里到帕大喇。

chapters.en: We found a ship crossing over to Phoenicia, went on board and set sail.
chapters.zh: 遇见一只船，要往腓尼基去，就上船起行。

chapters.en: After sighting Cyprus and passing to the south of it, we sailed on to Syria. We landed at Tyre, where our ship was to unload its cargo.
chapters.zh: 望见居比路，就从南边行过，往叙利亚去，我们就在推罗上岸。因为船要在那里卸货。

chapters.en: We sought out the disciples there and stayed with them seven days. Through the Spirit they urged Paul not to go on to Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 找着了门徒，就在那里住了七天。他们被圣灵感动，对保罗说，不要上耶路撒冷去。

chapters.en: When it was time to leave, we left and continued on our way. All of them, including wives and children, accompanied us out of the city, and there on the beach we knelt to pray.
chapters.zh: 过了这几天，我们就起身前行。他们众人同妻子儿女，送我们到城外，我们都跪在岸上祷告，彼此辞别。

chapters.en: After saying goodbye to each other, we went aboard the ship, and they returned home.
chapters.zh: 我们上了船，他们就回家去了。

chapters.en: We continued our voyage from Tyre and landed at Ptolemais, where we greeted the brothers and sisters and stayed with them for a day.
chapters.zh: 我们从推罗行尽了水路，来到多利买，就问那里的弟兄安，和他们同住了一天。

chapters.en: Leaving the next day, we reached Caesarea and stayed at the house of Philip the evangelist, one of the Seven.
chapters.zh: 第二天，我们离开那里，来到该撒利亚。就进了传福音的腓利家里，和他同住。他是那七个执事里的一个。

chapters.en: He had four unmarried daughters who prophesied.
chapters.zh: 他有四个女儿，都是处女，是说预言的。

chapters.en: After we had been there a number of days, a prophet named Agabus came down from Judea.
chapters.zh: 我们在那里多住了几天，有一个先知，名叫亚迦布，从犹太下来。

chapters.en: Coming over to us, he took Paul’s belt, tied his own hands and feet with it and said, “The Holy Spirit says, ‘In this way the Jewish leaders in Jerusalem will bind the owner of this belt and will hand him over to the Gentiles.’ ”
chapters.zh: 到了我们这里，就拿保罗的腰带，捆上自己的手脚，说，圣灵说，犹太人在耶路撒冷，要如此捆绑这腰带的主人，把他交在外邦人手里。

chapters.en: When we heard this, we and the people there pleaded with Paul not to go up to Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 我们和那本地的人，听见这话，都苦劝保罗不要上耶路撒冷去。

chapters.en: Then Paul answered, “Why are you weeping and breaking my heart? I am ready not only to be bound, but also to die in Jerusalem for the name of the Lord Jesus.”
chapters.zh: 保罗说，你们为什么这样痛哭，使我心碎呢？我为主耶稣的名，不但被人捆绑，就是死在耶路撒冷，也是愿意的。

chapters.en: When he would not be dissuaded, we gave up and said, “The Lord’s will be done.”
chapters.zh: 保罗既不听劝，我们便住了口，只说，愿主的旨意成就便了。

chapters.en: After this, we started on our way up to Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 过了几日，我们收拾行李上耶路撒冷去。

chapters.en: Some of the disciples from Caesarea accompanied us and brought us to the home of Mnason, where we were to stay. He was a man from Cyprus and one of the early disciples.
chapters.zh: 有该撒利亚的几个门徒和我们同去，带我们到一个久为（久为或作老）门徒的家里，叫我们与他同住，他名叫拿孙，是居比路人。

chapters.en: When we arrived at Jerusalem, the brothers and sisters received us warmly.
chapters.zh: 到了耶路撒冷，弟兄们欢欢喜喜地接待我们。

chapters.en: The next day Paul and the rest of us went to see James, and all the elders were present.
chapters.zh: 第二天，保罗同我们去见雅各。长老们也都在那里。

chapters.en: Paul greeted them and reported in detail what God had done among the Gentiles through his ministry.
chapters.zh: 保罗问了他们安，便将神用他传教，在外邦人中间所行之事，一一地述说了。

chapters.en: When they heard this, they praised God. Then they said to Paul: “You see, brother, how many thousands of Jews have believed, and all of them are zealous for the law.
chapters.zh: 他们听见，就归荣耀与神，对保罗说，兄台，你看犹太人中信主的有多少万，并且都为律法热心。

chapters.en: They have been informed that you teach all the Jews who live among the Gentiles to turn away from Moses, telling them not to circumcise their children or live according to our customs.
chapters.zh: 他们听见人说，你教训一切在外邦的犹太人，离弃摩西，对他们说，不要给孩子行割礼，也不要遵行条规。

chapters.en: What shall we do? They will certainly hear that you have come,
chapters.zh: 众人必听见你来了，这可怎么办呢？

chapters.en: so do what we tell you. There are four men with us who have made a vow.
chapters.zh: 你就照着我们的话行吧，我们这里有四个人，都有愿在身。

chapters.en: Take these men, join in their purification rites and pay their expenses, so that they can have their heads shaved. Then everyone will know there is no truth in these reports about you, but that you yourself are living in obedience to the law.
chapters.zh: 你带他们去，与他们一同行洁净的礼，替他们拿出规费，叫他们得以剃头。这样，众人就可知道，先前所听见你的事都是虚的。并可知道，你自己为人，循规蹈矩，遵行律法。

chapters.en: As for the Gentile believers, we have written to them our decision that they should abstain from food sacrificed to idols, from blood, from the meat of strangled animals and from sexual immorality.”
chapters.zh: 至于信主的外邦人，我们已经写信拟定，叫他们谨忌那祭偶像之物，和血，并勒死的牲畜，与奸淫。

chapters.en: The next day Paul took the men and purified himself along with them. Then he went to the temple to give notice of the date when the days of purification would end and the offering would be made for each of them.
chapters.zh: 于是保罗带着那四个人，第二天与他们一同行了洁净的礼，进了殿，报明洁净的日期满足。只等祭司为他们各人献祭。

chapters.en: When the seven days were nearly over, some Jews from the province of Asia saw Paul at the temple. They stirred up the whole crowd and seized him,
chapters.zh: 那七日将完，从亚西亚来的犹太人，看见保罗在殿里，就耸动了众人，下手拿他，

chapters.en: shouting, “Fellow Israelites, help us! This is the man who teaches everyone everywhere against our people and our law and this place. And besides, he has brought Greeks into the temple and defiled this holy place.”
chapters.zh: 喊叫说，以色列人来帮助，这就是在各处教训众人糟践我们百姓，和律法，并这地方的。他又带着希利尼人进殿，污秽了这圣地。

chapters.en: (They had previously seen Trophimus the Ephesian in the city with Paul and assumed that Paul had brought him into the temple.)
