chapters.en: that has come to you. In the same way, the gospel is bearing fruit and growing throughout the whole world—just as it has been doing among you since the day you heard it and truly understood God’s grace.
chapters.zh: 这福音传到你们那里，也传到普天之下，并且结果增长，如同在你们中间，自从你们听见福音，真知道神恩惠的日子一样。

chapters.en: You learned it from Epaphras, our dear fellow servant, who is a faithful minister of Christ on our behalf,
chapters.zh: 正如你们从我们所亲爱，一同作仆人的以巴弗所学的。他为我们（有古卷作你们）作了基督忠心的执事。

chapters.en: and who also told us of your love in the Spirit.
chapters.zh: 也把你们因圣灵所存的爱心告诉了我们。

chapters.en: For this reason, since the day we heard about you, we have not stopped praying for you. We continually ask God to fill you with the knowledge of his will through all the wisdom and understanding that the Spirit gives,
chapters.zh: 因此，我们自从听见的日子，也就为你们不住地祷告祈求，愿你们在一切属灵的智慧悟性上，满心知道神的旨意。

chapters.en: so that you may live a life worthy of the Lord and please him in every way: bearing fruit in every good work, growing in the knowledge of God,
chapters.zh: 好叫你们行事为人对得起主，凡事蒙他喜悦，在一切善事上结果子，渐渐的多知道神。

chapters.en: being strengthened with all power according to his glorious might so that you may have great endurance and patience,
chapters.zh: 照他荣耀的权能，得以在各样的力上加力，好叫你们凡事欢欢喜喜地忍耐宽容。

chapters.en: and giving joyful thanks to the Father, who has qualified you to share in the inheritance of his holy people in the kingdom of light.
chapters.zh: 又感谢父，叫我们能与众圣徒在光明中同得基业。

chapters.en: For he has rescued us from the dominion of darkness and brought us into the kingdom of the Son he loves,
chapters.zh: 他救了我们脱离黑暗的权势，把我们迁到他爱子的国里。

chapters.en: in whom we have redemption, the forgiveness of sins.
chapters.zh: 我们在爱子里得蒙救赎，罪过得以赦免。

chapters.en: The Son is the image of the invisible God, the firstborn over all creation.
chapters.zh: 爱子是那不能看见之神的像，是首生的，在一切被造的以先。

chapters.en: For in him all things were created: things in heaven and on earth, visible and invisible, whether thrones or powers or rulers or authorities; all things have been created through him and for him.
chapters.zh: 因为万有都是靠他造的，无论是天上的，地上的，能看见的，不能看见的，或是有位的，主治的，执政的，掌权的，一概都是借着他造的，又是为他造的。

chapters.en: He is before all things, and in him all things hold together.
chapters.zh: 他在万有之先，万有也靠他而立。

chapters.en: And he is the head of the body, the church; he is the beginning and the firstborn from among the dead, so that in everything he might have the supremacy.
chapters.zh: 他也是教会全体之首。他是元始，是从死里首先复生的，使他可以在凡事上居首位。

chapters.en: For God was pleased to have all his fullness dwell in him,
chapters.zh: 因为父喜欢叫一切的丰盛，在他里面居住。

chapters.en: and through him to reconcile to himself all things, whether things on earth or things in heaven, by making peace through his blood, shed on the cross.
chapters.zh: 既然借着他在十字架上所流的血，成就了和平，便借着他叫万有，无论是地上的，天上的，都与自己和好了。

chapters.en: Once you were alienated from God and were enemies in your minds because of your evil behavior.
chapters.zh: 你们从前与神隔绝，因着恶行，心里与他为敌。

chapters.en: But now he has reconciled you by Christ’s physical body through death to present you holy in his sight, without blemish and free from accusation—
chapters.zh: 但如今他借着基督的肉身受死，叫你们与自己和好，都成了圣洁，没有瑕疵，无可责备，把你们引到自己面前。

chapters.en: if you continue in your faith, established and firm, and do not move from the hope held out in the gospel. This is the gospel that you heard and that has been proclaimed to every creature under heaven, and of which I, Paul, have become a servant.
chapters.zh: 只要你们在所信的道上恒心，根基稳固，坚定不移，不至被引动失去原文作离开福音的盼望。这福音就是你们所听过的，也是传与普天下万人听的。万人原文作凡受造的我保罗也作了这福音的执事。

chapters.en: Now I rejoice in what I am suffering for you, and I fill up in my flesh what is still lacking in regard to Christ’s afflictions, for the sake of his body, which is the church.
chapters.zh: 现在我为你们受苦，倒觉欢乐，并且为基督的身体，就是为教会，要在我肉身上补满基督患难的缺欠。

chapters.en: I have become its servant by the commission God gave me to present to you the word of God in its fullness—
chapters.zh: 我照神为你们所赐我的职分，作了教会的执事，要把神的道理传得全备。

chapters.en: the mystery that has been kept hidden for ages and generations, but is now disclosed to the Lord’s people.
chapters.zh: 这道理就是历世历代所隐藏的奥秘，但如今向他的圣徒显明了。

chapters.en: To them God has chosen to make known among the Gentiles the glorious riches of this mystery, which is Christ in you, the hope of glory.
chapters.zh: 神愿意叫他们知道，这奥秘在外邦人中有何等丰盛的荣耀。就是基督在你们心里成了有荣耀的盼望。

chapters.en: He is the one we proclaim, admonishing and teaching everyone with all wisdom, so that we may present everyone fully mature in Christ.
chapters.zh: 我们传扬他，是用诸般的智慧，劝戒各人，教导各人。要把各人在基督里完完全全的引到神面前。

chapters.en: To this end I strenuously contend with all the energy Christ so powerfully works in me.
chapters.zh: 我也为此劳苦，照着他在我里面运用的大能，尽心竭力。

chapters.en: I want you to know how hard I am contending for you and for those at Laodicea, and for all who have not met me personally.
chapters.zh: 我愿意你们晓得我为你们和老底嘉人，并一切没有与我亲自见面的人，是何等的尽心竭力。

chapters.en: My goal is that they may be encouraged in heart and united in love, so that they may have the full riches of complete understanding, in order that they may know the mystery of God, namely, Christ,
chapters.zh: 要叫他们的心得安慰，因爱心互相联络，以致丰丰足足在悟性中有充足的信心，使他们真知神的奥秘，就是基督。

chapters.en: in whom are hidden all the treasures of wisdom and knowledge.
chapters.zh: 所积蓄的一切智慧知识，都在他里面藏着。

chapters.en: I tell you this so that no one may deceive you by fine-sounding arguments.
chapters.zh: 我说这话，免得有人用花言巧语迷惑你们。

chapters.en: For though I am absent from you in body, I am present with you in spirit and delight to see how disciplined you are and how firm your faith in Christ is.
chapters.zh: 我身子虽与你们相离，心却与你们同在，见你们循规蹈矩，信基督的心也坚固，我就欢喜了。

chapters.en: So then, just as you received Christ Jesus as Lord, continue to live your lives in him,
chapters.zh: 你们既然接受了主基督耶稣，就当遵他而行。

chapters.en: rooted and built up in him, strengthened in the faith as you were taught, and overflowing with thankfulness.
chapters.zh: 在他里面生根建造，信心坚固，正如你们所领的教训，感谢的心也更增长了。

chapters.en: See to it that no one takes you captive through hollow and deceptive philosophy, which depends on human tradition and the elemental spiritual forces of this world rather than on Christ.
chapters.zh: 你们要谨慎，恐怕有人用他的理学，和虚空的妄言，不照着基督，乃照人间的遗传，和世上的小学，就把你们掳去。

chapters.en: For in Christ all the fullness of the Deity lives in bodily form,
chapters.zh: 因为神本性一切的丰盛，都有形有体的居住在基督里面。

chapters.en: and in Christ you have been brought to fullness. He is the head over every power and authority.
chapters.zh: 你们在他里面也得了丰盛。他是各样执政掌权者的元首。

chapters.en: In him you were also circumcised with a circumcision not performed by human hands. Your whole self ruled by the flesh was put off when you were circumcised by Christ,
chapters.zh: 你们在他里面，也受了不是人手所行的割礼，乃是基督使你们脱去肉体情欲的割礼。

chapters.en: having been buried with him in baptism, in which you were also raised with him through your faith in the working of God, who raised him from the dead.
chapters.zh: 你们既受洗与他一同埋葬，也就在此与他一同复活。都因信那叫他从死里复活神的功用。

chapters.en: When you were dead in your sins and in the uncircumcision of your flesh, God made you alive with Christ. He forgave us all our sins,
chapters.zh: 你们从前在过犯，和未受割礼的肉体中死了，神赦免了你们（或作我们）一切过犯，便叫你们与基督一同活过来。

chapters.en: having canceled the charge of our legal indebtedness, which stood against us and condemned us; he has taken it away, nailing it to the cross.
chapters.zh: 又涂抹了在律例上所写，攻击我们有碍于我们的字据，把它撤去，钉在十字架上。

chapters.en: And having disarmed the powers and authorities, he made a public spectacle of them, triumphing over them by the cross.
chapters.zh: 既将一切执政的掌权的掳来，明显给众人看，就仗着十字架夸胜。

chapters.en: Therefore do not let anyone judge you by what you eat or drink, or with regard to a religious festival, a New Moon celebration or a Sabbath day.
chapters.zh: 所以不拘在饮食上，或节期，月朔，安息日，都不可让人论断你们。

chapters.en: These are a shadow of the things that were to come; the reality, however, is found in Christ.
chapters.zh: 这些原是后事的影儿。那形体却是基督。

chapters.en: Do not let anyone who delights in false humility and the worship of angels disqualify you. Such a person also goes into great detail about what they have seen; they are puffed up with idle notions by their unspiritual mind.
chapters.zh: 不可让人因着故意谦虚，和敬拜天使，就夺去你们的奖赏。这等人拘泥在所见过的，（有古卷作这等人窥察所没有见过的）随着自己的欲心，无故地自高自大，

chapters.en: They have lost connection with the head, from whom the whole body, supported and held together by its ligaments and sinews, grows as God causes it to grow.
chapters.zh: 不持定元首，全身既然靠着他，筋节得以相助联络，就因神大得长进。

chapters.en: Since you died with Christ to the elemental spiritual forces of this world, why, as though you still belonged to the world, do you submit to its rules:
chapters.zh: 你们若是与基督同死，脱离了世上的小学，为什么仍像在世俗中活着，服从那不可拿，不可尝，不可摸，等类的规条呢？

chapters.en: “Do not handle! Do not taste! Do not touch!”?
These rules, which have to do with things that are all destined to perish with use, are based on merely human commands and teachings.
chapters.zh: 这都是照人所吩咐所教导的。说到这一切正用的时候就都败坏了。

chapters.en: Such regulations indeed have an appearance of wisdom, with their self-imposed worship, their false humility and their harsh treatment of the body, but they lack any value in restraining sensual indulgence.
chapters.zh: 这些规条，使人徒有智慧之名，用私意崇拜，自表谦卑，苦待己身，其实在克制肉体的情欲上，是毫无功效。

chapters.en: Since, then, you have been raised with Christ, set your hearts on things above, where Christ is, seated at the right hand of God.
chapters.zh: 所以你们若真与基督一同复活，就当求在上面的事。那里有基督坐在神的右边。

chapters.en: Set your minds on things above, not on earthly things.
chapters.zh: 你们要思念上面的事，不要思念地上的事。

chapters.en: For you died, and your life is now hidden with Christ in God.
chapters.zh: 因为你们已经死了，你们的生命与基督一同藏在神里面。

chapters.en: When Christ, who is your life, appears, then you also will appear with him in glory.
chapters.zh: 基督是我们的生命，他显现的时候，你们也要与他一同显现在荣耀里。

chapters.en: Put to death, therefore, whatever belongs to your earthly nature: sexual immorality, impurity, lust, evil desires and greed, which is idolatry.
chapters.zh: 所以要治死你们在地上的肢体。就如淫乱，污秽，邪情，恶欲，和贪婪，贪婪就与拜偶像一样。

chapters.en: Because of these, the wrath of God is coming.
chapters.zh: 因这些事，神的忿怒必临到那悖逆之子。

chapters.en: You used to walk in these ways, in the life you once lived.
chapters.zh: 当你们在这些事中活着的时候，也曾这样行过。

chapters.en: But now you must also rid yourselves of all such things as these: anger, rage, malice, slander, and filthy language from your lips.
chapters.zh: 但现在你们要弃绝这一切的事，以及恼恨，忿怒，恶毒，（或作阴毒）毁谤，并口中污秽的言语。

chapters.en: Do not lie to each other, since you have taken off your old self with its practices
chapters.zh: 不要彼此说谎，因你们已经脱去旧人和旧人的行为，

chapters.en: and have put on the new self, which is being renewed in knowledge in the image of its Creator.
chapters.zh: 穿上了新人。这新人在知识上渐渐更新，正如造他主的形像。

chapters.en: Here there is no Gentile or Jew, circumcised or uncircumcised, barbarian, Scythian, slave or free, but Christ is all, and is in all.
chapters.zh: 在此并不分希利尼人，犹太人，受割礼的，未受割礼的，化外人，西古提人，为奴的，自主的，惟有基督是包括一切，又住在各人之内。

chapters.en: Therefore, as God’s chosen people, holy and dearly loved, clothe yourselves with compassion, kindness, humility, gentleness and patience.
chapters.zh: 所以你们既是神的选民，圣洁蒙爱的人，就要存（原文作穿下同）怜悯，恩慈，谦虚，温柔，忍耐的心。

chapters.en: Bear with each other and forgive one another if any of you has a grievance against someone. Forgive as the Lord forgave you.
chapters.zh: 倘若这人与那人有嫌隙，总要彼此包容，彼此饶恕。主怎样饶恕了你们，你们也要怎样饶恕人。

chapters.en: And over all these virtues put on love, which binds them all together in perfect unity.
chapters.zh: 在这一切之外，要存着爱心。爱心就是联络全德的。

chapters.en: Let the peace of Christ rule in your hearts, since as members of one body you were called to peace. And be thankful.
chapters.zh: 又要叫基督的平安在你们心里作主。你们也为此蒙召，归为一体。且要存感谢的心。

chapters.en: Let the message of Christ dwell among you richly as you teach and admonish one another with all wisdom through psalms, hymns, and songs from the Spirit, singing to God with gratitude in your hearts.
chapters.zh: 当用各样的智慧，把基督的道理，丰丰富富的存在心里，（或作当把基督的道理丰丰富富的存在心里以各样的智慧）用诗章，颂词，灵歌，彼此教导，互相劝戒，心被恩感歌颂神。

chapters.en: And whatever you do, whether in word or deed, do it all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God the Father through him.
chapters.zh: 无论作什么，或说话，或行事，都要奉主耶稣的名，借着他感谢父神。

chapters.en: Wives, submit yourselves to your husbands, as is fitting in the Lord.
chapters.zh: 你们作妻子的，当顺服自己的丈夫，这在主里面是相宜的。

chapters.en: Husbands, love your wives and do not be harsh with them.
chapters.zh: 你们作丈夫的，要爱你们的妻子，不可苦待她们。

chapters.en: Children, obey your parents in everything, for this pleases the Lord.
chapters.zh: 你们作儿女的，要凡事听从父母，因为这是主所喜悦的。

chapters.en: Fathers, do not embitter your children, or they will become discouraged.
chapters.zh: 你们作父亲的，不要惹儿女的气，恐怕他们失了志气。

chapters.en: Slaves, obey your earthly masters in everything; and do it, not only when their eye is on you and to curry their favor, but with sincerity of heart and reverence for the Lord.
chapters.zh: 你们作仆人的，要凡事听从你们肉身的主人，不要只在眼前事奉，像是讨人喜欢的，总要存心诚实敬畏主。

chapters.en: Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for the Lord, not for human masters,
chapters.zh: 无论作什么，都要从心里作，像是给主作的，不是给人作的。

chapters.en: since you know that you will receive an inheritance from the Lord as a reward. It is the Lord Christ you are serving.
chapters.zh: 因你们知道从主那里，必得着基业为赏赐。你们所事奉的乃是主基督。

chapters.en: Anyone who does wrong will be repaid for their wrongs, and there is no favoritism.
chapters.zh: 那行不义的，必受不义的报应。主并不偏待人。

chapters.en: Masters, provide your slaves with what is right and fair, because you know that you also have a Master in heaven.
chapters.zh: 你们作主人的，要公公平平的待仆人，因为知道你们也有一位主在天上。

chapters.en: Devote yourselves to prayer, being watchful and thankful.
chapters.zh: 你们要恒切祷告，在此儆醒感恩。

chapters.en: And pray for us, too, that God may open a door for our message, so that we may proclaim the mystery of Christ, for which I am in chains.
chapters.zh: 也要为我们祷告，求神给我们开传道的门，能以讲基督的奥秘，（我为此被捆锁）。

chapters.en: Pray that I may proclaim it clearly, as I should.
chapters.zh: 叫我按着所该说的话，将这奥秘发明出来。

chapters.en: Be wise in the way you act toward outsiders; make the most of every opportunity.
chapters.zh: 你们要爱惜光阴，用智慧与外人交往。

chapters.en: Let your conversation be always full of grace, seasoned with salt, so that you may know how to answer everyone.
chapters.zh: 你们的言语要常常带着和气，好像用盐调和，就可知道该怎样回答各人。

chapters.en: Tychicus will tell you all the news about me. He is a dear brother, a faithful minister and fellow servant in the Lord.
chapters.zh: 有我亲爱的兄弟推基古要将我一切的事都告诉你们。他是忠心的执事，和我一同作主的仆人。

chapters.en: I am sending him to you for the express purpose that you may know about our circumstances and that he may encourage your hearts.
chapters.zh: 我特意打发他到你们那里去，好叫你们知道我们的光景，又叫他安慰你们的心。

chapters.en: He is coming with Onesimus, our faithful and dear brother, who is one of you. They will tell you everything that is happening here.
chapters.zh: 我又打发一位亲爱忠心的兄弟阿尼西母同去。他也是你们那里的人。他们要把这里一切的事都告诉你们。

chapters.en: My fellow prisoner Aristarchus sends you his greetings, as does Mark, the cousin of Barnabas. (You have received instructions about him; if he comes to you, welcome him.)
chapters.zh: 与我一同坐监的亚里达古问你们安。巴拿巴的表弟马可也问你们安。（说到这马可，你们已经受了吩咐。他若到了你们那里，你们就接待他。）

chapters.en: Jesus, who is called Justus, also sends greetings. These are the only Jews among my co-workers for the kingdom of God, and they have proved a comfort to me.
chapters.zh: 耶数又称为犹士都，也问你们安。奉割礼的人中，只有这三个人，是为神的国与我一同作工的。也是叫我心里得安慰的。

chapters.en: Epaphras, who is one of you and a servant of Christ Jesus, sends greetings. He is always wrestling in prayer for you, that you may stand firm in all the will of God, mature and fully assured.
chapters.zh: 有你们那里的人，作基督耶稣仆人的以巴弗问你们安。他在祷告之间，常为你们竭力地祈求，愿你们在神一切的旨意上，得以完全。信心充足，能站立得稳。

chapters.en: I vouch for him that he is working hard for you and for those at Laodicea and Hierapolis.
chapters.zh: 他为你们和老底嘉并希拉波立的弟兄，多多地劳苦。这是我可以给他作见证的。

chapters.en: Our dear friend Luke, the doctor, and Demas send greetings.
chapters.zh: 所亲爱的医生路加，和底马问你们安。

chapters.en: Give my greetings to the brothers and sisters at Laodicea, and to Nympha and the church in her house.
chapters.zh: 请问老底嘉的弟兄和宁法，并他家里的教会安。

chapters.en: After this letter has been read to you, see that it is also read in the church of the Laodiceans and that you in turn read the letter from Laodicea.
chapters.zh: 你们念了这书信，便交给老底嘉的教会，叫他们也念。你们也要念从老底嘉来的书信。

chapters.en: Tell Archippus: “See to it that you complete the ministry you have received in the Lord.”
chapters.zh: 要对亚基布说，务要谨慎，尽你从主所受的职分。

chapters.en: I, Paul, write this greeting in my own hand. Remember my chains. Grace be with you.
chapters.zh: 我保罗亲笔问你们安。你们要记念我的捆锁。愿恩惠常与你们同在。

chapters.en: Paul, Silas and Timothy, To the church of the Thessalonians in God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ: Grace and peace to you.
chapters.zh: 保罗，西拉，提摩太，写信给帖撒罗尼迦在父神和主耶稣基督里的教会。愿恩惠平安归与你们。

chapters.en: We always thank God for all of you and continually mention you in our prayers.
chapters.zh: 我们为你们众人常常感谢神，祷告的时候提到你们。

chapters.en: We remember before our God and Father your work produced by faith, your labor prompted by love, and your endurance inspired by hope in our Lord Jesus Christ.
chapters.zh: 在神我们的父面前，不住地记念你们因信心所作的工夫，因爱心所受的劳苦，因盼望我们主耶稣基督所存的忍耐。

chapters.en: For we know, brothers and sisters loved by God, that he has chosen you,
chapters.zh: 被神所爱的弟兄阿，我知道你们是蒙拣选的。

chapters.en: because our gospel came to you not simply with words but also with power, with the Holy Spirit and deep conviction. You know how we lived among you for your sake.
chapters.zh: 因为我们的福音传到你们那里，不独在乎言语，也在乎权能和圣灵，并充足的信心，正如你们知道我们在你们那里，为你们的缘故是怎样为人。

chapters.en: You became imitators of us and of the Lord, for you welcomed the message in the midst of severe suffering with the joy given by the Holy Spirit.
chapters.zh: 并且你们在大难之中，蒙了圣灵所赐的喜乐，领受真道，就效法我们，也效法了主。

chapters.en: And so you became a model to all the believers in Macedonia and Achaia.
chapters.zh: 甚至你们作了马其顿和亚该亚，所有信主之人的榜样。

chapters.en: The Lord’s message rang out from you not only in Macedonia and Achaia—your faith in God has become known everywhere. Therefore we do not need to say anything about it,
chapters.zh: 因为主的道从你们那里已经传扬出来，你们向神的信心不但在马其顿和亚该亚，就是在各处，也都传开了。所以不用我们说什么话。

chapters.en: for they themselves report what kind of reception you gave us. They tell how you turned to God from idols to serve the living and true God,
chapters.zh: 因为他们自己已经报明我们是怎样进到你们那里，你们是怎样离弃偶像归向神，要服事那又真又活的神，

chapters.en: and to wait for his Son from heaven, whom he raised from the dead—Jesus, who rescues us from the coming wrath.
chapters.zh: 等候他儿子从天降临，就是他从死里复活的，那位救我们脱离将来忿怒的耶稣。

chapters.en: You know, brothers and sisters, that our visit to you was not without results.
chapters.zh: 弟兄们，你们自己原晓得我们进到你们那里，并不是徒然的。

chapters.en: We had previously suffered and been treated outrageously in Philippi, as you know, but with the help of our God we dared to tell you his gospel in the face of strong opposition.
chapters.zh: 我们从前在腓立比被害受辱，这是你们知道的。然而还是靠我们的神放开胆量，在大争战中把神的福音传给你们。

chapters.en: For the appeal we make does not spring from error or impure motives, nor are we trying to trick you.
chapters.zh: 我们的劝勉，不是出于错误，不是出于污秽，也不是用诡诈。

chapters.en: On the contrary, we speak as those approved by God to be entrusted with the gospel. We are not trying to please people but God, who tests our hearts.
chapters.zh: 但神既然验中了我们，把福音托付我们，我们就照样讲，不是要讨人喜欢，乃是要讨那察验我们心的神喜欢。

chapters.en: You know we never used flattery, nor did we put on a mask to cover up greed—God is our witness.
chapters.zh: 因为我们从来没有用过谄媚的话，这是你们知道的。也没有藏着贪心，这是神可以作见证的。

chapters.en: We were not looking for praise from people, not from you or anyone else, even though as apostles of Christ we could have asserted our authority.
chapters.zh: 我们作基督的使徒，虽然可以叫人尊重，却没有向你们或向别人求荣耀，

chapters.en: Instead, we were like young children among you. Just as a nursing mother cares for her children,
chapters.zh: 只在你们中间存心温柔，如同母亲乳养自己的孩子。

chapters.en: so we cared for you. Because we loved you so much, we were delighted to share with you not only the gospel of God but our lives as well.
chapters.zh: 我们既是这样爱你们，不但愿意将神的福音给你们，连自己的性命也愿意给你们，因你们是我们所疼爱的。

chapters.en: Surely you remember, brothers and sisters, our toil and hardship; we worked night and day in order not to be a burden to anyone while we preached the gospel of God to you.
chapters.zh: 弟兄们，你们记念我们的辛苦劳碌，昼夜作工，传神的福音给你们，免得叫你们一人受累。

chapters.en: You are witnesses, and so is God, of how holy, righteous and blameless we were among you who believed.
chapters.zh: 我们向你们信主的人，是何等圣洁，公义，无可指摘，有你们作见证，也有神作见证。

chapters.en: For you know that we dealt with each of you as a father deals with his own children,
chapters.zh: 你们也晓得我们怎样劝勉你们，安慰你们，嘱咐你们各人，好像父亲待自己的儿女一样。

chapters.en: encouraging, comforting and urging you to live lives worthy of God, who calls you into his kingdom and glory.
chapters.zh: 要叫你们行事对得起那召你们进他国得他荣耀的神。

chapters.en: And we also thank God continually because, when you received the word of God, which you heard from us, you accepted it not as a human word, but as it actually is, the word of God, which is indeed at work in you who believe.
chapters.zh: 为此，我们也不住地感谢神，因你们听见我们所传神的道，就领受了，不以为是人的道，乃以为是神的道。这道实在是神的，并且运行在你们信主的人心中。

chapters.en: For you, brothers and sisters, became imitators of God’s churches in Judea, which are in Christ Jesus: You suffered from your own people the same things those churches suffered from the Jews
chapters.zh: 弟兄们，你们曾效法犹太中，在基督耶稣里神的各教会。因为你们也受了本地人的苦害，像他们受了犹太人的苦害一样。

chapters.en: who killed the Lord Jesus and the prophets and also drove us out. They displease God and are hostile to everyone
chapters.zh: 这犹太人杀了主耶稣和先知，又把我们赶出去。他们不得神的喜悦，且与众人为敌。

chapters.en: in their effort to keep us from speaking to the Gentiles so that they may be saved. In this way they always heap up their sins to the limit. The wrath of God has come upon them at last.
chapters.zh: 不许我们传道给外邦人使外邦人得救，常常充满自己的罪恶。神的忿怒临在他们身上已经到了极处。

chapters.en: But, brothers and sisters, when we were orphaned by being separated from you for a short time (in person, not in thought), out of our intense longing we made every effort to see you.
chapters.zh: 弟兄们，我们暂时与你们离别，是面目离别，心里却不离别，我们极力地想法子，很愿意见你们的面。

chapters.en: For we wanted to come to you—certainly I, Paul, did, again and again—but Satan blocked our way.
chapters.zh: 所以我们有意到你们那里，我保罗有一两次要去，只是撒但阻挡了我们。

chapters.en: For what is our hope, our joy, or the crown in which we will glory in the presence of our Lord Jesus when he comes? Is it not you?
chapters.zh: 我们的盼望和喜乐，并所夸的冠冕，是什么呢？岂不是我们主耶稣来的时候，你们在他面前站立得住吗？

chapters.en: Indeed, you are our glory and joy.
chapters.zh: 因为你们就是我们的荣耀，我们的喜乐。

chapters.en: So when we could stand it no longer, we thought it best to be left by ourselves in Athens.
chapters.zh: 我们既不能再忍，就愿意独自等在雅典。

chapters.en: We sent Timothy, who is our brother and co-worker in God’s service in spreading the gospel of Christ, to strengthen and encourage you in your faith,
chapters.zh: 打发我们的兄弟在基督福音上作神执事的提摩太前去，（作神执事的有古卷作与神同工的）坚固你们，并在你们所信的道上劝慰你们。

chapters.en: so that no one would be unsettled by these trials. For you know quite well that we are destined for them.
chapters.zh: 免得有人被诸般患难摇动。因为你们自己知道我们受患难原是命定的。

chapters.en: In fact, when we were with you, we kept telling you that we would be persecuted. And it turned out that way, as you well know.
chapters.zh: 我们在你们那里的时候，预先告诉你们，我们必受患难，以后果然应验了，你们也知道。

chapters.en: For this reason, when I could stand it no longer, I sent to find out about your faith. I was afraid that in some way the tempter had tempted you and that our labors might have been in vain.
chapters.zh: 为此，我既不能再忍，就打发人去，要晓得你们的信心如何，恐怕那诱惑人的到底诱惑了你们，叫我们的劳苦归于徒然。

chapters.en: But Timothy has just now come to us from you and has brought good news about your faith and love. He has told us that you always have pleasant memories of us and that you long to see us, just as we also long to see you.
chapters.zh: 但提摩太刚才从你们那里回来，将你们信心和爱心的好消息报给我们，又说你们常常记念我们，切切地想见我们，如同我们想见你们一样。

chapters.en: Therefore, brothers and sisters, in all our distress and persecution we were encouraged about you because of your faith.
chapters.zh: 所以弟兄们，我们在一切困苦患难之中，因着你们的信心就得了安慰。

chapters.en: For now we really live, since you are standing firm in the Lord.
chapters.zh: 你们若靠主站立得稳，我们就活了。

chapters.en: How can we thank God enough for you in return for all the joy we have in the presence of our God because of you?
chapters.zh: 我们在神面前，因着你们甚是喜乐，为这一切喜乐，可用何等的感谢，为你们报答神呢？

chapters.en: Night and day we pray most earnestly that we may see you again and supply what is lacking in your faith.
chapters.zh: 我们昼夜切切地祈求，要见你们的面，补满你们信心的不足。

chapters.en: Now may our God and Father himself and our Lord Jesus clear the way for us to come to you.
chapters.zh: 愿神我们的父，和我们的主耶稣，一直引领我们到你们那里去。

chapters.en: May the Lord make your love increase and overflow for each other and for everyone else, just as ours does for you.
chapters.zh: 又愿主叫你们彼此相爱的心，并爱众人的心，都能增长，充足，如同我们爱你们一样。

chapters.en: May he strengthen your hearts so that you will be blameless and holy in the presence of our God and Father when our Lord Jesus comes with all his holy ones.
chapters.zh: 好使你们，当我们主耶稣同他众圣徒来的时候，在我们父神面前，心里坚固，成为圣洁，无可责备。

chapters.en: As for other matters, brothers and sisters, we instructed you how to live in order to please God, as in fact you are living. Now we ask you and urge you in the Lord Jesus to do this more and more.
chapters.zh: 弟兄们，我还有话说。我们靠着主耶稣求你们，劝你们，你们既然受了我们的教训，知道该怎样行，可以讨神的喜悦，就要照你们现在所行的，更加勉励。

chapters.en: For you know what instructions we gave you by the authority of the Lord Jesus.
chapters.zh: 你们原晓得我们凭主耶稣传给你们什么命令。

chapters.en: It is God’s will that you should be sanctified: that you should avoid sexual immorality;
chapters.zh: 神的旨意就是要你们成为圣洁，远避淫行。

chapters.en: that each of you should learn to control your own body in a way that is holy and honorable,
chapters.zh: 要你们各人晓得怎样用圣洁尊贵，守着自己的身体。

chapters.en: not in passionate lust like the pagans, who do not know God;
chapters.zh: 不放纵私欲的邪情，像那不认识神的外邦人。

chapters.en: and that in this matter no one should wrong or take advantage of a brother or sister. The Lord will punish all those who commit such sins, as we told you and warned you before.
chapters.zh: 不要一个人在这事上越分，欺负他的弟兄。因为这一类的事，主必报应，正如我预先对你们说过，又切切嘱咐你们的。

chapters.en: For God did not call us to be impure, but to live a holy life.
chapters.zh: 神召我们，本不是要我们沾染污秽，乃是要我们成为圣洁。

chapters.en: Therefore, anyone who rejects this instruction does not reject a human being but God, the very God who gives you his Holy Spirit.
chapters.zh: 所以那弃绝的，不是弃绝人，乃是弃绝那赐圣灵给你们的神。

chapters.en: Now about your love for one another we do not need to write to you, for you yourselves have been taught by God to love each other.
chapters.zh: 论到弟兄们相爱，不用人写信给你们，因为你们自己蒙了神的教训，叫你们彼此相爱。

chapters.en: And in fact, you do love all of God’s family throughout Macedonia. Yet we urge you, brothers and sisters, to do so more and more,
chapters.zh: 你们向马其顿全地的众弟兄，固然是这样行，但我劝弟兄们要更加勉励。

chapters.en: and to make it your ambition to lead a quiet life: You should mind your own business and work with your hands, just as we told you,
chapters.zh: 又要立志作安静人，办自己的事，亲手作工，正如我们从前所吩咐你们的。

chapters.en: so that your daily life may win the respect of outsiders and so that you will not be dependent on anybody.
chapters.zh: 叫你们可以向外人行事端正，自己也就没有什么缺乏了。

chapters.en: Brothers and sisters, we do not want you to be uninformed about those who sleep in death, so that you do not grieve like the rest of mankind, who have no hope.
chapters.zh: 论到睡了的人，我们不愿意弟兄们不知道，恐怕你们忧伤，像那些没有指望的人一样。

chapters.en: For we believe that Jesus died and rose again, and so we believe that God will bring with Jesus those who have fallen asleep in him.
chapters.zh: 我们若信耶稣死而复活了，那已经在耶稣里睡了的人，神也必将他与耶稣一同带来。

chapters.en: According to the Lord’s word, we tell you that we who are still alive, who are left until the coming of the Lord, will certainly not precede those who have fallen asleep.
chapters.zh: 我们现在照主的话告诉你们一件事。我们这活着还存留到主降临的人，断不能在那已经睡了的人之先。

chapters.en: For the Lord himself will come down from heaven, with a loud command, with the voice of the archangel and with the trumpet call of God, and the dead in Christ will rise first.
chapters.zh: 因为主必亲自从天降临，有呼叫的声音，和天使长的声音，又有神的号吹响。那在基督里死了的人必先复活。

chapters.en: After that, we who are still alive and are left will be caught up together with them in the clouds to meet the Lord in the air. And so we will be with the Lord forever.
chapters.zh: 以后我们这活着还存留的人，必和他们一同被提到云里，在空中与主相遇。这样，我们就要和主永远同在。

chapters.en: Therefore encourage one another with these words.
chapters.zh: 所以你们当用这些话彼此劝慰。

chapters.en: Now, brothers and sisters, about times and dates we do not need to write to you,
chapters.zh: 弟兄们，论到时候日期，不用写信给你们。

chapters.en: for you know very well that the day of the Lord will come like a thief in the night.
chapters.zh: 因为你们自己明明晓得，主的日子来到，好像夜间的贼一样。

chapters.en: While people are saying, “Peace and safety,” destruction will come on them suddenly, as labor pains on a pregnant woman, and they will not escape.
chapters.zh: 人正说平安稳妥的时候，灾祸忽然临到他们，如同产难临到怀胎的妇人一样，他们绝不能逃脱。

chapters.en: But you, brothers and sisters, are not in darkness so that this day should surprise you like a thief.
chapters.zh: 弟兄们，你们却不在黑暗里，叫那日子临到你们像贼一样。

chapters.en: You are all children of the light and children of the day. We do not belong to the night or to the darkness.
chapters.zh: 你们都是光明之子，都是白昼之子，我们不是属黑夜的，也不是属幽暗的。

chapters.en: So then, let us not be like others, who are asleep, but let us be awake and sober.
chapters.zh: 所以我们不要睡觉，像别人一样，总要儆醒谨守。

chapters.en: For those who sleep, sleep at night, and those who get drunk, get drunk at night.
chapters.zh: 因为睡了的人是在夜间睡。醉了的人是在夜间醉。

chapters.en: But since we belong to the day, let us be sober, putting on faith and love as a breastplate, and the hope of salvation as a helmet.
chapters.zh: 但我们既然属乎白昼，就应当谨守，把信和爱当作护心镜遮胸。把得救的盼望当作头盔戴上。

chapters.en: For God did not appoint us to suffer wrath but to receive salvation through our Lord Jesus Christ.
chapters.zh: 因为神不是预定我们受刑，乃是预定我们借着我们主耶稣基督得救。

chapters.en: He died for us so that, whether we are awake or asleep, we may live together with him.
chapters.zh: 他替我们死，叫我们无论醒着睡着，都与他同活。

chapters.en: Therefore encourage one another and build each other up, just as in fact you are doing.
chapters.zh: 所以你们该彼此劝慰，互相建立，正如你们素常所行的。

chapters.en: Now we ask you, brothers and sisters, to acknowledge those who work hard among you, who care for you in the Lord and who admonish you.
chapters.zh: 弟兄们，我们劝你们敬重那在你们中间劳苦的人，就是在主里面治理你们，劝戒你们的。

chapters.en: Hold them in the highest regard in love because of their work. Live in peace with each other.
chapters.zh: 又因他们所作的工，用爱心格外尊重他们，你们也要彼此和睦。

chapters.en: And we urge you, brothers and sisters, warn those who are idle and disruptive, encourage the disheartened, help the weak, be patient with everyone.
chapters.zh: 我们又劝弟兄们，要警戒不守规矩的人。勉励灰心的人。扶助软弱的人。也要向众人忍耐。

chapters.en: Make sure that nobody pays back wrong for wrong, but always strive to do what is good for each other and for everyone else.
chapters.zh: 你们要谨慎，无论是谁都不可以恶报恶。或是彼此相待，或是待众人，常要追求良善。

chapters.en: Rejoice always,
chapters.zh: 要常常喜乐。

chapters.en: pray continually,
chapters.zh: 不住地祷告。

chapters.en: give thanks in all circumstances; for this is God’s will for you in Christ Jesus.
chapters.zh: 凡事谢恩。因为这是神在基督耶稣里向你们所定的旨意。

chapters.en: Do not quench the Spirit.
chapters.zh: 不要消灭圣灵的感动。

chapters.en: Do not treat prophecies with contempt
chapters.zh: 不要藐视先知的讲论。

chapters.en: but test them all; hold on to what is good,
chapters.zh: 但要凡事察验。善美的要持守。

chapters.en: reject every kind of evil.
chapters.zh: 各样的恶事要禁戒不作。

chapters.en: May God himself, the God of peace, sanctify you through and through. May your whole spirit, soul and body be kept blameless at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.
chapters.zh: 愿赐平安的神，亲自使你们全然成圣。又愿你们的灵，与魂，与身子，得蒙保守，在我主耶稣基督降临的时候，完全无可指摘。

chapters.en: The one who calls you is faithful, and he will do it.
chapters.zh: 那召你们的本是信实的，他必成就这事。

chapters.en: Brothers and sisters, pray for us.
chapters.zh: 请弟兄们为我们祷告。

chapters.en: Greet all God’s people with a holy kiss.
chapters.zh: 与众弟兄亲嘴问安务要圣洁。

chapters.en: I charge you before the Lord to have this letter read to all the brothers and sisters.
chapters.zh: 我指着主嘱咐你们，要把这信念给众弟兄听。

chapters.en: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.
chapters.zh: 愿我主耶稣基督的恩常与你们同在。

chapters.en: Paul, Silas and Timothy, To the church of the Thessalonians in God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ:
chapters.zh: 保罗，西拉，提摩太，写信给帖撒罗尼迦在神我们的父，与主耶稣基督里的教会。

chapters.en: Grace and peace to you from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
chapters.zh: 愿恩惠平安，从父神和主耶稣基督，归与你们。

chapters.en: We ought always to thank God for you, brothers and sisters, and rightly so, because your faith is growing more and more, and the love all of you have for one another is increasing.
chapters.zh: 弟兄们，我们该为你们常常感谢神，这本是合宜的。因你们的信心格外增长，并且你们众人彼此相爱的心也都充足。

chapters.en: Therefore, among God’s churches we boast about your perseverance and faith in all the persecutions and trials you are enduring.
chapters.zh: 甚至我们在神的各教会里为你们夸口，都因你们在所受的一切逼迫患难中，仍旧存忍耐和信心。

chapters.en: All this is evidence that God’s judgment is right, and as a result you will be counted worthy of the kingdom of God, for which you are suffering.
chapters.zh: 这正是神公义判断的明证。叫你们可算配得神的国，你们就是为这国受苦。

chapters.en: God is just: He will pay back trouble to those who trouble you
chapters.zh: 神既是公义的，就必将患难报应那加患难给你们的人。

chapters.en: and give relief to you who are troubled, and to us as well. This will happen when the Lord Jesus is revealed from heaven in blazing fire with his powerful angels.
chapters.zh: 也必使你们这受患难的人，与我们同得平安。那时，主耶稣同他有能力的天使从天上在火焰中显现，

chapters.en: He will punish those who do not know God and do not obey the gospel of our Lord Jesus.
chapters.zh: 要报应那不认识神，和那不听从我主耶稣福音的人。

chapters.en: They will be punished with everlasting destruction and shut out from the presence of the Lord and from the glory of his might
chapters.zh: 他们要受刑罚，就是永远沉沦，离开主的面和他权能的荣光。

chapters.en: on the day he comes to be glorified in his holy people and to be marveled at among all those who have believed. This includes you, because you believed our testimony to you.
chapters.zh: 这正是主降临要在他圣徒的身上得荣耀，又在一切信的人身上显为希奇的那日子。（我们对你们作的见证，你们也信了。）

chapters.en: With this in mind, we constantly pray for you, that our God may make you worthy of his calling, and that by his power he may bring to fruition your every desire for goodness and your every deed prompted by faith.
chapters.zh: 因此，我们常为你们祷告，愿我们的神看你们配得过所蒙的召。又用大能成就你们一切所羡慕的良善，和一切因信心所作的工夫。

chapters.en: We pray this so that the name of our Lord Jesus may be glorified in you, and you in him, according to the grace of our God and the Lord Jesus Christ.
chapters.zh: 叫我们主耶稣的名在你们身上得荣耀，你们也在他身上得荣耀，都照着我们的神并主耶稣基督的恩。

chapters.en: Concerning the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ and our being gathered to him, we ask you, brothers and sisters,
chapters.zh: 弟兄们，论到我们主耶稣基督降临，和我们到他那里聚集，

chapters.en: not to become easily unsettled or alarmed by the teaching allegedly from us—whether by a prophecy or by word of mouth or by letter—asserting that the day of the Lord has already come.
chapters.zh: 我劝你们，无论有灵有言语，有冒我名的书信，说主的日子现在到了，（现在或作就）不要轻易动心，也不要惊慌。

chapters.en: Don’t let anyone deceive you in any way, for that day will not come until the rebellion occurs and the man of lawlessness is revealed, the man doomed to destruction.
chapters.zh: 人不拘用什么法子，你们总不要被他诱惑，因为那日子以前，必有离道反教的事，并有那大罪人，就是沉沦之子，显露出来。

chapters.en: He will oppose and will exalt himself over everything that is called God or is worshiped, so that he sets himself up in God’s temple, proclaiming himself to be God.
chapters.zh: 他是抵挡主，高抬自己，超过一切称为神的，和一切受人敬拜的。甚至坐在神的殿里，自称是神。

chapters.en: Don’t you remember that when I was with you I used to tell you these things?
chapters.zh: 我还在你们那里的时候，曾把这些事告诉你们，你们不记得吗？

chapters.en: And now you know what is holding him back, so that he may be revealed at the proper time.
chapters.zh: 现在你们也知道那拦阻他的是什么，是叫他到了的时候，才可以显露。

chapters.en: For the secret power of lawlessness is already at work; but the one who now holds it back will continue to do so till he is taken out of the way.
chapters.zh: 因为那不法的隐意已经发动。只是现在有一个拦阻的，等到那拦阻的被除去。

chapters.en: And then the lawless one will be revealed, whom the Lord Jesus will overthrow with the breath of his mouth and destroy by the splendor of his coming.
chapters.zh: 那时这不法的人，必显露出来。主耶稣要用口中的气灭绝他，用降临的荣光废掉他。

chapters.en: The coming of the lawless one will be in accordance with how Satan works. He will use all sorts of displays of power through signs and wonders that serve the lie,
chapters.zh: 这不法的人来，是照撒但的运动，行各样的异能神迹，和一切虚假的奇事，

chapters.en: and all the ways that wickedness deceives those who are perishing. They perish because they refused to love the truth and so be saved.
chapters.zh: 并且在那沉沦的人身上，行各样出于不义的诡诈。因他们不领受爱真理的心，使他们得救。

chapters.en: For this reason God sends them a powerful delusion so that they will believe the lie
chapters.zh: 故此，神就给他们一个生发错误的心，叫他们信从虚谎。

chapters.en: and so that all will be condemned who have not believed the truth but have delighted in wickedness.
chapters.zh: 使一切不信真理，倒喜爱不义的人，都被定罪。

chapters.en: But we ought always to thank God for you, brothers and sisters loved by the Lord, because God chose you as firstfruits to be saved through the sanctifying work of the Spirit and through belief in the truth.
chapters.zh: 主所爱的弟兄们哪，我们本该常为你们感谢神。因为他从起初拣选了你们，叫你们因信真道，又被圣灵感动，成为圣洁，能以得救。

chapters.en: He called you to this through our gospel, that you might share in the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.
chapters.zh: 神借我们所传的福音，召你们到这地步，好得着我们主耶稣基督的荣光。

chapters.en: So then, brothers and sisters, stand firm and hold fast to the teachings we passed on to you, whether by word of mouth or by letter.
chapters.zh: 所以弟兄们，你们要站立得稳，凡所领受的教训，不拘是我们口传的，是信上写的，都要坚守。

chapters.en: May our Lord Jesus Christ himself and God our Father, who loved us and by his grace gave us eternal encouragement and good hope,
chapters.zh: 但愿我们主耶稣基督，和那爱我们，开恩将永远的安慰，并美好的盼望，赐给我们的父神，

chapters.en: encourage your hearts and strengthen you in every good deed and word.
chapters.zh: 安慰你们的心，并且在一切善行善言上，坚固你们。

chapters.en: As for other matters, brothers and sisters, pray for us that the message of the Lord may spread rapidly and be honored, just as it was with you.
chapters.zh: 弟兄们，我还有话说，请你们为我们祷告，好叫主的道理快快行开，得着荣耀，正如在你们中间一样。

chapters.en: And pray that we may be delivered from wicked and evil people, for not everyone has faith.
chapters.zh: 也叫我们脱离无理之恶人的手。因为人不都是有信心。

chapters.en: But the Lord is faithful, and he will strengthen you and protect you from the evil one.
chapters.zh: 但主是信实的，要坚固你们，保护你们脱离那恶者。（或作脱离凶恶）

chapters.en: We have confidence in the Lord that you are doing and will continue to do the things we command.
chapters.zh: 我们靠主深信你们现在是遵行我们所吩咐的，后来也必要遵行。

chapters.en: May the Lord direct your hearts into God’s love and Christ’s perseverance.
chapters.zh: 愿主引导你们的心，叫你们爱神并学基督的忍耐。

chapters.en: In the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, we command you, brothers and sisters, to keep away from every believer who is idle and disruptive and does not live according to the teaching you received from us.
chapters.zh: 弟兄们，我们奉主耶稣基督的名吩咐你们，凡有弟兄不按规矩而行，不遵守从我们所受的教训，就当远离他。

chapters.en: For you yourselves know how you ought to follow our example. We were not idle when we were with you,
chapters.zh: 你们自己原知道应当怎样效法我们。因为我们在你们中间，未尝不按规矩而行。

chapters.en: nor did we eat anyone’s food without paying for it. On the contrary, we worked night and day, laboring and toiling so that we would not be a burden to any of you.
chapters.zh: 也未尝白吃人的饭。倒是辛苦劳碌，昼夜作工，免得叫你们一人受累。

chapters.en: We did this, not because we do not have the right to such help, but in order to offer ourselves as a model for you to imitate.
chapters.zh: 这并不是因我们没有权柄，乃是要给你们作榜样，叫你们效法我们。

chapters.en: For even when we were with you, we gave you this rule: “The one who is unwilling to work shall not eat.”
chapters.zh: 我们在你们那里的时候，曾吩咐你们说，若有人不肯作工，就不可吃饭。

chapters.en: We hear that some among you are idle and disruptive. They are not busy; they are busybodies.
chapters.zh: 因我们听说，在你们中间有人不按规矩而行，什么工都不作，反倒专管闲事。

chapters.en: Such people we command and urge in the Lord Jesus Christ to settle down and earn the food they eat.
chapters.zh: 我们靠主耶稣基督，吩咐劝戒这样的人，要安静作工，吃自己的饭。

chapters.en: And as for you, brothers and sisters, never tire of doing what is good.
chapters.zh: 弟兄们，你们行善不可丧志。

chapters.en: Take special note of anyone who does not obey our instruction in this letter. Do not associate with them, in order that they may feel ashamed.
chapters.zh: 若有人不听从我们这信上的话，要记下他，不和他交往，叫他自觉羞愧。

chapters.en: Yet do not regard them as an enemy, but warn them as you would a fellow believer.
chapters.zh: 但不要以他为仇人，要劝他如弟兄。

chapters.en: Now may the Lord of peace himself give you peace at all times and in every way. The Lord be with all of you.
chapters.zh: 愿赐平安的主，随时随事亲自给你们平安。愿主常与你们众人同在。

chapters.en: I, Paul, write this greeting in my own hand, which is the distinguishing mark in all my letters. This is how I write.
chapters.zh: 我保罗亲笔问你们安。凡我的信都以此为记。我的笔迹就是这样。

chapters.en: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all.
chapters.zh: 愿我们主耶稣基督的恩，常与你们众人同在。

chapters.en: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus by the command of God our Savior and of Christ Jesus our hope,
chapters.zh: 奉我们救主神，和我们的盼望基督耶稣之命，作基督耶稣使徒的保罗，

chapters.en: To Timothy my true son in the faith: Grace, mercy and peace from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.
chapters.zh: 写信给那因信主作我真儿子的提摩太。愿恩惠怜悯平安，从父神和我们主基督耶稣，归与你。

chapters.en: As I urged you when I went into Macedonia, stay there in Ephesus so that you may command certain people not to teach false doctrines any longer
chapters.zh: 我往马其顿去的时候，曾劝你仍住在以弗所，好嘱咐那几个人，不可传异教，

chapters.en: or to devote themselves to myths and endless genealogies. Such things promote controversial speculations rather than advancing God’s work—which is by faith.
chapters.zh: 也不可听从荒渺无凭的话语，和无穷的家谱。这等事只生辩论，并不发明神在信上所立的章程。

chapters.en: The goal of this command is love, which comes from a pure heart and a good conscience and a sincere faith.
chapters.zh: 但命令的总归就是爱。这爱是从清洁的心，和无亏的良心，无伪的信心，生出来的。

chapters.en: Some have departed from these and have turned to meaningless talk.
chapters.zh: 有人偏离这些，反去讲虚浮的话。

chapters.en: They want to be teachers of the law, but they do not know what they are talking about or what they so confidently affirm.
chapters.zh: 想要作教法师，却不明白自己所讲说的，所论定的。

chapters.en: We know that the law is good if one uses it properly.
chapters.zh: 我们知道律法原是好的，只要人用得合宜。

chapters.en: We also know that the law is made not for the righteous but for lawbreakers and rebels, the ungodly and sinful, the unholy and irreligious, for those who kill their fathers or mothers, for murderers,
chapters.zh: 因为律法不是为义人设立的，乃是为不法和不服的，不虔诚和犯罪的，不圣洁和恋世俗的，弑父母和杀人的，

chapters.en: for the sexually immoral, for those practicing homosexuality, for slave traders and liars and perjurers—and for whatever else is contrary to the sound doctrine
chapters.zh: 行淫和亲男色的，抢人口和说谎话的，并起假誓的，或是为别样敌正道的事设立的。

chapters.en: that conforms to the gospel concerning the glory of the blessed God, which he entrusted to me.
chapters.zh: 这是照着可称颂之神交托我荣耀福音说的。

chapters.en: I thank Christ Jesus our Lord, who has given me strength, that he considered me trustworthy, appointing me to his service.
chapters.zh: 我感谢那给我力量的，我们主基督耶稣，因他以我有忠心，派我服事他。

chapters.en: Even though I was once a blasphemer and a persecutor and a violent man, I was shown mercy because I acted in ignorance and unbelief.
chapters.zh: 我从前是亵渎神的，逼迫人的，侮慢人的。然而我还蒙了怜悯，因我是不信不明白的时候而作的。

chapters.en: The grace of our Lord was poured out on me abundantly, along with the faith and love that are in Christ Jesus.
chapters.zh: 并且我主的恩是格外丰盛，使我在基督耶稣里有信心和爱心。

chapters.en: Here is a trustworthy saying that deserves full acceptance: Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners—of whom I am the worst.
chapters.zh: 基督耶稣降世，为要拯救罪人。这话是可信的，是十分可佩服的。在罪人中我是个罪魁。

chapters.en: But for that very reason I was shown mercy so that in me, the worst of sinners, Christ Jesus might display his immense patience as an example for those who would believe in him and receive eternal life.
chapters.zh: 然而我蒙了怜悯，是因耶稣基督要在我这罪魁身上，显明他一切的忍耐，给后来信他得永生的人作榜样。

chapters.en: Now to the King eternal, immortal, invisible, the only God, be honor and glory for ever and ever. Amen.
chapters.zh: 但愿尊贵，荣耀归与那不能朽坏不能看见永世的君王，独一的神，直到永永远远。阿们。

chapters.en: Timothy, my son, I am giving you this command in keeping with the prophecies once made about you, so that by recalling them you may fight the battle well,
chapters.zh: 我儿提摩太阿，我照从前指着你的预言，将这命令交托你，叫你因此可以打那美好的仗。

chapters.en: holding on to faith and a good conscience, which some have rejected and so have suffered shipwreck with regard to the faith.
chapters.zh: 常存信心，和无亏的良心。有人丢弃良心，就在真道上如同船破坏了一般。

chapters.en: Among them are Hymenaeus and Alexander, whom I have handed over to Satan to be taught not to blaspheme.
chapters.zh: 其中有许米乃和亚力山大。我已经把他们交给撒但，使他们受责罚，就不再谤渎了。

chapters.en: I urge, then, first of all, that petitions, prayers, intercession and thanksgiving be made for all people—
chapters.zh: 我劝你第一要为万人恳求祷告，代求，祝谢。

chapters.en: for kings and all those in authority, that we may live peaceful and quiet lives in all godliness and holiness.
chapters.zh: 为君王和一切在位的也该如此。使我们可以敬虔端正，平安无事的度日。

chapters.en: This is good, and pleases God our Savior,
chapters.zh: 这是好的，在神我们救主面前可蒙悦纳。

chapters.en: who wants all people to be saved and to come to a knowledge of the truth.
chapters.zh: 他愿意万人得救，明白真道。

chapters.en: For there is one God and one mediator between God and mankind, the man Christ Jesus,
chapters.zh: 因为只有一位神，在神和人中间，只有一位中保，乃是降世为人的基督耶稣。

chapters.en: who gave himself as a ransom for all people. This has now been witnessed to at the proper time.
chapters.zh: 他舍自己作万人的赎价。到了时候，这事必证明出来。

chapters.en: And for this purpose I was appointed a herald and an apostle—I am telling the truth, I am not lying—and a true and faithful teacher of the Gentiles.
chapters.zh: 我为此奉派，作传道的，作使徒，作外邦人的师傅，教导他们相信，学习真道。我说的是真话，并不是谎言。

chapters.en: Therefore I want the men everywhere to pray, lifting up holy hands without anger or disputing.
chapters.zh: 我愿男人无忿怒，无争论，（争论或作疑惑），举起圣洁的手，随处祷告。

chapters.en: I also want the women to dress modestly, with decency and propriety, adorning themselves, not with elaborate hairstyles or gold or pearls or expensive clothes,
chapters.zh: 又愿女人廉耻，自守，以正派衣裳为妆饰，不以编发，黄金，珍珠，和贵价的衣裳为妆饰。

chapters.en: but with good deeds, appropriate for women who profess to worship God.
chapters.zh: 只要有善行。这才与自称是敬神的女人相宜。

chapters.en: A woman should learn in quietness and full submission.
chapters.zh: 女人要沉静学道，一味地顺服。

chapters.en: I do not permit a woman to teach or to assume authority over a man; she must be quiet.
chapters.zh: 我不许女人讲道，也不许她辖管男人，只要沉静。

chapters.en: For Adam was formed first, then Eve.
chapters.zh: 因为先造的是亚当，后造的是夏娃。

chapters.en: And Adam was not the one deceived; it was the woman who was deceived and became a sinner.
chapters.zh: 且不是亚当被引诱，乃是女人被引诱，陷在罪里。

chapters.en: But women will be saved through childbearing—if they continue in faith, love and holiness with propriety.
chapters.zh: 然而女人若常存信心爱心，又圣洁自守，就必在生产上得救。

chapters.en: Here is a trustworthy saying: Whoever aspires to be an overseer desires a noble task.
chapters.zh: 人若想要得监督的职分，就是羡慕善工。这话是可信的。

chapters.en: Now the overseer is to be above reproach, faithful to his wife, temperate, self-controlled, respectable, hospitable, able to teach,
chapters.zh: 作监督的，必须无可指责，只作一个妇人的丈夫，有节制，自守，端正。乐意接待远人，善于教导。

chapters.en: not given to drunkenness, not violent but gentle, not quarrelsome, not a lover of money.
chapters.zh: 不因酒滋事，不打人，只要温和，不争竞，不贪财。

chapters.en: He must manage his own family well and see that his children obey him, and he must do so in a manner worthy of full respect.
chapters.zh: 好好管理自己的家，使儿女凡事端庄顺服。（或作端端庄庄的使儿女顺服）

chapters.en: (If anyone does not know how to manage his own family, how can he take care of God’s church?)
chapters.zh: 人若不知道管理自己的家，焉能照管神的教会呢？

chapters.en: He must not be a recent convert, or he may become conceited and fall under the same judgment as the devil.
chapters.zh: 初入教的不可作监督，恐怕他自高自大，就落在魔鬼所受的刑罚里。

chapters.en: He must also have a good reputation with outsiders, so that he will not fall into disgrace and into the devil’s trap.
chapters.zh: 监督也必须在教外有好名声，恐怕被人毁谤，落在魔鬼的网罗里。

chapters.en: In the same way, deacons are to be worthy of respect, sincere, not indulging in much wine, and not pursuing dishonest gain.
chapters.zh: 作执事的也是如此，必须端庄，不一口两舌，不好喝酒，不贪不义之财。

chapters.en: They must keep hold of the deep truths of the faith with a clear conscience.
chapters.zh: 要存清洁的良心，固守真道的奥秘。

chapters.en: They must first be tested; and then if there is nothing against them, let them serve as deacons.
chapters.zh: 这等人也要先受试验。若没有可责之处，然后叫他们作执事。

chapters.en: In the same way, the women are to be worthy of respect, not malicious talkers but temperate and trustworthy in everything.
chapters.zh: 女执事（原文作女人）也是如此，必须端庄，不说谗言，有节制，凡事忠心。

chapters.en: A deacon must be faithful to his wife and must manage his children and his household well.
chapters.zh: 执事只要作一个妇人的丈夫，好好管理儿女和自己的家。

chapters.en: Those who have served well gain an excellent standing and great assurance in their faith in Christ Jesus.
chapters.zh: 因为善作执事的，自己就得到美好的地步，并且在基督耶稣里的真道上大有胆量。

chapters.en: Although I hope to come to you soon, I am writing you these instructions so that,
chapters.zh: 我指望快到你那里去，所以先将这些事写给你。

chapters.en: if I am delayed, you will know how people ought to conduct themselves in God’s household, which is the church of the living God, the pillar and foundation of the truth.
chapters.zh: 倘若我耽延日久，你也可以知道在神的家中当怎样行。这家就是永生神的教会，真理的柱石和根基。

chapters.en: Beyond all question, the mystery from which true godliness springs is great: He appeared in the flesh, was vindicated by the Spirit,was seen by angels, was preached among the nations, was believed on in the world, was taken up in glory.
chapters.zh: 大哉，敬虔的奥秘，无人不以为然，就是神在肉身显现，被圣灵称义，（或作在灵性称义），被天使看见，被传于外邦，被世人信服，被接在荣耀里。

chapters.en: The Spirit clearly says that in later times some will abandon the faith and follow deceiving spirits and things taught by demons.
chapters.zh: 圣灵明说，在后来的时候，必有人离弃真道，听从那引诱人的（邪）灵，和鬼魔的道理。

chapters.en: Such teachings come through hypocritical liars, whose consciences have been seared as with a hot iron.
chapters.zh: 这是因为说谎之人的假冒。这等人的良心，如同被热铁烙惯了一般。

chapters.en: They forbid people to marry and order them to abstain from certain foods, which God created to be received with thanksgiving by those who believe and who know the truth.
chapters.zh: 他们禁止嫁娶，又禁戒食物，（或作又叫人戒荤）就是神所造叫那信而明白真道的人，感谢着领受的。

chapters.en: For everything God created is good, and nothing is to be rejected if it is received with thanksgiving,
chapters.zh: 凡神所造的物，都是好的。若感谢着领受，就没有一样可弃的。

chapters.en: because it is consecrated by the word of God and prayer.
chapters.zh: 都因神的道和人的祈求，成为圣洁了。

chapters.en: If you point these things out to the brothers and sisters, you will be a good minister of Christ Jesus, nourished on the truths of the faith and of the good teaching that you have followed.
chapters.zh: 你若将这些事提醒弟兄们，便是基督耶稣的好执事，在真道的话语，和你向来所服从的善道上，得了教育。

chapters.en: Have nothing to do with godless myths and old wives’ tales; rather, train yourself to be godly.
chapters.zh: 只是要弃绝那世俗的言语，和老妇荒渺的话，在敬虔上操练自己。

chapters.en: For physical training is of some value, but godliness has value for all things, holding promise for both the present life and the life to come.
chapters.zh: 操练身体，益处还少。惟独敬虔，凡事都有益处。因有今生和来生的应许。

chapters.en: This is a trustworthy saying that deserves full acceptance.
chapters.zh: 这话是可信的，是十分可佩服的。

chapters.en: That is why we labor and strive, because we have put our hope in the living God, who is the Savior of all people, and especially of those who believe.
chapters.zh: 我们劳苦努力，正是为此。因我们的指望在乎永生的神。他是万人的救主，更是信徒的救主。

chapters.en: Command and teach these things.
chapters.zh: 这些事你要吩咐人，也要教导人。

chapters.en: Don’t let anyone look down on you because you are young, but set an example for the believers in speech, in conduct, in love, in faith and in purity.
chapters.zh: 不可叫人小看你年轻。总要在言语，行为，爱心，信心，清洁上，都作信徒的榜样。

chapters.en: Until I come, devote yourself to the public reading of Scripture, to preaching and to teaching.
chapters.zh: 你要以宣读，劝勉，教导为念，直等到我来。

chapters.en: Do not neglect your gift, which was given you through prophecy when the body of elders laid their hands on you.
chapters.zh: 你不要轻忽所得的恩赐，就是从前借着预言，在众长老按手的时候，赐给你的。

chapters.en: Be diligent in these matters; give yourself wholly to them, so that everyone may see your progress.
chapters.zh: 这些事你要殷勤去作，并要在此专心，使众人看出你的长进来。

chapters.en: Watch your life and doctrine closely. Persevere in them, because if you do, you will save both yourself and your hearers.
chapters.zh: 你要谨慎自己和自己的教训，要在这些事上恒心。因为这样行，又能救自己，又能救听你的人。

chapters.en: Do not rebuke an older man harshly, but exhort him as if he were your father. Treat younger men as brothers,
chapters.zh: 不可严责老年人，只要劝他如同父亲。劝少年人如同弟兄。

chapters.en: older women as mothers, and younger women as sisters, with absolute purity.
chapters.zh: 劝老年妇女如同母亲。劝少年妇女如同姐妹。总要清清洁洁的。

chapters.en: Give proper recognition to those widows who are really in need.
chapters.zh: 要尊敬那真为寡妇的。

chapters.en: But if a widow has children or grandchildren, these should learn first of all to put their religion into practice by caring for their own family and so repaying their parents and grandparents, for this is pleasing to God.
chapters.zh: 若寡妇有儿女，或有孙子孙女，便叫他们先在自己家中学着行孝，报答亲恩，因为这在神面前是可悦纳的。

chapters.en: The widow who is really in need and left all alone puts her hope in God and continues night and day to pray and to ask God for help.
chapters.zh: 那独居无靠真为寡妇的，是仰赖神，昼夜不住地祈求祷告。

chapters.en: But the widow who lives for pleasure is dead even while she lives.
chapters.zh: 但那好宴乐的寡妇，正活着的时候也是死的。

chapters.en: Give the people these instructions, so that no one may be open to blame.
chapters.zh: 这些事你要嘱咐他们，叫他们无可指责。

chapters.en: Anyone who does not provide for their relatives, and especially for their own household, has denied the faith and is worse than an unbeliever.
chapters.zh: 人若不看顾亲属，就是背了真道，比不信的人还不好。不看顾自己家里的人，更是如此。

chapters.en: No widow may be put on the list of widows unless she is over sixty, has been faithful to her husband,
chapters.zh: 寡妇记在册子上，必须年纪到六十岁，从来只作一个丈夫的妻子，

chapters.en: and is well known for her good deeds, such as bringing up children, showing hospitality, washing the feet of the Lord’s people, helping those in trouble and devoting herself to all kinds of good deeds.
chapters.zh: 又有行善的名声，就如养育儿女，接待远人，洗圣徒的脚，救济遭难的人，竭力行各样善事。

chapters.en: As for younger widows, do not put them on such a list. For when their sensual desires overcome their dedication to Christ, they want to marry.
chapters.zh: 至于年轻的寡妇，就可以辞她。因为她们的情欲发动，违背基督的时候，就想要嫁人。

chapters.en: Thus they bring judgment on themselves, because they have broken their first pledge.
chapters.zh: 她们被定罪，是因废弃了当初所许的愿。

chapters.en: Besides, they get into the habit of being idle and going about from house to house. And not only do they become idlers, but also busybodies who talk nonsense, saying things they ought not to.
chapters.zh: 并且她们又习惯懒惰，挨家闲游。不但是懒惰，又说长道短，好管闲事，说些不当说的话。

chapters.en: So I counsel younger widows to marry, to have children, to manage their homes and to give the enemy no opportunity for slander.
chapters.zh: 所以我愿意年轻的寡妇嫁人，生养儿女，治理家务，不给敌人辱骂的把柄。

chapters.en: Some have in fact already turned away to follow Satan.
chapters.zh: 因为已经有转去随从撒但的。

chapters.en: If any woman who is a believer has widows in her care, she should continue to help them and not let the church be burdened with them, so that the church can help those widows who are really in need.
chapters.zh: 信主的妇女，若家中有寡妇，自己就当救济她们，不可累着教会，好使教会能救济那真无倚靠的寡妇。

chapters.en: The elders who direct the affairs of the church well are worthy of double honor, especially those whose work is preaching and teaching.
chapters.zh: 那善于管理教会的长老，当以为配受加倍地敬奉。那劳苦传道教导人的，更当如此。

chapters.en: For Scripture says, “Do not muzzle an ox while it is treading out the grain,” and “The worker deserves his wages.”
chapters.zh: 因为经上说，牛在场上踹谷的时候，不可笼住它的嘴。又说，工人得工价是应当的。

chapters.en: Do not entertain an accusation against an elder unless it is brought by two or three witnesses.
chapters.zh: 控告长老的呈子，非有两三个见证就不要收。

chapters.en: But those elders who are sinning you are to reprove before everyone, so that the others may take warning.
chapters.zh: 犯罪的人，当在众人面前责备他，叫其余的人也可以惧怕。

chapters.en: I charge you, in the sight of God and Christ Jesus and the elect angels, to keep these instructions without partiality, and to do nothing out of favoritism.
chapters.zh: 我在神和基督耶稣并蒙拣选的天使面前嘱咐你，要遵守这些话，不可存成见，行事也不可有偏心。

chapters.en: Do not be hasty in the laying on of hands, and do not share in the sins of others. Keep yourself pure.
chapters.zh: 给人行按手的礼，不可急促。不要在别人的罪上有分。要保守自己清洁。

chapters.en: Stop drinking only water, and use a little wine because of your stomach and your frequent illnesses.
chapters.zh: 因你胃口不清，屡次患病，再不要照常喝水，可以稍微用点酒。

chapters.en: The sins of some are obvious, reaching the place of judgment ahead of them; the sins of others trail behind them.
chapters.zh: 有些人的罪是明显的，如同先到审判案前。有些人的罪是随后跟了去的。

chapters.en: In the same way, good deeds are obvious, and even those that are not obvious cannot remain hidden forever.
chapters.zh: 这样，善行也有明显的。那不明显的，也不能隐藏。

chapters.en: All who are under the yoke of slavery should consider their masters worthy of full respect, so that God’s name and our teaching may not be slandered.
chapters.zh: 凡在轭下作仆人的，当以自己主人配受十分的恭敬，免得神的名和道理，被人亵渎。

chapters.en: Those who have believing masters should not show them disrespect just because they are fellow believers. Instead, they should serve them even better because their masters are dear to them as fellow believers and are devoted to the welfare of their slaves. These are the things you are to teach and insist on.
chapters.zh: 仆人有信道的主人，不可因为与他是弟兄就轻看他。更要加意服事他。因为得服事之益处的，是信道蒙爱的。你要以此教训人，劝勉人。

chapters.en: If anyone teaches otherwise and does not agree to the sound instruction of our Lord Jesus Christ and to godly teaching,
chapters.zh: 若有人传异教，不服从我们主耶稣基督纯正的话，与那合乎敬虔的道理。

chapters.en: they are conceited and understand nothing. They have an unhealthy interest in controversies and quarrels about words that result in envy, strife, malicious talk, evil suspicions
chapters.zh: 他是自高自大，一无所知，专好问难争辩言词，从此就生出嫉妒，分争，毁谤，妄疑，

chapters.en: and constant friction between people of corrupt mind, who have been robbed of the truth and who think that godliness is a means to financial gain.
chapters.zh: 并那坏了心术，失丧真理之人的争竞。他们以敬虔为得利的门路。

chapters.en: But godliness with contentment is great gain.
chapters.zh: 然而敬虔加上知足的心便是大利了。

chapters.en: For we brought nothing into the world, and we can take nothing out of it.
chapters.zh: 因为我们没有带什么到世上来，也不能带什么去。

chapters.en: But if we have food and clothing, we will be content with that.
chapters.zh: 只要有衣有食，就当知足。

chapters.en: Those who want to get rich fall into temptation and a trap and into many foolish and harmful desires that plunge people into ruin and destruction.
chapters.zh: 但那些想要发财的人，就陷在迷惑，落在网罗，和许多无知有害的私欲里，叫人沉在败坏和灭亡中。

chapters.en: For the love of money is a root of all kinds of evil. Some people, eager for money, have wandered from the faith and pierced themselves with many griefs.
chapters.zh: 贪财是万恶之根。有人贪恋钱财，就被引诱离了真道，用许多愁苦把自己刺透了。

chapters.en: But you, man of God, flee from all this, and pursue righteousness, godliness, faith, love, endurance and gentleness.
chapters.zh: 但你这属神的人，要逃避这些事，追求公义，敬虔，信心，爱心，忍耐，温柔。

chapters.en: Fight the good fight of the faith. Take hold of the eternal life to which you were called when you made your good confession in the presence of many witnesses.
chapters.zh: 你要为真道打那美好的仗，持定永生。你为此被召，也在许多见证人面前，已经作了那美好的见证。

chapters.en: In the sight of God, who gives life to everything, and of Christ Jesus, who while testifying before Pontius Pilate made the good confession, I charge you
chapters.zh: 我在叫万物生活的神面前，并在向本丢彼拉多作过那美好见证的基督耶稣面前嘱咐你，

chapters.en: to keep this command without spot or blame until the appearing of our Lord Jesus Christ,
chapters.zh: 要守这命令，毫不玷污，无可指责，直到我们的主耶稣基督显现。

chapters.en: which God will bring about in his own time—God, the blessed and only Ruler, the King of kings and Lord of lords,
chapters.zh: 到了日期，那可称颂独有权能的，万王之王，万主之主，

chapters.en: who alone is immortal and who lives in unapproachable light, whom no one has seen or can see. To him be honor and might forever. Amen.
chapters.zh: 就是那独一不死，住在人不能靠近的光里，是人未曾看见，也是不能看见的，要将他显明出来。但愿尊贵和永远的权能，都归给他。阿们。

chapters.en: Command those who are rich in this present world not to be arrogant nor to put their hope in wealth, which is so uncertain, but to put their hope in God, who richly provides us with everything for our enjoyment.
chapters.zh: 你要嘱咐那些今世富足的人，不要自高，也不要倚靠无定的钱财。只要倚靠那厚赐百物给我们享受的神。

chapters.en: Command them to do good, to be rich in good deeds, and to be generous and willing to share.
chapters.zh: 又要嘱咐他们行善，在好事上富足，甘心施舍，乐意供给人，（供给或作体贴）

chapters.en: In this way they will lay up treasure for themselves as a firm foundation for the coming age, so that they may take hold of the life that is truly life.
chapters.zh: 为自己积成美好的根基，预备将来，叫他们持定那真正的生命。

chapters.en: Timothy, guard what has been entrusted to your care. Turn away from godless chatter and the opposing ideas of what is falsely called knowledge,
chapters.zh: 提摩太阿，你要保守所托付你的，躲避世俗的虚谈，和那敌真道似是而非的学问。

chapters.en: which some have professed and in so doing have departed from the faith. Grace be with you all.
chapters.zh: 已经有人自称有这学问，就偏离了真道。愿恩惠常与你们同在。

chapters.en: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus by the will of God, in keeping with the promise of life that is in Christ Jesus,
chapters.zh: 奉神旨意，照着在基督耶稣里生命的应许，作基督耶稣使徒的保罗，

chapters.en: To Timothy, my dear son: Grace, mercy and peace from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.
chapters.zh: 写信给我亲爱的儿子提摩太。愿恩惠怜悯平安，从父神和我们主基督耶稣，归与你。

chapters.en: I thank God, whom I serve, as my ancestors did, with a clear conscience, as night and day I constantly remember you in my prayers.
chapters.zh: 我感谢神，就是我接续祖先，用清洁的良心所事奉的神，祈祷的时候，不住地想念你，

chapters.en: Recalling your tears, I long to see you, so that I may be filled with joy.
chapters.zh: 记念你的眼泪，昼夜切切地想要见你，好叫我满心快乐。

chapters.en: I am reminded of your sincere faith, which first lived in your grandmother Lois and in your mother Eunice and, I am persuaded, now lives in you also.
chapters.zh: 想到你心里无伪之信。这信是先在你外祖母罗以，和你母亲友尼基心里的。我深信也在你的心里。

chapters.en: For this reason I remind you to fan into flame the gift of God, which is in you through the laying on of my hands.
chapters.zh: 为此我提醒你，使你将神借我按手所给你的恩赐，再如火挑旺起来。

chapters.en: For the Spirit God gave us does not make us timid, but gives us power, love and self-discipline.
chapters.zh: 因为神赐给我们，不是胆怯的心，乃是刚强，仁爱，谨守的心。

chapters.en: So do not be ashamed of the testimony about our Lord or of me his prisoner. Rather, join with me in suffering for the gospel, by the power of God.
chapters.zh: 你不要以给我们的主作见证为耻，也不要以我这为主被囚的为耻。总要按神的能力，与我为福音同受苦难。

chapters.en: He has saved us and called us to a holy life—not because of anything we have done but because of his own purpose and grace. This grace was given us in Christ Jesus before the beginning of time,
chapters.zh: 神救了我们，以圣召召我们，不是按我们的行为，乃是按他的旨意，和恩典。这恩典是万古之先，在基督耶稣里赐给我们的。

chapters.en: but it has now been revealed through the appearing of our Savior, Christ Jesus, who has destroyed death and has brought life and immortality to light through the gospel.
chapters.zh: 但如今借着我们救主基督耶稣的显现，才表明出来了。他已经把死废去，借着福音，将不能坏的生命彰显出来。

chapters.en: And of this gospel I was appointed a herald and an apostle and a teacher.
chapters.zh: 我为这福音奉派作传道的，作使徒，作师傅。

chapters.en: That is why I am suffering as I am. Yet this is no cause for shame, because I know whom I have believed, and am convinced that he is able to guard what I have entrusted to him until that day.
chapters.zh: 为这缘故，我也受这些苦难。然而我不以为耻。因为知道我所信的是谁，也深信他能保全我所交付他的，（或作他所交托我的）直到那日。

chapters.en: What you heard from me, keep as the pattern of sound teaching, with faith and love in Christ Jesus.
chapters.zh: 你从我听的那纯正话语的规模，要用在基督耶稣里的信心和爱心，常常守着。

chapters.en: Guard the good deposit that was entrusted to you—guard it with the help of the Holy Spirit who lives in us.
chapters.zh: 从前所交托你的善道，你要靠着那住在我们里面的圣灵，牢牢的守着。

chapters.en: You know that everyone in the province of Asia has deserted me, including Phygelus and Hermogenes.
chapters.zh: 凡在亚西亚的人都离弃我，这是你知道的。其中有腓吉路和黑摩其尼。

chapters.en: May the Lord show mercy to the household of Onesiphorus, because he often refreshed me and was not ashamed of my chains.
chapters.zh: 愿主怜悯阿尼色弗一家的人。因他屡次使我畅快，不以我的锁链为耻。

chapters.en: On the contrary, when he was in Rome, he searched hard for me until he found me.
chapters.zh: 反倒在罗马的时候，殷勤的找我，并且找着了。

chapters.en: May the Lord grant that he will find mercy from the Lord on that day! You know very well in how many ways he helped me in Ephesus.
chapters.zh: 愿主使他在那日得主的怜悯。他在以弗所怎样多多地服事我，是你明明知道的。

chapters.en: You then, my son, be strong in the grace that is in Christ Jesus.
chapters.zh: 我儿阿，你要在基督耶稣的恩典上刚强起来。

chapters.en: And the things you have heard me say in the presence of many witnesses entrust to reliable people who will also be qualified to teach others.
chapters.zh: 你在许多见证人面前听见我所教训的，也要交托那忠心能教导别人的人。

chapters.en: Join with me in suffering, like a good soldier of Christ Jesus.
chapters.zh: 你要和我同受苦难，好像基督耶稣的精兵。

chapters.en: No one serving as a soldier gets entangled in civilian affairs, but rather tries to please his commanding officer.
chapters.zh: 凡在军中当兵的，不将世务缠身，好叫那招他当兵的人喜悦。

chapters.en: Similarly, anyone who competes as an athlete does not receive the victor’s crown except by competing according to the rules.
chapters.zh: 人若在场上比武，非按规矩，就不能得冠冕。

chapters.en: The hardworking farmer should be the first to receive a share of the crops.
chapters.zh: 劳力的农夫，理当先得粮食。

chapters.en: Reflect on what I am saying, for the Lord will give you insight into all this.
chapters.zh: 我所说的话你要思想。因为凡事主必给你聪明。

chapters.en: Remember Jesus Christ, raised from the dead, descended from David. This is my gospel,
chapters.zh: 你要记念耶稣基督乃是大卫的后裔。他从死里复活，正合乎我所传的福音。

chapters.en: for which I am suffering even to the point of being chained like a criminal. But God’s word is not chained.
chapters.zh: 我为这福音受苦难，甚至被捆绑，像犯人一样。然而神的道，却不被捆绑。

chapters.en: Therefore I endure everything for the sake of the elect, that they too may obtain the salvation that is in Christ Jesus, with eternal glory.
chapters.zh: 所以我为选民凡事忍耐，叫他们也可以得着那在基督耶稣里的救恩，和永远的荣耀。

chapters.en: Here is a trustworthy saying: If we died with him, we will also live with him;
chapters.zh: 有可信的话说，我们若与基督同死，也必与他同活。

chapters.en: if we endure, we will also reign with him. If we disown him, he will also disown us;
chapters.zh: 我们若能忍耐，也必和他一同作王。我们若不认他，他也必不认我们。

chapters.en: if we are faithless, he remains faithful, for he cannot disown himself.
chapters.zh: 我们纵然失信，他仍是可信的。因为他不能背乎自己。

chapters.en: Keep reminding God’s people of these things. Warn them before God against quarreling about words; it is of no value, and only ruins those who listen.
chapters.zh: 你要使众人回想这些事，在主面前嘱咐他们，不可为言语争辩。这是没有益处的，只能败坏听见的人。

chapters.en: Do your best to present yourself to God as one approved, a worker who does not need to be ashamed and who correctly handles the word of truth.
chapters.zh: 你当竭力，在神面前得蒙喜悦，作无愧的工人，按着正意分解真理的道。

chapters.en: Avoid godless chatter, because those who indulge in it will become more and more ungodly.
chapters.zh: 但要远避世俗的虚谈。因为这等人必进到更不敬虔的地步。

chapters.en: Their teaching will spread like gangrene. Among them are Hymenaeus and Philetus,
chapters.zh: 他们的话如同毒疮，越烂越大。其中有许米乃和腓理徒。

chapters.en: who have departed from the truth. They say that the resurrection has already taken place, and they destroy the faith of some.
chapters.zh: 他们偏离了真道，说复活的事已过，就败坏好些人的信心。

chapters.en: Nevertheless, God’s solid foundation stands firm, sealed with this inscription: “The Lord knows those who are his,” and, “Everyone who confesses the name of the Lord must turn away from wickedness.”
chapters.zh: 然而神坚固的根基立住了。上面有这印记说，主认识谁是他的人。又说，凡称呼主名的人，总要离开不义。

chapters.en: In a large house there are articles not only of gold and silver, but also of wood and clay; some are for special purposes and some for common use.
chapters.zh: 在大户人家，不但有金器银器，也有木器瓦器。有作为贵重的，有作为卑贱的。

chapters.en: Those who cleanse themselves from the latter will be instruments for special purposes, made holy, useful to the Master and prepared to do any good work.
chapters.zh: 人若自洁，脱离卑贱的事，就必作贵重的器皿，成为圣洁，合乎主用，预备行各样的善事。

chapters.en: Flee the evil desires of youth and pursue righteousness, faith, love and peace, along with those who call on the Lord out of a pure heart.
chapters.zh: 你要逃避少年的私欲，同那清心祷告主的人追求公义，信德，仁爱，和平。

chapters.en: Don’t have anything to do with foolish and stupid arguments, because you know they produce quarrels.
chapters.zh: 惟有那愚拙无学问的辩论，总要弃绝。因为知道这等事是起争竞的。

chapters.en: And the Lord’s servant must not be quarrelsome but must be kind to everyone, able to teach, not resentful.
chapters.zh: 然而主的仆人不可争竞，只要温温和和的待众人，善于教导，存心忍耐，

chapters.en: Opponents must be gently instructed, in the hope that God will grant them repentance leading them to a knowledge of the truth,
chapters.zh: 用温柔劝戒那抵挡的人。或者神给他们悔改的心，可以明白真道。

chapters.en: and that they will come to their senses and escape from the trap of the devil, who has taken them captive to do his will.
chapters.zh: 叫他们这已经被魔鬼任意掳去的，可以醒悟，脱离他的网罗。

chapters.en: But mark this: There will be terrible times in the last days.
chapters.zh: 你该知道，末世必有危险的日子来到。

chapters.en: People will be lovers of themselves, lovers of money, boastful, proud, abusive, disobedient to their parents, ungrateful, unholy,
chapters.zh: 因为那时人要专顾自己，贪爱钱财，自夸，狂傲，谤讟，违背父母，忘恩负义，心不圣洁，

chapters.en: without love, unforgiving, slanderous, without self-control, brutal, not lovers of the good,
chapters.zh: 无亲情，不解怨，好说谗言，不能自约，性情凶暴，不爱良善，

chapters.en: treacherous, rash, conceited, lovers of pleasure rather than lovers of God—
chapters.zh: 卖主卖友，任意妄为，自高自大，爱宴乐不爱神。

chapters.en: having a form of godliness but denying its power. Have nothing to do with such people.
chapters.zh: 有敬虔的外貌，却背了敬虔的实意。这等人你要躲开。

chapters.en: They are the kind who worm their way into homes and gain control over gullible women, who are loaded down with sins and are swayed by all kinds of evil desires,
chapters.zh: 那偷进人家，牢笼无知妇女的，正是这等人。这些妇女担负罪恶，被各样的私欲引诱。

chapters.en: always learning but never able to come to a knowledge of the truth.
chapters.zh: 常常学习，终久不能明白真道。

chapters.en: Just as Jannes and Jambres opposed Moses, so also these teachers oppose the truth. They are men of depraved minds, who, as far as the faith is concerned, are rejected.
chapters.zh: 从前雅尼和佯庇怎样敌挡摩西，这等人也怎样敌挡真道。他们的心地坏了，在真道上是可废弃的。

chapters.en: But they will not get very far because, as in the case of those men, their folly will be clear to everyone.
chapters.zh: 然而他们不能再这样敌挡，因为他们的愚昧，必在众人面前显露出来，像那二人一样。

chapters.en: You, however, know all about my teaching, my way of life, my purpose, faith, patience, love, endurance,
chapters.zh: 但你已经服从了我的教训，品行，志向，信心，宽容，爱心，忍耐，

chapters.en: persecutions, sufferings—what kinds of things happened to me in Antioch, Iconium and Lystra, the persecutions I endured. Yet the Lord rescued me from all of them.
chapters.zh: 以及我在安提阿，以哥念，路司得，所遭遇的逼迫，苦难。我所忍受是何等的逼迫。但从这一切苦难中主都把我救出来了。

chapters.en: In fact, everyone who wants to live a godly life in Christ Jesus will be persecuted,
chapters.zh: 不但如此，凡立志在基督耶稣里敬虔度日的，也都要受逼迫。

chapters.en: while evildoers and impostors will go from bad to worse, deceiving and being deceived.
chapters.zh: 只是作恶的，和迷惑人的，必越久越恶，他欺哄人也被人欺哄。

chapters.en: But as for you, continue in what you have learned and have become convinced of, because you know those from whom you learned it,
chapters.zh: 但你所学习的，所确信的，要存在心里。因为你知道是跟谁学的。

chapters.en: and how from infancy you have known the Holy Scriptures, which are able to make you wise for salvation through faith in Christ Jesus.
chapters.zh: 并且知道你是从小明白圣经。这圣经能使你因信基督耶稣有得救的智慧。

chapters.en: All Scripture is God-breathed and is useful for teaching, rebuking, correcting and training in righteousness,
chapters.zh: 圣经都是神所默示的（或作凡神所默示的圣经），于教训，督责，使人归正，教导人学义，都是有益的。

chapters.en: so that the servant of God may be thoroughly equipped for every good work.
chapters.zh: 叫属神的人得以完全，预备行各样的善事。

chapters.en: In the presence of God and of Christ Jesus, who will judge the living and the dead, and in view of his appearing and his kingdom, I give you this charge:
chapters.zh: 我在神面前，并在将来审判活人死人的基督耶稣面前，凭着他的显现和他的国度嘱咐你。

chapters.en: Preach the word; be prepared in season and out of season; correct, rebuke and encourage—with great patience and careful instruction.
chapters.zh: 务要传道。无论得时不得时，总要专心，并用百般的忍耐，各样的教训，责备人，警戒人，劝勉人。

chapters.en: For the time will come when people will not put up with sound doctrine. Instead, to suit their own desires, they will gather around them a great number of teachers to say what their itching ears want to hear.
chapters.zh: 因为时候要到，人必厌烦纯正的道理。耳朵发痒，就随从自己的情欲，增添好些师傅。

chapters.en: They will turn their ears away from the truth and turn aside to myths.
chapters.zh: 并且掩耳不听真道，偏向荒渺的言语。

chapters.en: But you, keep your head in all situations, endure hardship, do the work of an evangelist, discharge all the duties of your ministry.
chapters.zh: 你却要凡事谨慎，忍受苦难，作传道的工夫，尽你的职分。

chapters.en: For I am already being poured out like a drink offering, and the time for my departure is near.
chapters.zh: 我现在被浇奠，我离世的时候到了。

chapters.en: I have fought the good fight, I have finished the race, I have kept the faith.
chapters.zh: 那美好的仗我已经打过了。当跑的路我已经跑尽了。所信的道我已经守住了。

chapters.en: Now there is in store for me the crown of righteousness, which the Lord, the righteous Judge, will award to me on that day—and not only to me, but also to all who have longed for his appearing.
chapters.zh: 从此以后，有公义的冠冕为我存留，就是按着公义审判的主到了那日要赐给我的。不但赐给我，也赐给凡爱慕他显现的人。

chapters.en: Do your best to come to me quickly,
chapters.zh: 你要赶紧的到我这里来。

chapters.en: for Demas, because he loved this world, has deserted me and has gone to Thessalonica. Crescens has gone to Galatia, and Titus to Dalmatia.
chapters.zh: 因为底马贪爱现今的世界，就离弃我往帖撒罗尼迦去了。革勒士往加拉太去。提多往挞马太去。

chapters.en: Only Luke is with me. Get Mark and bring him with you, because he is helpful to me in my ministry.
chapters.zh: 独有路加在我这里。你来的时候要把马可带来。因为他在传道的事上于我有益处。（传道或作服事我）

chapters.en: I sent Tychicus to Ephesus.
chapters.zh: 我已经打发推基古往以弗所去。

chapters.en: When you come, bring the cloak that I left with Carpus at Troas, and my scrolls, especially the parchments.
chapters.zh: 我在特罗亚留于加布的那件外衣，你来的时候可以带来。那些书也要带来。更要紧的是那些皮卷。

chapters.en: Alexander the metalworker did me a great deal of harm. The Lord will repay him for what he has done.
chapters.zh: 铜匠亚力山大多多地害我。主必照他所行的报应他。

chapters.en: You too should be on your guard against him, because he strongly opposed our message.
chapters.zh: 你也要防备他。因为他极力敌挡了我们的话。

chapters.en: At my first defense, no one came to my support, but everyone deserted me. May it not be held against them.
chapters.zh: 我初次申诉，没有人前来帮助，竟都离弃我。但愿这罪不归与他们。

chapters.en: But the Lord stood at my side and gave me strength, so that through me the message might be fully proclaimed and all the Gentiles might hear it. And I was delivered from the lion’s mouth.
chapters.zh: 惟有主站在我旁边，加给我力量，使福音被我尽都传明，叫外邦人都听见。我也从狮子口里被救出来。

chapters.en: The Lord will rescue me from every evil attack and will bring me safely to his heavenly kingdom. To him be glory for ever and ever. Amen.
chapters.zh: 主必救我脱离诸般的凶恶，也必救我进他的天国。愿荣耀归给他，直到永永远远。阿们。

chapters.en: Greet Priscilla and Aquila and the household of Onesiphorus.
chapters.zh: 问百基拉，亚居拉，和阿尼色弗一家的人安。

chapters.en: Erastus stayed in Corinth, and I left Trophimus sick in Miletus.
chapters.zh: 以拉都在哥林多住下了。特罗非摩病了，我就留他在米利都。

chapters.en: Do your best to get here before winter. Eubulus greets you, and so do Pudens, Linus, Claudia and all the brothers and sisters.
chapters.zh: 你要赶紧在冬天以前到我这里来。有友布罗，布田，利奴，革老底亚，和众弟兄，都问你安。

chapters.en: The Lord be with your spirit. Grace be with you all.
chapters.zh: 愿主与你的灵同在。愿恩惠常与你们同在。

chapters.en: Paul, a servant of God and an apostle of Jesus Christ to further the faith of God’s elect and their knowledge of the truth that leads to godliness—
chapters.zh: 神的仆人，耶稣基督的使徒保罗，凭着神选民的信心，与敬虔真理的知识，

chapters.en: in the hope of eternal life, which God, who does not lie, promised before the beginning of time,
chapters.zh: 盼望那无谎言的神在万古之先所应许的永生，

chapters.en: and which now at his appointed season he has brought to light through the preaching entrusted to me by the command of God our Savior,
chapters.zh: 到了日期，借着传扬的工夫，把他的道显明了。这传扬的责任，是按着神我们救主的命令交托了我。

chapters.en: To Titus, my true son in our common faith: Grace and peace from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Savior.
chapters.zh: 现在写信给提多，就是照着我们共信之道作我真儿子的。愿恩惠平安，从父神和我们的救主基督耶稣归与你。

chapters.en: The reason I left you in Crete was that you might put in order what was left unfinished and appoint elders in every town, as I directed you.
chapters.zh: 我从前留你在革哩底，是要你将那没有办完的事都办整齐了，又照我所吩咐你的，在各城设立长老。

chapters.en: An elder must be blameless, faithful to his wife, a man whose children believe and are not open to the charge of being wild and disobedient.
chapters.zh: 若有无可指责的人，只作一个妇人的丈夫，儿女也是信主的，没有人告他们是放荡不服约束的，就可以设立。

chapters.en: Since an overseer manages God’s household, he must be blameless—not overbearing, not quick-tempered, not given to drunkenness, not violent, not pursuing dishonest gain.
chapters.zh: 监督既是神的管家，必须无可指责，不任性，不暴躁，不因酒滋事，不打人，不贪无义之财，

chapters.en: Rather, he must be hospitable, one who loves what is good, who is self-controlled, upright, holy and disciplined.
chapters.zh: 乐意接待远人，好善，庄重，公平，圣洁，自持。

chapters.en: He must hold firmly to the trustworthy message as it has been taught, so that he can encourage others by sound doctrine and refute those who oppose it.
chapters.zh: 坚守所教真实的道理，就能将纯正的教训劝化人。又能把争辩的人驳倒了。

chapters.en: For there are many rebellious people, full of meaningless talk and deception, especially those of the circumcision group.
chapters.zh: 因为有许多人不服约束，说虚空话，欺哄人。那奉割礼的，更是这样。

chapters.en: They must be silenced, because they are disrupting whole households by teaching things they ought not to teach—and that for the sake of dishonest gain.
chapters.zh: 这些人的口总要堵住。他们因贪不义之财，将不该教导的教导人，败坏人的全家。

chapters.en: One of Crete’s own prophets has said it: “Cretans are always liars, evil brutes, lazy gluttons.”
chapters.zh: 有革哩底人中的一个本地先知说，革哩底人常说谎话，乃是恶兽，又馋又懒。

chapters.en: This saying is true. Therefore rebuke them sharply, so that they will be sound in the faith
chapters.zh: 这个见证是真的。所以你要严严地责备他们，使他们在真道上纯全无疵。

chapters.en: and will pay no attention to Jewish myths or to the merely human commands of those who reject the truth.
chapters.zh: 不听犹太人荒渺的言语，和离弃真道之人的诫命。

chapters.en: To the pure, all things are pure, but to those who are corrupted and do not believe, nothing is pure. In fact, both their minds and consciences are corrupted.
chapters.zh: 在洁净的人，凡物都洁净。在污秽不信的人，什么都不洁净。连心地和天良，也都污秽了。

chapters.en: They claim to know God, but by their actions they deny him. They are detestable, disobedient and unfit for doing anything good.
chapters.zh: 他们说是认识神行事却和他相背。本是可憎恶的，是悖逆的，在各样善事上是可废弃的。

chapters.en: You, however, must teach what is appropriate to sound doctrine.
chapters.zh: 但你所讲的，总要合乎那纯正的道理。

chapters.en: Teach the older men to be temperate, worthy of respect, self-controlled, and sound in faith, in love and in endurance.
chapters.zh: 劝老年人，要有节制，端庄，自守，在信心爱心忍耐上，都要纯全无疵。

chapters.en: Likewise, teach the older women to be reverent in the way they live, not to be slanderers or addicted to much wine, but to teach what is good.
chapters.zh: 又劝老年妇人，举止行动要恭敬，不说谗言，不给酒作奴仆，用善道教训人。

chapters.en: Then they can urge the younger women to love their husbands and children,
chapters.zh: 好指教少年妇人，爱丈夫，爱儿女，

chapters.en: to be self-controlled and pure, to be busy at home, to be kind, and to be subject to their husbands, so that no one will malign the word of God.
chapters.zh: 谨守贞洁，料理家务，待人有恩，顺服自己的丈夫，免得神的道理被毁谤。

chapters.en: Similarly, encourage the young men to be self-controlled.
chapters.zh: 又劝少年人要谨守。

chapters.en: In everything set them an example by doing what is good. In your teaching show integrity, seriousness
chapters.zh: 你自己凡事要显出善行的榜样，在教训上要正直，端庄，

chapters.en: and soundness of speech that cannot be condemned, so that those who oppose you may be ashamed because they have nothing bad to say about us.
chapters.zh: 言语纯全，无可指责，叫那反对的人，既无处可说我们的不是，便自觉羞愧。

chapters.en: Teach slaves to be subject to their masters in everything, to try to please them, not to talk back to them,
chapters.zh: 劝仆人要顺服自己的主人，凡事讨他的喜欢。不可顶撞他。

chapters.en: and not to steal from them, but to show that they can be fully trusted, so that in every way they will make the teaching about God our Savior attractive.
chapters.zh: 不可私拿东西。要显为忠诚，以致凡事尊荣我们救主神的道。

chapters.en: For the grace of God has appeared that offers salvation to all people.
chapters.zh: 因为神救众人的恩典，已经显明出来，

chapters.en: It teaches us to say “No” to ungodliness and worldly passions, and to live self-controlled, upright and godly lives in this present age,
chapters.zh: 教训我们除去不敬虔的心，和世俗的情欲，在今世自守，公义，敬虔度日。
