chapters.en: Be patient, then, brothers and sisters, until the Lord’s coming. See how the farmer waits for the land to yield its valuable crop, patiently waiting for the autumn and spring rains.
chapters.zh: 弟兄们哪，你们要忍耐直到主来。看哪，农夫忍耐等候地里宝贵的出产，直到得了秋雨春雨。

chapters.en: You too, be patient and stand firm, because the Lord’s coming is near.
chapters.zh: 你们也当忍耐，坚固你们的心。因为主来的日子近了。

chapters.en: Don’t grumble against one another, brothers and sisters, or you will be judged. The Judge is standing at the door!
chapters.zh: 弟兄们，你们不要彼此埋怨，免得受审判。看哪，审判的主站在门前了。

chapters.en: Brothers and sisters, as an example of patience in the face of suffering, take the prophets who spoke in the name of the Lord.
chapters.zh: 弟兄们，你们要把那先前奉主名说话的众先知，当作能受苦能忍耐的榜样。

chapters.en: As you know, we count as blessed those who have persevered. You have heard of Job’s perseverance and have seen what the Lord finally brought about. The Lord is full of compassion and mercy.
chapters.zh: 那先前忍耐的人，我们称他们是有福的，你们听见过约伯的忍耐，也知道主给他的结局，明显主是满心怜悯，大有慈悲。

chapters.en: Above all, my brothers and sisters, do not swear—not by heaven or by earth or by anything else. All you need to say is a simple “Yes” or “No.” Otherwise you will be condemned.
chapters.zh: 我的弟兄们，最要紧的是不可起誓。不可指着天起誓，也不可指着地起誓，无论何誓都不可起。你们说话，是就说是，不是就说不是，免得你们落在审判之下。

chapters.en: Is anyone among you in trouble? Let them pray. Is anyone happy? Let them sing songs of praise.
chapters.zh: 你们中间有受苦的呢，他就该祷告。有喜乐的呢，他就该歌颂。

chapters.en: Is anyone among you sick? Let them call the elders of the church to pray over them and anoint them with oil in the name of the Lord.
chapters.zh: 你们中间有病了的呢，他就该请教会的长老来。他们可以奉主的名用油抹他，为他祷告。

chapters.en: And the prayer offered in faith will make the sick person well; the Lord will raise them up. If they have sinned, they will be forgiven.
chapters.zh: 出于信心的祈祷，要救那病人，主必叫他起来。他若犯了罪，也必蒙赦免。

chapters.en: Therefore confess your sins to each other and pray for each other so that you may be healed. The prayer of a righteous person is powerful and effective.
chapters.zh: 所以你们要彼此认罪，互相代求，使你们可以得医治。义人祈祷所发的力量，是大有功效的。

chapters.en: Elijah was a human being, even as we are. He prayed earnestly that it would not rain, and it did not rain on the land for three and a half years.
chapters.zh: 以利亚与我们是一样性情的人，他恳切祷告，求不要下雨，雨就三年零六个月不下在地上。

chapters.en: Again he prayed, and the heavens gave rain, and the earth produced its crops.
chapters.zh: 他又祷告，天就降下雨来，地也生出土产。

chapters.en: My brothers and sisters, if one of you should wander from the truth and someone should bring that person back,
chapters.zh: 我的弟兄们，你们中间若有失迷真道的，有人使他回转。

chapters.en: remember this: Whoever turns a sinner from the error of their way will save them from death and cover over a multitude of sins.
chapters.zh: 这人该知道叫一个罪人从迷路上转回，便是救一个灵魂不死，并且遮盖许多的罪。

chapters.en: Peter, an apostle of Jesus Christ, To God’s elect, exiles scattered throughout the provinces of Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia and Bithynia,
chapters.zh: 耶稣基督的使徒彼得，写信给那分散在本都，加拉太，加帕多家，亚西亚，庇推尼寄居的。

chapters.en: who have been chosen according to the foreknowledge of God the Father, through the sanctifying work of the Spirit, to be obedient to Jesus Christ and sprinkled with his blood: Grace and peace be yours in abundance.
chapters.zh: 就是照父神的先见被拣选，借着圣灵得成圣洁，以致顺服耶稣基督，又蒙他血所洒的人。愿恩惠平安，多多地加给你们。

chapters.en: Praise be to the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ! In his great mercy he has given us new birth into a living hope through the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead,
chapters.zh: 愿颂赞归与我们主耶稣基督的父神，他曾照自己的大怜悯，借耶稣基督从死里复活重生了我们，叫我们有活泼的盼望，

chapters.en: and into an inheritance that can never perish, spoil or fade. This inheritance is kept in heaven for you,
chapters.zh: 可以得着不能朽坏，不能玷污，不能衰残，为你们存留在天上的基业。

chapters.en: who through faith are shielded by God’s power until the coming of the salvation that is ready to be revealed in the last time.
chapters.zh: 你们这因信蒙神能力保守的人，必能得着所预备，到末世要显现的救恩。

chapters.en: In all this you greatly rejoice, though now for a little while you may have had to suffer grief in all kinds of trials.
chapters.zh: 因此，你们是大有喜乐，但如今，在百般的试炼中暂时忧愁。

chapters.en: These have come so that the proven genuineness of your faith—of greater worth than gold, which perishes even though refined by fire—may result in praise, glory and honor when Jesus Christ is revealed.
chapters.zh: 叫你们的信心既被试验，就比那被火试验，仍然能坏的金子，更显宝贵。可以在耶稣基督显现的时候，得着称赞，荣耀，尊贵。

chapters.en: Though you have not seen him, you love him; and even though you do not see him now, you believe in him and are filled with an inexpressible and glorious joy,
chapters.zh: 你们虽然没有见过他，却是爱他。如今虽不得看见，却因信他就有说不出来，满有荣光的大喜乐。

chapters.en: for you are receiving the end result of your faith, the salvation of your souls.
chapters.zh: 并且得着你们信心的果效，就是灵魂的救恩。

chapters.en: Concerning this salvation, the prophets, who spoke of the grace that was to come to you, searched intently and with the greatest care,
chapters.zh: 论到这救恩，那预先说你们要得恩典的众先知，早已详细的寻求考察。

chapters.en: trying to find out the time and circumstances to which the Spirit of Christ in them was pointing when he predicted the sufferings of the Messiah and the glories that would follow.
chapters.zh: 就是考察在他们心里基督的灵，预先证明基督受苦难，后来得荣耀，是指着什么时候，并怎样的时候。

chapters.en: It was revealed to them that they were not serving themselves but you, when they spoke of the things that have now been told you by those who have preached the gospel to you by the Holy Spirit sent from heaven. Even angels long to look into these things.
chapters.zh: 他们得了启示，知道他们所传讲的一切事（传讲原文作服事），不是为自己，乃是为你们。那靠着从天上差来的圣灵，传福音给你们的人，现在将这些事报给你们。天使也愿意详细察看这些事。

chapters.en: Therefore, with minds that are alert and fully sober, set your hope on the grace to be brought to you when Jesus Christ is revealed at his coming.
chapters.zh: 所以要约束你们的心（原文作束上你们心中的腰），谨慎自守，专心盼望耶稣基督显现的时候所带来给你们的恩。

chapters.en: As obedient children, do not conform to the evil desires you had when you lived in ignorance.
chapters.zh: 你们既作顺命的儿女，就不要效法从前蒙昧无知的时候，那放纵私欲的样子。

chapters.en: But just as he who called you is holy, so be holy in all you do;
chapters.zh: 那召你们的既是圣洁，你们在一切所行的事上也要圣洁。

chapters.en: for it is written: “Be holy, because I am holy.”
chapters.zh: 因为经上记着说，你们要圣洁，因为我是圣洁的。

chapters.en: Since you call on a Father who judges each person’s work impartially, live out your time as foreigners here in reverent fear.
chapters.zh: 你们既称那不偏待人，按各人行为审判人的主为父，就当存敬畏的心，度你们在世寄居的日子。

chapters.en: For you know that it was not with perishable things such as silver or gold that you were redeemed from the empty way of life handed down to you from your ancestors,
chapters.zh: 知道你们得赎，脱去你们祖宗所传流虚妄的行为，不是凭着能坏的金银等物。

chapters.en: but with the precious blood of Christ, a lamb without blemish or defect.
chapters.zh: 乃是凭着基督的宝血，如同无瑕疵无玷污的羔羊之血。

chapters.en: He was chosen before the creation of the world, but was revealed in these last times for your sake.
chapters.zh: 基督在创世以前，是预先被神知道的，却在这末世，才为你们显现。

chapters.en: Through him you believe in God, who raised him from the dead and glorified him, and so your faith and hope are in God.
chapters.zh: 你们也因着他，信那叫他从死里复活，又给他荣耀的神，叫你们的信心，和盼望，都在于神。

chapters.en: Now that you have purified yourselves by obeying the truth so that you have sincere love for each other, love one another deeply, from the heart.
chapters.zh: 你们既因顺从真理，洁净了自己的心，以致爱弟兄没有虚假，就当从心里彼此切实相爱。从心里有古卷作从清洁的心

chapters.en: For you have been born again, not of perishable seed, but of imperishable, through the living and enduring word of God.
chapters.zh: 你们蒙了重生，不是由于能坏的种子，乃是由于不能坏的种子，是借着神活泼常存的道。

chapters.en: For, “All people are like grass, and all their glory is like the flowers of the field; the grass withers and the flowers fall,
chapters.zh: 因为凡有血气的，尽都如草，他的美荣，都像草上的花。草必枯干，花必凋谢。

chapters.en: but the word of the Lord endures forever.”And this is the word that was preached to you.
chapters.zh: 惟有主的道是永存的。所传给你们的福音就是这道。

chapters.en: Therefore, rid yourselves of all malice and all deceit, hypocrisy, envy, and slander of every kind.
chapters.zh: 所以你们既除去一切的恶毒（或作阴毒），诡诈，并假善，嫉妒，和一切毁谤的话，

chapters.en: Like newborn babies, crave pure spiritual milk, so that by it you may grow up in your salvation,
chapters.zh: 就要爱慕那纯净的灵奶，像才生的婴孩爱慕奶一样，叫你们因此渐长，以致得救。

chapters.en: now that you have tasted that the Lord is good.
chapters.zh: 你们若尝过主恩的滋味，就必如此

chapters.en: As you come to him, the living Stone—rejected by humans but chosen by God and precious to him—
chapters.zh: 主乃活石。固然是被人所弃的，却是被神所拣选所宝贵的。

chapters.en: you also, like living stones, are being built into a spiritual house to be a holy priesthood, offering spiritual sacrifices acceptable to God through Jesus Christ.
chapters.zh: 你们来到主面前，也就像活石，被建造成为灵宫，作圣洁的祭司，借着耶稣基督奉献神所悦纳的灵祭。

chapters.en: For in Scripture it says: “See, I lay a stone in Zion, a chosen and precious cornerstone, and the one who trusts in him will never be put to shame.”
chapters.zh: 因为经上说，看哪，我把所拣选所宝贵的房角石，安放在锡安。信靠他的人，必不至于羞愧。

chapters.en: Now to you who believe, this stone is precious. But to those who do not believe, “The stone the builders rejected has become the cornerstone,”
chapters.zh: 所以他在你们信的人就为宝贵，在那不信的人有话说，匠人所弃的石头，已作了房角的头块石头。

chapters.en: and, “A stone that causes people to stumble and a rock that makes them fall.”They stumble because they disobey the message—which is also what they were destined for.
chapters.zh: 又说，作了绊脚的石头，跌人的磐石。他们既不顺从，就在道理上绊跌。（或作他们绊跌都因不顺从道理）他们这样绊跌也是预定的。

chapters.en: But you are a chosen people, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, God’s special possession, that you may declare the praises of him who called you out of darkness into his wonderful light.
chapters.zh: 惟有你们是被拣选的族类，是有君尊的祭司，是圣洁的国度，是属神的子民，要叫你们宣扬那召你们出黑暗入奇妙光明者的美德。

chapters.en: Once you were not a people, but now you are the people of God; once you had not received mercy, but now you have received mercy.
chapters.zh: 你们从前算不得子民，现在却作了神的子民。从前未曾蒙怜恤，现在却蒙了怜恤。

chapters.en: Dear friends, I urge you, as foreigners and exiles, to abstain from sinful desires, which wage war against your soul.
chapters.zh: 亲爱的弟兄阿你们是客旅，是寄居的。我劝你们要禁戒肉体的私欲。这私欲是与灵魂争战的。

chapters.en: Live such good lives among the pagans that, though they accuse you of doing wrong, they may see your good deeds and glorify God on the day he visits us.
chapters.zh: 你们在外邦人中，应当品行端正，叫那些毁谤你们是作恶的，因看见你们的好行为，便在鉴察的日子（鉴察或作眷顾），归荣耀给神。

chapters.en: Submit yourselves for the Lord’s sake to every human authority: whether to the emperor, as the supreme authority,
chapters.zh: 你们为主的缘故，要顺服人的一切制度，或是在上的君王，

chapters.en: or to governors, who are sent by him to punish those who do wrong and to commend those who do right.
chapters.zh: 或是君王所派罚恶赏善的臣宰。

chapters.en: For it is God’s will that by doing good you should silence the ignorant talk of foolish people.
chapters.zh: 因为神的旨意原是要你们行善，可以堵住那糊涂无知人的口。

chapters.en: Live as free people, but do not use your freedom as a cover-up for evil; live as God’s slaves.
chapters.zh: 你们虽是自由的，却不可借着自由遮盖恶毒（或作阴毒），总要作神的仆人。

chapters.en: Show proper respect to everyone, love the family of believers, fear God, honor the emperor.
chapters.zh: 务要尊敬众人。亲爱教中的弟兄。敬畏神。尊敬君王。

chapters.en: Slaves, in reverent fear of God submit yourselves to your masters, not only to those who are good and considerate, but also to those who are harsh.
chapters.zh: 你们作仆人的，凡事要存敬畏的心顺服主人。不但顺服那善良温和的，就是那乖僻的也要顺服。

chapters.en: For it is commendable if someone bears up under the pain of unjust suffering because they are conscious of God.
chapters.zh: 倘若人为叫良心对得住神，就忍受冤屈的苦楚，这是可喜爱的。

chapters.en: But how is it to your credit if you receive a beating for doing wrong and endure it? But if you suffer for doing good and you endure it, this is commendable before God.
chapters.zh: 你们若因犯罪受责打，能忍耐，有什么可夸的呢？但你们若因行善受苦，能忍耐，这在神看是可喜爱的。

chapters.en: To this you were called, because Christ suffered for you, leaving you an example, that you should follow in his steps.
chapters.zh: 你们蒙召原是为此。因基督也为你们受过苦，给你们留下榜样，叫你们跟随他的脚踪行。

chapters.en: “He committed no sin, and no deceit was found in his mouth.”
chapters.zh: 他并没有犯罪，口里也没有诡诈。

chapters.en: When they hurled their insults at him, he did not retaliate; when he suffered, he made no threats. Instead, he entrusted himself to him who judges justly.
chapters.zh: 他被骂不还口。受害不说威吓的话。只将自己交托那按公义审判人的主。

chapters.en: “He himself bore our sins” in his body on the cross, so that we might die to sins and live for righteousness; “by his wounds you have been healed.”
chapters.zh: 他被挂在木头上亲身担当了我们的罪，使我们既然在罪上死，就得以在义上活。因他受的鞭伤，你们便得了医治。

chapters.en: For “you were like sheep going astray,” but now you have returned to the Shepherd and Overseer of your souls.
chapters.zh: 你们从前好像迷路的羊。如今却归到你们灵魂的牧人监督了。

chapters.en: Wives, in the same way submit yourselves to your own husbands so that, if any of them do not believe the word, they may be won over without words by the behavior of their wives,
chapters.zh: 你们作妻子的，要顺服自己的丈夫。这样，若有不信从道理的丈夫，他们虽然不听道，也可以因妻子的品行被感化过来。

chapters.en: when they see the purity and reverence of your lives.
chapters.zh: 这正是因看见你们有贞洁的品行，和敬畏的心。

chapters.en: Your beauty should not come from outward adornment, such as elaborate hairstyles and the wearing of gold jewelry or fine clothes.
chapters.zh: 你们不要以外面的辫头发，戴金饰，穿美衣，为妆饰，

chapters.en: Rather, it should be that of your inner self, the unfading beauty of a gentle and quiet spirit, which is of great worth in God’s sight.
chapters.zh: 只要以里面存着长久温柔安静的心为妆饰。这在神面前是极宝贵的。

chapters.en: For this is the way the holy women of the past who put their hope in God used to adorn themselves. They submitted themselves to their own husbands,
chapters.zh: 因为古时仰赖神的圣洁妇人，正是以此为妆饰，顺服自己的丈夫。

chapters.en: like Sarah, who obeyed Abraham and called him her lord. You are her daughters if you do what is right and do not give way to fear.
chapters.zh: 就如撒拉听从亚伯拉罕，称他为主。你们若行善，不因恐吓而害怕，便是撒拉的女儿了。

chapters.en: Husbands, in the same way be considerate as you live with your wives, and treat them with respect as the weaker partner and as heirs with you of the gracious gift of life, so that nothing will hinder your prayers.
chapters.zh: 你们作丈夫的，也要按情理和妻子同住（情理原文作知识）。因她比你软弱（比你软弱原文作是软弱的器皿），与你一同承受生命之恩的，所以要敬重她。这样便叫你们的祷告没有阻碍。

chapters.en: Finally, all of you, be like-minded, be sympathetic, love one another, be compassionate and humble.
chapters.zh: 总而言之，你们都要同心，彼此体恤，相爱如弟兄，存慈怜谦卑的心。

chapters.en: Do not repay evil with evil or insult with insult. On the contrary, repay evil with blessing, because to this you were called so that you may inherit a blessing.
chapters.zh: 不以恶报恶，以辱骂还辱骂，倒要祝福。因你们是为此蒙召，好叫你们承受福气。

chapters.en: For, “Whoever would love life and see good days must keep their tongue from evil and their lips from deceitful speech.
chapters.zh: 因为经上说，人若爱生命，愿享美福，须要禁止舌头不出恶言，嘴唇不说诡诈的话。

chapters.en: They must turn from evil and do good; they must seek peace and pursue it.
chapters.zh: 也要离恶行善。寻求和睦，一心追赶。

chapters.en: For the eyes of the Lord are on the righteous and his ears are attentive to their prayer, but the face of the Lord is against those who do evil.”
chapters.zh: 因为主的眼看顾义人，主的耳听他们的祈祷。惟有行恶的人，主向他们变脸。

chapters.en: Who is going to harm you if you are eager to do good?
chapters.zh: 你们若是热心行善，有谁害你们呢？

chapters.en: But even if you should suffer for what is right, you are blessed. “Do not fear their threats ; do not be frightened.”
chapters.zh: 你们就是为义受苦，也是有福的。不要怕人的威吓，也不要惊慌（的威吓或作所怕的）。

chapters.en: But in your hearts revere Christ as Lord. Always be prepared to give an answer to everyone who asks you to give the reason for the hope that you have. But do this with gentleness and respect,
chapters.zh: 只要心里尊主基督为圣。有人问你们心中盼望的缘由，就要常作准备，以温柔敬畏的心回答各人。

chapters.en: keeping a clear conscience, so that those who speak maliciously against your good behavior in Christ may be ashamed of their slander.
chapters.zh: 存着无亏的良心，叫你们在何事上被毁谤，就在何事上，可以叫那诬赖你们在基督里有好品行的人，自觉羞愧。

chapters.en: For it is better, if it is God’s will, to suffer for doing good than for doing evil.
chapters.zh: 神的旨意若是叫你们因行善受苦，总强如因行恶受苦。

chapters.en: For Christ also suffered once for sins, the righteous for the unrighteous, to bring you to God. He was put to death in the body but made alive in the Spirit.
chapters.zh: 因基督也曾一次为罪受苦（受苦有古卷作受死），就是义的代替不义的，为要引我们到神面前。按着肉体说他被治死。按着灵性说他复活了。

chapters.en: After being made alive, he went and made proclamation to the imprisoned spirits—
chapters.zh: 他借这灵，曾去传道给那些在监狱里的灵听。

chapters.en: to those who were disobedient long ago when God waited patiently in the days of Noah while the ark was being built. In it only a few people, eight in all, were saved through water,
chapters.zh: 就是那从前在挪亚预备方舟，神容忍等待的时候，不信从的人。当时进入方舟，借着水得救的不多，只有八个人。

chapters.en: and this water symbolizes baptism that now saves you also—not the removal of dirt from the body but the pledge of a clear conscience toward God. It saves you by the resurrection of Jesus Christ,
chapters.zh: 这水所表明的洗礼，现在借着耶稣基督复活。也拯救你们。这洗礼本不在乎除掉肉体的污秽，只求在神面前有无亏的良心。

chapters.en: who has gone into heaven and is at God’s right hand—with angels, authorities and powers in submission to him.
chapters.zh: 耶稣已经进入天堂，在神的右边。众天使和有权柄的，并有能力的，都服从了他。

chapters.en: Therefore, since Christ suffered in his body, arm yourselves also with the same attitude, because whoever suffers in the body is done with sin.
chapters.zh: 基督既在肉身受苦，你们也当将这样的心志作为兵器。因为在肉身受过苦的，就已经与罪断绝了。

chapters.en: As a result, they do not live the rest of their earthly lives for evil human desires, but rather for the will of God.
chapters.zh: 你们存这样的心，从今以后，就可以不从人的情欲，只从神的旨意，在世度余下的光阴。

chapters.en: For you have spent enough time in the past doing what pagans choose to do—living in debauchery, lust, drunkenness, orgies, carousing and detestable idolatry.
chapters.zh: 因为往日随从外邦人的心意，行邪淫，恶欲，醉酒，荒宴，群饮，并可恶拜偶像的事，时候已经够了。

chapters.en: They are surprised that you do not join them in their reckless, wild living, and they heap abuse on you.
chapters.zh: 他们在这些事上，见你们不与他们同奔那放荡无度的路，就以为怪毁谤你们。

chapters.en: But they will have to give account to him who is ready to judge the living and the dead.
chapters.zh: 他们必在那将要审判活人死人的主面前交账。

chapters.en: For this is the reason the gospel was preached even to those who are now dead, so that they might be judged according to human standards in regard to the body, but live according to God in regard to the spirit.
chapters.zh: 为此，就是死人也曾有福音传给他们，要叫他们的肉体按着人受审判，他们的灵性却靠神活着。

chapters.en: The end of all things is near. Therefore be alert and of sober mind so that you may pray.
chapters.zh: 万物的结局近了。所以你们要谨慎自守，儆醒祷告。

chapters.en: Above all, love each other deeply, because love covers over a multitude of sins.
chapters.zh: 最要紧的是彼此切实相爱。因为爱能遮掩许多的罪。

chapters.en: Offer hospitality to one another without grumbling.
chapters.zh: 你们要互相款待，不发怨言。

chapters.en: Each of you should use whatever gift you have received to serve others, as faithful stewards of God’s grace in its various forms.
chapters.zh: 各人要照所得的恩赐彼此服事，作神百般恩赐的好管家。

chapters.en: If anyone speaks, they should do so as one who speaks the very words of God. If anyone serves, they should do so with the strength God provides, so that in all things God may be praised through Jesus Christ. To him be the glory and the power for ever and ever. Amen.
chapters.zh: 若有讲道的，要按着神的圣言讲。若有服事人的，要按着神所赐的力量服事。叫神在凡事上因耶稣基督得荣耀。原来荣耀权能都是他的，直到永永远远。阿们。

chapters.en: Dear friends, do not be surprised at the fiery ordeal that has come on you to test you, as though something strange were happening to you.
chapters.zh: 亲爱的弟兄阿，有火炼的试验临到你们，不要以为奇怪，（似乎是遭遇非常的事）

chapters.en: But rejoice inasmuch as you participate in the sufferings of Christ, so that you may be overjoyed when his glory is revealed.
chapters.zh: 倒要欢喜。因为你们是与基督一同受苦，使你们在他荣耀显现的时候，也可以欢喜快乐。

chapters.en: If you are insulted because of the name of Christ, you are blessed, for the Spirit of glory and of God rests on you.
chapters.zh: 你们若为基督的名受辱骂，便是有福的。因为神荣耀的灵，常住在你们身上。

chapters.en: If you suffer, it should not be as a murderer or thief or any other kind of criminal, or even as a meddler.
chapters.zh: 你们中间却不可有人，因为杀人，偷窃，作恶，好管闲事而受苦。

chapters.en: However, if you suffer as a Christian, do not be ashamed, but praise God that you bear that name.
chapters.zh: 若为作基督徒受苦，却不要羞耻。倒要因这名归荣耀给神。

chapters.en: For it is time for judgment to begin with God’s household; and if it begins with us, what will the outcome be for those who do not obey the gospel of God?
chapters.zh: 因为时候到了，审判要从神的家起首。若是先从我们起首，那不信从神福音的人，将有何等的结局呢？

chapters.en: And, “If it is hard for the righteous to be saved, what will become of the ungodly and the sinner?”
chapters.zh: 若是义人仅仅得救，那不虔敬和犯罪的人，将有何地可站呢？

chapters.en: So then, those who suffer according to God’s will should commit themselves to their faithful Creator and continue to do good.
chapters.zh: 所以那照神旨意受苦的人，要一心为善，将自己灵魂交与那信实的造化之主。

chapters.en: To the elders among you, I appeal as a fellow elder and a witness of Christ’s sufferings who also will share in the glory to be revealed:
chapters.zh: 我这作长老，作基督受苦的见证，同享后来所要显现之荣耀的，劝你们中间与我同作长老的人。

chapters.en: Be shepherds of God’s flock that is under your care, watching over them—not because you must, but because you are willing, as God wants you to be; not pursuing dishonest gain, but eager to serve;
chapters.zh: 务要牧养在你们中间神的群羊，按着神旨意照管他们。不是出于勉强，乃是出于甘心。也不是因为贪财，乃是出于乐意。

chapters.en: not lording it over those entrusted to you, but being examples to the flock.
chapters.zh: 也不是辖制所托付你们的，乃是作群羊的榜样。

chapters.en: And when the Chief Shepherd appears, you will receive the crown of glory that will never fade away.
chapters.zh: 到了牧长显现的时候，你们必得那永不衰残的荣耀冠冕。

chapters.en: In the same way, you who are younger, submit yourselves to your elders. All of you, clothe yourselves with humility toward one another, because, “God opposes the proud but shows favor to the humble.”
chapters.zh: 你们年幼的，也要顺服年长的。就是你们众人，也都要以谦卑束腰，彼此顺服。因为神阻挡骄傲的人，赐恩给谦卑的人。

chapters.en: Humble yourselves, therefore, under God’s mighty hand, that he may lift you up in due time.
chapters.zh: 所以你们要自卑，服在神大能的手下，到了时候他必叫你们升高。

chapters.en: Cast all your anxiety on him because he cares for you.
chapters.zh: 你们要将一切的忧虑卸给神，因为他顾念你们。

chapters.en: Be alert and of sober mind. Your enemy the devil prowls around like a roaring lion looking for someone to devour.
chapters.zh: 务要谨守，儆醒。因为你们的仇敌魔鬼，如同吼叫的狮子，遍地游行，寻找可吞吃的人。

chapters.en: Resist him, standing firm in the faith, because you know that the family of believers throughout the world is undergoing the same kind of sufferings.
chapters.zh: 你们要用坚固的信心抵挡他，因为知道你们在世上的众弟兄，也是经历这样的苦难。

chapters.en: And the God of all grace, who called you to his eternal glory in Christ, after you have suffered a little while, will himself restore you and make you strong, firm and steadfast.
chapters.zh: 那赐诸般恩典的神，曾在基督里召你们，得享他永远的荣耀，等你们暂受苦难之后，必要亲自成全你们，坚固你们，赐力量给你们。

chapters.en: To him be the power for ever and ever. Amen.
chapters.zh: 愿权能归给他，直到永永远远。阿们。

chapters.en: With the help of Silas, whom I regard as a faithful brother, I have written to you briefly, encouraging you and testifying that this is the true grace of God. Stand fast in it.
chapters.zh: 我略略地写了这信，托我所看为忠心的兄弟西拉转交你们，劝勉你们，又证明这恩是神的真恩。你们务要在这恩上站立得住。

chapters.en: She who is in Babylon, chosen together with you, sends you her greetings, and so does my son Mark.
chapters.zh: 在巴比伦与你们同蒙拣选的教会问你们安。我儿子马可也问你们安。

chapters.en: Greet one another with a kiss of love. Peace to all of you who are in Christ.
chapters.zh: 你们要用爱心彼此亲嘴问安。愿平安归与你们凡在基督里的人。

chapters.en: Simon Peter, a servant and apostle of Jesus Christ, To those who through the righteousness of our God and Savior Jesus Christ have received a faith as precious as ours:
chapters.zh: 作耶稣基督仆人和使徒的西门彼得，写信给那因我们的神，和（有古卷无和字）救主耶稣基督之义，与我们同得一样宝贵信心的人。

chapters.en: Grace and peace be yours in abundance through the knowledge of God and of Jesus our Lord.
chapters.zh: 愿恩惠平安，因你们认识神和我们主耶稣，多多地加给你们。

chapters.en: His divine power has given us everything we need for a godly life through our knowledge of him who called us by his own glory and goodness.
chapters.zh: 神的神能已将一切关乎生命和虔敬的事赐给我们，皆因我们认识那用自己荣耀和美德召我们的主。

chapters.en: Through these he has given us his very great and precious promises, so that through them you may participate in the divine nature, having escaped the corruption in the world caused by evil desires.
chapters.zh: 因此他已将又宝贵又极大的应许赐给我们，叫我们既脱离世上从情欲来的败坏，就得与神的性情有分。

chapters.en: For this very reason, make every effort to add to your faith goodness; and to goodness, knowledge;
chapters.zh: 正因这缘故，你们要分外地殷勤。有了信心，又要加上德行。有了德行，又要加上知识。

chapters.en: and to knowledge, self-control; and to self-control, perseverance; and to perseverance, godliness;
chapters.zh: 有了知识，又要加上节制。有了节制，又要加上忍耐。有了忍耐，又要加上虔敬。

chapters.en: and to godliness, mutual affection; and to mutual affection, love.
chapters.zh: 有了虔敬，又要加上爱弟兄的心。有了爱弟兄的心，又要加上爱众人的心

chapters.en: For if you possess these qualities in increasing measure, they will keep you from being ineffective and unproductive in your knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ.
chapters.zh: 你们若充充足足地有这几样，就必使你们在认识我们的主耶稣基督上，不至于闲懒不结果子了。

chapters.en: But whoever does not have them is nearsighted and blind, forgetting that they have been cleansed from their past sins.
chapters.zh: 人若没有这几样，就是眼瞎，只看见近处的，忘了他旧日的罪已经得了洁净。

chapters.en: Therefore, my brothers and sisters, make every effort to confirm your calling and election. For if you do these things, you will never stumble,
chapters.zh: 所以弟兄们，应当更加殷勤，使你们所蒙的恩召和拣选坚定不移。你们若行这几样，就永不失脚。

chapters.en: and you will receive a rich welcome into the eternal kingdom of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ.
chapters.zh: 这样，必叫你们丰丰富富地，得以进入我们主救主耶稣基督永远的国。

chapters.en: So I will always remind you of these things, even though you know them and are firmly established in the truth you now have.
chapters.zh: 你们虽然晓得这些事，并且在你们已有的真道上坚固，我却要将这些事常常提醒你们。

chapters.en: I think it is right to refresh your memory as long as I live in the tent of this body,
chapters.zh: 我以为应当趁我还在这帐棚的时候提醒你们，激发你们。

chapters.en: because I know that I will soon put it aside, as our Lord Jesus Christ has made clear to me.
chapters.zh: 因为知道我脱离这帐棚的时候快到了，正如我们主耶稣基督所指示我的。

chapters.en: And I will make every effort to see that after my departure you will always be able to remember these things.
chapters.zh: 并且我要尽心竭力，使你们在我去世以后，时常记念这些事。

chapters.en: For we did not follow cleverly devised stories when we told you about the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ in power, but we were eyewitnesses of his majesty.
chapters.zh: 我们从前，将我们主耶稣基督的大能，和他降临的事，告诉你们，并不是随从乖巧捏造的虚言，乃是亲眼见过他的威荣。

chapters.en: He received honor and glory from God the Father when the voice came to him from the Majestic Glory, saying, “This is my Son, whom I love; with him I am well pleased.”
chapters.zh: 他从父神得尊贵荣耀的时候，从极大荣光之中，有声音出来向他说，这是我的爱子，我所喜悦的。

chapters.en: We ourselves heard this voice that came from heaven when we were with him on the sacred mountain.
chapters.zh: 我们同他在圣山的时候，亲自听见这声音从天上出来。

chapters.en: We also have the prophetic message as something completely reliable, and you will do well to pay attention to it, as to a light shining in a dark place, until the day dawns and the morning star rises in your hearts.
chapters.zh: 我们并有先知更确的预言，如同灯照在暗处。你们在这预言上留意，直等到天发亮晨星在你们心里出现的时候，才是好的。

chapters.en: Above all, you must understand that no prophecy of Scripture came about by the prophet’s own interpretation of things.
chapters.zh: 第一要紧的，该知道经上所有的预言，没有可随私意解说的。

chapters.en: For prophecy never had its origin in the human will, but prophets, though human, spoke from God as they were carried along by the Holy Spirit.
chapters.zh: 因为预言从来没有出于人意的，乃是人被圣灵感动说出神的话来。

chapters.en: But there were also false prophets among the people, just as there will be false teachers among you. They will secretly introduce destructive heresies, even denying the sovereign Lord who bought them—bringing swift destruction on themselves.
chapters.zh: 从前在百姓中有假先知起来，将来在你们中间，也必有假师傅，私自引进陷害人的异端，连买他们的主他们也不承认，自取速速地灭亡。

chapters.en: Many will follow their depraved conduct and will bring the way of truth into disrepute.
chapters.zh: 将有许多人随从他们邪淫的行为，便叫真道，因他们的缘故被毁谤。

chapters.en: In their greed these teachers will exploit you with fabricated stories. Their condemnation has long been hanging over them, and their destruction has not been sleeping.
chapters.zh: 他们因有贪心，要用捏造的言语，在你们身上取利。他们的刑罚，自古以来并不迟延，他们的灭亡也必速速来到（原文作也不打盹）。

chapters.en: For if God did not spare angels when they sinned, but sent them to hell, putting them in chains of darkness to be held for judgment;
chapters.zh: 就是天使犯了罪，神也没有宽容，曾把他们丢在地狱，交在黑暗坑中，等候审判。

chapters.en: if he did not spare the ancient world when he brought the flood on its ungodly people, but protected Noah, a preacher of righteousness, and seven others;
chapters.zh: 神也没有宽容上古的世代，曾叫洪水临到那不敬虔的世代，却保护了传义道的挪亚一家八口。

chapters.en: if he condemned the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah by burning them to ashes, and made them an example of what is going to happen to the ungodly;
chapters.zh: 又判定所多玛，蛾摩拉，将二城倾覆，焚烧成灰，作为后世不敬虔人的鉴戒。

chapters.en: and if he rescued Lot, a righteous man, who was distressed by the depraved conduct of the lawless
chapters.zh: 只搭救了那常为恶人淫行忧伤的义人罗得。

chapters.en: (for that righteous man, living among them day after day, was tormented in his righteous soul by the lawless deeds he saw and heard)—
chapters.zh: 因为那义人住在他们中间，看见听见他们不法的事，他的义心就天天伤痛。

chapters.en: if this is so, then the Lord knows how to rescue the godly from trials and to hold the unrighteous for punishment on the day of judgment.
chapters.zh: 主知道搭救敬虔的人脱离试探，把不义的人留在刑罚之下，等候审判的日子。

chapters.en: This is especially true of those who follow the corrupt desire of the flesh and despise authority. Bold and arrogant, they are not afraid to heap abuse on celestial beings;
chapters.zh: 那些随肉身，纵污秽的情欲，轻慢主治之人的，更是如此。他们胆大任性，毁谤在尊位的也不知惧怕。

chapters.en: yet even angels, although they are stronger and more powerful, do not heap abuse on such beings when bringing judgment on them from the Lord.
chapters.zh: 就是天使，虽然力量权能更大，还不用毁谤的话在主面前告他们。

chapters.en: But these people blaspheme in matters they do not understand. They are like unreasoning animals, creatures of instinct, born only to be caught and destroyed, and like animals they too will perish.
chapters.zh: 但这些人好像没有灵性，生来就是畜类，以备捉拿宰杀的。他们毁谤所不晓得的事，正在败坏人的时候，自己必遭遇败坏。

chapters.en: They will be paid back with harm for the harm they have done. Their idea of pleasure is to carouse in broad daylight. They are blots and blemishes, reveling in their pleasures while they feast with you.
chapters.zh: 行的不义，就得了不义的工价。这些人喜爱白昼宴乐，他们已被玷污，又有瑕疵，正与你们一同坐席，就以自己的诡诈为快乐。

chapters.en: With eyes full of adultery, they never stop sinning; they seduce the unstable; they are experts in greed—an accursed brood!
chapters.zh: 他们满眼是淫色（淫色原文作淫妇），止不住犯罪。引诱那心不坚固的人，心中习惯了贪婪，正是被咒诅的种类。

chapters.en: They have left the straight way and wandered off to follow the way of Balaam son of Bezer, who loved the wages of wickedness.
chapters.zh: 他们离弃正路，就走差了，随从比珥之子巴兰的路，巴兰就是那贪爱不义之工价的先知。

chapters.en: But he was rebuked for his wrongdoing by a donkey—an animal without speech—who spoke with a human voice and restrained the prophet’s madness.
chapters.zh: 他却为自己的过犯受了责备。那不能说话的驴，以人言拦阻先知的狂妄。

chapters.en: These people are springs without water and mists driven by a storm. Blackest darkness is reserved for them.
chapters.zh: 这些人是无水的井，是狂风催逼的雾气，有墨黑的幽暗为他们存留。

chapters.en: For they mouth empty, boastful words and, by appealing to the lustful desires of the flesh, they entice people who are just escaping from those who live in error.
chapters.zh: 他们说虚妄矜夸的大话，用肉身的情欲，和邪淫的事，引诱那些刚才脱离妄行的人。

chapters.en: They promise them freedom, while they themselves are slaves of depravity—for “people are slaves to whatever has mastered them.”
chapters.zh: 他们应许人得以自由，自己却作败坏的奴仆。因为人被谁制伏就是谁的奴仆。

chapters.en: If they have escaped the corruption of the world by knowing our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ and are again entangled in it and are overcome, they are worse off at the end than they were at the beginning.
chapters.zh: 倘若他们因认识主救主耶稣基督，得以脱离世上的污秽，后来又在其中被缠住制伏，他们末后的景况，就比先前更不好了。

chapters.en: It would have been better for them not to have known the way of righteousness, than to have known it and then to turn their backs on the sacred command that was passed on to them.
chapters.zh: 他们晓得义路，竟背弃了传给他们的圣命，倒不如不晓得为妙。

chapters.en: Of them the proverbs are true: “A dog returns to its vomit,” and, “A sow that is washed returns to her wallowing in the mud.”
chapters.zh: 俗语说得真不错，狗所吐的，它转过来又吃。猪洗净了，又回到泥里去滚。这话在他们身上正合式。

chapters.en: Dear friends, this is now my second letter to you. I have written both of them as reminders to stimulate you to wholesome thinking.
chapters.zh: 亲爱的弟兄啊，我现在写给你们的是第二封信。这两封都是提醒你们，激发你们诚实的心。

chapters.en: I want you to recall the words spoken in the past by the holy prophets and the command given by our Lord and Savior through your apostles.
chapters.zh: 叫你们记念圣先知预先所说的话，和主救主的命令，就是使徒所传给你们的。

chapters.en: Above all, you must understand that in the last days scoffers will come, scoffing and following their own evil desires.
chapters.zh: 第一要紧的，该知道在末世必有好讥诮的人，随从自己的私欲出来讥诮说，

chapters.en: They will say, “Where is this ‘coming’ he promised? Ever since our ancestors died, everything goes on as it has since the beginning of creation.”
chapters.zh: 主要降临的应许在哪里呢？因为从列祖睡了以来，万物与起初创造的时候仍是一样。

chapters.en: But they deliberately forget that long ago by God’s word the heavens came into being and the earth was formed out of water and by water.
chapters.zh: 他们故意忘记，从太古凭神的命有了天，并从水而出借水而成的地。

chapters.en: By these waters also the world of that time was deluged and destroyed.
chapters.zh: 故此，当时的世界被水淹没就消灭了。

chapters.en: By the same word the present heavens and earth are reserved for fire, being kept for the day of judgment and destruction of the ungodly.
chapters.zh: 但现在的天地，还是凭着那命存留，直留到不敬虔之人受审判遭沉沦的日子，用火焚烧。

chapters.en: But do not forget this one thing, dear friends: With the Lord a day is like a thousand years, and a thousand years are like a day.
chapters.zh: 亲爱的弟兄啊，有一件事你们不可忘记，就是主看一日如千年，千年如一日。

chapters.en: The Lord is not slow in keeping his promise, as some understand slowness. Instead he is patient with you, not wanting anyone to perish, but everyone to come to repentance.
chapters.zh: 主所应许的尚未成就，有人以为他是耽延，其实不是耽延，乃是宽容你们，不愿有一人沉沦，乃愿人人都悔改。

chapters.en: But the day of the Lord will come like a thief. The heavens will disappear with a roar; the elements will be destroyed by fire, and the earth and everything done in it will be laid bare.
chapters.zh: 但主的日子要像贼来到一样。那日天必大有响声废去，有形质的都要被烈火销化。地和其上的物都要烧尽了。

chapters.en: Since everything will be destroyed in this way, what kind of people ought you to be? You ought to live holy and godly lives
chapters.zh: 这一切既然都要如此销化，你们为人该当怎样圣洁，怎样敬虔，

chapters.en: as you look forward to the day of God and speed its coming. That day will bring about the destruction of the heavens by fire, and the elements will melt in the heat.
chapters.zh: 切切仰望神的日子来到。在那日天被火烧就销化了，有形质的都要被烈火熔化。

chapters.en: But in keeping with his promise we are looking forward to a new heaven and a new earth, where righteousness dwells.
chapters.zh: 但我们照他的应许，盼望新天新地，有义居在其中。

chapters.en: So then, dear friends, since you are looking forward to this, make every effort to be found spotless, blameless and at peace with him.
chapters.zh: 亲爱的弟兄啊，你们既盼望这些事，就当殷勤，使自己没有玷污，无可指摘，安然见主。

chapters.en: Bear in mind that our Lord’s patience means salvation, just as our dear brother Paul also wrote you with the wisdom that God gave him.
chapters.zh: 并且要以我主长久忍耐为得救的因由，就如我们所亲爱的兄弟保罗，照着所赐给他的智慧，写了信给你们。

chapters.en: He writes the same way in all his letters, speaking in them of these matters. His letters contain some things that are hard to understand, which ignorant and unstable people distort, as they do the other Scriptures, to their own destruction.
chapters.zh: 他一切的信上，也都是讲论这事。信中有些难明白的，那无学问不坚固的人强解，如强解别的经书一样，就自取沉沦。

chapters.en: Therefore, dear friends, since you have been forewarned, be on your guard so that you may not be carried away by the error of the lawless and fall from your secure position.
chapters.zh: 亲爱的弟兄啊，你们既然预先知道这事，就当防备，恐怕被恶人的错谬诱惑，就从自己坚固的地步上坠落。

chapters.en: But grow in the grace and knowledge of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ. To him be glory both now and forever! Amen.
chapters.zh: 你们却要在我们主救主耶稣基督的恩典和知识上有长进。愿荣耀归给他，从今直到永远。阿们。

chapters.en: That which was from the beginning, which we have heard, which we have seen with our eyes, which we have looked at and our hands have touched—this we proclaim concerning the Word of life.
chapters.zh: 论到从起初原有的生命之道，就是我们所听见所看见，亲眼看过，亲手摸过的。

chapters.en: The life appeared; we have seen it and testify to it, and we proclaim to you the eternal life, which was with the Father and has appeared to us.
chapters.zh: （这生命已经显现出来，我们也看见过，现在又作见证，将原与父同在，且显现与我们那永远的生命，传给你们）。

chapters.en: We proclaim to you what we have seen and heard, so that you also may have fellowship with us. And our fellowship is with the Father and with his Son, Jesus Christ.
chapters.zh: 我们将所看见，所听见的，传给你们，使你们与我们相交。我们乃是与父并他儿子耶稣基督相交的。

chapters.en: We write this to make our joy complete.
chapters.zh: 我们将这些话写给你们，使你们（有古卷作我们）的喜乐充足。

chapters.en: This is the message we have heard from him and declare to you: God is light; in him there is no darkness at all.
chapters.zh: 神就是光，在他毫无黑暗。这是我们从主所听见，又报给你们的信息。

chapters.en: If we claim to have fellowship with him and yet walk in the darkness, we lie and do not live out the truth.
chapters.zh: 我们若说是与神相交，却仍在黑暗里行，就是说谎话，不行真理了。

chapters.en: But if we walk in the light, as he is in the light, we have fellowship with one another, and the blood of Jesus, his Son, purifies us from all sin.
chapters.zh: 我们若在光明中行，如同神在光明中，就彼此相交，他儿子耶稣的血也洗净我们一切的罪。

chapters.en: If we claim to be without sin, we deceive ourselves and the truth is not in us.
chapters.zh: 我们若说自己无罪，便是自欺，真理不在我们心里了。

chapters.en: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and just and will forgive us our sins and purify us from all unrighteousness.
chapters.zh: 我们若认自己的罪，神是信实的，是公义的，必要赦免我们的罪，洗净我们一切的不义。

chapters.en: If we claim we have not sinned, we make him out to be a liar and his word is not in us.
chapters.zh: 我们若说自己没有犯过罪，便是以神为说谎的。他的道也不在我们心里了。

chapters.en: My dear children, I write this to you so that you will not sin. But if anybody does sin, we have an advocate with the Father—Jesus Christ, the Righteous One.
chapters.zh: 我小子们哪，我将这些话写给你们，是要叫你们不犯罪。若有人犯罪，在父那里我们有一位中保，就是那义者耶稣基督。

chapters.en: He is the atoning sacrifice for our sins, and not only for ours but also for the sins of the whole world.
chapters.zh: 他为我们的罪作了挽回祭。不是单为我们的罪，也是为普天下人的罪。

chapters.en: We know that we have come to know him if we keep his commands.
chapters.zh: 我们若遵守他的诫命，就晓得是认识他。

chapters.en: Whoever says, “I know him,” but does not do what he commands is a liar, and the truth is not in that person.
chapters.zh: 人若说我认识他，却不遵守他的诫命，便是说谎话的。真理也不在他心里了。

chapters.en: But if anyone obeys his word, love for God is truly made complete in them. This is how we know we are in him:
chapters.zh: 凡遵守主道的，爱神的心在他里面实在是完全的，从此我们知道我们是在主里面。

chapters.en: Whoever claims to live in him must live as Jesus did.
chapters.zh: 人若说他住在主里面，就该自己照主所行的去行。

chapters.en: Dear friends, I am not writing you a new command but an old one, which you have had since the beginning. This old command is the message you have heard.
chapters.zh: 亲爱的弟兄阿，我写给你们的，不是一条新命令，乃是你们从起初所受的旧命令。这旧命令就是你们所听见的道。

chapters.en: Yet I am writing you a new command; its truth is seen in him and in you, because the darkness is passing and the true light is already shining.
chapters.zh: 再者，我写给你们的，是一条新命令，在主是真的，在你们也是真的。因为黑暗渐渐过去，真光已经照耀。

chapters.en: Anyone who claims to be in the light but hates a brother or sister is still in the darkness.
chapters.zh: 人若说自己在光明中。却恨他的弟兄，他到如今还是在黑暗里。

chapters.en: Anyone who loves their brother and sister lives in the light, and there is nothing in them to make them stumble.
chapters.zh: 爱弟兄的就是住在光明中，在他并没有绊跌的缘由。

chapters.en: But anyone who hates a brother or sister is in the darkness and walks around in the darkness. They do not know where they are going, because the darkness has blinded them.
chapters.zh: 惟独恨弟兄的是在黑暗里，且在黑暗里行，也不知道往哪里去，因为黑暗叫他眼睛瞎了。

chapters.en: I am writing to you, dear children, because your sins have been forgiven on account of his name.
chapters.zh: 小子们哪，我写信给你们，因为你们的罪借着主名得了赦免。

chapters.en: I am writing to you, fathers, because you know him who is from the beginning. I am writing to you, young men, because you have overcome the evil one.
chapters.zh: 父老阿，我写信给你们，因为你们认识那从起初原有的。少年人哪，我写信给你们，因为你们胜了那恶者。小子们哪，我曾写信给你们，因为你们认识父。

chapters.en: I write to you, dear children, because you know the Father. I write to you, fathers, because you know him who is from the beginning. I write to you, young men, because you are strong, and the word of God lives in you, and you have overcome the evil one.
chapters.zh: 父老阿，我曾写信给你们，因为你们认识那从起初原有的。少年人哪，我曾写信给你们，因为你们刚强，神的道常存在你们心里，你们也胜了那恶者。

chapters.en: Do not love the world or anything in the world. If anyone loves the world, love for the Father is not in them.
chapters.zh: 不要爱世界，和世界上的事。人若爱世界，爱父的心就不在他里面了。

chapters.en: For everything in the world—the lust of the flesh, the lust of the eyes, and the pride of life—comes not from the Father but from the world.
chapters.zh: 因为凡世界上的事，就像肉体的情欲，眼目的情欲，并今生的骄傲，都不是从父来的，乃是从世界来的。

chapters.en: The world and its desires pass away, but whoever does the will of God lives forever.
chapters.zh: 这世界，和其上的情欲，都要过去。惟独遵行神旨意的，是永远常存。

chapters.en: Dear children, this is the last hour; and as you have heard that the antichrist is coming, even now many antichrists have come. This is how we know it is the last hour.
chapters.zh: 小子们哪，如今是末时了。你们曾听见说，那敌基督的要来现在已经有好些敌基督的出来了。从此我们就知道如今是末时了。

chapters.en: They went out from us, but they did not really belong to us. For if they had belonged to us, they would have remained with us; but their going showed that none of them belonged to us.
chapters.zh: 他们从我们中间出去，却不是属我们的。若是属我们的，就必仍旧与我们同在。他们出去，显明都不是属我们的。

chapters.en: But you have an anointing from the Holy One, and all of you know the truth.
chapters.zh: 你们从那圣者受了恩膏，并且知道这一切的事。（或作都有知识）

chapters.en: I do not write to you because you do not know the truth, but because you do know it and because no lie comes from the truth.
chapters.zh: 我写信给你们，不是因你们不知道真理，正是因你们知道，并且知道没有虚谎是从真理出来的。

chapters.en: Who is the liar? It is whoever denies that Jesus is the Christ. Such a person is the antichrist—denying the Father and the Son.
chapters.zh: 谁是说谎话的呢？不是那不认耶稣为基督的吗？不认父与子的，这就是敌基督的。

chapters.en: No one who denies the Son has the Father; whoever acknowledges the Son has the Father also.
chapters.zh: 凡不认子的就没有父。认子的连父也有了。

chapters.en: As for you, see that what you have heard from the beginning remains in you. If it does, you also will remain in the Son and in the Father.
chapters.zh: 论到你们，务要将那从起初所听见的常存在心里。若将从起初所听见的存在心里，你们就必住在子里面，也必住在父里面。

chapters.en: And this is what he promised us—eternal life.
chapters.zh: 主所应许我们的就是永生。

chapters.en: I am writing these things to you about those who are trying to lead you astray.
chapters.zh: 我将这些话写给你们，是指着那引诱你们的人说的。

chapters.en: As for you, the anointing you received from him remains in you, and you do not need anyone to teach you. But as his anointing teaches you about all things and as that anointing is real, not counterfeit—just as it has taught you, remain in him.
chapters.zh: 你们从主所受的恩膏，常存在你们心里，并不用人教训你们。自有主的恩膏在凡事上教训你们。这恩膏是真的，不是假的。你们要按这恩膏的教训，住在主里面。

chapters.en: And now, dear children, continue in him, so that when he appears we may be confident and unashamed before him at his coming.
chapters.zh: 小子们哪，你们要住在主里面。这样，他若显现，我们就可以坦然无惧。当他来的时候，在他面前也不至于惭愧。

chapters.en: If you know that he is righteous, you know that everyone who does what is right has been born of him.
chapters.zh: 你们若知道他是公义的，就知道凡行公义之人都是他所生的。

chapters.en: See what great love the Father has lavished on us, that we should be called children of God! And that is what we are! The reason the world does not know us is that it did not know him.
chapters.zh: 你看父赐给我们是何等的慈爱，使我们得称为神的儿女。我们也真是他的儿女。世人所以不认识我们，是因未曾认识他。

chapters.en: Dear friends, now we are children of God, and what we will be has not yet been made known. But we know that when Christ appears, we shall be like him, for we shall see him as he is.
chapters.zh: 亲爱的弟兄阿，我们现在是神的儿女，将来如何，还未显明。但我们知道主若显现，我们必要像他。因为必得见他的真体。

chapters.en: All who have this hope in him purify themselves, just as he is pure.
chapters.zh: 凡向他有这指望的，就洁净自己，像他洁净一样。

chapters.en: Everyone who sins breaks the law; in fact, sin is lawlessness.
chapters.zh: 凡犯罪的，就是违背律法。违背律法就是罪。

chapters.en: But you know that he appeared so that he might take away our sins. And in him is no sin.
chapters.zh: 你们知道主曾显现，是要除掉人的罪。在他并没有罪。

chapters.en: No one who lives in him keeps on sinning. No one who continues to sin has either seen him or known him.
chapters.zh: 凡住在他里面的，就不犯罪。凡犯罪的，是未曾看见他，也未曾认识他。

chapters.en: Dear children, do not let anyone lead you astray. The one who does what is right is righteous, just as he is righteous.
chapters.zh: 小子们哪，不要被人诱惑，行义的才是义人。正如主是义的一样。

chapters.en: The one who does what is sinful is of the devil, because the devil has been sinning from the beginning. The reason the Son of God appeared was to destroy the devil’s work.
chapters.zh: 犯罪的是属魔鬼，因为魔鬼从起初就犯罪。神的儿子显现出来，为要除灭魔鬼的作为。

chapters.en: No one who is born of God will continue to sin, because God’s seed remains in them; they cannot go on sinning, because they have been born of God.
chapters.zh: 凡从神生的就不犯罪，因神的道（原文作种）存在他心里。他也不能犯罪，因为他是由神生的。

chapters.en: This is how we know who the children of God are and who the children of the devil are: Anyone who does not do what is right is not God’s child, nor is anyone who does not love their brother and sister.
chapters.zh: 从此就显出谁是神的儿女，谁是魔鬼的儿女。凡不行义的，就不属神。不爱弟兄的也是如此。

chapters.en: For this is the message you heard from the beginning: We should love one another.
chapters.zh: 我们应当彼此相爱。这就是你们从起初所听见的命令。

chapters.en: Do not be like Cain, who belonged to the evil one and murdered his brother. And why did he murder him? Because his own actions were evil and his brother’s were righteous.
chapters.zh: 不可像该隐。他是属那恶者，杀了他的兄弟。为什么杀了他呢？因自己的行为是恶的，兄弟的行为是善的。

chapters.en: Do not be surprised, my brothers and sisters, if the world hates you.
chapters.zh: 弟兄们，世人若恨你们，不要以为希奇。

chapters.en: We know that we have passed from death to life, because we love each other. Anyone who does not love remains in death.
chapters.zh: 我们因为爱弟兄，就晓得是已经出死入生了。没有爱心的，仍住在死中。

chapters.en: Anyone who hates a brother or sister is a murderer, and you know that no murderer has eternal life residing in him.
chapters.zh: 凡恨他弟兄的，就是杀人的。你们晓得凡杀人的，没有永生存在他里面。

chapters.en: This is how we know what love is: Jesus Christ laid down his life for us. And we ought to lay down our lives for our brothers and sisters.
chapters.zh: 主为我们舍命，我们从此就知道何为爱。我们也当为弟兄舍命。

chapters.en: If anyone has material possessions and sees a brother or sister in need but has no pity on them, how can the love of God be in that person?
chapters.zh: 凡有世上财物的，看见弟兄穷乏，却塞住怜恤的心，爱神的心怎能存在他里面呢？

chapters.en: Dear children, let us not love with words or speech but with actions and in truth.
chapters.zh: 小子们哪，我们相爱，不要只在言语和舌头上。总要在行为和诚实上。

chapters.en: This is how we know that we belong to the truth and how we set our hearts at rest in his presence:
chapters.zh: 从此就知道我们是属真理的，并且我们的心在神面前可以安稳。

chapters.en: If our hearts condemn us, we know that God is greater than our hearts, and he knows everything.
chapters.zh: 我们的心若责备我们，神比我们的心大，一切事没有不知道的。

chapters.en: Dear friends, if our hearts do not condemn us, we have confidence before God
chapters.zh: 亲爱的弟兄阿，我们的心若不责备我们，就可以向神坦然无惧了。

chapters.en: and receive from him anything we ask, because we keep his commands and do what pleases him.
chapters.zh: 并且我们一切所求的，就从他得着。因为我们遵守他的命令，行他所喜悦的事。

chapters.en: And this is his command: to believe in the name of his Son, Jesus Christ, and to love one another as he commanded us.
chapters.zh: 神的命令就是叫我们信他儿子耶稣基督的名，且照他所赐给我们的命令彼此相爱。

chapters.en: The one who keeps God’s commands lives in him, and he in them. And this is how we know that he lives in us: We know it by the Spirit he gave us.
chapters.zh: 遵守神命令的，就住在神里面。神也住在他里面。我们所以知道神住在我们里面，是因他所赐给我们的圣灵。

chapters.en: Dear friends, do not believe every spirit, but test the spirits to see whether they are from God, because many false prophets have gone out into the world.
chapters.zh: 亲爱的弟兄阿，一切的灵，你们不可都信。总要试验那些灵是出于神的不是。因为世上有许多假先知已经出来了。

chapters.en: This is how you can recognize the Spirit of God: Every spirit that acknowledges that Jesus Christ has come in the flesh is from God,
chapters.zh: 凡灵认耶稣基督是成了肉身来的，就是出于神的。从此你们可以认出神的灵来。

chapters.en: but every spirit that does not acknowledge Jesus is not from God. This is the spirit of the antichrist, which you have heard is coming and even now is already in the world.
chapters.zh: 凡灵不认耶稣，就不是出于神。这是那敌基督者的灵。你们从前听见他要来。现在已经在世上了。

chapters.en: You, dear children, are from God and have overcome them, because the one who is in you is greater than the one who is in the world.
chapters.zh: 小子们哪，你们是属神的，并且胜了他们。因为那在你们里面的，比那在世界上的更大。

chapters.en: They are from the world and therefore speak from the viewpoint of the world, and the world listens to them.
chapters.zh: 他们是属世界的。所以论世界的事，世人也听从他们。

chapters.en: We are from God, and whoever knows God listens to us; but whoever is not from God does not listen to us. This is how we recognize the Spirit of truth and the spirit of falsehood.
chapters.zh: 我们是属神的。认识神的就听从我们。不属神的就不听从我们。从此我们可以认出真理的灵，和谬妄的灵来。

chapters.en: Dear friends, let us love one another, for love comes from God. Everyone who loves has been born of God and knows God.
chapters.zh: 亲爱的弟兄阿，我们应当彼此相爱。因为爱是从神来的。凡有爱心的，都是由神而生，并且认识神。

chapters.en: Whoever does not love does not know God, because God is love.
chapters.zh: 没有爱心的，就不认识神。因为神就是爱。

chapters.en: This is how God showed his love among us: He sent his one and only Son into the world that we might live through him.
chapters.zh: 神差他独生子到世间来，使我们借着他得生，神爱我们的心，在此就显明了。

chapters.en: This is love: not that we loved God, but that he loved us and sent his Son as an atoning sacrifice for our sins.
chapters.zh: 不是我们爱神，乃是神爱我们，差他的儿子，为我们的罪作了挽回祭，这就是爱了。

chapters.en: Dear friends, since God so loved us, we also ought to love one another.
chapters.zh: 亲爱的弟兄阿，神既是这样爱我们，我们也当彼此相爱。

chapters.en: No one has ever seen God; but if we love one another, God lives in us and his love is made complete in us.
chapters.zh: 从来没有人见过神。我们若彼此相爱，神就住在我们里面，爱他的心在我们里面得以完全了。

chapters.en: This is how we know that we live in him and he in us: He has given us of his Spirit.
chapters.zh: 神将他的灵赐给我们，从此就知道我们是住在他里面，他也住在我们里面。

chapters.en: And we have seen and testify that the Father has sent his Son to be the Savior of the world.
chapters.zh: 父差子作世人的救主，这是我们所看见且作见证的。

chapters.en: If anyone acknowledges that Jesus is the Son of God, God lives in them and they in God.
chapters.zh: 凡认耶稣为神儿子的，神就住在他里面，他也住在神里面。

chapters.en: And so we know and rely on the love God has for us. God is love. Whoever lives in love lives in God, and God in them.
chapters.zh: 神爱我们的心，我们也知道也信。神就是爱。住在爱里面的，就是住在神里面，神也住在他里面。

chapters.en: This is how love is made complete among us so that we will have confidence on the day of judgment: In this world we are like Jesus.
chapters.zh: 这样爱在我们里面得以完全，我们就可以在审判的日子，坦然无惧。因为他如何，我们在这世上也如何。

chapters.en: There is no fear in love. But perfect love drives out fear, because fear has to do with punishment. The one who fears is not made perfect in love.
chapters.zh: 爱里没有惧怕。爱既完全，就把惧怕除去。因为惧怕里含着刑罚。惧怕的人在爱里未得完全。

chapters.en: We love because he first loved us.
chapters.zh: 我们爱，因为神先爱我们。

chapters.en: Whoever claims to love God yet hates a brother or sister is a liar. For whoever does not love their brother and sister, whom they have seen, cannot love God, whom they have not seen.
chapters.zh: 人若说，我爱神，却恨他的弟兄，就是说谎话的。不爱他所看见的弟兄，就不能爱没有看见的神。（有古卷作怎能爱没有看见的神呢）。

chapters.en: And he has given us this command: Anyone who loves God must also love their brother and sister.
chapters.zh: 爱神的，也当爱弟兄，这是我们从神所受的命令。

chapters.en: Everyone who believes that Jesus is the Christ is born of God, and everyone who loves the father loves his child as well.
chapters.zh: 凡信耶稣是基督的，都是从神而生。凡爱生他之神的，也必爱从神生的。

chapters.en: This is how we know that we love the children of God: by loving God and carrying out his commands.
chapters.zh: 我们若爱神，又遵守他的诫命，从此就知道我们爱神的儿女。

chapters.en: In fact, this is love for God: to keep his commands. And his commands are not burdensome,
chapters.zh: 我们遵守神的诫命，这就是爱他了。并且他的诫命不是难守的。

chapters.en: for everyone born of God overcomes the world. This is the victory that has overcome the world, even our faith.
chapters.zh: 因为凡从神生的，就胜过世界。使我们胜了世界的，就是我们的信心。

chapters.en: Who is it that overcomes the world? Only the one who believes that Jesus is the Son of God.
chapters.zh: 胜过世界的是谁呢？不是那信耶稣是神儿子的吗？

chapters.en: This is the one who came by water and blood—Jesus Christ. He did not come by water only, but by water and blood. And it is the Spirit who testifies, because the Spirit is the truth.
chapters.zh: 这借着水和血而来的就是耶稣基督。不是单用水，乃是用水又用血。

chapters.en: For there are three that testify:
chapters.zh: 并且有圣灵作见证，因为圣灵就是真理。

chapters.en: the Spirit, the water and the blood; and the three are in agreement.
chapters.zh: 作见证的原来有三，就是圣灵，水，与血。这三样也都归于一。

chapters.en: We accept human testimony, but God’s testimony is greater because it is the testimony of God, which he has given about his Son.
chapters.zh: 我们既领受人的见证，神的见证更该领受了。（该领受原文作大）。因神的见证，是为他儿子作的。

chapters.en: Whoever believes in the Son of God accepts this testimony. Whoever does not believe God has made him out to be a liar, because they have not believed the testimony God has given about his Son.
chapters.zh: 信神儿子的，就有这见证在他心里。不信神的，就是将神当作说谎的。因不信神为他儿子作的见证。

chapters.en: And this is the testimony: God has given us eternal life, and this life is in his Son.
chapters.zh: 这见证，就是神赐给我们永生，这永生也是在他儿子里面。

chapters.en: Whoever has the Son has life; whoever does not have the Son of God does not have life.
chapters.zh: 人有了神的儿子就有生命。没有神的儿子就没有生命。

chapters.en: I write these things to you who believe in the name of the Son of God so that you may know that you have eternal life.
chapters.zh: 我将这些话写给你们信奉神儿子之名的人，要叫你们知道自己有永生。

chapters.en: This is the confidence we have in approaching God: that if we ask anything according to his will, he hears us.
chapters.zh: 我们若照他的旨意求什么，他就听我们。这是我们向他所存坦然无惧的心。

chapters.en: And if we know that he hears us—whatever we ask—we know that we have what we asked of him.
chapters.zh: 既然知道他听我们一切所求的，就知道我们所求于他的无不得着。

chapters.en: If you see any brother or sister commit a sin that does not lead to death, you should pray and God will give them life. I refer to those whose sin does not lead to death. There is a sin that leads to death. I am not saying that you should pray about that.
chapters.zh: 人若看见弟兄犯了不至于死的罪，就当为他祈求，神必将生命赐给他。有至于死的罪，我不说当为这罪祈求。

chapters.en: All wrongdoing is sin, and there is sin that does not lead to death.
chapters.zh: 凡不义的事都是罪。也有不至于死的罪。

chapters.en: We know that anyone born of God does not continue to sin; the One who was born of God keeps them safe, and the evil one cannot harm them.
chapters.zh: 我们知道凡从神生的必不犯罪。从神生的必保守自己，（有古卷作那从神生的必保护他），那恶者也就无法害他。

chapters.en: We know that we are children of God, and that the whole world is under the control of the evil one.
chapters.zh: 我们知道我们是属神的，全世界都卧在那恶者手下。

chapters.en: We know also that the Son of God has come and has given us understanding, so that we may know him who is true. And we are in him who is true by being in his Son Jesus Christ. He is the true God and eternal life.
chapters.zh: 我们也知道神的儿子已经来到，且将智慧赐给我们，使我们认识那位真实的，我们也在那位真实的里面，就是在他儿子耶稣基督里面。这是真神，也是永生。

chapters.en: Dear children, keep yourselves from idols.
chapters.zh: 小子们哪，你们要自守，远避偶像。

chapters.en: The elder, To the lady chosen by God and to her children, whom I love in the truth—and not I only, but also all who know the truth—
chapters.zh: 作长老的写信给蒙拣选的太太，（太太或作教会下同），和她的儿女，就是我诚心所爱的。不但我爱，也是一切知道真理之人所爱的。

chapters.en: because of the truth, which lives in us and will be with us forever:
chapters.zh: 爱你们是为真理的缘故，这真理存在我们里面，也必永远与我们同在。

chapters.en: Grace, mercy and peace from God the Father and from Jesus Christ, the Father’s Son, will be with us in truth and love.
chapters.zh: 恩惠，怜悯，平安，从父神和他儿子耶稣基督，在真理和爱心上，必常与我们同在。

chapters.en: It has given me great joy to find some of your children walking in the truth, just as the Father commanded us.
chapters.zh: 我见你的儿女，有照我们从父所受之命令遵行真理的，就甚欢喜。

chapters.en: And now, dear lady, I am not writing you a new command but one we have had from the beginning. I ask that we love one another.
chapters.zh: 太太阿，我现在劝你，我们大家要彼此相爱。这并不是我写一条新命令给你，乃是我们从起初所受的命令。

chapters.en: And this is love: that we walk in obedience to his commands. As you have heard from the beginning, his command is that you walk in love.
chapters.zh: 我们若照他的命令行，这就是爱。你们从起初所听见当行的，就是这命令。

chapters.en: I say this because many deceivers, who do not acknowledge Jesus Christ as coming in the flesh, have gone out into the world. Any such person is the deceiver and the antichrist.
chapters.zh: 因为世上有许多迷惑人的出来，他们不认耶稣基督是成了肉身来的。这就是那迷惑人，敌基督的。

chapters.en: Watch out that you do not lose what we have worked for, but that you may be rewarded fully.
chapters.zh: 你们要小心，不要失去你们（有古卷作我们）所作的工，乃要得着满足的赏赐。

chapters.en: Anyone who runs ahead and does not continue in the teaching of Christ does not have God; whoever continues in the teaching has both the Father and the Son.
chapters.zh: 凡越过基督的教训，不常守着的，就没有神。常守这教训的，就有父又有子。

chapters.en: If anyone comes to you and does not bring this teaching, do not take them into your house or welcome them.
chapters.zh: 若有人到你们那里，不是传这教训，不要接他到家里，也不要问他的安。

chapters.en: Anyone who welcomes them shares in their wicked work.
chapters.zh: 因为问他安的，就在他的恶行上有分。

chapters.en: I have much to write to you, but I do not want to use paper and ink. Instead, I hope to visit you and talk with you face to face, so that our joy may be complete.
chapters.zh: 我还有许多事要写给你们，却不愿意用纸墨写出来。但盼望到你们那里，与你们当面谈论，使你们的喜乐满足。

chapters.en: The children of your sister, who is chosen by God, send their greetings.
chapters.zh: 你那蒙拣选之姊妹的儿女都问你安。

chapters.en: The elder, To my dear friend Gaius, whom I love in the truth.
chapters.zh: 作长老的写信给亲爱的该犹，就是我诚心所爱的。

chapters.en: Dear friend, I pray that you may enjoy good health and that all may go well with you, even as your soul is getting along well.
chapters.zh: 亲爱的兄弟阿，我愿你凡事兴盛，身体健壮，正如你的灵魂兴盛一样。

chapters.en: It gave me great joy when some believers came and testified about your faithfulness to the truth, telling how you continue to walk in it.
chapters.zh: 有弟兄来证明你心里存的真理，正如你按真理而行，我就甚喜乐。

chapters.en: I have no greater joy than to hear that my children are walking in the truth.
chapters.zh: 我听见我的儿女们按真理而行，我的喜乐就没有比这个大的。

chapters.en: Dear friend, you are faithful in what you are doing for the brothers and sisters, even though they are strangers to you.
chapters.zh: 亲爱的兄弟阿，凡你向作客旅之弟兄所行的，都是忠心的。

chapters.en: They have told the church about your love. Please send them on their way in a manner that honors God.
chapters.zh: 他们在教会面前证明了你的爱。你若配得过神，帮助他们往前行，这就好了。

chapters.en: It was for the sake of the Name that they went out, receiving no help from the pagans.
chapters.zh: 因他们是为主的名（原文作那名）出外，对于外邦人一无所取。

chapters.en: We ought therefore to show hospitality to such people so that we may work together for the truth.
chapters.zh: 所以我们应该接待这样的人，叫我们与他们一同为真理作工。

chapters.en: I wrote to the church, but Diotrephes, who loves to be first, will not welcome us.
chapters.zh: 我曾略略地写信给教会。但那在教会中好为首的丢特腓不接待我们。

chapters.en: So when I come, I will call attention to what he is doing, spreading malicious nonsense about us. Not satisfied with that, he even refuses to welcome other believers. He also stops those who want to do so and puts them out of the church.
chapters.zh: 所以我若去，必要提说他所行的事。就是他用恶言妄论我们。还不以此为足，他自己不接待弟兄，有人愿意接待，他也禁止，并且将接待弟兄的人赶出教会。

chapters.en: Dear friend, do not imitate what is evil but what is good. Anyone who does what is good is from God. Anyone who does what is evil has not seen God.
chapters.zh: 亲爱的兄弟阿，不要效法恶，只要效法善。行善的属乎神。行恶的未曾见过神。

chapters.en: Demetrius is well spoken of by everyone—and even by the truth itself. We also speak well of him, and you know that our testimony is true.
chapters.zh: 低米丢行善有众人给他作见证。又有真理给他作见证。就是我们也给他作见证。你也知道我们的见证是真的。

chapters.en: I have much to write you, but I do not want to do so with pen and ink.
chapters.zh: 我原有许多事要写给你，却不愿意用笔墨写给你。

chapters.en: I hope to see you soon, and we will talk face to face. Peace to you. The friends here send their greetings. Greet the friends there by name.
chapters.zh: 但盼望快快地见你，我们就当面谈论。

chapters.en: Note: no this verse in english bible version.
chapters.zh: 愿你平安。众位朋友都问你安。请你替我按着姓名问众位朋友安。

chapters.en: Jude, a servant of Jesus Christ and a brother of James, To those who have been called, who are loved in God the Father and kept for Jesus Christ:
chapters.zh: 耶稣基督的仆人，雅各的弟兄犹大，写信给那被召，在父神里蒙爱，为耶稣基督保守的人。

chapters.en: Mercy, peace and love be yours in abundance.
chapters.zh: 愿怜恤，平安，慈爱，多多地加给你们。

chapters.en: Dear friends, although I was very eager to write to you about the salvation we share, I felt compelled to write and urge you to contend for the faith that was once for all entrusted to God’s holy people.
chapters.zh: 亲爱的弟兄阿，我想尽心写信给你们，论我们同得救恩的时候，就不得不写信劝你们，要为从前一次交付圣徒的真道，竭力地争辩。

chapters.en: For certain individuals whose condemnation was written about long ago have secretly slipped in among you. They are ungodly people, who pervert the grace of our God into a license for immorality and deny Jesus Christ our only Sovereign and Lord.
chapters.zh: 因为有些人偷着进来，就是自古被定受刑罚的，是不虔诚的，将我们神的恩变作放纵情欲的机会，并且不认独一的主宰我们（我们或作和我们）主耶稣基督。

chapters.en: Though you already know all this, I want to remind you that the Lord at one time delivered his people out of Egypt, but later destroyed those who did not believe.
chapters.zh: 从前主救了他的百姓出埃及地，后来就把那些不信的灭绝了。这一切的事，你们虽然都知道，我却仍要提醒你们。

chapters.en: And the angels who did not keep their positions of authority but abandoned their proper dwelling—these he has kept in darkness, bound with everlasting chains for judgment on the great Day.
chapters.zh: 又有不守本位，离开自己住处的天使，主用锁链把他们永远拘留在黑暗里，等候大日的审判。

chapters.en: In a similar way, Sodom and Gomorrah and the surrounding towns gave themselves up to sexual immorality and perversion. They serve as an example of those who suffer the punishment of eternal fire.
chapters.zh: 又如所多玛，蛾摩拉，和周围城邑的人，也照他们一味地行淫，随从逆性的情欲，就受永火的刑罚，作为鉴戒。

chapters.en: In the very same way, on the strength of their dreams these ungodly people pollute their own bodies, reject authority and heap abuse on celestial beings.
chapters.zh: 这些作梦的人，也像他们污秽身体，轻慢主治的，毁谤在尊位的。

chapters.en: But even the archangel Michael, when he was disputing with the devil about the body of Moses, did not himself dare to condemn him for slander but said, “The Lord rebuke you!”
chapters.zh: 天使长米迦勒，为摩西的尸首与魔鬼争辩的时候，尚且不敢用毁谤的话罪责他，只说，主责备你吧。

chapters.en: Yet these people slander whatever they do not understand, and the very things they do understand by instinct—as irrational animals do—will destroy them.
chapters.zh: 但这些人毁谤他们所不知道的。他们本性所知道的事与那没有灵性的畜类一样，在这事上竟败坏了自己。

chapters.en: Woe to them! They have taken the way of Cain; they have rushed for profit into Balaam’s error; they have been destroyed in Korah’s rebellion.
chapters.zh: 他们有祸了。因为走了该隐的道路，又为利往巴兰的错谬里直奔，并在可拉的背叛中灭亡了。

chapters.en: These people are blemishes at your love feasts, eating with you without the slightest qualm—shepherds who feed only themselves. They are clouds without rain, blown along by the wind; autumn trees, without fruit and uprooted—twice dead.
chapters.zh: 这样的人，在你们的爱席上，与你们同吃的时候，正是礁石。（或作玷污）他们作牧人，只知喂养自己，无所惧怕。是没有雨的云彩，被风飘荡，是秋天没有果子的树，死而又死，连根被拔出来。

chapters.en: They are wild waves of the sea, foaming up their shame; wandering stars, for whom blackest darkness has been reserved forever.
chapters.zh: 是海里的狂浪，涌出自己可耻的沫子来。是流荡的星，有墨黑的幽暗为他们永远存留。

chapters.en: Enoch, the seventh from Adam, prophesied about them: “See, the Lord is coming with thousands upon thousands of his holy ones
chapters.zh: 亚当的七世孙以诺，曾预言这些人说，看哪，主带着他的千万圣者降临，

chapters.en: to judge everyone, and to convict all of them of all the ungodly acts they have committed in their ungodliness, and of all the defiant words ungodly sinners have spoken against him.”
chapters.zh: 要在众人身上行审判，证实那一切不敬虔的人，所妄行一切不敬虔的事，又证实不敬虔之罪人所说顶撞他的刚愎话。

chapters.en: These people are grumblers and faultfinders; they follow their own evil desires; they boast about themselves and flatter others for their own advantage.
chapters.zh: 这些人是私下议论，常发怨言的，随从自己的情欲而行，口中说夸大的话，为得便宜谄媚人。

chapters.en: But, dear friends, remember what the apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ foretold.
chapters.zh: 亲爱的弟兄阿，你们要记念我们主耶稣基督之使徒从前所说的话。

chapters.en: They said to you, “In the last times there will be scoffers who will follow their own ungodly desires.”
chapters.zh: 他们曾对你们说过，末世必有好讥诮的人，随从自己不敬虔的私欲而行。

chapters.en: These are the people who divide you, who follow mere natural instincts and do not have the Spirit.
chapters.zh: 这就是那些引人结党，属乎血气，没有圣灵的人。

chapters.en: But you, dear friends, by building yourselves up in your most holy faith and praying in the Holy Spirit,
chapters.zh: 亲爱的弟兄阿，你们却要在至圣的真道上造就自己，在圣灵里祷告，

chapters.en: keep yourselves in God’s love as you wait for the mercy of our Lord Jesus Christ to bring you to eternal life.
chapters.zh: 保守自己常在神的爱中，仰望我们主耶稣基督的怜悯，直到永生。

chapters.en: Be merciful to those who doubt;
chapters.zh: 有些人存疑心，你们要怜悯他们。

chapters.en: save others by snatching them from the fire; to others show mercy, mixed with fear—hating even the clothing stained by corrupted flesh.
chapters.zh: 有些人你们要从火中抢出来搭救他们。有些人你们要存惧怕的心怜悯他们。连那被情欲沾染的衣服也当厌恶。

chapters.en: To him who is able to keep you from stumbling and to present you before his glorious presence without fault and with great joy—
chapters.zh: 那能保守你们不失脚，叫你们无瑕无疵，欢欢喜喜站在他荣耀之前的，我们的救主独一的神。

chapters.en: to the only God our Savior be glory, majesty, power and authority, through Jesus Christ our Lord, before all ages, now and forevermore! Amen.
chapters.zh: 愿荣耀，威严，能力，权柄，因我们的主耶稣基督，归与他，从万古以前，并现今，直到永永远远。阿们。

chapters.en: The revelation from Jesus Christ, which God gave him to show his servants what must soon take place. He made it known by sending his angel to his servant John,
chapters.zh: 耶稣基督的启示，就是神赐给他，叫他将必要快成的事指示他的众仆人。他就差遣使者，晓谕他的仆人约翰。

chapters.en: who testifies to everything he saw—that is, the word of God and the testimony of Jesus Christ.
chapters.zh: 约翰便将神的道，和耶稣基督的见证，凡自己所看见的，都证明出来。

chapters.en: Blessed is the one who reads aloud the words of this prophecy, and blessed are those who hear it and take to heart what is written in it, because the time is near.
chapters.zh: 念这书上预言的，和那些听见又遵守其中所记载的，都是有福的。因为日期近了。

chapters.en: John, To the seven churches in the province of Asia: Grace and peace to you from him who is, and who was, and who is to come, and from the seven spirits before his throne,
chapters.zh: 约翰写信给亚西亚的七个教会。但愿从那昔在今在以后永在的神和他宝座前的七灵。

chapters.en: and from Jesus Christ, who is the faithful witness, the firstborn from the dead, and the ruler of the kings of the earth. To him who loves us and has freed us from our sins by his blood,
chapters.zh: 并那诚实作见证的，从死里首先复活，为世上君王元首的耶稣基督。有恩惠平安归与你们。他爱我们，用自己的血使我们脱离罪恶。（脱离有古卷作洗去）

chapters.en: and has made us to be a kingdom and priests to serve his God and Father—to him be glory and power for ever and ever! Amen.
chapters.zh: 又使我们成为国民，作他父神的祭司。但愿荣耀权能归给他，直到永永远远。阿们。

chapters.en: “Look, he is coming with the clouds,”and “every eye will see him, even those who pierced him”; and all peoples on earth “will mourn because of him.”So shall it be! Amen.
chapters.zh: 看哪，他驾云降临。众目要看见他，连刺他的人也要看见他。地上的万族都要因他哀哭。这话是真实的。阿们。

chapters.en: “I am the Alpha and the Omega,” says the Lord God, “who is, and who was, and who is to come, the Almighty.”
chapters.zh: 主神说，我是阿拉法，我是俄梅戛（阿拉法俄梅戛乃希腊字母首末二字），是昔在今在以后永在的全能者。

chapters.en: I, John, your brother and companion in the suffering and kingdom and patient endurance that are ours in Jesus, was on the island of Patmos because of the word of God and the testimony of Jesus.
chapters.zh: 我约翰就是你们的弟兄，和你们在耶稣的患难，国度，忍耐里一同有分。为神的道，并为给耶稣作的见证，曾在那名叫拔摩的海岛上。

chapters.en: On the Lord’s Day I was in the Spirit, and I heard behind me a loud voice like a trumpet,
chapters.zh: 当主日我被圣灵感动，听见在我后面有大声音如吹号说，

chapters.en: which said: “Write on a scroll what you see and send it to the seven churches: to Ephesus, Smyrna, Pergamum, Thyatira, Sardis, Philadelphia and Laodicea.”
chapters.zh: 你所看见的，当写在书上，达与以弗所，士每拿，别迦摩，推雅推喇，撒狄，非拉铁非，老底嘉，那七个教会。

chapters.en: I turned around to see the voice that was speaking to me. And when I turned I saw seven golden lampstands,
chapters.zh: 我转过身来，要看是谁发声与我说话。既转过来，就看见七个金灯台。

chapters.en: and among the lampstands was someone like a son of man, dressed in a robe reaching down to his feet and with a golden sash around his chest.
chapters.zh: 灯台中间，有一位好像人子，身穿长衣，直垂到脚，胸间束着金带。

chapters.en: The hair on his head was white like wool, as white as snow, and his eyes were like blazing fire.
chapters.zh: 他的头与发皆白，如白羊毛，如雪。眼目如同火焰。

chapters.en: His feet were like bronze glowing in a furnace, and his voice was like the sound of rushing waters.
chapters.zh: 脚好像在炉中锻炼光明的铜。声音如同众水的声音。

chapters.en: In his right hand he held seven stars, and coming out of his mouth was a sharp, double-edged sword. His face was like the sun shining in all its brilliance.
chapters.zh: 他右手拿着七星。从他口中出来一把两刃的利剑。面貌如同烈日放光。

chapters.en: When I saw him, I fell at his feet as though dead. Then he placed his right hand on me and said: “Do not be afraid. I am the First and the Last.
chapters.zh: 我一看见，就仆倒在他脚前，像死了一样。他用右手按着我说，不要惧怕。我是首先的，我是末后的，

chapters.en: I am the Living One; I was dead, and now look, I am alive for ever and ever! And I hold the keys of death and Hades.
chapters.zh: 又是那存活的。我曾死过，现在又活了，直活到永永远远。并且拿着死亡和阴间的钥匙。

chapters.en: “Write, therefore, what you have seen, what is now and what will take place later.
chapters.zh: 所以你要把所看见的，和现在的事，并将来必成的事，都写出来。

chapters.en: The mystery of the seven stars that you saw in my right hand and of the seven golden lampstands is this: The seven stars are the angels of the seven churches, and the seven lampstands are the seven churches.
chapters.zh: 论到你所看见在我右手中的七星，和七个金灯台的奥秘。那七星就是七个教会的使者。七灯台就是七个教会。

chapters.en: “To the angel of the church in Ephesus write: These are the words of him who holds the seven stars in his right hand and walks among the seven golden lampstands.
chapters.zh: 你要写信给以弗所教会的使者，说，那右手拿着七星，在七个金灯台中间行走的，说，

chapters.en: I know your deeds, your hard work and your perseverance. I know that you cannot tolerate wicked people, that you have tested those who claim to be apostles but are not, and have found them false.
chapters.zh: 我知道你的行为，劳碌，忍耐，也知道你不能容忍恶人，你也曾试验那自称为使徒却不是使徒的，看出他们是假的来。

chapters.en: You have persevered and have endured hardships for my name, and have not grown weary.
chapters.zh: 你也能忍耐，曾为我的名劳苦，并不乏倦。

chapters.en: Yet I hold this against you: You have forsaken the love you had at first.
chapters.zh: 然而有一件事我要责备你，就是你把起初的爱心离弃了。

chapters.en: Consider how far you have fallen! Repent and do the things you did at first. If you do not repent, I will come to you and remove your lampstand from its place.
chapters.zh: 所以应当回想你是从哪里坠落的，并要悔改，行起初所行的事。你若不悔改，我就临到你那里，把你的灯台从原处挪去。

chapters.en: But you have this in your favor: You hate the practices of the Nicolaitans, which I also hate.
chapters.zh: 然而你还有一件可取的事，就是你恨恶尼哥拉一党人的行为，这也是我所恨恶的。

chapters.en: Whoever has ears, let them hear what the Spirit says to the churches. To the one who is victorious, I will give the right to eat from the tree of life, which is in the paradise of God.
chapters.zh: 圣灵向众教会所说的话，凡有耳的，就应当听。得胜的，我必将神乐园中生命树的果子赐给他吃。

chapters.en: “To the angel of the church in Smyrna write:These are the words of him who is the First and the Last, who died and came to life again.
chapters.zh: 你要写信给士每拿教会的使者说，那首先的，末后的，死过又活的说，

chapters.en: I know your afflictions and your poverty—yet you are rich! I know about the slander of those who say they are Jews and are not, but are a synagogue of Satan.
chapters.zh: 我知道你的患难，你的贫穷，（你却是富足的）也知道那自称是犹太人所说的毁谤话，其实他们不是犹太人，乃是撒但一会的人。

chapters.en: Do not be afraid of what you are about to suffer. I tell you, the devil will put some of you in prison to test you, and you will suffer persecution for ten days. Be faithful, even to the point of death, and I will give you life as your victor’s crown.
chapters.zh: 你将要受的苦你不用怕。魔鬼要把你们中间几个人下在监里，叫你们被试炼。你们必受患难十日。你务要至死忠心，我就赐给你那生命的冠冕。

chapters.en: Whoever has ears, let them hear what the Spirit says to the churches. The one who is victorious will not be hurt at all by the second death.
chapters.zh: 圣灵向众教会所说的话，凡有耳的，就应当听。得胜的，必不受第二次死的害。

chapters.en: “To the angel of the church in Pergamum write:These are the words of him who has the sharp, double-edged sword.
chapters.zh: 你要写信给别迦摩教会的使者，说，那有两刃利剑的说，

chapters.en: I know where you live—where Satan has his throne. Yet you remain true to my name. You did not renounce your faith in me, not even in the days of Antipas, my faithful witness, who was put to death in your city—where Satan lives.
chapters.zh: 我知道你的居所，就是有撒但座位之处。当我忠心的见证人安提帕在你们中间，撒但所住的地方被杀之时，你还坚守我的名，没有弃绝我的道。

chapters.en: Nevertheless, I have a few things against you: There are some among you who hold to the teaching of Balaam, who taught Balak to entice the Israelites to sin so that they ate food sacrificed to idols and committed sexual immorality.
chapters.zh: 然而有几件事我要责备你，因为在你那里，有人服从了巴兰的教训。这巴兰曾教导巴勒将绊脚石放在以色列人面前，叫他们吃祭偶像之物，行奸淫的事。

chapters.en: Likewise, you also have those who hold to the teaching of the Nicolaitans.
chapters.zh: 你那里也有人照样服从了尼哥拉一党人的教训。

chapters.en: Repent therefore! Otherwise, I will soon come to you and will fight against them with the sword of my mouth.
chapters.zh: 所以你当悔改。若不悔改，我就快临到你那里，用我口中的剑，攻击他们。

chapters.en: Whoever has ears, let them hear what the Spirit says to the churches. To the one who is victorious, I will give some of the hidden manna. I will also give that person a white stone with a new name written on it, known only to the one who receives it.
chapters.zh: 圣灵向众教会所说的话，凡有耳的就应当听。得胜的，我必将那隐藏的吗哪赐给他。并赐他一块白石，石上写着新名。除了那领受的以外。没有人能认识。

chapters.en: “To the angel of the church in Thyatira write:These are the words of the Son of God, whose eyes are like blazing fire and whose feet are like burnished bronze.
chapters.zh: 你要写信给推雅推喇教会的使者，说，那眼目如火焰，脚像光明铜的神之子，说，

chapters.en: I know your deeds, your love and faith, your service and perseverance, and that you are now doing more than you did at first.
chapters.zh: 我知道你的行为，爱心，信心，勤劳，忍耐。又知道你末后所行的善事，比起初所行的更多。

chapters.en: Nevertheless, I have this against you: You tolerate that woman Jezebel, who calls herself a prophet. By her teaching she misleads my servants into sexual immorality and the eating of food sacrificed to idols.
chapters.zh: 然而有一件事我要责备你，就是你容让那自称是先知的妇人耶洗别教导我的仆人，引诱他们行奸淫，吃祭偶像之物。

chapters.en: I have given her time to repent of her immorality, but she is unwilling.
chapters.zh: 我曾给她悔改的机会，她却不肯悔改她的淫行。

chapters.en: So I will cast her on a bed of suffering, and I will make those who commit adultery with her suffer intensely, unless they repent of her ways.
chapters.zh: 看哪，我要叫她病卧在床，那些与她行淫的人，若不悔改所行的，我也要叫他们同受大患难。

chapters.en: I will strike her children dead. Then all the churches will know that I am he who searches hearts and minds, and I will repay each of you according to your deeds.
chapters.zh: 我又要杀死她的党类（党类原文作儿女），叫众教会知道，我是那察看人肺腑心肠的。并要照你们的行为报应你们各人。

chapters.en: Now I say to the rest of you in Thyatira, to you who do not hold to her teaching and have not learned Satan’s so-called deep secrets, ‘I will not impose any other burden on you,
chapters.zh: 至于你们推雅推喇其余的人，就是一切不从那教训，不晓得他们素常所说撒但深奥之理的人。我告诉你们，我不将别的担子放在你们身上。

chapters.en: except to hold on to what you have until I come.’
chapters.zh: 但你们已经有的，总要持守，直等到我来。

chapters.en: To the one who is victorious and does my will to the end, I will give authority over the nations—
chapters.zh: 那得胜又遵守我命令到底的，我要赐给他权柄制伏列国。

chapters.en: that one ‘will rule them with an iron scepter and will dash them to pieces like pottery’—just as I have received authority from my Father.
chapters.zh: 他必用铁杖辖管他们（辖管原文作牧），将他们如同窑户的瓦器打得粉碎。像我从我父领受的权柄一样。

chapters.en: I will also give that one the morning star.
chapters.zh: 我又要把晨星赐给他。

chapters.en: Whoever has ears, let them hear what the Spirit says to the churches.
chapters.zh: 圣灵向众教会所说的话，凡有耳的就应当听。

chapters.en: “To the angel of the church in Sardis write: These are the words of him who holds the seven spirits of God and the seven stars. I know your deeds; you have a reputation of being alive, but you are dead.
chapters.zh: 你要写信给撒狄教会的使者，说，那有神的七灵和七星的，说，我知道你的行为，按名你是活的，其实是死的。

chapters.en: Wake up! Strengthen what remains and is about to die, for I have found your deeds unfinished in the sight of my God.
chapters.zh: 你要儆醒，坚固那剩下将要衰微的（衰微原文作死）。因我见你的行为，在我神面前，没有一样是完全的。

chapters.en: Remember, therefore, what you have received and heard; hold it fast, and repent. But if you do not wake up, I will come like a thief, and you will not know at what time I will come to you.
chapters.zh: 所以要回想你是怎样领受，怎样听见的。又要遵守，并要悔改。若不儆醒，我必临到你那里如同贼一样。我几时临到，你也决不能知道。

chapters.en: Yet you have a few people in Sardis who have not soiled their clothes. They will walk with me, dressed in white, for they are worthy.
chapters.zh: 然而在撒狄你还有几名是未曾污秽自己衣服的。他们要穿白衣与我同行。因为他们是配得过的。

chapters.en: The one who is victorious will, like them, be dressed in white. I will never blot out the name of that person from the book of life, but will acknowledge that name before my Father and his angels.
chapters.zh: 凡得胜的，必这样穿白衣。我也必不从生命册上涂抹他的名。且要在我父面前，和我父众使者面前认他的名。

chapters.en: Whoever has ears, let them hear what the Spirit says to the churches.
chapters.zh: 圣灵向众教会所说的话，凡有耳的，就应当听。

chapters.en: “To the angel of the church in Philadelphia write: These are the words of him who is holy and true, who holds the key of David. What he opens no one can shut, and what he shuts no one can open.
chapters.zh: 你要写信给非拉铁非教会的使者，说，那圣洁，真实，拿着大卫的钥匙，开了就没有人能关，关了就没有人能开的，说，

chapters.en: I know your deeds. See, I have placed before you an open door that no one can shut. I know that you have little strength, yet you have kept my word and have not denied my name.
chapters.zh: 我知道你的行为，你略有一点力量，也曾遵守我的道，没有弃绝我的名。看哪，我在你面前给你一个敞开的门，是无人能关的。

chapters.en: I will make those who are of the synagogue of Satan, who claim to be Jews though they are not, but are liars—I will make them come and fall down at your feet and acknowledge that I have loved you.
chapters.zh: 那撒但一会的，自称是犹太人，其实不是犹太人，乃是说谎话的，我要使他们来在你脚前下拜，也使他们知道我是已经爱你了。

chapters.en: Since you have kept my command to endure patiently, I will also keep you from the hour of trial that is going to come on the whole world to test the inhabitants of the earth.
chapters.zh: 你既遵守我忍耐的道，我必在普天下人受试炼的时候，保守你免去你的试炼。

chapters.en: I am coming soon. Hold on to what you have, so that no one will take your crown.
chapters.zh: 我必快来，你要持守你所有的，免得人夺去你的冠冕。

chapters.en: The one who is victorious I will make a pillar in the temple of my God. Never again will they leave it. I will write on them the name of my God and the name of the city of my God, the new Jerusalem, which is coming down out of heaven from my God; and I will also write on them my new name.
chapters.zh: 得胜的，我要叫他在我神殿中作柱子，他也必不再从那里出去。我又要将我神的名，和我神城的名，（这城就是从天上从我神那里降下来的新耶路撒冷）并我的新名，都写在他上面。

chapters.en: Whoever has ears, let them hear what the Spirit says to the churches.
chapters.zh: 圣灵向众教会所说的话，凡有耳的，就应当听。

chapters.en: “To the angel of the church in Laodicea write:These are the words of the Amen, the faithful and true witness, the ruler of God’s creation.
chapters.zh: 你要写信给老底嘉教会的使者，说，那为阿们的，为诚信真实见证的，在神创造万物之上为元首的，说，

chapters.en: I know your deeds, that you are neither cold nor hot. I wish you were either one or the other!
chapters.zh: 我知道你的行为，你也不冷也不热。我巴不得你或冷或热。

chapters.en: So, because you are lukewarm—neither hot nor cold—I am about to spit you out of my mouth.
chapters.zh: 你既如温水，也不冷也不热，所以我必从我口中把你吐出去。

chapters.en: You say, ‘I am rich; I have acquired wealth and do not need a thing.’ But you do not realize that you are wretched, pitiful, poor, blind and naked.
chapters.zh: 你说，我是富足，已经发了财，一样都不缺。却不知道你是那困苦，可怜，贫穷，瞎眼，赤身的。

chapters.en: I counsel you to buy from me gold refined in the fire, so you can become rich; and white clothes to wear, so you can cover your shameful nakedness; and salve to put on your eyes, so you can see.
chapters.zh: 我劝你向我买火炼的金子，叫你富足。又买白衣穿上，叫你赤身的羞耻不露出来。又买眼药擦你的眼睛，使你能看见。

chapters.en: Those whom I love I rebuke and discipline. So be earnest and repent.
chapters.zh: 凡我所疼爱的，我就责备管教他。所以你要发热心，也要悔改。

chapters.en: Here I am! I stand at the door and knock. If anyone hears my voice and opens the door, I will come in and eat with that person, and they with me.
chapters.zh: 看哪，我站在门外叩门。若有听见我声音就开门的，我要进到他那里去，我与他，他与我一同坐席。

chapters.en: To the one who is victorious, I will give the right to sit with me on my throne, just as I was victorious and sat down with my Father on his throne.
chapters.zh: 得胜的，我要赐他在我宝座上与我同坐，就如我得了胜，在我父的宝座上与他同坐一般。

chapters.en: Whoever has ears, let them hear what the Spirit says to the churches.”
chapters.zh: 圣灵向众教会所说的话，凡有耳的，就应当听。
