chapters.en: After this I looked, and there before me was a door standing open in heaven. And the voice I had first heard speaking to me like a trumpet said, “Come up here, and I will show you what must take place after this.”
chapters.zh: 此后，我观看，见天上有门开了，我初次听见好像吹号的声音，对我说，你上到这里来，我要将以后必成的事指示你。

chapters.en: At once I was in the Spirit, and there before me was a throne in heaven with someone sitting on it.
chapters.zh: 我立刻被圣灵感动，见有一个宝座安置在天上，又有一位坐在宝座上。

chapters.en: And the one who sat there had the appearance of jasper and ruby. A rainbow that shone like an emerald encircled the throne.
chapters.zh: 看那坐着的，好像碧玉和红宝石。又有虹围着宝座，好像绿宝石。

chapters.en: Surrounding the throne were twenty-four other thrones, and seated on them were twenty-four elders. They were dressed in white and had crowns of gold on their heads.
chapters.zh: 宝座的周围，又有二十四个座位，其上坐着二十四位长老，身穿白衣，头上戴着金冠冕。

chapters.en: From the throne came flashes of lightning, rumblings and peals of thunder. In front of the throne, seven lamps were blazing. These are the seven spirits of God.
chapters.zh: 有闪电，声音，雷轰，从宝座中发出。又有七盏火灯在宝座前点着，这七灯就是神的七灵。

chapters.en: Also in front of the throne there was what looked like a sea of glass, clear as crystal. In the center, around the throne, were four living creatures, and they were covered with eyes, in front and in back.
chapters.zh: 宝座前好像一个玻璃海如同水晶。宝座中，和宝座周围有四个活物，前后遍体都满了眼睛。

chapters.en: The first living creature was like a lion, the second was like an ox, the third had a face like a man, the fourth was like a flying eagle.
chapters.zh: 第一个活物像狮子，第二个像牛犊，第三个脸面像人，第四个像飞鹰。

chapters.en: Each of the four living creatures had six wings and was covered with eyes all around, even under its wings. Day and night they never stop saying: “ ‘Holy, holy, holy is the Lord God Almighty,’who was, and is, and is to come.”
chapters.zh: 四活物各有六个翅膀，遍体内外都满了眼睛。他们昼夜不住地说，圣哉，圣哉，圣哉，主神。是昔在今在以后永在的全能者。

chapters.en: Whenever the living creatures give glory, honor and thanks to him who sits on the throne and who lives for ever and ever,
chapters.zh: 每逢四活物将荣耀，尊贵，感谢，归给那坐在宝座上，活到永永远远者的时候，

chapters.en: the twenty-four elders fall down before him who sits on the throne and worship him who lives for ever and ever. They lay their crowns before the throne and say:
chapters.zh: 那二十四位长老，就俯伏在坐宝座的面前，敬拜那活到永永远远的，又把他们的冠冕放在宝座前，说，

chapters.en: “You are worthy, our Lord and God, to receive glory and honor and power, for you created all things, and by your will they were created and have their being.”
chapters.zh: 我们的主，我们的神，你是配得荣耀尊贵权柄的。因为你创造了万物，并且万物是因你的旨意被创造而有的。

chapters.en: Then I saw in the right hand of him who sat on the throne a scroll with writing on both sides and sealed with seven seals.
chapters.zh: 我看见坐宝座的右手中有书卷，里外都写着字，用七印封严了。

chapters.en: And I saw a mighty angel proclaiming in a loud voice, “Who is worthy to break the seals and open the scroll?”
chapters.zh: 我又看见一位大力的天使，大声宣传说，有谁配展开那书卷，揭开那七印呢？

chapters.en: But no one in heaven or on earth or under the earth could open the scroll or even look inside it.
chapters.zh: 在天上，地上，地底下，没有能展开能观看那书卷的。

chapters.en: I wept and wept because no one was found who was worthy to open the scroll or look inside.
chapters.zh: 因为没有配展开，配观看那书卷的，我就大哭。

chapters.en: Then one of the elders said to me, “Do not weep! See, the Lion of the tribe of Judah, the Root of David, has triumphed. He is able to open the scroll and its seven seals.”
chapters.zh: 长老中有一位对我说，不要哭。看哪，犹大支派中的狮子，大卫的根，他已得胜，能以展开那书卷，揭开那七印。

chapters.en: Then I saw a Lamb, looking as if it had been slain, standing at the center of the throne, encircled by the four living creatures and the elders. The Lamb had seven horns and seven eyes, which are the seven spirits of God sent out into all the earth.
chapters.zh: 我又看见宝座与四活物并长老之中，有羔羊站立，像是被杀过的，有七角七眼，就是神的七灵，奉差遣往普天下去的。

chapters.en: He went and took the scroll from the right hand of him who sat on the throne.
chapters.zh: 这羔羊前来，从坐宝座的右手里拿了书卷。

chapters.en: And when he had taken it, the four living creatures and the twenty-four elders fell down before the Lamb. Each one had a harp and they were holding golden bowls full of incense, which are the prayers of God’s people.
chapters.zh: 他既拿了书卷，四活物和二十四位长老，就俯伏在羔羊面前，各拿着琴，和盛满了香的金炉。这香就是众圣徒的祈祷。

chapters.en: And they sang a new song, saying: “You are worthy to take the scroll and to open its seals, because you were slain, and with your blood you purchased for God persons from every tribe and language and people and nation.
chapters.zh: 他们唱新歌，说，你配拿书卷，配揭开七印。因为你曾被杀，用自己的血从各族各方，各民各国中买了人来，叫他们归于神，

chapters.en: You have made them to be a kingdom and priests to serve our God, and they will reign on the earth.”
chapters.zh: 又叫他们成为国民，作祭司，归于神。在地上执掌王权。

chapters.en: Then I looked and heard the voice of many angels, numbering thousands upon thousands, and ten thousand times ten thousand. They encircled the throne and the living creatures and the elders.
chapters.zh: 我又看见，且听见，宝座与活物并长老的周围，有许多天使的声音。他们的数目有千千万万。

chapters.en: In a loud voice they were saying: “Worthy is the Lamb, who was slain, to receive power and wealth and wisdom and strength and honor and glory and praise!”
chapters.zh: 大声说，曾被杀的羔羊，是配得权柄，丰富，智慧，能力，尊贵，荣耀，颂赞的。

chapters.en: Then I heard every creature in heaven and on earth and under the earth and on the sea, and all that is in them, saying: “To him who sits on the throne and to the Lamb be praise and honor and glory and power, for ever and ever!”
chapters.zh: 我又听见，在天上，地上，地底下，沧海里，和天地间一切所有被造之物，都说，但愿颂赞，尊贵，荣耀，权势，都归给坐宝座的和羔羊，直到永永远远。

chapters.en: The four living creatures said, “Amen,” and the elders fell down and worshiped.
chapters.zh: 四活物就说，阿们。众长老也俯伏敬拜。

chapters.en: I watched as the Lamb opened the first of the seven seals. Then I heard one of the four living creatures say in a voice like thunder, “Come!”
chapters.zh: 我看见羔羊揭开七印中第一印的时候，就听见四活物中的一个活物，声音如雷，说，你来。

chapters.en: I looked, and there before me was a white horse! Its rider held a bow, and he was given a crown, and he rode out as a conqueror bent on conquest.
chapters.zh: 我就观看，见有一匹白马，骑在马上的拿着弓。并有冠冕赐给他。他便出来，胜了又要胜。

chapters.en: When the Lamb opened the second seal, I heard the second living creature say, “Come!”
chapters.zh: 揭开第二印的时候，我听见第二个活物说，你来。

chapters.en: Then another horse came out, a fiery red one. Its rider was given power to take peace from the earth and to make people kill each other. To him was given a large sword.
chapters.zh: 就另有一匹马出来，是红的。有权柄给了那骑马的，可以从地上夺去太平，使人彼此相杀。又有一把大刀赐给他。

chapters.en: When the Lamb opened the third seal, I heard the third living creature say, “Come!” I looked, and there before me was a black horse! Its rider was holding a pair of scales in his hand.
chapters.zh: 揭开第三印的时候，我听见第三个活物说，你来。我就观看，见有一匹黑马。骑在马上的手里拿着天平。

chapters.en: Then I heard what sounded like a voice among the four living creatures, saying, “Two pounds of wheat for a day’s wages, and six pounds of barley for a day’s wages, and do not damage the oil and the wine!”
chapters.zh: 我听见在四活物中，似乎有声音说，一钱银子买一升麦子，一钱银子买三升大麦。油和酒不可糟蹋。

chapters.en: When the Lamb opened the fourth seal, I heard the voice of the fourth living creature say, “Come!”
chapters.zh: 揭开第四印的时候，我听见第四个活物说，你来。

chapters.en: I looked, and there before me was a pale horse! Its rider was named Death, and Hades was following close behind him. They were given power over a fourth of the earth to kill by sword, famine and plague, and by the wild beasts of the earth.
chapters.zh: 我就观看，见有一匹灰色马。骑在马上的，名字叫作死。阴府也随着他。有权柄赐给他们，可以用刀剑，饥荒，瘟疫（瘟疫或作死亡），野兽，杀害地上四分之一的人。

chapters.en: When he opened the fifth seal, I saw under the altar the souls of those who had been slain because of the word of God and the testimony they had maintained.
chapters.zh: 揭开第五印的时候，我看见在祭坛底下，有为神的道，并为作见证，被杀之人的灵魂。

chapters.en: They called out in a loud voice, “How long, Sovereign Lord, holy and true, until you judge the inhabitants of the earth and avenge our blood?”
chapters.zh: 大声喊着说，圣洁真实的主阿，你不审判住在地上的人给我们伸流血的冤，要等到几时呢？

chapters.en: Then each of them was given a white robe, and they were told to wait a little longer, until the full number of their fellow servants, their brothers and sisters, were killed just as they had been.
chapters.zh: 于是有白衣赐给他们各人。又有话对他们说，还要安息片时，等着一同作仆人的，和他们的弟兄，也像他们被杀，满足了数目。

chapters.en: I watched as he opened the sixth seal. There was a great earthquake. The sun turned black like sackcloth made of goat hair, the whole moon turned blood red,
chapters.zh: 揭开第六印的时候，我又看见地大震动。日头变黑像毛布，满月变红像血。

chapters.en: and the stars in the sky fell to earth, as figs drop from a fig tree when shaken by a strong wind.
chapters.zh: 天上的星辰坠落于地，如同无花果树被大风摇动，落下未熟的果子一样。

chapters.en: The heavens receded like a scroll being rolled up, and every mountain and island was removed from its place.
chapters.zh: 天就挪移，好像书卷被卷起来。山岭海岛都被挪移离开本位。

chapters.en: Then the kings of the earth, the princes, the generals, the rich, the mighty, and everyone else, both slave and free, hid in caves and among the rocks of the mountains.
chapters.zh: 地上的君王，臣宰，将军，富户，壮士，和一切为奴的，自主的，都藏在山洞，和岩石穴里。

chapters.en: They called to the mountains and the rocks, “Fall on us and hide us from the face of him who sits on the throne and from the wrath of the Lamb!
chapters.zh: 向山和岩石说，倒在我们身上吧，把我们藏起来，躲避坐宝座者的面目，和羔羊的忿怒。

chapters.en: For the great day of their wrath has come, and who can withstand it?”
chapters.zh: 因为他们忿怒的大日到了，谁能站得住呢？

chapters.en: After this I saw four angels standing at the four corners of the earth, holding back the four winds of the earth to prevent any wind from blowing on the land or on the sea or on any tree.
chapters.zh: 此后我看见四位天使站在地的四角，执掌地上四方的风，叫风不吹在地上，海上，和树上。

chapters.en: Then I saw another angel coming up from the east, having the seal of the living God. He called out in a loud voice to the four angels who had been given power to harm the land and the sea:
chapters.zh: 我又看见另有一位天使，从日出之地上来，拿着永生神的印。他就向那得着权柄能伤害地和海的四位天使，大声喊着说，

chapters.en: “Do not harm the land or the sea or the trees until we put a seal on the foreheads of the servants of our God.”
chapters.zh: 地与海并树木，你们不可伤害，等我们印了我们神众仆人的额。

chapters.en: Then I heard the number of those who were sealed: 144,000 from all the tribes of Israel.
chapters.zh: 我听见以色列人，各支派中受印的数目，有十四万四千。

chapters.en: From the tribe of Judah 12,000 were sealed, from the tribe of Reuben 12,000, from the tribe of Gad 12,000,
chapters.zh: 犹大支派中受印的有一万二千。流便支派中有一万二千。迦得支派中有一万二千。

chapters.en: from the tribe of Asher 12,000, from the tribe of Naphtali 12,000, from the tribe of Manasseh 12,000,
chapters.zh: 亚设支派中有一万二千。拿弗他利支派中有一万二千。玛拿西支派中有一万二千。

chapters.en: from the tribe of Simeon 12,000, from the tribe of Levi 12,000, from the tribe of Issachar 12,000,
chapters.zh: 西缅支派中有一万二千。利未支派中有一万二千。以萨迦支派中有一万二千。

chapters.en: from the tribe of Zebulun 12,000, from the tribe of Joseph 12,000, from the tribe of Benjamin 12,000.
chapters.zh: 西布伦支派中有一万二千。约瑟支派中有一万二千。便雅悯支派中受印的有一万二千。

chapters.en: After this I looked, and there before me was a great multitude that no one could count, from every nation, tribe, people and language, standing before the throne and before the Lamb. They were wearing white robes and were holding palm branches in their hands.
chapters.zh: 此后，我观看，见有许多的人，没有人能数过来，是从各国各族各民各方来的，站在宝座和羔羊面前，身穿白衣，手拿棕树枝。

chapters.en: And they cried out in a loud voice: “Salvation belongs to our God, who sits on the throne, and to the Lamb.”
chapters.zh: 大声喊着说，愿救恩归与坐在宝座上我们的神，也归与羔羊。

chapters.en: All the angels were standing around the throne and around the elders and the four living creatures. They fell down on their faces before the throne and worshiped God,
chapters.zh: 众天使都站在宝座和众长老并四活物的周围，在宝座前，面伏于地，敬拜神，

chapters.en: saying: “Amen! Praise and glory and wisdom and thanks and honor and power and strength be to our God for ever and ever. Amen!”
chapters.zh: 说，阿们。颂赞，荣耀，智慧，感谢，尊贵，权柄，大力，都归与我们的神，直到永永远远。阿们。

chapters.en: Then one of the elders asked me, “These in white robes—who are they, and where did they come from?”
chapters.zh: 长老中有一位问我说，这些穿白衣的是谁？是从哪里来的？

chapters.en: I answered, “Sir, you know.” And he said, “These are they who have come out of the great tribulation; they have washed their robes and made them white in the blood of the Lamb.
chapters.zh: 我对他说，我主，你知道。他向我说，这些人是从大患难中出来的，曾用羔羊的血，把衣裳洗白净了。

chapters.en: Therefore, “they are before the throne of God and serve him day and night in his temple; and he who sits on the throne will shelter them with his presence.
chapters.zh: 所以他们在神宝座前，昼夜在他殿中事奉他。坐宝座的要用帐幕覆庇他们。

chapters.en: ‘Never again will they hunger; never again will they thirst. The sun will not beat down on them,’nor any scorching heat.
chapters.zh: 他们不再饥，不再渴。日头和炎热，也必不伤害他们。

chapters.en: For the Lamb at the center of the throne will be their shepherd; ‘he will lead them to springs of living water.’‘And God will wipe away every tear from their eyes.’ ”
chapters.zh: 因为宝座中的羔羊必牧养他们，领他们到生命水的泉源。神也必擦去他们一切的眼泪。

chapters.en: When he opened the seventh seal, there was silence in heaven for about half an hour.
chapters.zh: 羔羊揭开第七印的时候，天上寂静约有二刻。

chapters.en: And I saw the seven angels who stand before God, and seven trumpets were given to them.
chapters.zh: 我看见那站在神面前的七位天使，有七枝号赐给他们。

chapters.en: Another angel, who had a golden censer, came and stood at the altar. He was given much incense to offer, with the prayers of all God’s people, on the golden altar in front of the throne.
chapters.zh: 另有一位天使拿着金香炉，来站在祭坛旁边。有许多香赐给他，要和众圣徒的祈祷一同献在宝座前的金坛上。

chapters.en: The smoke of the incense, together with the prayers of God’s people, went up before God from the angel’s hand.
chapters.zh: 那香的烟，和众圣徒的祈祷，从天使的手中一同升到神面前。

chapters.en: Then the angel took the censer, filled it with fire from the altar, and hurled it on the earth; and there came peals of thunder, rumblings, flashes of lightning and an earthquake.
chapters.zh: 天使拿着香炉，盛满了坛上的火，倒在地上。随有雷轰，大声，闪电，地震。

chapters.en: Then the seven angels who had the seven trumpets prepared to sound them.
chapters.zh: 拿着七枝号的七位天使，就预备要吹。

chapters.en: The first angel sounded his trumpet, and there came hail and fire mixed with blood, and it was hurled down on the earth. A third of the earth was burned up, a third of the trees were burned up, and all the green grass was burned up.
chapters.zh: 第一位天使吹号，就有雹子与火搀着血丢在地上。地的三分之一和树的三分之一被烧了，一切的青草也被烧了。

chapters.en: The second angel sounded his trumpet, and something like a huge mountain, all ablaze, was thrown into the sea. A third of the sea turned into blood,
chapters.zh: 第二位天使吹号，就有仿佛火烧着的大山扔在海中。海的三分之一变成血。

chapters.en: a third of the living creatures in the sea died, and a third of the ships were destroyed.
chapters.zh: 海中的活物死了三分之一。船只也坏了三分之一。

chapters.en: The third angel sounded his trumpet, and a great star, blazing like a torch, fell from the sky on a third of the rivers and on the springs of water—
chapters.zh: 第三位天使吹号，就有烧着的大星，好像火把从天上落下来，落在江河的三分之一，和众水的泉源上。

chapters.en: the name of the star is Wormwood. A third of the waters turned bitter, and many people died from the waters that had become bitter.
chapters.zh: 这星名叫茵陈。众水的三分之一变为茵陈。因水变苦，就死了许多人。

chapters.en: The fourth angel sounded his trumpet, and a third of the sun was struck, a third of the moon, and a third of the stars, so that a third of them turned dark. A third of the day was without light, and also a third of the night.
chapters.zh: 第四位天使吹号，日头的三分之一，月亮的三分之一，星辰的三分之一，都被击打。以致日月星的三分之一黑暗了，白昼的三分之一没有光，黑夜也是这样。

chapters.en: As I watched, I heard an eagle that was flying in midair call out in a loud voice: “Woe! Woe! Woe to the inhabitants of the earth, because of the trumpet blasts about to be sounded by the other three angels!”
chapters.zh: 我又看见一个鹰飞在空中，并听见它大声说，三位天使要吹那其余的号，你们住在地上的民，祸哉，祸哉，祸哉。

chapters.en: The fifth angel sounded his trumpet, and I saw a star that had fallen from the sky to the earth. The star was given the key to the shaft of the Abyss.
chapters.zh: 第五位天使吹号，我就看见一个星从天落到地上。有无底坑的钥匙赐给他。

chapters.en: When he opened the Abyss, smoke rose from it like the smoke from a gigantic furnace. The sun and sky were darkened by the smoke from the Abyss.
chapters.zh: 他开了无底坑，便有烟从坑里往上冒，好像大火炉的烟。日头和天空，都因这烟昏暗了。

chapters.en: And out of the smoke locusts came down on the earth and were given power like that of scorpions of the earth.
chapters.zh: 有蝗虫从烟中出来飞到地上。有能力赐给它们，好像地上蝎子的能力一样。

chapters.en: They were told not to harm the grass of the earth or any plant or tree, but only those people who did not have the seal of God on their foreheads.
chapters.zh: 并且吩咐它们说，不可伤害地上的草，和各样青物，并一切树木，惟独要伤害额上没有神印记的人。

chapters.en: They were not allowed to kill them but only to torture them for five months. And the agony they suffered was like that of the sting of a scorpion when it strikes.
chapters.zh: 但不许蝗虫害死他们，只叫他们受痛苦五个月。这痛苦就像蝎子螫人的痛苦一样。

chapters.en: During those days people will seek death but will not find it; they will long to die, but death will elude them.
chapters.zh: 在那些日子，人要求死，决不得死。愿意死，死却远避他们。

chapters.en: The locusts looked like horses prepared for battle. On their heads they wore something like crowns of gold, and their faces resembled human faces.
chapters.zh: 蝗虫的形状，好像预备出战的马一样，头上戴的好像金冠冕，脸面好像男人的脸面。

chapters.en: Their hair was like women’s hair, and their teeth were like lions’ teeth.
chapters.zh: 头发像女人的头发，牙齿像狮子的牙齿。

chapters.en: They had breastplates like breastplates of iron, and the sound of their wings was like the thundering of many horses and chariots rushing into battle.
chapters.zh: 胸前有甲，好像铁甲。它们翅膀的声音，好像许多车马奔跑上阵的声音。

chapters.en: They had tails with stingers, like scorpions, and in their tails they had power to torment people for five months.
chapters.zh: 有尾巴像蝎子。尾巴上的毒钩能伤人五个月。

chapters.en: They had as king over them the angel of the Abyss, whose name in Hebrew is Abaddon and in Greek is Apollyon (that is, Destroyer).
chapters.zh: 有无底坑的使者作它们的王。按着希伯来话，名叫亚巴顿，希利尼话，名叫亚玻伦。

chapters.en: The first woe is past; two other woes are yet to come.
chapters.zh: 第一样灾祸过去了，还有两样灾祸要来。

chapters.en: The sixth angel sounded his trumpet, and I heard a voice coming from the four horns of the golden altar that is before God.
chapters.zh: 第六位天使吹号，我就听见有声音，从神面前金坛的四角出来，

chapters.en: It said to the sixth angel who had the trumpet, “Release the four angels who are bound at the great river Euphrates.”
chapters.zh: 吩咐那吹号的第六位天使，说，把那捆绑在伯拉大河的四个使者释放了。

chapters.en: And the four angels who had been kept ready for this very hour and day and month and year were released to kill a third of mankind.
chapters.zh: 那四个使者就被释放。他们原是预备好了，到某年某月某日某时，要杀人的三分之一。

chapters.en: The number of the mounted troops was twice ten thousand times ten thousand. I heard their number.
chapters.zh: 马军有二万万。他们的数目我听见了。

chapters.en: The horses and riders I saw in my vision looked like this: Their breastplates were fiery red, dark blue, and yellow as sulfur. The heads of the horses resembled the heads of lions, and out of their mouths came fire, smoke and sulfur.
chapters.zh: 我在异象中看见那些马和骑马的，骑马的胸前有甲如火，与紫玛瑙，并硫磺。马的头好像狮子头，有火，有烟，有硫磺，从马的口中出来。

chapters.en: A third of mankind was killed by the three plagues of fire, smoke and sulfur that came out of their mouths.
chapters.zh: 口中所出来的火，与烟，并硫磺，这三样灾杀了人的三分之一。

chapters.en: The power of the horses was in their mouths and in their tails; for their tails were like snakes, having heads with which they inflict injury.
chapters.zh: 这马的能力，是在口里，和尾巴上。因这尾巴像蛇，并且有头用以害人。

chapters.en: The rest of mankind who were not killed by these plagues still did not repent of the work of their hands; they did not stop worshiping demons, and idols of gold, silver, bronze, stone and wood—idols that cannot see or hear or walk.
chapters.zh: 其余未曾被这些灾所杀的人，仍旧不悔改自己手所作的，还是去拜鬼魔，和那些不能看，不能听，不能走，金，银，铜，木，石，的偶像。

chapters.en: Nor did they repent of their murders, their magic arts, their sexual immorality or their thefts.
chapters.zh: 又不悔改他们那些凶杀，邪术，奸淫，偷窃的事。

chapters.en: Then I saw another mighty angel coming down from heaven. He was robed in a cloud, with a rainbow above his head; his face was like the sun, and his legs were like fiery pillars.
chapters.zh: 我又看见另有一位大力的天使，从天降下，披着云彩，头上有虹。脸面像日头，两脚像火柱。

chapters.en: He was holding a little scroll, which lay open in his hand. He planted his right foot on the sea and his left foot on the land,
chapters.zh: 他手里拿着小书卷是展开的。他右脚踏海，左脚踏地。

chapters.en: and he gave a loud shout like the roar of a lion. When he shouted, the voices of the seven thunders spoke.
chapters.zh: 大声呼喊，好像狮子吼叫，呼喊完了，就有七雷发声。

chapters.en: And when the seven thunders spoke, I was about to write; but I heard a voice from heaven say, “Seal up what the seven thunders have said and do not write it down.”
chapters.zh: 七雷发声之后，我正要写出来，就听见从天上有声音说，七雷所说的你要封上，不可写出来。

chapters.en: Then the angel I had seen standing on the sea and on the land raised his right hand to heaven.
chapters.zh: 我所看见的那踏海踏地的天使，向天举起右手来，

chapters.en: And he swore by him who lives for ever and ever, who created the heavens and all that is in them, the earth and all that is in it, and the sea and all that is in it, and said, “There will be no more delay!
chapters.zh: 指着那创造天和天上之物，地和地上之物，海和海中之物，直活到永永远远的，起誓说，不再有时日了。（或作不再耽延了）

chapters.en: But in the days when the seventh angel is about to sound his trumpet, the mystery of God will be accomplished, just as he announced to his servants the prophets.”
chapters.zh: 但在第七位天使吹号发声的时候，神的奥秘，就成全了，正如神所传给他仆人众先知的佳音。

chapters.en: Then the voice that I had heard from heaven spoke to me once more: “Go, take the scroll that lies open in the hand of the angel who is standing on the sea and on the land.”
chapters.zh: 我先前从天上所听见的那声音，又吩咐我说，你去把那踏海踏地之天使手中展开的小书卷取过来。

chapters.en: So I went to the angel and asked him to give me the little scroll. He said to me, “Take it and eat it. It will turn your stomach sour, but ‘in your mouth it will be as sweet as honey.’ ”
chapters.zh: 我就走到天使那里，对他说，请你把小书卷给我。他对我说，你拿着吃尽了，便叫你肚子发苦，然而在你口中要甜如蜜。

chapters.en: I took the little scroll from the angel’s hand and ate it. It tasted as sweet as honey in my mouth, but when I had eaten it, my stomach turned sour.
chapters.zh: 我从天使手中把小书卷接过来，吃尽了。在我口中果然甜如蜜。吃了以后，肚子觉得发苦了。

chapters.en: Then I was told, “You must prophesy again about many peoples, nations, languages and kings.”
chapters.zh: 天使（原文作他们）对我说，你必指着多民多国多方多王再说预言。

chapters.en: I was given a reed like a measuring rod and was told, “Go and measure the temple of God and the altar, with its worshipers.
chapters.zh: 有一根苇子赐给我，当作量度的杖。且有话说，起来，将神的殿，和祭坛，并在殿中礼拜的人，都量一量。

chapters.en: But exclude the outer court; do not measure it, because it has been given to the Gentiles. They will trample on the holy city for 42 months.
chapters.zh: 只是殿外的院子，要留下不用量。因为这是给了外邦人的。他们要践踏圣城四十二个月。

chapters.en: And I will appoint my two witnesses, and they will prophesy for 1,260 days, clothed in sackcloth.”
chapters.zh: 我要使我那两个见证人，穿着毛衣，传道一千二百六十天。

chapters.en: They are “the two olive trees” and the two lampstands, and “they stand before the Lord of the earth.”
chapters.zh: 他们就是那两棵橄榄树，两个灯台，立在世界之主面前的。

chapters.en: If anyone tries to harm them, fire comes from their mouths and devours their enemies. This is how anyone who wants to harm them must die.
chapters.zh: 若有人想要害他们，就有火从他们口中出来，烧灭仇敌。凡想要害他们的，都必这样被杀。

chapters.en: They have power to shut up the heavens so that it will not rain during the time they are prophesying; and they have power to turn the waters into blood and to strike the earth with every kind of plague as often as they want.
chapters.zh: 这二人有权柄，在他们传道的日子叫天闭塞不下雨，又有权柄叫水变为血。并且能随时随意用各样的灾殃攻击世界。

chapters.en: Now when they have finished their testimony, the beast that comes up from the Abyss will attack them, and overpower and kill them.
chapters.zh: 他们作完见证的时候，那从无底坑里上来的兽，必与他们交战，并且得胜，把他们杀了。

chapters.en: Their bodies will lie in the public square of the great city—which is figuratively called Sodom and Egypt—where also their Lord was crucified.
chapters.zh: 他们的尸首就倒在大城里的街上。这城按着灵意叫所多玛，又叫埃及，就是他们的主钉十字架之处。

chapters.en: For three and a half days some from every people, tribe, language and nation will gaze on their bodies and refuse them burial.
chapters.zh: 从各民各族各方各国中，有人观看他们的尸首三天半，又不许把尸首放在坟墓里。

chapters.en: The inhabitants of the earth will gloat over them and will celebrate by sending each other gifts, because these two prophets had tormented those who live on the earth.
chapters.zh: 住在地上的人，就为他们欢喜快乐，互相馈送礼物。因这两位先知曾叫住在地上的人受痛苦。

chapters.en: But after the three and a half days the breath of life from God entered them, and they stood on their feet, and terror struck those who saw them.
chapters.zh: 过了这三天半，有生气从神那里进入他们里面，他们就站起来。看见他们的人甚是害怕。

chapters.en: Then they heard a loud voice from heaven saying to them, “Come up here.” And they went up to heaven in a cloud, while their enemies looked on.
chapters.zh: 两位先知听见有大声音从天上来，对他们说，上到这里来。他们就驾着云上了天。他们的仇敌也看见了。

chapters.en: At that very hour there was a severe earthquake and a tenth of the city collapsed. Seven thousand people were killed in the earthquake, and the survivors were terrified and gave glory to the God of heaven.
chapters.zh: 正在那时候，地大震动，城就倒塌了十分之一。因地震而死的有七千人。其余的都恐惧，归荣耀给天上的神。

chapters.en: The second woe has passed; the third woe is coming soon.
chapters.zh: 第二样灾祸过去。第三样灾祸快到了。

chapters.en: The seventh angel sounded his trumpet, and there were loud voices in heaven, which said: “The kingdom of the world has become the kingdom of our Lord and of his Messiah, and he will reign for ever and ever.”
chapters.zh: 第七位天使吹号，天上就有大声音说，世上的国，成了我主和主基督的国。他要作王，直到永永远远。

chapters.en: And the twenty-four elders, who were seated on their thrones before God, fell on their faces and worshiped God,
chapters.zh: 在神面前，坐在自己位上的二十四位长老，就面伏于地敬拜神，

chapters.en: saying: “We give thanks to you, Lord God Almighty, the One who is and who was, because you have taken your great power and have begun to reign.
chapters.zh: 说，昔在今在的主神，全能者阿，我们感谢你，因你执掌大权作王了。

chapters.en: The nations were angry, and your wrath has come. The time has come for judging the dead, and for rewarding your servants the prophets and your people who revere your name, both great and small— and for destroying those who destroy the earth.”
chapters.zh: 外邦发怒，你的忿怒也临到了。审判死人的时候也到了。你的仆人众先知，和众圣徒，凡敬畏你名的人连大带小得赏赐的时候也到了。你败坏那些败坏世界之人的时候也就到了。

chapters.en: Then God’s temple in heaven was opened, and within his temple was seen the ark of his covenant. And there came flashes of lightning, rumblings, peals of thunder, an earthquake and a severe hailstorm.
chapters.zh: 当时神天上的殿开了，在他殿中现出他的约柜。随后有闪电，声音，雷轰，地震，大雹。

chapters.en: A great sign appeared in heaven: a woman clothed with the sun, with the moon under her feet and a crown of twelve stars on her head.
chapters.zh: 天上现出大异象来。有一个妇人，身披日头，脚踏月亮，头戴十二星的冠冕。

chapters.en: She was pregnant and cried out in pain as she was about to give birth.
chapters.zh: 她怀了孕，在生产的艰难中疼痛呼叫。

chapters.en: Then another sign appeared in heaven: an enormous red dragon with seven heads and ten horns and seven crowns on its heads.
chapters.zh: 天上又现出异象来。有一条大红龙，七头十角，七头上戴着七个冠冕。

chapters.en: Its tail swept a third of the stars out of the sky and flung them to the earth. The dragon stood in front of the woman who was about to give birth, so that it might devour her child the moment he was born.
chapters.zh: 它的尾巴拖拉着天上星辰的三分之一，摔在地上。龙就站在那将要生产的妇人面前，等她生产之后，要吞吃她的孩子。

chapters.en: She gave birth to a son, a male child, who “will rule all the nations with an iron scepter.” And her child was snatched up to God and to his throne.
chapters.zh: 妇人生了一个男孩子，是将来要用铁杖辖管万国的（辖管原文作牧）。她的孩子被提到神宝座那里去了。

chapters.en: The woman fled into the wilderness to a place prepared for her by God, where she might be taken care of for 1,260 days.
chapters.zh: 妇人就逃到旷野，在那里有神给她预备的地方，使她被养活一千二百六十天。

chapters.en: Then war broke out in heaven. Michael and his angels fought against the dragon, and the dragon and his angels fought back.
chapters.zh: 在天上就有了争战。米迦勒同他的使者与龙争战。龙也同它的使者去争战。

chapters.en: But he was not strong enough, and they lost their place in heaven.
chapters.zh: 并没有得胜，天上再没有它们的地方。

chapters.en: The great dragon was hurled down—that ancient serpent called the devil, or Satan, who leads the whole world astray. He was hurled to the earth, and his angels with him.
chapters.zh: 大龙就是那古蛇，名叫魔鬼，又叫撒但，是迷惑普天下的。它被摔在地上，它的使者也一同被摔下去。

chapters.en: Then I heard a loud voice in heaven say: “Now have come the salvation and the power and the kingdom of our God, and the authority of his Messiah. For the accuser of our brothers and sisters, who accuses them before our God day and night, has been hurled down.
chapters.zh: 我听见在天上有大声音说，我神的救恩，能力，国度，并他基督的权柄，现在都来到了。因为那在我们神面前昼夜控告我们弟兄的，已经被摔下去了。

chapters.en: They triumphed over him by the blood of the Lamb and by the word of their testimony; they did not love their lives so much as to shrink from death.
chapters.zh: 弟兄胜过它，是因羔羊的血，和自己所见证的道。他们虽至于死，也不爱惜性命。

chapters.en: Therefore rejoice, you heavens and you who dwell in them! But woe to the earth and the sea, because the devil has gone down to you! He is filled with fury, because he knows that his time is short.”
chapters.zh: 所以诸天和住在其中的，你们都快乐吧。只是地与海有祸了，因为魔鬼知道自己的时候不多，就气忿忿地下到你们那里去了。

chapters.en: When the dragon saw that he had been hurled to the earth, he pursued the woman who had given birth to the male child.
chapters.zh: 龙见自己被摔在地上，就逼迫那生男孩子的妇人。

chapters.en: The woman was given the two wings of a great eagle, so that she might fly to the place prepared for her in the wilderness, where she would be taken care of for a time, times and half a time, out of the serpent’s reach.
chapters.zh: 于是有大鹰的两个翅膀赐给妇人，叫她能飞到旷野，到自己的地方，躲避那蛇。她在那里被养活一载二载半载。

chapters.en: Then from his mouth the serpent spewed water like a river, to overtake the woman and sweep her away with the torrent.
chapters.zh: 蛇就在妇人身后，从口中吐出水来像河一样，要将妇人冲去。

chapters.en: But the earth helped the woman by opening its mouth and swallowing the river that the dragon had spewed out of his mouth.
chapters.zh: 地却帮助妇人，开口吞了从龙口吐出来的水。（原文作河）

chapters.en: Then the dragon was enraged at the woman and went off to wage war against the rest of her offspring—those who keep God’s commands and hold fast their testimony about Jesus.
chapters.zh: 龙向妇人发怒，去与她其余的儿女争战，这儿女就是那守神诫命，为耶稣作见证的。那时龙就站在海边的沙上。

chapters.en: The dragon stood on the shore of the sea. And I saw a beast coming out of the sea. It had ten horns and seven heads, with ten crowns on its horns, and on each head a blasphemous name.
chapters.zh: 我又看见一个兽从海中上来，有十角七头，在十角上戴着十个冠冕，七头上有亵渎的名号。

chapters.en: The beast I saw resembled a leopard, but had feet like those of a bear and a mouth like that of a lion. The dragon gave the beast his power and his throne and great authority.
chapters.zh: 我所看见的兽，形状像豹，脚像熊的脚，口像狮子的口。那龙将自己的能力，座位，和大权柄，都给了它。

chapters.en: One of the heads of the beast seemed to have had a fatal wound, but the fatal wound had been healed. The whole world was filled with wonder and followed the beast.
chapters.zh: 我看见兽的七头中，有一个似乎受了死伤。那死伤却医好了。全地的人，都希奇跟从那兽。

chapters.en: People worshiped the dragon because he had given authority to the beast, and they also worshiped the beast and asked, “Who is like the beast? Who can wage war against it?”
chapters.zh: 又拜那龙，因为它将自己的权柄给了兽。也拜兽说，谁能比这兽，谁能与它交战呢？

chapters.en: The beast was given a mouth to utter proud words and blasphemies and to exercise its authority for forty-two months.
chapters.zh: 又赐给它说夸大亵渎话的口。又有权柄赐给它，可以任意而行四十二个月。

chapters.en: It opened its mouth to blaspheme God, and to slander his name and his dwelling place and those who live in heaven.
chapters.zh: 兽就开口向神说亵渎的话，亵渎神的名，并他的帐幕，以及那些住在天上的。

chapters.en: It was given power to wage war against God’s holy people and to conquer them. And it was given authority over every tribe, people, language and nation.
chapters.zh: 又任凭它与圣徒争战，并且得胜。也把权柄赐给它，制伏各族各民各方各国。

chapters.en: All inhabitants of the earth will worship the beast—all whose names have not been written in the Lamb’s book of life, the Lamb who was slain from the creation of the world.
chapters.zh: 凡住在地上，名字从创世以来，没有记在被杀之羔羊生命册上的人，都要拜它。

chapters.en: Whoever has ears, let them hear.
chapters.zh: 凡有耳的，就应当听。

chapters.en: “If anyone is to go into captivity, into captivity they will go. If anyone is to be killed with the sword, with the sword they will be killed.”This calls for patient endurance and faithfulness on the part of God’s people.
chapters.zh: 掳掠人的必被掳掠。用刀杀人的，必被刀杀。圣徒的忍耐和信心，就是在此。

chapters.en: Then I saw a second beast, coming out of the earth. It had two horns like a lamb, but it spoke like a dragon.
chapters.zh: 我又看见另有一个兽从地中上来。有两角如同羊羔，说话好像龙。

chapters.en: It exercised all the authority of the first beast on its behalf, and made the earth and its inhabitants worship the first beast, whose fatal wound had been healed.
chapters.zh: 它在头一个兽面前，施行头一个兽所有的权柄。并且叫地和住在地上的人，拜那死伤医好的头一个兽。

chapters.en: And it performed great signs, even causing fire to come down from heaven to the earth in full view of the people.
chapters.zh: 又行大奇事，甚至在人面前，叫火从天降在地上。

chapters.en: Because of the signs it was given power to perform on behalf of the first beast, it deceived the inhabitants of the earth. It ordered them to set up an image in honor of the beast who was wounded by the sword and yet lived.
chapters.zh: 它因赐给它权柄在兽面前能行奇事，就迷惑住在地上的人，说，要给那受刀伤还活着的兽作个像。

chapters.en: The second beast was given power to give breath to the image of the first beast, so that the image could speak and cause all who refused to worship the image to be killed.
chapters.zh: 又有权柄赐给它叫兽像有生气。并且能说话，又叫所有不拜兽像的人都被杀害。

chapters.en: It also forced all people, great and small, rich and poor, free and slave, to receive a mark on their right hands or on their foreheads,
chapters.zh: 它又叫众人，无论大小贫富，自主的，为奴的，都在右手上，或是在额上，受一个印记。

chapters.en: so that they could not buy or sell unless they had the mark, which is the name of the beast or the number of its name.
chapters.zh: 除了那受印记，有了兽名，或有兽名数目的，都不得作买卖。

chapters.en: This calls for wisdom. Let the person who has insight calculate the number of the beast, for it is the number of a man. That number is 666.
chapters.zh: 在这里有智慧。凡有聪明的，可以算计兽的数目，因为这是人的数目。它的数目是六百六十六。

chapters.en: Then I looked, and there before me was the Lamb, standing on Mount Zion, and with him 144,000 who had his name and his Father’s name written on their foreheads.
chapters.zh: 我又观看，见羔羊站在锡安山，同他又有十四万四千人，都有他的名，和他父的名，写在额上。

chapters.en: And I heard a sound from heaven like the roar of rushing waters and like a loud peal of thunder. The sound I heard was like that of harpists playing their harps.
chapters.zh: 我听见从天上有声音，像众水的声音，和大雷的声音。并且我所听见的好像弹琴的所弹的琴声。

chapters.en: And they sang a new song before the throne and before the four living creatures and the elders. No one could learn the song except the 144,000 who had been redeemed from the earth.
chapters.zh: 他们在宝座前，并在四活物和众长老前唱歌，仿佛是新歌。除了从地上买来的那十四万四千人以外，没有人能学这歌。

chapters.en: These are those who did not defile themselves with women, for they remained virgins. They follow the Lamb wherever he goes. They were purchased from among mankind and offered as firstfruits to God and the Lamb.
chapters.zh: 这些人未曾沾染妇女，他们原是童身。羔羊无论往哪里去，他们都跟随他。他们是从人间买来的，作初熟的果子归与神和羔羊。

chapters.en: No lie was found in their mouths; they are blameless.
chapters.zh: 在他们口中察不出谎言来。他们是没有瑕疵的。

chapters.en: Then I saw another angel flying in midair, and he had the eternal gospel to proclaim to those who live on the earth—to every nation, tribe, language and people.
chapters.zh: 我又看见另有一位天使飞在空中，有永远的福音要传给住在地上的人，就是各国各族各方各民。

chapters.en: He said in a loud voice, “Fear God and give him glory, because the hour of his judgment has come. Worship him who made the heavens, the earth, the sea and the springs of water.”
chapters.zh: 他大声说，应当敬畏神，将荣耀归给他。因他施行审判的时候已经到了。应当敬拜那创造天地海和众水泉源的。

chapters.en: A second angel followed and said, “ ‘Fallen! Fallen is Babylon the Great,’ which made all the nations drink the maddening wine of her adulteries.”
chapters.zh: 又有第二位天使，接着说，叫万民喝邪淫大怒之酒的巴比伦大城倾倒了，倾倒了。

chapters.en: A third angel followed them and said in a loud voice: “If anyone worships the beast and its image and receives its mark on their forehead or on their hand,
chapters.zh: 又有第三位天使，接着他们，大声说，若有人拜兽和兽像，在额上，或在手上，受了印记，

chapters.en: they, too, will drink the wine of God’s fury, which has been poured full strength into the cup of his wrath. They will be tormented with burning sulfur in the presence of the holy angels and of the Lamb.
chapters.zh: 这人也必喝神大怒的酒，此酒斟在神忿怒的杯中纯一不杂。他要在圣天使和羔羊面前，在火与硫磺之中受痛苦。

chapters.en: And the smoke of their torment will rise for ever and ever. There will be no rest day or night for those who worship the beast and its image, or for anyone who receives the mark of its name.”
chapters.zh: 他受痛苦的烟往上冒，直到永永远远。那些拜兽和兽像受他名之印记的，昼夜不得安宁。

chapters.en: This calls for patient endurance on the part of the people of God who keep his commands and remain faithful to Jesus.
chapters.zh: 圣徒的忍耐就在此。他们是守神诫命，和耶稣真道的。

chapters.en: Then I heard a voice from heaven say, “Write this: Blessed are the dead who die in the Lord from now on.” “Yes,” says the Spirit, “they will rest from their labor, for their deeds will follow them.”
chapters.zh: 我听见从天上有声音说，你要写下，从今以后，在主里面而死的人有福了。圣灵说，是的，他们息了自己的劳苦，作工的果效也随着他们。

chapters.en: I looked, and there before me was a white cloud, and seated on the cloud was one like a son of man with a crown of gold on his head and a sharp sickle in his hand.
chapters.zh: 我又观看，见有一片白云，云上坐着一位好像人子，头上戴着金冠冕，手里拿着快镰刀。

chapters.en: Then another angel came out of the temple and called in a loud voice to him who was sitting on the cloud, “Take your sickle and reap, because the time to reap has come, for the harvest of the earth is ripe.”
chapters.zh: 又有一位天使从殿中出来，向那坐在云上的大声喊着说，伸出你的镰刀来收割。因为收割的时候已经到了，地上的庄稼已经熟透了。

chapters.en: So he who was seated on the cloud swung his sickle over the earth, and the earth was harvested.
chapters.zh: 那坐在云上的，就把镰刀扔在地上。地上的庄稼就被收割了。

chapters.en: Another angel came out of the temple in heaven, and he too had a sharp sickle.
chapters.zh: 又有一位天使从天上的殿中出来，他也拿着快镰刀。

chapters.en: Still another angel, who had charge of the fire, came from the altar and called in a loud voice to him who had the sharp sickle, “Take your sharp sickle and gather the clusters of grapes from the earth’s vine, because its grapes are ripe.”
chapters.zh: 又有一位天使从祭坛中出来，是有权柄管火的，向拿着快镰刀的大声喊着说，伸出快镰刀来收取地上葡萄树的果子。因为葡萄熟透了。

chapters.en: The angel swung his sickle on the earth, gathered its grapes and threw them into the great winepress of God’s wrath.
chapters.zh: 那天使就把镰刀扔在地上，收取了地上的葡萄，丢在神忿怒的大酒榨中。

chapters.en: They were trampled in the winepress outside the city, and blood flowed out of the press, rising as high as the horses’ bridles for a distance of 1,600 stadia.
chapters.zh: 那酒榨踹在城外，就有血从酒榨里流出来，高到马的嚼环，远有六百里。

chapters.en: I saw in heaven another great and marvelous sign: seven angels with the seven last plagues—last, because with them God’s wrath is completed.
chapters.zh: 我又看见在天上有异象，大而且奇，就是七位天使掌管末了的七灾。因为神的大怒在这七灾中发尽了。

chapters.en: And I saw what looked like a sea of glass glowing with fire and, standing beside the sea, those who had been victorious over the beast and its image and over the number of its name. They held harps given them by God
chapters.zh: 我看见仿佛有玻璃海，其中有火搀杂。又看见那些胜了兽和兽的像，并它名字数目的人，都站在玻璃海上，拿着神的琴。

chapters.en: and sang the song of God’s servant Moses and of the Lamb: “Great and marvelous are your deeds, Lord God Almighty. Just and true are your ways, King of the nations.
chapters.zh: 唱神仆人摩西的歌，和羔羊的歌，说，主神，全能者阿，你的作为大哉，奇哉。万世之王阿，（世或作国）你的道途义哉，诚哉。

chapters.en: Who will not fear you, Lord, and bring glory to your name? For you alone are holy. All nations will come and worship before you, for your righteous acts have been revealed.”
chapters.zh: 主阿，谁敢不敬畏你，不将荣耀归与你的名呢？因为独有你是圣的。万民都要来在你面前敬拜。因你公义的作为已经显出来了。

chapters.en: After this I looked, and I saw in heaven the temple—that is, the tabernacle of the covenant law—and it was opened.
chapters.zh: 此后，我看见在天上那存法柜的殿开了。

chapters.en: Out of the temple came the seven angels with the seven plagues. They were dressed in clean, shining linen and wore golden sashes around their chests.
chapters.zh: 那掌管七灾的七位天使，从殿中出来，穿着洁白光明的细麻衣，（细麻衣有古卷作宝石）胸间束着金带。

chapters.en: Then one of the four living creatures gave to the seven angels seven golden bowls filled with the wrath of God, who lives for ever and ever.
chapters.zh: 四活物中有一个把盛满了活到永永远远之神大怒的七个金碗给了那七位天使。

chapters.en: And the temple was filled with smoke from the glory of God and from his power, and no one could enter the temple until the seven plagues of the seven angels were completed.
chapters.zh: 因神的荣耀，和能力，殿中充满了烟。于是没有人能以进殿，直等到那七位天使所降的七灾完毕了。

chapters.en: Then I heard a loud voice from the temple saying to the seven angels, “Go, pour out the seven bowls of God’s wrath on the earth.”
chapters.zh: 我听见有大声音从殿中出来，向那七位天使说，你们去，把盛神大怒的七碗倒在地上。

chapters.en: The first angel went and poured out his bowl on the land, and ugly, festering sores broke out on the people who had the mark of the beast and worshiped its image.
chapters.zh: 第一位天使便去，把碗倒在地上，就有恶而且毒的疮，生在那些有兽印记，拜兽像的人身上。

chapters.en: The second angel poured out his bowl on the sea, and it turned into blood like that of a dead person, and every living thing in the sea died.
chapters.zh: 第二位天使把碗倒在海里，海就变成血，好像死人的血，海中的活物都死了。

chapters.en: The third angel poured out his bowl on the rivers and springs of water, and they became blood.
chapters.zh: 第三位天使把碗倒在江河与众水的泉源里，水就变成血了。

chapters.en: Then I heard the angel in charge of the waters say: “You are just in these judgments, O Holy One, you who are and who were;
chapters.zh: 我听见掌管众水的天使说，昔在今在的圣者阿，你这样判断是公义的。

chapters.en: for they have shed the blood of your holy people and your prophets, and you have given them blood to drink as they deserve.”
chapters.zh: 他们曾流圣徒与先知的血，现在你给他们血喝。这是他们所该受的。

chapters.en: And I heard the altar respond: “Yes, Lord God Almighty, true and just are your judgments.”
chapters.zh: 我又听见祭坛中有声音说，是的，主神，全能者阿，你的判断义哉，诚哉。

chapters.en: The fourth angel poured out his bowl on the sun, and the sun was allowed to scorch people with fire.
chapters.zh: 第四位天使把碗倒在日头上，叫日头能用火烤人。

chapters.en: They were seared by the intense heat and they cursed the name of God, who had control over these plagues, but they refused to repent and glorify him.
chapters.zh: 人被大热所烤，就亵渎那有权掌管这些灾的神之名，并不悔改将荣耀归给神。

chapters.en: The fifth angel poured out his bowl on the throne of the beast, and its kingdom was plunged into darkness. People gnawed their tongues in agony
chapters.zh: 第五位天使把碗倒在兽的座位上，兽的国就黑暗了。人因疼痛就咬自己的舌头。

chapters.en: and cursed the God of heaven because of their pains and their sores, but they refused to repent of what they had done.
chapters.zh: 又因所受的疼痛，和生的疮，就亵渎天上的神。并不悔改所行的。

chapters.en: The sixth angel poured out his bowl on the great river Euphrates, and its water was dried up to prepare the way for the kings from the East.
chapters.zh: 第六位天使把碗倒在伯拉大河上，河水就干了，要给那从日出之地所来的众王预备道路。

chapters.en: Then I saw three impure spirits that looked like frogs; they came out of the mouth of the dragon, out of the mouth of the beast and out of the mouth of the false prophet.
chapters.zh: 我又看见三个污秽的灵，好像青蛙，从龙口兽口并假先知的口中出来。

chapters.en: They are demonic spirits that perform signs, and they go out to the kings of the whole world, to gather them for the battle on the great day of God Almighty.
chapters.zh: 他们本是鬼魔的灵，施行奇事，出去到普天下众王那里，叫他们在神全能者的大日聚集争战。

chapters.en: “Look, I come like a thief! Blessed is the one who stays awake and remains clothed, so as not to go naked and be shamefully exposed.”
chapters.zh: （看哪，我来像贼一样。那儆醒，看守衣服，免得赤身而行，叫人见他羞耻的，有福了

chapters.en: Then they gathered the kings together to the place that in Hebrew is called Armageddon.
chapters.zh: 那三个鬼魔便叫众王聚集在一处，希伯来话叫作哈米吉多顿。

chapters.en: The seventh angel poured out his bowl into the air, and out of the temple came a loud voice from the throne, saying, “It is done!”
chapters.zh: 第七位天使把碗倒在空中，就有大声音从殿中的宝座上出来，说，成了。

chapters.en: Then there came flashes of lightning, rumblings, peals of thunder and a severe earthquake. No earthquake like it has ever occurred since mankind has been on earth, so tremendous was the quake.
chapters.zh: 又有闪电，声音，雷轰，大地震，自从地上有人以来，没有这样大这样利害的地震。

chapters.en: The great city split into three parts, and the cities of the nations collapsed. God remembered Babylon the Great and gave her the cup filled with the wine of the fury of his wrath.
chapters.zh: 那大城裂为三段，列国的城也都倒塌了。神也想起巴比伦大城来，要把那盛自己烈怒的酒杯递给他。

chapters.en: Every island fled away and the mountains could not be found.
chapters.zh: 各海岛都逃避了，众山也不见了。

chapters.en: From the sky huge hailstones, each weighing about a hundred pounds, fell on people. And they cursed God on account of the plague of hail, because the plague was so terrible.
chapters.zh: 又有大雹子从天落在人身上，每一个约重一他连得。（一他连得约有九十斤）为这雹子的灾极大，人就亵渎神。

chapters.en: One of the seven angels who had the seven bowls came and said to me, “Come, I will show you the punishment of the great prostitute, who sits by many waters.
chapters.zh: 拿着七碗的七位天使中，有一位前来对我说，你到这里来，我将坐在众水上的大淫妇所要受的刑罚指给你看。

chapters.en: With her the kings of the earth committed adultery, and the inhabitants of the earth were intoxicated with the wine of her adulteries.”
chapters.zh: 地上的君王与她行淫。住在地上的人喝醉了她淫乱的酒。

chapters.en: Then the angel carried me away in the Spirit into a wilderness. There I saw a woman sitting on a scarlet beast that was covered with blasphemous names and had seven heads and ten horns.
chapters.zh: 我被圣灵感动，天使带我到旷野去。我就看见一个女人骑在朱红色的兽上。那兽有七头十角，遍体有亵渎的名号。

chapters.en: The woman was dressed in purple and scarlet, and was glittering with gold, precious stones and pearls. She held a golden cup in her hand, filled with abominable things and the filth of her adulteries.
chapters.zh: 那女人穿着紫色和朱红色的衣服，用金子宝石珍珠为妆饰。手拿金杯，杯中盛满了可憎之物，就是她淫乱的污秽。

chapters.en: The name written on her forehead was a mystery: BABYLON THE GREAT THE MOTHER OF PROSTITUTES AND OF THE ABOMINATIONS OF THE EARTH.
chapters.zh: 在她额上有名写着说，奥秘哉，大巴比伦，作世上的淫妇和一切可憎之物的母。

chapters.en: I saw that the woman was drunk with the blood of God’s holy people, the blood of those who bore testimony to Jesus. When I saw her, I was greatly astonished.
chapters.zh: 我又看见那女人喝醉了圣徒的血，和为耶稣作见证之人的血。我看见她，就大大地希奇。

chapters.en: Then the angel said to me: “Why are you astonished? I will explain to you the mystery of the woman and of the beast she rides, which has the seven heads and ten horns.
chapters.zh: 天使对我说，你为什么希奇呢？我要将这女人和驮着她的那七头十角兽的奥秘告诉你。

chapters.en: The beast, which you saw, once was, now is not, and yet will come up out of the Abyss and go to its destruction. The inhabitants of the earth whose names have not been written in the book of life from the creation of the world will be astonished when they see the beast, because it once was, now is not, and yet will come.
chapters.zh: 你所看见的兽，先前有，如今没有。将要从无底坑里上来，又要归于沉沦。凡住在地上名字从创世以来没有记在生命册上的，见先前有，如今没有，以后再有的兽，就必希奇。

chapters.en: “This calls for a mind with wisdom. The seven heads are seven hills on which the woman sits.
chapters.zh: 智慧的心在此可以思想。那七头就是女人所坐的七座山。

chapters.en: They are also seven kings. Five have fallen, one is, the other has not yet come; but when he does come, he must remain for only a little while.
chapters.zh: 又是七位王。五位已经倾倒了，一位还在，一位还没有来到。他来的时候，必须暂时存留。

chapters.en: The beast who once was, and now is not, is an eighth king. He belongs to the seven and is going to his destruction.
chapters.zh: 那先前有，如今没有的兽，就是第八位。他也和那七位同列，并且归于沉沦。

chapters.en: “The ten horns you saw are ten kings who have not yet received a kingdom, but who for one hour will receive authority as kings along with the beast.
chapters.zh: 你所看见的那十角，就是十王。他们还没有得国。但他们一时之间，要和兽同得权柄与王一样。

chapters.en: They have one purpose and will give their power and authority to the beast.
chapters.zh: 他们同心合意，将自己的能力权柄给那兽。

chapters.en: They will wage war against the Lamb, but the Lamb will triumph over them because he is Lord of lords and King of kings—and with him will be his called, chosen and faithful followers.”
chapters.zh: 他们与羔羊争战，羔羊必胜过他们，因为羔羊是万主之主，万王之王。同着羔羊的，就是蒙召被选有忠心的，也必得胜。

chapters.en: Then the angel said to me, “The waters you saw, where the prostitute sits, are peoples, multitudes, nations and languages.
chapters.zh: 天使又对我说，你所看见那淫妇坐的众水，就是多民多人多国多方。

chapters.en: The beast and the ten horns you saw will hate the prostitute. They will bring her to ruin and leave her naked; they will eat her flesh and burn her with fire.
chapters.zh: 你所看见的那十角，与兽，必恨这淫妇，使她冷落赤身。又要吃她的肉，用火将她烧尽。

chapters.en: For God has put it into their hearts to accomplish his purpose by agreeing to hand over to the beast their royal authority, until God’s words are fulfilled.
chapters.zh: 因为神使诸王同心合意，遵行他的旨意，把自己的国给那兽，直等到神的话都应验了。

chapters.en: The woman you saw is the great city that rules over the kings of the earth.”
chapters.zh: 你所看见的那女人，就是管辖地上众王的大城。

chapters.en: After this I saw another angel coming down from heaven. He had great authority, and the earth was illuminated by his splendor.
chapters.zh: 此后，我看见另有一位有大权柄的天使从天降下。地就因他的荣耀发光。

chapters.en: With a mighty voice he shouted: “ ‘Fallen! Fallen is Babylon the Great!’She has become a dwelling for demons and a haunt for every impure spirit, a haunt for every unclean bird, a haunt for every unclean and detestable animal.
chapters.zh: 他大声喊着说，巴比伦大城倾倒了，倾倒了，成了鬼魔的住处，和各样污秽之灵的巢穴（或作牢狱下同），并各样污秽可憎之雀鸟的巢穴。

chapters.en: For all the nations have drunk the maddening wine of her adulteries. The kings of the earth committed adultery with her, and the merchants of the earth grew rich from her excessive luxuries.”
chapters.zh: 因为列国都被她邪淫大怒的酒倾倒了。地上的君王与她行淫，地上的客商，因她奢华太过就发了财。

chapters.en: Then I heard another voice from heaven say: “ ‘Come out of her, my people,’so that you will not share in her sins, so that you will not receive any of her plagues;
chapters.zh: 我又听见从天上有声音说，我的民哪，你们要从那城出来，免得与她一同有罪，受她所受的灾殃。

chapters.en: for her sins are piled up to heaven, and God has remembered her crimes.
chapters.zh: 因她的罪恶滔天，她的不义神已经想起来了。

chapters.en: Give back to her as she has given; pay her back double for what she has done. Pour her a double portion from her own cup.
chapters.zh: 她怎样待人，也要怎样待她，按她所行的加倍地报应她。用她调酒的杯，加倍地调给她喝。

chapters.en: Give her as much torment and grief as the glory and luxury she gave herself. In her heart she boasts, ‘I sit enthroned as queen. I am not a widow;I will never mourn.’
chapters.zh: 她怎样荣耀自己，怎样奢华，也当叫她照样痛苦悲哀。因她心里说，我坐了皇后的位，并不是寡妇，决不至于悲哀。

chapters.en: Therefore in one day her plagues will overtake her: death, mourning and famine. She will be consumed by fire, for mighty is the Lord God who judges her.
chapters.zh: 所以在一天之内，她的灾殃要一齐来到，就是死亡，悲哀，饥荒，她又要被火烧尽了。因为审判她的主神大有能力。

chapters.en: “When the kings of the earth who committed adultery with her and shared her luxury see the smoke of her burning, they will weep and mourn over her.
chapters.zh: 地上的君王，素来与她行淫一同奢华的，看见烧她的烟，就必为她哭泣哀号。

chapters.en: Terrified at her torment, they will stand far off and cry: “ ‘Woe! Woe to you, great city, you mighty city of Babylon! In one hour your doom has come!’
chapters.zh: 因怕她的痛苦，就远远地站着说，哀哉，哀哉，巴比伦大城，坚固的城阿，一时之间你的刑罚就来到了。

chapters.en: “The merchants of the earth will weep and mourn over her because no one buys their cargoes anymore—
chapters.zh: 地上的客商也都为她哭泣悲哀，因为没有人再买他们的货物了。

chapters.en: cargoes of gold, silver, precious stones and pearls; fine linen, purple, silk and scarlet cloth; every sort of citron wood, and articles of every kind made of ivory, costly wood, bronze, iron and marble;
chapters.zh: 这货物就是金，银，宝石，珍珠，细麻布，紫色料，绸子，朱红色料，各样香木，各样象牙的器皿，各样极宝贵的木头和铜，铁，汉白玉的器皿，

chapters.en: cargoes of cinnamon and spice, of incense, myrrh and frankincense, of wine and olive oil, of fine flour and wheat; cattle and sheep; horses and carriages; and human beings sold as slaves.
chapters.zh: 并肉桂，豆蔻，香料，香膏，乳香，酒，油，细面，麦子，牛，羊，车，马，和奴仆，人口。

chapters.en: “They will say, ‘The fruit you longed for is gone from you. All your luxury and splendor have vanished, never to be recovered.’
chapters.zh: 巴比伦哪，你所贪爱的果子离开了你。你一切的珍馐美味，和华美的物件，也从你中间毁灭，决不能再见了。

chapters.en: The merchants who sold these things and gained their wealth from her will stand far off, terrified at her torment. They will weep and mourn
chapters.zh: 贩卖这些货物，借着她发了财的客商，因怕她的痛苦，就远远地站着哭泣悲哀，说，

chapters.en: and cry out: “ ‘Woe! Woe to you, great city, dressed in fine linen, purple and scarlet, and glittering with gold, precious stones and pearls!
chapters.zh: 哀哉，哀哉，这大城阿，素常穿着细麻，紫色，朱红色的衣服，又用金子，宝石，和珍珠为妆饰。

chapters.en: In one hour such great wealth has been brought to ruin!’ “Every sea captain, and all who travel by ship, the sailors, and all who earn their living from the sea, will stand far off.
chapters.zh: 一时之间，这么大的富厚就归于无有了。凡船主，和坐船往各处去的，并众水手，连所有靠海为业的，都远远地站着，

chapters.en: When they see the smoke of her burning, they will exclaim, ‘Was there ever a city like this great city?’
chapters.zh: 看见烧她的烟，就喊着说，有何城能比这大城呢？

chapters.en: They will throw dust on their heads, and with weeping and mourning cry out: “ ‘Woe! Woe to you, great city, where all who had ships on the sea became rich through her wealth! In one hour she has been brought to ruin!’
chapters.zh: 他们又把尘土撒在头上，哭泣悲哀，喊着说，哀哉，哀哉，这大城阿。凡有船在海中的，都因她的珍宝成了富足。她在一时之间就成了荒场。

chapters.en: “Rejoice over her, you heavens! Rejoice, you people of God! Rejoice, apostles and prophets! For God has judged her with the judgment she imposed on you.”
chapters.zh: 天哪，众圣徒众使徒众先知阿，你们都要因她欢喜。因为神已经在她身上伸了你们的冤。

chapters.en: Then a mighty angel picked up a boulder the size of a large millstone and threw it into the sea, and said: “With such violence the great city of Babylon will be thrown down, never to be found again.
chapters.zh: 有一位大力的天使举起一块石头，好像大磨石，扔在海里，说，巴比伦大城，也必这样猛力的被扔下去，决不能再见了。

chapters.en: The music of harpists and musicians, pipers and trumpeters, will never be heard in you again. No worker of any trade will ever be found in you again. The sound of a millstone will never be heard in you again.
chapters.zh: 弹琴，作乐，吹笛，吹号的声音，在你中间决不能再听见。各行手艺人在你中间决不能再遇见。推磨的声音在你中间决不能再听见。

chapters.en: The light of a lamp will never shine in you again. The voice of bridegroom and bride will never be heard in you again. Your merchants were the world’s important people. By your magic spell all the nations were led astray.
chapters.zh: 灯光在你中间决不能再照耀。新郎和新妇的声音，在你中间决不能再听见。你的客商原来是地上的尊贵人。万国也被你的邪术迷惑了。

chapters.en: In her was found the blood of prophets and of God’s holy people, of all who have been slaughtered on the earth.”
chapters.zh: 先知和圣徒，并地上一切被杀之人的血，都在这城里看见了。

chapters.en: After this I heard what sounded like the roar of a great multitude in heaven shouting: “Hallelujah! Salvation and glory and power belong to our God,
chapters.zh: 此后，我听见好像群众在天上大声说，哈利路亚（就是要赞美耶和华的意思），救恩，荣耀，权能，都属乎我们的神。

chapters.en: for true and just are his judgments. He has condemned the great prostitute who corrupted the earth by her adulteries. He has avenged on her the blood of his servants.”
chapters.zh: 他的判断是真实公义的。因他判断了那用淫行败坏世界的大淫妇，并且向淫妇讨流仆人血的罪，给他们伸冤。

chapters.en: And again they shouted: “Hallelujah! The smoke from her goes up for ever and ever.”
chapters.zh: 又说，哈利路亚。烧淫妇的烟往上冒，直到永永远远。

chapters.en: The twenty-four elders and the four living creatures fell down and worshiped God, who was seated on the throne. And they cried: “Amen, Hallelujah!”
chapters.zh: 那二十四位长老与四活物，就俯伏敬拜坐宝座的神，说，阿们，哈利路亚。

chapters.en: Then a voice came from the throne, saying: “Praise our God, all you his servants, you who fear him, both great and small!”
chapters.zh: 有声音从宝座出来说，神的众仆人哪，凡敬畏他的，无论大小，都要赞美我们的神。

chapters.en: Then I heard what sounded like a great multitude, like the roar of rushing waters and like loud peals of thunder, shouting: “Hallelujah! For our Lord God Almighty reigns.
chapters.zh: 我听见好像群众的声音，众水的声音，大雷的声音，说，哈利路亚。因为主我们的神，全能者，作王了。

chapters.en: Let us rejoice and be glad and give him glory! For the wedding of the Lamb has come, and his bride has made herself ready.
chapters.zh: 我们要欢喜快乐，将荣耀归给他。因为羔羊婚娶的时候到了，新妇也自己预备好了。

chapters.en: Fine linen, bright and clean, was given her to wear.” (Fine linen stands for the righteous acts of God’s holy people.)
chapters.zh: 就蒙恩得穿光明洁白的细麻衣，这细麻衣就是圣徒所行的义。

chapters.en: Then the angel said to me, “Write this: Blessed are those who are invited to the wedding supper of the Lamb!” And he added, “These are the true words of God.”
chapters.zh: 天使吩咐我说，你要写上，凡被请赴羔羊之婚筵的有福了。又对我说，这是神真实的话。

chapters.en: At this I fell at his feet to worship him. But he said to me, “Don’t do that! I am a fellow servant with you and with your brothers and sisters who hold to the testimony of Jesus. Worship God! For it is the Spirit of prophecy who bears testimony to Jesus.”
chapters.zh: 我就俯伏在他脚前要拜他。他说，千万不可。我和你并你那些为耶稣作见证的弟兄同是作仆人的。你要敬拜神。因为预言中的灵意，乃是为耶稣作见证。

chapters.en: I saw heaven standing open and there before me was a white horse, whose rider is called Faithful and True. With justice he judges and wages war.
chapters.zh: 我观看，见天开了。有一匹白马。骑在马上的，称为诚信真实。他审判争战都按着公义。

chapters.en: His eyes are like blazing fire, and on his head are many crowns. He has a name written on him that no one knows but he himself.
chapters.zh: 他的眼睛如火焰，他头上戴着许多冠冕。又有写着的名字，除了他自己没有人知道。

chapters.en: He is dressed in a robe dipped in blood, and his name is the Word of God.
chapters.zh: 他穿着溅了血的衣服。他的名称为神之道。

chapters.en: The armies of heaven were following him, riding on white horses and dressed in fine linen, white and clean.
chapters.zh: 在天上的众军，骑着白马，穿着细麻衣，又白又洁，跟随他。

chapters.en: Coming out of his mouth is a sharp sword with which to strike down the nations. “He will rule them with an iron scepter.” He treads the winepress of the fury of the wrath of God Almighty.
chapters.zh: 有利剑从他口中出来，可以击杀列国。他必用铁杖辖管他们。（辖管原文作牧）并要踹全能神烈怒的酒榨。

chapters.en: On his robe and on his thigh he has this name written: KING OF KINGS AND LORD OF LORDS.
chapters.zh: 在他衣服和大腿上，有名写着说，万王之王，万主之主。

chapters.en: And I saw an angel standing in the sun, who cried in a loud voice to all the birds flying in midair, “Come, gather together for the great supper of God,
chapters.zh: 我又看见一位天使站在日头中，向天空所飞的鸟，大声喊着说，你们聚集来赴神的大筵席。

chapters.en: so that you may eat the flesh of kings, generals, and the mighty, of horses and their riders, and the flesh of all people, free and slave, great and small.”
chapters.zh: 可以吃君王与将军的肉，壮士与马和骑马者的肉，并一切自主的为奴的，以及大小人民的肉。

chapters.en: Then I saw the beast and the kings of the earth and their armies gathered together to wage war against the rider on the horse and his army.
chapters.zh: 我看见那兽，和地上的君王，并他们的众军，都聚集，要与骑白马的并他的军兵争战。

chapters.en: But the beast was captured, and with it the false prophet who had performed the signs on its behalf. With these signs he had deluded those who had received the mark of the beast and worshiped its image. The two of them were thrown alive into the fiery lake of burning sulfur.
chapters.zh: 那兽被擒拿，那在兽面前曾行奇事，迷惑受兽印记，和拜兽像之人的假先知，也与兽同被擒拿。他们两个就活活地被扔在烧着硫磺的火湖里。

chapters.en: The rest were killed with the sword coming out of the mouth of the rider on the horse, and all the birds gorged themselves on their flesh.
chapters.zh: 其余的被骑白马者口中出来的剑杀了。飞鸟都吃饱了他们的肉。

chapters.en: And I saw an angel coming down out of heaven, having the key to the Abyss and holding in his hand a great chain.
chapters.zh: 我又看见一位天使从天降下，手里拿着无底坑的钥匙，和一条大链子。

chapters.en: He seized the dragon, that ancient serpent, who is the devil, or Satan, and bound him for a thousand years.
chapters.zh: 他捉住那龙，就是古蛇，又叫魔鬼，也叫撒但，把它捆绑一千年，

chapters.en: He threw him into the Abyss, and locked and sealed it over him, to keep him from deceiving the nations anymore until the thousand years were ended. After that, he must be set free for a short time.
chapters.zh: 扔在无底坑里，将无底坑关闭，用印封上，使它不得再迷惑列国，等到那一千年完了。以后必须暂时释放它。

chapters.en: I saw thrones on which were seated those who had been given authority to judge. And I saw the souls of those who had been beheaded because of their testimony about Jesus and because of the word of God. They had not worshiped the beast or its image and had not received its mark on their foreheads or their hands. They came to life and reigned with Christ a thousand years.
chapters.zh: 我又看见几个宝座，也有坐在上面的，并有审判的权柄赐给他们。我又看见那些因为给耶稣作见证，并为神之道被斩者的灵魂，和那没有拜过兽与兽像，也没有在额上和手上受过它印记之人的灵魂，他们都复活了，与基督一同作王一千年。

chapters.en: (The rest of the dead did not come to life until the thousand years were ended.) This is the first resurrection.
chapters.zh: 这是头一次的复活。其余的死人还没有复活，直等那一千年完了。

chapters.en: Blessed and holy are those who share in the first resurrection. The second death has no power over them, but they will be priests of God and of Christ and will reign with him for a thousand years.
chapters.zh: 在头一次复活有分的，有福了，圣洁了。第二次的死在他们身上没有权柄。他们必作神和基督的祭司，并要与基督一同作王一千年。

chapters.en: When the thousand years are over, Satan will be released from his prison
chapters.zh: 那一千年完了，撒但必从监牢里被释放，

chapters.en: and will go out to deceive the nations in the four corners of the earth—Gog and Magog—and to gather them for battle. In number they are like the sand on the seashore.
chapters.zh: 出来要迷惑地上四方的列国，（方原文作角）就是歌革和玛各，叫他们聚集争战。他们的人数多如海沙。

chapters.en: They marched across the breadth of the earth and surrounded the camp of God’s people, the city he loves. But fire came down from heaven and devoured them.
chapters.zh: 他们上来遍满了全地，围住圣徒的营，与蒙爱的城。就有火从天降下，烧灭了他们。

chapters.en: And the devil, who deceived them, was thrown into the lake of burning sulfur, where the beast and the false prophet had been thrown. They will be tormented day and night for ever and ever.
chapters.zh: 那迷惑他们的魔鬼，被扔在硫磺的火湖里，就是兽和假先知所在的地方。他们必昼夜受痛苦，直到永永远远。

chapters.en: Then I saw a great white throne and him who was seated on it. The earth and the heavens fled from his presence, and there was no place for them.
chapters.zh: 我又看见一个白色的大宝座，与坐在上面的。从他面前天地都逃避，再无可见之处了。

chapters.en: And I saw the dead, great and small, standing before the throne, and books were opened. Another book was opened, which is the book of life. The dead were judged according to what they had done as recorded in the books.
chapters.zh: 我又看见死了的人，无论大小，都站在宝座前。案卷展开了。并且另有一卷展开，就是生命册。死了的人都凭着这些案卷所记载的，照他们所行的受审判。

chapters.en: The sea gave up the dead that were in it, and death and Hades gave up the dead that were in them, and each person was judged according to what they had done.
chapters.zh: 于是海交出其中的死人。死亡和阴间也交出其中的死人。他们都照各人所行的受审判。

chapters.en: Then death and Hades were thrown into the lake of fire. The lake of fire is the second death.
chapters.zh: 死亡和阴间也被扔在火湖里。这火湖就是第二次的死。

chapters.en: Anyone whose name was not found written in the book of life was thrown into the lake of fire.
chapters.zh: 若有人名字没记在生命册上，他就被扔在火湖里。

chapters.en: Then I saw “a new heaven and a new earth,” for the first heaven and the first earth had passed away, and there was no longer any sea.
chapters.zh: 我又看见一个新天新地。因为先前的天地已经过去了。海也不再有了。

chapters.en: I saw the Holy City, the new Jerusalem, coming down out of heaven from God, prepared as a bride beautifully dressed for her husband.
chapters.zh: 我又看见圣城新耶路撒冷由神那里从天而降，预备好了，就如新妇妆饰整齐，等候丈夫。

chapters.en: And I heard a loud voice from the throne saying, “Look! God’s dwelling place is now among the people, and he will dwell with them. They will be his people, and God himself will be with them and be their God.
chapters.zh: 我听见有大声音从宝座出来说，看哪，神的帐幕在人间。他要与人同住，他们要作他的子民，神要亲自与他们同在，作他们的神。

chapters.en: ‘He will wipe every tear from their eyes. There will be no more death’ or mourning or crying or pain, for the old order of things has passed away.”
chapters.zh: 神要擦去他们一切的眼泪。不再有死亡，也不再有悲哀，哭号，疼痛，因为以前的事都过去了。

chapters.en: He who was seated on the throne said, “I am making everything new!” Then he said, “Write this down, for these words are trustworthy and true.”
chapters.zh: 坐宝座的说，看哪，我将一切都更新了。又说，你要写上。因这些话是可信的，是真实的。

chapters.en: He said to me: “It is done. I am the Alpha and the Omega, the Beginning and the End. To the thirsty I will give water without cost from the spring of the water of life.
chapters.zh: 他又对我说，都成了。我是阿拉法，我是俄梅戛，我是初，我是终。我要将生命泉的水白白赐给那口渴的人喝。

chapters.en: Those who are victorious will inherit all this, and I will be their God and they will be my children.
chapters.zh: 得胜的，必承受这些为业。我要作他的神，他要作我的儿子。

chapters.en: But the cowardly, the unbelieving, the vile, the murderers, the sexually immoral, those who practice magic arts, the idolaters and all liars—they will be consigned to the fiery lake of burning sulfur. This is the second death.”
chapters.zh: 惟有胆怯的，不信的，可憎的，杀人的，淫乱的，行邪术的，拜偶像的，和一切说谎话的，他们的分就在烧着硫磺的火湖里。这是第二次的死。

chapters.en: One of the seven angels who had the seven bowls full of the seven last plagues came and said to me, “Come, I will show you the bride, the wife of the Lamb.”
chapters.zh: 拿着七个金碗，盛满末后七灾的七位天使中，有一位来对我说，你到这里来，我要将新妇，就是羔羊的妻，指给你看。

chapters.en: And he carried me away in the Spirit to a mountain great and high, and showed me the Holy City, Jerusalem, coming down out of heaven from God.
chapters.zh: 我被圣灵感动，天使就带我到一座高大的山，将那由神那里从天而降的圣城耶路撒冷指示我。

chapters.en: It shone with the glory of God, and its brilliance was like that of a very precious jewel, like a jasper, clear as crystal.
chapters.zh: 城中有神的荣耀。城的光辉如同极贵的宝石，好像碧玉，明如水晶。

chapters.en: It had a great, high wall with twelve gates, and with twelve angels at the gates. On the gates were written the names of the twelve tribes of Israel.
chapters.zh: 有高大的墙。有十二个门，门上有十二位天使。门上又写着以色列十二个支派的名字。

chapters.en: There were three gates on the east, three on the north, three on the south and three on the west.
chapters.zh: 东边有三门。北边有三门。南边有三门。西边有三门。

chapters.en: The wall of the city had twelve foundations, and on them were the names of the twelve apostles of the Lamb.
chapters.zh: 城墙有十二根基，根基上有羔羊十二使徒的名字。

chapters.en: The angel who talked with me had a measuring rod of gold to measure the city, its gates and its walls.
chapters.zh: 对我说话的拿着金苇子当尺，要量那城，和城门城墙。

chapters.en: The city was laid out like a square, as long as it was wide. He measured the city with the rod and found it to be 12,000 stadia in length, and as wide and high as it is long.
chapters.zh: 城是四方的，长宽一样。天使用苇子量那城，共有四千里。长宽高都是一样。

chapters.en: The angel measured the wall using human measurement, and it was 144 cubits thick.
chapters.zh: 又量了城墙，按着人的尺寸，就是天使的尺寸，共有一百四十四肘。

chapters.en: The wall was made of jasper, and the city of pure gold, as pure as glass.
chapters.zh: 墙是碧玉造的。城是精金的，如同明净的玻璃。

chapters.en: The foundations of the city walls were decorated with every kind of precious stone. The first foundation was jasper, the second sapphire, the third agate, the fourth emerald,
chapters.zh: 城墙的根基是用各样宝石修饰的。第一根基是碧玉。第二是蓝宝石。第三是绿玛瑙。第四是绿宝石。

chapters.en: the fifth onyx, the sixth ruby, the seventh chrysolite, the eighth beryl, the ninth topaz, the tenth turquoise, the eleventh jacinth, and the twelfth amethyst.
chapters.zh: 第五是红玛瑙。第六是红宝石。第七是黄璧玺。第八是水苍玉。第九是红璧玺。第十是翡翠。第十一是紫玛瑙。第十二是紫晶。

chapters.en: The twelve gates were twelve pearls, each gate made of a single pearl. The great street of the city was of gold, as pure as transparent glass.
chapters.zh: 十二个门是十二颗珍珠。每门是一颗珍珠。城内的街道是精金，好像明透的玻璃。

chapters.en: I did not see a temple in the city, because the Lord God Almighty and the Lamb are its temple.
chapters.zh: 我未见城内有殿，因主神全能者，和羔羊，为城的殿。

chapters.en: The city does not need the sun or the moon to shine on it, for the glory of God gives it light, and the Lamb is its lamp.
chapters.zh: 那城内又不用日月光照。因有神的荣耀光照。又有羔羊为城的灯。

chapters.en: The nations will walk by its light, and the kings of the earth will bring their splendor into it.
chapters.zh: 列国要在城的光里行走。地上的君王必将自己的荣耀归与那城。

chapters.en: On no day will its gates ever be shut, for there will be no night there.
chapters.zh: 城门白昼总不关闭。在那里原没有黑夜。

chapters.en: The glory and honor of the nations will be brought into it.
chapters.zh: 人必将列国的荣耀尊贵归与那城。

chapters.en: Nothing impure will ever enter it, nor will anyone who does what is shameful or deceitful, but only those whose names are written in the Lamb’s book of life.
chapters.zh: 凡不洁净的，并那行可憎与虚谎之事的，总不得进那城。只有名字写在羔羊生命册上的才得进去。

chapters.en: Then the angel showed me the river of the water of life, as clear as crystal, flowing from the throne of God and of the Lamb
chapters.zh: 天使又指示我在城内街道当中一道生命水的河，明亮如水晶，从神和羔羊的宝座流出来。

chapters.en: down the middle of the great street of the city. On each side of the river stood the tree of life, bearing twelve crops of fruit, yielding its fruit every month. And the leaves of the tree are for the healing of the nations.
chapters.zh: 在河这边与那边有生命树，结十二样果子，（样或作回）每月都结果子。树上的叶子乃为医治万民。

chapters.en: No longer will there be any curse. The throne of God and of the Lamb will be in the city, and his servants will serve him.
chapters.zh: 以后再没有咒诅。在城里有神和羔羊的宝座。他的仆人都要事奉他。

chapters.en: They will see his face, and his name will be on their foreheads.
chapters.zh: 也要见他的面。他的名字必写在他们的额上。

chapters.en: There will be no more night. They will not need the light of a lamp or the light of the sun, for the Lord God will give them light. And they will reign for ever and ever.
chapters.zh: 不再有黑夜。他们也不用灯光日光。因为主神要光照他们。他们要作王，直到永永远远。

chapters.en: The angel said to me, “These words are trustworthy and true. The Lord, the God who inspires the prophets, sent his angel to show his servants the things that must soon take place.”
chapters.zh: 天使又对我说，这些话是真实可信的。主就是众先知被感之灵的神，差遣他的使者，将那必要快成的事指示他仆人。

chapters.en: “Look, I am coming soon! Blessed is the one who keeps the words of the prophecy written in this scroll.”
chapters.zh: 看哪，我必快来。凡遵守这书上预言的有福了。

chapters.en: I, John, am the one who heard and saw these things. And when I had heard and seen them, I fell down to worship at the feet of the angel who had been showing them to me.
chapters.zh: 这些事是我约翰所听见所看见的。我既听见看见了。就在指示我的天使脚前俯伏要拜他。

chapters.en: But he said to me, “Don’t do that! I am a fellow servant with you and with your fellow prophets and with all who keep the words of this scroll. Worship God!”
chapters.zh: 他对我说，千万不可。我与你，和你的弟兄众先知，并那些守这书上言语的人，同是作仆人的。你要敬拜神。

chapters.en: Then he told me, “Do not seal up the words of the prophecy of this scroll, because the time is near.
chapters.zh: 他又对我说，不可封了这书上的预言。因为日期近了。

chapters.en: Let the one who does wrong continue to do wrong; let the vile person continue to be vile; let the one who does right continue to do right; and let the holy person continue to be holy.”
chapters.zh: 不义的，叫他仍旧不义。污秽的，叫他仍旧污秽。为义的，叫他仍旧为义。圣洁的，叫他仍旧圣洁。

chapters.en: “Look, I am coming soon! My reward is with me, and I will give to each person according to what they have done.
chapters.zh: 看哪，我必快来。赏罚在我，要照各人所行的报应他。

chapters.en: I am the Alpha and the Omega, the First and the Last, the Beginning and the End.
chapters.zh: 我是阿拉法，我是俄梅戛，我是首先的，我是末后的，我是初，我是终。

chapters.en: “Blessed are those who wash their robes, that they may have the right to the tree of life and may go through the gates into the city.
chapters.zh: 那些洗净自己衣服的有福了，可得权柄能到生命树那里，也能从门进城。

chapters.en: Outside are the dogs, those who practice magic arts, the sexually immoral, the murderers, the idolaters and everyone who loves and practices falsehood.
chapters.zh: 城外有那些犬类，行邪术的，淫乱的，杀人的，拜偶像的，并一切喜好说谎言编造虚谎的。

chapters.en: “I, Jesus, have sent my angel to give you this testimony for the churches. I am the Root and the Offspring of David, and the bright Morning Star.”
chapters.zh: 我耶稣差遣我的使者为众教会将这些事向你们证明。我是大卫的根，又是他的后裔。我是明亮的晨星。

chapters.en: The Spirit and the bride say, “Come!” And let the one who hears say, “Come!” Let the one who is thirsty come; and let the one who wishes take the free gift of the water of life.
chapters.zh: 圣灵和新妇都说来。听见的人也该说来。口渴的人也当来。愿意的都可以白白取生命的水喝。

chapters.en: I warn everyone who hears the words of the prophecy of this scroll: If anyone adds anything to them, God will add to that person the plagues described in this scroll.
chapters.zh: 我向一切听见这书上预言的作见证，若有人在这预言上加添什么，神必将写在这书上的灾祸加在他身上。

chapters.en: And if anyone takes words away from this scroll of prophecy, God will take away from that person any share in the tree of life and in the Holy City, which are described in this scroll.
chapters.zh: 这书上的预言，若有人删去什么，神必从这书上所写的生命树，和圣城，删去他的分。

chapters.en: He who testifies to these things says, “Yes, I am coming soon.”Amen. Come, Lord Jesus.
chapters.zh: 证明这事的说，是了。我必快来。阿们。主耶稣阿，我愿你来。

chapters.en: The grace of the Lord Jesus be with God’s people. Amen.
chapters.zh: 愿主耶稣的恩惠，常与众圣徒同在。阿们。
